Rule.Original: An unfertilized megafauna egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: An unfertilized megafauna egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de megafauna. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Fertilized titanoboa egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby titanoboa. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized titanoboa egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby titanoboa. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de titanoboa. Si todo va bien, nacerá una cría de titanoboa. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Fertilized arthropleura egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an arthropleura larva. It can be eaten raw, but it tastes horrible.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized arthropleura egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an arthropleura larva. It can be eaten raw, but it tastes horrible.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de arthropleura. Si todo va bien, nacerá una larva de arthropleura. Puede comerse crudo, pero sabe horrible.

Rule.Original: Fertilized titanis egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby titanis. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized titanis egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby titanis. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de titanis. Si todo va bien, nacerá una cría de titanis. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A doedicurus' shell. It's remarkably durable but humans have no use for it. However, some collectors are still willing to pay a lot for one.
Rule.Raw: A doedicurus' shell. It's remarkably durable but humans have no use for it. However, some collectors are still willing to pay a lot for one.
Rule.Translated: El caparazón de un doedicurus. Es extraordinariamente resistente, aunque los humanos no le encuentran utilidad. Sin embargo, algunos coleccionistas están dispuestos a pagar mucho por uno.

Rule.Original: A mammoth's tusk. Very durable and valuable. Deadly but somewhat unwieldy as a weapon.
Rule.Raw: A mammoth's tusk. Very durable and valuable. Deadly but somewhat unwieldy as a weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un colmillo de mamut. Muy resistente y valioso. Mortal, aunque algo difícil de manejar como arma.

Rule.Original: Wool from a woolly mammoth. Provides great protection from cold and looks mighty stylish.
Rule.Raw: Wool from a woolly mammoth. Provides great protection from cold and looks mighty stylish.
Rule.Translated: Lana de mamut lanudo. Protege muy bien del frío y tiene muchísimo estilo.

Rule.Original: An elasmotherium's horn. Not nearly as deadly in human hands, but can still prove to be a relatively decent weapon.
Rule.Raw: An elasmotherium's horn. Not nearly as deadly in human hands, but can still prove to be a relatively decent weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un cuerno de elasmotherium. En manos humanas resulta mucho menos letal, pero puede servir como un arma bastante decente.

Rule.Original: Wool from an elasmotherium. The most exclusive kind of wool imaginable. It's as great for cold weather as it is beautiful.
Rule.Raw: Wool from an elasmotherium. The most exclusive kind of wool imaginable. It's as great for cold weather as it is beautiful.
Rule.Translated: Lana de elasmotherium. La clase de lana más exclusiva que puedas imaginar. Es tan adecuada para el frío como hermosa.

Rule.Original: A dead smilodon's pair of canines. Although a fantastic trophy, they aren't as good of a weapon when used by humans.
Rule.Raw: A dead smilodon's pair of canines. Although a fantastic trophy, they aren't as good of a weapon when used by humans.
Rule.Translated: Los dos colmillos de un smilodon muerto. Aunque son un trofeo magnífico, no resultan tan útiles como arma en manos humanas.

Rule.Original: A dead megaloceros' pair of antlers. Great as a decoration, way too unwieldy to be used as a weapon.
Rule.Raw: A dead megaloceros' pair of antlers. Great as a decoration, way too unwieldy to be used as a weapon.
Rule.Translated: Las dos astas de un megaloceros muerto. Una decoración estupenda, pero demasiado difíciles de manejar como arma.

Rule.Original: Fertilized megalania egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby megalania. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized megalania egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby megalania. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de megalania. Si todo va bien, nacerá una cría de megalania. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Very nutritious milk from a sivatherium.
Rule.Raw: Very nutritious milk from a sivatherium.

Rule.Original: Fertilized dinornis egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby dinornis bird. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized dinornis egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby dinornis bird. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de dinornis. Si todo va bien, nacerá un polluelo de dinornis. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Fertilized quinkana egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby quinkana. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de megalochelys. Si todo va bien, nacerá una cría de megalochelys. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Fertilized palaeeudyptes egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby palaeeudyptes. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized palaeeudyptes egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby palaeeudyptes. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de palaeeudyptes. Si todo va bien, nacerá una cría de palaeeudyptes. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de gigantophis. Si todo va bien, nacerá una cría de gigantophis. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Fertilized purussaurus egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby purussaurus. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized purussaurus egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby purussaurus. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de purussaurus. Si todo va bien, nacerá una cría de purussaurus. Puede comerse crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Fertilized meganeura egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a meganeura larva. It can be eaten raw, but it tastes horrible.
Rule.Raw: Fertilized meganeura egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a meganeura larva. It can be eaten raw, but it tastes horrible.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fecundado de meganeura. Si todo va bien, nacerá una larva de meganeura. Puede comerse crudo, pero sabe horrible.

Rule.Original: Wool from a josephoartigasia. Provides good insulation from both cold and heat. Very fluffy.
Rule.Raw: Wool from a josephoartigasia. Provides good insulation from both cold and heat. Very fluffy.
Rule.Translated: Lana de josephoartigasia. Aísla bien tanto del frío como del calor. Muy esponjosa.

Rule.Original: A deinotherium's tusk. Very durable and valuable. While somewhat unwieldy, it could be used for stabbing.
Rule.Raw: A deinotherium's tusk. Very durable and valuable. While somewhat unwieldy, it could be used for stabbing.
Rule.Translated: Un colmillo de deinotherium. Muy resistente y valioso. Aunque es algo difícil de manejar, podría usarse para apuñalar.

Rule.Original: A zygolophodon's enormous tusk. Extremely durable and valuable. Way too big to be effectively used as a weapon.
Rule.Raw: A zygolophodon's enormous tusk. Extremely durable and valuable. Way too big to be effectively used as a weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un colmillo enorme de zygolophodon. Extremadamente resistente y valioso. Demasiado grande para usarlo eficazmente como arma.

Rule.Original: A platybelodon's tusk. Somewhat small, compared to those of other proboscidea. Could be used as a stabbing weapon.
Rule.Raw: A platybelodon's tusk. Somewhat small, compared to those of other proboscidea. Could be used as a stabbing weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un colmillo de platybelodon. Algo pequeño comparado con los de otros proboscídeos. Podría usarse como arma punzante.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known land invertebrate of all time. Arthropleuras are huge, solitary, herbivorous millipedes that are mostly harmless, and will attack only in self-defense.
Some maniacs are willing to pay unreasonable amounts of money for eggs of this beast.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known land invertebrate of all time. Arthropleuras are huge, solitary, herbivorous millipedes that are mostly harmless, and will attack only in self-defense.
Some maniacs are willing to pay unreasonable amounts of money for eggs of this beast.
Rule.Translated:
Artrópodos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Los mayores invertebrados terrestres conocidos de todos los tiempos. Los arthropleura son enormes milpiés herbívoros y solitarios, generalmente inofensivos, que solo atacan para defenderse.
Algunos fanáticos están dispuestos a pagar sumas desorbitadas por los huevos de esta criatura.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known glyptodont. Its huge carapace is nearly unbreakable to any predator. 
Even though the tip of its tail is covered in spikes and would thus make for a decent weapon, it cannot use it effectively due to its very limited field of vision.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known glyptodont. Its huge carapace is nearly unbreakable to any predator. 
Even though the tip of its tail is covered in spikes and would thus make for a decent weapon, it cannot use it effectively due to its very limited field of vision.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

El mayor gliptodonte conocido. Su enorme caparazón es prácticamente impenetrable para cualquier depredador. 
Aunque la punta de su cola está cubierta de púas y podría servir como arma, no puede utilizarla eficazmente debido a su campo de visión muy limitado.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nDaeodons are large, pig-like, omnivorous animals. However, they are much more aggressive and dangerous than regular pigs or even wild boars. Try to stay away from their gigantic maws.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nDaeodons are large, pig-like, omnivorous animals. However, they are much more aggressive and dangerous than regular pigs or even wild boars. Try to stay away from their gigantic maws.
Rule.Translated: Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nLos daeodon son grandes animales omnívoros parecidos a los cerdos. Sin embargo, son mucho más agresivos y peligrosos que los cerdos normales o incluso que los jabalíes. Procura mantenerte lejos de sus enormes fauces.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nGigantopithecus is the largest known ape that ever lived. They are highly intelligent, social creatures that feed on seeds and fruit. Thanks to their thick fur, they are quite resistant to cold - the lone specimens seen in the mountains are said to have been the inspiration to stories about the mythical Big Foot.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nGigantopithecus is the largest known ape that ever lived. They are highly intelligent, social creatures that feed on seeds and fruit. Thanks to their thick fur, they are quite resistant to cold - the lone specimens seen in the mountains are said to have been the inspiration to stories about the mythical Big Foot.
Rule.Translated: Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nGigantopithecus es el mayor simio conocido que haya existido. Son criaturas sociales y muy inteligentes que se alimentan de semillas y frutas. Su espeso pelaje les proporciona bastante resistencia al frío; se dice que los ejemplares solitarios vistos en las montañas inspiraron las historias del mítico Pie Grande.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest land mammal known to man, Paraceratherium, is a gentle creature, however its size alone can also make it quite a formidable foe to face.
Feeds on plants and trees, which it can easily reach with its extraordinarily long neck, the trait that makes it unique to other genera of rhinoceroses.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest land mammal known to man, Paraceratherium, is a gentle creature, however its size alone can also make it quite a formidable foe to face.
Feeds on plants and trees, which it can easily reach with its extraordinarily long neck, the trait that makes it unique to other genera of rhinoceroses.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Paraceratherium, el mayor mamífero terrestre conocido, es una criatura apacible, aunque su tamaño puede convertirlo por sí solo en un rival formidable.
Se alimenta de plantas y árboles, que alcanza fácilmente gracias a su cuello extraordinariamente largo, un rasgo que lo distingue de otros géneros de rinocerontes.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nColloquially known as terror birds, titanis are large carnivorous flightless birds. Their abnormally huge beaks are incredibly deadly, and their strong legs not only allow them to easily outrun their prey, but can also serve vicious kicks.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nColloquially known as terror birds, titanis are large carnivorous flightless birds. Their abnormally huge beaks are incredibly deadly, and their strong legs not only allow them to easily outrun their prey, but can also serve vicious kicks.
Rule.Translated: Aves gigantes extinguidas hace mucho tiempo, devueltas a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nConocidos popularmente como aves del terror, los titanis son grandes aves carnívoras incapaces de volar. Sus picos anormalmente grandes son increíblemente mortíferos, y sus fuertes patas no solo les permiten alcanzar fácilmente a sus presas, sino también propinar patadas brutales.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe largest snake ever discovered, Titanoboa, is capable of swallowing cows whole. It can kill even medium-sized animals in just seconds, and thus should be stayed away from at all costs.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe largest snake ever discovered, Titanoboa, is capable of swallowing cows whole. It can kill even medium-sized animals in just seconds, and thus should be stayed away from at all costs.
Rule.Translated: Reptiles gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nTitanoboa, la mayor serpiente descubierta, es capaz de tragarse vacas enteras. Puede matar incluso a animales medianos en cuestión de segundos, por lo que conviene mantenerse lejos de ella a toda costa.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Very close relatives of modern elephants. Hunted by early humans for their meat, fur, and valuable tusks. 
As opposed to their today's equivalents, the mammoths' ears and tails are relatively short - to minimise frostbite and heat loss.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Very close relatives of modern elephants. Hunted by early humans for their meat, fur, and valuable tusks. 
As opposed to their today's equivalents, the mammoths' ears and tails are relatively short - to minimise frostbite and heat loss.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Parientes muy cercanos de los elefantes actuales. Los primeros humanos los cazaban por su carne, su pelaje y sus valiosos colmillos. 
A diferencia de sus equivalentes actuales, los mamuts tienen orejas y colas relativamente cortas para reducir las lesiones por congelación y la pérdida de calor.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe largest horned rhinoceros of all time. Elasmotherium uses its giant singular horn, placed on its forehead, to fight, attract mates, sweep snow, and dig in the ground in search of water and plant roots.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe largest horned rhinoceros of all time. Elasmotherium uses its giant singular horn, placed on its forehead, to fight, attract mates, sweep snow, and dig in the ground in search of water and plant roots.
Rule.Translated: Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nEl mayor rinoceronte con cuerno de todos los tiempos. Elasmotherium utiliza su enorme cuerno único, situado en la frente, para luchar, atraer parejas, apartar la nieve y excavar el suelo en busca de agua y raíces.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nSmilodon is an incredibly deadly predator, which kills its prey by holding it still with its strong forelimbs, and sinking its enormous pair of canines deep inside its neck.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nSmilodon is an incredibly deadly predator, which kills its prey by holding it still with its strong forelimbs, and sinking its enormous pair of canines deep inside its neck.
Rule.Translated: Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nSmilodon es un depredador increíblemente mortífero que mata a sus presas inmovilizándolas con sus fuertes extremidades delanteras y hundiendo sus enormes colmillos en el cuello.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Despite what its bizzare appearance could suggest, chalicotherium is most closely related to horses and rhinoceroses.
It walks on its knuckles and uses its huge sloth-like claws as both a rake and a mean of defense against predators.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Despite what its bizzare appearance could suggest, chalicotherium is most closely related to horses and rhinoceroses.
It walks on its knuckles and uses its huge sloth-like claws as both a rake and a mean of defense against predators.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Pese a lo que podría sugerir su extraño aspecto, chalicotherium está estrechamente emparentado con los caballos y los rinocerontes.
Camina apoyándose en los nudillos y utiliza sus enormes garras, similares a las de un perezoso, tanto para rastrillar como para defenderse de los depredadores.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Despite being colloquially known as the 'Giant Elk', it's, in fact, not an elk but an enormous deer.
Megaloceros is an easily angered herbivore that can cause severe wounds with its extraordinarily large antlers, which are otherwise used exclusively for attracting females.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Despite being colloquially known as the 'Giant Elk', it's, in fact, not an elk but an enormous deer.
Megaloceros is an easily angered herbivore that can cause severe wounds with its extraordinarily large antlers, which are otherwise used exclusively for attracting females.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Aunque se conoce popularmente como «alce gigante», en realidad es un ciervo enorme, no un alce.
Megaloceros es un herbívoro que se irrita fácilmente y puede causar heridas graves con su cornamenta extraordinariamente grande, utilizada por lo demás exclusivamente para atraer a las hembras.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known kangaroo that ever existed. Unlike its modern equivalents, procoptodons move around not by hopping but by walking, just like hominids.
They are very dangerous due to their ability to throw unbelievably swift punches.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known kangaroo that ever existed. Unlike its modern equivalents, procoptodons move around not by hopping but by walking, just like hominids.
They are very dangerous due to their ability to throw unbelievably swift punches.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

El mayor canguro conocido que haya existido. A diferencia de sus equivalentes actuales, los procoptodon se desplazan caminando, como los homínidos, en lugar de saltar.
Son muy peligrosos por su capacidad de lanzar golpes increíblemente rápidos.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest terrestial lizard of all time, as well as the biggest venomous vertebrate that's ever existed.
Because of its relatively short legs, most of megalania's prey can easily outrun it, which is why it most often has to rely on the element of surprise in its hunts.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest terrestial lizard of all time, as well as the biggest venomous vertebrate that's ever existed.
Because of its relatively short legs, most of megalania's prey can easily outrun it, which is why it most often has to rely on the element of surprise in its hunts.
Rule.Translated:
Reptiles gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

El mayor lagarto terrestre de todos los tiempos y el mayor vertebrado venenoso que haya existido.
Debido a sus patas relativamente cortas, la mayoría de las presas de megalania pueden dejarlo atrás fácilmente, por lo que suele depender del factor sorpresa para cazar.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Gomphotaria is equipped with not two, but four huge tusks that it uses to hammer and pierce its prey with.
Their seal-like bodies allow them to move very swiftly underwater but their huge mass as well as a lack of legs renders them somewhat sluggish on land.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Gomphotaria is equipped with not two, but four huge tusks that it uses to hammer and pierce its prey with.
Their seal-like bodies allow them to move very swiftly underwater but their huge mass as well as a lack of legs renders them somewhat sluggish on land.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Gomphotaria tiene cuatro enormes colmillos en lugar de dos, que utiliza para golpear y perforar a sus presas.
Su cuerpo parecido al de una foca le permite moverse con rapidez bajo el agua, pero su gran masa y la ausencia de patas lo vuelven algo lento en tierra.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known marsupial to have ever lived. As huge as a rhinoceros, it resembles a gigantic wombat.
Diprotodon's a relatively peaceful creature, however its huge pair of forward-facing teeth as well as its strong claws can prove quite dangerous in a combat situation.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known marsupial to have ever lived. As huge as a rhinoceros, it resembles a gigantic wombat.
Diprotodon's a relatively peaceful creature, however its huge pair of forward-facing teeth as well as its strong claws can prove quite dangerous in a combat situation.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

El mayor marsupial conocido que haya existido. Tan grande como un rinoceronte, se parece a un wombat gigantesco.
Diprotodon es relativamente apacible, aunque sus enormes dientes orientados hacia delante y sus fuertes garras pueden resultar muy peligrosos en combate.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nOne of the largest, if not the largest bear in history. What stands out the most about its appearance is the disproportionately short snout compared to other bears and the extraordinarily long legs it possesses. The latter makes it so hardly any prey can effectively outrun it.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nOne of the largest, if not the largest bear in history. What stands out the most about its appearance is the disproportionately short snout compared to other bears and the extraordinarily long legs it possesses. The latter makes it so hardly any prey can effectively outrun it.
Rule.Translated: Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nUno de los mayores osos de la historia, si no el mayor. Sus rasgos más llamativos son el hocico desproporcionadamente corto frente al de otros osos y sus patas extraordinariamente largas. Estas últimas hacen que prácticamente ninguna presa pueda escapar de él corriendo.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Gigantic hyena-like predators. Their exceptionally strong jaws easily crush bones.
Extremely aggresive, it's known to surprisingly often prey on animals larger than itself.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Gigantic hyena-like predators. Their exceptionally strong jaws easily crush bones.
Extremely aggresive, it's known to surprisingly often prey on animals larger than itself.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Depredadores gigantescos parecidos a hienas. Sus mandíbulas excepcionalmente fuertes aplastan huesos con facilidad.
Son extremadamente agresivos y cazan animales mayores que ellos con una frecuencia sorprendente.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe biggest ruminant in history. Unlike its modern equivalents, giraffes and okapis, sivatherium possesses two pairs of ossicones, one that is wide and resembles antlers, and the other being more horn-like, placed above its eyes.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe biggest ruminant in history. Unlike its modern equivalents, giraffes and okapis, sivatherium possesses two pairs of ossicones, one that is wide and resembles antlers, and the other being more horn-like, placed above its eyes.
Rule.Translated: Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nEl mayor rumiante de la historia. A diferencia de sus equivalentes actuales, las jirafas y los okapis, sivatherium tiene dos pares de osiconos: uno ancho y parecido a una cornamenta, y otro más similar a cuernos, situado sobre los ojos.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

This mysterious carnivore was the biggest predatory mammal of its time.
Often described as a "bear-dog", it was apparently related to entelodonts, hippopotamuses, and whales.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

This mysterious carnivore was the biggest predatory mammal of its time.
Often described as a "bear-dog", it was apparently related to entelodonts, hippopotamuses, and whales.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Este misterioso carnívoro fue el mayor mamífero depredador de su época.
A menudo descrito como un «oso-perro», al parecer estaba emparentado con los entelodontes, los hipopótamos y las ballenas.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe tallest birds to ever exist. They belong to the moa family and are characterised by quite dramatic sexual dimorphism, with the females being significantly larger than the males
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe tallest birds to ever exist. They belong to the moa family and are characterised by quite dramatic sexual dimorphism, with the females being significantly larger than the males
Rule.Translated: Aves gigantes extinguidas hace mucho tiempo, devueltas a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nLas aves más altas que hayan existido. Pertenecen a la familia de los moa y presentan un dimorfismo sexual muy marcado, con hembras considerablemente mayores que los machos

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Despite it possessing a trunk, macrauchenia's nostrils are actually located on the top of its head.
It's extraordinarily agile and thanks to its ability of rapidly changing directions while running at high speed, it can escape most predators fairly easily.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Despite it possessing a trunk, macrauchenia's nostrils are actually located on the top of its head.
It's extraordinarily agile and thanks to its ability of rapidly changing directions while running at high speed, it can escape most predators fairly easily.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Aunque tiene trompa, las fosas nasales de macrauchenia están situadas en la parte superior de la cabeza.
Es extraordinariamente ágil y puede cambiar de dirección rápidamente mientras corre a gran velocidad, lo que le permite escapar de la mayoría de los depredadores con bastante facilidad.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

This terrestrial crocodile possesses long legs, which render it much better of a runner than its modern equivalents.
Quinkana's teeth are shaped like knives, which makes them perfect for practically cutting away parts of its prey.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

This terrestrial crocodile possesses long legs, which render it much better of a runner than its modern equivalents.
Quinkana's teeth are shaped like knives, which makes them perfect for practically cutting away parts of its prey.
Rule.Translated:
Reptiles gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Este cocodrilo terrestre tiene patas largas que lo convierten en un corredor mucho más eficaz que sus equivalentes actuales.
Los dientes de quinkana tienen forma de cuchillo, lo que los hace perfectos para cortar trozos de sus presas.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

"Deinotherium" means "terrible beast". It's a unique cousin to mammoths and mastodons, equipped with downward curving tusks on the lower jaw.
Very short-tempered and incredibly dangerous when angered.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

"Deinotherium" means "terrible beast". It's a unique cousin to mammoths and mastodons, equipped with downward curving tusks on the lower jaw.
Very short-tempered and incredibly dangerous when angered.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

«Deinotherium» significa «bestia terrible». Es un pariente singular de los mamuts y mastodontes, con colmillos curvados hacia abajo en la mandíbula inferior.
Se irrita fácilmente y resulta increíblemente peligroso cuando se enfada.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The ancestor of domestic cattle, the aurochs, was to modern cows what wolves are to dogs.
Larger, tougher, faster, but producing less resources and eating more than today's cattle.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The ancestor of domestic cattle, the aurochs, was to modern cows what wolves are to dogs.
Larger, tougher, faster, but producing less resources and eating more than today's cattle.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

El uro, antepasado del ganado doméstico, era para las vacas actuales lo que el lobo es para el perro.
Más grande, resistente y rápido, pero produce menos recursos y come más que el ganado actual.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest tortoise of all time.
There aren't many predators that pose a threat to megalochelys, thanks to its thick and hard as rock shell. The ones that attempt to attack it anyway, will have to be prepared to deal with its surprisingly powerful bite.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest tortoise of all time.
There aren't many predators that pose a threat to megalochelys, thanks to its thick and hard as rock shell. The ones that attempt to attack it anyway, will have to be prepared to deal with its surprisingly powerful bite.
Rule.Translated:
Reptiles gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

La mayor tortuga terrestre de todos los tiempos.
Pocos depredadores amenazan a megalochelys gracias a su caparazón grueso y duro como una roca. Quienes intenten atacarla deberán estar preparados para afrontar su mordida sorprendentemente potente.

Rule.Original: Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe biggest penguin in history. While it's clearly best fitted for hunting fish, palaeeudyptes won't hesitate to take advantage of its huge size, and will attempt to hunt other vertebrates that are smaller than itself.
Rule.Raw: Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.\n\nThe biggest penguin in history. While it's clearly best fitted for hunting fish, palaeeudyptes won't hesitate to take advantage of its huge size, and will attempt to hunt other vertebrates that are smaller than itself.
Rule.Translated: Aves gigantes extinguidas hace mucho tiempo, devueltas a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.\n\nEl mayor pingüino de la historia. Aunque está claramente mejor adaptado para cazar peces, palaeeudyptes no dudará en aprovechar su enorme tamaño e intentará cazar otros vertebrados menores que él.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest rodent of all time, josephoartigasia, resembles a gigantic capybara or pacarana, but in a few regards it appears to be closer to today's hippopotamuses.
It is not a very good runner, and to compensate for that, it sports huge incisors that could prove very dangerous to lesser predators.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest rodent of all time, josephoartigasia, resembles a gigantic capybara or pacarana, but in a few regards it appears to be closer to today's hippopotamuses.
It is not a very good runner, and to compensate for that, it sports huge incisors that could prove very dangerous to lesser predators.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Josephoartigasia, el mayor roedor de todos los tiempos, se parece a una capibara o pacarana gigantesca, aunque en algunos aspectos recuerda más a los hipopótamos actuales.
No es muy buen corredor y, para compensarlo, tiene enormes incisivos que pueden resultar muy peligrosos para los depredadores más pequeños.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The second biggest snake in history, thought to have been the largest until the discovery of titanoboa.
It much prefers hunting big animals as they're easier to smell out.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The second biggest snake in history, thought to have been the largest until the discovery of titanoboa.
It much prefers hunting big animals as they're easier to smell out.
Rule.Translated:
Reptiles gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

La segunda mayor serpiente de la historia, considerada la más grande hasta el descubrimiento de titanoboa.
Prefiere cazar animales grandes porque le resulta más fácil localizarlos por el olfato.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest flying insect to ever exist, meganeura, just like modern dragonflies, is a highly specialised predator.
Swift and agile, it used to have no aerial competition, which was one of the reasons why it had evolved to be so gigantic.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest flying insect to ever exist, meganeura, just like modern dragonflies, is a highly specialised predator.
Swift and agile, it used to have no aerial competition, which was one of the reasons why it had evolved to be so gigantic.
Rule.Translated:
Artrópodos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Meganeura, el mayor insecto volador que haya existido, es un depredador muy especializado, al igual que las libélulas actuales.
Rápido y ágil, no tenía competencia en el aire, uno de los motivos por los que evolucionó hasta alcanzar un tamaño tan grande.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

One of the mastodons, and owner of some of the longest tusks in history.
While more primitive than mammoths, it's bigger, tougher, and more powerful than most of them. It is also heavier than some sauropod dinosaurs.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

One of the mastodons, and owner of some of the longest tusks in history.
While more primitive than mammoths, it's bigger, tougher, and more powerful than most of them. It is also heavier than some sauropod dinosaurs.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Uno de los mastodontes, con algunos de los colmillos más largos de la historia.
Aunque es más primitivo que los mamuts, supera a la mayoría de ellos en tamaño, resistencia y fuerza. También pesa más que algunos dinosaurios saurópodos.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Very unique kind of proboscideans, which, due to the shape of their two lower teeth is popularly known as "shovel tuskers".
It grasps tree branches with its trunk and rubs them against the lower teeth to cut them off. The "tusk shovel" is also used by platybelodons to strip bark from trees.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Very unique kind of proboscideans, which, due to the shape of their two lower teeth is popularly known as "shovel tuskers".
It grasps tree branches with its trunk and rubs them against the lower teeth to cut them off. The "tusk shovel" is also used by platybelodons to strip bark from trees.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Un tipo muy singular de proboscídeos, conocidos popularmente como «colmillos de pala» por la forma de sus dos dientes inferiores.
Sujeta las ramas con la trompa y las frota contra los dientes inferiores para cortarlas. Los platybelodon también utilizan esta «pala de colmillos» para arrancar la corteza de los árboles.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Quite possibly, the largest crocodilian of all time, and also the biggest reptile to roam the Earth after the extinction of dinosaurs.
It is so massive that even giant ground sloths have a place on its menu.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Quite possibly, the largest crocodilian of all time, and also the biggest reptile to roam the Earth after the extinction of dinosaurs.
It is so massive that even giant ground sloths have a place on its menu.
Rule.Translated:
Reptiles gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Posiblemente el mayor cocodriliano de todos los tiempos y el mayor reptil que recorrió la Tierra tras la extinción de los dinosaurios.
Es tan enorme que incluso los perezosos terrestres gigantes forman parte de su dieta.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

A very primitive, giant cousin of rhinoceroses.
It is neither the most beautiful, nor the most intelligent animal in history, with its brain being merely the size of an orange, but it can make up for it with its strong back, which renders it a good partner for a journey.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

A very primitive, giant cousin of rhinoceroses.
It is neither the most beautiful, nor the most intelligent animal in history, with its brain being merely the size of an orange, but it can make up for it with its strong back, which renders it a good partner for a journey.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Un pariente gigantesco y muy primitivo de los rinocerontes.
No es el animal más hermoso ni el más inteligente de la historia, pues su cerebro apenas tiene el tamaño de una naranja. Lo compensa con su fuerte lomo, que lo convierte en un buen compañero de viaje.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest land scorpion to ever exist.
Pulmonoscorpius is a solitary predator capable of taking down creatures way larger than itself with its deadly venom. Its sting should be stayed away from at all costs.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest land scorpion to ever exist.
Pulmonoscorpius is a solitary predator capable of taking down creatures way larger than itself with its deadly venom. Its sting should be stayed away from at all costs.
Rule.Translated:
Artrópodos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

El mayor escorpión terrestre que haya existido.
Pulmonoscorpius es un depredador solitario capaz de abatir criaturas mucho mayores que él con su veneno mortal. Conviene mantenerse lejos de su aguijón a toda costa.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

A gigantic species of baboons with an unusually prominent liking for meat.
They used to be the natural enemies of early humans, hunting them down more often than one could expect. It is possible that they could see modern humans as prey, too.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

A gigantic species of baboons with an unusually prominent liking for meat.
They used to be the natural enemies of early humans, hunting them down more often than one could expect. It is possible that they could see modern humans as prey, too.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Una especie gigantesca de babuinos con una afición especialmente marcada por la carne.
Eran enemigos naturales de los primeros humanos y los cazaban con más frecuencia de la esperada. Es posible que también consideren presas a los humanos actuales.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Giant beavers, the largest to ever exist.
Its incisors aren't as well fitted for cutting wood as those of its modern equivalents, which is why it doesn't bother with constructing dams. This makes it so it will more often have to resort to either running from predators or attempting to fight them off, instead of simply hiding away from them.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Giant beavers, the largest to ever exist.
Its incisors aren't as well fitted for cutting wood as those of its modern equivalents, which is why it doesn't bother with constructing dams. This makes it so it will more often have to resort to either running from predators or attempting to fight them off, instead of simply hiding away from them.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

Castores gigantes, los mayores que hayan existido.
Sus incisivos están menos adaptados para cortar madera que los de sus equivalentes actuales, por lo que no construyen presas. Esto hace que deban huir o enfrentarse a los depredadores con mayor frecuencia, en lugar de limitarse a esconderse de ellos.

Rule.Original:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest mustelid ever discovered. Enhydriodon is a bear-sized ancestor of modern otters, and a very dangerous predator that used to be a big threat to early humans.
Great swimmers, surprisingly swift on land.
Rule.Raw:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest mustelid ever discovered. Enhydriodon is a bear-sized ancestor of modern otters, and a very dangerous predator that used to be a big threat to early humans.
Great swimmers, surprisingly swift on land.
Rule.Translated:
Mamíferos gigantes extinguidos hace mucho tiempo, devueltos a la vida como parte del Proyecto Megafauna.

El mayor mustélido descubierto. Enhydriodon es un antepasado de las nutrias actuales del tamaño de un oso, y un depredador muy peligroso que supuso una gran amenaza para los primeros humanos.
Son grandes nadadores y sorprendentemente rápidos en tierra.

Rule.Original: Tablets of potassium iodide are supplied for emergency purposes related to blockade of radioiodine uptake.
Rule.Raw: Tablets of potassium iodide are supplied for emergency purposes related to blockade of radioiodine uptake.
Rule.Translated: Los comprimidos de yoduro de potasio se suministran en caso de emergencia para bloquear la captación de yodo radiactivo.

Rule.Original: Tablets of potassium iodide are supplied for emergency purposes related to blockade of radioiodine uptake.
Rule.Raw: Tablets of potassium iodide are supplied for emergency purposes related to blockade of radioiodine uptake.
Rule.Translated: Los comprimidos de yoduro de potasio se suministran en caso de emergencia para bloquear la captación de yodo radiactivo.

Rule.Original: A plume of radioactive smoke and ash from a reactor meltdown has been ejected into the air and will settle in the surrounding area.
Rule.Raw: A plume of radioactive smoke and ash from a reactor meltdown has been ejected into the air and will settle in the surrounding area.
Rule.Translated: Una columna de humo y cenizas radiactivas procedentes de la fusión de un reactor ha sido expulsada al aire y se asentará en los alrededores.

Rule.Original: The worst of the radioactive dust has been washed away.
Rule.Raw: The worst of the radioactive dust has been washed away.
Rule.Translated: Lo peor de la lluvia radiactiva ya ha pasado.

Rule.Original: A plume of radioactive smoke and ash from a nuclear blast has been ejected into the air and will settle in the surrounding area.
Rule.Raw: A plume of radioactive smoke and ash from a nuclear blast has been ejected into the air and will settle in the surrounding area.
Rule.Translated: Una columna de humo y cenizas radiactivas procedentes de una explosión nuclear ha sido expulsada al aire y se asentará en los alrededores.

Rule.Original: The worst of the radioactive dust has been washed away.
Rule.Raw: The worst of the radioactive dust has been washed away.
Rule.Translated: Lo peor de la lluvia radiactiva ya ha pasado.
Una ceguera repentina causada por un destello.
Una exposición mortal a la radiación.
Sacar barras de combustible de TargetA.

Rule.Original: View and manage Rimatomics research projects.
Rule.Raw: View and manage Rimatomics research projects.
Rule.Translated: Permite ver y gestionar los proyectos de investigación de Rimatomics.
Tiempo de espera del comerciante de Rimatomics

Rule.Original: Use heat and strong electromagnets to break turbine blades into useful resources.
Rule.Raw: Use heat and strong electromagnets to break turbine blades into useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza el calor y potentes electroimanes para romper las aspas de las turbinas y convertirlas en recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: Salvaging useful materials from a warhead
Rule.Raw: Salvaging useful materials from a warhead
Rule.Translated: Recupera de forma segura materiales útiles de una cabeza nuclear.

Rule.Original: A probe has been detected in orbit! It seems to be sending signals to the surface; maybe we can decipher its message.
Rule.Raw: A probe has been detected in orbit! It seems to be sending signals to the surface; maybe we can decipher its message.
Rule.Translated: ¡Se ha detectado una sonda en órbita! Parece estar enviando señales a la superficie, tal vez podamos descifrar su mensaje.

Rule.Original:
You open a connection to the probe and a recorded message starts to play.

Someone with the slimy demeanour of a used bionics salesman claims to represent a trading faction known as "Rimatomics".

As he makes his sales pitch, exabytes of data begins flooding into the console. He explains that he's sending blueprints to construct a Rimatomics research bench, which you can use to purchase plans for some of their technology or request trade ships.

Check the Rimatomics tab in the architect menu.
Rule.Raw:
You open a connection to the probe and a recorded message starts to play.

Someone with the slimy demeanour of a used bionics salesman claims to represent a trading faction known as "Rimatomics".

As he makes his sales pitch, exabytes of data begins flooding into the console. He explains that he's sending blueprints to construct a Rimatomics research bench, which you can use to purchase plans for some of their technology or request trade ships.

Check the Rimatomics tab in the architect menu.
Rule.Translated:
Abres una conexión con la sonda y empieza a reproducirse un mensaje grabado.

Alguien con la actitud untuosa de un vendedor de implantes biónicos usados afirma representar a una facción comercial llamada «Rimatomics».

Mientras presenta su oferta, exabytes de datos empiezan a inundar la consola. Explica que envía planos para construir un banco de investigación Rimatomics, donde podrás comprar planos de algunas de sus tecnologías o solicitar naves comerciales.

Busca la pestaña Rimatomics en el menú del arquitecto.

Rule.Original: The facility has broken down during research
Rule.Raw: The facility has broken down during research
Rule.Translated: La instalación se ha averiado durante la investigación

Rule.Original: The facility is leaking a short burst of radiation
Rule.Raw: The facility is leaking a short burst of radiation
Rule.Translated: La instalación está liberando una breve ráfaga de radiación

Rule.Original: The facility is leaking microwave radiation
Rule.Raw: The facility is leaking microwave radiation
Rule.Translated: La instalación tiene una fuga de radiación de microondas
La instalación tiene una fuga de ácido

Rule.Original: The facility is leaking toxic gas
Rule.Raw: The facility is leaking toxic gas
Rule.Translated: La instalación tiene una fuga de gas tóxico

Rule.Original: A blinding flash of light has emanated from the facility
Rule.Raw: A blinding flash of light has emanated from the facility
Rule.Translated: La instalación ha emitido un destello de luz cegador

Rule.Original: An arc of high voltage electricity shot from the facility
Rule.Raw: An arc of high voltage electricity shot from the facility
Rule.Translated: La instalación ha emitido un arco eléctrico de alta tensión

Rule.Original: A Laser discharge shot from the facility
Rule.Raw: A Laser discharge shot from the facility
Rule.Translated: La instalación ha emitido una descarga láser

Rule.Original: The facility has suffered a power surge and started a fire
Rule.Raw: The facility has suffered a power surge and started a fire
Rule.Translated: La instalación ha sufrido una sobretensión y se ha incendiado

Rule.Original: The facility has short-circuited. Switch off the power immediately or the building will be destroyed!
Rule.Raw: The facility has short-circuited. Switch off the power immediately or the building will be destroyed!
Rule.Translated: La instalación ha sufrido un cortocircuito. ¡Desconecta la energía de inmediato o el edificio quedará destruido!

Rule.Original: It is important to protect colonists from exposure to dangerous levels of radiation. Rimatomics offers portable devices which can be used for detecting ionizing radiation. All colonists will be equipped with radiation detectors, so that ionizing events will produce audible clicks. The dose rate is displayed as text.
Rule.Raw: It is important to protect colonists from exposure to dangerous levels of radiation. Rimatomics offers portable devices which can be used for detecting ionizing radiation. All colonists will be equipped with radiation detectors, so that ionizing events will produce audible clicks. The dose rate is displayed as text.
Rule.Translated: Es importante proteger a los colonos de niveles peligrosos de radiación. Rimatomics ofrece dispositivos portátiles para detectar radiación ionizante. Todos los colonos llevarán detectores, que emitirán chasquidos audibles al detectar ionización. La tasa de dosis se muestra como texto.

Rule.Original: All colonists are now equipped with radiation detectors. Ionizing events will produce audible clicks, and the dose rate is displayed as text with a strength ranging from 0-5.
Rule.Raw: All colonists are now equipped with radiation detectors. Ionizing events will produce audible clicks, and the dose rate is displayed as text with a strength ranging from 0-5.
Rule.Translated: Todos los colonos llevan ahora detectores de radiación. La ionización producirá chasquidos audibles y la tasa de dosis se mostrará como texto con una intensidad de 0-5.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the radiation detectors work.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the radiation detectors work.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe estudiar los diseños y aprender cómo funcionan los detectores de radiación.

Rule.Original: A skilled crafter needs to figure out how to build and maintain radiation detectors for all colonists using the resources and tools available.
Rule.Raw: A skilled crafter needs to figure out how to build and maintain radiation detectors for all colonists using the resources and tools available.
Rule.Translated: Un artesano experto debe averiguar cómo fabricar y mantener detectores de radiación para todos los colonos con los recursos y las herramientas disponibles.

Rule.Original: Protect your colonists from radiation with shielded clothing. More importantly, radiation suits prevent direct contact with or inhalation of radioactive particles or gas.
Rule.Raw: Protect your colonists from radiation with shielded clothing. More importantly, radiation suits prevent direct contact with or inhalation of radioactive particles or gas.
Rule.Translated: Protege a tus colonos de la radiación con ropa blindada. Además, los trajes antirradiación evitan el contacto directo con partículas o gases radiactivos y su inhalación.

Rule.Original: You can now produce your own radiation suits and MOPP suits at a Rimatomics Machining Table.
Rule.Raw: You can now produce your own radiation suits and MOPP suits at a Rimatomics Machining Table.
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar trajes antirradiación y trajes MOPP en una mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the radiation suits work before we can start making our own.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the radiation suits work before we can start making our own.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe estudiar los diseños y aprender cómo funcionan los trajes antirradiación antes de que podamos fabricar los nuestros.

Rule.Original: A skilled crafter needs to draw up plans for tailoring radiation suits using the resources and tools available to us.
Rule.Raw: A skilled crafter needs to draw up plans for tailoring radiation suits using the resources and tools available to us.
Rule.Translated: Un artesano cualificado debe elaborar los planos para confeccionar trajes antirradiación con los recursos y herramientas disponibles.

Rule.Original: Before your colonists can build full-scale Rimatomics nuclear reactors or other nuclear-based technologies, they must first train and research these technologies using a research reactor.
Rule.Raw: Before your colonists can build full-scale Rimatomics nuclear reactors or other nuclear-based technologies, they must first train and research these technologies using a research reactor.
Rule.Translated: Antes de construir reactores nucleares Rimatomics a escala completa u otras tecnologías nucleares, tus colonos deben formarse e investigar estas tecnologías con un reactor de investigación.

Rule.Original: More advanced research is now available.
Rule.Raw: More advanced research is now available.
Rule.Translated: Ahora hay investigaciones más avanzadas disponibles.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the research reactor works before we can build our own.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the research reactor works before we can build our own.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe estudiar los diseños y aprender cómo funciona el reactor de investigación antes de que podamos construir el nuestro.

Rule.Original: Construct a research reactor. Colonists will need access to the reactor for experimentation. It is advised to build the reactor in a secure, fireproof lab.
Rule.Raw: Construct a research reactor. Colonists will need access to the reactor for experimentation. It is advised to build the reactor in a secure, fireproof lab.
Rule.Translated: Construye un reactor de investigación. Los colonos necesitarán acceder a él para realizar experimentos. Se recomienda construirlo en un laboratorio seguro y resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original: Install reactor control software and perform training exercises while testing the reactor's capabilities.
Rule.Raw: Install reactor control software and perform training exercises while testing the reactor's capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Instala el software de control del reactor y realiza ejercicios de entrenamiento mientras pruebas sus capacidades.

Rule.Original: The Rimatomics nuclear power plant is a scalable design with the ability to run multiple reactors, turbine generators and cooling solutions in a single system. Each reactor is capable of producing more than 200kW of power when fully fueled. Reactors can also be used for plutonium production.
Rule.Raw: The Rimatomics nuclear power plant is a scalable design with the ability to run multiple reactors, turbine generators and cooling solutions in a single system. Each reactor is capable of producing more than 200kW of power when fully fueled. Reactors can also be used for plutonium production.
Rule.Translated: La central nuclear Rimatomics tiene un diseño ampliable que permite utilizar varios reactores, generadores de turbina y sistemas de refrigeración en un único sistema. Cada reactor puede producir más de 200kW de potencia con una carga completa de combustible. También pueden utilizarse para producir plutonio.

Rule.Original: You are no longer limited to building one of each part of the reactor system. You can expand by adding more cores, turbines, and coolers, and perform research using the Rimatomics research bench to improve upon the design.
Rule.Raw: You are no longer limited to building one of each part of the reactor system. You can expand by adding more cores, turbines, and coolers, and perform research using the Rimatomics research bench to improve upon the design.
Rule.Translated: Ya puedes construir más de una pieza de cada tipo del sistema del reactor. Puedes ampliarlo añadiendo núcleos, turbinas y refrigeradores, e investigar mejoras del diseño en el banco de investigación Rimatomics.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study the Rimatomics reactor designs and prepare for the construction of our first power reactor.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study the Rimatomics reactor designs and prepare for the construction of our first power reactor.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe estudiar los diseños de los reactores Rimatomics y preparar la construcción de nuestro primer reactor de energía.
Experimentar con reactores de investigación (riesgo alto)

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to experiment with the research reactor. This step has a chance for catastrophic failures!
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to experiment with the research reactor. This step has a chance for catastrophic failures!
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe experimentar con el reactor de investigación. ¡Este paso puede provocar fallos catastróficos!

Rule.Original: Build the frame for a nuclear reactor core. Note that once the frame is complete, more work must be done to finish constructing the core. It is highly recommended that the core be built in a containment room to protect colonists during fuel transfer. The thickness of the wall and HP of the materials used determines how much radiation is absorbed. We advise leaving space around the core as the frequency of radiation damage also decreases over distance.
Rule.Raw: Build the frame for a nuclear reactor core. Note that once the frame is complete, more work must be done to finish constructing the core. It is highly recommended that the core be built in a containment room to protect colonists during fuel transfer. The thickness of the wall and HP of the materials used determines how much radiation is absorbed. We advise leaving space around the core as the frequency of radiation damage also decreases over distance.
Rule.Translated: Construye la estructura de un núcleo de reactor nuclear. Una vez terminada, hará falta más trabajo para completar el núcleo. Se recomienda encarecidamente construirlo en una sala de contención para proteger a los colonos durante el traslado de combustible. El grosor de las paredes y los puntos de resistencia de los materiales utilizados determinan cuánta radiación absorben. Aconsejamos dejar espacio alrededor del núcleo, ya que la frecuencia del daño por radiación también disminuye con la distancia.

Rule.Original: The turbine requires a large quantity of turbine blades, which can be manufactured at a Rimatomics machining table.
Rule.Raw: The turbine requires a large quantity of turbine blades, which can be manufactured at a Rimatomics machining table.
Rule.Translated: La turbina necesita muchas palas, que pueden fabricarse en una mesa de mecanizado de Rimatomics.

Rule.Original: Connect the reactor to the turbine
Rule.Raw: Connect the reactor to the turbine
Rule.Translated: Conectar el reactor a la turbina

Rule.Original: Connect the reactor core to the turbine generator by constructing a (Steam pipe), and (Cold water pipe) between them. Turbines are not dangerous, and can be built outside of shielded containment rooms, but must be indoors.
Rule.Raw: Connect the reactor core to the turbine generator by constructing a (Steam pipe), and (Cold water pipe) between them. Turbines are not dangerous, and can be built outside of shielded containment rooms, but must be indoors.
Rule.Translated: Conecta el núcleo del reactor al generador de turbina construyendo una (tubería de vapor) y una (tubería de agua fría) entre ambos. Las turbinas no son peligrosas y pueden construirse fuera de las salas de contención blindadas, pero deben estar bajo techo.

Rule.Original: Build one of the available cooling systems and connect it to a turbine using (Coolant pipe). There are three available cooling systems>: water cooling requires rivers or large bodies of water, cooling towers require a lot of power and space and must be placed outside, and radiators have the lowest cooling capacity, but are smaller and cheaper to build and can be placed indoors.
Rule.Raw: Build one of the available cooling systems and connect it to a turbine using (Coolant pipe). There are three available cooling systems>: water cooling requires rivers or large bodies of water, cooling towers require a lot of power and space and must be placed outside, and radiators have the lowest cooling capacity, but are smaller and cheaper to build and can be placed indoors.
Rule.Translated: Construye uno de los sistemas de refrigeración disponibles y conéctalo a una turbina mediante una (tubería de refrigerante). Hay tres sistemas: la refrigeración por agua requiere ríos o grandes masas de agua; las torres de refrigeración necesitan mucha energía y espacio y deben colocarse en el exterior; los radiadores tienen la menor capacidad de refrigeración, pero son más pequeños y baratos y pueden instalarse bajo techo.

Rule.Original: Build a power transformer and connect it to the turbine using high voltage cables. A single transformer can convert up to 200kw of power from a turbine into usable electricity. Multiple transformers can be used to power different power grids. Power limit settings allow you to redistribute the power output between power grids.
Rule.Raw: Build a power transformer and connect it to the turbine using high voltage cables. A single transformer can convert up to 200kw of power from a turbine into usable electricity. Multiple transformers can be used to power different power grids. Power limit settings allow you to redistribute the power output between power grids.
Rule.Translated: Construye un transformador y conéctalo a la turbina mediante cables de alta tensión. Un transformador puede convertir hasta 200kw de potencia de una turbina en electricidad utilizable. Puedes utilizar varios para alimentar distintas redes eléctricas. Los ajustes de límite de potencia permiten redistribuir la producción entre las redes.
Construir un ordenador de control del reactor

Rule.Original: Build a reactor control computer and connect it to the nuclear reactor core using (Controller loom). This console is used to control reactor cores. They can be paired with specific cores by assigning an ID, allowing you to chain connections from core to core. Send a colonist to man the station to access the controls. Multiple controls can be open at the same time.
Rule.Raw: Build a reactor control computer and connect it to the nuclear reactor core using (Controller loom). This console is used to control reactor cores. They can be paired with specific cores by assigning an ID, allowing you to chain connections from core to core. Send a colonist to man the station to access the controls. Multiple controls can be open at the same time.
Rule.Translated: Construye un ordenador de control del reactor y conéctalo al núcleo mediante un (mazo de cables de control). Esta consola permite controlar los núcleos. Pueden vincularse a núcleos concretos asignándoles un ID, lo que permite encadenar las conexiones entre núcleos. Envía a un colono a manejar la estación para acceder a los controles. Puedes abrir varios controles a la vez.

Rule.Original: Construct or purchase nuclear fuel rods and load them into the reactor core using the reactor console to designate slots for loading. Load at least two fuel assemblies side-by-side to create a chain, use the reactor console to start the core, and then raise the control rods to 8% or higher to start gathering data.
Rule.Raw: Construct or purchase nuclear fuel rods and load them into the reactor core using the reactor console to designate slots for loading. Load at least two fuel assemblies side-by-side to create a chain, use the reactor console to start the core, and then raise the control rods to 8% or higher to start gathering data.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica o compra barras de combustible nuclear y cárgalas en el núcleo, utilizando la consola del reactor para designar los espacios de carga. Carga al menos dos conjuntos de combustible contiguos para formar una cadena, utiliza la consola para arrancar el núcleo y eleva las barras de control al 8% o más para comenzar a recopilar datos.

Rule.Original: Plutonium is produced within used nuclear fuel. Used fuel can be reprocessed to extract this plutonium to create MOX fuel, radioisotope thermoelectric generators, and nuclear weapons. The process requires chemfuel and produces drums of depleted uranium and nuclear waste.
Rule.Raw: Plutonium is produced within used nuclear fuel. Used fuel can be reprocessed to extract this plutonium to create MOX fuel, radioisotope thermoelectric generators, and nuclear weapons. The process requires chemfuel and produces drums of depleted uranium and nuclear waste.
Rule.Translated: El plutonio se produce en el combustible nuclear utilizado. Este puede reprocesarse para extraerlo y fabricar combustible MOX, generadores termoeléctricos de radioisótopos y armas nucleares. El proceso requiere combustible químico y produce bidones de uranio empobrecido y residuos nucleares.

Rule.Original:
You can now reprocess spent nuclear fuel.

The amount of material that will result from reprocessing is based on the conversion ratio stat of the fuel, with a maximum of 0.6x using normal reactors, and 1.2x using upgraded breeder reactors. This stat can be viewed by rolling over fuel slots in the reactor console.

The process of loading used fuel into the processor will require protective radiation suits, and shielding from the rest of the colony. Plutonium is stored in a protective case which is safe to handle.
Rule.Raw:
You can now reprocess spent nuclear fuel.

The amount of material that will result from reprocessing is based on the conversion ratio stat of the fuel, with a maximum of 0.6x using normal reactors, and 1.2x using upgraded breeder reactors. This stat can be viewed by rolling over fuel slots in the reactor console.

The process of loading used fuel into the processor will require protective radiation suits, and shielding from the rest of the colony. Plutonium is stored in a protective case which is safe to handle.
Rule.Translated:
Ahora puedes reprocesar combustible nuclear gastado.

La cantidad de material obtenida depende de la estadística de proporción de conversión del combustible, con un máximo de 0.6x en reactores normales y 1.2x en reactores reproductores mejorados. Puedes consultar esta estadística pasando el cursor por los espacios de combustible de la consola del reactor.

Cargar combustible gastado en el procesador requiere trajes antirradiación y aislamiento respecto al resto de la colonia. El plutonio se almacena en una caja protectora que puede manipularse con seguridad.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study how plutonium processing works, and finalize designs for a prototype fuel reprocessing facility.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study how plutonium processing works, and finalize designs for a prototype fuel reprocessing facility.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe estudiar el procesamiento de plutonio y terminar los diseños de una instalación prototipo de reprocesamiento de combustible.

Rule.Original: Construct a Plutonium Processor. To reduce the duration of exposure while handling radioactive fuel, it is advised that you locate the plutonium processor a short distance from reactors or spent fuel storage. Radiation suits will be required for workers that are moving radioactive fuel.
Rule.Raw: Construct a Plutonium Processor. To reduce the duration of exposure while handling radioactive fuel, it is advised that you locate the plutonium processor a short distance from reactors or spent fuel storage. Radiation suits will be required for workers that are moving radioactive fuel.
Rule.Translated: Construye un procesador de plutonio. Para reducir el tiempo de exposición al manipular combustible radiactivo, se recomienda colocarlo cerca de los reactores o del almacén de combustible gastado. Los trabajadores que transporten combustible radiactivo necesitarán trajes antirradiación.

Rule.Original: Experiment with the plutonium processor (High Risk)
Rule.Raw: Experiment with the plutonium processor (High Risk)
Rule.Translated: Experimentar con el procesador de plutonio (riesgo alto)

Rule.Original: Experiment with the prototype plutonium processor, ensuring that it is functioning correctly.
Rule.Raw: Experiment with the prototype plutonium processor, ensuring that it is functioning correctly.
Rule.Translated: Experimenta con el prototipo del procesador de plutonio y comprueba que funciona correctamente.

Rule.Original: Research breeder reactors that can generate more fissile material than they consume, and the Zeus turbine generator, which is capable of generating up to 1MW of power.
Rule.Raw: Research breeder reactors that can generate more fissile material than they consume, and the Zeus turbine generator, which is capable of generating up to 1MW of power.
Rule.Translated: Investiga reactores reproductores capaces de generar más material fisible del que consumen y el generador de turbina Zeus, que puede producir hasta 1MW de potencia.

Rule.Original: You can build advanced reactors and the Zeus turbine.
Rule.Raw: You can build advanced reactors and the Zeus turbine.
Rule.Translated: Puedes construir reactores avanzados y la turbina Zeus.
Experimentar con reactores de investigación (riesgo alto)

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to experiment with the research reactor. This step has a chance for catastrophic failures!
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to experiment with the research reactor. This step has a chance for catastrophic failures!
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe experimentar con el reactor de investigación. ¡Este paso puede provocar fallos catastróficos!

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to finalize the design of the advanced reactors before they are ready for construction.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to finalize the design of the advanced reactors before they are ready for construction.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe terminar el diseño de los reactores avanzados antes de que estén listos para construirse.
Construir un núcleo de reactor avanzado

Rule.Original: Build an advanced nuclear reactor core. It is highly recommended that the core be built in a shielded containment room to protect colonists during fuel transfer.
Rule.Raw: Build an advanced nuclear reactor core. It is highly recommended that the core be built in a shielded containment room to protect colonists during fuel transfer.
Rule.Translated: Construye un núcleo de reactor nuclear avanzado. Se recomienda encarecidamente instalarlo en una sala de contención blindada para proteger a los colonos durante el traslado de combustible.

Rule.Original: Power up the advanced reactor and start producing power to gather data.
Rule.Raw: Power up the advanced reactor and start producing power to gather data.
Rule.Translated: Enciende el reactor avanzado y empieza a producir energía para recopilar datos.

Rule.Original: A Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator (RTG) is portable electrical generator that uses an array of thermocouples to convert the heat released by the decay of a suitable radioactive material into electricity by the Seebeck effect. This generator has no moving parts.
Rule.Raw: A Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator (RTG) is portable electrical generator that uses an array of thermocouples to convert the heat released by the decay of a suitable radioactive material into electricity by the Seebeck effect. This generator has no moving parts.
Rule.Translated: Un generador termoeléctrico de radioisótopos (RTG) es un generador eléctrico portátil que utiliza termopares para convertir el calor liberado por la desintegración de un material radiactivo adecuado en electricidad mediante el efecto Seebeck. No tiene piezas móviles.

Rule.Original: RTGs can be reinstalled after being built and provide 1200w of constant power. Warning: if an RTG is damaged it will leak radiation!
Rule.Raw: RTGs can be reinstalled after being built and provide 1200w of constant power. Warning: if an RTG is damaged it will leak radiation!
Rule.Translated: Los RTG pueden reinstalarse después de construirlos y proporcionan 1200w de potencia constante. ¡Advertencia: un RTG dañado emitirá radiación!

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generators work before we can start making our own.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generators work before we can start making our own.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe estudiar los diseños y aprender cómo funcionan los generadores termoeléctricos de radioisótopos antes de que podamos fabricar los nuestros.

Rule.Original: Create some plutonium, which is required to make an RTG. To do this, spent nuclear fuel from a reactor must be processed in a plutonium processor.
