Rule.Raw: Create some plutonium, which is required to make an RTG. To do this, spent nuclear fuel from a reactor must be processed in a plutonium processor.
Rule.Translated: Produce plutonio, necesario para fabricar un RTG. Para ello, debes procesar combustible nuclear gastado de un reactor en un procesador de plutonio.

Rule.Original: A skilled crafter needs to plan how we can make the components required for a Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator from the resources available to us.
Rule.Raw: A skilled crafter needs to plan how we can make the components required for a Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator from the resources available to us.
Rule.Translated: Un artesano experto debe planificar cómo fabricar los componentes de un generador termoeléctrico de radioisótopos con nuestros recursos disponibles.

Rule.Original: The RA-1776b Liberator is a self-contained, all-in-one strategic missile manufacturing and launching facility with a five missile magazine. Requires plutonium that has been reprocessed from spent nuclear fuel.
Rule.Raw: The RA-1776b Liberator is a self-contained, all-in-one strategic missile manufacturing and launching facility with a five missile magazine. Requires plutonium that has been reprocessed from spent nuclear fuel.
Rule.Translated: El RA-1776b Liberator es una instalación autónoma que integra la fabricación y el lanzamiento de misiles estratégicos, con un almacén de cinco misiles. Necesita plutonio reprocesado a partir de combustible nuclear gastado.

Rule.Original: You may now stockpile nuclear arms.
Rule.Raw: You may now stockpile nuclear arms.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how nuclear weapons work before we can start making our own.
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how nuclear weapons work before we can start making our own.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe estudiar los diseños y aprender cómo funcionan las armas nucleares antes de que podamos fabricar las nuestras.

Rule.Original: Create some plutonium, which is required to make a bomb. To do this, spent nuclear fuel from a reactor must be processed in a plutonium processor.
Rule.Raw: Create some plutonium, which is required to make a bomb. To do this, spent nuclear fuel from a reactor must be processed in a plutonium processor.
Rule.Translated: Produce plutonio, necesario para fabricar una bomba. Para ello, debes procesar combustible nuclear gastado de un reactor en un procesador de plutonio.
Experimentar con el reactor de investigación

Rule.Original: Experiment with the research reactor to gain a greater understanding of nuclear physics before we attempt to build a weapon.
Rule.Raw: Experiment with the research reactor to gain a greater understanding of nuclear physics before we attempt to build a weapon.
Rule.Translated: Experimenta con el reactor de investigación para comprender mejor la física nuclear antes de intentar construir un arma.

Rule.Original: Construct a weapons console. The weapons console is a manned target acquisition computer required by all energy weapons. It networks to any Rimatomics energy weapons that share the same power net, then detects enemies using the onboard sensors of the weapons and the Target Acquisition System to assign targets. The main display features real-time ground and air target tracking, and a PPC capacity gauge displays the total stored PPC energy on the net.
Rule.Raw: Construct a weapons console. The weapons console is a manned target acquisition computer required by all energy weapons. It networks to any Rimatomics energy weapons that share the same power net, then detects enemies using the onboard sensors of the weapons and the Target Acquisition System to assign targets. The main display features real-time ground and air target tracking, and a PPC capacity gauge displays the total stored PPC energy on the net.
Rule.Translated: Construye una consola de armas. Es un ordenador de adquisición de objetivos que debe manejarse y que necesitan todas las armas de energía. Se conecta a las armas de energía Rimatomics que comparten su red eléctrica y detecta enemigos mediante los sensores de las armas y el sistema de adquisición de objetivos para asignarlos. La pantalla principal muestra el seguimiento de objetivos terrestres y aéreos en tiempo real, y un indicador de capacidad PPC muestra la energía PPC total almacenada en la red.

Rule.Original: Construct a Target Acquisition and Communications System (TACS)
Rule.Raw: Construct a Target Acquisition and Communications System (TACS)
Rule.Translated: Construir un sistema de adquisición de objetivos y comunicaciones (TACS)

Rule.Original: Construct a TACS. The system uses a combination of technologies to track land- and air-based targets. This includes living or robotic targets, projectiles such as mortar shells or railgun sabot rounds, and long-range tracking of ballistic missiles.
Rule.Raw: Construct a TACS. The system uses a combination of technologies to track land- and air-based targets. This includes living or robotic targets, projectiles such as mortar shells or railgun sabot rounds, and long-range tracking of ballistic missiles.
Rule.Translated: Construye un TACS. El sistema combina tecnologías para seguir objetivos terrestres y aéreos: seres vivos o robots, proyectiles como los de mortero o los subcalibrados de cañones de riel, y misiles balísticos a larga distancia.

Rule.Original: Construct a Liberator. It must be connected via power conduit to a weapons console to control the launch systems.
Rule.Raw: Construct a Liberator. It must be connected via power conduit to a weapons console to control the launch systems.
Rule.Translated: Construye un Liberator. Debe conectarse mediante un cable eléctrico a una consola de armas para controlar los sistemas de lanzamiento.

Rule.Original: Launch a strategic missile at any target to gather data. The amount of data gathered depends on the success of the launch, with a successful detonation on the target giving the maximum amount of data.
Rule.Raw: Launch a strategic missile at any target to gather data. The amount of data gathered depends on the success of the launch, with a successful detonation on the target giving the maximum amount of data.
Rule.Translated: Lanza un misil estratégico contra cualquier objetivo para recopilar datos. La cantidad obtenida depende del éxito del lanzamiento; detonar correctamente sobre el objetivo proporciona la máxima cantidad de datos.

Rule.Original: Rimatomics defines the future for high energy weapons systems, Gain a dominant battlefield advantage with our combat proven target designators and next generation energy weapons featuring modular, scalable designs, with 360 degree coverage that identifies, tracks, and defends against enemy troops, missiles, mortars, and long range targets
Rule.Raw: Rimatomics defines the future for high energy weapons systems, Gain a dominant battlefield advantage with our combat proven target designators and next generation energy weapons featuring modular, scalable designs, with 360 degree coverage that identifies, tracks, and defends against enemy troops, missiles, mortars, and long range targets
Rule.Translated: Rimatomics define el futuro de los sistemas de armas de alta energía. Consigue una ventaja dominante en el campo de batalla con nuestros designadores de objetivos probados en combate y armas de energía de nueva generación, con diseños modulares y ampliables y cobertura de 360 grados para identificar, seguir y defenderte de tropas enemigas, misiles, morteros y objetivos lejanos.

Rule.Original: All of the required technology for using Rimatomics energy weapons is available and weapon systems are now available for purchase at the research bench
Rule.Raw: All of the required technology for using Rimatomics energy weapons is available and weapon systems are now available for purchase at the research bench
Rule.Translated: Ya está disponible toda la tecnología necesaria para utilizar armas de energía Rimatomics, y puedes comprar sistemas de armas en el banco de investigación.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study how Rimatomics energy weapons work
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study how Rimatomics energy weapons work
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe estudiar cómo funcionan las armas de energía de Rimatomics
Construir un banco de investigación de armamento

Rule.Original: Construct a Weapons Research Bench, equipped with specialized equipment for prototyping and testing a wide range of energy weapons, it is a required facility for most energy weapons research and testing, colonists will need access to the bench for experimentation, it is advised to build it in a secure fireproof lab.
Rule.Raw: Construct a Weapons Research Bench, equipped with specialized equipment for prototyping and testing a wide range of energy weapons, it is a required facility for most energy weapons research and testing, colonists will need access to the bench for experimentation, it is advised to build it in a secure fireproof lab.
Rule.Translated: Construye un banco de investigación de armas, equipado con instrumental especializado para crear prototipos y probar una amplia variedad de armas de energía. Es necesario para la mayoría de investigaciones y pruebas de estas armas. Los colonos necesitarán acceder a él para experimentar; se recomienda instalarlo en un laboratorio seguro y resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original: Researchers must perform experiments using the new weapons research bench and lay the foundations for future projects, Rimatomics energy weapons are not plug and play and the technology must be tested and understood.\nExperimentation steps can be dangerous
Rule.Raw: Researchers must perform experiments using the new weapons research bench and lay the foundations for future projects, Rimatomics energy weapons are not plug and play and the technology must be tested and understood.\nExperimentation steps can be dangerous
Rule.Translated: Los investigadores deben realizar experimentos en el nuevo banco de investigación de armas y sentar las bases de futuros proyectos. Las armas de energía Rimatomics no funcionan simplemente conectándolas: hay que probar y comprender su tecnología.\nLos experimentos pueden ser peligrosos.

Rule.Original: Construct a Semi Automated Command Station (SACS)
Rule.Raw: Construct a Semi Automated Command Station (SACS)
Rule.Translated: Construir una estación de mando semiautomatizada (SACS)

Rule.Original:
Construct a SACS, this console is a target acquisition computer required by all energy weapons, it networks to all Rimatomics energy weapons that share the same power net, then it assigns targets using the onboard sensors of the weapons combined with the Target Acquisition System (TACS).

The main display features a real time ground target and aerial projectile tracker, and a gauge displays the total stored PPC energy on the net.
Some weapons require the console to be manned to function, this will be displayed in the inspect tab for the weapon
Rule.Raw:
Construct a SACS, this console is a target acquisition computer required by all energy weapons, it networks to all Rimatomics energy weapons that share the same power net, then it assigns targets using the onboard sensors of the weapons combined with the Target Acquisition System (TACS).

The main display features a real time ground target and aerial projectile tracker, and a gauge displays the total stored PPC energy on the net.
Some weapons require the console to be manned to function, this will be displayed in the inspect tab for the weapon
Rule.Translated:
Construye un SACS. Esta consola es un ordenador de adquisición de objetivos necesario para todas las armas de energía. Se conecta a las armas de energía Rimatomics que comparten su red eléctrica y asigna objetivos mediante los sensores de las armas y el sistema de adquisición de objetivos (TACS).

La pantalla principal muestra el seguimiento de objetivos terrestres y proyectiles aéreos en tiempo real, y un indicador muestra la energía PPC total almacenada en la red.
Algunas armas necesitan que alguien maneje la consola para funcionar; esto se indica en la pestaña de inspección del arma.

Rule.Original: Construct a Target Acquisition and Communications System (TACS)
Rule.Raw: Construct a Target Acquisition and Communications System (TACS)
Rule.Translated: Construir un sistema de adquisición de objetivos y comunicaciones (TACS)

Rule.Original: Construct a TACS. The system uses a combination of technologies to track land and air based targets, this includes living or robotic targets, projectiles such as mortar shells or railgun sabot rounds, and long range tracking of ballistic missiles. The information is routed to a SACS console where targets are selected and tracking information can be displayed
Rule.Raw: Construct a TACS. The system uses a combination of technologies to track land and air based targets, this includes living or robotic targets, projectiles such as mortar shells or railgun sabot rounds, and long range tracking of ballistic missiles. The information is routed to a SACS console where targets are selected and tracking information can be displayed
Rule.Translated: Construye un TACS. El sistema combina tecnologías para seguir objetivos terrestres y aéreos: seres vivos o robots, proyectiles como los de mortero o los subcalibrados de cañones de riel, y misiles balísticos a larga distancia. La información se envía a una consola SACS, donde se seleccionan objetivos y puede mostrarse su seguimiento.
Construir un contenedor de energía pulsada (PPC)

Rule.Original: Construct a Pulsed Power Container (PPC) and connect it to the same power net as the SACS.\n\nThese ultra-capacitors are much more efficient than standard batteries and are designed to provide the large jolts of power required by Rimatomics energy weapons. They are housed in a waterproof container and charged with excess power like a standard battery. We recommend using transformers to create isolated powernets for your PPC's and weapon arrays
Rule.Raw: Construct a Pulsed Power Container (PPC) and connect it to the same power net as the SACS.\n\nThese ultra-capacitors are much more efficient than standard batteries and are designed to provide the large jolts of power required by Rimatomics energy weapons. They are housed in a waterproof container and charged with excess power like a standard battery. We recommend using transformers to create isolated powernets for your PPC's and weapon arrays
Rule.Translated: Construye un contenedor de energía pulsada (PPC) y conéctalo a la misma red eléctrica que el SACS.\n\nEstos ultracondensadores son mucho más eficientes que las baterías normales y proporcionan las grandes descargas de energía que necesitan las armas de energía Rimatomics. Están alojados en un contenedor impermeable y se cargan con el excedente de energía, como una batería normal. Recomendamos utilizar transformadores para crear redes aisladas para tus PPC y conjuntos de armas.

Rule.Original: You are no longer limited to building 1 ADS and existing prototypes are now combat ready
Rule.Raw: You are no longer limited to building 1 ADS and existing prototypes are now combat ready
Rule.Translated: Ya puedes construir más de 1 ADS, y los prototipos existentes están listos para el combate.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the ADS works before we can build our own
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study the designs and learn how the ADS works before we can build our own
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe estudiar los diseños y aprender cómo funciona el ADS antes de que podamos construir el nuestro

Rule.Original: Researchers must perform experiments using the new weapons research bench and lay the foundations for future projects, Rimatomics energy weapons are not plug and play and the technology must be tested and understood.\nExperimentation steps can be dangerous
Rule.Raw: Researchers must perform experiments using the new weapons research bench and lay the foundations for future projects, Rimatomics energy weapons are not plug and play and the technology must be tested and understood.\nExperimentation steps can be dangerous
Rule.Translated: Los investigadores deben realizar experimentos en el nuevo banco de investigación de armas y sentar las bases de futuros proyectos. Las armas de energía Rimatomics no funcionan simplemente conectándolas: hay que probar y comprender su tecnología.\nLos experimentos pueden ser peligrosos.

Rule.Original: Construct a prototype version of the ADS. Prototype weapons have a high chance of failure! Recommend using isolated power nets and keeping safe distance with adequate fireproofing
Rule.Raw: Construct a prototype version of the ADS. Prototype weapons have a high chance of failure! Recommend using isolated power nets and keeping safe distance with adequate fireproofing
Rule.Translated: Construye un prototipo del ADS. ¡Los prototipos tienen una alta probabilidad de fallo! Se recomienda utilizar redes eléctricas aisladas, mantener una distancia de seguridad y disponer de protección adecuada contra incendios.

Rule.Original: Test fire the ADS on any living targets to gather weapons data
Rule.Raw: Test fire the ADS on any living targets to gather weapons data
Rule.Translated: Realiza disparos de prueba con el ADS contra objetivos vivos para recopilar datos del arma

Rule.Original: Energy shields that uses a combination of lasers, microwaves and arc discharges to create plasma fields which can intercept physical or energy based projectile weapons. A sensor detects a shockwave-producing event, determining a direction and distance of the shockwave relative to a defended target and calculates a firing plan, the device then attenuates the shockwave event using reflection, refraction, dispersion, absorption and momentum transfer
Rule.Raw: Energy shields that uses a combination of lasers, microwaves and arc discharges to create plasma fields which can intercept physical or energy based projectile weapons. A sensor detects a shockwave-producing event, determining a direction and distance of the shockwave relative to a defended target and calculates a firing plan, the device then attenuates the shockwave event using reflection, refraction, dispersion, absorption and momentum transfer
Rule.Translated: Escudos de energía que combinan láseres, microondas y descargas de arco para crear campos de plasma que interceptan proyectiles físicos o de energía. Un sensor detecta fenómenos que generan ondas de choque, determina su dirección y distancia respecto al objetivo protegido y calcula un plan de disparo. El dispositivo atenúa la onda mediante reflexión, refracción, dispersión, absorción y transferencia de momento.

Rule.Original: All of the required technology for using Rimatomics energy shields is available and shield systems are now available for construction
Rule.Raw: All of the required technology for using Rimatomics energy shields is available and shield systems are now available for construction
Rule.Translated: Ya está disponible toda la tecnología necesaria para utilizar escudos de energía Rimatomics y puedes construir sistemas de escudos.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher needs to study how Rimatomics energy shields work
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher needs to study how Rimatomics energy shields work
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe estudiar cómo funcionan los escudos de energía de Rimatomics

Rule.Original: Researchers must perform practical experiments using the weapons research bench, Rimatomics energy shields are not plug and play and the technology must be tested and understood.\nExperimentation steps can be dangerous
Rule.Raw: Researchers must perform practical experiments using the weapons research bench, Rimatomics energy shields are not plug and play and the technology must be tested and understood.\nExperimentation steps can be dangerous
Rule.Translated: Los investigadores deben realizar experimentos prácticos en el banco de investigación de armas. Los escudos de energía Rimatomics no funcionan simplemente conectándolos: hay que probar y comprender su tecnología.\nLos experimentos pueden ser peligrosos.

Rule.Original: Increase the speed of the control rods, this increases the responsiveness of flux level changes, and increases the shutdown speed
Rule.Raw: Increase the speed of the control rods, this increases the responsiveness of flux level changes, and increases the shutdown speed
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de las barras de control, mejorando la respuesta de los cambios de flujo y la velocidad de apagado.

Rule.Original: You can now produce the Control Rod Actuators at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a reactor core select the core and toggle the Control Rod Actuators, the reactor must then be shut down before it can be installed
Rule.Raw: You can now produce the Control Rod Actuators at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a reactor core select the core and toggle the Control Rod Actuators, the reactor must then be shut down before it can be installed
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar actuadores de barras de control en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos, selecciona un núcleo y activa la opción de actuadores de barras de control. Después debes apagar el reactor para realizar la instalación.

Rule.Original: Experiment with the research reactor and plan tests which can be performed on a live reactor core
Rule.Raw: Experiment with the research reactor and plan tests which can be performed on a live reactor core
Rule.Translated: Experimenta con el reactor de investigación y planifica pruebas que puedan realizarse en un núcleo de reactor activo
Realizar 2 paradas de emergencia SCRAM del reactor

Rule.Original: Test the control rod system by performing a reactor SCRAM while it is fully fueled and set to 100% power.
Rule.Raw: Test the control rod system by performing a reactor SCRAM while it is fully fueled and set to 100% power.
Rule.Translated: Prueba el sistema de barras de control realizando una parada de emergencia SCRAM con el reactor totalmente abastecido de combustible y ajustado al 100% de potencia.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the new control rod actuators
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the new control rod actuators
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños de los nuevos actuadores de las barras de control

Rule.Original: The Advanced Threat Detection module (ATOM) is an upgrade module for the TACS, when installed it it significantly increases the power usage increasing its range and scanning power, and making it possible to detect threats at much greater distances, acting as an early warning system for potential attacks. Airborne attacks will leave little room for warning, and smaller groups of ground units will be hard to detect, but large ground based fighting forces will be easily detected. False positives may be possible when using the system.
Rule.Raw: The Advanced Threat Detection module (ATOM) is an upgrade module for the TACS, when installed it it significantly increases the power usage increasing its range and scanning power, and making it possible to detect threats at much greater distances, acting as an early warning system for potential attacks. Airborne attacks will leave little room for warning, and smaller groups of ground units will be hard to detect, but large ground based fighting forces will be easily detected. False positives may be possible when using the system.
Rule.Translated: El módulo de detección avanzada de amenazas (ATOM) mejora el TACS. Una vez instalado, aumenta considerablemente su consumo eléctrico, alcance y potencia de exploración, permitiendo detectar amenazas mucho más lejos y avisar con antelación de posibles ataques. Los ataques aéreos dejarán poco tiempo de aviso y los pequeños grupos terrestres serán difíciles de detectar, pero las grandes fuerzas terrestres se detectarán fácilmente. El sistema puede dar falsos positivos.

Rule.Original: You can now produce ATOM modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them select a TACS and toggle the ATOM button\n\nThe ATOM module must be manually installed in each new TACS
Rule.Raw: You can now produce ATOM modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them select a TACS and toggle the ATOM button\n\nThe ATOM module must be manually installed in each new TACS
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar módulos ATOM en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos, selecciona un TACS y activa el botón ATOM.\n\nEl módulo ATOM debe instalarse manualmente en cada TACS nuevo.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on a TACS to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on a TACS to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe planificar una serie de pruebas que puedan realizarse en un TACS para recopilar datos que analizar

Rule.Original: Collect data from raids, each time you are raided the size and method of arrival will be analyzed and compared with sensor data to create a prediction model
Rule.Raw: Collect data from raids, each time you are raided the size and method of arrival will be analyzed and compared with sensor data to create a prediction model
Rule.Translated: Recopila datos de asaltos. Cada vez que sufras uno, se analizarán su tamaño y método de llegada y se compararán con los datos de sensores para crear un modelo de predicción.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the ATOM
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the ATOM
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del ATOM

Rule.Original: Increase the range and reliability of strategic missiles, Test the system by test launching missiles on any target to gather data for analysis.
Rule.Raw: Increase the range and reliability of strategic missiles, Test the system by test launching missiles on any target to gather data for analysis.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta el alcance y la fiabilidad de los misiles estratégicos. Prueba el sistema lanzando misiles contra cualquier objetivo para recopilar datos que analizar.

Rule.Original: The Guidance system upgrades are now complete, all strategic missiless are now automatically equipped with these upgrades and the maximum range is unlimited.
Rule.Raw: The Guidance system upgrades are now complete, all strategic missiless are now automatically equipped with these upgrades and the maximum range is unlimited.
Rule.Translated: Las mejoras del sistema de guiado están completas. Todos los misiles estratégicos las incorporan automáticamente y su alcance máximo es ilimitado.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on strategic missiles to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on strategic missiles to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe planificar una serie de pruebas con misiles estratégicos para recopilar datos que analizar.

Rule.Original: Launch a strategic missile at any target to gather data, the amount of data gathered depends on the success of the launch with a successful detonation on the target giving the maximum.
Rule.Raw: Launch a strategic missile at any target to gather data, the amount of data gathered depends on the success of the launch with a successful detonation on the target giving the maximum.
Rule.Translated: Lanza un misil estratégico contra cualquier objetivo para recopilar datos. La cantidad obtenida depende del éxito del lanzamiento; detonar correctamente sobre el objetivo proporciona la máxima cantidad.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the Guidance System
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the Guidance System
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del sistema de guiado

Rule.Original: The Modular Electric Power System (MEPS) is an ultra-capacitor that can interface with the power delivery system of any Rimatomics energy weapon to boost its maximum power, the extra power may be handled differently by each energy weapon
Rule.Raw: The Modular Electric Power System (MEPS) is an ultra-capacitor that can interface with the power delivery system of any Rimatomics energy weapon to boost its maximum power, the extra power may be handled differently by each energy weapon
Rule.Translated: El sistema modular de energía eléctrica (MEPS) es un ultracondensador que puede conectarse al sistema de suministro de cualquier arma de energía Rimatomics para aumentar su potencia máxima. Cada arma puede gestionar la energía adicional de forma diferente.

Rule.Original: You can now produce MEPS modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the MEPS button on\n\nThe MEPS must be manually installed in each new building
Rule.Raw: You can now produce MEPS modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the MEPS button on\n\nThe MEPS must be manually installed in each new building
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar módulos MEPS en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos en un arma de energía Rimatomics, selecciona el arma y activa el botón MEPS.\n\nEl MEPS debe instalarse manualmente en cada edificio nuevo.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe planificar una serie de pruebas con armas de energía Rimatomics para recopilar datos que analizar.

Rule.Original: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Raw: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Translated: Dispara cualquier arma de energía de Rimatomics a plena potencia para recopilar datos.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the MEPS module
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the MEPS module
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del módulo MEPS

Rule.Original: The Advanced Liquid Cooler (ALC) is a universal cooling system designed to work with all Rimatomics energy weapons, by increasing the cooling capacity of the weapon and its power deliver systems, cooldown times can be reduced.
Rule.Raw: The Advanced Liquid Cooler (ALC) is a universal cooling system designed to work with all Rimatomics energy weapons, by increasing the cooling capacity of the weapon and its power deliver systems, cooldown times can be reduced.
Rule.Translated: El refrigerador líquido avanzado (ALC) es un sistema de refrigeración universal para todas las armas de energía Rimatomics. Aumenta la capacidad de refrigeración del arma y de sus sistemas de suministro eléctrico, reduciendo el tiempo de enfriamiento.

Rule.Original: You can now produce ALC modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the ALC button on
Rule.Raw: You can now produce ALC modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the ALC button on
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar módulos ALC en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos en un arma de energía Rimatomics, selecciona el arma y activa el botón ALC.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe planificar una serie de pruebas con armas de energía Rimatomics para recopilar datos que analizar.

Rule.Original: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Raw: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Translated: Dispara cualquier arma de energía de Rimatomics a plena potencia para recopilar datos.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the ALC module
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the ALC module
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del módulo ALC

Rule.Original: The Energy Recovery System (ERS) uses a combination of energy recovery techniques to harvest waste kinetic and heat energy and return it to PPC's after a weapon has been fired.
Rule.Raw: The Energy Recovery System (ERS) uses a combination of energy recovery techniques to harvest waste kinetic and heat energy and return it to PPC's after a weapon has been fired.
Rule.Translated: El sistema de recuperación de energía (ERS) combina técnicas para recuperar energía cinética y térmica residual y devolverla a los PPC después de disparar un arma.

Rule.Original: You can now produce ERS modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the ERS button on
Rule.Raw: You can now produce ERS modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the ERS button on
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar módulos ERS en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos en un arma de energía Rimatomics, selecciona el arma y activa el botón ERS.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe planificar una serie de pruebas con armas de energía Rimatomics para recopilar datos que analizar.

Rule.Original: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Raw: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Translated: Dispara cualquier arma de energía de Rimatomics a plena potencia para recopilar datos.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the ERS module
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the ERS module
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del módulo ERS

Rule.Original: The SuperCapacitor Arc Defense system (SCAD) is an additional armour layer which is applied to Rimatomics energy weapons, Comprised of structural composite supercapacitors, the armour protects the weapon by charging with the plating and then releasing an electromagnetic arc discharge which deflects or vaporises incoming projectiles, reducing total damage received by up to 90%. The SCAD is a consumable system with limited uses and will need replacing.
Rule.Raw: The SuperCapacitor Arc Defense system (SCAD) is an additional armour layer which is applied to Rimatomics energy weapons, Comprised of structural composite supercapacitors, the armour protects the weapon by charging with the plating and then releasing an electromagnetic arc discharge which deflects or vaporises incoming projectiles, reducing total damage received by up to 90%. The SCAD is a consumable system with limited uses and will need replacing.
Rule.Translated: El sistema de defensa de arco con supercondensadores (SCAD) es una capa de blindaje adicional para las armas de energía Rimatomics. Sus supercondensadores estructurales compuestos se cargan con el revestimiento y liberan una descarga de arco electromagnético que desvía o vaporiza los proyectiles entrantes, reduciendo hasta un 90% el daño total recibido. Es un sistema consumible con usos limitados y debe reemplazarse.

Rule.Original: You can now produce SCAD modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the SCAD button\n\nThe SCAD must be manually installed in each new building
Rule.Raw: You can now produce SCAD modules at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Rimatomics energy weapon select the weapon and toggle the SCAD button\n\nThe SCAD must be manually installed in each new building
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar módulos SCAD en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos en un arma de energía Rimatomics, selecciona el arma y activa el botón SCAD.\n\nEl SCAD debe instalarse manualmente en cada edificio nuevo.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on Rimatomics energy weapons to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador experto debe planificar una serie de pruebas con armas de energía Rimatomics para recopilar datos que analizar.

Rule.Original: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Raw: Fire any Rimatomics energy weapon at full power to collect data.
Rule.Translated: Dispara cualquier arma de energía de Rimatomics a plena potencia para recopilar datos.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the SCAD module
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the SCAD module
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del módulo SCAD

Rule.Original: Improve stabilization accuracy and slew rates for turret based Rimatomics energy weapons. This high torque motor eliminates the need for a gearbox between the motor and load and provides low drive inertia for superior stabilization performance and high stiffness with a backlash free coupling
Rule.Raw: Improve stabilization accuracy and slew rates for turret based Rimatomics energy weapons. This high torque motor eliminates the need for a gearbox between the motor and load and provides low drive inertia for superior stabilization performance and high stiffness with a backlash free coupling
Rule.Translated: Mejora la precisión de estabilización y la velocidad de giro de las armas de energía Rimatomics montadas en torretas. Este motor de alto par elimina la necesidad de una caja de engranajes entre el motor y la carga, proporciona poca inercia para mejorar la estabilización y una gran rigidez con un acoplamiento sin holgura.

Rule.Original: You can now produce Drive Actuators at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a turret based energy weapon, select the weapon and designate the Drive Actuator for installation
Rule.Raw: You can now produce Drive Actuators at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a turret based energy weapon, select the weapon and designate the Drive Actuator for installation
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar actuadores de orientación en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos en un arma de energía montada en torreta, selecciona el arma y designa la instalación del actuador de orientación.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must experiment at a weapon research bench
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must experiment at a weapon research bench
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe experimentar en un banco de investigación de armas

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the Drive Actuators
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the Drive Actuators
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños de los actuadores de accionamiento

Rule.Original: Increase the range and accuracy of the Railgun, Test the system on any targets to gather data for analysis.
Rule.Raw: Increase the range and accuracy of the Railgun, Test the system on any targets to gather data for analysis.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta el alcance y la precisión del cañón de riel. Prueba el sistema contra cualquier objetivo para recopilar datos que analizar.

Rule.Original: You can now produce Targeting chips at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Railgun, select a Railgun and designate the Targeting chip for installation
Rule.Raw: You can now produce Targeting chips at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into a Railgun, select a Railgun and designate the Targeting chip for installation
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar chips de puntería en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos, selecciona un cañón de riel y designa la instalación del chip de puntería.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on the Railgun to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on the Railgun to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe planificar una serie de pruebas que puedan realizarse con el cañón de riel para recopilar datos que analizar

Rule.Original: Use the Railgun on any targets to collect data
Rule.Raw: Use the Railgun on any targets to collect data
Rule.Translated: Utiliza el cañón de riel contra cualquier objetivo para recopilar datos

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the targeting chip
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the targeting chip
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del chip de puntería

Rule.Original: The effective range of the Obelisk can be increased by improving the focusing and collimating of the main beam
Rule.Raw: The effective range of the Obelisk can be increased by improving the focusing and collimating of the main beam
Rule.Translated: El alcance efectivo del Obelisk puede aumentarse mejorando el enfoque y la colimación del haz principal.

Rule.Original: You can now produce Lens Module's at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into an Obelisk, select the Obelisk and designate the Lens Module for installation
Rule.Raw: You can now produce Lens Module's at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into an Obelisk, select the Obelisk and designate the Lens Module for installation
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar módulos de lentes en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos, selecciona un Obelisk y designa la instalación del módulo de lentes.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on the Obelisk to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on the Obelisk to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe planificar una serie de pruebas que puedan realizarse con el Obelisk para recopilar datos que analizar

Rule.Original: Use the Obelisk on any targets to collect data, the amount of data obtained scales based on the damage percentage used for each shot
Rule.Raw: Use the Obelisk on any targets to collect data, the amount of data obtained scales based on the damage percentage used for each shot
Rule.Translated: Utiliza el Obelisk contra cualquier objetivo para recopilar datos. La cantidad obtenida depende del porcentaje de daño utilizado en cada disparo.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the lens module
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the lens module
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del módulo de lentes

Rule.Original: The Obelisks laser can be split using a beam splitter, the secondary beam is tuned to a particular wavelength and polarization state which disables personal shields, the primary beam is delayed by a fraction of a second and then delivered with full power to the target
Rule.Raw: The Obelisks laser can be split using a beam splitter, the secondary beam is tuned to a particular wavelength and polarization state which disables personal shields, the primary beam is delayed by a fraction of a second and then delivered with full power to the target
Rule.Translated: El láser del Obelisk puede dividirse mediante un divisor de haz. El haz secundario se ajusta a una longitud de onda y un estado de polarización específicos que desactivan los escudos personales. El haz principal se retrasa una fracción de segundo y después alcanza el objetivo a plena potencia.

Rule.Original: You can now produce Beam splitters's at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into an Obelisk, select the Obelisk and designate the Beam splitter for installation
Rule.Raw: You can now produce Beam splitters's at the Rimatomics machining table, to install them into an Obelisk, select the Obelisk and designate the Beam splitter for installation
Rule.Translated: Ahora puedes fabricar divisores de haz en la mesa de mecanizado Rimatomics. Para instalarlos, selecciona un Obelisk y designa la instalación del divisor de haz.

Rule.Original: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on the Obelisk to collect data for analysis
Rule.Raw: A skilled researcher must plan a series of tests which can be performed on the Obelisk to collect data for analysis
Rule.Translated: Un investigador cualificado debe planificar una serie de pruebas que puedan realizarse con el Obelisk para recopilar datos que analizar

Rule.Original: Use the Obelisk on any targets to collect data, the amount of data obtained scales based on the damage percentage used for each burst.
Rule.Raw: Use the Obelisk on any targets to collect data, the amount of data obtained scales based on the damage percentage used for each burst.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza el Obelisk contra cualquier objetivo para recopilar datos. La cantidad obtenida depende del porcentaje de daño utilizado en cada ráfaga.

Rule.Original: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the beam splitter device
Rule.Raw: Analyze the data gathered and finalize the designs for the beam splitter device
Rule.Translated: Analiza los datos recopilados y termina los diseños del dispositivo divisor de haces

Rule.Original: Allow new fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Raw: Allow new fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Translated: Permite el almacenamiento de combustible nuevo en este lugar.

Rule.Original: Allow used fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Raw: Allow used fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Translated: Permite el almacenamiento de combustible usado en este lugar.

Rule.Original: Allow cracked fuel rods to be stored here.
Rule.Raw: Allow cracked fuel rods to be stored here.
Rule.Translated: Permite el almacenamiento de barras de combustible agrietadas en este lugar.

Rule.Original: Allow non cracked fuel rods to be stored here.
Rule.Raw: Allow non cracked fuel rods to be stored here.
Rule.Translated: Permite el almacenamiento de barras de combustible sin agrietar en este lugar.

Rule.Original: Allow processable fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Raw: Allow processable fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Translated: Permitir el almacenamiento de combustible procesable en este lugar.

Rule.Original: Allow non processable fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Raw: Allow non processable fuel to be stored here.
Rule.Translated: Permitir el almacenamiento de combustible no procesable en este lugar.

Rule.Original: Multiplier on the impact of radiation buildup on this character.
Rule.Raw: Multiplier on the impact of radiation buildup on this character.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador del impacto de la acumulación de radiación en este personaje.

Rule.Original: This person does Crafting research at this speed.
Rule.Raw: This person does Crafting research at this speed.
Rule.Translated: La velocidad a la que esta persona realiza la investigación de fabricación.

Rule.Original: This person does Construction research at this speed.
Rule.Raw: This person does Construction research at this speed.
Rule.Translated: La velocidad a la que esta persona realiza la investigación de construcción.

Rule.Original: Overcurrent in a transformer has caused the circuits to fry.
Rule.Raw: Overcurrent in a transformer has caused the circuits to fry.
Rule.Translated: El exceso de corriente en un transformador ha hecho que los circuitos se frían.

Rule.Original: Pipes for pumping coolant from the turbine to cooling systems. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Pipes for pumping coolant from the turbine to cooling systems. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías para bombear el refrigerante procedente de la turbina hacia los sistemas de refrigeración. Pueden colocarse debajo los muros y otras construcciones.

Rule.Original: Hidden pipes for pumping coolant from the turbine to cooling systems. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Hidden pipes for pumping coolant from the turbine to cooling systems. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías ocultas que bombean refrigerante desde la turbina a los sistemas de refrigeración. Pueden colocarse bajo muros y otros edificios.

Rule.Original: Opens or closes connections between coolant pipes.
Rule.Raw: Opens or closes connections between coolant pipes.
Rule.Translated: Permite abrir o cerrar las conexiones entre tuberías de refrigerante.

Rule.Original: Pipes for pumping high pressure steam from the reactor to turbines. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Pipes for pumping high pressure steam from the reactor to turbines. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías para bombear el vapor de alta presión procedente del reactor hacia las turbinas. Pueden colocarse debajo los muros y otras construcciones.

Rule.Original: Hidden pipes for pumping high pressure steam from the reactor to turbines. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Hidden pipes for pumping high pressure steam from the reactor to turbines. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías ocultas para bombear vapor a alta presión del reactor a las turbinas. Pueden colocarse bajo paredes y otros edificios.

Rule.Original: Opens or closes connections between steam pipes.
Rule.Raw: Opens or closes connections between steam pipes.
Rule.Translated: Permite abrir o cerrar las conexiones entre tuberías de vapor.

Rule.Original: Pipes for pumping cold water from the turbine or heat exchanger back to the core. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Pipes for pumping cold water from the turbine or heat exchanger back to the core. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías para bombear agua fría procedente de la turbina o del intercambiador de calor hacia el núcleo. Pueden colocarse debajo los muros y otras construcciones.

Rule.Original: Hidden pipes for pumping cold water from the turbine or heat exchanger back to the core. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Hidden pipes for pumping cold water from the turbine or heat exchanger back to the core. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías ocultas para bombear agua fría de la turbina o el intercambiador de calor al núcleo. Pueden colocarse bajo paredes y otros edificios.

Rule.Original: Opens or closes connections between cold water pipes.
Rule.Raw: Opens or closes connections between cold water pipes.
Rule.Translated: Permite abrir o cerrar las conexiones entre tuberías de agua fría.

Rule.Original: Cable for transporting high voltage power from turbines to transformers. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Cable for transporting high voltage power from turbines to transformers. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Unos cables que permiten transportar la energía de alta tensión desde las turbinas hasta los transformadores. Pueden colocarse debajo los muros y otras construcciones.

Rule.Original: Hidden cable for transporting high voltage power from turbines to transformers. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Hidden cable for transporting high voltage power from turbines to transformers. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Cable oculto para transportar energía de alta tensión desde las turbinas hasta los transformadores. Puede colocarse bajo paredes y otros edificios.

Rule.Original: Wiring loom for transmitting signals between a core and a control console. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Wiring loom for transmitting signals between a core and a control console. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Una red de cableado que transmite señales entre un núcleo y una consola de control. Puede colocarse debajo los muros y otras construcciones.

Rule.Original: Hidden wiring loom for transmitting signals between a core and a control console. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: Hidden wiring loom for transmitting signals between a core and a control console. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Mazo de cables oculto para transmitir señales entre un núcleo y una consola de control. Puede colocarse bajo paredes y otros edificios.

Rule.Original: Contains Rimatomics research projects. Requires power.
Rule.Raw: Contains Rimatomics research projects. Requires power.
Rule.Translated: Permite realizar proyectos de investigación de Rimatomics. Requiere de energía.

Rule.Original: A work station for assembling Rimatomics technologies
Rule.Raw: A work station for assembling Rimatomics technologies
Rule.Translated: Una estación de trabajo para realizar el montaje de las tecnologías de Rimatomics.
Una mesa de investigación de armas nucleares.

Rule.Original: A machine that uses chemicals to separate fissionable plutonium from spent nuclear fuel.
Rule.Raw: A machine that uses chemicals to separate fissionable plutonium from spent nuclear fuel.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina que utiliza productos químicos para extraer algo de plutonio fisionable del combustible nuclear gastado.

Rule.Original: An electrical generator that uses an array of thermocouples to convert the heat released by the decay of a suitable radioactive material into electricity.
Rule.Raw: An electrical generator that uses an array of thermocouples to convert the heat released by the decay of a suitable radioactive material into electricity.
Rule.Translated: Un RTG, abreviación de generador termoeléctrico de radioisótopos en inglés, es un generador eléctrico que utiliza un conjunto de termopares para convertir en electricidad el calor liberado por la desintegración de algún tipo de material radiactivo.

Rule.Original: Rimatomics thermal reactor core with 21 fuel assembly capacity. A reactor core contains the fuel components where nuclear reactions take place and heat is generated
Rule.Raw: Rimatomics thermal reactor core with 21 fuel assembly capacity. A reactor core contains the fuel components where nuclear reactions take place and heat is generated
Rule.Translated: Un núcleo de reactor térmico de Rimatomics con capacidad para 21 elementos de combustible. El núcleo de un reactor contiene los componentes del combustible donde tienen lugar las reacciones nucleares y se genera el calor.

Rule.Original: An advanced breeder reactor design which can generate more fissile material than it consumes.
Rule.Raw: An advanced breeder reactor design which can generate more fissile material than it consumes.
Rule.Translated: Un diseño de reactor reproductor avanzado que puede generar más material fisible del que consume.

Rule.Original: A massive advanced breeder reactor design which can generate more fissile material than it consumes.
Rule.Raw: A massive advanced breeder reactor design which can generate more fissile material than it consumes.
Rule.Translated: Un diseño de reactor reproductor masivo avanzado que puede generar más material fisible del que consume.

Rule.Original: A turbine driven by steam which turns a generator to produce electricity. The Thor has a maximum power output of 100 Kilowatts
Rule.Raw: A turbine driven by steam which turns a generator to produce electricity. The Thor has a maximum power output of 100 Kilowatts
Rule.Translated: Una turbina accionada por vapor que hace girar un generador para producir electricidad. El modelo Thor tiene una potencia máxima de 100 kilovatios.

Rule.Original: A turbine driven by steam which turns a generator to produce electricity. The Zeus has a maximum power output of 1 Megawatt
Rule.Raw: A turbine driven by steam which turns a generator to produce electricity. The Zeus has a maximum power output of 1 Megawatt
Rule.Translated: Una turbina accionada por vapor que hace girar un generador para producir electricidad. El modelo Zeus tiene una potencia máxima de 1 megavatio.

Rule.Original: Small air coolers designed to provide cooling for small nuclear reactors when resources or space is limited.\n25kW cooling capacity
Rule.Raw: Small air coolers designed to provide cooling for small nuclear reactors when resources or space is limited.\n25kW cooling capacity
Rule.Translated: Pequeños sistemas de refrigeración por aire diseñados para enfriar pequeños reactores nucleares cuando los recursos o el espacio son limitados.\nTiene una capacidad de refrigeración de 25 kW.

Rule.Original: Provides large amounts of cooling to nuclear reactors by using cold water from rivers, lakes or oceans.\n250kW cooling capacity
Rule.Raw: Provides large amounts of cooling to nuclear reactors by using cold water from rivers, lakes or oceans.\n250kW cooling capacity
Rule.Translated: Proporciona una gran capacidad de refrigeración a los reactores nucleares utilizando el agua fría de los ríos, lagos u océanos.\nTiene una capacidad de refrigeración de 250 kW.

Rule.Original: Very large air coolers designed to provide large amounts of cooling for nuclear reactors when no natural bodies of water are available.\n250kW cooling capacity
Rule.Raw: Very large air coolers designed to provide large amounts of cooling for nuclear reactors when no natural bodies of water are available.\n250kW cooling capacity
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de refrigeración por aire de gran tamaño diseñado para proporcionar una gran capacidad de refrigeración a los reactores nucleares cuando no se dispone de masas de agua naturales.\nTiene una capacidad de refrigeración de 250 kW.

Rule.Original: Provides the final voltage transformation from Turbine Generators, stepping down the voltage used in high voltage lines to the level used by power conduits
Rule.Raw: Provides the final voltage transformation from Turbine Generators, stepping down the voltage used in high voltage lines to the level used by power conduits
Rule.Translated: Proporciona la transformación final que requiere la tensión de las turbinas, reduciendo la tensión utilizada en las líneas de alta tensión al nivel utilizado por los conductos de energía habituales.

Rule.Original: Computer system designed to control nuclear reactors. Send a colonist to man the station to access the controls, multiple controls can be open at the same time
Rule.Raw: Computer system designed to control nuclear reactors. Send a colonist to man the station to access the controls, multiple controls can be open at the same time
Rule.Translated: Un sistema informático diseñado para controlar los reactores nucleares. Envía a un colono a la estación para que acceda a los controles. Varios controles pueden estar abiertos al mismo tiempo.

Rule.Original: A storage pool for safely storing spent nuclear fuel rods, water in the pool absorbs radiation, fuel must be manually removed from the pool before it can be used
Rule.Raw: A storage pool for safely storing spent nuclear fuel rods, water in the pool absorbs radiation, fuel must be manually removed from the pool before it can be used
Rule.Translated: Una piscina para almacenar de forma segura las barras de combustible nuclear gastado, ya que el agua de la piscina absorbe la radiación. El combustible debe ser retirado manualmente antes de que pueda ser utilizado.

Rule.Original: Radiation detector, can be placed near reactors to detect radiation leaks
Rule.Raw: Radiation detector, can be placed near reactors to detect radiation leaks
Rule.Translated: Un detector de radiación, que puede colocarse cerca de los reactores para detectar fugas de radiación.

Rule.Original: Very strong wall that is reinforced with depleted uranium, providing full shielding against radiation
Rule.Raw: Very strong wall that is reinforced with depleted uranium, providing full shielding against radiation
Rule.Translated: Un muro muy resistente reforzado con uranio empobrecido, que proporciona un blindaje total contra la radiación.

Rule.Original: Very strong blast doors that are reinforced with depleted uranium, providing full shielding against radiation.
Rule.Raw: Very strong blast doors that are reinforced with depleted uranium, providing full shielding against radiation.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta blindada y muy resistente, reforzada con uranio empobrecido, que proporciona un aislamiento total contra la radiación.

Rule.Original: The RA-P3 Pulsed Power Capacitor, stores large amounts of energy in a bank of ultra capacitors, which can be discharged in a single pulse by compatible Rimatomics energy weapons
Rule.Raw: The RA-P3 Pulsed Power Capacitor, stores large amounts of energy in a bank of ultra capacitors, which can be discharged in a single pulse by compatible Rimatomics energy weapons
Rule.Translated: El capacitor de potencia pulsada RA-P3 almacena grandes cantidades de energía en un banco de ultracapacitores, que pueden descargarse en un solo pulso mediante armas energéticas compatibles con Rimatomics.

Rule.Original: The RA-c85 Semi Automated Command Station, is required by all Rimatomics energy weapons, may require manning for certain weapons to function fully.
Rule.Raw: The RA-c85 Semi Automated Command Station, is required by all Rimatomics energy weapons, may require manning for certain weapons to function fully.
Rule.Translated: El puesto semi-automatizado de mando RA-C85 es un elemento indispensable para todas las armas de energía de Rimatomics. Es posible que ciertas armas deban ser tripuladas para que funcionen plenamente.

Rule.Original: The RA-92 Target Acquisition and Communication System, uses a combination of technologies to track land and air based targets and communicate with weapon systems.
Rule.Raw: The RA-92 Target Acquisition and Communication System, uses a combination of technologies to track land and air based targets and communicate with weapon systems.
Rule.Translated: El sistema de comunicación y adquisición de blancos RA-92 utiliza una combinación de diferentes tecnologías para rastrear objetivos, tanto terrestres como aéreos, y comunicarse con los sistemas de armamento.

Rule.Original: The RA-22 Active Denial System (ADS) is a non-lethal, directed-energy weapon designed for area denial and crowd control. It heats the skin of targeted human subjects causing them to break rank and flee. Does not require line of sight. Requires a manned SACS.
Rule.Raw: The RA-22 Active Denial System (ADS) is a non-lethal, directed-energy weapon designed for area denial and crowd control. It heats the skin of targeted human subjects causing them to break rank and flee. Does not require line of sight. Requires a manned SACS.
Rule.Translated: El Sistema de Denegación Activa RA-22 (ADS) es un arma de energía dirigida no letal diseñada para la negación de áreas y el control de multitudes. Calienta la piel de los sujetos humanos seleccionados haciéndolos romper filas y huir. No requiere línea de visión. Requiere un SACS tripulado.

Rule.Original: The RA-42T Tesla Coil delivers a huge electrical arc discharge to its targets resulting in severe burns or death. 100% accurate, medium range, sets targets on fire. Automatic targeting and firing. Manned SACS required for manual targeting.
Rule.Raw: The RA-42T Tesla Coil delivers a huge electrical arc discharge to its targets resulting in severe burns or death. 100% accurate, medium range, sets targets on fire. Automatic targeting and firing. Manned SACS required for manual targeting.
Rule.Translated: La bobina de Tesla RA-42T emite una gran descarga de arco eléctrico en sus objetivos, lo que resulta en quemaduras graves o muerte. 100% preciso, alcance medio, incendia los objetivos. Apuntado y disparo automáticos. Se requiere un SACS tripulado para el apuntado manual.
Dispositivo de descarga de arco de la bobina de Tesla
Dispositivo de descarga de arco de la bobina de Tesla.

Rule.Original: The RA-702 High Energy Laser (HEL) destroys enemy airborne projectiles such as mortar shells. When a mortar is fired the system will check if the shell will pass through the range of a HEL, and attempt to track the target and fire once it is in range.
Rule.Raw: The RA-702 High Energy Laser (HEL) destroys enemy airborne projectiles such as mortar shells. When a mortar is fired the system will check if the shell will pass through the range of a HEL, and attempt to track the target and fire once it is in range.
Rule.Translated: El láser de alta energía (HEL) RA-702 destruye proyectiles enemigos en el aire, como proyectiles de mortero. Cuando se dispara un mortero, el sistema verificará si el proyectil pasará por el rango de un HEL, e intentará rastrear el objetivo y disparar una vez que esté dentro del rango.

Rule.Original: The RA-1802D Punisher is a 25 round magazine fed railgun platform which uses large electromagnetic pulses to launch sabot projectiles to extreme velocities and ranges. Requires line of sight. Fire mission does not require line of sight. Manned SACS required for manual targeting. Requires a manned SACS.
Rule.Raw: The RA-1802D Punisher is a 25 round magazine fed railgun platform which uses large electromagnetic pulses to launch sabot projectiles to extreme velocities and ranges. Requires line of sight. Fire mission does not require line of sight. Manned SACS required for manual targeting. Requires a manned SACS.
Rule.Translated: El RA-1802D Punisher es una plataforma de railgun alimentada con un cargador de 25 rondas que utiliza grandes pulsos electromagnéticos para lanzar proyectiles a velocidades y rangos extremos. Requiere línea de visión. La misión de fuego no requiere línea de visión. Se requiere un SACS tripulado para el apuntado manual.

Rule.Original: The RA-2152-X Obelisk is a directed energy weapon that uses a focused solid state laser to vaporize targets. 100% accurate with long range and devastating power. Automatic targeting and firing. Manned SACS required for manual targeting
Rule.Raw: The RA-2152-X Obelisk is a directed energy weapon that uses a focused solid state laser to vaporize targets. 100% accurate with long range and devastating power. Automatic targeting and firing. Manned SACS required for manual targeting
Rule.Translated: El Obelisco RA-2152-X es un arma de energía dirigida que utiliza un láser de estado sólido enfocado para vaporizar objetivos. 100% preciso con alcance largo y poder devastador. Apuntado y disparo automáticos. Requiere SACS tripulado para el apuntado manual.

Rule.Original: The RA-3b Marauder is a multi-barrel coaxial plasma railgun platform, large electromagnetic pulses fire a burst of accelerated plasma toroids to extreme velocities causing explosive radiation emitting impacts. Requires a manned SACS.
Rule.Raw: The RA-3b Marauder is a multi-barrel coaxial plasma railgun platform, large electromagnetic pulses fire a burst of accelerated plasma toroids to extreme velocities causing explosive radiation emitting impacts. Requires a manned SACS.
Rule.Translated: El RA-3b Marauder es una plataforma coaxial de cañones de riel de plasma con varios tubos. Grandes pulsos electromagnéticos lanzan ráfagas de toroides de plasma acelerados a velocidades extremas, causando impactos explosivos que emiten radiación. Necesita un SACS manejado por alguien.

Rule.Original: The RA-S4 Sentinel is an energy shield that uses a combination of lasers, microwaves and arc discharges to create plasma fields which can intercept physical or energy based projectile weapons. A sensor detects a shockwave-producing event, determining a direction and distance of the shockwave relative to a defended target and calculates a firing plan, the device then attenuates the shockwave event using reflection, refraction, dispersion, absorption and momentum transfer.
Rule.Raw: The RA-S4 Sentinel is an energy shield that uses a combination of lasers, microwaves and arc discharges to create plasma fields which can intercept physical or energy based projectile weapons. A sensor detects a shockwave-producing event, determining a direction and distance of the shockwave relative to a defended target and calculates a firing plan, the device then attenuates the shockwave event using reflection, refraction, dispersion, absorption and momentum transfer.
Rule.Translated: El Sentinel RA-S4 es un escudo de energía que utiliza una combinación de láseres, microondas y descargas de arco para crear campos de plasma que pueden interceptar armas proyectiles físicas o basadas en energía. Un sensor detecta un evento que produce una onda de choque, determinando una dirección y una distancia de la onda de choque con respecto a un objetivo defendido y calcula un plan de disparo, el dispositivo entonces atenúa el evento de la onda de choque usando reflexión, refracción, dispersión, absorción y transferencia de momentum.

Rule.Original: The RA-1776b Liberator is a self contained all-in-one strategic missile manufacturing and launching facility with a 5 missile magazine capacity. Requires a manned SACS to function.
Rule.Raw: The RA-1776b Liberator is a self contained all-in-one strategic missile manufacturing and launching facility with a 5 missile magazine capacity. Requires a manned SACS to function.
Rule.Translated: El RA-1776b «Liberador» es una instalación autónoma de fabricación y lanzamiento de misiles estratégicos con capacidad para 5 misiles. Requiere de un PSAM tripulado para funcionar.
Unas palas que se utilizan para construir generadores.

Rule.Original: Pellets of uranium used in the construction of nuclear fuel rods.
Rule.Raw: Pellets of uranium used in the construction of nuclear fuel rods.
Rule.Translated: Pastillas de uranio, utilizadas para crear de barras de combustible nuclear.

Rule.Original: A case of plutonium used to create nuclear weapons or nuclear fuel rods.
Rule.Raw: A case of plutonium used to create nuclear weapons or nuclear fuel rods.
Rule.Translated: Un estuche con plutonio, utilizado para crear armas nucleares o barras de combustible nuclear.

Rule.Original: Pellets of depleted uranium used in the construction of nuclear fuel rods.
Rule.Raw: Pellets of depleted uranium used in the construction of nuclear fuel rods.
Rule.Translated: Pastillas de uranio empobrecido, utilizadas para construir barras de combustible nuclear.

Rule.Original: A group of rods filled with uranium pellets, when loaded in a reactor core they generate heat which can be used to drive a turbine.
Rule.Raw: A group of rods filled with uranium pellets, when loaded in a reactor core they generate heat which can be used to drive a turbine.
Rule.Translated: Un conjunto de barras llenas de pastillas de uranio que, cuando se cargan en el núcleo de un reactor, generan calor que puede utilizarse para accionar una turbina.

Rule.Original: A group of rods filled with a mix of uranium and plutonium, when loaded in a reactor core they generate heat which can be used to drive a turbine.
Rule.Raw: A group of rods filled with a mix of uranium and plutonium, when loaded in a reactor core they generate heat which can be used to drive a turbine.
Rule.Translated: Un conjunto de barras llenas de una mezcla de óxidos de uranio y plutonio que, cuando se cargan en el núcleo de un reactor, generan calor que puede utilizarse para accionar una turbina.

Rule.Original: Protect against radiation through shielding in the lining, but more importantly by preventing direct contact with or inhalation of radioactive particles or gas.
Rule.Raw: Protect against radiation through shielding in the lining, but more importantly by preventing direct contact with or inhalation of radioactive particles or gas.
Rule.Translated: Protege contra la radiación gracias al blindaje de su revestimiento, pero sobre todo al evitar el contacto directo o la inhalación de partículas o gases radiactivos.

Rule.Original: A suit that protects against radiation through shielding in the lining.
Rule.Raw: A suit that protects against radiation through shielding in the lining.
Rule.Translated: Un traje que protege contra la radiación gracias al blindaje del forro.

Rule.Original: A kinetic energy projectile fired from a railgun.
Rule.Raw: A kinetic energy projectile fired from a railgun.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil dotado de una gran energía cinética que se dispara desde un cañón de riel.
disparo de sabot de uranio empobrecido

Rule.Original: A kinetic energy projectile fired from a railgun, inert and safe to stockpile.
Rule.Raw: A kinetic energy projectile fired from a railgun, inert and safe to stockpile.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil dotado de una gran energía cinética que se dispara desde un cañón de riel. Es inerte, y por lo tanto seguro de almacenar.
bala de sabot de uranio empobrecido
sabot de uranio empobrecido en camino
Un objeto sin terminar de Rimatomics.

Rule.Original: Something happened last night, I don't know where I was!
Rule.Raw: Something happened last night, I don't know where I was!
Rule.Translated: Anoche pasó algo, ¡y no sé dónde estaba!

Rule.Original: Do bills at nuclear machining table
Rule.Raw: Do bills at nuclear machining table
Rule.Translated: Hacer proyectos en la mesa de maquinaria nuclear

Rule.Original: A strategic missile is a rocket powered guided ballistic missile primarily designed for nuclear weapons delivery, this one is tipped with a fission warhead.
Rule.Raw: A strategic missile is a rocket powered guided ballistic missile primarily designed for nuclear weapons delivery, this one is tipped with a fission warhead.
Rule.Translated: Un misil estratégico es un proyectil balístico guiado impulsado por cohetes y diseñado principalmente para el lanzamiento de armas nucleares. Este misil lleva una cabeza nuclear de fisión.
Disparo de sabot de un cañón de riel

Rule.Original: Nuclear fallout is the residual radioactive material propelled into the air by nuclear blasts or a nuclear reactor meltdown.
Rule.Raw: Nuclear fallout is the residual radioactive material propelled into the air by nuclear blasts or a nuclear reactor meltdown.
Rule.Translated: La lluvia radiactiva está formada por el material radiactivo residual lanzado al aire por las explosiones nucleares o la fusión de un reactor nuclear.
Permite designar sobre una línea recta.

Rule.Original: Designate in a freeform line, like a pen
Rule.Raw: Designate in a freeform line, like a pen
Rule.Translated: Designa siguiendo una línea a mano alzada, como con un bolígrafo
Permite designar sobre el contorno de un rectángulo.
Permite designar sobre la superficie de un rectángulo.

Rule.Raw: Designate in a fixed rectangle with user-defined size
Rule.Translated: Permite designar sobre el contorno de un rectángulo de un tamaño concreto.

Rule.Raw: Designate in a fixed filled rectangle with user-defined size
Rule.Translated: Permite designar sobre la superficie de un rectángulo de un tamaño concreto.

Rule.Original: Designate in a custom dimmensioned grid

Rule.Translated: Designa en una cuadrícula con dimensiones personalizadas
Designa en una cuadrícula inversa de 3x3

Rule.Translated: Designa en una cuadrícula inversa con dimensiones personalizadas

Permite designar sobre la superficie de una elipse.

Rule.Original: Designate in a fixed ellipse with user-defined size
Rule.Raw: Designate in a fixed ellipse with user-defined size
Rule.Translated: Permite designar sobre el contorno de una elipse de un tamaño concreto.

Rule.Original: Designate in a fixed filled ellipse with user-defined size
Rule.Raw: Designate in a fixed filled ellipse with user-defined size
Rule.Translated: Permite designar sobre la superficie de una elipse de un tamaño concreto.
Permite designar sobre el contorno de un hexágono.
Permite designar sobre la superficie de un hexágono.

Rule.Original: Designate in a hexagon from the center
Rule.Raw: Designate in a hexagon from the center
Rule.Translated: Designa un hexágono desde el centro

Rule.Original: Designate in a filled hexagon from the center
Rule.Raw: Designate in a filled hexagon from the center
Rule.Translated: Designa un hexágono relleno desde el centro

Permite designar sobre la superficie de un pentágono.
Permite designar sobre el contorno de un círculo.

Permite designar con la forma del alcance de una lámpara solar.

Rule.Raw: Designate in the outline of a sun-lamp-radius shape
Rule.Translated: Permite designar con la forma del contorno del alcance de una lámpara solar.
Permite designar con la forma del alcance de una baliza de comercio.
