Rule.Raw: Designate in the outline of a trade-beacon-radius shape
Rule.Translated: Permite designar con la forma del contorno del alcance de una baliza de comercio.

Rule.Original: Undo last action. Only works when the game is paused
Rule.Raw: Undo last action. Only works when the game is paused

Rule.Original: Redo last undo. Only works when the game is paused
Rule.Raw: Redo last undo. Only works when the game is paused

Rule.Original: Rectangles with fixed sizes that the user determines.
Rule.Raw: Rectangles with fixed sizes that the user determines.
Rule.Translated: Rectángulos con tamaños fijos definidos por el usuario.

Rule.Original: Ellipses with fixed sizes that the user determines.
Rule.Raw: Ellipses with fixed sizes that the user determines.
Rule.Translated: Elipses con tamaños fijos definidos por el usuario.
Rellena una zona delimitada por muros.

Rule.Original: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] tried to calm me down.
Rule.Raw: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] tried to calm me down.

Rule.Original: Search all buildings of all mods.
Rule.Raw: Search all buildings of all mods.
Rule.Translated: Busca todas las construcciones de todos los mods.
Consulta todas las órdenes de trabajo.
Consulta el equipo de todos los personajes.
Atajos de teclado de Dubs Mint Menus.

Rule.Original: Breaks corpses down into biomatter that is then turned into chemfuel, but is much less efficient than using other biomatter.
Rule.Raw: Breaks corpses down into biomatter that is then turned into chemfuel, but is much less efficient than using other biomatter.
Rule.Translated: Descompone cadáveres en biomateria que después se transforma en combustible químico, aunque es mucho menos eficiente que utilizar otras fuentes de biomateria.
Atajos de teclado de Dubs Mint Minimap.

Rule.Original: An ornamented burial receptacle for the honored dead animals.
Rule.Raw: An ornamented burial receptacle for the honored dead animals.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente funerario ornamentado para honrar a los animales muertos.

Rule.Original: A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
Rule.Raw: A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
Rule.Translated: Una sencilla pero hermosa losa de piedra utilizada para dormir. Ofrece un confort mínimo, pero es duradera e ignífuga.

Rule.Original: A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping that fits two people. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
Rule.Raw: A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping that fits two people. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
Rule.Translated: Una sencilla pero hermosa losa de piedra utilizada para dormir, con espacio para dos. Ofrece un confort mínimo, pero es duradera e ignífuga.

Rule.Original: A somewhat comfy net and pillow rested on a sturdy frame. Due to the simple construction, quality is not a factor in this bed.
Rule.Raw: A somewhat comfy net and pillow rested on a sturdy frame. Due to the simple construction, quality is not a factor in this bed.
Rule.Translated: Una malla y una almohada relativamente cómodas que descansan sobre un marco robusto. Debido a su sencillo método de construcción, este objeto no cuenta con niveles de calidad.

Rule.Original: A somewhat comfy net and pillow rested on a sturdy frame that fits two people. Due to the simple construction, quality is not a factor in this bed.
Rule.Raw: A somewhat comfy net and pillow rested on a sturdy frame that fits two people. Due to the simple construction, quality is not a factor in this bed.
Rule.Translated: Una malla y una almohada relativamente cómodas que descansan sobre un marco robusto, con espacio para dos. Debido a su sencillo método de construcción, este objeto no cuenta con niveles de calidad.

Rule.Original: A soft cushion designed for sitting. More comfortable than a stool but still a simple seating option.
Rule.Raw: A soft cushion designed for sitting. More comfortable than a stool but still a simple seating option.
Rule.Translated: Un sencillo almohadón para sentarse. A pesar de ser tan sencillo, es más cómodo que otros tipos de asiento.

Rule.Original: A simple long platform on which multiple people may sit at the same time, not very comfortable but much better than nothing. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Raw: A simple long platform on which multiple people may sit at the same time, not very comfortable but much better than nothing. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Translated: Un asiento alargado y sencillo en la que pueden sentarse varias personas al mismo tiempo. No es muy cómodo, pero es mucho mejor que nada. Puede utilizarse en mesas, estaciones de trabajo y otros lugares.

Rule.Original: An uncomfortable school chair. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere. Improves the learning rate when adjacent to the school desk.
Rule.Raw: An uncomfortable school chair. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere. Improves the learning rate when adjacent to the school desk.
Rule.Translated: Una silla escolar no demasiado cómoda. Puede utilizarse en mesas, estaciones de trabajo y otros lugares. Mejora el ritmo de aprendizaje cuando está junto al pupitre escolar.

Rule.Original: People eat off counters when chairs are placed facing them
Rule.Raw: People eat off counters when chairs are placed facing them
Rule.Translated: Una superficie lisa, a la altura de la cintura sobre la que se puede comer, normalmente presente en cocinas y bares.

Rule.Original: A small table which makes nearby armchairs and couches a little bit more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the couch or an armchair. Placing more than one coffee table near the same couch has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A small table which makes nearby armchairs and couches a little bit more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the couch or an armchair. Placing more than one coffee table near the same couch has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Una mesita que hace un poco más cómodos los sillones y sofás cercanos. Debe colocarse directamente junto al sofá o al sillón. Colocar más de una mesa de centro cerca del mismo asiento no tiene ningún efecto adicional.

Rule.Original: Cooks meals and produces heat, but burns wood in the process. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable.
Rule.Raw: Cooks meals and produces heat, but burns wood in the process. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable.
Rule.Translated: Permite preparar comidas y produce calor, pero consume madera en el proceso. Dura más tiempo que una hoguera estándar. Como todas las fuentes de calor, debe colocarse en interiores para que tenga un espacio cerrado que calentar. Se puede repostar.

Rule.Original: An industrial-era radio for playing music and spoken broadcasts. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting. Provides passive music recreation to those that can hear it.
Rule.Raw: An industrial-era radio for playing music and spoken broadcasts. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting. Provides passive music recreation to those that can hear it.
Rule.Translated: Un aparato de la era industrial capaz de reproducir música y noticias. Incluso en los mundos fronterizos suele haber algún viejo transmisor o una emisora de radio solitaria emitiendo algo. Proporciona diversión de forma pasiva a cualquiera que pueda oírla.

Rule.Original: A state-of-the-art, high-fidelity radio that uses advanced longwave transmission to deliver crystal-clear music, broadcasts, and interstellar transmissions. Even on the rimworlds, someone out there is always transmitting something - whether it’s news, music, or distant voices from the void..
Rule.Raw: A state-of-the-art, high-fidelity radio that uses advanced longwave transmission to deliver crystal-clear music, broadcasts, and interstellar transmissions. Even on the rimworlds, someone out there is always transmitting something - whether it’s news, music, or distant voices from the void..
Rule.Translated: Una radio de última generación y alta fidelidad que utiliza la transmisión avanzada por onda larga para ofrecer música, emisiones y transmisiones interestelares con gran nitidez. Incluso en los mundos fronterizos suele haber alguien transmitiendo algo, ya sean noticias, música o voces lejanas procedentes del vacío...

Rule.Original: A bulky, coin-operated arcade cabinet with an aging CRT screen and colorful buttons. Though outdated, it still provides hours of digital entertainment. Classic games never truly die.
Rule.Raw: A bulky, coin-operated arcade cabinet with an aging CRT screen and colorful buttons. Though outdated, it still provides hours of digital entertainment. Classic games never truly die.
Rule.Translated: Un mueble alto que cuenta con una pantalla de rayos catódicos y un panel de control con botones coloridos, que funciona con modedas. Aunque anticuado, sigue siendo capaz de proporcionar horas de entretenimiento digital. Los juegos clásicos nunca mueren de verdad.

Rule.Original: A bulky, outdated computer standing on a small desk. The screen flickers, the keys stick, and it hums with age, but it still runs simple programs. There's always some archaic software waiting to be used.
Rule.Raw: A bulky, outdated computer standing on a small desk. The screen flickers, the keys stick, and it hums with age, but it still runs simple programs. There's always some archaic software waiting to be used.
Rule.Translated: Un ordenador voluminoso y anticuado sobre un pequeño escritorio. La pantalla parpadea, las teclas se atascan y zumba por la edad, pero sigue ejecutando programas sencillos. Siempre hay algún programa arcaico esperando a ser utilizado.\n\nSu uso ayuda a entrenar la habilidad intelectual.

Rule.Original: A sleek, high-performance computing station housed on a sturdy desk. Equipped with a fast processor, an ergonomic keyboard, and a crisp, flat-panel display, it offers a vast range of software: whether for research, entertainment, or light interstellar networking.
Rule.Raw: A sleek, high-performance computing station housed on a sturdy desk. Equipped with a fast processor, an ergonomic keyboard, and a crisp, flat-panel display, it offers a vast range of software: whether for research, entertainment, or light interstellar networking.
Rule.Translated: Una elegante estación informática de alto rendimiento colocada sobre un robusto escritorio. Equipada con un rápido procesador, un teclado ergonómico y una nítida pantalla plana, ofrece una amplia gama de software: ya sea para investigación, entretenimiento o redes interestelares cercanas.\n\nSu uso ayuda a entrenar la habilidad intelectual, así como avanzar un poco en el proyecto de investigación actual.

Rule.Original: A compact upright piano designed for musical recreation. A great way to develop artistic skills and entertain others.
Rule.Raw: A compact upright piano designed for musical recreation. A great way to develop artistic skills and entertain others.
Rule.Translated: Un piano de cola robusto y compacto diseñado para su uso como fuente de recreación musical. Una gran manera de desarrollar la habilidad artística y entretener a los demás.

Rule.Original: A sophisticated gambling table designed for playing roulette. A thrilling mix of chance and strategy, making it a centerpiece of any high-end casino or social space.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticated gambling table designed for playing roulette. A thrilling mix of chance and strategy, making it a centerpiece of any high-end casino or social space.
Rule.Translated: Una sofisticada mesa de juego diseñada para jugar a la ruleta. Una emocionante mezcla de azar y estrategia, que la convierte en la pieza central de cualquier casino o espacio social de alto nivel.

Rule.Original: A simple dartboard mounted on a stand. A fun way to practice accuracy and hand-eye coordination. It trains shooting ability.
Rule.Raw: A simple dartboard mounted on a stand. A fun way to practice accuracy and hand-eye coordination. It trains shooting ability.
Rule.Translated: Una diana sencilla montada sobre un soporte. Una forma divertida de mejorar la puntería la coordinación ojo-mano. Su uso ayuda a mejorar habilidad de disparo.

Rule.Original: A sturdy, stand-mounted punching bag for combat training and stress relief. It trains melee combat ability.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy, stand-mounted punching bag for combat training and stress relief. It trains melee combat ability.
Rule.Translated: Un robusto saco de tela montado sobre un soporte vertical, ideal para aliviar el estrés. Su uso ayuda a mejorar la habilidad cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A reclining cushioned lounger designed for relaxation. Offers superior comfort but is not ideal for deep, restful sleep. Allows for sunbathing recreation.
Rule.Raw: A reclining cushioned lounger designed for relaxation. Offers superior comfort but is not ideal for deep, restful sleep. Allows for sunbathing recreation.
Rule.Translated: Una superficie acolchada y reclinable diseñada para relajarse. Ofrece una mayor comodidad que otras superficies, pero no es adecuada para obtener un sueño profundo y reparador. Permite tomar el sol de forma recreativa.

Rule.Original: Increases research speed when placed near a research bench. One research bench can use up to two filing cabinets.
Rule.Raw: Increases research speed when placed near a research bench. One research bench can use up to two filing cabinets.
Rule.Translated: Un mueble que sirve para organizar documentos y registros en papel. Aumenta la velocidad de investigación cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de investigación. Una mesa de investigación puede utilizar hasta dos archivadores al mismo tiempo.

Rule.Original: A shelf for storing weapons. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Raw: A shelf for storing weapons. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Translated: Un estante de alta resistencia para almacenar armamento. Los objetos almacenados en él no se deteriorarán, aunque estén en el exterior.

Rule.Original: A small bin to help keep the surrounding area somewhat clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 10-cell radius.
Rule.Raw: A small bin to help keep the surrounding area somewhat clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 10-cell radius.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño receptáculo que ayuda a mantener el área circundante algo más limpia. Elimina lentamente la basura y la suciedad en un radio de 10 celdas.

Rule.Original: A spacious waste disposal unit that efficiently keeps the surrounding area clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 15-cell radius.

Rule.Raw: A pair of thick enough jeans to provide some degree of protection from damage and cold.
Rule.Translated: Unos pantalones vaqueros lo suficientemente gruesos como para proporcionar cierto grado de protección contra el daño y el frío.

Rule.Original: A thick cloth coat protects from the heat of stoves and splattering of boiling liquids.
Rule.Raw: A thick cloth coat protects from the heat of stoves and splattering of boiling liquids.
Rule.Translated: Un manto de tela gruesa que protege del calor de los fogones y de las salpicaduras de los líquidos que hierven.

Rule.Original: A thick fabric military formal jacket used for certain ceremonies, receptions and celebrations. It contains orders, medals insignia and campaign ribbons. It is considered a symbol of courage and valor.
Rule.Raw: A thick fabric military formal jacket used for certain ceremonies, receptions and celebrations. It contains orders, medals insignia and campaign ribbons. It is considered a symbol of courage and valor.
Rule.Translated: Una chaqueta de gala militar de tejido grueso que se utiliza en determinadas ceremonias, recepciones y celebraciones. Lleva encima órdenes, insignias de medallas y cintas de campaña. Se considera un símbolo de valor y coraje.

Rule.Original: A thick, protective coverall with a military camouflage.
Rule.Raw: A thick, protective coverall with a military camouflage.
Rule.Translated: Un grueso mono de protección con un camuflaje militar.

Rule.Original: A jacket with highly reflective properties and a colour that is easily discernible from any background.\n\nMost industrial employees wear it as part of their personal protective equipment.
Rule.Raw: A jacket with highly reflective properties and a colour that is easily discernible from any background.\n\nMost industrial employees wear it as part of their personal protective equipment.
Rule.Translated: Un chaleco con propiedades altamente reflectantes y un color que se distingue fácilmente de cualquier fondo.\n\nLa mayoría de los empleados industriales lo llevan como parte de su equipo de protección personal.

Rule.Original: Sanitary clothing worn by surgeons, nurses and other workers involved in patient care. They are designed to be simple, easy to launder and cheap to replace if damaged or stained.
Rule.Raw: Sanitary clothing worn by surgeons, nurses and other workers involved in patient care. They are designed to be simple, easy to launder and cheap to replace if damaged or stained.
Rule.Translated: Indumentaria sanitaria utilizada por cirujanos, enfermeras y otros trabajadores que participan en el cuidado de los pacientes. Están diseñadas para ser sencillas, fáciles de lavar y baratas de sustituir si se dañan o manchan.

Rule.Original: A light coat worn to protect clothing from substances used in a lab.
Rule.Raw: A light coat worn to protect clothing from substances used in a lab.
Rule.Translated: Una bata ligera que se usa para proteger la ropa de las sustancias utilizadas en un laboratorio.

Rule.Original: A sleeveless type of T-shirt, useful during prolonged exercise.
Rule.Raw: A sleeveless type of T-shirt, useful during prolonged exercise.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de camiseta sin mangas, ideal para sesiones de ejercicio prolongadas.

Rule.Original: A formal, thick buttoned-down shirt with a sheriff star on the chest. Provides wearer with a sense of pride and accomplishment.
Rule.Raw: A formal, thick buttoned-down shirt with a sheriff star on the chest. Provides wearer with a sense of pride and accomplishment.
Rule.Translated: Una camisa formal, gruesa y abotonada, con una estrella de sheriff en el pecho. Proporciona a quien la lleva una sensación de orgullo y realización personal.

Rule.Original: A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather. Excellent for general body protection and manual labour.
Rule.Raw: A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather. Excellent for general body protection and manual labour.
Rule.Translated: Un mono de cuerpo entero hecho de tela gruesa o cuero. Excelente como protección general para el cuerpo y para realizar cualquier trabajo manual.

Rule.Original: Slightly heavier than a normal shirt, a tunic is a great isolation against cold weather.
Rule.Raw: Slightly heavier than a normal shirt, a tunic is a great isolation against cold weather.
Rule.Translated: La túnica, una prenda ligeramente más pesada que una camisa normal, es un excelente aislamiento contra el frío.

Rule.Original: Very light and thin blouse, great for hot climates.
Rule.Raw: Very light and thin blouse, great for hot climates.
Rule.Translated: Una blusa muy ligera y fina, ideal para climas cálidos.

Rule.Original: A leather or cloth apron covering legs, waist and chest.\n\nApron like that is often used by craftsmen, doctors and chefs due to useful pockets and protection it provides.
Rule.Raw: A leather or cloth apron covering legs, waist and chest.\n\nApron like that is often used by craftsmen, doctors and chefs due to useful pockets and protection it provides.
Rule.Translated: Un delantal de cuero o de tela que cubre las piernas, la cintura y el pecho.\n\nEste tipo de delantal suele ser utilizado por artesanos, médicos y cocineros debido a los prácticos bolsillos y a la protección que ofrece.

Rule.Original: A heavy coat insulated due to animal pelt, providing warmth and armor.
Rule.Raw: A heavy coat insulated due to animal pelt, providing warmth and armor.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo pesado y bien aislado gracias a la piel de los animales, que proporciona calor y protección.

Rule.Original: A poncho crafted using neolithic tools. While it may look primitive, it is effective at insulating the wearer.
Rule.Raw: A poncho crafted using neolithic tools. While it may look primitive, it is effective at insulating the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Un poncho fabricado con herramientas neolíticas. Aunque parezca primitivo, es eficaz a la hora de aislar a quien la lleva.

Rule.Original: A kilt crafted using neolithic tools. While it may look primitive, it is effective at insulating the wearer.
Rule.Raw: A kilt crafted using neolithic tools. While it may look primitive, it is effective at insulating the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña falda fabricada con herramientas neolíticas. Aunque parezca primitiva, es eficaz a la hora de aislar a quien la lleva.

Rule.Original: A warm and long piece of fabric protecting the neck from exposure to cold.
Rule.Raw: A warm and long piece of fabric protecting the neck from exposure to cold.
Rule.Translated: Una pieza de tela cálida y larga que protege el cuello de la exposición al frío.

Rule.Original: A soft, flat crowned hat. Often worn by the military as a symbol of valor.
Rule.Raw: A soft, flat crowned hat. Often worn by the military as a symbol of valor.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero suave y de copa plana. Los militares suelen llevarla como símbolo de valor.

Rule.Original: A type of helmet predominantly used in a work environment. Provides high protection against blunt trauma.
Rule.Raw: A type of helmet predominantly used in a work environment. Provides high protection against blunt trauma.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de casco que se utiliza sobre todo en el entorno laboral. Proporciona una alta protección contra los traumatismos por golpes.

Rule.Original: Sanitary mask worn by the surgeons, nurses and other workers involved in patient care.
Rule.Raw: Sanitary mask worn by the surgeons, nurses and other workers involved in patient care.
Rule.Translated: Una mascarilla sanitaria que usan los cirujanos, las enfermeras y otros trabajadores que participan en el cuidado de los pacientes.

Rule.Original: A type of soft cap with a rounded crown and a stiff peak protecting the front.
Rule.Raw: A type of soft cap with a rounded crown and a stiff peak protecting the front.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de gorra suave con una corona redondeada y una visera rígida que protege la parte delantera.

Rule.Original: A pair of sunglasses protecting the wearer from dangerous UV rays. Often considered to be ‘cool’.
Rule.Raw: A pair of sunglasses protecting the wearer from dangerous UV rays. Often considered to be ‘cool’.
Rule.Translated: Un par de gafas de sol que protegen al usuario de los peligrosos rayos ultravioleta. A menudo se consideran de lo más guay.

Rule.Original: A pair of correction glasses, providing users with some degree of psychic immunity.
Rule.Raw: A pair of correction glasses, providing users with some degree of psychic immunity.
Rule.Translated: Un par de gafas correctoras, que proporcionan a los usuarios cierto grado de inmunidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: A tall, round, pleated hat usually worn by the chefs.
Rule.Raw: A tall, round, pleated hat usually worn by the chefs.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero alto, redondo y plisado que suelen llevar los cocineros.
Suelo de tablones de madera quemado.
suelo de mosaico de madera quemado
Suelo de mosaico de madera quemado.

Rule.Original: Soft check carpet made from fibers dyed a single color. It's welcoming, cozy, and boosts the beauty of the room it's in. It's also quite flammable, and cleaning it is a laborious process.
Rule.Raw: Soft check carpet made from fibers dyed a single color. It's welcoming, cozy, and boosts the beauty of the room it's in. It's also quite flammable, and cleaning it is a laborious process.
Rule.Translated: Alfombra ajedrezada suave, hecha de fibras teñidas de un solo color. Es acogedora y confortable, y aumenta la belleza de la habitación en la que se coloca. También es bastante inflamable y cuesta mucho limpiarla.

Rule.Original: Luxurious, check carpet made from fibers dyed a single color. Beautiful to look at, but cleaning it is a labor-intensive process.
Rule.Raw: Luxurious, check carpet made from fibers dyed a single color. Beautiful to look at, but cleaning it is a labor-intensive process.
Rule.Translated: Alfombra ajedrezada lujosa, hecha de fibras teñidas de un solo color. Es bonita, pero limpiarla exige mucho trabajo.

Rule.Original: Simple, but beautiful tiles made of jade.
Rule.Raw: Simple, but beautiful tiles made of jade.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de jade sencillas, pero bonitas.

Rule.Original: Beautiful floor made of polished jade plates.
Rule.Raw: Beautiful floor made of polished jade plates.
Rule.Translated: Suelo bonito de placas de jade pulido.
Suelo fino de jade, de gran belleza.

Rule.Original: Floor made of simple metal sheets. Don't look great, but cheap and pretty fast to build. Good to cover big industrial areas.
Rule.Raw: Floor made of simple metal sheets. Don't look great, but cheap and pretty fast to build. Good to cover big industrial areas.
Rule.Translated: Suelo de planchas metálicas sencillas. Su aspecto deja que desear, pero es barato y bastante rápido de construir. Es adecuado para cubrir grandes áreas industriales.

Rule.Original: Caution metal floor for industrial areas painted with black and yellow stripes.
Rule.Raw: Caution metal floor for industrial areas painted with black and yellow stripes.
Rule.Translated: Suelo metálico de señalización para áreas industriales, pintado con franjas negras y amarillas.

Rule.Original: Floor made of simple metal sheets. Don't look great, but cheap and fast to build. Good to cover big industrial areas.
Rule.Raw: Floor made of simple metal sheets. Don't look great, but cheap and fast to build. Good to cover big industrial areas.
Rule.Translated: Suelo de planchas metálicas sencillas. Su aspecto deja que desear, pero es barato y rápido de construir. Es adecuado para cubrir grandes áreas industriales.

Rule.Original: Check metal tiles, for that spaceship look. Pretty, but labor and material-intensive.
Rule.Raw: Check metal tiles, for that spaceship look. Pretty, but labor and material-intensive.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas metálicas ajedrezadas que dan un aspecto de nave espacial. Son bonitas, pero exigen mucho trabajo y materiales.

Rule.Original: Hexagonal metal tiles, for that spaceship look. Pretty, but labor and material-intensive.
Rule.Raw: Hexagonal metal tiles, for that spaceship look. Pretty, but labor and material-intensive.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas metálicas hexagonales que dan un aspecto de nave espacial. Son bonitas, pero exigen mucho trabajo y materiales.

Rule.Original: For a futuristic but royal look, check silver tiles fit perfectly into luxurious rooms. They get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: For a futuristic but royal look, check silver tiles fit perfectly into luxurious rooms. They get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Las baldosas ajedrezadas de plata dan un aspecto futurista y regio, y encajan perfectamente en habitaciones lujosas. Otorgan una bonificación a la limpieza.

Rule.Original: For a futuristic but royal look, hexagonal silver tiles fit perfectly into luxurious rooms. They get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: For a futuristic but royal look, hexagonal silver tiles fit perfectly into luxurious rooms. They get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Las baldosas hexagonales de plata dan un aspecto futurista y regio, y encajan perfectamente en habitaciones lujosas. Otorgan una bonificación a la limpieza.

Rule.Original: For overbearing extravagance, nothing beats check gold tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them.
Rule.Raw: For overbearing extravagance, nothing beats check gold tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them.
Rule.Translated: Para una extravagancia ostentosa, nada supera a las baldosas ajedrezadas de oro. Son excepcionalmente caras y bonitas, y los demás te considerarán excepcionalmente esnob si de verdad vives sobre ellas.

Rule.Original: For overbearing extravagance, nothing beats hexagonal gold tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them.
Rule.Raw: For overbearing extravagance, nothing beats hexagonal gold tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them.
Rule.Translated: Para una extravagancia ostentosa, nada supera a las baldosas hexagonales de oro. Son excepcionalmente caras y bonitas, y los demás te considerarán excepcionalmente esnob si de verdad vives sobre ellas.

Rule.Original: Plasteel tiles, for that spaceship look. Slightly easier to clean. Expensive and slow to build, but very pretty. The smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: Plasteel tiles, for that spaceship look. Slightly easier to clean. Expensive and slow to build, but very pretty. The smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de plastiacero que dan un aspecto de nave espacial. Son algo más fáciles de limpiar. Resultan caras y lentas de construir, pero son muy bonitas. Su superficie lisa otorga una bonificación a la limpieza.

Rule.Original: Plasteel check tiles, for that spaceship look. Slightly easier to clean. Expensive and slow to build, but very pretty. The smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: Plasteel check tiles, for that spaceship look. Slightly easier to clean. Expensive and slow to build, but very pretty. The smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas ajedrezadas de plastiacero que dan un aspecto de nave espacial. Son algo más fáciles de limpiar. Resultan caras y lentas de construir, pero son muy bonitas. Su superficie lisa otorga una bonificación a la limpieza.

Rule.Original: Plasteel hexagonal tiles, for that spaceship look. Slightly easier to clean. Expensive and slow to build, but very pretty. The smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: Plasteel hexagonal tiles, for that spaceship look. Slightly easier to clean. Expensive and slow to build, but very pretty. The smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas hexagonales de plastiacero que dan un aspecto de nave espacial. Son algo más fáciles de limpiar. Resultan caras y lentas de construir, pero son muy bonitas. Su superficie lisa otorga una bonificación a la limpieza.

Rule.Original: Check sterile tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build.
Rule.Raw: Check sterile tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas estériles ajedrezadas con propiedades especiales que mejoran la limpieza. Las habitaciones especialmente limpias mejoran los resultados en hospitales y laboratorios de investigación. Estas baldosas se construyen muy despacio.

Rule.Original: Hexagonal sterile tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build.
Rule.Raw: Hexagonal sterile tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas estériles hexagonales con propiedades especiales que mejoran la limpieza. Las habitaciones especialmente limpias mejoran los resultados en hospitales y laboratorios de investigación. Estas baldosas se construyen muy despacio.

Rule.Original: Simple smoothened dirt. A bit less dirty than normal soil. Doesn't allow plants to grow.
Rule.Raw: Simple smoothened dirt. A bit less dirty than normal soil. Doesn't allow plants to grow.
Rule.Translated: Tierra simplemente alisada. Es algo menos sucia que la tierra normal y no permite que crezcan plantas.

Rule.Original: Plywood floor. Looks pretty bad, but cheap and fast to build. Perfect to cover big areas fast, but flammable.
Rule.Raw: Plywood floor. Looks pretty bad, but cheap and fast to build. Perfect to cover big areas fast, but flammable.
Rule.Translated: Suelo de contrachapado. Tiene un aspecto bastante malo, pero es barato y rápido de construir. Es perfecto para cubrir grandes áreas con rapidez, aunque es inflamable.

Rule.Original: Floor made of smooth wide wood planks. Simple and nice.
Rule.Raw: Floor made of smooth wide wood planks. Simple and nice.
Rule.Translated: Suelo de tablones de madera anchos y lisos. Sencillo y bonito.

Rule.Original: Nice looking checkered floor made of small wood planks.
Rule.Raw: Nice looking checkered floor made of small wood planks.
Rule.Translated: Suelo ajedrezado de buen aspecto, hecho de pequeños tablones de madera.

Rule.Original: Floor made of fine smooth wood planks. Makes any room better, but expensive and hard to build.
Rule.Raw: Floor made of fine smooth wood planks. Makes any room better, but expensive and hard to build.
Rule.Translated: Suelo de tablones de madera finos y lisos. Mejora cualquier habitación, pero resulta caro y difícil de construir.

Rule.Original: Polished wood floor made of small planks fitted to each other. Looks fine but very expensive and hard to build.
Rule.Raw: Polished wood floor made of small planks fitted to each other. Looks fine but very expensive and hard to build.
Rule.Translated: Suelo de madera pulida hecho de pequeños tablones encajados entre sí. Tiene buen aspecto, pero resulta muy caro y difícil de construir.

Rule.Original: this person is standing in a trench or other defensive structure.
Rule.Raw: this person is standing in a trench or other defensive structure.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona está en una trinchera u otra estructura defensiva similar.

Rule.Original: this person is standing on a platform or other structure.
Rule.Raw: this person is standing on a platform or other structure.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona está sobre una plataforma u otra estructura similar.

Rule.Original: Significant impairment of vision as a result of over-exposure to light.
Rule.Raw: Significant impairment of vision as a result of over-exposure to light.
Rule.Translated: Una deficiencia significativa de la capacidad de visión como resultado de la sobreexposición a la luz.

Rule.Original: subject_story->revived ancient methods for breaching the stoutest defenses
Rule.Raw: subject_story->revived ancient methods for breaching the stoutest defenses
Rule.Translated: subject_story->revivió antiguos métodos para romper las defensas más resistentes

Rule.Original: subject_story->crafted engines of war that thunder across fields, striking fear into foes
Rule.Raw: subject_story->crafted engines of war that thunder across fields, striking fear into foes
Rule.Translated: subject_story->máquinas de guerra artesanales que atronan los campos mientras infundien miedo a los enemigos.

Rule.Original: subject_story->engineered trebuchets and battering rams from sturdy timber and iron
Rule.Raw: subject_story->engineered trebuchets and battering rams from sturdy timber and iron

Rule.Original: subject_story->led sieges that would become legendary, their tactics studied for ages
Rule.Raw: subject_story->led sieges that would become legendary, their tactics studied for ages

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->laying siege to the future by rediscovering the past

Rule.Translated: subject_story->fusionó los antiguos sueños de invencibilidad con el toque tangible de la ciencia

Rule.Original: subject_story->ensured peace within the storm, under the watchful gaze of shimmering barriers
Rule.Raw: subject_story->ensured peace within the storm, under the watchful gaze of shimmering barriers
Rule.Translated: subject_story->aseguró la paz dentro de la tormenta, bajo la atenta mirada de barreras resplandecientes

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->weaving the fabric of defense with threads of pure energy
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->weaving the fabric of defense with threads of pure energy
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->tejiendo el manto de la defensa con hilos de energía pura

Rule.Original: How many times does this trap hit its targets.\n\nThe total trap damage is spread evenly across all the hits.
Rule.Raw: How many times does this trap hit its targets.\n\nThe total trap damage is spread evenly across all the hits.
Rule.Translated: El número de veces que esta trampa golpea a sus objetivos.\n\nEl daño total de la trampa se reparte uniformemente entre todos los impactos.

Rule.Original: A specialized defensive turret that intercepts explosive projectiles and incoming drop pods within its protective radius, but cannot engage ground targets. Interception chance scales with the target's velocity. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
Rule.Raw: A specialized defensive turret that intercepts explosive projectiles and incoming drop pods within its protective radius, but cannot engage ground targets. Interception chance scales with the target's velocity. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta defensiva especializada capaz de interceptar proyectiles explosivos y cápsulas de transporte entrantes dentro de su radio de protección. A cambio, no puede atacar objetivos terrestres. La probabilidad de intercepción depende de la velocidad del objetivo. Requiere de acero para renovar sus cañones tras un uso intensivo.

Rule.Original: A rapid-fire gun for point-defense applications.
Rule.Raw: A rapid-fire gun for point-defense applications.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de fuego rápido para aplicaciones de defensa puntual.

Rule.Original: An automated mortar that launches high-explosive shells. While it can inflict devastating damage, the mortar's inherent inaccuracy makes it more useful for attacking large fortifications than groups of enemies in the field. Due to a delicate firing mechanism, it's only calibrated to fire high-explosive shells.
Rule.Raw: An automated mortar that launches high-explosive shells. While it can inflict devastating damage, the mortar's inherent inaccuracy makes it more useful for attacking large fortifications than groups of enemies in the field. Due to a delicate firing mechanism, it's only calibrated to fire high-explosive shells.
Rule.Translated: Un mortero automatizado que lanza proyectiles de gran potencia explosiva. Aunque puede infligir daños devastadores, la imprecisión inherente del mortero lo hace más útil a la hora de atacar grandes fortificaciones que grupos de enemigos desperdigados. Debido a su delicado mecanismo de disparo, solo está calibrado para disparar obuses altamente explosivos.

Rule.Original: A powerful, manned artillery cannon designed for long-range bombardment. Though it fires slower than a mortar, its improved targeting systems allow for far greater accuracy, making it ideal for precise strikes against enemy structures or high-value targets. Can be crewed by two people to double its firing speed. Capable of providing fire support across the world map, but only on revealed locations.
Rule.Raw: A powerful, manned artillery cannon designed for long-range bombardment. Though it fires slower than a mortar, its improved targeting systems allow for far greater accuracy, making it ideal for precise strikes against enemy structures or high-value targets. Can be crewed by two people to double its firing speed. Capable of providing fire support across the world map, but only on revealed locations.
Rule.Translated: Un potente cañón de artillería de uso manual diseñado para realizar bombardeos de largo alcance. Aunque dispara más despacio que un mortero, sus sistemas de puntería mejorados permiten una precisión mucho mayor, lo que lo hace ideal para ataques precisos contra estructuras enemigas u objetivos de gran valor. Puede ser manejado por dos personas para duplicar su velocidad de disparo. Es capaz de proporcionar fuego de apoyo en todo el mapa del mundo, pero solo en ubicaciones reveladas.

Rule.Original: Artillery launcher. Lobs bombs over walls. Accurate and long-ranged.
Rule.Raw: Artillery launcher. Lobs bombs over walls. Accurate and long-ranged.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzador de obuses de artillería. Puede lanzar proyectiles por encima de los muros. Preciso y de largo alcance.

Rule.Original: A compact automatic turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. It is capable of submerging into the ground, becoming impossible to target. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: A compact automatic turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. It is capable of submerging into the ground, becoming impossible to target. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta automática compacta equipada con blindaje retráctil y un mecanismo de inmersión. Es capaz de sumergirse en el suelo, convirtiéndose de forma efectiva en un objeto inalcanzable. Requiere acero para reacondicionar su cañón tras un uso intensivo. Puede explotar si es dañado. Su tonto cerebro de IA no puede controlarse directamente, por lo que deberás tener cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un simple cañón automático hecho para ser montado en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A retractable, waist-high barrier for use as cover from incoming shots. It provides strong cover while deployed and is almost invisible when submerged. Barricades will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do. Requires power.
Rule.Raw: A retractable, waist-high barrier for use as cover from incoming shots. It provides strong cover while deployed and is almost invisible when submerged. Barricades will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do. Requires power.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera retráctil que llega a la altura de la cintura cuando está desplegada. Proporciona una fuerte cobertura cuando está activada y es casi invisible cuando está sumergida. Las barricadas bloquean a ciertos tipos de animales del mismo modo que las vallas. Requiere energía.

Rule.Original:
An ultratech device that projects a potent energy field around itself to protect everything inside, but consumes a huge amount of power when active. Works through walls.

Repulsors only activate when there's an active threat present such as a raid or an artillery bombardment. Otherwise, they stay in an inactive state and consume much less power.

Can set surrounding area on fire if enough damage is absorbed in a short period of time.
Rule.Raw:
An ultratech device that projects a potent energy field around itself to protect everything inside, but consumes a huge amount of power when active. Works through walls.

Repulsors only activate when there's an active threat present such as a raid or an artillery bombardment. Otherwise, they stay in an inactive state and consume much less power.

Can set surrounding area on fire if enough damage is absorbed in a short period of time.
Rule.Translated:
Un dispositivo ultratécnico que proyecta un potente campo de energía a su alrededor para proteger todo lo que hay en su interior, a costa de consumir una enorme cantidad de energía cuando está activo. Funciona incluso a través de las paredes.

Los repulsores solo se activan cuando hay una amenaza activa en el área, como una incursión o un bombardeo de artillería. De lo contrario, permanecen inactivos y consumen mucha menos energía.

Pueden incendiar la zona circundante si se absorbe suficiente daño en poco tiempo.

Rule.Original:
A large, ultratech device that projects an extremely vast energy field around itself to protect everything inside, but consumes a huge amount of power when active. Works through walls.

Repulsors only activate when there's an active threat present such as a raid or an artillery bombardment. Otherwise, they stay in an inactive state and consume much less power.

Can set surrounding area on fire if enough damage is absorbed in a short period of time.
Rule.Raw:
A large, ultratech device that projects an extremely vast energy field around itself to protect everything inside, but consumes a huge amount of power when active. Works through walls.

Repulsors only activate when there's an active threat present such as a raid or an artillery bombardment. Otherwise, they stay in an inactive state and consume much less power.

Can set surrounding area on fire if enough damage is absorbed in a short period of time.
Rule.Translated:
Un dispositivo ultratécnico de gran tamaño que proyecta un amplísimo campo de energía a su alrededor para proteger todo lo que hay en su interior, a costa de consumir una enorme cantidad de energía cuando está activo. Funciona incluso a través de las paredes.

Los repulsores solo se activan cuando hay una amenaza activa en el área, como una incursión o un bombardeo de artillería. De lo contrario, permanecen inactivos y consumen mucha menos energía.

Pueden incendiar la zona circundante si se absorbe suficiente daño en poco tiempo.

Rule.Original: Two heavy metal jaws held open under tension, connected to a pressure-sensitive trigger. When stepped on, the jaws snap shut with high force, inflicting severe damage. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. When triggered, it can be re-armed.
Rule.Raw: Two heavy metal jaws held open under tension, connected to a pressure-sensitive trigger. When stepped on, the jaws snap shut with high force, inflicting severe damage. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. When triggered, it can be re-armed.
Rule.Translated: Dos pesadas mandíbulas metálicas que se mantienen abiertas bajo tensión, conectadas a un gatillo sensible a la presión. Al pisarlas, las mandíbulas se cierran con gran fuerza, infligiendo graves daños. Al estar oculta en el terreno circundante, no puede colocarse junto a otras trampas. No se destruye cuando se activa, simplemente se puede volver a armar.

Rule.Original: A row of sharpened spikes laid low across the ground. Designed to maim or cripple those who attempt to charge through, especially fast-moving animals or mounted units. Can be placed next to other cavalry spikes. Upon being triggered, cavalry spikes will need to be rebuilt.
Rule.Raw: A row of sharpened spikes laid low across the ground. Designed to maim or cripple those who attempt to charge through, especially fast-moving animals or mounted units. Can be placed next to other cavalry spikes. Upon being triggered, cavalry spikes will need to be rebuilt.
Rule.Translated: Una hilera de pinchos afilados colocados a poca altura sobre el suelo. Diseñadas para mutilar o lisiar a quienes intenten atravesarlas, especialmente animales o unidades montadas que se muevan rápido. Puede colocarse junto a otros tramos de empalizada. Cuando se activan, deben reconstruirse.

Rule.Original: A sophisticated explosive charge connected to a pressure plate trigger which detonates immediately on touch. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticated explosive charge connected to a pressure plate trigger which detonates immediately on touch. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
Rule.Translated: Una sofisticada carga explosiva conectada a un detonador accionado por la presión que detona inmediatamente al tocarla. Al estar oculta en el terreno circundante, no puede colocarse junto a otras trampas. Los animales pueden percibirlas cuando están tranquilos.

Rule.Original: A concealed high-tech trap that releases a localized EMP pulse when triggered. It resets automatically after a short cooldown. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
Rule.Raw: A concealed high-tech trap that releases a localized EMP pulse when triggered. It resets automatically after a short cooldown. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
Rule.Translated: Una trampa oculta de alta tecnología que libera un pulso electromagnético localizado cuando se activa. Se restablece automáticamente tras un breve período de enfriamiento. Al estar oculta en el terreno circundante, no puede colocarse junto a otras trampas. Los animales pueden percibirlas cuando están tranquilos.

Rule.Original: A razor wire fence consisting of sharp edges and points arranged at intervals. Not only does it slow down movement of enemies, it also inflicts cuts and puncture wounds. Razor wire will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do.
Rule.Raw: A razor wire fence consisting of sharp edges and points arranged at intervals. Not only does it slow down movement of enemies, it also inflicts cuts and puncture wounds. Razor wire will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do.
Rule.Translated: Una alambrada formada por fibras llenas de bordes afilados y puntas dispuestas a intervalos aleatorios. No solo ralentiza el movimiento de los enemigos, sino que también inflige cortes y heridas punzantes. El alambre de espino bloquea a ciertos tipos de animales del mismo modo que las vallas.

Rule.Original: A long, narrow ditch dug into the ground. Crossing it requires climbing up and down, therefore it significantly slows down movement speed. People inside the dugout suffer weapon range penalty, but gain significant cover and protection from explosive damage.
Rule.Raw: A long, narrow ditch dug into the ground. Crossing it requires climbing up and down, therefore it significantly slows down movement speed. People inside the dugout suffer weapon range penalty, but gain significant cover and protection from explosive damage.
Rule.Translated: Una zanja larga y estrecha excavada en el suelo. Cruzarla requiere subir y bajar, lo que ralentiza considerablemente la velocidad de movimiento. Las personas que se encuentran dentro de la zanja ven el alcance de sus armas a distancia reducido, pero obtienen una cobertura y una protección significativas frente al daño explosivo.

Rule.Original: A long, damage-resistant reinforced trench. Crossing it requires climbing up and down, therefore it significantly slows down movement speed. People inside the trench suffer a weapon range penalty, but gain significant cover and protection from explosive damage.
Rule.Raw: A long, damage-resistant reinforced trench. Crossing it requires climbing up and down, therefore it significantly slows down movement speed. People inside the trench suffer a weapon range penalty, but gain significant cover and protection from explosive damage.
Rule.Translated: Una zanja larga reforzada resistente a los daños. Cruzarla requiere subir y bajar, lo que ralentiza considerablemente la velocidad de movimiento. Las personas que se encuentran dentro de la zanja ven el alcance de sus armas a distancia reducido, pero obtienen una cobertura y una protección significativas frente al daño explosivo.

Rule.Original: A long, narrow platform. Crossing it requires climbing up and down, therefore it significantly slows down movement speed. People on the platform receive a bonus to weapon range, but suffer from lower cover.
Rule.Raw: A long, narrow platform. Crossing it requires climbing up and down, therefore it significantly slows down movement speed. People on the platform receive a bonus to weapon range, but suffer from lower cover.
Rule.Translated: Una plataforma larga y estrecha. Cruzarla requiere subir y bajar, lo que ralentiza considerablemente la velocidad de movimiento. Las personas que se encuentran en la plataforma reciben una bonificación al alcance de sus armas a distancia, pero se convierten en blancos más fáciles de alcanzar.

Rule.Original: A small ammunition box that improves the reload speed of everyone nearby. Will explode if damaged.
Rule.Raw: A small ammunition box that improves the reload speed of everyone nearby. Will explode if damaged.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja de munición que mejora la velocidad de recarga de todos los que están cerca. Explota si es dañada.

Rule.Original: A ballistic device used to launch a projectile a great distance without the aid of gunpowder or other propellants. In use since ancient times, the catapult has proven to be one of the most persistently effective mechanisms in warfare.
Rule.Raw: A ballistic device used to launch a projectile a great distance without the aid of gunpowder or other propellants. In use since ancient times, the catapult has proven to be one of the most persistently effective mechanisms in warfare.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo balístico utilizado para lanzar proyectiles a gran distancia sin ayuda de pólvora u otro tipo de sustancias propulsoras. Utilizada desde la antigüedad, la catapulta ha demostrado ser uno de los mecanismos más persistentemente eficaces en la guerra.

Rule.Original: A ballistic device used to launch a projectile a great distance without the aid of gunpowder or other propellants.
Rule.Raw: A ballistic device used to launch a projectile a great distance without the aid of gunpowder or other propellants.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo balístico utilizado para lanzar proyectiles a gran distancia sin ayuda de pólvora u otro tipo de sustancias propulsoras.

Rule.Original: An ancient military siege engine in the form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct. Bolts fired from this machine explode into splinters on impact. Needs to be manned in order to fire.
Rule.Raw: An ancient military siege engine in the form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct. Bolts fired from this machine explode into splinters on impact. Needs to be manned in order to fire.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina militar de asedio que consiste en una gran ballesta montada sobre una construcción de madera. Los proyectiles que dispara estallan en astillas al impactar. Necesita ser manejada a mano para disparar.

Rule.Original: An ancient military siege engine in a form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct.
Rule.Raw: An ancient military siege engine in a form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina militar de asedio que consiste en una gran ballesta montada sobre una construcción de madera.

Rule.Original: A refined turret with military-grade stabilization, targeting routines, and hardened casing. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: A refined turret with military-grade stabilization, targeting routines, and hardened casing. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta refinada con sistemas de estabilización de grado militar, rutinas de puntería mejoradas y carcasa endurecida. Requiere de acero para reacondicionar su cañón tras un uso intensivo. Puede explotar si es dañada. Su tonto cerebro de IA no puede controlarse directamente, por lo que deberás tener cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: A refined automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A refined automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un arma automática refinada hecha para ser montada en una torreta.

Rule.Original: An armored, portable automatic turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. Extra armor plating allows the turret to provide some cover, makes it more resistant to enemy fire and prevents explosion in case of severe damage. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: An armored, portable automatic turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. Extra armor plating allows the turret to provide some cover, makes it more resistant to enemy fire and prevents explosion in case of severe damage. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta automática blindada y portátil. Requiere de acero para reacondicionar su cañón tras un uso intensivo. El blindaje adicional permite a esta torreta proporcionar cierta cobertura, a la vez que la hace más resistente al fuego enemigo y evita la explosión en caso de daños graves. Su tonto cerebro de IA no puede controlarse directamente, por lo que deberás tener cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: A refined automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A refined automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un arma automática refinada hecha para ser montada en una torreta.

Rule.Original: An apparatus combining an extremely luminous lamp and a mirrored parabolic reflector, useful for lighting up and dazzling targets.
Rule.Raw: An apparatus combining an extremely luminous lamp and a mirrored parabolic reflector, useful for lighting up and dazzling targets.
Rule.Translated: Un aparato que combina una lámpara extremadamente luminosa con un espejo reflector parabólico. Es muy útil para iluminar y deslumbrar a los objetivos alcanzados.

Rule.Original: A portable flamethrower turret, capable of spewing a cone of flame that engulfs enemies and terrain. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: A portable flamethrower turret, capable of spewing a cone of flame that engulfs enemies and terrain. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta portátil con un lanzallamas, capaz de proyectar un cono de llamas que envuelve tanto a enemigos como al terreno. Puede explotar si es dañada. Su tonto cerebro de IA no se puede controlar directamente, por lo que deberás tener cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: A flamethrower made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A flamethrower made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzallamas hecho para ser montado en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A compact automatic turret fitted with a semi-automatic shotgun. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: A compact automatic turret fitted with a semi-automatic shotgun. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta automática compacta equipada con una escopeta semiautomática. Requiere de acero para reacondicionar su cañón tras un uso intensivo. Puede explotar si es dañada. Su tonto cerebro de IA no puede controlarse directamente, por lo que deberás tener cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: An automatic shotgun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: An automatic shotgun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Una escopeta automática hecha para ser montada en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A heavy machine gun mounted on sandbags to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use.
Rule.Raw: A heavy machine gun mounted on sandbags to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use.
Rule.Translated: Una ametralladora pesada colocada sobre sacos de arena para proporcionar cobertura al usuario. Necesita ser manejada para disparar. Requiere de acero para recargar el cañón tras un uso intensivo.

Rule.Original: A self-loading HMG designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Raw: A self-loading HMG designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Translated: Una ametralladora de gran potencia autocargable diseñada para acoplarse a una torreta.

Rule.Original: A multi-barrel machine gun mounted on sandbags to grant cover and provide stability. Where most self-loading guns are powered by the energy from the gunpowder, the minigun uses an electric motor to rapidly cycle cartridges through the weapon. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
Rule.Raw: A multi-barrel machine gun mounted on sandbags to grant cover and provide stability. Where most self-loading guns are powered by the energy from the gunpowder, the minigun uses an electric motor to rapidly cycle cartridges through the weapon. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
Rule.Translated: Una ametralladora de varios cañones colocada sobre sacos de arena para proporcionar cobertura y estabilidad al usuario. Mientras que la mayoría de las ametralladoras de carga automática funcionan con la energía de la pólvora, la minigun utiliza un motor eléctrico para hacer circular rápidamente los cartuchos por el arma. Necesita ser manejada para disparar. Requiere de acero para reacondicionar sus cañones tras un uso intensivo.

Rule.Original: A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Raw: A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Translated: Una minigun autocargable diseñada para acoplarse a una torreta.

Rule.Original: A heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
Rule.Raw: A heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta automática pesada. Su mecanismo de múltiples cañones desata fuego sostenido a gran velocidad, destrozando objetivos con blindaje ligero a media distancia. Puede explotar si sufre daños. Requiere de acero para reacondicionar sus cañones tras un uso intensivo.

Rule.Original: A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Raw: A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Translated: Una minigun autocargable diseñada para acoplarse a una torreta.

Rule.Original: A charge rifle made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A charge rifle made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de carga hecho para ser montado en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A cutting-edge, pulse-charged, rail-assisted weapon system that fires a short burst of high-velocity projectiles, energized with unstable plasma as they leave the rail. The resulting shots pierce armor and bodies alike, but the turret requires new plasteel barrel after use. It cannot fire at close range, and may explode when damaged.
Rule.Raw: A cutting-edge, pulse-charged, rail-assisted weapon system that fires a short burst of high-velocity projectiles, energized with unstable plasma as they leave the rail. The resulting shots pierce armor and bodies alike, but the turret requires new plasteel barrel after use. It cannot fire at close range, and may explode when damaged.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de armas de última generación, cargado por impulsos y asistido por raíles, que dispara una corta ráfaga de proyectiles de alta velocidad, energizados con plasma inestable al salir del raíl. Los disparos resultantes atraviesan blindajes y cuerpos por igual, pero la torreta necesita un nuevo cañón de plastiacero tras su uso. No puede disparar a corta distancia y puede explotar si sufre daños.

Rule.Original: A cutting-edge utility turret designed to counter the mechanoid advances. Four capacitors are charged to release a bolt of electricity. Upon impact, the power surge stuns affected mechanoid, before seeking to jump to another. Will only target mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: A cutting-edge utility turret designed to counter the mechanoid advances. Four capacitors are charged to release a bolt of electricity. Upon impact, the power surge stuns affected mechanoid, before seeking to jump to another. Will only target mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta utilitaria de última generación diseñada para contrarrestar los avances mecanoides. Cuatro condensadores se cargan para liberar un rayo de electricidad. Al impactar, la oleada de energía aturde al mecanoide afectado, antes de intentar saltar a otro. Solo atacará a los mecanoides.

Rule.Original: A specialized electrical weapon designed to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A specialized electrical weapon designed to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un arma eléctrica especializada diseñada para ser montada en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A heavy, pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster mounted on a barricade to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires plasteel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use.
Rule.Raw: A heavy, pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster mounted on a barricade to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires plasteel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use.
Rule.Translated: Una pistola bláster pesada, cargada con impulsos y de disparo rápido, montada sobre una barricada para proporcionar cobertura al usuario. Necesita ser manejada para disparar. Requiere de plastiacero para reacondicionar su cañón tras un uso intensivo.

Rule.Original: A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Raw: A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Translated: Una bláster de cargas autocargable diseñada para acoplarse a una torreta.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed near a drug lab. One workbench links up to two drug cabinets.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed near a drug lab. One workbench links up to two drug cabinets.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de un laboratorio de drogas cuando se coloca cerca. Una de estas puede conectarse hasta con dos estantes de drogas.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed near a machining table. One workbench links up to two machining cabinets.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed near a machining table. One workbench links up to two machining cabinets.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de una mesa de maquinaria cuando se coloca cerca. Una de estas puede conectarse hasta con dos estantes de maquinaria.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed near a smithy. One workbench links up to two smithy cabinets.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed near a smithy. One workbench links up to two smithy cabinets.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de una forja cuando se coloca cerca. Una de estas puede conectarse hasta con dos estantes de forja.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed nearby a cooking stove.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed nearby a cooking stove.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de una cocina cuando se coloca cerca.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring table. One workbench links up to two tailor cabinets.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring table. One workbench links up to two tailor cabinets.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de una mesa de sastrería cuando se coloca cerca. Una de estas puede conectarse hasta con dos estantes de sastrería.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed near a fabrication bench. One workbench can link up to two fabrication cabinets.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed near a fabrication bench. One workbench can link up to two fabrication cabinets.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de una mesa de fabricación cuando se coloca cerca. Una de estas puede conectarse hasta con dos estantes de fabricación.

Rule.Original: An electric-powered work center for smithing non-mechanical weapons and tools. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Raw: An electric-powered work center for smithing non-mechanical weapons and tools. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de trabajo eléctrico para forjar armas y herramientas no mecánicas. Consume mucha energía.

Rule.Original: A large size manufacturing stove as well as multiple ovens to prepare meals and cook significantly faster.
Rule.Raw: A large size manufacturing stove as well as multiple ovens to prepare meals and cook significantly faster.
Rule.Translated: Una cocina industrial de gran tamaño, que cuenta con varios hornos para preparar comidas y cocinar mucho más rápido.

Rule.Original: A large size manufacturing workbench with several tools for designers and a sewing machine for rapid tailoring of clothes. Can work without electricity at 33% of normal speed.
Rule.Raw: A large size manufacturing workbench with several tools for designers and a sewing machine for rapid tailoring of clothes. Can work without electricity at 33% of normal speed.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de trabajo de gran tamaño con varias herramientas para diseñadores y una máquina de coser para la confección rápida de ropa. Puede operar sin electricidad a un 33% de la velocidad normal.

Rule.Original: A workbench equipped with advanced tools to produce components.
Rule.Raw: A workbench equipped with advanced tools to produce components.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de trabajo equipado con herramientas avanzadas para producir componentes.

Rule.Original: A motorized table with a rotating saw blade for butchering dead creatures quicker into precise slices of raw meat. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Raw: A motorized table with a rotating saw blade for butchering dead creatures quicker into precise slices of raw meat. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa con una sierra motorizada que permite cortar rápidamente las criaturas muertas y convertirlas en finas lonchas de carne cruda. Consume mucha energía.

Rule.Original: An advanced work bench equipped with containers, heaters, and measurement devices for producing various drugs with more efficiency. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Raw: An advanced work bench equipped with containers, heaters, and measurement devices for producing various drugs with more efficiency. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Translated: Un avanzado banco de trabajo equipado con recipientes, calentadores y dispositivos de medición para producir todo tipo de medicamentos con mayor eficacia. Consume mucha energía.

Rule.Original: A wood-fueled station for smelting. Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items.
Rule.Raw: A wood-fueled station for smelting. Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items.
Rule.Translated: Una fundición alimentada con madera. Extrae el metal utilizable de los trozos de chatarra y otros elementos metálicos mezclados.

Rule.Original: An advanced work table with electrical saws and holders for cutting stone chunks into usable blocks in shorter duration of time on an assembly line. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Raw: An advanced work table with electrical saws and holders for cutting stone chunks into usable blocks in shorter duration of time on an assembly line. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo avanzada, equipada con sierras eléctricas y soportes, para cortar trozos de piedra en bloques utilizables en poco tiempo y agilizar la cadena de montaje. Consume mucha energía.

Rule.Original: Build manufacturing benches and efficient work center.
Rule.Raw: Build manufacturing benches and efficient work center.
Rule.Translated: Construye mesas de fabricación y centros de trabajo eficientes.

Rule.Original: subject_story->pioneered the integration of complex machinery for mass production, heralding a new era of efficiency
Rule.Raw: subject_story->pioneered the integration of complex machinery for mass production, heralding a new era of efficiency
Rule.Translated: subject_story->fue pionero en integrar maquinaria compleja para la producción en masa y anunció una nueva era de eficiencia

Rule.Original: subject_story->transformed raw materials into marvels of utility, fueling the expansion of civilization
Rule.Raw: subject_story->transformed raw materials into marvels of utility, fueling the expansion of civilization
Rule.Translated: subject_story->transformó materias primas en maravillas útiles que impulsaban la expansión de la civilización

Rule.Original: subject_story->devised systems of assembly that became the heartbeat of the community's economic engine
Rule.Raw: subject_story->devised systems of assembly that became the heartbeat of the community's economic engine
Rule.Translated: subject_story->ideó sistemas de ensamblaje que se convirtieron en el latido del motor económico de la comunidad

Rule.Original: subject_story->cultivated a culture of innovation, where every tool and machine is a step towards the future
Rule.Raw: subject_story->cultivated a culture of innovation, where every tool and machine is a step towards the future
Rule.Translated: subject_story->cultivó una cultura de innovación en la que cada herramienta y máquina era un paso hacia el futuro

Rule.Original: subject_story->founded the principles of modern manufacturing, blending craftsmanship with the precision of technology
Rule.Raw: subject_story->founded the principles of modern manufacturing, blending craftsmanship with the precision of technology
Rule.Translated: subject_story->estableció los principios de la fabricación moderna combinando artesanía y precisión tecnológica

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->carving the path towards a self-sustaining society with the power of industrial manufacturing
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->carving the path towards a self-sustaining society with the power of industrial manufacturing
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->abriendo el camino hacia una sociedad autosuficiente con la fabricación industrial

Rule.Original: A table equipped with various tools suited for restyling hair and beards.
Rule.Raw: A table equipped with various tools suited for restyling hair and beards.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa equipada con diversas herramientas para cambiar el peinado y arreglar la barba.
comí hace poco pez globo crudo

Rule.Original: This person has fished something special.
Rule.Raw: This person has fished something special.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona ha pescado algo especial.

Rule.Original: The speed at which a person can fish is multiplied by this factor.
Rule.Raw: The speed at which a person can fish is multiplied by this factor.
Rule.Translated: La velocidad a la que una persona puede pescar se multiplica por este factor.

Rule.Original: The fishing yield of a person is multiplied by this factor.
Rule.Raw: The fishing yield of a person is multiplied by this factor.
Rule.Translated: El rendimiento de pesca de una persona se multiplica por este factor.

Rule.Original: The chance for every fishing attempt to fish a special item instead of a regular fish is increased by this offset.
Rule.Raw: The chance for every fishing attempt to fish a special item instead of a regular fish is increased by this offset.
Rule.Translated: Este valor aumenta la probabilidad de pescar un objeto especial en lugar de un pez normal en cada intento.

Rule.Original: Raw anchovy. A small, common forage fish of the family Engraulidae. Most species are found in marine waters, but several will enter brackish water and some are restricted to fresh water.
Rule.Raw: Raw anchovy. A small, common forage fish of the family Engraulidae. Most species are found in marine waters, but several will enter brackish water and some are restricted to fresh water.
Rule.Translated: Anchoa cruda. Un pez de forraje pequeño y común de la familia de los engraúlidos. La mayoría de estas especies se encuentran en aguas marinas, pero algunas entran en aguas salobres y otras se limitan al agua dulce.

Rule.Original: Raw angelfish. Angelfish refers to several species of fish, both marine and freshwater, usually sporting bright colours and deep, laterally compressed bodies.
Rule.Raw: Raw angelfish. Angelfish refers to several species of fish, both marine and freshwater, usually sporting bright colours and deep, laterally compressed bodies.
Rule.Translated: Pez ángel crudo. Los peces ángel representan a diversas especies de peces, tanto marinos como de agua dulce, que suelen lucir colores brillantes y tener un cuerpo muy plano.

Rule.Original: Raw anglerfish. Anglerfish are bony fish named for their characteristic mode of predation, in which, a fleshy growth from the fish's head (the esca or illicium) acts as a lure towards other fish.
Rule.Raw: Raw anglerfish. Anglerfish are bony fish named for their characteristic mode of predation, in which, a fleshy growth from the fish's head (the esca or illicium) acts as a lure towards other fish.
Rule.Translated: Rape crudo. El rape es un pez óseo conocido por su característico modo de depredación, en el que una protuberancia carnosa de la cabeza del pez (también llamada «esca» o «illicium») actúa como señuelo para otros peces.

Rule.Original: Raw bass. Bass is a name shared by many species of fish. The term encompasses both freshwater and marine species, all belonging to the large order Perciformes.
Rule.Raw: Raw bass. Bass is a name shared by many species of fish. The term encompasses both freshwater and marine species, all belonging to the large order Perciformes.
Rule.Translated: Lubina cruda. La lubina es un nombre que comparten muchas especies de peces. El término engloba tanto a especies de agua dulce como marinas, todas ellas pertenecientes al gran orden de los perciformes.

Rule.Original: Raw catfish. Catfish are a diverse group of ray-finned fish. Named for their prominent barbels, which resemble a cat's whiskers.
Rule.Raw: Raw catfish. Catfish are a diverse group of ray-finned fish. Named for their prominent barbels, which resemble a cat's whiskers.
Rule.Translated: Siluro crudo. Los siluros son un variado grupo de peces con aletas de raya. Son conocidos por sus prominentes barbillas, que se asemejan a los bigotes de un gato.

Rule.Original: Raw clownfish. In the wild, clownfish form symbiotic mutualisms with sea anemones. Depending on species, clownfish are overall yellow, orange, or a reddish or blackish color, and many show white bars or patches.
Rule.Raw: Raw clownfish. In the wild, clownfish form symbiotic mutualisms with sea anemones. Depending on species, clownfish are overall yellow, orange, or a reddish or blackish color, and many show white bars or patches.
Rule.Translated: Pez payaso crudo. En la naturaleza, los peces payaso y las anémonas de mar comparten una relación simbiótica. Dependiendo de la especie, el pez payaso es en general de color amarillo, naranja, o de un color rojizo o negruzco, y muchos muestran barras o manchas blancas.
