Rule.Original: Raw cod. Cod refers to several large species of fish with a voracious appetite, feeding largely on other fishes and various invertebrates. Cod has long been considered a perfect fish for human consumption, with its flaky white flesh, a high protein content and low fat content.
Rule.Raw: Raw cod. Cod refers to several large species of fish with a voracious appetite, feeding largely on other fishes and various invertebrates. Cod has long been considered a perfect fish for human consumption, with its flaky white flesh, a high protein content and low fat content.
Rule.Translated: Bacalao crudo. El bacalao hace referencia a varias especies de peces de gran tamaño con un apetito voraz, que se alimentan en gran medida de otros peces y diversos invertebrados. El bacalao se ha considerado durante mucho tiempo un pescado ideal para el consumo humano, por su carne blanca y escamosa, su alto contenido en proteínas y su bajo contenido en grasas.

Rule.Original: Raw eel. An eel is any ray-finned fish belonging to the order Anguilliformes. Eels are elongated fish, possessing no pelvic fins, and many species also lacking pectoral fins. Eels swim by generating body waves which travel the length of their bodies.
Rule.Raw: Raw eel. An eel is any ray-finned fish belonging to the order Anguilliformes. Eels are elongated fish, possessing no pelvic fins, and many species also lacking pectoral fins. Eels swim by generating body waves which travel the length of their bodies.
Rule.Translated: Anguila cruda. Una anguila es cualquier pez con aletas de raya perteneciente al orden de los anguiliformes. Las anguilas son peces alargados que no tienen aletas pélvicas y muchas especies carecen también de aletas pectorales. Las anguilas nadan generando ondas corporales que recorren la totalidad de sus cuerpos.

Rule.Original: Raw goldfish. The goldfish (Carassius auratus) is a freshwater fish in the family Cyprinidae of order Cypriniformes. It is one of the most commonly kept aquarium fish.
Rule.Raw: Raw goldfish. The goldfish (Carassius auratus) is a freshwater fish in the family Cyprinidae of order Cypriniformes. It is one of the most commonly kept aquarium fish.
Rule.Translated: Pez de colores crudo. El pez de colores, «Carassius auratus», es un pez de agua dulce de la familia de los ciprínidos y del orden de los cipriniformes. Es uno de los peces más comunes en los acuarios.

Rule.Original: Raw guppy. The guppy (Poecilia reticulata), also known as millionfish and rainbow fish, is one of the world's most widely distributed tropical fish, and one of the most popular freshwater aquarium fish species.
Rule.Raw: Raw guppy. The guppy (Poecilia reticulata), also known as millionfish and rainbow fish, is one of the world's most widely distributed tropical fish, and one of the most popular freshwater aquarium fish species.
Rule.Translated: Guppy crudo. El guppy, «Poecilia reticulata», también conocido como pez millón o pez arco iris, es uno de los peces tropicales de mayor distribución en el mundo y una de las especies de peces de acuario de agua dulce más populares.

Rule.Original: Raw haddock. The haddock (Melanogrammus aeglefinus) is a saltwater fish from the family Gadidae, the true cods. It is an important food fish and has traditionaly been consumed either fresh or smoked.
Rule.Raw: Raw haddock. The haddock (Melanogrammus aeglefinus) is a saltwater fish from the family Gadidae, the true cods. It is an important food fish and has traditionaly been consumed either fresh or smoked.
Rule.Translated: Eglefino crudo. El eglefino, «Melanogrammus aeglefinus», es un pez de agua salada de la familia de los gádidos, los verdaderos bacalaos. Es un pescado importante para la alimentación y tradicionalmente se consume fresco o ahumado.

Rule.Original: Raw halibut. Halibut is a common name principally applied to the two flatfish from the family of right-eye flounders. Less commonly, and in some regions only, other species of flatfish are also referred to as being halibuts.
Rule.Raw: Raw halibut. Halibut is a common name principally applied to the two flatfish from the family of right-eye flounders. Less commonly, and in some regions only, other species of flatfish are also referred to as being halibuts.
Rule.Translated: Fletán crudo. El término fletán se aplica principalmente a los dos peces planos de la familia de los lenguados de ojo derecho. Con menos frecuencia, y sólo en algunas regiones, otras especies de peces planos se denominan también como fletanes.

Rule.Original: Raw herring. Herring are forage fish, mostly belonging to the family Clupeidae. Herring often move in large schools around fishing banks and near the coast.
Rule.Raw: Raw herring. Herring are forage fish, mostly belonging to the family Clupeidae. Herring often move in large schools around fishing banks and near the coast.
Rule.Translated: Arenque crudo. Los arenques son peces de forraje, en su mayoría pertenecientes a la familia de los clupéidos. Los arenques suelen moverse en grandes bancos cerca de los puertos de pesca y de la costa.

Rule.Original: Raw koi. Koi are colored varieties of the Amur carp (Cyprinus rubrofuscus) that are kept for decorative purposes in outdoor koi ponds or water gardens.
Rule.Raw: Raw koi. Koi are colored varieties of the Amur carp (Cyprinus rubrofuscus) that are kept for decorative purposes in outdoor koi ponds or water gardens.
Rule.Translated: Carpa koi cruda. Las carpas koi son una variedad coloreada de la carpa Amur, de nombre científico «Cyprinus rubrofuscus», que se cría con fines decorativos en estanques o jardines acuáticos al aire libre.

Rule.Original: Raw lobster. Lobsters are large marine crustaceans. Lobsters have long bodies with muscular tails. Three of their five pairs of legs have claws, including the first pair, which are usually much larger than the others.
Rule.Raw: Raw lobster. Lobsters are large marine crustaceans. Lobsters have long bodies with muscular tails. Three of their five pairs of legs have claws, including the first pair, which are usually much larger than the others.
Rule.Translated: Langosta cruda. Las langostas son grandes crustáceos marinos. Tienen un cuerpo alargado y una cola musculosa. Tres de sus cinco pares de patas tienen pinzas, incluido el primer par, que suelen ser mucho más grandes que las demás.

Rule.Original: Raw mackerel. Mackerel is a common name applied to a number of different species of pelagic fish, mostly from the family Scombridae. They are found in both temperate and tropical seas, mostly living along the coast or offshore in the oceanic environment.
Rule.Raw: Raw mackerel. Mackerel is a common name applied to a number of different species of pelagic fish, mostly from the family Scombridae. They are found in both temperate and tropical seas, mostly living along the coast or offshore in the oceanic environment.
Rule.Translated: Caballa cruda. La caballa es un nombre común que se aplica a varias especies de peces pelágicos, principalmente de la familia de los escómbridos. Se pueden encontrar tanto en mares templados como en mares tropicales, y viven principalmente a lo largo de la costa o en alta mar, en pleno entorno oceánico.

Rule.Original: Raw minnow. Minnow is the common name for a number of species of small freshwater fish, belonging to several genera of the family Cyprinidae.
Rule.Raw: Raw minnow. Minnow is the common name for a number of species of small freshwater fish, belonging to several genera of the family Cyprinidae.
Rule.Translated: Un pececillo crudo. Se les llama pececillos en general a varias especies de peces pequeños de agua dulce, pertenecientes a varios géneros de la familia de los ciprínidos.

Rule.Original: Raw perch. Perch is a common name for fish of the genus Perca, freshwater gamefish belonging to the family Percidae. The perch lend their name to a large order of vertebrates: the Perciformes. Many species of freshwater gamefish more or less resemble perch, but belong to different genera.
Rule.Raw: Raw perch. Perch is a common name for fish of the genus Perca, freshwater gamefish belonging to the family Percidae. The perch lend their name to a large order of vertebrates: the Perciformes. Many species of freshwater gamefish more or less resemble perch, but belong to different genera.
Rule.Translated: Perca cruda. El nombre perca es un nombre común para los peces del género Perca, unos peces de pesca deportiva de agua dulce que pertenecen a la familia de los pércidos. Las percas llevan el nombre de un gran orden de vertebrados: los perciformes. Muchas especies de peces de pesca deportiva de agua dulce se parecen más o menos a la perca, pero pertenecen a géneros diferentes.

Rule.Original: Raw piranha. A piranha is a freshwater fish that inhabits rivers, floodplains, lakes and reservoirs. Although often described as extremely predatory and mainly feeding on fish, their dietary habits vary extensively, and they will also take plant material, leading to their classification as omnivorous.
Rule.Raw: Raw piranha. A piranha is a freshwater fish that inhabits rivers, floodplains, lakes and reservoirs. Although often described as extremely predatory and mainly feeding on fish, their dietary habits vary extensively, and they will also take plant material, leading to their classification as omnivorous.
Rule.Translated: Piraña cruda. La piraña es un pez de agua dulce que habita en ríos, terrenos inundados, lagos y embalses. Aunque a menudo se la describe como extremadamente depredadora y que se alimenta principalmente de peces, sus hábitos alimenticios varían mucho, llegando incluso a consumir materia vegetal, por lo que se las considera omnívoras.

Rule.Original: Raw pufferfish. Pufferfish are a family of primarily marine and estuarine fish. The majority of pufferfish species are toxic and some are among the most poisonous vertebrates in the world. In certain species, the internal organs, such as the liver, and sometimes their skin, contain tetrodotoxin and are highly toxic to most animals when eaten; nevertheless, the meat of some species is considered a delicacy when prepared by specially trained chefs.
Rule.Raw: Raw pufferfish. Pufferfish are a family of primarily marine and estuarine fish. The majority of pufferfish species are toxic and some are among the most poisonous vertebrates in the world. In certain species, the internal organs, such as the liver, and sometimes their skin, contain tetrodotoxin and are highly toxic to most animals when eaten; nevertheless, the meat of some species is considered a delicacy when prepared by specially trained chefs.
Rule.Translated: Pez globo crudo. Los peces globo son una familia de peces principalmente marinos y de estuario. La mayoría de las especies de peces globo son tóxicas y algunas son de los vertebrados más venenosos del mundo. En ciertas especies, los órganos internos, como el hígado, y a veces su piel, contienen tetrodotoxina y son muy tóxicos para la mayoría de los animales cuando se comen; no obstante, la carne de algunas especies se considera un manjar cuando la preparan cocineros especialmente capacitados.

Rule.Original: Raw salmon. Salmon is the common name for several species of ray-finned fish in the family Salmonidae. Typically, salmon are anadromous: they hatch in fresh water, migrate to the ocean, then return to fresh water to reproduce. However, populations of several species are restricted to fresh water through their lives.
Rule.Raw: Raw salmon. Salmon is the common name for several species of ray-finned fish in the family Salmonidae. Typically, salmon are anadromous: they hatch in fresh water, migrate to the ocean, then return to fresh water to reproduce. However, populations of several species are restricted to fresh water through their lives.
Rule.Translated: Salmón crudo. Salmón es el nombre común de varias especies de peces con aletas de raya de la familia de los salmónidos. Por lo general, los salmones son anádromos: nacen en agua dulce, migran al océano y luego regresan al agua dulce para reproducirse. Sin embargo, las poblaciones de algunas especies se limitan al agua dulce durante toda su vida.

Rule.Original: Raw sprat. Sprat is the common name applied to a group of forage fish belonging to the genus Sprattus in the family Clupeidae. Like most forage fishes, sprats are highly active, small, oily fish. They travel in large schools with other fish and swim continuously throughout the day.
Rule.Raw: Raw sprat. Sprat is the common name applied to a group of forage fish belonging to the genus Sprattus in the family Clupeidae. Like most forage fishes, sprats are highly active, small, oily fish. They travel in large schools with other fish and swim continuously throughout the day.
Rule.Translated: Espadín crudo. Espadín es el nombre común aplicado a un grupo de peces de forraje pertenecientes al género Sprattus de la familia de los clupéidos. Como la mayoría de los peces de forraje, los espadines son peces pequeños, aceitosos y muy activos. Viajan en grandes bancos con otros peces y nadan continuamente durante todo el día.

Rule.Original: Raw swordfish. Swordfish, also known as broadbills, are large, highly migratory, predatory fish characterized by a long, flat, pointed bill.
Rule.Raw: Raw swordfish. Swordfish, also known as broadbills, are large, highly migratory, predatory fish characterized by a long, flat, pointed bill.
Rule.Translated: Pez espada crudo. El pez espada, también conocido como aguja palá, es un pez depredador de gran tamaño y altamente migratorio que se caracteriza por tener un pico largo, plano y puntiagudo.

Rule.Original: Raw trout. Trout is the common name for a number of species of freshwater fish. Most species of trout live in freshwater lakes and rivers exclusively, while there are others, such as the steelhead, which can spend two or three years at sea before returning to fresh water to spawn (a habit more typical of salmon).
Rule.Raw: Raw trout. Trout is the common name for a number of species of freshwater fish. Most species of trout live in freshwater lakes and rivers exclusively, while there are others, such as the steelhead, which can spend two or three years at sea before returning to fresh water to spawn (a habit more typical of salmon).
Rule.Translated: Trucha cruda. El nombre de trucha se aplica a una serie de especies de peces de agua dulce. La mayoría de las especies de trucha viven exclusivamente en lagos y ríos de agua dulce, mientras que hay otras, como la trucha arco iris, que pueden pasar dos o tres años en el mar antes de regresar al agua dulce para desovar (un hábito más típico del salmón).

Rule.Original: Raw tuna. Tuna are large saltwater fish. An active and agile predator, the tuna has a sleek, streamlined body, and is among the fastest-swimming pelagic fish. Tuna has been highly prized as a food fish. Besides their commercial value as food, the great size, speed, and power they display as apex predators has attracted the admiration of fishermen, writers, and scientists.
Rule.Raw: Raw tuna. Tuna are large saltwater fish. An active and agile predator, the tuna has a sleek, streamlined body, and is among the fastest-swimming pelagic fish. Tuna has been highly prized as a food fish. Besides their commercial value as food, the great size, speed, and power they display as apex predators has attracted the admiration of fishermen, writers, and scientists.
Rule.Translated: Atún crudo. El atún es un gran pez de agua salada. Es un depredador activo y ágil, con un cuerpo estilizado e hidrodinámico, y uno de los peces pelágicos que más rápido nadan. El atún es un pez muy apreciado como alimento. Además de su valor comercial como alimento; su gran tamaño, velocidad y potencia como depredador supremo han despertado la admiración de pescadores, escritores y científicos.

Rule.Original: Nothing better to relax than fishing
Rule.Raw: Nothing better to relax than fishing
Rule.Translated: No hay nada mejor para relajarse que la pesca

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the solitude and tranquility inherent to long fishing sessions. {PAWN_pronoun} will prefer fishing above other activities.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the solitude and tranquility inherent to long fishing sessions. {PAWN_pronoun} will prefer fishing above other activities.
Rule.Translated: {PAWN_nameDef} disfruta de la soledad y la tranquilidad inherentes a las largas sesiones de pesca. Preferirá pescar a realizar otras actividades.

Rule.Original: Catch fish in designated work zones.
Rule.Raw: Catch fish in designated work zones.
Rule.Translated: Capturar peces en las zonas de pesca designadas.

Rule.Original: A catastrophic global deep freeze that plunges the planet into extreme cold, halting all human travel and trade while forcing the world to survive an extended, dangerous winter.
Rule.Raw: A catastrophic global deep freeze that plunges the planet into extreme cold, halting all human travel and trade while forcing the world to survive an extended, dangerous winter.
Rule.Translated: Una congelación global catastrófica que sume al planeta en un frío extremo, detiene todos los viajes y el comercio humanos y obliga al mundo a sobrevivir a un invierno prolongado y peligroso.

Rule.Original: Atmospheric temperatures are steadily dropping across the planet.\n\nThis is not a standard cold snap. You predict a catastrophic deep freeze is approaching, eventually leading to a complete whiteout. You have a short window to stockpile fuel, harvest your remaining crops, and build heaters before the true cold sets in.
Rule.Raw: Atmospheric temperatures are steadily dropping across the planet.\n\nThis is not a standard cold snap. You predict a catastrophic deep freeze is approaching, eventually leading to a complete whiteout. You have a short window to stockpile fuel, harvest your remaining crops, and build heaters before the true cold sets in.
Rule.Translated: Las temperaturas atmosféricas están descendiendo de forma constante en todo el planeta.\n\nNo es una ola de frío normal. Prevés una congelación catastrófica que acabará provocando una tormenta blanca total. Tienes poco tiempo para almacenar combustible, recoger los cultivos restantes y construir calefactores antes de que llegue el frío de verdad.

Rule.Original: The cold has deepened drastically.\n\nWildlife is fleeing the region, and the flora is dying off. Ensure your colony stays indoors and that your power grid can handle the immense strain of constant heating. The worst is still yet to come.
Rule.Raw: The cold has deepened drastically.\n\nWildlife is fleeing the region, and the flora is dying off. Ensure your colony stays indoors and that your power grid can handle the immense strain of constant heating. The worst is still yet to come.
Rule.Translated: El frío se ha intensificado drásticamente.\n\nLa fauna huye de la región y la flora está muriendo. Mantén a tu colonia bajo techo y asegúrate de que la red eléctrica soporte la enorme exigencia de la calefacción constante. Lo peor aún está por llegar.

Rule.Original:
The whiteout has arrived.

Temperatures have plummeted to unsurvivable levels. Human travel across the planet is now entirely unadvised; you will receive no trade caravans or human raids. However, the bitter cold does not bother mechanoids.

If you persevere, the freeze will eventually break.
Rule.Raw:
The whiteout has arrived.

Temperatures have plummeted to unsurvivable levels. Human travel across the planet is now entirely unadvised; you will receive no trade caravans or human raids. However, the bitter cold does not bother mechanoids.

If you persevere, the freeze will eventually break.
Rule.Translated:
La tormenta blanca ha llegado.

Las temperaturas han caído hasta niveles incompatibles con la supervivencia. Se desaconseja por completo que los humanos viajen por el planeta: no recibirás caravanas comerciales ni asaltos humanos. Sin embargo, el frío extremo no afecta a los mecanoides.

Si resistes, la congelación terminará por ceder.

Rule.Original: The skies are finally clearing and the bitter cold is beginning to recede.\n\nThe whiteout is ending. Temperatures will slowly return to normal over the next quadrum, and life will eventually return.
Rule.Raw: The skies are finally clearing and the bitter cold is beginning to recede.\n\nThe whiteout is ending. Temperatures will slowly return to normal over the next quadrum, and life will eventually return.
Rule.Translated: Los cielos por fin se despejan y el frío extremo empieza a retroceder.\n\nLa tormenta blanca está terminando. Las temperaturas volverán lentamente a la normalidad durante el próximo cuádrum y la vida acabará regresando.

Rule.Original: A catastrophic global heatwave that plunges the planet into extreme heat, halting all outdoor farming and travel while forcing the world to survive an extended, dangerous summer.
Rule.Raw: A catastrophic global heatwave that plunges the planet into extreme heat, halting all outdoor farming and travel while forcing the world to survive an extended, dangerous summer.
Rule.Translated: Una ola de calor global catastrófica que sume al planeta en temperaturas extremas, detiene los cultivos y los viajes al aire libre y obliga al mundo a sobrevivir a un verano prolongado y peligroso.

Rule.Original: The planet's atmosphere is beginning to trap immense amounts of solar radiation, bathing the region in an unnatural, oppressive heat.\n\nTravellers warn that this is just the beginning of a massive thermal event. Temperatures will continue to rise drastically. You have a short window to secure your food supply, build coolers, and tailor protective headgear for your colonists before the sun becomes deadly.
Rule.Raw: The planet's atmosphere is beginning to trap immense amounts of solar radiation, bathing the region in an unnatural, oppressive heat.\n\nTravellers warn that this is just the beginning of a massive thermal event. Temperatures will continue to rise drastically. You have a short window to secure your food supply, build coolers, and tailor protective headgear for your colonists before the sun becomes deadly.
Rule.Translated: La atmósfera del planeta comienza a retener enormes cantidades de radiación solar, bañando la región en un calor antinatural y opresivo.\n\nLos viajeros advierten de que esto es solo el comienzo de un fenómeno térmico masivo. Las temperaturas seguirán aumentando drásticamente. Tienes poco tiempo para asegurar el suministro de alimentos, construir refrigeradores y confeccionar protección para la cabeza de tus colonos antes de que el sol se vuelva mortal.

Rule.Original: The heat has reached dangerous levels, and rain clouds have vanished completely.\n\nOutdoor crops are struggling to grow in the baked earth. Furthermore, the intense UV radiation is causing sun sickness for anyone caught outside without a hat. This sickness makes victims extremely susceptible to heatstroke. Keep your colonists under roofs or ensure they are wearing headgear.
Rule.Raw: The heat has reached dangerous levels, and rain clouds have vanished completely.\n\nOutdoor crops are struggling to grow in the baked earth. Furthermore, the intense UV radiation is causing sun sickness for anyone caught outside without a hat. This sickness makes victims extremely susceptible to heatstroke. Keep your colonists under roofs or ensure they are wearing headgear.
Rule.Translated: El calor ha alcanzado niveles peligrosos y las nubes de lluvia han desaparecido por completo.\n\nLos cultivos al aire libre apenas crecen en la tierra abrasada. Además, la intensa radiación UV provoca enfermedad solar a quienes salgan sin sombrero. Esta enfermedad hace que las víctimas sean extremadamente vulnerables a los golpes de calor. Mantén a los colonos bajo techo o asegúrate de que lleven protección en la cabeza.

Rule.Original:
The heat has peaked into a catastrophic inferno. 

A thick, sweltering haze has settled over the area, and outdoor plant growth has completely halted. Worse yet, the superheated atmosphere is generating massive dry thunderstorms. Expect frequent lightning strikes and devastating wildfires.

Stay indoors, keep the coolers running, and wait for the rain to come back.
Rule.Raw:
The heat has peaked into a catastrophic inferno. 

A thick, sweltering haze has settled over the area, and outdoor plant growth has completely halted. Worse yet, the superheated atmosphere is generating massive dry thunderstorms. Expect frequent lightning strikes and devastating wildfires.

Stay indoors, keep the coolers running, and wait for the rain to come back.
Rule.Translated:
El calor ha alcanzado su máximo, convirtiéndose en un infierno catastrófico. 

Una bruma espesa y sofocante cubre la zona, y las plantas al aire libre han dejado de crecer por completo. Peor aún, la atmósfera sobrecalentada genera enormes tormentas eléctricas secas. Prepárate para rayos frecuentes e incendios devastadores.

Permanece bajo techo, mantén los refrigeradores funcionando y espera a que vuelva la lluvia.

Rule.Original: The oppressive haze is finally lifting, and the sun's glare seems less deadly today.\n\nThe scorch is ending. Temperatures will slowly return to normal over the coming days, and rain clouds will soon return.
Rule.Raw: The oppressive haze is finally lifting, and the sun's glare seems less deadly today.\n\nThe scorch is ending. Temperatures will slowly return to normal over the coming days, and rain clouds will soon return.
Rule.Translated: La bruma opresiva por fin se disipa y el resplandor del sol parece menos mortal hoy.\n\nEl calor abrasador está terminando. Las temperaturas volverán lentamente a la normalidad en los próximos días y pronto regresarán las nubes de lluvia.

Rule.Original: A catastrophic celestial eclipse that blankets the world in an endless, freezing twilight, forcing the world to adapt to artificial light and increased psychic sensitivity as nocturnal predators and subterranean threats emerge in the darkness.
Rule.Raw: A catastrophic celestial eclipse that blankets the world in an endless, freezing twilight, forcing the world to adapt to artificial light and increased psychic sensitivity as nocturnal predators and subterranean threats emerge in the darkness.
Rule.Translated: Un eclipse celeste catastrófico que cubre el mundo con un crepúsculo interminable y helado. Obliga a adaptarse a la iluminación artificial y a una mayor sensibilidad psíquica, mientras depredadores nocturnos y amenazas subterráneas emergen en la oscuridad.

Rule.Original: A space entity of unimaginable size has made first contact with a local star, resulting in the beginning of a long lasting eclipse.\n\nThe daylight is beginning to dim, casting a vast penumbra over the planet. Solar output and temperatures will continue to drop as the eclipse deepens. Prepare your power grids and indoor agriculture before the true darkness arrives.
Rule.Raw: A space entity of unimaginable size has made first contact with a local star, resulting in the beginning of a long lasting eclipse.\n\nThe daylight is beginning to dim, casting a vast penumbra over the planet. Solar output and temperatures will continue to drop as the eclipse deepens. Prepare your power grids and indoor agriculture before the true darkness arrives.
Rule.Translated: Una entidad espacial de tamaño inimaginable ha entrado en contacto con una estrella local, iniciando un eclipse prolongado.\n\nLa luz del día comienza a atenuarse y una inmensa penumbra cubre el planeta. La producción solar y las temperaturas seguirán descendiendo a medida que avance el eclipse. Prepara las redes eléctricas y la agricultura interior antes de que llegue la verdadera oscuridad.

Rule.Original: The celestial entity has begun to cross the center of the sun.\n\nThe planet has been plunged into a deep, freezing twilight. Solar generators are now struggling to produce power, and surface flora is dying. Rely on artificial lights and indoor heating to survive the coming black.
Rule.Raw: The celestial entity has begun to cross the center of the sun.\n\nThe planet has been plunged into a deep, freezing twilight. Solar generators are now struggling to produce power, and surface flora is dying. Rely on artificial lights and indoor heating to survive the coming black.
Rule.Translated: La entidad celeste ha comenzado a cruzar el centro del sol.\n\nEl planeta se ha sumido en un crepúsculo profundo y helado. Los generadores solares apenas producen energía y la flora de la superficie está muriendo. Depende de la iluminación artificial y la calefacción interior para sobrevivir a la oscuridad que se avecina.

Rule.Original:
The sun has been completely blotted out. 

Totality has been achieved, and an endless, freezing night has fallen across the world. The celestial entity is emitting a heavy cosmic resonance. Your colonists will tire much faster than normal, and their psychic sensitivity has been dangerously amplified.

The animals became a lot more aggressive. Guard your brightly lit base against the nocturnal predators and subterranean insectoids.
Rule.Raw:
The sun has been completely blotted out. 

Totality has been achieved, and an endless, freezing night has fallen across the world. The celestial entity is emitting a heavy cosmic resonance. Your colonists will tire much faster than normal, and their psychic sensitivity has been dangerously amplified.

The animals became a lot more aggressive. Guard your brightly lit base against the nocturnal predators and subterranean insectoids.
Rule.Translated:
El sol ha quedado completamente oculto. 

El eclipse es total y una noche interminable y helada ha caído sobre el mundo. La entidad celeste emite una intensa resonancia cósmica. Tus colonos se cansarán mucho más rápido de lo normal y su sensibilidad psíquica ha aumentado peligrosamente.

Los animales se han vuelto mucho más agresivos. Protege tu base bien iluminada de los depredadores nocturnos y los insectoides subterráneos.

Rule.Original: A brilliant flash of light has pierced the horizon!\n\nThe cosmic entity is finally shifting away from the sun's center. Totality has ended. The absolute darkness has broken into twilight. Your solar panels will begin generating power once again, and plants will resume growth as the temperature increases.
Rule.Raw: A brilliant flash of light has pierced the horizon!\n\nThe cosmic entity is finally shifting away from the sun's center. Totality has ended. The absolute darkness has broken into twilight. Your solar panels will begin generating power once again, and plants will resume growth as the temperature increases.
Rule.Translated: ¡Un destello brillante ha atravesado el horizonte!\n\nLa entidad cósmica por fin se aparta del centro del sol. La fase total ha terminado y la oscuridad absoluta ha dado paso al crepúsculo. Tus paneles solares volverán a generar energía y las plantas reanudarán su crecimiento a medida que aumente la temperatura.

Rule.Original: The celestial object is making its final pass across the sun.\n\nThe long night is ending. Over the coming days, the remaining shadows will clear, temperatures will normalize, and the planet will fully awaken from the dark.
Rule.Raw: The celestial object is making its final pass across the sun.\n\nThe long night is ending. Over the coming days, the remaining shadows will clear, temperatures will normalize, and the planet will fully awaken from the dark.
Rule.Translated: El objeto celeste está completando su paso frente al sol.\n\nLa larga noche está terminando. En los próximos días desaparecerán las sombras restantes, las temperaturas se normalizarán y el planeta despertará por completo de la oscuridad.

Rule.Original: A dimensional rift tears through the sky, blanketing the world in a perpetual purple aurora while alien seedlings sprout and mutate local flora into psychic lotuses, forcing the world to manage rapidly growing, otherworldly vegetation and intensifying psychic pressure.
Rule.Raw: A dimensional rift tears through the sky, blanketing the world in a perpetual purple aurora while alien seedlings sprout and mutate local flora into psychic lotuses, forcing the world to manage rapidly growing, otherworldly vegetation and intensifying psychic pressure.
Rule.Translated: Una grieta dimensional desgarra el cielo y cubre el mundo con una aurora púrpura perpetua. Brotan plantas alienígenas que transforman la flora local en lotos psíquicos, obligando a controlar una vegetación de otro mundo que crece rápidamente y una presión psíquica cada vez mayor.

Rule.Original: The veil between our reality and somewhere else is wearing dangerously thin.\n\nA tear in the dimensional fabric has ignited a permanent, unnatural purple aurora across the sky. Where the psychic energy bleeds through to the surface, bizarre, alien seedlings are manifesting in the soil. While they are harmless for now, they do not belong in this dimension. You may want to uproot them before they anchor themselves to our reality.
Rule.Raw: The veil between our reality and somewhere else is wearing dangerously thin.\n\nA tear in the dimensional fabric has ignited a permanent, unnatural purple aurora across the sky. Where the psychic energy bleeds through to the surface, bizarre, alien seedlings are manifesting in the soil. While they are harmless for now, they do not belong in this dimension. You may want to uproot them before they anchor themselves to our reality.
Rule.Translated: El velo entre nuestra realidad y otro lugar se está debilitando peligrosamente.\n\nUn desgarro del tejido dimensional ha encendido una aurora púrpura permanente y antinatural en el cielo. Allí donde la energía psíquica alcanza la superficie, aparecen extrañas plántulas alienígenas en la tierra. Por ahora son inofensivas, pero no pertenecen a esta dimensión. Quizá quieras arrancarlas antes de que se anclen a nuestra realidad.

Rule.Original:
The dimensional overlap is widening. The seedlings have matured into psychic lotuses, and they are actively terraforming our world to match their own.

The lotuses are mutating nearby flora into vibrant, otherworldly variants, and the ambient psychic sensitivity of everyone in the region has doubled.

Beware the weather, as clouds from the other side are bleeding through. Psychic rain can have devastating effects on anyone caught outside, as time behaves differently in its home dimension.
Rule.Raw:
The dimensional overlap is widening. The seedlings have matured into psychic lotuses, and they are actively terraforming our world to match their own.

The lotuses are mutating nearby flora into vibrant, otherworldly variants, and the ambient psychic sensitivity of everyone in the region has doubled.

Beware the weather, as clouds from the other side are bleeding through. Psychic rain can have devastating effects on anyone caught outside, as time behaves differently in its home dimension.
Rule.Translated:
La superposición dimensional se amplía. Las plántulas han madurado y se han convertido en lotos psíquicos que terraforman activamente nuestro mundo para adaptarlo al suyo.

Los lotos transforman la flora cercana en variantes coloridas de otro mundo, y la sensibilidad psíquica ambiental de todos los habitantes de la región se ha duplicado.

Ten cuidado con el clima: las nubes del otro lado están atravesando la grieta. La lluvia psíquica puede tener efectos devastadores sobre quienes estén al aire libre, porque el tiempo se comporta de otra manera en su dimensión de origen.

Rule.Original:
The boundary between realities has completely collapsed!

The otherworldly flora has entered a catastrophic superbloom, spreading at an uncontrollable rate. Worse, the psychic lotuses are acting as conduits for the crushing psychic weight of an entirely different universe. The intensity of this maddening drone is directly tied to how many lotuses are anchoring the rift to your map.

You must sever their connection by cutting down the lotuses immediately, or the sheer psychic pressure of another dimension will drive your colonists insane.
Rule.Raw:
The boundary between realities has completely collapsed!

The otherworldly flora has entered a catastrophic superbloom, spreading at an uncontrollable rate. Worse, the psychic lotuses are acting as conduits for the crushing psychic weight of an entirely different universe. The intensity of this maddening drone is directly tied to how many lotuses are anchoring the rift to your map.

You must sever their connection by cutting down the lotuses immediately, or the sheer psychic pressure of another dimension will drive your colonists insane.
Rule.Translated:
¡La frontera entre realidades se ha derrumbado por completo!

La flora de otro mundo ha entrado en una superfloración catastrófica y se extiende sin control. Peor aún, los lotos psíquicos canalizan el aplastante peso psíquico de un universo completamente distinto. La intensidad de este zumbido enloquecedor depende directamente del número de lotos que anclan la grieta a tu mapa.

Debes cortar su conexión talando los lotos de inmediato, o la enorme presión psíquica de otra dimensión volverá locos a tus colonos.

Rule.Original:
Reality has violently reasserted itself.

The dimensional rift has snapped shut. Cut off from the psychic energy of their home universe, the superbloom has instantly collapsed into a hideous, withered wasteland. The maddening drone is gone, but the dead flora will take years to decay naturally. You will need to burn or chop away these wilted plants to make room for your crops to return.

Psychic Rain remains a lingering threat until the sky fully heals and the aurora dissipates.
Rule.Raw:
Reality has violently reasserted itself.

The dimensional rift has snapped shut. Cut off from the psychic energy of their home universe, the superbloom has instantly collapsed into a hideous, withered wasteland. The maddening drone is gone, but the dead flora will take years to decay naturally. You will need to burn or chop away these wilted plants to make room for your crops to return.

Psychic Rain remains a lingering threat until the sky fully heals and the aurora dissipates.
Rule.Translated:
La realidad se ha impuesto violentamente.

La grieta dimensional se ha cerrado de golpe. Privada de la energía psíquica de su universo de origen, la superfloración se ha convertido al instante en un horrible páramo marchito. El zumbido enloquecedor ha desaparecido, pero la flora muerta tardará años en descomponerse por sí sola. Tendrás que quemar o cortar estas plantas marchitas para dejar espacio a tus cultivos.

La lluvia psíquica seguirá siendo una amenaza hasta que el cielo sane por completo y la aurora se disipe.

Rule.Original:
A dangerous psychic entity caused disturbance on subatomic levels, resonating across all particles of the atmosphere.
A seemingly endless supernatural rain has begun, altering the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under the roof will age significantly faster.
It will last anywhere between a season to several years.
Rule.Raw:
A dangerous psychic entity caused disturbance on subatomic levels, resonating across all particles of the atmosphere.
A seemingly endless supernatural rain has begun, altering the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under the roof will age significantly faster.
It will last anywhere between a season to several years.
Rule.Translated:
Una peligrosa entidad psíquica ha introducido una perturbación en los niveles subatómicos que resuena en todas las partículas de la atmósfera.

Una lluvia sobrenatural aparentemente interminable ha comenzado, alterando la composición misma del tiempo. Cualquier persona o criatura que no esté bajo el techo envejecerá mucho más rápido.

Durará entre una estación y varios años.

Rule.Original:
An extreme drought has set over the area. Rain clouds have vanished, and the sun is baking the earth.

Outdoor crops and wild plants will suffer heavily from the lack of moisture, almost halting their growth and eventually dying off. The fires will spread much quicker.

Plants sown in hydroponics systems are not affected.
Rule.Raw:
An extreme drought has set over the area. Rain clouds have vanished, and the sun is baking the earth.

Outdoor crops and wild plants will suffer heavily from the lack of moisture, almost halting their growth and eventually dying off. The fires will spread much quicker.

Plants sown in hydroponics systems are not affected.
Rule.Translated:
Una sequía extrema se ha instalado en la zona. Las nubes de lluvia han desaparecido y el sol abrasa la tierra.

Los cultivos al aire libre y las plantas silvestres sufrirán gravemente la falta de humedad: su crecimiento casi se detendrá y terminarán muriendo. Los incendios se propagarán mucho más deprisa.

Las plantas cultivadas en sistemas hidropónicos no se ven afectadas.

Los cultivos al aire libre y las plantas silvestres sufrirán gravemente la falta de humedad: su crecimiento casi se detendrá y terminarán muriendo. Los incendios se propagarán mucho más deprisa.

Las plantas cultivadas en sistemas hidropónicos no se ven afectadas.

Rule.Original: A massive orbital ship has suffered a catastrophic structural failure in orbit directly above your region!
Rule.Raw: A massive orbital ship has suffered a catastrophic structural failure in orbit directly above your region!
Rule.Translated: Una batalla espacial se está librando en el cielo, puede durar hasta 24 horas.

Rule.Original: The orbital ship crash is ending.
Rule.Raw: The orbital ship crash is ending.

Rule.Original: Some distant engine of joy sent psychic vibrations that washed over the region, specifically resonating with the minds of a particular demographic.
Rule.Raw: Some distant engine of joy sent psychic vibrations that washed over the region, specifically resonating with the minds of a particular demographic.
Rule.Translated: Alguna fuente lejana de alegría ha enviado vibraciones psíquicas a través de la región, que resuenan específicamente con las mentes de un grupo concreto de personas.

Rule.Original: Every {0} colonist seems more joyful!\n\nSome distant engine of joy sent psychic vibrations that washed over the region, specifically resonating with the minds of a particular demographic. Your colonists feel a deep, soothing calm as their minds are stimulated by the ethereal energy. They are finding great relaxation in this mental state. For a few days, their recreation will be completely satisfied.
Rule.Raw: Every {0} colonist seems more joyful!\n\nSome distant engine of joy sent psychic vibrations that washed over the region, specifically resonating with the minds of a particular demographic. Your colonists feel a deep, soothing calm as their minds are stimulated by the ethereal energy. They are finding great relaxation in this mental state. For a few days, their recreation will be completely satisfied.
Rule.Translated: ¡Todos los colonos del grupo {0} parecen más alegres!\n\nAlguna fuente lejana de alegría ha enviado vibraciones psíquicas a través de la región, que resuenan específicamente con las mentes de un grupo concreto. Tus colonos sienten una calma profunda y reconfortante mientras esta energía etérea estimula sus mentes. Este estado mental les proporciona una gran relajación. Durante unos días, su necesidad de recreación estará completamente satisfecha.

Rule.Original: A wave of psychic energy has washed over the colony, resonating specifically with the minds of some of your colonists!
Rule.Raw: A wave of psychic energy has washed over the colony, resonating specifically with the minds of some of your colonists!
Rule.Translated: ¡Una oleada de energía psíquica ha barrido la colonia, resonando específicamente en las mentes de algunos de tus colonos!

Rule.Original:
Every {0} colonist focuses much more on their work!

A wave of psychic energy has washed over the colony, resonating specifically with the minds of some of your colonists!

Their thoughts are racing, and their bodies are moving with newfound efficiency. For the next few days, their work speed will be significantly boosted by this psychic overcharge.
Rule.Raw:
Every {0} colonist focuses much more on their work!

A wave of psychic energy has washed over the colony, resonating specifically with the minds of some of your colonists!

Their thoughts are racing, and their bodies are moving with newfound efficiency. For the next few days, their work speed will be significantly boosted by this psychic overcharge.
Rule.Translated:
¡Todos los colonos del grupo {0} se concentran mucho más en su trabajo!

Una oleada de energía psíquica ha atravesado la colonia y resuena específicamente con las mentes de algunos de tus colonos.

Sus pensamientos se aceleran y sus cuerpos se mueven con una eficiencia renovada. Durante los próximos días, esta sobrecarga psíquica aumentará considerablemente su velocidad de trabajo.

Rule.Original: A weird, discordant psychic hum is vibrating through the minds of some people, seemingly chosen at random.
Rule.Raw: A weird, discordant psychic hum is vibrating through the minds of some people, seemingly chosen at random.
Rule.Translated: Un zumbido psíquico extraño y disonante vibra en las mentes de algunas personas, aparentemente elegidas al azar.

Rule.Original:
A weird, discordant psychic hum is vibrating through the minds of some people, seemingly chosen at random.

They are unable to rest or find any relief, and their mental state is rapidly deteriorating as their exhaustion and need for recreation skyrocket.

Colonists affected:

{0}.
Rule.Raw:
A weird, discordant psychic hum is vibrating through the minds of some people, seemingly chosen at random.

They are unable to rest or find any relief, and their mental state is rapidly deteriorating as their exhaustion and need for recreation skyrocket.

Colonists affected:

{0}.
Rule.Translated:
Un zumbido psíquico extraño y discordante vibra en las mentes de algunas personas, aparentemente elegidas al azar.

No pueden descansar ni encontrar alivio, y su estado mental se deteriora rápidamente mientras se disparan su agotamiento y su necesidad de recreación.

Colonos afectados:

{0}.

Rule.Original: Oh you dirty cheater, stop peeking behind the curtain!
Rule.Raw: Oh you dirty cheater, stop peeking behind the curtain!

Rule.Original: Severe cellular damage and blistering caused by unprotected exposure to solar radiation. Recovery is incredibly slow and leaves the skin highly sensitive for days.
Rule.Raw: Severe cellular damage and blistering caused by unprotected exposure to solar radiation. Recovery is incredibly slow and leaves the skin highly sensitive for days.
Rule.Translated: Daño celular grave y ampollas por exponerse sin protección a la radiación solar. La recuperación es muy lenta y deja la piel extremadamente sensible durante días.

Rule.Original: The celestial entity is emitting a heavy cosmic resonance. Organic beings will tire much faster than normal, and their psychic sensitivity will be dangerously amplified.
Rule.Raw: The celestial entity is emitting a heavy cosmic resonance. Organic beings will tire much faster than normal, and their psychic sensitivity will be dangerously amplified.
Rule.Translated: La entidad celeste emite una intensa resonancia cósmica. Los seres orgánicos se cansarán mucho más rápido de lo normal y su sensibilidad psíquica aumentará peligrosamente.

Rule.Original: The psychic lotuses are mutating nearby flora into vibrant, otherworldly variants, and the ambient psychic sensitivity of everyone in the region has doubled.
Rule.Raw: The psychic lotuses are mutating nearby flora into vibrant, otherworldly variants, and the ambient psychic sensitivity of everyone in the region has doubled.
Rule.Translated: Los lotos psíquicos transforman la flora cercana en variantes coloridas de otro mundo, y la sensibilidad psíquica ambiental de todos los habitantes de la región se ha duplicado.

Rule.Original: Some distant engine of joy sent psychic vibrations that washed over the region, specifically resonating with the minds of a particular demographic.
Rule.Raw: Some distant engine of joy sent psychic vibrations that washed over the region, specifically resonating with the minds of a particular demographic.
Rule.Translated: Alguna fuente lejana de alegría ha enviado vibraciones psíquicas a través de la región, que resuenan específicamente con las mentes de un grupo concreto de personas.

Rule.Original: A wave of psychic energy has washed over the colony, resonating specifically with the minds of some of your colonists!
Rule.Raw: A wave of psychic energy has washed over the colony, resonating specifically with the minds of some of your colonists!
Rule.Translated: ¡Una oleada de energía psíquica ha barrido la colonia, resonando específicamente en las mentes de algunos de tus colonos!

Rule.Original: A weird, discordant psychic hum is vibrating through the minds of some people, seemingly chosen at random.
Rule.Raw: A weird, discordant psychic hum is vibrating through the minds of some people, seemingly chosen at random.
Rule.Translated: Un zumbido psíquico extraño y disonante vibra en las mentes de algunas personas, aparentemente elegidas al azar.
Multiplicador de acumulación de enfermedad solar

Rule.Original: A factor on how fast sun sickness will be gained during a scorch incident.
Rule.Raw: A factor on how fast sun sickness will be gained during a scorch incident.
Rule.Translated: Un factor que determina la rapidez con la que se contrae la enfermedad solar durante un incidente de abrasamiento.

Rule.Original:
An extreme drought has set over the area. Rain clouds have vanished, and the sun is baking the earth.

Outdoor crops and wild plants will suffer heavily from the lack of moisture, almost halting their growth and eventually dying off. The fires will spread much quicker.

Plants sown in hydroponics systems are not affected.
Rule.Raw:
An extreme drought has set over the area. Rain clouds have vanished, and the sun is baking the earth.

Outdoor crops and wild plants will suffer heavily from the lack of moisture, almost halting their growth and eventually dying off. The fires will spread much quicker.

Plants sown in hydroponics systems are not affected.
Rule.Translated:
Una sequía extrema se ha instalado en la zona. Las nubes de lluvia han desaparecido y el sol abrasa la tierra.

Los cultivos al aire libre y las plantas silvestres sufrirán gravemente la falta de humedad: su crecimiento casi se detendrá y terminarán muriendo. Los incendios se propagarán mucho más deprisa.

Las plantas cultivadas en sistemas hidropónicos no se ven afectadas.

Rule.Original:
A cluster of meteorites has entered the atmosphere and is breaking apart directly over your area! 

Several rocks will strike the ground in a localized area over the next few hours. They will obliterate anything they hit.

Meteorites like that are likely to leave behind some resources.
Rule.Raw:
A cluster of meteorites has entered the atmosphere and is breaking apart directly over your area! 

Several rocks will strike the ground in a localized area over the next few hours. They will obliterate anything they hit.

Meteorites like that are likely to leave behind some resources.
Rule.Translated: Varios meteoritos de gran tamaño han impactado en la zona. Han dejado tras de sí grandes cantidades de recursos.

Rule.Original:
Giant insects are tunneling towards you! They will break through in a few seconds and plant hives.

The hives will spawn more insects and more hives.

If you don't want the insects to infest the whole area, destroy the hives. But beware - the bugs will defend their home.
Rule.Raw:
Giant insects are tunneling towards you! They will break through in a few seconds and plant hives.

The hives will spawn more insects and more hives.

If you don't want the insects to infest the whole area, destroy the hives. But beware - the bugs will defend their home.
Rule.Translated:
¡Insectos gigantes están excavando hacia ti! Saldrán a la superficie en unos segundos y establecerán colmenas.

Las colmenas generarán más insectos y más colmenas.

Si no quieres que infesten toda la zona, destruye las colmenas. Pero ten cuidado: los insectos defenderán su hogar.

Rule.Original:
A dangerous psychic entity caused disturbance on subatomic levels, resonating across all particles of the atmosphere.
A seemingly endless supernatural rain has begun, altering the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under the roof will age significantly faster.
It will last anywhere between a season to several years.
Rule.Raw:
A dangerous psychic entity caused disturbance on subatomic levels, resonating across all particles of the atmosphere.
A seemingly endless supernatural rain has begun, altering the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under the roof will age significantly faster.
It will last anywhere between a season to several years.
Rule.Translated:
Una peligrosa entidad psíquica ha introducido una perturbación en los niveles subatómicos que resuena en todas las partículas de la atmósfera.

Una lluvia sobrenatural aparentemente interminable ha comenzado, alterando la composición misma del tiempo. Cualquier persona o criatura que no esté bajo el techo envejecerá mucho más rápido.

Durará entre una estación y varios años.

Rule.Original: A crashed, spacer-tech shuttle designed for transit between surface and orbit. Can be deconstructed to yield some valuable salvage.
Rule.Raw: A crashed, spacer-tech shuttle designed for transit between surface and orbit. Can be deconstructed to yield some valuable salvage.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de una lanzadera. Se puede desmontar para obtener recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A large chunk of an orbital ship, violently torn off during a catastrophic structural failure in high orbit. Having crashlanded not long ago, it still contains useful resources which you can acquire by deconstructing it.
Rule.Raw: A large chunk of an orbital ship, violently torn off during a catastrophic structural failure in high orbit. Having crashlanded not long ago, it still contains useful resources which you can acquire by deconstructing it.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de una nave espacial. Se puede desmontar para obtener recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A heavy, compacted layer of snow that resists movement and muffles sound. Can be mined to remove it.
Rule.Raw: A heavy, compacted layer of snow that resists movement and muffles sound. Can be mined to remove it.
Rule.Translated: Una capa gruesa de nieve compactada que dificulta el movimiento y amortigua el sonido. Puede retirarse mediante minería.

Rule.Original: An unnatural, faintly glowing sprout that seems to root itself in reality rather than soil. While harmless, it is the beginning of a highly dangerous bloom and should be uprooted before it matures.
Rule.Raw: An unnatural, faintly glowing sprout that seems to root itself in reality rather than soil. While harmless, it is the beginning of a highly dangerous bloom and should be uprooted before it matures.
Rule.Translated: Un brote antinatural de tenue brillo que parece echar raíces en la propia realidad en lugar de en la tierra. Aunque es inofensivo, inicia una floración muy peligrosa y conviene arrancarlo antes de que madure.

Rule.Original: A mesmerizing, ethereal bloom that acts as a dimensional anchor, emitting floating, firefly-like flecks of light. It actively terraforms the area by continuously spawning alien flora around it. Destroying it may trigger a final, rapid burst of otherworldly growth.
Rule.Raw: A mesmerizing, ethereal bloom that acts as a dimensional anchor, emitting floating, firefly-like flecks of light. It actively terraforms the area by continuously spawning alien flora around it. Destroying it may trigger a final, rapid burst of otherworldly growth.
Rule.Translated: Una floración etérea e hipnótica que actúa como ancla dimensional y emite motas de luz flotantes, similares a luciérnagas. Terraforma activamente la zona generando flora alienígena sin cesar a su alrededor. Destruirla puede provocar una última y rápida oleada de crecimiento de otro mundo.

Rule.Original: A vibrant, otherworldly groundcover that feels unsettlingly smooth to the touch. It appears to feed on ambient psychic energy rather than soil or sunlight.
Rule.Raw: A vibrant, otherworldly groundcover that feels unsettlingly smooth to the touch. It appears to feed on ambient psychic energy rather than soil or sunlight.
Rule.Translated: Una cobertura vegetal colorida y de otro mundo, de tacto inquietantemente suave. Parece alimentarse de energía psíquica ambiental en vez de tierra o luz solar.

Rule.Original: Overgrown stalks of alien grass. Its long, vibrant blades sway rhythmically, completely ignoring the direction of the local wind.
Rule.Raw: Overgrown stalks of alien grass. Its long, vibrant blades sway rhythmically, completely ignoring the direction of the local wind.
Rule.Translated: Tallos crecidos de hierba alienígena. Sus hojas largas y coloridas oscilan rítmicamente, ignorando por completo la dirección del viento local.

Rule.Original: Bizarre, thread-like growths that hum faintly when approached. The strands vibrate constantly, potentially echoing the psychic pressure of their home dimension.
Rule.Raw: Bizarre, thread-like growths that hum faintly when approached. The strands vibrate constantly, potentially echoing the psychic pressure of their home dimension.
Rule.Translated: Extrañas formaciones similares a hilos que zumban débilmente cuando alguien se acerca. Las hebras vibran constantemente, quizá como eco de la presión psíquica de su dimensión de origen.

Rule.Original: A dense grouping of bulbous alien foliage that pulses with a slow, heartbeat-like rhythm. Standing near it leaves observers with the uneasy, creeping sensation of being watched by a thousand eyes.
Rule.Raw: A dense grouping of bulbous alien foliage that pulses with a slow, heartbeat-like rhythm. Standing near it leaves observers with the uneasy, creeping sensation of being watched by a thousand eyes.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo denso de follaje alienígena bulboso que pulsa lentamente, como un corazón. Permanecer cerca provoca la inquietante sensación de estar siendo observado por mil ojos.

Rule.Original: A towering, bizarre formation barely resembling a giant mushroom. Touching its trunk leaves a lingering, static-like tingling sensation in the mind.
Rule.Raw: A towering, bizarre formation barely resembling a giant mushroom. Touching its trunk leaves a lingering, static-like tingling sensation in the mind.
Rule.Translated: Una formación extraña y altísima que apenas recuerda a un hongo gigante. Tocar su tronco deja en la mente un hormigueo persistente, similar a la electricidad estática.

Rule.Original: A hauntingly beautiful, tree-like structure that refracts light in impossible colors. It appears almost crystalline and fragile, despite piercing the earth to anchor itself.
Rule.Raw: A hauntingly beautiful, tree-like structure that refracts light in impossible colors. It appears almost crystalline and fragile, despite piercing the earth to anchor itself.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura parecida a un árbol, de belleza inquietante, que refracta la luz en colores imposibles. Parece casi cristalina y frágil, pese a perforar la tierra para anclarse.

Rule.Original: A robust, twisted growth that resembles petrified muscle more than wood. It radiates a barely felt, unnatural warmth and smells sharply of ozone and burning copper.
Rule.Raw: A robust, twisted growth that resembles petrified muscle more than wood. It radiates a barely felt, unnatural warmth and smells sharply of ozone and burning copper.
Rule.Translated: Una formación robusta y retorcida que recuerda más a un músculo petrificado que a madera. Irradia una calidez antinatural apenas perceptible y desprende un olor intenso a ozono y cobre quemado.

Rule.Original: A garden flower with a violet–blue teint, with strongly recurved petals. Bluebells are very beautiful, and last long.
Rule.Raw: A garden flower with a violet–blue teint, with strongly recurved petals. Bluebells are very beautiful, and last long.
Rule.Translated: Una flor de jardín de color azul violáceo y pétalos muy curvados. Los jacintos son muy hermosos y duran mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: A flower with large petals. Gardenias are very beautiful.
Rule.Raw: A flower with large petals. Gardenias are very beautiful.
Rule.Translated: Una flor de grandes pétalos. Las gardenias son muy hermosas.

Rule.Original: A large cultivated flower with inimitable blue petals. Gentians are very beautiful.
Rule.Raw: A large cultivated flower with inimitable blue petals. Gentians are very beautiful.
Rule.Translated: Una gran flor de jardín con unos inconfundibles pétalos azules. Las gencianas son muy hermosas.

Rule.Original: A long lasting flower with purple petals. Petunias are very beautiful.
Rule.Raw: A long lasting flower with purple petals. Petunias are very beautiful.
Rule.Translated: Una flor de larga duración con pétalos morados. Las petunias son muy hermosas.

Rule.Original: A wilted, ethereal bloom that acted as a dimensional anchor. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Raw: A wilted, ethereal bloom that acted as a dimensional anchor. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Translated: Una flor etérea marchita que actuaba como ancla dimensional. Ahora está muerta y se deteriora.

Rule.Original: Bizarre, thread-like growths that hummed faintly when approached. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Raw: Bizarre, thread-like growths that hummed faintly when approached. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Translated: Extrañas formaciones filamentosas que zumbaban suavemente al acercarse a ellas. Ahora están muertas y se deterioran.

Rule.Original: A dense grouping of bulbous alien foliage that pulsed with a slow, heartbeat-like rhythm. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Raw: A dense grouping of bulbous alien foliage that pulsed with a slow, heartbeat-like rhythm. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo denso de follaje alienígena bulboso que palpitaba lentamente, como un corazón. Ahora está muerto y se deteriora.

Rule.Original: A towering, bizarre formation barely resembling a giant mushroom. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Raw: A towering, bizarre formation barely resembling a giant mushroom. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Translated: Una formación extraña y altísima que apenas recuerda a una seta gigante. Ahora está muerta y se deteriora.

Rule.Original: A wilted, tree-like structure that refracted light in impossible colors. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Raw: A wilted, tree-like structure that refracted light in impossible colors. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura arbórea marchita que refractaba la luz en colores imposibles. Ahora está muerta y se deteriora.

Rule.Original: A robust, twisted growth that resembles petrified muscle more than wood. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Raw: A robust, twisted growth that resembles petrified muscle more than wood. Now dead and withering.
Rule.Translated: Una formación robusta y retorcida que recuerda más a un músculo petrificado que a la madera. Ahora está muerta y se deteriora.

Rule.Original: My heart pounds and I'm sweating. All I can think of is hurting and suffering and all these enemies around me. They're my nightmare, my nightmare, my nightmare...
Rule.Raw: My heart pounds and I'm sweating. All I can think of is hurting and suffering and all these enemies around me. They're my nightmare, my nightmare, my nightmare...
Rule.Translated: El corazón me late con fuerza y estoy sudando. Solo puedo pensar en dolor, sufrimiento y todos esos enemigos que me rodean. Son mi pesadilla, mi pesadilla, mi pesadilla...

Rule.Original: Heavy, chilling snow that severely reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire and slows people down.
Rule.Raw: Heavy, chilling snow that severely reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire and slows people down.
Rule.Translated: Nieve intensa y gélida que reduce mucho la precisión de las armas a distancia, apaga el fuego y ralentiza a las personas.
Un calor catastrófico, antinatural y opresivo.

Rule.Original: A seemingly supernatural rain that alters the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under a roof will age significantly faster.
Rule.Raw: A seemingly supernatural rain that alters the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under a roof will age significantly faster.
Rule.Translated: Una lluvia aparentemente sobrenatural que altera la propia composición del tiempo. Toda persona o criatura que no esté bajo techo envejecerá mucho más rápido.

Rule.Original: A catastrophic celestial eclipse that blankets the world in an endless, freezing twilight, forcing the world to adapt to artificial light and increased psychic sensitivity as nocturnal predators and subterranean threats emerge in the darkness.
Rule.Raw: A catastrophic celestial eclipse that blankets the world in an endless, freezing twilight, forcing the world to adapt to artificial light and increased psychic sensitivity as nocturnal predators and subterranean threats emerge in the darkness.
Rule.Translated: Un eclipse celeste catastrófico que cubre el mundo con un crepúsculo interminable y helado. Obliga a adaptarse a la iluminación artificial y a una mayor sensibilidad psíquica, mientras depredadores nocturnos y amenazas subterráneas emergen en la oscuridad.

Rule.Original: Grows plants in a box of soil. Does not require power to work.
Rule.Raw: Grows plants in a box of soil. Does not require power to work.
Rule.Translated: Cultiva plantas en una caja de tierra. No necesita energía para funcionar.

Rule.Original: Grows plants quickly in an artificial, sealed ecosystem. Requires a high amount of power to work; plants will die if power is cut.\n\nContains a built-in sun lamp to provide light for the plants.
Rule.Raw: Grows plants quickly in an artificial, sealed ecosystem. Requires a high amount of power to work; plants will die if power is cut.\n\nContains a built-in sun lamp to provide light for the plants.
Rule.Translated: Cultiva plantas rápidamente en un ecosistema artificial y cerrado. Requiere una gran cantidad de energía para funcionar, y si se interrumpe el suministro de energía las plantas morirán.\n\nDispone de una lámpara solar incorporada para proporcionar luz a las plantas.

Rule.Original: Grows plants in a box of soil. Does not require power to work.\n\nCan be constructed in any desired shape.
Rule.Raw: Grows plants in a box of soil. Does not require power to work.\n\nCan be constructed in any desired shape.
Rule.Translated: Cultiva plantas en una caja de tierra. No necesita energía para funcionar.\n\nSe puede construir con la forma que uno quiera.

Rule.Original: An artificial nutrient bath for growing plants. The nutrients pumps must work continuously; the plants will die if power is cut.\n\nThis version is modular and can be assembled in any shape necessary.
Rule.Raw: An artificial nutrient bath for growing plants. The nutrients pumps must work continuously; the plants will die if power is cut.\n\nThis version is modular and can be assembled in any shape necessary.
Rule.Translated: Una bañera de nutrientes artificial para el cultivo de plantas. Las bombas de nutrientes deben funcionar continuamente, por lo que las plantas morirán si se corta la corriente.\n\nEsta versión es modular y se puede construir con la forma que sea necesaria.

Rule.Original: Grows plants quickly in an artificial, sealed ecosystem which can be configured to effectively grow even picky plants. Requires a high amount of power to work; plants will die if power is cut. Contains a built-in sun lamp to provide light for the plants.\n\nThis version is modular and can be assembled in any shape necessary.
Rule.Raw: Grows plants quickly in an artificial, sealed ecosystem which can be configured to effectively grow even picky plants. Requires a high amount of power to work; plants will die if power is cut. Contains a built-in sun lamp to provide light for the plants.\n\nThis version is modular and can be assembled in any shape necessary.
Rule.Translated:
Cultiva plantas rápidamente en un ecosistema artificial y cerrado. Requiere una gran cantidad de energía para funcionar, y si se interrumpe el suministro de energía las plantas morirán.

Dispone de una lámpara solar incorporada para proporcionar luz a las plantas.

Esta versión es modular y se puede construir con la forma que sea necesaria.

Rule.Original: A humanoid figure made out of hay, dressed in old clothes to deter animals in a large radius. Small animals will be too afraid to approach.
Rule.Raw: A humanoid figure made out of hay, dressed in old clothes to deter animals in a large radius. Small animals will be too afraid to approach.
Rule.Translated: Una figura humanoide hecha de heno y vestida con ropa vieja con la intención de disuadir a los animales en un amplio radio. Los animales pequeños tendrán demasiado miedo de acercarse.

Rule.Original: A water sprinkler, providing an area around it with water. Enhances the growth of surrounding plants.
Rule.Raw: A water sprinkler, providing an area around it with water. Enhances the growth of surrounding plants.
Rule.Translated: Un aspersor de agua, que provee de agua a la zona que lo rodea. Favorece el crecimiento de las plantas circundantes.

Rule.Original: Learn to construct artificial ecosystems, highly advanced terraria which vastly improve upon hydroponics.
Rule.Raw: Learn to construct artificial ecosystems, highly advanced terraria which vastly improve upon hydroponics.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a construir ecosistemas artificiales, terrarios muy avanzados que superan notablemente a la hidroponía.

Rule.Original: subject_story->conceived and created self-sustaining environments, mastering the balance of nature and technology
Rule.Raw: subject_story->conceived and created self-sustaining environments, mastering the balance of nature and technology
Rule.Translated: subject_story->concibió y creó entornos autosuficientes al dominar el equilibrio entre naturaleza y tecnología

Rule.Original: subject_story->ushered in a new age of food security with ecosystems that defy the natural limitations of climate and geography
Rule.Raw: subject_story->ushered in a new age of food security with ecosystems that defy the natural limitations of climate and geography
Rule.Translated: subject_story->inició una nueva era de seguridad alimentaria con ecosistemas que superaban las limitaciones naturales del clima y la geografía

Rule.Original: subject_story->harnessed the principles of ecological harmony, integrating advanced hydroponics with biodiverse terraria
Rule.Raw: subject_story->harnessed the principles of ecological harmony, integrating advanced hydroponics with biodiverse terraria
Rule.Translated: subject_story->aplicó los principios de la armonía ecológica al integrar hidroponía avanzada con terrarios de gran biodiversidad

Rule.Original: subject_story->enabled the cultivation of exotic flora and fauna, previously unseen on this scale
Rule.Raw: subject_story->enabled the cultivation of exotic flora and fauna, previously unseen on this scale
Rule.Translated: subject_story->permitió cultivar flora y criar fauna exóticas a una escala nunca vista

Rule.Original: subject_story->innovated in closed-loop water and nutrient cycles, reducing waste and increasing efficiency
Rule.Raw: subject_story->innovated in closed-loop water and nutrient cycles, reducing waste and increasing efficiency
Rule.Translated: subject_story->innovó en ciclos cerrados de agua y nutrientes que reducían los residuos y aumentaban la eficiencia

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->revolutionizing agriculture with the creation of artificial ecosystems
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->revolutionizing agriculture with the creation of artificial ecosystems
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->revolucionando la agricultura con ecosistemas artificiales

Rule.Original: Assemble schematics for a device which can automatically water fields, increasing the speed at which crops grow.
Rule.Raw: Assemble schematics for a device which can automatically water fields, increasing the speed at which crops grow.
Rule.Translated: Diseña un dispositivo que permite regar automáticamente los campos, aumentando la velocidad de crecimiento de los cultivos.

Rule.Original: subject_story->developed automated watering systems, ensuring optimal hydration for crops across vast fields
Rule.Raw: subject_story->developed automated watering systems, ensuring optimal hydration for crops across vast fields
Rule.Translated: subject_story->desarrolló sistemas de riego automatizados que garantizaban una hidratación óptima en grandes campos de cultivo

Rule.Original: subject_story->transformed agricultural productivity with precision irrigation, minimizing water waste
Rule.Raw: subject_story->transformed agricultural productivity with precision irrigation, minimizing water waste
Rule.Translated: subject_story->transformó la productividad agrícola mediante riego preciso que reducía el desperdicio de agua

Rule.Original: subject_story->pioneered the use of sprinklers, marking a leap forward from traditional watering methods
Rule.Raw: subject_story->pioneered the use of sprinklers, marking a leap forward from traditional watering methods
Rule.Translated: subject_story->fue pionero en el uso de aspersores y dio un salto respecto a los métodos tradicionales de riego

Rule.Original: subject_story->empowered farmers to control the very essence of growth - water - with the turn of a valve
Rule.Raw: subject_story->empowered farmers to control the very essence of growth - water - with the turn of a valve
Rule.Translated: subject_story->permitió a los agricultores controlar la esencia del crecimiento, el agua, con solo girar una válvula

Rule.Original: subject_story->fostered greener pastures and bountiful harvests, even in areas once thought barren
Rule.Raw: subject_story->fostered greener pastures and bountiful harvests, even in areas once thought barren
Rule.Translated: subject_story->favoreció pastos más verdes y cosechas abundantes incluso en zonas antes consideradas estériles

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->streamlining growth with the simplicity and efficiency of sprinklers
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->streamlining growth with the simplicity and efficiency of sprinklers
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->agilizando el crecimiento con la sencillez y eficiencia de los aspersores

Rule.Original: Develop a theoretical basis for larger-scale farming operations, including centralized feeding and dedicated scarecrows to keep your crops uneaten.
Rule.Raw: Develop a theoretical basis for larger-scale farming operations, including centralized feeding and dedicated scarecrows to keep your crops uneaten.
Rule.Translated: Desarrolla una base teórica para llevar a cabo operaciones agrícolas a mayor escala, contando con cosas como sistemas de alimentación centralizados y espantapájaros para evitar que se coman las cosechas.

Rule.Original: subject_story->rediscovered and refined ancient methods for modern largescale farming operations
Rule.Raw: subject_story->rediscovered and refined ancient methods for modern largescale farming operations
Rule.Translated: subject_story->redescubrió y perfeccionó métodos antiguos para la agricultura moderna a gran escala

Rule.Original: subject_story->implemented centralized feeding strategies, optimizing nutrition and yield
Rule.Raw: subject_story->implemented centralized feeding strategies, optimizing nutrition and yield
Rule.Translated: subject_story->aplicó estrategias centralizadas de alimentación que optimizaban la nutrición y el rendimiento

Rule.Original: subject_story->crafted scarecrows based on deep understanding of local fauna, effectively protecting crops
Rule.Raw: subject_story->crafted scarecrows based on deep understanding of local fauna, effectively protecting crops
Rule.Translated: subject_story->creó espantapájaros basados en un conocimiento profundo de la fauna local y protegió eficazmente los cultivos

Rule.Original: subject_story->laid down the foundational practices for sustainable and efficient food production
Rule.Raw: subject_story->laid down the foundational practices for sustainable and efficient food production
Rule.Translated: subject_story->estableció las prácticas fundamentales de una producción alimentaria sostenible y eficiente

Rule.Original: subject_story->inspired a generation of farmers to adopt innovative approaches to agriculture
Rule.Raw: subject_story->inspired a generation of farmers to adopt innovative approaches to agriculture
Rule.Translated: subject_story->inspiró a una generación de agricultores a adoptar enfoques innovadores

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->advancing the art and science of farming through cutting-edge techniques
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->advancing the art and science of farming through cutting-edge techniques
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->impulsando el arte y la ciencia de la agricultura mediante técnicas avanzadas

Rule.Original: Learn how to sculpt tall, narrow shaped obelisks to commemorate important events.
Rule.Raw: Learn how to sculpt tall, narrow shaped obelisks to commemorate important events.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a esculpir obeliscos altos y de forma estrecha para conmemorar acontecimientos importantes.
subject->centinelas de piedra de la historia

Rule.Original: subject_story->mastered the art of carving stone into towering obelisks, symbols of significant achievements and memory
Rule.Raw: subject_story->mastered the art of carving stone into towering obelisks, symbols of significant achievements and memory
Rule.Translated: subject_story->dominó el arte de tallar piedra para crear enormes obeliscos, símbolos de grandes logros y recuerdos

Rule.Original: subject_story->marked the landscape with these monoliths, guiding future generations towards understanding their heritage
Rule.Raw: subject_story->marked the landscape with these monoliths, guiding future generations towards understanding their heritage
Rule.Translated: subject_story->marcó el paisaje con estos monolitos y ayudó a las generaciones futuras a comprender su patrimonio

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->etching the narrative of civilization into the earth itself
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->etching the narrative of civilization into the earth itself
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->grabando el relato de la civilización en la propia tierra

Rule.Original: Learn how to create beautiful vases and other vessels from simple materials.
Rule.Raw: Learn how to create beautiful vases and other vessels from simple materials.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a crear bonitos jarrones y otros recipientes a partir de materiales sencillos.

Rule.Original: subject_story->rediscovered ancient techniques for shaping clay into vessels of beauty and utility
Rule.Raw: subject_story->rediscovered ancient techniques for shaping clay into vessels of beauty and utility
Rule.Translated: subject_story->redescubrió técnicas antiguas para moldear arcilla y crear recipientes hermosos y útiles

Rule.Original: subject_story->elevated simple materials to art, capturing the essence of culture in each curve and color
Rule.Raw: subject_story->elevated simple materials to art, capturing the essence of culture in each curve and color
Rule.Translated: subject_story->convirtió materiales sencillos en arte y capturó la esencia de la cultura en cada curva y color

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->molding the earth's bounty into forms of lasting legacy
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->molding the earth's bounty into forms of lasting legacy
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->moldeando la riqueza de la tierra en formas de legado duradero

Rule.Original: Master the techniques of wall carving to create beautiful pillars and reliefs.
Rule.Raw: Master the techniques of wall carving to create beautiful pillars and reliefs.
Rule.Translated: Domina técnicas de tallado de paredes para crear hermosos pilares y relieves.
