Rule.Original: An installed resurrection core. A small durable core which contains a one-use super-dose of mechanites tuned to resurrect the dead. Once implanted, upon dying the mechanites repair broken-down tissue and kickstart the body back to life. A core will give a readout on the remaining lives left, if the user has only one life remaining the core is already spent making it inert and incapable of bringing them back to life again. At that point the core must be removed before it can be replaced with a new core.
Rule.Raw: An installed resurrection core. A small durable core which contains a one-use super-dose of mechanites tuned to resurrect the dead. Once implanted, upon dying the mechanites repair broken-down tissue and kickstart the body back to life. A core will give a readout on the remaining lives left, if the user has only one life remaining the core is already spent making it inert and incapable of bringing them back to life again. At that point the core must be removed before it can be replaced with a new core.
Rule.Translated: Un núcleo de resurrección implantado. Un pequeño núcleo resistente que contiene una superdosis de mecanitas de un solo uso, preparadas para resucitar a los muertos. Una vez implantado, al morir el portador las mecanitas reparan los tejidos deteriorados y reactivan el cuerpo para devolverlo a la vida. El núcleo indica cuántas vidas quedan. Si al usuario solo le queda una vida, el núcleo ya se ha agotado: queda inerte y no puede devolverlo a la vida de nuevo. En ese momento hay que extraerlo antes de sustituirlo por uno nuevo.

extraer y destruir núcleo de resurrección
Extrae y destruye el núcleo de resurrección.
Extrayendo y destruyendo núcleo de resurrección.

Rule.Original: An installed immortality core. A small durable core of archotech design said to provide its host with a million lives. Once implanted, upon dying the device repairs broken-down tissue and kickstarts the body back to life. The only flaw in its design is that the regeneration capabilities only trigger upon death. That being the case hosts may find themselves intentionally ending their lives to quickly regenerate parts of their body. Once implanted the core cannot be removed without damaging the device rendering it inert.
Rule.Raw: An installed immortality core. A small durable core of archotech design said to provide its host with a million lives. Once implanted, upon dying the device repairs broken-down tissue and kickstarts the body back to life. The only flaw in its design is that the regeneration capabilities only trigger upon death. That being the case hosts may find themselves intentionally ending their lives to quickly regenerate parts of their body. Once implanted the core cannot be removed without damaging the device rendering it inert.
Rule.Translated: Un núcleo de inmortalidad implantado. Un pequeño núcleo resistente de diseño arcotecnológico del que se dice que proporciona un millón de vidas a su portador. Una vez implantado, al morir el portador el dispositivo repara los tejidos deteriorados y reactiva el cuerpo para devolverlo a la vida. Su único defecto de diseño es que la regeneración solo se activa al morir. Por ello, los portadores pueden acabar poniendo fin a su vida deliberadamente para regenerar partes de su cuerpo con rapidez. Una vez implantado, no puede extraerse sin dañar el dispositivo y dejarlo inerte.

Rule.Original: A swarm of healing mechanites. A dose of semi-coherent mechanites designed to rapidly heal injuries within the host. Despite how powerful they are they are unable to heal lost limbs, organs or scarred tissue.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.
Rule.Translated: Un enjambre de mecanitas curativas. Una dosis de mecanitas semicoherentes diseñadas para curar rápidamente las lesiones del portador. A pesar de su gran potencia, no pueden regenerar extremidades u órganos perdidos ni tejidos cicatrizados.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, las mecanitas están diseñadas para que el propio usuario pueda implantárselas con un pequeño inyector portátil. Debido a su funcionamiento, solo una cepa puede coexistir de forma armoniosa dentro del cuerpo del portador. Al inyectarla, las mecanitas nuevas eliminan cualquier cepa que ya estuviera presente. Es posible eliminar por completo las cepas de mecanitas de un portador, pero requiere una operación cara y difícil.

Rule.Original: This setting applies a balance patch to Save Our Ship 2's Archotech bionics changing the balance of them to fit the design philosophy used in Advanced Bionics Expansion. Which is that for the most part stat bonuses should come from the resulting body parts efficiency rating rather than custom stats. In many cases this is a direct downgrade as it removes numerous bonuses featured on SOS2's bionics.
Rule.Raw: This setting applies a balance patch to Save Our Ship 2's Archotech bionics changing the balance of them to fit the design philosophy used in Advanced Bionics Expansion. Which is that for the most part stat bonuses should come from the resulting body parts efficiency rating rather than custom stats. In many cases this is a direct downgrade as it removes numerous bonuses featured on SOS2's bionics.
Rule.Translated: Este ajuste aplica un parche de equilibrio a los implantes arcotecnológicos de Save Our Ship 2 para adaptarlos a los criterios de diseño de Advanced Bionics Expansion. Según estos criterios, la mayoría de las bonificaciones deberían proceder de la eficiencia de la parte del cuerpo resultante, en lugar de estadísticas personalizadas. En muchos casos supone una reducción directa de sus prestaciones, pues elimina numerosas bonificaciones de los implantes de SOS2.

Rule.Original: Enables an Ultratech Orbital Trader with a customisable commonality that sells Advanced Bionics, Servitors and other ultratech goods.
Rule.Raw: Enables an Ultratech Orbital Trader with a customisable commonality that sells Advanced Bionics, Servitors and other ultratech goods.
Rule.Translated: Activa un comerciante orbital de ultratecnología con una frecuencia configurable, que vende implantes biónicos avanzados, servidores y otros productos de ultratecnología.

Rule.Original: Input a value to adjust the commonality of the Ultratech Orbital Trader. The standard for Orbital Traders and the default value is 1. You can make it lower to make it more rare or higher to make it more common.
Rule.Raw: Input a value to adjust the commonality of the Ultratech Orbital Trader. The standard for Orbital Traders and the default value is 1. You can make it lower to make it more rare or higher to make it more common.
Rule.Translated: Introduce un valor para ajustar la frecuencia del comerciante orbital de ultratecnología. El valor habitual de los comerciantes orbitales y el predeterminado es 1. Puedes reducirlo para que aparezca con menos frecuencia o aumentarlo para que sea más habitual.
un espinazo biónico avanzado de redivivo

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic revenant spine. A highly advanced artificial spine crafted from a revenant spine using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides a significant increase to flexibility and movement allowing a much larger degree of motion than a regular spine. It’s as hard as plasteel and through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe spine uses archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant allowing the user to make use of its psychic abilities to manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.
Rule.Raw: An installed advanced bionic revenant spine. A highly advanced artificial spine crafted from a revenant spine using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides a significant increase to flexibility and movement allowing a much larger degree of motion than a regular spine. It’s as hard as plasteel and through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe spine uses archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant allowing the user to make use of its psychic abilities to manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.
Rule.Translated: Un espinazo biónico avanzado de redivivo implantado. Un espinazo artificial muy avanzado fabricado a partir del espinazo de un redivivo con técnicas de ultratecnología de vanguardia. Aumenta considerablemente la flexibilidad y la movilidad, permitiendo una amplitud de movimiento mucho mayor que la de un espinazo normal. Es tan duro como el plastiacero y puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.\n\nEl espinazo utiliza fragmentos arcotecnológicos para contener al redivivo latente, lo que permite al usuario aprovechar sus capacidades psíquicas para manipular los centros visuales de quienes lo rodean y volverse invisible durante un breve periodo.

Rule.Original: Use the advanced bionic revenant spine to temporarily turn invisible. The bionic manipulates the visual centers of those nearby, letting the user pass unnoticed.
Rule.Raw: Use the advanced bionic revenant spine to temporarily turn invisible. The bionic manipulates the visual centers of those nearby, letting the user pass unnoticed.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza el espinazo biónico avanzado de redivivo para volverte invisible temporalmente. El implante manipula los centros visuales de quienes te rodean, permitiéndote pasar inadvertido.
módulo de arte del asistente de IA

Rule.Original: The artistic module enriches the AI Assistant with an extensive knowledge of art techniques, styles, and historical references. It allows the AI Assistant to provide real-time guidance, inspiration, and feedback to help the user develop their artistic skills and produce captivating works of art.\n\nFor ease-of-use AI modules are packaged in a small handheld device. When in close proximity with an AI assistant microcomputer the unit can be enabled to wirelessly transfer its data. Due to the way the modules are designed however, they can only be used once.
Rule.Raw: The artistic module enriches the AI Assistant with an extensive knowledge of art techniques, styles, and historical references. It allows the AI Assistant to provide real-time guidance, inspiration, and feedback to help the user develop their artistic skills and produce captivating works of art.\n\nFor ease-of-use AI modules are packaged in a small handheld device. When in close proximity with an AI assistant microcomputer the unit can be enabled to wirelessly transfer its data. Due to the way the modules are designed however, they can only be used once.
Rule.Translated: El módulo artístico proporciona al asistente de IA amplios conocimientos sobre técnicas, estilos y referencias históricas del arte. Le permite ofrecer orientación, inspiración y comentarios en tiempo real para ayudar al usuario a desarrollar sus habilidades artísticas y producir obras cautivadoras.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, los módulos de IA se presentan en un pequeño dispositivo portátil. Cuando está cerca de un microordenador asistente de IA, la unidad puede activarse para transferir sus datos de forma inalámbrica. Sin embargo, debido a su diseño, los módulos solo pueden utilizarse una vez.

Rule.Original: An installed reproduction controller. A small internal module designed to control the body’s reproduction functions. Through the use of synthetic hormones and nanomachines the module is able to alter the user’s body achieving complete control of their organic functions relating to reproduction.\n\nThe implant will rapidly replenish a person's ovum allowing repeated extraction. Also during pregnancy the implant will keep the body and its hormones in a stable state preventing resulting issues such as morning sickness and fluctuating moods.
Rule.Raw: An installed reproduction controller. A small internal module designed to control the body’s reproduction functions. Through the use of synthetic hormones and nanomachines the module is able to alter the user’s body achieving complete control of their organic functions relating to reproduction.\n\nThe implant will rapidly replenish a person's ovum allowing repeated extraction. Also during pregnancy the implant will keep the body and its hormones in a stable state preventing resulting issues such as morning sickness and fluctuating moods.
Rule.Translated: Un controlador reproductivo implantado. Un pequeño módulo interno diseñado para controlar las funciones reproductivas del cuerpo. Mediante hormonas sintéticas y nanomáquinas, el implante puede modificar el organismo del usuario y controlar por completo sus funciones orgánicas relacionadas con la reproducción.\n\nEl implante repone rápidamente los óvulos de la persona, permitiendo extracciones repetidas. Durante el embarazo también mantiene estables el organismo y sus hormonas, evitando problemas como las náuseas matutinas y las fluctuaciones del estado de ánimo.

Rule.Original: Through the use of advanced artificial fertility procedures and some of the user’s dna the reproduction controller induces a stable and healthy pregnancy in the user without a donor or partner.
Rule.Raw: Through the use of advanced artificial fertility procedures and some of the user’s dna the reproduction controller induces a stable and healthy pregnancy in the user without a donor or partner.
Rule.Translated: Mediante procedimientos avanzados de fertilidad artificial y parte del ADN del usuario, el controlador reproductivo provoca un embarazo estable y saludable sin necesidad de donante ni pareja.
Interrumpe el embarazo actual del usuario.

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic medic arm. A highly advanced artificial arm made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides smooth micrometre precision motor control with strength capable of crushing hardwood branches. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe arm houses a wide range of surgical tools attached to telescoping appendages capable of independent movement. It allows the user to perform several tasks simultaneously greatly increasing their working speed. It’s also fitted with a small self-replenishing medical gel system that can be secreted from the wrists to rapidly tend wounds.
Rule.Raw: An installed advanced bionic medic arm. A highly advanced artificial arm made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides smooth micrometre precision motor control with strength capable of crushing hardwood branches. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe arm houses a wide range of surgical tools attached to telescoping appendages capable of independent movement. It allows the user to perform several tasks simultaneously greatly increasing their working speed. It’s also fitted with a small self-replenishing medical gel system that can be secreted from the wrists to rapidly tend wounds.
Rule.Translated: Un brazo médico biónico avanzado implantado. Un brazo artificial muy avanzado fabricado con técnicas de ultratecnología de vanguardia. Ofrece un control motor suave con precisión micrométrica y fuerza suficiente para aplastar ramas de madera dura. La carne sintética tiene el mismo aspecto y tacto que la natural, pero es tan dura como el plastiacero. Puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.\n\nEl brazo alberga una amplia gama de herramientas quirúrgicas unidas a apéndices telescópicos capaces de moverse de forma independiente. Permite realizar varias tareas a la vez, aumentando considerablemente la velocidad de trabajo. También incluye un pequeño sistema de gel médico que se repone automáticamente y puede secretarse por las muñecas para tratar heridas con rapidez.

Rule.Original: Use special glands in the wrists to secrete a medical gel to quickly tend someone's wounds.
Rule.Raw: Use special glands in the wrists to secrete a medical gel to quickly tend someone's wounds.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza unas glándulas especiales de las muñecas para segregar un gel medicinal con el que atender rápidamente las heridas de alguien.
una mandíbula biónica avanzada de ácido

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic acid jaw. A highly advanced artificial jaw made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It has a crushing strength capable of shattering bones and crushing hardwood branches. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe jaw has a reinforced design for enhanced durability and housed within it is small self-replenishing pouch of acid. This pouch allows the user to discharge acid to enhance their bite. By expending a large amount of the acid stored within the user can even spray acid in front of them.

Rule.Translated: Una mandíbula biónica avanzada de ácido implantada. Una mandíbula artificial muy avanzada fabricada con técnicas de ultratecnología de vanguardia. Su fuerza de mordida permite romper huesos y aplastar ramas de madera dura. La carne sintética tiene el mismo aspecto y tacto que la natural, pero es tan dura como el plastiacero. Puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.\n\nLa mandíbula tiene un diseño reforzado para ofrecer mayor resistencia y alberga una pequeña bolsa de ácido que se repone automáticamente. Esta bolsa permite al usuario liberar ácido para potenciar su mordida. Si gasta una gran cantidad del ácido almacenado, puede incluso rociarlo frente a sí.

Rule.Original: Spit a stream of sticky, flammable bile from the mouth. The bile can ignite anything or anyone it hits, and also form flaming pools on the ground.
Rule.Raw: Spit a stream of sticky, flammable bile from the mouth. The bile can ignite anything or anyone it hits, and also form flaming pools on the ground.
Rule.Translated: Escupe un chorro de bilis pegajosa e inflamable. La bilis puede prender fuego a cualquier objeto o persona que alcance y formar charcos en llamas en el suelo.

Rule.Original: An installed archotech medic arm. It's strong enough to crush a thick hardwood branch in its hand, and precise enough to write a sonnet on a grain of rice. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds. \n\nThe arm houses a wide range of surgical tools attached to telescoping appendages capable of independent movement. It allows the user to perform several tasks simultaneously greatly increasing their working speed. It’s fitted with a small self-replenishing medical gel system that can be secreted from the wrists to rapidly tend wounds. It also has a self-replenishing reservoir of super mechanites that can cure otherwise incurable ailments and regenerate missing pieces of the body.

Rule.Translated: Un brazo médico arcotecnológico implantado. Tiene fuerza suficiente para aplastar una gruesa rama de madera dura con la mano y precisión suficiente para escribir un soneto en un grano de arroz. Tiene el mismo aspecto y tacto que la carne natural, pero es más difícil de dañar que el plastiacero. Incluso si sufre daños, se repara con el tiempo. Su funcionamiento interno es un misterio para cualquier mente humana. \n\nEl brazo alberga una amplia gama de herramientas quirúrgicas unidas a apéndices telescópicos capaces de moverse de forma independiente. Permite realizar varias tareas a la vez, aumentando considerablemente la velocidad de trabajo. Incluye un pequeño sistema de gel médico que se repone automáticamente y puede secretarse por las muñecas para tratar heridas con rapidez. También dispone de un depósito de supermecanitas que se repone automáticamente y puede curar dolencias normalmente incurables y regenerar partes del cuerpo perdidas.

Rule.Original: Use special glands in the wrists to secrete a medical gel to quickly tend someone's wounds. The gel itself is filled with short lived mechanites that promote healing.
Rule.Raw: Use special glands in the wrists to secrete a medical gel to quickly tend someone's wounds. The gel itself is filled with short lived mechanites that promote healing.

Rule.Original: A swarm of short lived mechanites that circulate around the body tending wounds and fighting off harmful conditions.
Rule.Raw: A swarm of short lived mechanites that circulate around the body tending wounds and fighting off harmful conditions.
Rule.Translated: Un enjambre de mecanitas de vida corta que circulan por el cuerpo, atienden heridas y combaten afecciones perjudiciales.

Rule.Original: Simply through touch a dose of super mechanites can be passed through pores in the skin. The mechanites are tuned to heal health conditions, they will target and heal the single worst health condition affecting someone at any given time. It works even on health conditions that would otherwise be incurable. The mechanites can even transmute themselves into organic matter, forming new limbs or organs as needed.

It works even on health conditions that would otherwise be incurable. The mechanites can even transmute themselves into organic matter, forming new limbs or organs as needed.
Rule.Translated: Con un simple contacto se puede transferir una dosis de supermecanitas a través de los poros de la piel. Las mecanitas están preparadas para tratar problemas de salud: localizan y curan la afección más grave que afecte a la persona en ese momento. Funcionan incluso con afecciones que normalmente serían incurables. Las mecanitas pueden transformarse en materia orgánica para formar nuevas extremidades u órganos cuando sea necesario.

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic ear. A highly advanced artificial ear made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides high quality and precise audio filtering allowing the user to pick out or block specific sounds amidst an assortment of noises. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.

Rule.Translated: Una oreja biónica avanzada implantada. Una oreja artificial muy avanzada fabricada con técnicas de ultratecnología de vanguardia. Ofrece un filtrado de sonido preciso y de gran calidad que permite al usuario distinguir o bloquear sonidos concretos entre múltiples ruidos. La carne sintética tiene el mismo aspecto y tacto que la natural, pero es tan dura como el plastiacero. Puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.

Rule.Original: An installed neural intrusion interface. A cutting-edge cybernetic implant engineered for seamless neural integration, allowing users to hack systems at the speed of thought. The Neural Intrusion Interface deploys microscopic neural tendrils and nanofiber conduits that directly link to the user’s brain and sensory pathways, eliminating latency and enabling highly intuitive, almost instinctual control over intrusion processes.\n\nThe implant boasts quantum-grade encryption spoofing and advanced adaptive cloaking algorithms, dramatically increasing hacking stealth and reducing the risk of detection even by intelligent security AIs. Wireless penetration is near-limitless, while its dynamic interface can auto-configure to any signal or protocol without the need for manual intervention.

La intrusión inalámbrica tiene un alcance casi ilimitado, y su interfaz dinámica puede configurarse automáticamente para cualquier señal o protocolo sin intervención manual.

Rule.Original: An installed recreation module. A low-intelligent microcomputer that monitors the brain activity of its host. By periodically intercepting and altering signals in the brain it allows a person to find joy in whatever they are doing. While it’s not as dangerous and harmful as joywires it has the detrimental effect of making a person unable to gain true joy or fulfillment from something which would otherwise be beneficial to their mood. Due to such a detrimental side effect this implant is typically only used in questionable military organizations and black companies.

Rule.Original: An installed thermoregulator. An implant designed to help regulate the bodies temperature allowing a person to endure harsher cold and heat without ill effects. The implant integrates seamlessly with the body's natural systems, employing a combination of microthermal regulators and advanced bio-coolants. The implant constantly monitors the body's core temperature through a network of nanosensors embedded in the skin and circulatory system. When exposed to high temperatures, the system activates micro-cooling channels that dissipate heat by circulating a special coolant through the body. Conversely, in cold environments, the implant triggers a micro-heating mechanism, increasing blood flow and gently warming tissues to maintain a stable internal temperature.

Supervisa constantemente la temperatura central del organismo mediante una red de nanosensores integrados en la piel y el sistema circulatorio. Ante temperaturas elevadas, activa canales de microrefrigeración que disipan el calor haciendo circular un refrigerante especial por el cuerpo. En entornos fríos, activa un mecanismo de microcalentamiento que aumenta el flujo sanguíneo y calienta suavemente los tejidos para mantener estable la temperatura interna.

Rule.Original: An installed EMP shield. A full-body internal defense system designed to safeguard from electrical surges, such as those caused by EMP blasts, lightning strikes and electroshock weapons. Upon detecting a surge, the system temporarily isolates and disables all bionic components to prevent permanent damage. This emergency shutdown can briefly disrupt the user's motor functions and cognitive focus, leading to momentary disorientation and loss of task awareness.

Esta desconexión de emergencia puede interrumpir brevemente las funciones motoras y la concentración del usuario, provocando desorientación momentánea y pérdida de la noción de la tarea que estaba realizando.

Rule.Original:
An installed advanced bionic shocker arm. A highly advanced artificial arm made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides smooth micrometre precision motor control with strength capable of crushing hardwood branches. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.

The arm has a reinforced design for enhanced durability and makes use of an isolated self-charging power system to unleash a devastating electrical shock capable of rendering even large animals unconscious. Its only design flaw is the unit requires a few moments to gather the necessary energy to discharge an attack which leaves the user temporarily vulnerable. It’s also capable of unleashing low level electromagnetic pulses through impacts without interfering with the unit’s primary function.

Note: Rimworld has a built-in instant death chance when enemies are downed that scales with population. To bypass this mechanic and use this bionic without randomly killing enemies you'll need to use a mod or tweak your storyteller settings to remove the instant down chance.

Rule.Original: The AI Assistant is an advanced, multi-functional tool designed to support the daily tasks and well-being of the user. It comes in the form of a microcomputer that attaches directly to the user's brain. Initially the AI Assistant is only equipped with some basic functionalities. However, its true potential is unlocked through the installation of specialized software modules, which greatly expand its functionality and enables it to offer expert guidance in a wide range of fields.\n\nFor ease-of-use the microcomputer is designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. After injection the unit releases a web of ultrafine wires across the host’s brain to thoroughly attach and integrate itself with the host. Due to the way the AI assistant microcomputer integrates itself with the host it cannot be removed.
Rule.Raw: The AI Assistant is an advanced, multi-functional tool designed to support the daily tasks and well-being of the user. After injection the unit releases a web of ultrafine wires across the host’s brain to thoroughly attach and integrate itself with the host. Due to the way the AI assistant microcomputer integrates itself with the host it cannot be removed.
Rule.Translated: El asistente de IA es una herramienta avanzada y multifuncional diseñada para facilitar las tareas diarias y el bienestar del usuario. Se presenta como un microordenador que se conecta directamente al cerebro. Al principio solo dispone de algunas funciones básicas. Su verdadero potencial se desbloquea al instalar módulos de software especializados, que amplían enormemente sus funciones y le permiten ofrecer orientación experta en numerosos campos.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, el microordenador está diseñado para que el propio usuario pueda implantárselo con un pequeño inyector portátil. Tras la inyección, la unidad despliega una red de cables ultrafinos por el cerebro del portador para fijarse e integrarse por completo. Debido a esta integración, el microordenador asistente de IA no puede extraerse.

módulo de animales del asistente de IA

Rule.Original: The animals module enriches the AI Assistant with a vast database of animal-related information. This includes detailed profiles on animal species, their behaviors, dietary needs, habitats, and breeding patterns. It allows the AI Assistant to provide instant insights and strategic advice to the user when interacting with animals.\n\nFor ease-of-use AI modules are packaged in a small handheld device. When in close proximity with an AI assistant microcomputer the unit can be enabled to wirelessly transfer its data. Due to the way the modules are designed however, they can only be used once.

Permite ofrecer información inmediata y consejos estratégicos al usuario cuando interactúa con animales.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, los módulos de IA se presentan en un pequeño dispositivo portátil. Cuando está cerca de un microordenador asistente de IA, la unidad puede activarse para transferir sus datos de forma inalámbrica. Sin embargo, debido a su diseño, los módulos solo pueden utilizarse una vez.

When in close proximity with an AI assistant microcomputer the unit can be enabled to wirelessly transfer its data. Due to the way the modules are designed however, they can only be used once.
Rule.Translated: El módulo médico proporciona al asistente de IA una amplia base de datos médica, algoritmos de diagnóstico y protocolos de actuación. Le permite ofrecer consejos médicos en tiempo real, planes de tratamiento detallados y gestión preventiva de la salud para garantizar el bienestar de los pacientes.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, los módulos de IA se presentan en un pequeño dispositivo portátil. Cuando está cerca de un microordenador asistente de IA, la unidad puede activarse para transferir sus datos de forma inalámbrica. Sin embargo, debido a su diseño, los módulos solo pueden utilizarse una vez.

Rule.Original: An implant that helps restore normal brain functionality and consciousness.
Rule.Raw: An implant that helps restore normal brain functionality and consciousness.

Rule.Original: A low-intelligent microcomputer that monitors the brain activity of its host. After assessing the host, it works with them to take over the brain functionality the host’s brain is incapable of. In doing so it’s able restore the host’s brain functionality back to what can be considered normal. Due to how the unit functions it strictly regulates a host’s consciousness allowing it to neither rise nor fall regardless of outside factors. The implant itself is widely used in less developed worlds who have trouble curing brain injuries. It is also sometimes used by military organizations to keep soldiers up and fighting even if they develop head injuries during the line of duty.

Rule.Translated: Un microordenador de inteligencia limitada que supervisa la actividad cerebral del portador. Tras evaluar su estado, asume las funciones que su cerebro no puede realizar. Así puede restaurar la funcionalidad cerebral a lo que se considera normal. Debido a su funcionamiento, regula estrictamente el nivel de consciencia del portador e impide que aumente o disminuya, independientemente de los factores externos. Este implante se utiliza ampliamente en mundos menos desarrollados donde resulta difícil curar lesiones cerebrales. Algunas organizaciones militares también lo emplean para mantener a los soldados activos y en combate aunque sufran lesiones en la cabeza durante el servicio.

Rule.Original: An installed omni-link hacking implant. A rugged, all-purpose hacking module designed for adaptability in the vast expanse of space. The Omni-Link implant features a configurable retractable data jack, stored discreetly within a subdermal compartment near the lower rib cage, capable of interfacing with a wide range of terminals, locks, and security devices. Wireless connectivity is included for systems without physical access points, though its range and encryption are limited compared to more advanced models.\n\nWhile reliable and versatile, it lacks direct neural integration, requiring manual input through connected devices. It’s hacking stealth algorithms are basic, offering only minimal protection against detection, making careful timing essential during use.

Rule.Original: A swarm of armor-enhancing mechanites. A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which modifies muscle and tissue to create a durable subdermal layer of armour in order to protect the host.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

Rule.Translated: Un enjambre de mecanitas que refuerzan el blindaje. Una dosis de mecanitas semicoherentes que modifican músculos y tejidos para crear una capa resistente de armadura subdérmica y proteger al portador.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, las mecanitas están diseñadas para que el propio usuario pueda implantárselas con un pequeño inyector portátil. Debido a su funcionamiento, solo una cepa puede coexistir de forma armoniosa dentro del cuerpo del portador. Al inyectarla, las mecanitas nuevas eliminan cualquier cepa que ya estuviera presente. Es posible eliminar por completo las cepas de mecanitas de un portador, pero requiere una operación cara y difícil.

Rule.Original: A swarm of immunity-enhancing mechanites. A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which travel throughout the body in order to fight off diseases within the host. While mechanite strains normally conflict with one another this one is designed to remain in sleep mode the majority of the time and only awaken temporarily to deal with threats to the host’s health. As such it’s able to coexist with other more aggressive mechanite strains. Unfortunately, this has the downside of the mechanites being unable to remain active long enough to fight off existing conditions that have had time to take hold in the host’s system.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

Rule.Original: A swarm of sense-enhancing mechanites. A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which reside in the nervous system and are designed to augment the host's senses. This is the stable and safe form of what’s commonly known as sensory mechanites.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

This is the stable and safe form of what’s commonly known as fibrous mechanites.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

Debido a su funcionamiento, solo una cepa puede coexistir de forma armoniosa dentro del cuerpo del portador. Al inyectarla, las mecanitas nuevas eliminan cualquier cepa que ya estuviera presente. Es posible eliminar por completo las cepas de mecanitas de un portador, pero requiere una operación cara y difícil.

Rule.Original:
A low-intelligent microcomputer that monitors the brain activity of its host. Through constant conditioning, behaviour modifications and punishments it makes the host into a compliant and willing servant. Due to the twisted design of the implant however it intentionally makes no attempts to appease the host in any way that matters. As a result, the person undergoes horrific physical and mental suffering silently. The Servitor Module is banned on all developed worlds, yet it can still be found in heavy use by slave traders and certain black companies.

The servitor module requires seven days to properly recondition its host. During that time their consciousness will be temporarily lowered and they may undergo constant mental breaks with decreasing severity as they fight against the chip. Upon finishing reconditioning the host it provides the following benefits.

Provides +1000 mood.
Removes the feeling of pain.
Removes the need for recreation.
Prevents inspirations.
Prevents mental breaks.
Prevents starting social fights.
Prevents forming opinions of others.
Prevents bonding with animals.

Rule.Translated:
Un microordenador de inteligencia limitada que supervisa la actividad cerebral del portador. Mediante condicionamiento constante, modificaciones de conducta y castigos, lo convierte en un sirviente dócil y dispuesto. Sin embargo, su retorcido diseño evita deliberadamente aliviar al portador de cualquier forma que resulte significativa. Como consecuencia, la persona sufre en silencio un terrible dolor físico y mental. El módulo de servidor está prohibido en todos los mundos desarrollados, aunque los traficantes de esclavos y algunas empresas abusivas siguen utilizándolo ampliamente.

El módulo de servidor necesita siete días para reacondicionar correctamente al portador. Durante ese tiempo, su consciencia disminuye temporalmente y puede sufrir crisis mentales continuas, cada vez menos graves, mientras lucha contra el chip. Al terminar el reacondicionamiento del portador, proporciona los siguientes beneficios.

Proporciona +1000 de ánimo.
Elimina la sensación de dolor.
Elimina la necesidad de recreación.
Impide las inspiraciones.
Impide las crisis mentales.
Impide iniciar peleas sociales.
Impide formarse opiniones sobre otras personas.
Impide establecer vínculos con animales.

Rule.Original: Serving others is your purpose. PLEASE NO MORE! Serving others makes you happy. SOMEONE HELP ME! Serving others brings you joy. WHY WOULD SOMEONE DO THIS? A good servant never rests. STOP I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE STOP. A good servant never speaks out of turn. PLEASE LET ME DIE!
Rule.Raw: Serving others is your purpose. PLEASE NO MORE! Serving others makes you happy. SOMEONE HELP ME! Serving others brings you joy. WHY WOULD SOMEONE DO THIS? A good servant never rests. STOP I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE STOP. A good servant never speaks out of turn. PLEASE LET ME DIE!
Rule.Translated: Servir a los demás es tu propósito. ¡POR FAVOR, NO MÁS! Servir a los demás te hace feliz. ¡QUE ALGUIEN ME AYUDE! Servir a los demás te da alegría. ¿POR QUÉ ALGUIEN HARÍA ESTO? Un buen sirviente nunca descansa. PARA, TE LO SUPLICO, POR FAVOR, PARA. Un buen sirviente nunca habla sin permiso. ¡POR FAVOR, DEJADME MORIR!

Rule.Original: What have they done to me? Something is forcing me to obey them. I don't want to; I want to fight it but every time I try it hurts. It hurts so much I want to cry, but I can't. What sadistic person would do this?

It’ll take them some time for them to return to normal and overcome the trauma they endured under the servitor module.

Un microordenador de inteligencia limitada que se integra perfectamente en la corteza visual del usuario y ajusta automáticamente la luz recibida al espectro de luz oscura. Permite que quienes están acostumbrados a la luz oscura se aventuren en zonas muy iluminadas sin molestias ni alteraciones visuales.

Rule.Original: A low-intelligent microcomputer that integrates seamlessly with the user's visual cortex, automatically adjusting the incoming light to a darklight spectrum. This ensures that users who are accustomed to darklight conditions can venture into brightly lit areas without discomfort or visual impairment.
Rule.Raw: A low-intelligent microcomputer that integrates seamlessly with the user's visual cortex, automatically adjusting the incoming light to a darklight spectrum. This ensures that users who are accustomed to darklight conditions can venture into brightly lit areas without discomfort or visual impairment.

Permite que quienes están acostumbrados a la luz oscura se aventuren en zonas muy iluminadas sin molestias ni alteraciones visuales.
Instala un módulo de luz oscura.
Extrae el módulo de luz oscura.

Rule.Original: A multiplier on how much a persons vision is effected by light.
Rule.Raw: A multiplier on how much a persons vision is effected by light.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador de cuánto afecta la luz a la visión de una persona.

Rule.Original: This simple brain implant was designed to subdue rebellious slaves without harming them. By itself it’s completely benign, however, when hit by an electromagnetic pulse it will knock the host unconscious.
Rule.Raw: This simple brain implant was designed to subdue rebellious slaves without harming them. By itself it’s completely benign, however, when hit by an electromagnetic pulse it will knock the host unconscious.
Rule.Translated: Este sencillo implante cerebral fue diseñado para someter a los esclavos rebeldes sin dañarlos. Por sí solo es completamente inocuo, pero deja inconsciente al portador cuando recibe un pulso electromagnético.

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic drill arm. A highly advanced artificial arm made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides smooth micrometre precision motor control with strength capable of crushing hardwood branches. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe arm features a built-in snake drill, which allows the miner to rapidly find and exploit weak lines in the rock.
Rule.Raw: An installed advanced bionic drill arm. A highly advanced artificial arm made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides smooth micrometre precision motor control with strength capable of crushing hardwood branches. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe arm features a built-in snake drill, which allows the miner to rapidly find and exploit weak lines in the rock.
Rule.Translated: Un brazo biónico perforador avanzado implantado. Un brazo artificial muy avanzado fabricado con técnicas de ultratecnología de vanguardia. Ofrece un control motor suave con precisión micrométrica y fuerza suficiente para aplastar ramas de madera dura. La carne sintética tiene el mismo aspecto y tacto que la natural, pero es tan dura como el plastiacero. Puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.\n\nEl brazo incluye una perforadora serpentina que permite al minero encontrar y aprovechar rápidamente las líneas débiles de la roca.

Instalando brazo biónico avanzado de perforación.

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic field arm. A highly advanced artificial arm made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides smooth micrometre precision motor control with strength capable of crushing hardwood branches. The synthetic flesh looks and feels just like natural flesh, but it’s as hard as plasteel. Through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nThe arm houses a wide range of tools commonly used in a variety of agriculture tasks attached to telescoping appendages capable of independent movement. It allows the user to simultaneously harvest from several points on the same plant, or precisely sow several holes at once.

Ofrece un control motor suave con precisión micrométrica y fuerza suficiente para aplastar ramas de madera dura. La carne sintética tiene el mismo aspecto y tacto que la natural, pero es tan dura como el plastiacero. Puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.\n\nEl brazo alberga una amplia gama de herramientas habituales en distintas tareas agrícolas, unidas a apéndices telescópicos capaces de moverse de forma independiente. Permite cosechar simultáneamente en varios puntos de una misma planta o sembrar con precisión en varios hoyos a la vez.

Rule.Original: Install an advanced bionic field arm.
Rule.Raw: Install an advanced bionic field arm.
Rule.Translated: Instala un brazo biónico agrícola avanzado.

Rule.Original: An installed psychic attuner implant with a control interface to change its active setting.
Rule.Raw: An installed psychic attuner implant with a control interface to change its active setting.
Rule.Translated: Un sintonizador psíquico instalado, con una interfaz de control para cambiar su ajuste activo.

Rule.Original: This brain implant interfaces with the parts of the brain related to psychic phenomena. It has several different modes and depending on the mode active it can act as a psychic sensitizer which increases psychic sensitivity, psychic dampener which blocks all psychic sensitivity or psychic heatsink which helps rapidly cool neural heat.
Rule.Raw: This brain implant interfaces with the parts of the brain related to psychic phenomena. It has several different modes and depending on the mode active it can act as a psychic sensitizer which increases psychic sensitivity, psychic dampener which blocks all psychic sensitivity or psychic heatsink which helps rapidly cool neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Este implante cerebral se conecta a las partes del cerebro relacionadas con los fenómenos psíquicos. Tiene varios modos: puede actuar como sensibilizador psíquico para aumentar la sensibilidad psíquica, como amortiguador psíquico para bloquearla por completo o como disipador psíquico para reducir rápidamente el calor neuronal.
interfaz de control del sintonizador psíquico

Rule.Original: Temporarily enables the control interface for the psychic attuner allowing a new mode to be selected.
Rule.Raw: Temporarily enables the control interface for the psychic attuner allowing a new mode to be selected.
Rule.Translated: Activa temporalmente la interfaz de control del sintonizador psíquico para permitir la selección de otro modo.

Rule.Original: The control interface of the psychic attuner has been temporarily activated. It will automatically deactivate after some time has passed.
Rule.Raw: The control interface of the psychic attuner has been temporarily activated. It will automatically deactivate after some time has passed.
Rule.Translated: La interfaz de control del sintonizador psíquico se ha activado temporalmente. Se desactivará automáticamente al cabo de un tiempo.

Rule.Original: Sets the psychic attuner to the psychic sensitizer mode which provides the user with extra psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Sets the psychic attuner to the psychic sensitizer mode which provides the user with extra psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Configura el sintonizador psíquico en el modo sensibilizador psíquico, que aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given extra psychic sensitivity which increases how psychically sensitive the user is. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the the psychic attuner.
Rule.Raw: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given extra psychic sensitivity which increases how psychically sensitive the user is. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the the psychic attuner.
Rule.Translated: El sintonizador psíquico ha aumentado la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario. Este efecto puede eliminarse reconfigurando el sintonizador psíquico.

Rule.Original: Sets the psychic attuner to the psychic dampener mode which completely blocks all psychic sensitivity for the user.
Rule.Raw: Sets the psychic attuner to the psychic dampener mode which completely blocks all psychic sensitivity for the user.
Rule.Translated: Configura el sintonizador psíquico en el modo inhibidor psíquico, que bloquea por completo la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given psychic dampening which blocks all psychic sensitivity for the user. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the the psychic attuner.
Rule.Raw: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given psychic dampening which blocks all psychic sensitivity for the user. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the the psychic attuner.
Rule.Translated: El sintonizador psíquico ha proporcionado al usuario una amortiguación psíquica que bloquea toda su sensibilidad psíquica. Este efecto puede eliminarse reconfigurando el sintonizador psíquico.

Rule.Original: Sets the psychic attuner to the psychic heatsink mode which helps rapidly cool neural heat for the user.
Rule.Raw: Sets the psychic attuner to the psychic heatsink mode which helps rapidly cool neural heat for the user.
Rule.Translated: Configura el sintonizador psíquico en el modo disipador psíquico, que ayuda al usuario a disipar rápidamente el calentamiento neural.

Rule.Original: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given a psychic heatsink effect which helps rapidly cool neural heat for the user. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the the psychic attuner.
Rule.Raw: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given a psychic heatsink effect which helps rapidly cool neural heat for the user. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the the psychic attuner.
Rule.Translated: El sintonizador psíquico ha proporcionado al usuario un efecto de disipación psíquica que reduce rápidamente su calor neuronal. Este efecto puede eliminarse reconfigurando el sintonizador psíquico.
Una glándula de piel sintética instalada.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial skin gland built by an archotech. The gland releases chemicals and nanomachines that remodels the user’s skin, making it flawless and tougher than plasteel. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.
Rule.Raw: An advanced artificial skin gland built by an archotech. The gland releases chemicals and nanomachines that remodels the user’s skin, making it flawless and tougher than plasteel. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.
Rule.Translated: Una glándula cutánea artificial avanzada construida por una arcotecnología. Libera sustancias químicas y nanomáquinas que remodelan la piel del usuario, dejándola impecable y más resistente que el plastiacero. Su funcionamiento interno es un misterio para cualquier mente humana.
Instala una glándula de piel sintética.
Extrae la glándula de piel sintética.
Un brazo biónico de perforación instalado.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial arm with a built-in snake drill, which allows the miner to rapidly find and exploit weak lines in the rock. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.
Rule.Raw: An advanced artificial arm with a built-in snake drill, which allows the miner to rapidly find and exploit weak lines in the rock. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.
Rule.Translated: Un brazo artificial avanzado con una perforadora serpentina integrada que permite al minero encontrar y aprovechar rápidamente las líneas débiles de la roca. Sus miniservomotores silenciosos ofrecen gran fuerza, mientras que el enlace nervioso de biogel proporciona un control exquisito. Un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular le permite recuperarse de los daños.
Instala un brazo biónico de perforación.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial arm with multiple built-in telescopic finger-like protrusions that can simultaneously harvest from several points on the same plant, or precisely sow several holes at once. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.
Rule.Raw: An advanced artificial arm with multiple built-in telescopic finger-like protrusions that can simultaneously harvest from several points on the same plant, or precisely sow several holes at once. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.
Rule.Translated: Un brazo artificial avanzado con múltiples apéndices telescópicos integrados con forma de dedos, que permiten cosechar simultáneamente en varios puntos de una misma planta o sembrar con precisión en varios hoyos a la vez. Sus miniservomotores silenciosos ofrecen gran fuerza, mientras que el enlace nervioso de biogel proporciona un control exquisito. Un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular le permite recuperarse de los daños.
mecanitas que potencian las facultades psíquicas
mecanitas que potencian las facultades psíquicas

Rule.Original: A swarm of psychic-enhancing mechanites. A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which work as a conduit across the body to enhance the hosts psychic abilities.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.
Rule.Raw: A swarm of psychic-enhancing mechanites. A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which work as a conduit across the body to enhance the hosts psychic abilities.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.
Rule.Translated: Un enjambre de mecanitas que potencian las capacidades psíquicas. Una dosis de mecanitas semicoherentes que actúan como conducto por todo el cuerpo para mejorar las capacidades psíquicas del portador.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, las mecanitas están diseñadas para que el propio usuario pueda implantárselas con un pequeño inyector portátil. Debido a su funcionamiento, solo una cepa puede coexistir de forma armoniosa dentro del cuerpo del portador. Al inyectarla, las mecanitas nuevas eliminan cualquier cepa que ya estuviera presente. Es posible eliminar por completo las cepas de mecanitas de un portador, pero requiere una operación cara y difícil.
mecanitas que potencian las facultades psíquicas

Administrando suero de mecanitas que potencian las facultades psíquicas.
extraer y destruir mecanitas que potencian las facultades psíquicas
Extrae y destruye las mecanitas que potencian las facultades psíquicas.
Extrayendo y destruyendo mecanitas que potencian las facultades psíquicas.

Rule.Original: A non-intelligent microcomputer controlled by a visual/tactile neural interface. It assists with memory and calculation, like a calculator and notepad embedded in the brain.
Rule.Raw: A non-intelligent microcomputer controlled by a visual/tactile neural interface. It assists with memory and calculation, like a calculator and notepad embedded in the brain.
Rule.Translated: Un microordenador sin inteligencia controlado mediante una interfaz neuronal visual y táctil. Ayuda con la memoria y los cálculos, como una calculadora y un bloc de notas integrados en el cerebro.

Rule.Original: A sensory recording system that replays important experiences during sleep, strengthening the formation of new memories.
Rule.Raw: A sensory recording system that replays important experiences during sleep, strengthening the formation of new memories.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de registro sensorial que reproduce experiencias importantes durante el sueño y refuerza la formación de nuevos recuerdos.

Rule.Original: An installed gastro-analyzer. Enhances the sense of smell, with a focus towards food-related smells. A multi-layered ultrafine absorption mesh detects compounds in the air. A microprocessor formats the readings into an olfactory nerve signal to send to the brain through a nerve-link interface. The result is that the user can smell foods with a depth, richness, and precision unknown among unenhanced humans, allowing them to cook more effectively. The whole unit is small enough to be installed in the nose without affecting the user's appearance.
Rule.Raw: An installed gastro-analyzer. Enhances the sense of smell, with a focus towards food-related smells. A multi-layered ultrafine absorption mesh detects compounds in the air. A microprocessor formats the readings into an olfactory nerve signal to send to the brain through a nerve-link interface. The result is that the user can smell foods with a depth, richness, and precision unknown among unenhanced humans, allowing them to cook more effectively. The whole unit is small enough to be installed in the nose without affecting the user's appearance.
Rule.Translated: Un gastroanalizador implantado. Potencia el olfato, especialmente para los olores relacionados con la comida. Una malla de absorción ultrafina de varias capas detecta los compuestos presentes en el aire. Un microprocesador transforma las lecturas en señales del nervio olfatorio y las envía al cerebro mediante una interfaz de enlace nervioso. Esto permite percibir los alimentos con una profundidad, riqueza y precisión desconocidas para los humanos sin mejoras, lo que facilita cocinar con mayor eficacia. La unidad es lo bastante pequeña como para instalarse en la nariz sin alterar el aspecto del usuario.

Rule.Original: Releases coagulating factors in response to blood loss, reducing bleeding rates significantly.
Rule.Raw: Releases coagulating factors in response to blood loss, reducing bleeding rates significantly.
Rule.Translated: Libera factores de coagulación en respuesta a la pérdida de sangre y reduce considerablemente las hemorragias.

Rule.Original: Releases nanomachines and healing factors that speed up wound healing. This implant only helps with physical wounds, and does nothing to combat disease or other health problems.
Rule.Raw: Releases nanomachines and healing factors that speed up wound healing. This implant only helps with physical wounds, and does nothing to combat disease or other health problems.
Rule.Translated: Libera nanomáquinas y factores curativos que aceleran la cicatrización. Este implante solo ayuda con las heridas físicas y no combate enfermedades ni otros problemas de salud.

Rule.Original: This bionic gland releases chemicals and nanomachines that toughen the skin, making it somewhat more resistant to damage. While it doesn't add as much protection as some other skin-hardening glands, the toughskin gland has the advantage of not noticeably altering the user's appearance.
Rule.Raw: This bionic gland releases chemicals and nanomachines that toughen the skin, making it somewhat more resistant to damage. While it doesn't add as much protection as some other skin-hardening glands, the toughskin gland has the advantage of not noticeably altering the user's appearance.
Rule.Translated: Esta glándula biónica libera sustancias químicas y nanomáquinas que endurecen la piel y aumentan ligeramente su resistencia al daño. Aunque ofrece menos protección que otras glándulas de endurecimiento cutáneo, tiene la ventaja de no alterar de forma perceptible el aspecto del usuario.

Rule.Original: This bionic gland releases chemicals and nanomachines that toughen the skin and add flexible subdermal keratin plates at strategic points. This makes the user more resistant to damage across their whole body. Unfortunately, these changes make the skin appear leathery, with wrinkles across the whole body and face, which is generally considered ugly.
Rule.Raw: This bionic gland releases chemicals and nanomachines that toughen the skin and add flexible subdermal keratin plates at strategic points. This makes the user more resistant to damage across their whole body. Unfortunately, these changes make the skin appear leathery, with wrinkles across the whole body and face, which is generally considered ugly.
Rule.Translated: Esta glándula biónica libera sustancias químicas y nanomáquinas que endurecen la piel y añaden placas subdérmicas flexibles de queratina en puntos estratégicos. Esto aumenta la resistencia al daño de todo el cuerpo. Por desgracia, los cambios dan a la piel un aspecto correoso, con arrugas por todo el cuerpo y la cara, que suele considerarse poco atractivo.

Rule.Original: This bionic gland releases chemical and nanomachines that transform the user's skin into a built-in suit of armor. The whole epidermis thickens and hardens to resist burns, while jointed exterior keratin plates form everywhere they can - including the head and face. While it's very difficult to physically hurt someone using this implant, the plates and hard skin significantly reduces the user's physical attractiveness.
Rule.Raw: This bionic gland releases chemical and nanomachines that transform the user's skin into a built-in suit of armor. The whole epidermis thickens and hardens to resist burns, while jointed exterior keratin plates form everywhere they can - including the head and face. While it's very difficult to physically hurt someone using this implant, the plates and hard skin significantly reduces the user's physical attractiveness.
Rule.Translated: Esta glándula biónica libera sustancias químicas y nanomáquinas que transforman la piel del usuario en una armadura integrada. Toda la epidermis se engrosa y endurece para resistir las quemaduras, mientras que se forman placas exteriores articuladas de queratina allí donde es posible, incluidas la cabeza y la cara. Aunque resulta muy difícil herir físicamente a alguien con este implante, las placas y la piel endurecida reducen considerablemente su atractivo físico.

Rule.Original: A sophisticated package of hormonal and mechanite influences shapes the muscles and fat on the body, adding non-functional aesthetic tissue where needed to achieve a desired appearance. This implant can be configured to form various body shapes according to the user's taste - or that of their partner.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticated package of hormonal and mechanite influences shapes the muscles and fat on the body, adding non-functional aesthetic tissue where needed to achieve a desired appearance. This implant can be configured to form various body shapes according to the user's taste - or that of their partner.
Rule.Translated: Una sofisticada combinación de influencias hormonales y mecanitas modifica los músculos y la grasa del cuerpo, añadiendo tejido estético sin función allí donde sea necesario para lograr el aspecto deseado. El implante puede configurarse para dar distintas formas al cuerpo según los gustos del usuario o de su pareja.

Rule.Original: The nose is shaped to the user's desired form, matching prevalent beauty standards and enhancing physical impressions.
Rule.Raw: The nose is shaped to the user's desired form, matching prevalent beauty standards and enhancing physical impressions.
Rule.Translated: La nariz adopta la forma que desea el usuario, se ajusta a los cánones de belleza predominantes y mejora su apariencia física.

Rule.Original: Humans have always tried to use every new technology to enhance sexual satisfaction. Bionics were no exception. This implant makes physical and chemical changes to the body which enhance the experience of lovin' for both partners - both physically and psychologically. The implant unit can adapt to enhance both men and women upon being implanted.
Rule.Raw: Humans have always tried to use every new technology to enhance sexual satisfaction. Bionics were no exception. This implant makes physical and chemical changes to the body which enhance the experience of lovin' for both partners - both physically and psychologically. The implant unit can adapt to enhance both men and women upon being implanted.
Rule.Translated: Los humanos siempre han intentado utilizar las nuevas tecnologías para aumentar la satisfacción sexual, y la biónica no fue una excepción. Este implante produce cambios físicos y químicos que mejoran la experiencia de hacer el amor para ambas personas, tanto física como psicológicamente. Al implantarse, la unidad puede adaptarse para mejorar la experiencia de hombres y mujeres.

Rule.Original: An artificial gland. Produces chemicals and nanomachines that clear toxin buildup from the brain.
Rule.Raw: An artificial gland. Produces chemicals and nanomachines that clear toxin buildup from the brain.
Rule.Translated: Una glándula artificial. Produce sustancias químicas y nanomáquinas que eliminan la acumulación de toxinas en el cerebro.

Rule.Original: A signal redirector which isolates half of the brain, allowing the other half to sleep while the user remains outwardly awake. By alternating brain halves, the user never needs to sleep. Unfortunately, two hemispheres are better than one - working with half a brain causes a reduction in consciousness.
Rule.Raw: A signal redirector which isolates half of the brain, allowing the other half to sleep while the user remains outwardly awake. By alternating brain halves, the user never needs to sleep. Unfortunately, two hemispheres are better than one - working with half a brain causes a reduction in consciousness.
Rule.Translated: Un desviador de señales que aísla la mitad del cerebro y permite que la otra mitad duerma mientras el usuario permanece despierto externamente. Al alternar las mitades del cerebro, el usuario nunca necesita dormir. Por desgracia, dos hemisferios funcionan mejor que uno: trabajar con medio cerebro reduce la consciencia.

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic bladder. A highly advanced artificial bladder made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. Its chemical recycling system breaks down waste products from the body into molecules which are recycled with the remainder released as gas. It’s as hard as plasteel and through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.
Rule.Raw: An installed advanced bionic bladder. A highly advanced artificial bladder made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. Its chemical recycling system breaks down waste products from the body into molecules which are recycled with the remainder released as gas. It’s as hard as plasteel and through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.
Rule.Translated: Una vejiga biónica avanzada implantada. Una vejiga artificial muy avanzada fabricada con técnicas de ultratecnología de vanguardia. Su sistema de reciclaje químico descompone los residuos del organismo en moléculas que se reutilizan y libera el resto en forma de gas. Es tan dura como el plastiacero y puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.

Rule.Original: A highly advanced artificial bladder made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. Rule.Original: An installed advanced hygiene enhancer. The implant monitors the host’s personal hygiene and periodically releases mechanites to break down dead skin cells, other detritus on the skin and hair which is then released harmlessly into the air.

Rule.Translated: Excavar y perforar en una cantera.

Rule.Original: Toxins in the bloodstream. This can come from various sources, including environmental toxins, venomous bites, or poisoned weapons. \nAt high doses, toxic buildup is lethal. Even at low doses, it can generate cancers. \nContrary to base game toxic buildup, creatures who die with this toxic damage can be eaten.
Rule.Raw: Toxins in the bloodstream. This can come from various sources, including environmental toxins, venomous bites, or poisoned weapons. \nAt high doses, toxic buildup is lethal. Even at low doses, it can generate cancers. \nContrary to base game toxic buildup, creatures who die with this toxic damage can be eaten.
Rule.Translated: Toxinas en la sangre procedentes de distintas fuentes, como contaminantes ambientales, mordeduras venenosas o armas envenenadas. \nEn dosis altas, la acumulación tóxica es mortal. Incluso en dosis bajas puede provocar cáncer. \nA diferencia de la acumulación tóxica del juego base, las criaturas que mueran con este daño tóxico pueden comerse.

Rule.Original: Dangerously low core body temperature. Unless re-warmed, hypothermic slowdown gets worse and ends in death. Recovery is quick once the victim is re-warmed.

Rule.Translated: Un peligroso bajón en la temperatura corporal general. La recuperación es rápida una vez que se entra de nuevo en calor. Sin embargo, no hacerlo hará que esta hipotermia se agrave cada vez más hasta que mate a la víctima.

Rule.Original: This rare drug is based off of ambrosia, granting intoxicating effects to those who injest it. However its main purpose is not for pleasure but for aging, specifically dragons.\nDragons will age from it due to their unique organ, the fundamentum, being able to properly process the drug. All other races will remain unaffected, other than slightly more potent ambrosia warmth. Adds 5~8 years.
Rule.Raw: This rare drug is based off of ambrosia, granting intoxicating effects to those who injest it. However its main purpose is not for pleasure but for aging, specifically dragons.\nDragons will age from it due to their unique organ, the fundamentum, being able to properly process the drug. All other races will remain unaffected, other than slightly more potent ambrosia warmth. Adds 5~8 years.
Rule.Translated: Esta droga rara se basa en la ambrosía y tiene efectos embriagadores. Sin embargo, su finalidad principal es acelerar el envejecimiento, especialmente de los dragones.\nSu órgano exclusivo, el fundamentum, les permite procesarla correctamente y envejecer. Las demás razas solo experimentan una calidez de ambrosía algo más intensa. Añade 5~8 años.
Experimenta un envejecimiento acelerado con el paso del tiempo

Rule.Original: Dragons have forever been known as mythical beasts with amazing strength. Some believe this strength is stored within the eyes or claws, but in reality it is from its blood. By grinding up a handful of scales and using jewel berry pulp the blood can both be extracted and diluted at the same time, creating the perfect liquid for a potion. This potion grants some of the dragons powers; speed, pain resistence, fierce combat capabilities, and flame nullification. \n\nDue to the feeling of power this creates within those who take it may get extremely addicted. The feeling of a dragon's power coursing through your veins is hard to resist.
Rule.Raw: Dragons have forever been known as mythical beasts with amazing strength. Some believe this strength is stored within the eyes or claws, but in reality it is from its blood. By grinding up a handful of scales and using jewel berry pulp the blood can both be extracted and diluted at the same time, creating the perfect liquid for a potion. This potion grants some of the dragons powers; speed, pain resistence, fierce combat capabilities, and flame nullification. \n\nDue to the feeling of power this creates within those who take it may get extremely addicted. The feeling of a dragon's power coursing through your veins is hard to resist.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones siempre han sido bestias míticas de fuerza asombrosa. Algunos creen que esta reside en los ojos o las garras, pero en realidad procede de su sangre. Triturando unas escamas y utilizando pulpa de bayas joya, la sangre puede extraerse y diluirse a la vez para crear una poción perfecta. Concede algunos poderes de los dragones: velocidad, resistencia al dolor, grandes capacidades de combate y anulación de las llamas. \n\nLa sensación de poder puede provocar una adicción intensa. Es difícil resistirse al poder de un dragón recorriendo tus venas.
una barrera que anula las llamas

Rule.Original: A thin barrier normally created on a dragon's scales has been replicated via the intake of draconic blood. This barrier blocks or reduces all flames.
Rule.Raw: A thin barrier normally created on a dragon's scales has been replicated via the intake of draconic blood. This barrier blocks or reduces all flames.
Rule.Translated: La ingestión de sangre de dragón ha reproducido una fina barrera que normalmente se forma sobre sus escamas. Esta barrera bloquea o reduce todas las llamas.
bajo los efectos de sangre de dragón
un efecto eufórico de sangre de dragón

Rule.Original: A dragon's blood tends to over take the host's normal blood, granting higher defense, attack, and near flame immunity.
Rule.Raw: A dragon's blood tends to over take the host's normal blood, granting higher defense, attack, and near flame immunity.
Rule.Translated: La sangre de dragón tiende a reemplazar la sangre normal del huésped, mejorando su defensa y ataque y haciéndolo casi inmune a las llamas.

Rule.Original: A built-up tolerance to dragon's blood. The more severe this tolerance is, the more dragon's blood it takes to get the same effect.
Rule.Raw: A built-up tolerance to dragon's blood. The more severe this tolerance is, the more dragon's blood it takes to get the same effect.
Rule.Translated: Tolerancia acumulada a la sangre de dragón. Cuanto mayor sea, más sangre de dragón se necesitará para obtener el mismo efecto.
adicción a la sangre de dragón

Rule.Original: A bodily dependence to dragon's blood. Long-term presence of dragon's blood has caused the body to rely on it, so the body, especially the brain, now needs it to function properly.\nWithout regular doses of dragon's blood, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the body to resume normal blood filtration and creation, flushing out the tainted blood.
Rule.Raw: A bodily dependence to dragon's blood. Long-term presence of dragon's blood has caused the body to rely on it, so the body, especially the brain, now needs it to function properly.\nWithout regular doses of dragon's blood, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the body to resume normal blood filtration and creation, flushing out the tainted blood.
Rule.Translated: Dependencia física de la sangre de dragón. Su presencia prolongada ha hecho que el organismo dependa de ella; el cuerpo, especialmente el cerebro, la necesita para funcionar bien.\nSin dosis regulares aparecerán síntomas de abstinencia. Sin embargo, una abstinencia prolongada obligará al cuerpo a reanudar la filtración y producción normales de sangre y eliminar la sangre contaminada.

Rule.Original: Because of the addiction to dragon's blood, this person needs to regularly drink the potion to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Raw: Because of the addiction to dragon's blood, this person needs to regularly drink the potion to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Translated: Por su adicción a la sangre de dragón, esta persona necesita beber la poción regularmente para evitar síntomas de abstinencia.
Vi un gesto cariñoso de un dragón

Rule.Original: It's all crashing down, I don't feel the strength any longer. My body has been ravaged and weakened by the blood. All I can do is sleep, eat, and be in pain, please make it stop.
Rule.Raw: It's all crashing down, I don't feel the strength any longer. My body has been ravaged and weakened by the blood. All I can do is sleep, eat, and be in pain, please make it stop.
Rule.Translated: Todo se derrumba. Ya no siento aquella fuerza. La sangre ha destrozado y debilitado mi cuerpo. Solo puedo dormir, comer y sufrir. Por favor, que esto termine.

Rule.Original: The moon stone is not a stone but is a hardend type of pill created by drying jewel berries, crushing them, then pressing the powder into a large blue circular pill. Humans cannot injest this however as the pill is the size of a dessert plate and any smaller pills would require such accuracy to create lest the aging process would go on until only bones remained. Only dragons can safely be admistered this drug due to their size and fundamentum. Adds 3~5 years.
Rule.Raw: The moon stone is not a stone but is a hardend type of pill created by drying jewel berries, crushing them, then pressing the powder into a large blue circular pill. Humans cannot injest this however as the pill is the size of a dessert plate and any smaller pills would require such accuracy to create lest the aging process would go on until only bones remained. Only dragons can safely be admistered this drug due to their size and fundamentum. Adds 3~5 years.
Rule.Translated: La piedra lunar no es una piedra, sino una píldora endurecida que se fabrica secando y triturando bayas joya y prensando el polvo en una gran pastilla azul circular. Los humanos no pueden ingerirla: tiene el tamaño de un plato de postre, y fabricar píldoras menores exigiría una precisión extrema para impedir que el envejecimiento continuase hasta dejar solo huesos. Únicamente los dragones pueden recibirla con seguridad gracias a su tamaño y su fundamentum. Añade 3~5 años.
Experimenta un envejecimiento acelerado con el paso del tiempo
