Rule.Original: A reduction in the normal blood volume. Minor blood loss has relatively mild effects, but when blood loss becomes severe, oxygen transport becomes badly impaired and the victim loses the ability to move. Extreme blood loss leads to death.\nBlood loss naturally recovers over time as the body slowly regenerates its blood supply.
Rule.Raw: A reduction in the normal blood volume. Minor blood loss has relatively mild effects, but when blood loss becomes severe, oxygen transport becomes badly impaired and the victim loses the ability to move. Extreme blood loss leads to death.\nBlood loss naturally recovers over time as the body slowly regenerates its blood supply.
Rule.Translated: Reducción del volumen normal de sangre. Una pérdida leve tiene efectos relativamente pequeños, pero una pérdida grave dificulta mucho el transporte de oxígeno y deja a la víctima incapaz de moverse. Una pérdida extrema causa la muerte.\nLa sangre se recupera naturalmente con el tiempo a medida que el cuerpo la regenera.

Rule.Raw: This will destroy the target map (if it exists) and kill all pawns currently on it.\n
Rule.Translated: Esto destruirá el mapa objetivo, si existe, y matará a todos los peones que estén en él.\n

Rule.Original: You have done it, you escaped capture for your crimes. Now in possession of a dragon egg you must prepare for its arrival, or simply sell it off. Thieves have to survive somehow. \n\nNote: Since you'll start poor and lack technology, this is a difficult scenario.
Rule.Raw: You have done it, you escaped capture for your crimes. Now in possession of a dragon egg you must prepare for its arrival, or simply sell it off. Thieves have to survive somehow. \n\nNote: Since you'll start poor and lack technology, this is a difficult scenario.
Rule.Translated: Lo has conseguido: has escapado de la captura por tus crímenes. Ahora tienes un huevo de dragón y debes prepararte para su llegada, o simplemente venderlo. Los ladrones tienen que sobrevivir de alguna forma. \n\nNota: comenzarás con pocos recursos y tecnología, por lo que es un escenario difícil.

Rule.Original: Four runaway tribesmen with a very valuable egg. Difficult.
Rule.Raw: Four runaway tribesmen with a very valuable egg. Difficult.
Rule.Translated: Cuatro miembros de una tribu fugitivos con un huevo muy valioso. Difícil.

Rule.Original: You and your cronies had successfully snuck into the sacred temple; knowing from rumours something very valuable was hidden inside. Once the guards were alerted of your prescence you had no choice but to hide and take what you could get, or else suffer the consequences of attempted theft. When you finally escaped pursuit you decided to see what you managed to grab, and you did it. You stole the dragon egg. Now you must survive with minimal supplies, and a soon to be very hungry dragon.\n\nYour success is currently temporary, and the rest of your journey is going to be difficult, but you will have a great advantage in the future. If you make it that far.
Rule.Raw: You and your cronies had successfully snuck into the sacred temple; knowing from rumours something very valuable was hidden inside. Once the guards were alerted of your prescence you had no choice but to hide and take what you could get, or else suffer the consequences of attempted theft. When you finally escaped pursuit you decided to see what you managed to grab, and you did it. You stole the dragon egg. Now you must survive with minimal supplies, and a soon to be very hungry dragon.\n\nYour success is currently temporary, and the rest of your journey is going to be difficult, but you will have a great advantage in the future. If you make it that far.
Rule.Translated: Tus compañeros y tú lograsteis entrar a escondidas en el templo sagrado tras oír rumores de que ocultaba algo muy valioso. Cuando los guardias descubrieron vuestra presencia, solo podíais esconderos y tomar lo que hubiera, o afrontar las consecuencias del intento de robo. Tras escapar, comprobasteis lo que habíais conseguido: un huevo de dragón. Ahora debéis sobrevivir con suministros mínimos y un dragón que pronto tendrá mucha hambre.\n\nVuestro éxito es temporal y el resto del viaje será difícil, pero tendréis una gran ventaja en el futuro. Si llegáis hasta allí.

Rule.Original: A soft bed of hay Fit for any dragon egg as it protects it from the elements and increases growth by 13%.
Rule.Raw: A soft bed of hay Fit for any dragon egg as it protects it from the elements and increases growth by 13%.
Rule.Translated: Un lecho blando de heno apto para cualquier huevo de dragón: lo protege de la intemperie y aumenta su crecimiento un 13%.

Rule.Original: A soft bed for dragons to sleep on.
Rule.Raw: A soft bed for dragons to sleep on.
Rule.Translated: Una cama blanda para que duerman los dragones.

Rule.Original: An incubator specially made for dragon eggs. Speeds up the development of the dragon embryo by 30%, allowing it to hatch a little earlier than normal.
Rule.Raw: An incubator specially made for dragon eggs. Speeds up the development of the dragon embryo by 30%, allowing it to hatch a little earlier than normal.
Rule.Translated: Una incubadora especialmente diseñada para huevos de dragón. Acelera un 30% el desarrollo del embrión, permitiendo que nazca algo antes de lo normal.

Rule.Original: Removes the egg from the incubator.
Rule.Raw: Removes the egg from the incubator.
Rule.Translated: Retira el huevo de la incubadora.

Rule.Original: A highly monitored and regulated machine specially made to assist in the development of a dragon embryo. Allows the egg to grow 50% faster than normal, and hence a shorter hatch wait time.
Rule.Raw: A highly monitored and regulated machine specially made to assist in the development of a dragon embryo. Allows the egg to grow 50% faster than normal, and hence a shorter hatch wait time.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina cuidadosamente vigilada y regulada para favorecer el desarrollo del embrión de dragón. Hace que el huevo crezca un 50% más rápido y reduce la espera hasta la eclosión.

Rule.Original: Removes the egg from the incubator.
Rule.Raw: Removes the egg from the incubator.
Rule.Translated: Retira el huevo de la incubadora.
Ritual de la estatua de dragón

Rule.Original: A spot for carrying out certain kinds of rituals.
Rule.Raw: A spot for carrying out certain kinds of rituals.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar donde realizar ciertos tipos de rituales.
Ritual de la estatua de dragón

Rule.Original: A spot for carrying out certain kinds of rituals.
Rule.Raw: A spot for carrying out certain kinds of rituals.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar donde realizar ciertos tipos de rituales.
Ritual de la estatua de dragón

Rule.Original: A spot for carrying out certain kinds of rituals.
Rule.Raw: A spot for carrying out certain kinds of rituals.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar donde realizar ciertos tipos de rituales.

Rule.Original: An altar to worship dragons. While dragons themselves aren't as intelligent as humans, they do respect offers and gifts in their name and will in turn give favor. This favor can in turn be used in rituals, the effects of which can banish, sustain, and calm dragons (among other things).\n\nHowever over time they will require more offerings for the same amount of favor, and more favor for your requests...
Rule.Raw: An altar to worship dragons. While dragons themselves aren't as intelligent as humans, they do respect offers and gifts in their name and will in turn give favor. This favor can in turn be used in rituals, the effects of which can banish, sustain, and calm dragons (among other things).\n\nHowever over time they will require more offerings for the same amount of favor, and more favor for your requests...
Rule.Translated: Un altar para venerar a los dragones. Aunque no son tan inteligentes como los humanos, respetan las ofrendas y regalos hechos en su nombre y conceden favor a cambio. Este puede utilizarse en rituales para expulsarlos, mantenerlos y calmarlos, entre otros efectos.\n\nCon el tiempo exigirán más ofrendas por el mismo favor y más favor para atender tus peticiones...

Rule.Original: A simple bowl used for meager offerings to the dragons.\n\nHowever over time they will require more offerings for the same amount of favor, and more favor for your requests...
Rule.Raw: A simple bowl used for meager offerings to the dragons.\n\nHowever over time they will require more offerings for the same amount of favor, and more favor for your requests...
Rule.Translated: Un sencillo cuenco para ofrecer pequeñas ofrendas a los dragones.\n\nCon el tiempo exigirán más ofrendas por el mismo favor y más favor para atender tus peticiones...

Rule.Original: A one-use psycho-physical effector. It ages the target's mind and body, only taking a few moments to grow a couple decades, along with healing any old scars through the rapid generation of new tissue. It works over long distances, and through walls.
Rule.Raw: A one-use psycho-physical effector. It ages the target's mind and body, only taking a few moments to grow a couple decades, along with healing any old scars through the rapid generation of new tissue. It works over long distances, and through walls.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo psicofísico de un solo uso. Envejece la mente y el cuerpo del objetivo varias décadas en unos instantes y cura cicatrices antiguas mediante la rápida generación de tejido nuevo. Funciona a larga distancia y a través de paredes.

Rule.Original:
A one-use technologically enchanced horn.

Projects a normal dragon's roar over many miles and many landscapes, calling upon a suitable mate.
This however drives the dragons who have heard the call to act rashly for a period of time, as all they wish to do is mate.

Note: Forcing a enraged dragon, pack or not, to roar again will cause a disastrous effect.
Rule.Raw:
A one-use technologically enchanced horn.

Projects a normal dragon's roar over many miles and many landscapes, calling upon a suitable mate.
This however drives the dragons who have heard the call to act rashly for a period of time, as all they wish to do is mate.

Note: Forcing a enraged dragon, pack or not, to roar again will cause a disastrous effect.
Rule.Translated:
Un cuerno mejorado tecnológicamente de un solo uso.

Proyecta el rugido de un dragón corriente a lo largo de muchos kilómetros y paisajes para atraer a una pareja adecuada.
Sin embargo, hace que los dragones que lo oyen actúen imprudentemente durante un tiempo, porque solo quieren aparearse.

Nota: obligar a un dragón enfurecido, sea de manada o no, a rugir otra vez tendrá consecuencias desastrosas.

Rule.Original: The dragon has been driven mad by the roars.
Rule.Raw: The dragon has been driven mad by the roars.
Rule.Translated: Los rugidos han enloquecido al dragón.
fabricar combustible químico con escamas duras

Rule.Original: Make a batch of chemfuel by extracting and condensing oils from Hard Dragon Scales.
Rule.Raw: Make a batch of chemfuel by extracting and condensing oils from Hard Dragon Scales.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica un lote de combustible químico extrayendo y condensando los aceites de las escamas duras de dragón.

Rule.Original: Refining chemfuel from Hard Dragon Scales.
Rule.Raw: Refining chemfuel from Hard Dragon Scales.
Rule.Translated: Refinando combustible químico a partir de escamas duras de dragón.

Rule.Original: A dragon horn. To obtain one you must battle to the death with one of the fiercest animals on the rim. They are very durable and sharp, making it an excellent choice as a melee weapon.
Rule.Raw: A dragon horn. To obtain one you must battle to the death with one of the fiercest animals on the rim. They are very durable and sharp, making it an excellent choice as a melee weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un cuerno de dragón. Para conseguirlo debes luchar a muerte contra uno de los animales más feroces del borde. Es muy resistente y afilado, por lo que constituye una excelente arma cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A dragon egg that was lain unfertilized. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A dragon egg that was lain unfertilized. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo de dragón puesto sin fecundar. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Tar black eggs, whoever obtained this must've gone through a lot of trouble. Comes from a vicious black dragon.
Rule.Raw: Tar black eggs, whoever obtained this must've gone through a lot of trouble. Comes from a vicious black dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos negros como el alquitrán. Quien los haya conseguido habrá pasado muchas dificultades. Proceden de un feroz dragón negro.

Rule.Original: Lapis like eggs, awfully beautiful for an egg. Comes from a beautiful blue dragon.
Rule.Raw: Lapis like eggs, awfully beautiful for an egg. Comes from a beautiful blue dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos como el lapislázuli, extraordinariamente bellos para ser huevos. Proceden de un hermoso dragón azul.

Rule.Original: Eggs of gold, shimmering and showing off their beauty. Comes from the wise gold dragon.
Rule.Raw: Eggs of gold, shimmering and showing off their beauty. Comes from the wise gold dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos dorados que brillan y exhiben su belleza. Proceden del sabio dragón dorado.

Rule.Original: Brilliant green eggs, very difficult to find when properly hidden in lush canopies. Comes from the kind green dragon.
Rule.Raw: Brilliant green eggs, very difficult to find when properly hidden in lush canopies. Comes from the kind green dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos de un verde brillante, muy difíciles de encontrar si se ocultan bien entre el follaje. Proceden del amable dragón verde.

Rule.Original: Rich jade eggs, shimmering and glimmering with beauty and purity. Comes from the wonderous jade dragon.
Rule.Raw: Rich jade eggs, shimmering and glimmering with beauty and purity. Comes from the wonderous jade dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos de un intenso color jade que relucen con belleza y pureza. Proceden del maravilloso dragón de jade.

Rule.Original: Mysterious purple eggs, a color very uncommon in the wild, especially with animals. Comes from the unnatural purple dragon.
Rule.Raw: Mysterious purple eggs, a color very uncommon in the wild, especially with animals. Comes from the unnatural purple dragon.
Rule.Translated: Misteriosos huevos morados, de un color muy poco frecuente en la naturaleza, especialmente en animales. Proceden del antinatural dragón morado.

Rule.Original: Molten lava like eggs, when held you can feel a deep warmth come from it. Comes from the strong red dragon.
Rule.Raw: Molten lava like eggs, when held you can feel a deep warmth come from it. Comes from the strong red dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos como la lava fundida que desprenden un calor profundo al sostenerlos. Proceden del fuerte dragón rojo.

Rule.Original: Eggs of silver, so shiny you can nearly see your reflection in it. Comes from the intelligent silver dragon.
Rule.Raw: Eggs of silver, so shiny you can nearly see your reflection in it. Comes from the intelligent silver dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos plateados, tan brillantes que casi puedes verte reflejado en ellos. Proceden del inteligente dragón plateado.

Rule.Original: Beautiful creamy white eggs, unassuming at first; that is until you realize its size. Comes from the truest dragon.
Rule.Raw: Beautiful creamy white eggs, unassuming at first; that is until you realize its size. Comes from the truest dragon.
Rule.Translated: Hermosos huevos de color blanco cremoso, discretos hasta que reparas en su tamaño. Proceden del dragón más auténtico.

Rule.Original: Snow white eggs, blends perfectly into colder climates and mountains. Comes from the elusive white dragon.
Rule.Raw: Snow white eggs, blends perfectly into colder climates and mountains. Comes from the elusive white dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos blancos como la nieve que se camuflan perfectamente en climas fríos y montañas. Proceden del esquivo dragón blanco.

Rule.Original: Sun like eggs, blends in with the harsh Rimworld deserts. Comes from the warm yellow dragon.
Rule.Raw: Sun like eggs, blends in with the harsh Rimworld deserts. Comes from the warm yellow dragon.
Rule.Translated: Huevos semejantes al sol que se camuflan en los duros desiertos del mundo fronterizo. Proceden del cálido dragón amarillo.

Rule.Original: Commonly confused with True Dragon eggs, these little seeds actually house the flame of life for a Drake.
Rule.Raw: Commonly confused with True Dragon eggs, these little seeds actually house the flame of life for a Drake.
Rule.Translated: Estas pequeñas semillas suelen confundirse con huevos de dragón verdadero, pero en realidad albergan la llama vital de un draco.

Rule.Original: Exotic leather of a dragon. The tanning process has converted the hide into a rich, supple, strong leather. However, the original color has been lost (like when a lobster is boiled in water) and so the skin has irreversibly changed color.
Rule.Raw: Exotic leather of a dragon. The tanning process has converted the hide into a rich, supple, strong leather. However, the original color has been lost (like when a lobster is boiled in water) and so the skin has irreversibly changed color.
Rule.Translated: Cuero exótico de dragón. El curtido transforma la piel en un cuero rico, flexible y resistente. Sin embargo, pierde su color original, como una langosta al cocerla, y cambia de color irreversiblemente.

Rule.Original: The tanning process has converted these scales into a rich, supple, strong leather. However, the original color has been lost (like when a lobster is boiled in water) and so the scales and skin have irreversibly changed color.
Rule.Raw: The tanning process has converted these scales into a rich, supple, strong leather. However, the original color has been lost (like when a lobster is boiled in water) and so the scales and skin have irreversibly changed color.
Rule.Translated: El curtido transforma estas escamas en un cuero rico, flexible y resistente. Sin embargo, pierden su color original, como una langosta al cocerla, y las escamas y la piel cambian de color irreversiblemente.

Rule.Original: The tanning process has converted these scales into a rich, supple, strong leather. And, unlike other leathers of this kind, it still holds a resemblance to its original color which is a testament of strength to the true dragon.
Rule.Raw: The tanning process has converted these scales into a rich, supple, strong leather. And, unlike other leathers of this kind, it still holds a resemblance to its original color which is a testament of strength to the true dragon.
Rule.Translated: El curtido transforma estas escamas en un cuero rico, flexible y resistente. A diferencia de otros cueros similares, conserva parte de su color original, testimonio de la fuerza del dragón verdadero.

Rule.Original: Jewel berries are in fact not berries, but instead they are the pseudobulbs from the jewel orchid. They are quite nutritious but they do have a higher chance of food poisoning and have a long grow time, making them a bad choice for a staple crop. Their main use is in draconic recipes.
Rule.Raw: Jewel berries are in fact not berries, but instead they are the pseudobulbs from the jewel orchid. They are quite nutritious but they do have a higher chance of food poisoning and have a long grow time, making them a bad choice for a staple crop. Their main use is in draconic recipes.
Rule.Translated: Las bayas joya no son bayas, sino pseudobulbos de la orquídea joya. Son bastante nutritivas, pero presentan mayor riesgo de intoxicación alimentaria y tardan mucho en crecer, por lo que no sirven bien como cultivo básico. Se utilizan principalmente en recetas dracónicas.

Rule.Original: The root tubers of a Jewel orchid.
Rule.Raw: The root tubers of a Jewel orchid.
Rule.Translated: Los tubérculos radiculares de una orquídea joya.

Rule.Original: An incredibly heat resistant scale shed from a dragon. Besides being moderately above steel in terms of strength the scales also exhibit a curious ability to change hue when forged in a certain way. Unfortunately this does not apply to furniture or buildings, resulting in a dull gray as the scales cannot properly overlap.\n\nThe scales can be dull red, red, yellow, purple, blue, cyan, dark green, light green, dark gray, and white.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly heat resistant scale shed from a dragon. Besides being moderately above steel in terms of strength the scales also exhibit a curious ability to change hue when forged in a certain way. Unfortunately this does not apply to furniture or buildings, resulting in a dull gray as the scales cannot properly overlap.\n\nThe scales can be dull red, red, yellow, purple, blue, cyan, dark green, light green, dark gray, and white.
Rule.Translated: Una escama desprendida de dragón con una resistencia al calor increíble. Además de ser algo más resistente que el acero, cambia de tono al forjarse de determinada manera. Esto no funciona en muebles ni edificios: al no poder solaparse correctamente, las escamas quedan de un gris apagado.\n\nPueden ser rojo apagado, rojas, amarillas, moradas, azules, cian, verde oscuro, verde claro, gris oscuro y blancas.

Rule.Original: A helmet forged from small over lapping scales. Protects the entire head.
Rule.Raw: A helmet forged from small over lapping scales. Protects the entire head.
Rule.Translated: Un casco forjado con pequeñas escamas superpuestas. Protege toda la cabeza.

Rule.Original: A crown made out of carved dragon horns and metal. Greatly improves social impact.
Rule.Raw: A crown made out of carved dragon horns and metal. Greatly improves social impact.
Rule.Translated: Una corona de cuernos de dragón tallados y metal. Mejora enormemente el impacto social.

Rule.Original: Inspired by the way scales overlap each other, this suit of armor has multiple small "scales" bound together by chain, allowing for greater mobility than standard plate armor. However this increased mobility sacrifices some protection.
Rule.Raw: Inspired by the way scales overlap each other, this suit of armor has multiple small "scales" bound together by chain, allowing for greater mobility than standard plate armor. However this increased mobility sacrifices some protection.
Rule.Translated: Inspirada en la superposición de escamas, esta armadura combina pequeñas «escamas» unidas con cadenas. Permite más movilidad que una armadura de placas normal, a cambio de sacrificar protección.

Rule.Original: A short cape sewn in the shape of wings. Grants the wearer increased walking speed.
Rule.Raw: A short cape sewn in the shape of wings. Grants the wearer increased walking speed.
Rule.Translated: Una capa corta cosida con forma de alas. Aumenta la velocidad de desplazamiento de quien la lleva.

Rule.Original: A deadly spear tipped with a split and carved horn of a dragon. The length of the spear and the sharpness of the horn makes it possible for anyone to strike with great power.
Rule.Raw: A deadly spear tipped with a split and carved horn of a dragon. The length of the spear and the sharpness of the horn makes it possible for anyone to strike with great power.
Rule.Translated: Una lanza mortal con la punta fabricada a partir de un cuerno de dragón partido y tallado. Su longitud y el filo del cuerno permiten golpear con gran potencia.

Rule.Original: A perfectly balanced sword made with a carved dragon's horn. The blade of the sword is made with regular metals, however the dragon horn hilt allows for incredible speed and handling, turning this normal sword into a force to be reckoned with.
Rule.Raw: A perfectly balanced sword made with a carved dragon's horn. The blade of the sword is made with regular metals, however the dragon horn hilt allows for incredible speed and handling, turning this normal sword into a force to be reckoned with.
Rule.Translated: Una espada perfectamente equilibrada con un cuerno de dragón tallado. Su hoja utiliza metales normales, pero la empuñadura de cuerno permite una velocidad y un manejo extraordinarios, convirtiéndola en un arma formidable.

Rule.Original: A battle axe fashioned out of a sharpened thrumbo horn. The long handle allows for powerful swings and stabs, however this is for a sacrifice in speed.
Rule.Raw: A battle axe fashioned out of a sharpened thrumbo horn. The long handle allows for powerful swings and stabs, however this is for a sacrifice in speed.
Rule.Translated: Un hacha de batalla fabricada con un cuerno de thrumbo afilado. Su mango largo permite golpes y estocadas potentes, a cambio de velocidad.

Rule.Original: A book enscribed with special psychic runes. This heavy book enhances psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, granting the wielder a massive boost in psychic power. However it is just a book so unless you're a librarian it's not going to deal a lot of melee damage.
Rule.Raw: A book enscribed with special psychic runes. This heavy book enhances psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, granting the wielder a massive boost in psychic power. However it is just a book so unless you're a librarian it's not going to deal a lot of melee damage.
Rule.Translated: Un libro con runas psíquicas especiales. Este pesado tomo aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica y la disipación de calor neuronal, mejorando enormemente el poder psíquico del portador. Sin embargo, sigue siendo un libro: salvo que seas bibliotecario, no causará mucho daño cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A large bulky incediary launcher modeled after a dragon. Capable of firing two burst shots of light explosives in quick succession.
Rule.Raw: A large bulky incediary launcher modeled after a dragon. Capable of firing two burst shots of light explosives in quick succession.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzador incendiario grande y voluminoso inspirado en un dragón. Dispara dos ráfagas de explosivos ligeros en rápida sucesión.

Rule.Original: A double crossbow. Has two seperate chambers each capable of holding one arrow each, once the trigger is pulled a mechanism looses both in quick succession.
Rule.Raw: A double crossbow. Has two seperate chambers each capable of holding one arrow each, once the trigger is pulled a mechanism looses both in quick succession.
Rule.Translated: Una ballesta doble con dos compartimentos independientes, cada uno para una flecha. Al apretar el gatillo, un mecanismo dispara ambas en rápida sucesión.

Rule.Original: An exotic looking plant comprised of pseudobulbs, or as most call them, berries. These slow growing plants are quite beautiful, sprouting flower spikes with large yellow and red flowers. Used in the production of some draconic goods.
Rule.Raw: An exotic looking plant comprised of pseudobulbs, or as most call them, berries. These slow growing plants are quite beautiful, sprouting flower spikes with large yellow and red flowers. Used in the production of some draconic goods.
Rule.Translated: Una planta de aspecto exótico formada por pseudobulbos, normalmente llamados bayas. Crece lentamente y es muy hermosa, con tallos florales y grandes flores amarillas y rojas. Se utiliza para producir algunos productos dracónicos.

Rule.Original: Jeweled Rhi is a spicy-tasting underground tuber that draconic species love.
Rule.Raw: Jeweled Rhi is a spicy-tasting underground tuber that draconic species love.
Rule.Translated: Jeweled Rhi es un tubérculo subterráneo de sabor picante que encanta a las especies dracónicas.

Rule.Original: Black dragons overshadow all other dragons in terms of ferocity, even compared to the red dragon. Which is why they are incredibly hard to tame and very dangerous, simply too wild to use in war. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Black dragons overshadow all other dragons in terms of ferocity, even compared to the red dragon. Which is why they are incredibly hard to tame and very dangerous, simply too wild to use in war. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones negros superan a todos los demás en ferocidad, incluso a los dragones rojos. Son extremadamente difíciles de domesticar y peligrosos, demasiado salvajes para utilizarlos en la guerra. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Blue dragons are found in colder climates and their main source of energy comes from fish, this is due to the lack of larger prey in those areas. They are known to be a dragon of kinder temper, gladly accepting gifts and offerings. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Blue dragons are found in colder climates and their main source of energy comes from fish, this is due to the lack of larger prey in those areas. They are known to be a dragon of kinder temper, gladly accepting gifts and offerings. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones azules habitan climas fríos y obtienen su energía principalmente de los peces, debido a la falta de presas grandes en esas zonas. Tienen un temperamento más amable y aceptan gustosos regalos y ofrendas. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Green dragons were one of the first dragons used for war. Common, easy to tame, and easy to train, they were used to transport large amounts of soldiers quickly. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Green dragons were one of the first dragons used for war. Common, easy to tame, and easy to train, they were used to transport large amounts of soldiers quickly. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones verdes estuvieron entre los primeros utilizados en la guerra. Son comunes, fáciles de domesticar y adiestrar, y se usaban para transportar rápidamente muchos soldados. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Purple dragons were originally bred in captivity by combining red and blue varieties. It wasn't until a tribe member, Venn, released them from captivity that they became free, roaming the Rimworld as wild dragons. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Purple dragons were originally bred in captivity by combining red and blue varieties. It wasn't until a tribe member, Venn, released them from captivity that they became free, roaming the Rimworld as wild dragons. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones morados se criaron originalmente en cautividad cruzando variedades rojas y azules. Un miembro de la tribu llamado Venn los liberó y desde entonces recorren libremente RimWorld como dragones salvajes. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Red dragons have been known to fight with great strength, making them useful as living war machines. Many escaped their chains due to a tribesman, Curro, secretly freeing them whenever she could. Many have since returned to the wild. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Red dragons have been known to fight with great strength, making them useful as living war machines. Many escaped their chains due to a tribesman, Curro, secretly freeing them whenever she could. Many have since returned to the wild. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones rojos combaten con gran fuerza, por lo que sirven como máquinas de guerra vivientes. Muchos escaparon gracias a Curro, una miembro de la tribu que los liberaba en secreto siempre que podía. Desde entonces, muchos han vuelto a la naturaleza. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: White dragons are a mysterious species, native to the coldest of climates and extremely territorial, they try ward off all who attempt to observe them. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: White dragons are a mysterious species, native to the coldest of climates and extremely territorial, they try ward off all who attempt to observe them. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones blancos son una especie misteriosa propia de los climas más fríos. Son extremadamente territoriales e intentan ahuyentar a quienes los observan. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Yellow dragons are the newest dragons to have been seen in the wild. A rare dominant mutation created a new strain of dragon that developed into its own race. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Yellow dragons are the newest dragons to have been seen in the wild. A rare dominant mutation created a new strain of dragon that developed into its own race. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones amarillos son los últimos en aparecer en estado salvaje. Una rara mutación dominante creó una nueva variedad que acabó formando su propia raza. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Large, long, stocky lizards heavily reminiscent of a dragon, but without the wings. About as dangerous as a warg and as fast as a horse, these versitile reptiles are reliable battle companions.\n\nWhilst originally thought to be related to dragons, they are missing the required extra shoulderblades that would normally harbor the wings. Their similar scales and meat are now thought to be from convergent evolution.
Rule.Raw: Large, long, stocky lizards heavily reminiscent of a dragon, but without the wings. About as dangerous as a warg and as fast as a horse, these versitile reptiles are reliable battle companions.\n\nWhilst originally thought to be related to dragons, they are missing the required extra shoulderblades that would normally harbor the wings. Their similar scales and meat are now thought to be from convergent evolution.
Rule.Translated: Lagartos grandes, largos y robustos que recuerdan mucho a dragones sin alas. Tan peligrosos como un huargo y rápidos como un caballo, estos reptiles versátiles son compañeros de batalla fiables.\n\nAunque se creía que estaban emparentados con los dragones, carecen de los omóplatos adicionales que sostendrían las alas. Ahora se considera que sus escamas y carne similares se deben a la evolución convergente.

Rule.Original: Gold dragons are highly prized due to their golden scales and friendly disposition. Many struggling raiders and tribesmen seek out these generous beasts to ask for a part of their hoard, however many are turned down for their greed and hostility. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Gold dragons are highly prized due to their golden scales and friendly disposition. Many struggling raiders and tribesmen seek out these generous beasts to ask for a part of their hoard, however many are turned down for their greed and hostility. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones dorados son muy apreciados por sus escamas de oro y su carácter amistoso. Muchos asaltantes y miembros de tribus en dificultades buscan a estas generosas bestias para pedir parte de su tesoro, aunque suelen ser rechazados por su avaricia y hostilidad. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Silver dragons are highly prized just like their golden cousins, many believe they are even more valuable due to a popular rumour that their plucked scales can be used as currency. This rumour, however, is quite false and extremely deadly. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Silver dragons are highly prized just like their golden cousins, many believe they are even more valuable due to a popular rumour that their plucked scales can be used as currency. This rumour, however, is quite false and extremely deadly. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones plateados son tan apreciados como sus parientes dorados. Muchos los creen aún más valiosos por el popular rumor de que sus escamas arrancadas sirven como moneda. Pero el rumor es falso y extremadamente mortal. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Jade dragons represent luxury above all else; their entire body looks as if it was one solid piece of jade. Some say if you attempt to pluck one of its scales it would instantly turn into the purest of jades right in front of your eyes. Others say nothing because they tried and have been eaten. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: Jade dragons represent luxury above all else; their entire body looks as if it was one solid piece of jade. Some say if you attempt to pluck one of its scales it would instantly turn into the purest of jades right in front of your eyes. Others say nothing because they tried and have been eaten. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones de jade representan el lujo: todo su cuerpo parece estar formado por una única pieza de jade. Algunos dicen que arrancarles una escama la convierte al instante en el jade más puro. Otros no dicen nada porque lo intentaron y fueron devorados. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: True dragons are different compared to other dragons due to walking on all four legs instead of tucking the front two behind their giant wings. This is the ultimate dragon, respected and feared by all races. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Raw: True dragons are different compared to other dragons due to walking on all four legs instead of tucking the front two behind their giant wings. This is the ultimate dragon, respected and feared by all races. The altar rituals effect these dragons.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones verdaderos caminan sobre sus cuatro patas, a diferencia de otros dragones que esconden las delanteras detrás de sus enormes alas. Son los dragones definitivos, respetados y temidos por todas las razas. Los rituales del altar les afectan.

Rule.Original: Described as a mix between a horse and a goat, these fluffy beasts excell in long distance travel and hauling. Their thick necks lend to powerful headbutts and their long legs allow for speedy travel.
Rule.Raw: Described as a mix between a horse and a goat, these fluffy beasts excell in long distance travel and hauling. Their thick necks lend to powerful headbutts and their long legs allow for speedy travel.
Rule.Translated: Descritas como una mezcla de caballo y cabra, estas bestias peludas destacan en viajes largos y transporte. Sus gruesos cuellos permiten fuertes cabezazos y sus largas patas proporcionan velocidad.

Rule.Original: Adding animal ranged attacks to Dragons Descent
Rule.Raw: Adding animal ranged attacks to Dragons Descent
Rule.Translated: Incorporación de ataques a distancia de animales a Dragons Descent

Rule.Original: A cutting-edge, fully motorized bed equipped with pressure-adjusting surfaces, biometric monitoring, and tech-assisted sleep tracking. It offers unmatched comfort, rest efficiency, and surgical support.
Rule.Raw: A cutting-edge, fully motorized bed equipped with pressure-adjusting surfaces, biometric monitoring, and tech-assisted sleep tracking. It offers unmatched comfort, rest efficiency, and surgical support.
Rule.Translated: Una cama de alta tecnología completamente motorizada, equipada con superficies que ajustan la presión, sistemas de monitorización biométrica y un sistema de seguimiento del sueño diseñado para maximizar el descanso. Ofrece un confort, una eficiencia del descanso y una estabilidad para realizar cirugías inigualables.

Rule.Original: A cutting-edge, fully motorized bed that fits two people, equipped with pressure-adjusting surfaces, biometric monitoring, and tech-assisted sleep tracking. It offers unmatched comfort, rest efficiency, and surgical support.
Rule.Raw: A cutting-edge, fully motorized bed that fits two people, equipped with pressure-adjusting surfaces, biometric monitoring, and tech-assisted sleep tracking. It offers unmatched comfort, rest efficiency, and surgical support.
Rule.Translated: Una cama de alta tecnología completamente motorizada para dos personas, equipada con superficies que ajustan la presión, sistemas de monitorización biométrica y un sistema de seguimiento del sueño diseñado para maximizar el descanso. Ofrece un confort, una eficiencia del descanso y una estabilidad para realizar cirugías inigualables.

Rule.Original: A sleek bedside table with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A sleek bedside table with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Una elegante mesita de noche con una lámpara de luz tenue integrada. Debe colocarse directamente junto al cabecero de la cama. Colocar más de una mesita de noche cerca de una misma cama no mejora este efecto.

Rule.Original: A sleek, modern dresser with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A sleek, modern dresser with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Una elegante y moderna cómoda con una lámpara de luz tenue integrada. Proporciona un pequeño aumento en la comodidad de todas las camas cercanas. Colocar más de una cómoda cerca de una misma cama no mejora este efecto.

Rule.Original: A sleek, modern wardrobe with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Gives a small comfort and rest effectiveness bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A sleek, modern wardrobe with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Gives a small comfort and rest effectiveness bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Un elegante y moderno armario con una lámpara de luz tenue integrada. Proporciona un pequeño aumento en la comodidad de todas las camas cercanas. Colocar más de un armario cerca de una misma cama no mejora este efecto.

Rule.Original: A colossal, ultra-definition entertainment wall spanning multiple panels. Designed for luxurious colonies, it delivers an overwhelming visual experience with rich sound and vibrant clarity. Streams archived ultranet broadcasts from long-dead satellites and local data arrays.
Rule.Raw: A colossal, ultra-definition entertainment wall spanning multiple panels. Designed for luxurious colonies, it delivers an overwhelming visual experience with rich sound and vibrant clarity. Streams archived ultranet broadcasts from long-dead satellites and local data arrays.
Rule.Translated: Un colosal dispositivo de entretenimiento que se integra perfectamente en la pared, abarcando varios paneles. Diseñado para colonias de lujo, ofrece una experiencia visual abrumadora con un sonido rico y una claridad vibrante. Transmite emisiones de la ultra-red archivadas de satélites muertos hace mucho tiempo y matrices de datos locales.

Rule.Original: A sleek, high-tech flat-screen television. Its slim profile saves floor space while delivering the same rich color and clarity as traditional flat-screen units. It doesn’t have a huge viewing space, but can be mounted on walls.
Rule.Raw: A sleek, high-tech flat-screen television. Its slim profile saves floor space while delivering the same rich color and clarity as traditional flat-screen units. It doesn’t have a huge viewing space, but can be mounted on walls.
Rule.Translated: Un televisor de pantalla plana, elegante y de alta tecnología. Su delgado perfil permite ahorrar espacio de suelo a la vez que ofrece la misma riqueza de color y claridad que las unidades de pantalla plana tradicionales. No cuenta con un gran área de visualización, pero se puede montar en la pared.

Rule.Original: A high-fidelity audio system designed to enhance the viewing experience of nearby televisions. When placed near a television, it links with the screen to deliver immersive sound, increasing the recreation gain of any colonist watching.
Rule.Raw: A high-fidelity audio system designed to enhance the viewing experience of nearby televisions. When placed near a television, it links with the screen to deliver immersive sound, increasing the recreation gain of any colonist watching.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de audio de alta fidelidad diseñado para mejorar la experiencia visual de los televisores cercanos. Cuando se coloca cerca de un televisor, se enlaza con la pantalla para ofrecer un sonido envolvente que aumenta cantidad de diversión obtenida del mismo.

Rule.Original: A high-tech shelf for storing apparel or weapons. Items stored on this shelf will benefit from nanoswarms of mechanites that will slowly repair any damage and deterioration. The process requires a large amount of power and takes a significant amount of time.
Rule.Raw: A high-tech shelf for storing apparel or weapons. Items stored on this shelf will benefit from nanoswarms of mechanites that will slowly repair any damage and deterioration. The process requires a large amount of power and takes a significant amount of time.
Rule.Translated: Un estante de alta tecnología ideado para albergar ropa o armas. Los objetos almacenados aquí serán reparados lentamente gracias a una serie de nanoenjambres de mecanitos que produce esta máquina. El proceso requiere de una gran cantidad de energía y tiempo.

Rule.Original: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area, good for large outdoor spaces, with a small solar panel mounted on top. Stores electrical charge during the day, when it’s off, and automatically turns on at night.
Rule.Raw: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area, good for large outdoor spaces, with a small solar panel mounted on top. Stores electrical charge during the day, when it’s off, and automatically turns on at night.
Rule.Translated: Una lámpara eléctrica que ilumina una zona que cuenta con un pequeño panel solar en la parte superior, ideal para su uso en exteriores. Almacena carga eléctrica durante el día, cuando está apagada, y se enciende automáticamente por la noche.
Apagada porque hay suficiente luz solar.

Rule.Original: Off due to being under a roof.
Rule.Raw: Off due to being under a roof.

Rule.Original: A compact, high-efficiency air purifier that filters out dust, allergens, smoke, and other unwanted particulates while circulating clean, scented air. Improves room cleanliness, slightly boosts mood, and enhances the overall environment.
Rule.Raw: A compact, high-efficiency air purifier that filters out dust, allergens, smoke, and other unwanted particulates while circulating clean, scented air. Improves room cleanliness, slightly boosts mood, and enhances the overall environment.
Rule.Translated: Un purificador de aire compacto de alta eficacia que filtra el polvo, los alérgenos, el humo y otras partículas no deseadas mientras hace circular aire limpio y perfumado. Mejora la limpieza de la habitación, eleva ligeramente el estado de ánimo y mejora el ambiente en general.

Rule.Original: A high-end, spacer-era seating solution with adaptive cushioning, posture calibration, and breathable smart fabrics. Designed for maximum long-term comfort and sleek modern interiors.
Rule.Raw: A high-end, spacer-era seating solution with adaptive cushioning, posture calibration, and breathable smart fabrics. Designed for maximum long-term comfort and sleek modern interiors.
Rule.Translated: Un asiento de la era espacial de alta gama, que cuenta con amortiguadores adaptativa, sistemas de calibración de la postura y tejidos transpirables hechos de materiales inteligentes. Diseñada para ofrecer el máximo confort a largo plazo y un toque de elegancia moderna.

Rule.Original: A sleek, spacer-era armchair. Built with memory foam, smart-fabric upholstery, and ergonomic design, it provides superior comfort and aesthetics.
Rule.Raw: A sleek, spacer-era armchair. Built with memory foam, smart-fabric upholstery, and ergonomic design, it provides superior comfort and aesthetics.
Rule.Translated: Un elegante sillón de la era espacial. Fabricado con espuma viscoelástica, tapicería de tejido inteligente y diseño ergonómico, ofrece un confort y una estética superiores.

Rule.Original: A sleek, double-wide spacer-era couch. Memory foam, ergonomic design and smart-fabric upholstery provide maximum comfort.
Rule.Raw: A sleek, double-wide spacer-era couch. Memory foam, ergonomic design and smart-fabric upholstery provide maximum comfort.
Rule.Translated: Un elegante sofá de doble ancho de la era espacial. La espuma con memoria, el diseño ergonómico y la tapicería de tejido inteligente proporcionan el máximo confort.

Rule.Original: The air feels fresh and smells nice!
Rule.Raw: The air feels fresh and smells nice!
Rule.Translated: ¡El aire es fresco y huele bien!

Rule.Original: Build advanced furniture usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.
Rule.Raw: Build advanced furniture usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.
Rule.Translated: Construye muebles avanzados que normalmente solo se pueden encontrar en colonias avanzadas y edificios de mundos resplandecientes.

Rule.Original: subject_story->unveiled furniture designs that blend elegance with advanced functionality, suitable for the most sophisticated of colonies
Rule.Raw: subject_story->unveiled furniture designs that blend elegance with advanced functionality, suitable for the most sophisticated of colonies
Rule.Translated: subject_story->desveló muebles de diseño que combinan elegancia y funcionalidad avanzada, adecuados para las colonias más sofisticadas

Rule.Original: subject_story->introduced living solutions that adapt to their users, combining comfort with cutting-edge technology
Rule.Raw: subject_story->introduced living solutions that adapt to their users, combining comfort with cutting-edge technology
Rule.Translated: subject_story->introdujo soluciones de vivienda que se adaptan a sus usuarios, combinando confort con tecnología punta

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->redefining space with furniture that's as smart as it is stylish
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->redefining space with furniture that's as smart as it is stylish
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->redefiniendo el espacio con muebles tan inteligentes como elegantes

Rule.Original: Build advanced electronics usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.
Rule.Raw: Build advanced electronics usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.
Rule.Translated: Construye dispositivos electrónicos avanzados que normalmente solo se pueden encontrar en colonias avanzadas y edificios de mundos resplandecientes.

Rule.Original: subject_story->engineered electronics that push the boundaries of what's possible, powering devices that were once the realm of science fiction
Rule.Raw: subject_story->engineered electronics that push the boundaries of what's possible, powering devices that were once the realm of science fiction
Rule.Translated: subject_story->diseñó una electrónica que amplía los límites de lo posible, alimentando dispositivos que antes pertenecían al reino de la ciencia ficción.

Rule.Original: subject_story->brought glitterworld technologies to the hands of the colonists, elevating everyday experiences with unparalleled efficiency and ease
Rule.Raw: subject_story->brought glitterworld technologies to the hands of the colonists, elevating everyday experiences with unparalleled efficiency and ease
Rule.Translated: subject_story->puso en manos de los colonos las tecnologías de los mundos brillantes, elevando las experiencias cotidianas con una eficacia y facilidad sin precedentes.

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->unlocking the ultimate potential of electronic innovation
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->unlocking the ultimate potential of electronic innovation
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->liberando el máximo potencial de la innovación electrónica

Rule.Raw: Meat from snail or slug-like creatures.
Rule.Translated: Carne de criaturas similares a caracoles o babosas.

Rule.Original: Affects how easily an object catches fire and how quickly a fire will grow as it burns.
Rule.Raw: Affects how easily an object catches fire and how quickly a fire will grow as it burns.
Rule.Translated: Afecta a la facilidad con la que un objeto prende y a la rapidez con la que crece el fuego al arder.

Rule.Original: Affects how easily an object catches fire and how quickly a fire will grow as it burns.
Rule.Raw: Affects how easily an object catches fire and how quickly a fire will grow as it burns.

Rule.Original: Wading birds that get their color from the krill they eat by filtering food out of the water with their beaks. They thrive anywhere with warm, shallow water.
Rule.Raw: Wading birds that get their color from the krill they eat by filtering food out of the water with their beaks. They thrive anywhere with warm, shallow water.
Rule.Translated: Aves zancudas que obtienen su color del kril que ingieren al filtrar alimento del agua con sus picos. Prosperan donde haya aguas cálidas y poco profundas.

Rule.Original: A fertilized flamingo egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby flamingo. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized flamingo egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby flamingo. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo fecundado de flamenco. Si todo va bien, de él nacerá una cría de flamenco. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: An unfertilized flamingo egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: An unfertilized flamingo egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de flamenco. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Bright pink leather from a flamingo. It's somewhat stronger than your typical birdskin.
Rule.Raw: Bright pink leather from a flamingo. It's somewhat stronger than your typical birdskin.
Rule.Translated: Cuero de flamenco de color rosa intenso. Es algo más resistente que la piel de ave habitual.

Rule.Original: This land-dwelling octopus has somehow adapted to being fully amphibious, able to survive for long periods out of the water. Much like other octopi, it predates on anything small enough.
Rule.Raw: This land-dwelling octopus has somehow adapted to being fully amphibious, able to survive for long periods out of the water. Much like other octopi, it predates on anything small enough.
Rule.Translated: Este pulpo terrestre se ha adaptado de alguna forma a una vida totalmente anfibia y sobrevive largos periodos fuera del agua. Como otros pulpos, caza cualquier animal lo bastante pequeño.

Rule.Original: A fertilized terrestrial octopus egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby octopus. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized terrestrial octopus egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby octopus. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo fecundado de pulpo terrestre. Si todo va bien, de él nacerá una cría de pulpo. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: An unfertilized terrestrial octopus egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: An unfertilized terrestrial octopus egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de pulpo terrestre. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: These large salamanders prefer wet environments with pools of water they can comfortably slip into. While they lack teeth, their strong jaws can crush the shells of most insects. They are capable of fertilizing multiple batches of eggs in one go.
Rule.Raw: These large salamanders prefer wet environments with pools of water they can comfortably slip into. While they lack teeth, their strong jaws can crush the shells of most insects. They are capable of fertilizing multiple batches of eggs in one go.
Rule.Translated: Estas grandes salamandras prefieren entornos húmedos con charcas donde sumergirse cómodamente. Aunque no tienen dientes, sus fuertes mandíbulas aplastan el caparazón de la mayoría de insectos. Pueden fecundar varias puestas de una sola vez.

Rule.Original: A fertilized maxolotl egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a maxolotl. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized maxolotl egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a maxolotl. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo fecundado de maxolotl. Si todo va bien, de él nacerá un maxolotl. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: An unfertilized maxolotl egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: An unfertilized maxolotl egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de maxolotl. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.
