Rule.Original: A disease causing a state of perpetual starvation. Afflicted creatures search for food near human settlements, destroying doors and buildings to reach food.
Rule.Raw: A disease causing a state of perpetual starvation. Afflicted creatures search for food near human settlements, destroying doors and buildings to reach food.
Rule.Translated: Enfermedad que provoca hambre perpetua. Las criaturas afectadas buscan comida cerca de asentamientos humanos y destruyen puertas y edificios para alcanzarla.

Rule.Original: A disease causing a state of perpetual starvation.
Rule.Raw: A disease causing a state of perpetual starvation.
Rule.Translated: Una enfermedad que provoca un estado de inanición perpetua.

Rule.Original: Paralysis-inducing chemicals in the bloodstream. It rapidly renders creatures immobile.
Rule.Raw: Paralysis-inducing chemicals in the bloodstream. It rapidly renders creatures immobile.
Rule.Translated: Sustancias químicas paralizantes en el torrente sanguíneo. Inmovilizan rápidamente a las criaturas.

Rule.Original: A smooth terrain of unmelting ice, as cold as the depths of a glacier.
Rule.Raw: A smooth terrain of unmelting ice, as cold as the depths of a glacier.
Rule.Translated: Un terreno liso de hielo que no se derrite, tan frío como las profundidades de un glaciar.

Rule.Original: A smooth terrain of unmelting ice, as cold as the depths of a glacier, built from blocks of carved ice.
Rule.Raw: A smooth terrain of unmelting ice, as cold as the depths of a glacier, built from blocks of carved ice.
Rule.Translated: Un terreno liso de hielo que no se derrite, tan frío como las profundidades de un glaciar, construido con bloques de hielo tallado.

Rule.Original: A flat wooden surface on supportive beams which can be built over any water.
Rule.Raw: A flat wooden surface on supportive beams which can be built over any water.
Rule.Translated: Una superficie plana de madera sobre vigas de soporte que puede construirse sobre cualquier masa de agua.

Rule.Original: Chitin of a giant insect. It is one of the weakest types of chitin.
Rule.Raw: Chitin of a giant insect. It is one of the weakest types of chitin.
Rule.Translated: Quitina de un insecto gigante. Es uno de los tipos de quitina más débiles.

Rule.Original: Chitin of a giant insect. It doesn't protect very well.
Rule.Raw: Chitin of a giant insect. It doesn't protect very well.
Rule.Translated: Quitina de un insecto gigante. No ofrece mucha protección.
Un caparazón fuerte de quitina gris.
Un caparazón fuerte de quitina verde.

Rule.Original: Chitin of a giant insect. It's quite durable.
Rule.Raw: Chitin of a giant insect. It's quite durable.
Rule.Translated: Quitina de un insecto gigante. Es bastante resistente.

Rule.Original: Hard shell plates from molluscs like snails or clams.
Rule.Raw: Hard shell plates from molluscs like snails or clams.
Rule.Translated: Placas duras del caparazón de moluscos como caracoles o almejas.

Rule.Original: A crystallized carapace that is commonly found on arthropods in crystal-heavy caverns.
Rule.Raw: A crystallized carapace that is commonly found on arthropods in crystal-heavy caverns.
Rule.Translated: Un caparazón cristalizado que suele encontrarse en los artrópodos de cavernas con abundantes cristales.

Rule.Original: A legendary, royal, chitinous shell. It is only found on the strongest and or rarest creatures from within the bowels of the earth.
Rule.Raw: A legendary, royal, chitinous shell. It is only found on the strongest and or rarest creatures from within the bowels of the earth.
Rule.Translated: Un caparazón legendario de quitina real. Solo aparece en las criaturas más fuertes o raras de las profundidades de la tierra.

Rule.Original: A strong chitinous shell taken from a crustacean.
Rule.Raw: A strong chitinous shell taken from a crustacean.
Rule.Translated: Un caparazón fuerte de quitina obtenido de un crustáceo.

Rule.Original: A nearly inflammable and heat-proof chitin. It is only found on the creatures from the deepest and hottest environments within the UnderRim.
Rule.Raw: A nearly inflammable and heat-proof chitin. It is only found on the creatures from the deepest and hottest environments within the UnderRim.
Rule.Translated: Quitina prácticamente incombustible y resistente al calor. Solo aparece en criaturas de los entornos más profundos y calientes del UnderRim.

Rule.Original: A chunk of ice. Can be cut into usable ice blocks.
Rule.Raw: A chunk of ice. Can be cut into usable ice blocks.
Rule.Translated: Un fragmento de hielo. Puede cortarse en bloques de hielo utilizables.

Rule.Original: Cuts ice chunks into usable blocks.
Rule.Raw: Cuts ice chunks into usable blocks.
Rule.Translated: Corta fragmentos de hielo en bloques utilizables.

Rule.Original: A chunk of compressed sand. Can be cut into usable blocks.
Rule.Raw: A chunk of compressed sand. Can be cut into usable blocks.
Rule.Translated: Un fragmento de arena comprimida. Puede cortarse en bloques utilizables.

Rule.Original: Break sand chunks into sand blocks.
Rule.Raw: Break sand chunks into sand blocks.
Rule.Translated: Divide fragmentos de arena en bloques de arena.

Rule.Original: A tropical tree with a tall, naked trunk topped by a cluster of very broad leaves. This variety produces coconuts.
Rule.Raw: A tropical tree with a tall, naked trunk topped by a cluster of very broad leaves. This variety produces coconuts.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol tropical de tronco alto y desnudo coronado por un grupo de hojas muy anchas. Esta variedad produce cocos.

Rule.Original: Big round fruit with a hard shell and a milky center
Rule.Raw: Big round fruit with a hard shell and a milky center
Rule.Translated: Frutos grandes y redondos con una cáscara dura y un interior lechoso

Rule.Original: A suit of medium powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Durable plating and hazmat-quality air filtration make for heavy but highly protective armor. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial and corporate squads in environments otherwise unbreathable, whether it be from toxins, being underwater, or lacking air entirely. It also comes with special utilities that filter the blood of toxins.
Rule.Raw: A suit of medium powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Durable plating and hazmat-quality air filtration make for heavy but highly protective armor. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial and corporate squads in environments otherwise unbreathable, whether it be from toxins, being underwater, or lacking air entirely. It also comes with special utilities that filter the blood of toxins.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura motorizada media diseñada para ofrecer la máxima protección a costa de la movilidad. Sus placas resistentes y filtración de aire de calidad química hacen que sea pesada, pero muy protectora. Los asistentes neuromeméticos impiden que su enorme peso inmovilice por completo al portador, aunque sigue siendo voluminosa.\n\nLas escuadras imperiales y corporativas la utilizan en entornos irrespirables, por toxinas, inmersión o ausencia total de aire. También incorpora sistemas especiales que eliminan toxinas de la sangre.

Rule.Original: A hermetic armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered plasteel-weave plates.\n\nArmor like this is often used by groups needing to survive in inhospitable environments.
Rule.Raw: A hermetic armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered plasteel-weave plates.\n\nArmor like this is often used by groups needing to survive in inhospitable environments.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de armadura hermética con un ordenador de estado integrado y placas superpuestas de tejido de plastiacero.\n\nEstos equipos suelen utilizarse para sobrevivir en entornos inhóspitos.
Carne de criaturas similares a peces.

Rule.Original: A place for gathering chunks of sand from the terrain.
Rule.Raw: A place for gathering chunks of sand from the terrain.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para recoger fragmentos de arena del terreno.

Rule.Original: A place for gathering chunks of ice from the terrain.
Rule.Raw: A place for gathering chunks of ice from the terrain.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para recoger fragmentos de hielo del terreno.

Rule.Original: Very slowly cools nearby lava and magma by drawing the heat from it, converting it to usable stone. Does not affect deep lava or magma.
Rule.Raw: Very slowly cools nearby lava and magma by drawing the heat from it, converting it to usable stone. Does not affect deep lava or magma.
Rule.Translated: Enfría muy lentamente la lava y el magma cercanos extrayendo su calor y convirtiéndolos en piedra utilizable. No afecta a la lava ni al magma profundos.

Rule.Original: Produces electricity from the intense heat of lava and magma. It pipes must be placed within the molten rock to function. If lava generators are placed too close together, the turbulence they generate will interfere and reduce power generation.
Rule.Raw: Produces electricity from the intense heat of lava and magma. It pipes must be placed within the molten rock to function. If lava generators are placed too close together, the turbulence they generate will interfere and reduce power generation.
Rule.Translated: Produce electricidad con el intenso calor de la lava y el magma. Sus tuberías deben colocarse dentro de la roca fundida. Los generadores demasiado próximos interfieren entre sí por la turbulencia que producen y generan menos energía.

Rule.Original: The tanned skin of a gastropod, like a slug or snail. Gastropodskin feels crumbly and mushy at the same time.
Rule.Raw: The tanned skin of a gastropod, like a slug or snail. Gastropodskin feels crumbly and mushy at the same time.
Rule.Translated: La piel curtida de un gasterópodo, como una babosa o un caracol. Tiene una textura quebradiza y blanda a la vez.

Rule.Original: The tanned skin of an amphibian, like a frog or salamander. Amphibianskin feels moist and soft at the same time.
Rule.Raw: The tanned skin of an amphibian, like a frog or salamander. Amphibianskin feels moist and soft at the same time.
Rule.Translated: La piel curtida de un anfibio, como una rana o una salamandra. Tiene un tacto húmedo y suave a la vez.

Rule.Original: The tanned skin of a fireproof creature. It feels hardy and tough but doesn't protect against cold well.
Rule.Raw: The tanned skin of a fireproof creature. It feels hardy and tough but doesn't protect against cold well.
Rule.Translated: La piel curtida de una criatura ignífuga. Es resistente y dura al tacto, pero protege mal del frío.

Rule.Original: Tanned, dried, scraped skin. It is exceptionally durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.
Rule.Raw: Tanned, dried, scraped skin. It is exceptionally durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.
Rule.Translated: Piel curtida, seca y raspada. Es excepcionalmente resistente en combate, pero protege poco de la intemperie.

Rule.Original: The tanned skin of a pinniped, such as a seal or walrus. It protects well against the cold and blunt damage.
Rule.Raw: The tanned skin of a pinniped, such as a seal or walrus. It protects well against the cold and blunt damage.
Rule.Translated: La piel curtida de un pinnípedo, como una foca o una morsa. Protege bien del frío y del daño contundente.

Rule.Original: Leather from a fish. It doesn't protect very well.
Rule.Raw: Leather from a fish. It doesn't protect very well.
Rule.Translated: Cuero de pez. No ofrece mucha protección.
Piel de tiburón. Resistente, pero aísla poco.

Rule.Original: Leather from a whale. Durable in combat, but doesn't provide much insulation.
Rule.Raw: Leather from a whale. Durable in combat, but doesn't provide much insulation.
Rule.Translated: Cuero de ballena. Resistente en combate, pero no ofrece mucho aislamiento.

Rule.Original: Fish food made from mixed meat and plant sources. Less efficient than kibble, but won't deteriorate in water. Humans can eat it, but they really, really don't like it.
Rule.Raw: Fish food made from mixed meat and plant sources. Less efficient than kibble, but won't deteriorate in water. Humans can eat it, but they really, really don't like it.
Rule.Translated: Alimento para peces elaborado con una mezcla de carne y vegetales. Es menos eficiente que el pienso, pero no se deteriora en el agua. Los humanos pueden comerlo, aunque les desagrada muchísimo.

Rule.Original: Make fish food by combining raw meat and plants.
Rule.Raw: Make fish food by combining raw meat and plants.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica alimento para peces combinando carne cruda y plantas.

Rule.Original: An relatively weak wall created using soft sand.
Rule.Raw: An relatively weak wall created using soft sand.
Rule.Translated: Un muro relativamente débil hecho de arena blanda.

Rule.Original: A wall created using compacted sand. It uses more sand but is tougher than its softer version.
Rule.Raw: A wall created using compacted sand. It uses more sand but is tougher than its softer version.
Rule.Translated: Un muro hecho de arena compactada. Utiliza más arena, pero es más resistente que la versión blanda.

Rule.Original: A block of fine-grained sand. It's coarse, rough, and irritating, and it gets everywhere.
Rule.Raw: A block of fine-grained sand. It's coarse, rough, and irritating, and it gets everywhere.
Rule.Translated: Un bloque de arena de grano fino. Es basta, áspera e irritante, y se mete por todas partes.

Rule.Original: A block of ultra-cold, ultra-dense ice. Its special molecular structure makes it immune to melting.
Rule.Raw: A block of ultra-cold, ultra-dense ice. Its special molecular structure makes it immune to melting.
Rule.Translated: Un bloque de hielo ultrafrío y ultradenso. Su estructura molecular especial impide que se derrita.

Rule.Original: A wall of ultra-cold, ultra-dense ice. Its special molecular structure makes it immune to melting.
Rule.Raw: A wall of ultra-cold, ultra-dense ice. Its special molecular structure makes it immune to melting.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de hielo ultrafrío y ultradenso. Su estructura molecular especial impide que se derrita.

Rule.Original: A wall of ultra-cold, ultra-dense ice. Its special molecular structure makes it immune to melting.
Rule.Raw: A wall of ultra-cold, ultra-dense ice. Its special molecular structure makes it immune to melting.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de hielo ultrafrío y ultradenso. Su estructura molecular especial impide que se derrita.

Rule.Original: I don't want to know what's lurking underneath.
Rule.Raw: I don't want to know what's lurking underneath.
Rule.Translated: No quiero saber qué acecha ahí debajo.

Rule.Original: I had to eat raw fish. We should be cooking that kind of food before eating it or at least add some rice.
Rule.Raw: I had to eat raw fish. We should be cooking that kind of food before eating it or at least add some rice.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que comer pescado crudo. Deberíamos cocinar esa comida antes de comerla, o al menos añadirle un poco de arroz.

Rule.Original: I had to eat raw gastropod. We should be cooking that kind of food before eating it, or at least add some salt.
Rule.Raw: I had to eat raw gastropod. We should be cooking that kind of food before eating it, or at least add some salt.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que comer gasterópodos crudos. Deberíamos cocinar esa comida antes de comerla, o al menos añadirle un poco de sal.

Rule.Original: The nice blue water makes me feel relaxed.
Rule.Raw: The nice blue water makes me feel relaxed.
Rule.Translated: El bonito color azul del agua me relaja.

Rule.Original: I can't believe we can get real crab on this planet. It really made my day.
Rule.Raw: I can't believe we can get real crab on this planet. It really made my day.
Rule.Translated: No me puedo creer que podamos conseguir cangrejo de verdad en este planeta. Me ha alegrado el día.

Rule.Original: Chunks of fat in my food instead of real meat... At least it was flavorful.
Rule.Raw: Chunks of fat in my food instead of real meat... At least it was flavorful.
Rule.Translated: Trozos de grasa en mi comida en lugar de carne de verdad... Al menos tenían sabor.

Rule.Original: Hungering animals will try to eat the food and sown plants of your colony by any means. This pack will even destroy walls to steal your food.
Rule.Raw: Hungering animals will try to eat the food and sown plants of your colony by any means. This pack will even destroy walls to steal your food.
Rule.Translated: Los animales hambrientos intentarán comer los alimentos y cultivos de tu colonia por cualquier medio. Esta manada incluso destruirá paredes para robar la comida.
Atajos de teclado de Dubs Performance Analyzer.

Rule.Original: Build industrial-grade generators, capable of storing significantly more fuel and producing higher power.
Rule.Raw: Build industrial-grade generators, capable of storing significantly more fuel and producing higher power.
Rule.Translated: Construye generadores a escala industrial, capaces de almacenar mucho más combustible y generar una mayor potencia.
subject->la era de la energía industrial

Rule.Original: subject_story->ushered in robust solutions to meet the growing energy demands of burgeoning industries
Rule.Raw: subject_story->ushered in robust solutions to meet the growing energy demands of burgeoning industries
Rule.Translated: subject_story->introdujo soluciones robustas para satisfacer la creciente demanda energética de las industrias emergentes

Rule.Original: subject_story->developed generators with unparalleled fuel efficiency and output, powering the machinery of progress
Rule.Raw: subject_story->developed generators with unparalleled fuel efficiency and output, powering the machinery of progress
Rule.Translated: subject_story->desarrolló generadores con una eficiencia y una potencia sin precedentes para mover la maquinaria del progreso

Rule.Original: subject_story->overcame the limitations of earlier power sources, setting the stage for an era of expansion and invention
Rule.Raw: subject_story->overcame the limitations of earlier power sources, setting the stage for an era of expansion and invention
Rule.Translated: subject_story->superó las limitaciones de las fuentes de energía anteriores y sentó las bases de una era de expansión e invenciones

Rule.Original: subject_story->engineered durability and reliability into every unit, ensuring the wheels of industry never slow
Rule.Raw: subject_story->engineered durability and reliability into every unit, ensuring the wheels of industry never slow
Rule.Translated: subject_story->incorporó resistencia y fiabilidad a cada unidad para que las ruedas de la industria nunca se detuvieran

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->fueling the industrial revolution with advanced power generation
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->fueling the industrial revolution with advanced power generation
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->impulsando la revolución industrial con generación de energía avanzada

Rule.Original: Build spacertech batteries, capable of efficiently storing large amounts of energy.
Rule.Raw: Build spacertech batteries, capable of efficiently storing large amounts of energy.
Rule.Translated: Construye baterías de tecnología espacial, capaces de almacenar eficazmente grandes cantidades de energía.

Rule.Original: subject_story->broke new ground in energy storage, with batteries that hold the promise of tomorrow
Rule.Raw: subject_story->broke new ground in energy storage, with batteries that hold the promise of tomorrow
Rule.Translated: subject_story->abrió nuevos caminos en el almacenamiento energético con baterías que contenían la promesa del mañana

Rule.Original: subject_story->crafted compact yet powerful storage solutions, harnessing spacertech to leap forward in efficiency
Rule.Raw: subject_story->crafted compact yet powerful storage solutions, harnessing spacertech to leap forward in efficiency
Rule.Translated: subject_story->creó soluciones de almacenamiento compactas y potentes que aprovechaban la tecnología espacial para dar un salto de eficiencia

Rule.Original: subject_story->pioneered systems that safeguard against power fluctuations, securing energy for critical moments
Rule.Raw: subject_story->pioneered systems that safeguard against power fluctuations, securing energy for critical moments
Rule.Translated: subject_story->fue pionero en sistemas que protegen frente a fluctuaciones eléctricas y aseguran energía en los momentos cruciales

Rule.Original: subject_story->transformed the way civilizations store and manage their power, making energy scarcity a tale of the past
Rule.Raw: subject_story->transformed the way civilizations store and manage their power, making energy scarcity a tale of the past
Rule.Translated: subject_story->transformó la forma en que las civilizaciones almacenan y gestionan su energía y convirtió la escasez en algo del pasado

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->storing the pulse of progress in advanced batteries
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->storing the pulse of progress in advanced batteries
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->almacenando el pulso del progreso en baterías avanzadas

Rule.Original: Construct spacertech green power generators, including advanced solar panels and wind turbines.
Rule.Raw: Construct spacertech green power generators, including advanced solar panels and wind turbines.
Rule.Translated: Construye generadores de energía limpia de tecnología espacial, que incluyen paneles solares y turbinas eólicas avanzadas.

Rule.Original: subject_story->harnessed the power of the sun and wind with unprecedented efficiency, through advanced solar panels and turbines
Rule.Raw: subject_story->harnessed the power of the sun and wind with unprecedented efficiency, through advanced solar panels and turbines
Rule.Translated: subject_story->aprovechó la fuerza del sol y del viento con una eficiencia sin precedentes mediante paneles solares y turbinas avanzados

Rule.Original: subject_story->elevated green power technologies to new heights, combining sustainability with high performance
Rule.Raw: subject_story->elevated green power technologies to new heights, combining sustainability with high performance
Rule.Translated: subject_story->llevó las tecnologías de energía verde a nuevas cotas al combinar sostenibilidad y alto rendimiento

Rule.Original: subject_story->initiated a green revolution in energy production, reducing reliance on finite resources
Rule.Raw: subject_story->initiated a green revolution in energy production, reducing reliance on finite resources
Rule.Translated: subject_story->inició una revolución verde en la producción energética y redujo la dependencia de los recursos finitos

Rule.Original: subject_story->integrated smart technologies to optimize energy capture and utilization, even in the most challenging environments
Rule.Raw: subject_story->integrated smart technologies to optimize energy capture and utilization, even in the most challenging environments
Rule.Translated: subject_story->integró tecnologías inteligentes para optimizar la captación y el uso de la energía incluso en los entornos más difíciles

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->leading the charge towards a sustainable future with green power
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->leading the charge towards a sustainable future with green power
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->encabezando el camino hacia un futuro sostenible con energía verde

Rule.Original: The ultimate power generation method, nuclear power is as sufficient as it is deadly.
Rule.Raw: The ultimate power generation method, nuclear power is as sufficient as it is deadly.
Rule.Translated: La energía nuclear, el método de generación de energía por excelencia, es tan eficaz como peligrosa.

Rule.Original: subject_story->unlocked the atom's heart, unleashing a torrent of power sufficient to light cities and drive the engines of industry
Rule.Raw: subject_story->unlocked the atom's heart, unleashing a torrent of power sufficient to light cities and drive the engines of industry
Rule.Translated: subject_story->abrió el corazón del átomo y liberó un torrente de energía capaz de iluminar ciudades y mover los motores de la industria

Rule.Original: subject_story->balanced the immense potential with rigorous safety protocols, ensuring the boon of nuclear power wasn't overshadowed by its risks
Rule.Raw: subject_story->balanced the immense potential with rigorous safety protocols, ensuring the boon of nuclear power wasn't overshadowed by its risks
Rule.Translated: subject_story->equilibró su enorme potencial con rigurosos protocolos de seguridad para que sus riesgos no eclipsaran los beneficios de la energía nuclear

Rule.Original: subject_story->catalyzed a shift in power generation, where the atom's quiet hum underpins the bustling life of civilizations
Rule.Raw: subject_story->catalyzed a shift in power generation, where the atom's quiet hum underpins the bustling life of civilizations
Rule.Translated: subject_story->propició un cambio en la generación eléctrica en el que el suave zumbido del átomo sostiene la vida bulliciosa de las civilizaciones

Rule.Original: subject_story->led a scientific and engineering marvel, making nuclear power the cornerstone of a new era of energy sufficiency
Rule.Raw: subject_story->led a scientific and engineering marvel, making nuclear power the cornerstone of a new era of energy sufficiency
Rule.Translated: subject_story->dirigió una maravilla científica y técnica que convirtió la energía nuclear en la base de una nueva era de suficiencia energética

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->embracing the nucleus of progress with nuclear power
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->embracing the nucleus of progress with nuclear power
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->abrazando el núcleo del progreso con energía nuclear

Rule.Original: Build tidal generators on water to produce a large volume of sustainable green energy.
Rule.Raw: Build tidal generators on water to produce a large volume of sustainable green energy.
Rule.Translated: Construye generadores que funcionan con las mareas en el agua para producir una gran cantidad de energía limpia y sostenible.

Rule.Original: subject_story->tapped into the ceaseless motion of the oceans, converting the tides into a vast, unending source of power
Rule.Raw: subject_story->tapped into the ceaseless motion of the oceans, converting the tides into a vast, unending source of power
Rule.Translated: subject_story->aprovechó el movimiento incesante de los océanos para convertir las mareas en una fuente de energía enorme e inagotable

Rule.Original: subject_story->innovated with underwater turbines that dance with the currents, generating clean energy in harmony with nature
Rule.Raw: subject_story->innovated with underwater turbines that dance with the currents, generating clean energy in harmony with nature
Rule.Translated: subject_story->innovó con turbinas submarinas que bailaban con las corrientes y generaban energía limpia en armonía con la naturaleza

Rule.Original: subject_story->overcame the challenges of marine power generation, protecting ecosystems while harnessing their strength
Rule.Raw: subject_story->overcame the challenges of marine power generation, protecting ecosystems while harnessing their strength
Rule.Translated: subject_story->superó los desafíos de la generación marina y protegió los ecosistemas mientras aprovechaba su fuerza

Rule.Original: subject_story->showcased the potential of the planet's largest renewable resource, leading by example in the pursuit of sustainability
Rule.Raw: subject_story->showcased the potential of the planet's largest renewable resource, leading by example in the pursuit of sustainability
Rule.Translated: subject_story->demostró el potencial del mayor recurso renovable del planeta y dio ejemplo en la búsqueda de la sostenibilidad

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->syncing civilization's heartbeat with the tides
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->syncing civilization's heartbeat with the tides
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->sincronizando el latido de la civilización con las mareas

Rule.Original: A spacertech, advanced wind-powered electrical generator. Requires a large clear space in front and behind for optimal air flow.
Rule.Raw: A spacertech, advanced wind-powered electrical generator. Requires a large clear space in front and behind for optimal air flow.
Rule.Translated: Un generador eléctrico avanzado de tecnología espacial que funciona con energía eólica. Requiere un gran espacio despejado delante y detrás para que el flujo de aire sea óptimo.

Rule.Original: This spacertech solar generator is capable of extracting significantly more energy from sunlight. Does not work in the dark or under artificial light.
Rule.Raw: This spacertech solar generator is capable of extracting significantly more energy from sunlight. Does not work in the dark or under artificial light.
Rule.Translated: Este generador solar de tecnología espacial es capaz de extraer mucha más energía de la luz solar. No funciona en la oscuridad ni bajo la luz artificial.

Rule.Original: A spacertech building that produces electricity from a river. Must be placed with its wheel in moving water. If watermills are placed too close together, the turbulence they generate will interfere and reduce power generation.
Rule.Raw: A spacertech building that produces electricity from a river. Must be placed with its wheel in moving water. If watermills are placed too close together, the turbulence they generate will interfere and reduce power generation.
Rule.Translated: Una construcción de tecnología espacial que produce electricidad a partir del agua de un río. La rueda debe colocarse dentro del agua en movimiento. Si los molinos de agua se colocan demasiado juntos, las turbulencias que generan interfieren y reducen la generación de energía.

Rule.Original: This advanced, spacertech generator produces electricity from geothermal steam geysers. Must be placed on a steam geyser.
Rule.Raw: This advanced, spacertech generator produces electricity from geothermal steam geysers. Must be placed on a steam geyser.
Rule.Translated: Este avanzado generador de tecnología espacial produce electricidad a partir de géiseres de vapor geotérmicos. Debe colocarse sobre un géiser de vapor.

Rule.Original: Stores a large amount of electricity for later use. Charged large batteries explode when exposed to rain or fire.
Rule.Raw: Stores a large amount of electricity for later use. Charged large batteries explode when exposed to rain or fire.
Rule.Translated: Almacena grandes cantidades de electricidad para su uso posterior. Las baterías grandes cargadas explotan cuando se exponen a la lluvia o al fuego.

Rule.Original: Stores a small amount of electricity for later use. Charged batteries explode when exposed to rain or fire.
Rule.Raw: Stores a small amount of electricity for later use. Charged batteries explode when exposed to rain or fire.
Rule.Translated: Almacena una pequeña cantidad de electricidad para su uso posterior. Las baterías pequeñas cargadas explotan cuando se exponen a la lluvia o al fuego.

Rule.Original: Stores electricity for later use. Due to technological advancements, this battery unit is significantly more efficient. Charged advanced batteries are waterproof and don't explode when exposed to rain.
Rule.Raw: Stores electricity for later use. Due to technological advancements, this battery unit is significantly more efficient. Charged advanced batteries are waterproof and don't explode when exposed to rain.
Rule.Translated: Almacena electricidad para su uso posterior. Gracias a los avances técnicos, esta batería es mucho más eficiente. Las baterías avanzadas cargadas son resistentes al agua y no explotan cuando se exponen a la lluvia.

Rule.Original: Stores large amounts of electricity for later use. Due to technological advancements, this battery unit is significantly more efficient. Charged large advanced batteries are waterproof and don't explode when exposed to rain.
Rule.Raw: Stores large amounts of electricity for later use. Due to technological advancements, this battery unit is significantly more efficient. Charged large advanced batteries are waterproof and don't explode when exposed to rain.
Rule.Translated: Almacena grandes cantidades de electricidad para su uso posterior. Gracias a los avances técnicos, esta batería es mucho más eficiente. Las baterías avanzadas grandes cargadas son resistentes al agua y no explotan cuando se exponen a la lluvia.

Rule.Original:
A large nuclear reactor repurposed from a ship power core. Consumes uranium to produce large amounts of power. Can be overloaded, resulting in even larger power output at the cost of local radiation.

Nuclear reactor will quickly overheat and should be cooled at all times.

Cannot be placed outdoors.
Rule.Raw:
A large nuclear reactor repurposed from a ship power core. Consumes uranium to produce large amounts of power. Can be overloaded, resulting in even larger power output at the cost of local radiation.

Nuclear reactor will quickly overheat and should be cooled at all times.

Cannot be placed outdoors.
Rule.Translated:
Un gran reactor nuclear readaptado a partir del núcleo de energía de una nave. Consume uranio para producir grandes cantidades de energía. Puede sobrecargarse, lo que da lugar a una producción de energía aún mayor a costa de producir radiación local.

El reactor nuclear se recalienta rápidamente y debe ser refrigerado en todo momento.

No se puede colocar en el exterior.

Rule.Original: Generates a very small amount of free energy, forever, without using fuel. This technology is developed by archotechs, and is beyond even most glitterworld societies. While nobody knows exactly how it works, scholars believe it somehow extracts energy directly from fluctuations in the quantum foam.

Aunque nadie sabe exactamente cómo funciona, los estudiosos creen que de alguna manera extrae la energía directamente de las fluctuaciones del vacío cuántico.

Rule.Translated: Una ingeniería y una artesanía extraordinarias han permitido crear elegantes extremidades comparables a las naturales. Requieren mucho tiempo y recursos. Las extremidades paresianas pueden fabricarse en una herrería con combustible.

Rule.Original: Tillage is the agricultural preparation of soil by mechanical agitation of various types, increasing terrain fertility. Tilling soil can only be done on normal soil (not rich soil). When a plant is harvested on a plowed soil, the floor becomes a normal soil again and needs to be plowed again manually.
Rule.Raw: Tillage is the agricultural preparation of soil by mechanical agitation of various types, increasing terrain fertility. Tilling soil can only be done on normal soil (not rich soil). When a plant is harvested on a plowed soil, the floor becomes a normal soil again and needs to be plowed again manually.
Rule.Translated: El labrado es la preparación agrícola del suelo mediante la agitación mecánica de varios tipos, lo que aumenta la fertilidad del terreno. Labrar el suelo solo se puede hacer en suelo normal (no en suelo fertil). Cuando se cosecha una planta en un suelo arado, el suelo vuelve a convertirse en suelo normal y debe ser arado nuevamente manualmente.

Rule.Original: Glossy, red apples. Apples have been used as snacking food, a dessert ingredient, and brewed into cider since early mankind.
Rule.Raw: Glossy, red apples. Apples have been used as snacking food, a dessert ingredient, and brewed into cider since early mankind.
Rule.Translated: Manzanas rojas y brillantes. Las manzanas se han utilizado como tentempié, ingrediente para postres y para elaborar sidra desde tiempos inmemoriales.

Rule.Original: An edible juicy fruit called peach or nectarine. A ripe peach will have a fragrant aroma and be delicious eaten fresh out of hand.
Rule.Raw: An edible juicy fruit called peach or nectarine. A ripe peach will have a fragrant aroma and be delicious eaten fresh out of hand.
Rule.Translated: Unas frutas jugosas también conocidas como nectarinas. Un melocotón maduro tiene un aroma embriagador y es delicioso para comerlo crudo.

Rule.Original: Tiny purple-red sweet cherries. Cherries are notable for requiring a brief freezing season, as such they quickly became a favorite among northern occidental cultures.
Rule.Raw: Tiny purple-red sweet cherries. Cherries are notable for requiring a brief freezing season, as such they quickly became a favorite among northern occidental cultures.
Rule.Translated: Pequeñas cerezas dulces de color rojo púrpura. Las cerezas se caracterizan por necesitar una breve temporada de heladas, por lo que se convirtieron rápidamente en las favoritas de las civilizaciones occidentales del norte.

Rule.Original: A smooth-skinned purple fruit. Many cultures dry-age plums into prunes for long-term preservation. Instead of rotting, once the 15 days have passed the plums will dry into prunes, which are considered preserved food.
Rule.Raw: A smooth-skinned purple fruit. Many cultures dry-age plums into prunes for long-term preservation. Instead of rotting, once the 15 days have passed the plums will dry into prunes, which are considered preserved food.
Rule.Translated: Unos frutos morados de piel lisa. Muchas culturas secan las ciruelas para convertirlas en ciruelas pasas y poder conservarlas durante más tiempo. Una vez transcurridos unos 15 días, las ciruelas se secarán en lugar de pudrirse, y se convertirán en ciruelas pasas, un alimento que se conserva durante mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: Dried plums. Prunes take a very long time to deteriorate.
Rule.Raw: Dried plums. Prunes take a very long time to deteriorate.
Rule.Translated: Ciruelas pasas secas. Las ciruelas pasas tardan mucho tiempo en deteriorarse.

Rule.Original: Crispy green pears. While at first similar to apples, pears are slightly more fibrous and less sweet.
Rule.Raw: Crispy green pears. While at first similar to apples, pears are slightly more fibrous and less sweet.
Rule.Translated: Peras verdes y crujientes. Aunque a primera vista se parecen a las manzanas, las peras son ligeramente más fibrosas y menos dulces.

Rule.Original: Pink, melon-like edible fruits, used historically for both snacking as well as medicine by desert natives.
Rule.Raw: Pink, melon-like edible fruits, used historically for both snacking as well as medicine by desert natives.
Rule.Translated: Unos frutos comestibles de color rosa, parecidos al melón, que los nativos del desierto usaban tanto como aperitivo como medicina.

Rule.Original: These are small, pink berries known as bearberries. While raw bearberries possess an acidic and bland taste, after cooking a natural sweetness comes through and the results can be much more palatable.
Rule.Raw: These are small, pink berries known as bearberries. While raw bearberries possess an acidic and bland taste, after cooking a natural sweetness comes through and the results can be much more palatable.
Rule.Translated: Unas pequeñas bayas rosadas conocidas como arándanos. Aunque los arándanos silvestres crudos tienen un sabor ácido y soso, adquieren un dulzor natural tras cocinarlos, lo que los hace mucho más apetecibles.

Rule.Original: Yellow, elongated berries, easily peeled to reveal a deeply sweet, nearly mushy flesh inside. They have been a favorite of both humans and other primates across the tropics for millenia.
Rule.Raw: Yellow, elongated berries, easily peeled to reveal a deeply sweet, nearly mushy flesh inside. They have been a favorite of both humans and other primates across the tropics for millenia.
Rule.Translated: Unas bayas amarillas y alargadas que pueden pelarse fácilmente para revelar una pulpa muy dulce y blanda. Han sido los favoritos tanto de los seres humanos como de otros primates de los trópicos durante milenios.

Rule.Original: Spherical and perforated, oranges are notoriously annoying to peel and quite pulpy, but known as one of the absolute juiciest fruits with a bright tang and sour aftertaste.
Rule.Raw: Spherical and perforated, oranges are notoriously annoying to peel and quite pulpy, but known as one of the absolute juiciest fruits with a bright tang and sour aftertaste.
Rule.Translated: Unas frutas esféricas y perforadas, muy difíciles de pelar y bastante pulposas, pero conocidas como una de las frutas más jugosas que existen, con un sabor ácido y un regusto agrio.

Rule.Original: An edible bulb of pungent, savory taste and smell with almost as many varieties as cooking applications.
Rule.Raw: An edible bulb of pungent, savory taste and smell with almost as many varieties as cooking applications.
Rule.Translated: Un bulbo comestible, intenso y aromático, con casi tantas variedades como aplicaciones culinarias.

Rule.Original: Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest.
Rule.Raw: Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest.
Rule.Translated: Las calabazas, que técnicamente son bayas gigantes, son famosas por ser fáciles de sembrar y cosechar.

Rule.Original: Tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders. While the flavor itself is mild the capsaicin contained inside means humans find them oddly addicting, if painful when consumed in mass. Animals are known to avoid eating the plant entirely.
Rule.Raw: Tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders. While the flavor itself is mild the capsaicin contained inside means humans find them oddly addicting, if painful when consumed in mass. Animals are known to avoid eating the plant entirely.
Rule.Translated: Unas pequeñas vainas picantes de color carmesí que se utilizan a menudo en salsas, condimentos o polvos. Aunque el sabor en sí es suave, la capsaicina que contienen hace que los seres humanos las encuentren extrañamente adictivas, aunque dolorosas cuando se consumen en grandes cantidades.

Rule.Original: Spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Peas are notable for having potentially long shelf-lives when dried properly.
Rule.Raw: Spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Peas are notable for having potentially long shelf-lives when dried properly.
Rule.Translated: Unas semillas verdes esféricas guardadas en una vaina carnosa. Los guisantes son conocidos por tener una vida útil potencialmente larga cuando se secan adecuadamente.

Rule.Original: A bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish.
Rule.Raw: A bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish.
Rule.Translated: Un fruto bulboso de color morado de la familia de las solanáceas. Las berenjenas suelen ser el ingrediente principal del plato, rara vez se sirven como guarnición.

Rule.Original: A somewhat hardy, leafy green vegetable, often chopped and then fermented or stewed.
Rule.Raw: A somewhat hardy, leafy green vegetable, often chopped and then fermented or stewed.
Rule.Translated: Una verdura de hojas verdes bastante resistente, que a menudo se pica, se fermenta o se guisa.

Rule.Original: An herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike, notably nutritious and historically used in dye making.
Rule.Raw: An herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike, notably nutritious and historically used in dye making.
Rule.Translated: Una hortaliza herbácea muy cultivada tanto para el consumo humano como para el ganado, especialmente nutritiva y utilizada históricamente en la fabricación de tintes.

Rule.Original: A series of juicy, glossy red fruits attached by vine, used commonly as a vegetable. Strong stewing releases natural sugars and mellows out acids contained within.
Rule.Raw: A series of juicy, glossy red fruits attached by vine, used commonly as a vegetable. Strong stewing releases natural sugars and mellows out acids contained within.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de jugosos frutos rojos y brillantes unidos por una enredadera, que se utilizan habitualmente como verdura. Al cocinarlos a fuego fuerte, liberan azúcares naturales y suavizan los ácidos que contienen.

Rule.Original: Cultivated grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Grass can be used to feed cattle, similar to haygrass. It isn't affected by blight, but can't be harvested and stored as hay can.
Rule.Raw: Cultivated grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Grass can be used to feed cattle, similar to haygrass. It isn't affected by blight, but can't be harvested and stored as hay can.
Rule.Translated: Hierba cultivada. Crece en cualquier lugar donde haya algo de luz y un suelo mínimamente fértil.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La hierba se puede utilizar para alimentar al ganado, de forma similar al heno. No se ve afectada por el tizón, pero no se puede cosechar ni almacenar como el heno.

Rule.Original: Cultivated tall grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. Slows down anyone moving over it.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Grass can be used to feed cattle, similar to haygrass. It isn't affected by blight, but can't be harvested and stored as hay can.
Rule.Raw: Cultivated tall grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. Slows down anyone moving over it.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Grass can be used to feed cattle, similar to haygrass. It isn't affected by blight, but can't be harvested and stored as hay can.
Rule.Translated: Hierba alta cultivada. Crece en cualquier lugar donde haya algo de luz y un suelo mínimamente fértil. Reduce la velocidad de cualquier persona que se mueva sobre ella.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La hierba se puede utilizar para alimentar al ganado, de manera similar al heno. No se ve afectada por el tizón, pero no se puede cosechar ni almacenar como el heno.

Rule.Original: A large-leafed desert plant with edible flowers and stalks.
Rule.Raw: A large-leafed desert plant with edible flowers and stalks.
Rule.Translated: Una planta del desierto de hojas grandes con flores y tallos comestibles.

Rule.Original: An edible bulb of pungent, savory taste and smell with almost as many varieties as cooking applications.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Onion isn't affected by blight.
Rule.Raw: An edible bulb of pungent, savory taste and smell with almost as many varieties as cooking applications.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Onion isn't affected by blight.
Rule.Translated: Un bulbo comestible, intenso y aromático, con casi tantas variedades como aplicaciones culinarias.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Las cebollas no se ven afectadas por el tizón.

Rule.Original: Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest. However, their durability means added weight and mass - Too cumbersome for hydroponics basins.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Pumpkin harvests will always succeed, independently of the colonist's plants skill.
Rule.Raw: Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest. However, their durability means added weight and mass - Too cumbersome for hydroponics basins.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Pumpkin harvests will always succeed, independently of the colonist's plants skill.
Rule.Translated: Las calabazas, que técnicamente son bayas gigantes, son famosas por ser fáciles de sembrar y cosechar. Sin embargo, su dureza implica un mayor peso y volumen, lo que las hace demasiado aparatosas para los sistemas hidropónicos.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La cosecha de calabazas siempre será satisfactoria, independientemente del nivel de habilidad de los colonos.

Rule.Original: Tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders. While the flavor itself is mild the capsaicin contained inside means humans find them oddly addicting, if painful when consumed in mass. Animals are known to avoid eating them entirely.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Animals won't eat the pepper plant, having an effective nutrition of zero. Note however that they will eat the harvested produce normally.
Rule.Raw: Tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders. While the flavor itself is mild the capsaicin contained inside means humans find them oddly addicting, if painful when consumed in mass. Animals are known to avoid eating them entirely.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Animals won't eat the pepper plant, having an effective nutrition of zero. Note however that they will eat the harvested produce normally.
Rule.Translated: Unas pequeñas vainas picantes de color carmesí que se utilizan a menudo en salsas, condimentos o polvos. Aunque el sabor en sí es suave, la capsaicina que contienen hace que los seres humanos las encuentren extrañamente adictivas, aunque dolorosas cuando se consumen en grandes cantidades. Se sabe que los animales evitan comerlas por completo.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los animales no se comerán la planta de pimiento, ya que su valor nutricional efectivo es cero. Sin embargo, hay que tener en cuenta que sí que se comerán el producto cosechado con normalidad.

Rule.Original: Spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Pea plants are known to be quite thirsty, and will benefit greatly from rainfall. Peas are also notable for having potentially long shelf-lives when dried properly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Normally less efficient than corn, rice or potatoes, peas will however receive a huge 50% growth boost if it is raining.
Rule.Raw: Spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Pea plants are known to be quite thirsty, and will benefit greatly from rainfall. Peas are also notable for having potentially long shelf-lives when dried properly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Normally less efficient than corn, rice or potatoes, peas will however receive a huge 50% growth boost if it is raining.
Rule.Translated: Unas semillas verdes esféricas guardadas en una vaina carnosa. Las plantas de guisantes son conocidas por ser bastante sedientas y se beneficiarán enormemente de la lluvia. Los guisantes también son conocidos por tener una vida útil potencialmente larga cuando se secan adecuadamente.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Aunque son normalmente menos eficientes que el maíz, el arroz o las patatas, los guisantes recibirán un impulso del 50% a su ritmo de crecimiento si está lloviendo.

Rule.Original: A bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish. Flourishes in warm weather.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Eggplants will grow 30% faster if temperature is between 37 and 60 ºC.
Rule.Raw: A bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish. Flourishes in warm weather.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Eggplants will grow 30% faster if temperature is between 37 and 60 ºC.
Rule.Translated: Un fruto bulboso de color morado de la familia de las solanáceas. La berenjena suele ser el ingrediente principal del plato, rara vez se sirve como guarnición. Crece muy bien en climas cálidos.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Las berenjenas crecerán un 30 % más rápido si la temperatura está entre 37 y 60 ºC.

Rule.Original: A somewhat hardy, leafy green vegetable, often chopped and then fermented or stewed. This particular strain seems highly resistant to airborne toxin and radiation. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Cabbages are unaffected by toxic fallout and, contrary to other plants, won't die from it.
Rule.Raw: A somewhat hardy, leafy green vegetable, often chopped and then fermented or stewed. This particular strain seems highly resistant to airborne toxin and radiation. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Cabbages are unaffected by toxic fallout and, contrary to other plants, won't die from it.
Rule.Translated: Una verdura de hojas verdes bastante resistente, que a menudo se pica, se fermenta o se guisa. Esta variedad en concreto parece ser muy resistente a las toxinas del aire y a la radiación. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Las coles no se ven afectadas por la lluvia tóxica, y a diferencia de otras plantas, no mueren por su efecto.

Rule.Original: An herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike, notably nutritious and historically used in dye making.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> While beets do require rich soil they are quite hearty, and will continue to grow at 10% speed through winter. They need to be planted during growing season, though.
Rule.Raw: An herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike, notably nutritious and historically used in dye making.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> While beets do require rich soil they are quite hearty, and will continue to grow at 10% speed through winter. They need to be planted during growing season, though.
Rule.Translated: Una hortaliza herbácea muy cultivada tanto para el consumo humano como para el ganado, especialmente nutritiva y utilizada históricamente en la fabricación de tintes.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Aunque las remolachas requieren un suelo rico, son bastante resistentes y siguen creciendo a un ritmo del 10% durante el invierno. Sin embargo, deben plantarse durante la temporada de cultivo.

Rule.Original: A series of juicy, glossy red fruits attached by vine, used commonly as a vegetable. Strong stewing releases natural sugars and mellows out acids contained within. Tomatoes are easily removed from the vine without having to uproot the plant.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Tomatoes won't be destroyed on harvest, similar to fruit trees.
Rule.Raw: A series of juicy, glossy red fruits attached by vine, used commonly as a vegetable. Strong stewing releases natural sugars and mellows out acids contained within. Tomatoes are easily removed from the vine without having to uproot the plant.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Tomatoes won't be destroyed on harvest, similar to fruit trees.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de jugosos frutos rojos y brillantes unidos por una enredadera, que se utilizan habitualmente como verdura. Al cocinarlos a fuego fuerte, liberan azúcares naturales y suavizan los ácidos que contienen. Los tomates se pueden separar fácilmente de la enredadera sin necesidad de arrancar la planta. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los tomates no se destruyen al cosecharlos, similar a lo que ocurre con los árboles frutales.

Rule.Original: A tree bearing glossy, red apples, while a myriad of different varieties exist this particular type favors warm summers and mild winters. Apples have been used as snacking food, a dessert ingredient, and brewed into cider since early mankind.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.
Rule.Raw: A tree bearing glossy, red apples, while a myriad of different varieties exist this particular type favors warm summers and mild winters. Apples have been used as snacking food, a dessert ingredient, and brewed into cider since early mankind.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol que produce manzanas rojas y brillantes. Aunque existen una gran variedad de tipos diferentes, esta variedad en concreto prefiere veranos cálidos e inviernos suaves. Las manzanas se han utilizado como tentempié, ingrediente para postres y para elaborar sidra desde tiempos inmemoriales.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Rule.Original: A deciduous tree bearing fuzzy, stone fruit known as peaches, peach trees often require full sunlight and warm temperatures. Ancient oriental cultures cultivated these trees groves at a time, noting its ability to survive in drought conditions. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.
Rule.Raw: A deciduous tree bearing fuzzy, stone fruit known as peaches, peach trees often require full sunlight and warm temperatures. Ancient oriental cultures cultivated these trees groves at a time, noting its ability to survive in drought conditions. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol caducifolio que produce un fruto peludo y con hueso conocido como melocotón. Los melocotoneros suelen requerir plena luz solar y temperaturas cálidas. Las antiguas culturas orientales cultivaban estos árboles en bosquecillos, destacando su capacidad para sobrevivir en condiciones de sequía.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Rule.Original:
A tree bearing tiny purple-red sweet cherries. Cherry trees are notable for requiring a brief freezing season, as such their fruit quickly became a favorite among northern occidental civilizations. This particular genus is quite beautiful, speckled with pink blossoms throughout, blooming fully each winter.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Cherry trees have double beauty compared to other fruit trees.
Rule.Raw:
A tree bearing tiny purple-red sweet cherries. Cherry trees are notable for requiring a brief freezing season, as such their fruit quickly became a favorite among northern occidental civilizations. This particular genus is quite beautiful, speckled with pink blossoms throughout, blooming fully each winter.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Cherry trees have double beauty compared to other fruit trees.
Rule.Translated:
Un árbol que da pequeñas cerezas dulces de color rojo púrpura. Los cerezos se caracterizan por necesitar una breve temporada de heladas, por lo que sus frutos se convirtieron rápidamente en los favoritos de las civilizaciones occidentales del norte. Esta especie en particular es muy hermosa, salpicada de flores rosadas que florecen plenamente cada invierno.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Los cerezos tienen además el doble de belleza en comparación con otros árboles frutales.

Rule.Original:
A bushy tree bearing a smooth-skinned purple fruit. Plums are particularly tart and produced into a variety of jams, jellies, and ciders. Many cultures also dry-age plums into prunes for long-term preservation.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Plums can be consumed raw or dried into prunes.
Rule.Raw:
A bushy tree bearing a smooth-skinned purple fruit. Plums are particularly tart and produced into a variety of jams, jellies, and ciders. Many cultures also dry-age plums into prunes for long-term preservation.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Plums can be consumed raw or dried into prunes.
Rule.Translated:
Un árbol frondoso que da frutos morados de piel lisa. Las ciruelas son especialmente ácidas y se utilizan para elaborar una gran variedad de mermeladas, jaleas y sidras. Muchas culturas también secan las ciruelas para convertirlas en ciruelas pasas y poder conservarlas durante más tiempo.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Las ciruelas que produce se pueden consumir crudas o secarse y convertirse en ciruelas pasas.

Rule.Original:
A stout tree bearing crispy green pears, pear trees are notable for requiring high amounts of water and cool weather, and also doing quite well in shade. While at first similar to apples, pears are slightly more fibrous and less sweet.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Pear trees can be grown indoors and they won't block wind turbines.
Rule.Raw:
A stout tree bearing crispy green pears, pear trees are notable for requiring high amounts of water and cool weather, and also doing quite well in shade. While at first similar to apples, pears are slightly more fibrous and less sweet.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Pear trees can be grown indoors and they won't block wind turbines.
Rule.Translated:
Los perales son árboles robustos que producen peras verdes y crujientes. Se caracterizan por necesitar grandes cantidades de agua y un clima fresco, y también crecen muy bien a la sombra. Aunque a primera vista se parecen a las manzanas, las peras son ligeramente más fibrosas y menos dulces.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Los perales se pueden cultivar en interiores y no obstruyen las turbinas eólicas.

Rule.Original:
More often referred to as the “prickly pear” cactus, this plant is known to be quite bountiful even in hot, dry deserts. The pads of this tall, spiny cactus bloom pink, melon-like edible fruits, used historically for both snacking as well as medicine by desert natives.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Opuntis can be planted close to each other as they don't block sowing plants adjacent to them.
Rule.Raw:
More often referred to as the “prickly pear” cactus, this plant is known to be quite bountiful even in hot, dry deserts. The pads of this tall, spiny cactus bloom pink, melon-like edible fruits, used historically for both snacking as well as medicine by desert natives.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Opuntis can be planted close to each other as they don't block sowing plants adjacent to them.
Rule.Translated:
También conocida como «nopal» o el cactus que da «higos chumbos», esta planta es famosa por ser muy abundante incluso en los desiertos calientes y secos. Las pencas de este cactus alto y espinoso producen frutos comestibles de color rosa, parecidos al melón, que los nativos del desierto usaban tanto como aperitivo como medicina.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Las chumberas se pueden plantar adyacentes entre sí, y tampoco bloquean a otras plantas adyacentes.

Rule.Original:
A low-lying bush speckled with pink berries that thrives in poor, even sandy soil. While raw bearberries possess an acidic and bland taste, after cooking a natural sweetness comes through and the results can be much more palatable.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Bearberry bushes can be grown in pots. They won't block wind turbines.
Rule.Raw:
A low-lying bush speckled with pink berries that thrives in poor, even sandy soil. While raw bearberries possess an acidic and bland taste, after cooking a natural sweetness comes through and the results can be much more palatable.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Bearberry bushes can be grown in pots. They won't block wind turbines.
Rule.Translated:
Un arbusto bajo salpicado de bayas rosadas que crece en suelos pobres, incluso arenosos. Aunque los arándanos silvestres crudos tienen un sabor ácido y soso, adquieren un dulzor natural tras cocinarlos, lo que los hace mucho más apetecibles.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Los arbustos de arandanos se pueden cultivar en macetas, y no obstruyen las turbinas eólicas.

Rule.Original:
A broad-leafed, tall tropical tree adorned with a cluster of yellow, elongated berries succinctly known as bananas. Bananas are easily peeled to reveal a deeply sweet, nearly mushy flesh inside and have been a favorite of both humans and other primates across the tropics for millenia.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Bananas are easy to harvest, since a whole "hand" can be cut at the same time, making their harvest time much lower than other trees'.
Rule.Raw:
A broad-leafed, tall tropical tree adorned with a cluster of yellow, elongated berries succinctly known as bananas. Bananas are easily peeled to reveal a deeply sweet, nearly mushy flesh inside and have been a favorite of both humans and other primates across the tropics for millenia.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Bananas are easy to harvest, since a whole "hand" can be cut at the same time, making their harvest time much lower than other trees'.
Rule.Translated:
Un árbol tropical alto y de hojas anchas adornado con un racimo de bayas amarillas y alargadas conocidas popularmente como plátanos. Los plátanos se pelan fácilmente para revelar una pulpa muy dulce y blanda, y han sido los favoritos tanto de los seres humanos como de otros primates de los trópicos durante milenios.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Los plátanos son fáciles de cosechar, ya que se pueden cortar «racimos» enteros de una sola vez, lo que hace que el tiempo de cosecha sea mucho menor que el de otros árboles.

Rule.Original:
A bushy, semi-tropical tree dotted with orange fruits well equipped for growing in humid environments and in wet soil. Spherical and perforated, oranges are notoriously annoying to peel and quite pulpy, but known as one of the absolute juiciest fruits with a bright tang and sour aftertaste.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Orange trees receive a 1% boost to growth for each river terrain in a 3 tile radius around them.
Rule.Raw:
A bushy, semi-tropical tree dotted with orange fruits well equipped for growing in humid environments and in wet soil. Spherical and perforated, oranges are notoriously annoying to peel and quite pulpy, but known as one of the absolute juiciest fruits with a bright tang and sour aftertaste.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Orange trees receive a 1% boost to growth for each river terrain in a 3 tile radius around them.
Rule.Translated:
Un árbol frondoso y semitropical salpicado de frutos anaranjados, muy adecuado para crecer en ambientes húmedos y suelos mojados. Las naranjas, esféricas y perforadas, son muy difíciles de pelar y bastante pulposas, pero se conocen como una de las frutas más jugosas que existen, con un sabor ácido y un regusto agrio.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos normales, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producen frutos que se pueden comer crudos. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada, por lo que eventualmente será necesario replantarlos.

Los naranjos reciben un aumento del 1% en su ritmo de crecimiento por cada celda de río en un radio de 3 celdas a su alrededor.

Rule.Original: Construct MedPods, advanced hospital beds capable of automatically treating a wide range of diseases and injuries by electrically stimulating and guiding the repair processes of living cells.
Rule.Raw: Construct MedPods, advanced hospital beds capable of automatically treating a wide range of diseases and injuries by electrically stimulating and guiding the repair processes of living cells.
Rule.Translated: Construye cápsulas médicas, camas de hospital avanzadas capaces de tratar automáticamente una amplia gama de enfermedades y lesiones estimulando y guiando eléctricamente los procesos de reparación de las células vivas.
Acerda de: creación de cápsulas médicas

Rule.Original:
You now have the technology to build MedPod beds - but each MedPod requires a special Isolinear Processor component. You can collect Isolinear Processors via the following ways:

 -Orbital or caravan exotic goods traders sell Isolinear Processors. Invite or wait for them.
 -Some quests are rewarded with Isolinear Processors.
Rule.Raw:
You now have the technology to build MedPod beds - but each MedPod requires a special Isolinear Processor component. You can collect Isolinear Processors via the following ways:

 -Orbital or caravan exotic goods traders sell Isolinear Processors. Invite or wait for them.
 -Some quests are rewarded with Isolinear Processors.
Rule.Translated:
Ya dispones de la tecnología necesaria para construir cápsulas médicas, pero cada cápsulas médica requiere un componente especial de Procesador Isolineal. Puede obtenerse de varias formas:

-Comprándolo a comerciantes orbitales o caravanas.
-tal vez alguien ofrezca un procesador de este tipo como recompensa por alguna misión.

Rule.Original:
A self-loading large-bore cannon. Its large-caliber shells do heavy damage over significant ranges. It's slow to aim and it cannot fire at close-up targets.

Being an extremely heavy weapon, this gun requires a power armor to be effectively used.

This weapon has limited number of uses.
