Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will be able to sow any plants regardless of their Plants skill level for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to sow at least 50 plants.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will be able to sow any plants regardless of their Plants skill level for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to sow at least 50 plants.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] podrá sembrar cualquier planta independientemente de su nivel de habilidad durante los próximos 8 días.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría sembrar al menos 50 plantas.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (plantación inspirada).

Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will gain recreation twice as fast for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to attend a party.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will gain recreation twice as fast for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to attend a party.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] recuperará su necesidad de diversión el doble de rápido durante los próximos 8 días.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría asistir a una fiesta.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (frenesí fiestero).

Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will conduct research 5x as fast for the next 8 days or when the research project is completed.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to complete a research project.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will conduct research 5x as fast for the next 8 days or when the research project is completed.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to complete a research project.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] investigará 5 veces más rápido durante los próximos 8 días, o bien hasta que se finalice un proyecto de investigación.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría completar un proyecto de investigación.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (investigación inspirada).

Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will gain twice the yield of any rocks or ore mined for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to mine at least 50 rocks.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will gain twice the yield of any rocks or ore mined for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to mine at least 50 rocks.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] obtendrá el doble de recursos de cualquier roca o mineral durante los próximos 8 días.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría excavar en al menos 50 rocas.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (minería inspirada).

Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will gain experience in skill at twice the normal rate for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to level up any skill to level 10.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will gain experience in skill at twice the normal rate for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to level up any skill to level 10.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] ganará experiencia de habilidad el doble de rápido durante los próximos 8 días.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría alcanzar el nivel 10 en alguna habilidad.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (frenesí de aprendizaje).

Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will cook twice as fast for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to cook at least 50 meals.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will cook twice as fast for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to cook at least 50 meals.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] cocinará el doble de rápido durante los próximos 8 días.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría preparar al menos 50 comidas.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (cocina inspirada).

Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will be much nicer to others in social interactions, as well as much more sophisticated in romantic interactions, resulting in lower chances of being rebuffed for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to engage in some lovin’.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will be much nicer to others in social interactions, as well as much more sophisticated in romantic interactions, resulting in lower chances of being rebuffed for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to engage in some lovin’.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] será mucho más amable con los demás en las interacciones sociales, así como mucho más sofisticado con sus interacciones románticas, lo que resultará en una probabilidad menor de ser rechazado durante los próximos 8 días.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría hacer el amor.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (flirteo frenético).

Rule.Original: [PAWN_pronoun] will land all their melee hits for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to go defeat an enemy in melee combat.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_pronoun] will land all their melee hits for the next 8 days.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would like to go defeat an enemy in melee combat.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_pronoun] acertará con todos sus ataques cuerpo a cuerpo durante los próximos 8 días.\n\nA [PAWN_pronoun] le gustaría derrotar a un enemigo en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.
La inspiración de {0} ya no está disponible (frenesí de combate).
r_logentry(p=3)->[INITIATOR_nameDef] [insulted] a [target] con respecto a su [PersonalCharacteristic].
construir muñeco de nieve con TargetB.

Rule.Original: A friend of mine was sold to a trader like a piece of meat!
Rule.Raw: A friend of mine was sold to a trader like a piece of meat!
Rule.Translated: ¡Un amigo mío fue vendido a un comerciante como si fuera un trozo de carne!
mi mejor amigo {0} se ha ido

Rule.Original: My best friend has gone lost. I hope he will get back to us someday.
Rule.Raw: My best friend has gone lost. I hope he will get back to us someday.
Rule.Translated: Mi mejor amigo se ha ido. Espero que algún día vuelva con nosotros.
mi mejor amiga {0} se ha ido

Rule.Original: My best friend has gone lost. I hope she will get back to us someday.
Rule.Raw: My best friend has gone lost. I hope she will get back to us someday.
Rule.Translated: Mi mejor amiga se ha ido. Espero que algún día vuelva con nosotros.

Rule.Original: My best friend died. How could this happen!
Rule.Raw: My best friend died. How could this happen!
Rule.Translated: Mi mejor amigo murió. ¿Cómo pudo pasar esto?

Rule.Original: My best friend died. How could this happen!
Rule.Raw: My best friend died. How could this happen!
Rule.Translated: Mi mejor amiga murió. ¿Cómo pudo pasar esto?

Rule.Original: Being with my best friend makes me feel this way.
Rule.Raw: Being with my best friend makes me feel this way.
Rule.Translated: Estar con esta persona me hace sentir así de bien.

Rule.Original: I have failed to complete my aspiration.
Rule.Raw: I have failed to complete my aspiration.
Rule.Translated: No he logrado completar mi aspiración.

Rule.Original: had a nice chat with a beer
Rule.Raw: had a nice chat with a beer
Rule.Translated: tuvimos una agradable charla con una cerveza

Rule.Original: I enjoyed the little chit chat and a cold one in my hand.
Rule.Raw: I enjoyed the little chit chat and a cold one in my hand.
Rule.Translated: Disfruté de la conversación y de una cerveza fría en la mano.

Rule.Original: I had a great time at the binge party.
Rule.Raw: I had a great time at the binge party.
Rule.Translated: Me lo pasé muy bien en esa juerga.
asistí a fiesta al aire libre

Rule.Original: I had a great time outside!
Rule.Raw: I had a great time outside!
Rule.Translated: Me lo pasé muy bien al aire libre.

Rule.Original: I had a great time at the birthday party.
Rule.Raw: I had a great time at the birthday party.
Rule.Translated: Me lo pasé muy bien en esa fiesta de cumpleaños.

Rule.Original: They threw me a birthday party!
Rule.Raw: They threw me a birthday party!

Rule.Original: We lost, but we can persevere!
Rule.Raw: We lost, but we can persevere!

Rule.Original: It felt good to finally unbottle my feelings to a friend.
Rule.Raw: It felt good to finally unbottle my feelings to a friend.
Rule.Translated: Me sentí bien al desahogarme por fin con un amigo.

Rule.Original: My friend unbottled their feelings to me.
Rule.Raw: My friend unbottled their feelings to me.
Rule.Translated: Mi amigo compartió sus problemas conmigo.

Rule.Original: I'm jealous. My {0} went on a date with someone else!
Rule.Raw: I'm jealous. My {0} went on a date with someone else!
Rule.Translated: Qué celos... ¡Mi {0} se ha ido de citas con otra persona!

Rule.Original: I am liked and respected here. These people need me.
Rule.Raw: I am liked and respected here. These people need me.
Rule.Translated: Aquí me quieren y me respetan. Esta gente me necesita.

Rule.Original: I'm not having fun here. Nobody seems to respect me!
Rule.Raw: I'm not having fun here. Nobody seems to respect me!
Rule.Translated: No me gusta estar aquí. ¡Parece que nadie me respeta!

Rule.Original: {BUTCHER_nameDef} butchered my bonded pet {VICTIM_nameDef}, I will never forgive {BUTCHER_objective}
Rule.Raw: {BUTCHER_nameDef} butchered my bonded pet {VICTIM_nameDef}, I will never forgive {BUTCHER_objective}
Rule.Translated: {BUTCHER_nameDef} despiezó a mi mascota {VICTIM_nameDef}, nunca lo perdonaré.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} dug up and exposed the corpse of my {0} {VICTIM_nameDef}, I will always despise {OTHERPAWN_objective} for this
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} dug up and exposed the corpse of my {0} {VICTIM_nameDef}, I will always despise {OTHERPAWN_objective} for this
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} desenterró y expuso el cadáver de mi {0}, {VICTIM_nameDef}. Le despreciaré siempre por esto.
expuso el cadáver de mi amigo

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} ate human flesh, I will always be afraid of {OTHERPAWN_possessive}
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} ate human flesh, I will always be afraid of {OTHERPAWN_possessive}
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} comió carne humana, siempre tendré miedo de {OTHERPAWN_pronoun}.
{OTHERPAWN_nameDef} se dio un atracón de comida. Qué desperdicio.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} binged on drugs. I don’t need a junkie in my life
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} binged on drugs. I don’t need a junkie in my life
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} se dio un atracón de drogas. No necesito un drogadicto en mi vida.
se dio un homenaje con drogas
{OTHERPAWN_nameDef} se estaba escondiendo en su habitación. Vaya un bicho raro...

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} wandered in sadness. I feel pity for {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} wandered in sadness. I feel pity for {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} caminaba por ahí tristeza. Siento lástima por {OTHERPAWN_pronoun}.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went into sadistic rage. It’s absolutely disgusting
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went into sadistic rage. It’s absolutely disgusting
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} entró en cólera sádica. Es absolutamente repugnante.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} threw a tantrum. {OTHERPAWN_pronoun} needs to be taught some self control
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} threw a tantrum. {OTHERPAWN_pronoun} needs to be taught some self control
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} cogió una rabieta. Necesita que le enseñen a controlarse.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went berserk. I can never feel safe around {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went berserk. I can never feel safe around {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} se volvió loco. Nunca puedo sentirme seguro cerca de {OTHERPAWN_pronoun}.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went on a fire starting spree. It was so close and everything we know would have turned to ash. How can I forgive that?
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went on a fire starting spree. It was so close and everything we know would have turned to ash. How can I forgive that?
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} se puso a provocar incendios. Todo lo que conocemos podría haberse reducido a cenizas. ¿Cómo puedo perdonar eso?

Rule.Original: went on a fire starting spree
Rule.Raw: went on a fire starting spree

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went on a murderous rage. What if I’m {OTHERPAWN_possessive} next target?
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} went on a murderous rage. What if I’m {OTHERPAWN_possessive} next target?
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} montó en cólera asesina. ¿Y si soy su próximo objetivo?
{OTHERPAWN_nameDef} se volvió salvaje. Vaya un bicho raro...

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} insulted me. Words cut deeper than daggers
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} insulted me. Words cut deeper than daggers
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} me insultó. Las palabras hacen más daño que las armas.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} slaughtered our animal in a blind rage. I despise {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} slaughtered our animal in a blind rage. I despise {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} masacró a nuestro animal con ira irracional. Es despreciable.

Rule.Original: slaughtered an animal in a rage
Rule.Raw: slaughtered an animal in a rage
Rule.Translated: mató a un animal con rabia

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} rebuffed me. I thought {OTHERPAWN_pronoun} was the one
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} rebuffed me. I thought {OTHERPAWN_pronoun} was the one
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} me rechazó. Pensé que {OTHERPAWN_pronoun} era aquella persona especial...

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} broke our prisoners free. It could have ended very badly!
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} broke our prisoners free. It could have ended very badly!
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} liberó a nuestros prisioneros. ¡Podría haber terminado muy mal!
indujo a un prisionero a escapar

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} tamed a thrumbo. What a legendary feat!
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} tamed a thrumbo. What a legendary feat!
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} domó a un thrumbo. ¡Qué hazaña tan legendaria!

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} was previously our enemy. I don't trust {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} was previously our enemy. I don't trust {OTHERPAWN_objective}
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} era antes nuestro enemigo. No confío en {OTHERPAWN_pronoun}.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} was badly injured in battle. I admire {OTHERPAWN_possessive} courage
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} was badly injured in battle. I admire {OTHERPAWN_possessive} courage
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} fue gravemente herido en combate. Admiro su valor.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} didn't attend our wedding ceremony! Was it so hard to come and just be with me on that day?
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} didn't attend our wedding ceremony! Was it so hard to come and just be with me on that day?
Rule.Translated: ¡{OTHERPAWN_nameDef} no asistió a nuestra ceremonia de boda! ¿Era tan difícil venir y simplemente estar conmigo ese día?
no asistió a nuestra ceremonia de boda

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} removed the prisoner's organs! How can a person be capable of such a thing?
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} removed the prisoner's organs! How can a person be capable of such a thing?
Rule.Translated: ¡{OTHERPAWN_nameDef} extrajo los órganos de un prisionero! ¿Cómo puede alguien ser capaz de tal cosa?
extrajo los órganos de un prisionero

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} failed a medical operation and killed one of us
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} failed a medical operation and killed one of us
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} falló durante una cirugía y mató a uno de los nuestros.

Rule.Original: failed a medical operation and killed one of us
Rule.Raw: failed a medical operation and killed one of us
Rule.Translated: falló durante una cirugía y mató a uno de los nuestros

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} tamed me, I will always be glad of the wonders they've shown me
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} tamed me, I will always be glad of the wonders they've shown me
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} me domesticó, siempre me alegraré de las maravillas que me han mostrado.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} broke up with me. Will I ever find someone else?
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} broke up with me. Will I ever find someone else?
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} ha roto conmigo. ¿Encontraré alguna vez a otra persona?

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} and I had a nice chat. It feels like we can talk about anything
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} and I had a nice chat. It feels like we can talk about anything
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} y yo tuvimos una agradable charla. Siento que podemos hablar de cualquier cosa.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} and I had a social fight
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} and I had a social fight

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} saved me from my wounds. I will always be in {OTHERPAWN_possessive} debt
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} saved me from my wounds. I will always be in {OTHERPAWN_possessive} debt
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} me salvó de mis heridas. Siempre estaré en deuda con {OTHERPAWN_pronoun}.

Rule.Original: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} has been my friend since childhood, we have so much in common that no one can separate us
Rule.Raw: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} has been my friend since childhood, we have so much in common that no one can separate us
Rule.Translated: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} es mi amig{OTHERPAWN_gender ? o : a} desde mi infancia, tenemos tanto en común que nadie puede separarnos.

Rule.Original: has been my friend since childhood
Rule.Raw: has been my friend since childhood
Rule.Translated: ha sido mi amigo desde la infancia

Rule.Original: {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} saved me from {THIRDPAWN_kindDef}, I will always be in {SECONDPAWN_possessive} debt
Rule.Raw: {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} saved me from {THIRDPAWN_kindDef}, I will always be in {SECONDPAWN_possessive} debt
Rule.Translated: {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} me salvó de {THIRDPAWN_kindDef}, siempre estaré en deuda con {SECONDPAWN_pronoun}.

Rule.Original: {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} cured my {0} {THIRDPAWN_nameDef}, I will always be grateful to {SECONDPAWN_objective}
Rule.Raw: {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} cured my {0} {THIRDPAWN_nameDef}, I will always be grateful to {SECONDPAWN_objective}
Rule.Translated: {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} curó a mi {0}, {THIRDPAWN_nameDef}. Siempre estaré en deuda con {SECONDPAWN_pronoun}.

Rule.Original: {THIRDPAWN_nameDef} stole {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} away from me. What makes {THIRDPAWN_objective} so much better?
Rule.Raw: {THIRDPAWN_nameDef} stole {SECONDPAWN_nameDef} away from me. What makes {THIRDPAWN_objective} so much better?
Rule.Translated: {THIRDPAWN_nameDef} me robó a {SECONDPAWN_nameDef}. ¿Qué tiene {THIRDPAWN_pronoun} que yo no tenga?

Rule.Raw: There's nothing like a tumble between the sheets to lift the mood.
Rule.Translated: No hay nada como un revolcón entre las sábanas para levantar el ánimo.
