Rule.Original: A reinforced ditch that obstructs movement.which is deeper to make anyone or anything hard to crossover.
Rule.Raw: A reinforced ditch that obstructs movement.which is deeper to make anyone or anything hard to crossover.
Rule.Translated: Un foso reforzado que obstaculiza el movimiento. Es más profundo, por lo que resulta difícil de cruzar para personas, animales u objetos.

Rule.Original: An impassable high wall. Sturdy and capable of holding up a roof, but beware that it's weak to explosions
Rule.Raw: An impassable high wall. Sturdy and capable of holding up a roof, but beware that it's weak to explosions
Rule.Translated: Una muralla alta e infranqueable. Es resistente y puede sostener un techo, pero ten en cuenta que es vulnerable a las explosiones.

Rule.Original: A metal box filled with rocks. If necessary, a large amount of rocks can be dumped at once, causing damage to enemies within range.
Rule.Raw: A metal box filled with rocks. If necessary, a large amount of rocks can be dumped at once, causing damage to enemies within range.
Rule.Translated: Una caja metálica llena de rocas. Si es necesario, puede soltar una gran cantidad de rocas de una sola vez, dañando a los enemigos que se encuentren dentro de su alcance.

Rule.Original: A box that contain rocks,its a trigger-active defense that can give enemy in close range a suprise.
Rule.Raw: A box that contain rocks,its a trigger-active defense that can give enemy in close range a suprise.
Rule.Translated: Una caja que contiene rocas. Es una defensa activada mediante un mecanismo que puede sorprender a los enemigos situados a corta distancia.

Rule.Original: A small breech-loading cannon that can reload and shot shells in rapid rate of fire, its shell will burst out a huge explosion sound and can stunning enemies in range.
Rule.Raw: A small breech-loading cannon that can reload and shot shells in rapid rate of fire, its shell will burst out a huge explosion sound and can stunning enemies in range.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño cañón de retrocarga capaz de recargar y disparar proyectiles con rapidez. Sus disparos producen una fuerte explosión y pueden aturdir a los enemigos dentro de su alcance.

Rule.Original: a small cannon that have a rapid-fire capability by it's breech-loading design.
Rule.Raw: a small cannon that have a rapid-fire capability by it's breech-loading design.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño cañón con capacidad de fuego rápido gracias a su diseño de retrocarga.

Rule.Original: A simple roomy backpack. Greatly increases the carry weight of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: A simple roomy backpack. Greatly increases the carry weight of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila sencilla y espaciosa. Aumenta considerablemente el peso que puede transportar quien la lleva.

Rule.Original: A battle banner. Gives the wearer a fighting spirit and confidence.
Rule.Raw: A battle banner. Gives the wearer a fighting spirit and confidence.
Rule.Translated: Un estandarte de batalla. Aumenta el espíritu de lucha y la confianza del portador.

Rule.Original: A bag with everything needed to provide medical treatment.
Rule.Raw: A bag with everything needed to provide medical treatment.
Rule.Translated: Una bolsa con todo lo necesario para proporcionar tratamiento médico.

Rule.Original: A simple tool belt with everything needed to nail a couple of planks or fix electrical appliances.
Rule.Raw: A simple tool belt with everything needed to nail a couple of planks or fix electrical appliances.
Rule.Translated: Un sencillo cinturón de herramientas con todo lo necesario, tanto para clavar un par de tablones como para arreglar aparatos eléctricos.

Rule.Original: A projectile-repulsion device. It will attempt to stop incoming projectiles or shrapnel, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat. It doesn't prevent the wearer from firing out, and shuts down instantly if hit by EMP.
Rule.Raw: A projectile-repulsion device. It will attempt to stop incoming projectiles or shrapnel, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat. It doesn't prevent the wearer from firing out, and shuts down instantly if hit by EMP.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de repulsión de proyectiles. Intentará detener los proyectiles o la metralla, pero no hace nada frente a los ataques cuerpo a cuerpo o al calor. No impide que el portador dispare, y se apaga al instante si es alcanzado por un pulso electromagnético.

Rule.Original: A belt containing a dose of resurrector serum. Injects the serum immediately after death.
Rule.Raw: A belt containing a dose of resurrector serum. Injects the serum immediately after death.
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón que contiene una dosis de suero de resurrección. Inyecta el suero inmediatamente después de la muerte del portador.

Rule.Original: A small pack of ammunition and components that control a shoulder mounted mini-turret.
Rule.Raw: A small pack of ammunition and components that control a shoulder mounted mini-turret.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño paquete de munición y componentes que controlan una minitorreta montada en el hombro.

Rule.Original: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a shoulder.
Rule.Raw: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a shoulder.
Rule.Translated: Una simple pistola automática diseñada para ser instalada sobre los hombros.

Rule.Original: Unlock the advanced technology of The Eccentric.
Rule.Raw: Unlock the advanced technology of The Eccentric.
Rule.Translated: Desbloquea la tecnología avanzada de The Eccentric.

Rule.Original: Build a housing for Aurora's persona core, which will enable the decryption of her tech database.
Rule.Raw: Build a housing for Aurora's persona core, which will enable the decryption of her tech database.
Rule.Translated: Construye una carcasa para el núcleo de personalidad de Aurora que permita descifrar su base de datos tecnológicos.

Rule.Original: Build fabricators capable of manufacturing and assembling nano-scale smart materials and components.
Rule.Raw: Build fabricators capable of manufacturing and assembling nano-scale smart materials and components.
Rule.Translated: Construye fabricadores capaces de fabricar y ensamblar materiales inteligentes y componentes a escala nanométrica.

Rule.Original: Produce high-density, high-energy micro-capacitors capable of powering advanced electrothermal ignition weapons and nanoweave smart apparel.
Rule.Raw: Produce high-density, high-energy micro-capacitors capable of powering advanced electrothermal ignition weapons and nanoweave smart apparel.
Rule.Translated: Produce microcondensadores de gran densidad y energía, capaces de alimentar armas avanzadas de ignición electrotérmica y ropa inteligente de nanotejido.

Rule.Original: An AI mainframe housing a reconstruction of Aurora's persona core. It contains the encrypted database of The Eccentric's advanced technologies and, when connected to a high-tech research bench, allows Eccentric technology to be replicated and produced.\n\nAs a military-grade ship persona, Aurora is capable of connecting to defense grid networks and automatically managing shield configurations. If installed on a gravship with a working pilot console, she can also autonomously operate simple gravships with no chance for mishaps.
Rule.Raw: An AI mainframe housing a reconstruction of Aurora's persona core. It contains the encrypted database of The Eccentric's advanced technologies and, when connected to a high-tech research bench, allows Eccentric technology to be replicated and produced.\n\nAs a military-grade ship persona, Aurora is capable of connecting to defense grid networks and automatically managing shield configurations. If installed on a gravship with a working pilot console, she can also autonomously operate simple gravships with no chance for mishaps.
Rule.Translated: Un ordenador central de IA que alberga una reconstrucción del núcleo de personalidad de Aurora. Contiene la base de datos cifrada de las tecnologías avanzadas de The Eccentric y, al conectarse a una mesa de investigación avanzada, permite reproducir y fabricar su tecnología.\n\nComo personalidad de nave de grado militar, Aurora puede conectarse a redes defensivas y gestionar automáticamente los escudos. Si se instala en una astronave gravitatoria con una consola de pilotaje operativa, también puede manejar de forma autónoma astronaves sencillas sin riesgo de percances.

Rule.Original: An advanced fabrication bench for the production of Eccentric materials.
Rule.Raw: An advanced fabrication bench for the production of Eccentric materials.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de fabricación avanzada para producir materiales Eccentric.

Rule.Original: An advanced production table for assembling Eccentric weapons, smart apparel, and equipment.
Rule.Raw: An advanced production table for assembling Eccentric weapons, smart apparel, and equipment.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de producción avanzada para ensamblar armas, prendas inteligentes y equipo Eccentric.

Rule.Original: Produced at a Nanofabricator, this highly advanced fabric is laced with precisely woven synthetic fibers and nano-scale muscle fiber. On its own it is not particularly noteworthy, but when assembled alongside specialized controllers, it becomes an incredibly strong and versatile smart material.
Rule.Raw: Produced at a Nanofabricator, this highly advanced fabric is laced with precisely woven synthetic fibers and nano-scale muscle fiber. On its own it is not particularly noteworthy, but when assembled alongside specialized controllers, it becomes an incredibly strong and versatile smart material.
Rule.Translated: Este tejido muy avanzado se produce en un nanofabricador e incorpora fibras sintéticas tejidas con precisión y fibras musculares a escala nanométrica. Por sí solo no destaca especialmente, pero combinado con controladores especializados se convierte en un material inteligente increíblemente resistente y versátil.

Rule.Original: A miniaturized hex-cell capacitor that is capable of extremely high-density energy storage while remaining remarkably stable. It is used in the construction of Second Wave tech such as advanced power tools, smart apparel, and high-tech weapons.
Rule.Raw: A miniaturized hex-cell capacitor that is capable of extremely high-density energy storage while remaining remarkably stable. It is used in the construction of Second Wave tech such as advanced power tools, smart apparel, and high-tech weapons.
Rule.Translated: Un condensador miniaturizado de celdas hexagonales capaz de almacenar energía a una densidad muy alta con una estabilidad notable. Se utiliza para fabricar tecnología de la Segunda Oleada, como herramientas eléctricas avanzadas, ropa inteligente y armas de alta tecnología.
Fabrica una hexacelda de alta densidad.

Rule.Original: A strong armored door. Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
Rule.Raw: A strong armored door. Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta blindada resistente. Divide habitaciones. Las puertas sencillas deben abrirse manualmente, lo que ralentiza el paso. La demora depende del material de la puerta.

Rule.Original: A doorway hung with thick overlapping strips of camo netting made of fabric or leather. It allows people to pass while insulating the temperature. Camo netting flaps are commonly used as temporary doors to makeshift shelters.
Rule.Raw: A doorway hung with thick overlapping strips of camo netting made of fabric or leather. It allows people to pass while insulating the temperature. Camo netting flaps are commonly used as temporary doors to makeshift shelters.
Rule.Translated: Una entrada cubierta con gruesas tiras superpuestas de malla de camuflaje de tela o cuero. Permite el paso y aísla la temperatura. Estas cortinas suelen utilizarse como puertas temporales en refugios improvisados.

Rule.Original: A sturdy chainlink gate. Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy chainlink gate. Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta de malla metálica resistente. Divide habitaciones. Las puertas sencillas deben abrirse manualmente, lo que ralentiza el paso. La demora depende del material de la puerta.

Rule.Original: A cozy mattress and sheets on a frame for resting. Comes with an immaculately made bed sheet complete with hospital corners and zero creases. Beautiful to look at during inspection.
Rule.Raw: A cozy mattress and sheets on a frame for resting. Comes with an immaculately made bed sheet complete with hospital corners and zero creases. Beautiful to look at during inspection.
Rule.Translated: Un colchón y unas sábanas cómodos sobre un armazón para descansar. La cama está impecablemente hecha, con esquinas de hospital y sin una sola arruga. Da gusto verla durante una inspección.

Rule.Original: A luxurious bed fit for officers. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits two.
Rule.Raw: A luxurious bed fit for officers. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits two.
Rule.Translated: Una cama lujosa digna de oficiales. Muy cómoda y hermosa, es una obra de arte por sí sola. Caben dos personas.

Rule.Original: A canvas rip-stop sheet on a frame for resting. Not as comfortable as a normal bed, but lighter and costs less resources to make.
Rule.Raw: A canvas rip-stop sheet on a frame for resting. Not as comfortable as a normal bed, but lighter and costs less resources to make.
Rule.Translated: Una lona antidesgarro sobre un armazón para descansar. Es menos cómoda que una cama normal, pero más ligera y requiere menos recursos.

Rule.Original: A classic military footlocker. Gives a small comfort bonus to a nearby bed. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A classic military footlocker. Gives a small comfort bonus to a nearby bed. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Un baúl militar clásico. Añade una pequeña bonificación de comodidad a una cama cercana. Colocar más de una cómoda junto a la misma cama no aumenta el efecto.

Rule.Original: A heavy duty military crate re-purposed as a dresser. Gives a small comfort bonus to a nearby bed. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A heavy duty military crate re-purposed as a dresser. Gives a small comfort bonus to a nearby bed. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Una caja militar de gran resistencia reutilizada como cómoda. Añade una pequeña bonificación de comodidad a una cama cercana. Colocar más de una cómoda junto a la misma cama no aumenta el efecto.

Rule.Original: A small bedside table with a lamp which makes nearby beds a little bit more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A small bedside table with a lamp which makes nearby beds a little bit more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña mesilla de noche con una lámpara que hace más cómodas las camas cercanas. Debe colocarse directamente junto al cabecero. Colocar más de una mesilla junto a la misma cama no aumenta el efecto.

Rule.Original: A wardrobe or armoire is a standing closet used for storing clothes. The earliest wardrobe was a chest, and it was not until some degree of luxury was attained in regal palaces and the castles of powerful nobles that separate accommodation was provided for the apparel of the great. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A wardrobe or armoire is a standing closet used for storing clothes. The earliest wardrobe was a chest, and it was not until some degree of luxury was attained in regal palaces and the castles of powerful nobles that separate accommodation was provided for the apparel of the great. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Un armario es un mueble vertical para guardar ropa. Los primeros eran cofres; solo cuando los palacios reales y castillos de nobles poderosos alcanzaron cierto lujo se dedicaron espacios separados al vestuario de sus habitantes. Colocar más de un armario junto a la misma cama no aumenta el efecto.

Rule.Original: A comfortable and attractive folding chair. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Raw: A comfortable and attractive folding chair. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Translated: Una silla plegable cómoda y atractiva. Puede usarse en mesas, puestos de trabajo y otros lugares.

Rule.Original: Highly portable folding chair, comfortable to sit on.
Rule.Raw: Highly portable folding chair, comfortable to sit on.
Rule.Translated: Una silla plegable muy portátil y cómoda para sentarse.

Rule.Original: A large, soft, comfy seat. Great for relaxation. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Raw: A large, soft, comfy seat. Great for relaxation. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Translated: Un asiento grande, blando y cómodo. Ideal para relajarse. Puede usarse en mesas, puestos de trabajo y otros lugares.

Rule.Original: A small basketball hoop for basketball free throws. Everybody get up, it's time to jam now. This activity trains shooting skills.
Rule.Raw: A small basketball hoop for basketball free throws. Everybody get up, it's time to jam now. This activity trains shooting skills.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña canasta para practicar tiros libres. Todo el mundo arriba, es hora de jugar. Esta actividad entrena la habilidad de disparo.

Rule.Original: A small goalpost for a football/soccer penalty shootout. It's relaxing, and trains shooting skills.
Rule.Raw: A small goalpost for a football/soccer penalty shootout. It's relaxing, and trains shooting skills.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña portería para lanzar penaltis de fútbol. Relaja y entrena la habilidad de tiro.

Rule.Original: A simple target for a NERF toy gun. It's relaxing, and trains shooting skills.
Rule.Raw: A simple target for a NERF toy gun. It's relaxing, and trains shooting skills.
Rule.Translated: Una diana sencilla para una pistola de juguete NERF. Relaja y entrena la habilidad de tiro.

Rule.Original: A cathode ray tube display for showing moving pictures with sound. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting.
Rule.Raw: A cathode ray tube display for showing moving pictures with sound. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting.
Rule.Translated: Una pantalla de tubo de rayos catódicos que muestra imágenes en movimiento con sonido. Incluso en los mundos exteriores suele quedar alguna antigua emisora que transmite algo mínimamente interesante.

Rule.Original: A high-tech flat-screen television with crystal-clear image and rich color. Picks up transmissions from ancient satellites and ubiquitous data cards.
Rule.Raw: A high-tech flat-screen television with crystal-clear image and rich color. Picks up transmissions from ancient satellites and ubiquitous data cards.
Rule.Translated: Un televisor de pantalla plana de alta tecnología, con una imagen nítida y colores vivos. Recibe transmisiones de satélites antiguos y de las omnipresentes tarjetas de datos.

Rule.Original: A high-tech flat-screen television with crystal-clear image and rich color that comes with an Xbox 360 console. Picks up transmissions from ancient satellites and ubiquitous data cards, has a collection of classic video games that can be played offline.
Rule.Raw: A high-tech flat-screen television with crystal-clear image and rich color that comes with an Xbox 360 console. Picks up transmissions from ancient satellites and ubiquitous data cards, has a collection of classic video games that can be played offline.
Rule.Translated: Un televisor de pantalla plana de alta tecnología, con una imagen nítida y colores vivos, acompañado de una consola Xbox 360. Recibe transmisiones de satélites antiguos y tarjetas de datos, y tiene una colección de videojuegos clásicos que pueden jugarse sin conexión.

Rule.Original: Floodlights are broad-beamed, high-intensity artificial lights. They are often used to illuminate outdoor playing fields while an outdoor sports event is being held during low-light conditions. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Raw: Floodlights are broad-beamed, high-intensity artificial lights. They are often used to illuminate outdoor playing fields while an outdoor sports event is being held during low-light conditions. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Translated: Los reflectores son luces artificiales de gran intensidad y haz amplio. Suelen iluminar campos deportivos al aire libre durante eventos con poca luz. Las personas necesitan iluminación para moverse y trabajar a pleno rendimiento.

Rule.Original: Floodlights are broad-beamed, high-intensity artificial lights. They are often used to illuminate outdoor playing fields while an outdoor sports event is being held during low-light conditions. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Raw: Floodlights are broad-beamed, high-intensity artificial lights. They are often used to illuminate outdoor playing fields while an outdoor sports event is being held during low-light conditions. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Translated: Los reflectores son luces artificiales de gran intensidad y haz amplio. Suelen iluminar campos deportivos al aire libre durante eventos con poca luz. Las personas necesitan iluminación para moverse y trabajar a pleno rendimiento.

Rule.Original: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Raw: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Translated: Una lámpara eléctrica de pie que ilumina una zona. La gente necesita luz para moverse y trabajar a pleno rendimiento.

Rule.Original: A small trash can. Keeps the environment looking neater and tidier.
Rule.Raw: A small trash can. Keeps the environment looking neater and tidier.
Rule.Translated: Una papelera pequeña. Ayuda a que el entorno tenga un aspecto más limpio y ordenado.

Rule.Original: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Raw: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Translated: Una fortificación defensiva para detener vehículos. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose.

Rule.Original: An extremely outdated, yet fully functional radio trade beacon intended for military use. Required for orbital trading. You can only sell goods to orbital traders if they're near an orbital trade beacon. Can be placed indoors.
Rule.Raw: An extremely outdated, yet fully functional radio trade beacon intended for military use. Required for orbital trading. You can only sell goods to orbital traders if they're near an orbital trade beacon. Can be placed indoors.
Rule.Translated: Una baliza de comercio por radio muy anticuada, pero plenamente funcional, destinada a uso militar. Es necesaria para el comercio orbital. Solo puedes vender mercancías a los comerciantes orbitales si están cerca de una baliza de comercio. Puede colocarse en interiores.

Rule.Original: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Must be periodically refueled by hand. More efficient in fuel consumption than the original chemfuel generator but extremely loud and unpleasant to be around along with having less maximum fuel capacity.\n\nComboa emmission certified.
Rule.Raw: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Must be periodically refueled by hand. More efficient in fuel consumption than the original chemfuel generator but extremely loud and unpleasant to be around along with having less maximum fuel capacity.\n\nComboa emmission certified.
Rule.Translated: Produce electricidad consumiendo quimiocombustible. Debe repostarse manualmente de forma periódica. Consume menos combustible que el generador original, pero es extremadamente ruidoso y desagradable de tener cerca, y su depósito es más pequeño.\n\nCertificación de emisiones de Comboa.

Rule.Original: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Must be periodically refueled by hand. More efficient in fuel consumption than FIRMAN 3650 generator, however louder and unpleasant to be around along with having less maximum fuel capacity.\n\nMilitary use certified.
Rule.Raw: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Must be periodically refueled by hand. More efficient in fuel consumption than FIRMAN 3650 generator, however louder and unpleasant to be around along with having less maximum fuel capacity.\n\nMilitary use certified.
Rule.Translated: Produce electricidad consumiendo quimiocombustible. Debe repostarse manualmente de forma periódica. Consume menos combustible que el generador FIRMAN 3650, pero es más ruidoso y desagradable de tener cerca, y su depósito es más pequeño.\n\nCertificado para uso militar.

Rule.Original: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Has a higher fuel capacity than the normal chemfuel generator while maintaining the same fuel consumption rate.
Rule.Raw: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Has a higher fuel capacity than the normal chemfuel generator while maintaining the same fuel consumption rate.
Rule.Translated: Produce electricidad consumiendo quimiocombustible. Su depósito es mayor que el de un generador normal y mantiene el mismo ritmo de consumo.

Rule.Original: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Small and portable source of power, must be powered by hand. Consumes fuel in a slower rate than the normal chemfuel generator but has very low fuel capacity.
Rule.Raw: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Small and portable source of power, must be powered by hand. Consumes fuel in a slower rate than the normal chemfuel generator but has very low fuel capacity.
Rule.Translated: Produce electricidad consumiendo quimiocombustible. Es una fuente de energía pequeña y portátil que debe abastecerse manualmente. Consume combustible más despacio que un generador normal, pero su depósito es muy pequeño.

Rule.Original: A chain-link fence (also referred to as wire netting, wire-mesh fence, chain-wire fence, cyclone fence, hurricane fence, or diamond-mesh fence) is a type of woven fence usually made from galvanized or LLDPE-coated steel wire. The wires run vertically and are bent into a zig-zag pattern so that each "zig" hooks with the wire immediately on one side and each "zag" with the wire immediately on the other.
Rule.Raw: A chain-link fence (also referred to as wire netting, wire-mesh fence, chain-wire fence, cyclone fence, hurricane fence, or diamond-mesh fence) is a type of woven fence usually made from galvanized or LLDPE-coated steel wire. The wires run vertically and are bent into a zig-zag pattern so that each "zig" hooks with the wire immediately on one side and each "zag" with the wire immediately on the other.
Rule.Translated: Una valla de malla metálica, también llamada malla de alambre o malla romboidal. Suele fabricarse con alambre de acero galvanizado o recubierto de LLDPE. Los alambres discurren verticalmente y se doblan en zigzag, de modo que cada «zig» se engancha con el alambre de un lado y cada «zag» con el del otro.

Rule.Original: A concertina wire fence, able to be shot through but impassable. Very difficult to destroy without the help of explosives and cannot be used to build roofs over.
Rule.Raw: A concertina wire fence, able to be shot through but impassable. Very difficult to destroy without the help of explosives and cannot be used to build roofs over.
Rule.Translated: Una valla de alambre de concertina que permite disparar a través de ella, pero impide el paso. Es muy difícil destruirla sin explosivos y no puede sostener techos.

Rule.Original: A concertina wire fence, able to be shot through but impassable. Very difficult to destroy without the help of explosives and cannot be used to build roofs over.
Rule.Raw: A concertina wire fence, able to be shot through but impassable. Very difficult to destroy without the help of explosives and cannot be used to build roofs over.
Rule.Translated: Una valla de alambre de concertina que permite disparar a través de ella, pero impide el paso. Es muy difícil destruirla sin explosivos y no puede sostener techos.

Rule.Original: The HESCO MIL is a modern gabion primarily used for flood control and military fortifications. It is made of a collapsible wire mesh container and heavy duty fabric liner, and used as a temporary to semi-permanent levee or blast wall against explosions or small-arms. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: The HESCO MIL is a modern gabion primarily used for flood control and military fortifications. It is made of a collapsible wire mesh container and heavy duty fabric liner, and used as a temporary to semi-permanent levee or blast wall against explosions or small-arms. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: El HESCO MIL es un gavión moderno utilizado principalmente para controlar inundaciones y construir fortificaciones militares. Está formado por un contenedor plegable de malla metálica con un forro de tela resistente y sirve como dique o muro protector temporal o semipermanente frente a explosiones y armas ligeras. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: The HESCO MIL is a modern gabion primarily used for flood control and military fortifications. It is made of a collapsible wire mesh container and heavy duty fabric liner, and used as a temporary to semi-permanent levee or blast wall against explosions or small-arms. Capable of holding up a roof, has embrasures.
Rule.Raw: The HESCO MIL is a modern gabion primarily used for flood control and military fortifications. It is made of a collapsible wire mesh container and heavy duty fabric liner, and used as a temporary to semi-permanent levee or blast wall against explosions or small-arms. Capable of holding up a roof, has embrasures.
Rule.Translated: El HESCO MIL es un gavión moderno utilizado principalmente para controlar inundaciones y construir fortificaciones militares. Está formado por un contenedor plegable de malla metálica con un forro de tela resistente y sirve como dique o muro protector temporal o semipermanente frente a explosiones y armas ligeras. Puede sostener un techo y tiene troneras.

Rule.Original: A bunker is a defensive military fortification designed to protect people and valued materials from falling bombs or other attacks. Bunkers are mostly underground, in contrast to blockhouses which are mostly above ground. They were used extensively in World War I, World War II, and the Cold War for weapons facilities, command and control centers, and storage facilities. Bunkers can also be used as protection from tornadoes. Capable of holding up a roof, has embrasures.
Rule.Raw: A bunker is a defensive military fortification designed to protect people and valued materials from falling bombs or other attacks. Bunkers are mostly underground, in contrast to blockhouses which are mostly above ground. They were used extensively in World War I, World War II, and the Cold War for weapons facilities, command and control centers, and storage facilities. Bunkers can also be used as protection from tornadoes. Capable of holding up a roof, has embrasures.
Rule.Translated: Un búnker es una fortificación militar defensiva diseñada para proteger a las personas y los materiales valiosos de bombas y otros ataques. Suele estar bajo tierra, mientras que los fortines suelen construirse sobre ella. Se utilizaron ampliamente en la Primera Guerra Mundial, la Segunda Guerra Mundial y la Guerra Fría para instalaciones de armas, centros de mando y control y almacenes. También pueden proteger de tornados. Puede sostener un techo y tiene troneras.

Rule.Original: A quick build but weak container wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: A quick build but weak container wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de contenedor rápido de construir, pero débil. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: A quick build but weak plywood wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: A quick build but weak plywood wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de contrachapado rápido de construir, pero débil. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: A waist-high Jersey barrier for use as cover from incoming shots. Barricades appear neutral and provide better cover than other low objects. Barricades will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do.
Rule.Raw: A waist-high Jersey barrier for use as cover from incoming shots. Barricades appear neutral and provide better cover than other low objects. Barricades will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera Jersey a la altura de la cintura para cubrirse de los disparos. Las barricadas tienen aspecto neutral y ofrecen mejor cobertura que otros objetos bajos. Impiden el paso a ciertos animales del mismo modo que las vallas.

Rule.Original: A Bremer wall, or T-wall, is a twelve-foot-tall (3.66 m) portable, steel-reinforced concrete blast wall of the type used for blast protection throughout Iraq and Afghanistan. The name is believed to have originated from L. Paul Bremer of the Coalition Provisional Authority, who was the Director of Reconstruction and Humanitarian Assistance for post-war Iraq, following the Iraq War of 2003, in the early years of the Iraq War.
Rule.Raw: A Bremer wall, or T-wall, is a twelve-foot-tall (3.66 m) portable, steel-reinforced concrete blast wall of the type used for blast protection throughout Iraq and Afghanistan. The name is believed to have originated from L. Paul Bremer of the Coalition Provisional Authority, who was the Director of Reconstruction and Humanitarian Assistance for post-war Iraq, following the Iraq War of 2003, in the early years of the Iraq War.
Rule.Translated: Un muro Bremer, o muro en T, es una barrera portátil contra explosiones de hormigón armado, de doce pies de altura (3.66 m), del tipo utilizado en Irak y Afganistán. Se cree que su nombre procede de L. Paul Bremer, de la Autoridad Provisional de la Coalición, que fue director de Reconstrucción y Ayuda Humanitaria para el Irak de posguerra tras la invasión de 2003, durante los primeros años de la guerra.

Rule.Original: A varnished chipboard wood flooring for that quick and easy housing build. While it is low cost, it takes longer to lay due to it's varnishing, and far more flammable than normal woodern floors.
Rule.Raw: A varnished chipboard wood flooring for that quick and easy housing build. While it is low cost, it takes longer to lay due to it's varnishing, and far more flammable than normal woodern floors.
Rule.Translated: Un suelo de madera aglomerada barnizada para construir viviendas de forma rápida y sencilla. Aunque es barato, tarda más en colocarse por el barnizado y es mucho más inflamable que los suelos normales de madera.

Rule.Original: Floodlights are broad-beamed, high-intensity artificial lights. They are often used to illuminate outdoor playing fields while an outdoor sports event is being held during low-light conditions. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Raw: Floodlights are broad-beamed, high-intensity artificial lights. They are often used to illuminate outdoor playing fields while an outdoor sports event is being held during low-light conditions. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Rule.Translated: Los reflectores son luces artificiales de gran intensidad y haz amplio. Suelen iluminar campos deportivos al aire libre durante eventos con poca luz. Las personas necesitan iluminación para moverse y trabajar a pleno rendimiento.

Rule.Original: Allows radio contact with other factions and orbital traders.
Rule.Raw: Allows radio contact with other factions and orbital traders.
Rule.Translated: Permite contactar por radio con otras facciones y comerciantes orbitales.

Rule.Original: A mission board to look for new missions.
Rule.Raw: A mission board to look for new missions.
Rule.Translated: Un tablón de misiones donde buscar nuevas misiones.
Buscar y destruir un campamento de bandidos

Rule.Original: Search radio signals for a prisoner rescue
Rule.Raw: Search radio signals for a prisoner rescue
Rule.Translated: Buscar señales de radio para rescatar a un prisionero

Rule.Original: Search and rescue for downed refugees
Rule.Raw: Search and rescue for downed refugees
Rule.Translated: Buscar y rescatar a refugiados derribados

Rule.Original: Search for a peace talks opportunity
Rule.Raw: Search for a peace talks opportunity
Rule.Translated: Buscar una oportunidad de conversaciones de paz

Rule.Original: Request for an orbital trader arrival
Rule.Raw: Request for an orbital trader arrival
Rule.Translated: Solicitar la llegada de un comerciante orbital

Rule.Original: Request for a ransom demand (captured colonists only)
Rule.Raw: Request for a ransom demand (captured colonists only)
Rule.Translated: Solicitar una petición de rescate (solo colonos capturados)

Rule.Original: An electronic radio that plays music.
Rule.Raw: An electronic radio that plays music.
Rule.Translated: Una radio electrónica que reproduce música.
Edita los ajustes de los mods.

Rule.Original: Build advanced phased shield belts with improved performance.
Rule.Raw: Build advanced phased shield belts with improved performance.
Rule.Translated: Construye cinturones de escudo de fase avanzados con mejor rendimiento.

Rule.Original: Build advanced shield belts that synchronize with the wearer's firearms, allowing them to be fired while the shield is active.
Rule.Raw: Build advanced shield belts that synchronize with the wearer's firearms, allowing them to be fired while the shield is active.
Rule.Translated: Construye cinturones de escudo avanzados que se sincronizan con las armas del usuario y permiten dispararlas mientras el escudo está activo.

Rule.Original: Build advanced shield belts with distinct micro-layers capable of shrugging off powerful attacks.
Rule.Raw: Build advanced shield belts with distinct micro-layers capable of shrugging off powerful attacks.
Rule.Translated: Construye cinturones de escudo avanzados con microcapas diferenciadas capaces de resistir ataques potentes.
Pérdida máxima de energía del escudo

Rule.Original: The maximum amount of energy a shield can lose from a single hit.
Rule.Raw: The maximum amount of energy a shield can lose from a single hit.
Rule.Translated: La cantidad máxima de energía que puede perder un escudo por un solo impacto.
Retardo de recarga del escudo activo

Rule.Original: The amount of time it takes before the shield starts recharging after it has taken damage, but is still active.
Rule.Raw: The amount of time it takes before the shield starts recharging after it has taken damage, but is still active.
Rule.Translated: El tiempo que tarda el escudo en empezar a recargarse tras recibir daño mientras sigue activo.
Retardo de recarga del escudo inactivo

Rule.Original: The amount of time it takes before the shield starts recharging after breaking. This timer resets if the wearer continues to take damage.
Rule.Raw: The amount of time it takes before the shield starts recharging after breaking. This timer resets if the wearer continues to take damage.
Rule.Translated: El tiempo que tarda el escudo en empezar a recargarse después de romperse. El contador se reinicia si el usuario sigue recibiendo daños.

Rule.Original: An advanced shield belt used by The Eccentric's staff, phased shield belts have greatly increased capacity and rapid reset capabilities, but cannot recharge while actively under strain.\n\nThis offers more immediate protection against enemy attacks within a short period of time, allowing its user to take cover or retreat to safety.
Rule.Raw: An advanced shield belt used by The Eccentric's staff, phased shield belts have greatly increased capacity and rapid reset capabilities, but cannot recharge while actively under strain.\n\nThis offers more immediate protection against enemy attacks within a short period of time, allowing its user to take cover or retreat to safety.
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón de escudo avanzado utilizado por el personal de The Eccentric. Los escudos de fase tienen mucha más capacidad y pueden restablecerse rápidamente, pero no se recargan mientras están sometidos a presión.\n\nOfrecen una mayor protección inmediata frente a ataques concentrados en poco tiempo y permiten al usuario buscar cobertura o retirarse a un lugar seguro.

Rule.Original: This advanced shield belt uses precisely modulated field generators that synchronize with its user's weapons fire, allowing ranged weapons to be used while it is worn and active.\n\nIt is somewhat heavier than a standard phased shield belt, has lower overall shield strength, and charges more slowly.
Rule.Raw: This advanced shield belt uses precisely modulated field generators that synchronize with its user's weapons fire, allowing ranged weapons to be used while it is worn and active.\n\nIt is somewhat heavier than a standard phased shield belt, has lower overall shield strength, and charges more slowly.
Rule.Translated: Este cinturón avanzado utiliza generadores de campo modulados con precisión que se sincronizan con los disparos del usuario y permiten utilizar armas a distancia mientras el escudo está equipado y activo.\n\nEs algo más pesado que un cinturón de fase normal, tiene una resistencia total menor y se carga más despacio.

Rule.Original: Also known as a "shatter shield", this advanced shield belt uses a specialized field generator that projects layers of strong but brittle barriers. Upon being hit by a powerful attack, an individual layer will ablate and deflect the energy of the strike, limiting the amount of energy the shield can lose from a single blow.\n\nIt is somewhat heavier than a standard phased shield belt, has lower overall shield strength, and charges more slowly.
Rule.Raw: Also known as a "shatter shield", this advanced shield belt uses a specialized field generator that projects layers of strong but brittle barriers. Upon being hit by a powerful attack, an individual layer will ablate and deflect the energy of the strike, limiting the amount of energy the shield can lose from a single blow.\n\nIt is somewhat heavier than a standard phased shield belt, has lower overall shield strength, and charges more slowly.
Rule.Translated: También conocido como «escudo fragmentable», este cinturón avanzado utiliza un generador especializado que proyecta capas de barreras resistentes pero quebradizas. Cuando recibe un ataque potente, una capa se desprende y desvía la energía del impacto, lo que limita la energía que el escudo puede perder de un solo golpe.\n\nEs algo más pesado que un cinturón de fase normal, tiene una resistencia total menor y se carga más despacio.

Rule.Original: Luxurious and extremely hard to aquire, used for its durability and protection.
Rule.Raw: Luxurious and extremely hard to aquire, used for its durability and protection.
Rule.Translated: Lujoso y extremadamente difícil de conseguir; se utiliza por su resistencia y protección.

Rule.Original: An extremely versatile material and equal to steel , commonly found in a form of insect exoskeletons.
Rule.Raw: An extremely versatile material and equal to steel , commonly found in a form of insect exoskeletons.
Rule.Translated: Un material extremadamente versátil y equiparable al acero, que suele encontrarse en forma de exoesqueletos de insectos.

Rule.Original: A scale shed from a dragon. It's a bit better than steel, can be used as a construction material.
Rule.Raw: A scale shed from a dragon. It's a bit better than steel, can be used as a construction material.
Rule.Translated: Una escama desprendida de un dragón. Es algo mejor que el acero y puede usarse como material de construcción.
Una moqueta agradable y cómoda de aspecto acogedor.

Rule.Original: Industrial-style asphalt used to create roads and streets. Very easy to traverse for people and vehicles alike.
Rule.Raw: Industrial-style asphalt used to create roads and streets. Very easy to traverse for people and vehicles alike.
Rule.Translated: Asfalto al estilo industrial utilizado para crear carreteras y calles. Muy fácil de transitar para las personas y los vehículos por igual.

Rule.Original: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Raw: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Translated: Un suelo de tablas de madera que transmite una sensación cálida y hogareña. Aunque es rápido de colocar, también es muy inflamable.

Rule.Original: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Raw: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Translated: Un suelo de tablas de madera que transmite una sensación cálida y hogareña. Aunque es rápido de colocar, también es muy inflamable.

Rule.Original: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Raw: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Translated: Un suelo de tablas de madera que transmite una sensación cálida y hogareña. Aunque es rápido de colocar, también es muy inflamable.

Rule.Original: Field of grass with patches of soil here and there. Very pleasant to look at, it requires no resources to construct.
Rule.Raw: Field of grass with patches of soil here and there. Very pleasant to look at, it requires no resources to construct.
Rule.Translated: Un espacio con hierba y algunos parches de tierra aquí y allá. Muy agradable a la vista, y no requiere ningún recurso para su construcción.

Rule.Original: Beautifully trimmed grass with very high beauty value. Requires tremendous amounts of work to construct.
Rule.Raw: Beautifully trimmed grass with very high beauty value. Requires tremendous amounts of work to construct.
Rule.Translated: Un césped bellamente recortado con un valor de belleza muy alto. Su construcción requiere de una gran cantidad de trabajo.

Rule.Original: Old, broken apart asphalt, often found in the form of ancient highways around abandoned locations. Very easy to traverse for people and vehicles alike.
Rule.Raw: Old, broken apart asphalt, often found in the form of ancient highways around abandoned locations. Very easy to traverse for people and vehicles alike.
Rule.Translated: Asfalto viejo y destrozado, que a menudo se encuentra formando parte de antiguas carreteras y autopistas en lugares abandonados. Muy fácil de transitar para las personas y los vehículos por igual.

Rule.Original: Packed dirt, slightly enhancing movement speed, often forming paths around places of interest.
Rule.Raw: Packed dirt, slightly enhancing movement speed, often forming paths around places of interest.
Rule.Translated: Tierra compactada, que mejora ligeramente la velocidad de movimiento y que suele formar caminos en torno a los lugares de interés.

Rule.Original: Foundations are structures that can be built on mud, quicksand etc. Foundation allows more rapid movement across these normally slowing ground types. Once built, they can support many structures, including heavy structures and any other type of wall. Foundations allow for easier building in desert and swampy biomes. Floors cannot be built atop foundations.
Rule.Raw: Foundations are structures that can be built on mud, quicksand etc. Foundation allows more rapid movement across these normally slowing ground types. Once built, they can support many structures, including heavy structures and any other type of wall. Foundations allow for easier building in desert and swampy biomes. Floors cannot be built atop foundations.
Rule.Translated: Los cimientos son estructuras que pueden construirse sobre terrenos difíciles de transitar, tales como el barro o las arenas movedizas; y permiten un movimiento más rápido a través de los mismos. Una vez construidos, pueden sostener muchas estructuras, incluidas las pesadas y cualquier otro tipo de muro. Los cimientos permiten realizar construcciones con mayor facilidad en biomas desérticos y pantanosos. Pueden construirse suelos sobre los cimientos.

Rule.Original: A beautiful, impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: A beautiful, impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro hermoso e infranqueable. Es capaz de sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: A wall of horizontally placed wooden logs, for this nice, homely feeling. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: A wall of horizontally placed wooden logs, for this nice, homely feeling. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de troncos de madera colocados horizontalmente, para dar una sensación agradable y hogareña. Es capaz de sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: A metal fence made of posts joined by chain link sheets used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Rule.Raw: A metal fence made of posts joined by chain link sheets used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Rule.Translated: Una valla metálica hecha de postes unidos por mallas metálicas que se utiliza para construir corrales para ciertos tipos de animales. Algunos tipos de animales pueden atravesar las vallas. Los depredadores no cazan a los animales que están al otro lado de la valla, pero aún así pueden colarse en su interior.

Rule.Original:
A fence made of posts joined by vertical wooden boards called pickets, used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Picket fences are considerably more beautiful than alternatives, and evoke a nice, homely feeling.
Rule.Raw:
A fence made of posts joined by vertical wooden boards called pickets, used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Picket fences are considerably more beautiful than alternatives, and evoke a nice, homely feeling.
Rule.Translated: Una valla hecha de postes unidos por tablas verticales de madera llamadas piquetes que se utiliza para construir corrales para ciertos tipos de animales. Algunos tipos de animales pueden atravesar las vallas. Los depredadores no cazan a los animales que están al otro lado de la valla, pero aún así pueden colarse en su interior.\n\nLas vallas tradicionales son mucho más bonitas que otras alternativas y evocan una sensación acogedora y hogareña.

Rule.Original: A brick fence made tall brick pillars and a short fence in between them, used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Rule.Raw: A brick fence made tall brick pillars and a short fence in between them, used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Rule.Translated: Una valla de ladrillos formada por pilares altos de ladrillo y una valla corta entre ellos que se utiliza para construir corrales para ciertos tipos de animales. Algunos tipos de animales pueden atravesar las vallas. Los depredadores no cazan a los animales que están al otro lado de la valla, pero aún así pueden colarse en su interior.

Rule.Original: An invisible fence, for players wanting to create their own pens without fences, or to make it so that rivers or trees act as fence barriers. Does not have any path cost - thus not slowing down pawns wanting to traverse through it.
Rule.Raw: An invisible fence, for players wanting to create their own pens without fences, or to make it so that rivers or trees act as fence barriers. Does not have any path cost - thus not slowing down pawns wanting to traverse through it.
Rule.Translated: Una valla invisible, para aquellos jugadores que quieran crear sus propios corrales sin vallas, o hacer que los ríos o los árboles actúen como barreras naturales. No penaliza la capacidad de movimiento, por lo que no ralentizará a las personas que quieren atravesarla.

Rule.Original: A fence made of posts joined by crossbars used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Rule.Raw: A fence made of posts joined by crossbars used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.
Rule.Translated: Una valla hecha de postes unidos por travesaños que se utiliza para construir corrales para ciertos tipos de animales. Algunos tipos de animales pueden atravesar las vallas. Los depredadores no cazan a los animales que están al otro lado de la valla, pero aún así pueden colarse en su interior.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall made out of fake hedge. Very flammable.
Rule.Raw: An impassable wall made out of fake hedge. Very flammable.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable hecho de setos falsos. Muy inflamable.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall consisting of prison bars. Cannot be attacked by prisoners.
Rule.Raw: An impassable wall consisting of prison bars. Cannot be attacked by prisoners.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable formado por barrotes de prisión. No puede ser atacado por los prisioneros.

Rule.Original: A slow moving door that separates two rooms. Cell doors cannot be attacked by prisoners.
Rule.Raw: A slow moving door that separates two rooms. Cell doors cannot be attacked by prisoners.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta que se mueve lentamente y divide las habitaciones. Las puertas de prisión no pueden ser atacadas por los prisioneros.

Rule.Original: An impassable, heavy wall with multiple layers of armor. Nearly completely resistant to explosives and any breaching tools.
Rule.Raw: An impassable, heavy wall with multiple layers of armor. Nearly completely resistant to explosives and any breaching tools.
Rule.Translated: Un muro pesado e infranqueable con múltiples capas de blindaje. Es casi completamente resistente a los explosivos y a cualquier herramienta de demolición.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Armored doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. Armored doors are nearly entirely blast resistant and barely take damage from breaching methods.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Armored doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. Armored doors are nearly entirely blast resistant and barely take damage from breaching methods.
Rule.Translated: Divide las habitaciones. Las puertas acorazadas deben abrirse manualmente, lo que retrasa a las personas. Las puertas acorazadas son casi totalmente resistentes a las explosiones y apenas reciben daños cuando son atacadas.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown does not depend on what the door is made of.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown does not depend on what the door is made of.
Rule.Translated: Divide las habitaciones. Las puertas individuales deben abrirse manualmente, lo que retrasa a las personas. El grado de ralentización no depende del material de la puerta.

Rule.Original: A doorway with a gate easy enough to open so that it can be pushed open by animals. It allows animals to pass, but doesn’t insulate the room. Animal gates are often used as barn entrances in warmer climates.
Rule.Raw: A doorway with a gate easy enough to open so that it can be pushed open by animals. It allows animals to pass, but doesn’t insulate the room. Animal gates are often used as barn entrances in warmer climates.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta con una abertura lo suficientemente sencilla como para que los animales puedan empujarla para abrirla. Permite el paso de los animales, pero no retiene el calor. En climas cálidos, las puertas para animales suelen utilizarse como entradas a los establos.

Rule.Original: Executes a colonist. Every colonist sharing the Commissar's ideoligion receives a positive mood bonus.
Rule.Raw: Executes a colonist. Every colonist sharing the Commissar's ideoligion receives a positive mood bonus.
Rule.Translated: Ejecuta a un colono. Cada colono que comparta la ideoligión del comisario político recibirá una bonificación a su estado de humor.

Rule.Original: Try to persuade someone to adopt your beliefs. If it goes well, they will lose some certainty in their ideoligion and may convert. If it backfires, they will gain certainty in their old beliefs.\n\nTo start this ritual at a specific place, select a ritual spot or matching altar/ideogram.
Rule.Raw: Try to persuade someone to adopt your beliefs. If it goes well, they will lose some certainty in their ideoligion and may convert. If it backfires, they will gain certainty in their old beliefs.\n\nTo start this ritual at a specific place, select a ritual spot or matching altar/ideogram.
Rule.Translated: Intenta persuadir a alguien para que adopte tus creencias. Si sale bien, perderá algo de certeza en su ideología, convirtiéndose si es suficientemente baja. Si le sale mal, ganará seguridad en su ideoligión actual.\n\nPara iniciar este ritual en un lugar concreto, selecciona un punto de ritual o un altar/ideograma adecuado.

Rule.Original: Attempt to convert someone to the speaker's ideoligion. This will reduce the target's certainty in their own beliefs. The certainty reduction depends on the speaker's negotiation ability.
Rule.Raw: Attempt to convert someone to the speaker's ideoligion. This will reduce the target's certainty in their own beliefs. The certainty reduction depends on the speaker's negotiation ability.
Rule.Translated: Intenta convertir a alguien a la ideoligión del orador. Esto reducirá la certeza del objetivo en sus propias creencias. La reducción de la certeza depende de la capacidad de negociación del usuario.

Rule.Original: {INITIATOR_labelShort} failed to convert {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} was upset by the attempt, but {RECIPIENT_possessive} certainty fell from {CERTAINTYBEFORE} to {CERTAINTYAFTER}.
Rule.Raw: {INITIATOR_labelShort} failed to convert {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} was upset by the attempt, but {RECIPIENT_possessive} certainty fell from {CERTAINTYBEFORE} to {CERTAINTYAFTER}.
Rule.Translated: {INITIATOR_labelShort} no ha conseguido convertir a {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} se ha molestado por el intento, pero la certeza de {RECIPIENT_possessive} fe ha bajado de {CERTAINTYBEFORE} a {CERTAINTYAFTER}.

Rule.Original: Preach moral strength to a sick or wounded person through the concepts of your ideology. This will improve their rate of wound healing and immunity gain.
Rule.Raw: Preach moral strength to a sick or wounded person through the concepts of your ideology. This will improve their rate of wound healing and immunity gain.
Rule.Translated: Predica fuerza moral a una persona enferma o herida a través de los conceptos de tu ideología. Esto mejorará su ritmo de curación de heridas y de ganancia de inmunidad.

Rule.Original: Increase someone's certainty in their own beliefs. The regained certainty is based on the speaker's negotiation ability.
Rule.Raw: Increase someone's certainty in their own beliefs. The regained certainty is based on the speaker's negotiation ability.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la certeza de alguien en sus propias creencias. La cantidad de certeza recuperada depende de la capacidad de negociación del usuario.

Rule.Original: {INITIATOR_labelShort} has reassured {RECIPIENT_labelShort}, increasing {RECIPIENT_possessive} certainty in {IDEO} from {BEFORECERTAINTY} to {AFTERCERTAINTY}.
Rule.Raw: {INITIATOR_labelShort} has reassured {RECIPIENT_labelShort}, increasing {RECIPIENT_possessive} certainty in {IDEO} from {BEFORECERTAINTY} to {AFTERCERTAINTY}.
Rule.Translated: {INITIATOR_labelShort} ha tranquilizado a {RECIPIENT_labelShort} y ha aumentado la certeza de {RECIPIENT_possessive} fe en {IDEO} de {BEFORECERTAINTY} a {AFTERCERTAINTY}.

Rule.Original: Offer counsel to a person to cancel the effect of a sad memory. The chance of success depends on the speaker's social skills and their relationship with the listener.
Rule.Raw: Offer counsel to a person to cancel the effect of a sad memory. The chance of success depends on the speaker's social skills and their relationship with the listener.
Rule.Translated: Ofrece consejo a una persona para anular el efecto de un recuerdo triste. Las probabilidad de éxito depende de las habilidades sociales del usuario y de su relación con el oyente.

Rule.Original: {INITIATOR_labelShort} successfully counselled {RECIPIENT_labelShort}, canceling the mood impact of {2}.
Rule.Raw: {INITIATOR_labelShort} successfully counselled {RECIPIENT_labelShort}, canceling the mood impact of {2}.
Rule.Translated: {INITIATOR_labelShort} ha aconsejado con éxito a {RECIPIENT_labelShort} y ha anulado el efecto de {2} sobre su ánimo.
{INITIATOR_labelShort} ha aconsejado con éxito a {RECIPIENT_labelShort} y ha aumentado el nivel de {RECIPIENT_possessive} ánimo en {MOODBONUS}.

Rule.Original: {INITIATOR_labelShort} botched the attempt to counsel {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} has become upset.
Rule.Raw: {INITIATOR_labelShort} botched the attempt to counsel {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} has become upset.
Rule.Translated: {INITIATOR_labelShort} ha fracasado al intentar aconsejar a {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} se ha molestado.

Rule.Original: An ability to ignite flame sources and cause an explosion. Only works on wild fires, not on man-made fire structures.
Rule.Raw: An ability to ignite flame sources and cause an explosion. Only works on wild fires, not on man-made fire structures.
Rule.Translated: Una habilidad para avivar las llamas y causar una explosión. Solo funciona en fuegos naturales, no en estructuras de fuego creadas por el hombre.

Rule.Original: Harvests a fleshcrafted body part from a corpse.
Rule.Raw: Harvests a fleshcrafted body part from a corpse.
Rule.Translated: Extrae una parte del cuerpo de un cadáver, creando una parte de casquería.

Rule.Original: Targets an insectoid creature and tames it instantly.
Rule.Raw: Targets an insectoid creature and tames it instantly.
Rule.Translated: Apunta a una criatura insectoide y la domestica al instante.

Rule.Original: Constructs an insectoid nest that produces insect jelly. A sucessful insectoid hymn ritual must be conducted to reduce the cooldown of this ability.
Rule.Raw: Constructs an insectoid nest that produces insect jelly. A sucessful insectoid hymn ritual must be conducted to reduce the cooldown of this ability.
Rule.Translated: Construye un nido insectoide que produce jalea de insecto. Se debe realizar un ritual de himno insectoide con éxito para reducir el enfriamiento de esta habilidad.

Rule.Original: An ability to command a turret or mechanoid to self-destruct. The mechacker can target any turret, even enemy ones, as well as any mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: An ability to command a turret or mechanoid to self-destruct. The mechacker can target any turret, even enemy ones, as well as any mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Una habilidad que ordena la autodestrucción de una torreta o un mecanoide. El mecahacker puede apuntar a cualquier torreta, incluso a las enemigas, así como a cualquier mecanoide.

Rule.Original: Stops the Nurse’s Rest, Recreation and Hunger from dropping for 12 hours. During this time, Nurse can only do Doctoring jobs properly.
Rule.Raw: Stops the Nurse’s Rest, Recreation and Hunger from dropping for 12 hours. During this time, Nurse can only do Doctoring jobs properly.
Rule.Translated: Detiene el descenso de las necesidades de descanso, diversión y hambre durante 12 horas. Durante este tiempo, el usuario podrá realizar labores médicas de forma siempre correcta.

Rule.Original: A biological human arm, fleshcrafted from a corpse. This can be safely installed in colonists following a Fleshcrafting ideoligion, but will cause infections due to organ rejection in others.
Rule.Raw: A biological human arm, fleshcrafted from a corpse. This can be safely installed in colonists following a Fleshcrafting ideoligion, but will cause infections due to organ rejection in others.
Rule.Translated: Un brazo humano biológico, fabricado a partir de un cadáver. Puede instalarse con seguridad en colonos que sigan una ideoligión basada en la casquería, pero causará infecciones por rechazo en otros.

Rule.Original: A biological human hand, fleshcrafted from a corpse. This can be safely installed in colonists following a Fleshcrafting ideoligion, but will cause infections due to organ rejection in others.

Rule.Original: disillusionment->had no hope for another future
Rule.Raw: disillusionment->had no hope for another future
Rule.Translated: disillusionment->no puede aspirar a otra cosa
disillusionment->no podría sobrevivir por su cuenta

Rule.Original: disillusionment->had no option but to submit
Rule.Raw: disillusionment->had no option but to submit
Rule.Translated: disillusionment->no tiene otra alternativa que rendirse

Rule.Original: It is our duty to spread our beliefs, even by force.
Rule.Raw: It is our duty to spread our beliefs, even by force.
Rule.Translated: Los infieles pueden elegir entre adoptar nuestras creencias o morir.

Rule.Original: We are guided by the stars.
Rule.Raw: We are guided by the stars.
Rule.Translated: Un examen minucioso de las estrellas desvelará poderes místicos que van más allá de cualquier cosa que podamos imaginar.

Rule.Original: Our leader must be worshipped as a living God.
Rule.Raw: Our leader must be worshipped as a living God.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro líder debe ser adorado como un Dios viviente, una manifestación física de nuestros ideales y preceptos.

Rule.Original: Work gives a man dignity, being productive is our duty.
Rule.Raw: Work gives a man dignity, being productive is our duty.
Rule.Translated: El trabajo dignifica al hombre. Una persona solo puede crecer de verdad con el trabajo duro y siendo productiva.

Rule.Original: Each person should be in perfect synchronicity. People should achieve consensus and come to agreement.
Rule.Raw: Each person should be in perfect synchronicity. People should achieve consensus and come to agreement.
Rule.Translated: Ni siquiera debería existir la idea del individualismo. Actuando en perfecta sincronía, nuestra sociedad será más que la suma de sus partes.

Rule.Original: Only through extreme biological experimentation may we unlock our hidden potential.
Rule.Raw: Only through extreme biological experimentation may we unlock our hidden potential.
Rule.Translated: Hay que evitar la tecnología, a menos que esté al servicio de la carne. Sólo a través de la experimentación biológica extrema podemos liberar nuestro potencial oculto.

Rule.Original: Sickness is a blesting, and should be considered a gift.
Rule.Raw: Sickness is a blesting, and should be considered a gift.
Rule.Translated: Ser tocado por la peste es una bendición que debe ser codiciada. Así como las enfermedades se extienden, también lo hará nuestra influencia.

Rule.Original: Crafting is an essential part of our culture, and we treat it with great respect.
Rule.Raw: Crafting is an essential part of our culture, and we treat it with great respect.
Rule.Translated: Hay que aspirar a sentir el dolor de los dedos después de un largo día de trabajo artesanal. Un herrero o un sastre con talento debe ser digno.

Rule.Original: We should use automation to do our work, people should not do work normally meant for machines.
Rule.Raw: We should use automation to do our work, people should not do work normally meant for machines.
Rule.Translated: Las máquinas, las fábricas, los drones, un objetivo para cualquier comunidad de éxito debería ser la optimización de estos dispositivos y evitar la idea de que los seres inteligentes realicen tareas normalmente destinadas a ellos.

Rule.Original: Kings and Queens are the true path to prosperity, the mind of the common man is unfit for leadership.
Rule.Raw: Kings and Queens are the true path to prosperity, the mind of the common man is unfit for leadership.
Rule.Translated: Los reyes y las reinas son el verdadero camino hacia la prosperidad, la mente del hombre común no es apta para el liderazgo.

Rule.Original: setup(tag=meme_Aristocratic) ->Our founder [founderName] was a great sociologist, who saw the weak democratic systems in [founder_possessive] native world and found them incredibly inadequate. [founder_pronoun] chartered a private spaceship and left with hundreds of [founder_possessive] followers to create the ideal feudal society.
