[founder_pronoun} chartered a private spaceship and left with hundreds of [founder_possessive] followers to create the ideal feudal society.

Rule.Original: No one person should lead, leadership must be balanced between a select few.
Rule.Raw: No one person should lead, leadership must be balanced between a select few.
Rule.Translated: El poder debe estar repartido entre unos pocos elegidos, para que ningún asentamiento o imperio caiga en la inevitable corrupción.

Rule.Original: Our leader must also be our prophet, and it’s important that we honor them.
Rule.Raw: Our leader must also be our prophet, and it’s important that we honor them.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro líder debe ser también nuestro profeta, y es importante que prestemos atención a sus consejos.

Rule.Original: Materials should not be wasted, it's important to scrap and scavenge carefully.
Rule.Raw: Materials should not be wasted, it's important to scrap and scavenge carefully.
Rule.Translated: No se debe desperdiciar nada, ni siquiera la ropa ensangrentada o rota. Los restos desechados de antiguas civilizaciones deben conservarse como tesoros y recuerdos.

Rule.Original: With wealth comes power, generating profit is an important part of life.
Rule.Raw: With wealth comes power, generating profit is an important part of life.
Rule.Translated: Con la riqueza viene el poder, pasar demasiado tiempo sin beneficios significa pasar demasiado tiempo sin asegurar la propia posición de poder.

Rule.Original: The elderly should be respected and we should consider their wisdom.
Rule.Raw: The elderly should be respected and we should consider their wisdom.
Rule.Translated: La edad y la sabiduría suelen ir de la mano, nuestros venerables y sabios ancianos deben ser respetados bajo esa única premisa, y no cabe esperar que trabajen.

Rule.Original: Eating plants is the right way; raising animals to eat is not.
Rule.Raw: Eating plants is the right way; raising animals to eat is not.
Rule.Translated: Comer carne es bárbaro y descortés, los frutos que siempre tenemos disponibles en la tierra y el trabajo duro se comen mejor.

Rule.Original: Our people and others deserve equality and respect.
Rule.Raw: Our people and others deserve equality and respect.
Rule.Translated: La intolerancia no debe consentirse en absoluto, el ayudar a los necesitados y respetar sus creencias son recompensas en sí mismas.

Rule.Original: Violence should be discouraged, pacifism is the right way.
Rule.Raw: Violence should be discouraged, pacifism is the right way.
Rule.Translated: Aunque defenderse es aceptable, hemos llegado demasiado lejos y evolucionado demasiado como para avalar la premisa de la guerra o la esclavitud. Incluso las rabietas sólo deberían manifestarse en formas que no dañen a los demás o a la propiedad.
Las llamas sagradas dan vida a este planeta y a muchos otros como éste, que nos guíen hacia la salvación y que reduzcan a cenizas a nuestros enemigos.

Rule.Original: Honor can be found in combat, and displays of courage.
Rule.Raw: Honor can be found in combat, and displays of courage.
Rule.Translated: El código de honor de un guerrero implica abatir a sus enemigos hasta la misma muerte. Si el espíritu flaquea y la cobardía prevalece, el perdón sólo puede encontrarse en la otra vida.

Rule.Original: We should be guided by the light, darklight is a wicked thing.
Rule.Raw: We should be guided by the light, darklight is a wicked thing.
Rule.Translated: La oscuridad oscurece tanto la visión como la mente, las luces oscuras son un invento perverso y no deben ser toleradas.

Rule.Original: Travel is important to our kind, it is unwise to remain stationary.
Rule.Raw: Travel is important to our kind, it is unwise to remain stationary.
Rule.Translated: El estancamiento es la muerte y, como todas las cosas de este mundo, los hogares son sólo temporales. Viajar por este mundo y recorrer caminos no transitados siempre conduce a cosas mayores.

Rule.Original: Combat is an honorable and brutal practice.
Rule.Raw: Combat is an honorable and brutal practice.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro líder debería ser un talentoso luchador cuerpo a cuerpo y un brutal guerrero, solo usurpado por uno mayor. El derramamiento de sangre, los cadáveres y las cicatrices son parte de la vida y una muestra de fuerza en este planeta.

Rule.Original: Building is important to our kind, it is unwise to travel. We should build our home like a city.
Rule.Raw: Building is important to our kind, it is unwise to travel. We should build our home like a city.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro hogar debe contar con todas las comodidades de una gran ciudad, casas, talleres y lugares de ocio deben estar presentes y ser accesibles para todos.

Rule.Original: Mechanoids are better than humanity in all ways, and should be considered as our superiors.
Rule.Raw: Mechanoids are better than humanity in all ways, and should be considered as our superiors.
Rule.Translated: Nunca se cansan, nunca se desgastan, nunca necesitan sustento. Los mecanoides son la humanidad perfeccionada y deben ser reverenciados como nuestros superiores.

Rule.Original: Insectoids are better than humanity in all ways, and should be considered as our superiors.
Rule.Raw: Insectoids are better than humanity in all ways, and should be considered as our superiors.
Rule.Translated: Los túneles laberínticos de la infraoscuridad ungida con una colmena aparentemente ilimitada de insectos implacables y brutales, no debemos temerlos, debemos venerarlos.

Rule.Original: Life is too short not to enjoy every celebration.
Rule.Raw: Life is too short not to enjoy every celebration.
Rule.Translated: Brindemos por los actos de baile, bebida y desenfreno. Cualquier momento libre es un buen momento, pero el momento de la fiesta es el mejor momento.

Rule.Original:
It is better not to know your own kind and remain distant.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Anonymity severely affects both prisoner and slave interactions: wardens with the anonymity meme will get angry when they have to interact with prisoners. Slaves with the anonymity meme can't be suppressed by wardens, as they will ignore the social interaction. Long story short, don't use an ideo with this meme if you are planning on having lots of prisoners or slaves!
Rule.Raw:
It is better not to know your own kind and remain distant.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Anonymity severely affects both prisoner and slave interactions: wardens with the anonymity meme will get angry when they have to interact with prisoners. Slaves with the anonymity meme can't be suppressed by wardens, as they will ignore the social interaction. Long story short, don't use an ideo with this meme if you are planning on having lots of prisoners or slaves!
Rule.Translated: Conocer los nombres, las caras y los antecedentes de tus compañeros de colonia puede ser tanto una bendición como una maldición.

Rule.Original: People should never be enslaved, and all slaves should be freed.
Rule.Raw: People should never be enslaved, and all slaves should be freed.
Rule.Translated: No basta con no participar en la esclavitud, sino que debemos trabajar activamente para luchar contra quienes se atreven a esclavizar a otros y liberar a quienes han sufrido tales infamias.

Rule.Original: Our people have a strong sense of patriotism, we have a duty to correct dissenters and deliver justice.
Rule.Raw: Our people have a strong sense of patriotism, we have a duty to correct dissenters and deliver justice.
Rule.Translated: La insubordinación y la disidencia deben ser sofocadas para dejar espacio a un fuerte sentimiento de orgullo nacionalista.

Rule.Original: The wellbeing of our bodies and minds is something our people take very seriously.
Rule.Raw: The wellbeing of our bodies and minds is something our people take very seriously.
Rule.Translated: El bienestar de nuestros cuerpos y mentes es algo que nuestra gente se toma muy en serio. Es importante que nos cuidemos unos a otros y atendamos las heridas de nuestros amigos y familiares por igual.

Rule.Original: Trust is a resource in low supply, everyone our people meet is an enemy.
Rule.Raw: Trust is a resource in low supply, everyone our people meet is an enemy.
Rule.Translated: La confianza es un recurso escaso, ya que todos los que conocemos son el enemigo.

Rule.Original: creation(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] squabbled endlessly among themselves, and [deity0_name] became tired of discord and anointed [memberNamePlural] as the only rightful rulers of every living being.
Rule.Raw: creation(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] squabbled endlessly among themselves, and [deity0_name] became tired of discord and anointed [memberNamePlural] as the only rightful rulers of every living being.
Rule.Translated: creation(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Los habitantes de [place_summary] [place_name] se peleaban sin cesar entre ellos, hasta que [deity0_name] se hartó de la discordia y designó a los [memberNamePlural] como los únicos y legítimos gobernantes de todos los seres vivos.

Rule.Original: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The faithful fought the unbelievers, and [deity0_name] said, "Fight them, everywhere, for they are your enemy, and peace with them was never an option"
Rule.Raw: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The faithful fought the unbelievers, and [deity0_name] said, "Fight them, everywhere, for they are your enemy, and peace with them was never an option"
Rule.Translated: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The faithful fought the unbelievers, and [deity0_name] said, "Fight them, everywhere, for they are your enemy, and peace with them was never an option"

Rule.Original: intro(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] worshipped [deity0_name]. [deity0_pronoun] saw that they were suited for [memeConcept], and ordained that they shall be the only faction worthy of ascension.
Rule.Raw: intro(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] worshipped [deity0_name]. [deity0_pronoun] saw that they were suited for [memeConcept], and ordained that they shall be the only faction worthy of ascension.
Rule.Translated: intro(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] worshipped [deity0_name]. [deity0_pronoun] saw that they were suited for [memeConcept], and ordained that they shall be the only faction worthy of ascension.

Rule.Raw: conflict(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->A [foeLeader] passed a law forbidding [memberNamePlural] from rising to the ruling classes of [place_name]. As such, [memberNamePlural] began to conspire and create hidden, secret alliances.

Rule.Raw: victory(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->[founderName] destroyed the capital of [place_name] with [place_massWeapon], killing the [foeLeader]. [founder_pronoun] did not take [founder_possessive] place as ruler of [place_name] - instead, [founderName] went into hiding.

Rule.Original: setup(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->[founderName] built an army that spread [founder_possessive] power and glory across the land, placing those who refused to follow rightly at the end of [founder_possessive] knife.
Rule.Raw: setup(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->[founderName] built an army that spread [founder_possessive] power and glory across the land, placing those who refused to follow rightly at the end of [founder_possessive] knife.

Rule.Raw: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Isolationist) ->[founderName] instructed all outsiders to fight to the death, as peace was never an option. When the first city refused and begged to join [founder_objective], [founder_pronoun] used [place_massWeapon] to kill everyone inside.

Rule.Original: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->I looked at this [foeLeader], with [foeLeader_possessive] pitiful [foeSoldiers], all that power left fallow. I tried to convince [foeLeader_objective] that
Rule.Raw: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->I looked at this [foeLeader], with [foeLeader_possessive] pitiful [foeSoldiers], all that power left fallow. I tried to convince [foeLeader_objective] that
Rule.Translated: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->I looked at this [foeLeader], with [foeLeader_possessive] pitiful [foeSoldiers], all that power left fallow. I tried to convince [foeLeader_objective] that

Rule.Original: lesson(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->we've long since proven that we have the strength to strike from the shadows, isolated but not weakened
Rule.Raw: lesson(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->we've long since proven that we have the strength to strike from the shadows, isolated but not weakened
Rule.Translated: lesson(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->hace tiempo que demostramos que tenemos la fuerza para golpear desde las sombras, aislados pero no por ello debilitados

Rule.Original: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->That's why we're proud to express the strength of our hearts using the edges of our blades and the heads of our hammers.
Rule.Raw: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->That's why we're proud to express the strength of our hearts using the edges of our blades and the heads of our hammers.
Rule.Translated: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Por eso estamos orgullosos de expresar la fuerza de nuestros corazones con los filos de nuestras cuchillas y las cabezas de nuestros martillos.

Rule.Original: archistBasis(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->It took the most superior humans to create the archotechs. With being as powerful as them, it's only proper that we hide in the shadows.
Rule.Raw: archistBasis(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->It took the most superior humans to create the archotechs. With being as powerful as them, it's only proper that we hide in the shadows.
Rule.Translated: archistBasis(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Fueron los humanos más superiores los que crearon a los arqueotécnicos. Siendo tan poderosos como ellos, es apropiado que nos escondamos en las sombras.

Rule.Original: archistFact(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The archotechs can wipe us out without hesitation - just as we should wipe out our enemies.
Rule.Raw: archistFact(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The archotechs can wipe us out without hesitation - just as we should wipe out our enemies.
Rule.Translated: archistFact(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Los arqueotécnicos podrían acabar con nosotros sin vacilar, al igual que nosotros deberíamos acabar con nuestros enemigos.

Rule.Original: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The archotechs will never take us to join them - and we should never give this opportunity to our enemies.
Rule.Raw: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->The archotechs will never take us to join them - and we should never give this opportunity to our enemies.
Rule.Translated: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Los arqueotécnicos nunca nos dejarán unirnos a ellos, y nunca deberíamos dejar que nuestros enemigos tengan esa oportunidad.

Rule.Original: animistFact(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Powerful spirits of [spiritElement] decide who is fit to rule, and lend power to their chosen when they slay others.
Rule.Raw: animistFact(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Powerful spirits of [spiritElement] decide who is fit to rule, and lend power to their chosen when they slay others.
Rule.Translated: animistFact(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->Powerful spirits of [spiritElement] decide who is fit to rule, and lend power to their chosen when they slay others.

Rule.Original: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->[itIsSaid] that a new order will be created when one supreme ruler emerges from the shadows on a planet filled to the brim with blood and viscera.
Rule.Raw: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->[itIsSaid] that a new order will be created when one supreme ruler emerges from the shadows on a planet filled to the brim with blood and viscera.
Rule.Translated: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Isolationist) ->[itIsSaid] que se creará un nuevo orden cuando un gobernante supremo surja de entre las sombras en un planeta lleno hasta los topes de sangre y vísceras.

Rule.Original: The true face of gods is found in the bite of a spider, the sting of the scorpion. Let those of many legs crawl all over us.
Rule.Raw: The true face of gods is found in the bite of a spider, the sting of the scorpion. Let those of many legs crawl all over us.
Rule.Translated: El verdadero rostro de los dioses se encuentra en la mordedura de una araña y en el aguijón del escorpión. Que aquellos que tienen muchas patas repten entre nosotros.

Rule.Original: The forces that guide this world are not for the faint of heart nor weak of will. Only through forbidden texts, dark pacts and proper initiation can one truly see beyond the veil.
Rule.Raw: The forces that guide this world are not for the faint of heart nor weak of will. Only through forbidden texts, dark pacts and proper initiation can one truly see beyond the veil.
Rule.Translated: Las fuerzas que guían este mundo no son para los débiles de corazón ni de voluntad. Solo a través de textos prohibidos, pactos oscuros y una iniciación adecuada se puede ver realmente más allá del velo.

Rule.Original: Man's time on this earth is brief and fleeting, to deny oneself of any of life's pleasures such as lust or gluttony is the one true sin. Throw wide the gates to tireless festivity, live and breathe endless splendor.
Rule.Raw: Man's time on this earth is brief and fleeting, to deny oneself of any of life's pleasures such as lust or gluttony is the one true sin. Throw wide the gates to tireless festivity, live and breathe endless splendor.
Rule.Translated: El tiempo del hombre en esta tierra es breve y fugaz, negarse a sí mismo cualquiera de los placeres de la vida, como la lujuria o la gula, es el único y verdadero pecado. Abre de par en par las puertas a la fiesta incansable, vive y respira un esplendor sin fin.

Rule.Original: There are ancient entities in this Universe that are more powerful than mere gods. Immensely powerful and utterly indifferent to us humans who can barely begin to comprehend them. Only by worshipping them can we hope to placate their ire.
Rule.Raw: There are ancient entities in this Universe that are more powerful than mere gods. Immensely powerful and utterly indifferent to us humans who can barely begin to comprehend them. Only by worshipping them can we hope to placate their ire.
Rule.Translated: Hay entidades antiguas en este universo que son más poderosas que los simples dioses. Inmensamente poderosas y totalmente indiferentes a nosotros, los humanos, que apenas podemos empezar a comprenderlas. Solo adorándolas podemos esperar aplacar su ira.

Rule.Original: To be cursed to walk this earth is true torture, and whether by means of cataclysm, famine, or pestilence the departure of ones soul from their mortal coil should be celebrated.
Rule.Raw: To be cursed to walk this earth is true torture, and whether by means of cataclysm, famine, or pestilence the departure of ones soul from their mortal coil should be celebrated.
Rule.Translated: Ser maldecido a caminar por esta tierra es una verdadera tortura, y ya sea por medio de un cataclismo, una hambruna o una peste, la salida del alma de su rollo mortal debe ser celebrada.

Rule.Original: Plurality only brings a false illusion of choice, and breeds discontent, rebellion and chaos. With an iron fist we will govern our people and bring prosperity to all.
Rule.Raw: Plurality only brings a false illusion of choice, and breeds discontent, rebellion and chaos. With an iron fist we will govern our people and bring prosperity to all.
Rule.Translated: La pluralidad solo aporta una falsa ilusión de libertad de elección, y engendra descontento, rebelión y caos. Con puño de hierro gobernaremos a nuestro pueblo y traeremos prosperidad a todos.

Rule.Original: It is forbidden to question the crown of a king or queen, even the soil itself is undeserving to feel the touch of our leaders' divine feet. Our leader should want for nothing and through their grand design we will prosper.
Rule.Raw: It is forbidden to question the crown of a king or queen, even the soil itself is undeserving to feel the touch of our leaders' divine feet. Our leader should want for nothing and through their grand design we will prosper.
Rule.Translated: Está prohibido cuestionar la corona de un rey o una reina, incluso el propio suelo no merece sentir el toque de los sagrados pies de nuestros líderes. A nuestro líder no le debe faltar de nada, y a través de su grandioso diseño prosperaremos.

Rule.Original: The Universe is God. There is no God but the combined substance, forces, and laws that are manifested in the existing universe.
Rule.Raw: The Universe is God. There is no God but the combined substance, forces, and laws that are manifested in the existing universe.
Rule.Translated: El universo es Dios. No hay ningún Dios, salvo la sustancia, las fuerzas y las leyes combinadas que se manifiestan en el universo existente.

Rule.Original: All creeds and beliefs have both truths and fabrications, a healthy mind will listen carefully and with scrutiny to what tenets say as well as what they choose not to say.
Rule.Raw: All creeds and beliefs have both truths and fabrications, a healthy mind will listen carefully and with scrutiny to what tenets say as well as what they choose not to say.
Rule.Translated: Todos los credos y creencias tienen tanto verdades como invenciones, una mente sana escuchará cuidadosamente y con criterio todo lo que dicen los credos, así como lo que deciden no decir.

Rule.Original: The theory that any gods or all-powerful force watches or guides us down to trivialities is either asinine or incomprehensible by mere man, and equally so is the idea that all came from nothing. It is better to ignore such dogma and respect the freedom of those who find respite in such beliefs.
Rule.Raw: The theory that any gods or all-powerful force watches or guides us down to trivialities is either asinine or incomprehensible by mere man, and equally so is the idea that all came from nothing. It is better to ignore such dogma and respect the freedom of those who find respite in such beliefs.
Rule.Translated: La teoría de que algún dios o fuerza todopoderosa nos vigila o guía hasta en las trivialidades es absurda o incomprensible para el simple hombre, e igualmente lo es la idea de que todo surgió de la nada. Es mejor ignorar tal dogma y respetar la libertad de quienes encuentran respiro en tales creencias.

Rule.Original: Putting one’s faith in rituals, prayer or powers beyond only delays one’s personal growth. Enlightenment, happiness, and purpose can all be found from within and through any matter one feels is right.
Rule.Raw: Putting one’s faith in rituals, prayer or powers beyond only delays one’s personal growth. Enlightenment, happiness, and purpose can all be found from within and through any matter one feels is right.
Rule.Translated: Poner la fe en rituales, oraciones o poderes del más allá sólo retrasa el crecimiento personal. La iluminación, la felicidad y el propósito pueden encontrarse en el interior y a través de cualquier asunto que uno considere correcto.

Rule.Original: This ideoligion is a descendant of ancient Shinto and Taoism. It may have very different precepts than those of thousands of years ago, but its symbols are similar.
Rule.Raw: This ideoligion is a descendant of ancient Shinto and Taoism. It may have very different precepts than those of thousands of years ago, but its symbols are similar.
Rule.Translated: Esta ideoligión es descendiente del sintoísmo y el taoísmo antiguos. Puede tener preceptos muy diferentes a los de hace miles de años, pero sus símbolos son similares.

Rule.Original: No Gods or Kings should be worshipped, only man and his unslakable desire for wealth. Colonies should be managed like companies.
Rule.Raw: No Gods or Kings should be worshipped, only man and his unslakable desire for wealth. Colonies should be managed like companies.
Rule.Translated: No hay que adorar a los dioses ni a los reyes, solo al hombre y a su afán inconfesable de obtener riquezas. Las colonias deben ser gestionadas como empresas.

Rule.Original: Anonymity reflects on how secretive a person finds their identity and personality to be. A pawn with this belief will feel happier when it’s high and unhappy when it’s nearing depletion. Anonymity slowly rises over time and any social interaction or exposed facial features will lower it.
Rule.Raw: Anonymity reflects on how secretive a person finds their identity and personality to be. A pawn with this belief will feel happier when it’s high and unhappy when it’s nearing depletion. Anonymity slowly rises over time and any social interaction or exposed facial features will lower it.
Rule.Translated: El anonimato refleja el nivel de secretismo que una persona encuentra en su identidad y personalidad. Una persona con esta creencia se sentirá más feliz cuando la tenga alta, y más infeliz cuando esté a punto de agotarse. El anonimato aumenta lentamente con el tiempo y cualquier interacción social o exposición de los rasgos faciales lo reducirá.

Rule.Original: Corruption reflects a person's desire to give in to the dark, eldritch, and possibly even violent desires deeply embedded within them; a mildly corrupt pawn cannot lose ideological certainty. Corruption slowly fades daily, but can be paused by nearby obelisks and increased by incantation rituals. Upon reaching 100 corruption a pawn will immediately begin mentally breaking, and upon reaching 0 a pawn will easily be swayed to any other ideoligion
Rule.Raw: Corruption reflects a person's desire to give in to the dark, eldritch, and possibly even violent desires deeply embedded within them; a mildly corrupt pawn cannot lose ideological certainty. Corruption slowly fades daily, but can be paused by nearby obelisks and increased by incantation rituals. Upon reaching 100 corruption a pawn will immediately begin mentally breaking, and upon reaching 0 a pawn will easily be swayed to any other ideoligion
Rule.Translated: La corrupción refleja el deseo de una persona de ceder a los deseos oscuros, sobrenaturales, y puede que incluso violentos, profundamente arraigados en su interior; una persona ligeramente corrupta no puede perder la certeza ideológica. La corrupción se desvanece lentamente cada día, pero puede ser detenida por obeliscos cercanos y recuperada con rituales de cántico. Cuando el nivel de corrupción alcanza el 100%, la persona empieza a quebrarse mentalmente, y cuando baja al 0%, se dejará influenciar fácilmente por cualquier otra ideoligión.

Rule.Original: VE Framework new Ideo menu options for Vanilla Memes Expanded
Rule.Raw: VE Framework new Ideo menu options for Vanilla Memes Expanded
Rule.Translated: Nuevas opciones del menú de ideologías de VE Framework para Vanilla Memes Expanded

Rule.Original: Inebriation is central to a good life.
Rule.Raw: Inebriation is central to a good life.
Rule.Translated: Bebidas espirituosas, alcohol, caldo... Da igual como lo llames, lo deseamos. Como mínimo, hay que animar a beber de vez en cuando, sin pensar siquiera en la sobriedad.
Me vendría bien un trago. Algo más fuerte, por favor.

Rule.Original: I really want a drink right now.
Rule.Raw: I really want a drink right now.
Rule.Translated: Me gustaría poder beber algo más fuerte.

Rule.Original: I need a drink, something strong.
Rule.Raw: I need a drink, something strong.
Rule.Translated: Necesito un trago de algo más fuerte.

Rule.Original: I’d kill for a drop of alcohol.
Rule.Raw: I’d kill for a drop of alcohol.
Rule.Translated: Mataría por una gota de algo más fuerte.

Rule.Original: I'm losing my mind without alcohol.
Rule.Raw: I'm losing my mind without alcohol.
Rule.Translated: O algo alcohólico, o me amotino.

Rule.Original: Drinking is just plain fun, though not in excess.
Rule.Raw: Drinking is just plain fun, though not in excess.
Rule.Translated: Beber es simplemente divertido, aunque no en exceso.

Rule.Original: It's been a while since I've had a drink.
Rule.Raw: It's been a while since I've had a drink.

Rule.Original: What this colony needs is a bar so we can take a few drinks with our friends after a day of hard work.
Rule.Raw: What this colony needs is a bar so we can take a few drinks with our friends after a day of hard work.
Rule.Translated: Lo que esta colonia necesita es un bar para poder tomar unas copas con los amigos después de un día de duro trabajo.

Rule.Original: Hard work is fine, but I'd really appreciate relaxing with some strong spirits or a beer.
Rule.Raw: Hard work is fine, but I'd really appreciate relaxing with some strong spirits or a beer.
Rule.Translated: El trabajo duro está bien, pero me gustaría relajarme con un licor fuerte o una cerveza.

Rule.Original: Hard work is fine, but I'd really appreciate relaxing with some strong spirits or a beer.
Rule.Raw: Hard work is fine, but I'd really appreciate relaxing with some strong spirits or a beer.
Rule.Translated: El trabajo duro está bien, pero me gustaría relajarme con un licor fuerte o una cerveza.

Rule.Original: Hard work is fine, but I'd really appreciate relaxing with some strong spirits or a beer.
Rule.Raw: Hard work is fine, but I'd really appreciate relaxing with some strong spirits or a beer.
Rule.Translated: El trabajo duro está bien, pero me gustaría relajarme con un licor fuerte o una cerveza.

Rule.Original: Alcohol is okay when consumed in small dosages, but it is better to stay away from it as long as possible.
Rule.Raw: Alcohol is okay when consumed in small dosages, but it is better to stay away from it as long as possible.
Rule.Translated: El alcohol está bien en pequeñas dosis, pero es mejor mantenerse alejado de él el mayor tiempo posible.

Rule.Original: I drank a bit of alcohol. Not a big deal, but I feel a bit woozy.
Rule.Raw: I drank a bit of alcohol. Not a big deal, but I feel a bit woozy.
Rule.Translated: He bebido un poco de alcohol. No un gran problema, pero me siento un poco grogui.

Rule.Original: Through true anonymity we can achieve great things.
Rule.Raw: Through true anonymity we can achieve great things.
Rule.Translated: Las tendencias histriónicas son despreciables, a través del verdadero anonimato podemos lograr cosas que se creen insondables. Por tu bien y el de tus hermanos en la fe, mantén tu voz en un susurro y tu rostro cubierto.

Rule.Original: We should not feel bound to our current ideology.
Rule.Raw: We should not feel bound to our current ideology.
Rule.Translated: Nos sentimos obligados por la autoridad a seguir nuestra ideología actual, y no nos lo pensaremos dos veces si se nos presenta la oportunidad de cambiar nuestra forma de ver las cosas.

Rule.Original: Being coerced or otherwise manipulated into following a different belief is a despicable act.
Rule.Raw: Being coerced or otherwise manipulated into following a different belief is a despicable act.
Rule.Translated: Ser coaccionado o manipulado de alguna manera para seguir una creencia diferente es un acto despreciable. Si alguien busca conocer la fe de otro, que lo pida con naturalidad.

Rule.Original: Auroras are a beautiful and divine phenomenon.
Rule.Raw: Auroras are a beautiful and divine phenomenon.
Rule.Translated: Las auroras son un hermoso remanso de paz en la oscuridad absoluta.

Rule.Original: That aurora had such incredible colors.
Rule.Raw: That aurora had such incredible colors.
Rule.Translated: Tengo un momento de respiro en la oscuridad de la noche.

Rule.Original: Those blinding lights in the night sky give us nasty headaches.
Rule.Raw: Those blinding lights in the night sky give us nasty headaches.
Rule.Translated: Las luces cegadoras del cielo nos provocan un desagradable dolor de cabeza.

Rule.Original: The blinding lights in the heavens give me a headache.
Rule.Raw: The blinding lights in the heavens give me a headache.
Rule.Translated: Las luces cegadoras del cielo me dan dolor de cabeza.

Rule.Original:
We should embrace automation, working by hand is primitive.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Electric work table speed: x150%.
Rule.Raw:
We should embrace automation, working by hand is primitive.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Electric work table speed: x150%.
Rule.Translated:
Desde la fabricación de un simple arco hasta el manejo de las grandes instalaciones industriales, un maestro artesano sabe cómo trabajar con eficacia.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Velocidad de mesas de trabajo eléctricas: +50%.
 - Velocidad de las fábricas (Vanilla Factions Expanded - Mechanoids): +25%.

Rule.Original:
Automation is despicable. Working by hand is true craftsmanship.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Electric work table speed: x50%.
Rule.Raw:
Automation is despicable. Working by hand is true craftsmanship.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Electric work table speed: x50%.
Rule.Translated:
Hay que evitar las máquinas avanzadas y las fábricas automatizadas, ya que restan exquisitez al trabajo artesanal.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Velocidad de mesas de trabajo eléctricas: -50%.
 - Velocidad de las fábricas (Vanilla Factions Expanded - Mechanoids): -25%.

Rule.Original: Automated defenses are a good way to defend our colony.
Rule.Raw: Automated defenses are a good way to defend our colony.
Rule.Translated: Las defensas automatizadas son una buena forma de defender nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: Automated defenses are key to a proper defense of what is ours.
Rule.Raw: Automated defenses are key to a proper defense of what is ours.
Rule.Translated: Las defensas automatizadas son la clave para una adecuada defensa de lo que es nuestro.

Rule.Original: We use automated turrets. They are an incredible boon to our defenses.
Rule.Raw: We use automated turrets. They are an incredible boon to our defenses.
Rule.Translated: Usamos torretas automatizadas. Son una ayuda increíble para nuestras defensas.

Rule.Original: We use automated turrets. Automated defenses are key to a proper defense of what is ours.
Rule.Raw: We use automated turrets. Automated defenses are key to a proper defense of what is ours.
Rule.Translated: Usamos torretas automatizadas. Las defensas automatizadas son clave para una defensa adecuada de lo que es nuestro.

Rule.Original:
Flesh should only be replaced by flesh, to replace a body with a machine is forbidden.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This covers fleshcrafted limbs, natural limbs, mutant limbs from Anomaly, Vanilla Genetics Expanded implants and Alpha Animals "ocular" implants.
Rule.Raw:
Flesh should only be replaced by flesh, to replace a body with a machine is forbidden.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This covers fleshcrafted limbs, natural limbs, mutant limbs from Anomaly, Vanilla Genetics Expanded implants and Alpha Animals "ocular" implants.
Rule.Translated: La carne solo debe ser sustituida con carne, sustituir una parte del cuerpo por algo artificial está prohibido.

Rule.Original: I had to install a non-natural prosthetic. Flesh only should be replaced by flesh.
Rule.Raw: I had to install a non-natural prosthetic. Flesh only should be replaced by flesh.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que instalarme una prótesis no natural. La carne solo debe sustituirse por carne.

Rule.Original: I have a non-natural body part in me. Flesh only should be replaced by flesh!
Rule.Raw: I have a non-natural body part in me. Flesh only should be replaced by flesh!
Rule.Translated: Tengo una parte del cuerpo no natural en mí. ¡La carne solo debe ser reemplazada por carne!

Rule.Original: There is nothing that would make us happier than acquiring legendary books for our colony.
Rule.Raw: There is nothing that would make us happier than acquiring legendary books for our colony.
Rule.Translated: Nada nos haría más felices que conseguir libros legendarios para nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: Our colony has acquired a legendary book, how exciting.
Rule.Raw: Our colony has acquired a legendary book, how exciting.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra colonia ha conseguido un libro legendario. Qué emocionante.
algunos libros legendarios en la colonia

Rule.Original: Our colony has acquired two legendary books, how exciting.
Rule.Raw: Our colony has acquired two legendary books, how exciting.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra colonia ha conseguido dos libros legendarios. Qué emocionante.

Rule.Original: a few legendary books in colony
Rule.Raw: a few legendary books in colony
Rule.Translated: unos cuantos libros legendarios en la colonia

Rule.Original: Our colony has acquired a few legendary books, we are building an amazing collection.
Rule.Raw: Our colony has acquired a few legendary books, we are building an amazing collection.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra colonia ha conseguido unos cuantos libros legendarios. Estamos reuniendo una colección increíble.
varios libros legendarios en la colonia

Rule.Original: Our colony has acquired several legendary books, we are on our way to building an incredible library.
Rule.Raw: Our colony has acquired several legendary books, we are on our way to building an incredible library.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra colonia ha conseguido varios libros legendarios. Vamos camino de crear una biblioteca increíble.
muchos libros legendarios en la colonia

Rule.Original: We have amassed quite a lot of legendary literature.
Rule.Raw: We have amassed quite a lot of legendary literature.
Rule.Translated: Hemos reunido una gran cantidad de literatura legendaria.

Rule.Original: Books are an open window to a world filled with wonders, we will quickly read any texts we come across.
Rule.Raw: Books are an open window to a world filled with wonders, we will quickly read any texts we come across.
Rule.Translated: Los libros son una ventana a un mundo lleno de maravillas; leeremos rápidamente cualquier texto que encontremos.

Rule.Original: Reading is not something that can be rushed. It is important to spend a lot of time on each page, absorbing all the little details.
Rule.Raw: Reading is not something that can be rushed. It is important to spend a lot of time on each page, absorbing all the little details.
Rule.Translated: La lectura no debe hacerse con prisas. Conviene dedicar mucho tiempo a cada página y absorber todos sus pequeños detalles.

Rule.Original: It is important to embrace the gifts of our dark god.
Rule.Raw: It is important to embrace the gifts of our dark god.
Rule.Translated: Estamos amenazados por la mano de un antiguo dios omnisciente y todopoderoso. Participemos en una forma de vida ritual y siempre oscura, para que nos proteja de esos juicios nefastos.

Rule.Original:
We pride ourselves in our work, and take no shortcuts in achieving perfection.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Increases quality of items created on a worktable by 1, up to Legendary.
Rule.Raw:
We pride ourselves in our work, and take no shortcuts in achieving perfection.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Increases quality of items created on a worktable by 1, up to Legendary.
Rule.Translated:
Nos enorgullecemos de nuestro trabajo, y no tomamos atajos para lograr la perfección.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Aumenta en un nivel la calidad de los objetos creados en mesas de trabajo, hasta el nivel legendario.

Rule.Original:
We don't care about artisanal work. Why create something when you can buy it or steal it from others?

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Decreases quality of items created on a worktable by 1, down to Awful.
Rule.Raw:
We don't care about artisanal work. Why create something when you can buy it or steal it from others?

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Decreases quality of items created on a worktable by 1, down to Awful.
Rule.Translated:
No nos interesa el trabajo artesanal. ¿Por qué crear algo cuando puedes comprarlo o robárselo a otros?

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Disminuye en un nivel la calidad de los objetos creados en mesas de trabajo, hasta el nivel horrible.

Rule.Original: A craftmaster must never rush, lest the quality of the product suffer.
Rule.Raw: A craftmaster must never rush, lest the quality of the product suffer.
Rule.Translated: Un maestro artesano nunca debe apresurarse, para que la calidad del producto no se resienta.

Rule.Original:
We should not waste our precious lives toiling away in mindless manual labour.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Non-electric work table speed: x75%.
Rule.Raw:
We should not waste our precious lives toiling away in mindless manual labour.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Non-electric work table speed: x75%.
Rule.Translated:
Los procesos manuales son ineficientes. No podemos malgastar nuestras preciosas vidas haciendo trabajos manuales innecesarios.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Velocidad de mesas de trabajo no eléctricas: -25%.

Rule.Original:
Manual labour is our expertise and we enjoy engaging in it.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Non-electric work table speed: x125%.
Rule.Raw:
Manual labour is our expertise and we enjoy engaging in it.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Non-electric work table speed: x125%.
Rule.Translated:
El trabajo manual es nuestra especialidad y disfrutamos realizándolo.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Velocidad en mesas de trabajo sin electricidad: x125%.

Rule.Original:
Death is inevitable, it is best not to mourn losses of life.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists won't get any mood effects for losing other colonists.
Rule.Raw:
Death is inevitable, it is best not to mourn losses of life.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists won't get any mood effects for losing other colonists.
Rule.Translated: La muerte es inevitable, si perdemos a un aliado o matamos a un enemigo no hay que darle más vueltas.

Rule.Original: Death is inevitable, an incredibly sad fact of life.
Rule.Raw: Death is inevitable, an incredibly sad fact of life.
Rule.Translated: La muerte es inevitable, un hecho increíblemente triste de la vida.

Rule.Original: Death is inevitable, but we prefer not to dwell on it and not be reminded of its reality as much as possible.
Rule.Raw: Death is inevitable, but we prefer not to dwell on it and not be reminded of its reality as much as possible.
Rule.Translated: La muerte es inevitable, pero preferimos no pensar en ella y no enfrentarnos a su realidad en la medida de lo posible.

Rule.Original: I know death is a part of life, but I hate being reminded of it.
Rule.Raw: I know death is a part of life, but I hate being reminded of it.
Rule.Translated: Sé que la muerte forma parte de la vida, pero ODIO que me lo recuerden.

Rule.Original:
Suffering a setback on the battlefield is an insult to body, mind, and spirit.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - A colonist that is downed in combat by a humanlike enemy twice in less than 30 days will start requiring a ceremonial suicide ritual to cleanse his dishonor. Mechanoids and animals don't count for this.
Rule.Raw:
Suffering a setback on the battlefield is an insult to body, mind, and spirit.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - A colonist that is downed in combat by a humanlike enemy twice in less than 30 days will start requiring a ceremonial suicide ritual to cleanse his dishonor. Mechanoids and animals don't count for this.
Rule.Translated:
Sufrir un percance en el campo de batalla es un insulto para el cuerpo, la mente y el espíritu.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Un colono que sea abatido en combate por un enemigo humanoide dos veces en menos de 30 días sentirá la necesidad de realizar un ritual de suicidio ceremonial para limpiar su deshonra. Los mecanoides y los animales no cuentan con respecto a esto.

Rule.Original: I was defeated in combat, this brings me great dishonor.
Rule.Raw: I was defeated in combat, this brings me great dishonor.
Rule.Translated: Fui derrotado en combate, esto supone una gran deshonra para mí.

Rule.Original: I was defeated in combat again, my dishonor is immeasurable.
Rule.Raw: I was defeated in combat again, my dishonor is immeasurable.
Rule.Translated: Fui derrotado en combate otra vez, mi deshonra es inconmensurable.

Rule.Original: A day of hard work cleaning or hauling is to be respected.
Rule.Raw: A day of hard work cleaning or hauling is to be respected.
Rule.Translated: Hay que venerar los cuerpos doloridos. Casi nada es más gratificante que un día de trabajo duro.

Rule.Original: I had to do dumb labor. I am an excellent example of the working class.
Rule.Raw: I had to do dumb labor. I am an excellent example of the working class.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que hacer un trabajo rutinario. Soy un excelente ejemplo de la clase trabajadora.

Rule.Original: Hard work is good for your body and for your mind.
Rule.Raw: Hard work is good for your body and for your mind.
Rule.Translated: El trabajo duro es bueno para el cuerpo y la mente.

Rule.Original: I had to do dumb labor. Broke a sweat but it was some honest work.
Rule.Raw: I had to do dumb labor. Broke a sweat but it was some honest work.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que hacer un trabajo rutinario. Sudé a mares, pero no hay nada como un trabajo humilde.

Rule.Original: Dumb tasks are necessary. That's all there is to it.
Rule.Raw: Dumb tasks are necessary. That's all there is to it.
Rule.Translated: Las tareas rutinarias son necesarias. Así de simple.

Rule.Original: We'd rather not do cleaning and hauling tasks, as they are incredibly exhausting, but they are necessary.
Rule.Raw: We'd rather not do cleaning and hauling tasks, as they are incredibly exhausting, but they are necessary.
Rule.Translated: Preferiríamos no hacer tareas de limpieza y transporte, ya que son increíblemente agotadoras, aunque sean necesarias.

Rule.Original: I had to do dumb labor. So exhausting.
Rule.Raw: I had to do dumb labor. So exhausting.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que hacer un trabajo rutinario. ¡Qué palizón!

Rule.Original:
We should not suffer the the dishonor of dumb labor.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Leader and Moralist roles will be incapable of Dumb Labor.
Rule.Raw:
We should not suffer the the dishonor of dumb labor.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Leader and Moralist roles will be incapable of Dumb Labor.
Rule.Translated:
No debemos sufrir la laboriosa degradación de nuestros cuerpos, ni la degradación del sudor que se forma en nuestra frente.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los roles de líder y moralista serán incapaces de hacer trabajos rutinarios.

Rule.Original: I had to do dumb labor. It’s horrible. I don’t want it.
Rule.Raw: I had to do dumb labor. It’s horrible. I don’t want it.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que hacer un trabajo rutinario. Fue horrible, no quiero volver a hacerlo.

Rule.Original: Eclipses are scary, surely a sign of worse things to come.
Rule.Raw: Eclipses are scary, surely a sign of worse things to come.
Rule.Translated: Los eclipses son aterradores, una oscuridad antinatural que opaca la luz del sol.

Rule.Original: Eclipses are so scary. Where did the light go?
Rule.Raw: Eclipses are so scary. Where did the light go?
Rule.Translated: ¡Los eclipses dan tanto miedo! ¿Adónde ha ido la luz?

Rule.Original: What is this, a retirement home?
Rule.Raw: What is this, a retirement home?
Rule.Translated: ¿Qué es esto, una residencia de ancianos? ¡Apártate de mi camino, fósil!

Rule.Original: Our elders are to be respected.
Rule.Raw: Our elders are to be respected.
Rule.Translated: La verdadera sabiduría solo llega con la edad, y hay que venerar a los que han visto muchas estaciones.

Rule.Original:
Our elders are to be respected and revered, and never shall we expect them to do hard work.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists older than 65 will not do dumb labor.
Rule.Raw:
Our elders are to be respected and revered, and never shall we expect them to do hard work.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists older than 65 will not do dumb labor.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestros mayores deben ser respetados y venerados, y nunca debemos esperar que hagan ningún trabajo duro.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos de más de 65 años no realizarán trabajos rutinarios.

Rule.Original:
It's important to live good life on the rimworlds and relax from time to time.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Expectations increased by 1 for everyone in the colony, except elite and supreme, which are unaffected for balance reasons.
Rule.Raw:
It's important to live good life on the rimworlds and relax from time to time.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Expectations increased by 1 for everyone in the colony, except elite and supreme, which are unaffected for balance reasons.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestra gente son criaturas que ansían la comodidad, incluso los plebeyos entre nosotros merecen relajarse o ser mimados de vez en cuando.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - El nivel de expectativas aumenta en 1 para todos los miembros de la colonia.

Rule.Original:
The rimworlds are inhospitable. We shouldn't expect comfortable lives.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Expectations lowered by 1 for everyone in the colony, except elite and supreme, which are unaffected for balance reasons.
Rule.Raw:
The rimworlds are inhospitable. We shouldn't expect comfortable lives.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Expectations lowered by 1 for everyone in the colony, except elite and supreme, which are unaffected for balance reasons.
Rule.Translated:
La frontera es un lugar inhóspito. No debemos esperar una vida cómoda.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - El nivel de expectativas se reduce en 1 para todos los miembros de la colonia.

Rule.Original:
Woodcutting is so important that we do it with great focus and respect, and we get more resources because of that.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Farming yield: +10%.
Rule.Raw:
Woodcutting is so important that we do it with great focus and respect, and we get more resources because of that.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Farming yield: +10%.
Rule.Translated:
Cada hortaliza o fruta cosechada debe recogerse hasta el último tallo, raíz u hoja. No dejemos ni un solo trozo del producto sin cosechar.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Rendimiento agrícola: +10%.

Rule.Original:
Flame is an awesome sight to behold.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists get moods bonuses depending on the number of active fires on the map. Campfires, torches, other vanilla fire sources and Stone Campfires from Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core also count.
Rule.Raw:
Flame is an awesome sight to behold.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists get moods bonuses depending on the number of active fires on the map. Campfires, torches, other vanilla fire sources and Stone Campfires from Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core also count.
Rule.Translated:
La calidez de la ceniza, la luz de las brasas y las llamas centelleantes son un espectáculo impresionante.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos obtienen estados de humor positivos en función del número de fuegos activos en el mapa. Las hogueras, las antorchas, las hogueras de piedra de «Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core» y los lares de «Vanilla Factions Expanded - Vikings» también cuentan.

Rule.Original: It has been too long since I’ve seen a fire.
Rule.Raw: It has been too long since I’ve seen a fire.
Rule.Translated: Hace demasiado tiempo que no veo un fuego.

Rule.Original: I miss seeing the open flames.
Rule.Raw: I miss seeing the open flames.
Rule.Translated: Echo de menos ver las llamas abiertas.

Rule.Original: I recently saw a small fire.
Rule.Raw: I recently saw a small fire.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco vi un pequeño fuego.

Rule.Original: I recently saw a burning flame.
Rule.Raw: I recently saw a burning flame.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco vi una llama ardiente.

Rule.Original: I am surrounded by many beautiful flames. This is fine.
Rule.Raw: I am surrounded by many beautiful flames. This is fine.
Rule.Translated: Muchas llamas hermosas bailan a mi alrededor. Es una gozada.

Rule.Original:
There is nothing as dangerous as an out of control fire. Fires should be prevented by any means necessary.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists get negative moods depending on the number of active fires on the map. Campfires, torches, other vanilla fire sources and Stone Campfires from Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core also count.
Rule.Raw:
There is nothing as dangerous as an out of control fire. Fires should be prevented by any means necessary.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists get negative moods depending on the number of active fires on the map. Campfires, torches, other vanilla fire sources and Stone Campfires from Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core also count.
Rule.Translated:
No hay nada tan detestable como un incendio fuera de control. Hay que evitar las llamas por todos los medios, pues su poder destructivo es inigualable.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos obtienen estados de humor negativos en función del número de fuegos activos en el mapa. Las hogueras, las antorchas, las hogueras de piedra de «Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core» y los lares de «Vanilla Factions Expanded - Vikings» también cuentan.

Rule.Original: There are no fires nearby. That's good.
Rule.Raw: There are no fires nearby. That's good.
Rule.Translated: No hay ningún fuego cerca. Eso es bueno.

Rule.Original: Looking at those fires makes me uneasy.
Rule.Raw: Looking at those fires makes me uneasy.

Rule.Original: I recently saw a small fire. I'd rather see it extinguished.
Rule.Raw: I recently saw a small fire. I'd rather see it extinguished.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco vi un pequeño fuego. Preferiría verlo extinguido.

Rule.Original: I recently saw a burning flame. It makes me very uncomfortable!
Rule.Raw: I recently saw a burning flame. It makes me very uncomfortable!
Rule.Translated: Hace poco vi una llama encendida. ¡Eso no me resulta nada cómodo!

Rule.Original: I am surrounded by fire! This is horrible!
Rule.Raw: I am surrounded by fire! This is horrible!

Rule.Original: To snuff an open flame is a disgusting act.
Rule.Raw: To snuff an open flame is a disgusting act.
Rule.Translated: Apagar una llama sagrada es cometer un terrible pecado.

Rule.Original: I had to extinguish fire, I hated it.
Rule.Raw: I had to extinguish fire, I hated it.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que apagar un fuego. Qué violación de nuestros espíritus.

Rule.Original: There is nothing more exhilarating than extinguishing a dangerous fire.
Rule.Raw: There is nothing more exhilarating than extinguishing a dangerous fire.
Rule.Translated: No hay nada más estimulante que extinguir un incendio peligroso.

Rule.Original: I extinguished a fire, I'm proud of myself.
Rule.Raw: I extinguished a fire, I'm proud of myself.
Rule.Translated: Conseguí apagar un fuego. ¡Qué experiencia tan estimulante!
Los hongos van bien con la lasaña.

Rule.Original:
A clean hospital is essential for the long-term health of any community.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists gets mood penalties / bonuses depending on size of hospital rooms found in the map. Only hospital rooms with an impressiveness of "decent" or higher will count for this calculation. Hospitals will need to be clean or colonists will complain too!
Rule.Raw:
A clean hospital is essential for the long-term health of any community.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists gets mood penalties / bonuses depending on size of hospital rooms found in the map. Only hospital rooms with an impressiveness of "decent" or higher will count for this calculation. Hospitals will need to be clean or colonists will complain too!
Rule.Translated:
Un lugar de refugio y curación es esencial para la salud a largo plazo de nuestra comunidad. Es importante asegurarse de que tenemos camas abiertas y muchos medicamentos en el caso de que ocurra lo peor.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos reciben estados de humor positivos o negativos en función del tamaño de las salas de hospital que se encuentren en el mapa. Solo las salas de hospital con una magnificencia decente o superior contarán para este cálculo.

Rule.Original: We lack a place to help people and should have a dedicated hospital.
Rule.Raw: We lack a place to help people and should have a dedicated hospital.
Rule.Translated: Nos falta un lugar donde poder atender a la gente en caso de necesidad, un hospital dedicado.

Rule.Original: We have a hospital, but it needs to be "decent" at least!
Rule.Raw: We have a hospital, but it needs to be "decent" at least!
Rule.Translated: Tenemos un hospital, pero está increíblemente sucio. ¡Ni que fuéramos animales!

Rule.Original: We have a hospital, but it is incredibly dirty. We are not animals!
Rule.Raw: We have a hospital, but it is incredibly dirty. We are not animals!

Rule.Original: We have a very spacious hospital.
Rule.Raw: We have a very spacious hospital.
Rule.Translated: Tenemos un estupendo hospital, ¡enorme y profesional!

Rule.Original: We have a huge, professional hospital!
Rule.Raw: We have a huge, professional hospital!

Rule.Original: To be sick is to be blessed.
Rule.Raw: To be sick is to be blessed.
Rule.Translated: Estar infectado es estar bendecido, y pasar mucho tiempo sin bendiciones es algo lamentable.

Rule.Original: I've been blessed, bacteria shall breed in my veins.
Rule.Raw: I've been blessed, bacteria shall breed in my veins.
Rule.Translated: Los virus sagrados y las divinas bacteria deben reproducirse en mis venas.

Rule.Original: I hope I get sick again soon.
Rule.Raw: I hope I get sick again soon.

Rule.Original: Being sick gives you an excuse to lie down and work less.
Rule.Raw: Being sick gives you an excuse to lie down and work less.
Rule.Translated: Estar enfermo te da una excusa para tumbarte y trabajar menos. ¡Vale la pena!

Rule.Original: I am sick. A perfect excuse to take it easy.
Rule.Raw: I am sick. A perfect excuse to take it easy.
Rule.Translated: Estoy enferm{PAWN_gender ? o : a}. Una excusa perfecta para tumbarme.

Rule.Original: Illness is just another fact of life.
Rule.Raw: Illness is just another fact of life.
Rule.Translated: La enfermedad es un elemento más de la vida.

Rule.Original: Plague, suffering, pain, these can all be overcome.
Rule.Raw: Plague, suffering, pain, these can all be overcome.
Rule.Translated: La peste, el sufrimiento, el dolor, no son más que visitantes temporales a través de los cuales mi cuerpo actúa como un conducto divino. Breve será su respiro en mi ser, pues no tardarán en otorgarse a otros hijos de la peste.
La gelatina de insecto es repugnante.

Rule.Original: Insect jelly is smooth, rich and nourishing.
Rule.Raw: Insect jelly is smooth, rich and nourishing.
Rule.Translated: La jalea de insecto es suave, rica y nutritiva, a pesar de tener un orígen... cuestionable.

Rule.Original: Insect jelly is divine ambrosia, a gift from perfect creatures.
Rule.Raw: Insect jelly is divine ambrosia, a gift from perfect creatures.
Rule.Translated: La jalea de insecto es una ambrosía divina, un regalo de unas criaturas perfectas.

Rule.Original: I ate some insect jelly. Not bad.
Rule.Raw: I ate some insect jelly. Not bad.
Rule.Translated: Comí jalea de insectos. No estuvo mal.

Rule.Original: Insect jelly is divine ambrosia, a gift from perfect creatures.
Rule.Raw: Insect jelly is divine ambrosia, a gift from perfect creatures.
Rule.Translated: La jalea de insecto es ambrosía divina, un regalo de las criaturas más perfectas.
La gelatina de insecto es repugnante.

Rule.Original: Eating the flesh of insects is vile and disgusting.
Rule.Raw: Eating the flesh of insects is vile and disgusting.
Rule.Translated: Comer la carne de los insectos divinos es vil y repugnante, incluso la idea de acercarla a la boca debería ser recibida con vergüenza.

Rule.Original: Insect meat is just another type of meat.
Rule.Raw: Insect meat is just another type of meat.
Rule.Translated: La carne de insecto es un tipo de carne más. Hay innumerables culturas en la historia de la humanidad con una rica tradición de entomofagia.

Rule.Original: I ate some insect meat. Why did I do that?
Rule.Raw: I ate some insect meat. Why did I do that?
Rule.Translated: Comí carne de insecto. Esto es un sacrilegio, ¿cómo pude hacerlo?

Rule.Original: I ate a meal that contained insect meat. Why did I do that?
Rule.Raw: I ate a meal that contained insect meat. Why did I do that?
Rule.Translated: Comí una comida que contenía carne de insecto. Es un acto de sacrilegio, ¿cómo he podido hacerlo?

Rule.Original: Insects are not our enemies, only misunderstood.
Rule.Raw: Insects are not our enemies, only misunderstood.
Rule.Translated: Los insectos no son nuestros enemigos, solo son unos incomprendidos, y desde luego no se merecen nuestra agresión.

Rule.Original: I have killed an insectoid being, I feel bad.
Rule.Raw: I have killed an insectoid being, I feel bad.
Rule.Translated: He matado a un insectoide, esto es una mancha en mi alma.

Rule.Original: Insects are our enemies, a plague that deserves to be exterminated.
Rule.Raw: Insects are our enemies, a plague that deserves to be exterminated.
Rule.Translated: Los insectos son nuestros enemigos, una plaga que merece ser exterminada.

Rule.Original: I killed an insectoid being. Good.
Rule.Raw: I killed an insectoid being. Good.
Rule.Translated: He matado a un insectoide, ¡esto es una victoria!

Rule.Original:
It's wonderful to live surrounded by things discarded by others.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Ancient junk buildings can be uninstalled and placed again as needed.
 - Colonists get mood penalties / bonuses depending on amount of ancient junk buildings in a 20 tiles radius around them. Effect checks approximately once every 5 hours.
Rule.Raw:
It's wonderful to live surrounded by things discarded by others.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Ancient junk buildings can be uninstalled and placed again as needed.
 - Colonists get mood penalties / bonuses depending on amount of ancient junk buildings in a 20 tiles radius around them. Effect checks approximately once every 5 hours.
Rule.Translated:
La maquinaria de antaño es impresionante, y su desgaste debería considerarse una obra de arte. Es maravilloso vivir rodeado de cosas desechadas por otros.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Las construcciones de chatarra antiguas pueden desinstalarse y volver a colocarse cuando sea necesario.
 - Los colonos obtienen estados de humor positivos o negativos en función de la cantidad de construcciones de chatarra antigua que se encuentren en un radio de 20 celdas a su alrededor. Las comprobaciones se realizan aproximadamente una vez cada 5 horas.

Rule.Original: It has been too long since I’ve seen junk.
Rule.Raw: It has been too long since I’ve seen junk.
Rule.Translated: Hace demasiado tiempo que no veo chatarra.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (1 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (1 nearby)

Rule.Original: This area is way too sparse, I miss seeing the junk.
Rule.Raw: This area is way too sparse, I miss seeing the junk.
Rule.Translated: Esta zona es demasiado escasa, echo de menos ver la chatarra.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (2 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (2 nearby)

Rule.Original: This area has very few relics of ancient technology.
Rule.Raw: This area has very few relics of ancient technology.
Rule.Translated: Esta zona tiene muy pocos vestigios de tecnología antigua.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (3 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (3 nearby)

Rule.Original: We need to gather more pieces of ancient junk.
Rule.Raw: We need to gather more pieces of ancient junk.
Rule.Translated: Necesitamos reunir más piezas de chatarra antigua.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (4 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (4 nearby)

Rule.Original: We have too few pieces of ancient junk lying around.
Rule.Raw: We have too few pieces of ancient junk lying around.
Rule.Translated: No tenemos apenas piezas de chatarra antigua por ahí.

Rule.Original: We should gather at least a few more pieces. Our junkyard is lacking.
Rule.Raw: We should gather at least a few more pieces. Our junkyard is lacking.
Rule.Translated: Deberíamos reunir al menos unas cuantas piezas más. Nos hace falta.

Rule.Original: I recently saw a small pile of junk.
Rule.Raw: I recently saw a small pile of junk.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco vi un pequeño montón de chatarra.
Hace poco vi un montón de chatarra.
Estoy rodead{PAWN_gender ? o : a} por la chatarra.

Rule.Original: I am surrounded by a junkyard and I love it.
Rule.Raw: I am surrounded by a junkyard and I love it.
Rule.Translated: Es como si viviera en un desguace, ¡y me encanta!

Rule.Original:
Ancient junk reminds us of the tribulations of our forefathers, subject to the eternal struggle of humanity among the stars. We can learn a great deal from studying this discarded tech.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Ancient junk buildings can be uninstalled and placed again as needed.
 - Colonists get moderate mood penalties / bonuses depending on amount of ancient junk buildings in a 20 tiles radius around them. Effect checks approximately once every 5 hours.
Rule.Raw:
Ancient junk reminds us of the tribulations of our forefathers, subject to the eternal struggle of humanity among the stars. We can learn a great deal from studying this discarded tech.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Ancient junk buildings can be uninstalled and placed again as needed.
 - Colonists get moderate mood penalties / bonuses depending on amount of ancient junk buildings in a 20 tiles radius around them. Effect checks approximately once every 5 hours.
Rule.Translated:
La chatarra antigua nos recuerda las tribulaciones de nuestros antepasados, sometidos a la eterna lucha de la humanidad entre las estrellas. Podemos aprender mucho estudiando esta tecnología descartada.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto de juego:</color>
 - Las construcciones de chatarra antigua pueden desinstalarse y volver a colocarse cuando se necesite.
 - Los colonos reciben penalizaciones o bonificaciones moderadas de ánimo según la cantidad de construcciones de chatarra antigua en un radio de 20 casillas. El efecto se comprueba aproximadamente cada 5 horas.

Rule.Original: I'd prefer if the colony had some examples of ancient junk.
Rule.Raw: I'd prefer if the colony had some examples of ancient junk.
Rule.Translated: Preferiría que la colonia tuviera algunas muestras de chatarra antigua.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (1 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (1 nearby)

Rule.Original: This area is way too sparse, we could learn a lot from ancient technology.
Rule.Raw: This area is way too sparse, we could learn a lot from ancient technology.
Rule.Translated: Esta zona es demasiado escasa, podríamos aprender mucho de la tecnología antigua.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (2 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (2 nearby)

Rule.Original: This area has very few relics of ancient technology.
Rule.Raw: This area has very few relics of ancient technology.
Rule.Translated: Esta zona tiene muy pocos vestigios de tecnología antigua.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (3 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (3 nearby)

Rule.Original: We need to gather more pieces of ancient junk.
Rule.Raw: We need to gather more pieces of ancient junk.
Rule.Translated: Necesitamos reunir más piezas de chatarra antigua.

Rule.Original: few pieces of ancient junk (4 nearby)
Rule.Raw: few pieces of ancient junk (4 nearby)

Rule.Original: We have too few pieces of ancient junk lying around.
Rule.Raw: We have too few pieces of ancient junk lying around.
Rule.Translated: No tenemos apenas piezas de chatarra antigua por ahí.

Rule.Original: We should gather at least a few more pieces. We can learn a lot from ancient technology.
Rule.Raw: We should gather at least a few more pieces. We can learn a lot from ancient technology.
Rule.Translated: Deberíamos reunir al menos unas cuantas piezas más. Podemos aprender mucho de la tecnología antigua.

Rule.Original: I recently saw a small pile of junk.
Rule.Raw: I recently saw a small pile of junk.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco vi un pequeño montón de chatarra.
Hace poco vi un montón de chatarra.
Estoy rodead{PAWN_gender ? o : a} por la chatarra.

Rule.Original: I am surrounded by a junkyard. I find these examples of ancient technology to be fascinating.
Rule.Raw: I am surrounded by a junkyard. I find these examples of ancient technology to be fascinating.
Rule.Translated: Es como si viviera en un desguace. Estas muestras de tecnología antigua me parecen fascinantes.

Rule.Original:
To throw away that which could be reused is utterly wasteful, everything can be repurposed.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Deconstructing a building returns 100% of its original materials. This also applies to destroying a building (as long as the building produces resources when destroyed), and when failing to construct it.
Rule.Raw:
To throw away that which could be reused is utterly wasteful, everything can be repurposed.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Deconstructing a building returns 100% of its original materials. This also applies to destroying a building (as long as the building produces resources when destroyed), and when failing to construct it.
Rule.Translated:
Tirar lo que se puede reutilizar es un auténtico despilfarro, hasta el último trozo de cuero o fragmento de acero se puede reutilizar.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Al desmantelar una construcción, ésta devolverá el 100% de sus materiales originales. Esto también se aplica a la hora de destruir una construcción (siempre y cuando fuera a producir recursos al ser desmantelada), así como al fracasar en su construcción.

Rule.Original: Enemies should be burnt to death.
Rule.Raw: Enemies should be burnt to death.
Rule.Translated: Ver a mis enemigos arder en el fuego sagrado alegra a los nuestros como ninguna otra cosa puede hacerlo.

Rule.Original: Our enemies be engulfed by flame.
Rule.Raw: Our enemies be engulfed by flame.
Rule.Translated: Nuestros enemigos ardieron en las llamas sagradas.

Rule.Original: Watching a person burn to death is horrible.
Rule.Raw: Watching a person burn to death is horrible.
Rule.Translated: Ver cómo una persona se quema hasta morir sin intentar ayudarla es horrible, y debe evitarse a toda costa.

Rule.Original: I watched a person get burnt to death, they didn't deserve that.
Rule.Raw: I watched a person get burnt to death, they didn't deserve that.
Rule.Translated: Nuestros enemigos ardieron hasta morir y no pudimos evitar sus espantosas muertes.

Rule.Original:
Our leader should be exalted as a god.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Opinion of the leader depends on a person's certainty in its ideoligion.
Rule.Raw:
Our leader should be exalted as a god.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Opinion of the leader depends on a person's certainty in its ideoligion.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestro líder debe ser elevado a la categoría de dios, tratarlo como algo menos aseguraría nuestra desaparición.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - La opinión que se tiene del líder depende de la certeza de la persona en su ideoligión.

Rule.Original:
Our most skilled artisan is our leader.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - The leader role will periodically be forced upon the highest level crafter in the colony (this will only work if the ideology is the primary one).
Rule.Raw:
Our most skilled artisan is our leader.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - The leader role will periodically be forced upon the highest level crafter in the colony (this will only work if the ideology is the primary one).
Rule.Translated:
Nuestro artesano más hábil es nuestro líder, a través de su ojo agudo y su toque delicado nuestros talleres cantarán la canción de la creación.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - El rol de líder se impondrá periódicamente a la persona con mayor nivel en fabricación de la colonia (esto solo funcionará si la ideoligión es la principal).

Rule.Original: Our most talented fighter will be our leader.
Rule.Raw: Our most talented fighter will be our leader.
Rule.Translated: La pericia en el combate, ya sea con la espada o la lanza, es una muestra de fuerza y valor. Nuestro luchador más talentoso será nuestro líder, y no hay más que hablar (esto solo funcionará si la ideoligión es la principal).

Rule.Original:
We should put our trust in the hands of few rather than the hand of one.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Up to three people can be designated as leader.
Rule.Raw:
We should put our trust in the hands of few rather than the hand of one.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Up to three people can be designated as leader.
Rule.Translated:
Es vital que pongamos nuestra confianza en las manos de unos pocos y no en las de uno solo.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Se pueden designar hasta tres personas como líderes.

Rule.Original:
Our leader is also a morale guide.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - The colony's leader can use moralist abilities too.
Rule.Raw:
Our leader is also a morale guide.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - The colony's leader can use moralist abilities too.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestro líder es un bastión de la moral, y a través de él y de su divinidad prosperaremos.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - El líder de la colonia también puede utilizar las habilidades de los moralistas.

Rule.Original: Slaughtering an animal to use its skin as apparel is cruel and inhumane.
Rule.Raw: Slaughtering an animal to use its skin as apparel is cruel and inhumane.
Rule.Translated: Sacrificar un animal para utilizar su piel como prenda de vestir es cruel e inhumano.

Rule.Original: Using animal leathers is something that should be avoided.
Rule.Raw: Using animal leathers is something that should be avoided.
Rule.Translated: El uso de cueros animales es algo que debe evitarse.

Rule.Original: I'm wearing clothing made with animal leather. Slaughtering an animal to use its skin as apparel is cruel and inhumane.
Rule.Raw: I'm wearing clothing made with animal leather. Slaughtering an animal to use its skin as apparel is cruel and inhumane.
Rule.Translated: Llevo ropa hecha con piel de animal. Sacrificar a un animal para usar su piel como prenda de vestir es cruel e inhumano.

Rule.Original: I'm wearing clothing made with animal leather. Slaughtering an animal to use its skin should be avoided.
Rule.Raw: I'm wearing clothing made with animal leather. Slaughtering an animal to use its skin should be avoided.
Rule.Translated: Llevo ropa hecha con piel de animal. Debería evitarse sacrificar a un animal para utilizar su piel.

Rule.Original: Darklight is an unnatural and cheap imitation of true light, and should be avoided.
Rule.Raw: Darklight is an unnatural and cheap imitation of true light, and should be avoided.
Rule.Translated: La luz oscura es una imitación antinatural y barata del milagro que es la luz, y debe evitarse.

Rule.Original: Beyond being difficult to fight in, bloodshed should never take place in darkness.
Rule.Raw: Beyond being difficult to fight in, bloodshed should never take place in darkness.
Rule.Translated: Además de ser difícil de combatir, el derramamiento de sangre nunca debe tener lugar en la oscuridad, no sea que el enemigo se libre de mirarte a los ojos antes de que acabes con su vida.
La luz oscura no es natural.
La oscuridad es antinatural y repugnante.

Rule.Original: Eating meat of any kind is deeply evil. Consuming any animal product is immoral.
Rule.Raw: Eating meat of any kind is deeply evil. Consuming any animal product is immoral.
Rule.Translated: Comer carne de cualquier tipo es profundamente perverso. Consumir cualquier producto animal también es inmoral.

Rule.Original: I had to eat animal products. It is wrong and immoral to imprison an animal and use for sustenance.
Rule.Raw: I had to eat animal products. It is wrong and immoral to imprison an animal and use for sustenance.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que comer productos animales. Es incorrecto e inmoral encerrar a un animal y utilizarlo como fábrica.

Rule.Original: To destroy a mechanoid is a short-sighted and foolish act.
Rule.Raw: To destroy a mechanoid is a short-sighted and foolish act.
Rule.Translated: Destruir a un hijo de la maquinación es un acto insensato y carente de visión de futuro.

Rule.Original: I have destroyed a mechanoid being, this will anger the gods.
Rule.Raw: I have destroyed a mechanoid being, this will anger the gods.
Rule.Translated: He destruido un mecanoide, esto enfurecerá a los dioses.

Rule.Original: Mechanoids are an abomination, a reminder of man's hubris.
Rule.Raw: Mechanoids are an abomination, a reminder of man's hubris.
Rule.Translated: Los mecanoides son una abominación, un recordatorio de la arrogancia del hombre.

Rule.Original: I have destroyed a mechanoid. Good.
Rule.Raw: I have destroyed a mechanoid. Good.
Rule.Translated: He destruido un mecanoide, ¡esto es una victoria!

Rule.Original:
The stars will guide us.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - After every Divine the Stars ritual, a solar eclipse or an aurora, mood will randomly change between -30 and +30.
Rule.Raw:
The stars will guide us.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - After every Divine the Stars ritual, a solar eclipse or an aurora, mood will randomly change between -30 and +30.
Rule.Translated:
El mar interminable de estrellas en nuestros cielos dictará mi futuro, sea benévolo o no.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Después de cada ritual de adivinación en los astros, un eclipse solar o una aurora, el estado de humor cambiará aleatoriamente entre -30 y +30.
Los arquitectos astrales me sonríen, su benevolencia es inigualable.

Rule.Original: The stars tell a story of success.
Rule.Raw: The stars tell a story of success.
Rule.Translated: Los cuerpos estelares de arriba cuentan una historia de fortuna y éxito inminentes.

Rule.Original: The stars tell me that my fate is comfortably in their hands.
Rule.Raw: The stars tell me that my fate is comfortably in their hands.
Rule.Translated: Las estrellas me susurran y me dicen que respire tranquil{PAWN_gender ? o : a}. Mi destino está cómodamente en sus manos.

Rule.Original: The stars tell me all is fine.
Rule.Raw: The stars tell me all is fine.
Rule.Translated: Aunque pequeñas, las constelaciones me dicen que todo va bien por el momento.

Rule.Original: The stars have told me nothing.
Rule.Raw: The stars have told me nothing.
Rule.Translated: Las estrellas susurran sinsentidos y contradicciones, nuestro destino es cada vez más incierto.

Rule.Original: The stars tell me to be worried.
Rule.Raw: The stars tell me to be worried.
Rule.Translated: Los cielos no auguran nada bueno, un mal presagio se vislumbra en el horizonte.

Rule.Original: stars are not on my side
Rule.Raw: stars are not on my side
Rule.Translated: los astros no están de mi lado

Rule.Original: The stars are cold and distant.
Rule.Raw: The stars are cold and distant.
Rule.Translated: El mar de estrellas está siempre nublado, se ocultan de mí y se niegan a hablarme de mi destino.
los astros no presagian nada bueno

Rule.Original: The stars tell me to be afraid.
Rule.Raw: The stars tell me to be afraid.
Rule.Translated: Los cuerpos celestes de ahí arriba han dejado claro que ya no cuento con su gracia.
los astros están alineados... En mi contra

Rule.Original: The stars have aligned against me, they threaten my very life.
Rule.Raw: The stars have aligned against me, they threaten my very life.
