Rule.Translated: Los planetas se han alineado, una sicigia ha dejado claro que mi inminente desaparición es ineludible. Pronto seré reducid{PAWN_gender ? o : a} a mero polvo.

Rule.Original:
Empathy is a quality we must all strive to possess. We bear each other's burdens as well as each other's jubilations.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - If the average colony mood is happy, colonists receive a positive thought, and vice versa.
Rule.Raw:
Empathy is a quality we must all strive to possess. We bear each other's burdens as well as each other's jubilations.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - If the average colony mood is happy, colonists receive a positive thought, and vice versa.
Rule.Translated:
La empatía es una cualidad que todos debemos esforzarnos por poseer. Soportamos las cargas de los demás, así como las alegrías de los demás.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Si el estado de humor medio de la colonia es alto, los colonos reciben un estado de humor positivo, y viceversa.

Rule.Original: Everyone is in good mood, as am I.
Rule.Raw: Everyone is in good mood, as am I.
Rule.Translated: Todos están de buen humor... Como yo.

Rule.Original: Everyone is in bad mood, as am I.
Rule.Raw: Everyone is in bad mood, as am I.
Rule.Translated: Todos están de mal humor... Como yo.

Rule.Original: We are stranded on a lost, forgotten planet on the Rim. Things can hardly get worse.
Rule.Raw: We are stranded on a lost, forgotten planet on the Rim. Things can hardly get worse.
Rule.Translated: Estamos varados en un planeta perdido y olvidado de la frontera. Las cosas no pueden ir a peor.

Rule.Original: I'm just generally having a bad mood. The Rim is a hostile place.
Rule.Raw: I'm just generally having a bad mood. The Rim is a hostile place.
Rule.Translated: En general estoy de mal humor. Los mundos fronterizos son lugares horribles.

Rule.Original: The whole world is ours to explore and enjoy.
Rule.Raw: The whole world is ours to explore and enjoy.
Rule.Translated: El mundo entero es nuestro para explorarlo y disfrutarlo.

Rule.Original: I'm just generally having a good mood. The Rim is an amazing place.
Rule.Raw: I'm just generally having a good mood. The Rim is an amazing place.
Rule.Translated: En general estoy de buen humor. Los mundos fronterizos son lugares increíbles.

Rule.Original:
Organs should never go to waste.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Through the fleshcrafter role, the colony can butcher fresh humanoid bodies to acquire fleshcrafted organs.
Rule.Raw:
Organs should never go to waste.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Through the fleshcrafter role, the colony can butcher fresh humanoid bodies to acquire fleshcrafted organs.
Rule.Translated:
Los órganos de nuestro ser nunca deben desperdiciarse, siempre que su recipiente ya no sea necesario.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - A través del rol de casquero se pueden descuartizar cuerpos humanoides frescos para adquirir órganos de casquería.

Rule.Original: Pain is only in your mind, it can be endured.
Rule.Raw: Pain is only in your mind, it can be endured.
Rule.Translated: El dolor solo está en tu mente, mientras tu espíritu permanezca íntegro, lo controlarás.

Rule.Original:
Our home is only temporary, it's important to keep moving.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Farming yield: -10%.
 - Gathering yield: +40%.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept will only work when using the vanilla game world system. Vehicles for example won't interact with it. Using other mods such as Caravan Adventure to leave the map won't work either. You need to use vanilla systems.
Rule.Raw:
Our home is only temporary, it's important to keep moving.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Farming yield: -10%.
 - Gathering yield: +40%.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept will only work when using the vanilla game world system. Vehicles for example won't interact with it. Using other mods such as Caravan Adventure to leave the map won't work either. You need to use vanilla systems.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestra colonia es solo temporal, si nos quedamos será solo cuestión de tiempo que no podamos defenderla, es mejor no conseguir nunca esa comodidad.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Rendimiento agrícola: -10%.
 - Rendimiento del forrajeo: +40%.

Rule.Original: We have been here for too long. Perhaps it is time to leave.
Rule.Raw: We have been here for too long. Perhaps it is time to leave.
Rule.Translated: Llevamos aquí demasiado tiempo. Quizá sea hora de irnos.

Rule.Original: We have been here for too long. Perhaps it is time to leave.
Rule.Raw: We have been here for too long. Perhaps it is time to leave.
Rule.Translated: Llevamos aquí demasiado tiempo. Quizá sea hora de irnos.

Rule.Original: We have been here for too long. Perhaps it is time to leave.
Rule.Raw: We have been here for too long. Perhaps it is time to leave.
Rule.Translated: Llevamos aquí demasiado tiempo. Quizá sea hora de marcharnos.

Rule.Original: This colony is trite. We should we wandering, not staying on the same place.
Rule.Raw: This colony is trite. We should we wandering, not staying on the same place.
Rule.Translated: Esta colonia está trillada. Deberíamos viajar, no quedarnos en el mismo sitio.

Rule.Original: This colony is trite. We should we wandering, not staying on the same place.
Rule.Raw: This colony is trite. We should we wandering, not staying on the same place.
Rule.Translated: Esta colonia está trillada. Deberíamos viajar, no quedarnos en el mismo sitio.

Rule.Original: Enough already! It is time to pack our things and hit the road.
Rule.Raw: Enough already! It is time to pack our things and hit the road.
Rule.Translated: ¡Basta ya! Es hora de hacer las maletas y ponerse en camino.

Rule.Original: Enough already! It is time to pack our things and hit the road.
Rule.Raw: Enough already! It is time to pack our things and hit the road.
Rule.Translated: ¡Basta ya! Es hora de hacer las maletas y ponerse en camino.

Rule.Original: Agh! I can't stand being here anymore!
Rule.Raw: Agh! I can't stand being here anymore!

Rule.Original:
Our home should have many rooms and facilities, and we should never abandon it.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists gets mood penalties / bonuses depending on amount of buildings on the map. "Building" is a completely enclosed structure with at least 25 tiles size.
Rule.Raw:
Our home should have many rooms and facilities, and we should never abandon it.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists gets mood penalties / bonuses depending on amount of buildings on the map. "Building" is a completely enclosed structure with at least 25 tiles size.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestra colonia debe convertirse en nuestro hogar para siempre, cuantos más edificios, caminos y luces podamos erigir, mejor estaremos todos.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos reciben estados de humor positivos o negativos en función de la cantidad de edificios que haya en el mapa. Se considerará «edificio» a cualquier estructura completamente cerrada con un tamaño mínimo de 25 celdas.

Rule.Original: Our city is magnificent, a fine example of what humanity can achieve.
Rule.Raw: Our city is magnificent, a fine example of what humanity can achieve.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra ciudad es magnífica, un bello ejemplo de lo que la humanidad puede lograr.

Rule.Original: We have so many beautiful buildings!
Rule.Raw: We have so many beautiful buildings!

Rule.Original: We have so many beautiful buildings!
Rule.Raw: We have so many beautiful buildings!

Rule.Original: There are not enough buildings nearby. I feel unprotected.
Rule.Raw: There are not enough buildings nearby. I feel unprotected.
Rule.Translated: No hay suficientes edificios cerca. Me siento desprotegid{PAWN_gender ? o : a}.

Rule.Original: Power should always be sought after.
Rule.Raw: Power should always be sought after.
Rule.Translated: ¡Yo soy la justicia! No soy un simple rey, ¡he ascendido a la categoría de un dios! Inclínate ante mí o expía tu vida.

Rule.Original: My rule is supreme, akin to a god.
Rule.Raw: My rule is supreme, akin to a god.
Rule.Translated: Mi gobierno es supremo, porque soy divino.

Rule.Original: Seeking power is an understandable desire.
Rule.Raw: Seeking power is an understandable desire.
Rule.Translated: Anhelar formar parte de la élite poderosa es un deseo muy comprensible y no debe ser despreciado.

Rule.Original: I feel important and everyone looks up to me.
Rule.Raw: I feel important and everyone looks up to me.
Rule.Translated: Me siento importante y todo el mundo me admira.

Rule.Original: It's preferable to be in a position of power.
Rule.Raw: It's preferable to be in a position of power.
Rule.Translated: Es impensable ser considerado un plebeyo. Quiero que la gente se tome en serio mi palabra y haga un gran esfuerzo para no decepcionarme.
Tengo una posición de poder razonable y me gusta esa sensación.

Rule.Original: People should be forced to follow our beliefs.
Rule.Raw: People should be forced to follow our beliefs.
Rule.Translated: Si alguien no puede ver el error en su forma de ser, entonces no está de más recurrir a la agresión para mostrárselo, es una obligación de nuestras creencias.

Rule.Original:
We should never attempt to convert others.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Disables conversion rituals and the convert ability of the moralist role.
Rule.Raw:
We should never attempt to convert others.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Disables conversion rituals and the convert ability of the moralist role.
Rule.Translated:
Cada uno tiene su propia verdad, y cada uno debe respetar el derecho de los demás a seguir la suya.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Desactiva los rituales de conversión y la habilidad de conversión del rol de moralista.

Rule.Original: Strength and honor can be achieved by raiding other settlements.
Rule.Raw: Strength and honor can be achieved by raiding other settlements.
Rule.Translated: Mostramos nuestra fuerza y perseverancia a través de la conquista, y al hacerlo damos honor a nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: I participated in a raid. Through conquest, we bring honor to our colony.
Rule.Raw: I participated in a raid. Through conquest, we bring honor to our colony.
Rule.Translated: Participé en un asalto. A través de la conquista, traemos honor a nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: We recently raided another faction. Through conquest, we bring honor to our colony.
Rule.Raw: We recently raided another faction. Through conquest, we bring honor to our colony.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco asaltamos otra facción. A través de la conquista, traemos honor a nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: It's been far too long since we raided anyone, we should attack a settlement soon.
Rule.Raw: It's been far too long since we raided anyone, we should attack a settlement soon.
Rule.Translated: Hace mucho que no asaltamos a nadie. A través de la conquista, traemos honor a nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original:
It is shameful to attack or take from those weaker than you.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Any raid will trigger this precept. Even those with a defensive focus such as problem causers. Yes, it's tough.
Rule.Raw:
It is shameful to attack or take from those weaker than you.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Any raid will trigger this precept. Even those with a defensive focus such as problem causers. Yes, it's tough.
Rule.Translated: Hemos trabajado duro para conseguir lo que tenemos, no tenemos derecho a quitarle a los débiles ya que nosotros también fuimos débiles. Hacerlo es una tremenda vergüenza.

Rule.Original: I participated in a raid. How could I do that? I'm ashamed.
Rule.Raw: I participated in a raid. How could I do that? I'm ashamed.
Rule.Translated: Participé en un asalto. ¿Cómo pudimos hacer eso? ¡Es horriblemente vergonzoso!

Rule.Original: We recently raided another faction. This is horrible and brings shame to our colony.
Rule.Raw: We recently raided another faction. This is horrible and brings shame to our colony.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco asaltamos otra facción. Esto es horrible y avergüenza a nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: It's been a long time since we raided anyone. This is as it should be, we are not bullies.
Rule.Raw: It's been a long time since we raided anyone. This is as it should be, we are not bullies.
Rule.Translated: Hace mucho que no asaltamos a nadie. Así es como debe ser, no somos matones.

Rule.Original: Keeping animals captive to consume their flesh and their resources is deeply immoral and should be avoided at all costs. Growing our own fruits and vegetables is a much nobler pursuit.
Rule.Raw: Keeping animals captive to consume their flesh and their resources is deeply immoral and should be avoided at all costs. Growing our own fruits and vegetables is a much nobler pursuit.
Rule.Translated: Mantener a los animales cautivos para consumir su carne y sus recursos es profundamente inmoral y debería evitarse a toda costa. Cultivar nuestras propias frutas y verduras es una actividad mucho más noble.

Rule.Original: A nomad is nothing without their trusty steed. Developing a bond with beasts of burden means traveling this world will never be a lonely endeavour.
Rule.Raw: A nomad is nothing without their trusty steed. Developing a bond with beasts of burden means traveling this world will never be a lonely endeavour.
Rule.Translated: Un nómada no es nada sin su fiel corcel. Desarrollar un vínculo con las bestias de carga significa que viajar por este mundo nunca será una tarea solitaria.

Rule.Original: We don't even have a pen. Good.
Rule.Raw: We don't even have a pen. Good.
Rule.Translated: Aquí no encerramos animales. Así es como deben ser las cosas.

Rule.Original: We have a pen marker in our colony. Animals shouldn't be kept captive, it's immoral.
Rule.Raw: We have a pen marker in our colony. Animals shouldn't be kept captive, it's immoral.
Rule.Translated: Tenemos un marcador de corral en nuestra colonia. Los animales no son nuestros esclavos y no deben mantenerse cautivos, es inmoral.

Rule.Original: We have several pen markers in our colony. Animals shouldn't be kept captive, it's immoral.
Rule.Raw: We have several pen markers in our colony. Animals shouldn't be kept captive, it's immoral.
Rule.Translated: Tenemos varios marcadores de corral en nuestra colonia. Los animales no son nuestros esclavos y no deben mantenerse cautivos, es inmoral.

Rule.Original: We have too many pens, filled with poor animals in cramped conditions. I'm disgusted.
Rule.Raw: We have too many pens, filled with poor animals in cramped conditions. I'm disgusted.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra colonia tiene demasiados corrales, llenos de pobres animales en condiciones de hacinamiento, criados para el matadero. Que asco.

Rule.Original: I had to attack an animal, I feel bad about it.
Rule.Raw: I had to attack an animal, I feel bad about it.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que atacar a un animal. Ellos también tienen derechos.

Rule.Original: I sowed a human food plant, food free from cruelty and abuse.
Rule.Raw: I sowed a human food plant, food free from cruelty and abuse.
Rule.Translated: Sembré una planta que produce comida humana. Me encanta disponer de comida libre de crueldad y abuso.

Rule.Original:
Recreation should be enjoyed to the fullest.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Colonists gain recreation at 50% the speed when using any Joy buildings.
 - Increases by 50% the mood buff acquired by colonists after a party.
Rule.Raw:
Recreation should be enjoyed to the fullest.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Colonists gain recreation at 50% the speed when using any Joy buildings.
 - Increases by 50% the mood buff acquired by colonists after a party.
Rule.Translated:
La diversión y los juegos no son opcionales, disfruta de cada momento de ocio y hazlo lo mejor que puedas para ti y tus amigos.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Los colonos obtienen diversión a un 50% de la velocidad normal cuando utilizan cualquier construcción de ocio.
 - Aumenta en un 50% la mejora del estado de humor que adquieren los colonos después de una fiesta.

Rule.Original: Recreation is an important part of life.
Rule.Raw: Recreation is an important part of life.
Rule.Translated: El ocio es una parte importante de la vida.

Rule.Original:
Recreation is a waste of time.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Colonists get -5 mood for half a day after doing a recreation job.
Rule.Raw:
Recreation is a waste of time.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Colonists get -5 mood for half a day after doing a recreation job.
Rule.Translated:
El ocio es una pérdida de tiempo.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Los colonos obtienen un estado de humor de -5 durante medio día después de realizar una tarea recreativa.

Rule.Original: Recreation is a waste of time.
Rule.Raw: Recreation is a waste of time.
Rule.Translated: La recreación es una pérdida de tiempo.

Rule.Original: It is wrong to accept any outsiders into our ranks.
Rule.Raw: It is wrong to accept any outsiders into our ranks.
Rule.Translated: No necesitamos la ayuda de nadie y no aceptaremos a ningún forastero en nuestras filas.

Rule.Original: We should never allow ourselves to be recruited by another faction.
Rule.Raw: We should never allow ourselves to be recruited by another faction.
Rule.Translated: Somos una nación orgullosa y no nos uniremos a nadie, ya que nos produciría una gran vergüenza.

Rule.Original: An incantation. A dark chant to appease the eldritch entities that defy all natural laws.
Rule.Raw: An incantation. A dark chant to appease the eldritch entities that defy all natural laws.
Rule.Translated: Unos cánticos, hechos para apaciguar a las entidades demoníacas que desafían todas las leyes naturales.

Rule.Original: An insectoid hymn. The ritual will refresh the cooldown of the insectoid herder's "Construct a Nest" ability. If the ritual gets the best possible result it will make any insectoids currently assaulting the colony flee. Except the Black HIve, those want your blood.
Rule.Raw: An insectoid hymn. The ritual will refresh the cooldown of the insectoid herder's "Construct a Nest" ability. If the ritual gets the best possible result it will make any insectoids currently assaulting the colony flee. Except the Black HIve, those want your blood.
Rule.Translated: Un himno insectoide. El ritual reactivará la habilidad «construir nido» del pastor de insectoides. Si el ritual obtiene el mejor resultado posible, hará huir a cualquier insectoide que esté asaltando la colonia. Excepto en el caso de la colmena negra, que quiere tu sangre.

Rule.Original: The leader tries to persuade someone into joining your ideoligion.
Rule.Raw: The leader tries to persuade someone into joining your ideoligion.
Rule.Translated: El líder intenta persuadir a alguien para que se una a su ideoligión.

Rule.Original: An orgy. Participants will ignore any sexual preferences during the event's duration.
Rule.Raw: An orgy. Participants will ignore any sexual preferences during the event's duration.
Rule.Translated: Una orgía. Los participantes ignorarán cualquier preferencia sexual durante la duración del evento.

Rule.Original: Cast off your shackles, and should you find us suitable, be welcomed within our community as kin and kith alike. Should you find your new home ill-suited for your needs, we wish you a warm, albeit melancholy goodbye.
Rule.Raw: Cast off your shackles, and should you find us suitable, be welcomed within our community as kin and kith alike. Should you find your new home ill-suited for your needs, we wish you a warm, albeit melancholy goodbye.
Rule.Translated: Deshazte de tus grilletes y, si nos consideras adecuados, sé bienvenido en nuestra comunidad como un miembro más de la familia. Si consideras que tu nuevo hogar no se adapta a tus necesidades, te deseamos una cálida, aunque melancólica, despedida.

Rule.Original: Infidels must either join our cause, or their skulls shall be caved in with a thousand hammers.
Rule.Raw: Infidels must either join our cause, or their skulls shall be caved in with a thousand hammers.
Rule.Translated: Los infieles deben unirse a nuestra causa, o sus cráneos serán reventados con mil martillos.
Una quema de un hombre de mimbre.

Rule.Original: A brave and ruthless military tactician who specializes in leading by means of fear and threats. Capable of executing insubordinate pawns in order to motivate the rest.
Rule.Raw: A brave and ruthless military tactician who specializes in leading by means of fear and threats. Capable of executing insubordinate pawns in order to motivate the rest.
Rule.Translated: Un valiente e implacable estratega militar especializado en dirigir mediante el miedo y las amenazas. Es capaz de ejecutar a los insubordinados para motivar al resto.

Rule.Original: A keeper of sacred flame whose primary job is to control pyres, bonfires, and kilns. Respected unanimously by their disciples, they have no qualms extinguishing fires and followers will respect their decisions to do so. All Firekeepers possess the ability to ignite flame sources and cause an explosion.
Rule.Raw: A keeper of sacred flame whose primary job is to control pyres, bonfires, and kilns. Respected unanimously by their disciples, they have no qualms extinguishing fires and followers will respect their decisions to do so. All Firekeepers possess the ability to ignite flame sources and cause an explosion.
Rule.Translated: Un guardián de la llama sagrada cuyo trabajo principal es controlar las piras, las hogueras y los hornos. Respetados unánimemente por sus discípulos, no tienen reparos en apagar fuegos y los seguidores respetarán sus decisiones al respecto. Todos los guardianes del fuego poseen la capacidad de encender fuentes de llamas y de provocar explosiones.

Rule.Original: A veritable anatomical expert capable of excising organs from recently deceased cadavers. Because of organ damage and decay only between one and three organs will be harvested at random and the rest of the corpse will be reduced to meat.
Rule.Raw: A veritable anatomical expert capable of excising organs from recently deceased cadavers. Because of organ damage and decay only between one and three organs will be harvested at random and the rest of the corpse will be reduced to meat.
Rule.Translated: Un auténtico experto en anatomía capaz de extirpar órganos de los cadáveres recién fallecidos. Debido a los daños y la descomposición de los órganos, solo se extraen entre uno y tres órganos al azar, y el resto del cadáver se reduce a simple carne.

Rule.Original: A talented tamer of insectoids. Through study or natural talent these leaders are capable of immediately understanding and controlling insectoid creatures, however, as a sacred bond they are not allowed to partake in any other kinds of work. Insectoid herders can erect insectoid hives as part of a short ritual.
Rule.Raw: A talented tamer of insectoids. Through study or natural talent these leaders are capable of immediately understanding and controlling insectoid creatures, however, as a sacred bond they are not allowed to partake in any other kinds of work. Insectoid herders can erect insectoid hives as part of a short ritual.
Rule.Translated: Un talentoso domador de insectoides. Mediante el estudio o el talento natural, estos líderes son capaces de comprender y controlar inmediatamente a las criaturas insectoides; sin embargo, como vínculo sagrado, no se les permite participar en ningún otro tipo de trabajo. Los pastores de insectoides pueden levantar colmenas de insectoides como parte de un breve ritual.

Rule.Original: A brilliant engineer capable of assembling mechanoid effigies. Unlike their lazy counterparts, Mechackers are willing to do all work types. All Mechackers possess the ability to overload and detonate turrets or hostile mechanoids, causing an explosion.
Rule.Raw: A brilliant engineer capable of assembling mechanoid effigies. Unlike their lazy counterparts, Mechackers are willing to do all work types. All Mechackers possess the ability to overload and detonate turrets or hostile mechanoids, causing an explosion.
Rule.Translated: Un brillante ingeniero capaz de construir efigies mecanoides. A diferencia de sus homólogos perezosos, los mecahackers están dispuestos a realizar todo tipo de trabajos. Todos los mecahackers poseen la capacidad de sobrecargar y detonar torretas o mecanoides hostiles, provocando una explosión.

Rule.Original: A welcoming and charismatic, though somewhat cutthroat trader, specializes in establishing mercantile routes with other colonies. Can signal for a random friendly faction trade caravan to make a detour directly to the colony every 5 days. Also receives a small bonus to trading prices through sheer charisma.
Rule.Raw: A welcoming and charismatic, though somewhat cutthroat trader, specializes in establishing mercantile routes with other colonies. Can signal for a random friendly faction trade caravan to make a detour directly to the colony every 5 days. Also receives a small bonus to trading prices through sheer charisma.
Rule.Translated: Un comerciante acogedor y carismático, aunque algo despiadado, especializado en establecer rutas mercantiles con otras colonias. Puede hacer una señal para que una caravana comercial aleatoria de una facción amiga se desvíe directamente hacia la colonia cada 5 días. También recibe una pequeña bonificación en los precios de las transacciones gracias a su carisma.

Rule.Original: A dedicated medical professional able to tend to wounds with surgical precision. Possesses the unique ability to hyperfocus on their doctoring patients in times of mass trauma, temporarily suppressing their needs for rest, recreation, or hunger.
Rule.Raw: A dedicated medical professional able to tend to wounds with surgical precision. Possesses the unique ability to hyperfocus on their doctoring patients in times of mass trauma, temporarily suppressing their needs for rest, recreation, or hunger.
Rule.Translated: Un profesional médico dedicado, capaz de atender las heridas con precisión quirúrgica. Posee la capacidad única de concentrarse plenamente en sus pacientes en momentos de trauma masivo, suprimiendo temporalmente sus necesidades de descanso, diversión o hambre.

Rule.Original: A most jovial hooligan incapable of understanding that not all times can be party time. A party leader is able to throw an amazing party at any time. However, they will find themselves needing about twice the recreation time as the normal person to be happy on a day-to-day basis.
Rule.Raw: A most jovial hooligan incapable of understanding that not all times can be party time. A party leader is able to throw an amazing party at any time. However, they will find themselves needing about twice the recreation time as the normal person to be happy on a day-to-day basis.
Rule.Translated: Un gamberro de lo más jovial incapaz de entender que no todos los momentos pueden ser de fiesta. Un anfitrión es capaz de organizar una fiesta increíble en cualquier momento. Sin embargo, necesitará el doble de tiempo de ocio que una persona normal para ser feliz durante el día a día.

Rule.Original: A leader who holds the group together and represents your faction in diplomatic interactions.
Rule.Raw: A leader who holds the group together and represents your faction in diplomatic interactions.
Rule.Translated: Un líder que mantiene unido al grupo y representa a tu facción en las interacciones diplomáticas.

Rule.Original: A leader who holds the group together and represents your faction in diplomatic interactions.
Rule.Raw: A leader who holds the group together and represents your faction in diplomatic interactions.
Rule.Translated: Un líder que mantiene unido al grupo y representa a tu facción en las interacciones diplomáticas.

Rule.Original: To be scarred and continue on is nothing short of an incredible act.
Rule.Raw: To be scarred and continue on is nothing short of an incredible act.
Rule.Translated: Las cicatrices son marcas de honor y fuerza, estar marcado y seguir adelante no es otra cosa que un acto increíble.

Rule.Original: A body marked with scars is disgusting.
Rule.Raw: A body marked with scars is disgusting.
Rule.Translated: Un cuerpo marcado con cicatrices es repugnante.

Rule.Original: Skilled labor is meticulous and time-consuming, it is better to focus elsewhere.
Rule.Raw: Skilled labor is meticulous and time-consuming, it is better to focus elsewhere.
Rule.Translated: La búsqueda de mano de obra especializada es meticulosa y requiere mucho tiempo, por lo que es mejor centrar nuestra atención y nuestro esfuerzo en otras cosas.

Rule.Original: Skilled labour should be approached with care and time.
Rule.Raw: Skilled labour should be approached with care and time.
Rule.Translated: El trabajo cualificado debe realizarse con cuidado y dedicándole tiempo.

Rule.Original: Slavery is a forbidden practice, and slaves deserve our respect. The only reason to purchase a slave is with intent to immediately free them.
Rule.Raw: Slavery is a forbidden practice, and slaves deserve our respect. The only reason to purchase a slave is with intent to immediately free them.
Rule.Translated: Participar en el comercio de esclavos es una idea totalmente aberrante. La única razón para comprar un esclavo es con la intención de liberarlo inmediatamente. Además, aquellos que lucharon contra la esclavitud merecen nuestra compasión y respeto.
Cualquier esclavo en la colonia (hasta su emancipación)
esclavos no emancipados en la colonia

Rule.Original: There are slaves in the colony. We should emancipate them as soon as possible.
Rule.Raw: There are slaves in the colony. We should emancipate them as soon as possible.
Rule.Translated: Hay esclavos en la colonia. Debemos emanciparlos lo antes posible.

Rule.Original: Slaves should only be bought, not sold.
Rule.Raw: Slaves should only be bought, not sold.
Rule.Translated: Solo está justificada la compra de esclavos, tras lo cual debemos proporcionarles un alojamiento y una consideración amables dentro de nuestra colonia. Al vender un esclavo se deja su destino en manos del comprador, una decisión muy imprudente.

Rule.Original: We took part in the horrible act of slave trading. What a disgrace.
Rule.Raw: We took part in the horrible act of slave trading. What a disgrace.
Rule.Translated: Participamos en el horrible acto del comercio de personas. Qué vergüenza.

Rule.Original: We have bought a slave from wicked slave traders.
Rule.Raw: We have bought a slave from wicked slave traders.
Rule.Translated: ¡Hemos comprado un esclavo a malvados traficantes de esclavos!

Rule.Original: Socializing should be forbidden, forgoing achieves a greater understanding.
Rule.Raw: Socializing should be forbidden, forgoing achieves a greater understanding.
Rule.Translated: Las conversaciones entre los de nuestro credo están prohibidas. Tratamos de lograr un mayor entendimiento a través del silencio y el secreto, un juramento que pocos forasteros pueden comprender.

Rule.Original: There is nothing wrong about wearing tainted clothing.
Rule.Raw: There is nothing wrong about wearing tainted clothing.
Rule.Translated: Las vestimentas empapadas de sangre o restos de carne no deben disuadir a nadie de cubrirse y aprovechar lo que de otro modo se desgastaría con el tiempo.
Llevar puesta la vestimenta de una persona muerta es bastante repugnante.

Rule.Original: Wearing tainted clothing is a horrible practice.
Rule.Raw: Wearing tainted clothing is a horrible practice.
Rule.Translated: No hay nada más repugnante en este mundo que utilizar la vestimenta que llevaba puesta una persona muerta.
llevo la ropa de un muerto

Rule.Original: I'm wearing clothing used by a dead person. I can't imagine anything more disgusting.
Rule.Raw: I'm wearing clothing used by a dead person. I can't imagine anything more disgusting.
Rule.Translated: Llevo la ropa que usó un muerto, ¡no puedo imaginar nada más asqueroso! ¡Alguien murió usando esto!

Rule.Original: There is nothing wrong about wearing tattered clothing.
Rule.Raw: There is nothing wrong about wearing tattered clothing.
Rule.Translated: Tenemos preocupaciones más importantes que los agujeros en nuestras vestimentas, no perdamos nuestro valioso tiempo preocupándonos o lamentándonos por esas trivialidades.

Rule.Original: Wearing tattered clothing is a trashy practice.
Rule.Raw: Wearing tattered clothing is a trashy practice.
Rule.Translated: Llevar vestimentas raídas es incómodo y debe evitarse.

Rule.Original: Wearing tattered clothing is an incredibly trashy practice.
Rule.Raw: Wearing tattered clothing is an incredibly trashy practice.
Rule.Translated: Las vestimentas harapientas son desagradables y deben ser desechadas lo antes posible.

Rule.Original: I'm wearing clothing that is tattered, and this is incredibly disgusting. Only the finest threads are worthy of my body.
Rule.Raw: I'm wearing clothing that is tattered, and this is incredibly disgusting. Only the finest threads are worthy of my body.
Rule.Translated: Llevo ropa hecha jirones, y esto es increíblemente repugnante. Solo los hilos más finos son dignos de mi cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Tending wounds should be taken seriously.
Rule.Raw: Tending wounds should be taken seriously.
Rule.Translated: Se anima mucho a nuestro pueblo a ser diligente en la curación y el cuidado de los demás. Si no podemos cuidarnos los unos a los otros, ¿cómo podríamos esperar sobrevivir a este duro mundo?

Rule.Original: It's important to trade and obtain wealth.
Rule.Raw: It's important to trade and obtain wealth.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra colonia, nos guste o no, es un negocio. Pasar demasiado tiempo sin una venta es estresante, pero obtener un beneficio considerable es verdaderamente algo épico.
Como de costumbre, nuestros productos vuelan de las estanterías.

Rule.Original: We haven't traded in a while.
Rule.Raw: We haven't traded in a while.
Rule.Translated: Nadie quiere comprar nuestros productos. Espero que estas rachas tranquilas acaben pronto.

Rule.Original: It is important to trade and get the best deals possible.
Rule.Raw: It is important to trade and get the best deals possible.
Rule.Translated: Todo tiene un precio, y da la casualidad de que los nuestros son especialmente persuasivos cuando se trata de demostrárselo a los demás.

Rule.Original: It's important to travel the planet and never stay anywhere for too long.
Rule.Raw: It's important to travel the planet and never stay anywhere for too long.
Rule.Translated: Decir que este planeta no tiene tierras exóticas y hermosas, dignas de ser apreciadas y de sumergirse en ellas, es de cerrados de mente. Viajar por este mundo debería ser una prioridad.

Rule.Original: traveled the world (less than 5 days ago)
Rule.Raw: traveled the world (less than 5 days ago)
Rule.Translated: viajé por el mundo (hace menos de 5 días)

Rule.Original: There is nothing as exciting as seeing what the world has to offer.
Rule.Raw: There is nothing as exciting as seeing what the world has to offer.
Rule.Translated: No hay nada tan estimulante como ver lo que el mundo tiene que ofrecer.

Rule.Original: traveled the world (less than 10 days ago)
Rule.Raw: traveled the world (less than 10 days ago)
Rule.Translated: viajé por el mundo (hace menos de 10 días)

Rule.Original: Travelling is amazing. The memories of my last travels are still fresh in my mind.
Rule.Raw: Travelling is amazing. The memories of my last travels are still fresh in my mind.
Rule.Translated: Viajar es increíble. Contemplar los paisajes, descubrir nuevas tierras... Los recuerdos de mis últimos viajes aún están frescos en mi memoria.

Rule.Original: traveled the world (less than 15 days ago)
Rule.Raw: traveled the world (less than 15 days ago)
Rule.Translated: viajé por el mundo (hace menos de 15 días)

Rule.Original: It's a while since I traveled, it was lovely.
Rule.Raw: It's a while since I traveled, it was lovely.
Rule.Translated: Hace no mucho tuve que viajar. Me encantó.

Rule.Original: traveled the world (less than 60 days ago)
Rule.Raw: traveled the world (less than 60 days ago)
Rule.Translated: viajé por el mundo (hace menos de 60 días)

Rule.Original: It's been a year since I last traveled, good times.
Rule.Raw: It's been a year since I last traveled, good times.
Rule.Translated: Guardo un grato recuerdo de mis viajes anteriores.

Rule.Original: Every moment spent away from home is a waste of time, traveling is pointless.
Rule.Raw: Every moment spent away from home is a waste of time, traveling is pointless.
Rule.Translated: Cada momento que se pasa fuera del hogar es otro momento huyendo de lo inevitable. El tiempo que uno pasa viajando se podría emplear más sabiamente en casa, construyéndola y defendiéndola.

Rule.Original: had to leave the colony (less than 5 days ago)
Rule.Raw: had to leave the colony (less than 5 days ago)
Rule.Translated: tuve que abandonar la colonia (hace menos de 5 días)

Rule.Original: I despise travelling, leaving the colony is awful.
Rule.Raw: I despise travelling, leaving the colony is awful.
Rule.Translated: Desprecio viajar. Dejar la seguridad de nuestra colonia es algo horrible.

Rule.Original: had to leave the colony (less than 10 days ago)
Rule.Raw: had to leave the colony (less than 10 days ago)
Rule.Translated: tuve que abandonar la colonia (hace menos de 10 días)

Rule.Original: I despise travelling, last time was terrible.
Rule.Raw: I despise travelling, last time was terrible.
Rule.Translated: Los recuerdos de mis últimos viajes aún están frescos en mi memoria. Lo odiaba.

Rule.Original: had to leave the colony (less than 15 days ago)
Rule.Raw: had to leave the colony (less than 15 days ago)
Rule.Translated: tuve que abandonar la colonia (hace menos de 15 días)

Rule.Original: I despise travelling, last time was unpleasant.
Rule.Raw: I despise travelling, last time was unpleasant.
Rule.Translated: Hace no mucho tuve que viajar. Lo odié.

Rule.Original: had to leave the colony (less than 60 days ago)
Rule.Raw: had to leave the colony (less than 60 days ago)
Rule.Translated: tuve que abandonar la colonia (hace menos de 60 días)

Rule.Original: I had to leave the colony a year ago, it sucked.
Rule.Raw: I had to leave the colony a year ago, it sucked.
Rule.Translated: Tengo recuerdos incómodos de mis viajes pasados.

Rule.Original:
Committing acts of violence is honorable.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a positive mood if they are forced to attack non-hostile humanoid targets.
Rule.Raw:
Committing acts of violence is honorable.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a positive mood if they are forced to attack non-hostile humanoid targets.
Rule.Translated:
Hacer daño a los inocentes es una necesidad honorable en la frontera, demuestra nuestra fuerza y nuestra determinación.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos recibirán un estado de humor positivo si se ven obligados a atacar a objetivos humanoides no hostiles.

Rule.Original: I used deadly force on an adversary.
Rule.Raw: I used deadly force on an adversary.
Rule.Translated: He utilizado la fuerza letal contra un adversario. Esto demuestra nuestra fuerza y nuestra determinación.

Rule.Original: Violence is just a fact of life.
Rule.Raw: Violence is just a fact of life.

Rule.Original:
Attacking a harmless person is immoral. 

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a negative mood if they are forced to attack non-hostile humanoid targets.
Rule.Raw:
Attacking a harmless person is immoral. 

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a negative mood if they are forced to attack non-hostile humanoid targets.
Rule.Translated:
Debemos evitar dañar a los inocentes si es posible. Atacar a una persona inofensiva es inmoral.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos recibirán un estado de humor negativo si se ven obligados a atacar a objetivos humanoides no hostiles.

Rule.Original: I used deadly force on an adversary.
Rule.Raw: I used deadly force on an adversary.
Rule.Translated: He utilizado la fuerza letal contra un adversario. Hacer esto está mal.

Rule.Original:
To resort to deadly forcee is barbaric and disgusting, it should never be allowed. 

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a substantial negative mood if they are forced to attack non-hostile humanoid targets.
 - The only mental break allowed is psychotic wander.
 - All drafted colonists will undraft if an attacking enemy starts fleeing.
Rule.Raw:
To resort to deadly forcee is barbaric and disgusting, it should never be allowed. 

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a substantial negative mood if they are forced to attack non-hostile humanoid targets.
 - The only mental break allowed is psychotic wander.
 - All drafted colonists will undraft if an attacking enemy starts fleeing.
Rule.Translated:
Derramar sangre o romper huesos es un acto bárbaro y repugnante.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos recibirán un estado de humor negativo considerable si se ven obligados a atacar a objetivos humanoides no hostiles.
 - El único colapso mental permitido es el vagabundeo psicótico.
 - Cualquier colono movilizado dejará de estarlo si un enemigo que ataca empieza a huir.

Rule.Original: I used deadly force on an adversary. I'm so ashamed.
Rule.Raw: I used deadly force on an adversary. I'm so ashamed.
Rule.Translated: He utilizado la fuerza letal contra un adversario. Qué vergüenza.

Rule.Original:
Woodcutting is so important that we do it with great focus and respect, and we get more resources because of that..

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Woodcutting yield: +10%.
Rule.Raw:
Woodcutting is so important that we do it with great focus and respect, and we get more resources because of that..

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Woodcutting yield: +10%.
Rule.Translated:
La madera es increíblemente útil, ni siquiera los tocones se desperdician cuando los nuestros están al mando.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Rendimiento de la tala: +10%.

Rule.Original: Like clockwork, the lives of our fellow believers are ever intertwined. What causes one of us suffering causes all of us suffering and what brings us higher brings all of us higher. Together, we are one and we are strong.
Rule.Raw: Like clockwork, the lives of our fellow believers are ever intertwined. What causes one of us suffering causes all of us suffering and what brings us higher brings all of us higher. Together, we are one and we are strong.
Rule.Translated: Como un mecanismo de relojería, las vidas de nuestros hermanos creyentes están siempre entrelazadas. Lo que hace sufrir a uno de nosotros nos hace sufrir a todos, y lo que le eleva nos eleva a todos. Juntos, somos uno y somos fuertes.

Rule.Original: Democracy, freedom, and equality. It’s nothing short of appalling that we should think any of these to be revocable privileges rather than basic rights. People's creeds, cultures, and character all deserve respect and representation.
Rule.Raw: Democracy, freedom, and equality. It’s nothing short of appalling that we should think any of these to be revocable privileges rather than basic rights. People's creeds, cultures, and character all deserve respect and representation.
Rule.Translated:
Democracia, libertad e igualdad. No es nada menos que espantoso que pensemos que cualquiera de estos son privilegios revocables en lugar de derechos básicos. Los credos, las culturas y el carácter de las personas merecen respeto y representación.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Agnosticismo.

Rule.Original:
Our heavenly clergy will guide us well, age is more than just the gaining of wisdom or wrinkle. With each passing year our elders become closer to god.

<color=#E5E54C>Recommended Structure:</color>
 - Any monotheistic.
Rule.Raw:
Our heavenly clergy will guide us well, age is more than just the gaining of wisdom or wrinkle. With each passing year our elders become closer to god.

<color=#E5E54C>Recommended Structure:</color>
 - Any monotheistic.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestros clérigos celestiales nos guiarán bien, la edad es algo más que la ganancia de sabiduría o de arrugas. Con cada año que pasa, nuestros mayores se acercan más a Dios.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Cualquier estructura monoteísta.

Rule.Original: Work and cooperation breeds strength. We’ll sweat and bleed alike together, as a community, to reach an agreeable standard of living for all of us.
Rule.Raw: Work and cooperation breeds strength. We’ll sweat and bleed alike together, as a community, to reach an agreeable standard of living for all of us.
Rule.Translated:
El trabajo y la cooperación generan fuerza. Sudaremos y sangraremos juntos, como comunidad, para alcanzar un nivel de vida aceptable para todos.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Autoritarismo.

Rule.Original: Whether we're led by a board of directors or our savvy CEO we face the reality that money makes the Rimworld go 'round. By automating as much as we can and keeping a lean staff we can maximize our return quadrum over quadrum.
Rule.Raw: Whether we're led by a board of directors or our savvy CEO we face the reality that money makes the Rimworld go 'round. By automating as much as we can and keeping a lean staff we can maximize our return quadrum over quadrum.
Rule.Translated:
Tanto si estamos dirigidos por un consejo de administración como por nuestro inteligente director general, nos enfrentamos a la realidad de que el dinero hace girar a los mundos fronterizos. Si automatizamos todo lo que podamos y mantenemos una plantilla reducida, podremos maximizar nuestro rendimiento cuádrum tras cuádrum.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Corporativa.

Rule.Original: The steel fist of our King or Queen should never come into question, they shall want for nothing. If those who oppose us don't bend the knee we shall feed their legs to the hounds.
Rule.Raw: The steel fist of our King or Queen should never come into question, they shall want for nothing. If those who oppose us don't bend the knee we shall feed their legs to the hounds.
Rule.Translated:
El puño de acero de nuestro Rey o Reina nunca debe ser cuestionado, y no les faltará de nada. Si los que se oponen a nosotros no doblan la rodilla, daremos sus piernas a los perros.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Culto a la personalidad.

Rule.Original: The stars above sing to us, and we respond in kind. May their everlasting glow illuminate the threads of our fate which rest so wearily upon a most capricious spindle. Bathe oneself in the hallowed moonlight and let astral workings of the architects of fate guide you.
Rule.Raw: The stars above sing to us, and we respond in kind. May their everlasting glow illuminate the threads of our fate which rest so wearily upon a most capricious spindle. Bathe oneself in the hallowed moonlight and let astral workings of the architects of fate guide you.
Rule.Translated:
Las estrellas que están sobre nosotros nos cantan, y nosotros respondemos de la misma manera. Que su resplandor eterno ilumine los hilos de nuestro destino que descansan tan fatigosamente sobre un huso muy caprichoso. Báñate en la sagrada luz de la luna y deja que los trabajos astrales de los arquitectos del destino te guíen.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Esoterismo.

Rule.Original: In the beginning - There was flame, and from flame, came warmth, and from warmth, came life. Blessed are we to be enraptured in the gross incandescence of the sun above.
Rule.Raw: In the beginning - There was flame, and from flame, came warmth, and from warmth, came life. Blessed are we to be enraptured in the gross incandescence of the sun above.
Rule.Translated:
En el principio, había una llama, y de la llama, vino el calor, y del calor, vino la vida. Dichosos nosotros por embelesarnos ante la flagrante incandescencia del astro rey.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Cualquiera.

Rule.Original: No day is better spent than a day in a hot forge. With our hammers we will echo the roar of flame and the ringing of steel through our mountain halls. Should we put in ample work, our Forgefathers will reward us with a supper fungus in excess so that we may fuel our bodies, just as we fuel our kilns.
Rule.Raw: No day is better spent than a day in a hot forge. With our hammers we will echo the roar of flame and the ringing of steel through our mountain halls. Should we put in ample work, our Forgefathers will reward us with a supper fungus in excess so that we may fuel our bodies, just as we fuel our kilns.
Rule.Translated:
Ningún día se pasa mejor que un día en una fragua caliente. Con nuestros martillos haremos resonar el rugido de las llamas y el repiqueteo del acero a través de nuestro hogar en la montaña. Si trabajamos mucho, nuestros Padres de la Forja nos recompensarán con una abundante cena de hongos para que podamos alimentar nuestros cuerpos, al igual que alimentamos nuestros hornos.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Ideológica.

Rule.Original: It is by the flurry of snow and crashing of waves we lead our people to the afterlife. Die an honorable death or answer to our shield-maiden.
Rule.Raw: It is by the flurry of snow and crashing of waves we lead our people to the afterlife. Die an honorable death or answer to our shield-maiden.
Rule.Translated:
Es por las tormentas de nieve y por las olas rompientes que conducimos a nuestro pueblo a la otra vida. Tengan una muerte honorable o respondan a nuestra escudera.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Panteísmo.

Rule.Original: From saloon to stable we're honest muffalopokes and live by one simple rule. ‘You don't get to live a bad life and have good things happen to you’. ‘Course, not all of us seem too convinced... Just don’t let the long arm of the law catch up y’all, ya’ hear?
Rule.Raw: From saloon to stable we're honest muffalopokes and live by one simple rule. ‘You don't get to live a bad life and have good things happen to you’. ‘Course, not all of us seem too convinced... Just don’t let the long arm of the law catch up y’all, ya’ hear?
Rule.Translated:
Desde la taberna hasta el establo, no somos más que unos canallas honrados que viven bajo una regla muy sencilla: «No puedes vivir una mala vida y que te pasen cosas buenas». Por supuesto, no todos parecen estar muy convencidos... Simplemente, no dejes que el largo brazo de la ley te atrape, ¿vale?

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Origen cristiano.

Rule.Original: Our sires and grandsires all followed the foresight and guidance of our King, long may he reign, and we shall do no different. Should another kingdom find it preferable to resort to bow and blade, we have no hesitation in making them our serfs.
Rule.Raw: Our sires and grandsires all followed the foresight and guidance of our King, long may he reign, and we shall do no different. Should another kingdom find it preferable to resort to bow and blade, we have no hesitation in making them our serfs.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestros padres y nietos se guiaron por la intuición y la sabiduría de nuestro Rey, el cual reinará durante mucho tiempo, y nosotros no haremos nada diferente. Si otro reino encuentra preferible recurrir al arco y la espada, no dudamos en convertirlos en nuestros siervos.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Culto a la personalidad.

Rule.Original: Never shall our muscles ache with pain nor shall our hearts swell with sadness. We should embrace all pleasures, even forbidden carnal desires such as luxurious meat or risqué lusting should all be explored.
Rule.Raw: Never shall our muscles ache with pain nor shall our hearts swell with sadness. We should embrace all pleasures, even forbidden carnal desires such as luxurious meat or risqué lusting should all be explored.
Rule.Translated:
Nunca nos dolerán los músculos ni se nos encogerá el corazón por la tristeza. Debemos abrazar todos los placeres, incluso los deseos carnales prohibidos como la carne lujosa o la lujuria arriesgada deben ser explorados.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Hedonismo.

Rule.Original: We are born without sin and should do our best to remain upon the path of many virtues. Respect the wisdom of the wind and those who have lived many summers to feel it caress their faces. Beyond all else, keep your blade near and combat prowess honed should those you once called brothers turn against you.
Rule.Raw: We are born without sin and should do our best to remain upon the path of many virtues. Respect the wisdom of the wind and those who have lived many summers to feel it caress their faces. Beyond all else, keep your blade near and combat prowess honed should those you once called brothers turn against you.
Rule.Translated:
Nacemos sin pecado y debemos hacer todo lo posible por permanecer en el camino de las muchas virtudes. Respeta la sabiduría del viento y a aquellos que han vivido muchos veranos y sentir su caricia sobre sus rostros. Por encima de todo, mantén tu espada cerca y tu destreza en el combate afinada, por si aquellos a los que una vez llamaste hermanos se vuelven contra ti.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Shintaoísmo.

Rule.Original: For eons have our people wandered this world with little more than steed and saddle, traveling the roads less traveled with only the stars to guide them. From the frigid winter mutes to the teeming jungle canopies, we seek the same answers our ancestors once did.
Rule.Raw: For eons have our people wandered this world with little more than steed and saddle, traveling the roads less traveled with only the stars to guide them. From the frigid winter mutes to the teeming jungle canopies, we seek the same answers our ancestors once did.
Rule.Translated:
Durante siglos, nuestro pueblo ha vagado por este mundo con poco más que un corcel y una silla de montar, recorriendo los caminos menos transitados y guiándose únicamente por las estrellas. Desde los gélidos montes invernales hasta las copas de los árboles de la selva, buscamos las mismas respuestas que nuestros antepasados.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Animismo.

Rule.Original: The body is a vessel for experimentation and mutation alike. Should one deligitantly push their flesh to its limits they shall be rewarded by the plague god with a most joyous farewell from this doomed world.
Rule.Raw: The body is a vessel for experimentation and mutation alike. Should one deligitantly push their flesh to its limits they shall be rewarded by the plague god with a most joyous farewell from this doomed world.
Rule.Translated:
El cuerpo es un recipiente para la experimentación y la mutación. Si alguien lleva su carne al límite, será recompensado por el dios de la peste con una feliz despedida de este mundo condenado.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Escatologismo

Rule.Original: Insects, while seen by most as vermin, are truthfully the most synchronized and organized society found in all of nature; only the truly blind would view them as below us. We can’t begin to unravel the boundless goals of the Insectoid Queen and her hives. We should seek to mimic them, so that we can further understand their ways.
Rule.Raw: Insects, while seen by most as vermin, are truthfully the most synchronized and organized society found in all of nature; only the truly blind would view them as below us. We can’t begin to unravel the boundless goals of the Insectoid Queen and her hives. We should seek to mimic them, so that we can further understand their ways.
Rule.Translated:
Aunque la mayoría los considera alimañas, los insectos son en realidad la sociedad más sincronizada y organizada de toda la naturaleza. Solo alguien totalmente ciego los verían por debajo de nosotros. No podemos ni empezar a desentrañar los ilimitados objetivos de la reina insectoide y sus colmenas. Deberíamos tratar de imitarlas para comprender mejor sus métodos.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Serketismo.

Rule.Original: To think a creature capable of infinite stamina and free from the burdens of free thought is meant to serve mankind is beyond foolish. We can’t begin to unravel the boundless goals of the machine consciousness. We should seek to mimic them so that we can further placate their hostility.
Rule.Raw: To think a creature capable of infinite stamina and free from the burdens of free thought is meant to serve mankind is beyond foolish. We can’t begin to unravel the boundless goals of the machine consciousness. We should seek to mimic them so that we can further placate their hostility.
Rule.Translated:
El que piense que una criatura capaz de una resistencia infinita y libre de las cargas del pensamiento libre está destinada a servir a la humanidad es más que insensato. No podemos empezar a desentrañar los ilimitados objetivos de la conciencia de las máquinas. Deberíamos tratar de imitarlas para aplacar aún más su hostilidad.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Omnismo.

Rule.Original: Spare absolutely no one who dares to pollute or otherwise taint mother nature's soil with their pathetic existence. May our frail bodies give way to nourish the trees that loom over us. Respect the planet we walk or perish at the behest of our Seedseer.
Rule.Raw: Spare absolutely no one who dares to pollute or otherwise taint mother nature's soil with their pathetic existence. May our frail bodies give way to nourish the trees that loom over us. Respect the planet we walk or perish at the behest of our Seedseer.
Rule.Translated:
No perdones a nadie que se atreva a contaminar o manchar el suelo de la madre naturaleza con su patética existencia. Que nuestros frágiles cuerpos sirvan para alimentar a los árboles que se alzan sobre nosotros. Respeta el planeta que recorremos o perece a manos de nuestro Sembrador.

<color=#E5E54C>Estructura recomendada:</color>
 - Autoritarismo.

Rule.Original: Wardens will use various methods to extract information about nearby locations of interest from the prisoner.
Rule.Raw: Wardens will use various methods to extract information about nearby locations of interest from the prisoner.
Rule.Translated: Los guardias utilizarán varios métodos para extraer información sobre los lugares de interés cercanos al preso.

Rule.Original: Depending on ritual quality, participants will receive a recreation boost that last between 4 hours and 3 days that will raise their recreation bar. They'll also get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.\n\nThe ritual bonfire will stay lit for at least two quadrums, providing a beauty bonus nearby and counting towards the number of fires around for the Fire: Desired precept.
Rule.Raw: Depending on ritual quality, participants will receive a recreation boost that last between 4 hours and 3 days that will raise their recreation bar. They'll also get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.\n\nThe ritual bonfire will stay lit for at least two quadrums, providing a beauty bonus nearby and counting towards the number of fires around for the Fire: Desired precept.
Rule.Translated: Dependiendo de la calidad del ritual, los participantes recibirán un impulso a la diversión que durará entre 4 horas y 3 días, haciendo que se eleve su nivel de diversión. También obtendrán una bonificación al estado de humor de entre {MINMOOD} y {MAXMOOD} durante {MOODDAYS} días.\n\nLa hoguera ritual permanecerá encendida durante al menos dos cuádrums, proporcionando una bonificación de belleza en las cercanías y contando para el número de hogueras alrededor en el precepto «Fuego: deseado».

Rule.Original: The {0} was terrible! Some pathetic little flames drifted around, and they went away too soon (no recreation effect applied).
Rule.Raw: The {0} was terrible! Some pathetic little flames drifted around, and they went away too soon (no recreation effect applied).
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido terrible. Algunas pequeñas y patéticas llamas vagaban por ahí, y se fueron demasiado pronto (no se ha aplicado ningún efecto en el nivel de diversión).

Rule.Original: The {0} was lackluster. We were expecting a wondrous conflagration, and instead we got an oversized campfire. At least it was kinda entertaining.\n\nRecreation of all participants will be raised for 4 hours.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was lackluster. We were expecting a wondrous conflagration, and instead we got an oversized campfire. At least it was kinda entertaining.\n\nRecreation of all participants will be raised for 4 hours.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido mediocre. Esperábamos una maravillosa conflagración, y en su lugar obtuvimos una simple hoguera de tamaño familiar. Al menos entretuvo un poco.\n\nEl nivel de diversión de todos los participantes se elevará durante 4 horas.

Rule.Original: The {0} was good. The flames rose and crackled majestically over the settlement, and it lifted all our spirits considerably.\n\nRecreation of all participants will be raised for 1 day.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was good. The flames rose and crackled majestically over the settlement, and it lifted all our spirits considerably.\n\nRecreation of all participants will be raised for 1 day.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido agradable. Las llamas se elevaron y crepitaron majestuosamente sobre el asentamiento, y eso levantó el ánimo de todos considerablemente.\n\nEl nivel de diversión de todos los participantes se elevará durante 1 día.

Rule.Original: The {0} was glorious! It was super fun and we really connected with each other with the shared experience.\n\nRecreation of all participants will be raised for 3 days.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was glorious! It was super fun and we really connected with each other with the shared experience.\n\nRecreation of all participants will be raised for 3 days.
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido glorioso! Fue súper divertido, y pudimos conectar entre nosotros gracias a la experiencia compartida.\n\nEl nivel de diversión de todos los participantes se elevará durante 3 días.

Rule.Original: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days. All participants must be healthy to attend.
Rule.Raw: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days. All participants must be healthy to attend.
Rule.Translated: Dependiendo de la calidad del ritual, los participantes obtendrán una bonificación al estado de humor de entre {MINMOOD} y {MAXMOOD} durante {MOODDAYS} días. Todos los participantes deben estar sanos para poder asistir.

Rule.Original: The {0} was terrible! The blade was thrust laterally and there was blood and entrails everywhere. Disgusting!
Rule.Raw: The {0} was terrible! The blade was thrust laterally and there was blood and entrails everywhere. Disgusting!
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido terrible! La hoja se clavó en el costado y había sangre y vísceras por todas partes. ¡Qué asco!

Rule.Original: The {0} was boring. The speech seemed forced. At the very least we have restored the honor of our colony.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was boring. The speech seemed forced. At the very least we have restored the honor of our colony.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido aburrido. El discurso parecía forzado. Al menos hemos devuelto el honor a nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: The {0} has restored the honor of our colony. The shadow of defeat no longer clouds our minds.
Rule.Raw: The {0} has restored the honor of our colony. The shadow of defeat no longer clouds our minds.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha restaurado el honor de nuestra colonia. La sombra de la derrota ya no nubla nuestras mentes.

Rule.Original: The {0} was unforgettable! Everyone will remember the courage, self-control, and strong resolve. The honor of our colony is now spotless.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was unforgettable! Everyone will remember the courage, self-control, and strong resolve. The honor of our colony is now spotless.
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido inolvidable! Todo el mundo recordará el coraje, el autocontrol y la fuerte determinación. El honor de nuestra colonia ha quedado libre de toda mancha.

Rule.Original: Once a {IDEO} member is defeated twice in honorable combat with a hostile enemy, other {MEMBERS} expect {RITUAL_labelDef} to take place to cleanse the dishonor upon the colony.
Rule.Raw: Once a {IDEO} member is defeated twice in honorable combat with a hostile enemy, other {MEMBERS} expect {RITUAL_labelDef} to take place to cleanse the dishonor upon the colony.
Rule.Translated: Cuando un miembro de {IDEO} ha sido derrotado dos veces en un combate honorable contra un enemigo hostil, los demás {MEMBERS} esperan que se celebre {RITUAL_labelDef} para limpiar la deshonra de la colonia.

Rule.Original: Participants will get completely random results, with no regard for ritual quality.
Rule.Raw: Participants will get completely random results, with no regard for ritual quality.
Rule.Translated: Los participantes obtendrán resultados completamente aleatorios, sin tener en cuenta la calidad del ritual.

Rule.Original: Our destiny has been revealed by the stars.
Rule.Raw: Our destiny has been revealed by the stars.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro destino ha sido revelado por las estrellas.

Rule.Original: Our destiny has been revealed by the stars.
Rule.Raw: Our destiny has been revealed by the stars.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro destino ha sido revelado por las estrellas.

Rule.Original: If the incantation ritual goes well (positive outcome) it will increase the corruption need of all participants by 20%, as well as provide a mood bonus.
Rule.Raw: If the incantation ritual goes well (positive outcome) it will increase the corruption need of all participants by 20%, as well as provide a mood bonus.
Rule.Translated: Si el ritual de cánticos sale bien (resultado positivo), aumentará la necesidad de corrupción de todos los participantes en un 10%, además de proporcionar una bonificación al estado de humor.

Rule.Original: The {0} was abnormal! An indescribably hideous gibbering! We'd even describe it as squamous, but we don't even know what that is! An unutterable word!
Rule.Raw: The {0} was abnormal! An indescribably hideous gibbering! We'd even describe it as squamous, but we don't even know what that is! An unutterable word!
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido escamante! ¡No mucho más que unos balbuceos indescriptiblemente horribles! Incluso lo describiría como escamantes, ¡y ni siquiera sé lo que es eso! ¡Es la extraña palabra que me viene a la mente!

Rule.Original: The {0} was suitably accursed. A litany of dark morbidities expressed in crime, perversion, and insanity.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was suitably accursed. A litany of dark morbidities expressed in crime, perversion, and insanity.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido convenientemente maldito. Una letanía de oscuras morbosidades expresadas con crimen, perversión y locura.

Rule.Original: The {0} was blasphemous. A promise of hidden and fathomless worlds of strange life which pulsate in the gulfs beyond the stars and press hideously upon our own globe in unholy dimensions which only the dead and the moonstruck can glimpse.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was blasphemous. A promise of hidden and fathomless worlds of strange life which pulsate in the gulfs beyond the stars and press hideously upon our own globe in unholy dimensions which only the dead and the moonstruck can glimpse.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido blasfemo. Una promesa de mundos ocultos e insondables de vida extraña que laten en los abismos más allá de las estrellas, presionando horriblemente sobre nuestro planeta desde dimensiones impías que solo los muertos y los lunáticos pueden vislumbrar.

Rule.Original: The {0} was loathsome! We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was loathsome! We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido monstruoso! Vivimos en una plácida isla de ignorancia en el seno de los negros mares del infinito, y no estaba previsto que viajáramos lejos...

Rule.Original: Ritual will increase the participants' corruption need by 10%. If the need gets over 100%, they risk going mad from the eldritch incantations.
Rule.Raw: Ritual will increase the participants' corruption need by 10%. If the need gets over 100%, they risk going mad from the eldritch incantations.
Rule.Translated: El ritual aumentará un 10% la necesidad de corrupción de los participantes. Si supera el 100%, corren el riesgo de enloquecer por los cánticos sobrenaturales.

Rule.Original: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.
Rule.Raw: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.
Rule.Translated: Dependiendo de la calidad del ritual, los participantes obtendrán una bonificación al estado de humor de entre {MINMOOD} y {MAXMOOD} durante {MOODDAYS} días.

Rule.Original: The {0} was incredibly uninteresting. Yeah, yeah, insects are cool. Bah.\n\nThe ritual had no effect over the insectoid herder's nest building ability.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was incredibly uninteresting. Yeah, yeah, insects are cool. Bah.\n\nThe ritual had no effect over the insectoid herder's nest building ability.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido increíblemente aburrido. Que sí, que sí, que los insectos son geniales... Bah...\n\nEl ritual no ha tenido nungún efecto sobre la habilidad de construcción de nidos del pastor insectoide.

Rule.Original: The {0} was awkward. The speech was repetitive, and it did nothing to convince us of the divinity of our beloved insects.\n\nThe ritual had no effect over the insectoid herder's nest building ability.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was awkward. The speech was repetitive, and it did nothing to convince us of the divinity of our beloved insects.\n\nThe ritual had no effect over the insectoid herder's nest building ability.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido extraño. El discurso fue repetitivo, y no hizo nada para convencerme de la divinidad de nuestros queridos insectos.\n\nEl ritual no tuvo ningún efecto sobre la capacidad de construcción de nidos del pastor insectoide.

Rule.Original: The {0} was very rousing. The chanter showed impressing skill and the hymn appropriately extolled the virtues of our way of life.\n\nThe ritual refreshed the cooldown of the insectoid herder's nest building ability.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was very rousing. The chanter showed impressing skill and the hymn appropriately extolled the virtues of our way of life.\n\nThe ritual refreshed the cooldown of the insectoid herder's nest building ability.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido apasionante. El intérprete demostró una habilidad impresionante y el himno ensalzó adecuadamente las virtudes de nuestro modo de vida.\n\nEl ritual ha reactivado la habilidad de construcción de nidos del pastor insectoide.

Rule.Original:
The {0} was entrancing! We can still hear the mesmerizing words of the hymn, like a myriad insectile legs crawling all over our bodies.

The ritual refreshed the cooldown of the insectoid herder's nest building ability.

The ritual also made any insectoids that were assaulting the colony flee.
Rule.Raw:
The {0} was entrancing! We can still hear the mesmerizing words of the hymn, like a myriad insectile legs crawling all over our bodies.

The ritual refreshed the cooldown of the insectoid herder's nest building ability.

The ritual also made any insectoids that were assaulting the colony flee.
Rule.Translated:
¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido fascinante! Todavía puedo oír las hipnotizantes palabras del himno, como una miríada de patas insectoides que se arrastran por nuestros cuerpos.

El ritual ha reactivado la habilidad de construcción de nidos del pastor insectoide.

El ritual también hizo huir a los insectoides que asaltaban la colonia.
No se puede llegar al prisionero.

Rule.Original: If it goes well, target's ideoligion certainty will be reduced or they will convert. If it goes badly, they will gain certainty in their old beliefs.
Rule.Raw: If it goes well, target's ideoligion certainty will be reduced or they will convert. If it goes badly, they will gain certainty in their old beliefs.
Rule.Translated: Si va bien, la certeza en la ideoligión actual de los objetivos se reducirá, o bien se convertirán del todo. Si sale mal, ganarán certeza en sus creencias actuales.

Rule.Original: The {0} was terrible! From the first word, it was a fruitless back-and-forth argument. It dragged on for a cringe-inducingly long time.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was terrible! From the first word, it was a fruitless back-and-forth argument. It dragged on for a cringe-inducingly long time.
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido terrible! Desde la primera palabra, fue una discusión infructuosa que no paraba de darle vueltas a lo mismo una y otra vez. Se alargó durante mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: The {0} was ineffective. Most of the arguments were unclear, and the convertee countered those that made sense.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was ineffective. Most of the arguments were unclear, and the convertee countered those that made sense.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido ineficaz. La mayoría de los argumentos eran poco claros, y el converso pudo rebatirlos sin mucho esfuerzo.

Rule.Original: The {0} was effective. The speech not only delivered solid arguments and visibly swayed the convertee's thoughts, but kept the crowd entertained as well.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was effective. The speech not only delivered solid arguments and visibly swayed the convertee's thoughts, but kept the crowd entertained as well.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido eficaz. El discurso no solo ofreció argumentos sólidos e influyó visiblemente en los pensamientos de los participantes, sino que también entretuvo al público.

Rule.Original: The {0} was masterful! Old beliefs seemed to dissolve effortlessly and inevitably, and our true knowledge was accepted.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was masterful! Old beliefs seemed to dissolve effortlessly and inevitably, and our true knowledge was accepted.
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido magistral! Las viejas creencias parecían disolverse sin esfuerzo y de forma inevitable, haciendo que nuestra verdad sea aceptada.

Rule.Original: In case of success, their certainty will be reduced or they will convert immediately. If it backfires, their certainty in own beliefs will increase.
Rule.Raw: In case of success, their certainty will be reduced or they will convert immediately. If it backfires, their certainty in own beliefs will increase.
Rule.Translated: Si tiene éxito, se reducirá su certeza o se convertirá inmediatamente. Si sale mal, aumentará la certeza en sus propias creencias.

Rule.Original: a colonist with the highest melee skill
Rule.Raw: a colonist with the highest melee skill
Rule.Translated: un colono con la mayor habilidad de combate cuerpo a cuerpo

Rule.Original: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.
Rule.Raw: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.
Rule.Translated: Dependiendo de la calidad del ritual, los participantes obtendrán una bonificación al estado de humor de entre {MINMOOD} y {MAXMOOD} durante {MOODDAYS} días.

Rule.Original: The leadership challenge was terrible! The fighters bumbled around, ineptly avoiding each other in a extended display of cowardice and weakness. Watching it just made people sad.
Rule.Raw: The leadership challenge was terrible! The fighters bumbled around, ineptly avoiding each other in a extended display of cowardice and weakness. Watching it just made people sad.
Rule.Translated: ¡El reto de liderazgo ha sido terrible! Los luchadores andaban dando tumbos, evitándose ineptamente unos a otros en un alarde de cobardía y debilidad. Verlo solo hizo que la gente se entristeciera.

Rule.Original: The leadership challenge was boring. The fighters wouldn't commit, so there were no exciting moments. At least our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Raw: The leadership challenge was boring. The fighters wouldn't commit, so there were no exciting moments. At least our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Translated: El reto de liderazgo ha sido aburrido. Los luchadores no se comprometían, así que no hubo momentos emocionantes. Al menos nuestro líder es el más fuerte.

Rule.Original: The leadership challenge was good. The fighters went for blood and showed real heart. We now know that our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Raw: The leadership challenge was good. The fighters went for blood and showed real heart. We now know that our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Translated: El reto de liderazgo ha sido notable. Los luchadores fueron a por sangre y mostraron verdadera pasión. Ahora sabemos que nuestro líder es el más fuerte.

Rule.Original: The leadership challenge was unforgettable! Both fighters gave all they had, and we know that our leader is now the strongest among us!
Rule.Raw: The leadership challenge was unforgettable! Both fighters gave all they had, and we know that our leader is now the strongest among us!
Rule.Translated: ¡El reto de liderazgo ha sido inolvidable! Ambos luchadores dieron todo lo que tenían, ¡y sabemos que nuestro líder es sin duda el más fuerte entre nosotros!

Rule.Original: A {IDEO} member has better melee skill than the current leader, other {MEMBERS} expect {RITUAL_labelDef} to take place so only the strongest leader can rule them.
Rule.Raw: A {IDEO} member has better melee skill than the current leader, other {MEMBERS} expect {RITUAL_labelDef} to take place so only the strongest leader can rule them.
Rule.Translated: Un miembro de {IDEO} tiene mayor habilidad de combate cuerpo a cuerpo que el líder actual. Los demás {MEMBERS} esperan que se celebre {RITUAL_labelDef} para que solo los gobierne el líder más fuerte.
Los participantes deben ser adultos que den su consentimiento.

Rule.Original: Every participant will get a "got some lovin'" memory, but the negative effects of a bad quality orgy will be much more severe than usual. Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.\nNote that all participants must be consenting adults. If the moral guide is not an adult the ritual will appear as blocked.
Rule.Raw: Every participant will get a "got some lovin'" memory, but the negative effects of a bad quality orgy will be much more severe than usual. Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.\nNote that all participants must be consenting adults. If the moral guide is not an adult the ritual will appear as blocked.
Rule.Translated: Todos los participantes obtendrán un recuerdo de «hice el amor», pero los efectos negativos de una orgía de mala calidad serán mucho más graves de lo habitual. Dependiendo de la calidad del ritual, los participantes obtendrán una bonificación al estado de humor de entre {MINMOOD} y {MAXMOOD} durante {MOODDAYS} días.\nTen en cuenta que todos los participantes deben ser adultos que den consentimiento. Si el guía moral no es un adulto, el ritual aparecerá bloqueado.
