Rule.Original: The {0} was grotesque! When you think of an orgy, you tend to imagine attractive people. This was... the entire opposite. The mental images will take a while to go away.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was grotesque! When you think of an orgy, you tend to imagine attractive people. This was... the entire opposite. The mental images will take a while to go away.
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido grotesco! Cuando piensas en una orgía, tiendes a imaginar gente atractiva. Esto fue... Todo lo contrario. Las imágenes mentales tardarán un tiempo en desaparecer.

Rule.Original: The {0} was awkward. Everyone sat around not knowing exactly what to do, naked bodies laying everywhere. Quite disappointing.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was awkward. Everyone sat around not knowing exactly what to do, naked bodies laying everywhere. Quite disappointing.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido incómodo. Todos sentados sin saber qué hacer, cuerpos desnudos por todas partes. Bastante decepcionante.

Rule.Original: The {0} was very sexy. We gave ourselves to each other in a communal expression of our deepest passions.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was very sexy. We gave ourselves to each other in a communal expression of our deepest passions.
Rule.Translated: El ritual «{0}» ha sido muy sexy. Nos entregamos unos a otros en una expresión comunitaria de nuestras pasiones más profundas.

Rule.Original: The {0} was exhilarating! We all donned our high-society masquerade masks and uncovered our bodies. A barrage of ecstasy unlike no other made our bodies tremble with barely concealed excitement.
Rule.Raw: The {0} was exhilarating! We all donned our high-society masquerade masks and uncovered our bodies. A barrage of ecstasy unlike no other made our bodies tremble with barely concealed excitement.
Rule.Translated: ¡El ritual «{0}» ha sido estimulante! Todos nos pusimos nuestras máscaras de alta sociedad y nos desnudamos. Una avalancha de éxtasis sexual orgásmico sin igual hizo que nuestros cuerpos temblaran con una excitación apenas disimulada.

Rule.Original: an animal with body size of at least 0.8
Rule.Raw: an animal with body size of at least 0.8
Rule.Translated: un animal con un tamaño corporal de al menos 0.8
No se puede llegar al animal.

Rule.Original: Ritual will emancipate all participating slaves. Depending on outcome, a growing percentage of slaves will decide to join the colony, or leave.
Rule.Raw: Ritual will emancipate all participating slaves. Depending on outcome, a growing percentage of slaves will decide to join the colony, or leave.
Rule.Translated: El ritual emancipará a todos los esclavos participantes. Según el resultado, un porcentaje creciente decidirá unirse a la colonia o marcharse.

Rule.Original: Depending on ritual quality and as long as it is positive, between 1 and 6 trade caravans arrive from friendly factions. Also, depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.\n\nIf Microelectronics has been researched, you will need to have at least 200 silver near a valid trading beacon for the fair to work properly, or else participants will receive a "cheap trading fair" mood penalty.
Rule.Raw: Depending on ritual quality and as long as it is positive, between 1 and 6 trade caravans arrive from friendly factions. Also, depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.\n\nIf Microelectronics has been researched, you will need to have at least 200 silver near a valid trading beacon for the fair to work properly, or else participants will receive a "cheap trading fair" mood penalty.
Rule.Translated: Depending on ritual quality and as long as it is positive, between 1 and 6 trade caravans arrive from friendly factions. Also, depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.\n\nYou will need to have at least 200 silver near a valid trading beacon for the fair to work properly, or else participants will receive a "cheap trading fair" mood penalty.

Rule.Original: Spectators must be willing to watch the violent conversion.
Rule.Raw: Spectators must be willing to watch the violent conversion.
Rule.Translated: Los espectadores deben estar dispuestos a ver la conversión violenta.
No se puede llegar al prisionero.
iniciado en un altar o ideograma

Rule.Original: Spectators must be willing to watch the wicker man burning.
Rule.Raw: Spectators must be willing to watch the wicker man burning.
Rule.Translated: Los espectadores deben estar dispuestos a ver arder al hombre de mimbre.
No se puede llegar al prisionero.

Rule.Original: An ancient rack unit packed with unidentifiable devices. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient rack unit packed with unidentifiable devices. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo soporte repleto de dispositivos inidentificables. Faltan piezas valiosas y todo lo demás se ha degradado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: A collection of ancient equipment blocks of unknown function. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A collection of ancient equipment blocks of unknown function. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una colección de antiguos bloques de equipamiento de función desconocida. Faltan piezas valiosas y todo lo demás se ha degradado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: A large ancient machine case filled with unknown machinery. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A large ancient machine case filled with unknown machinery. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una gran carcasa de una antigua máquina llena de mecanismos desconocido. Faltan piezas valiosas y todo lo demás se ha degradado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: An ancient device that looks like it once stored some kind of fluid. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient device that looks like it once stored some kind of fluid. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo dispositivo que parece haber almacenado algún tipo de fluido. Faltan piezas valiosas y todo lo demás se ha degradado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: An ancient self-powered lamp. Its internal power supply is badly depleted, but it still emits a weak glow.
Rule.Raw: An ancient self-powered lamp. Its internal power supply is badly depleted, but it still emits a weak glow.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua lámpara autoalimentada. Su fuente de alimentación interna está muy agotada, pero aún emite un débil resplandor.

Rule.Original: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Though uncomfortable, it can still be used, but it's too dilapidated to restore.
Rule.Raw: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Though uncomfortable, it can still be used, but it's too dilapidated to restore.
Rule.Translated: Un colchón viejo y podrido sobre un armazón oxidado. Aunque es incómodo, aún se puede usar, pero está demasiado deteriorado como para restaurarlo.

Rule.Original: An ancient computer interface. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient computer interface. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua interfaz de ordenador. Faltan piezas valiosas y todo lo demás se ha degradado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo y oxidado juego de taquillas. Todas las taquillas han sido forzadas, por lo que no queda nada de valor.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una caja antigua y rota. Los objetos de valor que contenía se han degradado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua caja de aspecto militar. Se rompió hace tiempo y los objetos de valor que contenía ya han desaparecido.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained were taken long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained were taken long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una caja antigua y rota. Los objetos de valor que contenía se los han llevado hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken barrel that looks like it once contained waste of some sort. The only thing it contains now is a smear of dried sludge.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken barrel that looks like it once contained waste of some sort. The only thing it contains now is a smear of dried sludge.
Rule.Translated: Un barril roto que parece haber contenido algún tipo de residuo. Lo único que contiene ahora es una mancha de lodo seco.

Rule.Original: An ancient electrical generator. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago, and the rest has rusted into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient electrical generator. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago, and the rest has rusted into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo generador eléctrico. Sus componentes útiles están destrozados o ha sido saqueados hace tiempo, mientras que el resto se ha oxidado hasta quedar inservible.

Rule.Original: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa utilizada en el pasado para realizar operaciones quirúrgicas. Hace tiempo que está en un estado lamentable.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.
Rule.Translated: Un carrito de la compra antiguo y oxidado. Cómo llegó aquí exactamente es un misterio, y la historia es probablemente tan larga como triste.

Rule.Original: An ancient postbox, smashed and deteriorated to uselessness. It seems to have been moved here long ago for some unknown reason.
Rule.Raw: An ancient postbox, smashed and deteriorated to uselessness. It seems to have been moved here long ago for some unknown reason.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo buzón de correos, destrozado y deteriorado hasta la inutilidad. Parece haber sido trasladado aquí hace mucho tiempo por alguna razón desconocida.

Rule.Original: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.
Rule.Raw: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina expendedora. Quedó inservible hace siglos, y generaciones de saqueadores se han llevado todas las piezas útiles. Cómo acabó aquí es un misterio.

Rule.Original: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.
Rule.Raw: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina de aire acondicionado. Su interior ha quedado inservible hace mucho tiempo y lo que no ha sido saqueado se ha oxidado durante el tiempo transcurrido desde entonces.

Rule.Original: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.
Rule.Raw: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo fregadero de cocina hecho de algún material no metálico. Está muy deteriorado y no hay forma de aprovechar nada de él.\n\nCómo llegó aquí debe ser una larga historia.

Rule.Original: An ancient stove. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient stove. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua estufa. Está totalmente destrozada y oxidada, por lo que ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nCómo llegó aquí es difícil de decir.

Rule.Original: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un horno antiguo. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nCómo llegó aquí es difícil de decir.

Rule.Original: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo cajero automático. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo ha llegado hasta aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient device used for washing textiles. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient device used for washing textiles. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo aparato utilizado para lavar tejidos. Destrozada y oxidada, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo ha llegado hasta aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua boca de incendios. Está completamente oxidada, por lo que ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo ha llegado hasta aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo aparato para calentar comida. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo ha llegado hasta aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un váter antiguo. Destrozado hace mucho tiempo, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo ha llegado hasta aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico antiguo. Fue despojado de sus componentes más útiles hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: A small, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Raw: A small, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja vacía, abandonada hace años. Está demasiado oxidada como para almacenar nada.

Rule.Original: A long, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Raw: A long, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Translated: Una especie de cajón largo y vacío que fue abandonado hace años. Está demasiado oxidada como para almacenar nada.

Rule.Original: A large crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Raw: A large crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Translated: Una gran caja abandonada hace años. Está demasiado oxidada como para almacenar nada.

Rule.Original: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Raw: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda antigua, que debió pertenecer a algún tipo de vehículo. La goma se ha deteriorado, y el metal está retorcido y oxidado.

Rule.Original: A giant wheel which came off some large vehicle many ages ago. The rubber has disintegrated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Raw: A giant wheel which came off some large vehicle many ages ago. The rubber has disintegrated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda gigante que se desprendió de algún gran vehículo hace muchos años. La goma se ha desintegrado, y el metal está retorcido y oxidado.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un coche antiguo y roto. Todo lo que no está oxidado ha sido saqueado hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un camión antiguo y roto. Todo lo que era útil se ha oxidado o ha sido saqueado hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo transporte de tropas, completamente inservible. Todo lo que no se ha oxidado ha sido saqueado hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.
Rule.Translated: La carrocería de algún tipo de coche antiguo, completamente oxidada. Está apunto de degradarse por completo.

Rule.Original: The torso of a mid-scale warwalker which fell here in ancient days. The valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: The torso of a mid-scale warwalker which fell here in ancient days. The valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: El torso de un caminante de guerra de tamaño medio que cayó aquí en tiempos remotos. Las partes valiosas fueron saqueadas hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient dropship. The valuable parts were looted long ago and the rest has deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient dropship. The valuable parts were looted long ago and the rest has deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de una antigua nave de transporte. Las partes valiosas fueron saqueadas hace tiempo y el resto se han deteriorado tanto que han quedado inservibles.

Rule.Original: The assault claw of an ancient mid-scale warwalker. This weapon specialized in tearing through heavy plasteel armor at close range. Its valuable components were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: The assault claw of an ancient mid-scale warwalker. This weapon specialized in tearing through heavy plasteel armor at close range. Its valuable components were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: La garra de asalto de un antiguo caminante de guerra de tamaño media. Esta arma estaba especializada en desgarrar armaduras pesadas de plastiacero a corta distancia. Sus valiosos componentes fueron saqueados hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: The shattered leg of a mid-scale warwalker that fell here long ago. It has been picked clean by looters, and no valuable components remain.
Rule.Raw: The shattered leg of a mid-scale warwalker that fell here long ago. It has been picked clean by looters, and no valuable components remain.
Rule.Translated: La pierna destrozada de un caminante de guerra de tamaño medio, que cayó aquí hace mucho tiempo. Los saqueadores ya se han hecho con cualquier componente valioso que quedaba.

Rule.Original: The shattered remains of an ancient sub-scale warsprinter. Whatever parts weren't ruined when it was destroyed were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: The shattered remains of an ancient sub-scale warsprinter. Whatever parts weren't ruined when it was destroyed were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Los restos destrozados de un antiguo sprinter de guerra. Las partes que no se arruinaron cuando fue destruido fueron saqueadas hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: The ruined remains of an ancient mid-scale warspider. It has been picked over many times, and there is nothing valuable left to loot.
Rule.Raw: The ruined remains of an ancient mid-scale warspider. It has been picked over many times, and there is nothing valuable left to loot.
Rule.Translated: Los restos destrozados de una antigua araña de guerra. Los han saqueado en numerosas ocasiones, por lo que no queda nada valioso.

Rule.Original: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de una antigua tubería. Una vez transportó un fluido valioso a través de largas distancias. Ya la han despojado de cualquier resto útil, y se ha deteriorado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: A massive foot from an ancient warwalker. It seems to have been torn free from its owner by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Raw: A massive foot from an ancient warwalker. It seems to have been torn free from its owner by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un pie enorme de un antiguo caminante de guerra. Parece haber sido arrancado del conjunto por algún tipo de arma pesada. Todos los componentes útiles fueron saqueados o se han deteriorado hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient tank which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient tank which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un antiguo tanque que fue destruido por algún tipo de arma pesada. Todos los componentes útiles fueron saqueados o se han deteriorado hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient armoured troop carrier which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient armoured troop carrier which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un antiguo vehículo blindado de transporte de tropas que fue destruido por algún tipo de arma pesada. Todos los componentes útiles fueron saqueados o se han deteriorado hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: Most of the armored shell of a warwalker. It appears to have been torn off by some colossal weapon system. All the valuable parts were looted, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Raw: Most of the armored shell of a warwalker. It appears to have been torn off by some colossal weapon system. All the valuable parts were looted, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Translated: La mayor parte del blindaje de un caminante de guerra. Parece haber sido arrancado del conjunto por algún sistema de armas colosal. Todas las partes valiosas fueron saqueadas, y el resto está demasiado deteriorado.

Rule.Original: An ancient jet engine, probably detached from a large airplane. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient jet engine, probably detached from a large airplane. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo motor a reacción, que probablemente ha pertenecido a un gran avión. Sus delicadas partes internas están oxidadas hasta la inutilidad, y las piezas valiosas fueron saqueadas hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient dropship engine. It probably came off a military troop carrier. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient dropship engine. It probably came off a military troop carrier. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo motor de nave, que probablemente perteneció a algún tipo de transporte militar de tropas. Sus delicadas partes internas están oxidadas hasta la inutilidad, y las piezas valiosas fueron saqueadas hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Raw: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo vehículo capaz de volar de forma automática. Sus partes valiosas fueron saqueadas hace tiempo y el resto está muy deteriorado.

Rule.Original: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Raw: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura defensiva para detener vehículos. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose.

Rule.Original: An large, ancient engine block from some giant vehicle or power source. It's rusted through, and all the useful components are gone. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Raw: An large, ancient engine block from some giant vehicle or power source. It's rusted through, and all the useful components are gone. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Translated: Un bloque de motor grande y antiguo de algún tipo de vehículo gigante o fuente de energía. Está oxidado, y todos los componentes útiles han desaparecido. Ninguna reparación podría salvar esto.

Rule.Original: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.
Rule.Raw: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua valla hecha de postes de hormigón armado unidos por paneles de hormigón.

Rule.Original: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.
Rule.Raw: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de alambre de espino antiguo. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose y ya no supone ningún peligro.

Rule.Original: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.
Rule.Raw: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.
Rule.Translated: Un montón de viejas tuberías oxidadas. Es difícil decir cómo acabaron aquí.

Rule.Original: A mounting platform that once held some sort of cannon. It has been broken for many years and every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: A mounting platform that once held some sort of cannon. It has been broken for many years and every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una plataforma de montaje que una vez sostuvo algún tipo de cañón. Lleva muchos años rota y todos sus componentes útiles fueron saqueados hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: A barrel from a long-range cannon for artillery or anti-ship use. When it was new, it must have been frighteningly powerful. Now, it's far beyond repair and every useful component has been looted.
Rule.Raw: A barrel from a long-range cannon for artillery or anti-ship use. When it was new, it must have been frighteningly powerful. Now, it's far beyond repair and every useful component has been looted.
Rule.Translated: El cilindro de un gran cañón de largo alcance para uso artillero o antibuque. Cuando funcionaba, debía de ser terriblemente potente. Ahora está mucho más allá de la reparación y cada componente útil ha sido saqueado.

Rule.Original: A large container from some ancient freight carrying vehicle. It has long since been looted and deteriorted into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A large container from some ancient freight carrying vehicle. It has long since been looted and deteriorted into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un gran contenedor de algún antiguo vehículo de transporte de mercancías. Hace tiempo que ha sido saqueado y deteriorado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: The remains of a smashed mechanoid. All the useful components and materials are ruined or missing.
Rule.Raw: The remains of a smashed mechanoid. All the useful components and materials are ruined or missing.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un mecanoide destrozado. Todos los componentes y materiales útiles están estropeados o han desaparecido.
restos de baliza de llamada mecanoide

Rule.Original: The broken shell of a mech drop beacon. Its useful components are missing and the shell has deteriorated after many years.
Rule.Raw: The broken shell of a mech drop beacon. Its useful components are missing and the shell has deteriorated after many years.
Rule.Translated: El armazón roto de una baliza de descenso mecanoide. Faltan sus componentes útiles y el armazón se ha deteriorado tras muchos años.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de seguridad, antigua y rota. Todas las piezas valiosas han sido saqueadas o están destrozadas.

Rule.Original: An ancient engine block that is rusted through. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Raw: An ancient engine block that is rusted through. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Translated: Un bloque de motor antiguo que está completamente oxidado. Ninguna reparación podría salvarlo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken ship navigation beacon. Every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken ship navigation beacon. Every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua baliza de navegación, completamente rota. Ya ha sido despojada de cualquier componente útil hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: Ancient chunks of space junk that fell from orbit. Perhaps a relic of an ancient space battle.
Rule.Raw: Ancient chunks of space junk that fell from orbit. Perhaps a relic of an ancient space battle.
Rule.Translated: Antiguos trozos de basura espacial que en algún momento cayeron desde la órbita. Tal vez una reliquia de una antigua batalla espacial.

Rule.Original: A large humanoid figure made out of dry brush, thatch, and wood scraps. Prisoners have to be physically restrained to the figurine then burned alive as part of a trial or ritual.
Rule.Raw: A large humanoid figure made out of dry brush, thatch, and wood scraps. Prisoners have to be physically restrained to the figurine then burned alive as part of a trial or ritual.
Rule.Translated: Una gran figura humanoide hecha de maleza seca, paja y restos de madera. Hay que sujetar físicamente a los prisioneros a la figura y luego quemarlos vivos como parte de un juicio o ritual.

Rule.Original: An incredibly large and bright-burning bonfire made out of a carefully organized pile of logs on a stone base. Used heavily during flame-based rituals and can only be placed outdoors.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly large and bright-burning bonfire made out of a carefully organized pile of logs on a stone base. Used heavily during flame-based rituals and can only be placed outdoors.
Rule.Translated: Una hoguera increíblemente grande y brillante hecha a partir de un montón de troncos cuidadosamente organizados sobre una base de piedra. Se utiliza mucho en rituales con llamas y solo puede colocarse al aire libre.

Rule.Original: An incredibly large and bright-burning bonfire made out of a carefully organized pile of logs on a stone base. Used heavily during flame-based rituals and can only be placed outdoors. Will last for at least two quadrums and provide beauty nearby, as well as count for the Fire: Desired precept.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly large and bright-burning bonfire made out of a carefully organized pile of logs on a stone base. Used heavily during flame-based rituals and can only be placed outdoors. Will last for at least two quadrums and provide beauty nearby, as well as count for the Fire: Desired precept.
Rule.Translated: Una hoguera increíblemente grande y brillante hecha a partir de un montón de troncos cuidadosamente organizados sobre una base de piedra. Se utiliza mucho en rituales con llamas y solo puede colocarse al aire libre. Durará al menos dos cuádrums y proporcionará belleza en las proximidades, además de contar para el precepto «Fuego: deseado».

Rule.Original: A structure assembled from scrapped mechanoid parts. Emits an IFF programming signal capable of confusing ancient mechanoid receptors. Should two exist per colonist enough signal noise will soft reset ancient mechanoid programming, causing an immediate retreat. This will only work on raiding mechanoids, clusters and "boss" mechanoids won't be affected.
Rule.Raw: A structure assembled from scrapped mechanoid parts. Emits an IFF programming signal capable of confusing ancient mechanoid receptors. Should two exist per colonist enough signal noise will soft reset ancient mechanoid programming, causing an immediate retreat. This will only work on raiding mechanoids, clusters and "boss" mechanoids won't be affected.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura ensamblada a partir de piezas de mecanoides desechados. Emite una señal de identificación de objetivos capaz de confundir a los antiguos receptores mecanoides. Si hay dos por colono, la señal de ruido será de suficiente intensidad como para reiniciar la programación de los antiguos mecanoides, provocando una retirada inmediata.

Rule.Original: An ominous-looking obelisk of pure chiseled stone. It seems to radiate an aura of hopelessness and despair.\n\nThe Corruption need of any colonist in an obelisk's radius of effect won't decrease.
Rule.Raw: An ominous-looking obelisk of pure chiseled stone. It seems to radiate an aura of hopelessness and despair.\n\nThe Corruption need of any colonist in an obelisk's radius of effect won't decrease.
Rule.Translated: Un obelisco de aspecto ominoso de pura piedra cincelada. Parece irradiar un aura de desesperanza y desesperación.\n\nLa necesidad de «corrupción» de cualquier colono en el radio de efecto de un obelisco no disminuirá.

Rule.Original:
A large, swollen hive that seems to be seeping high amounts of bubbling insectoid jelly but not incubating any insectoids themselves.

The nest will need maintenance by a colonist with the insectoid herder role. If maintenance reaches 0%, the nest will be destroyed.

Insect nest maintenance is a Handling job that gets auto-queued if the hive's maintenance is lower than 50%..
Rule.Raw:
A large, swollen hive that seems to be seeping high amounts of bubbling insectoid jelly but not incubating any insectoids themselves.

The nest will need maintenance by a colonist with the insectoid herder role. If maintenance reaches 0%, the nest will be destroyed.

Insect nest maintenance is a Handling job that gets auto-queued if the hive's maintenance is lower than 50%..
Rule.Translated: Una colmena grande e hinchada que parece estar rezumando grandes cantidades de jalea de insecto, pero que no incuba ningún insectoide propiamente dicho.\n\nEl nido necesitará mantenimiento por parte de un colono con el rol de pastor de insectoides. Si el mantenimiento alcanza el 0%, el nido será destruido.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of shintao imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of shintao imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes shintaoístas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of shintao imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of shintao imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes shintaoístas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of esoteric imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of esoteric imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes esotéricas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of esoteric imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of esoteric imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes esotéricas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of eldritch imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of eldritch imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes diabólicas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of eldritch imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of eldritch imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes diabólicas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of serketist imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of serketist imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes serketistas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of serketist imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of serketist imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes serketistas para decorar un suelo.

Rule.Original: I had a good time at that party.
Rule.Raw: I had a good time at that party.
Rule.Translated: Me lo pasé bien en esa fiesta.

Rule.Original: Someone was executed for the lack of compliance. I need to be positive. I NEED TO.
Rule.Raw: Someone was executed for the lack of compliance. I need to be positive. I NEED TO.
Rule.Translated: Alguien fue ejecutado por la falta de cumplimiento. Necesito ser positivo. LO NECESITO.

Rule.Original: They know everything, I’m an open book, entirely vulnerable and without a shred of nuance.
Rule.Raw: They know everything, I’m an open book, entirely vulnerable and without a shred of nuance.
Rule.Translated: Lo saben todo, soy un libro abierto, totalmente vulnerable y sin un ápice de vergüenza.

Rule.Original: My identity has been deeply compromised, I’m so ashamed by the attention I’ve garnered for myself.
Rule.Raw: My identity has been deeply compromised, I’m so ashamed by the attention I’ve garnered for myself.
Rule.Translated: Mi identidad se ha visto profundamente comprometida, estoy muy avergonzad{PAWN_gender ? o : a} por la atención que he atraído hacia mi persona.

Rule.Original: This can’t be allowed to continue, if I keep this behavior up I’ll be exposed.
Rule.Raw: This can’t be allowed to continue, if I keep this behavior up I’ll be exposed.
Rule.Translated: Esto no puede seguir así, si sigo con este comportamiento me descubrirán.

Rule.Original: I feel so much more comfortable like this. I don’t even think they know my name or face.
Rule.Raw: I feel so much more comfortable like this. I don’t even think they know my name or face.
Rule.Translated: Me siento mucho más cómod{PAWN_gender ? o : a} así. Ni siquiera creo que sepan mi nombre o mi cara.

Rule.Original: Some pathetic little flames drifted around, and they went away too soon. "Bon" fire? More like "Lame" fire.
Rule.Raw: Some pathetic little flames drifted around, and they went away too soon. "Bon" fire? More like "Lame" fire.
Rule.Translated: Algunas pequeñas y patéticas llamas vagaban por ahí, y se fueron demasiado pronto. ¿«Oh-guera»? Más bien «bah-guera».

Rule.Original: We were expecting a wondrous conflagration, and instead we got an oversized campfire. At least it was kinda entertaining.
Rule.Raw: We were expecting a wondrous conflagration, and instead we got an oversized campfire. At least it was kinda entertaining.
Rule.Translated: Esperábamos una maravillosa conflagración, y en su lugar obtuvimos una simple hoguera de tamaño familiar. Al menos entretuvo un poco.

Rule.Original: The flames rose and crackled majestically over the settlement, and it lifted all our spirits considerably.
Rule.Raw: The flames rose and crackled majestically over the settlement, and it lifted all our spirits considerably.
Rule.Translated: Las llamas se elevaron y crepitaron majestuosamente sobre el asentamiento, y eso levantó el ánimo de todos considerablemente.

Rule.Original: It was super fun and we really connected with each other with the shared experience.
Rule.Raw: It was super fun and we really connected with each other with the shared experience.
Rule.Translated: Fue súper divertido, y pudimos conectar entre nosotros gracias a la experiencia compartida.

Rule.Original: That ceremonial suicide was terrible. The blade was thrust laterally and there was blood and entrails everywhere. Disgusting!
Rule.Raw: That ceremonial suicide was terrible. The blade was thrust laterally and there was blood and entrails everywhere. Disgusting!
Rule.Translated: Ese suicidio ceremonial fue terrible. La hoja se clavó en el costado y había sangre y vísceras por todas partes. ¡Qué asco!

Rule.Original: That ceremonial suicide was not good. The speech seemed forced. At the very least we have restored the honor of our colony.
Rule.Raw: That ceremonial suicide was not good. The speech seemed forced. At the very least we have restored the honor of our colony.
Rule.Translated: Ese suicidio ceremonial no fue muy bueno. El discurso parecía forzado. Al menos hemos devuelto el honor a nuestra colonia.

Rule.Original: A honorable ceremonial suicide. The shadow of defeat no longer clouds our minds.
Rule.Raw: A honorable ceremonial suicide. The shadow of defeat no longer clouds our minds.
Rule.Translated: Un suicidio ceremonial de lo más honorable. La sombra de la derrota ya no nubla nuestras mentes.

Rule.Original: That ceremonial suicide was unforgettable! Everyone will remember the courage, self-control, and strong resolve. The honor of our colony is now spotless.
Rule.Raw: That ceremonial suicide was unforgettable! Everyone will remember the courage, self-control, and strong resolve. The honor of our colony is now spotless.
Rule.Translated: ¡Ese suicidio ceremonial fue inolvidable! Todo el mundo recordará el coraje, el autocontrol y la fuerte determinación. El honor de nuestra colonia ha quedado libre de toda mancha.

Rule.Original: An indescribably hideous gibbering! I'd even describe it as squamous, but I don't even know what that is! An unutterable word!
Rule.Raw: An indescribably hideous gibbering! I'd even describe it as squamous, but I don't even know what that is! An unutterable word!
Rule.Translated: ¡No mucho más que unos balbuceos indescriptiblemente horribles! Incluso lo describiría como escamantes, ¡y ni siquiera sé lo que es eso! ¡Es la extraña palabra que me viene a la mente!

Rule.Original: A litany of dark morbidities expressed in crime, perversion, and insanity.
Rule.Raw: A litany of dark morbidities expressed in crime, perversion, and insanity.
Rule.Translated: Una letanía de oscuras morbosidades expresadas con crimen, perversión y locura.

Rule.Original: A promise of hidden and fathomless worlds of strange life which pulsate in the gulfs beyond the stars and press hideously upon our own globe in unholy dimensions which only the dead and the moonstruck can glimpse.
Rule.Raw: A promise of hidden and fathomless worlds of strange life which pulsate in the gulfs beyond the stars and press hideously upon our own globe in unholy dimensions which only the dead and the moonstruck can glimpse.
Rule.Translated: Una promesa de mundos ocultos e insondables de vida extraña que laten en los abismos más allá de las estrellas, presionando horriblemente sobre nuestro planeta desde dimensiones impías que solo los muertos y los lunáticos pueden vislumbrar.

Rule.Original: We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.
Rule.Raw: We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.
Rule.Translated: Vivimos en una plácida isla de ignorancia en medio de negros mares del infinito, y no estaba previsto que viajáramos tan lejos...

Rule.Original: What an incredibly uninteresting ritual. Yeah, yeah, insects are cool. Bah.
Rule.Raw: What an incredibly uninteresting ritual. Yeah, yeah, insects are cool. Bah.
Rule.Translated: Qué ritual tan poco interesante. Que sí, que sí, que los insectos son geniales... Bah...

Rule.Original: The speech was repetitive, and it did nothing to convince me of the divinity of our beloved insects.
Rule.Raw: The speech was repetitive, and it did nothing to convince me of the divinity of our beloved insects.
Rule.Translated: El discurso fue repetitivo, y no hizo nada para convencerme de la divinidad de nuestros queridos insectos.

Rule.Original: The chanter showed impressing skill and the hymn appropriately extolled the virtues of our way of life.
Rule.Raw: The chanter showed impressing skill and the hymn appropriately extolled the virtues of our way of life.
Rule.Translated: El intérprete demostró una habilidad impresionante y el himno ensalzó adecuadamente las virtudes de nuestro modo de vida.

Rule.Original: I can still hear the mesmerizing words of the hymn, like a myriad insectile legs crawling all over our bodies.
Rule.Raw: I can still hear the mesmerizing words of the hymn, like a myriad insectile legs crawling all over our bodies.
Rule.Translated: Todavía puedo oír las hipnotizantes palabras del himno, como una miríada de patas insectoides que se arrastran por nuestros cuerpos.

Rule.Original: That leadership challenge was terrible. Watching it just made people sad. I guess we have a strong leader, at least...
Rule.Raw: That leadership challenge was terrible. Watching it just made people sad. I guess we have a strong leader, at least...
Rule.Translated: Ese desafío de liderazgo fue terrible. Verlo solo hizo que la gente se entristeciera. Supongo que tenemos un líder fuerte, al menos...

Rule.Original: That leadership challenge was not good. The fighters wouldn't commit, so there were no exciting moments. At least our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Raw: That leadership challenge was not good. The fighters wouldn't commit, so there were no exciting moments. At least our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Translated: Ese desafío de liderazgo no fue bueno. Los luchadores no se comprometían, así que no hubo momentos emocionantes. Al menos nuestro líder es el más fuerte.

Rule.Original: A good leadership challenge. The fighters went for blood and showed real heart. We now know that our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Raw: A good leadership challenge. The fighters went for blood and showed real heart. We now know that our leader is the strongest.
Rule.Translated: Un buen desafío de liderazgo. Los luchadores fueron a por sangre y mostraron verdadera pasión. Ahora sabemos que nuestro líder es el más fuerte.

Rule.Original: That leadership challenge was unforgettable! Both fighters gave all they had, and we know that our leader is now the strongest among us!
Rule.Raw: That leadership challenge was unforgettable! Both fighters gave all they had, and we know that our leader is now the strongest among us!
Rule.Translated: ¡Ese desafío de liderazgo fue inolvidable! Ambos luchadores dieron todo lo que tenían, ¡y sabemos que nuestro líder es sin duda el más fuerte entre nosotros!

Rule.Original: When you think of an orgy, you tend to imagine attractive people. This was... the entire opposite. The mental images will take a while to go away.
Rule.Raw: When you think of an orgy, you tend to imagine attractive people. This was... the entire opposite. The mental images will take a while to go away.
Rule.Translated: Cuando piensas en una orgía, tiendes a imaginar gente atractiva. Esto fue... Todo lo contrario. Las imágenes mentales tardarán un tiempo en desaparecer.

Rule.Original: Everyone sat around not knowing exactly what to do, naked bodies laying everywhere. Quite disappointing.
Rule.Raw: Everyone sat around not knowing exactly what to do, naked bodies laying everywhere. Quite disappointing.
Rule.Translated: Todos sentados sin saber qué hacer, cuerpos desnudos por todas partes. Bastante decepcionante.

Rule.Original: We gave ourselves to each other in a communal expression of our deepest passions.
Rule.Raw: We gave ourselves to each other in a communal expression of our deepest passions.
Rule.Translated: Nos entregamos unos a otros en una expresión comunitaria de nuestras pasiones más profundas.

Rule.Original: We all donned our high-society masquerade masks and got naked. A barrage of orgasmic sexual ecstasy unlike no other made our bodies tremble with barely concealed excitement.
Rule.Raw: We all donned our high-society masquerade masks and got naked. A barrage of orgasmic sexual ecstasy unlike no other made our bodies tremble with barely concealed excitement.
Rule.Translated: Todos nos pusimos nuestras máscaras de alta sociedad y nos desnudamos. Una avalancha de éxtasis sexual orgásmico sin igual hizo que nuestros cuerpos temblaran con una excitación apenas disimulada.

Rule.Original: There's nothing like a tumble between the sheets to lift the mood.
Rule.Raw: There's nothing like a tumble between the sheets to lift the mood.
Rule.Translated: No hay nada como un revolcón entre las sábanas para levantar el ánimo.

Rule.Original: That plague festival was botched and the mood was way off. The corpse laid there, inert, and no holy miasma was liberated from it. What a waste of time!
Rule.Raw: That plague festival was botched and the mood was way off. The corpse laid there, inert, and no holy miasma was liberated from it. What a waste of time!
Rule.Translated: El festival de la peste ha sido una chapuza y el ambiente no era el adecuado. El cadáver yacía allí, inerte, y no se liberó de él ningún miasma sagrado. ¡Qué pérdida de tiempo!

Rule.Original: That plague festival was repetitive and the killing technique was noticeably flawed. However the blessed plague is now among us.
Rule.Raw: That plague festival was repetitive and the killing technique was noticeably flawed. However the blessed plague is now among us.
Rule.Translated: El festival de la peste ha sido repetitivo y la técnica de exterminio era notablemente defectuosa. Sin embargo, la bendita plaga ya está entre nosotros.

Rule.Original: That plague festival was satisfying and a holy miasma was liberated from the corpse, bathing us all in a sacred plague wind.
Rule.Raw: That plague festival was satisfying and a holy miasma was liberated from the corpse, bathing us all in a sacred plague wind.
Rule.Translated: Aquel festival de la peste fue satisfactorio y del cadáver se desprendió un miasma sagrado que nos bañó a todos en un viento sagrado de peste.

Rule.Original: The blood! The release! That plague festival brought everyone to the edge of a frenzy and a sacred plague wind wafted from the animal's corpse, blessing us.
Rule.Raw: The blood! The release! That plague festival brought everyone to the edge of a frenzy and a sacred plague wind wafted from the animal's corpse, blessing us.
Rule.Translated: ¡La sangre! ¡La liberación! Aquel festival de la peste llevó a todos al borde del frenesí y un viento sagrado de peste brotó del cadáver del animal, bendiciéndonos.

Rule.Original: We ended up looking as the evil guys here... With such a display, it's unlikely anyone will freely want to join the colony.
Rule.Raw: We ended up looking as the evil guys here... With such a display, it's unlikely anyone will freely want to join the colony.
Rule.Translated: Acabamos pareciendo los malos aquí... Con semejante despliegue, es poco probable que alguien quiera unirse libremente a la colonia.

Rule.Original: Our leader's speech was clear and succint, explaining all the evils of slavery in a concise way.
Rule.Raw: Our leader's speech was clear and succint, explaining all the evils of slavery in a concise way.
Rule.Translated: El discurso de nuestro líder fue claro y sucinto, explicando todos los males de la esclavitud de forma concisa.

Rule.Original: Our leader's speech was very inspiring, detailing all the evils caused by slavery and the immense advantages of a free society.
Rule.Raw: Our leader's speech was very inspiring, detailing all the evils caused by slavery and the immense advantages of a free society.
Rule.Translated: El discurso de nuestro líder fue muy inspirador, detallando todos los males causados por la esclavitud y las inmensas ventajas de una sociedad libre.

Rule.Original: Our leader's speech was a masterclass in extolling the virtues of a free society, liberated for the shackles of slavery.
Rule.Raw: Our leader's speech was a masterclass in extolling the virtues of a free society, liberated for the shackles of slavery.
Rule.Translated: El discurso de nuestro líder fue una clase magistral de ensalzamiento de las virtudes de una sociedad libre, liberada de los grilletes de la esclavitud.

Rule.Original: Legends will be told about our leader's speech, and how those words will resonate in the future, elevating the cause of emancipation.
Rule.Raw: Legends will be told about our leader's speech, and how those words will resonate in the future, elevating the cause of emancipation.
Rule.Translated: Se contarán leyendas sobre el discurso de nuestro líder, y cómo esas palabras resonarán en el futuro, elevando la noble causa de la emancipación.

Rule.Original: With such a low quality effort, no additional caravans will be attracted to our settlement...
Rule.Raw: With such a low quality effort, no additional caravans will be attracted to our settlement...
Rule.Translated: Con el poco esfuerzo que se ha puesto aquí, no creo que ninguna otra caravana se sienta atraída hacia nuestro asentamiento...

Rule.Original: Some exciting transactions took place, but the majority of it was boring business talk.
Rule.Raw: Some exciting transactions took place, but the majority of it was boring business talk.
Rule.Translated: Se produjeron algunas transacciones emocionantes, pero la mayor parte fueron aburridas conversaciones de negocios.

Rule.Original: There was a lot of back and forth and networking.
Rule.Raw: There was a lot of back and forth and networking.
Rule.Translated: Se hicieron muchas compras y ventas, y además se establecieron contactos.

Rule.Original: We discussed exciting and innovative economical paradigms, and our settlement will be renowned as a center of finance learning.
Rule.Raw: We discussed exciting and innovative economical paradigms, and our settlement will be renowned as a center of finance learning.
Rule.Translated: Debatimos paradigmas económicos apasionantes e innovadores, y nuestro asentamiento será reconocido como centro de aprendizaje de finanzas.

Rule.Original: We tried to organize a trading fair without spending any money on it. It is shameful to be so cheap.
Rule.Raw: We tried to organize a trading fair without spending any money on it. It is shameful to be so cheap.
Rule.Translated: Intentamos organizar una feria comercial sin gastar dinero en ella. Es vergonzoso ser tan tacaño.

Rule.Original: That violent conversion was awkward. The words were vague and unconvincing.
Rule.Raw: That violent conversion was awkward. The words were vague and unconvincing.
Rule.Translated: La conversión violenta fue torpe. Las palabras eran vagas y poco convincentes.

Rule.Original: That violent conversion was satisfying. The speech was stirring and enjoyable to listen to.
Rule.Raw: That violent conversion was satisfying. The speech was stirring and enjoyable to listen to.
Rule.Translated: La conversión violenta fue satisfactoria. El discurso fue conmovedor y agradable de escuchar.

Rule.Original: That violent conversion was electrifying! Surely our beliefs will prevail over any others!
Rule.Raw: That violent conversion was electrifying! Surely our beliefs will prevail over any others!
Rule.Translated: ¡La conversión violenta fue electrizante! ¡Seguro que nuestras creencias prevalecerán sobre cualquier otra!
quema de hombre de mimbre terrible

Rule.Original: The whole ritual smelled like rotten bacon. And, inexplicably the prisoner kept shouting "No! Not the bees!". What was that all about?
Rule.Raw: The whole ritual smelled like rotten bacon. And, inexplicably the prisoner kept shouting "No! Not the bees!". What was that all about?
Rule.Translated: Todo el ritual olía a tocino podrido. E, inexplicablemente, el prisionero no paraba de gritar «¡No! ¡Las abejas no!». ¿A qué venía eso?
quema de hombre de mimbre deslucida

Rule.Original: The prisoner just burned to death too fast, and the fire didn't even lift our spirits much.
Rule.Raw: The prisoner just burned to death too fast, and the fire didn't even lift our spirits much.
Rule.Translated: El prisionero murió quemado demasiado rápido, y el fuego no nos levantó mucho el ánimo.
quema de hombre de mimbre buena

Rule.Original: The anguished cries of the prisoner will resonate with us for a long time, another soul consumed by the flames.
Rule.Raw: The anguished cries of the prisoner will resonate with us for a long time, another soul consumed by the flames.
Rule.Translated: Los gritos angustiados del prisionero resonarán en nosotros durante mucho tiempo. Otra alma consumida por las llamas.
quema de hombre de mimbre gloriosa

Rule.Original: We will forever remember the thrashing of the prisoner, the frightened crescendo of screams as another soul was consumed by the holy flames.
Rule.Raw: We will forever remember the thrashing of the prisoner, the frightened crescendo of screams as another soul was consumed by the holy flames.
Rule.Translated: Recordaremos para siempre los golpes del prisionero, así como el crescendo asustado de los gritos mientras otra alma era consumida por las llamas sagradas.

Rule.Original: Either the body or mind of {PAWN_nameDef} is one of insight and experience. While some find them old fashioned, others will respect their guidance.
Rule.Raw: Either the body or mind of {PAWN_nameDef} is one of insight and experience. While some find them old fashioned, others will respect their guidance.
Rule.Translated: Tanto el cuerpo como la mente de {PAWN_nameDef} están llenos de perspicacia y experiencia. Mientras que algunos los encuentran desfasados, otros respetarán su orientación.

Rule.Original: Call a group of 6 mercenaries to aid you in battle. Each mercenary has some combat expierence and comes equipped with a leather armor, a crossbow or a two-handed axe.
Rule.Raw: Call a group of 6 mercenaries to aid you in battle. Each mercenary has some combat expierence and comes equipped with a leather armor, a crossbow or a two-handed axe.
Rule.Translated: Llama a un grupo de 6 mercenarios para que te ayuden en combate. Cada mercenario tiene cierta experiencia en combate y viene equipado con una armadura de cuero y una ballesta o un hacha a dos manos.

Rule.Original: A tall pillar of ornate design.
Rule.Raw: A tall pillar of ornate design.
Rule.Translated: Un pilar alto de diseño ornamentado.

Rule.Original: Logs that are stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Rule.Raw: Logs that are stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Rule.Translated: Troncos apilados de forma eficiente para ahorrar espacio.

Rule.Original: An open cupboard to store and display objects in an efficient manner.
Rule.Raw: An open cupboard to store and display objects in an efficient manner.
Rule.Translated: Un armario abierto para almacenar y exhibir objetos de forma eficiente.

Rule.Original: An open cupboard to store and display objects in an efficient manner.
Rule.Raw: An open cupboard to store and display objects in an efficient manner.
Rule.Translated: Un armario abierto para almacenar y exhibir objetos de forma eficiente.

Rule.Original: A cylindrical barrel for general storage. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Raw: A cylindrical barrel for general storage. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Translated: Un barril cilíndrico para almacenamiento general. Los objetos guardados en su interior no afectan a la belleza de la estancia y no se deterioran, ni siquiera en el exterior.

Rule.Translated: Una plataforma cuadrada grande para almacenar objetos, mantenerlos limpios y separados del suelo.

Rule.Translated: Una caja de tablones de madera diseñada para almacenar recursos. Los objetos almacenados aquí no afectan a la belleza de la habitación ni se deterioran, incluso al aire libre.

estante lleno de objetos de plata
estante lleno de objetos de oro
estante lleno de cálices de plata
estante lleno de cálices de oro

Rule.Original: A trusty wagon to carry novelties, artifacts, and goods across the unforgiving lands of the rim. Can be used to store items.
Rule.Raw: A trusty wagon to carry novelties, artifacts, and goods across the unforgiving lands of the rim. Can be used to store items.
Rule.Translated: Un fiel carromato para transportar novedades, artefactos y mercancías por las implacables tierras de la frontera. Puede usarse para almacenar objetos.

Rule.Original: Two layers of armor give way to this fantastically protective, yet cumbersome, suit, consisting of strong-forged chains beset by overlapping layers of metal plates to protect vitals and extremities.
Rule.Raw: Two layers of armor give way to this fantastically protective, yet cumbersome, suit, consisting of strong-forged chains beset by overlapping layers of metal plates to protect vitals and extremities.
Rule.Translated: Dos capas de armadura componen este traje de magnífica protección, aunque aparatoso: una resistente cota de malla cubierta por placas metálicas superpuestas que protegen los órganos vitales y las extremidades.

Rule.Original: An ornamented construction of an archaic full-head helmet, which provides excellent protection of the entire head and face at the cost of hindered eyesight and constricted breathing.
Rule.Raw: An ornamented construction of an archaic full-head helmet, which provides excellent protection of the entire head and face at the cost of hindered eyesight and constricted breathing.
Rule.Translated: Una versión ornamentada de un antiguo casco integral que proporciona una excelente protección de toda la cabeza y el rostro a costa de dificultar la visión y la respiración.

Rule.Original: Although cumbersome to carry, the heavy crossbow is capable of inflicting heavy damage and piercing armored foes. Longer range and higher damage than the crossbow but takes time to reload. This makes the heavy crossbow a formidable defensive weapon and otherwise most effective in a group.
Rule.Raw: Although cumbersome to carry, the heavy crossbow is capable of inflicting heavy damage and piercing armored foes. Longer range and higher damage than the crossbow but takes time to reload. This makes the heavy crossbow a formidable defensive weapon and otherwise most effective in a group.
Rule.Translated: Aunque es incómoda de llevar, la arbalesta es capaz de infligir grandes daños y atravesar a los enemigos acorazados. Tiene mayor alcance y mayor daño que la ballesta, pero tarda más en recargarse. Esto hace que la arbalesta sea un arma defensiva formidable, y por tanto, más eficaz en grupo.
virote de la ballesta del absolvedor
Atajos de teclado de Performance Optimizer.

Rule.Original: Grappling hook connects to walls and solid rock and allows the users to quickly move to the desired location. The launcher does not require ammunition, but time needs to be reserved between shots to wind it up again.
Rule.Raw: Grappling hook connects to walls and solid rock and allows the users to quickly move to the desired location. The launcher does not require ammunition, but time needs to be reserved between shots to wind it up again.
Rule.Translated: El gancho de abordaje se engancha a muros y roca sólida y permite desplazarse rápidamente al lugar deseado. El lanzador no necesita munición, pero requiere un tiempo entre disparos para volver a enrollarlo.

Rule.Original: Drill yourself into the ground in order to gain more stability and turn yourself into a stationary artillery unit, increasing the attack range and reload efficiency drastically.
Rule.Raw: Drill yourself into the ground in order to gain more stability and turn yourself into a stationary artillery unit, increasing the attack range and reload efficiency drastically.
Rule.Translated: Anclarse al suelo mediante perforación para ganar estabilidad y convertirse en una unidad de artillería estacionaria, aumentando drásticamente el alcance de ataque y la eficiencia de recarga.

Rule.Original: Use shoulder-mounted jump packs to travel a short distance and create a small explosion at both start and end of the flight.
Rule.Raw: Use shoulder-mounted jump packs to travel a short distance and create a small explosion at both start and end of the flight.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza propulsores de salto montados en los hombros para recorrer una distancia corta y provocar una pequeña explosión tanto al iniciar como al terminar el vuelo.

Rule.Original: Fire a large propulsion engine strapped to the back of your armor and designate a location on the world map to drop pod into. This will create a large explosion at the destination, but will most likely leave you stranded without fuel for the trip back.
Rule.Raw: Fire a large propulsion engine strapped to the back of your armor and designate a location on the world map to drop pod into. This will create a large explosion at the destination, but will most likely leave you stranded without fuel for the trip back.
Rule.Translated: Activa el gran motor propulsor montado en la espalda de la armadura y elige un lugar del mapa mundial para aterrizar como una cápsula de transporte. Provocará una gran explosión en el destino, pero probablemente te deje sin combustible para volver.

Rule.Original: A broad category describing the styles and practices of many pirate groups.
Rule.Raw: A broad category describing the styles and practices of many pirate groups.
Rule.Translated: Una amplia categoría de culturas que describe los estilos y prácticas de muchos grupos piratas.
Todos los efectos de humor se verán duplicados.

Rule.Original: Darkness intensified. Any tile with 0% light is pitch black.
Rule.Raw: Darkness intensified. Any tile with 0% light is pitch black.
Rule.Translated: La oscuridad se intensificará. Cualquier celda con una iluminación del 0% se verá completamente negra.
La velocidad de ganancia de inmunidad se verá reducida a la mitad.

Rule.Original: All damage in the game is doubled.
Rule.Raw: All damage in the game is doubled.
Rule.Translated: Cualquier cantidad de daño producido se verá duplicado.

Rule.Original: All mineable resources yield gold instead of what they would normally yield.
Rule.Raw: All mineable resources yield gold instead of what they would normally yield.
Rule.Translated: Todos los recursos extraíbles producirán oro en lugar de lo que producirían normalmente.

Rule.Original: All Melee attack cooldowns are halved.
Rule.Raw: All Melee attack cooldowns are halved.
Rule.Translated: El enfriamiento de cualquier ataque cuerpo a cuerpo se verá reducido a la mitad.

Rule.Original: Rain no longer triggers when the map burns.
Rule.Raw: Rain no longer triggers when the map burns.
Rule.Translated: No empezará a llover cuando haya mucho fuego en la zona.

Rule.Original: Killing a pawn spawns a confetti mote and a birthday Yay! Sound.
Rule.Raw: Killing a pawn spawns a confetti mote and a birthday Yay! Sound.
Rule.Translated: Cuando muera una persona, aparecerá un poco de confeti y sonará algo divertido.
No se podrán curar las heridas sin medicinas.
La penetración de las armas en los blindajes se verá reducida a la mitad.
Las personas envejecerán diez veces más rápido.
El enfriamiento de todas las armas se verá reducido en un 90%.
La precisión de las armas a distancia se verá reducida a la mitad.

Rule.Original: Hunger drops at twice the speed.
Rule.Raw: Hunger drops at twice the speed.
Rule.Translated: La necesidad de hambre bajará al doble de velocidad.
Las infestaciones serán el doble de grandes.

Rule.Original: Whenever a pawn would be downed, they die.
Rule.Raw: Whenever a pawn would be downed, they die.
Rule.Translated: Cada vez que una persona es derribada, morirá.

Rule.Original: You don’t see any letters when events happen. They still show up in the History tab.
Rule.Raw: You don’t see any letters when events happen. They still show up in the History tab.
Rule.Translated: No verás ninguna notificación cuando se produzca un evento. No obstante, seguirán apareciendo en la pestaña del historial.
{0} ha muerto a causa de un aplastamiento.

Rule.Original: A loose confederation of pirate gangs who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other. Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors. Junkers utilise warcasket technology and seal themselves in metal tombs in which they raid, steal, plunder and inevitably die. They rarely use melee weapons and prefer to keep at distance to the enemy to fully utilise the powerful warcasket weaponry.
Rule.Raw: A loose confederation of pirate gangs who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other. Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors. Junkers utilise warcasket technology and seal themselves in metal tombs in which they raid, steal, plunder and inevitably die. They rarely use melee weapons and prefer to keep at distance to the enemy to fully utilise the powerful warcasket weaponry.
Rule.Translated: Una confederación poco cohesionada de bandas piratas que han acordado luchar sobre todo contra extraños en lugar de enfrentarse entre sí. Los piratas no siembran, no construyen y rara vez comercian. Impulsados por una cultura de sangre y honor que valora la fuerza personal y la crueldad, se enriquecen asaltando y robando a sus vecinos más productivos. Los chatarreros utilizan sarcófagos de combate y se sellan en tumbas metálicas donde asaltan, roban, saquean e inevitablemente mueren. Rara vez usan armas cuerpo a cuerpo y prefieren mantener la distancia para aprovechar al máximo el potente armamento de sus sarcófagos de combate.

Rule.Original: A paramilitary organisation sanctioned and governed by political figures and megacorporations. Mercenaries don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors. Mercenaries utilise spacer-tech weapons and armors to eliminate the targets of their corporate overlords. Unlike other pirate factions, mercenaries can be communicated with and befriended, but they rarely have much to offer in regards to trade and research.
Rule.Raw: A paramilitary organisation sanctioned and governed by political figures and megacorporations. Mercenaries don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors. Mercenaries utilise spacer-tech weapons and armors to eliminate the targets of their corporate overlords. Unlike other pirate factions, mercenaries can be communicated with and befriended, but they rarely have much to offer in regards to trade and research.
Rule.Translated: Una organización paramilitar autorizada y gobernada por dirigentes políticos y megacorporaciones. Los mercenarios no siembran, no construyen y rara vez comercian. Impulsados por una cultura de sangre y honor que valora la fuerza personal y la crueldad, se enriquecen asaltando y robando a sus vecinos más productivos. Los mercenarios utilizan armas y armaduras de tecnología espacial para eliminar a los objetivos de sus amos corporativos. A diferencia de otras facciones piratas, se puede hablar con ellos y entablar amistad, aunque rara vez tienen mucho que ofrecer en comercio e investigación.
ingestión de cóctel a base de ron

Rule.Original: This colonist drank a cocktail that had rum as one of its ingredients. Reduces hunger rate by 15%.
Rule.Raw: This colonist drank a cocktail that had rum as one of its ingredients. Reduces hunger rate by 15%.
Rule.Translated: Este colono bebió un cóctel que tenía ron como uno de sus ingredientes. Reduce el ritmo de hambre en un 15%.

Rule.Original:
A loose confederation of pirate gangs who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other.

Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors.

Their technology level depends mostly on who they've managed to steal from recently. Mostly they carry gunpowder weapons, though some prefer to stab victims at close range.
Rule.Raw:
A loose confederation of pirate gangs who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other.

Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors.

Their technology level depends mostly on who they've managed to steal from recently. Mostly they carry gunpowder weapons, though some prefer to stab victims at close range.
Rule.Translated:
Una confederación poco cohesionada de bandas piratas que han acordado luchar sobre todo contra extraños en lugar de enfrentarse entre sí.

Los piratas no siembran, no construyen y rara vez comercian. Impulsados por una cultura de sangre y honor que valora la fuerza personal y la crueldad, se enriquecen asaltando y robando a sus vecinos más productivos.

Su nivel tecnológico depende principalmente de a quién han conseguido robar recientemente. La mayoría lleva armas de pólvora, aunque algunos prefieren apuñalar a sus víctimas de cerca.
