Rule.Original: Remove a warcasket from the body.
Rule.Raw: Remove a warcasket from the body.
Rule.Translated: Retira un exotraje bélico del cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Build warcasket foundries to manufacture basic warcasket parts and outfit pawns to utilise said warcaskets.
Rule.Raw: Build warcasket foundries to manufacture basic warcasket parts and outfit pawns to utilise said warcaskets.
Rule.Translated: Construye fraguas de exotrajes bélicos, fabrica sus piezas básicas e introduce a las personas en estos para que los utilizen en batalla.
subject->el desarrollo de la infantería mecanizada

Rule.Original: subject_story->initiated the age of warcaskets, transforming foot soldiers into titans on the battlefield
Rule.Raw: subject_story->initiated the age of warcaskets, transforming foot soldiers into titans on the battlefield
Rule.Translated: subject_story->inició la era de los exotrajes, transformando a los infantes en titanes en el campo de batalla

Rule.Original: subject_story->mastered the art of warcasket manufacturing, melding metal and might into a singular force
Rule.Raw: subject_story->mastered the art of warcasket manufacturing, melding metal and might into a singular force
Rule.Translated: subject_story->dominó el arte de la fabricación de exotrajes, fusionando el metal y la potencia en una fuerza singular

Rule.Original: subject_story->ushered in a new era of warfare, where the line between man and machine blurred
Rule.Raw: subject_story->ushered in a new era of warfare, where the line between man and machine blurred
Rule.Translated: subject_story->inauguró una nueva era de la guerra, donde la frontera entre el hombre y la máquina se desvaneció
subject_gerund->la vanguardia del futuro del combate

Rule.Original: Construct improved variations of warcaskets which lean towards speed, protection or a balanced approach.
Rule.Raw: Construct improved variations of warcaskets which lean towards speed, protection or a balanced approach.
Rule.Translated: Construye variaciones mejoradas de los exotrajes bélicos que se especializan en la velocidad, la protección o en algo más equilibrado.

Rule.Original: subject_story->refined warcasket designs for speed, durability, and versatility, setting new standards in mechanized warfare
Rule.Raw: subject_story->refined warcasket designs for speed, durability, and versatility, setting new standards in mechanized warfare
Rule.Translated: subject_story->perfeccionó el diseño de los exotrajes para hacerlos más rápidos, duraderos y versátiles, estableciendo nuevos estándares en el campo de la guerra mecanizada

Rule.Original: subject_story->crafted war machines that danced in battlefields with lethal grace
Rule.Raw: subject_story->crafted war machines that danced in battlefields with lethal grace
Rule.Translated: subject_story->diseñó máquinas de guerra que danzaban en los campos de batalla con una gracia mortal

Rule.Original: subject_story->balanced the trinity of speed, protection, and firepower in a symphony of destruction
Rule.Raw: subject_story->balanced the trinity of speed, protection, and firepower in a symphony of destruction
Rule.Translated: subject_story->equilibró la trinidad de velocidad, protección y potencia de fuego en una sinfonía de destrucción
subject_gerund->la mejora de la anatomía de la guerra

Rule.Original: Manufacture warcaskets designed to fit specialized roles.
Rule.Raw: Manufacture warcaskets designed to fit specialized roles.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica exotrajes bélicos diseñados para desempeñar roles más especializados.

Rule.Original: subject_story->designed warcaskets with specialized roles, from silent assassins to unstoppable juggernauts
Rule.Raw: subject_story->designed warcaskets with specialized roles, from silent assassins to unstoppable juggernauts
Rule.Translated: subject_story->diseñó sarcófagos de combate para funciones especializadas, desde asesinos silenciosos hasta colosos imparables

Rule.Original: subject_story->broke the mold of traditional warfare, introducing units tailored for specific tactical needs
Rule.Raw: subject_story->broke the mold of traditional warfare, introducing units tailored for specific tactical needs
Rule.Translated: subject_story->rompió los moldes de la guerra tradicional e introdujo unidades adaptadas a necesidades tácticas concretas

Rule.Original: subject_story->elevated the warcasket program to new heights with bespoke war machines
Rule.Raw: subject_story->elevated the warcasket program to new heights with bespoke war machines
Rule.Translated: subject_story->llevó el programa de sarcófagos de combate a nuevas cotas con máquinas de guerra hechas a medida
subject_gerund->especializando los engranajes de la guerra

Rule.Original: Manufacture Spacer-era warcaskets - a pinacle of war technology.
Rule.Raw: Manufacture Spacer-era warcaskets - a pinacle of war technology.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica exotrajes bélicos de la era espacial, la culminación de la tecnología bélica.
subject->la cúspide de la guerra mecanizada

Rule.Original: subject_story->crafted warcaskets that harnessed spacer-era technology, embodying the zenith of military engineering
Rule.Raw: subject_story->crafted warcaskets that harnessed spacer-era technology, embodying the zenith of military engineering
Rule.Translated: subject_story->fabricó exotrajes que aprovechan la tecnología de la era espacial, encarnando el cenit de la ingeniería militar

Rule.Original: subject_story->merged the cutting edge of space-age tech with the ancient art of war, creating unparalleled battle machines
Rule.Raw: subject_story->merged the cutting edge of space-age tech with the ancient art of war, creating unparalleled battle machines
Rule.Translated: subject_story->fusionó la tecnología de vanguardia de la era espacial con el antiguo arte de la guerra, creando máquinas de combate inigualables

Rule.Original: subject_story->redefined the battlefield with warcaskets that were legends incarnate
Rule.Raw: subject_story->redefined the battlefield with warcaskets that were legends incarnate
Rule.Translated: subject_story->redefinió el campo de batalla con exotrajes que eran leyendas encarnadas

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->achieving the apex of combat evolution
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->achieving the apex of combat evolution
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->la cúspide de la evolución del combate

Rule.Original: Unlocks the operation “remove warcasket” to remove a pawn from a warcasket, losing both their arms and legs, and reducing the warcasket to slag.
Rule.Raw: Unlocks the operation “remove warcasket” to remove a pawn from a warcasket, losing both their arms and legs, and reducing the warcasket to slag.
Rule.Translated: Desbloquea la operación «quitar exotraje bélico», necesaria para sacar a una persona de uno de esos exotrajes. Esa persona perderá sus brazos y piernas, y el exotraje quedará reducido a chatarra.

Rule.Original: subject_story->developed techniques to reclaim warriors from their metal confines, a bittersweet victory over the machine
Rule.Raw: subject_story->developed techniques to reclaim warriors from their metal confines, a bittersweet victory over the machine
Rule.Translated: subject_story->desarrolló técnicas para liberar a los guerreros de su carcasa de metal, una victoria agridulce sobre la máquina

Rule.Original: subject_story->faced the grim reality of extracting the human core from the war machine, sacrificing limb for life
Rule.Raw: subject_story->faced the grim reality of extracting the human core from the war machine, sacrificing limb for life
Rule.Translated: subject_story->se enfrentó a la triste realidad de extraer el núcleo humano de la máquina de guerra, sacrificando un miembro para preservar la vida

Rule.Original: subject_story->turned the promise of mechanized might into the pain of loss, with every warcasket removal a reminder of war's toll
Rule.Raw: subject_story->turned the promise of mechanized might into the pain of loss, with every warcasket removal a reminder of war's toll
Rule.Translated: subject_story->transformó la promesa de poder mecanizado en el dolor de la pérdida, cada retiro de exotraje recordando el costo de la guerra

Rule.Original: subject_gerund->unraveling the bond between flesh and steel
Rule.Raw: subject_gerund->unraveling the bond between flesh and steel
Rule.Translated: subject_gerund->la ruptura del vínculo entre la carne y el acero

Rule.Original: Build upscaled weapons designed to be mounted on warcaskets.
Rule.Raw: Build upscaled weapons designed to be mounted on warcaskets.
Rule.Translated: Construye grandes armas diseñadas para ser instaladas en exotrajes bélicos.

Rule.Original: subject_story->engineered devastating weaponry for warcaskets, turning them into walking arsenals
Rule.Raw: subject_story->engineered devastating weaponry for warcaskets, turning them into walking arsenals
Rule.Translated: subject_story->desarrolló armas devastadoras para los exotrajes, convirtiéndolos en arsenales ambulantes

Rule.Original: subject_story->bridged the gap between artillery power and infantry flexibility
Rule.Raw: subject_story->bridged the gap between artillery power and infantry flexibility
Rule.Translated: subject_story->cerró la brecha entre la potencia de la artillería y la flexibilidad de la infantería

Rule.Original:
As the ship entered the lower orbit, something struck the hull with tremendous force. Not sure if it was the AI-core miscalculation, a terrible accident or a targeted strike, you quickly realized it doesn’t matter. You ordered your crew to get in the escape pods, but not everyone managed to get out of cryptosleep in time. The ship split into numerous chunks as it quickly descended onto the surface, and the only thing you could have done is hit the Eject button on the emergency drop pod. Perhaps some things can still be recovered from the wreckage.
Note: Since you start crash landing and with no supplies other than what you can scavenge, this is a difficult scenario.
Rule.Raw:
As the ship entered the lower orbit, something struck the hull with tremendous force. Not sure if it was the AI-core miscalculation, a terrible accident or a targeted strike, you quickly realized it doesn’t matter. You ordered your crew to get in the escape pods, but not everyone managed to get out of cryptosleep in time. The ship split into numerous chunks as it quickly descended onto the surface, and the only thing you could have done is hit the Eject button on the emergency drop pod. Perhaps some things can still be recovered from the wreckage.
Note: Since you start crash landing and with no supplies other than what you can scavenge, this is a difficult scenario.
Rule.Translated: Algo golpeó el casco de la nave con una fuerza tremenda en cuanto la nave entró en órbita baja. No estás seguro de si fue un error de cálculo del núcleo de la IA, un terrible accidente o un ataque dirigido... Pero eso ya no importa. Ordenaste a tu tripulación que subiera a las cápsulas de escape, pero no todos consiguieron salir del criptosueño a tiempo. La nave se partió en numerosos pedazos al descender rápidamente a la superficie, y lo único que pudiste hacer fue pulsar el botón de expulsión de la cápsula de escape. Quizá aún puedan recuperarse algunos materiales de los restos del impacto.\n\nNota: Dado que comienzas con un aterrizaje forzoso sin más suministros que los que puedas recoger, este es un escenario difícil.

Rule.Original: A group of pirates, crash landing in the middle of nowhere. A classic VFE - Pirates experience.

Rule.Translated: Un grupo de piratas, estrellándose en medio de la nada. Una experiencia clásica de VFE - Piratas.

Rule.Translated: Miguelito lleva años viajando por el espacio conocido. Está maldito, y la mejor forma de librarse de una maldición es compartirla con los demás. Cuantas más maldiciones recibas, más te recompensará él.
bala de cañón de carga gauntlet

Rule.Raw: Ship mounted anti-armor charge cannon, often utilised in ship-to-ship combat in low atmosphere.
Rule.Translated: Cañón de impulso anti-blindaje montado en una nave, utilizado comúnmente en combates entre naves en altitudes bajas.

Rule.Original:
A complex foundry with four operating arms designed to assist an operator in mounting a person into the frame of a warcasket. Once they are locked in, the pilot cannot leave until the procedure is finished.

To begin, an operator starts linking them to the suit - their nerves and limbs permanently linked to the frame. Since the warcasket is not designed to register wear or damage they will feel no pain. The pilot can exit the foundry only when the final rivet is placed, the last plate is welded, and the power system is brought online. Due to their immbolization in the foundry they will be unable to rest, feed or treat themselves.

Because the various parts of the warcasket are welded onto the frame as a single, homogenous entity, one can mix and match various designs to suit the situation but certain later generations of warcaskets function better if they are part of the same series.
Rule.Raw:
A complex foundry with four operating arms designed to assist an operator in mounting a person into the frame of a warcasket. Once they are locked in, the pilot cannot leave until the procedure is finished.

To begin, an operator starts linking them to the suit - their nerves and limbs permanently linked to the frame. Since the warcasket is not designed to register wear or damage they will feel no pain. The pilot can exit the foundry only when the final rivet is placed, the last plate is welded, and the power system is brought online. Due to their immbolization in the foundry they will be unable to rest, feed or treat themselves.

Because the various parts of the warcasket are welded onto the frame as a single, homogenous entity, one can mix and match various designs to suit the situation but certain later generations of warcaskets function better if they are part of the same series.
Rule.Translated:
Una compleja maquinaria con cuatro brazos operativos diseñada para ayudar a un operario a insertar a una persona en el armazón de un exotraje bélico. Una vez encerrados, el piloto no puede salir hasta que finalice el procedimiento.

Durante el inicio del proceso, un operario comienza a vincular al usuario al traje, de tal forma que sus nervios y extremidades quedan permanentemente unidos al armazón. Como el exotraje bélico no está diseñado para registrar desgaste o daños, los usuarios no sentirán dolor. El piloto solo podrá salir de la fragua cuando se coloque el último remache, se suelde la última placa y se ponga en marcha el sistema de energía. Hasta entonces, necesitará ayuda externa, por ejemplo para alimentarse, ya que básicamente es como si estuviera enterrado vivo.

Dado que las distintas partes del exotraje bélico se sueldan al armazón como una entidad única y homogénea, se pueden mezclar y combinar varios diseños para adaptarlos a la situación. Sin embargo, algunas generaciones posteriores de exotrajes bélicos funcionan mejor si forman parte de la misma serie.

Rule.Original: A manned gun that launches all kinds of shells. A variation of the mortar with all the benefits and drawbacks, however it has a 45 degree cone of direct-fire in exchange for having an effective firing rate that is twice as fast.
Rule.Raw: A manned gun that launches all kinds of shells. A variation of the mortar with all the benefits and drawbacks, however it has a 45 degree cone of direct-fire in exchange for having an effective firing rate that is twice as fast.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón operado a mano que lanza todo tipo de proyectiles. Una variante del mortero con las mismas ventajas e inconvenientes, pero como tiene un cono de alcance de 90 grados tiene una cadencia de fuego el doble de rápida.

Rule.Raw: A manned gun that launches all kinds of shells. A variation of the mortar with all the benefits and drawbacks, however it has a 90 degree cone of direct-fire in exchange for having an effective firing rate that is twice as fast.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón operado a mano que lanza todo tipo de proyectiles. Una variante del mortero con las mismas ventajas e inconvenientes, pero como tiene un cono de alcance de 90 grados tiene una cadencia de fuego el doble de rápida.

La precisión es bastante escasa, pero supone una gran mejora en comparación con las catapultas, además de tener una cadencia de fuego considerablemente mucho más alta.
No puede disparar: necesita una bala de cañón

Rule.Original: A chunk of a combat-grade spacecraft. It seems to have been torn off either by uncontrolled re-entry forces or some kind of weapon. It is densely packed with double-layer armor plating and control systems, which can be acquired by deconstructing it.
Rule.Raw: A chunk of a combat-grade spacecraft. It seems to have been torn off either by uncontrolled re-entry forces or some kind of weapon. It is densely packed with double-layer armor plating and control systems, which can be acquired by deconstructing it.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de una nave espacial de combate. Parece haber sido arrancado por las fuerzas incontroladas de la reentrada atmosférica o por un impacto a gran velocidad. Su interior ha sido aplastado por una fuerza externa, lo que hace que parezca más un trozo de chatarra que un objeto intacto.

Rule.Original: The mangled remains of ship-borne battery, used to power systems with high power draw for short periods. It was leaps and bounds about Rimworld battery technology but it can no longer be recharged and yields decent salvage once it’s stored charge has run out.
Rule.Raw: The mangled remains of ship-borne battery, used to power systems with high power draw for short periods. It was leaps and bounds about Rimworld battery technology but it can no longer be recharged and yields decent salvage once it’s stored charge has run out.
Rule.Translated: Los restos dañados de una batería de nave, utilizada para alimentar sistemas de alto consumo energético durante cortos periodos. Representaba un avance significativo respecto a la tecnología de baterías de los Rimworlds, pero ya no puede recargarse y ofrece una recuperación decente una vez que se agota la carga almacenada.

Rule.Original: A self-powered cryptosleep casket caught in the remains of their ship’s hull. The occupant can still be recovered from the module, but most of the material is worth less than scrap metal and offers little salvage.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered cryptosleep casket caught in the remains of their ship’s hull. The occupant can still be recovered from the module, but most of the material is worth less than scrap metal and offers little salvage.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de hipersueño autoalimentado atrapado entre los restos del casco de la nave. Es posible rescatar al ocupante del módulo, aunque el resto del material vale menos que chatarra y no puede ser recuperado.

Rule.Original: Self-powered turbo engines for a combat-grade spacecraft, designed for atmospheric use. The control and safety system are damaged and the turbines are unable to take in enough air to cool itself. If not properly dismantled, the accumulating energy will tear itself apart.
Rule.Raw: Self-powered turbo engines for a combat-grade spacecraft, designed for atmospheric use. The control and safety system are damaged and the turbines are unable to take in enough air to cool itself. If not properly dismantled, the accumulating energy will tear itself apart.
Rule.Translated: Turbomotores autoalimentados para una nave espacial de combate, diseñados para uso atmosférico. El sistema de control y seguridad está dañado y las turbinas son incapaces de aspirar suficiente aire para enfriarse. Si no se desmonta correctamente, la energía acumulada explotará.

Rule.Original: A tank of Chemfuel, punctured by the hull of its ship’s hull. Some of the fluid can be recovered while the majority is filled with grime, leaking out and creating a fire hazard. A prime target for any pyromaniac wanting to watch the world burn.
Rule.Raw: A tank of Chemfuel, punctured by the hull of its ship’s hull. Some of the fluid can be recovered while the majority is filled with grime, leaking out and creating a fire hazard. A prime target for any pyromaniac wanting to watch the world burn.
Rule.Translated: Un depósito de biocombustible perforado por el casco de su nave. Parte del fluido puede recuperarse mientras que la mayoría está contaminada, fluyendo y creando un riesgo de incendio. Un objetivo ideal para cualquier pirómano ansioso por ver el mundo arder.

Rule.Original: The remains of the housing for the Gauntlet charge cannon. Powered externally, the ammunition storage is wrecked and cannot be replaced. Once the turret empties its magazine, it is still valuable salvage worth recovery.
Rule.Raw: The remains of the housing for the Gauntlet charge cannon. Powered externally, the ammunition storage is wrecked and cannot be replaced. Once the turret empties its magazine, it is still valuable salvage worth recovery.
Rule.Translated: Los restos del compartimento para el cañón de impulsos Gauntlet. Alimentado externamente, el almacenamiento de munición está dañado y no puede ser reemplazado. Una vez que la torreta agota su cargador, queda como un objeto valioso que merece la pena recuperar.
No puede disparar: necesita un cañón nuevo

Rule.Original: The remains of a combat-grade spacecraft’s nuclear reactor, low-yield and designed to operate alongside energy storage. Surprisingly, the reactor is fully functional with no structural damage, so it can be safely used for ground operations.
Rule.Raw: The remains of a combat-grade spacecraft’s nuclear reactor, low-yield and designed to operate alongside energy storage. Surprisingly, the reactor is fully functional with no structural damage, so it can be safely used for ground operations.
Rule.Translated: Los restos del reactor nuclear de una nave espacial de combate, de bajo rendimiento y diseñado para funcionar con un dispositivo de almacenamiento de energía. Sorprendentemente, el reactor está completamente funcional y no presenta daños estructurales, por lo que puede utilizarse de manera segura para operaciones terrestres.

Rule.Original: A now-unsealed crate containing first-aid supplies. The pallet can be dismantled for steel along with recovering the supplies.
Rule.Raw: A now-unsealed crate containing first-aid supplies. The pallet can be dismantled for steel along with recovering the supplies.
Rule.Translated: Una caja ahora desprecintada que contiene suministros de primeros auxilios. El palé puede desmontarse para obtener acero mientras se recuperan los suministros.
Caja de pasta nutritiva de nave

Rule.Original: A now-unsealed crate containing emergency food rations. The pallet can be dismantled for steel along with recovering the supplies.
Rule.Raw: A now-unsealed crate containing emergency food rations. The pallet can be dismantled for steel along with recovering the supplies.
Rule.Translated: Una caja ahora desprecintada que contiene raciones alimenticias de emergencia. El palé puede desmontarse para obtener acero mientras se recuperan las provisiones.

Rule.Original: A portable version of the Autocannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has a lower range, less penetration and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it is very capable in close quarters combat which makes up for the slight accuracy loss at greater ranges.
Rule.Raw: A portable version of the Autocannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has a lower range, less penetration and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it is very capable in close quarters combat which makes up for the slight accuracy loss at greater ranges.
Rule.Translated: Una versión portátil del autocañón diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Debido al cañón acortado, su alcance es menor y su penetración y daño se ven reducidos en comparación con la versión con torreta. Sin embargo, es muy eficaz en combate cercano, lo que compensa la ligera pérdida de precisión a larga distancia.

Rule.Original: A portable version of the uranium slug cannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has less penetration, worse recoil and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it lacks the minimum range requirement thanks to a human operator and has better mid-range performance.
Rule.Raw: A portable version of the uranium slug cannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has less penetration, worse recoil and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it lacks the minimum range requirement thanks to a human operator and has better mid-range performance.
Rule.Translated: Una versión portátil del cañón de balas de uranio diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Debido a un cañón más corto, la penetración es menor, el retroceso y los daños son menores que en la versión con torreta. Sin embargo, no tiene el alcance mínimo requerido gracias a un operador humano y tiene un mejor rendimiento a media distancia.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the pump shotgun designed for use by a warcasket. Each cartridge fired contains 4 pellets larger than slugs from a regular-sized shotgun, giving it better range, armor penetration and much better damage. The recoil is insane though, even for a warcasket’s recoil damping system.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the pump shotgun designed for use by a warcasket. Each cartridge fired contains 4 pellets larger than slugs from a regular-sized shotgun, giving it better range, armor penetration and much better damage. The recoil is insane though, even for a warcasket’s recoil damping system.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada de la escopeta diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Cada cartucho disparado contiene 4 perdigones más grandes que las balas de una escopeta de tamaño normal, lo que le confiere mejor alcance, mejor penetración de armadura y mucho más daño. El retroceso es, sin embargo, desmesurado, incluso para el sistema de amortiguación de retroceso de un exotraje.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the minigun designed for use by a warcasket. It uses larger caliber rounds which are poorly made en masse due to how many rounds need to be manufactured. Thus, it has a slower rate of fire and armor penetration, but who cares because no one wants to be on the receiving end of this amount of dakka.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the minigun designed for use by a warcasket. It uses larger caliber rounds which are poorly made en masse due to how many rounds need to be manufactured. Thus, it has a slower rate of fire and armor penetration, but who cares because no one wants to be on the receiving end of this amount of dakka.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada de la ametralladora diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Utiliza cartuchos de mayor calibre que se fabrican en masa. Su cadencia de disparo y penetración de armadura son menores, pero a nadie le importa porque nadie quiere recibir tal cantidad de balas.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the grenade launcher designed for use by a warcasket. A straight upgrade, it fires in bursts of 3 and benefits from recoil damping for faster recovery and better range. Like all launchers though, it has a worse miss radius compared to a hand-thrown grenade.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the grenade launcher designed for use by a warcasket. A straight upgrade, it fires in bursts of 3 and benefits from recoil damping for faster recovery and better range. Like all launchers though, it has a worse miss radius compared to a hand-thrown grenade.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del lanzagranadas diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Mejora directa, dispara en ráfagas de 3 y se beneficia del amortiguador de retroceso para una recuperación más rápida y un mejor alcance. Como todos los lanzadores, posee un radio de explosión inferior al de una granada lanzada a mano.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the heavy flamer designed for use by a warcasket. Thanks to the twin barrels and larger heat sink, it can spit out two jets of flames while also needing less time to prevent overheating.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the heavy flamer designed for use by a warcasket. Thanks to the twin barrels and larger heat sink, it can spit out two jets of flames while also needing less time to prevent overheating.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del lanzallamas diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Gracias a sus dos barriles y a un disipador térmico más grande, puede escupir dos chorros de llamas al mismo tiempo mientras tiene un mejor retraso para evitar el sobrecalentamiento.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the combat knife designed for use by a warcasket. It is only still called a knife due to size comparison to a warcasket, but it is capable of cleaving a man in half and is just as large. The preferred weapon for the faster moving warcaskets that prioritize lightly armored, isolated targets.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the combat knife designed for use by a warcasket. It is only still called a knife due to size comparison to a warcasket, but it is capable of cleaving a man in half and is just as large. The preferred weapon for the faster moving warcaskets that prioritize lightly armored, isolated targets.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del cuchillo de combate diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Todavía se llama cuchillo debido a la comparación de tamaño con un exotraje, pero es capaz de cortar a un hombre en dos y es igual de grande. Es el arma preferida de los exotrajes que se mueven más rápido y que prefieren objetivos aislados y ligeramente blindados.

Rule.Original: A very unique melee weapon exclusively made for warcaskets. It combines massive weight and a cutting force that gives it no equal in melee combat. While it was intended for use against other warcaskets, it works just as well against smaller targets that would normally be considered armored.
Rule.Raw: A very unique melee weapon exclusively made for warcaskets. It combines massive weight and a cutting force that gives it no equal in melee combat. While it was intended for use against other warcaskets, it works just as well against smaller targets that would normally be considered armored.
Rule.Translated: Un arma cuerpo a cuerpo única, diseñada exclusivamente para los exotrajes. Combina un peso masivo y una fuerza de corte que no tiene equivalente en combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Aunque fue diseñada para ser utilizada contra otros exotrajes, funciona igual de bien contra objetivos más pequeños que normalmente se considerarían blindados.

Rule.Original: A terror on the battlefield, the charge lance received a massive upgrade for warcasket use. A considerably more powerful energy source gives it superior stopping power, able to fire multiple larger projectiles at a greater range with improved accuracy and penetration.
Rule.Raw: A terror on the battlefield, the charge lance received a massive upgrade for warcasket use. A considerably more powerful energy source gives it superior stopping power, able to fire multiple larger projectiles at a greater range with improved accuracy and penetration.
Rule.Translated: Un terror en el campo de batalla, el lanza-cargas ha recibido una mejora masiva para su uso en exotrajes. Una fuente de energía considerablemente más potente le otorga un mayor poder de parada, capaz de disparar varios proyectiles más grandes a una mayor distancia con mejor precisión y penetración.

Rule.Original: Essentially a handheld smoothbore mortar that fires explosives in an arc, able to bypass enemy fortifications. The accuracy is abysmal but the onboard fabricator ensures that artillery fire can be provided without ever needing a resupply.

La precisión es terrible, pero el constructor integrado permite realizar disparos de artillería sin necesidad de reabastecimiento.

Rule.Original: A monumental piece of anti-personnel technology that can only be properly utilized by the oversized warcaskets. Practically an engine block fitted to the end of a mech’s limb actuator, equipped with multiple pneumatic plates covering miniature repulsor generators designed for riot control. In layman’s terms, a strike from the head will launch the target backwards by several meters.

En términos simples, un golpe en la cabeza lanza al objetivo varios metros hacia atrás.

Rule.Original:
Specialized warcasket helmet with superior protection for similar weight, aerodynamically designed with onboard telemetry for jump calculation.

The 7th generation warcaskets came after underwhelming results in improving the baseline performance even further, instead focusing on creating designs that - while interchangeable - work better as a set. They were also the first to include plasteel in the design as it appeared more frequently in scavenging and looting. Each piece has a unique function that synergises with those of the same series, making them a truly separate class of mobile armor units.

The Aerial series is based on the Marine design with a few improvements in key areas, namely that the plating was made more aerodynamic and the addition of shoulder thrusters. The primary goal was to get the pilot behind enemy lines or even right in the middle of them to tie up high priority targets, giving them the catchphrase “death from above”.

En su lugar, se buscó crear diseños que, aunque intercambiables, funcionasen mejor como conjunto. También fueron los primeros en incorporar plastiacero, cada vez más frecuente entre los materiales recuperados y saqueados. Cada pieza tiene una función única que complementa a las de su misma serie, lo que los convierte en una categoría propia de unidades blindadas móviles.

La serie aérea parte del diseño de infantería de marina e introduce mejoras en áreas clave: placas más aerodinámicas y propulsores en los hombros. Su objetivo principal era situar al piloto detrás de las líneas enemigas, o incluso en medio de ellas, para trabar combate con objetivos prioritarios. De ahí su lema: «Muerte desde el cielo».

The Hazard series was arguably one of the first of the 7th gen warcaskets, and was designed with utility in mind. The pilot can comfortably walk through a blazing inferno and excessive radiation, either when scavenging the remains of a battle or making its way to overload a ship’s nuclear reactor. Ironically, these pilots’ favourite saying is “I love the smell of napalm, it smells like money”.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Siegebreaker series provides a general focus on stronger ranged shields to improve survivability in the field, whether that be improving the capacitors or the charging conduits. Because it is a relatively simple improvement, this series is suited more for laying down masses of firepower downrange while offering excellent protection so one can freely reposition to flank the enemy.

El acceso a más recursos de gran calidad y el propósito de equipar a veteranos que ya no podían servir permitieron crear acorazados manejados por una sola persona. También se mejoró la versatilidad de las armaduras y se redujeron las restricciones para combinar piezas de distintas series, incluso de generaciones diferentes.

La serie rompeasedios se centra en escudos más potentes contra ataques a distancia para mejorar la supervivencia en combate, ya sea mediante condensadores mejores o conductos de carga reforzados. Como la mejora es relativamente sencilla, resulta adecuada para proyectar enormes cantidades de fuego y ofrecer una excelente protección que permita reposicionarse libremente y flanquear al enemigo.

Por eso rinde menos en solitario o contra objetivos individuales, pero destaca acompañando a un grupo numeroso frente a enemigos con sistemas de armas de un solo uso.
casco de sarcófago de combate controlador

Rule.Original: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a miniature combat drone deployment module but no controller.
Rule.Raw: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a miniature combat drone deployment module but no controller.

Rule.Original:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a miniature combat drone deployment module but no controller.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Controller series is packed to the brim with computing technology to support semi-autonomous AI-operated drones. While the power core couldn’t also support a fabrication module, this still permits this series to deploy a brief surge of firepower to overwhelm an enemy, even the odds or offer sufficient distraction to relocate to a more advantageous position. Controllers work very well in defensive locations that can afford to resupply them with the advanced components.

Los controladores funcionan muy bien en posiciones defensivas donde se puede reabastecerlos de componentes avanzados.
casco de sarcófago de combate funerario

Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with onboard bionics that replace the pilot’s breathing, eating, hearing, sight, and talking functionality. Also comes standard with a consciousness stimulator.

The Sarcophagus series is an extremely sensitive matter as it sparked numerous debates and riots regarding its use. This is because it can keep the pilot functional even well after they should have otherwise died, thus has been used not only on veterans but also on prisoners, cripples and indentured servants who have effectively been refuted their right to die. Generally, once someone has been integrated into this armour series, they remain inside until they are completely destroyed.

Por ello se ha utilizado no solo con veteranos, sino también con prisioneros, personas con discapacidad y sirvientes endeudados a quienes se ha negado, en la práctica, el derecho a morir. Una vez integrado alguien en esta serie de armaduras, suele permanecer dentro hasta su destrucción completa.

Rule.Original: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a discharge module which feeds from the shields’ capacitors.
Rule.Raw: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a discharge module which feeds from the shields’ capacitors.
Rule.Translated: Un casco especializado de sarcófago de combate de tecnología espacial, con protección estándar y un módulo de descarga alimentado por los condensadores de los escudos.

Rule.Original:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a discharge module which feeds from the shields’ capacitors.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Brute series is equipped with one of the most advanced shield modules available along with numerous oversized capacitors. Unique to this series, the shields lack the ability to allow the user to fire ranged weapons, but makes up for it by additionally blocking melee as well as ranged attacks. Due to the excessive number of capacitors, the recharge rate for the shields is particularly slow. As such, a Brute should go into melee and kill everything in one go, even detonating their shields if they don’t put themselves in immediate danger.

La serie bruto está equipada con uno de los módulos de escudo más avanzados disponibles y numerosos condensadores de gran tamaño. Sus escudos tienen una particularidad: no permiten disparar armas a distancia, pero lo compensan bloqueando ataques tanto cuerpo a cuerpo como a distancia. El elevado número de condensadores hace que la recarga sea especialmente lenta. Por tanto, un bruto debe entrar en cuerpo a cuerpo y matarlo todo de una vez, incluso detonando sus escudos si hacerlo no lo expone a un peligro inmediato.

Rule.Translated: Sobrecarga el escudo personal para crear una explosión de energía cinética alrededor del sarcófago de combate que daña todo lo que hay en su radio. Cuanta más energía se detone, mayor será el radio.

Rule.Original: Basic warcasket shell with baseline protection and weight.\n\nA 3rd generation warcasket which was the first to enter mass production, its design was based off of a combination of an upscaled astrominer’s powered rig and early iterations of bionic limb interfaces. As pirates have ample supply of “willing” human test subjects, they were deployed before power armor finished the prototype phase. The lead scientist on the project was quoted “you can’t make an omelette without breaking health and safety.”

Rule.Translated: Una carcasa básica de sarcófago de combate, con protección y peso estándar.\n\nUn sarcófago de combate de 3.ª generación, la primera que se fabricó en masa. Su diseño combinaba una versión ampliada del equipo motorizado de un minero espacial con las primeras interfaces para extremidades biónicas. Como los piratas disponen de abundantes sujetos humanos de prueba «voluntarios», se desplegaron antes de que las servoarmaduras superaran la fase de prototipo. Según el científico principal del proyecto: «No se puede hacer una tortilla sin romper las normas de seguridad y salud».

While the more advanced and adjustable marine armour was successful against those who couldn’t field warcaskets, their construction was already being imitated by reverse engineering the superior power supply units and armor design improvements, along with considerably thicker plating supported by stronger hydraulics.

Rule.Original: Advanced warcasket shell with improved environment protection and reduced weight.\n\n5th generation warcaskets were created with a much shorter period between generations, largely being slight specializations of the previous one. The Recon design was made with the goal of having it rapidly going behind enemy lines and taking out important personnel, such as doctors, armorers, engineers and botanists. They were typically armed with a warcasket knife to eliminate armed guards, their motto being “get busy moving or get busy dying”.

Rule.Raw: Specialized warcasket shell with superior protection for similar weight, aerodynamically designed and fitted with rocket booster injectors.
Rule.Translated: Una carcasa especializada de sarcófago de combate, con protección superior para un peso similar, diseño aerodinámico e inyectores de propulsores de cohete.

Rule.Original:
Specialized warcasket shell with superior protection for similar weight, aerodynamically designed and fitted with rocket booster injectors.

The 7th generation warcaskets came after underwhelming results in improving the baseline performance even further, instead focusing on creating designs that - while interchangeable - work better as a set. They were also the first to include plasteel in the design as it appeared more frequently in scavenging and looting. Each piece has a unique function that synergises with those of the same series, making them a truly separate class of mobile armor units.

The Aerial series is based on the Marine design with a few improvements in key areas, namely that the plating was made more aerodynamic and the addition of shoulder thrusters. The primary goal was to get the pilot behind enemy lines or even right in the middle of them to tie up high priority targets, giving them the catchphrase “death from above”.

Specialized warcasket shell with superior protection for similar weight, aerodynamically designed and fitted with rocket booster injectors.

The 7th generation warcaskets came after underwhelming results in improving the baseline performance even further, instead focusing on creating designs that - while interchangeable - work better as a set. They were also the first to include plasteel in the design as it appeared more frequently in scavenging and looting. Each piece has a unique function that synergises with those of the same series, making them a truly separate class of mobile armor units.

The Aerial series is based on the Marine design with a few improvements in key areas, namely that the plating was made more aerodynamic and the addition of shoulder thrusters. The primary goal was to get the pilot behind enemy lines or even right in the middle of them to tie up high priority targets, giving them the catchphrase “death from above”.
Rule.Translated:
Una carcasa especializada de sarcófago de combate, con protección superior para un peso similar, diseño aerodinámico e inyectores de propulsores de cohete.

Los sarcófagos de combate de 7.ª generación surgieron tras los discretos resultados de los intentos de mejorar aún más el rendimiento básico. En su lugar, se buscó crear diseños que, aunque intercambiables, funcionasen mejor como conjunto. También fueron los primeros en incorporar plastiacero, cada vez más frecuente entre los materiales recuperados y saqueados. Cada pieza tiene una función única que complementa a las de su misma serie, lo que los convierte en una categoría propia de unidades blindadas móviles.

La serie aérea parte del diseño de infantería de marina e introduce mejoras en áreas clave: placas más aerodinámicas y propulsores en los hombros. The Aerial series is based on the Marine design with a few improvements in key areas, namely that the plating was made more aerodynamic and the addition of shoulder thrusters. The primary goal was to get the pilot behind enemy lines or even right in the middle of them to tie up high priority targets, giving them the catchphrase “death from above”.

Specialized warcasket shell with peerless environment protection for similar weight, fitted with flame retardant material.

The 7th generation warcaskets came after underwhelming results in improving the baseline performance even further, instead focusing on creating designs that - while interchangeable - work better as a set. They were also the first to include plasteel in the design as it appeared more frequently in scavenging and looting. Each piece has a unique function that synergises with those of the same series, making them a truly separate class of mobile armor units.

The Hazard series was arguably one of the first of the 7th gen warcaskets, and was designed with utility in mind. The pilot can comfortably walk through a blazing inferno and excessive radiation, either when scavenging the remains of a battle or making its way to overload a ship’s nuclear reactor. Ironically, these pilots’ favourite saying is “I love the smell of napalm, it smells like money”.

The launcher does not require ammunition, but time needs to be reserved between shots to wind it up again. Privateers usually specialize in getting in and out of dangerous situations easily. Grappling hook connects to walls and solid rock and allows the users to quickly move to the desired location.
Rule.Raw: A variant of marine armor with an integrated grappling hook on the shoulder. The armor is slightly less protective than standard marine armor. The launcher does not require ammunition, but time needs to be reserved between shots to wind it up again. Privateers usually specialize in getting in and out of dangerous situations easily. Grappling hook connects to walls and solid rock and allows the users to quickly move to the desired location.
Rule.Translated: Una variante de la armadura de los marines, que aunque ofrece un poco menos de protección que esta, cuenta con un garfio integrado en el hombro. El lanza-garfios no necesita munición, pero hay que reservar tiempo entre disparo y disparo hasta que vuelve a enrollarse.\n\nLos corsarios suelen especializarse en entrar y salir fácilmente de situaciones peligrosas. Por eso, el gancho de agarre se conecta a paredes y rocas sólidas y permite a los usuarios desplazarse rápidamente al lugar deseado.

Rule.Original:
A large, bulky suit that allows the wearer to passively produce Rum once every 10 days. However, it is not very pleasant to wear as it feels like wearing damp, humid clothes from excessive sweating.

The suit includes a high-efficiency filter, heat-exchange filaments and salt precipitators. Urine and feces are processed in thigh pads and throughout the design are tubes that link to different catchpockets. Reprocessed bodily fluids are distilled into an alcoholic derivative of nutrient paste which can be drained when all the pockets are filled.

Removing the suit causes the accumulated liquid to evaporate, and it takes a long time to put on and properly adjust to the wearer. Due to the design, it can only be worn with an undersuit and the lack of head covering, while reducing efficiency, is purposefully done so it can be worn with head protection.

A large, bulky suit that allows the wearer to passively produce Rum once every 10 days. However, it is not very pleasant to wear as it feels like wearing damp, humid clothes from excessive sweating.

The suit includes a high-efficiency filter, heat-exchange filaments and salt precipitators. Urine and feces are processed in thigh pads and throughout the design are tubes that link to different catchpockets. Reprocessed bodily fluids are distilled into an alcoholic derivative of nutrient paste which can be drained when all the pockets are filled.

Removing the suit causes the accumulated liquid to evaporate, and it takes a long time to put on and properly adjust to the wearer. Due to the design, it can only be worn with an undersuit and the lack of head covering, while reducing efficiency, is purposefully done so it can be worn with head protection.
Rule.Translated:
Un traje grande y voluminoso que permite al usuario producir ron de forma pasiva cada 10 días. Sin embargo, no es muy agradable de llevar, ya que produce la sensación de estar llevando continuamente ropa húmeda y mojada por la sudoración excesiva.

El traje incluye un filtro de alta eficacia, filamentos de intercambio térmico y precipitadores de sal. La orina y las heces se procesan en las almohadillas de los muslos y por todo el diseño hay tubos que enlazan con diferentes bolsillos colectores. Los fluidos corporales reprocesados se destilan en un derivado alcohólico de la pasta nutritiva que puede drenarse cuando se llenan todos los bolsillos.

Al quitarse el traje, el líquido acumulado se evapora, y se tarda mucho tiempo en volver a ponérselo y ajustarlo correctamente al usuario. Debido a su diseño, solo puede llevarse con ropa interior; y el hecho de que no cubra la cabeza es intencionado, ya que aunque reduce la eficiencia del traje, permite que el usuario pueda usar protección para la misma.

Rule.Original: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with standard protection, augmented with improved shield capacitors for greater durability.
Rule.Raw: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with standard protection, augmented with improved shield capacitors for greater durability.
Rule.Translated: Una carcasa especializada de sarcófago de combate de tecnología espacial, con protección estándar y condensadores de escudo mejorados para aumentar su resistencia.

Rule.Original:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with standard protection, augmented with improved shield capacitors for greater durability.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Siegebreaker series provides a general focus on stronger ranged shields to improve survivability in the field, whether that be improving the capacitors or the charging conduits. Because it is a relatively simple improvement, this series is suited more for laying down masses of firepower downrange while offering excellent protection so one can freely reposition to flank the enemy.

Rule.Original:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with standard protection, equipped with a controller and combat drone deployment module.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Controller series is packed to the brim with computing technology to support semi-autonomous AI-operated drones. While the power core couldn’t also support a fabrication module, this still permits this series to deploy a brief surge of firepower to overwhelm an enemy, even the odds or offer sufficient distraction to relocate to a more advantageous position. Controllers work very well in defensive locations that can afford to resupply them with the advanced components.

The Sarcophagus series is an extremely sensitive matter as it sparked numerous debates and riots regarding its use. This is because it can keep the pilot functional even well after they should have otherwise died, thus has been used not only on veterans but also on prisoners, cripples and indentured servants who have effectively been refuted their right to die. Generally, once someone has been integrated into this armour series, they remain inside until they are completely destroyed.

Rule.Original:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with improved impact dispersion, equipped with powerful, oversized capacitors feeding a personal overshield.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Brute series is equipped with one of the most advanced shield modules available along with numerous oversized capacitors. Unique to this series, the shields lack the ability to allow the user to fire ranged weapons, but makes up for it by additionally blocking melee as well as ranged attacks. Due to the excessive number of capacitors, the recharge rate for the shields is particularly slow. As such, a Brute should go into melee and kill everything in one go, even detonating their shields if they don’t put themselves in immediate danger.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Brute series is equipped with one of the most advanced shield modules available along with numerous oversized capacitors. Unique to this series, the shields lack the ability to allow the user to fire ranged weapons, but makes up for it by additionally blocking melee as well as ranged attacks. Due to the excessive number of capacitors, the recharge rate for the shields is particularly slow. As such, a Brute should go into melee and kill everything in one go, even detonating their shields if they don’t put themselves in immediate danger.
Rule.Translated:
Unas hombreras especializadas de sarcófago de combate de tecnología espacial, con dispersión de impactos mejorada, bancos de condensadores adicionales y módulos de asistencia para combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Los sarcófagos de combate de 10.ª generación se adaptaron a partir de equipos piratas capturados, que las divisiones militares de investigación gubernamentales mejoraron con diseños avanzados de servoarmaduras. El acceso a más recursos de gran calidad y el propósito de equipar a veteranos que ya no podían servir permitieron crear acorazados manejados por una sola persona. También se mejoró la versatilidad de las armaduras y se redujeron las restricciones para combinar piezas de distintas series, incluso de generaciones diferentes.

La serie bruto está equipada con uno de los módulos de escudo más avanzados disponibles y numerosos condensadores de gran tamaño. Sus escudos tienen una particularidad: no permiten disparar armas a distancia, pero lo compensan bloqueando ataques tanto cuerpo a cuerpo como a distancia. El elevado número de condensadores hace que la recarga sea especialmente lenta. Por tanto, un bruto debe entrar en cuerpo a cuerpo y matarlo todo de una vez, incluso detonando sus escudos si hacerlo no lo expone a un peligro inmediato.
cápsula de criptosueño de nave (en curso)
depósito de biocombustible de nave (en curso)
caja de pasta nutritiva de nave (en curso)

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the combat knife designed for use by a warcasket. It is only still called a knife due to size comparison to a warcasket, but it is capable of cleaving a man in half and is just as large. The preferred weapon for the faster moving warcaskets that prioritize lightly armored, isolated targets.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the combat knife designed for use by a warcasket. It is only still called a knife due to size comparison to a warcasket, but it is capable of cleaving a man in half and is just as large. The preferred weapon for the faster moving warcaskets that prioritize lightly armored, isolated targets.
Rule.Translated: Una versión agrandada del cuchillo de combate diseñado para ser utilizado por un exotraje bélico. Se le sigue llamando cuchillo debido a su tamaño, pero es capaz de partir a un hombre por la mitad y es igual de grande. Es el arma que suelen usar los exotrajes veloces que dan prioridad a los objetivos aislados y con armadura ligera.

Rule.Original: A very unique melee weapon exclusively made for warcaskets. It combines massive weight and a cutting force that gives it no equal in melee combat. While it was intended for use against other warcaskets, it works just as well against smaller targets that would normally be considered armored.
Rule.Raw: A very unique melee weapon exclusively made for warcaskets. It combines massive weight and a cutting force that gives it no equal in melee combat. While it was intended for use against other warcaskets, it works just as well against smaller targets that would normally be considered armored.
Rule.Translated: Un arma cuerpo a cuerpo muy singular fabricada exclusivamente para los exotrajes bélicos. Su peso descomunal y capacidad de corte no tiene rival en el combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Aunque está pensada para usarse contra otros exotrajes, funciona igual de bien contra objetivos más pequeños que normalmente se considerarían blindados.

Rule.Original: A monumental piece of anti-personnel technology that can only be properly utilized by the oversized warcaskets. Practically an engine block fitted to the end of a mech’s limb actuator, equipped with multiple pneumatic plates covering miniature repulsor generators designed for riot control. In layman’s terms, a strike from the head will launch the target backwards by several meters.
Rule.Raw: A monumental piece of anti-personnel technology that can only be properly utilized by the oversized warcaskets. Practically an engine block fitted to the end of a mech’s limb actuator, equipped with multiple pneumatic plates covering miniature repulsor generators designed for riot control. In layman’s terms, a strike from the head will launch the target backwards by several meters.
Rule.Translated: Una pieza descomunal de tecnología antipersonal que solo pueden utilizar adecuadamente los exotrajes bélicos más grandes. Se trata básicamente de un grupo de motores acoplados al extremo del actuador de extremidad, equipado con múltiples placas neumáticas que cubren generadores repulsores en miniatura diseñados para el control de disturbios. En términos sencillos, un golpe de su cabeza lanzará al objetivo a varios metros de distancia.

Rule.Original: A military modification of the Plasmasaw, adapted for use by warcaskets for anti-materiel purposes. The original intention for this bastard sword was for it to be able to extend like a whip while also having a simple straight form, however issues with containing the plasma shelved the idea. Instead, the links are used to change the length of the sword as well as allow easier replacement of damaged sections.
Rule.Raw: A military modification of the Plasmasaw, adapted for use by warcaskets for anti-materiel purposes. The original intention for this bastard sword was for it to be able to extend like a whip while also having a simple straight form, however issues with containing the plasma shelved the idea. Instead, the links are used to change the length of the sword as well as allow easier replacement of damaged sections.
Rule.Translated: Una modificación militar de la sierra de plasma, adaptada para su uso en exotrajes con fines anti-material. Originalmente, esta espada bastarda debía poder alargarse como un látigo mientras mantenía una forma recta simple, pero los problemas relacionados con el confinamiento del plasma terminaron con esa idea. En su lugar, los eslabones se utilizan para modificar la longitud de la espada y facilitar el reemplazo de secciones dañadas.

Rule.Original: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a wardrone.
Rule.Raw: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a wardrone.
Rule.Translated: Una simple pistola automática hecha para ser montada en un dron bélico.

Rule.Original: A portable version of the autocannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has a lower range, less penetration and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it is very capable in close quarters combat which makes up for the slight accuracy loss at greater ranges.
Rule.Raw: A portable version of the autocannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has a lower range, less penetration and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it is very capable in close quarters combat which makes up for the slight accuracy loss at greater ranges.
Rule.Translated: Una versión portátil del autocañón diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Debido al cañón acortado, su alcance es menor y su penetración y daño son reducidos en comparación con la versión con torreta. Sin embargo, es muy eficaz en combate cercano, lo que compensa la ligera pérdida de precisión a larga distancia.

Rule.Original: A portable version of the uranium slug cannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has less penetration, worse recoil and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it lacks the minimum range requirement thanks to a human operator and has better mid-range performance.
Rule.Raw: A portable version of the uranium slug cannon designed for use by a warcasket. Due to a shortened barrel it has less penetration, worse recoil and damage compared to the turreted version. However, it lacks the minimum range requirement thanks to a human operator and has better mid-range performance.
Rule.Translated: Una versión portátil del cañón de obús de uranio diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Debido a un cañón más corto, la penetración se reduce, el retroceso y los daños son menores que en la versión con torreta. Sin embargo, no tiene el alcance mínimo requerido gracias a un operador humano y ofrece mejores resultados a media distancia.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the pump shotgun designed for use by a warcasket. Each cartridge fired contains 4 pellets larger than slugs from a regular-sized shotgun, giving it better range, armor penetration and much better damage. The recoil is insane though, even for a warcasket’s recoil damping system.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the pump shotgun designed for use by a warcasket. Each cartridge fired contains 4 pellets larger than slugs from a regular-sized shotgun, giving it better range, armor penetration and much better damage. The recoil is insane though, even for a warcasket’s recoil damping system.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada de la escopeta diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Cada cartucho disparado contiene 4 perdigones más grandes que las balas de una escopeta de tamaño normal, lo que le confiere un mejor alcance, mayor penetración de armadura y un daño significativamente mayor. El retroceso, sin embargo, es desmesurado, incluso para el sistema de amortiguación de un exotraje.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the minigun designed for use by a warcasket. It uses larger caliber rounds which are poorly made en masse due to how many rounds need to be manufactured. Thus, it has a slower rate of fire and armor penetration, but who cares because no one wants to be on the receiving end of this amount of dakka.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the minigun designed for use by a warcasket. It uses larger caliber rounds which are poorly made en masse due to how many rounds need to be manufactured. Thus, it has a slower rate of fire and armor penetration, but who cares because no one wants to be on the receiving end of this amount of dakka.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada de la ametralladora rotativa diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Utiliza cartuchos de mayor calibre que son fabricados en masa. Su cadencia de disparo y penetración de armadura son menores, pero eso no importa porque nadie quiere enfrentarse a tal cantidad de balas.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the grenade launcher designed for use by a warcasket. A straight upgrade, it fires in bursts of 3 and benefits from recoil damping for faster recovery and better range. Like all launchers though, it has a worse miss radius compared to a hand-thrown grenade.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the grenade launcher designed for use by a warcasket. A straight upgrade, it fires in bursts of 3 and benefits from recoil damping for faster recovery and better range. Like all launchers though, it has a worse miss radius compared to a hand-thrown grenade.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del lanzagranadas diseñada para ser utilizada por un exotraje. Mejora directa, dispara en ráfagas de 3 y se beneficia del amortiguador de retroceso para una recuperación más rápida y mejor alcance. Como todos los lanzadores, tiene un radio de explosión inferior al de una granada lanzada a mano.

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the heavy flamer designed for use by a warcasket. Thanks to the twin barrels and larger heat sink, it can spit out two jets of flames while also needing less time to prevent overheating.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the heavy flamer designed for use by a warcasket. Thanks to the twin barrels and larger heat sink, it can spit out two jets of flames while also needing less time to prevent overheating.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del lanzallamas diseñado para ser utilizado por un exotraje. Gracias a sus dos barriles y a un disipador térmico más grande, puede escupir dos chorros de llamas mientras tiene un mejor tiempo de enfriamiento para evitar el sobrecalentamiento.
disparo de lanzallamas pesado de sarcófago de combate

Rule.Original: A terror on the battlefield, the charge lance received a massive upgrade for warcasket use. A considerably more powerful energy source gives it superior stopping power, able to fire multiple larger projectiles at a greater range with improved accuracy and penetration.
Rule.Raw: A terror on the battlefield, the charge lance received a massive upgrade for warcasket use. A considerably more powerful energy source gives it superior stopping power, able to fire multiple larger projectiles at a greater range with improved accuracy and penetration.
Rule.Translated: Terror en el campo de batalla, el lanzador de cargas ha recibido una mejora masiva para su uso en exotrajes. Una fuente de energía considerablemente más potente le confiere un poder de detención superior, capaz de disparar varios proyectiles más grandes a mayor distancia con una precisión y penetración mejoradas.

Rule.Original: Essentially a handheld smoothbore mortar that fires explosives in an arc, able to bypass enemy fortifications. Made by those who wanted to combine ancient naval warfare with modern technology. The accuracy is abysmal but the onboard fabricator ensures that artillery fire can be provided without ever needing a resupply.
Rule.Raw: Essentially a handheld smoothbore mortar that fires explosives in an arc, able to bypass enemy fortifications. Made by those who wanted to combine ancient naval warfare with modern technology. The accuracy is abysmal but the onboard fabricator ensures that artillery fire can be provided without ever needing a resupply.
Rule.Translated: Esencialmente es un mortero portátil de ánima lisa que dispara explosivos en un arco, capaz de sortear las fortificaciones enemigas. Fabricado por aquellos que querían combinar la antigua guerra naval con la tecnología moderna. La precisión es espantosa, pero el constructor integrado permite realizar disparos de artillería sin necesidad de reabastecimiento.

Rule.Original: Essentially an upscaled charge minigun designed to be used by a warcasket. While firing fewer projectiles in each burst, the ammunition has been improved with explosive payloads. Designed as a support weapon that completely invalidates cover for the unlucky bastards on the receiving end.
Rule.Raw: Essentially an upscaled charge minigun designed to be used by a warcasket. While firing fewer projectiles in each burst, the ammunition has been improved with explosive payloads. Designed as a support weapon that completely invalidates cover for the unlucky bastards on the receiving end.
Rule.Translated: Esencialmente un minigun de carga mejorado diseñado para ser usado por un exotraje. Aunque dispara menos proyectiles por ráfaga, las municiones se han mejorado con cargas explosivas. Diseñado como un arma de apoyo que neutraliza completamente la cobertura de los desafortunados que la reciben.

Rule.Original: Semi-autonomous flying combat drone with limited combat functionality. Equipped with a lightweight semi-automatic miniturret due to limited recoil absorption and an onboard self-destruction module to both prevent enemy capture and defense against melee attackers.
Rule.Raw: Semi-autonomous flying combat drone with limited combat functionality. Equipped with a lightweight semi-automatic miniturret due to limited recoil absorption and an onboard self-destruction module to both prevent enemy capture and defense against melee attackers.
Rule.Translated: Un dron de combate semiautónomo con una capacidad de combate limitada. Está equipado con una minitorreta semiautomática ligera debido a la limitada capacidad para amortiguar el retroceso. También cuenta con un módulo de autodestrucción que le permite defenderse de los ataques cuerpo a cuerpo, a la vez que evita la captura del enemigo.

Rule.Original: Semi-autonomous combat drone with onboard pathfinding capability. Equipped with a self-destruction module and tracking system, designed to be launched as a payload and then seek out enemy targets. If no nearby targets can be acquired, it will immediately detonate in order to prevent future accidents.
Rule.Raw: Semi-autonomous combat drone with onboard pathfinding capability. Equipped with a self-destruction module and tracking system, designed to be launched as a payload and then seek out enemy targets. If no nearby targets can be acquired, it will immediately detonate in order to prevent future accidents.
Rule.Translated: Un dron de combate semiautónomo con capacidad de búsqueda de caminos. Equipado con un módulo de autodestrucción y un sistema de seguimiento, están diseñadas para ser lanzadas como si fueran bombas y luego buscar objetivos enemigos. Si no puede localizar objetivos cercanos, detonará inmediatamente para evitar futuros accidentes.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on them, and they can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. Because of how bulky the armor is and how much energy it takes to use it, {PAWN_nameDef} is not capable of doing any work.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on them, and they can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. Because of how bulky the armor is and how much energy it takes to use it, {PAWN_nameDef} is not capable of doing any work.
Rule.Translated: {PAWN_nameDef} está enterrad{PAWN_gender ? o : a} en un exotraje bélico. No le afecta ningún tipo de dolor, y nunca podrá sufrir un shock o caer inconsciente a causa de este. Debido a lo voluminoso que es este exotraje y a la cantidad de energía que se necesita para usarlo, {PAWN_nameDef} no es capaz de realizar ningún trabajo.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} was entombed in a warcasket, and then brutally pulled out of one. The neural and nerve damage from being unplugged is so severe that {PAWN_nameDef} is in constant, agonizing pain and can barely assemble {PAWN_possessive} thoughts. Only installing {PAWN_nameDef} back in a warcasket can cure the symptoms.

Rule.Translated: {PAWN_nameDef} fue enterrad{PAWN_gender ? o : a} en un exotraje bélico, para luego ser brutalmente sacad{PAWN_gender ? o : a} del mismo. Los daños neuronales y nerviosos causados por la desconexión son tan graves que {PAWN_nameDef} sufre de un dolor agónico constante, tan intenso que apenas puede pensar. Esto solo puede remediarse volviendo a introducir a {PAWN_nameDef} en un exotraje bélico.
