Rule.Translated: Integración de GarlicSauce's Advanced Deep Drill (Continued) con nuevas recetas de mineral de plata, oro y hierro en lugar de lingotes terminados.

Rule.Original: Are you sure you want to restart the game?
Rule.Raw: Are you sure you want to restart the game?

Rule.Translated: Producir combustible químico a partir de canola.

Rule.Original: Make a batch of chemfuel by extracting biofuel from canola flowers.
Rule.Raw: Make a batch of chemfuel by extracting biofuel from canola flowers.
Rule.Translated: Preparar un lote de combustible químico extrayendo biocombustible de las flores de canola.
Refinando combustible químico a partir de la canola.

Rule.Original: A bright-yellow flowering variety of the rapeseed, cultivated mainly for its oil-rich seed.
Rule.Raw: A bright-yellow flowering variety of the rapeseed, cultivated mainly for its oil-rich seed.
Rule.Translated: Una variedad de rapeseed de flores amarillas brillantes, cultivada principalmente por sus semillas ricas en aceite.

Rule.Original: A green or nearly black coloured fruit with a large seed or pit in the center. Avocados have a very mild, creamy texture. Hipsters love them.
Rule.Raw: A green or nearly black coloured fruit with a large seed or pit in the center. Avocados have a very mild, creamy texture. Hipsters love them.
Rule.Translated: Un fruto de color verde o casi negro con una gran semilla o hueso en el centro. Los aguacates tienen una textura muy suave y cremosa. A los hipsters les encantan.

Rule.Original: A sweet, edible, and fleshy fruit of considerable size. Melons are usually cultivated in warm regions.
Rule.Raw: A sweet, edible, and fleshy fruit of considerable size. Melons are usually cultivated in warm regions.
Rule.Translated: Un fruto dulce, comestible y carnoso de considerable tamaño. Los melones suelen ser cultivados en regiones cálidas.

Rule.Original: A sweet tropical fruit with a tough leathery skin and spiky leaves on top. The word pineapple was first used to mean "pine cone," and the fruit was given this name because of its resemblance to a large pine cone.
Rule.Raw: A sweet tropical fruit with a tough leathery skin and spiky leaves on top. The word pineapple was first used to mean "pine cone," and the fruit was given this name because of its resemblance to a large pine cone.
Rule.Translated: Una dulce fruta tropical con una piel dura y coriácea y hojas espinosas en la parte superior. La palabra 'piña' se utilizó por primera vez para referirse a 'piña de pino', y la fruta recibió este nombre debido a su semejanza con una gran piña de pino.

Rule.Original: The edible fruit of the coconut palm. Coconut flesh is high in fat and can be dried or eaten fresh or processed into coconut milk or coconut oil. The liquid of the nut, known as coconut water, is used in beverages.
Rule.Raw: The edible fruit of the coconut palm. Coconut flesh is high in fat and can be dried or eaten fresh or processed into coconut milk or coconut oil. The liquid of the nut, known as coconut water, is used in beverages.
Rule.Translated: El fruto comestible de la palma de coco. La pulpa del coco es rica en grasa y puede ser secada o consumida fresca, o procesada para obtener leche de coco o aceite de coco. El líquido del coco, conocido como agua de coco, se utiliza en bebidas.

Rule.Original: An oval shaped drupe often eaten on its own, raw or toasted, though it can also be used as a component of various dishes. A wide range of classic sweets feature almonds as a central ingredient.
Rule.Raw: An oval shaped drupe often eaten on its own, raw or toasted, though it can also be used as a component of various dishes. A wide range of classic sweets feature almonds as a central ingredient.
Rule.Translated: Un fruto seco de forma ovalada que a menudo se consume por sí solo, crudo o tostado, aunque también puede utilizarse como componente de varios platos. Una amplia variedad de dulces clásicos tienen a las almendras como ingrediente central.

Rule.Original: An oval fruit, vividly coloured with shades of red and yellow. The single large seed is flattened, and the flesh that surrounds it is yellow to orange in colour, juicy, and of distinctive sweet-spicy flavour.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Mangoes cannot be frozen or they get destroyed. The game won't be smart enough to detect this, so disable them from freezers.
Rule.Raw: An oval fruit, vividly coloured with shades of red and yellow. The single large seed is flattened, and the flesh that surrounds it is yellow to orange in colour, juicy, and of distinctive sweet-spicy flavour.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Mangoes cannot be frozen or they get destroyed. The game won't be smart enough to detect this, so disable them from freezers.
Rule.Translated: Una fruta ovalada, de colores vivos en tonos de rojo y amarillo. La única semilla grande está aplanada, y la pulpa que la rodea es de color amarillo a naranja, jugosa y de un distintivo sabor dulce y picante.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los mangos no pueden ser congelados o se destruirán. El juego no será lo suficientemente inteligente para detectarlo, así que desactívalos en los congeladores.

Rule.Original: A vegetable consisting of a long fibrous stalk tapering into leaves. The leaves are strongly flavored and are used less often, either as a flavoring in soups and stews or as a dried herb. Celery is a staple in many soups.
Rule.Raw: A vegetable consisting of a long fibrous stalk tapering into leaves. The leaves are strongly flavored and are used less often, either as a flavoring in soups and stews or as a dried herb. Celery is a staple in many soups.
Rule.Translated: Una verdura que consta de un largo tallo fibroso que se estrecha en hojas. Las hojas tienen un sabor fuerte y se utilizan menos a menudo, ya sea como saborizante en sopas y guisos o como hierba seca. El apio es un ingrediente básico en muchas sopas.

Rule.Original: A leaf vegetable commonly eaten fresh and served as the base of green salads. Lettuce is generally a rich source of vitamins K and A.
Rule.Raw: A leaf vegetable commonly eaten fresh and served as the base of green salads. Lettuce is generally a rich source of vitamins K and A.
Rule.Translated: Una verdura de hojas comúnmente consumida fresca y servida como base de ensaladas verdes. La lechuga generalmente es una fuente rica de vitaminas K y A.

Rule.Original: An edible root vegetable that is very easy to grow and quick to harvest. Radishes are often planted by novice gardeners.
Rule.Raw: An edible root vegetable that is very easy to grow and quick to harvest. Radishes are often planted by novice gardeners.
Rule.Translated: Una raíz comestible que es muy fácil de cultivar y se cosecha rápidamente. Los rábanos a menudo son plantados por jardineros novatos.

Rule.Original: A pseudocereal cultivated for its grain-like seeds. Its white flowers are produced in terminal clusters and after pòllination turn into triangular-shaped seeds that are enclosed by a tough dark brown or gray rind.
Rule.Raw: A pseudocereal cultivated for its grain-like seeds. Its white flowers are produced in terminal clusters and after pòllination turn into triangular-shaped seeds that are enclosed by a tough dark brown or gray rind.
Rule.Translated: Un pseudocereal cultivado por sus semillas similares a granos. Sus flores blancas se producen en racimos terminales y después de la polinización se convierten en semillas en forma de triángulo que están encerradas en una dura cáscara de color marrón oscuro o gris.

Rule.Original: Seeds with an oblong shape and a papery seed coat. Similar in taste and nutritional profile to tree nuts such as walnuts and almonds, but technically a legume.
Rule.Raw: Seeds with an oblong shape and a papery seed coat. Similar in taste and nutritional profile to tree nuts such as walnuts and almonds, but technically a legume.
Rule.Translated: Semillas de forma oblonga y tegumento parecido al papel. Similar en sabor y perfil nutricional a los frutos secos como las nueces y las almendras, pero técnicamente una legumbre.

Rule.Original: The seeds of the sunflower plant are more commonly eaten as a snack than as part of a meal. They can also be used as garnishes or ingredients in various recipes.
Rule.Raw: The seeds of the sunflower plant are more commonly eaten as a snack than as part of a meal. They can also be used as garnishes or ingredients in various recipes.
Rule.Translated: Las semillas de la planta de girasol se comen más comúnmente como refrigerio que como parte de una comida. También se pueden utilizar como guarnición o ingredientes en diversas recetas.

Rule.Original: Edible green seed pods, famously known for their slimy or sticky texture when cut open. Okra is a powerhouse of valuable nutrients.
Rule.Raw: Edible green seed pods, famously known for their slimy or sticky texture when cut open. Okra is a powerhouse of valuable nutrients.
Rule.Translated: Vainas de semilla verde comestibles, conocidas por su textura viscosa o pegajosa cuando se cortan. La okra es una fuente poderosa de nutrientes valiosos.

Rule.Original: A very old crop which is cultivated for its bulb, formed in the base of the leaves. It is highly appreciated in cooking for its pungent and characteristic taste.
Rule.Raw: A very old crop which is cultivated for its bulb, formed in the base of the leaves. It is highly appreciated in cooking for its pungent and characteristic taste.
Rule.Translated: Un cultivo muy antiguo que se cultiva por su bulbo, que se forma en la base de las hojas. Es muy apreciado en la cocina por su sabor picante y característico.

Rule.Original: A root vegetable, typically orange in color, though purple, black, red, white, and yellow cultivars exist. A versatile food that can be chopped and boiled, fried or steamed, cooked in soups and stews, as well as used for baby and pet foods.
Rule.Raw: A root vegetable, typically orange in color, though purple, black, red, white, and yellow cultivars exist. A versatile food that can be chopped and boiled, fried or steamed, cooked in soups and stews, as well as used for baby and pet foods.
Rule.Translated: Una raíz vegetal, típicamente de color naranja, aunque existen variedades de colores morado, negro, rojo, blanco y amarillo. Un alimento versátil que se puede picar y hervir, freír o cocinar al vapor, cocinar en sopas y guisos, así como usar para alimentos para bebés y mascotas.

Rule.Original: A form of cabbage grown for its edible buds called "sprouts". Brussels sprouts usually are eaten cooked, and the small young sprouts have a more delicate flavour than older ones.
Rule.Raw: A form of cabbage grown for its edible buds called "sprouts". Brussels sprouts usually are eaten cooked, and the small young sprouts have a more delicate flavour than older ones.
Rule.Translated: Una forma de col cultivada por sus brotes comestibles llamados "coles de Bruselas". Las coles de Bruselas generalmente se comen cocidas, y los brotes jóvenes y pequeños tienen un sabor más delicado que los más viejos.

Rule.Original: A small, egg-shaped black or green fruit that is used as food or for making oil. Olives freshly picked from the tree contain oleuropein, which makes the fruit unpalatable for immediate consumption. They must be brined or fermented to be used.
Rule.Raw: A small, egg-shaped black or green fruit that is used as food or for making oil. Olives freshly picked from the tree contain oleuropein, which makes the fruit unpalatable for immediate consumption. They must be brined or fermented to be used.
Rule.Translated: Una fruta pequeña de forma ovalada, negra o verde, que se utiliza como alimento o para hacer aceite. Las aceitunas recién recolectadas del árbol contienen oleuropeína, lo que hace que la fruta sea desagradable para el consumo inmediato. Deben ser saladas o fermentadas para ser utilizadas.

Rule.Original: Large, starchy, sweet-tasting (tasting similar to pumpkin), tuberous roots that are used as a root vegetable. The sweet potato is distantly related to the common potato.
Rule.Raw: Large, starchy, sweet-tasting (tasting similar to pumpkin), tuberous roots that are used as a root vegetable. The sweet potato is distantly related to the common potato.
Rule.Translated: Raíces tuberosas grandes, almidonadas y de sabor dulce (similar al de la calabaza), que se utilizan como vegetal de raíz. La batata está remotamente relacionado con la papa común.

Rule.Original: A tuberous edible plant also called manioc, mandioca, or yuca. They have a mild nutty taste and are commonly eaten as root vegetables in stews or as side dishes. Cassava roots are a versatile vegetable that can be used to produce flour, breads, tapioca, a laundry starch, and an alcoholic beverage.
Rule.Raw: A tuberous edible plant also called manioc, mandioca, or yuca. They have a mild nutty taste and are commonly eaten as root vegetables in stews or as side dishes. Cassava roots are a versatile vegetable that can be used to produce flour, breads, tapioca, a laundry starch, and an alcoholic beverage.
Rule.Translated: Una planta tuberosa comestible también llamada mandioca, mandioca o yuca. Tienen un sabor suave a nuez y se comen comúnmente como vegetales de raíz en guisos o como acompañamiento. Las raíces de yuca son un vegetal versátil que se puede usar para producir harina, pan, tapioca, almidón para lavandería y una bebida alcohólica.

Rule.Original: Young, unripe fruits of a cultivar of the common bean. They can be steamed, boiled, stir-fried, or baked. They are commonly cooked in other dishes such as soups, stews, and casseroles. Green beans can also be pickled, much like cucumbers are.
Rule.Raw: Young, unripe fruits of a cultivar of the common bean. They can be steamed, boiled, stir-fried, or baked. They are commonly cooked in other dishes such as soups, stews, and casseroles. Green beans can also be pickled, much like cucumbers are.
Rule.Translated: Frutos jóvenes e inmaduros de un cultivar del frijol común. Se pueden cocinar al vapor, hervir, saltear o hornear. Comúnmente se cocinan en otros platos como sopas, guisos y cazuelas. Las judías verdes también se pueden encurtir, similar a los pepinos.

Rule.Original: Also known as sweet peppers, bell peppers are technically nightshades and part of the capsicum family, but they are the only chili pepper that carries a recessive gene that stops any capsaicin from being made in the fruit, thus making them not spicy.
Rule.Raw: Also known as sweet peppers, bell peppers are technically nightshades and part of the capsicum family, but they are the only chili pepper that carries a recessive gene that stops any capsaicin from being made in the fruit, thus making them not spicy.
Rule.Translated: También conocidos como pimientos dulces, los pimientos morrones son técnicamente solanáceas y parte de la familia capsicum, pero son el único pimiento picante que lleva un gen recesivo que impide que se produzca capsaicina en el fruto, lo que los hace no picantes.

Rule.Original: Also known as sweet peppers, bell peppers are technically nightshades and part of the capsicum family, but they are the only chili pepper that carries a recessive gene that stops any capsaicin from being made in the fruit, thus making them not spicy.
Rule.Raw: Also known as sweet peppers, bell peppers are technically nightshades and part of the capsicum family, but they are the only chili pepper that carries a recessive gene that stops any capsaicin from being made in the fruit, thus making them not spicy.
Rule.Translated: También conocidos como pimientos dulces, los pimientos morrones son técnicamente solanáceas y parte de la familia capsicum, pero son el único pimiento picante que lleva un gen recesivo que impide que se produzca capsaicina en el fruto, lo que los hace no picantes.

Rule.Original: One of the earliest cultivated legumes. Chickpeas are high in fibre and protein and are a good source of iron, phosphorus, and folic acid.
Rule.Raw: One of the earliest cultivated legumes. Chickpeas are high in fibre and protein and are a good source of iron, phosphorus, and folic acid.
Rule.Translated: Una de las leguminosas cultivadas más tempranas. Los garbanzos son ricos en fibra y proteínas, y son una buena fuente de hierro, fósforo y ácido fólico.

Rule.Original: A starchy root vegetable. It has a brown outer skin and white flesh with purple specks throughout. When cooked, it has a mildly sweet taste and a texture similar to potato.
Rule.Raw: A starchy root vegetable. It has a brown outer skin and white flesh with purple specks throughout. When cooked, it has a mildly sweet taste and a texture similar to potato.
Rule.Translated: Un vegetal de raíz almidonado. Tiene una piel exterior marrón y una pulpa blanca con motas moradas en todo. Cuando se cocina, tiene un sabor ligeramente dulce y una textura similar a la papa.

Rule.Original: A green leaf vegetable rich in vitamins and minerals and from the same family as kale and broccoli.
Rule.Raw: A green leaf vegetable rich in vitamins and minerals and from the same family as kale and broccoli.
Rule.Translated: Un vegetal de hojas verdes rico en vitaminas y minerales y de la misma familia que el kale y el brócoli.

Rule.Original: The seeds of the lotus plant. They are packed with nutritional elements which make them an excellent choice for a healthy diet, with a high content of proteins, carbohydrates, and vitamins.
Rule.Raw: The seeds of the lotus plant. They are packed with nutritional elements which make them an excellent choice for a healthy diet, with a high content of proteins, carbohydrates, and vitamins.
Rule.Translated: Las semillas de la planta de loto. Están llenas de elementos nutricionales que las convierten en una excelente opción para una dieta saludable, con un alto contenido de proteínas, carbohidratos y vitaminas.

Rule.Original: Small, rounded corms with a crisp, white flesh that may be eaten slightly boiled, or grilled.
Rule.Raw: Small, rounded corms with a crisp, white flesh that may be eaten slightly boiled, or grilled.
Rule.Translated: Cormos pequeños y redondeados con una carne blanca y crujiente que se pueden comer crudos, ligeramente hervidos o a la parrilla.

Rule.Original: A long thin vegetable with hard green skin and wet transparent flesh. Can be eaten raw.
Rule.Raw: A long thin vegetable with hard green skin and wet transparent flesh. Can be eaten raw.
Rule.Translated: Un vegetal largo y delgado con piel verde dura y pulpa húmeda y transparente. Se puede comer crudo.

Rule.Original: A vegetable with a sweet, nutty taste similar to that of a pumpkin. It has tan-yellow skin and orange fleshy pulp with a compartment of seeds in the blossom end.
Rule.Raw: A vegetable with a sweet, nutty taste similar to that of a pumpkin. It has tan-yellow skin and orange fleshy pulp with a compartment of seeds in the blossom end.
Rule.Translated: Un vegetal con un sabor dulce y a nuez similar al de una calabaza. Tiene piel amarilla claro y pulpa naranja con un compartimento de semillas en el extremo de la flor.

Rule.Original: A vegetable consisting of a long fibrous stalk tapering into leaves. The leaves are strongly flavored and are used less often, either as a flavoring in soups and stews or as a dried herb. Celery is a staple in many soups.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Celery has a very long growth period (almost a full year!). If it can be kept alive all that time, it produces greater yield than corn.
Rule.Raw: A vegetable consisting of a long fibrous stalk tapering into leaves. The leaves are strongly flavored and are used less often, either as a flavoring in soups and stews or as a dried herb. Celery is a staple in many soups.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Celery has a very long growth period (almost a full year!). If it can be kept alive all that time, it produces greater yield than corn.
Rule.Translated: Un vegetal que consiste en un largo tallo fibroso que se estrecha en hojas. Las hojas tienen un sabor fuerte y se usan menos a menudo, ya sea como saborizante en sopas y guisos o como hierba seca. El apio es un elemento básico en muchas sopas.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El apio tiene un período de crecimiento muy largo (casi un año completo). Si se puede mantener vivo durante todo ese tiempo, produce un rendimiento mayor que el maíz.

Rule.Original: A sweet tropical fruit with a tough leathery skin and spiky leaves on top. The word pineapple was first used to mean "pine cone," and the fruit was given this name because of its resemblance to a large pine cone.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Pineapples have a very long growth period, but they are very nutritive, taking up less space in stockpiles.
Rule.Raw: A sweet tropical fruit with a tough leathery skin and spiky leaves on top. The word pineapple was first used to mean "pine cone," and the fruit was given this name because of its resemblance to a large pine cone.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Pineapples have a very long growth period, but they are very nutritive, taking up less space in stockpiles.
Rule.Translated: Una fruta tropical dulce con una piel dura y coriácea y hojas espinosas en la parte superior. La palabra "piña" se usó por primera vez para significar "piña de`pino", y la fruta recibió este nombre debido a su semejanza con una piña de pino mas grande.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Las piñas tienen un período de crecimiento muy largo, pero son muy nutritivas y ocupan menos espacio en los almacenes.

Rule.Original: A leaf vegetable commonly eaten fresh and served as the base of green salads. Lettuce is generally a rich source of vitamins K and A.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Lettuce can be eaten raw like strawberries, but needs to be grown in shade: outside, but under roof. It won't grow inside.
Rule.Raw: A leaf vegetable commonly eaten fresh and served as the base of green salads. Lettuce is generally a rich source of vitamins K and A.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Lettuce can be eaten raw like strawberries, but needs to be grown in shade: outside, but under roof. It won't grow inside.
Rule.Translated: Una verdura de hoja comúnmente consumida fresca y servida como base de ensaladas verdes. La lechuga suele ser una fuente rica de vitaminas K y A.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La lechuga se puede comer cruda como las fresas, pero necesita crecer en sombra: afuera, pero bajo techo. No crecerá en el interior.

Rule.Original: A form of cabbage grown for its edible buds called "sprouts". Brussels sprouts usually are eaten cooked, and the small young sprouts have a more delicate flavour than older ones.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Contrary to other plants, brussels sprouts thrive in snow, and receive a considerable boost to growth if snowing, AS LONG AS it is also growth season (they won't grow or be able to be planted otherwise). They won't die due to cold.
Rule.Raw: A form of cabbage grown for its edible buds called "sprouts". Brussels sprouts usually are eaten cooked, and the small young sprouts have a more delicate flavour than older ones.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Contrary to other plants, brussels sprouts thrive in snow, and receive a considerable boost to growth if snowing, AS LONG AS it is also growth season (they won't grow or be able to be planted otherwise). They won't die due to cold.
Rule.Translated: Una forma de repollo cultivada por sus brotes comestibles llamados "coles de Bruselas". Las coles de Bruselas generalmente se cocinan, y los pequeños brotes jóvenes tienen un sabor más delicado que los más viejos.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> A diferencia de otras plantas, las coles de Bruselas prosperan en la nieve y reciben un impulso considerable al crecimiento si está nevando, SIEMPRE QUE también sea la temporada de crecimiento (de lo contrario, no crecerán ni podrán ser plantadas). No morirán debido al frío.

Rule.Original: A tuberous edible plant also called manioc, mandioca, or yuca. They have a mild nutty taste and are commonly eaten as root vegetables in stews or as side dishes. Cassava roots are a versatile vegetable that can be used to produce flour, breads, tapioca, a laundry starch, and an alcoholic beverage.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Cassava grows best in tropical, warm and humid climates. As such, it will receive a considerable growth bonus if the weather is foggy.
Rule.Raw: A tuberous edible plant also called manioc, mandioca, or yuca. They have a mild nutty taste and are commonly eaten as root vegetables in stews or as side dishes. Cassava roots are a versatile vegetable that can be used to produce flour, breads, tapioca, a laundry starch, and an alcoholic beverage.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Cassava grows best in tropical, warm and humid climates. As such, it will receive a considerable growth bonus if the weather is foggy.
Rule.Translated: Una planta comestible tuberosa también llamada mandioca, mandioca o yuca. Tienen un sabor suave a nuez y se comen comúnmente como vegetales de raíz en guisos o como acompañamiento. Las raíces de yuca son un vegetal versátil que se puede usar para producir harina, panes, tapioca, almidón de lavandería y una bebida alcohólica.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La yuca crece mejor en climas cálidos y húmedos tropicales. Como tal, recibirá un considerable impulso al crecimiento si el clima está nublado.

Rule.Original: A plant with large, starchy, sweet-tasting (tasting similar to pumpkin), tuberous roots that are used as a root vegetable. The sweet potato is distantly related to the common potato.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Sweet potatoes show a marked preference for rocky soils, flourishing on them. Rich soils are actually detrimental to them. They do not tolerate frost, growing best at an average temperature of 24 °C, and receiving penalties under 20ºC.
Rule.Raw: A plant with large, starchy, sweet-tasting (tasting similar to pumpkin), tuberous roots that are used as a root vegetable. The sweet potato is distantly related to the common potato.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Sweet potatoes show a marked preference for rocky soils, flourishing on them. Rich soils are actually detrimental to them. They do not tolerate frost, growing best at an average temperature of 24 °C, and receiving penalties under 20ºC.
Rule.Translated: Una planta con raíces tuberosas grandes, almidonadas y de sabor dulce (similar al de la calabaza). Las batatas se utilizan como vegetales de raíz. La batata está distante mente relacionada con la patata común.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Las batatas muestran una marcada preferencia por los suelos rocosos, prosperando en ellos. Los suelos ricos en realidad les son perjudiciales. No toleran las heladas, creciendo mejor a una temperatura promedio de 24 °C y recibiendo penalizaciones por debajo de 20 °C.

Rule.Original: An edible root vegetable that is very easy to grow and quick to harvest. Radishes are often planted by novice gardeners.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> This genetically modified radish has a very short growth period (less than 2 days). This means it is an effective crop if you need small amounts of food FAST, and the sowing and harvesting work will be the most important factor.
Rule.Raw: An edible root vegetable that is very easy to grow and quick to harvest. Radishes are often planted by novice gardeners.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> This genetically modified radish has a very short growth period (less than 2 days). This means it is an effective crop if you need small amounts of food FAST, and the sowing and harvesting work will be the most important factor.
Rule.Translated: Un vegetal de raíz comestible que es muy fácil de cultivar y rápido de cosechar. Los rábanos a menudo son plantados por jardineros novatos.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Este rábano genéticamente modificado tiene un período de crecimiento muy corto (menos de 2 días). Esto significa que es un cultivo eficaz si necesitas pequeñas cantidades de comida RÁPIDAMENTE, y el trabajo de siembra y cosecha será el factor más importante.

Rule.Original: A pseudocereal cultivated for its grain-like seeds. Its white flowers are produced in terminal clusters and after pòllination turn into triangular-shaped seeds that are enclosed by a tough dark brown or gray rind.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Buckwheat is very resistant to fire, and this variety has been modified to be completely non-flammable.
Rule.Raw: A pseudocereal cultivated for its grain-like seeds. Its white flowers are produced in terminal clusters and after pòllination turn into triangular-shaped seeds that are enclosed by a tough dark brown or gray rind.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Buckwheat is very resistant to fire, and this variety has been modified to be completely non-flammable.
Rule.Translated: Un seudocereal cultivado por sus semillas parecidas a granos. Sus flores blancas se producen en racimos terminales y después de la polinización se convierten en semillas en forma de triángulo que están encerradas por una piel dura de color marrón oscuro o gris.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El trigo sarraceno es muy resistente al fuego, y esta variedad ha sido modificada para ser completamente ignífuga.

Rule.Original: A plant that produces seeds with an oblong shape and a papery seed coat. Similar in taste and nutritional profile to tree nuts such as walnuts and almonds, but technically a legume.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> This genetically modified variety of peanuts is sown by throwing the seeds haphazardly on the growing zone, and as such the plants will automatically be planted in the adjacent tiles 75% of the time, reducing the total amount of sowing work needed. Useful!

Rule.Translated: Una planta que produce semillas de forma oblonga y tegumento parecido al papel. De sabor y perfil nutricional similares a los frutos secos como las nueces y las almendras, pero técnicamente una leguminosa.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Esta variedad de cacahuetes genéticamente modificada se siembra arrojando las semillas al azar en la zona de cultivo, y como tal, las plantas se plantarán automáticamente en los azulejos adyacentes el 75% del tiempo, reduciendo la cantidad total de trabajo de siembra necesario. ¡Útil!

Rule.Original: A large crop used for its edible oil and edible fruits. The name sunflower may derive from the flower's head's shape, which resembles the sun.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Sunflowers grow 30% faster in equatorial regions. The size of the equatorial region depends on the planet's overall temperature: below 15º for Normal, below 35º for Warm, below 65º for Hot and all the planet for Very Hot. Planets with below Normal temperature are considered to have no equator.

The size of the equatorial region depends on the planet's overall temperature: below 15º for Normal, below 35º for Warm, below 65º for Hot and all the planet for Very Hot. Planets with below Normal temperature are considered to have no equator.
Rule.Translated: Un cultivo grande utilizado por su aceite comestible y frutos comestibles. El nombre girasol puede derivar de la forma de la cabeza de la flor, que se asemeja al sol.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los girasoles crecen un 30% más rápido en regiones ecuatoriales. El tamaño de la región ecuatorial depende de la temperatura general del planeta: por debajo de 15º para Normal, por debajo de 35º para Cálido, por debajo de 65º para Caluroso y todo el planeta para Muy Caluroso. Los planetas con temperaturas inferiores a la Normal se consideran que no tienen ecuador.

Rule.Original: A flowering plant in the mallow family valued for its edible green seed pods, which are famously known for their slimy or sticky texture when cut open. Okra is a powerhouse of valuable nutrients.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Okra is very, VERY resistant to damage. Okra plants will take less damage from prolonged lack of light, and will regenerate damage caused by any other means.

Okra is a powerhouse of valuable nutrients.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Okra is very, VERY resistant to damage. Okra plants will take less damage from prolonged lack of light, and will regenerate damage caused by any other means.
Rule.Translated: Una planta con flores de la familia de las malvas valorada por sus vainas de semillas verdes comestibles, que son famosas por su textura viscosa o pegajosa cuando se abren. La okra es una fuente inagotable de valiosos nutrientes.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La okra es muy, MUY resistente al daño. Las plantas de okra sufrirán menos daño por la falta prolongada de luz y regenerarán el daño causado por cualquier otro medio.

Rule.Original: A plant with long, flat grasslike leaves forming a stalk, which rises directly from the flower bulb, the part of the plant used as food and medicine. The bulb is made up of many smaller cloves covered with a papery skin.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Garlic has very little yield, but can grow in almost any terrain and takes an obscene time to rot, as dried garlic can be used to cook too.
Rule.Raw: A plant with long, flat grasslike leaves forming a stalk, which rises directly from the flower bulb, the part of the plant used as food and medicine. The bulb is made up of many smaller cloves covered with a papery skin.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Garlic has very little yield, but can grow in almost any terrain and takes an obscene time to rot, as dried garlic can be used to cook too.
Rule.Translated: Una planta con hojas largas y planas que forman un tallo, que se eleva directamente desde el bulbo de la flor, la parte de la planta utilizada como alimento y medicina. El bulbo se compone de muchos dientes más pequeños cubiertos con una piel parecida al papel.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El ajo tiene muy poco rendimiento, pero puede crecer en casi cualquier terreno y tarda un tiempo obsceno en pudrirse, ya que el ajo seco también se puede usar para cocinar.

Rule.Original: A herbaceous plant of the Apiaceae family that produces an edible taproot. An erect rosette of doubly compound, finely divided leaves develops above ground, while the edible carrot and attached roots are below.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Companion planting: carrots will grow faster if green beans are cultivated in the same map (up to 30% faster if 100 are found).

An erect rosette of doubly compound, finely divided leaves develops above ground, while the edible carrot and attached roots are below.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Companion planting: carrots will grow faster if green beans are cultivated in the same map (up to 30% faster if 100 are found).
Rule.Translated: Una planta herbácea de la familia Apiaceae que produce una raíz pivotante comestible. Una roseta erecta de hojas doblemente compuestas y finamente divididas se desarrolla sobre el suelo, mientras que la zanahoria comestible y las raíces adheridas están debajo.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Plantación complementaria: las zanahorias crecerán más rápido si se cultivan judías verdes en el mismo mapa (hasta un 30 % más rápido si se encuentran 100).

Rule.Original: A herbaceous bush with a long history of cultivation. They are distinguished from the many other varieties of beans in that green beans are harvested and consumed with their enclosing pods, before the bean seeds inside have fully matured, similar to peas.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Companion planting: green beans will grow faster if carrots are cultivated in the same map (up to 30% faster if 100 are found).

Rule.Translated: Un arbusto herbáceo con una larga historia de cultivo. Se distinguen de las muchas otras variedades de judias en que las judias verdes se cosechan y se consumen con las vainas que los encierran, antes de que las semillas de judia en el interior hayan madurado por completo, de forma similar a los guisantes.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Plantación complementaria: los frijoles verdes crecerán más rápido si se cultivan zanahorias en el mismo mapa (hasta un 30% más rápido si se encuentran 100).

Rule.Original: One of the earliest cultivated legumes, widely grown for its nutritious seeds. These are high in fibre and protein and are a good source of iron, phosphorus, and folic acid.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Chickpeas grow quite fast and have good yield, but they require a LOT of space to be stored (this may be negated by stack-increasing mods, you dirty cheater, but it's up to you to decide to mess up the game's balance).

Rule.Translated: Una de las primeras leguminosas cultivadas, ampliamente cultivada por sus nutritivas semillas. Estos son altos en fibra y proteína y son una buena fuente de hierro, fósforo y ácido fólico.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los garbanzos crecen bastante rápido y tienen un buen rendimiento, pero requieren MUCHO espacio para ser almacenados (esto puede ser anulado por mods que aumentan el almacenamiento, serias un sucio tramposo, pero depende de ti decidir arruinar el equilibrio del juego).

Rule.Original: Also known as sweet peppers, bell peppers are technically nightshades and part of the capsicum family, but they are the only chili pepper that carries a recessive gene that stops any capsaicin from being made in the fruit, thus making them not spicy.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> On average, 25% of bell peppers will mature into yellow peppers, while 75% will mature into red peppers. The former are more nutritive. If planted in large numbers this results in increased average yield.

The former are more nutritive. If planted in large numbers this results in increased average yield.
Rule.Translated: También conocidos como pimientos dulces, los pimientos son técnicamente solanáceas y parte de la familia Capsicum, pero son los únicos pimientos picantes que llevan un gen recesivo que evita que se produzca capsaicina en la fruta, por lo que no son picantes.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> En promedio, el 25 % de los pimientos madurarán y se convertirán en pimientos amarillos, mientras que el 75 % madurarán en pimientos rojos. Los primeros son más nutritivos. Si se planta en grandes cantidades, esto da como resultado un mayor rendimiento promedio.

Rule.Original: A tropical plant grown primarily for its edible corm, a root vegetable. Taro is one of the few crops that can be grown under flooded conditions, with the base of the plant always under water. This is due to air spaces in the petiole, which permit underwater gaseous exchange with the atmosphere.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Taro is only growable in aquatic growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Taro is the baseline aquatic plant.

These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Taro is the baseline aquatic plant.
Rule.Translated: Una planta tropical cultivada principalmente por su bulbo comestible, un tubérculo. El taro es uno de los pocos cultivos que se puede cultivar en condiciones de inundación, con la base de la planta siempre bajo el agua. Esto se debe a los espacios de aire en el pecíolo, que permiten el intercambio gaseoso bajo el agua con la atmósfera.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El taro solo se puede cultivar en zonas de cultivo acuático, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se usa. Taro es la planta acuática de referencia.

Rule.Original: Watercress is a rapidly growing, perennial plant. It is one of the oldest known leaf vegetables consumed by humans. Watercress and many of its relatives are noteworthy for their piquant flavors.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Watercress is only growable in aquatic growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Watercress grows faster than taro but needs a lot of space, blocking sowing in adjacent spaces.

Watercress and many of its relatives are noteworthy for their piquant flavors.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Watercress is only growable in aquatic growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Watercress grows faster than taro but needs a lot of space, blocking sowing in adjacent spaces.
Rule.Translated: El berro es una planta perenne de rápido crecimiento. Es uno de los vegetales de hoja más antiguos conocidos consumidos por humanos. Los berros y muchos de sus parientes son notables por sus sabores picantes.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El berro solo se puede cultivar en zonas de cultivo acuático, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se usa. El berro crece más rápido que el taro pero necesita mucho espacio, lo que bloquea la siembra en espacios adyacentes.

Rule.Original: Sometimes colloquially called a water lily, lotus plants are adapted to grow in the flood plains of slow-moving rivers and delta areas. Lotus rhizomes have a crunchy texture with sweet-tangy flavours and can be deep-fried, stir-fried, or stuffed with meats or preserved fruits.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Lotus is only growable in aquatic growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Lotus takes a long time to grow.

Rule.Translated: A veces llamado coloquialmente lirio de agua, las plantas de loto están adaptadas para crecer en las llanuras aluviales de ríos lentos y áreas del delta. Los rizomas de loto tienen una textura crujiente con sabores agridulces y se pueden freír, saltear o rellenar con carnes o frutas en conserva.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El loto solo se puede cultivar en zonas de cultivo acuático, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se utiliza. El loto tarda mucho tiempo en crecer.

Rule.Original: An aquatic vegetable that grows in marshes, under water, in the mud. It has stem-like, tubular green leaves, and small, rounded corms with a crisp, white flesh that may be eaten raw, slightly boiled, or grilled.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Water chestnut is only growable in aquatic growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Water chestnut grows 30% faster in the heat (37-60ºC).

These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Water chestnut grows 30% faster in the heat (37-60ºC).
Rule.Translated: Vegetal acuático que crece en los pantanos, bajo el agua, en el lodo. Tiene hojas verdes tubulares en forma de tallo y bulbos pequeños y redondeados con una pulpa blanca y crujiente que se puede comer cruda, ligeramente hervida o a la parrilla.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La castaña de agua solo se puede cultivar en zonas de cultivo acuático, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se usa. La castaña de agua crece un 30% más rápido con el calor (37-60ºC).

Rule.Original: A plant producing a sweet, edible, and fleshy fruit of considerable size. Melons are usually cultivated in warm regions.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Melons are only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Melons need a lot of space, blocking sowing in adjacent spaces, but harvesting them can't fail

Rule.Translated: Una planta que produce una fruta dulce, comestible y carnosa de tamaño considerable. Los melones se suelen cultivar en regiones cálidas.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los melones solo se pueden cultivar en zonas de cultivo arenosas, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se usa. Los melones necesitan mucho espacio, bloqueando la siembra en espacios adyacentes, pero la cosecha no puede fallar

Rule.Original: A sprawling vine with large leaves and curling tendrils, triangular prickly hairy leaves and yellow flowers. Produces a fruit that is a long thin vegetable with hard green skin and wet transparent flesh. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Cucumbers are only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Cucumbers grow quite fast, providing little yield but in a short period. They can be eaten raw.

Rule.Translated: Una enredadera en expansión con hojas grandes y zarcillos rizados, hojas triangulares espinosas y peludas y flores amarillas. Produce una fruta que es una verdura larga y delgada con piel verde dura y pulpa húmeda y transparente. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los pepinos solo se pueden cultivar en zonas de cultivo arenosas, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se usa. Los pepinos crecen bastante rápido, proporcionando poca producción pero en un período corto. Se pueden comer crudos.

Rule.Original: A vine plant that produces a vegetable with a sweet, nutty taste similar to that of a pumpkin. It has tan-yellow skin and orange fleshy pulp with a compartment of seeds in the blossom end.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Butternut squash is only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Butternut squash takes a long time to grow.

These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Butternut squash takes a long time to grow.
Rule.Translated: Una planta de vid que produce un vegetal con un sabor dulce a nuez similar al de una calabaza. Tiene piel de color amarillo tostado y pulpa carnosa de color naranja con un compartimento de semillas en el extremo de la flor.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La calabaza moscada solo se puede cultivar en zonas de cultivo arenosas, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se utiliza. La calabaza moscada tarda mucho en crecer.

Rule.Original: A herb with succulent leaves that are arranged in a rosette. The leaves are grey to green and sometimes have white spots on their surfaces. They have sharp, pinkish spines along their edges and are the source of a colourless gel that is used in many medicinal products.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Aloe vera is only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Aloe vera is a source of herbal medicine.
