Rule.Translated: Una hierba con hojas suculentas dispuestas en roseta. Las hojas son de color gris a verde y, a veces, tienen manchas blancas en la superficie. Tienen espinas afiladas y rosadas a lo largo de sus bordes y son la fuente de un gel incoloro que se usa en muchos productos medicinales.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El aloe vera solo se puede cultivar en zonas de cultivo arenosas, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio que normalmente no se utiliza. El aloe vera es una fuente de medicina herbal.

Rule.Original: A bright-yellow flowering variety of the rapeseed, cultivated mainly for its oil-rich seed.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Canola, though not directly edible, can be very efficiently converted into chemfuel at a refinery.
Rule.Raw: A bright-yellow flowering variety of the rapeseed, cultivated mainly for its oil-rich seed.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Canola, though not directly edible, can be very efficiently converted into chemfuel at a refinery.
Rule.Translated: Una variedad de rapeseed de flores amarillas brillantes, cultivada principalmente por sus semillas ricas en aceite.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La canola, aunque no es directamente comestible, puede ser convertida de manera muy eficiente en combustible químico en una refinería.

Rule.Original: A fragrant, purple-flowered plant known for its calming scent and ornamental beauty.
Rule.Raw: A fragrant, purple-flowered plant known for its calming scent and ornamental beauty.
Rule.Translated: Una planta fragante de flores moradas, conocida por su aroma calmante y su belleza ornamental.

Rule.Original: A unique rose variety cultivated for its intense, captivating scent, perfect for making perfumes and other aromatic products.
Rule.Raw: A unique rose variety cultivated for its intense, captivating scent, perfect for making perfumes and other aromatic products.
Rule.Translated: Una variedad de rosa cultivada por su aroma intenso y cautivador, perfecta para elaborar perfumes y otros productos aromáticos.

Rule.Original: A vibrant, sweet-smelling flower with a fresh, green fragrance that adds depth to gardens and perfumes alike.
Rule.Raw: A vibrant, sweet-smelling flower with a fresh, green fragrance that adds depth to gardens and perfumes alike.
Rule.Translated: Una flor vistosa y de aroma dulce, con una fragancia fresca y verde que aporta profundidad tanto a jardines como a perfumes.

Rule.Original: A vibrant, sweet-smelling flower with a fresh, green fragrance that adds depth to gardens and perfumes alike.
Rule.Raw: A vibrant, sweet-smelling flower with a fresh, green fragrance that adds depth to gardens and perfumes alike.
Rule.Translated: Una flor vistosa y de aroma dulce, con una fragancia fresca y verde que aporta profundidad tanto a jardines como a perfumes.

Rule.Original: A striking flower with a rich, sweet, and sometimes spicy fragrance that fills any space with elegance.
Rule.Raw: A striking flower with a rich, sweet, and sometimes spicy fragrance that fills any space with elegance.
Rule.Translated: Una flor llamativa con una fragancia intensa, dulce y a veces especiada que llena cualquier espacio de elegancia.

Rule.Original: A delicate and exotic bloom with a subtle, sweet scent that varies by species, often used in sophisticated perfumes.
Rule.Raw: A delicate and exotic bloom with a subtle, sweet scent that varies by species, often used in sophisticated perfumes.
Rule.Translated: Una flor delicada y exótica de aroma sutil y dulce que varía según la especie, usada a menudo en perfumes sofisticados.

Rule.Original: A tropical flower with a fruity, sweet, and creamy fragrance, perfect for creating a lush, warm atmosphere.
Rule.Raw: A tropical flower with a fruity, sweet, and creamy fragrance, perfect for creating a lush, warm atmosphere.
Rule.Translated: Una flor tropical de fragancia afrutada, dulce y cremosa, perfecta para crear un ambiente exuberante y cálido.

Rule.Original: A beautiful but mild-scented flower known more for its vibrant colors than its fragrance.
Rule.Raw: A beautiful but mild-scented flower known more for its vibrant colors than its fragrance.
Rule.Translated: Una flor hermosa de aroma suave, conocida más por sus colores vivos que por su fragancia.

Rule.Original: Delicate, creamy-white flowers with a light, sweet fragrance. While the flowers are beautiful, it’s the pods they produce that are prized for their warm, rich scent. We put some vanilla in your Vanilla Expanded so you can expand vanilla while you vanilla your expansion.
Rule.Raw: Delicate, creamy-white flowers with a light, sweet fragrance. While the flowers are beautiful, it’s the pods they produce that are prized for their warm, rich scent. We put some vanilla in your Vanilla Expanded so you can expand vanilla while you vanilla your expansion.
Rule.Translated: Delicadas flores de color blanco cremoso con una fragancia suave y dulce. Aunque las flores son hermosas, lo más apreciado son las vainas que producen, por su aroma cálido e intenso. Le hemos puesto vainilla a tu Vanilla Expanded para que amplíes la vainilla mientras llenas de vainilla tu expansión.

Rule.Original: A soft, powdery, and sweet-smelling flower, often used to add a gentle floral note to perfumes.
Rule.Raw: A soft, powdery, and sweet-smelling flower, often used to add a gentle floral note to perfumes.
Rule.Translated: Una flor de aroma suave, empolvado y dulce, usada a menudo para dar un delicado toque floral a los perfumes.

Rule.Original: A highly fragrant, sweet, and rich flower, prized for its use in exotic and sensual perfumes.
Rule.Raw: A highly fragrant, sweet, and rich flower, prized for its use in exotic and sensual perfumes.
Rule.Translated: Una flor muy fragante, dulce e intensa, apreciada por su uso en perfumes exóticos y sensuales.

Rule.Original: An evergreen tree with thick, leathery leaves that produces perfect white, ivory to yellow flowers. The fruit has a large seed or pit in the center and may be green or nearly black.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Avocado trees take a notoriously long period to mature and produce their fruits. If they can be kept alive all that time, they produce greater yield than other fruit trees. Plus if you install the Coffees and Teas mod and pair them with Pumpkin Spice Coffee you can have your dream RimWorld Hipster experience!
Rule.Raw: An evergreen tree with thick, leathery leaves that produces perfect white, ivory to yellow flowers. The fruit has a large seed or pit in the center and may be green or nearly black.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Avocado trees take a notoriously long period to mature and produce their fruits. If they can be kept alive all that time, they produce greater yield than other fruit trees. Plus if you install the Coffees and Teas mod and pair them with Pumpkin Spice Coffee you can have your dream RimWorld Hipster experience!
Rule.Translated: Un árbol perenne con hojas gruesas y coriáceas que produce flores perfectas de color blanco, marfil a amarillo. El fruto tiene una gran semilla o hueso en el centro y puede ser verde o casi negro.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los árboles de aguacate tardan notoriamente mucho tiempo en madurar y producir sus frutos. Si se pueden mantener vivos todo ese tiempo, producen un rendimiento mayor que otros árboles frutales. Además, si instalas el mod de Cafés y Tés y los combinas con el Pumpkin Spice Coffee, ¡puedes tener tu experiencia de mundo de RimWorld de hipster soñado!

Rule.Original: A subtropical broad-leaved evergreen tree. Its leaves, leathery and lance-shaped, are dark green above and silvery on the underside and are paired opposite each other on the twig. The wood is resistant to decay. If the top dies back, a new trunk will often arise from the roots.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Interestingly, olive trees show a marked preference for rocky soils, flourishing on them. Rich soils are actually detrimental to them. They will also live for a very, very long time, far longer than other produce trees. Contrary to other tree produce, olives can't be eaten raw.
Rule.Raw: A subtropical broad-leaved evergreen tree. Its leaves, leathery and lance-shaped, are dark green above and silvery on the underside and are paired opposite each other on the twig. The wood is resistant to decay. If the top dies back, a new trunk will often arise from the roots.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Interestingly, olive trees show a marked preference for rocky soils, flourishing on them. Rich soils are actually detrimental to them. They will also live for a very, very long time, far longer than other produce trees. Contrary to other tree produce, olives can't be eaten raw.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol subtropical de hojas perennes de hojas anchas. Sus hojas, coriáceas y en forma de lanza, son de color verde oscuro en la parte superior y plateadas en el reverso, y están dispuestas en pares opuestos en la ramita. La madera es resistente a la descomposición. Si la parte superior muere, a menudo surgirá un nuevo tronco de las raíces.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Curiosamente, los olivos muestran una marcada preferencia por los suelos rocosos, prosperando en ellos. Los suelos ricos en realidad les son perjudiciales. También vivirán durante mucho, mucho tiempo, mucho más que otros árboles frutales. A diferencia de otros árboles productores, las aceitunas no se pueden comer crudas.

Rule.Original:
A palm tree cultivated extensively in tropical areas for its edible fruit, the coconut. Coconut palms flourish best close to the sea on low-lying areas a few feet above high water.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Coconut palms are only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space.

Coconut palms receive a growth bonus if sea water tiles are found in a 6 tile radius. Coconuts can be used as fruits or processed into milk.
Rule.Raw:
A palm tree cultivated extensively in tropical areas for its edible fruit, the coconut. Coconut palms flourish best close to the sea on low-lying areas a few feet above high water.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Coconut palms are only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space.

Coconut palms receive a growth bonus if sea water tiles are found in a 6 tile radius. Coconuts can be used as fruits or processed into milk.
Rule.Translated:
Una palmera cultivada extensivamente en áreas tropicales por su fruto comestible, el coco. Las palmeras prosperan mejor cerca del mar en áreas bajas a pocos pies sobre el nivel del agua alta.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos regulares, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producir frutas que se pueden comer crudas. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada y eventualmente deberán ser replantados.

Las palmeras solo se pueden cultivar en zonas de cultivo arenosas, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sin embargo, estas plantas tardarán mucho tiempo en sembrarse y cosecharse, básicamente intercambiando el trabajo de los colonos por el cultivo de plantas en un espacio normalmente no utilizado.

Las palmeras reciben un bono de crecimiento si se encuentran casillas de agua de mar en un radio de 6 casillas. Los cocos se pueden usar como frutas o procesarse en leche."

Rule.Original:
A deciduous tree cultivated for its fruit, almonds. The sweet almond can be eaten plain or be used as ingredient in desserts and confectioneries. The trees are strikingly beautiful when in flower; they produce fragrant, five-petaled, light pink to white flowers.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Almond trees are beautiful, but they require water to be present in a 6 tile radius to grow properly. Almonds can be used as fruits or processed into milk.
Rule.Raw:
A deciduous tree cultivated for its fruit, almonds. The sweet almond can be eaten plain or be used as ingredient in desserts and confectioneries. The trees are strikingly beautiful when in flower; they produce fragrant, five-petaled, light pink to white flowers.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Almond trees are beautiful, but they require water to be present in a 6 tile radius to grow properly. Almonds can be used as fruits or processed into milk.
Rule.Translated:
Un árbol caducifolio cultivado por su fruto, las almendras. La almendra dulce se puede comer sola o utilizarse como ingrediente en postres y confiterías. Los árboles son sorprendentemente hermosos cuando están en flor; producen flores fragantes de cinco pétalos, de color rosa claro a blanco.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos regulares, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producir frutas que se pueden comer crudas. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada y eventualmente deberán ser replantados.

Los almendros son hermosos, pero requieren que el agua esté presente en un radio de 6 casillas para crecer adecuadamente. Las almendras se pueden usar como frutas o procesarse en leche.

Rule.Original:
A tropical evergreen tree that produces oval fruits, vividly coloured with shades of red and yellow. The single large seed is flattened, and the flesh that surrounds it is yellow to orange in colour, juicy, and of distinctive sweet-spicy flavour.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Mango trees have very good yield, but mangoes cannot be frozen or they get destroyed. The game won't be smart enough to detect this, so disable them from freezers.
Rule.Raw:
A tropical evergreen tree that produces oval fruits, vividly coloured with shades of red and yellow. The single large seed is flattened, and the flesh that surrounds it is yellow to orange in colour, juicy, and of distinctive sweet-spicy flavour.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Mango trees have very good yield, but mangoes cannot be frozen or they get destroyed. The game won't be smart enough to detect this, so disable them from freezers.
Rule.Translated:
Un árbol hoja perenne tropical que produce frutos ovales, de colores vivos en tonos de rojo y amarillo. La única semilla grande está aplanada, y la pulpa que la rodea es de color amarillo a naranja, jugosa y de un distintivo sabor dulce y picante.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Todos los árboles frutales ocupan aproximadamente cuatro veces más espacio que los cultivos regulares, tardan mucho tiempo en crecer y producir frutas que se pueden comer crudas. No se destruyen después de la cosecha, pero tienen una vida útil limitada y eventualmente deberán ser replantados.

Los árboles de mangos tienen un rendimiento muy bueno, pero los mangos no pueden ser congelados o se destruirán. El juego no será lo suficientemente inteligente para detectarlo, así que desactívalos en los congeladores.

Rule.Original: Spacer technology allows you to teleport any item you need for crafting, without need of hauling things manually.
Rule.Raw: Spacer technology allows you to teleport any item you need for crafting, without need of hauling things manually.
Rule.Translated: La tecnología espacial permite teletransportar cualquier objeto necesario para fabricar, sin tener que transportarlo manualmente.

Rule.Original: Steel pipes designed to transport usable chemfuel from deepchem refineries to chemfuel tanks for storage or to chemfuel-consuming structures for automatic refilling.
Rule.Raw: Steel pipes designed to transport usable chemfuel from deepchem refineries to chemfuel tanks for storage or to chemfuel-consuming structures for automatic refilling.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías de acero diseñadas para transportar el biocombustible utilizable desde las refinerías de geocombustible hacia los tanques de biocombustible para su almacenamiento, o hacia las construcciones que lo consumen para reabastecerlas de forma automática.

Rule.Original: Hidden steel pipes designed to transport usable chemfuel from deepchem refineries to chemfuel tanks for storage or to chemfuel-consuming structures for automatic refilling.
Rule.Raw: Hidden steel pipes designed to transport usable chemfuel from deepchem refineries to chemfuel tanks for storage or to chemfuel-consuming structures for automatic refilling.
Rule.Translated: Tuberías de acero subterráneas diseñadas para transportar el biocombustible utilizable desde las refinerías de geocombustible hacia los tanques de biocombustible para almacenarlo o hacia las construcciones que lo consumen para reabastecerlas de forma automática.
Permite activar o desactivar el flujo de biocombustible.

Rule.Original: An industrial liquid storage tank meant for storing chemfuel delivered via chemfuel pipe network. Tanks can be designated to be siphoned for usable chemfuel as needed. If damaged even lightly the escaping fumes will very swiftly create a gaseous fireball, the size of the resulting explosion will depend on the amount stored within.
Rule.Raw: An industrial liquid storage tank meant for storing chemfuel delivered via chemfuel pipe network. Tanks can be designated to be siphoned for usable chemfuel as needed. If damaged even lightly the escaping fumes will very swiftly create a gaseous fireball, the size of the resulting explosion will depend on the amount stored within.
Rule.Translated: Un depósito industrial de almacenamiento de líquidos que permite almacenar el biocombustible suministrado a través de una red de tuberías de biocombustible. Los tanques pueden ser designados para extraer bidones de biocombustible utilizable cuando sea necesario. Si se daña, aunque sea levemente, los vapores que escapan crearán rápidamente una bola de fuego gaseosa; el tamaño de la explosión resultante dependerá de la cantidad de fluido almacenada en su interior.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed chemfuel from tanks periodically for use later.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed chemfuel from tanks periodically for use later.
Rule.Translated: Una bandeja con forma de tolva que proporciona de forma periódica bidones de biocombustible procedente de los tanques para su uso posterior.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input chemfuel into the network, filling up connected tanks.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input chemfuel into the network, filling up connected tanks.
Rule.Translated: Una bandeja con forma de tolva que permite introducir biocombustible en la red y llenar los tanques conectados.

Rule.Original: Heavy steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as deepchem from pumpjacks to refineries or deepchem tanks for storage.
Rule.Raw: Heavy steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as deepchem from pumpjacks to refineries or deepchem tanks for storage.
Rule.Translated: Unas pesadas tuberías de acero que permiten transportar un líquido fangoso conocido como geocombustible desde las estaciones de bombeo hacia las refinerías para su transformación, o hacia los tanques de geocombustible para su almacenamiento.

Rule.Original: Hidden heavy steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as deepchem from pumpjacks to refineries or deepchem tanks for storage.
Rule.Raw: Hidden heavy steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as deepchem from pumpjacks to refineries or deepchem tanks for storage.
Rule.Translated: Unas pesadas tuberías de acero subterráneas que permiten transportar un líquido fangoso conocido como geocombustible desde las estaciones de bombeo hacia las refinerías para su transformación, o hacia los tanques de geocombustible para su almacenamiento.
Permite activar o desactivar el flujo de geocombustible.

Rule.Original: A heavy industrial sludge storage tank meant for storing deepchem delivered via deepchem pipe network. Tanks can be designated to be siphoned as needed. If damaged even lightly the escaping fumes will very swiftly create a gaseous fireball, the size of the resulting explosion will depend on the amount stored within.
Rule.Raw: A heavy industrial sludge storage tank meant for storing deepchem delivered via deepchem pipe network. Tanks can be designated to be siphoned as needed. If damaged even lightly the escaping fumes will very swiftly create a gaseous fireball, the size of the resulting explosion will depend on the amount stored within.
Rule.Translated: Un depósito industrial de almacenamiento de lodos que permite almacenar el geocombustible suministrado a través de una red de tuberías de geocombustible. Los tanques pueden ser designados para extraer bidones de geocombustible según sea necesario. Si se daña, aunque sea levemente, los vapores que escapan crearán rápidamente una bola de fuego gaseosa; el tamaño de la explosión resultante dependerá de la cantidad de fluido almacenada en su interior.

Rule.Original: A complex machine capable of refining deepchem delivered via deepchem pipes into usable liquid chemfuel. If no output is detected fuel will automatically be dispensed into cans. If output is connected to a tank or tap via chemfuel pipes the finished product will be transported as such for storage or dispensing.
Rule.Raw: A complex machine capable of refining deepchem delivered via deepchem pipes into usable liquid chemfuel. If no output is detected fuel will automatically be dispensed into cans. If output is connected to a tank or tap via chemfuel pipes the finished product will be transported as such for storage or dispensing.
Rule.Translated: Una compleja maquinaria capaz de refinar el geocombustible suministrado a través de la red de tuberías de geocombustible y convertirlo en biocombustible líquido utilizable. Si no se detecta salida, el combustible se dispensará automáticamente en forma de recipientes. Si la salida está conectada a un tanque o dispensador mediante tuberías de biocombustible, el producto se transportará automáticamente para su almacenamiento o dispensación.

Rule.Original: A deep-crust drilling rig for extracting deepchem from deep under the surface. Use a ground penetrating scanner to detect deposits. Deepchem can then be further refined into usable chemfuel. Can be repositioned freely.
Rule.Raw: A deep-crust drilling rig for extracting deepchem from deep under the surface. Use a ground penetrating scanner to detect deposits. Deepchem can then be further refined into usable chemfuel. Can be repositioned freely.
Rule.Translated: Una plataforma de perforación profunda que permite extraer geocombustible de debajo de la superficie. Utiliza un escáner de profundidad para detectar los depósitos. El geocombustible se puede refinar para obtener biocombustible. Puede reubicarse fácilmente.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed deepchem from tanks periodically for use later.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed deepchem from tanks periodically for use later.
Rule.Translated: Una bandeja con forma de tolva que proporciona de forma periódica bidones de geocombustible procedente de los tanques para su uso posterior.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input deepchem into the network, filling up connected tanks.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input deepchem into the network, filling up connected tanks.
Rule.Translated: Una bandeja con forma de tolva que permite introducir geocombustible en la red y llenar los tanques conectados.
fabricar biocombustible a partir de geocombustible

Rule.Original: Make a batch of chemfuel by refining deepchem.
Rule.Raw: Make a batch of chemfuel by refining deepchem.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica un lote de biocombustible refinando geocombustible.
Fabricar de biocombustible a partir de geocombustible.

Rule.Original: A volatile liquid chemical sludge, extracted from deep underground pockets. It’s too thick to be used to fuel engines and rockets, or to transmute into propellant for projectiles, but it can be refined down into standard chemfuel.
Rule.Raw: A volatile liquid chemical sludge, extracted from deep underground pockets. It’s too thick to be used to fuel engines and rockets, or to transmute into propellant for projectiles, but it can be refined down into standard chemfuel.
Rule.Translated: Un lodo químico muy volátil que se obtiene de profundas bolsas subterráneas. Es demasiado espeso, por lo que no puede ser utilizado como combustible de motores y cohetes o como explosivo en proyectiles, pero puede ser refinado para convertirlo en biocombustible estándar.

Rule.Original: Shoots a deadly plasma bolt, briefly stuns enemies that are hit.
Rule.Raw: Shoots a deadly plasma bolt, briefly stuns enemies that are hit.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un proyectil de plasma mortal que aturde brevemente a los enemigos alcanzados.

Rule.Original: Shoots an explosive fire bolt, setting enemies on fire upon contact.
Rule.Raw: Shoots an explosive fire bolt, setting enemies on fire upon contact.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un proyectil de fuego explosivo que incendia a los enemigos al impactar.

Rule.Original: Shoots 3 dangerous spikes from its tail.
Rule.Raw: Shoots 3 dangerous spikes from its tail.
Rule.Translated: Dispara 3 peligrosas púas desde la cola.

Rule.Original: Shoots lightning to a selected area, sets enemies on fire, and triggers EMP.
Rule.Raw: Shoots lightning to a selected area, sets enemies on fire, and triggers EMP.
Rule.Translated: Lanza un rayo sobre una zona seleccionada, incendia a los enemigos y provoca un EMP.

Rule.Original: Classic fire breath, sets enemies hit on fire.
Rule.Raw: Classic fire breath, sets enemies hit on fire.
Rule.Translated: Un aliento de fuego clásico que incendia a los enemigos alcanzados.

Rule.Original: Uses a unique fire, which is both yellow and purple. Sets enemies on fire
Rule.Raw: Uses a unique fire, which is both yellow and purple. Sets enemies on fire
Rule.Translated: Usa un fuego único de color amarillo y morado. Incendia a los enemigos

Rule.Original: Shoots acid towards enemies. All enemies hit will recieve acid burns for a while, causing extreme pain.
Rule.Raw: Shoots acid towards enemies. All enemies hit will recieve acid burns for a while, causing extreme pain.
Rule.Translated: Escupe ácido hacia los enemigos. Los alcanzados sufrirán quemaduras de ácido durante un tiempo, con dolor extremo.

Rule.Original: 1 Head shoots gas, the other head lights it. Causes a explosion in an area.
Rule.Raw: 1 Head shoots gas, the other head lights it. Causes a explosion in an area.
Rule.Translated: 1 cabeza escupe gas y la otra lo prende. Provoca una explosión en una zona.

Rule.Original: Releases a sonic wave around the dragon, hits anything within range, dealing damage.
Rule.Raw: Releases a sonic wave around the dragon, hits anything within range, dealing damage.
Rule.Translated: Libera una onda sónica alrededor del dragón que alcanza y daña todo lo que haya dentro de su radio.

Rule.Original: Creates a blue mist around the dragon, hitting ranged attacks is nearly impossible in the mist. Also makes anything inside invissible to turrets.
Rule.Raw: Creates a blue mist around the dragon, hitting ranged attacks is nearly impossible in the mist. Also makes anything inside invissible to turrets.
Rule.Translated: Crea una niebla azul alrededor del dragón. Acertar ataques a distancia dentro de ella es casi imposible. También vuelve invisible para las torretas todo lo que se encuentre en su interior.

Rule.Original: Enters stealth mode, making ranged attacks very unlikely to hit.
Rule.Raw: Enters stealth mode, making ranged attacks very unlikely to hit.
Rule.Translated: Entra en modo sigiloso, haciendo muy improbable que los ataques a distancia acierten.

Rule.Original: Spits thick amber-like substance at its prey which forms a cocoon upon hit, locking and stunning it for a while.
Rule.Raw: Spits thick amber-like substance at its prey which forms a cocoon upon hit, locking and stunning it for a while.
Rule.Translated: Escupe sobre su presa una sustancia espesa parecida al ámbar que forma un capullo al impactar, inmovilizándola y aturdiéndola durante un tiempo.

Rule.Original: Shoots an explosive fireball at its opponent.
Rule.Raw: Shoots an explosive fireball at its opponent.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una bola de fuego explosiva contra su oponente.

Rule.Original: Combines it's 3 tails into some sort of mace, and smacks the target.
Rule.Raw: Combines it's 3 tails into some sort of mace, and smacks the target.
Rule.Translated: Combina sus 3 colas para formar una especie de maza y golpear al objetivo.

Rule.Original: Sets itself on fire, burning anyone trying to melee it.
Rule.Raw: Sets itself on fire, burning anyone trying to melee it.
Rule.Translated: Se prende fuego y quema a cualquiera que intente atacarlo cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Shoots an explosive fire bolt, setting enemies on fire upon contact.
Rule.Raw: Shoots an explosive fire bolt, setting enemies on fire upon contact.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un proyectil de fuego explosivo que incendia a los enemigos al impactar.

Rule.Original: A flame projectile which sets anyone it hits on fire.
Rule.Raw: A flame projectile which sets anyone it hits on fire.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil de llamas que incendia a todo aquel al que alcanza.

Rule.Original: Fly between 2 areas without a roof.
Rule.Raw: Fly between 2 areas without a roof.

Rule.Translated: {0} ha muerto por un ataque de púas.
{0} ha muerto por heridas de arma blanca.
{0} ha sido aplastado hasta la muerte.

Rule.Original: A thick gas is covering the area, making it harder to see.
Rule.Raw: A thick gas is covering the area, making it harder to see.
Rule.Translated: Un gas espeso cubre la zona y dificulta la visión.

Rule.Original: This creature has been enveloped by a protective layer of flames. They won't be harmed by those flames, however anyone who attempts to attack them in melee range will be set on fire.
Rule.Raw: This creature has been enveloped by a protective layer of flames. They won't be harmed by those flames, however anyone who attempts to attack them in melee range will be set on fire.
Rule.Translated: Esta criatura está envuelta en una capa protectora de llamas. No le causan daño, pero cualquiera que intente atacarla cuerpo a cuerpo arderá.

Rule.Original: This creature has been blinded by sand. The sand is in their eyes, obstructing their sensors, or messing with their other sight organs.
Rule.Raw: This creature has been blinded by sand. The sand is in their eyes, obstructing their sensors, or messing with their other sight organs.
Rule.Translated: La arena ha cegado a esta criatura. Se le ha metido en los ojos, ha obstruido sus sensores o está alterando sus otros órganos de visión.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial animal wing. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic and effective flight. It is better than a biological wing in almost every way. Fits all animals.
Rule.Raw: An advanced artificial animal wing. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic and effective flight. It is better than a biological wing in almost every way. Fits all animals.
Rule.Translated: Un ala artificial avanzada para animales. Tiene fibras musculares sintéticas que permiten un vuelo realista y eficaz. Es mejor que un ala biológica en casi todos los aspectos. Compatible con todos los animales.

Rule.Original: {0}'s rage has come to an end.
Rule.Raw: {0}'s rage has come to an end.
Rule.Translated: La furia de {0} ha llegado a su fin.

Rule.Original: caravan ambushed by dragons quest weight: {0}
Rule.Raw: caravan ambushed by dragons quest weight: {0}
Rule.Translated: peso de las misiones de caravanas emboscadas por dragones: {0}

Rule.Original: intro->We've detected a nearby caravan from [siteFaction_name] that has been [threatAlt] by [dragonWithArticleAndCount].
Rule.Raw: intro->We've detected a nearby caravan from [siteFaction_name] that has been [threatAlt] by [dragonWithArticleAndCount].
Rule.Translated: intro->Hemos detectado una caravana cercana de [siteFaction_name] que ha sido [threatAlt] por [dragonWithArticleAndCount].

Rule.Original: intro->A caravan nearby owned by [siteFaction_name] is currently [threatAlt] by [dragonWithArticleAndCount].
Rule.Raw: intro->A caravan nearby owned by [siteFaction_name] is currently [threatAlt] by [dragonWithArticleAndCount].
Rule.Translated: intro->Una caravana cercana de [siteFaction_name] está siendo [threatAlt] por [dragonWithArticleAndCount].

Rule.Original: reward(isHostileToPlayer==true)->We may help the caravan, or we may decide to wait and scavenge the bodies if they lose. If we decide to help them, they may be thankful for it. If the caravan survives it may be willing to trade with us. We may also decide to attack them, however this will anger their faction.
Rule.Raw: reward(isHostileToPlayer==true)->We may help the caravan, or we may decide to wait and scavenge the bodies if they lose. If we decide to help them, they may be thankful for it. If the caravan survives it may be willing to trade with us. We may also decide to attack them, however this will anger their faction.
Rule.Translated: reward(isHostileToPlayer==true)->Podemos ayudar a la caravana o esperar para saquear los cadáveres si pierde. Si decidimos ayudarla, quizá nos lo agradezca. Si sobrevive, podría estar dispuesta a comerciar con nosotros. También podemos atacarla, aunque eso enfadará a su facción.

Rule.Original: reward(isHostileToPlayer==false)->We may wait for the the caravan and dragons to fight each other, and if we defeat the victorious group we'll be able to scavenge the bodies.
Rule.Raw: reward(isHostileToPlayer==false)->We may wait for the the caravan and dragons to fight each other, and if we defeat the victorious group we'll be able to scavenge the bodies.
Rule.Translated: reward(isHostileToPlayer==false)->Podemos esperar a que la caravana y los dragones luchen entre sí. Si derrotamos al grupo vencedor, podremos saquear los cadáveres.

Rule.Original: The caravan dealt with the dragons and moved on. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The caravan dealt with the dragons and moved on. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: La caravana se ha librado de los dragones y ha continuado su camino. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: The dragons destroyed the caravan. Anything of value from the caravan was destroyed and the dragons moved on. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The dragons destroyed the caravan. Anything of value from the caravan was destroyed and the dragons moved on. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones han destruido la caravana. Todo lo que tenía valor se ha perdido y los dragones se han marchado. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: Both dragons and caravan suffered heavy loses and ended up retreating, leaving nothing of value behind. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: Both dragons and caravan suffered heavy loses and ended up retreating, leaving nothing of value behind. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Tanto los dragones como la caravana han sufrido muchas bajas y han acabado retirándose, sin dejar nada de valor. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.
peso del evento de encuentro con dragones: {0}

Rule.Original: intro->We've heard rumours of [nearby] (*Threat)[kindLabel](/Threat). From what we could gather, they seem to be passive. (*Threat)There's a chance those rumours are incorrect and that they'll end up being aggressive.(/Threat)
Rule.Raw: intro->We've heard rumours of [nearby] (*Threat)[kindLabel](/Threat). From what we could gather, they seem to be passive. (*Threat)There's a chance those rumours are incorrect and that they'll end up being aggressive.(/Threat)
Rule.Translated: intro->Hemos oído rumores sobre [nearby] (*Threat)[kindLabel](/Threat). Por lo que hemos podido averiguar, parece que son pacíficos. (*Threat)Cabe la posibilidad de que esos rumores sean erróneos y resulten ser agresivos.(/Threat)

[asker_pronoun] told us that they are passive and won't mind our pressence there, unless provoked. (*Threat)There's a chance [asker_pronoun] may incorrect and that they'll end up being aggressive.(/Threat)

[asker_pronoun] told us that they are passive and won't mind our pressence there, unless provoked. Según [asker_pronoun], son pacíficos y no les molestará nuestra presencia si no los provocamos. (*Threat)Cabe la posibilidad de que [asker_pronoun] se equivoque y resulten ser agresivos.(/Threat)

Rule.Original: reward->There's no reward of any kind. We may still choose to go there to attempt to tame or hunt them.
Rule.Raw: reward->There's no reward of any kind. We may still choose to go there to attempt to tame or hunt them.
Rule.Translated: reward->No hay recompensa de ningún tipo. Aun así, podemos ir para intentar domesticarlos o cazarlos.

Rule.Original: reward->Nobody will give us anything if we go there - but we may choose to tame or hunt those dragons.
Rule.Raw: reward->Nobody will give us anything if we go there - but we may choose to tame or hunt those dragons.
Rule.Translated: reward->Nadie nos dará nada por ir allí, pero podemos intentar domesticar o cazar a esos dragones.

Rule.Original: The dragons have left the area. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The dragons have left the area. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones han abandonado la zona. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Raw: requestDescription->received reports from their scouts reported encountering (*Threat)[dragonWithArticleAndCount](/Threat) in the area

Rule.Raw: request->[asker_pronoun] wants us to travel there and defeat [that] [dragon]
Rule.Translated: request->[asker_pronoun] quiere que viajemos allí y derrotemos a [that] [dragon]

Rule.Raw: request->[asker_pronoun] asked us to dispose of [that] [dragon]
Rule.Translated: request->[asker_pronoun] nos ha pedido que nos deshagamos de [that] [dragon]

Rule.Original: The dragons have left the area. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The dragons have left the area. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones han abandonado la zona. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: The dragons have been slain!\n\nThe payment from [asker_faction_name] has arrived.
Rule.Raw: The dragons have been slain!\n\nThe payment from [asker_faction_name] has arrived.
Rule.Translated: ¡Los dragones han muerto!\n\nHa llegado el pago de [asker_faction_name].

Rule.Original: These colonists took on the [resolvedQuestName]. [asker_definite] wants to know who is going to receive the [royalFavorReward_amount] [asker_faction_royalFavorLabel] favor for it.
Rule.Raw: These colonists took on the [resolvedQuestName]. [asker_definite] wants to know who is going to receive the [royalFavorReward_amount] [asker_faction_royalFavorLabel] favor for it.
Rule.Translated: Estos colonos aceptaron la misión [resolvedQuestName]. [asker_definite] quiere saber quién recibirá los [royalFavorReward_amount] puntos de favor [asker_faction_royalFavorLabel] por ella.

Rule.Original: A location that one or more dragons are currently living in.
Rule.Raw: A location that one or more dragons are currently living in.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar donde viven actualmente uno o más dragones.

Rule.Original: A location where a caravan is being attacked by one or more dragons.
Rule.Raw: A location where a caravan is being attacked by one or more dragons.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar donde uno o más dragones están atacando una caravana.

Rule.Original: A location where a pack of dragons is currently residing. It's likely they're peacful, but it may not be the case.
Rule.Raw: A location where a pack of dragons is currently residing. It's likely they're peacful, but it may not be the case.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar donde reside actualmente un grupo de dragones. Es probable que sean pacíficos, pero podrían no serlo.

Rule.Original: Razorwhip scale tiles, for that fancy look. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Raw: Razorwhip scale tiles, for that fancy look. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de escamas de Razorwhip para dar un aspecto elegante. Se limpian rápidamente y obtienen una bonificación de limpieza para su uso en instalaciones médicas.

Rule.Original: Razorwhip scale tiles, for that fancy look. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Raw: Razorwhip scale tiles, for that fancy look. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de escamas de Razorwhip para dar un aspecto elegante. Se limpian rápidamente y obtienen una bonificación de limpieza para su uso en instalaciones médicas.

Rule.Original: Boneknappers are supringly playful dragons, these bone dragons have iconically be seen chasing bones like a dog. They make no sound but can scream to create a silent but deadly sonic wave strong enough to kill a man from close range.
Rule.Raw: Boneknappers are supringly playful dragons, these bone dragons have iconically be seen chasing bones like a dog. They make no sound but can scream to create a silent but deadly sonic wave strong enough to kill a man from close range.
Rule.Translated: Los Boneknapper son dragones sorprendentemente juguetones. Es habitual ver a estos dragones de huesos persiguiendo huesos como un perro. No emiten sonidos, pero pueden gritar para crear una onda sónica silenciosa y letal, capaz de matar a una persona a corta distancia.

Rule.Original: Changewings are generally avoiding people, and rarely look for a fight. However, if you try to attack one you can expect a deadly counter attack. Being pretty easy to tame and having nice all around scales, these make a good early-game dragon to tame for both protection and crafting.
Rule.Raw: Changewings are generally avoiding people, and rarely look for a fight. However, if you try to attack one you can expect a deadly counter attack. Being pretty easy to tame and having nice all around scales, these make a good early-game dragon to tame for both protection and crafting.
Rule.Translated: Los Changewing suelen evitar a las personas y rara vez buscan pelea. Sin embargo, si intentas atacar a uno, puedes esperar un contraataque letal. Son bastante fáciles de domesticar y sus escamas resultan útiles para muchas cosas, por lo que son buenos dragones para conseguir protección y materiales de fabricación al principio de la partida.

Rule.Original: Deadly Nadders are playful dragons, they love being part of a group. It's pretty easy to tame these dragons, though when angered they will shoot deadly spikes at their enemy. Either your best friend or worst enemy.
Rule.Raw: Deadly Nadders are playful dragons, they love being part of a group. It's pretty easy to tame these dragons, though when angered they will shoot deadly spikes at their enemy. Either your best friend or worst enemy.
Rule.Translated: Los Deadly Nadder son dragones juguetones a los que les encanta formar parte de un grupo. Resulta bastante fácil domesticarlos, aunque cuando se enfadan disparan púas mortales contra sus enemigos. Pueden ser tu mejor amigo o tu peor enemigo.

Rule.Original: Deathgrippers are very agressive dragons. They will attack you without hesitation when hungry. They are hard to tame as they usually do whatever they want. They are even known to eat their own kind when hungry enough. (and in some cases, their own mate.) Only try to tame this dragon if you have a escape plan prepared, you will most likely need it..
Rule.Raw: Deathgrippers are very agressive dragons. They will attack you without hesitation when hungry. They are hard to tame as they usually do whatever they want. They are even known to eat their own kind when hungry enough. (and in some cases, their own mate.) Only try to tame this dragon if you have a escape plan prepared, you will most likely need it..
Rule.Translated: Los Deathgripper son dragones muy agresivos. Te atacarán sin dudarlo cuando tengan hambre. Son difíciles de domesticar porque suelen hacer lo que les da la gana. Incluso se sabe que devoran a los de su propia especie cuando tienen suficiente hambre y, en algunos casos, hasta a su pareja. Intenta domesticar uno solo si tienes preparado un plan de huida: seguramente lo necesitarás.

Rule.Original: Death songs are very solitary dragons, making it very hard to tame one. they hunt pretty much anything because of the ability to both stun and lock even the biggest targets into place. Highly intelligent and a excellent ally if you do manage to tame one. They're generally not agressive towards people unless provoked as they focus on bigger meals.
Rule.Raw: Death songs are very solitary dragons, making it very hard to tame one. they hunt pretty much anything because of the ability to both stun and lock even the biggest targets into place. Highly intelligent and a excellent ally if you do manage to tame one. They're generally not agressive towards people unless provoked as they focus on bigger meals.
Rule.Translated: Los Death Song son dragones muy solitarios, por lo que resulta muy difícil domesticarlos. Cazan prácticamente cualquier cosa gracias a su capacidad para aturdir e inmovilizar incluso a los objetivos más grandes. Son muy inteligentes y excelentes aliados si logras domesticar uno. No suelen ser agresivos con las personas salvo que se les provoque, pues prefieren presas mayores.

Rule.Original: Dramillions are extremely intelligent, they can match the intelligence of a Nightfury. It's no suprise that they are easy to tame and train. They are generally calm dragons which like company from humans. Do not make them your enemy though, as they can be really deadly if you give them a reason to retaliate. Every dragon trainer loves to have a Dramillion on their side.
Rule.Raw: Dramillions are extremely intelligent, they can match the intelligence of a Nightfury. It's no suprise that they are easy to tame and train. They are generally calm dragons which like company from humans. Do not make them your enemy though, as they can be really deadly if you give them a reason to retaliate. Every dragon trainer loves to have a Dramillion on their side.
Rule.Translated: Los Dramillion son extremadamente inteligentes y pueden igualar la inteligencia de un Nightfury. No sorprende que sean fáciles de domesticar y adiestrar. Suelen ser dragones tranquilos que disfrutan de la compañía humana. Eso sí, no los conviertas en enemigos: pueden ser muy letales si les das motivos para contraatacar. Todo adiestrador de dragones querría tener un Dramillion a su lado.

Rule.Original: Dreadstriders are extremely fast and good at dodging attacks. They can dodge most melee attacks, and are almost impossible to hit by guns in their mist ability. Draw them out of the mist if you want to succeed.
Rule.Raw: Dreadstriders are extremely fast and good at dodging attacks. They can dodge most melee attacks, and are almost impossible to hit by guns in their mist ability. Draw them out of the mist if you want to succeed.
Rule.Translated: Los Dreadstrider son extremadamente rápidos y hábiles esquivando ataques. Pueden evitar la mayoría de los ataques cuerpo a cuerpo y resulta casi imposible acertarles con armas de fuego mientras usan su habilidad de niebla. Sácalos de ella si quieres tener éxito.

Rule.Original: Speed Stingers love the cold, They generally leave people alone and are not agressive. When Speed Stingers feel threatened however, they will attack. Their stinger is known to freeze people upon hit, do not get stung!
Rule.Raw: Speed Stingers love the cold, They generally leave people alone and are not agressive. When Speed Stingers feel threatened however, they will attack. Their stinger is known to freeze people upon hit, do not get stung!
Rule.Translated: A los Speed Stinger les encanta el frío. Suelen dejar tranquilas a las personas y no son agresivos, pero atacarán si se sienten amenazados. Su aguijón puede congelar a las personas al impactar. ¡No dejes que te piquen!

Rule.Original: The nightfury was once feared. The vikings described it as The unholy offspring of lightning and death itself, but time has proven that this is wrong. Nightfuries are shy, but are very loyal once you earn their trust. They can shoot powerful plasma bolts that explode on impact.
Rule.Raw: The nightfury was once feared. The vikings described it as The unholy offspring of lightning and death itself, but time has proven that this is wrong. Nightfuries are shy, but are very loyal once you earn their trust. They can shoot powerful plasma bolts that explode on impact.
Rule.Translated: El Nightfury fue temido en el pasado. Los vikingos lo describían como el hijo impío del rayo y de la propia muerte, pero el tiempo ha demostrado que se equivocaban. Los Nightfury son tímidos, pero muy leales una vez que te ganas su confianza. Pueden disparar poderosos proyectiles de plasma que explotan al impactar.

Rule.Original: *Twice the heads, Twice the status*; This dragon has 2 heads. 1 creates explosive gas, the other head lights it. This dragon isn't very agressive by nature, but if you anger it, you better run away before you find youself covered in a gas cloud.
Rule.Raw: *Twice the heads, Twice the status*; This dragon has 2 heads. 1 creates explosive gas, the other head lights it. This dragon isn't very agressive by nature, but if you anger it, you better run away before you find youself covered in a gas cloud.
Rule.Translated: *El doble de cabezas, el doble de categoría*; este dragón tiene 2 cabezas. 1 produce gas explosivo y la otra lo enciende. No es muy agresivo por naturaleza, pero si lo enfadas, será mejor que huyas antes de encontrarte dentro de una nube de gas.

Rule.Original: Few people have seen this dragon, Fewer lived to tell the tale. This dragon is known for summoning lightning or even full scaled thunderstorms with a single roar. Do not make it angry.
Rule.Raw: Few people have seen this dragon, Fewer lived to tell the tale. This dragon is known for summoning lightning or even full scaled thunderstorms with a single roar. Do not make it angry.
Rule.Translated: Pocas personas han visto a este dragón, y aún menos han vivido para contarlo. Es conocido por invocar rayos o incluso tormentas eléctricas completas con un solo rugido. No lo enfades.

Rule.Original: Few people have seen this dragon, Fewer lived to tell the tale. This dragon is known for summoning lightning or even full scaled thunderstorms with a single roar. Do not make it angry.
Rule.Raw: Few people have seen this dragon, Fewer lived to tell the tale. This dragon is known for summoning lightning or even full scaled thunderstorms with a single roar. Do not make it angry.
Rule.Translated: Pocas personas han visto a este dragón, y aún menos han vivido para contarlo. Es conocido por invocar rayos o incluso tormentas eléctricas completas con un solo rugido. No lo enfades.

Rule.Original: Deathgrippers are very agressive dragons. They will attack you without hesitation when hungry. They are hard to tame as they usually do whatever they want. They are even known to eat their own kind when hungry enough. (and in some cases, their own mate.) Only try to tame this dragon if you have a escape plan prepared, you will most likely need it..
Rule.Raw: Deathgrippers are very agressive dragons. They will attack you without hesitation when hungry. They are hard to tame as they usually do whatever they want. They are even known to eat their own kind when hungry enough. (and in some cases, their own mate.) Only try to tame this dragon if you have a escape plan prepared, you will most likely need it..
Rule.Translated: Los Deathgripper son dragones muy agresivos. Te atacarán sin dudarlo cuando tengan hambre. Son difíciles de domesticar porque suelen hacer lo que les da la gana. Incluso se sabe que devoran a los de su propia especie cuando tienen suficiente hambre y, en algunos casos, hasta a su pareja. Intenta domesticar uno solo si tienes preparado un plan de huida: seguramente lo necesitarás.

Rule.Original: The Monstrous Nightmare is known to set itself on fire when it's angry. Only the toughest people hunt this dragon. It's best to leave this dragon alone. People have tried to tame them, sometimes with succes, and sometimes not so much.
Rule.Raw: The Monstrous Nightmare is known to set itself on fire when it's angry. Only the toughest people hunt this dragon. It's best to leave this dragon alone. People have tried to tame them, sometimes with succes, and sometimes not so much.
Rule.Translated: El Monstrous Nightmare es conocido por prenderse fuego cuando se enfada. Solo las personas más duras cazan a este dragón. Es mejor dejarlo tranquilo. Algunos han intentado domesticarlo, a veces con éxito y otras no tanto.

Rule.Original: Snafflefangs are one of the most peaceful and calm dragon species you will find. They are generally friendly towards strangers, which is often abused by hunters. They are also very playful which makes it easier to bond with one.
Rule.Raw: Snafflefangs are one of the most peaceful and calm dragon species you will find. They are generally friendly towards strangers, which is often abused by hunters. They are also very playful which makes it easier to bond with one.
Rule.Translated: Los Snafflefang son una de las especies de dragones más pacíficas y tranquilas que encontrarás. Suelen ser amistosos con los desconocidos, algo de lo que los cazadores se aprovechan a menudo. También son muy juguetones, lo que facilita establecer un vínculo con ellos.

Rule.Original: A Razorwhip rivals Nightfuries in terms of intelligence, It's best to have this dragon on your good side rather then against you. It's metallic armor makes it a difficult target, and makes it nearly immune to blunt weapons. A powerful ally if you manage to tame one.
Rule.Raw: A Razorwhip rivals Nightfuries in terms of intelligence, It's best to have this dragon on your good side rather then against you. It's metallic armor makes it a difficult target, and makes it nearly immune to blunt weapons. A powerful ally if you manage to tame one.
Rule.Translated: Un Razorwhip rivaliza con los Nightfury en inteligencia, así que conviene tenerlo de tu lado. Su armadura metálica lo convierte en un objetivo difícil y lo hace casi inmune a las armas contundentes. Es un poderoso aliado si logras domesticarlo.

Rule.Original: Rockstompers have the nasty habit of burying hidden caches of supplies, including the belongings of their trainers. Keep a close eye on your stuff when attempting to train one! They are hunting and tracking experts as well, so sneaking up on one is impossible. They have doglike behavior, and are not hard to tame.
Rule.Raw: Rockstompers have the nasty habit of burying hidden caches of supplies, including the belongings of their trainers. Keep a close eye on your stuff when attempting to train one! They are hunting and tracking experts as well, so sneaking up on one is impossible. They have doglike behavior, and are not hard to tame.
Rule.Translated: Los Rockstomper tienen la mala costumbre de enterrar reservas ocultas de suministros, incluidas las pertenencias de sus adiestradores. ¡Vigila bien tus cosas cuando intentes adiestrar uno! También son expertos cazadores y rastreadores, por lo que resulta imposible acercarse a ellos sin que te detecten. Se comportan de forma similar a los perros y no son difíciles de domesticar.

Rule.Original: A Razorwhip rivals Nightfuries in terms of intelligence, It's best to have this dragon on your good side rather then against you. It's metallic armor makes it a difficult target, and makes it nearly immune to blunt weapons. A powerful ally if you manage to tame one.
Rule.Raw: A Razorwhip rivals Nightfuries in terms of intelligence, It's best to have this dragon on your good side rather then against you. It's metallic armor makes it a difficult target, and makes it nearly immune to blunt weapons. A powerful ally if you manage to tame one.
Rule.Translated: Un Razorwhip rivaliza con los Nightfury en inteligencia, así que conviene tenerlo de tu lado. Su armadura metálica lo convierte en un objetivo difícil y lo hace casi inmune a las armas contundentes. Es un poderoso aliado si logras domesticarlo.

Rule.Original: Rumblehorns are pretty lazy dragons, and not that fast. They are however very tanky, and will protect their owners to the end. They aren't hostile at all unless you make them angry.
Rule.Raw: Rumblehorns are pretty lazy dragons, and not that fast. They are however very tanky, and will protect their owners to the end. They aren't hostile at all unless you make them angry.
Rule.Translated: Los Rumblehorn son dragones bastante perezosos y poco rápidos. Sin embargo, son muy resistentes y protegerán a sus dueños hasta el final. No son hostiles en absoluto salvo que los enfades.

Rule.Original: A Sandwraith usually hides under the sand, blending in with it's surroundings. This way it's nearly impossible to see one until it's to late. It somewhat represents the shape of a Nightfury. It doesn't want much to do with people, so gaining it's trust might be difficult. But very loyal once you succeed.
Rule.Raw: A Sandwraith usually hides under the sand, blending in with it's surroundings. This way it's nearly impossible to see one until it's to late. It somewhat represents the shape of a Nightfury. It doesn't want much to do with people, so gaining it's trust might be difficult. But very loyal once you succeed.
Rule.Translated: El Sandwraith suele ocultarse bajo la arena y confundirse con el entorno. Así resulta casi imposible verlo hasta que es demasiado tarde. Su forma recuerda a la de un Nightfury. No quiere tener mucho que ver con las personas, por lo que ganarse su confianza puede ser difícil. Sin embargo, una vez que lo consigues, es muy leal.

Rule.Original: Few people have seen this dragon, Fewer lived to tell the tale. This dragon is known for summoning lightning or even full scaled thunderstorms with a single roar. Do not make it angry.
Rule.Raw: Few people have seen this dragon, Fewer lived to tell the tale. This dragon is known for summoning lightning or even full scaled thunderstorms with a single roar. Do not make it angry.
Rule.Translated: Pocas personas han visto a este dragón, y aún menos han vivido para contarlo. Es conocido por invocar rayos o incluso tormentas eléctricas completas con un solo rugido. No lo enfades.

Rule.Original: Snafflefangs are one of the most peaceful and calm dragon species you will find. They are generally friendly towards strangers, which is often abused by hunters. They are also very playful which makes it easier to bond with one.
Rule.Raw: Snafflefangs are one of the most peaceful and calm dragon species you will find. They are generally friendly towards strangers, which is often abused by hunters. They are also very playful which makes it easier to bond with one.
Rule.Translated: Los Snafflefang son una de las especies de dragones más pacíficas y tranquilas que encontrarás. Suelen ser amistosos con los desconocidos, algo de lo que los cazadores se aprovechan a menudo. También son muy juguetones, lo que facilita establecer un vínculo con ellos.

Rule.Original: Snow wraiths are one of the fastest dragons you can find, and can dig through anything with ease. They've been spotted digging through solid ice and frozen ground without a problem. They also have a ability to get into stealth mode. Their speed and stealth make for amazing mounts, but they are agressive and hard to tame. note: can mine for the colony after haul training is completed, has more mining speed and yield then any other dragons with oddesey DLC dig ability.
Rule.Raw: Snow wraiths are one of the fastest dragons you can find, and can dig through anything with ease. They've been spotted digging through solid ice and frozen ground without a problem. They also have a ability to get into stealth mode. Their speed and stealth make for amazing mounts, but they are agressive and hard to tame. note: can mine for the colony after haul training is completed, has more mining speed and yield then any other dragons with oddesey DLC dig ability.
Rule.Translated: Los Snow Wraith son algunos de los dragones más rápidos que puedes encontrar y pueden excavar casi cualquier cosa con facilidad. Se los ha visto atravesar hielo sólido y suelo congelado sin problemas. También tienen una habilidad para entrar en modo sigiloso. Su velocidad y sigilo los convierten en monturas extraordinarias, pero son agresivos y difíciles de domesticar. Nota: pueden minar para la colonia una vez completado el adiestramiento de transporte y tienen más velocidad y rendimiento de minería que cualquier otro dragón con la habilidad de excavación del DLC Odyssey.

Rule.Original: Speed Stingers love the cold, They generally leave people alone and are not agressive. When Speed Stingers feel threatened however, they will attack. Their stinger is known to freeze people upon hit, do not get stung!
Rule.Raw: Speed Stingers love the cold, They generally leave people alone and are not agressive. When Speed Stingers feel threatened however, they will attack. Their stinger is known to freeze people upon hit, do not get stung!
Rule.Translated: A los Speed Stinger les encanta el frío. Suelen dejar tranquilas a las personas y no son agresivos, pero atacarán si se sienten amenazados. Su aguijón puede congelar a las personas al impactar. ¡No dejes que te piquen!

Rule.Original: Stormcutters usually ignore people. You should never attack one as they possess a powerful fire breath and will not hesitate to use it when threatened. Will make strong allies once you gain their trust.
Rule.Raw: Stormcutters usually ignore people. You should never attack one as they possess a powerful fire breath and will not hesitate to use it when threatened. Will make strong allies once you gain their trust.
Rule.Translated: Los Stormcutter suelen ignorar a las personas. Nunca deberías atacar a uno: posee un poderoso aliento de fuego y no dudará en utilizarlo si se siente amenazado. Será un gran aliado cuando te ganes su confianza.

Rule.Original: A Thunderdrum is most commonly found in a storm, they love the rain and thunder. It's easy to make one mad, but once tamed it's a loyal dragon. Can create a sonic shockwave with it's roar, capable of killing a person from close range.
Rule.Raw: A Thunderdrum is most commonly found in a storm, they love the rain and thunder. It's easy to make one mad, but once tamed it's a loyal dragon. Can create a sonic shockwave with it's roar, capable of killing a person from close range.
Rule.Translated: Los Thunderdrum se encuentran con más frecuencia durante las tormentas, pues les encantan la lluvia y los truenos. Es fácil enfadarlos, pero una vez domesticados son leales. Su rugido puede crear una onda de choque sónica capaz de matar a una persona a corta distancia.

Rule.Original: Triple Stryke's are pretty wild dragons, they are hard to tame and are known to kill after a failed tame attempt. They are very tanky but also on slower side, be careful for their ranged attack! Once tamed however, they will be very loyal and protect their master at any cost. Proof them you are worthy and you will get a nice guardian.
Rule.Raw: Triple Stryke's are pretty wild dragons, they are hard to tame and are known to kill after a failed tame attempt. They are very tanky but also on slower side, be careful for their ranged attack! Once tamed however, they will be very loyal and protect their master at any cost. Proof them you are worthy and you will get a nice guardian.
Rule.Translated: Los Triple Stryke son dragones bastante salvajes, difíciles de domesticar y conocidos por matar tras un intento de domesticación fallido. Son muy resistentes, aunque algo lentos. ¡Cuidado con su ataque a distancia! Una vez domesticados, son muy leales y protegen a su dueño a cualquier precio. Demuestra que eres digno y tendrás un buen guardián.

Rule.Original: An unfertilized Skrill egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: An unfertilized Skrill egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de Skrill. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: These scales are excellent for building because of how sturdy they are. Also protects really well against blunt damage, and great for making sharp weapons. They do not protect well against temperature.
Rule.Raw: These scales are excellent for building because of how sturdy they are. Also protects really well against blunt damage, and great for making sharp weapons. They do not protect well against temperature.
Rule.Translated: Estas escamas son excelentes para construir por su gran resistencia. También protegen muy bien de los daños contundentes y sirven para fabricar armas afiladas. No aíslan bien de la temperatura.

Rule.Original: Adding ranged animals for auto-casting ranged attacks
Rule.Raw: Adding ranged animals for auto-casting ranged attacks

Rule.Original: A surface-to-surface missile (SSM) or ground-to-ground missile (GGM) is a missile designed to be launched from the ground or the sea and strike targets on land or at sea. A self-loading, automatic turret. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but can be quite unreliable with it's failure to recognise hostiles at times especially those under the cover of smoke.
Rule.Raw: A surface-to-surface missile (SSM) or ground-to-ground missile (GGM) is a missile designed to be launched from the ground or the sea and strike targets on land or at sea. A self-loading, automatic turret. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but can be quite unreliable with it's failure to recognise hostiles at times especially those under the cover of smoke.
Rule.Translated: Un misil superficie-superficie (SSM), o tierra-tierra (GGM), se lanza desde tierra o mar contra objetivos terrestres o marítimos. Una torreta automática que se recarga sola. Puede alcanzar objetivos a cualquier distancia y por encima de los muros, pero resulta poco fiable porque a veces no reconoce a los enemigos, especialmente si están ocultos por humo.

Rule.Original: Creation of powerful equipment using magic infused gemstones.
Rule.Raw: Creation of powerful equipment using magic infused gemstones.
Rule.Translated: Permite crear equipo poderoso utilizando gemas imbuidas de magia.

Rule.Original: Construct magical defences with magic infused gemstones.
Rule.Raw: Construct magical defences with magic infused gemstones.
Rule.Translated: Construye defensas mágicas utilizando gemas imbuidas de magia.

Rule.Original: Infuse rough gemstones with magic to create light.
Rule.Raw: Infuse rough gemstones with magic to create light.
Rule.Translated: Imbuye gemas en bruto con magia para crear fuentes de luz.

Rule.Original: Infuse rough gemstones with magic to create temperature altering pylons.
Rule.Raw: Infuse rough gemstones with magic to create temperature altering pylons.
Rule.Translated: Imbuye gemas en bruto con magia para crear pilones capaces de alterar la temperatura.

Rule.Original: Forge powerful weapons of war with magic infused gemstones.
Rule.Raw: Forge powerful weapons of war with magic infused gemstones.
Rule.Translated: Forja poderosas armas de guerra utilizando gemas imbuidas de magia.

Rule.Original: A carefully crafted, magical sapphire sphere set on a small base. Can be placed on top of tables to light up a room.\n\nPeople who prefer darklight work best with this light source.
Rule.Raw: A carefully crafted, magical sapphire sphere set on a small base. Can be placed on top of tables to light up a room.\n\nPeople who prefer darklight work best with this light source.
Rule.Translated: Una esfera mágica de zafiro cuidadosamente elaborada y colocada sobre una pequeña base. Puede ponerse sobre una mesa para iluminar una habitación.\n\nLas personas que prefieren la luz oscura trabajan mejor con esta fuente de iluminación.

Rule.Original: A beautiful, magically charged sapphire within a carefully crafted pedestal which lights up an area.\n\nPeople who prefer to work in darklight are happy with this light source.
Rule.Raw: A beautiful, magically charged sapphire within a carefully crafted pedestal which lights up an area.\n\nPeople who prefer to work in darklight are happy with this light source.
Rule.Translated: Un hermoso zafiro cargado mágicamente, colocado en un pedestal cuidadosamente elaborado que ilumina la zona a su alrededor.\n\nLas personas que prefieren trabajar con luz oscura se sienten cómodas con esta fuente de iluminación.
lámpara de pared de piedra oscura

Rule.Original: A small, magically charged sapphire sphere mounted on a wall. It lights up a small area, providing light in its surroundings.\n\nPeople who prefer darklight work best with this light source.
Rule.Raw: A small, magically charged sapphire sphere mounted on a wall. It lights up a small area, providing light in its surroundings.\n\nPeople who prefer darklight work best with this light source.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña esfera de zafiro cargada mágicamente y montada en una pared. Ilumina una pequeña zona a su alrededor.\n\nLas personas que prefieren la luz oscura trabajan mejor con esta fuente de iluminación.

Rule.Original: A carefully crafted, magical citrine sphere set on a small base. Can be placed on top of tables to light up a room.
Rule.Raw: A carefully crafted, magical citrine sphere set on a small base. Can be placed on top of tables to light up a room.
Rule.Translated: Una esfera mágica de citrino cuidadosamente elaborada y colocada sobre una pequeña base. Puede ponerse sobre una mesa para iluminar una habitación.

Rule.Original: A beautiful, magically charged citrine within a carefully crafted pedestal which lights up an area.
Rule.Raw: A beautiful, magically charged citrine within a carefully crafted pedestal which lights up an area.
Rule.Translated: Un hermoso citrino cargado mágicamente, colocado en un pedestal cuidadosamente elaborado que ilumina la zona a su alrededor.
lámpara de pared de piedra luminosa

Rule.Original: A small, magically charged citrine sphere mounted on a wall. It lights up a small area, providing light in its surroundings.
Rule.Raw: A small, magically charged citrine sphere mounted on a wall. It lights up a small area, providing light in its surroundings.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña esfera de citrino cargada mágicamente y montada en una pared. Ilumina una pequeña zona a su alrededor.

Rule.Original: A beautiful, magically charged diamond within a carefully crafted pedestal which lights up an area brightly enough to grow crops. The exordinary energy expenditure means that the gemstone within will only release its energy during the day.
Rule.Raw: A beautiful, magically charged diamond within a carefully crafted pedestal which lights up an area brightly enough to grow crops. The exordinary energy expenditure means that the gemstone within will only release its energy during the day.
Rule.Translated: Un hermoso diamante cargado mágicamente, colocado en un pedestal cuidadosamente elaborado que ilumina una zona con suficiente intensidad como para cultivar plantas. El extraordinario gasto de energía hace que la gema solo libere su poder durante el día.

Rule.Original: Recovering energy for the next release period
Rule.Raw: Recovering energy for the next release period
Rule.Translated: Recuperando energía para el siguiente periodo de liberación
lámpara de pared de piedra solar

Rule.Original: A small, magically charged diamond sphere mounted on a wall. It lights up a small area brightly enough to grow crops. The exordinary energy expenditure means that the gemstone within will only release its energy during the day.
Rule.Raw: A small, magically charged diamond sphere mounted on a wall. It lights up a small area brightly enough to grow crops. The exordinary energy expenditure means that the gemstone within will only release its energy during the day.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña esfera de diamante cargada mágicamente y montada en una pared. Ilumina una zona con suficiente intensidad como para cultivar plantas. El extraordinario gasto de energía hace que la gema de su interior solo libere su poder durante el día.

Rule.Original: Recovering energy for the next release period
Rule.Raw: Recovering energy for the next release period
Rule.Translated: Recuperando energía para el siguiente periodo de liberación

Rule.Original: An arcane workbench equipped for crafting of magical equipment using gemstones.
Rule.Raw: An arcane workbench equipped for crafting of magical equipment using gemstones.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de trabajo arcano equipado para fabricar objetos mágicos utilizando gemas.

Rule.Original: A gemstone pylon, magically charged to provide short and medium range combat support in an area. Requires a fresh supply of onyx after extended deployment. The magical energy the crystal shell is barely contained and will explode upon imminent destruction.
Rule.Raw: A gemstone pylon, magically charged to provide short and medium range combat support in an area. Requires a fresh supply of onyx after extended deployment. The magical energy the crystal shell is barely contained and will explode upon imminent destruction.
Rule.Translated: Un pilón de gema cargado mágicamente para ofrecer apoyo de combate a corta y media distancia. Requiere un nuevo suministro de ónice tras un uso prolongado. La energía mágica apenas puede contenerse dentro de la envoltura de cristal, que explotará cuando esté a punto de ser destruida.
No se puede disparar: energía insuficiente
proyectil mágico del pilón de bombardeo

Rule.Original: The core of a defence pylon that unleashes magical bolts.
Rule.Raw: The core of a defence pylon that unleashes magical bolts.
Rule.Translated: El núcleo de un pilón defensivo que dispara proyectiles mágicos.

Rule.Original: A gemstone pylon, magically charged to provide medium to long range combat support in an area. Requires a fresh supply of onyx after extended deployment. The magical energy the crystal shell is barely contained and will explode upon imminent destruction.
Rule.Raw: A gemstone pylon, magically charged to provide medium to long range combat support in an area. Requires a fresh supply of onyx after extended deployment. The magical energy the crystal shell is barely contained and will explode upon imminent destruction.

Rule.Translated: Imbuidos de magia y colocados en un cuenco, estos pequeños cristales reducen la temperatura del entorno para crear un ambiente más fresco.

Rule.Original: A beautifully crafted magic crystal that drains energy from its surroundings. Lowers nearby temperature and may explode on damage.
Rule.Raw: A beautifully crafted magic crystal that drains energy from its surroundings. Lowers nearby temperature and may explode on damage.
Rule.Translated: Un cristal mágico bellamente elaborado que absorbe energía de su entorno. Reduce la temperatura cercana y puede explotar al recibir daño.

Rule.Original: A beautifully crafted magic crystal that radiates energy into its surroundings. Increases nearby temperature and may explode on damage.
Rule.Raw: A beautifully crafted magic crystal that radiates energy into its surroundings. Increases nearby temperature and may explode on damage.
Rule.Translated: Un cristal mágico bellamente elaborado que irradia energía a su entorno. Aumenta la temperatura cercana y puede explotar al recibir daño.

efecto de anillo de zafiro encantado
efecto de anillo de rubí encantado

Rule.Original: Enchanted with lower battle magic, this weapon projects a weak bubble of magical energy that can occasionally shield the user from danger.\n\nThis variant of the shield spell is more reliable against melee attacks.
Rule.Raw: Enchanted with lower battle magic, this weapon projects a weak bubble of magical energy that can occasionally shield the user from danger.\n\nThis variant of the shield spell is more reliable against melee attacks.
Rule.Translated: Encantada con magia de batalla menor, esta arma proyecta una débil burbuja de energía mágica que puede proteger ocasionalmente al usuario del peligro.\n\nEsta variante del hechizo de escudo es más fiable contra ataques cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Enchanted with battle magic, this weapon projects a bubble of magical energy that can occasionally shield the user from danger.\n\nThis variant of the shield spell is more reliable against melee attacks.
Rule.Raw: Enchanted with battle magic, this weapon projects a bubble of magical energy that can occasionally shield the user from danger.\n\nThis variant of the shield spell is more reliable against melee attacks.
Rule.Translated: Encantada con magia de batalla, esta arma proyecta una burbuja de energía mágica que puede proteger ocasionalmente al usuario del peligro.\n\nEsta variante del hechizo de escudo es más fiable contra ataques cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Enchanted with higher battle magic, this weapon projects a powerful bubble of magical energy that can occasionally shield the user from danger.\n\nThis variant of the shield spell is more reliable against melee attacks.
Rule.Raw: Enchanted with higher battle magic, this weapon projects a powerful bubble of magical energy that can occasionally shield the user from danger.\n\nThis variant of the shield spell is more reliable against melee attacks.
Rule.Translated: Encantada con magia de batalla superior, esta arma proyecta una poderosa burbuja de energía mágica que puede proteger ocasionalmente al usuario del peligro.\n\nEsta variante del hechizo de escudo es más fiable contra ataques cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Extreme wind will cause a slowdown to everyone not under the roof.
