Rule.Raw: Extreme wind will cause a slowdown to everyone not under the roof.
Rule.Translated: Un señor eléctrico está creando un huracán.

Rule.Original: Speak to the prisoner while using psychic suggestion to reduce his resistance to recruitment. This psycast can only reduce a prisoner's resistance, but cannot recruit him.
Rule.Raw: Speak to the prisoner while using psychic suggestion to reduce his resistance to recruitment. This psycast can only reduce a prisoner's resistance, but cannot recruit him.
Rule.Translated: Habla con un prisionero mientras utiliza la sugestión psíquica para reducir su resistencia al reclutamiento. Esta sugestión psíquica solo puede reducir la resistencia de un prisionero, pero no puede reclutarlo.

Rule.Original: Using words of motivation with a heaping boost to metabolism, makes the touched target a more productive member of society for the next few days. Considered a hostile action and duration is affected by the target’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Using words of motivation with a heaping boost to metabolism, makes the touched target a more productive member of society for the next few days. Considered a hostile action and duration is affected by the target’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Hace que el objetivo se vuelva un miembro más productivo de la sociedad durante los días siguientes mediante palabras de motivación y un estímulo al metabolismo. Se considera una acción hostil y su duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del objetivo.

Rule.Original: Induce noise in the visual centers of the brain, obscuring vision of everyone near the target point. Lasts for half a minute, affected by psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Induce noise in the visual centers of the brain, obscuring vision of everyone near the target point. Lasts for half a minute, affected by psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Induce ruido en los centros visuales del cerebro, oscureciendo la visión de todos los que estén cerca del punto designado. Dura medio minuto, y esta duración se ve afectada por la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Speak words of friendship and benefits to a close target using psychic suggestion, coaxing them into improving their relations. Ineffective against hostility and scales with high psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Speak words of friendship and benefits to a close target using psychic suggestion, coaxing them into improving their relations. Ineffective against hostility and scales with high psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Expresa palabras de amistad y apoyo a un objetivo cercano mediante sugestión psíquica, haciendo que se dé cuenta de que no eres tan malo. Solo funciona con aquellos dispuestos a escuchar y el efecto varía según la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Creates a sphere of psychic suggestion around the caster, linking all pawns within to the caster and allowing any single target “Word of” psycast to affect all others. The effect ends when those linked move out of range.
Rule.Raw: Creates a sphere of psychic suggestion around the caster, linking all pawns within to the caster and allowing any single target “Word of” psycast to affect all others. The effect ends when those linked move out of range.
Rule.Translated: Crea una esfera de sugestión psíquica alrededor del lanzador, vinculando a cualquier persona que se encuentre dentro de ella con el lanzador y permitiendo que cualquier habilidad psíquica «palabra de» dirigida a uno de los vinculados afecte a todos los demás. El efecto termina cuando aquellos que están vinculados salen del radio de acción.

Rule.Original: Induces noise in the target’s pain centers of the brain and overstimulates their nerve endings, scaling with their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Induces noise in the target’s pain centers of the brain and overstimulates their nerve endings, scaling with their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Induce ruido en los centros de dolor del cerebro del objetivo y sobreestimula sus terminaciones nerviosas. El efecto es proporcional a la sensibilidad psíquica del objetivo.

Rule.Original: Using concentrated harmonic psychic noise, lobotomizes the target and turns them into a serving, restless thrall. Very much unappreciated by their former factions.
Rule.Raw: Using concentrated harmonic psychic noise, lobotomizes the target and turns them into a serving, restless thrall. Very much unappreciated by their former factions.
Rule.Translated: Lava el cerebro del objetivo con un ruido psíquico armónico concentrado, y lo convierte en un esclavo servil e inquieto. Muy poco apreciado por la antigua facción del afectado.

Rule.Original: Using harmonic psychic noise, physically alters the target’s body to be more durable and resistant to damage. Lasts a long time and scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Using harmonic psychic noise, physically alters the target’s body to be more durable and resistant to damage. Lasts a long time and scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Altera físicamente el cuerpo del objetivo con ruido psíquico armónico para que sea más duradero y resistente al daño. Tiene una duración prolongada y aumenta con la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Targeting a downed psychically-talented pawn, induces intense harmonic psychic noise to liquify their flesh and convert it into psyessence to be absorbed by the caster as their own accumulated psychic talent. The final moments of psychic disintegration will be felt by everyone for many kilometers around, causing diplomatic consequences with all factions.
Rule.Raw: Targeting a downed psychically-talented pawn, induces intense harmonic psychic noise to liquify their flesh and convert it into psyessence to be absorbed by the caster as their own accumulated psychic talent. The final moments of psychic disintegration will be felt by everyone for many kilometers around, causing diplomatic consequences with all factions.
Rule.Translated: Induce un intenso ruido psíquico armónico sobre una persona con talento psíquico para licuar su carne y convertirla en psiesencia, que será absorbida por el lanzador para desarrollar su propio talento psíquico. Los momentos finales de desintegración psíquica serán sentidos por todos a muchos kilómetros a la redonda, lo que tendrá consecuencias diplomáticas con todas las facciones.

Rule.Original: Creating a massive burst of psychic suggestion, convinces nearby pawns that rooms are the absolute best they could possibly be. The caster is put into a coma and the resulting effect lasts for five days.
Rule.Raw: Creating a massive burst of psychic suggestion, convinces nearby pawns that rooms are the absolute best they could possibly be. The caster is put into a coma and the resulting effect lasts for five days.
Rule.Translated: Convence a cualquier persona cercana de que las habitaciones son lo mejor de lo mejor. El lanzador entra en coma tras utilizar esta habilidad y el efecto dura cinco días.

Rule.Original: Slow the target for a short time by suppressing motor activity in the brain. Considered a hostile action and affected by the target’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Slow the target for a short time by suppressing motor activity in the brain. Considered a hostile action and affected by the target’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Ralentiza al objetivo durante un breve periodo de tiempo suprimiendo la actividad motora del cerebro. Se considera una acción hostil y su efecto es proporcional a la sensibilidad psíquica del objetivo.

Rule.Original: Momentarily disrupts motor function in the target's brain, preventing any movement. This lasts for a few seconds and is considered a hostile action.
Rule.Raw: Momentarily disrupts motor function in the target's brain, preventing any movement. This lasts for a few seconds and is considered a hostile action.
Rule.Translated: Interrumpe momentáneamente la función motora en el cerebro del objetivo, impidiendo cualquier movimiento. Dura unos segundos y se considera una acción hostil.

Rule.Original: Psychically shocks the target's mind with chaotic images, blocking coherent perception and dropping them into a state of psychic shock. There is a risk of brain damage and is overtly hostile.
Rule.Raw: Psychically shocks the target's mind with chaotic images, blocking coherent perception and dropping them into a state of psychic shock. There is a risk of brain damage and is overtly hostile.
Rule.Translated: Sacude psíquicamente la mente del objetivo con imágenes caóticas, bloqueando la percepción coherente y sumiéndolo en un estado de shock psíquico. Existe riesgo de daño cerebral y es un acto claramente hostil.

Rule.Original: Instantly dump all your neural heat into a conscious ally. As a side effect, the target will fall into a debilitating, harmless coma for about a day. The target must actively accept the psychic invasion, so only conscious allies can be targeted.
Rule.Raw: Instantly dump all your neural heat into a conscious ally. As a side effect, the target will fall into a debilitating, harmless coma for about a day. The target must actively accept the psychic invasion, so only conscious allies can be targeted.
Rule.Translated: Descarga al instante toda la entropía neuronal en un aliado consciente. Como efecto secundario, el objetivo caerá en un coma debilitante e inofensivo durante aproximadamente un día. El objetivo debe aceptar activamente la invasión psíquica, por lo que solo se puede utilizar con aliados conscientes.

Rule.Original: Induce a berserker psychosis in the target's mind, causing them to attack anyone nearby. They regain rationality after 15 seconds, depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Induce a berserker psychosis in the target's mind, causing them to attack anyone nearby. They regain rationality after 15 seconds, depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Induce un estado de psicosis enloquecedor en la mente del objetivo, haciendo que desee atacar a cualquiera que se encuentre cerca. El objetivo recupera la cordura al cabo de 15 segundos, duración que depende de su sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Instantly dump all of your neural heat into a target, causing them to explode with an area of effect relative to the heat lost. A good declaration of war.
Rule.Raw: Instantly dump all of your neural heat into a target, causing them to explode with an area of effect relative to the heat lost. A good declaration of war.
Rule.Translated: Descarga instantáneamente toda la entropía neuronal sobre un objetivo, haciéndole explotar. El alcance de la explosión es proporcional a la cantidad de entropía liberada y a la sensibilidad psíquica del objetivo. Una buena declaración de guerra.

Rule.Original: Generate an overwhelming rush of undirected rage in everyone near the target point. Considered an overt act of aggression and lasts several seconds.
Rule.Raw: Generate an overwhelming rush of undirected rage in everyone near the target point. Considered an overt act of aggression and lasts several seconds.
Rule.Translated: Genera una descarga abrumadora de agresividad descontrolada en todas las personas que estén cerca del punto designado. Se considera un acto abiertamente agresivo y dura varios segundos.

Rule.Original: Creates a massive psychic drone aura around the caster tuned to hostiles, frequently driving them insane until they overcome the break. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Creates a massive psychic drone aura around the caster tuned to hostiles, frequently driving them insane until they overcome the break. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Crea un aura de zumbido psíquico masivo alrededor del lanzador dirigido a los hostiles, volviéndolos locos continuamente hasta que superan el shock. La duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Efficiently but indiscriminately dumps all of the caster’s neural heat into an explosion away from themselves, the size being relative to the heat lost.
Rule.Raw: Efficiently but indiscriminately dumps all of the caster’s neural heat into an explosion away from themselves, the size being relative to the heat lost.
Rule.Translated: Descarga de forma eficiente pero indiscriminada toda la entropía neuronal del lanzador en una explosión apartada del mismo. El tamaño de la explosión depende tanto de la cantidad de entropía liberada como de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Find a discontinuity in the psychic field and unfold it, releasing a massive amount of psychic energy. Every creature in range but outside of the safe inner circle will be driven violently insane. Casting this takes 12 seconds of meditation, and afterwards, the caster will go into a psychic coma. The disturbing neuroquake echoes will inflict pain on everyone for many kilometers around, causing diplomatic consequences with all factions.
Rule.Raw: Find a discontinuity in the psychic field and unfold it, releasing a massive amount of psychic energy. Every creature in range but outside of the safe inner circle will be driven violently insane. Casting this takes 12 seconds of meditation, and afterwards, the caster will go into a psychic coma. The disturbing neuroquake echoes will inflict pain on everyone for many kilometers around, causing diplomatic consequences with all factions.
Rule.Translated: Busca una discontinuidad en el campo psíquico y la despliega, liberando una cantidad masiva de energía psíquica. Todas las criaturas que se encuentren en el radio de acción, pero fuera del círculo interior seguro, enloquecerán violentamente. El lanzamiento requiere 12 segundos de meditación, y tras éste, el lanzador entrará en un coma psíquico durante cinco días. Los perturbadores ecos del neurosismo infligirán dolor a todo el mundo en muchos kilómetros a la redonda, lo que tendrá consecuencias diplomáticas con todas las facciones.

Rule.Original:
If you use neuroquake, everyone in this region will feel the neuroquake echo, you will lose goodwill with every non-hostile faction.

Neuroquake takes 12 seconds to cast, and cannot be interrupted. When complete, the caster will fall into a psychic coma for up to 5 days.

Everyone in range except those in a small circle around the caster will be affected.

Do you really want to cast neuroquake?
Rule.Raw:
If you use neuroquake, everyone in this region will feel the neuroquake echo, you will lose goodwill with every non-hostile faction.

Neuroquake takes 12 seconds to cast, and cannot be interrupted. When complete, the caster will fall into a psychic coma for up to 5 days.

Everyone in range except those in a small circle around the caster will be affected.

Do you really want to cast neuroquake?
Rule.Translated:
Si utilizas neuroterremoto, todos los habitantes de la región sentirán su eco y perderás buena voluntad con todas las facciones no hostiles.

El neuroterremoto tarda 12 segundos en lanzarse y no puede interrumpirse. Al terminar, quien lo lance caerá en un coma psíquico de hasta 5 días.

Afectará a todos los que estén a su alcance, salvo a quienes se encuentren en un pequeño círculo alrededor del lanzador.

¿Seguro que quieres lanzar neuroterremoto?

Rule.Original: Grows all the plants in a radius around the caster, advancing their maturity by the equivalent of 7 days. Biologically ages the caster by a full year.
Rule.Raw: Grows all the plants in a radius around the caster, advancing their maturity by the equivalent of 7 days. Biologically ages the caster by a full year.
Rule.Translated: Hace crecer todas las plantas que se encuentren a cierta distancia del lanzador hasta que alcanzan la madurez.

Rule.Original: Puts the caster into a self-inflicted coma as they earn a considerable amount of experience toward their next Psycast level and regain full Psyfocus. Biologically ages the caster by five years.
Rule.Raw: Puts the caster into a self-inflicted coma as they earn a considerable amount of experience toward their next Psycast level and regain full Psyfocus. Biologically ages the caster by five years.
Rule.Translated: Somete al cuerpo del lanzador a un estrés considerable, envejeciéndolo biológicamente cinco años mientras gana una cantidad considerable de experiencia para su siguiente nivel de psíquico, a la vez que recupera todo su psifoco.

Rule.Original: Psychic whispers of things to come. Colony pawns are inspired, neutrals or friendlies improve relations, prisoners lose their resistance and enemies retreat from their doom. Biologically ages the caster by a full year.
Rule.Raw: Psychic whispers of things to come. Colony pawns are inspired, neutrals or friendlies improve relations, prisoners lose their resistance and enemies retreat from their doom. Biologically ages the caster by a full year.
Rule.Translated: Emite susurros psíquicos sobre lo que se avecina. Las personas de la colonia se sentirán inspirados, los neutrales o amigos mejorarán sus relaciones, los prisioneros perderán su resistencia y los enemigos retrocederán ante su perdición.

Rule.Original: Using very precise timeskipping, moves the desired item to its finished state as if the creator had continued working on it. Biologically ages the caster by a full year.
Rule.Raw: Using very precise timeskipping, moves the desired item to its finished state as if the creator had continued working on it. Biologically ages the caster by a full year.
Rule.Translated: Moldea la materia del objeto designado hasta su forma final como si su creador hubiera seguido trabajando en él mediante un salto temporal de alta precisión. El lanzador envejecerá 3 años.

Rule.Original: Very inefficiently siphons life force from a living target, de-aging the caster by 2 years and aging the other by 10. Very debilitating aftereffects for the victim and considered a hostile action by allies.
Rule.Raw: Very inefficiently siphons life force from a living target, de-aging the caster by 2 years and aging the other by 10. Very debilitating aftereffects for the victim and considered a hostile action by allies.
Rule.Translated: Absorbe de forma muy ineficaz la fuerza vital de un objetivo vivo, rejuveneciendo al lanzador 2 años y envejeciendo al objetivo 10 años. Esta habilidad deja secuelas bastante graves en la víctima y es considerada una acción hostil por los aliados..

Rule.Original: Depending on the caster’s psychic sensitivity, slows all raiders on the map to a complete stop for up to five minutes. Attacking any single affected raider jolts all of them back into action.
Rule.Raw: Depending on the caster’s psychic sensitivity, slows all raiders on the map to a complete stop for up to five minutes. Attacking any single affected raider jolts all of them back into action.
Rule.Translated: Ralentiza a todos los asaltantes del mapa hasta detenerlos por completo durante un máximo de 5 minutos. Esta duración es proporcional a la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador. Si se ataca a alguno de los asaltantes afectados, todos volverán a la acción.

Rule.Original: Locks the entire planet into a season-long psychically induced slowdown, effectively skipping forward a season. Nigh instantaneous effect, very strenuous and puts the caster in a coma, as well as biologically aging them by a full year.
Rule.Raw: Locks the entire planet into a season-long psychically induced slowdown, effectively skipping forward a season. Nigh instantaneous effect, very strenuous and puts the caster in a coma, as well as biologically aging them by a full year.
Rule.Translated: Encierra a todo el planeta en una ralentización temporal inducida psíquicamente durante toda una estación. El efecto es casi instantáneo, extremadamente agotador y deja al lanzador en coma.

Rule.Original: Psychically compresses the flow of time in an area. Rapidly ages living creatures, plants flourish and wither, and structures start to disintegrate from the bizarre stress.
Rule.Raw: Psychically compresses the flow of time in an area. Rapidly ages living creatures, plants flourish and wither, and structures start to disintegrate from the bizarre stress.
Rule.Translated: Comprime psíquicamente el flujo del tiempo en el área designada. Esto hace que los seres vivos envejezcan rápidamente, que las plantas florezcan y se marchiten, y que las estructuras empiecen a desmoronarse a causa de las extrañas perturbaciones temporales.

Rule.Original: Inefficiently siphons life force to a living target, aging the caster by 5 years and de-aging the other by 10. Has a minimum age, removes age related penalties and puts the caster in a coma.
Rule.Raw: Inefficiently siphons life force to a living target, aging the caster by 5 years and de-aging the other by 10. Has a minimum age, removes age related penalties and puts the caster in a coma.
Rule.Translated: Transfiere fuerza vital a un objetivo vivo de una forma algo ineficiente, haciendo que el lanzador envejezca 5 años y que el otro rejuvenezca 10 años. El objetivo no puede rejuvenecer más allá de cierta edad mínima. Elimina cualquier penalización relacionada con la edad y deja al lanzador en coma.

Rule.Original: Find a discontinuity in the psychic field and compress it, releasing a massive temporal disturbance. Every creature in range but outside of the safe inner circle will experience rapid aging and structures will warp. Casting this takes 20 seconds of meditation, and afterwards, the caster will go into a psychic coma. The disturbing timequake echoes will inflict pain on everyone for many kilometers around, causing diplomatic consequences with all factions.
Rule.Raw: Find a discontinuity in the psychic field and compress it, releasing a massive temporal disturbance. Every creature in range but outside of the safe inner circle will experience rapid aging and structures will warp. Casting this takes 20 seconds of meditation, and afterwards, the caster will go into a psychic coma. The disturbing timequake echoes will inflict pain on everyone for many kilometers around, causing diplomatic consequences with all factions.
Rule.Translated: Busca una discontinuidad en el campo psíquico y la comprime, liberando una perturbación temporal masiva. Todas las criaturas que se encuentren en el radio de acción, pero fuera del círculo interior seguro, envejecerán rápidamente; y las estructuras se deformarán. El lanzamiento requiere 20 segundos de meditación, y tras éste, el lanzador entrará en un coma psíquico durante cinco días. Los perturbadores ecos del cronosismo infligirán dolor a todo el mundo en muchos kilómetros a la redonda, lo que tendrá consecuencias diplomáticas con todas las facciones.

Rule.Original:
If you use timequake, everyone in this region will feel the timequake echo, you will lose goodwill with every non-hostile faction.

Timequake takes 20 seconds to cast, and cannot be interrupted. When complete, the caster will fall into a psychic coma for up to 5 days.

Everyone except those in a small circle around the caster will be affected.

Do you really want to cast timequake?
Rule.Raw:
If you use timequake, everyone in this region will feel the timequake echo, you will lose goodwill with every non-hostile faction.

Timequake takes 20 seconds to cast, and cannot be interrupted. When complete, the caster will fall into a psychic coma for up to 5 days.

Everyone except those in a small circle around the caster will be affected.

Do you really want to cast timequake?
Rule.Translated:
Si utilizas cronoterremoto, todos los habitantes de la región sentirán su eco y perderás buena voluntad con todas las facciones no hostiles.

El cronoterremoto tarda 20 segundos en lanzarse y no puede interrumpirse. Al terminar, quien lo lance caerá en un coma psíquico de hasta 5 días.

Afectará a todo el mundo, salvo a quienes se encuentren en un pequeño círculo alrededor del lanzador.

¿Seguro que quieres lanzar cronoterremoto?

Rule.Original: Throw an orb of condensed flames, similar to a grenade, which explodes upon impact. The range scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Throw an orb of condensed flames, similar to a grenade, which explodes upon impact. The range scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador genera una pequeña y frágil bola de magma y la lanza. El líquido produce una pequeña explosión tras el impacto.

Rule.Original: Expels pressurized, flammable gas from the caster which immediately ignites. High chance of igniting those in the blast site, but does little damage without harming the caster.
Rule.Raw: Expels pressurized, flammable gas from the caster which immediately ignites. High chance of igniting those in the blast site, but does little damage without harming the caster.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador se conecta a depósitos ocultos de gas inflamable a alta presión y crea un vórtice incendiario de breve duración a su alrededor. Al escapar, el gas se enciende y se propaga rápidamente. No provoca mucho daño, pero incendia casi todo lo que toca.

Rule.Original: Ignites a small amount of deepchem underneath the target area, which vents to the surface in an explosion. Burns the area and spills forth excess liquid.
Rule.Raw: Ignites a small amount of deepchem underneath the target area, which vents to the surface in an explosion. Burns the area and spills forth excess liquid.
Rule.Translated: Crea un pequeño teleportal de breve duración conectado con algún depósito subterráneo de sustancias bioquímicas sin refinar, junto con una pequeña chispa en el lugar designado. El gas ardiente estalla en una gran explosión mientras los componentes del biocombustible salpican de forma incontrolada.

Rule.Original: Creates an aura of blazing flames around the target for a time, preventing them from immolation and igniting any who try to attack them in melee. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Creates an aura of blazing flames around the target for a time, preventing them from immolation and igniting any who try to attack them in melee. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Crea un vórtice incendiario temporal alrededor de un objetivo mediante la creación de un teleportal conectado con alguna estrella cercana unos centímetros por fuera del mismo. Cualquiera que intente atacar al objetivo cuerpo a cuerpo arderá en llamas, con la ventaja adicional de potenciar cualquier otro efecto del fuego.

Rule.Original: Spews forth flammable liquid which immediately ignites, along with everything the flames touch.
Rule.Raw: Spews forth flammable liquid which immediately ignites, along with everything the flames touch.
Rule.Translated: Crea un pequeño teleportal unidireccional de breve duración conectado con algún depósito subterráneo de sustancias bioquímicas sin refinar, junto con una pequeña chispa delante de la boca del lanzador. Los chorros biocombustible en llamas que se proyectan lo incendiarán todo.

Rule.Original: Emulating a star, the caster compresses highly energized gas which escapes in the desired direction, with damage scaling with psychic sensitivity. Ignites a small but distant area.
Rule.Raw: Emulating a star, the caster compresses highly energized gas which escapes in the desired direction, with damage scaling with psychic sensitivity. Ignites a small but distant area.
Rule.Translated: Crea dos micro-teleportales unidireccionales delante de los ojos del lanzador conectados a una enana blanca cercana. Se debe apuntar a un punto concreto para evitar una descarga excesiva de energía. La energía cegadora sale disparada e incendia una pequeña zona.

Rule.Original: Converts a local deposit of deepchem into fire-retardant foam which sprays forth from the user in a large area.
Rule.Raw: Converts a local deposit of deepchem into fire-retardant foam which sprays forth from the user in a large area.
Rule.Translated: Crea una serie de teleportales conectados con alguna nave espacial que esté de paso y «toma prestado» un poco de la espuma ignífuga de los sistemas de extinción de incendios de la misma. Como hay mucho que «tomar prestado», el radio de acción es bastante impresionante.

Rule.Original: Skips and immolates orbiting meteoroids to strike a designated area. The number of impacts scales with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Skips and immolates orbiting meteoroids to strike a designated area. The number of impacts scales with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Provoca distorsiones gravitatorias cerca de meteoroides y basura espacial en órbita para redirigirlos y hacer que impacten en el punto que elija el lanzador. Estos objetos vienen en grupos de cuatro para garantizar un control y una capacidad de devastación óptimos.

Rule.Original: Attempts to recreate the power of a star inside a concentrated column of almost liquidized oxygen. The resulting emission of plasma is so powerful that only the most advanced weapons systems can hope to compare. The long, intense concentration ends with the caster falling into a coma.
Rule.Raw: Attempts to recreate the power of a star inside a concentrated column of almost liquidized oxygen. The resulting emission of plasma is so powerful that only the most advanced weapons systems can hope to compare. The long, intense concentration ends with the caster falling into a coma.
Rule.Translated: Intenta recrear la potencia de una estrella dentro de una columna concentrada de oxígeno casi licuado. La emisión de plasma resultante es tan poderosa que solo los sistemas de armamento más avanzados pueden compararse. La larga e intensa concentración que requiere esta habilidad hace que el lanzador entre en coma durante 6 horas.

Rule.Original: Attempts to recreate the power of a star inside a vortex of concentrated oxygen. The mess of reactions occurring creates flammable byproducts in its wake while also leaving its trajectory completely unpredictable.
Rule.Raw: Attempts to recreate the power of a star inside a vortex of concentrated oxygen. The mess of reactions occurring creates flammable byproducts in its wake while also leaving its trajectory completely unpredictable.
Rule.Translated: Intenta recrear la potencia de una estrella dentro de un vórtice de oxígeno concentrado. La trayectoria de este vórtice es completamente impredecible, y las reacciones que se producen crean subproductos inflamables a su paso.

Rule.Original: Speak happy, calming words to someone while using psychic suggestion to implant a joyfuzz loop in his mind. The joyfuzz will suppress uncomfortable thoughts and sensations in the target to improve mood. This has the side-effect of dulling sensation and decision-making, which reduces consciousness.
Rule.Raw: Speak happy, calming words to someone while using psychic suggestion to implant a joyfuzz loop in his mind. The joyfuzz will suppress uncomfortable thoughts and sensations in the target to improve mood. This has the side-effect of dulling sensation and decision-making, which reduces consciousness.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza la sugestión psíquica para infundir un zumbido de alegría en la mente de una persona con palabras alegres y tranquilizadoras. El zumbido de alegría suprimirá los pensamientos y sensaciones incómodos del objetivo para mejorar su estado de humor. Como efecto secundario, adormece las sensaciones y la capacidad de tomar decisiones, lo que reduce la consciencia.

Rule.Original: Speak about someone's romantic virtues while using psychic suggestion to implant romantic desire in the listener. For days afterward, the listener will feel psychically-induced romantic attraction towards the other person. This greatly increases opinion and makes them much more likely to attempt romantic advances and marriage proposals if they get the chance. This power can be used to connect two other people, induce love for the caster, or force oneself to love another.
Rule.Raw: Speak about someone's romantic virtues while using psychic suggestion to implant romantic desire in the listener. For days afterward, the listener will feel psychically-induced romantic attraction towards the other person. This greatly increases opinion and makes them much more likely to attempt romantic advances and marriage proposals if they get the chance. This power can be used to connect two other people, induce love for the caster, or force oneself to love another.
Rule.Translated: Habla de las virtudes románticas de otra persona mientras se utiliza la sugestión psíquica para implantar el deseo romántico en el objetivo. Durante los días siguientes, el objetivo sentirá una atracción romántica inducida psíquicamente hacia esa otra persona. Esto hace que el objetivo tenga una opinión mucho más favorable de ella, y la hace mucho más propensa a intentar avances románticos y propuestas de matrimonio si tiene la oportunidad. Este poder puede utilizarse para conectar a dos personas ajenas al lanzador, inducir amor hacia el lanzador u obligarse a uno mismo a amar a otra persona.

Rule.Original: Use calming words and psychic suggestion to end a mental break on a person or animal. The target will fall into a short psychic sleep. The psyfocus cost depends on the intensity of the target's mental break.
Rule.Raw: Use calming words and psychic suggestion to end a mental break on a person or animal. The target will fall into a short psychic sleep. The psyfocus cost depends on the intensity of the target's mental break.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza palabras tranquilizadoras y la sugestión psíquica para poner fin al colapso mental de una persona o animal. El objetivo caerá en un breve sueño psíquico. El coste de psifoco depende de la intensidad del colapso mental del objetivo.

Rule.Original: Speak words encouraging creativity while psychically hypercharging the target's mind with new ideas. The target will experience a random inspiration appropriate to them.
Rule.Raw: Speak words encouraging creativity while psychically hypercharging the target's mind with new ideas. The target will experience a random inspiration appropriate to them.
Rule.Translated: Pronuncia palabras que estimulan la creatividad mientras se hipercarga psíquicamente la mente del objetivo con nuevas ideas. El objetivo experimentará una inspiración aleatoria apropiada para él.

Rule.Original: Sends out a signal to a distant engine of happiness to begin projecting a positive psychic drone, while also manipulating an orbital amplifier that only affects males.
Rule.Raw: Sends out a signal to a distant engine of happiness to begin projecting a positive psychic drone, while also manipulating an orbital amplifier that only affects males.
Rule.Translated: Emite una señal hacia una lejana maquinaria de felicidad para que comience a proyectar un zumbido psíquico positivo, al tiempo que manipula un amplificador orbital que afecte solo a los hombres.

Rule.Original: Sends out a signal to a distant engine of happiness to begin projecting a positive psychic drone, while also manipulating an orbital amplifier that only affects females.
Rule.Raw: Sends out a signal to a distant engine of happiness to begin projecting a positive psychic drone, while also manipulating an orbital amplifier that only affects females.
Rule.Translated: Emite una señal hacia una lejana maquinaria de felicidad para que comience a proyectar un zumbido psíquico positivo, al tiempo que manipula un amplificador orbital que afecte solo a las mujeres.

Rule.Original: After a brief meditation period, induce a sense of serenity in the target that reaches maximum magnitude near the effect’s end. As the calming feeling becomes more pronounced, they will find it harder to concentrate but it is not considered a malicious action.
Rule.Raw: After a brief meditation period, induce a sense of serenity in the target that reaches maximum magnitude near the effect’s end. As the calming feeling becomes more pronounced, they will find it harder to concentrate but it is not considered a malicious action.
Rule.Translated: Tras un breve periodo de meditación, induce una sensación de serenidad en el objetivo que alcanza su máxima magnitud cuando el efecto está a punto de desaparecer. El objetivo tendrá más dificultades para concentrarse a medida que se acentúa la sensación de calma, pero no se considera una acción maliciosa.

Rule.Original: Purges the build-up of fatigue in a nearby target and leaves them completely refreshed, in exchange the caster is left completely exhausted and needing a good nap.
Rule.Raw: Purges the build-up of fatigue in a nearby target and leaves them completely refreshed, in exchange the caster is left completely exhausted and needing a good nap.
Rule.Translated: Elimina la acumulación de cansancio de un objetivo cercano y lo deja completamente descansado. A cambio, el lanzador queda completamente exhausto y con la necesidad de echarse una buena siesta.

Rule.Original: Induce a harmless, instantaneous retrograde amnesia in the target, purging all memories, social bonds and skills acquired outside of their backstory. They also feel a strong kinship with the caster’s colony and joy at rediscovering the joys of life without commitment.
Rule.Raw: Induce a harmless, instantaneous retrograde amnesia in the target, purging all memories, social bonds and skills acquired outside of their backstory. They also feel a strong kinship with the caster’s colony and joy at rediscovering the joys of life without commitment.
Rule.Translated: Induce una amnesia retrógrada instantánea e inofensiva en el objetivo, purgando todos los recuerdos, lazos sociales y habilidades adquiridas al margen de su trasfondo. También hace que el objetivo sienta un fuerte vínculo con la colonia del lanzador y se alegre de redescubrir las alegrías de la vida sin compromiso.

Rule.Original: After a short meditation period and followed by a coma, taps into a target’s bloodline to skip all living family members to their proximity, knocked out through psychic shock. However, it does nothing to change their relationships and is considered rude by all other factions.
Rule.Raw: After a short meditation period and followed by a coma, taps into a target’s bloodline to skip all living family members to their proximity, knocked out through psychic shock. However, it does nothing to change their relationships and is considered rude by all other factions.
Rule.Translated: Accede a los lazos familiares de un objetivo y teletransporta a todos los miembros vivos de su familia cerca de él, que aparecerán noqueados por el shock psíquico. Requiere de un breve periodo de meditación y hace que el lanzador caiga en coma durante 5 días. No obstante, las relaciones entre los familiares no cambiarán y esta acción es considerada cuanto menos grosera por el resto de facciones.

Rule.Original: Breathe forward a stream of psychic entropy, the resulting cold cutting and inducing hypothermia scaling with the distance to the target.
Rule.Raw: Breathe forward a stream of psychic entropy, the resulting cold cutting and inducing hypothermia scaling with the distance to the target.
Rule.Translated: Crea un campo de energía psicocriónica y lo proyecta en forma de chorro. El frío resultante produce cortes e hipotermia en función de la distancia que hay hasta el objetivo.

Rule.Original: Condenses vapor with psychic entropy into an icicle launched at a target, the damage and accuracy scaling with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Condenses vapor with psychic entropy into an icicle launched at a target, the damage and accuracy scaling with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Condensa vapor de agua con energía psicocriónica en un carámbano y lo lanza contra un objetivo. El daño aumenta con la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Creates an aura of psychic entropy around the target for a time, preventing them from experiencing cold and inducing hypothermia on any who try to attack them in melee. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Raw: Creates an aura of psychic entropy around the target for a time, preventing them from experiencing cold and inducing hypothermia on any who try to attack them in melee. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Translated: Crea un aura de energía psicocriónica alrededor del objetivo durante varios segundos, impidiéndole experimentar frío e induciendo hipotermia a cualquiera que intente atacarle cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Push forth a concentrated stream of psychic entropy for a few seconds, rapidly inducing cuts and hypothermia. The duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Push forth a concentrated stream of psychic entropy for a few seconds, rapidly inducing cuts and hypothermia. The duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Emite un chorro concentrado de energía psicocriónica durante unos segundos, provocando rápidamente cortes e hipotermia. La duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Creates a node of psychic entropy in the form of a crystal, sapping the heat from the room for the next 5 days.
Rule.Raw: Creates a node of psychic entropy in the form of a crystal, sapping the heat from the room for the next 5 days.
Rule.Translated: Crea un foco de energía psicocriónica en forma de cristal que absorbe el calor de la habitación en la que se encuentre durante 5 días.

Rule.Original: Cause an area to manifest nodes of psychic entropy for the next 24 hours, drastically lowering the temperature.
Rule.Raw: Cause an area to manifest nodes of psychic entropy for the next 24 hours, drastically lowering the temperature.
Rule.Translated: Provoca que toda la zona despliegue nodos de energía psicocriónica durante las próximas 24 horas, bajando drásticamente la temperatura.

Rule.Original: Combining nodes of psychic entropy and a skipgate linked to an ocean, creating a large block of ice to form in the target location. Fragile and can melt if the temperature is above freezing.
Rule.Raw: Combining nodes of psychic entropy and a skipgate linked to an ocean, creating a large block of ice to form in the target location. Fragile and can melt if the temperature is above freezing.
Rule.Translated: Combina una serie de nodos de energía psicocriónica con un teleportal conectado a un océano para crear un gran bloque de hielo en el punto designado. El bloque resultante es frágil, y puede derretirse si la temperatura ambiente es superior al punto de congelación.

Rule.Original: Creates motes of psychic entropy and miniature skipgates to water reservoirs above all the targets in a small area, encasing them in ice. Victims will experience hypothermia but the ice can melt prematurely if the temperature is above freezing.
Rule.Raw: Creates motes of psychic entropy and miniature skipgates to water reservoirs above all the targets in a small area, encasing them in ice. Victims will experience hypothermia but the ice can melt prematurely if the temperature is above freezing.
Rule.Translated: Envuelve a todos los objetivos de un área pequeña en hielo mediante la combinación de nodos de energía psicocriónica con teleportales en miniatura conectados con depósitos de agua. Las víctimas sufrirán de hipotermia, pero el hielo puede derretirse antes de tiempo si la temperatura ambiente es superior al punto de congelación.

Rule.Original: Combining nodes of psychic entropy and miniature skipgates linked to an ocean, creating a circular wall of ice to form around the caster. Fragile and can melt if the temperature is above freezing.
Rule.Raw: Combining nodes of psychic entropy and miniature skipgates linked to an ocean, creating a circular wall of ice to form around the caster. Fragile and can melt if the temperature is above freezing.
Rule.Translated: Crea una barrera circular de hielo alrededor del lanzador mediante la combinación de nodos de energía psicocriónica con teleportales en miniatura conectados a un océano. La barrera resultante es frágil y puede derretirse si la temperatura ambiente supera el punto de congelación.

Rule.Original: Using differential-pressure skipgates, water-linked skipgates and nodes of psychic entropy, creates a swirling blizzard away from the caster. Those exposed to the tempest experience reduced sight, moving and manipulation, as well as hypothermia buildup and cutting cold. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity and puts them in a coma.
Rule.Raw: Using differential-pressure skipgates, water-linked skipgates and nodes of psychic entropy, creates a swirling blizzard away from the caster. Those exposed to the tempest experience reduced sight, moving and manipulation, as well as hypothermia buildup and cutting cold. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity and puts them in a coma.
Rule.Translated: Usando teleportales expuestos a diferentes presiones, teleportales conectados con masas de agua y nodos de energía psicocriónica, crea una terrible ventisca que se aleja del lanzador. Aquellos que estén expuestos a la tempestad experimentarán una reducción en sus capacidades de visión, movimiento y manipulación, así como una acumulación de hipotermia y cortes por frío. La duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador, que entrará en coma durante 5 días.

Rule.Original: Psychically dominate a target for a brief period, scaling with their psychic sensitivity, giving the caster a second body. However, it’s difficult being two people at once.
Rule.Raw: Psychically dominate a target for a brief period, scaling with their psychic sensitivity, giving the caster a second body. However, it’s difficult being two people at once.
Rule.Translated: Domina psíquicamente a un objetivo durante un breve espacio de tiempo que depende de su sensibilidad psíquica, y otorga al lanzador un segundo cuerpo. Sin embargo, es difícil ser dos personas a la vez.

Rule.Original: Dampens the caster’s sight, hearing, movement and manipulation in exchange for overcharging the target’s own physical abilities.
Rule.Raw: Dampens the caster’s sight, hearing, movement and manipulation in exchange for overcharging the target’s own physical abilities.
Rule.Translated: Reduce la capacidad de visión, audición, movimiento y manipulación del lanzador a cambio de mejorar las capacidades físicas del objetivo.

Rule.Original: Designates an area of stone which will have its minerals swapped out for a single, randomized type from an underground strata.
Rule.Raw: Designates an area of stone which will have its minerals swapped out for a single, randomized type from an underground strata.
Rule.Translated: Intercambia las rocas de la zona designada un único tipo de rocas aleatorio procedente de un estrato subterráneo.

Rule.Original: Initiates harmonic meditation which converts all accumulated heat into psyfocus after 10 seconds. Can neither overcharge psyfocus nor heat dump.
Rule.Raw: Initiates harmonic meditation which converts all accumulated heat into psyfocus after 10 seconds. Can neither overcharge psyfocus nor heat dump.
Rule.Translated: Inicia una meditación armónica que convierte toda la entropía neuronal acumulada en psifoco al cabo de 10 segundos.

Rule.Original: Creates a rift in karmic balance by shifting the negative karma from the first target onto the second target, as well as receiving their positive karma. Only affects combat and the duration scales with the first target’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Creates a rift in karmic balance by shifting the negative karma from the first target onto the second target, as well as receiving their positive karma. Only affects combat and the duration scales with the first target’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Crea una fisura en el equilibrio kármico al trasladar el karma negativo del primer objetivo al segundo, recibiendo el primero de ellos el positivo. Solo afecta al combate y su duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del primer objetivo.

Rule.Original: Creates a ripple of cosmic scale that will force something to happen.
Rule.Raw: Creates a ripple of cosmic scale that will force something to happen.
Rule.Translated: Crea una distorsión a escala cósmica que forzará a que ocurra algo interesante.

Rule.Original: Using precision skipgates, swaps the positions of the caster and a visible target.
Rule.Raw: Using precision skipgates, swaps the positions of the caster and a visible target.
Rule.Translated: Crea dos teleportales precisos de un solo uso entre el lanzador y un objetivo visible, haciendo que intercambien sus posiciones.

Rule.Original: Through the law of equivalent exchange, returns the primary target’s vitality to its origin, transferring all foreign objects and injuries to the secondary target.
Rule.Raw: Through the law of equivalent exchange, returns the primary target’s vitality to its origin, transferring all foreign objects and injuries to the secondary target.
Rule.Translated: Crea un desequilibrio entre las fuerzas vitales de dos personas, haciendo que todas las afecciones negativas fluyan de una a otra. Las afecciones que no puedan transferirse simplemente desaparecerán.

Rule.Original: Through the law of equivalent exchange, converts a targeted (stack of) item(s) into an item of equal or lesser value. Completely unpredictable.
Rule.Raw: Through the law of equivalent exchange, converts a targeted (stack of) item(s) into an item of equal or lesser value. Completely unpredictable.
Rule.Translated: Utilizando el fundamento alquímico del intercambio equivalente, convierte un objeto o una pila de objetos en un objeto de igual o menor valor. Se trata de una habilidad extremadamente impredecible e incontrolable.

Rule.Original: Initiates a shift in the target’s knowledge and accumulated skills, attempting to rebalance them somewhat chaotically with some beneficial guidance. The strain puts the caster in a coma.
Rule.Raw: Initiates a shift in the target’s knowledge and accumulated skills, attempting to rebalance them somewhat chaotically with some beneficial guidance. The strain puts the caster in a coma.
Rule.Translated: Inicia una alteración en los conocimientos y habilidades acumuladas del objetivo, y los reestructura al azar mediante una orientación psíquica beneficiosa. La tensión hace que el lanzador entre en coma durante un día. Este tiempo se ve afectado por la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Induces panic by overloading their flight response system for a duration scaling with their psychic sensitivity. Considered a hostile action.
Rule.Raw: Induces panic by overloading their flight response system for a duration scaling with their psychic sensitivity. Considered a hostile action.
Rule.Translated: Induce a un objetivo al pánico sobrecargando su sistema de respuesta a la huida durante un breve espacio de tiempo. Se considera una acción hostil.

Rule.Original: Psychically induces randomized mass necrosis in a target, exposing the afflicted body parts to infection and inducing vomiting. Duration scales with the target’s psychic sensitivity and is an overtly hostile action.
Rule.Raw: Psychically induces randomized mass necrosis in a target, exposing the afflicted body parts to infection and inducing vomiting. Duration scales with the target’s psychic sensitivity and is an overtly hostile action.
Rule.Translated: Induce psíquicamente una necrosis masiva y aleatoria en un objetivo, exponiendo las partes del cuerpo afectadas a la infección y a intensas arcadas debido al olor. La duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del objetivo y se trata de una acción claramente hostil.

Rule.Original: Siphons vitality from a nearby source, transferring the target’s natural healing factor, movement speed, and consciousness to the caster for a full day. Considered an overtly hostile action.
Rule.Raw: Siphons vitality from a nearby source, transferring the target’s natural healing factor, movement speed, and consciousness to the caster for a full day. Considered an overtly hostile action.
Rule.Translated: Absorbe la vitalidad de un objetivo vivo cercano, transfiriendo al lanzador su capacidad de curación natural, su velocidad de movimiento y su consciencia. Se considera una acción claramente hostil.

Rule.Original: Emits a cloud of black particles from the caster, which afflicts all, caster included, within the area with paralytic abasia for a full day. The radius scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Emits a cloud of black particles from the caster, which afflicts all, caster included, within the area with paralytic abasia for a full day. The radius scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Emite una nube de partículas negras alrededor del lanzador que provoca abasia paralítica durante dos horas a todos los que se encuentren en los alrededores, salvo al lanzador. El radio de acción depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Target a corpse and temporarily appropriate the victim’s skills to make up for the caster’s deficiencies. Effect lasts for a season before returning to normal.
Rule.Raw: Target a corpse and temporarily appropriate the victim’s skills to make up for the caster’s deficiencies. Effect lasts for a season before returning to normal.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador compensa sus deficiencias apropiándose temporalmente de las habilidades que tenía un cadáver cuando estaba vivo. El efecto dura una estación, y el lanzador vuelve a la normalidad.

Rule.Original: Coats the caster in a layer of temporary psychic atrophy, allowing them to walk through structures unimpeded and without damaging anything. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Coats the caster in a layer of temporary psychic atrophy, allowing them to walk through structures unimpeded and without damaging anything. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Manipula psíquicamente las moléculas del lanzador para que puedan atravesar las moléculas de las estructuras. La duración de este efecto depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Psychically strips all remaining life force from nearby humanoid corpses and stores the essence as a permanent stacking buffer to neural heat.
Rule.Raw: Psychically strips all remaining life force from nearby humanoid corpses and stores the essence as a permanent stacking buffer to neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Extrae psíquicamente toda la fuerza vital restante de los cadáveres humanoides cercanos y utiliza esa esencia para aumentar el límite de entropía neuronal permanentemente.

Rule.Original: Locks the touched target’s life force in place for a day, preventing them from dying. After this period, they can die from accumulated wounds, blood loss, or missing limbs or organs.
Rule.Raw: Locks the touched target’s life force in place for a day, preventing them from dying. After this period, they can die from accumulated wounds, blood loss, or missing limbs or organs.
Rule.Translated: Inmoviliza la fuerza vital del objetivo designado durante un día, impidiendo que muera. Una vez transcurrido este período, puede morir a causa de las heridas acumuladas, la pérdida de sangre o la pérdida de miembros u órganos.

Rule.Original: Psychically strips the deceased target’s life force and infuses it directly into their bones, animating them for a full day. The only remaining instinct is to inflict pain on the caster’s enemies.
Rule.Raw: Psychically strips the deceased target’s life force and infuses it directly into their bones, animating them for a full day. The only remaining instinct is to inflict pain on the caster’s enemies.
Rule.Translated: Extrae psíquicamente la fuerza vital de un objetivo fallecido y la infunde directamente en sus huesos, dotándole de vida durante un día entero. El único instinto que conserva es el de causar dolor a cualquier enemigo del lanzador.

Rule.Original: By sacrificing a natural finger, the caster is able to imitate the effects of resurrector mech serum on any non-dessicated corpse, the psychic energy repairing broken-down tissues and kickstarting the body back to life. The target will be incapacitated and their allegiances will remain the same. The less preserved the body is, the more likely the target is to suffer from negative side effects. The long, intense concentration ends with the caster falling into a coma.
Rule.Raw: By sacrificing a natural finger, the caster is able to imitate the effects of resurrector mech serum on any non-dessicated corpse, the psychic energy repairing broken-down tissues and kickstarting the body back to life. The target will be incapacitated and their allegiances will remain the same. The less preserved the body is, the more likely the target is to suffer from negative side effects. The long, intense concentration ends with the caster falling into a coma.
Rule.Translated: Permite al lanzador, sacrificando uno de sus dedos naturales, reproducir los efectos del suero mecanoide resucitador en cualquier cadáver no disecado. La energía psíquica reparará los tejidos dañados y devolverá la vida al cuerpo. El objetivo quedará incapacitado y sus lealtades seguirán siendo las mismas. Cuanto menos conservado esté el cuerpo, más probabilidades tendrá de sufrir efectos secundarios negativos. La larga e intensa concentración hace que el lanzador entre en coma durante 6 horas.

Rule.Original: Gives the targeted pawn a nictitating membrane that allows them to see equally well in darkness and daytime. Duration scales with the target's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Gives the targeted pawn a nictitating membrane that allows them to see equally well in darkness and daytime. Duration scales with the target's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Otorga al objetivo una membrana nictitante que le permite ver en la oscuridad con la misma facilidad que con la luz del día. La duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del objetivo.

Rule.Original: Select a target area to generate an orb of completely obfuscating darkness, the duration scaling with the caster’s psychic sensitivity. All vision is blocked and any attacks within or passing through will miss entirely.
Rule.Raw: Select a target area to generate an orb of completely obfuscating darkness, the duration scaling with the caster’s psychic sensitivity. All vision is blocked and any attacks within or passing through will miss entirely.
Rule.Translated: Genera un orbe de oscuridad completamente ofuscante en un área determinada, cuya duración varía en función de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador. La visión queda bloqueada dentro de este área, y los ataques que se produzcan en su interior o a través de ella fallarán por completo.

Rule.Original: Creates a field of optical disharmony around the caster, causing affected allies standing in darkness to be completely invisible. Attacking breaks the illusion.
Rule.Raw: Creates a field of optical disharmony around the caster, causing affected allies standing in darkness to be completely invisible. Attacking breaks the illusion.
Rule.Translated: Crea un campo de disonancia óptica alrededor del lanzador, haciendo que los aliados afectados que se encuentren en la oscuridad sean completamente invisibles. La ilusión se rompe al atacar.

Rule.Original: By strategically placing an orb of obfuscating darkness high in the sky, the caster can effectively cause a spontaneous eclipse.
Rule.Raw: By strategically placing an orb of obfuscating darkness high in the sky, the caster can effectively cause a spontaneous eclipse.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador provoca un eclipse espontáneo colocando estratégicamente un orbe de oscuridad ofuscadora a gran altura en el cielo.

Rule.Original: Linking the caster with their own shadow allows them to teleport themselves to an area of darkness, even if they can’t see the location.
Rule.Raw: Linking the caster with their own shadow allows them to teleport themselves to an area of darkness, even if they can’t see the location.
Rule.Translated: Permite al lanzador teletransportarse a una zona oscura mediante el vínculo con su propia sombra, aunque no pueda ver el lugar de destino.

Rule.Original: Creates a localized field of optical disharmony to travel and remain in a desired location, with a duration scaling with psychic sensitivity. The illusion will draw the ire of all enemies.
Rule.Raw: Creates a localized field of optical disharmony to travel and remain in a desired location, with a duration scaling with psychic sensitivity. The illusion will draw the ire of all enemies.
Rule.Translated: Crea un campo localizado de disonancia óptica que se desplaza y permanece en el lugar deseado, con una duración proporcional a la sensibilidad psíquica. La ilusión atraerá la ira de todos los enemigos.

Rule.Original: Emitting particles of absorptive darkness allows the caster to augment their psychic sensitivity, which scales inversely with the local light level.
Rule.Raw: Emitting particles of absorptive darkness allows the caster to augment their psychic sensitivity, which scales inversely with the local light level.
Rule.Translated: Permite al lanzador aumentar su sensibilidad psíquica mediante la emisión de partículas de absorción de oscuridad, cuyo efecto es inversamente proporcional al nivel de luz local.

Rule.Original: Links the caster’s shadow with the shade and infuses it with obfuscating darkness, plummeting all areas on the map with less than 50% light levels into pitch darkness. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Links the caster’s shadow with the shade and infuses it with obfuscating darkness, plummeting all areas on the map with less than 50% light levels into pitch darkness. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Une la sombra del lanzador con la oscuridad de las inmediaciones y la impregna de más negrura, sumiendo en una oscuridad total a cualquier ubicación con menos de un 50% de luz. La duración de este efecto depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Links the caster’s shadow to a target in dark areas, allowing them to skip back and forth multiple times to attack in melee. The amount of hits depends on the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Links the caster’s shadow to a target in dark areas, allowing them to skip back and forth multiple times to attack in melee. The amount of hits depends on the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Une la sombra del lanzador con un objetivo que esté en una zona oscura, lo que le permite saltar de un lado a otro varias veces para atacarle cuerpo a cuerpo. El número de impactos depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Briefly links nearby allies to a distant colonist’s shadow to instantly teleport them, even across the planet as long as they are not overburdened. Can only be cast at night and temporarily stuns the caster.
Rule.Raw: Briefly links nearby allies to a distant colonist’s shadow to instantly teleport them, even across the planet as long as they are not overburdened. Can only be cast at night and temporarily stuns the caster.
Rule.Translated: Vincula brevemente a los aliados cercanos con la sombra de un colono lejano para teletransportarlos al instante, incluso a través del planeta siempre que no estén sobrecargados. Solo puede lanzarse de noche y aturde temporalmente al lanzador.

Rule.Original: Severely limit pain pathways in the target's brain for a couple of minutes. This can allow a person to move and act even with grievous injuries which would normally incapacitate them.
Rule.Raw: Severely limit pain pathways in the target's brain for a couple of minutes. This can allow a person to move and act even with grievous injuries which would normally incapacitate them.
Rule.Translated: Atenúa drásticamente las señales de dolor en el cerebro del objetivo durante un par de minutos. Esto puede hacer que una persona se mueva y actúe incluso con lesiones graves que normalmente la incapacitarían.

Rule.Original: Psychically stimulates a person’s regenerative capabilities into overdrive, effectively tripling their natural healing factor for a few days.
Rule.Raw: Psychically stimulates a person’s regenerative capabilities into overdrive, effectively tripling their natural healing factor for a few days.
Rule.Translated: Estimula psíquicamente la capacidad de regeneración de una persona, triplicándola durante unos días.

Rule.Original: Temporarily puts the target’s cardiovascular system in stasis, which prevents them from bleeding out for a time, scaling with the psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Raw: Temporarily puts the target’s cardiovascular system in stasis, which prevents them from bleeding out for a time, scaling with the psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Translated: Hace que el sistema cardiovascular de un objetivo entre temporalmente en estasis, lo que impide que se desangre durante dos minutos.

Rule.Original: Psychically stimulates a person’s immune system into overdrive, effectively nearly doubling their immunity gain speed for a few days.
Rule.Raw: Psychically stimulates a person’s immune system into overdrive, effectively nearly doubling their immunity gain speed for a few days.
Rule.Translated: Estimula psíquicamente el sistema inmunitario de una persona, triplicando su velocidad de inmunización durante unos días.

Rule.Original: Generate a spherical skipgate on a target that sends all incoming ground-level projectiles to some distant place, the duration scaling with the target’s psychic sensitivity. People and items are not affected.
Rule.Raw: Generate a spherical skipgate on a target that sends all incoming ground-level projectiles to some distant place, the duration scaling with the target’s psychic sensitivity. People and items are not affected.
Rule.Translated: Genera un teleportal esférico sobre un objetivo que envía todos los proyectiles entrantes a ras del suelo a un lugar distante. La duración de este efecto depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del objetivo. Las personas y los objetos no se ven afectados.

Rule.Original: Psychically focus the target's mind for a minute, boosting their sight, hearing and moving capacities.
Rule.Raw: Psychically focus the target's mind for a minute, boosting their sight, hearing and moving capacities.
Rule.Translated: Concentra psíquicamente la mente del objetivo durante un minuto, potenciando su capacidad visual, auditiva y de movimiento.

Rule.Original: Generate a spherical skipgate that sends all incoming and outgoing ground-level projectiles to some distant place. People and items are not affected. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Raw: Generate a spherical skipgate that sends all incoming and outgoing ground-level projectiles to some distant place. People and items are not affected. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Translated: Genera un teleportal esférico que envía todos los proyectiles entrantes y salientes a ras del suelo a un lugar distante. Las personas y los objetos no se ven afectados.

Rule.Original: Psychically manipulate the visual centers of everyone nearby, rendering them unable to perceive a particular individual for a short time.
Rule.Raw: Psychically manipulate the visual centers of everyone nearby, rendering them unable to perceive a particular individual for a short time.
Rule.Translated: Manipula psíquicamente los centros visuales de todas las personas cercanas, haciendo que sean incapaces de percibir a un individuo concreto durante un breve periodo de tiempo.

Rule.Original: Induces a psychic, regenerative coma in the target that lasts for a full day. The psychic energy assists the target by slowly regrowing any missing limbs.
Rule.Raw: Induces a psychic, regenerative coma in the target that lasts for a full day. The psychic energy assists the target by slowly regrowing any missing limbs.
Rule.Translated: Induce una forma compleja de rejuvenecimiento psíquico centrada en las extremidades del sujeto, concretamente en las que le faltan. El efecto es gradual, y perdura durante un día entero. A menudo se describe como «tremendamente incómodo», ya que sobreestimula el síndrome del miembro fantasma.

Rule.Original: Generate a spherical skipgate around the caster that sends all incoming ground-level projectiles to some distant place, lasting as long as they can manage the heat accumulation. People and items are not affected. It takes immense concentration to hold, as such the caster needs to be mindful of their steps.
Rule.Raw: Generate a spherical skipgate around the caster that sends all incoming ground-level projectiles to some distant place, lasting as long as they can manage the heat accumulation. People and items are not affected. It takes immense concentration to hold, as such the caster needs to be mindful of their steps.
Rule.Translated: Genera un teleportal esférico alrededor del lanzador que envía todos los proyectiles entrantes a ras del suelo a algún lugar distante, y que se mantiene activo mientras el lanzador pueda controlar la acumulación de entropía. Las personas y los objetos no se ven afectados. Requiere una gran concentración, por lo que el lanzador debe prestar especial atención a todo.

Rule.Original: Generate a microscopic skipgate linked to the core of a nearby star for a few days. Solar material leaks through the pinprick in spacetime, illuminating and warming the surrounding area until it closes. The light is enough to work by, but not enough to grow plants.
Rule.Raw: Generate a microscopic skipgate linked to the core of a nearby star for a few days. Solar material leaks through the pinprick in spacetime, illuminating and warming the surrounding area until it closes. The light is enough to work by, but not enough to grow plants.
Rule.Translated: Genera un teleportal microscópico conectado con el núcleo de una estrella cercana durante unos días. El material solar se filtra a través del pequeño agujero en el espacio-tiempo, iluminando y calentando la zona circundante hasta que se cierra. La luz es adecuada para trabajar, pero no para cultivar plantas.

Rule.Original: Skip the 5 chunks of rock or slag to scatter them near the target point. This is useful for producing cover during offensive operations.
Rule.Raw: Skip the 5 chunks of rock or slag to scatter them near the target point. This is useful for producing cover during offensive operations.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta cinco trozos de roca o chatarra y los esparce cerca del punto designado. Es útil para crear cobertura durante las operaciones ofensivas.

Rule.Original: Douse a target in water, extinguishing fires and shorting any electrical structures. The water is archotechnologically skipped from distant bodies of water or underground aquifers, with the amount skipped scaling with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Douse a target in water, extinguishing fires and shorting any electrical structures. The water is archotechnologically skipped from distant bodies of water or underground aquifers, with the amount skipped scaling with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Rocía la zona designada con agua, apagando cualquier fuego. El agua es teletransportada arqueotécnicamente desde masas de agua distantes o acuíferos subterráneos.

Rule.Original: Teleport the target to a random position from where he started, the distance scaling with the caster’s psychic sensitivity. Stuns the target for a second and is considered a hostile action.
Rule.Raw: Teleport the target to a random position from where he started, the distance scaling with the caster’s psychic sensitivity. Stuns the target for a second and is considered a hostile action.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta al objetivo a una posición aleatoria cerca de donde estaba. Aturde al objetivo durante unos segundos y se considera una acción hostil.

Rule.Original: Teleport the target to a desired position, the distance scaling with the caster’s psychic sensitivity, from his starting point. This is considered a hostile action.
Rule.Raw: Teleport the target to a desired position, the distance scaling with the caster’s psychic sensitivity, from his starting point. This is considered a hostile action.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta al objetivo a la posición deseada no muy lejos de su punto de partida. Esto se considera una acción hostil.

Rule.Original: Form a temporary wall by skipping rubble and soil up from deep under the ground. Decent range and useful in blocking line of sight and movement for a few hours.
Rule.Raw: Form a temporary wall by skipping rubble and soil up from deep under the ground. Decent range and useful in blocking line of sight and movement for a few hours.
Rule.Translated: Forma un muro temporal levantando escombros y tierra desde las profundidades del suelo. Tiene un alcance decente y es útil para bloquear la línea de visión y el movimiento durante unas horas.

Rule.Original: Skip dust particles up from under the ground surface to form a thick cloud. This reduces the accuracy of any shot fired through it, and prevents turrets from locking on entirely.
Rule.Raw: Skip dust particles up from under the ground surface to form a thick cloud. This reduces the accuracy of any shot fired through it, and prevents turrets from locking on entirely.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta partículas de polvo provenientes de debajo de la superficie del suelo hasta formar una espesa nube. Esto reduce la precisión de cualquier disparo realizado a través de ella e inutiliza por completo a las torretas.

Rule.Original: Skip everyone near a target point to a random location nearby. Considered a nuisance as it can put allies in danger.
Rule.Raw: Skip everyone near a target point to a random location nearby. Considered a nuisance as it can put allies in danger.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta a todos los que estén cerca del punto designado a un lugar cercano aleatorio. Se considera una habilidad engorrosa, ya que puede poner en peligro a los aliados.

Rule.Original: Creates an opening to a network of skipgates which can be placed in any location with a permanent presence. The network is tied to a group’s collective consciousness, allowing others to use it and different psycasters can add to it. However, the entry points are sensitive to physical disturbances which can cause them to collapse.
Rule.Raw: Creates an opening to a network of skipgates which can be placed in any location with a permanent presence. The network is tied to a group’s collective consciousness, allowing others to use it and different psycasters can add to it. However, the entry points are sensitive to physical disturbances which can cause them to collapse.
Rule.Translated: Crea una entrada a una red de teleportales que puede colocarse en cualquier lugar, donde contará con una presencia permanente. Esta red está vinculada a la conciencia colectiva del grupo, por lo que permite que otros la utilicen y que distintos psíquicos la amplíen. Sin embargo, los puntos de entrada son sensibles a las perturbaciones físicas, las cuales pueden provocar su colapso.

Rule.Original: Skip the caster, along with anyone standing near them, to a willing ally at a distant location. This can send people far across the planet, and the skipped people will always appear near a random ally on the target map and be stunned for a few seconds from the journey.
Rule.Raw: Skip the caster, along with anyone standing near them, to a willing ally at a distant location. This can send people far across the planet, and the skipped people will always appear near a random ally on the target map and be stunned for a few seconds from the journey.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta al lanzador y a todos los que se encuentren cerca de él a las inmediaciones de un aliado en un lugar distante. Esta habilidad puede enviar a gente a puntos muy lejanos a través del planeta. Las personas teletransportadas siempre aparecerán cerca de un aliado aleatorio en el mapa de destino y quedarán aturdidas durante unos segundos a causa del viaje.

Rule.Original: Hurls a weak bolt of electricity to strike a small target area, at a distance scaling with psychic sensitivity. Burns on direct hits and inflicts area EMP damage.
Rule.Raw: Hurls a weak bolt of electricity to strike a small target area, at a distance scaling with psychic sensitivity. Burns on direct hits and inflicts area EMP damage.
Rule.Translated: Lanza un pequeño rayo de electricidad para golpear a un objetivo pequeño, infligiendo quemaduras leves en los impactos directos y daños por pulso electromagnético dentro del área.

Rule.Original: Fires a living bolt of electricity at a target which can leak out onto nearby targets, the amount scaling with psychic sensitivity. Inflicts small burns and EMP damage.
Rule.Raw: Fires a living bolt of electricity at a target which can leak out onto nearby targets, the amount scaling with psychic sensitivity. Inflicts small burns and EMP damage.
Rule.Translated: Proyecta un rayo viviente de electricidad hacia un objetivo que puede propagarse hacia otros 5 objetivos cercanos, infligiendo pequeñas quemaduras y daños por pulso electromagnético.

Rule.Original: Summons a bolt of lightning to strike a target, inflicting burns on direct hits and a larger area EMP damage. The impact radius scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity, up to a maximum of 12 cells.
Rule.Raw: Summons a bolt of lightning to strike a target, inflicting burns on direct hits and a larger area EMP damage. The impact radius scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity, up to a maximum of 12 cells.
Rule.Translated: Convoca un rayo para que golpee a un objetivo, infligiendo quemaduras en los impactos directos y daños por pulso electromagnético en un área más amplia.

Rule.Original: The caster designates a nearby target to receive an aura of surging electricity, which will inflict EMP effects on anything foreign that they approach, including structures, pawns and electrical objects.
Rule.Raw: The caster designates a nearby target to receive an aura of surging electricity, which will inflict EMP effects on anything foreign that they approach, including structures, pawns and electrical objects.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador designa a un objetivo cercano para que se vea envuelto en un aura de electricidad, que causará los mismos efectos que un pulso electromagnético a cualquier objeto que se acerque, incluyendo estructuras, personas y objetos eléctricos.

Rule.Original: Carefully and delicately tunes a stream of electricity to a touched battery to charge it with 100kW or the equivalent of 100 Wd/s. The duration of charge depends on the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Carefully and delicately tunes a stream of electricity to a touched battery to charge it with 100kW or the equivalent of 100 Wd/s. The duration of charge depends on the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Dirige con cuidado y delicadeza un chorro de electricidad hacia una batería tocada para cargarla con una potencia de 100 kW, el equivalente a 100 Wd/s. La duración de la carga depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.

Rule.Original: The caster compresses a ball of condensed electricity which will slowly move to a designated location. A few seconds after release, it will start discharging into nearby surrounding targets with living bolts of electricity.
Rule.Raw: The caster compresses a ball of condensed electricity which will slowly move to a designated location. A few seconds after release, it will start discharging into nearby surrounding targets with living bolts of electricity.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador comprime una bola de electricidad que se desplazará lentamente hasta el lugar designado. Unos segundos después de soltarla, empezará a descargarse sobre los objetivos cercanos en forma de potentes rayos.

Rule.Original: The caster dumps a massive amount of voltage into the surrounding air, causing an EMP blast in a huge radius which is otherwise harmless.
Rule.Raw: The caster dumps a massive amount of voltage into the surrounding air, causing an EMP blast in a huge radius which is otherwise harmless.
