Rule.Translated: El lanzador aplica una enorme cantidad de voltaje al aire circundante, provocando un pulso electromagnético en un radio enorme que, por lo demás, es inofensivo.

Rule.Original: Manifests a gaping vortex of high-voltage electricity - redirected via skipgate from a nebula storm - at a target area with a large effect. Severely hampers movement and manipulating proportionately, with the strongest effect at the center.
Rule.Raw: Manifests a gaping vortex of high-voltage electricity - redirected via skipgate from a nebula storm - at a target area with a large effect. Severely hampers movement and manipulating proportionately, with the strongest effect at the center.
Rule.Translated: Manifiesta un enorme vórtice de electricidad de alto voltaje mediante un teleportal que conduce hacia una nebulosa tormentosa sobre la zona designada con un gran efecto. Reduce drásticamente la capacidad de movimiento y manipulación, de una forma proporcional a la distancia al centro.

Rule.Original: The caster forcibly changes the weather - using widespread differential-pressure skipgates - to a downpour with hurricane-force winds, which lasts as long as the caster can manage the heat accumulation and can instantly stop at-will. Those outdoors will experience progressively severe limitations to sight, moving and manipulation to the point they come to a complete stop.
Rule.Raw: The caster forcibly changes the weather - using widespread differential-pressure skipgates - to a downpour with hurricane-force winds, which lasts as long as the caster can manage the heat accumulation and can instantly stop at-will. Those outdoors will experience progressively severe limitations to sight, moving and manipulation to the point they come to a complete stop.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador cambia por la fuerza el clima mediante el uso de teleportales con una gran diferencia de presiones, generando un aguacero con vientos huracanados que dura tanto como el lanzador pueda controlar la acumulación de calor y que puede detener instantáneamente a voluntad. Los que estén en el exterior experimentarán limitaciones progresivamente severas para ver, moverse y manipular hasta el punto de quedar completamente parados.

Rule.Original: Use concentrated differential-pressure skipgates in the atmosphere to generate a localized flashstorm. The storm will strike the area with lightning for some time before dissipating.
Rule.Raw: Use concentrated differential-pressure skipgates in the atmosphere to generate a localized flashstorm. The storm will strike the area with lightning for some time before dissipating.
Rule.Translated: Crea una tormenta eléctrica mediante teleportales con una gran diferencia de presiones dispersos en la atmósfera. La tormenta descargará rayos sobre la zona designada durante algún tiempo antes de disiparse.

Rule.Original: Psychically manipulate an object or structure to improve its overall quality. Maximum quality depends on psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Psychically manipulate an object or structure to improve its overall quality. Maximum quality depends on psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador se concentra en un objeto e intenta mejorar su calidad remodelando ligeramente los materiales, aunque no podrá imitar la obra de un maestro.

Rule.Original: Psychically manipulate an object or structure to restore its condition. Requires high psychic sensitivity for any meaningful restoration.
Rule.Raw: Psychically manipulate an object or structure to restore its condition. Requires high psychic sensitivity for any meaningful restoration.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador se concentra en un objeto e intenta reparar el daño presente recomponiendo el material, con un efecto proporcional a su sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Converts the caster’s neural heat into compressed metaphysical pearls. Completely harmless, but dumps a tremendous amount of neural heat into a small area when shattered.
Rule.Raw: Converts the caster’s neural heat into compressed metaphysical pearls. Completely harmless, but dumps a tremendous amount of neural heat into a small area when shattered.
Rule.Translated: Convierte una cantidad mínima de la entropía del lanzador en perlas metafísicas. Pueden lanzarse a otros psíquicos para inducir en ellos grandes cantidades de entropía, pero aparte de eso son inofensivas.

Rule.Original: Subjects an area to psychic interference, temporarily reconfiguring up to 3 automated weapons systems to protect the caster and their allies. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Subjects an area to psychic interference, temporarily reconfiguring up to 3 automated weapons systems to protect the caster and their allies. Duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Designa una zona para que experimente interferencias psíquicas, haciendo que los sistemas de identificación electrónicos de las torretas y otros dispositivos similares se confundan, e identifiquen a las personas que pertenezcan a la misma facción que el lanzador como aliados. La duración depende de la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Metaphysically alters the designated equipment’s power input to extract energy directly from fluctuations in the quantum foam for a few days. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Metaphysically alters the designated equipment’s power input to extract energy directly from fluctuations in the quantum foam for a few days. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Altera metafísicamente la entrada de energía del aparato eléctrico designado para que extraiga energía directamente de las fluctuaciones de la espuma cuántica durante unos días. La duración de este efecto es proporcional a la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Compresses a portion of the caster’s neural heat tolerance into metaphysical crystals, then implanting them into a stone chunk. Creates a construct capable of simple chores. Breaking the crystals restores heat tolerance.
Rule.Raw: Compresses a portion of the caster’s neural heat tolerance into metaphysical crystals, then implanting them into a stone chunk. Creates a construct capable of simple chores. Breaking the crystals restores heat tolerance.
Rule.Translated: Convierte una cantidad mínima de la capacidad máxima de entropía del lanzador en cristales metafísicos que se implantan en un trozo de roca. Este nuevo constructo rocoso es capaz de realizar tareas sencillas. Cuando se rompen los cristales, se recupera la capacidad de entropía perdida.

Rule.Original: Compresses a portion of the caster’s neural heat tolerance into metaphysical crystals, then implanting them into steel slag. Creates a construct that guards the caster. Breaking the crystals restores heat tolerance.
Rule.Raw: Compresses a portion of the caster’s neural heat tolerance into metaphysical crystals, then implanting them into steel slag. Creates a construct that guards the caster. Breaking the crystals restores heat tolerance.
Rule.Translated: Convierte una cantidad mínima de la capacidad máxima de entropía del lanzador en cristales metafísicos que se implantan en un trozo de chatarra. Este nuevo constructo metálico acompañará al lanzador y lo defenderá de cualquier amenaza. Cuando se rompen los cristales, se recupera la capacidad de entropía perdida.

Rule.Original: Psychically alters the form of a piece of eltex into the shape of a ring, which is imbued with psycasting knowledge of the caster. When worn by another psycaster, this temporarily allows them to use this knowledge to perform the stored psycast without practice.
Rule.Raw: Psychically alters the form of a piece of eltex into the shape of a ring, which is imbued with psycasting knowledge of the caster. When worn by another psycaster, this temporarily allows them to use this knowledge to perform the stored psycast without practice.
Rule.Translated: Altera psíquicamente un trozo de eltex para darle la forma de un anillo, y lo imbuye con la sabiduría del lanzador. Cuando lo lleva puesto otro psíquico, podrá acceder temporalmente estos conocimientos y utilizar las habilidades psíquicas almacenadas sin necesidad de aprenderlas.

Rule.Original: Speak words encouraging problem solving capabilities while psychically hypercharging the target’s mind with keen insight. The target will experience double research speed and intellectual skill gain for 5 days, scaling with their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Speak words encouraging problem solving capabilities while psychically hypercharging the target’s mind with keen insight. The target will experience double research speed and intellectual skill gain for 5 days, scaling with their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Pronuncia palabras que estimulan la capacidad de resolver problemas a la vez que sobrecarga psíquicamente la mente del objetivo con una aguda perspicacia. El objetivo duplicará su velocidad de investigación y aumentará sus habilidades intelectuales durante 5 días, de acuerdo con su sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Psychically manipulate an object or structure to learn its history and principles, annihilating it in the process. Extremely taxing, resulting in the caster falling into a temporary coma.
Rule.Raw: Psychically manipulate an object or structure to learn its history and principles, annihilating it in the process. Extremely taxing, resulting in the caster falling into a temporary coma.
Rule.Translated: El lanzador se concentra en un objeto e intenta desentrañar los conocimientos necesarios para fabricar más. La larga e intensa concentración hace que el lanzador entre en coma durante 12 horas.

Rule.Original: Psychically augments the muscle fibers, ligaments and joints in the caster’s legs, tripling their movement speed for roughly two minutes depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Psychically augments the muscle fibers, ligaments and joints in the caster’s legs, tripling their movement speed for roughly two minutes depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Mejora psíquicamente las fibras musculares, los ligamentos y las articulaciones de las piernas del usuario, triplicando su velocidad de movimiento durante unos dos minutos. Esta duración varía en función de la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Psychically augments the muscle fibers, ligaments and joints in the caster’s arms, doubling their melee attack speed for roughly two minutes depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Psychically augments the muscle fibers, ligaments and joints in the caster’s arms, doubling their melee attack speed for roughly two minutes depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Mejora psíquicamente las fibras musculares, los ligamentos y las articulaciones de los brazos del usuario, duplicando su velocidad de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo durante unos dos minutos. Esta duración varía en función de la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Psychically augments the hands, eyes and reaction speed of the caster, reducing their ranged attack cooldown by 80% for roughly two minutes depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Psychically augments the hands, eyes and reaction speed of the caster, reducing their ranged attack cooldown by 80% for roughly two minutes depending on their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Mejora psíquicamente la destreza manual, la visión y la velocidad de reacción del usuario, reduciendo el tiempo de enfriamiento de su ataque a distancia en un 80% durante unos dos minutos. Esta duración varía en función de la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Drastically augments the caster’s legs, feet and spine to be able to leap great distances and land without injury, the distance improving with the user’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Drastically augments the caster’s legs, feet and spine to be able to leap great distances and land without injury, the distance improving with the user’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Mejora drásticamente las piernas, los pies y la columna vertebral del usuario para que pueda saltar grandes distancias y aterrizar sin heridas. La distancia abarcada aumenta según la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Psychically induces a surge of adrenaline in the caster, blocking all pain and augmenting their sight, hearing and movement. Lasts roughly thirty seconds depending on the user’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Psychically induces a surge of adrenaline in the caster, blocking all pain and augmenting their sight, hearing and movement. Lasts roughly thirty seconds depending on the user’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Induce psíquicamente un aumento de adrenalina en el usuario, lo que anula todo el dolor y mejora su vista, oído y velocidad de movimiento durante unos treinta segundos. Esta duración varía en función de la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Psychically augments the caster’s prowess and killing urges, doubling their damage output with all weapons. Each kill reduces the caster’s heat by 10 and resets the duration of the frenzy.
Rule.Raw: Psychically augments the caster’s prowess and killing urges, doubling their damage output with all weapons. Each kill reduces the caster’s heat by 10 and resets the duration of the frenzy.
Rule.Translated: Mejora psíquicamente la destreza y el instinto asesino del usuario, duplicando la cantidad de daño que produce con cualquier arma. Cada muerte reduce en diez unidades la entropía del usuario y reinicia la duración del frenesí.

Rule.Original: Projects a psychic aura for a few moments that allows the caster to alter the path of any bullet they fire, effectively doubling their weapon range and guaranteeing hits for the duration. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Raw: Projects a psychic aura for a few moments that allows the caster to alter the path of any bullet they fire, effectively doubling their weapon range and guaranteeing hits for the duration. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity of the caster.
Rule.Translated: Proyecta un aura psíquica durante 8 segundos que permite al usuario alterar la trayectoria de cualquier bala que dispare, duplicando el alcance de su arma y garantizando el impacto mientras dure el efecto.

Rule.Original: Psychically command the target to approach the caster.
Rule.Raw: Psychically command the target to approach the caster.
Rule.Translated: Ordena psíquicamente al objetivo que se acerque al usuario.

Rule.Original: Teleports to the target and executes a melee strike, weakened or augmented by the caster’s melee skill. If the target is killed, teleports to the next closest enemy at no cost and attacks again, until there is nothing left to kill.
Rule.Raw: Teleports to the target and executes a melee strike, weakened or augmented by the caster’s melee skill. If the target is killed, teleports to the next closest enemy at no cost and attacks again, until there is nothing left to kill.
Rule.Translated: Permite teletransportarse hasta un objetivo y ejecutar un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo, debilitado o aumentado según la habilidad cuerpo a cuerpo del lanzador. Si el objetivo muere, el usuario se teletransporta hasta el siguiente enemigo más cercano sin ningún coste adicional y ataca de nuevo, repitiendo el proceso hasta que no quede nada que matar.

Rule.Original: Psychically command the targets within an area to approach the caster.
Rule.Raw: Psychically command the targets within an area to approach the caster.
Rule.Translated: Ordena psíquicamente a los objetivos dentro de un área que se acerquen al usuario.

Rule.Original: Infuses a fertile area with chaotic life energy, causing it to sprout shoots of brambles that wither after 12 hours.
Rule.Raw: Infuses a fertile area with chaotic life energy, causing it to sprout shoots of brambles that wither after 12 hours.
Rule.Translated: Infunde una zona fértil con energía vital caótica, haciendo que broten zarzas que se marchitan al cabo de 12 horas.

Rule.Original: Infuses a fertile area with life energy, causing it to sprout plantable crops that finish growth in relation to the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Infuses a fertile area with life energy, causing it to sprout plantable crops that finish growth in relation to the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Infunde una zona fértil con energía vital, haciendo que broten cosechas cuyo nivel de desarrollo depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Soothe an animal using psychic suggestion, either calming a manhunting animal or taming them. Depending on the psychic sensitivity of the caster and the body size of an animal, the psycast may backfire and turn the animal manhunter.
Rule.Raw: Soothe an animal using psychic suggestion, either calming a manhunting animal or taming them. Depending on the psychic sensitivity of the caster and the body size of an animal, the psycast may backfire and turn the animal manhunter.
Rule.Translated: Apacigua a un animal utilizando la sugestión psíquica, ya sea calmando su furia cazahombres o domesticándolo. Esta habilidad puede fallar y hacer que el animal enloquezca en su lugar, en función de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador y del tamaño del objetivo.

Rule.Original: Drive animals in a large area into a manhunting rage using a psychic pulse, lasting a minute. Considered a declaration of war if it affects the animals in a caravan.
Rule.Raw: Drive animals in a large area into a manhunting rage using a psychic pulse, lasting a minute. Considered a declaration of war if it affects the animals in a caravan.
Rule.Translated: Provoca la furia de los animales de una zona extensa mediante un pulso psíquico de un minuto de duración. Se considera una declaración de guerra si afecta a los animales de una caravana.

Rule.Original: Infuses a fertile area with potent life energy, causing it to sprout fully grown native trees. The effective radius scales with psychic sensitivity, up to a maximum of 8 tiles.
Rule.Raw: Infuses a fertile area with potent life energy, causing it to sprout fully grown native trees. The effective radius scales with psychic sensitivity, up to a maximum of 8 tiles.
Rule.Translated: Infunde una gran zona fértil con una gran cantidad de energía vital, haciendo que crezcan árboles nativos completamente desarrollados. El radio de acción aumenta cuanto mayor sea la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario, hasta un máximo de 8 celdas.

Rule.Original: Generates spherical skipgates on all colony animals in range that sends all incoming and outgoing ground-level projectiles to some distant place. People and items are not affected and the duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Generates spherical skipgates on all colony animals in range that sends all incoming and outgoing ground-level projectiles to some distant place. People and items are not affected and the duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Genera teleportales esféricos alrededor de todos los animales de la colonia dentro del alcance. Estos envían todos los proyectiles entrantes y salientes a ras del suelo a un lugar distante. Las personas y los objetos no se ven afectados y la duración de este efecto depende de la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Infuses a large area with harmonic life force that influences animal behavior, causing them to attack those hostile to the caster for a duration scaling with their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Infuses a large area with harmonic life force that influences animal behavior, causing them to attack those hostile to the caster for a duration scaling with their psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Infunde un área extensa con una fuerza vital armónica que influye en el comportamiento de los animales, haciendo que ataquen a aquellos seres que sean hostiles con el usuario durante un tiempo proporcional a su sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Generate a spherical skipgate on a nature shrine that sends any incoming and outgoing projectiles, including mortar shells, to some distant place. People and items are not affected and the size of the sphere depends on the size of the shrine, while duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Generate a spherical skipgate on a nature shrine that sends any incoming and outgoing projectiles, including mortar shells, to some distant place. People and items are not affected and the size of the sphere depends on the size of the shrine, while duration scales with the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Genera un gran teleportal esférico alrededor de un santuario de la naturaleza que envía todos los proyectiles entrantes y salientes, incluyendo proyectiles de mortero, hacia un lugar distante. Las personas y los objetos no se ven afectados. El tamaño de la esfera depende del tamaño del santuario, y la duración de esta habilidad de la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: Infuses the life force of another nearby person into a colony animal, linking them and putting the caster in a coma. Should the linked person die, the linked animal will go to their side and transfer their own harmonized life essence to them, dying upon completion. Should the linked animal die first, the effect is lost, and there can only be one link at a time.
Rule.Raw: Infuses the life force of another nearby person into a colony animal, linking them and putting the caster in a coma. Should the linked person die, the linked animal will go to their side and transfer their own harmonized life essence to them, dying upon completion. Should the linked animal die first, the effect is lost, and there can only be one link at a time.
Rule.Translated: Infunde parte de la fuerza vital de una persona cercana en un animal de la colonia, vinculándolos a la vez que el usuario entra en coma psíquico durante 6 horas. Si la persona vinculada muere, el animal vinculado irá a su lado y le transferirá su propia esencia vital armonizada, muriendo en el proceso. Si es el animal vinculado el que muere primero, el efecto se pierde. Solo puede haber un vínculo activo al mismo tiempo.

Rule.Original: Sends out a pulse of lifeforce into the region, inducing territorial manhunting aggression into numerous animals that will appear to defend the colony. Once all invaders are defeated, the animals will return to their homes. The relative strength of the creatures summoned is influenced by the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Sends out a pulse of lifeforce into the region, inducing territorial manhunting aggression into numerous animals that will appear to defend the colony. Once all invaders are defeated, the animals will return to their homes. The relative strength of the creatures summoned is influenced by the caster’s psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Envía un pulso de fuerza vital a la región, induciendo agresividad territorial cazahombres en numerosos animales que aparecerán para defender la colonia. Una vez que todos los invasores son derrotados, los animales regresarán a sus hogares. La fuerza relativa de las criaturas convocadas dependen de la sensibilidad psíquica del lanzador.
{0} ha muerto a causa de la putrefacción.

Rule.Original: A Chronopath is pausing a raid.
Rule.Raw: A Chronopath is pausing a raid.
Rule.Translated: Un cronópata está pausando un asalto.

Rule.Original: A Staticlord is creating a hurricane.
Rule.Raw: A Staticlord is creating a hurricane.
Rule.Translated: Un señor estático está creando un huracán.

Rule.Original: A freak localized storm is blasting a small area with repeated lightning strikes.
Rule.Raw: A freak localized storm is blasting a small area with repeated lightning strikes.
Rule.Translated: Una extraña tormenta localizada azota una pequeña zona con repetidos relámpagos.

Rule.Original: A freak localized flashstorm is striking a small area with lightning. This can cause massive fires.
Rule.Raw: A freak localized flashstorm is striking a small area with lightning. This can cause massive fires.
Rule.Translated: Una tormenta eléctrica localizada está golpeando una pequeña zona con rayos. Esto puede provocar incendios masivos.

Rule.Original: All areas on this zone with less than 50% light levels have been plunged into pitch darkness.
Rule.Raw: All areas on this zone with less than 50% light levels have been plunged into pitch darkness.
Rule.Translated: Un acechador nocturno está oscureciendo las sombras aún más.
Las sombras vuelven a la normalidad.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced mind control, giving absolute control to another person.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced mind control, giving absolute control to another person.
Rule.Translated: Control mental inducido psíquicamente, que otorga el control absoluto de esta persona a otra.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced mind scramble, caused by attempting to be two people at once.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced mind scramble, caused by attempting to be two people at once.
Rule.Translated: Confusión mental inducida psíquicamente, causada por intentar ser dos personas al mismo tiempo.
Orientación psíquica inducida por otra persona.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced absence of mind caused by giving guidance to another person.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced absence of mind caused by giving guidance to another person.
Rule.Translated: Ausencia de mente inducida psíquicamente causada por orientar a otra persona.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced luck that allows this person to always hit their target, and never be hit by their enemy.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced luck that allows this person to always hit their target, and never be hit by their enemy.
Rule.Translated: Un soplo de buena suerte inducido psíquicamente que permite a esta persona acertar siempre en su objetivo, y nunca ser alcanzado por su enemigo.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced bad luck that stops this person from ever hitting their target, whilst always being hit by the enemy.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced bad luck that stops this person from ever hitting their target, whilst always being hit by the enemy.
Rule.Translated: Un soplo de mala suerte inducido psíquicamente que impide que esta persona pueda acertar a su objetivo, a la vez que hace que siempre sea alcanzada por el enemigo.

Rule.Original: Electricity is being channeled to a nearby battery.
Rule.Raw: Electricity is being channeled to a nearby battery.
Rule.Translated: Energía eléctrica que está siendo canalizada psíquicamente hacia una batería cercana.

Rule.Original: An electirical vortex is causing difficulty moving.
Rule.Raw: An electirical vortex is causing difficulty moving.
Rule.Translated: Un vórtice eléctrico está causando dificultades para moverse.

Rule.Original: A hurricane is causing difficulty moving and seeing.
Rule.Raw: A hurricane is causing difficulty moving and seeing.
Rule.Translated: Un huracán está causando dificultades para moverse y ver.

Rule.Original: Waves of serenity emanate deep from within, bringing peace of mind and lowering consciousness.
Rule.Raw: Waves of serenity emanate deep from within, bringing peace of mind and lowering consciousness.
Rule.Translated: Una sensación de serenidad que emana de lo más profundo del ser, aportando paz mental y reduciendo la conciencia.

Rule.Original: Age-related psychic sickness greatly reducing manipulation and consciousness.
Rule.Raw: Age-related psychic sickness greatly reducing manipulation and consciousness.
Rule.Translated: Enfermedad psíquica relacionada con la edad que reduce en gran medida la capacidad de manipulación y la conciencia.

Rule.Original: A strong psychic force affecting every enemy humanlike in the area, making them feel more disturbed, terrified, and paranoid.
Rule.Raw: A strong psychic force affecting every enemy humanlike in the area, making them feel more disturbed, terrified, and paranoid.
Rule.Translated: Una fuerte fuerza psíquica que afecta a todos los humanos enemigos de la zona, haciéndolos sentir más perturbados, aterrorizados y paranoicos.

Rule.Original: A psychic shield that protects from hypothermia and freezer enemies that interact with it.
Rule.Raw: A psychic shield that protects from hypothermia and freezer enemies that interact with it.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo psíquico que protege de la hipotermia y congela a cualquier enemigo que interactúe con él.

Rule.Original: A heavily damaging and freezing ray of frost.
Rule.Raw: A heavily damaging and freezing ray of frost.
Rule.Translated: Un rayo de escarcha fuertemente dañino y helador.

Rule.Original: This entity is completely frozen in a block of ice, and will not be able to move until it melts.
Rule.Raw: This entity is completely frozen in a block of ice, and will not be able to move until it melts.
Rule.Translated: Esta entidad está completamente congelada en un bloque de hielo, y no podrá moverse hasta que se derrita.
Esta persona está preparando una ventisca.

Rule.Original: A huge wind with extreme snow that lowers sight, manipulation and movement speed.
Rule.Raw: A huge wind with extreme snow that lowers sight, manipulation and movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme viento con nieve extrema que está reduciendo la capacidad de visión, la capacidad de manipulación y la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: Psychically hacked programming that disrupts the IFF operations.
Rule.Raw: Psychically hacked programming that disrupts the IFF operations.
Rule.Translated: Una especie de programación psíquica que confunde los sistemas de identificación electrónicos de las torretas y otros dispositivos similares.

Rule.Original: Generating infinite electricity supply to a given structure.
Rule.Raw: Generating infinite electricity supply to a given structure.
Rule.Translated: Genera un suministro infinito de electricidad a una estructura determinada.

Rule.Original: An overshield that protects the animal from any ranged attacks.
Rule.Raw: An overshield that protects the animal from any ranged attacks.
Rule.Translated: Un sobreescudo que protege al animal de cualquier ataque a distancia.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced feelings of clarity and curiosity. This improves research speed as well as skill gain speed.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced feelings of clarity and curiosity. This improves research speed as well as skill gain speed.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de sensaciones de claridad y curiosidad inducidas psíquicamente. Esto mejora la velocidad de investigación y la velocidad de adquisición de habilidades.

Rule.Original: Psychically-split fragment of someone's personality imbued in this very being.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-split fragment of someone's personality imbued in this very being.
Rule.Translated: Fragmento psíquico de la personalidad de alguien imbuido en este mismo ser.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced ability to see through the darkness and shadows.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced ability to see through the darkness and shadows.
Rule.Translated: Capacidad psíquica de ver a través de la oscuridad y las sombras.
Mejora de la velocidad de trabajo inducida psíquicamente.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced, self-satisfying perceptual distortions, giving a temporary mood boost.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced, self-satisfying perceptual distortions, giving a temporary mood boost.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de distorsiones perceptivas autocomplacientes inducidas psíquicamente. Otorga un plus al estado de humor.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced link between several entities. Any 'word of' psycast will resonate between all linked individuals.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced link between several entities. Any 'word of' psycast will resonate between all linked individuals.
Rule.Translated: Un vínculo inducido psíquicamente entre varias entidades. Cualquier uso de una habilidad «palabra de» resonará entre todos los individuos vinculados.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced physical protection from incoming damage.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced physical protection from incoming damage.
Rule.Translated: Protección física inducida psíquicamente contra el daño recibido.

Rule.Original: Strong psychic suggestion that reshapes reality in the eyes of the affected individuals, making them perceive their every day life as that of a luxury.
Rule.Raw: Strong psychic suggestion that reshapes reality in the eyes of the affected individuals, making them perceive their every day life as that of a luxury.
Rule.Translated: Una fuerte sugestión psíquica que remodela la realidad a los ojos del individuo afectado, haciéndole percibir su vida cotidiana como una envuelta en lujos.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced mass necrosis, causing living and healthy limbs and organs to rot on the victim.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced mass necrosis, causing living and healthy limbs and organs to rot on the victim.
Rule.Translated: Una necrosis masiva inducida psíquicamente, que hace que los miembros y órganos vivos y sanos se pudran en la víctima.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced vitality stolen from another person.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced vitality stolen from another person.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto revitalizante psíquicamente inducido gracias al robo de la vitalidad de otra persona.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced weakness caused by vitality being stolen by another person.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced weakness caused by vitality being stolen by another person.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto debilitante psíquicamente inducido debido al robo de la vitalidad de esta persona.
Un efecto de desfase cuántico inducido psíquicamente en la materia de esta criatura.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced link with a spirit of a deceased individual.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced link with a spirit of a deceased individual.
Rule.Translated: Un vínculo psíquico con el espíritu de un difunto.

Rule.Original: The amount of bodies that were consumed using the Consume Bodies psycast. Each body consumed increases a maximum neural heat by 1.
Rule.Raw: The amount of bodies that were consumed using the Consume Bodies psycast. Each body consumed increases a maximum neural heat by 1.
Rule.Translated: La cantidad de cuerpos que se han consumido con la habilidad psíquica «consumo de cuerpos». Cada cuerpo consumido aumenta el límite de entropía neuronal máximo en 1.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced immortality that lasts for one day.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced immortality that lasts for one day.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto de inmortalidad inducido psíquicamente. El efecto dura unas 24 horas.
Un efecto de invisibilidad inducido psíquicamente.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced increase to psychic sensitivity based on the lack of light around the psycaster.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced increase to psychic sensitivity based on the lack of light around the psycaster.
Rule.Translated: Un aumento de la sensibilidad psíquica inducido por la falta de luz alrededor del psíquico.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced limb removal caused by a powerful psycast. This body part will not regrow under any circumstances, even after using powerful healing artifacts.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced limb removal caused by a powerful psycast. This body part will not regrow under any circumstances, even after using powerful healing artifacts.
Rule.Translated: La extirpación de un miembro inducida psíquicamente por una potente habilidad psíquica. Esta parte del cuerpo no volverá a crecer bajo ninguna circunstancia, ni siquiera tras usar poderosos artefactos curativos.

Rule.Original: This creature has a reduced pain sensitivity, and it takes longer to be downed due to pain.
Rule.Raw: This creature has a reduced pain sensitivity, and it takes longer to be downed due to pain.
Rule.Translated: Esta criatura tiene una sensibilidad al dolor reducida. Tardará más en ser abatida debido al dolor.

Rule.Original: A state of psychic chaos in the brain and mind. Caused by psychic attacks or critical level of neural heat, this effect is debilitating until it wears off.
Rule.Raw: A state of psychic chaos in the brain and mind. Caused by psychic attacks or critical level of neural heat, this effect is debilitating until it wears off.
Rule.Translated: Un estado de caos psíquico en el cerebro y la mente. Causado por ataques psíquicos o un nivel crítico de entropía neuronal, este efecto es debilitante hasta que desaparece.
Una mejora en la capacidad de curación inducida psíquicamente.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced stasis that stops any bleeding.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced stasis that stops any bleeding.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto de estasis inducido psíquicamente que detiene cualquier hemorragia.
Una mejora en la velocidad de inmunización inducida psíquicamente.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced personal skipbarrier. Impenetrable by ranged projectiles.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced personal skipbarrier. Impenetrable by ranged projectiles.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera de teleportales personal inducida psíquicamente. Impenetrable por proyectiles a distancia.

Rule.Original: Psychically crafted defensive barrier that generates large amounts of psychic heat in order to sustain itself.
Rule.Raw: Psychically crafted defensive barrier that generates large amounts of psychic heat in order to sustain itself.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera defensiva psíquica que genera grandes cantidades de entropía neuronal para mantenerse activa.

Rule.Original: Psychically-induced tissue regeneration, which can close open wounds and regenerate missing body parts.
Rule.Raw: Psychically-induced tissue regeneration, which can close open wounds and regenerate missing body parts.
Rule.Translated: Un proceso de regeneración de tejidos inducido psíquicamente, que puede cerrar heridas abiertas y regenerar partes del cuerpo perdidas.

Rule.Original: A shield of fire, sets melee attackers on fire
Rule.Raw: A shield of fire, sets melee attackers on fire
Rule.Translated: Un escudo de fuego, capaz de prender fuego a los atacantes cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: An aura of static electricity, causes EMP damage to everything around
Rule.Raw: An aura of static electricity, causes EMP damage to everything around
Rule.Translated: Un aura de electricidad estática que causa daños por pulsos electromagnéticos a su alrededor.

Rule.Original: Psychically induced agility boost, greatly increasing movement speed.
Rule.Raw: Psychically induced agility boost, greatly increasing movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Un aumento de la agilidad inducido psíquicamente, que incrementa enormemente la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: Psychically induced combat focus, greatly enhancing melee combat capabilities.
Rule.Raw: Psychically induced combat focus, greatly enhancing melee combat capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de trance de combate inducido psíquicamente, que mejora enormemente las capacidades de combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Psychically induced combat focus, greatly enhancing ranged combat capabilities.
Rule.Raw: Psychically induced combat focus, greatly enhancing ranged combat capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de trance de combate inducido psíquicamente, que mejora enormemente las capacidades de combate a distancia.

Rule.Original: Psychically induced adrenaline rush, increasing sight, hearing and movement capabilities.
Rule.Raw: Psychically induced adrenaline rush, increasing sight, hearing and movement capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Un subidón de adrenalina inducido psíquicamente, que aumenta la capacidad de visión, audición y movimiento.

Rule.Original: Temporary, psychically induced frenzy. The energy restores itself with each consecutive kill.
Rule.Raw: Temporary, psychically induced frenzy. The energy restores itself with each consecutive kill.
Rule.Translated: Un estado de frenesí temporal inducido psíquicamente. La energía se restaura con cada muerte consecutiva.
Una precisión de disparo demente inducida psíquicamente.

Rule.Original: A large meteorite has struck ground in the area. It has left behind a lump of eltex. Eltex can be used to create psyfocus-enhancing gear, or sold to the Empire to gain honor.
Rule.Raw: A large meteorite has struck ground in the area. It has left behind a lump of eltex. Eltex can be used to create psyfocus-enhancing gear, or sold to the Empire to gain honor.
Rule.Translated: Un gran meteorito ha impactado contra el suelo en las cercanías. Ha dejado tras de sí un trozo de eltex. El eltex puede usarse para crear equipo que mejore el psifoco o venderse al Imperio para obtener honor.

Rule.Original:
These raiders seem to be led by a powerful psycaster. Psycasters can use psychic powers to manipulate the battlefield and easily tip the scales of the conflict. You should watch out for them, and prioritise targeting them when you see that they are about to cast a psycast.
Psycasters in this group:
Rule.Raw:
These raiders seem to be led by a powerful psycaster. Psycasters can use psychic powers to manipulate the battlefield and easily tip the scales of the conflict. You should watch out for them, and prioritise targeting them when you see that they are about to cast a psycast.
Psycasters in this group:
Rule.Translated:
Parece que estos asaltantes están dirigidos por un poderoso psíquico. Los psíquicos pueden utilizar sus poderes para alterar el campo de batalla y cambiar fácilmente el curso del conflicto. Vigílalos y dales prioridad como objetivos cuando veas que están a punto de lanzar un poder.
Psíquicos de este grupo:

Rule.Original: They are moving in to help you immediately.
Rule.Raw: They are moving in to help you immediately.
Rule.Translated: Se dirigen a ayudarte de inmediato.

Rule.Original: {0} is no longer wandering in sadness.
Rule.Raw: {0} is no longer wandering in sadness.

Rule.Original: {0} has broken down and is wandering around in sadness.
Rule.Raw: {0} has broken down and is wandering around in sadness.
Rule.Translated: {0} ha sufrido una crisis nerviosa y se ha puesto a pasear con tristeza.
¡{0} se ha vuelto un cazahombres territorial!

Rule.Original: {0}'s territorial defense instincts have come to an end.
Rule.Raw: {0}'s territorial defense instincts have come to an end.
Rule.Translated: Los instintos de defensa territorial de {0} han llegado a su fin.

Rule.Original: {0}'s rage has come to an end.
Rule.Raw: {0}'s rage has come to an end.
Rule.Translated: La furia de {0} ha llegado a su fin.

Rule.Original: Empath psycasts are focused on enhancing the mood of others, one way or another.
Rule.Raw: Empath psycasts are focused on enhancing the mood of others, one way or another.
Rule.Translated: Los poderes psíquicos de los empáticos se centran en mejorar el estado de ánimo de los demás, de la forma que sea.

Rule.Original: Empaths are psycasters committed to serving their community and boosting their kin’s spirits. Known to inspire joy with but a few words, as well as snap people out of mental states, particularly powerful empaths can emit strong psychic soothes or even skip blood-related family members from across the globe.
Rule.Raw: Empaths are psycasters committed to serving their community and boosting their kin’s spirits. Known to inspire joy with but a few words, as well as snap people out of mental states, particularly powerful empaths can emit strong psychic soothes or even skip blood-related family members from across the globe.
Rule.Translated: Los empáticos son psíquicos comprometidos con el servicio a su comunidad y la mejora del ánimo de sus familiares y amigos. Conocidos por inspirar alegría con unas pocas palabras, así como por sacar a la gente de sus estados mentales, los empáticos especialmente poderosos pueden emitir fuertes señales de calma psíquica o incluso teletransportar a familiares consanguíneos desde la otra punta del mundo.

Rule.Original: Skipmaster psycasts are focused on using skipgates to change the course of battle or the life of the colony.
Rule.Raw: Skipmaster psycasts are focused on using skipgates to change the course of battle or the life of the colony.
Rule.Translated: Los poderes psíquicos de los maestros del salto se centran en utilizar los portales de salto para cambiar el curso de la batalla o la vida cotidiana en la colonia.

Rule.Original: Skipmasters often served the Empire by establishing convoluted skipdoor networks. Masters of logistics and bending space, they can skip people to desired locations and can even use skipgates for everyday chores - such as creating solar pinholes or skipping water to extinguish flames.
Rule.Raw: Skipmasters often served the Empire by establishing convoluted skipdoor networks. Masters of logistics and bending space, they can skip people to desired locations and can even use skipgates for everyday chores - such as creating solar pinholes or skipping water to extinguish flames.
Rule.Translated: Los maestros del salto a menudo servían al Imperio estableciendo enrevesadas redes de teleportales. Son unos auténticos maestros de la logística y de la flexión del espacio, capaces de trasladar a la gente a los lugares deseados e incluso de utilizar portales para tareas cotidianas, como la creación de orificios solares o el transporte de agua para extinguir llamas.

Rule.Original: Conflagrator path is focused on manipulating fire, heat and energy to eliminate enemies.
Rule.Raw: Conflagrator path is focused on manipulating fire, heat and energy to eliminate enemies.
Rule.Translated: La senda del conflagrador se centra en manipular el fuego, el calor y la energía para eliminar a los enemigos.

Rule.Original: Conflagrators are the masters of flame, capable of eradicating entire regiments of enemy infantry using powerful fire tornadoes and explosions. Greatly respected across all psycaster paths, conflagrators bring fear, death and the stench of burnt meat wherever they go.
Rule.Raw: Conflagrators are the masters of flame, capable of eradicating entire regiments of enemy infantry using powerful fire tornadoes and explosions. Greatly respected across all psycaster paths, conflagrators bring fear, death and the stench of burnt meat wherever they go.
Rule.Translated: Los conflagradores son los maestros de las llamas, capaces de erradicar ejércitos enteros de infantería enemiga mediante poderosos tornados de fuego y explosiones. Los conflagradores, muy respetados en todos los caminos de los lanzadores de conjuros, llevan el miedo, la muerte y el hedor de la carne quemada allá donde van.

Rule.Original: Protector path is focused on providing aid and protection to your pawns, stopping them from dying and allowing you to escape from dangerous situations unscratched.
Rule.Raw: Protector path is focused on providing aid and protection to your pawns, stopping them from dying and allowing you to escape from dangerous situations unscratched.
Rule.Translated: La senda del Protector se centra en proporcionar ayuda y protección a tus colonos, evitando que mueran y permitiéndote escapar ileso de situaciones peligrosas.

Rule.Original: Protectors serve on the front lines, defending the brave soldiers from harm. Not only can they stop projectiles using powerful skipshields, but they can also help the body recover from wounds, as well as boost the natural regeneration and immunity of those in need.
Rule.Raw: Protectors serve on the front lines, defending the brave soldiers from harm. Not only can they stop projectiles using powerful skipshields, but they can also help the body recover from wounds, as well as boost the natural regeneration and immunity of those in need.
Rule.Translated: Los protectores sirven en el frente, defendiendo a los valientes soldados de cualquier daño. No solo pueden detener proyectiles usando potentes escudos de teleportales, sino que también pueden ayudar al cuerpo a recuperarse de las heridas, así como potenciar la regeneración natural y la inmunidad de aquellos que lo necesiten.

Rule.Original: Warlord path is focused on upgrading the warfare capabilities of the Psycaster and psycaster alone - as all the Warlord psycasts are to an extent self-cast.
Rule.Raw: Warlord path is focused on upgrading the warfare capabilities of the Psycaster and psycaster alone - as all the Warlord psycasts are to an extent self-cast.
Rule.Translated: La senda del señor bélico se centra en mejorar las capacidades bélicas de una única persona, el psíquico especializado en ella, ya que todos los poderes psíquicos del señor de la guerra son, en cierta medida, lanzados sobre uno mismo.

Rule.Original: Masters of warfare, warlords serve only themselves, able to improve their perception, reflexes, speed and stamina at will. Feared anywhere they go, a powerful warlord will never miss a shot and their blade will always find its target.
Rule.Raw: Masters of warfare, warlords serve only themselves, able to improve their perception, reflexes, speed and stamina at will. Feared anywhere they go, a powerful warlord will never miss a shot and their blade will always find its target.
Rule.Translated: Los señores bélicos, maestros del campo de batalla, solo se sirven a sí mismos y son capaces de mejorar su percepción, reflejos, velocidad y resistencia a voluntad. Temidos dondequiera que vayan, un poderoso señor bélico fallará un tiro, y su espada siempre encontrará su objetivo.

Rule.Original: Chronopath path is focused on manipulating time, making things older, completing growth of plants, or de-aging your pawns.
Rule.Raw: Chronopath path is focused on manipulating time, making things older, completing growth of plants, or de-aging your pawns.
Rule.Translated: La senda del cronópata se centra en la manipulación del tiempo, hacer que las cosas envejezcan, completar el crecimiento de las plantas o rejuvenecer a tus colonos.

Rule.Original: Chronopaths are rare and mysterious psycasters, capable of manipulating the fabric of time itself. By creating skipgates through time rather than space, chronopaths can have weapons assemble themselves, alter someone’s age at will, and even create bizarre timequakes that accelerate the time of everything around them by dozens of years.
Rule.Raw: Chronopaths are rare and mysterious psycasters, capable of manipulating the fabric of time itself. By creating skipgates through time rather than space, chronopaths can have weapons assemble themselves, alter someone’s age at will, and even create bizarre timequakes that accelerate the time of everything around them by dozens of years.
Rule.Translated: Los cronópatas son unos extraños y misteriosos psíquicos capaces de manipular el propio tejido del tiempo. Al crear teleportales a través del tiempo en lugar de a través del espacio, los cronópatas pueden hacer que se ensamblen armas, alterar la edad de alguien a voluntad e incluso crear extraños cronosismos capaces de acelerar el tiempo de todo lo que les rodea en decenas de años.

Rule.Original: A path so mysterious only imperial scholars can confirm rumours, archotechists are able to tap into archotech engines and exert power so ridiculous and bizarre that it really makes one question their sanity. Archotechists can simply drive entire armies to insanity, and can even manipulate neural heat to mutilate their adversaries.
Rule.Raw: A path so mysterious only imperial scholars can confirm rumours, archotechists are able to tap into archotech engines and exert power so ridiculous and bizarre that it really makes one question their sanity. Archotechists can simply drive entire armies to insanity, and can even manipulate neural heat to mutilate their adversaries.
Rule.Translated: Un camino tan misterioso que solo los eruditos imperiales pueden confirmar, aunque sea solo con rumores. Los arqueotecnistas son capaces de aprovechar los motores arqueotécnicos y ejercer un poder tan ridículo y extraño que realmente hace que uno se cuestione su cordura. Pueden llevar a ejércitos enteros a la locura e incluso manipular la entropía neuronal para mutilar a sus adversarios.

Rule.Original: Necropath is a path focused on distributing fear and death, whilst also gaining from death and corpses. You can resurrect fallen allies, prohibit them from dying and raise hordes of skeletons to fight for your cause.
Rule.Raw: Necropath is a path focused on distributing fear and death, whilst also gaining from death and corpses. You can resurrect fallen allies, prohibit them from dying and raise hordes of skeletons to fight for your cause.
Rule.Translated: La necropatía es la senda que se centra en sembrar el miedo y la muerte, pero también en obtener beneficios de la muerte y los cadáveres. Puedes resucitar a los aliados caídos, evitar que mueran y levantar hordas de esqueletos para que luchen por tu causa.

Rule.Original: Masters of the dark arts, necropaths live to defy death itself. They can cast fear into the hearts of their enemies, emit a paralytic pulse to knock attackers down, rot away the flesh of living bodies and ultimately summon the dead - either through wicked enthrallment or sacred resurrection.
Rule.Raw: Masters of the dark arts, necropaths live to defy death itself. They can cast fear into the hearts of their enemies, emit a paralytic pulse to knock attackers down, rot away the flesh of living bodies and ultimately summon the dead - either through wicked enthrallment or sacred resurrection.
Rule.Translated: Los necrópatas, maestros de las artes oscuras, viven para desafiar a la propia muerte. Pueden infundir miedo en los corazones de sus enemigos, emitir un pulso paralizante para derribar a los atacantes, pudrir la carne de los cuerpos vivos e incluso insuflar vida a los muertos, ya sea mediante un encantamiento maligno o una resurrección sagrada.

Rule.Original: Staticlord is a path focused on blasting enemies with electricity, disabling electronics and controlling the storm itself.
Rule.Raw: Staticlord is a path focused on blasting enemies with electricity, disabling electronics and controlling the storm itself.
Rule.Translated: La senda del señor eléctrico se centra en fulminar a los enemigos con electricidad, inutilizar los dispositivos electrónicos y controlar las mismas tormentas.

Rule.Original: Lords of thunder and lightning, staticlords are excellent psycasters when it comes to controlling the flow of electricity and fighting against mechanoid swarms. They can summon powerful lightning bolts in many shapes and forms, as well as manipulate the weather to generate localised lightning storms and hurricanes.
Rule.Raw: Lords of thunder and lightning, staticlords are excellent psycasters when it comes to controlling the flow of electricity and fighting against mechanoid swarms. They can summon powerful lightning bolts in many shapes and forms, as well as manipulate the weather to generate localised lightning storms and hurricanes.
Rule.Translated: Los señores estáticos, creadores de truenos y relámpagos, son excelentes psíquicos a la hora de controlar las corrientes eléctricas y luchar contra enjambres de mecanoides. Pueden invocar poderosos relámpagos y lanzarlos de múltiples formas, así como manipular el clima para generar tormentas eléctricas y huracanes localizados.

Rule.Original: Archon path is the path of a psychic leader, providing various buffs to the entire colony, but also ruling with an iron fist. It’s also a path that allows you to drain enemy psycasters and gain Psycast levels this way.
Rule.Raw: Archon path is the path of a psychic leader, providing various buffs to the entire colony, but also ruling with an iron fist. It’s also a path that allows you to drain enemy psycasters and gain Psycast levels this way.
Rule.Translated: La senda del arconte es la senda de un líder psíquico, que proporciona varios beneficios a toda la colonia, pero también gobierna con puño de hierro. También es una senda que te permite agotar la energía de los psíquicos enemigos y ganar así niveles de poder psíquico.

Rule.Original: The path of kings, archons often occupy the highest seats in their local governments. Being able to easily bond with others, manipulate their enemies either through friendship or pain, with powerful archons strengthening themselves by draining the psyessence of other psycasters.
Rule.Raw: The path of kings, archons often occupy the highest seats in their local governments. Being able to easily bond with others, manipulate their enemies either through friendship or pain, with powerful archons strengthening themselves by draining the psyessence of other psycasters.
Rule.Translated: Los arcontes, aquellos que se consideran que siguen el camino de los reyes, suelen ocupar los puestos más altos en sus gobiernos locales. Pueden establecer vínculos con los demás fácilmente, manipular a sus enemigos mediante la amistad o el dolor, o drenar psiesencia de otros psíquicos.

Rule.Original: Frostshaper is a path about manipulating the elements, particularly the cold, to your advantage. Not only you get to use the cold to freeze and slow enemies, frostshapers also gain access to many utility psycasts that either construct shelters out of ice blocks, or create cooling crystals that can be used both as a temporary fridge, and a trap.
Rule.Raw: Frostshaper is a path about manipulating the elements, particularly the cold, to your advantage. Not only you get to use the cold to freeze and slow enemies, frostshapers also gain access to many utility psycasts that either construct shelters out of ice blocks, or create cooling crystals that can be used both as a temporary fridge, and a trap.
Rule.Translated: La senda del escarchador gira en torno a la manipulación de los elementos, especialmente el frío, en tu beneficio. No solo puedes usar el frío para congelar y ralentizar a los enemigos, sino que también tienes acceso a muchos poderes psíquicos que te permitirán construir refugios con bloques de hielo o crear cristales refrigerantes que pueden usarse como neveras temporales o trampas.

Rule.Original: Frostshapers are psycaster who devoted their life to pursue the cold embrace of frost. This makes them equally as deadly as conflagrators, capable of breathing freezing air and creating localised cold zones that freeze everything in seconds. Frostshapers can also create walls and obstacles out of ice, as well as summon crystals of pure entropy that plunge entire rooms into subzero temperatures.
Rule.Raw: Frostshapers are psycaster who devoted their life to pursue the cold embrace of frost. This makes them equally as deadly as conflagrators, capable of breathing freezing air and creating localised cold zones that freeze everything in seconds. Frostshapers can also create walls and obstacles out of ice, as well as summon crystals of pure entropy that plunge entire rooms into subzero temperatures.
Rule.Translated: Los escarchadores son un grupo de psíquicos que han dedicado su vida a perseguir el frío abrazo de la escarcha. Esto los hace tan mortíferos como los conflagradores, capaces de exhalar aire helado y crear zonas frías localizadas que lo congelan todo en cuestión de segundos. Los escarchadores también pueden crear muros y obstáculos de hielo, así como invocar cristales de entropía pura que sumergen habitaciones enteras en temperaturas bajo cero.

Rule.Original: Wildspeaker path is a special path locked only for Tribal-based psycasters. It’s all about controlling nature and animals for defense and survival.
Rule.Raw: Wildspeaker path is a special path locked only for Tribal-based psycasters. It’s all about controlling nature and animals for defense and survival.
Rule.Translated: La senda del susurrador salvaje es una senda especial que solo pueden usar los psíquicos tribales. Consiste sobre todo en ejercer control sobre la naturaleza y los animales para defenderse y sobrevivir.

Rule.Original: A secret path of the tribal communities, wildspeaking is the art of living in harmony with the forest and nature, and being able to summon the aid of the forest when needed. Tribal wildspeakers are known to control packs of territorial animals, be protected from all damage by an impenetrable shield, and they can also seem to make brambles and trees sprout out of the ground on a whim.
Rule.Raw: A secret path of the tribal communities, wildspeaking is the art of living in harmony with the forest and nature, and being able to summon the aid of the forest when needed. Tribal wildspeakers are known to control packs of territorial animals, be protected from all damage by an impenetrable shield, and they can also seem to make brambles and trees sprout out of the ground on a whim.
Rule.Translated: Una senda secreta de las comunidades tribales. Los susurradores salvajes son la viva imagen de la vida en armonía con el bosque y la naturaleza, y son capaces de invocar la ayuda del bosque cuando es necesario. Se sabe que los susurradores pueden controlar manadas enteras de animales territoriales y protegerlos de todo daño con escudos impenetrables, así como hacer brotar zarzas y árboles del suelo a su antojo.

Rule.Original: Harmonists are all about manipulating the balance of the universe. Their abilities are never a clear benefit or a drawback, and they always come with a price one way or another.
Rule.Raw: Harmonists are all about manipulating the balance of the universe. Their abilities are never a clear benefit or a drawback, and they always come with a price one way or another.
Rule.Translated: Los armonistas buscan manipular el equilibrio del universo. Sus habilidades nunca son claramente beneficiosas o perjudiciales, y siempre tienen un precio que sopesar.

Rule.Original: Harmonists alter the probability, luck and balance of the universe. They are able to peak under the veil and adjust the scales as they desire, controlling the minds of unsuspecting foes, changing what has happened,influencing what might happen or even overriding the personal history of others.
Rule.Raw: Harmonists alter the probability, luck and balance of the universe. They are able to peak under the veil and adjust the scales as they desire, controlling the minds of unsuspecting foes, changing what has happened,influencing what might happen or even overriding the personal history of others.
Rule.Translated: Los armonistas pueden manipular la probabilidad, la suerte y el equilibrio del universo. Son capaces de asomarse bajo el velo y ajustar la balanza a su antojo, controlando las mentes de enemigos desprevenidos, cambiando lo que ha sucedido, influyendo en lo que podría suceder o incluso anulando la historia personal de otros.

Rule.Original: Technomancers are masters of technology, knowledge and research, capable of using psychic energy to aid in concept exploration, but also to breathe life into small-scale constructs that can help and defend them.
Rule.Raw: Technomancers are masters of technology, knowledge and research, capable of using psychic energy to aid in concept exploration, but also to breathe life into small-scale constructs that can help and defend them.
Rule.Translated: Los tecnomantes son los maestros de la tecnología, el conocimiento y la investigación, capaces de utilizar la energía psíquica para facilitar la exploración de conceptos, pero también para dar vida a pequeñas estructuras que puedan ayudarles y defenderles.

Rule.Original: Masters of knowledge and technology, technomancers can improve existing technology, generate infinite power, create constructs out of seemingly worthless materials as well as reverse engineer anything they can get their hands on. Especially powerful technomancers can even use eltex to create psyrings, essentially sharing their knowledge of the psycasting art with other amateur psycasters.
Rule.Raw: Masters of knowledge and technology, technomancers can improve existing technology, generate infinite power, create constructs out of seemingly worthless materials as well as reverse engineer anything they can get their hands on. Especially powerful technomancers can even use eltex to create psyrings, essentially sharing their knowledge of the psycasting art with other amateur psycasters.
Rule.Translated: Los tecnomantes, auténticos maestros del conocimiento y la tecnología, pueden mejorar la tecnología existente, generar energía infinita, crear construcciones a partir de materiales aparentemente inservibles y someter a ingeniería inversa cualquier cosa que esté a su alcance. Los tecnomantes más poderosos pueden incluso utilizar eltex para crear psicoanillos, permitiéndoles básicamente compartir sus habilidades psíquicas con otros psíquicos más principiantes.

Rule.Original: Nightstalkers are warriors of the dark, gaining many combat related benefits when shrouded in the shadows.
Rule.Raw: Nightstalkers are warriors of the dark, gaining many combat related benefits when shrouded in the shadows.
Rule.Translated: Los acechadores nocturnos son guerreros de la oscuridad, que obtienen muchos beneficios relacionados con el combate cuando se ocultan en las sombras.

Rule.Original: Silent assassins who strike from the shadows, nightstalkers move under the cover of darkness, gaining power from the absence of light. They are capable of skipping to wherever darkness prevails and executing multiple, near-simultaneous strikes to their target’s heart.
Rule.Raw: Silent assassins who strike from the shadows, nightstalkers move under the cover of darkness, gaining power from the absence of light. They are capable of skipping to wherever darkness prevails and executing multiple, near-simultaneous strikes to their target’s heart.
Rule.Translated: Los acechadores nocturnos, unos asesinos silenciosos que atacan desde las sombras, se mueven bajo el amparo de la oscuridad y obtienen su poder de la ausencia de luz visible. Son capaces de teletransportarse a cualquier lugar donde predomine la oscuridad y ejecutar múltiples ataques casi simultáneos dirigidos al corazón de su objetivo.

Rule.Original: questDescription->A large meteorite has struck ground nearby. It has left behind a lump of eltex. Eltex can be used to create psyfocus-enhancing gear, or sold to the Empire to gain honor. You can send a mining party to retrieve it, but chances are if you wait long enough, someone else will lay claim to it.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->A large meteorite has struck ground nearby. It has left behind a lump of eltex. Eltex can be used to create psyfocus-enhancing gear, or sold to the Empire to gain honor. You can send a mining party to retrieve it, but chances are if you wait long enough, someone else will lay claim to it.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Un gran meteorito ha caído cerca y ha dejado un bloque de eltex. El eltex puede utilizarse para fabricar equipo que mejora la concentración psíquica o venderse al Imperio para obtener honor. Puedes enviar un grupo minero para recuperarlo, pero si esperas demasiado, probablemente alguien más se lo quede.

Rule.Original: Others have mined the Eltex meteor. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: Others have mined the Eltex meteor. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Otros han extraído el meteorito de Eltex. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: Tailor and craft complex eltex apparel, capable of improving psychic focus of your psycasters, as well as an eltex-infused staff.
Rule.Raw: Tailor and craft complex eltex apparel, capable of improving psychic focus of your psycasters, as well as an eltex-infused staff.
Rule.Translated: Confecciona prendas de eltex complejas, capaces de mejorar la concentración psíquica de tus psíquicos, así como un bastón reforzado con eltex.

Rule.Original: Craft simple psycaster apparel, armor and gear using eltex.
Rule.Raw: Craft simple psycaster apparel, armor and gear using eltex.
Rule.Translated: Confecciona sencillas prendas, armaduras y equipamiento para psíquicos usando eltex.

Rule.Original: A location of an eltex meteor, highly desired by the empire. Travelling here will allow you to obtain eltex that can be used to craft psycasting gear.
Rule.Raw: A location of an eltex meteor, highly desired by the empire. Travelling here will allow you to obtain eltex that can be used to craft psycasting gear.
Rule.Translated: La ubicación de un meteorito de eltex, un material muy deseado por el Imperio. Viajar aquí permitirá obtener eltex para fabricar equipo de poderes psíquicos.

Rule.Original: A multiplier on psyfocus cost of psycasts.
Rule.Raw: A multiplier on psyfocus cost of psycasts.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador del coste de psicoconcentración de las psicohabilidades.

Rule.Original: The minimum amount of neural heat. This is increased by maintaining certain psycasts, which give heat that never fades.
Rule.Raw: The minimum amount of neural heat. This is increased by maintaining certain psycasts, which give heat that never fades.
Rule.Translated: La cantidad mínima de calor neuronal. Aumenta al mantener ciertas psicohabilidades que generan un calor que nunca se disipa.

Rule.Original: Basilicus enforces the will of the emperor wherever he goes, bestowing great powers on those who deserve it. Epic ballads become even more fantastic if everyone has access to psychic powers.
Rule.Raw: Basilicus enforces the will of the emperor wherever he goes, bestowing great powers on those who deserve it. Epic ballads become even more fantastic if everyone has access to psychic powers.
Rule.Translated: Salvador hace cumplir la voluntad del emperador allá donde va, otorgando grandes poderes a aquellos que lo merezcan. Las baladas épicas se vuelven incluso más extraordinarias cuando todo el mundo tiene acceso a los poderes psíquicos.

Rule.Original: A psychic entry-point to a portal network.
Rule.Raw: A psychic entry-point to a portal network.
Rule.Translated: Un punto de entrada psíquico hacia una red de portales.

Rule.Original: A small crystal of ice that cools down the temperature in the room. Can help freeze perishable items.
Rule.Raw: A small crystal of ice that cools down the temperature in the room. Can help freeze perishable items.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño cristal de hielo que enfría la temperatura ambiente. Puede ayudar a congelar objetos perecederos.

Rule.Original: A fragile wall made of ice. It will melt in heat.
Rule.Raw: A fragile wall made of ice. It will melt in heat.
Rule.Translated: Un frágil muro hecho de hielo. Se derretirá con el calor.

Rule.Original: A ball of flame launched by a conflagrator
Rule.Raw: A ball of flame launched by a conflagrator
Rule.Translated: Una bola de fuego lanzada por un conflagrador.

Rule.Original: A bolt launched by a staticlord
Rule.Raw: A bolt launched by a staticlord
Rule.Translated: Un rayo lanzado por un señor eléctrico.

Rule.Original: A spike of ice launched by the frostshaper.
Rule.Raw: A spike of ice launched by the frostshaper.
Rule.Translated: Un clavo de hielo lanzado por un escarchador.
Una roca que contiene trozos de eltex.

Rule.Original: An extremely mysterious mineral that is both malleable and serves as a physical conduit for psycasts. As psycasting originates from archotech engines, some speculate that either these minerals were manufactured by the archotechs or that they developed their engines using this strange mineral.
Rule.Raw: An extremely mysterious mineral that is both malleable and serves as a physical conduit for psycasts. As psycasting originates from archotech engines, some speculate that either these minerals were manufactured by the archotechs or that they developed their engines using this strange mineral.
Rule.Translated: Un mineral, maleable a la vez que extremadamente misterioso, que hace de medio de transmisión de las habilidades psíquicas. Dado que los mecanismos arqueotécnicos son los que originan las habilidades psíquicas, hay quien especula con la posibilidad de que, o bien estos minerales fueron fabricados por los arqueotécnicos, o bien desarrollaron estos mecanismos con este extraño mineral.

Rule.Original: An artistically impressive mask emanating psychic energy. Hides the face of the wearer but provides little physical protection. Its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: An artistically impressive mask emanating psychic energy. Hides the face of the wearer but provides little physical protection. Its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Una máscara de impresionante diseño artístico que emana energía psíquica. Oculta el rostro del portador, pero proporciona poca protección física. Sus materiales especiales aumentan la sensibilidad psíquica del portador y disipan la entropía neuronal.

Rule.Original: A long cape of mystical design. It hangs over one side of the torso. Its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: A long cape of mystical design. It hangs over one side of the torso. Its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Una larga capa con un diseño misterioso y místico que cuelga de un lado del torso. Sus materiales especiales aumentan la sensibilidad psíquica del portador y disipan la entropía neuronal.

Rule.Original: Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the entire body from neck to feet.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the entire body from neck to feet.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Unas placas sólidas superpuestas que cubren todo el cuerpo, desde el cuello hasta los pies.\n\nPreciosas y de gran valor, estas armaduras prestigiosas se suelen fabricar para personas con un gran estatus. Los hilos de eltex incrustados también aumentan la sensibilidad psíquica del portador.

Rule.Original: An eltex ring created by a skilled technomancer. It holds the knowledge of one particular psycast, and can be used by other psycasters to cast it.
Rule.Raw: An eltex ring created by a skilled technomancer. It holds the knowledge of one particular psycast, and can be used by other psycasters to cast it.
Rule.Translated: Un anillo eltex creado por un habilidoso tecnomante. Contiene el conocimiento de una habilidad psíquica concreta y puede ser utilizado por otros psíquicos para lanzarla.

Rule.Original: A medieval dagger threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon, as it follows the same idea as any other knife: A handle for holding and a sharp edge for cutting.
Rule.Raw: A medieval dagger threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon, as it follows the same idea as any other knife: A handle for holding and a sharp edge for cutting.
Rule.Translated: Una daga medieval adornada con materiales de focalización psíquica. Además de mejorar tanto la sensibilidad psíquica del portador como la disipación de la entropía neuronal, también se trata de una excelente arma cuerpo a cuerpo, ya que funciona da la misma forma que cualquier otro cuchillo: Un mango para agarrar y un filo para cortar.

Rule.Original: A medieval mace threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon, engineered for efficient swinging and deadly impacts.
Rule.Raw: A medieval mace threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon, engineered for efficient swinging and deadly impacts.
Rule.Translated: Una maza medieval adornada con materiales de focalización psíquica. Además de mejorar tanto la sensibilidad psíquica del portador como la disipación de la entropía neuronal, también se trata de una excelente arma cuerpo a cuerpo, diseñada para balancearse con eficacia y causar impactos mortales.

Rule.Original: A medieval sword threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon. Good for stabbing or slashing. It's light and nimble, which sometimes lets it beat bigger, heavier weapons.
Rule.Raw: A medieval sword threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon. Good for stabbing or slashing. It's light and nimble, which sometimes lets it beat bigger, heavier weapons.
Rule.Translated: Una espada medieval adornada con materiales de focalización psíquica. Además de mejorar tanto la sensibilidad psíquica del portador como la disipación de la entropía neuronal, también se trata de una excelente arma cuerpo a cuerpo capaz de apuñalar o cortar. Es ligera y ágil, lo que a veces permitirá hacer frente a armas más grandes y pesadas.

Rule.Original: Mystical heat pearls created by a technomancer in a process of condensing psychic heat into a physical form. They can be thrown at the other psycasters to unleash an insane amount of psychic heat, disabling their psycasting ability for the short duration.
Rule.Raw: Mystical heat pearls created by a technomancer in a process of condensing psychic heat into a physical form. They can be thrown at the other psycasters to unleash an insane amount of psychic heat, disabling their psycasting ability for the short duration.
Rule.Translated: Unas místicas perlas creadas por un tecnomante, en un proceso que condensa la entropía neuronal y le otorga forma física. Pueden lanzarse a otros psíquicos para infligirles una cantidad demencial de entropía neuronal, inutilizando su capacidad para usar habilidades psíquicas durante un breve periodo de tiempo.

Rule.Original: A piece of steel slag, animated by powerful psychic energy. It will engage nearby threats and defend the master from any harm that may come to them.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>Constructs generate constant heat for the caster that summoned them. Keeping too many constructs alive could prevent the psycaster from casting other abilities.
Rule.Raw: A piece of steel slag, animated by powerful psychic energy. It will engage nearby threats and defend the master from any harm that may come to them.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>Constructs generate constant heat for the caster that summoned them. Keeping too many constructs alive could prevent the psycaster from casting other abilities.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de chatarra metálica animada por una poderosa energía psíquica. Se enfrentará a las amenazas cercanas y defenderá a su creador de cualquier daño que pueda sufrir.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>Los constructos acaparan una cantidad de entropía constante en el psíquico que los invoca. Mantener demasiados constructos vivos podría impedir que el psíquico utilize otras habilidades.

Rule.Original: A piece of rock chunk, animated by powerful psychic energy. It will do simple work around the colony tirelessly and with maximum dedication.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>Constructs generate constant heat for the caster that summoned them. Keeping too many constructs alive could prevent the psycaster from casting other abilities.
Rule.Raw: A piece of rock chunk, animated by powerful psychic energy. It will do simple work around the colony tirelessly and with maximum dedication.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>Constructs generate constant heat for the caster that summoned them. Keeping too many constructs alive could prevent the psycaster from casting other abilities.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de roca animado por una poderosa energía psíquica.
