Rule.Original:
A group of five well dressed, heavily armed individuals with purple coloured masks and piercing blue eyes stare into your soul as they approach you. They come bearing gifts. They make it clear that they've come to negotiate, not to fight.

"Greetings. We are V.O.I.D."

"It's a pleasure to meet you. Currently this planet is under maintenance, unfortunately not everyone in the local sector received the memo. You have to leave effective immediately for your own safety, and because you are currently trespassing." a beat.

"Terribly sorry for the inconvenience caused, but we do own all of the land rights to this planet. The digital records are available to view in our nearby settlements."

The advisor shrugs at you, like something wrong trying to act human, right before standing eerily still as you think of your reply. You have three response options below.
Rule.Raw:
A group of five well dressed, heavily armed individuals with purple coloured masks and piercing blue eyes stare into your soul as they approach you. They come bearing gifts. They make it clear that they've come to negotiate, not to fight.

"Greetings. We are V.O.I.D."

"It's a pleasure to meet you. Currently this planet is under maintenance, unfortunately not everyone in the local sector received the memo. You have to leave effective immediately for your own safety, and because you are currently trespassing." a beat.

"Terribly sorry for the inconvenience caused, but we do own all of the land rights to this planet. The digital records are available to view in our nearby settlements."

The advisor shrugs at you, like something wrong trying to act human, right before standing eerily still as you think of your reply. You have three response options below.
Rule.Translated:
Cinco hombres bien vestidos y fuertemente armados con máscaras moradas se acercan a ti y sus ojos azules parecen penetrar tu alma. Vinieron con regalos y dejaron claro que estaban aquí para negociar, no para luchar. 

"Hola. Estamos V.O.I.D."

"Has invadido ilegalmente nuestro territorio recién anexado. Debes abandonar este mundo inmediatamente, de lo contrario tendremos que desalojarte por la fuerza."

"Debes dejar esto planeta de manera inmediata y eficiente."

El consultor realizará una breve evaluación de usted en función de sus respuestas. Tiene las siguientes tres opciones de respuesta.

Rule.Original: Beg for mercy. Try to plead to their humanity, they seem to be reasonable people.
Rule.Raw: Beg for mercy. Try to plead to their humanity, they seem to be reasonable people.
Rule.Translated: Pide clemencia. Intente rogar por su humanidad y parecerán personas razonables.

Rule.Original: Say something incredibly insulting. Immediately attack them.
Rule.Raw: Say something incredibly insulting. Immediately attack them.
Rule.Translated: Diga algo extremadamente insultante y atáquelo inmediatamente.

Rule.Original: Respectfully decline. You aren't here to beg or to surrender to anyone.
Rule.Raw: Respectfully decline. You aren't here to beg or to surrender to anyone.
Rule.Translated: Rechace cortésmente. No estás aquí para suplicar o rendirte a alguien.

Rule.Original:
"We understand. We aren't unreasonable people. You will be given 30 days grace period, after that I'm afraid we all answer to someone, and you will be violating our laws."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Raw:
"We understand. We aren't unreasonable people. You will be given 30 days grace period, after that I'm afraid we all answer to someone, and you will be violating our laws."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Translated:
"Lo entendemos. No somos irrazonables. Su estadía se extenderá por 30 días, después de los cuales debemos actuar de acuerdo con nuestras nuevas leyes como futuro gobierno de este mundo".

 "Por favor acepta nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."

"Adiós."

Rule.Original:
"We understand. This situation isn't easy for everyone. You are hereby granted 30 days of grace period until we are permitted to remove you by force."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Raw:
"We understand. This situation isn't easy for everyone. You are hereby granted 30 days of grace period until we are permitted to remove you by force."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Translated:
"Entendemos. Esta situación no es fácil para todos. Por la presente se le concede un período de gracia de 30 días antes del cual no lo desalojaremos por la fuerza."

"Acepte nuestro regalo, un regalo de despedida"

"Adiós"

Rule.Original:
"There's no need to worry. We grant you 30 days extension, consider this your final warning. If you are still here after your extension, we will return for you."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Raw:
"There's no need to worry. We grant you 30 days extension, consider this your final warning. If you are still here after your extension, we will return for you."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Translated:
"No se preocupe. Le otorgamos una extensión de 30 días como advertencia final. Si todavía está aquí después de la fecha límite, regresaremos aquí."

"Por favor, acepte nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida"

"Adiós"

Rule.Original:
"There is nothing to be afraid of. We are here to help. You are granted 30 days extension, V.O.I.D. will leave you alone for this duration. After this extension, you are no longer under protection."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Raw:
"There is nothing to be afraid of. We are here to help. You are granted 30 days extension, V.O.I.D. will leave you alone for this duration. After this extension, you are no longer under protection."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Translated:
"No temas, estamos aquí para ayudarte. Se te concede una extensión de 30 días, tiempo durante el cual V.O.I.D. te dejará en paz. Una vez que se alcance ese período, ya no estarás protegido ."
 
"Acepte nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."

"Adiós."

Rule.Original:
The V.O.I.D. advisor, cold and emotionless look down on you as you try to move them with words.

"You have 30 days. That is all we will give you as grace period before you leave us no choice. Please extend us the courtesy and respect that we have given you, then we will find common ground."

"One final thing, please accept our token of hospitality. We present to you a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Raw:
The V.O.I.D. advisor, cold and emotionless look down on you as you try to move them with words.

"You have 30 days. That is all we will give you as grace period before you leave us no choice. Please extend us the courtesy and respect that we have given you, then we will find common ground."

"One final thing, please accept our token of hospitality. We present to you a leaving gift."

"Goodbye."
Rule.Translated:
Los asesores de V.O.I.D. te tratan con frío desprecio mientras intentas impresionarlos con palabras. 

"Tiene 30 días. Le daremos este último período de gracia antes de que nos deje sin opción. Por favor, informe sobre la cortesía y el respeto que le brindamos y encontraremos puntos en común."\ n
 "Una última cosa, acepte nuestra hospitalidad. Le ofrecemos un regalo de despedida."

"Adiós."

Rule.Original: The V.O.I.D. advisor shakes their head at your response.\n\n"Well, there's that, then."
Rule.Raw: The V.O.I.D. advisor shakes their head at your response.\n\n"Well, there's that, then."
Rule.Translated: Negociador V.O.I.D. niega con la cabeza ante su respuesta. \n\n"Es como hablar con un niño ignorante."

Rule.Original: The V.O.I.D. advisor, surprised by your rude response, tilts their strange helmet obscured face.\n\n"I see. I was hoping you'd say something like that."
Rule.Raw: The V.O.I.D. advisor, surprised by your rude response, tilts their strange helmet obscured face.\n\n"I see. I was hoping you'd say something like that."
Rule.Translated: Negociador V.O.I.D. se sorprende por su grosera respuesta y asiente. \n\n"Entiendo, confundiste nuestra amabilidad con debilidad."

Rule.Original: The V.O.I.D. advisor, surprised by your remarks, responds with a flat and dry tone.\n\n"I suppose someone has to teaach the savages some manners."
Rule.Raw: The V.O.I.D. advisor, surprised by your remarks, responds with a flat and dry tone.\n\n"I suppose someone has to teaach the savages some manners."
Rule.Translated: Negociador V.O.I.D. se sorprende por sus comentarios y responde en un tono plano y condescendiente. \n\n"¿De dónde viene esta actitud?"

Rule.Original: The V.O.I.D. advisor is taken back by your response.\n\n"Interesting. You must be confusing kindness with weakness."
Rule.Raw: The V.O.I.D. advisor is taken back by your response.\n\n"Interesting. You must be confusing kindness with weakness."
Rule.Translated: Negociador V.O.I.D. cree que su respuesta es incorrecta. \n\n"Interesante. Debes estar confundido."

Rule.Original: The V.O.I.D. advisor is still and without emotion they utter a few cold words.\n\n"Interesting use of free will."
Rule.Raw: The V.O.I.D. advisor is still and without emotion they utter a few cold words.\n\n"Interesting use of free will."
Rule.Translated: El Consultor V.O.I.D. permaneció inmóvil y habló sin emoción. \n\n"Interesante."

Rule.Original: The skin tight mask of the V.O.I.D. advisor displays a smirking imprint, with the beady eyes glowing slightly brighter towards you.\n\n"And I thought this job was getting boring. Thank you."
Rule.Raw: The skin tight mask of the V.O.I.D. advisor displays a smirking imprint, with the beady eyes glowing slightly brighter towards you.\n\n"And I thought this job was getting boring. Thank you."
Rule.Translated: Aparece una sonrisa en la máscara del Asesor V.O.I.D., sus agudos ojos brillan levemente hacia ti. \n\n"Este será nuestro entretenimiento de hoy. Gracias."

Rule.Original: You see a smirk unfold by the mouth of the eerie and skin tight mask of the V.O.I.D. advisor.\n\n"I'm starting to like you lot."
Rule.Raw: You see a smirk unfold by the mouth of the eerie and skin tight mask of the V.O.I.D. advisor.\n\n"I'm starting to like you lot."
Rule.Translated: Ves una sonrisa debajo de la máscara del Asesor V.O.I.D. \n\n"Es fácil."

Rule.Original: The V.O.I.D. advisor leans back with feigned surprise at your response, laced with sarcasm.\n\n"Well, you certainly shocked me with your decision to resort to violence." a beat as their hands twitch. "I'm afraid we'll have to defend ourselves."
Rule.Raw: The V.O.I.D. advisor leans back with feigned surprise at your response, laced with sarcasm.\n\n"Well, you certainly shocked me with your decision to resort to violence." a beat as their hands twitch. "I'm afraid we'll have to defend ourselves."
Rule.Translated: V.O.I.D. Advisor está sorprendido por su reacción. \n\n"Esto será divertido."

Rule.Original: The advisor shrugs at your response, as if they expected it.\n\n"Funny. I was just thinking about what I'd do to you if you said something like that."
Rule.Raw: The advisor shrugs at your response, as if they expected it.\n\n"Funny. I was just thinking about what I'd do to you if you said something like that."
Rule.Translated: El asesor se encoge de hombros ante su respuesta, como si la esperara. \n\n"Bien. Supuse que dirías eso."

Rule.Original: The tone in the voice of the V.O.I.D. advisor shifts from neutral to a mildly frustrated one due to your response.\n\n"And I thought I had a screw loose in my head."
Rule.Raw: The tone in the voice of the V.O.I.D. advisor shifts from neutral to a mildly frustrated one due to your response.\n\n"And I thought I had a screw loose in my head."
Rule.Translated: El tono del asesor de V.O.I.D cambia de neutral a ligeramente frustrado por su respuesta. \n\n"Gran error."

Rule.Original: You see a wrinkle near the advisor's mouthpiece, indicating a smile behind the mask.\n\n"I do respect your tenacity."
Rule.Raw: You see a wrinkle near the advisor's mouthpiece, indicating a smile behind the mask.\n\n"I do respect your tenacity."
Rule.Translated: El asesor analiza brevemente la situación después de su respuesta y luego lo mira. \n\n"Cometiste un gran error."

Rule.Original: The advisor analyzes the situation briefly after your response and looks back at you.\n\n"Then this means war."
Rule.Raw: The advisor analyzes the situation briefly after your response and looks back at you.\n\n"Then this means war."
Rule.Translated: Ves la sonrisa del consultor, tan prominente incluso detrás de la máscara. \n\n"Igual que la respuesta que esperábamos."

Rule.Original: You seemed to have angered the V.O.I.D. advisor. The voice behind the emotionless mask speaks the following words full of indignation.\n\n"And this is why I disagreed when I was told you could be reasoned with."
Rule.Raw: You seemed to have angered the V.O.I.D. advisor. The voice behind the emotionless mask speaks the following words full of indignation.\n\n"And this is why I disagreed when I was told you could be reasoned with."
Rule.Translated: Parece que has enojado a los asesores de V.O.I.D. La voz detrás de su fría máscara estaba llena de ira. \n\n"Has perdido tu salvación."

Rule.Original: The cold and calculating V.O.I.D. advisor reacts to your response after a brief moment.\n\n'tsk' they kiss their teeth "And here I thought you were going to welcome us with open arms, tea and biscuits."
Rule.Raw: The cold and calculating V.O.I.D. advisor reacts to your response after a brief moment.\n\n'tsk' they kiss their teeth "And here I thought you were going to welcome us with open arms, tea and biscuits."
Rule.Translated: El asesor V.O.I.D., tranquilo y cauteloso, responde a su respuesta después de un breve momento. \n\n"Eso es lo que esperaba que respondieras."

Rule.Original: With a dry and condescending tone, the V.O.I.D. advisor quips back at your response.\n\n"And here I thought you were damsels in distress."
Rule.Raw: With a dry and condescending tone, the V.O.I.D. advisor quips back at your response.\n\n"And here I thought you were damsels in distress."
Rule.Translated: El consultor de V.O.I.D. se burló de su respuesta en un tono seco y condescendiente. \n\n"Pensé que eras una chica esperando ser rescatada, pero ¿no?"

Rule.Original: You see the advisor sent by V.O.I.D. slightly confused by your hostility, then immediately realizes your intentions.\n\n"Then we are at an impasse. they say with a sense of acceptance and finality."
Rule.Raw: You see the advisor sent by V.O.I.D. slightly confused by your hostility, then immediately realizes your intentions.\n\n"Then we are at an impasse. they say with a sense of acceptance and finality."
Rule.Translated: Estabas un poco confundido por la hostilidad del consultor enviado por V.O.I.D., e inmediatamente te diste cuenta de tus intenciones. \n\n"Te arrepentirás de esta decisión inmediatamente."

Rule.Original: In the tone of a disappointed parent, the advisor sent by V.O.I.D. tells you these final words.\n\n"Ever heard of the phrase "crossing the rubicon"?" they pause. "You have just reached it, and I wish you goodluck."
Rule.Raw: In the tone of a disappointed parent, the advisor sent by V.O.I.D. tells you these final words.\n\n"Ever heard of the phrase "crossing the rubicon"?" they pause. "You have just reached it, and I wish you goodluck."
Rule.Translated: El consultor de V.O.I.D. parecía un padre decepcionado. \n\n"Eres un tonto."

Rule.Original:
The V.O.I.D. advisor gives you a warm nod and begins bidding you farewell.

"We understand. I hope you and I will find our future encounters in good faith."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Raw:
The V.O.I.D. advisor gives you a warm nod and begins bidding you farewell.

"We understand. I hope you and I will find our future encounters in good faith."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Translated:
El Consultor V.O.I.D. asiente con entusiasmo y comienza a despedirse de usted. 

"Lo entendemos. Espero que usted y yo podamos volver a encontrarnos."

"Acepte nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."

Rule.Original:
The V.O.I.D. advisor gives you a slight bow with their hand in their heart and bids you farewell.

"We understand. Till we meet again."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Raw:
The V.O.I.D. advisor gives you a slight bow with their hand in their heart and bids you farewell.

"We understand. Till we meet again."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Translated:
V.O.I.D. Advisor se inclina suavemente hacia usted con la mano y se despide. 
"Lo entendemos. Hasta que nos volvamos a encontrar."

"Acepte nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."

Rule.Original:
The V.O.I.D. advisor nods and signs at their bodyguards to begin leaving.
"Thank you for your time."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Raw:
The V.O.I.D. advisor nods and signs at their bodyguards to begin leaving.
"Thank you for your time."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Translated:
V.O.I.D. Advisor asintió y le indicó al guardaespaldas que se preparara para irse. 
"Gracias por su tiempo."

"Acepte nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."

Rule.Original:
The V.O.I.D. advisor looks at one of the bodyguards and back to you with some final words.
"Understandable. We respect your courage and integrity."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Raw:
The V.O.I.D. advisor looks at one of the bodyguards and back to you with some final words.
"Understandable. We respect your courage and integrity."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Translated:
V.O.I.D. Advisor mira a uno de los guardaespaldas y te dice sus últimas palabras. 
"Comprensible. Respetamos su valentía e integridad."

"Acepte nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."

Rule.Original:
The V.O.I.D. advisor is surprised by your brazen response, their body language abruptly reveals this.

"I see. What an unexpected turn of events. We'll be on our way then."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Raw:
The V.O.I.D. advisor is surprised by your brazen response, their body language abruptly reveals this.

"I see. What an unexpected turn of events. We'll be on our way then."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Translated:
Los consultores de V.O.I.D se sorprenden por su descarada respuesta y su lenguaje corporal lo revela. 

"Ya veo. Este es un giro inesperado de los acontecimientos. Nos iremos pronto."

"Acepte nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."

Rule.Original:
The V.O.I.D. advisor stands still, almost emotionless. They abruptly begin leaving.
"Understandable. Have a good day."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Raw:
The V.O.I.D. advisor stands still, almost emotionless. They abruptly begin leaving.
"Understandable. Have a good day."

"Please accept our token of hospitality, a leaving gift."
Rule.Translated:
El asesor de V.O.I.D. estaba inmóvil y casi sin emociones. De repente estuvieron listos para partir. 
"Entendido. Que tengas un buen día."

"Acepta nuestra hospitalidad, un regalo de despedida."
V.O.I.D: Solicitud de liberación de prisionero

Rule.Original:
Hello. You are holding members of V.O.I.D. hostage.

This is our offer:
You have 24 hours to release the V.O.I.D. prisoners of war or else there will be dire consequences for your settlement.

This is your first and only warning.

Sincerely,
V.O.I.D.
Rule.Raw:
Hello. You are holding members of V.O.I.D. hostage.

This is our offer:
You have 24 hours to release the V.O.I.D. prisoners of war or else there will be dire consequences for your settlement.

This is your first and only warning.

Sincerely,
V.O.I.D.
Rule.Translated:
Hola. Somos conscientes de que usted tiene como rehén a uno de los miembros de V.O.I.D. 

Esta es nuestra propuesta:
Tienes 24 horas para liberar a los prisioneros de guerra, de lo contrario tus acciones tendrán graves consecuencias. 

Esta es la primera y única advertencia que recibirá. 

Atentamente,
V.O.I.D.

Rule.Original: Thank you for co-operating with us. We commend you for being reasonable people.\n\n- V.O.I.D.
Rule.Raw: Thank you for co-operating with us. We commend you for being reasonable people.\n\n- V.O.I.D.
Rule.Translated: Gracias por su cooperación con nosotros y nos alegra que sea una persona razonable. \n\n-V.O.I.D.

Rule.Original:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up as one of many survivors of the catastrophic Nerotonin-4 outbreak. [PAWN_pronoun] lived in one of the many outposts Fairview, migrating from the Holdout to the last reamining Secronom Bunker.

[PAWN_nameDef] has seen many horrors and had to endure losing friends and remaining family on a daily basis on top of fighting the never ending horde of infected creatures out in the inner city walls.

[PAWN_nameDef] learning knowledge of bartering in [PAWN_possessive] early age on top of having to fight in order to avoid going hungry when looting is not viable, and crops were too slow.
Rule.Raw:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up as one of many survivors of the catastrophic Nerotonin-4 outbreak. [PAWN_pronoun] lived in one of the many outposts Fairview, migrating from the Holdout to the last reamining Secronom Bunker.

[PAWN_nameDef] has seen many horrors and had to endure losing friends and remaining family on a daily basis on top of fighting the never ending horde of infected creatures out in the inner city walls.

[PAWN_nameDef] learning knowledge of bartering in [PAWN_possessive] early age on top of having to fight in order to avoid going hungry when looting is not viable, and crops were too slow.
Rule.Translated:
[PAWN_nameDef] creció como uno de los supervivientes del catastrófico brote de Nerotonin-4. [PAWN_pronoun] vivió en uno de los numerosos puestos de Fairview y migró desde Holdout hasta el último búnker de Secronom.

[PAWN_nameDef] ha visto muchos horrores y ha soportado a diario la pérdida de amigos y familiares, además de combatir a la interminable horda de criaturas infectadas de los muros interiores de la ciudad.

[PAWN_nameDef] aprendió a comerciar a [PAWN_possessive] corta edad y tuvo que luchar para no pasar hambre cuando no era posible saquear y los cultivos crecían demasiado despacio.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] was a scavenger during the midst of a Nerotonin-4 outbreak. [PAWN_pronoun] encountered several dangerous creatures and lost many of [PAWN_possessive] comrades during [PAWN_possessive] time as a survivor. What [PAWN_pronoun] was known for is undertaking one of the most dangerous tasks in the inner city. Looting the "Death Row" purple zones, an area occupied by evolved strains of the virus.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] grew up having to sharpen [PAWN_possessive] silver tongue and personal relations, on top of [PAWN_possessive] combat abilities in order to continue putting food in the table for [PAWN_possessive] family at a young age.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] was a scavenger during the midst of a Nerotonin-4 outbreak. [PAWN_pronoun] encountered several dangerous creatures and lost many of [PAWN_possessive] comrades during [PAWN_possessive] time as a survivor. What [PAWN_pronoun] was known for is undertaking one of the most dangerous tasks in the inner city. Looting the "Death Row" purple zones, an area occupied by evolved strains of the virus.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] grew up having to sharpen [PAWN_possessive] silver tongue and personal relations, on top of [PAWN_possessive] combat abilities in order to continue putting food in the table for [PAWN_possessive] family at a young age.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] se dedicaba a saquear durante un brote de Nerotonin-4. [PAWN_pronoun] se enfrentó a varias criaturas peligrosas y perdió a muchos de [PAWN_possessive] compañeros durante [PAWN_possessive] etapa de supervivencia. [PAWN_pronoun] era conocido por realizar una de las tareas más peligrosas del centro urbano: saquear las zonas moradas del «Corredor de la Muerte», ocupadas por cepas evolucionadas del virus.\n\nDesde joven, [PAWN_nameDef] tuvo que perfeccionar [PAWN_possessive] labia y sus relaciones personales, además de [PAWN_possessive] habilidades de combate, para seguir poniendo comida en la mesa de [PAWN_possessive] familia.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] was recruited into a mysterious organization that manifested itself among the flames and foundations of bodies in the inner city. [PAWN_pronoun] did not ask to join, they were invited. From then on, [PAWN_possessive] life was changed forever. The clan had access to the most powerful arsenal in their world, the Dusk gear. They also manipulated the market in order to hoard masses of resources for themselves when other survivors barely got by looting in the Inner City.\n\n[PAWN_possessive] was trained in all possible skills each clan member had to offer and learned in a higher capacity than normal means due to implants. The clan found means to escape the planet after re-developing space flight systems in complete secrecy from the average scavengers who still had their minds set on survival alone.

The clan found means to escape the planet after re-developing space flight systems in complete secrecy from the average scavengers who still had their minds set on survival alone.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] fue reclutado por una misteriosa organización que surgió entre las llamas y los montones de cadáveres del centro urbano. [PAWN_pronoun] no pidió incorporarse: recibió una invitación. Desde entonces, [PAWN_possessive] vida cambió para siempre. El clan tenía acceso al arsenal más poderoso de su mundo, el equipo Dusk. También manipulaba el mercado para acumular enormes recursos mientras otros supervivientes apenas se mantenían saqueando el centro urbano.\n\n[PAWN_possessive] formación abarcó todas las habilidades que podían enseñar los miembros del clan, y los implantes permitieron aprender por encima de las capacidades normales. El clan encontró una forma de escapar del planeta tras reconstruir en secreto sistemas de vuelo espacial, sin que lo supieran los saqueadores corrientes, aún centrados únicamente en sobrevivir.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] participated in a competition known as top survivor during a dusk event in Fairview. [PAWN_pronoun] won after losing several of [PAWN_possessive] friends and clanmates clearing innumerable hordes of N-4 infected through the wasteland, fighting other clans who encountered them trying to win the highly sought after Dusk Gear.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] was later recruited into a mysterious organization for [PAWN_possessive] talents, and the memories will never leave [PAWN_possessive] mind.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] participated in a competition known as top survivor during a dusk event in Fairview. [PAWN_pronoun] won after losing several of [PAWN_possessive] friends and clanmates clearing innumerable hordes of N-4 infected through the wasteland, fighting other clans who encountered them trying to win the highly sought after Dusk Gear.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] was later recruited into a mysterious organization for [PAWN_possessive] talents, and the memories will never leave [PAWN_possessive] mind.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] participó en una competición llamada Superviviente Supremo durante un evento del crepúsculo en Fairview. [PAWN_pronoun] ganó tras perder a varios de [PAWN_possessive] amigos y compañeros de clan mientras eliminaban innumerables hordas de infectados N-4 por el páramo y combatían a otros clanes que buscaban el codiciado equipo Dusk.\n\nMás tarde, una misteriosa organización reclutó a [PAWN_nameDef] por [PAWN_possessive] talentos, pero los recuerdos nunca abandonarán [PAWN_possessive] mente.

Rule.Original: The infected Nerotonin-4 horde, survivors have labelled these creatures as "zombies". These monsters do not rest until living non-infected beings around them are dead. Many worlds have fallen prey to this Nerotonin Type-4 virus, and it originated from a defunct company named Secronom that unleashed a pandemic the likes of which can only be described as horror. Lately the last known source of the virus is a result of intergalactic pharmaceutical corporation Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development (OVID in short) experiments. Nobody knows what goes on in the minds of these creatures, other than they are solely driven to commit violence.
Rule.Raw: The infected Nerotonin-4 horde, survivors have labelled these creatures as "zombies". These monsters do not rest until living non-infected beings around them are dead. Rule.Translated: La horda infectada por Nerotonin-4. Los supervivientes llaman «zombis» a estas criaturas, que no descansan hasta matar a los seres vivos no infectados que las rodean. Muchos mundos han sucumbido al virus Nerotonin tipo 4, originado en la desaparecida empresa Secronom, que desató una pandemia de horror indescriptible. La última fuente conocida del virus son los experimentos de la farmacéutica intergaláctica Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development, u OVID. Nadie sabe qué piensan estas criaturas; solo que las impulsa la violencia.

Rule.Original: V.O.I.D. is an intergalactic conglomerate consisting of "Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development" (OVID) and "Voidtech," known for their groundbreaking scientific advancements in aerospace, bionics, and pharmaceuticals. OVID has been blamed for several catastrophic virus outbreaks across Midworlds and Urbworlds in their mission to find a cure for death, regardless of the consequences. Their secondary company, Voidtech, produces bionics and weaponry covertly for V.O.I.D. and targets extremely wealthy individuals for their revenue.\n\nThe origins of V.O.I.D. are speculated, but their miracle pill, "Nerotonin," is believed to be stolen technology from a defunct company, Secronom. It is rumored that V.O.I.D. manipulates the geopolitics of different worlds for their benefit or personal amusement.
Rule.Raw: V.O.I.D. is an intergalactic conglomerate consisting of "Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development" (OVID) and "Voidtech," known for their groundbreaking scientific advancements in aerospace, bionics, and pharmaceuticals. OVID has been blamed for several catastrophic virus outbreaks across Midworlds and Urbworlds in their mission to find a cure for death, regardless of the consequences. Their secondary company, Voidtech, produces bionics and weaponry covertly for V.O.I.D. and targets extremely wealthy individuals for their revenue.\n\nThe origins of V.O.I.D. are speculated, but their miracle pill, "Nerotonin," is believed to be stolen technology from a defunct company, Secronom. Rule.Translated: V.O.I.D. es un conglomerado intergaláctico formado por «Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development» (OVID) y «Voidtech», conocido por sus avances pioneros en tecnología aeroespacial, biónica y farmacéutica. Se responsabiliza a OVID de varios brotes víricos catastróficos en mundos intermedios y urbanos, fruto de su búsqueda de una cura para la muerte sin importar las consecuencias. Voidtech produce implantes biónicos y armamento clandestinamente para V.O.I.D., y obtiene sus ingresos de clientes extremadamente ricos.\n\nSus orígenes son inciertos, pero se cree que su píldora milagrosa, «Nerotonin», utiliza tecnología robada a la desaparecida Secronom. Se rumorea que V.O.I.D. manipula la geopolítica de distintos mundos por beneficio propio o simple diversión.

Rule.Original: Only through chaos can true order be established. The human construct of right and wrong is far too subjective to be deemed reliable and those without the will to break through the constraints of morality and personal weaknesses are to be kept out of the loop. With that said, unnecessary cruelty and distasteful barbarism are frowned upon in our society. Acts of treachery are abominable of the highest order. If we are respectul of others, including our enemies, we display a great example as their future rulers.\n\nThere is something greater than all of us out there, and it is waiting for its turn to destroy us all. Only through human intervention, research and many sacrifices can a true utopia be established, transcending all natural limitations and overcoming death itself. The ends justify the means. We have the ability to manipulate reality through the very tools nature provides, and the masses must be subdued in order to keep them from getting in the way of our goals.
Rule.Raw: Only through chaos can true order be established. The human construct of right and wrong is far too subjective to be deemed reliable and those without the will to break through the constraints of morality and personal weaknesses are to be kept out of the loop. With that said, unnecessary cruelty and distasteful barbarism are frowned upon in our society. Acts of treachery are abominable of the highest order. If we are respectul of others, including our enemies, we display a great example as their future rulers.\n\nThere is something greater than all of us out there, and it is waiting for its turn to destroy us all. Only through human intervention, research and many sacrifices can a true utopia be established, transcending all natural limitations and overcoming death itself. The ends justify the means. We have the ability to manipulate reality through the very tools nature provides, and the masses must be subdued in order to keep them from getting in the way of our goals.
Rule.Translated: Sólo a través del caos se puede establecer el verdadero orden. Las ideas humanas sobre el bien y el mal son demasiado subjetivas y, por tanto, poco fiables, y aquellos que no están dispuestos a romper las limitaciones de la debilidad moral y personal deberían ser excluidos. Aún así, la crueldad innecesaria y la barbarie repugnante están mal vistas en nuestra cultura, y la traición es aún más vergonzosa. Si respetamos a los demás, incluso a nuestros enemigos, entonces daremos un buen ejemplo como futuros gobernantes. \n\nHay algo más poderoso que todos nosotros y, tarde o temprano, nos destruirá a todos. Sólo a través de la intervención humana, la investigación y el sacrificio masivo se podrá construir una verdadera utopía que trascienda todas las limitaciones naturales e incluso venza a la propia muerte. Somos capaces de manipular la realidad a través de las herramientas que nos proporciona la naturaleza, sin importar los sacrificios que implique. El fin justifica los medios. Para no permitir que otros se interpongan en el camino hacia este ambicioso objetivo, debemos conquistarlos a todos.

Rule.Original: A canned caviar, from its packaging it seems to mimic an ancient Fairview brand though it's freshly produced. Caviar is a food consisting of salt-cured roe. A canned delicacy, manufactured for survival use. While it never rots, it can still deteriorate if left outside.
Rule.Raw: A canned caviar, from its packaging it seems to mimic an ancient Fairview brand though it's freshly produced. Caviar is a food consisting of salt-cured roe. A canned delicacy, manufactured for survival use. While it never rots, it can still deteriorate if left outside.
Rule.Translated: Caviar enlatado. Aunque es de fabricación reciente, su envase parece imitar una antigua marca de Fairview. El caviar consiste en huevas curadas con sal. Es una delicatessen en conserva destinada a la supervivencia. Nunca se pudre, pero puede deteriorarse si se deja a la intemperie.
Un implante de potenciación extrema instalado.

Rule.Original: The Ultra Boost implant. Originally a drug synthesized by surviving Secronom scientists for the elite survivors of Fairview, and later converted into an implant. It was intended to be used by the best of the best.\n\nA worldhopper known only as AdminPwn commissioned its inception in order to reward the most powerful warriors within the inner city and allow them to protect the remaining humans that inhabit the world. Due the growing threat of wasteland mutations evolving rampant and eventually leaking into the streets where the average survivor scavenged and grew produce.
Rule.Raw: The Ultra Boost implant. Originally a drug synthesized by surviving Secronom scientists for the elite survivors of Fairview, and later converted into an implant. It was intended to be used by the best of the best.\n\nA worldhopper known only as AdminPwn commissioned its inception in order to reward the most powerful warriors within the inner city and allow them to protect the remaining humans that inhabit the world. Due the growing threat of wasteland mutations evolving rampant and eventually leaking into the streets where the average survivor scavenged and grew produce.
Rule.Translated: El implante de potenciación extrema. Originalmente era una droga sintetizada por científicos supervivientes de Secronom para los supervivientes de élite de Fairview, y después se convirtió en un implante. Estaba destinado a los mejores entre los mejores.\n\nUn viajero entre mundos conocido únicamente como AdminPwn encargó su creación para recompensar a los guerreros más poderosos de la ciudad interior y ayudarles a proteger a los humanos restantes. Las mutaciones de los páramos evolucionaban sin control y empezaban a invadir las calles donde los supervivientes comunes buscaban recursos y cultivaban alimentos.
Instala un implante de potenciación extrema.
Extrae un implante de potenciación extrema.

Rule.Original: The Devil's implant. Crafted from the beating heart of a Nerotonin Type-4 "Devil Hound". It enhances the user's mobility and resistance to physical trauma. It also inherits a small percentile of the Type-4 variant's ability to endure extremely high temperatures that would kill the average human being.
Rule.Raw: The Devil's implant. Crafted from the beating heart of a Nerotonin Type-4 "Devil Hound". It enhances the user's mobility and resistance to physical trauma. It also inherits a small percentile of the Type-4 variant's ability to endure extremely high temperatures that would kill the average human being.
Rule.Translated: El implante diabólico. Fabricado con el corazón aún latiente de un «Sabueso diabólico» infectado por Nerotonin tipo 4. Mejora la movilidad del usuario y su resistencia a los traumatismos físicos. También hereda una pequeña parte de la capacidad de esta variante de tipo 4 para soportar temperaturas extremas que matarían a una persona normal.

Rule.Original: The Volatile implant. Crafted from the Volatile hide and innards of a Nerotonin Type-4 "Volatile Leaper". It enhances the user's mobility and resistance to physical trauma. It also inherits a small percentile of the Type-4 variant's unnatural strength and ability to endure extremely high temperatures that would kill the average human being and secretes volatile chemicals from the body upon death, which would likely destroy the equipment on the user.
Rule.Raw: The Volatile implant. Crafted from the Volatile hide and innards of a Nerotonin Type-4 "Volatile Leaper". It enhances the user's mobility and resistance to physical trauma. It also inherits a small percentile of the Type-4 variant's unnatural strength and ability to endure extremely high temperatures that would kill the average human being and secretes volatile chemicals from the body upon death, which would likely destroy the equipment on the user.
Rule.Translated: El implante volátil. Fabricado con la piel y las vísceras volátiles de un «Saltador volátil» infectado por Nerotonin tipo 4. Mejora la movilidad del usuario y su resistencia a los traumatismos físicos. Hereda parte de la fuerza antinatural de esta variante de tipo 4 y su capacidad para soportar temperaturas extremas que matarían a una persona normal. Al morir, el cuerpo segrega sustancias volátiles que probablemente destruyan el equipo del usuario.

Rule.Original: The X-Dusk implant. An implant that was created by a worldhopper that went by the name of AdminPwn. Along with the Dusk set, the X-Dusk was a Mk 2 upgrade of the gear that equipped elite survivors to better deal with the growing threat of more and more extreme mutations appearing in their world thanks to the Nerotonin Type 4 virus outbreak.\n\nCannot be used with the Dawn implant.
Rule.Raw: The X-Dusk implant. An implant that was created by a worldhopper that went by the name of AdminPwn. Along with the Dusk set, the X-Dusk was a Mk 2 upgrade of the gear that equipped elite survivors to better deal with the growing threat of more and more extreme mutations appearing in their world thanks to the Nerotonin Type 4 virus outbreak.\n\nCannot be used with the Dawn implant.
Rule.Translated: El implante X-Dusk. Creado por un viajero entre mundos llamado AdminPwn. Junto con el conjunto Dusk, el X-Dusk era una mejora Mk 2 del equipo de los supervivientes de élite, para afrontar las mutaciones cada vez más extremas que aparecían en su mundo tras el brote del virus Nerotonin tipo 4.\n\nNo puede utilizarse con el implante del amanecer.

Rule.Original: The Dawn implant. An upgraded version of the X-Dusk implant, which leads to an incompatibility between the two implants. The Dawn implant is part of the Dawn series, a general upgrade of the X-Dusk set. Its architect was an engineer that was mentored by the renowned worldhopper and craftsman AdminPwn.\n\nCannot be used with the X-Dusk implant.
Rule.Raw: The Dawn implant. An upgraded version of the X-Dusk implant, which leads to an incompatibility between the two implants. The Dawn implant is part of the Dawn series, a general upgrade of the X-Dusk set. Its architect was an engineer that was mentored by the renowned worldhopper and craftsman AdminPwn.\n\nCannot be used with the X-Dusk implant.
Rule.Translated: El implante del amanecer. Una versión mejorada del implante X-Dusk, incompatible con él. Forma parte de la serie Amanecer, una mejora general del conjunto X-Dusk. Lo diseñó un ingeniero formado por el célebre viajero entre mundos y artesano AdminPwn.\n\nNo puede utilizarse con el implante X-Dusk.

Rule.Original: The Trinity implant. Enhances the user's mobility, resistance to trauma and capacity to learn.\n\nIt is part of the Epic Series of implants. It is crafted by a worldhopper known only as AdminPwn. Survivors who were able to afford these high class implants paid in a currency known as credits. The implants allowed elite survivors to face up against even some of the most dangerous N-4 variants that plagued the inner city when utilized with other implants that enhance the body.

Rule.Translated: El implante de trinidad. Mejora la movilidad del usuario, su resistencia a los traumatismos y su capacidad de aprendizaje.\n\nForma parte de la serie Épica de implantes y lo fabrica un viajero entre mundos conocido únicamente como AdminPwn. Los supervivientes que podían permitirse estos implantes de alta gama pagaban con una moneda llamada créditos. Combinados con otros implantes que mejoran el cuerpo, permitían a los supervivientes de élite enfrentarse incluso a algunas de las variantes N-4 más peligrosas que asolaban la ciudad interior.

Rule.Original: The March of the Living implant or MOTL for short. An implant invented by Dr. David Tolousse, a surviving Secronom scientist during the N-4 global pandemic. He invented this implant in mind in order to help survivors gain a greater edge in exploring the wastelands on the outskirts of the inner city, where the infected within were capable of outrunning an average adult human. Thanks to this implant, other innovations were developed that helped survivors who used them suffer less fatalities.

Rule.Original: A highly sophisticated modification of the Aesthetic Shaper, a package of hormonal and mechanite influences shapes the muscles and fat on the body, adding non-functional aesthetic tissue where needed to achieve a desired appearance. This implant can be configured to form various body shapes according to the user’s taste - or that of their partner.\n\nThis implant was produced by the infamous Dr. La Ruina, who made off with insurmountable wealth for the invention of this implant. He is hunted for multiple counts of unethical human experimentation, and being involved with human traffickers that use these implants for slaves.

Rule.Translated: Una modificación muy sofisticada del moldeador estético. Sus hormonas y mecanitos modelan los músculos y la grasa, añadiendo tejido estético sin función donde haga falta para lograr el aspecto deseado. Puede configurarse para crear distintas formas corporales al gusto del usuario o de su pareja.\n\nLo produjo el infame Dr. La Ruina, que amasó una fortuna descomunal con su invención. Se le busca por numerosos experimentos humanos contrarios a la ética y por colaborar con traficantes de personas que utilizan estos implantes en esclavos.

Rule.Original: The V.O.I.D. implant, a pinnacle of bionic engineering, is the result of Voidtech's advancements in the field, merging with the ancient implant technology of AdminPwn. It enhances the user's speed, cognitive capabilities, combat prowess, and physical endurance to an unprecedented level, making them almost superhuman. This implant is shrouded in secrecy and its availability is limited to only a select few, making it an exclusive asset of V.O.I.D. personnel.\n\nIn a world where bionics are becoming commonplace, the V.O.I.D. implant stands out as a rare and coveted piece of technology. Voidtech's recent re-production of ancient implants has led to sightings of these implants in markets across various worlds, often causing a stir among those in the know.

Rule.Translated: El implante V.O.I.D., cumbre de la ingeniería biónica, combina los avances de Voidtech con la antigua tecnología de implantes de AdminPwn. Mejora la velocidad, las capacidades cognitivas, la habilidad de combate y la resistencia física hasta niveles sin precedentes, casi sobrehumanos. Rodeado de secretismo y reservado a unos pocos, es un recurso exclusivo del personal de V.O.I.D.\n\nAunque la biónica se vuelve habitual, sigue siendo una tecnología rara y codiciada. Voidtech ha vuelto a producir implantes antiguos que empiezan a aparecer en mercados de distintos mundos, causando revuelo entre quienes los conocen.

Rule.Original: The X-Hyper implant. Enhances the user's mobility.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants. It is crafted by wasteland engineers and surviving Secronom scientists using available modern technology and junkyard materials in order to provide a cheap physical enhancement for survivors who could not afford the higher end implants.

It perceives every type of electromagnetic radiation, including radio waves, infrared, light, x-rays, and gamma rays. Its visual acuity is precise enough to read handwriting from twenty meters away. It can emit various wavelengths of radiation like a flashlight, and has an internal subpersona AI which helps highlight useful visual information. Its internal workings are a mystery to those outside Voidtech. The bionic part looks and feels exactly like its natural counterpart.

Percibe toda radiación electromagnética: radio, infrarrojos, luz, rayos X y gamma. Puede leer escritura a mano a veinte metros. Emite distintas longitudes de onda como una linterna y lleva una IA subpersona que destaca información visual útil. Su funcionamiento es un misterio fuera de Voidtech. Esta pieza biónica tiene exactamente el aspecto y el tacto de su equivalente natural.

Rule.Original: An artificial arm built by Voidtech. Seems to be a slight improvement from stolen specifications. It's strong enough to crush a thick hardwood branch in its hand, and precise enough to write a sonnet on a grain of rice. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to those outside Voidtech. The bionic part looks and feels exactly like its natural counterpart.

Its internal workings are a mystery to those outside Voidtech.

Rule.Original: Nerotonin-V serum extends life expectancy up to 100 years and provides high resistance to toxicity. It was created by OVID and Voidtech, building upon Secronom's research. They used the Nerotonin-4 virus to create a life-changing product, but its limits are still unknown.

OVID y Voidtech lo crearon a partir de las investigaciones de Secronom, utilizando el virus Nerotonin-4 para desarrollar un producto revolucionario cuyos límites aún se desconocen.

Rule.Original: The Nerotonin-2b serum, developed by OVID and Voidtech, grants rapid healing and immunity, even regenerating lost limbs and eliminating cancer. Based on the ancient Nerotonin-2 serum, it was genetically engineered into self-replicating smart cells. OVID credits defunct company Secronom for the original research.

Based on the ancient Nerotonin-2 serum, it was genetically engineered into self-replicating smart cells. OVID credits defunct company Secronom for the original research.

Parte del antiguo suero Nerotonin-2, modificado genéticamente para formar células inteligentes autorreplicantes. OVID atribuye las investigaciones originales a la desaparecida Secronom.

Rule.Original: The Nerotonin-4b serum is a rumored "cure for death" created in secret by Omnitech Viral Intelligence Department (OVID) and Voidtech. It replicates the resurrective properties of the Nerotonin Type 4 virus without causing subjects to turn into aggressive zombies. However, the development of Nerotonin-4b has come at a high cost, as it is linked to the destruction of multiple urbworlds and midworlds. OVID has sourced much of its research from Secronom, a fallen company that originally developed the Nerotonin Type 4 virus.

Reproduce la resurrección del virus Nerotonin tipo 4 sin transformar al sujeto en un zombi agresivo. El desarrollo de Nerotonin-4b ha costado caro: está vinculado a la destrucción de numerosos mundos urbanos e intermedios. OVID obtuvo gran parte de sus investigaciones de Secronom, la empresa desaparecida que desarrolló el virus Nerotonin tipo 4.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial spine, resembling a natural spine in appearance and its feeling. A biogel nerve bundle runs down an articulated plasteel core, surrounded by a lattice-dust healing system. It matches the performance of a biological spine.\n\nThis bionic part is custom made by VOID for their members.

It matches the performance of a biological spine.\n\nThis bionic part is custom made by VOID for their members.

Un haz de nervios de biogel recorre un núcleo articulado de plastiacero rodeado por un sistema de curación de polvo reticular. Iguala el rendimiento de una columna biológica.\n\nVOID fabrica esta pieza biónica a medida para sus miembros.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial heart resembling a natural heart in appearance and its feeling. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic heartbeat, plus a high-flow pump for rapid circulation during high stress. It is better than a biological heart in almost every way.\n\nThis product was created by Voidtech.

Supera a un corazón biológico en casi todos los aspectos.\n\nEste producto fue creado por Voidtech.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial stomach, resembling a natural stomach in appearance and its feeling. An advanced chemical processing system breaks down nutrients the body could normally never use, leading to increased efficiency. It is better than a biological stomach in almost every way.\n\nThis product was created by Voidtech. It is an improvement from the reprossesor stomach design.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial ear implant, resembling a natural ear in appearance and its feeling. A collection of invisible subdermal microphones capture sound and transmit it to a biogel nerve interface that links directly with the auditory nerve. It's sensitive enough to hear a cat before you see it, can't be damaged by loud noise, and automatically tunes itself to pick out meaningful sounds in noisy environments.\n\nThis bionic part is custom made by VOID for their members.

Detecta a un gato antes de verlo, no sufre daños por ruidos fuertes y se ajusta automáticamente para distinguir sonidos relevantes en entornos ruidosos.\n\nVOID fabrica esta pieza biónica a medida para sus miembros.

Rule.Original: A custom made signal redirector which isolates half of the brain, allowing the other half to sleep while the user remains outwardly awake. By alternating brain halves, the user never needs to sleep. Unfortunately, two hemispheres are better than one - working with half a brain causes a reduction in consciousness.\n\nThis implant is produced by VOID for their members, it is an improvement from the design of the circadian half-cycler with its EMP damage protection to prevent brain shock.

Mejora el supresor de sueño circadiano con protección frente al daño PEM para evitar el choque cerebral.

Rule.Translated: Curación rápida causada por el virus Nerotonin tipo 4. Se activa tras pasar un tiempo prolongado sin sufrir daños físicos.

Rule.Raw: A painkiller effect caused by the Nerotonin Type 4 virus.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto analgésico causado por el virus Nerotonin tipo 4.

Rule.Original:
The Nerotonin Type-4 control implant is a sinister creation of Voidtech Bionics and Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development (OVID) intended only for Nerotonin-4 infected variants. This insidious device can detect Nerotonin-4 variants within a short range, but the user must be in close proximity to the subject they wish to control. The implant contains a malevolent AI and tentacles that grip onto the subject's body with a violent force, burrowing its way into the brain to inject vast amounts of nanites. These nanites neutralize the Nerotonin-4 virus cells and render the subject docile, creating a friendly puppet under the control of the implant. Once the control chip has done its job, it remains in the subject's brain, regulating the nanites and continuing to exert control.
Rumors suggest that the technology for this device was stolen from the lost Project Lazarus and Secronom archives. Dark organizations seek to weaponize the most extreme Nerotonin-4 variants or to control the infected until a cure can be found, but after countless trials, a cure has been deemed "impossible." The N-4 control chip has therefore found other sinister purposes beyond humanitarian aid.
Rule.Raw:
The Nerotonin Type-4 control implant is a sinister creation of Voidtech Bionics and Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development (OVID) intended only for Nerotonin-4 infected variants. This insidious device can detect Nerotonin-4 variants within a short range, but the user must be in close proximity to the subject they wish to control. The implant contains a malevolent AI and tentacles that grip onto the subject's body with a violent force, burrowing its way into the brain to inject vast amounts of nanites. These nanites neutralize the Nerotonin-4 virus cells and render the subject docile, creating a friendly puppet under the control of the implant. Once the control chip has done its job, it remains in the subject's brain, regulating the nanites and continuing to exert control.
Rumors suggest that the technology for this device was stolen from the lost Project Lazarus and Secronom archives. Dark organizations seek to weaponize the most extreme Nerotonin-4 variants or to control the infected until a cure can be found, but after countless trials, a cure has been deemed "impossible." The N-4 control chip has therefore found other sinister purposes beyond humanitarian aid.
Rule.Translated:
El implante de control Nerotonin tipo 4 es una creación siniestra de Voidtech Bionics y Omnitech Viral Intelligence Development (OVID), destinada solo a variantes infectadas por Nerotonin-4. Detecta variantes Nerotonin-4 a corta distancia, pero el usuario debe acercarse al sujeto que quiere controlar. Su IA malévola y sus tentáculos se aferran violentamente al cuerpo y penetran hasta el cerebro para inyectar grandes cantidades de nanitos. Estos neutralizan las células del virus Nerotonin-4 y vuelven dócil al sujeto, como una marioneta amistosa. El chip permanece en su cerebro, regulando los nanitos y manteniendo el control.
Se rumorea que la tecnología fue robada de los archivos perdidos de Project Lazarus y Secronom. Organizaciones oscuras buscan convertir las variantes Nerotonin-4 más extremas en armas o controlar a los infectados hasta hallar una cura, pero tras innumerables pruebas se ha declarado «imposible». Así, el chip de control N-4 ha encontrado otros fines siniestros más allá de la ayuda humanitaria.

It was the result of a 100 year chapter in research and seeking ways to replicate the technology for use of whoever can afford such a device. Scholars are still scratching their heads as to how Voidtech unlocked the answers to their questions.

Rule.Original:
Every {0} colonist feels a wave of anxiety and anger!

Some distant engine of hatred is stirring. It is projecting a psychic drone onto this site through an orbital amplifier, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit worse.

The V.O.I.D. drone level is {1}.

Every {0} colonist feels a wave of anxiety and anger!

Some distant engine of hatred is stirring. It is projecting a psychic drone onto this site through an orbital amplifier, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit worse.

The V.O.I.D. drone level is {1}.
Rule.Translated:
¡Cada {0} colono sentirá oleadas de ira y ansiedad! 

Algún motor distante de odio está proyectando una señal psíquica enloquecedora a través de un amplificador de señal orbital, que solo afecta a {0}. Dentro de unos días, el estado de ánimo de algunas personas empeorará.

El nivel de shock psíquico actual de V.O.I.D. es {1}.

Rule.Original: An articially induced solar flare is blasting the planet through. The electromagnetic interference will prevent most electrical devices from working.
Rule.Raw: An articially induced solar flare is blasting the planet through. The electromagnetic interference will prevent most electrical devices from working.
Rule.Translated: Una llamarada solar provocada artificialmente está azotando el planeta. Las interferencias electromagnéticas impedirán que funcionen la mayoría de los dispositivos eléctricos.

Rule.Original: The solar flare caused by V.O.I.D. is ending.
Rule.Raw: The solar flare caused by V.O.I.D. is ending.

Rule.Original:
An artificially induced solar flare has begun.

The intense radiation will shut down all electrical devices.

It should pass in about a day.
Rule.Raw:
An artificially induced solar flare has begun.

The intense radiation will shut down all electrical devices.

It should pass in about a day.
Rule.Translated:
Ha comenzado una erupción solar provocada por el hombre. 

La fuerte radiación electromagnética hará que todos los equipos electrónicos dejen de funcionar. 

La llamarada durará aproximadamente un día.

Rule.Original: A plume of toxic dust from some distant source is slowly settling over this entire region. Any living thing not under a roof will be slowly poisoned, and items left outside will corrode.
Rule.Raw: A plume of toxic dust from some distant source is slowly settling over this entire region. Any living thing not under a roof will be slowly poisoned, and items left outside will corrode.
Rule.Translated: Una nube de polvo tóxico de alguna fuente lejana está depositándose lentamente por toda la región. Los seres vivos que no estén bajo un techo se envenenarán poco a poco y los objetos dejados al aire libre se corroerán.

Rule.Original: a cloud of toxic fallout will blanket the area around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], killing outdoor plant and animal life
Rule.Raw: a cloud of toxic fallout will blanket the area around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], killing outdoor plant and animal life
Rule.Translated: Una nube de polvo tóxico seguirá cubriendo el área [map_definite] durante el [gameConditionDuration_duration], matando toda la flora y fauna que aún esté afuera.

Rule.Original: The worst of the toxic fallout has settled.
Rule.Raw: The worst of the toxic fallout has settled.
Rule.Translated: V.O.I.D. El polvo tóxico básicamente se ha asentado.

Rule.Original:
A distant chemical fire has released a plume of poison over this entire region.

Any person or creature not under a roof will be slowly sickened by the toxic dust settling out of the atmosphere.

It will last for anywhere between a few days to over a quadrum.
Rule.Raw:
A distant chemical fire has released a plume of poison over this entire region.

It will last for anywhere between a few days to over a quadrum.
Rule.Translated:
El polvo tóxico liberado por un incendio químico distante está contaminando toda el área. 

Cualquier persona o animal que no esté bajo el techo se envenenará lentamente. 

El polvo tóxico persistirá desde unos días hasta una hora.

Rule.Original:
A mysterious conversion chamber has crashed nearby. A toxic fume killing all plantlife seems to emanate from within.

Unsettling echoes of weeping and howling is audible from the chamber.

Perhaps you should get away from it.
Rule.Raw:
A mysterious conversion chamber has crashed nearby. A toxic fume killing all plantlife seems to emanate from within.

Unsettling echoes of weeping and howling is audible from the chamber.

Perhaps you should get away from it.
Rule.Translated:
Un misterioso defoliador se estrelló cerca. 

Los vapores tóxicos que se esparcen desde el interior matarán las plantas cercanas. 

Los ecos de gritos y aullidos angustiosos se pueden escuchar débilmente. 

Tal vez deberías mantenerte alejado de esto.

A mysterious spherical chamber has crashed nearby.

A toxic fume killing all plantlife seems to emanate from within.

Unpromising roars of banging and ominous breathing is audible from the chamber.

Perhaps you should leave it alone.

A toxic fume killing all plantlife seems to emanate from within.

Unpromising roars of banging and ominous breathing is audible from the chamber.

Se pueden escuchar vagamente sonidos de golpes inquietantes y respiraciones siniestras. 

Tal vez deberías mantenerte alejado de esto.

Rule.Original:
A mysterious chamber leaking of toxic fumes has crashed nearby. There are growing tumours in and around the chamber, with red fur and large spiky bones sticking out. An inscripted company logo "OVID" is seen on the side.

A toxic fume killing all plantlife seems to emanate from within.

Something seems to be growling within, those who view it feel as though something is watching them back.

The tingling sensation on your spine tells you that will be better off leaving it alone.

A mysterious chamber leaking of toxic fumes has crashed nearby. There are growing tumours in and around the chamber, with red fur and large spiky bones sticking out. An inscripted company logo "OVID" is seen on the side.

Something seems to be growling within, those who view it feel as though something is watching them back.

Rule.Translated:
Una misteriosa cámara de gas se estrelló cerca. 

Estaba repleto de tumores aún en crecimiento, pelaje rojo y protuberancias óseas enormes y afiladas. 

Los vapores tóxicos que se esparcen desde el interior matarán las plantas cercanas. 

Parecía haber algo rugiendo en el interior y los testigos sintieron como si algo los estuviera espiando. 

El escalofrío que poco a poco sube por tu columna te advierte que es mejor dejar esto en paz.

Rule.Original: V.O.I.D. has activated an ancient device that can end all life in this world. You have 7 days until this planet's core implodes within itself.
Rule.Raw: V.O.I.D. has activated an ancient device that can end all life in this world. You have 7 days until this planet's core implodes within itself.
Rule.Translated: V.O.I.D. activa un antiguo dispositivo que podría acabar con toda la vida en el mundo. Sólo tienes 7 días antes de que explote el núcleo del planeta.

Rule.Original: Mj ai gerrsx eglmizi syv zmwmsr jsv xlmw asvph, mx qywx fi tyvkih.\n\nTime is running out, my friend.
Rule.Raw: Mj ai gerrsx eglmizi syv zmwmsr jsv xlmw asvph, mx qywx fi tyvkih.\n\nTime is running out, my friend.
Rule.Translated: Mj ai gerrsx eglmizi syv zmwmsr jsv xlmw asvph, mx qywx fi tyvkih.\n\nEl tiempo se agota, amigo mío.

Rule.Original: Nerotonin Type-4 "Red Zone" variants have been spotted wandering in your area. They seem to be highly aggressive and actively hunting.
Rule.Raw: Nerotonin Type-4 "Red Zone" variants have been spotted wandering in your area. They seem to be highly aggressive and actively hunting.
Rule.Translated: Mutantes "RedZone" de tipo nerotonina-4 han aparecido cerca, y parecen ser muy agresivos y felices de cazar.

Rule.Original: Nerotonin Type-4 "Death Row" variants have been spotted wandering in your area. They seem to be highly aggressive and actively hunting.
Rule.Raw: Nerotonin Type-4 "Death Row" variants have been spotted wandering in your area. They seem to be highly aggressive and actively hunting.
Rule.Translated: Mutantes de "Zona Muerta" de tipo nerotonina-4 han aparecido cerca, y parecen ser muy agresivos y felices de cazar.

Rule.Original: Red wine is a type of wine made from dark-colored grape varieties. Wine can taste good, but its main effect is intoxication. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.
Rule.Raw: Red wine is a type of wine made from dark-colored grape varieties. Wine can taste good, but its main effect is intoxication. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.
Rule.Translated: El vino tinto se elabora con variedades de uva de color oscuro. Puede tener un buen sabor, pero su efecto principal es la embriaguez. El consumo excesivo puede provocar lagunas de memoria por el alcohol y, con el tiempo, adicción.

Rule.Original: The N-8B (Nerotonin-8B) pill is a revolutionary discovery in the medical field, capable of rapidly healing a variety of health conditions. Unearthed from an abandoned Secronom building years after the devastating N-4 virus outbreak, this mysterious pill was not mentioned in any of the corporation's records. It was revealed to be the cure they failed to release, but only effective for those who have not yet succumbed to the virus or death itself. After being brought back to Fort Pastor, intense research was initiated to allow surviving scientists to reproduce this lost medicine and make it available to those who need it most. However, rumors persist that the true origins of this miraculous pill are rooted in the forbidden knowledge of ancient and malevolent entities.
Rule.Raw: The N-8B (Nerotonin-8B) pill is a revolutionary discovery in the medical field, capable of rapidly healing a variety of health conditions. Unearthed from an abandoned Secronom building years after the devastating N-4 virus outbreak, this mysterious pill was not mentioned in any of the corporation's records. It was revealed to be the cure they failed to release, but only effective for those who have not yet succumbed to the virus or death itself. After being brought back to Fort Pastor, intense research was initiated to allow surviving scientists to reproduce this lost medicine and make it available to those who need it most. However, rumors persist that the true origins of this miraculous pill are rooted in the forbidden knowledge of ancient and malevolent entities.
Rule.Translated: La pastilla N-8B (Nerotonin-8B) es un descubrimiento revolucionario en el campo médico, capaz de curar rápidamente diversas afecciones. Hallada en un edificio abandonado de Secronom años después del devastador brote del virus N-4, esta misteriosa pastilla no aparecía en ningún registro de la empresa. Resultó ser la cura que no llegaron a distribuir, aunque solo funciona en quienes aún no han sucumbido al virus ni a la propia muerte. Tras llevarla de vuelta a Fort Pastor, se inició una intensa investigación para que los científicos supervivientes pudieran reproducir este medicamento perdido y ponerlo a disposición de quienes más lo necesitan. Sin embargo, persisten los rumores de que el verdadero origen de esta pastilla milagrosa se encuentra en el conocimiento prohibido de entidades antiguas y malévolas.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 strain Mother. This subject was formerly a pregnant woman, its unborn child is noticeably merged with the mother's belly forming a second face.

The Mother is one of the most abominable results of the N4 virus, a walking corpse with a permanent reminder of what a child's life could've been. Slow in terms of mobility compared to other variants in its league, The Mother has a ranged attack, vomitting out fast dissipating volatile acid that can melt through armor and buildings.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.

Nerotonin Type-4 strain Mother. This subject was formerly a pregnant woman, its unborn child is noticeably merged with the mother's belly forming a second face.

The Mother is one of the most abominable results of the N4 virus, a walking corpse with a permanent reminder of what a child's life could've been. Slow in terms of mobility compared to other variants in its league, The Mother has a ranged attack, vomitting out fast dissipating volatile acid that can melt through armor and buildings.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.
Rule.Translated:
Madre, una cepa de Nerotonin tipo 4. Este sujeto era una mujer embarazada. Su hijo nonato está visiblemente fusionado con el vientre de la madre, formando un segundo rostro.

La Madre es uno de los resultados más abominables del virus N4: un cadáver ambulante que recuerda permanentemente lo que podría haber sido la vida de un niño. Se mueve despacio en comparación con otras variantes de su categoría, pero dispone de un ataque a distancia: vomita ácido volátil que se disipa rápidamente y puede fundir blindajes y edificios.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea muy resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Titan, an enlarged and muscle bound subject with bones protruding out of its body.

The Titan's strength is featured in its ability to run rampant across streets, running through vehicles in its path and losing very little speed to chase after its prey. The N4 strain changed this subject's bones into something stronger if not equal to concrete in terms of strength. This effectively makes the Titan a living tank, capable of taking many punishing hits before it goes down.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.

Rule.Translated:
Titán, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4. Es un sujeto de gran tamaño y musculatura desarrollada, con huesos que sobresalen de su cuerpo.

La fuerza del Titán le permite arrasar las calles y atravesar los vehículos a su paso, perdiendo muy poca velocidad mientras persigue a su presa. La cepa N4 transformó sus huesos en algo tan resistente como el hormigón, o incluso más. Esto lo convierte en un tanque viviente, capaz de soportar numerosos golpes contundentes antes de caer.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea muy resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Wraith, also known as "The Destroying Angel".

The Wraith's tentacles are capable of penetrating heavy armour found in tanks. They are the archetype of all female N-4 mutants. Wraiths are perhaps the least mentally affected by the mutations of Nerotonin-4, allowing them to retain their premortem mental acuity. Known back in their world as an eerie reminder of humanity’s best.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.

Rule.Translated:
Espectro, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4, también conocida como «El ángel destructor».

Los tentáculos del Espectro pueden perforar el grueso blindaje de los tanques. Los Espectros son el arquetipo de todas las mutantes N-4. Quizá sean los menos afectados mentalmente por las mutaciones de Nerotonin-4, lo que les permite conservar la agudeza mental que tenían antes de morir. En su mundo de origen se los conoce como un inquietante recuerdo de lo mejor de la humanidad.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea muy resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Giant Spider, typically a strain found in athletic body type subjects.

This Nerotonin Type-4 strain is an evolved form of the "Spider" mutation, which causes the infected to grow an extra set of 4 arms.

It is not clear how they could have grown so exponentially. It is hypothesized that the N4 virus mutated the pituitary gland to excrete vast amounts of HGH (Human Growth Hormone), the same mutation that might be found in Titans and Wraiths. This creature's intelligence is about the same as its predecessor, a disadvantage that allows it to be trapped with ease.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.

Rule.Translated:
Araña gigante, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4 cuya cepa suele aparecer en sujetos de constitución atlética.

Esta cepa de Nerotonin tipo 4 es una forma evolucionada de la mutación «Araña», que provoca que a los infectados les crezca un conjunto adicional de 4 brazos.

No está claro cómo han podido crecer de manera tan extraordinaria. Se cree que el virus N4 mutó la hipófisis para que segregase enormes cantidades de HGH (hormona del crecimiento humano), una mutación que también podría darse en Titanes y Espectros. La inteligencia de esta criatura es similar a la de su predecesora, una desventaja que permite atraparla con facilidad.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea muy resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original: A new Nerotonin Type-4 variant, the Stalker is an incredibly smart creature that seems to be capable of finding thrill in hunting its prey. Survivors who have escaped the stalker speak of hearing ominous heavy breathing when approaching its presence out of sight.
Rule.Raw: A new Nerotonin Type-4 variant, the Stalker is an incredibly smart creature that seems to be capable of finding thrill in hunting its prey. Survivors who have escaped the stalker speak of hearing ominous heavy breathing when approaching its presence out of sight.
Rule.Translated: El Acechador, una nueva variante de Nerotonin tipo 4, es una criatura increíblemente inteligente que parece disfrutar cazando a sus presas. Los supervivientes que han escapado del acechador cuentan que oyen una respiración pesada y ominosa cuando se acercan a él sin poder verlo.

Rule.Original: An evolved rumbler. This creature is a Nerotonin Type-4 variant that was commonly founded in dangerous areas known as "purple zones" in maps where the plague has spread, these areas are known to be more dangerous than black zones and have been labelled by survivors as "Death Row" due to the high mortality rates of looters in the area.

Rule.Translated: Un retumbador evolucionado. Esta criatura es una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4 que solía encontrarse en áreas peligrosas conocidas como «zonas moradas» en los mapas de los lugares donde se ha extendido la plaga. Estas áreas son más peligrosas que las zonas negras y los supervivientes las llaman «Corredor de la muerte» por la elevada mortalidad de los saqueadores que entran en ellas.

Rule.Original:
The Volatile Leaper. Incredibly fast, evolved version of the leaper in that it explodes irridiated substances upon death, and its signature movement is twitching as if posessed as it moves in very high speed.

The Leaper was an infamous type of creature well known for killing unsuspecting survivors in Fairview. Slow in terms of mobility, however, their tongue being their main weapon is hardened to the point of penetrating most material known to man with its skin near impervious to small-arms damage. Originally, the creature was the size of a 6 foot tall human being, the Volatile Leaper has undergone several forced mutations to make it superior in every way than its predecessor.

Due to how the N-4 virus strain works, this creature is immune to heat damage, though the creature is still vulnerable to heatstrokes.

Rule.Translated:
El Saltador volátil es una versión evolucionada e increíblemente rápida del saltador. Al morir, estalla y libera sustancias irradiadas. Su movimiento característico consiste en sufrir espasmos, como si estuviera poseído, mientras se desplaza a gran velocidad.

El Saltador era una criatura infame, conocida por matar a supervivientes desprevenidos en Fairview. Aunque se movía despacio, su lengua, su principal arma, estaba tan endurecida que podía perforar la mayoría de los materiales conocidos, y su piel era casi inmune al daño de las armas ligeras. Originalmente tenía el tamaño de un ser humano de 6 pies de altura. El Saltador volátil ha sufrido varias mutaciones forzadas para hacerlo superior a su predecesor en todos los aspectos.

Debido al funcionamiento de la cepa del virus N-4, esta criatura es inmune al daño por calor, aunque sigue siendo vulnerable a los golpes de calor.

Rule.Original:
A weaponized Black Titan, the result of a Titan's prolonged exposure to high temperature in a controlled environment.

Notably has a soot-black skin, larger in size and its bones protruding out of its body as a result of its "change". It is significantly faster and stronger than its Titan predecessor, its bones and muscle have adapted to be as hard as titanium. The Nerotonin-4 virus, having been known to survive high temperatures, under the right circumstances could potentially evolve in an attempt to preserve its host. Black Titans were among the most feared abominations within the Fairview Wasteland, very few survivors lived to report sightings in black zones.

Due to how the N-4 virus strain works, this creature is immune to heat damage, though the creature is still vulnerable to heatstrokes.
