Rule.Translated:
Un Titán negro convertido en arma, resultado de la exposición prolongada de un Titán a altas temperaturas en un entorno controlado.

Destacan su piel negra como el hollín, su mayor tamaño y los huesos que sobresalen de su cuerpo como resultado de su «transformación». Es mucho más rápido y fuerte que su predecesor, el Titán, y sus huesos y músculos se han adaptado hasta alcanzar la dureza del titanio. El virus Nerotonin-4, conocido por sobrevivir a altas temperaturas, podría evolucionar en las circunstancias adecuadas para intentar preservar a su huésped. Los Titanes negros eran de las abominaciones más temidas del yermo de Fairview; muy pocos supervivientes vivían para informar de avistamientos en las zonas negras.

Debido al funcionamiento de la cepa del virus N-4, esta criatura es inmune al daño por calor, aunque sigue siendo vulnerable a los golpes de calor.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Black Wraith, The Charred Destroying Angel. Black Wraiths are an evolution further from the Wraith variant caused by circumstances leading to the subject's mutation underconstant exposure to high temperature.

The Wraith's tentacles are capable of penetrating heavy armour found in tanks. They are the archetype of all female N-4 mutants. Wraiths are perhaps the least mentally affected by the mutations of Nerotonin-4, allowing them to retain their premortem mental acuity. Known back in their world as an eerie reminder of humanity’s best.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.
Rule.Raw:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Black Wraith, The Charred Destroying Angel. Black Wraiths are an evolution further from the Wraith variant caused by circumstances leading to the subject's mutation underconstant exposure to high temperature.

The Wraith's tentacles are capable of penetrating heavy armour found in tanks. They are the archetype of all female N-4 mutants. Wraiths are perhaps the least mentally affected by the mutations of Nerotonin-4, allowing them to retain their premortem mental acuity. Known back in their world as an eerie reminder of humanity’s best.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.
Rule.Translated:
Espectro negro, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4: el ángel destructor carbonizado. Los Espectros negros son una evolución de la variante Espectro, causada por circunstancias que provocan la mutación del sujeto bajo una exposición constante a altas temperaturas.

Los tentáculos del Espectro pueden perforar el grueso blindaje de los tanques. Los Espectros son el arquetipo de todas las mutantes N-4. Quizá sean los menos afectados mentalmente por las mutaciones de Nerotonin-4, lo que les permite conservar la agudeza mental que tenían antes de morir. En su mundo de origen se los conoce como un inquietante recuerdo de lo mejor de la humanidad.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea muy resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original:
An experimental weaponized Black Leaper, a mutant infected with a modified strain of the N-4 virus.

The Leaper was an infamous type of creature well known for killing unsuspecting survivors in Fairview. Slow in terms of mobility, however, their tongue being their main weapon is hardened to the point of penetrating most material known to man with its skin near impervious to small-arms damage. Originally, the creature was the size of a 6 foot tall human being, the Black Leaper has undergone several forced mutations to make it superior in every way than its predecessor.

Due to how the N-4 virus strain works, this creature is immune to heat damage, though the creature is still vulnerable to heatstrokes.

Due to how the N-4 virus strain works, this creature is immune to heat damage, though the creature is still vulnerable to heatstrokes.
Rule.Translated:
Un Saltador negro experimental convertido en arma, un mutante infectado con una cepa modificada del virus N-4.

El Saltador era una criatura infame, conocida por matar a supervivientes desprevenidos en Fairview. Aunque se movía despacio, su lengua, su principal arma, estaba tan endurecida que podía perforar la mayoría de los materiales conocidos, y su piel era casi inmune al daño de las armas ligeras. Originalmente tenía el tamaño de un ser humano de 6 pies de altura. El Saltador negro ha sufrido varias mutaciones forzadas para hacerlo superior a su predecesor en todos los aspectos.

Debido al funcionamiento de la cepa del virus N-4, esta criatura es inmune al daño por calor, aunque sigue siendo vulnerable a los golpes de calor.

Rule.Original: The dreaded Devil Hound of the wastelands, a K-9 infected with an unstable strain of the N-4 virus.\n\nThe Devil Hound is among the most dangerous Nerotonin Type-4 creature on record. Though it does not have the same lethality guaranteed by a Volatile Leaper's tongue, it is the fastest and most resilient creature on the roster of the abominable variants.
Rule.Raw: The dreaded Devil Hound of the wastelands, a K-9 infected with an unstable strain of the N-4 virus.\n\nThe Devil Hound is among the most dangerous Nerotonin Type-4 creature on record. Though it does not have the same lethality guaranteed by a Volatile Leaper's tongue, it is the fastest and most resilient creature on the roster of the abominable variants.
Rule.Translated: El temido Sabueso infernal de los yermos, un K-9 infectado con una cepa inestable del virus N-4.\n\nEl Sabueso infernal es una de las criaturas de Nerotonin tipo 4 más peligrosas de las que se tiene constancia. Aunque no alcanza la letalidad de la lengua de un Saltador volátil, es la criatura más rápida y resistente de todas las abominables variantes.

Rule.Original:
The Nerotonin Type-4 variant Tendril. It the result of a female subject mutating into having arms resembling tentacles that it uses as a weapon.

The Tendrils are typically found in Red Zones, areas where infected variants start showing specialized mutations as opposed to a normal mindless mob of zombies.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be resistant to fire, but not impervious to it like most extreme mutations.

Rule.Translated:
Tentáculo, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4. Es el resultado de la mutación de una mujer cuyos brazos adquieren el aspecto de tentáculos y que los utiliza como armas.

Los Tentáculos suelen encontrarse en las zonas rojas, áreas donde las variantes infectadas empiezan a mostrar mutaciones especializadas, en lugar de ser una simple masa de zombis sin mente.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea resistente al fuego, aunque no inmune a él como las mutaciones más extremas.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Bone, typically a strain present in subjects with anger management issues. Bones protrude out of the body and the muscle mass of the subject is significantly increased. It is the known predecessor of the Titan strain.

Bones are typically found in Red Zones, areas where infected variants start showing specialized mutations as opposed to a normal mindless mob of zombies.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be resistant to fire, but not impervious to it like most extreme mutations.

Rule.Translated:
Hueso, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4 cuya cepa suele aparecer en sujetos con problemas para controlar la ira. Los huesos sobresalen de su cuerpo y su masa muscular aumenta considerablemente. Es la predecesora conocida de la cepa Titán.

Los Huesos suelen encontrarse en las zonas rojas, áreas donde las variantes infectadas empiezan a mostrar mutaciones especializadas, en lugar de ser una simple masa de zombis sin mente.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea resistente al fuego, aunque no inmune a él como las mutaciones más extremas.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Roid Hulk, subjects with this evolved strain are typically those with anabolic or other forms steroids found within their body during the initial phases of their infection.

Roid Hulks are typically found in Red Zones, areas where infected variants start showing specialized mutations as opposed to a normal mindless mob of zombies. The Nerotonin Type-4 virus increases the rate of muscle growth, which has lead to survivors referring to these as "Roid Hulk".

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.
Rule.Raw:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Roid Hulk, subjects with this evolved strain are typically those with anabolic or other forms steroids found within their body during the initial phases of their infection.

Roid Hulks are typically found in Red Zones, areas where infected variants start showing specialized mutations as opposed to a normal mindless mob of zombies. The Nerotonin Type-4 virus increases the rate of muscle growth, which has lead to survivors referring to these as "Roid Hulk".

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be heavily resistant to fire.
Rule.Translated:
Coloso anabólico, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4. Esta cepa evolucionada suele aparecer en sujetos que tenían esteroides anabolizantes u otros tipos de esteroides en el cuerpo durante las primeras fases de la infección.

Los Colosos anabólicos suelen encontrarse en las zonas rojas, áreas donde las variantes infectadas empiezan a mostrar mutaciones especializadas, en lugar de ser una simple masa de zombis sin mente. El virus Nerotonin tipo 4 acelera el crecimiento muscular, lo que ha llevado a los supervivientes a llamarlos «Colosos anabólicos».

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea muy resistente al fuego.

Rule.Original:
Nerotonin Type-4 variant Reaper, subjects with this evolved strain are seen with a scythe like blade on their arm, which has lead to many survivors warning against engaging in melee combat against it.

Reapers are typically found in Red Zones, areas where infected variants start showing specialized mutations as opposed to a normal mindless mob of zombies. The Nerotonin Type-4 virus attacks the subject's main arm and turns it into a grotesque organic blade that is capable of withstanding and even damaging metallic surfaces.

The N-4 strain allows this subject to be resistant to fire, but not impervious to it like most extreme mutations.

Rule.Translated:
Segador, una variante de Nerotonin tipo 4. Los sujetos con esta cepa evolucionada presentan una cuchilla similar a una guadaña en un brazo, lo que ha llevado a muchos supervivientes a advertir contra el combate cuerpo a cuerpo con ellos.

Los Segadores suelen encontrarse en las zonas rojas, áreas donde las variantes infectadas empiezan a mostrar mutaciones especializadas, en lugar de ser una simple masa de zombis sin mente. El virus Nerotonin tipo 4 ataca el brazo principal del sujeto y lo transforma en una grotesca cuchilla orgánica, capaz de resistir e incluso dañar superficies metálicas.

La cepa N-4 hace que este sujeto sea resistente al fuego, aunque no inmune a él como las mutaciones más extremas.
Segundo dedo de la cola izquierdo

Rule.Original: An ancient suit of powered armor. The V.O.I.D. Reactive was crafted by a worldhopper known only by AdminPwn. He was stranded in an earth like world in the midst of a Nerotonin-4 viral outbreak. Through the years he used his knowledge from his journeys through other worlds in order to aid survivors by advancing their technology significantly. Legend says he was the reason why the human race stood a chance in the self contained world of Fairview, where monstrosities beyond imagination lurked outside the inner city walls.
Rule.Raw: An ancient suit of powered armor. The V.O.I.D. Reactive was crafted by a worldhopper known only by AdminPwn. He was stranded in an earth like world in the midst of a Nerotonin-4 viral outbreak. Through the years he used his knowledge from his journeys through other worlds in order to aid survivors by advancing their technology significantly. Legend says he was the reason why the human race stood a chance in the self contained world of Fairview, where monstrosities beyond imagination lurked outside the inner city walls.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua servoarmadura. La armadura reactiva V.O.I.D. fue creada por un viajero entre mundos conocido solo como AdminPwn. Quedó atrapado en un mundo parecido a la Tierra durante un brote del virus Nerotonin-4. A lo largo de los años, utilizó los conocimientos adquiridos en sus viajes por otros mundos para ayudar a los supervivientes, haciendo avanzar considerablemente su tecnología. Según la leyenda, gracias a él la humanidad tuvo una oportunidad en el mundo aislado de Fairview, donde monstruosidades inimaginables acechaban fuera de las murallas de la ciudad interior.

Rule.Original: The Vengeance Guard. It was one of the last known reactive armours invented by a world class craftsman and infamous worldhopper known by the name of AdminPwn. The Vengeance Guard was a solution to a growing Devil Hound threat in an ancient world overrun by the Nerotonin-4 infected. Unfortunately, though it is capable of surviving hits, the same cannot be said for the wearer due to the sheer force of the creature's ferocious attacks.
Rule.Raw: The Vengeance Guard. It was one of the last known reactive armours invented by a world class craftsman and infamous worldhopper known by the name of AdminPwn. The Vengeance Guard was a solution to a growing Devil Hound threat in an ancient world overrun by the Nerotonin-4 infected. Unfortunately, though it is capable of surviving hits, the same cannot be said for the wearer due to the sheer force of the creature's ferocious attacks.
Rule.Translated: El Guardián de la venganza fue una de las últimas armaduras reactivas conocidas que inventó AdminPwn, un artesano de talla mundial e infame viajero entre mundos. El Guardián de la venganza fue la respuesta a la creciente amenaza de los Sabuesos infernales en un antiguo mundo invadido por los infectados de Nerotonin-4. Por desgracia, aunque la armadura puede resistir los golpes, el usuario no siempre puede hacerlo debido a la enorme fuerza de los feroces ataques de estas criaturas.

Rule.Original: An ancient powered armor helmet, The V.O.I.D. helmet has a built-in interface that aids the user in combat and navigating terrain.\n\nThe V.O.I.D. helmet protects the user from psychic attacks and toxic fallouts, it was designed and invented by an infamouse worldhopper known by the name AdminPwn who created these specialized series of armour for V.O.I.D. under the impression that they would stay end help the fallen world they inhabited. Instead, the N-4 variants slowly but surely took over their world as the safe territories that survivors could inhabit in Farview shrunk little by little.
Rule.Raw: An ancient powered armor helmet, The V.O.I.D. helmet has a built-in interface that aids the user in combat and navigating terrain.\n\nThe V.O.I.D. helmet protects the user from psychic attacks and toxic fallouts, it was designed and invented by an infamouse worldhopper known by the name AdminPwn who created these specialized series of armour for V.O.I.D. under the impression that they would stay end help the fallen world they inhabited. Instead, the N-4 variants slowly but surely took over their world as the safe territories that survivors could inhabit in Farview shrunk little by little.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo casco de servoarmadura. El casco V.O.I.D. lleva una interfaz integrada que ayuda al usuario en combate y al recorrer el terreno.\n\nEl casco V.O.I.D. protege de los ataques psíquicos y la lluvia tóxica. Lo diseñó e inventó un infame viajero entre mundos conocido como AdminPwn, que creó esta serie de armaduras especializadas para V.O.I.D. creyendo que se quedarían y ayudarían al mundo caído que habitaban. En cambio, las variantes N-4 fueron apoderándose poco a poco de su mundo, mientras los territorios seguros donde podían vivir los supervivientes en Farview se reducían paulatinamente.

Rule.Original: The ancient Dusk helmet. Part of the dusk gear that infamous worldhopper only known by AdminPwn created. Legends say that formerly, the only way to obtain this helmet was through winning bloodsport among other survivors in a world overrun by the N-4 infected.
Rule.Raw: The ancient Dusk helmet. Part of the dusk gear that infamous worldhopper only known by AdminPwn created. Legends say that formerly, the only way to obtain this helmet was through winning bloodsport among other survivors in a world overrun by the N-4 infected.
Rule.Translated: El antiguo casco Dusk, parte del equipo Dusk creado por el infame viajero entre mundos conocido solo como AdminPwn. Según la leyenda, antiguamente la única forma de conseguirlo era ganar un combate sangriento entre supervivientes en un mundo invadido por los infectados N-4.

Rule.Original: A cloak hood that covers your head. Decent for warmth.
Rule.Raw: A cloak hood that covers your head. Decent for warmth.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha de capa que cubre la cabeza y abriga razonablemente bien.

Rule.Original: A windproof cloak, worn-out from it's years of use but keeps on going. It seems to be something wasteland survivors are too sentimental to let go of, before their time of using power armors. Maybe its just whats fashionable among their social circles.
Rule.Raw: A windproof cloak, worn-out from it's years of use but keeps on going. It seems to be something wasteland survivors are too sentimental to let go of, before their time of using power armors. Maybe its just whats fashionable among their social circles.
Rule.Translated: Una capa cortavientos desgastada por años de uso, pero que sigue aguantando. Parece que los supervivientes de los yermos le tienen demasiado cariño como para desprenderse de ella: la usaban antes de disponer de servoarmaduras. Quizá sea simplemente lo que está de moda entre sus círculos sociales.

Rule.Original: A speed skin that utilizes nano technology. It allows the user to perform actions almost as fast as they think them, with the skin suit preventing burnout, acid buildup and other issued to allow the wearer's body to move freely at meta human speeds.\n\nIt was something "borrowed" by VOID from Glitterworlds during their early stages of venturing through the stars.
Rule.Raw: A speed skin that utilizes nano technology. It allows the user to perform actions almost as fast as they think them, with the skin suit preventing burnout, acid buildup and other issued to allow the wearer's body to move freely at meta human speeds.\n\nIt was something "borrowed" by VOID from Glitterworlds during their early stages of venturing through the stars.
Rule.Translated: Un traje ceñido de velocidad que utiliza nanotecnología. Permite al usuario actuar casi tan rápido como piensa. El traje evita el agotamiento, la acumulación de ácido y otros problemas para que el cuerpo pueda moverse libremente a velocidades sobrehumanas.\n\nVOID lo «tomó prestado» de los mundobrillantes durante sus primeras incursiones entre las estrellas.

Rule.Original: A custom tailor business suit for VOID executives. Its inner workings are taken from Glitterworld technology, bullet resistant and keeps the temperature within warm despite its lightweight feel, as if the user is using a parka.\n\nEven though the color scheme of this suit seems to be for evil organizations, it's so sleek and smart in appearance that its wearer can just about persuade you to surrender and let them use you for human experiments.
Rule.Raw: A custom tailor business suit for VOID executives. Its inner workings are taken from Glitterworld technology, bullet resistant and keeps the temperature within warm despite its lightweight feel, as if the user is using a parka.\n\nEven though the color scheme of this suit seems to be for evil organizations, it's so sleek and smart in appearance that its wearer can just about persuade you to surrender and let them use you for human experiments.
Rule.Translated: Un traje de negocios hecho a medida para los ejecutivos de VOID. Sus mecanismos internos utilizan tecnología de mundobrillantes: resiste las balas y mantiene cálido el interior pese a su ligereza, como si el usuario llevara una parka.\n\nAunque sus colores parecen propios de una organización malvada, su aspecto es tan elegante y refinado que quien lo lleva casi podría convencerte de que te rindas y permitas que te utilicen en experimentos humanos.
armas cuerpo a cuerpo de Fairview

Rule.Original: The Dusk Razor is a strange and powerful falchion-like blade.\n\nPart of the dusk set, the rare weapon systems are shrouded in mystery. Legend says that before its schematics were unlocked for reproduction, the only way to obtain it was through winning a survivor's bloodsport within an ancient world lost to a viral outbreak the self contained world of Fairview. A worldhopper known only by "AdminPwn" was the credited author of the Dusk Set, and he was the one who chose who to award the gear to within the inner city of Fairview.
Rule.Raw: The Dusk Razor is a strange and powerful falchion-like blade.\n\nPart of the dusk set, the rare weapon systems are shrouded in mystery. Legend says that before its schematics were unlocked for reproduction, the only way to obtain it was through winning a survivor's bloodsport within an ancient world lost to a viral outbreak the self contained world of Fairview. A worldhopper known only by "AdminPwn" was the credited author of the Dusk Set, and he was the one who chose who to award the gear to within the inner city of Fairview.
Rule.Translated: La Hoja Dusk es una extraña y poderosa hoja similar a un bracamarte.\n\nForma parte del conjunto Dusk, cuyos inusuales sistemas de armamento están envueltos en misterio. Según la leyenda, antes de que se descubrieran sus planos para reproducirla, la única forma de conseguirla era ganar un combate sangriento entre supervivientes en Fairview, un antiguo mundo aislado que sucumbió a un brote vírico. La creación del conjunto Dusk se atribuye a un viajero entre mundos conocido solo como «AdminPwn», que era quien decidía a quién entregar el equipo dentro de la ciudad interior de Fairview.

Rule.Original: A strange, scythe-like blade. Quite awkward and unwieldy, but lives up to its name. Earned its title through years of use from wherever world it came from, against creatures that can endure losing limbs.
Rule.Raw: A strange, scythe-like blade. Quite awkward and unwieldy, but lives up to its name. Earned its title through years of use from wherever world it came from, against creatures that can endure losing limbs.
Rule.Translated: Una extraña hoja similar a una guadaña. Es bastante incómoda y difícil de manejar, pero hace honor a su nombre. Se ganó ese título tras años de uso en su mundo de origen contra criaturas capaces de soportar la pérdida de extremidades.

Rule.Original: The legendary Dual Blade. Originally produced from the blades of a wakizashi and a katana, the mysterious survivor's name responsible for it's invention has been lost to history. Copies of this item were given to Fairview blacksmiths and mass production began. Elite survivors chose this expensive weapon to take to bloodsport events since it outperformed even the Dusk Razor.
Rule.Raw: The legendary Dual Blade. Originally produced from the blades of a wakizashi and a katana, the mysterious survivor's name responsible for it's invention has been lost to history. Copies of this item were given to Fairview blacksmiths and mass production began. Elite survivors chose this expensive weapon to take to bloodsport events since it outperformed even the Dusk Razor.
Rule.Translated: La legendaria Hoja doble. Se fabricó originalmente con las hojas de un wakizashi y una katana. El nombre del misterioso superviviente responsable de su invención se perdió en la historia. Se entregaron copias a los herreros de Fairview y comenzó su producción en masa. Los supervivientes de élite elegían esta costosa arma para los combates sangrientos porque superaba incluso a la Hoja Dusk.

Rule.Original: The Grinder, a chainsaw with a mysterious origin. Upon close inspection, the word "ASH" is written on the side in crimson letters. Rumors say that the souls of slain enemies are what runs the high power engine of this chainsaw.
Rule.Raw: The Grinder, a chainsaw with a mysterious origin. Upon close inspection, the word "ASH" is written on the side in crimson letters. Rumors say that the souls of slain enemies are what runs the high power engine of this chainsaw.
Rule.Translated: La Trituradora, una motosierra de origen misterioso. Al examinarla de cerca, puede verse la palabra «ASH» escrita en un lateral con letras carmesíes. Se rumorea que las almas de los enemigos muertos alimentan su potente motor.

Rule.Original: A hibernation chamber for freshly converted N-4 infected subjects. It periodically awakens the creatures.
Rule.Raw: A hibernation chamber for freshly converted N-4 infected subjects. It periodically awakens the creatures.
Rule.Translated: Una cámara de hibernación para sujetos infectados N-4 recién convertidos. Despierta periódicamente a las criaturas.

Rule.Original: A volatile chamber for freshly converted N-4 infected subjects. It periodically awakens the creatures.
Rule.Raw: A volatile chamber for freshly converted N-4 infected subjects. It periodically awakens the creatures.
Rule.Translated: Una cámara volátil para sujetos infectados N-4 recién convertidos. Despierta periódicamente a las criaturas.

Rule.Original: A rebirth chamber for freshly converted N-4 infected subjects. It periodically awakens creatures.
Rule.Raw: A rebirth chamber for freshly converted N-4 infected subjects. It periodically awakens creatures.
Rule.Translated: Una cámara de renacimiento para sujetos infectados N-4 recién convertidos. Despierta periódicamente a las criaturas.

Rule.Original: The Longshot PP-10, chambered in 14.5x115mm anti-materiel rifle cartridge. The rifle is built from Ironsight 33-F parts, vastly improved by the best surviving engineers and weapon technicians of Fairview. It's development along with the Wraith Cannon was sponsored by the most powerful factions of the inner city.
Rule.Raw: The Longshot PP-10, chambered in 14.5x115mm anti-materiel rifle cartridge. The rifle is built from Ironsight 33-F parts, vastly improved by the best surviving engineers and weapon technicians of Fairview. It's development along with the Wraith Cannon was sponsored by the most powerful factions of the inner city.
Rule.Translated: El Longshot PP-10 utiliza munición de fusil antimaterial de 14.5x115mm. Está construido con piezas del Ironsight 33-F, mejoradas enormemente por los mejores ingenieros y técnicos de armamento supervivientes de Fairview. Su desarrollo, junto con el del Cañón Espectro, fue financiado por las facciones más poderosas de la ciudad interior.

Rule.Original:
The "Unlimited" Wraith Cannon, chambered in 14.5x115mm anti-materiel rifle cartridge. It is based on the Gatling gun's original designs and is the last weapon ever created by the worldhopper known only by "AdminPwn" until he escaped the dying world he was trapped in, of which where this weapon was born. He used ultratech level resources in his personal reserves to imbue this weapon with the ability to have an inner self replicating system for the ammunition, causing this weapon to be dubbed the "Unlimited" Wraith Cannon.

This minigun has made post-outbreak history in becoming the first weapon to outstrip the GAU-19 in the self contained world of Fairview. It was developed through the combined efforts of surviving engineers and weapon technicians in an attempt to arm the most powerful survivors in the inner city to deal with the Devil Hound threat.

It was named the "Wraith Cannon" as earliest tests with the weapon was conducted towards the Nerotonin Type-4 Wraith variants.
Rule.Raw:
The "Unlimited" Wraith Cannon, chambered in 14.5x115mm anti-materiel rifle cartridge. It is based on the Gatling gun's original designs and is the last weapon ever created by the worldhopper known only by "AdminPwn" until he escaped the dying world he was trapped in, of which where this weapon was born. He used ultratech level resources in his personal reserves to imbue this weapon with the ability to have an inner self replicating system for the ammunition, causing this weapon to be dubbed the "Unlimited" Wraith Cannon.

This minigun has made post-outbreak history in becoming the first weapon to outstrip the GAU-19 in the self contained world of Fairview. It was developed through the combined efforts of surviving engineers and weapon technicians in an attempt to arm the most powerful survivors in the inner city to deal with the Devil Hound threat.

It was named the "Wraith Cannon" as earliest tests with the weapon was conducted towards the Nerotonin Type-4 Wraith variants.
Rule.Translated:
El Cañón Espectro «Ilimitado» utiliza munición de fusil antimaterial de 14.5x115mm. Se basa en los diseños originales de la ametralladora Gatling y fue la última arma que creó el viajero entre mundos conocido solo como «AdminPwn» antes de escapar del mundo moribundo en el que estaba atrapado y donde nació esta arma. Utilizó recursos ultratecnológicos de sus reservas personales para dotarla de un sistema interno de autorreplicación de munición, lo que le valió el apodo de Cañón Espectro «Ilimitado».

Esta ametralladora rotativa hizo historia tras el brote al convertirse en la primera arma que superó a la GAU-19 en el mundo aislado de Fairview. Se desarrolló mediante el esfuerzo conjunto de los ingenieros y técnicos de armamento supervivientes para armar a los supervivientes más poderosos de la ciudad interior frente a la amenaza de los Sabuesos infernales.

Recibió el nombre de «Cañón Espectro» porque sus primeras pruebas se realizaron contra las variantes Espectro de Nerotonin tipo 4.

Rule.Original: The GAU-19/A is designed to accept standard NATO .50 caliber M9-linked ammunition. The rate of fire is selectable to be either 1,000 or 2,000 rounds per minute. The Humvee armament kit version fires at 1,300 rounds per minute. The average recoil force when firing is 1.7kN, 2.2kN or 2.8kN depending on firing rate.
Rule.Raw: The GAU-19/A is designed to accept standard NATO .50 caliber M9-linked ammunition. The rate of fire is selectable to be either 1,000 or 2,000 rounds per minute. The Humvee armament kit version fires at 1,300 rounds per minute. The average recoil force when firing is 1.7kN, 2.2kN or 2.8kN depending on firing rate.
Rule.Translated: La GAU-19/A está diseñada para utilizar munición estándar NATO del calibre .50 enlazada con eslabones M9. Su cadencia de tiro puede ajustarse a 1 000 o 2 000 disparos por minuto. La versión del kit de armamento para Humvee dispara a 1 300 disparos por minuto. La fuerza media del retroceso al disparar es de 1.7kN, 2.2kN o 2.8kN, según la cadencia de tiro.

Legend says that before its schematics were unlocked for reproduction, the only way to obtain it was through winning a survivor's bloodsport within an ancient world lost to a viral outbreak the self contained world of Fairview. Rule.Original: A grotesque semi automatic shotgun, crafted from the preserved remains of the N-4 "undead". It uses 10 gauge shells. Rumors among survivors who have witnessed this weapon perform, are that the cries of the undead can still be heard while firing this weapon.
Rule.Raw: A grotesque semi automatic shotgun, crafted from the preserved remains of the N-4 "undead". It uses 10 gauge shells. Rumors among survivors who have witnessed this weapon perform, are that the cries of the undead can still be heard while firing this weapon.
Rule.Translated: Una grotesca escopeta semiautomática fabricada con los restos preservados de los «no muertos» N-4. Utiliza cartuchos del calibre 10. Entre los supervivientes que la han visto funcionar se rumorea que aún pueden oírse los gritos de los no muertos cuando se dispara.

Rule.Translated: El Percutor Dusk es una escopeta totalmente automática que utiliza cartuchos del calibre 10.\n\nForma parte del conjunto Dusk, cuyos inusuales sistemas de armamento están envueltos en misterio. Según la leyenda, antes de que se descubrieran sus planos para reproducirla, la única forma de conseguirla era ganar un combate sangriento entre supervivientes en un antiguo mundo que sucumbió a un brote vírico. La creación del conjunto Dusk se atribuye a un viajero entre mundos conocido solo como «AdminPwn», que decidía a quién entregar el equipo dentro de la ciudad interior de Fairview.

Rule.Original: The Dusk Enforcer, a puzzling semi automatic pistol. This sidearm has the ability to fire infinitely without needing ammunittion. How this is possible is unknown to all but those who created it. Through ballistic studies, the bullet that exits the barrel upon firing resembles .50 caliber handgun ammo in terms of entry and exit wound damage.\n\nPart of the dusk set, the rare weapon systems are shrouded in mystery. Legend says that before its schematics were unlocked for reproduction, the only way to obtain it was through winning a survivor's bloodsport within an ancient world lost to a viral outbreak the self contained world of Fairview. A worldhopper known only by "AdminPwn" was the credited author of the Dusk Set, and he was the one who chose who to award the gear to within the inner city of Fairview.

Los estudios balísticos indican que la bala que sale del cañón causa daños de entrada y salida similares a los de la munición de pistola del calibre .50.\n\nForma parte del conjunto Dusk, cuyos inusuales sistemas de armamento están envueltos en misterio. Según la leyenda, antes de que se descubrieran sus planos para reproducirla, la única forma de conseguirla era ganar un combate sangriento entre supervivientes en Fairview, un antiguo mundo aislado que sucumbió a un brote vírico. La creación del conjunto Dusk se atribuye a un viajero entre mundos conocido solo como «AdminPwn», que decidía a quién entregar el equipo dentro de la ciudad interior de Fairview.

Rule.Original: Destructive and abhorrent, no one knows how this weapon was created, who actually designed and built it, or where it even came from. It is a general purpose machine gun chambered in 7.62x51mm. It is crafted from preserved remains of N-4 "undead", superstitiously rumored to have a mind of its own and cries of the infected that makes up the weapon parts still heard upon firing it.
Rule.Raw: Destructive and abhorrent, no one knows how this weapon was created, who actually designed and built it, or where it even came from. It is a general purpose machine gun chambered in 7.62x51mm. It is crafted from preserved remains of N-4 "undead", superstitiously rumored to have a mind of its own and cries of the infected that makes up the weapon parts still heard upon firing it.
Rule.Translated: Destructiva y abominable, nadie sabe cómo se creó esta arma, quién la diseñó y construyó ni de dónde procede. Es una ametralladora de uso general que utiliza munición de 7.62x51mm. Está fabricada con los restos preservados de los «no muertos» N-4. La superstición le atribuye una mente propia, y se dice que al disparar todavía se oyen los gritos de los infectados cuyos restos forman sus piezas.

Según la leyenda, antes de que se descubrieran sus planos para reproducirla, la única forma de conseguirla era ganar un combate sangriento entre supervivientes en Fairview, un antiguo mundo aislado que sucumbió a un brote vírico. La creación del conjunto Dusk se atribuye a un viajero entre mundos conocido solo como «AdminPwn», que decidía a quién entregar el equipo dentro de la ciudad interior de Fairview.

Rule.Original: A rifle that was originally custom made for one individual within V.O.I.D.\n\nA worldhopper known by AdminPwn crafted it for this individual after he discovered alien resources within their ancient home world. The GAUSS rifle was a much needed edge against Nerotonin Type 4 variants that run rampant across the inner city, since it was a hellscape where survivors had to fight for survival day by day.

Rule.Translated: Un fusil que originalmente se fabricó a medida para una persona de V.O.I.D.\n\nUn viajero entre mundos conocido como AdminPwn lo creó para ella tras descubrir recursos alienígenas en su antiguo mundo natal. El fusil GAUSS proporcionó una ventaja muy necesaria contra las variantes de Nerotonin tipo 4 que arrasaban la ciudad interior, un infierno donde los supervivientes tenían que luchar cada día por seguir con vida.

Rule.Original: A Nerotonin-4 conversion chamber. Seems to have come from a spacecraft's laboratory.\n\nIt is slowly releasing fumes that is destroying plant life near itself.
Rule.Raw: A Nerotonin-4 conversion chamber. Seems to have come from a spacecraft's laboratory.\n\nIt is slowly releasing fumes that is destroying plant life near itself.
Rule.Translated: Una cámara de conversión de Nerotonin-4 que parece proceder del laboratorio de una nave espacial.\n\nLibera lentamente vapores que destruyen la vida vegetal cercana.

Rule.Original: A Nerotonin-4 conversion chamber. Seems to have come from a spacecraft's laboratory. Something doesn't quite feel right about this one, those who approach it feel something incredibly ominous within.\n\nIt is slowly releasing fumes that is destroying plant life near itself.

Rule.Translated: Una cámara de conversión de Nerotonin-4 que parece proceder del laboratorio de una nave espacial. Hay algo inquietante en ella: quienes se acercan perciben una presencia increíblemente ominosa en su interior.\n\nLibera lentamente vapores que destruyen la vida vegetal cercana.

Rule.Original:
A Nerotonin-4 rebirth chamber. Seems to have come from a spacecraft's laboratory. 

A damaged screen with unintelligible words plead to you with warning symbols to stay away.

It is slowly releasing fumes that is destroying plant life near itself.
Rule.Raw:
A Nerotonin-4 rebirth chamber. Seems to have come from a spacecraft's laboratory. 

A damaged screen with unintelligible words plead to you with warning symbols to stay away.

It is slowly releasing fumes that is destroying plant life near itself.
Rule.Translated:
Una cámara de renacimiento de Nerotonin-4 que parece proceder del laboratorio de una nave espacial.

Una pantalla dañada muestra palabras ininteligibles y símbolos de advertencia que te imploran que mantengas la distancia.

Libera lentamente vapores que destruyen la vida vegetal cercana.

Rule.Original:
A Nerotonin-4 conversion chamber. Seems to have come from a spacecraft's laboratory. 

There's dying screen that seems as if it's fighting with it's life to stay on, flashing in red and displaying warning symbols. Your eyes are averted to one particular word, it says "Devil", with rest of the words illegible due to cracks and internal damage.

It is slowly releasing fumes that is destroying plant life near itself.
Rule.Raw:
A Nerotonin-4 conversion chamber. Seems to have come from a spacecraft's laboratory. 

There's dying screen that seems as if it's fighting with it's life to stay on, flashing in red and displaying warning symbols. Your eyes are averted to one particular word, it says "Devil", with rest of the words illegible due to cracks and internal damage.

It is slowly releasing fumes that is destroying plant life near itself.
Rule.Translated:
Una cámara de conversión de Nerotonin-4 que parece proceder del laboratorio de una nave espacial.

Una pantalla agonizante parece luchar por seguir encendida, parpadeando en rojo y mostrando símbolos de advertencia. Una palabra llama especialmente tu atención: «Diablo». Las demás resultan ilegibles por las grietas y los daños internos.

Libera lentamente vapores que destruyen la vida vegetal cercana.

Rule.Original: Deep in the forgotten corners of the universe, there lies an abhorrent device, born of a race of madmen who sought to ascend to godhood. They built this doomsday weapon to obliterate entire worlds and everything on them, in a grotesque attempt to become the masters of creation. The weapon's name is whispered in hushed tones by those who fear its terrible power, known as the Azathoth Engine. When it is unleashed, the planet's core collapses in on itself, unleashing a cataclysmic force that engulfs everything in its path, leaving nothing behind but cosmic ash and despair.
Rule.Raw: Deep in the forgotten corners of the universe, there lies an abhorrent device, born of a race of madmen who sought to ascend to godhood. They built this doomsday weapon to obliterate entire worlds and everything on them, in a grotesque attempt to become the masters of creation. The weapon's name is whispered in hushed tones by those who fear its terrible power, known as the Azathoth Engine. When it is unleashed, the planet's core collapses in on itself, unleashing a cataclysmic force that engulfs everything in its path, leaving nothing behind but cosmic ash and despair.
Rule.Translated: En los rincones olvidados del universo yace un dispositivo abominable, creado por una raza de locos que buscaba ascender a la divinidad. Construyeron esta arma del fin del mundo para destruir planetas enteros y todo lo que contienen, en un grotesco intento de convertirse en los amos de la creación. Quienes temen su terrible poder susurran su nombre: el Motor Azathoth. Al activarse, el núcleo del planeta colapsa sobre sí mismo y libera una fuerza cataclísmica que devora todo a su paso, dejando únicamente ceniza cósmica y desesperación.

Rule.Original: We apprehended a subject for the V.O.I.D. council. We are in control.
Rule.Raw: We apprehended a subject for the V.O.I.D. council. We are in control.

adicción a las pociones de curación

Rule.Original: A chemical addiction to healing potion. Long-term presence of healing potion has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of healing potion, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Raw: A chemical addiction to healing potion. Long-term presence of healing potion has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of healing potion, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Translated: Una adicción química a las pociones de curación. La exposición prolongada a estas pociones ha provocado adaptaciones neurológicas a nivel celular, por lo que el cerebro ya no puede funcionar correctamente sin la sustancia. \nSin dosis regulares de poción de curación aparecerán síntomas de abstinencia. Sin embargo, una abstinencia prolongada obligará al cerebro a readaptarse a su estado normal y acabará resolviendo la adicción.

Rule.Original: Because of a healing potion addiction, this person needs to regularly consume healing potion to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Raw: Because of a healing potion addiction, this person needs to regularly consume healing potion to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

Rule.Original: Noble house apothecaries, through their refined techniques, have transformed the tribal lesser healing elixir into what is now known as the minor healing potion. By incorporating amber into the recipe, this new concoction boasts enhanced restorative abilities while significantly reducing the adverse effects previously experienced.
Rule.Translated: Los boticarios de las casas nobles, gracias a sus técnicas refinadas, han transformado el elixir tribal de curación inferior en lo que hoy se conoce como poción menor de curación. Al incorporar ámbar a la receta, esta nueva mezcla posee mejores propiedades restauradoras y reduce considerablemente los efectos adversos de la versión anterior.

Rule.Original:
The mod adds some unique behaviors worth knowing about.
- Checking for enemies on the map - if the enemy is reachable and is not in the zone in which the mechanoid operates, then False is returned and the mechanoid will continue to work normally.
What does it mean: If you enable the "Work if safe" mode and limit the working area, the mechanoid will ignore the intrusion until the enemy is in the mechanoid's working area.
If you have enabled the "Find and destroy" mode and locked the mechanoids in a small but open area, then the mechanoid will not pursue enemies, but will try to fight with the enemy that is in the field of view of the mechanoid. This can lead to too smart AI kiting your mechs.
- Smart charge - In some modes, mechanoids will try to maintain close to the maximum charge. This is calculated according to the formula (Maximum charge level - 5), that is, if you set the charge to 100%, the mechanoids will be charged up to 95%, and so on. However, unlike vanilla charging, mechanoids will be interrupted if necessary.
- Shutdown mode - some work modes disable mechanoids for optimization when they are not doing anything. In work modes, the cooldown is much longer than in combat.
- Mechanoid shutdown zone - Mechanoids that have finished all their business and are going to sleep will go to the nearest such zone, if it is in an accessible area for them.
- Smart escort - Mechanoids can be assigned an escort purpose. This way the mechanoids will be able to protect and accompany different pawns. This feature only works for the home map.
Rule.Raw:
The mod adds some unique behaviors worth knowing about.
- Checking for enemies on the map - if the enemy is reachable and is not in the zone in which the mechanoid operates, then False is returned and the mechanoid will continue to work normally.
What does it mean: If you enable the "Work if safe" mode and limit the working area, the mechanoid will ignore the intrusion until the enemy is in the mechanoid's working area.
If you have enabled the "Find and destroy" mode and locked the mechanoids in a small but open area, then the mechanoid will not pursue enemies, but will try to fight with the enemy that is in the field of view of the mechanoid. This can lead to too smart AI kiting your mechs.
- Smart charge - In some modes, mechanoids will try to maintain close to the maximum charge. This is calculated according to the formula (Maximum charge level - 5), that is, if you set the charge to 100%, the mechanoids will be charged up to 95%, and so on. However, unlike vanilla charging, mechanoids will be interrupted if necessary.
- Shutdown mode - some work modes disable mechanoids for optimization when they are not doing anything. In work modes, the cooldown is much longer than in combat.
- Mechanoid shutdown zone - Mechanoids that have finished all their business and are going to sleep will go to the nearest such zone, if it is in an accessible area for them.
- Smart escort - Mechanoids can be assigned an escort purpose. This way the mechanoids will be able to protect and accompany different pawns. This feature only works for the home map.
Rule.Translated:
El mod añade algunos comportamientos particulares que conviene conocer.
- Comprobación de enemigos en el mapa: si se puede llegar al enemigo, pero está fuera de la zona de trabajo del mecanoide, se devuelve False y el mecanoide sigue trabajando normalmente.
Qué significa: Si activas el modo «Trabajar si es seguro» y limitas la zona de trabajo, el mecanoide ignorará la intrusión hasta que el enemigo entre en su área.
Si activas «Buscar y destruir» y limitas a los mecanoides a una zona pequeña pero abierta, no perseguirán a los enemigos e intentarán combatir únicamente a los que estén en su campo de visión. Una IA suficientemente inteligente podría aprovecharlo para atacar a tus mecanoides y retirarse repetidamente.
- Carga inteligente: en algunos modos, los mecanoides intentan mantener una carga cercana al máximo. Se calcula con la fórmula (nivel máximo de carga - 5). Si estableces la carga al 100%, se cargarán hasta el 95%, y así sucesivamente. Sin embargo, a diferencia de la carga normal, se interrumpirán cuando sea necesario.
- Modo de apagado: algunos modos desactivan a los mecanoides que no están haciendo nada para mejorar el rendimiento. En los modos de trabajo, el tiempo de reactivación es mucho mayor que en combate.
- Zona de apagado de mecanoides: los mecanoides que terminen sus tareas y vayan a dormir irán a la zona de este tipo más cercana, siempre que puedan acceder a ella.
- Escolta inteligente: se puede asignar a los mecanoides una función de escolta para proteger y acompañar a distintos peones. Esta función solo funciona en el mapa de la colonia.

Rule.Original:
The mod adds some unique behaviors worth knowing about.
- Checking for enemies on the map - if the enemy is reachable and is not in the zone in which the mechanoid operates, then False is returned and the mechanoid will continue to work normally.
What does it mean: If you enable the "Work if safe" mode and limit the working area, the mechanoid will ignore the intrusion until the enemy is in the mechanoid's working area.
If you have enabled the "Find and destroy" mode and locked the mechanoids in a small but open area, then the mechanoid will not pursue enemies, but will try to fight with the enemy that is in the field of view of the mechanoid. This can lead to too smart AI kiting your mechs.
- Smart charge - In some modes, mechanoids will try to maintain close to the maximum charge. This is calculated according to the formula (Maximum charge level - 5), that is, if you set the charge to 100%, the mechanoids will be charged up to 95%, and so on. However, unlike vanilla charging, mechanoids will be interrupted if necessary.
- Shutdown mode - some work modes disable mechanoids for optimization when they are not doing anything. In work modes, the cooldown is much longer than in combat.
- Mechanoid shutdown zone - Mechanoids that have finished all their business and are going to sleep will go to a such zone, if it is in an accessible area for them.
- Smart escort - Mechanoids can be assigned an escort purpose. This way the mechanoids will be able to protect and accompany different pawns. This feature only works for the home map.
Rule.Raw:
The mod adds some unique behaviors worth knowing about.
- Checking for enemies on the map - if the enemy is reachable and is not in the zone in which the mechanoid operates, then False is returned and the mechanoid will continue to work normally.
What does it mean: If you enable the "Work if safe" mode and limit the working area, the mechanoid will ignore the intrusion until the enemy is in the mechanoid's working area.
If you have enabled the "Find and destroy" mode and locked the mechanoids in a small but open area, then the mechanoid will not pursue enemies, but will try to fight with the enemy that is in the field of view of the mechanoid. This can lead to too smart AI kiting your mechs.
- Smart charge - In some modes, mechanoids will try to maintain close to the maximum charge. This is calculated according to the formula (Maximum charge level - 5), that is, if you set the charge to 100%, the mechanoids will be charged up to 95%, and so on. However, unlike vanilla charging, mechanoids will be interrupted if necessary.
- Shutdown mode - some work modes disable mechanoids for optimization when they are not doing anything. In work modes, the cooldown is much longer than in combat.
- Mechanoid shutdown zone - Mechanoids that have finished all their business and are going to sleep will go to a such zone, if it is in an accessible area for them.

Rule.Translated:
El mod añade algunos comportamientos particulares que conviene conocer.
- Comprobación de enemigos en el mapa: si se puede llegar al enemigo, pero está fuera de la zona de trabajo del mecanoide, se devuelve False y el mecanoide sigue trabajando normalmente.
Qué significa: Si activas el modo «Trabajar si es seguro» y limitas la zona de trabajo, el mecanoide ignorará la intrusión hasta que el enemigo entre en su área.
Si activas «Buscar y destruir» y limitas a los mecanoides a una zona pequeña pero abierta, no perseguirán a los enemigos e intentarán combatir únicamente a los que estén en su campo de visión. Una IA suficientemente inteligente podría aprovecharlo para atacar a tus mecanoides y retirarse repetidamente.
- Carga inteligente: en algunos modos, los mecanoides intentan mantener una carga cercana al máximo. Se calcula con la fórmula (nivel máximo de carga - 5). Si estableces la carga al 100%, se cargarán hasta el 95%, y así sucesivamente. Sin embargo, a diferencia de la carga normal, se interrumpirán cuando sea necesario.
- Modo de apagado: algunos modos desactivan a los mecanoides que no están haciendo nada para mejorar el rendimiento. En los modos de trabajo, el tiempo de reactivación es mucho mayor que en combate.
- Zona de apagado de mecanoides: los mecanoides que terminen sus tareas y vayan a dormir irán a una zona de este tipo, siempre que puedan acceder a ella.
- Escolta inteligente: se puede asignar a los mecanoides una función de escolta para proteger y acompañar a distintos peones. Esta función solo funciona en el mapa de la colonia.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have thick skin, dense flesh, and durable bones, and take much less damage than other people from the same blows.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene do not have a filter and always say what's on their mind, even if it rubs the others the wrong way.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene do not have a filter and always say what's on their mind, even if it rubs the others the wrong way.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen no se cortan y dicen siempre lo que piensan, aunque moleste a los demás.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene do not suffer movement speed penalties caused by wearing clothing that would normally slow them down.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene do not suffer movement speed penalties caused by wearing clothing that would normally slow them down.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen no se ven penalizados en su velocidad de movimiento por llevar ropa que normalmente les ralentizaría.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene need to ingest Luciferium on a regular basis to survive. After 10 days without luciferium, carriers will suffer from luciferium deficiency. After 20 days, they will fall into a coma. After 30 days, they will die.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene need to ingest Luciferium on a regular basis to survive. After 10 days without luciferium, carriers will suffer from luciferium deficiency. After 20 days, they will fall into a coma. After 30 days, they will die.

Rule.Original:
Uhlans are a side-development from captured hussars, turned by certain elements to become a counter to the military-developed supersoldier programs. Their genetic dependence on luciferium is both a deterrent against capturing and an improvement to long-term usefulness.

Appropriately named demons for their permanently flushed skin and intense bloodthirst, uhlans are incredibly resilient and specialized in certain styles of combat. Quite often they are decked out in heavy armor, in which they can charge full tilt at their intended target.

Extremely specialized and on a permanent hair-trigger, there has been much speculation that their development was sponsored by megacorporations as part of the latest arms race. No substantial evidence has been presented to support these claims.
Rule.Raw:
Uhlans are a side-development from captured hussars, turned by certain elements to become a counter to the military-developed supersoldier programs. Their genetic dependence on luciferium is both a deterrent against capturing and an improvement to long-term usefulness.

Appropriately named demons for their permanently flushed skin and intense bloodthirst, uhlans are incredibly resilient and specialized in certain styles of combat. Quite often they are decked out in heavy armor, in which they can charge full tilt at their intended target.

Extremely specialized and on a permanent hair-trigger, there has been much speculation that their development was sponsored by megacorporations as part of the latest arms race. No substantial evidence has been presented to support these claims.
Rule.Translated:
Los ulanos surgieron a partir de húsares capturados, convertidos por ciertos elementos para contrarrestar los programas de supersoldados desarrollados por el ejército. Su dependencia genética al luciferio es tanto un elemento disuasorio contra la captura como una mejora de su utilidad a largo plazo.

Conocidos popularmente como demonios por su piel permanentemente enrojecida y su intensa sed de sangre, los ulanos son increíblemente resistentes y están especializados en ciertos estilos de combate. Suelen ir equipados con armaduras pesadas con las que pueden avanzar a toda velocidad hacia sus objetivos.

Extremadamente especializados y en permanente estado de alerta, se ha especulado mucho con que su desarrollo fue patrocinado por megacorporaciones como parte de la última carrera armamentística. No se han encontrado pruebas sustanciales que respalden estas afirmaciones.

Rule.Original: Uhlans are engineered super-soldiers who fight aggressively and without emotion. They heal extremely fast, glide through obstacles using their small wings, freely ingest military drugs and rely on luciferium to keep their bodies functioning.
Rule.Raw: Uhlans are engineered super-soldiers who fight aggressively and without emotion. They heal extremely fast, glide through obstacles using their small wings, freely ingest military drugs and rely on luciferium to keep their bodies functioning.
Rule.Translated: Los ulanos son supersoldados modificados que combaten de forma agresiva y sin emociones. Se curan extremadamente rápido, planean sobre los obstáculos con sus pequeñas alas, consumen drogas militares sin restricciones y dependen del luciferio para mantener su cuerpo en funcionamiento.

Rule.Original: A small set of wings growing from this person's shoulderblades. They are not capable of flight, but they will not be slowed down by any obstacles.
Rule.Raw: A small set of wings growing from this person's shoulderblades. They are not capable of flight, but they will not be slowed down by any obstacles.
Rule.Translated: Unas pequeñas alas que salen de los omóplatos de esta persona. No le permiten volar, pero hacen que los obstáculos del terreno no le frenen.

Rule.Original: This person has a genetically-induced biochemical dependency on a specific drug. Without regular doses of the drug, their body cannot maintain itself in a healthy state and they will suffer degrading health and mood until they die.\n\nTakes effect after age: 13.
Rule.Raw: This person has a genetically-induced biochemical dependency on a specific drug. Without regular doses of the drug, their body cannot maintain itself in a healthy state and they will suffer degrading health and mood until they die.\n\nTakes effect after age: 13.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona tiene una dependencia bioquímica inducida genéticamente a una droga específica. Sin dosis regulares del químico, su organismo no puede mantenerse en un estado saludable y sufrirá una degradación de su salud y su estado de ánimo hasta que muera.\n\nTiene efecto a partir de los 13 años.

Rule.Original: Disabling this will make the game harder, as you will have to constantly carry a breaching axe to break stuff, but your turrets will be stronger.
Rule.Raw: Disabling this will make the game harder, as you will have to constantly carry a breaching axe to break stuff, but your turrets will be stronger.
Rule.Translated: Desactivarlo hará más difícil la partida, pues necesitarás llevar constantemente un hacha de demolición para romper cosas, aunque tus torretas serán más resistentes.
La piedra natural resiste los daños a distancia.

Rule.Original: Multiply ranged damage types against natural walls by zero.
Rule.Raw: Multiply ranged damage types against natural walls by zero.
Rule.Translated: Multiplica por cero los daños a distancia contra muros naturales.

Rule.Original: A relic from a bygone era, a piece of equipment onece commanded countless sentient weapons of war marching to their doom.
Rule.Raw: A relic from a bygone era, a piece of equipment onece commanded countless sentient weapons of war marching to their doom.
Rule.Translated: Una reliquia de una era pasada, una pieza de equipo que en otro tiempo comandó innumerables armas de guerra conscientes en su marcha hacia la perdición.

Rule.Original: An Powerarmor with built-in advanced cloak field generator can mask the presents of linked meches for a short duration, ideal for ambush. the battle colak works both on the wearer and the mechs also don't break when they attack.
Rule.Raw: An Powerarmor with built-in advanced cloak field generator can mask the presents of linked meches for a short duration, ideal for ambush.\n the battle colak works both on the wearer and the mechs also don't break when they attack.
Rule.Translated: Una servoarmadura con un avanzado generador de campo de camuflaje integrado capaz de ocultar durante un breve periodo la presencia de los mecas vinculados, ideal para emboscadas. El camuflaje de combate funciona tanto sobre el portador como sobre los mecas y no se rompe cuando atacan.

Rule.Original: Some would call this a piece of divinity it self, they are not wrong, in the sense insects cannot fasom humanite's achievement we cannot fasom this "thing".
Rule.Raw: Some would call this a piece of divinity it self, they are not wrong, in the sense insects cannot fasom humanite's achievement we cannot fasom this "thing".
Rule.Translated: Algunos llamarían a esto una pieza de divinidad, y no estarían equivocados. Del mismo modo que los insectos no pueden comprender los logros de la humanidad, nosotros no podemos comprender esta «cosa».

Rule.Original: An armor built around a strange archotech device, somehow it allows linked mechs to be temporarily invincible, but the effect is short lived.
Rule.Raw: An armor built around a strange archotech device, somehow it allows linked mechs to be temporarily invincible, but the effect is short lived.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura construida alrededor de un extraño dispositivo arcontecnológico. De algún modo permite que los mecas vinculados sean temporalmente invencibles, aunque el efecto dura poco.

Rule.Original: A relic from a bygone era, a piece of equipment onece commanded countless sentient weapons of war marching to their doom.

Rule.Translated: Una reliquia de una era pasada, una pieza de equipo que en otro tiempo comandó innumerables armas de guerra conscientes en su marcha hacia la perdición.

Rule.Translated: Una reliquia de una era pasada, una pieza de equipo que en otro tiempo comandó innumerables armas de guerra conscientes en su marcha hacia la perdición.
