Rule.Original: Technology-induced invisibility. Empowered by ancient technology, a mechanitor has cloaked this being.
Rule.Raw: Technology-induced invisibility. Empowered by ancient technology, a mechanitor has cloaked this being.
Rule.Translated: Invisibilidad inducida por tecnología. Potenciado por tecnología antigua, un mecanitor ha camuflado a este ser.

Rule.Original: Technology-induced toughness. Empowered by ancient technology, a mechanitor has toughened this being.
Rule.Raw: Technology-induced toughness. Empowered by ancient technology, a mechanitor has toughened this being.
Rule.Translated: Resistencia inducida por tecnología. Potenciado por tecnología antigua, un mecanitor ha reforzado a este ser.
posición al tumbarse en la cuna

Rule.Original: A one-piece garment for babies and toddlers.
Rule.Raw: A one-piece garment for babies and toddlers.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda de una sola pieza para bebés y niños pequeños.

Rule.Original: A warm hat for tiny heads.
Rule.Raw: A warm hat for tiny heads.
Rule.Translated: Un gorro cálido para cabezas diminutas.

Rule.Original: Keep the sun off sensitive baby skin with this tiny shadecone.
Rule.Raw: Keep the sun off sensitive baby skin with this tiny shadecone.
Rule.Translated: Protege del sol la piel sensible del bebé con este diminuto sombrero cónico.

Rule.Original: Tribalwear in a smaller size than ever.
Rule.Raw: Tribalwear in a smaller size than ever.
Rule.Translated: Ropa tribal de un tamaño más pequeño que nunca.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is still a baby. [PAWN_possessive] story has only just begun.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is still a baby. [PAWN_possessive] story has only just begun.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] aún es un bebé. [PAWN_possessive] historia acaba de comenzar.

Rule.Original: Without regular attention, toddlers become lonely and find it harder and harder to keep themselves entertained.
Rule.Raw: Without regular attention, toddlers become lonely and find it harder and harder to keep themselves entertained.
Rule.Translated: Sin atención regular, los niños pequeños se sienten solos y les cuesta cada vez más entretenerse.

Rule.Original: {0} gets around by crawling. Doors are an impassable barrier, and the crib is an effective prison.
Rule.Raw: {0} gets around by crawling. Doors are an impassable barrier, and the crib is an effective prison.
Rule.Translated: {0} se desplaza gateando. Las puertas son una barrera infranqueable y la cuna, una prisión eficaz.

Rule.Original: {0} is still slow and unsteady on {0_possessive} feet, but {0_pronoun} gains confidence every day.
Rule.Raw: {0} is still slow and unsteady on {0_possessive} feet, but {0_pronoun} gains confidence every day.
Rule.Translated: {0} aún se mueve despacio y con poca estabilidad sobre {0_possessive} pies, pero {0_pronoun} gana confianza cada día.
descripción del aprendizaje de la manipulación

Rule.Original: {0} still struggles with picking up and handling simple objects -- like food and clothes.
Rule.Raw: {0} still struggles with picking up and handling simple objects -- like food and clothes.
Rule.Translated: {0} aún tiene dificultades para recoger y manejar objetos sencillos, como comida y ropa.

Rule.Original: {0} is growing more capable. {PAWN_pronoun} can get food -- more or less -- into {PAWN_possessive} mouth and can undress. Putting clothes back on is more of a challenge.
Rule.Raw: {0} is growing more capable. {PAWN_pronoun} can get food -- more or less -- into {PAWN_possessive} mouth and can undress. Putting clothes back on is more of a challenge.
Rule.Translated: {0} es cada vez más hábil. {PAWN_pronoun} consigue llevar comida, más o menos, a {PAWN_possessive} boca y puede desvestirse. Volver a ponerse la ropa resulta más complicado.

Rule.Original: {0} has mastered most everyday manual tasks, and is eager to show off {PAWN_possessive} new capabilities.
Rule.Raw: {0} has mastered most everyday manual tasks, and is eager to show off {PAWN_possessive} new capabilities.
Rule.Translated: {0} domina la mayoría de las tareas manuales cotidianas y desea presumir de {PAWN_possessive} nuevas capacidades.
sacando a TargetA de la cuna.

Rule.Original: Mood represents how happy or stressed someone is. Babies with low mood are more likely to cry, while babies with a high mood are more likely to giggle.
Rule.Raw: Mood represents how happy or stressed someone is. Babies with low mood are more likely to cry, while babies with a high mood are more likely to giggle.
Rule.Translated: El ánimo representa la felicidad o el estrés de una persona. Los bebés con un ánimo bajo lloran con más frecuencia, mientras que los que están contentos tienden a reírse.

Rule.Original: Babies don't know what to expect from the world, so they can't be disappointed.
Rule.Raw: Babies don't know what to expect from the world, so they can't be disappointed.
Rule.Translated: Los bebés no saben qué esperar del mundo, así que no pueden decepcionarse.

Rule.Original: I'm so lonely. I need attention and I need it now.
Rule.Raw: I'm so lonely. I need attention and I need it now.
Rule.Translated: Me siento muy solo. Necesito atención y la necesito ahora.

Rule.Original: I don't understand what has happened to me and nothing here is familiar.
Rule.Raw: I don't understand what has happened to me and nothing here is familiar.
Rule.Translated: No entiendo qué me ha pasado y nada de aquí me resulta familiar.

Rule.Original: Light steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as nutrient paste from grinders and storage vats to dispensers.
Rule.Raw: Light steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as nutrient paste from grinders and storage vats to dispensers.
Rule.Translated: Una tubería ligera de acero para transportar ese pringue conocido como pasta nutritiva desde las trituradoras y los depósitos de almacenamiento hasta los dispensadores.

Rule.Original: Hidden steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as nutrient paste from grinders and storage vats to dispensers.
Rule.Raw: Hidden steel pipes for transporting the sludge known as nutrient paste from grinders and storage vats to dispensers.
Rule.Translated: Una tubería subterránea de acero para transportar ese pringue conocido como pasta nutritiva desde las trituradoras y los depósitos de almacenamiento hasta los dispensadores.
Permite activar o desactivar el flujo de pasta nutritiva.

Rule.Original: A machine that synthesizes edible nutrient paste from organic feedstocks placed in adjacent hoppers. It consumes less ingredients and time than any other meal production method - but nobody likes eating nutrient paste. Accepts raw food, but not rough plant matter like hay. It does not actually dispense the nutrient paste, but it allows it to be pumped into vats and dispensers in the network.
Rule.Raw: A machine that synthesizes edible nutrient paste from organic feedstocks placed in adjacent hoppers. It consumes less ingredients and time than any other meal production method - but nobody likes eating nutrient paste. Accepts raw food, but not rough plant matter like hay. It does not actually dispense the nutrient paste, but it allows it to be pumped into vats and dispensers in the network.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina que sintetiza pasta nutritiva comestible a partir de la materia prima orgánica que se coloca en tolvas adyacentes. Consume menos ingredientes y requiere menos tiempo que cualquier otro método de producción de comida, pero a nadie le gusta comer pasta nutritiva. Acepta alimentos crudos, pero no materia vegetal en bruto como el heno. En realidad no dispensa la pasta nutritiva, pero permite bombearla hacia los depósitos y dispensadores de la red.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed nutrient paste meal from the vats. Can be used by colonists and prisoners. Nutrient paste meal dispensed and ready for pick-up can deteriorate.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed nutrient paste meal from the vats. Can be used by colonists and prisoners. Nutrient paste meal dispensed and ready for pick-up can deteriorate.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente de almacenamiento en forma de embudo que sirve para almacenar la pasta nutritiva suministrada por los depósitos en forma de raciones. Puede ser utilizado por colonos y prisioneros. Las raciones de pasta nutritiva dispensadas pueden deteriorarse.
dispensador de raciones de pasta nutritiva

Rule.Original: A small pipe output that allows colonists and citizens to pick up nutrient paste.
Rule.Raw: A small pipe output that allows colonists and citizens to pick up nutrient paste.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña tubería de salida que permite a los colonos y a cualquier otro ciudadano recoger raciones de pasta nutritiva.

Rule.Original: A bedside device that feeds a person lying in bed whenever they are hungry, provided that nutrient paste dripper is connected to a nutrient paste vat. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one nutrient paste dripper near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A bedside device that feeds a person lying in bed whenever they are hungry, provided that nutrient paste dripper is connected to a nutrient paste vat. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one nutrient paste dripper near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo que sirve para alimentar a una persona que esté tumbada en una cama cuando tenga hambre, siempre y cuando esté conectado a un depósito de pasta nutritiva. Debe colocarse directamente junto a la cabecera de la cama y orientado hacia ella. Colocar más de un gotero de pasta nutritiva cerca de la misma cama no produce ningún efecto adicional.

Rule.Original: A large tank that can store up to 75 nutrient paste meals in it. Makes a big mess when destroyed.
Rule.Raw: A large tank that can store up to 75 nutrient paste meals in it. Makes a big mess when destroyed.
Rule.Translated: Un gran depósito que puede almacenar el equivalente a 75 raciones de pasta nutritiva. Produce un gran estropicio cuando se destruye.

Rule.Original: Water is stored from the connected well to the tank only while the work is being done.\n\n(Pumping efficiency depends on manipulation and is about 7 to 8 liters per once.)
Rule.Raw: Water is stored from the connected well to the tank only while the work is being done.\n\n(Pumping efficiency depends on manipulation and is about 7 to 8 liters per once.)
Rule.Translated: El agua del pozo conectado solo se almacena en el depósito mientras se realiza el trabajo.\n\n(La eficiencia depende de la manipulación y es de unos 7 a 8 litros por accionamiento).

Rule.Original: Make a filter for filtration device.
Rule.Raw: Make a filter for filtration device.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica un filtro para el dispositivo de filtración.
Fabrica 4 filtros para el dispositivo de filtración.

Rule.Original: Find out the fact that being unsanitary leads to disease. This will allow for research into more hygienic facilities.
Rule.Raw: Find out the fact that being unsanitary leads to disease. This will allow for research into more hygienic facilities.
Rule.Translated: Descubre que la falta de higiene provoca enfermedades. Esto permitirá investigar instalaciones más higiénicas.

Rule.Original: Build medieval-tech bathroom fixtures like toilets and showers.
Rule.Raw: Build medieval-tech bathroom fixtures like toilets and showers.
Rule.Translated: Construye accesorios de baño de tecnología medieval, como retretes y duchas.

Rule.Original: It will be possible to designate irrigation areas by discovering the fact that moisture in the ground is beneficial to crop growth.
Rule.Raw: It will be possible to designate irrigation areas by discovering the fact that moisture in the ground is beneficial to crop growth.
Rule.Translated: Permite designar zonas de riego tras descubrir que la humedad del suelo favorece el crecimiento de los cultivos.

Rule.Original: Inter-row irrigation and canals will allow for more efficient irrigation.
Rule.Raw: Inter-row irrigation and canals will allow for more efficient irrigation.
Rule.Translated: El riego entre hileras y los canales permitirán regar con mayor eficiencia.

Rule.Original: You will be able to install kettle on your camp fire or stove. No more cold feelings when washing your body.
Rule.Raw: You will be able to install kettle on your camp fire or stove. No more cold feelings when washing your body.
Rule.Translated: Podrás colocar un hervidor en la hoguera o la cocina. Se acabó pasar frío al lavarte.

Rule.Original: It is the most primitive toilet. No materials are required, as all you have to do is dig a pit.
Rule.Raw: It is the most primitive toilet. No materials are required, as all you have to do is dig a pit.
Rule.Translated: El retrete más primitivo. No requiere materiales, ya que basta con cavar un hoyo.

Rule.Original: A simple filtration device utilizing sand, fiber, charcoal, etc. It improves water quality and reduces the risk of disease.\n\nRequires filter as fuel.
Rule.Raw: A simple filtration device utilizing sand, fiber, charcoal, etc. It improves water quality and reduces the risk of disease.\n\nRequires filter as fuel.
Rule.Translated: Un sencillo dispositivo de filtración que utiliza arena, fibras, carbón y otros materiales. Mejora la calidad del agua y reduce el riesgo de enfermedades.\n\nRequiere filtros como consumible.

Rule.Original: A filter made of woven fibers. Toxic substances are left between the fibers to clean the water.
Rule.Raw: A filter made of woven fibers. Toxic substances are left between the fibers to clean the water.
Rule.Translated: Un filtro de fibras tejidas. Las sustancias tóxicas quedan atrapadas entre las fibras para limpiar el agua.

Rule.Original: This is a waterway used to draw water into the field.
Rule.Raw: This is a waterway used to draw water into the field.
Rule.Translated: Un canal usado para llevar agua al campo.

Rule.Original: This partition controls the amount of water that flows from the irrigation canal into the field.
Rule.Raw: This partition controls the amount of water that flows from the irrigation canal into the field.
Rule.Translated: Esta compuerta controla la cantidad de agua que pasa del canal de riego al campo.

Rule.Original: This container can be placed on the cooktop to heat the water inside.
Rule.Raw: This container can be placed on the cooktop to heat the water inside.
Rule.Translated: Este recipiente puede colocarse sobre la cocina para calentar el agua que contiene.

Rule.Original: This is a manual pump that pumps water using the pressure difference created by moving the handle up and down. It is a hand-pump, so it is tiring, but it should be better than using a bucket.
Rule.Raw: This is a manual pump that pumps water using the pressure difference created by moving the handle up and down. It is a hand-pump, so it is tiring, but it should be better than using a bucket.
Rule.Translated: Una bomba manual que mueve el agua mediante la diferencia de presión creada al subir y bajar la palanca. Manejarla cansa, pero debería ser mejor que utilizar un cubo.

Rule.Original: A simple bathtub made of a wooden board fitted with a binding hoop. Instead of consuming a large amount of water at a time, they are more comfortable, but not as comfortable as modern bathtubs.
Rule.Raw: A simple bathtub made of a wooden board fitted with a binding hoop. Instead of consuming a large amount of water at a time, they are more comfortable, but not as comfortable as modern bathtubs.
Rule.Translated: Una bañera sencilla hecha con tablas de madera sujetas por un aro. Consume mucha agua de una vez y es más cómoda que otros métodos, aunque menos que una bañera moderna.

Rule.Original: A simple toilet that no longer needs to be pumped as it is connected to the sewer line. They are crude and less beautiful and clean than modern ones.
Rule.Raw: A simple toilet that no longer needs to be pumped as it is connected to the sewer line. They are crude and less beautiful and clean than modern ones.
Rule.Translated: Un retrete sencillo que ya no necesita bombeo porque está conectado al alcantarillado. Es tosco, menos bonito y menos limpio que los modernos.

Rule.Original: A set of jug, bowl, and cloth to wash a dirty body.
Rule.Raw: A set of jug, bowl, and cloth to wash a dirty body.
Rule.Translated: Un conjunto de jarra, cuenco y paño para lavar un cuerpo sucio.

Rule.Original: A delicate silver circlet adorned with regal gemstone.
Rule.Raw: A delicate silver circlet adorned with regal gemstone.
Rule.Translated: Una delicada diadema de plata adornada con una majestuosa gema.

Rule.Original: A soft, flat crowned hat. Often worn by the military as a symbol of valor.
Rule.Raw: A soft, flat crowned hat. Often worn by the military as a symbol of valor.
Rule.Translated: Un gorro blando de copa plana. Los militares suelen llevarlo como símbolo de valor.

Rule.Original: A finely woven garment that blends seamlessly with natural surroundings, imbued with magical properties to enhance stealth.
Rule.Raw: A finely woven garment that blends seamlessly with natural surroundings, imbued with magical properties to enhance stealth.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda finamente tejida que se confunde con el entorno natural y está imbuida de propiedades mágicas para mejorar el sigilo.

Rule.Original: A clandestinine union of intelligent astrologers and engineers. They seek to unravel the mysteries of their arcotech origins and understand their place in the universe. Their technocratic society values knowledge as divine, but despite their insatatable thirst for it, they still manage to retain a deep respect for nature and the cosmos as a whole. They view the universe as a living, interconnected entity, and seek to understand and harmonize with it's divine will. While not directly hostile to other races and cultures, they are reluctant to share their knowledge and technology with outsiders. Those who are able to earn their trust are rewarded with access to their arcotech wonders and knowledge of the secrets of the universe. However, anyone who chooses to oppose them can expect swift and devastating retaliation.
Rule.Raw: A clandestinine union of intelligent astrologers and engineers. They seek to unravel the mysteries of their arcotech origins and understand their place in the universe. Their technocratic society values knowledge as divine, but despite their insatatable thirst for it, they still manage to retain a deep respect for nature and the cosmos as a whole. They view the universe as a living, interconnected entity, and seek to understand and harmonize with it's divine will. While not directly hostile to other races and cultures, they are reluctant to share their knowledge and technology with outsiders. Those who are able to earn their trust are rewarded with access to their arcotech wonders and knowledge of the secrets of the universe. However, anyone who chooses to oppose them can expect swift and devastating retaliation.
Rule.Translated: Una unión clandestina de inteligentes astrólogos e ingenieros. Buscan desentrañar los misterios de su origen arcotecnológico y comprender su lugar en el universo. Su sociedad tecnocrática considera divino el conocimiento, pero a pesar de su sed insaciable conserva un profundo respeto por la naturaleza y el cosmos. Ven el universo como una entidad viva e interconectada y buscan comprender su voluntad divina y armonizar con ella. Aunque no son directamente hostiles a otras razas y culturas, se resisten a compartir sus conocimientos y tecnología con forasteros. Quienes logran ganarse su confianza obtienen acceso a sus maravillas arcotecnológicas y a los secretos del universo. Sin embargo, quien se oponga a ellos puede esperar una represalia rápida y devastadora.

Rule.Original: These blessed have chosen to reject the pursuit of knowledge in favor of a simpler, more harmonious way of life. Their rejection of advanced technology is not due to a lack of understanding or ability, but rather a conscious decision to avoid disrupting the natural order. Their decision to live among the trees is rooted in their belief that technology can be a double-edged sword, capable of both great good and great harm, and that the natural world should be respected and preserved. They have developed a deep bond with the forest, viewing themselves as it's caretakers. Anyone who would dare to disrupt the delicate balance they have choosen to protect should expect to be met with vengeance both swift and fierce.
Rule.Raw: These blessed have chosen to reject the pursuit of knowledge in favor of a simpler, more harmonious way of life. Their rejection of advanced technology is not due to a lack of understanding or ability, but rather a conscious decision to avoid disrupting the natural order. Their decision to live among the trees is rooted in their belief that technology can be a double-edged sword, capable of both great good and great harm, and that the natural world should be respected and preserved. They have developed a deep bond with the forest, viewing themselves as it's caretakers. Anyone who would dare to disrupt the delicate balance they have choosen to protect should expect to be met with vengeance both swift and fierce.
Rule.Translated: Estos Bendecidos han rechazado la búsqueda de conocimiento en favor de una vida más sencilla y armoniosa. No renuncian a la tecnología avanzada por falta de comprensión o capacidad, sino por una decisión consciente de no alterar el orden natural. Viven entre los árboles porque creen que la tecnología es un arma de doble filo, capaz de causar grandes beneficios y daños, y que el mundo natural debe respetarse y conservarse. Han desarrollado un profundo vínculo con el bosque y se consideran sus guardianes. Quien se atreva a alterar el delicado equilibrio que protegen puede esperar una venganza rápida y feroz.

Rule.Original: These blessed live within sprawling underground cities where intrigue, betrayal, and ruthless ambition are common, reflecting their complex and often sinister culture. Social status is fiercely contested, with assassinations and political maneuvering being common methods to rise in power.
Rule.Raw: These blessed live within sprawling underground cities where intrigue, betrayal, and ruthless ambition are common, reflecting their complex and often sinister culture. Social status is fiercely contested, with assassinations and political maneuvering being common methods to rise in power.
Rule.Translated: Estos Bendecidos viven en enormes ciudades subterráneas donde abundan las intrigas, la traición y la ambición despiadada, reflejo de su cultura compleja y a menudo siniestra. El rango social se disputa con ferocidad y los asesinatos y las maniobras políticas son formas habituales de ascender al poder.

Rule.Original: Genealogical profile of the blessed and the cursed.
Rule.Raw: Genealogical profile of the blessed and the cursed.
Rule.Translated: Perfil genealógico de los bendecidos y los malditos.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene their metabolism advanced by seemingly divine means.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene their metabolism advanced by seemingly divine means.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen un metabolismo mejorado por medios aparentemente divinos.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their hair an ashen color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their hair an ashen color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su cabello un color ceniciento.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their hair an silver color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their hair an silver color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su cabello un color plateado.
piel púrpura clara de elfo oscuro

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a devious dark purple color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a devious dark purple color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un siniestro color morado oscuro.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a devious purple color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a devious purple color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un siniestro color morado.
piel púrpura oscura de elfo oscuro

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a devious dark purple color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a devious dark purple color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un siniestro color morado oscuro.

Rule.Original: Learn to craft the elegant apparel and weaponry of the blessed.
Rule.Raw: Learn to craft the elegant apparel and weaponry of the blessed.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a fabricar las elegantes prendas y armas de los bendecidos.

Rule.Original: Mithsilk is a strong fibre made from the bark of trees. It has a faded green hue and feel as soft and light as silk, yet remains extremely robust.
Rule.Raw: Mithsilk is a strong fibre made from the bark of trees. It has a faded green hue and feel as soft and light as silk, yet remains extremely robust.
Rule.Translated: Mithsilk es una fibra resistente obtenida de la corteza de los árboles. Tiene un tono verde apagado y es tan suave y ligera como la seda, pero conserva una gran robustez.

Rule.Original: Divine craftmenship radiate's from it's sleek and polished surface, imbuing each arrow with the whistling song of the forests wind.
Rule.Raw: Divine craftmenship radiate's from it's sleek and polished surface, imbuing each arrow with the whistling song of the forests wind.
Rule.Translated: Su superficie estilizada y pulida irradia una artesanía divina que imbuye cada flecha con el canto silbante del viento del bosque.

Rule.Original: This silver saber gleams with ethereal elegance, bearing intricate runes that dance with every graceful strike.
Rule.Raw: This silver saber gleams with ethereal elegance, bearing intricate runes that dance with every graceful strike.
Rule.Translated: Este sable de plata brilla con elegancia etérea y luce intrincadas runas que danzan con cada golpe grácil.

Rule.Original: The Blessed are an arcane and enigmatic race, possessing immortal bodies immune to the effects of aging. They are tall and graceful, with pointed ears and delicate features that give them an ethereal appearance. Their forms are similar to baseliners, yet they possess an otherworldly beauty that captivates all who see them.
Rule.Raw: The Blessed are an arcane and enigmatic race, possessing immortal bodies immune to the effects of aging. They are tall and graceful, with pointed ears and delicate features that give them an ethereal appearance. Their forms are similar to baseliners, yet they possess an otherworldly beauty that captivates all who see them.
Rule.Translated: Los Bendecidos son una raza arcana y enigmática de cuerpos inmortales inmunes al envejecimiento. Son altos y gráciles, con orejas puntiagudas y rasgos delicados que les dan un aspecto etéreo. Se parecen a los humanos estándar, pero poseen una belleza de otro mundo que cautiva a quienes los contemplan.

Rule.Original: The Hallowed are a sinister and cunning race characterized by their dark skin and white hair. They are tall and lithe, with pointed ears and elegant features that give them an otherworldly appearence. They exist as the antithesis of their Blessed cousins, seeking dominace over all other races and cultures whom they see as inferior.
Rule.Raw: The Hallowed are a sinister and cunning race characterized by their dark skin and white hair. They are tall and lithe, with pointed ears and elegant features that give them an otherworldly appearence. They exist as the antithesis of their Blessed cousins, seeking dominace over all other races and cultures whom they see as inferior.
Rule.Translated: Los Consagrados son una raza siniestra y astuta de piel oscura y cabello blanco. Son altos y esbeltos, con orejas puntiagudas y rasgos elegantes que les dan un aspecto de otro mundo. Son la antítesis de sus parientes Bendecidos y buscan dominar a todas las demás razas y culturas, a las que consideran inferiores.

Rule.Original: Mountainfolk colonies are typically established deep within the mountains, where they carve out extensive networks of tunnels and chambers to serve as their homes and workplaces. These subterranean complexes are carefully planned and designed to maximize efficiency and productivity, with workshops, storage rooms, and living quarters arranged in a logical and practical manner.
Rule.Raw: Mountainfolk colonies are typically established deep within the mountains, where they carve out extensive networks of tunnels and chambers to serve as their homes and workplaces. These subterranean complexes are carefully planned and designed to maximize efficiency and productivity, with workshops, storage rooms, and living quarters arranged in a logical and practical manner.
Rule.Translated: Las colonias del Pueblo de las Montañas suelen establecerse en sus profundidades, donde excavan extensas redes de túneles y cámaras para vivir y trabajar. Estos complejos subterráneos se planifican cuidadosamente para maximizar la eficiencia y productividad, con talleres, almacenes y viviendas organizados de forma lógica y práctica.

Rule.Original: The Hillfolk are a fierce and formidable faction, known for their parsimonious hostility towards outsiders. This hostility has given them a dangerous reputation, leading them to being feared by most factions of the worlds they inhabit. They have been known to launch brutal attacks on those who dare to challenge their territory.
Rule.Raw: The Hillfolk are a fierce and formidable faction, known for their parsimonious hostility towards outsiders. This hostility has given them a dangerous reputation, leading them to being feared by most factions of the worlds they inhabit. They have been known to launch brutal attacks on those who dare to challenge their territory.
Rule.Translated: El Pueblo de las Colinas es una facción feroz y formidable, conocida por su hostilidad parca hacia los forasteros. Esta actitud le ha dado una reputación peligrosa y ha hecho que la mayoría de las facciones de sus mundos lo tema. Se sabe que lanza ataques brutales contra quienes se atreven a desafiar su territorio.

Rule.Original: A dark underground society fueled by slavery, warfare and ruthless ambition, all done in the relentless pursuit of power and domination.
Rule.Raw: A dark underground society fueled by slavery, warfare and ruthless ambition, all done in the relentless pursuit of power and domination.
Rule.Translated: Una oscura sociedad subterránea impulsada por la esclavitud, la guerra y una ambición despiadada, siempre en busca de poder y dominación.
Perfil genealógico de un miembro del pueblo de piedra.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a light blue color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a light blue color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un color azul claro.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a blue color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a blue color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un color azul.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a dark blue color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a dark blue color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un color azul oscuro.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their hair an silver color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their hair an silver color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su cabello un color plateado.

Rule.Original: Pyrite, often called "fool's gold," is a shiny metallic mineral with a brassy-yellow hue and a durable crystalline structure that typically forms in cubic shapes.
Rule.Raw: Pyrite, often called "fool's gold," is a shiny metallic mineral with a brassy-yellow hue and a durable crystalline structure that typically forms in cubic shapes.
Rule.Translated: La pirita, a menudo llamada «oro de los tontos», es un mineral metálico brillante de tono amarillo latón y estructura cristalina resistente que suele formar cubos.

Rule.Original: Stonefolk are a race of hardy and resilient beings that are well-adapted to living in mountainous regions. They are known for their toughness, proficiency in mining, and their unique relationship with alcohol, which is a central aspect of their culture and survival. Stonefolk require a steady supply of alcohol in tehir, which they can brew themselves or trade for with other factions. Without access to alcohol, they can become depressed and unproductive, and eventually die.
Rule.Raw: Stonefolk are a race of hardy and resilient beings that are well-adapted to living in mountainous regions. They are known for their toughness, proficiency in mining, and their unique relationship with alcohol, which is a central aspect of their culture and survival. Stonefolk require a steady supply of alcohol in tehir, which they can brew themselves or trade for with other factions. Without access to alcohol, they can become depressed and unproductive, and eventually die.
Rule.Translated: El Pueblo de Piedra es una raza de seres fuertes y resistentes, bien adaptados a vivir en regiones montañosas. Destacan por su dureza, su habilidad minera y su singular relación con el alcohol, esencial para su cultura y supervivencia. Necesitan un suministro constante de alcohol, que pueden elaborar o conseguir comerciando con otras facciones. Sin él pueden deprimirse, dejar de ser productivos y acabar muriendo.

Rule.Original: Dark Horde's are ruthless, shadow-dwelling warriors who thrive in the depths of caves and dense forests, avoiding the sunlight that weakens burns their flesh. They rely on ambush tactics, night raids, and dark magic to overpower their enemies, using their sensitivity to light as a reason to embrace the cover of darkness.
Rule.Raw: Dark Horde's are ruthless, shadow-dwelling warriors who thrive in the depths of caves and dense forests, avoiding the sunlight that weakens burns their flesh. They rely on ambush tactics, night raids, and dark magic to overpower their enemies, using their sensitivity to light as a reason to embrace the cover of darkness.
Rule.Translated: Las hordas oscuras son guerreros despiadados que habitan en las sombras y prosperan en las profundidades de cuevas y bosques densos, evitando la luz solar que debilita y quema su carne. Dependen de emboscadas, incursiones nocturnas y magia oscura para imponerse a sus enemigos, convirtiendo su sensibilidad a la luz en una razón para abrazar la oscuridad.

Rule.Original: These cursed are a brutish and warlike. They revel in battle, thriving amidst chaos and destruction. With an insatiable appetite for violence and a love for crude technology, they form ramshackle armies that terrorize settlements across the many rimworlds they inhabit. Despite their seemingly primitive nature, Orks possess a latent psychic abilities that bolsters their strength and ferocity in combat.
Rule.Raw: These cursed are a brutish and warlike. They revel in battle, thriving amidst chaos and destruction. With an insatiable appetite for violence and a love for crude technology, they form ramshackle armies that terrorize settlements across the many rimworlds they inhabit. Despite their seemingly primitive nature, Orks possess a latent psychic abilities that bolsters their strength and ferocity in combat.
Rule.Translated: Estos Malditos son brutales y belicosos. Se deleitan en la batalla y prosperan entre el caos y la destrucción. Con un apetito insaciable por la violencia y un amor por la tecnología rudimentaria, forman ejércitos improvisados que aterrorizan asentamientos por los numerosos mundos del confín que habitan. Pese a su naturaleza aparentemente primitiva, los orkos poseen habilidades psíquicas latentes que refuerzan su fuerza y ferocidad en combate.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene prefer to stay indoors and avoid going outside.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene prefer to stay indoors and avoid going outside.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen prefieren permanecer bajo techo y evitar salir al exterior.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene are highly tuned to all psychic energy and influence.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene are highly tuned to all psychic energy and influence.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen presentan una gran sensibilidad a toda forma de energía e influencia psíquica.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene love to shoot wildly at anything that moves.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene love to shoot wildly at anything that moves.
Rule.Translated: A los portadores de este gen les encanta disparar sin control contra cualquier cosa que se mueva.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene sport jagged tusks that grow up from their lower jaw.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene sport jagged tusks that grow up from their lower jaw.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen desarrollan colmillos dentados que crecen desde la mandíbula inferior.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a sallow grey color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a sallow grey color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un tono gris cetrino.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a sallow brown color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a sallow brown color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un tono marrón cetrino.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a sallow ash color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a sallow ash color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un tono ceniciento.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a green color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a green color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un tono verde.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a light green color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a light green color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un tono verde claro.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a dark green color.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a dark green color.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producen un pigmento que da a su piel un tono verde oscuro.

Rule.Original: Learn to craft the brutish weaponry of the cursed.
Rule.Raw: Learn to craft the brutish weaponry of the cursed.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a fabricar el brutal armamento de los Malditos.

Rule.Original: A brutal, serrated blade forged from crude metal, this cursed machete boasts jagged edges and a menacing weight, embodying the raw savagery of its wielders.
Rule.Raw: A brutal, serrated blade forged from crude metal, this cursed machete boasts jagged edges and a menacing weight, embodying the raw savagery of its wielders.
Rule.Translated: Una brutal hoja dentada forjada con metal rudimentario. Este machete de los Malditos presenta bordes irregulares y un peso amenazante que encarna la ferocidad de sus portadores.

Rule.Original: The Cursed are brutish, malevolent creatures bred for war. They are characterized by their grotesque appearance, savage nature, and deep hatred for all that is good and fair.
Rule.Raw: The Cursed are brutish, malevolent creatures bred for war. They are characterized by their grotesque appearance, savage nature, and deep hatred for all that is good and fair.
Rule.Translated: Los Malditos son criaturas brutales y malévolas criadas para la guerra. Se caracterizan por su aspecto grotesco, su naturaleza salvaje y un profundo odio hacia todo lo bueno y justo.

Rule.Original: Greenskins are savage race of powerful warriors that feel no fear and relish in the face of battle. They are strong and vulgar, with tusks jutting from the corners of they mouths, reinforcing their primal nature. While their forms may suggest a lack of intelligence, many cursed are capable of intricate tasks and admirable craftmenship.
Rule.Raw: Greenskins are savage race of powerful warriors that feel no fear and relish in the face of battle. They are strong and vulgar, with tusks jutting from the corners of they mouths, reinforcing their primal nature. While their forms may suggest a lack of intelligence, many cursed are capable of intricate tasks and admirable craftmenship.
Rule.Translated: Los pielesverdes son una raza salvaje de poderosos guerreros que no sienten miedo y disfrutan del combate. Son fuertes y vulgares, con colmillos que sobresalen de las comisuras de la boca y refuerzan su aspecto primitivo. Aunque su apariencia pueda sugerir poca inteligencia, muchos Malditos son capaces de realizar tareas complejas y trabajos artesanales admirables.

Rule.Original: Artwork created by @No_Tables for the Melee Animation mod.\nThis background is dynamic, with a parallax effect.
Rule.Raw: Artwork created by @No_Tables for the Melee Animation mod.\nThis background is dynamic, with a parallax effect.
Rule.Translated: Ilustración creada por @No_Tables para el mod Melee Animation.\nEste fondo es dinámico y tiene un efecto de paralaje.
Ejecución: Puñalada acrobática por la espalda

Rule.Original: The result of being knocked out during melee combat. Recovery will happen automatically over time, or it can be cured by another pawn, even without medicine.
Rule.Raw: The result of being knocked out during melee combat. Recovery will happen automatically over time, or it can be cured by another pawn, even without medicine.
Rule.Translated: El resultado de perder el conocimiento durante un combate cuerpo a cuerpo. La recuperación se produce automáticamente con el tiempo, aunque otro peón puede tratarlo, incluso sin medicinas.

Rule.Original: moving towards TargetA to perform execution.
Rule.Raw: moving towards TargetA to perform execution.
Rule.Translated: acercándose a TargetA para realizar la ejecución.

Rule.Original: engaging in friendly duel with TargetA
Rule.Raw: engaging in friendly duel with TargetA
Rule.Translated: participando en un duelo amistoso con TargetA
viendo el duelo: animando a TargetC

Rule.Original: A cloth lasso that can drag enemies into melee range from a distance, or pull friendlies out of harm's way.
Rule.Raw: A cloth lasso that can drag enemies into melee range from a distance, or pull friendlies out of harm's way.
Rule.Translated: Un lazo de tela que puede arrastrar enemigos desde lejos hasta el alcance cuerpo a cuerpo o apartar a aliados del peligro.

Rule.Original: A devilstrand lasso that can drag enemies into melee range from a distance, or pull friendlies out of harm's way.\nAllows increased lasso reach compared to a regular lasso.
Rule.Raw: A devilstrand lasso that can drag enemies into melee range from a distance, or pull friendlies out of harm's way.\nAllows increased lasso reach compared to a regular lasso.
Rule.Translated: Un lazo de hilodiablo que permite arrastrar enemigos desde lejos hasta ponerlos al alcance del combate cuerpo a cuerpo, o apartar a aliados del peligro.\nTiene más alcance que un lazo normal.

Rule.Original: A hyperweave lasso that can drag enemies into melee range from a distance, or pull friendlies out of harm's way.\nAllows increased lasso reach compared to a devilstrand lasso.
Rule.Raw: A hyperweave lasso that can drag enemies into melee range from a distance, or pull friendlies out of harm's way.\nAllows increased lasso reach compared to a devilstrand lasso.
Rule.Translated: Un lazo de hipertejido que permite arrastrar enemigos desde lejos hasta ponerlos al alcance del combate cuerpo a cuerpo, o apartar a aliados del peligro.\nTiene más alcance que un lazo de hilodiablo.
weeb_legend->[INITIATOR_definite], Coleccionista de Fotos de Pies

Rule.Translated: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_definite] mató a [RECIPIENT_definite] en una ejecución [exec_desc].
r_logentry->Durante una ejecución [exec_desc], [INITIATOR_definite] [stabbed] a [RECIPIENT_definite] en la zona de [recipient_part0_label].
r_logentry->Durante una ejecución [exec_desc], [INITIATOR_definite] [slashed] a [RECIPIENT_definite] en la zona de [recipient_part0_label].
r_logentry->¡Durante una ejecución [exec_desc], [INITIATOR_definite] [beat] a [RECIPIENT_definite] hasta causarle la muerte!

Rule.Original: r_logentry->Performing a [exec_desc] execution, [INITIATOR_definite] [impaled] [RECIPIENT_definite] on [INITIATOR_possessive] [TOOL_label], then tossed [RECIPIENT_definite] over [INITIATOR_possessive] back! Brutal!
Rule.Raw: r_logentry->Performing a [exec_desc] execution, [INITIATOR_definite] [impaled] [RECIPIENT_definite] on [INITIATOR_possessive] [TOOL_label], then tossed [RECIPIENT_definite] over [INITIATOR_possessive] back! Brutal!

Rule.Original: r_logentry->Wielding [INITIATOR_possessive] [TOOL_label], a weapon said to have killed God, [INITIATOR_definite] confronted [RECIPIENT_definite]. Too fast for the eye to follow, [INITIATOR_pronoun] [slashed] [RECIPIENT_definite].\nEverybody clapped.
Rule.Raw: r_logentry->Wielding [INITIATOR_possessive] [TOOL_label], a weapon said to have killed God, [INITIATOR_definite] confronted [RECIPIENT_definite]. Too fast for the eye to follow, [INITIATOR_pronoun] [slashed] [RECIPIENT_definite].\nEverybody clapped.
Rule.Translated: r_logentry->Empuñando [INITIATOR_possessive] [TOOL_label], un arma de la que se dice que mató a Dios, [INITIATOR_definite] se enfrentó a [RECIPIENT_definite]. En un movimiento demasiado rápido para seguirlo con la vista, [INITIATOR_pronoun] [slashed] a [RECIPIENT_definite].\nTodo el mundo aplaudió.

Rule.Raw: r_logentry(p=5)->Wielding [INITIATOR_possessive] [TOOL_label], a weapon said to have killed God, [INITIATOR_definite] confronted [RECIPIENT_definite]. Too fast for the eye to follow, [INITIATOR_pronoun] [slashed] [RECIPIENT_definite].\nThus the legend of [weeb_legend] was born.

En un movimiento demasiado rápido para seguirlo con la vista, [INITIATOR_pronoun] [slashed] a [RECIPIENT_definite].\nAsí nació la leyenda de [weeb_legend].

Rule.Translated: r_logentry->Empuñando [INITIATOR_possessive] [TOOL_label], un arma de la que se dice que mató a Dios, [INITIATOR_definite] se enfrentó a [RECIPIENT_definite]. En un movimiento demasiado rápido para seguirlo con la vista, [INITIATOR_pronoun] [slashed] a [RECIPIENT_definite].\nNadie sabe con certeza si la hoja asestó el golpe mortal o si [INITIATOR_definite] desprende tanta oscuridad que [INITIATOR_possessive] poderosa aura arrebató por completo a [RECIPIENT_definite] las ganas de vivir.

Rule.Original: r_logentry->In an impressive feat of psycast mastery [INITIATOR_definite] summoned dozens of weapons to impale [RECIPIENT_definite].
Rule.Raw: r_logentry->In an impressive feat of psycast mastery [INITIATOR_definite] summoned dozens of weapons to impale [RECIPIENT_definite].
Rule.Translated: r_logentry->En una impresionante demostración de dominio de los poderes psíquicos, [INITIATOR_definite] invocó decenas de armas para empalar a [RECIPIENT_definite].

Rule.Original: Designates a spot where friendly duels can take place. Two colonists with valid melee weapons may spar here for fun and practice.
Rule.Raw: Designates a spot where friendly duels can take place. Two colonists with valid melee weapons may spar here for fun and practice.
Rule.Translated: Designa un lugar para celebrar duelos amistosos. Dos colonos con armas cuerpo a cuerpo válidas pueden enfrentarse aquí para divertirse y practicar.

Rule.Original: The maximum distance from which an enemy can be lassoed by this pawn.\nAffected by the equipped lasso type.
Rule.Raw: The maximum distance from which an enemy can be lassoed by this pawn.\nAffected by the equipped lasso type.
Rule.Translated: La distancia máxima desde la que este personaje puede enlazar a un enemigo.\nDepende del tipo de lazo equipado.

Rule.Original: This pawn's lethality when performing executions. This value represents the chance to kill when performing execution animations, including when winning a duel.
Rule.Raw: This pawn's lethality when performing executions. This value represents the chance to kill when performing execution animations, including when winning a duel.
Rule.Translated: La letalidad de este peón al realizar ejecuciones. Este valor representa la probabilidad de matar durante las animaciones de ejecución, incluso al ganar un duelo.
Habilidad de duelo cuerpo a cuerpo

Rule.Original: This pawn's effectiveness in melee duels. This stat value is compared against the opponents, and influcenes the outcome of the duel.
Rule.Raw: This pawn's effectiveness in melee duels. This stat value is compared against the opponents, and influcenes the outcome of the duel.
Rule.Translated: La eficacia de este peón en los duelos cuerpo a cuerpo. Este valor se compara con el de su oponente e influye en el resultado del duelo.

Rule.Original: The cooldown, measured in seconds, between lasso uses. Affected by lasso type and pawn health status.
Rule.Raw: The cooldown, measured in seconds, between lasso uses. Affected by lasso type and pawn health status.
Rule.Translated: El tiempo de recarga, en segundos, entre usos del lazo. Depende del tipo de lazo y del estado de salud del personaje.

Rule.Original: The cooldown, measured in seconds, between melee executions. Affected by pawn melee skill and other factors.
Rule.Raw: The cooldown, measured in seconds, between melee executions. Affected by pawn melee skill and other factors.
Rule.Translated: El tiempo de recarga, en segundos, entre ejecuciones cuerpo a cuerpo. Depende de la habilidad cuerpo a cuerpo del personaje y de otros factores.

Rule.Original: The speed of ensnaring and then reeling in an enemy using a lasso.\nHigher values mean that it takes less time to grab and pull the target into melee range.\nThis is NOT the lasso cooldown.
Rule.Raw: The speed of ensnaring and then reeling in an enemy using a lasso.\nHigher values mean that it takes less time to grab and pull the target into melee range.\nThis is NOT the lasso cooldown.
Rule.Translated: La velocidad con la que se atrapa y se arrastra a un enemigo mediante un lazo.\nLos valores más altos reducen el tiempo necesario para agarrar al objetivo y acercarlo al alcance del combate cuerpo a cuerpo.\nEste valor NO es el tiempo de recarga del lazo.

Rule.Original: I won a friendly duel against {OTHERPAWN}!\nIt was a relaxed bout but it still feels good to be victorious.
Rule.Raw: I won a friendly duel against {OTHERPAWN}!\nIt was a relaxed bout but it still feels good to be victorious.
Rule.Translated: ¡Gané un duelo amistoso contra {OTHERPAWN}!\nFue un enfrentamiento relajado, pero aun así sienta bien salir con la victoria.

Rule.Original: I lost in a friendly duel against {OTHERPAWN}.\nLosing is disappointing but it was still good practice. I'll get em' next time!
Rule.Raw: I lost in a friendly duel against {OTHERPAWN}.\nLosing is disappointing but it was still good practice. I'll get em' next time!
Rule.Translated: Perdí un duelo amistoso contra {OTHERPAWN}.\nPerder es decepcionante, pero al menos sirvió para practicar. ¡La próxima vez ganaré!

Rule.Original: Summons a myriad of weapons, of unknown origin, to impale the target. Does not require line of sight, and the onslaught of weapons is sure to kill the victim. However, such a feat of psychic ability will put the summoner in a psychic coma for around 2 days.
Rule.Raw: Summons a myriad of weapons, of unknown origin, to impale the target. Does not require line of sight, and the onslaught of weapons is sure to kill the victim. However, such a feat of psychic ability will put the summoner in a psychic coma for around 2 days.
Rule.Translated: Invoca un sinfín de armas de origen desconocido para empalar al objetivo. No requiere línea de visión, y la lluvia de armas matará sin duda a la víctima. Sin embargo, semejante proeza psíquica sumirá a quien la invoque en un coma psíquico durante unos 2 días.

Rule.Original: Casting unique skill: mystic weapon summon
Rule.Raw: Casting unique skill: mystic weapon summon
Rule.Translated: Lanzando habilidad única: invocación de arma mística

Rule.Original: Slash through a single enemy using Scarlet Edge, killing them instantly.
Rule.Raw: Slash through a single enemy using Scarlet Edge, killing them instantly.
Rule.Translated: Corta a un solo enemigo con Scarlet Edge y lo mata al instante.
Ejecución: Has insultado a mi dama

Rule.Original: Kill a single target in a complex and stylish animation that launches them into the air.\nAlways kills the target.
Rule.Raw: Kill a single target in a complex and stylish animation that launches them into the air.\nAlways kills the target.
Rule.Translated: Mata a un solo objetivo con una animación compleja y elegante que lo lanza por los aires.\nSiempre mata al objetivo.

Rule.Original: A legendary weapon of origin unknown. The wielder of this mighty weapon feels compelled to wear a dark trenchcoat and answer questions with a grunt. Some may find this unsettling but none can deny its effectiveness in combat. Unlocks a unique and deadly Special Skill animation.
Rule.Raw: A legendary weapon of origin unknown. The wielder of this mighty weapon feels compelled to wear a dark trenchcoat and answer questions with a grunt. Some may find this unsettling but none can deny its effectiveness in combat. Unlocks a unique and deadly Special Skill animation.
Rule.Translated: Un arma legendaria de origen desconocido. Quien empuña esta poderosa arma siente la necesidad de llevar una gabardina oscura y responder a las preguntas con gruñidos. A algunos les resulta inquietante, pero nadie puede negar su eficacia en combate. Desbloquea una animación de habilidad especial única y letal.

Rule.Original: Bite the target animal and extract hemogen directly from their blood. The animal will lose blood and will be horrified by the interaction, which can result in it lashing out. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target animals.
Rule.Raw: Bite the target animal and extract hemogen directly from their blood. The animal will lose blood and will be horrified by the interaction, which can result in it lashing out. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target animals.
Rule.Translated: Muerde al objetivo para extraer hemógeno directamente de su sangre. El animal perderá sangre y se sentirá horrorizado por la interacción, lo que puede provocar su ira. Un coagulante de efecto rápido cierra la herida para evitar la hemorragia.\n\nSolo puede usarse en animales.

Rule.Original: Bite the target corpse and extract hemogen directly from their blood. The corpse will lose any remaining blood.\n\nCan only target human corpses.
Rule.Raw: Bite the target corpse and extract hemogen directly from their blood. The corpse will lose any remaining blood.\n\nCan only target human corpses.
Rule.Translated: Muerde al cadaver objetivo para extraer hemógeno directamente de su sangre. El cadáver perderá toda la sangre que le quede.\n\nSolo puede usarse en cadáveres humanos.

Rule.Original: Bite the target and extract hemogen directly from their blood. The target will lose blood and will be insulted by the interaction, but will be otherwise unharmed. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target hemogenic humans.
Rule.Raw: Bite the target and extract hemogen directly from their blood. The target will lose blood and will be insulted by the interaction, but will be otherwise unharmed. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target hemogenic humans.
Rule.Translated: Muerde al objetivo para extraer hemógeno directamente de su sangre. El objetivo perderá sangre y se sentirá insultado por la interacción, pero no sufrirá ningún otro daño. Un coagulante de efecto rápido cierra la herida para evitar la hemorragia.\n\nSolo puede usarse en objetivos hemogénicos.

Rule.Original: Grant a target a feeling of extreme ecstasy for a brief duration, which makes them fall head over heels with the caster.
Rule.Raw: Grant a target a feeling of extreme ecstasy for a brief duration, which makes them fall head over heels with the caster.
Rule.Translated: Concede al objetivo una sensación de éxtasis extrema durante un breve período de tiempo, lo que hace que caiga rendido ante el usuario.

Rule.Original: Rip out the heart of an enemy in close proximity, instantly killing them and covering the area in blood. Will only work on creatures with body size of 2 or lower. Bigger creatures will still be heavily damaged.
Rule.Raw: Rip out the heart of an enemy in close proximity, instantly killing them and covering the area in blood. Will only work on creatures with body size of 2 or lower. Bigger creatures will still be heavily damaged.
Rule.Translated: Arranca el corazón de un enemigo cercano, matándolo al instante y cubriendo la zona de sangre. Solo funciona con criaturas con un tamaño corporal de 2 unidades o inferior. Las criaturas más grandes todavía sufrirán graves daños.

Rule.Original: Lay hands on a target and help the target battle their infections. Works on animals or humans.
Rule.Raw: Lay hands on a target and help the target battle their infections. Works on animals or humans.
Rule.Translated: Coloca las manos sobre un objetivo y le ayuda a combatir sus infecciones. Funciona tanto en humanos como en animales.

Rule.Original: Suck blood filth from the area around the sanguophage and turn it into hemogen.
Rule.Raw: Suck blood filth from the area around the sanguophage and turn it into hemogen.
Rule.Translated: Absorbe la sangre que pueda haber en la suciedad que rodea al usuario y la convierte en hemógeno.

Rule.Original: Use archites in the bloodstream to infuse a corpse's body with new life, repairing degenerated cell structures and kickstarting vital functions. The older and worse-preserved the corpse is, the more likely it is that they will come back with memory loss or health conditions. This ability seems to exhaust the archites somehow, so it can only be used very rarely.
Rule.Raw: Use archites in the bloodstream to infuse a corpse's body with new life, repairing degenerated cell structures and kickstarting vital functions. The older and worse-preserved the corpse is, the more likely it is that they will come back with memory loss or health conditions. This ability seems to exhaust the archites somehow, so it can only be used very rarely.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza arquitos en el torrente sanguíneo para insuflar nueva vida al cuerpo de un cadáver, reparando estructuras celulares degeneradas y volviendo a poner en marcha los procesos vitales. Cuanto más viejo y estropeado esté el cadáver, más probable será que el sujeto tenga pérdidas de memoria o problemas de salud. Esta habilidad parece agotar de algún modo los arquitos, por lo que solo puede utilizarse en contadas ocasiones.

Rule.Original: Excrete a thick toxic smoke from special organic reservoirs in the lungs. Tox gas is deadly to almost every creature.
Rule.Raw: Excrete a thick toxic smoke from special organic reservoirs in the lungs. Tox gas is deadly to almost every creature.
Rule.Translated: Excreta un espeso humo tóxico desde una serie de depósitos orgánicos especiales situados en los pulmones. El gas tóxico es mortal para casi todas las criaturas.

Rule.Original: Eject a projectile that explodes on impact and creates a large amount of filth that greatly slows down people trying to move through it.
Rule.Raw: Eject a projectile that explodes on impact and creates a large amount of filth that greatly slows down people trying to move through it.
Rule.Translated: Expulsa un proyectil que explota al impactar y crea una gran cantidad de suciedad que ralentiza enormemente a las personas que intentan atravesarlo.

Rule.Original: Use special glands in the wrists to quickly tend someone's wounds.
Rule.Raw: Use special glands in the wrists to quickly tend someone's wounds.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza glándulas especiales en las muñecas para atender rápidamente las heridas de alguien.

Rule.Original: Use a hemogenic chemical reaction to launch a bony spine at the target. The spine exits through the skin from an opening between the collarbones. Given the method of launch, it is surprisingly easy to aim.
Rule.Raw: Use a hemogenic chemical reaction to launch a bony spine at the target. The spine exits through the skin from an opening between the collarbones. Given the method of launch, it is surprisingly easy to aim.
Rule.Translated: Lanza una espina ósea al objetivo mediante una reacción química hemogénica. La espina sale a través de la piel por una abertura situada entre las clavículas. A pesar de lo engorroso que parece ser el método de lanzamiento, es sorprendentemente fácil de apuntar al objetivo.

Rule.Original: Spray a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up through the mouth and all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.
Rule.Raw: Spray a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up through the mouth and all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.
Rule.Translated: Rocía una sustancia ácida y viscosa a través de la boca por todo el área designada, desde unas glándulas situadas en el cuello. El ácido se adhiere a los objetivos, provocándoles quemaduras con el tiempo.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene can psychically connect with the target briefly, granting them a sense of ecstasy and making them fall in love with the caster.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene can psychically connect with the target briefly, granting them a sense of ecstasy and making them fall in love with the caster.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen pueden conectar psíquicamente con el objetivo brevemente, otorgándoles una sensación de éxtasis y haciendo que se enamoren del lanzador.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have special glands in their mouths that allow them to filter infected blood from the clean blood.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have special glands in their mouths that allow them to filter infected blood from the clean blood.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen unas glándulas especiales en la boca que les permiten filtrar la sangre infectada de la sangre limpia.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene are able to drain blood from their environment, provided there is blood to be drained there.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene are able to drain blood from their environment, provided there is blood to be drained there.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen son capaces de drenar sangre de su entorno, siempre que haya sangre que drenar allí.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene are able to excrete a thick toxic smoke from special organic reservoirs in their lungs. Tox gas is deadly to almost every creature.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene are able to excrete a thick toxic smoke from special organic reservoirs in their lungs. Tox gas is deadly to almost every creature.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen son capaces de excretar un espeso humo tóxico a partir de depósitos orgánicos especiales en sus pulmones. El gas tóxico es mortal para casi todas las criaturas.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have special adrenaline glands that allow them to find the beating heart of the opponent and rip it out in a mad fury.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have special adrenaline glands that allow them to find the beating heart of the opponent and rip it out in a mad fury.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen glándulas de adrenalina especiales que les permiten encontrar el corazón palpitante del adversario y arrancárselo con una furia enloquecida.

Rule.Original: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a thick goo. They can spit it over long distances and cover several people in a viscous goo that will slow them down.
Rule.Raw: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a thick goo. They can spit it over long distances and cover several people in a viscous goo that will slow them down.
Rule.Translated: A los portadores les crecen glándulas en el cuello que generan y almacenan una sustancia viscosa espesa. Pueden escupirlo a grandes distancias y cubrir a varias personas con una sustancia viscosa que las ralentizará.

Rule.Original: Carriers have a reserve of unique resurrector archites which can infuse a corpse, rebuild degenerated tissue and kickstart the vital processes. This brings the dead back to life - though possibly with health issues. This can only be done very rarely, and comes at a steep hemogen cost.
Rule.Raw: Carriers have a reserve of unique resurrector archites which can infuse a corpse, rebuild degenerated tissue and kickstart the vital processes. This brings the dead back to life - though possibly with health issues. This can only be done very rarely, and comes at a steep hemogen cost.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores tienen una reserva de arquitos resucitadores únicos que pueden ser insuflados en un cadáver para reconstruir el tejido degenerado y volver a poner en marcha los procesos vitales. Esto devuelve la vida a los muertos, aunque posiblemente con problemas de salud. Esto solo puede hacerse en contadas ocasiones y tiene un coste de hemógeno elevado.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have their hair naturally styled into elder sanguine hairstyles.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have their hair naturally styled into elder sanguine hairstyles.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen un pelo que adquiere de forma natural el estilo de antiguos chupasangres.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have bat-like ears.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have bat-like ears.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen orejas de murciélago.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have pointy bat-like ears.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have pointy bat-like ears.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen orejas puntiagudas de murciélago.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have hands that partially resemble talons. This reduces their ability to manipulate objects, but allows them to perform special attacks in melee combat.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have hands that partially resemble talons. This reduces their ability to manipulate objects, but allows them to perform special attacks in melee combat.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen manos que se asemejan parcialmente a garras. Esto reduce su capacidad para manipular objetos, pero les permite realizar ataques especiales en combates cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Carriers lose an additional 4 hemogen per day from biological entropy.
Rule.Raw: Carriers lose an additional 4 hemogen per day from biological entropy.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen pierden 4 unidades de hemógeno adicionales al día por entropía biológica.

Rule.Original: Carriers lose an additional 12 hemogen per day from biological entropy.
Rule.Raw: Carriers lose an additional 12 hemogen per day from biological entropy.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen pierden 12 unidades de hemógeno adicionales al día por entropía biológica.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have bat-like leaf nose.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have bat-like leaf nose.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen una nariz de hoja parecida a la de un murciélago.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood. They can bite any animal, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly. This can sometimes make the animal attack the gene carrier.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood. They can bite any animal, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly. This can sometimes make the animal attack the gene carrier.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen pequeños colmillos retráctiles y un órgano en el paladar que puede extraer hemógeno de la sangre caliente fresca. Pueden morder a cualquier animal, chupar la sangre y obtener hemógeno directamente. En ocasiones, esto puede hacer que el animal ataque al portador del gen.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from cold, rotting blood. They can bite any human corpse, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from cold, rotting blood. They can bite any human corpse, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen pequeños colmillos retráctiles y un órgano en el paladar que puede extraer hemógeno de la sangre fría y putrefacta. Pueden morder cualquier cadáver humano, chupar la sangre y obtener hemógeno directamente.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood of other sanguophages. They can bite an unresisting sanguophage, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood of other sanguophages. They can bite an unresisting sanguophage, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen pequeños colmillos retráctiles y un órgano en el paladar que puede extraer hemógeno de la sangre fresca y caliente de otros sanguinófagos. Pueden morder a un sanguinófago que no se resista, chuparle la sangre y obtener hemógeno directamente.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are extremely sensitive to sunlight.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are extremely sensitive to sunlight.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen compuestos biológicos en la piel que reaccionan peligrosamente a la radiación UV. Son extremadamente sensibles a la luz solar.

Rule.Original:
The Strigoi were born out of a catastrophic experiment gone awry. A brilliant scientist sought to create the ultimate soldier by merging the DNA of humans and a now-extinct bat-like creature known as the Desmodus. In pursuit of immortality and power, scientist infused these hybrid beings with archites, rendering them deathless and ageless. The Strigoi possess a terrifying visage, with features reminiscent of both humans and bats. Their bodies are covered in a layer of viscous fluid that enhances their ability to heal from any injury, rendering them immune to disease and poison. In battle, the Strigoi are formidable opponents, using their massive talons to tear their enemies apart with ruthless efficiency.

Over the millennia, the Strigoi have been both feared and hunted for their unnatural abilities and the threat they pose to the balance of power in the universe. They have been forced to live in the shadows, hiding from those who would destroy them, yet ever seeking to expand their influence and further their own mysterious agenda.

Some believe that the Strigoi are nothing more than myths and legends, while others whisper of secret cabals of Strigoi controlling entire civilizations from behind the scenes. There are tales of Strigoi orchestrating brutal blood feuds in the darkest corners of the distant planets, or lurking within the shadows of massive space stations, manipulating events to suit their inscrutable purposes.

Rule.Translated:
Los strigoi nacieron de un experimento catastrófico que salió mal. Un brillante científico trató de crear el soldado definitivo fusionando el ADN de los humanos con el de una criatura similar a un murciélago, ya extinta, conocida como desmodus. En busca de la inmortalidad y el poder, el científico introdujo arquitos en estos seres híbridos, haciéndolos inmortales y atemporales. Los strigoi poseen un rostro aterrador, con rasgos que recuerdan tanto a los humanos como a los murciélagos. Sus cuerpos están recubiertos de una capa de fluido viscoso que mejora su capacidad para curarse de cualquier herida, haciéndolos inmunes a las enfermedades y al veneno. En la batalla, los strigoi son oponentes formidables, que utilizan sus enormes garras para desgarrar a sus enemigos con una eficacia despiadada.

A lo largo de los milenios, los strigoi han sido temidos y perseguidos por sus habilidades antinaturales y la amenaza que suponen para el equilibrio de poder en el universo. Se han visto obligados a vivir en la sombra, escondiéndose de quienes querían destruirlos, pero siempre tratando de ampliar su influencia y promover su propia agenda misteriosa.

Algunos creen que los strigoi no son más que mitos y leyendas, mientras que otros hablan de cábalas secretas de Strigoi que controlan civilizaciones enteras entre bastidores. Hay historias de strigoi orquestando brutales luchas sangrientas en los rincones más oscuros de planetas distantes, o acechando entre las sombras de enormes estaciones espaciales, manipulando los acontecimientos para adaptarlos a sus inescrutables propósitos.

Rule.Original: Strigoi are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are viscous and resemble a half-human half-bat hybrid. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. In combat, they use their huge talons to rip their prey to pieces. The price is that strigoi sanguophages must consume hemogen derived from either human blood or animal blood to survive, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They lose their hemogen supply quickly due to high entropy, and need to replenish it regularly to sustain themselves. They're easily destroyed by fire, and suffer extreme penalties in UV light.

They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. In combat, they use their huge talons to rip their prey to pieces. The price is that strigoi sanguophages must consume hemogen derived from either human blood or animal blood to survive, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They lose their hemogen supply quickly due to high entropy, and need to replenish it regularly to sustain themselves. They're easily destroyed by fire, and suffer extreme penalties in UV light.
Rule.Translated: Los strigoi son superhumanos que no envejecen ni mueren, potenciados por arquitos creados mediante arcotecnología que circulan por su sangre. Son viscosos y parecen híbridos de humano y murciélago. Pueden curar cualquier lesión y nunca padecen enfermedades ni envenenamientos. En combate utilizan sus enormes garras para despedazar a sus presas. El precio es que estos sanguófagos necesitan consumir hemógeno procedente de sangre humana o animal para sobrevivir y entrar periódicamente en largos letargos mortales. Su elevada entropía agota rápidamente sus reservas de hemógeno, por lo que deben reponerlas con frecuencia. El fuego los destruye con facilidad y sufren penalizaciones extremas bajo luz UV.

Rule.Original:
In the darkest reaches of the universe, the Ekkimian vampires were birthed from the twisted ambitions of a rogue scientist named Dr. Mortis. Obsessed with the concept of death and resurrection, Dr. Mortis sought to create a new breed of immortals by fusing archites with the DNA of humans and a mysterious, long-extinct species that thrived on consuming the dead. The Ekkimian vampires, as they came to be known, are grotesque and horrifying in appearance. Resembling desiccated corpses more than living beings, their monstrous visages instill terror in all who lay eyes upon them. Despite their hideous appearance, the Ekkimian vampires possess incredible regenerative abilities, healing any injury and remaining immune to disease and poison.

Ekkimian vampires must consume hemogen derived exclusively from human corpses to survive. This morbid requirement has led them to lurk in the shadows, scavenging the remains of fallen warriors and feeding on the aftermath of battles. Like other sanguophages, they must periodically enter deathrest to recover their strength and replenish their hemogen reserves.

There are whispered tales of entire planets falling under the sway of Ekkimian vampire lords, who feed on the corpses of their enemies and rule with an iron, undead fist. Fearful of the day when these monstrous beings might rise up and unleash their full power, the inhabitants of the colonized planets must remain ever vigilant, lest they become mere fodder for the insatiable hunger of the Ekkimians.
