This morbid requirement has led them to lurk in the shadows, scavenging the remains of fallen warriors and feeding on the aftermath of battles. Like other sanguophages, they must periodically enter deathrest to recover their strength and replenish their hemogen reserves.

There are whispered tales of entire planets falling under the sway of Ekkimian vampire lords, who feed on the corpses of their enemies and rule with an iron, undead fist. Fearful of the day when these monstrous beings might rise up and unleash their full power, the inhabitants of the colonized planets must remain ever vigilant, lest they become mere fodder for the insatiable hunger of the Ekkimians.
Rule.Translated:
En los confines más oscuros del universo, los vampiros ekkimianos nacieron de las retorcidas ambiciones de un científico sin escrúpulos llamado Dr. Mortis. Obsesionado con el concepto de muerte y resurrección, el Dr. Mortis intentó crear una nueva raza de seres inmortales fusionando arquitos con el ADN de humanos y una misteriosa especie extinguida hace mucho tiempo que se alimentaba de los muertos. Los vampiros ekkimianos, como llegaron a ser conocidos, tienen un aspecto grotesco y horrible. Más parecidos a cadáveres resecos que a seres vivos, sus monstruosos rostros infunden terror a todo aquel que los contempla. A pesar de su horrible aspecto, los vampiros ekkimianos poseen increíbles habilidades regenerativas, curan cualquier herida y permanecen inmunes a las enfermedades y el veneno.

Los vampiros ekkimianos deben consumir el hemógeno derivado exclusivamente de cadáveres humanos para sobrevivir. Este morboso requisito les ha llevado a acechar en las sombras, carroñear los restos de guerreros caídos y alimentarse de las secuelas de las batallas. Al igual que otros tipos de sanguinófagos, deben entrar periódicamente en el estado de descanso sepulcral para recuperar fuerzas y reponer sus reservas de hemógeno.

Se rumorean historias de planetas enteros que caen bajo el dominio de los señores vampiros ekkimianos, que se alimentan de los cadáveres de sus enemigos y gobiernan con puño de hierro no muerto. Temerosos de que llegue el día en que estos seres monstruosos se alcen y desaten todo su poder, los habitantes de los planetas colonizados deben permanecer siempre vigilantes, no sea que se conviertan en mero forraje para el hambre insaciable de los ekkimianos.

Rule.Original: Ekkimian are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are extremely ugly and resemble dessicated corpses more than humans. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. In combat, they can excrete toxic clouds around themselves, and rapidly regenerate any wounds at the cost of hemogen. The price is that ekkimian sanguophages must consume hemogen derived from human corpses and only corpses, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They're easily destroyed by fire, and slowed down by UV light.
Rule.Raw: Ekkimian are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are extremely ugly and resemble dessicated corpses more than humans. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. In combat, they can excrete toxic clouds around themselves, and rapidly regenerate any wounds at the cost of hemogen. The price is that ekkimian sanguophages must consume hemogen derived from human corpses and only corpses, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They're easily destroyed by fire, and slowed down by UV light.
Rule.Translated: Los ekkimian son superhumanos que no envejecen ni mueren, potenciados por arquitos creados mediante arcotecnología que circulan por su sangre. Son extremadamente feos y parecen más cadáveres desecados que humanos. Pueden curar cualquier lesión y nunca padecen enfermedades ni envenenamientos. En combate pueden expulsar nubes tóxicas a su alrededor y regenerar rápidamente sus heridas a costa de hemógeno. El precio es que estos sanguófagos solo pueden obtener hemógeno de cadáveres humanos y necesitan entrar periódicamente en largos letargos mortales. El fuego los destruye con facilidad y la luz UV los ralentiza.

Rule.Original:
In the complex tapestry of the universe, the Bruxas emerged as a unique and alluring subxenotype of sanguophage. Created by an enigmatic archotech entity seeking to weave together beauty and power, the Bruxas were gifted with unparalleled grace and charm. Designed as the ultimate companions to other sanguophages, the Bruxas were engineered with the unique ability to bond with their brethren and feed on their blood, bestowing mutual benefits upon both parties.

The Bruxas are ageless and deathless, their bodies imbued with archotech-created archites that grant them extraordinary abilities. Possessing an ethereal beauty, they are irresistibly captivating to those who cross their paths. In addition to their regenerative powers, which allow them to heal any injury and remain immune to disease and poison, Bruxas have the remarkable ability to filter infections from the bloodstream of other humans, purifying their blood and filling them with an overwhelming sense of ecstasy in the process.

Throughout the ages, the Bruxas have been both feared and revered for their beguiling beauty and potent abilities. Often serving as confidants and companions to powerful individuals, including sanguophage lords, they have been known to wield considerable influence in the shadow societies. Their unique ability to bond with other humans has led to the formation of secret alliances and networks, further solidifying their power and influence.

In the vast expanse of the universe, the Bruxas remain an enigma - seductive and mysterious, their true intentions hidden behind a veil of allure and grace. Those who encounter a Bruxa must tread carefully, for while their touch may bring unimaginable pleasure, it may also lead to a fate more treacherous than one could ever imagine.

Those who encounter a Bruxa must tread carefully, for while their touch may bring unimaginable pleasure, it may also lead to a fate more treacherous than one could ever imagine.
Rule.Translated:
En el complejo tapiz del universo, los bruxa surgieron como un subxenotipo único y seductor de sanguinófagos. Creados por una enigmática entidad arqueotécnica que buscaba entrelazar belleza y poder, los bruxa estaban dotados de una gracia y un encanto incomparables. Diseñados como las mejores compañeros de otros sanguinófagos, los bruxa fueron creados con la capacidad única de unirse a sus hermanos y alimentarse de su sangre, otorgando beneficios mutuos a ambas partes.

Los bruxa son eternos e inmortales, y sus cuerpos están imbuidos de arquitos creados por los arqueotécnicos que les otorgan habilidades extraordinarias. Poseedores de una belleza etérea, son irresistiblemente cautivadores para quienes se cruzan en su camino. Además de sus poderes regenerativos, que les permiten curar cualquier herida y permanecer inmunes frente a enfermedades y venenos, los bruxa tienen la extraordinaria capacidad de filtrar infecciones del torrente sanguíneo de otros humanos, purificando su sangre y llenándoles de una abrumadora sensación de éxtasis en el proceso.

A lo largo de los siglos, los bruxa han sido temidos y venerados por su seductora belleza y sus potentes habilidades. A menudo han servido como confidentes y compañeros de individuos poderosos, incluidos los señores de los sanguinófagos, y se sabe que han ejercido una influencia considerable en las sociedades en la sombra. Su capacidad única para establecer vínculos con otros humanos ha dado lugar a la formación de alianzas y redes secretas, lo que ha reforzado aún más su poder e influencia.

En la vasta extensión del universo, los bruxa siguen siendo un enigma: seductores y misteriosos, sus verdaderas intenciones se ocultan tras un velo de encanto y gracia. Aquellos que se encuentran con un bruxa deben andarse con cuidado, pues aunque su contacto puede proporcionar un placer inimaginable, también puede conducir a un destino más traicionero de lo que uno podría imaginar.

Rule.Original: Bruxas are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are extremely beautiful, and almost always bond with other sanguophages. Unlike other subxenotypes of that species, bruxas are capable of feeding on sanguophage blood, providing them with great benefits. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. They can filter infection out of the bloodstream of other humans, as well as fill them with a sense of strong ecstasy. The price is that bruxa must sometimes consume hemogen - either human or sanguophage, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They're easily destroyed by fire, and slowed down by UV light.
Rule.Raw: Bruxas are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are extremely beautiful, and almost always bond with other sanguophages. Unlike other subxenotypes of that species, bruxas are capable of feeding on sanguophage blood, providing them with great benefits. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. They can filter infection out of the bloodstream of other humans, as well as fill them with a sense of strong ecstasy. The price is that bruxa must sometimes consume hemogen - either human or sanguophage, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They're easily destroyed by fire, and slowed down by UV light.
Rule.Translated: Las bruxas son superhumanos que no envejecen ni mueren, potenciados por arquitos creados mediante arcotecnología que circulan por su sangre. Son extremadamente hermosas y casi siempre establecen vínculos con otros sanguófagos. A diferencia de otros subxenotipos de esta especie, pueden alimentarse de sangre de sanguófago y obtener grandes beneficios. Pueden curar cualquier lesión y nunca padecen enfermedades ni envenenamientos. También pueden filtrar las infecciones de la sangre de otros humanos y hacerles sentir un intenso éxtasis. El precio es que a veces deben consumir hemógeno humano o de sanguófago y necesitan entrar periódicamente en largos letargos mortales. El fuego las destruye con facilidad y la luz UV las ralentiza.

Rule.Original: This is a hidden hediff that modifies the pawn's Sight depending on sunlight.
Rule.Raw: This is a hidden hediff that modifies the pawn's Sight depending on sunlight.
Rule.Translated: Se trata de un hediff oculto que modifica la vista de una persona en función de la luz solar.

Rule.Original: Animal hemogen increases regeneration and combat capabilities of the user, but greatly decreases the capability to communicate with others.
Rule.Raw: Animal hemogen increases regeneration and combat capabilities of the user, but greatly decreases the capability to communicate with others.
Rule.Translated: El hemógeno animal aumenta la regeneración y las capacidades de combate del usuario, pero disminuye en gran medida la capacidad de comunicarse con los demás.

Rule.Original: Corpse hemogen greatly weakens the carrier of this hemogen type, but increases consciousness and blood filtration significantly.
Rule.Raw: Corpse hemogen greatly weakens the carrier of this hemogen type, but increases consciousness and blood filtration significantly.
Rule.Translated: El hemógeno de un cadáver debilita mucho al portador de este tipo de hemógeno, pero aumenta significativamente la consciencia y la filtración de sangre.

Rule.Original: Sanguophage hemogen gives the carrier a powerful boost to all capacities.
Rule.Raw: Sanguophage hemogen gives the carrier a powerful boost to all capacities.
Rule.Translated: El hemógeno de sanguinófago proporciona al portador una potente mejora en todas sus capacidades.

Rule.Original: Sharp talons which can be used in melee combat.
Rule.Raw: Sharp talons which can be used in melee combat.
Rule.Translated: Garras afiladas que pueden utilizarse en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: After-effects of using a draincasket. Symptoms of draincasket sickness typically include localized pain, swelling, and redness at the site of the draincasket tubes' connection. Victims may experience increasing fatigue, weakness, and a general feeling of malaise.
Rule.Raw: After-effects of using a draincasket. Symptoms of draincasket sickness typically include localized pain, swelling, and redness at the site of the draincasket tubes' connection. Victims may experience increasing fatigue, weakness, and a general feeling of malaise.
Rule.Translated: Las secuelas del uso de un hemosarcófago. Los síntomas de la enfermedad del hemosarcófago suelen incluir dolor localizado, hinchazón y enrojecimiento en el lugar de conexión de los tubos del hemosarcófago. Las víctimas pueden experimentar fatiga, debilidad y malestar general.

Rule.Original: After-effects of using a draincasket. Victims may experience increasing fatigue, weakness, and a general feeling of malaise.
Rule.Raw: After-effects of using a draincasket. Victims may experience increasing fatigue, weakness, and a general feeling of malaise.
Rule.Translated: Secuelas de utilizar un hemosarcófago. Las víctimas pueden experimentar un cansancio creciente, debilidad y malestar general.

Rule.Original: Armor is enhanced because this person used a hemogen solidifier while deathresting. This effect lasts until the next deathrest.
Rule.Raw: Armor is enhanced because this person used a hemogen solidifier while deathresting. This effect lasts until the next deathrest.
Rule.Translated: El blindaje ha sido mejorado porque esta persona usó un solidificador de hemógeno mientras estaba realizando el descanso sepulcral. Este efecto dura hasta el siguiente descanso.

Rule.Original: All hemogen gains are multiplied up because this person used a small hemogen amplifier while deathresting. This effect lasts until the next deathrest.
Rule.Raw: All hemogen gains are multiplied up because this person used a small hemogen amplifier while deathresting. This effect lasts until the next deathrest.
Rule.Translated: Todas las ganancias de hemógeno se multiplican porque esta persona utilizó un pequeño amplificador de hemógeno durante el descanso sepulcral. Este efecto dura hasta el siguiente descanso.

Rule.Original: One of the moons of this planet has orbited into the rimworld’s umbra, making sanguophages go mad with hunger.
Rule.Raw: One of the moons of this planet has orbited into the rimworld’s umbra, making sanguophages go mad with hunger.
Rule.Translated: Una de las lunas de este planeta se ha posicionado en la umbra de este planeta, volviendo locos de hambre a los sanguinófagos.
La luna de sangre ha terminado.

Rule.Original: One of the moons of this planet has orbited into the rimworld’s umbra, blocking all direct sunlight from illuminating the moon’s surface. This resulted in the moon taking on a crimson color - a phenomena known as the blood moon.\n\nDuring this time, sanguophage mechanites will go into overdrive, driving hemogen-starved bloodfeeders out of their caves. Any bloodfeeder sanguophage with less than half hemogen supply gone will enter the hemohunter mental state. Hemogen will drain significantly quicker during blood moon.
Rule.Raw: One of the moons of this planet has orbited into the rimworld’s umbra, blocking all direct sunlight from illuminating the moon’s surface. This resulted in the moon taking on a crimson color - a phenomena known as the blood moon.\n\nDuring this time, sanguophage mechanites will go into overdrive, driving hemogen-starved bloodfeeders out of their caves. Any bloodfeeder sanguophage with less than half hemogen supply gone will enter the hemohunter mental state. Hemogen will drain significantly quicker during blood moon.
Rule.Translated: Una de las lunas de este planeta se ha posicionado en la umbra de este planeta, impidiendo que la luz solar directa ilumine la superficie lunar. Esto ha provocado que la luna adquiera un color carmesí, un fenómeno conocido como luna de sangre.\n\nDurante este tiempo, los mecanitos de los sanguinófagos se excitan, expulsando de sus cuevas a los hambrientos chupasangres. Cualquier sanguinófago con más de la mitad de su reserva de hemógeno agotada entrará en estado mental de cazasangre. El hemógeno se drenará mucho más rápido durante la luna de sangre.
extraer hemógeno de TargetA a la fuerza.

Rule.Original: {0} has become a hemohunter! \n\n[PAWN_pronoun] will drain hemogen off of anyone [PAWN_pronoun] sees, until their hemogen rises to a safe level.
Rule.Raw: {0} has become a hemohunter! \n\n[PAWN_pronoun] will drain hemogen off of anyone [PAWN_pronoun] sees, until their hemogen rises to a safe level.
Rule.Translated: ¡{0} se ha convertido en un cazasangre!\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] drenará el hemógeno de cualquier cosa que vea hasta que su nivel de hemógeno suba a un nivel seguro.

Rule.Original: {0}'s hemohunter state has come to an end.
Rule.Raw: {0}'s hemohunter state has come to an end.
Rule.Translated: El estado de cazasangre de {0} ha llegado a su fin.

Rule.Original: A pipe that’s used to transport hemogen between taps, drains, vats and hemogen-fueled structures.
Rule.Raw: A pipe that’s used to transport hemogen between taps, drains, vats and hemogen-fueled structures.
Rule.Translated: Una tubería que se utiliza para transportar hemógeno entre dispensadores, drenajes, depósitos y cualquier estructura alimentada con hemógeno.

Rule.Original: Hidden steel pipes designed to transport hemogen between taps, drains, vats and hemogen-fueled structures.
Rule.Raw: Hidden steel pipes designed to transport hemogen between taps, drains, vats and hemogen-fueled structures.
Rule.Translated: Una tubería que se utiliza para transportar hemógeno entre dispensadores, drenajes, tanques y cualquier estructura alimentada con hemógeno.
Permite activar o desactivar el flujo de hemógeno.

Rule.Original: An industrial liquid storage vat meant for storing hemogen delivered via hemogen pipe network. Vats can be designated to be siphoned for usable hemogen as needed.
Rule.Raw: An industrial liquid storage vat meant for storing hemogen delivered via hemogen pipe network. Vats can be designated to be siphoned for usable hemogen as needed.
Rule.Translated: Un depósito industrial de almacenamiento de líquidos destinado a almacenar el hemógeno suministrado a través de una red de tuberías de hemógeno. Los tanques pueden designarse para que alquien extraiga directamente el hemógeno cuando sea necesario.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage basin meant to dispense hemogen for later use.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage basin meant to dispense hemogen for later use.
Rule.Translated: Una bandeja en forma de tolva que proporciona hemógeno procedente de los tanques para su uso posterior.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input hemogen into the network, filling up connected vats.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input hemogen into the network, filling up connected vats.
Rule.Translated: Una bandeja con forma de tolva que permite introducir hemógeno en la red y llenar los tanques conectados.

Rule.Original: A sinister contraption designed to extract hemogen from an individual while maintaining their life force at the barest minimum. This dark and foreboding casket houses its occupant in a twilight state of existence with their body slowly drained of precious hemogen. Bound to their Draincasket, the occupant's survival depends on being fed regularly, as they can still starve to death.\n\nProduces hemogen packs a day as long as the occupant has food and the casket is connected to a hemogen network. The amount of hemogen packs depends on the occupant's hunger rate - someone with a worse metabolic efficiency will produce more hemogen packs while using proportionally more nutrition to do so. If deprived of food, the casket will eventually kill its occupant.
Rule.Raw: A sinister contraption designed to extract hemogen from an individual while maintaining their life force at the barest minimum. This dark and foreboding casket houses its occupant in a twilight state of existence with their body slowly drained of precious hemogen. Bound to their Draincasket, the occupant's survival depends on being fed regularly, as they can still starve to death.\n\nProduces hemogen packs a day as long as the occupant has food and the casket is connected to a hemogen network. The amount of hemogen packs depends on the occupant's hunger rate - someone with a worse metabolic efficiency will produce more hemogen packs while using proportionally more nutrition to do so. If deprived of food, the casket will eventually kill its occupant.
Rule.Translated:
Un siniestro artilugio diseñado para extraer el hemógeno de un individuo manteniendo sus constantes vitales al mínimo posible. Este oscuro y ominoso ataúd alberga a su ocupante en un estado crepuscular de existencia, mientras su cuerpo es despojado lentamente del preciado hemógeno. Mientras su ocupante esté atado aquí, su supervivencia dependerá de que se le alimente regularmente, ya que puede morir de hambre.

Produce 2 paquetes de hemógeno al día mientras el ocupante tenga comida y el sarcófago esté conectado a una red de hemógeno. Si se le priva de alimentos, el sarcófago matará a su ocupante en unos 2 días.

Si estás utilizando «Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded», podrás extraer los nutrientes de esa red, siempre que haya al menos 1 ración de comida disponible.

Rule.Original: A sophisticated device that infuses deathresting people with rare and potent sanguophage abilities, tapping into the very essence of their vampiric nature. Employing a complex system of blood conduits and essence resonators, the matrix connects to a deathrest casket and channels the life force of its occupant to unlock hidden potential within their bloodline. As the person slumbers in their deathrest state, the Invocation Matrix bestows upon them a selected, unique power. This building requires a constant supply of hemogen to operate.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticated device that infuses deathresting people with rare and potent sanguophage abilities, tapping into the very essence of their vampiric nature. Employing a complex system of blood conduits and essence resonators, the matrix connects to a deathrest casket and channels the life force of its occupant to unlock hidden potential within their bloodline. As the person slumbers in their deathrest state, the Invocation Matrix bestows upon them a selected, unique power. This building requires a constant supply of hemogen to operate.
Rule.Translated: Un sofisticado artefacto que infunde a los moribundos habilidades de sanguinófago raras y potentes, aprovechando la esencia misma de su naturaleza vampírica. Mediante un complejo sistema de conductos de sangre y resonadores de esencias, la matriz se conecta a un sarcófago de descanso sepulcral y canaliza la fuerza vital de su ocupante para liberar el potencial oculto de su linaje. Mientras la persona duerme en su estado de reposo, la matriz de invocación le otorga un poder único seleccionado. Este edificio requiere de un suministro constante de hemógeno para funcionar.

Rule.Original: An advanced device designed to expedite the deathrest process at the cost of blood consumption. By connecting with a deathresting person, this apparatus employs intricate blood analysis and potent sanguine stimulants to maximize the efficiency of the deathrest casket. As it hastens the character's recovery, the Hemodynamic Accelerator demands a continuous supply of hemogen to fuel its powerful operation. To function, it must be connected to a deathrest casket, ensuring the swift rejuvenation of its occupant.
Rule.Raw: An advanced device designed to expedite the deathrest process at the cost of blood consumption. By connecting with a deathresting person, this apparatus employs intricate blood analysis and potent sanguine stimulants to maximize the efficiency of the deathrest casket. As it hastens the character's recovery, the Hemodynamic Accelerator demands a continuous supply of hemogen to fuel its powerful operation. To function, it must be connected to a deathrest casket, ensuring the swift rejuvenation of its occupant.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo avanzado diseñado para acelerar el proceso de descanso sepulcral a costa del consumo de sangre. Al conectarse con una persona que realice este descanso, este aparato emplea un intrincado análisis de sangre y potentes estimulantes sanguíneos para maximizar la eficacia del sarcófago de descanso sepulcral. A medida que acelera la recuperación de la persona, el acelerador hemodinámico exigirá un suministro continuo de hemógeno para alimentar su potente funcionamiento. Para funcionar, debe estar conectado a un sarcófago de descanso sepulcral, lo que garantiza el rápido rejuvenecimiento de su ocupante.

Rule.Original: A device specifically engineered to enhance the durability of deathresting characters by manipulating the molecular structure of their skin. Utilizing an array of bioresonant projectors and blood-based nano-agents, the solidifier targets the hemogen within the character's body, fortifying and thickening skin molecules. As the deathresting individual slumbers, the Hemogen Solidifier weaves a dense, protective layer around them, rendering their skin more resilient and damage-resistant. The device must be connected to a deathrest casket to operate, ensuring its occupant emerges from their rest with an augmented defensive capacity.
Rule.Raw: A device specifically engineered to enhance the durability of deathresting characters by manipulating the molecular structure of their skin. Utilizing an array of bioresonant projectors and blood-based nano-agents, the solidifier targets the hemogen within the character's body, fortifying and thickening skin molecules. As the deathresting individual slumbers, the Hemogen Solidifier weaves a dense, protective layer around them, rendering their skin more resilient and damage-resistant. The device must be connected to a deathrest casket to operate, ensuring its occupant emerges from their rest with an augmented defensive capacity.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo diseñado específicamente para aumentar la durabilidad de las personas que han muerto manipulando la estructura molecular de su piel. Utilizando una serie de proyectores biorresonantes y nanoagentes sanguíneos, el solidificador se dirige al hemógeno del cuerpo del personaje, fortificando y engrosando las moléculas de la piel. Mientras el individuo que realiza el descanso sepulcral duerme, el solidificador de hemógeno teje una densa capa protectora a su alrededor, haciendo que su piel sea más elástica y resistente a los daños. Para funcionar, el dispositivo debe estar conectado a un sarcófago de descanso sepulcral, lo que garantiza que su ocupante salga de su descanso con una capacidad defensiva aumentada.

Rule.Original: This device leaves a deathrester in a hemogen-amplified state so they gain slightly more hemogen from any hemogen source. Using a gland probe and blood analyzer, it links with a deathresting person, stimulating hemogen glands into a more active state. It must be connected to a deathrest casket to function. This building needs to consume hemogen to function.
Rule.Raw: This device leaves a deathrester in a hemogen-amplified state so they gain slightly more hemogen from any hemogen source. Using a gland probe and blood analyzer, it links with a deathresting person, stimulating hemogen glands into a more active state. It must be connected to a deathrest casket to function. This building needs to consume hemogen to function.
Rule.Translated: Este dispositivo le otorga a una persona el estado de amplificación de hemógeno tras realizar el descanso sepulcral, haciendo que obtenga un poco más de hemógeno de cualquier fuente de hemógeno. Mediante una sonda de glándulas y un analizador de sangre, se conecta con una persona está realizando el descanso sepulcral y estimula las glándulas hemógenicas para que estén algo más activas. Debe estar conectado a un sarcófago de descanso sepulcral para funcionar.\n\nEsta construcción consume hemógeno para funcionar.

Rule.Original: This small, blood-refining pump increases the amount of hemogen a deathresting person can store in their body. It must be connected to a deathrest casket to function. This building needs to consume hemogen to function.
Rule.Raw: This small, blood-refining pump increases the amount of hemogen a deathresting person can store in their body. It must be connected to a deathrest casket to function. This building needs to consume hemogen to function.
Rule.Translated: Esta bomba refinadora de sangre aumenta la cantidad de hemógeno que una persona en estado de descanso sepulcral puede almacenar en su cuerpo. Debe estar conectada a un sarcófago de descanso sepulcral para funcionar.\n\nEsta construcción consume hemógeno para funcionar.

Rule.Original: Animal hemogen. Increases regeneration and combat capabilities of the user, but greatly decreases the capability to communicate with others.
Rule.Raw: Animal hemogen. Increases regeneration and combat capabilities of the user, but greatly decreases the capability to communicate with others.
Rule.Translated: Hemógeno animal. Aumenta la regeneración y las capacidades de combate del usuario, pero disminuye en gran medida la capacidad de comunicarse con los demás.

Rule.Original: Tainted, rotting hemogen from a cadaver. Greatly weakens the carrier of this hemogen type, but increases the blood filtration significantly.
Rule.Raw: Tainted, rotting hemogen from a cadaver. Greatly weakens the carrier of this hemogen type, but increases the blood filtration significantly.
Rule.Translated: Hemógeno contaminado y putrefacto de un cadáver. Debilita enormemente al consumidor de este tipo de hemógeno, pero aumenta notablemente la capacidad de filtración de la sangre.

Rule.Original: Pure, thick hemogen of another bloodfeeder. The most rare of all hemogens, it gives the carrier a powerful boost to all capacities.
Rule.Raw: Pure, thick hemogen of another bloodfeeder. The most rare of all hemogens, it gives the carrier a powerful boost to all capacities.
Rule.Translated: Hemógeno puro y espeso de otro chupasangre. El más raro de todos los hemógenos, uno que otorga al consumidor una importante mejora en todas sus capacidades.

Rule.Original: I can’t believe how I’m feeling, it’s amazing, it’s wonderful!
Rule.Raw: I can’t believe how I’m feeling, it’s amazing, it’s wonderful!
Rule.Translated: No puedo creer cómo me siento, ¡es increíble, maravilloso!

Rule.Original: The ultimate crime, I was fed on by another sanguophage!
Rule.Raw: The ultimate crime, I was fed on by another sanguophage!
Rule.Translated: El crimen supremo, ¡fui alimentado por otro sanguinófago!

Rule.Original: I can't even see anything in the light. My whole skin feels like it's going to burst into flames!
Rule.Raw: I can't even see anything in the light. My whole skin feels like it's going to burst into flames!
Rule.Translated: Ni siquiera puedo ver nada a la luz. Siento como si toda mi piel fuera a arder.

Rule.Original: No flame burns as softly as a blood flame.
Rule.Raw: No flame burns as softly as a blood flame.
Rule.Translated: Ninguna llama arde tan suavemente como una llama de sangre.

Rule.Original: No flame burns as softly as a blood flame.
Rule.Raw: No flame burns as softly as a blood flame.
Rule.Translated: Ninguna llama arde tan suavemente como una llama de sangre.

Rule.Raw: No flame burns as softly as a blood flame.
Rule.Translated: Ninguna llama arde tan suavemente como una llama de sangre.

Rule.Translated: Ninguna llama arde tan suavemente como una llama de sangre.

Rule.Original: No flame burns as softly as a blood flame.
Rule.Raw: No flame burns as softly as a blood flame.
Rule.Translated: Ninguna llama arde tan suavemente como una llama de sangre.

Rule.Original: Build sepulchral buildings to honor the deceased and embellish your catacombs and crypts.
Rule.Raw: Build sepulchral buildings to honor the deceased and embellish your catacombs and crypts.
Rule.Translated: Construye edificios sepulcrales para honrar a los difuntos y embellece tus catacumbas y criptas.

Rule.Original: Create specifically treated buildings that are soothing for people with the bloodfeeder gene.
Rule.Raw: Create specifically treated buildings that are soothing for people with the bloodfeeder gene.
Rule.Translated: Cree edificios tratados específicamente que sean relajantes para los que se alimentan de sangre

Rule.Original: A sculpted replica of a human skeleton wielding a spear and shield. A grim decoration often placed within catacombs and ossuraries.
Rule.Raw: A sculpted replica of a human skeleton wielding a spear and shield. A grim decoration often placed within catacombs and ossuraries.
Rule.Translated: Una réplica esculpida de un esqueleto humano empuñando una lanza y un escudo. Una decoración sombría que a menudo se coloca dentro de catacumbas y osarios.

Rule.Original: A sepulchral brazier used to illuminate sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Raw: A sepulchral brazier used to illuminate sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Translated: Un brasero utilizado para iluminar terrenos sagrados. Iluminará los alrededores y creará calor.

Rule.Original: A specifically treated sepulchral brazier used to illuminate sacred grounds with a dark flame. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Raw: A specifically treated sepulchral brazier used to illuminate sacred grounds with a dark flame. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Translated: Un brasero sepulcral tratado específicamente para iluminar terrenos sagrados con una llama oscura. Iluminará los alrededores y creará calor.

Rule.Original: A specifically treated sepulchral brazier used to illuminate sacred grounds with a red flame.The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Raw: A specifically treated sepulchral brazier used to illuminate sacred grounds with a red flame.The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Translated: Un brasero sepulcral tratado específicamente para iluminar terrenos sagrados con una llama roja. El brillo sanguíneo es particularmente agradable para las personas con el gen de alimentación de sangre. Iluminará los alrededores y creará calor.

Rule.Original: Candles producing a dim light over a small area. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Raw: Candles producing a dim light over a small area. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Translated: Velas que producen una luz tenue sobre un área pequeña. A menudo se utiliza para iluminar lugares sagrados como museos y criptas.

Rule.Original: Specifically treated candles producing a dim darklight over a small area. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Raw: Specifically treated candles producing a dim darklight over a small area. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Translated: Velas tratadas específicamente que producen una luz tenue y oscura sobre un área pequeña. A menudo se utiliza para iluminar lugares sagrados como museos y criptas.

Rule.Original: Specifically treated candles producing a dim red light over a small area. The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Raw: Specifically treated candles producing a dim red light over a small area. The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Translated: Velas tratadas específicamente que producen una luz roja tenue sobre un área pequeña. El brillo sanguíneo es particularmente agradable para las personas con el gen alimentación de sangre. A menudo se utiliza para iluminar lugares sagrados como museos y criptas.

Rule.Original: A tall candelabra holding severeal candles producing a dim light. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Raw: A tall candelabra holding severeal candles producing a dim light. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Translated: Un candelabro alto que sostiene varias velas que producen una luz tenue. A menudo se utiliza para iluminar lugares sagrados como mausoleos y criptas.

Rule.Original: A tall candelabra holding severeal candles producing a dim dark light. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Raw: A tall candelabra holding severeal candles producing a dim dark light. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Translated: Un candelabro alto que sostiene varias velas que producen una luz tenue y oscura. A menudo se utiliza para iluminar lugares sagrados como mausoleos y criptas.

Rule.Original: A tall candelabra holding severeal candles producing a dim red light.The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Raw: A tall candelabra holding severeal candles producing a dim red light.The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.
Rule.Translated: Un candelabro alto que sostiene varias velas que producen una tenue luz roja. El brillo sanguíneo es particularmente agradable para las personas con el gen de alimentación de sangre. A menudo se utiliza para iluminar lugares sagrados como museos y criptas.

Rule.Original: A cheap and easy to build coffin. It is not the most glorious resting place, but it is leagues above simply rotting in a dirt hole.
Rule.Raw: A cheap and easy to build coffin. It is not the most glorious resting place, but it is leagues above simply rotting in a dirt hole.
Rule.Translated: Un ataúd barato y fácil de construir. No es el lugar de descanso más glorioso, pero está a leguas de distancia simplemente pudriéndose en un agujero de tierra.

Rule.Original: A large and finely sculpted tomb to house the brave and esteemed in their final resting place. It is said that the grands of this world are buried with their most valuable possessions.
Rule.Raw: A large and finely sculpted tomb to house the brave and esteemed in their final resting place. It is said that the grands of this world are buried with their most valuable possessions.
Rule.Translated: Una tumba grande y finamente esculpida para albergar a los valientes y estimados en su lugar de descanso final. Se dice que los grandes de este mundo son enterrados con sus posesiones más valiosas.

Rule.Original: A grim sculpture depicting a lesser demon perching. Often used to decorate tombs and crypts, it is said to guard the dead and scare away spirits and ghosts.
Rule.Raw: A grim sculpture depicting a lesser demon perching. Often used to decorate tombs and crypts, it is said to guard the dead and scare away spirits and ghosts.
Rule.Translated: Una sombría escultura que representa a un demonio menor posado. A menudo se utiliza para decorar tumbas y criptas, se dice que protege a los muertos y ahuyenta a los espíritus y fantasmas.

Rule.Original: A sculpture of a Gargoyle, watchdog of the dead often depicted as bat-winged demons able the breath fire and torment the less fortunate. Now they are used as symbols of fear to scare away the spirits from sacred grounds.
Rule.Raw: A sculpture of a Gargoyle, watchdog of the dead often depicted as bat-winged demons able the breath fire and torment the less fortunate. Now they are used as symbols of fear to scare away the spirits from sacred grounds.
Rule.Translated: Una escultura de una gárgola, perro guardián de los muertos, a menudo representado como demonios con alas de murciélago capaces de lanzar fuego y atormentar a los menos afortunados. Ahora se utilizan como símbolos de miedo para ahuyentar a los espíritus de los terrenos sagrados.

Rule.Original: A large sculpture depicting a demon. Creature of hell sent to torture the miscreants and wrongdoers alike. Although this is but a statue some believe that malicious spirits inhabits them.
Rule.Raw: A large sculpture depicting a demon. Creature of hell sent to torture the miscreants and wrongdoers alike. Although this is but a statue some believe that malicious spirits inhabits them.
Rule.Translated: Una gran escultura que representa un demonio mayor. Criatura del infierno enviada a torturar tanto a los malhechores como a los malhechores. Aunque esto no es más que una estatua, algunos creen que espíritus malignos la habitan.

Rule.Original: A monument built to honor the fallen, from the simple soldiers to the champions of war, each and every soldier that gave their life shall be remembered.
Rule.Raw: A monument built to honor the fallen, from the simple soldiers to the champions of war, each and every soldier that gave their life shall be remembered.
Rule.Translated: Un monumento construido para honrar a los caídos, desde los simples soldados hasta los campeones de la guerra, todos y cada uno de los soldados que dieron su vida serán recordados.

Rule.Original: A stone urn for containing the remains of the deceased, typically after being immolated. Members of certain cultures use it to honor their dead, especially those who believe fire has a purifying nature.
Rule.Raw: A stone urn for containing the remains of the deceased, typically after being immolated. Members of certain cultures use it to honor their dead, especially those who believe fire has a purifying nature.
Rule.Translated: Urna para contener los restos del difunto, normalmente después de ser inmolado. Los miembros de determinadas culturas lo utilizan para honrar a sus muertos, especialmente aquellos que creen que el fuego tiene una naturaleza purificadora.

Rule.Original: A sepulchral statue holding a brazier in its hands to cast a light upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Raw: A sepulchral statue holding a brazier in its hands to cast a light upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Translated: Una estatua sepulcral que sostiene un brasero en sus manos para iluminar los terrenos sagrados. Iluminará los alrededores y creará calor.

Rule.Original: A sepulchral statue holding a specifically treated brazier in its hands to cast a darklight upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Raw: A sepulchral statue holding a specifically treated brazier in its hands to cast a darklight upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Translated: Una estatua sepulcral que sostiene en sus manos un brasero tratado específicamente para arrojar una luz oscura sobre terrenos sagrados. Iluminará el entorno y creará calor.

Rule.Original: A sepulchral statue holding a brazier in its hands to cast a bloodflame upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Raw: A sepulchral statue holding a brazier in its hands to cast a bloodflame upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
Rule.Translated: Una estatua sepulcral que sostiene un brasero en sus manos para arrojar una llama de sangre sobre terrenos sagrados. Iluminará los alrededores y creará calor.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall made out of sculpted skulls used to decorate ossuaries and crypts. A grim decoration that functions as a memento mori. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: An impassable wall made out of sculpted skulls used to decorate ossuaries and crypts. A grim decoration that functions as a memento mori. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro intransitable formado por calaveras esculpidas que adornaban osarios y criptas. Una decoración sombría que funciona como memento mori. Capaz de sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: A tomb directly carved into a wall to honor the dead. Takes a long time to build.
Rule.Raw: A tomb directly carved into a wall to honor the dead. Takes a long time to build.
Rule.Translated: Una tumba tallada directamente en un muro para honrar a los muertos. Lleva mucho tiempo construirla.

Rule.Original: Swaps between a charge blaster and a needle gun.
Rule.Raw: Swaps between a charge blaster and a needle gun.
Rule.Translated: Intercambia entre un bláster de carga y una pistola de agujas.

Rule.Original: Remotely hacks the IFF sensors of a mechanoid to temporarily swap its allegiance. This will last for a day, after which the mechanoid will revert to its former allegiance and attack indiscriminately.
Rule.Raw: Remotely hacks the IFF sensors of a mechanoid to temporarily swap its allegiance. This will last for a day, after which the mechanoid will revert to its former allegiance and attack indiscriminately.
Rule.Translated: Hackea remotamente los sensores IFF de un meca para cambiar temporalmente su lealtad. Esto durará un día, después del cual el meca volverá a su lealtad original y atacará indiscriminadamente.
{0} ha sido aplastado hasta la muerte.

Rule.Original: Caused by the apoptosis turret, a terrifying weapon designed to drain the souls of its targets. Equipped with soul-draining technology, it is capable of siphoning the life force of organic beings, leaving them weakened and vulnerable. Will eventually disappear.
Rule.Raw: Caused by the apoptosis turret, a terrifying weapon designed to drain the souls of its targets. Equipped with soul-draining technology, it is capable of siphoning the life force of organic beings, leaving them weakened and vulnerable. Will eventually disappear.
Rule.Translated: Causado por la torreta de apoptosis, un arma aterradora diseñada para drenar las almas de sus objetivos. Equipado con tecnología de drenaje de almas, es capaz de absorber la fuerza vital de los seres orgánicos, dejándolos debilitados y vulnerables. Finalmente, desaparecerá.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid's IFF sensors have been scrambled, making it unable to properly identify its foes. It will fight on the side of the colony for a day, and after that it will revert to its former allegiance.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid's IFF sensors have been scrambled, making it unable to properly identify its foes. It will fight on the side of the colony for a day, and after that it will revert to its former allegiance.
Rule.Translated: Los sensores IFF de este mecañoide han sido alterados, lo que le impide identificar correctamente a sus enemigos. Luchará del lado de la colonia durante un día, y después volverá a su lealtad original.

Rule.Original: This person has been affected by a freezing burst, reducing their movement speed. Effects will go away after 12 hours.
Rule.Raw: This person has been affected by a freezing burst, reducing their movement speed. Effects will go away after 12 hours.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona ha sido afectada por una explosión de congelación, lo que reduce su velocidad de movimiento. Los efectos desaparecerán después de 12 horas.

Rule.Original: A pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster for area suppressive fire. Heavy cooling allows long, deadly bursts.
Rule.Raw: A pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster for area suppressive fire. Heavy cooling allows long, deadly bursts.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster de fuego rápido cargado por pulsos para fuego supresivo en área. Su potente sistema de enfriamiento permite ráfagas largas y letales.

Rule.Original: A long-range weapon used by mechanoids. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. While it does less damage than charge weapons, it can reach over very long distances.
Rule.Raw: A long-range weapon used by mechanoids. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. While it does less damage than charge weapons, it can reach over very long distances.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de largo alcance utilizada por los mecanoides. Nombrada por sus proyectiles en forma de aguja, dispara disparos individuales con gran precisión. Aunque hace menos daño que las armas de carga, puede alcanzar distancias muy largas.

Rule.Original:
The Aura, also known as Avenging Angels, are angel-shaped mechanoids surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Auras don't have much health, but they will regenerate damage quite fast.

Regeneration is 0.1 damage to a random wound every 10 ticks, 1/6th of a second.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.
Rule.Raw:
The Aura, also known as Avenging Angels, are angel-shaped mechanoids surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Auras don't have much health, but they will regenerate damage quite fast.

Regeneration is 0.1 damage to a random wound every 10 ticks, 1/6th of a second.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.
Rule.Translated: Los Aura, también conocidos como Ángeles Vengadores, son mecanoides con forma de ángel rodeados por una nube giratoria de seis hojas metálicas levitantes. Prefieren el combate cuerpo a cuerpo, acercándose a sus víctimas y envolviéndolas en un torbellino eviscerante de muerte cortante. También tienen la habilidad de regenerar sus heridas gracias a mecanitas de acción rápida. Efecto en el juego: Los Aura no tienen mucha salud, pero regeneran el daño bastante rápido. Si se desactiva su aparición mediante las opciones del mod, serán reemplazados por un Scyther.

Rule.Original: The daggersnout is a fast, insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.
Rule.Raw: The daggersnout is a fast, insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.
Rule.Translated: El Hocicuchillo es un mecanoide de combate rápido, con aspecto insectoide, armado con una afilada y peligrosa hoja en su cabeza. No es tan peligroso como otros mecanoides de corto alcance, como los scythers, pero generalmente aparecen en mayor número. Efecto en el juego: Si se desactiva su aparición mediante las opciones del mod, serán reemplazados por un Scyther.

Rule.Original: The strange demolisher mechanoid looks like a weird amalgamation of a deep sea crab, a star-nosed mole and an armoured combat vehicle. Demolishers are armed with a very dangerous short range turret that fires demolisher charges, capable of blowing up even the strongest walls in two or three hits. Once they have ruptured a colony's outer defenses, their enormous plasteel reinforced claws can make short work of anyone foolish enough to stay in their way.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Demolishers will only appear in breach raids, as an alternative to the Termite. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Termite.
Rule.Raw: The strange demolisher mechanoid looks like a weird amalgamation of a deep sea crab, a star-nosed mole and an armoured combat vehicle. Demolishers are armed with a very dangerous short range turret that fires demolisher charges, capable of blowing up even the strongest walls in two or three hits. Once they have ruptured a colony's outer defenses, their enormous plasteel reinforced claws can make short work of anyone foolish enough to stay in their way.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Demolishers will only appear in breach raids, as an alternative to the Termite. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Termite.
Rule.Translated: El extraño mecanoide demolisher parece una extraña mezcla entre un cangrejo de aguas profundas, un topo de nariz estrellada y un vehículo de combate blindado. Los demolishers están armados con una torreta de corto alcance muy peligrosa que dispara cargas demolisher, capaces de destruir incluso los muros más fuertes en dos o tres impactos. Una vez que han roto las defensas exteriores de una colonia, sus enormes garras reforzadas con plasteel pueden acabar rápidamente con cualquiera lo suficientemente tonto como para quedarse en su camino. Efecto en el juego: Los demolishers solo aparecerán en asaltos de brecha, como una alternativa al Termite. Si se desactiva su aparición mediante las opciones del mod, serán reemplazados por un Termite.

Rule.Original:
A huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let a fireworm approach your defenses!

The fireworm superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like...

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 15 Bomb damage on a 1.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Rule.Raw:
A huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let a fireworm approach your defenses!

The fireworm superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like...

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 15 Bomb damage on a 1.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme gusano mecánico armado con un peligroso lanzallamas de químifuel. Su arma tiene un alcance muy corto, ¡así que no dejes que un fireworm se acerque a tus defensas! El fireworm se parece superficialmente a un Behemoth Helado. ¿Una coincidencia? O quizás los mecanoides toman a los seres vivos como modelo para sus unidades. Si es así, no querrías ver cómo luce un scyther biológico. Efecto en el juego: Si se desactiva su aparición mediante las opciones del mod, serán reemplazados por un Pikeman.

Rule.Original: The Goliath is a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Faster than a centipede, but weaker due to their weaker weapons. If built by the player, it will have a "Swap weapon" ability to choose between the charge blaster and the Needle gun. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.
Rule.Raw: The Goliath is a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Faster than a centipede, but weaker due to their weaker weapons. If built by the player, it will have a "Swap weapon" ability to choose between the charge blaster and the Needle gun. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.
Rule.Translated: El Goliath es un mecanoide de combate pesado con un diseño corporal humanoide. Son más rápidos que los ciempiés y generalmente están armados con armas mecanoides pesadas o pistolas de agujas. Efecto en el juego: Más rápido que un ciempiés, pero más débil debido a sus armas menos potentes. Si es construido por el jugador, tendrá la habilidad de “Cambiar arma” para elegir entre el cañón de carga y la pistola de agujas. Si se desactiva su aparición mediante las opciones del mod, serán reemplazados por un Cazador Ciempiés.

Rule.Original:
A hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.

This cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 10 Frostbite damage on a 2.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Rule.Raw:
A hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.

This cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 10 Frostbite damage on a 2.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme mecanoide basado en el diseño corporal de un escarabajo rinoceronte. El caparazón de plasteel del Phalanx oculta un poderoso motor criogénico capaz de producir constantemente pellets compactados de gas superenfriado. Estos son disparados desde una apertura en la cabeza del mecanoide. Esta arma criogénica tiene un alcance muy corto, pero puede ser muy peligrosa para seres susceptibles a la congelación por frío. Efecto en el juego: Si se desactiva su aparición mediante las opciones del mod, serán reemplazados por un Pikeman.

Rule.Original: The siegebreaker is a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosive shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Siegebreakers fire from an extremely long range, but they need line of sight, so they can be fooled into close quarters combat, where their cannons are mostly useless. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.
Rule.Raw: The siegebreaker is a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosive shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Siegebreakers fire from an extremely long range, but they need line of sight, so they can be fooled into close quarters combat, where their cannons are mostly useless. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.
Rule.Translated: El Siegebreaker es un mecanoide particularmente peligroso con forma de tanque. Armado con un cañón Siegebreaker que dispara proyectiles explosivos, puede detectar presencias hostiles a cientos de metros de distancia, actuando como un arma de asedio implacable capaz de destruir incluso las defensas más fuertes. Su movimiento es increíblemente lento y su cañón tarda mucho en recargarse, pero en la mayoría de los casos debe ser un objetivo prioritario. Efecto en el juego: Los Siegebreakers disparan desde un rango extremadamente largo, pero necesitan línea de visión, por lo que pueden ser engañados para combatir cuerpo a cuerpo, donde sus cañones son mayormente inútiles. Si se desactiva su aparición mediante las opciones del mod, serán reemplazados por un Cazador Ciempiés.

Rule.Translated: subject_story->abrió nuevas formas de explorar y comerciar

Rule.Original: subject_story->made air travel possible, changing how we see the world
Rule.Raw: subject_story->made air travel possible, changing how we see the world
Rule.Translated: subject_story->hizo posible viajar por el aire y cambió nuestra visión del mundo

Rule.Original: Learn to construct complex combat vehicles, such as bulldog battle tanks, tango armored personnel carriers and warbird combat airplanes.
Rule.Raw: Learn to construct complex combat vehicles, such as bulldog battle tanks, tango armored personnel carriers and warbird combat airplanes.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a construir vehículos de combate complejos, como tanques de combate «bulldog», transportes blindados de personal «tango» y aviones de combate conocidos como «aves de combate».

Rule.Original: subject_story->made powerful combat vehicles like tanks and armored planes
Rule.Raw: subject_story->made powerful combat vehicles like tanks and armored planes
Rule.Translated: subject_story->fabricó potentes vehículos de combate, como tanques y aviones blindados

Rule.Original: subject_story->vehicles could now fight and defend in wars
Rule.Raw: subject_story->vehicles could now fight and defend in wars
Rule.Translated: subject_story->permitió que los vehículos lucharan y defendieran en las guerras

Rule.Original: subject_story->changed how battles are fought with these new machines
Rule.Raw: subject_story->changed how battles are fought with these new machines
Rule.Translated: subject_story->cambió la forma de combatir con estas nuevas máquinas

Rule.Original: The rate at which the car accelerate, in cells per second. Higher rate means the vehicle will accelerate to its maximum speed faster. This also affects deceleration rate, which is double the acceleration rate.
Rule.Raw: The rate at which the car accelerate, in cells per second. Higher rate means the vehicle will accelerate to its maximum speed faster. This also affects deceleration rate, which is double the acceleration rate.
Rule.Translated: La velocidad a la que acelera el vehículo, en celdas por segundo. Un valor más alto hace que el vehículo acelere hasta su velocidad máxima en menos tiempo. Esto también afecta al ritmo de deceleración, que es el doble del ritmo de aceleración.

Rule.Original: A handy cabinet that contains a whole bunch of extra tools of various sizes and functions. Increases work speed when placed near a garage bench. One bench can use up to two garage cabinets.
Rule.Raw: A handy cabinet that contains a whole bunch of extra tools of various sizes and functions. Increases work speed when placed near a garage bench. One bench can use up to two garage cabinets.
Rule.Translated: Un práctico armario que contiene un montón de herramientas adicionales de diversos tamaños y funciones. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de garaje. Una mesa puede utilizar hasta dos armarios de garaje.

Rule.Original: A refueling pump that will automatically refuel chemfuel-powered vehicles standing on the interaction spot. Needs to be filled with chemfuel.
Rule.Raw: A refueling pump that will automatically refuel chemfuel-powered vehicles standing on the interaction spot. Needs to be filled with chemfuel.
Rule.Translated: Un surtidor de combustible que repostará automáticamente a cualquier vehículo propulsado por biocombustible que se encuentre en el punto de interacción. Debe abastecerse de biocombustible.

Rule.Original: A specialised work station for assembling vehicle parts. For those that are desperate, rusted cars and engine blocks can be salvaged for any remaining working parts.
Rule.Raw: A specialised work station for assembling vehicle parts. For those that are desperate, rusted cars and engine blocks can be salvaged for any remaining working parts.
Rule.Translated: Una estación de trabajo especialmente diseñada para fabricar piezas de vehículos. Para aquellos que estén más desesperados, puede usarse para rescatar piezas funcionales a partir de los vehículos y motores desvencijados que pueden hallarse en el entorno.

Rule.Original: A defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. Provides small amount of cover and can be walked through on foot, but is not traversable by vehicles.
Rule.Raw: A defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. Provides small amount of cover and can be walked through on foot, but is not traversable by vehicles.
Rule.Translated: Un obstáculo defensivo que impide de forma eficaz el paso de vehículos. Proporciona una pequeña cobertura y se puede atravesar a pie.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Manual operation allows people to open it, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Manual operation allows people to open it, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. Se abre de forma manual, y permite el paso de vehículos.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Electric-powered operation allows the door to open without manual interaction, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Electric-powered operation allows the door to open without manual interaction, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. Puede abrirse de forma automática, sin interacción manual, siempre que esté bien conectada a la red eléctrica, y permite el paso de vehículos.

Rule.Original: Literally the part that gets a vehicle moving in the first place, no vehicle can be assembled without one. Exceedingly large or heavy vehicles could require more than one.
Rule.Raw: Literally the part that gets a vehicle moving in the first place, no vehicle can be assembled without one. Exceedingly large or heavy vehicles could require more than one.
Rule.Translated: Se trata literalmente de la pieza que hace que un vehículo se mueva, ningún vehículo puede construirse sin uno. Es posible que los vehículos muy grandes o pesados requieran de más de uno.

Rule.Original: The alternator is an extremely vital engine part for any vehicle that has electrical systems. Some very basic systems can get away and some more complex vehicles can require more than one.
Rule.Raw: The alternator is an extremely vital engine part for any vehicle that has electrical systems. Some very basic systems can get away and some more complex vehicles can require more than one.
Rule.Translated: El alternador es una parte esencial de cualquier vehículo motorizado que tenga sistemas eléctricos. Algunos vehículos muy básicos puede que ni lo necesiten, mientras que alguno de los vehículos más complejos pueden requerir de más de uno.

Rule.Original: A series of pipes, catalysts and fittings that transfer the exhaust from the car engine away from the driver’s cabin. Engines that will be put under a lot of strain require more exhausts.
Rule.Raw: A series of pipes, catalysts and fittings that transfer the exhaust from the car engine away from the driver’s cabin. Engines that will be put under a lot of strain require more exhausts.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de tubos, catalizadores y otros accesorios que transfieren los gases de escape del motor del vehículo lejos de la cabina del conductor. Los motores que van a someterse a mucha carga de trabajo normalmente requerirán de más tubos de escape.

Rule.Original: A series of transmissions, springs and shock absorbers that redirect or reduce forces transferred through the wheels. Generally, the greater the mass and cargo capacity of the vehicle, the more suspensions are needed.
Rule.Raw: A series of transmissions, springs and shock absorbers that redirect or reduce forces transferred through the wheels. Generally, the greater the mass and cargo capacity of the vehicle, the more suspensions are needed.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de pistones, muelles y disipadores que redirigen o reducen las fuerzas transferidas a través de las ruedas. En general, cuanto mayor es la masa y la capacidad de carga del vehículo, más amortiguadores necesitará.

Rule.Original: One of the most ancient technologies developed by man, the wheel takes the power from the engine and translates it into movement. As wheels have to not only move the vehicle in whichever direction necessary but also withstand the combined weight, larger and heavier vehicles can need several or dozens of them.
Rule.Raw: One of the most ancient technologies developed by man, the wheel takes the power from the engine and translates it into movement. As wheels have to not only move the vehicle in whichever direction necessary but also withstand the combined weight, larger and heavier vehicles can need several or dozens of them.
Rule.Translated: La rueda, una de las tecnologías más antiguas desarrolladas por el hombre, toma la fuerza del motor y la convierte en movimiento. Los neumáticos no solo se encargan de mover el vehículo en la dirección que sea necesaria, sino que también se encargan de soportar el peso del mismo. Por ese motivo, los vehículos más grandes y pesados podrían necesitar incluso docenas de ellos.

Rule.Original: An insulated rechargeable battery and wiring which powers numerous electronic functions. Acts as a surge protector for electronic systems and multiple batteries can augment or even replace a vehicle's engine.
Rule.Raw: An insulated rechargeable battery and wiring which powers numerous electronic functions. Acts as a surge protector for electronic systems and multiple batteries can augment or even replace a vehicle's engine.
Rule.Translated: Una batería recargable aislada y un cableado que alimentan muchas de las funciones electrónicas de un vehículo. Actúa como protector contra picos de tensión para los sistemas electrónicos. El disponer de varias en un mismo vehículo no solo puede aumentar el rendimiento del motor, sino incluso llegar a sustituirlo.

Rule.Original: Carefully manufactured fuel storage and injection systems. Ideal for vehicles that require greater fuel capacity or even increased fuel consumption without increasing the likelihood of gas leaks or engine damage.
Rule.Raw: Carefully manufactured fuel storage and injection systems. Ideal for vehicles that require greater fuel capacity or even increased fuel consumption without increasing the likelihood of gas leaks or engine damage.
Rule.Translated: Unos sistemas de almacenamiento e inyección de combustible cuidadosamente fabricados. Ideal para vehículos que requieran una mayor capacidad o un consumo más elevado de combustible sin aumentar la probabilidad de fugas o daños en el motor.

Rule.Original: A dedicated, automatic transmission system delicately machined from hardened and durable materials. Due to its comparatively complex design, these are required in vehicles that require immense torque or excessive rotational speeds.
Rule.Raw: A dedicated, automatic transmission system delicately machined from hardened and durable materials. Due to its comparatively complex design, these are required in vehicles that require immense torque or excessive rotational speeds.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de transmisión automática fabricado con delicadeza a partir de materiales endurecidos y duraderos. Debido a su diseño comparativamente complejo, son necesarios en vehículos que requieren un par inmenso o velocidades de giro excesivas.

Rule.Original: A series of pipes, tubes, fans, pumps, and the radiator itself, ready to be installed in a vehicle that is expected to endure heavy loads. The harder the engine will have to work, the more radiators required to keep it cool.
Rule.Raw: A series of pipes, tubes, fans, pumps, and the radiator itself, ready to be installed in a vehicle that is expected to endure heavy loads. The harder the engine will have to work, the more radiators required to keep it cool.
Rule.Translated: Un disipador de calor, acompañado de una serie de tuberías, conductos, ventiladores y bombas, listo para ser instalado en un vehículo que tenga que soportar una gran carga de trabajo. Cuanto más tenga que trabajar el motor, más radiadores se necesitarán para mantenerlo refrigerado.

Rule.Original: Reinforced and machined wiring parts to improve electricity conduction. Typically required in vehicles that have a lot of synchronized or delicate electronic systems.
Rule.Raw: Reinforced and machined wiring parts to improve electricity conduction. Typically required in vehicles that have a lot of synchronized or delicate electronic systems.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de piezas de cableado reforzadas y procesadas para mejorar la conducción de la electricidad. Suele ser necesario en vehículos que cuentan con muchos sistemas electrónicos sincronizados o delicados.

Rule.Original:
A basic passenger transport, the Bangbus is a relatively cheap piece of machinery to construct to transport people across roads of flat terrain. Not recommended to use in the winter season or in snowy terrain, or both, as the light plates of armour that protect the passengers similarly negatively affects its acceleration.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x5
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw:
A basic passenger transport, the Bangbus is a relatively cheap piece of machinery to construct to transport people across roads of flat terrain. Not recommended to use in the winter season or in snowy terrain, or both, as the light plates of armour that protect the passengers similarly negatively affects its acceleration.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x5
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Translated:
El peñabús, un medio de transporte de pasajeros básico, es una pieza de maquinaria relativamente barata de construir para transportar personas por senderos de terreno llano. No se recomienda usarlo durante el frío del invierno o para desplazarse sobre terrenos nevados (o una combinación de ambos), ya que las ligeras placas de blindaje que protegen a los pasajeros también afectarán de forma negativa a su aceleración.

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 1, engulle combustible a mansalva y es mejor utilizarlo para distancias medias.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x5
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original:
A basic light tank, the Bunsen is a modified armoured vehicle suited for taking on enemy fortifications and exposed infantry. Special light plating to prevent self-immolation, combined with its main weapon drawing directly from its enlarged fuel tanks, leave it a very precarious model to field.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances, however it’s also less fuel efficient on the world map.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw:
A basic light tank, the Bunsen is a modified armoured vehicle suited for taking on enemy fortifications and exposed infantry. Special light plating to prevent self-immolation, combined with its main weapon drawing directly from its enlarged fuel tanks, leave it a very precarious model to field.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances, however it’s also less fuel efficient on the world map.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Translated:
El Bunsen, un tanque ligero básico, es un vehículo blindado modificado adecuado para enfrentarse a las fortificaciones enemigas y a la infantería expuesta. El blindaje ligero especial para evitar la autoinmolación, combinado con su arma principal que se alimenta directamente de sus depósitos de combustible agrandados, lo convierten en un modelo bastante precario.

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 1, engulle combustible a mansalva y es mejor utilizarlo para distancias medias. También consume algo más de combustible en comparación con otros vehículos de nivel 1 en el mapa del mundo.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Artillero x1
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: A lightly-armored medium range flamethrower turret usually mounted on bunsen tanks. Takes fuel directly from the chemtank of the vehicle. Quite devastating against infantry, bunsen flamethrower struggles against armored targets.
Rule.Raw: A lightly-armored medium range flamethrower turret usually mounted on bunsen tanks. Takes fuel directly from the chemtank of the vehicle. Quite devastating against infantry, bunsen flamethrower struggles against armored targets.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta lanzallamas de alcance medio y blindaje ligero, montada normalmente sobre tanques bunsen. Toma el combustible directamente del depósito del vehículo. Aunque es bastante devastador contra la infantería, este lanzallamas tiene dificultades contra objetivos blindados.

Rule.Original:
A very basic motorised boat, the Dingy is an incredibly cheap and discrete method of transportation over water. Has a good cargo capacity, however it is likely to get frozen solid in the winter times and moves slowly on rivers. The exposed rear-mounted engine is vulnerable to attacks and the hull plating should not be expected to wither projectile weapons.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x5
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x5
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Translated:
La lancha, una embarcación motorizada muy básica, constituye un método de transporte por el agua increíblemente barato y discreto. Tiene una buena capacidad de carga, aunque es probable que se congele durante el frío del invierno y que se desplace lentamente por los ríos. El motor expuesto montado en la parte trasera es vulnerable a los ataques y cabe esperar que el blindaje del casco no resista mucho los proyectiles de las armas.

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 1, engulle combustible a mansalva y es mejor utilizarlo para distancias medias.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x5
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible
