Rule.Original:
A basic off-road motorcycle, the Dirtbike is a very cheap vehicle that allows a single user to travel quickly, efficiently and quietly. Incredibly light and practically paper-thin on armour, it performs poorly in the winter or in the snow, or both, and has absolutely no cargo capacity.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw:
A basic off-road motorcycle, the Dirtbike is a very cheap vehicle that allows a single user to travel quickly, efficiently and quietly. Incredibly light and practically paper-thin on armour, it performs poorly in the winter or in the snow, or both, and has absolutely no cargo capacity.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Translated:
La moto de cross, un tipo de motocicleta todoterreno básica, es un vehículo muy asequible que le permite a un usuario desplazarse de forma rápida, eficaz y silenciosa. Aunque es increíblemente ligera, su blindaje es ridículo y no cuenta con ninguna capacidad de carga. Su rendimiento decae con el frío del invierno o al desplazarse sobre terrenos nevados (o una combinación de ambos).

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 1, engulle combustible a mansalva y es mejor utilizarlo para distancias medias.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original:
A basic reusable transport pod, the Frog is a relatively cheap vehicle that is the first option when it comes to flying without crashing into the ground. Several times faster than conventional transport pods with acceptable armour for its single passenger, making it an ideal ambush vehicle.

Even worse than other tier 1 vehicles, fuel efficiency isn’t a thing with this transportation. Care must be taken to either refuel at the landing site or travel with enough spare fuel to make the trip back.

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw:
A basic reusable transport pod, the Frog is a relatively cheap vehicle that is the first option when it comes to flying without crashing into the ground. Several times faster than conventional transport pods with acceptable armour for its single passenger, making it an ideal ambush vehicle.

Even worse than other tier 1 vehicles, fuel efficiency isn’t a thing with this transportation. Care must be taken to either refuel at the landing site or travel with enough spare fuel to make the trip back.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Translated:
La Pulga, una cápsula de transporte reutilizable básica, es un vehículo relativamente barato que suele convertirse en la primera opción cuando alguien trata de volar sin estrellarse contra el suelo. Es bastante más rápido que las cápsulas de transporte convencionales y cuenta con un blindaje aceptable para ser un vehículo de un solo pasajero, por lo que es ideal para hacer emboscadas.

Es incluso peor que otros vehículos de nivel 1, ya que en cuestión de eficiencia del combustible es lo peor de lo peor. Por ello, es conveniente que viajes con suficiente combustible extra para el viaje de vuelta, o en su defecto, que puedas repostar en el lugar de destino.

Al ser un vehículo volador, es extremadamente visible cuando está en movimiento.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

La Pulga, una cápsula de transporte reutilizable básica, es un vehículo relativamente barato que suele convertirse en la primera opción cuando alguien trata de volar sin estrellarse contra el suelo. Es bastante más rápido que las cápsulas de transporte convencionales y cuenta con un blindaje aceptable para ser un vehículo de un solo pasajero, por lo que es ideal para hacer emboscadas.

Es incluso peor que otros vehículos de nivel 1, ya que en cuestión de eficiencia del combustible es lo peor de lo peor. Por ello, es conveniente que viajes con suficiente combustible extra para el viaje de vuelta, o en su defecto, que puedas repostar en el lugar de destino.

Al ser un vehículo volador, es extremadamente visible cuando está en movimiento.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original:
A basic infantry fighting vehicle, the Highwayman is the cheapest weaponized option for transporting three people. Hardened against small-arms fire but very vulnerable at the rear, intended to provide mobile fire support for infantry and travel quickly along paved roads.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances, however it’s also less fuel efficient on the world map.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El guerrero del camino, un vehículo básico de combate terrestre, es la opción armada más asequible para transportar a tres personas. Está reforzado frente a los proyectiles de armas ligeras, pero es muy vulnerable en la parte trasera. Su objetivo es el de proporcionar apoyo móvil de fuego a la infantería y desplazarse rápidamente por carreteras asfaltadas.

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 1, engulle combustible a mansalva y es mejor utilizarlo para distancias medias. También consume algo más de combustible en comparación con otros vehículos de nivel 1 en el mapa del mundo.

Rule.Original: A lightly-armored twin-linked miniturret cannon. Usually mounted on Highwaymen armored personnel carriers. Needs to be reloaded with steel. Can only fire over short range, but doesn’t have any issues with firing at enemies that engage the vehicle in melee.
Rule.Raw: A lightly-armored twin-linked miniturret cannon. Usually mounted on Highwaymen armored personnel carriers. Needs to be reloaded with steel. Can only fire over short range, but doesn’t have any issues with firing at enemies that engage the vehicle in melee.
Rule.Translated: Una minitorreta con un cañón doble eslabón ligeramente blindado. Suele montarse sobre los TBP guerreros del camino. Debe recargarse con acero. Solo puede disparar a corta distancia, pero no tiene problemas para disparar a enemigos que se enfrentan al vehículo cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original:
A basic cargo transport, the Mule is a relatively cheap vehicle that can carry a large amount of cargo across smooth roads of flat terrain. Not recommended to use in the winter season or in snowy terrain, or both, and it is very lightly armoured to save weight.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances. Unlike other tier 1 vehicles, this one performs better on the world map by being slightly faster and more fuel efficient.

<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
La camioneta, un medio de transporte de carga básico, es un vehículo relativamente barato que puede transportar una gran cantidad de carga por carreteras lisas de terreno llano. No se recomienda usarlo durante el frío del invierno o para desplazarse sobre terrenos nevados (o una combinación de ambos), y está muy poco blindado para reducir su peso.

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 1, engulle combustible a mansalva y es mejor utilizarlo para distancias medias. Pero a diferencia de otros vehículos de nivel 1, este rinde mejor en el mapa del mundo al ser ligeramente más rápido y consumir menos combustible.

Rule.Original:
A basic off-road exploration vehicle, the Prowler is relatively cheap to construct and is an effective all-weather option for efficient travel over steep terrain. Very lightly armoured with a vulnerable rear-mounted engine, it’s best to keep this single-user automobile away from combat.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

El Merodeador, un vehículo todoterreno de exploración básico, es relativamente fácil de construir y es una opción eficaz para desplazarse en cualquier tipo de clima sobre cualquier tipo de terreno, por escarpado que sea. Con un blindaje muy ligero y un vulnerable motor montado en la parte trasera, lo mejor es intentar mantener este automóvil de un solo tripulante alejado del combate.

Rule.Original:
A basic medium tank, the Roadkill is a comparatively cheap armoured vehicle suited for short engagements. Very respectfully armoured from frontal attacks, however side attacks can disable movement and the exposed rear-mounted engine makes it vulnerable to flanking.

While other tier 1 vehicles are gas guzzlers, this one burns through fuel at an alarming rate and is extremely slow to repair.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Arrollador, un tanque mediano básico, es un vehículo blindado relativamente barato adecuado para enfrentamientos cortos. Cuenta con un blindaje respetable en su parte frontal. Sin embargo, los ataques laterales pueden inutilizar el movimiento y el motor expuesto montado en la parte trasera lo hace vulnerable al flanqueo.

Lo normal en cualquier vehículo de nivel 1 es engullir el combustible. Pero éste lo hace a un ritmo alarmantemente rápido en comparación, y es extremadamente lento de reparar.

Rule.Original:
A juryrigged multiple rocket launcher system, the Scytheman is a repurposed farming vehicle intended to saturate a location with inaccurate volleys of explosives. Due to the design, it is not intended to fire successive volleys or be exposed to enemy fire.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances. Performs worse in the winter but slightly better on the flat, open road.

El Guadañero, un sistema de lanzamiento de cohetes múltiples improvisado, es un vehículo agrícola reconvertido para acribillar a una ubicación con una lluvia imprecisa de explosivos. Debido a su diseño, no está pensado para disparar salvas sucesivas ni para exponerse al fuego enemigo.

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 1, engulle combustible a mansalva y es mejor utilizarlo para distancias medias. Su rendimiento es peor en invierno, pero ligeramente mejor en carreteras llanas y abiertas.

<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: An inaccurate launcher capable of firing two barrages of rockets covering a large area. The turret does not fire until someone orders it to fire. It is very effective against large groups of weaker combatants, but less effective against small numbers of armored targets. Extensive firing may overheat and disable the turret.

It is very effective against large groups of weaker combatants, but less effective against small numbers of armored targets. Extensive firing may overheat and disable the turret.
Rule.Translated: Un impreciso lanzador capaz de disparar dos andanadas de cohetes capaces de abarcar una amplia zona. La torreta no dispara hasta que alguien se lo ordena. Es muy eficaz contra grandes grupos de combatientes débiles, pero no tanto frente a un pequeño número de objetivos blindados. El fuego intensivo puede sobrecalentar e inutilizar la torreta.

Rule.Original:
A squad and mortar deployment pod, the Toad is a somewhat expensive vehicle to quickly mount a siege on a nearby locale without exposing your gunners to danger. With more armour than a tank and a design made to be deployed from orbit, it makes for a semi-disposable assault vehicle.

Fuel efficiency is not the design of this vehicle, consider only deploying on short distances with enough fuel to make it back.

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move.

Rule.Translated:
El Saltamontes, una cápsula de despliegue de escuadrones con mortero incluído, es un vehículo algo difícil de construir pero permite asediar un lugar cercano de forma rápida y sin exponer a tus artilleros al peligro. Con más blindaje que un tanque y un diseño pensado para ser desplegado desde la órbita, es el vehículo de asalto semi-desechable ideal.

Este vehículo no ha sido precisamente diseñado para ahorrar combustible, considera desplegarlo solo en distancias cortas y con suficiente combustible para volver.

Al ser un vehículo volador, es extremadamente visible cuando está en movimiento.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Operador x1, Pasajero x3
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biombustible

Rule.Original: A mortar turret that launches all kinds of shells, typically mounted on Toad siege pods. While it can inflict devastating damage, the mortar's inherent inaccuracy makes it more useful for attacking large fortifications than groups of enemies in the field.
Rule.Raw: A mortar turret that launches all kinds of shells, typically mounted on Toad siege pods. While it can inflict devastating damage, the mortar's inherent inaccuracy makes it more useful for attacking large fortifications than groups of enemies in the field.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta tipo mortero que lanza todo tipo de proyectiles, normalmente montada en cápsulas de asedio Saltamontes. Aunque puede infligir daños devastadores, la imprecisión innata del mortero hace que resulte más útil para atacar grandes fortificaciones que grupos de enemigos en el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original:
A basic road vehicle suited for flat terrain, the Traveller is a relatively cheap and fast option that still performs quite amicably in cold weather and snowy conditions. The light armour and exposed front-mounted engine leans to its cadence of running away from trouble rather than towards it.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances. The extra speed and acceleration make it even less fuel-efficient as well as more time-consuming to repair.

Rule.Original:
A general motorcycle, the Charley is a very effective single-person vehicle with a small cargo capacity. Performs well on any road except during winter season or snowy terrain, or both, with an increased speed on the world map.

Similar to other tier 2 vehicles, this has double fuel efficiency on the world map which makes them more efficient than tier 1 vehicles. They are also less visible due to improved manufacturing.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1

Rule.Original:
A general purpose armoured personnel carrier, the Tango is a slow but hardy troop transport. Ample cargo holds, hardened armour, all-terrain capability and a turret that can fire either mobile or stationary, the main downside is fuel consumption and slightly thinner plating on the rear.

Different to other tier 2 vehicles, this has regular fuel efficiency and is quite visible, its high fuel consumption rate putting a limit on the effective range.

La ranchera, un vehículo bastante polivalente, es un medio que se comporta bien en cualquier situación, con una buena capacidad para transportar carga y pasajeros. Funciona muy bien en carreteras llanas, pero le costará un poco atravesar colinas, terrenos nevados o celdas de invierno.

Al igual que otros vehículos de nivel 2, tiene el doble de eficiencia de combustible en el mapa del mundo, marcando la diferencia frente a los vehículos de nivel 1. También son menos visibles gracias a su fabricación mejorada.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x3
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original:
A general all-rounder vehicle, the Wagon performs well in all categories with a good cargo and passenger capacity. Best suited on flat roads and will struggle somewhat on hills, snow or winter tiles.

Similar to other tier 2 vehicles, this has double fuel efficiency on the world map which makes them more efficient than tier 1 vehicles. They are also less visible due to improved manufacturing.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x3
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Original:
A general-purpose fighter plane, the Warbird is an incredibly fast and effective attack craft. With minimal cargo intended for holding maintenance equipment and fuel, its primary purpose is to engage other aircraft and initiate strafing manoeuvres.

Different to other tier 2 vehicles, this has regular fuel efficiency on the world map but moves significantly faster in return.

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Ave de combate, un avión de combate de propósito general, es una nave de ataque increíblemente rápida y eficaz. Con una carga mínima destinada a albergar equipos de mantenimiento y combustible, su principal función es la de atacar a otros vehículos aéreos e iniciar maniobras de ametrallamiento.

A diferencia de otros vehículos de nivel 2, este tiene una eficiencia de combustible reducida mientras se desplaza por el mapa del mundo, pero a cambio se desplaza mucho más rápido.

Al ser un vehículo volador, es extremadamente visible cuando está en movimiento.

Tripulación:<color=#bb8f04> Piloto x1

Rule.Original:
A military-grade all-purpose transporter, the Wisent is a powerful truck capable of transporting both plentiful cargo and soldiers into hostile territory. Terrible fuel economy, however it can quickly navigate through rough terrain.

Counter to other tier 2 vehicles, this is less efficient but more effective when travelling away from roads. Passengers sitting in the back will be exposed to enemy fire and the armour plating is only suited for minimal small arms fire.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x7
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El cíbolo, un vehículo militar de transporte polivalente, es un potente camión capaz de transportar tanto grandes cantidades de carga como soldados a territorio hostil. Su consumo de combustible es pésimo, pero puede desplazarse rápidamente por terrenos abruptos.

En comparación con otros vehículos de nivel 2, es menos eficiente pero más eficaz cuando se aleja de las carreteras. Los pasajeros que vayan en la parte trasera estarán expuestos al fuego enemigo y el blindaje solo es apto para un fuego mínimo de armas pequeñas.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x9
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: The world is vast and meant to be explored in all its facets.
Rule.Raw: The world is vast and meant to be explored in all its facets.
Rule.Translated: El mundo es vasto y está para explorarlo en todas sus facetas.

Rule.Original: creation(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[deity0_name] wrote [deity0_possessive] commandments in eleven plasteel tablets. The fifth commandment read: "I shall not refrain from exploring the world."
Rule.Raw: creation(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[deity0_name] wrote [deity0_possessive] commandments in eleven plasteel tablets. The fifth commandment read: "I shall not refrain from exploring the world."
Rule.Translated: creation(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[deity0_name] escribió los mandamientos de [deity0_possessive] fe en once tablas de plastiacero. El quinto decía: «No me abstendré de explorar el mundo».

Rule.Original: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Traveler) ->In accordance with [deity0_name]'s precepts, we happily traveled abroad, away from our settlements, to see all our world has to offer.
Rule.Raw: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Traveler) ->In accordance with [deity0_name]'s precepts, we happily traveled abroad, away from our settlements, to see all our world has to offer.
Rule.Translated: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Traveler) ->De acuerdo con los preceptos de [deity0_name], viajamos con alegría a tierras lejanas, alejándonos de nuestros asentamientos para contemplar cuanto ofrece el mundo.

Rule.Original: intro(tag=meme_Traveler) ->The [memberNamePlural] were restless, for [deity0_name] had commanded them to explore the surrounding lands, and they were tired of roaming around living off the land.
Rule.Raw: intro(tag=meme_Traveler) ->The [memberNamePlural] were restless, for [deity0_name] had commanded them to explore the surrounding lands, and they were tired of roaming around living off the land.
Rule.Translated: intro(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Los [memberNamePlural] estaban inquietos, pues [deity0_name] les había ordenado explorar las tierras vecinas y estaban cansados de vagar y vivir de la tierra.

Rule.Original: conflict(tag=meme_Traveler) ->One of the elders wanted to defy [deity0_name]'s commandments, and close the settlements for further exploration.
Rule.Raw: conflict(tag=meme_Traveler) ->One of the elders wanted to defy [deity0_name]'s commandments, and close the settlements for further exploration.
Rule.Translated: conflict(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Uno de los ancianos quería desafiar los mandamientos de [deity0_name] y cerrar los asentamientos a nuevas exploraciones.

Rule.Original: founderJoin(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[founderName], the Great Explorer, grew tired of the insolence of the elder, and usurped his power. From that point on, the [memberNamePlural] would be the most skilled explorers in the land, venturing far away.
Rule.Raw: founderJoin(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[founderName], the Great Explorer, grew tired of the insolence of the elder, and usurped his power. From that point on, the [memberNamePlural] would be the most skilled explorers in the land, venturing far away.
Rule.Translated: founderJoin(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[founderName], el Gran Explorador, se cansó de la insolencia del anciano y usurpó su poder. Desde entonces, los [memberNamePlural] serían los exploradores más hábiles de estas tierras y se aventurarían muy lejos.

Rule.Original: victory(tag=meme_Traveler) ->It was thus that we became enamoured with wanderlust, and traveled the whole world exploring even its farther confines.
Rule.Raw: victory(tag=meme_Traveler) ->It was thus that we became enamoured with wanderlust, and traveled the whole world exploring even its farther confines.
Rule.Translated: victory(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Así nos enamoramos del afán de viajar y recorrimos todo el mundo, explorando incluso sus confines más remotos.

Rule.Original: setup(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[founderName] was a skilled explorer. [founder_pronoun] longed for discovery, travelling to the farther confiens of the world.
Rule.Raw: setup(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[founderName] was a skilled explorer. [founder_pronoun] longed for discovery, travelling to the farther confiens of the world.
Rule.Translated: setup(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[founderName] era un explorador hábil. [founder_pronoun] ansiaba descubrir y viajaba hasta los confines más remotos del mundo.

Rule.Original: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Traveler) ->Seeking the thrill of adventure, [founderName] assembled a small group of [founder_possessive] followers and chartered a ship to travel to the Rim. [founder_possessive] discoveries were the stuff of legend, mapping a plethora of strange new worlds and new civilizations, boldly going where... errr, sorry, got carried away a bit there.
Rule.Raw: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Traveler) ->Seeking the thrill of adventure, [founderName] assembled a small group of [founder_possessive] followers and chartered a ship to travel to the Rim. [founder_possessive] discoveries were the stuff of legend, mapping a plethora of strange new worlds and new civilizations, boldly going where... errr, sorry, got carried away a bit there.
Rule.Translated: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Traveler) ->En busca de la emoción de la aventura, [founderName] reunió a un pequeño grupo de seguidores de [founder_possessive] causa y fletó una nave para viajar a la frontera. Los descubrimientos de [founder_possessive] viaje fueron legendarios: cartografió numerosos mundos extraños y nuevas civilizaciones y llegó con audacia adonde... Ejem, perdón, me he dejado llevar un poco.

Rule.Original: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Humans fear the unknown, it's a fact. It is abundantly clear that
Rule.Raw: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Humans fear the unknown, it's a fact. It is abundantly clear that
Rule.Translated: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Los humanos temen lo desconocido. Es un hecho. Está absolutamente claro que

Rule.Original: lesson(tag=meme_Traveler) ->we need to explore our surroundings. Being unaware of what is around us is a recipe for disaster
Rule.Raw: lesson(tag=meme_Traveler) ->we need to explore our surroundings. Being unaware of what is around us is a recipe for disaster
Rule.Translated: lesson(tag=meme_Traveler) ->debemos explorar nuestro entorno. Ignorar lo que nos rodea conduce al desastre

Rule.Original: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Only true explorers can never be caught unawares.
Rule.Raw: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Only true explorers can never be caught unawares.
Rule.Translated: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Solo los auténticos exploradores pueden evitar que los sorprendan desprevenidos.

Rule.Original: archistBasis(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Archotechs are always aware of everything. Being unaware of your surroundings is almost obscene to them.
Rule.Raw: archistBasis(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Archotechs are always aware of everything. Being unaware of your surroundings is almost obscene to them.
Rule.Translated: archistBasis(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Las arcotecnologías siempre lo saben todo. Para ellas, ignorar el entorno es casi obsceno.

Rule.Original: archistFact(tag=meme_Traveler) ->The archotechs teach us that exploring and travelling are a path to transcendence.
Rule.Raw: archistFact(tag=meme_Traveler) ->The archotechs teach us that exploring and travelling are a path to transcendence.
Rule.Translated: archistFact(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Las arcotecnologías nos enseñan que explorar y viajar conducen a la trascendencia.

Rule.Original: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[inTheEnd], those who spend their whole lives hiding won't transcend, while those who are infused by wanderlust will join the archotechs.
Rule.Raw: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[inTheEnd], those who spend their whole lives hiding won't transcend, while those who are infused by wanderlust will join the archotechs.
Rule.Translated: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[inTheEnd], quienes se pasan la vida escondidos no trascenderán, mientras que quienes sientan el afán de viajar se unirán a las arcotecnologías.

Rule.Original: animistBasis(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Spirits govern everything, from the most abstract concepts to concrete ones. Specifically, each place has its own spirit, and that's why discovering and traveling to all these places brings us closer to the spirits.
Rule.Raw: animistBasis(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Spirits govern everything, from the most abstract concepts to concrete ones. Specifically, each place has its own spirit, and that's why discovering and traveling to all these places brings us closer to the spirits.
Rule.Translated: animistBasis(tag=meme_Traveler) ->Los espíritus gobiernan todo, desde los conceptos más abstractos hasta los más concretos. Cada lugar tiene su propio espíritu; por eso descubrirlos y viajar hasta ellos nos acerca a los espíritus.

Rule.Original: animistFact(tag=meme_Traveler) ->The spirit of wanderlust is a powerful one, and instills one with a passion for freedom, for exploration: you never know what the road ahead may bring.
Rule.Raw: animistFact(tag=meme_Traveler) ->The spirit of wanderlust is a powerful one, and instills one with a passion for freedom, for exploration: you never know what the road ahead may bring.
Rule.Translated: animistFact(tag=meme_Traveler) ->El espíritu del afán de viajar es poderoso e infunde pasión por la libertad y la exploración: nunca se sabe qué traerá el camino.

Rule.Original: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[itIsSaid] only those who are able to live without roots and roam free can truly appease the spirits.
Rule.Raw: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[itIsSaid] only those who are able to live without roots and roam free can truly appease the spirits.
Rule.Translated: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Traveler) ->[itIsSaid] solo quienes pueden vivir sin raíces y vagar libremente logran aplacar de verdad a los espíritus.

Rule.Original: For us, the road is sacred, and vehicular dominance is both a belief and a testament to our power. We view the roar of our engines and the rush of asphalt beneath our tires as sacred.
Rule.Raw: For us, the road is sacred, and vehicular dominance is both a belief and a testament to our power. We view the roar of our engines and the rush of asphalt beneath our tires as sacred.
Rule.Translated: Para nosotros, la carretera es sagrada y el dominio de los vehículos es a la vez una creencia y una demostración de poder. Consideramos sagrados el rugido de los motores y el asfalto que pasa veloz bajo nuestros neumáticos.

Rule.Original: creation(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[deity0_name] cared only for the roar of the engines. [deity0_pronoun] ordered all the faithful to hit the road.
Rule.Raw: creation(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[deity0_name] cared only for the roar of the engines. [deity0_pronoun] ordered all the faithful to hit the road.
Rule.Translated: creation(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->A [deity0_name] solo le importaba el rugido de los motores. [deity0_pronoun] ordenó a todos los fieles salir a la carretera.

Rule.Original: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Speaking to [deity0_possessive] believers, [deity0_name] said: "I myself will carry you through the gates of Valhalla. You shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!".
Rule.Raw: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Speaking to [deity0_possessive] believers, [deity0_name] said: "I myself will carry you through the gates of Valhalla. You shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!".
Rule.Translated: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Al dirigirse a los creyentes de [deity0_possessive] fe, [deity0_name] dijo: «Yo mismo os llevaré a través de las puertas del Valhalla. ¡Rodaréis eternamente, brillantes y cromados!».

Rule.Original: intro(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[place_summary] [place_name] glistened with the fresh engine oil that had dripped from our sacred vehicles, a testament of [deity0_name]'s glory.
Rule.Raw: intro(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[place_summary] [place_name] glistened with the fresh engine oil that had dripped from our sacred vehicles, a testament of [deity0_name]'s glory.
Rule.Translated: intro(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[place_summary] [place_name] relucía con el aceite de motor fresco que goteaba de nuestros vehículos sagrados, testimonio de la gloria de [deity0_name].

Rule.Original: conflict(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->A rabid [foeLeader], wanting to get [foeLeader_possessive] hands on our cars, tried to attack with the help of [foeLeader_possessive] many [foeSoldiers].
Rule.Raw: conflict(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->A rabid [foeLeader], wanting to get [foeLeader_possessive] hands on our cars, tried to attack with the help of [foeLeader_possessive] many [foeSoldiers].
Rule.Translated: conflict(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Un rabioso [foeLeader], ansioso por echar [foeLeader_possessive] garra a nuestros coches, intentó atacar con la ayuda de la multitud de [foeSoldiers] a [foeLeader_possessive] servicio.

Rule.Original: founderJoin(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[deity0_name] bestowed our founder, [founderName], with the [relic0_name], and [founder_pronoun] used it to annoint and augment the V8 engine of his custom-made Road Raging car, resisting the onslaught.
Rule.Raw: founderJoin(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[deity0_name] bestowed our founder, [founderName], with the [relic0_name], and [founder_pronoun] used it to annoint and augment the V8 engine of his custom-made Road Raging car, resisting the onslaught.
Rule.Translated: founderJoin(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[deity0_name] entregó a nuestro fundador, [founderName], el [relic0_name], y [founder_pronoun] lo utilizó para ungir y mejorar el motor V8 de su coche personalizado de furia en la carretera, resistiendo el ataque.

Rule.Original: victory(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The massacre was sublime. [founderName] slaughtered countless enemies, and we celebrated by hitting the road mounted on all our vehicles.
Rule.Raw: victory(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The massacre was sublime. [founderName] slaughtered countless enemies, and we celebrated by hitting the road mounted on all our vehicles.
Rule.Translated: victory(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->La masacre fue sublime. [founderName] mató a incontables enemigos y lo celebramos saliendo a la carretera montados en todos nuestros vehículos.

Rule.Original: setup(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[founderName] understood that the roar of an engine is the only true measure of power.
Rule.Raw: setup(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[founderName] understood that the roar of an engine is the only true measure of power.
Rule.Translated: setup(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[founderName] comprendió que el rugido de un motor es la única medida verdadera del poder.

Rule.Original: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[founderName] always repeated the same lesson over and over again: "I myself will carry you through the gates of Valhalla. You shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!".
Rule.Raw: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[founderName] always repeated the same lesson over and over again: "I myself will carry you through the gates of Valhalla. You shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!".
Rule.Translated: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[founderName] repetía siempre la misma lección: «Yo mismo os llevaré a través de las puertas del Valhalla. ¡Rodaréis eternamente, brillantes y cromados!».

Rule.Original: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->It is only by the roar of our engines that one arrives at pleasure. You need to understand that
Rule.Raw: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->It is only by the roar of our engines that one arrives at pleasure. You need to understand that
Rule.Translated: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Solo el rugido de nuestros motores nos lleva al placer. Debes comprender que

Rule.Original: lesson(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->I am your redeemer. It is by my hand you will rise from the ashes of this world
Rule.Raw: lesson(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->I am your redeemer. It is by my hand you will rise from the ashes of this world
Rule.Translated: lesson(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->yo soy tu redentor. Por mi mano te alzarás de las cenizas de este mundo

Rule.Original: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->I myself will carry you through the gates of Valhalla. You shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!
Rule.Raw: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->I myself will carry you through the gates of Valhalla. You shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!
Rule.Translated: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Yo mismo os llevaré a través de las puertas del Valhalla. ¡Rodaréis eternamente, brillantes y cromados!

Rule.Original: archistBasis(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The Archotechs understand that power is not just a means to an end. Power is an end on itself.
Rule.Raw: archistBasis(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The Archotechs understand that power is not just a means to an end. Power is an end on itself.
Rule.Translated: archistBasis(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Las arcotecnologías comprenden que el poder no es solo un medio para un fin. El poder es un fin en sí mismo.

Rule.Original: archistFact(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The Archotechs will stand in awe of the powerful roar of our engines. It is by their hand we will rise from the ashes of this world.
Rule.Raw: archistFact(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The Archotechs will stand in awe of the powerful roar of our engines. It is by their hand we will rise from the ashes of this world.
Rule.Translated: archistFact(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Las arcotecnologías admirarán el poderoso rugido de nuestros motores. Por su mano nos alzaremos de las cenizas de este mundo.

Rule.Original: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[inTheEnd], they will carry us through the gates of Valhalla. We shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!
Rule.Raw: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[inTheEnd], they will carry us through the gates of Valhalla. We shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!
Rule.Translated: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[inTheEnd], nos llevarán a través de las puertas del Valhalla. ¡Rodaremos eternamente, brillantes y cromados!

Rule.Original: animistBasis(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The spirits understand that power is not just a means to an end. Power is an end on itself.
Rule.Raw: animistBasis(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->The spirits understand that power is not just a means to an end. Power is an end on itself.
Rule.Translated: animistBasis(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Los espíritus comprenden que el poder no es solo un medio para un fin. El poder es un fin en sí mismo.

Rule.Original: animistFact(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->It is by their hand we will rise from the ashes of this world.
Rule.Raw: animistFact(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->It is by their hand we will rise from the ashes of this world.
Rule.Translated: animistFact(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->Por su mano nos alzaremos de las cenizas de este mundo.

Rule.Original: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[itIsSaid] only those who let the roar of their engines be heard above all else will be carried by the spirits through the gates of Valhalla. They shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!
Rule.Raw: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[itIsSaid] only those who let the roar of their engines be heard above all else will be carried by the spirits through the gates of Valhalla. They shall ride eternal, shiny and chrome!
Rule.Translated: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Roadragers) ->[itIsSaid] los espíritus solo llevarán a través de las puertas del Valhalla a quienes hagan oír el rugido de sus motores por encima de todo. ¡Rodarán eternamente, brillantes y cromados!

Rule.Original: Our vehicles move with balance, neither too fast nor too slow.
Rule.Raw: Our vehicles move with balance, neither too fast nor too slow.
Rule.Translated: Nuestros vehículos se desplazan de manera equilibrada, ni demasiado rápido ni demasiado lento.

Rule.Original:
A measured pace keeps the world in balance and grants us time to savor the journey.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All vehicles have World Speed Multiplier: x0.8
Rule.Raw:
A measured pace keeps the world in balance and grants us time to savor the journey.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All vehicles have World Speed Multiplier: x0.8
Rule.Translated:
Un ritmo medido mantiene el mundo en equilibrio y nos da tiempo para disfrutar del viaje.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Todos los vehículos tienen un multiplicador de velocidad en el mapa mundial: x0,8.

Rule.Original:
With swift acceleration, we move forward in leaps, seizing the day with passion.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All vehicles have World Speed Multiplier: x1.25
Rule.Raw:
With swift acceleration, we move forward in leaps, seizing the day with passion.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All vehicles have World Speed Multiplier: x1.25
Rule.Translated:
Con una aceleración rápida, avanzamos a saltos, apoderándonos del día con pasión.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Todos los vehículos tienen un multiplicador de velocidad en el mapa mundial: x1,25.

Rule.Original: To traverse the land in vehicles is a violation of our core beliefs.
Rule.Raw: To traverse the land in vehicles is a violation of our core beliefs.
Rule.Translated: Recorrer el territorio en vehículo es una violación de nuestras convicciones fundamentales.

Rule.Original: We see setting foot in a land vehicle as a profound offense to our values.
Rule.Raw: We see setting foot in a land vehicle as a profound offense to our values.
Rule.Translated: Consideramos que subirse a un vehículo terrestre es una profunda ofensa a nuestros valores.

Rule.Original: Navigating the world in vehicles is an accepted practice in our community.
Rule.Raw: Navigating the world in vehicles is an accepted practice in our community.
Rule.Translated: Recorrer el mundo a bordo de un vehículo es una práctica aceptada en nuestra comunidad.

Rule.Original: Every drive on land affirms our shared spirit and joy.
Rule.Raw: Every drive on land affirms our shared spirit and joy.
Rule.Translated: Cada viaje sobre tierra firme afirma nuestra alegría y nuestro espíritu común.

Rule.Original: Our people believe in the necessity of movement, to not drive is to neglect one's duty to oneself.
Rule.Raw: Our people believe in the necessity of movement, to not drive is to neglect one's duty to oneself.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro pueblo cree en la necesidad de moverse; no conducir es descuidar el deber hacia uno mismo.
Furia al volante (1 día sin conducir)
Furia al volante (5 días sin conducir)
Furia al volante (10 días sin conducir)
Furia al volante (20 días sin conducir)

Rule.Original: I was in a land vehicle. It was horrible.
Rule.Raw: I was in a land vehicle. It was horrible.
Rule.Translated: He estado en un vehículo terrestre. Ha sido horrible.

Rule.Original: I was in a land vehicle. I loved it.
Rule.Raw: I was in a land vehicle. I loved it.
Rule.Translated: He estado en un vehículo terrestre. Me ha encantado.
furia en la carretera (más de 1 día)

Rule.Original: It has been a lil while since I've been at the wheel of a land vehicle.
Rule.Raw: It has been a lil while since I've been at the wheel of a land vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Hace un tiempo que no me pongo al volante de un vehículo terrestre.
furia en la carretera (más de 5 días)

Rule.Original: I need to drive, I'm getting very antsy.
Rule.Raw: I need to drive, I'm getting very antsy.
Rule.Translated: Necesito conducir. Me estoy poniendo muy inquieto.
furia en la carretera (más de 10 días)

Rule.Original: Enough is enough, I'm feeling the call of the road! I want to drive!
Rule.Raw: Enough is enough, I'm feeling the call of the road! I want to drive!
Rule.Translated: Ya basta. ¡Siento la llamada de la carretera! ¡Quiero conducir!
furia en la carretera (más de 20 días)

Rule.Original: I AM THE ONE THAT RUNS FROM BOTH THE LIVING AND THE DEAD! GIVE ME MY CAR!
Rule.Raw: I AM THE ONE THAT RUNS FROM BOTH THE LIVING AND THE DEAD! GIVE ME MY CAR!
Rule.Translated: ¡SOY QUIEN HUYE DE LOS VIVOS Y DE LOS MUERTOS! ¡DAME MI COCHE!

Rule.Original: To soar through the skies is an affront to our traditions and beliefs.
Rule.Raw: To soar through the skies is an affront to our traditions and beliefs.
Rule.Translated: Elevarse en el cielo es un ultraje a nuestras tradiciones y creencias.

Rule.Original: We believe taking to the skies disrupts the natural balance.
Rule.Raw: We believe taking to the skies disrupts the natural balance.
Rule.Translated: Creemos que volar perturba el equilibrio natural.
Viajar a bordo de un vehículo aéreo

Rule.Original: The skies are open to us, as they should be for all who wish to traverse them.
Rule.Raw: The skies are open to us, as they should be for all who wish to traverse them.
Rule.Translated: El cielo está abierto para nosotros, como debería estarlo para todos los que desean recorrerlo.

Rule.Original: We hold that flying brings us collectively closer to the divine.
Rule.Raw: We hold that flying brings us collectively closer to the divine.
Rule.Translated: Creemos que volar nos acerca colectivamente a lo divino.
Viajar a bordo de un vehículo aéreo

Rule.Original: The purity of spirit is found amongst the clouds; one must experience the freedom of flight regularly.
Rule.Raw: The purity of spirit is found amongst the clouds; one must experience the freedom of flight regularly.
Rule.Translated: La pureza del espíritu se encuentra en las nubes; se debe experimentar regularmente la libertad de volar.
he subido a un vehículo aéreo

Rule.Original: I was in a flying vehicle. It was horrible.
Rule.Raw: I was in a flying vehicle. It was horrible.
Rule.Translated: He estado en un vehículo volador. Ha sido horrible.
he subido a un vehículo aéreo

Rule.Original: I was in an air vehicle. I loved it.
Rule.Raw: I was in an air vehicle. I loved it.
Rule.Translated: He estado en un vehículo aéreo. Me ha encantado.

Rule.Original: It has been a lil while since I've soared the skies.
Rule.Raw: It has been a lil while since I've soared the skies.
Rule.Translated: Hace un tiempo que no surco los cielos.

Rule.Original: I need to fly, I'm getting very antsy.
Rule.Raw: I need to fly, I'm getting very antsy.
Rule.Translated: Necesito volar. Me estoy poniendo muy inquieto.

Rule.Original: Enough is enough, I'm feeling the call of the open skies! I want to fly!
Rule.Raw: Enough is enough, I'm feeling the call of the open skies! I want to fly!
Rule.Translated: Ya basta. ¡Siento la llamada de los cielos abiertos! ¡Quiero volar!

Rule.Original: ICARUS FLEW TOO CLOSE TO THE SUN, BUT I'M GONNA CATAPULT YOU THERE IF I CAN'T FLY SOON!
Rule.Raw: ICARUS FLEW TOO CLOSE TO THE SUN, BUT I'M GONNA CATAPULT YOU THERE IF I CAN'T FLY SOON!
Rule.Translated: ¡ÍCARO VOLÓ DEMASIADO CERCA DEL SOL, PERO YO TE CATAPULTARÉ HASTA ALLÍ SI NO PUEDO VOLAR PRONTO!
Nuestro consumo de biocombustible sigue siendo tradicional.

Rule.Original:
Our vehicles have a higher fuel appetite.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept increases FuelConsumptionRate (if present) on the vehicle by 50%.
Rule.Raw:
Our vehicles have a higher fuel appetite.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept increases FuelConsumptionRate (if present) on the vehicle by 50%.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestros vehículos son más consumistas de biocombustible.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Este precepto aumenta en un 50 % el índice de consumo de biocombustible (si está presente) del vehículo.

Rule.Original:
Our vehicles are optimized for minimal fuel usage.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept decreases FuelConsumptionRate (if present) on the vehicle by 50%.
Rule.Raw:
Our vehicles are optimized for minimal fuel usage.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept decreases FuelConsumptionRate (if present) on the vehicle by 50%.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestros vehículos están optimizados para un consumo mínimo de biocombustible.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Este precepto disminuye en un 50 % el índice de consumo de biocombustible (si está presente) del vehículo.

Rule.Original:
In our belief, a vehicle's power is truly felt in its formidable impact.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Damage done via driving people over is further multiplied by x1.25
Rule.Raw:
In our belief, a vehicle's power is truly felt in its formidable impact.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Damage done via driving people over is further multiplied by x1.25
Rule.Translated:
Para nosotros, la potencia de un vehículo se traduce en una colisión formidable.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los daños causados por atropellar se multiplican por x1,25.

Rule.Original:
We cherish vehicles that transcend traditional limits.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Maximum speed of vehicles is increased by a multiplier of x1.2.
Rule.Raw:
We cherish vehicles that transcend traditional limits.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Maximum speed of vehicles is increased by a multiplier of x1.2.
Rule.Translated:
Valoramos los vehículos que trascienden los límites tradicionales.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - La velocidad máxima de los vehículos se incrementa en un multiplicador de x1,2.

Rule.Original: The sacred waters must not be disrupted with our vessels.
Rule.Raw: The sacred waters must not be disrupted with our vessels.
Rule.Translated: Las aguas sagradas no deben ser perturbadas por nuestros barcos.

Rule.Original: We hold the waters sacred; to sail them feels deeply wrong to us.
Rule.Raw: We hold the waters sacred; to sail them feels deeply wrong to us.
Rule.Translated: Consideramos las aguas como sagradas; navegar por estas aguas nos parece profundamente reprobable.

Rule.Original: The oceans and rivers are pathways we are permitted to tread, so long as we respect their depths.
Rule.Raw: The oceans and rivers are pathways we are permitted to tread, so long as we respect their depths.
Rule.Translated: Los océanos y ríos son caminos que podemos recorrer, siempre y cuando respetemos sus profundidades.

Rule.Original: We hold that Sailing brings us collectively closer to the divine.
Rule.Raw: We hold that Sailing brings us collectively closer to the divine.
Rule.Translated: Creemos que la navegación nos acerca colectivamente a lo divino.

Rule.Original: Our souls are intertwined with the rhythms of the waters; we must sail to truly be alive.
Rule.Raw: Our souls are intertwined with the rhythms of the waters; we must sail to truly be alive.
Rule.Translated: Almas entrelazadas con los ritmos del agua; debemos navegar para estar verdaderamente vivos.
Llamada de las sirenas (1 día sin navegar)
Llamada de las sirenas (5 días sin navegar)
Llamada de las sirenas (10 días sin navegar)
Llamada de las sirenas (20 días sin navegar)

Rule.Original: I was in a sailing vehicle. It was horrible
Rule.Raw: I was in a sailing vehicle. It was horrible
Rule.Translated: He estado en un vehículo de vela. Ha sido horrible.

Rule.Original: I was in a sea vessel. I loved it.
Rule.Raw: I was in a sea vessel. I loved it.
Rule.Translated: He estado en un barco. Me ha encantado.
llamada de las sirenas (más de 1 día)

Rule.Original: It has been a lil while since I've ridden the waves.
Rule.Raw: It has been a lil while since I've ridden the waves.
Rule.Translated: Hace un tiempo que no cabalgo sobre las olas.
llamada de las sirenas (más de 5 días)

Rule.Original: I need to sail, I'm getting very antsy.
Rule.Raw: I need to sail, I'm getting very antsy.
Rule.Translated: Necesito navegar. Me estoy poniendo muy inquieto.
llamada de las sirenas (más de 10 días)

Rule.Original: Enough is enough, I'm feeling the call of the open seas! I want to sail!
Rule.Raw: Enough is enough, I'm feeling the call of the open seas! I want to sail!
Rule.Translated: Ya basta. ¡Siento la llamada del mar abierto! ¡Quiero navegar!
llamada de las sirenas (más de 20 días)

Rule.Original: I AM THE MASTER OF MY FATE! I AM THE CAPTAIN OF MY SOUL! I MUST SAIL THE SEAS!
Rule.Raw: I AM THE MASTER OF MY FATE! I AM THE CAPTAIN OF MY SOUL! I MUST SAIL THE SEAS!
Rule.Translated: ¡SOY EL DUEÑO DE MI DESTINO! ¡SOY EL CAPITÁN DE MI ALMA! ¡DEBO SURCAR LOS MARES!

Rule.Original:
Being in tight quarters is an affront to our freedoms.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Doubles negative thoughts about small spaces. Positive thoughts about spacious areas are unaffected.
Rule.Raw:
Being in tight quarters is an affront to our freedoms.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Doubles negative thoughts about small spaces. Positive thoughts about spacious areas are unaffected.
Rule.Translated:
Estar confinado en espacios reducidos es un ultraje a nuestras libertades.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Doble las opiniones negativas sobre los espacios pequeños. Las opiniones positivas sobre los espacios amplios no se ven afectadas.

Rule.Original: Our approach to repairs is balanced, ensuring vehicles are restored to their rightful state.
Rule.Raw: Our approach to repairs is balanced, ensuring vehicles are restored to their rightful state.
Rule.Translated: Nuestra aproximación a las reparaciones es equilibrada, garantizando que los vehículos se restauren a su estado legítimo.

Rule.Original: Repairs are a careful ritual, not to be rushed, but to be performed with reverence.
Rule.Raw: Repairs are a careful ritual, not to be rushed, but to be performed with reverence.
Rule.Translated: Las reparaciones son un ritual minucioso, que no debe apresurarse, sino realizarse con respeto.

Rule.Original:
We mend with urgency, understanding the vital role our vehicles play in our lives.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Adds +1 to Repair Job Limitations on a vehicle (as long as "Multiple pawns per job" is active in Mod settings).
Rule.Raw:
We mend with urgency, understanding the vital role our vehicles play in our lives.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Adds +1 to Repair Job Limitations on a vehicle (as long as "Multiple pawns per job" is active in Mod settings).
Rule.Translated:
Reparamos con urgencia, conscientes del papel vital que juegan nuestros vehículos en nuestras vidas.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Añade +1 a las limitaciones de trabajo de reparación en un vehículo (si la opción "Varios colonos por trabajo" está activada en los ajustes del mod).

Rule.Original: This space is so tiny. I feel like a rat in a cage.
Rule.Raw: This space is so tiny. I feel like a rat in a cage.
Rule.Translated: Este espacio es diminuto. Me siento como una rata en una jaula.

Rule.Original: This room is too small. I wish I had more space to move around and breathe.
Rule.Raw: This room is too small. I wish I had more space to move around and breathe.
Rule.Translated: Esta habitación es demasiado pequeña. Ojalá tuviera más espacio para moverme y respirar.

Rule.Original: This room is so expansive, I feel free.
Rule.Raw: This room is so expansive, I feel free.
Rule.Translated: Esta habitación es tan amplia que me siento libre.

Rule.Original: A group of {0} from {1} have arrived in a shuttle nearby.
Rule.Raw: A group of {0} from {1} have arrived in a shuttle nearby.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo de {0} de {1} ha llegado en una lanzadera a las inmediaciones.

Rule.Original: A group of friendly {0} from {1} have arrived in a shuttle nearby.
Rule.Raw: A group of friendly {0} from {1} have arrived in a shuttle nearby.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo de {0} amistosos de {1} ha llegado en una lanzadera a las inmediaciones.

Rule.Original: A group of {0} from {1} have dropped in right on top of you!
Rule.Raw: A group of {0} from {1} have dropped in right on top of you!
Rule.Translated: ¡Un grupo de {0} de {1} ha aterrizado justo encima de ti!

Rule.Original: A group of friendly {0} from {1} have dropped in right on top of you!
Rule.Raw: A group of friendly {0} from {1} have dropped in right on top of you!
Rule.Translated: ¡Un grupo de {0} amistosos de {1} ha aterrizado justo encima de ti!

Rule.Original: {0_pawnsPluralDef} will arrive in a shuttle right on top of you.
Rule.Raw: {0_pawnsPluralDef} will arrive in a shuttle right on top of you.
Rule.Translated: {0_pawnsPluralDef} llegarán en una lanzadera justo encima de ti.
cargar materiales de mejora en TargetB.

Rule.Original: A group of {0} from {1} are parachuting nearby.
Rule.Raw: A group of {0} from {1} are parachuting nearby.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo de {0} de {1} está descendiendo en paracaídas en las inmediaciones.

Rule.Original: A group of friendly {0} from {1} are parachuting nearby.
Rule.Raw: A group of friendly {0} from {1} are parachuting nearby.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo de {0} amistosos de {1} está descendiendo en paracaídas en las inmediaciones.

Rule.Original: Speed of movement on the world map while flying.
Rule.Raw: Speed of movement on the world map while flying.
Rule.Translated: La velocidad de movimiento en el mapa del mundo durante el vuelo.

Rule.Original: Capacity of vehicle for flight. If value reaches 0, the vehicle will be forced to crash land.
Rule.Raw: Capacity of vehicle for flight. If value reaches 0, the vehicle will be forced to crash land.
Rule.Translated: La capacidad de vuelo del vehículo. Si el valor llega a 0, el vehículo se verá obligado a realizar un aterrizaje de emergencia.

Rule.Original: Speed of movement in cells per second.
Rule.Raw: Speed of movement in cells per second.
Rule.Translated: La velocidad de movimiento en celdas por segundo.

Rule.Original: Amount of weight this vehicle can carry as cargo.
Rule.Raw: Amount of weight this vehicle can carry as cargo.
Rule.Translated: La cantidad de peso que este vehículo puede transportar como carga. Es la misma cantidad que aparece como disponible al crear caravanas.

Rule.Original: The amount of health that is repaired per second.
Rule.Raw: The amount of health that is repaired per second.
Rule.Translated: La cantidad de puntos de impacto que se reparan por segundo.

Rule.Original: The physical mass of this vehicle.
Rule.Raw: The physical mass of this vehicle.
Rule.Translated: La masa física de este vehículo.

Rule.Original: The average of all vehicle parts' health. If the integrity of the vehicle reaches 0, it will disintegrate into a fraction of its build cost.
Rule.Raw: The average of all vehicle parts' health. If the integrity of the vehicle reaches 0, it will disintegrate into a fraction of its build cost.
Rule.Translated: El promedio de la salud de todas las partes del vehículo. Si la integridad llega a 0, el vehículo se desintegrará, dejando tras de sí una fracción de los materiales que fueron usados en su construcción.

Rule.Original: The base amount of work it takes to sabotage a vehicle.
Rule.Raw: The base amount of work it takes to sabotage a vehicle.
Rule.Translated: La cantidad base de trabajo que se necesita para sabotear este vehículo.

Rule.Original: A group of traveling people with vehicles.
Rule.Raw: A group of traveling people with vehicles.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo de personas que viajan con vehículos.

Rule.Original: An aerial vehicle capable of flight on the world map.
Rule.Raw: An aerial vehicle capable of flight on the world map.
Rule.Translated: Un vehículo aéreo operativo en el mapa del mundo.

Rule.Original: A recently downed aerial vehicle with possible survivors.
Rule.Raw: A recently downed aerial vehicle with possible survivors.
Rule.Translated: Un vehículo aéreo que se ha estrellado recientemente, con posibles supervivientes.

Rule.Original:
An automated surgery machine that can extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them. The machine will slowly extract genes from the person in it, preferring genes not already stored nearby.

A large amount of nutrition will be consumed while in use.

These more advanced machines are capable of extracting genes from Baseliners, such as "Regular Sleeper" or "Human Hands".

(The speed of the extraction can be changed in the mod settings)
Rule.Raw:
An automated surgery machine that can extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them. The machine will slowly extract genes from the person in it, preferring genes not already stored nearby.

A large amount of nutrition will be consumed while in use.

These more advanced machines are capable of extracting genes from Baseliners, such as "Regular Sleeper" or "Human Hands".

(The speed of the extraction can be changed in the mod settings)
Rule.Translated:
Una máquina de cirugía automática que extrae los genes de una persona y crea un paquete genético con ellos. Lo hace lentamente y da prioridad a los genes que no estén almacenados cerca.

Consume una gran cantidad de nutrientes durante su uso.

Estas máquinas avanzadas pueden extraer genes de humanos estándar, como «Sueño normal» o «Manos humanas».

(La velocidad de extracción puede modificarse en los ajustes del mod).
cuba de extracción de genes arquitas

Rule.Original:
An automated surgery machine that can extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them. The machine will slowly extract genes from the person in it, preferring genes not already stored nearby.

A large amount of nutrition will be consumed while in use.

This version can extract archite genes and extracts slightly faster.

These more advanced machines are capable of extracting genes from Baseliners, such as "Regular Sleeper" or "Human Hands".
Rule.Raw:
An automated surgery machine that can extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them. The machine will slowly extract genes from the person in it, preferring genes not already stored nearby.

A large amount of nutrition will be consumed while in use.

This version can extract archite genes and extracts slightly faster.

These more advanced machines are capable of extracting genes from Baseliners, such as "Regular Sleeper" or "Human Hands".
Rule.Translated:
Una máquina de cirugía automática que extrae los genes de una persona y crea un paquete genético con ellos. Lo hace lentamente y da prioridad a los genes que no estén almacenados cerca.

Consume una gran cantidad de nutrientes durante su uso.

Esta versión puede extraer genes de arquitos y trabaja algo más rápido.

Estas máquinas avanzadas pueden extraer genes de humanos estándar, como «Sueño normal» o «Manos humanas».
cuba de extracción de genes arquitas II

Rule.Original:
An automated surgery machine that can extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them, this version permits targeting specific genes and also operates at 250% of the speed a regular extractor vat, but requires an AI persona core. The machine will slowly extract genes from the person in it, preferring genes not already stored nearby.

A large amount of nutrition will be consumed while in use.

This version can extract archite genes.

These more advanced machines are capable of extracting genes from Baseliners, such as "Regular Sleeper" or "Human Hands"
Rule.Raw:
An automated surgery machine that can extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them, this version permits targeting specific genes and also operates at 250% of the speed a regular extractor vat, but requires an AI persona core. The machine will slowly extract genes from the person in it, preferring genes not already stored nearby.

A large amount of nutrition will be consumed while in use.

This version can extract archite genes.

These more advanced machines are capable of extracting genes from Baseliners, such as "Regular Sleeper" or "Human Hands"
Rule.Translated:
Una máquina de cirugía automática que extrae los genes de una persona y crea un paquete genético con ellos. Esta versión permite elegir genes concretos y funciona al 250% de la velocidad de una cubeta extractora normal, pero requiere un núcleo de personalidad de IA. Extrae los genes lentamente y da prioridad a los que no estén almacenados cerca.

Consume una gran cantidad de nutrientes durante su uso.

Esta versión puede extraer genes de arquitos.

Estas máquinas avanzadas pueden extraer genes de humanos estándar, como «Sueño normal» o «Manos humanas».

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have a normal sleep need.\n\nThis is mostly useful for overriding other sleep genes.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have a normal sleep need.\n\nThis is mostly useful for overriding other sleep genes.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen una necesidad de sueño normal.\n\nSirve sobre todo para anular otros genes de sueño.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have a normal capacity for violence.\n\nThis overrides pacifism and kill-thrist. Does not affect overall temper (e.g. aggressive)
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have a normal capacity for violence.\n\nThis overrides pacifism and kill-thrist. Does not affect overall temper (e.g. aggressive)
Rule.Translated: Quienes tienen este gen poseen una capacidad normal para la violencia.\n\nAnula el pacifismo y la sed de sangre. No afecta al temperamento general, como la agresividad.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have excellent memories and grasp new ideas quickly. They learn faster than others.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have excellent memories and grasp new ideas quickly. They learn faster than others.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen una memoria excelente y asimilan rápido las ideas nuevas. Aprenden más deprisa que los demás.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have normal legs.\n\nThis overrides many genes related to legs and the hips.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have normal legs.\n\nThis overrides many genes related to legs and the hips.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen piernas normales.\n\nEsto anula muchos genes relacionados con las piernas y las caderas.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have a tendency to an average appearance.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have a tendency to an average appearance.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienden a tener un aspecto corriente.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene don't have any particular genetic inclination either for or against hostile behaviour in social situations.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene don't have any particular genetic inclination either for or against hostile behaviour in social situations.
Rule.Translated: Quienes tienen este gen no presentan una inclinación genética particular a favor ni en contra de comportarse de forma hostil en situaciones sociales.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene tend to about the size of a baseline human.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene tend to about the size of a baseline human.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienden a tener un tamaño similar al de un humano estándar.

Rule.Original:
Carriers are just as likely to get addicted to {0} as anyone else.

Gives resistance to overdoses; blame Ludeon for hard-coding that. :p

.
Rule.Raw:
Carriers are just as likely to get addicted to {0} as anyone else.

Gives resistance to overdoses; blame Ludeon for hard-coding that. :p

.
Rule.Translated:
Sus portadores tienen las mismas probabilidades de volverse adictos a {0} que cualquier otra persona.

Proporciona resistencia a las sobredosis; culpa a Ludeon por fijarlo en el código. :p

.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have fairly regular hair.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have fairly regular hair.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen un cabello bastante normal.

Rule.Translated: Este nodo genético del mercado negro da acceso a genes básicos de habilidades de combate. Para construirlo se intercambiarán varios paquetes genéticos como parte del proceso.

Rule.Translated: Este nodo genético del mercado negro contiene una enorme variedad de genes que optimizan el metabolismo a costa de limitar las capacidades mentales. Sin devoluciones.

llevar a la cuba de extracción genética

Rule.Original: "You can't do proper science without breaking a few eggs". No refunds.
Rule.Raw: "You can't do proper science without breaking a few eggs". No refunds.
Rule.Translated: «No se puede hacer ciencia como es debido sin romper unos cuantos huevos». No se admiten devoluciones.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] was chosen at a young age to undergo the trials of the exalted, a brutal training regime that pushes physical and mental fortitude to it's absolute limit. Few survive the trials but for those that do, they emerge as elite crusaders, inquistors or heralds of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] was chosen at a young age to undergo the trials of the exalted, a brutal training regime that pushes physical and mental fortitude to it's absolute limit. Few survive the trials but for those that do, they emerge as elite crusaders, inquistors or heralds of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] fue elegido a una edad temprana para someterse a las pruebas de los exaltados, un régimen de entrenamiento brutal que lleva la resistencia física y mental al límite. Pocos sobreviven, pero quienes lo logran se convierten en cruzados, inquisidores o heraldos de élite de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the trials of the exalted and emerged as a crusader of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the trials of the exalted and emerged as a crusader of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] sobrevivió a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convirtió en cruzado de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the trials of the exalted and emerged as an inquisitor of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the trials of the exalted and emerged as an inquisitor of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] sobrevivió a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convirtió en inquisidor de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the trials of the exalted and emerged as a herald of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the trials of the exalted and emerged as a herald of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] sobrevivió a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convirtió en heraldo de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: Either forcefully initiated or born into the order, these people are iron-clad in their faith and consider it their divine mission to cleanse the realm of what they believe to be corruption. They are highly distrustful of outsiders but not completely without reason, and have been know to form uneasy alliances if they see the benefits of doing so.
Rule.Raw: Either forcefully initiated or born into the order, these people are iron-clad in their faith and consider it their divine mission to cleanse the realm of what they believe to be corruption. They are highly distrustful of outsiders but not completely without reason, and have been know to form uneasy alliances if they see the benefits of doing so.
Rule.Translated: Ya sea porque nacieron en la orden o porque fueron iniciados a la fuerza, estas personas tienen una fe inquebrantable y consideran su misión divina limpiar el mundo de lo que creen que es corrupción. Desconfían mucho de los forasteros, aunque no carecen por completo de razón y pueden formar alianzas incómodas si ven ventajas en ello.

Rule.Original: A small group of defectors fleeing the Divine Order.
Rule.Raw: A small group of defectors fleeing the Divine Order.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño grupo de desertores que huye de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: Learn to craft basic arms, armor and apparel of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: Learn to craft basic arms, armor and apparel of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a fabricar armas, armaduras y prendas básicas de la Orden Divina.
armadura de élite de la orden divina

Rule.Original: Learn to craft the powerful armor of crusaders, inquisitors and heralds of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: Learn to craft the powerful armor of crusaders, inquisitors and heralds of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a fabricar las poderosas armaduras de los cruzados, inquisidores y heraldos de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: Learn to craft the staff of divine judgement, the ultimate weapon of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: Learn to craft the staff of divine judgement, the ultimate weapon of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a fabricar el báculo del juicio divino, el arma definitiva de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original:
Formerly initiates of the Divine Order, the four of you have defected and have been on the run for what feels like weeks.

Supplies are running low, you only have some basic equipment and a single horse but the one saving grace is that you still have it.. a sacred tablet, that which is revered by the order so much. It could probably fetch a tidy sum from the right buyer or perhaps you could keep it and try to uncover its secrets.

Either way, you can't keep running forever. This is as good a place as any to settle and prepare to face the challenges to come. It won't be easy, but with hope and grit you might just be able to forge a new life for yourselves.

Only one thing is certain, eventually the order will find you and they will not show mercy.

You must be ready.

Rule.Translated:
Los cuatro erais iniciados de la Orden Divina, pero habéis desertado y lleváis huyendo lo que parecen semanas.

Las provisiones escasean y solo tenéis equipo básico y un caballo. Sin embargo, aún conserváis vuestra salvación: una tablilla sagrada, aquello que la orden tanto venera. Probablemente podríais venderla por una buena suma al comprador adecuado, o quizá conservarla e intentar descubrir sus secretos.

En cualquier caso, no podéis huir para siempre. Este lugar es tan bueno como cualquier otro para estableceros y prepararos para los desafíos que vendrán. No será fácil, pero con esperanza y determinación quizá podáis forjar una nueva vida.

Solo hay algo seguro: la orden terminará encontrándoos y no tendrá piedad.

Debéis estar preparados.

Rule.Original: Four defectors on the run from the Divine Order.
Rule.Raw: Four defectors on the run from the Divine Order.
Rule.Translated: Cuatro desertores huyen de la Orden Divina.
