Rule.Original: A banner displaying the insignia of the Divine Order.
Rule.Raw: A banner displaying the insignia of the Divine Order.
Rule.Translated: Un estandarte que muestra la insignia de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: A decorative pedestal displaying a sacred tablet.
Rule.Raw: A decorative pedestal displaying a sacred tablet.
Rule.Translated: Un pedestal decorativo que exhibe una tablilla sagrada.

Rule.Original: A horse of the divine order. Bred to be larger, stronger and faster than a common horse.\n\nWhen in a caravan, people can ride horses to increase the caravan's speed.
Rule.Raw: A horse of the divine order. Bred to be larger, stronger and faster than a common horse.\n\nWhen in a caravan, people can ride horses to increase the caravan's speed.
Rule.Translated: Un caballo de la Orden Divina, criado para ser más grande, fuerte y rápido que uno común.\n\nEn una caravana, las personas pueden montar a caballo para aumentar la velocidad del grupo.

Rule.Original: A sacred stone tablet revered by the Divine Order. It is believed to have been blessed by the gods and is used in the forging of powerful equipment.
Rule.Raw: A sacred stone tablet revered by the Divine Order. It is believed to have been blessed by the gods and is used in the forging of powerful equipment.
Rule.Translated: Una tablilla de piedra sagrada venerada por la Orden Divina. Se cree que ha recibido la bendición de los dioses y se utiliza para forjar equipo poderoso.

Rule.Original: A thick cloak made from fabric or leather.\n\nIt is usually worn over other clothes, offers a small amount of physical protection aswell as some protection from the elements.
Rule.Raw: A thick cloak made from fabric or leather.\n\nIt is usually worn over other clothes, offers a small amount of physical protection aswell as some protection from the elements.
Rule.Translated: Una capa gruesa de tela o cuero.\n\nSuele llevarse sobre otras prendas y ofrece algo de protección física y contra los elementos.
capa de piel de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A long, fur lined cloak. It offers a small amount of physical protection and insulates from the cold very well.
Rule.Raw: A long, fur lined cloak. It offers a small amount of physical protection and insulates from the cold very well.
Rule.Translated: Una capa larga forrada de piel. Ofrece algo de protección física y aísla muy bien del frío.
túnica de fanático de la orden divina

Rule.Original: Gold adorned robes worn by zealots of the Divine Order. It offers a small amount of physical protection, insulates well and slightly improves the casting ability of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: Gold adorned robes worn by zealots of the Divine Order. It offers a small amount of physical protection, insulates well and slightly improves the casting ability of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Túnicas adornadas con oro que llevan los fanáticos de la Orden Divina. Ofrecen algo de protección física, buen aislamiento y una ligera mejora de la capacidad de lanzar hechizos.

Rule.Original: A thick hood made from fabric or leather.\n\nIt offers a small amount of physical protection aswell as some protection from the elements.
Rule.Raw: A thick hood made from fabric or leather.\n\nIt offers a small amount of physical protection aswell as some protection from the elements.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha gruesa de tela o cuero.\n\nOfrece algo de protección física y contra los elementos.
capucha de piel de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A thick, fur lined hood.\n\nIt offers a small amount of physical protection and insulates from the cold very well.
Rule.Raw: A thick, fur lined hood.\n\nIt offers a small amount of physical protection and insulates from the cold very well.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha gruesa forrada de piel.\n\nOfrece algo de protección física y aísla muy bien del frío.
sombrero de mercader de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A fancy hat adorned with jewellery, favoured by merchants of the divine order.\n\nIt provides a boost to buying and selling prices when trading.
Rule.Raw: A fancy hat adorned with jewellery, favoured by merchants of the divine order.\n\nIt provides a boost to buying and selling prices when trading.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero elegante adornado con joyas, apreciado por los comerciantes de la Orden Divina.\n\nMejora los precios de compra y venta al comerciar.

Rule.Original: A thick, padded tunic made from cloth or leather.\n\nIt can be worn on its own or under armor and provides a good amount of insulation against the cold.
Rule.Raw: A thick, padded tunic made from cloth or leather.\n\nIt can be worn on its own or under armor and provides a good amount of insulation against the cold.
Rule.Translated: Una túnica gruesa y acolchada de tela o cuero.\n\nPuede llevarse sola o bajo una armadura y ofrece un buen aislamiento contra el frío.

Rule.Original: A pair of thick, padded breeches made from fabric or leather. They insulate well against the cold.
Rule.Raw: A pair of thick, padded breeches made from fabric or leather. They insulate well against the cold.
Rule.Translated: Unos calzones gruesos y acolchados de tela o cuero. Aíslan bien del frío.
casco de placas de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A sturdy, well made plate helmet forged in the style of the divine order that covers the whole head.\n\n It provides generous protection against sharp attacks but is ineffective against blunt weapons and restricts the wearer's field of vision.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy, well made plate helmet forged in the style of the divine order that covers the whole head.\n\n It provides generous protection against sharp attacks but is ineffective against blunt weapons and restricts the wearer's field of vision.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de placas resistente y bien fabricado, forjado al estilo de la Orden Divina, que cubre toda la cabeza.\n\nOfrece una buena protección contra ataques cortantes, pero es ineficaz contra armas contundentes y limita el campo de visión.
casco ligero de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A light plate helmet forged in the style of the divine order.\n\nIt doesn't offer as much protection as a full helmet and leaves the lower head exposed but requires less resources to craft and doesn't restrict vision.
Rule.Raw: A light plate helmet forged in the style of the divine order.\n\nIt doesn't offer as much protection as a full helmet and leaves the lower head exposed but requires less resources to craft and doesn't restrict vision.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de placas ligero forjado al estilo de la Orden Divina.\n\nProtege menos que un casco completo y deja expuesta la parte inferior de la cabeza, pero requiere menos recursos y no limita la visión.
casco abierto de la orden divina

Rule.Original: An open-faced plate helmet forged in the style of the divine order.\n\nIt offers a generous amount of protection and doesn't restrict vision but leaves the lower face exposed.
Rule.Raw: An open-faced plate helmet forged in the style of the divine order.\n\nIt offers a generous amount of protection and doesn't restrict vision but leaves the lower face exposed.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de placas abierto forjado al estilo de la Orden Divina.\n\nOfrece una buena protección sin limitar la visión, pero deja expuesta la parte inferior del rostro.
armadura de placas de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A full set of heavy plate armor forged in the style of the divine order.\n\nCovers the entire body and has an inner cloth lining, providing a substantial amount of protection and some insulation from the cold but slows the wearer down.
Rule.Raw: A full set of heavy plate armor forged in the style of the divine order.\n\nCovers the entire body and has an inner cloth lining, providing a substantial amount of protection and some insulation from the cold but slows the wearer down.
Rule.Translated: Un conjunto completo de armadura de placas pesada forjado al estilo de la Orden Divina.\n\nCubre todo el cuerpo e incorpora un forro de tela que ofrece mucha protección y cierto aislamiento contra el frío, aunque ralentiza al usuario.

Rule.Original: A sturdy, metal breastplate that can be worn underneath cloaks and similar apparel.\n\nIt only provides protection to the torso and slows the wearer down slightly.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy, metal breastplate that can be worn underneath cloaks and similar apparel.\n\nIt only provides protection to the torso and slows the wearer down slightly.
Rule.Translated: Un peto metálico resistente que puede llevarse bajo capas y prendas similares.\n\nSolo protege el torso y ralentiza ligeramente al usuario.
casco con capucha de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A thick leather cowl covered by a light helmet.\n\nIt offers a decent amount of protection and insulation without impeding head movement or vision.
Rule.Raw: A thick leather cowl covered by a light helmet.\n\nIt offers a decent amount of protection and insulation without impeding head movement or vision.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha gruesa de cuero cubierta por un casco ligero.\n\nOfrece una protección y un aislamiento aceptables sin dificultar el movimiento de la cabeza ni la visión.

Rule.Original: Thick leather armor covered by a light breastplate.\n\nIt offers decent protection whilst allowing the wearer to remain light on their feet and provides a generous amount of insulation from both cold and heat.
Rule.Raw: Thick leather armor covered by a light breastplate.\n\nIt offers decent protection whilst allowing the wearer to remain light on their feet and provides a generous amount of insulation from both cold and heat.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura de cuero grueso cubierta por un peto ligero.\n\nOfrece una protección aceptable sin restar agilidad, además de un buen aislamiento frente al frío y al calor.

Rule.Original: An exquisite plate helmet draped in runeweave, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Crusaders of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this helmet has received a blessing and will improve the melee proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: An exquisite plate helmet draped in runeweave, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Crusaders of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this helmet has received a blessing and will improve the melee proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Un exquisito casco de placas cubierto de tejido rúnico, concedido a quienes sobreviven a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convierten en cruzados de la Orden Divina.\n\nGracias al poder de una tablilla sagrada, este casco ha recibido una bendición que mejora la habilidad del usuario en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: An exquisite set of armor draped in runeweave, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Crusaders of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this armor has received a blessing and will improve the melee proficiency of the wearer.

Rule.Translated: Un exquisito conjunto de armadura cubierto de tejido rúnico, concedido a quienes sobreviven a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convierten en cruzados de la Orden Divina.\n\nGracias al poder de una tablilla sagrada, esta armadura ha recibido una bendición que mejora la habilidad del usuario en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A finely crafted leather hat adorned with gold, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Inquisitors of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this hat has received a blessing and will improve the shooting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: A finely crafted leather hat adorned with gold, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Inquisitors of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this hat has received a blessing and will improve the shooting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero de cuero de fina elaboración adornado con oro, concedido a quienes sobreviven a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convierten en inquisidores de la Orden Divina.\n\nGracias al poder de una tablilla sagrada, este sombrero ha recibido una bendición que mejora la habilidad de disparo del usuario.

Rule.Original: Finely crafted leather armor adorned with gold, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Inquisitors of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this armor has received a blessing and will improve the shooting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: Finely crafted leather armor adorned with gold, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Inquisitors of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this armor has received a blessing and will improve the shooting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura de cuero de fina elaboración adornada con oro, concedida a quienes sobreviven a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convierten en inquisidores de la Orden Divina.\n\nGracias al poder de una tablilla sagrada, esta armadura ha recibido una bendición que mejora la habilidad de disparo del usuario.

Rule.Original: A gold-trimmed cloak often worn by inquisitors of the divine order.
Rule.Raw: A gold-trimmed cloak often worn by inquisitors of the divine order.
Rule.Translated: Una capa con ribetes dorados que suelen llevar los inquisidores de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: An ornate plate helmet lined with runeweave, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Heralds of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this helmet has recieved a blessing and will improve the casting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: An ornate plate helmet lined with runeweave, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Heralds of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, this helmet has recieved a blessing and will improve the casting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de placas ornamentado y forrado de tejido rúnico, concedido a quienes sobreviven a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convierten en heraldos de la Orden Divina.\n\nGracias al poder de una tablilla sagrada, este casco ha recibido una bendición que mejora la capacidad del usuario para lanzar hechizos.

Rule.Original: Sturdy armor covered by heavy ceremonial robes, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Heralds of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, these robes have received a blessing and will improve the casting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: Sturdy armor covered by heavy ceremonial robes, bestowed upon those that survive the trails of the exalted and become Heralds of the divine order.\n\nBy the power of a sacred tablet, these robes have received a blessing and will improve the casting proficiency of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura resistente cubierta por pesadas túnicas ceremoniales, concedida a quienes sobreviven a las pruebas de los exaltados y se convierten en heraldos de la Orden Divina.\n\nGracias al poder de una tablilla sagrada, estas túnicas han recibido una bendición que mejora la capacidad del usuario para lanzar hechizos.

Rule.Original: A sturdy, reinforced shield that bears the insignia of the Divine Order.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy, reinforced shield that bears the insignia of the Divine Order.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo robusto y reforzado con la insignia de la Orden Divina.

Rule.Original: A sturdy mace forged in the style of the Divine Order, it inflicts blunt damage which is effective against armored foes.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy mace forged in the style of the Divine Order, it inflicts blunt damage which is effective against armored foes.
Rule.Translated: Una maza robusta forjada al estilo de la Orden Divina. Inflige daño contundente, eficaz contra enemigos acorazados.
espada corta de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A shortsword forged in the style of the Divine order. It is light and easy to handle, making it an ideal weapon for nobles and commoners.
Rule.Raw: A shortsword forged in the style of the Divine order. It is light and easy to handle, making it an ideal weapon for nobles and commoners.
Rule.Translated: Una espada corta forjada al estilo de la Orden Divina. Es ligera y fácil de manejar, por lo que resulta ideal tanto para nobles como para plebeyos.
espada larga de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A fine longsword forged in the style of the Divine order, a balanced weapon capable of slashing or stabbing.
Rule.Raw: A fine longsword forged in the style of the Divine order, a balanced weapon capable of slashing or stabbing.
Rule.Translated: Una buena espada larga forjada al estilo de la Orden Divina: un arma equilibrada capaz de cortar o apuñalar.
estandarte de batalla de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A long pike that bears the flag of the divine order. It is usually held high by standard bearers when marching into battle but is also an effective melee weapon, capable of delivering deadly thrusts from range.
Rule.Raw: A long pike that bears the flag of the divine order. It is usually held high by standard bearers when marching into battle but is also an effective melee weapon, capable of delivering deadly thrusts from range.
Rule.Translated: Una larga pica que lleva la bandera de la Orden Divina. Los abanderados suelen alzarla al marchar a la batalla, pero también es un arma eficaz capaz de asestar estocadas letales desde cierta distancia.
martillo de guerra de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A large, two handed warhammer forged in the style of the Divine order. It can deliver crushing, blunt strikes that are very effective against armored foes.
Rule.Raw: A large, two handed warhammer forged in the style of the Divine order. It can deliver crushing, blunt strikes that are very effective against armored foes.
Rule.Translated: Un gran martillo de guerra a dos manos forjado al estilo de la Orden Divina. Sus golpes aplastantes y contundentes son muy eficaces contra enemigos acorazados.

Rule.Original: A large, two handed greatsword forged in the style of the Divine order. It is slow to swing but in skilled hands it can deliver deadly, sweeping slashes.
Rule.Raw: A large, two handed greatsword forged in the style of the Divine order. It is slow to swing but in skilled hands it can deliver deadly, sweeping slashes.
Rule.Translated: Un gran mandoble a dos manos forjado al estilo de la Orden Divina. Es lento de blandir, pero en manos expertas puede asestar amplios tajos letales.

Rule.Original: An ornate pistol with a flintlock firing mechanism. It fires a powerful shot that can pierce most conventional armor but is slow to reload.
Rule.Raw: An ornate pistol with a flintlock firing mechanism. It fires a powerful shot that can pierce most conventional armor but is slow to reload.
Rule.Translated: Una pistola ornamentada con un mecanismo de chispa. Dispara un potente proyectil capaz de atravesar la mayoría de las armaduras convencionales, pero tarda en recargarse.

Rule.Original: A crossbow forged in the style of the Divine Order. It is easier to use than a bow and is capable of piercing armor but is slower to re-arm.
Rule.Raw: A crossbow forged in the style of the Divine Order. It is easier to use than a bow and is capable of piercing armor but is slower to re-arm.
Rule.Translated: Una ballesta forjada al estilo de la Orden Divina. Es más fácil de utilizar que un arco y puede perforar armaduras, pero tarda más en volver a tensarse.
ballesta de mano de la orden divina

Rule.Original: A small crossbow designed to be held in one hand. It has less range and damage than a regular crossbow but has a faster fire rate.
Rule.Raw: A small crossbow designed to be held in one hand. It has less range and damage than a regular crossbow but has a faster fire rate.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña ballesta diseñada para utilizarse con una mano. Tiene menos alcance y causa menos daños que una normal, pero dispara más deprisa.

Rule.Original: An unstable alchemical concoction within a sealed container. It can be ignited and thrown to produce a searing blast of light after a few seconds, burning and temporarily blinding those caught in the blast.\n\nWithin the divine order, use of this concoction is the primary way of "cleansing" what they deem to be corruption. As such, the method of creating it is a closely guarded secret.
Rule.Raw: An unstable alchemical concoction within a sealed container. It can be ignited and thrown to produce a searing blast of light after a few seconds, burning and temporarily blinding those caught in the blast.\n\nWithin the divine order, use of this concoction is the primary way of "cleansing" what they deem to be corruption. As such, the method of creating it is a closely guarded secret.
Rule.Translated: Un preparado alquímico inestable dentro de un recipiente sellado. Puede encenderse y lanzarse para producir, tras unos segundos, una explosión de luz abrasadora que quema y ciega temporalmente a quienes alcanza.\n\nLa Orden Divina utiliza este preparado como principal método para «purificar» lo que considera corrupción. Por ello, su fabricación es un secreto celosamente guardado.

Rule.Original: Exposure to the blinding light has caused temporary impaired vision.
Rule.Raw: Exposure to the blinding light has caused temporary impaired vision.
Rule.Translated: La exposición a la luz cegadora ha provocado una pérdida temporal de visión.

Rule.Original: The ultimate weapon of the Divine order. A grand, ornate staff that radiates divine power.\n\nWielding this staff grants the ability to call upon the power of the gods to deliver divine judgement, devastating an area with cleansing light.
Rule.Raw: The ultimate weapon of the Divine order. A grand, ornate staff that radiates divine power.\n\nWielding this staff grants the ability to call upon the power of the gods to deliver divine judgement, devastating an area with cleansing light.
Rule.Translated: El arma definitiva de la Orden Divina: un gran bastón ornamentado que irradia poder divino.\n\nPermite invocar el poder de los dioses para impartir el juicio divino y devastar una zona con luz purificadora.

Rule.Original: {0} has been incinerated by divine light.
Rule.Raw: {0} has been incinerated by divine light.
Rule.Translated: La luz divina ha incinerado a {0}.

Rule.Original: Either forcefully initiated or born into the order, these people are iron-clad in their faith and consider it their divine mission to cleanse the realm of what they believe to be corruption. They are highly distrustful of outsiders but not completely without reason, and have been know to form uneasy alliances if they see the benefits of doing so.
Rule.Raw: Either forcefully initiated or born into the order, these people are iron-clad in their faith and consider it their divine mission to cleanse the realm of what they believe to be corruption. They are highly distrustful of outsiders but not completely without reason, and have been know to form uneasy alliances if they see the benefits of doing so.
Rule.Translated: Ya sea porque nacieron en la orden o porque fueron iniciados a la fuerza, estas personas tienen una fe inquebrantable y consideran su misión divina limpiar el mundo de lo que creen que es corrupción. Desconfían mucho de los forasteros, aunque no carecen por completo de razón y pueden formar alianzas incómodas si ven ventajas en ello.

Rule.Original: A small image of what you are trading.
Rule.Raw: A small image of what you are trading.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña imagen de lo que estás comerciando.

Rule.Original: Button to open the info window.
Rule.Raw: Button to open the info window.
Rule.Translated: Botón para abrir la ventana de información.

Rule.Original: Additional icons shown in different situations.
Rule.Raw: Additional icons shown in different situations.
Rule.Translated: Iconos adicionales que aparecen en distintas situaciones.

Rule.Original: Quantity available for buying or selling.
Rule.Raw: Quantity available for buying or selling.
Rule.Translated: Cantidad disponible para comprar o vender.

Rule.Original: Numeric box where the current quantity bought or sold is shown and can be entered manually.
Rule.Raw: Numeric box where the current quantity bought or sold is shown and can be entered manually.
Rule.Translated: Casilla numérica que muestra la cantidad comprada o vendida y permite introducirla manualmente.

Rule.Original: Buttons used to increment or decrement the amount bought or sold.\nClicking the double arrow buttons will increase to most affordable by either party on first click and then to max quantity if clicked again. Hold shift to skip.
Rule.Raw: Buttons used to increment or decrement the amount bought or sold.\nClicking the double arrow buttons will increase to most affordable by either party on first click and then to max quantity if clicked again. Hold shift to skip.
Rule.Translated: Botones para aumentar o reducir la cantidad comprada o vendida.\nEl primer clic en los botones de doble flecha selecciona la mayor cantidad que puede pagar cualquiera de las partes; otro clic selecciona la cantidad máxima. Mantén pulsado shift para saltarte el paso intermedio.

Rule.Original: Shows the remaining hitpoints (if any) as a percentage.
Rule.Raw: Shows the remaining hitpoints (if any) as a percentage.
Rule.Translated: Muestra los puntos de vida restantes, si los hay, como porcentaje.

Rule.Original: Shows the price divided by mass.
Rule.Raw: Shows the price divided by mass.
Rule.Translated: Muestra el precio dividido entre la masa.

Rule.Original: A faster read-only version of the counter box where the current quantity bought or sold is shown.
Rule.Raw: A faster read-only version of the counter box where the current quantity bought or sold is shown.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más rápida y de solo lectura de la casilla que muestra la cantidad comprada o vendida.

Rule.Original: Shows the main category of the thing.
Rule.Raw: Shows the main category of the thing.
Rule.Translated: Muestra la categoría principal del objeto.

Rule.Original: Shows the quality of the thing.
Rule.Raw: Shows the quality of the thing.

Rule.Original: A table full of sharp blades. Increases work speed when placed near a butcher table.
Rule.Raw: A table full of sharp blades. Increases work speed when placed near a butcher table.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa llena de hojas afiladas. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de carnicería.

Rule.Original: A table equipped with blunt tools used to break stones more easily. Increases work speed when placed near a stonecutting bench.
Rule.Raw: A table equipped with blunt tools used to break stones more easily. Increases work speed when placed near a stonecutting bench.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa equipada con herramientas contundentes para romper piedra con mayor facilidad. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de cantería.

Rule.Original: A table supplying all the necessary tools to ease up the tailoring process. Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring table.
Rule.Raw: A table supplying all the necessary tools to ease up the tailoring process. Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring table.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa con todas las herramientas necesarias para facilitar el trabajo de sastrería. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de sastre.

Rule.Original: A wooden barrel used to help mix hops together to create wort. Increases work speed when placed near a brewery.
Rule.Raw: A wooden barrel used to help mix hops together to create wort. Increases work speed when placed near a brewery.
Rule.Translated: Un barril de madera utilizado para mezclar lúpulo y preparar mosto. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una cervecería.

Rule.Original: A tool with a heavy head mounted on a handle used for construction.
Rule.Raw: A tool with a heavy head mounted on a handle used for construction.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta con una cabeza pesada montada sobre un mango, utilizada en trabajos de construcción.

Rule.Original: A crude medical tool constitued of a sharp toothed blade often used to hack off infected limbs.
Rule.Raw: A crude medical tool constitued of a sharp toothed blade often used to hack off infected limbs.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta médica rudimentaria formada por una hoja dentada y afilada, utilizada con frecuencia para amputar extremidades infectadas.

Rule.Original: A heavy tool with a sharp t-shaped head used to break stones with ease.”
Rule.Raw: A heavy tool with a sharp t-shaped head used to break stones with ease.”
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta pesada con una cabeza afilada en forma de T utilizada para romper piedra con facilidad.

Rule.Original: A tool with a large blade used to chop meat and bones more efficiently.
Rule.Raw: A tool with a large blade used to chop meat and bones more efficiently.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta de hoja grande utilizada para cortar carne y huesos con mayor eficacia.

Rule.Original: A tool with a long sharp curved blade and a two handed handle used to reap fields.
Rule.Raw: A tool with a long sharp curved blade and a two handed handle used to reap fields.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta con una hoja larga, curva y afilada y un mango para ambas manos, utilizada para segar campos.

Rule.Original: A brush made out of dried grass tied to a wooden handle used as a simple but effective cleaning tool.
Rule.Raw: A brush made out of dried grass tied to a wooden handle used as a simple but effective cleaning tool.
Rule.Translated: Un cepillo hecho con hierba seca atada a un mango de madera. Una herramienta de limpieza sencilla pero eficaz.

Rule.Original: A wooden mace with metallic reinforcements designed to cause concussions and keep prisoners at bay.
Rule.Raw: A wooden mace with metallic reinforcements designed to cause concussions and keep prisoners at bay.
Rule.Translated: Una porra de madera con refuerzos metálicos diseñada para causar conmociones y mantener a raya a los prisioneros.

Rule.Original: This person is driving a human-powered vehicle, and therefore getting very tired.
Rule.Raw: This person is driving a human-powered vehicle, and therefore getting very tired.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona conduce un vehículo de propulsión humana y, por tanto, se está cansando mucho.

Rule.Original: This person is being carried in a luxurious vehicle, making them well rested and content.
Rule.Raw: This person is being carried in a luxurious vehicle, making them well rested and content.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona viaja en un vehículo lujoso, lo que le permite descansar bien y estar contenta.

Rule.Original: A lighter-than-air aircraft consisting of a bag, called an envelope, which contains heated air. Suspended beneath is a wicker basket which carries passengers and a source of heat.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
Rule.Raw: A lighter-than-air aircraft consisting of a bag, called an envelope, which contains heated air. Suspended beneath is a wicker basket which carries passengers and a source of heat.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
Rule.Translated: Una aeronave más ligera que el aire, formada por una bolsa llamada envolvente que contiene aire caliente. Debajo cuelga una cesta de mimbre que lleva a los pasajeros y la fuente de calor.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x1

Rule.Original:
A lighter-than-air aircraft consisting of a bag, called an envelope, which contains heated air. Suspended beneath is a wicker basket which carries passengers and a source of heat.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Wood

<color=#bb8f04>Pedantry PSA:</color> I know hot air balloons don't use ballast. I don't care, it looks cool. Plus this one uses hot Helixien gas instead of air, and since I made it up I make up the rules too!
Rule.Raw:
A lighter-than-air aircraft consisting of a bag, called an envelope, which contains heated air. Suspended beneath is a wicker basket which carries passengers and a source of heat.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Wood

<color=#bb8f04>Pedantry PSA:</color> I know hot air balloons don't use ballast. I don't care, it looks cool. Plus this one uses hot Helixien gas instead of air, and since I made it up I make up the rules too!
Rule.Translated:
Una aeronave más ligera que el aire, formada por una bolsa llamada envolvente que contiene aire caliente. Debajo cuelga una cesta de mimbre que lleva a los pasajeros y la fuente de calor.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x1
<color=#bb8f04>Combustible:</color> Madera

<color=#bb8f04>Aviso para pedantes:</color> Sé que los globos aerostáticos no utilizan lastre. Me da igual, queda genial. Además, este usa gas Helixien caliente en lugar de aire y, como me lo he inventado, ¡también me invento las reglas!

Rule.Original:
A simple horse-driven cart that provides fast transportation. The chariot is outrageously bad for offroading, so you'll need some roads between your origin and your destination for it to be really effective.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Hay

Un sencillo carro tirado por un caballo que permite viajar deprisa. Es pésimo fuera de los caminos, así que necesitarás carreteras entre el origen y el destino para que sea realmente eficaz.

A horse-drawn four-wheeled vehicle used to transport people. This particular carriage uses leather strapping suspension, making it more comfortable than otherwise. Can fit three passengers, plus the driver.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x3
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Hay

A sled pulled by four trained dogs used to travel over ice and through snow. Absolutely terrible for anything else.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Kibble

Rule.Original:
A primitive type of artillery designed to fire multiple rocket-powered iron-tipped arrows at once. The Hwacha consists of a wooden frame with a series of iron tubes mounted on top, which can hold up to 200 arrows. When fired, the Hwacha creates a very inaccurate barrage of projectiles that can inflict significant damage to enemy fortifications and troops.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1

<color=#bb8f04>Human-powered:</color> Driver will get 50% more tired and hungry while driving this vehicle.
Rule.Raw:
A primitive type of artillery designed to fire multiple rocket-powered iron-tipped arrows at once. The Hwacha consists of a wooden frame with a series of iron tubes mounted on top, which can hold up to 200 arrows. When fired, the Hwacha creates a very inaccurate barrage of projectiles that can inflict significant damage to enemy fortifications and troops.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1

<color=#bb8f04>Human-powered:</color> Driver will get 50% more tired and hungry while driving this vehicle.
Rule.Translated:
Un tipo primitivo de artillería diseñado para disparar simultáneamente múltiples flechas con punta de hierro propulsadas por cohetes. El Hwacha consta de un armazón de madera con tubos de hierro que pueden alojar hasta 200 flechas. Al disparar, crea una andanada muy imprecisa capaz de causar daños considerables a las fortificaciones y tropas enemigas.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1

<color=#bb8f04>Propulsión humana:</color> El conductor acumula un 50% más de cansancio y hambre al manejar este vehículo.

Rule.Original: A devastating barrage of explosive arrows that can inflict significant damage to enemy fortifications and troops... if it hits.

Rule.Original: A watercraft featuring a lateral support float known as an outrigger, which is fastened to one of the sides of the main hull. An outrigger generates stability as a result of the distance between its hulls rather than due to the shape of each individual hull. As such, the hulls of outrigger boats are typically longer, narrower and more hydrodynamically efficient.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1

An outrigger generates stability as a result of the distance between its hulls rather than due to the shape of each individual hull. As such, the hulls of outrigger boats are typically longer, narrower and more hydrodynamically efficient.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
Rule.Translated: Una embarcación con un flotador de apoyo lateral sujeto a un lado del casco principal. Su estabilidad depende de la distancia entre los cascos, en lugar de la forma de cada uno. Por ello, los cascos de estas embarcaciones suelen ser más largos, estrechos y eficientes hidrodinámicamente.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x1

A two wheeled cart pulled by oxen. A means of transportation used since ancient times, the ox cart is generally used to carry goods, such as agrarian produce or lumber. Terrible outside roads.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Hay

A mode of human-powered transport by which a runner draws a two-wheeled cart which seats another person. Not very comfortable, at least for one of them...

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1

<color=#bb8f04>Human-powered:</color> Driver will get 50% more tired and hungry while driving this vehicle.

Rule.Translated:
Un transporte de propulsión humana en el que una persona tira de un carro de dos ruedas donde viaja otra. No es demasiado cómodo, al menos para una de ellas...

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x1

<color=#bb8f04>Propulsión humana:</color> El conductor acumula un 50% más de cansancio y hambre al manejar este vehículo.

Rule.Original:
A mode of human-powered transport by which a runner draws a two-wheeled cart which seats another person. Not very comfortable, at least for one of them...

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1

<color=#bb8f04>Human-powered:</color> Driver will get 50% more tired and hungry while driving this vehicle.

Rule.Original: A small, manually powered boat propelled by oars. Typically designed for calm waters like lakes and rivers, it has a sturdy, flat-bottomed hull for stability.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1
Rule.Raw: A small, manually powered boat propelled by oars. Typically designed for calm waters like lakes and rivers, it has a sturdy, flat-bottomed hull for stability.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1

Rule.Original: A small, manually powered boat propelled by oars. Typically designed for calm waters like lakes and rivers, it has a sturdy, flat-bottomed hull for stability. Mostly useless in open waters.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1

Es prácticamente inútil en aguas abiertas.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1

Rule.Original:
The war chariot is a mobile archery platform operated by two people, with the driver steering the chariot with his reins while the main archer aims his bow and arrow at any targets within range.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Archer x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Hay

Rule.Original:
The wheelbarrow: Your trusty sidekick for moving stuff from 'point A' to 'point B' with all the pizzazz of a one-wheel parade float.

Look, this is just a wheelbarrow. It will allow people to carry things. Yep. That's it.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1

<color=#bb8f04>Human-powered:</color> Driver will get 50% more tired and hungry while driving this vehicle.

Rule.Original:
A tracked, armoured fighting vehicle, the Badger is designed to transport scouts and infantry while providing covering fire to suppress enemy troops. Reinforced side armour plating, ability to deploy blindsmoke and a powerful anti-infantry automated gun make it a powerful vehicle in small combat engagement. It’s relatively vulnerable to attacks from behind, and the short range of the turret means it is outclassed by most designated tanks.

Compared to previous generations, this IFV is designed to quickly drop infantry off at a desired location and provide light covering fire. Lack of armor piercing on fired projectiles make it weak against enemy tanks.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Passenger x4
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw:

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Passenger x4

Rule.Translated:
El Tejón, un vehículo blindado de combate sobre orugas, está diseñado para transportar exploradores e infantería al tiempo que proporciona fuego de cobertura para reprimir a las tropas enemigas. El blindaje lateral reforzado, la capacidad de desplegar humo de covertura y un potente cañón automático anti-infantería lo convierten en un vehículo poderoso en combates a pequeña escala. Es relativamente vulnerable a los ataques por la retaguardia, y el corto alcance de la torreta hace que sea superado por la mayoría de los tanques designados.

En comparación con las generaciones anteriores, este vehículo de combate está diseñado para llevar rápidamente a la infantería hacia el lugar deseado y proporcionar fuego ligero de cobertura. La falta de perforación de los proyectiles disparados lo hace débil frente a tanques enemigos.

<color=#bb8f04>nTripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Artillero x1, Pasajero x4
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: A powerful turret mounted on a Badger Infantry Fighting Vehicle. Its explosive shots deal significant damage to enemy infantry, but it’s low armor-piercing makes it subpar against armored targets, and it uses up a lot of ammo.
Rule.Raw: A powerful turret mounted on a Badger Infantry Fighting Vehicle. Its explosive shots deal significant damage to enemy infantry, but it’s low armor-piercing makes it subpar against armored targets, and it uses up a lot of ammo.
Rule.Translated: Una potente torreta montada sobre un vehículo de combate anti-infantería Tejón. Sus disparos explosivos infligen un daño considerable a la infantería enemiga, pero su baja perforación de blindaje hace que sea inferior contra objetivos blindados, desperdiciando munición.

Rule.Original:
A dedicated cargo transporter, the Big Rig is the epitome of bulk material transportation. While best suited on flat roads, it still has a powerful enough engine to effectively charge through difficult terrain.

A surprisingly quick, gas-guzzling cargo transporter that has terrible acceleration, but very little can slow it down once it gets up to speed.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1

Rule.Translated:
El camión de transporte, un vehículo de carga especializado, es la personificación del transporte de materiales a granel. Aunque se adapta mejor a las carreteras llanas, cuenta con un motor lo suficientemente potente como para atravesar con eficacia terrenos difíciles.

Se trata de un vehículo de carga sorprendentemente rápido, que consume mucho combustible y tiene una aceleración terrible, pero casi nada puede frenarlo una vez que alcanza cierta velocidad.

Rule.Original:
A dedicated multiple launch rocket system platform, the Burya is a long-range siege and area denial weapon that can be operated by a two-man crew for faster loading speeds. Capable of firing continuous volleys of long range missiles, Burya can blanket whole areas in anti-infantry rocket explosions.

Slow-moving and vulnerable to enemy fire, Burya needs to deploy before it can open fire, which may leave it stranded in enemy territory.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw:

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Translated:
El Burya, una plataforma de lanzamiento móvil de cohetes, es un arma de asedio y negación de área de largo alcance que puede ser operada por una tripulación de dos hombres para velocidades de carga más rápidas. Capaz de disparar salvas continuas de misiles de largo alcance, el Burya puede cubrir zonas enteras con explosiones de cohetes antiinfantería.

Aparte de ser lento y vulnerable al fuego enemigo, necesita ser desplegado antes de poder abrir fuego, por lo que puede quedarse varado en territorio enemigo si no se tiene demasiado cuidado.

Tripulación:<color=#bb8f04>Conductor x1, Artillero x2
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: A powerful multiple launch rocket system usually mounted on Burya, capable of firing powerful barrages of rockets covering a large area. The turret does not fire until someone orders it to fire. It is very effective against large groups of weaker combatants, but less effective against small numbers of armored targets. Extensive firing may overheat and disable the turret.
Rule.Raw: A powerful multiple launch rocket system usually mounted on Burya, capable of firing powerful barrages of rockets covering a large area. The turret does not fire until someone orders it to fire. It is very effective against large groups of weaker combatants, but less effective against small numbers of armored targets. Extensive firing may overheat and disable the turret.
Rule.Translated: Un potente sistema de lanzamiento de cohetes múltiples montado normalmente sobre un Burya, capaz de disparar potentes andanadas de cohetes que cubren una amplia zona. La torreta no dispara hasta que alguien se lo ordena. Es muy eficaz contra grandes grupos de combatientes débiles, pero menos contra un pequeño número de objetivos blindados. La torreta puede sobrecalentarse y quedar inutilizada si se dispara muchas veces seguidas.

Rule.Original:
A heavy duty transport aircraft, the Cherokee is a hulking monstrosity of aeronautical engineering. Very slow due to all the bulk, equally thirsty, and sports massive cargo capacity. Plan accordingly.

A dedicated transport helicopter with a modified cargo bay, it requires two pilots to operate and frequent refueling. However, nothing comes even close to bulk transportation at its tech level.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x2
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Cherokee, un helicóptero de transporte pesado, es una monstruosidad de la ingeniería aeronáutica. Su gran volumen hace que sea bastante lento y que consuma mucho, aunque tiene una enorme capacidad de carga. Tenlo en cuenta a la hora de planificar viajes.

Se trata de un helicóptero de transporte especializado con un compartimento de carga modificado, que requiere de dos pilotos y de frecuentes repostajes. Sin embargo, no hay nada que se le acerque en cuanto al transporte aéreo masivo en su nivel tecnológico.

Tripulación:<color=#bb8f04>Piloto x2
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original:
More of a movable mini-base than a deployment pod, Goliath is an expensive but powerful solution to any immovable enemy object. Equipped with four military turret stations and a long range rocket swarm turret at the top, this siege pod is capable of raining fire in 360 degree radius. Nearly impenetrable, it can serve as a portable base of operations, keeping all troops inside safe.

It’s incredibly heavy and lift off requires single-use boosters that separate once the trajectory and velocity is reached. In order to lift off again, the boosters need to be rebuilt.

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move.
Rule.Raw:

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move.
Rule.Translated:
El Goliat, un vehículo más parecido a una minibase móvil que a una cápsula de transporte, es una solución cara pero potente contra cualquier objeto enemigo inamovible. Equipado con cuatro estaciones de torretas militares y una torreta de cohetes-enjambre de largo alcance en la parte superior, esta cápsula de asedio es capaz de hacer llover fuego en un radio de 360 grados. Es casi impenetrable, por lo que puede servir como base de operaciones portátil, manteniendo a salvo a todas las tropas en su interior.

Es increíblemente pesada y su despegue requiere de propulsores de usar y tirar que se desprenden una vez que se alcanza la trayectoria y la velocidad necesarias. Debido a esto, es necesario reconstruir los propulsores para volver a despegar.

Al ser un vehículo volador, es extremadamente visible cuando está en movimiento.

Rule.Original: A military-grade double barreled automatic turret, usually mounted on Goliath siegepods. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use. May explode when damaged. It has a limited angle it can fire in.
Rule.Raw: A military-grade double barreled automatic turret, usually mounted on Goliath siegepods. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use. May explode when damaged. It has a limited angle it can fire in.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta automática de doble cañón y calidad militar, que suele montarse sobre las cápsulas de asedio Goliat. Requiere acero para renovar sus cañones tras un uso intensivo. Puede explotar si se daña. Tiene un ángulo limitado en el que puede disparar.

Rule.Original: An inaccurate launcher capable of firing two barrages of rockets covering a large area. The turret does not fire until someone orders it to fire. It is very effective against large groups of weaker combatants, but less effective against small numbers of armored targets. Extensive firing may overheat and disable the turret.

Es muy eficaz contra grandes grupos de combatientes débiles, pero menos contra un pequeño número de objetivos blindados. Rule.Original:
A dedicated refrigeration vehicle, the Hermano is a decent cargo transporter with a specific niche in ferrying perishable goods. Decent in long-range travel along roads, it performs terribly in off-road or winter conditions.

While there are better cargo transporters even in lower tiers, this truck can transport cargo in a frozen state, preventing spoilage. Due to the extra machinery, performance suffers and it should stay away from conflict zones.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Hermano es un vehículo frigorífico especializado en el transporte de mercancías perecederas. Funciona decentemente en trayectos largos por carretera, pero su rendimiento es pésimo en condiciones todoterreno o invernales.

Aunque hay mejores vehículos de transporte de carga incluso en niveles inferiores, este camión puede transportar carga bajo el punto de congelación, evitando que esta se estropee. Debido a la maquinaria adicional, el rendimiento se resiente y debería mantenerse alejado de las zonas conflictivas.

Rule.Original:
A dedicated refrigeration vehicle, the Hermano is a decent cargo transporter with a specific niche in ferrying perishable goods. Decent in long-range travel along roads, it performs terribly in off-road or winter conditions.

While there are better cargo transporters even in lower tiers, this truck can transport cargo in a frozen state, preventing spoilage. Due to the extra machinery, performance suffers and it should stay away from conflict zones.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Hermano es un vehículo frigorífico especializado en el transporte de mercancías perecederas. Funciona decentemente en trayectos largos por carretera, pero su rendimiento es pésimo en condiciones todoterreno o invernales.

Aunque hay mejores vehículos de transporte de carga incluso en niveles inferiores, este camión puede transportar carga bajo el punto de congelación, evitando que esta se estropee. Debido a la maquinaria adicional, el rendimiento se resiente y debería mantenerse alejado de las zonas conflictivas.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Pasajero x1
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: Enable or disable cargo refrigeration on this refrigerated truck. Refrigeration will stop items from spoiling, but will continuously use up fuel.
Rule.Raw: Enable or disable cargo refrigeration on this refrigerated truck. Refrigeration will stop items from spoiling, but will continuously use up fuel.
Rule.Translated: Activa o desactiva la refrigeración de la carga en este camión frigorífico. La refrigeración evitará que los artículos se estropeen, pero consumirá combustible continuamente.

Rule.Original:
A fast general purpose transporter, the Lightning is an excellent road vehicle for getting an appreciable amount of cargo in a very small time frame. Incredibly fast on flat roads and will struggle on hills, snow or winter tiles.

As it is designed for speed, trips should always be planned for staying on roads and having extra fuel, which can occupy most of the extra cargo space. It has terrible fuel efficiency due to the performance, so plan accordingly.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Relámpago, un veloz vehículo de propósito general, es un excelente vehículo de carretera para transportar una cantidad apreciable de carga en muy poco tiempo. Es increíblemente rápido en carreteras llanas, pero tiene dificultades en colinas, nieve o durante el invierno.

Como está diseñado para alcanzar una gran velocidad, los viajes siempre deben planificarse para permanecer en las carreteras y disponer de combustible extra, que puede ocupar la mayor parte del espacio de carga. Tiene una terrible eficiencia de combustible debido a su rendimiento, por lo que deberás planificar en consecuencia.

Rule.Original:
An armoured transport aircraft, the Louie is a robust and agile mobile mode of transportation. Doesn’t require a landing strip and won’t fall apart at the first sign of fire.

A relatively general purpose helicopter, it has both excellent cargo and passenger capacity. Has some armour for an aircraft, allowing it to deploy and extract from hot zones.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x1, Passenger x5
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Louie, un helicóptero de transporte blindado, es un medio de transporte robusto y ágil. No requiere de pistas de aterrizaje y no se desmorona al primer disparo.

Se trata de un helicóptero de propósito relativamente general, que cuenta con una excelente capacidad, tanto de carga como de pasajeros. Posee cierto blindaje para tratarse de un vehículo aéreo, lo que le permite desplegarse y salir de zonas conflictivas.

Rule.Original:
A general main battle tank, the Marshal is an improved combat vehicle that performs well in any engagement. Performs better in less favourable terrain with all sides armoured, the thinnest plating being at the rear near the engine.

Minimal armour improvements compared to previous tier tanks, instead it has a more powerful main gun and a secondary gun. Can fire while moving, as it requires one driver and two gunners; one for each weapon system.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Machine gunner x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Mariscal es un tanque de combate de propósito general mejorado que rinde bien en cualquier combate. Funciona mejor en terrenos menos favorables, y cuenta con blindaje en todos los flancos, siendo el más fino el de la parte trasera, cerca del motor.

Las mejoras en el blindaje son mínimas en comparación con los carros de nivel anterior; en su lugar, cuenta con un cañón principal más potente y un cañón secundario. Puede disparar mientras está en movimiento, ya que necesita un conductor y dos artilleros, uno para cada sistema de armas.

Tripulación:<color=#bb8f04>Conductor x1, Artillero x1, Ametrallador x1
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: A large and powerful tank cannon capable of firing explosive shells over long distance. Usually mounted on Marshal tanks.
Rule.Raw: A large and powerful tank cannon capable of firing explosive shells over long distance. Usually mounted on Marshal tanks.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón de tanque grande y potente capaz de disparar proyectiles explosivos a larga distancia. Suele montarse en tanques Mariscal.

Rule.Original: A small machine gun mounted on a marshal tank. Needs to be reloaded with steel. Can only fire over short range, but doesn’t have any issues with firing at enemies that engage the vehicle in melee.
Rule.Raw: A small machine gun mounted on a marshal tank. Needs to be reloaded with steel. Can only fire over short range, but doesn’t have any issues with firing at enemies that engage the vehicle in melee.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña ametralladora montada sobre un tanque Mariscal. Debe recargarse con acero. Solo puede disparar a corta distancia, pero no tiene problemas para disparar a enemigos que se enfrenten al vehículo cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original:
An armoured all-rounder vehicle, the Nomad performs remarkably well in all categories with an excellent cargo and passenger capacity. Performs well in any and all terrain, with some minor issues in the cold.

A relatively general purpose tier 3, effectively being a lightly armoured APC. While it excels in off road capabilities and works well in all situations, other vehicles perform even better on roads or in specialized tasks.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x3
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Original:
A general purpose armoured personnel carrier, the Paladin is a fast and hardy troop transport. Decent cargo holds, reinforced armour plating, all-terrain capability and a smoke grenade turret for screening troop deployment. The major downsides are no tracks for better terrain navigation and thinner plating on the rear.

Compared to previous generations, this APC is designed to quickly drop infantry off at a desired location and quickly retreat. It can act as temporary cover but ideally it should be able to deploy its cargo and bring it home safely.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Passenger x6
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Rule.Translated:
El Paladin, un transporte blindado de personal de propósito general, es un vehículo rápido a la vez que resistente. Dispone de buenas bodegas de carga, un blindaje reforzado, capacidad todoterreno y una torreta de granadas de humo ideal para la ocultación de tropas. Las dos mayores desventajas son la ausencia de orugas para una mejor navegación por el terreno y un blindaje más delgado en la parte trasera.

En comparación con las generaciones anteriores, este TBP está diseñado para dejar a la infantería en el lugar deseado y retirarse rápidamente. Puede actuar como cobertura temporal, pero lo ideal es desplegar su carga y llevarla a casa sana y salva.

Tripulación:<color=#bb8f04>Conductor x1, Artillero x1, Pasajero x6
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Translated: Un lanzagranadas de humo montado sobre un Paladín. Es excelente para proteger con humo a la infantería, pero no cuenta con capacidad ofensiva.

Rule.Original:
A general all-rounder vehicle, the Springbok performs well in all categories with a good cargo and passenger capacity. The old, robust build and loud engine negatively affect its fuel efficiency and visibility. Best suited on flat roads and will struggle somewhat on hills, snow or winter tiles.

A slightly worse performer compared to tier 2 vehicles, it is instead a stylish vehicle to drive and will provide a mood boost to all passengers.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Passenger x3
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

La construcción clásica a la vez que robusta y el motor ruidoso afectan negativamente a su eficiencia de combustible y visibilidad. Se adapta mejor en carreteras llanas y tendrá algunos problemas en colinas, nieve o durante el invierno.

Aunque es un poco peor en comparación con los vehículos de nivel 2, es un vehículo elegante de conducir que proporcionará una bonificación al estado de humor de todos los pasajeros.

Rule.Original:
A dedicated artillery unit, the Udar is a long-range siege weapon that can be operated by a two-man crew for faster loading speeds. Small and inefficient fuel reserves are its limiting factor, as it can drive through any terrain without issue.

A priority target and defenseless by itself or in close range, especially with its thin rear plating, a well-defended Udar can lay down quick barrages of mortar shells and reposition out of danger.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw:

Rule.Translated:
El Udar, una unidad de artillería dedicada, es un arma de asedio de largo alcance que puede ser operada por una tripulación de dos hombres para contar con una velocidad de recarga más rápida. Sus pequeñas e ineficientes reservas de combustible son su factor limitante, ya que puede atravesar cualquier terreno sin problemas.

Se trata de un objetivo prioritario e indefenso por sí mismo o a corta distancia, especialmente con su delgado blindaje trasero. Aun así, Un Udar bien defendido puede lanzar un aluvión proyectiles de mortero y reposicionarse fuera de peligro.

Tripulación:<color=#bb8f04>Conductor x1, Artillero x2
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: A gigantic artillery capable of firing various kinds of shells over medium distances. Whilst it cannot fire to different world tiles, the fact that it is mounted on an armored mobile platform gives it great versatility. It can only rotate 35 degrees in both directions. Usually mounted on Udar artillery.

Usually mounted on Udar artillery.
Rule.Translated: Una artillería gigantesca capaz de disparar varios tipos de proyectiles a media distancia. Aunque no puede disparar a otras celdas del mapa del mundo, el hecho de estar montada en una plataforma móvil blindada le confiere una gran versatilidad. Solo puede girar 35 grados en ambas direcciones. Suele montarse en la artillería Udar.

El Udar, una unidad de artillería dedicada, es un arma de asedio de largo alcance que puede ser operada por una tripulación de dos hombres para contar con una velocidad de recarga más rápida. Sus pequeñas e ineficientes reservas de combustible son su factor limitante, ya que puede atravesar cualquier terreno sin problemas.

Se trata de un objetivo prioritario e indefenso por sí mismo o a corta distancia, especialmente con su delgado blindaje trasero. Aun así, Un Udar bien defendido puede lanzar un aluvión proyectiles de mortero y reposicionarse fuera de peligro.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Conductor x1, Artillero x2
<color=#bb8f04>Tipo de combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original: Active-tracking anti-tank missiles such as the M48 can do heavy damage to their targets but can only be fired after locking onto a target of sufficient size or mass. These missiles can only target mechanoids and vehicles with a minimum body size of 1.5 or organic targets with a minimum body size of 3.0.
Rule.Raw: Active-tracking anti-tank missiles such as the M48 can do heavy damage to their targets but can only be fired after locking onto a target of sufficient size or mass. These missiles can only target mechanoids and vehicles with a minimum body size of 1.5 or organic targets with a minimum body size of 3.0.
Rule.Translated: Los misiles antitanque de seguimiento activo, como el M48, pueden causar grandes daños, pero solo se disparan tras fijar un objetivo de tamaño o masa suficientes. Solo pueden apuntar a mecanoides y vehículos con un tamaño corporal mínimo de 1.5, o a objetivos orgánicos con un tamaño mínimo de 3.0.
{0} ha sido aplastado hasta la muerte.
designando un objetivo de artillería con TargetB.

Rule.Original: Learn the basics of building conduits to connect networked defense systems.
Rule.Raw: Learn the basics of building conduits to connect networked defense systems.
Rule.Translated: Aprende los fundamentos de la construcción de conducciones para conectar sistemas de defensa en red.

Rule.Original: Build networked ship turrets for point defense.
Rule.Raw: Build networked ship turrets for point defense.
Rule.Translated: Construye torretas navales conectadas en red para defensa de punto.

Rule.Original: Build networked missile launchers and proximity sensor towers for close-range guided artillery support.
Rule.Raw: Build networked missile launchers and proximity sensor towers for close-range guided artillery support.
Rule.Translated: Construye lanzamisiles y torres de sensores de proximidad conectados en red para apoyo de artillería guiada a corta distancia.

Rule.Original: Build field laser designators to direct missile artillery at extended range.
Rule.Raw: Build field laser designators to direct missile artillery at extended range.
Rule.Translated: Construye designadores láser de campo para dirigir la artillería de misiles a larga distancia.

Rule.Original: Build wide-area defensive shields using networked capacitors and heatsinks.
Rule.Raw: Build wide-area defensive shields using networked capacitors and heatsinks.
Rule.Translated: Construye escudos defensivos de área amplia con condensadores y disipadores conectados en red.
núcleos de escudo de alta energía

Rule.Original: Unlock the ability to build high-energy shield cores at the nanoassembler.
Rule.Raw: Unlock the ability to build high-energy shield cores at the nanoassembler.
Rule.Translated: Permite fabricar núcleos de escudo de alta energía en el nanoensamblador.

Rule.Original: A sophisticated sensor suite that allows for remote targeting of guided ordnance when connected to a defense grid network. Missile launchers in the connected network can be directly fired at targets in range of a sensor tower from central consoles.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticated sensor suite that allows for remote targeting of guided ordnance when connected to a defense grid network. Missile launchers in the connected network can be directly fired at targets in range of a sensor tower from central consoles.
Rule.Translated: Un sofisticado conjunto de sensores que permite dirigir a distancia munición guiada cuando está conectado a una red defensiva. Los lanzamisiles de la red pueden dispararse directamente desde las consolas centrales contra objetivos al alcance de una torre de sensores.

Rule.Original: A compact vertical missile launcher based off of units intended for use on military-grade starships, this configurable launcher can be fired remotely and accepts terminal guidance from a variety of networked devices. It utilizes a soft launch system that ejects the missile before the engine ignites, minimizing damage to the launcher and allowing it to be rapidly reloaded.
Rule.Raw: A compact vertical missile launcher based off of units intended for use on military-grade starships, this configurable launcher can be fired remotely and accepts terminal guidance from a variety of networked devices. It utilizes a soft launch system that ejects the missile before the engine ignites, minimizing damage to the launcher and allowing it to be rapidly reloaded.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzamisiles vertical compacto basado en los utilizados por astronaves militares. Puede configurarse y dispararse a distancia, y recibe guiado terminal de diversos dispositivos conectados a la red. Su sistema de lanzamiento en frío expulsa el misil antes de encender el motor, lo que reduce los daños al lanzador y permite recargarlo rápidamente.

Rule.Original: A military-grade centralized shield generator unit designed to work with linked projectors.\n\nThis device cannot intercept projectiles on its own, but must be connected to shield projectors and shield capacitors via a defense grid network. Intercepting projectiles will also generate a large amount of heat, which must be dissipated in heatsinks.
Rule.Raw: A military-grade centralized shield generator unit designed to work with linked projectors.\n\nThis device cannot intercept projectiles on its own, but must be connected to shield projectors and shield capacitors via a defense grid network. Intercepting projectiles will also generate a large amount of heat, which must be dissipated in heatsinks.
Rule.Translated: Un generador de escudo centralizado de grado militar diseñado para funcionar con proyectores vinculados.\n\nNo puede interceptar proyectiles por sí solo: debe conectarse a proyectores y condensadores de escudo mediante una red defensiva. Interceptar proyectiles genera mucho calor, que debe eliminarse con disipadores.

Rule.Original: A shield projector designed to be linked together to provide protection for a wide area.\n\nShield projectors do not need to be directly powered, but must be connected to a defense grid network with an active shield generator and shield capacitors to function. Intercepting incoming projectiles will also generate a great deal of heat which must be dissipated in heatsinks.
Rule.Raw: A shield projector designed to be linked together to provide protection for a wide area.\n\nShield projectors do not need to be directly powered, but must be connected to a defense grid network with an active shield generator and shield capacitors to function. Intercepting incoming projectiles will also generate a great deal of heat which must be dissipated in heatsinks.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo diseñado para vincularse con otros y proteger una zona amplia.\n\nNo necesita alimentación eléctrica directa, pero debe estar conectado a una red defensiva con un generador de escudo activo y condensadores de escudo. Interceptar proyectiles entrantes genera mucho calor, que debe eliminarse con disipadores.

Rule.Original:
A shield projector designed to be linked together to provide protection for a wide area.

Shield projectors do not need to be directly powered, but must be connected to a defense grid network with an active shield generator and shield capacitors to function. Intercepting incoming projectiles will also generate a great deal of heat which must be dissipated in heatsinks.

This wide-area variant can cover a much larger area but requires its own shield core.

Esta variante de área amplia cubre una zona mucho mayor, pero necesita su propio núcleo de escudo.
