Rule.Original: A high-energy capacitor used to power networked shield generators.\n\nIt must be directly connected to power in order to charge and rapidly discharges if unpowered.
Rule.Raw: A high-energy capacitor used to power networked shield generators.\n\nIt must be directly connected to power in order to charge and rapidly discharges if unpowered.
Rule.Translated: Un condensador de alta energía que alimenta generadores de escudo conectados a la red.\n\nDebe estar conectado directamente a la electricidad para cargarse y se descarga rápidamente si pierde la alimentación.

Rule.Original: A high-capacity heatsink used to dissipate heat from networked shield generators.\n\nIt must be connected to a shield generator via defense grid conduits in order to receive heat.
Rule.Raw: A high-capacity heatsink used to dissipate heat from networked shield generators.\n\nIt must be connected to a shield generator via defense grid conduits in order to receive heat.
Rule.Translated: Un disipador de gran capacidad que elimina el calor de los generadores de escudo conectados a la red.\n\nDebe conectarse a un generador mediante conductos de la red defensiva para recibir el calor.

Rule.Original: A compact shield generator that can stop incoming projectiles and explosives. It has limited internal power and shorts out after a while.
Rule.Raw: A compact shield generator that can stop incoming projectiles and explosives. It has limited internal power and shorts out after a while.
Rule.Translated: Un generador de escudo compacto que detiene proyectiles y explosivos entrantes. Tiene una reserva interna de energía limitada y se cortocircuita al cabo de un tiempo.
conducto de la red de defensa

Rule.Original: A sophisticated conduit containing high-energy power links and coolant pipelines used to connect military-grade shield and weapon systems.\n\nCan be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticated conduit containing high-energy power links and coolant pipelines used to connect military-grade shield and weapon systems.\n\nCan be placed under walls and other buildings.
Rule.Translated: Un conducto sofisticado que contiene conexiones eléctricas de alta energía y tuberías de refrigerante para conectar sistemas militares de escudos y armamento.\n\nPuede colocarse bajo muros y otros edificios.
conducto oculto de la red de defensa

Rule.Original: A sophisticated conduit containing high-energy power links and coolant pipelines used to connect military-grade shield and weapon systems.\n\nThis particular conduit is buried underground, which requires more work and materials to build but protects the conduit from damage and creates less clutter in the area.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticated conduit containing high-energy power links and coolant pipelines used to connect military-grade shield and weapon systems.\n\nThis particular conduit is buried underground, which requires more work and materials to build but protects the conduit from damage and creates less clutter in the area.
Rule.Translated: Un conducto sofisticado que contiene conexiones eléctricas de alta energía y tuberías de refrigerante para conectar sistemas militares de escudos y armamento.\n\nEsta variante se entierra bajo tierra, lo que requiere más trabajo y materiales, pero la protege de los daños y reduce la acumulación de elementos en la zona.
consola de la red de defensa

Rule.Original: A console that allows for direct control of the connected defense grid network. A console must be manned by a human operator to allow for remote designation of artillery strikes.
Rule.Raw: A console that allows for direct control of the connected defense grid network. A console must be manned by a human operator to allow for remote designation of artillery strikes.
Rule.Translated: Una consola que permite controlar directamente la red defensiva conectada. Debe atenderla un operador humano para designar ataques de artillería a distancia.

Rule.Original: An interface that allows a manned turret to be remotely controlled via defense grid consoles. A single colonist can control all manned turrets connected to the network from a single console.
Rule.Raw: An interface that allows a manned turret to be remotely controlled via defense grid consoles. A single colonist can control all manned turrets connected to the network from a single console.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz que permite controlar una torreta tripulada a distancia mediante las consolas de la red defensiva. Un solo colono puede controlar desde una consola todas las torretas tripuladas conectadas a la red.
torreta de cañón automático de carga M51

Rule.Original: The Mark 51 turret is a ship-mounted twin-barreled charge-shot autocannon designed for use as a point defense weapon on military starships. It is powerful and sturdy, but can only be built on gravship substructure and requires external control via a defense grid console.\n\nIf connected to a supply network, it can reload itself using networked storage
Rule.Raw: The Mark 51 turret is a ship-mounted twin-barreled charge-shot autocannon designed for use as a point defense weapon on military starships. It is powerful and sturdy, but can only be built on gravship substructure and requires external control via a defense grid console.\n\nIf connected to a supply network, it can reload itself using networked storage
Rule.Translated: La torreta Mark 51 es un cañón automático de carga de dos tubos montado en naves y diseñado como defensa de punto para astronaves militares. Es potente y resistente, pero solo puede construirse sobre la subestructura de una astronave gravitatoria y requiere control externo desde una consola defensiva.\n\nSi está conectada a una red de suministros, puede recargarse utilizando los almacenes de la red.

Rule.Original: Cannot shoot: Needs to be reloaded
Rule.Raw: Cannot shoot: Needs to be reloaded

Rule.Translated: Un cañón automático pesado de dos tubos que dispara proyectiles de carga.
torreta de cañón de riel M64

Rule.Original: The Mark 64 turret is a ship-mounted railgun designed for use as a light anti-ship weapon on military starships. It is powerful and sturdy, but can only be built on gravship substructure and requires external control via a defense grid console.\n\nIf connected to a supply network, it can reload itself using networked storage
Rule.Raw: The Mark 64 turret is a ship-mounted railgun designed for use as a light anti-ship weapon on military starships. It is powerful and sturdy, but can only be built on gravship substructure and requires external control via a defense grid console.\n\nIf connected to a supply network, it can reload itself using networked storage
Rule.Translated: La torreta Mark 64 es un cañón de riel montado en naves y diseñado como arma antinave ligera para astronaves militares. Es potente y resistente, pero solo puede construirse sobre la subestructura de una astronave gravitatoria y requiere control externo desde una consola defensiva.\n\nSi está conectada a una red de suministros, puede recargarse utilizando los almacenes de la red.

Rule.Original: Cannot shoot: Needs to be reloaded
Rule.Raw: Cannot shoot: Needs to be reloaded

Rule.Translated: Un cañón de riel pesado montado.
núcleo de escudo de alta energía

Rule.Original: A critical component for wide-area defensive shields, high energy shield cores are required to construct networked shield generators such as those used in military-grade starships or high-tech colony defenses. These complex devices can only be fabricated by precision nano-scale production facilities, and thus are exceptionally rare on the rimworlds.\n\nHigh energy shield cores can be obtained by performing quests for friendly factions, in the hands of exotic goods traders, or manufactured at nanoassembler facilities. You can also salvage one by dismantling a gravship shield generator.
Rule.Raw: A critical component for wide-area defensive shields, high energy shield cores are required to construct networked shield generators such as those used in military-grade starships or high-tech colony defenses. These complex devices can only be fabricated by precision nano-scale production facilities, and thus are exceptionally rare on the rimworlds.\n\nHigh energy shield cores can be obtained by performing quests for friendly factions, in the hands of exotic goods traders, or manufactured at nanoassembler facilities. You can also salvage one by dismantling a gravship shield generator.
Rule.Translated: Un componente esencial para los escudos defensivos de área amplia. Los núcleos de escudo de alta energía son necesarios para construir generadores en red, como los utilizados por astronaves militares y defensas coloniales avanzadas. Estos dispositivos complejos solo pueden fabricarse en instalaciones de producción de precisión a escala nanométrica, por lo que son muy raros en los mundos exteriores.\n\nPueden obtenerse en misiones de facciones amigas, comprarse a comerciantes de bienes exóticos o fabricarse en instalaciones de nanoensamblaje. También puedes recuperar uno al desmontar un generador de escudo de astronave gravitatoria.
fabricar núcleo de escudo de alta energía
Fabrica un núcleo de escudo de alta energía.
Fabricando núcleo de escudo de alta energía.

Rule.Original: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with a high-explosive warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Raw: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with a high-explosive warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Translated: Un misil de corto alcance contra objetivos terrestres, guiado con precisión y equipado con una cabeza de alto explosivo.\n\nEstá diseñado para lanzamisiles verticales de astronaves militares y requiere fijar el objetivo antes de disparar.

Rule.Original: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with a volatile incendiary warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Raw: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with a volatile incendiary warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Translated: Un misil de corto alcance contra objetivos terrestres, guiado con precisión y equipado con una cabeza incendiaria volátil.\n\nEstá diseñado para lanzamisiles verticales de astronaves militares y requiere fijar el objetivo antes de disparar.

Rule.Original: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with an electromagnetic pulse warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Raw: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with an electromagnetic pulse warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Translated: Un misil de corto alcance contra objetivos terrestres, guiado con precisión y equipado con una cabeza de pulso electromagnético.\n\nEstá diseñado para lanzamisiles verticales de astronaves militares y requiere fijar el objetivo antes de disparar.

Rule.Original: A precision-guided short-range anti-tank missile with a high explosive shaped charge warhead. It can actively track targets of sufficient mass but has a very small blast radius.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Raw: A precision-guided short-range anti-tank missile with a high explosive shaped charge warhead. It can actively track targets of sufficient mass but has a very small blast radius.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Translated: Un misil antitanque de corto alcance, guiado con precisión y equipado con una cabeza de carga hueca de alto explosivo. Puede seguir activamente objetivos de masa suficiente, pero su radio de explosión es muy pequeño.\n\nEstá diseñado para lanzamisiles verticales de astronaves militares y requiere fijar el objetivo antes de disparar.

Rule.Original: A precision-guided short-range missile with a burnout shield payload. Upon impact, it deploys a temporary generator that projects a wide-area shield and is intended to assist ground forces under heavy fire.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Raw: A precision-guided short-range missile with a burnout shield payload. Upon impact, it deploys a temporary generator that projects a wide-area shield and is intended to assist ground forces under heavy fire.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Translated: Un misil de corto alcance guiado con precisión que transporta un escudo desechable. Al impactar, despliega un generador temporal que proyecta un escudo de área amplia para ayudar a las fuerzas terrestres sometidas a fuego intenso.\n\nEstá diseñado para lanzamisiles verticales de astronaves militares y requiere fijar el objetivo antes de disparar.

Rule.Original: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with an antigrain warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Raw: A precision-guided short-range anti-ground missile with an antigrain warhead.\n\nIt is designed to be loaded into vertical missile launchers on military-grade starships and requires a guidance lock to fire.
Rule.Translated: Un misil de corto alcance contra objetivos terrestres, guiado con precisión y equipado con una cabeza de antigrano.\n\nEstá diseñado para lanzamisiles verticales de astronaves militares y requiere fijar el objetivo antes de disparar.

Rule.Original: A compact laser designator used to direct artillery strikes from local networked defense grids.
Rule.Raw: A compact laser designator used to direct artillery strikes from local networked defense grids.
Rule.Translated: Un designador láser compacto para dirigir ataques de artillería desde redes de defensa locales conectadas.

bala de cañón de riel de 12mm (Sabot)

Rule.Original: metal parts such as fuel tank, carburetor, fuel pump and filter that is necessary for a fuel powered vehicle.
Rule.Raw: metal parts such as fuel tank, carburetor, fuel pump and filter that is necessary for a fuel powered vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Piezas metálicas como depósito de combustible, carburador, bomba y filtro, necesarias para un vehículo propulsado por combustible.

Rule.Original: Metal parts such as driveshafts, gearboxes, differentials and planetary gears that are necessary to transmit torque.
Rule.Raw: Metal parts such as driveshafts, gearboxes, differentials and planetary gears that are necessary to transmit torque.
Rule.Translated: Piezas metálicas como ejes de transmisión, cajas de cambios, diferenciales y engranajes planetarios necesarias para transmitir el par.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed near a bridge crane or Assembly platfrom. One workbench can use up to two tool shelves.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed near a bridge crane or Assembly platfrom. One workbench can use up to two tool shelves.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una grúa puente o una plataforma de montaje. Cada mesa puede usar hasta dos estantes de herramientas.

Rule.Original: A blast cabinet is essentially a closed loop system that allows the operator to blast the part and recycle the abrasive. Increases work speed when placed near an Assembly platfrom. One workbench can use one blast cabinet.
Rule.Raw: A blast cabinet is essentially a closed loop system that allows the operator to blast the part and recycle the abrasive. Increases work speed when placed near an Assembly platfrom. One workbench can use one blast cabinet.
Rule.Translated: Una cabina de granallado es un sistema cerrado que permite limpiar piezas mediante abrasivo y reciclarlo. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una plataforma de montaje. Cada mesa de trabajo puede usar una cabina.

Rule.Original: Increases work speed when placed near a bridge crane. One workbench can use up to two engine hanger.
Rule.Raw: Increases work speed when placed near a bridge crane. One workbench can use up to two engine hanger.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una grúa puente. Cada mesa de trabajo puede usar hasta dos soportes de motor.

Rule.Original: A workbench with heavy equipment and tools for components assembly.
Rule.Raw: A workbench with heavy equipment and tools for components assembly.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo con equipo pesado y herramientas para ensamblar componentes.

Rule.Original: A type of crane found in industrial environments, often used in the assembly and maintenance of heavy equipment and vehicles, it requires 4 walls as pillar to support placing.
Rule.Raw: A type of crane found in industrial environments, often used in the assembly and maintenance of heavy equipment and vehicles, it requires 4 walls as pillar to support placing.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de grúa utilizada en entornos industriales para el montaje y mantenimiento de equipos pesados y vehículos. Requiere cuatro muros como pilares de soporte.

Rule.Original: An unfinished vehicle's part and tools.
Rule.Raw: An unfinished vehicle's part and tools.
Rule.Translated: Piezas y herramientas de un vehículo sin terminar.

Rule.Original: A man-powered bicycle, cheap and useful in most cases.
Rule.Raw: A man-powered bicycle, cheap and useful in most cases.
Rule.Translated: Una bicicleta movida por fuerza humana, barata y útil en la mayoría de situaciones.

Rule.Original: A man-powered bicycle, cheap and useful in most cases.
Rule.Raw: A man-powered bicycle, cheap and useful in most cases.
Rule.Translated: Una bicicleta movida por fuerza humana, barata y útil en la mayoría de situaciones.

Rule.Original: assemble a medium engine, which is common used by tanks, trucks and aircrafts.
Rule.Raw: assemble a medium engine, which is common used by tanks, trucks and aircrafts.
Rule.Translated: Ensamblar un motor mediano, utilizado habitualmente en tanques, camiones y aeronaves.

Rule.Original: Use melted steel to make heavy compoment.
Rule.Raw: Use melted steel to make heavy compoment.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza acero fundido para fabricar un componente pesado.

Rule.Original: Use heat and strong electromagnets to recycle useful metal from heavy compoment.
Rule.Raw: Use heat and strong electromagnets to recycle useful metal from heavy compoment.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza calor y potentes electroimanes para recuperar metal útil de componentes pesados.
fabricar proyectiles de cañón automático (metralla) x50

Rule.Original: The desperate remains of an automatic drill designed for deep resource extraction, once supported by a multitude of ancient infrastructures. It is now missing its major foundations and core components, leaving it entirely non-functional. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: The desperate remains of an automatic drill designed for deep resource extraction, once supported by a multitude of ancient infrastructures. It is now missing its major foundations and core components, leaving it entirely non-functional. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Los ruinosos restos de un taladro automático diseñado para extraer recursos profundos, que antes dependía de numerosas infraestructuras antiguas. Ahora le faltan los soportes principales y los componentes esenciales, por lo que no funciona en absoluto. Destruirlo podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: The gigantic husk of what was once a mountain-devouring mechanical beast, larger than most conventional buildings. Maybe the ancients hated their planet, so much that they built this piece of machinery to tear it down. With its core components rusted and weathered, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: The gigantic husk of what was once a mountain-devouring mechanical beast, larger than most conventional buildings. Maybe the ancients hated their planet, so much that they built this piece of machinery to tear it down. With its core components rusted and weathered, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: La enorme carcasa de lo que fue una bestia mecánica capaz de devorar montañas, mayor que casi cualquier edificio convencional. Quizá los antiguos odiaban tanto su planeta que construyeron esta máquina para destrozarlo. Sin embargo, sus componentes esenciales están oxidados y deteriorados, por lo que ya no funciona. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.
sistema de energía de excavadora antigua

Rule.Original: The torn power system of the ancient giant excavator. Back in its hayday, this electro-hydraulic driven engine ccould easily lift giant rocks or, even better, a whole mountain with ease. With its core components gone, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: The torn power system of the ancient giant excavator. Back in its hayday, this electro-hydraulic driven engine ccould easily lift giant rocks or, even better, a whole mountain with ease. With its core components gone, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: El destrozado sistema de energía de la excavadora gigante antigua. En sus mejores tiempos, este motor electrohidráulico podía levantar enormes rocas o incluso una montaña entera con facilidad. Sin embargo, al faltarle los componentes esenciales, ya no funciona. Destruirlo podría proporcionar recursos útiles.
rueda de cangilones de excavadora antigua

Rule.Original: A rusted bucket wheel of ancient giant rock excavator. Made of high-strength alloy, these wheels could, at one time, grind down stone chunks with ease. With its core components lost, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: A rusted bucket wheel of ancient giant rock excavator. Made of high-strength alloy, these wheels could, at one time, grind down stone chunks with ease. With its core components lost, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda de cangilones oxidada de una excavadora gigante antigua. Fabricadas con una aleación de alta resistencia, estas ruedas podían triturar bloques de roca con facilidad. Sin embargo, al faltarle los componentes esenciales, ya no funciona. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: An ancient industrial machine. It was once capable of salvaging useable metal from rock chunks using water washing, sieving and magnets. With its core components gone, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: An ancient industrial machine. It was once capable of salvaging useable metal from rock chunks using water washing, sieving and magnets. With its core components gone, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina industrial que recuperaba metales aprovechables de los bloques de roca mediante lavado con agua, cribado e imanes. Al faltarle los componentes esenciales, ya no funciona. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A powered-down hulking industrial beast, once capable of digging through entire mountains to build ancient tunnels. With its core components rusted and weathered, it lacks all function. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: A powered-down hulking industrial beast, once capable of digging through entire mountains to build ancient tunnels. With its core components rusted and weathered, it lacks all function. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme bestia industrial apagada que antes podía perforar montañas enteras para construir túneles. Sus componentes esenciales están oxidados y deteriorados, por lo que ha perdido toda funcionalidad. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: Weathered electrical appliances once used in an ancient tunnel boring machines. Back in its haydays, it was capable of converting electricity into hydraulic power, thus powering up the drilling behemoth at one flick of switch. With its core components rusted and weathered, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: Weathered electrical appliances once used in an ancient tunnel boring machines. Back in its haydays, it was capable of converting electricity into hydraulic power, thus powering up the drilling behemoth at one flick of switch. With its core components rusted and weathered, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Equipos eléctricos deteriorados que antes se utilizaban en una antigua tuneladora. En sus mejores tiempos convertían la electricidad en energía hidráulica y ponían en marcha este coloso con solo accionar un interruptor. Sin embargo, sus componentes esenciales están oxidados y deteriorados, por lo que ya no funcionan. Destruirlos podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A torn ancient mineral conveyor once used for transporting minerals to beneficiation machines or any other locations of mind. With its core components rusted and weathered, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: A torn ancient mineral conveyor once used for transporting minerals to beneficiation machines or any other locations of mind. With its core components rusted and weathered, however, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una cinta transportadora de minerales antigua y destrozada que llevaba la carga a máquinas de tratamiento u otros destinos. Sus componentes esenciales están oxidados y deteriorados, por lo que ya no funciona. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A piece of ancient tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. With most of the framework well rusted and weathered, however, it can't hold anything as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: A piece of ancient tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. With most of the framework well rusted and weathered, however, it can't hold anything as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de armazón antiguo que sostenía los túneles durante su construcción e incorporaba una pasarela superior para facilitar el paso de los trabajadores. La mayor parte de la estructura está oxidada y deteriorada, por lo que ya no puede sostener nada. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A piece of ancient tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. With most of the framework well rusted and weathered, however, it can't hold anything as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: A piece of ancient tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. With most of the framework well rusted and weathered, however, it can't hold anything as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de armazón antiguo que sostenía los túneles durante su construcción e incorporaba una pasarela superior para facilitar el paso de los trabajadores. La mayor parte de la estructura está oxidada y deteriorada, por lo que ya no puede sostener nada. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A piece of ancient tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. With most of the framework well rusted and weathered, however, it can't hold anything as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: A piece of ancient tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. With most of the framework well rusted and weathered, however, it can't hold anything as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de armazón antiguo que sostenía los túneles durante su construcción e incorporaba una pasarela superior para facilitar el paso de los trabajadores. La mayor parte de la estructura está oxidada y deteriorada, por lo que ya no puede sostener nada. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: A delapidated mineral outlet. With its core components rusted and weathered, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Raw: A delapidated mineral outlet. With its core components rusted and weathered, it just woudn't function as of now. Destroying it may yield some useful resources.
Rule.Translated: Una salida de minerales en ruinas. Sus componentes esenciales están oxidados y deteriorados, por lo que ya no funciona. Destruirla podría proporcionar recursos útiles.

Rule.Original: An ancient compact mini shotgun turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: An ancient compact mini shotgun turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua minitorreta de escopeta compacta. Necesita acero para reacondicionar el cañón tras un uso intenso. Puede explotar si sufre daños. Su rudimentaria IA no permite controlarla directamente, así que ten cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un arma automática sencilla, diseñada para montarse en una torreta.

Rule.Original: An ancient compact mini shotgun turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: An ancient compact mini shotgun turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua minitorreta de escopeta compacta. Necesita acero para reacondicionar el cañón tras un uso intenso. Puede explotar si sufre daños. Su rudimentaria IA no permite controlarla directamente, así que ten cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un arma automática sencilla, diseñada para montarse en una torreta.
torreta de escopeta de gran calibre

Rule.Original: A large caliber shotgun turret, powerful enough to pose a destructive threat at medium to close range. Capable of punching through insectoid chitin with ease, it is a genuine insectoid killing machine usually deployed for defending military excavation sites.
Rule.Raw: A large caliber shotgun turret, powerful enough to pose a destructive threat at medium to close range. Capable of punching through insectoid chitin with ease, it is a genuine insectoid killing machine usually deployed for defending military excavation sites.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de escopeta de gran calibre, lo bastante potente como para ser una amenaza destructiva a distancias cortas y medias. Atraviesa fácilmente la quitina insectoide y es una auténtica máquina de matar insectos, utilizada normalmente para defender excavaciones militares.

Rule.Original: A self-loading large-bore shotcannon designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Raw: A self-loading large-bore shotcannon designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón de perdigones de gran calibre y carga automática diseñado para montarse en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with mud. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Raw: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with mud. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Translated: Un vagón minero deteriorado y cargado de barro. Quizá al romperlo se puedan obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with steel bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Raw: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with steel bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Translated: Un vagón minero deteriorado cargado de acero sujeto con lonas y cuerdas. Quizá romperlo proporcione recursos.

Rule.Original: A delpaidated mining train carriage loaded with uranium bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Raw: A delpaidated mining train carriage loaded with uranium bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Translated: Un vagón minero deteriorado cargado de uranio sujeto con lonas y cuerdas. Quizá romperlo proporcione recursos.

Rule.Original: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with plasteel bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Raw: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with plasteel bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Translated: Un vagón minero deteriorado cargado de plastiacero sujeto con lonas y cuerdas. Quizá romperlo proporcione recursos.

Rule.Original: A delapidated mine train carriage filled with cobwebs and rust.
Rule.Raw: A delapidated mine train carriage filled with cobwebs and rust.
Rule.Translated: Un vagón minero deteriorado lleno de telarañas y óxido.
vagoneta antigua de fragmentos de roca

Rule.Original: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with rock chunks bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Raw: A delapidated mining train carriage loaded with rock chunks bound by tarpaulins and ropes. Perhaps breaking it can yield some resources.
Rule.Translated: Un vagón minero deteriorado cargado de bloques de roca sujetos con lonas y cuerdas. Quizá romperlo proporcione recursos.

Rule.Original: An ancient fire hydrant with no water left inside.
Rule.Raw: An ancient fire hydrant with no water left inside.
Rule.Translated: Una boca de incendios antigua sin agua en su interior.

Rule.Original: An ancient barrier gate that's no longer functioning properly.
Rule.Raw: An ancient barrier gate that's no longer functioning properly.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera de acceso antigua que ya no funciona correctamente.

Rule.Original: An old truck trunk filled with dirt and cobwebs.
Rule.Raw: An old truck trunk filled with dirt and cobwebs.
Rule.Translated: La vieja caja de un camión, llena de suciedad y telarañas.

Rule.Original: An old truck trunk filled with dirt and cobwebs.
Rule.Raw: An old truck trunk filled with dirt and cobwebs.
Rule.Translated: La vieja caja de un camión, llena de suciedad y telarañas.

Rule.Original: A truck used to transport resources at the mines. It has been stripped of its useful parts.
Rule.Raw: A truck used to transport resources at the mines. It has been stripped of its useful parts.
Rule.Translated: Un camión usado para transportar recursos en las minas. Le han quitado las piezas útiles.

Rule.Original: An ancient sign warning of radiation poisoning.
Rule.Raw: An ancient sign warning of radiation poisoning.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero antiguo que advierte del envenenamiento por radiación.

Rule.Original: An abandoned pickaxe. Old enough to be considered useless.
Rule.Raw: An abandoned pickaxe. Old enough to be considered useless.
Rule.Translated: Un pico abandonado. Tan viejo que se considera inútil.

Rule.Original: An abandoned shovel. Old enough to be considered useless.
Rule.Raw: An abandoned shovel. Old enough to be considered useless.
Rule.Translated: Una pala abandonada. Tan vieja que se considera inútil.

Rule.Original: A large, badly damaged shotgun turret. No longer usable.
Rule.Raw: A large, badly damaged shotgun turret. No longer usable.
Rule.Translated: Una gran torreta de escopeta muy dañada. Ya no puede usarse.
Una vía férrea común bastante oxidada.

Rule.Original: A rail road crosstie placed under the railroad tracks.
Rule.Raw: A rail road crosstie placed under the railroad tracks.
Rule.Translated: Una traviesa colocada bajo los raíles de la vía férrea.

Rule.Original: Build heavy-duty industrial machines for mining and processing large amounts of resources.
Rule.Raw: Build heavy-duty industrial machines for mining and processing large amounts of resources.
Rule.Translated: Construye máquinas industriales de gran resistencia para extraer y procesar grandes cantidades de recursos.

Rule.Original: An automatic drilling system built for automated mining. It will constantly produce resources without human intervention as long as it is properly powered and placed on a tile with a known ore deposit.
Rule.Raw: An automatic drilling system built for automated mining. It will constantly produce resources without human intervention as long as it is properly powered and placed on a tile with a known ore deposit.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de perforación automática diseñado para la minería automatizada. Produce recursos de forma continua y sin intervención humana mientras tenga energía y esté colocado en una casilla con un yacimiento conocido.

Rule.Original: An industrial machine capable of taking rock chunks from its surroundings, filtering them through a mix of water washing, sieving and magnets, then outputting useable metals and organized bricks.
Rule.Raw: An industrial machine capable of taking rock chunks from its surroundings, filtering them through a mix of water washing, sieving and magnets, then outputting useable metals and organized bricks.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina industrial que recoge bloques de roca de sus alrededores y los filtra mediante lavado con agua, cribado e imanes para producir metales aprovechables y bloques ordenados.

Rule.Original: A hulking machine capable of tunneling through large amounts of stone. It moves forward on command, placing its own support walls and power conduits.
Rule.Raw: A hulking machine capable of tunneling through large amounts of stone. It moves forward on command, placing its own support walls and power conduits.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme máquina capaz de abrir túneles a través de grandes cantidades de roca. Avanza cuando recibe la orden y coloca sus propios muros de soporte y conductos eléctricos.

Rule.Original: Miscellaneous electrical appliances for your factories and industry. Purely decorative.
Rule.Raw: Miscellaneous electrical appliances for your factories and industry. Purely decorative.
Rule.Translated: Diversos aparatos eléctricos para tus fábricas e industria. Puramente decorativos.

Rule.Original: A rebuilt mineral conveyor belt. Purely decorative.
Rule.Raw: A rebuilt mineral conveyor belt. Purely decorative.
Rule.Translated: Una cinta transportadora de minerales reconstruida. Puramente decorativa.

Rule.Original: A piece of tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. Purely decorative.
Rule.Raw: A piece of tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top. Purely decorative.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de armazón que sostiene los túneles durante su construcción e incorpora una pasarela superior para facilitar el paso de los trabajadores. Puramente decorativa.

Rule.Original: A piece of tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top and a staircase for reaching the corridor. Purely decorative.
Rule.Raw: A piece of tunnel support frame used to support tunnels during construction, compact with a corridor for easy access of workers on top and a staircase for reaching the corridor. Purely decorative.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de armazón que sostiene los túneles durante su construcción e incorpora una pasarela superior para los trabajadores, además de una escalera para acceder a ella. Puramente decorativa.

Rule.Original: A mineral outlet, nothing more, nothing less. Purely decorative.
Rule.Raw: A mineral outlet, nothing more, nothing less. Purely decorative.
Rule.Translated: Una salida de minerales, ni más ni menos. Puramente decorativa.

Rule.Original: questDescription->Rumors have been circulating about a collapsed ancient mine that looks worthless on the outside, but may contain vast amounts of resources.\n\nMaybe we could investigate, but it seems to be potentially guarded with ancient defenses.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->Rumors have been circulating about a collapsed ancient mine that looks worthless on the outside, but may contain vast amounts of resources.\n\nMaybe we could investigate, but it seems to be potentially guarded with ancient defenses.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Circulan rumores sobre una antigua mina derrumbada que parece carecer de valor por fuera, pero podría contener enormes cantidades de recursos.\n\nPodríamos investigarla, aunque parece que aún puede estar protegida por defensas antiguas.

Rule.Original: questDescription->[worker_definite] followed the scanner's instructions to find a collapsed mining site nearby. Others might overlook a collapsed mine, but its internal structure likely contains large amounts of salvagable resources.\n\nMaybe we could investigate, but it seems to be potentially guarded with ancient defenses.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->[worker_definite] followed the scanner's instructions to find a collapsed mining site nearby. Others might overlook a collapsed mine, but its internal structure likely contains large amounts of salvagable resources.\n\nMaybe we could investigate, but it seems to be potentially guarded with ancient defenses.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->[worker_definite] ha seguido las indicaciones del escáner y encontrado una mina derrumbada cercana. Otros podrían pasarla por alto, pero su estructura interior probablemente contenga una gran cantidad de recursos recuperables.\n\nPodríamos investigarla, aunque parece que aún puede estar protegida por defensas antiguas.

Rule.Original: questDescription->We have caught wind of an undiscovered, incomplete tunnel construction site. Facilities at that location have been damaged; however, we can still recover a large amount of raw materials and components from it.\n\nThere might still be some automatic defenses in the construction area, but we aren't sure if they'd recognize us as an enemy.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->We have caught wind of an undiscovered, incomplete tunnel construction site. Facilities at that location have been damaged; however, we can still recover a large amount of raw materials and components from it.\n\nThere might still be some automatic defenses in the construction area, but we aren't sure if they'd recognize us as an enemy.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Hemos oído hablar de unas obras de túnel incompletas y aún sin descubrir. Sus instalaciones están dañadas, pero todavía podemos recuperar muchos materiales y componentes.\n\nPuede que queden defensas automáticas en la zona de construcción, aunque no sabemos si nos identificarían como enemigos.

Rule.Original: questDescription->The scanner revealed an undiscovered tunneling site nearby, with varying degrees of damage to its facilities. There will be a significant amount of raw materials and parts recoverable from the ruined technologies. The automatic defense system in the construction area is still operating, so we need to be careful as we are unsure whether we will be percieved as a threat.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->The scanner revealed an undiscovered tunneling site nearby, with varying degrees of damage to its facilities. There will be a significant amount of raw materials and parts recoverable from the ruined technologies. The automatic defense system in the construction area is still operating, so we need to be careful as we are unsure whether we will be percieved as a threat.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->El escáner ha revelado unas obras de túnel cercanas aún sin descubrir, cuyas instalaciones presentan distintos grados de deterioro. Podremos recuperar una cantidad considerable de materiales y piezas de la tecnología en ruinas. El sistema de defensa automática sigue funcionando, por lo que debemos tener cuidado: no sabemos si nos considerará una amenaza.
questName->mina industrial antigua a cielo abierto

Rule.Original: questDescription->We've recieved word of an ancient open-pit mine near us, with an interior that has collapsed on its giant excavator. Although it is no longer usable, its advanced parts are not damaged.\n\nThis may be a trap, but it may also be an opportunity for looting.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->We've recieved word of an ancient open-pit mine near us, with an interior that has collapsed on its giant excavator. Although it is no longer usable, its advanced parts are not damaged.\n\nThis may be a trap, but it may also be an opportunity for looting.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Nos han informado de una antigua mina a cielo abierto cercana cuyo interior se ha derrumbado sobre la excavadora gigante. Aunque ya no se puede utilizar, sus piezas avanzadas siguen intactas.\n\nPodría ser una trampa, pero también una oportunidad de saqueo.
questName->mina industrial antigua a cielo abierto

Rule.Original: questDescription->[worker_definite] recieved signals from an ancient open-pit mine nearby. Despite the collapse of the giant excavators due to years of disrepair, we should still be able to recover a substantial amount of resources and even salvage some advanced components. The damage to other structures is not as severe, and there might be a small amount of resources in these buildings as well.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->[worker_definite] recieved signals from an ancient open-pit mine nearby. Despite the collapse of the giant excavators due to years of disrepair, we should still be able to recover a substantial amount of resources and even salvage some advanced components. The damage to other structures is not as severe, and there might be a small amount of resources in these buildings as well.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->[worker_definite] ha recibido señales de una antigua mina a cielo abierto cercana. Aunque las excavadoras gigantes han cedido tras años de abandono, deberíamos poder recuperar muchos recursos e incluso algunos componentes avanzados. Los daños de otras estructuras son menores y también podrían contener algunos recursos.

Rule.Original: questDescription->A scout from [asker_faction_name] tells us that pioneers from [siteFaction_name] have appeared frequently near [map_definite] recently. By tracking them down, they discovered that they're digging a hole in an ancient iron mine that collapsed. We have been told that they might have set up a temporary encampment within the cave-in. Could we take out the defenders and seize the mine for ourselves?\n\nIt's not going to be easy to dig the hole open, we still have plenty of time.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->A scout from [asker_faction_name] tells us that pioneers from [siteFaction_name] have appeared frequently near [map_definite] recently. By tracking them down, they discovered that they're digging a hole in an ancient iron mine that collapsed. We have been told that they might have set up a temporary encampment within the cave-in. Could we take out the defenders and seize the mine for ourselves?\n\nIt's not going to be easy to dig the hole open, we still have plenty of time.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Un explorador de [asker_faction_name] nos cuenta que últimamente aparecen a menudo pioneros de [siteFaction_name] cerca de [map_definite]. Al seguirlos, descubrió que están abriendo un paso en una antigua mina de hierro derrumbada. Nos han dicho que quizá hayan instalado un campamento temporal dentro del derrumbe. ¿Podríamos eliminar a los defensores y apoderarnos de la mina?\n\nAbrir el paso no será fácil, así que aún tenemos bastante tiempo.

Rule.Original: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Los minerales de la mina se han extraído por completo y solo quedan piedras inútiles. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: They fortified their defenses after our retreat, making it impossible for us to plan another attack. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: They fortified their defenses after our retreat, making it impossible for us to plan another attack. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Tras nuestra retirada han reforzado sus defensas y ya no podemos planear otro ataque. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->Our scanner has detected an old steel mine whose entrance had collapsed, leaving unmined steel inside the mine and a lot of broken equipment from which we could recover a lot of resources. Unfortunateyl we are not the first to discover this steel mine, as other forces are already on the move. The cave collapse may take a long time, and they may be targeting more than just the mineral deposits inside.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->Our scanner has detected an old steel mine whose entrance had collapsed, leaving unmined steel inside the mine and a lot of broken equipment from which we could recover a lot of resources. Unfortunateyl we are not the first to discover this steel mine, as other forces are already on the move. The cave collapse may take a long time, and they may be targeting more than just the mineral deposits inside.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Nuestro escáner ha detectado una antigua mina de acero con la entrada derrumbada. En su interior quedan acero sin extraer y muchos equipos averiados de los que podríamos recuperar recursos. Por desgracia, no somos los primeros en descubrirla y otras fuerzas ya están actuando. Abrir el derrumbe puede llevar mucho tiempo, y quizá busquen algo más que los yacimientos minerales del interior.

Rule.Original: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Los minerales de la mina se han extraído por completo y solo quedan piedras inútiles. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: They fortified their defenses after our retreat, making it impossible for us to plan another attack. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: They fortified their defenses after our retreat, making it impossible for us to plan another attack. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Tras nuestra retirada han reforzado sus defensas y ya no podemos planear otro ataque. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->An explorer from [asker_faction_name] has told us that a group of pioneers from [siteFaction_name] got into a mining site loaded with plasteel. However, the entrance to the mine collapsed leading them to build a temporary base inside. Could we break in and take it for ourselves?
Rule.Raw: questDescription->An explorer from [asker_faction_name] has told us that a group of pioneers from [siteFaction_name] got into a mining site loaded with plasteel. However, the entrance to the mine collapsed leading them to build a temporary base inside. Could we break in and take it for ourselves?
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Un explorador de [asker_faction_name] nos ha contado que un grupo de pioneros de [siteFaction_name] entró en una mina llena de plastiacero. Sin embargo, la entrada se derrumbó y tuvieron que construir una base temporal dentro. ¿Podríamos irrumpir y quedárnosla?

Rule.Original: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Los minerales de la mina se han extraído por completo y solo quedan piedras inútiles. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: They fortified their defenses after our retreat, making it impossible for us to plan another attack. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: They fortified their defenses after our retreat, making it impossible for us to plan another attack. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Tras nuestra retirada han reforzado sus defensas y ya no podemos planear otro ataque. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->The scanners tell us that there is an ancient plasteel mining site nearby. Although the entrance has collapsed, the scanners show that there is still a lot of life inside. If we are going to go there, we'd better take our weapons with us.\n\nSuch a large plasteel deposit is bound to attract the attention of other powers, but most of them take a long time to assemble a mining team, and we can do it faster than them.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->The scanners tell us that there is an ancient plasteel mining site nearby. Although the entrance has collapsed, the scanners show that there is still a lot of life inside. If we are going to go there, we'd better take our weapons with us.\n\nSuch a large plasteel deposit is bound to attract the attention of other powers, but most of them take a long time to assemble a mining team, and we can do it faster than them.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Los escáneres indican que hay una antigua mina de plastiacero cerca. Aunque la entrada se ha derrumbado, aún detectan mucha vida en su interior. Si vamos, será mejor llevar armas.\n\nUn yacimiento de plastiacero tan grande atraerá sin duda a otras potencias, pero la mayoría tardará en reunir un equipo minero. Nosotros podemos hacerlo antes.

Rule.Original: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.

Rule.Translated: Tras nuestra retirada han reforzado sus defensas y ya no podemos planear otro ataque. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->A scout from [asker_faction_name] tells us that [siteFaction_name] is occupying an ancient military uranium mine nearby that they have fully re-occupied. We can be sure that the original defense system of the site has identified them as the new owners, so to seize the uranium mine we'd need to seize the garrison and defense system.\n\n[siteFaction_name] is utilizing the mining site, [asker_faction_name] has given us some time to deal with them ourselves. if we don't deal with them, they will take over.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->A scout from [asker_faction_name] tells us that [siteFaction_name] is occupying an ancient military uranium mine nearby that they have fully re-occupied. We can be sure that the original defense system of the site has identified them as the new owners, so to seize the uranium mine we'd need to seize the garrison and defense system.\n\n[siteFaction_name] is utilizing the mining site, [asker_faction_name] has given us some time to deal with them ourselves. if we don't deal with them, they will take over.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Un explorador de [asker_faction_name] nos cuenta que [siteFaction_name] ha reocupado por completo una antigua mina militar de uranio cercana. Podemos estar seguros de que el sistema de defensa original los ha reconocido como nuevos propietarios, así que para tomar la mina tendremos que vencer a la guarnición y a sus defensas.\n\n[siteFaction_name] está explotando la mina. [asker_faction_name] nos ha dado un tiempo para ocuparnos de ellos por nuestra cuenta; si no lo hacemos, se encargarán ellos.

Rule.Original: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Los minerales de la mina se han extraído por completo y solo quedan piedras inútiles. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Raw: They fortified their defenses after our retreat, making it impossible for us to plan another attack. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Tras nuestra retirada han reforzado sus defensas y ya no podemos planear otro ataque. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->[worker_definite] successfully found an ancient military uranium mine on the scanner, but we are not the first to find it. Unfortunately, someone has occupied it ahead of us and has co-opted the original defense system. We now not only have to face the defenders of the site, but also have to get through their ancient defenses.\n\nThe defenders are currently harvesting the remaining uranium at the site. There is still some time before it is fully looted. We must be well prepared before we move.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->[worker_definite] successfully found an ancient military uranium mine on the scanner, but we are not the first to find it. Unfortunately, someone has occupied it ahead of us and has co-opted the original defense system. We now not only have to face the defenders of the site, but also have to get through their ancient defenses.\n\nThe defenders are currently harvesting the remaining uranium at the site. There is still some time before it is fully looted. We must be well prepared before we move.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->[worker_definite] ha localizado con el escáner una antigua mina militar de uranio, pero no somos los primeros en encontrarla. Por desgracia, alguien la ha ocupado antes y ha tomado el control del sistema de defensa original. Tendremos que enfrentarnos tanto a los ocupantes como a sus defensas antiguas.\n\nLos defensores están extrayendo el uranio restante. Aún queda tiempo antes de que la vacíen por completo. Debemos prepararnos bien antes de actuar.

Rule.Original: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Raw: The minerals in the mine have been completely mined, and only useless stones remain.The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.
Rule.Translated: Los minerales de la mina se han extraído por completo y solo quedan piedras inútiles. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha terminado.
