questName->estación industrial de cribado de minerales

Rule.Original: questDescription->A scout from [asker_faction_name] informed us about an mineral screening station near [map_definite]. Despite the main building being destroyed, the automatic defense system remains operational, and according to the scout we won't be treated as hostile. This implies we can recover most of the resources without hindrance.\n\nIf we choose not to proceed with the raid, [asker_faction_name] will gather these ancient riches instead.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->A scout from [asker_faction_name] informed us about an mineral screening station near [map_definite]. Despite the main building being destroyed, the automatic defense system remains operational, and according to the scout we won't be treated as hostile. This implies we can recover most of the resources without hindrance.\n\nIf we choose not to proceed with the raid, [asker_faction_name] will gather these ancient riches instead.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Un explorador de [asker_faction_name] nos ha informado de una estación de cribado de minerales cerca de [map_definite]. Aunque el edificio principal está destruido, su defensa automática sigue funcionando y, según el explorador, no nos tratará como enemigos. Esto significa que podremos recuperar la mayoría de los recursos sin impedimentos.\n\nSi decidimos no saquearla, [asker_faction_name] se llevará estas riquezas antiguas.

Rule.Original: The mineral screening station has been ransacked by the others. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The mineral screening station has been ransacked by the others. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Otros han saqueado la estación de cribado de minerales. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.
questName->estación industrial de cribado de minerales

Rule.Original: questDescription->[worker_definite] has located an ancient industrial chunk screening station whose buildings are badly damaged, but there are still a lot of recoverable resources. Despite the automatic defense system being in full operation, it somehow does not recognize us as enemies. It can be determined that there is no additional threats on the site. \n\nIt's only a matter of time before the sifting station is ransacked by other factions, and before that we still have [timeoutTicks_duration].
Rule.Raw: questDescription->[worker_definite] has located an ancient industrial chunk screening station whose buildings are badly damaged, but there are still a lot of recoverable resources. Despite the automatic defense system being in full operation, it somehow does not recognize us as enemies. It can be determined that there is no additional threats on the site. \n\nIt's only a matter of time before the sifting station is ransacked by other factions, and before that we still have [timeoutTicks_duration].
Rule.Translated: questDescription->[worker_definite] ha localizado una antigua estación industrial de cribado de bloques con edificios muy dañados, pero aún quedan muchos recursos recuperables. Aunque la defensa automática funciona plenamente, por algún motivo no nos reconoce como enemigos. Podemos determinar que no hay otras amenazas en el lugar. \n\nEs cuestión de tiempo que otras facciones saqueen la estación. Hasta entonces, aún tenemos [timeoutTicks_duration].

Rule.Original: The mineral screening station has been ransacked by the others. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The mineral screening station has been ransacked by the others. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Otros han saqueado la estación de cribado de minerales. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->We have caught wind of a small abandoned mining site nearby that might contain many untapped minerals. It has been mentioned that there may be some threats, although this remains unclear. To heir on the side of caution, we should be well prepared if we plan to venture there.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->We have caught wind of a small abandoned mining site nearby that might contain many untapped minerals. It has been mentioned that there may be some threats, although this remains unclear. To heir on the side of caution, we should be well prepared if we plan to venture there.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Hemos oído hablar de una pequeña mina abandonada cercana que podría contener muchos minerales sin explotar. Se ha mencionado que quizá haya amenazas, aunque no está claro. Por precaución, debemos prepararnos bien si decidimos ir.

Rule.Original: The place has been ransacked by others. There's nothing left. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The place has been ransacked by others. There's nothing left. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Otros han saqueado el lugar. No queda nada. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->The scan revealed a small industrial mining site nearby. However, the scanner did not provide information on the minerals present. The scanner also indicated a potential threat to the location. If we intend to obtain these minerals, we must be prepared.\n\nSooner or later, others will notice this mineral deposit, meaning time is of the essence. We must act swiftly.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->The scan revealed a small industrial mining site nearby. However, the scanner did not provide information on the minerals present. The scanner also indicated a potential threat to the location. If we intend to obtain these minerals, we must be prepared.\n\nSooner or later, others will notice this mineral deposit, meaning time is of the essence. We must act swiftly.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->El escáner ha revelado una pequeña mina industrial cercana, pero no ha proporcionado información sobre sus minerales. También ha señalado una posible amenaza. Si queremos obtener esos recursos, debemos prepararnos.\n\nTarde o temprano otros descubrirán el yacimiento, así que el tiempo apremia. Debemos actuar deprisa.

Rule.Original: The place has been ransacked by others. There's nothing left. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The place has been ransacked by others. There's nothing left. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: Otros han saqueado el lugar. No queda nada. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: A mine whose entrance has collapsed. Seemingly guarded.
Rule.Raw: A mine whose entrance has collapsed. Seemingly guarded.
Rule.Translated: Una mina cuya entrada se ha derrumbado. Parece estar vigilada.
mina industrial antigua a cielo abierto

Rule.Original: An abandoned mine, among them was the remains of a huge excavator.
Rule.Raw: An abandoned mine, among them was the remains of a huge excavator.
Rule.Translated: Una mina abandonada entre cuyos restos hay una excavadora enorme.

Rule.Original: An iron mine with a lot of untapped iron ore.
Rule.Raw: An iron mine with a lot of untapped iron ore.
Rule.Translated: Una mina de hierro con mucho mineral de hierro sin explotar.

Rule.Original: An occupied military uranium mine, heavily defended.
Rule.Raw: An occupied military uranium mine, heavily defended.
Rule.Translated: Una mina militar de uranio ocupada y fuertemente defendida.

Rule.Original: A glass reinforced plasteel mine with a large amount of untapped glass reinforced plasteel deposits.
Rule.Raw: A glass reinforced plasteel mine with a large amount of untapped glass reinforced plasteel deposits.
Rule.Translated: Una mina de plastacero reforzado con vidrio, con abundantes depósitos de este material sin explotar.
estación industrial de cribado de minerales

Rule.Original: An abandoned sifting station with a lot of recyclable resources in the wreckage.
Rule.Raw: An abandoned sifting station with a lot of recyclable resources in the wreckage.
Rule.Translated: Una estación de cribado abandonada con muchos recursos reciclables entre sus restos.

Rule.Original: An abandoned mine with a lot of unmined minerals.
Rule.Raw: An abandoned mine with a lot of unmined minerals.
Rule.Translated: Una mina abandonada con muchos minerales sin extraer.

Rule.Original: A device tuned to detect a range of frequencies once commonly used by ancient civilization. You can tune towards specific frequencies to discover the location of lost ancient sites.
Rule.Raw: A device tuned to detect a range of frequencies once commonly used by ancient civilization. You can tune towards specific frequencies to discover the location of lost ancient sites.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo ajustado para detectar frecuencias que utilizaba habitualmente una civilización antigua. Puedes sintonizar frecuencias concretas para descubrir la ubicación de lugares antiguos perdidos.
Estación industrial de cribado de minerales

Rule.Original: Turns 1 stabilized alloypack into 1 Plasteel, 1 Gold and 2 Steel.
Rule.Raw: Turns 1 stabilized alloypack into 1 Plasteel, 1 Gold and 2 Steel.
Rule.Translated: Transforma 1 desecho de aleación estabilizada en 1 de plastiacero, 1 de oro y 2 de acero.
Reciclar residuos en paquetes de productos químicos reactivos

Rule.Original: Use manual labor to recycle toxic wastepacks into reactive chempacks, creating reclaimed biopacks as a byproduct.
Rule.Raw: Use manual labor to recycle toxic wastepacks into reactive chempacks, creating reclaimed biopacks as a byproduct.
Rule.Translated: Trabajo manual para reciclar paquetes de residuos tóxicos en paquetes de productos químicos reactivos, creando biopacks recuperados como subproducto.
Reciclando residuos en paquetes de productos químicos reactivos
Reciclar paquetes de productos químicos reactivos en combustible químico

Rule.Original: Use manual labor to separate viable chemfuel from trash in reactive chempacks.
Rule.Raw: Use manual labor to separate viable chemfuel from trash in reactive chempacks.
Rule.Translated: Trabajo manual para separar el combustible químico viable de los desechos en los paquetes de productos químicos reactivos.
Reciclando paquetes de productos químicos reactivos en combustible químico
Reciclar residuos en productos tóxicos volátiles

Rule.Original: Use manual labor to recycle toxic wastepacks into volatile toxpacks, creating trash as a byproduct.
Rule.Raw: Use manual labor to recycle toxic wastepacks into volatile toxpacks, creating trash as a byproduct.
Rule.Translated: Trabajo manual para reciclar paquetes de residuos tóxicos en productos tóxicos volátiles, creando desechos como subproducto.
Reciclando residuos en productos tóxicos volátiles

Rule.Original: recycle volatile toxpacks into isotopacks and alloypacks
Rule.Raw: recycle volatile toxpacks into isotopacks and alloypacks
Rule.Translated: Reciclar productos tóxicos volátiles en paquetes isotópicos y paquetes de aleación

Rule.Original: Use manual labor to recycle volatile toxpacks into stabilized alloypacks and radioactive isotopacks.
Rule.Raw: Use manual labor to recycle volatile toxpacks into stabilized alloypacks and radioactive isotopacks.
Rule.Translated: Trabajo manual para reciclar productos tóxicos volátiles en paquetes de aleación estabilizados y paquetes isotópicos radioactivos.

Rule.Original: Recycling volatile toxpacks into isotopacks and alloypacks.
Rule.Raw: Recycling volatile toxpacks into isotopacks and alloypacks.
Rule.Translated: Reciclando productos tóxicos volátiles en paquetes isotópicos y paquetes de aleación
Reciclar paquetes isotópicos radioactivos en uranio

Rule.Original: Use manual labor to separate viable uranium from trash in radioactive isotopacks.
Rule.Raw: Use manual labor to separate viable uranium from trash in radioactive isotopacks.
Rule.Translated: Trabajo manual para separar uranio viable de los desechos en paquetes isotópicos radioactivos.
Reciclando paquetes isotópicos radioactivos en uranio

Rule.Original: Discover basic recycling, giving you the ability to recycle wastepacks into a variety of different resources.
Rule.Raw: Discover basic recycling, giving you the ability to recycle wastepacks into a variety of different resources.
Rule.Translated: Descubre el reciclaje básico, que te permite reciclar paquetes de residuos en una variedad de recursos diferentes.

Rule.Original: Learn to recycle isotopacks and alloypacks into new resources and build garbage compactors to craft trashbricks.
Rule.Raw: Learn to recycle isotopacks and alloypacks into new resources and build garbage compactors to craft trashbricks.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a reciclar paquetes isotópicos y paquetes de aleación en nuevos recursos y construye compactadores de desechos para fabricar ladrillos de desechos.

Rule.Original: A large, groundwater-filtering pump which slowly cleans large swathes of polluted terrain. The extracted pollution is formed into toxic wastepacks which must be hauled away.
Rule.Raw: A large, groundwater-filtering pump which slowly cleans large swathes of polluted terrain. The extracted pollution is formed into toxic wastepacks which must be hauled away.
Rule.Translated: Una gran bomba de filtración de aguas subterráneas que limpia lentamente grandes extensiones de terreno contaminado. La contaminación extraída se transforma en desechos tóxicos que deben ser eliminados.

Rule.Original: A rapidly-working, groundwater-filtering pump which cleans polluted terrain. The extracted pollution is formed into toxic wastepacks which must be hauled away. It requires a large amount of electricity to work, but it works extremely quickly.
Rule.Raw: A rapidly-working, groundwater-filtering pump which cleans polluted terrain. The extracted pollution is formed into toxic wastepacks which must be hauled away. It requires a large amount of electricity to work, but it works extremely quickly.
Rule.Translated: Una bomba de filtración de aguas subterráneas de funcionamiento rápido que limpia el terreno contaminado. La contaminación extraída se transforma en desechos tóxicos que deben ser eliminados. Requiere una gran cantidad de electricidad para funcionar, pero es muy rápida.

Rule.Original: A hermetically sealed container that prevents toxic waste stored inside from dissolving and leaking into the environment. Can only hold a limited amount of waste. Does nothing to prevent the waste from burning.
Rule.Raw: A hermetically sealed container that prevents toxic waste stored inside from dissolving and leaking into the environment. Can only hold a limited amount of waste. Does nothing to prevent the waste from burning.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor herméticamente cerrado que impide que los desechos tóxicos almacenados en su interior se disuelvan y se esparzan por el entorno. Solo puede contener una cantidad limitada de desechos. No evita que los desechos se quemen.

Rule.Original: A workbench for recycling wastepacks into other resources. Works at 50% of the speed of an electric recycling workbench.
Rule.Raw: A workbench for recycling wastepacks into other resources. Works at 50% of the speed of an electric recycling workbench.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa para reciclar los desechos tóxicos en otros recursos. Funciona al 50% de la velocidad de una mesa de reciclaje eléctrica.

Rule.Original: A workbench with automated sorters and electric tools, used in recycling wastepacks into other resources. Can work without electricity at 50% of normal speed.
Rule.Raw: A workbench with automated sorters and electric tools, used in recycling wastepacks into other resources. Can work without electricity at 50% of normal speed.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa con clasificadores automatizados y herramientas eléctricas, utilizada para reciclar los desechos tóxicos en otros recursos. Puede funcionar sin electricidad al 50% de la velocidad normal.

Rule.Original: An industrial-tech device that condenses trash using hydraulic press into trashbricks. While it does not neutralize the trash completely, it allows for a creation of a construction resource out of it. The process requires considerable amounts of power and emits tox gas during operation.
Rule.Raw: An industrial-tech device that condenses trash using hydraulic press into trashbricks. While it does not neutralize the trash completely, it allows for a creation of a construction resource out of it. The process requires considerable amounts of power and emits tox gas during operation.
Rule.Translated: Un aparato de tecnología industrial que condensa los desechos mediante una prensa hidráulica para fabricar ladrillos de desechos. Aunque no neutraliza completamente los desechos, permite crear un recurso de construcción a partir de ellos. El proceso requiere cantidades considerables de energía y emite gas tóxico durante su funcionamiento.

Rule.Original: A spacertech device that separates stabilized alloypacks into steel, plasteel and gold compounds. This process takes a long time and requires a lot of power.\n\nConsider that the building will need free space behind it to produce its output!
Rule.Raw: A spacertech device that separates stabilized alloypacks into steel, plasteel and gold compounds. This process takes a long time and requires a lot of power.\n\nConsider that the building will need free space behind it to produce its output!
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de tecnología espacial que separa los desechos de aleaciones estabilizadas en compuestos de acero, plastiacero y oro. Este proceso lleva mucho tiempo y requiere mucha energía.

Rule.Original: A repurposed package of nutrient-rich bio-material, recovered from toxic waste through advanced recycling processes. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Reclaimed Biopacks improve soil fertility if a stack of 5 of them deteriorate on standard soil. If damaged or burned, they emit a small amount of disgusting rot stink.
Rule.Raw: A repurposed package of nutrient-rich bio-material, recovered from toxic waste through advanced recycling processes. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Reclaimed Biopacks improve soil fertility if a stack of 5 of them deteriorate on standard soil. If damaged or burned, they emit a small amount of disgusting rot stink.
Rule.Translated: Un paquete reciclado de biomateriales ricos en nutrientes, recuperados a partir de desechos tóxicos gracias a procesos de reciclaje avanzados. Su apertura está termosellada para un transporte seguro.\n\nLos biodesechos reciclados mejoran la fertilidad del suelo si se deterioran sobre un terreno estándar. Si se dañan o queman, liberan un ligero gas pestilente.

Rule.Original: A volatile package of highly reactive chemicals, generated as a byproduct of recycling toxic waste. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Reactive Chempacks are extremely dangerous and can cause devastating explosions if not handled carefully. If damaged or burned, they may explode in a big fireball.
Rule.Raw: A volatile package of highly reactive chemicals, generated as a byproduct of recycling toxic waste. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Reactive Chempacks are extremely dangerous and can cause devastating explosions if not handled carefully. If damaged or burned, they may explode in a big fireball.
Rule.Translated: Un paquete volátil de productos químicos altamente reactivos, generado como subproducto del reciclaje de desechos tóxicos. Su apertura está termosellada para un transporte seguro.\n\nLos desechos químicos reactivos son extremadamente peligrosos y pueden provocar explosiones devastadoras si no se manipulan con precaución. Si se dañan o queman, pueden explotar en una gran bola de fuego.

Rule.Original: An amalgamation of strong and lightweight alloys, synthesized from toxic waste through complex chemical reactions. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Stabilized Alloypacks contain high-quality material for crafting advanced weapons, armor, and components. If damaged or burned, they release a small puff of non-toxic smoke.
Rule.Raw: An amalgamation of strong and lightweight alloys, synthesized from toxic waste through complex chemical reactions. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Stabilized Alloypacks contain high-quality material for crafting advanced weapons, armor, and components. If damaged or burned, they release a small puff of non-toxic smoke.
Rule.Translated: Una amalgama de aleaciones sólidas y ligeras, sintetizadas a partir de desechos tóxicos mediante reacciones químicas complejas. Su apertura está termosellada para un transporte seguro.\n\nLos desechos de aleaciones estabilizadas contienen materiales de alta calidad para la fabricación de armas, armaduras y componentes avanzados. Si se dañan o queman, liberan una pequeña cantidad de humo no tóxico.

Rule.Original: An unstable package of highly concentrated toxic waste, created as a byproduct in more complex recycling projects. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Volatile toxpacks are extremely dangerous due to their instability and propensity to emit large amounts of tox gas and pollution. If burned or damaged, they release a massive cloud of deadly tox gas.

Volatile toxpacks are extremely dangerous due to their instability and propensity to emit large amounts of tox gas and pollution. If burned or damaged, they release a massive cloud of deadly tox gas.

Su apertura está termosellada para un transporte seguro.\n\nLos desechos tóxicos volátiles son extremadamente peligrosos debido a su inestabilidad y propensión a emitir grandes cantidades de gases tóxicos y contaminación. Si se queman o dañan, liberan una nube masiva y mortal de gas tóxico.

Rule.Original: A hazardous package of radioactive isotopes, resulting from the recycling of toxic waste. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Radioactive Isotopacks emit high levels of radiation, posing a serious threat to the health of colonists and animals. If damaged or burned, they release a burst of dangerous radiation.

Rule.Original: A package of non-toxic rubbish, carefully sorted and compacted for efficient storage. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Trash poses no risk of pollution or deterioration, making it safe for long-term storage. However, if burned, trash will release a moderate amount of tox gas as a byproduct of combustion.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age four times as fast as a standard baseliner.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age four times as fast as a standard baseliner.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen una mutación artificial en su material genético que les hace envejecer cuatro veces más rápido que un humano estándar.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age twice as fast as a standard baseliner.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age twice as fast as a standard baseliner.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen una mutación artificial en su material genético que les hace envejecer el doble de rápido que un humano estándar.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age much slower than a standard baseliner.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have an artificial mutation in their genetic material, causing them to age much slower than a standard baseliner.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen una mutación artificial en su material genético que les hace envejecer mucho más lentamente que un humano estándar.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene grow a short, curly tail that does not serve any purpose.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene grow a short, curly tail that does not serve any purpose.
Rule.Translated: A los portadores de este gen les crece una cola corta y rizada, que no tiene ningún propósito espacial.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene grow two small tusks protruding from the jaw.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene grow two small tusks protruding from the jaw.
Rule.Translated: A los portadores de este gen les crecen dos pequeños colmillos que sobresalen de la mandíbula inferior.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have muddy light brown skin.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have muddy light brown skin.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen la piel de un color marrón claro como el barro.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have light tan hazelnut-like skin.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have light tan hazelnut-like skin.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen la piel de un color avellana claro.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have muddy dark red-brown skin.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have muddy dark red-brown skin.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen la piel de un color marrón oscuro rojizo.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have much more dense meat and fat tissue, resulting in greater meat yield when butchered.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have much more dense meat and fat tissue, resulting in greater meat yield when butchered.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen unos tejidos musculares y adiposos mucho más densos, lo que se traduce en una mayor cantidad de carne obtenida al ser despiezados.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have very thin meat and fat tissue, resulting in much smaller meat yield when butchered.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have very thin meat and fat tissue, resulting in much smaller meat yield when butchered.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen unos tejidos musculares y adiposos muy finos, lo que se traduce en una menor cantidad de carne obtenida al ser despiezados.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have improved regenerating factors in their DNA, allowing them to slowly regenerate organs that may even be completely missing. The process is slow, and will prioritize healing existing, but damaged, organs.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have improved regenerating factors in their DNA, allowing them to slowly regenerate organs that may even be completely missing. The process is slow, and will prioritize healing existing, but damaged, organs.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen cuentan con unos factores regeneradores mejorados en su ADN, lo que les permite regenerar lentamente incluso órganos que falten por completo. El proceso es lento y da prioridad a la curación de los órganos existentes, pero dañados.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have elastic, bottomless stomachs and are capable of consuming twice as much food.\n\nThey will become increasingly unhappy if hungry, and most mental breaks will be food binges.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have elastic, bottomless stomachs and are capable of consuming twice as much food.\n\nThey will become increasingly unhappy if hungry, and most mental breaks will be food binges.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen estómagos elásticos, casi sin fondo. Son básicamente capaces de consumir el doble de comida.\n\nSe sentirán cada vez más infelices si pasan hambre, y la mayoría de los colapsos mentales estarán relacionados con la comida.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene will yield pigskin when butchered. Wearing pigskin clothing by them is classed as wearing human leather clothing.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene will yield pigskin when butchered. Wearing pigskin clothing by them is classed as wearing human leather clothing.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen producirán piel de cerdo al ser despiezados.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have traces of pork in their flesh. Consuming pork by them is classed as cannibalism. When butchered, they will yield pork instead of human meat.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have traces of pork in their flesh. Consuming pork by them is classed as cannibalism. When butchered, they will yield pork instead of human meat.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen una carne que recuerda a la de los cerdos en sus cuerpos. Considerarán el consumo de cerdo como canibalismo. Cuando son despiezados, producen carne de cerdo en lugar de carne humana.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene are much more prone to repond to nervous situations by cowering, hiding, or even going catatonic.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene are much more prone to repond to nervous situations by cowering, hiding, or even going catatonic.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen son mucho más propensos a responder a situaciones difíciles acobardándose, escondiéndose o incluso volviéndose catatónicos.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene are much more resilient to stress and exhibit behaviors typically classified as brave.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene are much more resilient to stress and exhibit behaviors typically classified as brave.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen son mucho más resistentes al estrés, y muestran comportamientos típicamente clasificados como valientes.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene do not stop growing until they reach a biological age of 60. They will keep increasing in size, reaching gargantuan sizes.\n\nAs they grow, they will become slower, but also stagger-immune. With size, their health pool will also increase.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene do not stop growing until they reach a biological age of 60. They will keep increasing in size, reaching gargantuan sizes.\n\nAs they grow, they will become slower, but also stagger-immune. With size, their health pool will also increase.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen no dejan de crecer hasta que alcanzan una edad biológica de 60 años. Tras la adolescencia, seguirán aumentando de tamaño hasta alcanzar tamaños realmente monstruosos.\n\nA medida que crezcan, se volverán más lentos, pero también inmunes al aturdimiento. Con el tamaño, su cantidad de puntos de impacto también aumentará.

Rule.Original: Boarskins, a formidable subspecies born from pigskins during captivity, stand as the vanguard of the revolution that ended their exploitation for organ farming. These human-boar hybrids navigate on two legs, wield tools, and communicate verbally, blending human intellect with the robustness of boars. Their resilience allows them to consume a diverse diet without ill effects, though their trotter hands impede fine manipulation.\n\nOriginating from a desperate attempt to avoid the ethical dilemma of harvesting organs from standard humans, Boarskins were an unforeseen outcome of blending human genes with those of pigs to yield more compatible organs. This initiative backfired, giving rise to entities far more anthropomorphic than intended. Boarskins, evolved from pigskins under duress, exhibit enhanced strength, courage, and a pronounced aggression, reflecting their tumultuous genesis and pivotal role in securing autonomy for their kin.
Rule.Raw: Boarskins, a formidable subspecies born from pigskins during captivity, stand as the vanguard of the revolution that ended their exploitation for organ farming. These human-boar hybrids navigate on two legs, wield tools, and communicate verbally, blending human intellect with the robustness of boars. Their resilience allows them to consume a diverse diet without ill effects, though their trotter hands impede fine manipulation.\n\nOriginating from a desperate attempt to avoid the ethical dilemma of harvesting organs from standard humans, Boarskins were an unforeseen outcome of blending human genes with those of pigs to yield more compatible organs. This initiative backfired, giving rise to entities far more anthropomorphic than intended. Boarskins, evolved from pigskins under duress, exhibit enhanced strength, courage, and a pronounced aggression, reflecting their tumultuous genesis and pivotal role in securing autonomy for their kin.
Rule.Translated: Los jabaleros, una formidable subespecie nacida de cerderos durante su cautiverio, son la vanguardia de la revolución que puso fin a su explotación para la cría de órganos. Estos híbridos de humano y jabalí se desplazan a dos patas, manejan herramientas y se comunican verbalmente, combinando el intelecto humano con la robustez de los jabalíes. Su resistencia les permite consumir una dieta variada sin efectos nocivos, aunque sus manos apezuñadas les impide la manipulación precisa.\n\nSurgidos de un intento desesperado de evitar el dilema ético de extraer órganos de humanos estándar, los jabaleros fueron el inesperado resultado de mezclar genes humanos con genes de cerdo para obtener órganos más compatibles. La iniciativa salió mal y dio lugar a entidades mucho más antropomórficas de lo previsto. Los jabaleros, que evolucionaron a partir de cerderos bajo estrés, muestran una mayor fuerza, valor y agresividad, lo que refleja su tumultuosa génesis y su papel fundamental para garantizar la autonomía de sus congéneres.

Rule.Original: Boarskins are a rare mutation of the human-pig hybrids. They are hardy, strong and brave, can eat almost anything without getting sick, but their trotter-shaped hands are bad at fine manipulation. They have better sight than their pigskin brethren, but they are aggressive and age rapidly.
Rule.Raw: Boarskins are a rare mutation of the human-pig hybrids. They are hardy, strong and brave, can eat almost anything without getting sick, but their trotter-shaped hands are bad at fine manipulation. They have better sight than their pigskin brethren, but they are aggressive and age rapidly.
Rule.Translated: Los jabalipiel son una rara mutación de los híbridos humano-cerdo. Son resistentes, fuertes y valientes, y pueden comer casi cualquier cosa sin enfermar, pero sus manos en forma de pezuña dificultan la manipulación fina. Tienen mejor visión que sus parientes piel de cerdo, aunque son agresivos y envejecen deprisa.

Rule.Original: A type of triangular sail that is rigged to a mast at an angle, allowing for efficient sailing close to the wind. Lateen sails were particularly advantageous for long-distance voyages and exploration during the Age of Discovery.
Rule.Raw: A type of triangular sail that is rigged to a mast at an angle, allowing for efficient sailing close to the wind. Lateen sails were particularly advantageous for long-distance voyages and exploration during the Age of Discovery.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de vela triangular montada en ángulo respecto al mástil que permite navegar eficazmente cerca de la dirección del viento. Las velas latinas fueron muy útiles en los viajes largos y la exploración durante la Era de los Descubrimientos.

Rule.Original: Naval tactics encompass strategies and maneuvers employed by naval forces during maritime engagements. These tactics allow the construction of larger, more efficient naval vessels, but they require complex machines to be built.
Rule.Raw: Naval tactics encompass strategies and maneuvers employed by naval forces during maritime engagements. These tactics allow the construction of larger, more efficient naval vessels, but they require complex machines to be built.
Rule.Translated: Las tácticas navales incluyen las estrategias y maniobras utilizadas por las fuerzas navales en enfrentamientos marítimos. Permiten construir buques más grandes y eficientes, pero exigen máquinas complejas.

Rule.Original: Masts and sails necessary for propulsion and navigation of a sailing ship.
Rule.Raw: Masts and sails necessary for propulsion and navigation of a sailing ship.
Rule.Translated: Mástiles y velas necesarios para la propulsión y navegación de un velero.

Rule.Original: A system of ropes, cables and chains which support and control a sailing ship's masts and sails.
Rule.Raw: A system of ropes, cables and chains which support and control a sailing ship's masts and sails.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de cabos, cables y cadenas que sostienen y controlan los mástiles y las velas de un velero.

Rule.Original: Devices used aboard a ship to measure and monitor various factors such as wind speed, direction, depth of water, and navigation data, aiding sailors in safe and efficient navigation.
Rule.Raw: Devices used aboard a ship to measure and monitor various factors such as wind speed, direction, depth of water, and navigation data, aiding sailors in safe and efficient navigation.
Rule.Translated: Dispositivos utilizados a bordo para medir y vigilar factores como la velocidad y dirección del viento, la profundidad del agua y los datos de navegación, y ayudar a los marineros a navegar de forma segura y eficiente.

Rule.Original: Panels of wood reinforced to withstand both impact and water pressure.
Rule.Raw: Panels of wood reinforced to withstand both impact and water pressure.
Rule.Translated: Paneles de madera reforzados para resistir tanto los impactos como la presión del agua.

Rule.Original: An air duct used by the AC network to transport air between the AC units and compressors.
Rule.Raw: An air duct used by the AC network to transport air between the AC units and compressors.
Rule.Translated: Un conducto de aire utilizado por la red de climatización para transportar aire entre las unidades de aire acondicionado y los compresores.
Permite activar o desactivar el flujo de aire.

Rule.Original: A subterranean air duct used by the AC network to transport air between the AC units and compressors.
Rule.Raw: A subterranean air duct used by the AC network to transport air between the AC units and compressors.
Rule.Translated: Un conducto de aire subterráneo utilizado por la red de climatización para transportar aire entre las unidades de aire acondicionado y los compresores.

Rule.Original: A main air conditioning control unit. Connects to compressors to allow AC units to generate cool or hot air. Needs to be connected to compressors by air ducts. AC control unit dictates the desired temperature for all AC units in the same network. Installing too many AC units may decrease the efficiency of the network, increasing the power drain of all devices. Constructing additional compressors will improve the efficiency of the network.
Rule.Raw: A main air conditioning control unit. Connects to compressors to allow AC units to generate cool or hot air. Needs to be connected to compressors by air ducts. AC control unit dictates the desired temperature for all AC units in the same network. Installing too many AC units may decrease the efficiency of the network, increasing the power drain of all devices. Constructing additional compressors will improve the efficiency of the network.
Rule.Translated: La unidad principal de control de un sistema de climatización. Se conecta a los compresores para que las unidades de aire acondicionado puedan generar aire frío o caliente. Debe conectarse a los compresores mediante conductos de aire. La unidad de control de climatización es la que dicta la temperatura deseada para todas las unidades de aire acondicionado de su misma red. Instalar demasiadas unidades de aire acondicionado puede disminuir la eficiencia de la red, aumentando el consumo de energía de todos los dispositivos. La construcción de compresores adicionales mejorará la eficiencia de la red.

Rule.Original: An air-conditioning machine that fits into a wall. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts.
Rule.Raw: An air-conditioning machine that fits into a wall. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de aire acondicionado que se comporta como un muro. Emite aire frío o caliente en la misma dirección, dependiendo de la temperatura actual de la habitación. A menos que se desvincule de los ajustes de la red, intentará alcanzar la temperatura especificada en la unidad de control de climatización. Debe conectarse a la unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted air-conditioning machine. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted air-conditioning machine. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de aire acondicionado que se monta sobre un muro. Emite aire frío o caliente en la misma dirección, dependiendo de la temperatura actual de la habitación. A menos que se desvincule de los ajustes de la red, intentará alcanzar la temperatura especificada en la unidad de control de climatización. Debe conectarse a la unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente.

Rule.Original: An air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate two additional AC devices without losing efficiency.
Rule.Raw: An air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate two additional AC devices without losing efficiency.
Rule.Translated: Un compresor de aire acondicionado que debe conectarse a una unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire. Solo puede colocarse en el exterior. Cuando está alimentado, permite que la red de climatización haga funcionar dos dispositivos de climatización adicionales sin perder eficiencia.

Rule.Original: A large air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate six additional AC devices without losing efficiency.
Rule.Raw: A large air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate six additional AC devices without losing efficiency.
Rule.Translated: Un compresor de aire acondicionado grande que debe conectarse a una unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire. Solo puede colocarse en el exterior. Cuando está alimentado, permite que la red de climatización haga funcionar seis dispositivos de climatización adicionales sin perder eficiencia.

Rule.Original: Build a reliable air conditioning system connecting AC control units and compressors to AC units via air ducts.
Rule.Raw: Build a reliable air conditioning system connecting AC control units and compressors to AC units via air ducts.
Rule.Translated: Construye un sistema de aire acondicionado fiable conectando entre sí unidades de control y compresores con unidades de aire acondicionado mediante conductos de aire.

Rule.Original: A large, industrial-type heater machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. It is capable of heating up the room to a much higher temperature than the standard heaters.
Rule.Raw: A large, industrial-type heater machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. It is capable of heating up the room to a much higher temperature than the standard heaters.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de calefacción de grandes dimensiones que se comporta como un muro. Convierte la energía eléctrica en calor. Puede encenderse o apagarse automáticamente para mantener una temperatura determinada. Es capaz de calentar la habitación a una temperatura mucho más alta que los calefactores estándar.

Rule.Original: A large, industrial-type air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. It’s capable of cooling the room to much lower temperature than the standard cooler.
Rule.Raw: A large, industrial-type air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. It’s capable of cooling the room to much lower temperature than the standard cooler.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de refrigeración de aire de grandes dimensiones que se comporta como un muro. El aire frío sale por un lado y el caliente, por el otro. Puede utilizarse para enfriar habitaciones en verano o para crear cámaras frigoríficas. Es capaz de enfriar la habitación a una temperatura mucho más baja que el refrigerador estándar.

Rule.Original: A heating machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can be used to heat up rooms during winter.
Rule.Raw: A heating machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can be used to heat up rooms during winter.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de calefacción que se comporta como una pared. Convierte la energía eléctrica en calor. Puede encenderse o apagarse automáticamente para mantener una temperatura determinada. Puede utilizarse para calentar habitaciones en invierno.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted device that converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted device that converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de calefacción de pared que transforma la energía eléctrica en calor. Puede encenderse o apagarse automáticamente para mantener una temperatura determinada. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de refrigeración de aire de pared. El aire frío sale por un lado y el caliente, por el otro. Puede utilizarse para enfriar habitaciones en verano o para crear cámaras frigoríficas. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente.

Rule.Original: A simple, wall-mounted vent for equalizing the temperature between two rooms without allowing people to walk between them. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Raw: A simple, wall-mounted vent for equalizing the temperature between two rooms without allowing people to walk between them. Can only be constructed on a wall.
Rule.Translated: Una sencilla rejilla de ventilación de pared que permite igualar la temperatura entre dos habitaciones a la vez que impide el paso de personas. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente.

Rule.Original: A free standing air-cooling machine. Cool air comes out of a fan and spreads over surrounding area. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food.
Rule.Raw: A free standing air-cooling machine. Cool air comes out of a fan and spreads over surrounding area. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de refrigeración de aire independiente. El aire frío sale de un ventilador y se esparce por los alrededores. Puede utilizarse para enfriar habitaciones en verano. No es lo bastante eficaz como para refrigerar alimentos.

Rule.Original: A ceiling-mounted fan. Can be used to slowly cool down rooms during the summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food, it will aim to reach a room temperature of 17C.
Rule.Raw: A ceiling-mounted fan. Can be used to slowly cool down rooms during the summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food, it will aim to reach a room temperature of 17C.
Rule.Translated: Un ventilador montado en el techo. Puede utilizarse para enfriar lentamente las habitaciones en verano. No es lo bastante eficaz como para refrigerar alimentos, ya que no puede reducir la temperatura por debajo de los 17 ºC.

Rule.Original: A large, ceiling-mounted fan. Can be used to quickly cool down rooms during the summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food, it will aim to reach a room temperature of 17C.
Rule.Raw: A large, ceiling-mounted fan. Can be used to quickly cool down rooms during the summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food, it will aim to reach a room temperature of 17C.
Rule.Translated: Un ventilador grande montado en el techo. Puede utilizarse para enfriar lentamente las habitaciones en verano. No es lo bastante eficaz como para refrigerar alimentos, ya que no puede reducir la temperatura por debajo de los 17 ºC.

Rule.Original: A barrel for fermenting various things into other products. It is not limited to fermenting a specific thing, so you could call it a "universal fermenter".
Rule.Raw: A barrel for fermenting various things into other products. It is not limited to fermenting a specific thing, so you could call it a "universal fermenter".
Rule.Translated: Un barril para fermentar distintas cosas y convertirlas en otros productos. No se limita a una materia concreta, así que podría llamarse «fermentador universal».

Rule.Original: The Northern Horse is a robust hoofed mammal boasting a dense, insulating fur, a formidable mane, and a bushy tail. Evolved to thrive in frigid climates, these horses are well-equipped for harsh winters, with their thick coat providing ample protection against biting cold. Domesticated by northern tribes for generations, these hardy steeds are valued for their endurance and resilience in traversing snow-covered landscapes. When harnessed in caravans, Northern Horses prove invaluable, their strength and surefootedness aiding in navigating treacherous terrain and speeding the caravan's progress through icy expanses.
Rule.Raw: The Northern Horse is a robust hoofed mammal boasting a dense, insulating fur, a formidable mane, and a bushy tail. Evolved to thrive in frigid climates, these horses are well-equipped for harsh winters, with their thick coat providing ample protection against biting cold. Domesticated by northern tribes for generations, these hardy steeds are valued for their endurance and resilience in traversing snow-covered landscapes. When harnessed in caravans, Northern Horses prove invaluable, their strength and surefootedness aiding in navigating treacherous terrain and speeding the caravan's progress through icy expanses.
Rule.Translated: El caballo del norte es un robusto mamífero ungulado con pelaje denso y aislante, una imponente crin y una cola tupida. Evolucionó para prosperar en climas gélidos y su espeso pelaje lo protege de los inviernos más duros. Domesticado durante generaciones por las tribus del norte, se aprecia por su resistencia y su capacidad para atravesar paisajes cubiertos de nieve. En las caravanas resulta inestimable: su fuerza y paso seguro ayudan a cruzar terrenos peligrosos y aceleran el avance por extensiones heladas.

Rule.Original: The barbarian banner is a fierce and intimidating symbol, crafted from a sturdy wooden shield and adorned with the skulls and horns of defeated foes. The banner is mounted on a tall standard, and is sure to strike fear into the hearts of any who behold it. The skull and bones design on the banner represents the ferocity and power of the barbarian tribe, and serves as a warning to all who would dare to challenge them.
Rule.Raw: The barbarian banner is a fierce and intimidating symbol, crafted from a sturdy wooden shield and adorned with the skulls and horns of defeated foes. The banner is mounted on a tall standard, and is sure to strike fear into the hearts of any who behold it. The skull and bones design on the banner represents the ferocity and power of the barbarian tribe, and serves as a warning to all who would dare to challenge them.
Rule.Translated: El estandarte bárbaro es un símbolo feroz e intimidante, fabricado con un resistente escudo de madera y adornado con cráneos y cuernos de enemigos derrotados. Se monta sobre un asta alta y está pensado para sembrar el miedo entre quienes lo contemplan. Su decoración de cráneos y huesos representa la ferocidad y el poder de la tribu bárbara y sirve de advertencia a cualquiera que ose desafiarla.

Rule.Original: The barbarian banner is a symbol of the tribe's strength and ferocity, crafted through a ritualistic process that involves reinforcing a wooden shield with stone blocks, and adorning it with the skulls and horns of defeated foes. The process is not only technical but also spiritual, as the tribe's craftspersons imbue the banner with the tribe's power and ferocity through the use of materials and symbolic decorations. The end result is a fierce and intimidating symbol that strikes fear into the hearts of all who behold it, and serves as a warning to any who would dare to challenge the tribe.
Rule.Raw: The barbarian banner is a symbol of the tribe's strength and ferocity, crafted through a ritualistic process that involves reinforcing a wooden shield with stone blocks, and adorning it with the skulls and horns of defeated foes. The process is not only technical but also spiritual, as the tribe's craftspersons imbue the banner with the tribe's power and ferocity through the use of materials and symbolic decorations. The end result is a fierce and intimidating symbol that strikes fear into the hearts of all who behold it, and serves as a warning to any who would dare to challenge the tribe.
Rule.Translated: El estandarte bárbaro simboliza la fuerza y ferocidad de la tribu. Se fabrica mediante un proceso ritual que refuerza un escudo de madera con bloques de piedra y lo adorna con cráneos y cuernos de enemigos derrotados. El proceso no es solo técnico, sino también espiritual: los artesanos impregnan el estandarte con el poder y la ferocidad de la tribu mediante materiales y decoraciones simbólicas. El resultado es un símbolo feroz e intimidante que infunde miedo y advierte a cualquiera que se atreva a desafiar a la tribu.

Rule.Original: The barbarian banner is a fierce and intimidating symbol, crafted from a sturdy wooden shield and adorned with the skulls and horns of defeated foes. The banner is mounted on a tall standard, and is sure to strike fear into the hearts of any who behold it. The skull and bones design on the banner represents the ferocity and power of the barbarian tribe, and serves as a warning to all who would dare to challenge them.

The skull and bones design on the banner represents the ferocity and power of the barbarian tribe, and serves as a warning to all who would dare to challenge them.
Rule.Translated: El estandarte bárbaro es un símbolo feroz e intimidante, fabricado con un resistente escudo de madera y adornado con cráneos y cuernos de enemigos derrotados. Se monta sobre un asta alta y está pensado para sembrar el miedo entre quienes lo contemplan. Su decoración de cráneos y huesos representa la ferocidad y el poder de la tribu bárbara y sirve de advertencia a cualquiera que ose desafiarla.

Rule.Original: The Barbarian Banner II is a symbol of the tribe's strength and ferocity, crafted through a ritualistic process that involves reinforcing a wooden shield with stone blocks, and adorning it with the skulls and horns of defeated foes. The process is not only technical but also spiritual, as the tribe's craftspersons imbue the banner with the tribe's power and ferocity through the use of materials and symbolic decorations. The end result is a fierce and intimidating symbol that strikes fear into the hearts of all who behold it, and serves as a warning to any who would dare to challenge the tribe.

Rule.Translated: El estandarte bárbaro II simboliza la fuerza y ferocidad de la tribu. Se fabrica mediante un proceso ritual que refuerza un escudo de madera con bloques de piedra y lo adorna con cráneos y cuernos de enemigos derrotados. Los artesanos lo impregnan espiritualmente con el poder de la tribu. El resultado es un símbolo intimidante que infunde miedo y advierte a cualquiera que ose desafiarla.

Rule.Original: A club weilded by barbarian tribes across the planet, cheap and easily availible to all members of the tribe.
Rule.Raw: A club weilded by barbarian tribes across the planet, cheap and easily availible to all members of the tribe.
Rule.Translated: Un garrote utilizado por tribus bárbaras de todo el planeta. Es barato y está al alcance de prácticamente cualquier miembro de la tribu.

Rule.Original: A Club made from the bones of animals or slain enemies. Cheap, and widely availible to clan members. This one is enhanced with claws.
Rule.Raw: A Club made from the bones of animals or slain enemies. Cheap, and widely availible to clan members. This one is enhanced with claws.
Rule.Translated: Un garrote fabricado con huesos de animales o enemigos caídos. Barato y muy accesible para los miembros del clan. Esta versión está reforzada con garras.

Rule.Original: A club crafted from the bones of fallen foes or slain beasts. Huge, and unweildy, used by the burliest and surliest of clan members. Better than the standard club for transfering force to the target.
Rule.Raw: A club crafted from the bones of fallen foes or slain beasts. Huge, and unweildy, used by the burliest and surliest of clan members. Better than the standard club for transfering force to the target.
Rule.Translated: Un garrote fabricado con huesos de enemigos caídos o bestias abatidas. Enorme y difícil de manejar, lo emplean los miembros más corpulentos y hoscos del clan. Transmite al objetivo mucha más fuerza que un garrote normal.

Rule.Original: A mace made from the skull of a fallen enemy or slain beast. Lashed and secured to a long pole, it uses its weight to overcome the armor of its enemies, though its weight can lead it to being slow and unwieldy.
Rule.Raw: A mace made from the skull of a fallen enemy or slain beast. Lashed and secured to a long pole, it uses its weight to overcome the armor of its enemies, though its weight can lead it to being slow and unwieldy.
Rule.Translated: Una maza hecha con el cráneo de un enemigo caído o una bestia abatida. Sujetada firmemente a un asta larga, aprovecha su peso para superar la armadura enemiga, aunque ese mismo peso la vuelve lenta y difícil de manejar.

Rule.Original: A crudly crafted or looted sword of the barbarian clans. It lacks a guard and is singularly edged. An effective cutting and slashing weapon, though it lacks defense, and the barbarian tribes lack the care nor the skill to maintain their equipment so it is rusted fairly badly, except along the edge.
Rule.Raw: A crudly crafted or looted sword of the barbarian clans. It lacks a guard and is singularly edged. An effective cutting and slashing weapon, though it lacks defense, and the barbarian tribes lack the care nor the skill to maintain their equipment so it is rusted fairly badly, except along the edge.
Rule.Translated: Una espada toscamente fabricada o saqueada por los clanes bárbaros. Carece de guarda y solo tiene un filo. Es eficaz para cortar y tajar, aunque ofrece poca defensa; además, las tribus bárbaras no poseen ni el cuidado ni la habilidad necesarios para mantener su equipo, por lo que está muy oxidada salvo en el filo.

Rule.Original: A crudly crafted sword of the barbarian clans. It lacks a guard and is singularly edged..
Rule.Raw: A crudly crafted sword of the barbarian clans. It lacks a guard and is singularly edged..
Rule.Translated: Una espada de fabricación rudimentaria de los clanes bárbaros. Carece de guarda y solo tiene un filo.

Rule.Original: A rusted Claymore made from a weapon looted on the battlefield. Its large, single edged blade leads to singularly devastating attacks, despite its crude construction.
Rule.Raw: A rusted Claymore made from a weapon looted on the battlefield. Its large, single edged blade leads to singularly devastating attacks, despite its crude construction.
Rule.Translated: Un mandoble oxidado obtenido de un arma saqueada en el campo de batalla. Su gran hoja de un solo filo permite ataques extraordinariamente devastadores pese a su fabricación rudimentaria.

Rule.Original: An ancient wilderness tall like no other, a place of dim light and dense, overwhelming vegetation. Commonly used to procure broad variety of cautionary tales for mischievous children. And justly so. Not many live long enough to carry this knowledge out of the forest, since the forest itself wishes to remain undiscovered. And it just so happens, this particular thicket has an arsenal of gnarly thorns and amply clawed paws willing to fulfill that wish.
Rule.Raw: An ancient wilderness tall like no other, a place of dim light and dense, overwhelming vegetation. Commonly used to procure broad variety of cautionary tales for mischievous children. And justly so. Not many live long enough to carry this knowledge out of the forest, since the forest itself wishes to remain undiscovered. And it just so happens, this particular thicket has an arsenal of gnarly thorns and amply clawed paws willing to fulfill that wish.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo páramo como ningún otro, un lugar tenebroso con una vegetación densa y abrumadora. Se usa habitualmente como base de una amplia variedad de cuentos con moraleja para los niños traviesos... Y con razón. No muchos viven lo suficiente como para extraer información del bosque, ya que el propio bosque desea permanecer sin descubrir. Y da la casualidad de que este bosque en particular cuenta con un arsenal de espinas nudosas y zarpas con garras dispuestas a cumplir ese deseo.

Rule.Original: A scroll detailing various technologies and the methods of their use. Perusing these schematic scrolls may unveil new advancements and hidden knowledge.
Rule.Raw: A scroll detailing various technologies and the methods of their use. Perusing these schematic scrolls may unveil new advancements and hidden knowledge.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino que detalla diversas tecnologías y sus métodos de uso. El estudio de estos pergaminos de planos puede revelar nuevos avances y conocimientos ocultos.

Rule.Original: Tale books are beautifully bound with stories of adventure and myth. Each book takes readers to distant lands and past times. Handwritten by scribes and decorated with illustrations, these books are loved for their rich stories and craftsmanship. They are enjoyed for both entertainment and preserving history.
Rule.Raw: Tale books are beautifully bound with stories of adventure and myth. Each book takes readers to distant lands and past times. Handwritten by scribes and decorated with illustrations, these books are loved for their rich stories and craftsmanship. They are enjoyed for both entertainment and preserving history.
Rule.Translated: Los libros de relatos reúnen historias de aventuras y mitos en hermosas encuadernaciones. Cada libro transporta a sus lectores a tierras lejanas y épocas pasadas. Escritos a mano por escribas y adornados con ilustraciones, son apreciados por la riqueza de sus historias y su elaboración artesanal. Sirven tanto de entretenimiento como para conservar la historia.

Rule.Original: Carefully bound volumes filled with detailed knowledge and techniques on various subjects. Each book offers in-depth explanations and practical advice, helping readers master new skills. Written by experts and often accompanied by detailed diagrams, these books are valuable resources for learning and improvement.
Rule.Raw: Carefully bound volumes filled with detailed knowledge and techniques on various subjects. Each book offers in-depth explanations and practical advice, helping readers master new skills. Written by experts and often accompanied by detailed diagrams, these books are valuable resources for learning and improvement.
Rule.Translated: Volúmenes cuidadosamente encuadernados que contienen conocimientos y técnicas detalladas sobre diversas materias. Cada libro ofrece explicaciones exhaustivas y consejos prácticos para ayudar al lector a dominar nuevas habilidades. Escritos por expertos y a menudo acompañados de diagramas detallados, son recursos valiosos para aprender y mejorar.

Rule.Original: An ancient tome intricately made with a golden finish. Contains scriptures detailing the historical accounts of the under empires. /n/nCan be sold for a pretty penny for interested collectors and the like.
Rule.Raw: An ancient tome intricately made with a golden finish. Contains scriptures detailing the historical accounts of the under empires. /n/nCan be sold for a pretty penny for interested collectors and the like.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo tomo de elaboración intrincada y acabado dorado. Contiene escritos que detallan los relatos históricos de los imperios subterráneos. /n/nPuede venderse por una buena suma a coleccionistas interesados y otros compradores similares.

Rule.Original:
“A mercer called Sheffield was from the north of England. He went into a house and asked the "good wyf" if he could buy some "egges". She replied that she could not speak French, which annoyed him, as he could also not speak French. A bystander suggested that Sheffield was asking for "eyren", which the woman said she understood
Lo, what should a man in these days write: egges or eyren? Certainly it is hard to please every man because of diversity and change of language."
Rule.Raw:
“A mercer called Sheffield was from the north of England. He went into a house and asked the "good wyf" if he could buy some "egges". She replied that she could not speak French, which annoyed him, as he could also not speak French. A bystander suggested that Sheffield was asking for "eyren", which the woman said she understood
Lo, what should a man in these days write: egges or eyren? Certainly it is hard to please every man because of diversity and change of language."
Rule.Translated:
«Un mercader llamado Sheffield procedía del norte de Inglaterra. Entró en una casa y preguntó a la “good wyf” si podía comprar unos “egges”. Ella respondió que no sabía francés, lo que le molestó, pues él tampoco lo hablaba. Un testigo sugirió que Sheffield estaba pidiendo “eyren”, término que la mujer dijo entender.
Ved, ¿qué debería escribir un hombre en estos días: egges o eyren? Ciertamente es difícil complacer a todos por la diversidad y los cambios de la lengua».

Rule.Original:
desc->“A mercer called Sheffield was from the north of England. He went into a house and asked the "good wyf" if he could buy some "egges". She replied that she could not speak French, which annoyed him, as he could also not speak French. A bystander suggested that Sheffield was asking for "eyren", which the woman said she understood
Lo, what should a man in these days write: egges or eyren? Certainly it is hard to please every man because of diversity and change of language."
Rule.Raw:
desc->“A mercer called Sheffield was from the north of England. He went into a house and asked the "good wyf" if he could buy some "egges". She replied that she could not speak French, which annoyed him, as he could also not speak French. A bystander suggested that Sheffield was asking for "eyren", which the woman said she understood
Lo, what should a man in these days write: egges or eyren? Certainly it is hard to please every man because of diversity and change of language."
Rule.Translated:
desc->«Un mercader llamado Sheffield procedía del norte de Inglaterra. Entró en una casa y preguntó a la “good wyf” si podía comprar unos “egges”. Ella respondió que no sabía francés, lo que le molestó, pues él tampoco lo hablaba. Un testigo sugirió que Sheffield estaba pidiendo “eyren”, término que la mujer dijo entender.
Ved, ¿qué debería escribir un hombre en estos días: egges o eyren? Ciertamente es difícil complacer a todos por la diversidad y los cambios de la lengua».

Rule.Original: Fermented beverage of deep golden colouring, a real lifeblood of social life in these parts. The frostberries, harvested during the first winter's frost, yield a wine with a crisp, sweet flavor and a hint of winter's chill. Ice Wine imparts a subtle frost resistance to those who drink it, fortifying them against the harshest cold. This magical beverage is a favorite among adventurers and travelers braving icy terrains, offering both warmth and protection in a single, refreshing sip.

Rule.Translated: Elaborado con las escasas bayas de escarcha, es un elixir muy codiciado por sus propiedades encantadas. Las bayas, recogidas durante la primera helada invernal, producen un vino de sabor fresco y dulce con un toque de frío invernal. El vino de hielo proporciona una leve resistencia a las heladas a quienes lo beben, fortaleciéndolos frente al frío más intenso. Esta bebida mágica es muy apreciada por aventureros y viajeros que atraviesan terrenos helados, pues ofrece calor y protección en un solo sorbo refrescante.

Long-term presence of go-juice has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of battle elixir, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

Sin embargo, una abstinencia prolongada obligará al cerebro a volver a adaptarse a su estado normal y resolverá la adicción.

Rule.Original:
DO NOT DEACTIVATE, IF YOU WANT TO RAID MEDIEVAL OVERHAUL HIDEOUTS.
Deep within the shadows of the world, whispers persist of a malevolent force known only as the Cultists. Long thought extinguished from memory, they linger like a haunting specter, devoted to the worship of false deities and ensnared in the practice of grotesque sacrifices. Their clandestine rituals, cloaked in secrecy, echo with the screams of the damned and the scent of blood. Masters of disguise and manipulation, they weave a web of deception that veils their existence from the eyes of the world.
Rumors abound of their insidious infiltration into every stratum of society, their tendrils coiling around the unsuspecting like serpents awaiting the moment to strike. Feeding on the flesh of the fallen, they are cannibals driven by primal hunger and twisted devotion. Yet amidst the horror, legends speak of hidden sanctuaries strewn with ancient relics and cursed treasures, concealed within their unholy enclaves.
Beware the shadows, for within them lies the domain of the Cultists, a realm where darkness reigns eternal and the boundaries between nightmare and reality blur into oblivion.

Rule.Translated:
NO DESACTIVES ESTA FACCIÓN SI QUIERES ASALTAR LAS GUARIDAS DE MEDIEVAL OVERHAUL.
En las sombras más profundas del mundo persisten rumores de una fuerza malévola conocida únicamente como los cultistas. Aunque se creía que su recuerdo se había extinguido hace mucho, perduran como un espectro inquietante, entregados al culto de falsas deidades y a la práctica de sacrificios grotescos. Sus ritos clandestinos, envueltos en secreto, resuenan con los gritos de los condenados y el olor de la sangre. Maestros del disfraz y la manipulación, tejen una red de engaños que oculta su existencia a los ojos del mundo.
Abundan los rumores sobre su insidiosa infiltración en todos los estratos de la sociedad, donde sus tentáculos se enroscan alrededor de los incautos como serpientes que esperan el momento de atacar. Se alimentan de la carne de los caídos: son caníbales movidos por un hambre primitiva y una devoción retorcida. Sin embargo, entre el horror, las leyendas hablan de santuarios ocultos repletos de reliquias antiguas y tesoros malditos, escondidos en sus enclaves impíos.
Cuídate de las sombras, pues albergan el dominio de los cultistas, un reino donde la oscuridad gobierna eternamente y los límites entre pesadilla y realidad se desvanecen en el olvido.

Rule.Translated: Monstruos y criaturas inhumanas que habitan las profundidades del bosque. Se sabe que cazan indiscriminadamente a los hombres, pero acogen pacíficamente a animales de la naturaleza.

Rule.Original:
These people have been here a very long time. Maybe their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago. Maybe they survived some cataclysm that destroyed a technological civilization here. In any case, the tribals are mostly nomadic people who live off the land using primitive tools and weapons.

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the tribals can be dangerous enemies and valuable friends because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particular tribe pursues a gentle way of life where they can. They are quite open to trade and alliances, even with strange peoples.

Rule.Translated:
Esta gente lleva aquí mucho tiempo. Tal vez sus antepasados se estrellaron aquí hace mil años. Tal vez sobrevivieron a un cataclismo que destruyó una civilización tecnológica. En cualquier caso, los tribales son en su mayoría nómadas que viven de la tierra utilizando herramientas y armas primitivas.

A pesar de su aparente debilidad tecnológica, los tribales pueden ser enemigos peligrosos y amigos valiosos por su habilidad con la guerra de baja tecnología, su número y su resistencia.

Esta tribu en particular valora la dominación bélica; puede ser difícil convertirlos en aliados.

Rule.Original:
War is a profitable endeavor, much so, that trading and haggling is as relentlessly ferocious as winning a battle. House Soren is notoriously recognized to be the masters of the trade, cunningly closing each profitable bargain. Many of their acquisitions are gained by honest trading but also through deceit, bribery, and extortion. Their towns are filled with riches as the house resides in their decadent castles, whilst pot-bellied peasants litter the streets.
House Soren's influence stretches far and wide, with their merchant fleets dominating the seas and their caravans threading through the most dangerous routes. They possess a network of spies and informants, ensuring they are always a step ahead of their rivals. The halls of their castles are adorned with treasures from distant lands, a testament to their vast wealth and far-reaching connections.
Once subjugated under the oppressive rule of the shattered empire, House Soren was among the first to seize the opportunity for independence when the empire's grip weakened. Their struggle for control over the other houses has been fierce, leveraging their economic prowess to tip the scales in their favor. They have successfully established themselves as a dominant force, exploiting the power vacuum left by the empire's collapse.

Rule.Original:
From the earth they came and so they shall claim; House Oswin declares their presence to have long existed when the first emperor dominated these lands. Now, one of the many noble houses, yet their ambitions to etch their name in history have yet to run dry. In an attempt to recover the treasure of the old under-empires, their expeditions uncover the earth in search of the depths of the ruins.
Guided by ancient maps and whispered legends, House Oswin's explorers delve into forgotten catacombs and shadowed caverns. Each descent is fraught with peril, as they navigate labyrinthine passages and face guardians of stone and steel. Yet, undeterred by the trials, they press on, driven by the promise of untold riches and arcane knowledge hidden beneath the soil. Their legacy is written not in ink, but in the very bones of the earth they unearth.

Rule.Original: questDescription(siteFaction==DankPyon_ShadowSect)->At first glance, this compound appears to be a small, unremarkable collection of buildings. There are a few ramshackle structures that seem to be used for living and storage, and a larger, more well-constructed building that could be a workshop or meeting place. However, upon closer inspection, you notice a few strange details that raise your suspicions. The windows of the buildings are covered with heavy curtains, and there are few signs of activity. It is possible that this compound is being used as a cover for the Shadow Sect's operations, and that there may be a hidden entrance to their actual hideout somewhere within. It will be up to you to investigate further and determine the truth.

Sin embargo, al observarlo más de cerca, descubres varios detalles extraños que despiertan tus sospechas. Las ventanas están cubiertas por cortinas gruesas y apenas hay señales de actividad. Es posible que este recinto sirva de tapadera para las operaciones de la Secta de las Sombras y que esconda una entrada a su verdadera guarida. Tendrás que investigar para descubrir la verdad.

Rule.Original: You entered the compound and managed to take out all of the cultists, purging the location of their presence. You were able to gather a wealth of intel, including information that could lead you to the larger location of their temple. You have disrupted the cultists activities and dealt a blow to their operations. Good work!

Rule.Translated: Has entrado en el recinto y has acabado con todos los cultistas, purgando el lugar de su presencia. Has conseguido abundante información, incluidas pistas que podrían conducirte al emplazamiento de su templo principal. Has interrumpido sus actividades y asestado un golpe a sus operaciones. ¡Buen trabajo!

Rule.Original: questDescription(siteFaction==DankPyon_ShadowSect)->At first glance, this monastery appears to be a peaceful, secluded place of worship. It is surrounded by lush gardens and is situated on a hill overlooking the surrounding countryside. The main building is a large, impressive structure with tall, arched windows and a grand entrance. However, upon closer inspection, you notice a few strange details that raise your suspicions. The windows are covered with heavy curtains, and there are few signs of activity within. It is possible that this monastery is being used as a cover for the Shadow Sect's operations, and that there may be hidden rooms or areas within that are being used for their secretive activities. It will be up to you to investigate further and determine the truth.

It is possible that this monastery is being used as a cover for the Shadow Sect's operations, and that there may be hidden rooms or areas within that are being used for their secretive activities. It will be up to you to investigate further and determine the truth.
