It is surrounded by lush gardens and is situated on a hill overlooking the surrounding countryside. The main building is a large, impressive structure with tall, arched windows and a grand entrance. However, upon closer inspection, you notice a few strange details that raise your suspicions. The windows are covered with heavy curtains, and there are few signs of activity within. It is possible that this monastery is being used as a cover for the Shadow Sect's operations, and that there may be hidden rooms or areas within that are being used for their secretive activities. It will be up to you to investigate further and determine the truth.
Rule.Translated: questDescription(siteFaction==DankPyon_ShadowSect)->A primera vista, este monasterio parece un lugar de culto tranquilo y apartado. Lo rodean jardines exuberantes y se alza en una colina que domina el paisaje circundante. El edificio principal es una gran e imponente construcción con altas ventanas de arco y una entrada majestuosa. Sin embargo, al observarlo más de cerca, descubres varios detalles extraños que despiertan tus sospechas. Las ventanas están cubiertas por cortinas gruesas y apenas hay señales de actividad en el interior. Es posible que este monasterio sirva de tapadera para las operaciones de la Secta de las Sombras y que algunas salas o zonas ocultas se utilicen para sus actividades secretas. Tendrás que investigar para descubrir la verdad.

Rule.Original:
One year’s service—that was the deal.
The lord whom I followed attempted many times to keep my sword by his side, but a deal is a deal and after one year, I swore no further oaths.
As I traverse the wooded hills, I wonder to myself whether the decision was correct.

I may have hoarded wealth, but bandits roam the countryside, and should my campfire not betray me, hungry beasts and monsters hidden in the dark eye me all the same.
I often wonder if I should have allowed my lord to wield me as his sword again, but I also know that in doing so, I would forgo my freedom.

So, after retrieving my silver, I march with no end in sight.
Perhaps I will be so lucky as to find a homestead, build a hall, and gather my own household warriors.
But the long-term goal seemed so far away, as I must focus on my foremost problems.

First, I must survive.

Rule.Translated:
Un año de servicio: ese era el trato.
El señor al que seguía intentó muchas veces mantener mi espada a su lado, pero un trato es un trato y, pasado el año, no juré ningún nuevo vasallaje.
Mientras atravieso las colinas boscosas, me pregunto si tomé la decisión correcta.

Puede que haya acumulado riquezas, pero los bandidos recorren los caminos y, aunque mi hoguera no me delate, las bestias hambrientas y los monstruos ocultos en la oscuridad también me observan.
A menudo me pregunto si debería haber permitido que mi señor volviera a empuñarme como su espada, aunque también sé que, de hacerlo, renunciaría a mi libertad.

Así que, tras recuperar mi plata, marcho sin un destino a la vista.
Quizá tenga la suerte de encontrar una granja, construir un salón y reunir a mis propios guerreros domésticos.
Pero ese objetivo a largo plazo parece muy lejano, pues primero debo ocuparme de mis problemas más inmediatos.

Lo primero es sobrevivir.

Rule.Original: Your lord, to whom you and your comrades remained forever loyal as long as there is money, fell at a concise battle. Free of your oath, your band of mercenaries departed to neighboring towns and cities in search of opportunity for silver and reputation but were disappointed to find peace-laden settlements, full of bounties fit for a daytaler. Eager to begin anew, you and your comrades settle land in the wilderness in hopes to one day grow wealth and return to former glory.
Rule.Raw: Your lord, to whom you and your comrades remained forever loyal as long as there is money, fell at a concise battle. Free of your oath, your band of mercenaries departed to neighboring towns and cities in search of opportunity for silver and reputation but were disappointed to find peace-laden settlements, full of bounties fit for a daytaler. Eager to begin anew, you and your comrades settle land in the wilderness in hopes to one day grow wealth and return to former glory.
Rule.Translated: Tu señor, a quien tú y tus camaradas guardabais lealtad eterna mientras hubiera dinero, cayó en una breve batalla. Liberada de su juramento, tu banda de mercenarios recorrió las poblaciones y ciudades vecinas en busca de plata y reputación, pero solo encontró asentamientos pacíficos con encargos propios de un jornalero. Con ganas de empezar de nuevo, tú y tus camaradas os instaláis en tierras salvajes con la esperanza de enriqueceros algún día y recuperar la gloria de antaño.

Rule.Original: Five hardened warriors reclaiming their former glory.
Rule.Raw: Five hardened warriors reclaiming their former glory.
Rule.Translated: Cinco guerreros curtidos que buscan recuperar su gloria de antaño.

Rule.Original:
The walls of a city were never reassuring. Neither was the bustle of urban life that could suck the soul out of a lich, given time.
What opportunities you could find were unsuitable for you for so many, many reasons: one, a lack of fitness, while another a lack of heartlessness.

It was this environment that told you to leave, with but raw materials and simple tools to fashion your dream.
For you aspired to a home out in the wilderness, a hearth that could welcome many a weary and worn traveler.
Rogue or hero, it would shelter them all.

With any hope comes risk, and this was one you could not ignore.
Reports from the local garrison indicated an increased bandit presence, and crime was on the rise.
Even with the most careful preparations, a criminal would most likely follow your trail.

But you took the leap of faith, and stepped across the threshold of the city.
With wilderness ahead and treachery behind, you march away.

Optimism and worry cloud your brow.

But you took the leap of faith, and stepped across the threshold of the city.
With wilderness ahead and treachery behind, you march away.

Optimism and worry cloud your brow.
Rule.Translated:
Las murallas de una ciudad nunca resultaron tranquilizadoras. Tampoco el bullicio de la vida urbana, capaz de absorber hasta el alma de un liche con el tiempo.
Las oportunidades que encontrabas no eran adecuadas para ti por muchas, muchísimas razones: unas exigían una condición física que no tenías; otras, una falta de escrúpulos que tampoco poseías.

Fue ese entorno el que te empujó a marcharte, llevándote apenas materias primas y herramientas sencillas con las que dar forma a tu sueño.
Aspirabas a levantar un hogar en plena naturaleza, un hogar con un fuego que pudiera recibir a muchos viajeros cansados y maltrechos.
Pícaros o héroes, todos encontrarían refugio allí.

Toda esperanza conlleva riesgos, y este era uno que no podías ignorar.
Los informes de la guarnición local indicaban una creciente presencia de bandidos y un aumento de la delincuencia.
Incluso con los preparativos más cuidadosos, era muy probable que algún criminal siguiera tu rastro.

Aun así, diste el salto de fe y cruzaste el umbral de la ciudad.
Con la naturaleza salvaje por delante y la traición a tus espaldas, te alejas marchando.

El optimismo y la preocupación se mezclan en tu rostro.

Rule.Translated: Tres colonos optimistas: una experiencia de comercio y rol

Rule.Original: At first glance, this compound appears to be a small, unremarkable collection of buildings. There are a few ramshackle structures that seem to be used for living and storage, and a larger, more well-constructed building that could be a workshop or meeting place. The compound is surrounded by a low fence, and there is a gate that appears to be the main entrance. However, upon closer inspection, you notice a few strange details that raise your suspicions. The windows of the buildings are covered with heavy curtains, and there are few signs of activity. It is possible that this compound is being used as a cover for the Shadow Sect's operations, and that there may be a hidden entrance to their actual hideout somewhere within. It will be up to you to investigate further and determine the truth.

It will be up to you to investigate further and determine the truth.

Hay unas pocas construcciones destartaladas que parecen servir de viviendas y almacenes, además de un edificio mayor y mejor construido que podría ser un taller o un lugar de reunión. Una cerca baja rodea el recinto y una puerta parece ser la entrada principal. Sin embargo, al observarlo más de cerca, descubres varios detalles extraños que despiertan tus sospechas. Las ventanas están cubiertas por cortinas gruesas y apenas hay señales de actividad. Es posible que este recinto sirva de tapadera para las operaciones de la Secta de las Sombras y que esconda una entrada a su verdadera guarida. Tendrás que investigar para descubrir la verdad.

Rule.Original: At first glance, this monastery appears to be a peaceful, secluded place of worship. It is surrounded by lush gardens and is situated on a hill overlooking the surrounding countryside. The main building is a large, impressive structure with tall, arched windows and a grand entrance. However, upon closer inspection, you notice a few strange details that raise your suspicions. The windows are covered with heavy curtains, and there are few signs of activity within. It is possible that this monastery is being used as a cover for the Shadow Sect's operations, and that there may be hidden rooms or areas within that are being used for their secretive activities. It will be up to you to investigate further and determine the truth.

Rule.Raw: A basic room divider that keeps the privacy of your pawns. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un separador de ambientes básico que preserva la privacidad de tus personajes. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: A column capable of holding a roof. Does not block sight or movement and looks quite nice.
Rule.Raw: A column capable of holding a roof. Does not block sight or movement and looks quite nice.
Rule.Translated: Una columna capaz de sostener un techo. No bloquea la vista ni el movimiento y tiene buen aspecto.

Rule.Original: A wooden hanging sign use to symbolize the purpose of a room.
Rule.Raw: A wooden hanging sign use to symbolize the purpose of a room.
Rule.Translated: Un cartel colgante para indicar la finalidad de una habitación.

Rule.Original: A dust-covered fragment of the old wagon. Moss slowly makes its way up, covering deep scratches and blood stains - traces of long forgotten struggle. Whatever happened here, heroes of that story are somewhere else, either above or under the ground. Supplies are left for anyone to take.
Rule.Raw: A dust-covered fragment of the old wagon. Moss slowly makes its way up, covering deep scratches and blood stains - traces of long forgotten struggle. Whatever happened here, heroes of that story are somewhere else, either above or under the ground. Supplies are left for anyone to take.
Rule.Translated: Los fragmentos polvorientos de un viejo carro. El musgo se abre paso lentamente, cubriendo muchos de los arañazos y manchas de sangre, evidencias de una lucha olvidada hace mucho tiempo. Ocurriera lo que ocurriera aquí, los héroes de esa historia están en otro lugar, ya sea en la superficie o bajo tierra. Se han dejado provisiones para que cualquiera pueda cogerlas.

Rule.Translated: Una mesa acotada con un tapete blando para simular un juego de guerra. Una buena forma de poner a prueba tus habilidades estratégicas y un poco de suerte.

Rule.Original: Some birds, when taught by expert trainers, are capable of flying to a designated location before returning to their home roost. This allows for communication with neighboring factions, assuming one can afford the costly requirements of obtaining and training the bird, as well as feeding the animals with meat. Requires the scribe table for correspondence.
Rule.Raw: Some birds, when taught by expert trainers, are capable of flying to a designated location before returning to their home roost. This allows for communication with neighboring factions, assuming one can afford the costly requirements of obtaining and training the bird, as well as feeding the animals with meat. Requires the scribe table for correspondence.
Rule.Translated: Algunas aves, cuando son adiestradas por entrenadores expertos, son capaces de volar a un lugar designado antes de regresar a su nido natal. Esto permite la comunicación con facciones vecinas, suponiendo que uno pueda permitirse los costosos requisitos de obtener y entrenar al ave, así como alimentar a los animales con carne. Requiere la mesa de escriba para enviar correspondencia.

Rule.Original: A table housing wax tablets, which contain records and receipts. Alongside the tablets lay parchments, a seal, quills, and ink to allow for correspondence. When used alongside the bird post, the written letters can reach far lands quicker than a messenger. One can invite allies for feasts, rivals for a challenge, or neutral factions for trade.
Rule.Raw: A table housing wax tablets, which contain records and receipts. Alongside the tablets lay parchments, a seal, quills, and ink to allow for correspondence. When used alongside the bird post, the written letters can reach far lands quicker than a messenger. One can invite allies for feasts, rivals for a challenge, or neutral factions for trade.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa con tablillas de cera que contienen registros y recibos. Junto a las tablillas hay pergaminos, un sello, plumas y tinta para la correspondencia. Cuando se utilizan junto con el correo aviar, las cartas escritas pueden llegar a tierras lejanas más rápido que un mensajero. Se puede invitar a aliados a un banquete, a rivales a un desafío o a facciones neutrales para comerciar.

Rule.Original: The Explorer's Workbench is a sturdy, timeworn table covered in an array of tools, maps, and magnifying glasses. This station is where adventurers bring their Torn Notes, piecing together the fragmented clues. By examining and arranging the tattered scraps of parchment, the workbench reveals hidden locations, secret hideouts, and points of interest. \n\nTo uncover more advanced hideouts, the workbench must be linked to specialized buildings such as the Explorer’s Archive, Ancient Pedestal, and the Ancient Orb, enhancing its capabilities and enabling the discovery of deeper secrets. Here, the path to grand adventures begins, where mysteries are unraveled and new quests are set in motion.

Here, the path to grand adventures begins, where mysteries are unraveled and new quests are set in motion.
Rule.Translated: La mesa del explorador es una mesa robusta y desgastada cubierta de herramientas, mapas y lupas. Aquí los aventureros reúnen sus notas rasgadas para recomponer pistas fragmentadas. Al examinar y ordenar los pedazos de pergamino, la mesa revela lugares ocultos, guaridas secretas y puntos de interés. \n\nPara descubrir guaridas más avanzadas, la mesa debe enlazarse con edificios especializados, como el archivo del explorador, el pedestal antiguo y el orbe antiguo, que amplían sus capacidades y permiten revelar secretos más profundos. Aquí comienza el camino hacia grandes aventuras, donde se resuelven misterios y se ponen en marcha nuevas misiones.

Rule.Original: This ancient pedestal is made of rough-hewn granite blocks and is adorned with mysterious markings and symbols. It appears to be very old and has likely been used by the Moon Cult for centuries. The pedestal seems to have been placed in strategic locations throughout the ruins, possibly as a marker or guide for members of the cult. It is possible that by studying these pedestals, one might be able to uncover the locations of larger, more important cult sites.
Rule.Raw: This ancient pedestal is made of rough-hewn granite blocks and is adorned with mysterious markings and symbols. The pedestal seems to have been placed in strategic locations throughout the ruins, possibly as a marker or guide for members of the cult. It is possible that by studying these pedestals, one might be able to uncover the locations of larger, more important cult sites.
Rule.Translated: Este pedestal antiguo está hecho de bloques de granito toscamente tallados y adornado con marcas y símbolos misteriosos. Parece muy viejo y probablemente el Culto de la Luna lo haya utilizado durante siglos. Los pedestales parecen situados en puntos estratégicos de las ruinas, quizá como señales o guías para los miembros del culto. Es posible que su estudio permita descubrir la ubicación de enclaves del culto más grandes e importantes.

Rule.Original: This ancient artifact is a glowing green sphere, encased in a four-legged granite pedestal. The sphere's surface is smooth and reflective, and seems to pulse with an otherworldly energy. The pedestal is adorned with symbols and engravings that are associated with the Moon Cult, and appears to have been crafted with great care and skill. The purpose and power of this mysterious artifact is not known, but it is clear that it holds great importance to the cult. Those who possess this artifact must be prepared to face the wrath of the Moon Cult, who will stop at nothing to protect it.

Rule.Translated: Este artefacto antiguo es una esfera verde luminosa situada en un pedestal de granito de cuatro patas. Su superficie lisa y reflectante parece palpitar con una energía sobrenatural. El pedestal está adornado con símbolos y grabados relacionados con el Culto de la Luna y parece elaborado con gran cuidado y habilidad. Se desconocen el propósito y el poder de este misterioso artefacto, pero resulta evidente su gran importancia para el culto. Quienes lo posean deben prepararse para afrontar la ira del Culto de la Luna, que hará cualquier cosa para protegerlo.

Rule.Original: The Explorer's Archive can be linked to the Explorer's Workbench./nDepending on the level of Hideouts you want to locate, up to 8 may need to be linked to the Workbench./nIt can also be used to store up to 9 torn notes.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Hyena rugs are small but the lavish patterns, from stripes to dots, make the piece a beautiful addition to decor.
Rule.Raw: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Hyena rugs are small but the lavish patterns, from stripes to dots, make the piece a beautiful addition to decor.
Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. Las alfombras de hiena son pequeñas, pero sus lujosos dibujos, que pueden ir desde rayas a lunares, las convierten en un bello complemento decorativo.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The grizzled grayish-brown fur of the timber wolf may make for a valuable rug but comes with a high cost as the hunter will likely face the beast in a pack.

Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. Aunque la piel grisácea de esta variedad de lobo permite fabricar una alfombra muy valiosa, ésta tiene un coste elevado, ya que el cazador probablemente tenga que enfrentarse a toda una manada de estas bestias salvajes.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. A variant of the wolf, arctic wolf rugs tell the story of a hunter who braved dangerous temperatures and conquered starving predators biologically designed for survival.
Rule.Raw: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. A variant of the wolf, arctic wolf rugs tell the story of a hunter who braved dangerous temperatures and conquered starving predators biologically designed for survival.
Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. Las alfombras de lobo ártico, una variante del lobo, cuentan la historia de un cazador que desafió a las temperaturas peligrosas y conquistó a depredadores hambrientos biológicamente diseñados para la supervivencia.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Cougars are prized for their luxurious pelts, which in turn makes for a valuable alternative to basic rugs.

Los pumas son apreciados por sus lujosas pieles, que a su vez constituyen una valiosa alternativa a las alfombras básicas.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Panther rugs, much like the animals themselves, fall into shadows during the night but marbled eyes illuminate in the darkness.

Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. Las alfombras de pantera, al igual que el animal del que provienen, se camuflan en las sombras durante la noche mientras los ojos jaspeados se iluminan en la oscuridad.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The bear’s great coat is one of the most sought-after materials for animal-skinned rugs, making the grizzly bear rug a worthy choice for the daring colonist brave enough to face the hunt.
Rule.Raw: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The bear’s great coat is one of the most sought-after materials for animal-skinned rugs, making the grizzly bear rug a worthy choice for the daring colonist brave enough to face the hunt.
Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. El gran pelaje del oso es uno de los materiales más codiciados para las alfombras de piel de animal, lo que convierte a la alfombra de oso pardo en una digna elección para el colono que sea lo suficientemente osado como para enfrentarse a esta criatura.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The polar bears found in frozen climates host great white fur that makes for cold-resistant rugs. Especially valuable to homesteads found in cold temperatures.
Rule.Raw: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The polar bears found in frozen climates host great white fur that makes for cold-resistant rugs. Especially valuable to homesteads found in cold temperatures.
Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. Los osos polares de los climas helados tienen un gran pelaje blanco que hace que las alfombras sean resistentes al frío. Son especialmente valiosas para las granjas situadas en climas fríos.

La piel de este semi-mítico animal le da a la alfombra un valor inigualable.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Few hunters can craft a trophy with a more refined and resistant coat than that of the thrumbo rug. Its long fur can catch the eye of any colonist, but the strong hide requires much work to tailor. Beware the horn while walking.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Human rugs are prized trophies admired by some and loathed by others, but like-minded cannibals will find comfort in its decor.
Rule.Raw: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Human rugs are prized trophies admired by some and loathed by others, but like-minded cannibals will find comfort in its decor.
Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. Las alfombras de humano son unos trofeos admirados por unos y aborrecidos por otros, pero los caníbales de ideas afines encontrarán consuelo en su decoración.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient battering ram. Were often used to breach castle gates, allowing troops to infiltrate fortifications. Can be destroyed to gain resources.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient battering ram. Were often used to breach castle gates, allowing troops to infiltrate fortifications. Can be destroyed to gain resources.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un antiguo ariete. Se utilizaban a menudo para abrir las puertas de los castillos, lo que permitía a las tropas infiltrarse en las fortificaciones. Pueden desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient siege tower. Tall and robust, siege towers were made to carry troops inside and were positioned againt walls to allow soldiers to climb and storm the fortress. Can be destroyed to gain resources.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient siege tower. Tall and robust, siege towers were made to carry troops inside and were positioned againt walls to allow soldiers to climb and storm the fortress. Can be destroyed to gain resources.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de una antigua torre de asedio. Altas y robustas, las torres de asedio se construían para transportar tropas en su interior y se colocaban contra las murallas para permitir a los soldados escalar y asaltar la fortaleza. Pueden desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: The remains of a soldier. Can be scavenged for resources.
Rule.Raw: The remains of a soldier. Can be scavenged for resources.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un soldado. Se pueden obtener recursos de ellos.

Rule.Original: an old and rusty piece of chainmail. Can be salvaged for resources.
Rule.Raw: an old and rusty piece of chainmail. Can be salvaged for resources.
Rule.Translated: Una vieja y oxidada cota de malla. Puede desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: Remains of a battlefield. Full of rusted weapons and armor. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Raw: Remains of a battlefield. Full of rusted weapons and armor. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Translated: Los restos de una antigua batalla, una en la que se usaron muchas armas y armaduras. Puede desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: Remains of a battlefield. Full of rusted weapons and armor. Can be salvaged for resources

Rule.Translated: Los restos de una antigua batalla, una en la que se usaron muchas armas y armaduras. Puede desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: Remains of a battlefield. An ancient banner of an old long forgotten kingdom. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Raw: Remains of a battlefield. An ancient banner of an old long forgotten kingdom. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Translated: Los restos de una antigua batalla, concretamente del símbolo de un reino ya olvidado. Puede desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: An ambushed caravan. There are still some goods left behind. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Raw: An ambushed caravan. There are still some goods left behind. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Translated: Los restos de una caravana emboscada. Aún queda algo de valor. Puede desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: An old and ruined empty crate. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Raw: An old and ruined empty crate. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente vacío, viejo y arruinada. Puede desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: An old and ruined empty barrel. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Raw: An old and ruined empty barrel. Can be salvaged for resources
Rule.Translated: Un viejo y arruinado barril vacío. Puede desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Translated: Una puerta a la que se le han clavado tablones de madera, bloqueándola completamente. Necesita ser destruida para poder pasar al otro lado.

Rule.Original: Crumbled into a pile of stone. Traversing through is impossible. Needs destroyed in order to pass through
Rule.Raw: Crumbled into a pile of stone. Traversing through is impossible. Needs destroyed in order to pass through
Rule.Translated: Los trozos de lo que antes fue una puerta. Es imposible atravesarlos a no ser que sean destruidos.

Rule.Original: A locked metal gate, the only way in is to break the door.
Rule.Raw: A locked metal gate, the only way in is to break the door.
Rule.Translated: Una verja metálica cerrada. La única forma de pasar es rompiéndola.

Rule.Original: A simple platform on which to sit. Not very comfortable, but much better than nothing.Commonly seen at taverns and inns. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Raw: A simple platform on which to sit. Not very comfortable, but much better than nothing.Commonly seen at taverns and inns. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Translated: Una sencilla plataforma sobre la que sentarse. No es muy cómodo, pero es mucho mejor que nada. Puede utilizarse en mesas, puestos de trabajo y otros lugares.

Rule.Original: A tall pillar of ornate design.

Rule.Raw: A simple and quick to make wicker bed.
Rule.Translated: Una cama de mimbre, sencilla y rápida de hacer.

Rule.Original: A ruined simple and quick to make wicker bed.
Rule.Raw: A ruined simple and quick to make wicker bed.
Rule.Translated: Una cama de mimbre, sencilla y rápida de hacer.

Rule.Original: A pile of ruined furniture seemingly stacked together in a deliberate fashion.
Rule.Raw: A pile of ruined furniture seemingly stacked together in a deliberate fashion.
Rule.Translated: Una pila de muebles en ruinas aparentemente apilados de forma deliberada.

Rule.Original: An empty wooden bucket. Could have some scraps inside.
Rule.Raw: An empty wooden bucket. Could have some scraps inside.
Rule.Translated: Un cubo de madera vacío. Podría tener restos dentro.

Rule.Original: A broken crate. Could have some scraps inside.
Rule.Raw: A broken crate. Could have some scraps inside.
Rule.Translated: Un cofre roto. Podría tener restos dentro.

Rule.Original: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The bear’s great coat is one of the most sought-after materials for animal-skinned rugs, making the grizzly bear rug a worthy choice for the daring colonist brave enough to face the hunt.
Rule.Raw: Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The bear’s great coat is one of the most sought-after materials for animal-skinned rugs, making the grizzly bear rug a worthy choice for the daring colonist brave enough to face the hunt.
Rule.Translated: Las alfombras de animales, que son el más común de los trofeos para cualquier cazador, se fabrican a partir de las pieles curtidas y disecadas de animales, cosidas y rellenadas hasta formar una cubierta decente para el suelo. El gran pelaje del oso es uno de los materiales más codiciados para las alfombras de piel de animal, lo que convierte a la alfombra de oso pardo en una digna elección para el colono que sea lo suficientemente osado como para enfrentarse a esta criatura.

Rule.Original: Old bones that are crudely stacked in a spot.
Rule.Raw: Old bones that are crudely stacked in a spot.
Rule.Translated: Unos viejos huesos se apilan toscamente en un punto.

Rule.Translated: Unos viejos huesos se apilan toscamente en un punto.

Rule.Raw: Old bones crudely deposited in a random spot.
Rule.Translated: Unos huesos viejos depositados toscamente en un lugar al azar.

Rule.Original: A broken avatar of a once prominent person.
Rule.Raw: A broken avatar of a once prominent person.
Rule.Translated: Una representación de una persona importante de antaño.

Rule.Original: Old and dusted candles, unfit for use.
Rule.Raw: Old and dusted candles, unfit for use.
Rule.Translated: Unas velas viejas cubiertas de polvo, no aptas para su uso.

Rule.Original: A candle stand to prevent darkness seeping in your room. Can be refueled with tallow.
Rule.Raw: A candle stand to prevent darkness seeping in your room. Can be refueled with tallow.
Rule.Translated: Un candelabro para evitar que la oscuridad se filtre en su habitación. Se puede recargar con sebo.

Rule.Original: An old and rusted cauldron, filled with the remains of unrecognizable creatures.
Rule.Raw: An old and rusted cauldron, filled with the remains of unrecognizable creatures.
Rule.Translated: Un caldero viejo y oxidado, lleno de restos de criaturas irreconocibles.

Rule.Original: Busted and bent, this anvil have seen better days.
Rule.Raw: Busted and bent, this anvil have seen better days.
Rule.Translated: Reventado y doblado, este yunque ha visto días mejores.
Un hogar de piedra en ruinas.

Rule.Original: An abandoned mine, with no maintanance, led to the collapse of its bearings, overall rendering the mine unsusable.
Rule.Raw: An abandoned mine, with no maintanance, led to the collapse of its bearings, overall rendering the mine unsusable.
Rule.Translated: Una mina abandonada que, sin ningún tipo de mantenimiento, acabó derrumbándose. Ha quedado totalmente inutilizada.

Rule.Original: A collapsed chunk of stone bricks, resembling of old ruins and dungeons.\n\n It still contains useful resources which you can acquire by deconstructing it.
Rule.Raw: A collapsed chunk of stone bricks, resembling of old ruins and dungeons.\n\n It still contains useful resources which you can acquire by deconstructing it.
Rule.Translated: Una pila de ladrillos de piedra que parecen provenir de alguna mazmorra o ruina antigua.\n\nTodavía contiene algunos recursos útiles que puedes adquirir al desmantelarlos.

Rule.Original: serves no function at the moment, just acts as a placeholder
Rule.Raw: serves no function at the moment, just acts as a placeholder
Rule.Translated: Por ahora no tiene ninguna función; solo sirve como elemento provisional
Una estantería que ha visto tiempos mejores.

Rule.Original: A rack for storing swords in an orderly fashion.
Rule.Raw: A rack for storing swords in an orderly fashion.
Rule.Translated: Un estante para guardar espadas de forma ordenada.

Rule.Original: A rack for storing swords in an orderly fashion.

Rule.Translated: Un estante para guardar espadas de forma ordenada.

Rule.Translated: Un soporte que exhibe una prestigiosa armadura usada por reyes y campeones de la antigüedad.

Rule.Original: A gigantic egg that has hatched, whatever was inside lies a massive beast.
Rule.Raw: A gigantic egg that has hatched, whatever was inside lies a massive beast.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo gigantesco que ha eclosionado, lo que había dentro es una bestia descomunal.

Rule.Raw: A group of snake eggs that has survived enough to hatch.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo de huevos de serpiente que ha sobrevivido lo suficiente para eclosionar.

Rule.Original: Developed during ancient times, the scorpio is a powerful missile weapon capable of launching large darts over long distances. Effective in both siege and defense, the precise design strikes fear into enemies but must be reloaded after every bolt fired.
Rule.Raw: Developed during ancient times, the scorpio is a powerful missile weapon capable of launching large darts over long distances. Effective in both siege and defense, the precise design strikes fear into enemies but must be reloaded after every bolt fired.
Rule.Translated: Un arma desarrollada en la antigüedad. El escorpión es una poderosa arma capaz de disparar dardos de gran tamaño a grandes distancias. Es eficaz tanto para el asedio como para la defensa. Su preciso diseño infunde miedo a los enemigos, pero debe recargarse después de cada proyectil disparado.
No puede disparar: necesita virotes de escorpión

Rule.Original: An ancient military siege engine in a form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct.
Rule.Raw: An ancient military siege engine in a form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina militar de asedio en forma de ballesta montada sobre una construcción de madera.

Rule.Original: Developed during ancient times, the ballista is a powerful missile weapon capable of launching large darts over long distances. Effective in both siege and defense, the precise design strikes fear into enemies but must be reloaded after every bolt fired.
Rule.Raw: Developed during ancient times, the ballista is a powerful missile weapon capable of launching large darts over long distances. Effective in both siege and defense, the precise design strikes fear into enemies but must be reloaded after every bolt fired.
Rule.Translated: Un arma desarrollada en la antigüedad. La balista es una poderosa arma de proyectiles capaz de lanzar dardos de gran tamaño a grandes distancias. Es eficaz tanto para el asedio como para la defensa. Su preciso diseño infunde miedo a los enemigos, pero debe recargarse después de cada proyectil disparado.
No puede disparar: necesita virotes de balista

Rule.Original: An ancient military siege engine in a form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct.
Rule.Raw: An ancient military siege engine in a form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina militar de asedio en forma de ballesta montada sobre una construcción de madera.

Rule.Original: The trebuchet relies on powerful torsion to launch stones over a great distance and with such power to destroy walls. This makes the trebuchet a fearsome siege weapon capable of ravaging defenses; where siege attackers used to climb palisades under enemy missiles, they can now create openings before the battle even begins. Upon seeing the great trebuchet deployed to fields, defenders should attempt to destroy it quickly.
Rule.Raw: The trebuchet relies on powerful torsion to launch stones over a great distance and with such power to destroy walls. This makes the trebuchet a fearsome siege weapon capable of ravaging defenses; where siege attackers used to climb palisades under enemy missiles, they can now create openings before the battle even begins. Upon seeing the great trebuchet deployed to fields, defenders should attempt to destroy it quickly.
Rule.Translated: El fundíbulo se basa en una potente fuerza de torsión para lanzar piedras a gran distancia, con una potencia capaz de destruir murallas. Esto hace que el fundíbulo sea una temible arma de asedio capaz de arrasar las defensas, ya que los agresores ahora pueden crear aperturas antes incluso de que comience la batalla, en lugar de tener que escalar empalizadas bajo el fuego enemigos. Los defensores, en cuanto vean un gran fundíbulo desplegado en las cercanías, deberían intentar destruirlo rápidamente.

Rule.Original: Mortar launcher. Lobs bombs over walls. Very inaccurate but long-ranged.
Rule.Raw: Mortar launcher. Lobs bombs over walls. Very inaccurate but long-ranged.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzador de mortero. Lanza bombas por encima de los muros. Muy impreciso pero de largo alcance.

Rule.Original: Developed during ancient times, the ballista repeater is a pinnacle of medieval engineering, it is a powerful missile weapon capable of launching multiple large darts over a quick sucession. Effective in both siege and defense, the precise design strikes fear into enemies but must be reloaded after every bolt fired.
Rule.Raw: Developed during ancient times, the ballista repeater is a pinnacle of medieval engineering, it is a powerful missile weapon capable of launching multiple large darts over a quick sucession. Effective in both siege and defense, the precise design strikes fear into enemies but must be reloaded after every bolt fired.
Rule.Translated: Un arma desarrollada en la antigüedad. La balista de repetición representa la culminación de la ingeniería bélica medieval, una poderosa arma de proyectiles capaz de lanzar múltiples dardos de gran tamaño en una rápida sucesión. Es eficaz tanto en el asedio como en la defensa. Su preciso diseño infunde miedo a los enemigos, pero debe recargarse después de cada proyectil disparo.
No puede disparar: necesita virotes de balista

Rule.Original: Upon closer inspection, this book appears to be quite ancient. Its cover is made of rough, worn leather, and the spine is held together by a series of intricate brass fastenings. The pages within are yellowed with age, and filled with strange symbols and arcane diagrams. Upon further examination, it becomes clear that this book contains a collection of research schematics for intermediate cooking recipes, military weapons such as blades, maces, and polearms, as well as light crossbows. It is unclear who wrote it, or for what purpose, but one thing is certain: this book holds secrets that have been lost to time, and could be of great use to those who seek to unlock its secrets.

It is unclear who wrote it, or for what purpose, but one thing is certain: this book holds secrets that have been lost to time, and could be of great use to those who seek to unlock its secrets.
Rule.Translated: Al examinarlo más de cerca, este libro parece muy antiguo. Su cubierta es de cuero áspero y desgastado, y una serie de intrincados cierres de latón mantiene unido el lomo. Sus páginas amarillentas están llenas de símbolos extraños y diagramas arcanos. Un examen más detenido revela una colección de planos de investigación para recetas de cocina intermedia, armas militares como espadas, mazas y armas de asta, además de ballestas ligeras. Se desconoce quién lo escribió o con qué propósito, pero una cosa es segura: contiene secretos perdidos en el tiempo que podrían resultar muy útiles a quien logre desentrañarlos.
El antiguo tomo de fabricación de materiales

Rule.Original: This ancient tome is bound in leather, with brass fastenings holding its spine together. Its pages are yellowed with age and filled with intricate diagrams and strange symbols. Upon closer examination, it becomes clear that this book contains a wealth of knowledge about advanced material processing techniques, including the creation of steel, tar, and gunpowder. It is unclear who wrote it or why, but one thing is certain: this book holds secrets that have been lost to time and could be of great value to those who seek to unlock its knowledge.

Rule.Translated: Este tomo antiguo está encuadernado en cuero, con cierres de latón que mantienen unido el lomo. Sus páginas amarillentas están llenas de intrincados diagramas y símbolos extraños. Al examinarlo más de cerca, resulta evidente que contiene abundantes conocimientos sobre técnicas avanzadas de procesamiento de materiales, como la fabricación de acero, alquitrán y pólvora. Se desconoce quién lo escribió o por qué, pero una cosa es segura: contiene secretos perdidos en el tiempo que podrían resultar muy valiosos a quien logre acceder a sus conocimientos.

Rule.Original: This ancient tome is bound in the finest leather, with intricate gold fastenings holding its spine together. Its pages are crisp and well-preserved, filled with detailed diagrams and ancient script. Upon closer examination, it becomes clear that this book contains a wealth of knowledge about the creation of noble weapons such as blades, maces, polearms, and heavy crossbows. It also holds information on using crossbows for defensive structures, as well as the secrets to creating the juiciest food imaginable. It is unclear who wrote it or why, but it is certain that this book is the most valuable of its kind and could be of great use to those who seek to unlock its secrets.

Rule.Translated: Este tomo antiguo está encuadernado en el mejor cuero, con intrincados cierres de oro que mantienen unido el lomo. Sus páginas están en buen estado y contienen diagramas detallados y escritura antigua. Al examinarlo más de cerca, resulta evidente que contiene abundantes conocimientos sobre la fabricación de armas nobles como espadas, mazas, armas de asta y ballestas pesadas. También incluye información sobre el uso de ballestas en estructuras defensivas y los secretos para preparar los platos más jugosos imaginables. Se desconoce quién lo escribió o por qué, pero es sin duda el ejemplar más valioso de su clase y podría resultar muy útil a quien logre acceder a sus secretos.

Rule.Translated: Divide las habitaciones. Las puertas sencillas deben abrirse manualmente, lo que ralentiza a la gente. El grado de ralentización depende del material del que esté hecha la puerta.

Rule.Raw: A tent made up of soft fabric or raw hide. Fast and easy to build but can be easily destroyed.\n\nDismantling the tent will return all resources.

Rule.Raw: Timber-framed construction filled with wattle and daub. Sturdy and capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura de entramado de madera rellena de cañizo y barro. Resistente y capaz de sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: An impassable high wall. Sturdy and capable of holding up a roof, but beware that due to its height it is weak to explosions.
Rule.Raw: An impassable high wall. Sturdy and capable of holding up a roof, but beware that due to its height it is weak to explosions.
Rule.Translated: Un muro alto infranqueable. Robusto y capaz de sostener un techo, pero debido a su altura es débil frente a explosiones.

Rule.Original: An organized collection of stakes designed to keep intruders out.\n\nWalking through the spikes can hurt pawns.
Rule.Raw: An organized collection of stakes designed to keep intruders out.\n\nWalking through the spikes can hurt pawns.
Rule.Translated: Una colección organizada de estacas diseñadas para mantener alejados a los intrusos./n/nCaminar por las estacas puede producir daños.

Rule.Original: A basic, unreinforced ditch that obstructs movement. Requires only labour to construct, but can be collapsed by damage.
Rule.Raw: A basic, unreinforced ditch that obstructs movement. Requires only labour to construct, but can be collapsed by damage.
Rule.Translated: Una zanja básica, no reforzada, que obstruye el movimiento. Su construcción solo requiere trabajo manual, pero puede derrumbarse si sufre daños.

Rule.Original: A reinforced trench that obstructs movement.which is deeper to make anyone or anything hard to crossover.
Rule.Raw: A reinforced trench that obstructs movement.which is deeper to make anyone or anything hard to crossover.
Rule.Translated: Una zanja reforzada que obstruye el movimiento. Con una profundidad mayor, es capaz de dificultar mucho más el paso de cualquier persona o cosa.

Rule.Original: A column capable of holding a roof. Does not block sight or movement and looks quite nice.
Rule.Raw: A column capable of holding a roof. Does not block sight or movement and looks quite nice.
Rule.Translated: Una columna capaz de sostener un techo. No bloquea la vista ni el movimiento y tiene buen aspecto.

Rule.Original: A beautiful gold-fitted column capable of holding a roof. Does not block sight or movement and looks quite nice.
Rule.Raw: A beautiful gold-fitted column capable of holding a roof. Does not block sight or movement and looks quite nice.
Rule.Translated: Una hermosa columna dorada capaz de sostener un techo. No bloquea la vista ni el movimiento, y cuenta con un aspecto bastante agradable.

Rule.Original: An insulated chest to store ice and passively refrigerate the surrounding environment.
Rule.Raw: An insulated chest to store ice and passively refrigerate the surrounding environment.
Rule.Translated: Un arcón aislado para guardar hielo y refrigerar pasivamente el entorno.

Rule.Translated: Una gran hoguera capaz de producir mucho calor y luz. Adecuada para quemar residuos y cadáveres. No se recomienda colocarla en interiores.

Rule.Raw: A box filled with dirt to grow plants.
Rule.Translated: Una caja llena de tierra para cultivar plantas.

Rule.Translated: Un montón de madera cubierto de tierra que arde lentamente para producir carbón vegetal como combustible y para la metalurgia.

Rule.Raw: A sturdy vessel used to brew potions, combining ingredients over heat to create powerful elixirs and remedies.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente resistente para elaborar pociones combinando ingredientes al calor y crear potentes elixires y remedios.

Rule.Raw: A wooden rack to dry goods under the sun to dehydrate and preserve them for a longer shelf life.
Rule.Translated: Un soporte de madera para secar productos al sol, deshidratarlos y conservarlos durante más tiempo.

Rule.Original: A wooden rack to dry goods under the sun for preservation and long time use.
Rule.Raw: A wooden rack to dry goods under the sun for preservation and long time use.
Rule.Translated: Un soporte de madera para secar productos al sol, conservarlos y poder usarlos durante mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: A standing rack for drying raw hides into stiff and untanned leathers.
Rule.Raw: A standing rack for drying raw hides into stiff and untanned leathers.
Rule.Translated: Un bastidor vertical para secar pieles crudas y obtener cueros rígidos sin curtir.

Rule.Original: A standing rack for treating raw hides to become soft and beautiful leathers.
Rule.Raw: A standing rack for treating raw hides to become soft and beautiful leathers.
Rule.Translated: Un estructura para tratar las pieles en bruto y convertirlas en cueros útiles.

Rule.Original: A wooden contraption to press selected items. Either to bring the juice out or whey from curds.
Rule.Raw: A wooden contraption to press selected items. Either to bring the juice out or whey from curds.
Rule.Translated: Un artilugio de madera para prensar los elementos seleccionados. Sirve tanto para extraer zumo como para separar el suero de la cuajada.

Rule.Original: A sturdy wooden device used to remove liquid and flatten sheets of paper. It uses a heavy screw mechanism to ensure each sheet is smooth and ready for writing or drawing. This essential tool helps turn pulp into usable parchment.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy wooden device used to remove liquid and flatten sheets of paper. It uses a heavy screw mechanism to ensure each sheet is smooth and ready for writing or drawing. This essential tool helps turn pulp into usable parchment.
Rule.Translated: Un robusto dispositivo de madera para extraer líquido y aplanar hojas de papel. Utiliza un mecanismo de tornillo pesado para dejar cada hoja lisa y lista para escribir o dibujar. Esta herramienta esencial transforma la pulpa en pergamino utilizable.

Rule.Original: Smoke generated by the burnt wood stacked at the bottom of the smoker encompasses the meat, providing indirect heat and a rich smoke flavor. This also adds a protective layer and allows the smoked meat to last longer.
Rule.Raw: Smoke generated by the burnt wood stacked at the bottom of the smoker encompasses the meat, providing indirect heat and a rich smoke flavor. This also adds a protective layer and allows the smoked meat to last longer.
Rule.Translated: El humo generado por la madera que se quema en el fondo de este instrumento envuelve la carne, proporcionando calor indirecto y un rico sabor a humo. Esto también añade una capa protectora que hace que la carne dure más tiempo.

Rule.Original: A wooden platform designed to hold silkworms during their cocoon life cycle and are harvested for silk once they have after fully spinning the cocoon.
Rule.Raw: A wooden platform designed to hold silkworms during their cocoon life cycle and are harvested for silk once they have after fully spinning the cocoon.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura de madera diseñada para albergar a los gusanos de seda, utilizada para recoger la seda una vez que han hilado completamente sus capullos.

Rule.Original: A large steel smelter used to refine scrap and raw resources. Generates strong heat.
Rule.Raw: A large steel smelter used to refine scrap and raw resources. Generates strong heat.
Rule.Translated: Una fundición de piedra utilizada para refinar chatarra, materias primas o incinerar cadáveres.

Rule.Original: A stone kiln used to cook raw clay into bricks.
Rule.Raw: A stone kiln used to cook raw clay into bricks.
Rule.Translated: Un horno de piedra para cocer arcilla cruda y convertirla en ladrillos.

Rule.Original: A wind-powered mill to automate grinding and sawing produce. Requires a large clear space in front and behind for optimal air flow.
Rule.Raw: A wind-powered mill to automate grinding and sawing produce. Requires a large clear space in front and behind for optimal air flow.
Rule.Translated: Un molino eólico para automatizar la molienda de productos. Requiere de un amplio espacio libre delante y detrás para optimizar el flujo de aire.

Rule.Original: A water-powered mill to automate grinding and sawing produce. Must be placed with its wheel in moving water. If watermills are placed too close together, the turbulence they generate will interfere.
Rule.Raw: A water-powered mill to automate grinding and sawing produce. Must be placed with its wheel in moving water. If watermills are placed too close together, the turbulence they generate will interfere.
Rule.Translated: Un molino hidráulico que automatiza la molienda y el aserrado de productos. Su rueda debe estar en agua en movimiento. Si varios molinos se colocan demasiado cerca, las turbulencias que generan interfieren entre sí.

Rule.Original: A wooden mold for freezing water into ice during times of cold.
Rule.Raw: A wooden mold for freezing water into ice during times of cold.
Rule.Translated: Un molde de madera para congelar agua y obtener hielo en épocas frías.

Rule.Original: A mechanical drum for treating raw hides to become soft and beautiful leathers.
Rule.Raw: A mechanical drum for treating raw hides to become soft and beautiful leathers.
Rule.Translated: Un tambor mecánico para tratar pieles crudas y convertirlas en cueros suaves y hermosos.

Rule.Original: A large blast furnace used to refine scrap and raw resources. Generates strong heat.
Rule.Raw: A large blast furnace used to refine scrap and raw resources. Generates strong heat.
Rule.Translated: Un gran alto horno para refinar chatarra y recursos en bruto. Genera mucho calor.

Rule.Original: An automatic device to spin cloth from thread.
Rule.Raw: An automatic device to spin cloth from thread.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo automático que convierte hilo en tela.

Rule.Original: A place for bashing stones to each other. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Raw: A place for bashing stones to each other. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para golpear piedras entre sí. La producción aquí es lenta, debido a la falta de herramientas.

Rule.Original: A wooden stump for butchering dead creatures into pieces of raw meat.
Rule.Raw: A wooden stump for butchering dead creatures into pieces of raw meat.
Rule.Translated: Un tocón de madera para descuartizar criaturas muertas y convertirlas en trozos de carne cruda.

Rule.Original: A small fortified hole dug through the ground to gain access to water.
Rule.Raw: A small fortified hole dug through the ground to gain access to water.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño hoyo reforzado excavado en el suelo para acceder al agua.

Rule.Original: A cooking table with a stone oven designed for baking meals.
Rule.Raw: A cooking table with a stone oven designed for baking meals.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de cocina con un horno de piedra diseñado para hornear comida.

Rule.Original: A cooking table with a stone oven designed for baking meals.
Rule.Raw: A cooking table with a stone oven designed for baking meals.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de cocina con un horno de piedra diseñado para hornear comida.

Rule.Original: A wood fueled grill used for cooking meals with an open fire.
Rule.Raw: A wood fueled grill used for cooking meals with an open fire.
Rule.Translated: Una parrilla de leña que se utiliza para cocinar con fuego abierto.

Rule.Original: A large metal cauldron that can cook delicious soups.
Rule.Raw: A large metal cauldron that can cook delicious soups.
Rule.Translated: Un gran recipiente de metal donde pueden cocinarse deliciosas sopas.

Rule.Original: A small round stone for grinding raw plants.
Rule.Raw: A small round stone for grinding raw plants.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña piedra redonda para moler materia vegetal en bruto.

Rule.Original: A simple platform to saw raw wood into planks.
Rule.Raw: A simple platform to saw raw wood into planks.
Rule.Translated: Una sencilla plataforma para aserrar madera en bruto en tablones.

Rule.Original: A table saw for turning logs into planks.
Rule.Raw: A table saw for turning logs into planks.
Rule.Translated: Una sierra de mesa para convertir troncos en tablones.

Rule.Original: A work table equipped with tools for crafting and designing items.
Rule.Raw: A work table equipped with tools for crafting and designing items.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo equipada con herramientas para crear y diseñar objetos.

Rule.Original: A work table equipped with tools for crafting and designing items.
Rule.Raw: A work table equipped with tools for crafting and designing items.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo equipada con herramientas para crear y diseñar objetos.

Rule.Original: A table to clean loot and ready them for display.
Rule.Raw: A table to clean loot and ready them for display.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa para limpiar los botines y prepararlos para su exposición.

Rule.Original: A heavy table, secured with a layer of thick leather. Stocked with all sorts of thingamajigs, it’s useless to uneducated mind whilst perfectly functional for an adept of forbidden arts. It’s everything an aspiring alchemist could wish for to mix ingredients and prepare oddly specific reagents.
Rule.Raw: A heavy table, secured with a layer of thick leather. Stocked with all sorts of thingamajigs, it’s useless to uneducated mind whilst perfectly functional for an adept of forbidden arts. It’s everything an aspiring alchemist could wish for to mix ingredients and prepare oddly specific reagents.
Rule.Translated: Una pesada mesa de madera, sujeta con una gruesa capa de cuero. Repleta de todo tipo de cachivaches, es inútil para una mente inculta, pero perfectamente funcional para un adepto de las artes prohibidas. Es todo lo que un aspirante a alquimista podría desear para mezclar ingredientes y preparar reactivos extrañamente específicos.

Rule.Original: A wooden table equipped with inkwells, quills, and parchment, designed for writing manuscripts and scrolls.
Rule.Raw: A wooden table equipped with inkwells, quills, and parchment, designed for writing manuscripts and scrolls.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de madera equipada con tinteros, plumas y pergamino, diseñada para escribir manuscritos y rollos.

Rule.Original: Greater technology requires greater minds, and thus, the simple research bench must upgraded to suit the needs of innovative inventors and accomplished researchers. From engineering to alchemy, the advanced research bench allows a colony to propel its technology into a new era of advanced warfare and medicine.
Rule.Raw: Greater technology requires greater minds, and thus, the simple research bench must upgraded to suit the needs of innovative inventors and accomplished researchers. From engineering to alchemy, the advanced research bench allows a colony to propel its technology into a new era of advanced warfare and medicine.
Rule.Translated: Una tecnología más avanzada requiere mentes más avanzadas, por lo que la mesa de investigación convencional debe actualizarse para adaptarse a las necesidades de inventores innovadores e investigadores consumados. Desde la ingeniería a la alquimia, la mesa de investigación avanzada permite a una colonia impulsar su tecnología hacia una nueva era de guerra y medicina avanzadas.

Rule.Original: A rolling contraption that processes raw cotton into fabrics.
Rule.Raw: A rolling contraption that processes raw cotton into fabrics.
Rule.Translated: Un artilugio rodante que permite transformar el algodón en bruto en tejido.

Rule.Original: A large stone furnace used to smelt raw ores and refine resources.
Rule.Raw: A large stone furnace used to smelt raw ores and refine resources.
Rule.Translated: Gran horno de piedra utilizado para fundir minerales en bruto y refinar recursos.

Rule.Original: A large metalworking tool with a flattened top surface to strike objects on such as weapons and armor.
Rule.Raw: A large metalworking tool with a flattened top surface to strike objects on such as weapons and armor.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta grande con una superficie superior plana, pensada como soporte para golpear el metal y fabricar cosas como armas y armaduras.

Rule.Original: A sturdy platform equipped with a primitive elevator built on top of a vertical tunnel. Can be used for mining resources and chunks.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy platform equipped with a primitive elevator built on top of a vertical tunnel. Can be used for mining resources and chunks.
Rule.Translated: Una plataforma robusta equipada con un ascensor primitivo construida sobre un túnel vertical. Puede utilizarse para extraer recursos y trozos de piedra.

Rule.Original: A wooden enclosure to host bees that produces honey and wax.
Rule.Raw: A wooden enclosure to host bees that produces honey and wax.
Rule.Translated: Un recinto de madera para albergar abejas y hacer que produzcan miel y cera.

Rule.Original: A gruel pot blending flavors from generations past into a timeless culinary adventure.
Rule.Raw: A gruel pot blending flavors from generations past into a timeless culinary adventure.
Rule.Translated: Una olla de gachas que combina sabores de generaciones pasadas en una aventura culinaria atemporal.

Rule.Original: A ragout pot blending flavors from generations past into a timeless culinary adventure.
Rule.Raw: A ragout pot blending flavors from generations past into a timeless culinary adventure.
Rule.Translated: Una olla de ragú que combina sabores de generaciones pasadas en una aventura culinaria atemporal.

Rule.Original: A fondue pot blending flavors from generations past into a timeless culinary adventure.
Rule.Raw: A fondue pot blending flavors from generations past into a timeless culinary adventure.
Rule.Translated: Una olla de fondue que combina sabores de generaciones pasadas en una aventura culinaria atemporal.

Rule.Original: A workbench for repairing clothes, armor, and weapons.
Rule.Raw: A workbench for repairing clothes, armor, and weapons.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo para reparar ropa, armaduras y armas.

Rule.Original: A place for mining minerals. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Raw: A place for mining minerals. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para extraer sal. La producción aquí es lenta, debido a la falta de herramientas.

Rule.Original: A place for digging the earth. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Raw: A place for digging the earth. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para excavar tierra. La producción es lenta debido a la falta de herramientas.

Rule.Original: A place for research simple concepts. Researching here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Raw: A place for research simple concepts. Researching here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para investigar conceptos sencillos. La investigación aquí es lenta, debido a la falta de herramientas.

Rule.Original: A place for gathering water. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Raw: A place for gathering water. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para recoger agua. La producción es lenta debido a la falta de herramientas.

Rule.Original: A Rox's horn. It is heavy, durable, and valuable. It is too bulky to be used as a weapon.
Rule.Raw: A Rox's horn. It is heavy, durable, and valuable. It is too bulky to be used as a weapon.
Rule.Translated: El cuerno de un heidrun. Es pesado, duradero y valioso, pero demasiado voluminoso como para usarlo de arma.

Rule.Original: A daers's antler. It's heavy, rock-hard, and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy that brings awe to whoever beholds upon it.
Rule.Raw: A daers's antler. It's heavy, rock-hard, and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy that brings awe to whoever beholds upon it.
Rule.Translated: La cornamenta de un eikthynir. Es pesada, dura como una roca y de un valor incalculable en la mayoría de los mercados. Es un verdadero trofeo que sobrecoge a quien lo contempla.

Rule.Original: A dire boar's tusk. It is very durable and valuable. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it can still be deadly.
Rule.Raw: A dire boar's tusk. It is very durable and valuable. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it can still be deadly.
Rule.Translated: El colmillo de un jabalí gigante. Es muy duradero y valioso. Aunque es algo difícil de manejar como arma cuerpo a cuerpo, puede ser letal.

Rule.Original: A hearty and nutritious packaged meal, packed for use in survival situations. It takes a long time to rot but it can still deteriorate if left outside. Great for adventuring.
Rule.Raw: A hearty and nutritious packaged meal, packed for use in survival situations. It takes a long time to rot but it can still deteriorate if left outside. Great for adventuring.
Rule.Translated: Una comida sustanciosa y nutritiva, envasada para su uso en situaciones de supervivencia. Tarda mucho en pudrirse, pero puede deteriorarse si se deja al aire libre. Ideal para aventureros.

Rule.Original: A hearty and nutritious packaged bread, typically prepared by wood rangers. It takes a long time to rot but it can still deteriorate if left outside. Great for adventuring.
Rule.Raw: A hearty and nutritious packaged bread, typically prepared by wood rangers. It takes a long time to rot but it can still deteriorate if left outside. Great for adventuring.
Rule.Translated: Una pasta de macci envasada, sustanciosa y nutritiva, que suelen preparar los rangers del bosque. Tarda mucho en pudrirse, pero puede deteriorarse si se deja al aire libre. Ideal para aventureros.

Rule.Original: Dried meat to preserve and prolong shelf life for later use as an ingredient in meals.
Rule.Raw: Dried meat to preserve and prolong shelf life for later use as an ingredient in meals.
Rule.Translated: Carne secada, para conservarla mejor y prolongar su vida útil.

Rule.Raw: >Dried meat to preserve and prolong shelf life for later use as an ingredient in meals. Does not rehydrate very well and only true cannibals can stomach it.
Rule.Translated: >Carne seca para conservarla y prolongar su duración, destinada a utilizarse después como ingrediente en comidas. No se rehidrata muy bien y solo los auténticos caníbales pueden digerirla.

Rule.Original: Dried insect meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.Does not rehydrate very well and not many can stomach it
Rule.Raw: Dried insect meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.Does not rehydrate very well and not many can stomach it
Rule.Translated: Carne de insecto seca para conservarla y prolongar su duración. Se rehidrata mal y pocos pueden digerirla

Rule.Original: Dried meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Raw: Dried meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Translated: Carne seca para conservarla y prolongar su duración.

Rule.Original: Smoked human meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Raw: Smoked human meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Translated: Carne humana ahumada para conservarla y prolongar su duración.

Rule.Original: Smoked insect meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Raw: Smoked insect meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Translated: Carne de insecto ahumada para conservarla y prolongar su duración.

Rule.Original: A sharp-tasting wheel of cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling animal milk. It makes for both a tasty treat on its own, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
Rule.Raw: A sharp-tasting wheel of cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling animal milk. It makes for both a tasty treat on its own, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda de queso de sabor fuerte, creada mediante un proceso especial de cuajado de la leche animal. Es un sabroso manjar en sí mismo, y un ingrediente versátil en cualquier plato.

Rule.Raw: A sharp-tasting wheel of cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling animal milk. It makes for both a tasty treat on its own, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.

Rule.Raw: A sharp-tasting wheel of cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling animal milk. It makes for both a tasty treat on its own, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
