Rule.Original: A thick slab of fatty rox meat, grilled to infuse smoky and savory flavors while seasoned with salt and stewed in ale. A luxurious feast that every king desires.
Rule.Raw: A thick slab of fatty rox meat, grilled to infuse smoky and savory flavors while seasoned with salt and stewed in ale. A luxurious feast that every king desires.
Rule.Translated: Un grueso trozo de carne de rox, asado a la parrilla para infundirle sabores ahumados y sabrosos, sazonado con sal y guisado en ale. Un lujoso festín digno de un rey.

Rule.Original: A delicious fruit-tart pie, consisting of a flakey sugar crust layer with a filling of pureed Griffon Berry, topped with a light lemon glaze.
Rule.Raw: A delicious fruit-tart pie, consisting of a flakey sugar crust layer with a filling of pureed Griffon Berry, topped with a light lemon glaze.
Rule.Translated: Una deliciosa tarta de frutas, compuesta por una corteza de azúcar hojaldrada, un relleno de puré de bayas de grifo y un ligero glaseado de limón.

Rule.Original: A rich meal consisting of spiced steak with chopped onion, sauteed in a light wine broth. A delightfully rich and bold-tasting meal.
Rule.Raw: A rich meal consisting of spiced steak with chopped onion, sauteed in a light wine broth. A delightfully rich and bold-tasting meal.
Rule.Translated: Una rica comida consistente en un filete especiado con cebolla picada, salteado en un ligero caldo de vino. Un plato delicioso con un sabor atrevido.

Rule.Original: A delightfully gooey soup consisting of cuts of melted cheese curd housed in a rich broth of garlic-spiced ale. A hearty dish best served warm, soothing for both the body and soul.
Rule.Raw: A delightfully gooey soup consisting of cuts of melted cheese curd housed in a rich broth of garlic-spiced ale. A hearty dish best served warm, soothing for both the body and soul.
Rule.Translated: Una sopa deliciosamente viscosa compuesta por trozos de requesón fundido en un rico caldo de ale con ajo y especias. Un plato contundente que es mejor servir caliente, capaz de calmar el cuerpo y el alma.

Rule.Original: A thick, milky soup housed in a bowl made from a hollowed out chunk of sour bread. A hearty, filling meal.
Rule.Raw: A thick, milky soup housed in a bowl made from a hollowed out chunk of sour bread. A hearty, filling meal.
Rule.Translated: Una sopa espesa y lechosa servida en un cuenco, hecha a partir de un trozo hueco de pan agrio. Una comida abundante y saciante.

Rule.Original: A pie that uses sliced apples for its principal filling ingredient, mixed together with profound spices. Typically covered with a lattice patterned crust then sprinkled with sugar for its finish.
Rule.Raw: A pie that uses sliced apples for its principal filling ingredient, mixed together with profound spices. Typically covered with a lattice patterned crust then sprinkled with sugar for its finish.
Rule.Translated: Una tarta cuyo relleno principal son manzanas cortadas en gajos, mezcladas con especias fuertes. Suele cubrirse con una corteza enrejada y espolvorearse con azúcar para rematar.

Rule.Original: A hearty stew consisting of boiled sausage sauteed in a vegetable broth with minced cabbage.
Rule.Raw: A hearty stew consisting of boiled sausage sauteed in a vegetable broth with minced cabbage.
Rule.Translated: Un contundente plato a base de salchichas cocidas, salteadas en un caldo de verduras con col picada.

Rule.Original: A simple dish consisting of a rich cut of cheese grilled with smoky fire.
Rule.Raw: A simple dish consisting of a rich cut of cheese grilled with smoky fire.
Rule.Translated: Un plato sencillo consistente en un rico corte de queso gratinado con fuego ahumado.

Rule.Original: Seasoned meat with spices encased in a cylindrical manner. Grilled in an open flame to bring out smoky flavors.
Rule.Raw: Seasoned meat with spices encased in a cylindrical manner. Grilled in an open flame to bring out smoky flavors.
Rule.Translated: Carne sazonada con especias envuelta en un cilindro. Se asa a la parrilla para que adquiera un sabor ahumado.

Rule.Original: A pie-adjacent breakfast food, consisting of layers of fluffy egg intermitted with delicious morsels of meat, baked into a hearty meal.
Rule.Raw: A pie-adjacent breakfast food, consisting of layers of fluffy egg intermitted with delicious morsels of meat, baked into a hearty meal.
Rule.Translated: Un complemento para el desayuno, consistente en varias capas de esponjoso huevo intercaladas con deliciosos bocados de carne, formando un abundante plato.

Rule.Original: Stacks of fluffy pan-fried shortcakes with a drizzel of sweet syrup plastered atop. A delicious, if not particularly healthy start to a day.
Rule.Raw: Stacks of fluffy pan-fried shortcakes with a drizzel of sweet syrup plastered atop. A delicious, if not particularly healthy start to a day.
Rule.Translated: Una pila de esponjosas tartaletas fritas con un chorrito de sirope dulce por encima. Aunque no son especialmente saludables, sí que alegran el comienzo de un día.

Rule.Original: A dense, rich pie made from mashed pumpkin mixed with strong spices, layered atop a sweet, flakey crust. A fall-favorite desert.
Rule.Raw: A dense, rich pie made from mashed pumpkin mixed with strong spices, layered atop a sweet, flakey crust. A fall-favorite desert.
Rule.Translated: Una tarta densa y rica hecha con puré de calabaza mezclado con especias fuertes, sobre una corteza dulce y hojaldrada. Uno de los postres favoritos del otoño.

Rule.Original: A creamy soup made from finely pureed pumpkin and a light assortment of spices.
Rule.Raw: A creamy soup made from finely pureed pumpkin and a light assortment of spices.
Rule.Translated: Una sopa cremosa hecha con puré fino de calabaza y un ligero surtido de especias.

Rule.Original: A sheet of fried, folded egg housing a tasteful cumilation of runny yolk and sauteed tomato.
Rule.Raw: A sheet of fried, folded egg housing a tasteful cumilation of runny yolk and sauteed tomato.
Rule.Translated: Una lámina de huevo frito y doblado que envuelve una sabrosa mezcla de yema líquida y tomate salteado.

Rule.Original: A weak broth made from animal bones. Not so filling on its own.
Rule.Raw: A weak broth made from animal bones. Not so filling on its own.
Rule.Translated: Un caldo pobre hecho de huesos de animales. No llena mucho por sí solo.

Rule.Original: Made from flour and water. A classic staple to start a day.
Rule.Raw: Made from flour and water. A classic staple to start a day.
Rule.Translated: Una comida hecha a base de harina y agua. Un clásico para empezar el día.

Rule.Original: A simple meal, consisting of eggs quickly prepared and optionally served with a light sprinkling of salt and or pepper.
Rule.Raw: A simple meal, consisting of eggs quickly prepared and optionally served with a light sprinkling of salt and or pepper.
Rule.Translated: Una comida sencilla, consistente en huevos preparados rápidamente y servidos opcionalmente con una ligera pizca de sal y/o pimienta.

Rule.Original: A simple dish made with boiled potatos then mashed into a soft mixture while supplmented with milk for a creamy base.
Rule.Raw: A simple dish made with boiled potatos then mashed into a soft mixture while supplmented with milk for a creamy base.
Rule.Translated: Un plato sencillo a base de patatas cocidas y machacadas hasta obtener una mezcla suave, a la que se añade leche para aumentar su cremosidad.

Rule.Original: A fragrant soup consisting of minced sauteed mushrooms in a rich milky broth, making for a bold-tasting, somewhat hearty meal.
Rule.Raw: A fragrant soup consisting of minced sauteed mushrooms in a rich milky broth, making for a bold-tasting, somewhat hearty meal.
Rule.Translated: Una aromática sopa de setas picadas y salteadas en un rico caldo lechoso, que constituye una comida contundente y algo sustanciosa.

Rule.Original: A rich stew of chopped vegetables, sauteed and boiled in a lightly seasoned broth. A hearty, yet healthy meal.
Rule.Raw: A rich stew of chopped vegetables, sauteed and boiled in a lightly seasoned broth. A hearty, yet healthy meal.
Rule.Translated: Un rico guiso de verduras picadas, salteadas y hervidas en un caldo ligeramente sazonado. Una comida abundante, pero sana.

Rule.Original: A sweet, dense biscuit of pumpkin and flour with a caramelized confectionery glaze.
Rule.Raw: A sweet, dense biscuit of pumpkin and flour with a caramelized confectionery glaze.
Rule.Translated: Una galleta dulce y densa de calabaza y harina con un glaseado de confitería caramelizado.

Rule.Original: Thick-cut chunks of seared meat arranged on a wooden stake, making for an easily-eaten, tasty meal.
Rule.Raw: Thick-cut chunks of seared meat arranged on a wooden stake, making for an easily-eaten, tasty meal.
Rule.Translated: Trozos gruesos de carne chamuscada ensartados con una estaca de madera, que forman una comida sabrosa y fácil de comer.

Rule.Original: A simple, yet hearty meal consisting of beans and chopped onion boiled in a light lentil broth.
Rule.Raw: A simple, yet hearty meal consisting of beans and chopped onion boiled in a light lentil broth.
Rule.Translated: Un plato sencillo pero contundente a base de alubias y cebolla picada, hervidas en un caldo ligero de lentejas.

Rule.Original: A light, homey soup primarily made up from lentils with a light sprinkling of herbs and seasonings. A perfect dish to sip on during a cold winter afternoon.
Rule.Raw: A light, homey soup primarily made up from lentils with a light sprinkling of herbs and seasonings. A perfect dish to sip on during a cold winter afternoon.
Rule.Translated: Una sopa ligera y casera compuesta principalmente de lentejas con un ligero toque de especias y otros condimentos. Un plato perfecto para saborear en una fría tarde de invierno.

Rule.Original: A bowl of slop, where every spoonful is an adventure in texture and taste!
Rule.Raw: A bowl of slop, where every spoonful is an adventure in texture and taste!
Rule.Translated: ¡Un cuenco de bazofia en el que cada cucharada es una aventura de textura y sabor!

Rule.Original: Venture into the murky depths of battle-tested stew, where the origins of its ingredients are as mysterious as the foes you face on the battlefield.
Rule.Raw: Venture into the murky depths of battle-tested stew, where the origins of its ingredients are as mysterious as the foes you face on the battlefield.
Rule.Translated: Adéntrate en las turbias profundidades de un guiso curtido en batalla, donde el origen de sus ingredientes es tan misterioso como los enemigos a los que te enfrentas en el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: Delve into the bubbling cauldron of fondue, where the melted cheese conceals the secrets of its savory companions, inviting you on a journey of culinary exploration
Rule.Raw: Delve into the bubbling cauldron of fondue, where the melted cheese conceals the secrets of its savory companions, inviting you on a journey of culinary exploration
Rule.Translated: Asómate al burbujeante caldero de fondue, donde el queso fundido oculta los secretos de sus sabrosos acompañantes y te invita a emprender un viaje de exploración culinaria.

Rule.Original: A moist and flavorful cake crafted from freshly grated carrots, infused with warm spices, and enveloped in a luscious cream cheese frosting. A classic indulgence perfect for any occasion.
Rule.Raw: A moist and flavorful cake crafted from freshly grated carrots, infused with warm spices, and enveloped in a luscious cream cheese frosting. A classic indulgence perfect for any occasion.
Rule.Translated: Un pastel jugoso y sabroso elaborado con zanahorias recién ralladas, aromatizado con especias cálidas y cubierto con un delicioso glaseado de queso crema. Un capricho clásico perfecto para cualquier ocasión.

Rule.Original: A zesty and moist cake infused with tangy lemon flavor, complemented by a light and fluffy texture. A refreshing dessert perfect for any occasion.
Rule.Raw: A zesty and moist cake infused with tangy lemon flavor, complemented by a light and fluffy texture. A refreshing dessert perfect for any occasion.
Rule.Translated: Un pastel jugoso de intenso sabor a limón y un ligero toque ácido, acompañado de una textura suave y esponjosa. Un postre refrescante perfecto para cualquier ocasión.

Rule.Original: Metal weapon scraps thare are broken and unusable. Can be smelted to recover resources.
Rule.Raw: Metal weapon scraps thare are broken and unusable. Can be smelted to recover resources.
Rule.Translated: Restos de armas metálicas rotas e inutilizables. Pueden fundirse para recuperar recursos.

Rule.Original: A book filled with information about a particular subject. Can be sold to interested traders.
Rule.Raw: A book filled with information about a particular subject. Can be sold to interested traders.
Rule.Translated: Un libro con información sobre un tema concreto. Puede venderse a los comerciantes interesados.

Rule.Original:
Volume 1 

He was crab, she was a crab 
could they they be any more oblivious 
He was a drone, she was a queen 
They just wanted to make a scene 
He wanted her, she wanted eggs 
Secretly she admired his legs 
But all the crabs had to propose 
they didnt like his crabby toes


he had a bigger claw, she had a lobster tail 
He was buttered up for her 
She wasnt very meek and could molt twice a week 
She had the thiccist armor


A few months from now, shes all alone 
feeding the eggs with her bio-foam 
she waits all day, waiting to see 
what her drone would say 
All of the while, she had a smile 
making armor for me


He had a bigger claw, she had a lobster tail 
He was butterd up for her 
Now hes in thick armor 
killing some rimworlders 
could it be better now 
I really dont see how 
the best race is the Brachyura.

Rule.Translated:
Volumen 1 
 

Él era cangrejo, ella era cangrejo 
 
¿podrían ser más inconscientes? 
 
Él era zángano, ella era reina 
 
Solo querían montar una escena 
 
Él la quería a ella, ella quería huevos 
 
En secreto ella admiraba sus piernas 
 
Pero todo cangrejo debía declararse 
 
no les gustaban sus dedos cangrejiles 
 
 

Él tenía una pinza mayor, ella tenía una cola de langosta 
 
Él estaba en mantequilla para ella 
 
Ella no era muy mansa y podía mudar dos veces por semana. 
 
Ella tenía la armadura más gruesa 
 
 

Dentro de unos meses, ella estará sola. 
 
alimentando los huevos con su bio-espuma 
 
ella espera todo el día, esperando a ver 
 
qué diría su zángano 
 
Todo el tiempo, ella tenía una sonrisa 
 
haciendo una armadura para mí 
 
 

Él tenía una pinza mayor, ella tenía una cola de langosta 
 
Él estaba en mantequilla para ella 
 
Ahora él tiene una gruesa armadura 
 
matando a algunos habitanted de la frontera 
 
¿podría ser mejor ahora? 
 
Realmente no veo cómo 
 
la mejor raza es la Brachyura.

Rule.Original:
A chalice most often used for drinking wine; this footed cup is made from silver, providing for an affordable way to improve the aesthetic of a hall.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!
Rule.Raw:

Rule.Original:

Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!

Rule.Original:
An elaborate silver bowl covered in dirt.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!

An elaborate silver bowl covered in dirt.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!

An elaborate gold bowl covered in dirt.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!

An elaborate gold bowl covered in dirt.

Rule.Original:
Found within the depths of ruins, the gold skull speaks of an ornate treasure held by those who walk as undead.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!
Rule.Raw:
Found within the depths of ruins, the gold skull speaks of an ornate treasure held by those who walk as undead.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!
Rule.Translated: Encontrada en las profundidades de las ruinas. La calavera de oro habla de un tesoro ornamentado que guardan los que caminan como no muertos.

Rule.Original:
A skull formed from the materials of a rare and prestigious gemstone. Although valuable, ruin delvers should tread carefully, for such a rich treasure would not go unprotected.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!
Rule.Raw:
A skull formed from the materials of a rare and prestigious gemstone. Although valuable, ruin delvers should tread carefully, for such a rich treasure would not go unprotected.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!
Rule.Translated: Una calavera formada a partir de los materiales de una piedra preciosa rara y prestigiosa. Aunque es valiosa, los buscadores de ruinas deben andarse con cuidado, pues un tesoro tan rico no quedaría desprotegido.

Rule.Original:
Glistening a blue hue, the skull of sapphire radiates with every curvature of its head. A treasure like this would surely fetch much wealth or would do well to be displayed in a great hall.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!

Rule.Original:
A grand prize of valuable gemstones, the ruby skull draws the attention of every lord, warrior, explorer, and merchant alike. A collector's prized possession.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!
Rule.Raw:
A grand prize of valuable gemstones, the ruby skull draws the attention of every lord, warrior, explorer, and merchant alike. A collector's prized possession.
Be sure to clean it with the cleaning table before placing it on your table!

Rule.Original: A set of dice of varying valuable gemstones; although small, each die is worth more than a pretty coin.
Rule.Raw: A set of dice of varying valuable gemstones; although small, each die is worth more than a pretty coin.
Rule.Translated: Un juego de dados de piedras preciosas de distinto valor. Aunque pequeños, cada dado vale más que cualquier simple moneda.

Rule.Original: Tattered scraps of parchment, often found scattered in ancient ruins or dropped by fleeing bandits. Each fragment holds a piece of a larger puzzle, scribbled with cryptic hints, crude maps, and faded symbols. When pieced together, these notes reveal the locations of hidden hideouts, forgotten treasures, and other intriguing points of interest. The pursuit of these fragmented clues leads adventurers on a journey of discovery, testing their wits and perseverance.
Rule.Raw: Tattered scraps of parchment, often found scattered in ancient ruins or dropped by fleeing bandits. Each fragment holds a piece of a larger puzzle, scribbled with cryptic hints, crude maps, and faded symbols. When pieced together, these notes reveal the locations of hidden hideouts, forgotten treasures, and other intriguing points of interest. The pursuit of these fragmented clues leads adventurers on a journey of discovery, testing their wits and perseverance.
Rule.Translated: Pedazos de pergamino hechos jirones, que suelen aparecer esparcidos por ruinas antiguas o caerse de las manos de bandidos que huyen. Cada fragmento contiene parte de un rompecabezas mayor, con pistas crípticas, mapas rudimentarios y símbolos desvaídos. Al recomponerlas, estas notas revelan guaridas ocultas, tesoros olvidados y otros puntos de interés intrigantes. La búsqueda de estas pistas fragmentadas conduce a los aventureros por un viaje de descubrimiento que pone a prueba su ingenio y perseverancia.

Rule.Original: A chunk of clay. Can be cut into blocks and than fired in a kiln for useable material.
Rule.Raw: A chunk of clay. Can be cut into blocks and than fired in a kiln for useable material.
Rule.Translated: Un fragmento de arcilla. Puede cortarse en bloques y cocerse en un horno para obtener material utilizable.

Rule.Original: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.
Rule.Raw: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.
Rule.Translated: Madera de árboles u otras plantas fibrosas. Útil para construir estructuras y armas. Es un buen combustible para hogueras y generadores, y puede refinarse para obtener biocombustible. En caso de apuro, un trozo de madera puede utilizarse como arma o pata.

Rule.Original: A darkish hard and old type of wood that has withstand the test of time. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires.
Rule.Raw: A darkish hard and old type of wood that has withstand the test of time. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de madera oscura, dura y antigua, que ha resistido el paso del tiempo. Útil para construir estructuras y armas. Es un buen combustible para las hogueras.

Rule.Original: A darkish hard and old type of wood that has withstand the test of time. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires.

Rule.Translated: Un tipo de madera oscura, dura y antigua, que ha resistido el paso del tiempo. Útil para construir estructuras y armas. Es un buen combustible para las hogueras.

Rule.Original: Coal is a black combustible chunk of rock formed by mostly carbon. A good source of fuel for stoves and furnaces.
Rule.Raw: Coal is a black combustible chunk of rock formed by mostly carbon. A good source of fuel for stoves and furnaces.
Rule.Translated: El carbón es un trozo de roca negra combustible formado principalmente por carbono. Es una buena fuente de combustible para estufas y hornos.

Rule.Original: Water which has been frozen to create blocks of ice. Will melt in temperatures above freezing.
Rule.Raw: Water which has been frozen to create blocks of ice. Will melt in temperatures above freezing.
Rule.Translated: Agua congelada para crear bloques de hielo. Se derrite a temperaturas superiores al punto de congelación.

Rule.Original: Water that has been gathered up and placed inside a pouch.
Rule.Raw: Water that has been gathered up and placed inside a pouch.
Rule.Translated: Agua recogida y guardada en un odre.

Rule.Original: An organic compound, solid at room temperature, which allows it to be stored for extended periods of time. Can be made into candles.
Rule.Raw: An organic compound, solid at room temperature, which allows it to be stored for extended periods of time. Can be made into candles.
Rule.Translated: Compuesto orgánico, sólido a temperatura ambiente, lo que permite almacenarlo durante largos periodos de tiempo. Puede transformarse en velas.

Rule.Original: The matriarch of a vulture bee colony originating from the regions of house oswin. Unlike typical bees, they consume carrion and produce a smokey and savory honey.
Rule.Raw: The matriarch of a vulture bee colony originating from the regions of house oswin. Unlike typical bees, they consume carrion and produce a smokey and savory honey.
Rule.Translated: La matriarca de una colonia de abejas originaria de las regiones de la casa Oswin. Se alimentan de carroña y son capaces de producir miel a partir de ella.

Rule.Original: A smokey and savory liquid substance made by vulture bees that can be used as a preservative or fermented into an alcoholic drink.
Rule.Raw: A smokey and savory liquid substance made by vulture bees that can be used as a preservative or fermented into an alcoholic drink.
Rule.Translated: Una sustancia líquida, dulce y viscosa que puede utilizarse como conservante o fermentarse para obtener una bebida alcohólica.

Rule.Original: Raw smokey honeycombs that contain vulture bee honey. \n\nCan be extracted to gain wax and smokey honey.
Rule.Raw: Raw smokey honeycombs that contain vulture bee honey. \n\nCan be extracted to gain wax and smokey honey.
Rule.Translated: Una sustancia líquida, dulce y viscosa que puede utilizarse como conservante o fermentarse para obtener una bebida alcohólica.

Rule.Original: A raw iron ore, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Raw: A raw iron ore, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Translated: Un mineral de hierro en bruto. Necesita ser transformado en lingotes en una fundición para ser utilizable.

Rule.Original: A bar of iron. Ready to be used in crafting and construction.
Rule.Raw: A bar of iron. Ready to be used in crafting and construction.
Rule.Translated: Una barra de hierro. Listo para ser utilizado en la artesanía y la construcción.

Rule.Original: A raw silver ore, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Raw: A raw silver ore, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Translated: Un mineral de plata en bruto. Necesita ser transformado en lingotes en una fundición para ser utilizable.

Rule.Original: A raw gold ore, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Raw: A raw gold ore, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Translated: Un mineral de oro en bruto. Necesita ser transformado en lingotes en una fundición para ser utilizable.

Rule.Original: Raw mithril, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Raw: Raw mithril, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
Rule.Translated: Mithril en bruto. Debe procesarse en lingotes en un horno de fundición para poder usarse.

Rule.Original: The pale, yellow quartz known as citrine is one of the lowest-valued crystals. Decorating jewelry with this gem increases wealth, even if by a smaller margin than more valuable gems.
Rule.Raw: The pale, yellow quartz known as citrine is one of the lowest-valued crystals. Decorating jewelry with this gem increases wealth, even if by a smaller margin than more valuable gems.
Rule.Translated: El cuarzo amarillo pálido conocido como citrino es uno de los cristales menos valorados. Adornar joyas con esta gema aumenta la riqueza, aunque en un grado menor que el de gemas más valiosas.

Rule.Original: A hardened gem of fossilized tree resin. Commonly admired by its natural yellowish orange hue, and is often used for ornaments and decorations. However, it is too soft to be used for weapons.
Rule.Raw: A hardened gem of fossilized tree resin. Commonly admired by its natural yellowish orange hue, and is often used for ornaments and decorations. However, it is too soft to be used for weapons.
Rule.Translated: Una gema endurecida de resina de árbol fosilizada. Comúnmente admirada por su tono natural naranja amarillento, se utiliza a menudo para adornos y decoraciones. Sin embargo, es demasiado blanda como para ser usada en armas.

Rule.Original: This black and white mineral alternates its colors through parallel bands, sometimes in harmony and other times in disarray. However, the chaotic colors don’t devalue this gem, yet instead increase its wealth, especially in carvings and jewelry.
Rule.Raw: This black and white mineral alternates its colors through parallel bands, sometimes in harmony and other times in disarray. However, the chaotic colors don’t devalue this gem, yet instead increase its wealth, especially in carvings and jewelry.
Rule.Translated: Este mineral blanco y negro alterna sus colores a través de bandas paralelas, a veces en armonía y otras en desorden. Sin embargo, los colores caóticos no devalúan esta gema, sino que aumentan su riqueza, especialmente en tallas y joyas.

Rule.Original: A hardy gemstone with a primarily green hue. The value brought by this crystal adds value to any ornament, be it a gem on a sword hilt or embellishment in a ring.
Rule.Raw: A hardy gemstone with a primarily green hue. The value brought by this crystal adds value to any ornament, be it a gem on a sword hilt or embellishment in a ring.
Rule.Translated: Una piedra preciosa resistente con un tono principalmente verde. El valor que aporta este cristal mejora cualquier adorno, ya sea como gema en la empuñadura de una espada o como complemento en un anillo.

Rule.Original: One of the more valuable and sought-after gemstones due to its crystalline facet. Its blue tone and gleam make for aesthetic jewelry, though even the gem holds enough value to draw the attention of dangerous vagrants.
Rule.Raw: One of the more valuable and sought-after gemstones due to its crystalline facet. Its blue tone and gleam make for aesthetic jewelry, though even the gem holds enough value to draw the attention of dangerous vagrants.
Rule.Translated: Una de las gemas más valiosas y codiciadas por su faceta cristalina. Su tono azul y su brillo la convierten en una joya estética, aunque incluso la gema tiene suficiente valor como para llamar la atención de peligrosos vagabundos.

Rule.Original: The most sought-after gemstone with a color as bloody as the sacrifice people take to obtain it. Cultures across the lands find themselves drawn to the aesthetically rich gem used for trading, jewelry-making, and even display.
Rule.Raw: The most sought-after gemstone with a color as bloody as the sacrifice people take to obtain it. Cultures across the lands find themselves drawn to the aesthetically rich gem used for trading, jewelry-making, and even display.
Rule.Translated: La gema más codiciada, con un color tan sangriento como el sacrificio que la gente hace para obtenerla. Culturas de todo el mundo se sienten atraídas por esta gema de gran riqueza estética, utilizada para el comercio, la joyería e incluso la exposición.

Rule.Original: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Raw: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Translated: Una hierba útil empleada para elaborar varias medicinas potentes.

Rule.Original: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Raw: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Translated: Una hierba útil empleada para elaborar varias medicinas potentes.

Rule.Original: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Raw: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Translated: Una hierba útil empleada para elaborar varias medicinas potentes.

Rule.Original: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Raw: Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
Rule.Translated: Una hierba útil empleada para elaborar varias medicinas potentes.

Rule.Original: An unfertilized cobra egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: An unfertilized cobra egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de cobra. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.
huevo de cobra del bosque grande (fert.)

Rule.Original: A large fertilized forest cobra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cobra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A large fertilized forest cobra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cobra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un gran huevo fecundado de cobra del bosque. Si todo va bien, debería eclosionar en una cría de cobra. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.
huevo de cobra de las cavernas grande (fert.)

Rule.Original: A large fertilized forest cobra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cobra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A large fertilized forest cobra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cobra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un gran huevo fecundado de cobra de las cavernas. Si todo va bien, debería eclosionar en una cría de cobra. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de constrictora gigante. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.
huevo de constrictor gigante del bosque (fert.)

Rule.Raw: A large fertilized forest cobra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cobra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

huevo de constrictor gigante de las cavernas (fert.)

Rule.Original: A large fertilized forest cobra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cobra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A large fertilized forest cobra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cobra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un gran huevo fecundado de constrictor de las cavernas. Si todo va bien, debería eclosionar en una cría de cobra. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Raw: An unfertilized lindwurm egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de lindwurm. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.

Rule.Raw: A large fertilized forest lindwurm egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby lindwurm. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

Rule.Original: A large fertilized forest lindwurm egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby lindwurm. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A large fertilized forest lindwurm egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby lindwurm. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un gran huevo fecundado de lindwurm de las cavernas. Si todo va bien, debería eclosionar en una cría de lindwurm. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Raw: An unfertilized webknecht egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de webknecht. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized webknecht egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby webknecht. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized webknecht egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby webknecht. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo fecundado de webknecht. Si todo va bien, de él nacerá una cría de webknecht. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: An unfertilized griffon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: An unfertilized griffon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo sin fecundar de grifo. Se puede comer crudo, pero está muchísimo mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized griffon egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby griffon. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized griffon egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby griffon. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo fecundado de grifo. Si todo va bien, de él nacerá una cría de grifo. Se puede comer crudo, pero está mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: Jelly stored and used as food by oversized insects. It is smooth, rich, and fulfills the recreation need of those who consume it. Because of its unique biological properties, it can nourish almost any creature and never rots.
Rule.Raw: Jelly stored and used as food by oversized insects. It is smooth, rich, and fulfills the recreation need of those who consume it. Because of its unique biological properties, it can nourish almost any creature and never rots.
Rule.Translated: Jalea que los insectos gigantes almacenan y utilizan como alimento. Es suave, nutritiva y satisface la necesidad de recreación de quienes la consumen. Sus propiedades biológicas únicas le permiten alimentar a casi cualquier criatura sin pudrirse nunca.

Rule.Original: A weak patch of leather that has not been exposed to tanning. Its hard and inflexible when dry but is very susceptible to water.
Rule.Raw: A weak patch of leather that has not been exposed to tanning. Its hard and inflexible when dry but is very susceptible to water.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de pieles parcheadas que no ha sido expuesto al curtido. Es duro e inflexible cuando está seco, pero muy sensible al agua.

Rule.Original: An abundant material, fat serves multiple purposes. In food, added fat improves meals and fills a colonist’s gut longer, but too much and the colonist will more likely get sick. In survival, fat can be added to flames, whether in a torch or a bonfire, to maintain heat longer. Finally, rendered fat can mold into candles, soaps, sculptures, and more.
Rule.Raw: An abundant material, fat serves multiple purposes. In food, added fat improves meals and fills a colonist’s gut longer, but too much and the colonist will more likely get sick. In survival, fat can be added to flames, whether in a torch or a bonfire, to maintain heat longer. Finally, rendered fat can mold into candles, soaps, sculptures, and more.
Rule.Translated: Un material orgánico abundante con un sinfín de usos. En la alimentación, la grasa añadida mejora las comidas y satisface el apetito de los colonos durante más tiempo, aunque en exceso es posible que perjudique su salud. En la supervivencia, la grasa puede añadirse a las llamas, ya sean las de una antorcha o una hoguera, para mantener el calor durante más tiempo. Por último, la grasa fundida puede moldearse para hacer velas, jabones, esculturas y mucho más.

Rule.Original: Tallow is a rendered form of fat, solid at room temperature, which allows it to be stored for extended periods of time. Can be made into candles.
Rule.Raw: Tallow is a rendered form of fat, solid at room temperature, which allows it to be stored for extended periods of time. Can be made into candles.
Rule.Translated: El sebo es una forma de grasa sólida a temperatura ambiente, lo que permite almacenarla durante largos periodos de tiempo. Puede transformarse en velas.

Rule.Original: Flour is used to prepare many different meals and can be stored for very long periods of time, but cannot be eaten raw. Due to its nature, it can be stored very efficiently.
Rule.Raw: Flour is used to prepare many different meals and can be stored for very long periods of time, but cannot be eaten raw. Due to its nature, it can be stored very efficiently.
Rule.Translated: La harina se utiliza para preparar una gran variedad de platos. Puede almacenarse durante periodos de tiempo muy largos, pero no puede comerse cruda. Debido a su naturaleza, puede almacenarse de forma muy eficiente.

Rule.Original: Dried stalks of grain, used especially as fodder, harvested and compacted for storage. Straw is good animal feed, but inedible for humans.
Rule.Raw: Dried stalks of grain, used especially as fodder, harvested and compacted for storage. Straw is good animal feed, but inedible for humans.
Rule.Translated: Tallos secos de cereales, utilizados sobre todo como forraje, cosechados y compactados para su almacenamiento. La paja es un buen alimento para los animales, pero no es comestible para los humanos.

Rule.Original: Salt is a common mineral, often found in natural rocky deposits and in abundance in the ocean. It is often used for food preservation, and as a seasoning in meals.
Rule.Raw: Salt is a common mineral, often found in natural rocky deposits and in abundance in the ocean. It is often used for food preservation, and as a seasoning in meals.
Rule.Translated: La sal es un mineral común que suele encontrarse en depósitos rocosos naturales y en abundancia en el océano. Se utiliza a menudo para conservar alimentos y como condimento en las comidas.

Rule.Original: A sweet, white powdery substance extracted from the sugar cane plant.
Rule.Raw: A sweet, white powdery substance extracted from the sugar cane plant.
Rule.Translated: Una sustancia en forma de polvo blanco y dulce, extraída de la planta de la caña de azúcar.

Rule.Original: A mix of dried and crushed seasonings, provides wonderful aroma and flavours.
Rule.Raw: A mix of dried and crushed seasonings, provides wonderful aroma and flavours.
Rule.Translated: Una mezcla de condimentos secos y triturados, que proporciona un aroma y un sabor maravillosos.

Rule.Original: Minced meat mixed with herbs and spices.
Rule.Raw: Minced meat mixed with herbs and spices.
Rule.Translated: Carne picada mezclada con hierbas y especias.

Rule.Original: Miscellaneous gears, wheels, nails. Necessary for assembling complex contraptions.
Rule.Raw: Miscellaneous gears, wheels, nails. Necessary for assembling complex contraptions.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de engranajes, ruedas, clavos y otras cosas. Necesarios para montar artilugios complejos.

Rule.Original: Miscellaneous bits and bobs to repair equipment
Rule.Raw: Miscellaneous bits and bobs to repair equipment
Rule.Translated: Diversas piezas y utensilios para reparar equipo

Rule.Original: An empty sheet of paper. Useful for scribbling or writing notes.
Rule.Raw: An empty sheet of paper. Useful for scribbling or writing notes.
Rule.Translated: Una hoja de papel vacía. Útil para garabatear o escribir notas.

Rule.Original: Tannins leeched from various natural sources have been concentrated into this liquor. It can be used to treat raw hides into tanned leathers.
Rule.Raw: Tannins leeched from various natural sources have been concentrated into this liquor. It can be used to treat raw hides into tanned leathers.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de compuestos aptos para el curtido procedentes de diversas fuentes naturales se concentran en esta solución. Puede utilizarse para transformar pieles en bruto en cueros curtidos.

Rule.Original: A thick, fibrous pulp created from finely ground fibrous materials, soaked and blended into a smooth consistency. This mixture is the essential raw material for crafting paper, ready to be spread, pressed, and dried into sturdy sheets for writing and drawing.
Rule.Raw: A thick, fibrous pulp created from finely ground fibrous materials, soaked and blended into a smooth consistency. This mixture is the essential raw material for crafting paper, ready to be spread, pressed, and dried into sturdy sheets for writing and drawing.
Rule.Translated: Una pulpa espesa y fibrosa elaborada con materiales fibrosos finamente triturados, remojados y mezclados hasta obtener una consistencia uniforme. Esta mezcla es la materia prima esencial para fabricar papel, lista para extenderse, prensarse y secarse en hojas resistentes para escribir y dibujar.

Rule.Original: A black viscious liquid that acts as an adhesive or flammable source of material used for siege warfare.
Rule.Raw: A black viscious liquid that acts as an adhesive or flammable source of material used for siege warfare.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido negro viscoso que actúa como adhesivo o como material inflamable en armas de asedio.

Rule.Original: A black powdery substance that is highly explosive and typically used in firearms.
Rule.Raw: A black powdery substance that is highly explosive and typically used in firearms.
Rule.Translated: Un polvo negro muy explosivo que suele utilizarse en las armas de fuego.

Rule.Original: A heavy bolt used by scorpios.
Rule.Raw: A heavy bolt used by scorpios.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil pesado utilizado por los escorpiones.

Rule.Original: A heavy bolt used by ballistas.
Rule.Raw: A heavy bolt used by ballistas.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil pesado utilizado por las balistas.

Rule.Original: A heavy chunk of rock, robust and round.
Rule.Raw: A heavy chunk of rock, robust and round.
Rule.Translated: Un pesado trozo de roca, robusto y redondo.

Rule.Original: A heavy chunk of rock, robust and round. \n\nCovered with tar, which can be lit once ready to be thrown.
Rule.Raw: A heavy chunk of rock, robust and round. \n\nCovered with tar, which can be lit once ready to be thrown.
Rule.Translated: Un pesado trozo de roca, robusto y redondo.\n\nEstá cubierta de alquitrán, por lo que puede encenderse antes de ser lanzada.

Rule.Original: A concentrated mixture of herbal essence extracted by grinding multiple raw herbs. It is less potent than industrial pharmaceuticals, but much better than nothing.
Rule.Raw: A concentrated mixture of herbal essence extracted by grinding multiple raw herbs. It is less potent than industrial pharmaceuticals, but much better than nothing.
Rule.Translated: Una mezcla concentrada de esencia herbal extraída al triturar varias hierbas crudas. Es menos potente que los fármacos industriales, pero mucho mejor que nada.

Rule.Original: A sphere of life energy, still feeding few writhing vines. Its pulsing rate increases when held in hand, greedily drawing heat from the limb. An important ingredient in numerous occult rituals, certainly a valuable possession.
Rule.Raw: A sphere of life energy, still feeding few writhing vines. Its pulsing rate increases when held in hand, greedily drawing heat from the limb. An important ingredient in numerous occult rituals, certainly a valuable possession.
Rule.Translated: Una esfera de energía vital, que sigue alimentando a unas pocas enredaderas retorcidas. Su frecuencia de pulsación aumenta cuando se sostiene en la mano, extrayendo ávidamente calor del portador. Un ingrediente importante en numerosos rituales ocultos, y sin duda, una posesión valiosa.

Rule.Original: A dark oaken wood as ancient as time. The wood is renowned for its strength and durability to withstand physical blows. A perfect material to use for a shield.
Rule.Raw: A dark oaken wood as ancient as time. The wood is renowned for its strength and durability to withstand physical blows. A perfect material to use for a shield.
Rule.Translated: Una madera de roble oscura tan antigua como el tiempo. Esta madera es famosa por su fuerza y su resistencia a la hora de soportar golpes físicos. Un material perfecto para fabricar escudos.

Rule.Original: Bright in its wake yet rich in hue. A glamorous gem that radiates the deep colours of the forest. It serves as an ingredient for potions and other formulaic procedures.
Rule.Raw: Bright in its wake yet rich in hue. A glamorous gem that radiates the deep colours of the forest. It serves as an ingredient for potions and other formulaic procedures.
Rule.Translated: Brillante en su estela pero rica en matices. Una gema glamurosa que irradia los colores profundos del bosque. Sirve como ingrediente para pociones y otras fórmulas.

Rule.Original: Enormous remnants of unsavory unholds, exuding an aura of primal power and intrigue, sought after for their immense size and physical resiliance.
Rule.Raw: Enormous remnants of unsavory unholds, exuding an aura of primal power and intrigue, sought after for their immense size and physical resiliance.

Rule.Original: Warm furs of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.
Rule.Raw: Warm furs of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.
Rule.Translated: Pieles cálidas del formidable unhold, célebres por su grosor y resistencia a la intemperie, muy codiciadas para confeccionar prendas resistentes y equipo protector.

Rule.Original: Robust hides of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.
Rule.Raw: Robust hides of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.
Rule.Translated: Cueros robustos del formidable unhold, célebres por su grosor y resistencia a la intemperie, muy codiciados para confeccionar prendas resistentes y equipo protector.

Rule.Original: The beating heart of the fearsome unhold, pulsing with primal power and ancient vitality, considered to be a key ingredient for creating elixirs of endurance.
Rule.Raw: The beating heart of the fearsome unhold, pulsing with primal power and ancient vitality, considered to be a key ingredient for creating elixirs of endurance.
Rule.Translated: El corazón palpitante del temible unhold, lleno de poder primitivo y vitalidad ancestral, considerado un ingrediente fundamental para elaborar elixires de resistencia.

Rule.Original: The heart of an Ancient Troll, prized for its alchemical properties.
Rule.Raw: The heart of an Ancient Troll, prized for its alchemical properties.
Rule.Translated: El corazón de un trol ancestral, apreciado por sus propiedades alquímicas.

Rule.Original: The strong strands of a Webknecht, lighter and stronger than steel.
Rule.Raw: The strong strands of a Webknecht, lighter and stronger than steel.
Rule.Translated: Los resistentes hilos de un Webknecht, más ligeros y fuertes que el acero.

Rule.Original: Webknect poison is known world wide for the ability to drop a Rox.
Rule.Raw: Webknect poison is known world wide for the ability to drop a Rox.
Rule.Translated: El veneno de Webknect es conocido en todo el mundo por su capacidad para derribar a un Rox.

Rule.Original: Redback poison is known world wide for the ability drop a Daer.
Rule.Raw: Redback poison is known world wide for the ability drop a Daer.
Rule.Translated: El veneno de Redback es conocido en todo el mundo por su capacidad para derribar a un Daer.

Rule.Original: The acidic blood of a Lindwurm, carefully preserved in glass. Highly corrosive in nature, it can melt through plate armor in a matter of seconds. Due to it’s offensive capabilities, it is highly sought for by alchemists and hunters.
Rule.Raw: The acidic blood of a Lindwurm, carefully preserved in glass. Highly corrosive in nature, it can melt through plate armor in a matter of seconds. Due to it’s offensive capabilities, it is highly sought for by alchemists and hunters.
Rule.Translated: La sangre ácida de un lindwurm, cuidadosamente conservada en un recipiente de vidrio. Es tan corrosiva que puede fundir una armadura de placas en cuestión de segundos. Sus propiedades ofensivas la hacen muy codiciada por alquimistas y cazadores.

Rule.Original: Strong and lightweight bones from a Lindwurm, valued for their durability and often used in crafting sturdy weapons and specialized tools.
Rule.Raw: Strong and lightweight bones from a Lindwurm, valued for their durability and often used in crafting sturdy weapons and specialized tools.
Rule.Translated: Huesos resistentes y ligeros de un lindwurm, apreciados por su durabilidad y utilizados a menudo para fabricar armas robustas y herramientas especializadas.

Rule.Original: Tough, durable scales shed from a Lindwurm, prized for their exceptional strength and resilience. Ideal for crafting high-quality armor and protective gear.
Rule.Raw: Tough, durable scales shed from a Lindwurm, prized for their exceptional strength and resilience. Ideal for crafting high-quality armor and protective gear.
Rule.Translated: Escamas duras y resistentes que ha desprendido un lindwurm, apreciadas por su extraordinaria fortaleza y durabilidad. Ideales para fabricar armaduras y equipo protector de gran calidad.

Rule.Original: Sharp, twisted horns from a Nachzehrer, known for their hardness and used in crafting powerful weapons or ritualistic items.
Rule.Raw: Sharp, twisted horns from a Nachzehrer, known for their hardness and used in crafting powerful weapons or ritualistic items.
Rule.Translated: Cuernos afilados y retorcidos de un nachzehrer, conocidos por su dureza y utilizados para fabricar armas poderosas u objetos rituales.

Rule.Original: Soft yet durable hide from an Alp, often used to craft lightweight armor or clothing with subtle protective qualities.
Rule.Raw: Soft yet durable hide from an Alp, often used to craft lightweight armor or clothing with subtle protective qualities.
Rule.Translated: Piel suave pero resistente de un Alp, usada a menudo en armaduras ligeras o ropa con discretas propiedades protectoras.

Rule.Original: A unique part of Alp biology, this solidified manifestation of the creature's final cry is a rare and eerie material used in crafting or dark rituals.
Rule.Raw: A unique part of Alp biology, this solidified manifestation of the creature's final cry is a rare and eerie material used in crafting or dark rituals.
Rule.Translated: Una parte singular de la biología del alp: la manifestación solidificada del último grito de la criatura. Es un material escaso y siniestro utilizado en la fabricación o en rituales oscuros.

Rule.Original: A mystical organ from an Alp, known for its ability to perceive beyond the physical realm. Often sought after for use in powerful rituals or crafting items with enhanced perception or psychic abilities.
Rule.Raw: A mystical organ from an Alp, known for its ability to perceive beyond the physical realm. Often sought after for use in powerful rituals or crafting items with enhanced perception or psychic abilities.
Rule.Translated: Un órgano místico de un alp, conocido por su capacidad de percibir más allá del mundo físico. Muy codiciado para rituales poderosos o para fabricar objetos que mejoran la percepción o las capacidades psíquicas.

Rule.Original: This organ significantly enhances the body's fight-or-flight response, increasing strength, speed, and reaction time when activated. Often used in crafting potent combat stimulants.
Rule.Raw: This organ significantly enhances the body's fight-or-flight response, increasing strength, speed, and reaction time when activated. Often used in crafting potent combat stimulants.
Rule.Translated: Este órgano mejora considerablemente la respuesta corporal de lucha o huida, aumentando la fuerza, la velocidad y el tiempo de reacción al activarse. Suele utilizarse para elaborar potentes estimulantes de combate.

Rule.Original: Stalks of plant fibre. Its fibre can be utilized for its stringy properties and will make good fabric.
Rule.Raw: Stalks of plant fibre. Its fibre can be utilized for its stringy properties and will make good fabric.
Rule.Translated: Tallos de fibra vegetal. Su fibra se puede utilizar por sus propiedades fibrosas y sirve para hacer buenas telas.

Rule.Original: Small wormy critters that produces silk for their cocoons that can be harvested to create fine silk.
Rule.Raw: Small wormy critters that produces silk for their cocoons that can be harvested to create fine silk.
Rule.Translated: Pequeñas criaturas que producen seda para formar sus capullos. Esta seda puede cosecharse para crear una fibra de gran calidad.
Un esponjoso producto proveniente de la planta homónima, útil para producir fibras.

Rule.Original: Wheat is a vital crop for the peasantry, its golden stalks ripening under the sun, ready to be harvested for sustenance and trade. Cultivated in vast fields, it ensures villages thrive and the people remain well-fed, securing the livelihood of the hard working peasants.
Rule.Raw: Wheat is a vital crop for the peasantry, its golden stalks ripening under the sun, ready to be harvested for sustenance and trade. Cultivated in vast fields, it ensures villages thrive and the people remain well-fed, securing the livelihood of the hard working peasants.
Rule.Translated: El trigo es un cereal que puede molerse para obtener harina.

Rule.Original: Tasty grapes that can be eaten raw. Useful for making wine.
Rule.Raw: Tasty grapes that can be eaten raw. Useful for making wine.
Rule.Translated: Uvas sabrosas que pueden comerse crudas. Útiles para elaborar vino.

Rule.Original: Raw sugarcane. Needs to be grineded into sugar to be usuable.
Rule.Raw: Raw sugarcane. Needs to be grineded into sugar to be usuable.
Rule.Translated: Caña de azúcar en bruto. Hay que molerla para convertirla en azúcar.

Rule.Original: Bone from animals, including humans, can be used as a general material. Bone weapons and armor offer poor durability but accessible protection. Buildings and art inlaid with bone provide decoration to otherwise poor or dull materials. Although easy to acquire, using bones as entire structures, such as a wall or door, should be cautioned. The best use of bone, whether for armor or art, should be to elevate other materials.
Rule.Raw: Bone from animals, including humans, can be used as a general material. Bone weapons and armor offer poor durability but accessible protection. Buildings and art inlaid with bone provide decoration to otherwise poor or dull materials. Although easy to acquire, using bones as entire structures, such as a wall or door, should be cautioned. The best use of bone, whether for armor or art, should be to elevate other materials.
Rule.Translated: El hueso de los animales, incluidos los humanos, puede utilizarse como material de propósito general. Las armas y armaduras de hueso ofrecen poca durabilidad pero una protección accesible. Los edificios y las obras de arte con incrustaciones de hueso proporcionan decoración a materiales que, de otro modo, serían pobres o aburridos. Aunque son fáciles de adquirir, hay que tener cuidado al utilizar huesos como estructuras integrales, tales como muros o puertas. El mejor uso del hueso, ya sea en armaduras o arte, debe ser el de complemento de otros materiales.

Rule.Original: A resillient fabric made out of dried fibres of flax.
Rule.Raw: A resillient fabric made out of dried fibres of flax.
Rule.Translated: Un tejido resistente hecho de fibras secas de lino.

Rule.Original: A soft and luxurious fabric frequently tailored for noble apparel.
Rule.Raw: A soft and luxurious fabric frequently tailored for noble apparel.
Rule.Translated: Un tejido suave y lujoso que se utiliza con frecuencia para prendas nobles.

Rule.Original: The fabled leather of a rox, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. Though somewhat rough in its raw form, none can deny its incredible insulating capabilities due to the sheer density of rox hairs. That same density as well as innate composition makes it surprisingly flame- retardent, preventing oxygen from reaching any smoldering embers on the fur. That said, it is a heavy material to work with.
Rule.Raw: The fabled leather of a rox, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. Though somewhat rough in its raw form, none can deny its incredible insulating capabilities due to the sheer density of rox hairs. That same density as well as innate composition makes it surprisingly flame- retardent, preventing oxygen from reaching any smoldering embers on the fur. That said, it is a heavy material to work with.
Rule.Translated: El legendario cuero del rox, obtenido al despellejar una de estas poderosas bestias. Aunque resulta algo áspero en bruto, nadie puede negar su extraordinaria capacidad aislante gracias a la enorme densidad de su pelo. Esa misma densidad y su composición natural lo hacen sorprendentemente resistente a las llamas, pues impiden que el oxígeno alcance las brasas que puedan formarse en el pelaje. Eso sí, es un material pesado.

Rule.Original: The fabled leather of a griffon, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. It boasts a unique blend of strength and suppleness, imbued with the creature's majestic aura. With its intricate patterns and exceptional durability, griffon leather is prized among craftsmen for its ability to fashion garments and goods of unparalleled quality and prestige.
Rule.Raw: The fabled leather of a griffon, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. It boasts a unique blend of strength and suppleness, imbued with the creature's majestic aura. With its intricate patterns and exceptional durability, griffon leather is prized among craftsmen for its ability to fashion garments and goods of unparalleled quality and prestige.
Rule.Translated: El legendario cuero del grifo, obtenido al despellejar una de estas poderosas bestias. Combina resistencia y flexibilidad, impregnado del aura majestuosa de la criatura. Sus intrincados patrones y excepcional durabilidad hacen que los artesanos lo aprecien para confeccionar prendas y artículos de calidad y prestigio incomparables.

Rule.Original: A strong furry pelt harvested from a vicious direwolf. Harder than regular wolf pelt and insulates well against cold.
Rule.Raw: A strong furry pelt harvested from a vicious direwolf. Harder than regular wolf pelt and insulates well against cold.
Rule.Translated: Una piel fuerte y peluda de un feroz lobo gigante. Más resistente que la de un lobo normal y aísla bien del frío.

Rule.Original: A strong furry pelt harvested from a vicious direboar. Harder than regular boar pelt and insulates well against cold.
Rule.Raw: A strong furry pelt harvested from a vicious direboar. Harder than regular boar pelt and insulates well against cold.
Rule.Translated: Una piel fuerte y peluda de un feroz jabalí gigante. Más resistente que la de un jabalí normal y aísla bien del frío.

Rule.Original: A soft furry pelt harvested from a hyena. It is difficult to pierce and insulates well against heat.
Rule.Raw: A soft furry pelt harvested from a hyena. It is difficult to pierce and insulates well against heat.
Rule.Translated: Una piel suave y peluda de hiena. Es difícil de perforar y aísla bien del calor.
Piel de trol curtida, seca y raspada.

Rule.Original: The fabled leather of a daer, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. Though somewhat rough in its raw form, none can deny its incredible insulating capabilities due to the sheer density of daer hairs. That same density as well as innate composition makes it surprisingly flame- retardent, preventing oxygen from reaching any smoldering embers on the fur. That said, it is a heavy material to work with.
Rule.Raw: The fabled leather of a daer, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. Though somewhat rough in its raw form, none can deny its incredible insulating capabilities due to the sheer density of daer hairs. That same density as well as innate composition makes it surprisingly flame- retardent, preventing oxygen from reaching any smoldering embers on the fur. That said, it is a heavy material to work with.
Rule.Translated: El legendario cuero de un eikthynir, hecho de la piel de una de las bestias más poderosas. Aunque algo áspero en bruto, nadie puede negar la increíble capacidad de aislamiento que tiene gracias a la densidad de los pelos de esta criatura. Esa misma densidad, así como su composición innata, lo hacen sorprendentemente ignífugo, impidiendo que el oxígeno llegue a las brasas ardientes del pelaje. Dicho esto, es un material pesado con el que trabajar.

Rule.Original: A broad green husks size of a hand, tinting the reflected light emerald. Material both durable and elegant, attracting envious glances.
Rule.Raw: A broad green husks size of a hand, tinting the reflected light emerald. Material both durable and elegant, attracting envious glances.
Rule.Translated: Una amplia cáscara verde del tamaño de una mano, que tiñe la luz reflejada de un bello color esmeralda. Un material duradero a la vez que elegante, capaz de atraer miradas envidiosas.

Rule.Original: Thick, coarse and provides very good insulation. Rox wool clothes can keep the body warm even in very cold conditions.
Rule.Raw: Thick, coarse and provides very good insulation. Rox wool clothes can keep the body warm even in very cold conditions.
Rule.Translated: Una lana gruesa, basta y que proporciona muy buen aislamiento. La ropa de lana heidrun puede mantener el cuerpo caliente incluso en las condiciones más gélidas.

Rule.Original: An unfinished piece of an hide.
Rule.Raw: An unfinished piece of an hide.
Rule.Translated: Una pieza inacabada de un cuero.

Rule.Original: An unfinished piece of hide armor.
Rule.Raw: An unfinished piece of hide armor.
Rule.Translated: Una pieza inacabada de armadura de piel.
Un escudo de lindwurm sin terminar.

Rule.Original: A warm robust coat sewn from a wolf's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious wolf to don the trophy.
Rule.Raw: A warm robust coat sewn from a wolf's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious wolf to don the trophy.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo robusto y cálido confeccionado a partir de la piel de un lobo. Llevarla demuestra la fuerza del dueño, ya que es la prueba de que ha matado a un lobo y lo lleva puesto como trofeo.

Rule.Original: A warm robust coat sewn from a bears's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious bear to don the trophy.
Rule.Raw: A warm robust coat sewn from a bears's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious bear to don the trophy.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo robusto y cálido confeccionado a partir de la piel de un oso. Llevarla demuestra la fuerza del dueño, ya que es la prueba de que ha matado a un oso y lo lleva puesto como trofeo.

Rule.Original: A warm robust coat sewn from a direwolf's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious wolf to don the trophy.
Rule.Raw: A warm robust coat sewn from a direwolf's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious wolf to don the trophy.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo robusto y cálido confeccionado a partir de piel de un lobo gigante. Llevarla demuestra la fuerza del dueño, ya que es la prueba de que ha matado a un lobo gigante y lo lleva puesto como trofeo.

Rule.Original: A warm robust coat sewn from a hyena's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious hyena to don the trophy. While intimidating the fearful, the pelt also grants strength and confidence in battle.
Rule.Raw: A warm robust coat sewn from a hyena's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious hyena to don the trophy. While intimidating the fearful, the pelt also grants strength and confidence in battle.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo robusto y cálido confeccionado a partir de la piel de una hiena. Llevarla demuestra la fuerza del dueño, ya que es la prueba de que ha matado a una hiena y la lleva puesta como trofeo. Además de intimidar a los temerosos, la piel da fuerza y confianza en la batalla.

Rule.Original: A scaly robust cloak sewn from a lindwurm's scales. Wearing the cloak displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a dangerous lindwurm to don the trophy. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid.
Rule.Raw: A scaly robust cloak sewn from a lindwurm's scales. Wearing the cloak displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a dangerous lindwurm to don the trophy. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid.
Rule.Translated: Una capa robusta y escamosa confeccionada con escamas de lindwurm. Vestirla demuestra la fuerza de su dueño, pues acredita que ha matado a un peligroso lindwurm para lucir el trofeo. \n\nOtorga inmunidad al ácido de lindwurm.

Rule.Original: A warm robust coat sewn from a thick unhold fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain an unhold to don the trophy. While intimidating the fearful, the cloak also grants the ability to shrug staggering hits.
Rule.Raw: A warm robust coat sewn from a thick unhold fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain an unhold to don the trophy. While intimidating the fearful, the cloak also grants the ability to shrug staggering hits.
Rule.Translated: Una capa cálida y robusta confeccionada con grueso pelaje de unhold. Vestirla demuestra la fuerza de su dueño, pues acredita que ha matado a un unhold para lucir el trofeo. Además de intimidar a los temerosos, permite resistir golpes que normalmente harían tambalearse a quien los recibe.

Rule.Original: Special plating that made from Unhold bones. WWhile intimidating the fearful, the cloak also grants the ability to shrug staggering hits
Rule.Raw: Special plating that made from Unhold bones. WWhile intimidating the fearful, the cloak also grants the ability to shrug staggering hits
Rule.Translated: Un refuerzo especial hecho de huesos de unhold. Además de intimidar a los temerosos, permite resistir golpes que normalmente harían tambalearse a quien los recibe.

Rule.Original: Additional padding made from Unhold Fur and the hide of a Direwolf. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain an unhold to don the trophy. While intimidating the fearful, the additional padding cushions blows upon the wearer.
Rule.Raw: Additional padding made from Unhold Fur and the hide of a Direwolf. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain an unhold to don the trophy. While intimidating the fearful, the additional padding cushions blows upon the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Un acolchado adicional hecho de pelaje de unhold y piel de lobo gigante. Vestirlo demuestra la fuerza de su dueño, pues acredita que ha matado a un unhold para lucir el trofeo. Además de intimidar a los temerosos, amortigua los golpes recibidos.

Rule.Original: Enchanted clothing adorned with mystical runes and sigils, boosting the wearer's mental fortitude
Rule.Raw: Enchanted clothing adorned with mystical runes and sigils, boosting the wearer's mental fortitude
Rule.Translated: Ropa encantada adornada con runas y sellos místicos que refuerza la fortaleza mental de quien la lleva

Rule.Original: A basic and simple hauberk. Offers decent and affordable protection against slashing and piercing attacks.
Rule.Raw: A basic and simple hauberk. Offers decent and affordable protection against slashing and piercing attacks.
Rule.Translated: Una coraza básica y sencilla. Ofrece una protección decente y asequible frente a ataques cortantes y perforantes.

Rule.Original: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective.
Rule.Raw: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective.
Rule.Translated: Un traje de cuerpo entero de cota de malla reforzada en lugares clave, con láminas y eslabones de metal adicionales. Una gran protección, aunque resulta agotador llevarla.

Rule.Original: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Amboise.
Rule.Raw: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Amboise.
Rule.Translated: Un traje de cuerpo entero de cota de malla reforzada en lugares clave, con láminas y eslabones de metal adicionales. Una gran protección, aunque resulta agotador llevarla.\n\nEsta cota de malla lleva los colores de la casa Amboise.

Rule.Original: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Soren.
Rule.Raw: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Soren.
Rule.Translated: Un traje de cuerpo entero de cota de malla reforzada en lugares clave, con láminas y eslabones de metal adicionales. Una gran protección, aunque resulta agotador llevarla.\n\nEsta cota de malla lleva los colores de la casa Soren.

Rule.Original: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Oswin.
Rule.Raw: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Oswin.
Rule.Translated: Un traje de cuerpo entero de cota de malla reforzada en lugares clave, con láminas y eslabones de metal adicionales. Una gran protección, aunque resulta agotador llevarla.\n\nEsta cota de malla lleva los colores de la casa Oswin.

Rule.Original: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Hesse.
Rule.Raw: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Hesse.
Rule.Translated: Un traje de cuerpo entero de cota de malla reforzada en lugares clave, con láminas y eslabones de metal adicionales. Una gran protección, aunque resulta agotador llevarla.\n\nEsta cota de malla lleva los colores de la casa Hesse.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the foot. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather boots will increase movement speed.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the foot. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather boots will increase movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Unas pieles curtidas cosidas para adaptarse a los pies. Proporcionan una protección mínima. Su uso aumenta la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: The inner lining consists of small plates overlapping each other which may slighty restrict feet movement. Wearing splinted boots will reduce movement speed.
Rule.Raw: The inner lining consists of small plates overlapping each other which may slighty restrict feet movement. Wearing splinted boots will reduce movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Un calzado cuyo forro interior está formado por pequeñas placas superpuestas que pueden restringir ligeramente el movimiento de los pies. Su uso reduce la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: A pair of meticulously crafted plate boots. Offers protection as great as its cost. Wearing plate gloves will reduce movement speed.
Rule.Raw: A pair of meticulously crafted plate boots. Offers protection as great as its cost. Wearing plate gloves will reduce movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Un par de botas con placas metálicas meticulosamente elaboradas. Ofrecen una protección tan grande como su coste. Su uso reduce la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather gloves will increase workspeed and shooting accuracy.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather gloves will increase workspeed and shooting accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Unas pieles curtidas cosidas para adaptarse a las manos. Proporcionan una protección mínima. Su uso aumenta la velocidad de trabajo y la precisión de tiro.

Rule.Original: The inner lining consists of small plates overlapping each other which may slighty restrict hand movement. Wearing splinted gloves will reduce workspeed and shooting accuracy.
Rule.Raw: The inner lining consists of small plates overlapping each other which may slighty restrict hand movement. Wearing splinted gloves will reduce workspeed and shooting accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes cuyo forro interior está formado por pequeñas placas superpuestas que pueden restringir ligeramente el movimiento de las manos. Su uso reduce la velocidad de trabajo y la precisión de tiro.

Rule.Original: A pair of meticulously crafted plate gloves. Offers protection as great as its cost. Wearing plate gloves will reduce the workspeed and shooting accuracy of the pawn.
Rule.Raw: A pair of meticulously crafted plate gloves. Offers protection as great as its cost. Wearing plate gloves will reduce the workspeed and shooting accuracy of the pawn.
Rule.Translated: Un par de guantes con placas metálicas meticulosamente elaboradas. Ofrecen una protección tan grande como su coste. Su uso reduce la velocidad de trabajo y la precisión de tiro.

Rule.Original: Two layers of armor give way to this fantastically protective, yet cumbersome, suit, consisting of internal strong-forged overlapping layers of metal plates riveted to the fabric for protecting vitals and extremities.
Rule.Raw: Two layers of armor give way to this fantastically protective, yet cumbersome, suit, consisting of internal strong-forged overlapping layers of metal plates riveted to the fabric for protecting vitals and extremities.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura de doble capa, que ofrece una protección fantástica a la par que engorrosa. Está formada por una serie de capas de placas metálicas superpuestas, remachadas a la tela para proteger los órganos vitales y las extremidades.

Rule.Original: A strong metal cuirass forged to encompass the torso while leaving the limbs exposed. Rather lightweight and protective.
Rule.Raw: A strong metal cuirass forged to encompass the torso while leaving the limbs exposed. Rather lightweight and protective.
Rule.Translated: Una robusta coraza de metal, diseñada para cubrir el torso y dejar las extremidades al descubierto. Bastante ligera y protectora.

Rule.Original: The Zweihander's cuirass is a striking blend of protection and flamboyance, featuring intricate plate armor complemented by vibrant, puffed clothing. Bold slashes in the fabric reveal contrasting colors beneath, creating a distinctive and formidable appearance on the battlefield. This unique combination of sturdy metal and eye-catching textiles embodies the fearless and audacious spirit of the Zweihander mercenaries.
Rule.Raw: The Zweihander's cuirass is a striking blend of protection and flamboyance, featuring intricate plate armor complemented by vibrant, puffed clothing. Bold slashes in the fabric reveal contrasting colors beneath, creating a distinctive and formidable appearance on the battlefield. This unique combination of sturdy metal and eye-catching textiles embodies the fearless and audacious spirit of the Zweihander mercenaries.
Rule.Translated: La coraza del espadón combina de forma llamativa protección y ostentación, con una intrincada armadura de placas complementada por ropas vistosas y abullonadas. Los cortes atrevidos del tejido dejan ver colores contrastantes y crean un aspecto distintivo y formidable en el campo de batalla. Esta singular combinación de metal resistente y telas llamativas encarna el espíritu intrépido y audaz de los mercenarios del espadón.

Rule.Original: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war.
Rule.Raw: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war.
Rule.Translated: Pocos hombres pueden llegar a ponerse una armadura tan protectora como el conjunto completo, que ofrece la mayor protección en forma de placas de metal superpuestas. Son nobles, señores y hombres con la fortuna necesaria para comprar una armadura magistralmente elaborada que bloquea eficazmente muchos ataques. La luz que brilla contra el metal pulido indica al enemigo que el portador no solo es rico, sino también un señor de la guerra.

Rule.Original: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates.
