They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war.
Rule.Raw: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war.
Rule.Translated: Pocos hombres pueden llegar a ponerse una armadura tan protectora como el conjunto completo, que ofrece la mayor protección en forma de placas de metal superpuestas. Son nobles, señores y hombres con la fortuna necesaria para comprar una armadura magistralmente elaborada que bloquea eficazmente muchos ataques. La luz que brilla contra el metal pulido indica al enemigo que el portador no solo es rico, sino también un señor de la guerra.

Rule.Original: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war.
Rule.Raw: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war.
Rule.Translated: Pocos hombres pueden llegar a ponerse una armadura tan protectora como el conjunto completo, que ofrece la mayor protección en forma de placas de metal superpuestas. Son nobles, señores y hombres con la fortuna necesaria para comprar una armadura magistralmente elaborada que bloquea eficazmente muchos ataques. La luz que brilla contra el metal pulido indica al enemigo que el portador no solo es rico, sino también un señor de la guerra.

Rule.Original: A scaly armor sewn from a lindwurm's scales. Wearing the armor displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a dangerous lindwurm to don the trophy. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid.
Rule.Raw: A scaly armor sewn from a lindwurm's scales. Wearing the armor displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a dangerous lindwurm to don the trophy. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura escamosa confeccionada con escamas de lindwurm. Vestirla demuestra la fuerza de su dueño, pues acredita que ha matado a un peligroso lindwurm para lucir el trofeo. \n\nOtorga inmunidad al ácido de lindwurm.

Rule.Original: This citrine-embedded necklace slightly increases wealth for the men and women seeking to improve their social status.
Rule.Raw: This citrine-embedded necklace slightly increases wealth for the men and women seeking to improve their social status.
Rule.Translated: Este collar, con un hermoso citrino incrustado, aumenta ligeramente la riqueza de los hombres y mujeres que buscan mejorar su estatus social.

Rule.Original: This necklace, crafted to be as hardy and beautiful as the jade gem, offers moderate wealth to those who can afford it.
Rule.Raw: This necklace, crafted to be as hardy and beautiful as the jade gem, offers moderate wealth to those who can afford it.
Rule.Translated: Este collar, fabricado para ser tan resistente y bello como la gema de jade, ofrece una riqueza moderada a quienes pueden permitírselo.

Rule.Original: This amber necklace, sharing the gem’s natural yellow-orange hue, is both familiar and valuable due to its natural beauty.
Rule.Raw: This amber necklace, sharing the gem’s natural yellow-orange hue, is both familiar and valuable due to its natural beauty.
Rule.Translated: Este collar de ámbar, que comparte el tono anaranjado natural de la piedra, es a la vez familiar y valioso por su belleza natural.

Rule.Original: This necklace, black as onyx itself, speaks of more incredible wealth than the average man or woman as the gem inside continues to glint despite its dark color.
Rule.Raw: This necklace, black as onyx itself, speaks of more incredible wealth than the average man or woman as the gem inside continues to glint despite its dark color.
Rule.Translated: Este collar, negro como el propio ónix, habla de una riqueza más increíble que la de un hombre o una mujer corrientes, ya que la gema de su interior sigue brillando a pesar de su color oscuro.

Rule.Original: This gold necklace, embedded with a pristine emerald, offers a significant increase of wealth to its wearer and is often seen on nobles and merchants.
Rule.Raw: This gold necklace, embedded with a pristine emerald, offers a significant increase of wealth to its wearer and is often seen on nobles and merchants.
Rule.Translated: Este collar de oro, con una prístina esmeralda incrustada, demuestra claramente la gran riqueza de su portador. Suele verse en nobles y mercaderes.

Rule.Original: This sapphire-embedded necklace shines its familiar blue gleam, ensuring those around the wearer take note of the wealthy man or woman who walks amongst them.
Rule.Raw: This sapphire-embedded necklace shines its familiar blue gleam, ensuring those around the wearer take note of the wealthy man or woman who walks amongst them.
Rule.Translated: Este collar de oro, con un zafiro incrustado que brilla con su característico resplandor azul, dejará claro a todos los que estén alrededor el nivel de opulencia de la persona que se pasee con él.

Rule.Original: This gold necklace decorated with multiple tear-drop rubies offers great wealth and implies great power, as one who can afford or steal such a necklace is not one to be trifled with.
Rule.Raw: This gold necklace decorated with multiple tear-drop rubies offers great wealth and implies great power, as one who can afford or steal such a necklace is not one to be trifled with.
Rule.Translated: Este collar de oro, decorado con múltiples rubíes en forma de lágrima, demuestra gran riqueza y poder, ya que quien pueda permitírselo o robarlo no es alguien con quien se deba jugar.

Rule.Original: This citrine-embedded ring slightly increases wealth for the men and women seeking to improve their social status.
Rule.Raw: This citrine-embedded ring slightly increases wealth for the men and women seeking to improve their social status.
Rule.Translated: Este anillo, con un hermoso citrino incrustado, aumenta ligeramente la riqueza de los hombres y mujeres que buscan mejorar su estatus social.

Rule.Original: This ring, crafted to be as hardy and beautiful as the jade gem, offers moderate wealth to those who can afford it.
Rule.Raw: This ring, crafted to be as hardy and beautiful as the jade gem, offers moderate wealth to those who can afford it.
Rule.Translated: Este anillo, fabricado para ser tan resistente y bello como la gema de jade, ofrece una riqueza moderada a quienes pueden permitírselo.

Rule.Original: This amber ring, sharing the gem’s natural yellow-orange hue, is both familiar and valuable due to its natural beauty.
Rule.Raw: This amber ring, sharing the gem’s natural yellow-orange hue, is both familiar and valuable due to its natural beauty.
Rule.Translated: Este anillo de ámbar, que comparte el tono amarillo anaranjado natural de la gema, es a la vez familiar y valioso por su belleza natural.

Rule.Original: This ring, black as onyx itself, speaks of more incredible wealth than the average man or woman as the gem inside continues to glint despite its dark color.
Rule.Raw: This ring, black as onyx itself, speaks of more incredible wealth than the average man or woman as the gem inside continues to glint despite its dark color.
Rule.Translated: Este anillo, negro como el propio ónice, habla de una riqueza más increíble que la del hombre o la mujer corrientes, ya que la gema de su interior sigue brillando a pesar de su color oscuro.

Rule.Original: This gold ring, embedded with a pristine emerald, offers a significant increase of wealth to its wearer and is often seen on nobles and merchants.
Rule.Raw: This gold ring, embedded with a pristine emerald, offers a significant increase of wealth to its wearer and is often seen on nobles and merchants.
Rule.Translated: Este anillo de oro, con una prístina esmeralda incrustada, demuestra claramente la gran riqueza de su portador. Suele verse en nobles y comerciantes.

Rule.Original: This sapphire-embedded necklace shines its familiar blue gleam, ensuring those around the wearer take note of the wealthy man or woman who walks amongst them.
Rule.Raw: This sapphire-embedded necklace shines its familiar blue gleam, ensuring those around the wearer take note of the wealthy man or woman who walks amongst them.
Rule.Translated: Este anillo de oro, decorado con un zafiro de gran tamaño, dejará claro a todos los que estén alrededor el nivel de opulencia de la persona que se pasee con él.

Rule.Original: This gold necklace decorated with multiple tear-drop rubies offers great wealth and implies great power, as one who can afford or steal such a necklace is not one to be trifled with.
Rule.Raw: This gold necklace decorated with multiple tear-drop rubies offers great wealth and implies great power, as one who can afford or steal such a necklace is not one to be trifled with.
Rule.Translated: Este anillo de oro, decorado con un rubí de gran tamaño, demuestra gran riqueza y poder, ya que quien pueda permitírselo o robarlo no es alguien con quien se deba jugar.

Rule.Original: A quickly made ragged piece of clothing, sewn from bits and pieces of various leathers.
Rule.Raw: A quickly made ragged piece of clothing, sewn from bits and pieces of various leathers.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda de vestir hecha jirones, confeccionada a partir de trozos de diversos cueros.

Rule.Original: A simple vest stitched from treated and tanned leathers, both comfortable and pragmatic. The thick leather is a decent balance between protection and encumbrance.
Rule.Raw: A simple vest stitched from treated and tanned leathers, both comfortable and pragmatic. The thick leather is a decent balance between protection and encumbrance.
Rule.Translated: Un chaleco sencillo confeccionado a partir de pieles tratadas y curtidas, cómodo a la par que pragmático. El cuero grueso supone un buen equilibrio entre protección y estorbo.

Rule.Original: A cloth mantle vest, sewn similarly to a gambeson, with a thick wool filling. Provides additional padding when worn but fails to deflect spear thrusts that come under shields.
Rule.Raw: A cloth mantle vest, sewn similarly to a gambeson, with a thick wool filling. Provides additional padding when worn but fails to deflect spear thrusts that come under shields.
Rule.Translated: Un chaleco con manto de tela, cosido de forma similar a un gambesón, pero con un grueso relleno de lana. Proporciona un acolchado adicional cuando se lleva puesto, pero no desvía las estocadas de lanza que llegen bajo los escudos.

Rule.Original: A lightweight protective garment layered with tautly stitched linens, between which a dense stuffing of oakum or wool sits. Quite insulating and provides decent protection against cuts and blows.
Rule.Raw: A lightweight protective garment layered with tautly stitched linens, between which a dense stuffing of oakum or wool sits. Quite insulating and provides decent protection against cuts and blows.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda protectora ligera formada por una serie de capas de lino fuertemente cosidas, entre las que se coloca un denso relleno de estopa o lana. Es bastante aislante y ofrece una buena protección frente a cortes y golpes.

Rule.Original: A padded linen tunic reinforced with mail plates and overlapping tanned leather, providing lightweight bodily protection at a low cost. A variation of the leather vest, the padded leather covers more of the body and is therefore more protective, but is more cumbersome as well.
Rule.Raw: A padded linen tunic reinforced with mail plates and overlapping tanned leather, providing lightweight bodily protection at a low cost. A variation of the leather vest, the padded leather covers more of the body and is therefore more protective, but is more cumbersome as well.
Rule.Translated: Una túnica acolchada de lino reforzada con placas de cota de malla y cuero curtido. Proporciona una protección corporal ligera con un bajo coste. Se trata de una variante del chaleco de cuero, una en la que el cuero acolchado cubre más parte del cuerpo, por lo que aunque protege más, es también algo más engorrosa.

Rule.Original: A leather lamellar built up of overlapping leather plates that can provide a substantial amount of protection.
Rule.Raw: A leather lamellar built up of overlapping leather plates that can provide a substantial amount of protection.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda formada por placas de cuero superpuestas que pueden proporcionar una protección considerable.

Rule.Original: A treasure to merchants and traveling warriors alike, this ring grants increased carrying capacity for those long campaigns and trading caravans.
Rule.Raw: A treasure to merchants and traveling warriors alike, this ring grants increased carrying capacity for those long campaigns and trading caravans.
Rule.Translated: Un tesoro para mercaderes y guerreros viajeros por igual. Este anillo otorga una mayor capacidad de carga, ideal para esas largas campañas y caravanas comerciales.

Rule.Original: An enchanted ring that bestows upon the wearer additional movement speed—perfect for explorers looking to quickly cover ground and escape dangerous expeditions.
Rule.Raw: An enchanted ring that bestows upon the wearer additional movement speed—perfect for explorers looking to quickly cover ground and escape dangerous expeditions.
Rule.Translated: Un anillo encantado que aumenta la velocidad de movimiento del portador, perfecto para aquellos exploradores que busquen cubrir el terreno rápidamente y escapar de expediciones peligrosas.

Rule.Original: A healer's basic ring, slippin on this garment imbues the hands with better tending quality and while also increasing the wearer's vitality.
Rule.Raw: A healer's basic ring, slippin on this garment imbues the hands with better tending quality and while also increasing the wearer's vitality.
Rule.Translated: El anillo básico para todo curandero. Al llevarse puesto, las manos se imbuen de un poder que mejora la calidad de la atención médica, a la vez que aumenta la vitalidad del portador.

Rule.Original: Through perseverance and wit brings the wonders of the world. Upon wearing this ring, will bless enlightenment to open the mind into the depths of madness and ingenuity.
Rule.Raw: Through perseverance and wit brings the wonders of the world. Upon wearing this ring, will bless enlightenment to open the mind into the depths of madness and ingenuity.
Rule.Translated: La perseverancia y el ingenio son las virtudes que permiten admirar las maravillas del mundo. Al llevar este anillo, se obtendrá la iluminación para abrir la mente a las profundidades de la locura y la ingenuidad.

Rule.Original: A powerful ring that grants the wearer complete immunity to stun effects, ensuring uninterrupted movement and action during combat or critical situations.
Rule.Raw: A powerful ring that grants the wearer complete immunity to stun effects, ensuring uninterrupted movement and action during combat or critical situations.
Rule.Translated: Un anillo poderoso que otorga inmunidad completa al aturdimiento, lo que permite moverse y actuar sin interrupciones durante el combate o en situaciones críticas.

Rule.Original: A standard pair of clothing for burghers and nobility alike.
Rule.Raw: A standard pair of clothing for burghers and nobility alike.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda estándar, para burgueses y nobles por igual.

Rule.Original: A standard pair of clothing for burghers and nobility alike.
Rule.Raw: A standard pair of clothing for burghers and nobility alike.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda estándar, para burgueses y nobles por igual.

Rule.Original: Braies are underhose, usually of linen, although in some cultures they serve also as an outer garment.
Rule.Raw: Braies are underhose, usually of linen, although in some cultures they serve also as an outer garment.
Rule.Translated: Unas medias interiores, normalmente hechas de lino. En algunas culturas sirven también como prenda exterior.

Rule.Original: A quilted legwear that provides protection with padded fabric.
Rule.Raw: A quilted legwear that provides protection with padded fabric.
Rule.Translated: Una pernera mullida que proporciona protección gracias al tejido acolchado.

Rule.Original: A pair of splinted chausses to protect the leg with riveted metal plates. Cunningly crafted to allow the wearer almost complete freedom of mobility.
Rule.Raw: A pair of splinted chausses to protect the leg with riveted metal plates. Cunningly crafted to allow the wearer almost complete freedom of mobility.
Rule.Translated: Un par de perneras entablilladas para proteger la pierna con placas metálicas remachadas. Hechas con astucia para permitir al usuario una libertad de movimiento casi total.

Rule.Original: A pair of plate chausses to protect the leg with exceptionally crafted plates fitted to the wearer. It's strong riveted plate and finely articulated structure provides almost complete mobility.
Rule.Raw: A pair of plate chausses to protect the leg with exceptionally crafted plates fitted to the wearer. It's strong riveted plate and finely articulated structure provides almost complete mobility.
Rule.Translated: Un par de perneras hechas a base de placas excepcionalmente elaboradas para ajustarse al usuario, protegiendo las piernas. Su resistente placa remachada y su estructura finamente articulada proporcionan una movilidad casi total.

Rule.Original: A thick and robust hauberk, covered by a fine quilted surcoat. The layered structure provides an ample amount of warmth. Overall, an impressive piece of armor, decorated with trophies and holy symbols.
Rule.Raw: A thick and robust hauberk, covered by a fine quilted surcoat. The layered structure provides an ample amount of warmth. Overall, an impressive piece of armor, decorated with trophies and holy symbols.
Rule.Translated: Una gruesa y robusta cota de malla, cubierta por un fino abrigo interior acolchado. La estructura en capas proporciona una gran cantidad de calor. En conjunto, una armadura impresionante, decorada con trofeos y símbolos sagrados.

Rule.Original: A robust mail shirt, covered by a fine quilted surcoat. The layered structure provides an ample amount of warmth. Overall, an impressive piece of armor, decorated with trophies and holy symbols.
Rule.Raw: A robust mail shirt, covered by a fine quilted surcoat. The layered structure provides an ample amount of warmth. Overall, an impressive piece of armor, decorated with trophies and holy symbols.
Rule.Translated: Una robusta camisa de malla metálica, cubierta por un fino abrigo interior acolchado. La estructura en capas proporciona una gran cantidad de calor. En conjunto, una armadura impresionante, decorada con trofeos y símbolos sagrados.

Rule.Original: A heavy plate coverd by a thick riveted jacket and reinforced vambraces. The layered structure provides an ample amount of warmth. Typically worn by the oathbound, the best of the oathtakers, finely decorated with trophies and religious symbols.
Rule.Raw: A heavy plate coverd by a thick riveted jacket and reinforced vambraces. The layered structure provides an ample amount of warmth. Typically worn by the oathbound, the best of the oathtakers, finely decorated with trophies and religious symbols.
Rule.Translated: Una pesada prenda metálica cubierta por una gruesa chaqueta remachada y rematada con avambrazos reforzados. La estructura en capas proporciona una gran cantidad de calor. La suelen llevar los guerreros entregados, finamente decorada con trofeos y símbolos sagrados.

Rule.Original: A thick hood forged from chains of metal with an added plate-metal noseguard to almost entirely protect the face. Makes it a bit difficult to see, but otherwise offers excellent protection against cuts.
Rule.Raw: A thick hood forged from chains of metal with an added plate-metal noseguard to almost entirely protect the face. Makes it a bit difficult to see, but otherwise offers excellent protection against cuts.
Rule.Translated: Una gruesa capucha forjada a partir de cadenas de metal, que cuenta con un protector nasal de chapa metálica añadido para proteger casi por completo la cara. Dificulta un poco la visión, pero por lo demás ofrece una excelente protección contra los cortes.

Rule.Original: An early design of the full-faced helmet, consisting of a reinforced flat-top helmet with an additional face-plate and a mail coif. Offers great protection of the entire head, but hinders eyesight and breathing.
Rule.Raw: An early design of the full-faced helmet, consisting of a reinforced flat-top helmet with an additional face-plate and a mail coif. Offers great protection of the entire head, but hinders eyesight and breathing.
Rule.Translated: Uno de los primeros diseños de casco integral, consistente en una pieza plana reforzada con una placa facial adicional y una cofia de cota de malla. Ofrece una gran protección para toda la cabeza, pero dificulta la visión y la respiración.

Rule.Original: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of the Ulrik order.
Rule.Raw: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of the Ulrik order.
Rule.Translated: Un gran casco de placas completo, muy ornamentado. Suelen llevarlo los justadores, los campeones heráldicos y las figuras notables de casas notables en la guerra. Representa la nobleza y ofrece una protección considerable en la batalla.\n\nEste gran yelmo lleva los colores de la casa Amboise.

Rule.Original: A wearable leather container designed for holding arrows. Wearing the quiver reduces the time it takes to shoot for bows and crossbows.
Rule.Raw: A wearable leather container designed for holding arrows. Wearing the quiver reduces the time it takes to shoot for bows and crossbows.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de cuero portátil diseñado para guardar flechas. Llevar el carcaj reduce el tiempo de disparo de arcos y ballestas.

Rule.Original: A utility belt designed to carry throwable flash pots, which can be tossed to disorient and blind enemies.
Rule.Raw: A utility belt designed to carry throwable flash pots, which can be tossed to disorient and blind enemies.
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón para llevar recipientes de destello arrojadizos que desorientan y ciegan a los enemigos.

Rule.Original: A utility belt designed to carry throwable fire pots, allowing the wearer to ignite areas or enemies from a distance
Rule.Raw: A utility belt designed to carry throwable fire pots, allowing the wearer to ignite areas or enemies from a distance
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón para llevar recipientes incendiarios arrojadizos que permiten incendiar zonas o enemigos a distancia

Rule.Original: A utility belt designed to carry throwable smoke pots, which can be tossed to disorient and blind enemies.
Rule.Raw: A utility belt designed to carry throwable smoke pots, which can be tossed to disorient and blind enemies.
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón para llevar recipientes de humo arrojadizos que desorientan y ciegan a los enemigos.

Rule.Original: A utility belt designed to carry throwable acid flasks, which can be tossed to unleash powerful acid attacks that can melt through armor and damage enemies over time..
Rule.Raw: A utility belt designed to carry throwable acid flasks, which can be tossed to unleash powerful acid attacks that can melt through armor and damage enemies over time..
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón utilitario diseñado para llevar frascos arrojadizos de ácido. Al lanzarlos, desatan potentes ataques ácidos capaces de fundir armaduras y causar daño continuado a los enemigos.

Rule.Original: A simple headwrap tied from a long strip of dark-red cloth. Provides a bit of warmth and padding for the noggin'.
Rule.Raw: A simple headwrap tied from a long strip of dark-red cloth. Provides a bit of warmth and padding for the noggin'.
Rule.Translated: Un simple pañuelo para la cabeza atado con una larga tira de tela de color rojo oscuro. Proporciona un poco de calor y acolcha la cabeza.

Rule.Original: A draped hood which covers the head and ears.
Rule.Raw: A draped hood which covers the head and ears.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha drapeada que cubre la cabeza y las orejas.

Rule.Original: A close-fitting and lightly padded coif often worn beneath mail or a helmet, or on its own for warmth in cold weather.
Rule.Raw: A close-fitting and lightly padded coif often worn beneath mail or a helmet, or on its own for warmth in cold weather.
Rule.Translated: Una cofia ceñida y ligeramente acolchada que suele llevarse bajo la cota de malla o el casco, o sola para abrigarse cuando hace frío.

Rule.Original: A thickly padded cap most often worn beneath heavier helmets for an additional layer of protection. Quite insulating and offers a bit of blunt protection on its own.
Rule.Raw: A thickly padded cap most often worn beneath heavier helmets for an additional layer of protection. Quite insulating and offers a bit of blunt protection on its own.
Rule.Translated: Un gorro grueso y acolchado que se suele llevar debajo de los cascos más pesados como capa adicional de protección. Es bastante aislante, y ofrece un poco de protección contra los golpes.

Rule.Original: A thickly padded hood most often worn beneath heavier helmets for an additional layer of protection. Very insulating and offers a bit of blunt protection on its own.
Rule.Raw: A thickly padded hood most often worn beneath heavier helmets for an additional layer of protection. Very insulating and offers a bit of blunt protection on its own.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha con un acolchado grueso que se suele llevar debajo de los cascos más pesados como capa adicional de protección. Es un gran aislante, y ofrece un poco de protección contundente por sí sola.

Rule.Original: A thick, padded hood favored by cultists, offering insulation and minor blunt protection. Its sturdy design provides decent head protection on its own.
Rule.Raw: A thick, padded hood favored by cultists, offering insulation and minor blunt protection. Its sturdy design provides decent head protection on its own.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha gruesa y acolchada muy apreciada por los cultistas, que proporciona aislamiento y una ligera protección frente a impactos contundentes. Su diseño robusto ofrece por sí solo una protección aceptable de la cabeza.

Rule.Original: A thick, ornamented hat. Protective simply due to its size and shape, but mainly worn for decoration and as a status symbol.
Rule.Raw: A thick, ornamented hat. Protective simply due to its size and shape, but mainly worn for decoration and as a status symbol.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero grueso y ornamentado, cuyo tamaño y forma ofrece bastante protección de por sí. Suele llevarse sobre todo como adorno y símbolo de estatus.

Rule.Original: A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
Rule.Raw: A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
Rule.Translated: Un resistente casco medieval que cubre toda la cabeza. Aunque ofrece una protección fantástica, dificulta la visión, por lo que solo se recomienda para la infantería de primera línea, sobre todo a la que no lleva escudo.

Rule.Original: A wide-rimmed kettle helmet paired with a thick padded coif, offering good protection of the head.
Rule.Raw: A wide-rimmed kettle helmet paired with a thick padded coif, offering good protection of the head.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de ala ancha con una cofia gruesa y acolchada. Ofrece una buena protección de la cabeza.

Rule.Original: A thick padded coif coupled with a simple flat-top nasal helmet. Offers good protection of the head, and is also quite insulating in cold weather.
Rule.Raw: A thick padded coif coupled with a simple flat-top nasal helmet. Offers good protection of the head, and is also quite insulating in cold weather.
Rule.Translated: Una cofia gruesa y acolchada combinada con un sencillo casco nasal plano. Protege bien la cabeza y es bastante aislante cuando hace frío.

Rule.Original: A thick hood forged from chains of metal provides excellent protection to the head against slashing and thrusting attacks.
Rule.Raw: A thick hood forged from chains of metal provides excellent protection to the head against slashing and thrusting attacks.
Rule.Translated: Una gruesa capucha forjada con cadenas de metal que proporciona una excelente protección a la cabeza frente a ataques cortantes y perforantes.

Rule.Original: A thick hood forged from chains of metal with additional protection reinforcing the lower face. Provides excellent protection to the entire head against piercing and slashing attacks.
Rule.Raw: A thick hood forged from chains of metal with additional protection reinforcing the lower face. Provides excellent protection to the entire head against piercing and slashing attacks.
Rule.Translated: Una gruesa capucha forjada a partir de cadenas de metal con una pieza de protección adicional que refuerza la parte inferior de la cara. Proporciona una excelente protección a toda la cabeza contra ataques cortantes y perforantes.

Rule.Original: A thick hood forged from chains of metal with an added plate-metal noseguard to almost entirely protect the face, head,. Makes it a bit difficult to see, but otherwise offers excellent protection against cuts.
Rule.Raw: A thick hood forged from chains of metal with an added plate-metal noseguard to almost entirely protect the face, head,. Makes it a bit difficult to see, but otherwise offers excellent protection against cuts.
Rule.Translated: Una gruesa capucha forjada a partir de cadenas de metal con varios protectores adicionales, incluyendo un chapa metálica sobre la nariz, para proteger casi por completo toda la cabeza y la cara. Dificulta un poco la visión, pero ofrece una protección más que excelente contra los cortes.

Rule.Original: A chainmail coif coupled with a simple round nasal helmet, offering excellent protection of the head.
Rule.Raw: A chainmail coif coupled with a simple round nasal helmet, offering excellent protection of the head.
Rule.Translated: Una cofia de cota de malla unida a un sencillo casco nasal redondo. Ofrece una excelente protección a la cabeza.

Rule.Original: A variation of the chain skull cap crafted as a chainmail coif coupled with a nasal helmet. Offers the same level of protection for the head, but the strip of red cloth tied around the forehead displays authority.
Rule.Raw: A variation of the chain skull cap crafted as a chainmail coif coupled with a nasal helmet. Offers the same level of protection for the head, but the strip of red cloth tied around the forehead displays authority.
Rule.Translated: Una variante de la cofia de cota de malla con casco nasal. Ofrece el mismo nivel de protección para la cabeza, pero la tira de tela roja atada alrededor de la frente muestra autoridad.

Rule.Original: A wide-rimmed kettle helmet paired with a chainmail coif, offering excellent protection of the head while providing comfortable shade from the sun.
Rule.Raw: A wide-rimmed kettle helmet paired with a chainmail coif, offering excellent protection of the head while providing comfortable shade from the sun.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de ala ancha combinado con una cofia de cota de malla. Ofrece una excelente protección a la cabeza, al tiempo que proporciona una cómoda sombra en días soleados.

Rule.Original: A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
Rule.Raw: A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
Rule.Translated: Un resistente casco medieval que cubre toda la cabeza. Aunque ofrece una protección fantástica, dificulta la visión, por lo que solo se recomienda para la infantería de primera línea, sobre todo a la que no lleva escudo.

Rule.Original: A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
Rule.Raw: A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
Rule.Translated: Un resistente casco medieval que cubre toda la cabeza. Aunque ofrece una protección fantástica, dificulta la visión, por lo que solo se recomienda para la infantería de primera línea, sobre todo a la que no lleva escudo.

Rule.Original: An early design of the full-faced helmet, consisting of a reinforced flat-top helmet with an additional face-plate and a mail coif. Offers great protection of the entire head, but hinders eyesight and breathing.
Rule.Raw: An early design of the full-faced helmet, consisting of a reinforced flat-top helmet with an additional face-plate and a mail coif. Offers great protection of the entire head, but hinders eyesight and breathing.
Rule.Translated: Uno de los primeros diseños de casco integral, consistente en un casco plano reforzado con una placa facial adicional y una cofia de cota de malla. Ofrece una gran protección para toda la cabeza, pero dificulta la visión y la respiración.

Rule.Original: A formidable heavy barbute helmet, crafted from robust and weighty steel. This design, known for its exceptional durability, provides substantial protection while retaining its imposing presence on the battlefield.
Rule.Raw: A formidable heavy barbute helmet, crafted from robust and weighty steel. This design, known for its exceptional durability, provides substantial protection while retaining its imposing presence on the battlefield.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de casco medieval parecido a una celada sin visera y con una apertura para la cara en forma de T o Y.

Rule.Original: The visored-less bascinet helmet features a conical shape with a retractable visor, allowing for versatility in protection and visibility. It offers defense to the head while granting improved breathability and vision compared to fully enclosed helmets. Though it sacrifices some protection, its open design ensures greater comfort and ease of movement for wearers in combat scenarios.
Rule.Raw: The visored-less bascinet helmet features a conical shape with a retractable visor, allowing for versatility in protection and visibility. It offers defense to the head while granting improved breathability and vision compared to fully enclosed helmets. Though it sacrifices some protection, its open design ensures greater comfort and ease of movement for wearers in combat scenarios.
Rule.Translated: Una variante sin visera de un casco de hierro medieval hemisférico que cubre las orejas y el cuello.

Rule.Original: A sturdy metal helmet adorned with a flamboyant colored large baggy feathered hat to display one's status.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy metal helmet adorned with a flamboyant colored large baggy feathered hat to display one's status.
Rule.Translated: Un robusto casco de metal adornado con un gran sombrero de plumas de colores llamativos, perfecto para mostrar el estatus del usuario.

Rule.Original: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with a round-faced visor, paired with a chainmail coif and padding. Provides complete protection of the entire head, but is hindering to see and difficult to breathe in.
Rule.Raw: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with a round-faced visor, paired with a chainmail coif and padding. Provides complete protection of the entire head, but is hindering to see and difficult to breathe in.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de chapa gruesa, con una visera redonda y una cofia de cota de malla. Protege toda la cabeza, pero dificulta la visión y la respiración.

Rule.Original: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with a round-faced visor, paired with a chainmail coif and padding. Provides complete protection of the entire head, but is hindering to see and difficult to breathe in.
Rule.Raw: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with a round-faced visor, paired with a chainmail coif and padding. Provides complete protection of the entire head, but is hindering to see and difficult to breathe in.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de chapa gruesa, con una visera redonda y una cofia de cota de malla. Protege toda la cabeza, pero dificulta la visión y la respiración.

Rule.Original: A simple plate bascinet helmet with an affixed flip-up visor. Offers good protection of the head and face, but it hinders one's eyesight while wearing it.
Rule.Raw: A simple plate bascinet helmet with an affixed flip-up visor. Offers good protection of the head and face, but it hinders one's eyesight while wearing it.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de chapa simple con visera abatible. Ofrece una buena protección a la cabeza y la cara, pero dificulta la visión.

Rule.Original: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with a round-faced visor, paired with a chainmail coif and padding. Provides complete protection of the entire head, but is hindering to see and difficult to breathe in.
Rule.Raw: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with a round-faced visor, paired with a chainmail coif and padding. Provides complete protection of the entire head, but is hindering to see and difficult to breathe in.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de chapa gruesa, con una visera redonda y una cofia de cota de malla. Protege toda la cabeza, pero dificulta la visión y la respiración.

Rule.Original: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with an extended pig-faced visor, which allows for easier breathing. Still quite hindering to see out of, however.
Rule.Raw: A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with an extended pig-faced visor, which allows for easier breathing. Still quite hindering to see out of, however.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de tipo bacinete hecho de placas gruesas y equipado con una visera alargada en forma de hocico, que facilita la respiración. Sin embargo, sigue dificultando bastante la visión.

Rule.Original: A sleek three-part helmet consisting of a top, visor, and bevor to protect the head, face, respectively. Lightweight, and very protective, though it hinders eyesight significantly.
Rule.Raw: A sleek three-part helmet consisting of a top, visor, and bevor to protect the head, face, respectively. Lightweight, and very protective, though it hinders eyesight significantly.
Rule.Translated: Un casco elegante de tres partes que consta de una parte superior, una visera y un barbote para proteger la cabeza, la cara y el cuello respectivamente. Ligero y muy protector, aunque dificulta considerablemente la visión.

Rule.Original: A sleek three-part helmet consisting of a top, visor, and bevor to protect the head, face, respectively. Lightweight, and very protective, though it hinders eyesight significantly.
Rule.Raw: A sleek three-part helmet consisting of a top, visor, and bevor to protect the head, face, respectively. Lightweight, and very protective, though it hinders eyesight significantly.
Rule.Translated: Un casco elegante de tres partes que consta de una parte superior, una visera y un barbote para proteger la cabeza, la cara y el cuello respectivamente. Ligero y muy protector, aunque dificulta considerablemente la visión.

Rule.Original: A sleek three-part helmet consisting of a top, visor, and bevor to protect the head, face, respectively. Lightweight, and very protective, though it hinders eyesight significantly.
Rule.Raw: A sleek three-part helmet consisting of a top, visor, and bevor to protect the head, face, respectively. Lightweight, and very protective, though it hinders eyesight significantly.
Rule.Translated: Un casco elegante de tres partes que consta de una parte superior, una visera y un barbote para proteger la cabeza, la cara y el cuello respectivamente. Ligero y muy protector, aunque dificulta considerablemente la visión.

Rule.Original: An early design of the close helm, which is worn over a very thickly padded fabric coif. Provides excellent protection to the entire head, but, like with most full-face helmets, limits one's field of vision and constricts breathing when worn.
Rule.Raw: An early design of the close helm, which is worn over a very thickly padded fabric coif. Provides excellent protection to the entire head, but, like with most full-face helmets, limits one's field of vision and constricts breathing when worn.
Rule.Translated: Uno de los primeros diseños de casco integral, que se lleva sobre una cofia de tela muy gruesa y acolchada. Proporciona una excelente protección a toda la cabeza, pero, como la mayoría de los cascos integrales, limita el campo de visión y dificulta la respiración.

Rule.Original: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Amboise.
Rule.Raw: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Amboise.
Rule.Translated: Un gran casco de placas completo, muy ornamentado. Suelen llevarlo los justadores, los campeones heráldicos y las figuras notables de casas notables en la guerra. Representa la nobleza y ofrece una protección considerable en la batalla.\n\nEste gran yelmo lleva los colores de la casa Amboise.

Rule.Original: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Soren.
Rule.Raw: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Soren.
Rule.Translated: Un gran casco de placas completo, muy ornamentado. Suelen llevarlo los justadores, los campeones heráldicos y las figuras notables de casas notables en la guerra. Representa la nobleza y ofrece una protección considerable en la batalla.\n\nEste gran yelmo lleva los colores de la casa Soren.

Rule.Original: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Oswin.
Rule.Raw: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Oswin.
Rule.Translated: Un gran casco de placas completo, muy ornamentado. Suelen llevarlo los justadores, los campeones heráldicos y las figuras notables de casas notables en la guerra. Representa la nobleza y ofrece una protección considerable en la batalla.\n\nEste gran yelmo lleva los colores de la casa Oswin.

Rule.Original: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Hesse.
Rule.Raw: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nThis great helm carries the colours of house Hesse.
Rule.Translated: Un gran casco de placas completo, muy ornamentado. Suelen llevarlo los justadores, los campeones heráldicos y las figuras notables de casas notables en la guerra. Representa la nobleza y ofrece una protección considerable en la batalla.\n\nEste gran yelmo lleva los colores de la casa Hesse.

Rule.Original: A finely crafted, ergonomically shaped plate helmet that provides complete protection of the entire head, face,, shaped in such a way to optimize deflection of what would otherwise be direct blows.
Rule.Raw: A finely crafted, ergonomically shaped plate helmet that provides complete protection of the entire head, face,, shaped in such a way to optimize deflection of what would otherwise be direct blows.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de placas ergonómico y finamente fabricado que proporciona una protección completa de toda la cabeza y la cara, con una forma que optimiza la desviación de lo que de otro modo serían golpes directos.

Rule.Original: A finely crafted, ergonomically shaped plate helmet that provides complete protection of the entire head, face,, shaped in such a way to optimize deflection of what would otherwise be direct blows.
Rule.Raw: A finely crafted, ergonomically shaped plate helmet that provides complete protection of the entire head, face,, shaped in such a way to optimize deflection of what would otherwise be direct blows.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de placas ergonómico y finamente fabricado que proporciona una protección completa de toda la cabeza y la cara, con una forma que optimiza la desviación de lo que de otro modo serían golpes directos.

Rule.Original: An ancient ornate armet masterfully smithed by the under-forges of the ancient empire. It gives great protection for one's visage and embelishes an awe inspiring grace.
Rule.Raw: An ancient ornate armet masterfully smithed by the under-forges of the ancient empire. It gives great protection for one's visage and embelishes an awe inspiring grace.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo almete ornamentado, forjado con maestría por los forjadores del antiguo imperio. Protege el rostro y confiere una gracia que inspira admiración.

Rule.Original: A scaly helmet from a lindwurm's scales. Wearing the helmet displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a dangerous lindwurm to don the trophy. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid.
Rule.Raw: A scaly helmet from a lindwurm's scales. Wearing the helmet displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a dangerous lindwurm to don the trophy. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid.
Rule.Translated: Un casco escamoso hecho de escamas de lindwurm. Vestirlo demuestra la fuerza de su dueño, pues acredita que ha matado a un peligroso lindwurm para lucir el trofeo. \n\nOtorga inmunidad al ácido de lindwurm.

Rule.Original: A sedimentary rock composed of clay particles compressed together.
Rule.Raw: A sedimentary rock composed of clay particles compressed together.
Rule.Translated: Una roca sedimentaria formada por partículas de arcilla comprimidas.

Rule.Original: A sedimentary rock composed of clay particles compressed together. The clay layers have been polished to a flat, smooth surface.
Rule.Raw: A sedimentary rock composed of clay particles compressed together. The clay layers have been polished to a flat, smooth surface.
Rule.Translated: Una roca sedimentaria formada por partículas de arcilla comprimidas. Las capas de arcilla se han pulido hasta obtener una superficie plana y lisa.

Rule.Original: Blocks of solid clay. Clay is a relatively soft rock and chips easily.
Rule.Raw: Blocks of solid clay. Clay is a relatively soft rock and chips easily.
Rule.Translated: Bloques de arcilla sólida. La arcilla es una roca relativamente blanda que se desconcha con facilidad.

Rule.Original: Cuts clay chunks into usable blocks.
Rule.Raw: Cuts clay chunks into usable blocks.
Rule.Translated: Corta fragmentos de arcilla en bloques utilizables.

Rule.Original: A round shield, provides decent coverage and protection against physical blows.
Rule.Raw: A round shield, provides decent coverage and protection against physical blows.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo redondo. Proporciona una cobertura decente y algo de protección frente a golpes físicos.

Rule.Original: An elongated shield that offers a wide area of protection. Somewhat bulky for close combat.
Rule.Raw: An elongated shield that offers a wide area of protection. Somewhat bulky for close combat.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo alargado que ofrece una amplia superficie protectora. Algo voluminoso para el combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A light triangular shield, provides decent coverage and good protection against physical blows.
Rule.Raw: A light triangular shield, provides decent coverage and good protection against physical blows.
Rule.Translated: Un ligero escudo triangular de madera.

Rule.Original: A shield carved out of the remains of a living tree, slowly regrows any sustained damage. \n\Regenerates durability over a period of time
Rule.Raw: A shield carved out of the remains of a living tree, slowly regrows any sustained damage. \n\Regenerates durability over a period of time
Rule.Translated: Un escudo tallado a partir de los restos de un árbol viviente. Regenera lentamente cualquier daño sufrido.

Rule.Original: This sturdy shield fashioned from the shimmering scales of a Lindwurm makes for protection nigh indestructible. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid
Rule.Raw: This sturdy shield fashioned from the shimmering scales of a Lindwurm makes for protection nigh indestructible. \n\nGrants immunity to lindwurm acid
Rule.Translated: Este resistente escudo, elaborado con las relucientes escamas de un lindwurm, ofrece una protección casi indestructible. \n\nOtorga inmunidad al ácido de lindwurm.

Rule.Original: A heavy blade used for chopping meat and bone, the cleaver excels for preparing food and dismembering animals. However, its sharp edge also makes it effective as a deadly weapon.
Rule.Raw: A heavy blade used for chopping meat and bone, the cleaver excels for preparing food and dismembering animals. However, its sharp edge also makes it effective as a deadly weapon.
Rule.Translated: Una hoja pesada para cortar carne y huesos. La cuchilla resulta excelente para preparar comida y despiezar animales, pero su filo también la convierte en un arma mortífera.

Rule.Original: A primitive tool used by apprentice lumberjacks, the hatchet is useful for both woodworking and chopping attacks. A great and accessible alternative to swords should the enemy hide behind a shield wall.
Rule.Raw: A primitive tool used by apprentice lumberjacks, the hatchet is useful for both woodworking and chopping attacks. A great and accessible alternative to swords should the enemy hide behind a shield wall.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta primitiva, utilizada por los aprendices de leñador. Las hachuelas son útiles tanto para trabajar la madera como para realizar ataques cortantes. Una alternativa estupenda y accesible a las espadas en caso de que el enemigo se esconda tras un muro de escudos.

Rule.Original: A longer version of the hatchet, the handaxe’s long shaft allows for stronger swings at a distance. Due to its easy use and practicality, this axe is a favorite against shielded enemies.
Rule.Raw: A longer version of the hatchet, the handaxe’s long shaft allows for stronger swings at a distance. Due to its easy use and practicality, this axe is a favorite against shielded enemies.
Rule.Translated: Una versión alargada de la hachuela. El mango largo del hacha de mano permite golpes más fuertes a distancia. Debido a su facilidad de uso y practicidad, esta hacha es una de las favoritas contra los enemigos con escudo.

Rule.Original: A variation of the axe forged for the sole purpose of warfare, with a sturdy metal head for splitting shields and sharp points for puncturing mail. Strong damage, but short range.
Rule.Raw: A variation of the axe forged for the sole purpose of warfare, with a sturdy metal head for splitting shields and sharp points for puncturing mail. Strong damage, but short range.
Rule.Translated: Una variante del hacha forjada con el único propósito de ser usada en la guerra, con una robusta cabeza de metal para partir escudos y afiladas puntas para perforar la cota de malla. Hace mucho daño, pero tiene poco alcance.

Rule.Original: A long axe used by experienced lumberjacks and brigands alike due to its long shaft and heavy sharp head. The design makes the two-handed axe great for chopping down trees as well as chopping down an enemy.
Rule.Raw: A long axe used by experienced lumberjacks and brigands alike due to its long shaft and heavy sharp head. The design makes the two-handed axe great for chopping down trees as well as chopping down an enemy.
Rule.Translated: Un hacha larga utilizada tanto por leñadores experimentados como por bandoleros debido a su largo mango y su pesada cabeza afilada. Su diseño la convierte en un hacha de dos manos ideal tanto para talar árboles como para abatir a un enemigo.

Rule.Original: An axe inspired by pikes, the bardiche features an axe head extended like a pike’s head. The design makes this two-handed weapon adaptable to many situations, as it can split unarmored enemies just as easily as it can split a shield.
Rule.Raw: An axe inspired by pikes, the bardiche features an axe head extended like a pike’s head. The design makes this two-handed weapon adaptable to many situations, as it can split unarmored enemies just as easily as it can split a shield.
Rule.Translated: Un hacha inspirada en las picas. La bardiche presenta una cabeza de hacha extendida como la cabeza de una pica. Su diseño hace que esta arma a dos manos se adapte a muchas situaciones, ya que puede partir a enemigos sin armadura con la misma facilidad que a un escudo.

Rule.Original: A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively.
Rule.Raw: A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más pesada del hacha a dos manos. El peso de esta hacha permite un gran daño bruto, así como una sólida durabilidad. Una gran opción para partir escudos o enemigos sin armadura. Requiere de mucha fuerza para blandirla con eficacia.

Rule.Original: A widespread two-handed weapon often utilized by raiders due to its easy use and high damage. High damage, but the long shaft requires a warrior to forgo a shield, so the longaxe should be used by confident combatants.\nThe reach of the longaxe allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A widespread two-handed weapon often utilized by raiders due to its easy use and high damage. High damage, but the long shaft requires a warrior to forgo a shield, so the longaxe should be used by confident combatants.\nThe reach of the longaxe allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Un arma a dos manos muy utilizada por los asaltantes debido a su facilidad de uso y su gran daño. Hace mucho daño, pero su larga asta obliga al guerrero a prescindir del escudo, por lo que el hacha larga debe ser utilizada por combatientes seguros de sí mismos.

Rule.Original: A quintessential tool of the forge, the blacksmith hammer is designed for shaping molten metal and forging formidable weapons and armor. Though its primary function lies in crafting, its heavy head and stout handle make it a formidable weapon in its own right, capable of battering through defenses with the same efficiency it shapes ingots.
Rule.Raw: A quintessential tool of the forge, the blacksmith hammer is designed for shaping molten metal and forging formidable weapons and armor. Though its primary function lies in crafting, its heavy head and stout handle make it a formidable weapon in its own right, capable of battering through defenses with the same efficiency it shapes ingots.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta esencial de la forja, diseñada para dar forma al metal fundido y fabricar armas y armaduras formidables. Aunque su función principal es artesanal, su cabeza pesada y su mango robusto también la convierten en un arma temible, capaz de atravesar defensas con la misma eficacia con la que moldea lingotes.

Rule.Original: A mining tool used to batter stones and ores; although primarily used to gather economic resources, the mine features deadly picks at both ends, capable of decimating armor as effectively as it mines ore.
Rule.Raw: A mining tool used to batter stones and ores; although primarily used to gather economic resources, the mine features deadly picks at both ends, capable of decimating armor as effectively as it mines ore.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta minera utilizada para perforar piedras y lingotes. Aunque se utiliza principalmente para recolectar recursos, esta herramienta cuenta con afiladas y mortíferas puntas en ambos extremos, capaces de diezmar armaduras con la misma eficacia con la que puede extraer minerales.

Rule.Original: Inspired by the miner’s pickaxe, the military pick consists of a long shaft with a pointy spike designed to puncture armor more effectively than the tool that inspired its design.
Rule.Raw: Inspired by the miner’s pickaxe, the military pick consists of a long shaft with a pointy spike designed to puncture armor more effectively than the tool that inspired its design.
Rule.Translated: Inspirada en el pico de los mineros, el pico militar consiste en un palo largo con un pincho puntiagudo diseñado para perforar armaduras con mayor eficacia que la herramienta que inspiró su diseño.

Rule.Original: While metal plates prove difficult to puncture, many warriors instead opt to damage the armor with a warhammer. Short, and thus wieldable with a shield, the warhammer continues to be a solid choice for battling rich nobles and heavily armored knights.
Rule.Raw: While metal plates prove difficult to puncture, many warriors instead opt to damage the armor with a warhammer. Short, and thus wieldable with a shield, the warhammer continues to be a solid choice for battling rich nobles and heavily armored knights.
Rule.Translated: Aunque las placas de metal son difíciles de perforar, muchos guerreros optan por dañar la armadura con un martillo de guerra. Este martillo, corto y por tanto manejable con un escudo, sigue siendo una opción sólida para luchar contra nobles ricos y caballeros fuertemente acorazados.

Rule.Original: A basic weapon composed of a single accessible material like wood, the two-handed mallet can disrupt enemy formations, whether the enemies are armored or not.
Rule.Raw: A basic weapon composed of a single accessible material like wood, the two-handed mallet can disrupt enemy formations, whether the enemies are armored or not.
Rule.Translated: El mazo a dos manos, un arma básica compuesta de un único material accesible como la madera, puede desbaratar con cierta facilidad las formaciones enemigas, tanto si éstos están acorazados como si no.

Rule.Original: An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
Rule.Raw: An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
Rule.Translated: El martillo a dos manos, una mejora del mazo, utiliza una pesada cabeza de metal para multiplicar la fuerza infligida a los objetivos. La fuerza de los martillazos puede partir placas sólidas y escudos resistentes.

Rule.Original: A variation of the two-handed hammer that features two points at the head. This design offers additional ways to penetrate armored foes, as well as puncture less armored enemies with ease.\nThe reach of the polehammer allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A variation of the two-handed hammer that features two points at the head. This design offers additional ways to penetrate armored foes, as well as puncture less armored enemies with ease.\nThe reach of the polehammer allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Una variación del martillo a dos manos que presenta dos puntas en la cabeza. Este diseño ofrece formas adicionales de penetrar a enemigos acorazados, así como de perforar a enemigos menos acorazados con facilidad.

Rule.Original: The first version of the club, which is also more practical in battle. The metal head allows for greater armor penetration and can easily break the bones of unarmored foes.
Rule.Raw: The first version of the club, which is also more practical in battle. The metal head allows for greater armor penetration and can easily break the bones of unarmored foes.
Rule.Translated: La primera versión del garrote, una que también es más práctica en la batalla. La cabeza metálica permite una mayor penetración de la armadura y puede romper fácilmente los huesos de los enemigos sin armadura.

Rule.Original: Popular amongst roaming tribals, the nomad mace features a wide and heavy metal head. While damage inflicted will be similar to other maces, the circumference of the head causes higher armor damage.
Rule.Raw: Popular amongst roaming tribals, the nomad mace features a wide and heavy metal head. While damage inflicted will be similar to other maces, the circumference of the head causes higher armor damage.
Rule.Translated: La maza nómada, una variante popular entre las tribus nómadas, tiene una cabeza de metal ancha y pesada. Aunque el daño infligido es similar al de otras mazas, la circunferencia de la cabeza causa más daño a las armaduras.

Rule.Original: A fierce and deadly mace loved by raiders and bandits for its blunt damage, as well as puncturing damage thanks to the spikes mounted around the head.
Rule.Raw: A fierce and deadly mace loved by raiders and bandits for its blunt damage, as well as puncturing damage thanks to the spikes mounted around the head.
Rule.Translated: Una maza feroz y letal muy apreciada por asaltantes y bandidos por su daño contundente, así como por el daño punzante gracias a los pinchos montados alrededor de la cabeza.

Rule.Original: Resembling an arrow with feathering, the winged mace features protruded ridges around the metal head, which further boasts armor penetration. Best when used against enemies turtling behind heavy plate armor.
Rule.Raw: Resembling an arrow with feathering, the winged mace features protruded ridges around the metal head, which further boasts armor penetration. Best when used against enemies turtling behind heavy plate armor.
Rule.Translated: Semejante a una flecha con plumas, la maza alada presenta crestas sobresalientes alrededor de la cabeza de metal, lo que aumenta la penetración en la armadura. Ideal contra enemigos que se esconden tras una armadura pesada.

Rule.Original: A simple, yet ingenious weapon which merges the utility of a spear with the brute force of a club. Capable of delivering both deadly thrusts and rib-crushing smashes with its weighted, spiked head.
Rule.Raw: A simple, yet ingenious weapon which merges the utility of a spear with the brute force of a club. Capable of delivering both deadly thrusts and rib-crushing smashes with its weighted, spiked head.
Rule.Translated: Un arma sencilla pero ingeniosa que combina la utilidad de una lanza con la fuerza bruta de un garrote. Es capaz de asestar estocadas mortales y aplastar costillas con su pesada cabeza de púas.

Rule.Original: The two-handed version of the morning star, warriors can trade their shields for further offensive potential. The handle’s longer reach allows for easier striking on mounts and greater armor penetration.
Rule.Raw: The two-handed version of the morning star, warriors can trade their shields for further offensive potential. The handle’s longer reach allows for easier striking on mounts and greater armor penetration.
Rule.Translated: La versión a dos manos del lucero del alba. Permite a los guerreros cambiar sus escudos por una mayor capacidad ofensivs. El mayor alcance de la empuñadura permite golpear más fácilmente a las monturas y penetrar mejor en la armadura.

Rule.Original: The two-handed version of the winged mace, the long handle not only allows for higher damage but also greater armor penetration. The protruding flanges decimate both shields and metal plates.
Rule.Raw: The two-handed version of the winged mace, the long handle not only allows for higher damage but also greater armor penetration. The protruding flanges decimate both shields and metal plates.
Rule.Translated: La versión a dos manos de la maza alada. El mango largo no solo permite un mayor daño, sino también una mayor penetración en la armadura. Los rebordes salientes diezman tanto escudos como placas metálicas.

Rule.Original:
A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well. 

An ancient relic of the long forgotten under-empires. A masterfully crafted blade able to carve through plates of steel with its edge unwavering.
The reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw:
A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well. 

An ancient relic of the long forgotten under-empires. A masterfully crafted blade able to carve through plates of steel with its edge unwavering.
The reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme espada a dos manos de hoja larga, capaz de atravesar a los enemigos con feroces golpes y estocadas. También es buena para las estocadas largas.\n\nUna antigua reliquia de los subimperios olvidados, con una hoja magistralmente elaborada, capaz de atravesar placas de acero con su filo inquebrantable.
maza con reborde a dos manos

Rule.Original: The two-handed version of the winged mace, the long handle not only allows for higher damage but also greater armor penetration. The protruding flanges decimate both shields and metal plates.
Rule.Raw: The two-handed version of the winged mace, the long handle not only allows for higher damage but also greater armor penetration. The protruding flanges decimate both shields and metal plates.
Rule.Translated: La versión a dos manos de la maza alada. El mango largo no solo permite hacer más daño, sino también penetrar mejor en la armadura. Los rebordes salientes diezman tanto escudos como placas metálicas.

Rule.Original: A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively.
Rule.Raw: A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más pesada del hacha a dos manos. El peso de esta hacha permite un gran daño bruto, así como una sólida durabilidad. Una gran opción para partir escudos o enemigos sin armadura. Requiere de mucha fuerza para blandirla con eficacia.

Rule.Original: An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
Rule.Raw: An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
Rule.Translated: El martillo a dos manos, una mejora del mazo, utiliza una pesada cabeza de metal para multiplicar la fuerza infligida a los objetivos. La fuerza de los martillazos puede partir placas sólidas y escudos resistentes.

Rule.Original: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de pica, muy versátil gracias a sus tres extremos mortales: una hoja para golpear, un gancho para agarrar y una punta en forma de lanza para perforar cotas de malla y placas metálicas.

Rule.Original: Since ancient times, lords provided militia spears to their fyrd, the peasants who take up arms during wartime. Their reasoning was simple: rather than practice the bow or sword, one with low melee skill will be more effective hidden behind a shield and jabbing with a long, pointy stick. Low damage, but decent armor penetration and easy to use.
Rule.Raw: Since ancient times, lords provided militia spears to their fyrd, the peasants who take up arms during wartime. Their reasoning was simple: rather than practice the bow or sword, one with low melee skill will be more effective hidden behind a shield and jabbing with a long, pointy stick. Low damage, but decent armor penetration and easy to use.
Rule.Translated: Desde la antigüedad, los señores proporcionaban lanzas miliciana a sus súbditos, los campesinos que tomaban las armas en tiempos de guerra. Su razonamiento era sencillo: en lugar de practicar con el arco o la espada, alguien con poca habilidad para el combate cuerpo a cuerpo será más eficaz escondido tras un escudo y clavando un palo largo y puntiagudo. Hace poco daño, pero penetra bien en la armadura y es fácil de usar.

Rule.Original: The two wings found at the base of the spear socket act as barriers to halt oncoming attacks. They also prevent the spear from penetrating too far and thus getting stuck, making the boar spear effective for hunting as well as quick thrusts.
Rule.Raw: The two wings found at the base of the spear socket act as barriers to halt oncoming attacks. They also prevent the spear from penetrating too far and thus getting stuck, making the boar spear effective for hunting as well as quick thrusts.
Rule.Translated: Las dos alas que se encuentran en la base de la lanza actúan como barreras para detener los ataques. También evitan que la lanza penetre demasiado y se atasque, lo que hace que la lanza de jabalí sea eficaz tanto para la caza como para realizar estocadas rápidas.

Rule.Original: A spear most effective for combat, the fighting spear is long and sturdy to help frontlines maintain their spear wall. Borrowing the wing design from the boar spear, the fighting spear also features two protruding points, which can help stop enemy swings.
Rule.Raw: A spear most effective for combat, the fighting spear is long and sturdy to help frontlines maintain their spear wall. Borrowing the wing design from the boar spear, the fighting spear also features two protruding points, which can help stop enemy swings.
Rule.Translated: La lanza de combate es larga y robusta para ayudar a las primeras líneas a mantener su muro de lanzas. La lanza de combate, que toma prestado el diseño de ala de la lanza de jabalí, también presenta dos puntas salientes que pueden ayudar a detener los golpes enemigos.

Rule.Original: An adaptation of the agricultural pitchfork, the warfork is designed for easy use like the spear but with the range of a pike. Solid damage and easy to use, great for beginner warriors.\nThe reach of the warfork allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: An adaptation of the agricultural pitchfork, the warfork is designed for easy use like the spear but with the range of a pike. Solid damage and easy to use, great for beginner warriors.\nThe reach of the warfork allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Una adaptación de la horca agrícola, la horca de guerra está diseñada para un uso fácil como la lanza pero con el alcance de una pica. Puede producir daño sólido y es sencilla de usar, ideal para guerreros principiantes.

Rule.Original: A pole weapon with a spearhead at the tip and side blades that allow for several penetration points. A thrust from the spetum can damage multiple areas at once while providing additional defense from the pike-inspired side blades.\nThe reach of the spetum allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A pole weapon with a spearhead at the tip and side blades that allow for several penetration points. A thrust from the spetum can damage multiple areas at once while providing additional defense from the pike-inspired side blades.\nThe reach of the spetum allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de asta con una punta de lanza en la punta y hojas laterales que permiten varios puntos de penetración. Una estocada del tridente puede dañar varias zonas a la vez, a la vez que proporciona defensa adicional con las hojas laterales inspiradas en las picas.

Rule.Original: An agricultural tool, the pitchfork offers minimal damage and armor penetration. However, the length and pointy ends allow it to be useful as an improvised weapon by outranging swords and spears.\nThe reach of the pitchfork allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: An agricultural tool, the pitchfork offers minimal damage and armor penetration. However, the length and pointy ends allow it to be useful as an improvised weapon by outranging swords and spears.\nThe reach of the pitchfork allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Una herramienta agrícola, que ofrece un daño y una penetración de armadura mínimos. Sin embargo, su longitud y sus extremos puntiagudos le permiten ser útil como arma improvisada, superando a espadas y lanzas.

Rule.Original: When striking isn’t enough, brave warriors can close distances with the hooked blade’s curved head. The sharp point can puncture both flesh and metal, ensuring a tight grip to pull in enemies. Deals impressive damage for an agricultural tool but shines thanks to its utility.\nThe reach of the hooked blade allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: When striking isn’t enough, brave warriors can close distances with the hooked blade’s curved head. The sharp point can puncture both flesh and metal, ensuring a tight grip to pull in enemies. Deals impressive damage for an agricultural tool but shines thanks to its utility.\nThe reach of the hooked blade allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Cuando golpear no es suficiente, los valientes guerreros pueden acortar distancias con la cabeza curva de la hoja en forma de gancho. La afilada punta puede perforar tanto la carne como el metal, asegurando un agarre firme para atraer a los enemigos. Inflige un daño impresionante para ser una herramienta agrícola, y todo gracias a su practicidad.

Rule.Original: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the billhook allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the billhook allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de pica, muy versátil gracias a sus tres extremos mortales: una hoja para golpear, un gancho para agarrar y una punta en forma de lanza para perforar cotas de malla y placas metálicas.

Rule.Original: Unlike the spear, pikes must be wielded with both hands to be effective. This allows pike-users to impale enemies at a distance, making pikemen feared warriors even from the backline.\nThe reach of the pike allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: Unlike the spear, pikes must be wielded with both hands to be effective. This allows pike-users to impale enemies at a distance, making pikemen feared warriors even from the backline.\nThe reach of the pike allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: A diferencia de la lanza, las picas deben blandirse con ambas manos para ser eficaces. Esto permite a los usuarios de picas empalar a los enemigos a distancia, lo que convierte a los piqueros en guerreros temidos incluso desde la retaguardia.

Rule.Original:
Unlike the spear, pikes must be wielded with both hands to be effective. This allows pike-users to impale enemies at a distance, making pikemen feared warriors even from the backline.
The reach of the pike allows it to strike enemies much further away. 

 This pike carries the colors of house Amboise.
