Rule.Original: Variation of the pike, although the curved blade allows for fierce slashing at a distance. This trades armor penetration for raw damage, making the swordlance deadly in experienced hands.\nThe reach of the swordlance allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: Variation of the pike, although the curved blade allows for fierce slashing at a distance. This trades armor penetration for raw damage, making the swordlance deadly in experienced hands.\nThe reach of the swordlance allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Una variante de la pica en la que la hoja curvada permite realizar feroces tajos a distancia. Esto cambia la penetración de la armadura por el daño bruto, lo que la convierte en una espada letal en manos expertas.

Rule.Original: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de pica, muy versátil gracias a sus tres extremos mortales: una hoja para golpear, un gancho para agarrar y una punta en forma de lanza para perforar cotas de malla y placas metálicas.

Rule.Original: A stout, broad-bladed falchion, often found in the hands of militiamen and peasantry due to the ease of its manufacture and use. Best used for slashing, but can still thrust in a pinch.
Rule.Raw: A stout, broad-bladed falchion, often found in the hands of militiamen and peasantry due to the ease of its manufacture and use. Best used for slashing, but can still thrust in a pinch.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de espada robusta y de hoja ancha, a menudo en manos de milicianos y campesinos por su facilidad de fabricación y uso. Se usa sobre todo para acuchillar, pero también puede empujar en caso de apuro.

Rule.Original: Many warriors see their weapons as tools, and so the most common swords are those most practical. Arming swords, praised for their light weight, fullered blade, and efficient craftsmanship, prove useful for both novices and veterans alike. Swords can bring warriors wealth, so when choosing the tool for warfare, one would be lucky to wield an arming sword.
Rule.Raw: Many warriors see their weapons as tools, and so the most common swords are those most practical. Arming swords, praised for their light weight, fullered blade, and efficient craftsmanship, prove useful for both novices and veterans alike. Swords can bring warriors wealth, so when choosing the tool for warfare, one would be lucky to wield an arming sword.
Rule.Translated: Muchos guerreros ven sus armas como herramientas, por lo que las espadas más comunes son las más prácticas. Las espadas de armar, alabadas por su ligereza, su hoja entera y su eficiente manufactura, resultan útiles tanto para novatos como para veteranos. Las espadas pueden aportar riqueza a los guerreros, por lo que, a la hora de elegir la herramienta para la guerra, uno sería afortunado si empuñara una espada de armar.

Rule.Original: An elegant weapon both light and deadly, the fencing sword requires great skill to use effectively. However, mastery of such a weapon can lead duelists to many victories even against mails, as precise strikes can pierce weak points.
Rule.Raw: An elegant weapon both light and deadly, the fencing sword requires great skill to use effectively. However, mastery of such a weapon can lead duelists to many victories even against mails, as precise strikes can pierce weak points.
Rule.Translated: La espada de esgrima, un arma elegante a la vez que ligera y mortífera, requiere una gran habilidad para utilizarla con eficacia. Sin embargo, el dominio de un arma así puede llevar a los duelistas a muchas victorias incluso contra armaduras, ya que los golpes precisos pueden perforar los puntos débiles.

Rule.Original: A well forged and masterfully balanced arming sword, ornately decorated and finely finished. Both a fine weapon and a work of art.
Rule.Raw: A well forged and masterfully balanced arming sword, ornately decorated and finely finished. Both a fine weapon and a work of art.
Rule.Translated: Una espada de armar bien forjada y magistralmente equilibrada, ornamentada y finamente acabada. Un arma excelente y una obra de arte.

Rule.Original: Where shorter and lighter blades are most useful in shield walls, the longsword shines in skirmishes and duels. By increasing the length, and consequently ditching a shield, a warrior can increase reach to inflict high damage through swings and even thrusts. Do not assume that the increased size brings increased weight, as a swift strike from a longsword has caught many enemies off-guard.
Rule.Raw: Where shorter and lighter blades are most useful in shield walls, the longsword shines in skirmishes and duels. By increasing the length, and consequently ditching a shield, a warrior can increase reach to inflict high damage through swings and even thrusts. Do not assume that the increased size brings increased weight, as a swift strike from a longsword has caught many enemies off-guard.
Rule.Translated: Mientras que las espadas más cortas y ligeras son más útiles en los muros de escudos, la espada larga brilla en escaramuzas y duelos. Al aumentar la longitud y, en consecuencia, prescindir del escudo, un guerrero puede aumentar el alcance para infligir un gran daño mediante golpes e incluso estocadas. No asumas que el aumento de tamaño conlleva un aumento de peso, ya que un golpe rápido de un sable largo puede pillar desprevenidos a muchos enemigos.

Rule.Original: A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well.\nThe reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well.\nThe reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme espada a dos manos de hoja larga, capaz de atravesar a los enemigos con feroces golpes y estocadas. También es buena para las estocadas largas.

Rule.Original: A projectile launching weapon that, much like the bow, relies on a string pulled back for tension and propels a projectile upon release. However, the crossbow allows the wielder to maintain the draw thanks to the crossbow’s locking mechanism, thus making the ranged weapon both accessible to novices and powerful in combat.
Rule.Raw: A projectile launching weapon that, much like the bow, relies on a string pulled back for tension and propels a projectile upon release. However, the crossbow allows the wielder to maintain the draw thanks to the crossbow’s locking mechanism, thus making the ranged weapon both accessible to novices and powerful in combat.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de lanzamiento de proyectiles que, al igual que el arco, se basa en una cuerda tensada que propulsa un proyectil al soltarse. Sin embargo, la ballesta permite a su portador mantener la tensión gracias a su mecanismo de bloqueo, lo que la convierte en un arma a distancia accesible para los principiantes y poderosa en combate.

Rule.Original: Although cumbersome to carry, the heavy crossbow is capable of inflicting heavy damage and piercing armored foes. Longer range and higher damage than the crossbow but takes time to reload. This makes the heavy crossbow a formidable defensive weapon and otherwise most effective in a group.
Rule.Raw: Although cumbersome to carry, the heavy crossbow is capable of inflicting heavy damage and piercing armored foes. Longer range and higher damage than the crossbow but takes time to reload. This makes the heavy crossbow a formidable defensive weapon and otherwise most effective in a group.
Rule.Translated: Aunque es incómoda de llevar, la arbalesta es capaz de infligir grandes daños y atravesar a los enemigos acorazados. Tiene mayor alcance y mayor daño que la ballesta, pero tarda más en recargarse. Esto hace que la arbalesta sea un arma defensiva formidable, y por tanto, más eficaz en grupo.

Rule.Original: War changes as the handgonnes take to the field; through powder and ignition, warriors fire hot shrapnel forward to pierce multiple targets. The long handle and heavy barrel make the weapon cumbersome to carry, but one skilled shot can turn the tides of battle in an instant.
Rule.Raw: War changes as the handgonnes take to the field; through powder and ignition, warriors fire hot shrapnel forward to pierce multiple targets. The long handle and heavy barrel make the weapon cumbersome to carry, but one skilled shot can turn the tides of battle in an instant.
Rule.Translated: La guerra cambió cuando los cañones de mano llegaron al campo de batalla. Mediante la pólvora y la ignición, los guerreros pueden disparar metralla caliente hacia adelante y atravesar múltiples objetivos. La larga empuñadura y el pesado cañón hacen que el arma sea incómoda de llevar, pero un disparo hábil puede cambiar las tornas de la batalla en un instante.

Rule.Original: An explosive clay pot designed to lit an area ablaze with its oil filled case.
Rule.Raw: An explosive clay pot designed to lit an area ablaze with its oil filled case.
Rule.Translated: Unas vasijas de barro explosivas, diseñadas para incendiar una zona con el aceite del interior.

Rule.Original: An explosive clay pot designed to disorient victims with a bright flash and loude sharp noise.
Rule.Raw: An explosive clay pot designed to disorient victims with a bright flash and loude sharp noise.
Rule.Translated: Unas vasijas de barro explosivas, diseñadas para desorientar a las víctimas con un destello brillante y un ruido agudo.

Rule.Original: An explosive clay pot designed to create a screen of smoke to provide visionary cover.
Rule.Raw: An explosive clay pot designed to create a screen of smoke to provide visionary cover.
Rule.Translated: Unas vasijas de barro explosivas, diseñadas para crear una pantalla de humo que proporciona cobertura.

Rule.Original: An flask containing linwurm acid, designed to spray the corrosive acid upon breaking.
Rule.Raw: An flask containing linwurm acid, designed to spray the corrosive acid upon breaking.
Rule.Translated: Un frasco de ácido de lindwurm diseñado para rociar el ácido corrosivo al romperse.

Rule.Original: A simple and short weapon, the hunting bow mixes dense wood for the belly along with springier wood for the front. This allows the dense wood to bend, but the wood always fights to return to the straight, and so ousts arrows pulled along the strand at great force. Smaller than the war bow, resulting in less distance and penetration, but deadly in the hands of a skilled archer or hunter.
Rule.Raw: A simple and short weapon, the hunting bow mixes dense wood for the belly along with springier wood for the front. This allows the dense wood to bend, but the wood always fights to return to the straight, and so ousts arrows pulled along the strand at great force. Smaller than the war bow, resulting in less distance and penetration, but deadly in the hands of a skilled archer or hunter.
Rule.Translated: Un arma sencilla y corta, el arco de caza mezcla madera densa para el vientre con madera más elástica para la parte delantera. Esto permite que la madera densa se doble, pero la madera siempre lucha por volver a estar recta, expulsando así las flechas a lo largo de la hebra con gran fuerza. Es más pequeño que el arco de guerra, por lo que cuenta con menos distancia y penetración, pero es mortal en manos de un arquero o cazador experto.

Rule.Original: A long bow carved from beautiful yew with tips steamed to provide slight bend and painted to keep the bow from shattering under stress—and the bow indeed experiences stress as the long body allows the hemp strand to pull further and with more tension. This helps arrows fly further and better penetrate surfaces, making the war bow a deadly weapon for combat.
Rule.Raw: A long bow carved from beautiful yew with tips steamed to provide slight bend and painted to keep the bow from shattering under stress—and the bow indeed experiences stress as the long body allows the hemp strand to pull further and with more tension. This helps arrows fly further and better penetrate surfaces, making the war bow a deadly weapon for combat.
Rule.Translated: Un arco largo tallado en hermoso tejo con las puntas vaporizadas para proporcionar una ligera curvatura, y pintado para evitar que el arco se rompa bajo tensión. Y efectivamente, este arco experimenta bastante tensión, ya que el cuerpo largo permite que la hebra de cáñamo tire más lejos y con más tensión. Esto ayuda a que las flechas vuelen más lejos y penetren mejor en las superficies, haciendo del arco de guerra un arma mortal para el combate.

Rule.Original: A small, delicate herb with pale green leaves and tiny, yellow flowers, often used in crafting strong elixirs due to its potent properties.
Rule.Raw: A small, delicate herb with pale green leaves and tiny, yellow flowers, often used in crafting strong elixirs due to its potent properties.
Rule.Translated: Una hierba pequeña y delicada de hojas verde pálido y diminutas flores amarillas. Sus potentes propiedades la hacen frecuente en la elaboración de elixires fuertes.

Rule.Original: A vibrant plant with striking red flowers, known for its use in various medicinal and alchemical preparations, often valued for its potent effects.
Rule.Raw: A vibrant plant with striking red flowers, known for its use in various medicinal and alchemical preparations, often valued for its potent effects.
Rule.Translated: Una planta vistosa de llamativas flores rojas, conocida por su uso en diversos preparados medicinales y alquímicos y apreciada por sus potentes efectos.

Rule.Original: A hardy plant, traditionally used for its medicinal properties.
Rule.Raw: A hardy plant, traditionally used for its medicinal properties.
Rule.Translated: Una planta resistente usada tradicionalmente por sus propiedades medicinales.

Rule.Original: A striking mushroom with a bright red cap adorned with white spots, known for its toxic properties. Despite its danger, it has been used in small doses in traditional remedies and rituals, though caution is always advised.
Rule.Raw: A striking mushroom with a bright red cap adorned with white spots, known for its toxic properties. Despite its danger, it has been used in small doses in traditional remedies and rituals, though caution is always advised.
Rule.Translated: Una seta llamativa con un sombrero rojo brillante salpicado de manchas blancas, conocida por sus propiedades tóxicas. A pesar del peligro, se ha utilizado en pequeñas dosis en remedios y rituales tradicionales, aunque siempre se recomienda precaución.

Rule.Original: A highly nutritious bulb. Onions grow well even in even the worst soils, but don't benefit from better soil.
Rule.Raw: A highly nutritious bulb. Onions grow well even in even the worst soils, but don't benefit from better soil.
Rule.Translated: Unos tallos verdes fibrosos que dan paso a una cabeza bulbosa y fragante contenida en una piel fina como un papel. La cebolla es un ingrediente versátil que sirve de base a platos de verduras y de delicioso acompañamiento a platos con carne.

Rule.Original: A petite, leafy legume which gives way to numerous little sprouts. Lentils are surprisingly nourishing, and are shelf stable for a longer time.
Rule.Raw: A petite, leafy legume which gives way to numerous little sprouts. Lentils are surprisingly nourishing, and are shelf stable for a longer time.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña y frondosa liguilla que da lugar a numerosos brotes pequeños. Las lentejas son sorprendentemente nutritivas y se dice que son buenas tanto para el cuerpo como para el alma.

Rule.Original: Layered leafy vegetable for its cold resilience. Cabbage is especially good as an ingredient in salads and soups.
Rule.Raw: Layered leafy vegetable for its cold resilience. Cabbage is especially good as an ingredient in salads and soups.
Rule.Translated: Cabezas verdes de col, una hortaliza formada por muchas hojas apiladas unas sobre otras. La col es especialmente buena como ingrediente de ensaladas y sopas.

Rule.Original: Leafy green stalks, who's base consists of a segmented off-white bulb. Garlic makes for a good seasoning and ingredient for many meals, either minced and sauteed for use as an ingredient, or pulverized and used as a seasoning.
Rule.Raw: Leafy green stalks, who's base consists of a segmented off-white bulb. Garlic makes for a good seasoning and ingredient for many meals, either minced and sauteed for use as an ingredient, or pulverized and used as a seasoning.
Rule.Translated: Unos tallos frondosos de color verde, cuya base está formada por un bulbo segmentado de color blanquecino. El ajo es un buen ingrediente y condimento para muchas comidas, ya sea picado y salteado para lo primero, o pulverizado para lo segundo.

Rule.Original: Small button shaped fungus that are safe to digest, but are an acquired taste. It dies when exposed to light
Rule.Raw: Small button shaped fungus that are safe to digest, but are an acquired taste. It dies when exposed to light
Rule.Translated: Diversas variedades de hongos han sido cultivadas por el hombre durante milenios, ya sea con fines recreativos, medicinales o culinarios. Estos tallos son seguros para la digestión y constituyen un tentempié característicamente terroso, además de un rico complemento para cualquier comida.

Rule.Original: A tall, slow-growing crop that has a high yield of small yellow grains. These grains require further processing, but are relatively stable. Needs fertile soil to grow well.
Rule.Raw: A tall, slow-growing crop that has a high yield of small yellow grains. These grains require further processing, but are relatively stable. Needs fertile soil to grow well.
Rule.Translated: Una planta de grano fino y frágil que produce pequeñas semillas amarillas. Tarda relativamente mucho en crecer y produce mucho alimento, pero requiere una transformación posterior para ser comestible. Necesita tierra fértil para crecer bien.

Rule.Original: A fibrous wheatlike plant. Its versatile fibre can be utilized for its stringy properties and will make good fabric.
Rule.Raw: A fibrous wheatlike plant. Its versatile fibre can be utilized for its stringy properties and will make good fabric.
Rule.Translated: Una planta fibrosa parecida al trigo. Su fibra es muy versátil, sus propiedades permiten fabricar buenos tejidos.

Rule.Original: Sweet, stout stalks of fibrous plant growth. While virtually inedible on its own, they are often processed into sugar for use in numerous meals.
Rule.Raw: Sweet, stout stalks of fibrous plant growth. While virtually inedible on its own, they are often processed into sugar for use in numerous meals.
Rule.Translated: Unos tallos dulces y robustos de plantas fibrosas. Aunque prácticamente no son comestibles por sí mismos, a menudo se transforman en azúcar para su uso en numerosas comidas.

Rule.Original: Bushy, short stalks whos value is in the sugary taproot. They make for a healthy, if not tasty snacks on their own, or a good addition to any meal when boiled, stewed or sauteed.
Rule.Raw: Bushy, short stalks whos value is in the sugary taproot. They make for a healthy, if not tasty snacks on their own, or a good addition to any meal when boiled, stewed or sauteed.
Rule.Translated: Unos tallos cortos y tupidos cuya raíz está formada por un tubérculo de color naranja brillante. Son un tentempié sano, aunque no sabroso, a la vez que un buen complemento para cualquier comida si se hierven, guisan o saltean.

Rule.Original: A fragrant, leafy green plant which has an iota of uses in food preparation as a flavor enhancer, but which is virtually inedible on its own.
Rule.Raw: A fragrant, leafy green plant which has an iota of uses in food preparation as a flavor enhancer, but which is virtually inedible on its own.
Rule.Translated: Una planta fragante, de hojas verdes, que tiene un nicho de uso en la preparación de alimentos como potenciador del sabor, aunque por sí sola no es que sea muy comestible.

Rule.Original: A thick, leafy green vine which gives birth to many large bulbous red fruits. While weither it exists as a fruit or a vegetable is a hotly debated topic, what is known is that the tomatoes it creates are juicy and delicious.
Rule.Raw: A thick, leafy green vine which gives birth to many large bulbous red fruits. While weither it exists as a fruit or a vegetable is a hotly debated topic, what is known is that the tomatoes it creates are juicy and delicious.
Rule.Translated: Una enredadera gruesa y frondosa de color verde que da muchos frutos rojos, grandes y bulbosos. Aunque es debatible si se trata de una fruta o una verdura, lo que sí se sabe es que los tomates son jugosos y deliciosos.

Rule.Original: A medium-sized vine that yields grapes when harvested - an essential ingredient in the production of wine that also tastes nice when eaten raw. Takes a long time to initially grow but can be harvested repeatedly in a single lifespan.
Rule.Raw: A medium-sized vine that yields grapes when harvested - an essential ingredient in the production of wine that also tastes nice when eaten raw. Takes a long time to initially grow but can be harvested repeatedly in a single lifespan.
Rule.Translated: Una vid de tamaño medio que da uvas cuando se cosecha, un ingrediente esencial en la producción de vino que también sabe bien cuando se come crudo. Al principio tarda mucho en crecer, pero puede cosecharse varias veces durante su ciclo de vida.

Rule.Original: A thin green vine which gives way to a characteristically massive orange vegetable, a good visualization of "big things come in small packages". Not particularly tasty on its own, but it makes for a variety of hearty seasonal meals.
Rule.Raw: A thin green vine which gives way to a characteristically massive orange vegetable, a good visualization of "big things come in small packages". Not particularly tasty on its own, but it makes for a variety of hearty seasonal meals.
Rule.Translated: Una fina vid verde que produce una hortaliza de color naranja característicamente enorme, un buen ejemplo de que «las cosas grandes vienen en paquetes pequeños». No es especialmente sabrosa por sí sola, pero sirve para preparar abundantes platos de temporada.

Rule.Original: A hardwood tree known for its wonderfully sweet, bright-red fruits, which are good both on their own and mixed into a variety of desserts.
Rule.Raw: A hardwood tree known for its wonderfully sweet, bright-red fruits, which are good both on their own and mixed into a variety of desserts.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol frondoso conocido por sus maravillosos frutos rojos, dulces y brillantes, que son buenos tanto solos como mezclados en una variedad de postres.

Rule.Original: A small hardwood tree which gives way to bitter-tasting yellow citrus fruits. Lemons are often consumed for their dietary benefits and to prevent diseases such as Scurvy, as well as often being used as an ingredient or glaze for many different prepared meals.
Rule.Raw: A small hardwood tree which gives way to bitter-tasting yellow citrus fruits. Lemons are often consumed for their dietary benefits and to prevent diseases such as Scurvy, as well as often being used as an ingredient or glaze for many different prepared meals.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño árbol de madera dura que da lugar a cítricos amarillos de sabor amargo. Los limones se consumen a menudo por sus beneficios dietéticos y para prevenir enfermedades como el escorbuto, además de utilizarse a menudo como ingrediente o glaseado de una gran variedad de platos.

Rule.Original: A small and fast-growing tree they yields sweet mulberries. They are commonly known to host mulberry worms that can produce previous silk.
Rule.Raw: A small and fast-growing tree they yields sweet mulberries. They are commonly known to host mulberry worms that can produce previous silk.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol pequeño y de crecimiento rápido que produce moras dulces. Son conocidas por albergar gusanos que pueden producir seda.

Rule.Original: A rare luscious fruit that grows on small tree. As per it's given name, the red fruit is a delicacy to griffins and are typically guarded by them.
Rule.Raw: A rare luscious fruit that grows on small tree. As per it's given name, the red fruit is a delicacy to griffins and are typically guarded by them.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol pequeño que da un fruto exquisito. Como su nombre indica, los frutos rojos son un manjar para los grifos, que suelen estar protegiendo el árbol.

Rule.Original: A small, delicate herb with pale green leaves and tiny, yellow flowers, often used in crafting strong elixirs due to its potent properties.
Rule.Raw: A small, delicate herb with pale green leaves and tiny, yellow flowers, often used in crafting strong elixirs due to its potent properties.
Rule.Translated: Una hierba pequeña y delicada de hojas verde pálido y diminutas flores amarillas. Sus potentes propiedades la hacen frecuente en la elaboración de elixires fuertes.

Rule.Original: A vibrant plant with striking red flowers, known for its use in various medicinal and alchemical preparations, often valued for its potent effects.
Rule.Raw: A vibrant plant with striking red flowers, known for its use in various medicinal and alchemical preparations, often valued for its potent effects.
Rule.Translated: Una planta vistosa de llamativas flores rojas, conocida por su uso en diversos preparados medicinales y alquímicos y apreciada por sus potentes efectos.

Rule.Original: A hardy plant, traditionally used for its medicinal properties.
Rule.Raw: A hardy plant, traditionally used for its medicinal properties.
Rule.Translated: Una planta resistente usada tradicionalmente por sus propiedades medicinales.

Rule.Original: A striking mushroom with a bright red cap adorned with white spots, known for its toxic properties. Despite its danger, it has been used in small doses in traditional remedies and rituals, though caution is always advised.
Rule.Raw: A striking mushroom with a bright red cap adorned with white spots, known for its toxic properties. Despite its danger, it has been used in small doses in traditional remedies and rituals, though caution is always advised.
Rule.Translated: Una seta llamativa con un sombrero rojo brillante salpicado de manchas blancas, conocida por sus propiedades tóxicas. A pesar del peligro, se ha utilizado en pequeñas dosis en remedios y rituales tradicionales, aunque siempre se recomienda precaución.

Rule.Original: The tallest variety of common hardwood tree. While an everyday view and trusted source of shadow for local villagers, Great Oak amazes foreigners with its imposing scale. Grows mostly on black soils, with thick roots reaching far underground. Its broad canopy easily reaches three or even four hundred feet diameter.
Rule.Raw: The tallest variety of common hardwood tree. While an everyday view and trusted source of shadow for local villagers, Great Oak amazes foreigners with its imposing scale. Grows mostly on black soils, with thick roots reaching far underground. Its broad canopy easily reaches three or even four hundred feet diameter.
Rule.Translated: La variedad más alta de un árbol frondoso común. Aunque es una vista cotidiana y una fuente fiable de sombra para los aldeanos locales, el gran roble asombra a los extranjeros por su imponente escala. Crece sobre todo en suelos negros, con gruesas raíces que llegan muy lejos bajo tierra. Su amplia copa alcanza fácilmente los cien metros de diámetro.

Rule.Original: An ancient schrat has been angered due to the cutting of great trees. Make sure to not anger it!
Rule.Raw: An ancient schrat has been angered due to the cutting of great trees. Make sure to not anger it!
Rule.Translated: La tala de grandes árboles ha enfurecido a un schrat antiguo. ¡Procura no irritarlo!

Rule.Original: The smallest of giant trees, iters are distinguished by a thick foliage and an abundance of viscous, sour fruits. During particularly scorching summers they start to form a new leaf terrace, hence iter is commonly used as a symbol of thermophilia and heat protection.
Rule.Raw: The smallest of giant trees, iters are distinguished by a thick foliage and an abundance of viscous, sour fruits. During particularly scorching summers they start to form a new leaf terrace, hence iter is commonly used as a symbol of thermophilia and heat protection.
Rule.Translated: El más pequeño de los árboles gigantes, el íter, se distingue por su espeso follaje y la abundancia de frutos viscosos y agrios. Durante los veranos especialmente abrasadores empiezan a formar una nueva terraza de hojas, de ahí que el íter se utilice habitualmente como símbolo de termofilia y protección contra el calor.

Rule.Original: An ancient schrat has been angered due to the cutting of great trees. Make sure to not anger it!
Rule.Raw: An ancient schrat has been angered due to the cutting of great trees. Make sure to not anger it!
Rule.Translated: La tala de grandes árboles ha enfurecido a un schrat antiguo. ¡Procura no irritarlo!

Rule.Original: Three hundred feet high giant cousins of cedars. Those trees are often called the last guardians of summer, evergreen stretches of hopeful colour, contrasting against the snow. Be wary when traversing a close-knit fir forest, as 10-inch cones can knock down even a knight in full armour.
Rule.Raw: Three hundred feet high giant cousins of cedars. Those trees are often called the last guardians of summer, evergreen stretches of hopeful colour, contrasting against the snow. Be wary when traversing a close-knit fir forest, as 10-inch cones can knock down even a knight in full armour.
Rule.Translated: Un pariente de los cedros de cien metros de altura. A estos árboles se les suele llamar los últimos guardianes del verano, extensiones de hoja perenne cuyo verdor esperanzador contrasta con la blancura de la nieve. Ten cuidado cuando atravieses un bosque de abetos, ya que las piñas del tamaño de un coco pueden derribar incluso a un caballero con armadura.

Rule.Original: A willow tree that has managed to live for thousands of years.
Rule.Raw: A willow tree that has managed to live for thousands of years.
Rule.Translated: Un sauce que ha conseguido vivir miles de años.

Rule.Original: An ancient schrat has been angered due to the cutting of great trees. Make sure to not anger it!
Rule.Raw: An ancient schrat has been angered due to the cutting of great trees. Make sure to not anger it!
Rule.Translated: La tala de grandes árboles ha enfurecido a un schrat antiguo. ¡Procura no irritarlo!

Rule.Original: A pale creature of the night, Alps invade the dreams of nearby creatures, trapping them in a nightmare and feeding on their negative emotions. Victims often report extreme signs of distress upon waking, and most travelers will not stay at a settlement without some kind of night watch due to the intense experiences often reported. Despite this, Alps tend to be easy prey with their frail bones, parchment-like skin, and decaying insides. Scholars remain unsure about the origins of these creatures, though some theorize an ancient curse may be responsible.
Rule.Raw: A pale creature of the night, Alps invade the dreams of nearby creatures, trapping them in a nightmare and feeding on their negative emotions. Victims often report extreme signs of distress upon waking, and most travelers will not stay at a settlement without some kind of night watch due to the intense experiences often reported. Despite this, Alps tend to be easy prey with their frail bones, parchment-like skin, and decaying insides. Scholars remain unsure about the origins of these creatures, though some theorize an ancient curse may be responsible.
Rule.Translated: Una criatura pálida de la noche. Los alps invaden los sueños de las criaturas cercanas, las atrapan en una pesadilla y se alimentan de sus emociones negativas. Las víctimas suelen despertar con síntomas de angustia extrema, y muchos viajeros se niegan a alojarse en asentamientos sin vigilancia nocturna debido a la intensidad de estas experiencias. Pese a ello, los alps suelen ser presas fáciles por sus huesos frágiles, su piel semejante al pergamino y sus entrañas en descomposición. Los eruditos desconocen su origen, aunque algunos creen que podrían ser fruto de una antigua maldición.

Rule.Original: Force target to hallucinate and experience nightmares
Rule.Raw: Force target to hallucinate and experience nightmares
Rule.Translated: Obliga al objetivo a sufrir alucinaciones y pesadillas.

Rule.Original: Hampshires are a robust breed of pigs and are typically gathered for its lean meat and taste. They are an efficient source of meat, and are easy to feed because they will eat almost anything.
Rule.Raw: Hampshires are a robust breed of pigs and are typically gathered for its lean meat and taste. They are an efficient source of meat, and are easy to feed because they will eat almost anything.
Rule.Translated: Los hampshires son una raza robusta de cerdos que suelen criarse por su carne magra y su sabor. Son una fuente eficiente de carne, fáciles de alimentar porque comen casi de todo.

Rule.Original: Gloucestershires thrive on pastures, they are excellent foragers and grazers which makes them known for their quality of meat. They are an efficient source of meat, and are easy to feed because they will eat almost anything.
Rule.Raw: Gloucestershires thrive on pastures, they are excellent foragers and grazers which makes them known for their quality of meat. They are an efficient source of meat, and are easy to feed because they will eat almost anything.
Rule.Translated: Los glucestershires son una variedad de cerdos que prosperan en los pastos, excelentes buscadores de comida y pastores, lo que hace que sean conocidos por la calidad de su carne. Son una fuente eficiente de carne, fáciles de alimentar porque comen casi de todo.

Rule.Original: This hairy omnivore is descended from escaped pigs and evolved for living in the northern forests.\n\nIts tusks make it a better fighter than its domesticated pig cousins. Unfortunately, it is too unruly to be trained in the most complex tasks.
Rule.Raw: This hairy omnivore is descended from escaped pigs and evolved for living in the northern forests.\n\nIts tusks make it a better fighter than its domesticated pig cousins. Unfortunately, it is too unruly to be trained in the most complex tasks.
Rule.Translated: Este peludo omnívoro desciende de cerdos huidos, y evolucionó para vivir en los bosques del norte.\n\nSus colmillos lo convierten en un mejor luchador que sus parientes domesticados. Por desgracia, es demasiado revoltoso para ser adiestrado en las tareas más complejas.

Rule.Original: A large domesticated ungulate, cows have been bred for millennia to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.
Rule.Raw: A large domesticated ungulate, cows have been bred for millennia to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.
Rule.Translated: Las vacas, un gran ungulado domesticado, han sido criadas durante milenios para producir grandes cantidades de leche, carne y cuero. Son criaturas excepcionalmente mansas que nunca buscarán venganza, no importa cuántas veces se les haga daño. La mayoría están tan adaptadas a la vida en las granjas que no podrían sobrevivir en libertad.

Rule.Original: A large domesticated ungulate, Angus have better marbling than a typical cow and are bred to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.
Rule.Raw: A large domesticated ungulate, Angus have better marbling than a typical cow and are bred to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.
Rule.Translated: Las reses angus, un gran ungulado domesticado, tienen un mejor veteado que una vaca típica y han sido criadas producir grandes cantidades de leche, carne y cuero. Son criaturas excepcionalmente mansas que nunca buscarán venganza, no importa cuántas veces se les haga daño. La mayoría están tan adaptadas a la vida en las granjas que no podrían sobrevivir en libertad.

Rule.Original: A fabled legend amongst commonfolk, a gigantic deer with with a body of a bear... or was it a bear with the horns of the deer, nevertheless, its maws does not discriminate for when the beast hungers for prey.\n\nA daer's caracass contain majestic antlers that can be recovered by butchering, as well as providing meat that gives a mood bonus.
Rule.Raw: A fabled legend amongst commonfolk, a gigantic deer with with a body of a bear... or was it a bear with the horns of the deer, nevertheless, its maws does not discriminate for when the beast hungers for prey.\n\nA daer's caracass contain majestic antlers that can be recovered by butchering, as well as providing meat that gives a mood bonus.
Rule.Translated: Una leyenda entre la gente común, un ciervo gigantesco con cuerpo de oso... O un oso con cuernos de ciervo... No obstante, sus fauces no discriminan cuando la bestia tiene hambre de presa.\n\nAl despiezarlo, además de poder obtener una carne que otorga una bonificación al estado de humor, puedes obtener una majestuosa y valiosa cornamenta.

Rule.Original: A vicious omnivore equipped with a deadly pair tusks that can gore threats. Dire boars regularly travel in herds and are feared to be dangerous once encountered.\n\nA dire boar's caracass contains tusks that can be recovered by butchering.
Rule.Raw: A vicious omnivore equipped with a deadly pair tusks that can gore threats. Dire boars regularly travel in herds and are feared to be dangerous once encountered.\n\nA dire boar's caracass contains tusks that can be recovered by butchering.
Rule.Translated: Una criatura omnívora y violenta, equipada con un par de colmillos mortales que pueden cornear a las amenazas. Estos jabalíes suelen viajar en manadas, y si te topas con una será mejor que te prepares para el peligro.\n\nEl cadáver de un jabalí gigante contiene colmillos que pueden recuperarse al despiezarlo.

Rule.Original: A subspecies of the great wolf, hardened by the relentless frosts of the north. Aggressive and resolute, they hunt in well-coordinated packs. In the olden days direwolves preferred domains of cold. Lack of prey during extremely hostile winters forced them to migrate to warmer regions, where they descend upon caravans and small settlements.
Rule.Raw: A subspecies of the great wolf, hardened by the relentless frosts of the north. Aggressive and resolute, they hunt in well-coordinated packs. In the olden days direwolves preferred domains of cold. Lack of prey during extremely hostile winters forced them to migrate to warmer regions, where they descend upon caravans and small settlements.
Rule.Translated: Una subespecie del gran lobo, endurecida por las implacables heladas del norte. Agresivos y decididos, cazan en manadas bien coordinadas. Antiguamente, los lobos gigante preferían los dominios del frío. La falta de presas durante inviernos extremadamente hostiles les obligó a emigrar a regiones más cálidas, donde emboscan caravanas y pequeños asentamientos.

Rule.Original: A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
Rule.Raw: A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
Rule.Translated: Un necrófago suele describirse como un cadáver reanimado con un apetito insaciable por la carne humana. Las leyendas afirman que siente una especial atracción por los lugares de enterramiento y los parajes desolados.

Rule.Original: A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
Rule.Raw: A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
Rule.Translated: Un necrófago suele describirse como un cadáver reanimado con un apetito insaciable por la carne humana. Las leyendas afirman que siente una especial atracción por los lugares de enterramiento y los parajes desolados.

Rule.Original: A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
Rule.Raw: A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
Rule.Translated: Un necrófago suele describirse como un cadáver reanimado con un apetito insaciable por la carne humana. Las leyendas afirman que siente una especial atracción por los lugares de enterramiento y los parajes desolados.

Rule.Original: A golem made out of iron
Rule.Raw: A golem made out of iron

Rule.Original: A golem made out of gold.
Rule.Raw: A golem made out of gold.

Rule.Original: A golem made out of steel.
Rule.Raw: A golem made out of steel.

Rule.Original: A golem made out of silver
Rule.Raw: A golem made out of silver

Rule.Original: Griffon is a majestic creature blending the features of an eagle and a lion, embodying strength, agility, and predatory instincts, making it a formidable presence in the wilds.
Rule.Raw: Griffon is a majestic creature blending the features of an eagle and a lion, embodying strength, agility, and predatory instincts, making it a formidable presence in the wilds.
Rule.Translated: El grifo es una criatura majestuosa que combina los rasgos de un águila y un león. Su fuerza, agilidad e instintos depredadores lo convierten en una presencia formidable en las tierras salvajes.

Rule.Original: A cunning predator, possessing features of felines and canids alike. An easily underestimated creature by those taking their peculiar chuckling gurgles as a playful sign of harmlessness. While a pack of hyenas might hesitate to attack a group of man in the open, they will show no mercy to a lonesome vagabond. Being eaten alive to the accompaniment of satisfied giggles must be a terrible end.
Rule.Raw: A cunning predator, possessing features of felines and canids alike. An easily underestimated creature by those taking their peculiar chuckling gurgles as a playful sign of harmlessness. While a pack of hyenas might hesitate to attack a group of man in the open, they will show no mercy to a lonesome vagabond. Being eaten alive to the accompaniment of satisfied giggles must be a terrible end.
Rule.Translated: Un depredador astuto, con rasgos tanto de felino como de cánido. Una criatura fácilmente subestimada por aquellos que toman sus peculiares carcajadas como una señal juguetona de inofensividad. Mientras que una manada de hienas puede dudar en atacar a un grupo de hombres en campo abierto, no tendrán piedad con un vagabundo solitario. Ser devorado vivo con el acompañamiento de risitas de satisfacción debe ser un final terrible.

Rule.Original: An usually large and vicious wasp, hunting prey in a collective swarm. Its thick shell and deadly stinger makes them dangerous when fighting. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.
Rule.Raw: An usually large and vicious wasp, hunting prey in a collective swarm. Its thick shell and deadly stinger makes them dangerous when fighting. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.
Rule.Translated: Una avispa generalmente grande y feroz que caza a sus presas en enjambres colectivos. Su grueso caparazón y su mortífero aguijón las hacen muy peligrosas. Una criatura eusocial que no puede reproducirse individualmente.

Rule.Original: The rox is a majestic, large creature with thick, luxurious fur and two impressive horns crowning its head. Known for its gentle demeanor, this enormous beast provides rich, creamy milk, while its fur, sheared and spun into fine yarn, is highly prized for its warmth and softness. The rox's imposing size, combined with its benevolent nature and distinctive horns, makes it a beloved and essential part of any settlement.
Rule.Raw: The rox is a majestic, large creature with thick, luxurious fur and two impressive horns crowning its head. Known for its gentle demeanor, this enormous beast provides rich, creamy milk, while its fur, sheared and spun into fine yarn, is highly prized for its warmth and softness. The rox's imposing size, combined with its benevolent nature and distinctive horns, makes it a beloved and essential part of any settlement.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme herbívoro pastor de origen desconocido. La mayoría de los heidruns tienen cuernos muy grandes que utilizan para defenderse de los agresores. Los valiosos cuernos de un heidrun muerto pueden recuperarse al despiezarlo.\n\nCriaturas inteligentes con relaciones sociales complejas, los heidrun pueden utilizarse como animales de carga o entrenarse para realizar las tareas más complejas. Viven mucho tiempo y se sabe que recuerdan acontecimientos y relaciones de muchas décadas antes.

Rule.Original: A gnarled tangle of branches, roots and mud, roughly shaped after a human being. Gifted with a twisted, sinister will, Schrats slowly shuffle through the undergrowth in search of the living. It’s said that Waldschrats relish the blood of intrusive lumberjacks and overzealous hunters.
Rule.Raw: A gnarled tangle of branches, roots and mud, roughly shaped after a human being. Gifted with a twisted, sinister will, Schrats slowly shuffle through the undergrowth in search of the living. It’s said that Waldschrats relish the blood of intrusive lumberjacks and overzealous hunters.
Rule.Translated: Una maraña retorcida de ramas, raíces y barro con una forma vagamente humana. Dotados de una voluntad perversa y siniestra, los schrats avanzan lentamente entre la maleza en busca de seres vivos. Se dice que los waldschrats disfrutan de la sangre de leñadores intrusos y cazadores demasiado entusiastas.

Rule.Original: A gnarled tangle of branches, roots and mud, roughly shaped after a human being. Gifted with a twisted, sinister will, Schrats slowly shuffle through the undergrowth in search of the living. It’s said that Waldschrats relish the blood of intrusive lumberjacks and overzealous hunters.
Rule.Raw: A gnarled tangle of branches, roots and mud, roughly shaped after a human being. Gifted with a twisted, sinister will, Schrats slowly shuffle through the undergrowth in search of the living. It’s said that Waldschrats relish the blood of intrusive lumberjacks and overzealous hunters.

Dotados de una voluntad perversa y siniestra, los schrats avanzan lentamente entre la maleza en busca de seres vivos. Se dice que los waldschrats disfrutan de la sangre de leñadores intrusos y cazadores demasiado entusiastas.

Rule.Original: Larger than their cousins and more resilient, large cobras prove to be deadlier and more agressive when it hunts for its pray. Their bite injects toxic venom into the victim.
Rule.Raw: Larger than their cousins and more resilient, large cobras prove to be deadlier and more agressive when it hunts for its pray. Their bite injects toxic venom into the victim.
Rule.Translated: Más grandes que sus parientes convencionales y más resistentes, las cobras gigantes resultan ser más mortíferas y agresivas cuando cazan a sus presas. Su mordedura inyecta veneno tóxico en la víctima.

Rule.Original: A venomous snake with a hood along its head that it rears when threatened. This giant creature dwells in caves and will not hesitate to protect its territory.
Rule.Raw: A venomous snake with a hood along its head that it rears when threatened. This giant creature dwells in caves and will not hesitate to protect its territory.
Rule.Translated: Una serpiente venenosa con una capucha a lo largo de la cabeza que echa hacia atrás cuando se siente amenazada. Esta criatura gigante habita en cuevas y no dudará en proteger su territorio.

Rule.Original: A primadorial snake, gigantic in size and old as the forlorn trees.
Rule.Raw: A primadorial snake, gigantic in size and old as the forlorn trees.
Rule.Translated: Una serpiente primigenia, de tamaño gigantesco y tan vieja como los árboles desamparados.

Rule.Original: One of the most enormous variants of snakes, this creature has a jaw capable of opening wide enough to swallow a man whole.
Rule.Raw: One of the most enormous variants of snakes, this creature has a jaw capable of opening wide enough to swallow a man whole.
Rule.Translated: Una de las variantes más enormes de las serpientes. Esta criatura tiene una mandíbula capaz de abrirse lo suficiente como para tragarse a un hombre entero.

Rule.Original: An enormous reptile, halfway between serpents and dragons. One of the few creatures truly incapable of feeling fear. Any daredevil who manages to get past the mighty yet nimble tail and pierce a hardy scale will be splashed with corrosive blood. Lindwurm blood is the most powerful acid known yet — dissolving even the thickest steel, eating through the flesh in seconds.
Rule.Raw: An enormous reptile, halfway between serpents and dragons. One of the few creatures truly incapable of feeling fear. Any daredevil who manages to get past the mighty yet nimble tail and pierce a hardy scale will be splashed with corrosive blood. Lindwurm blood is the most powerful acid known yet — dissolving even the thickest steel, eating through the flesh in seconds.
Rule.Translated: Un reptil enorme, a medio camino entre las serpientes y los dragones. Una de las pocas criaturas realmente incapaces de sentir miedo. Cualquier temerario que se atreva a pasar por delante de su poderosa pero ágil cola y perforar aunque sea una de sus resistentes escamas será salpicado con sangre corrosiva. La sangre de lindwurm es el ácido más poderoso conocido hasta ahora, capaz de disolver incluso el acero más grueso y deshacer la carne en segundos.

Rule.Original: Lumbering giant, easily the size of three men, and dwarfing even the tallest. It eats whole sheep for a snack and empties a pond to wash it down
Rule.Raw: Lumbering giant, easily the size of three men, and dwarfing even the tallest. It eats whole sheep for a snack and empties a pond to wash it down
Rule.Translated: Un gigante descomunal, del tamaño de tres hombres, que empequeñece incluso a los más altos. Se come ovejas enteras como aperitivo y vacía un estanque para acompañarlas.

Rule.Original: The Unhold is a towering giant, three times the size of a man, known for devouring sheep and draining ponds in a single gulp. Though tales paint them as destructive, they're not inherently malicious, preferring to scare off intruders with deafening roars rather than attacking. Usually solitary, Unholds are found alone or in small groups, fiercely defending their territory.
Rule.Raw: The Unhold is a towering giant, three times the size of a man, known for devouring sheep and draining ponds in a single gulp. Though tales paint them as destructive, they're not inherently malicious, preferring to scare off intruders with deafening roars rather than attacking. Usually solitary, Unholds are found alone or in small groups, fiercely defending their territory.
Rule.Translated: El unhold es un gigante imponente, tres veces mayor que un hombre, conocido por devorar ovejas y vaciar estanques de un solo trago. Aunque los relatos lo pintan como una criatura destructiva, no es malicioso por naturaleza y prefiere ahuyentar a los intrusos con rugidos ensordecedores antes que atacarlos. Normalmente solitarios, los unholds viven solos o en grupos pequeños y defienden ferozmente su territorio.

Rule.Original: The Unhold is a towering giant, three times the size of a man, known for devouring sheep and draining ponds in a single gulp. Usually solitary, Unholds are found alone or in small groups, fiercely defending their territory.

Aunque los relatos lo pintan como una criatura destructiva, no es malicioso por naturaleza y prefiere ahuyentar a los intrusos con rugidos ensordecedores antes que atacarlos. Normalmente solitarios, los unholds viven solos o en grupos pequeños y defienden ferozmente su territorio.

Rule.Original: The Webknecht is a large arachnid that lives in sizable colonies in the dark areas of forests throughout the world of Battle Brothers. It’s there that they spin their webs between trees to trap anything from bird to deer and between.
Rule.Raw: The Webknecht is a large arachnid that lives in sizable colonies in the dark areas of forests throughout the world of Battle Brothers. It’s there that they spin their webs between trees to trap anything from bird to deer and between.
Rule.Translated: El webknecht es un gran arácnido que vive en colonias numerosas en las zonas oscuras de los bosques del mundo de Battle Brothers. Allí teje telarañas entre los árboles para atrapar presas de todos los tamaños, desde aves hasta ciervos.

Rule.Original: I had the unfortunate experience of eating awful-quality cheese. The taste still lingers, haunting my thoughts.
Rule.Raw: I had the unfortunate experience of eating awful-quality cheese. The taste still lingers, haunting my thoughts.
Rule.Translated: He tenido la desgracia de comer un queso de calidad horrible. Su sabor aún persiste y atormenta mis pensamientos.

Rule.Original: I ate some poor-quality cheese. The taste was less than satisfying
Rule.Raw: I ate some poor-quality cheese. The taste was less than satisfying
Rule.Translated: He comido un queso de mala calidad. Su sabor no ha sido nada satisfactorio.

Rule.Original: The taste of the good-quality cheese you just ate lingers on your palate, bringing a smile to your face.
Rule.Raw: The taste of the good-quality cheese you just ate lingers on your palate, bringing a smile to your face.
Rule.Translated: El sabor del buen queso que acabo de comer permanece en mi paladar y me dibuja una sonrisa.

Rule.Original: The incredible taste of the excellent-quality cheese you just indulged in has left you in a state of pure culinary delight
Rule.Raw: The incredible taste of the excellent-quality cheese you just indulged in has left you in a state of pure culinary delight
Rule.Translated: El increíble sabor del excelente queso que acabo de disfrutar me ha dejado en un estado de puro deleite culinario.
he comido queso de calidad magistral

Rule.Original: The unparalleled taste of the masterwork-quality cheese you just savored has transported you to a realm of gustatory ecstasy.
Rule.Raw: The unparalleled taste of the masterwork-quality cheese you just savored has transported you to a realm of gustatory ecstasy.
Rule.Translated: El sabor incomparable del queso de calidad magistral que acabo de saborear me ha transportado a un mundo de éxtasis gastronómico.

Rule.Original: The divine taste of the legendary-quality cheese you just experienced has forever altered your perception of culinary perfection.
Rule.Raw: The divine taste of the legendary-quality cheese you just experienced has forever altered your perception of culinary perfection.
Rule.Translated: El sabor divino del queso legendario que acabo de probar ha cambiado para siempre mi percepción de la perfección culinaria.

Rule.Original: Look at these awesome runes I have.
Rule.Raw: Look at these awesome runes I have.
Rule.Translated: Mira qué runas tan increíbles tengo.

Rule.Original: I had the unfortunate experience of drinking awful-quality wine. The taste still lingers, haunting my thoughts.
Rule.Raw: I had the unfortunate experience of drinking awful-quality wine. The taste still lingers, haunting my thoughts.
Rule.Translated: He tenido la desgracia de beber un vino de calidad horrible. Su sabor aún persiste y atormenta mis pensamientos.

Rule.Original: I drank some poor-quality wine. The taste was less than satisfying
Rule.Raw: I drank some poor-quality wine. The taste was less than satisfying
Rule.Translated: He bebido un vino de mala calidad. Su sabor no ha sido nada satisfactorio.

Rule.Original: The taste of the good-quality wine you just drank lingers on your paldrank, bringing a smile to your face.
Rule.Raw: The taste of the good-quality wine you just drank lingers on your paldrank, bringing a smile to your face.
Rule.Translated: El sabor del buen vino que acabo de beber permanece en mi paladar y me dibuja una sonrisa.

Rule.Original: The incredible taste of the excellent-quality wine you just indulged in has left you in a stdrank of pure culinary delight
Rule.Raw: The incredible taste of the excellent-quality wine you just indulged in has left you in a stdrank of pure culinary delight
Rule.Translated: El increíble sabor del excelente vino que acabo de disfrutar me ha dejado en un estado de puro deleite culinario.

Rule.Original: The unparalleled taste of the masterwork-quality wine you just savored has transported you to a realm of gustatory ecstasy.
Rule.Raw: The unparalleled taste of the masterwork-quality wine you just savored has transported you to a realm of gustatory ecstasy.
Rule.Translated: El sabor incomparable del vino de calidad magistral que acabo de saborear me ha transportado a un mundo de éxtasis gastronómico.

Rule.Original: The divine taste of the legendary-quality wine you just experienced has forever altered your perception of culinary perfection.
Rule.Raw: The divine taste of the legendary-quality wine you just experienced has forever altered your perception of culinary perfection.
Rule.Translated: El sabor divino del vino legendario que acabo de probar ha cambiado para siempre mi percepción de la perfección culinaria.

Rule.Original: A berry for griffons! Such profound sweetness!
Rule.Raw: A berry for griffons! Such profound sweetness!
Rule.Translated: ¡Una baya para grifos! ¡Qué dulzura tan intensa!

Rule.Original: Nothing like good Ale to keep the horrors out of my mind.
Rule.Raw: Nothing like good Ale to keep the horrors out of my mind.
Rule.Translated: Nada como una buena cerveza para apartar los horrores de mi mente.

Rule.Original: Warm and sweet, it's distinct tone of honey is somewhat satisfying.
Rule.Raw: Warm and sweet, it's distinct tone of honey is somewhat satisfying.
Rule.Translated: Cálida y dulce, su característico toque de miel resulta bastante agradable.

Rule.Original: I ate a Hearty Stew, a delightful meal that warms my body.
Rule.Raw: I ate a Hearty Stew, a delightful meal that warms my body.
Rule.Translated: He comido un guiso sustancioso, una comida deliciosa que me calienta el cuerpo.

Rule.Original: I ate a Weak Stew, a delightful meal that warms my body.
Rule.Raw: I ate a Weak Stew, a delightful meal that warms my body.
Rule.Translated: He comido un guiso ligero, una comida deliciosa que me calienta el cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A Rox steak! Its fatty meat melts in your mouth while the sauce gives off a wonderful kick!
Rule.Raw: A Rox steak! Its fatty meat melts in your mouth while the sauce gives off a wonderful kick!
Rule.Translated: ¡Un filete de rox! Su carne grasa se deshace en la boca y la salsa le da un toque maravilloso.
ingestión de pastel de bayas de grifo

Rule.Original: A pie baked for griffons! Such profound aroma inexorably satisfies one's tongue!
Rule.Raw: A pie baked for griffons! Such profound aroma inexorably satisfies one's tongue!
Rule.Translated: ¡Una tarta horneada para grifos! ¡Su intenso aroma satisface irresistiblemente el paladar!

Rule.Original: That smoked meat had a rustic flavour to it.
Rule.Raw: That smoked meat had a rustic flavour to it.
Rule.Translated: Esa carne ahumada tenía un sabor rústico.

Rule.Original: That meat was incredibly dry and tasteless, I am parched.
Rule.Raw: That meat was incredibly dry and tasteless, I am parched.
Rule.Translated: Esa carne estaba increíblemente seca e insípida. Me muero de sed.

Rule.Original: A chunk of bread filled with hearty soup—I’m not in love, but I do feel my strength rejuvenated.
Rule.Raw: A chunk of bread filled with hearty soup—I’m not in love, but I do feel my strength rejuvenated.
Rule.Translated: Un trozo de pan relleno de una sopa sustanciosa. No me entusiasma, pero siento que he recuperado las fuerzas.
he comido salchichas a la parrilla

Rule.Original: These sausages harbor a savory and smoky flavor!
Rule.Raw: These sausages harbor a savory and smoky flavor!
Rule.Translated: ¡Estas salchichas tienen un sabor delicioso y ahumado!

Rule.Original: What a tasty treat! Who knew that apples could be made even sweeter?
Rule.Raw: What a tasty treat! Who knew that apples could be made even sweeter?
Rule.Translated: ¡Qué delicia! ¿Quién iba a pensar que las manzanas podían ser aún más dulces?

Rule.Original: The stew was brimmed with savory elements. It nourished my body!
Rule.Raw: The stew was brimmed with savory elements. It nourished my body!
Rule.Translated: El guiso estaba repleto de ingredientes sabrosos. ¡Me ha nutrido el cuerpo!

Rule.Original: That bowl of mashed potato had an enjoyable creamy taste.
Rule.Raw: That bowl of mashed potato had an enjoyable creamy taste.
Rule.Translated: Ese cuenco de puré de patatas tenía un agradable sabor cremoso.
he comido queso a la parrilla

Rule.Original: I ate a gooey, tasty, luxurious slab of grilled cheese.
Rule.Raw: I ate a gooey, tasty, luxurious slab of grilled cheese.
Rule.Translated: He comido una deliciosa y exquisita porción de queso fundido a la parrilla.

Rule.Original: I ate a savory pie of egg and meat. Yum!
Rule.Raw: I ate a savory pie of egg and meat. Yum!
Rule.Translated: He comido un pastel salado de huevo y carne. ¡Qué rico!

Rule.Original: I ate a stack of sweet, thick pancakes with syrup. Tasty!
Rule.Raw: I ate a stack of sweet, thick pancakes with syrup. Tasty!
Rule.Translated: He comido una pila de tortitas dulces y gruesas con sirope. ¡Qué rico!
he comido sopa invernal de lentejas

Rule.Original: I ate a soothing soup of lentils and spices. A delightful warmth courses through my body.
Rule.Raw: I ate a soothing soup of lentils and spices. A delightful warmth courses through my body.
Rule.Translated: He comido una reconfortante sopa de lentejas y especias. Una agradable calidez recorre mi cuerpo.

Rule.Original: I ate a rich soup of minced mushrooms. So earthy, so good!
Rule.Raw: I ate a rich soup of minced mushrooms. So earthy, so good!
Rule.Translated: He comido una rica sopa de setas picadas. ¡Qué sabor a tierra tan delicioso!

Rule.Original: I ate an omelette filled with tomatoes. Juicy, yet savory!
Rule.Raw: I ate an omelette filled with tomatoes. Juicy, yet savory!
Rule.Translated: He comido una tortilla rellena de tomates. ¡Jugosa y sabrosa!

Rule.Original: I ate a savory stew of veggies and greens. Hearty, and healthy.
Rule.Raw: I ate a savory stew of veggies and greens. Hearty, and healthy.
Rule.Translated: He comido un sabroso guiso de hortalizas y verduras. Sustancioso y saludable.

Rule.Original: Sweet, yet slightly spicy. What a delicious pie!
Rule.Raw: Sweet, yet slightly spicy. What a delicious pie!
Rule.Translated: Dulce, pero ligeramente especiada. ¡Qué tarta tan deliciosa!

Rule.Original: The right touch of sweetness on a thick and filling biscuit. Does anyone have some ale to wash this down with?
Rule.Raw: The right touch of sweetness on a thick and filling biscuit. Does anyone have some ale to wash this down with?
Rule.Translated: El punto justo de dulzor en una galleta gruesa y saciante. ¿Alguien tiene cerveza para acompañarla?
he comido brochetas a la parrilla

Rule.Original: Easy to eat and delicious. What else is to say about meat on a stick?
Rule.Raw: Easy to eat and delicious. What else is to say about meat on a stick?
Rule.Translated: Fáciles de comer y deliciosas. ¿Qué más se puede pedir a un poco de carne en un palo?

Rule.Original: I ate a thick soup of pumpkin and spice. A delightful warmth courses through my body.
Rule.Raw: I ate a thick soup of pumpkin and spice. A delightful warmth courses through my body.
Rule.Translated: He comido una sopa espesa de calabaza y especias. Una agradable calidez recorre mi cuerpo.

Rule.Original: The tender steak melts with each bite, and the rich broth elevates the dish’s flavor. If I could eat anything, it would always be steak with wine."
Rule.Raw: The tender steak melts with each bite, and the rich broth elevates the dish’s flavor. If I could eat anything, it would always be steak with wine."
Rule.Translated: El tierno filete se deshace con cada bocado y el rico caldo realza el sabor del plato. Si pudiera comer cualquier cosa, siempre elegiría filete al vino.
he comido judías hervidas con cebolla

Rule.Original: It’s bean and onion soup. I’m full and feel recharged, but the taste is forgettable.
Rule.Raw: It’s bean and onion soup. I’m full and feel recharged, but the taste is forgettable.
Rule.Translated: Es una sopa de judías y cebolla. Estoy lleno y siento que he recuperado la energía, pero el sabor no tiene nada especial.

Rule.Original: The way the cheese melts in the spiced broth makes me want to dance! The only negative is that people are watching.
Rule.Raw: The way the cheese melts in the spiced broth makes me want to dance! The only negative is that people are watching.
Rule.Translated: ¡La forma en que el queso se funde en el caldo especiado me da ganas de bailar! Lo único malo es que hay gente mirando.
he comido un cuenco de bazofia

Rule.Original: I had to eat a disgusting, tasteless meal. I know it keeps you alive, but nobody wants to swallow that glop.
Rule.Raw: I had to eat a disgusting, tasteless meal. I know it keeps you alive, but nobody wants to swallow that glop.
Rule.Translated: He tenido que comer una comida asquerosa e insípida. Sé que te mantiene con vida, pero nadie quiere tragarse esa plasta.
he comido un cuenco de fondue

Rule.Original: I ate a delicious cheesey soup.
Rule.Raw: I ate a delicious cheesey soup.
Rule.Translated: He comido una deliciosa sopa de queso.

Rule.Original: Indulgent and warmly spiced. What a delightful slice of cake!
Rule.Raw: Indulgent and warmly spiced. What a delightful slice of cake!
Rule.Translated: Deliciosa y aromatizada con especias cálidas. ¡Qué porción de tarta tan agradable!

Rule.Original: Tangy and refreshing, with just the right amount of sweetness. What a delightful treat!
Rule.Raw: Tangy and refreshing, with just the right amount of sweetness. What a delightful treat!
Rule.Translated: Ácida y refrescante, con la cantidad justa de dulzor. ¡Qué delicia!

Rule.Original: I enjoyed reading in a decent library.
Rule.Raw: I enjoyed reading in a decent library.
Rule.Translated: He disfrutado leyendo en una biblioteca aceptable.

Rule.Original: I enjoyed reading in a nice library.
Rule.Raw: I enjoyed reading in a nice library.
Rule.Translated: He disfrutado leyendo en una biblioteca agradable.

Rule.Original: I had a great time reading in an impressive library.
Rule.Raw: I had a great time reading in an impressive library.
Rule.Translated: Me lo he pasado muy bien leyendo en una biblioteca impresionante.

Rule.Original: I had a great time reading in a very impressive library.
Rule.Raw: I had a great time reading in a very impressive library.
Rule.Translated: Me lo he pasado muy bien leyendo en una biblioteca muy impresionante.

Rule.Original: I had a great time reading in an extremely impressive library. I could stay there forever.
Rule.Raw: I had a great time reading in an extremely impressive library. I could stay there forever.
Rule.Translated: Me lo he pasado muy bien leyendo en una biblioteca extremadamente impresionante. Podría quedarme allí para siempre.

Rule.Original: I had a great time reading in an unbelievably impressive library. I could stay there forever.
Rule.Raw: I had a great time reading in an unbelievably impressive library. I could stay there forever.
Rule.Translated: Me lo he pasado muy bien leyendo en una biblioteca increíblemente impresionante. Podría quedarme allí para siempre.

Rule.Original: I had a great time reading in a wonderful library. I could stay there forever.
Rule.Raw: I had a great time reading in a wonderful library. I could stay there forever.
Rule.Translated: Me lo he pasado muy bien leyendo en una biblioteca maravillosa. Podría quedarme allí para siempre.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is a formidable fighter. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to effectively handle a weapon and take blows.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is a formidable fighter. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to effectively handle a weapon and take blows.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nombreDef] es {PAWN_gender ? un luchador : una luchadora} formidable. Sabe bien cómo manejar eficazmente un arma y encajar golpes.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is a veteran. [PAWN_pronoun] has experienced countless of horrifying battles enough to break a common man.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is a veteran. [PAWN_pronoun] has experienced countless of horrifying battles enough to break a common man.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nombreDef] es {PAWN_gender ? un veterano : una veterana}. Ha experimentado un sinfín de horribles batallas, las suficientes como para poder vencer a cualquier persona común.

Rule.Original: Hides will need to be processed before they can be used.\nUse a tanning rack to create leather.\nA drying rack can be used to create weaker rawhide.
Rule.Raw: Hides will need to be processed before they can be used.\nUse a tanning rack to create leather.\nA drying rack can be used to create weaker rawhide.
Rule.Translated: Las pieles deben procesarse antes de poder utilizarse.\nUsa un bastidor de curtido para obtener cuero.\nUn bastidor de secado permite obtener piel cruda, de menor resistencia.

Rule.Original: Logs will need to be cut into planks before they can be used for more complex uses.\nA trestle can be used to cut logs into planks.
Rule.Raw: Logs will need to be cut into planks before they can be used for more complex uses.\nA trestle can be used to cut logs into planks.
Rule.Translated: Los troncos deben cortarse en tablones antes de utilizarlos para trabajos más complejos.\nUn caballete permite cortar los troncos en tablones.

Rule.Original: Explorer's Table can used to find quest locations by using torn notes as fuel.\nThe more objects linked to the table the higher level of locations can be searched for.
Rule.Raw: Explorer's Table can used to find quest locations by using torn notes as fuel.\nThe more objects linked to the table the higher level of locations can be searched for.
Rule.Translated: La mesa del explorador permite encontrar lugares de misión utilizando notas rasgadas como combustible.\nCuantos más objetos estén enlazados a la mesa, mayor será el nivel de los lugares que se pueden buscar.

Rule.Original: Some research require schematics placed inside a bookshelf to start research.\nSchematics can be found in quest locations from explorer's table or very rarely from traders.
Rule.Raw: Some research require schematics placed inside a bookshelf to start research.\nSchematics can be found in quest locations from explorer's table or very rarely from traders.
Rule.Translated: Algunas investigaciones requieren colocar sus planos en una estantería para poder iniciarse.\nLos planos pueden encontrarse en lugares de misión descubiertos con la mesa del explorador o, muy raramente, en manos de comerciantes.

Rule.Original: Some monsters have a fast healing factor called "regeneration".\nRegeneration can be turned off with the use of fire.
Rule.Raw: Some monsters have a fast healing factor called "regeneration".\nRegeneration can be turned off with the use of fire.
Rule.Translated: Algunos monstruos tienen una rápida capacidad de curación llamada «regeneración».\nLa regeneración puede desactivarse usando fuego.
extraer tierra en el punto de excavación

Rule.Original: Accesses ground water which can be pumped by water pumps. The presence of sewage or other pollution will reduce water quality and can cause contamination.
Rule.Raw: Accesses ground water which can be pumped by water pumps. The presence of sewage or other pollution will reduce water quality and can cause contamination.
Rule.Translated: Accede al agua subterránea, que puede extraerse mediante bombas. La presencia de aguas residuales u otros contaminantes reduce la calidad del agua y puede contaminarla.

Rule.Original: Produces 2000 heating units for piped radiators and hot water tanks. Heats the room and adjacent baths. Requires wood logs for fuel.
Rule.Raw: Produces 2000 heating units for piped radiators and hot water tanks. Heats the room and adjacent baths. Requires wood logs for fuel.
Rule.Translated: Produce 2000 unidades de calefacción para radiadores conectados por tuberías y depósitos de agua caliente. Calienta la habitación y los baños adyacentes. Requiere troncos como combustible.

Rule.Original: Stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.
Rule.Raw: Stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.
Rule.Translated: Almacena agua caliente corriente para duchas y baños. Conéctalo a cualquier caldera para calentarla.

Rule.Original: Eliminates fecal sludge by burning it as fuel. Can also be used for disposing of corpses or other detritus. Colonists may become sick if they spend too long near burning waste.
Rule.Raw: Eliminates fecal sludge by burning it as fuel. Can also be used for disposing of corpses or other detritus. Colonists may become sick if they spend too long near burning waste.
Rule.Translated: Elimina los lodos fecales quemándolos como combustible. También puede utilizarse para deshacerse de cadáveres y otros residuos. Los colonos pueden enfermar si pasan demasiado tiempo cerca de los desechos en combustión.

Rule.Original: Slowly cleans sewage over time. Sewage is directed to septic tanks first. If it reaches full capacity, excess sewage is sent to sewage outlets.
Rule.Raw: Slowly cleans sewage over time. Sewage is directed to septic tanks first. If it reaches full capacity, excess sewage is sent to sewage outlets.
Rule.Translated: Depura lentamente las aguas residuales. Estas se envían primero a las fosas sépticas. Cuando alcanzan su capacidad máxima, el exceso se dirige a las salidas de aguas residuales.

Rule.Original: Dried fish to preserve and prolong shelf life for later use as an ingredient in meals.
Rule.Raw: Dried fish to preserve and prolong shelf life for later use as an ingredient in meals.
Rule.Translated: Pescado seco para conservarlo y prolongar su duración, para usarlo después como ingrediente en comidas.

Rule.Original: Dried meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Raw: Dried meat to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Translated: Carne seca para conservarla y prolongar su duración.

Rule.Original: Make sweetrolls out of honey and eggs.
Rule.Raw: Make sweetrolls out of honey and eggs.
Rule.Translated: Elabora bollos dulces con miel y huevos.

Rule.Original: Make sweetrolls out of honey and eggs.
Rule.Raw: Make sweetrolls out of honey and eggs.
Rule.Translated: Elabora bollos dulces con miel y huevos.

Rule.Original: Smoked fish to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Raw: Smoked fish to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Translated: Pescado ahumado para conservarlo y prolongar su duración.

Rule.Original: Smoked fish to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Raw: Smoked fish to preserve and prolong shelf life.
Rule.Translated: Pescado ahumado para conservarlo y prolongar su duración.

Rule.Original: Mech that is able to repair other mechs.
Rule.Raw: Mech that is able to repair other mechs.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide capaz de reparar otros mecanoides.

Rule.Original: Shortcuts for Choose Your Outfit dialog.
Rule.Raw: Shortcuts for Choose Your Outfit dialog.
Rule.Translated: Atajos para el diálogo de Choose Your Outfit.
Abrir el diálogo de Choose Your Outfit

Rule.Original: Efficiency is increased do to the high workspeed of the producer mech.
Rule.Raw: Efficiency is increased do to the high workspeed of the producer mech.
Rule.Translated: La eficiencia aumenta gracias a la elevada velocidad de trabajo del mecanoide productor.

Rule.Original: These goblins have congreated together with various other races to form a collection of peaceful communities. They've found inner peace through their abundant consumption of various chemical substances, which has become the primary foundation of their society and culture.
Rule.Raw: These goblins have congreated together with various other races to form a collection of peaceful communities. They've found inner peace through their abundant consumption of various chemical substances, which has become the primary foundation of their society and culture.
Rule.Translated: Estos goblins se han reunido con miembros de diversas razas para formar varias comunidades pacíficas. Han encontrado la paz interior mediante el consumo abundante de distintas sustancias químicas, que se ha convertido en el principal fundamento de su sociedad y cultura.

Rule.Original: Darkness is a underkins best friend, and its rare you'll find one stepping foot outside their hovel. When they do emerge from the depths of the world, they do so in large raiding parties, typically attacking during the night.
Rule.Raw: Darkness is a underkins best friend, and its rare you'll find one stepping foot outside their hovel. When they do emerge from the depths of the world, they do so in large raiding parties, typically attacking during the night.
Rule.Translated: La oscuridad es la mejor amiga de un underkin y rara vez se ve a uno fuera de su madriguera. Cuando emergen de las profundidades del mundo lo hacen en grandes grupos de asalto, normalmente durante la noche.
