Rule.Original: Underkin are mischiveous race of cave dwellers, finding refuge in the dank and dark corners of the world. They are short and thin, with large crude ears potruding out from the sides of their heads. While their short stature makes them naturally weaker then other races, they make up for it in numbers. If you happen to find a lone underkin, don't be fooled, as there are likely many, many more to be found nearby.
Rule.Raw: Underkin are mischiveous race of cave dwellers, finding refuge in the dank and dark corners of the world. They are short and thin, with large crude ears potruding out from the sides of their heads. While their short stature makes them naturally weaker then other races, they make up for it in numbers. If you happen to find a lone underkin, don't be fooled, as there are likely many, many more to be found nearby.
Rule.Translated: Los underkin son una raza traviesa de habitantes de las cavernas que encuentra refugio en los rincones húmedos y oscuros del mundo. Son bajos y delgados, con grandes orejas toscas que sobresalen a ambos lados de la cabeza. Aunque su pequeña estatura los hace naturalmente más débiles que otras razas, compensan esa desventaja con su número. Si encuentras a un underkin solitario, no te confíes: probablemente haya muchos, muchos más cerca.

Rule.Original: Build storage containers suitable for a neolithic-era colony with ways of protecting goods from the elements, organizing resources and display weapons.
Rule.Raw: Build storage containers suitable for a neolithic-era colony with ways of protecting goods from the elements, organizing resources and display weapons.
Rule.Translated: Construye contenedores de almacenamiento adecuados para una colonia de la época neolítica, con formas de proteger los bienes de los elementos, organizar los recursos y exponer las armas.

Rule.Original: Build storage containers suitable for a medieval-era colony with methods of organizing food and resources in a more efficient manner.
Rule.Raw: Build storage containers suitable for a medieval-era colony with methods of organizing food and resources in a more efficient manner.
Rule.Translated: Construye contenedores de almacenamiento adecuados para una colonia de la época medieval con métodos para organizar los alimentos y los recursos de forma más eficiente.

Rule.Original: Build tough storage containers suitable for a industrial-era colony with methods for efficiently storing and organizing large quantities of resources using modern technologies.
Rule.Raw: Build tough storage containers suitable for a industrial-era colony with methods for efficiently storing and organizing large quantities of resources using modern technologies.
Rule.Translated: Construye resistentes contenedores de almacenamiento adecuados para una colonia de la era industrial con métodos para almacenar y organizar eficazmente grandes cantidades de recursos utilizando tecnologías modernas.

Rule.Original: Build advanced storage containers suitable for spacefaring colonies and vessels with methods for efficiently storing and organizing large quantities of resources while using the least amount of space.
Rule.Raw: Build advanced storage containers suitable for spacefaring colonies and vessels with methods for efficiently storing and organizing large quantities of resources while using the least amount of space.
Rule.Translated: Construye contenedores de almacenamiento avanzados aptos para colonias y naves espaciales con métodos para almacenar y organizar eficazmente grandes cantidades de recursos utilizando el mínimo espacio.

A specialized storage container designed to hold food for feeding your colony animals. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 18 Stack per tile: 9
Allowed items: Hay, Kibble

Objetos permitidos: Medicina, Materia vegetal, Drogas, Neutroamina, Partes del cuerpo

Rule.Original: Bound by a strict code of honor and tradition, these draconid govern their territories with meticulous order, ensuring justice, fairness, and adherence to ancient laws while upholding their responsibilities as protectors of the land.
Rule.Raw: Bound by a strict code of honor and tradition, these draconid govern their territories with meticulous order, ensuring justice, fairness, and adherence to ancient laws while upholding their responsibilities as protectors of the land.
Rule.Translated: Ligados por un estricto código de honor y tradición, estos dracónidos gobiernan sus territorios con un orden meticuloso, procurando justicia, equidad y respeto por las antiguas leyes mientras cumplen con su deber como protectores de la tierra.

Rule.Original: These draklings are a mischievous group of scoundrels who delight in sowing chaos across the rim with their unpredictable raids and causing trouble wherever they scurry.
Rule.Raw: These draklings are a mischievous group of scoundrels who delight in sowing chaos across the rim with their unpredictable raids and causing trouble wherever they scurry.
Rule.Translated: Estos drakelings son un grupo travieso de bribones que disfrutan sembrando el caos por el confín con incursiones impredecibles y causando problemas allí por donde pasan.

Rule.Original: Draconids are ravenous beasts that lumber through their territory, their movements ponderous and methodical as they scavenge for sustenance, their hunger driving them to patiently await prey with relentless determination despite their lethargy.
Rule.Raw: Draconids are ravenous beasts that lumber through their territory, their movements ponderous and methodical as they scavenge for sustenance, their hunger driving them to patiently await prey with relentless determination despite their lethargy.
Rule.Translated: Los dracónidos son bestias voraces que recorren pesadamente su territorio con movimientos lentos y metódicos mientras buscan alimento. Su hambre los impulsa a aguardar a sus presas con una determinación implacable pese a su aparente letargo.

Rule.Original: Draklings are the stunted offshoot of their larger draconid cousins. They're cunning and resourceful, and despite their small size, they excel at using their intelligence and ingenuity to survive and thrive in hostile environments, devising clever traps and intricate tunnel systems to outwit their enemies.
Rule.Raw: Draklings are the stunted offshoot of their larger draconid cousins. They're cunning and resourceful, and despite their small size, they excel at using their intelligence and ingenuity to survive and thrive in hostile environments, devising clever traps and intricate tunnel systems to outwit their enemies.
Rule.Translated: Los drakelings son una rama menuda de sus primos dracónidos de mayor tamaño. Son astutos e ingeniosos y, pese a su pequeño tamaño, destacan por utilizar su inteligencia y creatividad para sobrevivir y prosperar en entornos hostiles, ideando trampas ingeniosas y complejos sistemas de túneles para superar a sus enemigos.

Rule.Original: A human-sized mechanoid designed to take care of babies. Their upper body is covered in warm heating apparatuses to comfort newborns, and its chest simulates a human heartbeat. The Surrogate can feed children with baby food, play with them and fight fires. It can attack with a small slugthrower in case of an emergency.
Rule.Raw: A human-sized mechanoid designed to take care of babies. Their upper body is covered in warm heating apparatuses to comfort newborns, and its chest simulates a human heartbeat. The Surrogate can feed children with baby food, play with them and fight fires. It can attack with a small slugthrower in case of an emergency.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide de tamaño humano diseñado para cuidar bebés. La parte superior de su cuerpo está cubierta de dispositivos calefactores para reconfortar a los recién nacidos, y su pecho simula un latido humano. Puede alimentar a los niños con comida para bebés, jugar con ellos y apagar incendios. En una emergencia puede atacar con un pequeño lanzaproyectiles.

Rule.Original: Tier 1: Investigation into the production of the Simple Robotic Matrix units to make robots with workskill 4.
Rule.Raw: Tier 1: Investigation into the production of the Simple Robotic Matrix units used in producing Amateur-class robots. Unlocks Basic robotic research (Tier 2) and the Simple Robotic Matrix.
Rule.Translated: Nivel 1: investigación sobre la producción de matrices robóticas simples para fabricar robots con habilidad de trabajo 4.

Rule.Original: Tier 2: Investigation into the production of the Basic Robotic Matrix units to make robots with workskill 8.
Rule.Raw: Tier 2: Investigation into the production of the Basic Robotic Matrix units used in producing Professional-class robots. Unlocks Intermediate robotic research (Tier 3) and the Basic Robotic Matrix unit. All robots in this tier are faster and less flammable than the previous.
Rule.Translated: Nivel 2: investigación sobre la producción de matrices robóticas básicas para fabricar robots con habilidad de trabajo 8.

Rule.Original: Tier 3: Investigation into the production of the Intermediate Robotic Matrix units to make robots with workskill 13.
Rule.Raw: Tier 3: Investigation into the production of the Intermediate Robotic Matrix units used in producing Master-class robots. Unlocks advanced robotic research (Tier 4) and the Intermediate Robotic Matrix unit. All robots in this tier are faster and less flammable than the previous.
Rule.Translated: Nivel 3: investigación sobre la producción de matrices robóticas intermedias para fabricar robots con habilidad de trabajo 13.

Rule.Original: Tier 4: Investigation into the production of the Advanced Robotic Matrix units to make robots with workskill 16.
Rule.Raw: Tier 4: Investigation into the production of the Advanced Robotic Matrix units used in producing System-Master-class robots. Unlocks the Advanced Robotic Matrix unit. All robots in this tier are faster and less flammable than the previous.
Rule.Translated: Nivel 4: investigación sobre la producción de matrices robóticas avanzadas para fabricar robots con habilidad de trabajo 16.

Rule.Original: Tier 5: Break the boundaries set by existing levels of technology, understandings of logic, and the very concepts of causation. Our scientific horizons are becoming a lot more timey-wimey. Investigation into the production of the Anti-Logic Robotic Matrix units to make robots with workskill 20.
Rule.Raw: Tier 5: Break the boundaries set by existing levels of technology, understandings of logic, and the very concepts of causation. Our scientific horizons are becoming a lot more timey-wimey.
Rule.Translated: Nivel 5: rompe los límites impuestos por los niveles tecnológicos existentes, nuestra comprensión de la lógica y los propios conceptos de causalidad. Nuestros horizontes científicos se vuelven mucho más extraños. Investigación sobre la producción de matrices robóticas de antilógica para fabricar robots con habilidad de trabajo 20.

Rule.Original: Tier 0:\nInvestigation into the easiest principles of robotics and automation.
Rule.Raw: Tier 0:\nInvestigation into the easiest principles of robotics and automation.
Rule.Translated: Nivel 0:\nInvestigación de los principios más básicos de robótica y automatización.

Rule.Original: Production of cleaning robots. The Hauling and Cleaning bots are faster than all other bots of the same tier.
Rule.Raw: Production of cleaning robots. The Hauling and Cleaning bots are faster than all other bots of the same tier.
Rule.Translated: Producción de robots de limpieza. Los robots transportistas y limpiadores son más rápidos que los demás robots del mismo nivel.

Rule.Raw: Production of Hauling robots. The Hauling and Cleaning bots are faster than all other bots of the same tier.
Rule.Translated: Producción de robots transportistas. Los robots transportistas y limpiadores son más rápidos que los demás robots del mismo nivel.

Rule.Original: Delve into the power of automation with tiered robots. While you can start with simple electronics, you'll need to master greater technologies before you can begin work on more advanced tiers of robotics.
Rule.Raw: Delve into the power of automation with tiered robots. While you can start with simple electronics, you'll need to master greater technologies before you can begin work on more advanced tiers of robotics.
Rule.Translated: Adéntrate en el poder de la automatización con robots de distintos niveles. Aunque puedes empezar con electrónica sencilla, tendrás que dominar tecnologías superiores antes de trabajar con niveles más avanzados de robótica.

Rule.Original: Steel grate tiles, for that spaceship workshop look. They are very quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Raw: Steel grate tiles, for that spaceship workshop look. They are very quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Translated: Unas baldosas de rejilla de acero, dignas del taller de una nave espacial. Son muy fáciles de limpiar y otorgan un plus de limpieza, ideal para su uso en entornos médicos.

Rule.Original: For a futuristic but royal look, silver grate tiles fit perfectly into luxurious workshops or armories. They are very quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: For a futuristic but royal look, silver grate tiles fit perfectly into luxurious workshops or armories. They are very quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Para un aspecto futurista pero regio, las baldosas de rejilla plateadas encajan perfectamente en talleres o armerías de lujo. Son muy fáciles de limpiar y otorgan un plus de limpieza.

Rule.Original: For idiotic and overbearing extravagance, nothing beats gold grate tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them. They are very quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: For idiotic and overbearing extravagance, nothing beats gold grate tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them. They are very quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Nada mejor que unas baldosas de rejilla de oro para sugerir una extravagancia de lo más descerebrada y prepotente. Son excepcionalmente caras y bonitas, y la gente pensará que eres excepcionalmente esnob si vives con ellas. Son muy fáciles de limpiar y otorgan un plus de limpieza.

Rule.Original: Steel studded tiles, for that spaceship look. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Raw: Steel studded tiles, for that spaceship look. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.
Rule.Translated: Unas baldosas con rebordes de acero, dignas del taller de una nave espacial. Son fáciles de limpiar y otorgan un plus de limpieza, ideal para su uso en entornos médicos.

Rule.Original: For a futuristic but royal look, silver studded tiles fit perfectly into luxurious rooms. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: For a futuristic but royal look, silver studded tiles fit perfectly into luxurious rooms. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Para un aspecto futurista pero regio, los baldosines de plata encajan perfectamente en habitaciones lujosas. Son fáciles de limpiar y otorgan un plus de limpieza.

Rule.Original: For overbearing extravagance, few things beat studded gold tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them.
Rule.Raw: For overbearing extravagance, few things beat studded gold tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them.
Rule.Translated: En cuanto a extravagancia, pocas cosas superan a los baldosines de oro. Son excepcionalmente caros y bonitos, y la gente pensará que eres excepcionalmente esnob si vives con ellos.

Rule.Original: Sterile grate tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build, but very quick to clean.
Rule.Raw: Sterile grate tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build, but very quick to clean.
Rule.Translated: Unas baldosas de rejilla estériles con propiedades especiales que mejoran la limpieza. Las salas muy limpias mejoran los resultados de los hospitales y laboratorios de investigación. Esta baldosa es muy lenta de construir, pero muy rápida de limpiar.

Rule.Original: Sterile studded tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build, but quick to clean.
Rule.Raw: Sterile studded tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build, but quick to clean.
Rule.Translated: Unos baldosines estériles con propiedades especiales que mejoran la limpieza. Las salas muy limpias mejoran los resultados de los hospitales y laboratorios de investigación. Esta baldosa es muy lenta de construir, pero rápida de limpiar.
Un suelo de madera noble quemado.

Rule.Original: A floor-mounted lamp that lights an area using electricity. It is less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be build on any floor.
Rule.Raw: A floor-mounted lamp that lights an area using electricity. It is less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be build on any floor.
Rule.Translated: Una lámpara de suelo que ilumina una zona utilizando electricidad. Es menos potente que una lámpara de pie, pero se puede instalar en cualquier suelo.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. El funcionamiento motorizado permite que las personas pasen por la puerta sin reducir su velocidad.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. El funcionamiento motorizado permite que las personas pasen por la puerta sin reducir su velocidad.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. Las puertas sencillas deben ser abiertas a mano, lo que ralentiza a las personas. El nivel de ralentización depende del material del que está hecha la puerta.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. El funcionamiento motorizado permite que las personas pasen por la puerta sin reducir su velocidad.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. An intricately-carved door, decorated with gold. This large, heavy door requires adjacent walls to function.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. An intricately-carved door, decorated with gold. This large, heavy door requires adjacent walls to function.
Rule.Translated: Divide las habitaciones. Una puerta con detalles intrincados y decorada con oro. Esta puerta grande y pesada necesita paredes adyacentes para funcionar.

Rule.Original: A slow moving door that separates two rooms.
Rule.Raw: A slow moving door that separates two rooms.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta lenta que separa dos habitaciones.

Rule.Original: A stone fireplace build into an existing wall. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable with wood.
Rule.Raw: A stone fireplace build into an existing wall. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable with wood.
Rule.Translated: Una chimenea de piedra que se puede instalar en una pared existente. Como todas las fuentes de calor, debe colocarse en el interior para que tenga un espacio cerrado que calentar. Se puede repostar con leña.

Rule.Original: A stone fireplace. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable with wood.
Rule.Raw: A stone fireplace. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable with wood.
Rule.Translated: Una chimenea de piedra. Como todas las fuentes de calor, debe colocarse en el interior para que tenga un espacio cerrado que calentar. Se puede repostar con leña.

Rule.Original: A durable, reinforced armor that seamlessly integrates with existing walls. Provides enhanced protection against external threats while maintaining structural integrity. It will protect the wall under it from damage until destroyed. Must be constructed on an existing wall.
Rule.Raw: A durable, reinforced armor that seamlessly integrates with existing walls. Provides enhanced protection against external threats while maintaining structural integrity. It will protect the wall under it from damage until destroyed. Must be constructed on an existing wall.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura reforzada y duradera que se integra perfectamente en los muros existentes. Proporciona una mayor protección contra las amenazas externas al tiempo que mantiene la integridad estructural. Protegerá de daños al muro que se encuentre debajo hasta que se destruya. Debe construirse sobre un muro existente.

Rule.Original: A simplistic, weak and impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: A simplistic, weak and impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro simple, débil pero infranqueable. Es capaz de sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: An intricate and impassable wall, decorated with gold. Capable of holding up a roof, but more fragile than a normal wall. Dignity-focused psycaster will receive a meditation bonus when meditating near them.
Rule.Raw: An intricate and impassable wall, decorated with gold. Capable of holding up a roof, but more fragile than a normal wall. Dignity-focused psycaster will receive a meditation bonus when meditating near them.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable, con detalles intrincados y decorado con oro. Es capaz de sostener un techo, pero es más frágil que un muro normal. Los psíquicos con el foco adecuado recibirán una bonificación a la meditación cuando mediten cerca de ellos.

Rule.Original: An impassable half-glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof, but more fragile than a normal wall. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Raw: An impassable half-glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof, but more fragile than a normal wall. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable hecho en parte de cristal. Puede sostener un techo, pero es más frágil que un muro normal. No bloquea la luz, proporcionando una bonificación al crecimiento de las plantas cercanas a ellos. Rellena lentamente las necesidad de aire libre de las personas.

Rule.Original: An impassable half-glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Raw: An impassable half-glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable hecho en parte de cristal. Puede sostener un techo y no bloquea la luz, proporcionando una bonificación al crecimiento de las plantas cercanas a ellos. Rellena lentamente las necesidad de aire libre de las personas.

Rule.Original: An impassable glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof, but far more fragile than a normal wall. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Raw: An impassable glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof, but far more fragile than a normal wall. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de vidrio infranqueable. Puede sostener un techo, pero es más frágil que un muro normal. No bloquea la luz, proporcionando una bonificación al crecimiento de las plantas cercanas a ellos. Rellena lentamente las necesidad de aire libre de las personas.

Rule.Original: An impassable reinforced glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Raw: An impassable reinforced glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de vidrio infranqueable. Puede sostener un techo y no bloquea la luz, proporcionando una bonificación al crecimiento de las plantas cercanas a ellos. Rellena lentamente las necesidad de aire libre de las personas.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall consisting of metal bars.

Rule.Original: Fulfillment represents how happy someone is with their personal achievements in life. If they achieve their dreams and complete their lifetime goals, the fulfillment will increase. Each stage of fulfillment decreases mental break threshold. Achieving 80% fulfillment will result in a final growth moment. Most people will have four aspirations, but some can have up to five.
Rule.Raw: Fulfillment represents how happy someone is with their personal achievements in life. If they achieve their dreams and complete their lifetime goals, the fulfillment will increase. Each stage of fulfillment decreases mental break threshold. Achieving 80% fulfillment will result in a final growth moment. Most people will have four aspirations, but some can have up to five.
Rule.Translated: La realización representa lo feliz que es una persona con respecto a sus logros personales en la vida. Si se cumplen sus sueños y se completan los objetivos vitales, el nivel de realización aumentará. Cada etapa de realización disminuye el umbral de colapso mental. Alcanzar el nivel máximo dará lugar a un hito de crecimiento final.

Rule.Original: An advanced heavy shield made out of layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings. More a portable wall than a shield, it provides maximum protection at the cost of heavy encumbrance.\n\nThis type of shield is commonly used by advanced police forces and space marine pointmen.
Rule.Raw: An advanced heavy shield made out of layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings. More a portable wall than a shield, it provides maximum protection at the cost of heavy encumbrance.\n\nThis type of shield is commonly used by advanced police forces and space marine pointmen.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo pesado avanzado de placas superpuestas de tejido de plastiacero con revestimientos ablativos sólidos. Es casi un muro portátil y ofrece la máxima protección a costa de dificultar mucho el movimiento.\n\nEste tipo de escudo suele utilizarse en fuerzas policiales avanzadas y soldados de vanguardia de la infantería de marina espacial.

Rule.Original: An advanced portable repulsor shield formed by a hardened emitter. It is capable of blocking both melee and ranged attacks, and light enough to not encumber it's user, though is dramatically less effective while its shield is down.\n\nThis type of shield is commonly used by advanced security forces and space marine commandos.
Rule.Raw: An advanced portable repulsor shield formed by a hardened emitter. It is capable of blocking both melee and ranged attacks, and light enough to not encumber it's user, though is dramatically less effective while its shield is down.\n\nThis type of shield is commonly used by advanced security forces and space marine commandos.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo repulsor portátil avanzado generado por un emisor reforzado. Bloquea ataques cuerpo a cuerpo y a distancia, y es tan ligero que no dificulta el movimiento, aunque resulta mucho menos eficaz cuando su escudo está desactivado.\n\nEste tipo de escudo suele utilizarse en fuerzas de seguridad avanzadas y comandos de la infantería de marina espacial.

Rule.Original: A wide-area repulsion shield mounted atop an imperial battle standard. It is designed to inspire and protect nearby soldiers rallying around it.\n\nThis type of shield is commonly used by imperial standard bearers.
Rule.Raw: A wide-area repulsion shield mounted atop an imperial battle standard. It is designed to inspire and protect nearby soldiers rallying around it.\n\nThis type of shield is commonly used by imperial standard bearers.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo de repulsión de área amplia montado sobre un estandarte imperial de batalla. Está diseñado para inspirar y proteger a los soldados cercanos que se reúnen a su alrededor.\n\nEste tipo de escudo suele utilizarse por los abanderados imperiales.

Rule.Original: An advanced shield made out of layered plasteel-weave plates, featuring a powerful electromagnetic system capable of pulling metallic foes towards the user.\n\nThis type of shield is commonly used by mechanoid hunters and imperial champions.

Rule.Translated: Resucita a un mecanoide aliado de clase avanzada. Puede resucitarse mientras su cuerpo no esté completamente destruido.

Rule.Original: Resurrect a large friendly mechanoid of the advanced class. So long as the mechanoid's body is not completely destroyed, it can be resurrected.
Rule.Raw: Resurrect a large friendly mechanoid of the advanced class. So long as the mechanoid's body is not completely destroyed, it can be resurrected.
Rule.Translated: Resucita a un mecanoide grande aliado de clase avanzada. Puede resucitarse mientras su cuerpo no esté completamente destruido.
factor de velocidad de movimiento de mecanoides

Rule.Original: A movement speed factor applied to a mechanitor's mechs.
Rule.Raw: A movement speed factor applied to a mechanitor's mechs.
Rule.Translated: Un factor de velocidad de movimiento aplicado a los mecanoides de un mecanitor.

Rule.Original: A compact, long-range rifle designed to be mounted on an advanced militor.
Rule.Raw: A compact, long-range rifle designed to be mounted on an advanced militor.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil compacto de largo alcance diseñado para montarse en un militor avanzado.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the militor with a long range mini-rifle and hunting capabilities.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the militor with a long range mini-rifle and hunting capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del militor con un minifusil de largo alcance y capacidad de caza.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the lifter with increased speed and carry capacity.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the lifter with increased speed and carry capacity.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del acarreador con más velocidad y capacidad de transporte.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the paramedic with increased healing speed and lower cooldown firefoam pop and long jump abilities.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the paramedic with increased healing speed and lower cooldown firefoam pop and long jump abilities.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del sanitario con mayor velocidad de curación y menores tiempos de recarga para sus habilidades de descarga de espuma ignífuga y salto largo.

Rule.Original: Jump to a distant location using a built-in jump launcher.
Rule.Raw: Jump to a distant location using a built-in jump launcher.
Rule.Translated: Salta a un lugar lejano mediante un lanzador de salto integrado.

Rule.Original: Release a fire-retardant foam in a circular area.
Rule.Raw: Release a fire-retardant foam in a circular area.
Rule.Translated: Libera espuma ignífuga en un área circular.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the tunneler with increased mining speed.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the tunneler with increased mining speed.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del tunelador con mayor velocidad de minería.

Rule.Original: Release compressed smoke from concealed vents. Smoke reduces the accuracy of any shot fired through it, and prevents turrets from locking on entirely.
Rule.Raw: Release compressed smoke from concealed vents. Smoke reduces the accuracy of any shot fired through it, and prevents turrets from locking on entirely.
Rule.Translated: Libera humo comprimido por conductos ocultos. El humo reduce la precisión de los disparos que lo atraviesan e impide por completo que las torretas fijen objetivos.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the fabricor with faster crafting speed.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the fabricor with faster crafting speed.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del fabricador con mayor velocidad de fabricación.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the cleansweeper with faster cleaning speed.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the cleansweeper with faster cleaning speed.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del limpiador con mayor velocidad de limpieza.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the agrihand with faster plant working speed.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the agrihand with faster plant working speed.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del agricultor con mayor velocidad de trabajo con plantas.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the constructoid faster construction speed.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the constructoid faster construction speed.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del constructor con mayor velocidad de construcción.

Rule.Original: A workbench for creating new genepacks from existing packs banked nearby.
Rule.Raw: A workbench for creating new genepacks from existing packs banked nearby.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo para crear nuevos paquetes genéticos a partir de los paquetes existentes almacenados cerca.
velocidad de creación de paquetes genéticos

Rule.Original: A multiplier on the speed at which this person can make new genepacks.
Rule.Raw: A multiplier on the speed at which this person can make new genepacks.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador de la velocidad a la que esta persona puede crear nuevos paquetes genéticos.

Rule.Original: Learn to build bigger garage doors.
Rule.Raw: Learn to build bigger garage doors.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a construir puertas de garaje más grandes.

Rule.Original: Learn to build garage doors with multiple layers of armor. Nearly completely resistant to explosives and any breaching tools.
Rule.Raw: Learn to build garage doors with multiple layers of armor. Nearly completely resistant to explosives and any breaching tools.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a construir puertas de garaje con varias capas de blindaje. Son casi totalmente resistentes a los explosivos y a cualquier herramienta de demolición.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Manual operation allows people to open it, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Manual operation allows people to open it, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Translated: Separa estancias. El funcionamiento manual permite abrirla para dejar pasar vehículos.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Electric-powered operation allows the door to open without manual interaction, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Electric-powered operation allows the door to open without manual interaction, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Translated: Separa estancias. El funcionamiento eléctrico permite abrirla sin intervención manual para dejar pasar vehículos.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene grow thick fur all over their body, which protects them from cold temperatures.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene grow thick fur all over their body, which protects them from cold temperatures.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen desarrollan un pelaje espeso por todo el cuerpo que los protege del frío.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have a pinched, gaunt appearance in their face and head.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have a pinched, gaunt appearance in their face and head.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen el rostro y la cabeza enjutos y demacrados.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have large jaws.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have large jaws.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen mandíbulas grandes.

Rule.Original: Carriers of this gene have a prominent brow.
Rule.Raw: Carriers of this gene have a prominent brow.
Rule.Translated: Los portadores de este gen tienen un arco superciliar prominente.

Rule.Original: For more info see the Wiki
Rule.Raw: For more info see the Wiki
Rule.Translated: Consulta la wiki para obtener más información

Rule.Original: Restarting game is required to apply some changes.
Rule.Raw: Restarting game is required to apply some changes.
Rule.Translated: Algunos cambios requieren reiniciar el juego para aplicarse.

Rule.Original: A sack, a large bag used for carrying various items, is made from durable materials to easily transport heavy loads.
Rule.Raw: A sack, a large bag used for carrying various items, is made from durable materials to easily transport heavy loads.
Rule.Translated: Un saco, una bolsa grande para llevar diversos objetos, hecho de materiales resistentes para transportar cargas pesadas fácilmente.

Rule.Original: A pouch, a small bag used for carrying personal items, is often made from leather or cloth and can be easily attached to a belt.
Rule.Raw: A pouch, a small bag used for carrying personal items, is often made from leather or cloth and can be easily attached to a belt.
Rule.Translated: Una bolsa pequeña para llevar objetos personales. Suele ser de cuero o tela y puede sujetarse fácilmente a un cinturón.

Rule.Original: A field bag, designed for carrying equipment and supplies in the field, is durable and spacious.
Rule.Raw: A field bag, designed for carrying equipment and supplies in the field, is durable and spacious.
Rule.Translated: Una bolsa de campaña resistente y espaciosa, diseñada para llevar equipo y suministros sobre el terreno.

Rule.Original: A carrying bundle, a tied-up collection of items for easy transport, is typically used by travelers and soldiers to carry belongings and supplies.
Rule.Raw: A carrying bundle, a tied-up collection of items for easy transport, is typically used by travelers and soldiers to carry belongings and supplies.
Rule.Translated: Un fardo de objetos atados para facilitar su transporte. Los viajeros y soldados suelen utilizarlo para llevar pertenencias y suministros.

Rule.Original: A military bag, designed for soldiers, is rugged and spacious, ideal for carrying essential gear and supplies during missions.
Rule.Raw: A military bag, designed for soldiers, is rugged and spacious, ideal for carrying essential gear and supplies during missions.
Rule.Translated: Una bolsa militar resistente y espaciosa, diseñada para que los soldados lleven el equipo y los suministros esenciales durante las misiones.

Rule.Original: An advanced military bag, featuring enhanced durability and multiple compartments, offers superior organization and capacity for soldiers.
Rule.Raw: An advanced military bag, featuring enhanced durability and multiple compartments, offers superior organization and capacity for soldiers.
Rule.Translated: Una bolsa militar avanzada, con mayor resistencia y varios compartimentos, que ofrece una organización y capacidad superiores a los soldados.

Rule.Original: Replace the tires with deep treaded tires that provide more traction and will allow the vehicle to move significantly faster offroad.
Rule.Raw: Replace the tires with deep treaded tires that provide more traction and will allow the vehicle to move significantly faster offroad.
Rule.Translated: Sustituye los neumáticos por unos con relieves más profundos que proporcionan más tracción y permitirán que el vehículo se mueva mucho más rápido fuera de la carretera.

Rule.Original: Increase the amount of cargo that can be hauled by this vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Increase the amount of cargo that can be hauled by this vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la cantidad de carga que puede transportar este vehículo.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] was a former athlete. [PAWN_pronoun] had won multiple sports championships before injury.[PAWN_pronoun] had a twin brother who started working in a chemical factory during his youth, but has never heard from him since.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] was a former athlete. [PAWN_pronoun] had won multiple sports championships before injury.[PAWN_pronoun] had a twin brother who started working in a chemical factory during his youth, but has never heard from him since.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] se dedicaba al deporte. [PAWN_pronoun] ganó varios campeonatos antes de lesionarse. [PAWN_pronoun] tenía un hermano gemelo que empezó a trabajar en una fábrica química de joven, pero nunca volvió a saber de él.

Rule.Original: After being injured,[PAWN_nameDef] was no longer able to continue [PAWN_pronoun] career as an athlete. Disappointed, [PAWN_pronoun] was hired as a security guard by a shopping mall. This fashionable guy liked to patrol the mall at night in his classic black striped sportswear and use a machine gun to knock out every sneaky thief.
Rule.Raw: After being injured,[PAWN_nameDef] was no longer able to continue [PAWN_pronoun] career as an athlete. Disappointed, [PAWN_pronoun] was hired as a security guard by a shopping mall. This fashionable guy liked to patrol the mall at night in his classic black striped sportswear and use a machine gun to knock out every sneaky thief.
Rule.Translated: Tras una lesión, [PAWN_nameDef] no pudo continuar su carrera deportiva. [PAWN_pronoun] quedó muy decepcionado y acabó trabajando en la seguridad de un centro comercial. [PAWN_pronoun] disfrutaba patrullando el centro de noche con su clásico conjunto deportivo negro a rayas y derribando con una ametralladora a cualquier ladrón que intentara colarse.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is an intern at a chemical plant, tasked with handling certain chemical agents and learning to operate the factory equipment. [PAWN_pronoun] learns rapidly and occasionally assists workers in treating injuries sustained while on the job.[PAWN_pronoun] also enjoys drawing in his spare time.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is an intern at a chemical plant, tasked with handling certain chemical agents and learning to operate the factory equipment. [PAWN_pronoun] learns rapidly and occasionally assists workers in treating injuries sustained while on the job.[PAWN_pronoun] also enjoys drawing in his spare time.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] hace prácticas en una fábrica química, donde se encarga de manipular ciertos agentes químicos y aprende a manejar los equipos. [PAWN_pronoun] aprende rápido y a veces ayuda a tratar las heridas que sufren los trabajadores. A [PAWN_pronoun] también le gusta dibujar en su tiempo libre.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] inhaled a large amount of toxic gas during a chemical plant accident .[PAWN_possessive] twin brother sent [PAWN_pronoun] to the hospital affiliated with the chemical plant to save [PAWN_pronoun], but the hospital did not treat [PAWN_nameDef]. Instead, they lied to [PAWN_possessive] family that [PAWN_pronoun] had died and used [PAWN_nameDef] as an experimental subject in a parasite experiment. This failed experiment destroyed [PAWN_possessive] mind.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] inhaled a large amount of toxic gas during a chemical plant accident .[PAWN_possessive] twin brother sent [PAWN_pronoun] to the hospital affiliated with the chemical plant to save [PAWN_pronoun], but the hospital did not treat [PAWN_nameDef]. Instead, they lied to [PAWN_possessive] family that [PAWN_pronoun] had died and used [PAWN_nameDef] as an experimental subject in a parasite experiment. This failed experiment destroyed [PAWN_possessive] mind.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] inhaló una gran cantidad de gas tóxico en un accidente de una fábrica química. [PAWN_possessive] hermano gemelo buscó ayuda para [PAWN_pronoun] en el hospital de la fábrica, con la intención de salvar a [PAWN_pronoun], pero allí no trataron a [PAWN_nameDef]. En su lugar, mintieron a [PAWN_possessive] familia diciendo que [PAWN_pronoun] había muerto y utilizaron a [PAWN_nameDef] en un experimento con parásitos. El fracaso del experimento destruyó [PAWN_possessive] mente.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] was conceived in a test tube in a secret laboratory, where every child underwent military-style education and was frequently administered drugs. There, [PAWN_nameDef] acquired a great deal of knowledge.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] was conceived in a test tube in a secret laboratory, where every child underwent military-style education and was frequently administered drugs. There, [PAWN_nameDef] acquired a great deal of knowledge.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] fue concebido en una probeta de un laboratorio secreto, donde todos los niños recibían una educación militar y les administraban drogas con frecuencia. Allí, [PAWN_nameDef] adquirió muchos conocimientos.

Rule.Original: Following a specialized "consensual" parasite experiment, [PAWN_nameDef] was enhanced and designated as a unique unit, frequently undertaking covert missions.
Rule.Raw: Following a specialized "consensual" parasite experiment, [PAWN_nameDef] was enhanced and designated as a unique unit, frequently undertaking covert missions.
Rule.Translated: Tras un experimento especializado con parásitos supuestamente «consensuado», [PAWN_nameDef] recibió mejoras y pasó a formar parte de una unidad especial que realizaba frecuentes misiones encubiertas.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] lost [PAWN_possessive] parents in the insect infestation and lived alone in an underground network of caves. [PAWN_pronoun] often went hungry until one day [PAWN_pronoun] discovered the back door of a secret laboratory warehouse. [PAWN_pronoun] broke in and stole the food inside, but was caught on [PAWN_possessive] second attempt.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] lost [PAWN_possessive] parents in the insect infestation and lived alone in an underground network of caves. [PAWN_pronoun] often went hungry until one day [PAWN_pronoun] discovered the back door of a secret laboratory warehouse. [PAWN_pronoun] broke in and stole the food inside, but was caught on [PAWN_possessive] second attempt.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] perdió a [PAWN_possessive] padres durante la infestación de insectos y vivió en soledad en una red de cuevas subterráneas. [PAWN_pronoun] pasaba hambre con frecuencia, hasta que un día [PAWN_pronoun] descubrió la puerta trasera del almacén de un laboratorio secreto. [PAWN_pronoun] entró y robó la comida que había dentro, pero en [PAWN_possessive] segundo intento acabó atrapado.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef]'s father was a researcher at an ancient laboratory, with an unnatural fondness for experimentation. Consequently, [PAWN_nameDef] was frequently administered unauthorized drugs, inflicting severe pain upon [PAWN_nameDef].
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef]'s father was a researcher at an ancient laboratory, with an unnatural fondness for experimentation. Consequently, [PAWN_nameDef] was frequently administered unauthorized drugs, inflicting severe pain upon [PAWN_nameDef].
Rule.Translated: El padre de [PAWN_nameDef] investigaba en un antiguo laboratorio y sentía una afición enfermiza por los experimentos. Por ello, administraba con frecuencia drogas no autorizadas a [PAWN_nameDef], lo que causaba fuertes dolores a [PAWN_nameDef].

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] was frequently mistreated by [PAWN_possessive] parents, leading [PAWN_pronoun] to leave home in a fit of rage. Tragically, [PAWN_pronoun] was soon kidnapped by individuals and spirited away to a covert laboratory.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] was frequently mistreated by [PAWN_possessive] parents, leading [PAWN_pronoun] to leave home in a fit of rage. Tragically, [PAWN_pronoun] was soon kidnapped by individuals and spirited away to a covert laboratory.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] sufría malos tratos de [PAWN_possessive] padres con frecuencia, hasta que [PAWN_pronoun] abandonó el hogar en un arrebato de ira. Por desgracia, poco después [PAWN_pronoun] acabó en manos de unos secuestradores que se lo llevaron a un laboratorio secreto.

Rule.Original: rising star of the military academy
Rule.Raw: rising star of the military academy
Rule.Translated: estrella emergente de la academia militar

Rule.Original: rising star of the military academy
Rule.Raw: rising star of the military academy
Rule.Translated: estrella emergente de la academia militar

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is a rising star in the military academy with excellent physical fitness and combat skills, which led to [PAWN_pronoun] being kidnapped and sent to a secret laboratory, where a clone was sent to [PAWN_possessive] family as a substitute.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is a rising star in the military academy with excellent physical fitness and combat skills, which led to [PAWN_pronoun] being kidnapped and sent to a secret laboratory, where a clone was sent to [PAWN_possessive] family as a substitute.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] era una promesa de la academia militar, con una excelente forma física y habilidad para el combate. Por ello, [PAWN_pronoun] fue secuestrado y enviado a un laboratorio secreto, mientras un clon ocupaba su lugar ante [PAWN_possessive] familia.

Rule.Original: Learning how to basic disassemble and reassemble weapons, assembly is an easy task when using standardized components.
Rule.Raw: Learning how to basic disassemble and reassemble weapons, assembly is an easy task when using standardized components.
Rule.Translated: Aprende los fundamentos del desmontaje y montaje de armas. El montaje resulta sencillo con componentes estandarizados.

Rule.Original: There is no weather in facilities.
Rule.Raw: There is no weather in facilities.
Rule.Translated: No hay fenómenos meteorológicos en las instalaciones.

Rule.Original: Poor scavengers who found an underground safe house.
Rule.Raw: Poor scavengers who found an underground safe house.
Rule.Translated: Pobres recuperadores de materiales que encontraron un refugio subterráneo seguro.

Rule.Original: Schedule colonists' activities to certain times of day, and set their allowed areas.
Rule.Raw: Schedule colonists' activities to certain times of day, and set their allowed areas.
Rule.Translated: Programa las actividades de los colonos para ciertas horas del día y establece sus zonas permitidas.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} is a successful product of an ancient experimental project, {PAWN_pronoun} almost entirely specialized for combat. {PAWN_pronoun} is extremely hard to defeat.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} is a successful product of an ancient experimental project, {PAWN_pronoun} almost entirely specialized for combat. {PAWN_pronoun} is extremely hard to defeat.
Rule.Translated: {PAWN_nameDef} es el resultado satisfactorio de un antiguo proyecto experimental. {PAWN_pronoun} está especializado casi por completo en el combate. {PAWN_pronoun} es extremadamente difícil de derrotar.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} is a fashion guy who is skilled at shooting in a slide shovel, {PAWN_pronoun} can use gun to blast everything he sees.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} is a fashion guy who is skilled at shooting in a slide shovel, {PAWN_pronoun} can use gun to blast everything he sees.
Rule.Translated: {PAWN_nameDef} es una persona aficionada a la moda y hábil disparando mientras se desliza. {PAWN_pronoun} puede destrozar a tiros todo lo que ve.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} was implanted with an excessive amount of parasites, which completely destroyed {PAWN_possessive} sanity but greatly increased {PAWN_possessive} strength.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} was implanted with an excessive amount of parasites, which completely destroyed {PAWN_possessive} sanity but greatly increased {PAWN_possessive} strength.
Rule.Translated: A {PAWN_nameDef} le implantaron demasiados parásitos, lo que destruyó por completo {PAWN_possessive} cordura, pero aumentó enormemente {PAWN_possessive} fuerza.

Rule.Original: An ancient, specialized implant involved introducing carefully selected parasites into the body, endowing the subject with a body akin to bulletproof fibers and enhancing muscular strength. However, the technology behind it has been entirely lost and cannot be replicated.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, specialized implant involved introducing carefully selected parasites into the body, endowing the subject with a body akin to bulletproof fibers and enhancing muscular strength. However, the technology behind it has been entirely lost and cannot be replicated.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo implante especializado que introducía parásitos cuidadosamente seleccionados en el cuerpo. Dotaba al sujeto de una estructura similar a las fibras antibalas y aumentaba su fuerza muscular. Sin embargo, la tecnología se ha perdido por completo y no puede reproducirse.

Rule.Original: An unsuccessful outcome of ancient parasitic experiments, though it greatly enhances combat effectiveness, the victim lacks any semblance of intelligence and is utterly uncontrollable.
Rule.Raw: An unsuccessful outcome of ancient parasitic experiments, though it greatly enhances combat effectiveness, the victim lacks any semblance of intelligence and is utterly uncontrollable.
Rule.Translated: El resultado fallido de antiguos experimentos con parásitos. Aunque aumenta mucho la eficacia en combate, la víctima pierde cualquier rastro de inteligencia y resulta totalmente incontrolable.

Rule.Original: The ancient architectural complex has been searched and wiped out, and it will disappear into the tide of history.
Rule.Raw: The ancient architectural complex has been searched and wiped out, and it will disappear into the tide of history.
Rule.Translated: El antiguo complejo arquitectónico ha sido registrado y arrasado, y desaparecerá en el curso de la historia.

Rule.Original: questDescription -> We have discovered the site of an ancient block ruins, where the streets were once lined with shops. The map also indicates the presence of an entrance to an underground commercial street, promising the discovery of numerous high-value items.
Rule.Raw: questDescription -> We have discovered the site of an ancient block ruins, where the streets were once lined with shops. The map also indicates the presence of an entrance to an underground commercial street, promising the discovery of numerous high-value items.
Rule.Translated: questDescription -> Hemos descubierto las ruinas de una antigua manzana urbana cuyas calles estaban repletas de tiendas. El mapa también indica que hay una entrada a una calle comercial subterránea, donde podrían encontrarse numerosos objetos de gran valor.

Rule.Original: The ancient architectural complex has been searched and wiped out, and it will disappear into the tide of history.
Rule.Raw: The ancient architectural complex has been searched and wiped out, and it will disappear into the tide of history.
Rule.Translated: El antiguo complejo arquitectónico ha sido registrado y arrasado, y desaparecerá en el curso de la historia.

Rule.Original: questDescription -> We have discovered the location of an ancient military Reservation Station, which is heavily fortified and rumored to be manned by well-equipped ancient elite soldiers. Infiltrating this location carries extreme risk, but also offers equally significant rewards.
Rule.Raw: questDescription -> We have discovered the location of an ancient military Reservation Station, which is heavily fortified and rumored to be manned by well-equipped ancient elite soldiers. Infiltrating this location carries extreme risk, but also offers equally significant rewards.
Rule.Translated: questDescription -> Hemos descubierto la ubicación de un antiguo puesto militar de reserva, fuertemente fortificado y que, según los rumores, está ocupado por soldados antiguos de élite bien equipados. Infiltrarse allí supone un riesgo extremo, pero también ofrece recompensas igualmente importantes.

Rule.Original: The ancient architectural complex has been searched and wiped out, and it will disappear into the tide of history.

Rule.Translated: El antiguo complejo arquitectónico ha sido registrado y arrasado, y desaparecerá en el curso de la historia.

Rule.Original: questDescription -> We have discovered an ancient giant shopping mall that is remarkably well-preserved and abundant in resources. Undoubtedly, other factions have also discovered this location, making a conflict inevitable.
Rule.Raw: questDescription -> We have discovered an ancient giant shopping mall that is remarkably well-preserved and abundant in resources. Undoubtedly, other factions have also discovered this location, making a conflict inevitable.
Rule.Translated: questDescription -> Hemos descubierto un enorme centro comercial antiguo, muy bien conservado y con abundantes recursos. Sin duda, otras facciones también han encontrado este lugar, por lo que el conflicto es inevitable.

Rule.Original: The ancient architectural complex has been searched and wiped out, and it will disappear into the tide of history.
Rule.Raw: The ancient architectural complex has been searched and wiped out, and it will disappear into the tide of history.
Rule.Translated: El antiguo complejo arquitectónico ha sido registrado y arrasado, y desaparecerá en el curso de la historia.

Rule.Raw: questDescription -> We have discovered an ancient giant shopping mall that is remarkably well-preserved and abundant in resources. Undoubtedly, other factions have also discovered this location, making a conflict inevitable.

Rule.Original: questDescription->We've discovered the location of an abandoned construction site, rumored to hold an entrance to the ancient city's underground system. A group of guards, clad in equipment stolen from an old bunker, are stationed there. They appear oblivious to the fact that they've been discovered.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->We've discovered the location of an abandoned construction site, rumored to hold an entrance to the ancient city's underground system. A group of guards, clad in equipment stolen from an old bunker, are stationed there. They appear oblivious to the fact that they've been discovered.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Hemos descubierto la ubicación de unas obras abandonadas que, según los rumores, contienen una entrada al sistema subterráneo de la ciudad antigua. Allí hay un grupo de guardias equipados con material robado de un viejo búnker. Parece que no saben que los hemos descubierto.

Rule.Original: An ancient complex containing the corpse of a mechanitor. You can try to penetrate this dangerous structure to extract the mechanitor's mechlink for your own use.
Rule.Raw: An ancient complex containing the corpse of a mechanitor. You can try to penetrate this dangerous structure to extract the mechanitor's mechlink for your own use.
Rule.Translated: Un complejo antiguo que contiene el cadáver de un mecanitor. Puedes intentar penetrar en esta peligrosa estructura para extraer su mecaenlace y utilizarlo tú.
Desmonta armas de fuego para obtener componentes de armas.
desmontar arma de fuego de precisión

Rule.Original: Disassemble precise firearms into weapon components.
Rule.Raw: Disassemble precise firearms into weapon components.
Rule.Translated: Desmonta armas de fuego precisas para obtener componentes de armas.
desmontando un arma de fuego de precisión.

Rule.Original: Disassemble light armor into armor plates and fibers.
Rule.Raw: Disassemble light armor into armor plates and fibers.
Rule.Translated: Desmonta armaduras ligeras para obtener placas de blindaje y fibras.

Rule.Original: Remove the aramid fabric layer from the polyethylene armor plate to recycle precious aramid.
Rule.Raw: Remove the aramid fabric layer from the polyethylene armor plate to recycle precious aramid.
Rule.Translated: Retira la capa de tejido de aramida de la placa de blindaje de polietileno para reciclar la valiosa aramida.

Rule.Original: Disassemble heavy armor into armor plates and fibers.
Rule.Raw: Disassemble heavy armor into armor plates and fibers.
Rule.Translated: Desmonta armaduras pesadas para obtener placas de blindaje y fibras.

Rule.Original: You've wandered this rimworld, living off the spoils of ancient ruins. You traverse the desolate ruins of cities, devoid of any signs of life. On the outskirts of town, you discover an abandoned ancient underground shelter. Though its resources won't last long...\n\nNote: You have no operable colonists and lack essential survival resources. Scavengers start off starving, making this a challenging scenario.
Rule.Raw: You've wandered this rimworld, living off the spoils of ancient ruins. You traverse the desolate ruins of cities, devoid of any signs of life. On the outskirts of town, you discover an abandoned ancient underground shelter. Though its resources won't last long...\n\nNote: You have no operable colonists and lack essential survival resources. Scavengers start off starving, making this a challenging scenario.
Rule.Translated: Has vagado por este mundo exterior viviendo de lo que encontrabas en ruinas antiguas. Recorres los restos desolados de ciudades sin señales de vida. A las afueras de una de ellas descubres un antiguo refugio subterráneo abandonado, aunque sus recursos no durarán mucho...\n\nNota: no tienes colonos controlables y careces de recursos esenciales para sobrevivir. Los saqueadores empiezan hambrientos, por lo que este escenario es difícil.

Rule.Original: A lone scavenger discovers an old underground bunker. Particularly challenging.
Rule.Raw: A lone scavenger discovers an old underground bunker. Particularly challenging.
Rule.Translated: Un saqueador solitario descubre un antiguo búnker subterráneo. Especialmente difícil.

Rule.Original: You have discovered an ancient, abandoned small underground facility that could potentially serve as a shelter.
Rule.Raw: You have discovered an ancient, abandoned small underground facility that could potentially serve as a shelter.
Rule.Translated: Has descubierto una pequeña instalación subterránea antigua y abandonada que podría servir como refugio.

Rule.Original: In your earlier explorations, the regions nearer to the settlement were thoroughly examined. You've been left with no option but to venture into uncharted territories. On this day, you have discovered an entrance to an unknown underground facility. You have decided to settle here, but the strange odor and faint, incessant sounds seem to hint that this place is not as safe as you once imagined....
Rule.Raw: In your earlier explorations, the regions nearer to the settlement were thoroughly examined. You've been left with no option but to venture into uncharted territories. On this day, you have discovered an entrance to an unknown underground facility. You have decided to settle here, but the strange odor and faint, incessant sounds seem to hint that this place is not as safe as you once imagined....
Rule.Translated: En tus exploraciones anteriores examinaste a fondo las regiones cercanas al asentamiento. No te ha quedado otra opción que adentrarte en territorios desconocidos. Hoy has descubierto la entrada de una instalación subterránea desconocida y has decidido establecerte aquí. Sin embargo, el extraño olor y los tenues sonidos incesantes parecen indicar que este lugar no es tan seguro como imaginabas...

Rule.Original: A group of three scavengers wandering between the ruins of a city. Particularly challenging.
Rule.Raw: A group of three scavengers wandering between the ruins of a city. Particularly challenging.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo de tres saqueadores recorre las ruinas de una ciudad. Especialmente difícil.

Rule.Original: You have discovered an ancient underground parking lot that could serve as your stronghold, but there seems to be a strange noise underground....
Rule.Raw: You have discovered an ancient underground parking lot that could serve as your stronghold, but there seems to be a strange noise underground....
Rule.Translated: Has descubierto un antiguo aparcamiento subterráneo que podría servir como base, pero parece que hay ruidos extraños bajo tierra...

Rule.Original: Four bulletproof plates firmly protect the dress. Use four fourth level PE plates for protection, keeping its weight within an acceptable range. Due to being too bulky, flak vests cannot be worn anymore. Integrated with some tactical vest features, providing a bulletproof level of power armor.
Rule.Raw: Four bulletproof plates firmly protect the dress. Use four fourth level PE plates for protection, keeping its weight within an acceptable range. Due to being too bulky, flak vests cannot be worn anymore. Integrated with some tactical vest features, providing a bulletproof level of power armor.
Rule.Translated: Cuatro placas antibalas protegen firmemente el traje. Utiliza cuatro placas PE de nivel cuatro para mantener el peso dentro de un margen aceptable. Su gran volumen impide llevar además un chaleco antibalas. Integra algunas funciones de un chaleco táctico y proporciona una protección comparable a la de una armadura potenciada.

Rule.Original: A rig equipped with bulletproof armor plates. Its lightweight model can be concealed underneath an outer garment, providing effective protection for the entire upper body.
Rule.Raw: A rig equipped with bulletproof armor plates. Its lightweight model can be concealed underneath an outer garment, providing effective protection for the entire upper body.
Rule.Translated: Un arnés equipado con placas de blindaje antibalas. Su modelo ligero puede ocultarse bajo una prenda exterior y ofrece protección eficaz a toda la parte superior del cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A rig equipped with bulletproof armor plates. Its heavy-duty structure can provide effective protection but does not protect the legs.
Rule.Raw: A rig equipped with bulletproof armor plates. Its heavy-duty structure can provide effective protection but does not protect the legs.
Rule.Translated: Un arnés equipado con placas de blindaje antibalas. Su estructura pesada ofrece protección eficaz, pero no cubre las piernas.

Rule.Original: Combat clothing made of aramid material, when paired with a composite bulletproof vest, offers the benefits of lightweight mobility and significant protection. This type of attire was frequently worn by ancient soldiers.
Rule.Raw: Combat clothing made of aramid material, when paired with a composite bulletproof vest, offers the benefits of lightweight mobility and significant protection. This type of attire was frequently worn by ancient soldiers.
Rule.Translated: Ropa de combate de aramida que, combinada con un chaleco antibalas compuesto, ofrece movilidad ligera y una protección considerable. Los soldados antiguos la utilizaban con frecuencia.

Rule.Original: An aramid bulletproof helmet, paired with a fully enclosed polyurethane gas mask, effectively mitigates the dangers of toxic environments and offers superior protection,often equipped by ancient soldiers.
Rule.Raw: An aramid bulletproof helmet, paired with a fully enclosed polyurethane gas mask, effectively mitigates the dangers of toxic environments and offers superior protection,often equipped by ancient soldiers.
Rule.Translated: Un casco antibalas de aramida combinado con una máscara antigás de poliuretano completamente cerrada. Reduce eficazmente los peligros de los entornos tóxicos y ofrece una protección superior. Los soldados antiguos lo utilizaban a menudo.

Rule.Original: An aramid bulletproof helmet, used in conjunction with night vision goggles, enhances the wearer's shooting accuracy. It was commonly worn by ancient soldiers.
Rule.Raw: An aramid bulletproof helmet, used in conjunction with night vision goggles, enhances the wearer's shooting accuracy. It was commonly worn by ancient soldiers.
Rule.Translated: Un casco antibalas de aramida que, combinado con gafas de visión nocturna, mejora la precisión de disparo de quien lo lleva. Los soldados antiguos lo utilizaban habitualmente.

Rule.Original: A cataphract helmet, which was secretly modified by a fashionable person, was painted with the logo of a famous ancient clothing store.
Rule.Raw: A cataphract helmet, which was secretly modified by a fashionable person, was painted with the logo of a famous ancient clothing store.
Rule.Translated: Un casco catafracto modificado en secreto por una persona aficionada a la moda, que pintó en él el logotipo de una famosa tienda de ropa antigua.

Rule.Translated: Un casco catafracto modificado en secreto por un asesino demente, que lo adornó con una calavera y la palabra «Matanza».
