Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo y oxidado banco de taquillas. Se han restaurado para que sean al menos parcialmente funcionales. Da una pequeña bonificación de comodidad a todas las camas antiguas restauradas cercanas. Colocar más de un banco de taquillas cerca de la misma cama antigua no tiene ningún efecto.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken barrel that looks like it once contained waste of some sort. The only thing it contains now is a smear of dried sludge.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken barrel that looks like it once contained waste of some sort. The only thing it contains now is a smear of dried sludge.
Rule.Translated: Un barril roto que parece haber contenido algún tipo de residuo. Lo único que contiene ahora es una mancha de lodo seco.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una caja antigua rota. Los objetos de valor que contenía se han deteriorado hasta quedar inservibles.

Rule.Original: An ancient electrical generator. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago, and the rest has rusted into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient electrical generator. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago, and the rest has rusted into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo generador eléctrico. Sus componentes útiles están destrozados o ha sido saqueados hace tiempo, mientras que el resto se ha oxidado hasta quedar inservible.

Rule.Original: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.
Rule.Raw: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.
Rule.Translated: Un montón de tuberías antiguas oxidadas. Es difícil saber cómo acabaron aquí.

Rule.Original: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.
Rule.Raw: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.
Rule.Translated: Un tramo de alambre de cuchillas antiguo. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose y ya no supone ningún peligro.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de seguridad antigua rota. Todas las piezas valiosas han sido saqueadas o destrozadas.

Rule.Original: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Raw: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Translated: Una fortificación defensiva para detener vehículos. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose.

Rule.Original: An ancient, unstable fuel node once used to charge machines with fuel. It has become unstable over the years due to lack of maintenance.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, unstable fuel node once used to charge machines with fuel. It has become unstable over the years due to lack of maintenance.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo nodo de combustible que se utilizaba para abastecer máquinas. Se ha vuelto inestable con los años por la falta de mantenimiento.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un coche antiguo roto. Todo lo que no se ha oxidado fue saqueado hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.
Rule.Translated: Un carrito de la compra antiguo y oxidado. Cómo llegó aquí es un misterio, pero su historia es larga y probablemente triste.

Rule.Original: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Raw: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda antigua de algún vehículo. El caucho se ha deshecho y el metal está retorcido y oxidado.

Rule.Original: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.
Rule.Raw: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina de aire acondicionado. Su interior ha quedado inservible hace mucho tiempo y lo que no ha sido saqueado se ha oxidado durante el tiempo transcurrido desde entonces.

Rule.Original: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un cajero automático antiguo. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Though uncomfortable, it can still be used, but it's too dilapidated to restore.
Rule.Raw: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Though uncomfortable, it can still be used, but it's too dilapidated to restore.
Rule.Translated: Un viejo colchón podrido sobre un armazón oxidado. Restaurado para ser utilizable, aunque un poco incómodo.

Rule.Original: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.
Rule.Raw: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua valla hecha de postes de hormigón armado unidos por paneles de hormigón.

Rule.Original: A shipping container from some ancient freight-carrying vehicle. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A shipping container from some ancient freight-carrying vehicle. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de algún vehículo de carga antiguo. Hace mucho que se deterioró hasta quedar inservible.

Rule.Original: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Una boca de incendios antigua. Muy oxidada, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un aparato antiguo para calentar comida. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un horno antiguo. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un retrete antiguo. Destrozado hace mucho tiempo, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico antiguo. Le quitaron las piezas interesantes hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.
Rule.Raw: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo fregadero de cocina hecho de algún material no metálico. Está muy deteriorado y no hay forma de aprovechar nada de él.\n\nCómo llegó aquí debe ser una larga historia.

Rule.Original: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de una antigua tubería. Una vez transportó un fluido valioso a través de largas distancias. Ya la han despojado de cualquier resto útil, y se ha deteriorado hasta la inutilidad.

Rule.Original: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Raw: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo vehículo capaz de volar de forma automática. Sus partes valiosas fueron saqueadas hace tiempo y el resto está muy deteriorado.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.
Rule.Translated: Un chasis de coche antiguo y oxidado. La carrocería desapareció por completo a causa del óxido hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un transporte de tropas antiguo roto. Todo lo que no se ha oxidado fue saqueado hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un camión antiguo roto. Todo lo útil se ha oxidado o fue saqueado hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient stove. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient stove. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Una cocina antigua. Destrozada y oxidada, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.
Rule.Raw: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina expendedora. Quedó inservible hace siglos, y generaciones de saqueadores se han llevado todas las piezas útiles. Cómo acabó aquí es un misterio.

Rule.Original: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.
Rule.Translated: Una caja antigua de aspecto militar. La rompieron hace mucho tiempo y saquearon todos los objetos de valor que contenía.

Rule.Original: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua cama utilizada antaño para operaciones quirúrgicas olvidadas. Ajustable para un paciente y engalanada con equipos incorporados, mejora los resultados médicos con respecto a las camas normales. Incómoda pero eficaz.

Rule.Translated: Un enorme helicóptero antiguo estrellado, con un número de identificación poco legible en el fuselaje: mi26.

Rule.Original: The metal blood stimulant used in combat does not cause discoloration of the skin at a special concentration dose, which improves the ability of muscle tissue to withstand impact damage and to some extent increases movement speed. However, it is also more susceptible to fire damage and metabolism becomes higher.
Rule.Raw: The metal blood stimulant used in combat does not cause discoloration of the skin at a special concentration dose, which improves the ability of muscle tissue to withstand impact damage and to some extent increases movement speed. However, it is also more susceptible to fire damage and metabolism becomes higher.
Rule.Translated: Un estimulante de sangre metálica utilizado en combate. A una concentración específica no altera el color de la piel y mejora la capacidad del tejido muscular para resistir impactos, además de aumentar en cierta medida la velocidad de movimiento. Sin embargo, también incrementa la vulnerabilidad al fuego y el metabolismo.

Rule.Original: A blood stimulant used in combat. It was discovered that it does not cause discoloration of the skin at a special concentration dose, which improves the ability of muscle tissue to withstand impact damage and to some extent increases movement speed. However, it is also can make its user susceptible to fire damage and hightens their metabolism.
Rule.Raw: A blood stimulant used in combat. It was discovered that it does not cause discoloration of the skin at a special concentration dose, which improves the ability of muscle tissue to withstand impact damage and to some extent increases movement speed. However, it is also can make its user susceptible to fire damage and hightens their metabolism.
Rule.Translated: Un estimulante sanguíneo utilizado en combate. Se descubrió que a una concentración específica no altera el color de la piel y mejora la capacidad del tejido muscular para resistir impactos, además de aumentar en cierta medida la velocidad de movimiento. Sin embargo, también puede aumentar la vulnerabilidad al fuego y el metabolismo del usuario.

Rule.Raw: Regenerated substances are rapidly repairing the body,but has strong side effects.
Rule.Translated: Las sustancias regeneradas reparan rápidamente el cuerpo, pero tienen fuertes efectos secundarios.

Rule.Original: A powerful regeneration promoter. Once used for rapid recovery of injured or severely injured individuals during transportation, despite its strong side effects.
Rule.Raw: A powerful regeneration promoter. Once used for rapid recovery of injured or severely injured individuals during transportation, despite its strong side effects.
Rule.Translated: Un potente promotor de regeneración. Se utilizaba para recuperar rápidamente a personas heridas o gravemente lesionadas durante su transporte, a pesar de sus fuertes efectos secundarios.

Rule.Original: Stimulate the brain with strong essential balm to secrete endorphins for pain relief and improve focus.
Rule.Raw: Stimulate the brain with strong essential balm to secrete endorphins for pain relief and improve focus.
Rule.Translated: Estimula el cerebro con un potente bálsamo esencial para liberar endorfinas, aliviar el dolor y mejorar la concentración.

Rule.Original: An ointment that can stimulate nerves and make people more energetic.
Rule.Raw: An ointment that can stimulate nerves and make people more energetic.
Rule.Translated: Una pomada que estimula los nervios y da más energía a las personas.

Rule.Original: To exert anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects by inhibiting the activity of cyclooxygenase (COX).
Rule.Raw: To exert anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects by inhibiting the activity of cyclooxygenase (COX).
Rule.Translated: Ejerce efectos antiinflamatorios, analgésicos y antipiréticos al inhibir la actividad de la ciclooxigenasa (COX).

Rule.Original: A non steroidal anti-inflammatory drug that can relieve fever and pain. May cause drowsiness.
Rule.Raw: A non steroidal anti-inflammatory drug that can relieve fever and pain. May cause drowsiness.
Rule.Translated: Un antiinflamatorio no esteroideo que puede aliviar la fiebre y el dolor. Puede provocar somnolencia.

Rule.Original: Broad spectrum antibiotics, used to combat various bacterial diseases.
Rule.Raw: Broad spectrum antibiotics, used to combat various bacterial diseases.
Rule.Translated: Antibióticos de amplio espectro para combatir diversas enfermedades bacterianas.

Rule.Original: A common tool used to combat various bacterial diseases.
Rule.Raw: A common tool used to combat various bacterial diseases.
Rule.Translated: Un medio común para combatir diversas enfermedades bacterianas.

Rule.Original: A short barreled spear rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Has a fast firing rate, but a compromising range.
Rule.Raw: A short barreled spear rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Has a fast firing rate, but a compromising range.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil Spear de cañón corto procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Tiene una cadencia de disparo rápida, a costa de un alcance limitado.

Rule.Original: A 6.8 caliber standard rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Equipped with a variable magnification sight.
Rule.Raw: A 6.8 caliber standard rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Equipped with a variable magnification sight.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil estándar de calibre 6.8 procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Está equipado con una mira de aumento variable.

Rule.Original: A modified heavy barrel MCXspear originating from some ancient military supplier. It's been modified to be .300 caliber, suitable for medium range combat.
Rule.Raw: A modified heavy barrel MCXspear originating from some ancient military supplier. It's been modified to be .300 caliber, suitable for medium range combat.
Rule.Translated: Un MCXspear de cañón pesado modificado procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Se ha adaptado al calibre .300 y resulta adecuado para combates a media distancia.

Rule.Original: A TKB022 rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It's been modded with a modified caliber of 6.8. Its accuracy is somewhat questionable as it is not designed for this caliber.
Rule.Raw: A TKB022 rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It's been modded with a modified caliber of 6.8. Its accuracy is somewhat questionable as it is not designed for this caliber.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil TKB022 procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar, modificado para utilizar el calibre 6.8. Su precisión es algo dudosa, ya que no se diseñó para esta munición.

Rule.Original: An AK rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. With a caliber of 6.8, its been modified to have high power and fast firing rate. Due to the short barrel, the range is not optimal.
Rule.Raw: An AK rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. With a caliber of 6.8, its been modified to have high power and fast firing rate. Due to the short barrel, the range is not optimal.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil AK procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Se ha modificado para utilizar el calibre 6.8 y ofrecer una gran potencia y cadencia de disparo. Su cañón corto limita el alcance.

Rule.Original: A 6.8 caliber SCAR originating from some ancient military supplier. Poses a terrifying threat at medium range.
Rule.Raw: A 6.8 caliber SCAR originating from some ancient military supplier. Poses a terrifying threat at medium range.
Rule.Translated: Un SCAR de calibre 6.8 procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Supone una amenaza aterradora a media distancia.

Rule.Original: A buttless experimental 6.8 caliber weapon originating from some ancient military supplier. It has a sluggish firing rate and a longer barrel that enhances its long-range accuracy.
Rule.Raw: A buttless experimental 6.8 caliber weapon originating from some ancient military supplier. It has a sluggish firing rate and a longer barrel that enhances its long-range accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Un arma experimental sin culata de calibre 6.8 procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Tiene una cadencia de disparo lenta y un cañón largo que mejora la precisión a larga distancia.

Rule.Original: A close combat specialized .300BLK assault rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. This modified version uses a longer barrel and stock, enhancing mid range accuracy.
Rule.Raw: A close combat specialized .300BLK assault rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. This modified version uses a longer barrel and stock, enhancing mid range accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto .300BLK especializado en combate cercano, procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Esta versión modificada utiliza un cañón y una culata más largos para mejorar la precisión a media distancia.

Rule.Original: A specialized .300BLK assault rifle for close combat originating from some ancient military supplier. This modified version uses a short barrel and large drum for higher intensity at close range.
Rule.Raw: A specialized .300BLK assault rifle for close combat originating from some ancient military supplier. This modified version uses a short barrel and large drum for higher intensity at close range.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto .300BLK especializado en combate cercano, procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Esta versión modificada utiliza un cañón corto y un gran tambor para combatir con mayor intensidad a corta distancia.

Rule.Original: A semi-automatic high-precision civilian AR rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses special air pointed bullets and has a strong stopping effect.
Rule.Raw: A semi-automatic high-precision civilian AR rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses special air pointed bullets and has a strong stopping effect.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil AR civil semiautomático de alta precisión procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Utiliza proyectiles especiales de punta hueca y tiene un gran poder de parada.

Rule.Original: Customized M4A1 carbine originating from some ancient military supplier. Very light.
Rule.Raw: Customized M4A1 carbine originating from some ancient military supplier. Very light.
Rule.Translated: Una carabina M4A1 personalizada procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Muy ligera.

Rule.Original: A new model M4A1 of military regulations originating from some ancient military supplier. It is equipped with a silencer.
Rule.Raw: A new model M4A1 of military regulations originating from some ancient military supplier. It is equipped with a silencer.
Rule.Translated: Un nuevo modelo de M4A1 de especificación militar procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Está equipado con un silenciador.

Rule.Original: A self modified large drum close combat M4 originating from some ancient military supplier. It has strong firepower at close range，with a thermal imaging sight and flashlight. Great for close range indoor combat.
Rule.Raw: A self modified large drum close combat M4 originating from some ancient military supplier. It has strong firepower at close range，with a thermal imaging sight and flashlight. Great for close range indoor combat.
Rule.Translated: Un M4 modificado para combate cercano con un gran tambor, procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Tiene una gran potencia de fuego a corta distancia, además de una mira térmica y una linterna. Es excelente para combatir en interiores.

Rule.Original: The ultimate form of the short barrel M4, originating from some ancient military supplier. It is equipped with a strong flashlight and large drum, along with an adjustable magnification scope to ensure range.
Rule.Raw: The ultimate form of the short barrel M4, originating from some ancient military supplier. It is equipped with a strong flashlight and large drum, along with an adjustable magnification scope to ensure range.
Rule.Translated: La versión definitiva del M4 de cañón corto, procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Está equipada con una potente linterna, un gran tambor y una mira de aumento ajustable para mantener el alcance.

Rule.Original: A 5.56-caliber AK assault rifle originating from some ancient military supplier with very low recoil.
Rule.Raw: A 5.56-caliber AK assault rifle originating from some ancient military supplier with very low recoil.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto AK de calibre 5.56 procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar, con muy poco retroceso.

Rule.Original: A silencing assault rifle used in special operations originating from some ancient military supplier. It is quite lethal but has limited range.
Rule.Raw: A silencing assault rifle used in special operations originating from some ancient military supplier. It is quite lethal but has limited range.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto silenciado para operaciones especiales procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Es muy letal, pero tiene un alcance limitado.

Rule.Original: A silencing sniper rifle used in special operations originating from some ancient military supplier. Can shoot automatically, which is very lethal but has limited range and a small magazine.
Rule.Raw: A silencing sniper rifle used in special operations originating from some ancient military supplier. Can shoot automatically, which is very lethal but has limited range and a small magazine.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de francotirador silenciado para operaciones especiales procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Puede disparar en automático y es muy letal, pero tiene un alcance limitado y un cargador pequeño.

Rule.Original: A .308 caliber buttless rifle MDR originating from some ancient military supplier. It has high accuracy and controllable recoil, allowing for fully automatic shooting.
Rule.Raw: A .308 caliber buttless rifle MDR originating from some ancient military supplier. It has high accuracy and controllable recoil, allowing for fully automatic shooting.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil MDR sin culata de calibre .308 procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Su gran precisión y retroceso controlable permiten disparar en automático.

Rule.Original: A 762 NATO caliber assault rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It is long and not very flexible, equipped with a silencer.
Rule.Raw: A 762 NATO caliber assault rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It is long and not very flexible, equipped with a silencer.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto de calibre 762 NATO procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Es largo y poco manejable, y está equipado con un silenciador.

Rule.Original: A semi-automatic DMR produced by an ancient company named Remington. It has high shooting accuracy.
Rule.Raw: A semi-automatic DMR produced by an ancient company named Remington. It has high shooting accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Un DMR semiautomático fabricado por una antigua empresa llamada Remington. Tiene una gran precisión de tiro.

Rule.Original: A 7.62 NATO caliber DMR originating from some ancient military supplier. It was modified using a close range kit.
Rule.Raw: A 7.62 NATO caliber DMR originating from some ancient military supplier. It was modified using a close range kit.
Rule.Translated: Un DMR de calibre 7.62 NATO procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Modificado con un kit para corta distancia.

Rule.Original: A Civil .308 single shot hunting rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It is powerful but has very little ammunition capacity.
Rule.Raw: A Civil .308 single shot hunting rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It is powerful but has very little ammunition capacity.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de caza civil de un solo disparo de calibre .308 procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Es potente, pero su capacidad de munición es muy reducida.

Rule.Original: A specially customized M700 bolt action sniper rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Has good accuracy and is light weight.
Rule.Raw: A specially customized M700 bolt action sniper rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Has good accuracy and is light weight.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de francotirador de cerrojo M700 especialmente personalizado, procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Es ligero y tiene buena precisión.

Rule.Original: A semi-automatic DMR with a caliber of .338LM originating from some ancient military supplier. With its terrifying power and massive gunfire, in ancient times it earned the nickname Mjölnir.
Rule.Raw: A semi-automatic DMR with a caliber of .338LM originating from some ancient military supplier. With its terrifying power and massive gunfire, in ancient times it earned the nickname Mjölnir.
Rule.Translated: Un DMR semiautomático de calibre .338LM procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Su potencia aterradora y su intenso fuego le valieron en la antigüedad el apodo de Mjölnir.

Rule.Original: The lightest general-purpose machine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. Paired with large caliber armor piercing shells and variable magnification sights, it gives an advantage at any distance.
Rule.Raw: The lightest general-purpose machine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. Paired with large caliber armor piercing shells and variable magnification sights, it gives an advantage at any distance.
Rule.Translated: La ametralladora de uso general más ligera, procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Combinada con munición perforante de gran calibre y miras de aumento variable, ofrece ventaja a cualquier distancia.

Rule.Original: The lightest general-purpose machine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. Paired with large caliber armor piercing shells and close combat sights, it makes a terrifying close range weapon.
Rule.Raw: The lightest general-purpose machine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. Paired with large caliber armor piercing shells and close combat sights, it makes a terrifying close range weapon.
Rule.Translated: La ametralladora de uso general más ligera, procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Combinada con munición perforante de gran calibre y miras de combate cercano, es un arma aterradora a corta distancia.

Rule.Original: A fully automatic rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Has poor accuracy but extremely powerful damage.
Rule.Raw: A fully automatic rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Has poor accuracy but extremely powerful damage.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil automático procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Tiene poca precisión, pero causa daños extraordinarios.

Rule.Original: A medium to close range submachine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. It is equipped with a silencer, which is very flexible and uses Armor piercing pistol cartridges.
Rule.Raw: A medium to close range submachine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. It is equipped with a silencer, which is very flexible and uses Armor piercing pistol cartridges.
Rule.Translated: Un subfusil para distancias cortas y medias procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Es muy manejable, lleva un silenciador y utiliza cartuchos de pistola perforantes.

Rule.Original: A weapon originating from some ancient military supplier. Extending the barrel of the MPX gives it a combat range similar to that of a rifle, but sacrifices some flexibility.
Rule.Raw: A weapon originating from some ancient military supplier. Extending the barrel of the MPX gives it a combat range similar to that of a rifle, but sacrifices some flexibility.
Rule.Translated: Un arma procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. El cañón alargado del MPX le da un alcance de combate similar al de un fusil, a costa de cierta manejabilidad.

Rule.Original: A civilian semi-automatic carbine originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses a heavy pistol bullet, which is very precise but it doesn't deal a lot of damage.
Rule.Raw: A civilian semi-automatic carbine originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses a heavy pistol bullet, which is very precise but it doesn't deal a lot of damage.
Rule.Translated: Una carabina civil semiautomática procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Utiliza proyectiles pesados de pistola y es muy precisa, pero causa pocos daños.

Rule.Original: A civilian semi-automatic carbine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses a heavy handgun cartridge with a modified silencing brake and magnifying glass, which increases the range compared to the original version.
Rule.Raw: A civilian semi-automatic carbine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses a heavy handgun cartridge with a modified silencing brake and magnifying glass, which increases the range compared to the original version.
Rule.Translated: Una carabina civil semiautomática procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Utiliza cartuchos pesados de pistola y cuenta con un freno silenciador modificado y una mira de aumento que amplían su alcance respecto a la versión original.

Rule.Original: A fully automatic submachine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. Very light.
Rule.Raw: A fully automatic submachine gun originating from some ancient military supplier. Very light.
Rule.Translated: Un subfusil totalmente automático procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Muy ligero.

Rule.Original: A small semi-automatic pistol originating from some ancient military supplier.
Rule.Raw: A small semi-automatic pistol originating from some ancient military supplier.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña pistola semiautomática procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar.

Rule.Original: A semi-automatic pistol using special ammunition. Originating from some ancient military supplier.
Rule.Raw: A semi-automatic pistol using special ammunition. Originating from some ancient military supplier.
Rule.Translated: Una pistola semiautomática de munición especial procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar.

Rule.Original: A special pistol originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses armor piercing bullets, with a large capacity and high firing rate.
Rule.Raw: A special pistol originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses armor piercing bullets, with a large capacity and high firing rate.
Rule.Translated: Una pistola especial procedente de un antiguo proveedor militar. Utiliza munición perforante y tiene una gran capacidad y cadencia de disparo.

Rule.Original: Experimental type ultra-high bore pressure tungsten core armor piercing discarding sabot，only special thick barrels can withstand the chamber pressure of this type of bullet.
Rule.Raw: Experimental type ultra-high bore pressure tungsten core armor piercing discarding sabot，only special thick barrels can withstand the chamber pressure of this type of bullet.
Rule.Translated: Munición perforante experimental de núcleo de tungsteno y sabot desechable que genera una presión extremadamente alta. Solo los cañones especialmente gruesos pueden soportar la presión que produce en la recámara.

Rule.Original: Upgrade to M1083 6x6 MTV with better capacity.
Rule.Raw: Upgrade to M1083 6x6 MTV with better capacity.
Rule.Translated: Mejora a un M1083 6x6 MTV con mayor capacidad.

Rule.Original: Upgrade to M1083 6x6 MTV with better capacity.
Rule.Raw: Upgrade to M1083 6x6 MTV with better capacity.
Rule.Translated: Mejora a un M1083 6x6 MTV con mayor capacidad.

Rule.Original: Add M134 RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add M134 RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade una estación de armas M134 RWS en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Add M230LF RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add M230LF RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade una estación de armas M230LF RWS en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Add M2HB RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add M2HB RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade una estación de armas M2HB RWS en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Add M2HB RWS with Javelin launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add M2HB RWS with Javelin launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade una M2HB RWS con lanzador Javelin en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Add Mk19 RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add Mk19 RWS on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade una Mk19 RWS en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Add Mk19 RWS with Javelin launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add Mk19 RWS with Javelin launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade una Mk19 RWS con lanzador Javelin en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Add TOW Launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add TOW Launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade un lanzador TOW en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Add Mk19 Grenade Launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Raw: Add Mk19 Grenade Launcher on the top of the vehicle.
Rule.Translated: Añade un lanzagranadas Mk19 en la parte superior del vehículo.

Rule.Original: Anti-bio/Anti-group. A HE rocket turret, can shoot two HE rocket at once. It mainly used against non-fireproof creatures and monster clusters. Requires Chemfuel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Raw: Anti-bio/Anti-group. A HE rocket turret, can shoot two HE rocket at once. It mainly used against non-fireproof creatures and monster clusters. Requires Chemfuel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Translated: Antibiológico/Antigrupos. Una torreta de cohetes HE que puede disparar dos cohetes HE a la vez. Se utiliza contra criaturas sin resistencia al fuego y grupos de monstruos. Necesita quimiocombustible para recargarse tras un uso intenso. Puede explotar si sufre daños.

Rule.Original: A HE rocket launcher, can launch incendiary rockets. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Raw: A HE rocket launcher, can launch incendiary rockets. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzacohetes HE capaz de lanzar cohetes incendiarios. Diseñado para montarse en IFT.

Rule.Original: Medium range/Anti-light armor The turret was fitted with a large double-barreled shotgun, could fire two large shotgun shells in succession to suppress the enemy. Requires steel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged. *Ready sir, where's the trouble?
Rule.Raw: Medium range/Anti-light armor The turret was fitted with a large double-barreled shotgun, could fire two large shotgun shells in succession to suppress the enemy. Requires steel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged. *Ready sir, where's the trouble?
Rule.Translated: Alcance medio/Antiblindaje ligero. La torreta lleva una gran escopeta de dos cañones y puede disparar dos cartuchos grandes seguidos para suprimir al enemigo. Necesita acero para recargarse tras un uso intenso. Puede explotar si sufre daños. *Listo, señor. ¿Dónde está el problema?

Rule.Original: A large double-barreled shotgun, could fire anti-infantry shotgun shells, designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Raw: A large double-barreled shotgun, could fire anti-infantry shotgun shells, designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Translated: Una gran escopeta de dos cañones que dispara cartuchos antipersona, diseñada para montarse en IFT.

Rule.Original: Long range/Anti-light armor A duplex carbine turret, can shoot 10 charge blaster at once, and It has good accuracy. Requires steel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Raw: Long range/Anti-light armor A duplex carbine turret, can shoot 10 charge blaster at once, and It has good accuracy. Requires steel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Translated: Largo alcance/Antiblindaje ligero. Una torreta de carabina doble que dispara 10 proyectiles de carga a la vez con buena precisión. Necesita acero para recargarse tras un uso intenso. Puede explotar si sufre daños.

Rule.Original: A duplex carbine, can shoot charge blaster. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Raw: A duplex carbine, can shoot charge blaster. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Translated: Una carabina dúplex capaz de disparar proyectiles de bláster de carga. Diseñada para montarse en IFT.

Rule.Original: Single/Anti-heavy armor. A turret with a giant bow, can shoot AP arrow which blessed by a imperial mystery technology. Requires steel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Raw: Single/Anti-heavy armor. A turret with a giant bow, can shoot AP arrow which blessed by a imperial mystery technology. Requires steel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Translated: Objetivo individual/Antiblindaje pesado. Una torreta con un arco gigante que dispara flechas AP bendecidas por una misteriosa tecnología imperial. Necesita acero para recargarse tras un uso intenso. Puede explotar si sufre daños.

Rule.Original: A giant crossbow that can shoot a huge anti-armor arrow. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Raw: A giant crossbow that can shoot a huge anti-armor arrow. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Translated: Una ballesta gigante que dispara enormes flechas antiblindaje. Diseñada para montarse en IFT.

Rule.Original: Advanced anti-armor. A plasma turret, Can emit plasma beam and perfect for attacking large enemy while ignoring shields. Since it's an energy weapon it doesn't need ammo, but it does need more power. May explode when damaged. *No enemy is too big!
Rule.Raw: Advanced anti-armor. A plasma turret, Can emit plasma beam and perfect for attacking large enemy while ignoring shields. Since it's an energy weapon it doesn't need ammo, but it does need more power. May explode when damaged. *No enemy is too big!
Rule.Translated: Antiblindaje avanzado. Una torreta que emite haces de plasma, perfecta para atacar a enemigos grandes e ignorar sus escudos. Al ser un arma de energía, no necesita munición, pero consume más electricidad. Puede explotar si sufre daños. *¡Ningún enemigo es demasiado grande!

Rule.Original: A machine that emits plasma beams, Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Raw: A machine that emits plasma beams, Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina que emite haces de plasma, diseñada para montarse en IFT.

Rule.Original: Heavy bombing. A turret with rocket launcher that can fire up 6 armor-breaking rockets at once to attack the target. It has low blast coverage, but good for the heavy armor cluster. Of course, it works well on loots too. Requires chemfuel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Raw: Heavy bombing. A turret with rocket launcher that can fire up 6 armor-breaking rockets at once to attack the target. It has low blast coverage, but good for the heavy armor cluster. Of course, it works well on loots too. Requires chemfuel to reload after heavy use. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Translated: Bombardeo pesado. Una torreta con un lanzacohetes que dispara hasta 6 cohetes perforantes a la vez contra el objetivo. Su explosión cubre poca superficie, pero es eficaz contra grupos con blindaje pesado. También funciona bien contra el botín. Necesita quimiocombustible para recargarse tras un uso intenso. Puede explotar si sufre daños.

Rule.Original: A rocketswarm, can fire up 6 armor-breaking rockets at once. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Raw: A rocketswarm, can fire up 6 armor-breaking rockets at once. Designed to be mounted on IFT.
Rule.Translated: Un enjambre de cohetes capaz de disparar 6 cohetes antiblindaje a la vez. Diseñado para montarse en IFT.

Rule.Original: Battlefield Support. A plasma beam tower that can be temporarily deployed on the battlefield through airdrop and will self destruct when the time up. Before that, it could attract enemy fire and assist in battles.
Rule.Raw: Battlefield Support. A plasma beam tower that can be temporarily deployed on the battlefield through airdrop and will self destruct when the time up. Before that, it could attract enemy fire and assist in battles.
Rule.Translated: Apoyo en el campo de batalla. Una torre de haces de plasma que puede desplegarse temporalmente mediante lanzamiento aéreo y se autodestruye cuando se agota su tiempo. Hasta entonces, puede atraer el fuego enemigo y ayudar en los combates.

Rule.Original: This turret has a limited battery life. Once it runs out, it will stop working entirely.
Rule.Raw: This turret has a limited battery life. Once it runs out, it will stop working entirely.
Rule.Translated: Esta torreta tiene una batería de duración limitada. Cuando se agote, dejará de funcionar por completo.

Rule.Original: A machine that emits plasma beams, Designed to be mounted on turret.
Rule.Raw: A machine that emits plasma beams, Designed to be mounted on turret.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina que emite haces de plasma, diseñada para montarse en una torreta.

Rule.Original: Anti-group. A giant turret with low attack frequency, but the huge range allows it to attack any corner of the map, enough to deter enemys.
Rule.Raw: Anti-group. A giant turret with low attack frequency, but the huge range allows it to attack any corner of the map, enough to deter enemys.
Rule.Translated: Antigrupos. Una torreta gigante de baja cadencia, pero con un enorme alcance que le permite atacar cualquier rincón del mapa y disuadir a los enemigos.

Rule.Original:
A stasis cocoon containing a insect.

When conditions are inhospitable, insects sometimes form stasis cocoons and burrow underground. These cocoons keep insects safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats for years.

Pollutants can stimulate cocoons and cause them to resurface, and strong pollutants can attract cocoons from great distances.

Cocoons do nothing if they are not disturbed. If a cocoon is disturbed or destroyed, the insect within will awaken and attack, triggering other nearby cocoons in the process.
Rule.Raw:
A stasis cocoon containing a insect.

When conditions are inhospitable, insects sometimes form stasis cocoons and burrow underground. These cocoons keep insects safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats for years.

Pollutants can stimulate cocoons and cause them to resurface, and strong pollutants can attract cocoons from great distances.

Cocoons do nothing if they are not disturbed. If a cocoon is disturbed or destroyed, the insect within will awaken and attack, triggering other nearby cocoons in the process.
Rule.Translated:
Un capullo de estasis que contiene un insecto.

Cuando las condiciones son inhóspitas, los insectos a veces forman capullos de estasis y se entierran. Los capullos los protegen del fuego, las temperaturas extremas y otras amenazas durante años.

Los contaminantes pueden estimular los capullos y hacer que regresen a la superficie. Una contaminación intensa puede atraerlos desde grandes distancias.

Los capullos no hacen nada si no se los molesta. Si uno es perturbado o destruido, el insecto del interior despertará y atacará, activando otros capullos cercanos en el proceso.

Rule.Original: Two panels of plasteel that get placed on the sides under the arms, they wrap the wearer in a nanostrucure of carbonweave, providing a perfectly fitting body suit. It is robust, light and thin, but quite expensive and biocodes itself on first use. Carbon panels are designed to be reliable in unfamiliar environments. They help the wearer to control the temperature and dissipate any foreign bodies to the outside, while beeing quite resilient to fire. \n\n Pawns might decide on their own if they want to wear this AND biocode this item on their own, if they are allowed to.
Rule.Raw: Two panels of plasteel that get placed on the sides under the arms, they wrap the wearer in a nanostrucure of carbonweave, providing a perfectly fitting body suit. It is robust, light and thin, but quite expensive and biocodes itself on first use. Carbon panels are designed to be reliable in unfamiliar environments. They help the wearer to control the temperature and dissipate any foreign bodies to the outside, while beeing quite resilient to fire. \n\n Pawns might decide on their own if they want to wear this AND biocode this item on their own, if they are allowed to.
Rule.Translated: Dos paneles de plastiacero que se colocan a los lados, bajo los brazos, y envuelven al usuario en una nanoestructura de tejido de carbono que forma un traje ajustado a la perfección. Es resistente, ligero y fino, pero caro, y se biocodifica al usarlo por primera vez. Regula la temperatura y expulsa cuerpos extraños al exterior, con buena resistencia al fuego, para ser fiable en entornos desconocidos. \n\n Los personajes pueden decidir por sí mismos llevarlo Y biocodificarlo si tienen permiso.

Rule.Original: A limited-use psychic hacking device for mechanoids. It overwhelms the targetes defence and temporarily disrupt its connection to their overseer or hive, making them wander around aimlessly. A new overseer can connect to it afterwards. It has a long range but requires line of sight. This processs consumes charges depending on the bandwithcost of the targeted mech.

It overwhelms the targetes defence and temporarily disrupt its connection to their overseer or hive, making them wander around aimlessly. A new overseer can connect to it afterwards. It has a long range but requires line of sight. This processs consumes charges depending on the bandwithcost of the targeted mech.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de hackeo psíquico de usos limitados para mecanoides. Supera las defensas del objetivo e interrumpe temporalmente su conexión con el supervisor o la colmena, haciendo que deambule sin rumbo. Después, un nuevo supervisor puede conectarse a él. Tiene un gran alcance, pero requiere línea de visión. Consume cargas según el coste de ancho de banda del mecanoide objetivo.

Rule.Original:
A reuseable psychic hacking device for fixing mechanoids with failing systems. Requires line of sight. Needs to be refueled with components after 2 uses.

<color=#f8f32b>Usage:</color>
- destoy mechs with a limited power cell
- removes mental state problems
<color=#f8f32b>With [AV] Mechanoid orbital traders:</color>
- purge old connection data
- fix data breaches

Rule.Original:
A mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Band nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor. This will add 1 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids. Needs to be fueled with neutroamine by hand to work. 

Once a band node is constructed, it can be quickly tuned to a mechanitor. However, retuning a band node to a different mechanitor takes significantly longer.
Buildings powered by neutroamine have no problems with power fluctuations or solar flares, but are expensive to maintain.

Un amplificador de señal de banda mecanoide. Debe sintonizarse con un mecanitor concreto: añade 1 punto a su ancho de banda total para que controle más mecanoides. Necesita repostarse a mano con neutroamina para funcionar. 

Tras construirlo, puede sintonizarse rápidamente con un mecanitor. Resintonizarlo con otro mecanitor lleva bastante más tiempo.
Los edificios alimentados con neutroamina no sufren problemas por fluctuaciones eléctricas ni erupciones solares, pero su mantenimiento es caro.

Not suitable for cooling food.\nBuildings powered by neutroamine have no problems with power fluctuations or solar flares, but are expensive to maintain.

Rule.Original: A synthetic stimulant. Neurill changes the brains focus to concentrate on an installed mechlink making them far better mechanitors. However, taking neurill runs the risk of developing an addiction. Users without a mechlink are said to get a special high.
Rule.Raw: A synthetic stimulant. Neurill changes the brains focus to concentrate on an installed mechlink making them far better mechanitors. However, taking neurill runs the risk of developing an addiction. Users without a mechlink are said to get a special high.
Rule.Translated: Un estimulante sintético. El neurill dirige la atención del cerebro hacia un mecaenlace instalado y mejora mucho al mecanitor. Sin embargo, puede provocar adicción. Se dice que quienes carecen de mecaenlace experimentan una euforia peculiar.

Rule.Raw: Neurill in the bloodstream. It increases focus for mechlink users.

Rule.Translated: Debido a su adicción al neurill, esta persona necesita consumir la droga regularmente para evitar los síntomas de abstinencia.

Rule.Original: A chemical addiction to neurill. Long-term presence of neurill has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of neurill, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Raw: A chemical addiction to neurill. Long-term presence of neurill has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of neurill, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Translated: Una adicción química al neurill. Su presencia prolongada ha provocado adaptaciones neurológicas a nivel celular, por lo que el cerebro ya no funciona correctamente sin la droga. \nSin dosis regulares aparecen síntomas de abstinencia. Sin embargo, una abstinencia prolongada obliga al cerebro a recuperar su estado normal y resuelve la adicción.

Rule.Original: I feel all fuzzy and unfocused. And I'm so tired.
Rule.Raw: I feel all fuzzy and unfocused. And I'm so tired.
Rule.Translated: Estoy aturdido y no consigo concentrarme. Y tengo tanto sueño.

Rule.Original: A built-up tolerance to neurill. The more severe this tolerance is, the more neurill it takes to get the same effect.
Rule.Raw: A built-up tolerance to neurill. The more severe this tolerance is, the more neurill it takes to get the same effect.
Rule.Translated: Una tolerancia adquirida al neurill. Cuanto mayor sea, más neurill se necesita para obtener el mismo efecto.

Rule.Original: Refined luciferium. It enhances wound healing and can heal scars or even regrow missing body parts, but not without causing severe pain. It is not addictive and was once marketed as a cheap miracle cure to replace luciferium. The refining process takes a long time and is easy to mess up, which can cause the mechanites in the consumer's body to go haywire. A faulty batch sends the consumer in a long lasting coma, while the working product cures the patient after a week of severe pain.

Rule.Translated: Luciferium refinado. Potencia la curación de heridas y puede eliminar cicatrices o regenerar partes del cuerpo perdidas, pero causa un dolor intenso. No es adictivo y se vendió como cura milagrosa barata para sustituir al luciferium. El refinado es largo y delicado: los errores pueden descontrolar los mecanitos del consumidor. Una partida defectuosa provoca un coma prolongado; una correcta cura al paciente tras una semana de dolor intenso.

Rule.Original: Neuroferium mechanites working within the bloodstream cousing immense pain and enhanced cell regeneration even capeable of removing scars or regrowing lost bodyparts.
Rule.Raw: Neuroferium mechanites working within the bloodstream cousing immense pain and enhanced cell regeneration even capeable of removing scars or regrowing lost bodyparts.
Rule.Translated: Mecanitos de neuroferium actúan en el torrente sanguíneo, provocando un dolor inmenso y potenciando la regeneración celular, hasta el punto de eliminar cicatrices o regenerar partes del cuerpo perdidas.

Rule.Original: Neuroferium mechanites are running wild, severly disrupting bodily functions. It takes a long time for them to stop working, but it can be accelerated with a large amount of glitterworld medicine.
Rule.Raw: Neuroferium mechanites are running wild, severly disrupting bodily functions. It takes a long time for them to stop working, but it can be accelerated with a large amount of glitterworld medicine.
Rule.Translated: Los mecanitos de neuroferium están fuera de control y alteran gravemente las funciones del cuerpo. Tardan mucho en dejar de actuar, pero el proceso puede acelerarse con una gran cantidad de medicina de mundo brillante.
infusión de mecanitos contra el neuroferium

Rule.Original: This special medical operation uses a massive dose of mechanites to hunt down neuroferium mechanites to cures a patient's neuroferium posioning, but consumes a large amount of glitterworld medicine.
Rule.Raw: This special medical operation uses a massive dose of mechanites to hunt down neuroferium mechanites to cures a patient's neuroferium posioning, but consumes a large amount of glitterworld medicine.
Rule.Translated: Esta operación médica especial utiliza una dosis masiva de mecanitos para perseguir a los de neuroferium y curar la intoxicación del paciente. Consume una gran cantidad de medicina de mundo brillante.
{0} ha curado la intoxicación por neuroferium de {1}.

Rule.Original:
A neural implant from the days when mechlinks were still in the development phase, usually traded on black markets. It gives the user the ability to irrevocably trade brain capacity for increased mechlink features. While it can increase a mechanitor's power immensely, many individuals took it too far and became braindead, earning this implant the nickname "brain limiter." It can be self-installed without surgery, but there is no way to safely remove it.

<color=#f8f32b>Each Stage gains:
 10% reduced consciousness
 +2 bandwidth
 +10% bandwidth
 +10% mech workspeed
 +10% mech repair speed
 +15% mech gestation speed
 +5% psychic sensitivity</color>
Can be stacked up to 9 times.

Un implante neural de la época en que los mecaenlaces aún se desarrollaban, vendido normalmente en mercados negros. Permite sacrificar de forma irreversible capacidad cerebral para mejorar las funciones del mecaenlace. Aunque potencia enormemente al mecanitor, muchos abusaron de él y sufrieron muerte cerebral, de ahí su apodo «limitador cerebral». Puede instalarse sin cirugía por el propio usuario, pero no extraerse de forma segura.

<color=#f8f32b>Cada etapa otorga:
 10% menos consciencia
 +2 de ancho de banda
 +10% de ancho de banda
 +10% de velocidad de trabajo de mecanoides
 +10% de velocidad de reparación de mecanoides
 +15% de velocidad de gestación de mecanoides
 +5% de sensibilidad psíquica</color>
Puede acumularse hasta 9 veces.
Implantar eliminador de límites del mecaenlace

Rule.Original:
A bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. Compared to a real mechlink this device is quite limited, which allowed it to be sold to the public without the risk of individuals building armies. It is not as psychically binding as a real mechlink, making the removal (and destruction of it) by surgery possible. Not suitable for most additional mechanitor add-on implants.

Can not be removed from corpses.

This can be upgraded into a full mechlink with an mechlink enhancer implant.
Rule.Raw:
A bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. Compared to a real mechlink this device is quite limited, which allowed it to be sold to the public without the risk of individuals building armies. It is not as psychically binding as a real mechlink, making the removal (and destruction of it) by surgery possible. Not suitable for most additional mechanitor add-on implants.

Can not be removed from corpses.

This can be upgraded into a full mechlink with an mechlink enhancer implant.
Rule.Translated:
Un implante biónico que permite controlar mecanoides directamente. Es bastante limitado frente a un mecaenlace real, por lo que pudo venderse al público sin riesgo de que la gente formase ejércitos. Su vínculo psíquico es más débil, lo que permite extraerlo y destruirlo mediante cirugía. No es compatible con la mayoría de implantes adicionales para mecanitores.

No puede extraerse de cadáveres.

Puede mejorarse a un mecaenlace completo con un implante potenciador de mecaenlace.

Rule.Original:
A bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. Compared to a real mechlink this device is quiet limited, which allowed selling it to the public without getting individuals building armies.

Mechlinks are used by soldiers to control war mechs, and by workers to control labor mechs. A person with a mechlink is known as a mechanitor.

Mechlinks are self-installable. Pressed into the back of the throat, the unit injects itself through the flesh to clamp inside the base of the skull where it meets the spinal cord. There, it threads a web of ultrafine wires throughout nearby neuronal tissue to make the direct mental link between the user and the mechanoid control band.

Mechlinks are not simply devices for sending radio signals to mechanoids, because mechanoids are not merely robots. In addition to traditional computers, mechanoids have a dim psychic presence, so fluently controlling them requires a psychic connection. By linking mechanitor and mechanoid both psychically and electromagnetically, the mechlink permits deeper control than screen-and-button interfaces.

Since the mechlink interlaces deep within the brain tissue, it can only be removed after death.

Note: A mechanitor must be capable of smithing work to gestate mechanoids.
Rule.Raw:
A bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. Compared to a real mechlink this device is quiet limited, which allowed selling it to the public without getting individuals building armies.

Mechlinks are self-installable. Pressed into the back of the throat, the unit injects itself through the flesh to clamp inside the base of the skull where it meets the spinal cord. By linking mechanitor and mechanoid both psychically and electromagnetically, the mechlink permits deeper control than screen-and-button interfaces.

Since the mechlink interlaces deep within the brain tissue, it can only be removed after death.

Note: A mechanitor must be capable of smithing work to gestate mechanoids.
Rule.Translated:
Un implante biónico que permite controlar mecanoides directamente. Es bastante limitado frente a un mecaenlace real, por lo que pudo venderse al público sin que los individuos formasen ejércitos.

Los soldados utilizan mecaenlaces para controlar mecanoides de guerra, y los trabajadores para controlar mecanoides de trabajo. Una persona con mecaenlace se conoce como mecanitor.

Los mecaenlaces pueden instalarse por el propio usuario. Al presionar la unidad contra el fondo de la garganta, atraviesa la carne y se fija en la base del cráneo, donde se une a la médula espinal. Allí extiende una red de hilos ultrafinos por el tejido neuronal cercano y crea el enlace mental directo entre el usuario y la banda de control mecanoide.

Los mecaenlaces no se limitan a enviar señales de radio, porque los mecanoides no son simples robots. Además de ordenadores tradicionales, tienen una débil presencia psíquica, por lo que controlarlos con fluidez requiere una conexión psíquica. Al enlazar al mecanitor y al mecanoide de forma psíquica y electromagnética, el mecaenlace ofrece un control más profundo que las interfaces de pantallas y botones.

Como se entrelaza profundamente con el tejido cerebral, solo puede extraerse después de la muerte.

Nota: un mecanitor debe ser capaz de realizar trabajos de herrería para gestar mecanoides.

Rule.Original: This special medical operation removes the basic mechlink by a infusion of bacteriophage mechanites. The implant wont survive.
Rule.Raw: This special medical operation removes the basic mechlink by a infusion of bacteriophage mechanites. The implant wont survive.
Rule.Translated: Esta operación médica especial elimina el mecaenlace básico mediante una infusión de mecanitos bacteriófagos. El implante no sobrevivirá.

Rule.Original: A device for upgrading a basic mechlink to the real deal. It can be self-installed without surgery.
Rule.Raw: A device for upgrading a basic mechlink to the real deal. It can be self-installed without surgery.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo que convierte un mecaenlace básico en uno completo. Puede instalarse sin cirugía por el propio usuario.

Rule.Original: Recover a signal chip from an uninstalled mechlink. Any other components of the mechlink are wasted.
Rule.Raw: Recover a signal chip from an uninstalled mechlink. Any other components of the mechlink are wasted.
Rule.Translated: Recupera un chip de señal de un mecaenlace sin instalar. El resto de sus componentes se pierde.

Rule.Original: A neural implant which optimizes the interaction between a mechlink and bandnodes tuned to it. Each implant increases the bandwidth gained from bandnodes by 50%.\n\nThis implant can be installed up to 2 times to increase its effect.
Rule.Raw: A neural implant which optimizes the interaction between a mechlink and bandnodes tuned to it. Each implant increases the bandwidth gained from bandnodes by 50%.\n\nThis implant can be installed up to 2 times to increase its effect.
Rule.Translated: Un implante neural que optimiza la interacción entre un mecaenlace y los nodos de banda sintonizados con él. Cada implante aumenta en un 50% el ancho de banda obtenido de los nodos.\n\nPuede instalarse hasta 2 veces para aumentar su efecto.
Implantar expansor de nodo de banda

Rule.Original: A neural implant which optimizes the interaction between a mechlink and a bandnodes tuned to it. This increases the bandwidth gained from bandnodes.
Rule.Raw: A neural implant which optimizes the interaction between a mechlink and a bandnodes tuned to it. This increases the bandwidth gained from bandnodes.
Rule.Translated: Un implante neural que optimiza la interacción entre un mecaenlace y los nodos de banda sintonizados con él. Aumenta el ancho de banda obtenido de los nodos.

Rule.Original: This subdermal plating releases heat, increasing its carriers adaptivity to cold temperatures while reducing them to hot temperatures. Provides a bit of protection.
Rule.Raw: This subdermal plating releases heat, increasing its carriers adaptivity to cold temperatures while reducing them to hot temperatures. Provides a bit of protection.
Rule.Translated: Este revestimiento subdérmico libera calor. Aumenta la adaptación de su portador al frío, pero reduce su adaptación al calor. Proporciona algo de protección.

Rule.Original: This subdermal plating cools the body, increasing its carrier adaptivity to hot temperatures while reducing them to cold temperatures. Provides a bit of protection.
Rule.Raw: This subdermal plating cools the body, increasing its carrier adaptivity to hot temperatures while reducing them to cold temperatures. Provides a bit of protection.
Rule.Translated: Este revestimiento subdérmico enfría el cuerpo. Aumenta la adaptación de su portador al calor, pero reduce su adaptación al frío. Proporciona algo de protección.

Rule.Original: This subdermal armor implant makes the carrier more resistant to damage across their whole body, at the price of interfering with the immune system.
Rule.Raw: This subdermal armor implant makes the carrier more resistant to damage across their whole body, at the price of interfering with the immune system.
Rule.Translated: Este implante de armadura subdérmica hace que su portador resista mejor los daños en todo el cuerpo, a costa de perjudicar al sistema inmunitario.

Rule.Original: A brain implant which reduces the users pain sensitivity by moving parts of the pain signal to a subcore instead of to the brain.
Rule.Raw: A brain implant which reduces the users pain sensitivity by moving parts of the pain signal to a subcore instead of to the brain.
Rule.Translated: Un implante cerebral que reduce la sensibilidad al dolor del usuario desviando parte de la señal de dolor hacia un subnúcleo en vez de hacia el cerebro.

Rule.Original: A bland paste of microorganisms, bioengineered to serve as fuel for biopods or as emergency food. Babies won't mind it, but children and adults will be annoyed if they are forced to eat it.
Rule.Raw: A bland paste of microorganisms, bioengineered to serve as fuel for biopods or as emergency food. Babies won't mind it, but children and adults will be annoyed if they are forced to eat it.
Rule.Translated: Una pasta insípida de microorganismos modificados mediante bioingeniería para servir como combustible de biocápsulas o como comida de emergencia. A los bebés no les molesta, pero a los niños y adultos les disgusta tener que comerla.

Rule.Original: I had to eat neurofoam. Utterly disgusting.
Rule.Raw: I had to eat neurofoam. Utterly disgusting.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que comer neuroespuma. Absolutamente repugnante.

Rule.Original: Refine neurofoam into pure neutroamine, removing all nutrition.
Rule.Raw: Refine neurofoam into pure neutroamine, removing all nutrition.
Rule.Translated: Refina neuroespuma hasta obtener neutroamina pura y elimina todos sus nutrientes.

Rule.Original: A bland paste of hemogen-like microorganisms, for these special guests. It has a worse hemogen density compared to human blood.
Rule.Raw: A bland paste of hemogen-like microorganisms, for these special guests. It has a worse hemogen density compared to human blood.
Rule.Translated: Una pasta insípida de microorganismos similares al hemógeno para esos invitados especiales. Tiene menor concentración de hemógeno que la sangre humana.

Rule.Original: Extract neurofoam into hemogen-like paste, this is a wasteful process.
Rule.Raw: Extract neurofoam into hemogen-like paste, this is a wasteful process.
Rule.Translated: Extrae una pasta similar al hemógeno a partir de neuroespuma. Es un proceso poco eficiente.

Rule.Original: Refine hemogen packs into synthetic blood.
Rule.Raw: Refine hemogen packs into synthetic blood.
Rule.Translated: Refina bolsas de hemógeno hasta obtener sangre sintética.

Rule.Original: An artillery shell containing compressed toxic waste. When fired, it will stick into the ground and pollute the area while releasing tox gas for some time before expiring.\n\nTox gas burns the lungs and eyes, causing a temporary shortness of breath and reduction in sight. Continued exposure to tox gas results in toxic buildup that can be lethal.
Rule.Raw: An artillery shell containing compressed toxic waste. When fired, it will stick into the ground and pollute the area while releasing tox gas for some time before expiring.\n\nTox gas burns the lungs and eyes, causing a temporary shortness of breath and reduction in sight. Continued exposure to tox gas results in toxic buildup that can be lethal.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil de artillería con residuos tóxicos comprimidos. Al dispararlo, se clava en el suelo y contamina la zona, liberando gas tóxico durante un tiempo hasta agotarse.\n\nEl gas tóxico quema los pulmones y los ojos, provocando temporalmente dificultad respiratoria y pérdida de visión. La exposición continua causa una acumulación tóxica que puede ser letal.

Rule.Original: A shell filled with a sleeping warurchin. On impact it will activate and hunt down any hostile creatures. While this makes a good surprise attack, their data processing is limited which makes them see nearly everybody as hostile.
Rule.Raw: A shell filled with a sleeping warurchin. On impact it will activate and hunt down any hostile creatures. While this makes a good surprise attack, their data processing is limited which makes them see nearly everybody as hostile.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil que contiene un erizo bélico dormido. Al impactar, se activa y persigue a las criaturas hostiles. Es eficaz para atacar por sorpresa, pero su limitada capacidad de procesamiento de datos hace que considere hostil a casi todo el mundo.

Rule.Original: Compressed toxic waste in a sealed canister. Dissolution will take considerably longer, even when not frozen. While they are robust they can still be damaged, releasing the waste inside.
Rule.Raw: Compressed toxic waste in a sealed canister. Dissolution will take considerably longer, even when not frozen. While they are robust they can still be damaged, releasing the waste inside.
Rule.Translated: Residuos tóxicos comprimidos en un recipiente sellado. Tardan mucho más en descomponerse, incluso sin congelar. Aunque son resistentes, pueden dañarse y liberar los residuos que contienen.

Rule.Original: Seal toxic wastepacks in a steel canister to contain it for a long time.
Rule.Raw: Seal toxic wastepacks in a steel canister to contain it for a long time.
Rule.Translated: Sella paquetes de residuos tóxicos en un recipiente de acero para contenerlos durante mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: Open a sealed toxic wastecontainer to reclaim small steel amounts.
Rule.Raw: Open a sealed toxic wastecontainer to reclaim small steel amounts.
Rule.Translated: Abre un contenedor sellado de residuos tóxicos para recuperar pequeñas cantidades de acero.

Rule.Original: A small pod which provides the perfect environment for cultivating microorganisms.
Rule.Raw: A small pod which provides the perfect environment for cultivating microorganisms.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña cápsula que proporciona el entorno perfecto para cultivar microorganismos.

Rule.Original: A small sealed pod that provides the perfect environment for cultivating microorganisms.
Rule.Raw: A small sealed pod that provides the perfect environment for cultivating microorganisms.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña cápsula sellada que proporciona el entorno perfecto para cultivar microorganismos.

Rule.Original: An unfinished mechanoid subcore of the standard type.
Rule.Raw: An unfinished mechanoid subcore of the standard type.
Rule.Translated: Un subnúcleo mecanoide de tipo estándar sin terminar.

Rule.Original: An unfinished mechanoid subcore of the high type.
Rule.Raw: An unfinished mechanoid subcore of the high type.
Rule.Translated: Un subnúcleo mecanoide de tipo superior sin terminar.

Rule.Original: Copy the engram of an existing standard subcore to a newly build one. This is a lengthy process.
Rule.Raw: Copy the engram of an existing standard subcore to a newly build one. This is a lengthy process.
Rule.Translated: Copia el engrama de un subnúcleo estándar existente a uno recién construido. Es un proceso largo.

Rule.Original: Copy the engram of an existing high subcore to a newly build one. This is a very lengthy process.
Rule.Raw: Copy the engram of an existing high subcore to a newly build one. This is a very lengthy process.
Rule.Translated: Copia el engrama de un subnúcleo avanzado existente a uno recién construido. Es un proceso muy largo.

Rule.Original: An unspecialized mechanoid micro-organ. A mechanitor may trigger a specialization to an already studied mechchips.
Rule.Raw: An unspecialized mechanoid micro-organ. A mechanitor may trigger a specialization to an already studied mechchips.
Rule.Translated: Un microórgano mecanoide sin especializar. Un mecanitor puede especializarlo en un tipo de chip mecanoide ya estudiado.

Rule.Original: A small mechanoid with an internal microorganism cultivation pod, designed to take care of biopods and cryptosleep caskets on long space trips. It is capable of slowly producing a nutritious but disgusting foam, while beeing quite energy efficient. But it moves slowly and is almost completely helpless in combat.\n\nIn the early age of space settlement, these mechanoids were widely used, but as tech advanced and the travelingtime got way shorter those mechanoids were no longer manufactured.
Rule.Raw: A small mechanoid with an internal microorganism cultivation pod, designed to take care of biopods and cryptosleep caskets on long space trips. It is capable of slowly producing a nutritious but disgusting foam, while beeing quite energy efficient. But it moves slowly and is almost completely helpless in combat.\n\nIn the early age of space settlement, these mechanoids were widely used, but as tech advanced and the travelingtime got way shorter those mechanoids were no longer manufactured.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño mecanoide con una cápsula interna de cultivo de microorganismos, diseñado para cuidar biocápsulas y sarcófagos de criptosueño durante viajes espaciales largos. Produce lentamente una espuma nutritiva pero repugnante y consume poca energía. Se mueve despacio y está casi indefenso en combate.\n\nSe usaba mucho al comienzo de la colonización espacial, pero dejó de fabricarse a medida que avanzó la tecnología y los viajes se hicieron mucho más cortos.

Rule.Original: A small mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. It is slow but can deal with blunt impacts quite well and comes with an inbuild jetpack. Originaly designed on generation ships for asteroid mining it was also used as an civilian security force.
Rule.Raw: A small mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. It is slow but can deal with blunt impacts quite well and comes with an inbuild jetpack. Originaly designed on generation ships for asteroid mining it was also used as an civilian security force.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño mecanoide construido para minar en lugares peligrosos. Es lento, resiste bien los impactos contundentes y lleva una mochila propulsora integrada. Diseñado originalmente en naves generacionales para la minería de asteroides, también se utilizó como fuerza de seguridad civil.

Rule.Original:
A heavy combat mechanoid that walks on three pairs of heavy legs. This variant is equipped with two attached missile launchers, making it very effective against bunched-up static defenders. Once their long range missiles are depleted it becomes somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics, but even without missiles its thick carapace and firepower should not be underestimated.

Rockets need to be refilled in the form of 15 chemfuel by another creature by hand.

 "Just use smokegrenades and advance! Little did we know that this devil did not care at all."
Rule.Raw:
A heavy combat mechanoid that walks on three pairs of heavy legs. This variant is equipped with two attached missile launchers, making it very effective against bunched-up static defenders. Once their long range missiles are depleted it becomes somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics, but even without missiles its thick carapace and firepower should not be underestimated.

Rockets need to be refilled in the form of 15 chemfuel by another creature by hand.

 "Just use smokegrenades and advance! Little did we know that this devil did not care at all."
Rule.Translated:
Un mecanoide de combate pesado con tres pares de patas robustas. Sus dos lanzamisiles son muy eficaces contra defensores estáticos agrupados. Al agotar los misiles de largo alcance, es vulnerable a tácticas móviles de ataque y retirada, pero su grueso caparazón y potencia de fuego siguen siendo temibles.

Otra criatura debe reponer los cohetes a mano, utilizando 15 unidades de biocombustible.

 «¡Usad granadas de humo y avanzad! No sabíamos que a ese demonio le daba igual».

Rule.Original: Launch a salve of up to 8 rockets at the targeted area.\n<color=#f8f32b>Consumes 15 chemfuel per rocket.</color>
Rule.Raw: Launch a salve of up to 8 rockets at the targeted area.\n<color=#f8f32b>Consumes 15 chemfuel per rocket.</color>
Rule.Translated: Lanza una salva de hasta 8 cohetes contra la zona objetivo.\n<color=#f8f32b>Consume 15 unidades de biocombustible por cohete.</color>
