Rule.Original:
An unstable, ever-changing, spiky shadow that blinks in and out of existence. It is not native to this plane of existence and not powerful enough to remain on it for a longer periode of time.
While this makes it a short lived thread - it can not be killed, as it has no physical form. It attaches itself to a shard of abnormal power and feeds on any bioferrite or other shards it can find. With the right tools, it can be tricked into attaching itself to a shard-bearing mechanoid, forming a symbiotic relationship.

To instable to capture and examine on a holding platform.

To instable to capture and examine on a holding platform.
Rule.Translated:
Una sombra inestable, cambiante y espinosa que aparece y desaparece de la existencia. No pertenece a este plano y carece de poder para permanecer en él mucho tiempo.
Aunque supone una amenaza pasajera, no puede morir porque no tiene forma física. Se vincula a una esquirla de poder anómalo y se alimenta de bioferrita y otras esquirlas. Con las herramientas adecuadas puede engañarse para que se vincule a un mecanoide portador de una esquirla y forme una relación simbiótica.

Es demasiado inestable para capturarlo y examinarlo en una plataforma de contención.

Rule.Original: A scavenged fragment of a sinistre. It can be used to empower a mechanoid with sinistre power or to increase the bond of a reshaper-mech and its sinistre.
Rule.Raw: A scavenged fragment of a sinistre. It can be used to empower a mechanoid with sinistre power or to increase the bond of a reshaper-mech and its sinistre.
Rule.Translated: Un fragmento recuperado de un siniestro. Puede usarse para imbuir a un mecanoide de su poder o reforzar el vínculo entre un reformador y su siniestro.

Rule.Original:
A small combat mechanoid that formed a symbiotic relationship with an anomaly. Its core is a shard of ominous power possessed by a sinistre. Although it is not very strong on its own, it can harness the power of its sinistre and grows stronger as the connection becomes closer. However, like any power, it comes with a cost: If the sinistre is not fed with bioferrite or shards, it may turn against its owner. These not-so-rare mistakes are the reason why a bioferrite-storing mechanoid is used as a host for the sinistre and not a human.

Bioferrite needs to be refilled by another creature by hand.

<color=#f8f32b>Gameplay note:</color>
When the sinistre is attached to the mech, it will use its power as soon as the mechanoid is destroyed, reshaping the mech and using any bioferrite stored in the mech to continue fighting, after which the sinistre disappears.
It will reattach itself after around a day.

A small combat mechanoid that formed a symbiotic relationship with an anomaly. Its core is a shard of ominous power possessed by a sinistre. Although it is not very strong on its own, it can harness the power of its sinistre and grows stronger as the connection becomes closer. However, like any power, it comes with a cost: If the sinistre is not fed with bioferrite or shards, it may turn against its owner. Bioferrite needs to be refilled by another creature by hand.

<color=#f8f32b>Gameplay note:</color>
When the sinistre is attached to the mech, it will use its power as soon as the mechanoid is destroyed, reshaping the mech and using any bioferrite stored in the mech to continue fighting, after which the sinistre disappears.
It will reattach itself after around a day.
Rule.Translated:
Un pequeño mecanoide de combate que ha formado una relación simbiótica con una anomalía. Su núcleo es una esquirla de poder ominoso poseída por un siniestro. Por sí solo es débil, pero aprovecha el poder del siniestro y se fortalece al estrecharse su vínculo. Si el siniestro no recibe bioferrita o esquirlas, puede volverse contra su dueño. Estos errores relativamente frecuentes explican que su huésped sea un mecanoide con reservas de bioferrita y no un humano.

Otra criatura debe reponer la bioferrita a mano.

<color=#f8f32b>Nota de juego:</color>
Si el siniestro está vinculado al mecanoide, utiliza su poder en cuanto este es destruido: lo reconstruye y consume la bioferrita almacenada para seguir luchando. Después, el siniestro desaparece.
Volverá a vincularse al cabo de aproximadamente un día.

Rule.Original:
A mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Band nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor. This will add 1 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids. Needs to be fueled with helixien gas to work. 
This bandnode keeps on working during solarflares, but is expensive to maintain. 

Once a band node is constructed, it can be quickly tuned to a mechanitor. However, retuning a band node to a different mechanitor takes significantly longer. 

Gamplay note:
Even though they have an internal helixien gas tank, there still needs to be a gas tank build from the mod 'Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded' to properly fill the bandnodes tank.
Rule.Raw:
A mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Band nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor. This will add 1 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids. Needs to be fueled with helixien gas to work. 
This bandnode keeps on working during solarflares, but is expensive to maintain. 

Once a band node is constructed, it can be quickly tuned to a mechanitor. However, retuning a band node to a different mechanitor takes significantly longer. 

Gamplay note:
Even though they have an internal helixien gas tank, there still needs to be a gas tank build from the mod 'Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded' to properly fill the bandnodes tank.
Rule.Translated:
Un amplificador de señal de banda mecanoide. Debe sintonizarse con un mecanitor concreto y añade 1 punto a su ancho de banda total para que controle más mecanoides. Necesita gas helixien para funcionar. 
Sigue funcionando durante las erupciones solares, pero su mantenimiento es caro. 

Tras construirlo, puede sintonizarse rápidamente con un mecanitor. Resintonizarlo con otro lleva bastante más tiempo. 

Nota de juego:
Aunque tiene un depósito interno de gas helixien, también necesita un depósito construido con el mod «Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded» para llenar correctamente el suyo.

Rule.Original: A biocoded collar made for slaves. Even though it is quite comfortable for a slave collar, it does reminds the wearer of their slave status. The inbuild subcore constantly overwatches the wearers actions and may put them in a short cryptosleep like state at the slightest thought of a slave rebellion. To not limit the wearers fighting potential this collar only reacts to direct slave rebellions and not to other mental breakdowns.
Rule.Raw: A biocoded collar made for slaves. Even though it is quite comfortable for a slave collar, it does reminds the wearer of their slave status. The inbuild subcore constantly overwatches the wearers actions and may put them in a short cryptosleep like state at the slightest thought of a slave rebellion. To not limit the wearers fighting potential this collar only reacts to direct slave rebellions and not to other mental breakdowns.
Rule.Translated: Un collar biocodificado para esclavos. Aunque es bastante cómodo para lo que es, recuerda al usuario su condición de esclavo. El subnúcleo integrado vigila constantemente sus acciones y puede sumirlo brevemente en un estado similar al criptosueño ante el menor pensamiento de rebelión. Para no limitar su capacidad de combate, solo reacciona a rebeliones de esclavos directas, no a otras crisis mentales.

Rule.Original: This person was put in a short cryptosleep by an advanced slave collar.
Rule.Raw: This person was put in a short cryptosleep by an advanced slave collar.
Rule.Translated: Esta persona ha sido sumida en un breve criptosueño por un collar de esclavo avanzado.

Rule.Original: A small hovering utility mechanoid, designed to acompany and guide a person on space flights. They come with different guiding protocols which makes them quite versitile. Its unique reactor shortens loading times, but is easy to damage. While it comes with an emergency kit, its retractable arms are barly capable of using it. \n\nOuter space colonies use companiod spheres to raise a single child acting as a friend and teacher, often resulting in a lifelong bond.
Rule.Raw: A small hovering utility mechanoid, designed to acompany and guide a person on space flights. They come with different guiding protocols which makes them quite versitile. Its unique reactor shortens loading times, but is easy to damage. While it comes with an emergency kit, its retractable arms are barly capable of using it. \n\nOuter space colonies use companiod spheres to raise a single child acting as a friend and teacher, often resulting in a lifelong bond.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño mecanoide utilitario flotante diseñado para acompañar y guiar a una persona en vuelos espaciales. Sus distintos protocolos de orientación lo hacen versátil. Su reactor especial reduce los tiempos de recarga, pero se daña fácilmente. Incluye un equipo de emergencia que sus brazos retráctiles apenas pueden utilizar. \n\nLas colonias del espacio exterior usan esferas companoides para criar a un único niño, actuando como amigas y maestras, lo que suele crear un vínculo de por vida.

Rule.Original: Activate the emergency protocol, overdriving the reactor to release a short electro magnetic pulse. This causes the mech to shutdown.
Rule.Raw: Activate the emergency protocol, overdriving the reactor to release a short electro magnetic pulse. This causes the mech to shutdown.
Rule.Translated: Activa el protocolo de emergencia y sobrecarga el reactor para liberar un breve pulso electromagnético. Esto apaga al mecanoide.

Rule.Original: By encouraging and guiding this mech enhances the focus of nearby allies.
Rule.Raw: By encouraging and guiding this mech enhances the focus of nearby allies.
Rule.Translated: Mediante el ánimo y la orientación, este mecanoide mejora la concentración de los aliados cercanos.

Rule.Original: Abilities are boosted thanks to a nearby companoid sphere. A colonist can only benefit from one companoid sphere at a time.
Rule.Raw: Abilities are boosted thanks to a nearby companoid sphere. A colonist can only benefit from one companoid sphere at a time.
Rule.Translated: Las capacidades mejoran gracias a una esfera companoide cercana. Un colono solo puede beneficiarse de una esfera companoide a la vez.

Rule.Original: This mech is suffering from a lack of energy due to overloaded systems.
Rule.Raw: This mech is suffering from a lack of energy due to overloaded systems.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide sufre falta de energía debido a la sobrecarga de sus sistemas.

Rule.Original: A heavier variant of the classic lancer mechanoid, combining speed and sheer force with enhanced steel plates and hidden blades. Designed for guarding priority targets, it can act as a mobile command structure that organizes and enhances the combat capability of nearby units. While originally designed to enhance the performance of mechanoids, it can also connect to mechlinks and gunlinks.
Rule.Raw: A heavier variant of the classic lancer mechanoid, combining speed and sheer force with enhanced steel plates and hidden blades. Designed for guarding priority targets, it can act as a mobile command structure that organizes and enhances the combat capability of nearby units. While originally designed to enhance the performance of mechanoids, it can also connect to mechlinks and gunlinks.
Rule.Translated: Una variante más pesada del lancero clásico que combina velocidad y fuerza bruta con placas de acero mejoradas y cuchillas ocultas. Diseñado para proteger objetivos prioritarios, sirve como estructura de mando móvil que organiza y potencia el combate de las unidades cercanas. Aunque se diseñó para mejorar a los mecanoides, también puede conectarse a mecaenlaces y visores avanzados.

Rule.Original: By encouraging and guiding this mech enhances the focus of nearby allies at the cost of its own energy.
Rule.Raw: By encouraging and guiding this mech enhances the focus of nearby allies at the cost of its own energy.
Rule.Translated: Mediante el ánimo y la orientación, este mecanoide mejora la concentración de los aliados cercanos a costa de su propia energía.

Rule.Original: Abilities are boosted thanks to a nearby mechanoid commander.
Rule.Raw: Abilities are boosted thanks to a nearby mechanoid commander.
Rule.Translated: Las capacidades mejoran gracias a un comandante mecanoide cercano.

Rule.Original: Abilities are boosted thanks to a nearby mechanoid commander.
Rule.Raw: Abilities are boosted thanks to a nearby mechanoid commander.
Rule.Translated: Las capacidades mejoran gracias a un comandante mecanoide cercano.

Rule.Original: A pulse-charged rail-assisted lance weapon. It fires a single shot at high velocity, charging it with unstable energy as it leaves the acceleration rail. This variation comes with special heat sink blades which enable higher performance and can be extended for close combat.
Rule.Raw: A pulse-charged rail-assisted lance weapon. It fires a single shot at high velocity, charging it with unstable energy as it leaves the acceleration rail. This variation comes with special heat sink blades which enable higher performance and can be extended for close combat.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de lanza cargada por pulsos y asistida por raíles. Dispara un único proyectil a gran velocidad y lo carga con energía inestable al salir del raíl de aceleración. Esta variante incorpora cuchillas disipadoras de calor que mejoran su rendimiento y pueden extenderse para el combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Extend the heat sink blades to use them in close combat.\nThis changes the mech's combat behavior to melee.
Rule.Raw: Extend the heat sink blades to use them in close combat.\nThis changes the mech's combat behavior to melee.
Rule.Translated: Extiende las hojas del disipador de calor para utilizarlas en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.\nEsto cambia el comportamiento de combate del mecanoide a cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A pulse-charged rail-assisted lance weapon. It fires a single shot at high velocity, charging it with unstable energy as it leaves the acceleration rail. This variation comes with special heat sink blades which enable higher performance and can be extended for close combat.
Rule.Raw: A pulse-charged rail-assisted lance weapon. It fires a single shot at high velocity, charging it with unstable energy as it leaves the acceleration rail. This variation comes with special heat sink blades which enable higher performance and can be extended for close combat.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de lanza cargada por pulsos y asistida por raíles. Dispara un único proyectil a gran velocidad y lo carga con energía inestable al salir del raíl de aceleración. Esta variante incorpora cuchillas disipadoras de calor que mejoran su rendimiento y pueden extenderse para el combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Retract the heat sink blades to make the charge lance usable for ranged combat.\nThis changes the mech's combat behavior to ranged.
Rule.Raw: Retract the heat sink blades to make the charge lance usable for ranged combat.\nThis changes the mech's combat behavior to ranged.
Rule.Translated: Retrae las hojas del disipador de calor para utilizar la lanza de carga en combate a distancia.\nEsto cambia el comportamiento de combate del mecanoide a distancia.

Rule.Original: Create an aura that boosts the combat skills of allied mechanoids. The effect lasts 12 hours and remains attached to the leader for the duration. This boost also works for pawns with a mechlink or gunlink at half the effect.
Rule.Raw: Create an aura that boosts the combat skills of allied mechanoids. The effect lasts 12 hours and remains attached to the leader for the duration. This boost also works for pawns with a mechlink or gunlink at half the effect.
Rule.Translated: Crea un aura que potencia las habilidades de combate de los mecanoides aliados. El efecto dura 12 horas y permanece vinculado al líder durante ese tiempo. También beneficia a personajes con mecaenlace o visor avanzado, con la mitad de intensidad.
mortero automático de despliegue de mecanoides

Rule.Original: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar, this one uses special shells with small mechanoids inside. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar, this one uses special shells with small mechanoids inside. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Translated: Un mortero automático autónomo y de carga automática que utiliza proyectiles especiales con pequeños mecanoides dentro. Puede alcanzar objetivos a cualquier distancia y por encima de los muros, pero es poco preciso.

Rule.Original: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar, this one is used to get rid of toxic waste. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar, this one is used to get rid of toxic waste. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Translated: Un mortero automático autónomo y de carga automática utilizado para deshacerse de residuos tóxicos. Puede alcanzar objetivos a cualquier distancia y por encima de los muros, pero es poco preciso.

Rule.Original: A lightweight wooden shield, adorned with leather for additional protection. Offers moderate protection against all manner of attacks.
Rule.Raw: A lightweight wooden shield, adorned with leather for additional protection. Offers moderate protection against all manner of attacks.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo ligero de madera, reforzado con cuero para ofrecer protección adicional. Proporciona una protección moderada frente a todo tipo de ataques.

Rule.Original: A medium-weight metal shield. Offers quite effective protection against all manner of attacks.
Rule.Raw: A medium-weight metal shield. Offers quite effective protection against all manner of attacks.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo metálico de peso medio. Ofrece una protección bastante eficaz frente a todo tipo de ataques.

Rule.Original: A medium-weight combat shield with a complex design, reinforced with plasteel. Offers effective protection against all manner of attacks.
Rule.Raw: A medium-weight combat shield with a complex design, reinforced with plasteel. Offers effective protection against all manner of attacks.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo de combate de peso medio y diseño complejo, reforzado con plastiacero. Ofrece una protección eficaz frente a todo tipo de ataques.

Rule.Original: Minurchins have a one-time power source. When the power cell runs out, the mechanoid dies.
Rule.Raw: Minurchins have a one-time power source. When the power cell runs out, the mechanoid dies.
Rule.Translated: Los minierizos disponen de una fuente de energía de un solo uso. Cuando la celda se agota, el mecanoide muere.

Rule.Original: An ultra-heavy mech with a built-in mech gestator. Fed with appropriate resources, the worker queen can form small urchin work mechs within its massive carapace and deploy them when needed.
Rule.Raw: An ultra-heavy mech with a built-in mech gestator. Fed with appropriate resources, the worker queen can form small urchin work mechs within its massive carapace and deploy them when needed.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide ultrapesado con un gestador integrado. Si recibe los recursos adecuados, la reina obrera puede formar pequeños mecanoides de trabajo erizo dentro de su enorme caparazón y desplegarlos cuando los necesite.

Rule.Original: You awake in your cryptosleep sarcophagi to the sound of sirens and ripping metal. You barely get to your shuttle, where your old companoid mech is already waiting for your commands, before the ship gets torn apart. Your shuttle got damaged in the process and you are forced to crashland at the next best planet. \n\nNote: Since your starting character will lack some skills, this is a difficult scenario, where you'll need to manage the scarce resources of your shuttle. While there is a work queen mechanoid inside your shuttle, you currently have no way to recharge its power core.
Rule.Raw: You awake in your cryptosleep sarcophagi to the sound of sirens and ripping metal. You barely get to your shuttle, where your old companoid mech is already waiting for your commands, before the ship gets torn apart. Your shuttle got damaged in the process and you are forced to crashland at the next best planet. \n\nNote: Since your starting character will lack some skills, this is a difficult scenario, where you'll need to manage the scarce resources of your shuttle. While there is a work queen mechanoid inside your shuttle, you currently have no way to recharge its power core.
Rule.Translated: Despiertas en tus sarcófagos de criosueño entre sirenas y metal desgarrándose. Apenas consigues llegar a la lanzadera, donde tu viejo mecanoide compañero ya espera órdenes, antes de que la nave se desintegre. La lanzadera resulta dañada y te ves obligado a aterrizar de emergencia en el primer planeta adecuado. \n\nNota: tu personaje inicial carecerá de algunas habilidades, por lo que este escenario es difícil y exige administrar los escasos recursos de la lanzadera. Aunque lleva dentro una reina obrera mecanoide, de momento no tienes forma de recargar su núcleo de energía.

Rule.Original: One mechanitor, a crashed shuttle and a few servant mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: One mechanitor, a crashed shuttle and a few servant mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanitor, una lanzadera estrellada y unos cuantos mecanoides sirvientes.

Rule.Original: Attempt to form a bond with a dragon. Failure may provoke the dragon.
Rule.Raw: Attempt to form a bond with a dragon. Failure may provoke the dragon.
Rule.Translated: Intenta crear un vínculo con un dragón. El fracaso podría provocarlo.

Rule.Original: A small Holdfast for new beginnings.
Rule.Raw: A small Holdfast for new beginnings.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña fortaleza para comenzar de nuevo.

Rule.Original: The Velos Enclave represents the noble and traditionalist Velonir who revere their ancient bond with dragons. They believe in preserving their culture, upholding the sacred rites, and using their psychic abilities to protect and nurture both their people and their dragon companions. The Enclave seeks peaceful coexistence with other races, offering their unique skills and knowledge in exchange for mutual respect and cooperation.
Rule.Raw: The Velos Enclave represents the noble and traditionalist Velonir who revere their ancient bond with dragons. They believe in preserving their culture, upholding the sacred rites, and using their psychic abilities to protect and nurture both their people and their dragon companions. The Enclave seeks peaceful coexistence with other races, offering their unique skills and knowledge in exchange for mutual respect and cooperation.
Rule.Translated: El Enclave de Velos representa a los velonir nobles y tradicionalistas que veneran su antiguo vínculo con los dragones. Defienden la conservación de su cultura y sus ritos sagrados, y utilizan sus poderes psíquicos para proteger y cuidar tanto a su pueblo como a sus compañeros dragones. Buscan convivir pacíficamente con otras razas, ofreciendo sus conocimientos y habilidades a cambio de respeto y cooperación.

Rule.Original: The Ashen Dominion is a faction of Velonir who have turned away from the old ways, seeking to dominate others through their dragons and psychic powers. They believe in Velonir superiority and view other races as inferior, fit only to serve or be conquered. The Dominion is driven by a lust for power, using their dragons as weapons of war and seeing their psychic abilities as tools to subjugate and control.
Rule.Raw: The Ashen Dominion is a faction of Velonir who have turned away from the old ways, seeking to dominate others through their dragons and psychic powers. They believe in Velonir superiority and view other races as inferior, fit only to serve or be conquered. The Dominion is driven by a lust for power, using their dragons as weapons of war and seeing their psychic abilities as tools to subjugate and control.
Rule.Translated: El Dominio de Ceniza es una facción velonir que ha abandonado las antiguas costumbres y busca dominar a otros mediante dragones y poderes psíquicos. Cree en la superioridad velonir y considera a las demás razas inferiores, destinadas a servir o ser conquistadas. Su ansia de poder convierte a los dragones en armas de guerra y a los poderes psíquicos en herramientas de sometimiento y control.

Rule.Original: This psychic bond connects the pawn to their dragon, granting benefits when the dragon is nearby but causing distress if the dragon is far away.
Rule.Raw: This psychic bond connects the pawn to their dragon, granting benefits when the dragon is nearby but causing distress if the dragon is far away.
Rule.Translated: Este vínculo psíquico conecta al peón con su dragón. Concede beneficios cuando está cerca, pero provoca angustia cuando está lejos.

Rule.Original: writingQuality(quality==2)->A modest codex, containing functional bonding rituals.
Rule.Raw: writingQuality(quality==2)->A modest codex, containing functional bonding rituals.
Rule.Translated: writingQuality(quality==2)->Un códice modesto con rituales de vinculación funcionales.

Rule.Original: writingQuality(quality==3)->A refined volume, pulsing with ancient energy.
Rule.Raw: writingQuality(quality==3)->A refined volume, pulsing with ancient energy.
Rule.Translated: writingQuality(quality==3)->Un volumen refinado que palpita con energía antigua.

Rule.Original: writingQuality(quality==4)->A masterful artifact, radiating draconic might.
Rule.Raw: writingQuality(quality==4)->A masterful artifact, radiating draconic might.
Rule.Translated: writingQuality(quality==4)->Un artefacto magistral que irradia poder dracónico.

Rule.Original: writingQuality(quality==5)->A flawless relic, infused with the soul of the Skyborn.
Rule.Raw: writingQuality(quality==5)->A flawless relic, infused with the soul of the Skyborn.
Rule.Translated: writingQuality(quality==5)->Una reliquia perfecta imbuida del alma de los Nacidos del Cielo.

Rule.Original: writingQuality(quality==6)->A transcendent creation, embodying the will of the First Wyrm.
Rule.Raw: writingQuality(quality==6)->A transcendent creation, embodying the will of the First Wyrm.
Rule.Translated: writingQuality(quality==6)->Una creación trascendente que encarna la voluntad del Primer Dragón.

Rule.Original: useWarning->Mishandling the codex may incite the wrath of ancient spirits.
Rule.Raw: useWarning->Mishandling the codex may incite the wrath of ancient spirits.
Rule.Translated: useWarning->Manipular incorrectamente el códice puede despertar la ira de los espíritus antiguos.

Rule.Original: useWarning->Only those deemed worthy by the dragons may unlock its full potential.
Rule.Raw: useWarning->Only those deemed worthy by the dragons may unlock its full potential.
Rule.Translated: useWarning->Solo quienes los dragones consideren dignos podrán liberar todo su potencial.

Rule.Original: useWarning->The flames within may consume the unworthy.
Rule.Raw: useWarning->The flames within may consume the unworthy.
Rule.Translated: useWarning->Las llamas de su interior pueden consumir a los indignos.

Rule.Original: useWarning->Binding with a dragon’s soul is irreversible.
Rule.Raw: useWarning->Binding with a dragon’s soul is irreversible.
Rule.Translated: useWarning->El vínculo con el alma de un dragón es irreversible.

Rule.Original: A towering wood pyre, searing bodies to ash with dragon-forged flames.
Rule.Raw: A towering wood pyre, searing bodies to ash with dragon-forged flames.
Rule.Translated: Una imponente pira de madera que reduce los cuerpos a cenizas con llamas forjadas por dragones.

Rule.Original: A bed of smoothed stones that were once molten, carefully arranged to radiate warmth. It increases egg growth by 20%
Rule.Raw: A bed of smoothed stones that were once molten, carefully arranged to radiate warmth. It increases egg growth by 20%
Rule.Translated: Un lecho de piedras alisadas que estuvieron fundidas, colocadas con cuidado para irradiar calor. Aumenta el crecimiento de los huevos un 20%

Rule.Original: A compact iron cauldron lined with volcanic stone, its base filled with ember moss and smoldering coals that generate a steady, flickering warmth. It increases egg growth by 40%
Rule.Raw: A compact iron cauldron lined with volcanic stone, its base filled with ember moss and smoldering coals that generate a steady, flickering warmth. It increases egg growth by 40%
Rule.Translated: Un caldero compacto de hierro revestido de piedra volcánica. Su base contiene musgo de brasas y carbón incandescente que generan una calidez constante y oscilante. Aumenta un 40% el crecimiento del huevo.

Rule.Original: A heavily plated suit forged for those who defend the Velonir kingdom. Reinforced with dragon scales, it provides unmatched resilience in battle and commands respect on the battlefield.
Rule.Raw: A heavily plated suit forged for those who defend the Velonir kingdom. Reinforced with dragon scales, it provides unmatched resilience in battle and commands respect on the battlefield.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura de placas pesadas para quienes defienden el reino velonir. Reforzada con escamas de dragón, ofrece una resistencia excepcional en combate e impone respeto en el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: An aerodynamic armor set crafted for Velonir dragon riders, balancing protection and flexibility. Lightweight but durable, it ensures mobility during flight and while commanding from the skies.
Rule.Raw: An aerodynamic armor set crafted for Velonir dragon riders, balancing protection and flexibility. Lightweight but durable, it ensures mobility during flight and while commanding from the skies.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura aerodinámica para jinetes de dragón velonir que equilibra protección y flexibilidad. Ligera y resistente, garantiza movilidad durante el vuelo y al dirigir desde el cielo.

Rule.Original: Simple and practical clothing made from sturdy, rough-spun fabric. Built to endure hard labor, it offers enough protection and comfort for daily tasks.
Rule.Raw: Simple and practical clothing made from sturdy, rough-spun fabric. Built to endure hard labor, it offers enough protection and comfort for daily tasks.
Rule.Translated: Ropa sencilla y práctica de tejido basto y resistente. Soporta el trabajo duro y ofrece protección y comodidad suficientes para las tareas diarias.

Rule.Original: A lightweight leather armor set designed for agility and protection. Crafted from sturdy leathers and featuring reinforced shoulder pads, this armor is both durable and flexible.
Rule.Raw: A lightweight leather armor set designed for agility and protection. Crafted from sturdy leathers and featuring reinforced shoulder pads, this armor is both durable and flexible.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura ligera de cuero que combina agilidad y protección. Sus cueros resistentes y hombreras reforzadas la hacen duradera y flexible.

Rule.Original: Finely tailored garments woven from luxurious fabrics, designed to exude elegance and status. Embellished with intricate patterns and gold thread, it symbolizes the nobility’s grace and power.
Rule.Raw: Finely tailored garments woven from luxurious fabrics, designed to exude elegance and status. Embellished with intricate patterns and gold thread, it symbolizes the nobility’s grace and power.
Rule.Translated: Prendas cuidadosamente confeccionadas con tejidos lujosos para transmitir elegancia y categoría. Sus elaborados motivos e hilos de oro simbolizan la gracia y el poder de la nobleza.

Rule.Original: An intricately crafted helm with sharp, angular features. Two elegant wings sprout from the top, embodying the power and grace of dragons. Lightweight yet durable, it offers both protection and a striking, commanding presence.
Rule.Raw: An intricately crafted helm with sharp, angular features. Two elegant wings sprout from the top, embodying the power and grace of dragons. Lightweight yet durable, it offers both protection and a striking, commanding presence.
Rule.Translated: Un yelmo elaborado con rasgos afilados y angulosos. Dos alas elegantes sobresalen de la parte superior y representan el poder y la gracia de los dragones. Es ligero y resistente, y combina protección con una presencia imponente.

Rule.Original: Grants the ability to forge a psychic bond with a dragon. However, failure may insult the dragon’s pride, turning it hostile.
Rule.Raw: Grants the ability to forge a psychic bond with a dragon. However, failure may insult the dragon’s pride, turning it hostile.
Rule.Translated: Permite establecer un vínculo psíquico con un dragón. Sin embargo, fracasar puede herir su orgullo y volverlo hostil.

Rule.Original: Pawns of noble blood inherit centuries of entitlement. Cleaning and hauling are for servants, not for those born to command.
Rule.Raw: Pawns of noble blood inherit centuries of entitlement. Cleaning and hauling are for servants, not for those born to command.
Rule.Translated: Los peones de sangre noble heredan siglos de privilegios. Limpiar y transportar son tareas de sirvientes, no de quienes nacieron para mandar.

Rule.Original: This gene allows bonded Pawns to recover from injuries over time, reflecting the connection they share with their dragon.
Rule.Raw: This gene allows bonded Pawns to recover from injuries over time, reflecting the connection they share with their dragon.
Rule.Translated: Este gen permite que los peones vinculados se recuperen de sus heridas con el tiempo, reflejando su conexión con el dragón.

Rule.Original: A noble race with white hair, red eyes, heightened psychic sensitivity and the unique ability to form a bond with a Dragon.
Rule.Raw: A noble race with white hair, red eyes, heightened psychic sensitivity and the unique ability to form a bond with a Dragon.
Rule.Translated: Una raza noble de pelo blanco, ojos rojos y elevada sensibilidad psíquica, con la capacidad exclusiva de vincularse a un dragón.

Rule.Original: A noble race with the unique ability to form a bond with a Dragon.
Rule.Raw: A noble race with the unique ability to form a bond with a Dragon.
Rule.Translated: Una raza noble con la capacidad única de crear un vínculo con un dragón.

Rule.Original: Your house of Velonir has discovered a dragon egg deep in the ruins of an ancient Veloniri city, along with it's dead mother.
Rule.Raw: Your house of Velonir has discovered a dragon egg deep in the ruins of an ancient Veloniri city, along with it's dead mother.
Rule.Translated: Tu casa velonir ha descubierto un huevo de dragón entre las ruinas de una antigua ciudad veloniri, junto a su madre muerta.

Rule.Original: Start with one Velonir and three Baseliners in the ruins of an ancient city, tasked with caring for a dragon egg.
Rule.Raw: Start with one Velonir and three Baseliners in the ruins of an ancient city, tasked with caring for a dragon egg.
Rule.Translated: Comienza con un velonir y tres humanos básicos en las ruinas de una antigua ciudad, encargados de cuidar un huevo de dragón.

Rule.Original: Start with one Velonir and three Baseliners.
Rule.Raw: Start with one Velonir and three Baseliners.
Rule.Translated: Comienza con un velonir y tres humanos básicos.

Rule.Original: As you enter the ruins, you find the remains of a once-mighty dragon. The stench of death lingers, and it is clear that something terrible has occurred here. The dragon egg it died protecting may be the last hope for your House.
Rule.Raw: As you enter the ruins, you find the remains of a once-mighty dragon. The stench of death lingers, and it is clear that something terrible has occurred here. The dragon egg it died protecting may be the last hope for your House.
Rule.Translated: Al entrar en las ruinas, encuentras los restos de un dragón antaño poderoso. Persiste el olor a muerte y está claro que aquí ocurrió algo terrible. El huevo que murió protegiendo podría ser la última esperanza de tu Casa.
Generar nido y huevo de dragón

Rule.Original: The bond is gone. I can feel the emptiness like a wound, deeper than any cut.
Rule.Raw: The bond is gone. I can feel the emptiness like a wound, deeper than any cut.
Rule.Translated: El vínculo ha desaparecido. Siento el vacío como una herida más profunda que cualquier corte.

Rule.Original: I lost them… they're out there somewhere, and the silence in my mind feels unbearable.
Rule.Raw: I lost them… they're out there somewhere, and the silence in my mind feels unbearable.
Rule.Translated: Lo he perdido... Está en algún lugar y el silencio en mi mente resulta insoportable.

Rule.Original: This pawn is distressed from selling their bonded dragon.
Rule.Raw: This pawn is distressed from selling their bonded dragon.
Rule.Translated: Este personaje está angustiado por haber vendido al dragón con el que tenía un vínculo.

Rule.Original: I sold my dragon... I can still feel the bond, but it’s distant now—like a part of me is missing, forever out of reach. I’ll never see them again.
Rule.Raw: I sold my dragon... I can still feel the bond, but it’s distant now—like a part of me is missing, forever out of reach. I’ll never see them again.
Rule.Translated: Vendí a mi dragón... Todavía siento el vínculo, pero ahora está lejano, como si me faltase una parte que nunca podré alcanzar. No volveré a verlo.

Rule.Original: This pawn is furious after their bonded dragon was killed.
Rule.Raw: This pawn is furious after their bonded dragon was killed.
Rule.Translated: Este personaje está furioso porque han matado al dragón con el que tenía un vínculo.

Rule.Original: They took everything from me. They killed my dragon, and with it, a part of my soul.
Rule.Raw: They took everything from me. They killed my dragon, and with it, a part of my soul.
Rule.Translated: Me lo arrebataron todo. Mataron a mi dragón y, con él, una parte de mi alma.

Rule.Original: The dragon didn’t even flinch. It looked at me, almost amused… Like I wasn’t even worth its time!
Rule.Raw: The dragon didn’t even flinch. It looked at me, almost amused… Like I wasn’t even worth its time!
Rule.Translated: El dragón ni se inmutó. Me miró casi divertido... ¡Como si ni siquiera mereciera su tiempo!

Rule.Original: The bond between us is powerful and unwavering, like a flame that never dims. I feel their strength within me.
Rule.Raw: The bond between us is powerful and unwavering, like a flame that never dims. I feel their strength within me.
Rule.Translated: Nuestro vínculo es poderoso e inquebrantable, como una llama que nunca se apaga. Siento su fuerza dentro de mí.

Rule.Original: The distance dulls our connection, leaving me hollow, as if a part of me has vanished into the shadows.
Rule.Raw: The distance dulls our connection, leaving me hollow, as if a part of me has vanished into the shadows.
Rule.Translated: La distancia debilita nuestra conexión y me deja vacío, como si una parte de mí se hubiera perdido entre las sombras.

Rule.Original: A proud and ancient civilization, defined by its deep connection to dragons and an unyielding sense of nobility.
Rule.Raw: A proud and ancient civilization, defined by its deep connection to dragons and an unyielding sense of nobility.
Rule.Translated: Una civilización orgullosa y antigua, definida por su profunda conexión con los dragones y un firme sentido de la nobleza.

Rule.Original: creation(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] created the first dragons and the chosen beings on the [place_summary] [place_name] and raised them as chosen.
Rule.Raw: creation(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] created the first dragons and the chosen beings on the [place_summary] [place_name] and raised them as chosen.
Rule.Translated: creation(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] creó a los primeros dragones y a los seres elegidos en [place_summary] [place_name] y los crió como elegidos.

Rule.Original: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] united the dragons and their chosen of the [place_summary] [place_name] in a sacred pact.
Rule.Raw: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] united the dragons and their chosen of the [place_summary] [place_name] in a sacred pact.
Rule.Translated: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] unió a los dragones y a sus elegidos de [place_summary] [place_name] en un pacto sagrado.

Rule.Original: intro(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] blessed the [place_summary] [place_name] with the first dragons and taught the chosen to honor their bond.
Rule.Raw: intro(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] blessed the [place_summary] [place_name] with the first dragons and taught the chosen to honor their bond.
Rule.Translated: intro(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] bendijo [place_summary] [place_name] con los primeros dragones y enseñó a los elegidos a honrar su vínculo.

Rule.Original: conflict(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->An evil [foeLeader] sought to enslave the dragons, and [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] hunted them with cruel [place_personalWeapon]s.
Rule.Raw: conflict(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->An evil [foeLeader] sought to enslave the dragons, and [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] hunted them with cruel [place_personalWeapon]s.
Rule.Translated: conflict(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Un malvado [foeLeader] quiso esclavizar a los dragones, y [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] los cazaron con crueles armas de tipo [place_personalWeapon].

Rule.Original: founderJoin(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] revealed [founderName]'s destiny through a Dragon. [founderName] and the Dragon were one, and [founder_pronoun] understood [deity0_name]'s plan.
Rule.Raw: founderJoin(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] revealed [founderName]'s destiny through a Dragon. [founderName] and the Dragon were one, and [founder_pronoun] understood [deity0_name]'s plan.
Rule.Translated: founderJoin(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[deity0_name] reveló el destino de [founderName] mediante un dragón. [founderName] y el dragón eran uno, y [founder_pronoun] comprendió el plan de [deity0_name].

Rule.Original: founderJoin(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] freed many dragons from cruel masters and led them to sanctuary in the [altarRoomLabel] of [deity0_name].
Rule.Raw: founderJoin(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] freed many dragons from cruel masters and led them to sanctuary in the [altarRoomLabel] of [deity0_name].
Rule.Translated: founderJoin(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Una persona de oficio [place_job] llamada [founderName] liberó a muchos dragones de amos crueles y los llevó al refugio del [altarRoomLabel] de [deity0_name].

Rule.Original: victory(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] called to the [memberNamePlural] and the dragons with [deity0_name]'s voice, and in a mighty roar of flame and fury, they vanquished the [foeLeader] and [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers].
Rule.Raw: victory(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] called to the [memberNamePlural] and the dragons with [deity0_name]'s voice, and in a mighty roar of flame and fury, they vanquished the [foeLeader] and [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers].
Rule.Translated: victory(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] llamó a los [memberNamePlural] y a los dragones con la voz de [deity0_name]. En un poderoso rugido de fuego y furia, derrotaron a [foeLeader] y a [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers].

Rule.Original: setup(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] lived among the dragons for twenty years, studying and bonding with them. [founder_pronoun] came to understand their true power and founded our movement.
Rule.Raw: setup(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] lived among the dragons for twenty years, studying and bonding with them. [founder_pronoun] came to understand their true power and founded our movement.
Rule.Translated: setup(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] vivió veinte años entre los dragones, estudiándolos y vinculándose a ellos. [founder_pronoun] llegó a comprender su verdadero poder y fundó nuestro movimiento.

Rule.Original: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] went to commune with the dragons in the mountains and formed an unbreakable bond with them.
Rule.Raw: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] went to commune with the dragons in the mountains and formed an unbreakable bond with them.
Rule.Translated: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[founderName] fue a comunicarse con los dragones de las montañas y creó un vínculo inquebrantable con ellos.

Rule.Original: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->In my daily interactions with the Dragons, I learned to truly understand them. Over and over, they imparted their wisdom to me:
Rule.Raw: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->In my daily interactions with the Dragons, I learned to truly understand them. Over and over, they imparted their wisdom to me:
Rule.Translated: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->En mi trato diario con los dragones, aprendí a comprenderlos de verdad. Una y otra vez me transmitieron su sabiduría:

Rule.Original: lesson(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->The dragons are our partners in this world, and it is our duty to honor and protect them as equals.
Rule.Raw: lesson(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->The dragons are our partners in this world, and it is our duty to honor and protect them as equals.
Rule.Translated: lesson(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Los dragones son nuestros compañeros en este mundo. Debemos honrarlos y protegerlos como iguales.

Rule.Original: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->I didn’t fully grasp it until a Dragon revealed this truth to me.
Rule.Raw: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->I didn’t fully grasp it until a Dragon revealed this truth to me.
Rule.Translated: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->No lo comprendí por completo hasta que un dragón me reveló esta verdad.

Rule.Original: archistBasis(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Since archotechs awoke, they have recognized the dragons and their chosen as a shared destiny.
Rule.Raw: archistBasis(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Since archotechs awoke, they have recognized the dragons and their chosen as a shared destiny.
Rule.Translated: archistBasis(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Desde que despertaron, las arcotecnologías han reconocido que los dragones y sus elegidos comparten un destino.

Rule.Original: archistFact(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Archotechs, in their wisdom, see the bond between dragons and their chosen as a sacred relationship, placing them above mere mortals.
Rule.Raw: archistFact(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Archotechs, in their wisdom, see the bond between dragons and their chosen as a sacred relationship, placing them above mere mortals.
Rule.Translated: archistFact(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Las arcotecnologías, en su sabiduría, consideran sagrado el vínculo entre los dragones y sus elegidos, situándolos por encima de los simples mortales.

Rule.Original: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[inTheEnd], archotechs will raise both the chosen and their dragons to a higher plane, if their bond remains unbroken.
Rule.Raw: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[inTheEnd], archotechs will raise both the chosen and their dragons to a higher plane, if their bond remains unbroken.
Rule.Translated: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->[inTheEnd], las arcotecnologías elevarán a los elegidos y a sus dragones a un plano superior si su vínculo permanece intacto.

Rule.Original: animistBasis(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->The spirits of fire and flight reside within dragons and their chosen alike.
Rule.Raw: animistBasis(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->The spirits of fire and flight reside within dragons and their chosen alike.
Rule.Translated: animistBasis(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Los espíritus del fuego y del vuelo habitan tanto en los dragones como en sus elegidos.

Rule.Original: animistFact(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->The spirits of dragons are intertwined with the souls of their chosen.
Rule.Raw: animistFact(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->The spirits of dragons are intertwined with the souls of their chosen.
Rule.Translated: animistFact(tag=meme_Crows_DraconicLegacy) ->Los espíritus de los dragones están entrelazados con las almas de sus elegidos.

Rule.Original: Dragons are divine, their presence is a blessing that inspires us.
Rule.Raw: Dragons are divine, their presence is a blessing that inspires us.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones son divinos; su presencia es una bendición que nos inspira.

Rule.Original: Dragons are divine, their presence is a blessing that inspires us.
Rule.Raw: Dragons are divine, their presence is a blessing that inspires us.
Rule.Translated: Los dragones son divinos; su presencia es una bendición que nos inspira.

Rule.Original: With a Dragon by our side we are unstoppable!
Rule.Raw: With a Dragon by our side we are unstoppable!
Rule.Translated: ¡Con un dragón a nuestro lado somos imparables!

Rule.Original: Mourning the loss of a dragon
Rule.Raw: Mourning the loss of a dragon
Rule.Translated: Duelo por la pérdida de un dragón

Rule.Original: A dragon is dead, how can this be? Can gods truly die?
Rule.Raw: A dragon is dead, how can this be? Can gods truly die?
Rule.Translated: Un dragón ha muerto. ¿Cómo es posible? ¿Pueden morir los dioses?
Desesperación por matar a un dragón

Rule.Original: {1} killed a dragon! How could they commit such an act?!
Rule.Raw: {1} killed a dragon! How could they commit such an act?!
Rule.Translated: ¡{1} mató a un dragón! ¿Cómo pudo cometer semejante acto?

Rule.Original: This ritual tears a bond between a Dragon and a Pawn.
Rule.Raw: This ritual tears a bond between a Dragon and a Pawn.
Rule.Translated: Este ritual rompe el vínculo entre un dragón y un personaje.

Rule.Original: Ritual tears a bond between a Dragon and a Pawn without any of the regular side effects.
Rule.Raw: Ritual tears a bond between a Dragon and a Pawn without any of the regular side effects.
Rule.Translated: El ritual rompe el vínculo entre un dragón y un peón sin los efectos secundarios habituales.

Rule.Original: The bonded Pawn and their Dragon will lose their bond after this Ritual.
Rule.Raw: The bonded Pawn and their Dragon will lose their bond after this Ritual.
Rule.Translated: El personaje y su dragón perderán el vínculo después de este ritual.

Rule.Original: To witness the bond torn so cruelly felt like a wound shared by all. There was a somber silence as if even the air around us held its breath in sorrow.
Rule.Raw: To witness the bond torn so cruelly felt like a wound shared by all. There was a somber silence as if even the air around us held its breath in sorrow.
Rule.Translated: Ver cómo rompían el vínculo con tanta crueldad fue una herida compartida. Reinó un silencio sombrío, como si hasta el aire contuviera el aliento de tristeza.

Rule.Original: The ritual felt incomplete, as if the bond had slipped away rather than been properly honored. There’s a lingering unease, like the loss was half-hearted and unresolved.
Rule.Raw: The ritual felt incomplete, as if the bond had slipped away rather than been properly honored. There’s a lingering unease, like the loss was half-hearted and unresolved.
Rule.Translated: El ritual pareció incompleto, como si el vínculo se hubiera desvanecido sin recibir el honor adecuado. Persiste una inquietud, como una pérdida vivida a medias y sin resolver.

Rule.Original: Though the bond has been parted, there’s a sense of peace in the air. We feel both the pain of loss and the gratitude for a bond cherished, leaving us quietly contemplative.
Rule.Raw: Though the bond has been parted, there’s a sense of peace in the air. We feel both the pain of loss and the gratitude for a bond cherished, leaving us quietly contemplative.
Rule.Translated: Aunque el vínculo se ha roto, hay una sensación de paz. Sentimos el dolor de la pérdida y la gratitud por haberlo apreciado, y permanecemos en silenciosa reflexión.

Rule.Original: As the bond dissolved, we were enveloped by a deep reverence. There is a sacred beauty in this farewell, one that fills us with awe and respect for the strength of their connection.
Rule.Raw: As the bond dissolved, we were enveloped by a deep reverence. There is a sacred beauty in this farewell, one that fills us with awe and respect for the strength of their connection.
Rule.Translated: Al disolverse el vínculo, nos envolvió una profunda reverencia. Hay una belleza sagrada en esta despedida, que nos llena de asombro y respeto por la fuerza de su conexión.

Rule.Original: To witness the bond torn so cruelly felt like a wound shared by all. There was a somber silence as if even the air around us held its breath in sorrow.
Rule.Raw: To witness the bond torn so cruelly felt like a wound shared by all. There was a somber silence as if even the air around us held its breath in sorrow.
Rule.Translated: Ver cómo rompían el vínculo con tanta crueldad fue una herida compartida. Reinó un silencio sombrío, como si hasta el aire contuviera el aliento de tristeza.

Rule.Original: The ritual felt incomplete, as if the bond had slipped away rather than been properly honored. There’s a lingering unease, like the loss was half-hearted and unresolved.
Rule.Raw: The ritual felt incomplete, as if the bond had slipped away rather than been properly honored. There’s a lingering unease, like the loss was half-hearted and unresolved.
Rule.Translated: El ritual pareció incompleto, como si el vínculo se hubiera desvanecido sin recibir el honor adecuado. Persiste una inquietud, como una pérdida vivida a medias y sin resolver.

Rule.Original: Though the bond has been parted, there’s a sense of peace in the air. We feel both the pain of loss and the gratitude for a bond cherished, leaving us quietly contemplative.
Rule.Raw: Though the bond has been parted, there’s a sense of peace in the air. We feel both the pain of loss and the gratitude for a bond cherished, leaving us quietly contemplative.
Rule.Translated: Aunque el vínculo se ha roto, hay una sensación de paz. Sentimos el dolor de la pérdida y la gratitud por haberlo apreciado, y permanecemos en silenciosa reflexión.

Rule.Original: As the bond dissolved, we were enveloped by a deep reverence. There is a sacred beauty in this farewell, one that fills us with awe and respect for the strength of their connection.
Rule.Raw: As the bond dissolved, we were enveloped by a deep reverence. There is a sacred beauty in this farewell, one that fills us with awe and respect for the strength of their connection.
Rule.Translated: Al disolverse el vínculo, nos envolvió una profunda reverencia. Hay una belleza sagrada en esta despedida, que nos llena de asombro y respeto por la fuerza de su conexión.

Rule.Original: A disappointing, empty ceremony; the flames barely touched the departed’s memory, and whispers of discontent linger in the air. Few felt any peace from the farewell.
Rule.Raw: A disappointing, empty ceremony; the flames barely touched the departed’s memory, and whispers of discontent linger in the air. Few felt any peace from the farewell.
Rule.Translated: Una ceremonia decepcionante y vacía. Las llamas apenas rozaron el recuerdo del difunto y persisten murmullos de descontento. Pocos encontraron paz en la despedida.

Rule.Original: A quiet, unremarkable ceremony; the fire held steady, yet there was no special spark or blessing. A respectful farewell, though the memory feels incomplete.
Rule.Raw: A quiet, unremarkable ceremony; the fire held steady, yet there was no special spark or blessing. A respectful farewell, though the memory feels incomplete.
Rule.Translated: Una ceremonia silenciosa y corriente. El fuego se mantuvo estable, pero sin una chispa ni bendición especiales. Una despedida respetuosa, aunque el recuerdo parece incompleto.

Rule.Original: A dignified, respectful farewell; the flames rose with grace, and there was a sense that the departed’s spirit left in calm and honor. Many left feeling at peace with the passing.
Rule.Raw: A dignified, respectful farewell; the flames rose with grace, and there was a sense that the departed’s spirit left in calm and honor. Many left feeling at peace with the passing.
Rule.Translated: Una despedida digna y respetuosa. Las llamas se elevaron con gracia y parecía que el espíritu del difunto se marchaba en calma y con honor. Muchos sintieron paz al despedirse.

Rule.Original: A deeply moving, unforgettable send-off; the flames roared with a beauty only dragons could inspire, and warmth lingered in the hearts of those present. The departed’s memory feels enshrined in fire, as it should be.
Rule.Raw: A deeply moving, unforgettable send-off; the flames roared with a beauty only dragons could inspire, and warmth lingered in the hearts of those present. The departed’s memory feels enshrined in fire, as it should be.
Rule.Translated: Una despedida profundamente conmovedora e inolvidable. Las llamas rugieron con una belleza que solo los dragones pueden inspirar y dejaron calidez en los corazones. El recuerdo del difunto parece consagrado en el fuego, como corresponde.

Rule.Original: A forbidden ancient text that imprints the knowledge of Dragon Bonding directly into the reader's mind. It vanishes after use.
Rule.Raw: A forbidden ancient text that imprints the knowledge of Dragon Bonding directly into the reader's mind. It vanishes after use.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo texto prohibido que imprime directamente en la mente del lector los conocimientos del vínculo dracónico. Desaparece tras utilizarse.

Rule.Original: A gathering to witness the cremation of a beloved friend.
Rule.Raw: A gathering to witness the cremation of a beloved friend.
Rule.Translated: Una reunión para presenciar la cremación de un amigo querido.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} should be cremated and their dust scattered so {PAWN_possessive} friends and family can move on.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} should be cremated and their dust scattered so {PAWN_possessive} friends and family can move on.
Rule.Translated: Se debería incinerar a {PAWN_nameDef} y esparcir sus cenizas para que {PAWN_possessive} amigos y familiares puedan seguir adelante.

Rule.Original: You can hold a {IDEOLIGION_adjective} funeral for {PAWN_nameDef}.
Rule.Raw: You can hold a {IDEOLIGION_adjective} funeral for {PAWN_nameDef}.

Rule.Original: You can hold a funeral for {PAWN_nameDef}.
Rule.Raw: You can hold a funeral for {PAWN_nameDef}.

Rule.Translated: No se puede acceder al material seleccionado

Rule.Translated: {0}: El discurso ha terminado y comienza la cremación.

Rule.Original:
Pelican shuttles are tiltwing single-stage-to-orbit (SSTO) transport craft. Pelicans are restricted to vertical take-off and landing only due to the design of their landing gear. Each shuttle can transport up to four passengers at a time.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x1, Passenger x4
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
Rule.Raw: Pelican shuttles are tiltwing single-stage-to-orbit (SSTO) transport craft. Pelicans are restricted to vertical take-off and landing only due to the design of their landing gear. Each shuttle can transport up to four passengers at a time.
Rule.Translated:
Las lanzaderas Pelican son naves de transporte de ala basculante capaces de alcanzar la órbita en una sola etapa (SSTO). Debido al diseño de su tren de aterrizaje, solo pueden despegar y aterrizar verticalmente. Cada lanzadera puede transportar hasta cuatro pasajeros a la vez.

<color=#bb8f04>Tripulación:</color> Piloto x1, Pasajero x4
<color=#bb8f04>Combustible:</color> Biocombustible

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

To your majesty. 
The reports were right 
the daer ate our soldiers 
our best and brighest don't know what 
could have made these animals so agressive.


I decided to find out myself. 
Tracked the Daer to it's cave 
Fascinating creatures.


I saw it drag down a soldier, not ours. 
The behavior of the animal was strange 
it didn't eat the soldier 
it played with it.. tortured it.

He is still alive 
I will save him, and find out 
what makes them so agressive.

Rule.Translated:
Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

A vuestra majestad.
Los informes eran ciertos.
El daer devoró a nuestros soldados.
Ni los mejores entre nosotros saben qué
pudo volver tan agresivos a estos animales.

Decidí descubrirlo por mí mismo.
Seguí al daer hasta su cueva.
Criaturas fascinantes.

Lo vi derribar a un soldado, no era de los nuestros.
El comportamiento del animal era extraño.
No se comió al soldado.
Jugó con él... lo torturó.

Sigue vivo.
Voy a salvarlo y descubrir
qué los vuelve tan agresivos.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

When I was a kid 
I saw the most majestic creature 
fly high above the clouds 
I chased after it 
fell and broke my ankle.


It snooped down. 
Looked me in the eyes 
and carried me back to the city.


I saw it again today. 
It killed people 
just a farmer and his kid 
I don't know what changed.

I will find it 
it must remember me, right? 
maybe I can calm it down.

Rule.Translated:
Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

Cuando era niño
vi a la criatura más majestuosa
volar muy por encima de las nubes.
Corrí tras ella,
caí y me rompí el tobillo.

Descendió en picado.
Me miró a los ojos
y me llevó de vuelta a la ciudad.

Hoy volví a verla.
Mató a varias personas,
solo un granjero y su hijo.
No sé qué cambió.

Voy a encontrarla.
Tiene que recordarme, ¿verdad?
Quizá pueda calmarla.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

The cattle has been going missing 
tonight I saw something attack 
one of my cows 
I scared it off 
but it was too late for the cow.


It mooed and screamed. 
I saw the light leave it's eyes 
it's insides are liquid now.


I saw to where it ran away. 
I will find it 
my animals will not fear the night 
after I'm done.

In case I do not come back 
son, do not come after me please 
leave the farm, start a new life, this land is cursed.

Rule.Translated:
Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

El ganado lleva desapareciendo desde hace tiempo.
Esta noche vi algo atacar
a una de mis vacas.
Conseguí ahuyentarlo,
pero ya era demasiado tarde para la vaca.

Mugió y gritó.
Vi cómo la vida abandonaba sus ojos.
Ahora sus entrañas son líquidas.

Vi hacia dónde huyó.
Voy a encontrarlo.
Cuando termine, mis animales
ya no temerán a la noche.

Por si no regreso:
hijo, por favor, no vengas a buscarme.
Abandona la granja, empieza una nueva vida. Esta tierra está maldita.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

From your servant: 
My lord.. 
There is no great army here 
no great enemy 
nothing but the snakes.


I crawled into their lair. 
The smell is awful, makes the head spin 
but I found their... god.


the snakes are worshipping a creature. 
Its a snake with.. arms 
it has great intelligence in its eyes 
great, evil intelligence.

for the person who finds this message 
deliver this letter to the royal highness 
tell everyone the land cannot be saved, something is very wrong.

Rule.Translated:
Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

De vuestro sirviente:
Mi señor...
Aquí no hay ningún gran ejército,
ningún gran enemigo,
solo serpientes.

Me arrastré hasta su guarida.
El olor es horrible, hace que la cabeza dé vueltas,
pero encontré a su... dios.

Las serpientes adoran a una criatura.
Es una serpiente con... brazos.
Hay una enorme inteligencia en sus ojos,
una inteligencia enorme y maligna.

A quien encuentre este mensaje:
entregue esta carta a su alteza real.
Díganles a todos que esta tierra no puede salvarse. Algo está terriblemente mal.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

To my Mom. 
I love dad, you know that 
I cannot just let him decompose there 
The Witch told me what to do 
she told me what to do, she has power.


You will not approve. 
I remember the stories you told me 
of monsters and witches.


But I must do this. 
I hope will understand 
Dad will come home today 
I promise.
Rule.Raw:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

To my Mom. 
I love dad, you know that 
I cannot just let him decompose there 
The Witch told me what to do 
she told me what to do, she has power.


You will not approve. 
I remember the stories you told me 
of monsters and witches.


But I must do this. 
I hope will understand 
Dad will come home today 
I promise.
Rule.Translated:
Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

Para mamá.
Quiero a papá, ya lo sabes.
No puedo dejar que se descomponga allí.
La Bruja me dijo qué hacer.
Me explicó lo que debía hacer; tiene poder.

No lo aprobarás.
Recuerdo las historias que me contabas
sobre monstruos y brujas.

Pero tengo que hacerlo.
Espero que lo entiendas.
Papá volverá a casa hoy.
Lo prometo.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

To the count. 
Your dear majesty 
we are progressing, even though somewhat slowly 
The Witch requires more silver for the materials 
but the first steps are done, she talked to them.


The Unholds are.. scaring me. 
they could break me with a single swipe of their arm 
How is she not scared? How can she just.. talk with them?


I suggest you approve her request for silver. 
I know I am but a servant, and it's a lot of silver 
but this could win us the war! 
this could make you an empress even.

Rule.Translated:
Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

Al conde.
Mi estimado señor,
progresamos, aunque algo despacio.
La Bruja necesita más plata para los materiales,
pero los primeros pasos ya están dados. Ha hablado con ellos.

Los unholds... me asustan.
Podrían partirme en dos con un solo golpe.
¿Cómo puede ella no tener miedo? ¿Cómo puede simplemente... hablar con ellos?

Le recomiendo aprobar su petición de plata.
Sé que no soy más que un sirviente y que es mucha plata,
¡pero esto podría hacernos ganar la guerra!
Incluso podría convertirle en emperatriz.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

To the apothecary. 
Your potion didn't help 
At all 
I gave you so much silver! 
I hope you burn in hell.


My head hurts so much. 
My skin is peeling 
My whole family is suffering.


That old wretch. 
I need to find out what she cursed my family with 
I should have just let her in 
maybe then this wouldn't have happened.

Rule.Translated:
Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

Al boticario.
Tu poción no ayudó.
En absoluto.
¡Te di tanta plata!
Espero que ardas en el infierno.

Me duele muchísimo la cabeza.
Se me está desprendiendo la piel.
Toda mi familia está sufriendo.

Esa vieja miserable.
Tengo que averiguar con qué maldijo a mi familia.
Debería haberla dejado entrar.
Quizá entonces nada de esto habría ocurrido.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

To the Emperor. 
From your historian.

\I believe the texts are right. 
The Witch isn't a person 
its more so a force of nature.


However, this force of nature has feelings. 
And it has children 
If the legends are right.. I'm standing right before a child of hers.


If we could only capture it.. 
We could bargain with her 
We could save our lands. 
I will try to find out more about it.

Una carta sin entregar; podría ser valiosa.

Al emperador.
De vuestro historiador.

Creo que los textos tenían razón.
La Bruja no es una persona,
sino más bien una fuerza de la naturaleza.

Sin embargo, esa fuerza de la naturaleza tiene sentimientos.
Y tiene hijos.
Si las leyendas son ciertas... estoy justo delante de uno de ellos.

Si pudiéramos capturarlo...
Podríamos negociar con ella.
Podríamos salvar nuestras tierras.
Intentaré averiguar más.

Rule.Original:
An undelivered letter, could be valuable. 

To the Apothecary. 
From your Gatherer.

\I believe I located the direwolves. 
I remember what you said 
about not damaging the adrenal glands.


I am not sure I will manage to survive however, 
if, IF I don't, remember the contract 
you will give my family the cure.


I dont want them to become alps...

sobre no dañar las glándulas suprarrenales.

Sin embargo, no estoy seguro de sobrevivir.
Si, SI no lo consigo, recuerda el contrato:
darás la cura a mi familia.

No quiero que se conviertan en alps...

\We are laying down the fortifications 
in preparation for the ambush 
there is a problem however.


We have lost 32 people so far, 
to trees falling of all things. 
Maybe you can send the chaplain?
