Hasta ahora hemos perdido a 32 personas,
por árboles que caen, de entre todas las cosas posibles.
¿Quizá podría enviar al capellán?

Rule.Original: Ornately painted tusks and bones for ceremonial or decorative purposes.
Rule.Raw: Ornately painted tusks and bones for ceremonial or decorative purposes.
Rule.Translated: Colmillos y huesos decorados con elaboradas pinturas para usos ceremoniales o decorativos.

Rule.Original: Install parched skin on a person instead of their skin until they are beautiful.
Rule.Raw: Install parched skin on a person instead of their skin until they are beautiful.
Rule.Translated: Sustituye la piel de una persona por piel apergaminada para embellecerla.

Rule.Original: Remove paper skin, make them ugly.
Rule.Raw: Remove paper skin, make them ugly.
Rule.Translated: Retira la piel de papel, dejándolos menos atractivos.

Rule.Original: An installed adrenal gland, its constantly pumping adrenaline and cortisol into the blood, essentially puts a person in a constant state of fight-or-Flight, the increased blood pressure makes bloodloss occur more quickly.
Rule.Raw: An installed adrenal gland, its constantly pumping adrenaline and cortisol into the blood, essentially puts a person in a constant state of fight-or-Flight, the increased blood pressure makes bloodloss occur more quickly.
Rule.Translated: Una glándula suprarrenal implantada que bombea constantemente adrenalina y cortisol a la sangre, dejando a la persona en un estado permanente de lucha o huida. El aumento de la presión sanguínea hace que la pérdida de sangre sea más rápida.

Rule.Original: Lindwurm scales in place of skin, they glisten and protect from fire.
Rule.Raw: Lindwurm scales in place of skin, they glisten and protect from fire.
Rule.Translated: Escamas de lindwurm en lugar de piel. Brillan y protegen contra el fuego.

Rule.Original: Install lindwurm skin, a very painful procedure.
Rule.Raw: Install lindwurm skin, a very painful procedure.
Rule.Translated: Instala piel de lindwurm mediante un procedimiento muy doloroso.

Rule.Original: Remove lindwurm scales, painful, you have to rip each scale individually.
Rule.Raw: Remove lindwurm scales, painful, you have to rip each scale individually.
Rule.Translated: Retira las escamas de lindwurm. Es doloroso: hay que arrancarlas una por una.

Rule.Original: Be wary, this is irreversible! Lindwrum blood in a person's veins is a potent combination, but it burns them from within, but they heal constantly due to the blood's effects, the constant damage and healing increase cancer rate due to metabolic strain..
Rule.Raw: Be wary, this is irreversible! Lindwrum blood in a person's veins is a potent combination, but it burns them from within, but they heal constantly due to the blood's effects, the constant damage and healing increase cancer rate due to metabolic strain..
Rule.Translated: ¡Cuidado, esto es irreversible! La sangre de lindwurm en las venas de una persona es una combinación muy poderosa, pero la quema desde dentro. La sangre también la cura constantemente; este ciclo continuo de daño y regeneración aumenta el riesgo de cáncer por la sobrecarga metabólica.

Rule.Original: Be wary, this is irreversible! Replace the blood with that of a lindwurm, its toxic, acidic, but the body will adapt, no matter how much it hurts.
Rule.Raw: Be wary, this is irreversible! Replace the blood with that of a lindwurm, its toxic, acidic, but the body will adapt, no matter how much it hurts.
Rule.Translated: ¡Cuidado, esto es irreversible! Sustituye la sangre por la de un lindwurm. Es tóxica y ácida, pero el cuerpo acabará adaptándose, por mucho que duela.
un juego de colmillos de araña

Rule.Original: Be wary, this is irreversible! Spider's venom glands in the roof of the mouth, very uncomfortable.
Rule.Raw: Be wary, this is irreversible! Spider's venom glands in the roof of the mouth, very uncomfortable.
Rule.Translated: ¡Cuidado, esto es irreversible! Glándulas de veneno de araña implantadas en el paladar. Resultan muy incómodas.

Rule.Original: Be wary, this is irreversible! Install spider fangs.
Rule.Raw: Be wary, this is irreversible! Install spider fangs.
Rule.Translated: ¡Cuidado, esto es irreversible! Implanta colmillos de araña.

Rule.Original: An installed troll heart, its huge, you can feel it beating, full of power, the strain it puts on the body is immense, increasing the cancer rate 9-fold.
Rule.Raw: An installed troll heart, its huge, you can feel it beating, full of power, the strain it puts on the body is immense, increasing the cancer rate 9-fold.
Rule.Translated: Un corazón de trol implantado. Es enorme y puedes sentir sus latidos cargados de poder. La tensión que ejerce sobre el cuerpo es inmensa y multiplica por nueve el riesgo de cáncer.
Implanta un poderoso corazón de trol.

Rule.Original: Skin from an Unhold covering the body, ugly and heavvy, but it heals fast and is extremely thick.
Rule.Raw: Skin from an Unhold covering the body, ugly and heavvy, but it heals fast and is extremely thick.
Rule.Translated: Piel de un unhold cubriendo el cuerpo. Es fea y pesada, pero cicatriza con rapidez y es extremadamente gruesa.

Rule.Original: Install unhold skin, a very painful procedure.
Rule.Raw: Install unhold skin, a very painful procedure.
Rule.Translated: Instala piel de unhold mediante un procedimiento muy doloroso.

Rule.Original: Remove unhold skin, even more painful than installing it.
Rule.Raw: Remove unhold skin, even more painful than installing it.
Rule.Translated: Retira la piel de unhold, un procedimiento todavía más doloroso que instalarla.

Rule.Original: fur from an Unhold covering the body, not as ugly, but less protective, while offering good temperature resistence.
Rule.Raw: fur from an Unhold covering the body, not as ugly, but less protective, while offering good temperature resistence.
Rule.Translated: Pelaje de un unhold cubriendo el cuerpo. No es tan desagradable, pero protege menos y ofrece buena resistencia a las temperaturas extremas.

Rule.Original: Install unhold fur, a very painful procedure.
Rule.Raw: Install unhold fur, a very painful procedure.
Rule.Translated: Instala pelaje de unhold mediante un procedimiento muy doloroso.

Rule.Original: Remove unhold fur, even more painful than installing it.
Rule.Raw: Remove unhold fur, even more painful than installing it.
Rule.Translated: Retira el pelaje de unhold, un procedimiento todavía más doloroso que instalarlo.

Rule.Original: An installed unhold heart, the metabolic strain on the body leads to a five-fold increase in cancer rates.
Rule.Raw: An installed unhold heart, the metabolic strain on the body leads to a five-fold increase in cancer rates.
Rule.Translated: Un corazón de unhold implantado. La sobrecarga metabólica del cuerpo multiplica por cinco el riesgo de cáncer.

Rule.Original: Plates of ancient wood covering the body, at least it's not ugly.
Rule.Raw: Plates of ancient wood covering the body, at least it's not ugly.
Rule.Translated: Placas de madera ancestral que cubren el cuerpo. Al menos no son feas.

Rule.Original: Install ancient wood plates, a crude procedure.
Rule.Raw: Install ancient wood plates, a crude procedure.
Rule.Translated: Instala placas de madera ancestral mediante un procedimiento rudimentario.

Rule.Original: My skin is cut all over, I keep scratching it and making it worse.
Rule.Raw: My skin is cut all over, I keep scratching it and making it worse.
Rule.Translated: Tengo la piel llena de cortes. No dejo de rascarme y empeorarlo.

Rule.Original: I can see ghosts, they scream, the anima screams too.
Rule.Raw: I can see ghosts, they scream, the anima screams too.
Rule.Translated: Puedo ver fantasmas. Gritan. El ánima también grita.

Rule.Original: Everyone is out to get me, I need to be ready, I keep sweating, the smell might give my position out to an enemy.
Rule.Raw: Everyone is out to get me, I need to be ready, I keep sweating, the smell might give my position out to an enemy.
Rule.Translated: Todos vienen a por mí. Debo estar preparado. No dejo de sudar y el olor podría revelar mi posición al enemigo.

Rule.Original: The scales scrape against each other, it sounds and feels bad.
Rule.Raw: The scales scrape against each other, it sounds and feels bad.
Rule.Translated: Las escamas rozan entre sí. Suena mal y se siente peor.

Rule.Original: I can feel my veins burn, they heal and burn and heal and burn.
Rule.Raw: I can feel my veins burn, they heal and burn and heal and burn.
Rule.Translated: Siento arder mis venas. Se curan, arden, se curan y vuelven a arder.

Rule.Original: The venom tastes so bad, and the fangs feel weird in my mouth.
Rule.Raw: The venom tastes so bad, and the fangs feel weird in my mouth.
Rule.Translated: El veneno sabe horrible y los colmillos se sienten extraños dentro de mi boca.

Rule.Original: I can feel it pushing against my ribs, each pump breaking my blood vessels.
Rule.Raw: I can feel it pushing against my ribs, each pump breaking my blood vessels.
Rule.Translated: Puedo sentirlo presionando contra mis costillas. Cada latido rompe mis vasos sanguíneos.

Rule.Original: I feel it, the ability to crush anything in my path.
Rule.Raw: I feel it, the ability to crush anything in my path.
Rule.Translated: Lo siento: tengo el poder de aplastar cualquier cosa que se interponga en mi camino.

Rule.Original: My skin is thick, it's hard to move with it, and it smells of death.
Rule.Raw: My skin is thick, it's hard to move with it, and it smells of death.
Rule.Translated: Mi piel es gruesa, me cuesta moverme con ella y huele a muerte.

Rule.Original: My skin is full of fur, it smells of animals and death, it doesn't matter how much I clean myself.
Rule.Raw: My skin is full of fur, it smells of animals and death, it doesn't matter how much I clean myself.
Rule.Translated: Mi piel está cubierta de pelaje y huele a animal y a muerte. Da igual cuánto me lave.

Rule.Original: My heart beats really hard, I can feel it push my blood, my body is aching.
Rule.Raw: My heart beats really hard, I can feel it push my blood, my body is aching.
Rule.Translated: Mi corazón late con muchísima fuerza. Siento cómo impulsa la sangre y me duele todo el cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Each beat of the heart sends a commands to kill, I am ready.
Rule.Raw: Each beat of the heart sends a commands to kill, I am ready.
Rule.Translated: Cada latido del corazón me ordena matar. Estoy preparado.

Rule.Original: The wooden plates on my skin have sprouted roots into my body, it hurts.
Rule.Raw: The wooden plates on my skin have sprouted roots into my body, it hurts.
Rule.Translated: Las placas de madera de mi piel han echado raíces dentro de mi cuerpo. Duele.

Rule.Original: The heart of the forest drains my vitality, I can feel it reaching out into the aether.
Rule.Raw: The heart of the forest drains my vitality, I can feel it reaching out into the aether.
Rule.Translated: El corazón del bosque drena mi vitalidad. Puedo sentir cómo se extiende hacia el éter.

Rule.Original: This is irreversible! Gauranlen roots sprouting in the brain, is... beneficial?
Rule.Raw: This is irreversible! Gauranlen roots sprouting in the brain, is... beneficial?
Rule.Translated: ¡Esto es irreversible! Raíces de Gauranlen brotando en el cerebro... ¿es algo beneficioso?

Rule.Original: Irreversible! install gauranlen seeds into the brain
Rule.Raw: Irreversible! install gauranlen seeds into the brain
Rule.Translated: ¡Irreversible! implantar semillas de Gauranlen en el cerebro

Rule.Original: I just wanna lay down, and get covered by plants.
Rule.Raw: I just wanna lay down, and get covered by plants.
Rule.Translated: Solo quiero tumbarme y dejar que las plantas me cubran.

Rule.Original: An expertise in researching new technologies.

Rule.Original: An expertise in both reading and writing books in a timely manner.

Rule.Raw: An expertise in living off the land and foraging the fruits of the forest.
Rule.Translated: La pericia para vivir de la tierra y recolectar los frutos del bosque.

Rule.Original: An expertise in communicating psychically and pruning the Gauranlen trees.
Rule.Raw: An expertise in communicating psychically and pruning the Gauranlen trees.
Rule.Translated: La pericia para comunicarse psíquicamente con los árboles gauranlen y podarlos.

Rule.Original: An expertise in ensuring no parts of the plant are wasted on harvesting.
Rule.Raw: An expertise in ensuring no parts of the plant are wasted on harvesting.
Rule.Translated: La pericia para aprovechar todas las partes de las plantas al cosecharlas.

Rule.Original: An expertise in quickly sowing and harvesting large amounts of plants.

Rule.Raw: An expertise in handling prisoners and slaves, recruiting them and arresting them if needed.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a small village and spent [PAWN_possessive] days hunting game to provide food for the community. [PAWN_pronoun] became skilled at tracking and setting traps but rarely interacted with others, preferring the solitude of the forest. Over time, [PAWN_pronoun] gained a reputation as a reliable provider, though [PAWN_possessive] social skills remained underdeveloped.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a small village and spent [PAWN_possessive] days hunting game to provide food for the community. [PAWN_pronoun] became skilled at tracking and setting traps but rarely interacted with others, preferring the solitude of the forest. Over time, [PAWN_pronoun] gained a reputation as a reliable provider, though [PAWN_possessive] social skills remained underdeveloped.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] creció en una pequeña aldea y se pasaba los días cazando para proporcionar alimento a la comunidad. Se hizo {PAWN_gender ? un : una } expert{PAWN_gender ? o : a } en rastrear y colocar trampas, pero rara vez se relacionaba con otros, pues prefería la soledad del bosque. Con el tiempo, [PAWN_pronoun] se ganó la reputación de proveedor fiable, aunque sus habilidades sociales seguían estando poco desarrolladas.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a laborer in the fields from a young age, planting crops and harvesting under the watchful eye of overseers. [PAWN_pronoun] grew strong from hauling sacks of grain and learned the basics of caring for plants. However, the grueling work left little time for other pursuits, and [PAWN_pronoun] never learned to read or write.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a laborer in the fields from a young age, planting crops and harvesting under the watchful eye of overseers. [PAWN_pronoun] grew strong from hauling sacks of grain and learned the basics of caring for plants. However, the grueling work left little time for other pursuits, and [PAWN_pronoun] never learned to read or write.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] trabajó como jornaler{PAWN_gender ? o : a } en el campo desde muy joven, plantando y cosechando bajo la atenta mirada de los capataces. Se hizo fuerte acarreando sacos de grano y aprendió los fundamentos del cuidado de las plantas. Sin embargo, el agotador trabajo le dejaba poco tiempo para otras ocupaciones, por lo que nunca aprendió a leer ni a escribir.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] life in the forests, cutting down trees to supply timber for the local village. The work was grueling, but it made [PAWN_pronoun] strong and skilled with tools. Though the solitude of the woods suited [PAWN_objective], [PAWN_pronoun] never learned much about socializing or the finer arts of crafting.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] life in the forests, cutting down trees to supply timber for the local village. The work was grueling, but it made [PAWN_pronoun] strong and skilled with tools. Though the solitude of the woods suited [PAWN_objective], [PAWN_pronoun] never learned much about socializing or the finer arts of crafting.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] se pasaba la vida en los bosques, talando árboles para abastecer de madera a la aldea local. El trabajo era agotador, pero {PAWN_gender ? lo : la } hacía fuerte y hábil con las herramientas. Aunque la soledad de los bosques era adecuada para [PAWN_pronoun], nunca aprendió mucho sobre socialización o las bellas artes de la artesanía.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] made a living catching fish from the rivers and lakes near [PAWN_possessive] village. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to craft simple nets and traps but spent most of [PAWN_possessive] time alone on the water. The repetitive work left [PAWN_pronoun] skilled but uninterested in other tasks.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] made a living catching fish from the rivers and lakes near [PAWN_possessive] village. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to craft simple nets and traps but spent most of [PAWN_possessive] time alone on the water. The repetitive work left [PAWN_pronoun] skilled but uninterested in other tasks.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] se ganaba la vida pescando en los ríos y lagos cercanos a su aldea de origen. Aprendió a fabricar redes y trampas sencillas, pero se pasaba la mayor parte del tiempo sol{PAWN_gender ? o : a } en la orilla. El trabajo repetitivo {PAWN_gender ? lo : la } hizo hábil, pero fue perdiendo el interés por otras tareas.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in a stone quarry, hauling heavy blocks to construction sites. The endless labor left [PAWN_pronoun] with great strength but little patience for intellectual pursuits. The hard life in the quarry also sharpened [PAWN_possessive] instincts for survival.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in a stone quarry, hauling heavy blocks to construction sites. The endless labor left [PAWN_pronoun] with great strength but little patience for intellectual pursuits. The hard life in the quarry also sharpened [PAWN_possessive] instincts for survival.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] trabajaba en una cantera de piedra, transportando pesados bloques a las obras de construcción. El interminable trabajo hizo que ganara mucha fuerza, a costa de perder paciencia para las actividades intelectuales. La dura vida en la cantera también agudizó su instinto de supervivencia.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] days tending sheep in the hills surrounding [PAWN_possessive] village. [PAWN_pronoun] became skilled at managing livestock and defending the flock from predators. The quiet life made [PAWN_pronoun] thoughtful but left [PAWN_pronoun] unprepared for more physically demanding work.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] days tending sheep in the hills surrounding [PAWN_possessive] village. [PAWN_pronoun] became skilled at managing livestock and defending the flock from predators. The quiet life made [PAWN_pronoun] thoughtful but left [PAWN_pronoun] unprepared for more physically demanding work.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] se pasaba los días cuidando ovejas en las colinas que rodeaban su aldea. Aprendió a manejar el ganado y a defender el rebaño de los depredadores. La vida tranquila le hizo reflexionar, pero no le preparó para un trabajo más exigente físicamente.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in a tannery, turning raw hides into leather for clothing and armor. The job was messy and unpleasant, but it gave [PAWN_pronoun] an eye for detail and strong hands. Years of exposure to harsh chemicals left [PAWN_pronoun] with poor health.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in a tannery, turning raw hides into leather for clothing and armor. The job was messy and unpleasant, but it gave [PAWN_pronoun] an eye for detail and strong hands. Years of exposure to harsh chemicals left [PAWN_pronoun] with poor health.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] trabajaba en una curtiduría, convirtiendo pieles crudas en cuero para ropa y armaduras. El trabajo era sucio y desagradable, pero le dio un buen ojo para los detalles, así como manos fuertes. Años de exposición a productos químicos agresivos dejaron a [PAWN_nameDef] algo maltrech{PAWN_gender ? o : a }.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years crafting candles from tallow and wax, supplying light to the nearby village. The work required patience and precision, which [PAWN_pronoun] excelled at. However, the repetitive nature of the trade left [PAWN_pronoun] uninterested in more creative pursuits.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years crafting candles from tallow and wax, supplying light to the nearby village. The work required patience and precision, which [PAWN_pronoun] excelled at. However, the repetitive nature of the trade left [PAWN_pronoun] uninterested in more creative pursuits.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] trabajó durante años fabricando velas de sebo y cera para iluminar el pueblo cercano. El trabajo requería paciencia y precisión, algo en lo que [PAWN_pronoun] destacaba. Sin embargo, la naturaleza repetitiva del oficio hizo que no se interesara por actividades más creativas.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] prepared meals for the local villagers, using simple ingredients to make hearty stews and breads. [PAWN_pronoun] honed [PAWN_possessive] skills over countless fires and learned to stretch resources in times of scarcity. The kitchen, however, left no time for intellectual or artistic pursuits.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] prepared meals for the local villagers, using simple ingredients to make hearty stews and breads. [PAWN_pronoun] honed [PAWN_possessive] skills over countless fires and learned to stretch resources in times of scarcity. The kitchen, however, left no time for intellectual or artistic pursuits.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] preparaba comidas para los aldeanos locales, utilizando ingredientes sencillos para elaborar guisos y panes sustanciosos. Perfeccionó sus habilidades en innumerables fogones y aprendió a aprovechar los recursos en tiempos de escasez. La cocina, sin embargo, no le dejaba tiempo para actividades intelectuales o artísticas.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] shaped and fired clay bricks for construction projects in [PAWN_possessive] village. The intense labor strengthened [PAWN_possessive] body and gave [PAWN_pronoun] a keen understanding of construction techniques. Years of working near hot kilns left [PAWN_pronoun] with little stamina for long days of physical labor.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] shaped and fired clay bricks for construction projects in [PAWN_possessive] village. The intense labor strengthened [PAWN_possessive] body and gave [PAWN_pronoun] a keen understanding of construction techniques. Years of working near hot kilns left [PAWN_pronoun] with little stamina for long days of physical labor.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] moldeaba y cocía ladrillos de arcilla para los proyectos de construcción de su aldea. El intenso trabajo fortalecía su cuerpo y le proporcionaba un profundo conocimiento de las técnicas de construcción. Crops failed, livestock died, and villagers fell ill, all under [PAWN_possessive] dark shadow. [PAWN_pronoun] grew to expect rejection, developing a cold resilience to survive in a world that feared [PAWN_objective].
Rule.Translated: Se creía que [PAWN_nameDef] estaba maldito y se le culpaba de cada desgracia de la aldea. Las cosechas fallaban, el ganado moría y los aldeanos enfermaban bajo [PAWN_possessive] oscura sombra. [PAWN_pronoun] aprendió a esperar el rechazo y desarrolló una fría resistencia para sobrevivir en un mundo que temía a [PAWN_objective].

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] was discovered as an infant at the edge of the woods, wrapped in tattered cloth and left in the rain. The villagers took [PAWN_objective] in reluctantly, always murmuring of unnatural origins. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up in the shadow of suspicion, learning to remain unseen and unheard.

Los aldeanos acogieron a [PAWN_objective] a regañadientes y siempre murmuraban sobre un origen antinatural. [PAWN_pronoun] creció bajo la sombra de la sospecha y aprendió a pasar sin ser visto ni oído.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] surprised [PAWN_possessive] elders by brokering a truce between feuding noble families at just twelve years old. [PAWN_pronoun] used charm and logic to persuade both sides, earning respect far beyond [PAWN_possessive] years. The experience cemented [PAWN_possessive] place as a rising star in courtly politics.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] demonstrated a gift for strategy by organizing and winning a mock battle between the castle’s squires. [PAWN_pronoun] anticipated [PAWN_possessive] opponents’ moves and used the terrain to [PAWN_possessive] advantage, earning the admiration of seasoned knights. The event marked [PAWN_objective] as a promising future commander.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] won a prestigious archery competition at the age of thirteen, besting older and more experienced opponents. [PAWN_pronoun] was praised for [PAWN_possessive] precision and composure under pressure. The victory brought honor to [PAWN_possessive] family and set [PAWN_objective] on a path of future acclaim.

[PAWN_pronoun] recibió elogios por [PAWN_possessive] precisión y serenidad bajo presión. La victoria honró a [PAWN_possessive] familia y puso a [PAWN_objective] en el camino hacia un futuro reconocimiento.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] composed an epic poem at a young age that spread throughout the region, earning [PAWN_pronoun] fame and admiration. Nobles and commoners alike recited [PAWN_possessive] verses, praising their vivid imagery and emotional depth. The success brought invitations to courts across the land.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall made out of big rock chunks.
Rule.Raw: An impassable wall made out of big rock chunks.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable hecho de grandes trozos de roca.

Rule.Original: A harsh feudal culture of medieval people.
Rule.Raw: A harsh feudal culture of medieval people.
Rule.Translated: Una tosca cultura feudal de gente medieval.

Rule.Original: A harsh feudal culture of medieval people.
Rule.Raw: A harsh feudal culture of medieval people.

Rule.Original: A drink akin to wine, made of fermented honey and water, aged in a simple barrel. This sweet, crisp drink is known be nursed over time and has a reputation of being particularly comforting. Consuming mead lowers psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A drink akin to wine, made of fermented honey and water, aged in a simple barrel. This sweet, crisp drink is known be nursed over time and has a reputation of being particularly comforting. Consuming mead lowers psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Una bebida parecida al vino, elaborada con miel fermentada y agua, y envejecida en un barril sencillo. Esta bebida dulce y crujiente tiene fama de ser especialmente reconfortante. Consumir aguamiel disminuye la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Mead in the bloodstream. It makes people happy, but reduces capacities. Slightly reduces psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Mead in the bloodstream. It makes people happy, but reduces capacities. Slightly reduces psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Hidromiel en el torrente sanguíneo. Alegra a las personas, pero reduce sus capacidades. Reduce ligeramente la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: I just feel a bit more relaxed after that drink. That's good.
Rule.Raw: I just feel a bit more relaxed after that drink. That's good.
Rule.Translated: Me siento un poco más relajado después de ese trago. Eso es bueno.

Rule.Original: I'm a bit wobbly! And this is quite enjoyable.
Rule.Raw: I'm a bit wobbly! And this is quite enjoyable.
Rule.Translated: ¡Estoy un poco tambaleante! Y esto es bastante agradable.

Rule.Original: I feel so uninhibited and unafraid! This is a great time!
Rule.Raw: I feel so uninhibited and unafraid! This is a great time!
Rule.Translated: ¡Me siento tan desinhibido y sin miedo! Es un gran momento.

Rule.Original: A large bottle of a strong alcoholic beverage that is made from fermented grapes. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction. Consuming wine increases psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A large bottle of a strong alcoholic beverage that is made from fermented grapes. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction. Consuming wine increases psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Una botella grande de una bebida alcohólica fuerte elaborada con uvas fermentadas. Un consumo excesivo puede provocar desmayos alcohólicos y, con el tiempo, adicción. El consumo de vino aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: Wine in the bloodstream. It makes people happy and more psychically sensitive, but reduces capacities.
Rule.Raw: Wine in the bloodstream. It makes people happy and more psychically sensitive, but reduces capacities.
Rule.Translated: Vino en el torrente sanguíneo. Alegra a las personas y aumenta su sensibilidad psíquica, pero reduce sus capacidades.

Rule.Original:
These clanmen have been here for a long time. Perhaps their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago, as their legends suggest. In any case, the nordmen are fierce people who live off of the work of others, and they are not afraid to use force to take what's not theirs.

Albeit not as technologically advanced as other factions, the nordmen can be a valuable ally and a terrible enemy due to their hardiness and savage, heathen ways.

This particular clan values warlike dominance; it may be difficult to turn them into an ally.

This particular clan values warlike dominance; it may be difficult to turn them into an ally.
Rule.Translated:
Estos miembros del clan llevan aquí mucho tiempo. Tal vez sus antepasados se estrellaron aquí hace mil años, como sugieren sus leyendas. En cualquier caso, los hombres del norte son gente feroz que vive del trabajo de los demás, y no temen usar la fuerza para tomar lo que no es suyo.

Aunque no tan avanzados tecnológicamente como otras facciones, los nórdicos pueden ser un valioso aliado y un terrible enemigo debido a su rusticidad y a sus salvajes costumbres paganas.

Este clan en particular valora el dominio bélico; puede ser difícil convertirlos en aliados.

Rule.Original:
These people have been here for a shorter period of time than their neolithic bretheren. It is believed that some tribespeople and outlanders had come to embrace the medieval ways of life and decided to unite.

Though still technologically inferior to many other factions, the subjects of this kingdom are well-known for using towering fortifications to protect their assets, as well as adopting the use of shields in combat and fighting in a particularly orderly manner.

This particular kingdom is open to keeping trade relations good with other settlements to bolster their economic position.

Aunque siguen siendo tecnológicamente inferiores a muchas otras facciones, los súbditos de este reino son conocidos por utilizar altísimas fortificaciones para proteger sus bienes, así como por adoptar el uso de escudos en combate y luchar de forma especialmente ordenada.

Este reino en particular está abierto a mantener buenas relaciones comerciales con otros asentamientos para reforzar su posición económica.

Rule.Original:
These people have been here for a shorter period of time than their neolithic brethren. These wandering traders and skilled negotiators form a vast network of traveling caravans and temporary markets. Originating from a loose coalition of outlanders and former city-dwellers, they abandoned static settlements in favor of constant movement, seeking prosperity through commerce rather than conquest.

Unlike most factions, the Guild operates on a pure barter economy—silver holds no value to them, only goods and services do. Their traders travel far and wide, setting up bustling market hubs wherever they stop, offering rare wares and exotic goods in exchange for what they deem useful.

Though they avoid direct conflict and prefer diplomacy, their well-armed guards ensure that their caravans remain safe from opportunistic raiders.

These people have been here for a shorter period of time than their neolithic brethren. These wandering traders and skilled negotiators form a vast network of traveling caravans and temporary markets. Unlike most factions, the Guild operates on a pure barter economy—silver holds no value to them, only goods and services do. Their traders travel far and wide, setting up bustling market hubs wherever they stop, offering rare wares and exotic goods in exchange for what they deem useful.

Though they avoid direct conflict and prefer diplomacy, their well-armed guards ensure that their caravans remain safe from opportunistic raiders.
Rule.Translated:
Estas personas llevan aquí menos tiempo que sus hermanos neolíticos. Estos comerciantes errantes y hábiles negociadores forman una vasta red de caravanas itinerantes y mercados temporales. Surgidos de una coalición de forasteros y antiguos habitantes de ciudades, abandonaron los asentamientos estáticos en favor del movimiento constante, buscando la prosperidad a través del comercio en lugar de la conquista.

A diferencia de la mayoría de las facciones, el Gremio funciona con una economía de trueque puro: la plata no tiene valor para ellos, solo los bienes y servicios. Sus comerciantes viajan por todas partes, estableciendo bulliciosos mercados allá donde se detienen, ofreciendo mercancías raras y productos exóticos a cambio de lo que consideran útil.

Aunque evitan el conflicto directo y prefieren la diplomacia, sus guardias bien armados garantizan que sus caravanas permanezcan a salvo de asaltantes oportunistas.

Rule.Original: You are about to attack the Merchants' Guild, which will make that faction hostile. Are you sure you want to do that?
Rule.Raw: You are about to attack the Merchants' Guild, which will make that faction hostile. Are you sure you want to do that?
Rule.Translated: Estás a punto de atacar al gremio de mercaderes, lo que hará que esa facción se vuelva hostil. ¿Realmente deseas hacerlo?
campamento del gremio de mercaderes destruido

Rule.Original: A draught is improving this person’s immune system, making them more capable of fighting off diseases and infections at the cost of making them more sleepy.
Rule.Raw: A draught is improving this person’s immune system, making them more capable of fighting off diseases and infections at the cost of making them more sleepy.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje mejora el sistema inmunitario de esta persona y su capacidad para combatir enfermedades e infecciones, a costa de aumentar la somnolencia.

Rule.Original: A draught is improving this person’s natural wound regeneration, making them able to heal from wounds significantly faster than normal.
Rule.Raw: A draught is improving this person’s natural wound regeneration, making them able to heal from wounds significantly faster than normal.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje mejora la regeneración natural de las heridas de esta persona y permite que sane considerablemente más rápido de lo normal.

Rule.Original: A draught is improving strength and reflexes of the user, improving their combat capabilities at the cost of increased social fight chance and higher mental break threshold.
Rule.Raw: A draught is improving strength and reflexes of the user, improving their combat capabilities at the cost of increased social fight chance and higher mental break threshold.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje mejora la fuerza y los reflejos de quien lo consume y aumenta su capacidad de combate, a costa de elevar la probabilidad de peleas sociales y el umbral de crisis mental.

Rule.Original: A draught is improving global workspeed of the user while also simultaneously slowing down their energy loss at the cost of increased chance of a heart attack. At the end of the potent duration, the user receives a major sleep fall rate increase.
Rule.Raw: A draught is improving global workspeed of the user while also simultaneously slowing down their energy loss at the cost of increased chance of a heart attack. At the end of the potent duration, the user receives a major sleep fall rate increase.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje mejora la velocidad de trabajo global de quien lo consume y reduce la pérdida de energía, a costa de aumentar la probabilidad de sufrir un infarto. Al terminar su fase potente, aumenta considerablemente la velocidad de pérdida de descanso.

Rule.Original: A draught is stopping the user from feeling pain at the cost of lowering their focus and productivity greatly.
Rule.Raw: A draught is stopping the user from feeling pain at the cost of lowering their focus and productivity greatly.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje impide al usuario sentir dolor a costa de reducir mucho su concentración y productividad.

Rule.Original: A draught is causing severe pain to the user, making them unable to even move. If they are a prisoner, they will rapidly lose their resistance, and if they are a slave, they will be fully suppressed.
Rule.Raw: A draught is causing severe pain to the user, making them unable to even move. If they are a prisoner, they will rapidly lose their resistance, and if they are a slave, they will be fully suppressed.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje provoca un dolor intenso que impide incluso moverse. Si quien lo consume es prisionero, perderá rápidamente su resistencia; si es esclavo, quedará completamente sometido.

Rule.Original: A draught is increasing the capability of the user to learn, allowing them to gain more knowledge, eat faster, rest quicker and gain more psyfocus while potent. The effects are reversed when the draught is fading.
Rule.Raw: A draught is increasing the capability of the user to learn, allowing them to gain more knowledge, eat faster, rest quicker and gain more psyfocus while potent. The effects are reversed when the draught is fading.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje mejora la capacidad de aprendizaje de quien lo consume y permite adquirir más conocimientos, comer más rápido, descansar con mayor rapidez y obtener más psicoconcentración mientras está activo. Los efectos se invierten cuando el brebaje pierde fuerza.

Rule.Original: A draught is artificially increasing the fertility of the user. The slight boost to fertility will allow even infertile people to have a chance to become parents.
Rule.Raw: A draught is artificially increasing the fertility of the user. The slight boost to fertility will allow even infertile people to have a chance to become parents.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje aumenta artificialmente la fertilidad de quien lo consume. La pequeña mejora permite que incluso las personas infértiles tengan alguna posibilidad de convertirse en padres.

Rule.Original: A draught is providing the user with mental clarity, allowing them to focus on gaining new knowledge in skills they are passionate about at the cost of diminished combat capabilities.
Rule.Raw: A draught is providing the user with mental clarity, allowing them to focus on gaining new knowledge in skills they are passionate about at the cost of diminished combat capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje aporta claridad mental y permite concentrarse en adquirir conocimientos de habilidades que apasionan a quien lo consume, a costa de reducir su capacidad de combate.

Rule.Original: A draught is transforming the user's skin into a built-in suit of armor. The whole epidermis thickens and hardens to resist burns, while jointed exterior keratin plates form everywhere they can - including the head and face. While it's very difficult to physically hurt someone under the effects of this draught, the plates and hard skin significantly reduces the user's physical attractiveness.
Rule.Raw: A draught is transforming the user's skin into a built-in suit of armor. The whole epidermis thickens and hardens to resist burns, while jointed exterior keratin plates form everywhere they can - including the head and face. While it's very difficult to physically hurt someone under the effects of this draught, the plates and hard skin significantly reduces the user's physical attractiveness.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje transforma la piel de quien lo consume en una armadura integrada. Toda la epidermis se engrosa y endurece para resistir quemaduras, mientras se forman placas exteriores articuladas de queratina donde pueden, incluso en la cabeza y el rostro. Aunque resulta muy difícil herir físicamente a alguien bajo sus efectos, las placas y la piel endurecida reducen considerablemente su atractivo físico.

Rule.Original: A draught is causing the user to quickly lose memory, resulting in both negative and positive memories lasting significantly shorter.
Rule.Raw: A draught is causing the user to quickly lose memory, resulting in both negative and positive memories lasting significantly shorter.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje provoca una rápida pérdida de memoria, de modo que tanto los recuerdos positivos como los negativos duran mucho menos.

Rule.Original:
Oppression breeds defiance. For years, your village toiled under the weight of crushing taxes and hunger while the lord’s knights took everything: grain, livestock, even your last scraps of dignity. When they seized your final stores of food, desperation turned to rage.
Armed with nothing but fury, you march upon the castle where the lord and his knights hide behind stone walls. You are weak, but sheer numbers and resolve may turn the tide. Should you triumph, the castle’s wealth and security could be yours.
But not all believe in victory. Some whisper of escape, of slipping away before the slaughter begins. Beyond the walls lies an uncertain world, one that promises danger but also the chance for a new life. Will you fight to take the castle, or flee and forge your own path? Note: Since you start around an enemy castle, this is a difficult scenario.
Rule.Raw:
Oppression breeds defiance. For years, your village toiled under the weight of crushing taxes and hunger while the lord’s knights took everything: grain, livestock, even your last scraps of dignity. When they seized your final stores of food, desperation turned to rage.
Armed with nothing but fury, you march upon the castle where the lord and his knights hide behind stone walls. You are weak, but sheer numbers and resolve may turn the tide. Should you triumph, the castle’s wealth and security could be yours.
But not all believe in victory. Some whisper of escape, of slipping away before the slaughter begins. Beyond the walls lies an uncertain world, one that promises danger but also the chance for a new life. Will you fight to take the castle, or flee and forge your own path? Note: Since you start around an enemy castle, this is a difficult scenario.
Rule.Translated:
La opresión engendra rebeldía. Durante años, tu aldea se ha esforzado bajo el peso de los impuestos y el hambre, mientras los caballeros del señor se apoderaban de todo: el grano, el ganado e incluso los últimos restos de dignidad. Cuando se apoderaron de las últimas reservas de alimentos, la desesperación se convirtió en rabia.



Armados con nada más que furia, marcháis hacia el castillo donde el señor y sus caballeros se esconden tras los muros de piedra. Sois débiles, pero vuestro número y determinación pueden cambiar las tornas. Si triunfas, la riqueza y la seguridad del castillo podrían ser tuyas.



Pero no todos creen en la victoria. Algunos susurran escapar, escabullirse antes de que comience la masacre. Más allá de los muros hay un mundo incierto, que promete peligros pero también la oportunidad de una nueva vida. ¿Lucharás para tomar el castillo, o huirás y forjarás tu propio camino?

Nota: Dado que empiezas alrededor de un castillo enemigo, este es un escenario difícil.

Rule.Original: Maynard Medieval weaves a tale of struggle and hardship, where every breakthrough is earned through sweat, blood, and sacrifice. The march of progress slows as tradition clings tight, demanding ever greater effort to pry knowledge from the grip of time. Research projects will cost more time the more of them you have completed.
Rule.Raw: Maynard Medieval weaves a tale of struggle and hardship, where every breakthrough is earned through sweat, blood, and sacrifice. The march of progress slows as tradition clings tight, demanding ever greater effort to pry knowledge from the grip of time. Research projects will cost more time the more of them you have completed.
Rule.Translated: Marcial Medieval teje una historia de lucha y penurias, en la que cada avance se gana con sudor, sangre y sacrificio. La marcha del progreso se ralentiza a medida que la tradición se aferra con fuerza, exigiendo un esfuerzo cada vez mayor para arrancar el conocimiento de las garras del tiempo. Los proyectos de investigación costarán más tiempo cuantos más de ellos hayas completado.

Rule.Original: A wooden box-like structure with a series of shelves, lattices, and chambers. When placed near flowers the apiary will naturally attract wild bees which will make it their new home. Over time these bees will produce honey which can be harvested and eaten directly, or later fermented into mead.
Rule.Raw: A wooden box-like structure with a series of shelves, lattices, and chambers. When placed near flowers the apiary will naturally attract wild bees which will make it their new home. Over time these bees will produce honey which can be harvested and eaten directly, or later fermented into mead.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura en forma de caja de madera con una serie de estantes, celosías y cámaras. Si se coloca cerca de las flores, el colmenar atraerá de forma natural a las abejas silvestres, que lo convertirán en su nuevo hogar. Con el tiempo, estas abejas producirán miel, que podrá recolectarse y consumirse directamente, o bien, ser fermentada para producir aguamiel.

Rule.Original: An incredibly resistant door made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. It’s a good choice if you want to keep the enemies out - or in. The door requires walls on either side to function.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly resistant door made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. It’s a good choice if you want to keep the enemies out - or in. The door requires walls on either side to function.

It’s a good choice if you want to keep the enemies out - or in. The door requires walls on either side to function. Castle gates take a long time to open.

Rule.Original: A wood-framed bed stuffed with dried grasses and covered in a variety of pelts and furs to provide extra insulation during frigid nights. The warmth of this bed counters hypothermia.
Rule.Raw: A wood-framed bed stuffed with dried grasses and covered in a variety of pelts and furs to provide extra insulation during frigid nights. The warmth of this bed counters hypothermia.
Rule.Translated: Una cama construida a partir de una estructura de madera, rellena de hierbas secas y cubierta con un juego de pieles para proporcionar un aislamiento adicional durante las noches frías. El calor de esta cama contrarresta la hipotermia.

Rule.Original: A two-person, wood-framed bed stuffed with dried grasses and covered in a variety of pelts and furs to provide extra insulation during frigid nights. The warmth of this bed counters hypothermia.
Rule.Raw: A two-person, wood-framed bed stuffed with dried grasses and covered in a variety of pelts and furs to provide extra insulation during frigid nights. The warmth of this bed counters hypothermia.
Rule.Translated: Una cama para dos construida a partir de una estructura de madera, rellena de hierbas secas y cubierta con un juego de pieles para proporcionar un aislamiento adicional durante las noches frías. El calor de esta cama contrarresta la hipotermia.

Rule.Original: A large, tightly packed fire pit capable of holding high amounts of wood at once. Provides hefty warmth and light to thronerooms and halls alike and acts as a gathering spot for idle colonists.
Rule.Raw: A large, tightly packed fire pit capable of holding high amounts of wood at once. Provides hefty warmth and light to thronerooms and halls alike and acts as a gathering spot for idle colonists.
Rule.Translated: Una hoguera grande y compacta capaz de albergar grandes cantidades de leña. Proporciona calor y luz a los salones del trono y demás tipos de salas, y actúa como punto de reunión para los colonos ociosos.

Rule.Original: A tall fabric banner mounted on a sturdy wooden frame, proudly displaying the heraldry of the faction.
Rule.Raw: A tall fabric banner mounted on a sturdy wooden frame, proudly displaying the heraldry of the faction.
Rule.Translated: Un estandarte de tela montado sobre un robusto y alto marco de madera, que exhibe con orgullo la heráldica de una facción.

Rule.Original: A triple-stack shelf that holds three times as much as empty ground. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.\n\nSince shelf space is limited, shelves cannot hold chunks, buildings, plants and large corpses.
Rule.Raw: A triple-stack shelf that holds three times as much as empty ground. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.\n\nSince shelf space is limited, shelves cannot hold chunks, buildings, plants and large corpses.
Rule.Translated: Una estantería con capacidad para tres pilas, por lo que puede alojar tres veces más objetos que el suelo vacío. Los objetos almacenados en su interior nunca se deterioran y no afectan a la belleza de su entorno.\n\nComo el espacio de las estanterías es limitado, en ellas no caben trozos de piedra, construcciones, plantas ni cadáveres grandes.

Rule.Original: A simple archery target mounted on a wooden stand. It's relaxing, and allows oneself to test their accuracy and train over time without risking fatal confrontation.
Rule.Raw: A simple archery target mounted on a wooden stand. It's relaxing, and allows oneself to test their accuracy and train over time without risking fatal confrontation.
Rule.Translated: Una sencilla diana de tiro con arco montada sobre un soporte de madera. Es relajante y permite a uno mismo poner a prueba su precisión y entrenarse con el tiempo sin arriesgarse a un enfrentamiento fatal.

Rule.Original: A target dummy made out of wood, soil, and dried plant matter. Surprisingly durable, allows oneself to test their swordsmanship and train over time without risking fatal confrontation.
Rule.Raw: A target dummy made out of wood, soil, and dried plant matter. Surprisingly durable, allows oneself to test their swordsmanship and train over time without risking fatal confrontation.
Rule.Translated: Un muñeco de entrenamiento hecho de madera, tierra y materia vegetal seca. Es sorprendentemente duradero, y permite poner a prueba la destreza con la espada y entrenarse sin arriesgarse a un enfrentamiento mortal.

Rule.Original: A wood-fueled metal pot used to boil patchleather. Consumes wood when working.
Rule.Raw: A wood-fueled metal pot used to boil patchleather. Consumes wood when working.
Rule.Translated: Una olla de metal alimentada con leña que se utiliza para hervir parches de cuero. Consume leña cuando funciona.

Rule.Original: A heavy steel anvil used to shape metalwork with greater precision. Increases work speed when placed near a smithy. Items of awful and poor quality crafted on the linked workbench have a chance of being upgraded by one quality level. One workbench can only use one anvil.
Rule.Raw: A heavy steel anvil used to shape metalwork with greater precision. Increases work speed when placed near a smithy. Items of awful and poor quality crafted on the linked workbench have a chance of being upgraded by one quality level. One workbench can only use one anvil.
Rule.Translated: Un yunque de acero pesado utilizado para dar forma a las piezas de metal con mayor precisión. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una herrería. Los objetos de mala o pésima calidad fabricados en la estación de trabajo vinculada tienen una cierta probabilidad de mejorar un nivel de calidad. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar un yunque.

Rule.Original: A manually operated bellows that boosts airflow to the smithy. Increases work speed when placed near a smithy. Bellows reduce the fuel consumption of the linked workbench by 20%. One workbench can only use one bellows.
Rule.Raw: A manually operated bellows that boosts airflow to the smithy. Increases work speed when placed near a smithy. Bellows reduce the fuel consumption of the linked workbench by 20%. One workbench can only use one bellows.
Rule.Translated: Un fuelle accionado manualmente que aumenta el flujo de aire en una herrería. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una herrería. El fuelle reduce el consumo de combustible de la estación de trabajo vinculado en un 20%. Una estación de trabajo solo puede usar un fuelle.

Rule.Original: A small loom for weaving thread. Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring bench. One workbench can only use one tailoring loom.
Rule.Raw: A small loom for weaving thread. Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring bench. One workbench can only use one tailoring loom.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño telar para tejer hilo. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de sastrería. Una estación de trabajo solo puede usar un telar de sastrería.

Rule.Original: A basic mannequin used to measure and shape garments for more refined results. Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring bench. Mannequin stand allows for more precise measurements, reducing the cost of crafting apparel by 10%. One workbench can only use one mannequin.
Rule.Raw: A basic mannequin used to measure and shape garments for more refined results. Increases work speed when placed near a tailoring bench. Mannequin stand allows for more precise measurements, reducing the cost of crafting apparel by 10%. One workbench can only use one mannequin.
Rule.Translated: Un maniquí básico utilizado para medir y dar forma a las prendas para obtener resultados más refinados. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de sastrería. El soporte para maniquí permite tomar medidas más precisas, lo que reduce el coste de la confección en un 10%. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar un soporte para maniquí.

Rule.Original: A small rack filled with various chisels. Increases work speed when placed near a stonecutter’s table. One workbench can only use one chisel rack.
Rule.Raw: A small rack filled with various chisels. Increases work speed when placed near a stonecutter’s table. One workbench can only use one chisel rack.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño estante con varios cinceles. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de cantería. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar un soporte para cinceles.

Rule.Original: A simple clamp for holding large stones in place. Increases work speed when placed near a stonecutter’s table. The clamp allows higher productivity, increasing resource yield from all recipes by 10%. One workbench can only use one stone clamp.
Rule.Raw: A simple clamp for holding large stones in place. Increases work speed when placed near a stonecutter’s table. The clamp allows higher productivity, increasing resource yield from all recipes by 10%. One workbench can only use one stone clamp.
Rule.Translated: Una pinza sencilla para sujetar piedras grandes. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de cantería. La pinza permite una mayor productividad, reduciendo la cantidad de recursos necesaria en cualquier receta en un 10%. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar una pinza para piedras.

Rule.Original: A sturdy rack holding sharp cleavers and knives. Increases work speed when placed near a butchering table. One workbench can only use one cleaver rack.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy rack holding sharp cleavers and knives. Increases work speed when placed near a butchering table. One workbench can only use one cleaver rack.
Rule.Translated: Un robusto soporte para cuchillos de carnicero. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de carnicero. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar un soporte para cuchillos.

Rule.Original: A thick, well-worn wooden board that allows for precision cuts. Increases work speed when placed near a butchering table. The sharp blades allow the butcher to extract 10% more meat and leather from any butchered creature. One workbench can only use one carving board.
Rule.Raw: A thick, well-worn wooden board that allows for precision cuts. Increases work speed when placed near a butchering table. The sharp blades allow the butcher to extract 10% more meat and leather from any butchered creature. One workbench can only use one carving board.
Rule.Translated: Una tabla de madera gruesa y desgastada que permite realizar cortes de precisión. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de carnicero. Las afiladas cuchillas permiten al carnicero extraer un 10% más de carne y cuero de cualquier criatura despiezada. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar una tabla de trinchar.

Rule.Original: A polishing wheel that ensures sculptures have a smooth and refined finish. Increases work speed when placed near an art bench. Stone sculptures of awful and poor quality crafted on the linked art bench have a high chance of being upgraded by one quality level One workbench can only use one stone polisher.
Rule.Raw: A polishing wheel that ensures sculptures have a smooth and refined finish. Increases work speed when placed near an art bench. Stone sculptures of awful and poor quality crafted on the linked art bench have a high chance of being upgraded by one quality level One workbench can only use one stone polisher.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda de pulido que garantiza que las esculturas tengan un acabado suave y refinado. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de arte. Las esculturas de piedra de mala o pésima calidad creadas en el banco de arte vinculado tienen muchas posibilidades de subir un nivel de calidad. Una estación de trabajo solo puede usar un pulidor de piedra.

Rule.Original: A rack with chisels, hammers, and other carving tools. Increases work speed when placed near an art bench. One workbench can only use one tool stand.
Rule.Raw: A rack with chisels, hammers, and other carving tools. Increases work speed when placed near an art bench. One workbench can only use one tool stand.
Rule.Translated: Un estante con cinceles, martillos y otras herramientas de talla. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de arte. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar un soporte para herramientas artísticas.

Rule.Original: A small desk stocked with numerous notes and pieces of paper. Increases work speed when placed near a research bench. One workbench can only use one notes stack.
Rule.Raw: A small desk stocked with numerous notes and pieces of paper. Increases work speed when placed near a research bench. One workbench can only use one notes stack.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño escritorio provisto de numerosas notas y trozos de papel. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de investigación. Una estación de trabajo solo puede utilizar una pila de notas.

Rule.Original: A slate or chalkboard for sketching diagrams and sharing ideas. Increases work speed when placed near a research bench. Up to two research benches can be linked to one chalkboard.
Rule.Raw: A slate or chalkboard for sketching diagrams and sharing ideas. Increases work speed when placed near a research bench. Up to two research benches can be linked to one chalkboard.
Rule.Translated: Una pizarra para esbozar diagramas y compartir ideas. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de investigación. Se pueden vincular hasta dos mesas de investigación a una misma pizarra.

Rule.Original: A small stand holding scalpels, clamps, and bone saws. Increases work speed when placed near a bed of any kind, including sleeping spots and hospital beds. One bed can only use one set of surgical tools.
Rule.Raw: A small stand holding scalpels, clamps, and bone saws. Increases work speed when placed near a bed of any kind, including sleeping spots and hospital beds. One bed can only use one set of surgical tools.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño soporte para bisturíes, pinzas y sierras para huesos. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una cama de cualquier tipo, incluidos los puntos designados en el suelo y las camas de hospital. Una cama solo puede utilizar un juego de herramientas quirúrgicas.

Rule.Original: A small wooden cabinet that can be stocked with herbal remedies, tinctures, and basic medicinal tools. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.
Rule.Raw: A small wooden cabinet that can be stocked with herbal remedies, tinctures, and basic medicinal tools. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño armario de madera que puede abastecerse con remedios herbales, tinturas y herramientas medicinales básicas. Los objetos almacenados en su interior nunca se deterioran y no afectan a la belleza de su entorno.

Rule.Original: A very simple barrel, held together with a series of mortise and tenon joints. Can turn honey into mead.
Rule.Raw: A very simple barrel, held together with a series of mortise and tenon joints. Can turn honey into mead.
Rule.Translated: Una barril muy sencillo, unido con una serie de juntas de mortaja y espiga. Puede convertir la miel en aguamiel.

Rule.Original: A wood-fueled station for brewing various alchemical draughts.
Rule.Raw: A wood-fueled station for brewing various alchemical draughts.
Rule.Translated: Una estación alimentada con leña que sirve para elaborar diversos brebajes alquímicos.

Rule.Original: An electrically-powered station for brewing various alchemical draughts.
Rule.Raw: An electrically-powered station for brewing various alchemical draughts.
Rule.Translated: Una estación alimentada con electricidad que sirve para elaborar diversos brebajes alquímicos.

Rule.Original: A stationary heavy arbalest mounted on a low castle wall to grant cover. While reload speed leaves a lot to be desired, arbalest has an extremely long range, provided there is line of sight on the target.
Rule.Raw: A stationary heavy arbalest mounted on a low castle wall to grant cover. While reload speed leaves a lot to be desired, arbalest has an extremely long range, provided there is line of sight on the target.
Rule.Translated: Una arbalesta pesada estacionario montada sobre un muro bajo del castillo para dar cobertura. Aunque la velocidad de recarga deja mucho que desear, la arbalesta tiene un alcance extremadamente largo, siempre que haya línea de visión sobre el objetivo.

Rule.Original: A stationary heavy arbalest mounted on a low castle wall to grant cover. While reload speed leaves a lot to be desired, arbalest has an extremely long range, provided there is line of sight on the target.
Rule.Raw: A stationary heavy arbalest mounted on a low castle wall to grant cover. While reload speed leaves a lot to be desired, arbalest has an extremely long range, provided there is line of sight on the target.
Rule.Translated: Una arbalesta pesado estacionaria montada sobre un muro bajo del castillo para dar cobertura. Aunque la velocidad de recarga deja mucho que desear, la arbalesta tiene un alcance extremadamente largo, siempre que haya línea de visión sobre el objetivo.

Rule.Original: A stationary arquebus mounted on a low castle wall to grant cover. Because of the added stability, the wall-mounted arquebus can fire much further than normal. The lead balls lose velocity and damage with distance, and are extremely ineffective against armor. Due to the chempowder reaction when firing the arquebus, plumes of blindsmoke are ejected from the barrel.
Rule.Raw: A stationary arquebus mounted on a low castle wall to grant cover. Because of the added stability, the wall-mounted arquebus can fire much further than normal. The lead balls lose velocity and damage with distance, and are extremely ineffective against armor. Due to the chempowder reaction when firing the arquebus, plumes of blindsmoke are ejected from the barrel.
Rule.Translated: Un arcabuz fijo montado sobre un muro bajo del castillo para dar cobertura. Gracias a la estabilidad añadida, el arcabuz puede disparar mucho más lejos de lo normal. Las bolas de plomo pierden velocidad y daño con la distancia, y son extremadamente ineficaces contra las armaduras. Debido a la reacción de la pólvora al disparar el arcabuz, el cañón expulsa columnas de humo ciego.

Rule.Original: A stationary arquebus mounted on a low castle wall to grant cover. Because of the added stability, the wall-mounted arquebus can fire much further than normal. The lead balls lose velocity and damage with distance, and are extremely ineffective against armor. Due to the chempowder reaction when firing the arquebus, plumes of blindsmoke are ejected from the barrel.

The lead balls lose velocity and damage with distance, and are extremely ineffective against armor. Due to the chempowder reaction when firing the arquebus, plumes of blindsmoke are ejected from the barrel.
Rule.Translated: Un arcabuz fijo montado sobre un muro bajo del castillo para dar cobertura. Gracias a la estabilidad añadida, el arcabuz puede disparar mucho más lejos de lo normal. Las bolas de plomo pierden velocidad y daño con la distancia, y son extremadamente ineficaces contra las armaduras. Debido a la reacción de la pólvora al disparar el arcabuz, el cañón expulsa columnas de humo ciego.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall made out of thick overlapping strips of fabric or leather stitched together. Quick to build, but extremely flammable. When deconstructed, returns all of the cloth used.
Rule.Raw: An impassable wall made out of thick overlapping strips of fabric or leather stitched together. Quick to build, but extremely flammable. When deconstructed, returns all of the cloth used.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable hecho de gruesas tiras superpuestas de tela o cuero cosidas entre sí. Es rápido de construir, pero es extremadamente inflamable. Cuando se desmantela, devuelve toda la tela utilizada.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall made out of stone blocks and heavy, carefully fitted timbers forming a box frame. Slow to build but much more resistant to damage. Flammable, but less so than ordinary wooden walls. Capable of holding a roof.
Rule.Raw: An impassable wall made out of stone blocks and heavy, carefully fitted timbers forming a box frame. Slow to build but much more resistant to damage. Flammable, but less so than ordinary wooden walls. Capable of holding a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable hecho de bloques de piedra y troncos de madera pesados, cuidadosamente encajados para formar un armazón. Es lento de construir, pero mucho más resistente a los daños. También es inflamable, pero menos que un muro de madera ordinario. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: An impassable fence made out of vertically-standing wooden stakes. Slow to build but requires little resources. Incapable of holding a roof.
Rule.Raw: An impassable fence made out of vertically-standing wooden stakes. Slow to build but requires little resources. Incapable of holding a roof.
Rule.Translated: Una valla infranqueable hecha de estacas de madera colocadas verticalmente. Es lenta de construir, pero requiere de pocos recursos. Incapaz de sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: An incredibly resistant impassable wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Capable of holding a roof. If castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a chest-high passable cover that when repaired, turns into an impassable wall again.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly resistant impassable wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Capable of holding a roof. If castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a chest-high passable cover that when repaired, turns into an impassable wall again.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable increíblemente resistente hecho de bloques de piedra de gran tamaño, capaz de sostener un techo. Es muy lento de construir. Si un muro de castillo sufre suficientes daños, se convierte en una cubierta transitable a la altura del pecho que, cuando se repara, vuelve a convertirse en un muro infranqueable.

Rule.Original: An incredibly resistant impassable wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Capable of holding a roof. If castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a chest-high passable cover that when repaired, turns into an impassable wall again.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly resistant impassable wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Capable of holding a roof. If castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a chest-high passable cover that when repaired, turns into an impassable wall again.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable increíblemente resistente hecho de bloques de piedra de gran tamaño, capaz de sostener un techo. Es muy lento de construir. Si un muro de castillo sufre suficientes daños, se convierte en una cubierta transitable a la altura del pecho que, cuando se repara, vuelve a convertirse en un muro infranqueable.

Rule.Original: An incredibly resistant chest-high wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Incapable of holding a roof. If low castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a very low but standable cover that when repaired, turns into the chest-high wall again.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly resistant chest-high wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Incapable of holding a roof. If low castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a very low but standable cover that when repaired, turns into the chest-high wall again.
Rule.Translated: Un muro increíblemente resistente de bloques de piedra de gran tamaño. Llega más o menos a la altura del pecho, por lo que es incapaz de sostener un techo. Es muy lento de construir. Si un muro bajo de castillo sufre suficientes daños, se convierte en una cubierta transitable a la altura de los pies que, cuando se repara, vuelve a convertirse en un muro bajo.

Rule.Original: An incredibly resistant chest-high wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Incapable of holding a roof. If low castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a very low but standable cover that when repaired, turns into the chest-high wall again.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly resistant chest-high wall made out of oversized stone blocks. Very slow to build. Incapable of holding a roof. If low castle wall sustains enough damage, it becomes a very low but standable cover that when repaired, turns into the chest-high wall again.
Rule.Translated: Un muro increíblemente resistente de bloques de piedra de gran tamaño. Llega más o menos a la altura del pecho, por lo que es incapaz de sostener un techo. Es muy lento de construir. Si un muro bajo de castillo sufre suficientes daños, se convierte en una cubierta transitable a la altura de los pies que, cuando se repara, vuelve a convertirse en un muro bajo.

Rule.Original: A barrel for fermenting raw must into wine.
Rule.Raw: A barrel for fermenting raw must into wine.
Rule.Translated: Un barril que permite fermentar el mosto de uva y convertirlo en vino.

Rule.Original: An amber-colored drink with tiny particles floating in it that bolsters the immune system of anyone that drinks it. While it helps them fight off sickness better, the downside is that it makes the user feel much more tired after drinking it, as well as overall makes the user get sleepy much faster than usual. The effects of the draught are strongest immediately after consumption, and then slowly fade away over the following days.
Rule.Raw: An amber-colored drink with tiny particles floating in it that bolsters the immune system of anyone that drinks it. While it helps them fight off sickness better, the downside is that it makes the user feel much more tired after drinking it, as well as overall makes the user get sleepy much faster than usual. The effects of the draught are strongest immediately after consumption, and then slowly fade away over the following days.
Rule.Translated: Una bebida de color ámbar con pequeñas partículas flotando en ella que refuerza el sistema inmunológico de cualquiera que la beba. Aunque ayuda a combatir mejor las enfermedades, el inconveniente es que hace que el usuario se sienta mucho más cansado después de beberla, haciendo que tenga sueño mucho más rápido de lo habitual. Los efectos de la bebida son más intensos inmediatamente después de consumirla y desaparecen lentamente en los días siguientes.

Rule.Original: A vibrant red liquid. When the user drinks it, it greatly enhances their injury healing rate, speeding up the process of wound closure and tissue repair. This potion works by boosting the body’s natural healing mechanisms, making recovery from injuries much quicker.
Rule.Raw: A vibrant red liquid. When the user drinks it, it greatly enhances their injury healing rate, speeding up the process of wound closure and tissue repair. This potion works by boosting the body’s natural healing mechanisms, making recovery from injuries much quicker.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido de color rojo vivo. El que lo beba mejorará enormemente su ritmo de curación, acelerando el proceso de cierre de heridas y reparación de tejidos. Esta poción estimula los mecanismos naturales de curación del cuerpo y acelera la recuperación de las heridas.

Rule.Original: A bold, deep red liquid. When the user drinks it, it significantly increases their physical strength, giving them the power to perform feats they normally couldn't. However, the potion also raises the user's mental break threshold, making them more prone to psychological stress. Additionally, the intense surge of strength increases the likelihood of conflicts, leading to a higher chance of social fights.
Rule.Raw: A bold, deep red liquid. When the user drinks it, it significantly increases their physical strength, giving them the power to perform feats they normally couldn't. However, the potion also raises the user's mental break threshold, making them more prone to psychological stress. Additionally, the intense surge of strength increases the likelihood of conflicts, leading to a higher chance of social fights.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido de color rojo intenso. El que lo beba verá un aumento significativo de su fuerza física, dándole la capacidad de realizar hazañas que normalmente no podría. Sin embargo, la poción también eleva el umbral de colapso mental del usuario, haciéndole más propenso al estrés psicológico. Además, la intensa oleada de fuerza aumenta la probabilidad de conflictos, lo que conducirá a una mayor probabilidad de iniciar peleas sociales.

Rule.Original: A slate-gray liquid that when drunk, enhances the user’s global work speed and reduces their energy depletion, allowing them to work faster and longer without feeling tired. However, the intense boost in productivity comes at a significant risk, increasing the chance of a heart attack due to the strain on the body. After the potion's effects diminish, the user experiences a sharp increase in the rate at which they become sleepy, necessitating immediate rest to recover.
Rule.Raw: A slate-gray liquid that when drunk, enhances the user’s global work speed and reduces their energy depletion, allowing them to work faster and longer without feeling tired. However, the intense boost in productivity comes at a significant risk, increasing the chance of a heart attack due to the strain on the body. After the potion's effects diminish, the user experiences a sharp increase in the rate at which they become sleepy, necessitating immediate rest to recover.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido de color gris pizarra que, al beberlo, aumenta la velocidad global de trabajo del usuario y reduce su agotamiento energético, lo que le permite trabajar más rápido y durante más tiempo sin sentirse cansado. Sin embargo, el intenso aumento de la productividad conlleva un riesgo significativo, ya que aumenta la posibilidad de sufrir un ataque al corazón debido a la tensión a la que se somete el cuerpo. Una vez que los efectos de la poción disminuyen, el usuario experimenta un fuerte aumento de la velocidad a la que le entra sueño, necesitando un descanso inmediato para recuperarse.

Rule.Original: A pale blue liquid known as Painkiller Draught. When the user drinks it, it effectively reduces their sensation of pain, providing relief from discomfort and injuries. However, the sedative components of the draught also diminish the user's productivity and focus, making it harder to concentrate and complete tasks efficiently. This makes it suitable for recovery periods but less ideal when active mental or physical effort is required.
Rule.Raw: A pale blue liquid known as Painkiller Draught. When the user drinks it, it effectively reduces their sensation of pain, providing relief from discomfort and injuries. However, the sedative components of the draught also diminish the user's productivity and focus, making it harder to concentrate and complete tasks efficiently. This makes it suitable for recovery periods but less ideal when active mental or physical effort is required.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido azul pálido que, al beberlo, reduce eficazmente el dolor, aliviando molestias y lesiones. Sin embargo, los componentes sedantes de la bebida también disminuyen la productividad y la atención del consumidor, dificultando la concentración y la realización eficaz de tareas. Esto la hace adecuada para periodos de recuperación, pero menos ideal cuando se requiere un esfuerzo mental o físico activo.

Rule.Original: A dark, foreboding purple liquid. When the user drinks it, it induces severe pain, incapacitating them to the point where movement becomes impossible. For prisoners, this intense agony causes a rapid decline in their will to resist, breaking down any mental barriers they may have. In the case of slaves, the draught completely suppresses their spirit, leaving them entirely subdued. This potion is used with caution due to its extreme effects.
Rule.Raw: A dark, foreboding purple liquid. When the user drinks it, it induces severe pain, incapacitating them to the point where movement becomes impossible. For prisoners, this intense agony causes a rapid decline in their will to resist, breaking down any mental barriers they may have. In the case of slaves, the draught completely suppresses their spirit, leaving them entirely subdued. This potion is used with caution due to its extreme effects.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido púrpura oscuro de aspecto ominoso. Al que lo beba le entrará un dolor intenso, tanto que le incapacitará hasta el punto de no poder moverse. En el caso de los prisioneros, esta intensa agonía provocará una rápida disminución de su voluntad de resistir, rompiendo cualquier barrera mental que pudieran tener. Para el caso de los esclavos, la poción suprime por completo su espíritu, dejándolos totalmente sometidos. Esta poción debe utilizarse con precaución debido a sus efectos extremos.

Rule.Original: A crisp, energizing turquoise liquid that when drank, significantly enhances learning abilities of the user, enabling them to absorb and retain more information rapidly. Additionally, the draught increases the efficiency of eating and resting, allowing quicker nourishment and recovery. It also boosts the accumulation of psyfocus, enhancing mental clarity and psychic abilities. However, once the effects of the draught begin to fade, these enhancements reverse, leading to decreased learning capacity, slower eating and resting rates, and diminished psyfocus.
Rule.Raw: A crisp, energizing turquoise liquid that when drank, significantly enhances learning abilities of the user, enabling them to absorb and retain more information rapidly.
