Rule.Original: My eyes are crying and i feel as if a simple cut would feel as painful as a torn limb.
Rule.Raw: My eyes are crying and i feel as if a simple cut would feel as painful as a torn limb.
Rule.Translated: Mis ojos lloran y siento como si un simple corte doliera tanto como un miembro arrancado.

Rule.Original: Everythig hurts, from moving to breathing, make it stop !
Rule.Raw: Everythig hurts, from moving to breathing, make it stop !
Rule.Translated: Todo duele, desde moverme hasta respirar, ¡que pare!

Rule.Original: Because of an red tear addiction, this person needs to regularly consume the venom to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Raw: Because of an red tear addiction, this person needs to regularly consume the venom to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Translated: Debido a una adicción a la tinta roja, esta persona necesita consumir regularmente este veneno para evitar síntomas de abstinencia.

Rule.Original: A built-up tolerance to the red ink. The more severe this tolerance is, the more it will take to get the same effect.
Rule.Raw: A built-up tolerance to the red ink. The more severe this tolerance is, the more it will take to get the same effect.
Rule.Translated: Tolerancia desarrollada a la tinta roja. Cuanto más grave sea esta tolerancia, más se necesitará para obtener el mismo efecto.

Rule.Original: A chemical addiction to the red ink. Long exposure to its euphoric effects has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of red ink, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Raw: A chemical addiction to the red ink. Long exposure to its euphoric effects has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of red ink, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Translated: Adicción química a la tinta roja. La exposición prolongada a sus efectos eufóricos ha causado adaptaciones neurológicas a nivel celular, por lo que el cerebro ya no puede funcionar correctamente sin la sustancia.\nSin dosis regulares de tinta roja, comenzarán los síntomas de abstinencia. Sin embargo, la abstinencia prolongada forzará al cerebro a readaptarse a su estado normal, resolviendo la adicción.

Rule.Original: I feel cold, as if all warmth from my body was stripped away.
Rule.Raw: I feel cold, as if all warmth from my body was stripped away.
Rule.Translated: Me siento frío, como si me hubieran arrancado todo el calor del cuerpo.

Rule.Original: One of the largest flightless birds, and the north's apex predator. The crestel is a fearsome beast that can completely paralyze unfortunate victims for a short duration with its venomous beak, rendering them helpless against its attacks. Despite their delicate look, the crestel's feathers are harder than stone, serving as natural armor.\n\nIts vicious nature and unusual appearance perpetuates numerous myths- legends of a beast capable of turning flesh to stone with its gaze. Some also believe the crestel to be a bad omen, a sign of the coming end, and the start of a new age.
Rule.Raw: One of the largest flightless birds, and the north's apex predator. The crestel is a fearsome beast that can completely paralyze unfortunate victims for a short duration with its venomous beak, rendering them helpless against its attacks. Despite their delicate look, the crestel's feathers are harder than stone, serving as natural armor.\n\nIts vicious nature and unusual appearance perpetuates numerous myths- legends of a beast capable of turning flesh to stone with its gaze. Some also believe the crestel to be a bad omen, a sign of the coming end, and the start of a new age.
Rule.Translated: Una de las aves no voladoras más grandes y el depredador supremo del norte. La cocatriz es una bestia temible que puede paralizar completamente a víctimas desafortunadas durante un breve periodo con su pico venenoso, dejándolas indefensas ante sus ataques. A pesar de su aspecto delicado, las plumas de la cocatriz son más duras que la piedra, sirviendo como armadura natural.\n\nSu naturaleza viciosa y apariencia inusual perpetúa numerosos mitos: leyendas de una bestia capaz de convertir la carne en piedra con su mirada. Algunos también creen que la cocatriz es un mal presagio, un signo del fin que se acerca y el comienzo de una nueva era.

Rule.Original: A large crestel egg with a thick rocky shell that serves as a natural disguise. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A large crestel egg with a thick rocky shell that serves as a natural disguise. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un gran huevo de cocatriz con una gruesa cáscara rocosa que sirve de camuflaje natural. Puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho, mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized crestel egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a crestel chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized crestel egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a crestel chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fertilizado de cocatriz. Si todo va bien, eclosionará en un polluelo de cocatriz. Puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: The dwarven muffton is sheep-like herbivore known for its warm brown wool and gigantic horns. Herds can be often seen hopping around in the cold northern mountains where they live most of the year. Prideful and with a firey temperament, the males tends to fight by ramming their heads until one or the other is killed.\n\nThere are tales of a stoneborn king who fought countless battles on the back of a dwarven muffton. This legend gave rise to a tradition among certain clans, in which upon reaching puberty each stoneborn would be given a baby muffton.
Rule.Raw: The dwarven muffton is sheep-like herbivore known for its warm brown wool and gigantic horns. Herds can be often seen hopping around in the cold northern mountains where they live most of the year. Prideful and with a firey temperament, the males tends to fight by ramming their heads until one or the other is killed.\n\nThere are tales of a stoneborn king who fought countless battles on the back of a dwarven muffton. This legend gave rise to a tradition among certain clans, in which upon reaching puberty each stoneborn would be given a baby muffton.
Rule.Translated: El muftón enano es un herbívoro parecido a una oveja, conocido por su cálida lana marrón y sus gigantescos cuernos. A menudo pueden verse rebaños saltando por las frías montañas del norte, donde viven la mayor parte del año. Orgullosos y de temperamento fogoso, los machos tienden a luchar embistiendo sus cabezas hasta que uno u otro muere.\n\nHay cuentos de un rey piedranato que libró innumerables batallas montado en un muftón enano. Esta leyenda dio lugar a una tradición entre ciertos clanes, por la cual al llegar a la pubertad cada piedranato recibía un muftón bebé.

Rule.Original: Disoriented by a powerful blunt shock.
Rule.Raw: Disoriented by a powerful blunt shock.
Rule.Translated: Desorientado por un golpe contundente poderoso.

Rule.Original: The strong and pungent milk of a dwarven muffton. It is rather acidic and leaves a sour aftertaste if eaten raw, fortunately it loose most of its acidity when cooked.
Rule.Raw: The strong and pungent milk of a dwarven muffton. It is rather acidic and leaves a sour aftertaste if eaten raw, fortunately it loose most of its acidity when cooked.
Rule.Translated: La leche fuerte y picante de un muftón enano. Es bastante ácida y deja un regusto agrio si se consume cruda; afortunadamente, pierde la mayor parte de su acidez al cocinarse.

Rule.Original: I drank muffton milk. The sharp, pungent flavor leaves a bad aftertaste.
Rule.Raw: I drank muffton milk. The sharp, pungent flavor leaves a bad aftertaste.
Rule.Translated: Bebí leche de muftón. El sabor agudo y picante deja un mal regusto.

Rule.Original: Muffton milk which has been stirred and fermented for a extended duration. While not as alcoholic as other beverages excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.
Rule.Raw: Muffton milk which has been stirred and fermented for a extended duration. While not as alcoholic as other beverages excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.
Rule.Translated: Leche de muftón que ha sido removida y fermentada durante un periodo prolongado. Aunque no es tan alcohólica como otras bebidas, el consumo excesivo puede provocar desmayos etílicos y, con el tiempo, adicción.

Rule.Original: Stir muffton milk for a long period of time until fermentation, resulting in a alcoholic drink called karhan.
Rule.Raw: Stir muffton milk for a long period of time until fermentation, resulting in a alcoholic drink called karhan.
Rule.Translated: Remueve leche de muftón durante un largo periodo hasta que fermente, obteniendo una bebida alcohólica llamada karhan.

Rule.Original: Fermenting muffton milk that needs to be stirred regularly in order to produce karhan.
Rule.Raw: Fermenting muffton milk that needs to be stirred regularly in order to produce karhan.
Rule.Translated: Leche de muftón en fermentación que debe removerse regularmente para producir karhan.

Rule.Original: An enormous, carnivorous amphibian reigning as swamplands' apex predator. The tooth-filled maw that earned giant snaptoad its moniker can easily crush bone, and unhinge to swallow smaller prey whole after a leaping ambush from between the reeds. Its dentition, unique among contemporary amphibians, leads to speculation among scholars about whether giant snaptoad is a true toad, or an unrelated amphibian that convergently developed toad-like traits.\n\nGiant snaptoads practice a rare form of child rearing called gastric brooding: upon fertilization, the eggs are immediately swallowed by the female and stored in a special chamber in their stomach. There, the tadpoles can safely hatch and develop, regurgitated by their parent only once they have transformed into froglets. However, in rare cases, the practice is omitted, and the tadpoles are left to fend for themselves in marshy waters.
Rule.Raw: An enormous, carnivorous amphibian reigning as swamplands' apex predator. The tooth-filled maw that earned giant snaptoad its moniker can easily crush bone, and unhinge to swallow smaller prey whole after a leaping ambush from between the reeds. Its dentition, unique among contemporary amphibians, leads to speculation among scholars about whether giant snaptoad is a true toad, or an unrelated amphibian that convergently developed toad-like traits.\n\nGiant snaptoads practice a rare form of child rearing called gastric brooding: upon fertilization, the eggs are immediately swallowed by the female and stored in a special chamber in their stomach. There, the tadpoles can safely hatch and develop, regurgitated by their parent only once they have transformed into froglets. However, in rare cases, the practice is omitted, and the tadpoles are left to fend for themselves in marshy waters.
Rule.Translated: Un anfibio carnívoro enorme que reina como el depredador supremo de los humedales. La mandíbula llena de dientes que le dio su nombre puede aplastar huesos con facilidad y desencajarse para tragar presas más pequeñas enteras tras un salto sorpresa entre los juncos. Su dentición, única entre los anfibios contemporáneos, lleva a especulaciones entre los eruditos sobre si el sapo mordedor gigante es un sapo verdadero o un anfibio no relacionado que desarrolló rasgos similares de forma convergente.\n\nLos sapos mordedores gigantes practican una forma rara de crianza llamada incubación gástrica: tras la fertilización, los huevos son inmediatamente tragados por la hembra y almacenados en una cámara especial de su estómago. Allí, los renacuajos pueden eclosionar y desarrollarse con seguridad, siendo regurgitados por su progenitor solo una vez que se han transformado en juveniles. Sin embargo, en raras ocasiones se omite esta práctica y los renacuajos se quedan a su suerte en aguas pantanosas.

Rule.Original: Tales are told of a gleaming giant gilding the very earth it walks upon, making a king out of the poorest serf with the treasure left in its wake. Many such myths surround the fabled goldilox, a legendary beast who roams the world. While peaceful by nature, goldilox is a fierce defender, trampling any who incur its wrath beneath golden hooves.\n\nThe few who ever managed to tame the beast were rewarded with a rich and creamy milk, and its glistening wool rumored to be made out of genuine gold.
Rule.Raw: Tales are told of a gleaming giant gilding the very earth it walks upon, making a king out of the poorest serf with the treasure left in its wake. Many such myths surround the fabled goldilox, a legendary beast who roams the world. While peaceful by nature, goldilox is a fierce defender, trampling any who incur its wrath beneath golden hooves.\n\nThe few who ever managed to tame the beast were rewarded with a rich and creamy milk, and its glistening wool rumored to be made out of genuine gold.
Rule.Translated: Se cuentan historias de un gigante reluciente que doraba la tierra que pisaba, convirtiendo en rey al siervo más pobre con el tesoro que dejaba a su paso. Muchos mitos así rodean al legendario vellocino áureo, una bestia mítica que recorre el mundo. Aunque pacífico por naturaleza, el vellocino áureo es un defensor feroz, aplastando bajo sus pezuñas doradas a cualquiera que incurra en su ira.\n\nLos pocos que lograron domar a la bestia fueron recompensados con una leche rica y cremosa, y su lana reluciente de la que se rumorea está hecha de oro genuino.

Rule.Original: The rich and creamy milk of a goldilox. While it taste better raw, it still maintain some of its flavors when cooked.
Rule.Raw: The rich and creamy milk of a goldilox. While it taste better raw, it still maintain some of its flavors when cooked.
Rule.Translated: La leche rica y cremosa de un vellocino áureo. Aunque sabe mejor cruda, conserva parte de su sabor al cocinarse.

Rule.Original: I drank exquisite milk. The slight buttery notes and creamy texture were amazing.
Rule.Raw: I drank exquisite milk. The slight buttery notes and creamy texture were amazing.
Rule.Translated: Bebí leche exquisita. Las ligeras notas mantecosas y la textura cremosa eran asombrosas.

Rule.Original: I ate a meal containing regal milk, it really elevated the savors.
Rule.Raw: I ate a meal containing regal milk, it really elevated the savors.
Rule.Translated: Comí una comida que contenía leche real, realmente realzó los sabores.

Rule.Original: Because of a regal milk addiction, this person needs to regularly consume regal milk to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Raw: Because of a regal milk addiction, this person needs to regularly consume regal milk to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Translated: Debido a una adicción a la leche real, esta persona necesita consumir regularmente leche real para evitar síntomas de abstinencia.

Rule.Original: A psychological addiction to regal milk. Because of its exquisite taste the brain cannot function without it. \nWithout regular doses of regal milk, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Raw: A psychological addiction to regal milk. Because of its exquisite taste the brain cannot function without it. \nWithout regular doses of regal milk, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Translated: Adicción psicológica a la leche real. Debido a su exquisito sabor, el cerebro no puede funcionar sin ella.\nSin dosis regulares de leche real, comenzarán los síntomas de abstinencia. Sin embargo, la abstinencia prolongada forzará al cerebro a readaptarse a su estado normal, y la adicción desaparecerá.

Rule.Original: Everything is tasteless, i desire nothing more than a drop of regal milk.
Rule.Raw: Everything is tasteless, i desire nothing more than a drop of regal milk.
Rule.Translated: Todo es insípido, no deseo nada más que una gota de leche real.

Rule.Original: A large beetle covered in iron-like carapace. Fearful and reclusive, these peculiar insectoids burrow into ore deposits to give birth, where their young can stay safe and absorb the minerals necessary for formation of their metallic shells.\n\nExperienced quarry overseers often hire hunters to track ironcasket beetle nests, as their shells can be extracted for a hassle-free source of steel.
Rule.Raw: A large beetle covered in iron-like carapace. Fearful and reclusive, these peculiar insectoids burrow into ore deposits to give birth, where their young can stay safe and absorb the minerals necessary for formation of their metallic shells.\n\nExperienced quarry overseers often hire hunters to track ironcasket beetle nests, as their shells can be extracted for a hassle-free source of steel.
Rule.Translated: Un gran escarabajo cubierto por un caparazón similar al hierro. Temerosos y solitarios, estos insectoides peculiares excavan en depósitos de mineral para dar a luz, donde sus crías pueden permanecer seguras y absorber los minerales necesarios para la formación de sus caparazones metálicos.\n\nLos supervisores de canteras experimentados a menudo contratan cazadores para rastrear nidos de escarabajos de hierro, ya que sus caparazones pueden extraerse para obtener una fuente de acero sin complicaciones.

Rule.Original: The remains of some ancient, collapsed structure. Rich in steel.
Rule.Raw: The remains of some ancient, collapsed structure. Rich in steel.
Rule.Translated: Restos de alguna antigua estructura colapsada. Rico en acero.

Rule.Original: One of the ore deposit started to move frenetically. It appears that it was infested by a ironcasket beetle. The confused insectoid is now fleeing in panic.
Rule.Raw: One of the ore deposit started to move frenetically. It appears that it was infested by a ironcasket beetle. The confused insectoid is now fleeing in panic.
Rule.Translated: Uno de los depósitos de mineral comenzó a moverse frenéticamente. Parece que estaba infestado por un escarabajo de hierro. El insectoide confundido ahora huye en pánico.
Roca que contiene trozos de hierro.

Rule.Original: One of the ore deposit started to move frenetically. It appears that it was infested by a ironcasket beetle. The confused insectoid is now fleeing in panic.
Rule.Raw: One of the ore deposit started to move frenetically. It appears that it was infested by a ironcasket beetle. The confused insectoid is now fleeing in panic.
Rule.Translated: Uno de los depósitos de mineral comenzó a moverse frenéticamente. Parece que estaba infestado por un escarabajo de hierro. El insectoide confundido ahora huye en pánico.

Rule.Original: A large nocturnal bat-like creature who lives in the arid wastes of the world. They primarily feed on blood, which they suck off sleeping animals when twilight descends on the cold dunes.\n\nWhile weaker and smaller than a wolf, the karabal makes up for its size with its bite, injecting an anti-coagulant venom that greatly increases the threat of blood loss.
Rule.Raw: A large nocturnal bat-like creature who lives in the arid wastes of the world. They primarily feed on blood, which they suck off sleeping animals when twilight descends on the cold dunes.\n\nWhile weaker and smaller than a wolf, the karabal makes up for its size with its bite, injecting an anti-coagulant venom that greatly increases the threat of blood loss.
Rule.Translated: Una gran criatura nocturna similar a un murciélago que vive en los páramos áridos del mundo. Se alimenta principalmente de sangre, que chupa de animales dormidos cuando el crepúsculo desciende sobre las dunas frías.\n\nAunque más débil y pequeño que un lobo, el karabal compensa su tamaño con su mordedura, inyectando un veneno anticoagulante que aumenta enormemente la amenaza de pérdida de sangre.

Rule.Original: Struck by the anti-coagulant venom of a karabal. Greatly increase bloodloss.
Rule.Raw: Struck by the anti-coagulant venom of a karabal. Greatly increase bloodloss.
Rule.Translated: Golpeado por el veneno anticoagulante de un karabal. Aumenta enormemente la pérdida de sangre.

Rule.Original: A giant crustacean who lives most of its life under the cold blanket of the sea. When the tide is low, leviathans may wander inland to prey on the unfortunate using their massive claw.n\n\Some courageous fishermen have made a habit out of hunting for leviathan juveniles, as their flesh can last a long time without spoiling away.
Rule.Raw: A giant crustacean who lives most of its life under the cold blanket of the sea. When the tide is low, leviathans may wander inland to prey on the unfortunate using their massive claw.n\n\Some courageous fishermen have made a habit out of hunting for leviathan juveniles, as their flesh can last a long time without spoiling away.
Rule.Translated: Un crustáceo gigante que vive la mayor parte de su vida bajo el manto frío del mar. Cuando la marea está baja, los leviatanes pueden adentrarse en tierra para cazar a los desafortunados usando sus pinzas masivas.\n\nAlgunos valientes pescadores han tomado la costumbre de cazar juveniles de leviatán, ya que su carne puede durar mucho tiempo sin estropearse.

Rule.Original: The colossal northern cousin of the wild boar. The drog is a gigantic dendrovore that roams the colder regions of the world where it can be seen tearing down trees to feed on with it's massive tusks. Territorial by nature, it will not hesitate to crush anything that earns its ire.\n\nDespite its impressive size and strength, the drog is often hunted for it's thick fur and valuable tusks.
Rule.Raw: The colossal northern cousin of the wild boar. The drog is a gigantic dendrovore that roams the colder regions of the world where it can be seen tearing down trees to feed on with it's massive tusks. Territorial by nature, it will not hesitate to crush anything that earns its ire.\n\nDespite its impressive size and strength, the drog is often hunted for it's thick fur and valuable tusks.
Rule.Translated: El primo colosal del norte del jabalí salvaje. El nago es un dendróvoro gigantesco que recorre las regiones más frías del mundo, donde puede verse derribando árboles para alimentarse con sus colmillos masivos. Territorial por naturaleza, no dudará en aplastar cualquier cosa que provoque su ira.\n\nA pesar de su impresionante tamaño y fuerza, el nago suele ser cazado por su grueso pelaje y sus valiosos colmillos.

Rule.Original: A strange creature combining the features of a feline and that of an owl. The nimble predator referred only as owlcats can be commonly found hunting and nesting in the woodlands. Their long elegant wings are vestigial and primarly serve in the mating season, in order to attract new partners or to scare off predators by appearing bigger than they are.\n\nSome hunters have taken a liking to owlcats for their ability to quickly track and hunt rodents.
Rule.Raw: A strange creature combining the features of a feline and that of an owl. The nimble predator referred only as owlcats can be commonly found hunting and nesting in the woodlands. Their long elegant wings are vestigial and primarly serve in the mating season, in order to attract new partners or to scare off predators by appearing bigger than they are.\n\nSome hunters have taken a liking to owlcats for their ability to quickly track and hunt rodents.
Rule.Translated: Una extraña criatura que combina rasgos felinos y de búho. Este ágil depredador, llamado simplemente gatobúho, puede encontrarse comúnmente cazando y anidando en bosques. Sus alas largas y elegantes son vestigiales y sirven principalmente en la época de apareamiento, para atraer nuevas parejas o ahuyentar depredadores aparentando ser más grandes de lo que son.\n\nAlgunos cazadores han tomado afecto a los gatobúhos por su capacidad para rastrear y cazar roedores rápidamente.

Rule.Original: A strange creature combining the features of a feline and that of an owl. The nimble predator referred only as owlcats can be commonly found hunting and nesting in the woodlands. Their long elegant wings are vestigial and primarly serve in the mating season, in order to attract new partners or to scare off predators by appearing bigger than they are.\n\nAdapted to the frozen climates, the arctic owlcat can be seen wandering the white landscapes in search of preys, only to seek shelter in the nearby forests when winter comes..
Rule.Raw: A strange creature combining the features of a feline and that of an owl. The nimble predator referred only as owlcats can be commonly found hunting and nesting in the woodlands. Their long elegant wings are vestigial and primarly serve in the mating season, in order to attract new partners or to scare off predators by appearing bigger than they are.\n\nAdapted to the frozen climates, the arctic owlcat can be seen wandering the white landscapes in search of preys, only to seek shelter in the nearby forests when winter comes..
Rule.Translated: Una extraña criatura que combina rasgos felinos y de búho. Este ágil depredador, llamado simplemente gatobúho, puede encontrarse comúnmente cazando y anidando en bosques. Sus alas largas y elegantes son vestigiales y sirven principalmente en la época de apareamiento, para atraer nuevas parejas o ahuyentar depredadores aparentando ser más grandes de lo que son.\n\nAdaptado a climas helados, el gatobúho ártico puede verse deambulando por los paisajes blancos en busca de presas, para luego buscar refugio en los bosques cercanos cuando llega el invierno.

Rule.Original: The prickly egg of an owlcat, mimicing the features of a pinecone. It can be eaten raw but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: The prickly egg of an owlcat, mimicing the features of a pinecone. It can be eaten raw but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: El huevo espinoso de un gatobúho, que imita las características de una piña. Puede comerse crudo pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized owlcat egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a owlkitten. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized owlcat egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a owlkitten. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fertilizado de gatobúho. Si todo va bien, eclosionará en un gatito de gatobúho. Es muy nutritivo y puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: The prickly egg of an owlcat, mimicing the features of a pinecone. It can be eaten raw but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: The prickly egg of an owlcat, mimicing the features of a pinecone. It can be eaten raw but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: El huevo espinoso de un gatobúho, que imita las características de una piña. Puede comerse crudo pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized owlcat egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a owlkitten. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized owlcat egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a owlkitten. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fertilizado de gatobúho. Si todo va bien, eclosionará en un gatito de gatobúho. Es muy nutritivo y puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: The buzzing pest of the marshy groves. The phrak is a mosquito-like insectoid that hunts using it's large rostrum. While not particularly armored, it makes up for with its agility and quick reflexes, outmaneuvering even the most trained of fighters. They spread by laying numerous eggs in bodies of water, making swamps a perfect habitat for them.\n\nPhraks can use a special organ near their abdomen to shoot a volley of toxic barbpikes in order to quickly take out hostile threats from afar.
Rule.Raw: The buzzing pest of the marshy groves. The phrak is a mosquito-like insectoid that hunts using it's large rostrum. While not particularly armored, it makes up for with its agility and quick reflexes, outmaneuvering even the most trained of fighters. They spread by laying numerous eggs in bodies of water, making swamps a perfect habitat for them.\n\nPhraks can use a special organ near their abdomen to shoot a volley of toxic barbpikes in order to quickly take out hostile threats from afar.
Rule.Translated: La molesta plaga de los humedales pantanosos. El phrak es un insectoide similar a un mosquito que caza usando su largo rostro. Aunque no está particularmente blindado, lo compensa con su agilidad y reflejos rápidos, superando en maniobrabilidad incluso a los combatientes más entrenados. Se reproducen poniendo numerosos huevos en cuerpos de agua, haciendo de los pantanos un hábitat perfecto para ellos.\n\nLos phraks pueden usar un órgano especial cerca de su abdomen para lanzar una ráfaga de púas tóxicas y eliminar rápidamente amenazas hostiles desde la distancia.

Rule.Original: The sticky egg of a phrak. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: The sticky egg of a phrak. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: El huevo pegajoso de un phrak. Puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho, mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized phrak egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a phrak larvling. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized phrak egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a phrak larvling. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fertilizado de phrak. Si todo va bien, eclosionará en una larva de phrak. Puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A dangerous toxin inflicted by a phrak. Quite dangerous as it can quickly lead to death at high doses. Even at low doses, it can generate cancers.
Rule.Raw: A dangerous toxin inflicted by a phrak. Quite dangerous as it can quickly lead to death at high doses. Even at low doses, it can generate cancers.
Rule.Translated: Toxina peligrosa infligida por un phrak. Muy peligrosa, ya que en dosis altas puede llevar rápidamente a la muerte. Incluso en dosis bajas, puede generar cánceres.

Rule.Original: A large avian often seen striding amidst the dunes. The pilgrims were given their name after their long migration periods which can last months as they travel from one desert to the next.\n\nPilgrims are often domesticated by the southern tribes to serve as mounts and for their eggs which provides nutrition in the harsh desert conditions.
Rule.Raw: A large avian often seen striding amidst the dunes. The pilgrims were given their name after their long migration periods which can last months as they travel from one desert to the next.\n\nPilgrims are often domesticated by the southern tribes to serve as mounts and for their eggs which provides nutrition in the harsh desert conditions.
Rule.Translated: Un ave grande que a menudo se ve caminando entre las dunas. Los Seikrets son domesticados a menudo por las tribus del sur para servir como monturas y por sus huevos, que proporcionan nutrición en las duras condiciones desérticas.

Rule.Original: The sand-colored egg of a pilgrim. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: The sand-colored egg of a pilgrim. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: El huevo color arena de un Seikret. Puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho, mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized pilgrim egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a pilgrim chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized pilgrim egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a pilgrim chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fertilizado de Seikret. Si todo va bien, eclosionará en un polluelo de Seikret. Puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: An elusive and deceitful creature, the red-horned larpah is a large leporidae with tall brown antlers protruding from it's head. While it may look gentle, larpah's apperence belies its predatory, fierce nature. As they grow older, a thick layer of dried blood from past battles coats their horns, earning them the moniker of "red-horned".\n\nDeadly and tough for its size, its aggressiveness rarely discourages hunters from trying their luck at slaying the beast for its durable pelt and valuable antlers, which can be turned into a powerful mixture.
Rule.Raw: An elusive and deceitful creature, the red-horned larpah is a large leporidae with tall brown antlers protruding from it's head. While it may look gentle, larpah's apperence belies its predatory, fierce nature. As they grow older, a thick layer of dried blood from past battles coats their horns, earning them the moniker of "red-horned".\n\nDeadly and tough for its size, its aggressiveness rarely discourages hunters from trying their luck at slaying the beast for its durable pelt and valuable antlers, which can be turned into a powerful mixture.
Rule.Translated: Una criatura escurridiza y engañosa, el larpa cornirrojo es un gran lepórido con altos cuernos marrones que sobresalen de su cabeza. Aunque pueda parecer gentil, la apariencia del larpa oculta su naturaleza depredadora y feroz. A medida que envejecen, una gruesa capa de sangre seca de batallas pasadas cubre sus cuernos, ganándose el apodo de "cornirrojo".\n\nMortífero y resistente para su tamaño, su agresividad rara vez desanima a los cazadores de intentar suerte matando a la bestia por su dura piel y valiosos cuernos, que pueden convertirse en una poderosa mezcla.

Rule.Original: A red mixture of bone marrow extracted from the antlers of a larpah and several herbs. It is consumed by burning the concoction and inhaling the fumes, which drastically increase one's abilities and strength.\n\nWhile the powerful drug is non-addictive, it can lead to a uncontrollable frenzy.
Rule.Raw: A red mixture of bone marrow extracted from the antlers of a larpah and several herbs. It is consumed by burning the concoction and inhaling the fumes, which drastically increase one's abilities and strength.\n\nWhile the powerful drug is non-addictive, it can lead to a uncontrollable frenzy.
Rule.Translated: Una mezcla roja de médula ósea extraída de los cuernos de un larpa y varias hierbas. Se consume quemando la poción e inhalando los vapores, lo que aumenta drásticamente las habilidades y la fuerza.\n\nAunque esta poderosa droga no es adictiva, puede llevar a un frenesí incontrolable.

Rule.Original: Inhaled fumes from the red mix known as scarlet scent. Greatly increase one's combat capabilities, while possibly entering a blood fueled frenzy.
Rule.Raw: Inhaled fumes from the red mix known as scarlet scent. Greatly increase one's combat capabilities, while possibly entering a blood fueled frenzy.
Rule.Translated: Vapores inhalados de la mezcla roja conocida como aroma escarlata. Aumenta enormemente las capacidades de combate, pudiendo entrar en un frenesí alimentado por la sangre.

Rule.Original: I feel my own blood boiling, i feel powerful.
Rule.Raw: I feel my own blood boiling, i feel powerful.
Rule.Translated: Siento mi propia sangre hirviendo, me siento poderoso.

Rule.Original: Extract the bone marrow of a pair of larpah antlers and mix it with various herbs in order to create scarlet scent, a potent battle drug.
Rule.Raw: Extract the bone marrow of a pair of larpah antlers and mix it with various herbs in order to create scarlet scent, a potent battle drug.
Rule.Translated: Extrae la médula ósea de un par de cuernos de larpa y mézclala con varias hierbas para crear el esencia escarlata, una potente droga de combate.

Rule.Original: Unfinished scarlet scent that is still in the mixing process.
Rule.Raw: Unfinished scarlet scent that is still in the mixing process.
Rule.Translated: Esencia escarlata sin terminar que aún está en proceso de mezcla.

Rule.Original: Nearly the size of a bear, the imperial redhound is the largest dog breed in the world. Trained to protect and serve kings, they are seen as pure and noble with an undying loyalty, even capable of overpowering the fiercest of men with their prodigious strength.\n\nRedhounds are clever beasts, and their intelligence is known throughout the lands, as they are capable of following even the most complex of orders. With only a few sanctioned kennel-masters allowed to breed them, it makes them a rare sight outside of a noble court.
Rule.Raw: Nearly the size of a bear, the imperial redhound is the largest dog breed in the world. Trained to protect and serve kings, they are seen as pure and noble with an undying loyalty, even capable of overpowering the fiercest of men with their prodigious strength.\n\nRedhounds are clever beasts, and their intelligence is known throughout the lands, as they are capable of following even the most complex of orders. With only a few sanctioned kennel-masters allowed to breed them, it makes them a rare sight outside of a noble court.
Rule.Translated: Casi del tamaño de un oso, el sabueso rojo imperial es la raza de perro más grande del mundo. Entrenados para proteger y servir a reyes, son vistos como puros y nobles con una lealtad inquebrantable, incluso capaces de dominar a los hombres más feroces con su fuerza prodigiosa.\n\nLos sabuesos rojos son bestias inteligentes, y su astucia es conocida en todas las tierras, ya que pueden seguir incluso las órdenes más complejas. Con solo unos pocos maestros de perrera autorizados para criarlos, son una rareza fuera de la corte noble.

Rule.Original: The rock troll is a colossal, eyeless creature often found living in caves and underground chasms. Much more reclusive than its northern cousins, the rock troll will only surface from its underground lair when provoked.\n\nLacking regenerative abilities, the rock troll makes up for it through a strange process known as self-petrification. Any open wound will almost immediately be closed by ultra-fast blood clotting that ossifies soon after, creating dense stone-like formations that provide the beast with temporary ablative armor.
Rule.Raw: The rock troll is a colossal, eyeless creature often found living in caves and underground chasms. Much more reclusive than its northern cousins, the rock troll will only surface from its underground lair when provoked.\n\nLacking regenerative abilities, the rock troll makes up for it through a strange process known as self-petrification. Any open wound will almost immediately be closed by ultra-fast blood clotting that ossifies soon after, creating dense stone-like formations that provide the beast with temporary ablative armor.
Rule.Translated: El troll de roca es una criatura colosal y ciega que a menudo vive en cuevas y simas subterráneas. Mucho más retraído que sus primos del norte, el troll de roca solo saldrá a la superficie desde su guarida subterránea cuando sea provocado.\n\nCareciendo de habilidades regenerativas, el troll de roca lo compensa mediante un extraño proceso conocido como auto-petrificación. Cualquier herida abierta se cerrará casi inmediatamente mediante una coagulación sanguínea ultrarrápida que se osifica poco después, creando densas formaciones pétreas que proporcionan a la bestia una armadura ablativa temporal.

Rule.Original: A large quake occured and a rock troll emerged ! Stories of the beast are told from far and wide. Walls of stone turned into rubble and entire villages ravaged by its wrath. Taking it down will be no small feat.
Rule.Raw: A large quake occured and a rock troll emerged ! Stories of the beast are told from far and wide. Walls of stone turned into rubble and entire villages ravaged by its wrath. Taking it down will be no small feat.
Rule.Translated: ¡Ocurrió un gran terremoto y emergió un troll de roca! Las historias sobre la bestia se cuentan por todas partes. Los muros de piedra se convirtieron en escombros y pueblos enteros fueron arrasados por su furia. Derrotarlo no será tarea fácil.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} has noticed a seemingly large chunk of stone emerging from the earth. Valuable minerals could be found within.\n\nA small thumping can be heard from beneath.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} has noticed a seemingly large chunk of stone emerging from the earth. Valuable minerals could be found within.\n\nA small thumping can be heard from beneath.
Rule.Translated: {PAWN_nameDef} ha notado un gran trozo de piedra que emerge de la tierra. Podrían encontrarse minerales valiosos en su interior.\n\nSe oye un pequeño golpeteo desde abajo.

Rule.Original: The near instantenous clotting of the blood which results in stone-like formations appearing all over the body, providing excellent protection and slowing the rate of blood-loss.
Rule.Raw: The near instantenous clotting of the blood which results in stone-like formations appearing all over the body, providing excellent protection and slowing the rate of blood-loss.
Rule.Translated: La coagulación casi instantánea de la sangre que resulta en formaciones pétreas que aparecen por todo el cuerpo, proporcionando una excelente protección y ralentizando la pérdida de sangre.

Rule.Original: A small burrowing mammal with glistening silver fur. Elusive and skittish, the silver mole can rarely be seen outside the safety of its underground den deep in the mountains.\n\nMany woodsmen make a habit of patrolling silver mole habitats, hoping to catch the critter while it digs for its favourite food - white truffles, rare mushrooms with sublime taste that grows under stony soils.
Rule.Raw: A small burrowing mammal with glistening silver fur. Elusive and skittish, the silver mole can rarely be seen outside the safety of its underground den deep in the mountains.\n\nMany woodsmen make a habit of patrolling silver mole habitats, hoping to catch the critter while it digs for its favourite food - white truffles, rare mushrooms with sublime taste that grows under stony soils.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño mamífero excavador con pelaje plateado reluciente. Esquivo y asustadizo, el topo plateado rara vez se ve fuera de la seguridad de su madriguera subterránea en lo profundo de las montañas.\n\nMuchos leñadores tienen la costumbre de patrullar hábitats de topo plateado, esperando atrapar al animal mientras excava en busca de su comida favorita: las trufas blancas, raros hongos de sabor sublime que crecen bajo suelos pedregosos.

Rule.Original: Fleeing in panic after witnessing danger.
Rule.Raw: Fleeing in panic after witnessing danger.
Rule.Translated: Huye en pánico tras presenciar peligro.

Rule.Original: Often growing beneath stony soil, the white truffles are a rare delicacy in high demand for their unique taste.
Rule.Raw: Often growing beneath stony soil, the white truffles are a rare delicacy in high demand for their unique taste.
Rule.Translated: Las trufas blancas, que a menudo crecen bajo suelos pedregosos, son un raro manjar muy demandado por su sabor único.

Rule.Original: I ate a delicate white mushroom. While it would taste much better cooked and prepared, it tasted very good by itself.
Rule.Raw: I ate a delicate white mushroom. While it would taste much better cooked and prepared, it tasted very good by itself.
Rule.Translated: Comí una delicada seta blanca. Aunque sabría mucho mejor cocinada y preparada, sabía muy bien por sí sola.

Rule.Original: I ate a delicate white mushroom. The sublime taste accompanies my food perfectly.
Rule.Raw: I ate a delicate white mushroom. The sublime taste accompanies my food perfectly.
Rule.Translated: Comí una delicada seta blanca. Su sabor sublime acompaña perfectamente mi comida.

Rule.Original: The taraal, also known as great land owl is a huge omnivorous bird that dwells in the many forests of the world. They primarily eat fish, and can be often seen near rivers and lakes in search of their favourite prey. In its absence, the taraal will not hesitate to use its immense, bear-like strength to hunt live prey instead..\n\nWhen the wind grows cold and the first snows begin, taraals leave their forests to seek shelter in the mountains where they will hibernate.
Rule.Raw: The taraal, also known as great land owl is a huge omnivorous bird that dwells in the many forests of the world. They primarily eat fish, and can be often seen near rivers and lakes in search of their favourite prey. In its absence, the taraal will not hesitate to use its immense, bear-like strength to hunt live prey instead..\n\nWhen the wind grows cold and the first snows begin, taraals leave their forests to seek shelter in the mountains where they will hibernate.
Rule.Translated: El Oso Lechuza, también conocido como gran búho terrestre, es un ave omnívora enorme que habita en los muchos bosques del mundo. Se alimenta principalmente de peces y a menudo puede verse cerca de ríos y lagos en busca de su presa favorita. En su ausencia, el Oso Lechuza no dudará en usar su inmensa fuerza similar a la de un oso para cazar presas vivas.\n\nCuando el viento se enfría y comienzan las primeras nieves, los Oso Lechuzas abandonan sus bosques para buscar refugio en las montañas donde hibernarán.

Rule.Original: A cousin of the common taraal adapted to frozen climates. They wander in the frigid wastelands in search of carcasses from animals taken by the frost and snow hares for the majority of the year.\n\nWhen the wind grows colder and the snow thickens, the snow taraals leave the northern ices to seek shelter in the mountains where they will hibernate.
Rule.Raw: A cousin of the common taraal adapted to frozen climates. They wander in the frigid wastelands in search of carcasses from animals taken by the frost and snow hares for the majority of the year.\n\nWhen the wind grows colder and the snow thickens, the snow taraals leave the northern ices to seek shelter in the mountains where they will hibernate.
Rule.Translated: Un pariente del Oso Lechuza común adaptado a climas helados. Deambulan por páramos gélidos en busca de cadáveres de animales tomados por la escarcha y liebres de las nieves durante la mayor parte del año.\n\nCuando el viento se enfría y la nieve se espesa, los Oso Lechuzas de las nieves abandonan los hielos del norte para buscar refugio en las montañas donde hibernarán.
cría de Oso Lechuza de las nieves

Rule.Original: A large and heavy taraal egg. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A large and heavy taraal egg. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo de Oso Lechuza grande y pesado. Es muy nutritivo y puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho, mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: A fertilized taraal egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a taraal cub. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized taraal egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a taraal cub. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fertilizado de Oso Lechuza. Si todo va bien, eclosionará en una cría de Oso Lechuza. Es muy nutritivo y puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho mejor cocinado.
Huevo de Oso Lechuza de las nieves (no fert.)

Rule.Original: A large and heavy taraal egg. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A large and heavy taraal egg. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Un huevo de Oso Lechuza grande y pesado. Es muy nutritivo y puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho, mucho mejor cocinado.
Huevo de Oso Lechuza de las nieves (fert.)

Rule.Original: A fertilized taraal egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a taraal cub. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Raw: A fertilized taraal egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a taraal cub. It is very nutritious and can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Rule.Translated: Huevo fertilizado de Oso Lechuza. Si todo va bien, eclosionará en una cría de Oso Lechuza. Es muy nutritivo y puede comerse crudo, pero es mucho mejor cocinado.

Rule.Original: I ate some raw troll meat. It could be worse but it would be better if it was cooked.
Rule.Raw: I ate some raw troll meat. It could be worse but it would be better if it was cooked.
Rule.Translated: Comí un poco de carne de troll cruda. Podría ser peor, pero sería mejor si estuviera cocinada.

Rule.Original: I ate a delicious meal prepared with troll meat. It felt amazing.
Rule.Raw: I ate a delicious meal prepared with troll meat. It felt amazing.
Rule.Translated: Comí una deliciosa comida preparada con carne de troll. Fue asombroso.
charcos de desove de Sapo mordedor
Terrenos de cría de sapos mordedores

Rule.Original: A wetland used by giant snaptoads as spawning pools. Its waters teem with the dangerous amphibians and their offsprings.
Rule.Raw: A wetland used by giant snaptoads as spawning pools. Its waters teem with the dangerous amphibians and their offsprings.
Rule.Translated: Un humedal utilizado por los sapos mordedores gigantes como charcas de desove. Sus aguas abundan en estos peligrosos anfibios y su descendencia.

Rule.Original: This coast is home to a leviathan nest deep beneath the water surface. The large crustaceans are more common and can attack if disturbed.
Rule.Raw: This coast is home to a leviathan nest deep beneath the water surface. The large crustaceans are more common and can attack if disturbed.
Rule.Translated: Esta costa alberga un nido de leviatán en las profundidades de la superficie acuática. Los grandes crustáceos son más comunes y pueden atacar si se les molesta.

Rule.Original: Relatively thin form fitted jacket worn under armor.
Rule.Raw: Relatively thin form fitted jacket worn under armor.
Rule.Translated: Chaqueta acolchada relativamente fina y ajustada, utilizada debajo de la armadura.

Rule.Original: A medium sized overlapping plates riveted onto a vest, it provides great protection but not quite form fitting.
Rule.Raw: A medium sized overlapping plates riveted onto a vest, it provides great protection but not quite form fitting.
Rule.Translated: Chaleco con placas metálicas superpuestas y remachadas de tamaño medio. Ofrece una gran protección, aunque no se ajusta demasiado al cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A surcoat worn by knights over maille, for protection against the elements and identifications on the battlefield
Rule.Raw: A surcoat worn by knights over maille, for protection against the elements and identifications on the battlefield
Rule.Translated: Una sobrevesta que los caballeros llevan sobre la malla para protegerse de los elementos y facilitar su identificación en el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: Large, thick, fully enclosed helmet. While rather cumbersome and significantly restricts wearer's field of view and breathing, it provides great protection for a heavily armored rider.
Rule.Raw: Large, thick, fully enclosed helmet. While rather cumbersome and significantly restricts wearer's field of view and breathing, it provides great protection for a heavily armored rider.
Rule.Translated: Yelmo grande, grueso y completamente cerrado. Aunque resulta aparatoso y limita bastante el campo de visión y la respiración, ofrece una excelente protección a un jinete con armadura pesada.

Rule.Original: Simple steel helmet with a wide brim, protects from overhead blows while leaving good visibility.
Rule.Raw: Simple steel helmet with a wide brim, protects from overhead blows while leaving good visibility.
Rule.Translated: Casco sencillo de acero con ala ancha. Protege de golpes desde arriba sin reducir demasiado la visibilidad.
Guantes sin dedos recubiertos de malla.

Rule.Original: Implement for chopping branches. And sometimes limbs.
Rule.Raw: Implement for chopping branches. And sometimes limbs.
Rule.Translated: Herramienta para cortar ramas. Y, a veces, extremidades.

Rule.Original: Siple lever released crossbow with wooden bow.
Rule.Raw: Siple lever released crossbow with wooden bow.
Rule.Translated: Ballesta sencilla con arco de madera y mecanismo de disparo por palanca.

Rule.Original: One handed spear, primary fighting weapon of shield formations.
Rule.Raw: One handed spear, primary fighting weapon of shield formations.
Rule.Translated: Lanza de una mano, arma principal de combate de las formaciones con escudo.

Rule.Original: Brigandine vest with plate limb cover. Compared to proper full plate armor, next best thing to a full plate harness, slighly cheaper.
Rule.Raw: Brigandine vest with plate limb cover. Compared to proper full plate armor, next best thing to a full plate harness, slighly cheaper.
Rule.Translated: Chaleco de brigantina con protección de placas para las extremidades. Es la alternativa más cercana a una armadura completa de placas y resulta algo más barata.

Rule.Original: A vest with small overlapping armor plates riveted on it's inside, a more ergonomic successor of the coat of plates
Rule.Raw: A vest with small overlapping armor plates riveted on it's inside, a more ergonomic successor of the coat of plates
Rule.Translated: Un chaleco con pequeñas placas de armadura superpuestas y remachadas en su interior; una evolución más ergonómica de la cota de placas.

Rule.Original: Body armor constructed of large solid armor plates, shaped to fit the human form ergonomically, providing great protection for the center of the body
Rule.Raw: Body armor constructed of large solid armor plates, shaped to fit the human form ergonomically, providing great protection for the center of the body
Rule.Translated: Armadura corporal construida con grandes placas sólidas moldeadas para ajustarse de forma ergonómica al cuerpo humano y ofrecer una gran protección al torso.

Rule.Original: Plate armor colvering the whole body, with good ergonomics and with well articulated joints, top of the line protection.
Rule.Raw: Plate armor colvering the whole body, with good ergonomics and with well articulated joints, top of the line protection.
Rule.Translated: Armadura de placas que cubre todo el cuerpo, con buena ergonomía y articulaciones bien diseñadas. Ofrece una protección de primera categoría.

Rule.Original: A medium thickness gambeson reinforced with maille skirt and sleeves, designed specifically as an underarmor.
Rule.Raw: A medium thickness gambeson reinforced with maille skirt and sleeves, designed specifically as an underarmor.
Rule.Translated: Un gambesón de grosor medio reforzado con faldón y mangas de malla, diseñado específicamente para llevarse bajo una armadura.

Rule.Original: Relatively thinly padded jacket and pants with attachment point for plate armor.
Rule.Raw: Relatively thinly padded jacket and pants with attachment point for plate armor.
Rule.Translated: Chaqueta y pantalones con acolchado relativamente fino y puntos de sujeción para armadura de placas.

Rule.Original: light padded jacket worn by knights their plate harness, for battlefield identification and protection from arrows spalling on their armor
Rule.Raw: light padded jacket worn by knights their plate harness, for battlefield identification and protection from arrows spalling on their armor
Rule.Translated: Chaqueta acolchada ligera que los caballeros llevan sobre el arnés de placas para identificarse en el campo de batalla y protegerse de fragmentos de flechas al impactar contra la armadura.

Rule.Original: Simple steel helmet with a wide brim, protects face from overhead blows while leaving good visibility.
Rule.Raw: Simple steel helmet with a wide brim, protects face from overhead blows while leaving good visibility.
Rule.Translated: Casco sencillo de acero con ala ancha que protege el rostro de golpes descendentes sin sacrificar demasiado la visibilidad.
arma de asta de corte y estocada
Alabardas y cosas por el estilo.

Rule.Original: Properly made military crossbow, limbs similar in construction to eastern composite bows but much thicker and shorter.
Rule.Raw: Properly made military crossbow, limbs similar in construction to eastern composite bows but much thicker and shorter.
Rule.Translated: Una ballesta militar bien construida, con palas similares a las de los arcos compuestos orientales, aunque mucho más gruesas y cortas.

Rule.Original: A multi-layered robe for protection against the harsh coastal weather. Kid-sized.
Rule.Raw: A multi-layered robe for protection against the harsh coastal weather. Kid-sized.
Rule.Translated: Una túnica de varias capas que protege del duro clima costero. De tamaño infantil.

Rule.Original: A nice breezy dress for children, but not suitable for cold nights.
Rule.Raw: A nice breezy dress for children, but not suitable for cold nights.
Rule.Translated: Un vestido infantil agradable y fresco, aunque poco adecuado para las noches frías.

Rule.Original: A fridge that can freeze up to 2 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Raw: A fridge that can freeze up to 2 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico que puede congelar hasta 2 objetos. No funciona a temperaturas superiores a 100 °C.

Rule.Original: A fridge that can freeze up to 10 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Raw: A fridge that can freeze up to 10 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico que puede congelar hasta 10 objetos. No funciona a temperaturas superiores a 100 °C.

Rule.Original: A fridge that can freeze up to 3 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Raw: A fridge that can freeze up to 3 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico que puede congelar hasta 3 objetos. No funciona a temperaturas superiores a 100 °C.

Rule.Original: A fridge that can freeze up to 6 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Raw: A fridge that can freeze up to 6 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico que puede congelar hasta 6 objetos. No funciona a temperaturas superiores a 100 °C.

Rule.Original: A fridge that can freeze up to 3 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C. Cannot support the roof.
Rule.Raw: A fridge that can freeze up to 3 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C. Cannot support the roof.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico que puede congelar hasta 3 objetos. No funciona a temperaturas superiores a 100°C. No puede soportar un techo.

Rule.Original: A fridge that can freeze up to 6 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C. Cannot support the roof.
Rule.Raw: A fridge that can freeze up to 6 items. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C. Cannot support the roof.
Rule.Translated: Un frigorífico que puede congelar hasta 6 objetos. No funciona a temperaturas superiores a 100°C. No puede soportar un techo.

Rule.Original: A fridge that can freeze up to 20 corpses. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Raw: A fridge that can freeze up to 20 corpses. Does not function in temperatures above 100°C.
Rule.Translated: Una frigorífico que puede congelar hasta 20 cadáveres. No funciona a temperaturas superiores a 100 °C.

Rule.Original: An automated device for cutting and disassembling items. It can dismantle most items and recover raw materials at a certain ratio.
Rule.Raw: 一款用于切割拆解物品的自动化器械,能够将绝大多数的物品进行拆解,按一定比例获得原材料
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo automatizado para cortar y desmontar objetos. Puede desmantelar la mayoría de los objetos y recuperar materias primas en una proporción determinada.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the foot. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather boots will increase movement speed.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the foot. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather boots will increase movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Cuero curtido cosido para ajustarse al pie. Ofrece una protección mínima. Llevar este calzado aumenta la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers crafted by talented cobblers. These shoes show intricate design and craftsmanship.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers crafted by talented cobblers. These shoes show intricate design and craftsmanship.
Rule.Translated: Cuero curtido trabajado por zapateros expertos. Estos zapatos muestran un diseño y una elaboración muy detallados.

Rule.Original: Common boots worn by many. Help protect the feed from the elements. And provide good traction.
Rule.Raw: Common boots worn by many. Help protect the feed from the elements. And provide good traction.
Rule.Translated: Botas comunes utilizadas por mucha gente. Ayudan a proteger los pies de los elementos y ofrecen buena tracción.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers crafted into well made travel boots. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather boots will increase movement speed.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers crafted into well made travel boots. Provides minimal protection. Wearing leather boots will increase movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Cuero curtido convertido en unas botas de viaje bien confeccionadas. Ofrecen una protección mínima y aumentan la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers crafted by talented cobblers. These boots show intricate design and craftsmanship.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers crafted by talented cobblers. These boots show intricate design and craftsmanship.
Rule.Translated: Cuero curtido trabajado por zapateros expertos. Estas botas muestran un diseño y una elaboración muy detallados.

Rule.Original: Metal shackles ment to limit the movement speed of those they are attached to.
Rule.Raw: Metal shackles ment to limit the movement speed of those they are attached to.
Rule.Translated: Grilletes metálicos destinados a reducir la velocidad de movimiento de quienes los llevan.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing town gloves will increase workspeed.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing town gloves will increase workspeed.
Rule.Translated: Cuero curtido cosido para ajustarse a las manos. Ofrece una protección mínima. Llevar estos guantes aumenta la velocidad de trabajo.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing hunting gloves will increase workspeed and shooting accuracy.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing hunting gloves will increase workspeed and shooting accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Cuero curtido cosido para ajustarse a las manos. Ofrece una protección mínima. Llevar estos guantes aumenta la velocidad de trabajo y la precisión de disparo.

Rule.Original: Delicately worked leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing these elegant gloves will increase your social status, and help you get better deals.
Rule.Raw: Delicately worked leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing these elegant gloves will increase your social status, and help you get better deals.
Rule.Translated: Cuero trabajado con delicadeza y cosido para ajustarse a las manos. Ofrece una protección mínima. Llevar estos elegantes guantes aumenta el estatus social y ayuda a conseguir mejores acuerdos.

Rule.Original: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing town gloves will increase workspeed.
Rule.Raw: Tanned leathers sewn to fit the hand. Provides minimal protection. Wearing town gloves will increase workspeed.
Rule.Translated: Cuero curtido cosido para ajustarse a las manos. Ofrece una protección mínima. Llevar estos guantes aumenta la velocidad de trabajo.

Rule.Original: A piece of armor designed to protect the arm from the elbow to the wrist.
Rule.Raw: A piece of armor designed to protect the arm from the elbow to the wrist.
Rule.Translated: Una pieza de armadura diseñada para proteger el brazo desde el codo hasta la muñeca.

Rule.Original: A piece of armor designed to protect the arm from the elbow to the wrist.
Rule.Raw: A piece of armor designed to protect the arm from the elbow to the wrist.
Rule.Translated: Una pieza de armadura diseñada para proteger el brazo desde el codo hasta la muñeca.

Rule.Original: A pair of shackles ment to limit the users workspeed, and put fear in them.
Rule.Raw: A pair of shackles ment to limit the users workspeed, and put fear in them.
Rule.Translated: Un par de grilletes destinados a reducir la velocidad de trabajo del usuario e infundirle miedo.

Rule.Original: A form of hood or, highly versatile hat worn to protect ones head from the weather.
Rule.Raw: A form of hood or, highly versatile hat worn to protect ones head from the weather.
Rule.Translated: Una forma de capucha o sombrero muy versátil utilizado para proteger la cabeza de las inclemencias del tiempo.

Rule.Original: A simple hat, It holds distinguishing mark of the foresters.
Rule.Raw: A simple hat, It holds distinguishing mark of the foresters.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero sencillo que lleva la marca distintiva de los guardabosques.

Rule.Original: A feathered hat, It holds distinguishing mark of the foresters and the fowl they hunt.
Rule.Raw: A feathered hat, It holds distinguishing mark of the foresters and the fowl they hunt.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero emplumado que lleva la marca distintiva de los guardabosques y de las aves que cazan.

Rule.Original: A thick, ornamented hat. Protective simply due to its size and shape, but mainly worn for decoration and as a status symbol.
Rule.Raw: A thick, ornamented hat. Protective simply due to its size and shape, but mainly worn for decoration and as a status symbol.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero grueso y ornamentado. Ofrece cierta protección simplemente por su tamaño y forma, aunque se utiliza sobre todo como adorno y símbolo de estatus.

Rule.Original: A warm cap, helpful in the cold months.
Rule.Raw: A warm cap, helpful in the cold months.
Rule.Translated: Un gorro cálido, útil durante los meses fríos.

Rule.Original: A thick, ornamented hat. Protective simply due to its size and shape, but mainly worn for Ideoligion and as a status symbol.
Rule.Raw: A thick, ornamented hat. Protective simply due to its size and shape, but mainly worn for Ideoligion and as a status symbol.
Rule.Translated: Un sombrero grueso y ornamentado. Ofrece cierta protección por su tamaño y forma, aunque se utiliza principalmente por motivos de ideoligión y como símbolo de estatus.

Rule.Original: A quilted and padded or stuffed cloth garment worn under chain mail that offers some protection.
Rule.Raw: A quilted and padded or stuffed cloth garment worn under chain mail that offers some protection.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda de tela acolchada y rellena que se lleva bajo la cota de malla y proporciona cierta protección.

Rule.Original: A sleeveless long garment made from leather to protect and keep the user warm.
Rule.Raw: A sleeveless long garment made from leather to protect and keep the user warm.
Rule.Translated: Una prenda larga y sin mangas hecha de cuero para proteger y mantener caliente a quien la lleva.

Rule.Original: A beautiful garment that is suitable for a night out, a duel, or both at the same time. You'll look appropriate either way.
Rule.Raw: A beautiful garment that is suitable for a night out, a duel, or both at the same time. You'll look appropriate either way.
Rule.Translated: Una hermosa prenda adecuada para una noche de fiesta, un duelo o ambas cosas a la vez. En cualquier caso, irás vestido para la ocasión.

Rule.Original: A padded doublet stitched from fabrics, both comfortable and pragmatic. The thick fabric is a decent balance between protection and encumbrance.
Rule.Raw: A padded doublet stitched from fabrics, both comfortable and pragmatic. The thick fabric is a decent balance between protection and encumbrance.
Rule.Translated: Un jubón acolchado cosido con tejidos, cómodo y práctico. La tela gruesa ofrece un equilibrio razonable entre protección y estorbo.

Rule.Original: A long doublet helpful to protect the wearer from the grit of the outdoors.
Rule.Raw: A long doublet helpful to protect the wearer from the grit of the outdoors.
Rule.Translated: Un jubón largo útil para proteger al usuario de las asperezas de la vida al aire libre.

Rule.Original: A tough short coat to stop scrapes and bruises, and to keep one warm in chilly weather.
Rule.Raw: A tough short coat to stop scrapes and bruises, and to keep one warm in chilly weather.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo corto y resistente que protege de rozaduras y moratones y ayuda a conservar el calor cuando hace frío.

Rule.Original: A medieval long sleeved tunic, usually girded, and worn by men and women.
Rule.Raw: A medieval long sleeved tunic, usually girded, and worn by men and women.
Rule.Translated: Una túnica medieval de manga larga, normalmente ceñida con cinturón y utilizada tanto por hombres como por mujeres.

Rule.Original: A fancy medieval long sleeved tunic, usually girded, and worn by men and women.This one has been tailored to the wearers dimensions quite well.
Rule.Raw: A fancy medieval long sleeved tunic, usually girded, and worn by men and women.This one has been tailored to the wearers dimensions quite well.
Rule.Translated: Una elegante túnica medieval de manga larga, normalmente ceñida con cinturón y utilizada por hombres y mujeres. Esta ha sido confeccionada cuidadosamente a las medidas de su portador.

Rule.Original: The fanciest medieval long sleeved tunic money can buy. The craftsmanship is very delicate and intricate, this one has been tailored to the wearers dimensions perfectly.
Rule.Raw: The fanciest medieval long sleeved tunic money can buy. The craftsmanship is very delicate and intricate, this one has been tailored to the wearers dimensions perfectly.
Rule.Translated: La túnica medieval de manga larga más lujosa que el dinero puede comprar. Su elaboración es delicada e intrincada y ha sido confeccionada perfectamente a las medidas de quien la lleva.

Rule.Original: A dress made for the everday toils.
Rule.Raw: A dress made for the everday toils.
Rule.Translated: Un vestido confeccionado para las tareas cotidianas.

Rule.Original: Sturdy and durable trousers made to keep the lower body covered and protected from the elements.
Rule.Raw: Sturdy and durable trousers made to keep the lower body covered and protected from the elements.
Rule.Translated: Pantalones resistentes y duraderos diseñados para cubrir la parte inferior del cuerpo y protegerla de los elementos.

Rule.Original: A fancy set of hose made for nobles.
Rule.Raw: A fancy set of hose made for nobles.
Rule.Translated: Un elegante conjunto de calzas confeccionado para nobles.

Rule.Original: Tatterd pieces of fabric or leather. Just enough to cover the wearers legs.
Rule.Raw: Tatterd pieces of fabric or leather. Just enough to cover the wearers legs.
Rule.Translated: Pedazos desgarrados de tela o cuero. Apenas suficientes para cubrir las piernas.

Rule.Original: A well made coat ment to protect the user from some of the coldest nights.
Rule.Raw: A well made coat ment to protect the user from some of the coldest nights.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo bien confeccionado destinado a proteger al usuario durante algunas de las noches más frías.

Rule.Original: A thick hood made out of reinforced cloth or leather. Provides some protection against cold and damage.
Rule.Raw: A thick hood made out of reinforced cloth or leather. Provides some protection against cold and damage.
Rule.Translated: Una capucha gruesa de tela reforzada o cuero. Ofrece cierta protección contra el frío y los daños.

Rule.Original: A loose cloak fastened around the neck of the wearer.
Rule.Raw: A loose cloak fastened around the neck of the wearer.
Rule.Translated: Una capa holgada que se abrocha alrededor del cuello.

Rule.Original: A thick cloak fastened around the neck of the wearer. Made from leather or hides this cloak is made to keep the wearer warm.
Rule.Raw: A thick cloak fastened around the neck of the wearer. Made from leather or hides this cloak is made to keep the wearer warm.
Rule.Translated: Una capa gruesa abrochada alrededor del cuello. Fabricada con cuero o pieles, está pensada para mantener caliente a quien la lleva.

Rule.Original: Mechanitor ship, recreated using ancient technology, has worse fuel consumption, slightly better recharge time before departure, and greater flight range, though it falls short of the Drone. The main advantage is high cargo capacity and a larger fuel tank. Requires a mechanitor colonist to research.
Rule.Raw: Mechanitor ship, recreated using ancient technology, has worse fuel consumption, slightly better recharge time before departure, and greater flight range, though it falls short of the Drone. The main advantage is high cargo capacity and a larger fuel tank. Requires a mechanitor colonist to research.
Rule.Translated: Nave de mecanitor recreada mediante tecnología antigua. Consume más combustible, tiene un tiempo de recarga ligeramente mejor antes de partir y un mayor alcance de vuelo, aunque sigue por debajo del dron. Su principal ventaja es la gran capacidad de carga y un depósito de combustible de mayor tamaño. Requiere un colono mecanitor para investigarla.

Rule.Original: A heavy-duty chemfuel-powered shuttle designed for mechanitor operations. It features enhanced systems for controlling mechs and increased cargo capacity, but at the cost of fuel efficiency.
Rule.Raw: A heavy-duty chemfuel-powered shuttle designed for mechanitor operations. It features enhanced systems for controlling mechs and increased cargo capacity, but at the cost of fuel efficiency.
Rule.Translated: Una lanzadera pesada impulsada por biocombustible y diseñada para operaciones de mecanitor. Incorpora sistemas mejorados para controlar mecas y una mayor capacidad de carga, a costa de una menor eficiencia de combustible.
Una nave de mecanitor en vuelo.

Rule.Original: Drone for longer journeys and reaching orbit. Requires a shuttle engine, which can only be obtained from orbital traders and missions. Compared to a regular Shuttle, it has worse cargo capacity, faster recharge time before departure, and more efficient fuel consumption.
Rule.Raw: Drone for longer journeys and reaching orbit. Requires a shuttle engine, which can only be obtained from orbital traders and missions. Compared to a regular Shuttle, it has worse cargo capacity, faster recharge time before departure, and more efficient fuel consumption.
Rule.Translated: Dron destinado a viajes largos y a alcanzar la órbita. Requiere un motor de lanzadera, que solo puede obtenerse mediante comerciantes orbitales y misiones. Comparado con una lanzadera normal, tiene menor capacidad de carga, menor tiempo de recarga antes de partir y un consumo de combustible más eficiente.

Rule.Original: Drone for longer journeys and reaching orbit. Requires a shuttle engine, which can only be obtained from orbital traders and missions. Compared to a regular Shuttle, it has worse cargo capacity, faster recharge time before departure, and more efficient fuel consumption.
Rule.Raw: Drone for longer journeys and reaching orbit. Requires a shuttle engine, which can only be obtained from orbital traders and missions. Compared to a regular Shuttle, it has worse cargo capacity, faster recharge time before departure, and more efficient fuel consumption.
Rule.Translated: Dron destinado a viajes largos y a alcanzar la órbita. Requiere un motor de lanzadera, que solo puede obtenerse mediante comerciantes orbitales y misiones. Comparado con una lanzadera normal, tiene menor capacidad de carga, menor tiempo de recarga antes de partir y un consumo de combustible más eficiente.
Un dron de transporte en vuelo.
cerveza negra de baya de rox

Rule.Original: Fermented beverage of deep golden colouring, a real lifeblood of social life in these parts. Few mugs in the tavern are all what's needed to forget about hardships of field work, dangers awaiting on the road or ill-considered marriage vows. Let the warm haze of drunkenness embrace you, no need to worry about anything. Not today.
Rule.Raw: Fermented beverage of deep golden colouring, a real lifeblood of social life in these parts. Few mugs in the tavern are all what's needed to forget about hardships of field work, dangers awaiting on the road or ill-considered marriage vows. Let the warm haze of drunkenness embrace you, no need to worry about anything. Not today.
Rule.Translated: Bebida fermentada de intenso color dorado, auténtica savia de la vida social de estas tierras. Unas pocas jarras en la taberna bastan para olvidar las penurias del campo, los peligros del camino o unos votos matrimoniales poco meditados. Deja que el cálido sopor de la embriaguez te envuelva; hoy no hace falta preocuparse por nada.
mosto de cerveza de baya de rox

Rule.Original: Crushed berries infused with rox milk.
Rule.Raw: Crushed berries infused with rox milk.
Rule.Translated: Bayas trituradas infusionadas con leche de rox.
bebió cerveza negra de baya de rox

Rule.Original: Drank roxberry stout, energizing the body. Slightly boosts workspeed and gets the blood pumping.
Rule.Raw: Drank roxberry stout, energizing the body. Slightly boosts workspeed and gets the blood pumping.
Rule.Translated: Beber cerveza negra de baya de rox vigoriza el cuerpo. Aumenta ligeramente la velocidad de trabajo y acelera la circulación.

Rule.Original: House Roxmont was founded in an older era of strife and hardship. While other Houses rose and fell, house Roxmont endured. Settled in the cold dark forests, they prefer not to meddle in social affairs, leaving them isolated from the other noble families.
Rule.Raw: House Roxmont was founded in an older era of strife and hardship. While other Houses rose and fell, house Roxmont endured. Settled in the cold dark forests, they prefer not to meddle in social affairs, leaving them isolated from the other noble families.
Rule.Translated: La Casa Roxmont fue fundada en una época antigua de conflictos y penurias. Mientras otras casas surgían y desaparecían, Roxmont perduró. Asentados en fríos y oscuros bosques, prefieren no entrometerse en los asuntos sociales, lo que los mantiene aislados de las demás familias nobles.

Rule.Original: A masterfully cooked dish that harbors intense aromatic flavours.
Rule.Raw: A masterfully cooked dish that harbors intense aromatic flavours.
Rule.Translated: Un plato preparado con maestría y cargado de intensos sabores aromáticos.

Rule.Original: Eating that roxwood cheese filled my hunger.
Rule.Raw: Eating that roxwood cheese filled my hunger.
Rule.Translated: Ese queso de rox sació mi hambre.
preparar mosto de cerveza de baya de rox

Rule.Original: Make roxberry stout wort by crushing griffon berries. Needs to undergo fermentation in order to become ale.
Rule.Raw: Make roxberry stout wort by crushing griffon berries. Needs to undergo fermentation in order to become ale.
Rule.Translated: Prepara mosto de cerveza de baya de rox triturando bayas de grifo. Debe fermentar para convertirse en cerveza.
Preparando mosto de cerveza de baya de rox.

Rule.Original:
The call of adventure beckoned, a siren's song that I could not ignore. Bound by duty, yet yearning for more, my heart longed for the thrill of the unknown and the promise of uncharted territories. Leaving the comfort of my lord's halls, I set forth into the rugged highlands, eager to forge my own path.
