My armor bears the mark of House Roxmont, but now it shields a knight errant. The wilds are filled with bandits and hidden monsters, ever watchful for a lone traveler. The nights are cold and fraught with danger, each shadow a potential threat. Still, the thrill of the unknown drives me forward, far from the comfort of my lord’s halls.

With a pouch of silver and a heart yearning for adventure, I march on. Perhaps I will find glory in distant lands, build a reputation that echoes through the ages, and gather comrades who share my quest. Yet for now, the path is uncertain and perilous.

For now, the journey itself is my reward.
Rule.Raw:
The call of adventure beckoned, a siren's song that I could not ignore. Bound by duty, yet yearning for more, my heart longed for the thrill of the unknown and the promise of uncharted territories. Leaving the comfort of my lord's halls, I set forth into the rugged highlands, eager to forge my own path.

My armor bears the mark of House Roxmont, but now it shields a knight errant. The wilds are filled with bandits and hidden monsters, ever watchful for a lone traveler. The nights are cold and fraught with danger, each shadow a potential threat. Still, the thrill of the unknown drives me forward, far from the comfort of my lord’s halls.

With a pouch of silver and a heart yearning for adventure, I march on. Perhaps I will find glory in distant lands, build a reputation that echoes through the ages, and gather comrades who share my quest. Yet for now, the path is uncertain and perilous.

For now, the journey itself is my reward.
Rule.Translated:
La llamada de la aventura resonó como un canto de sirena que no pude ignorar. Atado por el deber, pero anhelando algo más, mi corazón deseaba la emoción de lo desconocido y la promesa de tierras aún sin explorar. Dejando atrás la comodidad de los salones de mi señor, partí hacia las escarpadas tierras altas, dispuesto a forjar mi propio camino.

Mi armadura lleva la marca de la Casa Roxmont, pero ahora protege a un caballero errante. Las tierras salvajes están llenas de bandidos y monstruos ocultos que acechan a los viajeros solitarios. Las noches son frías y están cargadas de peligro; cada sombra puede esconder una amenaza. Aun así, la emoción de lo desconocido me impulsa hacia delante, lejos de la comodidad de los salones de mi señor.

Con una bolsa de plata y el corazón sediento de aventura, sigo mi marcha. Quizá encuentre gloria en tierras lejanas, forje una reputación que perdure a través de los años y reúna compañeros que compartan mi búsqueda. Pero, por ahora, el camino es incierto y peligroso.

Por ahora, el propio viaje es mi recompensa.

Rule.Original: One lone rox knight with a good supply of roberry stout.
Rule.Raw: One lone rox knight with a good supply of roberry stout.
Rule.Translated: Un caballero rox solitario con una buena provisión de cerveza negra de bayas rox.

Rule.Original: The grand feasts, lavish tournaments, and courtly pleasures were never enough for you. You longed for more—the grit and consequence of true adventure, like the bards sing of in ancient tales. You yearned to know what real challenge and danger feel like. \n\nNow, after years of preparation and training, you're venturing into the untamed wilderness. Real perils and glory await you.
Rule.Raw: The grand feasts, lavish tournaments, and courtly pleasures were never enough for you. You longed for more—the grit and consequence of true adventure, like the bards sing of in ancient tales. You yearned to know what real challenge and danger feel like. \n\nNow, after years of preparation and training, you're venturing into the untamed wilderness. Real perils and glory await you.
Rule.Translated: Los grandes banquetes, los torneos fastuosos y los placeres de la corte nunca te bastaron. Ansiabas algo más: la dureza y las consecuencias de una aventura verdadera, como las que cantan los bardos en sus viejos relatos. Querías conocer el auténtico desafío y el peligro. \n\nAhora, tras años de preparación y entrenamiento, te adentras en las tierras salvajes. Te esperan peligros reales y gloria.

Rule.Original: A wooden contraption to press selected items. Either to bring the juice out or whey from curds.
Rule.Raw: A wooden contraption to press selected items. Either to bring the juice out or whey from curds.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanismo de madera para prensar determinados productos, ya sea para extraer zumo o separar el suero de la cuajada.

Rule.Original: A cylindrical barrel for general storage. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Raw: A cylindrical barrel for general storage. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Translated: Un barril cilíndrico para almacenamiento general. Los objetos guardados en su interior no afectan a la belleza de la estancia y no se deterioran, ni siquiera en el exterior.

Rule.Original: A table filled to display dairy goods.
Rule.Raw: A table filled to display dairy goods.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa preparada para exhibir productos lácteos.

Rule.Original: A robust fabric bag designed to store resources in an efficient manner. Items stored inside will not affect room beauty and will never deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Raw: A robust fabric bag designed to store resources in an efficient manner. Items stored inside will not affect room beauty and will never deteriorate, even if outside.
Rule.Translated: Una bolsa resistente de tela diseñada para almacenar recursos de forma eficiente. Los objetos guardados en su interior no afectan a la belleza de la estancia y nunca se deterioran, ni siquiera en el exterior.

Rule.Original: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Roxmont.
Rule.Raw: A full-body suit of heavy chainmail reinforced in key places with additional sheets and links of metal. Quite fatiguing to wear, but very protective. \n\nThis heavy hauberk carries the colours of house Roxmont.
Rule.Translated: Una cota de malla pesada que cubre todo el cuerpo, reforzada en puntos clave con láminas y eslabones metálicos adicionales. Resulta agotadora de llevar, pero ofrece una gran protección. \n\nEsta cota pesada luce los colores de la Casa Roxmont.

Rule.Original: The Zweihander's cuirass is a striking blend of protection and flamboyance, featuring intricate plate armor complemented by vibrant, puffed clothing. Bold slashes in the fabric reveal contrasting colors beneath, creating a distinctive and formidable appearance on the battlefield. This unique combination of sturdy metal and eye-catching textiles embodies the fearless and audacious spirit of the Zweihander mercenaries. \n\nThis Zweihander's cuirass carries the colours of house Roxmont.
Rule.Raw: The Zweihander's cuirass is a striking blend of protection and flamboyance, featuring intricate plate armor complemented by vibrant, puffed clothing. Bold slashes in the fabric reveal contrasting colors beneath, creating a distinctive and formidable appearance on the battlefield. This unique combination of sturdy metal and eye-catching textiles embodies the fearless and audacious spirit of the Zweihander mercenaries. \n\nThis Zweihander's cuirass carries the colours of house Roxmont.
Rule.Translated: La coraza de zweihander combina de forma llamativa protección y ostentación, con una elaborada armadura de placas acompañada de prendas abullonadas de vivos colores. Los cortes en la tela dejan ver colores contrastantes debajo, creando una presencia distintiva e imponente en el campo de batalla. Esta mezcla de metal resistente y tejidos vistosos encarna el espíritu audaz y temerario de los mercenarios zweihander. \n\nEsta coraza de zweihander luce los colores de la Casa Roxmont.

Rule.Original: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war. \n\nWorn by the noble knights and champions of the Roxmont house. Specially fitted with rox fur to provide resistance against the harsh winters of the north.
Rule.Raw: Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war. \n\nWorn by the noble knights and champions of the Roxmont house. Specially fitted with rox fur to provide resistance against the harsh winters of the north.
Rule.Translated: Pocos hombres pueden permitirse una armadura tan protectora como una completa de placas, formada por capas de metal que ofrecen una defensa excepcional. Sus portadores suelen ser nobles, señores y hombres con la fortuna necesaria para pagar una pieza elaborada por maestros capaz de detener numerosos ataques. El brillo de la luz sobre el metal pulido anuncia al enemigo que quien la lleva no solo es rico, sino también un señor de la guerra. \n\nLa llevan los nobles caballeros y campeones de la Casa Roxmont. Está especialmente forrada con piel de rox para resistir los duros inviernos del norte.

Rule.Original: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nWorn by the noble knights and champions of the Roxmont house. Specially fitted with rox fur to provide resistance against the harsh winters of the north.
Rule.Raw: A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. \n\nWorn by the noble knights and champions of the Roxmont house. Specially fitted with rox fur to provide resistance against the harsh winters of the north.
Rule.Translated: Un gran yelmo de placas muy ornamentado, usado a menudo por justadores, campeones heráldicos y figuras destacadas de casas nobles durante la guerra. Proclama el estatus noble de su portador sin renunciar a una protección considerable en combate. \n\nLo llevan los nobles caballeros y campeones de la Casa Roxmont. Está especialmente forrado con piel de rox para resistir los duros inviernos del norte.

Rule.Original: Unlike the spear, pikes must be wielded with both hands to be effective. This allows pike-users to impale enemies at a distance, making pikemen feared warriors even from the backline. \n\n This pike carries the colors of house Roxmont.
Rule.Raw: Unlike the spear, pikes must be wielded with both hands to be effective. This allows pike-users to impale enemies at a distance, making pikemen feared warriors even from the backline. \n\n This pike carries the colors of house Roxmont.
Rule.Translated: A diferencia de una lanza, la pica debe empuñarse con ambas manos para resultar eficaz. Esto permite atravesar enemigos desde cierta distancia, haciendo de los piqueros guerreros temibles incluso desde la retaguardia. \n\nEsta pica luce los colores de la Casa Roxmont.

Rule.Original: A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively. \n\nFashioned with a piercing hammer made out of a rox’s horn, it allows for deadly armor penetrating attacks against heavily plated knights.
Rule.Raw: A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively. \n\nFashioned with a piercing hammer made out of a rox’s horn, it allows for deadly armor penetrating attacks against heavily plated knights.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más pesada del hacha a dos manos. El peso de esta gran hacha permite infligir un daño enorme y le proporciona gran resistencia. Es excelente para partir escudos o abatir enemigos sin armadura, aunque requiere mucha fuerza para manejarla con eficacia. \n\nIncorpora un martillo perforante fabricado con el cuerno de un rox, capaz de realizar ataques letales que atraviesan la armadura de los caballeros fuertemente acorazados.

Rule.Original: Rox cheese is a creamy, artisanal delight crafted from the rich milk of the rox. Its smooth texture and slightly tangy flavor make it a prized addition to any feast, perfect for pairing with rustic bread and hearty ales.
Rule.Raw: Rox cheese is a creamy, artisanal delight crafted from the rich milk of the rox. Its smooth texture and slightly tangy flavor make it a prized addition to any feast, perfect for pairing with rustic bread and hearty ales.
Rule.Translated: El queso de rox es una delicia artesanal y cremosa elaborada con la rica leche del rox. Su textura suave y su ligero toque ácido lo convierten en un complemento muy apreciado para cualquier festín, perfecto para acompañar con pan rústico y cervezas intensas.

Rule.Original: Thick-cut chunks of seared meat arranged on a wooden stake, making for an easily-eaten, tasty meal.
Rule.Raw: Thick-cut chunks of seared meat arranged on a wooden stake, making for an easily-eaten, tasty meal.
Rule.Translated: Gruesos trozos de carne sellada ensartados en una estaca de madera, formando una comida sabrosa y fácil de comer.

Rule.Original: A rich meal consisting of spiced steak with toasted potatoes, sauteed in its own beef broth. A delightfully rich and bold-tasting meal.
Rule.Raw: A rich meal consisting of spiced steak with toasted potatoes, sauteed in its own beef broth. A delightfully rich and bold-tasting meal.
Rule.Translated: Una comida abundante compuesta por filete especiado con patatas tostadas, salteadas en su propio caldo de carne. Un plato intenso, sustancioso y de sabor marcado.

Rule.Original: I had the unfortunate experience of eating awful-quality rox cheese. The taste was dissapointing and the taste still lingers in my mouth.
Rule.Raw: I had the unfortunate experience of eating awful-quality rox cheese. The taste was dissapointing and the taste still lingers in my mouth.
Rule.Translated: Tuve la desgracia de comer queso de rox de calidad horrible. Fue decepcionante y el sabor todavía permanece en mi boca.
comió queso de rox de mala calidad

Rule.Original: I ate some poor-quality rox cheese. The taste was average but palateable
Rule.Raw: I ate some poor-quality rox cheese. The taste was average but palateable
Rule.Translated: Comí queso de rox de mala calidad. El sabor era mediocre, pero aceptable.

Rule.Original: I ate rox cheese. It was tasty and filling.
Rule.Raw: I ate rox cheese. It was tasty and filling.
Rule.Translated: Comí queso de rox. Estaba sabroso y era saciante.

Rule.Original: The taste of the good-quality rox cheese you just ate lingers on your palate, bringing a smile to your face.
Rule.Raw: The taste of the good-quality rox cheese you just ate lingers on your palate, bringing a smile to your face.
Rule.Translated: El sabor del queso de rox de buena calidad que acabas de comer permanece en tu paladar y te dibuja una sonrisa.

Rule.Original: The incredible taste of the excellent-quality rox cheese you just indulged in has left you in a state of pure culinary delight
Rule.Raw: The incredible taste of the excellent-quality rox cheese you just indulged in has left you in a state of pure culinary delight
Rule.Translated: El increíble sabor del queso de rox de calidad excelente que acabas de degustar te ha dejado en un estado de auténtico deleite culinario.
comió queso de rox obra maestra

Rule.Original: The unparalleled taste of the masterwork-quality rox cheese you just savored has transported you to a realm of gustatory ecstasy.
Rule.Raw: The unparalleled taste of the masterwork-quality rox cheese you just savored has transported you to a realm of gustatory ecstasy.
Rule.Translated: El sabor incomparable del queso de rox de calidad obra maestra que acabas de saborear te ha transportado a un estado de éxtasis gastronómico.

Rule.Original: The divine taste of the legendary-quality rox cheese you just experienced has forever altered your perception of culinary perfection.
Rule.Raw: The divine taste of the legendary-quality rox cheese you just experienced has forever altered your perception of culinary perfection.
Rule.Translated: El sabor divino del queso de rox de calidad legendaria que acabas de probar ha cambiado para siempre tu idea de la perfección culinaria.

Rule.Original: Builders will try to mine valuables
Rule.Raw: Builders will try to mine valuables
Rule.Translated: Los constructores tratarán de extraer los bienes de valor

Rule.Original: Note: Placing a building over valuable ore will allow builders to mine the ore. Ore can be wasted if mined with low skill. If your builders are not skilled at mining, you may want to cancel your building project and let skilled miners do their job first.
Rule.Raw: Note: Placing a building over valuable ore will allow builders to mine the ore. Ore can be wasted if mined with low skill. If your builders are not skilled at mining, you may want to cancel your building project and let skilled miners do their job first.
Rule.Translated: Nota: Colocar un edificio sobre un mineral valioso permitirá a los constructores extraer el mineral. El mineral puede desperdiciarse si se extrae con poca habilidad. Si sus constructores no son expertos en minería, es posible que desee cancelar su proyecto de construcción y dejar que mineros cualificados hagan antes su trabajo.

Rule.Original: A self-powered mechanoid node of unknown function. Mech nodes can be deconstructed to yield valuable resources - but only if they are captured intact. The internal micro power cell will flame out and ruin the materials if the unit takes too much damage.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered mechanoid node of unknown function. Mech nodes can be deconstructed to yield valuable resources - but only if they are captured intact. The internal micro power cell will flame out and ruin the materials if the unit takes too much damage.
Rule.Translated: Un nodo mecanoide autoalimentado de función desconocida. Puede desmontarse para obtener recursos valiosos, pero solo si se captura intacto. Si recibe demasiados daños, su microcelda de energía arderá y arruinará los materiales.

Rule.Original: These kholo are a fearsome group of skilled hunters and warriors who prowl the many rimworlds. They practice a sacred form of cannibalism, believing it grants them the strength and wisdom of their enemies. Encounters with these feral tribes are perilous, as they fiercely guard their territory with primal fury.
Rule.Raw: These kholo are a fearsome group of skilled hunters and warriors who prowl the many rimworlds. They practice a sacred form of cannibalism, believing it grants them the strength and wisdom of their enemies. Encounters with these feral tribes are perilous, as they fiercely guard their territory with primal fury.
Rule.Translated: Estos kholo forman un temible grupo de cazadores y guerreros expertos que merodean por los numerosos mundos del confín. Practican una forma sagrada de canibalismo y creen que les concede la fuerza y la sabiduría de sus enemigos. Los encuentros con estas tribus salvajes son peligrosos, pues defienden ferozmente su territorio con una furia primitiva.

Rule.Original: Kholos are hyena-like humanoids known for their ruthless cunning and pack-based society, often driven by hunger, ambition, or the will of a dark patron.
Rule.Raw: Kholos are hyena-like humanoids known for their ruthless cunning and pack-based society, often driven by hunger, ambition, or the will of a dark patron.
Rule.Translated: Los kholo son humanoides semejantes a hienas, conocidos por su astucia despiadada y su sociedad organizada en manadas. A menudo los impulsan el hambre, la ambición o la voluntad de un oscuro patrón.

Rule.Original: Not all wounds are equal; set guidelines for which medicine to use when.
Rule.Raw: Not all wounds are equal; set guidelines for which medicine to use when.
Rule.Translated: No todas las heridas son iguales; establezca pautas sobre qué medicamento usar y en qué momento.

Rule.Original: Corporations, and really any heirarchal power structure, are an abomination and must be destroyed. Except for our own, of course.
Rule.Raw: Corporations, and really any heirarchal power structure, are an abomination and must be destroyed. Except for our own, of course.
Rule.Translated: Las corporaciones y, en realidad, cualquier estructura jerárquica de poder son una abominación y deben ser destruidas. Salvo la nuestra, por supuesto.

Rule.Original: Man was meant to conquer the stars. Every world that can be made to support human life, will be. The flora and fauna of those worlds will adapt to serve humanity, or it will be replaced.
Rule.Raw: Man was meant to conquer the stars. Every world that can be made to support human life, will be. The flora and fauna of those worlds will adapt to serve humanity, or it will be replaced.
Rule.Translated: La humanidad está destinada a conquistar las estrellas. Todos los mundos que puedan sustentar vida humana se adaptarán para ello. Su flora y fauna aprenderán a servir a la humanidad o serán reemplazadas.

Rule.Original: Tenere Lineam. The mechanoid menace is an existential threat to all of humanity. While others bicker and fight, Jotuns never forget that they are the final bulwark, protecting humanity from extinction.
Rule.Raw: Tenere Lineam. The mechanoid menace is an existential threat to all of humanity. While others bicker and fight, Jotuns never forget that they are the final bulwark, protecting humanity from extinction.
Rule.Translated: Tenere Lineam. La amenaza mecanoide pone en peligro la propia existencia de la humanidad. Mientras otros discuten y luchan, los Jotun nunca olvidan que son el último bastión que protege a la humanidad de la extinción.

Rule.Original: Sic semper tyrannis. Tyrants must be cast down; what they build, we will destroy, down to the last vestige.
Rule.Raw: Sic semper tyrannis. Tyrants must be cast down; what they build, we will destroy, down to the last vestige.
Rule.Translated: Sic semper tyrannis. Hay que derrocar a los tiranos; destruiremos todo lo que construyan hasta el último vestigio.

Rule.Original: All things are either wealth, or a resource that can be exploited for wealth. RimWorlds are just free real estate.
Rule.Raw: All things are either wealth, or a resource that can be exploited for wealth. RimWorlds are just free real estate.
Rule.Translated: Todo es riqueza o un recurso que puede explotarse para obtenerla. Los mundos fronterizos son terrenos disponibles gratis.

Rule.Original: Ex-employees of major interstellar corporations, terminated from their jobs or simply abandoning their duties. Now they are little more than pirates.
Rule.Raw: Ex-employees of major interstellar corporations, terminated from their jobs or simply abandoning their duties. Now they are little more than pirates.
Rule.Translated: Antiguos empleados de grandes corporaciones interestelares, despedidos o que simplemente abandonaron sus obligaciones. Ahora son poco más que piratas.

Rule.Original: The Greydale Foundation, the largest terraforming organization in the galaxy, is famous for producing robust and efficient equipment needed for initial colonization. It is common to produce Greydale equipment even on a planet that has been successfully colonized.\n\nThe foundation's modular equipment is easy to produce and easy to maintain. There are many cases in which militias in the lonely settlement of rimworlds are armed with equipment from the Greydale Foundation. And there are good reasons.
Rule.Raw: The Greydale Foundation, the largest terraforming organization in the galaxy, is famous for producing robust and efficient equipment needed for initial colonization. It is common to produce Greydale equipment even on a planet that has been successfully colonized.\n\nThe foundation's modular equipment is easy to produce and easy to maintain. There are many cases in which militias in the lonely settlement of rimworlds are armed with equipment from the Greydale Foundation. And there are good reasons.
Rule.Translated: La Fundación Greydale, la mayor organización de terraformación de la galaxia, es famosa por producir el equipo robusto y eficiente necesario para iniciar una colonización. Incluso los planetas ya colonizados suelen fabricar equipo de Greydale.\n\nEl equipo modular de la fundación es fácil de producir y mantener. Muchas milicias de asentamientos aislados de los mundos exteriores lo utilizan, y tienen buenos motivos.

Rule.Original: Facing countless mechanoid invasions, the fort world of Jotunheim Prime spent a thousand years fighting the merciless killing machines.\n\nSurviving in some of the harshest living conditions in the whole galaxy, the settlers of Jotunheim Prime developed equipment as ruthless as their opponents to survive. When you need absolute firepower, Jotun Interstellar is your company.
Rule.Raw: Facing countless mechanoid invasions, the fort world of Jotunheim Prime spent a thousand years fighting the merciless killing machines.\n\nSurviving in some of the harshest living conditions in the whole galaxy, the settlers of Jotunheim Prime developed equipment as ruthless as their opponents to survive. When you need absolute firepower, Jotun Interstellar is your company.
Rule.Translated: Tras sufrir incontables invasiones mecanoides, el mundo fortaleza de Jotunheim Prime pasó mil años luchando contra estas despiadadas máquinas de matar.\n\nPara sobrevivir en unas condiciones de vida de las más duras de la galaxia, sus colonos desarrollaron un equipo tan implacable como sus oponentes. Cuando necesitas potencia de fuego absoluta, Jotun Interstellar es tu compañía.

Rule.Original: Founded to track down and exterminate the Federation and its peacekeeper corps, the Tisiphone Hunting Contingent is the merciless embodiment of vengeance that can do anything to achieve their goals.\n\nUsing anti-federation kinetic impact weapons, Tisiphone hunters have a reputation for being the ones who will invade hell if there is a trace of the federation.
Rule.Raw: Founded to track down and exterminate the Federation and its peacekeeper corps, the Tisiphone Hunting Contingent is the merciless embodiment of vengeance that can do anything to achieve their goals.\n\nUsing anti-federation kinetic impact weapons, Tisiphone hunters have a reputation for being the ones who will invade hell if there is a trace of the federation.
Rule.Translated: Fundado para perseguir y exterminar a la Federación y su cuerpo de fuerzas de paz, el Contingente de Cazadores de Tisiphone es la encarnación despiadada de la venganza, dispuesto a todo para lograr sus objetivos.\n\nSus cazadores utilizan armas de impacto cinético contra la Federación y tienen fama de ser capaces de invadir el infierno si encuentran allí algún rastro de ella.

Rule.Original: The YeonHwa Precision is a cold-blooded megacorp that exploits the surrounding systems with invasive and elusive methods.\n\nAgents of their Aggressive Marketing Division remove elements in advance that would be a discouragement to the corporation's complex plans via high mobility gears and fast-firing weapons.
Rule.Raw: The YeonHwa Precision is a cold-blooded megacorp that exploits the surrounding systems with invasive and elusive methods.\n\nAgents of their Aggressive Marketing Division remove elements in advance that would be a discouragement to the corporation's complex plans via high mobility gears and fast-firing weapons.
Rule.Translated: YeonHwa Precision es una megacorporación de sangre fría que explota los sistemas cercanos mediante métodos invasivos y escurridizos.\n\nLos agentes de su División de Marketing Agresivo utilizan equipo de gran movilidad y armas de disparo rápido para eliminar de antemano cualquier elemento que pueda obstaculizar los complejos planes de la corporación.

Rule.Original:
A mechanoid designed for prison and city police, has a strange pepper gun.
This model can do basic warden work like release, execute and feeding, but can notdo any social interactions.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Can pick up a variety of weapons like DMS Automatroids, but no longerhave initial weapon.
Rule.Raw:
A mechanoid designed for prison and city police, has a strange pepper gun.
This model can do basic warden work like release, execute and feeding, but can notdo any social interactions.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Can pick up a variety of weapons like DMS Automatroids, but no longerhave initial weapon.
Rule.Translated:
Un mecanoide diseñado para prisiones y policía urbana, equipado con una extraña arma de pimienta.
Puede realizar tareas básicas de carcelero, como liberar, ejecutar y alimentar, pero no puede mantener interacciones sociales.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Puede recoger distintas armas, como los Automatroids de DMS, pero deja de tener un arma inicial.

Rule.Original:
A mechanoid designed for hunting, has special charge rifle, very effective against organics and mechanoids.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Can pick up a variety of weapons like DMS Automatroids, but no longerhave initial weapon.
Rule.Raw:
A mechanoid designed for hunting, has special charge rifle, very effective against organics and mechanoids.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Can pick up a variety of weapons like DMS Automatroids, but no longerhave initial weapon.
Rule.Translated:
Un mecanoide diseñado para cazar, equipado con un fusil de carga especial muy eficaz contra seres orgánicos y mecanoides.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Puede recoger distintas armas, como los Automatroids de DMS, pero deja de tener un arma inicial.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid designed for early space colonization, has decent armor to endure harsh alien environment, moves nearly as fast as normal human.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid designed for early space colonization, has decent armor to endure harsh alien environment, moves nearly as fast as normal human.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide diseñado para las primeras etapas de colonización espacial. Tiene un blindaje aceptable para soportar entornos alienígenas hostiles y se mueve casi tan deprisa como un humano normal.

Rule.Original:
Massively deployed in Ultratech factories, can do basic production jobs very effectively, but not good at quality control.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Enables function to produce cloth.
Rule.Raw:
Massively deployed in Ultratech factories, can do basic production jobs very effectively, but not good at quality control.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Enables function to produce cloth.
Rule.Translated:
Desplegado en masa en fábricas de ultratecnología. Realiza tareas básicas de producción con mucha eficacia, pero no destaca en el control de calidad.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Activa la producción de tela.

Rule.Original:
A mechanoid designed by Archoservitor for butchering alien animals, it has basic cooking programme, cooks products completely safe.

<color=yellow>More Mechanitor Mechs</color>
Canhandle and tame animals.
Rule.Raw:
A mechanoid designed by Archoservitor for butchering alien animals, it has basic cooking programme, cooks products completely safe.

<color=yellow>More Mechanitor Mechs</color>
Canhandle and tame animals.
Rule.Translated:
Un mecanoide diseñado por Archoservitor para despiezar animales alienígenas. Su programa básico de cocina elabora productos completamente seguros.

<color=yellow>More Mechanitor Mechs</color>
Puede manejar y domesticar animales.

Rule.Original: A heavy cleaver that can chop flesh very effectively, can only be handled by certain mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: A heavy cleaver that can chop flesh very effectively, can only be handled by certain mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Una cuchilla pesada que corta carne con gran eficacia y solo pueden manejar ciertos mecanoides.

Rule.Original: A pepper gun designed for interior combat, used to be a non-lethal weapon, but maids are adding more and more metal into pepper bullets.
Rule.Raw: A pepper gun designed for interior combat, used to be a non-lethal weapon, but maids are adding more and more metal into pepper bullets.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de pimienta para combatir en interiores. Antes era no letal, pero las doncellas añaden cada vez más metal a sus proyectiles de pimienta.

Rule.Original: A fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.
Rule.Raw: A fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de energía temible diseñada para descargar una cascada de energía electromagnética sobre sus objetivos. Su ráfaga de energía EMP puede aturdir e inutilizar mecanoides de un solo disparo. Al mismo tiempo, libera una descarga eléctrica abrasadora que quema a los objetivos orgánicos y los deja humeantes y vulnerables.

Rule.Raw: All changes require a restart to take effect!

Agrupa o desagrupa todas las alfombras.

Rule.Original: A heavy door that is far more resilient to damage.
Rule.Raw: A heavy door that is far more resilient to damage.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta pesada que es mucho más resistente al daño.

Rule.Original: Cook a straightforward meal from one vegetarian ingredient.
Rule.Raw: Cook a straightforward meal from one vegetarian ingredient.
Rule.Translated: Prepara una comida sencilla con un solo ingrediente vegetariano.

Rule.Original: Cook 4 straightforward meals from one vegetarian ingredient.
Rule.Raw: Cook 4 straightforward meals from one vegetarian ingredient.
Rule.Translated: Cocina 4 platos sencillos con un solo ingrediente vegetariano.

Rule.Original: Make portion of chopped meat from raw meat ingredients.
Rule.Raw: Make portion of chopped meat from raw meat ingredients.
Rule.Translated: Hace porciones de carne picada a partir de ingredientes cárnicos crudos.

Rule.Original: A large, soft, luxurious seat. Fitted inside a golden frame for only the wealthiest elites. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Raw: A large, soft, luxurious seat. Fitted inside a golden frame for only the wealthiest elites. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
Rule.Translated: Un asiento grande, suave, cómodo y lujoso. Con un reborde dorado, ideal para las élites más adineradas. Puede utilizarse en mesas, puestos de trabajo y otros lugares.

Rule.Original: A standing mirror. Must be placed near the bed. Placing more than one mirror near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A standing mirror. Must be placed near the bed. Placing more than one mirror near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Un espejo de pie. Debe colocarse cerca de la cama. Colocar más de un espejo cerca de la misma cama no tiene ningún efecto.

Rule.Original: A tall, impassable room divider. Must be placed near the bed. Placing more than one divider near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Raw: A tall, impassable room divider. Must be placed near the bed. Placing more than one divider near the same bed has no effect.
Rule.Translated: Un separador de habitaciones alto e infranqueable. Debe colocarse cerca de la cama. Colocar más de un separador cerca de la misma cama no tiene ningún efecto.

Rule.Original: A decorative banner hanging from a vertical wooden frame.
Rule.Raw: A decorative banner hanging from a vertical wooden frame.
Rule.Translated: Un bandera decorativa colgada de un soporte vertical de madera.

Rule.Original: A bed specially designed for animals surgery and recovery. It improves medical outcomes over normal beds.
Rule.Raw: A bed specially designed for animals surgery and recovery. It improves medical outcomes over normal beds.
Rule.Translated: Cama especialmente diseñada para la cirugía y recuperación de animales. Mejora los resultados médicos con respecto a las camas normales.

Rule.Original: An non-powered table preparing vegetarian meals. Cannot produce meat dishes, as it does not have heat treatment methods.
Rule.Raw: An non-powered table preparing vegetarian meals. Cannot produce meat dishes, as it does not have heat treatment methods.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa sin fuegos que sirve para preparar platos vegetarianos. No puede elaborar platos carnívoros, ya que no dispone de métodos de tratamiento térmico.

Rule.Original: A table with a meat grinder installed on it. Allows you to turn raw meat into minced meat.
Rule.Raw: A table with a meat grinder installed on it. Allows you to turn raw meat into minced meat.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa con una picadora de carne instalada. Permite convertir la carne cruda en carne picada.

Rule.Original: Simple steal wood-fired heater with chimney for space heating. Heats the room to a comfortable temperature, but the power cannot be changed.
Rule.Raw: Simple steal wood-fired heater with chimney for space heating. Heats the room to a comfortable temperature, but the power cannot be changed.
Rule.Translated: Un calefactor de leña con chimenea para calentar espacios. Calienta la habitación a una temperatura agradable, pero no se puede regular la intensidad.

Rule.Original: Minced meat product. It doesn`t look very appetizing, and spoils quickly outside the refrigerator. May consist of several types of meat and is mixed so much that it is impossible to determine what it is made of.
Rule.Raw: Minced meat product. It doesn`t look very appetizing, and spoils quickly outside the refrigerator. May consist of several types of meat and is mixed so much that it is impossible to determine what it is made of.
Rule.Translated: El resultado de triturar la carne. No tiene un aspecto muy apetitoso y se estropea rápidamente fuera del frigorífico. Puede estar compuesto por varios tipos de carne y está tan mezclado que es imposible determinar de qué está hecho.

Rule.Original: A location the player caravan has explored.
Rule.Raw: A location the player caravan has explored.

Rule.Original: Transforms one’s intense will into commands through the mech control nexus, causing the designated mechanoid to evolve. \n\n<color=#FFC857>Currently evolvable mechanoids:</color> Diabolus, War Queen, Any Centipede.
Rule.Raw: 将自身的强烈期望通过机控中枢转化为指令，令对应的机械体进行进化。\n\n<color=#FFC857>当前可进化的机械族：</color>炼狱魔王，战争女皇，任意机械蜈蚣。
Rule.Translated: Transforma una voluntad intensa en órdenes a través del nexo de control mecanoide, haciendo evolucionar al mecanoide designado. \n\n<color=#FFC857>Mecanoides que pueden evolucionar actualmente:</color> diábolus, reina bélica y cualquier ciempiés.

Rule.Original: Transforms one’s intense will into commands through the mech control nexus, causing the designated mechanoid to gigantamax. \n\n<color=#FFC857>Currently gigantamaxable units:</color> Diabolus, War Queen, Centurion.
Rule.Raw: 将自身的强烈期望通过机控中枢转化为指令，令对应的机械体进行极巨化。\n\n<color=#FFC857>当前可极巨化的单位：</color>炼狱魔王，战争女皇，机械卫螽。
Rule.Translated: Transforma una voluntad intensa en órdenes a través del nexo de control mecanoide, haciendo que el mecanoide designado alcance una forma gigantesca. \n\n<color=#FFC857>Unidades que pueden alcanzar una forma gigantesca actualmente:</color> diábolus, reina bélica y centurión.

Rule.Original: Transforms one’s intense will into commands through the mech control nexus, allowing designated mechanoids to fuse with each other. Due to bond restrictions, non-colony mechanoids cannot be selected.
Rule.Raw: 将自身的强烈期望通过机控中枢转化为指令，令对应的机械体之间进行融合。因为指令限制，不能指定非本阵营的机械体。\n\n<color=#FFC857>当前的融合配方：</color>炼狱魔王+憎恶毒蜂；炼狱魔王+战争女皇；炼狱魔王+任意机械蜈蚣；炼狱帝王+凤凰机械耀螳；战争女皇+机械卫螽（即百机长）。
Rule.Translated: Transforma una voluntad intensa en órdenes a través del nexo de control mecanoide, permitiendo fusionar los mecanoides designados. Las restricciones del vínculo impiden seleccionar mecanoides ajenos a la colonia.

Rule.Original: Transforms one’s intense will into commands through the mech control nexus, allowing designated mechanoids to fuse with each other. Due to bond restrictions, non-colony mechanoids cannot be selected.
Rule.Raw: 将自身的强烈期望通过机控中枢转化为指令，令对应的机械体之间进行融合。这种指令可以指定非本阵营的机械体，但融合素材中必须至少有一个属于己方阵营。\n\n<color=#FFC857>当前的融合配方：</color>炼狱魔王+憎恶毒蜂；炼狱魔王+战争女皇；炼狱魔王+任意机械蜈蚣；炼狱帝王+凤凰机械耀螳；战争女皇+机械卫螽（即百机长）。
Rule.Translated: Transforma una voluntad intensa en órdenes a través del nexo de control mecanoide, permitiendo fusionar los mecanoides designados. Las restricciones del vínculo impiden seleccionar mecanoides ajenos a la colonia.

Rule.Original: Through the authority of the Royalty Diabolus, directly summon a shuttle from the Imperial system to serve you.
Rule.Raw: 通过炼狱帝王的权限在帝国系统内部直接调用一架穿梭机为你服务。
Rule.Translated: Utilizando la autoridad del Diabolus de la Realeza, invoca directamente una lanzadera del sistema imperial para que te sirva.

Rule.Original: Harnessing its mastery of psionics, the Royalty Diabolus can instantly cross the boundaries of space-time, teleporting to any location on the planet. Like long-range farskip, an ally must serve as the beacon to fix the destination.
Rule.Raw: 通过所掌控的灵能，炼狱帝王能够瞬间穿越时空的界限，传送至星球上的任意位置。与远距离折跃一样，需要盟友作为信标确定位置。
Rule.Translated: Gracias a su dominio de la psiónica, el Diabolus de la Realeza puede atravesar instantáneamente los límites del espacio-tiempo y teletransportarse a cualquier lugar del planeta. Igual que con un salto lejano, un aliado debe actuar como baliza para fijar el destino.

Rule.Original: Harnessing its mastery of psionics, the Royalty Diabolus can cause a target to traverse through rifts, transporting it to a nearby desired location that does not need to be within line of sight. Objects that are too large cannot be transported.
Rule.Raw: 通过所掌控的灵能，炼狱帝王能够使目标在裂隙中穿行，并将其传送到离其起点不太远的所需位置，且不需要位置处于视野之中，太大的物体无法传送。
Rule.Translated: Gracias a su dominio de la psiónica, el Diabolus de la Realeza puede hacer que un objetivo atraviese grietas y trasladarlo a un lugar cercano que no necesita estar en línea de visión. Los objetos demasiado grandes no pueden transportarse.

Rule.Original: Harnessing its mastery of psionics, the Royalty Diabolus can generate a spherical barrier within a designated area, diverting all projectiles entering or leaving the ground to distant locations. Explosive ordnance detonates during transmission. By its own admission, these redirected trajectories often end up at the homes of Imperial officials it dislikes.
Rule.Raw: 通过所掌控的灵能，炼狱帝王能够在指定区域创造一个球形屏障，并将所有进出地面的弹道传送到遥远的地方。传送过程会引爆爆炸性弹药。据炼狱帝王亲口承认，这些弹道通常指向与其不对付的帝国官员家中。
Rule.Translated: Gracias a su dominio de la psiónica, el Diabolus de la Realeza puede generar una barrera esférica en una zona designada que desvía hacia lugares lejanos todos los proyectiles que entran o salen del área. La munición explosiva detona durante la transmisión. Según admite el propio Diabolus, estas trayectorias redirigidas suelen acabar en las casas de funcionarios imperiales que le caen mal.

Rule.Original: The Royalty Diabolus transmits scan orders to Imperial orbiting vessels, which then scan the area around its current location.
Rule.Raw: 炼狱帝王将扫描指令传输给帝国在轨飞船，后者将对炼狱帝王的所在区域进行扫描。
Rule.Translated: El Diabolus de la Realeza transmite órdenes de escaneo a naves imperiales en órbita, que exploran la zona alrededor de su posición actual.

Rule.Original: 帝国神秘天线其实是个陷阱！其所发出的脉冲最终指向机械族巢穴，并为天线所在地带来大规模的机械族袭击，其中包括{LEADERKIND_label}。帝国军队在与机械族巢穴的战斗中多次使用{LEADERKIND_label}，最直接的结果就是导致机械族巢穴也开始量产{LEADERKIND_label}了。
Rule.Raw: 帝国神秘天线其实是个陷阱！其所发出的脉冲最终指向机械族巢穴，并为天线所在地带来大规模的机械族袭击，其中包括{LEADERKIND_label}。帝国军队在与机械族巢穴的战斗中多次使用{LEADERKIND_label}，最直接的结果就是导致机械族巢穴也开始量产{LEADERKIND_label}了。
Rule.Translated: ¡La misteriosa antena imperial es una trampa! Sus pulsos terminan llegando a la colmena mecanoide y provocan un ataque mecanoide masivo contra la ubicación de la antena, que incluye a {LEADERKIND_label}. Las tropas imperiales han utilizado repetidamente a {LEADERKIND_label} en sus combates contra las colmenas mecanoides, y el resultado más directo es que estas también han empezado a producir en masa a {LEADERKIND_label}.

Rule.Original: {0} has been vaporized by extreme heat.
Rule.Raw: {0} has been vaporized by extreme heat.
Rule.Translated: {0} ha sido vaporizado por calor extremo.

Rule.Original: {0} has been vaporized by extreme heat.
Rule.Raw: {0} has been vaporized by extreme heat.
Rule.Translated: {0} ha sido vaporizado por calor extremo.

Rule.Original: A gene formed by the mech control nexus, with its origin unknown. Carriers of this gene can transmit evolution commands through the nexus to designated mechanoids, causing them to evolve—though a certain degree of knowledge is required to achieve this.
Rule.Raw: 因机控中枢形成的基因，形成原因不明。该基因的携带者能够通过机控中枢对特定的机械体发射进化指令，令特定的机械体进行进化，只不过需要一定的知识储备才能办到这一点。
Rule.Translated: Un gen formado por el Nexo de Control Mecanoide cuyo origen es desconocido. Quienes portan este gen pueden transmitir órdenes de evolución a través del Nexo hacia mecanoides concretos y hacerlos evolucionar, aunque se necesita cierto conocimiento para conseguirlo.

Rule.Original: A gene formed by the mech control nexus, with its origin unknown. Carriers of this gene can transmit gigantamax commands through the nexus to designated mechanoids, causing them to gigantamax—though a certain degree of knowledge is required to achieve this.
Rule.Raw: 因机控中枢形成的基因，形成原因不明。该基因的携带者能够通过机控中枢对特定的机械体发射极巨化指令，令特定的机械体进行极巨化，只不过需要一定的知识储备才能办到这一点。
Rule.Translated: Un gen formado por el Nexo de Control Mecanoide cuyo origen es desconocido. Quienes portan este gen pueden transmitir órdenes de gigantificación a través del Nexo hacia mecanoides concretos y hacerlos gigantificar, aunque se necesita cierto conocimiento para conseguirlo.

Rule.Original: A gene formed by the mech control nexus, with its origin unknown. Carriers of this gene can transmit fusion commands through the nexus to designated mechanoids, enabling them to fuse with each other—though a certain degree of knowledge is required to achieve this.
Rule.Raw: 因机控中枢形成的基因，形成原因不明。该基因的携带者能够通过机控中枢对特定的机械体之间发射融合指令，令特定的机械体之间进行融合，只不过需要一定的知识储备才能办到这一点。
Rule.Translated: Un gen formado por el Nexo de Control Mecanoide cuyo origen es desconocido. Quienes portan este gen pueden transmitir órdenes de fusión a través del Nexo hacia mecanoides concretos, permitiendo que se fusionen entre sí, aunque se necesita cierto conocimiento para conseguirlo.

Rule.Original: A gene formed by the mech control nexus, with its origin unknown. Carriers of this gene can transmit fusion commands through the nexus to designated mechanoids, enabling them to fuse with each other. Unlike standard fusion, this process can target non-colony mechanoids, but at least one fusion material must belong to the colony for it to succeed. A certain degree of knowledge is also required to achieve this.
Rule.Raw: 因机控中枢形成的基因，形成原因不明。该基因的携带者能够通过机控中枢对特定的机械体之间发射融合指令，令特定的机械体之间进行融合。这种融合可以指定非己方的机械体，但融合素材中至少有一个属于己方才能生效，而且也需要一定的知识储备才能办到这一点。
Rule.Translated: Un gen formado por el Nexo de Control Mecanoide cuyo origen es desconocido. Quienes portan este gen pueden transmitir órdenes de fusión a través del Nexo hacia mecanoides concretos y permitir que se fusionen entre sí. A diferencia de la fusión normal, este proceso puede afectar a mecanoides ajenos a la colonia, aunque al menos uno de los materiales de fusión debe pertenecer a ella. También se necesita cierto conocimiento.

Rule.Original: This mech has been summoned via innate psychic means, and will vanish after a period of 1 day.
Rule.Raw: This mech has been summoned via innate psychic means, and will vanish after a period of 1 day.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide ha sido invocado por medios psíquicos innatos y desaparecerá al cabo de 1 día.

Rule.Original: A state entered after being attacked by the Imperial Soul Cannon, typically resulting in expiration within 2 hours. Like a call of death approaching from afar, each hit by the Imperial True Soul Cannon increases the chance of immediate death; the more hits, the greater the chance. There are no other effects.
Rule.Raw: 受到帝王镇魂炮攻击后进入的状态，通常会在2小时后小时。犹如死亡的呼唤由远及近，每次被帝王真魂炮击中后都有机会立即死亡，受击次数越多机会越大。但除此之外无其他影响。
Rule.Translated: Estado provocado tras ser alcanzado por el Cañón de Almas Imperial y que normalmente causa la muerte en un plazo de 2 horas. Como una llamada de la muerte que se acerca desde lejos, cada impacto del Cañón de Alma Verdadera Imperial aumenta la probabilidad de muerte inmediata; cuantos más impactos, mayor es la probabilidad. No tiene otros efectos.

Rule.Original: Ignited upon being struck by the Gigantic Fire Cannon. The immense fire burns through armor, making it more susceptible to damage. Additionally, due to the fire's disruption, control and mobility are reduced.
Rule.Raw: 受到极巨业火炮的攻击而被点燃。极巨业火会烧毁身上的装甲，使其更易受伤.同时因为业火的干扰，操控和移动能力都会下降。
Rule.Translated: Se encienden al recibir un impacto del Cañón de Fuego Gigantesco. El fuego intenso atraviesa la armadura y hace que el objetivo sea más vulnerable al daño. Además, la perturbación de las llamas reduce el control y la movilidad.

Rule.Original: A psychological reaction induced by the mental energy emitted from super-mechs. When the urge to fight arises uncontrollably without an outlet, indiscriminate attacks occur. The fighting spirit fades over time.\n\nThose whose combined shooting and melee levels are less than the enemy's combat spirit level will not be driven berserk by the combat spirit.
Rule.Raw: 由超级机械散发的心灵能量产生的心理反应。当心中激起的战意无处宣泄时，就会不受控制的无差别攻击。战意会随着时间消退。\n\n射击等级与格斗等级之和小于敌人的战意等级者不会因被战意引发狂暴。
Rule.Translated: Una reacción psicológica provocada por la energía mental que emiten los supermecanoides. Cuando el impulso de combatir surge sin control y no encuentra salida, se producen ataques indiscriminados. El espíritu combativo se desvanece con el tiempo.\n\nAquellos cuya suma de niveles de tiro y cuerpo a cuerpo sea inferior al nivel de espíritu combativo del enemigo no entrarán en frenesí por dicho espíritu.

Rule.Original:
Reactive Armor: After being injured, this unit cannot be harmed again for one second.

 Firepower Boost: The main cannon and defensive flames gain greatly increased power.

 Reinforced Armor: This unit is nearly immune to conventional sharp and blunt damage.

 Flammable: All heat damage taken by this unit is doubled.
Rule.Raw:
反应装甲：该单位受伤后的一秒内无法再次受伤。

 火力提升：主炮与自卫火焰的威力显著提升。

 坚固装甲：该单位几乎不会受到任何传统的锐器与钝器伤害。

 易燃：该单位受到的所有热能伤害翻倍。
Rule.Translated:
Armadura reactiva: después de recibir daño, esta unidad no puede volver a ser dañada durante un segundo.
Potencia de fuego aumentada: el cañón principal y las llamas defensivas reciben un gran aumento de potencia.
Armadura reforzada: esta unidad es casi inmune al daño cortante y contundente convencional.
Inflamable: todo el daño por calor recibido por esta unidad se duplica.
