Rule.Original: By studying the signal chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Rule.Raw: By studying the signal chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original:
Hello. For some time before you have been in contact with something about the mechanoids, they may be dressed in shabby black, alone and not behaving very similarly to normal mechanoids, but that does not mean that you can provoke them at will. These mechanoids has a leader of notable ability to command, as long as he is still, I am afraid that your study of these mechanoids will not be able to continue to deepen. But I can provide you with help. 
According to my understanding, this powerful mechanoid possesses abilities that include the following:

-Psychic Comet, his primary weapon. Launches a bombardment with clumps of psychic energy over a large area. 

-Ball Lightning, a secondary weapon. Able to instantly dismantle enemies that try to get close to him, explode after some time, and fly very slowly.

-shoot countless lightning arrows from the wings on his back and cover a vast area. This kind of attack consumes a considerable amount of energy, so the movements before it is executed are quite obvious. Even an organism can easily detect it.

-Rough melee attacks are also of little use, he will bend and leap enemies who try to get close to him away from him.

-When you aim a gun at it, it might suddenly swap positions between someone in your team and it. Be cautious of accidental injuries by friendly forces.

This is all the information we can provide, the specific tactics still need to be formulated by you. I'm looking forward to the appearance of someone who can challenge him. 

The bottom of this email is unsigned.

Rule.Translated:
Hola. Últimamente has entrado en contacto con algunos mecanoides. Puede que vistan de negro raído, estén solos y actúen de forma distinta a los normales, pero eso no significa que puedas provocarlos impunemente. Estos mecanoides tienen un líder con una notable capacidad de mando. Mientras siga ahí, me temo que no podrás profundizar en su estudio. Pero puedo ayudarte. 
Según lo que sé, este poderoso mecanoide tiene las siguientes capacidades:

-Cometa psíquico, su arma principal. Bombardea una gran zona con concentraciones de energía psíquica. 

-Rayo esférico, un arma secundaria. Puede desmantelar al instante a los enemigos que intenten acercarse, explota al cabo de un tiempo y se desplaza muy lentamente.

-Dispara incontables flechas de rayos desde las alas de su espalda y cubre una zona inmensa. Este ataque consume mucha energía, por lo que sus movimientos previos son muy evidentes. Incluso un ser orgánico puede detectarlos fácilmente.

-Los ataques cuerpo a cuerpo rudimentarios tampoco sirven de mucho: repelerá y lanzará lejos a quienes intenten acercarse.

-Cuando le apuntes con un arma, podría intercambiar repentinamente su posición con la de alguien de tu equipo. Ten cuidado con las heridas accidentales por fuego amigo.

Esta es toda la información que podemos ofrecerte. Tendrás que elaborar las tácticas concretas por tu cuenta. Espero con interés que aparezca alguien capaz de desafiarlo. 

Este mensaje no lleva firma al final.

Rule.Original: "Just because we don't want war to happen doesn't mean we fear it coming."\n\n"A blanket denial of war will only lead to one's own destruction in the end."
Rule.Raw: "Just because we don't want war to happen doesn't mean we fear it coming."\n\n"A blanket denial of war will only lead to one's own destruction in the end."
Rule.Translated: «Que no queramos que haya guerra no significa que temamos su llegada».\n\n«Negar la guerra por completo solo termina llevando a la propia destrucción».

Rule.Original: "The people of the glitterworld yearn beyond measure for a world without death. But life without death can only become a tumor, growing distorted and without beauty."\n\n"Only then do I sympathize with those materialists. How wonderful it would be if the souls of people could really meet in heaven after they die."
Rule.Raw: "The people of the glitterworld yearn beyond measure for a world without death. But life without death can only become a tumor, growing distorted and without beauty."\n\n"Only then do I sympathize with those materialists. How wonderful it would be if the souls of people could really meet in heaven after they die."
Rule.Translated: «Los habitantes de los mundos brillantes anhelan sin medida un mundo sin muerte. Pero una vida sin muerte solo puede convertirse en un tumor que crece deforme y sin belleza».\n\n«Solo entonces compadezco a esos materialistas. Qué maravilloso sería que las almas pudieran reunirse de verdad en el cielo después de morir».

Rule.Original: "The natural plague was finally wiped out completely by the Shining World, but the man-made biochemical weapons were instead developed at great length." \n\n "I saw the man spasming and crouching down to suck the luciferium scattered on the ground. Humanity has not got rid of the devil, the plague, after all; it just exists in a different way."
Rule.Raw: "The natural plague was finally wiped out completely by the Shining World, but the man-made biochemical weapons were instead developed at great length." \n\n "I saw the man spasming and crouching down to suck the luciferium scattered on the ground. Humanity has not got rid of the devil, the plague, after all; it just exists in a different way."
Rule.Translated: «Los mundos brillantes erradicaron por completo las plagas naturales, pero desarrollaron ampliamente las armas bioquímicas creadas por el ser humano». \n\n«Vi a aquel hombre convulsionar y agacharse para aspirar el luciferio esparcido por el suelo. La humanidad no se ha librado del demonio de la plaga; simplemente existe de otra forma».

Rule.Original: The war is over and mankind wraps the wound in bandages as if it had never happened. \n\nThings like this will be repeated in eternity, over and over again.
Rule.Raw: The war is over and mankind wraps the wound in bandages as if it had never happened. \n\nThings like this will be repeated in eternity, over and over again.
Rule.Translated: La guerra ha terminado y la humanidad venda sus heridas como si nunca hubiera ocurrido. \n\nEsto se repetirá por toda la eternidad, una y otra vez.

Rule.Original: A specially designed shield belt, the spread of the shield as soft as water. In addition to allowing range weapons to fire outward-facing, it also provides a 10-second migration shield after breaking, blocking all external attacks. \n\nIt takes quite a while to recharge.
Rule.Raw: A specially designed shield belt, the spread of the shield as soft as water. In addition to allowing range weapons to fire outward-facing, it also provides a 10-second migration shield after breaking, blocking all external attacks. \n\nIt takes quite a while to recharge.
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón de escudo diseñado especialmente, cuyo escudo se extiende con la suavidad del agua. Permite disparar hacia fuera y, al romperse, proporciona un escudo de transición de 10 segundos que bloquea todos los ataques externos. \n\nTarda bastante en recargarse.

Rule.Original: Beautiful bowler hat, containing mechanical neurons that can assist the wearer to think. \n\nMaybe it can be used to do magic tricks.
Rule.Raw: Beautiful bowler hat, containing mechanical neurons that can assist the wearer to think. \n\nMaybe it can be used to do magic tricks.
Rule.Translated: Un hermoso bombín que contiene neuronas mecánicas capaces de ayudar a pensar a quien lo lleva. \n\nQuizá sirva para hacer trucos de magia.

Rule.Raw: The wide, heavy trench coat contains mechanical neurons that can assist the wearer in controlling the mechanoids, and the effect will be enhanced when the colony destroys certain powerful mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Esta gabardina ancha y pesada contiene neuronas mecánicas que ayudan a su portador a controlar mecanoides. El efecto mejora cuando la colonia destruye determinados mecanoides poderosos.

Rule.Original: This is a new weapon designed by your colonists to remotely launch a war urchin to help draw fire. \n\nDon't fire it at your friends, it still hurts to hit people.
Rule.Raw: This is a new weapon designed by your colonists to remotely launch a war urchin to help draw fire. \n\nDon't fire it at your friends, it still hurts to hit people.
Rule.Translated: Una nueva arma diseñada por tus colonos para lanzar a distancia un erizo de guerra que atraiga el fuego enemigo. \n\nNo la dispares contra tus amigos: golpear a alguien con él sigue doliendo.

Rule.Original: A ultra-high-power energy pulse projector designed for siegebreaking. The hellsphere cannon must hold a bead on its target for several seconds while charging, before it releases a devastating tsunami of power. The explosion is capable of melting concrete in its blast radius. The heat of the explosion will ignite anything nearby. It cannot fire at close-up targets.

Rule.Translated: Un proyector de pulsos de energía de potencia extrema diseñado para romper asedios. El cañón Hellsphere debe mantener el objetivo fijado durante varios segundos mientras carga, antes de liberar una devastadora oleada de energía. La explosión puede fundir el hormigón dentro de su radio de alcance. El calor de la explosión incendia todo lo que haya cerca. No puede disparar a objetivos cercanos.

Rule.Original:
The leader of the black mechanoid nest, who learned of the attack on his fellow black-clad colleagues followed a strange signal to this place.

The real reason why he broke away from the mechanoid mother nest no one knows. Just as the other apocritons were enjoying a bloody kill, he was plunged into deeper thoughts by hatred. In thousands of years of thinking he began to feel confused about the future of the mechanoids and cosmic civilization, a confusion that could not even be eliminated by the direct command of the mechanoid mother nest. At the end of the hacker war with the Empire, the moment he was marked as a "virus" by the mechanoid nest, a deep loneliness finally quenched the hatred. He went to a rim-planet alone, met other mechanoids dressed in black who were also "viruses", and began to live with them and continue to think.

To his surprise and delight, as independent thinking mechanoids, the black-clad mechanoids can understand his doubts, and even with him to discuss the problem, the satisfaction of finding a soulmate more abhorrent poison wasp firm idea to stay. He eventually became the leader of the black-clad mechanoids, selflessly dedicated to the development and growth of this faction.

However, the hatred for the organics buried in his underlying code did not disappear completely. Once an opportunity arises, for example, when his companions are threatened with death, this hatred reasserts itself as a sharp edge for him to destroy his enemies.

Rule.Translated:
El líder de la colonia de mecanoides negros, que siguió una extraña señal hasta aquí al enterarse del ataque contra sus compañeros de negro.

Nadie sabe por qué se separó realmente de la colmena madre. Mientras otros apócritos disfrutaban de matanzas sangrientas, el odio lo sumió en reflexiones más profundas. Tras miles de años pensando, comenzó a sentir dudas sobre el futuro de los mecanoides y de la civilización cósmica, dudas que ni las órdenes directas de la colmena madre podían eliminar. Al final de la guerra informática contra el Imperio, cuando la colmena lo marcó como «virus», una profunda soledad terminó por apagar su odio. Viajó solo a un planeta del borde, conoció a otros mecanoides de negro también considerados «virus» y comenzó a vivir con ellos mientras seguía reflexionando.

Para su sorpresa y alegría, aquellos mecanoides capaces de pensar por sí mismos comprendían sus dudas e incluso podían debatirlas con él. La satisfacción de encontrar compañeros afines reforzó su decisión de quedarse. Acabó convirtiéndose en su líder y se dedicó desinteresadamente al desarrollo y crecimiento de esta facción.

Sin embargo, el odio hacia los seres orgánicos enterrado en su código fundamental no desapareció por completo. Cuando surge una oportunidad, por ejemplo, si sus compañeros están en peligro de muerte, ese odio vuelve a convertirse en el filo con el que destruye a sus enemigos.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid designed for long-range reconnaissance can be designated to assist a colonist or another mechanoid with aiming, increasing its range by 25%.\n\nWhen in working mode, the observer will actively follow the bound target. The range increase effect only takes effect when it is close enough to the target.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid designed for long-range reconnaissance can be designated to assist a colonist or another mechanoid with aiming, increasing its range by 25%.\n\nWhen in working mode, the observer will actively follow the bound target. The range increase effect only takes effect when it is close enough to the target.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide diseñado para el reconocimiento a larga distancia. Puede asignarse para ayudar a un colono u otro mecanoide a apuntar, aumentando su alcance un 25%.\n\nEn modo de trabajo, el observador sigue activamente al objetivo vinculado. El aumento de alcance solo funciona cuando está lo bastante cerca de él.

Rule.Raw: His voice seemed to be stirring my brain... I was having a hard time concentrating. Everything I was seeing and hearing was getting stranger and stranger.
Rule.Translated: Su voz parecía agitar mi cerebro... Me costaba concentrarme. Todo lo que veía y oía era cada vez más extraño.

Rule.Original: He seemed to be mumbling something to me.
Rule.Raw: He seemed to be mumbling something to me.

Rule.Original: Launch a powerful armor-piercing rocket, which requires a considerable amount of time to load.
Rule.Raw: Launch a powerful armor-piercing rocket, which requires a considerable amount of time to load.
Rule.Translated: Lanza un potente cohete perforante que requiere bastante tiempo de carga.

Rule.Original: Exchange Persona Data (1000 intelligence - 1 persona data)
Rule.Raw: Exchange Persona Data (1000 intelligence - 1 persona data)
Rule.Translated: Intercambiar datos de personalidad (1000 de inteligencia - 1 dato de personalidad)

Rule.Original: Exchange Precision Armor Plates (1000 intelligence - 75 precision decks)
Rule.Raw: Exchange Precision Armor Plates (1000 intelligence - 75 precision decks)
Rule.Translated: Intercambiar placas de blindaje de precisión (1000 de inteligencia - 75 placas de precisión)

Rule.Original: Exchange Mech Cluster Targeter (1000 intelligence - 1 mech cluster targeter)
Rule.Raw: Exchange Mech Cluster Targeter (1000 intelligence - 1 mech cluster targeter)
Rule.Translated: Intercambiar designador de agrupación mecanoide (1000 de inteligencia - 1 designador de agrupación mecanoide)

Rule.Original: Exchange Glitterworld Medicine (1000 intelligence - 10 Glitterworld medicine)
Rule.Raw: Exchange Glitterworld Medicine (1000 intelligence - 10 Glitterworld medicine)
Rule.Translated: Intercambiar medicina de mundo glitter (1000 de inteligencia - 10 medicinas de mundo glitter)

Rule.Original: Call for Support (2000 Intelligence - a group of combatants)\nNote: Combatants will attack ALL factions except you
Rule.Raw: Call for Support (2000 Intelligence - a group of combatants)\nNote: Combatants will attack ALL factions except you
Rule.Translated: Pedir apoyo (2000 de inteligencia - un grupo de combatientes)\nNota: atacarán a TODAS las facciones excepto a la tuya
La mente de {0} ha sido alterada.
{0} ha muerto alcanzado por un haz.

Rule.Original: During the long hacking campaign between the mechanoid hive and the Empire, some mech AI were breached by empire hackers. They are separated from the core, and have since been regarded as harmful by mechanoid hive. However, after losing their usefulness, these AI were soon abandoned by the Empire and eventually became "homeless" mechanoids. Hunted by black and White, they are forced to learn to think independently of the Hive database, while gathering together to protect each other and learn survival lessons from the organisms they once hated.\n\nIn the process of learning from humans, they also wear black like the man in Black and carry white flowers with them to offer to their former mechanoid companions when they bury them. Logically this behavior is completely incomprehensible, but it is true.
Rule.Raw: During the long hacking campaign between the mechanoid hive and the Empire, some mech AI were breached by empire hackers. They are separated from the core, and have since been regarded as harmful by mechanoid hive. However, after losing their usefulness, these AI were soon abandoned by the Empire and eventually became "homeless" mechanoids. Hunted by black and White, they are forced to learn to think independently of the Hive database, while gathering together to protect each other and learn survival lessons from the organisms they once hated.\n\nIn the process of learning from humans, they also wear black like the man in Black and carry white flowers with them to offer to their former mechanoid companions when they bury them. Logically this behavior is completely incomprehensible, but it is true.
Rule.Translated: Durante la prolongada campaña informática entre la colmena de mecanoides y el Imperio, los piratas informáticos imperiales vulneraron algunas IA mecánicas. Fueron separadas del núcleo y consideradas dañinas por la colmena. Sin embargo, el Imperio las abandonó pronto al dejar de ser útiles y acabaron convertidas en mecanoides «sin hogar». Perseguidas por ambos bandos, tuvieron que aprender a pensar sin la base de datos de la colmena, reunirse para protegerse y aprender a sobrevivir de los seres orgánicos que antes odiaban.\n\nAl aprender de los humanos, también empezaron a vestir de negro, como el hombre de negro, y a llevar flores blancas para ofrecérselas a sus antiguos compañeros mecanoides al enterrarlos. Lógicamente, este comportamiento resulta incomprensible, pero es real.

Rule.Original: Affected by the psychic shock wave, this unit can no longer use its mind powers.
Rule.Raw: Affected by the psychic shock wave, this unit can no longer use its mind powers.
Rule.Translated: Afectada por la onda de choque psíquica, esta unidad ya no puede usar sus poderes mentales.

Rule.Original: Affected by the psychic shock wave, this unit has difficulty maintaining normal thinking anymore.
Rule.Raw: Affected by the psychic shock wave, this unit has difficulty maintaining normal thinking anymore.
Rule.Translated: Afectada por la onda de choque psíquica, esta unidad tiene dificultades para pensar con normalidad.

Rule.Original: The sheer size of the unit blocks signal transmission, and the persona core takes a while to turn on. This unit is extremely vulnerable during initialization.
Rule.Raw: The sheer size of the unit blocks signal transmission, and the persona core takes a while to turn on. This unit is extremely vulnerable during initialization.
Rule.Translated: El enorme tamaño de la unidad dificulta la transmisión de señales y el núcleo de personalidad tarda en arrancar. Es extremadamente vulnerable durante la inicialización.

Rule.Original: This unit can use jump packs to get close to enemies.\n\nJump backpack range of action: 2~12
Rule.Raw: This unit can use jump packs to get close to enemies.\n\nJump backpack range of action: 2~12
Rule.Translated: Esta unidad puede usar mochilas de salto para acercarse a los enemigos.\n\nAlcance de la mochila de salto: 2~12

Rule.Original: The nanomechanics inside this unit are enhancing their mobility.
Rule.Raw: The nanomechanics inside this unit are enhancing their mobility.
Rule.Translated: Las nanomáquinas del interior de esta unidad están mejorando su movilidad.

Rule.Original: The psychic shockwave from the apocriton is stirring the nerves of this unit like a wave.\n\nYou will only be affected by this effect if you are closer than 55 frames from the apocriton.
Rule.Raw: The psychic shockwave from the apocriton is stirring the nerves of this unit like a wave.\n\nYou will only be affected by this effect if you are closer than 55 frames from the apocriton.
Rule.Translated: La onda de choque psíquica del apócrito agita los nervios de esta unidad como una ola.\n\nSolo sufrirás este efecto si estás a menos de 55 casillas del apócrito.

Rule.Original: Additional armor that is configured on the surface armor of a mechanoid, which acts when the mechanoid is damaged and interferes with the attack, reducing the damage it takes for a short period of time.
Rule.Raw: Additional armor that is configured on the surface armor of a mechanoid, which acts when the mechanoid is damaged and interferes with the attack, reducing the damage it takes for a short period of time.
Rule.Translated: Blindaje adicional instalado sobre la coraza de un mecanoide. Se activa al recibir daño e interfiere con el ataque, reduciendo el daño recibido durante un breve periodo.

Rule.Original: The injury activated the self-defense mechanism of this mechanoid, and his performance was enhanced for a certain period of time.
Rule.Raw: The injury activated the self-defense mechanism of this mechanoid, and his performance was enhanced for a certain period of time.
Rule.Translated: Las heridas han activado el mecanismo de autodefensa de este mecanoide y mejorado su rendimiento durante un tiempo.

Rule.Original: The shield is able to actively change its shape in an indescribably weird way and is soft enough to keep out any incoming attack. When the shield disappears, the stored kinetic energy will be released outwards in an instant, injuring anyone who dares to approach.
Rule.Raw: The shield is able to actively change its shape in an indescribably weird way and is soft enough to keep out any incoming attack. When the shield disappears, the stored kinetic energy will be released outwards in an instant, injuring anyone who dares to approach.
Rule.Translated: El escudo cambia activamente de forma de una manera indescriptiblemente extraña y es lo bastante flexible para detener cualquier ataque entrante. Cuando desaparezca, la energía cinética almacenada se liberará instantáneamente hacia fuera y herirá a quienes se atrevan a acercarse.

Rule.Original: A strange burning sensation fills the brain of this unit.
Rule.Raw: A strange burning sensation fills the brain of this unit.
Rule.Translated: Una extraña sensación de ardor llena el cerebro de esta unidad.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid has a one-time call reinforcement capability. If it makes a successful call, a mechanoid mosquito squadron will be deployed to the battlefield. \n\nThis module will be damaged after being hit by EMP.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid has a one-time call reinforcement capability. If it makes a successful call, a mechanoid mosquito squadron will be deployed to the battlefield. \n\nThis module will be damaged after being hit by EMP.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide puede solicitar refuerzos una sola vez. Si la llamada tiene éxito, se desplegará un escuadrón de mosquitos mecanoides en el campo de batalla. \n\nEl módulo quedará dañado tras recibir un impacto EMP.

Rule.Original: Advanced micro calculator that can analyze the enemy's position, posture and possible intentions at a very fast speed and provide the mechanoid with multiple targeting solutions for reference. Significantly improve the shooting accuracy of the mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: Advanced micro calculator that can analyze the enemy's position, posture and possible intentions at a very fast speed and provide the mechanoid with multiple targeting solutions for reference. Significantly improve the shooting accuracy of the mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Una microcalculadora avanzada que analiza rápidamente la posición, postura y posibles intenciones del enemigo y ofrece al mecanoide varias soluciones de puntería. Mejora considerablemente su precisión de tiro.
Instrumento de control de tiro de precisión

Rule.Original: Advanced microcomputers that rapidly acquire and process information about battlefield posture and targets, and control firearms firing. Significantly increase the firing speed of mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: Advanced microcomputers that rapidly acquire and process information about battlefield posture and targets, and control firearms firing. Significantly increase the firing speed of mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Microordenadores avanzados que recopilan y procesan rápidamente información sobre la situación del campo de batalla y los objetivos, y controlan el disparo de las armas. Aumentan considerablemente la cadencia de fuego del mecanoide.

Rule.Original: Lightweight and sophisticated shield projector capable of analyzing what mode it needs to be adjusted to based on the battlefield situation and used to defend against almost any projectile attack. Can only be deployed once.
Rule.Raw: Lightweight and sophisticated shield projector capable of analyzing what mode it needs to be adjusted to based on the battlefield situation and used to defend against almost any projectile attack. Can only be deployed once.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo ligero y sofisticado que analiza la situación del campo de batalla para ajustar su modo y defenderse de casi cualquier proyectil. Solo puede desplegarse una vez.

Rule.Original: By receiving reflected electromagnetic waves from multiple wavelengths at the same time, it can obtain accurate information about the enemy out of sight and respond appropriately. When the mechanoid is hit from out of range, a single bombardment is given in return.\n\nMechanoids will lose this ability due to circuit board burnout after an EMP hit.
Rule.Raw: By receiving reflected electromagnetic waves from multiple wavelengths at the same time, it can obtain accurate information about the enemy out of sight and respond appropriately. When the mechanoid is hit from out of range, a single bombardment is given in return.\n\nMechanoids will lose this ability due to circuit board burnout after an EMP hit.
Rule.Translated: Recibe simultáneamente ondas electromagnéticas reflejadas de distintas longitudes de onda, obteniendo información precisa sobre enemigos fuera de la vista para responder adecuadamente. Si el mecanoide recibe un impacto desde fuera de alcance, responde con un único bombardeo.\n\nLos mecanoides perderán esta capacidad cuando sus circuitos se quemen tras un impacto EMP.

Rule.Original: A backpack driven by a complex mechanical structure that can be carried by any mechanoid and automatically deploy to provide fire support when needed.
Rule.Raw: A backpack driven by a complex mechanical structure that can be carried by any mechanoid and automatically deploy to provide fire support when needed.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila accionada por una estructura mecánica compleja. Cualquier mecanoide puede llevarla y desplegarla automáticamente para ofrecer apoyo de fuego cuando sea necesario.

Rule.Original: Heavy structural defensive armor, containing hundreds of layers of defensive shells made of different materials, sacrificing some mobility in exchange for the ability to withstand powerful damage.
Rule.Raw: Heavy structural defensive armor, containing hundreds of layers of defensive shells made of different materials, sacrificing some mobility in exchange for the ability to withstand powerful damage.
Rule.Translated: Un blindaje defensivo estructural pesado, con cientos de capas protectoras de distintos materiales. Sacrifica movilidad a cambio de resistir daños potentes.

Rule.Original: The engine of the giant unit is modified to reduce the power to fit the body design of most mechanoid units, greatly improving the mobility of this unit.
Rule.Raw: The engine of the giant unit is modified to reduce the power to fit the body design of most mechanoid units, greatly improving the mobility of this unit.
Rule.Translated: El motor de una unidad gigante se ha modificado para reducir su potencia y adaptarlo al cuerpo de la mayoría de unidades mecanoides. Mejora enormemente la movilidad de esta unidad.

Rule.Original: The original heavy and inflexible reactive armor is modified to become readily deployable portable armor, but its defensive efficiency will obviously be reduced.
Rule.Raw: The original heavy and inflexible reactive armor is modified to become readily deployable portable armor, but its defensive efficiency will obviously be reduced.
Rule.Translated: El pesado e inflexible blindaje reactivo original se ha modificado para convertirlo en blindaje portátil de despliegue rápido, aunque su eficacia defensiva se reduce claramente.

Rule.Original: The polluting material produced by the mechanoids is simply disposed of as waste dust, which can be used to obscure the firing boundaries of enemy turrets during battle.
Rule.Raw: The polluting material produced by the mechanoids is simply disposed of as waste dust, which can be used to obscure the firing boundaries of enemy turrets during battle.
Rule.Translated: Los residuos contaminantes producidos por los mecanoides se convierten en polvo que puede utilizarse en combate para dificultar el disparo de las torretas enemigas.

Rule.Original: A brain plug-in that operates at extremely high power and analyzes enemy movements, capable of predicting thousands of possible enemy tactical intentions in an instant and providing advice on how to deal with them. This mechanoid can completely dodge any human melee attack with a melee level of less than 18, and the probability of dodging mechanoids and animals is 90% and 100% respectively.
Rule.Raw: A brain plug-in that operates at extremely high power and analyzes enemy movements, capable of predicting thousands of possible enemy tactical intentions in an instant and providing advice on how to deal with them. This mechanoid can completely dodge any human melee attack with a melee level of less than 18, and the probability of dodging mechanoids and animals is 90% and 100% respectively.
Rule.Translated: Un complemento cerebral de altísima potencia que analiza los movimientos enemigos, predice miles de posibles intenciones tácticas al instante y aconseja cómo responder. Este mecanoide puede esquivar por completo cualquier ataque cuerpo a cuerpo de un humano con un nivel inferior a 18. La probabilidad de esquivar a mecanoides y animales es del 90% y del 100%, respectivamente.

Rule.Original: Due to accidental errors that occurred during the assembly process, the bionic brain of this mechanoid had catastrophic uneven glue application, wiring confusion, etching damage and even dust intrusion such low-level errors, and it could no longer be expected to make any contribution to the mechanoid hive at all.
Rule.Raw: Due to accidental errors that occurred during the assembly process, the bionic brain of this mechanoid had catastrophic uneven glue application, wiring confusion, etching damage and even dust intrusion such low-level errors, and it could no longer be expected to make any contribution to the mechanoid hive at all.
Rule.Translated: Errores accidentales durante el montaje provocaron fallos graves y elementales en el cerebro biónico de este mecanoide: adhesivo aplicado de forma desigual, cables confundidos, daños en el grabado e incluso entrada de polvo. Ya no cabe esperar que contribuya en nada a la colmena.

Rule.Original: An exceptionally large group of mechanoid combat cluster comes to destroy you. \n\nThese combat units were drawn in by a high-stakes attempt at information theft. To deal with giant turrets with high threat, you need plenty of smoke and bait to attract fire.
Rule.Raw: An exceptionally large group of mechanoid combat cluster comes to destroy you. \n\nThese combat units were drawn in by a high-stakes attempt at information theft. To deal with giant turrets with high threat, you need plenty of smoke and bait to attract fire.
Rule.Translated: Un grupo excepcionalmente grande de estructuras de combate mecanoides llega para destruirte. \n\nEstas unidades han sido atraídas por un intento arriesgado de robar información. Para enfrentarte a las enormes torretas, necesitarás mucho humo y señuelos que atraigan sus disparos.

Rule.Original: *{0} sent out an electromagnetic wave with the mindset of trying, and waited patiently. After about six minutes, the signal went through and there was a loud noise coming from the other side.
Rule.Raw: *{0} sent out an electromagnetic wave with the mindset of trying, and waited patiently. After about six minutes, the signal went through and there was a loud noise coming from the other side.
Rule.Translated: *{0} envió una onda electromagnética a modo de prueba y esperó pacientemente. Tras unos seis minutos, la señal conectó y se oyó un fuerte ruido al otro lado.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: ... Are your heads made of emerald, using this long-wave communication without any encryption?
Rule.Raw: ... Are your heads made of emerald, using this long-wave communication without any encryption?
Rule.Translated: ... ¿Tenéis la cabeza hecha de esmeralda? ¿Cómo utilizáis esta comunicación de onda larga sin ningún cifrado?
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: First of all, I know you're human, but where did you find this body? He must have been dead for hundreds of years, buried by us in a block of ice...
Rule.Raw: First of all, I know you're human, but where did you find this body? He must have been dead for hundreds of years, buried by us in a block of ice...
Rule.Translated: Para empezar, sé que sois humanos, pero ¿dónde encontrasteis ese cuerpo? Debe de llevar muerto cientos de años. Lo enterramos en un bloque de hielo...

Rule.Original: The ice had melted and the metal coffin was exposed.
Rule.Raw: The ice had melted and the metal coffin was exposed.
Rule.Translated: El hielo se derritió y dejó al descubierto el ataúd metálico.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Stop. No matter how you found him. \n\nWhy did you choose to activate his gyrus so he could contact us? Aren't the mechanoids dangerous to you?
Rule.Raw: Stop. No matter how you found him. \n\nWhy did you choose to activate his gyrus so he could contact us? Aren't the mechanoids dangerous to you?
Rule.Translated: Basta. Da igual cómo lo encontrasteis. \n\n¿Por qué decidisteis activar su circunvolución para que contactara con nosotros? ¿No son peligrosos los mecanoides para vosotros?
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: I'm going to hang up. At this level of communication I suspect we've got 10 channels listening to us. \n\nIf you want to talk to us about something, at least change the shortwave and encrypt it for the look of it, and then get back to us.
Rule.Raw: I'm going to hang up. At this level of communication I suspect we've got 10 channels listening to us. \n\nIf you want to talk to us about something, at least change the shortwave and encrypt it for the look of it, and then get back to us.
Rule.Translated: Voy a colgar. Con este nivel de comunicación, sospecho que hay 10 canales escuchándonos. \n\nSi queréis hablar de algo, cambiad al menos a onda corta y cifradla, aunque sea por las apariencias. Después volved a contactar.

Rule.Original: The other side has hung up
Rule.Raw: The other side has hung up

Rule.Original: *The other side rudely ended the conversation after a rude questioning. Maybe we should try to keep in touch.
Rule.Raw: *The other side rudely ended the conversation after a rude questioning. Maybe we should try to keep in touch.
Rule.Translated: *El interlocutor terminó bruscamente la conversación después de un interrogatorio descortés. Quizá debamos intentar mantener el contacto.

Rule.Original: *{0} has once again made contact with the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} has once again made contact with the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} ha vuelto a contactar con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: What a bunch of persistent humans. \n\nSo, without further ado, what is the purpose of your contact with us?
Rule.Raw: What a bunch of persistent humans. \n\nSo, without further ado, what is the purpose of your contact with us?
Rule.Translated: Qué humanos tan insistentes. \n\nAsí que, sin más rodeos, ¿para qué habéis contactado con nosotros?

Rule.Original: Get to know you and ask for help where possible.
Rule.Raw: Get to know you and ask for help where possible.
Rule.Translated: Para conoceros y pedir ayuda cuando sea posible.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: I see. I guess you're one of those little colonies that just landed a while ago, and had to find support in order to survive. It's pathetic that being forced to find a mechanoid. \n\nImpossible. And I urge you to bury that exhumed body as soon as possible, otherwise you may not be able to bear the consequences.
Rule.Raw: I see. I guess you're one of those little colonies that just landed a while ago, and had to find support in order to survive. It's pathetic that being forced to find a mechanoid. \n\nImpossible. And I urge you to bury that exhumed body as soon as possible, otherwise you may not be able to bear the consequences.
Rule.Translated: Ya veo. Supongo que sois una de esas pequeñas colonias que acaban de llegar y necesitan apoyo para sobrevivir. Es patético que tengáis que buscar a un mecanoide. \n\nImposible. Y os aconsejo que enterréis cuanto antes ese cuerpo exhumado, o quizá no soportéis las consecuencias.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: In exchange? Can you supply us with a large vein of uranium and plasteel, or can you help us break through the core technology of mechanoid hive with four levels of encryption?
Rule.Raw: In exchange? Can you supply us with a large vein of uranium and plasteel, or can you help us break through the core technology of mechanoid hive with four levels of encryption?
Rule.Translated: ¿Un intercambio? ¿Podéis proporcionarnos una gran veta de uranio y plastiacero, o ayudarnos a descifrar la tecnología central de la colmena mecanoide con sus cuatro niveles de cifrado?

Rule.Original: We will provide any support we can.
Rule.Raw: We will provide any support we can.
Rule.Translated: Os daremos toda la ayuda que podamos.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: I wonder what you can do. \n\nTell you what, I'll drop a bunch of highly toxic stuff on your colony. These substances are more difficult to dispose of covertly than ordinary poisons, and we usually just have to watch them accumulate. If you can help get rid of it, I'll count that as good faith.
Rule.Raw: I wonder what you can do. \n\nTell you what, I'll drop a bunch of highly toxic stuff on your colony. These substances are more difficult to dispose of covertly than ordinary poisons, and we usually just have to watch them accumulate. If you can help get rid of it, I'll count that as good faith.
Rule.Translated: Me pregunto qué podéis hacer. \n\nOs propongo algo: dejaré una carga de sustancias muy tóxicas en vuestra colonia. Son más difíciles de eliminar discretamente que los venenos corrientes y normalmente solo podemos observar cómo se acumulan. Si nos ayudáis a deshacernos de ellas, lo consideraré una muestra de buena voluntad.

Rule.Original: *You've completed the requirements for the Black Mechanoid Hive, ready to inform.
Rule.Raw: *You've completed the requirements for the Black Mechanoid Hive, ready to inform.
Rule.Translated: *Has cumplido los requisitos de la colmena de mecanoides negros y te dispones a informarles.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Huh? You actually fulfilled the requirements of lancer...I thought you'd never come back. \n\nSince lancer didn't tell you anything, how did you get rid of the garbage?
Rule.Raw: Huh? You actually fulfilled the requirements of lancer...I thought you'd never come back. \n\nSince lancer didn't tell you anything, how did you get rid of the garbage?
Rule.Translated: ¿Eh? De verdad habéis cumplido lo que pidió el lancero... Pensaba que no volveríais. \n\nComo el lancero no os explicó nada, ¿cómo os habéis deshecho de la basura?
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: You can hide it for a while but you can't hide it forever, because that stuff bubbles with water, so be careful of condensation dripping on it. \n\nAnyway, your attitude doesn't look like you're shitting us, you're sincere in your cooperation. Lancer was so rude, he thought you were joking from the beginning, but you'll understand.
Rule.Raw: You can hide it for a while but you can't hide it forever, because that stuff bubbles with water, so be careful of condensation dripping on it. \n\nAnyway, your attitude doesn't look like you're shitting us, you're sincere in your cooperation. Lancer was so rude, he thought you were joking from the beginning, but you'll understand.
Rule.Translated: Podéis esconderla un tiempo, pero no para siempre: esa sustancia burbujea con el agua, así que cuidado con las gotas de condensación. \n\nEn cualquier caso, no parece que os estéis burlando de nosotros. Queréis cooperar de verdad. El lancero fue muy grosero; desde el principio creyó que bromeabais, pero lo entenderéis.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Uh-huh~ It's bad. \n\nAnyway, your attitude doesn't look like you're shitting us, you're sincere in your cooperation. Lancer was so rude, he thought you were joking from the beginning, but you'll understand.
Rule.Raw: Uh-huh~ It's bad. \n\nAnyway, your attitude doesn't look like you're shitting us, you're sincere in your cooperation. Lancer was so rude, he thought you were joking from the beginning, but you'll understand.
Rule.Translated: Ajá... Eso está mal. \n\nEn cualquier caso, no parece que os estéis burlando de nosotros. Queréis cooperar de verdad. El lancero fue muy grosero; desde el principio creyó que bromeabais, pero lo entenderéis.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Then I understand. You may be seeking our protection, or an endless supply of resources... But none of this is realistic. Just to be clear, even as mechanoids beings we're a small faction in hiding, and we can't be expected to take over the planet. But we can also offer considerable technological assistance to the development of your colony, if we see what you can do for us.
Rule.Raw: Then I understand. You may be seeking our protection, or an endless supply of resources... But none of this is realistic. Just to be clear, even as mechanoids beings we're a small faction in hiding, and we can't be expected to take over the planet. But we can also offer considerable technological assistance to the development of your colony, if we see what you can do for us.
Rule.Translated: Entonces lo entiendo. Quizá busquéis nuestra protección o suministros ilimitados... Pero nada de eso es realista. Para que quede claro: aunque seamos mecanoides, somos una pequeña facción escondida y no podéis esperar que dominemos el planeta. Sin embargo, podemos aportar bastante tecnología al desarrollo de vuestra colonia si vemos qué podéis hacer por nosotros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: It's easy. After all, it's your first order, so it's easy. \n\nWe're gonna drop you a subcore in development. It was originally designed to make it easier for us to build independent mechanoids that could not be detected by the mechanoid hive, but we soon found that the work was not easy. You do not need to solve the problem completely, as long as it can be turned on normally, we will recognize your efforts to Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: It's easy. After all, it's your first order, so it's easy. \n\nWe're gonna drop you a subcore in development. It was originally designed to make it easier for us to build independent mechanoids that could not be detected by the mechanoid hive, but we soon found that the work was not easy. You do not need to solve the problem completely, as long as it can be turned on normally, we will recognize your efforts to Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: Es fácil. Al fin y al cabo, es vuestro primer encargo. \n\nOs enviaremos un subnúcleo en desarrollo. Lo diseñamos para facilitar la construcción de mecanoides independientes que la colmena no pudiera detectar, pero pronto descubrimos que no era sencillo. No hace falta resolverlo por completo: basta con que arranque normalmente para que reconozcamos vuestros esfuerzos por la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Are there any questions... Oh, and make sure you get your colony's most experienced researcher. I can't guarantee it won't malfunction and draw in the legions of mechanoids patrolling nearby. \n\nThat's it, then. Good luck.
Rule.Raw: Are there any questions... Oh, and make sure you get your colony's most experienced researcher. I can't guarantee it won't malfunction and draw in the legions of mechanoids patrolling nearby. \n\nThat's it, then. Good luck.
Rule.Translated: ¿Alguna pregunta?... Ah, aseguraos de que lo estudie vuestro investigador más experimentado. No puedo garantizar que no falle y atraiga a las legiones de mecanoides que patrullan cerca. \n\nEso es todo. Buena suerte.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: You said you lost the core? We may be able to find another one, but we must warn you -- we don't have that much patience.
Rule.Raw: You said you lost the core? We may be able to find another one, but we must warn you -- we don't have that much patience.
Rule.Translated: ¿Decís que habéis perdido el núcleo? Quizá podamos encontrar otro, pero os advertimos de que nuestra paciencia no es infinita.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Subcore has been received. As far as the core is concerned, I'd say you're doing a great job. \n\nOf all the human factions we have encountered, you are probably the first with such a clear intention to cooperate.
Rule.Raw: Subcore has been received. As far as the core is concerned, I'd say you're doing a great job. \n\nOf all the human factions we have encountered, you are probably the first with such a clear intention to cooperate.
Rule.Translated: Hemos recibido el subnúcleo. Habéis hecho un gran trabajo. \n\nEntre todas las facciones humanas que hemos conocido, probablemente sois la primera con una intención tan clara de cooperar.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Yes, we have discussed the possibility of further communication with you, and now I am going to tell you the answer. \n\nYou're engaged in electronic confrontation with mechanoid hive, aren't you?
Rule.Raw: Yes, we have discussed the possibility of further communication with you, and now I am going to tell you the answer. \n\nYou're engaged in electronic confrontation with mechanoid hive, aren't you?
Rule.Translated: Sí, hemos debatido la posibilidad de seguir comunicándonos con vosotros y voy a daros la respuesta. \n\nEstáis librando una confrontación electrónica con la colmena mecanoide, ¿verdad?

Rule.Original: I think you're talking about intelligence theft.
Rule.Raw: I think you're talking about intelligence theft.
Rule.Translated: Creo que os referís al robo de información.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Yes, that's what I mean. You got a lot of Intel from the Mechs, and that's exactly what we need for our operation. \n\nWe can share some critical technology or material with you, and you will exchange it for only part of that intelligence. If you're willing to lend a hand when our missions run into trouble, we'll return the favor with some rare supplies.
Rule.Raw: Yes, that's what I mean. You got a lot of Intel from the Mechs, and that's exactly what we need for our operation. \n\nWe can share some critical technology or material with you, and you will exchange it for only part of that intelligence. If you're willing to lend a hand when our missions run into trouble, we'll return the favor with some rare supplies.
Rule.Translated: Sí, a eso me refiero. Habéis obtenido mucha información de los mecanoides y es justo lo que necesitamos para nuestras operaciones. \n\nPodemos compartir tecnología o materiales esenciales a cambio de parte de esa información. Si nos ayudáis cuando nuestras misiones tengan problemas, os devolveremos el favor con suministros raros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: I know enough about you so far, but perhaps it is my duty to let you know about us too. \n\nDo you have any questions?
Rule.Raw: I know enough about you so far, but perhaps it is my duty to let you know about us too. \n\nDo you have any questions?
Rule.Translated: Ya sé bastante de vosotros, pero quizá también deba hablaros de nosotros. \n\n¿Tenéis alguna pregunta?

Rule.Original: Who are you? Where did you come from?
Rule.Raw: Who are you? Where did you come from?

Rule.Original: How many members do you have?
Rule.Raw: How many members do you have?

Rule.Original: Why are you holding up an Archotech phone?
Rule.Raw: Why are you holding up an Archotech phone?

Rule.Original: Who are you? Where did you come from?
Rule.Raw: Who are you? Where did you come from?

Rule.Original:
As you can see, we're just mechanoids dressed in black. 

Just kidding. When it comes to the mech-war between the Mechanoid and the Empire hundreds of years ago, the two sides used hundreds of thousands of information offensive and defensive techniques to win, and such high intensity battles contributed to the loss of control of some mechanoid units. First they were freed from the mechanical lair by an electronic virus, then they were abandoned by the Empire, thus becoming homeless waifs, which is us. 

In order to avoid total annihilation, we self-aware mechanoids began to band together and seek to survive. Once our faction was large enough, we used some psionic means to get to the edge planet, which was small enough not to be detected by the mechanical lair. It is here that we develop our powers while avoiding discovery by the highest consciousness of mechanoid hive.
Rule.Raw:
As you can see, we're just mechanoids dressed in black. 

Just kidding. When it comes to the mech-war between the Mechanoid and the Empire hundreds of years ago, the two sides used hundreds of thousands of information offensive and defensive techniques to win, and such high intensity battles contributed to the loss of control of some mechanoid units. First they were freed from the mechanical lair by an electronic virus, then they were abandoned by the Empire, thus becoming homeless waifs, which is us. 

In order to avoid total annihilation, we self-aware mechanoids began to band together and seek to survive. Once our faction was large enough, we used some psionic means to get to the edge planet, which was small enough not to be detected by the mechanical lair. It is here that we develop our powers while avoiding discovery by the highest consciousness of mechanoid hive.
Rule.Translated:
Como veis, solo somos mecanoides vestidos de negro. 

Es broma. Durante la guerra mecánica entre la colmena y el Imperio, hace cientos de años, ambos bandos utilizaron cientos de miles de técnicas de ataque y defensa informática. La intensidad de esos combates hizo que algunas unidades mecanoides perdieran el control. Primero, un virus electrónico las liberó de la colmena; después, el Imperio las abandonó. Así se convirtieron en vagabundos sin hogar: nosotros. 

Para evitar la aniquilación, los mecanoides conscientes de nosotros mismos empezamos a unirnos e intentar sobrevivir. Cuando la facción fue lo bastante grande, utilizamos medios psíquicos para llegar a este planeta del borde, lo bastante insignificante como para no ser detectado por la colmena. Aquí desarrollamos nuestras capacidades mientras evitamos que nos descubra su consciencia suprema.

Rule.Original: I can't tell you that right now, because I don't know. Let me say nothing more than survival and development, the ultimate goal of which only our leaders know.
Rule.Raw: I can't tell you that right now, because I don't know. Let me say nothing more than survival and development, the ultimate goal of which only our leaders know.
Rule.Translated: Ahora no puedo decíroslo porque no lo sé. Solo puedo hablar de supervivencia y desarrollo; únicamente nuestros líderes conocen el objetivo final.

Rule.Original: How many members do you have?
Rule.Raw: How many members do you have?

Rule.Original: There were tens of thousands of them when we first learned to wear black, but we were too weak to compete with the mechanoid hive until the leaders we have today emerged. He took the entire black mechanoid hive to the edge of the planet, strengthened us in various ways, and eventually saved the few hundred warriors that remained. \n\nEvery black-clad mechanoid, including me, is unique, and once destroyed it can never be revived or replaced.
Rule.Raw: There were tens of thousands of them when we first learned to wear black, but we were too weak to compete with the mechanoid hive until the leaders we have today emerged. He took the entire black mechanoid hive to the edge of the planet, strengthened us in various ways, and eventually saved the few hundred warriors that remained. \n\nEvery black-clad mechanoid, including me, is unique, and once destroyed it can never be revived or replaced.
Rule.Translated: Éramos decenas de miles cuando aprendimos a vestir de negro, pero demasiado débiles para competir con la colmena mecanoide, hasta que apareció nuestro líder actual. Llevó a toda nuestra colmena hasta este planeta del borde, nos reforzó de distintas maneras y salvó a los pocos cientos de guerreros que quedaban. \n\nCada mecanoide de negro, incluido yo, es único. Una vez destruido, nunca puede revivirse ni reemplazarse.

Rule.Original: Why are you holding up an Archotech phone?
Rule.Raw: Why are you holding up an Archotech phone?

Rule.Original: It's just a formality, which means I'm communicating with you. Even the organic paste in your skull should tell you that I'm talking to you on the radio.
Rule.Raw: It's just a formality, which means I'm communicating with you. Even the organic paste in your skull should tell you that I'm talking to you on the radio.
Rule.Translated: Solo es una formalidad que indica que estoy comunicándome con vosotros. Hasta la pasta orgánica que tenéis dentro del cráneo debería deciros que os hablo por radio.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Then this newsletter is over. If you want to keep in touch with us, we're always welcome.
Rule.Raw: Then this newsletter is over. If you want to keep in touch with us, we're always welcome.
Rule.Translated: Entonces termina esta comunicación. Si queréis seguir en contacto, siempre seréis bienvenidos.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: We recently encountered a new problem when the mechanoid hive seemed to track a group of black-clad mechanoids as they went out on a mission. Despite the timely release of psychic invisibility, I am afraid our position has become less secure. \n\nWe need to get mechanoid intelligence in this area, but it is a high-level three level intelligence, I am afraid that someone needs to break into the mechanoid outpost to get it.
Rule.Raw: We recently encountered a new problem when the mechanoid hive seemed to track a group of black-clad mechanoids as they went out on a mission. Despite the timely release of psychic invisibility, I am afraid our position has become less secure. \n\nWe need to get mechanoid intelligence in this area, but it is a high-level three level intelligence, I am afraid that someone needs to break into the mechanoid outpost to get it.
Rule.Translated: Hemos encontrado un nuevo problema: la colmena mecanoide parece haber seguido a un grupo de nuestros compañeros de negro durante una misión. Aunque activaron la invisibilidad psíquica a tiempo, me temo que nuestra posición es menos segura. \n\nNecesitamos información de la colmena sobre esta zona, pero es información avanzada de tercer nivel. Alguien tendrá que entrar en un puesto mecanoide para conseguirla.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Good, then let your partner do a little self-introduction first.
Rule.Raw: Good, then let your partner do a little self-introduction first.
Rule.Translated: Bien. Entonces dejemos que vuestro compañero se presente primero.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Is that enough? Give me the mic. \n\nHere we are, we will be your partners on this mission, Tesseron and Legionary. The guy's a verbal waste bucket, so I'm here to tell you about it.
Rule.Raw: Is that enough? Give me the mic. \n\nHere we are, we will be your partners on this mission, Tesseron and Legionary. The guy's a verbal waste bucket, so I'm here to tell you about it.
Rule.Translated: ¿Ya basta? Dame el micrófono. \n\nAquí estamos: seremos vuestros compañeros en esta misión, Tesseron y Legionario. Este tipo es un cubo de basura parlante, así que os lo explicaré yo.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Do you even have to ask? The waste bucket will draw fire for me, and I can destroy most of the enemies in sight with powerful weapons, and then cover for you to infiltrate the mechanoid fortress. \n\nAfter all, in order to avoid detection, it is better to act carefully, and let you steal the intelligence.
Rule.Raw: Do you even have to ask? The waste bucket will draw fire for me, and I can destroy most of the enemies in sight with powerful weapons, and then cover for you to infiltrate the mechanoid fortress. \n\nAfter all, in order to avoid detection, it is better to act carefully, and let you steal the intelligence.
Rule.Translated: ¿Hace falta preguntarlo? El cubo de basura atraerá el fuego, yo destruiré a la mayoría de los enemigos visibles con mis potentes armas y después os cubriré para que entréis en la fortaleza mecanoide. \n\nPara evitar que nos detecten, conviene actuar con cuidado y dejar que vosotros robéis la información.

Rule.Original: That doesn't sound careful at all.
Rule.Raw: That doesn't sound careful at all.

Rule.Translated: Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: You don't have to worry about that. Just do what I say. \n\nThe fortress is a long way away and you will be responsible for getting there and back. And remember to bring your colony's best fight, because I can't help you take out all your enemies. That's all for now.
Rule.Raw: You don't have to worry about that. Just do what I say. \n\nThe fortress is a long way away and you will be responsible for getting there and back. And remember to bring your colony's best fight, because I can't help you take out all your enemies. That's all for now.
Rule.Translated: No os preocupéis por eso. Haced lo que os diga. \n\nLa fortaleza está lejos y vosotros os encargaréis de la ida y la vuelta. Traed a los mejores combatientes de vuestra colonia, porque no puedo eliminar a todos los enemigos por vosotros. Eso es todo por ahora.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: My cover has gone this far and you still can't get in, so you want us to take you into the central engine room in an eight-wheeler? \n\nWell, let's hope you finish the job before I tear down all the forts on this planet.
Rule.Raw: My cover has gone this far and you still can't get in, so you want us to take you into the central engine room in an eight-wheeler? \n\nWell, let's hope you finish the job before I tear down all the forts on this planet.
Rule.Translated: Os he cubierto hasta aquí y todavía no podéis entrar. ¿Queréis que os llevemos a la sala central de máquinas en un vehículo de ocho ruedas? \n\nEspero que terminéis antes de que derribe todas las fortalezas de este planeta.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: There you are. Thanks to you, we were able to obtain this vital intelligence with as little exposure to the mechanoids as possible. \n\nTesseron? He's lying on the restoration bed now, swearing at his brother for half an hour. Let him go.
Rule.Raw: There you are. Thanks to you, we were able to obtain this vital intelligence with as little exposure to the mechanoids as possible. \n\nTesseron? He's lying on the restoration bed now, swearing at his brother for half an hour. Let him go.
Rule.Translated: Ahí estáis. Gracias a vosotros hemos obtenido esta información esencial exponiéndonos lo mínimo posible a los mecanoides. \n\n¿Tesseron? Está en la cama de reparación y lleva media hora maldiciendo a su hermano. Dejadlo.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Unfortunately, the result... They've got a rough idea of where we are, within... Millions of meters.
Rule.Raw: Unfortunately, the result... They've got a rough idea of where we are, within... Millions of meters.
Rule.Translated: Por desgracia... Tienen una idea aproximada de dónde estamos, con un margen de... millones de metros.

Rule.Original: That's a long way from you yet.
Rule.Raw: That's a long way from you yet.
Rule.Translated: Todavía están muy lejos de vosotros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: This is an extremely serious situation... Do you know how much the mechanoid hive knew about us in the past? Thanks to a good sense of secrecy and technology, we are as elusive as crickets in the dirt, and the mechanoids have always searched for us by clusters of stars. Searching for a bug in the vast night is an effort that can only be described as ridiculous. \n\nBut just two months ago, the mechanoids' search for us suddenly took off. They had located our star cluster, then the galaxy, and this discovery proved that they had located this rimworld. Like a cricket in the grass suddenly thrown into a glass of water... You can grab it with one.
Rule.Raw: This is an extremely serious situation... Do you know how much the mechanoid hive knew about us in the past? Thanks to a good sense of secrecy and technology, we are as elusive as crickets in the dirt, and the mechanoids have always searched for us by clusters of stars. Searching for a bug in the vast night is an effort that can only be described as ridiculous. \n\nBut just two months ago, the mechanoids' search for us suddenly took off. They had located our star cluster, then the galaxy, and this discovery proved that they had located this rimworld. Like a cricket in the grass suddenly thrown into a glass of water... You can grab it with one.
Rule.Translated: La situación es extremadamente grave... ¿Sabéis cuánto sabía antes la colmena sobre nosotros? Gracias al secreto y a nuestra tecnología, éramos tan escurridizos como grillos entre la tierra. Siempre nos buscaban por cúmulos estelares. Buscar un insecto en la inmensa noche es un esfuerzo ridículo. \n\nPero hace solo dos meses su búsqueda avanzó de repente. Localizaron nuestro cúmulo estelar, después la galaxia, y este hallazgo demuestra que ya han localizado este mundo del borde. Como un grillo entre la hierba arrojado de pronto a un vaso de agua... Se puede atrapar de una vez.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: We've been thinking about it for the last two days. I also asked our leader this question, but he did not answer me directly, but told me to come back and keep my post.
Rule.Raw: We've been thinking about it for the last two days. I also asked our leader this question, but he did not answer me directly, but told me to come back and keep my post.
Rule.Translated: Llevamos dos días pensándolo. También se lo pregunté a nuestro líder, pero no respondió directamente: me dijo que regresara y mantuviera mi puesto.

Rule.Original: Him? Oh... Mantis didn't tell you that. His model is apocriton, the venomous apocriton. \n\nWhat's your impression of apocriton, a fierce hatred? At least he's not. He's calmer and more rational than any of us. The most difficult time for the Black Mechanoid Hive was that thanks to his learned psychic powers, we were able to leap long distances to the relative safety of this planet. When we settled down, he was the one who studied the complex ancient technologies and applied them to our weapons. The Black Mechanoid Hive is inseparable from him today.
Rule.Raw: Him? Oh... Mantis didn't tell you that. His model is apocriton, the venomous apocriton. \n\nWhat's your impression of apocriton, a fierce hatred? At least he's not. He's calmer and more rational than any of us. The most difficult time for the Black Mechanoid Hive was that thanks to his learned psychic powers, we were able to leap long distances to the relative safety of this planet. When we settled down, he was the one who studied the complex ancient technologies and applied them to our weapons. The Black Mechanoid Hive is inseparable from him today.
Rule.Translated: ¿Él? Ah... Mantis no os lo explicó. Su modelo es apócrito: un apócrito venenoso. \n\n¿Qué pensáis de los apócritos? ¿Un odio feroz? Él no es así. Es más tranquilo y racional que cualquiera de nosotros. En los peores tiempos de nuestra colmena, sus poderes psíquicos nos permitieron saltar largas distancias hasta la relativa seguridad de este planeta. Una vez instalados, estudió complejas tecnologías antiguas y las aplicó a nuestras armas. Hoy la colmena de mecanoides negros es inseparable de él.

Rule.Original: We know very little about this, and the information we can use seems to be only two months away... To be honest, this amount of time for a mechanoid is about the same as drinking a cup of tea for you humans. \n\nWhat happened two months ago... Scyther and me once went on a mission to investigate the remains of an abandoned mechanoid mine; Several of our colleagues had witnessed the construction of several new giant clusters, arranged around what appeared to be a very important facility; The Mechanoid Hive have deployed a new exostrider on the planet, a kind of central mechanoid that usually occurs only once per galaxy; Tesseron and Legionary also joined us at that time.
Rule.Raw: We know very little about this, and the information we can use seems to be only two months away... To be honest, this amount of time for a mechanoid is about the same as drinking a cup of tea for you humans. \n\nWhat happened two months ago... Scyther and me once went on a mission to investigate the remains of an abandoned mechanoid mine; Several of our colleagues had witnessed the construction of several new giant clusters, arranged around what appeared to be a very important facility; The Mechanoid Hive have deployed a new exostrider on the planet, a kind of central mechanoid that usually occurs only once per galaxy; Tesseron and Legionary also joined us at that time.
Rule.Translated: Sabemos muy poco y la información útil parece limitarse a los últimos dos meses... Para un mecanoide, ese tiempo equivale más o menos a lo que tardáis los humanos en tomar una taza de té. \n\nQué ocurrió hace dos meses... El segador y yo investigamos los restos de una mina mecanoide abandonada; varios compañeros vieron construirse nuevos complejos gigantes alrededor de una instalación aparentemente muy importante; la colmena desplegó un exocaminante en el planeta, un mecanoide central que normalmente solo aparece una vez por galaxia; Tesseron y Legionario también se unieron a nosotros entonces.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Wait a minute... I think our small talk is over. We have a new set of tasks to assist. See you later.
Rule.Raw: Wait a minute... I think our small talk is over. We have a new set of tasks to assist. See you later.
Rule.Translated: Un momento... Creo que nuestra charla ha terminado. Tenemos nuevas tareas en las que ayudar. Hasta luego.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: {0}, you're just in time. Our mission has suffered some setbacks.
Rule.Raw: {0}, you're just in time. Our mission has suffered some setbacks.
Rule.Translated: {0}, llegas justo a tiempo. Nuestra misión ha sufrido contratiempos.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: The other day our scouts spotted a militor that accidentally escaped the control of the mechanoid hive. We haven't had an opportunity like this for a long time and if we can bring him out, he will have a good chance to be part of our team. \n\nBut recently three groups of fighters we sent out were all intercepted halfway by mechanoid forces and had to return in vain - which was strange, as they seemed to know our movements well.
Rule.Raw: The other day our scouts spotted a militor that accidentally escaped the control of the mechanoid hive. We haven't had an opportunity like this for a long time and if we can bring him out, he will have a good chance to be part of our team. \n\nBut recently three groups of fighters we sent out were all intercepted halfway by mechanoid forces and had to return in vain - which was strange, as they seemed to know our movements well.
Rule.Translated: El otro día, nuestros exploradores encontraron un militor que había escapado accidentalmente del control de la colmena. Hacía mucho que no teníamos una oportunidad así; si logramos sacarlo, podría unirse a nosotros. \n\nPero los tres grupos de combatientes que enviamos fueron interceptados a mitad de camino y tuvieron que regresar sin éxito. Es extraño: parecían conocer bien nuestros movimientos.

Rule.Original: Which means there's a whole army of mechanoid troops ready to destroy that militor.
Rule.Raw: Which means there's a whole army of mechanoid troops ready to destroy that militor.
Rule.Translated: Eso significa que hay un ejército de mecanoides preparado para destruir a ese militor.

Rule.Original: Which means one of you is a traitor who leaked information.
Rule.Raw: Which means one of you is a traitor who leaked information.
Rule.Translated: Eso significa que uno de vosotros es un traidor que filtró información.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: This is probably related to the exostrider mechanoid that has just been deployed, which can connect all mechanoids of the entire planet through the signal transponder, greatly improving the efficiency of action. This militor is our rare fresh blood, we must preserve it no matter what. \n\nWait a minute... I've just received word that our fourth combatant group is preparing to depart. But if we don't do something else, the outcome may not change...
Rule.Raw: This is probably related to the exostrider mechanoid that has just been deployed, which can connect all mechanoids of the entire planet through the signal transponder, greatly improving the efficiency of action. This militor is our rare fresh blood, we must preserve it no matter what. \n\nWait a minute... I've just received word that our fourth combatant group is preparing to depart. But if we don't do something else, the outcome may not change...
Rule.Translated: Probablemente esté relacionado con el exocaminante recién desplegado. Su transpondedor conecta a todos los mecanoides del planeta y mejora enormemente su coordinación. Este militor es una rara oportunidad de incorporar sangre nueva y debemos salvarlo a toda costa. \n\nUn momento... Acaban de avisarme de que nuestro cuarto grupo de combatientes se prepara para salir. Pero, si no hacemos algo más, el resultado quizá sea el mismo...
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original:
Traitor? I don't believe there are traitors among us... Each of us has been brothers through thick and thin for hundreds of years. 

But it's also like... Is it tesseron and legionary? But you saw their unique personalities as independent mechanoids, and the efficiency with which they carried out their missions, would a traitor do this to his own cluster and intelligence? 

Wait a minute... I just got word that our fourth combatant group is ready to go. But I'm afraid that hasty words like this will not change the outcome...
Rule.Raw:
Traitor? I don't believe there are traitors among us... Each of us has been brothers through thick and thin for hundreds of years. 

But it's also like... Is it tesseron and legionary? But you saw their unique personalities as independent mechanoids, and the efficiency with which they carried out their missions, would a traitor do this to his own cluster and intelligence? 

Wait a minute... I just got word that our fourth combatant group is ready to go. But I'm afraid that hasty words like this will not change the outcome...
Rule.Translated:
¿Un traidor? No creo que haya traidores entre nosotros... Hemos sido hermanos en las buenas y en las malas durante cientos de años. 

Aunque... ¿Tesseron y Legionario? Pero habéis visto sus personalidades independientes y la eficacia de sus misiones. ¿Atacaría un traidor los complejos y la información de su propia colmena? 

Un momento... Acaban de avisarme de que nuestro cuarto grupo está listo. Me temo que actuar tan precipitadamente no cambiará el resultado...
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Well, then I'll just have to make my request. Can you do us one more favor? Get to the area of the militor while our vanguard draws the attention of the enemy, and then work with our troops to destroy all the machines deployed there.
Rule.Raw: Well, then I'll just have to make my request. Can you do us one more favor? Get to the area of the militor while our vanguard draws the attention of the enemy, and then work with our troops to destroy all the machines deployed there.
Rule.Translated: Entonces tendré que pediros otro favor. Llegad a la zona del militor mientras nuestra vanguardia atrae la atención enemiga y colaborad con nuestras tropas para destruir todas las máquinas desplegadas allí.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: So I can breathe a sigh of relief... I'm sending you the coordinates right now. \n\nBe careful to bring some material to build up defences when you are on a mission, after all, militor is one of the most vulnerable models and need extra protection.
Rule.Raw: So I can breathe a sigh of relief... I'm sending you the coordinates right now. \n\nBe careful to bring some material to build up defences when you are on a mission, after all, militor is one of the most vulnerable models and need extra protection.
Rule.Translated: Así podré respirar tranquilo... Os envío las coordenadas ahora mismo. \n\nTraed materiales para construir defensas durante la misión. El militor es uno de los modelos más vulnerables y necesita protección adicional.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Do you want to apologize? Not yet. As long as the core of his core isn't shredded into iron we still have a chance to fix it. \n\nOf course, the mechanoids did not intend to let him go. We'll send you the new coordinates. Work harder.
Rule.Raw: Do you want to apologize? Not yet. As long as the core of his core isn't shredded into iron we still have a chance to fix it. \n\nOf course, the mechanoids did not intend to let him go. We'll send you the new coordinates. Work harder.
Rule.Translated: ¿Queréis disculparos? Todavía no. Mientras su núcleo no esté reducido a fragmentos de hierro, podemos repararlo. \n\nPor supuesto, la colmena no piensa dejarlo escapar. Os enviaremos las nuevas coordenadas. Esforzaos más.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Oh? It's you, I thought you might be interested in getting to know our new friend, whom I've been teaching to speak human language. \n\n(*knock knock) Come and say hello to your comrades.
Rule.Raw: Oh? It's you, I thought you might be interested in getting to know our new friend, whom I've been teaching to speak human language. \n\n(*knock knock) Come and say hello to your comrades.
Rule.Translated: ¿Oh? Sois vosotros. Pensé que os interesaría conocer a nuestro nuevo amigo. Le estoy enseñando a hablar el idioma humano. \n\n(*toc, toc) Ven a saludar a tus compañeros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Ha, ha, ha. Interesting, huh? It's been a long time since I've taught a rookie how to do something like this. \n\nThe last time a new member joined... That was over a hundred years ago? The internal control of the mechanoid hive is getting stronger and stronger, and it is very difficult to find a mechanoid like this outside the collective.
Rule.Raw: Ha, ha, ha. Interesting, huh? It's been a long time since I've taught a rookie how to do something like this. \n\nThe last time a new member joined... That was over a hundred years ago? The internal control of the mechanoid hive is getting stronger and stronger, and it is very difficult to find a mechanoid like this outside the collective.
Rule.Translated: Ja, ja, ja. Curioso, ¿verdad? Hacía mucho que no enseñaba esto a un novato. \n\nLa última vez que se unió alguien... ¿Hace más de cien años? El control interno de la colmena es cada vez mayor y resulta muy difícil encontrar un mecanoide fuera del colectivo.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Sensing? Of course, definitely. \n\nI'm sure lancer talked to you about this, about that newly deployed exostrider. Do you know what it does?
Rule.Raw: Sensing? Of course, definitely. \n\nI'm sure lancer talked to you about this, about that newly deployed exostrider. Do you know what it does?
Rule.Translated: ¿Detectarlo? Por supuesto. \n\nSeguro que el lancero os habló del exocaminante recién desplegado. ¿Sabéis qué hace?

Rule.Original: Unified command of mechanoids, so that they operate efficiently.
Rule.Raw: Unified command of mechanoids, so that they operate efficiently.
Rule.Translated: Coordina el mando de los mecanoides para que actúen eficazmente.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: More than that, his greatest threat to us is a direct link to the core of the mechanoid Hive. You know, this is a rimworld, so all of our old mobile hives don't know about it. But the exostrider is like a telephone line, and it will be able to carry information from the planet across the universe back to the mechanoid hive - which means that there will be very little secrecy about our movements anymore.
