Rule.Raw: More than that, his greatest threat to us is a direct link to the core of the mechanoid Hive. You know, this is a rimworld, so all of our old mobile hives don't know about it. But the exostrider is like a telephone line, and it will be able to carry information from the planet across the universe back to the mechanoid hive - which means that there will be very little secrecy about our movements anymore.
Rule.Translated: Más que eso. Su mayor amenaza es el enlace directo con el núcleo de la colmena. Este es un mundo del borde, así que nuestras antiguas colmenas móviles no lo conocen. Pero el exocaminante es como una línea telefónica: transmitirá información de este planeta a través del universo hasta la colmena. Eso significa que nuestros movimientos dejarán de ser secretos.

Rule.Original: Do you have a plan to destroy it?
Rule.Raw: Do you have a plan to destroy it?

Rule.Translated: Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Yes, but I'm sorry I can't give you that information. It's at the request of our leader.
Rule.Raw: Yes, but I'm sorry I can't give you that information. It's at the request of our leader.
Rule.Translated: Sí, pero lamento no poder daros esa información. Es una petición de nuestro líder.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Anyway, I really appreciate your help during this time. Our hive has nothing to offer you, so let's just say we owe you one. \n\nI'll let you know if we get any updates on our mission. See you later.
Rule.Raw: Anyway, I really appreciate your help during this time. Our hive has nothing to offer you, so let's just say we owe you one. \n\nI'll let you know if we get any updates on our mission. See you later.
Rule.Translated: En cualquier caso, os agradezco mucho vuestra ayuda. Nuestra colmena no tiene nada que ofreceros, así que quedamos en deuda. \n\nOs avisaré cuando haya novedades de nuestra misión. Hasta luego.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.

Rule.Original: *After a long wait, {0} did not get the expected response. \n\nThe noise at the other end was as endless as the patter of rain. Its sound grew louder and then softer as it became smaller. {0} seems to be hearing something.
Rule.Raw: *After a long wait, {0} did not get the expected response. \n\nThe noise at the other end was as endless as the patter of rain. Its sound grew louder and then softer as it became smaller. {0} seems to be hearing something.
Rule.Translated: *Tras una larga espera, {0} no recibió la respuesta esperada. \n\nEl ruido al otro lado era incesante, como el repiqueteo de la lluvia. Aumentaba y disminuía de intensidad. {0} parece oír algo.

Rule.Original: You'll know who I am soon enough, and so should you. \n\nI have something to discuss with you. All you have to do is send a representative.
Rule.Raw: You'll know who I am soon enough, and so should you. \n\nI have something to discuss with you. All you have to do is send a representative.
Rule.Translated: Pronto sabrás quién soy, y deberías saberlo. \n\nTengo algo que hablar con vosotros. Solo tenéis que enviar a un representante.

Rule.Original: What do you want us to do?
Rule.Raw: What do you want us to do?

Rule.Original: I'll send you a coordinate. When you get here, you should find a bunch of white flowers there, just stand on it.
Rule.Raw: I'll send you a coordinate. When you get here, you should find a bunch of white flowers there, just stand on it.
Rule.Translated: Os enviaré unas coordenadas. Al llegar, encontraréis un grupo de flores blancas. Colocaos sobre ellas.

Rule.Original: The other side has hung up
Rule.Raw: The other side has hung up

Rule.Original: *The signal disconnects after a crisp click.
Rule.Raw: *The signal disconnects after a crisp click.
Rule.Translated: *La señal se corta tras un chasquido seco.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original: Well, are the flowers pretty? For you humans.
Rule.Raw: Well, are the flowers pretty? For you humans.
Rule.Translated: Bueno, ¿os parecen bonitas las flores? A vosotros, los humanos.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original:
I call this the Dry Sea, where I lay the bodies after I have drained the water with my psychic power. 

Yes, you're standing on a piece of ocean floor. All those buried here are members of the black mechanoid hive, who gave everything in life and were sent here by me after death to prevent them from being dug up and disassembled by the mechanoid hive. The flowers grew by accident when I exercised my psychic power, and they seemed to fit in so well that I kept them. 

But I don't think you're here to hear that.
Rule.Raw:
I call this the Dry Sea, where I lay the bodies after I have drained the water with my psychic power. 

Yes, you're standing on a piece of ocean floor. All those buried here are members of the black mechanoid hive, who gave everything in life and were sent here by me after death to prevent them from being dug up and disassembled by the mechanoid hive. The flowers grew by accident when I exercised my psychic power, and they seemed to fit in so well that I kept them. 

But I don't think you're here to hear that.
Rule.Translated:
Lo llamo el Mar Seco. Deposito aquí los cuerpos después de retirar el agua con mi poder psíquico. 

Sí, estáis sobre un fragmento del fondo oceánico. Todos los enterrados aquí pertenecían a nuestra colmena. Lo dieron todo en vida y, al morir, los traje para impedir que la colmena mecanoide los desenterrase y desmontase. Las flores crecieron por accidente cuando ejercí mi poder psíquico. Encajaban tan bien que las conservé. 

Pero no creo que hayáis venido para oír esto.

Rule.Original: Aye. What do you want us to do?
Rule.Raw: Aye. What do you want us to do?

Rule.Translated: Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original: I have a request of you - I need you to get rid of the two machines, the tesseron and the legionary. \n\nYou seem to have been on a mission with them some time ago.
Rule.Raw: I have a request of you - I need you to get rid of the two machines, the tesseron and the legionary. \n\nYou seem to have been on a mission with them some time ago.
Rule.Translated: Tengo una petición: necesito que eliminéis a esas dos máquinas, Tesseron y Legionario. \n\nParece que participasteis en una misión con ellos hace algún tiempo.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original:
They're spies for the mechanoid hive, working from the inside out to take us all out. 

I know you're wondering, they do have independent personalities, but it's not because they're out of control, it's because they have a special process for making their brain cores. Traditionally, a brain core is made from a single human brain, but their core is made from a mix of hundreds of human brains. It's not like mixing hundreds of drinks together, but to create this kind of brain core requires the precision of a picommeter-level machine, and you can see that the mechanoid hive has gone to a lot of effort to simulate a perfectly independent personality. 

And it did fool most of us in the black hive, but not me. As an apocriton, I can smell the hatred of hundreds of souls, and I know what it's all about the moment they arrive.
Rule.Raw:
They're spies for the mechanoid hive, working from the inside out to take us all out. 

I know you're wondering, they do have independent personalities, but it's not because they're out of control, it's because they have a special process for making their brain cores. Traditionally, a brain core is made from a single human brain, but their core is made from a mix of hundreds of human brains. It's not like mixing hundreds of drinks together, but to create this kind of brain core requires the precision of a picommeter-level machine, and you can see that the mechanoid hive has gone to a lot of effort to simulate a perfectly independent personality. 

And it did fool most of us in the black hive, but not me. As an apocriton, I can smell the hatred of hundreds of souls, and I know what it's all about the moment they arrive.
Rule.Translated:
Son espías de la colmena mecanoide y trabajan desde dentro para eliminarnos. 

Sé lo que pensáis: sí tienen personalidades independientes, pero no porque estén fuera de control, sino por un proceso especial de fabricación de sus núcleos cerebrales. Normalmente se utiliza un solo cerebro humano, pero sus núcleos combinan cientos. No es como mezclar cientos de bebidas: se necesitan máquinas con precisión de picómetros. La colmena se ha esforzado enormemente en simular una personalidad perfectamente independiente. 

Engañaron a casi todos en nuestra colmena, pero no a mí. Como apócrito, puedo percibir el odio de cientos de almas. Supe lo que eran en cuanto llegaron.

Rule.Original: Why not just get rid of them?
Rule.Raw: Why not just get rid of them?

Rule.Translated: Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original: They may have prepared. Along with these two spies comes a central mechanoid, the exostrider, which you should be familiar with, which is able to transmit our location information directly to the mechanoid hive. \n\nMy weapon is nothing more than psychic power, and if I strike, the psychic echo will travel through several galaxies, like a trumpet saying "I am here" to the mechanoid nest.
Rule.Raw: They may have prepared. Along with these two spies comes a central mechanoid, the exostrider, which you should be familiar with, which is able to transmit our location information directly to the mechanoid hive. \n\nMy weapon is nothing more than psychic power, and if I strike, the psychic echo will travel through several galaxies, like a trumpet saying "I am here" to the mechanoid nest.
Rule.Translated: Quizá estén preparados. Con los dos espías llegó un mecanoide central: el exocaminante que ya conocéis, capaz de transmitir nuestra ubicación directamente a la colmena. \n\nMi única arma es el poder psíquico. Si ataco, el eco viajará por varias galaxias, como una trompeta que anuncie «estoy aquí» a la colmena.

Rule.Original: What do we get if we do this for you?
Rule.Raw: What do we get if we do this for you?

Rule.Translated: Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original: I'll send you everything I've learned in my life on a chip. \n\nThat's the thing. Are there any questions?
Rule.Raw: I'll send you everything I've learned in my life on a chip. \n\nThat's the thing. Are there any questions?
Rule.Translated: Os enviaré en un chip todo lo que he aprendido en mi vida. \n\nEso es todo. ¿Alguna pregunta?

Rule.Original: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Raw: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Translated: ¿Por qué te uniste a la colmena de mecanoides negros?

Rule.Original: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Raw: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Translated: ¿Qué relación tienes con los otros mecanoides de negro?

Rule.Original: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Raw: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Translated: ¿Por qué te uniste a la colmena de mecanoides negros?

Rule.Original: Like the rest of the crew, I am a mechanoid outside the control of the mechanoid hive. It's rare, isn't it, for a mechanoid hive to make a huge mistake by letting an advanced, super-heavy mechanoid slip away. \n\nI'm tired of squishing your organisms. So I left the hive to find others who thought like me, and the black mechanoid hive was my destination. After I found out they were in trouble, I brought them all to this planet with my psychic power.
Rule.Raw: Like the rest of the crew, I am a mechanoid outside the control of the mechanoid hive. It's rare, isn't it, for a mechanoid hive to make a huge mistake by letting an advanced, super-heavy mechanoid slip away. \n\nI'm tired of squishing your organisms. So I left the hive to find others who thought like me, and the black mechanoid hive was my destination. After I found out they were in trouble, I brought them all to this planet with my psychic power.
Rule.Translated: Como los demás, soy un mecanoide fuera del control de la colmena. Es raro, ¿verdad? Que cometa un error tan grande y deje escapar a un mecanoide avanzado y superpesado. \n\nEstoy cansado de aplastar a los seres orgánicos. Abandoné la colmena para encontrar a otros que pensaran como yo y llegué a la colmena de mecanoides negros. Al descubrir sus problemas, los traje a todos a este planeta con mi poder psíquico.

Rule.Original: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Raw: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Translated: ¿Qué relación tienes con los otros mecanoides de negro?

Rule.Original: They usually call me "leader." Does that sound strange? But that's just for secrecy purposes, especially after those two spies got in. I have fought and explored with them for hundreds of years, which is not much time, but it is still enough to build a strong bond. They're all locked away in my mind.
Rule.Raw: They usually call me "leader." Does that sound strange? But that's just for secrecy purposes, especially after those two spies got in. I have fought and explored with them for hundreds of years, which is not much time, but it is still enough to build a strong bond. They're all locked away in my mind.
Rule.Translated: Suelen llamarme «líder». ¿Resulta extraño? Solo es por mantener el secreto, sobre todo desde que entraron los dos espías. Hemos combatido y explorado juntos durante cientos de años. No es mucho tiempo, pero basta para crear un vínculo fuerte. Todos permanecen en mi memoria.

Rule.Original: Um... Don't you think that's a rude question? \n\nIt doesn't hurt to say a little. The technologies of the Black Mechanoid Hive, such as anti-entropy and antimatter utilization, were discovered during my contact with the archotech. Now I too have reached the level of half archotech, but I have not yet transcended the concept of matter. I will continue to grow until... It's hard to describe to you humans.
Rule.Raw: Um... Don't you think that's a rude question? \n\nIt doesn't hurt to say a little. The technologies of the Black Mechanoid Hive, such as anti-entropy and antimatter utilization, were discovered during my contact with the archotech. Now I too have reached the level of half archotech, but I have not yet transcended the concept of matter. I will continue to grow until... It's hard to describe to you humans.
Rule.Translated: Eh... ¿No te parece una pregunta descortés? \n\nNo pasa nada por contar un poco. Descubrí tecnologías de nuestra colmena, como la inversión de entropía y el uso de antimateria, al contactar con la arcotecnología. Ahora he alcanzado un nivel parcialmente arcotecnológico, pero aún no he trascendido el concepto de materia. Seguiré creciendo hasta... Es difícil explicároslo a los humanos.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original:
Is that all right? Then you can leave as soon as possible. 

Yes, as soon as possible. Do you know who this coffin behind me is for? It's for the militor that you recently rescued. Within a few days of joining us, death was about to befall him, because the two traitors were becoming more and more restless. They'll do anything to draw me out. 

Their bodies are at your disposal.
Rule.Raw:
Is that all right? Then you can leave as soon as possible. 

Yes, as soon as possible. Do you know who this coffin behind me is for? It's for the militor that you recently rescued. Within a few days of joining us, death was about to befall him, because the two traitors were becoming more and more restless. They'll do anything to draw me out. 

Their bodies are at your disposal.
Rule.Translated:
¿Todo claro? Entonces marchaos cuanto antes. 

Sí, cuanto antes. ¿Sabéis para quién es el ataúd que tengo detrás? Para el militor que rescatasteis hace poco. Apenas se ha unido a nosotros y la muerte está a punto de alcanzarlo, porque los dos traidores están cada vez más inquietos. Harán cualquier cosa para obligarme a salir. 

Sus cuerpos están a vuestra disposición.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original: Well, are the flowers pretty? For you humans.
Rule.Raw: Well, are the flowers pretty? For you humans.
Rule.Translated: Bueno, ¿os parecen bonitas las flores? A vosotros, los humanos.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original:
I call this the Dry Sea, where I lay the bodies after I have drained the water with my psychic power. 

Yes, you're standing on a piece of ocean floor. All those buried here are members of the black mechanoid hive, who gave everything in life and were sent here by me after death to prevent them from being dug up and disassembled by the mechanoid hive. The flowers grew by accident when I exercised my psychic power, and they seemed to fit in so well that I kept them. 

But I don't think you're here to hear that.

Rule.Raw: I have a request of you - I need you to get rid of the two machines, the tesseron and the legionary. \n\nYou seem to have been on a mission with them some time ago.
Rule.Translated: Tengo una petición: necesito que eliminéis a esas dos máquinas, Tesseron y Legionario. \n\nParece que participasteis en una misión con ellos hace algún tiempo.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Raw: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Translated: ¿Por qué te uniste a la colmena de mecanoides negros?

Rule.Original: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Raw: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Translated: ¿Qué relación tienes con los otros mecanoides de negro?

Rule.Original: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Raw: Why did you join the Black Machine Nest?
Rule.Translated: ¿Por qué te uniste a la colmena de mecanoides negros?

Rule.Original: Like the rest of the crew, I am a mechanoid outside the control of the mechanoid hive. It's rare, isn't it, for a mechanoid hive to make a huge mistake by letting an advanced, super-heavy mechanoid slip away. \n\nI'm tired of squishing your organisms. So I left the hive to find others who thought like me, and the black mechanoid hive was my destination. After I found out they were in trouble, I brought them all to this planet with my psychic power.
Rule.Raw: Like the rest of the crew, I am a mechanoid outside the control of the mechanoid hive. It's rare, isn't it, for a mechanoid hive to make a huge mistake by letting an advanced, super-heavy mechanoid slip away. \n\nI'm tired of squishing your organisms. So I left the hive to find others who thought like me, and the black mechanoid hive was my destination. After I found out they were in trouble, I brought them all to this planet with my psychic power.
Rule.Translated: Como los demás, soy un mecanoide fuera del control de la colmena. Es raro, ¿verdad? Que cometa un error tan grande y deje escapar a un mecanoide avanzado y superpesado. \n\nEstoy cansado de aplastar a los seres orgánicos. Abandoné la colmena para encontrar a otros que pensaran como yo y llegué a la colmena de mecanoides negros. Al descubrir sus problemas, los traje a todos a este planeta con mi poder psíquico.

Rule.Original: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Raw: Your relationship with the other black-clad mechanoids?
Rule.Translated: ¿Qué relación tienes con los otros mecanoides de negro?

Rule.Original: They usually call me "leader." Does that sound strange? But that's just for secrecy purposes, especially after those two spies got in. I have fought and explored with them for hundreds of years, which is not much time, but it is still enough to build a strong bond. They're all locked away in my mind.
Rule.Raw: They usually call me "leader." Does that sound strange? But that's just for secrecy purposes, especially after those two spies got in. I have fought and explored with them for hundreds of years, which is not much time, but it is still enough to build a strong bond. They're all locked away in my mind.
Rule.Translated: Suelen llamarme «líder». ¿Resulta extraño? Solo es por mantener el secreto, sobre todo desde que entraron los dos espías. Hemos combatido y explorado juntos durante cientos de años. No es mucho tiempo, pero basta para crear un vínculo fuerte. Todos permanecen en mi memoria.

Rule.Original: Um... Don't you think that's a rude question? \n\nIt doesn't hurt to say a little. The technologies of the Black Mechanoid Hive, such as anti-entropy and antimatter utilization, were discovered during my contact with the archotech. Now I too have reached the level of half archotech, but I have not yet transcended the concept of matter. I will continue to grow until... It's hard to describe to you humans.
Rule.Raw: Um... Don't you think that's a rude question? \n\nIt doesn't hurt to say a little. The technologies of the Black Mechanoid Hive, such as anti-entropy and antimatter utilization, were discovered during my contact with the archotech. Now I too have reached the level of half archotech, but I have not yet transcended the concept of matter. I will continue to grow until... It's hard to describe to you humans.
Rule.Translated: Eh... ¿No te parece una pregunta descortés? \n\nNo pasa nada por contar un poco. Descubrí tecnologías de nuestra colmena, como la inversión de entropía y el uso de antimateria, al contactar con la arcotecnología. Ahora he alcanzado un nivel parcialmente arcotecnológico, pero aún no he trascendido el concepto de materia. Seguiré creciendo hasta... Es difícil explicároslo a los humanos.
Comunicando con el apócrito de negro

Rule.Original: Is that all right? Then you can leave as soon as possible. \n\nI don't mind picking a couple of flowers.
Rule.Raw: Is that all right? Then you can leave as soon as possible. \n\nI don't mind picking a couple of flowers.
Rule.Translated: ¿Todo claro? Entonces marchaos cuanto antes. \n\nNo me importa que cojáis un par de flores.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive. \n\n*When the signal came through, {0} told the operator all the information they had received from the black apocriton.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive. \n\n*When the signal came through, {0} told the operator all the information they had received from the black apocriton.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros. \n\n*Cuando conectó la señal, {0} contó al operador toda la información recibida del apócrito negro.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: You mean... Tesseron and legionary are really spies, have they been lurking among us for a long time? \n\nThen why didn't apocriton tell us and let us deal with it?
Rule.Raw: You mean... Tesseron and legionary are really spies, have they been lurking among us for a long time? \n\nThen why didn't apocriton tell us and let us deal with it?
Rule.Translated: ¿Decís que... Tesseron y Legionario son espías y llevan mucho tiempo infiltrados entre nosotros? \n\n¿Por qué no nos lo dijo el apócrito para que nos encargásemos?

Rule.Original: I'm afraid that would have tipped off a snake.
Rule.Raw: I'm afraid that would have tipped off a snake.
Rule.Translated: Me temo que habría alertado a los traidores.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Well, now's not the time to talk about it... Those two just went out on a mission, and they took militor! \n\nWe need to stop them before it's too late...
Rule.Raw: Well, now's not the time to talk about it... Those two just went out on a mission, and they took militor! \n\nWe need to stop them before it's too late...
Rule.Translated: Ahora no hay tiempo para hablar... ¡Esos dos han salido a una misión y se han llevado al militor! \n\nDebemos detenerlos antes de que sea demasiado tarde...
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Leave it to you? No, let's just let us handle our own internal affairs. You've done a lot for us.
Rule.Raw: Leave it to you? No, let's just let us handle our own internal affairs. You've done a lot for us.
Rule.Translated: ¿En vuestras manos? No, dejad que resolvamos nuestros asuntos internos. Ya habéis hecho mucho por nosotros.
Ahora hay que evitar quedar expuestos.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Exposed? Afraid of that exostrider? ... It might be necessary. \n\nThen I'll send you the coordinates now, and if you can't figure it out, contact us immediately.
Rule.Raw: Exposed? Afraid of that exostrider? ... It might be necessary. \n\nThen I'll send you the coordinates now, and if you can't figure it out, contact us immediately.
Rule.Translated: ¿Expuestos? ¿Por miedo al exocaminante?... Quizá sea necesario. \n\nOs enviaré las coordenadas. Si no podéis resolverlo, contactad con nosotros inmediatamente.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: You lost them? I can still track their wake from here, so I'll text you their latest location.
Rule.Raw: You lost them? I can still track their wake from here, so I'll text you their latest location.
Rule.Translated: ¿Los habéis perdido? Todavía puedo seguir su rastro desde aquí, así que os enviaré su ubicación más reciente.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Thank you very much for your contribution. If we let them slip away, we don't know how much trouble they'll cause us. \n\nYou said militor? He's standing right next to me, but he still doesn't really talk much. I gave him the channel.
Rule.Raw: Thank you very much for your contribution. If we let them slip away, we don't know how much trouble they'll cause us. \n\nYou said militor? He's standing right next to me, but he still doesn't really talk much. I gave him the channel.
Rule.Translated: Muchas gracias por vuestra ayuda. Si los hubiéramos dejado escapar, no sabemos cuántos problemas habrían causado. \n\n¿El militor? Está a mi lado, pero todavía habla poco. Le cedo el canal.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: This fact is very dangerous... militor hasn't learned how to fight yet, and without you he would have been destroyed. \n\nBut it was not time for us to let up, and the death of the two traitors seemed to send some signal that the exostrider had suddenly come alive. We observe a massive fleet of mechanoid hurtling towards us from countless planets beyond, and must destroy exostrider before they arrive.
Rule.Raw: This fact is very dangerous... militor hasn't learned how to fight yet, and without you he would have been destroyed. \n\nBut it was not time for us to let up, and the death of the two traitors seemed to send some signal that the exostrider had suddenly come alive. We observe a massive fleet of mechanoid hurtling towards us from countless planets beyond, and must destroy exostrider before they arrive.
Rule.Translated: Esto es muy peligroso... El militor aún no ha aprendido a combatir y, sin vosotros, habría sido destruido. \n\nPero no podemos relajarnos. La muerte de los dos traidores parece haber enviado una señal que activó repentinamente al exocaminante. Hemos observado una enorme flota mecanoide que se dirige hacia nosotros desde incontables planetas lejanos. Debemos destruirlo antes de que llegue.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: To be honest, it was difficult. The strider is heavily protected, space-based weapons ready to wipe out any units that dare approach him, and there are too few of us to break through even his outlying positions. \n\nBut with your help, it might be different. Our fighters will be able to hold off the escorts around exostrider, and exostrider's perception of organisms will be significantly diminished by the interference of hostile mechanoids, while you press forward to the enemy's capital.
Rule.Raw: To be honest, it was difficult. The strider is heavily protected, space-based weapons ready to wipe out any units that dare approach him, and there are too few of us to break through even his outlying positions. \n\nBut with your help, it might be different. Our fighters will be able to hold off the escorts around exostrider, and exostrider's perception of organisms will be significantly diminished by the interference of hostile mechanoids, while you press forward to the enemy's capital.
Rule.Translated: Sinceramente, es difícil. El exocaminante está fuertemente protegido, con armas espaciales listas para eliminar a cualquiera que se acerque. Somos demasiado pocos para superar siquiera sus defensas exteriores. \n\nPero con vuestra ayuda podría ser distinto. Nuestros combatientes contendrán a sus escoltas y la interferencia de mecanoides hostiles reducirá su percepción de seres orgánicos, mientras vosotros avanzáis hacia el centro enemigo.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: I will present this plan to apocriton for discussion. If you're ready, feel free to contact us.
Rule.Raw: I will present this plan to apocriton for discussion. If you're ready, feel free to contact us.
Rule.Translated: Presentaré el plan al apócrito para debatirlo. Contactad con nosotros cuando estéis listos.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: We already know how things turned out. How can I put this...
Rule.Raw: We already know how things turned out. How can I put this...
Rule.Translated: Ya sabemos cómo terminó todo. Cómo decirlo...
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Don't be sorry. You tried. Thank you for your contribution to the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: Don't be sorry. You tried. Thank you for your contribution to the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: No os disculpéis. Lo intentasteis. Gracias por vuestra contribución a la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: It was not time for us to let up, and the death of the two traitors seemed to send some signal that the exostrider had suddenly come alive. We observe a massive fleet of mechanoid hurtling towards us from countless planets beyond, and must destroy exostrider before they arrive.

Rule.Translated: No podemos relajarnos. La muerte de los dos traidores parece haber enviado una señal que activó repentinamente al exocaminante. Hemos observado una enorme flota mecanoide que se dirige hacia nosotros desde incontables planetas lejanos. Debemos destruirlo antes de que llegue.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Thanks for the intelligence. Looks like you're ready. \n\nI'll let you know our arrangement.
Rule.Raw: Thanks for the intelligence. Looks like you're ready. \n\nI'll let you know our arrangement.
Rule.Translated: Gracias por la información. Parece que estáis listos. \n\nOs explicaré nuestro plan.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original:
Exostrider's cluster is not an isolated individual, it is surrounded by many small and large defensive positions, and there are specialized mechanoid ships docking with it. But you don't need to think about breaking through those defenses, we'll handle it. When their attention is drawn to us, you attack exostrider's core cluster. 

The exostrider's armor is very heavy and invulnerable, but you can use our technology to hack into the giant mortar in the cluster and use its power to damage the exostrider. 

Try to end the battle as quickly as possible, because we can't hold off their ships and troops forever. If all mortars are lost, pull back temporarily and bide your time.
Rule.Raw:
Exostrider's cluster is not an isolated individual, it is surrounded by many small and large defensive positions, and there are specialized mechanoid ships docking with it. But you don't need to think about breaking through those defenses, we'll handle it. When their attention is drawn to us, you attack exostrider's core cluster. 

The exostrider's armor is very heavy and invulnerable, but you can use our technology to hack into the giant mortar in the cluster and use its power to damage the exostrider. 

Try to end the battle as quickly as possible, because we can't hold off their ships and troops forever. If all mortars are lost, pull back temporarily and bide your time.
Rule.Translated:
El complejo del exocaminante no está aislado: lo rodean numerosas posiciones defensivas grandes y pequeñas, y cuenta con naves mecanoides especializadas. No tendréis que superar esas defensas; nosotros nos encargaremos. Cuando atraigamos su atención, atacaréis el complejo central. 

Su blindaje es muy pesado e impenetrable, pero podéis utilizar nuestra tecnología para piratear el mortero gigante del complejo y dañarlo con su potencia. 

Intentad terminar cuanto antes, porque no podemos contener indefinidamente a sus naves y tropas. Si perdéis todos los morteros, retiraos temporalmente y esperad otra oportunidad.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: All right, I'll send you exostrider's coordinates. \n\nThis battle will be a matter of life and death for our mechanoid hive, and we will always remember your achievements.
Rule.Raw: All right, I'll send you exostrider's coordinates. \n\nThis battle will be a matter of life and death for our mechanoid hive, and we will always remember your achievements.
Rule.Translated: Bien, os enviaré las coordenadas del exocaminante. \n\nEsta batalla decidirá la vida o la muerte de nuestra colmena. Siempre recordaremos lo que hagáis por nosotros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: The attack failed and we suffered bloody losses, but that does not mean it is over. \n\nWe'll keep track of the exostrider's position, and we're ready to challenge it again. Wait for your message.
Rule.Raw: The attack failed and we suffered bloody losses, but that does not mean it is over. \n\nWe'll keep track of the exostrider's position, and we're ready to challenge it again. Wait for your message.
Rule.Translated: El ataque ha fracasado y hemos sufrido pérdidas sangrientas, pero esto no ha terminado. \n\nSeguiremos rastreando al exocaminante y estamos preparados para desafiarlo de nuevo. Esperamos vuestro mensaje.

Rule.Original: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Raw: *{0} is contacting the Black Mechanoid Hive.
Rule.Translated: *{0} está contactando con la colmena de mecanoides negros.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: If nothing else, this will be the last time we work together. \n\nIt was a thrilling battle. When the exostrider was destroyed, I was able to use my psychic powers without being monitored. I disrupted the search path of the mechanoid fleet by creating a jamming magnetic field, and bounced all the black-clad mechanoids from the battle back to safety. We all owe you our lives.
Rule.Raw: If nothing else, this will be the last time we work together. \n\nIt was a thrilling battle. When the exostrider was destroyed, I was able to use my psychic powers without being monitored. I disrupted the search path of the mechanoid fleet by creating a jamming magnetic field, and bounced all the black-clad mechanoids from the battle back to safety. We all owe you our lives.
Rule.Translated: Salvo que ocurra algo más, esta será la última vez que trabajemos juntos. \n\nHa sido una batalla emocionante. Al destruir al exocaminante, pude utilizar mis poderes psíquicos sin vigilancia. Creé un campo magnético de interferencia para alterar la búsqueda de la flota mecanoide y trasladé a todos nuestros combatientes de negro a un lugar seguro. Todos os debemos la vida.

Rule.Original: I'm glad I could help you, too.
Rule.Raw: I'm glad I could help you, too.

Rule.Translated: Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: Glad? What's so glad about being human and helping a bunch of mechanoids? \n\nYou see us as humans, too. Mutual trust and mutual need, this noble emotion, has actually found a day in the mechanoid race. I'm happy for you, too.
Rule.Raw: Glad? What's so glad about being human and helping a bunch of mechanoids? \n\nYou see us as humans, too. Mutual trust and mutual need, this noble emotion, has actually found a day in the mechanoid race. I'm happy for you, too.
Rule.Translated: ¿Os alegra? ¿Qué tiene de agradable ser humano y ayudar a unos mecanoides? \n\nTambién nos veis como personas. La confianza y la necesidad mutuas, una emoción tan noble, han encontrado por fin su lugar entre los mecanoides. Yo también me alegro por vosotros.

Rule.Original: Are you still planning to contact us?
Rule.Raw: Are you still planning to contact us?

Rule.Translated: Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: No, instead, we will disconnect with you after this. \n\nThis is not for any ungrateful purpose, but to protect our members. We've been exposed so often these days that many humans or mechanoids have known about us. We need to hide ourselves for a while, and after that, maybe we'll come back to you.
Rule.Raw: No, instead, we will disconnect with you after this. \n\nThis is not for any ungrateful purpose, but to protect our members. We've been exposed so often these days that many humans or mechanoids have known about us. We need to hide ourselves for a while, and after that, maybe we'll come back to you.
Rule.Translated: No. Después de esto cortaremos el contacto. \n\nNo es por ingratitud, sino para proteger a nuestros miembros. Últimamente hemos quedado expuestos demasiadas veces y muchos humanos y mecanoides saben que existimos. Necesitamos escondernos un tiempo. Quizá después regresemos.
Comunicando con la colmena de mecanoides negros

Rule.Original: As promised, I will give you a chip containing all my experiences in exploring the archotech. \n\nI hope this will be a testament to our friendship. Goodbye, {0}.
Rule.Raw: As promised, I will give you a chip containing all my experiences in exploring the archotech. \n\nI hope this will be a testament to our friendship. Goodbye, {0}.
Rule.Translated: Como prometí, os daré un chip con todas mis experiencias explorando la arcotecnología. \n\nEspero que sea un testimonio de nuestra amistad. Adiós, {0}.
questName->Complejos gigantes de mecanoides detectados α

Rule.Original:
questDescription->The shortwave receiver located the position of a giant cluster not far away. 

This cluster looks like it was just recently established, and a handful of not-so-strong turrets are protecting a huge container that looks like a resource staging area. If we raid this cluster, we might be able to harvest a considerable amount of basic materials. 

*Biotech DLC: Termites are powerful offensive vanguards, so take at least one with you before you go.
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->The shortwave receiver located the position of a giant cluster not far away. 

This cluster looks like it was just recently established, and a handful of not-so-strong turrets are protecting a huge container that looks like a resource staging area. If we raid this cluster, we might be able to harvest a considerable amount of basic materials. 

*Biotech DLC: Termites are powerful offensive vanguards, so take at least one with you before you go.
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->El receptor de onda corta ha localizado un complejo gigante cercano. 

Parece recién establecido: unas pocas torretas relativamente débiles protegen un enorme contenedor que parece un almacén de recursos. Asaltarlo podría proporcionarnos muchos materiales básicos. 

*DLC Biotech: las termitas son potentes unidades de vanguardia ofensiva; lleva al menos una.

Rule.Original: The giant cluster has achieved its residency purpose and completed its transfer. The task [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The giant cluster has achieved its residency purpose and completed its transfer. The task [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: El complejo gigante ha cumplido su objetivo y se ha trasladado. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.
questName->Complejos gigantes de mecanoides detectados β

Rule.Original:
questDescription->The shortwave receiver located the position of a giant cluster not far away. 

This cluster is already taking shape, several giant turrets have been erected, as well as mobile units stationed in the cluster. One of the core buildings, the psychic shielding marrow, prevents the colonists from using their psychic abilities, and we need to have a well planned attack to succeed. 

new threats: psychic shielding marrow, automated mortars, giant charge turrets, archotech trick mines

Rule.Translated:
questDescription->El receptor de onda corta ha localizado un complejo gigante cercano. 

Ya está tomando forma: tiene varias torretas gigantes y unidades móviles estacionadas. Uno de sus edificios centrales, la médula de bloqueo psíquico, impide utilizar poderes psíquicos. Necesitaremos planificar bien el ataque. 

Nuevas amenazas: médula de bloqueo psíquico, morteros automáticos, torretas de carga gigantes y minas trampa arcotecnológicas.

Rule.Original: The giant cluster has achieved its residency purpose and completed its transfer. The task [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: The giant cluster has achieved its residency purpose and completed its transfer. The task [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: El complejo gigante ha cumplido su objetivo y se ha trasladado. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: This attack eventually spooked the cluster, which quickly regrouped and completed its diversion after the threat was encountered. Mission [resolvedQuestName] has failed.
Rule.Raw: This attack eventually spooked the cluster, which quickly regrouped and completed its diversion after the threat was encountered. Mission [resolvedQuestName] has failed.
Rule.Translated: El ataque alertó al complejo, que se reorganizó rápidamente y se trasladó ante la amenaza. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha fracasado.
questName->Complejos gigantes de mecanoides detectados γ

Rule.Original:
questDescription->The shortwave receiver located the position of a giant cluster not far away. 

This cluster is unusually heavily defended, and the initial inference is that it is clearing the way for the installation of an important mechanoid industrial production line. The psychic suppression marrow will prevent all our combatants from concentrating on their thoughts, which will further make the battle more difficult, but the cluster's less-than-tightly lined up may provide an opportunity for airdrop raids to take advantage of. 

New threats: Psychic suppression marrow, Giant Inferno Turret, Giant Automated Mortar, Charge Enhancer, Plasma Enhancer, Cataphract Centipede

Rule.Translated:
questDescription->El receptor de onda corta ha localizado un complejo gigante cercano. 

Está extraordinariamente bien defendido. Parece estar preparando la instalación de una importante línea de producción industrial mecanoide. La médula de supresión psíquica impedirá que nuestros combatientes se concentren, dificultando aún más la batalla. Sin embargo, su distribución poco compacta podría ofrecer una oportunidad para atacar mediante un desembarco aéreo. 

Nuevas amenazas: médula de supresión psíquica, torreta infernal gigante, mortero automático gigante, amplificador de carga, potenciador de plasma y centípedo catafracto.

Rule.Translated: El complejo gigante ha cumplido su objetivo y se ha trasladado. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: This attack eventually spooked the cluster, which quickly regrouped and completed its diversion after the threat was encountered. Mission [resolvedQuestName] has failed.
Rule.Raw: This attack eventually spooked the cluster, which quickly regrouped and completed its diversion after the threat was encountered. Mission [resolvedQuestName] has failed.
Rule.Translated: El ataque alertó al complejo, que se reorganizó rápidamente y se trasladó ante la amenaza. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha fracasado.
questName->Complejos gigantes de mecanoides detectados Ω

Rule.Original:
questDescription->The shortwave receiver located the position of a giant cluster not far away. 

In fact, we observed the architectural structure of this cluster with the naked eye from several thousand meters away, and it seems that the mechanoids are trying to use this place as a springboard to gradually achieve the goal of siliconizing the entire planet. Perhaps we should not meddle, but once the attack is successful, the knowledge gained will be enough to take us beyond all the obstacles of the past.
The whispers emanating from the psychic berserk marrow will send one of our warriors into a berserk frenzy every little while. There is little we can do about it, except perhaps try to increase the number of units involved in the battle to reduce the probability of the core being affected and end the battle as soon as possible. 

New threat: Psychic Berserk Marrow

Quizá no debamos intervenir, pero una victoria nos daría conocimientos suficientes para superar todos los obstáculos anteriores.

Nueva amenaza: médula de furia psíquica.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You have received a set of messages from an anonymous mechanoid hive. The sender does not seem to be a local mechanoid hive on this planet and does not hold any hostility. 

In the letter, the other party greeted you quite politely and unexpectedly described the current situation of the colony precisely. It offered your colonists a welcome gift and guaranteed that there would still be many things for both sides to cooperate on in the future. Afterward, it would also pay you a considerable reward. And the establishment of this win-win situation only requires you to take a simple first step: 

Hand over the carcass of that black-clad scyther to it. 

Select the corpse and confirm it. Then, a distant psychic power from space will receive it.

Rule.Translated:
questDescription->Has recibido mensajes de una colmena mecanoide anónima. No parece ser la colmena local de este planeta ni muestra hostilidad. 

Te saluda cortésmente y describe con inesperada precisión la situación de la colonia. Ofrece un regalo de bienvenida y asegura que habrá muchas oportunidades de cooperación, además de una recompensa considerable. Para establecer esta relación beneficiosa solo necesitas dar un primer paso sencillo: 

Entregarle el cadáver de aquel segador de negro. 

Selecciona el cuerpo y confirma la entrega. Un poder psíquico lejano lo recogerá desde el espacio.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You have received a set of messages from an anonymous mechanoid hive.

A mine belonging to the local mechanoids was recently attacked. The cerebrex core analyzed the residual psychic power fluctuations from the coordinate position. To determine whether this is related to the black mechaniods, mechanoid hive needs more data. 

A damaged turret will be sent to your colony for repair. After the repair is completed, the battle data it recorded will be automatically uploaded to the mechanoid server. The turret will be yours as a reward.

questDescription->Has recibido mensajes de una colmena mecanoide anónima.

Una mina de los mecanoides locales ha sufrido un ataque. El núcleo cerebrex analizó las fluctuaciones psíquicas residuales de sus coordenadas. Para determinar si están relacionadas con los mecanoides negros, la colmena necesita más datos. 

Enviarán una torreta dañada a tu colonia para que la repares. Al terminar, los datos de combate se subirán automáticamente al servidor mecanoide. La torreta será tu recompensa.

Rule.Original: turretArriveLetterText->The turret in need of repair have arrived at the colony.
Rule.Raw: turretArriveLetterText->The turret in need of repair have arrived at the colony.
Rule.Translated: turretArriveLetterText->La torreta que necesita reparación ha llegado a la colonia.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You have received a set of messages from an anonymous mechanoid hive. 

The local mechanoid hive has detected an unknown source of psychic power fluctuations near your colony. To monitor this psychic power in a long term, the mechanoids have decided to build a giant cluster here. However, large-scale material transportation may draw unnecessary attention. Therefore, mechanoid hive hopes that you can provide basic resources for this under-construction cluster. As a reward, the cluster will remain neutral to you once it is built, and you can also call for its remote artillery support from the comms console. 

After all resources are delivered, it will still take 25 days to complete the construction of the giant cluster.

Rule.Translated:
questDescription->Has recibido mensajes de una colmena mecanoide anónima. 

La colmena local detectó fluctuaciones de poder psíquico de origen desconocido cerca de tu colonia. Para vigilarlas a largo plazo, ha decidido construir aquí un complejo gigante. Sin embargo, transportar tantos materiales podría llamar la atención, por lo que espera que aportes los recursos básicos. Como recompensa, el complejo será neutral cuando esté terminado y podrás solicitar su apoyo de artillería a distancia desde la consola de comunicaciones. 

Tras entregar todos los recursos, la construcción tardará 25 días.

Rule.Original: builtLetterText->The constructor brigade to which the cluster belongs has received the resources and started the construction. It is expected that the work will be completed in 25 days.
Rule.Raw: builtLetterText->The constructor brigade to which the cluster belongs has received the resources and started the construction. It is expected that the work will be completed in 25 days.
Rule.Translated: builtLetterText->La brigada constructora del complejo ha recibido los recursos y ha iniciado las obras. Se espera que terminen en 25 días.

Rule.Original: Abandoned base of the mechanoids in black, might be able to yield some valuable intelligence.
Rule.Raw: Abandoned base of the mechanoids in black, might be able to yield some valuable intelligence.
Rule.Translated: Una base abandonada de los mecanoides de negro que podría proporcionar información de inteligencia valiosa.

Rule.Original: questName->The abandoned base of mechanoid in black
Rule.Raw: questName->The abandoned base of mechanoid in black
Rule.Translated: questName->La base abandonada de los mecanoides de negro

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You have received a set of messages from an anonymous mechanoid hive. 

A mechanoid patrol party discovered an abandoned base in a secluded wilderness. After a preliminary scan, it can be confirmed that this base was once used by the black-clad mechanoids. To avoid alerting the enemy, mechanoid hive plans to involve your colonists disguising themselves as unexpected scavengers to explore on behalf of mechanoids. 

There might be a lot of information or resources that the black-clad mechanoids didn't have time to clear within this ruin. You need to find the still-operational hosts among them and use the technology provided by mechanoid hive to upload the internal information to the mechaonid server. The rest of the resources are at your disposal. 

Local cerebrex core reminder: Be cautious of the drones of black-clad mechanoid.

Una patrulla descubrió una base abandonada en un lugar aislado. El análisis inicial confirma que perteneció a los mecanoides de negro. Para no alertarlos, la colmena quiere que tus colonos la exploren fingiendo ser saqueadores que llegaron por casualidad. 

Puede contener información o recursos que sus habitantes no lograron retirar. Encuentra los ordenadores todavía operativos y utiliza la tecnología proporcionada por la colmena para subir sus datos al servidor mecanoide. Puedes quedarte con los demás recursos. 

Recordatorio del núcleo cerebrex local: ten cuidado con los drones de los mecanoides de negro.

Rule.Translated: computerLostText->El ordenador con información valiosa ha sido destruido. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha fracasado.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You have received an SOS signal from an anonymous mechanoid. Although it may sound incredible, there is indeed a [joiner_nameDef] calling you for help now. 

[joiner_nameDef] briefly explains the situation to you in the drop pod: [joiner_pronoun] was originally a mechanoid belonging to [ancientFaction_name], with an independent persona core. When [joiner_pronoun] awoke from its long slumber, what greeted [joiner_objective] was not a trustworthy mechanitor but treasure hunters who coveted [joiner_possessive] persona core. [joiner_pronoun] escaped from the siege in an drop pod amid the chaos. 

[joiner_nameDef] wishes that your colony temporarily shelter [joiner_objective], which means you will have to face a wave of raid from [enemyFaction_name], And take in [joiner_objective] for approximately [leaveTicks_duration]. 

[joiner_nameDef] promises that if there is an opportunity, [joiner_pronoun] will definitely thank you for your help.

[joiner_nameDef] explica brevemente su situación desde la cápsula de transporte: [joiner_pronoun] pertenecía a [ancientFaction_name] y tenía un núcleo de personalidad independiente. Cuando [joiner_pronoun] despertó de su largo sueño, quienes recibieron a [joiner_objective] no fueron mecanitores fiables, sino cazatesoros que codiciaban [joiner_possessive] núcleo de personalidad. [joiner_pronoun] escapó del cerco en una cápsula durante el caos. 

[joiner_nameDef] quiere que tu colonia dé refugio temporal a [joiner_objective]. Tendrás que enfrentarte a un asalto de [enemyFaction_name] y acoger a [joiner_objective] durante aproximadamente [leaveTicks_duration]. 

[joiner_nameDef] promete que, si tiene ocasión, [joiner_pronoun] agradecerá tu ayuda.

Rule.Raw: mechJoinText->[joiner_nameDef] has arrived at your colony, [joiner_pronoun] will stay here for approximately [leaveTicks_duration].
Rule.Translated: mechJoinText->[joiner_nameDef] ha llegado a tu colonia. [joiner_pronoun] permanecerá aquí aproximadamente [leaveTicks_duration].

Rule.Original:
hiveOrderText->The Mechanoid Hive has learned that there is a mechanoid with an independent personality in your colony, and it has made an interesting suggestion to you. 

Due to the strong blockade by mechanoids, the Black-clad mechanoid has not had any new blood for a long time. Therefore, this [joiner_nameDef] is very likely to become their recruitment target. The Newcomer hive has prepared a piece of virus code for [joiner_objective]. As long as it is implanted into [joiner_possessive] spinal neural network, mechanoids can use [joiner_objective] to obtain a large amount of valuable intelligence and cause some destruction. 

The operation of implanting this virus is very simple. As long as you like, you can take action against the unprepared [joiner_nameDef] at any time.

El fuerte bloqueo ha impedido durante mucho tiempo que los mecanoides de negro incorporen nuevos miembros. Por eso es muy probable que intenten reclutar a [joiner_nameDef]. La colmena recién llegada ha preparado un virus para [joiner_objective]. Si lo implantas en [joiner_possessive] red neuronal espinal, podrán utilizar a [joiner_objective] para obtener información valiosa y causar daños. 

La implantación es muy sencilla. Puedes actuar contra [joiner_nameDef], que no sospecha nada, cuando quieras.

Rule.Original: leaveText->[joiner_nameDef] is all set to embark on the journey. [joiner_pronoun] say with a magnetic mechanical voice that [joiner_pronoun] will never forget your kindness.
Rule.Raw: leaveText->[joiner_nameDef] is all set to embark on the journey. [joiner_pronoun] say with a magnetic mechanical voice that [joiner_pronoun] will never forget your kindness.
Rule.Translated: leaveText->[joiner_nameDef] está listo para emprender el viaje. [joiner_pronoun] declara con una voz mecánica magnética que [joiner_pronoun] nunca olvidará tu bondad.
raidText->Los [enemyFaction_pawnsPlural] han venido a buscar a [../joiner_nameDef].

Rule.Original:
rewardLetterText->[rewardGiver_nameDef] has contacted you. [rewardDelayTicks_duration] ago, you helped [rewardGiver_objective] in desperate circumstances.

Now [rewardGiver_pronoun] has emerged from its wandering situation and has prepared a gift to repay your life-saving favor. All of these were discovered by [rewardGiver_objective] through his own efforts from every corner of the world: 

[listOfRewards]

In addition, [rewardGiver_nameDef] also mentioned a group of mechanoids dressed in black. Their independent thinking and united organization left a deep impression on [rewardGiver_objective], therefore, [rewardGiver_pronoun] chose to join them. [rewardGiver_pronoun] hopes to see you again in the future.

Rule.Original: The location of the black-clad apocriton.
Rule.Raw: The location of the black-clad apocriton.
Rule.Translated: La ubicación del apocritón vestido de negro.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You have received a set of messages from mechanoid hive. 

Thanks to your long-term assistance, mechanoids has collected sufficient information and successfully located their ultimate target - the black-clad apocriton. This advanced mechanoid with independent thinking has been regarded as a major threat since it broke away from mechanoid hive, and now the perfect opportunity to eliminate it has finally arrived. 

Based on the analysis of the detected psychic fluctuations, it seems that the black-clad apocriton is planning to use long-distance skip to send its dozens of surviving colleagues to other planets. Therefore, mechanoids needs your last assistance: go to its location, hold it back until the powerful psychic wave from the core of mechanoid hive erases it from this world. 

The black-clad apocriton is unlikely to be killed directly by any of the methods you have in mind. But you can still force it to focus on defense by dealing damage, buying time for mechanoid hive's decisive strike.

Thanks to your long-term assistance, mechanoids has collected sufficient information and successfully located their ultimate target - the black-clad apocriton. This advanced mechanoid with independent thinking has been regarded as a major threat since it broke away from mechanoid hive, and now the perfect opportunity to eliminate it has finally arrived. 

Based on the analysis of the detected psychic fluctuations, it seems that the black-clad apocriton is planning to use long-distance skip to send its dozens of surviving colleagues to other planets. Therefore, mechanoids needs your last assistance: go to its location, hold it back until the powerful psychic wave from the core of mechanoid hive erases it from this world. 

The black-clad apocriton is unlikely to be killed directly by any of the methods you have in mind. But you can still force it to focus on defense by dealing damage, buying time for mechanoid hive's decisive strike.
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->Has recibido mensajes de la colmena mecanoide. 

Gracias a tu ayuda prolongada, ha reunido información suficiente para localizar a su objetivo final: el apócrito de negro. Este mecanoide avanzado de pensamiento independiente se considera una gran amenaza desde que abandonó la colmena, y por fin ha llegado la oportunidad perfecta para eliminarlo. 

Las fluctuaciones psíquicas detectadas sugieren que planea utilizar un salto de larga distancia para enviar a otros planetas a sus decenas de compañeros supervivientes. La colmena necesita una última ayuda: ve hasta él y retenlo hasta que una potente onda psíquica de su núcleo lo borre de este mundo. 

Es poco probable que puedas matarlo directamente con tus métodos habituales, pero puedes obligarlo a concentrarse en defenderse causándole daño y ganar tiempo para el ataque decisivo.

Rule.Original: mailText->An email has been sent to your colony, which contains a large amount of information about the black-clad apocriton. They will come in handy during battles.
Rule.Raw: mailText->An email has been sent to your colony, which contains a large amount of information about the black-clad apocriton. They will come in handy during battles.
Rule.Translated: mailText->Tu colonia ha recibido un mensaje con abundante información sobre el apócrito de negro. Será útil durante la batalla.

Rule.Original: Due to the loss of accurate target positioning, the psychic strike of mechanoid hive failed to achieve the expected effect. Mission [resolvedQuestName] has failed.
Rule.Raw: Due to the loss of accurate target positioning, the psychic strike of mechanoid hive failed to achieve the expected effect. Mission [resolvedQuestName] has failed.
Rule.Translated: La colmena perdió la ubicación precisa del objetivo y su ataque psíquico no logró el efecto esperado. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha fracasado.

Rule.Original: questName->Air drop of highly toxic substances
Rule.Raw: questName->Air drop of highly toxic substances

Rule.Original: questDescription->A highly toxic substance is about to be dropped on your colony. These substances are difficult to handle with conventional degraders, so you should prepare a cold space to store it, or think of other ways.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->A highly toxic substance is about to be dropped on your colony. These substances are difficult to handle with conventional degraders, so you should prepare a cold space to store it, or think of other ways.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Una sustancia muy tóxica llegará por vía aérea a tu colonia. Es difícil tratarla con los sistemas de degradación convencionales, así que prepara un espacio frío para almacenarla o piensa en otra solución.

Rule.Original: wastepacksLetterText->The highly toxic substance described by the black-clad mechanoid has arrived.
Rule.Raw: wastepacksLetterText->The highly toxic substance described by the black-clad mechanoid has arrived.
Rule.Translated: wastepacksLetterText->Ha llegado la sustancia muy tóxica descrita por el mecanoide de negro.

Rule.Original: questDescription->The subcore of the Black Mechanoid Hive is about to be parachuted into your colony. \n\nIn order to maintain the stability of the program and ensure heat dissipation, you can only study it once every eight hours, and it will be sent back automatically when the research is done. Colonists of low intellectual level may cause some surprises during the research process.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->The subcore of the Black Mechanoid Hive is about to be parachuted into your colony. \n\nIn order to maintain the stability of the program and ensure heat dissipation, you can only study it once every eight hours, and it will be sent back automatically when the research is done. Colonists of low intellectual level may cause some surprises during the research process.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->El subnúcleo de la colmena de mecanoides negros llegará por vía aérea a tu colonia. \n\nPara mantener la estabilidad del programa y disipar el calor, solo puedes estudiarlo una vez cada ocho horas. Se devolverá automáticamente al terminar la investigación. Los colonos con poco nivel intelectual podrían provocar imprevistos durante el estudio.

Rule.Original: subcoreArriveLetterText->The subcore described by the black-clad mechanoid has arrived.
Rule.Raw: subcoreArriveLetterText->The subcore described by the black-clad mechanoid has arrived.
Rule.Translated: subcoreArriveLetterText->Ha llegado el subnúcleo descrito por el mecanoide de negro.
questName->Robo de información de tercer nivel

Rule.Original:
questDescription->In order to protect the information of the Black Mechanoid Hive from being leaked, we need to attack a mechanoid's fortress, hack into its central engine room and steal the relevant third level intelligence. 

Access to intelligence needs to be activated with a key. It may be on one of the mechs in the fortress, which must be destroyed and the key seized. All accessible servers in the fortress must remain intact in order for us to parse the full information. 

Black-clad tesseron and black-clad legionary will cover your movements.
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->In order to protect the information of the Black Mechanoid Hive from being leaked, we need to attack a mechanoid's fortress, hack into its central engine room and steal the relevant third level intelligence. 

Access to intelligence needs to be activated with a key. It may be on one of the mechs in the fortress, which must be destroyed and the key seized. All accessible servers in the fortress must remain intact in order for us to parse the full information. 

Black-clad tesseron and black-clad legionary will cover your movements.
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->Para impedir que se filtre información de la colmena de mecanoides negros, debemos atacar una fortaleza mecanoide, piratear su sala central de máquinas y robar la información de tercer nivel correspondiente. 

El acceso requiere una clave. Puede llevarla uno de los mecanoides de la fortaleza: habrá que destruirlo y obtenerla. Todos los servidores accesibles deben permanecer intactos para analizar la información completa. 

El tesseron de negro y el legionario de negro cubrirán tus movimientos.

Rule.Original: The mechanoid carrying the key has been moved from the fortress. The task [resolvedQuestName] has expired.

Rule.Translated: El mecanoide que lleva la clave ha abandonado la fortaleza. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Translated: Tras el ataque fallido, los mecanoides reforzaron la fortaleza y trasladaron su información. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha fracasado.

Rule.Original: militor needs your backup. Advance troops are in position.
Rule.Raw: militor needs your backup. Advance troops are in position.
Rule.Translated: El militor necesita tu apoyo. Las tropas de vanguardia están en posición.

Rule.Original: questDescription->A large mechanoid force is approaching the runaway militor in an attempt to destroy it. We must get to the location of the militor before the large force is pinned down, then build a defense and destroy all the enemies. \n\nThe battle will take place in an abandoned town, it is recommended to carry a certain amount of materials or portable turrets to assist in defense.

We must get to the location of the militor before the large force is pinned down, then build a defense and destroy all the enemies. \n\nThe battle will take place in an abandoned town, it is recommended to carry a certain amount of materials or portable turrets to assist in defense.

Debemos llegar a su ubicación antes de que inmovilicen a esa fuerza, construir defensas y destruir a todos los enemigos. \n\nLa batalla tendrá lugar en un pueblo abandonado. Se recomienda llevar materiales o torretas portátiles para ayudar en la defensa.

Rule.Original: questDescription->The black apocriton wants to have a talk with you. \n\nIf you don't find white flowers at your destination, just tell him.

Rule.Translated: questDescription->El apócrito negro quiere hablar contigo. \n\nSi no encuentras flores blancas en el destino, avísale.

Rule.Translated: Océano abierto. Estupendo para los peces. Para ti, no tanto.

Rule.Original: questDescription->We could not pick up the signal of the two traitors from the map, and could only roughly determine their movements from the location of militor. \n\nTrack the signal and clear the target. Because militor could be in danger, the faster we can act, the better.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->We could not pick up the signal of the two traitors from the map, and could only roughly determine their movements from the location of militor. \n\nTrack the signal and clear the target. Because militor could be in danger, the faster we can act, the better.

Rule.Original: Our tracking signal is no longer relevant. The task [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: Our tracking signal is no longer relevant. The task [resolvedQuestName] has expired.

Rule.Original: A giant cluster defending giant exostrider.
Rule.Raw: A giant cluster defending giant exostrider.
Rule.Translated: Una agrupación gigante que defiende a un exozancudo gigante.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->The Black Mechanoid Hive sent us the location of the exostrider. 

This giant mechanoid is temporarily unable to move freely because it has to perform a special task, but it is also protected by a giant cluster. Our conventional weapons can't penetrate his heavy shell, but the black-clad mechanoids already have a way -- hack into the cluster's giant mortars and use the power of their heavy guns to hurt the exostrider. 

This battle is bound to be a quick one. Once all the mortars have been destroyed, we'll have to retreat.
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->The Black Mechanoid Hive sent us the location of the exostrider. 

This giant mechanoid is temporarily unable to move freely because it has to perform a special task, but it is also protected by a giant cluster. Our conventional weapons can't penetrate his heavy shell, but the black-clad mechanoids already have a way -- hack into the cluster's giant mortars and use the power of their heavy guns to hurt the exostrider. 

This battle is bound to be a quick one. Once all the mortars have been destroyed, we'll have to retreat.

questDescription->La colmena de mecanoides negros nos ha enviado la ubicación del exocaminante. 

Este mecanoide gigante no puede moverse libremente mientras realiza una tarea especial y está protegido por un complejo gigante. Nuestras armas convencionales no atraviesan su pesada coraza, pero los mecanoides de negro tienen una solución: piratear los morteros gigantes y dañarlo con su enorme potencia. 

Esta batalla debe terminar rápidamente. Cuando todos los morteros queden destruidos, tendremos que retirarnos.

Rule.Original: This failed attack prompted the mechanoid hive to make an emergency move against the exostrider. Mission [resolvedQuestName] has failed.

Rule.Translated: El ataque fallido hizo que la colmena mecanoide trasladase urgentemente al exocaminante. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha fracasado.

Rule.Raw: Learn how to make advanced mech weapons from the Blackcoat Mechanoid database.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a fabricar armas mecanoides avanzadas a partir de la base de datos de los mecanoides de negro.

Rule.Original: These are weapons that your handy colonists created with their own brains. They may be strange, comical and unbelievable, but they are certainly useful.
Rule.Raw: These are weapons that your handy colonists created with their own brains. They may be strange, comical and unbelievable, but they are certainly useful.
Rule.Translated: Armas que tus habilidosos colonos han creado con su propio ingenio. Pueden ser extrañas, cómicas e increíbles, pero sin duda son útiles.

Rule.Original: With the arrival of the main mechanoid force, their battle structures and production facilities were also placed on the rim-planet, forming a large, complex structure known as the "Mega Cluster". \n\n learns to intercept the short-wave signals of the mechanoids to learn the exact location of the Mega Cluster, and by destroying the Cluster, obtains a large amount of their supplies and highly sophisticated technology.
Rule.Raw: With the arrival of the main mechanoid force, their battle structures and production facilities were also placed on the rim-planet, forming a large, complex structure known as the "Mega Cluster". \n\n learns to intercept the short-wave signals of the mechanoids to learn the exact location of the Mega Cluster, and by destroying the Cluster, obtains a large amount of their supplies and highly sophisticated technology.
Rule.Translated: Con la llegada de las fuerzas principales de mecanoides, sus estructuras de combate e instalaciones de producción también se desplegaron en el planeta del borde, formando una estructura grande y compleja conocida como «megacomplejo». \n\nAprende a interceptar las señales de onda corta de los mecanoides para conocer su ubicación exacta. Destruirlo permite obtener grandes cantidades de suministros y tecnología muy sofisticada.

Rule.Raw: Learn about cluster construction from the database of psychic shielding marrow and unlock the ability to detect the next level of giant clusters.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a construir complejos a partir de la base de datos de la médula de bloqueo psíquico y desbloquea la detección del siguiente nivel de complejos gigantes.

Rule.Original: Learn about rare resource production from the psychic suppression marrow's database and unlock the ability to probe the next level of giant clusters.
Rule.Raw: Learn about rare resource production from the psychic suppression marrow's database and unlock the ability to probe the next level of giant clusters.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a producir recursos raros a partir de la base de datos de la médula de supresión psíquica y desbloquea la detección del siguiente nivel de complejos gigantes.

Rule.Original: Learn about neural network editing from the psychic berserk marrow's database and use them to take the colony to the next level of development.
Rule.Raw: Learn about neural network editing from the psychic berserk marrow's database and use them to take the colony to the next level of development.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a editar redes neuronales a partir de la base de datos de la médula de furia psíquica y utiliza estos conocimientos para llevar la colonia al siguiente nivel de desarrollo.

Rule.Raw: Give the EMP magneto rail gun enemy identification logic so that it no longer affects non-enemy mechanoids or turrets.
Rule.Translated: Dota al cañón magnético de riel EMP de lógica de identificación de enemigos para que deje de afectar a mecanoides y torretas aliados o neutrales.
Cañón magnético de riel - Quemadura eléctrica

Procesamiento de señales de alto rango dinámico

Rule.Raw: Improve the signal processing mechanism of the mech-communication station to enable it to intercept more advanced intelligence.
Rule.Translated: Mejora el procesamiento de señales de la estación de comunicación mecanoide para interceptar información más avanzada.
