multiplicador de recarga a distancia de construcción

Rule.Original: A multiplier on the cooldown between bursts when the turret using a ranged weapon.
Rule.Raw: A multiplier on the cooldown between bursts when the turret using a ranged weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador del tiempo de recarga entre ráfagas cuando la torreta usa un arma a distancia.

Rule.Original:
This seemingly simple communication station can help you hack into the primary servers of the mechanoid and intercept some of their intelligence. This information can be used to make deals with certain large factions, as well as for other mysterious purposes. 

Since every step of the operation leaves a data trail, this behavior is not safe. If the mechanoid hive finds out, even if the connection to the server is cut off immediately, retaliation against you will come quickly, so you should avoid continuing to hack into the network during a sensitive period. 

By the way, when it comes to data theft, the Empire has long been involved and established complete laws and regulations, and every piece of data you obtain is subject to a 10% tax. 
Unless you plan to show your hand.
Rule.Raw:
This seemingly simple communication station can help you hack into the primary servers of the mechanoid and intercept some of their intelligence. This information can be used to make deals with certain large factions, as well as for other mysterious purposes. 

Since every step of the operation leaves a data trail, this behavior is not safe. If the mechanoid hive finds out, even if the connection to the server is cut off immediately, retaliation against you will come quickly, so you should avoid continuing to hack into the network during a sensitive period. 

By the way, when it comes to data theft, the Empire has long been involved and established complete laws and regulations, and every piece of data you obtain is subject to a 10% tax. 
Unless you plan to show your hand.
Rule.Translated:
Esta estación de comunicación aparentemente sencilla te permite entrar en los servidores principales de los mecanoides e interceptar parte de su información. Puedes utilizarla para negociar con ciertas facciones importantes y para otros fines misteriosos. 

Cada paso deja un rastro de datos, así que no es una actividad segura. Si la colmena lo descubre, las represalias llegarán rápidamente aunque cortes de inmediato la conexión. Evita seguir entrando en su red durante un periodo delicado. 

Por cierto, el Imperio lleva mucho tiempo implicado en el robo de datos y ha establecido leyes y normas completas: cada dato que obtengas está sujeto a un impuesto del 10%. 
Salvo que decidas mostrar tus cartas.

Rule.Original: The blockade from the mechanoids prevents your colonists from actively researching this technology. \n Destroy the giant cluster core building in the corresponding stage to unlock this item.
Rule.Raw: The blockade from the mechanoids prevents your colonists from actively researching this technology. \n Destroy the giant cluster core building in the corresponding stage to unlock this item.
Rule.Translated: El bloqueo de los mecanoides impide que tus colonos investiguen activamente esta tecnología. \nDestruye el edificio central del complejo gigante de la fase correspondiente para desbloquearla.

Rule.Original: Servers that may contain useful information require a secret key to open.
Rule.Raw: Servers that may contain useful information require a secret key to open.
Rule.Translated: Los servidores que podrían contener información útil requieren una clave secreta para abrirlos.

Rule.Original: Servers that may contain useful information are highly encrypted.
Rule.Raw: Servers that may contain useful information are highly encrypted.
Rule.Translated: Los servidores que podrían contener información útil tienen un cifrado muy complejo.

Rule.Original: A server that may contain useful information, but is not the target of this case.
Rule.Raw: A server that may contain useful information, but is not the target of this case.
Rule.Translated: Un servidor que podría contener información útil, pero no es el objetivo de este caso.

Rule.Original: The tall tower, equipped with communication devices, houses a large number of dormant mechanoid mosquitoes inside and can be quickly deployed to the battlefield when needed.
Rule.Raw: The tall tower, equipped with communication devices, houses a large number of dormant mechanoid mosquitoes inside and can be quickly deployed to the battlefield when needed.
Rule.Translated: Una torre alta equipada con dispositivos de comunicación. Alberga numerosos mosquitos mecanoides inactivos que pueden desplegarse rápidamente cuando sea necesario.

Rule.Original: The exact location of the giant cluster is determined by intercepting specific short-wave signals emitted by the mechanoids. \n\nEach intercepted signal will cause the Mechanoid Hive to be alerted, and the receiver will need to perform a period of standby cover to avoid having the coordinates discovered.
Rule.Raw: The exact location of the giant cluster is determined by intercepting specific short-wave signals emitted by the mechanoids. \n\nEach intercepted signal will cause the Mechanoid Hive to be alerted, and the receiver will need to perform a period of standby cover to avoid having the coordinates discovered.
Rule.Translated: Determina la ubicación exacta del complejo gigante interceptando señales específicas de onda corta emitidas por los mecanoides. \n\nCada señal interceptada alertará a la colmena. El receptor deberá pasar un tiempo en espera encubierta para evitar que descubran sus coordenadas.

Rule.Original: A steel behemoth, formed by complex craftsmanship, will only appear as a guard force in a giant cluster. \n\nThis turret will fire charge bullets with a caliber close to that of a cannonball, tearing apart each offender's body. It will switch to a shotgun-like firing mode when it is approached by the enemy.
Rule.Raw: A steel behemoth, formed by complex craftsmanship, will only appear as a guard force in a giant cluster. \n\nThis turret will fire charge bullets with a caliber close to that of a cannonball, tearing apart each offender's body. It will switch to a shotgun-like firing mode when it is approached by the enemy.
Rule.Translated: Un coloso de acero de fabricación compleja que solo aparece como defensa de un complejo gigante. \n\nDispara balas de carga con un calibre cercano al de un proyectil de cañón y desgarra a cualquier intruso. Cambia a un modo de disparo similar al de una escopeta cuando el enemigo se acerca.

Rule.Original: A special charge blaster that fires large caliber charge shells.
Rule.Raw: A special charge blaster that fires large caliber charge shells.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster de carga especial que dispara proyectiles de carga de gran calibre.

Rule.Original: A steel behemoth formed by complex craftsmanship, it will only appear as a guard force in giant clusters. \n\nThis turret will fire huge inferno shells, and the liquid hellfire in it will splash in all directions after the shells explode, melting all the enemies around.
Rule.Raw: A steel behemoth formed by complex craftsmanship, it will only appear as a guard force in giant clusters. \n\nThis turret will fire huge inferno shells, and the liquid hellfire in it will splash in all directions after the shells explode, melting all the enemies around.
Rule.Translated: Un coloso de acero de fabricación compleja que solo aparece como defensa de complejos gigantes. \n\nDispara enormes proyectiles incendiarios. Al explotar, su fuego infernal líquido salpica en todas direcciones y funde a los enemigos cercanos.

Rule.Original: A special gun that fires large caliber inferno.
Rule.Raw: A special gun that fires large caliber inferno.
Rule.Translated: Un arma especial que dispara proyectiles infernales de gran calibre.

Rule.Original: A structurally sophisticated amplifier that can significantly increase the firing speed and accuracy of the surrounding giant charge blaster.
Rule.Raw: A structurally sophisticated amplifier that can significantly increase the firing speed and accuracy of the surrounding giant charge blaster.
Rule.Translated: Un amplificador de estructura sofisticada que aumenta considerablemente la cadencia de fuego y la precisión de los desintegradores de carga gigantes cercanos.

Rule.Original: A sophisticatedly structured enhancer that can significantly increase the firing speed of the surrounding giant inferno cannons.
Rule.Raw: A sophisticatedly structured enhancer that can significantly increase the firing speed of the surrounding giant inferno cannons.
Rule.Translated: Un potenciador de estructura sofisticada que aumenta considerablemente la cadencia de fuego de los cañones infernales gigantes cercanos.

Rule.Original: A small device that hovers eerily in mid-air and can only be vaguely observed when extremely close to it. The \n\n triggers will vaporize everything around it.
Rule.Raw: A small device that hovers eerily in mid-air and can only be vaguely observed when extremely close to it. The \n\n triggers will vaporize everything around it.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño dispositivo que flota de forma inquietante en el aire y apenas puede verse desde muy cerca.\n\nAl activarse, vaporiza todo lo que lo rodea.

Rule.Original: {0} has been beaten into quantum foam.
Rule.Raw: {0} has been beaten into quantum foam.
Rule.Translated: {0} ha sido reducido a espuma cuántica.

Rule.Original: A steel beast assembled by a complex process would only appear as a guard force in a giant cluster. \n\nA single cluster antigrain shell is powerful enough to cut a mountain down by several meters. It will switch to landing fire mode when it is approached by the enemy.
Rule.Raw: A steel beast assembled by a complex process would only appear as a guard force in a giant cluster. \n\nA single cluster antigrain shell is powerful enough to cut a mountain down by several meters. It will switch to landing fire mode when it is approached by the enemy.
Rule.Translated: Una bestia de acero ensamblada mediante un proceso complejo que solo aparece como defensa de un complejo gigante. \n\nUn único proyectil antigrano de racimo puede rebajar una montaña varios metros. Cambia al modo de fuego de aterrizaje cuando el enemigo se acerca.

Rule.Original: Mortars that fire cluster anti-grain shells.
Rule.Raw: Mortars that fire cluster anti-grain shells.
Rule.Translated: Morteros que disparan proyectiles de racimo antigrano.

Rule.Original: Containers containing large amounts of basic supplies for building clusters normally require a password to unlock them, but we obviously don't have to follow this rule.
Rule.Raw: Containers containing large amounts of basic supplies for building clusters normally require a password to unlock them, but we obviously don't have to follow this rule.
Rule.Translated: Contenedores con grandes cantidades de suministros básicos para construir complejos. Normalmente requieren una contraseña para abrirse, pero nosotros no tenemos por qué respetar esa regla.

Rule.Original: A huge archotech building capable of shielding the psychic network of all enemies in the region. \n\n Destroy to unlock Level 1 Cluster Technology.
Rule.Raw: A huge archotech building capable of shielding the psychic network of all enemies in the region. \n\n Destroy to unlock Level 1 Cluster Technology.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme edificio arcotecnológico capaz de bloquear la red psíquica de todos los enemigos de la región. \n\nDestrúyelo para desbloquear la tecnología de complejos de nivel 1.

Rule.Original: A huge archotech building capable of suppressing the consciousness of all enemies in the region to a lower level. \n\n Destroy to unlock Level 2 Cluster Technology.
Rule.Raw: A huge archotech building capable of suppressing the consciousness of all enemies in the region to a lower level. \n\n Destroy to unlock Level 2 Cluster Technology.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme edificio arcotecnológico capaz de reducir la consciencia de todos los enemigos de la región. \n\nDestrúyelo para desbloquear la tecnología de complejos de nivel 2.

Rule.Original: A huge archotech building capable of intermittently raging against any enemy in the region. \n\n Destroy to unlock Level 3 Cluster technology.
Rule.Raw: A huge archotech building capable of intermittently raging against any enemy in the region. \n\n Destroy to unlock Level 3 Cluster technology.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme edificio arcotecnológico capaz de provocar furia intermitente en cualquier enemigo de la región. \n\nDestrúyelo para desbloquear la tecnología de complejos de nivel 3.

Rule.Original: A steel beast assembled by a complex process would only appear as a guard force in a giant cluster. \n\nYou can order the intelligent colonists in your party to hack into the mortar and use its powerful fire to damage the giant exostrider.
Rule.Raw: A steel beast assembled by a complex process would only appear as a guard force in a giant cluster. \n\nYou can order the intelligent colonists in your party to hack into the mortar and use its powerful fire to damage the giant exostrider.
Rule.Translated: Una bestia de acero ensamblada mediante un proceso complejo que solo aparece como defensa de un complejo gigante. \n\nPuedes ordenar a los colonos inteligentes de tu grupo que pirateen el mortero y utilicen su potente fuego contra el exocaminante gigante.

Rule.Original: Mortars that fire cluster anti-grain shells.
Rule.Raw: Mortars that fire cluster anti-grain shells.
Rule.Translated: Morteros que disparan proyectiles de racimo antigrano.

Rule.Original:
A giant central mechanoid, one of the most magnificent creations of the mechaonid hive. 

Normally, the exostrider would only use its transponder to uniformly schedule the mechanoid clusters within a galaxy and exchange information directly with the mechanoid hive core. A exostrider usually has several mechanoid ships working together to facilitate information transmission and protection. In special situations, it can also use heavy artillery and industrial rapid-fire artillery combat, rapid-fire guns will automatically search for a certain range of enemy attacks, while the main gun will only be activated when forced to use against some of the most threatening targets. 

Since the exostrider acts as a "coordinate origin" when summoning the mechanoid fleet, it can't move at will, but its heavy armor also means you can't deal damage to it using normal methods.
Rule.Raw:
A giant central mechanoid, one of the most magnificent creations of the mechaonid hive. 

Normally, the exostrider would only use its transponder to uniformly schedule the mechanoid clusters within a galaxy and exchange information directly with the mechanoid hive core. A exostrider usually has several mechanoid ships working together to facilitate information transmission and protection. In special situations, it can also use heavy artillery and industrial rapid-fire artillery combat, rapid-fire guns will automatically search for a certain range of enemy attacks, while the main gun will only be activated when forced to use against some of the most threatening targets. 

Since the exostrider acts as a "coordinate origin" when summoning the mechanoid fleet, it can't move at will, but its heavy armor also means you can't deal damage to it using normal methods.
Rule.Translated:
Un mecanoide central gigante, una de las creaciones más magníficas de la colmena. 

Normalmente, el exocaminante utiliza su transpondedor para coordinar los complejos de una galaxia e intercambiar información directamente con el núcleo de la colmena. Suele contar con varias naves mecanoides que colaboran en la transmisión de información y su protección. En situaciones especiales también puede combatir con artillería pesada y cañones industriales de disparo rápido. Estos buscan automáticamente enemigos dentro de su alcance, mientras que el cañón principal solo se activa cuando resulta imprescindible contra los objetivos más peligrosos. 

Como sirve de «origen de coordenadas» al convocar a la flota mecanoide, no puede moverse libremente. Su blindaje pesado también impide dañarlo mediante métodos normales.

Rule.Original: A giant cannon mounted by a giant exostrider, whose single fire was enough to shake the whole earth. It's usually only activated when there's a major threat.
Rule.Raw: A giant cannon mounted by a giant exostrider, whose single fire was enough to shake the whole earth. It's usually only activated when there's a major threat.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón gigante instalado en un exocaminante gigante. Un único disparo basta para sacudir toda la tierra. Normalmente solo se activa ante una amenaza grave.
cañón de tiro rápido «Luz estelar del Estigia»

Rule.Original: A rapid-fire cannon equipped with a exostrider, usually used to destroy groups of heavily armored units, but had limited effectiveness against small, flexible targets.
Rule.Raw: A rapid-fire cannon equipped with a exostrider, usually used to destroy groups of heavily armored units, but had limited effectiveness against small, flexible targets.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón de disparo rápido instalado en un exocaminante. Suele destruir grupos de unidades fuertemente blindadas, pero tiene una eficacia limitada contra objetivos pequeños y ágiles.

Rule.Original: A small charge blaster designed for use on a defense turret.
Rule.Raw: A small charge blaster designed for use on a defense turret.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster de carga pequeño diseñado para una torreta defensiva.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid storage and deployment capsule. It can contain a number of mechanoids, ready to emerge and fight upon being awakened.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid storage and deployment capsule. It can contain a number of mechanoids, ready to emerge and fight upon being awakened.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula de almacenamiento y despliegue de mecanoides. Puede contener varios, listos para salir y combatir al activarse.

Rule.Original: A self-powered, fast-loading automatic mortar. Less powerful.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered, fast-loading automatic mortar. Less powerful.
Rule.Translated: Un mortero automático con energía propia y carga rápida. Menos potente.

Rule.Original: A damaged turret, in which there are some data of analytical value. After repair, it will be automatically uploaded to the mechanoid hive's server.
Rule.Raw: A damaged turret, in which there are some data of analytical value. After repair, it will be automatically uploaded to the mechanoid hive's server.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta dañada que contiene datos útiles para el análisis. Tras repararla, se subirán automáticamente al servidor de la colmena mecanoide.

Rule.Original: A turret mounted with a charge sleet gun, capable of dealing devastating damage to close-range enemies.
Rule.Raw: A turret mounted with a charge sleet gun, capable of dealing devastating damage to close-range enemies.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta con un arma de granizada de carga, capaz de causar daños devastadores a enemigos cercanos.

Rule.Original: A blaster designed to fire dense large-caliber charge projectiles at close range.
Rule.Raw: A blaster designed to fire dense large-caliber charge projectiles at close range.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster diseñado para disparar una densa lluvia de proyectiles de carga de gran calibre a corta distancia.

Rule.Original: A turret armed with charged railguns, after being accelerated by electromagnetic fields, the emit charges can penetrate several heavily armored units.
Rule.Raw: A turret armed with charged railguns, after being accelerated by electromagnetic fields, the emit charges can penetrate several heavily armored units.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta con cañones de riel de carga. Sus proyectiles, acelerados mediante campos electromagnéticos, pueden atravesar varias unidades fuertemente blindadas.

Rule.Original: A railgun designed to strike heavy units.
Rule.Raw: A railgun designed to strike heavy units.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón de riel diseñado para atacar unidades pesadas.

Rule.Original: The turret armed with an arc gun, capable of dealing chain damage to enemies within a certain range and creating EMP deterrence.
Rule.Raw: The turret armed with an arc gun, capable of dealing chain damage to enemies within a certain range and creating EMP deterrence.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta con un arma de arco eléctrico. Causa daño en cadena a enemigos dentro de cierto radio y genera una amenaza EMP.

Rule.Original: An arc gun designed to strike group units.
Rule.Raw: An arc gun designed to strike group units.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de arcos eléctricos diseñada para atacar grupos de unidades.

Rule.Original: A computer used by the black-clad mechanoid for temporary data storage and analysis, which has been physically damaged to prevent data leakage. However, with the technology of mechanoid hive, as long as some residual data or hardware fragments can be collected, useful information can be restored.
Rule.Raw: A computer used by the black-clad mechanoid for temporary data storage and analysis, which has been physically damaged to prevent data leakage. However, with the technology of mechanoid hive, as long as some residual data or hardware fragments can be collected, useful information can be restored.
Rule.Translated: Un ordenador utilizado por los mecanoides de negro para almacenar y analizar datos temporalmente. Ha sido dañado físicamente para evitar filtraciones, pero la tecnología de la colmena puede reconstruir información útil a partir de datos residuales o fragmentos de hardware.

Rule.Original: A terminal used for emergency shutdown of drone operations and can be forcibly activated through hacking. \n\nRandomly deactivate a trick mine drone that is still in operation, and there is a possibility of analyzing residual information to obtain persona data with a small probability.
Rule.Raw: A terminal used for emergency shutdown of drone operations and can be forcibly activated through hacking. \n\nRandomly deactivate a trick mine drone that is still in operation, and there is a possibility of analyzing residual information to obtain persona data with a small probability.
Rule.Translated: Un terminal para detener drones en caso de emergencia. Puede activarse por la fuerza mediante pirateo. \n\nDesactiva aleatoriamente un dron de mina trampa todavía operativo. Existe una pequeña probabilidad de analizar la información residual y obtener datos de personalidad.

Rule.Original: This item rack that has been emptied.
Rule.Raw: This item rack that has been emptied.
Rule.Translated: Una estantería de objetos que ha sido vaciada.

Rule.Original: This shelve piled with some disordered parts might be able to sort out some useful materials.
Rule.Raw: This shelve piled with some disordered parts might be able to sort out some useful materials.
Rule.Translated: Una estantería con piezas desordenadas de las que quizá puedan recuperarse materiales útiles.

Rule.Original: It seems that the black-clad mechanoids also like to use this simple and efficient storage tool. You can open it to obtain some useful materials.
Rule.Raw: It seems that the black-clad mechanoids also like to use this simple and efficient storage tool. You can open it to obtain some useful materials.
Rule.Translated: Parece que los mecanoides de negro también utilizan este sencillo y eficaz sistema de almacenamiento. Puedes abrirlo para obtener materiales útiles.

Rule.Original: It seems that the black-clad mechanoids also like to use this simple and efficient storage tool. You can open it to obtain some useful materials.
Rule.Raw: It seems that the black-clad mechanoids also like to use this simple and efficient storage tool. You can open it to obtain some useful materials.
Rule.Translated: Parece que los mecanoides de negro también utilizan este sencillo y eficaz sistema de almacenamiento. Puedes abrirlo para obtener materiales útiles.

Rule.Original: A big case that was not taken away in time for some reason, might contain precious resources.
Rule.Raw: A big case that was not taken away in time for some reason, might contain precious resources.
Rule.Translated: Una caja grande que, por algún motivo, no retiraron a tiempo. Podría contener recursos valiosos.

Rule.Original: A small case that was not taken away in time for some reason, might contain precious resources.
Rule.Raw: A small case that was not taken away in time for some reason, might contain precious resources.
Rule.Translated: Una caja pequeña que, por algún motivo, no retiraron a tiempo. Podría contener recursos valiosos.

Rule.Original: A self-powered defense turret mounted with a weak but long-ranged slug-thrower. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered defense turret mounted with a weak but long-ranged slug-thrower. May explode when damaged.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta defensiva con energía propia y un lanzador de proyectiles macizos débil, pero de largo alcance. Puede explotar al sufrir daños.

Rule.Original: A self-powered turret mounted with a charge blaster.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered turret mounted with a charge blaster.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta con energía propia y un bláster de carga montado.

Rule.Original: A self-powered turret mounted with an inferno cannon. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered turret mounted with an inferno cannon. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta con energía propia y un cañón infernal montado. No detecta objetivos a distancias muy cortas.

Rule.Original: A self-powered turret. Fire an EMP shell with a blast powerful enough to stun the most powerful mechanoid body for 40 seconds.\n\nMechanoids do not have blueprints for this turret, it was designed and built entirely by your clever colonists.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered turret. Fire an EMP shell with a blast powerful enough to stun the most powerful mechanoid body for 40 seconds.\n\nMechanoids do not have blueprints for this turret, it was designed and built entirely by your clever colonists.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta con alimentación propia. Dispara un proyectil EMP cuya explosión puede aturdir durante 40 segundos incluso al mecanoide más poderoso.\n\nLos mecanoides no tienen planos de esta torreta: tus ingeniosos colonos la diseñaron y construyeron por completo.

Rule.Original: Shoot until you run out of shell
Rule.Raw: Shoot until you run out of shell

Rule.Original: Can't shoot: need to fill plasteel
Rule.Raw: Can't shoot: need to fill plasteel

Rule.Original: A powerful magnetic rail gun that fires EMP rounds.
Rule.Raw: A powerful magnetic rail gun that fires EMP rounds.
Rule.Translated: Un potente cañón magnético de riel que dispara proyectiles EMP.

Rule.Original: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Translated: Mortero automático, autoalimentado y autocargable. Puede alcanzar objetivos a cualquier distancia y por encima de muros, aunque es bastante impreciso.

Rule.Original: A self-powered, fast-loading automatic mortar. Less powerful.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered, fast-loading automatic mortar. Less powerful.
Rule.Translated: Un mortero automático con energía propia y carga rápida. Menos potente.

Rule.Original:
A steel behemoth, formed by complex craftsmanship. The power is slightly reduced to ensure safety, and each fire consumes a certain amount of power storage. 

This turret will fire charge bullets with a caliber close to that of a cannonball, tearing apart each offender's body. It will switch to a shotgun-like firing mode when it is approached by the enemy.

*Important: The turret cannot fire when your circuit network storage is too low or there is no storage device.
Rule.Raw:
A steel behemoth, formed by complex craftsmanship. The power is slightly reduced to ensure safety, and each fire consumes a certain amount of power storage. 

This turret will fire charge bullets with a caliber close to that of a cannonball, tearing apart each offender's body. It will switch to a shotgun-like firing mode when it is approached by the enemy.

*Important: The turret cannot fire when your circuit network storage is too low or there is no storage device.
Rule.Translated:
Un coloso de acero de fabricación compleja. Su potencia se ha reducido ligeramente por seguridad y cada disparo consume parte de la energía almacenada. 

Dispara balas de carga con un calibre cercano al de un proyectil de cañón y desgarra a cualquier intruso. Cambia a un modo similar al de una escopeta cuando el enemigo se acerca.

*Importante: la torreta no puede disparar si la energía almacenada en la red es demasiado baja o no hay dispositivos de almacenamiento.

Rule.Original: A modified automatic quadruple machine gun turret, which can only fire at air units, can cause considerable effective damage to the enemy air force. It can also be used to intercept any high-angle artillery shells, but there are requirements for the firing Angle.
Rule.Raw: A modified automatic quadruple machine gun turret, which can only fire at air units, can cause considerable effective damage to the enemy air force. It can also be used to intercept any high-angle artillery shells, but there are requirements for the firing Angle.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta automática modificada de cuatro ametralladoras. Solo puede disparar contra unidades aéreas y causa daños considerables a la aviación enemiga. También puede interceptar proyectiles de artillería de trayectoria elevada, aunque existen requisitos de ángulo de disparo.

Rule.Original: A machine gun that can only fire at units in the air.
Rule.Raw: A machine gun that can only fire at units in the air.
Rule.Translated: Una ametralladora que solo puede disparar a unidades en el aire.
torreta de batería de cohetes antiaéreos

Rule.Original: An automatic quadruple rocket tower can only fire at air units, has a relatively high hit rate and a high efficiency in killing enemy groups, but is relatively weak against scattered enemies. \n\nIt can also be used to intercept any high-angle artillery shells.
Rule.Raw: An automatic quadruple rocket tower can only fire at air units, has a relatively high hit rate and a high efficiency in killing enemy groups, but is relatively weak against scattered enemies. \n\nIt can also be used to intercept any high-angle artillery shells.
Rule.Translated: Una torre automática de cuatro lanzacohetes que solo dispara contra unidades aéreas. Tiene una probabilidad de impacto relativamente alta y es eficaz contra grupos, pero más débil frente a enemigos dispersos. \n\nTambién puede interceptar proyectiles de artillería de trayectoria elevada.

Rule.Original: A rocket pod that can only be launched at units in the air.
Rule.Raw: A rocket pod that can only be launched at units in the air.
Rule.Translated: Una batería de cohetes que solo puede disparar contra unidades en el aire.

Rule.Original: A mechanoids' high-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoids' high-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo mecanoide de ángulo alto. Las balas pueden salir, pero no entrar. Su fuente de energía compacta se quema tras unos segundos de uso.

Rule.Original: A mechanoids' low-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoids' low-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo mecanoide de ángulo bajo. Las balas pueden salir, pero no entrar. Su fuente de energía compacta se quema tras unos segundos de uso.

Rule.Original: A mechanoids' high-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoids' high-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo mecanoide de ángulo alto. Las balas pueden salir, pero no entrar. Su fuente de energía compacta se quema tras unos segundos de uso.

Rule.Original: Strong and reliable walls that will repair themselves over time.
Rule.Raw: Strong and reliable walls that will repair themselves over time.
Rule.Translated: Muros fuertes y fiables que se reparan solos con el tiempo.

Rule.Original: Strong and reliable walls that will repair themselves over time.
Rule.Raw: Strong and reliable walls that will repair themselves over time.
Rule.Translated: Muros fuertes y fiables que se reparan solos con el tiempo.

Rule.Original: Precious data extracted from the bionic brain of a black-clad robot. It's hard to interpret, but the tiny amount of data that's been gathered so far has allowed the colonists to do some amazing things.\n\nColonists also found some white petals in the coat pockets of the mechanoids, but did not find their reason for carrying them in the database.
Rule.Raw: Precious data extracted from the bionic brain of a black-clad robot. It's hard to interpret, but the tiny amount of data that's been gathered so far has allowed the colonists to do some amazing things.\n\nColonists also found some white petals in the coat pockets of the mechanoids, but did not find their reason for carrying them in the database.
Rule.Translated: Datos valiosos extraídos del cerebro biónico de un robot de negro. Son difíciles de interpretar, pero la pequeña cantidad recopilada hasta ahora ha permitido a los colonos hacer cosas asombrosas.\n\nTambién encontraron pétalos blancos en los bolsillos de sus abrigos, aunque la base de datos no explicaba por qué los llevaban.

Rule.Original: Your colonists' best efforts failed to disassemble these ridiculously hard boards. Maybe they could be used in some solid buildings.
Rule.Raw: Your colonists' best efforts failed to disassemble these ridiculously hard boards. Maybe they could be used in some solid buildings.
Rule.Translated: Tus colonos no han logrado desmontar estas placas absurdamente resistentes pese a sus esfuerzos. Quizá puedan utilizarse en edificios sólidos.

Rule.Original:
Your colonists were informed of the principle of action of this shell from the massive amount of data of the black-clad lancer. 

Although they have not been able to restore the full power of this warhead, its destructive power is already enough to vaporize a hundred-meter mountain. 
It is strange that the black-clad lancer static mantis does not apply this horrific power completely to warfare - perhaps this means that after spending an unknown amount of time with the organism, he is no longer a pure war machine.
Rule.Raw:
Your colonists were informed of the principle of action of this shell from the massive amount of data of the black-clad lancer. 

Although they have not been able to restore the full power of this warhead, its destructive power is already enough to vaporize a hundred-meter mountain. 
It is strange that the black-clad lancer static mantis does not apply this horrific power completely to warfare - perhaps this means that after spending an unknown amount of time with the organism, he is no longer a pure war machine.
Rule.Translated:
Tus colonos aprendieron el funcionamiento de este proyectil gracias a los abundantes datos del lancero de negro. 

Aunque no han recuperado toda la potencia de la ojiva, su capacidad destructiva basta para vaporizar una montaña de cien metros. 
Es extraño que el lancero de negro, la mantis inmóvil, no dedique por completo este poder aterrador a la guerra. Quizá pasar un tiempo desconocido con seres orgánicos haya hecho que deje de ser una simple máquina de guerra.

Rule.Original:
Your colonists have learned from the massive data of the black-clad scyther how the projectile works. 

The stuff released by this warhead doesn't seem to be a "shockwave", but rather a fantastic way to instantly destroy the heat around it. Whether it is organic or mechanoids, it is difficult for anything to survive such an attack. 
It is strange that the black-clad scyther static mantis does not apply this horrific power completely to warfare - perhaps this means that after spending an unknown amount of time with the organism, he is no longer a pure war machine.
Rule.Raw:
Your colonists have learned from the massive data of the black-clad scyther how the projectile works. 

The stuff released by this warhead doesn't seem to be a "shockwave", but rather a fantastic way to instantly destroy the heat around it. Whether it is organic or mechanoids, it is difficult for anything to survive such an attack. 
It is strange that the black-clad scyther static mantis does not apply this horrific power completely to warfare - perhaps this means that after spending an unknown amount of time with the organism, he is no longer a pure war machine.
Rule.Translated:
Tus colonos aprendieron el funcionamiento del proyectil gracias a los abundantes datos del segador de negro. 

Lo que libera la ojiva no parece una «onda de choque», sino una forma extraordinaria de destruir instantáneamente el calor circundante. Difícilmente sobrevivirá nada, sea orgánico o mecanoide. 
Es extraño que el segador de negro, la mantis inmóvil, no dedique por completo este poder aterrador a la guerra. Quizá pasar un tiempo desconocido con seres orgánicos haya hecho que deje de ser una simple máquina de guerra.

Rule.Original: A special skill trainer that can upgrade all skills of the user by one level.
Rule.Raw: A special skill trainer that can upgrade all skills of the user by one level.
Rule.Translated: Un entrenador de habilidades especial que mejora todas las habilidades del usuario en un nivel.

Rule.Original:
The body of a scyther was gently covered with its hat and a bouquet of flowers. 

The source of this corpse is suspicious, perhaps we can check if the communication system on its body is still functioning.

You can melt it to recover a little steel.
Rule.Raw:
The body of a scyther was gently covered with its hat and a bouquet of flowers. 

The source of this corpse is suspicious, perhaps we can check if the communication system on its body is still functioning.

You can melt it to recover a little steel.
Rule.Translated:
El cuerpo de un segador ha sido cubierto cuidadosamente con su sombrero y un ramo de flores. 

Su procedencia es sospechosa. Quizá podamos comprobar si su sistema de comunicación sigue funcionando.

Puedes fundirlo para recuperar un poco de acero.

Rule.Original: The communication system activated, and we were able to contact an anonymous mechanoid, but he shut down the communication as soon as he received our first hello. Maybe we can get back in touch with them some other way. \n\nYou have found the faction "Black Mechanoid Hive" and can contact them on the mech-communication station.
Rule.Raw: The communication system activated, and we were able to contact an anonymous mechanoid, but he shut down the communication as soon as he received our first hello. Maybe we can get back in touch with them some other way. \n\nYou have found the faction "Black Mechanoid Hive" and can contact them on the mech-communication station.
Rule.Translated: El sistema de comunicación se activó y contactamos con un mecanoide anónimo, pero cortó la comunicación tras nuestro primer saludo. Quizá podamos volver a contactar de otra manera. \n\nHas descubierto la facción «Colmena de mecanoides negros» y puedes comunicarte con ella desde la estación de comunicación mecanoide.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original: Extremely unstable and highly toxic mixtures, once left the special container, will completely dissolve at a very fast rate. Getting rid of it under the radar would be a very difficult thing to do.
Rule.Raw: Extremely unstable and highly toxic mixtures, once left the special container, will completely dissolve at a very fast rate. Getting rid of it under the radar would be a very difficult thing to do.
Rule.Translated: Mezclas extremadamente inestables y muy tóxicas que se disuelven por completo y con gran rapidez al salir de su contenedor especial. Deshacerse de ellas sin llamar la atención sería muy difícil.

Rule.Original:
A subcore that's been almost completely rewritten, and somehow it can't even start up stably. We need a researcher to do the analysis. 

There may be some accidents during the research.

Note: If you are unable to return to the subcore after completing your research, you will be judged to have completed the task by violently destroying it and then retaking it.
Rule.Raw:
A subcore that's been almost completely rewritten, and somehow it can't even start up stably. We need a researcher to do the analysis. 

There may be some accidents during the research.

Note: If you are unable to return to the subcore after completing your research, you will be judged to have completed the task by violently destroying it and then retaking it.
Rule.Translated:
Un subnúcleo casi completamente reescrito que ni siquiera logra arrancar de forma estable. Necesitamos que un investigador lo analice. 

Podrían producirse accidentes durante la investigación.

Nota: si no puedes regresar al subnúcleo después de investigar, destrúyelo por la fuerza y vuelve a tomarlo para que la tarea se considere completada.

Rule.Original: The subcore has been studied, and soon it will be sent back to the black mechanoid hive in a teleport.
Rule.Raw: The subcore has been studied, and soon it will be sent back to the black mechanoid hive in a teleport.
Rule.Translated: El subnúcleo ha sido estudiado y pronto se devolverá a la colmena de mecanoides negros mediante teletransporte.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original: Secret key used to encrypt and decrypt data. Right-click activation to give you access to the server.
Rule.Raw: Secret key used to encrypt and decrypt data. Right-click activation to give you access to the server.
Rule.Translated: Clave secreta para cifrar y descifrar datos. Actívala con un clic derecho para acceder al servidor.

Rule.Original: "The hunger felt like a fire burning through flesh and blood. I raised my eyes and saw the orange light of the house, which seemed to be the color of hunger." \n\n"The people of the glitterworld have not experienced hunger for a long time, and they take it for granted. I just hope they don't forget where such a life comes from."
Rule.Raw: "The hunger felt like a fire burning through flesh and blood. I raised my eyes and saw the orange light of the house, which seemed to be the color of hunger." \n\n"The people of the glitterworld have not experienced hunger for a long time, and they take it for granted. I just hope they don't forget where such a life comes from."
Rule.Translated: «El hambre era como un fuego que consumía carne y sangre. Alcé la mirada y vi la luz naranja de la casa, que parecía tener el color del hambre». \n\n«Los habitantes de los mundos brillantes llevan mucho tiempo sin pasar hambre y lo dan por hecho. Solo espero que no olviden de dónde viene esa vida».
lanza de carga de alta energía

Rule.Original: A charge lance loaded with special ammunition, powerful enough to destroy space ships.
Rule.Raw: A charge lance loaded with special ammunition, powerful enough to destroy space ships.
Rule.Translated: Una lanza de carga con munición especial, lo bastante potente para destruir naves espaciales.

Rule.Original: Legionary in black is equipped with this weapon that uses its rapid rate of fire to gain an advantage in close combat.
Rule.Raw: Legionary in black is equipped with this weapon that uses its rapid rate of fire to gain an advantage in close combat.
Rule.Translated: El legionario de negro lleva esta arma, cuya alta cadencia de tiro le da ventaja en el combate cercano.

Rule.Original: A giant charge blaster equipped with a mono-sword. You don't want to face it head on.
Rule.Raw: A giant charge blaster equipped with a mono-sword. You don't want to face it head on.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster de carga gigante equipado con una monoespada. No querrás enfrentarte a él de frente.

Rule.Original: A giant inferno launcher used by a jumbo unit. The shells dropped were enough to smash a small fort.
Rule.Raw: A giant inferno launcher used by a jumbo unit. The shells dropped were enough to smash a small fort.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzador infernal gigante usado por una unidad enorme. Sus proyectiles bastan para destrozar un pequeño fuerte.

Rule.Original: It was used for cutting parts in the manufacture of precision instruments, until the mechanoid hive found it useful for cutting organisms as well.
Rule.Raw: It was used for cutting parts in the manufacture of precision instruments, until the mechanoid hive found it useful for cutting organisms as well.
Rule.Translated: Se utilizaba para cortar piezas al fabricar instrumentos de precisión, hasta que la colmena mecanoide descubrió que también servía para cortar seres orgánicos.

Rule.Original: Modified charge lance. Slightly sacrificed power for speed of fire.
Rule.Raw: Modified charge lance. Slightly sacrificed power for speed of fire.
Rule.Translated: Una lanza de carga modificada. Sacrifica algo de potencia para ganar cadencia de tiro.

Rule.Original: The secret weapon of the mechanical Hive, previously used to destroy heavily armored empire soldiers, the Star Guardian. \n\n can shoot through walls, but the range is very limited and the damage does not cause brain burn. Keep your distance from the mantis that carry it.
Rule.Raw: The secret weapon of the mechanical Hive, previously used to destroy heavily armored empire soldiers, the Star Guardian. \n\n can shoot through walls, but the range is very limited and the damage does not cause brain burn. Keep your distance from the mantis that carry it.
Rule.Translated: El arma secreta de la colmena mecanoide, utilizada anteriormente para destruir a los soldados imperiales fuertemente blindados de la Guardia Estelar. \n\nPuede disparar a través de paredes, pero su alcance es muy limitado y no provoca quemaduras cerebrales. Mantén la distancia con las mantis que la llevan.
Aceleradores de carga para luciérnagas mecánicas.

Rule.Original: Large caliber machine gun with overwhelming firepower. Be glad you don't have to be in charge of this centipede's logistics in rimworld.
Rule.Raw: Large caliber machine gun with overwhelming firepower. Be glad you don't have to be in charge of this centipede's logistics in rimworld.
Rule.Translated: Una ametralladora de gran calibre con una potencia de fuego abrumadora. Alégrate de no tener que encargarte de la logística de este centípedo en RimWorld.

Rule.Original: A small charge blaster designed for use on a defense turret.
Rule.Raw: A small charge blaster designed for use on a defense turret.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster de carga pequeño diseñado para una torreta defensiva.

Rule.Original: Your colonists have accessed the black mechanoids' database to harness the power of antimatter annihilation, but how the black lancer manage this power remains a mystery. \n\n The rifle is capable of firing powerful antimatter rounds, but is somewhat weakened for safety reasons.
Rule.Raw: Your colonists have accessed the black mechanoids' database to harness the power of antimatter annihilation, but how the black lancer manage this power remains a mystery. \n\n The rifle is capable of firing powerful antimatter rounds, but is somewhat weakened for safety reasons.
Rule.Translated: Tus colonos han accedido a la base de datos de los mecanoides negros para aprovechar la aniquilación de antimateria, aunque sigue siendo un misterio cómo controlan este poder los lanceros negros. \n\nEl fusil dispara potentes proyectiles de antimateria, pero su potencia se ha reducido por seguridad.

Rule.Original: Your colonists read from the black mechanoids' database a way to destroy heat out of thin air, but how the black scyther achieve their anti-entropy is still a mystery. \n\n This fatal ceremonial sword can cause cold bite and EMP shock to enemies.
Rule.Raw: Your colonists read from the black mechanoids' database a way to destroy heat out of thin air, but how the black scyther achieve their anti-entropy is still a mystery. \n\n This fatal ceremonial sword can cause cold bite and EMP shock to enemies.
Rule.Translated: Tus colonos han aprendido en la base de datos de los mecanoides negros a destruir calor de la nada, aunque sigue siendo un misterio cómo consiguen los segadores negros invertir la entropía. \n\nEsta espada ceremonial mortal causa congelación y descargas EMP a los enemigos.

Rule.Original: The process is simple and inexpensive, and although it is not very reliable it does not prevent it from being a good choice for soldiers during offensive battles. The high temperature generated by \n\nCan also damage the power core of some heavy armor units with relative ease.
Rule.Raw: The process is simple and inexpensive, and although it is not very reliable it does not prevent it from being a good choice for soldiers during offensive battles. The high temperature generated by \n\nCan also damage the power core of some heavy armor units with relative ease.
Rule.Translated: Su fabricación es sencilla y barata. Aunque no es muy fiable, sigue siendo una buena opción para los soldados en batallas ofensivas. El calor que genera\n\ntambién puede dañar con relativa facilidad el núcleo de energía de algunas unidades de blindaje pesado.

Rule.Original: A lightweight and reliable anti-Mech weapon capable of projecting EMP grenades at a considerable distance, effectively combining the advantages of an EMP grenade with an EMP launcher.
Rule.Raw: A lightweight and reliable anti-Mech weapon capable of projecting EMP grenades at a considerable distance, effectively combining the advantages of an EMP grenade with an EMP launcher.
Rule.Translated: Un arma antimécanoides ligera y fiable que lanza granadas EMP a una distancia considerable, combinando eficazmente las ventajas de una granada EMP y un lanzador EMP.

Rule.Original: A replica of the psychic grenade derived from the knowledge of the marine lancer. The explosion of the shock wave can disturb the enemy's psychic nerves, making them dizzy, vomiting, and in severe cases may fall or even die.\n\nDoes not damage friendly or neutral units.
Rule.Raw: A replica of the psychic grenade derived from the knowledge of the marine lancer. The explosion of the shock wave can disturb the enemy's psychic nerves, making them dizzy, vomiting, and in severe cases may fall or even die.\n\nDoes not damage friendly or neutral units.
Rule.Translated: Una réplica de la granada psíquica basada en los conocimientos del lancero naval. Su onda expansiva altera los nervios psíquicos del enemigo y provoca mareos y vómitos; en casos graves puede causar desmayos o incluso la muerte.\n\nNo daña a unidades aliadas ni neutrales.

Rule.Original: Your colonists have read from the black mechanoids' database how to use many types of weapons efficiently. \n\nThis shotgun is capable of firing a dense array of bullets simultaneously, including charge, inferno, high-explosive, and EMP. Beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: Your colonists have read from the black mechanoids' database how to use many types of weapons efficiently. \n\nThis shotgun is capable of firing a dense array of bullets simultaneously, including charge, inferno, high-explosive, and EMP. Beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Tus colonos han aprendido en la base de datos de los mecanoides negros a utilizar eficazmente muchos tipos de armas. \n\nEsta escopeta dispara simultáneamente una densa lluvia de balas de carga, incendiarias, de alto explosivo y EMP. Ten cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: Your colonists have read from the black mechanoids' database how to flexibly use electric current. \n\nThis arc thrower can cause chain burns to a small area of enemies and generate EMP impacts. Because it is equipped with an automatic voltage regulation system, it will not pose a threat to nearby friendly forces.
Rule.Raw: Your colonists have read from the black mechanoids' database how to flexibly use electric current. \n\nThis arc thrower can cause chain burns to a small area of enemies and generate EMP impacts. Because it is equipped with an automatic voltage regulation system, it will not pose a threat to nearby friendly forces.
Rule.Translated: Tus colonos han aprendido en la base de datos de los mecanoides negros a utilizar la corriente eléctrica con flexibilidad. \n\nEste lanzador de arcos causa quemaduras en cadena a enemigos de una zona pequeña y produce impactos EMP. Su sistema automático de regulación de voltaje evita que amenace a los aliados cercanos.

Rule.Original: You often see the black-clad apocriton lost in thought alone. The universe is so vast and profound. The more you know about it, the more frightened you become in your heart. \n\nEnemies that receive an electric shock will simultaneously generate several lightning arrows nearby.
Rule.Raw: You often see the black-clad apocriton lost in thought alone. The universe is so vast and profound. The more you know about it, the more frightened you become in your heart. \n\nEnemies that receive an electric shock will simultaneously generate several lightning arrows nearby.
Rule.Translated: A menudo ves al apócrito de negro reflexionando a solas. El universo es inmenso y profundo. Cuanto más sabes de él, más miedo sientes en tu interior. \n\nLos enemigos que reciban una descarga eléctrica generarán simultáneamente varias flechas de rayos a su alrededor.

Rule.Original: The faint petals illuminate the way to come.
Rule.Raw: The faint petals illuminate the way to come.
Rule.Translated: Los tenues pétalos iluminan el camino que está por venir.

Rule.Original: The petals of the peace lily. It is white and beautiful, but its use is limited because of its special physical properties. \n\nWhen you touch the petal with your hand, it turns into a transparent, smooth oily liquid that adheres to your finger and changes back into its original shape when you stop. But when squeezed, the petals are irreversibly transformed into a pool of sake-like liquid that occasionally glint in a dazzling spot of light.
Rule.Raw: The petals of the peace lily. It is white and beautiful, but its use is limited because of its special physical properties. \n\nWhen you touch the petal with your hand, it turns into a transparent, smooth oily liquid that adheres to your finger and changes back into its original shape when you stop. But when squeezed, the petals are irreversibly transformed into a pool of sake-like liquid that occasionally glint in a dazzling spot of light.
Rule.Translated: Pétalos de lirio de la paz, blancos y hermosos, pero de uso limitado por sus propiedades físicas especiales. \n\nAl tocarlos, se convierten en un líquido aceitoso transparente y suave que se adhiere al dedo. Recuperan su forma original al dejar de tocarlos. Sin embargo, al aplastarlos se transforman irreversiblemente en un líquido parecido al sake que, de vez en cuando, emite destellos deslumbrantes.

Rule.Original: Replicas of archotech trick mine after being reverse-analyzed by the black-clad mechanoids, responsible for replacing their combatants to carry out regular defense and patrol tasks. \n\nIn the patrol state, this drone will randomly teleport at a certain frequency. When a moving target is detected, it will enter an alert state. Keeping still can relieve its alertness. After determining the target, it will quickly approach and self-destruct.
Rule.Raw: Replicas of archotech trick mine after being reverse-analyzed by the black-clad mechanoids, responsible for replacing their combatants to carry out regular defense and patrol tasks. \n\nIn the patrol state, this drone will randomly teleport at a certain frequency. When a moving target is detected, it will enter an alert state. Keeping still can relieve its alertness. After determining the target, it will quickly approach and self-destruct.
Rule.Translated: Réplicas de minas trampa arcotecnológicas obtenidas mediante ingeniería inversa por los mecanoides de negro. Sustituyen a sus combatientes en las tareas habituales de defensa y patrulla. \n\nAl patrullar, este dron se teletransporta aleatoriamente a cierta frecuencia. Entra en alerta al detectar un objetivo en movimiento; quedarse quieto puede reducir su alerta. Cuando identifica el objetivo, se acerca rápidamente y se autodestruye.

Rule.Original: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nDesigned based on the prototype of the cataphracts, The cross section is as big as a human head, the single-molecule bayonet sharp enough to cut mountains, and the armor is completely impossible to penetrate, making the cataphract centipede an unprecedented super war machine. Although conceptually uneconomical, the hulking behemoth was more than adequate against empire soldiers.
Rule.Raw: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nDesigned based on the prototype of the cataphracts, The cross section is as big as a human head, the single-molecule bayonet sharp enough to cut mountains, and the armor is completely impossible to penetrate, making the cataphract centipede an unprecedented super war machine. Although conceptually uneconomical, the hulking behemoth was more than adequate against empire soldiers.
Rule.Translated: Durante la larga guerra, no solo los humanos aprendieron de los mecanoides: los mecanoides también aprendieron de los humanos.\n\nDiseñado a partir del modelo de los catafractos, combina una sección transversal del tamaño de una cabeza humana, una bayoneta monomolecular capaz de cortar montañas y un blindaje imposible de penetrar. El centípedo catafracto es una supermáquina de guerra sin precedentes. Aunque su concepto no es económico, este enorme coloso resulta más que adecuado contra los soldados imperiales.

Rule.Original: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nModelled on the Empire Royal Navy, the lancers are equipped with shield belts and a more advanced targeting system. Some lancers may also carry psychic weapons.
Rule.Raw: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nModelled on the Empire Royal Navy, the lancers are equipped with shield belts and a more advanced targeting system. Some lancers may also carry psychic weapons.
Rule.Translated: Durante la larga guerra, no solo los humanos aprendieron de los mecanoides: los mecanoides también aprendieron de los humanos.\n\nInspirados en la Armada Real del Imperio, estos lanceros llevan cinturones de escudo y un sistema de puntería más avanzado. Algunos también pueden llevar armas psíquicas.

Rule.Original: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nModeled after the Empire Recons, the scythers offer reduced weight in exchange for greater mobility, with specially designed jumping packs that allow them to move quickly toward their victims.
Rule.Raw: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nModeled after the Empire Recons, the scythers offer reduced weight in exchange for greater mobility, with specially designed jumping packs that allow them to move quickly toward their victims.
Rule.Translated: Durante la larga guerra, no solo los humanos aprendieron de los mecanoides: los mecanoides también aprendieron de los humanos.\n\nInspirados en los exploradores imperiales, estos segadores reducen su peso para ganar movilidad. Sus mochilas de salto especialmente diseñadas les permiten acercarse rápidamente a sus víctimas.

Rule.Original: The prototype was a large cloaking device used by mechanoid warships, which was adapted to become the firefly.\n\nIt can make contact with and render invisible surrounding mechanoids in a special psychic network that isolates organisms.
Rule.Raw: The prototype was a large cloaking device used by mechanoid warships, which was adapted to become the firefly.\n\nIt can make contact with and render invisible surrounding mechanoids in a special psychic network that isolates organisms.
Rule.Translated: Su prototipo era un gran dispositivo de camuflaje utilizado por naves de guerra mecanoides, adaptado para convertirse en el Firefly.\n\nPuede conectar con los mecanoides cercanos y volverlos invisibles mediante una red psíquica especial que excluye a los seres orgánicos.

Rule.Original: A light and compact mechanoid, designed to maneuver at extremely high speeds in the air and strike targets, the combined charge lance on board can cause terrifying damage to ground targets. These troublesome mechs often go out in groups, ruthlessly seizing air superiority for the mechanoid hive. \n\nThere was once a version of mosquito that had mono blades installed on both sides of its body to chop up enemies during dives, but they were replaced due to their impact on mobility.
Rule.Raw: A light and compact mechanoid, designed to maneuver at extremely high speeds in the air and strike targets, the combined charge lance on board can cause terrifying damage to ground targets. These troublesome mechs often go out in groups, ruthlessly seizing air superiority for the mechanoid hive. \n\nThere was once a version of mosquito that had mono blades installed on both sides of its body to chop up enemies during dives, but they were replaced due to their impact on mobility.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide ligero y compacto diseñado para maniobrar por el aire a gran velocidad y atacar objetivos. Su lanza de carga integrada causa daños aterradores a objetivos terrestres. Estos molestos mecanoides suelen actuar en grupos y conquistar sin piedad la superioridad aérea para la colmena. \n\nExistió una versión del mosquito con filos monomoleculares a ambos lados para despedazar enemigos en picado, pero se sustituyó por su efecto negativo en la movilidad.

Rule.Original:
During the long hacking campaign between the mechanoid hive and the Empire, some mech AI were breached by empire hackers. They are separated from the core, and have since been regarded as harmful by mechanoid hive. However, after losing their usefulness, these AI were soon abandoned by the Empire and eventually became "homeless" mechanoids. Hunted by black and White, they are forced to learn to think independently of the Hive database, while gathering together to protect each other and learn survival lessons from the organisms they once hated.
In the process of learning from humans, they also wear black like the man in Black and carry white flowers with them to offer to their former mechanoid companions when they bury them. Logically this behavior is completely incomprehensible, but it is true.

His two scythes are as sharp as mono-swords and contain nanomechanics that can cause frostbite to organisms. After being severely damaged beyond repair, he would detonate himself and unleash a cryogenic shockwave as his last stand.
Rule.Raw:
During the long hacking campaign between the mechanoid hive and the Empire, some mech AI were breached by empire hackers. They are separated from the core, and have since been regarded as harmful by mechanoid hive. However, after losing their usefulness, these AI were soon abandoned by the Empire and eventually became "homeless" mechanoids. Hunted by black and White, they are forced to learn to think independently of the Hive database, while gathering together to protect each other and learn survival lessons from the organisms they once hated.
In the process of learning from humans, they also wear black like the man in Black and carry white flowers with them to offer to their former mechanoid companions when they bury them. Logically this behavior is completely incomprehensible, but it is true.

His two scythes are as sharp as mono-swords and contain nanomechanics that can cause frostbite to organisms. After being severely damaged beyond repair, he would detonate himself and unleash a cryogenic shockwave as his last stand.
Rule.Translated:
Durante la prolongada campaña informática entre la colmena de mecanoides y el Imperio, los piratas informáticos imperiales vulneraron algunas IA mecánicas. Fueron separadas del núcleo y consideradas dañinas por la colmena. Sin embargo, el Imperio las abandonó pronto al dejar de ser útiles y acabaron convertidas en mecanoides «sin hogar». Perseguidas por ambos bandos, tuvieron que aprender a pensar sin la base de datos de la colmena, reunirse para protegerse y aprender a sobrevivir de los seres orgánicos que antes odiaban.
Al aprender de los humanos, también empezaron a vestir de negro, como el hombre de negro, y a llevar flores blancas para ofrecérselas a sus antiguos compañeros mecanoides al enterrarlos. Lógicamente, este comportamiento resulta incomprensible, pero es real.

Sus dos guadañas son tan afiladas como espadas monomoleculares y contienen nanomáquinas que provocan congelación en seres orgánicos. Si sufre daños irreparables, se autodestruye y libera una onda de choque criogénica como último acto de resistencia.

Rule.Original:
During the long hacking campaign between the mechanoid hive and the Empire, some mech AI were breached by empire hackers. They are separated from the core, and have since been regarded as harmful by mechanoid hive. However, after losing their usefulness, these AI were soon abandoned by the Empire and eventually became "homeless" mechanoids. Hunted by black and White, they are forced to learn to think independently of the Hive database, while gathering together to protect each other and learn survival lessons from the organisms they once hated.
In the process of learning from humans, they also wear black like the man in Black and carry white flowers with them to offer to their former mechanoid companions when they bury them. Logically this behavior is completely incomprehensible, but it is true.

He uses antimatter rounds capable of piercing the armor of a space ship with a single blow, and his advanced shield belt allows him to survive the fire of dozens of empire cataphracts.

During the long hacking campaign between the mechanoid hive and the Empire, some mech AI were breached by empire hackers. He uses antimatter rounds capable of piercing the armor of a space ship with a single blow, and his advanced shield belt allows him to survive the fire of dozens of empire cataphracts.
Rule.Translated:
Durante la prolongada campaña informática entre la colmena de mecanoides y el Imperio, los piratas informáticos imperiales vulneraron algunas IA mecánicas. Fueron separadas del núcleo y consideradas dañinas por la colmena. Sin embargo, el Imperio las abandonó pronto al dejar de ser útiles y acabaron convertidas en mecanoides «sin hogar». Perseguidas por ambos bandos, tuvieron que aprender a pensar sin la base de datos de la colmena, reunirse para protegerse y aprender a sobrevivir de los seres orgánicos que antes odiaban.
Al aprender de los humanos, también empezaron a vestir de negro, como el hombre de negro, y a llevar flores blancas para ofrecérselas a sus antiguos compañeros mecanoides al enterrarlos. Lógicamente, este comportamiento resulta incomprensible, pero es real.

Utiliza proyectiles de antimateria capaces de atravesar el blindaje de una nave espacial de un solo impacto. Su avanzado cinturón de escudo le permite sobrevivir al fuego de decenas de catafractos imperiales.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid is a recent addition to the Black Mechanoid Hive, and all members, including scyther and lancer, know little about him, except that he claims to be a stray from the mechanoid hive and is being hunted. After joining the hive, he did not receive much improvement in weapons and equipment, apparently because he was not yet fully trusted by the hive. \n\nWith the aid of four floating cannons, tesseron is capable of firing enough firepower to flatten any defensive facility.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid is a recent addition to the Black Mechanoid Hive, and all members, including scyther and lancer, know little about him, except that he claims to be a stray from the mechanoid hive and is being hunted. After joining the hive, he did not receive much improvement in weapons and equipment, apparently because he was not yet fully trusted by the hive. \n\nWith the aid of four floating cannons, tesseron is capable of firing enough firepower to flatten any defensive facility.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide se incorporó recientemente a la colmena de mecanoides negros. Todos sus miembros, incluidos los segadores y lanceros, saben poco de él, salvo que afirma haber abandonado la colmena mecanoide y estar siendo perseguido. Tras unirse, no recibió grandes mejoras de armas ni equipo, aparentemente porque aún no gozaba de plena confianza. \n\nCon cuatro cañones flotantes, el tesseron despliega suficiente potencia de fuego para arrasar cualquier instalación defensiva.
