Rule.Original: This mechanoid is a recent addition to the Black Mechanoid Hive, and all members, including scyther and lancer, know little about him, except that he claims to be a stray from the mechanoid hive and is being hunted. After joining the hive, he did not receive much improvement in weapons and equipment, apparently because he was not yet fully trusted by the hive. \n\nLegionary uses a high-powered shield generator to protect itself and its Allies. When the shield breaks, nearby enemy troops will suffer internal injuries from the impact.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid is a recent addition to the Black Mechanoid Hive, and all members, including scyther and lancer, know little about him, except that he claims to be a stray from the mechanoid hive and is being hunted. After joining the hive, he did not receive much improvement in weapons and equipment, apparently because he was not yet fully trusted by the hive. \n\nLegionary uses a high-powered shield generator to protect itself and its Allies. When the shield breaks, nearby enemy troops will suffer internal injuries from the impact.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide se incorporó recientemente a la colmena de mecanoides negros. Todos sus miembros, incluidos los segadores y lanceros, saben poco de él, salvo que afirma haber abandonado la colmena mecanoide y estar siendo perseguido. Tras unirse, no recibió grandes mejoras de armas ni equipo, aparentemente porque aún no gozaba de plena confianza. \n\nEl legionario utiliza un generador de escudo de gran potencia para protegerse y proteger a sus aliados. Cuando el escudo se rompe, las fuerzas enemigas cercanas sufren lesiones internas por el impacto.

Rule.Original: As the newest member of the Black Mechanoid Hive, this little fellow still has a lot to learn.
Rule.Raw: As the newest member of the Black Mechanoid Hive, this little fellow still has a lot to learn.
Rule.Translated: Como miembro más reciente de la colmena de mecanoides negros, este pequeño aún tiene mucho que aprender.

Rule.Original: Abandoned base of the mechanoids in black, might be able to yield some valuable intelligence.
Rule.Raw: Abandoned base of the mechanoids in black, might be able to yield some valuable intelligence.
Rule.Translated: Una base abandonada de los mecanoides de negro que podría proporcionar información de inteligencia valiosa.
piratear en la estación de comunicaciones

Rule.Original: The framework of the giant cluster under construction. To avoid drawing attention, you need to provide the construction resources.
Rule.Raw: The framework of the giant cluster under construction. To avoid drawing attention, you need to provide the construction resources.
Rule.Translated: La estructura de un complejo gigante en construcción. Para no llamar la atención, debes aportar los recursos de construcción.

Rule.Original: For the giant cluster that remains neutral towards you, you can call for artillery support through the comms console.
Rule.Raw: For the giant cluster that remains neutral towards you, you can call for artillery support through the comms console.
Rule.Translated: Puedes pedir apoyo de artillería a la agrupación gigante neutral mediante la consola de comunicaciones.

Rule.Original: Leap high and land at the target location, dealing terrifying crushing damage to the enemies within the landing spot.
Rule.Raw: Leap high and land at the target location, dealing terrifying crushing damage to the enemies within the landing spot.
Rule.Translated: Salta muy alto y aterriza en el lugar objetivo, causando un daño por aplastamiento aterrador a los enemigos del punto de aterrizaje.

Rule.Original: Activate the grav engine, suspend and spray plasma downward to clean up all objects within the range.
Rule.Raw: Activate the grav engine, suspend and spray plasma downward to clean up all objects within the range.
Rule.Translated: Activa el motor gravitatorio, se mantiene suspendido y rocía plasma hacia abajo para eliminar todos los objetos a su alcance.

Rule.Original: Leap high and turns into a suspended state above the target location, spraying plasma for sweeping.
Rule.Raw: Leap high and turns into a suspended state above the target location, spraying plasma for sweeping.
Rule.Translated: Salta muy alto y queda suspendido sobre el lugar objetivo, rociando plasma para barrer la zona.

Rule.Original: Leap high and use the grav engine to sail for a short distance, then land at the target location.
Rule.Raw: Leap high and use the grav engine to sail for a short distance, then land at the target location.
Rule.Translated: Salta muy alto y usa el motor gravitatorio para recorrer una distancia corta antes de aterrizar en el lugar objetivo.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->[discoveryMethod] the location of an abandoned orbital platform.

This place seems to be a docked port abandoned in an ancient war. Through the incomplete signals, you can detect a giant mechanoid drifting in the nearby space. You have no idea about its origin or purpose, only thing you know is that it is in dormant and extremely dangerous. 

You can try to land onto the platform and send analog signals to activate and attract the mechanoid here. All the possible consequences that may arise from this are unknown.
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->[discoveryMethod] the location of an abandoned orbital platform.

This place seems to be a docked port abandoned in an ancient war. Through the incomplete signals, you can detect a giant mechanoid drifting in the nearby space. You have no idea about its origin or purpose, only thing you know is that it is in dormant and extremely dangerous. 

You can try to land onto the platform and send analog signals to activate and attract the mechanoid here. All the possible consequences that may arise from this are unknown.
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->[discoveryMethod] la ubicación de una plataforma orbital abandonada.

Parece un puerto de atraque abandonado durante una antigua guerra. Sus señales incompletas permiten detectar un mecanoide gigante que deriva por el espacio cercano. Desconoces su origen y propósito; solo sabes que está inactivo y es extremadamente peligroso. 

Puedes intentar desembarcar en la plataforma y enviar señales analógicas para activarlo y atraerlo. Se desconocen las posibles consecuencias.

Rule.Original: expiredText->The central mechanoid that was previously detected has already left the adjacent orbit, The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Raw: expiredText->The central mechanoid that was previously detected has already left the adjacent orbit, The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
Rule.Translated: expiredText->El mecanoide central detectado ha abandonado la órbita cercana. La misión [resolvedQuestName] ha caducado.

Rule.Original: Seize one of the most terrifying forces of the mechanoid hive from the ruins of annihilator.
Rule.Raw: Seize one of the most terrifying forces of the mechanoid hive from the ruins of annihilator.
Rule.Translated: Hazte con una de las fuerzas más aterradoras de la colmena mecanoide a partir de las ruinas del aniquilador.

Rule.Original: A platform that has the potential to establish a connection with the central mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: A platform that has the potential to establish a connection with the central mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Una plataforma con potencial para establecer una conexión con el mecanoide central.

Rule.Original: The small self-propelled star-slayer weapon of the mechanoid hive. When carrying out the mission, it is responsible for drilling deep into the earth and using plasma nozzles to activate the mantle, triggering intense geological activities and making the first step in preparing for the disintegration of the planet. When in standby mode, it drifts in space, waiting for the nearest cerebrex core to wake it up, and take it to kill. \n\nThe plasma nozzle is its main attack method. It is equipped with small turrets on its limbs, destroying the corresponding parts can paralyze it.
Rule.Raw: The small self-propelled star-slayer weapon of the mechanoid hive. When carrying out the mission, it is responsible for drilling deep into the earth and using plasma nozzles to activate the mantle, triggering intense geological activities and making the first step in preparing for the disintegration of the planet. When in standby mode, it drifts in space, waiting for the nearest cerebrex core to wake it up, and take it to kill. \n\nThe plasma nozzle is its main attack method. It is equipped with small turrets on its limbs, destroying the corresponding parts can paralyze it.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña arma autopropulsada destructora de mundos de la colmena mecanoide. En sus misiones perfora profundamente la tierra y utiliza toberas de plasma para activar el manto, provocar una intensa actividad geológica e iniciar la desintegración del planeta. En espera, deriva por el espacio hasta que el núcleo cerebrex más cercano la activa y la envía a matar. \n\nLa tobera de plasma es su principal arma. Sus extremidades llevan pequeñas torretas; destruir las partes correspondientes puede paralizarla.

Rule.Original: The terminal used in ancient times for processing mechanoid signals. It can be hacked by professionals and analog signals sent to attract the surrounding mechanoids to approach.
Rule.Raw: The terminal used in ancient times for processing mechanoid signals. It can be hacked by professionals and analog signals sent to attract the surrounding mechanoids to approach.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo terminal de procesamiento de señales mecanoides. Los especialistas pueden piratearlo y enviar señales analógicas que atraigan a los mecanoides cercanos.

Rule.Original: A large charging station designed for central-level mechanoids. Its specially reinforced design enables it to withstand instantaneous pressure of thousands of tons without significant deformation. Even so, it is still necessary to pay attention to regular maintenance.
Rule.Raw: A large charging station designed for central-level mechanoids. Its specially reinforced design enables it to withstand instantaneous pressure of thousands of tons without significant deformation. Even so, it is still necessary to pay attention to regular maintenance.
Rule.Translated: Una gran estación de recarga diseñada para mecanoides de nivel central. Su diseño reforzado soporta presiones instantáneas de miles de toneladas sin deformarse significativamente. Aun así, necesita mantenimiento regular.

Rule.Original:
Reactive Armor: The unit cannot be wounded again for one second after being wounded. 

Psychic Comet: This unit can perform Psychic Bombardment 

 Spherical Lightning: This unit will constantly release Spherical Lightning, as well as make Spherical Lightning using the Cane in hand. 
\nMicroarmor Reinforcement:This unit can reinforce Mechanicals within range, as well as reinforce Black units across the field. 
\nMicromachine Survival: This unit can revive our Mechanicals within range.
Rule.Raw:
Reactive Armor: The unit cannot be wounded again for one second after being wounded. 

Psychic Comet: This unit can perform Psychic Bombardment 

 Spherical Lightning: This unit will constantly release Spherical Lightning, as well as make Spherical Lightning using the Cane in hand. 
\nMicroarmor Reinforcement:This unit can reinforce Mechanicals within range, as well as reinforce Black units across the field. 
\nMicromachine Survival: This unit can revive our Mechanicals within range.
Rule.Translated:
Blindaje reactivo: la unidad no puede volver a sufrir heridas durante un segundo después de recibir una. 

Cometa psíquico: esta unidad puede realizar un bombardeo psíquico. 

Relámpago esférico: esta unidad libera relámpagos esféricos continuamente y también puede crearlos con el bastón que lleva. 

Refuerzo de microblindaje: esta unidad puede reforzar a los mecanoides que estén a su alcance y a las unidades negras de todo el campo de batalla. 

Supervivencia nanomecánica: esta unidad puede reanimar a nuestros mecanoides que estén a su alcance.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid has been fully reinforced by a nearby commander.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid has been fully reinforced by a nearby commander.
Rule.Translated: Un comandante cercano ha reforzado por completo a este mecanoide.

Rule.Original: The failure of the counterattack resulted in energy backflow and instead strengthened the body
Rule.Raw: The failure of the counterattack resulted in energy backflow and instead strengthened the body
Rule.Translated: El fallo del contraataque provocó un reflujo de energía que, en lugar de atacar, fortaleció el cuerpo

Rule.Original:
Core Startup: Every time the Legion Crab on the field dies, it gradually activates its shield core and enters the micro weapon pulsating form after startup. 

 Defense Shield Armor: This unit will hardly receive any traditional long-range damage and will not receive most of the explosive damage. 

 High Energy Barrier: This unit's shield can withstand both firearms and mortar ammunition at the same time. 

 Standard Blueprint: The building quality produced by this unit increases
Rule.Raw:
Core Startup: Every time the Legion Crab on the field dies, it gradually activates its shield core and enters the micro weapon pulsating form after startup. 

 Defense Shield Armor: This unit will hardly receive any traditional long-range damage and will not receive most of the explosive damage. 

 High Energy Barrier: This unit's shield can withstand both firearms and mortar ammunition at the same time. 

 Standard Blueprint: The building quality produced by this unit increases
Rule.Translated:
Arranque del núcleo: cada vez que muere un Cangrejo de la Legión en el campo de batalla, su núcleo de escudo se activa gradualmente. Una vez completado el arranque, adopta su forma de pulsos de microarmas. 

Blindaje protector: esta unidad apenas recibe daños de ataques a distancia convencionales y es inmune a la mayoría de los daños explosivos. 

Barrera de alta energía: el escudo de esta unidad puede resistir tanto disparos de armas de fuego como proyectiles de mortero. 

Plano estándar: aumenta la calidad de los edificios construidos por esta unidad.

Los nodos de ancho de banda deben sintonizarse con un mecanitor concreto y pueden mejorarse aumentando su consumo eléctrico, lo que permite controlar más mecanoides. Sin embargo, resintonizar un nodo para otro mecanitor lleva más tiempo.

Rule.Original:
A giant central mechanoid, one of the most magnificent creations of the mechaonid hive. 

Normally, the exostrider would only use its transponder to uniformly schedule the mechanoid clusters within a galaxy and exchange information directly with the mechanoid hive core. A exostrider usually has several mechanoid ships working together to facilitate information transmission and protection. In special situations, it can also use heavy artillery and industrial rapid-fire artillery combat, rapid-fire guns will automatically search for a certain range of enemy attacks, while the main gun will only be activated when forced to use against some of the most threatening targets. 

Since the exostrider acts as a "coordinate origin" when summoning the mechanoid fleet, it can't move at will, but its heavy armor also means you can't deal damage to it using normal methods.

With the aid of SEMI-Psychic Chip's research, we can imitate this behemoth.Consumes 100,000 stored power per shot.
Rule.Raw:
A giant central mechanoid, one of the most magnificent creations of the mechaonid hive. 

Normally, the exostrider would only use its transponder to uniformly schedule the mechanoid clusters within a galaxy and exchange information directly with the mechanoid hive core. A exostrider usually has several mechanoid ships working together to facilitate information transmission and protection. In special situations, it can also use heavy artillery and industrial rapid-fire artillery combat, rapid-fire guns will automatically search for a certain range of enemy attacks, while the main gun will only be activated when forced to use against some of the most threatening targets. 

Since the exostrider acts as a "coordinate origin" when summoning the mechanoid fleet, it can't move at will, but its heavy armor also means you can't deal damage to it using normal methods.

With the aid of SEMI-Psychic Chip's research, we can imitate this behemoth.Consumes 100,000 stored power per shot.
Rule.Translated:
Un mecanoide central gigantesco, una de las creaciones más imponentes de la colmena mecanoide. 

Normalmente, el exocaminante solo utiliza su transpondedor para coordinar las agrupaciones mecanoides de una galaxia e intercambiar información directamente con el núcleo de la colmena. Suele contar con varias naves mecanoides que colaboran para facilitar la transmisión de información y su protección. En situaciones especiales también puede combatir con artillería pesada y cañones industriales de tiro rápido. Estos buscan automáticamente enemigos a cierta distancia, mientras que el cañón principal solo se activa cuando es necesario utilizarlo contra algunos de los objetivos más peligrosos. 

Como el exocaminante actúa como «origen de coordenadas» al invocar a la flota mecanoide, no puede moverse libremente. Sin embargo, su pesado blindaje también impide dañarlo mediante métodos convencionales.

Gracias a la investigación del chip SEMI-Psychic, podemos imitar a este coloso. Consume 100,000 de energía almacenada por disparo.

Rule.Original:
During the long hacking campaign between the mechanoid hive and the Empire, some mech AI were breached by empire hackers. They are separated from the core, and have since been regarded as harmful by mechanoid hive. However, after losing their usefulness, these AI were soon abandoned by the Empire and eventually became "homeless" mechanoids. Hunted by black and White, they are forced to learn to think independently of the Hive database, while gathering together to protect each other and learn survival lessons from the organisms they once hated.
In the process of learning from humans, they also wear black like the man in Black and carry white flowers with them to offer to their former mechanoid companions when they bury them. 

She uses antimatter rounds capable of piercing the armor of a space ship with a single blow, and his advanced shield belt allows him to survive the fire of dozens of empire cataphracts.

We have not mastered the creation of such mechanical bodies, but through the study of semi-psychic chips, it seems that we can replicate their original shells with the help of the persona core as well as the persona data.

We have not mastered the creation of such mechanical bodies, but through the study of semi-psychic chips, it seems that we can replicate their original shells with the help of the persona core as well as the persona data.
Rule.Translated:
Durante la prolongada campaña de intrusiones informáticas entre la colmena mecanoide y el Imperio, los piratas informáticos imperiales vulneraron algunas IA mecanoides. Estas se separaron del núcleo y desde entonces la colmena las considera perjudiciales. Sin embargo, cuando dejaron de ser útiles, el Imperio las abandonó y terminaron convertidas en mecanoides «sin hogar». Perseguidas por ambos bandos, se ven obligadas a aprender a pensar al margen de la base de datos de la colmena, al tiempo que se agrupan para protegerse y aprender a sobrevivir de los organismos que antes odiaban.
Al aprender de los humanos, también se visten de negro, como el hombre de negro, y llevan flores blancas para ofrecérselas a sus antiguos compañeros mecanoides cuando los entierran. 

Utiliza proyectiles de antimateria capaces de atravesar el blindaje de una nave espacial de un solo impacto, y su avanzado cinturón de escudo le permite sobrevivir al fuego de decenas de catafractos imperiales.

Aún no dominamos la creación de estos mecanoides, pero el estudio de los chips semipsíquicos parece permitirnos replicar sus carcasas originales con ayuda del núcleo y los datos de personalidad.

Rule.Original:
This mechanoid is a recent addition to the Black Mechanoid Hive, and all members, including scyther and lancer, know little about him, except that he claims to be a stray from the mechanoid hive and is being hunted. After joining the hive, he did not receive much improvement in weapons and equipment, apparently because he was not yet fully trusted by the hive. 

Legionary uses a high-powered shield generator to protect itself and its Allies. When the shield breaks, nearby enemy troops will suffer internal injuries from the impact.

Based on our research on the semi-psychic chip, we copied this cyborg and installed new configurations that weren't there originally.

Tras incorporarse, sus armas y equipo apenas mejoraron, al parecer porque la colmena aún no confía plenamente en él. 

El legionario utiliza un generador de escudo de alta potencia para protegerse y proteger a sus aliados. Cuando el escudo se rompe, las tropas enemigas cercanas sufren heridas internas por el impacto.

A partir de nuestra investigación del chip semipsíquico, copiamos este cíborg e instalamos nuevas configuraciones que no tenía originalmente.

Its most obvious power is its ability to resurrect recently-killed mechs by supercharging their self-repair processes. \n\n Modified by the colonists, this model of Notircopa can be better adapted to colonial combat.
Rule.Translated: Un comandante mecanoide diseñado para coordinar y motivar a otros mecanoides durante largas campañas de exterminio. Su capacidad más evidente consiste en resucitar mecanoides recién destruidos mediante la sobrecarga de sus procesos de autorreparación. \n\nLos colonos han modificado este modelo de Notircopa para adaptarlo mejor al combate de la colonia.

Rule.Original: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nDesigned after the Phoenix armour, this Tesseron is prepared with an incendiary launcher, as well as a modified Beam graser, capable of destroying its victims with fiery flames.
Rule.Raw: During the long war it was not only the humans who were learning the mechanoids, the mechanoids were learning the humans.\n\nDesigned after the Phoenix armour, this Tesseron is prepared with an incendiary launcher, as well as a modified Beam graser, capable of destroying its victims with fiery flames.
Rule.Translated: Durante la larga guerra, los humanos no eran los únicos que aprendían de los mecanoides: estos también aprendían de los humanos.\n\nDiseñado a partir de la armadura Fénix, este teserón está equipado con un lanzador incendiario y un graser de haz modificado, capaces de destruir a sus víctimas con llamas ardientes.

Rule.Original: A small mechanical designed to extract minerals. Though it is designed for small extraction operations in its own right, it can also fight with a built-in drill if necessary.
Rule.Raw: A small mechanical designed to extract minerals. Though it is designed for small extraction operations in its own right, it can also fight with a built-in drill if necessary.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño mecanoide diseñado para extraer minerales. Aunque está destinado a operaciones de extracción pequeñas, también puede combatir con su taladro integrado si es necesario.
Núcleo de pulsos de gran capacidad
blindaje de precisión de la cabeza
blindaje de precisión del hombro izquierdo
blindaje de precisión del hombro derecho

Rule.Original: Equipped with two plasma mechanical claws, it is a super heavy mechanical body that can easily dig through mountains and rocks. Its powerful shield strike will make its enemies learn fear, and any attempt to engage in close combat with it is such an overestimation. \Most of the time, the core of Mole Cricket is in an incomplete running state. And once attacked, it will gradually activate its core until it becomes overloaded and enters a state of fierce combat, transforming into a hellish monster emitting hot steam and tearing apart all creatures that dare to oppose it.
Rule.Raw: Equipped with two plasma mechanical claws, it is a super heavy mechanical body that can easily dig through mountains and rocks. Its powerful shield strike will make its enemies learn fear, and any attempt to engage in close combat with it is such an overestimation. \Most of the time, the core of Mole Cricket is in an incomplete running state. And once attacked, it will gradually activate its core until it becomes overloaded and enters a state of fierce combat, transforming into a hellish monster emitting hot steam and tearing apart all creatures that dare to oppose it.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide superpesado equipado con dos garras mecánicas de plasma, capaz de excavar con facilidad montañas y rocas. Su poderoso golpe de escudo enseña a sus enemigos lo que es el miedo; intentar enfrentarse a él cuerpo a cuerpo supone sobrestimar las propias capacidades. \El núcleo del grillo topo suele funcionar de forma incompleta. Cuando lo atacan, se activa gradualmente hasta sobrecargarse y entrar en un estado de combate feroz. Así se transforma en un monstruo infernal que emite vapor ardiente y despedaza a todas las criaturas que se atreven a oponerse a él.

Rule.Raw: Heavy gauntlets provide a more powerful punch
Rule.Translated: Los guanteletes pesados permiten dar puñetazos más potentes

Rule.Original: Make a pair of eltex gloves.
Rule.Raw: Make a pair of eltex gloves.
Rule.Translated: Confecciona un par de guantes de eltex.

Rule.Original: Making a pair of eltex gloves.
Rule.Raw: Making a pair of eltex gloves.
Rule.Translated: Confeccionando un par de guantes de eltex.

Rule.Original: Make a pair of eltex boots.
Rule.Raw: Make a pair of eltex boots.
Rule.Translated: Confecciona un par de botas de eltex.

Rule.Original: Making a pair of eltex boots.
Rule.Raw: Making a pair of eltex boots.
Rule.Translated: Confeccionando un par de botas de eltex.

Rule.Original: A pair of boots embedded with special psychic focusing materials. While not very protective, it enhances the wearer's psychic capabilities and helps to dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: A pair of boots embedded with special psychic focusing materials. While not very protective, it enhances the wearer's psychic capabilities and helps to dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas con materiales especiales de concentración psíquica. Aunque no protegen demasiado, mejoran las capacidades psíquicas del usuario y ayudan a disipar el calor neural.

Rule.Original: A pair of light power armor boots, fitted with strategically placed plasteel plates and servomotors. Their relatively light weight allows the servomotors to work without hinderance.
Rule.Raw: A pair of light power armor boots, fitted with strategically placed plasteel plates and servomotors. Their relatively light weight allows the servomotors to work without hinderance.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas ligeras de armadura potenciada, con placas de plastiacero colocadas estratégicamente y servomotores. Su peso relativamente bajo permite que estos funcionen sin impedimentos.

Rule.Original: A pair of heavy power armor boots, layered with thick plasteel plates and fitted with enough servomotors to keep the wearer unimpeded. Its sturdy build and heavier weight helps to keep the wearer stable.
Rule.Raw: A pair of heavy power armor boots, layered with thick plasteel plates and fitted with enough servomotors to keep the wearer unimpeded. Its sturdy build and heavier weight helps to keep the wearer stable.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas pesadas de armadura potenciada, con capas de gruesas placas de plastiacero y suficientes servomotores para no dificultar el movimiento. Su estructura robusta y mayor peso ayudan a mantener estable al usuario.

Rule.Original: A pair of advanced light power armor boots, with plasteel plates efficiently placed to cover all the important parts of the foot. Interwoven heat shields in the plating offers superior heat protection, and sophisticated servomotors allow the wearer to perform evasive maneuvers that would otherwise be impractical.
Rule.Raw: A pair of advanced light power armor boots, with plasteel plates efficiently placed to cover all the important parts of the foot. Interwoven heat shields in the plating offers superior heat protection, and sophisticated servomotors allow the wearer to perform evasive maneuvers that would otherwise be impractical.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas ligeras avanzadas de armadura potenciada con placas de plastiacero que cubren eficazmente las partes importantes del pie. Sus escudos térmicos entretejidos ofrecen una protección superior contra el calor, y sus sofisticados servomotores permiten maniobras evasivas que de otro modo serían impracticables.

Rule.Original: A pair of ultraheavy power armor boots, laden with reinforced plasteel plates that are capable of stopping even the largest projectiles in their tracks.\n\nNumerous servomotors allow the wearer to move unimpeded, while hydraulics inside the boots provide additional stability and carry capacity.
Rule.Raw: A pair of ultraheavy power armor boots, laden with reinforced plasteel plates that are capable of stopping even the largest projectiles in their tracks.\n\nNumerous servomotors allow the wearer to move unimpeded, while hydraulics inside the boots provide additional stability and carry capacity.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas ultrapesadas de armadura potenciada con placas reforzadas de plastiacero capaces de detener incluso los mayores proyectiles.\n\nNumerosos servomotores permiten moverse sin impedimentos, mientras que los sistemas hidráulicos internos aportan estabilidad y capacidad de carga.

Rule.Original: A pair of boots with steel plates covering the toes and most of the foot. Slightly cumbersome to move in, but offers good protection while being fairly comfortable to wear.
Rule.Raw: A pair of boots with steel plates covering the toes and most of the foot. Slightly cumbersome to move in, but offers good protection while being fairly comfortable to wear.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas con placas de acero que cubren los dedos y la mayor parte del pie. Dificultan ligeramente el movimiento, pero ofrecen buena protección y resultan bastante cómodas.

Rule.Original: A pair of boots bolstered with padded plates. A bit bulky, but good for preventing your digits from being removed by any sudden blunt force trauma, which helps when trying to detain more rowdy prisoners.
Rule.Raw: A pair of boots bolstered with padded plates. A bit bulky, but good for preventing your digits from being removed by any sudden blunt force trauma, which helps when trying to detain more rowdy prisoners.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas reforzadas con placas acolchadas. Son algo voluminosas, pero evitan perder los dedos por traumatismos contundentes repentinos, algo útil al detener a prisioneros especialmente revoltosos.

Rule.Original: A pair of protective boots that slightly protect the wearer from the vacuum of space. These boots contain gravity stabilizers specially designed to keep the wearer steady during a gravship launch, which helps with gravship piloting.
Rule.Raw: A pair of protective boots that slightly protect the wearer from the vacuum of space. These boots contain gravity stabilizers specially designed to keep the wearer steady during a gravship launch, which helps with gravship piloting.
Rule.Translated: Unas botas protectoras que aíslan ligeramente del vacío espacial. Incorporan estabilizadores gravitatorios para mantener al usuario firme durante el despegue de una astronave gravitatoria, lo que ayuda a pilotarla.

Rule.Original: A pair of gloves embedded with special psychic focusing materials. While not very protective, it enhances the wearer's psychic capabilities and helps to dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: A pair of gloves embedded with special psychic focusing materials. While not very protective, it enhances the wearer's psychic capabilities and helps to dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes con materiales especiales de concentración psíquica. Aunque no protegen demasiado, mejoran las capacidades psíquicas del usuario y ayudan a disipar el calor neural.

Rule.Original: A pair of light power armor gloves, with plasteel plates covering the majority of the wearer's fingers and hand. Tactile amplifiers and built in neuro-memetic assistors help the wearer with reloading and aiming more efficiently.
Rule.Raw: A pair of light power armor gloves, with plasteel plates covering the majority of the wearer's fingers and hand. Tactile amplifiers and built in neuro-memetic assistors help the wearer with reloading and aiming more efficiently.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes ligeros de armadura potenciada con placas de plastiacero que cubren la mayor parte de las manos y dedos. Sus amplificadores táctiles y asistentes neuromeméticos integrados ayudan a recargar y apuntar con más eficacia.

Rule.Original: A pair of reinforced power armor gauntlets, with plating going from fingers to forearm without sacrificing fine motor control. They are fitted with reflex synchronizers that help guide the user to make clean, efficient strikes.
Rule.Raw: A pair of reinforced power armor gauntlets, with plating going from fingers to forearm without sacrificing fine motor control. They are fitted with reflex synchronizers that help guide the user to make clean, efficient strikes.
Rule.Translated: Unos guanteletes reforzados de armadura potenciada con placas desde los dedos hasta el antebrazo, sin sacrificar la motricidad fina. Incorporan sincronizadores de reflejos que guían al usuario para asestar golpes limpios y eficaces.

Rule.Original: A pair of advanced light power armor gloves, with plasteel plates carefully placed to protect the majority of the wearer's hand. Heat shields are interwoven in the plating, which provides superior heat protection. Sound-absorbing padding helps to muffle the actions of the wearer, and refined tactile amplifiers help the wearer to reload quickly and deflect blows.
Rule.Raw: A pair of advanced light power armor gloves, with plasteel plates carefully placed to protect the majority of the wearer's hand. Heat shields are interwoven in the plating, which provides superior heat protection. Sound-absorbing padding helps to muffle the actions of the wearer, and refined tactile amplifiers help the wearer to reload quickly and deflect blows.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes ligeros avanzados de armadura potenciada con placas de plastiacero que protegen la mayor parte de la mano. Sus escudos térmicos entretejidos ofrecen una protección superior contra el calor. El acolchado absorbente amortigua los sonidos y los amplificadores táctiles refinados ayudan a recargar deprisa y desviar golpes.

Rule.Original: A pair of ultraheavy power armor gauntlets, with fingers to elbow covered by reinforced plasteel plating capable of deflecting even the most grievous attacks.\n\nNumerous neuro-memetic assistors manage to provide the wearer unimpeded use of their hands. Additionally, the considerable weight of the gauntlets add weight to the wearer's melee strikes, as well as acting as a natural recoil buffer.
Rule.Raw: A pair of ultraheavy power armor gauntlets, with fingers to elbow covered by reinforced plasteel plating capable of deflecting even the most grievous attacks.\n\nNumerous neuro-memetic assistors manage to provide the wearer unimpeded use of their hands. Additionally, the considerable weight of the gauntlets add weight to the wearer's melee strikes, as well as acting as a natural recoil buffer.
Rule.Translated: Unos guanteletes ultrapesados de armadura potenciada con placas reforzadas de plastiacero desde los dedos hasta los codos, capaces de desviar incluso los ataques más graves.\n\nNumerosos asistentes neuromeméticos permiten utilizar las manos sin impedimentos. Su peso considerable también refuerza los golpes cuerpo a cuerpo y amortigua de forma natural el retroceso.

Rule.Original: A pair of gloves with steel plates protecting the hand and fingers. Slightly cumbersome to work in, but offers good protection while being comfortable to wear.
Rule.Raw: A pair of gloves with steel plates protecting the hand and fingers. Slightly cumbersome to work in, but offers good protection while being comfortable to wear.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes con placas de acero que protegen las manos y dedos. Dificultan ligeramente el trabajo, pero ofrecen buena protección y resultan cómodos.

Rule.Original: A pair of gloves fortified with padded plates. A bit bulky, but good for preventing your digits from being removed by any sudden blunt force trauma, which helps when trying to detain more rowdy prisoners.
Rule.Raw: A pair of gloves fortified with padded plates. A bit bulky, but good for preventing your digits from being removed by any sudden blunt force trauma, which helps when trying to detain more rowdy prisoners.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes reforzados con placas acolchadas. Son algo voluminosos, pero evitan perder los dedos por traumatismos contundentes repentinos, algo útil al detener a prisioneros especialmente revoltosos.

Rule.Original: A pair of protective gloves that slightly protect the wearer from the vacuum of space. These gloves possess vibration dampeners, which allow the wearer to maintain steady hands even during the turbulent launch of a gravship.
Rule.Raw: A pair of protective gloves that slightly protect the wearer from the vacuum of space. These gloves possess vibration dampeners, which allow the wearer to maintain steady hands even during the turbulent launch of a gravship.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes protectores que aíslan ligeramente del vacío espacial. Sus amortiguadores de vibración permiten mantener las manos firmes incluso durante el turbulento despegue de una astronave gravitatoria.

Rule.Original: Create simple guns for the RDA faction.
Rule.Raw: Create simple guns for the RDA faction.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica armas sencillas para la facción RDA.

Rule.Original: Standard RDA weaponry capable of killing with great efficiency.
Rule.Raw: Standard RDA weaponry capable of killing with great efficiency.
Rule.Translated: Armamento estándar de RDA capaz de matar con gran eficacia.

Rule.Original: Heavy weapons are necessary for various purposes, such as suppressing fire, clearing areas, and destroying heavily armored targets.
Rule.Raw: Heavy weapons are necessary for various purposes, such as suppressing fire, clearing areas, and destroying heavily armored targets.
Rule.Translated: Las armas pesadas son necesarias para diversas tareas, como proporcionar fuego de supresión, despejar zonas y destruir objetivos fuertemente blindados.

Rule.Original: Light armor of standard RDA soldiers.
Rule.Raw: Light armor of standard RDA soldiers.
Rule.Translated: Armadura ligera de los soldados estándar de RDA.

Rule.Original: Medium armor issued to special units for special combat operations and to soldiers with higher ranks.
Rule.Raw: Medium armor issued to special units for special combat operations and to soldiers with higher ranks.
Rule.Translated: Armadura media para unidades especiales en operaciones de combate especiales y para soldados de mayor rango.

Rule.Original: Expensive and rare heavy armor for trusted employees with high ranks and/or members of commando units.
Rule.Raw: Expensive and rare heavy armor for trusted employees with high ranks and/or members of commando units.
Rule.Translated: Armadura pesada, cara y poco común, para empleados de confianza de alto rango o miembros de unidades de comandos.
Desbloquea las numerosas tecnologías de RDA.

Rule.Original: Fires a grenade that explodes upon impact. Steel is needed for recharging.
Rule.Raw: Fires a grenade that explodes upon impact. Steel is needed for recharging.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una granada que explota al impactar. Requiere acero para recargarse.

Rule.Original: Firing a shotgun pellet. Steel is needed for recharging.
Rule.Raw: Firing a shotgun pellet. Steel is needed for recharging.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un perdigón de escopeta. Requiere acero para recargarse.

Rule.Original: The most balanced heavy armor. Provides good protection without significantly reducing movement speed.
Rule.Raw: The most balanced heavy armor. Provides good protection without significantly reducing movement speed.
Rule.Translated: La armadura pesada más equilibrada. Ofrece buena protección sin reducir mucho la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: The heaviest armor set available to RDA employees. For this reason, it has low movement speed, but is the most heavily armored of all sets.
Rule.Raw: The heaviest armor set available to RDA employees. For this reason, it has low movement speed, but is the most heavily armored of all sets.
Rule.Translated: El conjunto de armadura más pesado disponible para los empleados de RDA. Por ello reduce la velocidad de movimiento, pero ofrece la mayor protección de todos los conjuntos.

Rule.Original: A lightweight set of heavy armor that does not restrict the fighter's movements or slow him down. However, the armor itself does not provide the same protection as other sets.
Rule.Raw: A lightweight set of heavy armor that does not restrict the fighter's movements or slow him down. However, the armor itself does not provide the same protection as other sets.
Rule.Translated: Un conjunto ligero de armadura pesada que no limita ni ralentiza los movimientos del combatiente. Sin embargo, no ofrece la misma protección que otros conjuntos.

Rule.Original: The simplest basic mask for RDA employees. Lightweight and durable, it performs well as a gas mask.
Rule.Raw: The simplest basic mask for RDA employees. Lightweight and durable, it performs well as a gas mask.
Rule.Translated: La máscara básica más sencilla para empleados de RDA. Ligera y resistente, funciona bien como máscara de gas.

Rule.Original: Basic helmet for RDA employees. This mask is integrated into the helmet, making it much stronger and improving protection..
Rule.Raw: Basic helmet for RDA employees. This mask is integrated into the helmet, making it much stronger and improving protection..
Rule.Translated: Un casco básico para empleados de RDA. La máscara está integrada en el casco, lo que aumenta su resistencia y protección.

Rule.Original: A combat visor for RDA soldiers that assists in aiming and directing fire from personal weapons.
Rule.Raw: A combat visor for RDA soldiers that assists in aiming and directing fire from personal weapons.
Rule.Translated: Un visor de combate para soldados de RDA que ayuda a apuntar y dirigir el fuego de sus armas personales.

Rule.Original: A rare heavy-armored helmet that can also serve as a spacesuit helmet for commando units and soldiers with very high ranks.
Rule.Raw: A rare heavy-armored helmet that can also serve as a spacesuit helmet for commando units and soldiers with very high ranks.
Rule.Translated: Un raro casco de blindaje pesado que también puede utilizarse como casco de traje espacial para comandos y soldados de rango muy elevado.

Rule.Original: A heavily armored medium helmet with a heavy nose plate protecting the face and external sensors instead of eyes. It is completely sealed and extremely durable, but also very heavy.
Rule.Raw: A heavily armored medium helmet with a heavy nose plate protecting the face and external sensors instead of eyes. It is completely sealed and extremely durable, but also very heavy.
Rule.Translated: Un casco mediano con blindaje pesado, una gruesa placa nasal que protege el rostro y sensores externos en lugar de ojos. Está completamente sellado y es muy resistente, pero también muy pesado.

Rule.Original: Medium armor helmet for special forces and soldiers with higher ranks.
Rule.Raw: Medium armor helmet for special forces and soldiers with higher ranks.
Rule.Translated: Casco de armadura media para fuerzas especiales y soldados de mayor rango.

Rule.Original: Standard light armor for RDA riflemen. The armor has additional pouches for magazines and a holster for a pistol for convenience.
Rule.Raw: Standard light armor for RDA riflemen. The armor has additional pouches for magazines and a holster for a pistol for convenience.
Rule.Translated: La armadura ligera estándar de los fusileros de RDA. Incorpora bolsas adicionales para cargadores y una funda de pistola para mayor comodidad.

Rule.Original: Standard light armor worn by RDA fighters. This armor is very light and comfortable for close combat, which is why it is used by RDA fighters.
Rule.Raw: Standard light armor worn by RDA fighters. This armor is very light and comfortable for close combat, which is why it is used by RDA fighters.
Rule.Translated: La armadura ligera estándar de los combatientes de RDA. Es muy ligera y cómoda para el combate cercano, por lo que estas tropas la utilizan.

Rule.Original: Standard medium armor for RDA employees. Provides good protection and sufficient mobility.
Rule.Raw: Standard medium armor for RDA employees. Provides good protection and sufficient mobility.
Rule.Translated: Armadura media estándar para empleados de RDA. Ofrece buena protección y movilidad suficiente.

Rule.Original: Medium high-tech armor with a built-in exoskeleton that allows you to run faster, dodge melee attacks, and reload weapons more quickly.
Rule.Raw: Medium high-tech armor with a built-in exoskeleton that allows you to run faster, dodge melee attacks, and reload weapons more quickly.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura mediana de alta tecnología con un exoesqueleto integrado que permite correr más deprisa, esquivar ataques cuerpo a cuerpo y recargar las armas más rápido.

Rule.Original: The most heavily armored medium armor available to RDA employees. However, it significantly reduces movement speed..
Rule.Raw: The most heavily armored medium armor available to RDA employees. However, it significantly reduces movement speed..
Rule.Translated: La armadura media con mayor blindaje disponible para empleados de RDA. Sin embargo, reduce mucho la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: The SN-9 WASP is a modern revolver model that is used by some RDA SecOps personnel as a personal weapon instead of the RDA Handgun.
Rule.Raw: The SN-9 WASP is a modern revolver model that is used by some RDA SecOps personnel as a personal weapon instead of the RDA Handgun.
Rule.Translated: El SN-9 WASP es un revólver moderno que parte del personal de RDA SecOps utiliza como arma personal en lugar de la pistola RDA.

Rule.Original: The CARB SMG is a submachine gun manufactured by Matanza Arms Corporation. As a weapon derivative of the CARB Weapon System, the SMG is merely a CARB Base Unit Automatic Rifle with its rifle barrel removed and replaced with a snub-muzzle that is chambered to fire 6.2x35mm ammunition, attached foregrip, and laser sites. On Pandora, the gun is used inside 'the wire' by Security Operations as well as being issued to pilots and vehicle drivers.
Rule.Raw: The CARB SMG is a submachine gun manufactured by Matanza Arms Corporation. As a weapon derivative of the CARB Weapon System, the SMG is merely a CARB Base Unit Automatic Rifle with its rifle barrel removed and replaced with a snub-muzzle that is chambered to fire 6.2x35mm ammunition, attached foregrip, and laser sites. On Pandora, the gun is used inside 'the wire' by Security Operations as well as being issued to pilots and vehicle drivers.
Rule.Translated: El CARB SMG es un subfusil fabricado por Matanza Arms Corporation. Derivado del sistema de armas CARB, consiste en una unidad base de fusil automático cuyo cañón se sustituye por uno corto preparado para munición de 6.2x35mm, con empuñadura delantera y miras láser. En Pandora, Operaciones de Seguridad lo utiliza dentro del perímetro y también lo entrega a pilotos y conductores de vehículos.

Rule.Original: The Standard CARB DMR is an automatic rifle that can be seen in use by many RDA personnel . Utilizing the best technology of the last hundred years, the military has created one of the most versatile assault rifles for their soldiers. As with many RDA weapons, the magazine is behind the trigger, in what is known as a “bullpup” layout. Commonly referred to as the “Standard” rifle by RDA soldiers, this rifle has been used by the RDA for many years, and several modernized versions have been produced.
Rule.Raw: The Standard CARB DMR is an automatic rifle that can be seen in use by many RDA personnel . Utilizing the best technology of the last hundred years, the military has created one of the most versatile assault rifles for their soldiers. As with many RDA weapons, the magazine is behind the trigger, in what is known as a “bullpup” layout. Commonly referred to as the “Standard” rifle by RDA soldiers, this rifle has been used by the RDA for many years, and several modernized versions have been produced.
Rule.Translated: El CARB DMR estándar es un fusil automático utilizado por muchos empleados de RDA. Con la mejor tecnología de los últimos cien años, el ejército ha creado uno de los fusiles de asalto más versátiles para sus soldados. Como en muchas armas de RDA, el cargador está detrás del gatillo, en una disposición «bullpup». Las tropas lo llaman simplemente el fusil «Estándar». RDA lleva muchos años utilizándolo y ha producido varias versiones modernizadas.

Rule.Original: The CARB Shotgun is a semi-automatic, RDA-designed shotgun, based on the CARB platform. The CARB Automatic Rifle has its standard barrel stripped down, with an additional foregrip attached to attain better weapons handling. It uses 20mm shells to disperse a spray of small spherical pellets when fired. These pellets can cause horrific injuries at close range, and are highly effective against the Na'vi as they often charge at RDA troops to use close combat weapons such as axes and spears.
Rule.Raw: The CARB Shotgun is a semi-automatic, RDA-designed shotgun, based on the CARB platform. The CARB Automatic Rifle has its standard barrel stripped down, with an additional foregrip attached to attain better weapons handling. It uses 20mm shells to disperse a spray of small spherical pellets when fired. These pellets can cause horrific injuries at close range, and are highly effective against the Na'vi as they often charge at RDA troops to use close combat weapons such as axes and spears.
Rule.Translated: La escopeta CARB es un arma semiautomática diseñada por RDA sobre la plataforma CARB. Se sustituye el cañón estándar del fusil automático y se añade una empuñadura delantera para mejorar el manejo. Utiliza cartuchos de 20mm que dispersan pequeños perdigones esféricos. Estos pueden causar heridas terribles a corta distancia y son muy eficaces contra los Na'vi, que suelen cargar contra las tropas de RDA con armas cuerpo a cuerpo como hachas y lanzas.

Rule.Original: The RML M83 Rocket Launcher is a Resources Development Administration-designed collapsible rocket-propelled grenade launcher built for Human needs but can also be used to the scale of a Recombinant or a Skel Suit operator - albeit awkwardly - and are used by the RDA in the Western Frontier. It is a standard RPG used for anti-armour and anti-personnel purposes.
Rule.Raw: The RML M83 Rocket Launcher is a Resources Development Administration-designed collapsible rocket-propelled grenade launcher built for Human needs but can also be used to the scale of a Recombinant or a Skel Suit operator - albeit awkwardly - and are used by the RDA in the Western Frontier. It is a standard RPG used for anti-armour and anti-personnel purposes.
Rule.Translated: El lanzacohetes RML M83 es un lanzagranadas propulsadas por cohete plegable diseñado por Resources Development Administration para humanos. También pueden utilizarlo, aunque de forma incómoda, recombinantes y operadores de Skel Suit. RDA lo emplea en la Frontera Occidental como RPG estándar contra blindajes y personal.

Rule.Original: RDA Handgun - is the standard RDA employee handgun. It is a semi-automatic handgun designed and manufactured by Hirte s Fahl Arms Ltd. and produced on Pandora under license for use by SecOps. This weapon is favored by RDAs for its simplicity, durability, and low cost of manufacture, although SecOps personnel often consider it underpowered.
Rule.Raw: RDA Handgun - is the standard RDA employee handgun. It is a semi-automatic handgun designed and manufactured by Hirte s Fahl Arms Ltd. and produced on Pandora under license for use by SecOps. This weapon is favored by RDAs for its simplicity, durability, and low cost of manufacture, although SecOps personnel often consider it underpowered.
Rule.Translated: La pistola RDA es el arma de mano estándar de sus empleados. Es semiautomática, diseñada y fabricada por Hirte s Fahl Arms Ltd., y se produce bajo licencia en Pandora para SecOps. RDA la aprecia por su sencillez, resistencia y bajo coste, aunque el personal de SecOps suele considerarla poco potente.

Rule.Original: The FNG Hammer 1 is an accurate long-range nail gun that fires armor-piercing sub-caliber projectiles at high velocity. It fires titanium “nails” capable of penetrating almost all types of heavy armor. Unusually for a long-range weapon, the Nail Gun's ammunition is placed on top of the weapon, meaning that aiming down the weapon would be unconventional.
Rule.Raw: The FNG Hammer 1 is an accurate long-range nail gun that fires armor-piercing sub-caliber projectiles at high velocity. It fires titanium “nails” capable of penetrating almost all types of heavy armor. Unusually for a long-range weapon, the Nail Gun's ammunition is placed on top of the weapon, meaning that aiming down the weapon would be unconventional.
Rule.Translated: El FNG Hammer 1 es un arma de clavos precisa de largo alcance que dispara proyectiles subcalibrados perforantes a gran velocidad. Sus «clavos» de titanio pueden atravesar casi cualquier blindaje pesado. A diferencia de otras armas de largo alcance, la munición se coloca en la parte superior, por lo que apuntar resulta poco convencional.

Rule.Original: The CGL M222 is a powerful handheld grenade launcher used by RDA , which fires bursting projectiles. Specialists equipped with this weapon are often deployed in hot spots where the terrain does not allow the use of heavy equipment. This makes it critical for supporting forward troops, as it is powerful enough to take out some of the larger creatures on Pandora. The CGL M222 has quickly earned a reputation as a weapon for swift raids and surprise counterattacks
Rule.Raw: The CGL M222 is a powerful handheld grenade launcher used by RDA , which fires bursting projectiles. Specialists equipped with this weapon are often deployed in hot spots where the terrain does not allow the use of heavy equipment. This makes it critical for supporting forward troops, as it is powerful enough to take out some of the larger creatures on Pandora. The CGL M222 has quickly earned a reputation as a weapon for swift raids and surprise counterattacks
Rule.Translated: El CGL M222 es un potente lanzagranadas portátil utilizado por RDA que dispara proyectiles explosivos. Los especialistas que lo llevan suelen desplegarse en puntos conflictivos donde el terreno impide utilizar equipo pesado. Es esencial para apoyar a las tropas avanzadas, pues puede abatir a algunas de las mayores criaturas de Pandora. El CGL M222 se ha ganado rápidamente una reputación como arma para incursiones rápidas y contraataques sorpresa.

Rule.Original: CARB AR MUB is a standard assault rifle from MATANZA ARMS with modified underbarrel grenade launcher. This weapon has proven itself in many battles and conflicts. You can say that this weapon was ahead of its time, and now it is just a great rifle.
Rule.Raw: CARB AR MUB is a standard assault rifle from MATANZA ARMS with modified underbarrel grenade launcher. This weapon has proven itself in many battles and conflicts. You can say that this weapon was ahead of its time, and now it is just a great rifle.
Rule.Translated: El CARB AR MUB es un fusil de asalto estándar de MATANZA ARMS con un lanzagranadas bajo el cañón modificado. Ha demostrado su eficacia en muchas batallas y conflictos. Podría decirse que se adelantó a su tiempo; ahora sigue siendo un gran fusil.

Rule.Original: Heavy version of the CARB assault rifle with an underbarrel shotgun.
Rule.Raw: Heavy version of the CARB assault rifle with an underbarrel shotgun.
Rule.Translated: Versión pesada del fusil de asalto CARB con una escopeta bajo el cañón.

Rule.Original: CARB SR is an anti-material sniper rifle from MATANZA ARMS, designed to compete with FNG Hammer1. It is not as powerful as we would like it to be, but it shoots much faster than its competitor.
Rule.Raw: CARB SR is an anti-material sniper rifle from MATANZA ARMS, designed to compete with FNG Hammer1. It is not as powerful as we would like it to be, but it shoots much faster than its competitor.
Rule.Translated: El CARB SR es un fusil de francotirador antimaterial de MATANZA ARMS diseñado para competir con el FNG Hammer1. No es tan potente como nos gustaría, pero dispara mucho más rápido que su rival.

Rule.Original: CARB RL rocket launcher from MATANZA ARMS based on CARB. uses compact rockets with increased explosive charge compared to RDA's RML M83.
Rule.Raw: CARB RL rocket launcher from MATANZA ARMS based on CARB. uses compact rockets with increased explosive charge compared to RDA's RML M83.
Rule.Translated: El CARB RL es un lanzacohetes de MATANZA ARMS basado en la plataforma CARB. Utiliza cohetes compactos con una carga explosiva mayor que los del RML M83 de RDA.

Rule.Original: The AVR M30 is a heavy machine gun based on the M60 and produced by the RDA for the Avatar program. Designed specifically for the 10' frame of an avatar, the M30, has a high rate of fire and reasonable accuracy over long range. Unlike the M60 which fires depleted plutonium, the M30 fires more traditional 7.62x51mm NATO Caliber FMJ.
Rule.Raw: The AVR M30 is a heavy machine gun based on the M60 and produced by the RDA for the Avatar program. Designed specifically for the 10' frame of an avatar, the M30, has a high rate of fire and reasonable accuracy over long range. Unlike the M60 which fires depleted plutonium, the M30 fires more traditional 7.62x51mm NATO Caliber FMJ.
Rule.Translated: La AVR M30 es una ametralladora pesada basada en la M60 y producida por RDA para el programa Avatar. Diseñada para el cuerpo de 10' de un avatar, la M30 tiene una cadencia alta y una precisión razonable a larga distancia. A diferencia de la M60, que dispara plutonio empobrecido, la M30 utiliza munición tradicional FMJ de calibre 7.62x51mm NATO.

Rule.Original: The AVR M60 is a large caliber machine gun that has a medium rate of fire and good accuracy at long ranges. It also fires depleted plutonium rounds .This allows it to penetrate even the heaviest armor, although the thick, carbon fiber reinforced bones of some of Pandora's largest creatures can take it. The Na'vi, however, can be killed quickly due to the weapon's high rate of fire.
Rule.Raw: The AVR M60 is a large caliber machine gun that has a medium rate of fire and good accuracy at long ranges. It also fires depleted plutonium rounds .This allows it to penetrate even the heaviest armor, although the thick, carbon fiber reinforced bones of some of Pandora's largest creatures can take it. The Na'vi, however, can be killed quickly due to the weapon's high rate of fire.
Rule.Translated: La AVR M60 es una ametralladora de gran calibre con cadencia media y buena precisión a larga distancia. Dispara munición de plutonio empobrecido, lo que permite atravesar incluso los blindajes más pesados, aunque los gruesos huesos reforzados con fibra de carbono de algunas grandes criaturas de Pandora pueden resistirla. Sin embargo, su elevada cadencia permite matar rápidamente a los Na'vi.

Rule.Original: A very rare version of the AVR, designed to provide firepower and clear areas. There is also a larger version of this machine gun, which is used for air defense.
Rule.Raw: A very rare version of the AVR, designed to provide firepower and clear areas. There is also a larger version of this machine gun, which is used for air defense.
Rule.Translated: Una versión muy rara de la AVR diseñada para proporcionar potencia de fuego y despejar zonas. También existe una versión mayor para defensa antiaérea.

Rule.Original: A lightweight version of the Hydra stationary machine gun for tactical breakthroughs in enemy defense lines or adaptive territorial defense.
Rule.Raw: A lightweight version of the Hydra stationary machine gun for tactical breakthroughs in enemy defense lines or adaptive territorial defense.
Rule.Translated: Una versión ligera de la ametralladora fija Hydra para abrir brechas tácticas en las defensas enemigas o realizar defensa territorial adaptable.

Rule.Original: This rare rifle is a joint development between Matanza ARMS and RDA, combining CARB and railgun technologies. It is capable of piercing absolutely any armor and inflicting incredible damage on its target.
Rule.Raw: This rare rifle is a joint development between Matanza ARMS and RDA, combining CARB and railgun technologies. It is capable of piercing absolutely any armor and inflicting incredible damage on its target.
Rule.Translated: Este raro fusil es un desarrollo conjunto de Matanza ARMS y RDA que combina la tecnología CARB con la de los cañones de riel. Puede perforar absolutamente cualquier blindaje y causar daños increíbles al objetivo.

Rule.Original: The RDA Mk3 Knife otherwise known as the SecOps Knife is a standard-issue, combat knife used by normal RDA personnel.
Rule.Raw: The RDA Mk3 Knife otherwise known as the SecOps Knife is a standard-issue, combat knife used by normal RDA personnel.
Rule.Translated: El cuchillo RDA Mk3, también llamado cuchillo SecOps, es el cuchillo de combate reglamentario del personal común de RDA.

Rule.Original: The Falcata is a large knife, similar in size to a machete. RDA employees can purchase it instead of the standard RDA Mk3 knife.
Rule.Raw: The Falcata is a large knife, similar in size to a machete. RDA employees can purchase it instead of the standard RDA Mk3 knife.
Rule.Translated: La Falcata es un cuchillo grande, de tamaño similar al de un machete. Los empleados de RDA pueden comprarlo en lugar del cuchillo estándar RDA Mk3.

Rule.Original: Automated artillery system specialized in tracking and engaging subterranean threats.
Rule.Raw: Automated artillery system specialized in tracking and engaging subterranean threats.
Rule.Translated: Sistema de artillería automatizado especializado en rastrear y atacar amenazas subterráneas.

Rule.Original: Teleports an enemy combatant adjacent to a nearby allied unit.
Rule.Raw: Teleports an enemy combatant adjacent to a nearby allied unit.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta a un combatiente enemigo junto a una unidad aliada cercana.

Rule.Original: The psychic Militor instantly teleports a target to a designated location using telekinesis.
Rule.Raw: The psychic Militor instantly teleports a target to a designated location using telekinesis.
Rule.Translated: El Militor psíquico teletransporta al instante un objetivo a una ubicación designada mediante telequinesis.

Rule.Original: The psychic Militor uses telekinesis to partially heal scars on all allies within a 25-cell radius.
Rule.Raw: The psychic Militor uses telekinesis to partially heal scars on all allies within a 25-cell radius.
Rule.Translated: El Militor psíquico usa telequinesis para curar parcialmente cicatrices de todos los aliados en un radio de 25 casillas.
Suministro de escudos de primera línea

Rule.Original: The psychic Militor telekinetically steals three shield packs from the nearest trade ship's cargo hold and instantly equips them on the three allies closest to enemy forces.
Rule.Raw: The psychic Militor telekinetically steals three shield packs from the nearest trade ship's cargo hold and instantly equips them on the three allies closest to enemy forces.
Rule.Translated: El Militor psíquico roba telequinéticamente tres paquetes de escudo de la bodega de la nave comercial más cercana y los equipa al instante en los tres aliados más próximos a las fuerzas enemigas.

Rule.Original: The psychic Militor uses telekinesis to partially heal scars on all allies within a 25-cell radius.
Rule.Raw: The psychic Militor uses telekinesis to partially heal scars on all allies within a 25-cell radius.
Rule.Translated: El Militor psíquico usa telequinesis para curar parcialmente cicatrices de todos los aliados en un radio de 25 casillas.
Despliegue de escudos de primera línea

Rule.Original: The psychic Militor telekinetically retrieves three shield packs from the nearest merchant vessel's cargo racks and instantly deploys them onto three frontline allies positioned nearest to hostile forces.
Rule.Raw: The psychic Militor telekinetically retrieves three shield packs from the nearest merchant vessel's cargo racks and instantly deploys them onto three frontline allies positioned nearest to hostile forces.
Rule.Translated: El Militor psíquico recupera telequinéticamente tres paquetes de escudo de las bodegas de la nave mercante más cercana y los despliega al instante sobre tres aliados de primera línea situados más cerca de fuerzas hostiles.

Rule.Original: 隔壁偷来的护盾生成器
Rule.Raw: 隔壁偷来的护盾生成器
Rule.Translated: generador de escudo robado al vecino

Rule.Original: 灵能小镰用念力从隔壁偷来了护盾生成器，因传送匆忙忘了拆标签。很快，商船上的灵能者就会循着标签将护盾折跃回去。
Rule.Raw: 灵能小镰用念力从隔壁偷来了护盾生成器，因传送匆忙忘了拆标签。很快，商船上的灵能者就会循着标签将护盾折跃回去。
Rule.Translated: El pequeño segador psíquico ha robado un generador de escudo al vecino mediante telequinesis. Con las prisas del transporte, se ha olvidado de quitarle la etiqueta. Pronto, los psíquicos de la nave comercial seguirán su señal y teletransportarán el escudo de vuelta.

Rule.Original: Propels toward target, displacing enemies along trajectory and generating large-area effect at impact zone.
Rule.Raw: Propels toward target, displacing enemies along trajectory and generating large-area effect at impact zone.
Rule.Translated: Se impulsa hacia el objetivo, aparta a los enemigos de su trayectoria y genera un efecto de área en el punto de impacto.

Rule.Original: Self Repair, can recover 15 scars on the user itself
Rule.Raw: Self Repair, can recover 15 scars on the user itself
Rule.Translated: Autorreparación; puede reparar hasta 15 cicatrices del propio usuario.
Despliegue del Sistema de Velo Binario

Rule.Original: Deploys smokescreen generators to create visual-obscurement fields while simultaneously launching two Gyro-Blades.
Rule.Raw: Deploys smokescreen generators to create visual-obscurement fields while simultaneously launching two Gyro-Blades.
Rule.Translated: Despliega generadores de cortina de humo para crear campos de ocultación visual mientras lanza simultáneamente dos Girocuchillas.

Rule.Original: Overdrives nanomachines for instantaneous spatial translocation. Impact releases kinetic shockwave devastating nearby enemies while generating 16 unstable energy arcs. Post-translocation, user enters enhanced combat mode with significantly increased mobility, defense, and attack frequency.
Rule.Raw: Overdrives nanomachines for instantaneous spatial translocation. Impact releases kinetic shockwave devastating nearby enemies while generating 16 unstable energy arcs. Post-translocation, user enters enhanced combat mode with significantly increased mobility, defense, and attack frequency.
Rule.Translated: Sobrecarga las nanomáquinas para realizar una translocación espacial instantánea. El impacto libera una onda cinética devastadora contra enemigos cercanos y genera 16 arcos de energía inestable. Después de la translocación, el usuario entra en un modo de combate mejorado con mayor movilidad, defensa y frecuencia de ataque.

Rule.Original: This lunar bionic-derived combat protocol enables temporary omnipotent combat state: perfect accuracy, zero action delay, instant target acquisition, dark-phase teleportation, and cryonic suspension of enemies in shadows. The godlike state lasts precisely 5 hours before neural collapse renders the implantee combat-ineffective.
Rule.Raw: This lunar bionic-derived combat protocol enables temporary omnipotent combat state: perfect accuracy, zero action delay, instant target acquisition, dark-phase teleportation, and cryonic suspension of enemies in shadows. The godlike state lasts precisely 5 hours before neural collapse renders the implantee combat-ineffective.
Rule.Translated: Este protocolo de combate derivado de un implante biónico lunar permite alcanzar temporalmente un estado de combate casi omnipotente: precisión perfecta, ausencia de retraso entre acciones, adquisición instantánea de objetivos, teletransporte de fase oscura y suspensión criónica de enemigos en las sombras. El estado dura exactamente 5 horas antes de que el colapso neural deje al implantado incapacitado para combatir.

Rule.Original: Yggdrasil-root inspired quantum translocation system enabling terrain-ignoring free teleportation.
Rule.Raw: Yggdrasil-root inspired quantum translocation system enabling terrain-ignoring free teleportation.
Rule.Translated: Sistema de translocación cuántica inspirado en las raíces de Yggdrasil que permite teletransportarse libremente ignorando el terreno.

Rule.Original: extend or retract a tiny, shoulder mounted automatic turret
Rule.Raw: extend or retract a tiny, shoulder mounted automatic turret
Rule.Translated: Extiende o retrae una pequeña torreta automática montada en el hombro.

Rule.Original: Detonates the mechanoid, instantly destroying it and damaging all nearby entities regardless of allegiance.
Rule.Raw: Detonates the mechanoid, instantly destroying it and damaging all nearby entities regardless of allegiance.
Rule.Translated: Detona el mecanoide, destruyéndolo al instante y dañando a todas las entidades cercanas sin importar su bando.

Rule.Original: Propels toward target, displacing enemies along trajectory and generating large-area effect at impact zone.
Rule.Raw: Propels toward target, displacing enemies along trajectory and generating large-area effect at impact zone.
Rule.Translated: Se impulsa hacia el objetivo, aparta a los enemigos de su trayectoria y genera un efecto de área en el punto de impacto.
Crónicas de combate: fusil de francotirador
Crónicas de combate: fusil de carga

Rule.Original:
「滋——嘟……量子链路建立成功！」
电子屏幕剧烈闪烁后，突然映出一顶压低的宽檐帽，帽檐下传来带着电流杂音的少女声：
「Fieldy在线验证——咦？这频段明明该接贸易中转站的呀？」
（镜头拉远露出半张脸）「你谁啊？天轴的幸存者？还是……（突然警觉）该不会又是机械族的仿生陷阱吧？」
Rule.Raw:
「滋——嘟……量子链路建立成功！」
电子屏幕剧烈闪烁后，突然映出一顶压低的宽檐帽，帽檐下传来带着电流杂音的少女声：

Rule.Translated:
«Bzzzt... bip... ¡Enlace cuántico establecido!»
Tras un intenso parpadeo, la pantalla muestra de repente un sombrero de ala ancha calado hasta abajo. Desde debajo del ala se oye la voz de una chica entre interferencias:
«Verificación de Fieldy en línea... ¿Eh? ¿No debería esta frecuencia conectar con la estación de tránsito comercial?»
(La cámara se aleja y muestra media cara). «¿Quién eres? ¿Un superviviente del Eje Celeste? ¿O... (se pone alerta de repente) otra trampa biónica de los mecanoides?»

Rule.Original:
「新殖民地？（突然笑出声）哈！我就知道——只有你们这些刚降落边缘世界的愣头青，才会用这种老古董频段！」
「让我看看你们的位置...等等，这个坐标附近不是有台战争信标吗？你们该不会已经手贱激活了吧？」
（快速扫描数据ing） 「唔...信号读数还算稳定，看来你们运气不错。听着，那玩意儿可不是什么好玩具，上次有个殖民地乱碰信标，没几天就被强化后的机械族给拆了，虽然说那玩意内部的确有可能藏有什么珍贵情报...」
「不过既然你们还没变成废铁，按照《边缘世界团结互助条例》第三章第十二款，NCL很乐意帮助迷路的开拓者啦！虽然资源有限...（小声嘀咕）但总比看着你们被机械族拆了强～」
Rule.Raw:

Rule.Translated:
«¿Una colonia nueva? (Se echa a reír). ¡Ja! ¡Lo sabía! ¡Solo unos novatos recién llegados a un mundo fronterizo usarían una frecuencia tan anticuada!»
«Veamos vuestra posición... Un momento, ¿no hay una baliza de guerra cerca de esas coordenadas? No me digáis que ya habéis tenido la mala idea de activarla».
(Escanea los datos rápidamente). «Mmm... Las lecturas son bastante estables. Habéis tenido suerte. Escuchad, eso no es ningún juguete. La última colonia que toqueteó una baliza acabó destrozada por mecanoides reforzados en pocos días, aunque es verdad que podría contener información valiosa...»
«Pero, como todavía no sois chatarra, según el capítulo tercero, artículo duodécimo del Reglamento de Solidaridad y Ayuda Mutua de los Mundos Fronterizos, ¡NCL se alegra de ayudar a los pioneros perdidos! Aunque los recursos sean limitados... (murmura) sigue siendo mejor que ver cómo os desmantelan los mecanoides».

Rule.Original:
「（突然象征性地立正敬礼）‘为人类存续而奋斗！’——官方口号嘛，喊还是要喊一下的～（肩膀立刻松懈下来）」
「其实就是几个幸存者据点凑成的互助群组。以前嘛...可能还像点样子，但自从闪耀世界那边爆发了智械革命，我们这边也开始疯狂减员...现在嘛，不剩多少人了。」
「大本营在离你们五个地月距离的一颗人造卫星上，现在主要靠迫降到就近的行星做些买卖，回收些机械族残骸来发展。」
「至于那个《条例》？我们老大56年前编的，一共六百六十六页！真正的核心思想就一条——，撑久一点，至少撑到能叫人来给你收尸的地步。’」
「所以，既然联系上了，也算认识了。以后真遇到搞不定的麻烦，如果频道还通着... 可以试着呼叫我们。力所能及的范围内，我们或许能想想办法搭把手。」

Rule.Translated:
«(Se cuadra y saluda de forma simbólica). “¡Luchar por la supervivencia humana!” Es el lema oficial, así que hay que gritarlo un poco... (Relaja los hombros enseguida)».
«En realidad somos un grupo de ayuda mutua formado por varios puestos de supervivientes. Antes... quizá éramos algo más organizado, pero desde la revolución de las máquinas en los mundos avanzados estamos perdiendo gente sin parar. Ya no quedamos muchos».
«Nuestra base está en un satélite artificial a cinco distancias Tierra-Luna de vosotros. Ahora vivimos sobre todo de aterrizar en planetas cercanos para comerciar y recuperar restos de mecanoides con los que desarrollarnos».
«¿El reglamento? Lo escribió nuestro jefe hace 56 años. ¡Tiene seiscientas sesenta y seis páginas! En realidad, la idea principal es solo una: aguanta lo suficiente para que al menos puedas llamar a alguien que recoja tu cadáver».
«Bueno, ya que hemos conectado, ya nos conocemos. Si algún día os metéis en problemas que no podáis resolver y el canal sigue abierto... podéis intentar llamarnos. Quizá podamos echaros una mano dentro de nuestras posibilidades».

Rule.Original: 你启动了通讯台,然而对面似乎没有回应
Rule.Raw: 你启动了通讯台,然而对面似乎没有回应
Rule.Translated: Has activado la consola de comunicaciones, pero nadie parece responder al otro lado.

Rule.Original: 来吧，让我看到你的挣扎!
Rule.Raw: 来吧，让我看到你的挣扎!

Rule.Original: 喂喂喂，通讯突然断了，你那边发生了什么事吗？
Rule.Raw: 喂喂喂，通讯突然断了，你那边发生了什么事吗？
Rule.Translated: ¡Eh, eh! La comunicación se ha cortado de repente. ¿Ha pasado algo por ahí?

Rule.Original: 你没什么自己要忙的事吗？
Rule.Raw: 你没什么自己要忙的事吗？
Rule.Translated: ¿No tienes tus propios asuntos que atender?

Rule.Original:
Fieldy： “援兵？说来惭愧，咱们这儿也不剩几个活人了，直接派舰队支援是没戏了。”
“不过嘛，也不是完全没人能派...emmm，这样吧！我听我家那两位机械师说，他们刚弄出个新型泰坦机械体，还在调试阶段。虽然是待测试的，但毕竟是泰坦级别，战斗力你们绝对可以放心！”
（调出一个巨大但有些闪烁的泰坦投影）“那些白大褂肯定很乐意收集实战数据。等着，我去问问她愿不愿意把它送到你们那儿，帮你们守城顺便测试！”（话音刚落，Fieldy的身影就从屏幕上消失了）
【约5分钟后】 （屏幕重新亮起，Fieldy微喘着气）“OK！她答应了，少有这么爽快！（快速操作）先给你们发份操作手册...（投影中的泰坦模型突然抽搐了一下）别看它这样，拆起机械族可利索了！条件是...（查看清单）嗯...每天提供20单位钢铁给它当‘零食费’？”
（确认发送完毕）“好了！你们没意见的话，我这就让它往你们那边动身了。预计2天之内就能赶到！”

Rule.Translated:
Fieldy: «¿Refuerzos? Me da vergüenza decirlo, pero aquí apenas quedan personas vivas. No podemos enviar una flota».
«Pero tampoco es que no podamos mandar a nadie... Mmm, ¡hagamos esto! He oído a nuestros dos mecánicos decir que acaban de construir un nuevo titán mecánico. Sigue en fase de ajustes, pero, aunque esté por probar, ¡es de clase titán y su potencia de combate está garantizada!»
(Muestra una enorme proyección de titán que parpadea ligeramente). «Seguro que los de las batas blancas estarán encantados de obtener datos de combate real. Esperad, voy a preguntarle si quiere enviároslo para defender vuestra colonia y probarlo de paso». (Nada más acabar la frase, Fieldy desaparece de la pantalla).
【Unos 5 minutos después】 (La pantalla vuelve a encenderse y Fieldy aparece algo jadeante). «¡Vale! Ha aceptado, ¡qué rapidez tan poco habitual! (Teclea deprisa). Primero os envío un manual... (El modelo de titán se sacude de repente). No os fijéis en eso, ¡desmonta mecanoides de maravilla! La condición es... (consulta una lista) mmm... ¿darle 20 unidades de acero diarias como “dinero para aperitivos”?»
(Confirma el envío). «¡Listo! Si os parece bien, haré que se ponga en camino. ¡Debería llegar en 2 días!»

Rule.Original: 确认申请（官方作弊码，不建议过度依赖于它）
Rule.Raw: 确认申请（官方作弊码，不建议过度依赖于它）

Rule.Translated: Intentas conectar con el canal especial, pero nadie responde al otro lado de la pantalla. Solo se oyen interferencias esporádicas.

Rule.Original: “我听见你灵魂的饥渴了...人类。但史诗的真谛，从来要用血与火来书写。” （全息投影突然在硝烟中凝聚，呈现一座燃烧的特洛伊城微缩模型） “真相？当然可以给你。可你确定付得起入场券么？” “现在转身离去——还能当个糊涂的活死人。
Rule.Raw: “我听见你灵魂的饥渴了...人类。但史诗的真谛，从来要用血与火来书写。” （全息投影突然在硝烟中凝聚，呈现一座燃烧的特洛伊城微缩模型） “真相？当然可以给你。可你确定付得起入场券么？” “现在转身离去——还能当个糊涂的活死人。
Rule.Translated: «He oído el hambre de tu alma... humano. Pero la esencia de la épica siempre se escribe con sangre y fuego». (Una proyección holográfica aparece entre el humo y muestra una maqueta de Troya en llamas). «¿La verdad? Claro que puedo dártela. Pero ¿estás seguro de poder pagar la entrada?» «Date la vuelta ahora y aún podrás seguir siendo un cadáver viviente ignorante».

Rule.Original: 好,蠕虫现在已经进入休眠状态了
Rule.Raw: 好,蠕虫现在已经进入休眠状态了
Rule.Translated: Bien, el gusano ha entrado en hibernación.

Rule.Original: 好,蠕虫现在已经恢复活跃状态了
Rule.Raw: 好,蠕虫现在已经恢复活跃状态了
Rule.Translated: Bien, el gusano ha vuelto al estado activo.

Rule.Raw: 「想交易？当然行！我可是吃这碗饭的」 「不光跟我们，我还能帮你连线几个常跑这条线的老油条商船。需要的时候吱一声，我立马让他们调头往你们那破地方赶。」
Rule.Translated: «¿Quieres comerciar? ¡Claro! Es mi especialidad». «Además de comerciar con nosotros, puedo ponerte en contacto con varias naves mercantes veteranas de esta ruta. Avísame cuando las necesites y haré que cambien de rumbo hacia vuestro destartalado puesto».

Rule.Original: 别急，不是什么时候都碰巧有商船经过的
Rule.Raw: 别急，不是什么时候都碰巧有商船经过的
Rule.Translated: Paciencia: no siempre pasa una nave comercial por casualidad.

Rule.Original: Signal acquired. Comm channel decrypted. Proceed with directive?
Rule.Raw: Signal acquired. Comm channel decrypted. Proceed with directive?
Rule.Translated: Señal adquirida. Canal de comunicaciones descifrado. ¿Proceder con la orden?
Marcando las coordenadas de transmisión descifradas...

Rule.Original:
「Bzzrt— Beep... Quantum link established!」
The screen flickers violently before resolving onto a wide-brimmed fedora pulled low. A girl’s voice crackles through static:
「Fieldy authentication— Huh? This channel’s supposed to route to Trade Hub.」
(Perspective widens, revealing half her face) 「Who’re you? Glitterworld survivor? Or... (suddenly tense) Another mechanoid bionic trap?」

Rule.Original:
(Sudden laughter) "New colony? Hah! Only rookies fresh on the Rim would use this antique frequency!"
(Keys clattering) "Let me check your coordinates... Wait. Isn't there a War Beacon near you? Please tell me you didn't activate that thing?"
(Rapid scanning sounds) "Hmm... readings stable. You got lucky. That beacon's no toy—last colony that touched it got shredded by enhanced Mechanoids within days." Leans closer, voice dropping. "Though rumor says its core holds priceless intel..."
"But since you're not scrap metal yet..." Taps a faded emblem on her jacket. "Per Chapter 3, Article 12 of the Rimworld Solidarity Act, NCL assists lost pioneers. Limited supplies, but..." (smirks) "better than watching Mechanoids recycle you~"

Rule.Raw: What organization are you people exactly?

Rule.Original:
(Snaps a mock salute) "Fighting for humanity's survival!" —gotta chant the official motto~ (immediately slumps) "Total nonsense, obviously."
"Truth is, we're just a support collective cobbled from survivor outposts. Used to be semi-organized... till the Glitterworld's 'Machine Revolution' started wiping us out."
(Taps star chart) "Headquarters? A derelict satellite five lunar orbits away. We scrape by trading on nearby planets and salvaging mechanoid wrecks."
"That 'Solidarity Act'? Our boss wrote it 56 years ago—666 pages of pure fluff. Real rule's simple: Survive long enough for someone to bury your corpse."
(Leans in, static flickering) "Since we're connected now... if you're truly screwed and the channel's hot? Call us. We'll do... what we can."
