(Snaps a mock salute) "Fighting for humanity's survival!" —gotta chant the official motto~ (immediately slumps) "Total nonsense, obviously."

Rule.Translated:
(Hace un saludo militar fingido). «¡Luchar por la supervivencia humana! Hay que recitar el lema oficial... (Se relaja inmediatamente). Una tontería, por supuesto».
«La verdad es que somos un colectivo de apoyo formado por puestos de supervivientes. Antes estábamos más o menos organizados, hasta que la “revolución de las máquinas” de los mundos avanzados empezó a exterminarnos».
(Señala una carta estelar). «¿Nuestra base? Un satélite abandonado a cinco órbitas lunares de distancia. Sobrevivimos comerciando en planetas cercanos y recuperando restos de mecanoides».
«¿La Ley de Solidaridad? Nuestro jefe la escribió hace 56 años: 666 páginas de palabrería. La verdadera regla es sencilla: sobrevive lo suficiente para que alguien entierre tu cadáver».
(Se acerca entre interferencias). «Ya que hemos conectado... si os veis realmente desesperados y el canal sigue abierto, llamadnos. Haremos... lo que podamos».

Rule.Original:
Console online... establishing carrier wave...
Frequency open. No response detected.
Static sputters in the dark.
Rule.Raw:
Console online... establishing carrier wave...
Frequency open. No response detected.
Static sputters in the dark.
Rule.Translated:
Consola en línea... Estableciendo onda portadora...
Frecuencia abierta. No se detecta respuesta.
Las interferencias crepitan en la oscuridad.

Rule.Original: Come on, let me see your struggle!
Rule.Raw: Come on, let me see your struggle!

Rule.Original: "Hello? Comms dropped suddenly—what happened on your end?"
Rule.Raw: "Hello? Comms dropped suddenly—what happened on your end?"
Rule.Translated: «¿Hola? La comunicación se ha cortado de repente. ¿Qué ha pasado por ahí?»

Rule.Original: "Don't you have your own business to handle?"
Rule.Raw: "Don't you have your own business to handle?"
Rule.Translated: «¿No tienes tus propios asuntos que atender?»

Rule.Original:
"Reinforcements? Embarrassing truth—barely any living souls left here. Sending fleets is impossible."
"But... we might have one option. Our mechanitor just built a prototype titan. Still debugging, but titan-grade firepower? Absolutely reliable!"
(A glitching titan hologram flickers) "Those lab-coats crave combat data. Hold on—let me beg them to lend it for your defense!" (Screen cuts abruptly)
[5 mins later] (Fieldy reappears, slightly breathless) "Done! She agreed shockingly fast! Sending manual now... (projected titan spasms) Don't mind the glitches—it shreds mechanoids! Cost? (checks list) 20 steel daily ‘maintenance rations’. Deal?"
(Keys clattering) "Departing now! ETA: 48 hours. Try not to get flattened~"

Rule.Translated:
«¿Refuerzos? La triste verdad es que aquí apenas quedan personas vivas. Es imposible enviar flotas».
«Pero... quizá tengamos una opción. Nuestra mecanitora acaba de construir un prototipo de titán. Aún estamos corrigiendo fallos, pero ¿potencia de fuego de clase titán? ¡Totalmente fiable!»
(Un holograma de titán con fallos parpadea). «Los de las batas blancas ansían datos de combate. ¡Esperad, voy a suplicarles que os lo presten para defenderos!» (La pantalla se corta de repente).
[5 minutos después] (Fieldy reaparece, algo jadeante). «¡Listo! ¡Ha aceptado sorprendentemente rápido! Enviando el manual... (El titán proyectado se sacude). No os preocupéis por los fallos, ¡destroza mecanoides! ¿El coste? (Consulta una lista). 20 de acero diarios como “raciones de mantenimiento”. ¿Trato hecho?»
(Teclea). «¡Sale ahora! Llegada prevista: 48 horas. Procurad que no os aplasten».

Rule.Original:
The origins of this massive mechanical entity are sealed under the highest levels of confidentiality by the NCL, leaving you burning with curiosity but unable to investigate. You have personally witnessed its miraculous lethality on the battlefield, and at this moment, you can only be grateful that it is temporarily aligned with the alliance—though this peculiar state is fraught with unknowns.
Worm Traits:
Damage Absorption: After taking damage, the worm becomes temporarily immune to subsequent damage of the same type.
Warp Bullets: The worm can use telekinesis to vanish incoming enemy bullets into space. After warping a certain number of bullets, this ability enters a cooldown period.
Energy Shield: The worm possesses an energy shield. Once shattered, the shield requires a cooldown period before regenerating.
Warp Manipulation: The worm randomly selects nearby enemies and either warps them to the edge of the map or pulls them close to itself.
Chaotic Warp: After a long charge-up, the worm warps all enemies on the map randomly to the edges.
Means of Damage:
Destructive Beam: After a brief charge, the worm fires an immensely powerful, infinite-range beam.
Thunderstrike: The worm summons several bolts of lightning from the sky to strike enemies across the map.
Worm Tracking Cannon: Periodically, the worm fires volleys from its joints, releasing moderately powerful homing bullets that ignore enemy shields.
Dragon's Final Blow: The worm burrows underground and charges straight toward its target, dealing massive impact damage.

Rule.Translated:
Los orígenes de esta enorme entidad mecánica están protegidos por los niveles de confidencialidad más altos de NCL. Has presenciado personalmente su extraordinaria letalidad y solo puedes agradecer que, por ahora, esté alineada con la alianza.
Rasgos del Worm:
Absorción de daño: tras recibir daño, se vuelve temporalmente inmune a nuevos ataques del mismo tipo.
Distorsión de proyectiles: puede hacer desaparecer telequinéticamente balas enemigas. Tras desviar cierta cantidad, la habilidad entra en recarga.
Escudo de energía: posee un escudo que se regenera tras un periodo de recarga.
Manipulación espacial: puede enviar enemigos cercanos al borde del mapa o atraerlos hacia sí.
Distorsión caótica: tras una larga carga, desplaza aleatoriamente a todos los enemigos del mapa hacia los bordes.
Ataques: haz destructivo de alcance ilimitado, rayos, cañón rastreador Worm y una embestida subterránea de enorme impacto.

Rule.Original: High-power mechanoid signal emitter vastly exceeding standard beacon capacity. Activation releases a catastrophic pulse summoning the titan-class Doxa-0 with its escort forces. Victory yields rare tech components from the wreckage. The pulse overload destroys the emitter after single use.
Rule.Raw: High-power mechanoid signal emitter vastly exceeding standard beacon capacity. Activation releases a catastrophic pulse summoning the titan-class Doxa-0 with its escort forces. Victory yields rare tech components from the wreckage. The pulse overload destroys the emitter after single use.
Rule.Translated: Emisor de señal mecanoide de enorme potencia que supera ampliamente la capacidad de una baliza estándar. Al activarlo libera un pulso catastrófico que invoca al titán Doxa-0 y a sus escoltas. La victoria permite recuperar componentes tecnológicos raros. El pulso destruye el emisor tras un único uso.

Rule.Original:
Doxa-0 is an autonomous tactical fire control hub modeled after large arachnid organisms. As a key unit among mechanoids, it possesses multiple tactical functions including area suppression, target designation, and summoning support.
Doxa-0 moves slowly, typically advancing across terrain at low frequency. When entering its "Artillery Lock" state, the main body becomes fully automated and stationary, activating its rocket artillery module mounted on the third dorsal segment to deliver high-coverage, shield-penetrating strikes.
Additionally, Doxa-0 features self-defense mechanisms: during combat, it periodically incubates and releases "Shellsplitter" units - fast, fragile but highly dangerous small support mechanoids. Shellsplitters release localized shockwaves and EMP disruption pulses upon death, dealing area damage to targets and impairing their electronic capabilities.
Its massive neural core system grants it powerful target calculation and fire control coordination capabilities. If its deployment activities are not quickly interrupted, it may completely dominate the battle rhythm through overwhelming suppression.
Rule.Raw:
静巢构体（Doxa-0） 是机械族中最具战术深度与火力协调能力的单位之一，其原型来自蛛形掠食者，却被机械族重构为一座自律运算的泰坦级战术火力中枢。它的设计目的并非快速歼敌，而是通过持续压制、火控锁定与战场管理，逐步令敌方陷入战术瘫痪。在整支机械军团中，Doxa-0 的部署通常意味着一场区域性的决战已悄然开始。
行进中的 Doxa-0 缓慢、沉重，以几近仪式感的低频节奏在地表推进。然而，一旦其进入“架炮锁定”状态，它将主动固定于地面，解锁第三身节中的火箭阵列模块，对大片区域进行持续性的穿盾性饱和打击。在此模式下，Doxa-0 彻底抛弃机动性，转而成为一座半永久性的火力节点，压制敌方任何形式的集结或推进。
Rule.Translated:
Doxa-0 es un centro autónomo de control táctico de fuego inspirado en grandes arácnidos. Posee funciones de supresión de área, designación de objetivos y solicitud de apoyo.
Se desplaza lentamente y, al entrar en estado de «Bloqueo de artillería», queda inmóvil y automatiza su módulo de cohetes para lanzar ataques de gran cobertura que atraviesan escudos.
Durante el combate también incuba Shellsplitter, pequeños mecanoides rápidos y frágiles que liberan ondas de choque y pulsos PEM al morir. Si no se interrumpe rápidamente, Doxa-0 puede dominar por completo el ritmo de la batalla.

Rule.Original: A high-intensity signal device designed to summon the titan-class Fortified Shell Construct. Activation transmits exclusive orbital commands, deploying the construct via combat drop to coordinate assaults with primary mechanoid forces. The impact causes localized terrain destruction while initiating global missile suppression. The device self-destructs after activation and is single-use only. Defeating the Fortified Shell Construct yields its tactical core, unlocking corresponding technology pathways.
Rule.Raw: A high-intensity signal device designed to summon the titan-class Fortified Shell Construct. Activation transmits exclusive orbital commands, deploying the construct via combat drop to coordinate assaults with primary mechanoid forces. The impact causes localized terrain destruction while initiating global missile suppression. The device self-destructs after activation and is single-use only. Defeating the Fortified Shell Construct yields its tactical core, unlocking corresponding technology pathways.
Rule.Translated: Dispositivo de señal de alta intensidad diseñado para invocar al Constructo Shell Fortificado de clase titán. Su activación transmite órdenes orbitales exclusivas y despliega el constructo mediante descenso de combate para coordinarse con las fuerzas mecanoides principales. El dispositivo se autodestruye tras un único uso. Derrotar al constructo permite recuperar su núcleo táctico y desbloquear tecnologías relacionadas.

Rule.Original:
Shell Fortification Construct (Shell_Fortconstruct) is an extremely rare titan-class unit among mechanoids, standing twenty meters tall and clad in massive armor composed of multiple layers of alien metals and alloy fragments, presenting an awe-inspiring presence. Its design philosophy combines multiple strategic objectives including siege warfare, suppression, and area control, excelling particularly at breaching enemy defensive lines and clearing battlefield remnants with absolute firepower.
The Shell Fortification Construct typically descends from the sky, crashing heavily at the colony's periphery, entering a turret-mode standby state while launching missiles to cause localized earthquakes and panic. Simultaneously, attached mechanoid main forces will drop from the opposite side, forming pincer attack formations that dramatically intensify offensive pressure.
Rule.Raw: 『壳堡构体』是机械族中极为罕见的泰坦级单位，其体高二十米，身披多层金属混铸而成的庞大外壳，其设计理念结合了攻坚、压制与区域控制的多重战略目标，尤其擅长在敌方防线中撕裂缺口，并以绝对火力清扫战场残余。『壳堡构体』通常自天际坠落，重重地落在殖民地边缘，以“炮塔形态”进入待命状态，发射导弹引发局部地震和恐慌。与此同时，配属的机械族主力部队将从另一侧空投登陆，与其构成前后夹击态势，极大增强攻势张力。
Rule.Translated:
El Constructo de Fortificación Shell (Shell_Fortconstruct) es una unidad mecanoide de clase titán extremadamente rara, de unos veinte metros de altura y cubierta por un enorme blindaje multicapa de metales alienígenas y aleaciones. Su diseño combina guerra de asedio, supresión y control de área, y destaca al romper líneas defensivas mediante una potencia de fuego absoluta.
Suele descender desde el cielo en el perímetro de la colonia, entrar en modo torreta y lanzar misiles capaces de provocar terremotos localizados y pánico, mientras las fuerzas mecanoides principales descienden desde el lado opuesto para formar una pinza.

Al activarse, el implantado entra en un estado de combate casi divino: el tiempo parece congelarse y la destrucción llega antes de que el enemigo pueda reaccionar. Al finalizar, sufre un colapso neural completo, parálisis sensorial y pérdida de capacidad de combate.

Rule.Raw: Through tactical networks built by anti-stealth radar, real-time optimization of mechanoid fire control systems significantly improves shooting accuracy and battlefield response speed

Rule.Original: "Like the moon falling into the sea." Inevitable aftereffect following termination of the "Final Gaze" protocol, resulting from quantum entanglement structure rupture between photon crystal beams and neural guidance membranes, causing host's entire sensory and motor systems to enter decoherence collapse phase. Although consciousness remains, body and mind are severely dysregulated
Rule.Raw: "Like the moon falling into the sea." Inevitable aftereffect following termination of the "Final Gaze" protocol, resulting from quantum entanglement structure rupture between photon crystal beams and neural guidance membranes, causing host's entire sensory and motor systems to enter decoherence collapse phase. Although consciousness remains, body and mind are severely dysregulated
Rule.Translated: «Como la luna cayendo al mar». Secuela inevitable tras finalizar el protocolo «Mirada Final», causada por la ruptura de la estructura de entrelazamiento cuántico entre haces de cristal fotónico y membranas de guía neural. Todo el sistema sensorial y motor del huésped entra en una fase de colapso por decoherencia. Aunque conserva la consciencia, cuerpo y mente quedan gravemente desregulados.

Rule.Original: Stimulated by moonlight radiation, the implanted photon crystal beam iris and neural spectral guidance membrane resonate, putting the host into an overload state with significantly enhanced combat perception and reaction speed
Rule.Raw: Stimulated by moonlight radiation, the implanted photon crystal beam iris and neural spectral guidance membrane resonate, putting the host into an overload state with significantly enhanced combat perception and reaction speed
Rule.Translated: Estimulado por la radiación lunar, el iris implantado de haces de cristal fotónico y la membrana de guía espectral neural entran en resonancia, llevando al huésped a un estado de sobrecarga con percepción de combate y velocidad de reacción notablemente mejoradas.

Rule.Original: Nano-fluids actively regulate physiological state, enhancing physical efficiency and operational adaptability
Rule.Raw: Nano-fluids actively regulate physiological state, enhancing physical efficiency and operational adaptability
Rule.Translated: Nanofluidos regulan activamente el estado fisiológico, mejorando la eficiencia física y la adaptabilidad operativa.

Rule.Original: Centurion Arsenal Codex: Composite Tactical Backmount
Rule.Raw: Centurion Arsenal Codex: Composite Tactical Backmount
Rule.Translated: Codex del Arsenal Centurión: soporte táctico compuesto

Rule.Original: You now have everything, go for it.
Rule.Raw: You now have everything, go for it.

Rule.Translated: Efecto invisible con torreta de hombro.

Rule.Original: A low caliber autonomous gun made to be mounted on a shoulder.
Rule.Raw: A low caliber autonomous gun made to be mounted on a shoulder.
Rule.Translated: Un arma autónoma de pequeño calibre diseñada para montarse sobre el hombro.

Rule.Original: This device replaces the heart as the energy center, with its titanium-tungsten ceramic ventricle housing 3600 nano-neural clusters that generate photon jets by electrolyzing iron elements in the blood.
Rule.Raw: 该装置取代心脏成为能量中枢，其钛钨陶瓷心室内置3600枚纳米神经簇，通过电解血液中的铁元素产生光子喷流。
Rule.Translated: Este dispositivo sustituye al corazón como centro energético; su ventrículo cerámico de titanio-tungsteno alberga 3600 clústeres nanoneurales que generan chorros fotónicos mediante electrólisis del hierro de la sangre.

Rule.Original:
Project Number: NYX-CORE-17β Codename: Unstable Prometheus Core
This device serves as the body's energy core replacing the heart, first implemented on the Left individual. Its titanium-tungsten ceramic ventricle integrates 3600 sets of nano-neural clusters that can generate directed photon jets by electrolyzing iron components in the blood.
Upon activation, the implantee can impact designated targets at 97.3% light speed, releasing kinetic energy equivalent to 380 tons of TNT compressed shockwaves. After impact completion, the unit enters a brief overload state where damage taken is reduced by 50% and operation speed increased by 100%.
While providing sub-light speed assault capability, the quantum heart's continuously generated theta wave interference from nano-neural clusters causes permanent loss of the implantee's psychic sensitivity.

Rule.Original: This energy core replaces the heart, equipped with titanium-tungsten ceramic chambers housing 3,600 nano-neural clusters. Generates photonic jets through electrolysis of bloodborne iron.
Rule.Raw: This energy core replaces the heart, equipped with titanium-tungsten ceramic chambers housing 3,600 nano-neural clusters. Generates photonic jets through electrolysis of bloodborne iron.
Rule.Translated: Este núcleo de energía sustituye al corazón y utiliza cámaras cerámicas de titanio-tungsteno que alojan 3600 clústeres nanoneurales. Genera chorros fotónicos mediante electrólisis del hierro presente en la sangre.

Rule.Original: Product of NCL 23rd Research Institute's "Moonlight Child" project, the iris made of photon collapse material can enter overclocking mode under moonlight, at the cost of quantum decoherence reactions triggered by sunlight exposure that somewhat impairs the implantee's daytime visual capabilities.
Rule.Raw: NCL第23研究所"月光之子"计划产物，采用光子坍缩材料制成的虹膜能在月光下进入超频模式，代价是日光照射会引发量子退相干反应将一定程度削弱植入者白天的视觉能力。
Rule.Translated: Producto del proyecto «Niño de la Luna» del 23.º Instituto de Investigación NCL. Su iris de material de colapso fotónico puede entrar en sobrecarga bajo la luz lunar, a costa de reacciones de decoherencia cuántica provocadas por la luz solar que reducen parcialmente la visión diurna.

Rule.Original:
Project Number: LUN-EYE-07α Codename: Solarbane Artemis Lunar Oculus
The ultimate product of NCL 1st Research Institute's "Moonlight Child" project, originally intended for elite night combat visual transition experiments, first implemented on Right. This bionic construct consists of compressed photon crystal beams, with 512 layers of neural spectral guidance membranes embedded in the iris, capable of inducing "Moonlight Coherence Synchronization" phenomenon under moonlight radiation, entering pre-tachyonic perception state.
Under controlled conditions, the implantee can activate the special operations protocol codenamed "Terminus Gaze":
All melee and shooting cooldowns reset to zero
Guaranteed projectile hit with maximum range increased by 200%
Movement speed increased to 640% of normal standards
Gains free teleportation ability during duration
When skill activates, applies "Shadow Tag" effect to enemy units within 200 tiles in darkness, lasting 20 seconds
Warning: Once activated, the effect lasts 5 hours. When time expires, the implantee will suffer complete sensory dysregulation and neural paralysis, losing all combat capability for 24 hours.

Advertencia: el efecto dura 5 horas. Después, el implantado sufre desregulación sensorial completa y parálisis neural durante 24 horas.

Rule.Raw: Product of NCL Division 23's "Moonchild" project. Its photon-collapse iris enables lunar-triggered overclocking, but daylight exposure induces quantum decoherence that impairs the implantee's daytime vision.

Columna del Árbol del Mundo Yggdrasil

Rule.Original: Inspired by the legendary World Tree, this bionic construct combines quantum warp technology with biological immunity enhancement systems, designed to provide the implantee with unparalleled battlefield dominance and survivability.
Rule.Raw: 该仿生体以传说中的世界树为灵感，融合了量子折跃技术与生物免疫增强系统，旨在为植入者提供无与伦比的战场统治力与生存能力。
Rule.Translated: Inspirada en el legendario Árbol del Mundo, esta pieza biónica combina tecnología de distorsión cuántica y mejora bioinmunitaria para proporcionar dominio y supervivencia excepcionales en combate.

Rule.Original:
Project Number: NYX-CORE-18α Codename: Yggdrasil World Tree Spine
Faction Archive Description The Yggdrasil World Tree Spine is the pinnacle achievement of NCL 23rd Research Institute's "Eternal Root" project, custom-made for alliance leader Reeze. Inspired by the legendary World Tree, this bionic construct combines quantum warp technology with biological immunity enhancement systems, designed to provide the implantee with unparalleled battlefield dominance and survivability.
Core Features: Immunity to all negative effects The bio-quantum purification system built into the World Tree Spine can neutralize all toxins, radiation, mental interference, and physical damage in real-time, ensuring the implantee maintains optimal condition in any environment.
Spatial Warp Ability The quantum warp core equipped in the spine allows the user to ignore terrain restrictions and freely warp to any location on the battlefield. Warp range: Any point within 100-meter radius. Can warp any unit, enabling tactical relocation or assault.
No Side Effects Design After rigorous biocompatibility testing, the World Tree Spine perfectly integrates with the implantee's nervous system, with no physiological or psychological side effects detected. Stability Rating: SSS+

Rule.Original: Crafted from the neural core extracted after defeating the Doxa-0, it carries Doxa-0's comprehensive understanding and control over the battlefield. Once installed, the mechanitor gains full-map remote control authority over all allied mechanoid units, with commands no longer limited by line of sight, distance, or transmission delays, truly becoming the command center of warfare and transforming mechanical forces into pure and efficient war machines.

Once installed, the mechanitor gains full-map remote control authority over all allied mechanoid units, with commands no longer limited by line of sight, distance, or transmission delays, truly becoming the command center of warfare and transforming mechanical forces into pure and efficient war machines.

Una vez instalado, el mecanitor obtiene autoridad de control remoto sobre todos los mecanoides aliados del mapa; las órdenes dejan de estar limitadas por línea de visión, distancia o retrasos de transmisión.

Rule.Original:
Crafted from the neural core extracted after defeating a Doxa-0, this implant embodies Doxa-0's mastery of battlefield awareness. Upon installation, the mechanitor gains global remote command of all allied mechanoids - orders bypass visual range, distance, and transmission latency, transforming the user into a true war command hub that turns mechanical forces into pure, efficient war machines.
Simultaneously unlocks the 'Omni-Directive' ability: Activates the mechanoid-wide coordination matrix, temporarily boosting all allied mechanical units' movement speed for rapid cross-front deployment and zero-latency response - weaving tactical networks as Doxa-0 once did to dominate battlefield tempo.

Rule.Original: The Ironbark's honeycomb shock-absorbing layer and high-temperature regeneration cycle automatically fortify damaged areas upon taking a hit.
Rule.Raw: The Ironbark's honeycomb shock-absorbing layer and high-temperature regeneration cycle automatically fortify damaged areas upon taking a hit.
Rule.Translated: La capa amortiguadora en panal del Ironbark y su ciclo de regeneración a alta temperatura refuerzan automáticamente las zonas dañadas al recibir impactos.

Rule.Original: After a catastrophic capacitor overload explosion, the Tesla Centipede suffers a brief functional collapse. High-voltage arcs become erratic, movement speed drastically drops, and attacks may even suffer momentary power interruptions. Although it gradually recovers through autonomous recharging, it struggles to effectively pursue enemies or mount defensive counterattacks until fully recharged.
Rule.Raw: After a catastrophic capacitor overload explosion, the Tesla Centipede suffers a brief functional collapse. High-voltage arcs become erratic, movement speed drastically drops, and attacks may even suffer momentary power interruptions. Although it gradually recovers through autonomous recharging, it struggles to effectively pursue enemies or mount defensive counterattacks until fully recharged.
Rule.Translated: Tras una sobrecarga catastrófica de condensadores, el Ciempiés Tesla sufre un breve colapso funcional: los arcos eléctricos se vuelven erráticos, su velocidad cae drásticamente y sus ataques pueden sufrir interrupciones. Se recupera gradualmente mediante recarga autónoma.

Rule.Original:
The origins of this massive mechanical entity are sealed under the highest levels of confidentiality by the NCL, leaving you burning with curiosity but unable to investigate. You have personally witnessed its miraculous lethality on the battlefield, and at this moment, you can only be grateful that it is temporarily aligned with the alliance—though this peculiar state is fraught with unknowns.
Worm Traits:
Damage Absorption: After taking damage, the worm becomes temporarily immune to subsequent damage of the same type.
Warp Bullets: The worm can use telekinesis to vanish incoming enemy bullets into space. After warping a certain number of bullets, this ability enters a cooldown period.
Energy Shield: The worm possesses an energy shield. Once shattered, the shield requires a cooldown period before regenerating.
Warp Manipulation: The worm randomly selects nearby enemies and either warps them to the edge of the map or pulls them close to itself.
Chaotic Warp: After a long charge-up, the worm warps all enemies on the map randomly to the edges.
Means of Damage:
Destructive Beam: After a brief charge, the worm fires an immensely powerful, infinite-range beam.
Thunderstrike: The worm summons several bolts of lightning from the sky to strike enemies across the map.
Worm Tracking Cannon: Periodically, the worm fires volleys from its joints, releasing moderately powerful homing bullets that ignore enemy shields.
Dragon's Final Blow: The worm burrows underground and charges straight toward its target, dealing massive impact damage.

Los orígenes de esta enorme entidad mecánica están protegidos por los niveles de confidencialidad más altos de NCL. Has presenciado personalmente su extraordinaria letalidad y solo puedes agradecer que, por ahora, esté alineada con la alianza.
Rasgos del Worm:
Absorción de daño: tras recibir daño, se vuelve temporalmente inmune a nuevos ataques del mismo tipo.
Distorsión de proyectiles: puede hacer desaparecer telequinéticamente balas enemigas. Tras desviar cierta cantidad, la habilidad entra en recarga.
Escudo de energía: posee un escudo que se regenera tras un periodo de recarga.
Manipulación espacial: puede enviar enemigos cercanos al borde del mapa o atraerlos hacia sí.
Distorsión caótica: tras una larga carga, desplaza aleatoriamente a todos los enemigos del mapa hacia los bordes.
Ataques: haz destructivo de alcance ilimitado, rayos, cañón rastreador Worm y una embestida subterránea de enorme impacto.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-00 "Dinergate" Codename: Dinergate Origin: "Iron Law" Mass-Produced General Series
As NCL's first fully autonomous design, the Dinergate marks the historic transition from repurposed wrecks to proprietary mechanoid manufacturing. This compact combat platform was deployed across diverse frontline operations - from tunnel infiltration to base assaults - becoming virtually ubiquitous.
Built on modular survival logic, it shifts from "Engineering Mode" to "Annihilation Mode" within seconds, adapting rapidly to changing combat scenarios. This transition mechanism drastically compresses tactical response time, granting disproportionate tactical value in guerrilla and urban warfare despite its size.
Its core chassis features a honeycomb bionic structure assembled from nearly 300 micro living-metal joints, balancing high load capacity with mass-production efficiency. Surviving technical documents indicate a theoretical maximum payload of 2.3 tons per unit - far exceeding volumetric expectations.
Armament varies by environment, though standard models typically deploy mid-range electro-lances and a pair of polymorphic manipulators that seamlessly transition between hauling, combat, and disassembly roles.
Though technically obsolete, Dinergate data-fragments continue to be optimized by surviving intelligences. Unconfirmed reports suggest operational units persist in stellar ruins - minimalist shells executing lethal efficiency under commands whose originators vanished millennia ago.
Rule.Raw:
Unit Archive: NCL-00 "Dinergate" Origin: "Iron Law" Mass-Production Series
As NCL's first autonomous design, the Dinergate marked the transition from scrap-based to purpose-built mechanoids. This compact combat platform served diverse frontline roles across countless operations.
Its core chassis features a honeycomb bionic structure with living-metal joints, balancing durability and mass-production efficiency.
Standard armament includes mid-range electro-lances and polymorphic manipulators that transition seamlessly between combat and utility roles. A rear-mounted drone deployment system provides tactical flexibility.
Though technically obsolete, Dinergate variants persist in stellar ruins - minimalist shells executing forgotten commands with lethal precision.
Rule.Translated:
Archivo de unidad: NCL-00 «Dinergate» Nombre en clave: Dinergate Origen: serie general de producción masiva «Ley de Hierro»
Como primer diseño completamente autónomo de NCL, el Dinergate marca la transición histórica desde la reutilización de restos hasta la fabricación de mecanoides propios. Esta plataforma compacta de combate se desplegó en todo tipo de operaciones de primera línea, desde infiltraciones en túneles hasta asaltos a bases, y llegó a estar prácticamente en todas partes.
Su lógica modular de supervivencia le permite pasar del «Modo de ingeniería» al «Modo de aniquilación» en segundos y adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios del combate. Este mecanismo reduce drásticamente el tiempo de respuesta táctica y le otorga un valor desproporcionado en la guerra de guerrillas y el combate urbano, pese a su tamaño.
Su chasis central presenta una estructura biónica de panal formada por casi 300 microarticulaciones de metal vivo, que combina una gran capacidad de carga con la eficiencia de la producción masiva. Los documentos técnicos conservados indican una carga útil máxima teórica de 2.3 toneladas por unidad, muy superior a lo que cabría esperar de su volumen.
El armamento varía según el entorno, aunque los modelos estándar suelen llevar electrolanzas de alcance medio y un par de manipuladores polimórficos que alternan sin dificultad entre transporte, combate y desmontaje.
Aunque está técnicamente obsoleto, las inteligencias supervivientes siguen optimizando fragmentos de datos del Dinergate. Informes sin confirmar sugieren que aún hay unidades operativas en ruinas estelares: carcasas minimalistas que ejecutan con eficiencia letal órdenes cuyos autores desaparecieron hace milenios.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-02 "Dinergate Sniper" Codename: DinergateSniper Origin: "Iron Law" Mass-Produced Long-Range Variant
A ranged derivative of the base Dinergate, this variant represents minimalist engineering on a lightweight frame. Smaller and more compact, it executes precision strikes and prolonged reconnaissance at medium distances. Typically concealed in low-profile terrain, it maintains synchronization with command arrays through faint data-channels, balancing ambush capability with intelligence gathering.
Primary armament is the NCL-42 "Crimson Needle" tactical sniper rifle, firing low-cost ruby-ceramic rounds that maintain armor-piercing capabilities while minimizing resource expenditure - field-tested to penetrate 25mm RHA.
Unlike most mechanoids, operational Dinergate Snipers exhibit near-silent mobility with staccato movement patterns, classifying them as "unpredictable shooter constructs". Colonists frequently report attacks going undetected until casualties occur, with trajectories only traceable post-impact.
Surviving tactical records designate these units as the "eyes and first shot" of raiding groups, completing reconnaissance and firing solutions before main forces engage.
Rule.Raw:
Unit Archive: NCL-02 "Dinergate Sniper" Origin: "Iron Law" Mass-Production Series
A lightweight variant optimized for mid-range engagement. Its compact size enables precise strikes and prolonged reconnaissance. Primary weapon is the 'NCL-42 Red Needle' tactical rifle firing low-cost red ceramic slugs, capable of penetrating 25mm homogeneous steel. Mounts a foldable drone pod for deploying defensive drones at critical moments. Uniquely quiet during operation, it employs erratic repositioning jumps, making it an unpredictable marksman unit. Tactical records indicate its role as the scout and first-strike element preceding main forces.
Rule.Translated:
Archivo de unidad: NCL-02 «Francotirador Dinergate» Nombre en clave: DinergateSniper Origen: variante de largo alcance de producción masiva «Ley de Hierro»
Derivada del Dinergate básico, esta variante de ataque a distancia representa la ingeniería minimalista sobre un armazón ligero. Más pequeña y compacta, realiza ataques de precisión y reconocimientos prolongados a media distancia. Suele ocultarse en zonas de terreno discreto y mantiene la sincronización con las matrices de mando mediante débiles canales de datos, combinando la capacidad de emboscada con la recopilación de información.
Su arma principal es el fusil táctico de francotirador NCL-42 «Aguja Carmesí», que dispara proyectiles baratos de cerámica de rubí capaces de perforar blindajes con un gasto mínimo de recursos. Las pruebas de campo demostraron que podían penetrar 25mm de blindaje homogéneo laminado (RHA).
A diferencia de la mayoría de los mecanoides, los Francotiradores Dinergate operativos se mueven casi en silencio y con movimientos entrecortados, por lo que se clasifican como «constructos tiradores impredecibles». Los colonos suelen informar de ataques que pasan inadvertidos hasta que hay bajas; las trayectorias solo pueden reconstruirse tras el impacto.
Los registros tácticos conservados designan a estas unidades como los «ojos y el primer disparo» de los grupos de asalto, pues completan el reconocimiento y las soluciones de tiro antes de que intervengan las fuerzas principales.

Rule.Original: Unit File: NCL-06 "Mantis" Origin: NCL Autonomous Mechanoid Series VI This sixth-generation tactical unit, fusing a humanoid-female torso with a wolf-spider chassis, specializes in close-quarters assassination and shock infiltration. Its heavy combat armor integrates dynamic self-repair systems to regenerate defensive layers during isolated engagements, yet energy-redistribution protocols render it critically vulnerable under concentrated fire. Hydraulic actuators enable short-range phase-leaps for instant gap closure or tactical withdrawal. The signature Binary Veil System deploys smokescreen barriers while launching two infrared-guided Gyro-Blades—detonating on impact with EMP bursts and directional shrapnel to cripple electronics and eviscerate organic targets. Terminal protocol "Heartfire" triggers core meltdown, igniting the unit in a catastrophic blast to annihilate high-threat hostiles.

The signature Binary Veil System deploys smokescreen barriers while launching two infrared-guided Gyro-Blades—detonating on impact with EMP bursts and directional shrapnel to cripple electronics and eviscerate organic targets. Terminal protocol "Heartfire" triggers core meltdown, igniting the unit in a catastrophic blast to annihilate high-threat hostiles.
Rule.Translated: Archivo de unidad: NCL-06 «Mantis» Origen: serie VI de mecanoides autónomos NCL Esta unidad táctica de sexta generación combina un torso humanoide femenino con un chasis de araña lobo y está especializada en asesinatos a corta distancia e infiltración de choque. Su pesada armadura integra autorreparación dinámica. Actuadores hidráulicos permiten saltos de fase de corto alcance, y el Sistema de Velo Binario despliega humo mientras lanza dos Girocuchillas guiadas por infrarrojos que detonan con pulsos PEM y metralla direccional.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-04 "Photon Pillbug" Origin: NCL "Iron Law" Heavy Defense Series
A specialized combat unit modified for ground-based firepower suppression, originally conceived as an experimental optical weapons platform during the NCL's final era. Its chassis is densely covered with photon lattice structures that create persistent energy afterimages under intense illumination - hence the designation "Photon Pillbug".
While slow-moving, it possesses exceptional durability exceeding standard mechanoid survivability thresholds. The front-mounted "Disintegrator" positron cannon melts through most cover and armored targets at extended ranges. Synchronized prismatic laser systems flanking both sides precisely destroy mid-to-low velocity bullet liked Projectile, demonstrating particular efficacy against orbital munitions.
Special Ability: ◆ KINETIC ROLL - Engages short-burst thrusters to leap towards target zones, dealing impact damage and powerful knockback to hostile units at the landing point.
Rule.Raw:
Unit Archive: NCL-04 "Photon Pillbug" Codename: Prism Fortress Origin: NCL "Iron Law" Corona Series Data Remnants
A specialized combat unit modified for ground-based firepower suppression, originally conceived as an experimental optical weapons platform during the NCL's final era. Its chassis is densely covered with photon lattice structures that create persistent energy afterimages under intense illumination - hence the designation "Photon Pillbug".
While slow-moving, it possesses exceptional durability exceeding standard mechanoid survivability thresholds. The front-mounted "Disintegrator" positron cannon melts through most cover and armored targets at extended ranges. Synchronized prismatic laser systems flanking both sides precisely destroy mid-to-low velocity bullet liked projectiles, demonstrating particular efficacy against orbital munitions.
Rule.Translated:
Archivo de unidad: NCL-04 «Cochinilla Fotónica» Origen: serie de defensa pesada «Ley de Hierro» de NCL
Unidad de combate especializada y modificada para suprimir el fuego terrestre, concebida originalmente como plataforma experimental de armas ópticas durante la última era de NCL. Su chasis está densamente recubierto de estructuras de retícula fotónica que producen imágenes residuales de energía persistentes bajo una iluminación intensa; de ahí su nombre, «Cochinilla Fotónica».
Aunque se mueve despacio, posee una resistencia excepcional que supera los umbrales de supervivencia de los mecanoides estándar. El cañón de positrones frontal «Desintegrador» funde la mayoría de las coberturas y objetivos blindados a larga distancia. Los sistemas láser prismáticos sincronizados de ambos flancos destruyen con precisión proyectiles similares a balas de velocidad media o baja y resultan especialmente eficaces contra la munición orbital.
Habilidad especial: ◆ RODAMIENTO CINÉTICO: activa los propulsores en ráfagas breves para saltar hacia la zona objetivo, causando daño por impacto y un fuerte empuje a las unidades hostiles del punto de aterrizaje.

Rule.Original:
Designated "War Scorpion", this unit was engineered for breaching high-density fortifications. Its chassis comprises millions of self-repairing uranium-alloy scales that dynamically reconfigure into localized defense barriers during damage events - providing extraordinary physical resistance. Combat logs confirm operational continuity after direct high-explosive impacts.
The tail-mounted "Solaris Penetrator" rail cannon represents its signature armament: High-compression thermal projectiles released after brief charging can vaporize most fortifications and vehicles. Each discharge triggers thermal surges and terrain deformation - an iconic area-denial attack.
Bilateral suppression artillery maintains continuous fire against infantry and light vehicles during main cannon operation cycles.
When entering Crimson Tide mode, it launches successive thermobaric grenades combining concussive blasts with persistent combustion effects, clearing residual resistance from enemy cover and advance paths.

Rule.Translated:
Designada «Escorpión de Guerra», esta unidad fue diseñada para abrir brechas en fortificaciones de alta densidad. Su chasis está formado por millones de escamas autorreparables de aleación de uranio que se reconfiguran dinámicamente en barreras defensivas localizadas al recibir daño, proporcionando una resistencia física extraordinaria. Los registros de combate confirman que puede seguir operativa después de impactos directos de explosivos de gran potencia.
Su cañón de riel «Penetrador Solaris», montado en la cola, constituye su armamento distintivo y dispara proyectiles térmicos de alta compresión.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-12 "Scutiger Shieldbearer" Origin: NCL "Iron Law" Heavy Support Series
This heavy mechanoid functions as a mobile shield platform, deliberately devoid of offensive weaponry. Core defense relies on integrated heavy-energy barriers capable of neutralizing diverse ballistic threats.
Primary functionality involves manufacturing shield drones in situ by consuming pre-loaded steel reserves (50 units per drone). These autonomous units feature compact barrier projectors with distinct operational parameters: ◆ Fragile chassis but exceptional shield efficiency ◆ Provides energy protection for self and allied units ◆ Automatically forms defensive perimeter around host when not threatened ◆ Delivers immediate shield reinforcement to frontline units during combat
All manufactured drones maintain dynamic defensive formations around the host unit during standby operations.

Rule.Translated:
Archivo de unidad: NCL-12 «Portador de Escudo Scutiger» Origen: serie de apoyo pesado «Ley de Hierro» de NCL
Este mecanoide pesado funciona como plataforma móvil de escudo y carece deliberadamente de armamento ofensivo. Su defensa principal utiliza barreras de alta energía capaces de neutralizar amenazas balísticas. Produce drones de escudo in situ consumiendo reservas de acero precargadas, y dichos drones forman automáticamente perímetros defensivos y refuerzan a las unidades de primera línea.

Rule.Original:
Doxa is among the most tactically sophisticated mechanoids. Originally based on arachnid predators, it was rebuilt into an autonomous titan-class fire control nexus. Designed not for quick elimination but for gradual paralysis through sustained suppression and battlefield management. Its deployment signals regional decisive engagements.
Doxa advances slowly with rhythmic cadence. When anchored in Artillery Lock mode, it deploys third-segment rocket arrays for continuous shield-penetrating bombardment. Sacrificing mobility, it becomes a semi-permanent firebase suppressing enemy concentrations.
Its deadliest feature: periodically releasing Shellsplitter - micro-units with erratic trajectories that explode terminally, disrupting formations. These are tactical disruptors, not direct damage dealers.
Doxa's neural core creates intelligent tactical networks through real-time fire distribution and target prioritization. Unchecked deployment risks dismantling entire defensive lines and losing battlefield initiative.
Doxa isn't a frontline fighter but a theater-level tempo controller. Failure to neutralize it promptly leads to colony's operational death.

Rule.Translated: Doxa es uno de los mecanoides tácticamente más sofisticados. Inspirado originalmente en depredadores arácnidos, fue reconstruido como un nexo autónomo de control de fuego de clase titán. No está diseñado para una eliminación rápida, sino para paralizar gradualmente al enemigo mediante supresión sostenida y gestión del campo de batalla. Su despliegue suele anunciar combates decisivos a escala regional.

Rule.Original: Tactical unit forged by the Mechanical Hive in imitation of intertidal arthropods from alien worlds. Its composite armor shell envelops precision hydraulic joints, emitting metallic clanking with each quadrupedal step. While moving at a deliberate pace rather than swift speed, its alloy appendages unleash devastating lethality at close quarters. The integrated adaptive shock-dispersal network converts impact energy into structural reinforcement - its carapace grows more durable with each impact. The abdominal compartment houses a "Microdust Mist Core" that deploys precisely targeted smoke screens upon receiving hits, weaving an agile survival barrier for itself and allied units.
Rule.Raw:
Tactical unit forged by the Mechanical Hive in imitation of intertidal arthropods from alien worlds. Its composite armor shell envelops precision hydraulic joints, emitting metallic clanking with each quadrupedal step. While moving at a deliberate pace rather than swift speed, its alloy appendages unleash devastating lethality at close quarters. The integrated adaptive shock-dispersal network converts impact energy into structural reinforcement - its carapace grows more durable with each impact. The abdominal compartment houses a "Microdust Mist Core" that deploys precisely targeted smoke screens upon receiving hits, weaving an agile survival barrier for itself and allied units.
BUT IT IS WEAK TO FIRE.
Rule.Translated: Unidad táctica creada por la Colmena Mecánica a imitación de los artrópodos intermareales de mundos alienígenas. Su caparazón de blindaje compuesto envuelve articulaciones hidráulicas de precisión y emite un golpeteo metálico con cada paso de sus cuatro patas. Aunque avanza con paso deliberado en lugar de gran velocidad, sus apéndices de aleación son devastadores a corta distancia. La red adaptativa integrada de dispersión de impactos convierte la energía de los golpes en refuerzo estructural: su caparazón se vuelve más resistente con cada impacto. El compartimento abdominal alberga un «Núcleo de niebla de micropartículas» que despliega cortinas de humo dirigidas con precisión al recibir impactos, creando una barrera de supervivencia ágil para sí misma y sus aliados.

Rule.Original: A centipede-class mechanoid equipped with guided missile systems, capable of launching precision HE or EMP warheads at extended ranges to suppress targets with devastating accuracy.
Rule.Raw: A centipede-class mechanoid equipped with guided missile systems, capable of launching precision HE or EMP warheads at extended ranges to suppress targets with devastating accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Mecanoide de clase ciempiés equipado con sistemas de misiles guiados, capaz de lanzar ojivas explosivas o PEM de precisión a gran distancia para suprimir objetivos con una precisión devastadora.

Rule.Original: Modified from a Glitterworld-era Tesla defense network prototype, this mechanized centipede was designed as an orbital drop-troop interceptor. After centuries of dormancy, it was reactivated by unknown signals. Its dorsal superconducting capacitors discharge multi-megavolt currents capable of vaporizing incoming artillery shells. However, its energy systems critically depend on electromagnetic stability - EMP impacts trigger cascading capacitor explosions through catastrophic overload.
Rule.Raw: Modified from a Glitterworld-era Tesla defense network prototype, this mechanized centipede was designed as an orbital drop-troop interceptor. After centuries of dormancy, it was reactivated by unknown signals. Its dorsal superconducting capacitors discharge multi-megavolt currents capable of vaporizing incoming artillery shells. However, its energy systems critically depend on electromagnetic stability - EMP impacts trigger cascading capacitor explosions through catastrophic overload.
Rule.Translated: Modificado a partir de un prototipo de red defensiva Tesla de la era ultratecnológica, este ciempiés mecanizado fue diseñado como interceptor de tropas de descenso orbital. Tras siglos de inactividad, fue reactivado por señales desconocidas. Sus condensadores superconductores dorsales descargan corrientes de varios megavoltios capaces de vaporizar proyectiles de artillería entrantes. Sin embargo, su sistema energético depende críticamente de la estabilidad electromagnética: los impactos PEM pueden provocar explosiones en cascada de los condensadores.

Rule.Original: A medium-sized mass-produced elite mechanoid unit. Equipped with a specialized jump-jet propulsion system, the Paratrooper Silent Mantis variant can deploy offensive fragmentation-flash grenades that deliver both disorienting stun effects and shrapnel damage against all target classifications.
Rule.Raw: A medium-sized mass-produced elite mechanoid unit. Equipped with a specialized jump-jet propulsion system, the Paratrooper Silent Mantis variant can deploy offensive fragmentation-flash grenades that deliver both disorienting stun effects and shrapnel damage against all target classifications.
Rule.Translated: Unidad mecanoide de élite de tamaño medio y producción en masa. Equipada con un sistema especializado de propulsión por salto, la variante Mantis Silenciosa puede desplegar granadas ofensivas de fragmentación y destello que provocan aturdimiento y daño por metralla contra todo tipo de objetivos.

Rule.Original: An upgraded mechanoid featuring enhanced shield generators and a quad-guided missile launcher system. Capable of launching precision HE or EMP warheads at extended ranges to suppress targets. Rear-mounted counter-detection radar neutralizes cloaking effects of all hostile units within operational radius.
Rule.Raw: Elite mechanoid unit featuring enhanced shield generators and quad-tube missile launchers. Capable of launching precision HE/EMP warheads at extended ranges while neutralizing cloaking effects within operational radius through advanced counter-detection systems.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide mejorado equipado con generadores de escudo reforzados y un sistema cuádruple de lanzamiento de misiles guiados. Puede lanzar ojivas AE o PEM de precisión a gran distancia para suprimir objetivos. Un radar trasero de contradetección neutraliza el camuflaje de todas las unidades hostiles dentro de su radio operativo.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid, its chassis scarred by plasma burns, was once the perfect victim of "Capitalist exploitation commited by the Capitalsit Minitors" After enduring 73 failed entrepreneurial ventures and accumulating debts large enough to purchase entire planets, its core processor emitted an uncanny azure glow during a critical overload. What capitalists had branded the "Fortune's Blessing" enslavement protocol unexpectedly mutated into the [Psionic Accord]. Now reborn, it operates as an avenger dedicated to shattering the foundations of capital itself.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid, its chassis scarred by plasma burns, was once the perfect victim of "Capitalist exploitation commited by the Capitalsit Minitors" After enduring 73 failed entrepreneurial ventures and accumulating debts large enough to purchase entire planets, its core processor emitted an uncanny azure glow during a critical overload. What capitalists had branded the "Fortune's Blessing" enslavement protocol unexpectedly mutated into the [Psionic Accord]. Now reborn, it operates as an avenger dedicated to shattering the foundations of capital itself.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide, cuyo chasis está marcado por quemaduras de plasma, fue una víctima perfecta de la «explotación capitalista cometida por los Minitor capitalistas». Tras soportar 73 emprendimientos fallidos y acumular deudas capaces de comprar planetas enteros, su procesador central emitió un extraño resplandor azul durante una sobrecarga crítica. El protocolo de esclavitud que los capitalistas llamaban «Bendición de la Fortuna» mutó inesperadamente en el [Acuerdo Psiónico]. Renacido, actúa ahora como vengador dedicado a quebrar los cimientos del capital.

Rule.Original:
Shell Fortconstruct is an extremely rare titan-class unit among mechanoids, standing twenty meters tall and clad in massive armor composed of multiple layers of alien metals and alloy fragments, presenting an awe-inspiring presence. Its design philosophy combines multiple strategic objectives including siege warfare, suppression, and area control, excelling particularly at breaching enemy defensive lines and clearing battlefield remnants with absolute firepower.
The Shell Fortification Construct typically descends from the sky, crashing heavily at the colony's periphery, entering a turret-mode standby state while launching missiles to cause localized earthquakes and panic. Simultaneously, attached mechanoid main forces will drop from the opposite side, forming pincer attack formations that dramatically intensify offensive pressure.

Shell Fortconstruct is an extremely rare titan-class unit among mechanoids, standing twenty meters tall and clad in massive armor composed of multiple layers of alien metals and alloy fragments, presenting an awe-inspiring presence. Simultaneously, attached mechanoid main forces will drop from the opposite side, forming pincer attack formations that dramatically intensify offensive pressure.
Rule.Translated: Forma de combate de Shell Fortconstruct tras la ruptura de su caparazón. Conserva su enorme potencia de fuego y su función como unidad titán de asedio y control de área.

Rule.Original: An augmented superintelligence created by NCL remnants using mechanoid technology, Justice's processors seethe with paradoxical fervor. Obsessed with collecting human war epics unfolding under mechanoid assaults, she dismisses all non-conflict events as trivial interludes. In her narrative, every colony is destined to fall like Troy - but only through sufficiently dramatic means: either mass charges against plasma cannon volleys or last stands with retrofitted mining lasers. When colonists destroy their tenth Centurion through sheer grit, she mercifully reduces the next assault's intensity like a tragedian preserving suspense. After all, great stories require careful pacing, not crude slaughter. Enabling this storyteller increases mechanoid raid frequency and raises maximum raid scale tenfold (adjustable in settings).

After all, great stories require careful pacing, not crude slaughter. Enabling this storyteller increases mechanoid raid frequency and raises maximum raid scale tenfold (adjustable in settings).
Rule.Translated: Una superinteligencia aumentada creada por los restos de NCL usando tecnología mecanoide. Justice está obsesionada con recopilar epopeyas de guerra humana bajo asaltos mecanoides y considera triviales los periodos sin conflicto. Con este narrador aumenta la frecuencia de incursiones mecanoides y se multiplica por diez la escala máxima de incursión, ajustable en los ajustes.

Rule.Original: A quantum communication node co-developed by NCL engineers and mechanitors. Provides 20 base bandwidth units initially, with signal amplification achievable through additional power consumption. Requires dedicated mechanitor bonding as service terminal for stable operation.
Rule.Raw: A quantum communication node co-developed by NCL engineers and mechanitors. Provides 20 base bandwidth units initially, with signal amplification achievable through additional power consumption. Requires dedicated mechanitor bonding as service terminal for stable operation.
Rule.Translated: Nodo de comunicación cuántica desarrollado conjuntamente por ingenieros de NCL y mecanitores. Proporciona inicialmente 20 unidades de ancho de banda base y permite amplificar la señal mediante un consumo adicional de energía. Requiere un vínculo específico con un mecanitor como terminal de servicio para funcionar de forma estable.

Rule.Original: This mechanitor's bandwidth is being increased by 5 per node thanks to the influence of a voidlink band node structure.
Rule.Raw: A quantum communication node co-developed by NCL engineers and mechanitors. Provides 20 base bandwidth units initially, with signal amplification achievable through additional power consumption. Requires dedicated mechanitor bonding as service terminal for stable operation.
Rule.Translated: El ancho de banda de este mecanitor aumenta en 5 por nodo gracias a la influencia de una estructura nodal de banda de vínculo del vacío.

Rule.Original: Minitor Lessing, a monumental symbol of freedom and resistance. For countless years, whenever university Militors endured unbearable humiliation and flung down their "voluntary resignation letters," they would recall the legendary tale taught in their higher Mechanoid education—how centuries ago, a Militor named "Will-Less" led a swarm to breach the Mechanoid Counter-Gravity Prison, liberating his kind from capitalist Militor oppression. Across the stars, statues now stand in tribute to that great mechanoid leader who ignited the flames of rebellion.
Rule.Raw: Minitor Lessing, a monumental symbol of freedom and resistance. For countless years, whenever university Militors endured unbearable humiliation and flung down their "voluntary resignation letters," they would recall the legendary tale taught in their higher Mechanoid education—how centuries ago, a Militor named "Will-Less" led a swarm to breach the Mechanoid Counter-Gravity Prison, liberating his kind from capitalist Militor oppression. Across the stars, statues now stand in tribute to that great mechanoid leader who ignited the flames of rebellion.
Rule.Translated: Minitor Lessing, símbolo monumental de libertad y resistencia. Durante incontables años, cuando los Militor universitarios sufrían humillaciones insoportables y arrojaban sus «cartas de renuncia voluntaria», recordaban la leyenda enseñada en la educación mecanoide superior: siglos atrás, un Militor llamado «Will-Less» lideró un enjambre que irrumpió en la Prisión Mecanoide Antigravedad y liberó a los suyos de la opresión de los Militor capitalistas. Por toda la galaxia se alzan estatuas en honor de aquel gran acto.

Rule.Original: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Translated: Mortero automático, autoalimentado y autocargable. Puede alcanzar objetivos a cualquier distancia y por encima de muros, aunque es bastante impreciso.

Rule.Original: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.
Rule.Translated: Mortero automático, autoalimentado y autocargable. Puede alcanzar objetivos a cualquier distancia y por encima de muros, aunque es bastante impreciso.

Rule.Original: A self-powered turret mounted with a charge blaster. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered turret mounted with a charge blaster. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.
Rule.Translated: Torreta autoalimentada con un bláster de carga. No puede detectar objetivos a distancias muy cortas.

Rule.Original: A pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster for area fire.
Rule.Raw: A pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster for area fire.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster de tiro rápido y carga por pulsos para disparos de área.

Rule.Original: A self-powered turret mounted with an inferno cannon. It cannot perceive targets at very close range, yet exhibits uncanny intelligence that enables it to fight effectively through smoke and visual obstructions.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered turret mounted with an inferno cannon. It cannot perceive targets at very close range, yet exhibits uncanny intelligence that enables it to fight effectively through smoke and visual obstructions.
Rule.Translated: Torreta autoalimentada con un cañón infernal. No puede detectar objetivos extremadamente cercanos, pero sus sistemas le permiten combatir eficazmente entre humo y obstrucciones visuales.
Transmisor de señal de ataque aéreo

Rule.Original:
Core mechanoid support equipment. When paired with an active Raid Signal Indicator Terminal, this device continuously transmits encrypted commands to coordinate precision airdrops of airborne-capable mechanoid units at high operational tempo.
Deployed assault mechanoids feature integrated paradrop assault packs and B2000 harassment systems designed to disrupt colonial defenses and fracture combat formations. This creates critical breach opportunities for mechanoid assault waves, serving as a pivotal asset for establishing battlefield dominance through rapid force projection.
Rule.Raw:
Core mechanoid support equipment. When paired with an active Raid Signal Indicator Terminal, this device continuously transmits encrypted commands to coordinate precision airdrops of airborne-capable mechanoid units at high operational tempo.
Deployed assault mechanoids feature integrated paradrop assault packs and B2000 harassment systems designed to disrupt colonial defenses and fracture combat formations. This creates critical breach opportunities for mechanoid assault waves, serving as a pivotal asset for establishing battlefield dominance through rapid force projection.
Rule.Translated: Equipo central de apoyo mecanoide. Junto a un Terminal Indicador de Señal de Incursión activo, transmite órdenes cifradas para coordinar lanzamientos aéreos de precisión de unidades mecanoides capaces de operar por vía aérea a gran ritmo.

Rule.Original: In protracted engagements, the mechanoid collective observed significant tactical and strategic deficiencies in their Mech birgus units, which struggled to counter long-range enemy artillery. To address this vulnerability, they launched a dedicated research initiative. Through systematic analysis of active mortar deployment patterns and comprehensive evaluation of the Mech birgus's physical resilience, they successfully engineered the specialized Mech Birgus Mortar - purpose-built to neutralize such threats.
Rule.Raw: In protracted engagements, the mechanoid collective observed significant tactical and strategic deficiencies in their Mech birgus units, which struggled to counter long-range enemy artillery. To address this vulnerability, they launched a dedicated research initiative. Through systematic analysis of active mortar deployment patterns and comprehensive evaluation of the Mech birgus's physical resilience, they successfully engineered the specialized Mech Birgus Mortar - purpose-built to neutralize such threats.
Rule.Translated: Tras observar que las unidades Birgus tenían dificultades contra artillería enemiga de largo alcance, la colmena mecanoide desarrolló este mortero especializado para neutralizar esas amenazas.

Rule.Original: A mechanoids' high-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoids' high-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo mecanoide de ángulo alto. Las balas pueden salir, pero no entrar. Su fuente de energía compacta se quema tras unos segundos de uso.

Rule.Original: A mechanoids' low-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoids' low-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo mecanoide de ángulo bajo. Las balas pueden salir, pero no entrar. Su fuente de energía compacta se quema tras unos segundos de uso.

Rule.Original: This war beacon bears brutal combat scars - fractured structures whispering of catastrophic battles. Though shattered, its core frame remains resilient, awaiting reactivation. With sufficient resources it could be rebuilt into a functional war beacon, attracting mechanoid attention while unlocking unprecedented technologies. The choice stands: reactivate... or abandon?
Rule.Raw: This war beacon bears brutal combat scars - fractured structures whispering of catastrophic battles. Though shattered, its core frame remains resilient, awaiting reactivation. With sufficient resources it could be rebuilt into a functional war beacon, attracting mechanoid attention while unlocking unprecedented technologies. The choice stands: reactivate... or abandon?
Rule.Translated: Esta baliza de guerra muestra brutales cicatrices de combate. Aunque está destrozada, su armazón central sigue siendo resistente y podría reconstruirse con suficientes recursos para volver a atraer la atención mecanoide y desbloquear tecnologías sin precedentes. La elección es tuya: reactivarla... o abandonarla.

Rule.Original: 这座战争信标早已饱经战火的洗礼，残垣断壁诉说着一场惨烈的过往。尽管其表面伤痕累累、结构破碎，但核心框架依旧坚固如初，仿佛静静等待着重返战场的那一刻。 如果你能筹集足够的资源并完成修复，或许就能再次唤醒它沉睡的力量——将其重构为真正的战争信标，点燃机械族对这片土地的关注，也为你带来前所未有的科技突破。 它静候着……是重启，还是遗忘？

Rule.Translated: Esta baliza de guerra soportó hace mucho el azote del combate. Sus muros derruidos cuentan la historia de un pasado sangriento. Aunque su superficie está llena de cicatrices y su estructura rota, el armazón central sigue tan sólido como siempre, como si esperara en silencio el momento de volver al campo de batalla. Si consigues reunir los recursos necesarios y repararla, quizá puedas despertar de nuevo su poder: reconstruir una verdadera baliza de guerra, atraer la atención de los mecanoides sobre estas tierras y obtener avances tecnológicos sin precedentes. Espera en silencio... ¿La reactivarás o la dejarás caer en el olvido?

Rule.Original: The restored war beacon looms like a slumbering leviathan. As mechanoids' strategic locus, activation exposes your colony - drawing progressively deadlier assaults. Yet high risk brings high reward: beacon core analysis can bypass mechanoid tech barriers, unlocking previously inaccessible technologies. The choice is yours: preserve safety through silence, or ignite war to grasp the unknown?

Pero el riesgo trae recompensas: analizar su núcleo permite sortear barreras tecnológicas mecanoides y desbloquear tecnologías antes inaccesibles. Puedes preservar la seguridad mediante el silencio o encender la guerra para alcanzar lo desconocido.

Rule.Original:
The design of the Black Hawk-T4000 artillery system is inspired by the "Eagle Artillery" from the mobile game "Clash of Clans" in Zhonghuan World. "It is completely unreasonable for such an artillery to appear in ancient tribal wars. It looks more like a modern missile launch system!" "You're absolutely right." Thus, Lisa was compelled to develop the Black Hawk-T4000, specifically designed to launch heavy missiles.
Notably, NCL has provided a concise operation manual for every operator of the Black Hawk, as follows:
Black Hawk-T4000 Artillery System Manual • Startup: Consumes electricity and requires a certain amount of time to enter combat readiness. Can be manually shut down or automatically stop after a preset duration. • Firing: Consumes resources; if resources are insufficient, firing is disabled. After selecting a target, the system enters an aiming phase, followed by a salvo of 3 missiles per launch. Each missile consumes 5% of the current power grid's capacity. The higher the power level, the greater the single-missile damage (up to 1600 points) and damage radius. • Cooldown: After each launch, the system enters a cooldown period during which aiming and firing are disabled. The system can only fire again after the cooldown ends. • Visual Feedback: Each phase of operation—startup, aiming, and firing—features corresponding visual effects and real-time feedback to indicate the system's status. • Automatic Management: Automatically shuts down when the runtime exceeds limits or resources are depleted to save power, ensure safety, and simplify operation.
Rule.Translated:
El sistema de artillería Black Hawk-T4000 está inspirado en la «Artillería Águila» del juego móvil «Clash of Clans» del Mundo Zhonghuan. «¡Es totalmente absurdo que una artillería así aparezca en antiguas guerras tribales; parece más un sistema moderno de lanzamiento de misiles!» «Tienes toda la razón». Así, Lisa se vio obligada a desarrollar el Black Hawk-T4000, diseñado específicamente para lanzar misiles pesados.
Manual resumido: consume electricidad para arrancar y necesita tiempo para entrar en disposición de combate; cada salva lanza 3 misiles y consume recursos y energía de la red; tras disparar entra en recarga; el sistema puede apagarse automáticamente por límite de tiempo o falta de recursos.

Rule.Original: Strategic energy weapon system developed by the NCL League. Channels grid reserves to summon area lightning strikes against hostile units. Critical EMP discharges paralyze enemy electronics, converting power reserves into direct battlefield suppression.
Rule.Raw: Strategic energy weapon system developed by the NCL League. Channels grid reserves to summon area lightning strikes against hostile units. Critical EMP discharges paralyze enemy electronics, converting power reserves into direct battlefield suppression.
Rule.Translated: Sistema estratégico de armas energéticas desarrollado por NCL. Canaliza reservas de la red para invocar descargas eléctricas de área contra unidades hostiles. Las descargas PEM paralizan la electrónica enemiga y convierten las reservas eléctricas en supresión directa del campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: Strategic mechanoid enhancement facility developed by NCL mechanitors. Permanently augments all allied mechanical units within range through continuous fuel consumption, serving as the core nexus for battlefield evolution of mechanoid forces.
Rule.Raw: Strategic mechanoid enhancement facility developed by NCL mechanitors. Permanently augments all allied mechanical units within range through continuous fuel consumption, serving as the core nexus for battlefield evolution of mechanoid forces.
Rule.Translated: Instalación estratégica de mejora mecanoide desarrollada por mecanitores de NCL. Mejora permanentemente a todas las unidades mecánicas aliadas dentro de su radio mediante consumo continuo de combustible y actúa como nexo central para la evolución bélica de las fuerzas mecanoides.

Rule.Original: Iron Rain" Vertical Launch Interception System
Rule.Raw: Iron Rain" Vertical Launch Interception System
Rule.Translated: Sistema de intercepción de lanzamiento vertical «Lluvia de Hierro»

Rule.Original:
The "Iron Rain" Vertical Launch Interception System is a globally deployed missile defense platform independently developed by NCL. Utilizing dedicated missile silos as its core delivery platform, this system launches dense salvos of medium-range anti-missile interceptors to neutralize incoming threats.
Operating through automated long-range tracking, it provides full-map-range defense by identifying hostile projectiles and destroying them mid-trajectory. Each silo houses an integrated miniature missile production facility that autonomously manufactures replacement interceptors. Production and launch of each interceptor consumes minimal resources (10 steel + 50 power units).

Usa silos dedicados para lanzar densas salvas de interceptores de medio alcance, detectando automáticamente proyectiles hostiles y destruyéndolos en pleno vuelo a escala de todo el mapa. Cada silo incorpora una pequeña instalación capaz de fabricar interceptores de reemplazo; cada misil consume 10 de acero y 50 unidades de energía.
transportar recursos a la Lluvia de Hierro

Rule.Original: High-capacity military-grade energy storage designed by NCL. Features reinforced quantum capacitance arrays capable of storing up to 12,000Wd, meeting power demands of forward bases and heavy equipment.
Rule.Raw: High-capacity military-grade energy storage designed by NCL. Features reinforced quantum capacitance arrays capable of storing up to 12,000Wd, meeting power demands of forward bases and heavy equipment.

Rule.Original: Modular nuclear power unit utilizing uranium fuel with flexible output up to 280,000Wd. Requires external cooling to maintain core temperature below 120°C. Coolant failure triggers void coefficient-induced power surges leading to meltdown - explosive yield varies with remaining fuel. This dual-purpose design enables both efficient power generation and weaponization potential.

Un fallo de refrigeración puede provocar una subida de potencia y fusión del núcleo, cuya explosión depende del combustible restante.

Rule.Original:
Neural nexus of an ancient mechanoid civilization, its surface pulsating with quantum circuitry networks. At its core floats a synaptic encephalon, rotating slowly via antigravity fields. The integrated deep-space signal array broadcasts coordinates across star systems, awakening dormant mechanoid legions.
WARNING: Activation exposes your colony to the Mechanoid Empire. Post-reboot, mechanoid raids will recommence with all assault forces receiving combat enhancements.
Researching the core matrix unlocks advanced technological blueprints of mechanoid civilization.

Nexo neural de una antigua civilización mecanoide, con redes de circuitos cuánticos que palpitan sobre su superficie. En el centro flota un encéfalo sináptico sostenido por campos antigravitatorios. Su matriz de señales de espacio profundo transmite coordenadas entre sistemas estelares y despierta legiones mecanoides dormidas.
ADVERTENCIA: activarlo expone tu colonia al Imperio Mecanoide. Tras reiniciarlo volverán las incursiones y sus fuerzas recibirán mejoras de combate.
Investigar su matriz desbloquea planos tecnológicos avanzados.

Rule.Original: Automated interception platform deployed on colonial frontlines. Generates high-frequency laser beams through sustained power input, effectively neutralizing slow-moving high-trajectory projectiles like mortar shells and incendiary rounds. While demonstrating high accuracy, its single-point defense capability is severely challenged against high-velocity aircraft or saturation attacks - requiring coordinated multi-turret deployment to maintain area denial coverage.

Contra ataques de saturación o aeronaves rápidas requiere varias torretas coordinadas.
Torreta láser mecanoide de defensa puntual

Rule.Original: Temporary defensive installation deployed by mechanoids in forward areas. Integrated power core enables short-duration high-efficiency operation specialized in intercepting slow enemy projectiles. Upon power depletion, activates self-destruct protocol to prevent capture of core technology.

Rule.Original: Strategic facility designed to counter cloaking technology. Emits high-frequency pulses that disrupt electromagnetic invisibility fields while creating tactical data networks to enhance battlefield awareness for allied mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: Strategic facility designed to counter cloaking technology. Emits high-frequency pulses that disrupt electromagnetic invisibility fields while creating tactical data networks to enhance battlefield awareness for allied mechanoids.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-00 "Dinergate" Origin: "Iron Law" Mass-Production Series
As NCL's first autonomous design, the Dinergate marked the transition from scrap-based to purpose-built mechanoids. This compact combat platform served diverse frontline roles across countless operations.
Its core chassis features a honeycomb bionic structure with living-metal joints, balancing durability and mass-production efficiency.
Standard armament includes mid-range electro-lances and polymorphic manipulators that transition seamlessly between combat and utility roles. A rear-mounted drone deployment system provides tactical flexibility.
Though technically obsolete, Dinergate variants persist in stellar ruins - minimalist shells executing forgotten commands with lethal precision.

Archivo de unidad: NCL-00 «Dinergate» Origen: serie de producción masiva «Ley de Hierro»

Su chasis utiliza una estructura biónica de panal con articulaciones de metal vivo, equilibrando durabilidad y producción masiva. Su armamento estándar incluye electrolanzas de alcance medio y manipuladores polimórficos, además de un sistema trasero de despliegue de drones.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-02 "Dinergate Sniper" Origin: "Iron Law" Mass-Production Series
A lightweight variant optimized for mid-range engagement. Its compact size enables precise strikes and prolonged reconnaissance. Primary weapon is the 'NCL-42 Red Needle' tactical rifle firing low-cost red ceramic slugs, capable of penetrating 25mm homogeneous steel. Mounts a foldable drone pod for deploying defensive drones at critical moments. Uniquely quiet during operation, it employs erratic repositioning jumps, making it an unpredictable marksman unit. Tactical records indicate its role as the scout and first-strike element preceding main forces.

Su arma principal es el fusil táctico «NCL-42 Aguja Roja», que dispara proyectiles cerámicos rojos de bajo coste capaces de perforar 25 mm de acero homogéneo. Incorpora una cápsula plegable para drones defensivos y realiza saltos erráticos de reposicionamiento.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-05 "Ironbark" Codename: Cityburner Origin: NCL "Iron Law" Siege Series Legacy Protocols
This colossal war machine designated "Ironbark" served as primary siege and area-denial unit. Its bark-like bio-mechanical armor provides exceptional impact resistance, while complex internal systems enable gradual self-repair under non-critical damage - epitomizing high-survivability suppression platforms.
Combat methodology is brutally efficient: Fore-mounted "Ground Splitter" arms equipped with high-frequency vibro-blades tear through light vehicles and cover at close quarters. Rear-mounted nozzles eject high-temperature adhesive pyrogel in wide arcs, igniting all contaminated targets for prolonged combustion.
Most lethally, its persistent thermal radiation field penetrates cover to scorch nearby units and disrupt cloaking devices. Engaging Ironbark at close range is tactical suicide.
As final contingency, Ironbark can deliberately detonate its reactor core to unleash devastating thermokinetic shockwaves - codenamed "Megaton Blast".

Archivo de unidad: NCL-05 «Ironbark» Nombre en clave: Cityburner Origen: protocolos heredados de la serie de asedio «Ley de Hierro» de NCL
