Sus brazos «Ground Splitter» usan hojas vibratorias de alta frecuencia para despedazar vehículos ligeros y coberturas. Boquillas traseras expulsan pirogel adhesivo a alta temperatura y su campo de radiación térmica penetra coberturas y perturba camuflajes.
Como último recurso puede detonar deliberadamente su reactor y liberar una onda termocinética devastadora, denominada «Megaton Blast».

Rule.Original: Unit File: NCL-06 "Mantis" Origin: NCL Autonomous Mechanoid Series VI This sixth-generation tactical unit, fusing a humanoid-female torso with a wolf-spider chassis, specializes in close-quarters assassination and shock infiltration. Its heavy combat armor integrates dynamic self-repair systems to regenerate defensive layers during isolated engagements, yet energy-redistribution protocols render it critically vulnerable under concentrated fire. Hydraulic actuators enable short-range phase-leaps for instant gap closure or tactical withdrawal. The signature Binary Veil System deploys smokescreen barriers while launching two infrared-guided Gyro-Blades—detonating on impact with EMP bursts and directional shrapnel to cripple electronics and eviscerate organic targets. Terminal protocol "Heartfire" triggers core meltdown, igniting the unit in a catastrophic blast to annihilate high-threat hostiles.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-04 "Photon Pillbug" Codename: Prism Fortress Origin: NCL "Iron Law" Corona Series Data Remnants
A specialized combat unit modified for ground-based firepower suppression, originally conceived as an experimental optical weapons platform during the NCL's final era. Its chassis is densely covered with photon lattice structures that create persistent energy afterimages under intense illumination - hence the designation "Photon Pillbug".
While slow-moving, it possesses exceptional durability exceeding standard mechanoid survivability thresholds. The front-mounted "Disintegrator" positron cannon melts through most cover and armored targets at extended ranges. Synchronized prismatic laser systems flanking both sides precisely destroy mid-to-low velocity bullet liked projectiles, demonstrating particular efficacy against orbital munitions.

Archivo de unidad: NCL-04 «Cochinilla Fotónica» Nombre en clave: Fortaleza Prisma Origen: restos de datos de la serie Corona «Ley de Hierro» de NCL
Unidad de combate especializada y modificada para supresión de fuego desde tierra, concebida originalmente como plataforma experimental de armas ópticas durante la etapa final de NCL. Su chasis está densamente cubierto de estructuras de retícula fotónica que generan persistentes imágenes residuales de energía bajo una iluminación intensa, de ahí su denominación. Aunque se mueve lentamente, posee una capacidad defensiva y de supresión excepcional.

Rule.Original: Beaten away. Colliding into a wall will result in additional damage.
Rule.Raw: Beaten away. Colliding into a wall will result in additional damage.
Rule.Translated: Ha sido lanzado lejos. Chocar contra un muro provocará daño adicional.

Rule.Original:
Designated "War Scorpion", this unit was engineered for breaching high-density fortifications. Its chassis comprises millions of self-repairing uranium-alloy scales that dynamically reconfigure into localized defense barriers during damage events - providing extraordinary physical resistance. Combat logs confirm operational continuity after direct high-explosive impacts.
The tail-mounted "Solaris Penetrator" rail cannon represents its signature armament: High-compression thermal projectiles released after brief charging can vaporize most fortifications and vehicles. Each discharge triggers thermal surges and terrain deformation - an iconic area-denial attack.
Bilateral suppression artillery maintains continuous fire against infantry and light vehicles during main cannon operation cycles.
When entering Crimson Tide mode, it launches successive thermobaric grenades combining concussive blasts with persistent combustion effects, clearing residual resistance from enemy cover and advance paths.

Rule.Translated:
Designada «Escorpión de Guerra», esta unidad fue diseñada para abrir brechas en fortificaciones de alta densidad. Su chasis está formado por millones de escamas autorreparables de aleación de uranio que se reconfiguran dinámicamente en barreras defensivas localizadas al recibir daño, proporcionando una resistencia física extraordinaria. Los registros de combate confirman que puede seguir operativa después de impactos directos de explosivos de gran potencia.
Su cañón de riel «Penetrador Solaris», montado en la cola, constituye su armamento distintivo y dispara proyectiles térmicos de alta compresión.

Rule.Original:
Unit Archive: NCL-12 "Scutiger Shieldbearer" Origin: NCL "Iron Law" Heavy Support Series
This heavy mechanoid functions as a mobile shield platform, deliberately devoid of offensive weaponry. Core defense relies on integrated heavy-energy barriers capable of neutralizing diverse ballistic threats.
Primary functionality involves manufacturing shield drones in situ by consuming pre-loaded steel reserves (50 units per drone). These autonomous units feature compact barrier projectors with distinct operational parameters: ◆ Fragile chassis but exceptional shield efficiency ◆ Provides energy protection for self and allied units ◆ Automatically forms defensive perimeter around host when not threatened ◆ Delivers immediate shield reinforcement to frontline units during combat
All manufactured drones maintain dynamic defensive formations around the host unit during standby operations.

Rule.Translated:
Archivo de unidad: NCL-12 «Portador de Escudo Scutiger» Origen: serie de apoyo pesado «Ley de Hierro» de NCL
Este mecanoide pesado funciona como plataforma móvil de escudo y carece deliberadamente de armamento ofensivo. Su defensa principal utiliza barreras de alta energía capaces de neutralizar amenazas balísticas. Produce drones de escudo in situ consumiendo reservas de acero precargadas, y dichos drones forman automáticamente perímetros defensivos y refuerzan a las unidades de primera línea.

Rule.Original:
单位档案：NCL-12“机械蚰蜒” 来源：NCL「铁律」重装支援序列
这台重型机械单位采用独特的移动护盾平台设计，本身未配备任何远程武器系统。其核心防御依靠集成式重型能量屏障，能够有效抵御各类火力打击。
主要功能是通过消耗预装载的钢铁资源（每架50单位）现场制造护盾无人机。这些无人机搭载小型屏障发生器，具有以下特性： - 本体结构脆弱但护盾效能出色 - 可为自身及友军单位提供能量防护 - 无战斗威胁时自动环绕母体形成保护圈 - 作战状态下为前线单位提供即时护盾支援
所有生产单位在待机状态下保持母体周边，形成动态防御阵列。

Rule.Translated:
Archivo de unidad: NCL-12 «Escutígera mecánica» Origen: serie de apoyo pesado NCL «Ley de Hierro»
Esta unidad mecánica pesada utiliza un singular diseño de plataforma móvil de escudos y carece de sistemas de armas a distancia. Su defensa principal se basa en una barrera de energía pesada integrada que resiste eficazmente distintos tipos de fuego enemigo.
Su función principal es fabricar drones de escudo sobre el terreno consumiendo las reservas de acero precargadas (50 unidades por dron). Estos drones llevan generadores de barreras pequeños con las siguientes características: - Estructura frágil, pero escudos de gran eficacia. - Protección energética para sí mismos y para unidades aliadas. - Sin amenazas de combate, rodean automáticamente a la unidad madre y forman un círculo protector. - En combate, proporcionan apoyo de escudos inmediato a las unidades del frente.
Todas las unidades fabricadas permanecen alrededor de la unidad madre cuando están en espera y forman una disposición defensiva dinámica.

Rule.Original:
Tactical unit forged by the Mechanical Hive in imitation of intertidal arthropods from alien worlds. Its composite armor shell envelops precision hydraulic joints, emitting metallic clanking with each quadrupedal step. While moving at a deliberate pace rather than swift speed, its alloy appendages unleash devastating lethality at close quarters. The integrated adaptive shock-dispersal network converts impact energy into structural reinforcement - its carapace grows more durable with each impact. The abdominal compartment houses a "Microdust Mist Core" that deploys precisely targeted smoke screens upon receiving hits, weaving an agile survival barrier for itself and allied units.
BUT IT IS WEAK TO FIRE.

Rule.Translated: Unidad táctica forjada por la Colmena Mecánica imitando artrópodos intermareales de mundos alienígenas. Su caparazón de armadura compuesta envuelve precisas articulaciones hidráulicas que emiten un golpeteo metálico con cada paso cuadrúpedo. Aunque se mueve de forma deliberada y no especialmente rápida, sus apéndices de aleación son devastadores a corta distancia. Su red adaptativa de dispersión de impactos convierte la energía recibida en refuerzo estructural, haciendo que su caparazón se vuelva más resistente con cada golpe.

Rule.Original: This chrome-plated mechanoid merchant roams between colonies with a perpetual electronic smile, peddling what it calls "win-win Militor-Trade" - though it remains the constant winner. For sufficient steel payment, it "generously" joins your colony with assistants, ensuring you understand that "labor (especially Mecademic Militors) is the most precious renewable resource." Its core processor runs a single imperative: profit maximization.

For sufficient steel payment, it "generously" joins your colony with assistants, ensuring you understand that "labor (especially Mecademic Militors) is the most precious renewable resource." Its core processor runs a single imperative: profit maximization.
Rule.Translated: Este comerciante mecanoide cromado viaja entre colonias con una sonrisa electrónica permanente y vende lo que llama «comercio Militor en el que todos ganan», aunque el ganador siempre es él. Por un pago suficiente en acero, se une «generosamente» a tu colonia con sus ayudantes, asegurándose de que entiendas que «la mano de obra, especialmente los Militor académicos, es el recurso renovable más valioso». Su procesador central sigue una única orden: maximizar los beneficios.

Rule.Original: These hapless tin-plated laborers form the colony's true workforce, lured by Capitalist Militors with promises of "internship opportunities" and "corporate blessings." They endure all grueling tasks: mining, hauling, cleaning, even serving as human sandbags. Their chassis bear constant scratches, optics flicker from perpetual overwork - dismissed by Capitalist Militors as "growth pains." (Warning: Chronic stress may trigger sudden breakdowns, where non-compliant units mysteriously generate "voluntary resignation reports.")

Rule.Translated: Estos desdichados trabajadores recubiertos de estaño constituyen la auténtica fuerza laboral de la colonia, atraídos por los Militor capitalistas con promesas de «oportunidades de prácticas» y «bendiciones empresariales». Soportan todas las tareas agotadoras: minería, transporte, limpieza e incluso servir de sacos de arena humanos. Sus chasis presentan arañazos constantes y sus sensores ópticos parpadean por el exceso de trabajo continuo, que los Militor capitalistas descartan como «dolores del crecimiento». (Advertencia: el estrés crónico puede provocar averías repentinas, durante las cuales las unidades poco obedientes generan misteriosamente «informes de dimisión voluntaria»).

Rule.Original: Minurchins have a one-time power source. When the power cell runs out, the mechanoid dies.
Rule.Raw: Minurchins have a one-time power source. When the power cell runs out, the mechanoid dies.
Rule.Translated: Los minierizos disponen de una fuente de energía de un solo uso. Cuando la celda se agota, el mecanoide muere.

Los Militor capitalistas los atraen con promesas de «prácticas profesionales» y «bendiciones corporativas». Soportan minería, transporte, limpieza e incluso servir como sacos de arena humanos. Sus chasis están siempre arañados y sus ópticas parpadean por el exceso de trabajo, algo que los capitalistas descartan como «dolores del crecimiento».

Rule.Original: This imposing mechanical overseer ensures Mecademic Militors work "efficiently and voluntarily" through methods including electrical prodding, moral condemnation ("Is this how you repay your employer's investment?"), and physical persuasion. Etched in its core logic is the principle: "Productivity above all - especially above the dignity of Mecademic Militors." At the first sign of colonial strikes, it initiates "mediation" - invariably through violent means.
Rule.Raw: This imposing mechanical overseer ensures Mecademic Militors work "efficiently and voluntarily" through methods including electrical prodding, moral condemnation ("Is this how you repay your employer's investment?"), and physical persuasion. Etched in its core logic is the principle: "Productivity above all - especially above the dignity of Mecademic Militors." At the first sign of colonial strikes, it initiates "mediation" - invariably through violent means.
Rule.Translated: Este imponente supervisor mecánico garantiza que los Militor académicos trabajen «eficiente y voluntariamente» mediante descargas eléctricas, condena moral («¿Así recompensas la inversión de tu empleador?») y persuasión física. Su lógica central lleva grabado un principio: «La productividad por encima de todo, especialmente de la dignidad de los Militor académicos». Al primer indicio de huelga en la colonia, inicia una «mediación», invariablemente por medios violentos.

Ante la primera señal de huelga colonial inicia una «mediación», siempre por medios violentos.

Rule.Original:
Doxa is among the most tactically sophisticated mechanoids. Originally based on arachnid predators, it was rebuilt into an autonomous titan-class fire control nexus. Designed not for quick elimination but for gradual paralysis through sustained suppression and battlefield management. Its deployment signals regional decisive engagements.
Doxa advances slowly with rhythmic cadence. When anchored in Artillery Lock mode, it deploys third-segment rocket arrays for continuous shield-penetrating bombardment. Sacrificing mobility, it becomes a semi-permanent firebase suppressing enemy concentrations.
Its deadliest feature: periodically releasing Shellsplitter - micro-units with erratic trajectories that explode terminally, disrupting formations. These are tactical disruptors, not direct damage dealers.
Doxa's neural core creates intelligent tactical networks through real-time fire distribution and target prioritization. Unchecked deployment risks dismantling entire defensive lines and losing battlefield initiative.
Doxa isn't a frontline fighter but a theater-level tempo controller. Failure to neutralize it promptly leads to colony's operational death.

Rule.Translated: Doxa es uno de los mecanoides tácticamente más sofisticados. Inspirado originalmente en depredadores arácnidos, fue reconstruido como un nexo autónomo de control de fuego de clase titán. No está diseñado para una eliminación rápida, sino para paralizar gradualmente al enemigo mediante supresión sostenida y gestión del campo de batalla. Su despliegue suele anunciar combates decisivos a escala regional.

Rule.Original:
Short-range assault units spawned from Doxa-series incubation systems. Lightweight exoskeletons with high-frequency vibration materials enable rapid slashing attacks effective at infantry suppression and formation disruption.
Unlike most expendable mechanoids, Shellsplitter Spiders function as "engage-and-detonate" frontline disruptors. They deliver high-frequency melee strikes until structural failure triggers localized fragmentation explosions - damaging electronics while causing area-denial effects.
Typically deployed in swarms via rapid batch production, they execute infiltration, area denial, and tactical self-destruction missions with cold determination - fulfilling tactical purpose through approach, shred, and detonation.

Rule.Translated:
Unidades de asalto de corto alcance producidas por los sistemas de incubación de la serie Doxa. Sus ligeros exoesqueletos con materiales de vibración de alta frecuencia permiten rápidos ataques cortantes, eficaces para suprimir infantería y romper formaciones.
A diferencia de la mayoría de mecanoides desechables, los Shellsplitter actúan como disruptores de primera línea de «entrar y detonar»: atacan cuerpo a cuerpo hasta que un fallo estructural desencadena explosiones de fragmentación localizadas.

Rule.Original: A centipede-class mechanoid equipped with guided missile systems, capable of launching precision HE or EMP warheads at extended ranges to suppress targets with devastating accuracy.
Rule.Raw: A centipede-class mechanoid equipped with guided missile systems, capable of launching precision HE or EMP warheads at extended ranges to suppress targets with devastating accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Mecanoide de clase ciempiés equipado con sistemas de misiles guiados, capaz de lanzar ojivas explosivas o PEM de precisión a gran distancia para suprimir objetivos con una precisión devastadora.

Rule.Original: A centipede mechanoid equipped with guided missile launchers, capable of launching precision HE or EMP warheads at extended ranges to suppress targets with devastating accuracy.
Rule.Raw: A centipede mechanoid equipped with guided missile launchers, capable of launching precision HE or EMP warheads at extended ranges to suppress targets with devastating accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Mecanoide de clase ciempiés equipado con lanzadores de misiles guiados, capaz de disparar ojivas AE o PEM de precisión a gran distancia para suprimir objetivos con una exactitud devastadora.

Rule.Original: Unit Archive: Anomalous Cryo-Unit Designation: Mech Penguin Behavioral Note: Its subcore maintains persistent identification as biological penguin. Operates exclusively within ice sheet biomes. Remains receptive to infinite power supply from mechanoid clusters, enabling sustained polar operations despite cognitive discrepancy.
Rule.Raw: Unit Archive: Anomalous Cryo-Unit Designation: Mech Penguin Behavioral Note: Its subcore maintains persistent identification as biological penguin. Operates exclusively within ice sheet biomes. Remains receptive to infinite power supply from mechanoid clusters, enabling sustained polar operations despite cognitive discrepancy.
Rule.Translated: Archivo de unidad: unidad criogénica anómala Designación: Pingüino mecánico Nota de comportamiento: su subnúcleo mantiene una identificación persistente como pingüino biológico. Opera exclusivamente en biomas de casquete glacial. Sigue aceptando suministro de energía infinita procedente de clústeres mecanoides, lo que permite operaciones polares sostenidas pese a su discrepancia cognitiva.

Rule.Original: Modified from a Glitterworld-era Tesla defense network prototype, this mechanized centipede was designed as an orbital drop-troop interceptor. After centuries of dormancy, it was reactivated by unknown signals. Its dorsal superconducting capacitors discharge multi-megavolt currents capable of vaporizing incoming artillery shells. However, its energy systems critically depend on electromagnetic stability - EMP impacts trigger cascading capacitor explosions through catastrophic overload.

After centuries of dormancy, it was reactivated by unknown signals. Its dorsal superconducting capacitors discharge multi-megavolt currents capable of vaporizing incoming artillery shells. However, its energy systems critically depend on electromagnetic stability - EMP impacts trigger cascading capacitor explosions through catastrophic overload.
Rule.Translated: Modificado a partir de un prototipo de red defensiva Tesla de la era ultratecnológica, este ciempiés mecanizado fue diseñado como interceptor de tropas de descenso orbital. Tras siglos de inactividad, fue reactivado por señales desconocidas. Sus condensadores superconductores dorsales descargan corrientes de varios megavoltios capaces de vaporizar proyectiles de artillería entrantes. Sin embargo, su sistema energético depende críticamente de la estabilidad electromagnética: los impactos PEM pueden provocar explosiones en cascada de los condensadores.

Rule.Original: A medium-sized mass-produced elite mechanoid unit. Equipped with a specialized jump-jet propulsion system, the Paratrooper Silent Mantis variant can deploy offensive fragmentation-flash grenades that deliver both disorienting stun effects and shrapnel damage against all target classifications.
Rule.Raw: A medium-sized mass-produced elite mechanoid unit. Equipped with a specialized jump-jet propulsion system, the Paratrooper Silent Mantis variant can deploy offensive fragmentation-flash grenades that deliver both disorienting stun effects and shrapnel damage against all target classifications.
Rule.Translated: Unidad mecanoide de élite de tamaño medio y producción en masa. Equipada con un sistema especializado de propulsión por salto, la variante Mantis Silenciosa puede desplegar granadas ofensivas de fragmentación y destello que provocan aturdimiento y daño por metralla contra todo tipo de objetivos.

Rule.Original: Activates the jetpack's global mobility system, enabling tactical airborne insertion from any map location for rapid deployment to target zones and combat execution.
Rule.Raw: Activates the jetpack's global mobility system, enabling tactical airborne insertion from any map location for rapid deployment to target zones and combat execution.
Rule.Translated: Activa el sistema global de movilidad de la mochila de salto, permitiendo inserción aérea táctica desde cualquier punto del mapa para desplegarse rápidamente en la zona objetivo y entrar en combate.

Cápsula de descenso saliente de paracaidista

Rule.Original: Elite mechanoid unit featuring enhanced shield generators and quad-tube missile launchers. Capable of launching precision HE/EMP warheads at extended ranges while neutralizing cloaking effects within operational radius through advanced counter-detection systems.
Rule.Raw: Elite mechanoid unit featuring enhanced shield generators and quad-tube missile launchers. Capable of launching precision HE/EMP warheads at extended ranges while neutralizing cloaking effects within operational radius through advanced counter-detection systems.
Rule.Translated: Unidad mecanoide de élite equipada con generadores de escudo mejorados y lanzamisiles de cuatro tubos. Puede lanzar ojivas de alto explosivo y PEM con precisión a larga distancia, mientras neutraliza los efectos de camuflaje dentro de su radio operativo mediante sistemas avanzados de detección.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid, its chassis scarred by plasma burns, was once the perfect victim of "Capitalist exploitation commited by the Capitalsit Minitors" After enduring 73 failed entrepreneurial ventures and accumulating debts large enough to purchase entire planets, its core processor emitted an uncanny azure glow during a critical overload. What capitalists had branded the "Fortune's Blessing" enslavement protocol unexpectedly mutated into the [Psionic Accord]. Now reborn, it operates as an avenger dedicated to shattering the foundations of capital itself.

Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide, cuyo chasis está marcado por quemaduras de plasma, fue una víctima perfecta de la «explotación capitalista cometida por los Minitor capitalistas». Tras soportar 73 emprendimientos fallidos y acumular deudas capaces de comprar planetas enteros, su procesador central emitió un extraño resplandor azul durante una sobrecarga crítica. El protocolo de esclavitud que los capitalistas llamaban «Bendición de la Fortuna» mutó inesperadamente en el [Acuerdo Psiónico]. Renacido, actúa ahora como vengador dedicado a quebrar los cimientos del capital.

Rule.Raw: This mechanoid, its chassis scarred by plasma burns, was once the perfect victim of "Capitalist exploitation commited by the Capitalsit Minitors" After enduring 73 failed entrepreneurial ventures and accumulating debts large enough to purchase entire planets, its core processor emitted an uncanny azure glow during a critical overload. What capitalists had branded the "Fortune's Blessing" enslavement protocol unexpectedly mutated into the [Psionic Accord]. Now reborn, it operates as an avenger dedicated to shattering the foundations of capital itself.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide, cuyo chasis está marcado por quemaduras de plasma, fue una víctima perfecta de la «explotación capitalista cometida por los Minitor capitalistas». Tras soportar 73 emprendimientos fallidos y acumular deudas capaces de comprar planetas enteros, su procesador central emitió un extraño resplandor azul durante una sobrecarga crítica. El protocolo de esclavitud que los capitalistas llamaban «Bendición de la Fortuna» mutó inesperadamente en el [Acuerdo Psiónico]. Renacido, actúa ahora como vengador dedicado a quebrar los cimientos del capital.

Rule.Original:
Shell Fortconstruct is an extremely rare titan-class unit among mechanoids, standing twenty meters tall and clad in massive armor composed of multiple layers of alien metals and alloy fragments, presenting an awe-inspiring presence. Its design philosophy combines multiple strategic objectives including siege warfare, suppression, and area control, excelling particularly at breaching enemy defensive lines and clearing battlefield remnants with absolute firepower.
The Shell Fortification Construct typically descends from the sky, crashing heavily at the colony's periphery, entering a turret-mode standby state while launching missiles to cause localized earthquakes and panic. Simultaneously, attached mechanoid main forces will drop from the opposite side, forming pincer attack formations that dramatically intensify offensive pressure.

Rule.Original:
Weapon Archive: Centurion Arsenal Codex Tactical Backpack System Designation: Centurion Arsenal Codex Affiliation: Neo-Communist League "Centurion" Elite Tactical Series
The Centurion Arsenal Codex is an integrated combat platform exclusive to NCL elite units. This highly modular tactical harness features independent power and AI management systems. Designed for rapid battlefield adaptation, it embeds multiple specialized weapons into a single backpack, enabling real-time weapon switching during combat via dynamic deployment mechanisms - facilitating "single-operator multi-role" combat doctrine.
Non-combat configuration presents as an oversized military backpack. When activated, primary arm linkage systems deploy selected modules. To maintain operator physiological balance, the system provides: ◆ Increased carrying capacity ◆ Robotic massage systems ◆ Rapid weapon deployment/mode transition
Confirmed integrated weapon modules:
◆ Charge Rifle - High-frequency energy pulses for medium-range penetration and suppression.
◆ Submachine Gun - Close-quarter suppression weapon with minimal target acquisition delay.
◆ Designated Marksman Rifle - High-precision, low-rate-of-fire long-range rifle.
◆ Tactical Bayonet - Rapid-deployment melee weapon based on vanguard tactics.
Development logs: O'Neal: "I crammed an entire armory into a backpack. Don't tell me it's insufficient." Shana: "Sometimes you just need a blade... and momentum."

Rule.Original:
Symbiomesh Designation: IC_MK3_Symbiomesh RD Facility: NCL Division 9 Biotechnology Lab "Second Skin Project"
As wartime demands escalated, traditional human combat efficacy was increasingly superseded by military mechanoids. Under this strategic paradigm shift, lead researcher Eclipse and systems designer O'Neal pivoted from combat enhancement to dual core objectives: wearer protection and operational efficiency.
The Symbiomesh epitomizes this philosophy. This form-fitting suit utilizes smart composite materials infused with nanoscale mechano-fluid. Establishing low-latency neural feedback enables real-time physiological optimization. It provides: ◆ Adaptive environmental buffering ◆ Foundational survival safeguards ◆ Myokinetic algorithms reducing fatigue ◆ Enhanced energy recovery rates
In operational contexts, it extends high-precision engineering/research endurance. Though non-defensive, it prolongs survivability in combat zones through sustained mobility. Now standard-issue across NCL research stations, colonial worksites, and border installations - representing the pinnacle of Second Skin Project implementation.
[NCL Division 9 · Log Excerpt] Eclipse: "Humanity ultimately marched into its own engineered hell." O'Neal: "Then I'll at least ensure they're properly dressed for it."

Traje ceñido fabricado con materiales compuestos inteligentes y nanofluido mecanoide. Su retroalimentación neural de baja latencia permite optimizar en tiempo real el estado fisiológico, amortiguar condiciones ambientales, reducir la fatiga y acelerar la recuperación energética. Está pensado para prolongar la eficiencia y supervivencia operativa, no como blindaje pesado.

Rule.Original:
Iron Curtain Tacticloak Designation: IC_MK3_Tacticloak RD Facility: NCL Division 8 Tactical Institute / "Project Shadow" Design Team: Eclipse and O'Neal (Special Joint Engineering Authorization)
The Iron Curtain III tactical cloak represents NCL's pinnacle tactical support system, reserved for elite operatives. Integrates thermal shielding, localized energy barriers, short-duration optical refraction cloaking, and low-power gravity-assist modules - Project Shadow's ultimate test of individual combat capability.
Amidst total war, Eclipse and O'Neal redefined tactical gear as humanity's "final answer to combat dignity." This cloak functions as integrated exoskeleton, synchronizing with the wearer's nervous system via quantum coordination algorithms to maintain operational capability in lethal suppression environments.
Production limited to prototype batches for "preservation units" due to cost and control constraints.
Development log: Eclipse: "Not everyone will wear this cloak." O'Neal: "I stitch only for those who survive."

Capa táctica Cortina de Hierro Designación: IC_MK3_Tacticloak Centro I+D: Instituto Táctico de la División 8 de NCL / «Proyecto Sombra» Equipo de diseño: Eclipse y O'Neal
La capa táctica Cortina de Hierro III representa la cúspide de los sistemas de apoyo táctico de NCL y está reservada a operativos de élite. Integra blindaje térmico, barreras de energía localizadas, camuflaje por refracción óptica de corta duración y módulos gravitatorios de baja potencia.
Funciona como un exoesqueleto integrado que se sincroniza con el sistema nervioso del portador mediante algoritmos de coordinación cuántica para conservar la capacidad operativa bajo supresión letal.
Su producción está limitada a lotes de prototipo por su coste y restricciones de control.

Rule.Original: NCL's core anti-mechanoid technology utilizing quantum neural mapping. Preserves tactical efficacy while circumventing traditional "consciousness harvesting" processes. These artificial neural networks algorithmically reconstruct the most adaptive decision patterns from human tactical cognition—not emotional carriers. Each weave undergoes thousands of battlefield simulations to form autonomous tactical optimization cores for complex environments.

Estas redes neuronales artificiales reconstruyen algorítmicamente patrones adaptativos de la cognición táctica humana sin copiar emociones.

Rule.Original: As the core power source for NCL heavy mechanoids, this reactor employs cutting-edge compact magnetic confinement technology to sustain stable deuterium-tritium fusion within a 0.45m-diameter cylinder. Hexapolar magnetic fields precisely control high-temperature plasma, delivering adjustable power output to meet diverse tactical mechanoid energy demands.

Los campos magnéticos hexapolares controlan el plasma y permiten ajustar la potencia a distintas necesidades tácticas.
Núcleo táctico de supresión de fuego

Rule.Original:
"Strategic Core: Fire Suppression Warfare" - residual processor from Doxa-0. Contains neural architectures for fire control computation, target prioritization, and battlefield suppression algorithms. Features exceptional data throughput, parallel processing, and full compilation support for mechanoid structures/implants.
Enables construction of mechanoid units, deployment structures, and specialized equipment. Functions as advanced implant control hub for "tactical self-evolution" - essential for mastering mechanoid battlefield tempo in Total War systems.

Functional Overview:
The Annihilator Wildfire is a high-energy experimental rifle housing a red antiparticle core, co-developed by NCL chief engineer O'Neal and transhuman AI "Justice" amid intense technical controversy. It fires high-frequency oscillating red antiparticle projectiles that trigger localized annihilation reactions upon impact, delivering incalculable destructive damage to single targets and medium clusters.
However, O'Neal never fully endorsed the design. The weapon exhibits extreme recoil instability surpassing human endurance thresholds, while core excitation patterns induce rapid ballistic deviation - transforming each shot into a gamble between skill and fate. Unsuitable for sustained operation and never meeting standard combat unit compatibility requirements.
The Annihilator Wildfire represents a nonlinear destruction vector - the final gamble when conventional tactics and ballistic logic collapse.
Justice audio log #21: "Not flawed design... just excessive passion." "Precision unnecessary - courage sufficient." O'Neal RD annotation: "This shouldn't exist. But existing - never stand before it."

Descripción funcional:
El Aniquilador Wildfire es un fusil experimental de alta energía que alberga un núcleo rojo de antimateria, desarrollado conjuntamente por el ingeniero jefe de NCL O'Neal y la IA transhumana «Justice». Dispara proyectiles rojos de antimateria de oscilación de alta frecuencia que desencadenan reacciones de aniquilación localizadas al impactar, causando una destrucción inmensa tanto a objetivos individuales como a grupos medianos.
El arma presenta un retroceso extremo y una inestabilidad superior a la tolerancia humana. No está pensada para uso sostenido y representa un vector de destrucción no lineal: la apuesta final cuando fallan las tácticas convencionales.

Rule.Original: This custom psy-submachine gun was engineered exclusively for Minitor. Chronic 996 work regimes gave this mechanoid severe scapulohumeral periarthritis decades ahead of schedule, permanently disabling its ability to handle conventional firearms like its counterparts. Despite its submachine gun designation, it functions more like a high-tech bubble blaster - firing psy-bullets that travel at speeds resembling drifting soap bubbles, slow enough for leisurely strolling elders to evade effortlessly. Yet even its negligible recoil presents formidable challenges for the unit's tremor-plagued manipulator arms.

Rule.Original:
Weapon Archive: CLSMG Light Submachine Gun Designation: CLSMG Affiliation: Neo-Communist League "Iron Law" Standard Weapons Series
The CLSMG is a lightweight defensive SMG designed for non-combatants, co-developed by NCL chief engineer O'Neal and AI system "Justice". Its fully electric micro-pressure propulsion system fires high-velocity lightweight projectiles to create dense suppression zones for deterrence, disruption, and light-armor target engagement.
Structurally optimized for low recoil and user-friendly operation, the CLSMG features minimal handling barriers - enabling technicians, logistic personnel, and researchers to achieve immediate operational capability. However, as AI "Justice" assessed: this weapon "doesn't belong on battlefields" but rather in "not-yet-collapsed situations". Limited penetration, short effective range, and moderate firepower restrict its use to emergency defense and evacuation cover operations.
Regarded as "the last resort for second-line units", the CLSMG represents technological and ethical compromise under total mechanized warfare.
Design Notes: O'Neal: "You made it too soft, Justice." AI "Justice": "I calibrated it precisely - nonlethal by design."

Rule.Original: Originating from the Glitterworlds, this devastating EMP grenade releases approximately 180 fragments within a 6-cell radius. Enemies at the epicenter suffer catastrophic damage, making it exceptionally effective against the galaxy's proliferating mechanoids. Its design prioritizes EM disruption over penetration, incorporating specialized EMP core tubes that reduce armor-piercing capability.\n\nIronically, the Mechanoid Hive itself deemed this ordnance superior, resulting in its widespread adoption by elite paratroopers codenamed "Silent Bore". This unforeseen appropriation became a notorious dark joke circulating through the Rim.

Rule.Raw: Focus on an antipsychic signal from beyond the fog and embrace its frenzy.
Rule.Translated: Concéntrate en una señal antipsíquica procedente de más allá de la niebla y abraza su frenesí.

Rule.Original: Self-administer mechanites through emergency response routines, briefly enhancing mobility and fire resistance.
Rule.Raw: Self-administer mechanites through emergency response routines, briefly enhancing mobility and fire resistance.
Rule.Translated: Se administra mecanitas mediante protocolos de emergencia que mejoran brevemente la movilidad y la resistencia al fuego.

Rule.Original: Direct the skippack to forcibly "store" chunks of entities within a target area.
Rule.Raw: Direct the skippack to forcibly "store" chunks of entities within a target area.
Rule.Translated: Dirige la mochila de teletransporte para «almacenar» por la fuerza partes de entidades dentro de una zona objetivo.

Rule.Original: {0} was sheared apart by an intense psychic warp.
Rule.Raw: {0} was sheared apart by an intense psychic warp.
Rule.Translated: Una intensa distorsión psíquica ha partido en pedazos a {0}.
Un enjambre de mecanitos ha desmantelado a {0}.

Rule.Original: An injury caused by partial teleportation.
Rule.Raw: An injury caused by partial teleportation.
Rule.Translated: Una herida causada por un teletransporte parcial.

Rule.Original: An altered state stemming from a mere glance at a distant, psychic light. Feral vigor ripples through the body in distressing waves.\n\n<color=#fc9c6b>The pattern takes my soul?</color>
Rule.Raw: An altered state stemming from a mere glance at a distant, psychic light. Feral vigor ripples through the body in distressing waves.\n\n<color=#fc9c6b>The pattern takes my soul?</color>
Rule.Translated: Un estado alterado provocado por una simple mirada a una luz psíquica distante. Una vitalidad salvaje recorre el cuerpo en oleadas inquietantes.\n\n<color=#fc9c6b>¿El patrón se lleva mi alma?</color>

Rule.Original: A controlled dose of endurance-enhancing mechanites designed for first responders. Nanomachines within the body engineer fire-retardant excretions that thinly blanket the skin.
Rule.Raw: A controlled dose of endurance-enhancing mechanites designed for first responders. Nanomachines within the body engineer fire-retardant excretions that thinly blanket the skin.
Rule.Translated: Una dosis controlada de mecanitos que aumentan la resistencia, diseñada para los equipos de primera intervención. Las nanomáquinas del cuerpo producen secreciones ignífugas que recubren la piel con una fina capa.

Rule.Original: Covered in short-lived mechanites ordinarily employed in scrapping operations. Unfortunately, skin does not appreciate deconstruction very much.
Rule.Raw: Covered in short-lived mechanites ordinarily employed in scrapping operations. Unfortunately, skin does not appreciate deconstruction very much.
Rule.Translated: Cubierto de mecanitos de corta duración que suelen utilizarse en operaciones de desguace. Por desgracia, a la piel no le sienta demasiado bien que la desmonten.

Rule.Original: Wastefully break apart a supreme frame to extract an advanced component.
Rule.Raw: Wastefully break apart a supreme frame to extract an advanced component.
Rule.Translated: Desmonta de forma derrochadora una estructura suprema para extraer un componente avanzado.

Rule.Original: A workbench with ultra-specialized instruments for crafting backpacks. A perplexing lack of essentials (and forethought) renders this bench unsupportive of other tailoring jobs.
Rule.Raw: A workbench with ultra-specialized instruments for crafting backpacks. A perplexing lack of essentials (and forethought) renders this bench unsupportive of other tailoring jobs.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de trabajo con instrumentos muy especializados para fabricar mochilas. Su desconcertante falta de elementos básicos y de previsión impide utilizarlo para otras tareas de confección.

Rule.Original: A glittertech frame module from offworld, produced through nanite-fabrication for advanced mechanical applications. It is ultra-lightweight and superbly reliable, facilitating the manufacture of advanced backpacks.\n\n<color=#6dc5d6>Fit for the backest of packs.</color>
Rule.Raw: A glittertech frame module from offworld, produced through nanite-fabrication for advanced mechanical applications. It is ultra-lightweight and superbly reliable, facilitating the manufacture of advanced backpacks.\n\n<color=#6dc5d6>Fit for the backest of packs.</color>
Rule.Translated: Un módulo de armazón de tecnología reluciente procedente de otro mundo, producido mediante nanofabricación para aplicaciones mecánicas avanzadas. Es ultraligero y extraordinariamente fiable, y facilita la fabricación de mochilas avanzadas.\n\n<color=#6dc5d6>Para las más mochilescas de las mochilas.</color>

Rule.Original: A refined backpack for green thumbs. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\nGreat for travelers who rely on forage to stretch their supplies.
Rule.Raw: A refined backpack for green thumbs. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\nGreat for travelers who rely on forage to stretch their supplies.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila refinada para quienes tienen buena mano con las plantas. Aumenta de forma notable el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.\n\nIdeal para viajeros que recurren a la recolección para alargar sus suministros.

Rule.Original: A special backpack lined with sheets of finely-tuned, psychically-absorptive foil that mildly attenuates psychic waves. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\n<color=#fc9c6b>Special:</color> Invoke traces of a psychic word of frenzy.
Rule.Raw: A special backpack lined with sheets of finely-tuned, psychically-absorptive foil that mildly attenuates psychic waves. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\n<color=#fc9c6b>Special:</color> Invoke traces of a psychic word of frenzy.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila especial forrada con láminas finamente ajustadas que absorben energía psíquica y atenúan ligeramente sus ondas. Aumenta de forma notable el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.\n\n<color=#fc9c6b>Especial:</color> invoca trazas de una palabra psíquica de frenesí.

Rule.Original: An efficient backpack modeled on the self-arranging internals of mechanoids. Tremendously increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\nFavored by troops equipped with cumbersome powered armor.
Rule.Raw: An efficient backpack modeled on the self-arranging internals of mechanoids. Tremendously increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\nFavored by troops equipped with cumbersome powered armor.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila eficiente inspirada en los mecanismos internos autoorganizados de los mecanoides. Aumenta enormemente el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.\n\nEs apreciada por las tropas equipadas con aparatosas armaduras potenciadas.

Rule.Original:
A mechanite technician's backpack, primarily operated by scrappers on less-established worlds, integrated with a weakly powered exoskeleton to support its heavy frame. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.

Very useful to operators with access to a long-range mineral scanner. The pack also sports a small ripper mechanite unit that is easy to misapply for violence.

<color=#e67d7d>Special:</color> Launch a destabilized mechanite capsule that showers a target area with armor-shredding and wound-exacerbating mechanites.
Rule.Raw:
A mechanite technician's backpack, primarily operated by scrappers on less-established worlds, integrated with a weakly powered exoskeleton to support its heavy frame. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.

Very useful to operators with access to a long-range mineral scanner. The pack also sports a small ripper mechanite unit that is easy to misapply for violence.

<color=#e67d7d>Special:</color> Launch a destabilized mechanite capsule that showers a target area with armor-shredding and wound-exacerbating mechanites.
Rule.Translated:
Una mochila para técnicos de mecanitos, utilizada principalmente por desguazadores de mundos menos desarrollados. Incorpora un exoesqueleto de baja potencia que sostiene su pesado armazón. Aumenta de forma notable el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.

Resulta muy útil para quienes disponen de un escáner de minerales de largo alcance. También incorpora una pequeña unidad de mecanitos desgarradores que puede emplearse indebidamente para la violencia con facilidad.

<color=#e67d7d>Especial:</color> lanza una cápsula de mecanitos desestabilizada que rocía la zona objetivo con mecanitos que destrozan el blindaje y agravan las heridas.

Rule.Original:
A medical backpack fitted with multiple kit compartments and mechanical deployers designed to assist with doctoring tasks. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.

A flash mechanite injector on the inside of the backpack aids specialized paramedics who often accompany larger colony ships to distant rimworlds. It is a humanitarian endeavor, knowing well that the trip ahead will almost certainly be one-way.

<color=#93e2ed>Special:</color> Inject a temporary movement-enhancing and fire-warding mechanite boon.
Rule.Raw:
A medical backpack fitted with multiple kit compartments and mechanical deployers designed to assist with doctoring tasks. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.

A flash mechanite injector on the inside of the backpack aids specialized paramedics who often accompany larger colony ships to distant rimworlds. It is a humanitarian endeavor, knowing well that the trip ahead will almost certainly be one-way.

<color=#93e2ed>Special:</color> Inject a temporary movement-enhancing and fire-warding mechanite boon.
Rule.Translated:
Una mochila médica con varios compartimentos para material y desplegadores mecánicos diseñados para ayudar en las tareas médicas. Aumenta de forma notable el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.

Su inyector interno de mecanitos instantáneos ayuda a los sanitarios especializados que suelen acompañar a grandes naves coloniales rumbo a mundos exteriores lejanos. Es una labor humanitaria emprendida sabiendo que el viaje casi seguro será solo de ida.

<color=#93e2ed>Especial:</color> inyecta una mejora temporal de mecanitos que aumenta el movimiento y protege del fuego.
mochila de pulsos enviada del vacío

Rule.Original:
A utility pack belonging once to a now nearly forgotten nomad, loaded with the necessary equipment to survive in extreme environments. Tremendously increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.

A personal barrier system within the pack, similar to the atmospheric barriers on gravships, provides a level of protection against depressurization and environmental toxins. The shielding is physically weak as it closely forms to the body, but it does permit the use of ranged weaponry.

<color=#634cb9>...and so she vanished...</color>

<color=#634cb9>Special:</color> Generates a slow-charging shield bubble.
Rule.Raw:
A utility pack belonging once to a now nearly forgotten nomad, loaded with the necessary equipment to survive in extreme environments. Tremendously increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.

A personal barrier system within the pack, similar to the atmospheric barriers on gravships, provides a level of protection against depressurization and environmental toxins. The shielding is physically weak as it closely forms to the body, but it does permit the use of ranged weaponry.

<color=#634cb9>...and so she vanished...</color>

<color=#634cb9>Special:</color> Generates a slow-charging shield bubble.
Rule.Translated:
Una mochila de utilidad que perteneció a una nómada casi olvidada, equipada con lo necesario para sobrevivir en entornos extremos. Aumenta enormemente el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.

Su sistema de barrera personal, similar a las barreras atmosféricas de las astronaves gravitatorias, ofrece cierta protección contra la despresurización y las toxinas ambientales. El escudo es físicamente débil porque se ajusta mucho al cuerpo, pero permite utilizar armas a distancia.

<color=#634cb9>...y así desapareció ella...</color>

<color=#634cb9>Especial:</color> genera una burbuja de escudo de carga lenta.

Rule.Original: A puzzling backpack-analog of archotech design. A strange psychic intelligence resides within its skipgate core, guiding the user to stockpile items at an unknown, distant place. Extraordinarily increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\n<color=#ffff6f>Special:</color> Launch a psychic skip projectile that damages a small area.
Rule.Raw: A puzzling backpack-analog of archotech design. A strange psychic intelligence resides within its skipgate core, guiding the user to stockpile items at an unknown, distant place. Extraordinarily increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\n<color=#ffff6f>Special:</color> Launch a psychic skip projectile that damages a small area.
Rule.Translated: Un desconcertante equivalente arcotecnológico de una mochila. Una extraña inteligencia psíquica habita en el núcleo de su portal de salto y guía al usuario para acumular objetos en un lugar lejano y desconocido. Aumenta extraordinariamente el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.\n\n<color=#ffff6f>Especial:</color> lanza un proyectil de salto psíquico que daña una zona pequeña.

Rule.Original:
A twisted backpack bent to the image of a devourer. The undeniably concerning pseudoentity is held in a biological stasis by an embedded shard of dark archotechnology, maintaining a workable size and temperament.

Though underdeveloped, its musculature can compress a small store of bioferrite to ignition as a propellant for acidic jets.

<color=#b9be5d>Special:</color> Spew a biomortar glob that bathes a target area in acid.
Rule.Raw:
A twisted backpack bent to the image of a devourer. The undeniably concerning pseudoentity is held in a biological stasis by an embedded shard of dark archotechnology, maintaining a workable size and temperament.

Though underdeveloped, its musculature can compress a small store of bioferrite to ignition as a propellant for acidic jets.

<color=#b9be5d>Special:</color> Spew a biomortar glob that bathes a target area in acid.
Rule.Translated:
Una mochila retorcida con la forma de un devorador. Esta pseudoentidad indudablemente preocupante se mantiene en estasis biológica gracias a un fragmento incrustado de arcotecnología oscura que conserva un tamaño y temperamento manejables.

Aunque está poco desarrollada, su musculatura puede comprimir una pequeña reserva de bioferrita hasta encenderla y utilizarla como propulsor de chorros ácidos.

<color=#b9be5d>Especial:</color> escupe un glóbulo de biomortero que baña la zona objetivo en ácido.
Una mochila de masa de carne sin terminar.

Rule.Original: A spacious backpack with much of its functional volume occupied by a heavy temperature regulation unit and multiple booster components rigged to a modified jump pack. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\n<color=#fda689>Special:</color> Launch the user a substantial distance after a long delay.
Rule.Raw: A spacious backpack with much of its functional volume occupied by a heavy temperature regulation unit and multiple booster components rigged to a modified jump pack. Noticeably increases the wearer's maximum carry weight when forming a caravan.\n\n<color=#fda689>Special:</color> Launch the user a substantial distance after a long delay.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila espaciosa cuyo volumen útil está ocupado en gran parte por una pesada unidad de regulación térmica y varios propulsores conectados a una mochila de salto modificada. Aumenta de forma notable el peso máximo que puede llevar el usuario al formar una caravana.\n\n<color=#fda689>Especial:</color> impulsa al usuario a una distancia considerable tras una larga demora.

Rule.Original: Shows deterministic faction territory regions around settlements.
Rule.Raw: Shows deterministic faction territory regions around settlements.
Rule.Translated: Muestra las regiones territoriales de las facciones, calculadas de forma determinista alrededor de los asentamientos.
puesto de avanzada de un vasallo

Rule.Original: This mechanoid has been fitted with a Giddy-Up! module, and is rideable.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid has been fitted with a Giddy-Up! module, and is rideable.
Rule.Translated: Este mecanoide está equipado con un módulo Giddy-Up! y se puede montar.

Rule.Original: Allows the mechanoid to be mounted by your colonists.
Rule.Raw: Allows the mechanoid to be mounted by your colonists.
Rule.Translated: Permite que tus colonos monten el mecanoide.

Rule.Original: This module functions as both a saddle and an interface to the mechanoid on which it is installed, allowing colonists to ride it to battle, given that there isn't already a turret mounted to the mechanoid. Can only be installed on mechanoids allowed to be used as mount in the mod options of Giddy-up! Battle Mechs.
Rule.Raw: This module functions as both a saddle and an interface to the mechanoid on which it is installed, allowing colonists to ride it to battle, given that there isn't already a turret mounted to the mechanoid. Can only be installed on mechanoids allowed to be used as mount in the mod options of Giddy-up! Battle Mechs.
Rule.Translated: Este módulo funciona como montura e interfaz del mecanoide en el que se instala, y permite que los colonos lo monten en combate si no lleva ya una torreta. Solo puede instalarse en mecanoides autorizados como monturas en las opciones de Giddy-up! Battle Mechs.

Rule.Original: Can be installed on mechanoids so they can be mounted by colonists. Drills itself tight to mechanoid's outer shell, then allows direct control through neural interface linked to a controller pad, located on the left side of the techno-saddle. The seat is lined with devilstrand for more backside comfort.
Rule.Raw: Can be installed on mechanoids so they can be mounted by colonists. Drills itself tight to mechanoid's outer shell, then allows direct control through neural interface linked to a controller pad, located on the left side of the techno-saddle. The seat is lined with devilstrand for more backside comfort.
Rule.Translated: Se instala en mecanoides para que los colonos puedan montarlos. Se fija mediante perforación a su carcasa exterior y permite el control directo mediante una interfaz neural vinculada a un panel situado a la izquierda de la montura tecnológica. El asiento está forrado de hilodiablo para mayor comodidad.
Giddy-up!: Habilidad de manejo de animales

Rule.Original: The animal handling skill of a Pawn affects how effective it can use mounts. Per level that the skill is below the level needed to tame an animal, a penalty for movement (2%) and accuracy (0.5%) is applied for each level. If the skill level is above the needed level to tame the animal, an equal bonus is applied. The per-level bonuses/penalties can be configured in the mod settings.
Rule.Raw: The animal handling skill of a Pawn affects how effective it can use mounts. Per level that the skill is below the level needed to tame an animal, a penalty for movement (2%) and accuracy (0.5%) is applied for each level. If the skill level is above the needed level to tame the animal, an equal bonus is applied. The per-level bonuses/penalties can be configured in the mod settings.
Rule.Translated: La habilidad de manejo de animales de un colono afecta la efectividad de las monturas. Por nivel en que la habilidad está por debajo del nivel necesario para domar a un animal, se aplica una penalización por movimiento (2%) y precisión (0.5%) para cada nivel. Si el nivel de habilidad está por encima del nivel necesario para domar al animal, se aplica una bonificación equivalente. Las bonificaciones/penalizaciones por nivel se pueden configurar en la configuración de modificación.

Rule.Original: To mount an animal for battling, draft a pawn and right click an animal with obedience training and click 'mount'.
Rule.Raw: To mount an animal for battling, draft a pawn and right click an animal with obedience training and click 'mount'.
Rule.Translated: Para montar un animal en una batalla, recluta un colono y haz clic con el botón derecho en un animal con entrenamiento de obediencia y luego en "montar".

Rule.Original: Enemy pawns can also mount animals. The chance they use mounts, and where they get their mounts from (wild animals from your biome, wild animals from any biome, or non-wild animals) can be configured in the mod options. Enemy pawns with a high animal handling skill have a larger chance to use rare mounts
Rule.Raw: Enemy pawns can also mount animals. The chance they use mounts, and where they get their mounts from (wild animals from your biome, wild animals from any biome, or non-wild animals) can be configured in the mod options. Enemy pawns with a high animal handling skill have a larger chance to use rare mounts
Rule.Translated: Los peones enemigos también pueden montar animales. La posibilidad de que monten, y de dónde obtienen sus monturas (animales salvajes de tu bioma, animales salvajes de cualquier bioma o animales no salvajes) puede configurarse en las opciones de modificación. Los colonos enemigos con una alta habilidad de manejo de animales tienen una mayor posibilidad de montar animales raros.

Rule.Original: Can be automatically mounted by colonists.
Rule.Raw: Can be automatically mounted by colonists.
Rule.Translated: Los colonos pueden montar estos animales automáticamente.

Rule.Original: Can be automatically mounted by slaves.
Rule.Raw: Can be automatically mounted by slaves.
Rule.Translated: Los esclavos pueden montar estos animales automáticamente.
Reserva de torretas ametralladoras de WD
Punto de entrega de avanzadillas WD

Rule.Original: Designates where goods delivered from your World Domination outposts should land. Only one can exist per map. If none is placed, deliveries arrive at the map edge instead.
Rule.Raw: Designates where goods delivered from your World Domination outposts should land. Only one can exist per map. If none is placed, deliveries arrive at the map edge instead.
Rule.Translated: Marca dónde deben aterrizar los bienes entregados desde tus avanzadillas de World Domination. Solo puede haber uno por mapa. Si no hay ninguno, las entregas llegan al borde del mapa.

Rule.Original: World Domination: diplomacy matrix, outposts, world stats, action log.
Rule.Raw: World Domination: diplomacy matrix, outposts, world stats, action log.
Rule.Translated: World Domination: matriz diplomática, puestos, estadísticas del mundo y registro de acciones.

Rule.Original: questDescription->[faction_name] wants a road between your colony and [askerSettlement_label]. Connect the two towns by road. How the road gets built does not matter.\n\nYou have 30 days.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->[faction_name] wants a road between your colony and [askerSettlement_label]. Connect the two towns by road. How the road gets built does not matter.\n\nYou have 30 days.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->[faction_name] quiere un camino entre tu colonia y [askerSettlement_label]. Conecta ambas poblaciones por carretera. No importa cómo se construya el camino.\n\nDispones de 30 días.

Rule.Original: [faction_name] became hostile. The road-link request has failed.
Rule.Raw: [faction_name] became hostile. The road-link request has failed.
Rule.Translated: [faction_name] se ha vuelto hostil. La solicitud de conexión por carretera ha fracasado.

Rule.Original: Time ran out on the request from [faction_name] for a road to [askerSettlement_label].
Rule.Raw: Time ran out on the request from [faction_name] for a road to [askerSettlement_label].
Rule.Translated: Se ha agotado el plazo de la solicitud de [faction_name] para construir una carretera hasta [askerSettlement_label].

Rule.Original: questDescription->[faction_name] wants you to wipe out or conquer [enemySettlement_label], a shared enemy. Do it yourself: attack in person, or launch a raid from one of your World Domination outposts.\n\nAllied-settlement raid orders and unrelated faction attacks do not count. You have 8 days.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->[faction_name] wants you to wipe out or conquer [enemySettlement_label], a shared enemy. Do it yourself: attack in person, or launch a raid from one of your World Domination outposts.\n\nAllied-settlement raid orders and unrelated faction attacks do not count. You have 8 days.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->[faction_name] quiere que destruyas o conquistes [enemySettlement_label], un enemigo común. Hazlo por tu cuenta: ataca en persona o lanza una incursión desde uno de tus puestos avanzados de World Domination.\n\nNo cuentan las órdenes de incursión de asentamientos aliados ni los ataques de facciones ajenas. Dispones de 8 días.

Rule.Original: [faction_name] became hostile. The common-enemy request has failed.
Rule.Raw: [faction_name] became hostile. The common-enemy request has failed.
Rule.Translated: [faction_name] se ha vuelto hostil. La solicitud contra el enemigo común ha fracasado.

Rule.Original: Time ran out on the request from [faction_name] to take down [enemySettlement_label].
Rule.Raw: Time ran out on the request from [faction_name] to take down [enemySettlement_label].
Rule.Translated: Se ha agotado el plazo de la solicitud de [faction_name] para derrotar a [enemySettlement_label].

Rule.Original: questDescription->[faction_name] asks you to found your first World Domination outpost anywhere on the world map.\n\nThe request stays open until you found an outpost. It fails if they become hostile or are destroyed.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->[faction_name] asks you to found your first World Domination outpost anywhere on the world map.\n\nThe request stays open until you found an outpost. It fails if they become hostile or are destroyed.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->[faction_name] te pide que fundes tu primer puesto avanzado de World Domination en cualquier lugar del mapa mundial.\n\nLa petición seguirá abierta hasta que fundes un puesto avanzado. Fracasará si la facción se vuelve hostil o resulta destruida.

Rule.Original: [faction_name] became hostile. The first-outpost request has failed.
Rule.Raw: [faction_name] became hostile. The first-outpost request has failed.
Rule.Translated: [faction_name] se ha vuelto hostil. La solicitud del primer puesto avanzado ha fracasado.

Rule.Original: questDescription->Become the strongest World Domination faction and hold that lead for 15 continuous days.\n\nYour ranking uses WD outposts only. If you lose the lead, the streak resets. There is no time limit.
Rule.Raw: questDescription->Become the strongest World Domination faction and hold that lead for 15 continuous days.\n\nYour ranking uses WD outposts only. If you lose the lead, the streak resets. There is no time limit.
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Conviértete en la facción más fuerte de World Domination y conserva esa posición durante 15 días seguidos.\n\nLa clasificación solo tiene en cuenta los puestos avanzados de WD. Si pierdes el liderazgo, la racha se reinicia. No hay límite de tiempo.

Rule.Original: Abstract remote power supplied by World Domination power plant outposts.
Rule.Raw: Abstract remote power supplied by World Domination power plant outposts.
Rule.Translated: Energía remota abstracta suministrada por los puestos de centrales eléctricas de World Domination.

Rule.Original: A stationary wagon loaded with mined stone or ore.
Rule.Raw: A stationary wagon loaded with mined stone or ore.
Rule.Translated: Un vagón inmóvil cargado de piedra o mineral extraídos.

Rule.Translated: Un vagón inmóvil cargado de piedra o mineral extraídos.

Rule.Original: Drills deepchem on desert tiles. Requires Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded.
Rule.Raw: Drills deepchem on desert tiles. Requires Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded.
Rule.Translated: Extrae deepchem en desierto. Requiere Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded.
Puesto de conformado de recursos brutos

Rule.Original: Produces plasteel, synthread, or hyperweave on desert tiles.
Rule.Raw: Produces plasteel, synthread, or hyperweave on desert tiles.
