Mochila portabebés de tela para niños

Rule.Original: A smaller cloth sling sized for young children. Lets a child carry an infant close to the body. Restricts movement slightly but keeps the baby safe.
Rule.Raw: A smaller cloth sling sized for young children. Lets a child carry an infant close to the body. Restricts movement slightly but keeps the baby safe.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila de tela más pequeña, adaptada para niños. Permite a un niño cargar un bebé cerca del cuerpo. Limita ligeramente el movimiento, pero mantiene al bebé seguro.

Rule.Original: A smaller version of the traditional tribal baby sling, sized for young children. Lets a child carry an infant close to the body while moving around the colony.
Rule.Raw: A smaller version of the traditional tribal baby sling, sized for young children. Lets a child carry an infant close to the body while moving around the colony.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más pequeña de la mochila tribal tradicional, adaptada para niños. Permite a un niño cargar un bebé cerca del cuerpo mientras se mueve por la colonia.

Rule.Original: A high-tech spacer-grade infant carrier constructed from advanced composite materials. The padded harness distributes the load perfectly, so the wearer never tires of carrying. The sealed micro-environment shields the baby from vacuum exposure, toxic gas and other hazardous atmospheres, and its composite shell absorbs nearly all harm that reaches the wearer - only a catastrophic hit still gets through to the infant.
Rule.Raw: A high-tech spacer-grade infant carrier constructed from advanced composite materials. The padded harness distributes the load perfectly, so the wearer never tires of carrying. The sealed micro-environment shields the baby from vacuum exposure, toxic gas and other hazardous atmospheres, and its composite shell absorbs nearly all harm that reaches the wearer - only a catastrophic hit still gets through to the infant.
Rule.Translated: Un portabebés de alta tecnología fabricado con materiales compuestos avanzados. El arnés acolchado reparte la carga a la perfección, de modo que el portador nunca se cansa de llevarlo. El microambiente sellado protege al bebé del vacío espacial, del gas tóxico y de otras atmósferas peligrosas, y su carcasa compuesta absorbe casi todo el daño que alcanza al portador: solo un impacto catastrófico llega todavía al bebé.

Rule.Original: A spacer carrier resting on the ground with an infant sealed inside. The sealed micro-environment shields the baby from vacuum, hazardous atmospheres and temperature extremes. Select it to take the baby out, or have a colonist pick it back up.
Rule.Raw: A spacer carrier resting on the ground with an infant sealed inside. The sealed micro-environment shields the baby from vacuum, hazardous atmospheres and temperature extremes. Select it to take the baby out, or have a colonist pick it back up.
Rule.Translated: Un portabebés espacial apoyado en el suelo, con un bebé sellado en su interior. El microentorno cerrado lo protege del vacío, las atmósferas peligrosas y las temperaturas extremas. Selecciónalo para sacar al bebé o haz que un colono lo recoja de nuevo.

Rule.Original: A traditional sling used to carry infants close to the body. Restricts movement and handling slightly, but keeps the baby safe.
Rule.Raw: A traditional sling used to carry infants close to the body. Restricts movement and handling slightly, but keeps the baby safe.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila tradicional usada para llevar bebés cerca del cuerpo. Limita ligeramente el movimiento y la destreza, pero mantiene al bebé seguro.

Rule.Original: There's nothing quite like exploring the world together with my child. These moments matter.
Rule.Raw: There's nothing quite like exploring the world together with my child. These moments matter.
Rule.Translated: No hay nada mejor que explorar el mundo junto a mi hijo. Estos momentos importan.
Ayudando con el cuidado del bebé
Ayudando con el cuidado del bebé

Rule.Original: It feels good to help out with the little ones. Takes a village to raise a child.
Rule.Raw: It feels good to help out with the little ones. Takes a village to raise a child.
Rule.Translated: Se siente bien ayudar con los pequeños. Se necesita toda una aldea para criar a un niño.

Rule.Original: The baby fell asleep in my arms. So peaceful and trusting.
Rule.Raw: The baby fell asleep in my arms. So peaceful and trusting.
Rule.Translated: El bebé se ha dormido en mis brazos. Tan tranquilo y confiado.

Rule.Original: I need to keep this child safe. If anything happens to them...
Rule.Raw: I need to keep this child safe. If anything happens to them...
Rule.Translated: Tengo que mantener a este niño a salvo. Si les pasara algo...
El bebé durmió entre el caos

Rule.Original: How can they sleep through all this noise? Babies are incredible.
Rule.Raw: How can they sleep through all this noise? Babies are incredible.
Rule.Translated: ¿Cómo puede dormir con todo este ruido? Los bebés son increíbles.

Rule.Original: I'm badly hurt, but I have to keep carrying them. I can't let them down.
Rule.Raw: I'm badly hurt, but I have to keep carrying them. I can't let them down.
Rule.Translated: Estoy gravemente herido, pero tengo que seguir cargándolo. No puedo abandonarlo.

Rule.Original: I have to protect them! Nothing else matters right now!
Rule.Raw: I have to protect them! Nothing else matters right now!
Rule.Translated: ¡Tengo que protegerlo! ¡Nada más importa ahora mismo!

Rule.Original: The adrenaline is wearing off. I feel completely drained.
Rule.Raw: The adrenaline is wearing off. I feel completely drained.
Rule.Translated: La adrenalina está bajando. Me siento completamente destrozado.

Rule.Original: Mom/Dad is holding me, I feel so loved.
Rule.Raw: Mom/Dad is holding me, I feel so loved.
Rule.Translated: Mamá/papá me abraza, me siento tan querido.

Rule.Original: I'm being carried around, I feel warm and safe.
Rule.Raw: I'm being carried around, I feel warm and safe.
Rule.Translated: Me están cargando, me siento calentito y seguro.

Rule.Original: What was that loud sound?! It scared me!
Rule.Raw: What was that loud sound?! It scared me!
Rule.Translated: ¿Qué fue ese ruido tan fuerte?! ¡Me asustó!

Rule.Original: The rain is cold and I'm getting wet! I don't like this!
Rule.Raw: The rain is cold and I'm getting wet! I don't like this!
Rule.Translated: ¡La lluvia está fría y me está mojando! ¡No me gusta!

Rule.Original: The rain feels nice and cool! It's refreshing!
Rule.Raw: The rain feels nice and cool! It's refreshing!
Rule.Translated: ¡La lluvia se siente agradable y fresca! ¡Es refrescante!

Rule.Original: It's cold outside, but I'm all bundled up and warm. This is nice.
Rule.Raw: It's cold outside, but I'm all bundled up and warm. This is nice.
Rule.Translated: Fuera hace frío, pero estoy bien arropado y calentito. Qué agradable.

Rule.Original: I got hurt and I don't like it!
Rule.Raw: I got hurt and I don't like it!
Rule.Translated: ¡Me hice daño y no me gusta!

Rule.Original: I'm hurt badly and everything hurts so much!
Rule.Raw: I'm hurt badly and everything hurts so much!
Rule.Translated: ¡Estoy gravemente herido y todo duele tanto!

Rule.Original: My little sibling feels so tiny in my arms. I'll keep them safe, no matter what.
Rule.Raw: My little sibling feels so tiny in my arms. I'll keep them safe, no matter what.
Rule.Translated: Mi hermanito/hermanita es tan pequeño en mis brazos. Lo/la protegeré, pase lo que pase.

Rule.Original: My big sibling is holding me. I feel safe.
Rule.Raw: My big sibling is holding me. I feel safe.
Rule.Translated: Mi hermano/hermana mayor me está cargando. Me siento seguro.
llevar al bebé cargado a la cuna
llevar al bebé cargado a la cuna
llevar al bebé cargado a la cuna
jugar con el bebé en brazos
jugar con el bebé en brazos
jugando con el bebé en brazos
recoger al bebé de la cápsula espacial
recoger al bebé de la cápsula espacial
recogiendo al bebé de la cápsula espacial

Rule.Original: {0} has been crushed to death by a boulder.
Rule.Raw: {0} has been crushed to death by a boulder.
Rule.Translated: {0} ha muerto aplastado por una roca.

Rule.Original: It looks like they want to besiege the colony and pound you with siege engines from a distance. You can try to wait them out - or go get them.
Rule.Raw: It looks like they want to besiege the colony and pound you with siege engines from a distance. You can try to wait them out - or go get them.
Rule.Translated: Parece que quieren asediar la colonia y bombardearte desde lejos con máquinas de asedio. Puedes intentar esperar a que se marchen o salir a por ellos.

Rule.Original: It looks like they want to use siege tactics to help you.
Rule.Raw: It looks like they want to use siege tactics to help you.
Rule.Translated: Parece que quieren ayudarte con tácticas de asedio.

Rule.Original: A primitive siege weapon that launches chunks. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Raw: A primitive siege weapon that launches chunks. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de asedio primitiva que lanza fragmentos de roca. Es pesada, imprecisa y lenta de recargar.

Rule.Original: A primitive siege weapon that launches chunks. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Raw: A primitive siege weapon that launches chunks. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de asedio primitiva que lanza fragmentos de roca. Es pesada, imprecisa y lenta de recargar.

Rule.Original: A primitive siege weapon that launches two chunks at a time. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Raw: A primitive siege weapon that launches two chunks at a time. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de asedio primitiva que lanza dos fragmentos de roca a la vez. Es pesada, imprecisa y lenta de recargar.

Rule.Original: A primitive siege weapon that launches two chunks at a time. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Raw: A primitive siege weapon that launches two chunks at a time. Heavy, inacurrate, and slow to reload.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de asedio primitiva que lanza dos fragmentos de roca a la vez. Es pesada, imprecisa y lenta de recargar.

Rule.Original: This faction resides under your control.
Rule.Raw: This faction resides under your control.
Rule.Translated: Esta facción reside bajo tu control.

Rule.Original: Click here to construct a building
Rule.Raw: Click here to construct a building
Rule.Translated: Haz clic aquí para construir un edificio

Rule.Original: A building is being constructed here...
Rule.Raw: A building is being constructed here...
Rule.Translated: Aquí se está construyendo un edificio...

Rule.Original: Scientists spend their days researching here.
Rule.Raw: Scientists spend their days researching here.
Rule.Translated: Los científicos pasan los días investigando aquí.

Rule.Original: Food is produced indoors, protecting it from the harshness of the world.
Rule.Raw: Food is produced indoors, protecting it from the harshness of the world.
Rule.Translated: La comida se produce en interior, protegiéndola de las inclemencias del mundo.

Rule.Original: A factory that produces mass quantities of firearms.
Rule.Raw: A factory that produces mass quantities of firearms.
Rule.Translated: Una fábrica que produce armas de fuego en masa.

Rule.Original: A warehouse stocked full of goods marked to be shipped.
Rule.Raw: A warehouse stocked full of goods marked to be shipped.
Rule.Translated: Un almacén repleto de bienes marcados para su envío.

Rule.Original: Barracks for an in-house mercenary company. They will provide security for the settlement.
Rule.Raw: Barracks for an in-house mercenary company. They will provide security for the settlement.
Rule.Translated: Cuartel para una compañía mercenaria propia. Proporcionarán seguridad al asentamiento.

Rule.Original: A place for the local people to spend a dime and have a good time.
Rule.Raw: A place for the local people to spend a dime and have a good time.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para que la gente local gaste unas monedas y se divierta.

Rule.Original: Put those prisoners to work and increase your production!
Rule.Raw: Put those prisoners to work and increase your production!
Rule.Translated: ¡Pon a esos prisioneros a trabajar y aumenta tu producción!

Rule.Original: When this building is built, an artillery strike can be called for a cost in the military menu.
Rule.Raw: When this building is built, an artillery strike can be called for a cost in the military menu.
Rule.Translated: Cuando se construye este edificio, se puede solicitar un ataque de artillería por un coste en el menú militar.

Rule.Original: It's quick, cheap, and unhealthy. The locals will complain about the lack of quality, but they'll be too unhealthy to do anything about it.
Rule.Raw: It's quick, cheap, and unhealthy. The locals will complain about the lack of quality, but they'll be too unhealthy to do anything about it.
Rule.Translated: Es rápida, barata y poco saludable. Los lugareños se quejarán de la falta de calidad, pero estarán demasiado enfermos para hacer algo al respecto.

Rule.Original: Making clothes is so much easier when machines do most of the work!
Rule.Raw: Making clothes is so much easier when machines do most of the work!
Rule.Translated: ¡Hacer ropa es mucho más fácil cuando las máquinas hacen casi todo el trabajo!

Rule.Original: A place for people to ogle various different animals as they pass through the settlement for fun and profit!
Rule.Raw: A place for people to ogle various different animals as they pass through the settlement for fun and profit!
Rule.Translated: ¡Un lugar para que la gente contemple distintos animales mientras pasan por el asentamiento, por diversión y beneficio!

Rule.Original: Stop stripping forest of trees and just grow your own!
Rule.Raw: Stop stripping forest of trees and just grow your own!
Rule.Translated: ¡Deja de talar bosques y cultiva los tuyos propios!
Almacén de equipos de minería industrial

Rule.Original: Build a place to store and maintain big ugly machines that chew through rock like it's cardboard.
Rule.Raw: Build a place to store and maintain big ugly machines that chew through rock like it's cardboard.
Rule.Translated: Construye un lugar para almacenar y mantener máquinas grandes y feas que mastican la roca como si fuera cartón.

Rule.Original: Restores fertility to the damaged and depleted soil of Scarlands.
Rule.Raw: Restores fertility to the damaged and depleted soil of Scarlands.
Rule.Translated: Restaura la fertilidad del suelo dañado y agotado de las Tierras cicatrizadas.

Rule.Original: Harness the easily accessible geothermal energy of volcanically active areas for power generation.
Rule.Raw: Harness the easily accessible geothermal energy of volcanically active areas for power generation.
Rule.Translated: Aprovecha la energía geotérmica de fácil acceso de las zonas volcánicamente activas para generar energía.

Rule.Original: A research facility dedicated to studying volcanology and any potential practical applications.
Rule.Raw: A research facility dedicated to studying volcanology and any potential practical applications.
Rule.Translated: Una instalación de investigación dedicada a estudiar la vulcanología y sus posibles aplicaciones prácticas.

Rule.Original: A power station to store excess energy production.
Rule.Raw: A power station to store excess energy production.
Rule.Translated: Una estación eléctrica para almacenar el exceso de producción de energía.

Rule.Original: A solar powerplant to produce extra energy.
Rule.Raw: A solar powerplant to produce extra energy.
Rule.Translated: Una central solar para producir energía extra.

Rule.Original: A research lab dedicated to researching and producing more efficient clean forms of energy.
Rule.Raw: A research lab dedicated to researching and producing more efficient clean forms of energy.
Rule.Translated: Un laboratorio dedicado a investigar y producir formas de energía limpia más eficientes.

Rule.Original: A research lab dedicated to testing products on animals. Unethical, but useful.
Rule.Raw: A research lab dedicated to testing products on animals. Unethical, but useful.
Rule.Translated: Un laboratorio dedicado a probar productos en animales. Poco ético, pero útil.

Rule.Original: A large apartment block to house local workers.
Rule.Raw: A large apartment block to house local workers.
Rule.Translated: Un gran bloque de apartamentos para alojar a los trabajadores locales.
Aquí los esclavos trabajan los campos.

Rule.Original: A place for traveling adventurers to meet up and spend a night.
Rule.Raw: A place for traveling adventurers to meet up and spend a night.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para que los aventureros viajeros se reúnan y pasen la noche.

Rule.Original: A public market to exchange goods.
Rule.Raw: A public market to exchange goods.
Rule.Translated: Un mercado público para intercambiar bienes.

Rule.Original: A place to store criminal scum.
Rule.Raw: A place to store criminal scum.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para encerrar a la escoria criminal.

Rule.Original: A guild dedicated to taming the wilderness.
Rule.Raw: A guild dedicated to taming the wilderness.
Rule.Translated: Un gremio dedicado a domar la naturaleza salvaje.
Taller de ropa con explotación laboral

Rule.Original: A place to work slaves and colonists alike!
Rule.Raw: A place to work slaves and colonists alike!
Rule.Translated: ¡Un lugar para hacer trabajar a esclavos y colonos por igual!

Rule.Original: A camp dedicated to the logging industry. Includes a lumber mill and everything!
Rule.Raw: A camp dedicated to the logging industry. Includes a lumber mill and everything!
Rule.Translated: Un campamento dedicado a la industria maderera. ¡Incluye un aserradero y todo!

Rule.Original: A place for Merchant and common people to spend a night with questionable people.
Rule.Raw: A place for Merchant and common people to spend a night with questionable people.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para que comerciantes y gente común pasen la noche con personas de dudosa reputación.

Rule.Original: A sturdy forge and sturdier anvil. Perfect for shaping metal into weapons and tools alike.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy forge and sturdier anvil. Perfect for shaping metal into weapons and tools alike.
Rule.Translated: Una forja robusta y un yunque aún más robusto. Perfecto para dar forma al metal y convertirlo en armas y herramientas.

Rule.Original: Dig down into the planet's surface in search of those really valuable materials. Don't forget to build supports!
Rule.Raw: Dig down into the planet's surface in search of those really valuable materials. Don't forget to build supports!
Rule.Translated: Excava en la superficie del planeta en busca de esos materiales realmente valiosos. ¡No olvides construir soportes!

Rule.Original: Mills! Wind or water, these are useful for a number of things!
Rule.Raw: Mills! Wind or water, these are useful for a number of things!
Rule.Translated: ¡Molinos! De viento o de agua, son útiles para muchas cosas.

Rule.Original: Servants are a delight to have and more places to house them means you can hire more!
Rule.Raw: Servants are a delight to have and more places to house them means you can hire more!
Rule.Translated: Los sirvientes son un placer y más lugares para alojarlos significa que puedes contratar más.

Rule.Original: A containment camp to keep the sick and the dying.
Rule.Raw: A containment camp to keep the sick and the dying.
Rule.Translated: Un campamento de contención para los enfermos y los moribundos.

Rule.Original: Land for growing cereal crops to feed more than a single village.
Rule.Raw: Land for growing cereal crops to feed more than a single village.
Rule.Translated: Tierra para cultivar cereales que alimenten a más de una sola aldea.

Rule.Original: A mill to process cereal crops with big, grindy rocks.
Rule.Raw: A mill to process cereal crops with big, grindy rocks.
Rule.Translated: Un molino para procesar cereales con grandes piedras de moler.

Rule.Original: A safe place to store cereal crops from those pesky rats.
Rule.Raw: A safe place to store cereal crops from those pesky rats.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar seguro para almacenar cereales lejos de esas molestas ratas.

Rule.Original: A creator of arrows - the best ammunition in the neolithic!
Rule.Raw: A creator of arrows - the best ammunition in the neolithic!
Rule.Translated: Un fabricante de flechas: ¡la mejor munición del neolítico!

Rule.Original: An artisan of stone by day - rules the world by night.
Rule.Raw: An artisan of stone by day - rules the world by night.
Rule.Translated: Artesano de la piedra de día, gobernante del mundo de noche.

Rule.Original: Makes goods from furs and pelts. Ignore the funky smell.
Rule.Raw: Makes goods from furs and pelts. Ignore the funky smell.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica bienes a partir de pieles. Ignora el olor raro.

Rule.Original: Hunts the surrounding woods for food. Endangered species are delicious!
Rule.Raw: Hunts the surrounding woods for food. Endangered species are delicious!
Rule.Translated: Caza en los bosques cercanos en busca de comida. ¡Las especies en peligro están deliciosas!

Rule.Original: Brews the finest ethanols and ethanol byproducts. Please drink responsibly.
Rule.Raw: Brews the finest ethanols and ethanol byproducts. Please drink responsibly.
Rule.Translated: Destila los mejores etanoles y subproductos del etanol. Por favor, bebe con responsabilidad.

Rule.Original: Makes wonderful furniture to prevent the most heinous of war crimes.
Rule.Raw: Makes wonderful furniture to prevent the most heinous of war crimes.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica muebles maravillosos para evitar los más atroces crímenes de guerra.

Rule.Original: Makes elixirs to cure all ailments! (Results may vary.)
Rule.Raw: Makes elixirs to cure all ailments! (Results may vary.)
Rule.Translated: ¡Elabora elixires para curar todos los males! (Los resultados pueden variar.)

Rule.Original: Turn steel into gold? We'll find a way!
Rule.Raw: Turn steel into gold? We'll find a way!

Rule.Original: Unlocks secrets of the universe which may or may not be true but not both!
Rule.Raw: Unlocks secrets of the universe which may or may not be true but not both!
Rule.Translated: ¡Desvela secretos del universo que pueden o no ser ciertos, pero no ambas cosas!

Rule.Original: Does not accept excuses for late rent payments.
Rule.Raw: Does not accept excuses for late rent payments.
Rule.Translated: No acepta excusas por los pagos atrasados del alquiler.

Rule.Original: Ready to fight for their families, though not very effectively.
Rule.Raw: Ready to fight for their families, though not very effectively.
Rule.Translated: Listos para luchar por sus familias, aunque no muy eficazmente.

Rule.Original: A guild of trained salvage crews that searches the ruins of destroyed and abandoned settlements, recovering weapons and apparel while also potentially recovering research notes.
Rule.Raw: A guild of trained salvage crews that searches the ruins of destroyed and abandoned settlements, recovering weapons and apparel while also potentially recovering research notes.
Rule.Translated: Un gremio de cuadrillas de chatarreros entrenadas que registra las ruinas de asentamientos destruidos y abandonados, recuperando armas y ropa, y potencialmente también notas de investigación.

Rule.Original: Farmlands adapted to the local ecosystem by growing fungi for food and medicine.
Rule.Raw: Farmlands adapted to the local ecosystem by growing fungi for food and medicine.
Rule.Translated: Tierras de cultivo adaptadas al ecosistema local cultivando hongos para comida y medicina.

Rule.Original: A gatherer and forager specialising in gathering loose wood in the form of fallen branches and driftwood.
Rule.Raw: A gatherer and forager specialising in gathering loose wood in the form of fallen branches and driftwood.
Rule.Translated: Un recolector especializado en recoger madera suelta en forma de ramas caídas y madera flotante.

Rule.Original: A local woodcutter making use of stone tools to fell trees and process lumber.
Rule.Raw: A local woodcutter making use of stone tools to fell trees and process lumber.
Rule.Translated: Un leñador local que usa herramientas de piedra para talar árboles y procesar madera.

Rule.Original: Stores and processes fuel for spacecraft. Essential for maintaining orbital operations and supporting space travel.
Rule.Raw: Stores and processes fuel for spacecraft. Essential for maintaining orbital operations and supporting space travel.
Rule.Translated: Almacena y procesa combustible para naves espaciales. Esencial para mantener las operaciones orbitales y apoyar los viajes espaciales.

Rule.Original: Automated mining drones harvest resources from nearby asteroids and space debris. Much more efficient than planetary mining.
Rule.Raw: Automated mining drones harvest resources from nearby asteroids and space debris. Much more efficient than planetary mining.
Rule.Translated: Drones mineros automatizados extraen recursos de asteroides cercanos y restos espaciales. Mucho más eficiente que la minería planetaria.

Rule.Original: Massive solar panel arrays with no atmospheric interference collect energy directly from the star. Powers the station and provides surplus energy.
Rule.Raw: Massive solar panel arrays with no atmospheric interference collect energy directly from the star. Powers the station and provides surplus energy.
Rule.Translated: Enormes conjuntos de paneles solares sin interferencia atmosférica recogen energía directamente de la estrella. Alimenta la estación y proporciona energía excedente.

Rule.Original: Soilless grow chambers producing food in artificial light. Essential for station self-sufficiency.
Rule.Raw: Soilless grow chambers producing food in artificial light. Essential for station self-sufficiency.
Rule.Translated: Cámaras de cultivo sin suelo que producen comida con luz artificial. Esencial para la autosuficiencia de la estación.

Rule.Original: Pressurized arboretums growing fast-cycle timber in enriched CO2 atmospheres.
Rule.Raw: Pressurized arboretums growing fast-cycle timber in enriched CO2 atmospheres.
Rule.Translated: Arboretos presurizados que cultivan madera de ciclo rápido en atmósferas enriquecidas con CO2.

Rule.Original: Zero-G manufacturing bays that produce weapons and apparel with minimal waste.
Rule.Raw: Zero-G manufacturing bays that produce weapons and apparel with minimal waste.
Rule.Translated: Bahías de fabricación en gravedad cero que producen armas y ropa con un desperdicio mínimo.

Rule.Original: Microgravity labs enable experiments impossible planetside, advancing medicine and research.
Rule.Raw: Microgravity labs enable experiments impossible planetside, advancing medicine and research.
Rule.Translated: Los laboratorios en microgravedad permiten experimentos imposibles en superficie, avanzando la medicina y la investigación.

Rule.Original: Functional dormitories with viewports to the stars. Houses additional station workers.
Rule.Raw: Functional dormitories with viewports to the stars. Houses additional station workers.
Rule.Translated: Dormitorios funcionales con ventanales a las estrellas. Aloja a trabajadores adicionales de la estación.

Rule.Original: Centrifugal gravity rings housing workers in comfortable simulated-gravity conditions.
Rule.Raw: Centrifugal gravity rings housing workers in comfortable simulated-gravity conditions.
Rule.Translated: Anillos de gravedad centrífuga que alojan a los trabajadores en cómodas condiciones de gravedad simulada.

Rule.Original: Heavy weapons platform providing overwhelming defensive firepower against orbital threats.
Rule.Raw: Heavy weapons platform providing overwhelming defensive firepower against orbital threats.
Rule.Translated: Plataforma de armas pesadas que proporciona una potencia de fuego defensiva abrumadora contra las amenazas orbitales.

Rule.Original: Close-range interceptor turrets protecting the station from incoming projectiles and boarding parties.
Rule.Raw: Close-range interceptor turrets protecting the station from incoming projectiles and boarding parties.
Rule.Translated: Torretas interceptoras de corto alcance que protegen la estación de proyectiles entrantes y grupos de abordaje.

Rule.Original: Long-range comms relay improving diplomatic coordination and suppressing dissent through propaganda.
Rule.Raw: Long-range comms relay improving diplomatic coordination and suppressing dissent through propaganda.
Rule.Translated: Repetidor de comunicaciones de largo alcance que mejora la coordinación diplomática y suprime la disidencia mediante propaganda.

Rule.Original: Premium quarters with artificial gravity beds and fine amenities imported from glitterworlds.
Rule.Raw: Premium quarters with artificial gravity beds and fine amenities imported from glitterworlds.
Rule.Translated: Aposentos de primera con camas de gravedad artificial y finas comodidades importadas de mundos relucientes.

Rule.Original: A commercial nexus coordinating interstellar trade routes and maximizing profit margins.
Rule.Raw: A commercial nexus coordinating interstellar trade routes and maximizing profit margins.
Rule.Translated: Un nexo comercial que coordina rutas comerciales interestelares y maximiza los márgenes de beneficio.

Rule.Original: Micro-gravity fermentation produces unique chemfuel compounds and exotic trade goods.
Rule.Raw: Micro-gravity fermentation produces unique chemfuel compounds and exotic trade goods.
Rule.Translated: La fermentación en microgravedad produce compuestos únicos de biocombustible y bienes comerciales exóticos.

Rule.Original: Full-scale drydock for constructing and repairing spacecraft. Accelerates all station construction.
Rule.Raw: Full-scale drydock for constructing and repairing spacecraft. Accelerates all station construction.
Rule.Translated: Dique seco a gran escala para construir y reparar naves espaciales. Acelera toda la construcción de la estación.
Operaciones de superficie desde la órbita

Rule.Original: Coordinates surface resource extraction from orbit — managing livestock herds and mining operations remotely.
Rule.Raw: Coordinates surface resource extraction from orbit — managing livestock herds and mining operations remotely.
Rule.Translated: Coordina la extracción de recursos en superficie desde la órbita, gestionando manadas de ganado y operaciones mineras de forma remota.

Rule.Original: A premier research institution pushing the boundaries of science in microgravity.
Rule.Raw: A premier research institution pushing the boundaries of science in microgravity.
Rule.Translated: Una institución de investigación de primer nivel que amplía las fronteras de la ciencia en microgravedad.

Rule.Original: Trains elite officers for fleet command. Significantly improves military readiness and reduces deployment cooldowns.
Rule.Raw: Trains elite officers for fleet command. Significantly improves military readiness and reduces deployment cooldowns.
Rule.Translated: Entrena a oficiales de élite para el mando de flotas. Mejora significativamente la preparación militar y reduce las reutilizaciones de despliegue.

Rule.Original: A small scale airport, this building provides the infrastructure to rapidly send goods around the planet. This building allows you to send three shuttles every tax cycle.
Rule.Raw: A small scale airport, this building provides the infrastructure to rapidly send goods around the planet. This building allows you to send three shuttles every tax cycle.
Rule.Translated: Un aeropuerto a pequeña escala, este edificio proporciona la infraestructura para enviar bienes rápidamente por todo el planeta. Este edificio te permite enviar tres lanzaderas cada ciclo de impuestos.

Rule.Original: From here, ships fly in and deposit their goods and replace their cargo before returning home.
Rule.Raw: From here, ships fly in and deposit their goods and replace their cargo before returning home.
Rule.Translated: Desde aquí, las naves vuelan y depositan sus bienes y reponen su carga antes de regresar a casa.

Rule.Original: From this building, researchers equipped with the highest-grade tools search for the answers of the universe.
Rule.Raw: From this building, researchers equipped with the highest-grade tools search for the answers of the universe.
Rule.Translated: Desde este edificio, investigadores equipados con las herramientas de más alta gama buscan las respuestas del universo.

Rule.Original: Androids roam the streets, keeping the colonists safe from external and internal harm.
Rule.Raw: Androids roam the streets, keeping the colonists safe from external and internal harm.
Rule.Translated: Androides patrullan las calles, manteniendo a los colonos a salvo de daños externos e internos.

Rule.Original: Nobody likes nutrient paste, but with a little flavoring and cosmetic tweaks, it can look and taste like whatever you want it to!
Rule.Raw: Nobody likes nutrient paste, but with a little flavoring and cosmetic tweaks, it can look and taste like whatever you want it to!
Rule.Translated: A nadie le gusta la pasta de nutrientes, pero con un poco de saborizante y retoques cosméticos, ¡puede parecer y saber a lo que tú quieras!

Rule.Original: With the right tools, you can do more than shred dead mechanoids, you can salvage their tech to use against them.
Rule.Raw: With the right tools, you can do more than shred dead mechanoids, you can salvage their tech to use against them.
Rule.Translated: Con las herramientas adecuadas, puedes hacer más que despedazar mecanoides muertos: puedes recuperar su tecnología para usarla contra ellos.

Rule.Original: Remove the human element altogether! Dump raw materials in and watch as each article of clothing is printed as a single, seamless piece!
Rule.Raw: Remove the human element altogether! Dump raw materials in and watch as each article of clothing is printed as a single, seamless piece!
Rule.Translated: ¡Elimina por completo el elemento humano! ¡Echa materias primas y observa cómo cada prenda se imprime como una sola pieza sin costuras!

Rule.Original: It's new! It's space-age! It's just as good as the real thing and it's definitely not vinyl, we swear!
Rule.Raw: It's new! It's space-age! It's just as good as the real thing and it's definitely not vinyl, we swear!
Rule.Translated: ¡Es nueva! ¡Es de la era espacial! Es tan buena como la de verdad y desde luego no es vinilo, lo juramos.

Rule.Original: People may not like it, but it's hard to deny the amount of resources gathered when you just pull the metals you want out of the sky.
Rule.Raw: People may not like it, but it's hard to deny the amount of resources gathered when you just pull the metals you want out of the sky.
Rule.Translated: A la gente puede no gustarle, pero es difícil negar la cantidad de recursos que se reúnen cuando simplemente sacas del cielo los metales que quieres.

Rule.Original: Put robots to work doing the more mundane tasks around the settlement so the people can be put to work elsewhere.
Rule.Raw: Put robots to work doing the more mundane tasks around the settlement so the people can be put to work elsewhere.
Rule.Translated: Pon robots a hacer las tareas más mundanas del asentamiento para que la gente pueda trabajar en otra parte.

Rule.Original: Weave subliminal messaging into the settlement's local broadcasts.
Rule.Raw: Weave subliminal messaging into the settlement's local broadcasts.
Rule.Translated: Entreteje mensajes subliminales en las emisiones locales del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Why breed or capture animals when you can just grow them in vats?
Rule.Raw: Why breed or capture animals when you can just grow them in vats?
Rule.Translated: ¿Por qué criar o capturar animales cuando puedes cultivarlos en cubas?

Rule.Original: An impossibility against the laws of physics, a generator that produces extra energy using the concept of perpetual motion.
Rule.Raw: An impossibility against the laws of physics, a generator that produces extra energy using the concept of perpetual motion.
Rule.Translated: Una imposibilidad contra las leyes de la física: un generador que produce energía extra usando el concepto del movimiento perpetuo.
Planta de fabricación de prótesis biónicas

Rule.Original: A factory dedicated to the development of new bionics.
Rule.Raw: A factory dedicated to the development of new bionics.
Rule.Translated: Una fábrica dedicada al desarrollo de nuevos biónicos.

Rule.Original: A large, vanometrically powered, archotech machine that can turn light into just about anything that isn't alive. Needs a constant military presence to ward off raiders.
Rule.Raw: A large, vanometrically powered, archotech machine that can turn light into just about anything that isn't alive. Needs a constant military presence to ward off raiders.
Rule.Translated: Una gran máquina arcotecnológica de propulsión vanométrica que puede convertir la luz en casi cualquier cosa que no esté viva. Necesita una presencia militar constante para ahuyentar a los saqueadores.

Rule.Original: An archotech tower that emits a signal which lures distant animals and calms nearby ones.
Rule.Raw: An archotech tower that emits a signal which lures distant animals and calms nearby ones.
Rule.Translated: Una torre arcotecnológica que emite una señal que atrae a los animales lejanos y calma a los cercanos.

Rule.Original: An archotech level AI trapped in a closed network. It's perfectly safe unless someone lets it out.
Rule.Raw: An archotech level AI trapped in a closed network. It's perfectly safe unless someone lets it out.
Rule.Translated: Una IA de nivel arcotecnológico atrapada en una red cerrada. Es perfectamente segura a menos que alguien la deje salir.

Rule.Original: A central building for local unions to operate out of. It's amazing how much happier and willing to work people are when you treat them well.
Rule.Raw: A central building for local unions to operate out of. It's amazing how much happier and willing to work people are when you treat them well.
Rule.Translated: Un edificio central desde el que operan los sindicatos locales. Es asombroso lo mucho más feliz y dispuesta a trabajar que está la gente cuando la tratas bien.

Rule.Original: It's kind of like a nuclear bomb, but reusable and solar powered.
Rule.Raw: It's kind of like a nuclear bomb, but reusable and solar powered.
Rule.Translated: Es algo así como una bomba nuclear, pero reutilizable y de energía solar.

Rule.Original: It's one thing to trade across the galaxy. It's another to build a flaming obsidian monolith to trade with the residents of a hell-dimension.
Rule.Raw: It's one thing to trade across the galaxy. It's another to build a flaming obsidian monolith to trade with the residents of a hell-dimension.
Rule.Translated: Una cosa es comerciar por toda la galaxia. Otra es construir un monolito de obsidiana en llamas para comerciar con los residentes de una dimensión infernal.

Rule.Original: An arcane generator that even the maintainers can't hope to understand, but have acquired.
Rule.Raw: An arcane generator that even the maintainers can't hope to understand, but have acquired.
Rule.Translated: Un generador arcano que ni siquiera los encargados de su mantenimiento pueden aspirar a comprender, pero que han adquirido.

Rule.Original: A building to house the local troops, letting the settlement muster one additional squad.
Rule.Raw: A building to house the local troops, letting the settlement muster one additional squad.
Rule.Translated: Un edificio para alojar a las tropas locales.

Rule.Original: A small outpost that roving traders frequent.
Rule.Raw: A small outpost that roving traders frequent.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño puesto que los comerciantes errantes frecuentan.

Rule.Original: Local housing for traveling migrants to stay in.
Rule.Raw: Local housing for traveling migrants to stay in.
Rule.Translated: Alojamiento local para que los migrantes de paso se queden.

Rule.Original: Torn up land being used to mine for valuable ore.
Rule.Raw: Torn up land being used to mine for valuable ore.
Rule.Translated: Tierra removida que se usa para extraer mineral valioso.

Rule.Original: A place for your soldiers to train.
Rule.Raw: A place for your soldiers to train.
Rule.Translated: Un lugar para que tus soldados entrenen.
Campamento de caza de animales de piel

Rule.Original: A camp for your Fur Hunter.
Rule.Raw: A camp for your Fur Hunter.
Rule.Translated: Un campamento para tu cazador de pieles.

Rule.Original: A pit where Slaves go to sleep.
Rule.Raw: A pit where Slaves go to sleep.
Rule.Translated: Un foso donde los esclavos duermen.

Rule.Original: A section of land dedicated to growing edible plants.
Rule.Raw: A section of land dedicated to growing edible plants.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de tierra dedicada a cultivar plantas comestibles.

Rule.Original: From flint for arrows to the materials for bullets and gunpowder, these mines take up space that could be used for other resource mining.
Rule.Raw: From flint for arrows to the materials for bullets and gunpowder, these mines take up space that could be used for other resource mining.
Rule.Translated: Desde pedernal para flechas hasta los materiales para balas y pólvora, estas minas ocupan espacio que podría usarse para extraer otros recursos.

Rule.Original: A workshop designed to turn animal hides into leather.
Rule.Raw: A workshop designed to turn animal hides into leather.
Rule.Translated: Un taller diseñado para convertir las pieles de animales en cuero.

Rule.Original: It's amazing the discoveries people make while absurdly high. Sometimes those discoveries are even useful!
Rule.Raw: It's amazing the discoveries people make while absurdly high. Sometimes those discoveries are even useful!
Rule.Translated: Es asombroso los descubrimientos que hace la gente cuando está absurdamente colocada. ¡A veces esos descubrimientos hasta son útiles!

Rule.Original: It's not much, but it's better than nothing!
Rule.Raw: It's not much, but it's better than nothing!
Rule.Translated: No es mucho, ¡pero es mejor que nada!

Rule.Original: A camp that the local forests are stripped of all their resources and the life within.
Rule.Raw: A camp that the local forests are stripped of all their resources and the life within.
Rule.Translated: Un campamento desde el que se despoja a los bosques locales de todos sus recursos y de la vida que albergan.

Rule.Original: A small farm to grow herbal medicine.
Rule.Raw: A small farm to grow herbal medicine.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña granja para cultivar medicina herbal.

Rule.Original: Onboarding topics: founding your faction, your first settlement, and the basics of running an empire.
Rule.Raw: Onboarding topics: founding your faction, your first settlement, and the basics of running an empire.
Rule.Translated: Temas de iniciación: fundar tu facción, tu primer asentamiento y los fundamentos de dirigir un imperio.

Rule.Original: Economic mechanics: resource production, taxes, workers, prosperity, and difficulty settings.
Rule.Raw: Economic mechanics: resource production, taxes, workers, prosperity, and difficulty settings.
Rule.Translated: Mecánicas económicas: producción de recursos, impuestos, trabajadores, prosperidad y ajustes de dificultad.

Rule.Original: Military mechanics: threat level, battle simulation, cooldowns, targeting, and attack frequency.
Rule.Raw: Military mechanics: threat level, battle simulation, cooldowns, targeting, and attack frequency.
Rule.Translated: Mecánicas militares: nivel de amenaza, simulación de batalla, reutilizaciones, selección de objetivos y frecuencia de ataque.

Rule.Original: Settlement mechanics: social stats, upgrade costs, building slots, and settlement types.
Rule.Raw: Settlement mechanics: social stats, upgrade costs, building slots, and settlement types.
Rule.Translated: Mecánicas de asentamiento: estadísticas sociales, costes de mejora, ranuras de edificio y tipos de asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
Prosperity is a 0–100 stat on each settlement that directly multiplies all resource production.
At 50 prosperity, your settlement produces half as much as at 100. At 1, production is nearly zero.
Prosperity drifts daily toward a target calculated from your other social stats: Target = (Happiness + Loyalty + (100 − Unrest)) / 3
The drift rate is equal to the distance from the current target, divided by 5 (plus any stat modifiers from policies, buildings, or events). If your happiness and loyalty are high and unrest is low, prosperity will climb. If social stats deteriorate, prosperity follows.
Losing a defensive battle costs prosperity immediately (20 by default), which can take many days to recover from.

At 50 prosperity, your settlement produces half as much as at 100. At 1, production is nearly zero.
Prosperity drifts daily toward a target calculated from your other social stats: Target = (Happiness + Loyalty + (100 − Unrest)) / 3
The drift rate is equal to the distance from the current target, divided by 5 (plus any stat modifiers from policies, buildings, or events). If your happiness and loyalty are high and unrest is low, prosperity will climb. If social stats deteriorate, prosperity follows.

Rule.Translated:
La prosperidad es una estadística de 0 a 100 en cada asentamiento que multiplica directamente toda la producción de recursos.

Con 50 de prosperidad, tu asentamiento produce la mitad que con 100. Con 1, la producción es casi nula.

La prosperidad deriva a diario hacia un objetivo calculado a partir de tus otras estadísticas sociales:
 Objetivo = (Felicidad + Lealtad + (100 − Descontento)) / 3

La tasa de deriva es igual a la distancia respecto al objetivo actual, dividida entre 5 (más cualquier modificador de estadística de políticas, edificios o eventos). Si tu felicidad y lealtad son altas y el descontento es bajo, la prosperidad subirá. Si las estadísticas sociales se deterioran, la prosperidad las sigue.

Perder una batalla defensiva cuesta prosperidad de inmediato (20 por defecto), de lo que puede costar muchos días recuperarse.

Rule.Original:
Every settlement turns assigned workers into resources through a three-stage cascade. Knowing where each stage's bonuses come from is the difference between a settlement that barely breaks even and one that funds the rest of your empire.
[b]Stage 1: Base.[/b] Each resource starts with a per-settlement base value driven mostly by the biome and adjusted by tile mutators or landmarks. Buildings, policies, and events can add flat amounts here through additive resource-production stats.
[b]Stage 2: Multiplier.[/b] Buildings, policies, governors, events, and faction-wide stat modifiers stack into a single multiplier on the base.
[b]Stage 3: Workers and prosperity.[/b] The base × multiplier is then scaled linearly by assigned workers, and finally multiplied by prosperity / 100. A settlement at 50 prosperity produces half of what its workers and buildings would otherwise yield, no matter how good the rest of the chain looks.
At tax time, the produced resources are converted to silver at the configured silver-per-resource ratio.

Rule.Translated:
Cada asentamiento convierte a los trabajadores asignados en recursos mediante una cascada de tres fases. Saber de dónde provienen las bonificaciones de cada fase es la diferencia entre un asentamiento que apenas cubre gastos y otro que financia el resto de tu imperio.

[b]Fase 1: Base.[/b] Cada recurso parte de un valor base por asentamiento determinado en su mayor parte por el bioma y ajustado por mutadores de casilla o hitos. Los edificios, las políticas y los eventos pueden añadir cantidades fijas aquí mediante estadísticas aditivas de producción de recursos.

[b]Fase 2: Multiplicador.[/b] Los edificios, las políticas, los gobernadores, los eventos y los modificadores de estadística de toda la facción se acumulan en un único multiplicador sobre la base.

[b]Fase 3: Trabajadores y prosperidad.[/b] La base × multiplicador se escala luego linealmente según los trabajadores asignados y, por último, se multiplica por prosperidad / 100. Un asentamiento con 50 de prosperidad produce la mitad de lo que rendirían sus trabajadores y edificios, por muy bien que se vea el resto de la cadena.

A la hora de los impuestos, los recursos producidos se convierten en plata según la proporción de plata por recurso configurada.

Rule.Original:
The basics of resource production are outlined in the Resource Production entry, and explain how the raw income value for each resource is calculated. However, at tax time, you may receive a different value from what the raw income, or even the gross income claims. This is due to [b]Production Snapshotting.[/b]
Each day, a snapshot is taken of each settlement's production allocations. At tax time, you actually receive the average of these daily snapshots over the tax period.
This means that anything that changes a resource's production – events, changed worker assignments, new buildings, etc. – will change the actual value that you receive at tax time.
You can see the running average by mousing over a resource's raw income value in the settlement window.

The basics of resource production are outlined in the Resource Production entry, and explain how the raw income value for each resource is calculated. However, at tax time, you may receive a different value from what the raw income, or even the gross income claims. This is due to [b]Production Snapshotting.[/b]
Each day, a snapshot is taken of each settlement's production allocations. At tax time, you actually receive the average of these daily snapshots over the tax period.
This means that anything that changes a resource's production – events, changed worker assignments, new buildings, etc. – will change the actual value that you receive at tax time.
You can see the running average by mousing over a resource's raw income value in the settlement window.
Rule.Translated:
Los fundamentos de la producción de recursos se explican en la entrada Producción de recursos, y describen cómo se calcula el valor de ingreso bruto de cada recurso. Sin embargo, a la hora de los impuestos, puedes recibir un valor distinto del que indica el ingreso bruto, o incluso el ingreso total. Esto se debe al [b]registro de producción.[/b]
 
Cada día se toma un registro de las asignaciones de producción de cada asentamiento. A la hora de los impuestos, recibes en realidad la media de esos registros diarios a lo largo del periodo de impuestos.
 
Esto significa que cualquier cosa que cambie la producción de un recurso —eventos, cambios en la asignación de trabajadores, nuevos edificios, etc.— cambiará el valor real que recibes a la hora de los impuestos.
 
Puedes ver la media acumulada pasando el cursor sobre el valor de ingreso bruto de un recurso en la ventana del asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
By default, resource production is turned into silver, which is then shipped to you. But there is another way to direct a resource's production: through [b]tithes.[/b]
Tithes allow you to divert resource production towards producing actual goods. The resource's gross income is reduced, and in exchange, you can choose a list of items for the settlement to send you at tax time.
The list of available items will depend on your tech level and unlocked research. For items that support it, you can choose the "stuff" that they're made out of, or their quality – with a respective increase on the item's price.
You can also choose to enable Random Tithes. If enabled, you will be sent a random assortment of items, selected from the random tithes list and with a total value equal to or less than your allowed Random Tithe Budget. If the budget isn't high enough to support any single item, then it rolls over to the next tax period.

You can also choose to enable Random Tithes. If enabled, you will be sent a random assortment of items, selected from the random tithes list and with a total value equal to or less than your allowed Random Tithe Budget. If the budget isn't high enough to support any single item, then it rolls over to the next tax period.
Rule.Translated:
Por defecto, la producción de recursos se convierte en plata, que luego se te envía. Pero hay otra forma de dirigir la producción de un recurso: mediante [b]diezmos.[/b]
 
Los diezmos te permiten desviar la producción de recursos hacia la fabricación de bienes reales. El ingreso bruto del recurso se reduce y, a cambio, puedes elegir una lista de objetos para que el asentamiento te los envíe a la hora de los impuestos.
 
La lista de objetos disponibles dependerá de tu nivel tecnológico y de la investigación desbloqueada. Para los objetos que lo admiten, puedes elegir el material del que están hechos o su calidad, con el respectivo aumento del precio del objeto.
 
También puedes activar los Diezmos aleatorios. Si los activas, se te enviará un surtido aleatorio de objetos, seleccionados de la lista de diezmos aleatorios y con un valor total igual o inferior a tu Presupuesto de diezmo aleatorio permitido. Si el presupuesto no es suficiente para ningún objeto, se traslada al siguiente periodo de impuestos.

Rule.Original:
Most resources are converted to silver (or tithed goods) when taxes are collected. A few are different: [b]Non-Income[/b] resources never become silver. Instead, each settlement's production is added to a dedicated, faction-wide pool that you spend in other ways.
Because they don't earn silver, they also can't be tithed. In the settlement window, they're grouped under the "Non-Income Resources" header, set apart from your silver-earning resources.
There are two of them: [b]Research[/b] and [b]Power[/b].
[b]Research.[/b] Each tax cycle, research production is banked into a research-point pool that carries over indefinitely. Those points are spent on whichever research project you currently have selected, advancing it a little each day. You can also spend the pool on demand from the main overview's "Activate Research" option. Any points left over when a project finishes roll forward to the next one, and if you have no active project they simply keep accumulating. Your storyteller's research-speed difficulty affects how far each point goes.
[b]Power.[/b] Unlocked by Electricity. Unlike Research, the power pool resets every tax cycle – it represents a steady supply of electricity. To actually use it, build a [b]faction power generator[/b] in your colony and wire it into your power grid. Its "Set Power Output" command marks it as the active output, and it then feeds your colony the wattage your settlements are generating.
The live values in the sidebar show your current research pool and power output.

Rule.Translated:
La mayoría de los recursos se convierten en plata (o bienes de diezmo) cuando se cobran los impuestos. Unos pocos son distintos: los recursos [b]sin ingresos[/b] nunca se convierten en plata. En su lugar, la producción de cada asentamiento se añade a una reserva dedicada, de toda la facción, que gastas de otras formas.
 
Como no generan plata, tampoco pueden diezmarse. En la ventana del asentamiento se agrupan bajo el encabezado "Recursos sin ingresos", separados de tus recursos que generan plata.

Hay dos: [b]Investigación[/b] y [b]Energía[/b].

[b]Investigación.[/b] Cada ciclo de impuestos, la producción de investigación se deposita en una reserva de puntos de investigación que se acumula indefinidamente. Esos puntos se gastan en el proyecto de investigación que tengas seleccionado, avanzándolo un poco cada día. También puedes gastar la reserva a demanda desde la opción "Activar investigación" del resumen principal. Los puntos sobrantes al terminar un proyecto pasan al siguiente y, si no tienes ningún proyecto activo, simplemente se siguen acumulando. La dificultad de velocidad de investigación de tu narrador afecta a cuánto rinde cada punto.

[b]Energía.[/b] Se desbloquea con Electricidad. A diferencia de la Investigación, la reserva de energía se reinicia cada ciclo de impuestos: representa un suministro constante de electricidad. Para usarla de verdad, construye un [b]generador de energía de la facción[/b] en tu colonia y conéctalo a tu red eléctrica. Su comando "Fijar salida de energía" lo marca como la salida activa, y entonces alimenta a tu colonia con el vatiaje que generan tus asentamientos.

Los valores en directo de la barra lateral muestran tu reserva de investigación y tu salida de energía actuales.

Rule.Original:
Each assigned worker costs a flat amount of silver per tax cycle (set by the Worker Cost difficulty parameter). Up to a settlement's Assigned Workers cap, workers cost their base rate. Past the cap, costs rise. Workers assigned past the cap are known as Overmax Workers.
The penalty compounds: the total cost of all workers is multiplied by 1 + (workers over cap) / 20. Five workers over the cap is a 25% surcharge on the whole settlement's worker bill; ten over is 50%; twenty over is 100%.
At default difficulty settings where workers cost 100 silver each, assigning 5 overmax workers will cause [b]all[/b] workers to cost 125 silver.
Rule.Raw:
Each assigned worker costs a flat amount of silver per tax cycle (set by the Worker Cost difficulty parameter). Up to a settlement's Assigned Workers cap, workers cost their base rate. Past the cap, costs rise. Workers assigned past the cap are known as Overmax Workers.
The penalty compounds: the total cost of all workers is multiplied by 1 + (workers over cap) / 20. Five workers over the cap is a 25% surcharge on the whole settlement's worker bill; ten over is 50%; twenty over is 100%.
At default difficulty settings where workers cost 100 silver each, assigning 5 overmax workers will cause [b]all[/b] workers to cost 125 silver.
Rule.Translated:
Cada trabajador asignado cuesta una cantidad fija de plata por ciclo de impuestos (establecida por el parámetro de dificultad Coste por trabajador). Hasta el límite de Trabajadores asignados de un asentamiento, los trabajadores cuestan su tarifa base. Por encima del límite, los costes suben. Los trabajadores asignados por encima del límite se conocen como Trabajadores extra.

La penalización es compuesta: el coste total de todos los trabajadores se multiplica por 1 + (trabajadores por encima del límite) / 20. Cinco trabajadores por encima del límite suponen un recargo del 25% sobre toda la factura de trabajadores del asentamiento; diez, un 50%; veinte, un 100%.
 
Con los ajustes de dificultad por defecto, donde cada trabajador cuesta 100 de plata, asignar 5 trabajadores extra hará que [b]todos[/b] los trabajadores cuesten 125 de plata.

Rule.Original:
The Empire difficulty preset is independent of Rimworld's storyteller difficulty. It controls four economic parameters that together set how forgiving the early game is and how lucrative a mature empire becomes.
[b]- Silver per Resource[/b]: the silver value of one unit of produced resource. [b]- Days between Tax Cycles[/b]: how often production is collected and converted to silver. [b]- Production Tithe[/b]: a per-worker budget bonus that only counts towards tithing. [b]- Worker Cost[/b]: the per-worker silver charge applied each cycle.
Lower presets (e.g. Peaceful, Community Builder) pay you more per resource and charge less per worker. Higher presets (e.g. Blood and Dust, Losing is Fun) invert everything: lower silver per resource, more expensive workers, and the gap between paydays is widened.
Choose Custom to set each parameter independently. Useful when you want, for example, vanilla payouts but a faster tax cadence, or harsh worker costs without lowering production value.

Rule.Translated:
El preajuste de dificultad del Imperio es independiente de la dificultad del narrador de RimWorld. Controla cuatro parámetros económicos que, juntos, determinan lo indulgente que es el inicio de partida y lo lucrativo que llega a ser un imperio maduro.

 [b]- Plata por recurso[/b]: el valor en plata de una unidad de recurso producido.
 [b]- Días entre ciclos de impuestos[/b]: con qué frecuencia se recoge la producción y se convierte en plata.
 [b]- Diezmo de producción[/b]: una bonificación de presupuesto por trabajador que solo cuenta para el diezmo.
 [b]- Coste por trabajador[/b]: el cargo en plata por trabajador aplicado cada ciclo.

Los preajustes más bajos (p. ej. Pacífica, Constructor de comunidades) te pagan más por recurso y cobran menos por trabajador. Los preajustes más altos (p. ej. Sangre y polvo, Perder es divertido) lo invierten todo: menos plata por recurso, trabajadores más caros y un intervalo mayor entre cobros.

Elige Personalizada para establecer cada parámetro de forma independiente. Útil cuando quieres, por ejemplo, pagos vanilla pero una cadencia de impuestos más rápida, o costes de trabajador duros sin reducir el valor de producción.

Rule.Original:
Income from your settlements is collected periodically, sometimes referred to as "tax cycles" or on a "tax tick". Following the full path from production to payout ties together several other entries.
[b]1. Production.[/b] Each settlement turns workers, buildings, and prosperity into a flow of resources (see [i]Resource Production[/i]).
[b]2. Snapshots.[/b] That flow is sampled daily, and what you collect is the average across the whole tax period, not a single instant (see [i]Production Snapshots[/i]).
[b]3. Conversion.[/b] At collection time, produced resources are valued in silver at the Silver per Resource rate.
[b]4. Tithes.[/b] You can divert part of a resource's production away from silver and toward actual goods instead (see [i]Resource Tithing[/i]).
[b]5. Delivery.[/b] The result is shipped to you by caravan, drop pod, or shuttle (requires Royalty), arriving after a travel time.
How often this happens, how much each resource is worth, and how much workers cost are all set by your Difficulty Settings.

Rule.Translated:
Los ingresos de tus asentamientos se recogen periódicamente, a veces denominados "ciclos de impuestos" o "tick de impuestos". Seguir el recorrido completo desde la producción hasta el pago conecta varias otras entradas.

[b]1. Producción.[/b] Cada asentamiento convierte trabajadores, edificios y prosperidad en un flujo de recursos (consulta [i]Producción de recursos[/i]).

[b]2. Registros.[/b] Ese flujo se muestrea a diario, y lo que recoges es la media de todo el periodo de impuestos, no un único instante (consulta [i]Registros de producción[/i]).

[b]3. Conversión.[/b] En el momento del cobro, los recursos producidos se valoran en plata según la tasa de Plata por recurso.

[b]4. Diezmos.[/b] Puedes desviar parte de la producción de un recurso de la plata hacia bienes reales (consulta [i]Diezmo de recursos[/i]).

[b]5. Entrega.[/b] El resultado se te envía por caravana, cápsula de descenso o lanzadera (requiere Royalty), llegando tras un tiempo de viaje.

La frecuencia con la que ocurre esto, cuánto vale cada recurso y cuánto cuestan los trabajadores los determinan tus Ajustes de dificultad.

Rule.Original:
Not every cost is paid up front. Some charges (e.g. squad deployment costs) are billed and come due after a grace period.
Pay the bill before it's due, and the matter is settled. If the bill's deadline arrives without you paying it out, then the settlement will claw their silver from your coffers and be unhappy with you.
If you don't have the silver – or if you refuse to pay – then the settlement will be [b]really[/b] unhappy with you. And unhappy settlements will stop letting you deploy squads from them. (See [i]Empire Safeguards[/i])
Keep an eye on outstanding bills, especially after a flurry of military deployments. An aggressive campaign can quietly run up debts that erode the morale of the very settlements you're fighting from.

Rule.Translated:
No todos los costes se pagan por adelantado. Algunos cargos (p. ej. los costes de despliegue de escuadrones) se facturan y vencen tras un periodo de gracia.

Paga la factura antes de su vencimiento y el asunto queda zanjado. Si llega la fecha límite de la factura sin que la pagues, el asentamiento sacará su plata de tus arcas y se enfadará contigo.

Si no tienes la plata —o si te niegas a pagar—, el asentamiento se enfadará [b]mucho[/b] contigo. Y los asentamientos descontentos dejarán de permitirte desplegar escuadrones desde ellos. (Consulta [i]Salvaguardas del Imperio[/i])

Vigila las facturas pendientes, sobre todo tras una ráfaga de despliegues militares. Una campaña agresiva puede acumular deudas en silencio que erosionan la moral de los mismos asentamientos desde los que combates.

Rule.Original:
Your Empire's character is shaped by three layers of choices, each a different kind of commitment.
[b]Policies[/b] are your core governing direction. They carry strong, defining bonuses and drawbacks, and you commit to a small set of them.
[b]Faction traits[/b] are broad dispositions that color the whole empire, filling a handful of trait slots. Trait slots unlock by leveling up your Empire.
[b]Edicts[/b] are lighter, swappable measures grouped into categories – Social, Tax, Doctrine, and Military. Each category unlocks as your faction grows in level, and you can run one edict per category at a time. Some edicts carry an ongoing silver upkeep.
None of this is locked in forever. You can clear your chosen policies and pick again – but doing so costs silver, scaled to the size and prosperity of your empire.
The live values in the sidebar list what you currently have in force.

Rule.Translated:
El carácter de tu Imperio se moldea mediante tres capas de decisiones, cada una un tipo distinto de compromiso.

Las [b]políticas[/b] son tu dirección de gobierno central. Conllevan bonificaciones e inconvenientes fuertes y definitorios, y te comprometes con un pequeño conjunto de ellas.

Los [b]rasgos de facción[/b] son disposiciones amplias que tiñen todo el imperio, llenando un puñado de ranuras de rasgo. Las ranuras de rasgo se desbloquean subiendo de nivel tu Imperio.

Los [b]edictos[/b] son medidas más ligeras e intercambiables agrupadas en categorías: Social, Fiscal, Doctrina y Militar. Cada categoría se desbloquea a medida que tu facción sube de nivel, y puedes tener un edicto activo por categoría a la vez. Algunos edictos conllevan un mantenimiento continuo en plata.

Nada de esto queda fijado para siempre. Puedes borrar las políticas elegidas y volver a elegir, pero hacerlo cuesta plata, escalada al tamaño y la prosperidad de tu imperio.

Los valores en directo de la barra lateral enumeran lo que tienes actualmente en vigor.

Rule.Original:
From time to time, something happens that demands a decision – a windfall, a crisis, a stranger at the gates. Many of these events present you with a choice.
When an event with options appears, the game pauses and stays paused: you can't unpause or save until you've picked an option. There's no waiting it out or savescumming to dodge a bad roll.
Options often have a silver cost and a chance of success. That cost scales with how many settlements the event affects, so the same choice weighs more heavily on a large empire than a small one.
Some options are sure things; others are gambles with better and worse outcomes. Read them carefully; the cheapest choice is not always the safest.

Rule.Translated:
De vez en cuando ocurre algo que exige una decisión: un golpe de suerte, una crisis, un desconocido a las puertas. Muchos de estos eventos te presentan una elección.

Cuando aparece un evento con opciones, el juego se pausa y permanece pausado: no puedes reanudar ni guardar hasta que hayas elegido una opción. No hay forma de esperar a que pase ni de recargar la partida para esquivar una mala tirada.

Las opciones suelen tener un coste en plata y una probabilidad de éxito. Ese coste escala con cuántos asentamientos afecta el evento, así que la misma elección pesa más en un imperio grande que en uno pequeño.

Algunas opciones son cosa segura; otras son apuestas con resultados mejores y peores. Léelas con atención; la opción más barata no siempre es la más segura.

Rule.Original:
Enemy raids are sized by each attacking faction's own military tier, not by how large or wealthy your empire is. A pirate band hits about as hard whether you run one settlement or twenty.
Raid level and combat efficiency come from the attacking faction's tech level, plus a small random variance.
Attackers are chosen to roughly match your development. Factions whose power level is within +/-2 of your average settlement military level are favored; far-off tiers can still attack, but rarely.
For the first 30 days after raids begin, a cap softens how strong raids can be. After that, it lifts and raids arrive at full faction strength.

Rule.Translated:
Los saqueos enemigos se dimensionan según el rango militar de cada facción atacante, no según lo grande o rico que sea tu imperio. Una banda de piratas golpea con más o menos la misma fuerza tengas uno o veinte asentamientos.


El nivel del saqueo y la eficiencia de combate provienen del nivel tecnológico de la facción atacante, más una pequeña variación aleatoria.

Los atacantes se eligen para que coincidan aproximadamente con tu desarrollo. Se favorece a las facciones cuyo nivel de poder esté dentro de +/-2 de tu nivel militar medio de asentamiento; los rangos lejanos aún pueden atacar, pero rara vez.

Durante los primeros 30 días tras el inicio de los saqueos, un límite suaviza lo fuertes que pueden ser. Después, se levanta y los saqueos llegan con toda la fuerza de la facción.

Rule.Original:
Empire military level governs how dangerous each attack is. Attack Frequency governs how often they come.
Attack frequency is driven by your settlement count: roughly 1.0x at one settlement, 1.4x at five, 1.8x at ten, and 2.0x at fifteen or more. It is capped only by the "min/max days till military action" setting; attacks will never occur more frequently than the minimum value.
In practical terms, a sprawling fifteen-settlement empire faces attacks roughly twice as often as a single-settlement empire, even if both have the same average military level.

Rule.Translated:
El nivel militar del Imperio determina lo peligroso que es cada ataque. La Frecuencia de ataque determina con qué frecuencia llegan.

La frecuencia de ataque la impulsa tu número de asentamientos: aproximadamente 1.0x con un asentamiento, 1.4x con cinco, 1.8x con diez y 2.0x con quince o más. Solo está limitada por el ajuste "días mín./máx. hasta una acción militar"; los ataques nunca ocurrirán con más frecuencia que el valor mínimo.

En términos prácticos, un imperio extenso de quince asentamientos se enfrenta a ataques aproximadamente el doble de a menudo que un imperio de un solo asentamiento, aunque ambos tengan el mismo nivel militar medio.

Rule.Original:
Both auto-defend battles and offensive raids involving Empire settlements are resolved by simulation.
An auto-resolve battle begins by assigning both the attacker and the defender an HP value, derived from their base Military Level and any modifiers (such as Military Efficiency or Defender Advantage).
The simulation then consists of a number of rounds. Each round, the attacker and defender roll a d20; the side with the lowest value loses one HP, with the defender winning ties. This repeats until one side reaches 0 HP.
But there's a catch: each d20 roll is multiplied by that force's Military Efficiency. For a force with a raw efficiency of 1.2, a d20 roll of 10 becomes 12; for a force with an efficiency of 0.8, a roll of 10 becomes 8. (This is the raw multiplier – Efficiency Damping compresses it before the fight; more on that in the [i]Battle Simulation Modifiers[/i] entry.)
In this way, military efficiency can have a substantial impact on auto-resolve battles. Don't neglect it!
More technologically advanced NPC factions field more efficient forces – the current efficiency for each tech level is listed in the sidebar.

Rule.Translated:
Tanto las batallas de defensa automática como los saqueos ofensivos en los que intervienen asentamientos del Imperio se resuelven por simulación.
 
Una batalla de resolución automática comienza asignando tanto al atacante como al defensor un valor de PV, derivado de su Nivel militar base y de cualquier modificador (como la Eficiencia militar o la Ventaja del defensor).
 
La simulación consiste entonces en una serie de rondas. En cada ronda, el atacante y el defensor tiran un d20; el bando con el valor más bajo pierde un PV, ganando el defensor los empates. Esto se repite hasta que un bando llega a 0 PV.
 
Pero hay una trampa: cada tirada de d20 se multiplica por la Eficiencia militar de esa fuerza. Para una fuerza con una eficiencia bruta de 1.2, una tirada de 10 en el d20 se convierte en 12; para una fuerza con una eficiencia de 0.8, una tirada de 10 se convierte en 8. (Este es el multiplicador bruto; la Amortiguación de eficiencia lo comprime antes del combate; más sobre esto en la entrada [i]Modificadores de simulación de batalla[/i].)

De este modo, la eficiencia militar puede tener un impacto sustancial en las batallas de resolución automática. ¡No la descuides!

Las facciones NPC tecnológicamente más avanzadas despliegan fuerzas más eficientes; la eficiencia actual de cada nivel tecnológico se enumera en la barra lateral.

Rule.Original:
Both auto-defend battles and offensive raids involving Empire settlements are resolved by simulation. Two settings control how that simulation behaves.
Defender Advantage is a flat multiplier on the defender's effective combat power. The default reflects the natural edge that comes from prepared positions; raising it makes garrisons more durable, lowering it makes attackers more deadly. This advantage applies to both Empire settlements and NPC settlements: you benefit when someone attacks you, but they benefit when you raid them.
Efficiency Damping compresses extreme efficiency ratios toward 1.0, so neither side runs away with the fight on a single lucky composition. The formula is straightforward: final = 1 + (raw − 1) × damping. A raw efficiency of 2.0 with the default damping of 0.5 becomes 1.5, and a raw of 0.3 with the same damping becomes 0.65.
Set damping high to preserve the raw outcomes (sharp wins and sharp losses); set it low to flatten the curve (no battle is ever a runaway). Defender Advantage and Damping interact, so tune both together rather than in isolation.

Rule.Translated:
Tanto las batallas de defensa automática como los saqueos ofensivos en los que intervienen asentamientos del Imperio se resuelven por simulación. Dos ajustes controlan cómo se comporta esa simulación.

La Ventaja del defensor es un multiplicador fijo sobre el poder de combate efectivo del defensor. El valor por defecto refleja la ventaja natural que aportan las posiciones preparadas; subirlo hace las guarniciones más duraderas, bajarlo hace los atacantes más letales. Esta ventaja se aplica tanto a los asentamientos del Imperio como a los NPC: te beneficias cuando alguien te ataca, pero ellos se benefician cuando los saqueas.

La Amortiguación de eficiencia comprime las proporciones de eficiencia extremas hacia 1.0, para que ningún bando arrase en el combate con una sola composición afortunada. La fórmula es sencilla: final = 1 + (bruto − 1) × amortiguación. Una eficiencia bruta de 2.0 con la amortiguación por defecto de 0.5 se convierte en 1.5, y una bruta de 0.3 con la misma amortiguación se convierte en 0.65.

Pon la amortiguación alta para preservar los resultados brutos (victorias y derrotas contundentes); ponla baja para aplanar la curva (ninguna batalla es nunca una paliza). La Ventaja del defensor y la Amortiguación interactúan, así que ajústalas juntas en lugar de por separado.

Rule.Original:
Most battles end with one side's force worn down while the other survives with losses. But two extreme results carry special weight.
An [b]Overwhelming Victory[/b] is a win in which your force takes zero casualties – the enemy is broken without costing you a single point of strength. It rewards the winning settlement with a boost to happiness and loyalty.
A [b]Crushing Defeat[/b] is the same situation seen from the losing side: you lose the battle without inflicting a single casualty in return. It applies penalties well beyond those of an ordinary loss.
Tiny skirmishes don't count for either option: at least one side must field a meaningful force for the outcome to qualify as an Overwhelming Victory or Crushing Defeat.
Both outcomes hinge on the casualty count, not the final margin. So a strong, efficient force is the surest way to court Overwhelming Victories and avoid Crushing Defeats.
