Rule.Translated:
La mayoría de las batallas terminan con la fuerza de un bando desgastada mientras el otro sobrevive con pérdidas. Pero dos resultados extremos tienen un peso especial.

Una [b]Victoria aplastante[/b] es una victoria en la que tu fuerza no sufre ninguna baja: el enemigo es derrotado sin costarte un solo punto de fuerza. Recompensa al asentamiento ganador con un aumento de felicidad y lealtad.

Una [b]Derrota aplastante[/b] es la misma situación vista desde el lado perdedor: pierdes la batalla sin infligir una sola baja a cambio. Aplica penalizaciones muy superiores a las de una derrota ordinaria.

Las escaramuzas diminutas no cuentan para ninguna de las dos opciones: al menos un bando debe desplegar una fuerza significativa para que el resultado cuente como Victoria aplastante o Derrota aplastante.

Ambos resultados dependen del recuento de bajas, no del margen final. Así que una fuerza fuerte y eficiente es la forma más segura de buscar Victorias aplastantes y evitar Derrotas aplastantes.
Tiempo de espera de los escuadrones

Rule.Original:
After a squad acts, it needs time before it can act again – but how long depends on what it did.
Defending its own home settlement carries no cooldown: the squad is already there and simply re-forms. If sent to defend a different settlement, it takes about a day to return and reset.
Offensive operations cost more time. After an attack, the squad must physically travel back from the target to its home settlement, so the cooldown scales with distance – a raid on a neighbor recovers quickly, while a strike across the planet leaves the squad unavailable far longer.
Injuries are a separate matter. Wounded mercenaries lower a squad's combat effectiveness until they heal, and the squad inspection window shows the estimated recovery time. Mercenaries killed in action leave their slot empty until you pay to fill it.
Rule.Raw:
After a squad acts, it needs time before it can act again – but how long depends on what it did.
Defending its own home settlement carries no cooldown: the squad is already there and simply re-forms. If sent to defend a different settlement, it takes about a day to return and reset.
Offensive operations cost more time. After an attack, the squad must physically travel back from the target to its home settlement, so the cooldown scales with distance – a raid on a neighbor recovers quickly, while a strike across the planet leaves the squad unavailable far longer.
Injuries are a separate matter. Wounded mercenaries lower a squad's combat effectiveness until they heal, and the squad inspection window shows the estimated recovery time. Mercenaries killed in action leave their slot empty until you pay to fill it.
Rule.Translated:
Después de que un escuadrón actúe, necesita tiempo antes de poder volver a actuar, pero cuánto depende de lo que hiciera.

Defender su propio asentamiento de origen no conlleva reutilización: el escuadrón ya está allí y simplemente se reorganiza. Si se envía a defender un asentamiento distinto, tarda aproximadamente un día en regresar y restablecerse.

Las operaciones ofensivas cuestan más tiempo. Tras un ataque, el escuadrón debe viajar físicamente de vuelta desde el objetivo a su asentamiento de origen, así que la reutilización escala con la distancia: un saqueo a un vecino se recupera rápido, mientras que un ataque al otro lado del planeta deja al escuadrón indisponible mucho más tiempo.

Las heridas son un asunto aparte. Los mercenarios heridos reducen la eficacia de combate de un escuadrón hasta que se curan, y la ventana de inspección del escuadrón muestra el tiempo de recuperación estimado. Los mercenarios muertos en combate dejan su ranura vacía hasta que pagues por rellenarla.

Rule.Original:
A squad is no longer a one-time assignment that fights forever for free. Maintaining a fighting force is an ongoing expense.
[b]Hiring:[/b] each squad must be hired with silver before it can defend or deploy. Filling empty slots – whether on a fresh squad or to replace the fallen – costs silver per mercenary.
[b]Casualties:[/b] mercenaries killed in battle leave empty slots. Their replacements must be hired and equipped, so even a bloody victory carries a bill.
[b]Updating:[/b] changing a squad's loadout template doesn't immediately re-equip the squad, nor does it do so for free; bringing existing mercenaries up to a new template costs silver.
[b]Deployment:[/b] every offensive operation and every deployment charges a fraction of the squad's value – 20% by default, configurable in the mod settings. This is billed after the fact, so watch your treasury.
[b]Defense without a squad:[/b] a settlement with no squad assigned to it still defends itself, but at roughly half the strength its military level would otherwise provide. Assigning a real squad is the difference between a token defense and a real one.

Rule.Translated:
Un escuadrón ya no es una asignación de una sola vez que combate para siempre gratis. Mantener una fuerza de combate es un gasto continuo.

[b]Contratación:[/b] cada escuadrón debe contratarse con plata antes de poder defender o desplegarse. Rellenar las ranuras vacías —ya sea en un escuadrón nuevo o para reemplazar a los caídos— cuesta plata por mercenario.

[b]Bajas:[/b] los mercenarios muertos en batalla dejan ranuras vacías. Sus reemplazos deben contratarse y equiparse, así que incluso una victoria sangrienta conlleva una factura.

[b]Actualización:[/b] cambiar la plantilla de equipamiento de un escuadrón no lo reequipa de inmediato, ni lo hace gratis; poner a los mercenarios existentes al día con una nueva plantilla cuesta plata.

[b]Despliegue:[/b] cada operación ofensiva y cada despliegue cobra una fracción del valor del escuadrón —20% por defecto, configurable en los ajustes del mod—. Se factura a posteriori, así que vigila tu tesorería.

[b]Defensa sin escuadrón:[/b] un asentamiento sin escuadrón asignado aún se defiende, pero a aproximadamente la mitad de la fuerza que su nivel militar proporcionaría de otro modo. Asignar un escuadrón real es la diferencia entre una defensa simbólica y una de verdad.

Rule.Original:
Empire includes a set of safeguards that close off the most abusive player tactics. They can all be disabled in the mod settings if you prefer the old, looser rules.
[b]- Losing your people hurts.[/b] When a mercenary or other Empire pawn dies, the faction takes a happiness hit; if the death was your own doing, the penalty is larger and also damages loyalty and raises unrest. Wiping out a caravan's pack animals carries its own steep happiness and loyalty penalty.
[b]- Morale gates deployment.[/b] A settlement whose happiness or loyalty has collapsed, or whose unrest has boiled over, cannot launch offensive or deploy operations from itself. It will still defend itself; a struggling settlement is never left defenseless.
[b]- No looting of Empire goods.[/b] In manual defense battles, items belonging to your Empire (i.e. items that spawned with the map) are auto-forbidden and cannot be carried away, neither by pawn nor by caravan. You'll still be able to loot goods off of enemy corpses, but you can't treat your own Empire like a loot pinata.
The live values below show which of your settlements, if any, are currently locked out of deploying.

Rule.Translated:
Empire incluye un conjunto de salvaguardas que cierran las tácticas más abusivas del jugador. Todas pueden desactivarse en los ajustes del mod si prefieres las reglas antiguas y más laxas.

[b]- Perder a tu gente duele.[/b] Cuando un mercenario u otro personaje del Imperio muere, la facción sufre un golpe de felicidad; si la muerte fue obra tuya, la penalización es mayor y además daña la lealtad y aumenta el descontento. Aniquilar a los animales de carga de una caravana conlleva su propia fuerte penalización de felicidad y lealtad.

[b]- La moral condiciona el despliegue.[/b] Un asentamiento cuya felicidad o lealtad se haya hundido, o cuyo descontento se haya desbordado, no puede lanzar operaciones ofensivas ni de despliegue desde sí mismo. Aún se defenderá; un asentamiento en apuros nunca queda indefenso.

[b]- Sin saqueo de bienes del Imperio.[/b] En las batallas de defensa manual, los objetos que pertenecen a tu Imperio (es decir, los que aparecieron con el mapa) quedan auto-prohibidos y no pueden llevarse, ni por personajes ni por caravanas. Aún podrás saquear bienes de los cadáveres enemigos, pero no puedes tratar a tu propio Imperio como una piñata de botín.

Los valores en directo de abajo muestran cuáles de tus asentamientos, si los hay, están actualmente bloqueados para desplegar.

Rule.Original:
Every battle your Empire fights – whether resolved automatically or played out manually – is recorded in the Battle Reports archive.
For auto-resolved battles, the report preserves the round-by-round exchange: how each side's force was whittled down, and what tipped the result. Manual battles record only their final outcome.
Open the archive from the military side of the Empire interface to review past engagements.

Rule.Translated:
Cada batalla que libra tu Imperio —ya se resuelva automáticamente o se juegue manualmente— se registra en el archivo de Informes de batalla.

Para las batallas de resolución automática, el informe conserva el intercambio ronda a ronda: cómo se fue mermando la fuerza de cada bando y qué inclinó el resultado. Las batallas manuales registran solo su resultado final.

Abre el archivo desde el lado militar de la interfaz del Imperio para revisar enfrentamientos pasados.

Rule.Original:
Every settlement tracks three social stats, each on a 0-100 scale, and together they are the pulse of the settlement.
Happiness reflects contentment. Loyalty reflects allegiance to your Empire. Unrest reflects agitation – and unlike the other two, lower is better.
Left alone, happiness and loyalty drift upward by a point a day and unrest drifts downward. But policies, buildings, and events constantly push them around.
These stats matter for two reasons: - They set the prosperity target. Prosperity, the master multiplier on production, drifts toward (happiness + loyalty + (100 - unrest)) / 3. Healthy social stats mean a productive settlement (see [i]Prosperity[/i]). - They gate your military. If a settlement's happiness or loyalty falls too low, or its unrest climbs too high, it can no longer launch offensive or deploy operations (see [i]Empire Safeguards[/i]).
The live values in the sidebar show each settlement's current standing.

Rule.Translated:
Cada asentamiento registra tres estadísticas sociales, cada una en una escala de 0 a 100, y juntas son el pulso del asentamiento.

La felicidad refleja la satisfacción. La lealtad refleja la fidelidad a tu Imperio. El descontento refleja la agitación y, a diferencia de las otras dos, cuanto más bajo, mejor.

Si se las deja en paz, la felicidad y la lealtad derivan al alza un punto al día y el descontento deriva a la baja. Pero las políticas, los edificios y los eventos las empujan constantemente.

Estas estadísticas importan por dos razones:
 - Fijan el objetivo de prosperidad. La prosperidad, el multiplicador maestro de la producción, deriva hacia (felicidad + lealtad + (100 - descontento)) / 3. Unas estadísticas sociales sanas significan un asentamiento productivo (consulta [i]Prosperidad[/i]).
 - Condicionan tu ejército. Si la felicidad o la lealtad de un asentamiento caen demasiado, o su descontento sube demasiado, ya no puede lanzar operaciones ofensivas ni de despliegue (consulta [i]Salvaguardas del Imperio[/i]).

Los valores en directo de la barra lateral muestran la situación actual de cada asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
Settlements grow by leveling up and by building. Both are gated by what the settlement type and your tech allow.
[b]- Building slots.[/b] Each settlement type has a limited number of building slots, and that number grows as the settlement levels up. You can't build past the slots you have, so higher-level, larger settlements are what let you stack the buildings that drive production and defense.
[b]- Costs.[/b] Buildings cost silver to construct and take time to finish; many also carry an ongoing upkeep. Upgrading a settlement to the next level has its own escalating cost. These costs can be shifted by stats from policies, traits, and other buildings.
[b]- Prerequisites.[/b] Some buildings require another building first, forming upgrade chains. A building's upgrades satisfy the same requirements that its base form did, so you can keep advancing a chain without losing what depended on the earlier tier.
The Buildings tab of this Codex lists every building with its cost, requirements, and effects.

Rule.Translated:
Los asentamientos crecen subiendo de nivel y construyendo. Ambas cosas están condicionadas por lo que permiten el tipo de asentamiento y tu tecnología.

[b]- Ranuras de edificio.[/b] Cada tipo de asentamiento tiene un número limitado de ranuras de edificio, y ese número crece a medida que el asentamiento sube de nivel. No puedes construir más allá de las ranuras que tienes, así que los asentamientos de mayor nivel y más grandes son los que te permiten acumular los edificios que impulsan la producción y la defensa.

[b]- Costes.[/b] Los edificios cuestan plata de construir y tardan en terminarse; muchos también conllevan un mantenimiento continuo. Mejorar un asentamiento al siguiente nivel tiene su propio coste creciente. Estos costes pueden alterarse con estadísticas de políticas, rasgos y otros edificios.

[b]- Prerrequisitos.[/b] Algunos edificios requieren otro edificio primero, formando cadenas de mejora. Las mejoras de un edificio satisfacen los mismos requisitos que satisfacía su forma base, así que puedes seguir avanzando una cadena sin perder lo que dependía del nivel anterior.

La pestaña de Edificios de este Códice enumera cada edificio con su coste, requisitos y efectos.

Rule.Original:
Captives taken in battle can be put to work in your settlements.
[b]- Putting them to work.[/b] Prisoners held at a settlement contribute to its workforce. A prisoner who has been downed contributes nothing until they recover.
[b]- Health and workload.[/b] Each prisoner has a workload setting that trades work against well-being: heavier workloads wear their health down each day, while lighter ones let them recover. Push too hard and a prisoner can die, which costs you a little goodwill with their home faction. You can set a default workload per settlement or for the whole faction, and apply one in bulk.
[b]- Moving them.[/b] Prisoners don't teleport. To relocate a captive, a caravan must physically carry them to the destination settlement and transfer them there.

Rule.Translated:
Los cautivos tomados en batalla pueden ponerse a trabajar en tus asentamientos.

[b]- Ponerlos a trabajar.[/b] Los prisioneros retenidos en un asentamiento contribuyen a su mano de obra. Un prisionero que ha sido incapacitado no contribuye en nada hasta que se recupera.

[b]- Salud y carga de trabajo.[/b] Cada prisionero tiene un ajuste de carga de trabajo que sopesa el trabajo frente al bienestar: las cargas más pesadas desgastan su salud cada día, mientras que las más ligeras le permiten recuperarse. Si aprietas demasiado, un prisionero puede morir, lo que te cuesta un poco de buena voluntad con su facción de origen. Puedes fijar una carga de trabajo por defecto por asentamiento o para toda la facción, y aplicarla en lote.

[b]- Trasladarlos.[/b] Los prisioneros no se teletransportan. Para reubicar a un cautivo, una caravana debe transportarlo físicamente al asentamiento de destino y transferirlo allí.

Rule.Original:
Your Empire faction has its own tech level, and it climbs as you complete the research that gates each tier. A higher tech level unlocks better buildings and resources across the whole faction.
Each advancement is tied to specific research; reaching a tier requires completing the projects that gate it. These gates are defined through XML Defs, so other mods can alter their progression.
There is a mod setting to pin your Empire's tech level directly to your own faction's tech level, so that they advance with you instead of at arbitrary techs. (Note: in vanilla Rimworld, this will result in the Empire faction effectively being locked at either Neolithic or Industrial. Player-faction tech level advancing requires mods.)
The live values below show your current tech level and what advances it next.

Rule.Translated:
Tu facción del Imperio tiene su propio nivel tecnológico, y sube a medida que completas la investigación que condiciona cada rango. Un nivel tecnológico más alto desbloquea mejores edificios y recursos en toda la facción.

Cada avance está vinculado a una investigación específica; alcanzar un rango requiere completar los proyectos que lo condicionan. Estas condiciones se definen mediante Defs XML, así que otros mods pueden alterar su progresión.

Hay un ajuste del mod para fijar el nivel tecnológico de tu Imperio directamente al de tu propia facción, de modo que avancen contigo en lugar de a tecnologías arbitrarias. (Nota: en RimWorld vanilla, esto hará que la facción del Imperio quede efectivamente bloqueada en Neolítico o Industrial. Que el nivel tecnológico de la facción del jugador avance requiere mods.)

Los valores en directo de abajo muestran tu nivel tecnológico actual y qué lo hace avanzar a continuación.

Rule.Original:
Empire lets you found and lead your own allied NPC faction - a second power on the world map that gathers resources, fields armies, and answers to you.
You begin by establishing the faction and your first settlement. From there, your Empire runs on a rhythm: settlements produce resources, taxes are collected on a cycle and delivered to you, and you spend that income expanding, building, raising armies, and weathering events and raids.
Your colony and your Empire are partners, but they are [b]not[/b] the same faction. The Empire is managed from its own interface, and you direct it through windows: founding and upgrading settlements, assigning workers, choosing policies, designing military units, and responding to events.
The entries in this Codex break down each of those systems. If you're just starting, read [i]Founding Your First Settlement[/i] next, then the [b]Economy[/b] and [b]Military[/b] sections.
There is also a more in-depth guide in the Empire Discord server, complete with helpful screenshots and visual aids. Check the patch notes page (through mod settings) to get a link.

Rule.Translated:
Empire te permite fundar y liderar tu propia facción NPC aliada: una segunda potencia en el mapa del mundo que reúne recursos, despliega ejércitos y responde ante ti.

Empiezas estableciendo la facción y tu primer asentamiento. A partir de ahí, tu Imperio funciona con un ritmo: los asentamientos producen recursos, los impuestos se cobran por ciclos y se te entregan, y gastas esos ingresos en expandirte, construir, levantar ejércitos y capear eventos y saqueos.

Tu colonia y tu Imperio son socios, pero [b]no[/b] son la misma facción. El Imperio se gestiona desde su propia interfaz, y lo diriges a través de ventanas: fundando y mejorando asentamientos, asignando trabajadores, eligiendo políticas, diseñando unidades militares y respondiendo a eventos.

Las entradas de este Códice desglosan cada uno de esos sistemas. Si acabas de empezar, lee a continuación [i]Fundar tu primer asentamiento[/i], y luego las secciones de [b]Economía[/b] y [b]Militar[/b].

También hay una guía más detallada en el servidor de Discord de Empire, con útiles capturas de pantalla y ayudas visuales. Consulta la página de notas del parche (a través de los ajustes del mod) para conseguir un enlace.

Rule.Original:
Everything your Empire does begins with a settlement. Founding one is your first real decision.
[b]- Choosing a tile.[/b] You pick where to settle on the world map. The tile's biome and features shape what the settlement can produce, so the choice has lasting consequences. The founding screen shows the resources and modifiers a candidate tile offers, along with the travel time to reach it.
[b]- Paying for it.[/b] Founding a settlement costs silver. By default, you'll be asked to confirm before the cost is taken, so an accidental click won't drain your treasury.
[b]- Settling in.[/b] A new settlement isn't instant: after you commit, it takes time to travel to the tile and construct the settlement before it comes online and starts producing.
From there you assign workers, raise its level, and add buildings. See [i]Settlement Social Stats[/i] and the [b]Economy[/b] section to keep it healthy and productive.

Rule.Translated:
Todo lo que hace tu Imperio comienza con un asentamiento. Fundar uno es tu primera decisión de verdad.

[b]- Elegir una casilla.[/b] Eliges dónde asentarte en el mapa del mundo. El bioma y las características de la casilla determinan lo que el asentamiento puede producir, así que la elección tiene consecuencias duraderas. La pantalla de fundación muestra los recursos y modificadores que ofrece una casilla candidata, junto con el tiempo de viaje para llegar a ella.

[b]- Pagar por ello.[/b] Fundar un asentamiento cuesta plata. Por defecto, se te pedirá que confirmes antes de cobrar el coste, así que un clic accidental no vaciará tu tesorería.

[b]- Establecerse.[/b] Un nuevo asentamiento no es instantáneo: tras comprometerte, lleva tiempo viajar a la casilla y construir el asentamiento antes de que entre en funcionamiento y empiece a producir.

A partir de ahí asignas trabajadores, subes su nivel y añades edificios. Consulta [i]Estadísticas sociales del asentamiento[/i] y la sección de [b]Economía[/b] para mantenerlo sano y productivo.

Rule.Original: Fixes a crash when trying to add Empire mid-save. In this circumstance, Empire attempted to initialize the XenotypeFilter in the FactionFC.FinalizeInit function. As part of initializing the filter, Empire attempts to load all custom xenotypes through CustomXenotypesForReading. That calls CheckVersionAndLoad, which in turn calls InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly. Fun fact: if the Scribe mode is *not* Inactive, then InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly panics and force stops the scribe process. And guess what Empire's custom xenotype loading does? That's right: it calls InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly when the Scribe mode is not Inactive. Thus, loading stops, and everything breaks. Fun.\n\nThis issue does not affect new saves.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a crash when trying to add Empire mid-save. In this circumstance, Empire attempted to initialize the XenotypeFilter in the FactionFC.FinalizeInit function. As part of initializing the filter, Empire attempts to load all custom xenotypes through CustomXenotypesForReading. That calls CheckVersionAndLoad, which in turn calls InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly. Fun fact: if the Scribe mode is *not* Inactive, then InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly panics and force stops the scribe process. And guess what Empire's custom xenotype loading does? That's right: it calls InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly when the Scribe mode is not Inactive. Thus, loading stops, and everything breaks. Fun.\n\nThis issue does not affect new saves.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un fallo al intentar añadir Empire a una partida en curso. En ese caso, Empire intentaba inicializar XenotypeFilter en la función FactionFC.FinalizeInit. Al inicializar el filtro, intenta cargar todos los xenotipos personalizados mediante CustomXenotypesForReading. Esto llama a CheckVersionAndLoad, que a su vez llama a InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly. Un detalle curioso: si el modo de Scribe *no* es Inactive, InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly entra en pánico y detiene forzosamente el proceso de escritura. ¿Y qué hace la carga de xenotipos personalizados de Empire? Exacto: llama a InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly cuando el modo de Scribe no es Inactive. Por tanto, la carga se detiene y todo falla. Divertidísimo.\n\nEste problema no afecta a las partidas nuevas.

Mejora de la compatibilidad con RimWar

Rule.Original: Improves RimWar compat by patching up some of *their* patches for Empire, and setting our own point calculation. A caveat: this patch fully hijacks RimWar's point calculation for Empire settlements. That makes it difficult to track the point cost for units, so the unit-spawning gizmos for Empire settlements have been disabled, to prevent cheesing. This might be revisited in the future, but for an old mod barely on life support, I'm considering this good enough for now.
Rule.Raw: Improves RimWar compat by patching up some of *their* patches for Empire, and setting our own point calculation. A caveat: this patch fully hijacks RimWar's point calculation for Empire settlements. That makes it difficult to track the point cost for units, so the unit-spawning gizmos for Empire settlements have been disabled, to prevent cheesing. This might be revisited in the future, but for an old mod barely on life support, I'm considering this good enough for now.
Rule.Translated: Mejora la compatibilidad con RimWar corrigiendo algunos de *sus* parches para Empire y estableciendo nuestro propio cálculo de puntos. Una advertencia: este parche sustituye por completo el cálculo de puntos de RimWar para los asentamientos del Imperio. Esto dificulta seguir el coste en puntos de las unidades, por lo que se han desactivado los controles para generar unidades en esos asentamientos y evitar abusos. Quizá se revise en el futuro, pero, tratándose de un mod antiguo que apenas sigue vivo, por ahora lo considero suficiente.
Actualización de la ventana de asentamientos

Rule.Original: Fixes a couple issues with the settlement window, and adds the ability for submods to add their own buttons to the bottom left panel.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a couple issues with the settlement window, and adds the ability for submods to add their own buttons to the bottom left panel.
Rule.Translated: Corrige problemas de la ventana de asentamientos y permite a los submods añadir sus propios botones al panel inferior izquierdo.

Rule.Original: Adds option to not use the threaded computations for the road builder, just in case some users run into problems with it.
Rule.Raw: Adds option to not use the threaded computations for the road builder, just in case some users run into problems with it.
Rule.Translated: Añade una opción para desactivar los cálculos con hilos del constructor de carreteras, por si algunos usuarios encuentran problemas.

Rule.Original: Adds compatibility with vehicle framework for sending vehicle caravans to manual battles.
Rule.Raw: Adds compatibility with vehicle framework for sending vehicle caravans to manual battles.
Rule.Translated: Añade compatibilidad con Vehicle Framework para enviar caravanas de vehículos a batallas manuales.
Corrección de compatibilidad con Combat Extended

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue with using CE mortars in fire support.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue with using CE mortars in fire support.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema al utilizar morteros CE como apoyo de fuego.

Rule.Original: Augments the RimWar compatibility patch to turn RimWar attacks on Empire settlements into Empire military events.
Rule.Raw: Augments the RimWar compatibility patch to turn RimWar attacks on Empire settlements into Empire military events.
Rule.Translated: Amplía el parche de compatibilidad con RimWar para convertir sus ataques a asentamientos del Imperio en eventos militares de Empire.
Corrección de compatibilidad con Vehicle Framework

Rule.Original: Fix up the VF compat patch.
Rule.Raw: Fix up the VF compat patch.
Rule.Translated: Corrige el parche de compatibilidad con VF.

Rule.Original: Updates the road network calculations to cache old results, and to also only consider each settlements' 8 closest neighbors.
Rule.Raw: Updates the road network calculations to cache old results, and to also only consider each settlements' 8 closest neighbors.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza los cálculos de la red de carreteras para almacenar los resultados anteriores en caché y considerar únicamente los 8 vecinos más cercanos de cada asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Cleans up some code, and minor performance changes.
Rule.Raw: Cleans up some code, and minor performance changes.
Rule.Translated: Limpieza de código y pequeños cambios de rendimiento.

Rule.Original: Updates the resource traders so that they don't offer to buy literally everything, including toxic wastepacks.
Rule.Raw: Updates the resource traders so that they don't offer to buy literally everything, including toxic wastepacks.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza los comerciantes de recursos para que no ofrezcan comprar absolutamente todo, incluidos los paquetes de residuos tóxicos.

Rule.Original: Fixes a minor bug in the UI for selecting alternate squads to defend an under-attack settlement.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a minor bug in the UI for selecting alternate squads to defend an under-attack settlement.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un pequeño error en la interfaz para seleccionar escuadras alternativas que defiendan un asentamiento atacado.

Rule.Original: Hardens the code against crashing events that wipe out the event log.
Rule.Raw: Hardens the code against crashing events that wipe out the event log.
Rule.Translated: Refuerza el código frente a fallos de eventos que borran el registro de eventos.

Rule.Original: Updates manual battles to only end once the player has removed their own pawns from the map, similar to how the vanilla game handles map removal.
Rule.Raw: Updates manual battles to only end once the player has removed their own pawns from the map, similar to how the vanilla game handles map removal.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza las batallas manuales para que solo terminen cuando el jugador haya retirado sus peones del mapa, de forma similar a la eliminación de mapas del juego base.

Rule.Original: Add stone roads to Empire's road progression (dirt -> stone -> asphalt -> asphalt highway).
Rule.Raw: Add stone roads to Empire's road progression (dirt -> stone -> asphalt -> asphalt highway).
Rule.Translated: Añade las carreteras de piedra a la progresión de carreteras de Empire: tierra -> piedra -> asfalto -> autopista de asfalto.
Compatibilidad con más biomas del juego base

Rule.Original: Adds support for More Vanilla Biomes.
Rule.Raw: Adds support for More Vanilla Biomes.
Rule.Translated: Añade compatibilidad con More Vanilla Biomes.

Rule.Original: Adds support for More Vanilla Biomes.
Rule.Raw: Adds support for More Vanilla Biomes.
Rule.Translated: Añade compatibilidad con More Vanilla Biomes.

Rule.Original: Fixes a handful of issues with the new delayed-end manual defense + some event resolution fixes.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a handful of issues with the new delayed-end manual defense + some event resolution fixes.
Rule.Translated: Corrige varios problemas de la nueva finalización aplazada de la defensa manual y de la resolución de eventos.
Añade protecciones frente a WorldSettlementFCs nulos.
Correcciones de lanzaderas de defensa manual

Rule.Original: Various fixes to ensure that shuttles work properly with manual defense.
Rule.Raw: Various fixes to ensure that shuttles work properly with manual defense.
Rule.Translated: Varias correcciones para garantizar que las lanzaderas funcionen correctamente con la defensa manual.

Rule.Original: Cleans up a couple things that I should've caught before the 1.3.30 release...
Rule.Raw: Cleans up a couple things that I should've caught before the 1.3.30 release...
Rule.Translated: Corrige un par de cosas que debería haber detectado antes de publicar la versión 1.3.30...

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where manual defense battles might not end after sending a supporting caravan and then withdrawing.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where manual defense battles might not end after sending a supporting caravan and then withdrawing.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que las batallas de defensa manual podían no terminar después de enviar una caravana de apoyo y retirarse.
Corrección de Skyfaller en defensa manual

Rule.Original: Fixes a bug with skyfallers (transport pods, shuttles) in manual defense battles.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a bug with skyfallers (transport pods, shuttles) in manual defense battles.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un error con los objetos que caen del cielo, como cápsulas de transporte y lanzaderas, en las batallas de defensa manual.
Error del estado de batalla de asentamientos

Rule.Original: Bug: when saving+loading while a settlement is under attack (but before a defense has started), load order issues could cause the settlement to clear its own "isUnderAttack" flag, leading to bad state.
Rule.Raw: Bug: when saving+loading while a settlement is under attack (but before a defense has started), load order issues could cause the settlement to clear its own "isUnderAttack" flag, leading to bad state.
Rule.Translated: Error: al guardar y cargar mientras un asentamiento estaba siendo atacado, antes de iniciar la defensa, los problemas de orden de carga podían hacer que borrase su propia marca «isUnderAttack», dejando un estado incorrecto.
Actualización de la interfaz de defensa

Rule.Original: Fixes a couple of UI bugs with auto-defense. No mechanical issues; only the UI had a problem.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a couple of UI bugs with auto-defense. No mechanical issues; only the UI had a problem.
Rule.Translated: Corrige errores de interfaz en la defensa automática. No había problemas de mecánicas, solo de interfaz.
Corrección de la comprobación de animales

Rule.Original: Fixes a bug where a pawnKindDef with a null race or race.race could break one of Empire's checks for animals. I don't *think* either of these fields are meant to be null, but Rimworld seemingly allows it, so, *shrug*. We at least log the pawnkinddef in question so we know which one needs fixing.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a bug where a pawnKindDef with a null race or race.race could break one of Empire's checks for animals. I don't *think* either of these fields are meant to be null, but Rimworld seemingly allows it, so, *shrug*. We at least log the pawnkinddef in question so we know which one needs fixing.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un error por el que un pawnKindDef con race o race.race nulos podía romper una comprobación de animales de Empire. No *creo* que esos campos deban ser nulos, pero Rimworld parece permitirlo, así que, *qué se le va a hacer*. Al menos registramos el pawnkinddef en cuestión para saber cuál hay que corregir.

Rule.Original: Pawns held as prisoner by Empire settlements can be double-deep scribed under some circumstances, resulting in errors on loading a save.
Rule.Raw: Pawns held as prisoner by Empire settlements can be double-deep scribed under some circumstances, resulting in errors on loading a save.
Rule.Translated: En determinadas circunstancias, los peones encarcelados en asentamientos del Imperio podían serializarse por duplicado en profundidad, provocando errores al cargar una partida.

Rule.Original: Adds the ability to reform caravans after a manual defense battle.
Rule.Raw: Adds the ability to reform caravans after a manual defense battle.
Rule.Translated: Permite reorganizar caravanas después de una batalla de defensa manual.
Actualización de botones de acción de caravanas 2

Rule.Original: Rimworld logic says that a battle is over as soon as hostiles start to flee; this is when the Reform Caravan gizmo appears. Empire, however, does not consider a battle to be over until all hostiles have died or fled the map. This creates an awkward interim period where the gizmo appears, but isn't fully usable. This update resolves that by disabling the gizmo until Empire says the battle is over.
Rule.Raw: Rimworld logic says that a battle is over as soon as hostiles start to flee; this is when the Reform Caravan gizmo appears. Empire, however, does not consider a battle to be over until all hostiles have died or fled the map. This creates an awkward interim period where the gizmo appears, but isn't fully usable. This update resolves that by disabling the gizmo until Empire says the battle is over.
Rule.Translated: La lógica de Rimworld considera que una batalla termina en cuanto los enemigos empiezan a huir; entonces aparece el control para reorganizar la caravana. Sin embargo, Empire no la considera terminada hasta que todos los enemigos han muerto o abandonado el mapa. Esto crea un intervalo incómodo en el que aparece el control, pero no puede utilizarse plenamente. Esta actualización lo resuelve desactivándolo hasta que Empire dé la batalla por terminada.

Rule.Original: Adds load-time and debug-action-triggered checks to clear settlements that are erroneously stuck in the "Defending [settlement name]" state. I'm not completely sure what the root cause of the bug is, but this should at least clear up the resulting corrupted state.
Rule.Raw: Adds load-time and debug-action-triggered checks to clear settlements that are erroneously stuck in the "Defending [settlement name]" state. I'm not completely sure what the root cause of the bug is, but this should at least clear up the resulting corrupted state.
Rule.Translated: Añade comprobaciones al cargar y mediante acciones de depuración para liberar asentamientos que queden atascados por error en el estado «Defending [settlement name]». No tengo del todo clara la causa del error, pero esto debería corregir al menos el estado corrupto resultante.

Rule.Original: More null hardening for IsAnimalAndAllowed, used to fill out the animal pawnkind caches.
Rule.Raw: More null hardening for IsAnimalAndAllowed, used to fill out the animal pawnkind caches.
Rule.Translated: Más protecciones frente a valores nulos en IsAnimalAndAllowed, utilizado para completar las cachés de pawnkind de animales.
Actualización de la evasión de impuestos

Rule.Original: Patches an exploit where workers could be all unassigned right before tax is due to minimize the upkeep paid, while coasting by on income being calculated by the period average.
Rule.Raw: Patches an exploit where workers could be all unassigned right before tax is due to minimize the upkeep paid, while coasting by on income being calculated by the period average.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un abuso que permitía retirar a todos los trabajadores justo antes del pago de impuestos para reducir el mantenimiento, mientras los ingresos seguían calculándose según la media del periodo.

Rule.Original: Add missing translation key for the prosperity lost base stat.
Rule.Raw: Add missing translation key for the prosperity lost base stat.
Rule.Translated: Añade la clave de traducción que faltaba para la estadística base de pérdida de prosperidad.
Actualización de la interfaz de ingresos estimados

Rule.Original: Updates UI displays for estimated income to show the period average, which is what the player will actually receive.
Rule.Raw: Updates UI displays for estimated income to show the period average, which is what the player will actually receive.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza las estimaciones de ingresos de la interfaz para mostrar la media del periodo, que es lo que realmente recibirá el jugador.
Corrección de comerciantes del Imperio Fragmentado

Rule.Original: The defName for Empire Refactor's settlement traderkind collided with the base game's traderkind for the Shattered Empire, causing the actual Empire to generate stock oddly, or not at all. ...Really ought to've changed the mod name when I had the chance. Oh well.
Rule.Raw: The defName for Empire Refactor's settlement traderkind collided with the base game's traderkind for the Shattered Empire, causing the actual Empire to generate stock oddly, or not at all. ...Really ought to've changed the mod name when I had the chance. Oh well.
Rule.Translated: El defName del traderkind de asentamientos de Empire Refactor coincidía con el traderkind del Imperio fragmentado del juego base, haciendo que el Imperio real generase existencias de forma extraña o no las generase. ...Debería haber cambiado el nombre del mod cuando tuve ocasión. En fin.

Rule.Original: Mods that define a pawnKindDef with a null race field can crash various aspects of Empire.
Rule.Raw: Mods that define a pawnKindDef with a null race field can crash various aspects of Empire.
Rule.Translated: Los mods que definen un pawnKindDef con el campo race nulo pueden provocar fallos en varios sistemas de Empire.

Rule.Original: More hardening of pawnKindDef handling. Hopefully, this time, we won't see any more pawnKindDef-related errors. Hopefully.
Rule.Raw: More hardening of pawnKindDef handling. Hopefully, this time, we won't see any more pawnKindDef-related errors. Hopefully.
Rule.Translated: Más protecciones en la gestión de pawnKindDef. Con suerte, esta vez no veremos más errores relacionados con pawnKindDef. Con suerte.

Rule.Original: Fix for an issue with the capital spot on asteroids, and a small tweak to the Combat Extended patch.
Rule.Raw: Fix for an issue with the capital spot on asteroids, and a small tweak to the Combat Extended patch.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema del lugar de la capital en asteroides y ajusta ligeramente el parche de Combat Extended.

Rule.Original: Delays the construction of caravan traderkinds so that actually valid lists are created.
Rule.Raw: Delays the construction of caravan traderkinds so that actually valid lists are created.
Rule.Translated: Retrasa la creación de traderkinds de caravanas para generar listas válidas.
Mejoras de las caravanas del imperio

Rule.Original: Refines the specialized resource trader caravans: there is now a cap on the number of distinct items they carry, which should mitigate issues such as animal traders arriving with a thousand different animals.
Rule.Raw: Refines the specialized resource trader caravans: there is now a cap on the number of distinct items they carry, which should mitigate issues such as animal traders arriving with a thousand different animals.
Rule.Translated: Mejora las caravanas comerciales especializadas en recursos: ahora hay un límite de objetos distintos que pueden transportar, para mitigar problemas como comerciantes de animales que llegan con mil animales diferentes.
Corrección de la visualización de recursos de facción

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue with the faction-level "Total Production" resource readouts not being correct.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue with the faction-level "Total Production" resource readouts not being correct.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que las lecturas de «Producción total» de recursos de la facción eran incorrectas.
Corrección de Hediff en defensa manual

Rule.Original: Manual Defense battles will apply "well-trained" or "poorly-trained" hediffs to pawns based on the military efficiency of their home settlement/faction. However, this hediff isn't always stripped once the battle is over, allowing the player to obtain buffed pawns. This patch corrects that.
Rule.Raw: Manual Defense battles will apply "well-trained" or "poorly-trained" hediffs to pawns based on the military efficiency of their home settlement/faction. However, this hediff isn't always stripped once the battle is over, allowing the player to obtain buffed pawns. This patch corrects that.
Rule.Translated: Las batallas de defensa manual aplican a los peones estados de «bien entrenado» o «mal entrenado» según la eficiencia militar de su asentamiento o facción de origen. Sin embargo, este estado no siempre se eliminaba al terminar la batalla, permitiendo al jugador obtener peones mejorados. Este parche lo corrige.

Rule.Original: Updates the Empire-specific resource caravans to cap the number of pawns that the caravan can generate. Only relevant for the animals resource today, but should be able to handle any future resource that also would spawn pawns.
Rule.Raw: Updates the Empire-specific resource caravans to cap the number of pawns that the caravan can generate. Only relevant for the animals resource today, but should be able to handle any future resource that also would spawn pawns.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza las caravanas de recursos de Empire para limitar el número de peones que pueden generar. Actualmente solo afecta al recurso de animales, pero debería admitir futuros recursos que también generen peones.
Cambio de la ficha informativa de Hediff de eficiencia de combate

Rule.Original: Changes the infocard for the combat efficiency hediff to explain that the hediff's bonuses are derived from the faction's military efficiency.
Rule.Raw: Changes the infocard for the combat efficiency hediff to explain that the hediff's bonuses are derived from the faction's military efficiency.
Rule.Translated: Cambia la ficha informativa del estado de eficiencia de combate para explicar que sus bonificaciones proceden de la eficiencia militar de la facción.
Corrección de la selección de objetivos del apoyo de fuego

Rule.Original: Fixes the targeting circle for Fire Support to draw persistently, instead of just when the camera is moving.
Rule.Raw: Fixes the targeting circle for Fire Support to draw persistently, instead of just when the camera is moving.
Rule.Translated: Corrige el círculo de selección de objetivo del apoyo de fuego para que se dibuje continuamente, en lugar de hacerlo solo cuando se mueve la cámara.

Rule.Original: When RimWar is active, trader caravans from the Mercantile policy can fail to spawn and spam the log with errors. The root bug is ultimately on RimWar's side, but this patch hardens Empire's code to more gracefully handle such errors.
Rule.Raw: When RimWar is active, trader caravans from the Mercantile policy can fail to spawn and spam the log with errors. The root bug is ultimately on RimWar's side, but this patch hardens Empire's code to more gracefully handle such errors.
Rule.Translated: Con RimWar activo, las caravanas comerciales de la política Mercantil podían no generarse y llenar el registro de errores. El error original está en RimWar, pero este parche refuerza el código de Empire para gestionarlo mejor.

Rule.Original: Previously, trader caravans sent by the Mercantile Policy would fail to show up if the player hadn't set a capital location. With this patch, they now *will* show up.
Rule.Raw: Previously, trader caravans sent by the Mercantile Policy would fail to show up if the player hadn't set a capital location. With this patch, they now *will* show up.
Rule.Translated: Antes, las caravanas comerciales enviadas por la política Mercantil no aparecían si el jugador no había establecido la ubicación de la capital. Con este parche, *sí* aparecerán.

Rule.Original: Did you know that many of Empire's textures were over 1000 pixels on a side? I sure didn't. But thanks to that, Empire would use a whopping 600MB+ of VRAM!\n\nThis patch shrinks all those icons to more reasonable sizes, thereby reducing Empire's VRAM usage to only about 36MB.
Rule.Raw: Did you know that many of Empire's textures were over 1000 pixels on a side? I sure didn't. But thanks to that, Empire would use a whopping 600MB+ of VRAM!\n\nThis patch shrinks all those icons to more reasonable sizes, thereby reducing Empire's VRAM usage to only about 36MB.
Rule.Translated: ¿Sabías que muchas texturas de Empire superaban los 1000 píxeles por lado? Yo tampoco. ¡Pero eso hacía que Empire consumiese más de 600MB de VRAM!\n\nEste parche reduce esos iconos a tamaños más razonables, disminuyendo el uso de VRAM de Empire a unos 36MB.

Rule.Original: Removes the naive name filter that would mark any xenotype as non-violent if its defName contained "pacifist", "gentle", "weak", "frail", "nearsighted", or "peaceful".
Rule.Raw: Removes the naive name filter that would mark any xenotype as non-violent if its defName contained "pacifist", "gentle", "weak", "frail", "nearsighted", or "peaceful".
Rule.Translated: Elimina el filtro simplista que consideraba no violento cualquier xenotipo cuyo defName contuviese «pacifist», «gentle», «weak», «frail», «nearsighted» o «peaceful».

Rule.Original: Updates several non-English translations to remove a translation key collision with the base game.
Rule.Raw: Updates several non-English translations to remove a translation key collision with the base game.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza varias traducciones a otros idiomas para eliminar una coincidencia de claves de traducción con el juego base.

Rule.Original: Empire sets merc needs to full before they're deployed, but modded races can mess with this check. This update makes the checks stricter.
Rule.Raw: Empire sets merc needs to full before they're deployed, but modded races can mess with this check. This update makes the checks stricter.
Rule.Translated: Empire satisface por completo las necesidades de los mercenarios antes de desplegarlos, pero las razas de otros mods podían interferir con esta comprobación. La actualización hace las comprobaciones más estrictas.
Corrección de compatibilidad con Vehicle Framework

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where joining a manual battle with a vehicle and never dismounting can result in both the vehicle and the pawns within being swallowed and spat into the void upon battle conclusion.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where joining a manual battle with a vehicle and never dismounting can result in both the vehicle and the pawns within being swallowed and spat into the void upon battle conclusion.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que entrar en una batalla manual con un vehículo y no desmontar podía hacer desaparecer al vehículo y a los peones de su interior al terminar la batalla.

Rule.Original: A military unit that is created with a HAR race will lose that race when saving the game. This is a side-effect of how Empire handles pawnkinds.\n\nThis update fixes that bug.
Rule.Raw: A military unit that is created with a HAR race will lose that race when saving the game. This is a side-effect of how Empire handles pawnkinds.\n\nThis update fixes that bug.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad militar creada con una raza HAR perdía esa raza al guardar la partida. Era un efecto secundario de la gestión de pawnkinds de Empire.\n\nEsta actualización corrige el error.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where, if a race is set to 0 weight in the xenotype/race filter, then any mercs created with that race will have their race silently swapped later on.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where, if a race is set to 0 weight in the xenotype/race filter, then any mercs created with that race will have their race silently swapped later on.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que, si una raza tenía un peso de 0 en el filtro de xenotipos y razas, los mercenarios creados con ella cambiaban de raza silenciosamente más adelante.
Corrección de entregas en el punto de impuestos

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where getting taxes delivered without an active tax spot may cause errors and send all of your tax items into the void.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where getting taxes delivered without an active tax spot may cause errors and send all of your tax items into the void.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que recibir impuestos sin un lugar de entrega activo podía provocar errores y enviar todos los objetos de impuestos al vacío.

Rule.Original: The SettlementTypeExtension would cache a reference to the main world component, but never invalidate it. This could lead to things like settlement cost evaluations referring to the wrong world component. This update fixes that, and a couple of other minor issues.
Rule.Raw: The SettlementTypeExtension would cache a reference to the main world component, but never invalidate it. This could lead to things like settlement cost evaluations referring to the wrong world component. This update fixes that, and a couple of other minor issues.
Rule.Translated: SettlementTypeExtension almacenaba en caché una referencia al componente principal del mundo, pero nunca la invalidaba. Esto podía hacer que evaluaciones como el coste de un asentamiento utilizasen el componente de mundo equivocado. La actualización corrige esto y otros problemas menores.
Corrección de errores de guardado y carga

Rule.Original: Fixes a bug where an entirely-derived list is still saved and loaded, introducing the possibility for a corrupted save or weird behavior to null it out. This then causes crashes and issues later on.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a bug where an entirely-derived list is still saved and loaded, introducing the possibility for a corrupted save or weird behavior to null it out. This then causes crashes and issues later on.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un error por el que se guardaba y cargaba una lista obtenida íntegramente de otros datos, permitiendo que una partida corrupta o un comportamiento extraño la volviesen nula y provocasen fallos posteriores.

Rule.Original: Adds some diagnostic logging for the failure case of failing to spawn a Mercantile caravan. The added logging fires only when a caravan fails to spawn, which happens at maximum once every 2 days.
Rule.Raw: Adds some diagnostic logging for the failure case of failing to spawn a Mercantile caravan. The added logging fires only when a caravan fails to spawn, which happens at maximum once every 2 days.
Rule.Translated: Añade registros de diagnóstico cuando no se logra generar una caravana Mercantil. Solo se registran cuando falla su generación, lo que ocurre como máximo una vez cada 2 días.
Diagnóstico de caravanas comerciales del imperio

Rule.Original: Adds a little bit of diagnostic logging for Empire trade caravans. The logging runs rarely, and should not impact performance.
Rule.Raw: Adds a little bit of diagnostic logging for Empire trade caravans. The logging runs rarely, and should not impact performance.
Rule.Translated: Añade algunos registros de diagnóstico para las caravanas comerciales de Empire. Se ejecutan con poca frecuencia y no deberían afectar al rendimiento.

Rule.Original: Adds machinery to let submods intercept and redirect tax events.
Rule.Raw: Adds machinery to let submods intercept and redirect tax events.
Rule.Translated: Añade mecanismos para que los submods intercepten y redirijan eventos de impuestos.

Rule.Original: Backend code updates to clean things up a bit.
Rule.Raw: Backend code updates to clean things up a bit.
Rule.Translated: Actualizaciones del código interno para ordenarlo un poco.

Rule.Original: Updates all scrollbars in Empire windows to use flat rectangles instead of the default rounded shape, to be more in line with Empire's general UI design.
Rule.Raw: Updates all scrollbars in Empire windows to use flat rectangles instead of the default rounded shape, to be more in line with Empire's general UI design.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza todas las barras de desplazamiento de las ventanas de Empire para que utilicen rectángulos planos en vez de la forma redondeada predeterminada, en consonancia con el diseño general de su interfaz.

Rule.Original: Adds the framework for the Empire Codex, meant to be an in-game resource similar to Civilization's Civilopedia.
Rule.Raw: Adds the framework for the Empire Codex, meant to be an in-game resource similar to Civilization's Civilopedia.
Rule.Translated: Añade la estructura del Códice del Imperio, concebido como una fuente de información dentro del juego similar a la Civilopedia de Civilization.

Rule.Original: Updates military raids to enable additional military functionality.
Rule.Raw: Updates military raids to enable additional military functionality.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza los asaltos militares para permitir funciones militares adicionales.

Rule.Original: Adds resources to the Empire Codex.
Rule.Raw: Adds resources to the Empire Codex.
Rule.Translated: Añade los recursos al Códice del Imperio.

Rule.Original: Minor backend change to how bonuses are colorized, which should hopefully produce more consistent bonus coloration throughout the UI.
Rule.Raw: Minor backend change to how bonuses are colorized, which should hopefully produce more consistent bonus coloration throughout the UI.

Rule.Original: Some extensibility changes for the manage units/squads/fire support windows to make it easier for submods to interject their own windows.
Rule.Raw: Some extensibility changes for the manage units/squads/fire support windows to make it easier for submods to interject their own windows.
Rule.Translated: Cambios de extensibilidad en las ventanas de gestión de unidades, escuadras y apoyo de fuego para que los submods incorporen sus propias ventanas con más facilidad.

Rule.Original: Add guards against the time between taxes being 0.
Rule.Raw: Add guards against the time between taxes being 0.
Rule.Translated: Añade protecciones para cuando el tiempo entre impuestos sea 0.

Rule.Original: Adds a few more entries to the Empire Codex.
Rule.Raw: Adds a few more entries to the Empire Codex.
Rule.Translated: Añade más entradas al Códice del Imperio.

Rule.Original: A few changes to make military units and squads more extensible.
Rule.Raw: A few changes to make military units and squads more extensible.
Rule.Translated: Varios cambios para facilitar la ampliación de las unidades y escuadras militares.

Rule.Original: The first real balance pass. This patch updates many of the policies to (hopefully) smooth out the power level. Along with the shake-up comes a new feature: the ability to clear your chosen policies and select new ones, albeit for a cost.
Rule.Raw: The first real balance pass. This patch updates many of the policies to (hopefully) smooth out the power level. Along with the shake-up comes a new feature: the ability to clear your chosen policies and select new ones, albeit for a cost.
Rule.Translated: Primer reajuste de equilibrio completo. Actualiza muchas políticas para intentar igualar sus niveles de poder. También añade una función: borrar las políticas elegidas y seleccionar otras, a cambio de un coste.

Rule.Original: Changes all fields that refer to a planet tile to use the actual PlanetTile type. Rimworld does technically allow for straight casting between int and PlanetTile, but you lose layer information when you do that. Empire actually does handle multiple layers (see orbital settlements), so switching over to using the actual PlanetTile type should protect against future errors.
Rule.Raw: Changes all fields that refer to a planet tile to use the actual PlanetTile type. Rimworld does technically allow for straight casting between int and PlanetTile, but you lose layer information when you do that. Empire actually does handle multiple layers (see orbital settlements), so switching over to using the actual PlanetTile type should protect against future errors.
Rule.Translated: Cambia todos los campos que hacen referencia a una casilla planetaria para utilizar el tipo PlanetTile real. Rimworld permite convertir directamente entre int y PlanetTile, pero así se pierde la información de capa. Empire admite varias capas, como los asentamientos orbitales, por lo que utilizar el tipo PlanetTile debería evitar futuros errores.

Rule.Original: Currently, when setting up a manual defense battle, if an animal would spawn without a rider, then the mod logs an error and skips the animal. This update changes that; we now only log a warning, and then try to spawn the animal anyways.
Rule.Raw: Currently, when setting up a manual defense battle, if an animal would spawn without a rider, then the mod logs an error and skips the animal. This update changes that; we now only log a warning, and then try to spawn the animal anyways.
Rule.Translated: Actualmente, al preparar una batalla de defensa manual, si un animal fuese a generarse sin jinete, el mod registra un error y omite al animal. Esta actualización lo cambia: solo registramos una advertencia e intentamos generar el animal de todos modos.

Rule.Original: A backend code update for event handling.
Rule.Raw: A backend code update for event handling.
Rule.Translated: Actualización del código interno de gestión de eventos.

Rule.Original: The caravan list for the Empire NPC faction gets built too early in the loading process, resulting in an empty list until a taxday occurs. This patch delays the list assembly to make sure that it always correctly reflects the production of the Empire faction.
Rule.Raw: The caravan list for the Empire NPC faction gets built too early in the loading process, resulting in an empty list until a taxday occurs. This patch delays the list assembly to make sure that it always correctly reflects the production of the Empire faction.
Rule.Translated: La lista de caravanas de la facción del Imperio controlada por PNJ se creaba demasiado pronto durante la carga, quedando vacía hasta un día de impuestos. Este parche retrasa su creación para que refleje correctamente la producción de la facción.

Rule.Original: Minor backend change to the tax tick processing.
Rule.Raw: Minor backend change to the tax tick processing.
Rule.Translated: Pequeño cambio interno en el procesamiento de los ciclos de impuestos.
Reorganización del código del sistema militar

Rule.Original:
This update features a hefty refactor of Empire's military system, largely in the name of future extensibility. Some of the changes won't be evident to the player, but many will; and in time, this refactor should allow for further new and requested features.

This update *does* make some fairly substantial changes to how squads work. If you don't like those changes -- or any of the other changes -- then the latest 1.3.x version of Empire will be available in the releases section of the official Empire Refactored github. But once 1.5.x hits the steam workshop, support for 1.3.x will cease.

1.5.x should be save compatible with previous versions, but active battles or military events might behave a little weirdly.
Rule.Raw:
This update features a hefty refactor of Empire's military system, largely in the name of future extensibility. Some of the changes won't be evident to the player, but many will; and in time, this refactor should allow for further new and requested features.

This update *does* make some fairly substantial changes to how squads work. If you don't like those changes -- or any of the other changes -- then the latest 1.3.x version of Empire will be available in the releases section of the official Empire Refactored github. But once 1.5.x hits the steam workshop, support for 1.3.x will cease.

1.5.x should be save compatible with previous versions, but active battles or military events might behave a little weirdly.
Rule.Translated:
Esta actualización incorpora una importante reestructuración del sistema militar de Empire, principalmente para facilitar futuras ampliaciones. Algunos cambios no serán visibles para el jugador, pero muchos sí; con el tiempo, debería permitir añadir nuevas funciones solicitadas.

Esta actualización *sí* cambia de forma considerable el funcionamiento de las escuadras. Si no te gustan estos cambios, o cualquier otro, la última versión 1.3.x de Empire estará disponible en la sección de versiones del GitHub oficial de Empire Refactored. Sin embargo, cuando 1.5.x llegue a Steam Workshop, finalizará el soporte de 1.3.x.

1.5.x debería ser compatible con partidas de versiones anteriores, aunque las batallas o los eventos militares activos podrían comportarse de forma algo extraña.

Rule.Original: Various minor backend refactors to clean up the code. There shouldn't be any impact on gameplay.
Rule.Raw: Various minor backend refactors to clean up the code. There shouldn't be any impact on gameplay.
Rule.Translated: Varias pequeñas reestructuraciones internas para ordenar el código. No deberían afectar a la jugabilidad.
Cambio del modificador de coste de xenotipos

Rule.Original: Changes the cost modifier for xenotypes in the Unit Template maker. Previously, the modifier just multiplied together all of the xenotype's genes' non-zero marketValueFactors. Now, we take various other stats into account: metabolism, complexity, archites, how many abilities the gene grants, stat bonuses, pain bonus, damage resist. All individually weighted with settings sliders.\n\nThe effect from each gene is also added together instead of multiplied. The cost of a xenotype shouldn't explode quite so easily anymore, but supremely powerful xenotypes will still be very expensive.
Rule.Raw: Changes the cost modifier for xenotypes in the Unit Template maker. Previously, the modifier just multiplied together all of the xenotype's genes' non-zero marketValueFactors. Now, we take various other stats into account: metabolism, complexity, archites, how many abilities the gene grants, stat bonuses, pain bonus, damage resist. All individually weighted with settings sliders.\n\nThe effect from each gene is also added together instead of multiplied. The cost of a xenotype shouldn't explode quite so easily anymore, but supremely powerful xenotypes will still be very expensive.
Rule.Translated: Cambia el modificador de coste de xenotipos del creador de plantillas de unidades. Antes multiplicaba todos los marketValueFactors distintos de cero de los genes del xenotipo. Ahora considera otras estadísticas: metabolismo, complejidad, architas, habilidades concedidas por el gen, bonificaciones de estadísticas, bonificación de dolor y resistencia al daño. Cada factor tiene un peso ajustable mediante controles deslizantes.\n\nAdemás, los efectos de cada gen se suman en vez de multiplicarse. El coste de un xenotipo ya no debería dispararse tan fácilmente, aunque los xenotipos extremadamente poderosos seguirán siendo muy caros.

Rule.Original: Some backend reorganization of the code. Player-facing functionality should not be affected.
Rule.Raw: Some backend reorganization of the code. Player-facing functionality should not be affected.
Rule.Translated: Reorganización interna del código. No debería afectar a las funciones visibles para el jugador.

Rule.Original: Some backend code changes to clean things up. User-facing functionality should not change.
Rule.Raw: Some backend code changes to clean things up. User-facing functionality should not change.
Rule.Translated: Cambios internos para ordenar el código. Las funciones visibles para el usuario no deberían cambiar.

Rule.Original: A polish and balance pass for prisoners.
Rule.Raw: A polish and balance pass for prisoners.
Rule.Translated: Mejoras y reajustes de equilibrio para los prisioneros.

Rule.Original: Hardens some of the checks in ResetNeeds to prevent weird modded races from throwing errors.
Rule.Raw: Hardens some of the checks in ResetNeeds to prevent weird modded races from throwing errors.
Rule.Translated: Refuerza comprobaciones de ResetNeeds para impedir que razas extrañas de otros mods provoquen errores.

Rule.Original: Makes more use of Def caching. Will this actually produce a notable performance improvement? I doubt it. But at least all our Def grabbing is in one place! ...Just, don't ever hot-reload your defs, please.
Rule.Raw: Makes more use of Def caching. Will this actually produce a notable performance improvement? I doubt it. But at least all our Def grabbing is in one place! ...Just, don't ever hot-reload your defs, please.
Rule.Translated: Utiliza más la caché de definiciones. ¿Mejorará perceptiblemente el rendimiento? Lo dudo. ¡Pero al menos todas las búsquedas de definiciones están en un único lugar! ...Por favor, no recarguéis las definiciones en caliente.
Corrección de compatibilidad con Vehicle Framework

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where joining a manual battle with a vehicle and never dismounting the pawns inside can result in both getting silently purged when the battle is over.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where joining a manual battle with a vehicle and never dismounting the pawns inside can result in both getting silently purged when the battle is over.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que entrar en una batalla manual con un vehículo sin hacer desmontar a los peones de su interior podía provocar la eliminación silenciosa de ambos al terminar.

Rule.Original: Adds some quality-of-life features to prisoner handling, and also a slight balance pass.
Rule.Raw: Adds some quality-of-life features to prisoner handling, and also a slight balance pass.
Rule.Translated: Añade mejoras de comodidad a la gestión de prisioneros y un pequeño reajuste de equilibrio.
Corrección del caso excepcional sin mapa

Rule.Original: Fixes an edge-case scenario where tax delivery would error out if the player has no active maps. Technically possible with caravans/nomadic playthroughs.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an edge-case scenario where tax delivery would error out if the player has no active maps. Technically possible with caravans/nomadic playthroughs.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un caso excepcional en el que la entrega de impuestos fallaba si el jugador no tenía mapas activos. Esto puede ocurrir en partidas con caravanas o de estilo nómada.

Rule.Original: Adds a mod option to scale the silver cost of event options, just in case the values are too low (or high) for your liking.
Rule.Raw: Adds a mod option to scale the silver cost of event options, just in case the values are too low (or high) for your liking.
Rule.Translated: Añade una opción del mod para ajustar el coste en plata de las opciones de eventos, por si los valores te parecen demasiado bajos o altos.

Rule.Original: Various tweaks and edits to random events.
Rule.Raw: Various tweaks and edits to random events.
Rule.Translated: Varios ajustes y modificaciones de los eventos aleatorios.

Rule.Original: Before, the strength of a settlement's defending force was snapshot at the moment a warning letter is sent, and that snapshot is carried forward into the battle. This means that any changes to military level or combat efficiency during the warning window wouldn't actually apply to the coming battle.\n\nThis update changes that. Now, the defending force's strength is recalculated at battle start.
Rule.Raw: Before, the strength of a settlement's defending force was snapshot at the moment a warning letter is sent, and that snapshot is carried forward into the battle. This means that any changes to military level or combat efficiency during the warning window wouldn't actually apply to the coming battle.\n\nThis update changes that. Now, the defending force's strength is recalculated at battle start.
Rule.Translated: Antes, la fuerza defensiva de un asentamiento se fijaba al enviar la carta de advertencia y ese valor se mantenía hasta la batalla. Por tanto, los cambios de nivel militar o eficiencia de combate durante el periodo de aviso no se aplicaban a la batalla posterior.\n\nEsta actualización lo cambia. Ahora la fuerza defensiva se recalcula al comenzar la batalla.

Rule.Original: A broad balance pass to make events harder to cheese: when an event has options, the game auto-pauses and can't be unpaused or saved until an option is chosen. Additionally, the base cost of event options now scales by the number of settlements affected, among other things.
Rule.Raw: A broad balance pass to make events harder to cheese: when an event has options, the game auto-pauses and can't be unpaused or saved until an option is chosen. Additionally, the base cost of event options now scales by the number of settlements affected, among other things.
Rule.Translated: Reajuste general de equilibrio para dificultar los abusos en eventos: cuando un evento tiene opciones, el juego se pausa automáticamente y no puede reanudarse ni guardarse hasta elegir una. Además, el coste base de las opciones ahora depende, entre otros factores, del número de asentamientos afectados.

Rule.Original: Fix for pawn generation in battles
Rule.Raw: Fix for pawn generation in battles
Rule.Translated: Corrección de la generación de personajes en batallas

Rule.Original: Adds protection against failed GeneratePawn calls fouling up the map generation for a manual defense battle, which would then crash the game.
Rule.Raw: Adds protection against failed GeneratePawn calls fouling up the map generation for a manual defense battle, which would then crash the game.
Rule.Translated: Añade protección frente a llamadas fallidas a GeneratePawn que podían estropear la generación del mapa de una batalla de defensa manual y bloquear el juego.
Sin hostiles de un 3.er bando en defensa manual

Rule.Original: When generating a manual defense battle, we now loop through all things and destroy any that are hostile to the player. This loop runs before adding hostiles, and is necessary to clean the map of third-party hostiles such as if the settlement was founded on a Launch Point landmark.
Rule.Raw: When generating a manual defense battle, we now loop through all things and destroy any that are hostile to the player. This loop runs before adding hostiles, and is necessary to clean the map of third-party hostiles such as if the settlement was founded on a Launch Point landmark.
Rule.Translated: Al generar una batalla de defensa manual, ahora recorremos todos los objetos y destruimos los hostiles al jugador. Esto ocurre antes de añadir a los enemigos y es necesario para limpiar el mapa de enemigos ajenos a la batalla, por ejemplo, si el asentamiento se fundó en un punto de interés de lanzamiento.

Rule.Original: Update the choose-a-defender dialog to be able to handle defenders from other mods (such as the eventual Vanilla Outposts Expanded compat patch).
Rule.Raw: Update the choose-a-defender dialog to be able to handle defenders from other mods (such as the eventual Vanilla Outposts Expanded compat patch).
Rule.Translated: Actualiza el diálogo de selección de defensores para admitir defensores de otros mods, como el futuro parche de compatibilidad con Vanilla Outposts Expanded.

Rule.Original: Updates IRaidTarget to use PlanetTile instead of int.
Rule.Raw: Updates IRaidTarget to use PlanetTile instead of int.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza IRaidTarget para utilizar PlanetTile en lugar de int.

Rule.Original: Changes some of the Tick functions to exclude comps that don't tick. This has an actual (albeit small) performance improvement for as "few" as 20-30 Empire Settlements.
Rule.Raw: Changes some of the Tick functions to exclude comps that don't tick. This has an actual (albeit small) performance improvement for as "few" as 20-30 Empire Settlements.
Rule.Translated: Cambia algunas funciones Tick para excluir componentes que no ejecutan ciclos. Esto mejora realmente el rendimiento, aunque sea poco, a partir de «solo» 20-30 asentamientos del Imperio.

Rule.Original: Changes the list of pack animals to be the list of animals that are allowed in at least one biome's allowedPackAnimals list. Further, the number of biomes that a pack animal supports is shown in their Pack badge on the animal filter. And if the player doesn't select any pack animals that support the biome they're playing in, then the filter will warn them that they won't receive any Empire trading caravans.
Rule.Raw: Changes the list of pack animals to be the list of animals that are allowed in at least one biome's allowedPackAnimals list. Further, the number of biomes that a pack animal supports is shown in their Pack badge on the animal filter. And if the player doesn't select any pack animals that support the biome they're playing in, then the filter will warn them that they won't receive any Empire trading caravans.
Rule.Translated: Cambia la lista de animales de carga para incluir los permitidos en la lista allowedPackAnimals de al menos un bioma. Además, su indicador de carga en el filtro muestra el número de biomas compatibles. Si el jugador no selecciona animales de carga compatibles con el bioma donde juega, el filtro advertirá que no recibirá caravanas comerciales del Imperio.

Rule.Original: Adds official support for the biomes from Biomes! Caverns.
Rule.Raw: Adds official support for the biomes from Biomes! Caverns.
Rule.Translated: Añade compatibilidad oficial con los biomas de Biomes! Caverns.

Rule.Original: Adds the ability to set a military unit's inventory and implants.
Rule.Raw: Adds the ability to set a military unit's inventory and implants.
Rule.Translated: Permite establecer el inventario y los implantes de una unidad militar.

Rule.Original: Changes how the Empire faction's ideology is assigned on creation. It now only has the player's primary ideology, instead of all of the player's ideologies.
Rule.Raw: Changes how the Empire faction's ideology is assigned on creation. It now only has the player's primary ideology, instead of all of the player's ideologies.
Rule.Translated: Cambia la asignación de la ideología de la facción del Imperio al crearla. Ahora solo utiliza la ideología principal del jugador, en vez de todas sus ideologías.

Rule.Original: Adds numerous new stat modifiers for buildings, policies, and other things to interact with Empire's systems. The design space should open up a good bit!
Rule.Raw: Adds numerous new stat modifiers for buildings, policies, and other things to interact with Empire's systems. The design space should open up a good bit!

Rule.Raw: Updates the Biomes! Caverns compat patch.

Rule.Raw: Updates the Japanese translation, courtesy of PhenylPropion.

Rule.Raw: Mercs Update: Psycasts, Mechs, and Animals, oh my

Rule.Raw: Changes the list of items that mercs are allowed to carry in their inventory. The new calculation is more permissive, which *should* (ideally) mean fewer necessary compatibility patches with other mods.

Rule.Raw: A few minor bits of code cleanup.
Rule.Translated: Pequeñas tareas de limpieza del código.

Rule.Original: A handful of backend updates to help cleanup the code a bit.
Rule.Raw: A handful of backend updates to help cleanup the code a bit.
Rule.Translated: Actualizaciones internas para ordenar un poco el código.

Rule.Original: Reworks how resource production is calculated and displayed. All values are now calculated in per-day increments, added up each day before being disbursed on the tax tick. The net income should be the same, but the affect of mid-cycle production differences should be more obvious than the old average-of-daily-snapshots system.\n\nAlso, tithing has been slightly reworked. The tithes list is now a priority list of items. You can list more items than your settlement can afford, and when the tax tick comes, you will be sent the first N items that fit within the tithe limit.
Rule.Raw: Reworks how resource production is calculated and displayed. All values are now calculated in per-day increments, added up each day before being disbursed on the tax tick. The net income should be the same, but the affect of mid-cycle production differences should be more obvious than the old average-of-daily-snapshots system.\n\nAlso, tithing has been slightly reworked. The tithes list is now a priority list of items. You can list more items than your settlement can afford, and when the tax tick comes, you will be sent the first N items that fit within the tithe limit.
Rule.Translated: Rediseña el cálculo y la visualización de la producción de recursos. Todos los valores se calculan ahora por día y se acumulan diariamente antes de entregarse en el ciclo de impuestos. Los ingresos netos deberían ser iguales, pero los cambios de producción a mitad del ciclo deberían resultar más claros que con el antiguo sistema de medias de valores diarios.\n\nTambién cambia ligeramente el diezmo. Su lista ahora es una lista de objetos por prioridad. Puedes incluir más de los que pueda pagar el asentamiento y, cuando llegue el ciclo de impuestos, recibirás los primeros N objetos que quepan dentro del límite de diezmo.

Rule.Original: Adds Situations, shamelessly stolen from - er, inspired by - Stellaris. Situations feature a meter that can tick up or down over time, as well as the opportunity for the player to pick one of several 'approaches' to influence how the Situation resolves.\n\nThis initial implementation is a rough first pass. It needs further UI work, and to also be more featureful in general (not to mention it needs actual Situations to be used with).
Rule.Raw: Adds Situations, shamelessly stolen from - er, inspired by - Stellaris.
