Situations feature a meter that can tick up or down over time, as well as the opportunity for the player to pick one of several 'approaches' to influence how the Situation resolves.\n\nThis initial implementation is a rough first pass. It needs further UI work, and to also be more featureful in general (not to mention it needs actual Situations to be used with).
Rule.Translated: Añade situaciones, descaradamente robadas de... ejem, inspiradas en Stellaris. Incluyen un indicador que puede subir o bajar con el tiempo y permiten al jugador elegir entre varios «enfoques» para influir en su desenlace.\n\nEsta implementación inicial es una primera aproximación. Necesita más trabajo de interfaz y más funciones en general, además de situaciones reales con las que utilizarla.

Rule.Original: A variety of minor bugfixes, changes, and features.
Rule.Raw: A variety of minor bugfixes, changes, and features.
Rule.Translated: Varias correcciones menores de errores, cambios y funciones.
Actualización de la traducción al español
Añade una traducción al español actualizada.

Rule.Original: Adds the ability to hire laborers, mimicing the system used by the Royalty DLC's Call Laborers permit. As this mimics a Royalty feature, it is locked behind access to the Royalty DLC, per Ludeon's modding policy.
Rule.Raw: Adds the ability to hire laborers, mimicing the system used by the Royalty DLC's Call Laborers permit. As this mimics a Royalty feature, it is locked behind access to the Royalty DLC, per Ludeon's modding policy.
Rule.Translated: Permite contratar trabajadores, imitando el permiso de solicitar trabajadores del DLC Royalty. Al reproducir una función de Royalty, exige tener acceso a ese DLC, según la política de mods de Ludeon.

Rule.Original: Adds manual offense battles! With this, you should now be able to run all Empire battles manually!
Rule.Raw: Adds manual offense battles! With this, you should now be able to run all Empire battles manually!
Rule.Translated: ¡Añade batallas ofensivas manuales! ¡Ahora deberías poder librar manualmente todas las batallas de Empire!

Rule.Original: A handful of small fixes and performance improvements.
Rule.Raw: A handful of small fixes and performance improvements.
Rule.Translated: Pequeñas correcciones y mejoras de rendimiento.

Rule.Original: Numerous fixes for features new and old.
Rule.Raw: Numerous fixes for features new and old.
Rule.Translated: Numerosas correcciones de funciones nuevas y antiguas.
Corrección de errores de ofensivas manuales

Rule.Original: Fixes a bug with manual offense battles.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a bug with manual offense battles.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un error de las batallas ofensivas manuales.

Rule.Original: Final wave of fixes before the workshop release of Empire Refactored 1.6.
Rule.Raw: Final wave of fixes before the workshop release of Empire Refactored 1.6.
Rule.Translated: Última tanda de correcciones antes de publicar Empire Refactored 1.6 en Workshop.

Rule.Original: An events bugfix and minor tweak.
Rule.Raw: An events bugfix and minor tweak.
Rule.Translated: Corrección de un error de eventos y pequeño ajuste.
Actualizaciones diarias del coste de trabajadores

Rule.Original: Updates the workerBaseCost stat on many policies and buildings to actually respect the new Daily Cadence.
Rule.Raw: Updates the workerBaseCost stat on many policies and buildings to actually respect the new Daily Cadence.
Rule.Translated: Actualiza la estadística workerBaseCost de muchas políticas y edificios para respetar el nuevo ritmo diario.
Corrección de errores de mercancías de prisioneros

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue with items disappearing when delivering prisoners to settlements.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue with items disappearing when delivering prisoners to settlements.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que desaparecían objetos al entregar prisioneros a asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where low-tech empires with HAR races might general naked pawns due to lacking apparel selection.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where low-tech empires with HAR races might general naked pawns due to lacking apparel selection.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que imperios de baja tecnología con razas HAR podían generar peones desnudos por falta de opciones de ropa.

Rule.Original: A couple changes in regards to pawn nudity.
Rule.Raw: A couple changes in regards to pawn nudity.
Rule.Translated: Varios cambios relacionados con la desnudez de los peones.

Rule.Original: Fixes a couple of issues with cross-planet layer distance calculation.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a couple of issues with cross-planet layer distance calculation.
Rule.Translated: Corrige problemas en el cálculo de distancias entre capas planetarias.

Rule.Original: A small fix for Empire world pawns. Largely unused by Empire Refactored itself, but relevant for some submods.
Rule.Raw: A small fix for Empire world pawns. Largely unused by Empire Refactored itself, but relevant for some submods.
Rule.Translated: Pequeña corrección para los peones del mundo de Empire. Empire Refactored apenas los utiliza, pero son relevantes para algunos submods.

Rule.Original: A couple of changes to make research points less annoying to have once you've researched everything.
Rule.Raw: A couple of changes to make research points less annoying to have once you've researched everything.
Rule.Translated: Varios cambios para que los puntos de investigación resulten menos molestos cuando ya has investigado todo.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where pool resources wouldn't be shown as accruing in the production UI, even though they do.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where pool resources wouldn't be shown as accruing in the production UI, even though they do.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que la interfaz de producción no mostraba la acumulación de recursos comunes, aunque sí se acumulaban.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where the Wattage generated by Empire's power generator is *always* x100 of the produced power. This is a violation of how *every* other resource works in the mod, and frankly ought to have been fixed months ago. The recent daily cadence update merely made the bug more obvious.\n\nPlayers on higher diffculties are likely to notice a drastic drop in power generation. This is intentional; power production should never have been so high.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where the Wattage generated by Empire's power generator is *always* x100 of the produced power. This is a violation of how *every* other resource works in the mod, and frankly ought to have been fixed months ago. The recent daily cadence update merely made the bug more obvious.\n\nPlayers on higher diffculties are likely to notice a drastic drop in power generation. This is intentional; power production should never have been so high.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que la potencia en vatios del generador de Empire era *siempre* x100 la energía producida. Esto contradice el funcionamiento de *todos* los demás recursos del mod y debería haberse corregido hace meses. La reciente actualización del ritmo diario solo hizo más evidente el error.\n\nLos jugadores en dificultades altas probablemente notarán una reducción drástica de la generación eléctrica. Es intencionado: la producción nunca debió ser tan alta.

Rule.Original: A couple fixes for manual battle issues.
Rule.Raw: A couple fixes for manual battle issues.
Rule.Translated: Correcciones de problemas de las batallas manuales.

Rule.Original: Settlements with a shuttle port always send their deliveries via shuttle (if both Royalty and the settings option are enabled). If the shuttle repeatedly can't find a landing location, though, then the deliveries will never actually go through. This update provides a small fix for that.
Rule.Raw: Settlements with a shuttle port always send their deliveries via shuttle (if both Royalty and the settings option are enabled). If the shuttle repeatedly can't find a landing location, though, then the deliveries will never actually go through. This update provides a small fix for that.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos con puerto de lanzaderas siempre envían sus entregas mediante lanzadera si Royalty y la opción correspondiente están activos. Sin embargo, si la lanzadera no encuentra repetidamente un lugar de aterrizaje, las entregas nunca llegan. Esta actualización lo corrige ligeramente.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where the battle log would display the name of the defending squad's home settlement, rather than the actual settlement that's under attack.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where the battle log would display the name of the defending squad's home settlement, rather than the actual settlement that's under attack.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que el registro de batallas mostraba el nombre del asentamiento de origen de la escuadra defensora en vez del asentamiento realmente atacado.
Corrección de compatibilidad con acidificadores de cadáveres

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue with merc hires being broken by mods that disable or remove the Death Acidifier.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue with merc hires being broken by mods that disable or remove the Death Acidifier.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que los mods que desactivan o eliminan el acidificador de muerte impedían contratar mercenarios.

Rule.Original: Previously, if a xenotype had *any* of shooting accuracy < 50%, melee hit chance < 50%, or melee dodge chance < 50%, then it would be classified as 'non-violent', and barred from use in the unit creator.\n\nThis patch changes the logic so that all three must be true for a xenotype to be classified as 'non-violent'. So now you can have merc units that are incapable of dodging, or shit at shooting, but still capable in the other two stats.
Rule.Raw: Previously, if a xenotype had *any* of shooting accuracy < 50%, melee hit chance < 50%, or melee dodge chance < 50%, then it would be classified as 'non-violent', and barred from use in the unit creator.\n\nThis patch changes the logic so that all three must be true for a xenotype to be classified as 'non-violent'. So now you can have merc units that are incapable of dodging, or shit at shooting, but still capable in the other two stats.
Rule.Translated: Antes, un xenotipo se consideraba «no violento» y quedaba excluido del creador de unidades si tenía *cualquiera* de estas estadísticas: precisión de tiro < 50%, probabilidad de impacto cuerpo a cuerpo < 50% o probabilidad de esquiva cuerpo a cuerpo < 50%.\n\nEste parche cambia la lógica para exigir las tres condiciones a la vez. Ahora puedes tener unidades mercenarias incapaces de esquivar o pésimas disparando, pero competentes en las otras dos estadísticas.

Rule.Original: Change a few hard-coded strings to use translation keys instead, particularly in the Tile Field Resource Production Extension.
Rule.Raw: Change a few hard-coded strings to use translation keys instead, particularly in the Tile Field Resource Production Extension.
Rule.Translated: Sustituye varias cadenas de texto fijas por claves de traducción, especialmente en Tile Field Resource Production Extension.

Rule.Original: Fixes a bug where merc units wouldn't spawn if they have no equipped apparel or weapons.
Rule.Raw: Fixes a bug where merc units wouldn't spawn if they have no equipped apparel or weapons.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un error por el que las unidades mercenarias no aparecían si no llevaban ropa ni armas equipadas.
Actualización de compatibilidad con Medieval Overhaul

Rule.Original: Allows manufactured textiles to be selected as materials for mercenary gear when Medieval Overhaul is enabled.
Rule.Raw: Allows manufactured textiles to be selected as materials for mercenary gear when Medieval Overhaul is enabled.
Rule.Translated: Permite seleccionar tejidos manufacturados como materiales para el equipo mercenario cuando Medieval Overhaul está activo.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where prisoners generated from a battle victory would be generated with the Empire faction, rather than the faction of the enemy settlement. This results in Empire trying to generate a xenotype of the Empire faction, rather than the enemy faction.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where prisoners generated from a battle victory would be generated with the Empire faction, rather than the faction of the enemy settlement. This results in Empire trying to generate a xenotype of the Empire faction, rather than the enemy faction.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que los prisioneros generados tras una victoria pertenecían a la facción del Imperio en vez de a la del asentamiento enemigo. Esto hacía que Empire generase un xenotipo de su propia facción en vez de uno de la facción enemiga.

Rule.Original: Empire is coded defensively when it comes to settlement destruction, in that it prevents the actual destruction unless Empire does it itself. It's a bit *too* jealous in its defense, though, causing errors when RimWorld itself tries to clean up a corrupted settlement.\n\nIt shouldn't be possible to hit this issue through legitimate play, but a hole is a hole. This patch makes the destroy handling a little more robust.
Rule.Raw: Empire is coded defensively when it comes to settlement destruction, in that it prevents the actual destruction unless Empire does it itself. It's a bit *too* jealous in its defense, though, causing errors when RimWorld itself tries to clean up a corrupted settlement.\n\nIt shouldn't be possible to hit this issue through legitimate play, but a hole is a hole. This patch makes the destroy handling a little more robust.
Rule.Translated: Empire protege la destrucción de asentamientos impidiendo que se destruyan salvo que lo haga el propio mod. Pero su protección es demasiado celosa y provoca errores cuando RimWorld intenta eliminar un asentamiento corrupto.\n\nEste problema no debería ocurrir jugando normalmente, pero sigue siendo una vulnerabilidad. El parche mejora la fiabilidad de la gestión de destrucción.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where a non-raze manual offense battle could still result in the enemy settlement being destroyed.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where a non-raze manual offense battle could still result in the enemy settlement being destroyed.
Rule.Translated: Corrige un problema por el que una batalla ofensiva manual sin arrasamiento podía destruir igualmente el asentamiento enemigo.
Asentamientos atascados en modo de ataque

Rule.Original: Settlements sometimes get stuck in 'under attack' mode, preventing upgrades, building buildings, and using their military. The full cause of this error eludes me, so this update hardens the stuck-settlement check to make it better at catching said stuck settlements and restoring them to a working state.
Rule.Raw: Settlements sometimes get stuck in 'under attack' mode, preventing upgrades, building buildings, and using their military. The full cause of this error eludes me, so this update hardens the stuck-settlement check to make it better at catching said stuck settlements and restoring them to a working state.
Rule.Translated: A veces los asentamientos se atascan en el estado de «bajo ataque», impidiendo mejorarlos, construir edificios o utilizar sus fuerzas militares. No conozco la causa completa del error, por lo que esta actualización refuerza la comprobación de asentamientos atascados para detectarlos mejor y restaurar su funcionamiento.

Rule.Original: Settlements prioritize fortifying infrastructure. Defenders fight cautiously to protect buildings.
Rule.Raw: Settlements prioritize fortifying infrastructure. Defenders fight cautiously to protect buildings.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos priorizan fortificar la infraestructura. Los defensores luchan con cautela para proteger los edificios.

Rule.Original: Settlements commit everything to repelling attackers. Higher chance of victory, but infrastructure suffers in the chaos.
Rule.Raw: Settlements commit everything to repelling attackers. Higher chance of victory, but infrastructure suffers in the chaos.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos lo dan todo por repeler a los atacantes. Mayor probabilidad de victoria, pero la infraestructura sufre en el caos.

Rule.Original: Your forces fight with total disregard for collateral damage. Even victories leave the settlement scarred.
Rule.Raw: Your forces fight with total disregard for collateral damage. Even victories leave the settlement scarred.
Rule.Translated: Tus fuerzas luchan con total desprecio por los daños colaterales. Incluso las victorias dejan el asentamiento marcado.

Rule.Original: Every able body is on the walls. Massive combat power, but morale suffers and defeat is catastrophic.
Rule.Raw: Every able body is on the walls. Massive combat power, but morale suffers and defeat is catastrophic.
Rule.Translated: Todo cuerpo capaz está en las murallas. Poder de combate masivo, pero la moral sufre y la derrota es catastrófica.

Rule.Original: A militaristic society, one who seeks glory in blood and death for their cause.
Rule.Raw: A militaristic society, one who seeks glory in blood and death for their cause.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad militarista, que busca la gloria en la sangre y la muerte por su causa.

Rule.Original: A pacifist society that seeks to avoid conflict when and where possible.
Rule.Raw: A pacifist society that seeks to avoid conflict when and where possible.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad pacifista que busca evitar el conflicto siempre que es posible.

Rule.Original: An authoritarian society that seeks to hold control over its members by whatever means necessary.
Rule.Raw: An authoritarian society that seeks to hold control over its members by whatever means necessary.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad autoritaria que busca mantener el control sobre sus miembros por todos los medios necesarios.

Rule.Original: An egalitarian society is one that seeks equality amongst all.
Rule.Raw: An egalitarian society is one that seeks equality amongst all.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad igualitaria es aquella que busca la igualdad entre todos.

Rule.Original: An isolationist society is one that seeks to stay reclusive amongst the world's politics and interactions.
Rule.Raw: An isolationist society is one that seeks to stay reclusive amongst the world's politics and interactions.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad aislacionista es aquella que busca permanecer recluida de la política y las interacciones del mundo.

Rule.Original: An expansionist society is one that seeks to spread their glory across the entirety of the realm.
Rule.Raw: An expansionist society is one that seeks to spread their glory across the entirety of the realm.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad expansionista es aquella que busca extender su gloria por todo el reino.

Rule.Original: A technocratic society is one that seeks the furthering of knowledge and continuous improvement.
Rule.Raw: A technocratic society is one that seeks the furthering of knowledge and continuous improvement.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad tecnocrática es aquella que busca el avance del conocimiento y la mejora continua.

Rule.Original: A feudal society is one that supports a feudal contract, binding the society to a liege in return for protection.
Rule.Raw: A feudal society is one that supports a feudal contract, binding the society to a liege in return for protection.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad feudal es aquella que sostiene un contrato feudal, vinculando a la sociedad a un señor a cambio de protección.

Rule.Original: A Society that focuses on Slavery
Rule.Raw: A Society that focuses on Slavery
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad centrada en la esclavitud.

Rule.Original: A large number of the populace is conscripted into the settlement's military forces.
Rule.Raw: A large number of the populace is conscripted into the settlement's military forces.
Rule.Translated: Una gran parte de la población es reclutada en las fuerzas militares del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The military force of your settlements is by volunteers only.
Rule.Raw: The military force of your settlements is by volunteers only.
Rule.Translated: La fuerza militar de tus asentamientos es solo de voluntarios.

Rule.Original: There is very little, if any trained military forces in the faction.
Rule.Raw: There is very little, if any trained military forces in the faction.
Rule.Translated: Hay muy pocas fuerzas militares entrenadas en la facción, si es que las hay.

Rule.Original: The majority of your settlements' military forces is comprised of slaves or those in forced servitude.
Rule.Raw: The majority of your settlements' military forces is comprised of slaves or those in forced servitude.
Rule.Translated: La mayoría de las fuerzas militares de tus asentamientos está compuesta por esclavos o personas en servidumbre forzada.

Rule.Original: Click here to enact this policy.
Rule.Raw: Click here to enact this policy.
Rule.Translated: Haz clic aquí para promulgar esta política.

Rule.Original: A society united by common cause holds the strongest of wills for the hardest duties.
Rule.Raw: A society united by common cause holds the strongest of wills for the hardest duties.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad unida por una causa común posee la más fuerte de las voluntades para los deberes más duros.

Rule.Original: A diverse society has no unfilled cracks that could collapse itself.
Rule.Raw: A diverse society has no unfilled cracks that could collapse itself.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad diversa no tiene grietas sin rellenar que puedan derrumbarla.

Rule.Original: A society under the command of a royal family is unified in its traditions.
Rule.Raw: A society under the command of a royal family is unified in its traditions.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad bajo el mando de una familia real está unificada en sus tradiciones.

Rule.Original: A corporation that has struck out to create their own self-sufficient trade empire.
Rule.Raw: A corporation that has struck out to create their own self-sufficient trade empire.
Rule.Translated: Una corporación que se ha lanzado a crear su propio imperio comercial autosuficiente.

Rule.Original: A society in which those of power are those with the wealth to spend.
Rule.Raw: A society in which those of power are those with the wealth to spend.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad en la que quienes tienen el poder son quienes tienen la riqueza para gastar.

Rule.Original: A society that values knowledge and exploring the unknown.
Rule.Raw: A society that values knowledge and exploring the unknown.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad que valora el conocimiento y la exploración de lo desconocido.

Rule.Original: Collect less taxes from your settlements. This will make them happier and reduce unrest.
Rule.Raw: Collect less taxes from your settlements. This will make them happier and reduce unrest.
Rule.Translated: Cobra menos impuestos a tus asentamientos. Esto los hará más felices y reducirá el descontento.

Rule.Original: Increase the amount of taxes on your settlements at the cost of happiness and unrest.
Rule.Raw: Increase the amount of taxes on your settlements at the cost of happiness and unrest.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la cantidad de impuestos sobre tus asentamientos a costa de la felicidad y el descontento.

Rule.Original: Settlements prioritize sending physical goods over silver. Tithe budgets increase significantly, but silver income decreases.
Rule.Raw: Settlements prioritize sending physical goods over silver. Tithe budgets increase significantly, but silver income decreases.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos priorizan enviar bienes físicos en lugar de plata. Los presupuestos de diezmo aumentan significativamente, pero los ingresos de plata disminuyen.

Rule.Original: Settlements sell goods locally and remit coin instead. Silver income increases, but tithe budgets are reduced.
Rule.Raw: Settlements sell goods locally and remit coin instead. Silver income increases, but tithe budgets are reduced.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos venden los bienes localmente y remiten moneda en su lugar. Los ingresos de plata aumentan, pero los presupuestos de diezmo se reducen.

Rule.Original: An armorer in a nearby settlement has received a great inspiration and is seeking patrons for what he claims will be a work of unparalleled quality! He plans to give it to his patron as a token of his loyalty.
Rule.Raw: An armorer in a nearby settlement has received a great inspiration and is seeking patrons for what he claims will be a work of unparalleled quality! He plans to give it to his patron as a token of his loyalty.
Rule.Translated: ¡Un armero de un asentamiento cercano ha recibido una gran inspiración y busca mecenas para lo que afirma que será una obra de calidad sin parangón! Planea entregársela a su mecenas como muestra de su lealtad.

Rule.Original: I cannot spare the funds for such an endeavor.
Rule.Raw: I cannot spare the funds for such an endeavor.
Rule.Translated: No puedo destinar fondos a semejante proyecto.

Rule.Original: A modest bag of silver for a modest commission.
Rule.Raw: A modest bag of silver for a modest commission.
Rule.Translated: Una modesta bolsa de plata para un modesto encargo.

Rule.Original: Fund the masterwork! Spare no expense.
Rule.Raw: Fund the masterwork! Spare no expense.
Rule.Translated: ¡Financia la obra maestra! No escatimes en gastos.

Rule.Original: I'll provide workshop materials from our settlement stores.
Rule.Raw: I'll provide workshop materials from our settlement stores.
Rule.Translated: Proporcionaré materiales del taller de nuestros almacenes del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The armorer's ambition outpaced his skill. The result is serviceable, but far from the masterwork promised.
Rule.Raw: The armorer's ambition outpaced his skill. The result is serviceable, but far from the masterwork promised.
Rule.Translated: La ambición del armero superó su habilidad. El resultado es funcional, pero lejos de la obra maestra prometida.
Inspiración del fabricante de armaduras (obra maestra)

Rule.Original: After a few days of work, the armorer's inspiration has produced a true masterwork! The result exceeds all expectations.
Rule.Raw: After a few days of work, the armorer's inspiration has produced a true masterwork! The result exceeds all expectations.
Rule.Translated: Tras unos días de trabajo, ¡la inspiración del armero ha producido una verdadera obra maestra! El resultado supera todas las expectativas.

Rule.Original: After a few days of work, the armorer completes his commissioned piece. While "unparalleled quality" may have been an overstatement, the resulting armor is nonetheless quite acceptable.
Rule.Raw: After a few days of work, the armorer completes his commissioned piece. While "unparalleled quality" may have been an overstatement, the resulting armor is nonetheless quite acceptable.
Rule.Translated: Tras unos días de trabajo, el armero completa su pieza encargada. Aunque "calidad sin parangón" pueda haber sido una exageración, la armadura resultante es no obstante bastante aceptable.

Rule.Original: After several days of work, the armorer completes his commissioned piece. While no masterwork, the final product is nonetheless quite respectable.
Rule.Raw: After several days of work, the armorer completes his commissioned piece. While no masterwork, the final product is nonetheless quite respectable.
Rule.Translated: Tras varios días de trabajo, el armero completa su pieza encargada. Aunque no es una obra maestra, el producto final es no obstante bastante respetable.
Inspiración del fabricante de armaduras (en curso)

Rule.Original: The armorer is working on your commission...
Rule.Raw: The armorer is working on your commission...
Rule.Translated: El armero está trabajando en tu encargo...
Inspiración del fabricante de armaduras (en curso)

Rule.Original: The armorer is working on your commission...
Rule.Raw: The armorer is working on your commission...
Rule.Translated: El armero está trabajando en tu encargo...
Inspiración del fabricante de armaduras (en curso)

Rule.Original: The armorer is working on your commission...
Rule.Raw: The armorer is working on your commission...
Rule.Translated: El armero está trabajando en tu encargo...
Inspiración del fabricante de armaduras (materiales de taller)

Rule.Original: The armorer works with materials diverted from your settlement's production lines. The diversion slows apparel output, but the armorer's work proceeds well.
Rule.Raw: The armorer works with materials diverted from your settlement's production lines. The diversion slows apparel output, but the armorer's work proceeds well.
Rule.Translated: El armero trabaja con materiales desviados de las líneas de producción de tu asentamiento. El desvío ralentiza la producción de ropa, pero el trabajo del armero avanza bien.

Rule.Original: A blacksmith in a nearby settlement has received a great inspiration and is seeking patrons for what she claims will be a work of unparalleled quality! She plans to give it to her patron as a token of her loyalty.
Rule.Raw: A blacksmith in a nearby settlement has received a great inspiration and is seeking patrons for what she claims will be a work of unparalleled quality! She plans to give it to her patron as a token of her loyalty.
Rule.Translated: ¡Una herrera de un asentamiento cercano ha recibido una gran inspiración y busca mecenas para lo que afirma que será una obra de calidad sin parangón! Planea entregársela a su mecenas como muestra de su lealtad.

Rule.Original: I cannot spare the funds for such an endeavor.
Rule.Raw: I cannot spare the funds for such an endeavor.
Rule.Translated: No puedo destinar fondos a semejante proyecto.

Rule.Original: A modest bag of silver for a modest commission.
Rule.Raw: A modest bag of silver for a modest commission.
Rule.Translated: Una modesta bolsa de plata para un modesto encargo.

Rule.Original: Fund the masterwork! Spare no expense.
Rule.Raw: Fund the masterwork! Spare no expense.
Rule.Translated: ¡Financia la obra maestra! No escatimes en gastos.

Rule.Original: I'll provide workshop materials from our settlement stores.
Rule.Raw: I'll provide workshop materials from our settlement stores.
Rule.Translated: Proporcionaré materiales del taller de nuestros almacenes del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The blacksmith is working on your commission...
Rule.Raw: The blacksmith is working on your commission...
Rule.Translated: La herrera está trabajando en tu encargo...

Rule.Original: After a few days of work, the blacksmith completes her commissioned piece. While "unparalleled quality" may have been an overstatement, the resulting weapon is nonetheless quite acceptable.
Rule.Raw: After a few days of work, the blacksmith completes her commissioned piece. While "unparalleled quality" may have been an overstatement, the resulting weapon is nonetheless quite acceptable.
Rule.Translated: Tras unos días de trabajo, la herrera completa su pieza encargada. Aunque "calidad sin parangón" pueda haber sido una exageración, el arma resultante es no obstante bastante aceptable.

Rule.Original: The blacksmith is working on your commission...
Rule.Raw: The blacksmith is working on your commission...
Rule.Translated: La herrera está trabajando en tu encargo...

Rule.Original: The blacksmith is working on your commission...
Rule.Raw: The blacksmith is working on your commission...
Rule.Translated: La herrera está trabajando en tu encargo...

Rule.Original: The blacksmith's inspiration has produced a true masterwork! The result exceeds all expectations.
Rule.Raw: The blacksmith's inspiration has produced a true masterwork! The result exceeds all expectations.
Rule.Translated: ¡La inspiración de la herrera ha producido una verdadera obra maestra! El resultado supera todas las expectativas.

Rule.Original: The blacksmith works with materials diverted from your settlement's production lines. The diversion slows weapons output, but the blacksmith's work proceeds well.
Rule.Raw: The blacksmith works with materials diverted from your settlement's production lines. The diversion slows weapons output, but the blacksmith's work proceeds well.
Rule.Translated: La herrera trabaja con materiales desviados de las líneas de producción de tu asentamiento. El desvío ralentiza la producción de armas, pero el trabajo de la herrera avanza bien.

Rule.Original: After several days of work, the blacksmith completes her commissioned piece. While no masterwork, the final product is nonetheless quite respectable.
Rule.Raw: After several days of work, the blacksmith completes her commissioned piece. While no masterwork, the final product is nonetheless quite respectable.
Rule.Translated: Tras varios días de trabajo, la herrera completa su pieza encargada. Aunque no es una obra maestra, el producto final es no obstante bastante respetable.

Rule.Original: The blacksmith's ambition outpaced her skill. The result is serviceable, but far from the masterwork promised.
Rule.Raw: The blacksmith's ambition outpaced her skill. The result is serviceable, but far from the masterwork promised.
Rule.Translated: La ambición de la herrera superó su habilidad. El resultado es funcional, pero lejos de la obra maestra prometida.

Rule.Original: A figure of high-importance and connection to your capital in a settlement has been assassinated. Some people on the streets are spreading that it was you who caused their death. How will you respond?
Rule.Raw: A figure of high-importance and connection to your capital in a settlement has been assassinated. Some people on the streets are spreading that it was you who caused their death. How will you respond?
Rule.Translated: Una figura de gran importancia y conexión con tu capital en un asentamiento ha sido asesinada. Algunas personas en las calles difunden que fuiste tú quien causó su muerte. ¿Cómo responderás?

Rule.Original: We'll mourn in private. Time will heal this wound.
Rule.Raw: We'll mourn in private. Time will heal this wound.
Rule.Translated: Guardaremos luto en privado. El tiempo curará esta herida.

Rule.Original: Hold a public memorial to honor their legacy.
Rule.Raw: Hold a public memorial to honor their legacy.
Rule.Translated: Celebra un homenaje público para honrar su legado.

Rule.Original: Investigate the assassination — someone will answer for this.
Rule.Raw: Investigate the assassination — someone will answer for this.
Rule.Translated: Investiga el asesinato: alguien responderá por esto.

Rule.Original: The investigation uncovers the assassin and brings them to justice. Conclusive results absolve you of guilt in the people's eyes, allowing them to properly focus on mourning the fallen figure — a process made all the easier by the catharsis of finding the killer.
Rule.Raw: The investigation uncovers the assassin and brings them to justice. Conclusive results absolve you of guilt in the people's eyes, allowing them to properly focus on mourning the fallen figure — a process made all the easier by the catharsis of finding the killer.
Rule.Translated: La investigación descubre al asesino y lo lleva ante la justicia. Los resultados concluyentes te absuelven de culpa a ojos del pueblo, permitiéndoles centrarse debidamente en llorar a la figura caída, un proceso facilitado por la catarsis de encontrar al asesino.

Rule.Original: The investigation turns up nothing and only fuels the rumors that you were behind the assassination. The people grow restless.
Rule.Raw: The investigation turns up nothing and only fuels the rumors that you were behind the assassination. The people grow restless.
Rule.Translated: La investigación no encuentra nada y solo alimenta los rumores de que estabas detrás del asesinato. El pueblo se inquieta.

Rule.Original:
The settlements mourn in private. The grief weighs heavily on the people.
Refusing to acknowledge the rumors allows them to fester, however. Amidst the grief, people continue to speculate on your involvement...
Rule.Raw:
The settlements mourn in private. The grief weighs heavily on the people.
Refusing to acknowledge the rumors allows them to fester, however. Amidst the grief, people continue to speculate on your involvement...
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos guardan luto en privado. El dolor pesa mucho sobre la gente.\n\nNegarse a reconocer los rumores, sin embargo, permite que se enconen. En medio del dolor, la gente sigue especulando sobre tu implicación...

Rule.Original: A public memorial is held, honoring the fallen figure's legacy. The gesture helps ease the grief, and allays concerns that you were involved in their death.
Rule.Raw: A public memorial is held, honoring the fallen figure's legacy. The gesture helps ease the grief, and allays concerns that you were involved in their death.
Rule.Translated: Se celebra un homenaje público en honor al legado de la figura caída. El gesto ayuda a aliviar el dolor y calma las inquietudes sobre tu implicación en su muerte.

Rule.Original:
The announcement of the investigation sweeps aside most rumors of your involvement — but many still choose to reserve judgement until the investigation concludes.
In the meantime, your settlements continue to grieve.
Rule.Raw:
The announcement of the investigation sweeps aside most rumors of your involvement — but many still choose to reserve judgement until the investigation concludes.
In the meantime, your settlements continue to grieve.
Rule.Translated: El anuncio de la investigación disipa la mayoría de los rumores sobre tu implicación, pero muchos aún prefieren reservar su juicio hasta que concluya la investigación.\n\nMientras tanto, tus asentamientos siguen de luto.

Rule.Original:
The announcement of the investigation sweeps aside most rumors of your involvement — but many still choose to reserve judgement until the investigation concludes.
In the meantime, your settlements continue to grieve.
Rule.Raw:
The announcement of the investigation sweeps aside most rumors of your involvement — but many still choose to reserve judgement until the investigation concludes.
In the meantime, your settlements continue to grieve.
Rule.Translated: El anuncio de la investigación disipa la mayoría de los rumores sobre tu implicación, pero muchos aún prefieren reservar su juicio hasta que concluya la investigación.\n\nMientras tanto, tus asentamientos siguen de luto.

Rule.Original: There is a great amount of animals roaming the region. How should your settlements take advantage?
Rule.Raw: There is a great amount of animals roaming the region. How should your settlements take advantage?
Rule.Translated: Hay una gran cantidad de animales vagando por la región. ¿Cómo deberían aprovecharlo tus asentamientos?

Rule.Original: Let the herds flourish and boost our animal production.
Rule.Raw: Let the herds flourish and boost our animal production.
Rule.Translated: Deja que las manadas prosperen y aumenten nuestra producción animal.

Rule.Original: Organize a grand hunt and bring back the spoils.
Rule.Raw: Organize a grand hunt and bring back the spoils.
Rule.Translated: Organiza una gran cacería y trae sus frutos.

Rule.Original: Capture and domesticate what we can for long-term gains.
Rule.Raw: Capture and domesticate what we can for long-term gains.
Rule.Translated: Captura y domestica lo que podamos para obtener beneficios a largo plazo.

Rule.Original: Establish a sanctuary. These creatures are people too, and they share this world with us.
Rule.Raw: Establish a sanctuary. These creatures are people too, and they share this world with us.
Rule.Translated: Crea un santuario. Estas criaturas también son personas y comparten este mundo con nosotros.

Rule.Original: The herds flourish and boost animal production.
Rule.Raw: The herds flourish and boost animal production.
Rule.Translated: Las manadas prosperan e impulsan la producción animal.

Rule.Original: A grand hunt is organized. Hunters join from across {FACTION}, eager to hone their skills with this opportunity.
Rule.Raw: A grand hunt is organized. Hunters join from across {FACTION}, eager to hone their skills with this opportunity.
Rule.Translated: Se organiza una gran cacería. Cazadores de todo {FACTION} se unen, ansiosos por perfeccionar sus habilidades con esta oportunidad.

Rule.Original: Some of the animals are captured and domesticated for long-term gains.
Rule.Raw: Some of the animals are captured and domesticated for long-term gains.
Rule.Translated: Algunos de los animales son capturados y domesticados para obtener beneficios a largo plazo.
Fauna abundante (resultado de la gran cacería)

Rule.Original: The grand hunt concludes; your hunters were quite successful, bringing back valuable animal products.
Rule.Raw: The grand hunt concludes; your hunters were quite successful, bringing back valuable animal products.
Rule.Translated: La gran cacería concluye; tus cazadores tuvieron bastante éxito y trajeron valiosos productos animales.

Rule.Original: Rather than hunt or pen the animals, your settlements set aside the land as a sanctuary where the creatures live unmolested. The people take quiet pride in sharing their world rather than ruling it, and the herds that linger near the settlements still provide for those who tend them gently.
Rule.Raw: Rather than hunt or pen the animals, your settlements set aside the land as a sanctuary where the creatures live unmolested. The people take quiet pride in sharing their world rather than ruling it, and the herds that linger near the settlements still provide for those who tend them gently.
Rule.Translated: En lugar de cazar o encerrar a los animales, tus asentamientos reservan la tierra como un santuario donde las criaturas viven sin ser molestadas. La gente siente un orgullo callado por compartir su mundo en lugar de gobernarlo, y las manadas que rondan cerca de los asentamientos aún proveen a quienes las cuidan con delicadeza.

Rule.Original: One of your settlements is reporting a massive spike in illegal drug use. The leadership suspects that a producer has taken up residence nearby. They request your word on the matter.
Rule.Raw: One of your settlements is reporting a massive spike in illegal drug use. The leadership suspects that a producer has taken up residence nearby. They request your word on the matter.
Rule.Translated: Uno de tus asentamientos informa de un aumento masivo del consumo de drogas ilegales. La dirigencia sospecha que un productor se ha instalado cerca. Piden tu palabra sobre el asunto.

Rule.Original: Find the source of this drug trade!
Rule.Raw: Find the source of this drug trade!
Rule.Translated: ¡Encuentra el origen de este comercio de drogas!

Rule.Original: Are the drugs keeping my subjects content? Yes? Then leave it be.
Rule.Raw: Are the drugs keeping my subjects content? Yes? Then leave it be.
Rule.Translated: ¿Las drogas mantienen contentos a mis súbditos? ¿Sí? Pues déjalo estar.

Rule.Original: The drug line has been incorporated into the settlement's official production. A random tithe of drugs will be delivered to you on a 5-day basis.
Rule.Raw: The drug line has been incorporated into the settlement's official production. A random tithe of drugs will be delivered to you on a 5-day basis.
Rule.Translated: La línea de drogas se ha incorporado a la producción oficial del asentamiento. Se te entregará un diezmo aleatorio de drogas cada 5 días.

Rule.Original: You have received a new tithe of drugs. Continue production or shut down the facility?
Rule.Raw: You have received a new tithe of drugs. Continue production or shut down the facility?
Rule.Translated: Has recibido un nuevo diezmo de drogas. ¿Continuar la producción o cerrar la instalación?

Rule.Original: Your settlement may be hooked on drugs, but they seem content with their reality. You doubt you'll hear any complaints anytime soon.
Rule.Raw: Your settlement may be hooked on drugs, but they seem content with their reality. You doubt you'll hear any complaints anytime soon.
Rule.Translated: Puede que tu asentamiento esté enganchado a las drogas, pero parecen contentos con su realidad. Dudas que vayas a oír quejas pronto.

Rule.Original: The authorities you directed to find the source of the drug production have turned up nothing. Locals are unhappy with the upheaval. The investigators are going to have to lay back for a short while.
Rule.Raw: The authorities you directed to find the source of the drug production have turned up nothing. Locals are unhappy with the upheaval. The investigators are going to have to lay back for a short while.
Rule.Translated: Las autoridades que enviaste a encontrar el origen de la producción de drogas no han encontrado nada. Los lugareños están descontentos con el alboroto. Los investigadores tendrán que mantenerse al margen un tiempo.
Comercio de drogas (continuación de la investigación)

Rule.Original: The locals have settled, and your investigators believe that they can get back to work finding the source of the drugs. In light of the unexpected difficulty, however, they are requesting an increased budget to help with the investigation.
Rule.Raw: The locals have settled, and your investigators believe that they can get back to work finding the source of the drugs. In light of the unexpected difficulty, however, they are requesting an increased budget to help with the investigation.
Rule.Translated: Los lugareños se han calmado, y tus investigadores creen que pueden volver al trabajo de encontrar el origen de las drogas. A la luz de la inesperada dificultad, sin embargo, solicitan un presupuesto mayor para ayudar con la investigación.

Rule.Original: Make do with what you have.
Rule.Raw: Make do with what you have.

Rule.Original:
The authorities have returned with good news! They have found the drug production. The sneaky lads almost got away, but no one can match the strength of {FACTION}!
However, they point out that a coin or two could be turned from taking over the production instead...
Rule.Raw:
The authorities have returned with good news! They have found the drug production. The sneaky lads almost got away, but no one can match the strength of {FACTION}!
However, they point out that a coin or two could be turned from taking over the production instead...
Rule.Translated: ¡Las autoridades han vuelto con buenas noticias! Han encontrado la producción de drogas. Los muy astutos casi se escapan, ¡pero nadie puede igualar la fuerza de {FACTION}!\n\nNo obstante, señalan que podría sacarse alguna moneda tomando el control de la producción en su lugar...

Rule.Original: I said, take down the facility! We do not require such a degenerate pleasure.
Rule.Raw: I said, take down the facility! We do not require such a degenerate pleasure.
Rule.Translated: ¡He dicho que desmanteles las instalaciones! No necesitamos semejante placer degenerado.

Rule.Original: We could... incorporate it into our official production lines.
Rule.Raw: We could... incorporate it into our official production lines.
Rule.Translated: Podríamos... incorporarlo a nuestras líneas de producción oficiales.

Rule.Original: The affected region(s) have run short on veins to mine. What should be done?
Rule.Raw: The affected region(s) have run short on veins to mine. What should be done?
Rule.Translated: La(s) región(es) afectada(s) se han quedado sin vetas que explotar. ¿Qué se debería hacer?

Rule.Original: The miners will have to wait for new veins to be found.
Rule.Raw: The miners will have to wait for new veins to be found.
Rule.Translated: Los mineros tendrán que esperar a que se encuentren nuevas vetas.

Rule.Original: Hire prospectors to search for untapped deposits.
Rule.Raw: Hire prospectors to search for untapped deposits.
Rule.Translated: Contrata prospectores para buscar yacimientos sin explotar.

Rule.Original: Redirect the idle miners to settlement construction.
Rule.Raw: Redirect the idle miners to settlement construction.
Rule.Translated: Destina a los mineros inactivos a la construcción del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The miners wait for new veins to be found.
Rule.Raw: The miners wait for new veins to be found.
Rule.Translated: Los mineros esperan a que se encuentren nuevas vetas.

Rule.Original: Your hired prospectors set out in search of new ore veins.
Rule.Raw: Your hired prospectors set out in search of new ore veins.
Rule.Translated: Tus prospectores contratados parten en busca de nuevas vetas de mineral.

Rule.Original: The prospectors found nothing. The mines remain empty.
Rule.Raw: The prospectors found nothing. The mines remain empty.
Rule.Translated: Los prospectores no encontraron nada. Las minas siguen vacías.

Rule.Original: Your hired prospectors set out in search of new ore veins.
Rule.Raw: Your hired prospectors set out in search of new ore veins.
Rule.Translated: Tus prospectores contratados parten en busca de nuevas vetas de mineral.

Rule.Original: The prospectors successfully located new veins of ore, and your miners gladly return to work. A small sample of the new ore is sent back for your own use.
Rule.Raw: The prospectors successfully located new veins of ore, and your miners gladly return to work. A small sample of the new ore is sent back for your own use.
Rule.Translated: Los prospectores localizaron con éxito nuevas vetas de mineral, y tus mineros regresan encantados al trabajo. Se te envía una pequeña muestra del nuevo mineral para tu propio uso.

Rule.Original: Idle miners are put to work on settlement construction projects.
Rule.Raw: Idle miners are put to work on settlement construction projects.
Rule.Translated: Los mineros ociosos se ponen a trabajar en proyectos de construcción del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Some of your settlements have expanded their forestry production this week. How should the extra timber be used?
Rule.Raw: Some of your settlements have expanded their forestry production this week. How should the extra timber be used?
Rule.Translated: Algunos de tus asentamientos han ampliado su producción forestal esta semana. ¿Cómo se debería usar la madera extra?

Rule.Original: Keep the expanded logging operations running.
Rule.Raw: Keep the expanded logging operations running.
Rule.Translated: Mantén en marcha las operaciones madereras ampliadas.

Rule.Original: Sell the extra timber to passing traders.
Rule.Raw: Sell the extra timber to passing traders.
Rule.Translated: Vende la madera adicional a los comerciantes de paso.

Rule.Original: Stockpile the lumber for settlement construction.
Rule.Raw: Stockpile the lumber for settlement construction.
Rule.Translated: Almacena la madera de construcción para las obras del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The extra timber is sold to passing traders for a tidy profit.
Rule.Raw: The extra timber is sold to passing traders for a tidy profit.
Rule.Translated: La madera extra se vende a los comerciantes que pasan, con un buen beneficio.
Ampliación de la explotación forestal (reserva para construcción)

Rule.Original: Lumber is stockpiled for construction projects, and construction speeds up.
Rule.Raw: Lumber is stockpiled for construction projects, and construction speeds up.
Rule.Translated: La madera se acumula para proyectos de construcción, y la construcción se acelera.

Rule.Original: There's a widespread food shortage in the affected regions. Your settlements need guidance on how to handle this crisis.
Rule.Raw: There's a widespread food shortage in the affected regions. Your settlements need guidance on how to handle this crisis.
Rule.Translated: Hay una escasez generalizada de comida en las regiones afectadas. Tus asentamientos necesitan orientación sobre cómo manejar esta crisis.

Rule.Original: There's little we can do. We'll endure the shortage.
Rule.Raw: There's little we can do. We'll endure the shortage.
Rule.Translated: Hay poco que podamos hacer. Soportaremos la escasez.

Rule.Original: Purchase emergency food imports to soften the blow.
Rule.Raw: Purchase emergency food imports to soften the blow.
Rule.Translated: Compra importaciones de alimentos de emergencia para aliviar el impacto.

Rule.Original: Enforce strict rationing — shared sacrifice builds loyalty.
Rule.Raw: Enforce strict rationing — shared sacrifice builds loyalty.
Rule.Translated: Impón un racionamiento estricto: el sacrificio compartido refuerza la lealtad.

Rule.Original: Let the slaves starve. The workers will eat.
Rule.Raw: Let the slaves starve. The workers will eat.
Rule.Translated: Deja que los esclavos mueran de hambre. Los trabajadores comerán.

Rule.Original: Dark times call for dark sustenance. Let the dead feed the living.
Rule.Raw: Dark times call for dark sustenance. Let the dead feed the living.
Rule.Translated: Los tiempos oscuros exigen un sustento oscuro. Que los muertos alimenten a los vivos.

Rule.Original: Your settlements endure the food shortage.
Rule.Raw: Your settlements endure the food shortage.
Rule.Translated: Tus asentamientos soportan la escasez de comida.

Rule.Original: Emergency imports have arrived, lessening the impact of the food shortage.
Rule.Raw: Emergency imports have arrived, lessening the impact of the food shortage.
Rule.Translated: Han llegado importaciones de emergencia, reduciendo el impacto de la escasez de comida.

Rule.Original: Strict rationing is in effect. Citizens admire the shared sacrifice.
Rule.Raw: Strict rationing is in effect. Citizens admire the shared sacrifice.
Rule.Translated: El racionamiento estricto está en vigor. Los ciudadanos admiran el sacrificio compartido.
Escasez de alimentos (esclavos muertos de hambre)

Rule.Original: The slaves bear the brunt of the shortage. Your citizens eat like normal, but slaves starve across the land.
Rule.Raw: The slaves bear the brunt of the shortage. Your citizens eat like normal, but slaves starve across the land.
Rule.Translated: Los esclavos cargan con el peso de la escasez. Tus ciudadanos comen con normalidad, pero los esclavos pasan hambre por toda la tierra.

Rule.Original: The starved fallen are quietly rendered into the food supply. No one goes hungry — production never falters — but being forced to feast on their own is unsettling. Eating human meat is one thing; killing a friend to eat them is another entirely.
Rule.Raw: The starved fallen are quietly rendered into the food supply. No one goes hungry — production never falters — but being forced to feast on their own is unsettling. Eating human meat is one thing; killing a friend to eat them is another entirely.
Rule.Translated: Los caídos por inanición se incorporan en silencio al suministro de comida. Nadie pasa hambre —la producción nunca flaquea—, pero verse forzados a alimentarse de los suyos es inquietante. Comer carne humana es una cosa; matar a un amigo para comérselo es algo muy distinto.

Rule.Original: Lucky harvests have led to a surplus of food in some settlements. What should be done with the excess?
Rule.Raw: Lucky harvests have led to a surplus of food in some settlements. What should be done with the excess?
Rule.Translated: Cosechas afortunadas han llevado a un excedente de comida en algunos asentamientos. ¿Qué se debería hacer con el sobrante?

Rule.Original: Store the surplus for continued production.
Rule.Raw: Store the surplus for continued production.
Rule.Translated: Guarda el excedente para continuar la producción.

Rule.Original: Sell the excess harvest to traders.
Rule.Raw: Sell the excess harvest to traders.
Rule.Translated: Vende la cosecha sobrante a los comerciantes.

Rule.Original: Host a grand feast to celebrate the bounty.
Rule.Raw: Host a grand feast to celebrate the bounty.
Rule.Translated: Celebra un gran banquete para festejar la abundancia.

Rule.Original: The surplus is stored for continued production.
Rule.Raw: The surplus is stored for continued production.
Rule.Translated: El excedente se almacena para mantener la producción.

Rule.Original: The excess harvest is sold to passing traders.
Rule.Raw: The excess harvest is sold to passing traders.
Rule.Translated: La cosecha sobrante se vende a los comerciantes que pasan.

Rule.Original: A grand feast is held to celebrate the bounty! Citizens are happy and loyal.
Rule.Raw: A grand feast is held to celebrate the bounty! Citizens are happy and loyal.
Rule.Translated: ¡Se celebra un gran festín para festejar la abundancia! Los ciudadanos están felices y leales.

Rule.Original: The affected region(s) have forest fires blazing out of control. How should your settlements respond?
Rule.Raw: The affected region(s) have forest fires blazing out of control. How should your settlements respond?
Rule.Translated: La(s) región(es) afectada(s) tienen incendios forestales descontrolados. ¿Cómo deberían responder tus asentamientos?

Rule.Original: Let the fire burn itself out.
Rule.Raw: Let the fire burn itself out.
Rule.Translated: Deja que el fuego se extinga por sí solo.

Rule.Original: Organize firefighting crews to contain the blaze.
Rule.Raw: Organize firefighting crews to contain the blaze.
Rule.Translated: Organiza brigadas de extinción para contener el incendio.

Rule.Original: Perform a controlled burn — cleared land can be farmed.
Rule.Raw: Perform a controlled burn — cleared land can be farmed.
Rule.Translated: Realiza una quema controlada: el terreno despejado se puede cultivar.

Rule.Original: The fire burns unchecked through the forests.
Rule.Raw: The fire burns unchecked through the forests.
Rule.Translated: El fuego arde sin control por los bosques.

Rule.Original: The firefighting crews managed to contain the blaze! The damage is limited.
Rule.Raw: The firefighting crews managed to contain the blaze! The damage is limited.
Rule.Translated: ¡Las cuadrillas de bomberos lograron contener las llamas! El daño es limitado.

Rule.Original: Despite their best efforts, the firefighting crews couldn't contain the blaze. The fire rages on.
Rule.Raw: Despite their best efforts, the firefighting crews couldn't contain the blaze. The fire rages on.
Rule.Translated: A pesar de sus mejores esfuerzos, las cuadrillas de bomberos no pudieron contener las llamas. El fuego sigue arrasando.

Rule.Original: The controlled burn clears damaged forest, opening land for farming.
Rule.Raw: The controlled burn clears damaged forest, opening land for farming.
Rule.Translated: La quema controlada despeja el bosque dañado, abriendo tierra para el cultivo.

Rule.Original:
Due to widespread unrest in {FACTION}, a growing number of settlements are beginning to entertain ideas of secession and independence.
How will you address the dissent?
Rule.Raw:
Due to widespread unrest in {FACTION}, a growing number of settlements are beginning to entertain ideas of secession and independence.
How will you address the dissent?
Rule.Translated: Debido al descontento generalizado en {FACTION}, un número creciente de asentamientos empieza a barajar ideas de secesión e independencia.\n\n¿Cómo abordarás la disidencia?

Rule.Original: Let them petition. We are a just nation.
Rule.Raw: Let them petition. We are a just nation.
Rule.Translated: Deja que presenten sus peticiones. Somos una nación justa.

Rule.Original: Address their grievances — distribute aid to the discontented.
Rule.Raw: Address their grievances — distribute aid to the discontented.
Rule.Translated: Atiende sus quejas: reparte ayuda entre los descontentos.
Reprime el movimiento por la fuerza.

Rule.Original: The petitions continue unopposed. The movement grows as more settlements consider independence.
Rule.Raw: The petitions continue unopposed. The movement grows as more settlements consider independence.
Rule.Translated: Las peticiones continúan sin oposición. El movimiento crece a medida que más asentamientos consideran la independencia.

Rule.Original: Aid is distributed to the discontented settlements. The gesture helps, but the underlying tensions remain.
Rule.Raw: Aid is distributed to the discontented settlements. The gesture helps, but the underlying tensions remain.
Rule.Translated: Se distribuye ayuda a los asentamientos descontentos. El gesto ayuda, pero las tensiones subyacentes permanecen.

Rule.Original: The independence movement is crushed by force. The dissidents are silenced, but the heavy-handed response breeds further resentment.
Rule.Raw: The independence movement is crushed by force. The dissidents are silenced, but the heavy-handed response breeds further resentment.
Rule.Translated: El movimiento independentista es aplastado por la fuerza. Los disidentes son silenciados, pero la respuesta de mano dura engendra más resentimiento.

Rule.Original: Due to lowered loyalty, citizens are starting to form local militias and are refusing to hand over their share of taxes. How will you handle the situation?
Rule.Raw: Due to lowered loyalty, citizens are starting to form local militias and are refusing to hand over their share of taxes. How will you handle the situation?
Rule.Translated: Debido a la baja lealtad, los ciudadanos empiezan a formar milicias locales y se niegan a entregar su parte de los impuestos. ¿Cómo manejarás la situación?

Rule.Original: Let them play soldier. They'll tire of it.
Rule.Raw: Let them play soldier. They'll tire of it.
Rule.Translated: Deja que jueguen a ser soldados. Ya se cansarán.

Rule.Original: Fold the militias into our settlement garrisons.
Rule.Raw: Fold the militias into our settlement garrisons.
Rule.Translated: Integra las milicias en las guarniciones de nuestros asentamientos.

Rule.Original: The militias continue their activities unchecked. Tax collection suffers as citizens refuse to pay their share.
Rule.Raw: The militias continue their activities unchecked. Tax collection suffers as citizens refuse to pay their share.
Rule.Translated: Las milicias continúan sus actividades sin control. La recaudación de impuestos se resiente al negarse los ciudadanos a pagar su parte.
Formación de milicias locales (incorporadas a la guarnición)

Rule.Original: The militias are folded into the settlement garrisons. Tax collection still suffers, but the settlements are better defended. Citizens resent the forced conscription.
Rule.Raw: The militias are folded into the settlement garrisons. Tax collection still suffers, but the settlements are better defended. Citizens resent the forced conscription.
Rule.Translated: Las milicias se integran en las guarniciones de los asentamientos. La recaudación de impuestos sigue resintiéndose, pero los asentamientos están mejor defendidos. Los ciudadanos resienten el reclutamiento forzoso.

Rule.Original: The militias are forcibly disbanded. Tax collection resumes, but the heavy-handed response damages loyalty and breeds unrest.
Rule.Raw: The militias are forcibly disbanded. Tax collection resumes, but the heavy-handed response damages loyalty and breeds unrest.
Rule.Translated: Las milicias se disuelven por la fuerza. La recaudación de impuestos se reanuda, pero la respuesta de mano dura daña la lealtad y engendra descontento.

Rule.Original: Some of the settlements in {FACTION} are having a parade in your honor! How will you respond to their display of loyalty?
Rule.Raw: Some of the settlements in {FACTION} are having a parade in your honor! How will you respond to their display of loyalty?
Rule.Translated: ¡Algunos de los asentamientos de {FACTION} celebran un desfile en tu honor! ¿Cómo responderás a su muestra de lealtad?

Rule.Original: Join the parade and rally the people.
Rule.Raw: Join the parade and rally the people.
Rule.Translated: Únete al desfile y anima al pueblo.

Rule.Original: Use the gathering to recruit new workers.
Rule.Raw: Use the gathering to recruit new workers.
Rule.Translated: Aprovecha la reunión para reclutar nuevos trabajadores.

Rule.Original: The parade continues unhindered. Citizens feel proud and loyal.
Rule.Raw: The parade continues unhindered. Citizens feel proud and loyal.
Rule.Translated: El desfile continúa sin contratiempos. Los ciudadanos se sienten orgullosos y leales.

Rule.Original: Your personal appearance at the parade electrifies the crowd! The people are inspired by their leader's presence.
Rule.Raw: Your personal appearance at the parade electrifies the crowd! The people are inspired by their leader's presence.
Rule.Translated: ¡Tu aparición personal en el desfile electriza a la multitud! La gente se inspira con la presencia de su líder.

Rule.Original: The enthusiastic gathering is used to recruit new workers for {FACTION}'s settlements.
Rule.Raw: The enthusiastic gathering is used to recruit new workers for {FACTION}'s settlements.
Rule.Translated: La entusiasta concentración se aprovecha para reclutar nuevos trabajadores para los asentamientos de {FACTION}.

Rule.Original: The craftsmen in the affected region(s) are suffering from a lack of supplies. How should they adapt?
Rule.Raw: The craftsmen in the affected region(s) are suffering from a lack of supplies. How should they adapt?
Rule.Translated: Los artesanos de la(s) región(es) afectada(s) sufren por la falta de suministros. ¿Cómo deberían adaptarse?

Rule.Original: We'll wait for the next delivery.
Rule.Raw: We'll wait for the next delivery.

Rule.Original: Source replacement supplies from local traders.
Rule.Raw: Source replacement supplies from local traders.
Rule.Translated: Consigue suministros de reemplazo de comerciantes locales.

Rule.Original: Have the craftsmen improvise with local materials.
Rule.Raw: Have the craftsmen improvise with local materials.
Rule.Translated: Haz que los artesanos improvisen con materiales locales.

Rule.Original: The craftsmen wait for the next delivery.
Rule.Raw: The craftsmen wait for the next delivery.
Rule.Translated: Los artesanos esperan a la próxima entrega.

Rule.Original: Trade connections help source replacement supplies locally.
Rule.Raw: Trade connections help source replacement supplies locally.
Rule.Translated: Las conexiones comerciales ayudan a conseguir suministros de repuesto localmente.

Rule.Original: The craftsmen improvise with local materials, focusing their limited supplies on apparel.
Rule.Raw: The craftsmen improvise with local materials, focusing their limited supplies on apparel.
Rule.Translated: Los artesanos improvisan con materiales locales, concentrando sus escasos suministros en la ropa.
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: One of your settlements reports seeing strange figures wander into the forest at night. They are described as wearing strange costumes.
Rule.Raw: One of your settlements reports seeing strange figures wander into the forest at night. They are described as wearing strange costumes.
Rule.Translated: Uno de tus asentamientos informa de que ven figuras extrañas adentrarse en el bosque de noche. Se las describe vistiendo extraños atuendos.

Rule.Original: I don't care what people do in the forest. Leave them be.
Rule.Raw: I don't care what people do in the forest. Leave them be.
Rule.Translated: No me importa lo que haga la gente en el bosque. Déjalos en paz.

Rule.Original: Send someone to follow them. I want to know what's happening.
Rule.Raw: Send someone to follow them. I want to know what's happening.
Rule.Translated: Envía a alguien a seguirlos. Quiero saber qué ocurre.
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: Someone has been sent to investigate...
Rule.Raw: Someone has been sent to investigate...
Rule.Translated: Se ha enviado a alguien a investigar...

Rule.Original: You receive news that an investigator followed an individual into the woods. They reported back seeing the group perform a series of almost ritualistic carnal acts. Not caring to stick around for it, he returned.
Rule.Raw: You receive news that an investigator followed an individual into the woods. They reported back seeing the group perform a series of almost ritualistic carnal acts. Not caring to stick around for it, he returned.
Rule.Translated: Recibes noticias de que un investigador siguió a una persona hasta el bosque. Informó de que había visto al grupo realizar varios actos carnales casi rituales. Como no quería quedarse allí, regresó.

Rule.Original: A romp in the woods? Who cares?
Rule.Raw: A romp in the woods? Who cares?
Rule.Translated: ¿Un revolcón en el bosque? ¿A quién le importa?
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: The investigator reports back that the group returned again. They continued the same activities as the night prior — however, after not leaving, he observed that the group brought out an ornate chest with religious-looking symbols. He stepped closer for a better look, but after stepping on a dead leaf, the group heard him. He fled before they could find him.
Rule.Raw: The investigator reports back that the group returned again. They continued the same activities as the night prior — however, after not leaving, he observed that the group brought out an ornate chest with religious-looking symbols. He stepped closer for a better look, but after stepping on a dead leaf, the group heard him. He fled before they could find him.
Rule.Translated: El investigador informa de que el grupo volvió. Continuaron con las mismas actividades de la noche anterior, pero esta vez permaneció allí y observó que sacaban un cofre ornamentado con símbolos de aspecto religioso. Se acercó para verlo mejor, pero pisó una hoja seca y el grupo lo oyó. Huyó antes de que pudieran encontrarlo.

Rule.Original: Whatever it is, I think it's time to just let it go.
Rule.Raw: Whatever it is, I think it's time to just let it go.
Rule.Translated: Sea lo que sea, creo que es hora de dejarlo estar.

Rule.Original: Go back again. I need to know if this some sort of cult.
Rule.Raw: Go back again. I need to know if this some sort of cult.
Rule.Translated: Vuelve otra vez. Necesito saber si esto es una especie de culto.
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: You have decided to leave them be.
Rule.Raw: You have decided to leave them be.

Rule.Translated: Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: You have ordered the investigation to continue...
Rule.Raw: You have ordered the investigation to continue...
Rule.Translated: Has ordenado que la investigación continúe...
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original:
After not reporting back, a search for the investigator was conducted. He was found dead. His body was stripped, his chest cavity split, and his skin carved with runic symbols. The group, whoever they were, were not seen again. Dread falls upon us all.
Coincidentally, this week's harvests seem to have spoiled...
Rule.Raw:
After not reporting back, a search for the investigator was conducted. He was found dead. His body was stripped, his chest cavity split, and his skin carved with runic symbols. The group, whoever they were, were not seen again. Dread falls upon us all.
Coincidentally, this week's harvests seem to have spoiled...
Rule.Translated: Al no dar parte, se llevó a cabo una búsqueda del investigador. Fue hallado muerto. Su cuerpo estaba despojado, su cavidad torácica abierta y su piel tallada con símbolos rúnicos. El grupo, fueran quienes fueran, no volvió a ser visto. El pavor cae sobre todos nosotros.\n\nCasualmente, las cosechas de esta semana parecen haberse echado a perder...
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: You have ordered the investigation to continue...
Rule.Raw: You have ordered the investigation to continue...
Rule.Translated: Has ordenado que la investigación continúe...
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: The investigator reported back early in the morning looking quite disheveled. However, his story says otherwise. They expected him this time and gave an invitation to join. As he explains it, they were performing a fertility ritual to their goddess for hopes of a good harvest. Regardless, he seems to have enjoyed himself!
Rule.Raw: The investigator reported back early in the morning looking quite disheveled. However, his story says otherwise. They expected him this time and gave an invitation to join. As he explains it, they were performing a fertility ritual to their goddess for hopes of a good harvest. Regardless, he seems to have enjoyed himself!
Rule.Translated: El investigador dio parte de madrugada con un aspecto bastante desaliñado. Sin embargo, su historia dice otra cosa. Esta vez lo esperaban y le ofrecieron una invitación para unirse. Según lo explica, estaban realizando un ritual de fertilidad a su diosa con la esperanza de una buena cosecha. En cualquier caso, ¡parece que se lo pasó bien!
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: This week's harvests seem to be unnaturally more plentiful than usual...
Rule.Raw: This week's harvests seem to be unnaturally more plentiful than usual...
Rule.Translated: Las cosechas de esta semana parecen antinaturalmente más abundantes de lo habitual...
Un ritual a la luz de la luna

Rule.Original: This week's harvests seem to be unnaturally less plentiful than usual...
Rule.Raw: This week's harvests seem to be unnaturally less plentiful than usual...
Rule.Translated: Las cosechas de esta semana parecen antinaturalmente menos abundantes de lo habitual...

Rule.Original: The citizens of {FACTION} are currently reluctant to expand.
Rule.Raw: The citizens of {FACTION} are currently reluctant to expand.
Rule.Translated: Los ciudadanos de {FACTION} se muestran actualmente reacios a expandirse.

Rule.Original: The wildlife in the affected region(s) have all but disappeared. How should your settlements adapt?
Rule.Raw: The wildlife in the affected region(s) have all but disappeared. How should your settlements adapt?
Rule.Translated: La fauna de la(s) región(es) afectada(s) ha desaparecido casi por completo. ¿Cómo deberían adaptarse tus asentamientos?
Nos las arreglaremos sin la fauna.
Envía partidas de caza más lejos.

Rule.Original: Shift focus to farming the land instead.
Rule.Raw: Shift focus to farming the land instead.

Rule.Original: Your settlements make do without the wildlife.
Rule.Raw: Your settlements make do without the wildlife.
Rule.Translated: Tus asentamientos se las arreglan sin la fauna.

Rule.Original: Hunting parties range further to compensate.
Rule.Raw: Hunting parties range further to compensate.
Rule.Translated: Las partidas de caza se alejan más para compensar.

Rule.Original: Settlers shift their focus from hunting to farming.
Rule.Raw: Settlers shift their focus from hunting to farming.
Rule.Translated: Los colonos desplazan su atención de la caza a la agricultura.

Rule.Original: Deep in the mines, a strange presence has been felt and the miners have stopped working to investigate it.
Rule.Raw: Deep in the mines, a strange presence has been felt and the miners have stopped working to investigate it.
Rule.Translated: En lo profundo de las minas, se ha sentido una presencia extraña y los mineros han dejado de trabajar para investigarla.

Rule.Original: What are you doing? Keep digging!
Rule.Raw: What are you doing? Keep digging!

Rule.Original: Send in the military to escort the miners.
Rule.Raw: Send in the military to escort the miners.
Rule.Translated: Envía al ejército a escoltar a los mineros.

Rule.Original: Your miners start to investigate under military escort...
Rule.Raw: Your miners start to investigate under military escort...
Rule.Translated: Tus mineros empiezan a investigar bajo escolta militar...

Rule.Original: Your miners press deeper into the unknown...
Rule.Raw: Your miners press deeper into the unknown...
Rule.Translated: Tus mineros se adentran más en lo desconocido...

Rule.Original: Your miners start to investigate under military escort...
Rule.Raw: Your miners start to investigate under military escort...
Rule.Translated: Tus mineros empiezan a investigar bajo escolta militar...

Rule.Original:
After investigating, the miners found several veins of ore all clumped together! Someone must have wanted us to find this.
You will receive a small group of ores that the miners dug up.
Rule.Raw:
After investigating, the miners found several veins of ore all clumped together! Someone must have wanted us to find this.
You will receive a small group of ores that the miners dug up.
Rule.Translated: Tras investigar, ¡los mineros encontraron varias vetas de mineral todas juntas! Alguien debió de querer que encontráramos esto.\n\nRecibirás un pequeño grupo de minerales que los mineros extrajeron.

Rule.Original:
The miners struck an exceptionally rich vein near the disturbance! Someone must have wanted us to find this.
You will receive a haul of ores that the miners dug up.
Rule.Raw:
The miners struck an exceptionally rich vein near the disturbance! Someone must have wanted us to find this.
You will receive a haul of ores that the miners dug up.
Rule.Translated: ¡Los mineros dieron con una veta excepcionalmente rica cerca de la perturbación! Alguien debió de querer que encontráramos esto.\n\nRecibirás un cargamento de minerales que los mineros extrajeron.

Rule.Original: When your miners investigated, a large insectoid attacked! Luckily, the security force sent with the miners fought off the creature with no casualties. A report of the event has been sent up for investigation.
Rule.Raw: When your miners investigated, a large insectoid attacked! Luckily, the security force sent with the miners fought off the creature with no casualties. A report of the event has been sent up for investigation.
Rule.Translated: Cuando tus mineros investigaron, ¡un gran insectoide atacó! Por suerte, la fuerza de seguridad enviada con los mineros repelió a la criatura sin bajas. Se ha enviado un informe del suceso para su investigación.

Rule.Original: When your miners investigated, a large insectoid attacked! A few of the miners were killed before the creature was slain. Due to this, a number of workers have decided to stay home after the traumatic event.
Rule.Raw: When your miners investigated, a large insectoid attacked! A few of the miners were killed before the creature was slain. Due to this, a number of workers have decided to stay home after the traumatic event.
Rule.Translated: Cuando tus mineros investigaron, ¡un gran insectoide atacó! Varios de los mineros murieron antes de que la criatura fuera abatida. Debido a esto, varios trabajadores han decidido quedarse en casa tras el traumático suceso.
Hallazgo de una rica veta de mineral

Rule.Original: Some of your settlements have managed to strike veins of rich ore in their mines! How should they proceed?
Rule.Raw: Some of your settlements have managed to strike veins of rich ore in their mines! How should they proceed?
Rule.Translated: ¡Algunos de tus asentamientos han logrado dar con vetas de mineral rico en sus minas! ¿Cómo deberían proceder?

Rule.Original: Mine the vein at a steady, sustainable pace.
Rule.Raw: Mine the vein at a steady, sustainable pace.
Rule.Translated: Explota la veta a un ritmo constante y sostenible.

Rule.Original: Rush the extraction — push the miners hard.
Rule.Raw: Rush the extraction — push the miners hard.
Rule.Translated: Acelera la extracción: exige más a los mineros.

Rule.Original: Sell the mining rights to outside interests.
Rule.Raw: Sell the mining rights to outside interests.
Rule.Translated: Vende los derechos de explotación a inversores externos.

Rule.Original: The miners extract ore at a steady pace.
Rule.Raw: The miners extract ore at a steady pace.
Rule.Translated: Los mineros extraen mineral a un ritmo constante.

Rule.Original: The miners are pushed hard to extract as much ore as possible, but the overwork takes its toll.
Rule.Raw: The miners are pushed hard to extract as much ore as possible, but the overwork takes its toll.
Rule.Translated: Se presiona a los mineros para extraer todo el mineral posible, pero el exceso de trabajo se cobra su precio.

Rule.Original: The mining rights are sold to outside interests for immediate profit.
Rule.Raw: The mining rights are sold to outside interests for immediate profit.
Rule.Translated: Los derechos de minería se venden a intereses externos para obtener un beneficio inmediato.
