Rule.Original: The craftsmen in your settlements have been working unusually well! How should their talents be directed?
Rule.Raw: The craftsmen in your settlements have been working unusually well! How should their talents be directed?
Rule.Translated: ¡Los artesanos de tus asentamientos han estado trabajando inusualmente bien! ¿Cómo deberían dirigirse sus talentos?

Rule.Original: Encourage them to keep up the good work across the board.
Rule.Raw: Encourage them to keep up the good work across the board.
Rule.Translated: Anímalos a mantener el buen trabajo en todos los ámbitos.

Rule.Original: Direct the craftsmen to focus on weaponsmithing.
Rule.Raw: Direct the craftsmen to focus on weaponsmithing.
Rule.Translated: Indica a los artesanos que se centren en fabricar armas.

Rule.Original: Direct the craftsmen to focus on tailoring and armorsmithing.
Rule.Raw: Direct the craftsmen to focus on tailoring and armorsmithing.
Rule.Translated: Indica a los artesanos que se centren en confeccionar ropa y fabricar armaduras.

Rule.Original: The craftsmen continue their excellent work across all disciplines. Their broad excellence boosts morale.
Rule.Raw: The craftsmen continue their excellent work across all disciplines. Their broad excellence boosts morale.
Rule.Translated: Los artesanos continúan su excelente trabajo en todas las disciplinas. Su amplia excelencia eleva la moral.

Rule.Original: The craftsmen focus their talents on weaponsmithing.
Rule.Raw: The craftsmen focus their talents on weaponsmithing.
Rule.Translated: Los artesanos concentran sus talentos en la fabricación de armas.

Rule.Original: The craftsmen focus their talents on tailoring and armorsmithing.
Rule.Raw: The craftsmen focus their talents on tailoring and armorsmithing.
Rule.Translated: Los artesanos concentran sus talentos en la sastrería y la fabricación de armaduras.

Rule.Original: After a week of work, the craftsmen's focus has produced a fine weapon.
Rule.Raw: After a week of work, the craftsmen's focus has produced a fine weapon.
Rule.Translated: Tras una semana de trabajo, la concentración de los artesanos ha producido un arma excelente.

Rule.Original: After a week of work, the craftsmen's focus has produced a fine piece of armor.
Rule.Raw: After a week of work, the craftsmen's focus has produced a fine piece of armor.
Rule.Translated: Tras una semana de trabajo, la concentración de los artesanos ha producido una excelente pieza de armadura.

Rule.Original: The citizens of {FACTION} are itching to get on the road and settle new lands.
Rule.Raw: The citizens of {FACTION} are itching to get on the road and settle new lands.
Rule.Translated: Los ciudadanos de {FACTION} están deseando echarse al camino y colonizar nuevas tierras.

Rule.Original: A farmer of one of your settlements has brought a wounded animal to your capital. He states that it entered their town and would refuse to leave. The animal looks sickly and on edge. It looks like it could snap at any moment...
Rule.Raw: A farmer of one of your settlements has brought a wounded animal to your capital. He states that it entered their town and would refuse to leave. The animal looks sickly and on edge. It looks like it could snap at any moment...
Rule.Translated: Un granjero de uno de tus asentamientos ha traído un animal herido a tu capital. Afirma que entró en su pueblo y se negaba a marcharse. El animal tiene aspecto enfermizo y nervioso. Parece que podría atacar en cualquier momento...

Rule.Original: Get that THING out of my court!
Rule.Raw: Get that THING out of my court!

Rule.Original: We shall take care of it. Surely it cannot be of harm to us.
Rule.Raw: We shall take care of it. Surely it cannot be of harm to us.
Rule.Translated: Lo cuidaremos. Seguro que no puede hacernos daño.

Rule.Original: Send for a trained handler to approach it carefully.
Rule.Raw: Send for a trained handler to approach it carefully.
Rule.Translated: Envía a un cuidador adiestrado para que se acerque con cuidado.

Rule.Original: The animal remains calm. Your colonists guide it in without issue.
Rule.Raw: The animal remains calm. Your colonists guide it in without issue.
Rule.Translated: El animal permanece tranquilo. Tus colonos lo guían adentro sin problema.

Rule.Original: As the animal is guided in, it starts to fight against the settlers delivering it. It quickly becomes more and more aggressive and all attempts to calm it start to fail. Several settlers are heavily injured or die. Unfortunately, this will affect production for a period of time.
Rule.Raw: As the animal is guided in, it starts to fight against the settlers delivering it. It quickly becomes more and more aggressive and all attempts to calm it start to fail. Several settlers are heavily injured or die. Unfortunately, this will affect production for a period of time.
Rule.Translated: Mientras guían al animal adentro, empieza a forcejear contra los colonos que lo llevan. Rápidamente se vuelve cada vez más agresivo y todos los intentos de calmarlo empiezan a fracasar. Varios colonos resultan gravemente heridos o mueren. Por desgracia, esto afectará a la producción durante un tiempo.

Rule.Original: The trained handler approaches the animal with care and expertise. It calms down and allows itself to be guided in safely.
Rule.Raw: The trained handler approaches the animal with care and expertise. It calms down and allows itself to be guided in safely.
Rule.Translated: El cuidador adiestrado se acerca al animal con cuidado y pericia. Se calma y se deja guiar adentro a salvo.

Rule.Original: Despite the handler's best efforts, the animal lashes out. The handler manages to contain the situation, but sustains injuries in the process.
Rule.Raw: Despite the handler's best efforts, the animal lashes out. The handler manages to contain the situation, but sustains injuries in the process.
Rule.Translated: A pesar de los mejores esfuerzos del cuidador, el animal arremete. El cuidador logra contener la situación, pero sufre heridas en el proceso.

Rule.Original: A resource category for farmed crops: food, textiles, and other non-food plant harvests.
Rule.Raw: A resource category for farmed crops: food, textiles, and other non-food plant harvests.
Rule.Translated: Una categoría de recursos para comidas y alimentos vegetales.
Una categoría de recursos para armas.
Una categoría de recursos para ropa.

Rule.Original: A resource category for livestock and animal products.
Rule.Raw: A resource category for livestock and animal products.
Rule.Translated: Una categoría de recursos para ganado y productos animales.
Una categoría de recursos para la tala.

Rule.Original: A resource category for mining materials.
Rule.Raw: A resource category for mining materials.
Rule.Translated: Una categoría de recursos para materiales de minería.
Una categoría de recursos para medicina.
Una categoría de recursos para investigación.
Una categoría de recursos para energía.
Una categoría de recursos para biocombustible.

Rule.Original: A resource category for gravtech resources.
Rule.Raw: A resource category for gravtech resources.
Rule.Translated: Una categoría de recursos para recursos gravtech.

Rule.Original: Let the situation run its course. Free, no upkeep.
Rule.Raw: Let the situation run its course. Free, no upkeep.
Rule.Translated: Deja que la situación siga su curso. Gratis, sin mantenimiento.

Rule.Original: Buy calm with silver and softened policy. Pulls the bar down.
Rule.Raw: Buy calm with silver and softened policy. Pulls the bar down.
Rule.Translated: Compra la calma con plata y políticas más suaves. Hace bajar el indicador.

Rule.Original: Garrison the streets. Drives the bar up but suppresses overt unrest.
Rule.Raw: Garrison the streets. Drives the bar up but suppresses overt unrest.
Rule.Translated: Despliega guarniciones en las calles. Hace subir el indicador, pero reprime los disturbios abiertos.

Rule.Original: A dormant demo situation, faction-wide. Fire it from the Empire debug menu to exercise the Events-tab situation subtab, stages, approaches, and daily upkeep.
Rule.Raw: A dormant demo situation, faction-wide. Fire it from the Empire debug menu to exercise the Events-tab situation subtab, stages, approaches, and daily upkeep.
Rule.Translated: Situación de demostración inactiva que afecta a toda la facción. Actívala desde el menú de depuración de Empire para probar la subpestaña de situaciones de la pestaña de eventos, sus fases, enfoques y mantenimiento diario.

Rule.Original: A dormant demo situation scoped to a single settlement. Fire it on a settlement from the Empire debug menu to exercise the settlement panel's situation tab and the target-labelled row.
Rule.Raw: A dormant demo situation scoped to a single settlement. Fire it on a settlement from the Empire debug menu to exercise the settlement panel's situation tab and the target-labelled row.
Rule.Translated: Situación de demostración inactiva que afecta a un único asentamiento. Actívala en un asentamiento desde el menú de depuración de Empire para probar la pestaña de situaciones del panel del asentamiento y la fila etiquetada con el objetivo.
ajuste del tiempo de espera militar
ajuste del tiempo de espera de incursiones
penalización de felicidad por muerte de mercenarios
multiplicador de probabilidad de muerte de mercenarios
multiplicador de tasa de bajas de mercenarios
bonificación del tamaño máximo de escuadrón
