Rule.Original:
This combatant benefits from superior training and coordination provided by their settlement's military infrastructure.
----------
The buffs applied by this hediff are scaled by the military efficiency of the defending/home settlement (for player Empire pawns) or by the military efficiency of their faction (for enemy NPC pawns).
Rule.Raw:
This combatant benefits from superior training and coordination provided by their settlement's military infrastructure.
----------
The buffs applied by this hediff are scaled by the military efficiency of the defending/home settlement (for player Empire pawns) or by the military efficiency of their faction (for enemy NPC pawns).
Rule.Translated:
Este combatiente se beneficia de un entrenamiento y una coordinación superiores proporcionados por la infraestructura militar de su asentamiento.
 
----------
 
Las bonificaciones aplicadas por esta dolencia se escalan según la eficiencia militar del asentamiento defensor/de origen (para los personajes del Imperio del jugador) o según la eficiencia militar de su facción (para los personajes NPC enemigos).

Rule.Original: This combatant benefits from superior training and coordination provided by their settlement's military infrastructure.
Rule.Raw: This combatant benefits from superior training and coordination provided by their settlement's military infrastructure.
Rule.Translated: Este combatiente se beneficia de una formación y una coordinación superiores gracias a la infraestructura militar de su asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
This combatant suffers from inadequate training and poor coordination due to their settlement's weak military infrastructure.
----------
The penalties applied by this hediff are scaled by the military efficiency of the defending/home settlement (for player Empire pawns) or by the military efficiency of their faction (for enemy NPC pawns).
Rule.Raw:
This combatant suffers from inadequate training and poor coordination due to their settlement's weak military infrastructure.
----------
The penalties applied by this hediff are scaled by the military efficiency of the defending/home settlement (for player Empire pawns) or by the military efficiency of their faction (for enemy NPC pawns).
Rule.Translated:
Este combatiente sufre un entrenamiento inadecuado y una mala coordinación debido a la débil infraestructura militar de su asentamiento.

----------

Las penalizaciones aplicadas por esta dolencia se escalan según la eficiencia militar del asentamiento defensor/de origen (para los personajes del Imperio del jugador) o según la eficiencia militar de su facción (para los personajes NPC enemigos).

Rule.Original: This combatant suffers from inadequate training and poor coordination due to their settlement's weak military infrastructure.
Rule.Raw: This combatant suffers from inadequate training and poor coordination due to their settlement's weak military infrastructure.
Rule.Translated: Este combatiente sufre una formación insuficiente y una coordinación deficiente debido a la débil infraestructura militar de su asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Extension tabs added by Empire submods
Rule.Raw: Extension tabs added by Empire submods
Rule.Translated: Pestañas de extensión añadidas por submods de Empire

Rule.Original: Found and manage your NPC settlements
Rule.Raw: Found and manage your NPC settlements
Rule.Translated: Funda y gestiona tus asentamientos NPC

Rule.Original: Storm the settlement, plunder what you can carry, and return home. The settlement is left intact.
Rule.Raw: Storm the settlement, plunder what you can carry, and return home. The settlement is left intact.
Rule.Translated: Asalta el asentamiento, saquea lo que puedas llevar y regresa a casa. El asentamiento queda intacto.

Rule.Original: Random loot scaled to the enemy's tech level, with an occasional captured prisoner.
Rule.Raw: Random loot scaled to the enemy's tech level, with an occasional captured prisoner.
Rule.Translated: Botín aleatorio según el nivel tecnológico del enemigo, con algún prisionero capturado ocasionalmente.

Rule.Original: Storm the settlement and take what you can, with an eye on the people instead of their goods.
Rule.Raw: Storm the settlement and take what you can, with an eye on the people instead of their goods.
Rule.Translated: Asalta el asentamiento y toma lo que puedas, con la mira puesta en la gente en lugar de en sus bienes.

Rule.Original: Several prisoners abducted from the settlement's population, delivered as slaves.
Rule.Raw: Several prisoners abducted from the settlement's population, delivered as slaves.
Rule.Translated: Varios prisioneros secuestrados de la población del asentamiento y entregados como esclavos.

Rule.Original: Conquer the settlement and annex it as one of your own.
Rule.Raw: Conquer the settlement and annex it as one of your own.
Rule.Translated: Conquista el asentamiento y anéxalo como uno propio.

Rule.Original: The settlement is annexed as a new settlement. Starting level scales with the previous owner's tech level.
Rule.Raw: The settlement is annexed as a new settlement. Starting level scales with the previous owner's tech level.
Rule.Translated: El asentamiento se anexiona como un asentamiento nuevo. Su nivel inicial depende del nivel tecnológico de su anterior propietario.

Rule.Original: Burn the settlement to the ground and wipe it from the map. Nothing is annexed or carried home.
Rule.Raw: Burn the settlement to the ground and wipe it from the map. Nothing is annexed or carried home.
Rule.Translated: Arrasa el asentamiento y bórralo del mapa. No se anexiona nada ni se lleva nada a casa.

Rule.Original: The settlement is destroyed and removed from the world. No loot is taken.
Rule.Raw: The settlement is destroyed and removed from the world. No loot is taken.
Rule.Translated: El asentamiento se destruye y desaparece del mundo. No se obtiene botín.

Rule.Original: Laborers sent by [permitFaction_name] have arrived to help out. They will head home in [laborersDurationDays] days.
Rule.Raw: Laborers sent by [permitFaction_name] have arrived to help out. They will head home in [laborersDurationDays] days.
Rule.Translated: Los trabajadores enviados por [permitFaction_name] han llegado para ayudar. Volverán a casa en [laborersDurationDays] días.

Rule.Original: The laborers from [permitFaction_name] have finished their contract and are heading home.
Rule.Raw: The laborers from [permitFaction_name] have finished their contract and are heading home.
Rule.Translated: Los trabajadores de [permitFaction_name] han terminado su contrato y vuelven a casa.

Rule.Original: Laborers sent by [permitFaction_name] have arrived to help out. A shuttle will collect them in [laborersDurationDays] days.
Rule.Raw: Laborers sent by [permitFaction_name] have arrived to help out. A shuttle will collect them in [laborersDurationDays] days.
Rule.Translated: Los trabajadores enviados por [permitFaction_name] han llegado para ayudar. Una lanzadera los recogerá en [laborersDurationDays] días.

Rule.Original: A shuttle has arrived to collect the laborers from [permitFaction_name].
Rule.Raw: A shuttle has arrived to collect the laborers from [permitFaction_name].
Rule.Translated: Ha llegado una lanzadera para recoger a los trabajadores de [permitFaction_name].

Rule.Original: Learn the basics of constructing habitable structures in the void of space. Unlocks basic space station construction capabilities.
Rule.Raw: Learn the basics of constructing habitable structures in the void of space. Unlocks basic space station construction capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Aprende los fundamentos de la construcción de estructuras habitables en el vacío del espacio. Desbloquea las capacidades básicas de construcción de estaciones espaciales.

Rule.Original: Master advanced techniques for constructing larger and more efficient orbital installations. Reduces orbital platform construction costs by 25%.
Rule.Raw: Master advanced techniques for constructing larger and more efficient orbital installations. Reduces orbital platform construction costs by 25%.
Rule.Translated: Domina técnicas avanzadas para construir instalaciones orbitales más grandes y eficientes. Reduce los costes de construcción de plataformas orbitales en un 25%.

Rule.Original: Develop efficient systems for moving resources between orbital platforms and planetary surfaces. Reduces tax delivery time by 50% and unlocks special space station buildings.
Rule.Raw: Develop efficient systems for moving resources between orbital platforms and planetary surfaces. Reduces tax delivery time by 50% and unlocks special space station buildings.
Rule.Translated: Desarrolla sistemas eficientes para mover recursos entre plataformas orbitales y superficies planetarias. Reduce el tiempo de entrega de impuestos en un 50% y desbloquea edificios especiales de estación espacial.

Rule.Original: A vision of orbital living inspired by glitterworld engineering.
Rule.Raw: A vision of orbital living inspired by glitterworld engineering.
Rule.Translated: Una visión de la vida orbital inspirada en la ingeniería de los mundos relucientes.
Construcción de caminos de tierra de asentamiento

Rule.Original: Enables your Empire settlements to build dirt roads automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Raw: Enables your Empire settlements to build dirt roads automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Translated: Permite a tus asentamientos del Imperio construir caminos de tierra automáticamente con el tiempo. Los caminos construirán un segmento cada 3 días si la opción de construcción de carreteras está activada.
Construcción de caminos de piedra de asentamiento

Rule.Original: Enables your Empire settlements to build stone roads automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Raw: Enables your Empire settlements to build stone roads automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Translated: Permite a tus asentamientos del Imperio construir caminos de piedra automáticamente con el tiempo. Los caminos construirán un segmento cada 3 días si la opción de construcción de carreteras está activada.
Construcción de carreteras de asfalto de asentamiento

Rule.Original: Enables your Empire settlements to build asphalt roads automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Raw: Enables your Empire settlements to build asphalt roads automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Translated: Permite a tus asentamientos del Imperio construir carreteras de asfalto automáticamente con el tiempo. Los caminos construirán un segmento cada 3 días si la opción de construcción de carreteras está activada.
Construcción de autopistas de asfalto de asentamiento

Rule.Original: Enables your Empire settlements to build asphalt highways automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Raw: Enables your Empire settlements to build asphalt highways automatically over time. Roads will construct one segment every 3 days if the road building option is enabled.
Rule.Translated: Permite a tus asentamientos del Imperio construir autopistas de asfalto automáticamente con el tiempo. Los caminos construirán un segmento cada 3 días si la opción de construcción de carreteras está activada.
generador de energía de la facción

Rule.Original: Outputs energy created by your settlements to your colony!
Rule.Raw: Outputs energy created by your settlements to your colony!
Rule.Translated: ¡Envía a tu colonia la energía creada por tus asentamientos!

Rule.Original: Designates the seat of your Empire's capital. This location serves as the central reference point for travel calculations, event targeting, and administrative functions. Can be moved with your gravship empire.
Rule.Raw: Designates the seat of your Empire's capital. This location serves as the central reference point for travel calculations, event targeting, and administrative functions. Can be moved with your gravship empire.
Rule.Translated: Designa la sede de la capital de tu Imperio. Esta ubicación sirve como punto de referencia central para los cálculos de viaje, el direccionamiento de eventos y las funciones administrativas. Puede moverse con tu imperio de gravnaves.

Rule.Original: Designates a spot to receive taxes and tithes. Can be set as the active tax delivery location for your entire empire.
Rule.Raw: Designates a spot to receive taxes and tithes. Can be set as the active tax delivery location for your entire empire.
Rule.Translated: Designa un lugar para recibir impuestos y diezmos. Puede establecerse como la ubicación activa de entrega de impuestos para todo tu imperio.

Rule.Original: Animals flee this hell, the hardest stones cannot endure it; only men endure.
Rule.Raw: Animals flee this hell, the hardest stones cannot endure it; only men endure.
Rule.Translated: Los animales huyen de este infierno, las piedras más duras no lo soportan; solo los hombres resisten.

Rule.Original: A player-built orbital platform in space.
Rule.Raw: A player-built orbital platform in space.
Rule.Translated: Una plataforma orbital construida por el jugador en el espacio.

Rule.Original: A general-purpose orbital station. Produces all standard resources plus chemfuel and gravtech. Only raidable by spacer-tech factions. Battles auto-resolve only.
Rule.Raw: A general-purpose orbital station. Produces all standard resources plus chemfuel and gravtech. Only raidable by spacer-tech factions. Battles auto-resolve only.
Rule.Translated: Una estación orbital de uso general. Produce todos los recursos estándar más biocombustible y gravtech. Solo saqueable por facciones con tecnología espacial. Las batallas solo se resuelven automáticamente.

Rule.Original: A trade-focused orbital station. Unlocks exclusive buildings that increase tax rate and tithe value.
Rule.Raw: A trade-focused orbital station. Unlocks exclusive buildings that increase tax rate and tithe value.
Rule.Translated: Una estación orbital centrada en el comercio. Desbloquea edificios exclusivos que aumentan la tasa impositiva y el valor del diezmo.

Rule.Original: An industrial orbital station. Unlocks exclusive buildings that reduce construction time and boost animal and mining production.
Rule.Raw: An industrial orbital station. Unlocks exclusive buildings that reduce construction time and boost animal and mining production.
Rule.Translated: Una estación orbital industrial. Desbloquea edificios exclusivos que reducen el tiempo de construcción e impulsan la producción animal y minera.

Rule.Original: A high-tech orbital station. Unlocks exclusive buildings that enhance research output and military effectiveness.
Rule.Raw: A high-tech orbital station. Unlocks exclusive buildings that enhance research output and military effectiveness.
Rule.Translated: Una estación orbital de alta tecnología. Desbloquea edificios exclusivos que mejoran la producción de investigación y la eficacia militar.

Rule.Original: Disable/Enable MissileGirl features from anywhere using KeyBinds.
Rule.Raw: Disable/Enable MissileGirl features from anywhere using KeyBinds.
Rule.Translated: Activa o desactiva funciones de MissileGirl desde cualquier lugar mediante atajos de teclado.
Alternar modo de depuración de MissileGirl

Rule.Original: Airborne neurotoxin saturating the atmosphere. It paralyzes the pain receptors of local animals, driving them into a state of feral hyper-aggression.
Rule.Raw: Airborne neurotoxin saturating the atmosphere. It paralyzes the pain receptors of local animals, driving them into a state of feral hyper-aggression.
Rule.Translated: Una neurotoxina transportada por el aire satura la atmósfera. Paraliza los receptores del dolor de los animales locales y los vuelve salvajemente agresivos.
El aerosol bioquímico se está disipando.

Rule.Original:
Drifting silently across the region, a wave of airborne neurotoxin has saturated the atmosphere.
The compound interacts exclusively with the neural pathways of local fauna. It anesthetizes their pain receptors and drastically lowers their threshold for entering a manhunting state.
The toxin will linger for a few days. Exercise extreme caution when interacting with wildlife outdoors.
Rule.Raw:
Drifting silently across the region, a wave of airborne neurotoxin has saturated the atmosphere.
The compound interacts exclusively with the neural pathways of local fauna. It anesthetizes their pain receptors and drastically lowers their threshold for entering a manhunting state.
The toxin will linger for a few days. Exercise extreme caution when interacting with wildlife outdoors.
Rule.Translated:
Una oleada de neurotoxina transportada por el aire ha cruzado silenciosamente la región y saturado la atmósfera.
El compuesto solo interactúa con las vías neuronales de la fauna local. Anestesia sus receptores del dolor y reduce drásticamente el umbral para que empiecen a cazar humanos.
La toxina permanecerá unos días. Extrema las precauciones al interactuar con animales salvajes al aire libre.

Rule.Original: Low-frequency vibrations propagate through the ground, depressing the consciousness and reflexes of local animals.
Rule.Raw: Low-frequency vibrations propagate through the ground, depressing the consciousness and reflexes of local animals.
Rule.Translated: Vibraciones de baja frecuencia se propagan por el suelo y reducen la consciencia y los reflejos de los animales locales.

Rule.Original:
A deep, sustained infrasonic hum is vibrating through the ground.
This tectonic tremor directly disrupts the nervous systems of local fauna. This disruption numbs their consciousness, causing a noticeable slowdown in movement and close-quarters combat reflexes.
The tremor will pass within several days. Targets will remain sluggish and significantly easier to hunt or subdue until it ends.
Rule.Raw:
A deep, sustained infrasonic hum is vibrating through the ground.
This tectonic tremor directly disrupts the nervous systems of local fauna. This disruption numbs their consciousness, causing a noticeable slowdown in movement and close-quarters combat reflexes.
The tremor will pass within several days. Targets will remain sluggish and significantly easier to hunt or subdue until it ends.
Rule.Translated:
Un zumbido infrasónico profundo y sostenido hace vibrar el suelo.
Este temblor tectónico altera directamente el sistema nervioso de la fauna local. Embota su consciencia y ralentiza de forma notable sus movimientos y sus reflejos en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.
El temblor cesará en unos días. Hasta entonces, los animales seguirán aletargados y será mucho más fácil cazarlos o someterlos.

Rule.Original: Something in the air of this planet seems to put people in the mood to reproduce.
Rule.Raw: Something in the air of this planet seems to put people in the mood to reproduce.
Rule.Translated: Algo en el aire de este planeta parece despertar en las personas el deseo de reproducirse.
El efecto del afrodisíaco atmosférico está terminando.

Rule.Original:
A heavy surge of natural airborne pheromones has drifted into the troposphere.
This hormonal shift affects all biological entities in the area, making them far more prone to romantic advances and significantly increasing their drive to reproduce.
The pheromone cloud will last for a few days. Manage your colonists' social environments carefully to control relationship dynamics and potential pregnancies.
Rule.Raw:
A heavy surge of natural airborne pheromones has drifted into the troposphere.
This hormonal shift affects all biological entities in the area, making them far more prone to romantic advances and significantly increasing their drive to reproduce.
The pheromone cloud will last for a few days. Manage your colonists' social environments carefully to control relationship dynamics and potential pregnancies.
Rule.Translated:
Una intensa oleada de feromonas naturales transportadas por el aire ha llegado a la troposfera.
Este cambio hormonal afecta a todos los seres biológicos de la zona, que se vuelven mucho más propensos a las insinuaciones románticas y sienten un impulso reproductivo considerablemente mayor.
La nube de feromonas durará unos días. Gestiona con cuidado las relaciones sociales de tus colonos para controlar sus vínculos y los posibles embarazos.

Rule.Original: Volatile bio-excitants saturate the air, boosting cellular metabolism to elevate consciousness and double natural healing rates.
Rule.Raw: Volatile bio-excitants saturate the air, boosting cellular metabolism to elevate consciousness and double natural healing rates.
Rule.Translated: Los bioestimulantes volátiles saturan el aire y aceleran el metabolismo celular, lo que aumenta la consciencia y duplica la curación natural.
El efecto del estimulante atmosférico está terminando.

Rule.Original:
An atmospheric wave rich in volatile bio-excitants has blanketed the region.
Upon breathing these compounds, biological entities experience a rapid boost in metabolism. This elevates their general consciousness and doubles the natural healing rate of wounds and injuries.
The excitant will dissipate after a few days.
Rule.Raw:
An atmospheric wave rich in volatile bio-excitants has blanketed the region.
Upon breathing these compounds, biological entities experience a rapid boost in metabolism. This elevates their general consciousness and doubles the natural healing rate of wounds and injuries.
The excitant will dissipate after a few days.
Rule.Translated:
Una oleada atmosférica rica en bioestimulantes volátiles ha cubierto la región.
Al respirar estos compuestos, los seres biológicos experimentan un rápido aumento del metabolismo. Esto eleva su consciencia general y duplica la velocidad de curación natural de heridas y lesiones.
El estimulante se disipará al cabo de unos días.

Rule.Original: Airborne psychoactive spores induce widespread mild hallucinations, amplifying colony mood while degrading global work speed.
Rule.Raw: Airborne psychoactive spores induce widespread mild hallucinations, amplifying colony mood while degrading global work speed.
Rule.Translated: Las esporas psicoactivas transportadas por el aire provocan alucinaciones leves generalizadas, mejoran el ánimo de la colonia y reducen la velocidad de trabajo general.
El efecto del alucinógeno atmosférico está terminando.

Rule.Original:
The air of this planet contains a natural hallucinogen.
While this does keep people happy, it also distracts people from other work.
The spore cloud will hover over the region for a few days. Expect a significant drop in overall work speed across the settlement.
Rule.Raw:
The air of this planet contains a natural hallucinogen.
While this does keep people happy, it also distracts people from other work.
The spore cloud will hover over the region for a few days. Expect a significant drop in overall work speed across the settlement.
Rule.Translated:
El aire de este planeta contiene un alucinógeno natural.
Aunque mantiene a la gente contenta, también la distrae de su trabajo.
La nube de esporas permanecerá sobre la región unos días. Cabe esperar una caída considerable de la velocidad de trabajo general del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: A localized gravitational anomaly intensifies planetary pull, decreasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Raw: A localized gravitational anomaly intensifies planetary pull, decreasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía gravitatoria local intensifica la atracción planetaria y reduce la velocidad de movimiento y la capacidad de carga.

Rule.Original:
A massive gravitational anomaly has locked onto this region, warping the local planetary pull.
Every action feels heavier as the increased weight strains biological muscles and mechanical machinery. Colonists will move slower and their maximum carrying capacity will be severely restricted.
This compressed state will take several days to clear.
Rule.Raw:
A massive gravitational anomaly has locked onto this region, warping the local planetary pull.
Every action feels heavier as the increased weight strains biological muscles and mechanical machinery. Colonists will move slower and their maximum carrying capacity will be severely restricted.
This compressed state will take several days to clear.
Rule.Translated:
Una enorme anomalía gravitatoria se ha fijado sobre esta región y altera la atracción planetaria local.
Cada acción resulta más pesada, pues el aumento del peso fuerza tanto a los músculos biológicos como a la maquinaria. Los colonos se moverán más despacio y su capacidad máxima de carga quedará muy limitada.
Este estado de compresión tardará varios días en desaparecer.

Rule.Original: A localized gravitational anomaly weakens planetary pull, increasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Raw: A localized gravitational anomaly weakens planetary pull, increasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía gravitatoria local debilita la atracción planetaria y aumenta la velocidad de movimiento y la capacidad de carga.

Rule.Original:
A massive gravitational anomaly has locked onto this region, warping the local planetary pull.
Every action feels lighter as the reduced weight eases biological muscles and mechanical machinery. Colonists will move faster and their maximum carrying capacity will be greatly expanded.
This liberated state will take several days to clear.
Rule.Raw:
A massive gravitational anomaly has locked onto this region, warping the local planetary pull.
Every action feels lighter as the reduced weight eases biological muscles and mechanical machinery. Colonists will move faster and their maximum carrying capacity will be greatly expanded.
This liberated state will take several days to clear.
Rule.Translated:
Una enorme anomalía gravitatoria se ha fijado sobre esta región y altera la atracción planetaria local.
Cada acción resulta más ligera, pues la reducción del peso alivia tanto a los músculos biológicos como a la maquinaria. Los colonos se moverán más deprisa y su capacidad máxima de carga aumentará considerablemente.
Este estado de ligereza tardará varios días en desaparecer.

Rule.Original: A peculiar quantum dissipation wave permeates local space, causing electromagnetic pulses to decay rapidly and significantly shortening the stun duration of mechanical targets.
Rule.Raw: A peculiar quantum dissipation wave permeates local space, causing electromagnetic pulses to decay rapidly and significantly shortening the stun duration of mechanical targets.
Rule.Translated: Una peculiar onda de disipación cuántica impregna el espacio local, hace que los pulsos electromagnéticos se disipen rápidamente y acorta mucho la duración del aturdimiento de los objetivos mecánicos.
La disipación de EMP está terminando.

Rule.Original:
A volatile energy dissipation anomaly has locked onto this sector.
This damping field forces high-energy electromagnetic discharge to ground and diffuses almost instantly. Consequently、any mechanoids or electronic entities subjected to an EMP strike will experience accelerated dissipation of their overloaded internal charge, drastically reducing their downtime from stuns and system malfunctions.
This interference will persist for several days. During this window, traditional EMP crowd-control measures will be highly ineffective.
Rule.Raw:
A volatile energy dissipation anomaly has locked onto this sector.
This damping field forces high-energy electromagnetic discharge to ground and diffuses almost instantly. Consequently、any mechanoids or electronic entities subjected to an EMP strike will experience accelerated dissipation of their overloaded internal charge, drastically reducing their downtime from stuns and system malfunctions.
This interference will persist for several days. During this window, traditional EMP crowd-control measures will be highly ineffective.
Rule.Translated:
Una anomalía volátil de disipación energética se ha fijado sobre este sector.
Este campo amortiguador deriva a tierra las descargas electromagnéticas de alta energía y las disipa casi al instante. Por ello, los mecanoides y seres electrónicos que reciban un impacto EMP descargarán antes su sobrecarga interna y permanecerán mucho menos tiempo inactivos por aturdimientos y fallos del sistema.
La interferencia persistirá varios días. Durante este periodo, las medidas tradicionales de control mediante EMP serán muy poco eficaces.

Rule.Original: Intense subspace noise floods the regional spectrum, disrupting mechanoid diagnostic protocols and shortening their EMP adaptation immunity time.
Rule.Raw: Intense subspace noise floods the regional spectrum, disrupting mechanoid diagnostic protocols and shortening their EMP adaptation immunity time.
Rule.Translated: Un intenso ruido subespacial inunda el espectro regional, altera los protocolos de diagnóstico de los mecanoides y acorta su inmunidad por adaptación a los EMP.

Rule.Original:
A cascading torrent of high-intensity subspace noise has blanketed the entire region.
This chaotic frequency directly paralyzes the background algorithmic subroutines that mechanoids use to establish post-EMP electromagnetic barriers. Deprived of this safety buffer, mechanized hostile forces will be unable to maintain their adaptive immunity, allowing them to be restunned much sooner after an initial EMP strike.
The subspace storm will rage for several days. This creates a critical tactical window to deploy high-frequency EMP armaments and neutralize localized mechanoid threats.
Rule.Raw:
A cascading torrent of high-intensity subspace noise has blanketed the entire region.
This chaotic frequency directly paralyzes the background algorithmic subroutines that mechanoids use to establish post-EMP electromagnetic barriers. Deprived of this safety buffer, mechanized hostile forces will be unable to maintain their adaptive immunity, allowing them to be restunned much sooner after an initial EMP strike.
The subspace storm will rage for several days. This creates a critical tactical window to deploy high-frequency EMP armaments and neutralize localized mechanoid threats.
Rule.Translated:
Un torrente de ruido subespacial de alta intensidad ha cubierto toda la región.
Esta frecuencia caótica paraliza directamente las subrutinas que los mecanoides utilizan en segundo plano para establecer barreras electromagnéticas tras recibir un EMP. Sin esta protección, las fuerzas mecánicas hostiles no podrán mantener su inmunidad adaptativa y será posible volver a aturdirlas mucho antes tras el primer impacto EMP.
La tormenta subespacial durará varios días. Esto abre una oportunidad táctica crucial para desplegar armamento EMP de alta frecuencia y neutralizar las amenazas mecanoides locales.

Rule.Original: A localized microclimatic cooling anomaly enables hardware overclocking in mechanoids, increasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Raw: A localized microclimatic cooling anomaly enables hardware overclocking in mechanoids, increasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía microclimática de enfriamiento permite que los mecanoides aumenten la frecuencia de su hardware, mejorando su consciencia, coordinación de apuntado y cadencia de disparo.
El aumento de frecuencia de los mecanoides está terminando.

Rule.Original:
A sudden microclimatic cooling anomaly has developed across the local environment.
The optimized thermal conditions trigger automatic hardware overclocking across all mechanoid networks. Affected mechanoids will exhibit heightened systemic consciousness, razor-sharp aiming coordination, and accelerated weapon cooling rates.
This hyper-reactive state will last for a few days. This creates a dangerous period where tactical caution is advised, as mechanical forces operate well above their baseline parameters.
Rule.Raw:
A sudden microclimatic cooling anomaly has developed across the local environment.
The optimized thermal conditions trigger automatic hardware overclocking across all mechanoid networks. Affected mechanoids will exhibit heightened systemic consciousness, razor-sharp aiming coordination, and accelerated weapon cooling rates.
This hyper-reactive state will last for a few days. This creates a dangerous period where tactical caution is advised, as mechanical forces operate well above their baseline parameters.
Rule.Translated:
Una repentina anomalía microclimática de enfriamiento se ha extendido por el entorno local.
Las condiciones térmicas óptimas activan automáticamente un aumento de frecuencia del hardware en todas las redes mecanoides. Los mecanoides afectados mostrarán una consciencia sistémica superior, una coordinación de apuntado extraordinaria y una refrigeración más rápida de sus armas.
Este estado de hiperactividad durará unos días. Será un periodo peligroso que exigirá cautela táctica, pues las fuerzas mecánicas operarán muy por encima de sus parámetros habituales.

Rule.Original: A localized microclimatic thermal anomaly forces hardware throttling in mechanoids, decreasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Raw: A localized microclimatic thermal anomaly forces hardware throttling in mechanoids, decreasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía térmica microclimática obliga a los mecanoides a reducir la frecuencia de su hardware, disminuyendo su consciencia, coordinación de apuntado y cadencia de disparo.
La reducción de frecuencia de los mecanoides está terminando.

Rule.Original:
A sudden microclimatic thermal anomaly has developed across the local environment.
The degraded thermal conditions trigger automatic hardware throttling across all mechanoid networks. Affected mechanoids will suffer from diminished systemic consciousness, compromised aiming coordination, and decelerated weapon cooling rates.
This sluggish-reactive state will last for a few days. This creates an excellent opportunity where proactive assault is advised, as mechanical forces operate well below their baseline parameters.
Rule.Raw:
A sudden microclimatic thermal anomaly has developed across the local environment.
The degraded thermal conditions trigger automatic hardware throttling across all mechanoid networks. Affected mechanoids will suffer from diminished systemic consciousness, compromised aiming coordination, and decelerated weapon cooling rates.
This sluggish-reactive state will last for a few days. This creates an excellent opportunity where proactive assault is advised, as mechanical forces operate well below their baseline parameters.
Rule.Translated:
Una repentina anomalía térmica microclimática se ha extendido por el entorno local.
Las malas condiciones térmicas activan automáticamente una reducción de frecuencia del hardware en todas las redes mecanoides. Los mecanoides afectados sufrirán una menor consciencia sistémica, peor coordinación de apuntado y una refrigeración más lenta de sus armas.
Este estado de lentitud durará unos días. Será una excelente oportunidad para tomar la iniciativa y atacar, pues las fuerzas mecánicas operarán muy por debajo de sus parámetros habituales.

Rule.Original: A high-frequency spatial instability causes localized collapses, causing entities to spontaneously teleport short distances.
Rule.Raw: A high-frequency spatial instability causes localized collapses, causing entities to spontaneously teleport short distances.
Rule.Translated: Una inestabilidad espacial de alta frecuencia provoca colapsos locales que hacen que las entidades se teletransporten espontáneamente a corta distancia.
La inestabilidad espacial se ha estabilizado.

Rule.Original:
A wave of high-frequency dimensional interference is sweeping across the region.
Space-time coordinates are becoming fluid and unstable. Localized quantum micro-collapses will cause both biological and mechanical entities to randomly "skip" and teleport between nearby positions without warning.
The interference will persist for a few days. Be prepared for tactical chaos, as positioning during combat or standard routines will be highly unpredictable.
Rule.Raw:
A wave of high-frequency dimensional interference is sweeping across the region.
Space-time coordinates are becoming fluid and unstable. Localized quantum micro-collapses will cause both biological and mechanical entities to randomly "skip" and teleport between nearby positions without warning.
The interference will persist for a few days. Be prepared for tactical chaos, as positioning during combat or standard routines will be highly unpredictable.
Rule.Translated:
Una oleada de interferencia dimensional de alta frecuencia recorre la región.
Las coordenadas espaciotemporales se vuelven variables e inestables. Los microcolapsos cuánticos locales harán que tanto los seres biológicos como los mecánicos den «saltos» aleatorios y se teletransporten entre posiciones cercanas sin previo aviso.
La interferencia persistirá unos días. Prepárate para el caos táctico, pues las posiciones durante el combate y las tareas habituales serán muy impredecibles.

Rule.Original: A cascade of glowing embers falls from the sky, threatening to ignite any flammable objects left unroofed.
Rule.Raw: A cascade of glowing embers falls from the sky, threatening to ignite any flammable objects left unroofed.
Rule.Translated: Una cascada de brasas incandescentes cae del cielo y amenaza con incendiar los objetos inflamables que estén sin techo.
La lluvia de brasas está terminando.

Rule.Original:
A dense cloud of burning, glowing embers has begun to rain down from the sky, bathing the entire landscape in a dull crimson light.
The ambient heat from these embers poses a constant fire hazard. Any flammable items, wooden structures, or crops exposed directly to the sky run a continuous risk of spontaneously catching fire.
The fallout will last for several days or more. Ensure all critical stockpiles are roofed, and keep your fire-fighting colonists ready to respond to outdoor ignitions.
Rule.Raw:
A dense cloud of burning, glowing embers has begun to rain down from the sky, bathing the entire landscape in a dull crimson light.
The ambient heat from these embers poses a constant fire hazard. Any flammable items, wooden structures, or crops exposed directly to the sky run a continuous risk of spontaneously catching fire.
The fallout will last for several days or more. Ensure all critical stockpiles are roofed, and keep your fire-fighting colonists ready to respond to outdoor ignitions.
Rule.Translated:
Una densa nube de brasas ardientes y luminosas ha empezado a caer del cielo y baña todo el paisaje con una tenue luz carmesí.
El calor que desprenden supone un riesgo constante de incendio. Todos los objetos inflamables, estructuras de madera y cultivos expuestos directamente al cielo corren el riesgo continuo de prender espontáneamente.
La lluvia de brasas durará varios días o más. Asegúrate de techar los almacenes importantes y mantén a los colonos encargados de apagar incendios preparados para actuar al aire libre.

Rule.Original: A psychic harmony triggers a map-wide Gauranlen tree bloom, preventing connection decay and increasing pruning speed.
Rule.Raw: A psychic harmony triggers a map-wide Gauranlen tree bloom, preventing connection decay and increasing pruning speed.
Rule.Translated: Una armonía psíquica provoca la floración de los árboles Gauranlen de todo el mapa, impide que se debilite la conexión y acelera la poda.

Rule.Original:
The Gauranlen trees on this map have entered a rare state of synchronized, psychic-fueled bloom.
The unique resonance locks the psychic bond of your tree-connectors. For the duration of this event, Gauranlen connection strength will not degrade over time, and the speed of all pruning work is significantly increased.
The bloom will last for a few weeks. Use this opportunity to maximize your dryad counts or reassign your connector to other tasks temporarily without penalty.
Rule.Raw:
The Gauranlen trees on this map have entered a rare state of synchronized, psychic-fueled bloom.
The unique resonance locks the psychic bond of your tree-connectors. For the duration of this event, Gauranlen connection strength will not degrade over time, and the speed of all pruning work is significantly increased.
The bloom will last for a few weeks. Use this opportunity to maximize your dryad counts or reassign your connector to other tasks temporarily without penalty.
Rule.Translated:
Los árboles gauranlen de este mapa han entrado en un raro estado de floración sincronizada alimentada por energía psíquica.
Esta resonancia singular estabiliza el vínculo psíquico de quienes están conectados a los árboles. Mientras dure el evento, la fuerza de conexión gauranlen no disminuirá con el tiempo y todas las tareas de poda serán mucho más rápidas.
La floración durará unas semanas. Aprovecha para maximizar el número de dríades o asignar temporalmente otras tareas a quienes mantienen los vínculos, sin penalización.

Rule.Original: A cloud of autonomous mechanites descends, mending outdoor structures while risking mechanite infections in unroofed biological hosts.
Rule.Raw: A cloud of autonomous mechanites descends, mending outdoor structures while risking mechanite infections in unroofed biological hosts.
Rule.Translated: Desciende una nube de mecanitos autónomos que repara estructuras exteriores, pero puede infectar con mecanitos a los huéspedes biológicos que estén sin techo.
La nube de mecanitos se está disipando.

Rule.Original:
A shimmering cloud of autonomous, microscopic mechanites has drifted into the local atmosphere.
These rogue machines are programmed for structural maintenance, automatically mending damaged outdoor walls and furniture. However, they will also aggressively interface with biological hosts; colonists left exposed to the open sky risk contracting sensory or fibrous mechanite infections.
This active state will persist for a few days. Restrict your colonists to roofed areas to avoid biological infection while exploiting the free structural repairs.
Rule.Raw:
A shimmering cloud of autonomous, microscopic mechanites has drifted into the local atmosphere.
These rogue machines are programmed for structural maintenance, automatically mending damaged outdoor walls and furniture. However, they will also aggressively interface with biological hosts; colonists left exposed to the open sky risk contracting sensory or fibrous mechanite infections.
This active state will persist for a few days. Restrict your colonists to roofed areas to avoid biological infection while exploiting the free structural repairs.
Rule.Translated:
Una nube brillante de mecanitos microscópicos autónomos ha llegado a la atmósfera local.
Estas máquinas fuera de control están programadas para el mantenimiento estructural y reparan automáticamente los muros y muebles exteriores dañados. Sin embargo, también interactúan agresivamente con huéspedes biológicos: los colonos expuestos al cielo corren el riesgo de contraer infecciones de mecanitos sensoriales o fibrosos.
Este estado activo persistirá unos días. Limita a tus colonos a zonas techadas para evitar las infecciones mientras aprovechas las reparaciones gratuitas.

Rule.Original: The trees are awakening, though they previously appeared dormant.
Rule.Raw: The trees are awakening, though they previously appeared dormant.
Rule.Translated: Los árboles están despertando, aunque antes parecían inactivos.
Los árboles han despertado por completo.

Rule.Original:
The pawn has found that the trees are mobile to various degrees, though they previously appeared dormant.
They clearly possess some form of rudimentary intelligence.
Rule.Raw:
The pawn has found that the trees are mobile to various degrees, though they previously appeared dormant.
They clearly possess some form of rudimentary intelligence.
Rule.Translated:
El peón ha descubierto que los árboles pueden moverse en distintos grados, aunque antes parecían inactivos.
Es evidente que poseen alguna forma de inteligencia rudimentaria.

Rule.Original: A cloud of exotic matter destabilizes advanced technologies. All equipment above the Industrial tech level suffers penalties to weapon cooldown, armor ratings, and energy shielding.
Rule.Raw: A cloud of exotic matter destabilizes advanced technologies. All equipment above the Industrial tech level suffers penalties to weapon cooldown, armor ratings, and energy shielding.
Rule.Translated: Una nube de materia exótica desestabiliza las tecnologías avanzadas. Todo el equipo de nivel tecnológico superior al industrial sufre penalizaciones al tiempo de recarga de las armas, la protección del blindaje y los escudos de energía.
La turbulencia subatómica se está disipando.

Rule.Original:
A localized subatomic turbulence has begun. The chaotic particle flow is interfering with advanced computing and energy-directing machinery.
High-precision weapons, advanced armors, and specialized tools will be weakened until the cloud passes. Industrial and primitive gear remain unaffected due to their simpler physical structures.
The turbulence will pass in a few days.
Rule.Raw:
A localized subatomic turbulence has begun. The chaotic particle flow is interfering with advanced computing and energy-directing machinery.
High-precision weapons, advanced armors, and specialized tools will be weakened until the cloud passes. Industrial and primitive gear remain unaffected due to their simpler physical structures.
The turbulence will pass in a few days.
Rule.Translated:
Ha comenzado una turbulencia subatómica local. El flujo caótico de partículas interfiere con la informática avanzada y la maquinaria de dirección energética.
Las armas de alta precisión, las armaduras avanzadas y las herramientas especializadas quedarán debilitadas hasta que pase la nube. El equipo industrial y primitivo no se ve afectado gracias a su estructura física más sencilla.
La turbulencia desaparecerá en unos días.

Rule.Original: A prolonged dry weather pattern forces clear skies, parching the land and reducing plant growth speed.
Rule.Raw: A prolonged dry weather pattern forces clear skies, parching the land and reducing plant growth speed.
Rule.Translated: Un periodo prolongado de tiempo seco mantiene los cielos despejados, reseca la tierra y reduce la velocidad de crecimiento de las plantas.

Rule.Original: The dry spell has broken, and the air feels moist again.
Rule.Raw: The dry spell has broken, and the air feels moist again.
Rule.Translated: La sequía ha terminado y el aire vuelve a estar húmedo.

Rule.Original:
A prolonged dry spell has settled over the region, locking the weather to completely clear skies.
The high atmospheric pressure prevents any cloud formation, parching the soil and stunting the development of all local vegetation. Plant growth speeds will be reduced across the map.
The dry pattern will persist for a few days. Ensure your agricultural fields are well-maintained, and prepare for potential food shortages if the drought lingers.
Rule.Raw:
A prolonged dry spell has settled over the region, locking the weather to completely clear skies.
The high atmospheric pressure prevents any cloud formation, parching the soil and stunting the development of all local vegetation. Plant growth speeds will be reduced across the map.
The dry pattern will persist for a few days. Ensure your agricultural fields are well-maintained, and prepare for potential food shortages if the drought lingers.
Rule.Translated:
Una sequía prolongada se ha instalado en la región y mantiene el cielo completamente despejado.
La alta presión atmosférica impide que se formen nubes, reseca el suelo y frena el desarrollo de toda la vegetación local. El crecimiento de las plantas se ralentizará en todo el mapa.
La sequía persistirá unos días. Cuida bien los campos de cultivo y prepárate para posibles escaseces de alimentos si se prolonga.

Rule.Original: A temporary shift in environmental variables optimizes soil conditions, significantly increasing plant growth speed.
Rule.Raw: A temporary shift in environmental variables optimizes soil conditions, significantly increasing plant growth speed.
Rule.Translated: Un cambio temporal de las variables ambientales optimiza las condiciones del suelo y aumenta mucho la velocidad de crecimiento de las plantas.

Rule.Original: The bountiful growth period has ended.
Rule.Raw: The bountiful growth period has ended.
Rule.Translated: El periodo de crecimiento abundante ha terminado.

Rule.Original:
A wave of high organic vitality has swept through the local ecosystem.
Environmental variables and atmospheric humidity are currently optimized for rapid plant development, unnaturally boosting the growth rates of all crops and wild flora.
This surge of life will last for a few days. Take advantage of this window to sow slow-growing, high-yield crops that would normally take much longer to mature.
Rule.Raw:
A wave of high organic vitality has swept through the local ecosystem.
Environmental variables and atmospheric humidity are currently optimized for rapid plant development, unnaturally boosting the growth rates of all crops and wild flora.
This surge of life will last for a few days. Take advantage of this window to sow slow-growing, high-yield crops that would normally take much longer to mature.
Rule.Translated:
Una oleada de intensa vitalidad orgánica ha recorrido el ecosistema local.
Las condiciones ambientales y la humedad atmosférica son óptimas para un desarrollo rápido de las plantas, lo que aumenta de forma antinatural el crecimiento de todos los cultivos y la flora silvestre.
Este auge de vida durará unos días. Aprovecha para sembrar cultivos de crecimiento lento y gran rendimiento que normalmente tardarían mucho más en madurar.

Rule.Original: An influx of organic nutrients saturates the ecosystem, significantly increasing harvest yields from all plants.
Rule.Raw: An influx of organic nutrients saturates the ecosystem, significantly increasing harvest yields from all plants.
Rule.Translated: Una afluencia de nutrientes orgánicos satura el ecosistema y aumenta mucho el rendimiento de las cosechas de todas las plantas.

Rule.Original: A nutrient surge is enriching the soil. Harvests will be more bountiful.
Rule.Raw: A nutrient surge is enriching the soil. Harvests will be more bountiful.
Rule.Translated: Una oleada de nutrientes está enriqueciendo el suelo. Las cosechas serán más abundantes.
La oleada de nutrientes se ha disipado.

Rule.Original:
A sudden influx of hyper-potent organic nutrients is flowing through the local soil and water tables.
This sudden enrichment allows plants to develop dense, high-grade yields, meaning any agricultural or wild plant harvested during this period will produce significantly more food and materials.
The nutrient surge will enrich the map for a few days. Order your growers to prioritize harvesting mature crops immediately to maximize your food reserves.
Rule.Raw:
A sudden influx of hyper-potent organic nutrients is flowing through the local soil and water tables.
This sudden enrichment allows plants to develop dense, high-grade yields, meaning any agricultural or wild plant harvested during this period will produce significantly more food and materials.
The nutrient surge will enrich the map for a few days. Order your growers to prioritize harvesting mature crops immediately to maximize your food reserves.
Rule.Translated:
Una repentina afluencia de nutrientes orgánicos extraordinariamente potentes recorre el suelo y las aguas subterráneas locales.
Este enriquecimiento permite que las plantas desarrollen cosechas abundantes y de gran calidad, de modo que cualquier planta cultivada o silvestre cosechada durante este periodo producirá muchos más alimentos y materiales.
Los nutrientes enriquecerán el mapa durante unos días. Ordena a tus agricultores que prioricen de inmediato los cultivos maduros para maximizar tus reservas de comida.

Rule.Original: Anomalous environmental shifts alter localized dielectric constants, increasing polarization loss to depress the net efficiency of all power generators and batteries.
Rule.Raw: Anomalous environmental shifts alter localized dielectric constants, increasing polarization loss to depress the net efficiency of all power generators and batteries.
Rule.Translated: Los cambios ambientales anómalos alteran las constantes dieléctricas locales y aumentan las pérdidas de polarización, reduciendo la eficiencia neta de todos los generadores eléctricos y baterías.

Rule.Original:
An anomalous electromagnetic shift has distorted the localized dielectric continuum.
This environmental aberration destabilizes molecular polarization within electrical infrastructures. Throughout the grid, power generators will experience severe efficiency choking due to heightened dielectric dielectric loss, while batteries suffer from systemic charge leakage.
The degradation will persist for a few days. Minimize non-essential power loads to prevent grid-wide brownouts.
Rule.Raw:
An anomalous electromagnetic shift has distorted the localized dielectric continuum.
This environmental aberration destabilizes molecular polarization within electrical infrastructures. Throughout the grid, power generators will experience severe efficiency choking due to heightened dielectric dielectric loss, while batteries suffer from systemic charge leakage.
The degradation will persist for a few days. Minimize non-essential power loads to prevent grid-wide brownouts.
Rule.Translated:
Un cambio electromagnético anómalo ha distorsionado el continuo dieléctrico local.
Esta aberración ambiental desestabiliza la polarización molecular de las instalaciones eléctricas. En toda la red, los generadores sufrirán una grave reducción de eficiencia por el aumento de las pérdidas dieléctricas, mientras que las baterías perderán carga de forma generalizada.
El deterioro persistirá unos días. Reduce el consumo eléctrico no esencial para evitar caídas de tensión en toda la red.

Rule.Original: Anomalous environmental shifts alter localized dielectric constants, minimizing polarization loss to enhance the net efficiency of all power generators and batteries.
Rule.Raw: Anomalous environmental shifts alter localized dielectric constants, minimizing polarization loss to enhance the net efficiency of all power generators and batteries.
Rule.Translated: Los cambios ambientales anómalos alteran las constantes dieléctricas locales y minimizan las pérdidas de polarización, mejorando la eficiencia neta de todos los generadores eléctricos y baterías.

Rule.Original:
An anomalous electromagnetic shift has organized the localized dielectric continuum.
This environmental alignment synchronizes molecular polarization within electrical infrastructures. Throughout the grid, power generators will experience severe efficiency boosting due to minimize dielectric loss, while batteries benefit from systemic charge buffering.
The optimization will persist for a few days. Maximize high-consumption operations to leverage the temporary grid surplus.
Rule.Raw:
An anomalous electromagnetic shift has organized the localized dielectric continuum.
This environmental alignment synchronizes molecular polarization within electrical infrastructures. Throughout the grid, power generators will experience severe efficiency boosting due to minimize dielectric loss, while batteries benefit from systemic charge buffering.
The optimization will persist for a few days. Maximize high-consumption operations to leverage the temporary grid surplus.
Rule.Translated:
Un cambio electromagnético anómalo ha ordenado el continuo dieléctrico local.
Esta alineación ambiental sincroniza la polarización molecular de las instalaciones eléctricas. En toda la red, los generadores mejorarán considerablemente su eficiencia gracias a la reducción de las pérdidas dieléctricas, mientras que las baterías se beneficiarán de una mayor conservación de la carga.
La mejora persistirá unos días. Aprovecha el excedente temporal de la red para realizar tareas de alto consumo.

Rule.Original: Aggressive psychic signals sweep the region, increasing social conflict, violent impulses, and prisoner resistance.
Rule.Raw: Aggressive psychic signals sweep the region, increasing social conflict, violent impulses, and prisoner resistance.
Rule.Translated: Señales psíquicas agresivas barren la región y aumentan los conflictos sociales, los impulsos violentos y la resistencia de los prisioneros.

Rule.Original:
Psychic signals are filling the area, projecting feelings of aggression into the minds of everyone.
Colonists will be quick to anger. They are twice as likely to start social fights. When they have mental breaks, they are twice as likely to choose an aggressive kind of break.
The signals will blanket the region for several days. Keep problematic individuals separated and avoid heavy social interactions to minimize internal conflict.
Rule.Raw:
Psychic signals are filling the area, projecting feelings of aggression into the minds of everyone.
Colonists will be quick to anger. They are twice as likely to start social fights. When they have mental breaks, they are twice as likely to choose an aggressive kind of break.
The signals will blanket the region for several days. Keep problematic individuals separated and avoid heavy social interactions to minimize internal conflict.
Rule.Translated:
Unas señales psíquicas llenan la zona y proyectan sentimientos de agresividad en la mente de todo el mundo.
Los colonos se enfadarán con facilidad. Tendrán el doble de probabilidades de iniciar peleas sociales. Cuando sufran crisis mentales, tendrán el doble de probabilidades de que sean agresivas.
Las señales cubrirán la región varios días. Mantén separadas a las personas problemáticas y evita las interacciones sociales intensas para reducir los conflictos internos.

Rule.Original: Calming psychic signals sweep the region, quelling social conflict, violent impulses, and prisoner unrest.
Rule.Raw: Calming psychic signals sweep the region, quelling social conflict, violent impulses, and prisoner unrest.
Rule.Translated: Señales psíquicas calmantes barren la región y apaciguan los conflictos sociales, los impulsos violentos y la agitación de los prisioneros.

Rule.Original:
Psychic signals are filling the area, projecting feelings of calming into the minds of everyone.
Colonists will feel calm in every situation and have a very placid demeanor. They will never start social fights or have aggressive mental breaks.
The signals will blanket the region for several days.
Rule.Raw:
Psychic signals are filling the area, projecting feelings of calming into the minds of everyone.
Colonists will feel calm in every situation and have a very placid demeanor. They will never start social fights or have aggressive mental breaks.
The signals will blanket the region for several days.
Rule.Translated:
Unas señales psíquicas llenan la zona y proyectan sentimientos de calma en la mente de todo el mundo.
Los colonos se sentirán tranquilos en cualquier situación y tendrán un comportamiento muy apacible. Nunca iniciarán peleas sociales ni sufrirán crisis mentales agresivas.
Las señales cubrirán la región varios días.

Rule.Original: An intense field of anti-psychic interference neutralizes psychic cognition, preventing the use of psycasts and psychic technology.
Rule.Raw: An intense field of anti-psychic interference neutralizes psychic cognition, preventing the use of psycasts and psychic technology.
Rule.Translated: Un intenso campo de interferencia antipsíquica neutraliza la cognición psíquica e impide utilizar poderes y tecnología psíquicos.
La zona muerta psíquica está desapareciendo.

Rule.Original:
A massive field of absolute anti-psychic interference has blanketed the region.
The localized field completely dampens all psychic wavelengths, reducing the psychic sensitivity of all individuals to zero.
The deadzone will take a few days to clear.
Rule.Raw:
A massive field of absolute anti-psychic interference has blanketed the region.
The localized field completely dampens all psychic wavelengths, reducing the psychic sensitivity of all individuals to zero.
The deadzone will take a few days to clear.
Rule.Translated:
Un enorme campo de interferencia antipsíquica absoluta ha cubierto la región.
El campo local amortigua por completo todas las longitudes de onda psíquicas y reduce a cero la sensibilidad psíquica de todas las personas.
La zona muerta tardará unos días en desaparecer.

Rule.Original: A localized psychic ripple amplifies emotional volatility, doubling the intensity of all thought-based mood modifiers.
Rule.Raw: A localized psychic ripple amplifies emotional volatility, doubling the intensity of all thought-based mood modifiers.
Rule.Translated: Una onda psíquica local amplifica la volatilidad emocional y duplica la intensidad de todos los modificadores de ánimo basados en pensamientos.

Rule.Original:
A powerful psychic ripple is bouncing across the local area, acting as a cognitive amplifier for raw emotion.
The echo distorts perceptions: positive thoughts will feel like pure bliss, while negative thoughts and pain will cut twice as deep. Every mood modifier, good or bad, has its impact doubled.
The echo will persist for a few days. Keep your colony pampered and comfortable, as a single bad thought can spiral into an immediate mental break.
Rule.Raw:
A powerful psychic ripple is bouncing across the local area, acting as a cognitive amplifier for raw emotion.
The echo distorts perceptions: positive thoughts will feel like pure bliss, while negative thoughts and pain will cut twice as deep. Every mood modifier, good or bad, has its impact doubled.
The echo will persist for a few days. Keep your colony pampered and comfortable, as a single bad thought can spiral into an immediate mental break.
Rule.Translated:
Una poderosa onda psíquica rebota por la zona y amplifica cognitivamente las emociones.
El eco distorsiona las percepciones: los pensamientos positivos se sentirán como una felicidad absoluta, mientras que los negativos y el dolor calarán el doble. Todos los modificadores de ánimo, buenos o malos, duplican su efecto.
El eco persistirá unos días. Mantén a tu colonia cómoda y satisfecha, pues un solo pensamiento negativo puede desencadenar de inmediato una crisis mental.

Rule.Original: An archotech high-frequency pulse of unknown origin has swept through the system. This signal seems to have bypassed the physical world entirely, altering only the higher-dimensional transcendent consciousness...
Rule.Raw: An archotech high-frequency pulse of unknown origin has swept through the system. This signal seems to have bypassed the physical world entirely, altering only the higher-dimensional transcendent consciousness...
Rule.Translated: Un pulso arcotecnológico de alta frecuencia y origen desconocido ha recorrido el sistema. La señal parece haber eludido por completo el mundo físico y alterado únicamente la consciencia trascendente de dimensiones superiores...

Rule.Original:
An unknown archotech node has been activated. It possesses no physical lethality, nor does it inflict any actual disruption upon colonists.
However, certain "non-three-dimensional" observation noises are being forcefully injected into the hyper-dimensional entity currently gazing down upon this land.
Through the eyes of this transcendent consciousness, the world will appear to burn, infrastructure will seem to crumble, and phantom alarms of impending doom will echo in its mind.
Rule.Raw:
An unknown archotech node has been activated. It possesses no physical lethality, nor does it inflict any actual disruption upon colonists.
However, certain "non-three-dimensional" observation noises are being forcefully injected into the hyper-dimensional entity currently gazing down upon this land.
Through the eyes of this transcendent consciousness, the world will appear to burn, infrastructure will seem to crumble, and phantom alarms of impending doom will echo in its mind.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha activado un nodo arcotecnológico desconocido. No tiene capacidad letal física ni causa alteraciones reales a los colonos.
Sin embargo, está introduciendo a la fuerza ciertos ruidos de observación «no tridimensionales» en la entidad hiperdimensional que contempla estas tierras.
A través de los ojos de esta consciencia trascendente, parecerá que el mundo arde, las infraestructuras se derrumban y unas alarmas fantasmales de destrucción inminente resonarán en su mente.

Rule.Original: A world-wide surge of cultural appreciation skyrockets the market value of sculptures and art pieces.
Rule.Raw: A world-wide surge of cultural appreciation skyrockets the market value of sculptures and art pieces.
Rule.Translated: Un auge mundial del aprecio por la cultura dispara el valor de mercado de esculturas y obras de arte.

Rule.Original:
A sudden golden age of cultural appreciation has swept through the regional trade networks.
Wealthy collectors and interstellar merchants are paying premium prices for human creativity. Art pieces, sculptures, and fine crafts can now be sold for significantly higher prices than usual.
The renaissance will last for several days. Empty your art storage and sell your stockpiled works to passing traders for maximum profit while demand peaks.
Rule.Raw:
A sudden golden age of cultural appreciation has swept through the regional trade networks.
Wealthy collectors and interstellar merchants are paying premium prices for human creativity. Art pieces, sculptures, and fine crafts can now be sold for significantly higher prices than usual.
The renaissance will last for several days. Empty your art storage and sell your stockpiled works to passing traders for maximum profit while demand peaks.
Rule.Translated:
Una repentina edad de oro de apreciación cultural ha recorrido las redes comerciales de la región.
Los coleccionistas adinerados y los comerciantes interestelares pagan precios excepcionales por la creatividad humana. Las obras de arte, esculturas y artesanías finas pueden venderse ahora por mucho más de lo habitual.
Este renacimiento durará varios días. Vacía tus almacenes de arte y vende las obras acumuladas a los comerciantes de paso para maximizar los beneficios mientras la demanda está en su punto álgido.

Rule.Original: A systemic failure in trade networks paralyzes the regional economy, devaluing your goods while inflating merchant prices.
Rule.Raw: A systemic failure in trade networks paralyzes the regional economy, devaluing your goods while inflating merchant prices.
Rule.Translated: Un fallo sistémico de las redes comerciales paraliza la economía regional, devalúa tus mercancías y encarece las de los comerciantes.
Los indicadores económicos se han estabilizado.

Rule.Original:
A total collapse in regional trade networks has triggered a severe economic depression across the sector.
Struggling with liquidity and supply chain panics, all orbital and surface traders will now offer extremely unfavorable exchange rates, demanding extortionate prices for their goods while heavily undervaluing yours.
The depression will take a few days to resolve. Avoid making non-essential purchases or selling off valuable assets until market indicators stabilize.
Rule.Raw:
A total collapse in regional trade networks has triggered a severe economic depression across the sector.
Struggling with liquidity and supply chain panics, all orbital and surface traders will now offer extremely unfavorable exchange rates, demanding extortionate prices for their goods while heavily undervaluing yours.
The depression will take a few days to resolve. Avoid making non-essential purchases or selling off valuable assets until market indicators stabilize.
Rule.Translated:
El colapso total de las redes comerciales regionales ha provocado una grave depresión económica en todo el sector.
Ante los problemas de liquidez y el pánico en las cadenas de suministro, todos los comerciantes orbitales y terrestres ofrecerán condiciones de intercambio muy desfavorables: exigirán precios abusivos por sus mercancías y valorarán las tuyas muy por debajo de lo normal.
La depresión tardará unos días en resolverse. Evita las compras no esenciales y vender bienes valiosos hasta que los indicadores del mercado se estabilicen.

Rule.Original: Your settlement's widespread renown inspires goodwill among trade routes, granting better deals on all transactions.
Rule.Raw: Your settlement's widespread renown inspires goodwill among trade routes, granting better deals on all transactions.
Rule.Translated: La amplia fama de tu asentamiento inspira buena voluntad en las rutas comerciales y mejora los acuerdos de todas las transacciones.

Rule.Original: Your settlement's favorable reputation is no longer the talk of the trade routes.
Rule.Raw: Your settlement's favorable reputation is no longer the talk of the trade routes.
Rule.Translated: La buena reputación de tu asentamiento ya no es el tema de conversación de las rutas comerciales.

Rule.Original:
Word of your settlement's great achievements and honorable conduct has spread far along the orbital trade lanes.
Respectful merchants are eager to curry favor with your colony, and will offer significantly better prices on both things they sell to you and items they purchase from you.
This renown will last for a few days. Take advantage of this economic windfall to purchase expensive materials or clear out excess stockpiles.
Rule.Raw:
Word of your settlement's great achievements and honorable conduct has spread far along the orbital trade lanes.
Respectful merchants are eager to curry favor with your colony, and will offer significantly better prices on both things they sell to you and items they purchase from you.
This renown will last for a few days. Take advantage of this economic windfall to purchase expensive materials or clear out excess stockpiles.
Rule.Translated:
Las noticias sobre los grandes logros y la conducta honorable de tu asentamiento se han extendido por las rutas comerciales orbitales.
Los comerciantes desean ganarse el favor de tu colonia y ofrecerán precios mucho mejores tanto al venderte mercancías como al comprártelas.
Esta fama durará unos días. Aprovecha esta oportunidad económica para comprar materiales caros o deshacerte del exceso de reservas.
escasez en la cadena de suministro

Rule.Original: A severe shipping disruption triggers a regional shortage of a specific category, highly inflating its market value.
Rule.Raw: A severe shipping disruption triggers a regional shortage of a specific category, highly inflating its market value.
Rule.Translated: Una grave interrupción del transporte provoca una escasez regional de una categoría concreta y eleva mucho su valor de mercado.
Las cadenas de suministro se han restablecido.

Rule.Original:
A major disruption in regional shipping routes has caused a critical market shortage of {0}.
Until supply lines are restored, the global market value for this category will skyrocket. Traders will demand a massive premium if you buy from them, but will also pay inflated prices for your stock.
The shortage will persist for a few days. Check your stockpiles and liquidate any excess items of this category to passing traders for massive profits.
Rule.Raw:
A major disruption in regional shipping routes has caused a critical market shortage of {0}.
Until supply lines are restored, the global market value for this category will skyrocket. Traders will demand a massive premium if you buy from them, but will also pay inflated prices for your stock.
The shortage will persist for a few days. Check your stockpiles and liquidate any excess items of this category to passing traders for massive profits.
Rule.Translated:
Una grave interrupción de las rutas de transporte regionales ha provocado una escasez crítica de {0} en el mercado.
Hasta que se restablezcan las líneas de suministro, el valor de mercado global de esta categoría se disparará. Los comerciantes te cobrarán mucho más por ella, pero también pagarán precios elevados por tus existencias.
La escasez persistirá unos días. Revisa tus almacenes y vende cualquier excedente de esta categoría a los comerciantes de paso para obtener grandes beneficios.

Rule.Original: The magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our electric workstations, greatly disrupting work and upsetting the populace.
Rule.Raw: The magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our electric workstations, greatly disrupting work and upsetting the populace.
Rule.Translated: El campo magnético de este planeta interfiere con nuestros puestos de trabajo eléctricos, perjudica mucho el trabajo y molesta a la población.

Rule.Original:
The strong magnetic field around the settlement has caused some problems with electronic instruments on the surface, but recently the effect on our computers has been especially notable.
So far, it is unknown what has caused this flare up, although we suspect it to be temporary.
Rule.Raw:
The strong magnetic field around the settlement has caused some problems with electronic instruments on the surface, but recently the effect on our computers has been especially notable.
So far, it is unknown what has caused this flare up, although we suspect it to be temporary.
Rule.Translated:
El intenso campo magnético que rodea el asentamiento ha causado algunos problemas con los instrumentos electrónicos de la superficie, pero últimamente su efecto sobre nuestros ordenadores ha sido especialmente notable.
Por ahora se desconoce la causa de este aumento, aunque sospechamos que es temporal.

Rule.Original: Somehow, the magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our electric workstations, but rather than a simple disruption, it is actually making them more efficient!
Rule.Raw: Somehow, the magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our electric workstations, but rather than a simple disruption, it is actually making them more efficient!
Rule.Translated: De algún modo, el campo magnético de este planeta interfiere con nuestros puestos de trabajo eléctricos, pero en vez de perjudicarlos, ¡los hace más eficientes!

Rule.Original:
The strong magnetic field around the settlement has been affecting computers on the surface recently.
Oddly, this effect is not merely random interference, instead computers are actually working more efficiently than they should be. It's almost as if an outside force is lending a helping hand...
Rule.Raw:
The strong magnetic field around the settlement has been affecting computers on the surface recently.
Oddly, this effect is not merely random interference, instead computers are actually working more efficiently than they should be. It's almost as if an outside force is lending a helping hand...
Rule.Translated:
El intenso campo magnético que rodea el asentamiento ha estado afectando últimamente a los ordenadores de la superficie.
Curiosamente, no se trata de una simple interferencia aleatoria: los ordenadores funcionan mejor de lo que deberían. Es casi como si una fuerza externa nos estuviera echando una mano...
