Rule.Original:
A contagious biological pathogen that specifically targets the interface between organic nerve endings and synthetic neural-linkages.
The virus coats artificial connectors with a bio-film that disrupts signal conductivity, effectively bottlenecking the performance of any bionic or prosthetic part.
Rule.Raw:
A contagious biological pathogen that specifically targets the interface between organic nerve endings and synthetic neural-linkages.
The virus coats artificial connectors with a bio-film that disrupts signal conductivity, effectively bottlenecking the performance of any bionic or prosthetic part.
Rule.Translated:
Un patógeno biológico contagioso que ataca específicamente la interfaz entre las terminaciones nerviosas orgánicas y las conexiones neuronales sintéticas.
El virus recubre los conectores artificiales con una biopelícula que altera la conducción de señales y limita el rendimiento de cualquier parte biónica o protésica.

Rule.Original:
Induces feelings of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, while suppressing fatigue.
It seems to be fairly benign, however, as the self-preservation instincts prevent them from literally dancing themselves to death.
Rule.Raw:
Induces feelings of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, while suppressing fatigue.
It seems to be fairly benign, however, as the self-preservation instincts prevent them from literally dancing themselves to death.
Rule.Translated:
Provoca una sensación de euforia y unas ganas irresistibles de bailar, al tiempo que suprime el cansancio.
Sin embargo, parece bastante benigno, ya que el instinto de conservación impide que bailen literalmente hasta morir.

Rule.Original: Rumors, informants, and fear have slowed the decline of suppression among slaves.
Rule.Raw: Rumors, informants, and fear have slowed the decline of suppression among slaves.
Rule.Translated: Los rumores, los informantes y el miedo han ralentizado la pérdida de supresión de los esclavos.

Rule.Original: Airborne neurotoxin saturating the atmosphere. It paralyzes the pain receptors of local animals, driving them into a state of feral hyper-aggression.
Rule.Raw: Airborne neurotoxin saturating the atmosphere. It paralyzes the pain receptors of local animals, driving them into a state of feral hyper-aggression.
Rule.Translated: Una neurotoxina transportada por el aire satura la atmósfera. Paraliza los receptores del dolor de los animales locales y los vuelve salvajemente agresivos.

Rule.Original: Low-frequency vibrations propagate through the ground, depressing the consciousness and reflexes of local animals.
Rule.Raw: Low-frequency vibrations propagate through the ground, depressing the consciousness and reflexes of local animals.
Rule.Translated: Vibraciones de baja frecuencia se propagan por el suelo y reducen la consciencia y los reflejos de los animales locales.

Rule.Original: Something in the air of this planet seems to put people in the mood to reproduce.
Rule.Raw: Something in the air of this planet seems to put people in the mood to reproduce.
Rule.Translated: Algo en el aire de este planeta parece despertar en las personas el deseo de reproducirse.

Rule.Original: Volatile bio-excitants saturate the air, boosting cellular metabolism to elevate consciousness and double natural healing rates.
Rule.Raw: Volatile bio-excitants saturate the air, boosting cellular metabolism to elevate consciousness and double natural healing rates.
Rule.Translated: Los bioestimulantes volátiles saturan el aire y aceleran el metabolismo celular, lo que aumenta la consciencia y duplica la curación natural.

Rule.Original: Airborne psychoactive spores induce widespread mild hallucinations, amplifying colony mood while degrading global work speed.
Rule.Raw: Airborne psychoactive spores induce widespread mild hallucinations, amplifying colony mood while degrading global work speed.
Rule.Translated: Las esporas psicoactivas transportadas por el aire provocan alucinaciones leves generalizadas, mejoran el ánimo de la colonia y reducen la velocidad de trabajo general.

Rule.Original: A localized gravitational anomaly intensifies planetary pull, decreasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Raw: A localized gravitational anomaly intensifies planetary pull, decreasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía gravitatoria local intensifica la atracción planetaria y reduce la velocidad de movimiento y la capacidad de carga.

Rule.Original: A localized gravitational anomaly weakens planetary pull, increasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Raw: A localized gravitational anomaly weakens planetary pull, increasing movement speed and carrying capacity.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía gravitatoria local debilita la atracción planetaria y aumenta la velocidad de movimiento y la capacidad de carga.

Rule.Original: A localized microclimatic cooling anomaly enables hardware overclocking in mechanoids, increasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Raw: A localized microclimatic cooling anomaly enables hardware overclocking in mechanoids, increasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía microclimática de enfriamiento permite que los mecanoides aumenten la frecuencia de su hardware, mejorando su consciencia, coordinación de apuntado y cadencia de disparo.

Rule.Original: A localized microclimatic thermal anomaly forces hardware throttling in mechanoids, decreasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Raw: A localized microclimatic thermal anomaly forces hardware throttling in mechanoids, decreasing their consciousness, aiming coordination, and fire rates.
Rule.Translated: Una anomalía térmica microclimática obliga a los mecanoides a reducir la frecuencia de su hardware, disminuyendo su consciencia, coordinación de apuntado y cadencia de disparo.

Rule.Original: A psychic harmony triggers a map-wide Gauranlen tree bloom, preventing connection decay and increasing pruning speed.
Rule.Raw: A psychic harmony triggers a map-wide Gauranlen tree bloom, preventing connection decay and increasing pruning speed.
Rule.Translated: Una armonía psíquica provoca la floración de los árboles Gauranlen de todo el mapa, impide que se debilite la conexión y acelera la poda.

Rule.Original: An intense field of anti-psychic interference neutralizes psychic cognition, preventing the use of psycasts and psychic technology.
Rule.Raw: An intense field of anti-psychic interference neutralizes psychic cognition, preventing the use of psycasts and psychic technology.
Rule.Translated: Un intenso campo de interferencia antipsíquica neutraliza la cognición psíquica e impide utilizar poderes y tecnología psíquicos.
{0} ha empezado a bailar sin control.

Rule.Original:
A sudden surge of psychic energy has caused the anima tree to bloom rapidly.
{0} new anima grasses have sprouted around the tree.
Rule.Raw:
A sudden surge of psychic energy has caused the anima tree to bloom rapidly.
{0} new anima grasses have sprouted around the tree.
Rule.Translated:
Una repentina oleada de energía psíquica ha hecho que el árbol anima florezca rápidamente.
Han brotado {0} nuevas plantas de hierba anima alrededor del árbol.

Rule.Original:
A temporary black market has set up camp nearby.
These smugglers deal in high-value contraband and rare tech found nowhere else, though their prices are steep. Fearing orbital authorities, they will leave quickly. Assemble a caravan and move fast if you wish to trade.
Rule.Raw:
A temporary black market has set up camp nearby.
These smugglers deal in high-value contraband and rare tech found nowhere else, though their prices are steep. Fearing orbital authorities, they will leave quickly. Assemble a caravan and move fast if you wish to trade.
Rule.Translated:
Un mercado negro temporal se ha instalado cerca.
Estos contrabandistas venden mercancías ilícitas de gran valor y tecnología rara que no se encuentra en ningún otro sitio, aunque sus precios son altos. Como temen a las autoridades orbitales, se marcharán pronto. Organiza una caravana y actúa deprisa si quieres comerciar.

Rule.Original: The {FACTION_name} has sent a small gift as a token of goodwill.
Rule.Raw: The {FACTION_name} has sent a small gift as a token of goodwill.
Rule.Translated: La facción {FACTION_name} ha enviado un pequeño regalo como muestra de buena voluntad.

Rule.Original:
A short, nutrient-rich rain is falling.
The strange bio-catalysts in the water directly boost the growth of all plants on the map.
Rule.Raw:
A short, nutrient-rich rain is falling.
The strange bio-catalysts in the water directly boost the growth of all plants on the map.
Rule.Translated:
Está cayendo una breve lluvia rica en nutrientes.
Los extraños biocatalizadores del agua aceleran directamente el crecimiento de todas las plantas del mapa.

Rule.Original:
{INFORMER_nameDef} secretly informed your overseers of a slave escape conspiracy.
You tighten chains and increase patrols. The plot collapses before it begins, and suspicion spreads among the slaves.
Rule.Raw:
{INFORMER_nameDef} secretly informed your overseers of a slave escape conspiracy.
You tighten chains and increase patrols. The plot collapses before it begins, and suspicion spreads among the slaves.
Rule.Translated:
{INFORMER_nameDef} ha informado en secreto a tus supervisores de una conspiración de fuga entre los esclavos.
Refuerzas las cadenas y aumentas las patrullas. El plan fracasa antes de empezar y la desconfianza se extiende entre los esclavos.

Rule.Original:
One of your researchers has had a sudden moment of clarity!
Research on {PROJECT_label} has been accelerated by {PERCENT}.
Rule.Raw:
One of your researchers has had a sudden moment of clarity!
Research on {PROJECT_label} has been accelerated by {PERCENT}.
Rule.Translated:
¡Uno de tus investigadores ha tenido una revelación repentina!
La investigación de {PROJECT_label} ha avanzado un {PERCENT}.

Rule.Original: The shattered pod disintegrated in mid-air, and silver rained down across the map.
Rule.Raw: The shattered pod disintegrated in mid-air, and silver rained down across the map.
Rule.Translated: La cápsula destrozada se desintegró en el aire, y llovió plata por todo el mapa.

Rule.Original:
{PAWN_labelShort} has experienced a sudden moment of clarity!
By re-evaluating past experiences, {PAWN_labelShort}'s {SKILL_label} skill has increased from level {oldLEVEL} to {newLEVEL}.
Rule.Raw:
{PAWN_labelShort} has experienced a sudden moment of clarity!
By re-evaluating past experiences, {PAWN_labelShort}'s {SKILL_label} skill has increased from level {oldLEVEL} to {newLEVEL}.
Rule.Translated:
¡{PAWN_labelShort} ha tenido una revelación repentina!
Al reevaluar sus experiencias, la habilidad {SKILL_label} de {PAWN_labelShort} ha subido del nivel {oldLEVEL} al {newLEVEL}.

Rule.Original:
A sudden voltage instability in the grid has triggered a safety protocol.
{BUILDING_labelShort} has been automatically shut down to prevent hardware damage.
Rule.Raw:
A sudden voltage instability in the grid has triggered a safety protocol.
{BUILDING_labelShort} has been automatically shut down to prevent hardware damage.
Rule.Translated:
Una repentina inestabilidad de tensión en la red ha activado un protocolo de seguridad.
{BUILDING_labelShort} se ha apagado automáticamente para evitar daños en sus componentes.

Rule.Original:
A group of hungry {0} have wandered into the area.
They won't attack unless provoked.
{0} will leave the area in a few days.
Rule.Raw:
A group of hungry {0} have wandered into the area.
They won't attack unless provoked.
{0} will leave the area in a few days.
Rule.Translated:
Un grupo de {0} hambrientos ha entrado en la zona.
No atacarán salvo que los provoques.
Los {0} abandonarán la zona en unos días.

Rule.Original:
A collection of flotsam has washed up on the shore.
It contains a grim mixture of supplies and remains, but movement among the wreckage suggests that some survivors — or perhaps something else — may still be present.
Rule.Raw:
A collection of flotsam has washed up on the shore.
It contains a grim mixture of supplies and remains, but movement among the wreckage suggests that some survivors — or perhaps something else — may still be present.
Rule.Translated:
Una acumulación de restos flotantes ha llegado a la orilla.
Contiene una macabra mezcla de suministros y restos, pero el movimiento entre los escombros sugiere que aún podría haber supervivientes... o quizá otra cosa.

Rule.Original:
The {FACTION_name} has sent toxic wastepacks to your colony.
These heat-sealed packages will dissolve and pollute the terrain unless kept frozen. If burned or destroyed, they will release lethal tox gas.
Rule.Raw:
The {FACTION_name} has sent toxic wastepacks to your colony.
These heat-sealed packages will dissolve and pollute the terrain unless kept frozen. If burned or destroyed, they will release lethal tox gas.
Rule.Translated:
La facción {FACTION_name} ha enviado paquetes de residuos tóxicos a tu colonia.
Estos paquetes termosellados se disolverán y contaminarán el terreno si no se mantienen congelados. Si se queman o destruyen, liberarán gas tóxico letal.

Rule.Original:
A conduit segment has suffered a thermal failure.
Reconstruct the damaged segment to restore the power grid.
Rule.Raw:
A conduit segment has suffered a thermal failure.
Reconstruct the damaged segment to restore the power grid.
Rule.Translated:
Un tramo de conducto ha sufrido un fallo térmico.
Reconstruye el tramo dañado para restablecer la red eléctrica.

Rule.Original:
A storage mishap or chemical instability has caused {COUNT}x {MEDICINE} to spoil.
They are no longer usable and have been discarded.
Rule.Raw:
A storage mishap or chemical instability has caused {COUNT}x {MEDICINE} to spoil.
They are no longer usable and have been discarded.
Rule.Translated:
Un percance de almacenamiento o una inestabilidad química ha estropeado {COUNT}x {MEDICINE}.
Ya no se pueden utilizar y se han desechado.

Rule.Original:
The pawn has found that the trees are mobile to various degrees.
Trees will slowly migrate to new areas richer in nutrients.
Rule.Raw:
The pawn has found that the trees are mobile to various degrees.
Trees will slowly migrate to new areas richer in nutrients.
Rule.Translated:
El peón ha descubierto que los árboles pueden moverse en distintos grados.
Los árboles migrarán lentamente hacia zonas más ricas en nutrientes.

Rule.Original:
An internal fault has caused {COUNT} batteries to suffer a sudden discharge!
Approximately {ENERGY} Wd of stored energy has leaked away into the ground.
Rule.Raw:
An internal fault has caused {COUNT} batteries to suffer a sudden discharge!
Approximately {ENERGY} Wd of stored energy has leaked away into the ground.
Rule.Translated:
¡Un fallo interno ha provocado una descarga repentina en {COUNT} baterías!
Se han perdido hacia el suelo aproximadamente {ENERGY} Wd de energía almacenada.

Rule.Original: Rats are swarming around stored food!
Rule.Raw: Rats are swarming around stored food!
Rule.Translated: ¡Las ratas se agolpan alrededor de la comida almacenada!

Rule.Original:
A major error was discovered in the recent findings for {PROJECT_label}, or critical records have been damaged beyond recovery.
Research progress has been set back by {PERCENT} as the work must be painstakingly reconstructed.
Rule.Raw:
A major error was discovered in the recent findings for {PROJECT_label}, or critical records have been damaged beyond recovery.
Research progress has been set back by {PERCENT} as the work must be painstakingly reconstructed.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha descubierto un error grave en los últimos hallazgos de {PROJECT_label}, o se han dañado registros importantes sin posibilidad de recuperarlos.
El progreso de la investigación ha retrocedido un {PERCENT}, pues es necesario reconstruir el trabajo con mucho esfuerzo.

Rule.Original:
{PAWN_labelShort} has hit a hollow pocket while operating the deep drill.
A path to a subterranean mineral cave has been exposed!
Rule.Raw:
{PAWN_labelShort} has hit a hollow pocket while operating the deep drill.
A path to a subterranean mineral cave has been exposed!
Rule.Translated:
{PAWN_labelShort} ha perforado una cavidad mientras utilizaba el taladro profundo.
¡Se ha abierto un paso hacia una cueva mineral subterránea!

Rule.Original:
A {FACTION_name} fire support base has been established within tactical range.
Until destroyed, this site provides off-map bombardment to support hostile forces engaging your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A {FACTION_name} fire support base has been established within tactical range.
Until destroyed, this site provides off-map bombardment to support hostile forces engaging your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha establecido una base de apoyo de fuego de {FACTION_name} dentro del alcance táctico.
Hasta que la destruyas, proporcionará bombardeos desde fuera del mapa para apoyar a las fuerzas hostiles que ataquen tu asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
A {FACTION_name} forward operating base has been established within tactical range.
Until destroyed, this site increases the scale of incoming raids targeting your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A {FACTION_name} forward operating base has been established within tactical range.
Until destroyed, this site increases the scale of incoming raids targeting your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha establecido una base de operaciones avanzada de {FACTION_name} dentro del alcance táctico.
Hasta que la destruyas, aumentará la magnitud de los ataques contra tu asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
The trees have fully awakened!
They clearly possess some form of rudimentary intelligence, and they have begun to systematically attack our settlements!
Rule.Raw:
The trees have fully awakened!
They clearly possess some form of rudimentary intelligence, and they have begun to systematically attack our settlements!
Rule.Translated:
¡Los árboles han despertado por completo!
Es evidente que poseen alguna forma de inteligencia rudimentaria, ¡y han empezado a atacar sistemáticamente nuestros asentamientos!

Rule.Original:
Mysterious orbital structures have broken apart, scattering wreckage across the surrounding area.
One central escape pod has crashed nearby, revealing faint, unknown life signs. Incoming alerts indicate multiple secondary impacts across the map. Hostile units are clawing out of the debris. Prepare for an immediate confrontation.
Rule.Raw:
Mysterious orbital structures have broken apart, scattering wreckage across the surrounding area.
One central escape pod has crashed nearby, revealing faint, unknown life signs. Incoming alerts indicate multiple secondary impacts across the map. Hostile units are clawing out of the debris. Prepare for an immediate confrontation.
Rule.Translated:
Unas misteriosas estructuras orbitales se han desintegrado y han esparcido restos por los alrededores.
Una cápsula de escape central ha caído cerca y muestra débiles señales de vida desconocidas. Las alertas entrantes indican múltiples impactos secundarios por el mapa. Unidades hostiles están saliendo de los restos. Prepárate para un enfrentamiento inmediato.

Rule.Original:
A {FACTION_name} interdiction point has been established within tactical range.
Until destroyed, this site blocks all neutral caravans and visitors traveling to your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A {FACTION_name} interdiction point has been established within tactical range.
Until destroyed, this site blocks all neutral caravans and visitors traveling to your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha establecido un puesto de bloqueo de {FACTION_name} dentro del alcance táctico.
Hasta que lo destruyas, impedirá que lleguen a tu asentamiento las caravanas neutrales y los visitantes.

Rule.Original:
The object has twisted and reshaped itself into a hostile mimic!
It is no longer a piece of furniture, but a predatory entity driven by a singular urge to hunt.
Rule.Raw:
The object has twisted and reshaped itself into a hostile mimic!
It is no longer a piece of furniture, but a predatory entity driven by a singular urge to hunt.
Rule.Translated:
¡El objeto se ha retorcido y transformado en un mímico hostil!
Ya no es un mueble, sino una entidad depredadora impulsada por un único deseo: cazar.

Rule.Original:
A short circuit has occurred in the defensive network.
The automated turret defense system has suffered a friend-or-foe recognition failure. {0} unit(s) have temporarily turned hostile!
Rule.Raw:
A short circuit has occurred in the defensive network.
The automated turret defense system has suffered a friend-or-foe recognition failure. {0} unit(s) have temporarily turned hostile!
Rule.Translated:
Se ha producido un cortocircuito en la red defensiva.
El sistema de torretas automáticas ha sufrido un fallo de identificación entre aliados y enemigos. ¡{0} unidad(es) se han vuelto hostiles temporalmente!
escasez en la cadena de suministro
Escasez en la cadena de suministro

Rule.Original: A massive environmental shift has caused the {BIOME_label} to expand into neighboring regions.
Rule.Raw: A massive environmental shift has caused the {BIOME_label} to expand into neighboring regions.
Rule.Translated: Un cambio ambiental de gran magnitud ha provocado que el bioma {BIOME_label} se expanda hacia las regiones vecinas.

Rule.Original:
Caught a delegate from {FACTION_name} in a rare blunder, letting slip their faction's true feelings about us to another, anonymous party.
More than the usual political mud-slinging: these amount to an outright insult, as it appears we are the subjects of fierce ridicule amongst {FACTION_name} society.
{FACTION} goodwill decreased by {CHANGE}.
Rule.Raw:
Caught a delegate from {FACTION_name} in a rare blunder, letting slip their faction's true feelings about us to another, anonymous party.
More than the usual political mud-slinging: these amount to an outright insult, as it appears we are the subjects of fierce ridicule amongst {FACTION_name} society.
{FACTION} goodwill decreased by {CHANGE}.
Rule.Translated:
Un delegado de {FACTION_name} ha cometido un raro desliz y ha revelado a un tercero anónimo los verdaderos sentimientos de su facción hacia nosotros.
Esto va más allá de los habituales ataques políticos y constituye un insulto directo: al parecer, somos objeto de duras burlas entre los miembros de {FACTION_name}.
La buena voluntad de {FACTION} ha disminuido en {CHANGE}.

Rule.Original:
Carrying incendiary weaponry, these zealots will target and ignite anyone with hemogenic genes. If a hemogenic pawn is downed, they will be executed on the spot.
They are attacking immediately. Watch out for their scorched-earth tactics.
Rule.Raw:
Carrying incendiary weaponry, these zealots will target and ignite anyone with hemogenic genes. If a hemogenic pawn is downed, they will be executed on the spot.
They are attacking immediately. Watch out for their scorched-earth tactics.
Rule.Translated:
Estos fanáticos llevan armas incendiarias y atacarán y prenderán fuego a cualquiera que tenga genes hemogénicos. Si derriban a un peón hemogénico, lo ejecutarán en el acto.
Atacan de inmediato. Ten cuidado con sus tácticas de tierra quemada.

Rule.Original: They are moving in to help you immediately.
Rule.Raw: They are moving in to help you immediately.
Rule.Translated: Se dirigen a ayudarte de inmediato.

Rule.Original:
A fire support base has been established in the region.
Until destroyed, this site provides off-map bombardment to support hostile forces engaging your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A fire support base has been established in the region.
Until destroyed, this site provides off-map bombardment to support hostile forces engaging your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha establecido una base de apoyo de fuego en la región.
Hasta que la destruyas, proporcionará bombardeos desde fuera del mapa para apoyar a las fuerzas hostiles que ataquen tu asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The fire support base has been neutralized.
Rule.Raw: The fire support base has been neutralized.
Rule.Translated: La base de apoyo de fuego ha sido neutralizada.

Rule.Original:
A fire support base.
Until destroyed, this site provides off-map bombardment to support hostile forces engaging your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A fire support base.
Until destroyed, this site provides off-map bombardment to support hostile forces engaging your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Una base de apoyo de fuego.
Hasta que la destruyas, proporcionará bombardeos desde fuera del mapa para apoyar a las fuerzas hostiles que ataquen tu asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
A forward operating base has been established in the region.
Until destroyed, this site increases the scale of incoming raids targeting your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A forward operating base has been established in the region.
Until destroyed, this site increases the scale of incoming raids targeting your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha establecido una base de operaciones avanzada en la región.
Hasta que la destruyas, aumentará la magnitud de los ataques contra tu asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The forward operating base has been neutralized.
Rule.Raw: The forward operating base has been neutralized.
Rule.Translated: La base de operaciones avanzada ha sido neutralizada.

Rule.Original:
A forward operating base.
Until destroyed, this site increases the scale of incoming raids targeting your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A forward operating base.
Until destroyed, this site increases the scale of incoming raids targeting your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Una base de operaciones avanzada.
Hasta que sea destruida, este lugar aumenta la magnitud de los asaltos dirigidos contra tu asentamiento.

Rule.Original:
A interdiction point has been established in the region.
Until destroyed, this site blocks all neutral caravans and visitors traveling to your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A interdiction point has been established in the region.
Until destroyed, this site blocks all neutral caravans and visitors traveling to your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Se ha establecido un puesto de bloqueo en la región.
Hasta que lo destruyas, impedirá que lleguen a tu asentamiento las caravanas neutrales y los visitantes.

Rule.Original:
A interdiction point.
Until destroyed, this site blocks all neutral caravans and visitors traveling to your settlement.
Rule.Raw:
A interdiction point.
Until destroyed, this site blocks all neutral caravans and visitors traveling to your settlement.
Rule.Translated:
Un punto de interdicción.
Hasta que sea destruido, este lugar bloquea todas las caravanas y visitantes neutrales que se dirijan a tu asentamiento.

Rule.Original: The entrance to a cave network. It is possible to climb down into the caves below.
Rule.Raw: The entrance to a cave network. It is possible to climb down into the caves below.
Rule.Translated: La entrada a una red de cuevas. Es posible descender a las cuevas que hay debajo.

Rule.Original: In the depths, you have discovered a massive cavern system infested with mineral veins.
Rule.Raw: In the depths, you have discovered a massive cavern system infested with mineral veins.
Rule.Translated: En las profundidades has descubierto un enorme sistema de cavernas repleto de vetas minerales.
Derrumbar la entrada de la cueva

Rule.Original: Choose a colonist to permanently collapse the entrance. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.
Rule.Raw: Choose a colonist to permanently collapse the entrance. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.
Rule.Translated: Elige a un colono para derrumbar la entrada de forma permanente. Todo lo que quede abajo, incluidas las personas, se perderá para siempre.

Rule.Original: Collapsing the cave entrance is permanent. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.{0}\n\nAre you sure you want to continue?
Rule.Raw: Collapsing the cave entrance is permanent. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.{0}\n\nAre you sure you want to continue?
Rule.Translated: Derrumbar la entrada de la cueva es permanente. Todo lo que quede abajo, incluidas las personas, se perderá para siempre.{0}\n\n¿Seguro que quieres continuar?

Rule.Original:
A tree that has gained self-awareness and the ability to move. Its trunk and massive branches can easily crush human bones.
Although it moves slowly, its physiological structure makes it extremely difficult to kill completely.
Rule.Raw:
A tree that has gained self-awareness and the ability to move. Its trunk and massive branches can easily crush human bones.
Although it moves slowly, its physiological structure makes it extremely difficult to kill completely.
Rule.Translated:
Un árbol que ha adquirido consciencia propia y la capacidad de moverse. Su tronco y sus enormes ramas pueden aplastar con facilidad los huesos humanos.
Aunque se mueve despacio, su estructura fisiológica hace que sea muy difícil matarlo por completo.

Rule.Original: It is portrayed as being able to change its shape to disguise its body as an inanimate object, commonly a chest.
Rule.Raw: It is portrayed as being able to change its shape to disguise its body as an inanimate object, commonly a chest.
Rule.Translated: Se representa como una criatura capaz de cambiar de forma para disfrazar su cuerpo de objeto inanimado, normalmente un cofre.

Rule.Original: I feel so heavy... and so relaxed...
Rule.Raw: I feel so heavy... and so relaxed...
Rule.Translated: Siento tanta pesadez... y tanta relajación...

Rule.Original:
A makeshift settlement serving as a temporary black market for smugglers dealing in contraband and exotic equipment.
Prices are high and they will disband at a moment's notice, but it remains an excellent opportunity to source rare items.
Rule.Raw:
A makeshift settlement serving as a temporary black market for smugglers dealing in contraband and exotic equipment.
Prices are high and they will disband at a moment's notice, but it remains an excellent opportunity to source rare items.
Rule.Translated:
Un asentamiento improvisado que sirve como mercado negro temporal para contrabandistas de mercancías ilícitas y equipo exótico.
Los precios son altos y pueden levantar el campamento en cualquier momento, pero sigue siendo una excelente oportunidad para conseguir objetos raros.

Rule.Original: Create a custom Origin using the settings below.
Rule.Raw: Create a custom Origin using the settings below.
Rule.Translated: Crea un Origen personalizado con los ajustes que aparecen a continuación.

Rule.Original: You recently joined the ranks of the Empire as Novices. For your first mission, you are sent out to do field work and establish another base of operations.
Rule.Raw: You recently joined the ranks of the Empire as Novices. For your first mission, you are sent out to do field work and establish another base of operations.
Rule.Translated: Os habéis incorporado recientemente al Imperio como novicios. En vuestra primera misión os envían al terreno para establecer una nueva base de operaciones.

Rule.Original: Imperial Novices sent out into the field.
Rule.Raw: Imperial Novices sent out into the field.

Rule.Translated: desactivar el arranque de la nave
fijar la buena voluntad forzada de la facción
fijar la buena voluntad natural de la facción
fijar la buena voluntad inicial de la facción
empezar con un objeto sin desmontar

Rule.Original: win condition: sell items to faction
Rule.Raw: win condition: sell items to faction
Rule.Translated: condición de victoria: vender objetos a una facción

Rule.Original:
While the experiment worked, the results failed to gather any more meaningful data, and risked attracting outside attention. You have been exiled, dumped onto a distant rimworld along with your subjects.

A researcher out of their depth, and a number of sapient animals. With no tools, limited opposable thumbs, but a strong will to live, can you make it on such a hostile planet?

Note: this is a difficult scenario, with limited starting supplies. You will not be able to see the stats of the sapient animals in the preparation screen. Plan ahead.
Rule.Raw:
While the experiment worked, the results failed to gather any more meaningful data, and risked attracting outside attention. You have been exiled, dumped onto a distant rimworld along with your subjects.

A researcher out of their depth, and a number of sapient animals. With no tools, limited opposable thumbs, but a strong will to live, can you make it on such a hostile planet?

Note: this is a difficult scenario, with limited starting supplies. You will not be able to see the stats of the sapient animals in the preparation screen. Plan ahead.
Rule.Translated:
Aunque el experimento funcionó, sus resultados no aportaron más datos útiles y corrían el riesgo de atraer atención externa. Te han exiliado y abandonado en un mundo exterior lejano junto con tus sujetos.

Un investigador superado por las circunstancias y varios animales sapientes. Sin herramientas, con pocos pulgares oponibles, pero con una gran voluntad de vivir, ¿podréis sobrevivir en un planeta tan hostil?

Nota: este escenario es difícil y tiene pocos suministros iniciales. No podrás ver los atributos de los animales sapientes en la pantalla de preparación. Planifica con antelación.

Rule.Original: A researcher and sapient animal subjects, dumped after a failed experiment.
Rule.Raw: A researcher and sapient animal subjects, dumped after a failed experiment.
Rule.Translated: Un investigador y sujetos animales sapientes, abandonados tras un experimento fallido.

Rule.Original: 5 corporate goons sent down by a subsidiary of The Corporation to analyze the planet hands-on. The subsidiary would like to see mountains of paperwork filled out to assess the value of this planet's resources and artifacts.
Rule.Raw: 5 corporate goons sent down by a subsidiary of The Corporation to analyze the planet hands-on. The subsidiary would like to see mountains of paperwork filled out to assess the value of this planet's resources and artifacts.
Rule.Translated: Una filial de La Corporación ha enviado a 5 matones corporativos para analizar el planeta sobre el terreno. La filial espera montañas de formularios para evaluar el valor de sus recursos y artefactos.

Rule.Original: Corporate goons sent to fill out paperwork.
Rule.Raw: Corporate goons sent to fill out paperwork.
Rule.Translated: Matones corporativos enviados a cumplimentar papeleo.

Rule.Original: Activate a giant shield bubble for you and your allies.
Rule.Raw: Activate a giant shield bubble for you and your allies.
Rule.Translated: Activa una enorme burbuja de escudo para ti y tus aliados.

Rule.Original: Throw an anti-personel grenade at the enemy.
Rule.Raw: Throw an anti-personel grenade at the enemy.
Rule.Translated: Lanza una granada antipersona contra el enemigo.

Rule.Original: Throw an anti-mechanoid grenade at the enemy.
Rule.Raw: Throw an anti-mechanoid grenade at the enemy.
Rule.Translated: Lanza una granada antimecanoides contra el enemigo.

Rule.Original: Jump to a distant location using the melee enforcer backpack.
Rule.Raw: Jump to a distant location using the melee enforcer backpack.
Rule.Translated: Salta a un lugar lejano con la mochila del ejecutor de combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Activate the enforcer duster's hidden camouflage module to blend into the surroundings.
Rule.Raw: Activate the enforcer duster's hidden camouflage module to blend into the surroundings.
Rule.Translated: Activa el módulo de camuflaje oculto del guardapolvo del ejecutor para mimetizarte con el entorno.

Rule.Original: Fire a basic psychic bullet. The user will gain a maximum number of 25 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Fire a basic psychic bullet. The user will gain a maximum number of 25 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una bala psíquica básica. Dispone de un máximo de 25 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Fire a psychic bullet that has a chance to inflict berserk upon impact. The user will gain a maximum number of 15 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Fire a psychic bullet that has a chance to inflict berserk upon impact. The user will gain a maximum number of 15 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una bala psíquica que puede provocar frenesí al impactar. Dispone de un máximo de 15 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Fire a psychic bullet that has a chance to inflict confusion upon impact. The user will gain a maximum number of 15 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Fire a psychic bullet that has a chance to inflict confusion upon impact. The user will gain a maximum number of 15 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una bala psíquica que puede provocar confusión al impactar. Dispone de un máximo de 15 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Fire an ominous psychic bullet that has a chance to inflict health blight, and an even rarer chance of insta-killing a target upon impact. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Fire an ominous psychic bullet that has a chance to inflict health blight, and an even rarer chance of insta-killing a target upon impact. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una siniestra bala psíquica que puede deteriorar la salud del objetivo y, en casos aún más raros, matarlo al instante al impactar. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Fire an enhanced psychic bullet. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Fire an enhanced psychic bullet. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una bala psíquica mejorada. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Conjure a localized anti-organic blast in a single area. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Conjure a localized anti-organic blast in a single area. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Provoca una explosión antiorgánica localizada en una zona. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Conjure an AOE anti-organic orbital strike at any chosen locations. The user will gain a maximum number of 2 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Conjure an AOE anti-organic orbital strike at any chosen locations. The user will gain a maximum number of 2 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Provoca un ataque orbital antiorgánico de área en los lugares elegidos. Dispone de un máximo de 2 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Cast a mass burden pulse against multiple enemies. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Cast a mass burden pulse against multiple enemies. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Emite un pulso de carga masiva contra varios enemigos. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Fire an explosive charged warhead using a retractable buster cannon.
Rule.Raw: Fire an explosive charged warhead using a retractable buster cannon.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una ojiva explosiva cargada con un cañón destructor retráctil.

Rule.Original: Bend the fabrics of time and space to teleport yourself, and your allies, to any X,Y,Z coordinates. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Bend the fabrics of time and space to teleport yourself, and your allies, to any X,Y,Z coordinates. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dobla el tejido del espacio y el tiempo para teletransportarte junto con tus aliados a cualquier coordenada X,Y,Z. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.
paso por la grieta de largo alcance

Rule.Original: Teleport the caster, along with their allies, to any distant locations throughout the planet where a willing ally is used as a beacon for mass transport. The user will gain a maximum number of 4 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Teleport the caster, along with their allies, to any distant locations throughout the planet where a willing ally is used as a beacon for mass transport. The user will gain a maximum number of 4 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Teletransporta al usuario y a sus aliados a lugares lejanos del planeta, utilizando a un aliado dispuesto como baliza para el transporte en grupo. Dispone de un máximo de 4 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Heal yourself from any wounds by hastening the body's blood clotting process and boost its natural healing ability. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Heal yourself from any wounds by hastening the body's blood clotting process and boost its natural healing ability. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Cura tus heridas acelerando la coagulación de la sangre y potenciando la capacidad natural de curación del cuerpo. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Jump to a distant location using gravitational propulsion. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Jump to a distant location using gravitational propulsion. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Salta a un lugar lejano mediante propulsión gravitatoria. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Activate the archotech heart's main function and enter in an overdriven state. The user will gain a maximum number of 3 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Activate the archotech heart's main function and enter in an overdriven state. The user will gain a maximum number of 3 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Activa la función principal del corazón arqueotecnológico y entra en un estado de sobrecarga. Dispone de un máximo de 3 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Channel energy into the core to fire an explosive energy-based warhead.
Rule.Raw: Channel energy into the core to fire an explosive energy-based warhead.
Rule.Translated: Canaliza energía hacia el núcleo para disparar una ojiva explosiva de energía.

Rule.Original: Channel energy into the core to fire a superheated plasma warhead.
Rule.Raw: Channel energy into the core to fire a superheated plasma warhead.
Rule.Translated: Canaliza energía hacia el núcleo para disparar una ojiva de plasma sobrecalentado.

Rule.Original: Shoot a stun grenade hidden within the mechanical arm.
Rule.Raw: Shoot a stun grenade hidden within the mechanical arm.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una granada aturdidora oculta en el brazo mecánico.

Rule.Original: Cast a transmitted berserk pulse against multiple enemies.
Rule.Raw: Cast a transmitted berserk pulse against multiple enemies.
Rule.Translated: Transmite un pulso de frenesí contra varios enemigos.

Rule.Original: Fire a mech canister full of toxic gas.
Rule.Raw: Fire a mech canister full of toxic gas.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un recipiente mecanoide lleno de gas tóxico.

Rule.Original: Fire a mech canister full of lungrot gas.
Rule.Raw: Fire a mech canister full of lungrot gas.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un recipiente mecanoide lleno de gas de putrefacción pulmonar.

Rule.Original: Launch an explosive payload full of anti-organic nanites, that brutaly harms organics inside a 15.9 blast radius.
Rule.Raw: Launch an explosive payload full of anti-organic nanites, that brutaly harms organics inside a 15.9 blast radius.
Rule.Translated: Lanza una carga explosiva llena de nanitos antiorgánicos que inflige daños brutales a los seres orgánicos dentro de un radio de explosión de 15.9.

Rule.Original: Shoot a stun grenade at longer distance.
Rule.Raw: Shoot a stun grenade at longer distance.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una granada aturdidora a mayor distancia.

Rule.Original: Conjure a psychic explosion in any area while ignoring all forms of obstacles.
Rule.Raw: Conjure a psychic explosion in any area while ignoring all forms of obstacles.
Rule.Translated: Provoca una explosión psíquica en cualquier zona, ignorando todo tipo de obstáculos.

Rule.Original: Shoot a razor sharp blade using the blade horns protruding on each sides.
Rule.Raw: Shoot a razor sharp blade using the blade horns protruding on each sides.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una cuchilla afiladísima mediante los cuernos cortantes que sobresalen a ambos lados.

Rule.Original: Launch an explosive inferno rocket at enemies.
Rule.Raw: Launch an explosive inferno rocket at enemies.
Rule.Translated: Lanza un cohete infernal explosivo contra los enemigos.

Rule.Original: Fire a super explosive anti-organic warhead.
Rule.Raw: Fire a super explosive anti-organic warhead.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una ojiva antiorgánica de enorme potencia explosiva.

Rule.Original: Unleash the wrath of the machines by blasting those filthy organics with an anti-organic orbital strike.
Rule.Raw: Unleash the wrath of the machines by blasting those filthy organics with an anti-organic orbital strike.
Rule.Translated: Desata la ira de las máquinas y fulmina a esos repugnantes seres orgánicos con un ataque orbital antiorgánico.

Rule.Original: Fire a death ray that can reduce the target's capacities to 35%, along with a 20% chance of instant death.
Rule.Raw: Fire a death ray that can reduce the target's capacities to 35%, along with a 20% chance of instant death.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un rayo de la muerte que puede reducir las capacidades del objetivo al 35%, además de tener un 20% de probabilidad de matarlo al instante.

Rule.Original: Allows a valkyrian to jump at distant location using special ultrafast mechanoid muscles.
Rule.Raw: Allows a valkyrian to jump at distant location using special ultrafast mechanoid muscles.
Rule.Translated: Permite a una valquiria saltar a un lugar lejano mediante músculos mecanoides especiales ultrarrápidos.

Rule.Original: Vaporize enemies with an anti-organic blast.
Rule.Raw: Vaporize enemies with an anti-organic blast.
Rule.Translated: Vaporiza a los enemigos con una explosión antiorgánica.

Rule.Original: Vaporize enemies with a thunder blast.
Rule.Raw: Vaporize enemies with a thunder blast.
Rule.Translated: Vaporiza a los enemigos con una explosión de trueno.
ataque orbital de explosiones de trueno

Rule.Original: Unleash a barrage of thunder blasts and annihilate groups of enemies in seconds.
Rule.Raw: Unleash a barrage of thunder blasts and annihilate groups of enemies in seconds.
Rule.Translated: Desata una andanada de explosiones de trueno y aniquila a grupos de enemigos en segundos.

Rule.Original: Emit a burst of pure energy and vaporize multiple enemies under melee range.
Rule.Raw: Emit a burst of pure energy and vaporize multiple enemies under melee range.
Rule.Translated: Emite un estallido de energía pura y vaporiza a varios enemigos a distancia de combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Launch a spear made of iron sand that can inflict iron lung towards the intended target. The user will gain a maximum number of 25 charges before the ability enters a 6 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Launch a spear made of iron sand that can inflict iron lung towards the intended target. The user will gain a maximum number of 25 charges before the ability enters a 6 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Lanza una lanza de arena de hierro que puede provocar pulmón de hierro en el objetivo. Dispone de un máximo de 25 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 6 horas.

Rule.Original: Shower the enemies with a field of iron sand, which inflicts iron lung to muliple targets.
Rule.Raw: Shower the enemies with a field of iron sand, which inflicts iron lung to muliple targets.
Rule.Translated: Baña a los enemigos en un campo de arena de hierro que provoca pulmón de hierro en varios objetivos.

Rule.Original: Fire a deadly beam that can lower the target's defense. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 6 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Fire a deadly beam that can lower the target's defense. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 6 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un rayo mortal que puede reducir la defensa del objetivo. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 6 horas.

Rule.Original: Rapidly energize the particles that is surrounding groups of enemies and unleash it in a violent manner that inflicts both stun and armor break at the same time. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Rapidly energize the particles that is surrounding groups of enemies and unleash it in a violent manner that inflicts both stun and armor break at the same time. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Energiza rápidamente las partículas que rodean a grupos de enemigos y libera esa energía de forma violenta, provocando aturdimiento y rotura de armadura a la vez. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Raise a singular target's attack DPS with a raise attack buff. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Raise a singular target's attack DPS with a raise attack buff. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta el daño por segundo de los ataques de un único objetivo con una bonificación de ataque. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Bestow a singular target with a fortified defense buff. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Bestow a singular target with a fortified defense buff. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Otorga una bonificación de defensa reforzada a un único objetivo. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Heal a singular target of any wounds. Can also heal permanent wounds, but can't regrow limbs. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Heal a singular target of any wounds. Can also heal permanent wounds, but can't regrow limbs. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Cura las heridas de un único objetivo. También puede curar heridas permanentes, pero no regenerar extremidades. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Generate a powerful aura that raises the morale towards anyone who are exposed to its influence. The effect lasts 24 hours and remains attached to the caster for the duration.
Rule.Raw: Generate a powerful aura that raises the morale towards anyone who are exposed to its influence. The effect lasts 24 hours and remains attached to the caster for the duration.
Rule.Translated: Genera un aura poderosa que eleva la moral de quienes están bajo su influencia. El efecto dura 24 horas y permanece vinculado al usuario durante ese tiempo.

Rule.Original: Temporarily void the extended warranty in order to become nimble and increadibly effective in ranged combat. The user will gain a maximum number of 2 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Temporarily void the extended warranty in order to become nimble and increadibly effective in ranged combat. The user will gain a maximum number of 2 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Anula temporalmente la garantía extendida para ganar agilidad y una eficacia increíble en combate a distancia. Dispone de un máximo de 2 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Attract multiple targets under a 5.9 radius and force them to draw near you. The user will gain a maximum number of 7 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Attract multiple targets under a 5.9 radius and force them to draw near you. The user will gain a maximum number of 7 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Atrae a varios objetivos dentro de un radio de 5.9 y los obliga a acercarse a ti. Dispone de un máximo de 7 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Temporarily grant the user an increased defense buff. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Temporarily grant the user an increased defense buff. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Otorga temporalmente al usuario una bonificación de defensa. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Deploy a mini broad shield generator. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Deploy a mini broad shield generator. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Despliega un minigenerador de escudo de área. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Distribute a concoction that temporarily seal the target's open wounds, preserving their life until they recieve medical treatment. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Distribute a concoction that temporarily seal the target's open wounds, preserving their life until they recieve medical treatment. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Administra una mezcla que cierra temporalmente las heridas abiertas del objetivo y lo mantiene con vida hasta que reciba tratamiento médico. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Distribute a potent medicine that raises the target's immune system. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Distribute a potent medicine that raises the target's immune system. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Administra un potente medicamento que refuerza el sistema inmunitario del objetivo. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Distribute a potent serum that can heal major injuries. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Distribute a potent serum that can heal major injuries. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Administra un potente suero capaz de curar heridas graves. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Bring out a cure-all injector inside the backpack. The user will have a maximum of 2 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Bring out a cure-all injector inside the backpack. The user will have a maximum of 2 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Extrae un inyector curalotodo de la mochila. Dispone de un máximo de 2 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 120 horas.

Rule.Original: Distribute a potent solution that fully suppresses the target's feeling of pain. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Distribute a potent solution that fully suppresses the target's feeling of pain. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Administra una potente solución que suprime por completo el dolor del objetivo. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Temporarily grant the user an increased accuracy in range weapons. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Temporarily grant the user an increased accuracy in range weapons. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Aumenta temporalmente la precisión del usuario con armas a distancia. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Activate the inner stealth module which renders the user invisible. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Activate the inner stealth module which renders the user invisible. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Activa el módulo interno de sigilo, que vuelve invisible al usuario. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Shoot an explosive EMP warhead that can disable groups of mechanoids. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Shoot an explosive EMP warhead that can disable groups of mechanoids. The user will gain a maximum number of 10 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Dispara una ojiva PEM explosiva capaz de desactivar grupos de mecanoides. Dispone de un máximo de 10 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Invade the body of multiple targets with harmful nanites that lowers some of their body's capacities and forces them to go berserk. The user will gain a maximum number of 6 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Invade the body of multiple targets with harmful nanites that lowers some of their body's capacities and forces them to go berserk. The user will gain a maximum number of 6 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Invade el cuerpo de varios objetivos con nanitos dañinos que reducen algunas de sus capacidades y los obligan a entrar en frenesí. Dispone de un máximo de 6 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Throw a packed liquid magnesium grenade that slows the target and make them flamable. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Throw a packed liquid magnesium grenade that slows the target and make them flamable. The user will gain a maximum number of 5 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Lanza una granada cargada de magnesio líquido que ralentiza al objetivo y lo vuelve inflamable. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Spawn a food dispensing structure that dispense 5 pieces of packed survival meals every 24 hours, and disappears after 5 days. The user will have a maximum of 2 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Spawn a food dispensing structure that dispense 5 pieces of packed survival meals every 24 hours, and disappears after 5 days. The user will have a maximum of 2 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Genera una estructura que dispensa 5 raciones de supervivencia envasadas cada 24 horas y desaparece al cabo de 5 días. Dispone de un máximo de 2 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 120 horas.

Rule.Original: Spawn an ammo dispensing structure that dispense a box full of high caliber ammunition every 24 hours, and disappears after 5 days. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Spawn an ammo dispensing structure that dispense a box full of high caliber ammunition every 24 hours, and disappears after 5 days. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Genera una estructura que dispensa una caja de munición de gran calibre cada 24 horas y desaparece al cabo de 5 días. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 120 horas.

Rule.Original: Spawn a small generator that generates 500 watts of electricity, and disappears after 5 days. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Spawn a small generator that generates 500 watts of electricity, and disappears after 5 days. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Genera un pequeño generador que produce 500 vatios de electricidad y desaparece al cabo de 5 días. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 120 horas.

Rule.Original: Deploy military-grade landmines permanently. The user will have a maximum of 20 charges before the ability enters a 360 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Deploy military-grade landmines permanently. The user will have a maximum of 20 charges before the ability enters a 360 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Despliega minas terrestres de uso militar de forma permanente. Dispone de un máximo de 20 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 360 horas.

Rule.Original: Deploy an automatic, self-powered pulse turret that provides solid cover fire, then disappears after the entire day. The user will have a maximum of 2 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Deploy an automatic, self-powered pulse turret that provides solid cover fire, then disappears after the entire day. The user will have a maximum of 2 charges before the ability enters a 24 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Despliega una torreta de pulsos automática y autónoma que proporciona un sólido fuego de cobertura y desaparece al cabo de un día. Dispone de un máximo de 2 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 24 horas.

Rule.Original: Deploy an automatic machinegun turret that fortifies defensive positions, and permanently stays in the colony. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Raw: Deploy an automatic machinegun turret that fortifies defensive positions, and permanently stays in the colony. The user will have a maximum of 5 charges before the ability enters a 120 hr. cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Despliega una torreta de ametralladora automática que refuerza las posiciones defensivas y permanece en la colonia. Dispone de un máximo de 5 cargas; después, la capacidad entra en un periodo de recarga de 120 horas.
cápsula de formación de la capa protectora

Rule.Original: Ancient compacted rubble rich in supersteel.
Rule.Raw: Ancient compacted rubble rich in supersteel.
Rule.Translated: Escombros antiguos compactados ricos en superacero.
generador de núcleos de fusión mecanoide

Rule.Original: Produces power by consuming mech fusion cores. Must be periodically refueled by hand.
Rule.Raw: Produces power by consuming mech fusion cores. Must be periodically refueled by hand.
Rule.Translated: Produce energía consumiendo núcleos de fusión mecanoide. Debe repostarse periódicamente a mano.

Rule.Original: An advanced fabrication bench developed by kraltech industries. This bench, is capable of fabricating military gears, weapons, implants, and various items that are only available in kraltech.
Rule.Raw: An advanced fabrication bench developed by kraltech industries. This bench, is capable of fabricating military gears, weapons, implants, and various items that are only available in kraltech.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de fabricación avanzado desarrollado por Kraltech Industries. Puede fabricar equipo militar, armas, implantes y diversos objetos exclusivos de Kraltech.

Rule.Original: A special mech gestator capable of growing mech variants.
Rule.Raw: A special mech gestator capable of growing mech variants.
Rule.Translated: Un gestador especial de mecanoides capaz de desarrollar variantes de mecanoides.

Rule.Original: A crashed scavenger ship that was abandoned not too long ago. Luckily enough, all its cargo were also abandoned, so you can destroy the ship and claim all the cargo for yourself.
Rule.Raw: A crashed scavenger ship that was abandoned not too long ago. Luckily enough, all its cargo were also abandoned, so you can destroy the ship and claim all the cargo for yourself.
Rule.Translated: Una nave de chatarreros estrellada que fue abandonada hace poco. Por suerte, también abandonaron toda su carga, así que puedes destruir la nave y quedártela.

Rule.Original: Passing near the intact remains of a crashed scavenger ship, {PAWN_nameDef} noticed some intact strongboxes and other goodies.\n\nBy destroying the ship, {PAWN_nameDef} will be able to receive all the stuff that are inside the ship.
Rule.Raw: Passing near the intact remains of a crashed scavenger ship, {PAWN_nameDef} noticed some intact strongboxes and other goodies.\n\nBy destroying the ship, {PAWN_nameDef} will be able to receive all the stuff that are inside the ship.
Rule.Translated: Al pasar junto a los restos intactos de una nave de saqueadores estrellada, {PAWN_nameDef} ha descubierto cajas fuertes intactas y otros objetos interesantes.\n\nAl destruir la nave, {PAWN_nameDef} podrá obtener todo lo que contiene.

Rule.Original: Contains a bunch of useful stuff that would benefit anyone.
Rule.Raw: Contains a bunch of useful stuff that would benefit anyone.
Rule.Translated: Contiene numerosos objetos útiles que beneficiarían a cualquiera.

Rule.Original: A damaged remains of a scavenger ship which is now beyond repair. Can be deconstructed for resources.
Rule.Raw: A damaged remains of a scavenger ship which is now beyond repair. Can be deconstructed for resources.
Rule.Translated: Restos dañados e irreparables de una nave de chatarreros. Pueden desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: A computer access container box that contains a healthy supply of emergency supplies.
Rule.Raw: A computer access container box that contains a healthy supply of emergency supplies.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor con acceso informatizado que guarda una buena provisión de suministros de emergencia.

Rule.Original: A damaged exotic resource pod from a capital class cargo freighter. It contains exotic resources if deconstructed.
Rule.Raw: A damaged exotic resource pod from a capital class cargo freighter. It contains exotic resources if deconstructed.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula dañada de recursos exóticos procedente de un carguero de clase capital. Contiene recursos exóticos que se obtienen al desmantelarla.

Rule.Original: Some damaged remains of a gigantic cargo freighter. Can be deconstructed for resources.
Rule.Raw: Some damaged remains of a gigantic cargo freighter. Can be deconstructed for resources.
Rule.Translated: Restos dañados de un carguero gigantesco. Pueden desmantelarse para obtener recursos.

Rule.Original: A self-powered turret mounted with a pulse blaster. It cannot sense targets at very long ranges.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered turret mounted with a pulse blaster. It cannot sense targets at very long ranges.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta autónoma equipada con un bláster de pulsos. No puede detectar objetivos a distancias muy largas.

Rule.Original: A rapid-fire pulse blaster for area fire.
Rule.Raw: A rapid-fire pulse blaster for area fire.

Rule.Original: A psychic droner that was redesigned into a ship. This devious archotech device can transmit an even deadlier psychic drone that has a high chance of causing berserk onto humanoids every three days. Drawing near to it would be very detrimental, since the psychic frequency would raise dramatically to the point of drawing the victim to insanity. The ship is highly durable and protected with a high frequency shield generator.
Rule.Raw: A psychic droner that was redesigned into a ship. This devious archotech device can transmit an even deadlier psychic drone that has a high chance of causing berserk onto humanoids every three days. Drawing near to it would be very detrimental, since the psychic frequency would raise dramatically to the point of drawing the victim to insanity. The ship is highly durable and protected with a high frequency shield generator.
Rule.Translated: Un zumbador psíquico rediseñado como nave. Este perverso dispositivo arqueotecnológico transmite un zumbido aún más letal, con una alta probabilidad de provocar frenesí en humanoides cada tres días. Acercarse es muy perjudicial: la frecuencia psíquica aumenta drásticamente hasta llevar a la víctima a la locura. La nave es muy resistente y está protegida por un generador de escudo de alta frecuencia.

Rule.Original: A severe psychic droner field is affecting {0}s and reducing their consciousness and increasing their tendencies to go berserk. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A severe psychic droner field is affecting {0}s and reducing their consciousness and increasing their tendencies to go berserk. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Un campo de zumbido psíquico intenso afecta a los individuos de tipo {0}, reduce su consciencia y aumenta su tendencia a entrar en frenesí. El efecto depende de la sensibilidad psíquica de cada individuo.

Rule.Original: a psychic droner wave will reduce the consciousness and increase berserk tendencies of all [psychicSuppressorGender]s around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
Rule.Raw: a psychic droner wave will reduce the consciousness and increase berserk tendencies of all [psychicSuppressorGender]s around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
Rule.Translated: una onda de zumbido psíquico reducirá la consciencia y aumentará las tendencias de furia de todas las personas de tipo [psychicSuppressorGender] en torno a [map_definite] durante [gameConditionDuration_duration]

Rule.Original: The severe psychic droner field has dissipated.
Rule.Raw: The severe psychic droner field has dissipated.
Rule.Translated: El intenso campo de zumbido psíquico se ha disipado.

Rule.Original: A severe psychic droner field has begun reducing the consciousness, and forcing them to go berserk after three days of {0}s across the whole region. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A severe psychic droner field has begun reducing the consciousness, and forcing them to go berserk after three days of {0}s across the whole region. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Un intenso campo de zumbido psíquico ha empezado a reducir la consciencia de las personas de tipo {0} en toda la región y a hacer que entren en un estado de furia tras tres días. El efecto depende de la sensibilidad psíquica de cada individuo.

Rule.Original: The effect of a severe psychic droner field. Coordination, reasoning, and morality are muddled.
Rule.Raw: The effect of a severe psychic droner field. Coordination, reasoning, and morality are muddled.
Rule.Translated: El efecto de un campo de zumbido psíquico intenso. La coordinación, el razonamiento y la moral se ven alterados.

Rule.Original: This damn psychic drone is killing me!!
Rule.Raw: This damn psychic drone is killing me!!
Rule.Translated: ¡¡Este maldito zumbido psíquico me está matando!!
aterrizaje de nave con dinamo IEM

Rule.Original: An EMI dynamo that was redesigned into a ship. As the name suggests, the ship has the ability to disable electrical devices with an added bonus of polluting the entire region with radiation. The ship is protected with a high frequency shield generator.
Rule.Raw: An EMI dynamo that was redesigned into a ship. As the name suggests, the ship has the ability to disable electrical devices with an added bonus of polluting the entire region with radiation. The ship is protected with a high frequency shield generator.
Rule.Translated: Una dinamo IEM rediseñada como nave. Puede desactivar dispositivos eléctricos y, además, contaminar toda la región con radiación. La nave está protegida por un generador de escudo de alta frecuencia.

Rule.Original: An electromagnetic interference dynamo is projecting an EM interference field, disabling electrical devices and cause radiation poisoning.
Rule.Raw: An electromagnetic interference dynamo is projecting an EM interference field, disabling electrical devices and cause radiation poisoning.
Rule.Translated: Una dinamo de interferencia electromagnética está proyectando un campo de interferencia que desactiva los dispositivos eléctricos y provoca intoxicación por radiación.

Rule.Original: a distant EMI dynamo ship will blast [map_definite] with an EMI field with radiation, shutting down electrical devices and cause radiation poisoning for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
Rule.Raw: a distant EMI dynamo ship will blast [map_definite] with an EMI field with radiation, shutting down electrical devices and cause radiation poisoning for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
Rule.Translated: una nave distante con dinamo EMI bombardeará [map_definite] con un campo EMI radiactivo, desactivando los dispositivos eléctricos y provocando envenenamiento por radiación durante [gameConditionDuration_duration]

Rule.Original: An EMI field has been generated. It is disabling electrical devices and cause radiation poisoning.
Rule.Raw: An EMI field has been generated. It is disabling electrical devices and cause radiation poisoning.
Rule.Translated: Se ha generado un campo EMI. Desactiva los dispositivos eléctricos y provoca envenenamiento por radiación.
aterrizaje de nave emisora de tóxicos

Rule.Original: A toxic spewer that was redesigned into a ship. The ship can spread noxious chemicals through the atmosphere, which results in toxic rain that can turn the entire region into a toxic hellscape. The ship can fabricate mechanoid pestilence to besiege your colony, and it is protected with a high frequency shield generator.
Rule.Raw: A toxic spewer that was redesigned into a ship. The ship can spread noxious chemicals through the atmosphere, which results in toxic rain that can turn the entire region into a toxic hellscape. The ship can fabricate mechanoid pestilence to besiege your colony, and it is protected with a high frequency shield generator.
Rule.Translated: Un emisor de tóxicos rediseñado como nave. Dispersa sustancias nocivas por la atmósfera y provoca una lluvia tóxica capaz de convertir toda la región en un infierno venenoso. Puede fabricar mecanoides pestilencia para asediar tu colonia y está protegida por un generador de escudo de alta frecuencia.

Rule.Original: A modified toxic spewer is polluting the atmosphere, causing toxic rain to the entire region.
Rule.Raw: A modified toxic spewer is polluting the atmosphere, causing toxic rain to the entire region.
Rule.Translated: Un emisor de tóxicos modificado está contaminando la atmósfera y provoca lluvia tóxica en toda la región.

Rule.Original: a distant toxic spewer ship will rain down [map_definite] with toxic rain, inflicting deadly neurotoxins for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
Rule.Raw: a distant toxic spewer ship will rain down [map_definite] with toxic rain, inflicting deadly neurotoxins for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
Rule.Translated: una nave emisora de tóxicos distante provocará lluvia tóxica sobre [map_definite] y liberará neurotoxinas mortales durante [gameConditionDuration_duration]

Rule.Original: A toxic rain has been conjured. It is blanketing the entire region with nerotoxins.

nave avanzada de ola de frío

Rule.Original: A ship that can conjure an extreme cold snap, that can blanket the entire region with snow through heavy snowfall, and can reduce the temperature to -500 degrees. The ship can also add a bonus of inflicting the victim with heat nullifying nanites that nullify the victim's resistance to cold. The ship is protected with a high frequency shield generator.
Rule.Raw: A ship that can conjure an extreme cold snap, that can blanket the entire region with snow through heavy snowfall, and can reduce the temperature to -500 degrees. The ship can also add a bonus of inflicting the victim with heat nullifying nanites that nullify the victim's resistance to cold. The ship is protected with a high frequency shield generator.

También infecta a las víctimas con nanitos que anulan el calor y eliminan su resistencia al frío. La nave está protegida por un generador de escudo de alta frecuencia.

Rule.Original: A small energy shield device deployed by a militor heavy. Unlike other shield generators, this particular shield generator can block both bullet and mortar fire, and can cover a wide area of land that can shield an entire squad of combatants.
Rule.Raw: A small energy shield device deployed by a militor heavy. Unlike other shield generators, this particular shield generator can block both bullet and mortar fire, and can cover a wide area of land that can shield an entire squad of combatants.
