Rule.Original: An impassable perimeter wall, that surrounds an entire military compound. Capable of holding a roof.
Rule.Raw: An impassable perimeter wall, that surrounds an entire military compound. Capable of holding a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro perimetral infranqueable que rodea todo un complejo militar. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: An impassable, defensive wall that is reinforced with a lining of armor plates. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: An impassable, defensive wall that is reinforced with a lining of armor plates. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro defensivo infranqueable reforzado con un revestimiento de placas de blindaje. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: An impassable wall with a firing port, which allows marksmen to shoot in relative safety. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Raw: An impassable wall with a firing port, which allows marksmen to shoot in relative safety. Capable of holding up a roof.
Rule.Translated: Un muro infranqueable con una abertura de tiro que permite a los tiradores disparar con relativa seguridad. Puede sostener un techo.

Rule.Original: A robust barricade that can provide cover against enemy fire.
Rule.Raw: A robust barricade that can provide cover against enemy fire.
Rule.Translated: Una barricada robusta que proporciona cobertura frente al fuego enemigo.
transpondedor de banda mecanoide (Cazador de dragones)

Rule.Original: A mech-band signaling device that uses a signal chip as a core. When activated, it can transmited an encrpted message via mech signal pulse that can attract a steel wyvern, and its escorts, into your vicinity. Bear in mind that this is a single-use signaling device, and it will destroy itself after use.
Rule.Raw: A mech-band signaling device that uses a signal chip as a core. Invocar la amenaza del dragón de acero

It can fire high explosive shells that can takedown large groups of enemies in a single shot, and it's highly accurate thanks to its automatic targeting AI, but it has very low firing rate due to the recoil where the interior frame only managed to suppress half of the recoil.

Rule.Original: Individuals who belongs to a massive weapons manufacturing megacorp "Kraltech". Kraltech, in itself, has a long history of expansions where they originated somewhere near the center of the universe, and slowly expanded through many core worlds until they reach the very rim of the universe through the use of space jump relay technology. They sell a plethra of weapons, but the main product that solidified their position would be the anti-mech armaments. As the appearance of mech variants have grown in great frequency, and multiple colonies have fallen due to their onslaught, kraltech's anti-mech armaments became the spearhead that pushed the mech variants back and saved multiple colonies, though they have to pay a bloody price for such victories. It is not an exaggeration to say that their weapons are ridiculously expensive, but kraltech guarantees that their weapons possess superior firepower that are unmatched through many generations to come.
Rule.Raw: Individuals who belongs to a massive weapons manufacturing megacorp "Kraltech". Kraltech, in itself, has a long history of expansions where they originated somewhere near the center of the universe, and slowly expanded through many core worlds until they reach the very rim of the universe through the use of space jump relay technology. They sell a plethra of weapons, but the main product that solidified their position would be the anti-mech armaments. As the appearance of mech variants have grown in great frequency, and multiple colonies have fallen due to their onslaught, kraltech's anti-mech armaments became the spearhead that pushed the mech variants back and saved multiple colonies, though they have to pay a bloody price for such victories. It is not an exaggeration to say that their weapons are ridiculously expensive, but kraltech guarantees that their weapons possess superior firepower that are unmatched through many generations to come.
Rule.Translated: Miembros de «Kraltech», una enorme megacorporación fabricante de armas. Surgió cerca del centro del universo y se expandió por numerosos mundos centrales hasta alcanzar sus confines mediante tecnología de relés de salto espacial. Vende una amplia variedad de armas, pero su posición se consolidó gracias al armamento antimecanoides. Ante la aparición cada vez más frecuente de variantes de mecanoides y la caída de múltiples colonias, las armas de Kraltech encabezaron el contraataque y salvaron a muchas colonias, aunque esas victorias se pagaron con sangre. Sus armas son desorbitadamente caras, pero Kraltech garantiza una potencia de fuego superior que seguirá sin rival durante muchas generaciones.

Rule.Original: A powerful psychic ability that psychically warps that target's perception and bodily function, making them nigh unstoppable temporarily. Though there is a chance that it may cause severe brain damage!
Rule.Raw: A powerful psychic ability that psychically warps that target's perception and bodily function, making them nigh unstoppable temporarily. Though there is a chance that it may cause severe brain damage!
Rule.Translated: Una poderosa capacidad psíquica que altera la percepción y las funciones corporales del objetivo, haciéndolo casi imparable temporalmente. ¡Sin embargo, existe la posibilidad de que cause daños cerebrales graves!

Rule.Original: I can feel the dragon spirit within me!
Rule.Raw: I can feel the dragon spirit within me!
Rule.Translated: ¡Siento el espíritu del dragón dentro de mí!

Rule.Original: A powerful psychic ability that envelopes the target with an invisible forcefield, which renders the target invincible while lowering their mobility temporarily.
Rule.Raw: A powerful psychic ability that envelopes the target with an invisible forcefield, which renders the target invincible while lowering their mobility temporarily.
Rule.Translated: Una poderosa capacidad psíquica que envuelve al objetivo en un campo de fuerza invisible, lo vuelve invencible y reduce temporalmente su movilidad.
un carismático decreto de la emperatriz

Rule.Original: A powerful psychic ability that warps the target's physiology, bestowing them with increased productivity and a massive mood buff temporarily. It can also stop any current mental breaks that the target is having.
Rule.Raw: A powerful psychic ability that warps the target's physiology, bestowing them with increased productivity and a massive mood buff temporarily. It can also stop any current mental breaks that the target is having.
Rule.Translated: Una poderosa capacidad psíquica que altera la fisiología del objetivo y le otorga temporalmente mayor productividad y una enorme bonificación de ánimo. También puede detener sus crisis mentales actuales.

Rule.Original: I am to give it my all and work hard as the empress decreed!
Rule.Raw: I am to give it my all and work hard as the empress decreed!
Rule.Translated: ¡Debo darlo todo y trabajar duro, tal como ha decretado la emperatriz!
un aura de berserker sedienta de sangre

Rule.Original: A powerful psychic ability that psychically warps that target's physique, bolstering their muscle tissues which allows them to become a god of melee temporarily, though they would be in a beserk state in return.
Rule.Raw: A powerful psychic ability that psychically warps that target's physique, bolstering their muscle tissues which allows them to become a god of melee temporarily, though they would be in a beserk state in return.
Rule.Translated: Una poderosa capacidad psíquica que altera el físico del objetivo y fortalece su tejido muscular, convirtiéndolo temporalmente en un dios del combate cuerpo a cuerpo. A cambio, entra en un estado de frenesí.

Rule.Original: A sudden burst of chemical hormone injected by the MK.1 combat module. The designated target will recieve an significant boost for all capacities, reduced bleeding, and immune to stager temporarily.
Rule.Raw: A sudden burst of chemical hormone injected by the MK.1 combat module. The designated target will recieve an significant boost for all capacities, reduced bleeding, and immune to stager temporarily.
Rule.Translated: Una descarga repentina de hormonas inyectada por el módulo de combate MK.1. El objetivo recibe temporalmente una mejora notable de todas sus capacidades, sangra menos y es inmune al tambaleo.

Rule.Original: A sudden burst of chemical hormone injected by the Executive combat module. The designated target will recieve an explosive boost for all capacities, reduced bleeding, immune to stager, and increased damage resistance temporarily.
Rule.Raw: A sudden burst of chemical hormone injected by the Executive combat module. The designated target will recieve an explosive boost for all capacities, reduced bleeding, immune to stager, and increased damage resistance temporarily.
Rule.Translated: Una descarga repentina de hormonas inyectada por el módulo de combate ejecutivo. El objetivo recibe temporalmente una mejora extraordinaria de todas sus capacidades, sangra menos, es inmune al tambaleo y resiste mejor los daños.

Rule.Original: YOU CAN'T STOP ME!! IT'S FUTILE!!!!
Rule.Raw: YOU CAN'T STOP ME!! IT'S FUTILE!!!!

Rule.Original: From the moment I understood the weakness of my flesh, it disgusted me. I craved the strength and certainty of super steel. I aspired to the purity of the omnipotent machine. Your kind cling to your flesh as if it will not decay and fail you.
Rule.Raw: From the moment I understood the weakness of my flesh, it disgusted me. I craved the strength and certainty of super steel. I aspired to the purity of the omnipotent machine. Your kind cling to your flesh as if it will not decay and fail you.
Rule.Translated: Desde el momento en que comprendí la debilidad de mi carne, me repugnó. Ansiaba la fuerza y la certeza del superacero. Aspiraba a la pureza de la máquina omnipotente. Los de tu especie os aferráis a vuestra carne como si no fuera a deteriorarse y fallaros.

Rule.Original: This mechanitor's bandwidth and control group is being increased exponentialy thanks to the influence of an archotech band node structure.
Rule.Raw: This mechanitor's bandwidth and control group is being increased exponentialy thanks to the influence of an archotech band node structure.

Rule.Original: The soothing hym from the archotech band node fills me with absolute joy, it feels great!
Rule.Raw: The soothing hym from the archotech band node fills me with absolute joy, it feels great!
Rule.Translated: El himno relajante del nodo de banda arcotecnológica me llena de alegría absoluta. ¡Es una sensación estupenda!
calma del emanador del trofeo de apócrito supremo

Rule.Original: I can't believe we have killed such a mechanical being, it felt so unreal but it felt realy good.

Rule.Original: By emiting a psychic aura to nearby allies, the caster can bestow them with a morale boost.
Rule.Raw: By emiting a psychic aura to nearby allies, the caster can bestow them with a morale boost.
Rule.Translated: Al emitir un aura psíquica hacia los aliados cercanos, el usuario puede otorgarles una mejora de moral.

Rule.Original: Overall morale were fortified thanks to being near someone who is using the morale boost aura.
Rule.Raw: Overall morale were fortified thanks to being near someone who is using the morale boost aura.
Rule.Translated: La moral general se refuerza gracias a la cercanía de alguien que utiliza el aura de potenciación de moral.

Rule.Original: I'm filled with hope and ready to face what tomorrow will bring!
Rule.Raw: I'm filled with hope and ready to face what tomorrow will bring!
Rule.Translated: ¡Estoy lleno de esperanza y listo para afrontar lo que traiga el mañana!

Rule.Original: A special condition unique to modified militors that raises their movespeed and ranged combat potential.
Rule.Raw: A special condition unique to modified militors that raises their movespeed and ranged combat potential.
Rule.Translated: Un estado especial exclusivo de los militores modificados que aumenta su velocidad de movimiento y su potencial de combate a distancia.

Rule.Original: A special effect for heavy type militors where it can reinforce their own defense for a fixed period of time.
Rule.Raw: A special effect for heavy type militors where it can reinforce their own defense for a fixed period of time.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto especial de los militores pesados que les permite reforzar su propia defensa durante un tiempo determinado.

Rule.Original: Temporarily seal the target's open wound, preventing them from bleeding any further.
Rule.Raw: Temporarily seal the target's open wound, preventing them from bleeding any further.
Rule.Translated: Cierra temporalmente la herida abierta del objetivo y evita que siga sangrando.

Rule.Original: An immuno-enhancement solution that raises the patient's immunity against ailments.
Rule.Raw: An immuno-enhancement solution that raises the patient's immunity against ailments.
Rule.Translated: Una solución que refuerza la inmunidad del paciente frente a las enfermedades.

Rule.Original: A benefitial effect from the regen serum where it can heal severe wounds.
Rule.Raw: A benefitial effect from the regen serum where it can heal severe wounds.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto beneficioso del suero regenerador que permite curar heridas graves.

Rule.Original: A benefitial effect where the subject can temporarily feel no pain.
Rule.Raw: A benefitial effect where the subject can temporarily feel no pain.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto beneficioso que permite al sujeto dejar de sentir dolor temporalmente.

Rule.Original: A benefitial effect after being injected by a cure-all serum, which possess miraculous healing properties.
Rule.Raw: A benefitial effect after being injected by a cure-all serum, which possess miraculous healing properties.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto beneficioso tras recibir una inyección de suero curalotodo, que posee propiedades curativas milagrosas.

Rule.Original: An benefitial effect that grants the target increased accuracy.
Rule.Raw: An benefitial effect that grants the target increased accuracy.
Rule.Translated: Un efecto beneficioso que aumenta la precisión del objetivo.

Rule.Original: A serious health condition that lowers consciousness, sight, and breathing to 35%, due to harmful nanites present in the body.
Rule.Raw: A serious health condition that lowers consciousness, sight, and breathing to 35%, due to harmful nanites present in the body.
Rule.Translated: Un estado de salud grave que reduce la consciencia, la vista y la respiración al 35% debido a la presencia de nanitos dañinos en el cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A health hazard byproduct emited by the EMI dynamo ship.
Rule.Raw: A health hazard byproduct emited by the EMI dynamo ship.
Rule.Translated: Un subproducto peligroso para la salud emitido por la nave con dinamo IEM.

Rule.Original: Artificial toxic hazards that invaded the brain due to being exposed to toxic rain.
Rule.Raw: Artificial toxic hazards that invaded the brain due to being exposed to toxic rain.
Rule.Translated: Agentes tóxicos artificiales que han invadido el cerebro debido a la exposición a la lluvia tóxica.

Rule.Original: Dangerous nanites that slowly nullifies the victim's cold resistance.
Rule.Raw: Dangerous nanites that slowly nullifies the victim's cold resistance.
Rule.Translated: Nanitos peligrosos que anulan lentamente la resistencia de la víctima al frío.

Rule.Original: Dangerous nanites that slowly nullifies the victim's heat resistance.
Rule.Raw: Dangerous nanites that slowly nullifies the victim's heat resistance.
Rule.Translated: Nanitos peligrosos que anulan lentamente la resistencia de la víctima al calor.

Rule.Original: Toxin secreting nanites found in anti-organic fallouts. Symptoms includes, but not limited to, increased pain, slow degredation of the body, lowered immune system, and death.
Rule.Raw: Toxin secreting nanites found in anti-organic fallouts. Symptoms includes, but not limited to, increased pain, slow degredation of the body, lowered immune system, and death.
Rule.Translated: Nanitos que segregan toxinas presentes en la precipitación antiorgánica. Sus síntomas incluyen aumento del dolor, deterioro lento del cuerpo, debilitamiento del sistema inmunitario y muerte, entre otros.

Rule.Original: An infectious disease caused by anti-oraganic nanites. Symptoms includes, but not limited to, increased pain, slow degredation of the body, and lowered immune system.
Rule.Raw: An infectious disease caused by anti-oraganic nanites. Symptoms includes, but not limited to, increased pain, slow degredation of the body, and lowered immune system.
Rule.Translated: Una enfermedad infecciosa causada por nanitos antiorgánicos. Sus síntomas incluyen aumento del dolor, deterioro lento del cuerpo y debilitamiento del sistema inmunitario, entre otros.

Rule.Original: Rage-inducing nanites that hijacks the victim's brain, boosting their combat capabilities while plunging them in an unbridled amount of rage.
Rule.Raw: Rage-inducing nanites that hijacks the victim's brain, boosting their combat capabilities while plunging them in an unbridled amount of rage.
Rule.Translated: Nanitos que inducen ira y secuestran el cerebro de la víctima, potenciando sus capacidades de combate mientras la sumen en una furia desenfrenada.
Un módulo de combate mk.1 instalado.

Rule.Original: A damage reactant combat brain implant. It contains an intelligent micro-computer that assists the combatant by providing immediate combat data on the current enemy, further improving every combat facets that the combatant has. The implant also possess a hidden feature where the combatant recives a sudden surge of adrenaline when afflicted with any bullet-type wound.
Rule.Raw: A damage reactant combat brain implant. It contains an intelligent micro-computer that assists the combatant by providing immediate combat data on the current enemy, further improving every combat facets that the combatant has. The implant also possess a hidden feature where the combatant recives a sudden surge of adrenaline when afflicted with any bullet-type wound.
Rule.Translated: Un implante cerebral de combate que reacciona al daño. Su microordenador inteligente proporciona datos inmediatos sobre el enemigo actual y mejora todos los aspectos del combate. También incorpora una función oculta que provoca una descarga repentina de adrenalina cuando el usuario sufre una herida de bala.
Instala un módulo de combate mk.1.
Extrae el módulo de combate mk.1.
Un módulo de combate mk.2 instalado.

Rule.Original: A regenerative combat brain implant. The mk. 2 implant is somewhat inferior to the mk.1 in stat benefits, but the mk.2 is capable of releasing fast wound healing chemicals capable of healing severe wounds overtime.
Rule.Raw: A regenerative combat brain implant. The mk. 2 implant is somewhat inferior to the mk.1 in stat benefits, but the mk.2 is capable of releasing fast wound healing chemicals capable of healing severe wounds overtime.
Rule.Translated: Un implante cerebral de combate regenerativo. El mk. 2 ofrece bonificaciones algo inferiores a las del mk.1, pero el mk.2 libera sustancias de curación rápida capaces de sanar heridas graves con el tiempo.
Instala un módulo de combate mk.2.
Extrae el módulo de combate mk.2.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat eye implant designed specificly for melee combat. Its lens are made of high quality carbon fiber glass for maximum ballistic protection, and equipped with highly sensitive micro sensors for high quality resolution. The microsensors are also highly sensitive to muscular movement within 5 feet radius, in which it will send data to the nervous system so the combatant will react quicker than the preceding threat, further improving their efficientcy in melee combat.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat eye implant designed specificly for melee combat. Its lens are made of high quality carbon fiber glass for maximum ballistic protection, and equipped with highly sensitive micro sensors for high quality resolution. The microsensors are also highly sensitive to muscular movement within 5 feet radius, in which it will send data to the nervous system so the combatant will react quicker than the preceding threat, further improving their efficientcy in melee combat.
Rule.Translated: Un implante ocular avanzado diseñado para el combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Sus lentes de vidrio de fibra de carbono de alta calidad ofrecen máxima protección balística, y sus microsensores sensibles proporcionan gran resolución. Detectan movimientos musculares en un radio de 5 pies y envían datos al sistema nervioso para que el combatiente reaccione antes de que la amenaza se materialice, mejorando su eficacia cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat eye implant designed specificly for ranged combat. Its lens are highly sensitive to movement at long distance and it has 4x zoom, making the combatant highly efficient to ranged combat.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat eye implant designed specificly for ranged combat. Its lens are highly sensitive to movement at long distance and it has 4x zoom, making the combatant highly efficient to ranged combat.
Rule.Translated: Un implante ocular avanzado diseñado para el combate a distancia. Sus lentes detectan movimientos lejanos con gran sensibilidad y tienen un zoom de 4x, lo que aumenta enormemente la eficacia del combatiente a distancia.

Rule.Original: A combat arm implant with a mantis blade hidden in the wrists, in which it can retract itself upon command and deal deadly amounts of slicing damage at frightning pace.
Rule.Raw: A combat arm implant with a mantis blade hidden in the wrists, in which it can retract itself upon command and deal deadly amounts of slicing damage at frightning pace.
Rule.Translated: Un implante de brazo de combate con una cuchilla mantis oculta en la muñeca. Puede desplegarse al recibir una orden e infligir daños cortantes letales a una velocidad aterradora.
Instala un brazo de combate «Cuchilla mantis».

Rule.Original: A combat leg implant with a reinforced shin. The implant allows the combatant to perform a deadly roundhouse kick that can stun or inflict EMP to organic and non organic foes.
Rule.Raw: A combat leg implant with a reinforced shin. The implant allows the combatant to perform a deadly roundhouse kick that can stun or inflict EMP to organic and non organic foes.
Rule.Translated: Un implante de pierna de combate con la espinilla reforzada. Permite dar una patada circular letal capaz de aturdir o infligir PEM a enemigos orgánicos y no orgánicos.
Una columna vertebral de combate instalada.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat spine implant crafted specificly to mimic the actual likeness of a regular spine, down to its very details. The spine is very flexible and had an uncanny feeling of having no difference towards a normal spine. The inside of the spine is filled with biogel and fiber optics, in which the biogel absorbs external shock and fiber optics improve a combatant's mobility and blood filtration. The combat spine also has a key feature of fitering toxins via blood vessels and releasing adamant chemicals that reinforces a combatant's damage resistance.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat spine implant crafted specificly to mimic the actual likeness of a regular spine, down to its very details. The spine is very flexible and had an uncanny feeling of having no difference towards a normal spine. The inside of the spine is filled with biogel and fiber optics, in which the biogel absorbs external shock and fiber optics improve a combatant's mobility and blood filtration. The combat spine also has a key feature of fitering toxins via blood vessels and releasing adamant chemicals that reinforces a combatant's damage resistance.
Rule.Translated: Una columna vertebral de combate avanzada que imita hasta el último detalle de una normal. Es muy flexible y resulta inquietantemente indistinguible de una columna natural. Su interior contiene biogel, que absorbe los impactos externos, y fibra óptica, que mejora la movilidad y el filtrado de la sangre. También filtra toxinas a través de los vasos sanguíneos y libera sustancias endurecedoras que refuerzan la resistencia del combatiente a los daños.
Instala una columna vertebral de combate.
Extrae la columna vertebral de combate.

Rule.Original: A skin implant with millions of nanomachines that hardens in response to physical and environmental trauma. These nanomachines are all controlled by a central nanomachine core, which prevents these nanomachines to go rampant inside the body and control them to repair damaged tissues caused by external damage.
Rule.Raw: A skin implant with millions of nanomachines that hardens in response to physical and environmental trauma. These nanomachines are all controlled by a central nanomachine core, which prevents these nanomachines to go rampant inside the body and control them to repair damaged tissues caused by external damage.
Rule.Translated: Un implante de piel con millones de nanomáquinas que se endurecen ante daños físicos y ambientales. Un núcleo central controla las nanomáquinas, impide que se descontrolen dentro del cuerpo y las dirige para reparar los tejidos dañados por agresiones externas.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat heart implant, capable of pumping blood more efficiently and releases regenerative agents and spreading it throughout the body.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat heart implant, capable of pumping blood more efficiently and releases regenerative agents and spreading it throughout the body.
Rule.Translated: Un implante avanzado de corazón de combate que bombea sangre con mayor eficacia y libera agentes regenerativos que se distribuyen por todo el cuerpo.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat stomach implant with a built-in micronutrients storage compartment which stores extra nutrients from food, and using them when needed the most. It can also excrete chemicals that can prevent food poisoning from ever happening.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat stomach implant with a built-in micronutrients storage compartment which stores extra nutrients from food, and using them when needed the most. It can also excrete chemicals that can prevent food poisoning from ever happening.
Rule.Translated: Un implante avanzado de estómago de combate con un compartimento integrado que guarda micronutrientes adicionales de los alimentos para utilizarlos cuando más se necesitan. También segrega sustancias que previenen las intoxicaciones alimentarias.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat ear implant that offers a patient with a more heightened sense of hearing once installed.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat ear implant that offers a patient with a more heightened sense of hearing once installed.
Rule.Translated: Un implante avanzado de oído de combate que proporciona al paciente una audición más aguda al instalarlo.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat lung implant which offers the best performance in inhaling oxygen and exhaling carbon dioxide. It can also filter external toxic fumes if inhaled.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat lung implant which offers the best performance in inhaling oxygen and exhaling carbon dioxide. It can also filter external toxic fumes if inhaled.
Rule.Translated: Un implante avanzado de pulmón de combate que ofrece un rendimiento óptimo al inhalar oxígeno y exhalar dióxido de carbono. También filtra los vapores tóxicos del exterior si se inhalan.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat kidney implant that is more efficient than a normal kidney.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat kidney implant that is more efficient than a normal kidney.
Rule.Translated: Un implante avanzado de riñón de combate más eficiente que un riñón normal.

Rule.Original: A damage reactant combat brain implant used by the executives. It is a complete upgrade to the combat module mk.1 where the combatant receives exponential combat boost, and auto heal to permanent wounds, with the help of nanomachines flooding from the brain and spread throughout the body. The implant also has a unique feature of releasing a chemical compound called "Adrenaline EX" once been inflicted with a bullet wound.

This implant is considered as one of the most powerful implant, granting the user absurd benefits in all capacities, and an ability to cast mass teleportation that can teleport the caster and their allies towards or away from danger. Though bear in mind that inorder to teleport nearby pawns, one should be under the caster's 1.9 effect radius for them to be teleported.

The spine implant contains potent medicinal compound that instantly finishes the body's blood clotting process and greatly boost its natural healing ability, and all of this can be manually activated by the user as a standalone ability.

El usuario puede activarlo manualmente como una capacidad independiente.

Rule.Original: An ultra tech heart implant designed by the archotechs. Considered as a must-have combat implant, the archotech overdrive heart implant can send the user in an overdriven state, where bodily function are pushed to an extreme inorder to increase melee DPS, decrease ranged cooldown and aiming delay temporarily. Although during this state, the user's hunger need will increase twofold temporarily.

Rule.Translated: Un implante de corazón ultratecnológico diseñado por arqueotecas, considerado imprescindible en combate. Induce una sobrecarga que lleva las funciones corporales al extremo para aumentar temporalmente el daño por segundo cuerpo a cuerpo y reducir la recarga y el tiempo de apuntado a distancia. Durante ese estado, la necesidad de comida del usuario se duplica temporalmente.
instalar implante de corazón arqueotecnológico de sobrecarga

Rule.Original: An ultra-heavy war queen variant with a built-in mech gestator. The empress bears the nickname "The walking fortress" due to its excellent versatility in both attack and defence. For attack, the empress wields a dual mech chaingun from the front and the back, which both delivers unrelenting punisment at long distances. For defense, the empress is heavily cladded with armor platting that renders ordinary small arms useless, and capable of fabricating an aggressive squad of hydraulic knights and depoly them in battle. Such a powerful mech variant can reduce any colony, that doesn't possess any effective countermesure against it, into rubble. Theoratically, a lone hydraulic empress is enough to wipe-out an entire colony, if unprepared.
Rule.Raw: An ultra-heavy war queen variant with a built-in mech gestator. The empress bears the nickname "The walking fortress" due to its excellent versatility in both attack and defence. Rule.Translated: Una variante ultrapesada de reina bélica con un gestador de mecanoides integrado. La emperatriz recibe el apodo de «La fortaleza andante» por su excelente versatilidad tanto en ataque como en defensa. Para atacar, lleva ametralladoras mecanoides dobles delante y detrás, que castigan sin descanso a larga distancia. Para defenderse, está recubierta de gruesas placas de blindaje que inutilizan las armas ligeras corrientes. Además, puede fabricar una agresiva escuadra de caballeros hidráulicos y desplegarla en combate. Esta poderosa variante mecanoide puede reducir a escombros cualquier colonia que carezca de contramedidas eficaces. En teoría, una sola emperatriz hidráulica basta para arrasar una colonia desprevenida.

Rule.Original: An ultra-heavy hybrid variant of a warqueen and an apocriton. The warlord is the most devious of all mech bosses ever discovered, well protected by a monstrous shield bubble, able to fire laser bolts using a mech laser blaster, can fabricate a legion of dragon knights to defend itself, and can resurrect them when fallen in battle. The warlord is designed to be a solution againts spacer-tech factions, according to official glittertech archives and various combat transcripts, multiple high-tech colonies from multiple core worlds collapsed due to the arrival of the dragon warlord, along with it's cadre of dragon knights.
Rule.Raw: An ultra-heavy hybrid variant of a warqueen and an apocriton. Rule.Translated: Una variante híbrida ultrapesada de reina bélica y apocritón. Es uno de los jefes mecanoides más perversos: tiene una enorme burbuja de escudo, dispara descargas láser con un bláster mecanoide y fabrica legiones de caballeros dracónicos, a los que puede resucitar. Diseñado contra facciones de tecnología espacial, ha provocado, junto con sus caballeros, el colapso de numerosas colonias avanzadas de mundos centrales, según archivos oficiales de tecnología de mundo brillante y registros de combate.

Rule.Original: A heavy-class diabolus variant, and one of the most destructive mech variant ever concieved. The steel wyvern possess the highest health out of all the mech bossess, and that monstrous health is cladded with layers of armor plating. The steel wyvern is capable of spamming charge blasts and plasma blasts through its mouth, and fires laser bolts through its back as support. All this specs were concieved by the mech hive in their intension to create the deadliest siege beast that ever exist, and after years of pain and destruction caused by the aforementioned siege beast, it's safe to say that it had succeeded.

Rule.Translated: Una variante pesada de diábolus y una de las variantes mecanoides más destructivas jamás concebidas. El guiverno de acero tiene la mayor reserva de salud de todos los jefes mecanoides, y su monstruosa resistencia está protegida por capas de blindaje. Puede lanzar sin descanso explosiones de carga y de plasma por la boca, mientras dispara descargas láser desde el lomo como apoyo. La colmena mecanoide concibió todas estas prestaciones para crear la bestia de asedio más letal jamás vista. Tras años de dolor y destrucción causados por esta bestia, puede afirmarse que lo consiguió.

Rule.Original: An ultra-heavy apocriton variant mechanoid, who specializes in spreding life threatning toxins in the atmosphere. The pestilence has the ability to spread hazardous fumes in a wide area, preventing any organics from drawing near, all while forcing them away from their defensive position, giving its mech allies an opportunity to push forward. This type of mech oftenly spawns alongside the empress and the warlord, serving as their main support by gassing the defenders and drastically lowering their defensive capabilities.
Rule.Raw: An ultra-heavy apocriton variant mechanoid, who specializes in spreding life threatning toxins in the atmosphere. Rule.Translated: Una variante ultrapesada de apocritón especializada en dispersar toxinas letales por la atmósfera. La pestilencia puede esparcir vapores peligrosos por una amplia zona, impidiendo que los seres orgánicos se acerquen y obligándolos a abandonar sus posiciones defensivas, lo que permite avanzar a sus aliados mecanoides. Este tipo de mecanoide suele aparecer junto a la emperatriz y al señor de la guerra. Les proporciona su principal apoyo gaseando a los defensores y reduciendo drásticamente su capacidad defensiva.

Rule.Original: Another ultra-heavy war queen variant with a built-in mech gestator. This mechanoid is capable of gestating a group of militor mk2 en mass and provide relative distraction and destruction at the same time, all while providing cover fire using its mech orbital beam targeter. The militor queen only spawns during a supreme apocriton raid, serving as the ultra boss's reliable support.

Rule.Translated: Otra variante ultrapesada de reina bélica con un gestador de mecanoides integrado. Gesta militores mk2 en masa para distraer y destruir, mientras proporciona fuego de cobertura con su designador de rayo orbital mecanoide. Solo aparece durante un asalto de apocritón supremo, como apoyo fiable del superjefe.

Rule.Original: An improved version of the militor, now with a shield generator pack and an ability to wield a plethra of light-weight mech weapons in its mechanical hands.
Rule.Raw: An improved version of the militor, now with a shield generator pack and an ability to wield a plethra of light-weight mech weapons in its mechanical hands.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del militor, con un generador de escudo y la capacidad de empuñar numerosas armas mecanoides ligeras en sus manos mecánicas.

Rule.Original: A small, deployable combat mechanoid variant produced by the supreme apocriton. The scyth urchin has blades that was permanently installed and can use it to cut enemy combatants to pieces, and like the war urchin, the scyth urchin also specializes in swarm tactics in which it can overwhelm and subdue enemies using numerical superiority.

Rule.Translated: Una pequeña variante mecanoide de combate desplegable producida por el apocritón supremo. Sus cuchillas permanentes despedazan a los enemigos. Como el erizo bélico, se especializa en tácticas de enjambre para arrollar y someter al enemigo mediante superioridad numérica.

Rule.Original: A powerful mech variant holding a mech mono sword. This mech is increadibly fast where it can chase down slow moving organics with ease, and it possess quick reflexes which alows for faster and more precise melee hits. The hydraulic knight is mostly seen accompanying the hydraulic empress, serving as its sworn sword and creator.

Su gran velocidad permite perseguir fácilmente a los seres orgánicos lentos, y sus rápidos reflejos hacen sus golpes cuerpo a cuerpo más veloces y precisos. Suele acompañar a la emperatriz hidráulica, su creadora, y le sirve como espada juramentada.

Rule.Original: A highly aggressive mech variant who serves the dragon warlord. The dragon knight uses a variety of mech ranged weapons ranging from a tri-shot charge lance to a full auto assault charger, all while being protected by a low frequency shield bubble. The capabilities of the dragon knight truely shines when fighting alongside the dragon warlord along with the rest of its dragon knights, which also spells doom to their organic foes.

Rule.Translated: Una variante mecanoide muy agresiva al servicio del señor de la guerra dracónico. Utiliza armas a distancia que van de una lanza de carga de tres disparos a un arma de asalto de carga automática, protegida por un escudo de baja frecuencia. Sus capacidades brillan junto al señor de la guerra y los demás caballeros dracónicos, para desgracia de sus enemigos orgánicos.

Rule.Original: One of the few tankiest mech variant grunt ever existed. The paladin is cladded with the same armor plating that the mech bosses uses, but not too much that it would overload its mechanical rotors. Though in exchange for more armor, its movement speed would be lowered which it will pose a problem in chasing down agile opponents, but the paladin has a built-in grenade launcher that shoots stun grenades at enemies for easy takedowns. The paladin is mostly seen whenever a mech boss appears in the distance, serving as their faithful guards in the battlefield.

Rule.Translated: Una de las variantes de tropa mecanoide más resistentes que existen. El paladín está recubierto del mismo blindaje que usan los jefes mecanoides, aunque en una cantidad que no sobrecarga sus rotores mecánicos. A cambio de esta protección adicional, pierde velocidad de movimiento, lo que dificulta perseguir a enemigos ágiles. Sin embargo, lleva un lanzagranadas integrado que dispara granadas aturdidoras para abatirlos con facilidad. Suele verse cuando aparece un jefe mecanoide en la distancia, al que sirve como guardia fiel en el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: One of the most dangerous mech variant grunt ever created, built specifically for aggressive skirmishes against larger settlements throughout the rim. The mech samurai has low armor, but its attacks are swift and accurate which leaves the enemy with little opportunity to retaliate. The samurai is also increadibly fast, where running away is impossible unless you're bionicaly enhanced. According to official records after salveging the samurai's artificial brain, its battle prowess originated from a famous samurai general from feudal era japan. His name were never recorded, for the mechanoids never cared about that after defeating him and stole his brain.

Rule.Translated: Una de las variantes de tropa mecanoide más peligrosas, diseñada para escaramuzas agresivas contra grandes asentamientos del borde exterior. Tiene poco blindaje, pero sus ataques rápidos y precisos apenas permiten responder. Es tan veloz que solo alguien mejorado con biónica puede escapar. Los registros de su cerebro artificial indican que su destreza procede de un famoso general samurái del Japón feudal. Su nombre no se conservó: los mecanoides no se preocuparon por ello tras derrotarlo y robarle el cerebro.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid variant capable of using AOE psycast abilities. The psionic has an artificial psycast brain inside its mechanical head, which was mass produced by the mech hive for devious motives. The psionic can cast at least cast two psycast abilities which includes but not limited to, the ability fire an explosive psychic bullet, and the ability to cast berserk pulse on multiple enemies. But despite all this, the psionic is the weakest of all the mech variants in terms of health and armor, but through combat prowess and use of psycast abilities, it is one of the most annoying enemy to deal with.

But despite all this, the psionic is the weakest of all the mech variants in terms of health and armor, but through combat prowess and use of psycast abilities, it is one of the most annoying enemy to deal with.
Rule.Translated: Una variante mecanoide capaz de usar psipoderes de área. El psiónico contiene un cerebro psíquico artificial en su cabeza mecánica, fabricado en masa por la colmena mecanoide con fines perversos. Puede utilizar al menos dos psipoderes, entre los que se incluyen una bala psíquica explosiva y un pulso de frenesí contra varios enemigos, aunque sus capacidades no se limitan a ellos. Pese a todo, es la variante mecanoide más débil en salud y blindaje. Su destreza en combate y el uso de psipoderes lo convierten, sin embargo, en uno de los enemigos más molestos de afrontar.

Rule.Original: One of the tankiest and largest mech variant grunt ever concieved, and probably considered a mech boss despite its status as a mech variant grunt. The guardian is built specifically for invasions, where it is capable of facing a storm of bullets from the defending force and still continues to push through. The guardian is also versatile in both close, medium, and ranged combat, where it can take down enemies at long range using its charged battle rifle and a built-in rocket launcher, repel approaching enemies with a laser blaster turret, and stun enemies that are too close with a stun grenade launcher. The guardian only spawns during a supreme apocriton raid, serving as the ultra boss's valiant protector and executioner.

The guardian only spawns during a supreme apocriton raid, serving as the ultra boss's valiant protector and executioner.
Rule.Translated: Una de las variantes de tropa mecanoide más grandes y resistentes jamás concebidas, que probablemente se considere un jefe mecanoide pese a su condición de tropa. El guardián está diseñado específicamente para las invasiones: puede afrontar una lluvia de balas de los defensores y seguir avanzando. También es versátil en el combate a corta, media y larga distancia. Abate enemigos lejanos con su fusil de batalla de carga y un lanzacohetes integrado, repele a quienes se acercan con una torreta de bláster láser y aturde a los que están demasiado cerca con un lanzagranadas aturdidor. Solo aparece durante un asalto de apocritón supremo, al que sirve como valiente protector y ejecutor.

Rule.Original: An improved version of the centipede, now with more armor and health capable of deflecting bullets from small firearms, and armed with one the best heavy weapons that the mech hive has to offer.
Rule.Raw: An improved version of the centipede, now with more armor and health capable of deflecting bullets from small firearms, and armed with one the best heavy weapons that the mech hive has to offer.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del ciempiés, con más blindaje y salud para desviar balas de armas pequeñas. Empuña una de las mejores armas pesadas de la colmena mecanoide.

Rule.Original: An improved version of the lancer, now with faster movement speed for quicker response and interception.
Rule.Raw: An improved version of the lancer, now with faster movement speed for quicker response and interception.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del lancero, con mayor velocidad de movimiento para responder e interceptar con más rapidez.

Rule.Original: An improved version of the scyther, now with four blades for improved DPS. The alpha scyther is oftenly seen in packs with other alpha scythers, making them a serious threat to anyone who's not well versed in melee combat.
Rule.Raw: An improved version of the scyther, now with four blades for improved DPS. The alpha scyther is oftenly seen in packs with other alpha scythers, making them a serious threat to anyone who's not well versed in melee combat.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del segador, con cuatro cuchillas que aumentan el daño por segundo. Suele aparecer en grupos con otros segadores alfa, siendo una grave amenaza para quien no domine el combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: An improved version of the pikeman, now with more armor and a slightly increase in movespeed.
Rule.Raw: An improved version of the pikeman, now with more armor and a slightly increase in movespeed.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del piquero, con más blindaje y un ligero aumento de velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: The harbinger of death, and the all-father of apocritons. The supreme apocriton is an ultra-heavy mech variant which is believed to be the sole progenitor of all apocritons that exist today, and like the apocritons, it also has a deep hatred towards all natural life to an extreme degree. Its total abilities are unknown other than its ability to resurrect mechanoid allies, and it is the only mech variant capable of wielding the infamous mech heavy laser blaster. The supreme apocriton oftenly spawns with a cadre of hard to defeat mech variants, but luckly, it never spawns normally unless summoned using a "god slayer" mech transponder.

Rule.Translated: El heraldo de la muerte y padre de todos los apocritones. Se cree que esta variante ultrapesada es su único progenitor y comparte su odio extremo a la vida natural. Sus capacidades son desconocidas salvo la resurrección de aliados mecanoides. Es la única variante que empuña el temido bláster láser pesado mecanoide. Suele aparecer con un destacamento de variantes muy difíciles de derrotar, pero, por suerte, solo lo hace si se invoca mediante un transpondedor «Matadioses».

Rule.Original: An offshoot created by the image of the supreme apocriton, meant to provide support by wielding the original's power to achieve victory.
Rule.Raw: An offshoot created by the image of the supreme apocriton, meant to provide support by wielding the original's power to achieve victory.
Rule.Translated: Un vástago creado a imagen del apocritón supremo para proporcionar apoyo y alcanzar la victoria utilizando el poder del original.

Rule.Original: An extremely agile mechanoid that personifies the valkyries of norse mythos. With a mech lance on one hand, the valkyrian can push through enemy defenses and impale enemy soldiers within seconds. The valkyrian is also unfazed when hit with bullets while closing in, and possess a handful of skills that are effective against singular and group targets. The valkyrian only spawns during a supreme apocriton raid, serving as the ultra boss's elite soldiers.
Rule.Raw: An extremely agile mechanoid that personifies the valkyries of norse mythos. With a mech lance on one hand, the valkyrian can push through enemy defenses and impale enemy soldiers within seconds. The valkyrian is also unfazed when hit with bullets while closing in, and possess a handful of skills that are effective against singular and group targets. The valkyrian only spawns during a supreme apocriton raid, serving as the ultra boss's elite soldiers.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide extremadamente ágil que encarna a las valquirias de la mitología nórdica. Con una lanza mecanoide en una mano, atraviesa las defensas y empala soldados en segundos. No se inmuta ante los disparos mientras avanza y posee capacidades eficaces contra objetivos individuales y grupos. Solo aparece durante un asalto de apocritón supremo, como soldado de élite del superjefe.

Rule.Original: A heavy laser turret that shoots high intensity gamma ray that burns anything in its wake.
Rule.Raw: A heavy laser turret that shoots high intensity gamma ray that burns anything in its wake.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta láser pesada que dispara un rayo gamma de gran intensidad y quema todo a su paso.

Rule.Original: A heavy laser blaster turret that shoots deadly laser bolts onto enemies of great quantity.
Rule.Raw: A heavy laser blaster turret that shoots deadly laser bolts onto enemies of great quantity.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de bláster láser pesado que dispara descargas letales contra numerosos enemigos.

Rule.Original: A stub chaingun turret that can shoot armor piercing bullets at the back.
Rule.Raw: A stub chaingun turret that can shoot armor piercing bullets at the back.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de ametralladora corta que dispara balas perforantes hacia atrás.

Rule.Original: A heavy laser blaster turret that shoots even more deadly laser beams onto enemies of great quantity.
Rule.Raw: A heavy laser blaster turret that shoots even more deadly laser beams onto enemies of great quantity.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de bláster láser pesado que dispara rayos aún más letales contra numerosos enemigos.

Rule.Original: A hidden heavy plasma blaster turret.
Rule.Raw: A hidden heavy plasma blaster turret.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta oculta de bláster de plasma pesado.

Rule.Original: One of the strongest mechanoid which is believed to be on par to the supreme apocriton, and the ultimate solution against the ever growing threat of the mechanoid variants. Inspired by the weapon used by the god of thunder "Thor", mjolnir is capable of wielding electrical based ablities that are detrimental to both organic and mechanical enemies, along with few abilities that allows it to dominate the battlefield. It is also immune to both stagger and EMP, increadibly proficient in melee combat, and the only mechanoid that can wield the mech storm lance. The conception of mjolnir is due to the result of the combined efforts of the mechanitors of long ago, who are hellbent in creating a mechanoid strong enough to oppose the mech hive, and to counter the onslaught of the mech hive's powerful ultra bosses.
Rule.Raw: One of the strongest mechanoid which is believed to be on par to the supreme apocriton, and the ultimate solution against the ever growing threat of the mechanoid variants. Inspired by the weapon used by the god of thunder "Thor", mjolnir is capable of wielding electrical based ablities that are detrimental to both organic and mechanical enemies, along with few abilities that allows it to dominate the battlefield. It is also immune to both stagger and EMP, increadibly proficient in melee combat, and the only mechanoid that can wield the mech storm lance. The conception of mjolnir is due to the result of the combined efforts of the mechanitors of long ago, who are hellbent in creating a mechanoid strong enough to oppose the mech hive, and to counter the onslaught of the mech hive's powerful ultra bosses.
Rule.Translated: Uno de los mecanoides más poderosos, que se cree comparable al apocritón supremo, y la solución definitiva a la amenaza cada vez mayor de las variantes mecanoides. Inspirado en el arma del dios del trueno «Thor», Mjolnir usa capacidades eléctricas dañinas tanto para enemigos orgánicos como mecánicos, junto con otras que le permiten dominar el campo de batalla. También es inmune al tambaleo y al PEM, es increíblemente hábil en el combate cuerpo a cuerpo y es el único mecanoide capaz de empuñar la lanza de tormenta mecanoide. Mjolnir surgió del esfuerzo conjunto de los mecanitores de antaño, empeñados en crear un mecanoide lo bastante fuerte como para enfrentarse a la colmena mecanoide y contrarrestar los ataques de sus poderosos superjefes.

Rule.Original: An ultra boss prototype created by the mechanitors that malfunctioned, went on an unbridled rampage, and later been assimilated to the mech hive. This prototype thunder god, who became corrupted, possess at least half of the original power of the thunder god so elimination is highly possible, but don't let that fact fool you, since it is still an ultra boss reguardless of it being a prototype.
Rule.Raw: An ultra boss prototype created by the mechanitors that malfunctioned, went on an unbridled rampage, and later been assimilated to the mech hive. This prototype thunder god, who became corrupted, possess at least half of the original power of the thunder god so elimination is highly possible, but don't let that fact fool you, since it is still an ultra boss reguardless of it being a prototype.
Rule.Translated: Un prototipo de superjefe creado por mecanitores que se averió, entró en un frenesí desenfrenado y terminó asimilado por la colmena. Este dios del trueno corrupto conserva al menos la mitad del poder del original, por lo que puede ser eliminado. Aun así, no te confíes: sigue siendo un superjefe, aunque sea un prototipo.

Rule.Original: A militor mk2 with advanced modifications which makes it highly adept in combat, and able to perform most jobs that a normal human can do.
Rule.Raw: A militor mk2 with advanced modifications which makes it highly adept in combat, and able to perform most jobs that a normal human can do.
Rule.Translated: Un militor mk2 con modificaciones avanzadas que lo hacen muy eficaz en combate. Puede realizar la mayoría de trabajos de un humano normal.

Rule.Original: A militor mk2 with advanced modifications which makes it an effective tank, and able to perform most jobs that a normal human can do.
Rule.Raw: A militor mk2 with advanced modifications which makes it an effective tank, and able to perform most jobs that a normal human can do.
Rule.Translated: Un militor mk2 con modificaciones avanzadas que lo convierten en un tanque eficaz. Puede realizar la mayoría de trabajos de un humano normal.

Rule.Raw: A militor mk2 with advanced modifications which makes it an effective combat medic, and able to perform most jobs that a normal human can do.
Rule.Translated: Un militor mk2 con modificaciones avanzadas que lo convierten en un médico de combate eficaz. Puede realizar la mayoría de trabajos de un humano normal.

Rule.Raw: A militor mk2 with advanced modifications which makes it a deadly sniper, and able to perform most jobs that a normal human can do.
Rule.Translated: Un militor mk2 con modificaciones avanzadas que lo convierten en un francotirador letal. Puede realizar la mayoría de trabajos de un humano normal.

Rule.Translated: Un militor mk2 con modificaciones avanzadas que lo convierten en un excelente especialista CnC. Puede realizar la mayoría de trabajos de un humano normal.

Rule.Raw: An improved version of the tesseron, now capable of firing dual lasers which doubles the amount of frequency that it can spread fire in an open an enclosed area.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del teserón, capaz de disparar láseres dobles que duplican la frecuencia con la que propaga fuego en zonas abiertas y cerradas.

Rule.Raw: An improved version of the termite, now equipped with the best tools to cause more property damage and anarchy against any colony unfortunate enough to encounter it.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada de la termita, equipada con las mejores herramientas para causar más daños materiales y caos en cualquier colonia que tenga la desgracia de encontrarla.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} can easily spam both charge and plasma blast against you, and can blast you away with a rain of laser bolts.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} can easily spam both charge and plasma blast against you, and can blast you away with a rain of laser bolts.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} puede lanzar fácilmente continuas explosiones de carga y de plasma contra ti y hacerte volar con una lluvia de descargas láser.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} has a built-in mech gestator that is capable of deploying hydraulic knights into battle.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} has a built-in mech gestator that is capable of deploying hydraulic knights into battle.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} tiene un gestador de mecanoides integrado capaz de desplegar caballeros hidráulicos en combate.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} is a hybrid of the warqueen and the apocriton, capable of ressurecting dead mechanoids and spawn aggressive dragon knights to fight for it.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} is a hybrid of the warqueen and the apocriton, capable of ressurecting dead mechanoids and spawn aggressive dragon knights to fight for it.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} es un híbrido de reina de guerra y apócrito, capaz de resucitar mecanoides muertos y generar agresivos caballeros dragón para que luchen a su servicio.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} is a powerful mech variant wielding a mech heavy laser blaster. Its abilities are unknown other than its ability to resurrect dead mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} is a powerful mech variant wielding a mech heavy laser blaster. Its abilities are unknown other than its ability to resurrect dead mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} es una potente variante mecanoide que porta un bláster láser mecanoide pesado. Sus capacidades se desconocen, salvo la de resucitar mecanoides muertos.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} is a prototype ultra boss that wields powerful AOE abilities, and a proficient melee combatant.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} is a prototype ultra boss that wields powerful AOE abilities, and a proficient melee combatant.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} es un prototipo de jefe superior con potentes habilidades de área (AOE) y una gran destreza en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Try to engage the threat with utmost caution and be careful on the ship itself.

Rule.Original: A psychic droner ship has landed near your colony! The ship can drive your colonist insane with a high chance of them going berserk every three days, not only that, the ship is heavily shielded and protected by a hostile group of mech variants. Destroy the ship before its too late!

Rule.Original: You are part of an unnamed scavenger group, and managed to strike it rich after scavenging the space wreck of a kraltech cargo freighter, little do you know that the freighter was attacked by a mechanoid extermination fleet, and the fleet has detected your group's scavenger fleet. The scavenger fleet was shot down and its crew were blasted to pieces, but you and your friend managed to escape via drop pod to a nearby rimworld, although you were lucky enough to escape, unfortunately, you are marked by the mechanoid extermination fleet.\n\nP.S: The mechanoid fleet will send an overdriven mech fabricator ship and a psychic droner ship immediately after you landed, and they will continue to send ships every 15 days.
Rule.Raw: You are part of an unnamed scavenger group, and managed to strike it rich after scavenging the space wreck of a kraltech cargo freighter, little do you know that the freighter was attacked by a mechanoid extermination fleet, and the fleet has detected your group's scavenger fleet. The scavenger fleet was shot down and its crew were blasted to pieces, but you and your friend managed to escape via drop pod to a nearby rimworld, although you were lucky enough to escape, unfortunately, you are marked by the mechanoid extermination fleet.\n\nP.S: The mechanoid fleet will send an overdriven mech fabricator ship and a psychic droner ship immediately after you landed, and they will continue to send ships every 15 days.
Rule.Translated: Formas parte de un grupo de chatarreros sin nombre y habéis conseguido haceros ricos al saquear los restos de un carguero Kraltech en el espacio. Lo que no sabíais era que una flota de exterminio mecanoide había atacado el carguero y detectado la flota chatarrera de vuestro grupo. Vuestras naves fueron derribadas y su tripulación quedó hecha pedazos, pero tú y tu amigo lograsteis escapar en una cápsula de descenso hacia un mundo del borde cercano. Aunque tuvisteis la suerte de escapar, la flota de exterminio mecanoide os ha marcado como objetivos.\n\nP. D.: La flota mecanoide enviará una nave de fabricación mecanoide en sobrecarga y una nave de zumbido psíquico en cuanto aterricéis. Seguirá enviando naves cada 15 días.

Rule.Original: Two scavengers with a profitable yet dangerous twist.
Rule.Raw: Two scavengers with a profitable yet dangerous twist.
Rule.Translated: Dos saqueadores con un giro lucrativo, aunque peligroso.

Rule.Original: The sky is raining blood and space debris, and among the sea of ethereal wreckage comes a handful of drop pods carrying the remaining survivors of the scavenger fleet. The survivors lost their fleet and their friends, and are now stuck on an unforgiving planet on the rim. But the time for lamenting their loss must be put aside for now, since the mechanoid extermination fleet has marked the survivors for death, and has sent a fragment of its forces to wipe them out for good.
Rule.Raw: The sky is raining blood and space debris, and among the sea of ethereal wreckage comes a handful of drop pods carrying the remaining survivors of the scavenger fleet. The survivors lost their fleet and their friends, and are now stuck on an unforgiving planet on the rim. But the time for lamenting their loss must be put aside for now, since the mechanoid extermination fleet has marked the survivors for death, and has sent a fragment of its forces to wipe them out for good.
Rule.Translated: Del cielo llueven sangre y restos espaciales. Entre el mar de escombros etéreos aparece un puñado de cápsulas de transporte con los últimos supervivientes de la flota de saqueadores. Han perdido su flota y a sus amigos y ahora están atrapados en un implacable planeta fronterizo. Pero deben dejar el duelo para después: la flota de exterminio mecanoide los ha marcado para la muerte y ha enviado una parte de sus fuerzas para eliminarlos definitivamente.

Rule.Original:
In the furthest star system where the mech hive is located, there exists a mech commander who's the subject of fear for multiple intelligent life across many core worlds. Victoria Valkyria is a valkyrian-type mech variant, and the first-in-command of the ever growing mech variant legion. She serves the mech hive according to her protocol, and leads her legion of mech variants in an un-ending march, which results to the fall of multiple colonies and the ruin of multiple advanced civilizations.

With Victoria Valkyria good events rarely happens. Instead, you'll experience deadly psychic drones, noxious toxic fallouts, and various harmful phenomena that are designed to screw you over. Raids will be very frequent to the point where you'll have little time to recollect yourself and organize your forces.

Not only that, she will send loads of hostile ships, harmful nanites, extreme weather events, and fragments of her own mech variant legion to wipe you out.
Rule.Raw:
In the furthest star system where the mech hive is located, there exists a mech commander who's the subject of fear for multiple intelligent life across many core worlds. Victoria Valkyria is a valkyrian-type mech variant, and the first-in-command of the ever growing mech variant legion. She serves the mech hive according to her protocol, and leads her legion of mech variants in an un-ending march, which results to the fall of multiple colonies and the ruin of multiple advanced civilizations.

With Victoria Valkyria good events rarely happens. Instead, you'll experience deadly psychic drones, noxious toxic fallouts, and various harmful phenomena that are designed to screw you over. Raids will be very frequent to the point where you'll have little time to recollect yourself and organize your forces.

Not only that, she will send loads of hostile ships, harmful nanites, extreme weather events, and fragments of her own mech variant legion to wipe you out.
Rule.Translated:
En el sistema estelar más remoto, donde se encuentra la colmena mecanoide, existe una comandante mecanoide temida por numerosas formas de vida inteligentes de muchos mundos centrales. Victoria Valkyria es una variante mecanoide de tipo valquiria y la comandante suprema de una legión de variantes mecanoides en constante crecimiento. Sirve a la colmena según su protocolo y dirige a su legión en una marcha interminable que provoca la caída de numerosas colonias y la ruina de múltiples civilizaciones avanzadas.

Con Victoria Valkyria, los sucesos positivos son poco frecuentes. En su lugar, sufrirás zumbidos psíquicos mortales, nocivas lluvias tóxicas y diversos fenómenos dañinos diseñados para fastidiarte. Los asaltos serán tan frecuentes que apenas tendrás tiempo de recuperarte y organizar tus fuerzas.

Además, enviará multitud de naves hostiles, nanitos dañinos, fenómenos meteorológicos extremos y destacamentos de su propia legión de variantes mecanoides para aniquilarte.

Rule.Original: Military-grade anti-ballistic combat chestplate, that provides ballistic protection from the torso, and a slight increase in movespeed. The armor also possess superior heat resistance, making it a viable armor against enemies with incendiary weapons.
Rule.Raw: Military-grade anti-ballistic combat chestplate, that provides ballistic protection from the torso, and a slight increase in movespeed. The armor also possess superior heat resistance, making it a viable armor against enemies with incendiary weapons.

Rule.Original: A skin-tight combat suit worn by elite kraltech PMCs. Unlike regular skin tight suits, the combat suit has a superior balistic and heat resistance, and had a built-in microrotors that assists the wearer's motor function and allowing the wearer to become more agile.

Rule.Original: A power-assisted armor suit packed with advanced mechanitor-assistance gear, and cladded with mechanoid variant armor plating. This suit of armor can amplify a mechanator's bandwidth to 80, can turn any wearer nigh invincible, and can invoke a powerful buff "dragons aura".

Rule.Original: A heavily plated, norse inspired, mechanitor-assistance helmet that was used to hunt steel dragons. casco de mecalord cazador de señores de la guerra

This jacket was previously worn by a famous edgerunner of night city named David Martinez.

Rule.Original: A highly advanced version of the mech hunter chestplate that offers more mobility and protection, which are commonly worn by elite enforcers.
Rule.Raw: A highly advanced version of the mech hunter chestplate that offers more mobility and protection, which are commonly worn by elite enforcers.

Rule.Original: A advanced version of the flak dusters without the movement penalty and with increased damage resistance, along with a camouflage module that could render the wearer invisible temporarily. This duster is mostly worn by elite enforcers of kraltech industries.
Rule.Raw: A advanced version of the flak dusters without the movement penalty and with increased damage resistance, along with a camouflage module that could render the wearer invisible temporarily. This duster is mostly worn by elite enforcers of kraltech industries.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat jumpsuit worn by the enforcers. The suit is designed with dynamic fiber optics that are accurately placed according to the wearer's accupoint, and it can automaticaly adjust itself according to corresponding body types. These fiber optics are connected to an omni-module located at the spine area where it can raise a few combat related capacities at 75, further boosting their combat capabilities.

Estas fibras se conectan a un omnimódulo situado en la zona de la columna vertebral, capaz de elevar algunas capacidades relacionadas con el combate a 75 y mejorar aún más su eficacia en combate.

Rule.Original: A dual purpose parka worn the enforcers. It can greatly protect the wearer in both the heat and cold and offers sufficient amounts of armor.

protector facial con capucha de asaltante

Rule.Raw: Techwear bodysuit made specifically for optimal heat insulation.

Rule.Raw: A state of the art visor meant for efficient takedowns in the dark. It can also make the wearer well proficient in melee combat.

Rule.Raw: A state of the art visor glassess for passionate and aspiring builders, where a sub-persona AI provides the wearer with ancient carpenter knowledge from a world renowned builder "Builder Bo", improving their proficientcy in construction.
Rule.Translated: Unas gafas con visor de última generación para constructores entusiastas y en formación. Una IA de subpersonalidad proporciona al usuario los antiguos conocimientos de carpintería de «Builder Bo», un constructor de renombre mundial, y mejora su destreza en construcción.

Rule.Original: A state of the art visor glassess for those trigger happy gunslingers, where a sub-persona AI aid the wearer in reducing ranged cooldown and aiming delay on ranged weapons.
Rule.Raw: A state of the art visor glassess for those trigger happy gunslingers, where a sub-persona AI aid the wearer in reducing ranged cooldown and aiming delay on ranged weapons.
Rule.Translated: Unas gafas con visor de última generación para pistoleros de gatillo fácil. Una IA de subpersonalidad ayuda al usuario a reducir el tiempo de recuperación entre disparos y la demora al apuntar con armas a distancia.

Rule.Original: A state of the art visor glassess for medics, in which a sub persona AI provides medical knowledge on-the-go for the wearer using the ancient knowledge of WEB MD, making them a somewhat proficient medic.
Rule.Raw: A state of the art visor glassess for medics, in which a sub persona AI provides medical knowledge on-the-go for the wearer using the ancient knowledge of WEB MD, making them a somewhat proficient medic.
Rule.Translated: Unas gafas con visor de última generación para médicos. Una IA de subpersonalidad proporciona conocimientos médicos al usuario sobre la marcha, recurriendo a la antigua sabiduría de WEB MD, y lo convierte en un médico razonablemente competente.

Rule.Original: An improved gasmask with an increased efficientcy in filtering toxic fumes.
Rule.Raw: An improved gasmask with an increased efficientcy in filtering toxic fumes.
Rule.Translated: Una máscara antigás mejorada que filtra los vapores tóxicos con mayor eficacia.

Rule.Original: An improved gasmask with an increased efficientcy in filtering toxic fumes, now available with a protective screen.
Rule.Raw: An improved gasmask with an increased efficientcy in filtering toxic fumes, now available with a protective screen.
Rule.Translated: Una máscara antigás mejorada que filtra los vapores tóxicos con mayor eficacia, ahora con una pantalla protectora.

Rule.Original: A gasmask made specifically for miners in urbworld coal mines. This gasmask has a built-in mineral deposit scanner that boosts the wearer's mining yield, and slightly boost their mining speed, definitely a must have apparel for those who wants more minerals in their storage.
Rule.Raw: A gasmask made specifically for miners in urbworld coal mines. This gasmask has a built-in mineral deposit scanner that boosts the wearer's mining yield, and slightly boost their mining speed, definitely a must have apparel for those who wants more minerals in their storage.
Rule.Translated: Una máscara antigás fabricada específicamente para los mineros de las minas de carbón de los mundos urbanos. Lleva un escáner de depósitos minerales integrado que aumenta el rendimiento de extracción y mejora ligeramente la velocidad de minería. Una prenda imprescindible para quienes quieren almacenar más minerales.

Rule.Original: An aesthetic-looking headgear that offers complete immunity to toxic fallout, and can turn anyone into a medical whiz in an instant.
Rule.Raw: An aesthetic-looking headgear that offers complete immunity to toxic fallout, and can turn anyone into a medical whiz in an instant.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de aspecto cuidado que ofrece inmunidad completa a la lluvia tóxica y puede convertir a cualquiera en un prodigio de la medicina al instante.

Rule.Original: An aesthetic-looking headgear that offers complete immunity to toxic fallout, and can turn anyone into a veteran researcher in an instant. It can also raise their social skill at the same time.
Rule.Raw: An aesthetic-looking headgear that offers complete immunity to toxic fallout, and can turn anyone into a veteran researcher in an instant. It can also raise their social skill at the same time.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de aspecto cuidado que ofrece inmunidad completa a la lluvia tóxica y puede convertir a cualquiera en un investigador veterano al instante. También mejora su habilidad social.

Rule.Original: An aesthetic-looking headgear that offers complete immunity to toxic fallout, and can turn anyone into an expert builder.
Rule.Raw: An aesthetic-looking headgear that offers complete immunity to toxic fallout, and can turn anyone into an expert builder.
Rule.Translated: Un casco de aspecto cuidado que ofrece inmunidad completa a la lluvia tóxica y puede convertir a cualquiera en un constructor experto.

Rule.Original: High-tech sketchers made with the finest materials that offers optimal comfort and slight mobility. Now available in neon blue aesthetics.
Rule.Raw: High-tech sketchers made with the finest materials that offers optimal comfort and slight mobility. Now available in neon blue aesthetics.
Rule.Translated: Unas zapatillas de alta tecnología fabricadas con los mejores materiales. Ofrecen una comodidad óptima y una ligera mejora de la movilidad. Ahora con un diseño azul neón.

Rule.Original: High-tech sketchers made with the finest materials that offers optimal comfort and slight mobility. Now available in neon yellow aesthetics.
Rule.Raw: High-tech sketchers made with the finest materials that offers optimal comfort and slight mobility. Now available in neon yellow aesthetics.

Rule.Original: A stylish fingerless gloves with a hard knuckle. Wearing it would slightly decrease aiming delay.
Rule.Raw: A stylish fingerless gloves with a hard knuckle. Wearing it would slightly decrease aiming delay.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes elegantes sin dedos y con nudillos rígidos. Llevarlos reduce ligeramente la demora al apuntar.

Rule.Original: Hi-tech fingerless gloves designed for self defense. Using uranium as ammunition, the wearer can fire a shock projectile that can burn organic individuals and disable electronics and mechanoids with its EMP property.
Rule.Raw: Hi-tech fingerless gloves designed for self defense. Using uranium as ammunition, the wearer can fire a shock projectile that can burn organic individuals and disable electronics and mechanoids with its EMP property.
Rule.Translated: Unos guantes sin dedos de alta tecnología diseñados para la defensa personal. Utilizan uranio como munición y permiten disparar un proyectil eléctrico que quema a los seres orgánicos e inutiliza dispositivos electrónicos y mecanoides mediante su efecto PEM.

Rule.Original: A standard jumpsuit fit for traveling. It provides minimal amount of comfort and few work related bonuses along with a pleasant feeling that soothe the nerves. A recommended apparel for long term expeditions throughout the rim.
Rule.Raw: A standard jumpsuit fit for traveling. It provides minimal amount of comfort and few work related bonuses along with a pleasant feeling that soothe the nerves. A recommended apparel for long term expeditions throughout the rim.
Rule.Translated: Un mono estándar adecuado para viajar. Ofrece algo de comodidad y ciertas bonificaciones al trabajo, además de una agradable sensación que calma los nervios. Una prenda recomendable para expediciones prolongadas por el borde.

Rule.Original: A reinforced jumpsuit that provides slight armor rating compared to other jumpsuits, along with a slight bonus to move speed and consciousness.
Rule.Raw: A reinforced jumpsuit that provides slight armor rating compared to other jumpsuits, along with a slight bonus to move speed and consciousness.
Rule.Translated: Un mono reforzado que ofrece algo más de blindaje que otros monos, además de una ligera bonificación a la velocidad de movimiento y la consciencia.

Rule.Original: A utility jumpsuit that provides slight production related bonuses and carry capacity, but provides minimum protection.
Rule.Raw: A utility jumpsuit that provides slight production related bonuses and carry capacity, but provides minimum protection.
Rule.Translated: Un mono de trabajo que ofrece pequeñas bonificaciones a la producción y la capacidad de carga, pero una protección mínima.

Rule.Original: An improved mechanoid-built projectile-repulsion device. This heavy shield unit has the highest energy shield rating and the fastest energy shield regeneration speed. This apparel is only worn by the supreme apocriton.
Rule.Raw: An improved mechanoid-built projectile-repulsion device. This heavy shield unit has the highest energy shield rating and the fastest energy shield regeneration speed. This apparel is only worn by the supreme apocriton.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo mejorado de repulsión de proyectiles fabricado por mecanoides. Esta unidad de escudo pesado ofrece la mayor capacidad de escudo energético y la regeneración de energía más rápida. Solo la lleva el apocritón supremo.

Rule.Original:
A increadibly precious containment unit that came from the supreme apocriton. It contains treasures of unfathomable quality, and relics of great power. What are these treasures exactly? Well, only one way to find out!
PS: Try to open this thing in a spacious environment.
