Rule.Original: A spacer-level metal alloy used in military, industrial, and interstellar application. This futuristic alloy in a mixture of iron, and other classified metals, which grants the metal alloy incredible durability, damage resistance, and immunity against fire.
Rule.Raw: A spacer-level metal alloy used in military, industrial, and interstellar application. This futuristic alloy in a mixture of iron, and other classified metals, which grants the metal alloy incredible durability, damage resistance, and immunity against fire.
Rule.Translated: Una aleación metálica de nivel espacial utilizada en aplicaciones militares, industriales e interestelares. Esta aleación futurista mezcla hierro con otros metales clasificados, lo que le otorga una durabilidad y una resistencia al daño increíbles, además de inmunidad al fuego.

Rule.Original: A highly advanced armor plating that can only be obtained by salvaging heavily armored mech variants. This unknown metallic alloy is considered as one of the most indestructible material that ever existed, in contrast the molecular structure of the armor plating is a triple-layer honey comb structure that are weaved together into a basket case. Truely a state of the art material used to clad murderous death bots with indestructable armor.
Rule.Raw: A highly advanced armor plating that can only be obtained by salvaging heavily armored mech variants. This unknown metallic alloy is considered as one of the most indestructible material that ever existed, in contrast the molecular structure of the armor plating is a triple-layer honey comb structure that are weaved together into a basket case. Truely a state of the art material used to clad murderous death bots with indestructable armor.
Rule.Translated: Un blindaje muy avanzado que solo puede obtenerse al recuperar piezas de variantes mecanoides fuertemente blindadas. Esta aleación metálica desconocida se considera uno de los materiales más indestructibles que existen. Su estructura molecular consiste en tres capas con forma de panal, entretejidas como una cesta. Un material de última generación que recubre a robots asesinos con un blindaje indestructible.

Rule.Original: An increadibly sensitive mech components that can only be found from mech variant bosses. Theses components are responsible in keeping mech variant bosses function in full capacity without breaking down, and can be used to craft high-tier equipments an useful structures. The only downside is that it deteriorates faster if left outdoors and unattended.
Rule.Raw: An increadibly sensitive mech components that can only be found from mech variant bosses. Theses components are responsible in keeping mech variant bosses function in full capacity without breaking down, and can be used to craft high-tier equipments an useful structures. The only downside is that it deteriorates faster if left outdoors and unattended.
Rule.Translated: Unos componentes mecanoides extremadamente delicados que solo se encuentran en los jefes de las variantes mecanoides. Mantienen a estos jefes funcionando a plena capacidad sin averiarse y permiten fabricar equipo de categoría superior y estructuras útiles. Su única desventaja es que se deterioran más deprisa si se dejan al aire libre y sin cuidado.

Rule.Original: A peculiar psycaster module that can be salvaged from mech psionics. This piece of mech hardware is responsible for allowing mech psionics to wield psycast abilities, and it can be installed to a humanoid to enhance the their psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat. It can also grant the user the ability to wield a basic psychic bullet, though it requires any level of psylink for the psychic module to be used.
Rule.Raw: A peculiar psycaster module that can be salvaged from mech psionics. This piece of mech hardware is responsible for allowing mech psionics to wield psycast abilities, and it can be installed to a humanoid to enhance the their psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat. It can also grant the user the ability to wield a basic psychic bullet, though it requires any level of psylink for the psychic module to be used.
Rule.Translated: Un peculiar módulo de psipoderes que puede recuperarse de los psiónicos mecanoides. Esta pieza de hardware les permite utilizar psipoderes y puede instalarse en un humanoide para aumentar su sensibilidad psíquica y disipar el calentamiento neural. También permite utilizar una bala psíquica básica, aunque requiere algún nivel de psienlace para usar el módulo.
núcleo de reactor de fusión mecanoide

Rule.Original: A miniature fusion reactor that can only be found inside various mech variant bosses. It draws the power from fusion cores and distributes it throughout their mechanical body, and since the mech variant bosses possess lots of fusion cores, they need a medium to regulate the flow of power form all those fusion core so that they won't overload. The mech fusion reactor core can be used to build power generators that uses fusion cores as fuel, and can be used to craft powerful weapons that uses fusion cores as fuel.
Rule.Raw: A miniature fusion reactor that can only be found inside various mech variant bosses. It draws the power from fusion cores and distributes it throughout their mechanical body, and since the mech variant bosses possess lots of fusion cores, they need a medium to regulate the flow of power form all those fusion core so that they won't overload. The mech fusion reactor core can be used to build power generators that uses fusion cores as fuel, and can be used to craft powerful weapons that uses fusion cores as fuel.
Rule.Translated: Un reactor de fusión en miniatura que solo se encuentra dentro de distintos jefes de las variantes mecanoides. Extrae la energía de los núcleos de fusión y la distribuye por su cuerpo mecánico. Como estos jefes tienen numerosos núcleos de fusión, necesitan un dispositivo que regule el flujo energético de todos ellos para evitar una sobrecarga. El núcleo de reactor de fusión mecanoide permite construir generadores y fabricar armas potentes que utilizan núcleos de fusión como combustible.
kit de piezas de armas avanzadas

Rule.Original: Specially manufactured kit that contains all of the sensitive parts necesary to construct high-tech firearms.
Rule.Raw: Specially manufactured kit that contains all of the sensitive parts necesary to construct high-tech firearms.
Rule.Translated: Un kit fabricado especialmente que contiene todas las piezas delicadas necesarias para construir armas de fuego de alta tecnología.

Rule.Original: Military-grade fabric made from super steel. This fabric is increadibly durable, immune to deterioration, and fireproof, making it an ideal material for fabricating numerous protective gears.
Rule.Raw: Military-grade fabric made from super steel. This fabric is increadibly durable, immune to deterioration, and fireproof, making it an ideal material for fabricating numerous protective gears.
Rule.Translated: Un tejido de grado militar fabricado con superacero. Es extremadamente duradero, no se deteriora y es ignífugo, lo que lo convierte en un material ideal para fabricar numerosas protecciones.

Rule.Original: An ultra-tech fussion core that are found inside of powerful mech variants. This fussion core contains an abundant supply of power, which is necessary for any mechanoid variants to function at full capacity. Think of it as the heart of the mechanoid variants.
Rule.Raw: An ultra-tech fussion core that are found inside of powerful mech variants. This fussion core contains an abundant supply of power, which is necessary for any mechanoid variants to function at full capacity. Think of it as the heart of the mechanoid variants.
Rule.Translated: Un núcleo de fusión ultratecnológico que se encuentra dentro de las variantes mecanoides más poderosas. Contiene una abundante reserva de energía, necesaria para que cualquier variante mecanoide funcione a plena capacidad. Puedes considerarlo el corazón de estas variantes.

Rule.Original: A razor sharp blade horn located near at the empress's smell sensors. Can be used immediately as a weapon, or can be refined into an even powerful melee weapon.
Rule.Raw: A razor sharp blade horn located near at the empress's smell sensors. Can be used immediately as a weapon, or can be refined into an even powerful melee weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un cuerno afilado como una cuchilla situado junto a los sensores olfativos de la emperatriz. Puede utilizarse directamente como arma o transformarse en un arma cuerpo a cuerpo aún más potente.

Rule.Original: A highly advanced ammunition used by advanced vulcan turrets.
Rule.Raw: A highly advanced ammunition used by advanced vulcan turrets.
Rule.Translated: Una munición muy avanzada utilizada por las torretas Vulcan avanzadas.

Rule.Original: An increadibly dangerous ammunition, which is made by dismantling fussion cores, extracting its anti matter cells, and fabricate it into an explosive shell used by an advanced antigrain cannon turret. This shell is capable of wiping out groups of mech variants in one fell swoop, and heavily damage mech variant bossess in a single shot.
Rule.Raw: An increadibly dangerous ammunition, which is made by dismantling fussion cores, extracting its anti matter cells, and fabricate it into an explosive shell used by an advanced antigrain cannon turret. This shell is capable of wiping out groups of mech variants in one fell swoop, and heavily damage mech variant bossess in a single shot.
Rule.Translated: Una munición extremadamente peligrosa que se fabrica desmontando núcleos de fusión, extrayendo sus células de antimateria y convirtiéndolas en un proyectil explosivo para una torreta avanzada de cañón de antimateria. Puede aniquilar grupos de variantes mecanoides de una sola vez y causar graves daños a sus jefes con un solo disparo.

Rule.Original: A metallic box, which is full of high caliber ammunition for the advanced auto turrets.
Rule.Raw: A metallic box, which is full of high caliber ammunition for the advanced auto turrets.
Rule.Translated: Una caja metálica llena de munición de gran calibre para las torretas automáticas avanzadas.

Rule.Original: Some high explosive flak cannon shell, which is used by the auto flak cannon turret.
Rule.Raw: Some high explosive flak cannon shell, which is used by the auto flak cannon turret.
Rule.Translated: Un proyectil de alto poder explosivo para cañón antiaéreo, utilizado por la torreta automática de cañón antiaéreo.

Rule.Original: A highly explosive missile warhead that is used to arm the air frame missile turret.
Rule.Raw: A highly explosive missile warhead that is used to arm the air frame missile turret.
Rule.Translated: Una ojiva de misil de alto poder explosivo utilizada para armar la torreta de misiles antiaéreos.

Rule.Original: An advanced alpha micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.
Rule.Raw: An advanced alpha micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.
Rule.Translated: Un microórgano alfa avanzado. Es necesario para producir ciertos tipos avanzados de mecanoides y equipo.\n\nUn mecanitor puede estudiar este chip para ayudar a desbloquear categorías superiores de investigación de tecnología mecanoide.

Rule.Original: By studying the alpha chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Rule.Raw: By studying the alpha chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Rule.Translated: Al estudiar el chip alfa, {PAWN_labelShort} ha adquirido los conocimientos necesarios para los proyectos de investigación {RESEARCH}.\n\nTus investigadores ya pueden utilizar las mesas de investigación para comenzar a estudiar cómo aplicar la tecnología.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original: An advanced beta micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.
Rule.Raw: An advanced beta micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.

Rule.Original:
It appears to be a research document for a project named "Project mjolnir". This document contains the progression of the project and it is written in a language that you can understand. The content of the project is as follows....
"Project mjolnir is now entering its final stage. Both me and my colleagues have run various simulations and implemented everything that was needed to implement, now all that's left is to construct our prototypes.
Got to be honest, these prototypes are expensive as hell! I can't even imagine a normal human can procure these resources, luckily, we have our own mechs to provide everything we need but these expenses are enough to bankrupt a small country, well I guess these are perks for being a mechanitor hehe.
With the help of Fedinand's tunneler and fabricator mech, we have procured all the resources we need to gestate a few prototypes, hopefully we'll be done after 24 gestation cycles, and with Angela's centipedes, we'll be safe against whatever the mech hive sends at us for the time being.
Here's hoping that our efforts will bear fruit."

Here's hoping that our efforts will bear fruit."
Rule.Translated:
Parece ser un documento de investigación de un proyecto llamado «Proyecto Mjolnir». Describe el progreso del proyecto y está escrito en un idioma que puedes entender. Su contenido es el siguiente....
«El Proyecto Mjolnir está entrando en su fase final. Mis colegas y yo hemos realizado diversas simulaciones e implementado todo lo necesario. Ahora solo queda construir los prototipos.
Tengo que admitirlo: ¡estos prototipos son caros de narices! No puedo ni imaginar cómo una persona normal conseguiría todos estos recursos. Por suerte, tenemos nuestros propios mecanoides para proporcionarnos lo que necesitamos, pero estos gastos bastarían para arruinar a un país pequeño. Supongo que son las ventajas de ser mecanitor, je, je.
Con la ayuda del tunelador y el mecanoide fabricador de Fedinand, hemos conseguido todos los recursos necesarios para gestar algunos prototipos. Con suerte, habremos terminado tras 24 ciclos de gestación. Y con los ciempiés de Angela estaremos a salvo, de momento, de lo que nos envíe la colmena mecanoide.
Espero que nuestros esfuerzos den fruto».

Rule.Original:
It appears to be a research document for a project named "Project mjolnir". This document contains the progression of the project and it is written in a language that you can understand. The content of the project is as follows....
"Something is wrong! Something is definitely! We have ran multiple simulatons! Our designs are flawless, so why?! Why are they going berserk?!
For now, evacuation is our top priority, while Angela holds of those beserked prototypes with her centipedes, me and Ferdinand will head to the hangar and start the engines of our cargo ships.
We will have our chance to rebuild our strength and find out what went wrong, but for now, we need to esca-..."
The writing was stopped abruptly, judging by the blood spattered in the document, it appears that something happened to the writer.

Rule.Translated:
Parece ser un documento de investigación de un proyecto llamado «Proyecto Mjolnir». Describe el progreso del proyecto y está escrito en un idioma que puedes entender. Su contenido es el siguiente....
«¡Algo va mal! ¡Está claro que algo va mal! ¡Hemos realizado múltiples simulaciones! ¡Nuestros diseños son perfectos! Entonces, ¿por qué? ¡¿Por qué entran en frenesí?!
Por ahora, evacuar es nuestra máxima prioridad. Mientras Angela contiene a esos prototipos enloquecidos con sus ciempiés, Ferdinand y yo iremos al hangar y pondremos en marcha los motores de nuestros cargueros.
Tendremos otra oportunidad de recuperar nuestras fuerzas y descubrir qué salió mal, pero ahora necesitamos esca-...»
La escritura se interrumpe de golpe. A juzgar por la sangre que salpica el documento, parece que algo le ocurrió a quien lo escribió.

Rule.Original:
It appears to be a research document for a project named "Project mjolnir". This document contains the progression of the project and it is written in a language that you can understand. The content of the project is as follows....
"Angela is dead, her centipedes were pierced to oblivion, and so as her torso. Me and Ferdinand managed to escape using our cargo ships, but during our way of escape, one of the prototypes managed to reach us and were aiming at me. I thought i was dead, but Ferdinand took the hit for me, crazy bastard, you shouldn't have done that, and your wounds are too deep so I can't save you.
In the end, I was the only one who survived, and what's funny is that after the prototype's rampage, one of the mechs from the mech hive came in and claimed those prototypes to themselves. Suprise suprise! We were dancing in its palms all this time, FUCK! But you think I'll give up? Screw off! I'll perfect the prototype, just watch me! Humans aren't as fragile as you think we are!"
You skimmed through the document and reach the very end...
"I finished it! A mech micro-organ that will make the prototype immune to the mech hive's influence! Finally the project will reach its frution, but sadly, I'm out of supplies and the next planet is 300 lightyears away. Either way I'm fucked, malnutrition will claim me first before I could finish the damn project. To anyone who can read this, it is up to you to finish what me and my colleagues have started, just construct a transponder, fight one of the prototypes, and claim its subcore to understand how to gestate it.
Everything in the cargo ships will be yours, just finish the project and give that damn hive a run to its circuits."

Parece ser un documento de investigación de un proyecto llamado «Proyecto Mjolnir». Describe el progreso del proyecto y está escrito en un idioma que puedes entender. Su contenido es el siguiente....
«Angela ha muerto. Sus ciempiés fueron atravesados de parte a parte, igual que su torso. Ferdinand y yo conseguimos escapar en nuestros cargueros, pero durante la huida uno de los prototipos nos alcanzó y me apuntó. Pensé que estaba muerto, pero Ferdinand recibió el golpe por mí. Maldito loco, no deberías haberlo hecho. Tus heridas son demasiado profundas y no puedo salvarte.
Al final fui el único superviviente. Y lo más gracioso es que, después de la carnicería del prototipo, uno de los mecanoides de la colmena vino y se quedó con los prototipos. ¡Sorpresa, sorpresa! Todo este tiempo nos estuvo manejando a su antojo. ¡JODER! ¿Pero crees que voy a rendirme? ¡Que te den! ¡Perfeccionaré el prototipo, ya lo verás! ¡Los humanos no somos tan frágiles como crees!»
Ojeas el documento hasta llegar al final...
«¡Lo he terminado! ¡Un microórgano mecanoide que hará al prototipo inmune a la influencia de la colmena! Por fin el proyecto dará sus frutos, pero, por desgracia, me he quedado sin suministros y el siguiente planeta está a 300 años luz. Estoy jodido de cualquier forma: la desnutrición acabará conmigo antes de que termine el maldito proyecto. A quien pueda leer esto: te corresponde terminar lo que mis colegas y yo empezamos. Construye un transpondedor, lucha contra uno de los prototipos y recupera su subnúcleo para entender cómo gestarlo.
Todo lo que hay en los cargueros será tuyo. Solo termina el proyecto y pon en apuros a esa maldita colmena y a sus circuitos».
caja fuerte con equipo para principiantes

Rule.Raw: A premium, ultra compact, secured container which contains one of a few basic gears needed to survive the rim.

caja fuerte con equipo cuerpo a cuerpo

Rule.Raw: A premium, ultra compact, secured container which contains a complete melee combatant set.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de primera calidad, ultracompacto y protegido que contiene un equipo completo para combatientes cuerpo a cuerpo.
caja fuerte con equipo de soldado veterano

caja fuerte con equipo de ejecutor de élite

Rule.Raw: A premium, ultra compact, secured container which contains a complete enforcer set.
