Rule.Original: A premium, ultra compact, secured container which contains a healthy supply of food, medicine, raw resources, and components.
Rule.Raw: A premium, ultra compact, secured container which contains a healthy supply of food, medicine, raw resources, and components.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de primera calidad, ultracompacto y protegido que contiene una buena reserva de comida, medicamentos, recursos en bruto y componentes.

Rule.Original: An ancient mechanoid-band signal amplifier created by the archotechs. This peculiar structure behaves the same as a regular band node, the only difference is that it can grant a mechanitor an extra 300 bandwith, all while slightly improving their mood.
Rule.Raw: An ancient mechanoid-band signal amplifier created by the archotechs. This peculiar structure behaves the same as a regular band node, the only difference is that it can grant a mechanitor an extra 300 bandwith, all while slightly improving their mood.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo amplificador de señal de banda mecanoide creado por arqueotecas. Esta peculiar estructura funciona igual que un nodo de banda corriente, pero concede a un mecanitor 300 de ancho de banda adicionales y mejora ligeramente su estado de ánimo.

Rule.Original: An ancient self assembly structure created by the archotechs. It slowly assembles sensitve mech components, mech fusion cores, and mech variant armorplating out of thin air. How exactly? Who knows. But hey, free mech resources!
Rule.Raw: An ancient self assembly structure created by the archotechs. It slowly assembles sensitve mech components, mech fusion cores, and mech variant armorplating out of thin air. How exactly? Who knows. But hey, free mech resources!
Rule.Translated: Una antigua estructura de autoensamblaje creada por arqueotecas. Fabrica lentamente componentes mecanoides delicados, núcleos de fusión mecanoide y blindaje de variante mecanoide de la nada. ¿Cómo lo hace? Quién sabe. ¡Pero son recursos mecanoides gratis!

Rule.Original: An obtainable trophy after defeating the supreme apocriton. It is basicaly a scale model of the real thing with a built-in psychic emanator that soothes nearby colonists. It is also a great tool to remind your slaves just how powerful you are, reducing the chances of a slave rebellion.
Rule.Raw: An obtainable trophy after defeating the supreme apocriton. It is basicaly a scale model of the real thing with a built-in psychic emanator that soothes nearby colonists. It is also a great tool to remind your slaves just how powerful you are, reducing the chances of a slave rebellion.
Rule.Translated: Un trofeo que puede obtenerse tras derrotar al apocritón supremo. Es una maqueta a escala del original con un emanador psíquico integrado que calma a los colonos cercanos. También sirve para recordar a tus esclavos lo poderoso que eres y reducir las probabilidades de una rebelión.

Rule.Original: A remote energy and computation enhancement device created by the archotechs. Using this device, any friendly range-type mechanoids inside a 3.9 radius of the building will be able to fire their weapons continuously without the worries of range cooldown and aiming delay.
Rule.Raw: A remote energy and computation enhancement device created by the archotechs. Using this device, any friendly range-type mechanoids inside a 3.9 radius of the building will be able to fire their weapons continuously without the worries of range cooldown and aiming delay.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo remoto de mejora energética y de cálculo creado por arqueotecas. Los mecanoides tiradores aliados situados en un radio de 3.9 alrededor del edificio pueden disparar continuamente, sin preocuparse por el tiempo de recuperación entre disparos ni la demora al apuntar.

Rule.Original:
A precious archotech device for psycasters. Upon injection, the user's psyfocus will be fully replenished along with their neural heat fully dissipated, with an added side effect of temporary increase on all capacities, efficientcy in generating psyfocus, and efficient dissipation of neural heat.
WARNING: Continuous use can cause permanent brain damage.
Rule.Raw:
A precious archotech device for psycasters. Upon injection, the user's psyfocus will be fully replenished along with their neural heat fully dissipated, with an added side effect of temporary increase on all capacities, efficientcy in generating psyfocus, and efficient dissipation of neural heat.
WARNING: Continuous use can cause permanent brain damage.
Rule.Translated:
Un valioso dispositivo arqueotecnológico para usuarios de psipoderes. Al inyectarlo, repone por completo el psifoco y disipa todo el calentamiento neural. Además, aumenta temporalmente todas las capacidades, la eficacia de generación de psifoco y la disipación del calentamiento neural.
ADVERTENCIA: Su uso continuado puede causar daño cerebral permanente.

Rule.Original: A burst type service rifle, that was modified to fire high caliber, AP rifle rounds. The anti-mech service rifle is the most used mech-exterminating weapon by kraltech's mech-extermination squads, due to the versatility, quick response to threats, and the recoil being less difficult to deal with, allowing for consistent and slightly accurate shots.
Rule.Raw: A burst type service rifle, that was modified to fire high caliber, AP rifle rounds. The anti-mech service rifle is the most used mech-exterminating weapon by kraltech's mech-extermination squads, due to the versatility, quick response to threats, and the recoil being less difficult to deal with, allowing for consistent and slightly accurate shots.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de servicio de ráfagas modificado para disparar munición perforante de gran calibre. Es el arma de exterminio de mecanoides más utilizada por las escuadras de Kraltech gracias a su versatilidad, su rápida respuesta a las amenazas y su retroceso más manejable, que permiten mantener disparos consistentes y razonablemente precisos.

Rule.Original: A supped-up anti-material rifle with a monstrous recoil. The bullet that this weapon fires is a special high caliber AP anti material bullets that travels further and possess stronger armor penetration, allowing for effective takes downs against heavily armored targets on long distances.
Rule.Raw: A supped-up anti-material rifle with a monstrous recoil. The bullet that this weapon fires is a special high caliber AP anti material bullets that travels further and possess stronger armor penetration, allowing for effective takes downs against heavily armored targets on long distances.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil antimaterial potenciado con un retroceso monstruoso. Dispara munición antimaterial perforante especial de gran calibre, con mayor alcance y penetración de blindaje, que permite abatir con eficacia objetivos fuertemente blindados a larga distancia.

Rule.Original: Few of the strongest close-range firearm. Nicknamed as the "Shredder", this auto shotgun can easily shred mechanoids like a chainsaw on steroids. Structures aren't safe either, since this weapon can easily melt granite like butter, making it a viable weapon for elite sappers.
Rule.Raw: Few of the strongest close-range firearm. Nicknamed as the "Shredder", this auto shotgun can easily shred mechanoids like a chainsaw on steroids. Structures aren't safe either, since this weapon can easily melt granite like butter, making it a viable weapon for elite sappers.
Rule.Translated: Una de las armas de fuego más potentes a corta distancia. Apodada «La Trituradora», esta escopeta automática puede destrozar mecanoides como una motosierra potenciada con esteroides. Las estructuras tampoco están a salvo: funde el granito como si fuera mantequilla, por lo que resulta útil para los zapadores de élite.

Rule.Original: A moddified magnum with an elongated barrel. Unlike other sidearms, the anti-mech magnum pistol has the strongest raw damage for a sidearm, capable of blowing-out mechanical limbs without breaking a sweat. The only downside is the difficulty of using this magnum due to recoil, unless the gunman is a master gunman, wielding this magnum will prove to be a difficult undertaking.
Rule.Raw: A moddified magnum with an elongated barrel. Unlike other sidearms, the anti-mech magnum pistol has the strongest raw damage for a sidearm, capable of blowing-out mechanical limbs without breaking a sweat. The only downside is the difficulty of using this magnum due to recoil, unless the gunman is a master gunman, wielding this magnum will prove to be a difficult undertaking.
Rule.Translated: Una magnum modificada con un cañón alargado. Ofrece el mayor daño bruto entre las armas cortas y puede arrancar extremidades mecánicas sin esfuerzo. Su única desventaja es la dificultad de manejar su retroceso: salvo en manos de un tirador experto, utilizarla resulta complicado.

Rule.Original: An increadibly heavy and large anti material rifle. The rifle has infinite range, increadible armor penetration, and deals monstrous amounts of damage, though in exchange for lowered mobility, even longer range cooldown and warmup time, and some level of difficulty of wielding it.
Rule.Raw: An increadibly heavy and large anti material rifle. The rifle has infinite range, increadible armor penetration, and deals monstrous amounts of damage, though in exchange for lowered mobility, even longer range cooldown and warmup time, and some level of difficulty of wielding it.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil antimaterial extremadamente grande y pesado. Tiene alcance infinito, una penetración de blindaje increíble y causa un daño monstruoso. A cambio, reduce la movilidad, requiere más tiempo de recuperación y preparación entre disparos y resulta algo difícil de manejar.

Rule.Original: A pulse type, full-auto assault rifle that can fire nova bullets that deals explosive damage upon impact. A perfect weapon in dealing those powerful mechanoid variants.
Rule.Raw: A pulse type, full-auto assault rifle that can fire nova bullets that deals explosive damage upon impact. A perfect weapon in dealing those powerful mechanoid variants.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto de pulsos totalmente automático que dispara balas nova capaces de causar daño explosivo al impactar. Un arma perfecta para enfrentarse a las poderosas variantes mecanoides.

Rule.Original: A pulse-type sniper rifle, now equipped with a high-tech scope for pin point accuracy. This sniper rifle is capable of condensing high voltage of electricity into its induction core, and propel nova bullets at such force that can easily puncture plasteel. Very recommended weapon when dealing those tanky mech bosses.
Rule.Raw: A pulse-type sniper rifle, now equipped with a high-tech scope for pin point accuracy. This sniper rifle is capable of condensing high voltage of electricity into its induction core, and propel nova bullets at such force that can easily puncture plasteel. Very recommended weapon when dealing those tanky mech bosses.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de francotirador de pulsos equipado con una mira de alta tecnología para ofrecer una precisión excepcional. Condensa electricidad de alto voltaje en su núcleo de inducción y propulsa balas nova con fuerza suficiente para perforar el plastiacero con facilidad. Muy recomendable contra los jefes mecanoides más resistentes.

Rule.Original: A spacer-level pulse sub machinegun. The novasurge super kriss is a burst-type energy submachine gun that fires a burst of nova bullets rapidly, in exchange of decreased range and fire power.
Rule.Raw: A spacer-level pulse sub machinegun. The novasurge super kriss is a burst-type energy submachine gun that fires a burst of nova bullets rapidly, in exchange of decreased range and fire power.
Rule.Translated: Un subfusil de pulsos de nivel espacial. El super Kriss Novasurge es un subfusil de energía que dispara rápidamente ráfagas de balas nova, a cambio de un menor alcance y potencia de fuego.

Rule.Original: A spacer-level pulse pistol. The novasurge pistol is versatile in both offense and defense, easy to use, and it is also the cheapest in terms of cost. Probably one of the most reliable energy-based sidearm for a soldier can have.
Rule.Raw: A spacer-level pulse pistol. The novasurge pistol is versatile in both offense and defense, easy to use, and it is also the cheapest in terms of cost. Probably one of the most reliable energy-based sidearm for a soldier can have.
Rule.Translated: Una pistola de pulsos de nivel espacial. Es versátil tanto en ataque como en defensa, fácil de usar y la opción más barata. Probablemente sea una de las armas cortas de energía más fiables que puede tener un soldado.

Rule.Original: A single use pulse chaingun. The novasurge cosmic destroyer is one of the few most powerful energy-based weapon ever developed, capable of firing a bulletstorm of nova bullets that offers no defense towards any unfortunate targets.
Rule.Raw: A single use pulse chaingun. The novasurge cosmic destroyer is one of the few most powerful energy-based weapon ever developed, capable of firing a bulletstorm of nova bullets that offers no defense towards any unfortunate targets.
Rule.Translated: Una ametralladora de pulsos de un solo uso. El destructor cósmico Novasurge es una de las armas de energía más potentes jamás desarrolladas, capaz de disparar una tormenta de balas nova frente a la que ningún desafortunado objetivo puede defenderse.

Rule.Original: A single use heavy plasma cannon. This weapon is the result of unraveling the secrets inside the alpha chip, where incinerator plasma cannon can fire superheated plasma ball that deals a tremendous amounts of damage, but suffers a halacious 20 second charge time just to fire the explosive warhead.
Rule.Raw: A single use heavy plasma cannon. This weapon is the result of unraveling the secrets inside the alpha chip, where incinerator plasma cannon can fire superheated plasma ball that deals a tremendous amounts of damage, but suffers a halacious 20 second charge time just to fire the explosive warhead.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón de plasma pesado de un solo uso. Es el resultado de desentrañar los secretos del chip alfa. Puede disparar una bola de plasma sobrecalentado que causa un daño tremendo, pero necesita nada menos que 20 segundos de carga para lanzar la ojiva explosiva.

Rule.Original: A single use heavy charged cannon, and a twin sibling of the incinerator plasma cannon. It behaves the same as the incinerator plasma cannon, but instead of firing superheated plasma warhead, it fires a supercharged warhead that explodes in energized fury that deals heavy amounts of sharp damage.
Rule.Raw: A single use heavy charged cannon, and a twin sibling of the incinerator plasma cannon. It behaves the same as the incinerator plasma cannon, but instead of firing superheated plasma warhead, it fires a supercharged warhead that explodes in energized fury that deals heavy amounts of sharp damage.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón de carga pesado de un solo uso, hermano del cañón de plasma incinerador. Funciona igual que este, pero sustituye la ojiva de plasma sobrecalentado por una ojiva sobrecargada que estalla con furia energética y causa un enorme daño cortante.

Rule.Original: A dual edged battle axe. This weapon made good use of the empress blade horns for blade edges, which are reinforced with a frame made of super steel. This battleaxe is not only capable of cutting anything in half, it also has an ability to invoke "Berserker aura" that plunge any humanlikes in a berserk state while raising their melee combat abilities to their limits.
Rule.Raw: A dual edged battle axe. This weapon made good use of the empress blade horns for blade edges, which are reinforced with a frame made of super steel. This battleaxe is not only capable of cutting anything in half, it also has an ability to invoke "Berserker aura" that plunge any humanlikes in a berserk state while raising their melee combat abilities to their limits.
Rule.Translated: Un hacha de batalla de doble filo que aprovecha los cuernos cuchilla de la emperatriz para sus filos, reforzados con una estructura de superacero. Además de partir cualquier cosa por la mitad, permite activar «Aura de frenesí», que sume a cualquier humanoide en un estado de frenesí y lleva sus capacidades de combate cuerpo a cuerpo al límite.

Rule.Original: Widely used assault rifle outfitted for the use of mass-produced expendable mechs. Fairly cheap and easy to manufacture, and boasts a decent stats which rivals modern day rifles.
Rule.Raw: Widely used assault rifle outfitted for the use of mass-produced expendable mechs. Fairly cheap and easy to manufacture, and boasts a decent stats which rivals modern day rifles.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto muy extendido, adaptado para mecanoides prescindibles producidos en masa. Es bastante barato y fácil de fabricar, con unas prestaciones adecuadas que rivalizan con las de los fusiles actuales.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the mech assault rifle mk.1, which uses flash bullets that stuns the target for a 5 % chance.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the mech assault rifle mk.1, which uses flash bullets that stuns the target for a 5 % chance.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del fusil de asalto mecanoide mk.1. Utiliza balas cegadoras que tienen un 5 % de probabilidad de aturdir al objetivo.

Rule.Original: An advanced assault rifle used by the militor MK2, now with an ability to inflict frostbite to organic enemies.
Rule.Raw: An advanced assault rifle used by the militor MK2, now with an ability to inflict frostbite to organic enemies.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto avanzado utilizado por el militor MK2, ahora capaz de provocar congelación a los enemigos orgánicos.

Rule.Original: An assault rifle which was reversed engineered from the original mech assault rifle. The militor assault rifle in an automatic firearm that fires 25 shots and deals more damage than the original.
Rule.Raw: An assault rifle which was reversed engineered from the original mech assault rifle. The militor assault rifle in an automatic firearm that fires 25 shots and deals more damage than the original.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto obtenido mediante ingeniería inversa a partir del fusil mecanoide original. Es un arma automática que dispara 25 proyectiles y causa más daño que el original.
fusil de asalto de carga de militor

Rule.Original: A reversed engineered mech assault charger, which fires pulse bullets that can inflict physical, flame, and EMP damage.
Rule.Raw: A reversed engineered mech assault charger, which fires pulse bullets that can inflict physical, flame, and EMP damage.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto de carga mecanoide obtenido mediante ingeniería inversa. Dispara balas de pulsos que pueden infligir daño físico, de fuego y PEM.

Rule.Original: A reversed engineered and modified charged battle rifle which was designed to be wielded by a militor. The militor heavy bolter can fire high explosive bolts that deals heavy amounts of damage, although its explosion radius is only limited to 1, It's still very effective against singular armored enemies that are clustered together.
Rule.Raw: A reversed engineered and modified charged battle rifle which was designed to be wielded by a militor. The militor heavy bolter can fire high explosive bolts that deals heavy amounts of damage, although its explosion radius is only limited to 1, It's still very effective against singular armored enemies that are clustered together.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de batalla de carga obtenido mediante ingeniería inversa y modificado para que lo empuñe un militor. El bólter pesado de militor dispara proyectiles de alto poder explosivo que causan mucho daño. Aunque su radio de explosión se limita a 1, sigue siendo muy eficaz contra enemigos blindados individuales que estén agrupados.

Rule.Original: A customized anti-material rifle for militors, which boasts the best long range damage and can inflict EMP damage upon impact.
Rule.Raw: A customized anti-material rifle for militors, which boasts the best long range damage and can inflict EMP damage upon impact.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil antimaterial personalizado para militores que ofrece el mejor daño a larga distancia y puede infligir daño PEM al impactar.

Rule.Original: A scoped smg made specifically for militors. Like the burst smg, it can fire a hailstorm of bullets and excells greatly at slowing down a singular enemy due to its increadible stopping power.
Rule.Raw: A scoped smg made specifically for militors. Like the burst smg, it can fire a hailstorm of bullets and excells greatly at slowing down a singular enemy due to its increadible stopping power.
Rule.Translated: Un subfusil con mira fabricado específicamente para militores. Como el subfusil de ráfagas, puede disparar una lluvia de balas y destaca al ralentizar a un solo enemigo gracias a su enorme poder de parada.

Rule.Original: An advanced monosword variant created by the vile mech hive. Unlike the regular mono sword, the mech mono sword is sharper which is capable in penetrating even the finest set of power armor, incredibly durable, and immune to rusting.
Rule.Raw: An advanced monosword variant created by the vile mech hive. Unlike the regular mono sword, the mech mono sword is sharper which is capable in penetrating even the finest set of power armor, incredibly durable, and immune to rusting.
Rule.Translated: Una variante avanzada de monoespada creada por la malvada colmena mecanoide. Es más afilada que una monoespada corriente y puede atravesar incluso las mejores servoarmaduras. También es extremadamente duradera e inmune a la oxidación.

Rule.Original: An advanced great sword wielded by the mech paladins. The greatsword's edges are completely sharpless and can only deal blunt damage at best, but the paladin cross possess the highest blunt-based damage capable of crushing armor.
Rule.Raw: An advanced great sword wielded by the mech paladins. The greatsword's edges are completely sharpless and can only deal blunt damage at best, but the paladin cross possess the highest blunt-based damage capable of crushing armor.
Rule.Translated: Un espadón avanzado que empuñan los paladines mecanoides. Sus bordes carecen por completo de filo, por lo que solo causa daño contundente. Sin embargo, la cruz de paladín ofrece el mayor daño de este tipo y puede aplastar blindajes.

Rule.Original: A dual edge battle axe made with the same material used for the mech mono sword, which is wielded mostly by the mech paladins.
Rule.Raw: A dual edge battle axe made with the same material used for the mech mono sword, which is wielded mostly by the mech paladins.
Rule.Translated: Un hacha de batalla de doble filo fabricada con el mismo material que la monoespada mecanoide, utilizada principalmente por los paladines mecanoides.

Rule.Original: A great katana created by the vile mech hive. At the hands of an artificial expert, the oodachi is capable of performing various slashes which deals various damages, some of which can instantly kill the enemy in a single slash. The oodachi is twice the size of the original, and only the beings with mechanical hands are capable of wielding such a weapon.
Rule.Raw: A great katana created by the vile mech hive. At the hands of an artificial expert, the oodachi is capable of performing various slashes which deals various damages, some of which can instantly kill the enemy in a single slash. The oodachi is twice the size of the original, and only the beings with mechanical hands are capable of wielding such a weapon.
Rule.Translated: Una gran katana creada por la malvada colmena mecanoide. En manos de un experto artificial, el oodachi permite realizar diversos cortes que causan distintos tipos de daño; algunos pueden matar al enemigo al instante de un solo golpe. Tiene el doble de tamaño que el original y solo los seres con manos mecánicas pueden empuñarlo.

Rule.Original: * An advanced scoped burst rifle that was designed to disable mechanoids. The rifle almost never miss thanks to its target assisted scope, and it fires a special EMP bullet that pierces armor plating and the inner payload of the bullet implodes, which disables them in the process. It is also effective against non-mechanoid opponents without the EMP effect.
Rule.Raw: * An advanced scoped burst rifle that was designed to disable mechanoids. The rifle almost never miss thanks to its target assisted scope, and it fires a special EMP bullet that pierces armor plating and the inner payload of the bullet implodes, which disables them in the process. It is also effective against non-mechanoid opponents without the EMP effect.
Rule.Translated: * Un fusil avanzado de ráfagas con mira, diseñado para inutilizar mecanoides. Casi nunca falla gracias a su mira de asistencia al apuntado. Dispara una bala PEM especial que perfora el blindaje y cuya carga interna implosiona, inutilizando al objetivo. También es eficaz contra enemigos no mecanoides, aunque sin el efecto PEM.

Rule.Original: A single use, 20 shot EMP rocket launcher that fires high explosive EMP rockets. It can fire these rockets separately, and each rockets can disable large amounts of mechanoids at a very large radius.
Rule.Raw: A single use, 20 shot EMP rocket launcher that fires high explosive EMP rockets. It can fire these rockets separately, and each rockets can disable large amounts of mechanoids at a very large radius.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzacohetes PEM de un solo uso con 20 disparos, que lanza cohetes PEM de alto poder explosivo. Puede dispararlos por separado y cada uno inutiliza numerosos mecanoides dentro de un radio muy amplio.

Rule.Original: A single use heavy chaingun. Originally a weapon that was used to arm military gunships, the anti-mech chaingun was modified to be wielded by humans, granting heavy firepower anywhere on the field, though in exchange, the wielder will recieve a movement penalty and it will fire atleast 10000 rounds before it can no longer be used.
Rule.Raw: A single use heavy chaingun. Originally a weapon that was used to arm military gunships, the anti-mech chaingun was modified to be wielded by humans, granting heavy firepower anywhere on the field, though in exchange, the wielder will recieve a movement penalty and it will fire atleast 10000 rounds before it can no longer be used.
Rule.Translated: Una ametralladora pesada de un solo uso. Originalmente se utilizaba para armar aeronaves de combate militares, pero se modificó para que pudieran empuñarla humanos y disponer de gran potencia de fuego en cualquier lugar del campo de batalla. A cambio, penaliza el movimiento del usuario. Dispara al menos 10 000 proyectiles antes de quedar inutilizable.

Rule.Original: A single use heavy autocannon. Though by default, it is impossible to wield autocannons by hand, but with some engineering magic, it is now possible to wield autocannons by hand. The anti-mech autocannon is capable of firing high-caliber 20mm caliber bullets, which deals tons of damage with monstrous armor penetration to boot.
Rule.Raw: A single use heavy autocannon. Though by default, it is impossible to wield autocannons by hand, but with some engineering magic, it is now possible to wield autocannons by hand. The anti-mech autocannon is capable of firing high-caliber 20mm caliber bullets, which deals tons of damage with monstrous armor penetration to boot.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón automático pesado de un solo uso. Aunque normalmente es imposible empuñar estos cañones, un poco de magia de la ingeniería ha logrado hacerlo posible. Dispara proyectiles de gran calibre de 20mm que causan muchísimo daño y ofrecen una penetración de blindaje monstruosa.

Rule.Original: A single use shell launcher. The anti-mech shell launcher can launch high explosive shells at long distances, where it can fire two shells at a time. It uses a lot of high-explosive shells, all for the luxury of launching high explosive shells with great precision, and inflict heavy damage against multiple enemies at once.
Rule.Raw: A single use shell launcher. The anti-mech shell launcher can launch high explosive shells at long distances, where it can fire two shells at a time. It uses a lot of high-explosive shells, all for the luxury of launching high explosive shells with great precision, and inflict heavy damage against multiple enemies at once.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzaproyectiles de un solo uso que lanza munición de alto poder explosivo a larga distancia, con dos proyectiles por disparo. Consume mucha munición a cambio de lanzar esos proyectiles con gran precisión y causar graves daños a varios enemigos a la vez.

Rule.Original: A single use, heavy canister launcher. This heavyweapon is capable of firing a volley of three toxic canisters at once, where each canisters can spew toxic gas at unsuspecting victims. It is also equipped with an accurate targeting system that aids the wielder in landing the canisters in their designated locations.
Rule.Raw: A single use, heavy canister launcher. This heavyweapon is capable of firing a volley of three toxic canisters at once, where each canisters can spew toxic gas at unsuspecting victims. It is also equipped with an accurate targeting system that aids the wielder in landing the canisters in their designated locations.
Rule.Translated: Un lanzabotes pesado de un solo uso que dispara una salva de tres botes tóxicos a la vez. Cada bote libera gas tóxico sobre víctimas desprevenidas. Incluye un sistema de puntería preciso que ayuda al usuario a colocar los botes en los lugares designados.

Rule.Original: The ultimate solution against mech bosses with powerful shields. The anti-mech railgun is a single-use heavy weapon that fires railgun rods that ignores shield bubbles and explode upon impact, all while spreading corrosive acid that nullifies armor.
Rule.Raw: The ultimate solution against mech bosses with powerful shields. The anti-mech railgun is a single-use heavy weapon that fires railgun rods that ignores shield bubbles and explode upon impact, all while spreading corrosive acid that nullifies armor.
Rule.Translated: La solución definitiva contra los jefes mecanoides con escudos potentes. Es un arma pesada de un solo uso que dispara varillas de cañón de riel capaces de atravesar las burbujas de escudo y explotar al impactar, además de esparcir ácido corrosivo que anula el blindaje.

Rule.Original: A top-of-the-line, burst-type, plasma assault rifle, capable of unleashing a burst of superheated plasma, that can either set the target on fire, or burn them to a crisp. The incinerator assault rifle is a must have weapon for incinirating hoards of bugs, and hostile tribals who relies on numbers and banzai tactics.
Rule.Raw: A top-of-the-line, burst-type, plasma assault rifle, capable of unleashing a burst of superheated plasma, that can either set the target on fire, or burn them to a crisp. The incinerator assault rifle is a must have weapon for incinirating hoards of bugs, and hostile tribals who relies on numbers and banzai tactics.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto de plasma de primera categoría que dispara ráfagas de plasma sobrecalentado capaces de prender fuego al objetivo o reducirlo a cenizas. Es un arma imprescindible para incinerar hordas de insectos y tribales hostiles que dependen de la superioridad numérica y los ataques a la carga.

Rule.Original: An energy sub machinegun that fires low-power plasma bolts. The overall energy of the plasma bolt were lessen inorder to allow full-auto, without the risk of the gun overheating. But don't let the lack of firepower fool you, since getting hit by a barrage of low-power plasma bolts is similar to having hundreds of superheated needles hitting you all at once.
Rule.Raw: An energy sub machinegun that fires low-power plasma bolts. The overall energy of the plasma bolt were lessen inorder to allow full-auto, without the risk of the gun overheating. But don't let the lack of firepower fool you, since getting hit by a barrage of low-power plasma bolts is similar to having hundreds of superheated needles hitting you all at once.
Rule.Translated: Un subfusil de energía que dispara descargas de plasma de baja potencia. La energía de estas descargas se redujo para permitir el fuego automático sin riesgo de sobrecalentar el arma. Pero no te dejes engañar por su menor potencia: recibir una andanada de estas descargas equivale a que te alcancen cientos de agujas sobrecalentadas a la vez.

Rule.Original: An advanced plasma sniper rifle with an incredible firepower. The incinerator sniper rifle can fire a concentrated superheated plasma round that deals heavy amounts of burn damage at long distances, with a cost of an increased weapon cooldown.
Rule.Raw: An advanced plasma sniper rifle with an incredible firepower. The incinerator sniper rifle can fire a concentrated superheated plasma round that deals heavy amounts of burn damage at long distances, with a cost of an increased weapon cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de francotirador de plasma avanzado con una potencia de fuego increíble. Dispara un proyectil concentrado de plasma sobrecalentado que causa graves quemaduras a larga distancia, a cambio de un mayor tiempo de recuperación entre disparos.

Rule.Original: A spacer-level energy weapon developed by kraltech industries, which is the result of unraveling the secrets hidden from the alpha chip. The incinerator laser blaster's beam is so hot, that it can melt concrete like butter, and the weapon can fire the hazardous beam without harming the wielder.
Rule.Raw: A spacer-level energy weapon developed by kraltech industries, which is the result of unraveling the secrets hidden from the alpha chip. The incinerator laser blaster's beam is so hot, that it can melt concrete like butter, and the weapon can fire the hazardous beam without harming the wielder.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de energía de nivel espacial desarrollada por Kraltech Industries al desentrañar los secretos ocultos del chip alfa. Su rayo es tan caliente que funde el hormigón como si fuera mantequilla. Puede disparar ese peligroso rayo sin dañar al usuario.

Rule.Original: An advanced monosword variant created by the vile mech hive. Unlike the regular mono sword, the mech mono sword is sharper which is capable in penetrating even the finest set of power armor, incredibly durable, and immune to rusting.
Rule.Raw: An advanced monosword variant created by the vile mech hive. Unlike the regular mono sword, the mech mono sword is sharper which is capable in penetrating even the finest set of power armor, incredibly durable, and immune to rusting.
Rule.Translated: Una variante avanzada de monoespada creada por la malvada colmena mecanoide. Es más afilada que una monoespada corriente y puede atravesar incluso las mejores servoarmaduras. También es extremadamente duradera e inmune a la oxidación.

Rule.Original: An advanced great sword wielded by the mech paladins. The greatsword's edges are completely sharpless and can only deal blunt damage at best, but the paladin cross possess the highest blunt-based damage capable of crushing armor.
Rule.Raw: An advanced great sword wielded by the mech paladins. The greatsword's edges are completely sharpless and can only deal blunt damage at best, but the paladin cross possess the highest blunt-based damage capable of crushing armor.
Rule.Translated: Un espadón avanzado que empuñan los paladines mecanoides. Sus bordes carecen por completo de filo, por lo que solo causa daño contundente. Sin embargo, la cruz de paladín ofrece el mayor daño de este tipo y puede aplastar blindajes.

Rule.Original: A dual edge battle axe made with the same material used for the mech mono sword, which is wielded mostly by the mech paladins.
Rule.Raw: A dual edge battle axe made with the same material used for the mech mono sword, which is wielded mostly by the mech paladins.
Rule.Translated: Un hacha de batalla de doble filo fabricada con el mismo material que la monoespada mecanoide, utilizada principalmente por los paladines mecanoides.

Rule.Original: A great katana created by the vile mech hive. At the hands of an artificial expert, the oodachi is capable of performing various slashes which deals various damages, some of which can instantly kill the enemy in a single slash. The oodachi is twice the size of the original, and only the beings with mechanical hands are capable of wielding such a weapon.
Rule.Raw: A great katana created by the vile mech hive. At the hands of an artificial expert, the oodachi is capable of performing various slashes which deals various damages, some of which can instantly kill the enemy in a single slash. The oodachi is twice the size of the original, and only the beings with mechanical hands are capable of wielding such a weapon.
Rule.Translated: Una gran katana creada por la malvada colmena mecanoide. En manos de un experto artificial, el oodachi permite realizar diversos cortes que causan distintos tipos de daño; algunos pueden matar al enemigo al instante de un solo golpe. Tiene el doble de tamaño que el original y solo los seres con manos mecánicas pueden empuñarlo.

Rule.Original: A gigantic lance wielded by a valkyrian. The mech lance possess the highest armor penetration capable of piercing even the strongest mech variant armor plating, and can inflict a deadly amount of piercing damage in a single hit.
Rule.Raw: A gigantic lance wielded by a valkyrian. The mech lance possess the highest armor penetration capable of piercing even the strongest mech variant armor plating, and can inflict a deadly amount of piercing damage in a single hit.
Rule.Translated: Una lanza gigantesca empuñada por una valquiria. Ofrece la mayor penetración de blindaje, capaz de atravesar incluso las placas más resistentes de las variantes mecanoides, y puede infligir una cantidad letal de daño perforante con un solo golpe.

Rule.Original: A gigantic lance wielded solely by mjolnir. The storm lance has a slightly higher armor penetration than the mech lance, and can call upon a barrage of thunder that can decimate groups of enemies.
Rule.Raw: A gigantic lance wielded solely by mjolnir. The storm lance has a slightly higher armor penetration than the mech lance, and can call upon a barrage of thunder that can decimate groups of enemies.
Rule.Translated: Una lanza gigantesca empuñada exclusivamente por Mjolnir. Tiene una penetración de blindaje ligeramente superior a la lanza mecanoide y puede invocar una andanada de rayos capaz de diezmar grupos de enemigos.

Rule.Original: A gigantic lance wielded solely by mjolnir. The storm lance has a slightly higher armor penetration than the mech lance, which deals a deadly amount of piercing damage against the enemy.
Rule.Raw: A gigantic lance wielded solely by mjolnir. The storm lance has a slightly higher armor penetration than the mech lance, which deals a deadly amount of piercing damage against the enemy.
Rule.Translated: Una lanza gigantesca empuñada exclusivamente por Mjolnir. Tiene una penetración de blindaje ligeramente superior a la lanza mecanoide y causa una cantidad letal de daño perforante al enemigo.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid heavy weapon that fires an explosive payload that explodes in pure energy, which deals deadly amounts of sharp damage under a 2.9 explosion radius.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid heavy weapon that fires an explosive payload that explodes in pure energy, which deals deadly amounts of sharp damage under a 2.9 explosion radius.
Rule.Translated: Un arma pesada mecanoide que dispara una carga explosiva que estalla en energía pura, causando una cantidad letal de daño cortante dentro de un radio de explosión de 2.9.

Rule.Original: A powerful chaingun designed for crowd control and suppression. This heavy weapon possess the best armor penetration and inflict both extra bleeding and extra pain against enemies upon impact.
Rule.Raw: A powerful chaingun designed for crowd control and suppression. This heavy weapon possess the best armor penetration and inflict both extra bleeding and extra pain against enemies upon impact.
Rule.Translated: Una potente ametralladora diseñada para el control de grupos y el fuego de supresión. Esta arma pesada ofrece la mejor penetración de blindaje y provoca hemorragias y dolor adicionales a los enemigos al impactar.

Rule.Original: A terrible heavy chemical weapon wielded exclusively by the mech pestilence. The bullet itself can inflict a plague disease with an added bonus of having their immune system jacked and explode upon death.
Rule.Raw: A terrible heavy chemical weapon wielded exclusively by the mech pestilence. The bullet itself can inflict a plague disease with an added bonus of having their immune system jacked and explode upon death.
Rule.Translated: Una terrible arma química pesada empuñada exclusivamente por la pestilencia mecanoide. Su bala puede causar peste, además de alterar el sistema inmunitario del objetivo y hacer que explote al morir.

Rule.Original: An alter version of the mech chaingun that deals more damage and inflict shock pain, in exchange of reduced range, reduced armor penetration, and reduced barrel length.
Rule.Raw: An alter version of the mech chaingun that deals more damage and inflict shock pain, in exchange of reduced range, reduced armor penetration, and reduced barrel length.
Rule.Translated: Una variante de la ametralladora mecanoide que causa más daño y dolor por choque, a cambio de menor alcance, menor penetración de blindaje y un cañón más corto.

Rule.Original: Rapid fire laser blaster with the highest base damage for an automatic energy weapon. Like a chaingun, it can unleash a storm of high power laser projectiles that can take down any threats with excellent efficientcy. Such a weapon is only seen being wielded by heavy-class mechanoids with abundant energy supply stored within them.
Rule.Raw: Rapid fire laser blaster with the highest base damage for an automatic energy weapon. Like a chaingun, it can unleash a storm of high power laser projectiles that can take down any threats with excellent efficientcy. Such a weapon is only seen being wielded by heavy-class mechanoids with abundant energy supply stored within them.
Rule.Translated: Un bláster láser de disparo rápido con el mayor daño base entre las armas de energía automáticas. Como una ametralladora, puede lanzar una tormenta de proyectiles láser de gran potencia y eliminar cualquier amenaza con excelente eficacia. Solo lo empuñan mecanoides de clase pesada que almacenan grandes reservas de energía en su interior.
lanza de carga de triple disparo

Rule.Original: An advanced version of the traditional charge lance that fires three consecutive charge rods, dealing triple the damage than usual.
Rule.Raw: An advanced version of the traditional charge lance that fires three consecutive charge rods, dealing triple the damage than usual.
Rule.Translated: Una versión avanzada de la lanza de carga tradicional que dispara tres varillas de carga consecutivas y causa el triple de daño de lo habitual.

Rule.Original: A charge lance modified with an arc injector, which propels charge projectiles at incredible range and deals heavy amounts of damage on a single target. .
Rule.Raw: A charge lance modified with an arc injector, which propels charge projectiles at incredible range and deals heavy amounts of damage on a single target. .
Rule.Translated: Una lanza de carga modificada con un inyector de arco que propulsa proyectiles de carga a un alcance extraordinario y causa graves daños a un único objetivo.

Rule.Original: An automatic charge rifle wielded primarily by agile mechanoids. It deals decent damage, better armor penetration, and inflicts vitality drain hediff upon impact.
Rule.Raw: An automatic charge rifle wielded primarily by agile mechanoids. It deals decent damage, better armor penetration, and inflicts vitality drain hediff upon impact.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de carga automático empuñado principalmente por mecanoides ágiles. Causa un daño adecuado, ofrece una mayor penetración de blindaje e inflige la afección de drenaje de vitalidad al impactar.

Rule.Original: A bizarre weapon capable of inducing a localized psychic explosion at a very long distance that deals severe burns against unsuspecting victims.
Rule.Raw: A bizarre weapon capable of inducing a localized psychic explosion at a very long distance that deals severe burns against unsuspecting victims.
Rule.Translated: Un arma extraña capaz de provocar una explosión psíquica localizada a una distancia muy grande, causando quemaduras graves a víctimas desprevenidas.

Rule.Original: Bigger and heavier version of the charge lance wielded by higher class mechanoids. It possess greater damage with incredible armor penetration, along with an added effect of inflicting instant death with a chance of 1%.
Rule.Raw: Bigger and heavier version of the charge lance wielded by higher class mechanoids. It possess greater damage with incredible armor penetration, along with an added effect of inflicting instant death with a chance of 1%.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más grande y pesada de la lanza de carga que empuñan mecanoides de clase superior. Ofrece más daño y una penetración de blindaje increíble, además de una probabilidad del 1% de causar muerte instantánea.

Rule.Original: A larger version of the mech laser blaster that was used to arm capital-class mech ships, now redesigned to be used by the supreme apocriton.
Rule.Raw: A larger version of the mech laser blaster that was used to arm capital-class mech ships, now redesigned to be used by the supreme apocriton.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más grande del bláster láser mecanoide, utilizada para armar naves capitales mecanoides y ahora rediseñada para el apocritón supremo.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the mini shotgun, now with a cylindrical drum which allows the gun to fire 12 rounds of shotgun pellets with a decent stopping power of 250 %.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the mini shotgun, now with a cylindrical drum which allows the gun to fire 12 rounds of shotgun pellets with a decent stopping power of 250 %.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada de la miniescopeta, ahora con un tambor cilíndrico que permite disparar 12 proyectiles de perdigones con un poder de parada del 250 %.

Rule.Original: An advanced charge rifle used by the hydraulic guardians. The charge battle riffle is very efficient in eliminating threats due to its consistent shots and high base damage, and the gun is very accurate due to its reinforced charge barrel and a built-in smart targeting system.
Rule.Raw: An advanced charge rifle used by the hydraulic guardians. The charge battle riffle is very efficient in eliminating threats due to its consistent shots and high base damage, and the gun is very accurate due to its reinforced charge barrel and a built-in smart targeting system.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de carga avanzado utilizado por los guardianes hidráulicos. Elimina amenazas con gran eficacia gracias a sus disparos constantes y su elevado daño base. Es muy preciso debido a su cañón de carga reforzado y su sistema inteligente de puntería integrado.

Rule.Original: Widely used assault rifle outfitted for the use of mass-produced expendable mechs. Fairly cheap and easy to manufacture, and boasts a decent stats which rivals modern day rifles.
Rule.Raw: Widely used assault rifle outfitted for the use of mass-produced expendable mechs. Fairly cheap and easy to manufacture, and boasts a decent stats which rivals modern day rifles.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto muy extendido, adaptado para mecanoides prescindibles producidos en masa. Es bastante barato y fácil de fabricar, con unas prestaciones adecuadas que rivalizan con las de los fusiles actuales.

Rule.Original: An upgraded version of the mech assault rifle mk.1, which uses flash bullets that stuns the target for a 5 % chance.
Rule.Raw: An upgraded version of the mech assault rifle mk.1, which uses flash bullets that stuns the target for a 5 % chance.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del fusil de asalto mecanoide mk.1. Utiliza balas cegadoras que tienen un 5 % de probabilidad de aturdir al objetivo.

Rule.Original: An advanced assault rifle used by the militor MK2, now with an ability to inflict frostbite to organic enemies.
Rule.Raw: An advanced assault rifle used by the militor MK2, now with an ability to inflict frostbite to organic enemies.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto avanzado utilizado por el militor MK2, ahora capaz de provocar congelación a los enemigos orgánicos.

Rule.Original: A large mech orbital targeter that summons an orbital laser from the heavens. Very effective againsts oraganic targets, but not so effective against other mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: A large mech orbital targeter that summons an orbital laser from the heavens. Very effective againsts oraganic targets, but not so effective against other mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Un gran designador orbital mecanoide que invoca un láser orbital desde el cielo. Es muy eficaz contra objetivos orgánicos, pero menos contra otros mecanoides.

Rule.Original: An assault rifle which was reversed engineered from the original mech assault rifle. The militor assault rifle in an automatic firearm that fires 25 shots and deals more damage than the original.
Rule.Raw: An assault rifle which was reversed engineered from the original mech assault rifle. The militor assault rifle in an automatic firearm that fires 25 shots and deals more damage than the original.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto obtenido mediante ingeniería inversa a partir del fusil mecanoide original. Es un arma automática que dispara 25 proyectiles y causa más daño que el original.
fusil de asalto de carga de militor

Rule.Original: A reversed engineered mech assault charger, which fires pulse bullets that can inflict physical, flame, and EMP damage.
Rule.Raw: A reversed engineered mech assault charger, which fires pulse bullets that can inflict physical, flame, and EMP damage.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto de carga mecanoide obtenido mediante ingeniería inversa. Dispara balas de pulsos que pueden infligir daño físico, de fuego y PEM.

Rule.Original: A reversed engineered and modified charged battle rifle which was designed to be wielded by a militor. The militor heavy bolter can fire high explosive bolts that deals heavy amounts of damage, although its explosion radius is only limited to 1, It's still very effective against singular armored enemies that are clustered together.
Rule.Raw: A reversed engineered and modified charged battle rifle which was designed to be wielded by a militor. The militor heavy bolter can fire high explosive bolts that deals heavy amounts of damage, although its explosion radius is only limited to 1, It's still very effective against singular armored enemies that are clustered together.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de batalla de carga obtenido mediante ingeniería inversa y modificado para que lo empuñe un militor. El bólter pesado de militor dispara proyectiles de alto poder explosivo que causan mucho daño. Aunque su radio de explosión se limita a 1, sigue siendo muy eficaz contra enemigos blindados individuales que estén agrupados.

Rule.Original: A customized anti-material rifle for militors, which boasts the best long range damage and can inflict EMP damage upon impact.
Rule.Raw: A customized anti-material rifle for militors, which boasts the best long range damage and can inflict EMP damage upon impact.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil antimaterial personalizado para militores que ofrece el mejor daño a larga distancia y puede infligir daño PEM al impactar.

Rule.Original: A scoped smg made specifically for militors. Like the burst smg, it can fire a hailstorm of bullets and excells greatly at slowing down a singular enemy due to its increadible stopping power.
Rule.Raw: A scoped smg made specifically for militors. Like the burst smg, it can fire a hailstorm of bullets and excells greatly at slowing down a singular enemy due to its increadible stopping power.
Rule.Translated: Un subfusil con mira fabricado específicamente para militores. Como el subfusil de ráfagas, puede disparar una lluvia de balas y destaca al ralentizar a un solo enemigo gracias a su enorme poder de parada.

Rule.Original: Tools of infernal chaos wielded by the alpha tesserons. Capable of firing beams of scorching heat, this particular laser blaster can inflict severe gamma beam burns that nullifies heat armor and increase flamability of the victim.
Rule.Raw: Tools of infernal chaos wielded by the alpha tesserons. Capable of firing beams of scorching heat, this particular laser blaster can inflict severe gamma beam burns that nullifies heat armor and increase flamability of the victim.
Rule.Translated: Instrumentos de caos infernal empuñados por los teserones alfa. Este bláster láser dispara haces de calor abrasador y puede causar graves quemaduras por rayos gamma que anulan la protección térmica y aumentan la inflamabilidad de la víctima.

Rule.Original: A chaingun version of the thump cannon, which fires five consecutive shots of thump bombs.
Rule.Raw: A chaingun version of the thump cannon, which fires five consecutive shots of thump bombs.
Rule.Translated: Una versión ametralladora del cañón de golpes, que dispara cinco bombas de impacto consecutivas.

Rule.Original: A semi automatic laser assault rifle with one of the highest armor penetration ever concieved. It's laser bolts are increadibly deadly that can easily melt mechanoid variant armor like butter, and inflict massive ammounts of damage at a short period of time.
Rule.Raw: A semi automatic laser assault rifle with one of the highest armor penetration ever concieved. It's laser bolts are increadibly deadly that can easily melt mechanoid variant armor like butter, and inflict massive ammounts of damage at a short period of time.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de asalto láser semiautomático con una de las mayores capacidades de penetración de armadura jamás concebidas. Sus rayos láser son increíblemente letales: funden el blindaje de las variantes mecanoides como si fuera mantequilla e infligen enormes cantidades de daño en muy poco tiempo.

Rule.Original: A long range laser sniper rifle wielded by the enforcers. The mech slayer laser sniper rifle is one of the few non-EMP energy weapons in its class that are highly effective against shield buubles, in constrast, a single laser beam shot can take away 990 points of shield value, and it is very effective against shield bubbles that are immune to EMP.
Rule.Raw: A long range laser sniper rifle wielded by the enforcers. The mech slayer laser sniper rifle is one of the few non-EMP energy weapons in its class that are highly effective against shield buubles, in constrast, a single laser beam shot can take away 990 points of shield value, and it is very effective against shield bubbles that are immune to EMP.
Rule.Translated: Un fusil de francotirador láser de largo alcance utilizado por los ejecutores. Es una de las pocas armas de energía de su clase que resulta muy eficaz contra las burbujas de escudo sin recurrir a pulsos PEM: un único disparo láser puede eliminar 990 puntos de escudo y es muy eficaz contra las burbujas inmunes a los PEM.

Rule.Original: An automatic heavy laser shooter wielded by the enforcers. It laser bolts are one of the most destructive, specially designed to overwhelm high health shield bubbles and counter mechanoids with high health. Due to the tremendous recoil, the weapon can only be fired at a reduced range coupled with slightly longer ranged cooldowns.
Rule.Raw: An automatic heavy laser shooter wielded by the enforcers. It laser bolts are one of the most destructive, specially designed to overwhelm high health shield bubbles and counter mechanoids with high health. Due to the tremendous recoil, the weapon can only be fired at a reduced range coupled with slightly longer ranged cooldowns.
Rule.Translated: Un arma láser pesada automática utilizada por los ejecutores. Sus rayos se cuentan entre los más destructivos y están diseñados para saturar burbujas de escudo muy resistentes y combatir mecanoides con mucha salud. Su enorme retroceso obliga a disparar a menor alcance y con intervalos algo más largos entre disparos.

Rule.Original: One of the most devestating energy weapon wielded by the enforcers. It fires the same laser bolts as the laser avenger and it can fire ten bolts per shot, and unlike any other shotguns, it has an enhanced range which covers at least 12.5 radius around the shooter. This weapon is highly effective against enemies with high health and armor.
Rule.Raw: One of the most devestating energy weapon wielded by the enforcers. It fires the same laser bolts as the laser avenger and it can fire ten bolts per shot, and unlike any other shotguns, it has an enhanced range which covers at least 12.5 radius around the shooter. This weapon is highly effective against enemies with high health and armor.
Rule.Translated: Una de las armas de energía más devastadoras utilizadas por los ejecutores. Emplea los mismos rayos que el vengador láser y lanza diez por disparo. A diferencia de otras escopetas, tiene un alcance mejorado que cubre un radio de al menos 12.5 alrededor del tirador. Es muy eficaz contra enemigos con mucha salud y armadura.

Rule.Original: An all-purpose military shovel used by frontline soldiers. This shovel can do anything from digging trenches, harvest vegetables, cook meals, mine raw minerals, and ofcourse, bashing someone's head into a bloody pulp! The all-purpose shovel will be your bestfriend and companion in surviving the wilderness and the battlefield.
Rule.Raw: An all-purpose military shovel used by frontline soldiers. This shovel can do anything from digging trenches, harvest vegetables, cook meals, mine raw minerals, and ofcourse, bashing someone's head into a bloody pulp! The all-purpose shovel will be your bestfriend and companion in surviving the wilderness and the battlefield.
Rule.Translated: Una pala militar multiusos utilizada por soldados de primera línea. Sirve para cavar trincheras, cosechar verduras, cocinar, extraer minerales y, por supuesto, ¡reventarle la cabeza a alguien hasta convertirla en una masa sanguinolenta! Será tu mejor amiga y compañera para sobrevivir en la naturaleza y en el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: A two handed katana, that makes you feel as if you're the storm that is approaching. The katana's edge is so sharp that it can cut-up pirate heads with ease, and lightweight where the wielder can swing the katana continuously. The raider katana is oftenly used by fast-moving melee units who loves provoking dark clouds in isolation.
Rule.Raw: A two handed katana, that makes you feel as if you're the storm that is approaching. The katana's edge is so sharp that it can cut-up pirate heads with ease, and lightweight where the wielder can swing the katana continuously. The raider katana is oftenly used by fast-moving melee units who loves provoking dark clouds in isolation.
Rule.Translated: Una katana a dos manos que te hace sentir como la tormenta que se aproxima. Su filo corta cabezas de piratas con facilidad y su ligereza permite blandirla sin parar. Suelen utilizarla unidades de combate cuerpo a cuerpo muy rápidas, aficionadas a invocar nubarrones en soledad.

Rule.Original: An exclusive two handed katana with its blade edge made of vibrosonic solution. Vibrosonic solution has a hidden EMP properties which is essential against mechanoids, and at the hands of a professional swordsman, the katana is capable of performing multiple sword slashes with variying damages. Due to the rarity of vibrosonic solution, only a handful of these katanas are manufactured and only sold on a premium price.
Rule.Raw: An exclusive two handed katana with its blade edge made of vibrosonic solution. Vibrosonic solution has a hidden EMP properties which is essential against mechanoids, and at the hands of a professional swordsman, the katana is capable of performing multiple sword slashes with variying damages. Due to the rarity of vibrosonic solution, only a handful of these katanas are manufactured and only sold on a premium price.
Rule.Translated: Una katana exclusiva a dos manos con el filo hecho de solución vibrosónica. Esta solución tiene propiedades PEM ocultas, esenciales contra los mecanoides. En manos de un espadachín profesional, la katana puede encadenar varios tajos con distintos niveles de daño. La rareza de la solución vibrosónica limita su fabricación a unas pocas unidades, que se venden a precios muy elevados.

Rule.Original: A burst-type submachine gun capable of unleashing a hailstorm of bullets. It has no range cooldown and it has impressive fire rate, though it lacks decent armor penetration. A perfect weapon for colony defenses.
Rule.Raw: A burst-type submachine gun capable of unleashing a hailstorm of bullets. It has no range cooldown and it has impressive fire rate, though it lacks decent armor penetration. A perfect weapon for colony defenses.
Rule.Translated: Un subfusil de ráfagas capaz de desatar una lluvia de balas. No tiene tiempo de recuperación entre disparos y posee una cadencia impresionante, aunque su penetración de armadura es escasa. Un arma perfecta para defender la colonia.

Rule.Original: A four-shot black hawk revolver. Unlike regular revolvers, the homelander revolver possess increased damage and decent stopping power, along with a comfortable grip for easy aim at mid to short range. Truly a viable sidearm to use to defend yourself against the horrors of the rim.
Rule.Raw: A four-shot black hawk revolver. Unlike regular revolvers, the homelander revolver possess increased damage and decent stopping power, along with a comfortable grip for easy aim at mid to short range. Truly a viable sidearm to use to defend yourself against the horrors of the rim.
Rule.Translated: Un revólver Black Hawk de cuatro disparos. Frente a los revólveres normales, el Homelander inflige más daño, tiene un buen poder de parada y una empuñadura cómoda que facilita apuntar a corta y media distancia. Un arma secundaria muy útil para defenderte de los horrores del borde.

Rule.Original: An excellent pump shotgun which deals the best damage at close range. It fires specialized slug shots that deals somewhat decent armor penetration, can inflict stun, and can easily take-down enemy raiders without breaking a sweat. A perfect weapon for support and ambush tactics.
Rule.Raw: An excellent pump shotgun which deals the best damage at close range. It fires specialized slug shots that deals somewhat decent armor penetration, can inflict stun, and can easily take-down enemy raiders without breaking a sweat. A perfect weapon for support and ambush tactics.
Rule.Translated: Una excelente escopeta de corredera que inflige el máximo daño a corta distancia. Dispara cartuchos especializados de proyectil único con una penetración de armadura aceptable, capaces de aturdir y abatir fácilmente a los asaltantes enemigos. Un arma perfecta para tácticas de apoyo y emboscadas.

Rule.Original: An ultra compact DDM4 PDW pistol designed for colony defense. This AR pistol is the superior alternative to traditional pistols due to its increadible range and fire rate, and it possess great armor penetration that can penetrate even the finest of flak vests.
Rule.Raw: An ultra compact DDM4 PDW pistol designed for colony defense. This AR pistol is the superior alternative to traditional pistols due to its increadible range and fire rate, and it possess great armor penetration that can penetrate even the finest of flak vests.
Rule.Translated: Una pistola DDM4 PDW ultracompacta diseñada para defender la colonia. Esta pistola AR supera a las pistolas tradicionales gracias a su increíble alcance y cadencia. Su gran capacidad de penetración puede atravesar incluso los mejores chalecos antibalas.

Rule.Original: The apex of counter offense armaments for early to mid stage in surviving the rim. The homelander assault rifle is an automatic assault rifle with a very decent armor penetration, which is capable of providing support fire and effective counter offence and defense against invading ememies.
Rule.Raw: The apex of counter offense armaments for early to mid stage in surviving the rim. The homelander assault rifle is an automatic assault rifle with a very decent armor penetration, which is capable of providing support fire and effective counter offence and defense against invading ememies.
Rule.Translated: La máxima expresión del armamento de contraataque para las etapas iniciales e intermedias de supervivencia en el borde. El fusil de asalto Homelander es un fusil automático con una penetración de armadura muy aceptable, capaz de proporcionar fuego de apoyo y responder con eficacia a los invasores tanto en ataque como en defensa.

Rule.Original: A powerful heavy machinegun that would definitely put you on the wanted list for most warcrimes commited involving poisons. The toxic HMG can fire a barrage of toxic bullets at quick succession, with a guaranteed kill to organic targets if the poison manages to stack up repeatedly.
Rule.Raw: A powerful heavy machinegun that would definitely put you on the wanted list for most warcrimes commited involving poisons. The toxic HMG can fire a barrage of toxic bullets at quick succession, with a guaranteed kill to organic targets if the poison manages to stack up repeatedly.
Rule.Translated: Una potente ametralladora pesada que sin duda te colocaría en la lista de los más buscados por crímenes de guerra relacionados con venenos. Dispara una lluvia de balas tóxicas en rápida sucesión y garantiza la muerte de los objetivos orgánicos si el veneno consigue acumularse repetidamente.

Rule.Original: An iconic power SMG. The fenrir smg deals thermal damage with an increased chance to apply burn, reduces bullet spread, increases bullet impact at the cost of higher recoil, and deal corrosive damage that nullifies heavy armor.
Rule.Raw: An iconic power SMG. The fenrir smg deals thermal damage with an increased chance to apply burn, reduces bullet spread, increases bullet impact at the cost of higher recoil, and deal corrosive damage that nullifies heavy armor.
Rule.Translated: Un emblemático subfusil de potencia. El Fenrir inflige daño térmico con una mayor probabilidad de provocar quemaduras, reduce la dispersión de las balas y aumenta su impacto a costa de un mayor retroceso. También inflige daño corrosivo que anula la armadura pesada.

Rule.Original: The 3516 is an Iconic Power Pistol manufactured by Malorian Arms. This pistol in particular is a one of the kind semi-automatic pistol wielded by the iconic Johnny Silverhand.

Rule.Translated: La 3516 es una emblemática pistola de potencia fabricada por Malorian Arms. Esta pieza única es la pistola semiautomática que empuña el icónico Johnny Silverhand.

Rule.Original: The 'Akicita' is a long-range scout variant of the 'Warrior' Modular Body Protection System. This outfit recycles the wearer's bodily waste and moisture, provides protection against heat and cold, dampens sound, and assists movement with servo motors and a lightweight exoskeleton. The wearer requires less sleep, moves faster, and hunts more quietly. Originally designed as protective gear for explorers, guerrilla fighters and caravans on the rimworlds quickly recognized its incredible potential.
Rule.Raw: The 'Akicita' is a long-range scout variant of the 'Warrior' Modular Body Protection System. This outfit recycles the wearer's bodily waste and moisture, provides protection against heat and cold, dampens sound, and assists movement with servo motors and a lightweight exoskeleton. The wearer requires less sleep, moves faster, and hunts more quietly. Originally designed as protective gear for explorers, guerrilla fighters and caravans on the rimworlds quickly recognized its incredible potential.
Rule.Translated: La «Akicita» es una variante de exploración de largo alcance del sistema modular de protección corporal «Warrior». Recicla los residuos y la humedad corporales de quien la lleva, protege del calor y el frío, amortigua el sonido y facilita el movimiento mediante servomotores y un exoesqueleto ligero. El usuario necesita dormir menos, se mueve más rápido y caza con mayor sigilo. Aunque se diseñó para proteger a exploradores, los guerrilleros y las caravanas de los mundos exteriores reconocieron enseguida su enorme potencial.

Rule.Original: A helmet from the Akicita Nomad Armor set. Its long-range observation equipment can also be used for aiming.

Rule.Raw: Designed for combat medics, the 'Hospitaller' armor is the medical variant of the 'Warrior' Modular Body Protection System. It is equipped with a variety of medical tools and supplies, allowing the wearer to treat the injured in the field.
Rule.Translated: La armadura «Hospitaller», diseñada para sanitarios de combate, es la variante médica del sistema modular de protección corporal «Warrior». Incorpora diversas herramientas y suministros médicos que permiten atender a los heridos sobre el terreno.
