Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Drop Suit Model 212f “JanYeong” (Shadow Remains) You don’t see them coming. You only see what’s left.
The Model 212f “JanYeong” is a fully enclosed atmospheric insertion suit engineered for the Aggressive Marketing Division’s orbital deployment units. Designed for high-speed, high-risk entry from low orbit, it enables rapid, pinpoint insertion deep within hostile zones—long before air defenses can respond.
Fitted with a proprietary long-range jump pack and environmental sealing allow operators to deploy in virtually any atmosphere, climate, or war crime. Standard-issue for corporate drop troopers tasked with pre-market stabilization, the JanYeong is more than a suit. It’s the last thing anyone hears before a “strategic rebranding” begins.
Yeonhwa Precision: Descent Is Inevitable.
Rule.Raw:
Yeonhwa Precision Drop Suit Model 212f “JanYeong” (Shadow Remains) You don’t see them coming. You only see what’s left.
The Model 212f “JanYeong” is a fully enclosed atmospheric insertion suit engineered for the Aggressive Marketing Division’s orbital deployment units. Designed for high-speed, high-risk entry from low orbit, it enables rapid, pinpoint insertion deep within hostile zones—long before air defenses can respond.
Fitted with a proprietary long-range jump pack and environmental sealing allow operators to deploy in virtually any atmosphere, climate, or war crime. Standard-issue for corporate drop troopers tasked with pre-market stabilization, the JanYeong is more than a suit. It’s the last thing anyone hears before a “strategic rebranding” begins.
Yeonhwa Precision: Descent Is Inevitable.
Rule.Translated:
Traje de descenso de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 212f «JanYeong» (Restos de sombra). No los ves llegar. Solo ves lo que queda.
El modelo 212f «JanYeong» es un traje de inserción atmosférica completamente cerrado, diseñado para las unidades de despliegue orbital de la División de Marketing Agresivo. Preparado para entradas rápidas y peligrosas desde órbita baja, permite una inserción veloz y precisa en lo más profundo de las zonas hostiles, mucho antes de que las defensas aéreas puedan responder.
Su mochila de salto de largo alcance patentada y su sellado ambiental permiten operar en prácticamente cualquier atmósfera, clima o crimen de guerra. Es el equipo estándar de los soldados de descenso corporativos encargados de estabilizar los mercados antes de su apertura. El JanYeong es más que un traje: es lo último que se oye antes de que empiece un «cambio estratégico de marca».
Yeonhwa Precision: el descenso es inevitable.

Rule.Original: A cutting-edge EVA helmet loaded with flashy gadgets — most of which are completely useless planetside. Fortunately, the targeting-assist pseudo-AI still works.
Rule.Raw: A cutting-edge EVA helmet loaded with flashy gadgets — most of which are completely useless planetside. Fortunately, the targeting-assist pseudo-AI still works.
Rule.Translated: Un casco EVA de última generación repleto de aparatos llamativos, casi todos completamente inútiles en la superficie de un planeta. Por suerte, la pseudo-IA de asistencia al apuntado sigue funcionando.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Strike Suit Model 183a “ChangWol” (Azure Moon)
Blink. Break. Bleed.
The Model 183a “ChangWol” is an advanced urban strike suit engineered for high-speed, close-quarters assault. Outfitted with short-range directional jump thrusters, it allows operators to breach, reposition, and kill in the space between heartbeats.
Built for precision strikes and controlled chaos, the ChangWol favors users with razor instincts and fearless aggression. Each movement is a gamble—and a weapon. The suit's lightweight composite armor and responsive neuro-linked controls reward boldness and punish hesitation. Standard issue for Aggressive Marketing Division entry teams, the ChangWol isn’t designed for survival. It’s designed for momentum.
Yeonhwa Precision: Boldness Engineered.
Rule.Raw:
Yeonhwa Precision Strike Suit Model 183a “ChangWol” (Azure Moon)
Blink. Break. Bleed.
The Model 183a “ChangWol” is an advanced urban strike suit engineered for high-speed, close-quarters assault. Outfitted with short-range directional jump thrusters, it allows operators to breach, reposition, and kill in the space between heartbeats.
Built for precision strikes and controlled chaos, the ChangWol favors users with razor instincts and fearless aggression. Each movement is a gamble—and a weapon. The suit's lightweight composite armor and responsive neuro-linked controls reward boldness and punish hesitation. Standard issue for Aggressive Marketing Division entry teams, the ChangWol isn’t designed for survival. It’s designed for momentum.
Yeonhwa Precision: Boldness Engineered.
Rule.Translated:
Traje de asalto de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 183a «ChangWol» (Luna azul).
Parpadea. Rompe. Sangra.
El modelo 183a «ChangWol» es un traje avanzado de asalto urbano diseñado para ataques rápidos a corta distancia. Sus propulsores de salto direccionales de corto alcance permiten abrir brechas, cambiar de posición y matar en el tiempo que transcurre entre dos latidos.
Creado para ataques precisos y caos controlado, el ChangWol favorece a quienes tienen instintos afilados y una agresividad sin miedo. Cada movimiento es una apuesta y un arma. Su armadura compuesta ligera y sus controles de respuesta rápida con enlace neural premian la audacia y castigan las dudas. Es el equipo estándar de los equipos de entrada de la División de Marketing Agresivo. El ChangWol no está diseñado para sobrevivir: está diseñado para mantener el impulso.
Yeonhwa Precision: audacia diseñada.

Rule.Original: A helmet from the delicate strike suit. Its sophisticated nerve-assist system enhances the wearer's reaction speed.
Rule.Raw: A helmet from the delicate strike suit. Its sophisticated nerve-assist system enhances the wearer's reaction speed.
Rule.Translated: Un casco del delicado traje de incursión. Su sofisticado sistema de asistencia nerviosa mejora la velocidad de reacción del usuario.

Rule.Original: An ultra-heavy protective armor, Bjorn is clad in layers of composite plasteel-weave and reactive armor plates. The wearer of this armor practically becomes a walking tank. It offers tremendous protection at the expense of mobility and includes an integrated short-range EMP grenade launcher.
Rule.Raw: An ultra-heavy protective armor, Bjorn is clad in layers of composite plasteel-weave and reactive armor plates. The wearer of this armor practically becomes a walking tank. It offers tremendous protection at the expense of mobility and includes an integrated short-range EMP grenade launcher.
Rule.Translated: Una armadura protectora ultrapesada. La Bjorn está cubierta de capas de tejido compuesto de plastiacero y placas de blindaje reactivo. Quien la lleva se convierte prácticamente en un tanque andante. Ofrece una protección enorme a costa de la movilidad e incorpora un lanzagranadas EMP de corto alcance.

Rule.Original: A rugged and reliable helmet from the assault armor set.
Rule.Raw: A rugged and reliable helmet from the assault armor set.
Rule.Translated: Un casco resistente y fiable del conjunto de armadura de asalto.

Rule.Original: Varg Fire Support Armor turns its wearer into a mobile weapon platform. Equipped for heavy suppression, it dominates firefights — just don’t let the enemy get too close.
Rule.Raw: Varg Fire Support Armor turns its wearer into a mobile weapon platform. Equipped for heavy suppression, it dominates firefights — just don’t let the enemy get too close.
Rule.Translated: La armadura de apoyo de fuego Varg convierte a quien la lleva en una plataforma de armamento móvil. Preparada para una intensa supresión, domina los tiroteos; procura que el enemigo no se acerque demasiado.

Rule.Original: A helmet from the Varg Fire Support Armor set. It shares the same features as the main armor.
Rule.Raw: A helmet from the Varg Fire Support Armor set. It shares the same features as the main armor.
Rule.Translated: Un casco del conjunto de armadura de apoyo de fuego Varg. Comparte las características de la armadura principal.

Rule.Original:
A variant of the Varg Fire Support Armor, the Korp (“Raven”) Artillery Armor originated from improvised frontline modifications. All nonessential equipment was stripped from the Korp to mount a massive mortar: the “Crow Feeder.” Its purpose is simple — to turn the wearer into walking artillery.
This mortar exclusively fires high-explosive shells.
Rule.Raw:
A variant of the Varg Fire Support Armor, the Korp (“Raven”) Artillery Armor originated from improvised frontline modifications. All nonessential equipment was stripped from the Korp to mount a massive mortar: the “Crow Feeder.” Its purpose is simple — to turn the wearer into walking artillery.
This mortar exclusively fires high-explosive shells.
Rule.Translated:
La armadura de artillería Korp («Cuervo») es una variante de la armadura de apoyo de fuego Varg surgida de modificaciones improvisadas en el frente. Se retiró todo el equipo no esencial para montar un enorme mortero, el «Comedero de cuervos». Su propósito es sencillo: convertir a quien la lleva en artillería andante.
Este mortero solo dispara proyectiles de alto explosivo.

Rule.Original: Nemesis is high-performance power armor engineered specifically for extermination missions against Federation remnants. With near-total resistance to heat-based weaponry, it's reserved for the most elite of the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent.
Rule.Raw: Nemesis is high-performance power armor engineered specifically for extermination missions against Federation remnants. With near-total resistance to heat-based weaponry, it's reserved for the most elite of the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent.
Rule.Translated: Nemesis es una armadura potenciada de altas prestaciones diseñada específicamente para misiones de exterminio contra los remanentes de la Federación. Su resistencia casi total a las armas térmicas la reserva para la élite del Contingente de Cazadores de Tisiphone.

Rule.Original: A helmet equipped with a complete heat deflection system.
Rule.Raw: A helmet equipped with a complete heat deflection system.
Rule.Translated: Un casco equipado con un sistema completo de desviación del calor.

Rule.Original: The Alecto Hazard Carapace is designed to carry out missions even in the harshest environments. In extreme cold, scorching heat, or radioactive wastelands, Tisiphone hunters can continue their relentless pursuit.
Rule.Raw: The Alecto Hazard Carapace is designed to carry out missions even in the harshest environments. In extreme cold, scorching heat, or radioactive wastelands, Tisiphone hunters can continue their relentless pursuit.
Rule.Translated: La coraza de protección ambiental Alecto está diseñada para realizar misiones incluso en los entornos más extremos. En frío intenso, calor abrasador o páramos radiactivos, los cazadores de Tisiphone pueden continuar su persecución implacable.

Rule.Original: Part of the Alecto Hazard Carapace set, this helmet offers superior protection against extreme heat, cold, and radiation.
Rule.Raw: Part of the Alecto Hazard Carapace set, this helmet offers superior protection against extreme heat, cold, and radiation.
Rule.Translated: Este casco forma parte del conjunto de coraza de protección ambiental Alecto y ofrece una protección superior contra el calor extremo, el frío y la radiación.

Rule.Original: Excelsior is a shielded power armor optimized for brutal close-range engagements. Fast, tough, and deadly — it's made for those who charge headfirst into danger.
Rule.Raw: Excelsior is a shielded power armor optimized for brutal close-range engagements. Fast, tough, and deadly — it's made for those who charge headfirst into danger.
Rule.Translated: Excelsior es una armadura potenciada con escudo, optimizada para enfrentamientos brutales a corta distancia. Rápida, resistente y letal, está hecha para quienes se lanzan de cabeza al peligro.

Rule.Original: Part of the Excelsior set, this helmet features a neural enhancement system that boosts reflexes and close-combat performance.
Rule.Raw: Part of the Excelsior set, this helmet features a neural enhancement system that boosts reflexes and close-combat performance.
Rule.Translated: Este casco forma parte del conjunto Excelsior e incorpora un sistema de mejora neural que aumenta los reflejos y el rendimiento en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: A table with equipments for assembling and disassembling Greydale equipments.
Rule.Raw: A table with equipments for assembling and disassembling Greydale equipments.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa equipada para montar y desmontar equipo Greydale.

Rule.Original: A table with equipments for assembling Yeonhwa Precision equipments.
Rule.Raw: A table with equipments for assembling Yeonhwa Precision equipments.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa equipada para ensamblar equipo de Yeonhwa Precision.

Rule.Original: A table with equipments for assembling Jotun Interstellar equipments.
Rule.Raw: A table with equipments for assembling Jotun Interstellar equipments.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa equipada para ensamblar equipo de Jotun Interstellar.

Rule.Original: A table with equipments for assembling Tisiphone Enterprise equipments.
Rule.Raw: A table with equipments for assembling Tisiphone Enterprise equipments.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa equipada para ensamblar equipo de Tisiphone Enterprise.

Rule.Original: All the parts necessary to convert a Panther-C modular carbine to another configuration. To reconfigure an already assembled Panther Modular Rifle System, you first need to disassemble it back to the carbine configuration, then assemble it again with the parts you prefer.
Rule.Raw: All the parts necessary to convert a Panther-C modular carbine to another configuration. To reconfigure an already assembled Panther Modular Rifle System, you first need to disassemble it back to the carbine configuration, then assemble it again with the parts you prefer.
Rule.Translated: Todas las piezas necesarias para convertir una carabina modular Panther-C en otra configuración. Para reconfigurar un sistema de fusil modular Panther ya ensamblado, primero debes desmontarlo hasta obtener la configuración de carabina y después volver a montarlo con las piezas que prefieras.

Rule.Original: An advanced conversion kit for the Greydale modular weapon systems. It contains sophisticated components such as high-capacity capacitors and a magnetic accelerator barrel.
Rule.Raw: An advanced conversion kit for the Greydale modular weapon systems. It contains sophisticated components such as high-capacity capacitors and a magnetic accelerator barrel.
Rule.Translated: Un kit de conversión avanzado para los sistemas de armas modulares de Greydale. Contiene componentes sofisticados, como condensadores de alta capacidad y un cañón de aceleración magnética.
kit de sistema de arma secundaria modular

Rule.Original: Basic components for assembling the Ocelot modular sidearm system.
Rule.Raw: Basic components for assembling the Ocelot modular sidearm system.
Rule.Translated: Componentes básicos para ensamblar el sistema de arma secundaria modular Ocelot.

Rule.Original: Various armor components for assembling the "Warrior" modular body protection system.
Rule.Raw: Various armor components for assembling the "Warrior" modular body protection system.
Rule.Translated: Diversos componentes de armadura para ensamblar el sistema de protección corporal modular «Warrior».

Rule.Original:
Standard close-range sidearm with good armor-piercing capability. Fires three rounds simultaneously.
Graydale Defense ATX10 "Ocelot" series Modular Sidearm System, standard triple-shot pistol variant.
Unlike more conventional firearms—such as its predecessor, the Lynx tactical pistol—the Ocelot uses electrically primed ammunition and a tubular magazine-chamber system. It can fire three armor-piercing rounds almost simultaneously.
Rule.Raw:
Standard close-range sidearm with good armor-piercing capability. Fires three rounds simultaneously.
Graydale Defense ATX10 "Ocelot" series Modular Sidearm System, standard triple-shot pistol variant.
Unlike more conventional firearms—such as its predecessor, the Lynx tactical pistol—the Ocelot uses electrically primed ammunition and a tubular magazine-chamber system. It can fire three armor-piercing rounds almost simultaneously.
Rule.Translated:
Un arma secundaria estándar para distancias cortas con buena capacidad de perforación de blindaje. Dispara tres proyectiles simultáneamente.
Sistema modular de armas secundarias de la serie ATX10 «Ocelot» de Graydale Defense, variante estándar de pistola de triple disparo.
A diferencia de las armas convencionales, como su predecesora, la pistola táctica Lynx, la Ocelot utiliza munición de encendido eléctrico y un sistema tubular de cargador y recámara. Puede disparar tres proyectiles perforantes casi al mismo tiempo.

Rule.Original:
A short-range bullet-sprayer that compensates for its mediocre damage with sheer volume of fire.
Graydale Defense ATX10 "Ocelot" series Modular Sidearm System, burst pistol variant.
Equipped with a tubular magazine, this pistol unleashes a rapid burst of metal darts at an exceptionally high rate of fire.
Rule.Raw:
A short-range bullet-sprayer that compensates for its mediocre damage with sheer volume of fire.
Graydale Defense ATX10 "Ocelot" series Modular Sidearm System, burst pistol variant.
Equipped with a tubular magazine, this pistol unleashes a rapid burst of metal darts at an exceptionally high rate of fire.
Rule.Translated:
Un rociador de balas de corto alcance que compensa sus daños mediocres con un enorme volumen de fuego.
Sistema modular de armas secundarias de la serie ATX10 «Ocelot» de Graydale Defense, variante de pistola de ráfagas.
Equipada con un cargador tubular, esta pistola dispara una rápida ráfaga de dardos metálicos con una cadencia excepcionalmente alta.

Rule.Original:
A lightweight grenade launcher with a longer effective range than standard hand-thrown grenades.
Graydale Defense ATX10 "Ocelot" series Modular Sidearm System, grenade pistol variant.
Originally designed as a flare gun, it was quickly adapted to fire more lethal, explosive ammunition.
Rule.Raw:
A lightweight grenade launcher with a longer effective range than standard hand-thrown grenades.
Graydale Defense ATX10 "Ocelot" series Modular Sidearm System, grenade pistol variant.
Originally designed as a flare gun, it was quickly adapted to fire more lethal, explosive ammunition.
Rule.Translated:
Un lanzagranadas ligero con un alcance efectivo superior al de las granadas de mano normales.
Sistema modular de armas secundarias de la serie ATX10 «Ocelot» de Graydale Defense, variante de pistola lanzagranadas.
Se diseñó originalmente como pistola de bengalas, pero enseguida se adaptó para disparar munición explosiva más letal.

Rule.Original:
An advanced pistol with burst-fire capability and generally solid performance.
Graydale Defense ATX10-A "Arctic Ocelot" hybrid pistol.
As the most technologically advanced model in the Ocelot Modular Sidearm System, the "Arctic Ocelot" fires powerful armor-piercing projectiles using an electrochemical hybrid firing mechanism. Due to its integrated design, the hybrid pistol cannot be disassembled into a modular sidearm kit.
Rule.Raw:
An advanced pistol with burst-fire capability and generally solid performance.
Graydale Defense ATX10-A "Arctic Ocelot" hybrid pistol.
As the most technologically advanced model in the Ocelot Modular Sidearm System, the "Arctic Ocelot" fires powerful armor-piercing projectiles using an electrochemical hybrid firing mechanism. Due to its integrated design, the hybrid pistol cannot be disassembled into a modular sidearm kit.
Rule.Translated:
Una pistola avanzada capaz de disparar ráfagas y con buenas prestaciones generales.
Pistola híbrida ATX10-A «Arctic Ocelot» de Graydale Defense.
Como modelo más avanzado del sistema modular de armas secundarias Ocelot, la «Arctic Ocelot» dispara potentes proyectiles perforantes mediante un mecanismo de disparo híbrido electroquímico. Su diseño integrado impide desmontarla para obtener un kit modular de arma secundaria.

Rule.Original:
A carbine with solid close-quarters combat capabilities. When paired with a Modular Rifle System Kit, it can serve as the base for other MRS weapons built at a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, carbine variant.
This carbine is a capable close-quarters weapon in its own right, though it is often used as a foundation for constructing other MRS configurations. Its robust and straightforward design makes it a popular choice among security forces.
Rule.Raw:
A carbine with solid close-quarters combat capabilities. When paired with a Modular Rifle System Kit, it can serve as the base for other MRS weapons built at a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, carbine variant.
This carbine is a capable close-quarters weapon in its own right, though it is often used as a foundation for constructing other MRS configurations. Its robust and straightforward design makes it a popular choice among security forces.
Rule.Translated:
Una carabina con buenas prestaciones en combate cercano. Combinada con un kit de sistema de fusil modular, puede servir de base para fabricar otras armas MRS en una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale.
Sistema de fusil modular GEN6 de la serie ATR-12 «Panther» de Graydale Defense, variante de carabina.
Es un arma competente a corta distancia por sí sola, aunque a menudo se utiliza como base para otras configuraciones MRS. Su diseño robusto y sencillo la hace popular entre las fuerzas de seguridad.

Rule.Original:
A jack-of-all-trades assault rifle equipped with an underbarrel micro missile launcher. Can be disassembled into a modular carbine and rifle kit using components from a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, assault rifle variant.
A versatile rifle that uses caseless ammunition. Thanks to its rugged and straightforward design, this model is widely favored by colonial militias. The under-barrel micro-missile launcher enhances tactical versatility.
Rule.Raw:
A jack-of-all-trades assault rifle equipped with an underbarrel micro missile launcher. Can be disassembled into a modular carbine and rifle kit using components from a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, assault rifle variant.
A versatile rifle that uses caseless ammunition. Thanks to its rugged and straightforward design, this model is widely favored by colonial militias. The under-barrel micro-missile launcher enhances tactical versatility.
Rule.Translated:
Un fusil de asalto versátil con un lanzador de micromisiles bajo el cañón. Puede desmontarse para obtener una carabina modular y un kit de fusil mediante los componentes de una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale.
Sistema de fusil modular GEN6 de la serie ATR-12 «Panther» de Graydale Defense, variante de fusil de asalto.
Un fusil polivalente que utiliza munición sin vaina. Su diseño resistente y sencillo lo hace muy popular entre las milicias coloniales. El lanzador de micromisiles bajo el cañón aumenta su versatilidad táctica.

Rule.Original: Launch a micro missile to the target location.
Rule.Raw: Launch a micro missile to the target location.
Rule.Translated: Lanza un micromisil al lugar objetivo.

Rule.Original:
A lightweight sniper weapon with a relatively high rate of fire but low damage output. Well-suited for hit-and-run tactics. Can be disassembled into a modular carbine and DMR kit using components from a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, marksman rifle variant.
Designed for precision fire support, this marksman rifle offers fast follow-up shots and reliable accuracy. It also serves as an effective tool for hunting in the field.
Rule.Raw:
A lightweight sniper weapon with a relatively high rate of fire but low damage output. Well-suited for hit-and-run tactics. Can be disassembled into a modular carbine and DMR kit using components from a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, marksman rifle variant.
Designed for precision fire support, this marksman rifle offers fast follow-up shots and reliable accuracy. It also serves as an effective tool for hunting in the field.
Rule.Translated:
Un arma ligera de francotirador con una cadencia relativamente alta, pero pocos daños. Es adecuada para tácticas de ataque y retirada. Puede desmontarse para obtener una carabina modular y un kit DMR mediante los componentes de una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale.
Sistema de fusil modular GEN6 de la serie ATR-12 «Panther» de Graydale Defense, variante de fusil de tirador.
Diseñado para proporcionar apoyo de fuego preciso, permite encadenar disparos rápidamente con una precisión fiable. También es eficaz para cazar sobre el terreno.

Rule.Original:
An automatic weapon with greater range than a standard LMG. While it fires more rounds per burst than an assault rifle, its sustained fire rate limits its role to support engagements. Can be disassembled into a modular carbine and LMG kit using components from a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, light machine gun variant.
A sturdy and reliable LMG, this weapon excels in providing continuous suppressive fire in support of assault troops.
Rule.Raw:
An automatic weapon with greater range than a standard LMG. While it fires more rounds per burst than an assault rifle, its sustained fire rate limits its role to support engagements. Can be disassembled into a modular carbine and LMG kit using components from a Graydale equipment assembly facility.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6, light machine gun variant.
A sturdy and reliable LMG, this weapon excels in providing continuous suppressive fire in support of assault troops.
Rule.Translated:
Un arma automática con más alcance que una LMG estándar. Aunque dispara más proyectiles por ráfaga que un fusil de asalto, su cadencia sostenida limita su función al apoyo. Puede desmontarse para obtener una carabina modular y un kit LMG mediante los componentes de una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale.
Sistema de fusil modular GEN6 de la serie ATR-12 «Panther» de Graydale Defense, variante de ametralladora ligera.
Una LMG robusta y fiable que destaca al proporcionar fuego de supresión continuo en apoyo de las tropas de asalto.

Rule.Original:
A general-purpose advanced rifle. It offers superior armor-piercing capability and a higher burst count than a standard charge rifle, though it falls short in raw damage and stopping power.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6 Mod.5 "Desert Panther", hybrid rifle variant.
Unlike other Panther MRS models, the Desert Panther features an additional firing mechanism to enhance firepower and armor penetration. Its electromagnetic induction barrel accelerates projectiles to hypersonic speeds, making it highly effective against armored targets.
Rule.Raw:
A general-purpose advanced rifle. It offers superior armor-piercing capability and a higher burst count than a standard charge rifle, though it falls short in raw damage and stopping power.
Graydale Defense ATR-12 "Panther" series Modular Rifle System GEN6 Mod.5 "Desert Panther", hybrid rifle variant.
Unlike other Panther MRS models, the Desert Panther features an additional firing mechanism to enhance firepower and armor penetration. Its electromagnetic induction barrel accelerates projectiles to hypersonic speeds, making it highly effective against armored targets.
Rule.Translated:
Un fusil avanzado de uso general. Tiene mayor capacidad de perforación de blindaje y dispara más proyectiles por ráfaga que un fusil de carga estándar, aunque causa menos daños y tiene menor poder de parada.
Sistema de fusil modular GEN6 de la serie ATR-12 «Panther» de Graydale Defense, Mod.5 «Desert Panther», variante de fusil híbrido.
A diferencia de otros modelos Panther MRS, el Desert Panther incorpora un mecanismo de disparo adicional para mejorar su potencia de fuego y penetración. Su cañón de inducción electromagnética acelera los proyectiles a velocidades hipersónicas, lo que lo hace muy eficaz contra objetivos blindados.

Rule.Original:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons available, the Jaguar multi-launcher is both reliable and highly effective. Its configuration can be easily adjusted at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. When firing fragmentation grenades over long distances, it can become a serious threat—especially in enemy hands.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Fragmentation Grenade Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Raw:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons available, the Jaguar multi-launcher is both reliable and highly effective. Its configuration can be easily adjusted at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. When firing fragmentation grenades over long distances, it can become a serious threat—especially in enemy hands.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Fragmentation Grenade Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Translated:
El multilanzador Jaguar es una de las armas de apoyo de fuego más versátiles: fiable y muy eficaz. Su configuración puede ajustarse fácilmente en una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale. Al disparar granadas de fragmentación a larga distancia, puede convertirse en una amenaza seria, sobre todo en manos enemigas.
Lanzador de apoyo polivalente GMG31 «Jaguar» de Graydale Defense: configuración de granadas de fragmentación.
Configuraciones disponibles:
Fragmentación: configuración predeterminada. Causa pocos daños en una zona amplia.
Postas: configuración de combate cercano. Dispara una dispersión de postas para enfrentamientos a corta distancia.
Incendiaria: causa daños por fuego y prende a los objetivos.
Humo: no letal. Crea una cortina de humo en la zona objetivo.

Rule.Original:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons in the field, the Jaguar multi-launcher is both reliable and effective. Its settings can be easily reconfigured at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. In its incendiary mode, it launches fire grenades at long range—perfect for area denial or flushing out entrenched enemies. Simple, effective, and dangerous.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Incendiary Grenade Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Raw:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons in the field, the Jaguar multi-launcher is both reliable and effective. Its settings can be easily reconfigured at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. In its incendiary mode, it launches fire grenades at long range—perfect for area denial or flushing out entrenched enemies. Simple, effective, and dangerous.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Incendiary Grenade Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Translated:
El multilanzador Jaguar es una de las armas de apoyo de fuego más versátiles del campo de batalla: fiable y eficaz. Puede reconfigurarse fácilmente en una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale. En modo incendiario lanza granadas de fuego a larga distancia, perfectas para impedir el acceso a zonas o sacar a enemigos atrincherados. Sencillo, eficaz y peligroso.
Lanzador de apoyo polivalente GMG31 «Jaguar» de Graydale Defense: configuración de granadas incendiarias.
Configuraciones disponibles:
Fragmentación: configuración predeterminada. Causa pocos daños en una zona amplia.
Postas: configuración de combate cercano. Dispara una dispersión de postas para enfrentamientos a corta distancia.
Incendiaria: causa daños por fuego y prende a los objetivos.
Humo: no letal. Crea una cortina de humo en la zona objetivo.

Rule.Original:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons available, the Jaguar multi-launcher is a reliable and effective tool on the battlefield. Its firing mode can be easily reconfigured at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. In smoke grenade mode, it is typically deployed to provide concealment for allied forces or to disrupt enemy targeting and line of sight.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Smoke Grenade Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Raw:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons available, the Jaguar multi-launcher is a reliable and effective tool on the battlefield. Its firing mode can be easily reconfigured at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. In smoke grenade mode, it is typically deployed to provide concealment for allied forces or to disrupt enemy targeting and line of sight.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Smoke Grenade Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Translated:
El multilanzador Jaguar es una de las armas de apoyo de fuego más versátiles: una herramienta fiable y eficaz en el campo de batalla. Su modo de disparo puede reconfigurarse fácilmente en una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale. En modo de granadas de humo suele utilizarse para ocultar a las fuerzas aliadas o dificultar el apuntado y la línea de visión del enemigo.
Lanzador de apoyo polivalente GMG31 «Jaguar» de Graydale Defense: configuración de granadas de humo.
Configuraciones disponibles:
Fragmentación: configuración predeterminada. Causa pocos daños en una zona amplia.
Postas: configuración de combate cercano. Dispara una dispersión de postas para enfrentamientos a corta distancia.
Incendiaria: causa daños por fuego y prende a los objetivos.
Humo: no letal. Crea una cortina de humo en la zona objetivo.

Rule.Original:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons in deployment, the Jaguar multi-launcher is a reliable and effective battlefield asset. Its firing mode can be easily reconfigured at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. Unlike the other settings that launch explosive canisters, this mode fires a blast of buckshot, making it highly effective in close-quarters combat.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Buckshot Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Raw:
One of the most versatile fire support weapons in deployment, the Jaguar multi-launcher is a reliable and effective battlefield asset. Its firing mode can be easily reconfigured at a Graydale equipment assembly facility. Unlike the other settings that launch explosive canisters, this mode fires a blast of buckshot, making it highly effective in close-quarters combat.
Graydale Defense GMG31 "Jaguar" Multi-Purpose Support Launcher – Buckshot Setting
Available Settings:
Frag: Default setting. Low damage, affects a wide area.
Buckshot: Close-quarters combat setting. Fires a spread of buckshot for short-range engagements.
Incendiary: Deals flame damage and ignites targets.
Smoke: Non-lethal. Creates a smoke screen over the target area.
Rule.Translated:
El multilanzador Jaguar es una de las armas de apoyo de fuego más versátiles: un recurso fiable y eficaz en el campo de batalla. Su modo de disparo puede reconfigurarse fácilmente en una instalación de ensamblaje de equipo de Graydale. A diferencia de otras configuraciones que lanzan cargas explosivas, esta dispara una descarga de postas muy eficaz en combate cercano.
Lanzador de apoyo polivalente GMG31 «Jaguar» de Graydale Defense: configuración de postas.
Configuraciones disponibles:
Fragmentación: configuración predeterminada. Causa pocos daños en una zona amplia.
Postas: configuración de combate cercano. Dispara una dispersión de postas para enfrentamientos a corta distancia.
Incendiaria: causa daños por fuego y prende a los objetivos.
Humo: no letal. Crea una cortina de humo en la zona objetivo.

Rule.Original:
A heavy battle rifle with high damage and top-notch armor-piercing capability. It has low accuracy and a slow rate of fire.
Jotun Interstellar JG-1421 "Hrunting" ULM (Ultra-density Liquefied Metal) rifle.
Manufactured by Jotun Interstellar, this weapon fires molten metal as ammunition. The designer of the Hrunting never concerned himself with trivial matters like ergonomics—his sole focus was raw firepower.
Rule.Raw:
A heavy battle rifle with high damage and top-notch armor-piercing capability. It has low accuracy and a slow rate of fire.
Jotun Interstellar JG-1421 "Hrunting" ULM (Ultra-density Liquefied Metal) rifle.
Manufactured by Jotun Interstellar, this weapon fires molten metal as ammunition. The designer of the Hrunting never concerned himself with trivial matters like ergonomics—his sole focus was raw firepower.
Rule.Translated:
Un fusil de combate pesado con grandes daños y una capacidad de perforación de blindaje de primera categoría. Tiene poca precisión y una cadencia lenta.
Fusil ULM (metal licuado de ultradensidad) JG-1421 «Hrunting» de Jotun Interstellar.
Esta arma fabricada por Jotun Interstellar utiliza metal fundido como munición. El diseñador de la Hrunting nunca se preocupó por asuntos triviales como la ergonomía: su único interés era la potencia de fuego bruta.

Rule.Original:
A heavy pistol with great firepower and strong armor-piercing capability.
Jotun Interstellar JP-1844 "Trollsverd" ULM (Ultra-density Liquefied Metal) pistol.
Firing molten metal as projectiles, a single shot from the Trollsverd can solve most of the problems faced by lonely frontier colonies.
Rule.Raw:
A heavy pistol with great firepower and strong armor-piercing capability.
Jotun Interstellar JP-1844 "Trollsverd" ULM (Ultra-density Liquefied Metal) pistol.
Firing molten metal as projectiles, a single shot from the Trollsverd can solve most of the problems faced by lonely frontier colonies.
Rule.Translated:
Una pistola pesada con gran potencia de fuego y una fuerte capacidad de perforación de blindaje.
Pistola ULM (metal licuado de ultradensidad) JP-1844 «Trollsverd» de Jotun Interstellar.
Dispara metal fundido como proyectiles. Un solo disparo de la Trollsverd puede resolver la mayoría de los problemas de las colonias solitarias de la frontera.

Rule.Original:
A heavy shotgun with excellent armor-piercing capability. If you need to deal with heavily armored targets at close range, this will be one of the best options.
Jotun Interstellar JH-918 "Fafnir" ULM (Ultra-density Liquefied Metal) snub cannon.
This oversized shotgun—crafted from a sawed-off anti-aircraft gun barrel—is designed for combating mechanoids in urban warfare. If a person were to accidentally take a burst from this siege weapon, they would be instantly reduced to a sticky red mist.
Rule.Raw:
A heavy shotgun with excellent armor-piercing capability. If you need to deal with heavily armored targets at close range, this will be one of the best options.
Jotun Interstellar JH-918 "Fafnir" ULM (Ultra-density Liquefied Metal) snub cannon.
This oversized shotgun—crafted from a sawed-off anti-aircraft gun barrel—is designed for combating mechanoids in urban warfare. If a person were to accidentally take a burst from this siege weapon, they would be instantly reduced to a sticky red mist.
Rule.Translated:
Una escopeta pesada con excelente capacidad de perforación de blindaje. Si necesitas enfrentarte a objetivos muy blindados a corta distancia, es una de las mejores opciones.
Cañón corto ULM (metal licuado de ultradensidad) JH-918 «Fafnir» de Jotun Interstellar.
Esta escopeta descomunal, construida a partir de un cañón antiaéreo recortado, está diseñada para combatir mecanoides en guerras urbanas. Si una persona recibe por accidente una ráfaga de esta arma de asedio, quedará reducida al instante a una pegajosa niebla roja.

Rule.Original:
A super-heavy anti-materiel rifle. With extreme firepower and long range, it can engage most targets from a safe distance. However, due to its terrible rate of fire and staggering mass, it’s not suited for hit-and-run tactics.
Jotun Interstellar JG-330 "Gramr" Anti-Mechanoid rifle.
As heavy as a small truck and just as unwieldy, the recoil from a Gramr hits like a mule's kick. But its firepower justifies everything.
Rule.Raw:
A super-heavy anti-materiel rifle. With extreme firepower and long range, it can engage most targets from a safe distance. However, due to its terrible rate of fire and staggering mass, it’s not suited for hit-and-run tactics.
Jotun Interstellar JG-330 "Gramr" Anti-Mechanoid rifle.
As heavy as a small truck and just as unwieldy, the recoil from a Gramr hits like a mule's kick. But its firepower justifies everything.
Rule.Translated:
Un fusil antimaterial superpesado. Su enorme potencia de fuego y largo alcance le permiten atacar a la mayoría de los objetivos desde una distancia segura. Sin embargo, su pésima cadencia y su masa descomunal lo hacen poco adecuado para tácticas de ataque y retirada.
Fusil antimecanoide JG-330 «Gramr» de Jotun Interstellar.
Tan pesado como un pequeño camión e igual de poco manejable, el retroceso de la Gramr golpea como una coz de mula. Pero su potencia de fuego lo justifica todo.

Rule.Original:
A portable, short-range, multiple explosive metal ball launcher. Effective against massed troops and fixed targets. Well, not much else to say.
Jotun Interstellar JR-702 "Grendel" assault launcher.
A legacy of the grim mechanoid wars, Jotun Interstellar’s "Grendel" siege gun is one of the most devastating man-portable siege weapons in the galaxy. It fires super-cooled liquid metal projectiles that instantly solidify upon impact, creating a violent explosion of metal shrapnel.
Rule.Raw:
A portable, short-range, multiple explosive metal ball launcher. Effective against massed troops and fixed targets. Well, not much else to say.
Jotun Interstellar JR-702 "Grendel" assault launcher.
A legacy of the grim mechanoid wars, Jotun Interstellar’s "Grendel" siege gun is one of the most devastating man-portable siege weapons in the galaxy. It fires super-cooled liquid metal projectiles that instantly solidify upon impact, creating a violent explosion of metal shrapnel.
Rule.Translated:
Un lanzador portátil de múltiples bolas metálicas explosivas de corto alcance. Eficaz contra tropas concentradas y objetivos fijos. Bueno, no hay mucho más que decir.
Lanzador de asalto JR-702 «Grendel» de Jotun Interstellar.
Legado de las terribles guerras mecanoides, el cañón de asedio «Grendel» es una de las armas de asedio portátiles más devastadoras de la galaxia. Dispara proyectiles de metal líquido superenfriado que se solidifican al impactar y provocan una violenta explosión de metralla metálica.

Rule.Original:
An automatic weapon with high stopping power. While its long bursts leave the user vulnerable, it is well-suited for delaying enemy advances.
Jotun Interstellar JM-7912 "Muspell" fragment discharger.
The "Muspell" suppressor cannon is Jotun Interstellar’s answer to swarms of small "militor"-type mechanoids. It ceaselessly fires superheated metal fragments.
Rule.Raw:
An automatic weapon with high stopping power. While its long bursts leave the user vulnerable, it is well-suited for delaying enemy advances.
Jotun Interstellar JM-7912 "Muspell" fragment discharger.
The "Muspell" suppressor cannon is Jotun Interstellar’s answer to swarms of small "militor"-type mechanoids. It ceaselessly fires superheated metal fragments.
Rule.Translated:
Un arma automática con gran poder de parada. Aunque sus largas ráfagas dejan al usuario expuesto, resulta adecuada para retrasar el avance enemigo.
Descargador de fragmentos JM-7912 «Muspell» de Jotun Interstellar.
El cañón de supresión «Muspell» es la respuesta de Jotun Interstellar a los enjambres de pequeños mecanoides de tipo «militor». Dispara sin descanso fragmentos metálicos sobrecalentados.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Disposable Microwave Emitting Device Model 91u “BaegYa” (White Night) No flames. Just panic.
The Model 91u “BaegYa” is a compact, single-use microwave emitter engineered for rapid crowd suppression and area denial. Upon activation, it unleashes a burst of focused millimeter waves that ignite the pain receptors of organic targets—simulating the sensation of being set on fire, without generating actual combustion.
Completely inert against machines and armor plating, BaegYa is designed to disorient, scatter, and demoralize unshielded hostiles in seconds.
Yeonhwa Precision: Pain Is a Message. We Deliver It Clearly.
Rule.Raw:
Yeonhwa Precision Disposable Microwave Emitting Device Model 91u “BaegYa” (White Night) No flames. Just panic.
The Model 91u “BaegYa” is a compact, single-use microwave emitter engineered for rapid crowd suppression and area denial. Upon activation, it unleashes a burst of focused millimeter waves that ignite the pain receptors of organic targets—simulating the sensation of being set on fire, without generating actual combustion.
Completely inert against machines and armor plating, BaegYa is designed to disorient, scatter, and demoralize unshielded hostiles in seconds.
Yeonhwa Precision: Pain Is a Message. We Deliver It Clearly.
Rule.Translated:
Emisor de microondas desechable de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 91u «BaegYa» (Noche blanca). Sin llamas. Solo pánico.
El modelo 91u «BaegYa» es un emisor de microondas compacto de un solo uso, diseñado para suprimir rápidamente multitudes e impedir el acceso a zonas. Al activarse, libera una descarga de ondas milimétricas concentradas que estimulan los receptores del dolor de los objetivos orgánicos y simulan la sensación de arder sin provocar una combustión real.
Completamente ineficaz contra máquinas y placas de blindaje, el BaegYa está diseñado para desorientar, dispersar y desmoralizar en segundos a los enemigos sin protección.
Yeonhwa Precision: el dolor es un mensaje. Lo transmitimos con claridad.

Rule.Original: A "Dunder" Satchel charge. Combat engineer's best friend.
Rule.Raw: A "Dunder" Satchel charge. Combat engineer's best friend.
Rule.Translated: Una carga de demolición «Dunder». La mejor amiga del ingeniero de combate.

Rule.Original: "Bobcat" mini grenades. Their small size allows for carrying a considerable number.
Rule.Raw: "Bobcat" mini grenades. Their small size allows for carrying a considerable number.
Rule.Translated: Minigranadas «Bobcat». Su pequeño tamaño permite llevar una cantidad considerable.

Rule.Original: When it explodes, the "Grief" impact grenade releases a graviton shockwave. Although its damage is low, movement within the grenade’s explosion radius is severely restricted.
Rule.Raw: When it explodes, the "Grief" impact grenade releases a graviton shockwave. Although its damage is low, movement within the grenade’s explosion radius is severely restricted.
Rule.Translated: Al explotar, la granada de impacto «Grief» libera una onda de choque de gravitones. Aunque causa pocos daños, el movimiento dentro de su radio de explosión queda muy limitado.

Rule.Original: The "Sabertooth" combat blade by Greydale Defence. Effective for chopping down trees or severing enemy limbs.
Rule.Raw: The "Sabertooth" combat blade by Greydale Defence. Effective for chopping down trees or severing enemy limbs.
Rule.Translated: La hoja de combate «Sabertooth» de Greydale Defence. Eficaz para talar árboles o cercenar miembros enemigos.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Vibro-Dagger Model 1q “BingJu” (Ice Pillar)
The last sound they’ll never hear.
The Model 1q “BingJu” is a lightweight, high-frequency vibro-dagger engineered for close-quarters elimination. Forged from ultra-sharp crystalline composite alloys and honed to molecular precision, it vibrates at frequencies capable of severing flesh, fiber, and light armor with minimal resistance.
Standard issue for operatives in Yeonhwa Precision’s Aggressive Marketing Division, the BingJu is favored not only for its compact profile and lethality, but for the silence with which it operates. Where bullets are too loud and witnesses too inconvenient, the BingJu excels.
Yeonhwa Precision: Efficiency Has an Edge.
Rule.Raw:
Yeonhwa Precision Vibro-Dagger Model 1q “BingJu” (Ice Pillar)
The last sound they’ll never hear.
The Model 1q “BingJu” is a lightweight, high-frequency vibro-dagger engineered for close-quarters elimination. Forged from ultra-sharp crystalline composite alloys and honed to molecular precision, it vibrates at frequencies capable of severing flesh, fiber, and light armor with minimal resistance.
Standard issue for operatives in Yeonhwa Precision’s Aggressive Marketing Division, the BingJu is favored not only for its compact profile and lethality, but for the silence with which it operates. Where bullets are too loud and witnesses too inconvenient, the BingJu excels.
Yeonhwa Precision: Efficiency Has an Edge.
Rule.Translated:
Vibrodaga de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 1q «BingJu» (Pilar de hielo).
El último sonido que nunca oirán.
El modelo 1q «BingJu» es una vibrodaga ligera de alta frecuencia diseñada para eliminar objetivos a corta distancia. Está forjada con aleaciones compuestas cristalinas ultrafiladas y afilada con precisión molecular. Vibra a frecuencias capaces de cortar carne, fibras y blindajes ligeros con una resistencia mínima.
Es el equipo estándar de los agentes de la División de Marketing Agresivo de Yeonhwa Precision. La BingJu destaca por su tamaño compacto y su letalidad, pero también por el silencio con el que actúa. Donde las balas hacen demasiado ruido y los testigos resultan demasiado incómodos, la BingJu sobresale.
Yeonhwa Precision: la eficiencia tiene filo.

Rule.Original: The "Ormbane" is a massive combat sledgehammer manufactured by Jotun Interstellar.
Rule.Raw: The "Ormbane" is a massive combat sledgehammer manufactured by Jotun Interstellar.
Rule.Translated: El «Ormbane» es un enorme martillo de combate fabricado por Jotun Interstellar.

Rule.Original:
A knuckle weapon with fast attack speed. It can knock enemies out momentarily.
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-5 "Eris" close-range kinetic energy discharger.
Because some things deserve a personal touch.
The Eris is a high-speed knuckle-mounted kinetic discharger that delivers a focused shockwave on contact—enough to knock targets unconscious, or worse, depending on how personal things have gotten. Lightweight, brutal, and utterly satisfying, it was designed by the Tisiphone Enterprise Hunter Contingent—an outfit dedicated to the extermination of surviving Federation remnants, and not especially concerned with subtlety.
Why knuckles? Because nothing quite matches the satisfaction of punching a Federation soldier to death with your own hands
Rule.Raw:
A knuckle weapon with fast attack speed. It can knock enemies out momentarily.
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-5 "Eris" close-range kinetic energy discharger.
Because some things deserve a personal touch.
The Eris is a high-speed knuckle-mounted kinetic discharger that delivers a focused shockwave on contact—enough to knock targets unconscious, or worse, depending on how personal things have gotten. Lightweight, brutal, and utterly satisfying, it was designed by the Tisiphone Enterprise Hunter Contingent—an outfit dedicated to the extermination of surviving Federation remnants, and not especially concerned with subtlety.
Why knuckles? Because nothing quite matches the satisfaction of punching a Federation soldier to death with your own hands
Rule.Translated:
Un arma de nudillos con una velocidad de ataque rápida. Puede dejar inconscientes a los enemigos durante un momento.
Descargador de energía cinética de corto alcance Type-5 «Eris» de Tisiphone Enterprise.
Porque algunas cosas merecen un trato personal.
El Eris es un descargador cinético de alta velocidad montado en los nudillos que transmite una onda de choque concentrada al contacto, suficiente para dejar inconsciente al objetivo o algo peor, según lo personal que se haya vuelto el asunto. Ligero, brutal y profundamente satisfactorio, fue diseñado por el Contingente de Cazadores de Tisiphone Enterprise, dedicado a exterminar los remanentes de la Federación y poco preocupado por la sutileza.
¿Por qué los nudillos? Porque nada iguala la satisfacción de matar a puñetazos a un soldado de la Federación con tus propias manos.

Rule.Original: The "Purifier" torch sword is a high-capacity plasma torch featuring both a grip and blade. It attacks in one of three modes at random: armor-piercing focus mode, dispersion mode for heavy damage, or incineration mode for fire damage.
Rule.Raw: The "Purifier" torch sword is a high-capacity plasma torch featuring both a grip and blade. It attacks in one of three modes at random: armor-piercing focus mode, dispersion mode for heavy damage, or incineration mode for fire damage.
Rule.Translated: La espada soplete «Purifier» es un soplete de plasma de alta capacidad con empuñadura y hoja. Ataca aleatoriamente en uno de tres modos: concentración perforante, dispersión para causar grandes daños o incineración para causar daños por fuego.

Rule.Original:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-3 "Tyrant" kinetic blast rifle.
It doesn’t kill cleanly. That’s the point.
The Tyrant is the standard-issue rifle of the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent—built for close-quarters combat and designed with one purpose: deliver blunt-force trauma at high speed and with zero remorse. Firing high-velocity kinetic slugs that hit like a sledgehammer, the Tyrant trades range and raw damage for a brutally efficient firing cycle with rock-hard stopping power.
It’s paired with a cutting-edge targeting system for rapid acquisition and active tracking—because when you’re hunting Federation stragglers through the ruins of their sins, hesitation isn’t just dangerous. It’s disrespectful.
Rule.Raw:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-3 "Tyrant" kinetic blast rifle.
It doesn’t kill cleanly. That’s the point.
The Tyrant is the standard-issue rifle of the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent—built for close-quarters combat and designed with one purpose: deliver blunt-force trauma at high speed and with zero remorse. Firing high-velocity kinetic slugs that hit like a sledgehammer, the Tyrant trades range and raw damage for a brutally efficient firing cycle with rock-hard stopping power.
It’s paired with a cutting-edge targeting system for rapid acquisition and active tracking—because when you’re hunting Federation stragglers through the ruins of their sins, hesitation isn’t just dangerous. It’s disrespectful.
Rule.Translated:
Fusil de descarga cinética Type-3 «Tyrant» de Tisiphone Enterprise.
No mata limpiamente. Esa es la idea.
El Tyrant es el fusil estándar del Contingente de Cazadores de Tisiphone. Está construido para el combate cercano y tiene un único propósito: causar traumatismos contundentes a gran velocidad y sin remordimientos. Dispara proyectiles cinéticos de alta velocidad que golpean como un mazo y sacrifica alcance y daños brutos a cambio de un ciclo de disparo brutalmente eficaz y un poder de parada tremendo.
Incorpora un sistema de apuntado de última generación para adquirir objetivos rápidamente y seguirlos de forma activa. Porque cuando persigues a rezagados de la Federación entre las ruinas de sus pecados, dudar no solo es peligroso: es una falta de respeto.

Rule.Original:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-6 “Tormentor” Kinetic Blast Pistol
Quick. Cruel. Personal.
The Tormentor is the standard-issue sidearm of the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent—a hair-rising fast kinetic pistol designed for close-range ambushes, executions, and anything else that requires both speed and spite. With an exceptionally short firing cycle—even by pistol standards—it excels in hit-and-run engagements where every fraction of a millisecond counts. It delivers blunt-force kinetic trauma with high stopping power, making it less of a sidearm and more of a pocket-sized vendetta.
Rule.Raw:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-6 “Tormentor” Kinetic Blast Pistol
Quick. Cruel. Personal.
The Tormentor is the standard-issue sidearm of the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent—a hair-rising fast kinetic pistol designed for close-range ambushes, executions, and anything else that requires both speed and spite. With an exceptionally short firing cycle—even by pistol standards—it excels in hit-and-run engagements where every fraction of a millisecond counts. It delivers blunt-force kinetic trauma with high stopping power, making it less of a sidearm and more of a pocket-sized vendetta.
Rule.Translated:
Pistola de descarga cinética Type-6 «Tormentor» de Tisiphone Enterprise.
Rápida. Cruel. Personal.
La Tormentor es el arma secundaria estándar del Contingente de Cazadores de Tisiphone: una pistola cinética de rapidez escalofriante, diseñada para emboscadas cercanas, ejecuciones y cualquier otra tarea que requiera velocidad y rencor. Su ciclo de disparo es excepcionalmente corto incluso para una pistola, por lo que destaca en enfrentamientos de ataque y retirada donde cuenta cada fracción de milisegundo. Provoca traumatismos cinéticos contundentes con un gran poder de parada, de modo que resulta menos un arma secundaria que una venganza de bolsillo.

Rule.Original:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-11 “Oppressor” Kinetic Canister Launcher
For when there’s too many of them, and not enough of you.
The Oppressor is Tisiphone’s answer to crowd control—assuming the crowd isn’t meant to survive. Firing charged kinetic canisters that detonate in area-blast shockwaves, it’s a close-range weapon by design, but don’t let that fool you: it remains deadly even at its farthest reach.
The Oppressor doesn’t care much about precision. And why should it? Accuracy is a concern when you're aiming at a person. The Oppressor is aimed at problems—plural. It sends a message to massed Federation auxiliaries, swarming Seekers, and anything else foolish enough to cluster.
Loudly. Repeatedly. Permanently
Rule.Raw:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-11 “Oppressor” Kinetic Canister Launcher
For when there’s too many of them, and not enough of you.
The Oppressor is Tisiphone’s answer to crowd control—assuming the crowd isn’t meant to survive. Firing charged kinetic canisters that detonate in area-blast shockwaves, it’s a close-range weapon by design, but don’t let that fool you: it remains deadly even at its farthest reach.
The Oppressor doesn’t care much about precision. And why should it? Accuracy is a concern when you're aiming at a person. The Oppressor is aimed at problems—plural. It sends a message to massed Federation auxiliaries, swarming Seekers, and anything else foolish enough to cluster.
Loudly. Repeatedly. Permanently
Rule.Translated:
Lanzador de cargas cinéticas Type-11 «Oppressor» de Tisiphone Enterprise.
Para cuando ellos son demasiados y vosotros demasiado pocos.
El Oppressor es la respuesta de Tisiphone al control de multitudes, siempre que no se espere que la multitud sobreviva. Dispara cargas cinéticas que detonan en ondas de choque de área. Está pensado para distancias cortas, pero no te engañes: sigue siendo letal incluso en el límite de su alcance.
Al Oppressor no le preocupa demasiado la precisión. ¿Y por qué debería? La precisión importa cuando apuntas a una persona. El Oppressor apunta a problemas, en plural. Envía un mensaje a los auxiliares de la Federación concentrados, los enjambres de Buscadores y cualquier otro objetivo lo bastante insensato como para agruparse.
Con estruendo. Repetidamente. Para siempre.

Rule.Original:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-4 “Wailer” Kinetic Blast Rifle
Sniper rifles are supposed to be patient. The Wailer is not.
The Wailer is a fast-firing kinetic marksman rifle engineered for one job: outshoot the Federation’s finest before they finish exhaling. Built for rapid counter-sniper operations, it combines high stopping power with blisteringly fast target acquisition—unusual for its class, and deeply unpleasant for anything downrange. Rather than vaporize its targets, the Wailer prefers to break them apart—bone, armor, and confidence included. Blunt-force slugs. Rage in physical form. Fired fast enough to erase the idea of a fair fight.
Rule.Raw:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-4 “Wailer” Kinetic Blast Rifle
Sniper rifles are supposed to be patient. The Wailer is not.
The Wailer is a fast-firing kinetic marksman rifle engineered for one job: outshoot the Federation’s finest before they finish exhaling. Built for rapid counter-sniper operations, it combines high stopping power with blisteringly fast target acquisition—unusual for its class, and deeply unpleasant for anything downrange. Rather than vaporize its targets, the Wailer prefers to break them apart—bone, armor, and confidence included. Blunt-force slugs. Rage in physical form. Fired fast enough to erase the idea of a fair fight.
Rule.Translated:
Fusil de descarga cinética Type-4 «Wailer» de Tisiphone Enterprise.
Se supone que los fusiles de francotirador son pacientes. El Wailer no lo es.
El Wailer es un fusil cinético de tirador de disparo rápido diseñado para una sola tarea: superar a los mejores de la Federación antes de que terminen de exhalar. Preparado para operaciones rápidas contra francotiradores, combina un gran poder de parada con una adquisición de objetivos vertiginosa, algo poco habitual en su categoría y muy desagradable para cualquier cosa que esté delante. En lugar de vaporizar a sus objetivos, prefiere hacerlos pedazos, incluidos sus huesos, su blindaje y su confianza. Proyectiles contundentes. Furia hecha materia. Disparados tan deprisa que borran la idea de una pelea justa.

Rule.Original:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-22 “Atrocity” Area Suppression System
It doesn’t kill quickly. That’s what makes it cruel.
The Atrocity is an area suppression weapon designed not to eliminate enemies, but to break their momentum, scatter their ranks, and remind them they’re not in control. Firing concentrated volleys of low-damage kinetic blasts, it slows movement, distorts formations, and grinds assaults to a halt. It’s not an assault weapon. It’s a disciplinary tool—with range. Feared more for what it denies than what it destroys, the Atrocity earned its name the honest way: through long minutes of confusion, pain, and frustration, delivered in kinetic blasts.

Firing concentrated volleys of low-damage kinetic blasts, it slows movement, distorts formations, and grinds assaults to a halt. It’s not an assault weapon. It’s a disciplinary tool—with range. Feared more for what it denies than what it destroys, the Atrocity earned its name the honest way: through long minutes of confusion, pain, and frustration, delivered in kinetic blasts.
Rule.Translated:
Sistema de supresión de área Type-22 «Atrocity» de Tisiphone Enterprise.
No mata deprisa. Eso es lo que lo hace cruel.
El Atrocity es un arma de supresión de área diseñada para frenar el impulso de los enemigos, dispersar sus filas y recordarles que no tienen el control. Dispara salvas concentradas de descargas cinéticas de pocos daños que ralentizan el movimiento, desorganizan las formaciones y detienen los asaltos. No es un arma de asalto: es una herramienta disciplinaria con alcance. Más temida por lo que impide que por lo que destruye, se ganó su nombre de forma honesta: mediante largos minutos de confusión, dolor y frustración transmitidos por descargas cinéticas.

Rule.Original:
Tisiphone Enterprise Type-0 “Harrower” Directional Kinetic Wave Projector
Not built for survivability. Built for spite.
The Harrower is the blunt answer to the Federation’s mechsuits—a close-range kinetic lance that projects a continuous, focused shockwave capable of carving through composite armor and flaying flesh from bone. It doesn’t hit its targets. It unmakes them.
Unlike most Tisiphone weapons, it demands patience, positioning, and a disturbing level of proximity. Its short range and long charge-up time make it a liability in most engagements—until it fires. Then nothing matters.
Flesh is stripped. Armor is peeled. Mechsuits buckle. The Harrower was built as Tisiphone’s answer to the Federation’s towering war hulks, and it delivers that answer in one drawn-out, agonizing scream of kinetic violence.

Tisiphone Enterprise Type-0 “Harrower” Directional Kinetic Wave Projector

Rule.Translated:
Proyector de ondas cinéticas direccionales Type-0 «Harrower» de Tisiphone Enterprise.
Creado por rencor, sin pensar en la supervivencia.
El Harrower es la respuesta contundente a las armaduras mecanizadas de la Federación: una lanza cinética de corto alcance que proyecta una onda de choque continua y concentrada, capaz de atravesar blindajes compuestos y arrancar la carne de los huesos. No golpea a sus objetivos: los deshace.
A diferencia de la mayoría de las armas de Tisiphone, exige paciencia, una buena posición y una cercanía inquietante. Su corto alcance y largo tiempo de carga lo convierten en un lastre en muchos enfrentamientos... hasta que dispara. Entonces nada más importa.
La carne se desprende. El blindaje se pela. Las armaduras mecanizadas ceden. El Harrower fue creado como respuesta de Tisiphone a los enormes colosos de guerra de la Federación, y la transmite en un único grito prolongado y agónico de violencia cinética.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Shard Rifle Model 88c “SeoLi (Frost)”
Because suppression is cheaper than resolution.
An advanced close-quarters assault platform, the Model 88c “SeoLi” deploys high-velocity carbon-crystal shard projectiles at an exceptional rate of fire. While each individual round delivers minimal kinetic impact, the rifle’s sustained volume saturates targets with armor-piercing shards capable of overwhelming most modern personal defenses.
Engineered for urban suppression and zero-distance escalation, the SeoLi trades effective range and raw stopping power for absolute control of confined environments. Boasting an extended magazine and near-zero recoil profile, it excels in scenarios where hesitation means sure death.
Yeonhwa Precision: Efficiency is Eternal.

Yeonhwa Precision Shard Rifle Model 88c “SeoLi (Frost)”

Rule.Translated:
Fusil de esquirlas de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 88c «SeoLi (Escarcha)».
Porque reprimir sale más barato que resolver.
El modelo 88c «SeoLi» es una plataforma avanzada de asalto cercano que dispara esquirlas de cristal de carbono a gran velocidad y con una cadencia excepcional. Aunque cada proyectil produce un impacto cinético mínimo, su fuego sostenido satura a los objetivos con fragmentos perforantes capaces de superar la mayoría de las defensas personales modernas.
Diseñado para la supresión urbana y la escalada a distancia cero, el SeoLi sacrifica alcance efectivo y poder de parada bruto a cambio de un control absoluto de los espacios cerrados. Su cargador ampliado y su retroceso casi nulo lo hacen excelente cuando dudar significa una muerte segura.
Yeonhwa Precision: la eficiencia es eterna.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Mechanite Swarm Projector Model 1331a “SagPung” (Boreas)
You can run. You just won’t get far.
Designated for close-range termination, the Model 1331a “SagPung” delivers a precision-guided payload of autonomous mechanites. Unlike conventional scatter-based shotguns, the SagPung replaces brute force with clinical accuracy—releasing a dense, adaptive swarm that locks onto and relentlessly pursues its target.
Though its anti-armor performance is limited and its per-hit lethality modest, the SagPung compensates with its absolute hit certainty. No cover, no movement, no evasive measure escapes the swarm. It’s not designed to shatter steel—just to erase everything soft beneath it.
Yeonhwa Precision: The Future Bleeds Clean.

Rule.Translated:
Proyector de enjambres de mecanitos de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 1331a «SagPung» (Bóreas).
Puedes correr. No llegarás lejos.
Destinado a eliminar objetivos a corta distancia, el modelo 1331a «SagPung» lanza una carga de mecanitos autónomos guiada con precisión. A diferencia de las escopetas convencionales de dispersión, sustituye la fuerza bruta por precisión clínica: libera un enjambre denso y adaptable que fija su objetivo y lo persigue sin descanso.
Aunque su capacidad contra el blindaje es limitada y la letalidad de cada impacto modesta, lo compensa con una certeza absoluta de acertar. Ninguna cobertura, movimiento o maniobra evasiva permite escapar del enjambre. No está diseñado para romper el acero, sino para borrar todo lo blando que hay debajo.
Yeonhwa Precision: el futuro sangra con limpieza.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Explosive Crystalline Projectile Accelerator Model 723a “SangAe” (Frost Haze)
Pierce. Wait. Detonate.
The Model 723a “SangAe” delivers shaped crystalline spikes engineered from high-density explosive compound. Each projectile embeds into the target before a delayed micro-detonation—ensuring optimal penetration and internal devastation.
In contrast to traditional anti-armor platforms, the SangAe boasts a higher rate of fire, enabling sustained anti-material application without compromising mobility. Precision-charged and tactically efficient, it has become Yeonhwa Precision’s flagship answer to hardened threats across variable combat theaters.
Yeonhwa Precision: Nothing is Impervious.

Yeonhwa Precision: Nothing is Impervious.
Rule.Translated:
Acelerador de proyectiles cristalinos explosivos de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 723a «SangAe» (Bruma helada).
Perfora. Espera. Detona.
El modelo 723a «SangAe» dispara púas cristalinas moldeadas a partir de un compuesto explosivo de alta densidad. Cada proyectil se incrusta en el objetivo antes de una microdetonación retardada, lo que garantiza una penetración óptima y una devastación interna.
Frente a las plataformas antiblindaje tradicionales, el SangAe ofrece una mayor cadencia de disparo y permite una acción antimaterial sostenida sin comprometer la movilidad. Su carga precisa y su eficacia táctica lo han convertido en la respuesta principal de Yeonhwa Precision a las amenazas resistentes de diversos escenarios de combate.
Yeonhwa Precision: nada es impenetrable.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Hyper Rapid Shard Accelerator Model 61t “SeolHwa” (Snow Blossom)
Beauty. Velocity. Ruin.
Originally conceived as a personal defense platform, the Model 61t “SeolHwa” quickly transcended its design brief. Now infamous for its blistering fire rate, the SeolHwa has become a fixture in high-clearance incidents, silent purges, and executive-level resolutions.
It fires ultrathin 121㎛ crystalline shards that fracture on impact into razor-fine fractal splinters, maximizing internal trauma while minimizing over-penetration. Though its range is limited and stopping power low per round, its armor-piercing performance and volume of fire more than compensate in confined engagements.
Yeonhwa Precision: When Seconds Are Too Long.

Yeonhwa Precision: When Seconds Are Too Long.
Rule.Translated:
Acelerador de esquirlas ultrarrápido de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 61t «SeolHwa» (Flor de nieve).
Belleza. Velocidad. Ruina.
Concebido originalmente como plataforma de defensa personal, el modelo 61t «SeolHwa» superó pronto sus objetivos de diseño. Ahora es infame por su vertiginosa cadencia y habitual en incidentes de alta autorización, purgas silenciosas y resoluciones ejecutivas.
Dispara esquirlas cristalinas ultrafinas de 121㎛ que se fracturan al impactar en fragmentos fractales tan afilados como cuchillas, maximizando las lesiones internas y reduciendo la sobrepenetración. Aunque su alcance es limitado y el poder de parada de cada proyectil bajo, su capacidad perforante y volumen de fuego lo compensan de sobra en espacios cerrados.
Yeonhwa Precision: cuando los segundos son demasiado largos.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Microwave Emitter Model 7r “GeugGwang” (Aurora)
No blood. No mess. Just screaming.
The Model 7r “GeugGwang” is a long-range area denial and suppression system designed for non-lethal deterrence—at least in theory. Emitting tightly-focused millimeter waves, the weapon rapidly excites water molecules in exposed skin, inducing searing, incapacitating pain without causing permanent physical trauma.
While entirely ineffective against inorganic entities, the GeugGwang excels in breaking enemy formations, scattering crowds, and neutralizing biological threats without the administrative overhead of actual fatalities. Targets typically cease resistance in favor of extinguishing themselves.
Yeonhwa Precision: Control Without Consequence.

Emisor de microondas de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 7r «GeugGwang» (Aurora).
Sin sangre. Sin suciedad. Solo gritos.
El modelo 7r «GeugGwang» es un sistema de supresión y bloqueo de zonas de largo alcance diseñado para la disuasión no letal, al menos en teoría. Emite ondas milimétricas muy concentradas que excitan rápidamente las moléculas de agua de la piel expuesta y provocan un dolor abrasador e incapacitante sin causar lesiones físicas permanentes.
Aunque es totalmente ineficaz contra entidades inorgánicas, destaca al romper formaciones enemigas, dispersar multitudes y neutralizar amenazas biológicas sin los trámites administrativos de las muertes reales. Los objetivos suelen dejar de resistirse para intentar apagarse.
Yeonhwa Precision: control sin consecuencias.

Rule.Original:
Yeonhwa Precision Smart Projectile Launch System Model 2357b “NuRi” (Hail) Your walls are meaningless.
The Model 2357b “NuRi” is a precision indirect-fire weapon system engineered for dense, urban environments. Launching smart-guided submunitions on steep arcs, the NuRi can strike targets obscured by cover, barricades, or interior structures—with no line of sight required.
Equipped with a multispectral targeting suite and autonomous pathfinding logic, each bolt adjusts mid-flight to deliver targeted strikes with uncanny precision. However, its arcing trajectory demands open overhead clearance, rendering it unusable under subterranean ceilings.
Yeonhwa Precision: Nowhere Left to Hide.

Rule.Translated:
Sistema de lanzamiento de proyectiles inteligentes de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 2357b «NuRi» (Granizo). Tus muros no sirven de nada.
El modelo 2357b «NuRi» es un sistema preciso de fuego indirecto diseñado para entornos urbanos densos. Lanza submuniciones guiadas en arcos pronunciados y puede alcanzar objetivos ocultos tras coberturas, barricadas o estructuras interiores sin necesidad de línea de visión.
Su sistema de apuntado multiespectral y su lógica autónoma de búsqueda de rutas permiten que cada proyectil ajuste su trayectoria en pleno vuelo para impactar con una precisión extraordinaria. Sin embargo, la trayectoria arqueada exige espacio libre por encima, por lo que no puede utilizarse bajo techos subterráneos.
Yeonhwa Precision: no queda dónde esconderse.

Rule.Original:
Allows construction of a magnetic shield to protect electric devices in the entire colony from solar flares.
When idle, the shield requires a pittance of power to maintain it's detection circuits, ever ready to activate whenever a solar flare occurs. Should that happen, the shield will start drawing up to 25 kWt of power in order to form a semblance of localized magnetosphere, neutralizing the effect a solar flare would have on colony's electronics. Effective range of this protection is enough to cover the colony and then some.
Even reduced by the shield, excessive electromagnetic fluctuations caused by the flare will still render more sensitive devices like comms consoles inoperable.

Allows construction of a magnetic shield to protect electric devices in the entire colony from solar flares.
