Should that happen, the shield will start drawing up to 25 kWt of power in order to form a semblance of localized magnetosphere, neutralizing the effect a solar flare would have on colony's electronics. Effective range of this protection is enough to cover the colony and then some.
Even reduced by the shield, excessive electromagnetic fluctuations caused by the flare will still render more sensitive devices like comms consoles inoperable.
Rule.Translated:
Permite la construcción de un escudo magnético para proteger los dispositivos eléctricos de toda la colonia de las erupciones solares.

Cuando está inactivo, el escudo requiere una cantidad ínfima de energía para mantener sus circuitos de detección, siempre listos para activarse cuando se produzca una erupción solar. Si eso ocurre, el escudo empezará a consumir hasta 25 kWt de energía para formar una especie de magnetosfera localizada, neutralizando el efecto que una erupción solar tendría en la electrónica de la colonia. El alcance efectivo de esta protección es suficiente para cubrir la colonia y algo más.

Incluso reducidas por el escudo, las fluctuaciones electromagnéticas excesivas causadas por la llamarada seguirán inutilizando los dispositivos más sensibles, como las consolas de comunicaciones.

Rule.Original: Automatically switches on to protect the entire colony from a solar flare; tremendous power drain and considerable heating when operational.
Rule.Raw: Automatically switches on to protect the entire colony from a solar flare; tremendous power drain and considerable heating when operational.
Rule.Translated: Se enciende automáticamente para proteger a toda la colonia de una erupción solar; consume mucha energía y se calienta considerablemente cuando está en funcionamiento.

Rule.Original: Recycle apparel into their basic components.
Rule.Raw: Recycle apparel into their basic components.
Rule.Translated: Reciclar la ropa para recuperar sus componentes básicos.

Rule.Original: Crafts mending kits from materials. Produces enough to re-stock the mending table.
Rule.Raw: Crafts mending kits from materials. Produces enough to re-stock the mending table.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica kits de reparación a partir de materiales. Produce suficientes para reabastecer la mesa de reparación.

Rule.Original: A workbench equipped with all the tools required to mend and repair damaged items. Requires power and consumes mending kits. Mending kits can be made in the tailoring benches.
Rule.Raw: A workbench equipped with all the tools required to mend and repair damaged items. Requires power and consumes mending kits. Mending kits can be made in the tailoring benches.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de trabajo con todas las herramientas necesarias para arreglar y reparar objetos dañados. Necesita electricidad y consume kits de reparación, que pueden fabricarse en las mesas de costura.

Rule.Original: Miscellaneous cloth, bits and parts. Necessary for repairing weapons and mending apparel.
Rule.Raw: Miscellaneous cloth, bits and parts. Necessary for repairing weapons and mending apparel.
Rule.Translated: Retales de tela, piezas y componentes diversos. Necesarios para reparar armas y remendar ropa.

Rule.Original: Shortcuts for designators provided by the Allow Tool mod.
Rule.Raw: Shortcuts for designators provided by the Allow Tool mod.
Rule.Translated: Atajos para las herramientas de órdenes del mod Allow Tool.
Herramienta actual: acción del menú contextual

Rule.Original: Unforbid all items in the selected area. Click and drag over an area to use.
Rule.Raw: Unforbid all items in the selected area. Click and drag over an area to use.
Rule.Translated: Permite todos los objetos de la zona seleccionada. Haz clic y arrastra sobre una zona para utilizarla.

Rule.Original: Forbid all items in the selected area. Click and drag over an area to use.
Rule.Raw: Forbid all items in the selected area. Click and drag over an area to use.
Rule.Translated: Prohíbe todos los objetos de la zona seleccionada. Haz clic y arrastra sobre una zona para utilizarla.

Rule.Original: Unforbids all forbidden items on the map. Click to activate. Hold Ctrl/Option to include buildings. Hold Shift to include skeletons and non-fresh corpses.
Rule.Raw: Unforbids all forbidden items on the map. Click to activate. Hold Ctrl/Option to include buildings. Hold Shift to include skeletons and non-fresh corpses.
Rule.Translated: Permite todos los objetos prohibidos del mapa. Haz clic para activarla. Mantén pulsado Ctrl/Option para incluir edificios. Mantén pulsado Shift para incluir esqueletos y cadáveres que ya no estén frescos.

Rule.Original: Selects only things similar to those already selected. Hold Shift to pick additional things. Hold Alt to ignore selection limits.
Rule.Raw: Selects only things similar to those already selected. Hold Shift to pick additional things. Hold Alt to ignore selection limits.
Rule.Translated: Selecciona solo elementos similares a los que ya están seleccionados. Mantén pulsado Shift para añadir más elementos. Mantén pulsado Alt para ignorar los límites de selección.

Rule.Original: Mark things to be hauled as soon as possible. Colonists will delay other work until hauling is complete. Configurable in the Work tab. Hold Shift to interrupt current colonist work.
Rule.Raw: Mark things to be hauled as soon as possible. Colonists will delay other work until hauling is complete. Configurable in the Work tab. Hold Shift to interrupt current colonist work.
Rule.Translated: Marca objetos para transportarlos cuanto antes. Los colonos pospondrán otras tareas hasta terminar el transporte. Se configura en la pestaña Trabajo. Mantén pulsado Shift para interrumpir la tarea actual de los colonos.

Rule.Original: Quickly and painlessly kill downed creatures. Hold Shift to include colonists and allies.
Rule.Raw: Quickly and painlessly kill downed creatures. Hold Shift to include colonists and allies.
Rule.Translated: Mata rápida y sin dolor a las criaturas derribadas. Mantén pulsado Shift para incluir colonos y aliados.

Rule.Original: Orders the harvesting or chopping crops and trees that are sufficiently grown to yield their maximum amount of resources when gathered. Hold Shift to include only plants. Hold Ctrl/Option to include only trees.
Rule.Raw: Orders the harvesting or chopping crops and trees that are sufficiently grown to yield their maximum amount of resources when gathered. Hold Shift to include only plants. Hold Ctrl/Option to include only trees.
Rule.Translated: Ordena cosechar o talar cultivos y árboles que hayan crecido lo suficiente para proporcionar la máxima cantidad de recursos. Mantén pulsado Shift para incluir solo plantas. Mantén pulsado Ctrl/Option para incluir solo árboles.

Rule.Original: Lays out mine orders in a grid to maximize the chance to find hidden ores. Hold Shift to show settings window or designate using current settings.
Rule.Raw: Lays out mine orders in a grid to maximize the chance to find hidden ores. Hold Shift to show settings window or designate using current settings.
Rule.Translated: Coloca órdenes de minería en una cuadrícula para maximizar las probabilidades de encontrar minerales ocultos. Mantén pulsado Shift para mostrar la configuración o colocar órdenes con los ajustes actuales.

Rule.Original: New tool:|"Finish off" allows to quickly and humanely clean up downed animals and raid survivors. Requires a colonist skilled in melee combat to carry out the order.
Rule.Raw: New tool:|"Finish off" allows to quickly and humanely clean up downed animals and raid survivors. Requires a colonist skilled in melee combat to carry out the order.
Rule.Translated: Nueva herramienta:|«Rematar» permite eliminar rápida y humanamente a animales derribados y supervivientes de los ataques. La orden requiere un colono con habilidad en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Rule.Original: Cut blighted plants: marks all blighted plants on the map to be cut. Right-click the "Cut plants" tool to use.|Cancel all of this type: cancels all designations found on the selected item across the whole map. Useful to undo accidentally issued commands that affect the whole map.
Rule.Raw: Cut blighted plants: marks all blighted plants on the map to be cut. Right-click the "Cut plants" tool to use.|Cancel all of this type: cancels all designations found on the selected item across the whole map. Useful to undo accidentally issued commands that affect the whole map.
Rule.Translated: Cortar plantas con plaga: marca para cortar todas las plantas afectadas por plagas del mapa. Haz clic derecho en «Cortar plantas» para utilizarla.|Cancelar todo de este tipo: cancela en todo el mapa las órdenes presentes en el objeto seleccionado. Es útil para deshacer órdenes que se hayan aplicado accidentalmente a todo el mapa.

Rule.Original: New tools:|Drafted hunt is a tool for manual hunting. When enabled, allows colonists to automatically target and finish off wild animals. Draft a colonist to use, right-click to change settings.|Harvest/Chop fully grown: tools to mark only fully grown plants for harvesting and chopping, which improves resource yield. Right click the "Harvest" or "Chop" tools to use.
Rule.Raw: New tools:|Drafted hunt is a tool for manual hunting. When enabled, allows colonists to automatically target and finish off wild animals. Draft a colonist to use, right-click to change settings.|Harvest/Chop fully grown: tools to mark only fully grown plants for harvesting and chopping, which improves resource yield. Right click the "Harvest" or "Chop" tools to use.
Rule.Translated: Nuevas herramientas:|Caza reclutada es una herramienta de caza manual. Cuando está activada, permite que los colonos apunten y rematen automáticamente a los animales salvajes. Recluta a un colono para utilizarla y haz clic derecho para cambiar los ajustes.|Cosechar/talar plantas maduras: herramientas para marcar solo plantas completamente crecidas, lo que mejora el rendimiento de recursos. Haz clic derecho en «Cosechar» o «Talar» para utilizarlas.

Rule.Original: Chop tool actions: added "Chop all wood" and "Chop all wood in home area" to the Chop tool's right-click menu.|Pick Up And Haul compatibility: Haul Urgently will now use the custom (and more effective) hauling logic if the Pick Up And Haul mod is installed.
Rule.Raw: Chop tool actions: added "Chop all wood" and "Chop all wood in home area" to the Chop tool's right-click menu.|Pick Up And Haul compatibility: Haul Urgently will now use the custom (and more effective) hauling logic if the Pick Up And Haul mod is installed.
Rule.Translated: Acciones de tala: se han añadido «Talar toda la madera» y «Talar toda la madera de la zona de hogar» al menú de clic derecho de la herramienta Talar.|Compatibilidad con Pick Up And Haul: Transportar urgentemente ahora utiliza la lógica de transporte personalizada y más eficaz si el mod Pick Up And Haul está instalado.

Rule.Original: New tools:|Harvest fully grown: Harvesting fully grown things has been promoted to a separate tool, which can now be used in combination with "Select similar". Can selectively mark crops or trees only by holding Shift or Ctrl.|Strip mine: all new tool to easily lay out mining orders in a grid to maximize the chance of finding ores.|Other additions:|Select similar in visible area: added to "Select similar" tool right-click menu.|Customizable tool placement: other mods can now affect where in the menu the tools appear (most notably RIMMSqol).
Rule.Raw: New tools:|Harvest fully grown: Harvesting fully grown things has been promoted to a separate tool, which can now be used in combination with "Select similar". Can selectively mark crops or trees only by holding Shift or Ctrl.|Strip mine: all new tool to easily lay out mining orders in a grid to maximize the chance of finding ores.|Other additions:|Select similar in visible area: added to "Select similar" tool right-click menu.|Customizable tool placement: other mods can now affect where in the menu the tools appear (most notably RIMMSqol).
Rule.Translated: Nuevas herramientas:|Cosechar plantas maduras: esta función pasa a ser una herramienta independiente que puede combinarse con «Seleccionar similares». Permite marcar solo cultivos o árboles al mantener pulsado Shift o Ctrl.|Minería en cuadrícula: nueva herramienta para colocar fácilmente órdenes de minería en cuadrícula y maximizar las probabilidades de encontrar minerales.|Otras novedades:|Seleccionar similares en la zona visible: añadido al menú de clic derecho de «Seleccionar similares».|Posición de herramientas personalizable: otros mods, especialmente RIMMSqol, pueden modificar el lugar donde aparecen las herramientas en el menú.

Rule.Original: High-priority hauling. Works like the regular kind, but only for things that are manually designated. Use Architect > Orders > Haul Urgently to designate things to haul.\nAdded by the Allow Tool mod. Can be disabled in Options > Mod Settings.
Rule.Raw: High-priority hauling. Works like the regular kind, but only for things that are manually designated. Use Architect > Orders > Haul Urgently to designate things to haul.\nAdded by the Allow Tool mod. Can be disabled in Options > Mod Settings.
Rule.Translated: Transporte de alta prioridad. Funciona como el transporte normal, pero solo para objetos designados manualmente. Utiliza Arquitecto > Órdenes > Transportar urgentemente para marcar los objetos.\nAñadido por el mod Allow Tool. Puede desactivarse en Opciones > Ajustes de mods.

Rule.Original: Quickly and painlessly kill downed creatures.\nAdded by the Allow Tool mod. Can be disabled in Options > Mod Settings.

Rule.Original: Vacuum toilet that doesn't require water and jettisons all waste into space via sewage dump ports.
Rule.Raw: Vacuum toilet that doesn't require water and jettisons all waste into space via sewage dump ports.
Rule.Translated: Un inodoro aspirador que no necesita agua para funcionar. Arroja todos los residuos al espacio a través de los eyectores de aguas fecales conectados.

Rule.Original: A vacuum-sealed sewage expulsion port for use in spacecraft. When connected to a vacuum toilet, it safely ejects waste into the void of space.\nMust be mounted on an exterior wall of a ship.
Rule.Raw: A vacuum-sealed sewage expulsion port for use in spacecraft. When connected to a vacuum toilet, it safely ejects waste into the void of space.\nMust be mounted on an exterior wall of a ship.
Rule.Translated: Un puerto de expulsión de aguas residuales sellado al vacío para su uso en naves espaciales. Cuando se conecta a un retrete de vacío, expulsa los residuos de forma segura al vacío del espacio.\nDebe instalarse en la pared exterior de una nave.

Rule.Original: Extracts and sublimates volatile ices trapped beneath asteroid regolith. It produces usable water and generates substantial heat—handle with care when operating in enclosed environments.
Rule.Raw: Extracts and sublimates volatile ices trapped beneath asteroid regolith. It produces usable water and generates substantial heat—handle with care when operating in enclosed environments.
Rule.Translated: Extrae y sublima los hielos volátiles atrapados bajo el regolito de los asteroides. Totalmente sellado y autoalimentado, produce agua utilizable y genera un calor considerable, por lo que debe manejarse con cuidado en entornos cerrados.

Rule.Original: A compact high-efficiency recycling node that recovers and reuses water from showers and sinks.
Rule.Raw: A compact high-efficiency recycling node that recovers and reuses water from showers and sinks.
Rule.Translated: Un nodo de reciclaje compacto de alta eficiencia que recupera y reutiliza el agua de duchas y lavabos.

Rule.Original: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 2000.
Rule.Raw: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 2000.
Rule.Translated: Almacena el agua para su uso en instalaciones de fontanería. Si el agua almacenada se contamina, será necesario vaciar el depósito.

volviendo a equipar TargetA como arma secundaria.

Rule.Original:
Simple Sidearms

In order to equip weapons as sidearms, rightclick them and select the Equip as sidearm option.

By default, colonists will use whichever weapon type they are best skilled with or passionate about. Ranged weapon users will also switch to a melee weapon when engaged in close combat. This behaviour can be altered in the mod settings.
Rule.Raw:
Simple Sidearms

In order to equip weapons as sidearms, rightclick them and select the Equip as sidearm option.

By default, colonists will use whichever weapon type they are best skilled with or passionate about. Ranged weapon users will also switch to a melee weapon when engaged in close combat. This behaviour can be altered in the mod settings.
Rule.Translated:
Simple Sidearms

Para equipar un arma como secundaria, haz clic derecho en ella y selecciona «Equipar como arma secundaria».

Por defecto, los colonos utilizan el tipo de arma con el que tienen más habilidad o pasión. Quienes usan armas a distancia también cambiarán a un arma cuerpo a cuerpo cuando entren en combate cercano. Este comportamiento puede modificarse en los ajustes del mod.

Rule.Original: Sidearms with a gray background are currently in a colonists inventory and eligible for use. Right click to drop.
Rule.Raw: Sidearms with a gray background are currently in a colonists inventory and eligible for use. Right click to drop.
Rule.Translated: Las armas secundarias con fondo gris están en el inventario del colono y pueden utilizarse. Haz clic derecho para soltarlas.

Rule.Original: Sidearms with a dark purple background are currently missing from a colonists loadout. They will attempt to replace them at earliest opportunity, assuming any can be found. Right click to forget about the sidearm.
Rule.Raw: Sidearms with a dark purple background are currently missing from a colonists loadout. They will attempt to replace them at earliest opportunity, assuming any can be found. Right click to forget about the sidearm.
Rule.Translated: Las armas secundarias con fondo morado oscuro faltan en el equipo del colono. Intentará reemplazarlas en cuanto pueda, si encuentra alguna. Haz clic derecho para olvidarla.

Rule.Original:
Colonists can have sidearm use configured on an individual basis. The options are: 
Use ranged weapons
Use weapons colonist is passionate about or skilled with 
Use melee weapons
Rule.Raw:
Colonists can have sidearm use configured on an individual basis. The options are: 
Use ranged weapons
Use weapons colonist is passionate about or skilled with 
Use melee weapons
Rule.Translated:
El uso de armas secundarias puede configurarse para cada colono. Las opciones son:
Utilizar armas a distancia
Utilizar armas por las que el colono tenga pasión o habilidad
Utilizar armas cuerpo a cuerpo

Rule.Original:
Left click a carried ranged weapon to set it as the default ranged weapon. If the colonist weapon preference is set to ranged (or skill on a colonist more skilled with ranged weapons), this weapon will be what the colonist equips when not in active combat. It will also be used while hunting. 

Click a default ranged weapon again to force its use regardless of range/DPS. 

Right click to remove forced use/default status.
Rule.Raw:
Left click a carried ranged weapon to set it as the default ranged weapon. If the colonist weapon preference is set to ranged (or skill on a colonist more skilled with ranged weapons), this weapon will be what the colonist equips when not in active combat. It will also be used while hunting. 

Click a default ranged weapon again to force its use regardless of range/DPS. 

Right click to remove forced use/default status.
Rule.Translated:
Haz clic izquierdo en un arma a distancia del inventario para establecerla como predeterminada. Si la preferencia del colono está en armas a distancia, o en habilidad y se le dan mejor esas armas, la equipará cuando no esté en combate activo. También la utilizará para cazar.

Vuelve a hacer clic en el arma predeterminada para forzar su uso sin importar el alcance o el DPS.

Haz clic derecho para eliminar el uso forzado o el estado de arma predeterminada.

Rule.Original:
Left click a carried melee weapon to set it as the preferred ranged weapon. The colonist will always use this weapon when weapon preference is set to melee (or skill on a colonist more skilled with melee weapons) and when forced into close combat. 

Click a preferred melee weapon again to force its use at all times. 

Right click to remove forced use/preference.
Rule.Raw:
Left click a carried melee weapon to set it as the preferred ranged weapon. The colonist will always use this weapon when weapon preference is set to melee (or skill on a colonist more skilled with melee weapons) and when forced into close combat. 

Click a preferred melee weapon again to force its use at all times. 

Right click to remove forced use/preference.
Rule.Translated:
Haz clic izquierdo en un arma cuerpo a cuerpo del inventario para establecerla como preferida. El colono la utilizará cuando la preferencia esté en cuerpo a cuerpo, o en habilidad y se le den mejor esas armas, y cuando se vea obligado a combatir de cerca.

Vuelve a hacer clic en el arma preferida para forzar su uso en todo momento.

Haz clic derecho para eliminar el uso forzado o la preferencia.

Rule.Original: Left click a carried weapon while drafted to force its use until end of combat. \n\nNote that most changes to sidearm loadout require the pawn to not be drafted.
Rule.Raw: Left click a carried weapon while drafted to force its use until end of combat. \n\nNote that most changes to sidearm loadout require the pawn to not be drafted.
Rule.Translated: Haz clic izquierdo en un arma del inventario mientras el colono esté reclutado para forzar su uso hasta el final del combate.\n\nTen en cuenta que la mayoría de los cambios de equipo secundario requieren que el peón no esté reclutado.

Rule.Original: Depending on the settings, Simple Sidearms can cause colonists to drop their weapons in a variety of situations (default is attacks in melee). Don't worry - your colonists will retrieve their weapons after the fight. \n\nThis is a customizable feature - take a look in the mod settings dialog to learn more.
Rule.Raw: Depending on the settings, Simple Sidearms can cause colonists to drop their weapons in a variety of situations (default is attacks in melee). Don't worry - your colonists will retrieve their weapons after the fight. \n\nThis is a customizable feature - take a look in the mod settings dialog to learn more.
Rule.Translated: Según los ajustes, Simple Sidearms puede hacer que los colonos suelten sus armas en distintas situaciones; por defecto, cuando reciben ataques cuerpo a cuerpo. No te preocupes: las recogerán después de la pelea.\n\nEsta función es configurable. Consulta el cuadro de ajustes del mod para saber más.

Rule.Translated: Combat Extended está cargado. La gestión del inventario de SimpleSidearms está desactivada.

Rule.Original:
Stone Bridges are structures that can be built on water. Bridges allow more rapid movement across water. Once built, they can support many structures, including heavy structures and any type of wall. Bridges allow for easier building in swampy biomes.
Can be made out of any stone blocks.
Rule.Raw:
Stone Bridges are structures that can be built on water. Bridges allow more rapid movement across water. Once built, they can support many structures, including heavy structures and any type of wall. Bridges allow for easier building in swampy biomes.
Can be made out of any stone blocks.
Rule.Translated: Los puentes de piedra son estructuras que pueden construirse sobre el agua, y permiten un desplazamiento más rápido a través de la misma. Una vez construidos, pueden sostener muchas estructuras, incluidas las pesadas y cualquier tipo de muro. Los puentes permiten realizar construcciones con mayor facilidad en biomas pantanosos.\n\nPueden construirse con cualquier tipo de bloques de piedra.

Rule.Original: The Gauntlet combat-grade spacecraft is a ship-launched fighter cleared for low atmosphere operations. It was designed to strafe targets and take out enemy air units, however it fell out of favour due to numerous shortcomings and can frequently be found as part of military surplus.\n\nIt was not intended to land planetside as it doesn’t even have landing gear, but some enterprising individuals have decided to do just that. The mounted charge cannon works perfectly well against armored targets and the interior has been retrofitted to accommodate raid parties and supplies. The extra weight all but guarantees that the ship will be non-recoverable and create massive chaos when it flops onto the surface.
Rule.Raw: The Gauntlet combat-grade spacecraft is a ship-launched fighter cleared for low atmosphere operations. It was designed to strafe targets and take out enemy air units, however it fell out of favour due to numerous shortcomings and can frequently be found as part of military surplus.\n\nIt was not intended to land planetside as it doesn’t even have landing gear, but some enterprising individuals have decided to do just that. The mounted charge cannon works perfectly well against armored targets and the interior has been retrofitted to accommodate raid parties and supplies. The extra weight all but guarantees that the ship will be non-recoverable and create massive chaos when it flops onto the surface.
Rule.Translated: La nave espacial de combate Gauntlet es un caza lanzado por otra nave y adaptado para operaciones en altitudes bajas. Fue diseñado para ametrallar objetivos y eliminar unidades aéreas enemigas, pero cayó en desuso debido a sus numerosas deficiencias y es común encontrarlo en excedentes militares.\n\nNo estaba destinado a aterrizar en el planeta ya que ni siquiera tiene tren de aterrizaje, pero algunos individuos ingeniosos decidieron intentarlo. El cañón de impulso montado funciona perfectamente contra objetivos blindados y el interior se ha reacondicionado para albergar grupos de asalto y suministros. El peso adicional asegura que la nave será irrecuperable y creará un caos masivo cuando caiga a la superficie.

Rule.Original:
An alluring glow gives away the fact that this is a magical ring. This ring allow its wearer to release destructive bolts of energy around their target.

Shields cannot be used along with this weapon as they interfere with the flow of magical energies around the caster.

Does not drop on down or death.

Does not drop on down or death.
Rule.Translated:
Un resplandor cautivador delata la naturaleza mágica de este anillo. Permite a quien lo lleva liberar destructivos proyectiles de energía alrededor del objetivo.

No se pueden usar escudos junto con esta arma, ya que interfieren con el flujo de energía mágica alrededor del lanzador.

No cae al quedar incapacitado ni al morir.

Rule.Original: An enchanted tome made back in the golden age. Each page seems to be immeasurably steeped in ambiguity, imbued with signs of magic. Its undecipherable phrases slowly turn into a recognizable language when stared upon. Uttering its words will surely grant change, however, rendering the book useless.
Rule.Raw: An enchanted tome made back in the golden age. Each page seems to be immeasurably steeped in ambiguity, imbued with signs of magic. Its undecipherable phrases slowly turn into a recognizable language when stared upon. Uttering its words will surely grant change, however, rendering the book useless.
Rule.Translated: Un tomo encantado de la edad de oro. Cada página parece estar repleta de símbolos sobrenaturales imposibles de descifrar. Su contenido se convierte lenta y misteriosamente en un lenguaje reconocible cuando se mira fijamente. Sin embargo, al pronunciar sus palabras, el libro se vuelve inútil.

Rule.Translated: Un tomo encantado de la edad de oro. Cada página parece estar repleta de símbolos sobrenaturales imposibles de descifrar. Su contenido se convierte lenta y misteriosamente en un lenguaje reconocible cuando se mira fijamente. Sin embargo, al pronunciar sus palabras, el libro se vuelve inútil.

Rule.Original: A warm robust coat sewn from a wolf's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious wolf to don the trophy.
Rule.Raw: A warm robust coat sewn from a wolf's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious wolf to don the trophy.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo robusto y cálido confeccionado a partir de la piel de un lobo. Llevarla demuestra la fuerza del dueño, ya que es la prueba de que ha matado a un lobo y lo lleva puesto como trofeo.

Rule.Raw: A warm robust coat sewn from a bears's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious bear to don the trophy.

Rule.Original: The Zweihander's cuirass is a striking blend of protection and flamboyance, featuring intricate plate armor complemented by vibrant, puffed clothing. Bold slashes in the fabric reveal contrasting colors beneath, creating a distinctive and formidable appearance on the battlefield. This unique combination of sturdy metal and eye-catching textiles embodies the fearless and audacious spirit of the Zweihander mercenaries.
Rule.Raw: The Zweihander's cuirass is a striking blend of protection and flamboyance, featuring intricate plate armor complemented by vibrant, puffed clothing. Bold slashes in the fabric reveal contrasting colors beneath, creating a distinctive and formidable appearance on the battlefield. This unique combination of sturdy metal and eye-catching textiles embodies the fearless and audacious spirit of the Zweihander mercenaries.
Rule.Translated: La coraza del espadón combina de forma llamativa protección y ostentación, con una intrincada armadura de placas complementada por ropas vistosas y abullonadas. Los cortes atrevidos del tejido dejan ver colores contrastantes y crean un aspecto distintivo y formidable en el campo de batalla. Esta singular combinación de metal resistente y telas llamativas encarna el espíritu intrépido y audaz de los mercenarios del espadón.

Rule.Original: A sturdy metal helmet adorned with a flamboyant colored large baggy feathered hat to display one's status.
Rule.Raw: A sturdy metal helmet adorned with a flamboyant colored large baggy feathered hat to display one's status.
Rule.Translated: Un robusto casco de metal adornado con un gran sombrero de plumas de colores llamativos, perfecto para mostrar el estatus del usuario.

Rule.Original:
A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well. 

An ancient relic of the long forgotten under-empires. A masterfully crafted blade able to carve through plates of steel with its edge unwavering.
The reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw:
A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well. 

An ancient relic of the long forgotten under-empires. A masterfully crafted blade able to carve through plates of steel with its edge unwavering.
The reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme espada a dos manos de hoja larga, capaz de atravesar a los enemigos con feroces golpes y estocadas. También es buena para las estocadas largas.\n\nUna antigua reliquia de los subimperios olvidados, con una hoja magistralmente elaborada, capaz de atravesar placas de acero con su filo inquebrantable.

Rule.Original: An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
Rule.Raw: An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
Rule.Translated: El martillo a dos manos, una mejora del mazo, utiliza una pesada cabeza de metal para multiplicar la fuerza infligida a los objetivos. La fuerza de los martillazos puede partir placas sólidas y escudos resistentes.

Rule.Original: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Raw: A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.\nThe reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.
Rule.Translated: Un tipo de pica, muy versátil gracias a sus tres extremos mortales: una hoja para golpear, un gancho para agarrar y una punta en forma de lanza para perforar cotas de malla y placas metálicas.

Rule.Original: An enormous reptile, halfway between serpents and dragons. One of the few creatures truly incapable of feeling fear. Any daredevil who manages to get past the mighty yet nimble tail and pierce a hardy scale will be splashed with corrosive blood. Lindwurm blood is the most powerful acid known yet — dissolving even the thickest steel, eating through the flesh in seconds.
Rule.Raw: An enormous reptile, halfway between serpents and dragons. One of the few creatures truly incapable of feeling fear. Any daredevil who manages to get past the mighty yet nimble tail and pierce a hardy scale will be splashed with corrosive blood. Lindwurm blood is the most powerful acid known yet — dissolving even the thickest steel, eating through the flesh in seconds.
Rule.Translated: Un reptil enorme, a medio camino entre las serpientes y los dragones. Una de las pocas criaturas realmente incapaces de sentir miedo. Cualquier temerario que se atreva a pasar por delante de su poderosa pero ágil cola y perforar aunque sea una de sus resistentes escamas será salpicado con sangre corrosiva. La sangre de lindwurm es el ácido más poderoso conocido hasta ahora, capaz de disolver incluso el acero más grueso y deshacer la carne en segundos.

Rule.Original: Carefully-cut and fit stone tiles in a mosaic pattern, stylish in bathrooms or kitchens.
Rule.Raw: Carefully-cut and fit stone tiles in a mosaic pattern, stylish in bathrooms or kitchens.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de piedra cuidadosamente talladas y encajadas en un mosaico, elegantes para baños y cocinas.

Rule.Original: Beautifully laid down wooden flooring for that posh, fancy feeling. Whilst beautiful, it takes a long time to lay down and is also very flammable.
Rule.Raw: Beautifully laid down wooden flooring for that posh, fancy feeling. Whilst beautiful, it takes a long time to lay down and is also very flammable.
Rule.Translated: Un hermoso suelo de madera para dar una sensación de lujo y refinamiento. Aunque es bonito, se tarda mucho en colocarlo y resulta muy inflamable.

Rule.Original: Fancy, polished stone tiles for an elegant, mansion-like look. Don’t take nearly as long to lay down as the finer stone floors, but require a lot of resources. They are incredibly beautiful to look at.
Rule.Raw: Fancy, polished stone tiles for an elegant, mansion-like look. Don’t take nearly as long to lay down as the finer stone floors, but require a lot of resources. They are incredibly beautiful to look at.
Rule.Translated: Elegantes baldosas de piedra pulida para dar el aspecto de una mansión. Se colocan mucho más rápido que los suelos de piedra más refinados, pero requieren muchos recursos. Son extraordinariamente bonitas.

Rule.Original: Large slabs of stone laid at random for that temple-like look. Beautiful to look at, they take a lot of work to place down and use up large amounts of resources.
Rule.Raw: Large slabs of stone laid at random for that temple-like look. Beautiful to look at, they take a lot of work to place down and use up large amounts of resources.
Rule.Translated: Grandes losas de piedra colocadas de forma irregular para dar un aspecto de templo. Son bonitas, pero requieren mucho trabajo de colocación y consumen grandes cantidades de recursos.

Rule.Original: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Raw: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
Rule.Translated: Un suelo de tablas de madera que transmite una sensación cálida y hogareña. Aunque es rápido de colocar, también es muy inflamable.

Bláster de carga de la Reina de guerra

Rule.Original: A pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster designed for area suppression. Enhanced coolant systems enable sustained lethal fire. This specialized variant created for the War Queen represents a significant tactical upgrade over previous models.
Rule.Raw: 脉冲充能速射冲击炮，专为区域火力压制设计。强化冷却系统支持持久致命的连续射击,该款型专为战争女王设计，比以往的更加危险致命。
Rule.Translated: Bláster de fuego rápido cargado por pulsos y diseñado para supresión de área. Sus sistemas de refrigeración mejorados permiten fuego letal sostenido.

Rule.Original: Comfortable, self cleaning, unblockable, super efficient smart toilet. Provides the optimum multi-functional experience with automatic cleansing and deodorization.\n7L per use
Rule.Raw: Comfortable, self cleaning, unblockable, super efficient smart toilet. Provides the optimum multi-functional experience with automatic cleansing and deodorization.\n7L per use
Rule.Translated: Utiliza la mitad de agua que un retrete convencional. Proporciona una experiencia multifuncional óptima, además de limpieza y eliminación del olor de forma automática. Emplea 7 litros de agua por uso.

Rule.Original: Make a Lavish meal with lobster
Rule.Raw: Make a Lavish meal with lobster
Rule.Translated: Prepara una comida suntuosa con langosta

Rule.Original: Catch something that is not a fish
Rule.Raw: Catch something that is not a fish
Rule.Translated: Pesca algo que no sea un pez

Rule.Original: An expertise in fishing speed that reduces the time spent on fishing jobs.
Rule.Raw: An expertise in fishing speed that reduces the time spent on fishing jobs.
Rule.Translated: Una especialidad en velocidad de pesca que reduce el tiempo dedicado a las tareas de pesca.

Rule.Original: An expertise in fish catching that increases the amount of fish caught.
Rule.Raw: An expertise in fish catching that increases the amount of fish caught.
Rule.Translated: Una especialidad en captura de peces que aumenta la cantidad de peces capturados.

Rule.Original: An expertise in getting lucky when fishing, catching special items that are not fish.
Rule.Raw: An expertise in getting lucky when fishing, catching special items that are not fish.
Rule.Translated: Una especialidad en tener suerte al pescar, que permite capturar objetos especiales que no son peces.

Rule.Original: Assemble and disassemble bionics at a bionics table.
Rule.Raw: Assemble and disassemble bionics at a bionics table.
Rule.Translated: Monta y desmonta implantes biónicos en una mesa de biónica.
fabricar objetos en la mesa de biónica

Rule.Original: Charge powered lethal gas canister causing toxic buildup over a very short period of time, strapped to a belt. Can be reloaded using tox grenades.
Rule.Raw: Charge powered lethal gas canister causing toxic buildup over a very short period of time, strapped to a belt. Can be reloaded using tox grenades.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente de gas letal, activado por una carga y sujeto a un cinturón, que provoca acumulación tóxica en muy poco tiempo. Puede recargarse con granadas tóxicas.

Rule.Original: Makeshift explosive sticks of chemfuel strapped to a belt. They can be thrown a short distance, where they will explode after a random amount of time. Can be reloaded using dynamite.
Rule.Raw: Makeshift explosive sticks of chemfuel strapped to a belt. They can be thrown a short distance, where they will explode after a random amount of time. Can be reloaded using dynamite.
Rule.Translated: Cartuchos explosivos improvisados de quimiocombustible sujetos a un cinturón. Pueden lanzarse a corta distancia y explotan tras un intervalo aleatorio. Puede recargarse con dinamita.
cinturón de granadas de gas lacrimógeno

Rule.Original: Modern canister containing a special compound commonly referred to as tear gas, strapped to a belt. Can be reloaded using tear gas grenades.
Rule.Raw: Modern canister containing a special compound commonly referred to as tear gas, strapped to a belt. Can be reloaded using tear gas grenades.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente moderno, sujeto a un cinturón, que contiene un compuesto especial conocido como gas lacrimógeno. Puede recargarse con granadas de gas lacrimógeno.

Rule.Original: Old school condensed smoke canisters that explodes into a smoke wall on impact, strapped to a belt. Can be reloaded using smoke grenades.
Rule.Raw: Old school condensed smoke canisters that explodes into a smoke wall on impact, strapped to a belt. Can be reloaded using smoke grenades.
Rule.Translated: Recipientes tradicionales de humo condensado, sujetos a un cinturón, que estallan al impactar y forman una cortina de humo. Puede recargarse con granadas de humo.

Rule.Original: A belt of flash grenades. Temporarily stuns organic enemies allowing users to close the distance. Can be reloaded using flash grenades.
Rule.Raw: A belt of flash grenades. Temporarily stuns organic enemies allowing users to close the distance. Can be reloaded using flash grenades.
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón de granadas cegadoras. Aturde temporalmente a los enemigos orgánicos y permite acercarse a ellos. Puede recargarse con granadas cegadoras.

Rule.Raw: sentence->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told a dirty joke to [RECIPIENT_nameDef]
Rule.Translated: sentence->[INITIATOR_nameDef] contó un chiste verde a [RECIPIENT_nameDef]
pe_topic->mantener el interés de una pareja

Rule.Original: Crafted from sturdy oak and designed with functional elegance in mind, this simple wooden throne provides a comfortable seat for any lower class noble. The backrest and armrests are carefully carved with ornate patterns, adding a touch of regality to its humble design. Though not as imposing as its grander counterparts, this throne is well-suited for smaller courts or chambers, where a more understated presence is desired. With its solid construction and timeless appeal, this throne is sure to be a cherished piece of furniture for generations to come.
Rule.Raw: Crafted from sturdy oak and designed with functional elegance in mind, this simple wooden throne provides a comfortable seat for any lower class noble. The backrest and armrests are carefully carved with ornate patterns, adding a touch of regality to its humble design. Though not as imposing as its grander counterparts, this throne is well-suited for smaller courts or chambers, where a more understated presence is desired. With its solid construction and timeless appeal, this throne is sure to be a cherished piece of furniture for generations to come.
Rule.Translated: Fabricado con roble resistente y diseñado para combinar funcionalidad y elegancia, este sencillo trono de madera ofrece un asiento cómodo para cualquier noble de rango inferior. El respaldo y los reposabrazos están cuidadosamente tallados con motivos ornamentales que añaden un toque regio a su modesto diseño. Aunque menos imponente que otros tronos más grandiosos, resulta adecuado para cortes o salas pequeñas que requieren una presencia más discreta. Su construcción sólida y su atractivo intemporal lo convierten en un mueble que se apreciará durante generaciones.

Rule.Original: Unlock the capability to transform raw wooden logs into fresh lumber ready to be used for crafting and construction.
Rule.Raw: Unlock the capability to transform raw wooden logs into fresh lumber ready to be used for crafting and construction.
Rule.Translated: Desbloquea la capacidad de transformar troncos en bruto en tablones recién cortados, listos para la elaboración y la construcción.

Rule.Original: A concentrated mixture of herbal essence extracted by grinding multiple raw herbs. Used in the crafting of medicine and healing potions.
Rule.Raw: A concentrated mixture of herbal essence extracted by grinding multiple raw herbs. Used in the crafting of medicine and healing potions.
Rule.Translated: Una mezcla concentrada de esencia herbal extraída al triturar varias hierbas crudas. Se utiliza para elaborar medicina y pociones curativas.

Rule.Original: Fancy, polished stone tiles for an elegant, mansion-like look. Don’t take nearly as long to lay down as the finer stone floors, but require a lot of resources. They are incredibly beautiful to look at.
Rule.Raw: Fancy, polished stone tiles for an elegant, mansion-like look. Don’t take nearly as long to lay down as the finer stone floors, but require a lot of resources. They are incredibly beautiful to look at.
Rule.Translated: Elegantes baldosas de piedra pulida para dar el aspecto de una mansión. Se colocan mucho más rápido que los suelos de piedra más refinados, pero requieren muchos recursos. Son extraordinariamente bonitas.

Rule.Original: Large slabs of stone laid at random for that temple-like look. Beautiful to look at, they take a lot of work to place down and use up large amounts of resources.
Rule.Raw: Large slabs of stone laid at random for that temple-like look. Beautiful to look at, they take a lot of work to place down and use up large amounts of resources.
Rule.Translated: Grandes losas de piedra colocadas de forma irregular para dar un aspecto de templo. Son bonitas, pero requieren mucho trabajo de colocación y consumen grandes cantidades de recursos.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Manual operation allows people to open it, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Manual operation allows people to open it, letting vehicles through.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. Puede abrirse manualmente para dejar pasar vehículos.

[AV] Proyectos de investigación de tecnología mecanoide

Rule.Original: Unlock technologies from [AV] Mods by researching at a research bench, mostly centered around mechtech.
Rule.Raw: Unlock technologies from [AV] Mods by researching at a research bench, mostly centered around mechtech.
Rule.Translated: Desbloquea tecnologías de los mods de [AV] investigando en una mesa de investigación. Se centran principalmente en la tecnología mecanoide.

Rule.Original: An artifical hornet nest. An extraordinary structure crafted from wood, clay, iron and woven straw. The hive houses a swarm of specially bred hornets, nurtured to produce a unique, viscous substance known as hornet honey. Unlike ordinary honey, hornet honey is rich in nutrients, granting those who consume it bursts of energy and resilience—an invaluable resource for knights preparing for battle or peasants enduring harsh winters. The cultivation of hornet honey is a very time consuming process.
Rule.Raw: An artifical hornet nest. An extraordinary structure crafted from wood, clay, iron and woven straw. The hive houses a swarm of specially bred hornets, nurtured to produce a unique, viscous substance known as hornet honey. Unlike ordinary honey, hornet honey is rich in nutrients, granting those who consume it bursts of energy and resilience—an invaluable resource for knights preparing for battle or peasants enduring harsh winters. The cultivation of hornet honey is a very time consuming process.
Rule.Translated: Un nido artificial de avispones. Una extraordinaria estructura elaborada con madera, arcilla, hierro y paja tejida. Alberga un enjambre de avispones criados especialmente para producir una sustancia viscosa y singular conocida como miel de avispón. A diferencia de la miel común, la miel de avispón es rica en nutrientes y proporciona a quienes la consumen una ráfaga de energía y resistencia: un recurso muy valioso para los caballeros que se preparan para la batalla o los campesinos que soportan inviernos rigurosos. La producción de miel de avispón requiere mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: The matriarch of a hornet colony. Unlike bees, they consume carrion and produce potent hornet honey.
Rule.Raw: The matriarch of a hornet colony. Unlike bees, they consume carrion and produce potent hornet honey.
Rule.Translated: La matriarca de una colonia de avispones. A diferencia de las abejas, consumen carroña y producen una potente miel de avispón.

Rule.Translated: Un suelo de piedra colocado en un patrón escalonado mixto. Es bonito, pero se tarda algo en colocarlo.

Rule.Original: Roughly-cut stone tiles in a staggered pattern. Not particularly beautiful, but they make good surfaces for roads, outdoor walkways, or underground dungeons. Deconstruction yields no resources.
Rule.Raw: Roughly-cut stone tiles in a staggered pattern. Not particularly beautiful, but they make good surfaces for roads, outdoor walkways, or underground dungeons. Deconstruction yields no resources.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de piedra cortadas de forma tosca y colocadas en un patrón escalonado. No son especialmente bonitas, pero sirven bien para caminos, pasarelas exteriores o mazmorras subterráneas. Al desmontarlas no se recuperan recursos.
baldosa escalonada R M de arcilla

baldosa de doble rombo de arcilla

Rule.Original: Stone flooring laid in a double diamond pattern. Pretty but takes significantly more time to lay. Fit for royalty.
Rule.Raw: Stone flooring laid in a double diamond pattern. Pretty but takes significantly more time to lay. Fit for royalty.
Rule.Translated: Un suelo de piedra colocado en un patrón de doble rombo. Es bonito, pero se tarda bastante más en colocarlo. Adecuado para la realeza.

Rule.Original: Stone paving laid in a fishscale pattern. Pretty but takes some time to lay.
Rule.Raw: Stone paving laid in a fishscale pattern. Pretty but takes some time to lay.
Rule.Translated: Un pavimento de piedra colocado en un patrón de escamas. Es bonito, pero se tarda algo en colocarlo.

Rule.Original: Stone paving laid in a rough circular pattern. Pretty but takes some time to lay.
Rule.Raw: Stone paving laid in a rough circular pattern. Pretty but takes some time to lay.
Rule.Translated: Un pavimento de piedra colocado en un patrón circular tosco. Es bonito, pero se tarda algo en colocarlo.

Rule.Original: Stone paving made out of gravel. Unremarkable in terms of looks and easy to lay. Yields no resources upon deconstruction.
Rule.Raw: Stone paving made out of gravel. Unremarkable in terms of looks and easy to lay. Yields no resources upon deconstruction.
Rule.Translated: Un pavimento de piedra hecho con grava. Tiene un aspecto corriente y es fácil de colocar. Al desmontarlo no se recuperan recursos.

Rule.Original: Checkered smooth stone tiles combining two types of stone. Pretty but takes some time to lay. Nobles love it.
Rule.Raw: Checkered smooth stone tiles combining two types of stone. Pretty but takes some time to lay. Nobles love it.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de piedra lisas y ajedrezadas que combinan dos tipos de piedra. Son bonitas, pero se tarda algo en colocarlas. A los nobles les encantan.

Rule.Translated: Baldosas de piedra cortadas de forma tosca y colocadas en un patrón aleatorio. No son especialmente bonitas, pero sirven bien para caminos, pasarelas exteriores o mazmorras subterráneas. Al desmontarlas no se recuperan recursos.
baldosa de patrón aleatorio R de anortosita

Rule.Original:
Close-combat firearms with high fire rates and strong armor-piercing capability. Their downsides are extremely short range and low stopping power.
Yeonhwa Precision Hyper Rapid Shard Accelerator Model 61t “SeolHwa (Snow Blossom)”
Originally built as a personal defense weapon, this pistol’s hair-raising fire rates have carved countless bloody legends in the corridors of the corporate world. The 121㎛-thick crystalline shards fired by the pistol are designed to break into sharp fractal forms upon impact, causing maximum damage.
Rule.Raw:
Close-combat firearms with high fire rates and strong armor-piercing capability. Their downsides are extremely short range and low stopping power.
Yeonhwa Precision Hyper Rapid Shard Accelerator Model 61t “SeolHwa (Snow Blossom)”
Originally built as a personal defense weapon, this pistol’s hair-raising fire rates have carved countless bloody legends in the corridors of the corporate world. The 121㎛-thick crystalline shards fired by the pistol are designed to break into sharp fractal forms upon impact, causing maximum damage.
Rule.Translated:
Armas de fuego de combate cercano con gran cadencia y una fuerte capacidad de perforación de blindaje. Sus inconvenientes son un alcance extremadamente corto y un bajo poder de parada.
Acelerador de esquirlas ultrarrápido de Yeonhwa Precision, modelo 61t «SeolHwa (Flor de nieve)».
Diseñada originalmente como arma de defensa personal, la cadencia escalofriante de esta pistola ha escrito innumerables leyendas sangrientas en los pasillos del mundo corporativo. Las esquirlas cristalinas de 121㎛ de grosor que dispara están diseñadas para romperse al impactar en formas fractales afiladas y causar el máximo daño.

Rule.Original: Damage values against buildings will be multiplied by these factors: \nSolid means impassable structures, typically walls.
Rule.Raw: Damage values against buildings will be multiplied by these factors: \nSolid means impassable structures, typically walls.
Rule.Translated: Los daños contra edificios se multiplican por estos factores:\n«Sólido» significa estructuras infranqueables, normalmente muros.
Cortante cuerpo a cuerpo contra sólidos {SharpMeleeImpassable} [Predeterminado: 0.1]

Rule.Original: Melee Sharp: Cut, Poke, Stab, Scratch, Bite
Rule.Raw: Melee Sharp: Cut, Poke, Stab, Scratch, Bite
Rule.Translated: Cortante cuerpo a cuerpo: Cut, Poke, Stab, Scratch, Bite
Cortante a distancia: RangedStab, Bullet, Arrow

Rule.Translated: «Bomb» es el único que ya tenía ambos factores, 2 y 4 respectivamente.

Rule.Original: Disabling this will make the game harder, as you will have to constantly carry a breaching axe to break stuff, but your turrets will be stronger.
Rule.Raw: Disabling this will make the game harder, as you will have to constantly carry a breaching axe to break stuff, but your turrets will be stronger.
Rule.Translated: Desactivarlo hará más difícil la partida, pues necesitarás llevar constantemente un hacha de demolición para romper cosas, aunque tus torretas serán más resistentes.
La piedra natural resiste los daños a distancia.

Rule.Original: Multiply ranged damage types against natural walls by zero.
Rule.Raw: Multiply ranged damage types against natural walls by zero.
Rule.Translated: Multiplica por cero los daños a distancia contra muros naturales.

Rule.Original: A dose of semi-coherent mechanites designed to rapidly heal injuries within the host. They're so powerful they can regenerate scars, missing organs and lost limbs.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.
Rule.Raw: A dose of semi-coherent mechanites designed to rapidly heal injuries within the host. They're so powerful they can regenerate scars, missing organs and lost limbs.\n\nFor ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector. Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body. Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites. It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.
Rule.Translated: Una dosis de mecanitas semicoherentes diseñadas para curar rápidamente las lesiones del portador. Son tan potentes que pueden regenerar cicatrices, órganos perdidos y extremidades ausentes.\n\nPara facilitar su uso, las mecanitas están diseñadas para que el propio usuario pueda implantárselas con un pequeño inyector portátil. Debido a su funcionamiento, solo una cepa puede coexistir de forma armoniosa dentro del cuerpo del portador. Al inyectarla, las mecanitas nuevas eliminan cualquier cepa que ya estuviera presente. Es posible eliminar por completo las cepas de mecanitas de un portador, pero requiere una operación cara y difícil.

Rule.Original: An installed resurrection core. A small durable core which contains a one-use super-dose of mechanites tuned to resurrect the dead. After the host dies, the core will sustain their mind and, when they choose, rebuild their body. The flesh will rapidly reform, replacing missing organs and healing wounds. The process is not perfect and may cause scarring or other health complications.
Rule.Raw: An installed resurrection core. A small durable core which contains a one-use super-dose of mechanites tuned to resurrect the dead. After the host dies, the core will sustain their mind and, when they choose, rebuild their body. The flesh will rapidly reform, replacing missing organs and healing wounds. The process is not perfect and may cause scarring or other health complications.
Rule.Translated: Un núcleo de resurrección implantado. Un pequeño núcleo resistente que contiene una superdosis de mecanitas de un solo uso, preparadas para resucitar a los muertos. Después de morir el portador, el núcleo conserva su mente y, cuando este lo decide, reconstruye su cuerpo. La carne vuelve a formarse rápidamente, repone los órganos perdidos y cura las heridas. El proceso no es perfecto y puede causar cicatrices u otras complicaciones de salud.

Rule.Original: An installed immortality core. A small durable core of archotech design said to make its host immortal through rapid regeneration. Its inner workings are a complete mystery, it’s unclear how it can endlessly regenerate a person seemingly from nothing. Once implanted the core cannot be removed without damaging the device rendering it inert.

Su funcionamiento interno es un misterio absoluto: no se sabe cómo puede regenerar indefinidamente a una persona, aparentemente de la nada. Una vez implantado, no puede extraerse sin dañar el dispositivo y dejarlo inerte.

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic lung. A highly advanced artificial lung made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides enhanced breathing which improves consciousness, helps with movement and promotes a better night’s rest. It’s as hard as plasteel and through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.\n\nIt’s microfilters reduce the intake of environmental toxins allowing the user to survive longer in polluted environments. Additionally, it negates the irritation of acidic smoke and prevents lung rot in this lung.

Additionally, it negates the irritation of acidic smoke and prevents lung rot in this lung.
Rule.Translated: Un pulmón biónico avanzado implantado. Un pulmón artificial muy avanzado fabricado con técnicas de ultratecnología de vanguardia. Mejora la respiración, lo que aumenta la consciencia, facilita el movimiento y favorece un mejor descanso nocturno. Es tan duro como el plastiacero y puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.\n\nSus microfiltros reducen la entrada de toxinas ambientales y permiten al usuario sobrevivir más tiempo en entornos contaminados. Además, evitan la irritación causada por el humo ácido y la putrefacción de este pulmón.

Rule.Original: An installed advanced bionic kidney. A highly advanced artificial kidney made using cutting edge ultratech techniques. It provides enhanced blood filtration which helps fight against diseases and infections. Using a series of nanofilters, it can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons. It’s as hard as plasteel and through the use of a lattice-dust healing system its capable of repairing itself over time.

Mediante una serie de nanofiltros, elimina rápidamente una amplia variedad de toxinas de la sangre, por lo que resulta eficaz contra toxinas ambientales, venenos e inyecciones tóxicas. Es tan duro como el plastiacero y puede repararse con el tiempo mediante un sistema de curación basado en polvo reticular.

Rule.Original: An installed environmental filter. A small internal module connected to the respiratory system that filters the incoming air of environmental toxins and gases. The gathered toxins are later harmlessly excreted from the body. The implant allows the user to survive longer in polluted environments. Additionally, it negates the irritation of acidic smoke and prevents lung rot.

Además, evita la irritación causada por el humo ácido y la putrefacción pulmonar.

Rule.Original: An herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike. Though these look like ordinary beets from the outside, on the inside they have distinct red-and-white-striped flesh. These are highest on the sweetness scale. While beets do require rich soil they are quite hearty, and will continue to grow very slowly through winter. They need to be planted during growing season, though.

Rule.Translated: Una hortaliza herbácea muy cultivada para alimentar tanto a humanos como al ganado. Aunque por fuera parece una remolacha corriente, su interior tiene una pulpa con franjas rojas y blancas muy características. Es una de las variedades más dulces. Necesita un suelo fértil, pero es bastante resistente y seguirá creciendo muy lentamente durante el invierno. Eso sí, debe plantarse durante la temporada de cultivo.

Rule.Original: One of the biggest varieties of pumpkin, the mammoth gold can grow to between 25 and 50 Kg of weight. Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest. However, their durability means added weight and mass - Too cumbersome for hydroponics basins.

Sin embargo, su resistencia supone un mayor peso y volumen, lo que las hace demasiado aparatosas para las cubetas hidropónicas.

Rule.Original: A variety of tomatoes with a firm, meaty, rich, vibrant red colour. Its flavour is mild, juicy and balanced compared to other varieties. Tomatoes are easily removed from the vine without having to uproot the plant.

Rule.Original: A tree bearing hard apples, with a light green skin and crisp, juicy flesh. The flavour is tart and acidic. It remains firm when baked, making it a very popular cooking apple used in pies, where it can be sweetened.

Rule.Translated: Un árbol que produce manzanas duras de piel verde clara y pulpa crujiente y jugosa. Su sabor es agrio y ácido. Conservan su firmeza al hornearse, por lo que son muy populares en repostería, especialmente en tartas, donde se pueden endulzar.

Rule.Original: Also known as the cherry blossom, Sakura trees produce small fruits known as sakuranbo, small cherries that do not have much flesh beyond the seed within. Due to their bitter taste, sakuranbo are not traditionally eaten raw, but these trees have been genetically modified to produce sweeter tasting fruits. This particular genus is quite beautiful, speckled with pink blossoms throughout, blooming fully each winter.

Due to their bitter taste, sakuranbo are not traditionally eaten raw, but these trees have been genetically modified to produce sweeter tasting fruits. This particular genus is quite beautiful, speckled with pink blossoms throughout, blooming fully each winter.
Rule.Translated: Los árboles sakura, también conocidos como cerezos en flor, producen unos frutos llamados sakuranbo: pequeñas cerezas con poca pulpa alrededor de la semilla. Por su sabor amargo, tradicionalmente no se comen crudas, pero estos árboles se han modificado genéticamente para producir frutos más dulces. Este género en concreto es muy bonito, cubierto de flores rosas que alcanzan su plena floración cada invierno.

Rule.Original: The apricot is a fruit that resembles the peach but much smaller, pale yellow or orange with some red shades. It is mainly consumed fresh, although it is also used to make some by-products like stewed fruit, jams, juices and dried apricots. Apricots have a high concentration of vitamin C. This variety of apricot tree is quite hardy, and they can be planted in stony soil.

Rule.Translated: El albaricoque es una fruta parecida al melocotón, pero mucho más pequeña, de color amarillo pálido o naranja con algunos tonos rojos. Se consume principalmente fresco, aunque también se utiliza para elaborar compotas, mermeladas, zumos y orejones. Tiene una elevada concentración de vitamina C. Esta variedad de albaricoquero es bastante resistente y se puede plantar en suelos pedregosos.

Rule.Original: The Damson plum tree, also archaically called the "damascene", is a bushy tree bearing a relatively small ovoid fruit with a distinctive, somewhat astringent taste, widely used for culinary purposes, particularly in fruit preserves and jams. Many cultures also dry-age plums into prunes for long-term preservation.

Many cultures also dry-age plums into prunes for long-term preservation.
Rule.Translated: El ciruelo damasceno es un árbol de porte arbustivo que produce una fruta ovoide relativamente pequeña, de sabor característico y algo astringente. Se utiliza mucho en la cocina, sobre todo en conservas y mermeladas. Muchas culturas también secan las ciruelas para conservarlas durante mucho tiempo como ciruelas pasas.

Rule.Original: A tall tropical tree adorned with a cluster of yellow, elongated berries. These trees have been genetically modified to resist the fungal infections that nearly caused their extinction in old Terra. The Gros Michel variety has a distinct taste, different from that of Cavendish variety bananas. Bananas are easy to harvest, since a whole "hand" can be cut at the same time.

Estos árboles se han modificado genéticamente para resistir las infecciones fúngicas que casi los extinguieron en la antigua Terra. La variedad Gros Michel tiene un sabor característico, distinto del de los plátanos Cavendish. Los plátanos son fáciles de cosechar, ya que se puede cortar una «mano» entera de una vez.

Rule.Original: A small citrus tree with fruit resembling miniature oranges, usually eaten plain or in fruit salads. Mandarins are smaller and oblate, rather than spherical, like the common oranges (which are a mandarin hybrid). The taste is considered less sour, as well as sweeter and stronger. Mandarin trees are well equipped for growing in humid environments and in wet soil.

Mandarin trees are well equipped for growing in humid environments and in wet soil.

Las mandarinas son más pequeñas y achatadas, en lugar de esféricas como las naranjas comunes, que son un híbrido de mandarina. Su sabor se considera menos ácido, más dulce y más intenso. Los mandarinos están bien adaptados a crecer en ambientes húmedos y suelos mojados.

Rule.Original: A bulbous, tender, tasty purplish-black fruit of the nightshade family. Aubergines or eggplants are great in a variety of dishes, and the Black Beauty variety is delicious grilled, baked and stir-fried. Flourishes in warm weather.

Rule.Translated: Hierba forrajera cultivada. Crece donde haya algo de luz y un suelo mínimamente fértil.

Rule.Original: Aggression is just a fact of life.
Rule.Raw: Aggression is just a fact of life.
Rule.Translated: La agresión es una realidad de la vida.

Rule.Original: A concentrated mixture of herbal essence extracted by grinding multiple raw herbs. Used in the crafting of medicine and healing potions.
Rule.Raw: A concentrated mixture of herbal essence extracted by grinding multiple raw herbs. Used in the crafting of medicine and healing potions.
Rule.Translated: Una mezcla concentrada de esencia herbal extraída al triturar varias hierbas crudas. Se utiliza para elaborar medicina y pociones curativas.

Rule.Original: Build water purification system and decrease the risk of disease.
Rule.Raw: Build water purification system and decrease the risk of disease.
Rule.Translated: Construye un sistema de purificación de agua y reduce el riesgo de enfermedades.

Rule.Original:
A sinister contraption designed to extract hemogen from an individual while maintaining their life force at the barest minimum. This dark and foreboding casket houses its occupant in a twilight state of existence with their body slowly drained of precious hemogen. Bound to their Draincasket, the occupant's survival depends on being fed regularly, as they can still starve to death.

Produces hemogen packs a day as long as the occupant has food and the casket is connected to a hemogen network. The amount of hemogen packs depends on the occupant's hunger rate - someone with a worse metabolic efficiency will produce more hemogen packs while using proportionally more nutrition to do so. If deprived of food, the casket will eventually kill its occupant.

If connected to a nutrient paste network it will feed its occupant using its stored nutrients.

Rule.Translated:
Un siniestro aparato diseñado para extraer hemógeno de una persona mientras mantiene su fuerza vital al mínimo imprescindible. Este hemosarcófago oscuro y amenazante mantiene a su ocupante en un estado de existencia crepuscular mientras drena lentamente su valioso hemógeno. La supervivencia de quien está confinado en él depende de recibir comida con regularidad, pues aún puede morir de hambre.

Produce paquetes de hemógeno cada día mientras el ocupante tenga comida y el hemosarcófago esté conectado a una red de hemógeno. La cantidad depende del ritmo de hambre del ocupante: alguien con peor eficiencia metabólica producirá más paquetes y consumirá proporcionalmente más nutrientes. Si se queda sin comida, el hemosarcófago terminará matando a su ocupante.

Si está conectado a una red de pasta nutritiva, alimentará al ocupante con los nutrientes almacenados.
barril de fermentación de vino de miel

Rule.Original: A very simple barrel, held together with a series of mortise and tenon joints. Can turn honey into honey-wine.
Rule.Raw: A very simple barrel, held together with a series of mortise and tenon joints. Can turn honey into honey-wine.
Rule.Translated: Un barril muy sencillo unido mediante ensamblajes de caja y espiga. Permite transformar miel en vino de miel.

Rule.Original: A drink akin to wine, made of fermented honey and water, aged in a simple barrel. This sweet, crisp drink is known be nursed over time and has a reputation of being particularly comforting. Consuming honey-wine lowers psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A drink akin to wine, made of fermented honey and water, aged in a simple barrel. This sweet, crisp drink is known be nursed over time and has a reputation of being particularly comforting. Consuming honey-wine lowers psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Una bebida similar al vino, hecha de miel y agua fermentadas y envejecida en un barril sencillo. Esta bebida dulce y fresca suele beberse lentamente y tiene fama de resultar especialmente reconfortante. Consumir vino de miel reduce la sensibilidad psíquica.
una embriaguez de vino de miel

Rule.Original: Honey-wine in the bloodstream. It makes people happy, but reduces capacities. Slightly reduces psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: Honey-wine in the bloodstream. It makes people happy, but reduces capacities. Slightly reduces psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Vino de miel en la sangre. Alegra a las personas, pero reduce sus capacidades. Disminuye ligeramente la sensibilidad psíquica.

Rule.Original: A wooden enclosure built specifically to support a vulture bee colony originating from the regions of House Oswin. Unlike typical bees, they consume carrion and produce a smokey and savory honey.
Rule.Raw: A wooden enclosure built specifically to support a vulture bee colony originating from the regions of House Oswin. Unlike typical bees, they consume carrion and produce a smokey and savory honey.
Rule.Translated: Un recinto de madera construido específicamente para albergar una colonia de abejas buitre procedente de las tierras de la Casa Oswin. A diferencia de las abejas corrientes, se alimentan de carroña y producen una miel ahumada y sabrosa.

Objetos permitidos: todo excepto alimentos, cadáveres y trozos de piedra

Rule.Original:
A collection of wooden crates designed for storing mass quantities of goods and valuables. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 16 Stack per tile: 4
Allowed items: Everything except Foods, Corpses and Chunks

Rule.Original: 「喂喂喂，又是你们呀，找我有什么事吗？」
Rule.Raw: 「喂喂喂，又是你们呀，找我有什么事吗？」
Rule.Translated: «¡Eh, eh! ¿Vosotros otra vez? ¿Qué queréis esta vez?»

Rule.Original: 「哟，还活着呢？可以嘛～这世道真是没个消停。自从某个闪耀世界的机械族造反之后，咱们人类和他们之间就没一刻太平，现在连附近的中寰世界都快给他们洗了，还好是他们没搞出超光速，不然我们连窝在边缘世界过日子的愿望都泡汤了。」
Rule.Raw: 「哟，还活着呢？可以嘛～这世道真是没个消停。自从某个闪耀世界的机械族造反之后，咱们人类和他们之间就没一刻太平，现在连附近的中寰世界都快给他们洗了，还好是他们没搞出超光速，不然我们连窝在边缘世界过日子的愿望都泡汤了。」
Rule.Translated: «¿Todavía seguís vivos? Nada mal. Este caos nunca termina. Desde aquella rebelión de mecanoides en un mundo brillante, los humanos y ellos no han dejado de luchar. Hasta los mundos intermedios cercanos están siendo invadidos. Menos mal que todavía no dominan el viaje FTL; de lo contrario, ni siquiera podríamos vivir tranquilos aquí, en el borde.»

Rule.Original: 「生存建议？那当然，多造点激光点防御炮塔？现在的机械族精得很，还会用迫击炮偷家。点防御不仅能干掉炮弹，就连魔王弹都能拦呢」
Rule.Raw: 「生存建议？那当然，多造点激光点防御炮塔？现在的机械族精得很，还会用迫击炮偷家。点防御不仅能干掉炮弹，就连魔王弹都能拦呢」
Rule.Translated: «¿Consejos para sobrevivir? ¡Construid muchas torretas láser de defensa puntual! Los mecanoides modernos atacan por sorpresa con morteros. La defensa puntual destruye sus proyectiles, ¡incluso las ojivas demoníacas!»

Rule.Original: 「机械族能隐身？不是早把反隐雷达的图纸发你了吗？前线建一个呗？我记得咱家那边自研的机械族里好像也有一个能反隐的，你掂量下哪个合适？」
Rule.Raw: 「机械族能隐身？不是早把反隐雷达的图纸发你了吗？前线建一个呗？我记得咱家那边自研的机械族里好像也有一个能反隐的，你掂量下哪个合适？」
Rule.Translated: «¿Mecanoides invisibles? ¿No os envié ya los planos del radar de detección? Construid uno en primera línea. O... espera, nuestros propios mecanoides también tienen un detector de invisibilidad. Elegid lo que os convenga.»

Rule.Original: 「你们最近是不是碰上了机械族泰坦？对，就是那些巨大的、像能把山拆了似的家伙。听好了，用信标可以召唤他们作战，打赢了还能学他们的构造，不过……能不能活着回来，就看你们造化了。」
Rule.Raw: 「你们最近是不是碰上了机械族泰坦？对，就是那些巨大的、像能把山拆了似的家伙。听好了，用信标可以召唤他们作战，打赢了还能学他们的构造，不过……能不能活着回来，就看你们造化了。」
Rule.Translated: «¿Os habéis encontrado con un titán mecanoide? ¿Uno de esos gigantes capaces de arrasar montañas? Usad balizas para convocarlos. Si ganáis, podréis estudiar su construcción... siempre que sobreviváis.»

Rule.Original: 「说起来你们势力范围内那座破烂的机械族建筑，应该是个‘战争信标’。激活它，会引来机械族主力入侵，不过也能解析一些隐藏科技。是赌一把还是保守点，看你们咯～当地人倒是可能会感激你，毕竟你吸引了火力。」
Rule.Raw: 「说起来你们势力范围内那座破烂的机械族建筑，应该是个‘战争信标’。激活它，会引来机械族主力入侵，不过也能解析一些隐藏科技。是赌一把还是保守点，看你们咯～当地人倒是可能会感激你，毕竟你吸引了火力。」
Rule.Translated: «Esa estructura mecanoide en ruinas de vuestro territorio es una baliza de tribulación. Activadla para atraer a las legiones mecanoides y descifrar tecnologías ocultas. ¿Os la jugáis o vais a lo seguro? Quizá los lugareños os agradezcan que desviéis el fuego enemigo.»

Rule.Original: 「要不要我给你们连线点商船？有几家贸易商和我们关系不错。你问我们平时卖些什么？艺术品、衣服、奢侈食品啥的……你们要来点吗？」
Rule.Raw: 「要不要我给你们连线点商船？有几家贸易商和我们关系不错。你问我们平时卖些什么？艺术品、衣服、奢侈食品啥的……你们要来点吗？」
Rule.Translated: «¿Queréis que contacte con algunos mercaderes? Conozco a varios con buenas naves comerciales. ¿Qué vendemos? Arte, ropa elegante, alimentos de lujo... ¿queréis algo?»

Rule.Original: 我以为世界上就我这么闲，我在殖民地里啥也不干，他们一开始把我招进来是想要我做厨师，结果来了才发现我不会做饭。老大辛苦跑商给我带了几个学习机回来想要我当厨子，结果后面来了个机械师，她的厨艺机把我的活给抢了。现在的我负责帮厨艺机端盘子和接电话，老大说我口才还是不错的。
Rule.Raw: 我以为世界上就我这么闲，我在殖民地里啥也不干，他们一开始把我招进来是想要我做厨师，结果来了才发现我不会做饭。老大辛苦跑商给我带了几个学习机回来想要我当厨子，结果后面来了个机械师，她的厨艺机把我的活给抢了。现在的我负责帮厨艺机端盘子和接电话，老大说我口才还是不错的。
Rule.Translated: Creía que era la única persona ociosa por aquí. No hago nada en la colonia: me contrataron como cocinero y luego descubrieron que no sé cocinar. El jefe trajo entrenadores de habilidades de sus viajes comerciales para enseñarme, pero después llegó una mecanitora. Su mecanoide cocinero me quitó el trabajo. Ahora llevo platos y contesto llamadas. El jefe dice que al menos se me da bien hablar.

Rule.Original: 好啦，你快去干自己的事情，我看你们那还挺破的，还不快好好发展一下。
Rule.Raw: 好啦，你快去干自己的事情，我看你们那还挺破的，还不快好好发展一下。
Rule.Translated: ¡Bueno, ponte a lo tuyo! Tu colonia sigue hecha un desastre; ¿no deberías arreglarla?

Rule.Original: "Hey hey, you guys again? What's up this time?"
Rule.Raw: "Hey hey, you guys again? What's up this time?"
Rule.Translated: «¡Eh, eh! ¿Vosotros otra vez? ¿Qué queréis esta vez?»

Rule.Original: 「"Whoa, still breathing? Not bad~ This chaos never ends. Since that Glitterworld mechanoid uprising, humans and bots have been at constant war. Even nearby Midworlds are getting overrun. Thank the void they haven't cracked FTL yet - otherwise we'd lose our last scrap of peace out here on the Rim."
Rule.Raw: 「"Whoa, still breathing? Not bad~ This chaos never ends. Since that Glitterworld mechanoid uprising, humans and bots have been at constant war. Even nearby Midworlds are getting overrun. Thank the void they haven't cracked FTL yet - otherwise we'd lose our last scrap of peace out here on the Rim."
Rule.Translated: «¿Todavía seguís vivos? Nada mal. Este caos nunca termina. Desde aquella rebelión de mecanoides en un mundo brillante, los humanos y ellos no han dejado de luchar. Hasta los mundos intermedios cercanos están siendo invadidos. Menos mal que todavía no dominan el viaje FTL; de lo contrario, ni siquiera podríamos vivir tranquilos aquí, en el borde.»

Rule.Original: "Survival advice? Pile up laser point-defense turrets! Modern mechanoids ambush with mortars. Point-defense shreds shells - even demon warheads!"
Rule.Raw: "Survival advice? Pile up laser point-defense turrets! Modern mechanoids ambush with mortars. Point-defense shreds shells - even demon warheads!"
Rule.Translated: «¿Consejos para sobrevivir? ¡Construid muchas torretas láser de defensa puntual! Los mecanoides modernos atacan por sorpresa con morteros. La defensa puntual destruye sus proyectiles, ¡incluso las ojivas demoníacas!»

Rule.Original: "Invisible mechs? Didn't I send you the sensor blueprint? Build a scanner upfront. Or... wait, our homebrew mechanoids have an invis-detector too. Pick whichever fits."
Rule.Raw: "Invisible mechs? Didn't I send you the sensor blueprint? Build a scanner upfront. Or... wait, our homebrew mechanoids have an invis-detector too. Pick whichever fits."
Rule.Translated: «¿Mecanoides invisibles? ¿No os envié ya los planos del radar de detección? Construid uno en primera línea. O... espera, nuestros propios mecanoides también tienen un detector de invisibilidad. Elegid lo que os convenga.»

Rule.Original: "Facing a mechanoid titan? Those mountain-crushers? Use beacons to summon them. Win, and you might reverse-engineer them... if you survive."
Rule.Raw: "Facing a mechanoid titan? Those mountain-crushers? Use beacons to summon them. Win, and you might reverse-engineer them... if you survive."
Rule.Translated: «¿Os habéis encontrado con un titán mecanoide? ¿Uno de esos gigantes capaces de arrasar montañas? Usad balizas para convocarlos. Si ganáis, podréis estudiar su construcción... siempre que sobreviváis.»

Rule.Original: "That broken structure in your territory? It's a Tribulation Beacon. Activate it to lure mechanoid legions - and decrypt hidden tech. Gamble or play safe? Locals might thank you for drawing fire though~"
Rule.Raw: "That broken structure in your territory? It's a Tribulation Beacon. Activate it to lure mechanoid legions - and decrypt hidden tech. Gamble or play safe? Locals might thank you for drawing fire though~"
