Rule.Translated: «Esa estructura mecanoide en ruinas de vuestro territorio es una baliza de tribulación. Activadla para atraer a las legiones mecanoides y descifrar tecnologías ocultas. ¿Os la jugáis o vais a lo seguro? Quizá los lugareños os agradezcan que desviéis el fuego enemigo.»

Rule.Original: "Want me to ping some merchants? Got contacts with decent trade ships. What we sell? Art, fancy clothes, luxury snacks... want some?"
Rule.Raw: "Want me to ping some merchants? Got contacts with decent trade ships. What we sell? Art, fancy clothes, luxury snacks... want some?"
Rule.Translated: «¿Queréis que contacte con algunos mercaderes? Conozco a varios con buenas naves comerciales. ¿Qué vendemos? Arte, ropa elegante, alimentos de lujo... ¿queréis algo?»

Rule.Original: Thought I was the only idle soul around. I do nothing at the colony—they recruited me as a chef, turns out I can't cook. Boss hauled skill trainers from trade runs to teach me, but then a Mechanitor arrived. Her cooking mech stole my job. Now I serve plates and answer calls. Boss says I 'talk a good game' though.
Rule.Raw: Thought I was the only idle soul around. I do nothing at the colony—they recruited me as a chef, turns out I can't cook. Boss hauled skill trainers from trade runs to teach me, but then a Mechanitor arrived. Her cooking mech stole my job. Now I serve plates and answer calls. Boss says I 'talk a good game' though.
Rule.Translated: Creía que era la única persona ociosa por aquí. No hago nada en la colonia: me contrataron como cocinero y luego descubrieron que no sé cocinar. El jefe trajo entrenadores de habilidades de sus viajes comerciales para enseñarme, pero después llegó una mecanitora. Su mecanoide cocinero me quitó el trabajo. Ahora llevo platos y contesto llamadas. El jefe dice que al menos se me da bien hablar.

Rule.Original: Alright, scram! Your colony's still rundown—shouldn't you be fixing that?
Rule.Raw: Alright, scram! Your colony's still rundown—shouldn't you be fixing that?
Rule.Translated: ¡Bueno, ponte a lo tuyo! Tu colonia sigue hecha un desastre; ¿no deberías arreglarla?

Rule.Original: Playing the game in character mode lets you fully embody a colonist and control them with your keyboard.
Rule.Raw: Playing the game in character mode lets you fully embody a colonist and control them with your keyboard.
Rule.Translated: Jugar en modo personaje te permite encarnar a un colono y controlarlo con el teclado.

Rule.Original: Adds an ITitheBudgetModifier interface that WorldObjectComps can implement. Allows for 'injection' of additional value into a settlement's tithe budget for a given resource
Rule.Raw: Adds an ITitheBudgetModifier interface that WorldObjectComps can implement. Allows for 'injection' of additional value into a settlement's tithe budget for a given resource
Rule.Translated: Añade una interfaz ITitheBudgetModifier que pueden implementar los WorldObjectComps. Permite incorporar valor adicional al presupuesto de diezmos de un asentamiento para un recurso determinado.

Rule.Original: Reworked FactionColonies class and the settings
Rule.Raw: Reworked FactionColonies class and the settings
Rule.Translated: Reorganizada la clase FactionColonies y sus ajustes.

Rule.Original: Refactored settlements to use a single WorldSettlementFC class
Rule.Raw: Refactored settlements to use a single WorldSettlementFC class
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos utilizan ahora una única clase WorldSettlementFC.

Rule.Original: Settlement types and resources defined through XML defs
Rule.Raw: Settlement types and resources defined through XML defs
Rule.Translated: Los tipos de asentamiento y los recursos se definen mediante definiciones XML.

Rule.Original: Major UI rework (redid most of the mod's windows)
Rule.Raw: Major UI rework (redid most of the mod's windows)
Rule.Translated: Gran renovación de la interfaz: se han rehecho la mayoría de las ventanas del mod.

Rule.Original: Road buildings uses a Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) for more organic-looking road networks
Rule.Raw: Road buildings uses a Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) for more organic-looking road networks
Rule.Translated: La construcción de carreteras utiliza un árbol de expansión mínima (MST) para crear redes con un aspecto más natural.

Rule.Original: Faction policies and traits converted into defs
Rule.Raw: Faction policies and traits converted into defs
Rule.Translated: Las políticas y los rasgos de facción se han convertido en definiciones.

Rule.Original: Repurposed old, unused policies into three new categories of Edicts
Rule.Raw: Repurposed old, unused policies into three new categories of Edicts
Rule.Translated: Las antiguas políticas sin utilizar se han reaprovechado en tres nuevas categorías de edictos.

Rule.Original: Reworked events to give the player a choice over how they respond
Rule.Raw: Reworked events to give the player a choice over how they respond
Rule.Translated: Los sucesos se han rediseñado para que el jugador pueda elegir cómo responder.

Rule.Original: Reworked taxes: a snapshot of a settlement's production is taken each day. At tax time, the player recieves taxes based on the average of these daily snapshots
Rule.Raw: Reworked taxes: a snapshot of a settlement's production is taken each day. At tax time, the player recieves taxes based on the average of these daily snapshots
Rule.Translated: Impuestos rediseñados: cada día se registra la producción del asentamiento. Al cobrar los impuestos, el jugador recibe una cantidad basada en la media de estos registros diarios.

Rule.Original: Numerous bug fixes to the manual battle system. It has been tentatively re-enabled. If it remains buggy, it may be disabled again
Rule.Raw: Numerous bug fixes to the manual battle system. It has been tentatively re-enabled. If it remains buggy, it may be disabled again
Rule.Translated: Numerosas correcciones del sistema de batallas manuales. Se ha vuelto a activar de forma provisional. Si sigue dando problemas, podría desactivarse de nuevo.

Rule.Original: Military threat levels reworked. Settlement raids scale more
Rule.Raw: Military threat levels reworked. Settlement raids scale more
Rule.Translated: Rediseñados los niveles de amenaza militar. Las incursiones contra asentamientos escalan más.

Rule.Original: Numerous changes in the name of extensibility (refer to the Docs)
Rule.Raw: Numerous changes in the name of extensibility (refer to the Docs)
Rule.Translated: Numerosos cambios para facilitar las ampliaciones; consulta la documentación.

Rule.Original: Compatibility patches for Humanoid Alien Races, Combat Extended, RimWar, World Domination, and Faction Territories & Vassalage. Some still need testing
Rule.Raw: Compatibility patches for Humanoid Alien Races, Combat Extended, RimWar, World Domination, and Faction Territories & Vassalage. Some still need testing
Rule.Translated: Parches de compatibilidad para Humanoid Alien Races, Combat Extended, RimWar, World Domination y Faction Territories & Vassalage. Algunos todavía necesitan pruebas.

Rule.Original: Numerous other bugfixes; too many to note here
Rule.Raw: Numerous other bugfixes; too many to note here
Rule.Translated: Muchas otras correcciones de errores, demasiadas para enumerarlas aquí.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: some delivery types would deliver goods 1-3 at a time instead of stacking them
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: some delivery types would deliver goods 1-3 at a time instead of stacking them
Rule.Translated: Corrección: algunos tipos de entrega transportaban 1-3 productos a la vez en lugar de apilarlos.

Rule.Original: Update the event system so that events won't stack on the same settlement
Rule.Raw: Update the event system so that events won't stack on the same settlement
Rule.Translated: Actualizado el sistema de sucesos para impedir que se acumulen en el mismo asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Update event chains to have the proper incompatible tags, so that incompatible events won't fire at the same time
Rule.Raw: Update event chains to have the proper incompatible tags, so that incompatible events won't fire at the same time
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas las cadenas de sucesos con las etiquetas de incompatibilidad adecuadas, para que los sucesos incompatibles no se activen al mismo tiempo.

Rule.Original: Add transpiler patch to fix an out-of-bounds error during VBGE map generation
Rule.Raw: Add transpiler patch to fix an out-of-bounds error during VBGE map generation
Rule.Translated: Añadido un parche de transpilación para corregir un error de índice fuera de los límites durante la generación de mapas de VBGE.

Rule.Original: Fix the spawning of defense turrets for settlements that have weapons production
Rule.Raw: Fix the spawning of defense turrets for settlements that have weapons production
Rule.Translated: Corregida la aparición de torretas defensivas en asentamientos con producción de armas.

Rule.Original: Extensiblity: tithe injections are properly reflected in the "net income" display on the settlement window
Rule.Raw: Extensiblity: tithe injections are properly reflected in the "net income" display on the settlement window
Rule.Translated: Ampliaciones: las aportaciones de diezmos se reflejan correctamente en los «ingresos netos» de la ventana del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Added a small indicator to the tithing tab of the settlement window, indicating if a resource has a non-zero tithe budget
Rule.Raw: Added a small indicator to the tithing tab of the settlement window, indicating if a resource has a non-zero tithe budget
Rule.Translated: Añadido un pequeño indicador en la pestaña de diezmos de la ventana del asentamiento que muestra si un recurso tiene un presupuesto de diezmos distinto de cero.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue where auto-resolve won't properly auto-resolve bills with a negative silver amount
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue where auto-resolve won't properly auto-resolve bills with a negative silver amount
Rule.Translated: Corregido un problema que impedía resolver automáticamente facturas con una cantidad negativa de plata.

Rule.Original: Changes drop pod deliveries to target the tax spot, if it exists and is valid
Rule.Raw: Changes drop pod deliveries to target the tax spot, if it exists and is valid
Rule.Translated: Las entregas mediante cápsulas de transporte apuntan al punto de impuestos, si existe y es válido.

Rule.Original: Adds an "Upgrade" button to each upgradable settlement in the faction overview
Rule.Raw: Adds an "Upgrade" button to each upgradable settlement in the faction overview
Rule.Translated: Añadido un botón «Mejorar» a cada asentamiento que puede mejorarse en la vista general de la facción.

Rule.Original: Adds an "Upgrading..." progress bar to each actively upgrading settlement in the faction overview
Rule.Raw: Adds an "Upgrading..." progress bar to each actively upgrading settlement in the faction overview
Rule.Translated: Añadida una barra de progreso «Mejorando...» a cada asentamiento que se está mejorando en la vista general de la facción.

Rule.Original: Adds a new button "ButtonFlatIcon" to UIUtil
Rule.Raw: Adds a new button "ButtonFlatIcon" to UIUtil
Rule.Translated: Añadido un nuevo botón «ButtonFlatIcon» a UIUtil.

Rule.Original: Fixes an issue with how the minimum time between events is calculated.
Rule.Raw: Fixes an issue with how the minimum time between events is calculated.
Rule.Translated: Corregido el cálculo del tiempo mínimo entre sucesos.

Rule.Original: Change the RoadTick frequency from every 20 ticks to every 250
Rule.Raw: Change the RoadTick frequency from every 20 ticks to every 250
Rule.Translated: La frecuencia de RoadTick cambia de cada 20 ticks a cada 250.

Rule.Original: Update FCEventDef to include a restrictedBiomes field
Rule.Raw: Update FCEventDef to include a restrictedBiomes field
Rule.Translated: Actualizado FCEventDef para incluir un campo restrictedBiomes.

Rule.Original: Events now respect their allowed or restricted biomes
Rule.Raw: Events now respect their allowed or restricted biomes
Rule.Translated: Los sucesos respetan ahora los biomas permitidos o restringidos.

Rule.Original: Added restricted biomes to a handful of events
Rule.Raw: Added restricted biomes to a handful of events
Rule.Translated: Añadidos biomas restringidos a varios sucesos.

Rule.Original: Adds PColony to the Shattered Empire's enemy whitelist, allowing the PColony faction to properly mirror the player's relations with the Shattered Empire
Rule.Raw: Adds PColony to the Shattered Empire's enemy whitelist, allowing the PColony faction to properly mirror the player's relations with the Shattered Empire
Rule.Translated: Añadido PColony a la lista de enemigos permitidos del Imperio Fragmentado, para que la facción PColony refleje correctamente las relaciones del jugador con ese imperio.

Rule.Original: Adds a couple of patches to the goodwill- and relation-changing functions to keep PColony's faction relations in lockstep with the player's
Rule.Raw: Adds a couple of patches to the goodwill- and relation-changing functions to keep PColony's faction relations in lockstep with the player's
Rule.Translated: Añadidos varios parches a las funciones que cambian la buena voluntad y las relaciones, para mantener las relaciones de la facción PColony sincronizadas con las del jugador.

Rule.Original: Add "WeaponUnique" to the category blocklist of the weapons resource, thus blocking unique weapons from being tithed
Rule.Raw: Add "WeaponUnique" to the category blocklist of the weapons resource, thus blocking unique weapons from being tithed
Rule.Translated: Añadido «WeaponUnique» a las categorías bloqueadas del recurso de armas, impidiendo que las armas únicas se entreguen como diezmos.

Rule.Original: Block unique weapons from appearing in the weapon selection list for created military units
Rule.Raw: Block unique weapons from appearing in the weapon selection list for created military units
Rule.Translated: Las armas únicas ya no aparecen en la lista de selección de armas de las unidades militares creadas.

Rule.Original: Add "FCWeaponBlocklist_Merc" weapontag to block a weapon from being choosable for mercs
Rule.Raw: Add "FCWeaponBlocklist_Merc" weapontag to block a weapon from being choosable for mercs
Rule.Translated: Añadida la etiqueta de armas «FCWeaponBlocklist_Merc» para impedir que los mercenarios elijan un arma.

Rule.Original: Add "FCWeaponBlocklist_Craft" weapontag to more generally block a weapon from being crafted
Rule.Raw: Add "FCWeaponBlocklist_Craft" weapontag to more generally block a weapon from being crafted
Rule.Translated: Añadida la etiqueta de armas «FCWeaponBlocklist_Craft» para impedir de forma general la fabricación de un arma.

Rule.Original: Add an interface so that submods can inject their own information into a building's description in the building window
Rule.Raw: Add an interface so that submods can inject their own information into a building's description in the building window
Rule.Translated: Añadida una interfaz para que los mods complementarios incorporen información a la descripción de un edificio en la ventana de edificios.

Rule.Original: Add a 'baseSettlementType' to WorldSettlementDef and add inheritence-aware settlementtype checks to buildings
Rule.Raw: Add a 'baseSettlementType' to WorldSettlementDef and add inheritence-aware settlementtype checks to buildings
Rule.Translated: Añadido «baseSettlementType» a WorldSettlementDef y comprobaciones de tipos de asentamiento que tienen en cuenta la herencia para los edificios.

Rule.Original: SettlementType blocklists and allowlists on building Defs now proritize specificity; if a building blocks a parent settlementtype but allows a child type, then the building is allowed, and vice versa
Rule.Raw: SettlementType blocklists and allowlists on building Defs now proritize specificity; if a building blocks a parent settlementtype but allows a child type, then the building is allowed, and vice versa
Rule.Translated: Las listas de tipos de asentamiento bloqueados y permitidos de los edificios priorizan ahora el tipo más específico: si se bloquea un tipo padre pero se permite un tipo hijo, el edificio se permite, y viceversa.

Rule.Original: Minor changes to settlementDefs and building processing
Rule.Raw: Minor changes to settlementDefs and building processing
Rule.Translated: Pequeños cambios en settlementDefs y en el procesamiento de edificios.

Rule.Original: Wrap merc pawn destruction in a try-catch to gracefully handle errors
Rule.Raw: Wrap merc pawn destruction in a try-catch to gracefully handle errors
Rule.Translated: La destrucción de peones mercenarios se ejecuta dentro de un bloque try-catch para gestionar los errores correctamente.

Rule.Original: Validate pawnKindDef when loading and creating mercs
Rule.Raw: Validate pawnKindDef when loading and creating mercs
Rule.Translated: Se valida pawnKindDef al cargar y crear mercenarios.

Rule.Original: When a bill with a payment is allowed to come due (instead of paying it ahead of time), the player is sent a letter, and the affected settlements gain a small happiness and unrest penalty
Rule.Raw: When a bill with a payment is allowed to come due (instead of paying it ahead of time), the player is sent a letter, and the affected settlements gain a small happiness and unrest penalty
Rule.Translated: Cuando vence una factura con un pago pendiente, en lugar de pagarla por adelantado, el jugador recibe una carta y los asentamientos afectados sufren pequeñas penalizaciones de felicidad y agitación.

Rule.Original: Settlement prosperity now targets the average value of happiness, loyalty, and (inverted) unrest. Prosperity will slowly drift towards this value.
Rule.Raw: Settlement prosperity now targets the average value of happiness, loyalty, and (inverted) unrest. Prosperity will slowly drift towards this value.
Rule.Translated: La prosperidad del asentamiento tiende ahora a la media de la felicidad, la lealtad y la agitación invertida. Se ajusta lentamente hacia ese valor.

Rule.Original: Update the patch notes window to cut down redundant wording and to use less empty space
Rule.Raw: Update the patch notes window to cut down redundant wording and to use less empty space
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la ventana de notas de versión para reducir las frases repetidas y aprovechar mejor el espacio.

Rule.Original: Lets users change in the settings when the patch notes auto-open on game start (or if they even auto-open at all)
Rule.Raw: Lets users change in the settings when the patch notes auto-open on game start (or if they even auto-open at all)
Rule.Translated: Los usuarios pueden configurar cuándo se abren automáticamente las notas de versión al iniciar el juego, o impedir que se abran.

Rule.Original: Update packageID Saakra.Empire -> Matatahias.Empire, and update other namespaces accordingly. This will "break" compatibility patches that target old Empire, but this is intentional, as those old patches are unlikely to work anyways.
Rule.Raw: Update packageID Saakra.Empire -> Matatahias.Empire, and update other namespaces accordingly. This will "break" compatibility patches that target old Empire, but this is intentional, as those old patches are unlikely to work anyways.
Rule.Translated: Actualizado el packageID de Saakra.Empire a Matatahias.Empire y los demás espacios de nombres correspondientes. Esto rompe intencionadamente los parches de compatibilidad dirigidos al antiguo Empire, porque es poco probable que esos parches sigan funcionando.

Rule.Original: Reorganize the mod settings to put events settings and military settings in their own tabs
Rule.Raw: Reorganize the mod settings to put events settings and military settings in their own tabs
Rule.Translated: Reorganizados los ajustes del mod: los sucesos y los ajustes militares tienen ahora sus propias pestañas.

Rule.Original: Empire Events can be individually disabled in the settings
Rule.Raw: Empire Events can be individually disabled in the settings
Rule.Translated: Los sucesos de Empire se pueden desactivar individualmente en los ajustes.

Rule.Original: Adds a dampening factor to how much Military Efficiency affects the outcome of auto-resolve battles (its effect was a little too strong). The dampening factor can be changed in the settings.
Rule.Raw: Adds a dampening factor to how much Military Efficiency affects the outcome of auto-resolve battles (its effect was a little too strong). The dampening factor can be changed in the settings.
Rule.Translated: Añadido un factor de atenuación al efecto de la eficiencia militar en las batallas resueltas automáticamente, que era demasiado fuerte. El factor se puede cambiar en los ajustes.

Rule.Original: The "atk x / def x * <budget>" label in the main military tab is now wider, so the text shouldn't wrap
Rule.Raw: The "atk x / def x * <budget>" label in the main military tab is now wider, so the text shouldn't wrap
Rule.Translated: La etiqueta «atk x / def x * <budget>» de la pestaña militar principal es ahora más ancha para evitar que el texto salte de línea.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: deploying a squad to a map and then leaving the map before the squad does can result in the squad's settlement being stuck in the "Deployed" state
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: deploying a squad to a map and then leaving the map before the squad does can result in the squad's settlement being stuck in the "Deployed" state
Rule.Translated: Corrección: desplegar un escuadrón en un mapa y abandonarlo antes que el escuadrón podía dejar su asentamiento atascado en el estado «Desplegado».

Rule.Original: Changed auto-resolve defense battles: if a defending settlement is being reinforced by another (e.g. through auto-defend), then the combined defensive force uses a mix of the military efficiency of the defending settlement and the reinforcing settlement
Rule.Raw: Changed auto-resolve defense battles: if a defending settlement is being reinforced by another (e.g. through auto-defend), then the combined defensive force uses a mix of the military efficiency of the defending settlement and the reinforcing settlement
Rule.Translated: Cambian las batallas defensivas automáticas: si otro asentamiento refuerza al defensor, por ejemplo mediante defensa automática, la fuerza combinada utiliza una mezcla de la eficiencia militar de ambos asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Loosens restrictions on what settlements can auto-defend
Rule.Raw: Loosens restrictions on what settlements can auto-defend
Rule.Translated: Se flexibilizan las restricciones sobre qué asentamientos pueden defender automáticamente.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the settlementMilitaryLevel field would sometimes not update when it should, resulting in a settlement that *should* be auto-defending, not actually being chosen to auto-defend
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the settlementMilitaryLevel field would sometimes not update when it should, resulting in a settlement that *should* be auto-defending, not actually being chosen to auto-defend
Rule.Translated: Corrección: settlementMilitaryLevel a veces no se actualizaba cuando debía, por lo que un asentamiento que tenía que defender automáticamente no era seleccionado.

Rule.Original: Adds a 'allowedSettlementTypes' and 'blockedSettlementTypes' fields to FCEventDef
Rule.Raw: Adds a 'allowedSettlementTypes' and 'blockedSettlementTypes' fields to FCEventDef
Rule.Translated: Añadidos los campos «allowedSettlementTypes» y «blockedSettlementTypes» a FCEventDef.

Rule.Original: Adds a call to ChangeTick in CheckMilitaryUtilForErrors, allowing existing guards to exit early
Rule.Raw: Adds a call to ChangeTick in CheckMilitaryUtilForErrors, allowing existing guards to exit early
Rule.Translated: Añadida una llamada a ChangeTick en CheckMilitaryUtilForErrors para permitir que las condiciones de salida existentes terminen antes.

Rule.Original: Update a couple of tests to reflect recent tweaking of mechanics
Rule.Raw: Update a couple of tests to reflect recent tweaking of mechanics
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas algunas pruebas para reflejar los ajustes recientes de las mecánicas.

Rule.Original: Use PColony_Fighter pawnkind as a fallback when generating mercenarys instead of calling RandomPawnKind
Rule.Raw: Use PColony_Fighter pawnkind as a fallback when generating mercenarys instead of calling RandomPawnKind
Rule.Translated: Se utiliza el tipo de peón PColony_Fighter como alternativa al generar mercenarios, en lugar de llamar a RandomPawnKind.

Rule.Original: Adds baseUnlockedBuildings and perLevelUnlockedBuildings fields to WorldSettlementDef. The number of buildings unlocked at any given level is baseUnlockedBuildings + Floor(perLevelUnlockedBuildings * settlement level)
Rule.Raw: Adds baseUnlockedBuildings and perLevelUnlockedBuildings fields to WorldSettlementDef. The number of buildings unlocked at any given level is baseUnlockedBuildings + Floor(perLevelUnlockedBuildings * settlement level)
Rule.Translated: Añadidos baseUnlockedBuildings y perLevelUnlockedBuildings a WorldSettlementDef. Los edificios desbloqueados en cada nivel son baseUnlockedBuildings + Floor(perLevelUnlockedBuildings * nivel del asentamiento).

Rule.Original: When playing with multiple races (i.e. with HAR), Empire creates runtime pawnKindDefs for each race. But, as runtime-created defs, they cannot be resolved when loading. This fix adds a patch to loading: on encountering a 'runtime def', the def is replaced with its template version. Then, once we actually recreate the runtime def, we assign it to the pawns that need it
Rule.Raw: When playing with multiple races (i.e. with HAR), Empire creates runtime pawnKindDefs for each race. But, as runtime-created defs, they cannot be resolved when loading. This fix adds a patch to loading: on encountering a 'runtime def', the def is replaced with its template version. Then, once we actually recreate the runtime def, we assign it to the pawns that need it
Rule.Translated: Al jugar con varias razas mediante HAR, Empire crea pawnKindDefs para cada raza durante la ejecución, pero no puede resolverlos al cargar. Este parche sustituye cada definición dinámica por su plantilla durante la carga y la reasigna a los peones cuando vuelve a crearse.

Rule.Original: Add requiredPolicies and requirementMode fields to FCPolicyDef. If requiredPolicies is not empty, then all (or any) of the given policies must be active in order for the main def to be selectable
Rule.Raw: Add requiredPolicies and requirementMode fields to FCPolicyDef. If requiredPolicies is not empty, then all (or any) of the given policies must be active in order for the main def to be selectable
Rule.Translated: Añadidos requiredPolicies y requirementMode a FCPolicyDef. Si requiredPolicies no está vacío, deben estar activas todas las políticas indicadas, o cualquiera de ellas según el modo, para seleccionar la definición principal.

Rule.Original: Remove the "Reset" button from the main military tab, and move its functionality to a "Reset Squad" float menu option for the Military button on the Settlement Window. Comes with a confirmation dialog
Rule.Raw: Remove the "Reset" button from the main military tab, and move its functionality to a "Reset Squad" float menu option for the Military button on the Settlement Window. Comes with a confirmation dialog
Rule.Translated: El botón «Restablecer» se elimina de la pestaña militar principal. Su función pasa a «Restablecer escuadrón», dentro del menú del botón Militar en la ventana del asentamiento, con un diálogo de confirmación.

Rule.Original: Injured mercs heal gradually over time, instead of instantly
Rule.Raw: Injured mercs heal gradually over time, instead of instantly
Rule.Translated: Los mercenarios heridos se curan gradualmente con el tiempo, en lugar de hacerlo al instante.

Rule.Original: Updates the Manage Units window to replace the 6 hard-coded apparel slots with being able to choose any apparel
Rule.Raw: Updates the Manage Units window to replace the 6 hard-coded apparel slots with being able to choose any apparel
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la ventana de gestión de unidades: las 6 casillas de ropa fijas se sustituyen por la posibilidad de elegir cualquier prenda.

Rule.Original: Adds "Doctrine" edicts, unlocked at faction level 3, that influence how Empire defense is handled. Largest impact on auto-battle mode
Rule.Raw: Adds "Doctrine" edicts, unlocked at faction level 3, that influence how Empire defense is handled. Largest impact on auto-battle mode
Rule.Translated: Añadidos edictos de «Doctrina», desbloqueados en el nivel de facción 3, que influyen en la defensa de Empire, especialmente en las batallas automáticas.

Rule.Original: Adds a couple of new Tax edicts
Rule.Raw: Adds a couple of new Tax edicts

Rule.Original: Store patch notes in individual files based on minor version, rather than 1 monolithic file
Rule.Raw: Store patch notes in individual files based on minor version, rather than 1 monolithic file
Rule.Translated: Las notas de versión se guardan en archivos individuales según la versión menor, en lugar de en 1 archivo monolítico.

Rule.Original: Sort patch notes in-game based on version number, rather than date
Rule.Raw: Sort patch notes in-game based on version number, rather than date
Rule.Translated: Las notas de versión se ordenan dentro del juego por número de versión, en lugar de por fecha.

Rule.Original: Did some code cleanup and file reorg
Rule.Raw: Did some code cleanup and file reorg
Rule.Translated: Limpieza del código y reorganización de archivos.

Rule.Original: Removes organic organs from the Medicine resource. Where did they all come from, anyways...?
Rule.Raw: Removes organic organs from the Medicine resource. Where did they all come from, anyways...?
Rule.Translated: Se eliminan los órganos biológicos del recurso de medicina. ¿De dónde salían tantos, por cierto...?

Rule.Original: Adds drugs to the Medicine resource
Rule.Raw: Adds drugs to the Medicine resource
Rule.Translated: Se añaden drogas al recurso de medicina.

Rule.Original: Adds two hediffs (a buff and a debuff) that impact a pawn's shooting accuracy, melee hit chance, melee dodge change, aiming dely factor, and move speed based on their combat efficiency
Rule.Raw: Adds two hediffs (a buff and a debuff) that impact a pawn's shooting accuracy, melee hit chance, melee dodge change, aiming dely factor, and move speed based on their combat efficiency
Rule.Translated: Añadidas dos afecciones, una bonificación y una penalización, que modifican la precisión de disparo, la probabilidad de acertar y esquivar cuerpo a cuerpo, el factor de demora al apuntar y la velocidad de movimiento según la eficiencia de combate.

Rule.Original: Fixes the animal event reward to properly include all animals in its filter
Rule.Raw: Fixes the animal event reward to properly include all animals in its filter
Rule.Translated: Corregida la recompensa de animales de los sucesos para que su filtro incluya correctamente todos los animales.

Rule.Original: Disables pawn relation generation for Empire-generated pawns
Rule.Raw: Disables pawn relation generation for Empire-generated pawns
Rule.Translated: Desactivada la generación de relaciones para los peones creados por Empire.

Rule.Original: Can set primary and secondary faction colors in the faction customize menu
Rule.Raw: Can set primary and secondary faction colors in the faction customize menu
Rule.Translated: Se pueden elegir los colores principal y secundario de la facción en el menú de personalización.

Rule.Original: Can set individual apparel colors for military units in the Manage Units menu
Rule.Raw: Can set individual apparel colors for military units in the Manage Units menu
Rule.Translated: Se pueden elegir colores individuales para la ropa de las unidades militares en el menú de gestión de unidades.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: squads that are deployed to a map, and then told to leave, will not actually enter cooldown, leaving their settlement stuck in a "Deployed" state
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: squads that are deployed to a map, and then told to leave, will not actually enter cooldown, leaving their settlement stuck in a "Deployed" state
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los escuadrones desplegados en un mapa a los que se ordenaba retirarse no entraban en recuperación y dejaban el asentamiento atascado en «Desplegado».
Rediseñada la ventana de personalización de la facción.

Rule.Original: Allows player to choose custom xenotypes for Human military units
Rule.Raw: Allows player to choose custom xenotypes for Human military units
Rule.Translated: El jugador puede elegir xenotipos personalizados para las unidades militares humanas.

Rule.Original: Replaces the floatmenu for settlement type selection with a full dialog.
Rule.Raw: Replaces the floatmenu for settlement type selection with a full dialog.
Rule.Translated: El menú de selección del tipo de asentamiento se sustituye por un diálogo completo.

Rule.Original: Augments the building window with a toggle to show buildings that are locked by research or tech level
Rule.Raw: Augments the building window with a toggle to show buildings that are locked by research or tech level
Rule.Translated: La ventana de edificios incorpora una opción para mostrar edificios bloqueados por investigación o nivel tecnológico.

Rule.Original: Fixes faction-level stat calculations to actually take faction-level events into account.
Rule.Raw: Fixes faction-level stat calculations to actually take faction-level events into account.
Rule.Translated: Corregidos los cálculos de estadísticas de facción para que incluyan realmente los sucesos de facción.

Rule.Original: Adds 'MayRequire' guards for the Odyssey DLC on all defs/xml patches for space stuff
Rule.Raw: Adds 'MayRequire' guards for the Odyssey DLC on all defs/xml patches for space stuff
Rule.Translated: Añadidas condiciones «MayRequire» del DLC Odyssey a todas las definiciones y parches XML relacionados con el espacio.

Rule.Original: Adds a canTithe field to ResourceTypeDef. If false, the resource cannot be tithed.
Rule.Raw: Adds a canTithe field to ResourceTypeDef. If false, the resource cannot be tithed.
Rule.Translated: Añadido canTithe a ResourceTypeDef. Si es false, el recurso no puede entregarse como diezmo.

Rule.Original: Adds a postfix onto Game.ClearCache to clear Empire's caches, in addition to the current Game.Dispose patch
Rule.Raw: Adds a postfix onto Game.ClearCache to clear Empire's caches, in addition to the current Game.Dispose patch
Rule.Translated: Añadido un parche posterior a Game.ClearCache para limpiar las cachés de Empire, además del parche existente de Game.Dispose.

Rule.Original: Uses the player faction's tech level as a floor when determining the Empire faction's tech level. Meant to provide compatibility with techlevel-advancing mods.
Rule.Raw: Uses the player faction's tech level as a floor when determining the Empire faction's tech level. Meant to provide compatibility with techlevel-advancing mods.
Rule.Translated: El nivel tecnológico de la facción del jugador se utiliza como mínimo al determinar el de Empire, para dar compatibilidad a los mods que aumentan el nivel tecnológico.

Rule.Original: Add a raidTargetingWeight field to WorldSettlementDef. Influences how likely settlements of that type are to be raided
Rule.Raw: Add a raidTargetingWeight field to WorldSettlementDef. Influences how likely settlements of that type are to be raided
Rule.Translated: Añadido raidTargetingWeight a WorldSettlementDef. Influye en la probabilidad de que los asentamientos de ese tipo sufran incursiones.

Rule.Original: Slight rewrite of the raid-targeting logic to include the above field and also make use of RandomElementByWeight
Rule.Raw: Slight rewrite of the raid-targeting logic to include the above field and also make use of RandomElementByWeight
Rule.Translated: Ajustada la lógica de selección de objetivos de incursión para incluir el campo anterior y utilizar RandomElementByWeight.

Rule.Original: Add two functions to FCEventHandlerExtension to let events have dynamic odds of success
Rule.Raw: Add two functions to FCEventHandlerExtension to let events have dynamic odds of success
Rule.Translated: Añadidas dos funciones a FCEventHandlerExtension para que los sucesos tengan probabilidades de éxito dinámicas.

Rule.Original: Add IsOptionAvailable to FCEventHandlerExtension to let events dynamically determine if an option is available
Rule.Raw: Add IsOptionAvailable to FCEventHandlerExtension to let events dynamically determine if an option is available
Rule.Translated: Añadido IsOptionAvailable a FCEventHandlerExtension para que los sucesos determinen dinámicamente si una opción está disponible.

Rule.Original: Always show pool resources on the main tab window, even if they are 0
Rule.Raw: Always show pool resources on the main tab window, even if they are 0
Rule.Translated: Los recursos compartidos se muestran siempre en la ventana principal, aunque sean 0.
Restaurada la función del rasgo Innovador.
Implementado por fin el rasgo Afortunado...
Añadido el campo displayDivisor a FCStatDef.

Rule.Original: FCStatModifier descriptions will divide stat values by their displayDivisor if displayDivisor is non-zero
Rule.Raw: FCStatModifier descriptions will divide stat values by their displayDivisor if displayDivisor is non-zero
Rule.Translated: Las descripciones de FCStatModifier dividen los valores de las estadísticas por displayDivisor cuando es distinto de cero.

Rule.Original: raidCooldownOffset and deadPawnCooldownOffset have 2500 displayDivisor (so they will show up in-game as hours instead of ticks)
Rule.Raw: raidCooldownOffset and deadPawnCooldownOffset have 2500 displayDivisor (so they will show up in-game as hours instead of ticks)
Rule.Translated: raidCooldownOffset y deadPawnCooldownOffset utilizan un displayDivisor de 2500, para mostrarse en horas dentro del juego en lugar de en ticks.

Rule.Original: Handful of grammar and clarity fixes
Rule.Raw: Handful of grammar and clarity fixes
Rule.Translated: Varias mejoras de gramática y claridad.

Rule.Original: Publicizes the EmpireCacheUtil class and adds two functions for submods to "register" themselves, so that their global caches are automatically invalidated at the same time as Empire's
Rule.Raw: Publicizes the EmpireCacheUtil class and adds two functions for submods to "register" themselves, so that their global caches are automatically invalidated at the same time as Empire's
Rule.Translated: La clase EmpireCacheUtil pasa a ser pública y añade dos funciones para que los mods complementarios se registren y sus cachés globales se invaliden al mismo tiempo que las de Empire.

Rule.Original: Wraps the settleNewColony portion of Process Events in a try/catch, so we can remove the target location from the caravans list if the event fails somehow
Rule.Raw: Wraps the settleNewColony portion of Process Events in a try/catch, so we can remove the target location from the caravans list if the event fails somehow
Rule.Translated: La parte settleNewColony de Process Events se ejecuta dentro de un bloque try/catch para eliminar la ubicación objetivo de la lista de caravanas si el suceso falla.

Rule.Original: Adds new ValidateSettlementCaravansList function, firing daily to make sure that the settlementCaravansList has no orphaned locations
Rule.Raw: Adds new ValidateSettlementCaravansList function, firing daily to make sure that the settlementCaravansList has no orphaned locations
Rule.Translated: Añadida ValidateSettlementCaravansList, que se ejecuta a diario para comprobar que settlementCaravansList no contenga ubicaciones huérfanas.

Rule.Original: FCPolicyDef now uses modExtensions in conjunction with behaviorClass to expose several policy constants to XML editing
Rule.Raw: FCPolicyDef now uses modExtensions in conjunction with behaviorClass to expose several policy constants to XML editing
Rule.Translated: FCPolicyDef utiliza ahora modExtensions junto con behaviorClass para exponer varias constantes de políticas a la edición XML.

Rule.Original: Add RaidWeightRegistry and associated interface, for submods to influence the raid weighting for Empire settlements
Rule.Raw: Add RaidWeightRegistry and associated interface, for submods to influence the raid weighting for Empire settlements
Rule.Translated: Añadidos RaidWeightRegistry y su interfaz para que los mods complementarios influyan en los objetivos de incursiones contra asentamientos de Empire.

Rule.Original: Add UnitOverlayRegistry and associated interface, for submods to add information to the military squad screen
Rule.Raw: Add UnitOverlayRegistry and associated interface, for submods to add information to the military squad screen
Rule.Translated: Añadidos UnitOverlayRegistry y su interfaz para que los mods complementarios incorporen información a la pantalla de escuadrones militares.

Rule.Original: Add MercenaryDeathEvent, for submods to potentially intercept mercenary deaths
Rule.Raw: Add MercenaryDeathEvent, for submods to potentially intercept mercenary deaths
Rule.Translated: Añadido MercenaryDeathEvent para que los mods complementarios puedan interceptar las muertes de mercenarios.

Rule.Original: If a delivery good can't be added to a pawn for some reason, then it is placed at the tax spot, instead of silently destroyed
Rule.Raw: If a delivery good can't be added to a pawn for some reason, then it is placed at the tax spot, instead of silently destroyed
Rule.Translated: Si un producto de una entrega no puede añadirse a un peón, se coloca en el punto de impuestos en lugar de destruirse sin avisar.

Rule.Original: Tax delivery method is locked in at event creation time, rather than delivery time
Rule.Raw: Tax delivery method is locked in at event creation time, rather than delivery time
Rule.Translated: El método de entrega de impuestos se fija al crear el suceso, en lugar de al realizar la entrega.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: Deathrest capacity serum and Sentience catalyst on RTD_Medicine weren't gated behind DLC checks, causing problems for players without those DLC
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: Deathrest capacity serum and Sentience catalyst on RTD_Medicine weren't gated behind DLC checks, causing problems for players without those DLC
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el suero de capacidad de descanso mortal y el catalizador de consciencia de RTD_Medicine no comprobaban los DLC necesarios y causaban problemas a quienes no los tenían.

Rule.Original: Updated several other items to also check for DLC
Rule.Raw: Updated several other items to also check for DLC
Rule.Translated: Actualizados otros objetos para comprobar también los DLC necesarios.

Rule.Original: Gate xenotype initialization behind a check for the Biotech DLC
Rule.Raw: Gate xenotype initialization behind a check for the Biotech DLC
Rule.Translated: La inicialización de xenotipos comprueba ahora si está activo el DLC Biotech.

Rule.Original: Don't render the xenotype filter button if Biotech is disabled/not intalled, and there is only one humanlike race
Rule.Raw: Don't render the xenotype filter button if Biotech is disabled/not intalled, and there is only one humanlike race
Rule.Translated: El botón de filtro de xenotipos no se muestra si Biotech está desactivado o no está instalado y solo hay una raza humanoide.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: Militaristic and Expansionist policies wouldn't correctly apply their bonuses until restarting the game
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: Militaristic and Expansionist policies wouldn't correctly apply their bonuses until restarting the game
Rule.Translated: Corrección: las políticas Militarista y Expansionista no aplicaban correctamente sus bonificaciones hasta reiniciar el juego.

Rule.Original: Make sure that the settlement list is populated before processing paths
Rule.Raw: Make sure that the settlement list is populated before processing paths
Rule.Translated: Se comprueba que la lista de asentamientos esté completa antes de procesar las rutas.

Rule.Original: Detect when an imported unit encountered errors during loading, and mark it in the Import Units UI
Rule.Raw: Detect when an imported unit encountered errors during loading, and mark it in the Import Units UI
Rule.Translated: Se detectan los errores de carga de unidades importadas y se indican en la interfaz de importación.

Rule.Original: Patch out references to "Xenotypes" in the Manage Units window when Biotech isn't active
Rule.Raw: Patch out references to "Xenotypes" in the Manage Units window when Biotech isn't active
Rule.Translated: Se eliminan las referencias a «Xenotipos» de la ventana de gestión de unidades cuando Biotech no está activo.

Rule.Original: Gates two code uses of shuttles behind checks for the Royalty DLC, with a fallback option to transport pods or regular caravans
Rule.Raw: Gates two code uses of shuttles behind checks for the Royalty DLC, with a fallback option to transport pods or regular caravans
Rule.Translated: Dos usos de lanzaderas en el código comprueban ahora el DLC Royalty y ofrecen cápsulas de transporte o caravanas normales como alternativa.

Rule.Original: Add workerProductionBase and workerProductionMultiplier to easily modify production for all of a settlement's resources
Rule.Raw: Add workerProductionBase and workerProductionMultiplier to easily modify production for all of a settlement's resources
Rule.Translated: Añadidos workerProductionBase y workerProductionMultiplier para modificar fácilmente la producción de todos los recursos de un asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Updates the "Add Stat Modifier" debug action to add the stat's label to the new modifier description
Rule.Raw: Updates the "Add Stat Modifier" debug action to add the stat's label to the new modifier description
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la acción de depuración «Añadir modificador de estadística» para incluir la etiqueta de la estadística en la descripción del nuevo modificador.

Rule.Original: Updates the resource display on the main tab window to actually use the full space
Rule.Raw: Updates the resource display on the main tab window to actually use the full space
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la presentación de recursos de la ventana principal para aprovechar todo el espacio.

Rule.Original: When calculating a settlement's max building slots, enforce the settlement type's def as a hard cap
Rule.Raw: When calculating a settlement's max building slots, enforce the settlement type's def as a hard cap
Rule.Translated: Al calcular el máximo de espacios de edificios de un asentamiento, la definición de su tipo se impone como límite absoluto.

Rule.Original: Changes the tooltip for locked building slots to show the actual requirements, if overriden
Rule.Raw: Changes the tooltip for locked building slots to show the actual requirements, if overriden
Rule.Translated: La ayuda de los espacios de edificios bloqueados muestra los requisitos reales si se han modificado.

Rule.Original: When getting a WorldSettlementDef's SettlementTypeExtension, always grab the last one in the modExtensions list. This should account for xml inheritance
Rule.Raw: When getting a WorldSettlementDef's SettlementTypeExtension, always grab the last one in the modExtensions list. This should account for xml inheritance
Rule.Translated: Al obtener SettlementTypeExtension de un WorldSettlementDef, se utiliza siempre la última entrada de modExtensions para tener en cuenta la herencia XML.

Rule.Original: Updates FCBuildingDefs: if a building A is listed as a requirement for building B, then both A and all upgrades of A will satisfy B's requirement
Rule.Raw: Updates FCBuildingDefs: if a building A is listed as a requirement for building B, then both A and all upgrades of A will satisfy B's requirement
Rule.Translated: Actualizados FCBuildingDefs: si el edificio A es requisito del edificio B, tanto A como cualquiera de sus mejoras satisfacen el requisito de B.

Rule.Original: Block a building from being built if one of its upgrades already exists
Rule.Raw: Block a building from being built if one of its upgrades already exists
Rule.Translated: Se impide construir un edificio si ya existe una de sus mejoras.

Rule.Original: Updates the prisoner window to be more useful and visually interesting
Rule.Raw: Updates the prisoner window to be more useful and visually interesting
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la ventana de prisioneros para que sea más útil y visualmente interesante.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: FCPolicy might not set its behavior correctly due to the loading order of WorldObjectComps and WorldComponents
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: FCPolicy might not set its behavior correctly due to the loading order of WorldObjectComps and WorldComponents
Rule.Translated: Corrección: FCPolicy podía configurar mal su comportamiento debido al orden de carga de WorldObjectComps y WorldComponents.

Rule.Original: Adds targetAllSettlements field to FCEventDef. If true, the event targets all valid settlements
Rule.Raw: Adds targetAllSettlements field to FCEventDef. If true, the event targets all valid settlements
Rule.Translated: Añadido targetAllSettlements a FCEventDef. Si es true, el suceso afecta a todos los asentamientos válidos.

Rule.Original: Adds serialized list of permanent stat modifiers to WorldSettlementFC, so that settlements can track permanent stat modifiers that aren't attached to buildings or events
Rule.Raw: Adds serialized list of permanent stat modifiers to WorldSettlementFC, so that settlements can track permanent stat modifiers that aren't attached to buildings or events
Rule.Translated: Añadida a WorldSettlementFC una lista guardada de modificadores permanentes de estadísticas para registrar los que no están vinculados a edificios o sucesos.

Rule.Original: Adds permanentStatModifiers field to FCEventDef. Listed modifiers will be permanently applied to all settlements affected by the event
Rule.Raw: Adds permanentStatModifiers field to FCEventDef. Listed modifiers will be permanently applied to all settlements affected by the event
Rule.Translated: Añadido permanentStatModifiers a FCEventDef. Los modificadores indicados se aplican permanentemente a todos los asentamientos afectados por el suceso.

Rule.Original: Show permanent stat modifiers for each event option alongside the temporary ones
Rule.Raw: Show permanent stat modifiers for each event option alongside the temporary ones
Rule.Translated: Los modificadores permanentes de cada opción de suceso se muestran junto a los temporales.

Rule.Original: Can restrict events based on tech level, cooldown, faction age, required policy
Rule.Raw: Can restrict events based on tech level, cooldown, faction age, required policy
Rule.Translated: Los sucesos se pueden restringir por nivel tecnológico, tiempo de espera, antigüedad de la facción o política requerida.

Rule.Original: Drug Trade has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Rule.Raw: Drug Trade has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Rule.Translated: Tráfico de drogas tiene un tiempo de espera de 30 días y solo puede activarse cuando la facción Empire tiene al menos 5 días.

Rule.Original: Independence Petitions has a 10-day cooldown, can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old, and requires at least 3 settlements in the faction
Rule.Raw: Independence Petitions has a 10-day cooldown, can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old, and requires at least 3 settlements in the faction
Rule.Translated: Las peticiones de independencia tienen un tiempo de espera de 10 días, requieren que Empire tenga al menos 5 días y que cuente con un mínimo de 3 asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Moonlit Ritual has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Rule.Raw: Moonlit Ritual has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Rule.Translated: Ritual a la luz de la luna tiene un tiempo de espera de 30 días y solo puede activarse cuando Empire tiene al menos 5 días.

Rule.Original: Settling Down has a 15-day cooldown, and requires at least 2 settlements in the faction
Rule.Raw: Settling Down has a 15-day cooldown, and requires at least 2 settlements in the faction
Rule.Translated: Establecerse tiene un tiempo de espera de 15 días y requiere al menos 2 asentamientos en la facción.

Rule.Original: Strange Discovery has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Rule.Raw: Strange Discovery has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Rule.Translated: Descubrimiento extraño tiene un tiempo de espera de 30 días y solo puede activarse cuando Empire tiene al menos 5 días.
Ansia de viajar tiene un tiempo de espera de 15 días.

Rule.Original: Adds timeTillTriggerMax field to FCEventDef. If set, and larger than timeTillTriger, then the event's duration will be randomly chosen from the range (timeTillTrigger, timeTillTriggerMax)
Rule.Raw: Adds timeTillTriggerMax field to FCEventDef. If set, and larger than timeTillTriger, then the event's duration will be randomly chosen from the range (timeTillTrigger, timeTillTriggerMax)
Rule.Translated: Añadido timeTillTriggerMax a FCEventDef. Si se establece y supera timeTillTriger, la duración del suceso se elige aleatoriamente dentro del intervalo (timeTillTrigger, timeTillTriggerMax).

Rule.Original: If an edict is currently being enacted (and thus isn't yet applying its bonuses), its bonus text in the menu is grayed out
Rule.Raw: If an edict is currently being enacted (and thus isn't yet applying its bonuses), its bonus text in the menu is grayed out
Rule.Translated: Si un edicto se está promulgando y todavía no aplica sus bonificaciones, el texto de sus efectos aparece atenuado en el menú.

Rule.Original: After a manual battle, all non-player pawns that were drafted are moved back to the Empire faction
Rule.Raw: After a manual battle, all non-player pawns that were drafted are moved back to the Empire faction
Rule.Translated: Después de una batalla manual, todos los peones reclutados que no pertenecen al jugador vuelven a la facción Empire.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: existing linux patch hadn't been updated for the new refactored code patterns
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: existing linux patch hadn't been updated for the new refactored code patterns
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el parche existente de Linux no se había actualizado para los nuevos patrones del código reorganizado.

Rule.Original: Building window filter buttons: truncate button label if it's too long
Rule.Raw: Building window filter buttons: truncate button label if it's too long
Rule.Translated: Botones de filtro de la ventana de edificios: la etiqueta se recorta si es demasiado larga.

Rule.Original: Event window: add scrollview for events with many options
Rule.Raw: Event window: add scrollview for events with many options
Rule.Translated: Ventana de sucesos: añadida una vista con desplazamiento para los sucesos con muchas opciones.

Rule.Original: Fix the building count test to call the correct function after changing how bulding counts work
Rule.Raw: Fix the building count test to call the correct function after changing how bulding counts work
Rule.Translated: Corregida la prueba del recuento de edificios para llamar a la función correcta tras cambiar su funcionamiento.

Rule.Original: Fix titheValueMultiplier to actually apply to settlements
Rule.Raw: Fix titheValueMultiplier to actually apply to settlements
Rule.Translated: Corregido titheValueMultiplier para que se aplique realmente a los asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Instead of baking modifier readouts into event descriptions, they are dynamically generated
Rule.Raw: Instead of baking modifier readouts into event descriptions, they are dynamically generated
Rule.Translated: Los resúmenes de modificadores se generan dinámicamente en lugar de incorporarse de forma fija a las descripciones de los sucesos.

Rule.Original: Updates a couple existing tests and adds a few new ones
Rule.Raw: Updates a couple existing tests and adds a few new ones
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas varias pruebas existentes y añadidas otras nuevas.

Rule.Original: Adds a tooltip to the Tax Base section of the settlement window UI, breaking down contributions to the tax base
Rule.Raw: Adds a tooltip to the Tax Base section of the settlement window UI, breaking down contributions to the tax base
Rule.Translated: Añadida una ayuda a la sección de base fiscal de la ventana del asentamiento que desglosa sus aportaciones.

Rule.Original: Space Distillery and Orbital Trade Hub's taxBasePercentage modifiers were too low
Rule.Raw: Space Distillery and Orbital Trade Hub's taxBasePercentage modifiers were too low
Rule.Translated: Los modificadores taxBasePercentage de la destilería espacial y el centro de comercio orbital eran demasiado bajos.

Rule.Original: Adds null guards and checks to a handful of bill code paths
Rule.Raw: Adds null guards and checks to a handful of bill code paths
Rule.Translated: Añadidas comprobaciones de valores nulos a varias rutas del código de facturas.
IResourceProductionModifier.GetResourceModifierDesc se divide en GetResourceAdditiveDesc y GetResourceMultiplierDesc.

Rule.Original: Adds a maxFireCount field to FCEventDef, specifying the maximum number of times the event can fire (default is -1, for unlimited)
Rule.Raw: Adds a maxFireCount field to FCEventDef, specifying the maximum number of times the event can fire (default is -1, for unlimited)
Rule.Translated: Añadido maxFireCount a FCEventDef para indicar cuántas veces puede activarse el suceso; el valor predeterminado es -1, sin límite.

Rule.Original: Removes redundant fields from the PatchNoteDef and sets up a parent with common info. Significant reduction in lines of xml dedicated to patch notes
Rule.Raw: Removes redundant fields from the PatchNoteDef and sets up a parent with common info. Significant reduction in lines of xml dedicated to patch notes
Rule.Translated: Eliminados los campos redundantes de PatchNoteDef y creada una definición padre con la información común. Se reduce considerablemente el XML dedicado a notas de versión.

Rule.Original: Changes to center tab rendering for settlement window tabs
Rule.Raw: Changes to center tab rendering for settlement window tabs
Rule.Translated: Cambios en el dibujo centrado de las pestañas de la ventana del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Alter rendering of settlement window to use a settlementDef's accentColor, if it exists
Rule.Raw: Alter rendering of settlement window to use a settlementDef's accentColor, if it exists
Rule.Translated: La ventana del asentamiento utiliza accentColor de settlementDef, si existe.

Rule.Original: Round stat gain to 2 decimal places for the Happiness, Loyalty, Unrest, and Prosperity tooltips
Rule.Raw: Round stat gain to 2 decimal places for the Happiness, Loyalty, Unrest, and Prosperity tooltips
Rule.Translated: Las variaciones de felicidad, lealtad, agitación y prosperidad se redondean a 2 decimales en sus ayudas.
Varias tareas de limpieza del código.

Rule.Original: Remove the "AnimalAlpha" trade tag from the blacklist
Rule.Raw: Remove the "AnimalAlpha" trade tag from the blacklist
Rule.Translated: Eliminada la etiqueta comercial «AnimalAlpha» de la lista de bloqueo.

Rule.Original: Expose the list of blacklisted trade tags and animal defs in XML, specifically on the ResourceFilterExtension_Animals (found on RTD_Animals)
Rule.Raw: Expose the list of blacklisted trade tags and animal defs in XML, specifically on the ResourceFilterExtension_Animals (found on RTD_Animals)
Rule.Translated: La lista de etiquetas comerciales y animales bloqueados se expone en XML mediante ResourceFilterExtension_Animals, en RTD_Animals.

Rule.Original: The list of required policies would wrap if it got too long. Now, it's truncated with elipsis, with a tooltip that shows all policies.
Rule.Raw: The list of required policies would wrap if it got too long. Now, it's truncated with elipsis, with a tooltip that shows all policies.
Rule.Translated: La lista de políticas requeridas saltaba de línea si era demasiado larga. Ahora se recorta con puntos suspensivos y una ayuda muestra todas las políticas.

Rule.Original: Permanent stat modifiers are more clearly separated from temporary modifiers
Rule.Raw: Permanent stat modifiers are more clearly separated from temporary modifiers
Rule.Translated: Los modificadores permanentes se distinguen con mayor claridad de los temporales.

Rule.Original: Adds IProfitContributor interface. Can be implemented on a WorldObjectComp to affect the income and upkeep of the associated WorldSettlementFC
Rule.Raw: Adds IProfitContributor interface. Can be implemented on a WorldObjectComp to affect the income and upkeep of the associated WorldSettlementFC
Rule.Translated: Añadida la interfaz IProfitContributor, que puede implementarse en un WorldObjectComp para modificar los ingresos y el mantenimiento de su WorldSettlementFC.

Rule.Original: Adds a "confirm" dialog when founding a settlement, with a setting to disable the dialog
Rule.Raw: Adds a "confirm" dialog when founding a settlement, with a setting to disable the dialog
Rule.Translated: Añadido un diálogo de confirmación al fundar un asentamiento, con una opción para desactivarlo.

Rule.Original: Changes how events are invalidated when rendering them in the main tab window
Rule.Raw: Changes how events are invalidated when rendering them in the main tab window
Rule.Translated: Cambiada la forma de invalidar los sucesos al mostrarlos en la ventana principal.

Rule.Original: Adds a ISettlementPostLoadInit interface to let other comps know when a WorldSettlementFC has fully finished loading
Rule.Raw: Adds a ISettlementPostLoadInit interface to let other comps know when a WorldSettlementFC has fully finished loading
Rule.Translated: Añadida ISettlementPostLoadInit para avisar a otros componentes cuando WorldSettlementFC ha terminado de cargarse por completo.

Rule.Original: Update how mod versioning is handled
Rule.Raw: Update how mod versioning is handled
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la gestión de versiones del mod.

Rule.Original: Adds a banner image path to the patch note def
Rule.Raw: Adds a banner image path to the patch note def
Rule.Translated: Añadida una ruta de imagen de cabecera a la definición de notas de versión.

Rule.Original: Changes the patch notes window to accept a modId and filter patch notes by the id
Rule.Raw: Changes the patch notes window to accept a modId and filter patch notes by the id
Rule.Translated: La ventana de notas de versión acepta un modId y filtra las notas por ese identificador.

Rule.Original: Lightens the color of orbital settlements to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) to make their text more legible on the main tab window
Rule.Raw: Lightens the color of orbital settlements to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) to make their text more legible on the main tab window
Rule.Translated: El color de los asentamientos orbitales se aclara a (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) para que su texto sea más legible en la ventana principal.

Rule.Original: Slave Market -0.4 happinessLostBase -> 0.4 happinessLostBase (this aligns with the original description; the stat was just always wrong)
Rule.Raw: Slave Market -0.4 happinessLostBase -> 0.4 happinessLostBase (this aligns with the original description; the stat was just always wrong)
Rule.Translated: Mercado de esclavos: happinessLostBase cambia de -0.4 a 0.4, de acuerdo con la descripción original; la estadística siempre había sido incorrecta.

Rule.Original: Independence Petitions: multiple options changed to use prosperityLostBase instead of prosperityGainedBase. No actual gameplay affect
Rule.Raw: Independence Petitions: multiple options changed to use prosperityLostBase instead of prosperityGainedBase. No actual gameplay affect
Rule.Translated: Peticiones de independencia: varias opciones utilizan prosperityLostBase en lugar de prosperityGainedBase. No cambia la jugabilidad.

Rule.Original: Local Millitias Form: changed an option to use happinessLostBase instead of happinessGainedBase. No actual gameplay affect
Rule.Raw: Local Millitias Form: changed an option to use happinessLostBase instead of happinessGainedBase. No actual gameplay affect
Rule.Translated: Formación de milicias locales: una opción utiliza happinessLostBase en lugar de happinessGainedBase. No cambia la jugabilidad.

Rule.Original: Rich Ore Vein: changed an option to use happinessLostBase insteead of happinessGainedBase. No actual gameplay affect
Rule.Raw: Rich Ore Vein: changed an option to use happinessLostBase insteead of happinessGainedBase. No actual gameplay affect
Rule.Translated: Veta de mineral abundante: una opción utiliza happinessLostBase en lugar de happinessGainedBase. No cambia la jugabilidad.
Corregida una posible referencia nula en WorldObjectComp_SettlementMilitary.AddToDefenceFromList.

Rule.Original: Patch a potential dictionary access issue in FactionFC.RevokeEdict
Rule.Raw: Patch a potential dictionary access issue in FactionFC.RevokeEdict
Rule.Translated: Corregido un posible problema de acceso al diccionario en FactionFC.RevokeEdict.

Rule.Original: Adds an ISettlementFoundingValidator interface to let other classes/submods control when or if a settlement can be founded
Rule.Raw: Adds an ISettlementFoundingValidator interface to let other classes/submods control when or if a settlement can be founded
Rule.Translated: Añadida ISettlementFoundingValidator para que otras clases o mods complementarios controlen cuándo puede fundarse un asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Nerfed military efficiency for NPCs: Neolithic 1 -> .9, Medieval 1.2 -> 1, Industrial 1.2 -> 1.1, Spacer 1.3 -> 1.2
Rule.Raw: Nerfed military efficiency for NPCs: Neolithic 1 -> .9, Medieval 1.2 -> 1, Industrial 1.2 -> 1.1, Spacer 1.3 -> 1.2
Rule.Translated: Reducida la eficiencia militar de los personajes no jugadores: Neolítico 1 pasa a .9, Medieval 1.2 a 1, Industrial 1.2 a 1.1 y Espacial 1.3 a 1.2.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: non-stuffable items would show incorrect market values in the manage units window
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: non-stuffable items would show incorrect market values in the manage units window
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los objetos que no admiten materiales mostraban valores de mercado incorrectos en la ventana de gestión de unidades.

Rule.Original: Changes Manage Units window so that the "Equipped Apparel" label won't overlap with the "Clear Colors" button
Rule.Raw: Changes Manage Units window so that the "Equipped Apparel" label won't overlap with the "Clear Colors" button
Rule.Translated: La etiqueta «Ropa equipada» ya no se superpone al botón «Borrar colores» en la ventana de gestión de unidades.

Rule.Original: Updates CreateColonyWindowFc to show travel time so long as selected tile is valid
Rule.Raw: Updates CreateColonyWindowFc to show travel time so long as selected tile is valid
Rule.Translated: CreateColonyWindowFc muestra el tiempo de viaje siempre que la casilla seleccionada sea válida.

Rule.Original: Changed Create Settlement (Instant) debug action to choose settlement type first, and then enable the tile picker for the correct planet layer. This makes it possible to instantly place orbital settlements
Rule.Raw: Changed Create Settlement (Instant) debug action to choose settlement type first, and then enable the tile picker for the correct planet layer. This makes it possible to instantly place orbital settlements
Rule.Translated: La acción de depuración para crear un asentamiento al instante permite elegir primero su tipo y después la casilla en la capa planetaria correspondiente. Ahora se pueden colocar asentamientos orbitales al instante.

Rule.Original: Fixes a bug in the Reset All Military Squads debug action that left squads orphaned, causing the squad command window to break
Rule.Raw: Fixes a bug in the Reset All Military Squads debug action that left squads orphaned, causing the squad command window to break
Rule.Translated: Corregido un error de la acción de depuración que restablece todos los escuadrones militares: dejaba escuadrones huérfanos y rompía su ventana de órdenes.

Rule.Original: Adds new debug action: Reset All Military Cooldowns, that instantly resets squad cooldown
Rule.Raw: Adds new debug action: Reset All Military Cooldowns, that instantly resets squad cooldown
Rule.Translated: Nueva acción de depuración: restablecer todos los tiempos de recuperación militares al instante.

Rule.Original: We have a new member on the team! @AutumnLight has contributed to the mod first by fixing and optimizing the Trait Selection Screen!
Rule.Raw: We have a new member on the team! @AutumnLight has contributed to the mod first by fixing and optimizing the Trait Selection Screen!
Rule.Translated: ¡Tenemos un nuevo integrante en el equipo! @AutumnLight ha contribuido corrigiendo y optimizando la pantalla de selección de rasgos.

Rule.Original: With the help of the Talented pinedog, we have managed to fix the Xenotype Generation, so now Xenotypes Unit works Perfectly!
Rule.Raw: With the help of the Talented pinedog, we have managed to fix the Xenotype Generation, so now Xenotypes Unit works Perfectly!
Rule.Translated: Con ayuda del talentoso pinedog hemos corregido la generación de xenotipos. ¡Las unidades con xenotipo funcionan perfectamente!

Rule.Original: Be advised, make sure Vehicle Framework is up to date as this point of time as it's spewing errors.
Rule.Raw: Be advised, make sure Vehicle Framework is up to date as this point of time as it's spewing errors.
Rule.Translated: Asegúrate de tener Vehicle Framework actualizado, ya que en este momento está generando errores.

Rule.Original: Some building textures were removed and replaced with placeholders whilst we work on new textures.
Rule.Raw: Some building textures were removed and replaced with placeholders whilst we work on new textures.
Rule.Translated: Algunas texturas de edificios se han eliminado y sustituido por imágenes provisionales mientras trabajamos en las nuevas.

Rule.Original: Building menu has had an overhaul, You can now resize and filter buildings
Rule.Raw: Building menu has had an overhaul, You can now resize and filter buildings
Rule.Translated: Rediseñado el menú de edificios: ahora puedes cambiar su tamaño y filtrar edificios.
Compatibilidad con Alpha Biomes, por Pecha.

Rule.Original: Roads should be working much better now
Rule.Raw: Roads should be working much better now
Rule.Translated: Las carreteras deberían funcionar mucho mejor.

Rule.Original: New roads provide an alert when built
Rule.Raw: New roads provide an alert when built
Rule.Translated: Las nuevas carreteras generan una alerta al construirse.

Rule.Original: Fixed infinite loop crash in tax system with safety checks. Fixed PawnGen errors upon delivery + Safe delivery location coordinate error.
Rule.Raw: Fixed infinite loop crash in tax system with safety checks. Fixed PawnGen errors upon delivery + Safe delivery location coordinate error.
Rule.Translated: Corregido un bloqueo por bucle infinito en el sistema de impuestos mediante comprobaciones de seguridad. Corregidos errores de PawnGen durante las entregas y un error de coordenadas en la ubicación segura de entrega.

Rule.Original: Fixed a stack overflow error when opening the Create Settlement screen caused by infinite recursion in IsInAnyShuttleRange
Rule.Raw: Fixed a stack overflow error when opening the Create Settlement screen caused by infinite recursion in IsInAnyShuttleRange
Rule.Translated: Corregido un desbordamiento de pila al abrir la pantalla de creación de asentamientos causado por recursión infinita en IsInAnyShuttleRange.

Rule.Original: Fixed PawnGenerationRequest "incorrect constructor" errors in FCPawnGenerator
Rule.Raw: Fixed PawnGenerationRequest "incorrect constructor" errors in FCPawnGenerator
Rule.Translated: Corregidos los errores de «constructor incorrecto» de PawnGenerationRequest en FCPawnGenerator.

Rule.Original: Fixed Critical XML Definition Errors - Policy System Repair
Rule.Raw: Fixed Critical XML Definition Errors - Policy System Repair
Rule.Translated: Corregidos errores críticos de definiciones XML y reparado el sistema de políticas.

Rule.Original: Fixed version tracking and red outline display issues
Rule.Raw: Fixed version tracking and red outline display issues
Rule.Translated: Corregidos problemas de seguimiento de versiones y de visualización del contorno rojo.

Rule.Original: Enhanced patch notes window visual design
Rule.Raw: Enhanced patch notes window visual design
Rule.Translated: Mejorado el diseño visual de la ventana de notas de versión.

Rule.Original: Improved code stability and asset loading
Rule.Raw: Improved code stability and asset loading
Rule.Translated: Mejoradas la estabilidad del código y la carga de recursos.

Rule.Original: Better user experience with branded default imagery
Rule.Raw: Better user experience with branded default imagery
Rule.Translated: Mejorada la experiencia del usuario con imágenes predeterminadas de la marca.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the orbit worlddrawlayer throws errors when launching with a gravship
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the orbit worlddrawlayer throws errors when launching with a gravship
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la capa de dibujo orbital del mundo generaba errores al despegar con una gravinave.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: roads would build to/from the surface location of orbital settlements
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: roads would build to/from the surface location of orbital settlements
Rule.Translated: Corrección: las carreteras se construían hacia o desde la ubicación en superficie de los asentamientos orbitales.
Varias correcciones menores de la interfaz.

Rule.Original: Swapped the production bonuses of Fur Hunter Camp and Wilderness Guild
Rule.Raw: Swapped the production bonuses of Fur Hunter Camp and Wilderness Guild
Rule.Translated: Intercambiadas las bonificaciones de producción del campamento de cazadores de pieles y el gremio de la naturaleza.

Rule.Original: Allows custom fire supports to be imported or exported. Uses same design as unit and squad import/export
Rule.Raw: Allows custom fire supports to be imported or exported. Uses same design as unit and squad import/export
Rule.Translated: Se pueden importar y exportar apoyos de fuego personalizados, con el mismo diseño utilizado para unidades y escuadrones.

Rule.Original: Generate settlement descriptions based on optional new descriptionKey on WorldSettlementDef
Rule.Raw: Generate settlement descriptions based on optional new descriptionKey on WorldSettlementDef
Rule.Translated: Las descripciones de asentamientos se generan mediante un nuevo descriptionKey opcional de WorldSettlementDef.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when the player has the Militaristic policy and builds an Orbital settlement, a barracks building is added, even though barracks cannot be built on orbital settlements
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when the player has the Militaristic policy and builds an Orbital settlement, a barracks building is added, even though barracks cannot be built on orbital settlements
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la política Militarista añadía un cuartel al construir un asentamiento orbital, aunque los cuarteles no pueden construirse allí.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: ReturnTicksToArrive() doesn't properly handle cross-layer pathfinding
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: ReturnTicksToArrive() doesn't properly handle cross-layer pathfinding
Rule.Translated: Corrección: ReturnTicksToArrive() no gestionaba correctamente las rutas entre capas.

Rule.Original: Add canBeRaided and supportsManualBattle fields to WorldSettlementDef
Rule.Raw: Add canBeRaided and supportsManualBattle fields to WorldSettlementDef
Rule.Translated: Añadidos canBeRaided y supportsManualBattle a WorldSettlementDef.

Rule.Original: Add virtual CanBeRaidedByFaction function to SettlementTypeExtension, allowing settlements to determine what kinds of factions can attack them. Defaults true
Rule.Raw: Add virtual CanBeRaidedByFaction function to SettlementTypeExtension, allowing settlements to determine what kinds of factions can attack them. Defaults true
Rule.Translated: Añadida la función virtual CanBeRaidedByFaction a SettlementTypeExtension para que los asentamientos determinen qué facciones pueden atacarlos. Su valor predeterminado es true.

Rule.Original: Use the new fields/functions to make Orbital Settlements raidable only by factions with Spacer tech or above. Orbital Settlements also do not support manual battles
Rule.Raw: Use the new fields/functions to make Orbital Settlements raidable only by factions with Spacer tech or above. Orbital Settlements also do not support manual battles
Rule.Translated: Los nuevos campos y funciones permiten que los asentamientos orbitales solo sean atacados por facciones con tecnología espacial o superior. Tampoco admiten batallas manuales.

Rule.Original: Minor update to the Russian translation
Rule.Raw: Minor update to the Russian translation
Rule.Translated: Pequeña actualización de la traducción al ruso.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: unexpected null def causes errors on paying taxes
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: unexpected null def causes errors on paying taxes
Rule.Translated: Corrección: una definición nula inesperada provocaba errores al pagar impuestos.

Rule.Original: Add numerous null checks and guards
Rule.Raw: Add numerous null checks and guards
Rule.Translated: Añadidas numerosas comprobaciones de valores nulos.

Rule.Original: Update orbital settlement descriptions for the settlement type picker
Rule.Raw: Update orbital settlement descriptions for the settlement type picker
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas las descripciones de asentamientos orbitales en el selector de tipos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: clicking the 'Resolve Bill' button may not make the bill disappear when it should
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: clicking the 'Resolve Bill' button may not make the bill disappear when it should
Rule.Translated: Corrección: pulsar «Resolver factura» podía no eliminar la factura cuando correspondía.

Rule.Original: Adds Synthread and Hyperweave to the Apparel resource, gated behind the Ultra tech level
Rule.Raw: Adds Synthread and Hyperweave to the Apparel resource, gated behind the Ultra tech level
Rule.Translated: Añadidos hilo sintético y tejido hiperresistente al recurso de ropa, disponibles a partir del nivel tecnológico Ultra.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: Non-stuffable Things would not have variable prices based on quality
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: Non-stuffable Things would not have variable prices based on quality
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los objetos que no admiten materiales no variaban de precio según la calidad.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the building build time multplier wouldn't apply when granted via building
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the building build time multplier wouldn't apply when granted via building
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el multiplicador del tiempo de construcción no se aplicaba cuando procedía de un edificio.

Rule.Original: Orbital Trade Hub and Space Distillery only buildable on logistics orbital platforms
Rule.Raw: Orbital Trade Hub and Space Distillery only buildable on logistics orbital platforms
Rule.Translated: El centro de comercio orbital y la destilería espacial solo pueden construirse en plataformas orbitales logísticas.

Rule.Original: Orbital Shipyard and Orbital Surface Operations only buildable on advanced orbital platforms
Rule.Raw: Orbital Shipyard and Orbital Surface Operations only buildable on advanced orbital platforms
Rule.Translated: El astillero orbital y las operaciones de superficie orbitales solo pueden construirse en plataformas orbitales avanzadas.

Rule.Original: Orbital Academy and Naval Academy only buildable on glitterworld orbital platforms
Rule.Raw: Orbital Academy and Naval Academy only buildable on glitterworld orbital platforms
Rule.Translated: La academia orbital y la academia naval solo pueden construirse en plataformas orbitales de mundos brillantes.

Rule.Original: Update military tests to reflect the combat efficiency change from a little bit ago
