Rule.Raw: Update military tests to reflect the combat efficiency change from a little bit ago
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas las pruebas militares para reflejar el cambio reciente de eficiencia de combate.
Actualizada la invalidación de la caché de beneficios de asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Add more tick guards for sensitive code paths, and remove some redundant code
Rule.Raw: Add more tick guards for sensitive code paths, and remove some redundant code
Rule.Translated: Añadidas más comprobaciones durante los ticks en rutas sensibles del código y eliminado código redundante.

Rule.Original: Change the xenotype filter to be initialized on the first tick instead of during loading
Rule.Raw: Change the xenotype filter to be initialized on the first tick instead of during loading
Rule.Translated: El filtro de xenotipos se inicializa en el primer tick en lugar de durante la carga.

Rule.Original: Moves the harmony.PatchAll() call into a static class with a StaticConstructoreOnStartup tag
Rule.Raw: Moves the harmony.PatchAll() call into a static class with a StaticConstructoreOnStartup tag
Rule.Translated: La llamada harmony.PatchAll() pasa a una clase estática con la etiqueta StaticConstructoreOnStartup.

Rule.Original: Update XenotypeFilter.BuildMergedCustomXenotypeList to only access CharacterCardUtility.CustomXenotypesForReading when the Scribe mode is Inactive
Rule.Raw: Update XenotypeFilter.BuildMergedCustomXenotypeList to only access CharacterCardUtility.CustomXenotypesForReading when the Scribe mode is Inactive
Rule.Translated: XenotypeFilter.BuildMergedCustomXenotypeList solo accede a CharacterCardUtility.CustomXenotypesForReading cuando el modo de Scribe es Inactive.

Rule.Original: Update XenotypeFilter.CustomXenotypes to only cache the list of custom xenotypes if the scribe mode is Inactive (to force re-calculating the list if it is access during loading)
Rule.Raw: Update XenotypeFilter.CustomXenotypes to only cache the list of custom xenotypes if the scribe mode is Inactive (to force re-calculating the list if it is access during loading)
Rule.Translated: XenotypeFilter.CustomXenotypes solo guarda en caché los xenotipos personalizados cuando Scribe está Inactive, para recalcularlos si se consultan durante la carga.

Rule.Original: Event options can't be selected until 0.5 seconds after the event window appears
Rule.Raw: Event options can't be selected until 0.5 seconds after the event window appears
Rule.Translated: Las opciones de suceso no se pueden elegir hasta 0.5 segundos después de aparecer la ventana.

Rule.Original: Change several lines in MilitaryJobHandler_Capture.OnResolved to use worldsettlement instead of milComp.WorldSettlement
Rule.Raw: Change several lines in MilitaryJobHandler_Capture.OnResolved to use worldsettlement instead of milComp.WorldSettlement
Rule.Translated: Varias líneas de MilitaryJobHandler_Capture.OnResolved utilizan worldsettlement en lugar de milComp.WorldSettlement.

Rule.Original: Add try/catch guards to pawn spawning for manual battles. Pawns that fail to spawn are logged with the corresponding error message.
Rule.Raw: Add try/catch guards to pawn spawning for manual battles. Pawns that fail to spawn are logged with the corresponding error message.
Rule.Translated: Añadidos bloques try/catch al generar peones para batallas manuales. Los que no pueden aparecer se registran con el mensaje de error correspondiente.

Rule.Original: Updates resource and tithe handling to let the user automatically allocate all available tithe budget to random tithes
Rule.Raw: Updates resource and tithe handling to let the user automatically allocate all available tithe budget to random tithes
Rule.Translated: La gestión de recursos y diezmos permite asignar automáticamente todo el presupuesto disponible a diezmos aleatorios.

Rule.Original: Add impassableAllowedMutators field to WorldSettlementDef. If an impassable tile has a tile mutator that is in a settlement's impassableAllowedMutators list, then the settlement can be founded on that tile
Rule.Raw: Add impassableAllowedMutators field to WorldSettlementDef. If an impassable tile has a tile mutator that is in a settlement's impassableAllowedMutators list, then the settlement can be founded on that tile
Rule.Translated: Añadido impassableAllowedMutators a WorldSettlementDef. Se puede fundar el asentamiento en una casilla infranqueable si su modificador de terreno figura en esta lista.

Rule.Original: Reworks the tile check to skip the base game's Impassable check if a settlement has an impassible override
Rule.Raw: Reworks the tile check to skip the base game's Impassable check if a settlement has an impassible override
Rule.Translated: La comprobación de casillas omite la restricción de terreno infranqueable del juego base si el asentamiento tiene una excepción que lo permite.

Rule.Original: Notify_BuildingTookDamage, Notify_MemberStripped, and Notify_BuildingRemoved all patched to return early for the Empire NPC faction, just like Notify_MemberTookDamage
Rule.Raw: Notify_BuildingTookDamage, Notify_MemberStripped, and Notify_BuildingRemoved all patched to return early for the Empire NPC faction, just like Notify_MemberTookDamage
Rule.Translated: Notify_BuildingTookDamage, Notify_MemberStripped y Notify_BuildingRemoved terminan antes para la facción Empire no controlada por el jugador, igual que Notify_MemberTookDamage.

Rule.Original: Add a null check to FCRoadBuilder.DrawPaths() to prevent the Create New Colony window from crashing on a null road builder
Rule.Raw: Add a null check to FCRoadBuilder.DrawPaths() to prevent the Create New Colony window from crashing on a null road builder
Rule.Translated: Añadida una comprobación de valores nulos a FCRoadBuilder.DrawPaths() para evitar que la ventana de creación de colonias falle si el constructor de carreteras es nulo.

Rule.Original: The paths of roads-to-be-built are drawn more consistently (when the Create New Colony window is open)
Rule.Raw: The paths of roads-to-be-built are drawn more consistently (when the Create New Colony window is open)
Rule.Translated: Las rutas de carreteras pendientes se dibujan de forma más consistente cuando está abierta la ventana de creación de colonias.

Rule.Original: The defaults for minimum time between events and maximum time between events have been changed from 0 -> 2 and 6 -> 8, respectively. Average event interval should be around 5 days.
Rule.Raw: The defaults for minimum time between events and maximum time between events have been changed from 0 -> 2 and 6 -> 8, respectively. Average event interval should be around 5 days.
Rule.Translated: Los tiempos mínimo y máximo entre sucesos cambian de 0 a 2 y de 6 a 8, respectivamente. El intervalo medio debería ser de unos 5 días.

Rule.Original: Actually save the "disable forced pausing during events" setting so it persists between game launches
Rule.Raw: Actually save the "disable forced pausing during events" setting so it persists between game launches
Rule.Translated: El ajuste para desactivar la pausa forzada durante los sucesos se guarda correctamente entre inicios del juego.

Rule.Original: Updates the xenotype picker for military units to more gracefully handle xenotype names that resolve to null
Rule.Raw: Updates the xenotype picker for military units to more gracefully handle xenotype names that resolve to null
Rule.Translated: El selector de xenotipos de unidades militares gestiona mejor los nombres que se resuelven como valores nulos.

Rule.Original: Adds numerous null guards across Empire's windows
Rule.Raw: Adds numerous null guards across Empire's windows
Rule.Translated: Añadidas numerosas comprobaciones de valores nulos en las ventanas de Empire.

Rule.Original: At Empire faction creation, copy all faction relations from the player faction
Rule.Raw: At Empire faction creation, copy all faction relations from the player faction
Rule.Translated: Al crear la facción Empire se copian todas las relaciones de la facción del jugador.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the deployed squad menu could get stuck with a stale squad selection, leaving the menu unusable
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the deployed squad menu could get stuck with a stale squad selection, leaving the menu unusable
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el menú de escuadrones desplegados podía conservar una selección desactualizada y quedar inutilizable.

Rule.Original: Additional null protections in the deployed squad menu
Rule.Raw: Additional null protections in the deployed squad menu
Rule.Translated: Más protecciones contra valores nulos en el menú de escuadrones desplegados.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when a squad is deployed, if one of the pawns fails to spawn for any reason, the entire squad will never become ready for commands
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when a squad is deployed, if one of the pawns fails to spawn for any reason, the entire squad will never become ready for commands
Rule.Translated: Corrección: si uno de los peones no podía aparecer al desplegar un escuadrón, el escuadrón entero nunca estaba listo para recibir órdenes.

Rule.Original: Update lord handling for deployed squads
Rule.Raw: Update lord handling for deployed squads
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la gestión de grupos de comportamiento de escuadrones desplegados.
Añadidas numerosas protecciones adicionales contra valores nulos.

Rule.Original: Updates use of comp.strength to comp.GetTotalLocalDefensePower()
Rule.Raw: Updates use of comp.strength to comp.GetTotalLocalDefensePower()

Rule.Original: Updates world stats to remove the Empire faction's per-tier strength
Rule.Raw: Updates world stats to remove the Empire faction's per-tier strength
Rule.Translated: Las estadísticas del mundo ya no utilizan la fuerza por nivel de la facción Empire.

Rule.Original: Add a prefix to one of WDExp's prefixes to prevent WDExp from destroying Empire settlements
Rule.Raw: Add a prefix to one of WDExp's prefixes to prevent WDExp from destroying Empire settlements
Rule.Translated: Añadido un parche previo a uno de los parches previos de WDExp para impedir que destruya asentamientos de Empire.

Rule.Original: Adds a Postfix on GenHostility.HostileTo for Empire pawns to consider aggressive factionless pawns as hostile
Rule.Raw: Adds a Postfix on GenHostility.HostileTo for Empire pawns to consider aggressive factionless pawns as hostile
Rule.Translated: Añadido un parche posterior a GenHostility.HostileTo para que los peones de Empire consideren hostiles a los peones agresivos sin facción.

Rule.Original: Adds victory percentages to the battle notification, as well as to all menus that let the player swap defenders.
Rule.Raw: Adds victory percentages to the battle notification, as well as to all menus that let the player swap defenders.
Rule.Translated: Añadidos porcentajes de victoria a la notificación de batalla y a todos los menús que permiten cambiar defensores.

Rule.Original: Replaces the semi-destructive harmony patches with a comp-based approach to add gizmos to non-Empire NPC settlements
Rule.Raw: Replaces the semi-destructive harmony patches with a comp-based approach to add gizmos to non-Empire NPC settlements
Rule.Translated: Los parches de Harmony parcialmente destructivos se sustituyen por componentes que añaden botones a los asentamientos no jugadores ajenos a Empire.

Rule.Original: Replace the old trader code with actual functional code that won't needlessly harm performance
Rule.Raw: Replace the old trader code with actual functional code that won't needlessly harm performance
Rule.Translated: El antiguo código de mercaderes se sustituye por código funcional que no perjudica innecesariamente al rendimiento.

Rule.Original: Adds the ability to pick what animals can accompany Empire pawns during delivery events
Rule.Raw: Adds the ability to pick what animals can accompany Empire pawns during delivery events
Rule.Translated: Se pueden elegir los animales que acompañan a los peones de Empire durante las entregas.

Rule.Original: Adds menus and machinery for picking caravan types for the Empire faction. One caravan type per tithe-able resource, plus slaver and exotic (if certain conditions are met)
Rule.Raw: Adds menus and machinery for picking caravan types for the Empire faction. One caravan type per tithe-able resource, plus slaver and exotic (if certain conditions are met)
Rule.Translated: Añadidos menús y funciones para elegir tipos de caravanas de Empire: uno por recurso entregable como diezmo, además de esclavistas y exóticos si se cumplen ciertas condiciones.

Rule.Original: Updates Empire's pawnkind handling to take tech level into account for HAR races. Techlevel was already accounted for for the base human race; only HAR races had this issue
Rule.Raw: Updates Empire's pawnkind handling to take tech level into account for HAR races. Techlevel was already accounted for for the base human race; only HAR races had this issue
Rule.Translated: La gestión de tipos de peón de Empire tiene en cuenta el nivel tecnológico de las razas HAR. La raza humana del juego base ya lo tenía en cuenta.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: several pawn generation request used the template pawnKindDefs instead of the tech-level derived clones, resulting in pawns generating with the wrong gear
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: several pawn generation request used the template pawnKindDefs instead of the tech-level derived clones, resulting in pawns generating with the wrong gear
Rule.Translated: Corrección: varias solicitudes de generación de peones utilizaban plantillas de pawnKindDefs en lugar de sus copias adaptadas al nivel tecnológico, generando equipamiento incorrecto.

Rule.Original: Patch PRD's ResetRequest to ignore Empire's runtime-generated pawnkinds
Rule.Raw: Patch PRD's ResetRequest to ignore Empire's runtime-generated pawnkinds
Rule.Translated: ResetRequest de PRD ignora los tipos de peón creados por Empire durante la ejecución.

Rule.Original: Synthetic Wood Factory's 0.5 multiplier changed to a 0.5 additive bonus
Rule.Raw: Synthetic Wood Factory's 0.5 multiplier changed to a 0.5 additive bonus
Rule.Translated: El multiplicador de 0.5 de la fábrica de madera sintética se cambia por una bonificación aditiva de 0.5.

Rule.Original: Add several guards to prevent duplicate cooldown events or letters from firing
Rule.Raw: Add several guards to prevent duplicate cooldown events or letters from firing
Rule.Translated: Añadidas comprobaciones para impedir sucesos o cartas duplicados sobre tiempos de recuperación.

Rule.Original: Road paths track what road def they were built with, and if new, better roads become available, old paths are wiped from the MST, enabling new paths with the new road type to be built
Rule.Raw: Road paths track what road def they were built with, and if new, better roads become available, old paths are wiped from the MST, enabling new paths with the new road type to be built
Rule.Translated: Las rutas de carreteras registran la definición utilizada. Cuando se desbloquean carreteras mejores, las rutas antiguas se eliminan del MST para permitir construir rutas con el nuevo tipo.

Rule.Original: Spreads the MST computation out over several road ticks, reducing the possibility of a hang any time the MST is recomputed.
Rule.Raw: Spreads the MST computation out over several road ticks, reducing the possibility of a hang any time the MST is recomputed.
Rule.Translated: El cálculo del MST se distribuye entre varios ticks de carreteras para reducir los bloqueos al recalcularlo.

Rule.Original: Updates the road builder to build from both ends, instead of just one
Rule.Raw: Updates the road builder to build from both ends, instead of just one
Rule.Translated: El constructor de carreteras trabaja desde ambos extremos, en lugar de solo desde uno.

Rule.Original: Adds the ability to 'pasue' tithes, preserving the tithe settings while sending silver instead of items
Rule.Raw: Adds the ability to 'pasue' tithes, preserving the tithe settings while sending silver instead of items
Rule.Translated: Se pueden pausar los diezmos, conservando sus ajustes pero enviando plata en lugar de objetos.

Rule.Original: Sets the default animal list to Husky, Timber Wolf, Arctic Wolf, Lynx, Cougar, Muffalo, Dromedary, Horse, Donkey, Elephant, and Yak
Rule.Raw: Sets the default animal list to Husky, Timber Wolf, Arctic Wolf, Lynx, Cougar, Muffalo, Dromedary, Horse, Donkey, Elephant, and Yak
Rule.Translated: La lista predeterminada de animales incluye husky, lobo gris, lobo ártico, lince, puma, mufalo, dromedario, caballo, burro, elefante y yak.

Rule.Original: The stock generator for animal traders will now general pawns for animals instead of trying to use MakeThing
Rule.Raw: The stock generator for animal traders will now general pawns for animals instead of trying to use MakeThing
Rule.Translated: El generador de mercancías de los comerciantes de animales genera ahora peones en lugar de intentar utilizar MakeThing.

Rule.Original: Updates the Orbital Fuel Depot to have an actual icon
Rule.Raw: Updates the Orbital Fuel Depot to have an actual icon
Rule.Translated: El depósito orbital de combustible tiene ahora un icono propio.

Rule.Original: Adds Salvage Guild, Fungal Farm, Wood Gatherer, Woodcutter buildings
Rule.Raw: Adds Salvage Guild, Fungal Farm, Wood Gatherer, Woodcutter buildings
Rule.Translated: Añadidos los edificios gremio de recuperación, granja de hongos, recolector de madera y leñador.

Rule.Original: Fixes a couple building description typos
Rule.Raw: Fixes a couple building description typos
Rule.Translated: Corregidas varias erratas en las descripciones de edificios.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the shuttles building wouldn't refresh correctly
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the shuttles building wouldn't refresh correctly
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el edificio de lanzaderas no se actualizaba correctamente.

Rule.Original: Move the event modifier application code out of FactionFC.FinalizeInit and into each settlement's PostLoadInit phase. WorldComponents are finalized before WorldObjects are, and event modifiers got lost in that difference
Rule.Raw: Move the event modifier application code out of FactionFC.FinalizeInit and into each settlement's PostLoadInit phase. WorldComponents are finalized before WorldObjects are, and event modifiers got lost in that difference
Rule.Translated: La aplicación de modificadores de sucesos pasa de FactionFC.FinalizeInit a PostLoadInit de cada asentamiento. Los WorldComponents terminan antes que los WorldObjects y esa diferencia hacía que se perdieran los modificadores.

Rule.Original: Changes code to handle military cooldown only once per squad deployment
Rule.Raw: Changes code to handle military cooldown only once per squad deployment
Rule.Translated: El tiempo de recuperación militar se gestiona una sola vez por despliegue de escuadrón.

Rule.Original: Handful of other fixes related to post-deployment cooldown
Rule.Raw: Handful of other fixes related to post-deployment cooldown
Rule.Translated: Varias correcciones adicionales del tiempo de recuperación tras los despliegues.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: settlement gizmos would stop working when a shuttle port is built due to an NRE in the shuttle's comp's GetGizmos function
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: settlement gizmos would stop working when a shuttle port is built due to an NRE in the shuttle's comp's GetGizmos function
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los botones del asentamiento dejaban de funcionar al construir un puerto de lanzaderas por una referencia nula en GetGizmos de su componente.

Rule.Original: Fixes up event handling to cleanup a bug with manual defense
Rule.Raw: Fixes up event handling to cleanup a bug with manual defense
Rule.Translated: Ajustada la gestión de sucesos para corregir un error de defensa manual.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when there are no custom xenotypes saved at all, the custom xenotype caches aren't built, and can cause NREs
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when there are no custom xenotypes saved at all, the custom xenotype caches aren't built, and can cause NREs
Rule.Translated: Corrección: si no había xenotipos personalizados guardados, sus cachés no se creaban y podían provocar referencias nulas.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the check for if a xenotype is valid for a given pawn generation request was too permissive
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the check for if a xenotype is valid for a given pawn generation request was too permissive
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la validación de xenotipos para las solicitudes de generación de peones era demasiado permisiva.

Rule.Original: When generating a faction leader for the Empire faction, use PawnKindDefOf.Villager as the ultimate fallback
Rule.Raw: When generating a faction leader for the Empire faction, use PawnKindDefOf.Villager as the ultimate fallback
Rule.Translated: Al generar un líder para Empire se utiliza PawnKindDefOf.Villager como última alternativa.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: some values for building comps were serialized wrong, meaning that buildings like the Shuttle Port could load incorrectly
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: some values for building comps were serialized wrong, meaning that buildings like the Shuttle Port could load incorrectly
Rule.Translated: Corrección: algunos valores de componentes de edificios se guardaban mal y podían cargar incorrectamente edificios como el puerto de lanzaderas.

Rule.Original: Use a background thread for computation of the road builder MST
Rule.Raw: Use a background thread for computation of the road builder MST
Rule.Translated: El cálculo del MST del constructor de carreteras utiliza un hilo en segundo plano.

Rule.Original: Updates many UI strings to use "settlement" instead of "colony"
Rule.Raw: Updates many UI strings to use "settlement" instead of "colony"
Rule.Translated: Muchos textos de la interfaz utilizan «asentamiento» en lugar de «colonia».

Rule.Original: Updates translation keys that don't already have an "FC" prefix to have one. Touches many files.
Rule.Raw: Updates translation keys that don't already have an "FC" prefix to have one. Touches many files.
Rule.Translated: Las claves de traducción que no tenían el prefijo «FC» lo incorporan ahora. El cambio afecta a muchos archivos.

Rule.Original: Buildings can now set tile mutator block/allowlists
Rule.Raw: Buildings can now set tile mutator block/allowlists
Rule.Translated: Los edificios pueden definir listas de modificadores de casilla permitidos y bloqueados.

Rule.Original: New TileMutatorResourceExtension can be patched onto tile mutators to let them grant production bonuses/maluses
Rule.Raw: New TileMutatorResourceExtension can be patched onto tile mutators to let them grant production bonuses/maluses
Rule.Translated: La nueva TileMutatorResourceExtension se puede añadir a modificadores de casilla para que otorguen bonificaciones o penalizaciones de producción.

Rule.Original: New ResourceProductionExtension_TileField allows various tile fields to affect resource production
Rule.Raw: New ResourceProductionExtension_TileField allows various tile fields to affect resource production
Rule.Translated: La nueva ResourceProductionExtension_TileField permite que varios campos de casilla afecten a la producción de recursos.

Rule.Original: New mod setting to ignore research and pin the Empire faction's tech level to the player faction's
Rule.Raw: New mod setting to ignore research and pin the Empire faction's tech level to the player faction's
Rule.Translated: Nuevo ajuste para ignorar la investigación y fijar el nivel tecnológico de Empire al de la facción del jugador.

Rule.Original: Change the tech level gates to be defined through XML
Rule.Raw: Change the tech level gates to be defined through XML
Rule.Translated: Los requisitos de nivel tecnológico se definen ahora mediante XML.

Rule.Original: Adds various protections to clean up a settlement's "under attack" state if there's no corresponding event
Rule.Raw: Adds various protections to clean up a settlement's "under attack" state if there's no corresponding event
Rule.Translated: Añadidas protecciones para limpiar el estado «bajo ataque» de un asentamiento si no tiene un suceso correspondiente.
Más cambios en la interfaz para utilizar «asentamiento».

Rule.Original: Centralizes events into an FCEventManager that handles actually adding or removing events to the queue.
Rule.Raw: Centralizes events into an FCEventManager that handles actually adding or removing events to the queue.
Rule.Translated: Los sucesos se centralizan en FCEventManager, que gestiona su incorporación y eliminación de la cola.

Rule.Original: Adds new TileLandmarkResourceExtension that can be xml patched onto landmarks to make them grant special bonuses to Empire settlements.
Rule.Raw: Adds new TileLandmarkResourceExtension that can be xml patched onto landmarks to make them grant special bonuses to Empire settlements.
Rule.Translated: La nueva TileLandmarkResourceExtension se puede añadir mediante XML a lugares destacados para otorgar bonificaciones especiales a los asentamientos de Empire.

Rule.Original: Adds new window on Found New Settlement screen to show non-resource bonuses/maluses provided by the tile
Rule.Raw: Adds new window on Found New Settlement screen to show non-resource bonuses/maluses provided by the tile
Rule.Translated: Nueva ventana en la pantalla de fundación de asentamientos que muestra las bonificaciones y penalizaciones de la casilla no relacionadas con recursos.

Rule.Original: Adds and wires up a FCStatModifier list to BiomeResourceDef, enabling biomes to add bonuses or maluses to non-resource stats
Rule.Raw: Adds and wires up a FCStatModifier list to BiomeResourceDef, enabling biomes to add bonuses or maluses to non-resource stats
Rule.Translated: Añadida y conectada una lista de FCStatModifier a BiomeResourceDef para que los biomas modifiquen estadísticas ajenas a los recursos.

Rule.Original: Adds numerous null guards. Some are unlikely to ever trigger, but better safe than sorry...
Rule.Raw: Adds numerous null guards. Some are unlikely to ever trigger, but better safe than sorry...
Rule.Translated: Añadidas numerosas comprobaciones de valores nulos. Algunas probablemente nunca se activen, pero conviene prevenir.

Rule.Original: Adds diagnostic logging to the failure paths of Mercantile caravan spawning
Rule.Raw: Adds diagnostic logging to the failure paths of Mercantile caravan spawning
Rule.Translated: Añadido registro de diagnóstico cuando falla la aparición de caravanas del rasgo Mercantil.

Rule.Original: Several harmony patches to improve Empire compatibility with RimWar
Rule.Raw: Several harmony patches to improve Empire compatibility with RimWar
Rule.Translated: Varios parches de Harmony mejoran la compatibilidad de Empire con RimWar.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: after recent translation key changes, the military stat wouldn't render in the settlement window
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: after recent translation key changes, the military stat wouldn't render in the settlement window
Rule.Translated: Corrección: tras los cambios recientes de claves de traducción, la estadística militar no se mostraba en la ventana del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Adds an ISettlementWindowButton interface that can dynamically add buttons to the button left panel of the settlement window
Rule.Raw: Adds an ISettlementWindowButton interface that can dynamically add buttons to the button left panel of the settlement window
Rule.Translated: Añadida ISettlementWindowButton para incorporar botones dinámicamente al panel izquierdo de la ventana del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Adds a version of the road builder network calculations that runs on the main thread instead of a background thread
Rule.Raw: Adds a version of the road builder network calculations that runs on the main thread instead of a background thread
Rule.Translated: Añadida una versión del cálculo de redes de carreteras que se ejecuta en el hilo principal en lugar de en segundo plano.

Rule.Original: Adds a compatibility patch for Vehicle Framework to allow vehicle caravans to start manual battles.
Rule.Raw: Adds a compatibility patch for Vehicle Framework to allow vehicle caravans to start manual battles.
Rule.Translated: Añadido un parche de compatibilidad con Vehicle Framework para que las caravanas de vehículos puedan iniciar batallas manuales.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: using Empire's fire support feature with Combat Extended enabled can sometimes cause projectiles to go way off course
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: using Empire's fire support feature with Combat Extended enabled can sometimes cause projectiles to go way off course
Rule.Translated: Corrección: utilizar el apoyo de fuego de Empire con Combat Extended podía desviar mucho los proyectiles.

Rule.Original: Augments the RimWar compat patch so that RimWar attacks on Empire settlements generate a military event that is resolved through Empire's own system
Rule.Raw: Augments the RimWar compat patch so that RimWar attacks on Empire settlements generate a military event that is resolved through Empire's own system
Rule.Translated: Ampliado el parche de RimWar para que sus ataques contra asentamientos de Empire generen sucesos militares resueltos por el propio sistema de Empire.

Rule.Original: Fixes up the Vehicle Framework compat patch
Rule.Raw: Fixes up the Vehicle Framework compat patch
Rule.Translated: Corregido el parche de compatibilidad con Vehicle Framework.

Rule.Original: Road MST computation: cache edge pathfinding results
Rule.Raw: Road MST computation: cache edge pathfinding results
Rule.Translated: Cálculo del MST de carreteras: los resultados de búsqueda de rutas de las conexiones se guardan en caché.

Rule.Original: Road MST computation: only calculate pathfinding costs for a settlement's 8 closest neighbors, instead of *all* settlements
Rule.Raw: Road MST computation: only calculate pathfinding costs for a settlement's 8 closest neighbors, instead of *all* settlements
Rule.Translated: Cálculo del MST de carreteras: solo se calcula el coste de las rutas a los 8 vecinos más cercanos de cada asentamiento, en lugar de a todos.

Rule.Original: Cleans up the road builder code
Rule.Raw: Cleans up the road builder code
Rule.Translated: Limpieza del código del constructor de carreteras.

Rule.Original: Updates the trader types added by Empire Refactored to not buy literally everything
Rule.Raw: Updates the trader types added by Empire Refactored to not buy literally everything
Rule.Translated: Los tipos de mercader añadidos por Empire Refactored ya no compran absolutamente todo.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when a settlement is under attack, trying to assign a defensive squad through the settlement window can produce an error due to a translation string not receiving all three of its required arguments
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when a settlement is under attack, trying to assign a defensive squad through the settlement window can produce an error due to a translation string not receiving all three of its required arguments
Rule.Translated: Corrección: asignar un escuadrón defensor desde la ventana de un asentamiento bajo ataque podía fallar porque una traducción no recibía sus tres argumentos necesarios.

Rule.Original: Catch errors from erroring events instead of letting them wipe out the event log
Rule.Raw: Catch errors from erroring events instead of letting them wipe out the event log
Rule.Translated: Los errores de los sucesos se capturan en lugar de permitir que borren el registro de sucesos.

Rule.Original: Instead of instantly removing a manual battle map when the battle ends, let the player move their own pawns off of the map
Rule.Raw: Instead of instantly removing a manual battle map when the battle ends, let the player move their own pawns off of the map
Rule.Translated: Al terminar una batalla manual, el mapa no se elimina al instante: el jugador puede sacar a sus peones.

Rule.Original: Adds stone roads to Empire's road progression.
Rule.Raw: Adds stone roads to Empire's road progression.
Rule.Translated: Añadidas carreteras de piedra a la progresión de carreteras de Empire.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: events sometimes won't resolve for unknown reasons, and remain in the queue with negative timers
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: events sometimes won't resolve for unknown reasons, and remain in the queue with negative timers
Rule.Translated: Corrección: algunos sucesos no se resolvían por motivos desconocidos y permanecían en la cola con temporizadores negativos.

Rule.Original: Fixing various issues with new delayed-end manual defense
Rule.Raw: Fixing various issues with new delayed-end manual defense
Rule.Translated: Corregidos varios problemas del nuevo final diferido de las defensas manuales.

Rule.Original: Adds protections against null WorldSettlementFCs in the FactionFc.settlements list
Rule.Raw: Adds protections against null WorldSettlementFCs in the FactionFc.settlements list
Rule.Translated: Añadidas protecciones contra WorldSettlementFC nulos en FactionFc.settlements.

Rule.Original: Various fixes to ensure that shuttles work properly with manual defense
Rule.Raw: Various fixes to ensure that shuttles work properly with manual defense
Rule.Translated: Varias correcciones para que las lanzaderas funcionen correctamente con la defensa manual.

Rule.Original: Update the research tree so that the road and orbital techs aren't awkwardly clashing
Rule.Raw: Update the research tree so that the road and orbital techs aren't awkwardly clashing
Rule.Translated: Actualizado el árbol de investigación para evitar que las tecnologías de carreteras y orbitales se solapen de forma incómoda.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: sending a caravan to help with a manual defense battle and then pulling the pawns out could get the battle stuck
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: sending a caravan to help with a manual defense battle and then pulling the pawns out could get the battle stuck
Rule.Translated: Corrección: enviar una caravana para ayudar en una defensa manual y retirar después los peones podía dejar la batalla atascada.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: if attackers arrive to manual defense with transport pods, the battle may end prematurely
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: if attackers arrive to manual defense with transport pods, the battle may end prematurely
Rule.Translated: Corrección: si los atacantes de una defensa manual llegaban en cápsulas de transporte, la batalla podía terminar antes de tiempo.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: settlements can lose their "isUnderAttack" state on save+load due to object loading order
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: settlements can lose their "isUnderAttack" state on save+load due to object loading order
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los asentamientos podían perder su estado «isUnderAttack» al guardar y cargar debido al orden de carga de objetos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the translation key for the letter that reports an auto-defender was missed in the recent translation key update
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the translation key for the letter that reports an auto-defender was missed in the recent translation key update
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la clave de traducción de la carta que informa sobre un defensor automático se había omitido en la actualización reciente.

Rule.Original: Change: the currently-defending settlement is marked as such when choosing defenders through the world map gizmo
Rule.Raw: Change: the currently-defending settlement is marked as such when choosing defenders through the world map gizmo
Rule.Translated: Cambio: el asentamiento que está defendiendo aparece identificado al elegir defensores desde el botón del mapa mundial.
Añadidas comprobaciones de valores nulos en IsAnimalAndAllowed.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: Empire prisoner pawns are sometimes Scribe_Deep twice, resulting in a litany of errors on loading the save
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: Empire prisoner pawns are sometimes Scribe_Deep twice, resulting in a litany of errors on loading the save
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los peones prisioneros de Empire a veces se guardaban dos veces mediante Scribe_Deep y generaban muchos errores al cargar.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: after winning (or losing) a manual defense battle, the typical "Reform Caravan" gizmo would not appear
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: after winning (or losing) a manual defense battle, the typical "Reform Caravan" gizmo would not appear
Rule.Translated: Corrección: tras ganar o perder una defensa manual no aparecía el botón habitual «Reformar caravana».

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the Reform Caravan gizmo can appear before Empire says the battle is actually over
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the Reform Caravan gizmo can appear before Empire says the battle is actually over
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el botón «Reformar caravana» podía aparecer antes de que Empire considerase terminada la batalla.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: settlements sometimes get stuck in a "Defending [settlement name]" state
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: settlements sometimes get stuck in a "Defending [settlement name]" state
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los asentamientos podían quedar atascados en «Defendiendo [settlement name]».

Rule.Original: Bugfix: a malformed pawnKindDef could cause errors when determining which pawnkinds can be pack animals
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: a malformed pawnKindDef could cause errors when determining which pawnkinds can be pack animals
Rule.Translated: Corrección: un pawnKindDef incorrecto podía provocar errores al determinar qué tipos de peón pueden servir como animales de carga.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: some translation keys were missed in the update from a week or so ago
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: some translation keys were missed in the update from a week or so ago
Rule.Translated: Corrección: algunas claves de traducción se habían omitido en la actualización de hacía aproximadamente una semana.

Rule.Original: Add more null checks when processing pawnKindDefs for the pawnkind caches
Rule.Raw: Add more null checks when processing pawnKindDefs for the pawnkind caches
Rule.Translated: Añadidas más comprobaciones de valores nulos al procesar pawnKindDefs para sus cachés.

Rule.Original: Settlements now track a periodic average of their upkeep.
Rule.Raw: Settlements now track a periodic average of their upkeep.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos registran ahora una media periódica de sus costes de mantenimiento.
Añadida la clave de traducción FCTraitDesc_prosperityLostBase.

Rule.Original: Updates UI displays for estimated income to show the period average, which is what the player will actually receive
Rule.Raw: Updates UI displays for estimated income to show the period average, which is what the player will actually receive
Rule.Translated: Las estimaciones de ingresos de la interfaz muestran la media del período, que es lo que recibe realmente el jugador.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: Base_Empire_Standard traderKindDef collides with the traderKindDef used for the base game's Shattered Empire faction
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: Base_Empire_Standard traderKindDef collides with the traderKindDef used for the base game's Shattered Empire faction
Rule.Translated: Corrección: Base_Empire_Standard coincidía con el traderKindDef utilizado por el Imperio Fragmentado del juego base.

Rule.Original: Remove RaceProps null check in ValidPawnKindDef. PawnKindDef.RaceProps is just a property that accesses race.race, so race being null crashes the access. The following null check on pawnKindDef.race?.race is sufficient.
Rule.Raw: Remove RaceProps null check in ValidPawnKindDef. PawnKindDef.RaceProps is just a property that accesses race.race, so race being null crashes the access. The following null check on pawnKindDef.race?.race is sufficient.
Rule.Translated: Eliminada la comprobación de RaceProps nulo en ValidPawnKindDef. PawnKindDef.RaceProps accede a race.race y falla si race es nulo. La comprobación posterior de pawnKindDef.race?.race es suficiente.

Rule.Original: Further hardening of Empire's pawnKindDef handling
Rule.Raw: Further hardening of Empire's pawnKindDef handling
Rule.Translated: Más mejoras de robustez en la gestión de pawnKindDef de Empire.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: due to int/PlanetTile conversion, the capital location update for the Capital Spot building is broken on non-surface layers, resulting in gravship bases getting bombarded with "Empire Relocated" messages
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: due to int/PlanetTile conversion, the capital location update for the Capital Spot building is broken on non-surface layers, resulting in gravship bases getting bombarded with "Empire Relocated" messages
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la conversión entre int y PlanetTile rompía la actualización de ubicación del edificio de capital en capas distintas de la superficie y llenaba las bases de gravinaves de mensajes «Empire reubicado».

Rule.Original: Tweak: CE compat: increase the number of mags that pawns start with from 3 to 6
Rule.Raw: Tweak: CE compat: increase the number of mags that pawns start with from 3 to 6
Rule.Translated: Ajuste de compatibilidad con CE: los peones comienzan con 6 cargadores en lugar de 3.

Rule.Original: Fixes a bug where, after loading a save, the Empire faction would not have any valid caravan traders until a tax tick occurred
Rule.Raw: Fixes a bug where, after loading a save, the Empire faction would not have any valid caravan traders until a tax tick occurred
Rule.Translated: Corregido un error que dejaba a Empire sin caravanas comerciales válidas después de cargar, hasta que se ejecutaba un tick de impuestos.

Rule.Original: Refines Empire caravans to carry far fewer distinct items
Rule.Raw: Refines Empire caravans to carry far fewer distinct items
Rule.Translated: Las caravanas de Empire transportan muchos menos tipos diferentes de objetos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: due to load-ordering issues, faction-level "Total Production" resource readouts are incorrect when loading a save
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: due to load-ordering issues, faction-level "Total Production" resource readouts are incorrect when loading a save
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el orden de carga hacía incorrectos los datos de «Producción total» de recursos de la facción al cargar una partida.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: strip the combat efficiency hediff whenever a pawn is despawned (e.g. leaves the map or joins a caravan)
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: strip the combat efficiency hediff whenever a pawn is despawned (e.g. leaves the map or joins a caravan)
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la afección de eficiencia de combate se elimina siempre que un peón deja de estar en el mapa, por ejemplo al salir o unirse a una caravana.

Rule.Original: Cap animal spawns for animal caravans to 15.
Rule.Raw: Cap animal spawns for animal caravans to 15.
Rule.Translated: La aparición de animales en caravanas de animales se limita a 15.

Rule.Original: Updates infocard for combat efficiency hediff
Rule.Raw: Updates infocard for combat efficiency hediff
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la ficha de información de la afección de eficiencia de combate.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: targeting circle for fire support would only render while the camera is moving
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: targeting circle for fire support would only render while the camera is moving
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el círculo de selección del apoyo de fuego solo se dibujaba mientras se movía la cámara.

Rule.Original: Set the mercantile trader as a forced event so it doesn't get suppressed by the storyteller or third-party patches
Rule.Raw: Set the mercantile trader as a forced event so it doesn't get suppressed by the storyteller or third-party patches
Rule.Translated: La caravana del rasgo Mercantil se trata como un suceso forzado para impedir que el narrador o parches externos la supriman.

Rule.Original: Wrap the caravan spawning processing in a try/catch so we can still update the next arrival tick if an error occurs
Rule.Raw: Wrap the caravan spawning processing in a try/catch so we can still update the next arrival tick if an error occurs
Rule.Translated: La aparición de caravanas se ejecuta en un bloque try/catch para actualizar el próximo tick de llegada aunque ocurra un error.

Rule.Original: Merantile caravans use TaxMap instead of ReturnCapitalMap(). TaxMap actually falls through to the player's active colony if neither a capital nor a tax spot are set
Rule.Raw: Merantile caravans use TaxMap instead of ReturnCapitalMap(). TaxMap actually falls through to the player's active colony if neither a capital nor a tax spot are set
Rule.Translated: Las caravanas mercantiles utilizan TaxMap en lugar de ReturnCapitalMap(). TaxMap recurre a la colonia activa del jugador si no hay capital ni punto de impuestos.

Rule.Original: Shrink faction icons to 256x256, and shrink trait icons to 128x128
Rule.Raw: Shrink faction icons to 256x256, and shrink trait icons to 128x128
Rule.Translated: Los iconos de facción se reducen a 256x256 y los de rasgos a 128x128.

Rule.Original: Remove redundant texture loads in TexLoad
Rule.Raw: Remove redundant texture loads in TexLoad
Rule.Translated: Eliminadas las cargas redundantes de texturas en TexLoad.

Rule.Original: Removes the naive name filter for xenotypes
Rule.Raw: Removes the naive name filter for xenotypes
Rule.Translated: Eliminado el filtro simplista de nombres de xenotipos.

Rule.Original: Change non-English translation keys: TotalValue -> FCTotalValue
Rule.Raw: Change non-English translation keys: TotalValue -> FCTotalValue
Rule.Translated: Cambio de claves de traducción ajenas al inglés: TotalValue pasa a FCTotalValue.

Rule.Original: Gate needs checks behind RaceProps.Humanlike instead of !AnimalOrWildMan()
Rule.Raw: Gate needs checks behind RaceProps.Humanlike instead of !AnimalOrWildMan()
Rule.Translated: Las comprobaciones de necesidades utilizan RaceProps.Humanlike en lugar de !AnimalOrWildMan().

Rule.Original: When checking if it's safe to delete a map, check AllPawnsSpawned with a faction filter, rather than checking FreeColonistsSpawned
Rule.Raw: When checking if it's safe to delete a map, check AllPawnsSpawned with a faction filter, rather than checking FreeColonistsSpawned
Rule.Translated: Para comprobar si es seguro eliminar un mapa se consulta AllPawnsSpawned con un filtro de facción, en lugar de FreeColonistsSpawned.

Rule.Original: Store a direct reference to the unit's race in MilUnitFC, so that when we load the unit, we can restore the correct pawnKind
Rule.Raw: Store a direct reference to the unit's race in MilUnitFC, so that when we load the unit, we can restore the correct pawnKind
Rule.Translated: MilUnitFC guarda una referencia directa a la raza de la unidad para restaurar el pawnKind correcto al cargarla.

Rule.Original: If a designed unit has a set race, then always use that race, even if it has weight 0 in the faction's xenotype filter
Rule.Raw: If a designed unit has a set race, then always use that race, even if it has weight 0 in the faction's xenotype filter
Rule.Translated: Si una unidad diseñada tiene una raza asignada, se utiliza siempre, aunque su peso en el filtro de xenotipos de la facción sea 0.

Rule.Original: When finding the tax map, don't clobber an already-found map with a null value just because CheckForActiveTaxDeliverySpot returned false
Rule.Raw: When finding the tax map, don't clobber an already-found map with a null value just because CheckForActiveTaxDeliverySpot returned false
Rule.Translated: Al buscar el mapa de impuestos, un resultado válido no se sobrescribe con un valor nulo solo porque CheckForActiveTaxDeliverySpot devuelve false.

Rule.Original: Don't cache the FactionFC WorldComponent in SettlementTypeExtension
Rule.Raw: Don't cache the FactionFC WorldComponent in SettlementTypeExtension
Rule.Translated: SettlementTypeExtension no guarda en caché el WorldComponent FactionFC.

Rule.Original: Snapshot settlement cost in the settle confirmation dialog so the actual cost paid matches what the user sees in all cases
Rule.Raw: Snapshot settlement cost in the settle confirmation dialog so the actual cost paid matches what the user sees in all cases
Rule.Translated: El diálogo de confirmación registra el coste de fundación para que la cantidad pagada coincida siempre con la mostrada.

Rule.Original: Don't scribe FactionFC.factionResources. It's always fully rebuilt after loading, so saving it is pointless
Rule.Raw: Don't scribe FactionFC.factionResources. It's always fully rebuilt after loading, so saving it is pointless
Rule.Translated: FactionFC.factionResources no se guarda mediante Scribe: se reconstruye por completo después de cargar y guardarlo es innecesario.

Rule.Original: Add BuildPawnGroupMakerDiagnostic for increased diag logging when a mercantile caravan fails to spawn
Rule.Raw: Add BuildPawnGroupMakerDiagnostic for increased diag logging when a mercantile caravan fails to spawn
Rule.Translated: Añadido BuildPawnGroupMakerDiagnostic para ampliar los datos de diagnóstico cuando no aparece una caravana mercantil.

Rule.Original: XenotypeFilter.ValidatePawnGroupMakers now also validates that trader makers have valid carriers
Rule.Raw: XenotypeFilter.ValidatePawnGroupMakers now also validates that trader makers have valid carriers
Rule.Translated: XenotypeFilter.ValidatePawnGroupMakers también comprueba que los generadores de comerciantes tengan transportistas válidos.

Rule.Original: Adds diagnostic logging showing when a player's selection of animal carriers doesn't cover the biome of their colony
Rule.Raw: Adds diagnostic logging showing when a player's selection of animal carriers doesn't cover the biome of their colony
Rule.Translated: Añadido registro de diagnóstico cuando los animales de carga elegidos por el jugador no admiten el bioma de su colonia.

Rule.Original: Also adds a small patch for RimWar to force Vassal status on the Empire faction
Rule.Raw: Also adds a small patch for RimWar to force Vassal status on the Empire faction
Rule.Translated: Añadido un pequeño parche de RimWar que fuerza el estado de vasallaje de la facción Empire.

Rule.Original: Adds ITaxDeliveryInterceptor interface to let submods redirect tax events, or intercept them at time of delivery
Rule.Raw: Adds ITaxDeliveryInterceptor interface to let submods redirect tax events, or intercept them at time of delivery
Rule.Translated: Añadida ITaxDeliveryInterceptor para que los mods complementarios redirijan los sucesos de impuestos o los intercepten al entregarlos.

Rule.Original: Cleans up some code to more properly encapsulate many fields
Rule.Raw: Cleans up some code to more properly encapsulate many fields
Rule.Translated: Limpieza del código para encapsular mejor numerosos campos.

Rule.Original: Adds new ScrollUtil class to handle the new scrollbars
Rule.Raw: Adds new ScrollUtil class to handle the new scrollbars
Rule.Translated: Nueva clase ScrollUtil para gestionar las barras de desplazamiento.

Rule.Original: Adds framework for the Empire Codex
Rule.Raw: Adds framework for the Empire Codex
Rule.Translated: Añadida la estructura del códice de Empire.

Rule.Original: Allows multiple raids to hit the same settlement at once
Rule.Raw: Allows multiple raids to hit the same settlement at once
Rule.Translated: Se permiten varias incursiones simultáneas contra el mismo asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Allows multiple settlements to be raided at once
Rule.Raw: Allows multiple settlements to be raided at once
Rule.Translated: Se permiten incursiones simultáneas contra varios asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Adds backend infrastructure for a submod to implement manual battles for offensive raids
Rule.Raw: Adds backend infrastructure for a submod to implement manual battles for offensive raids
Rule.Translated: Añadida la infraestructura para que un mod complementario implemente batallas manuales en incursiones ofensivas.

Rule.Original: Adds Resources to the Empire Codex.
Rule.Raw: Adds Resources to the Empire Codex.
Rule.Translated: Añadidos los recursos al códice de Empire.

Rule.Original: Change TextUtil.ColorizeAdditiveBonus and ColorizeMultiplierBonus to return strings instead of TaggedStrings
Rule.Raw: Change TextUtil.ColorizeAdditiveBonus and ColorizeMultiplierBonus to return strings instead of TaggedStrings
Rule.Translated: TextUtil.ColorizeAdditiveBonus y ColorizeMultiplierBonus devuelven strings en lugar de TaggedStrings.

Rule.Original: Adds MilitaryWindowRegistry to make it easier for submods to intercept the existing Manage Units/Squads/Fire Support windows and draw their own
Rule.Raw: Adds MilitaryWindowRegistry to make it easier for submods to intercept the existing Manage Units/Squads/Fire Support windows and draw their own
Rule.Translated: Añadida MilitaryWindowRegistry para facilitar que los mods complementarios intercepten las ventanas de gestión de unidades, escuadrones y apoyo de fuego, y dibujen las suyas.

Rule.Original: Prevent the user from setting the time between taxes to 0. If it somehow becomes 0 anyways, log a warning and set it to 1.
Rule.Raw: Prevent the user from setting the time between taxes to 0. If it somehow becomes 0 anyways, log a warning and set it to 1.
Rule.Translated: Se impide fijar el tiempo entre impuestos en 0. Si aun así llega a 0, se registra un aviso y se cambia a 1.

Rule.Original: Adds Codex entries for Resource Production, Production Snapshots, Resource Tithing, Worker Overmax, Difficulty Settings, Attack Frequency, Battle Simulation, Battle Simulation Modifiers, and Military Cooldown
Rule.Raw: Adds Codex entries for Resource Production, Production Snapshots, Resource Tithing, Worker Overmax, Difficulty Settings, Attack Frequency, Battle Simulation, Battle Simulation Modifiers, and Military Cooldown
Rule.Translated: Añadidas entradas del códice sobre producción de recursos, registros de producción, diezmos, exceso de trabajadores, dificultad, frecuencia de ataques, simulación de batallas, modificadores de simulación y recuperación militar.

Rule.Original: Alters MilUnitFC, MilSquadFC, and MercenarySquadFC to be subclassable
Rule.Raw: Alters MilUnitFC, MilSquadFC, and MercenarySquadFC to be subclassable
Rule.Translated: MilUnitFC, MilSquadFC y MercenarySquadFC admiten ahora clases derivadas.

Rule.Original: Alters unit and squad saving to account for subclassing
Rule.Raw: Alters unit and squad saving to account for subclassing
Rule.Translated: El guardado de unidades y escuadrones tiene en cuenta las clases derivadas.

Rule.Original: Militaristic policy nerfed: 1.2 military efficiency -> 1.1, extra squad cost 20% -> 40%, military building upkeep reduction 100 -> 50, and the policy now carries an inherent -0.5 happiness per day. People generally don't like living in militaristic regimes, after all
Rule.Raw: Militaristic policy nerfed: 1.2 military efficiency -> 1.1, extra squad cost 20% -> 40%, military building upkeep reduction 100 -> 50, and the policy now carries an inherent -0.5 happiness per day. People generally don't like living in militaristic regimes, after all
Rule.Translated: Reducida la política Militarista: eficiencia militar de 1.2 a 1.1, coste del escuadrón extra del 20% al 40% y reducción del mantenimiento militar de 100 a 50. Añadida una penalización de -0.5 de felicidad al día. En general, a la gente no le gusta vivir bajo regímenes militaristas.

Rule.Original: Pacifist policy buff/nerfed: no longer immune to soldier deaths (no idea why that was even a thing); in exchange, the diplomatic envoy is slightly more likely to succeed, and the relation improvement range has been changed from 5-15 to 8-20
Rule.Raw: Pacifist policy buff/nerfed: no longer immune to soldier deaths (no idea why that was even a thing); in exchange, the diplomatic envoy is slightly more likely to succeed, and the relation improvement range has been changed from 5-15 to 8-20
Rule.Translated: Ajustada la política Pacifista: ya no es inmune a las muertes de soldados, algo que no tenía sentido. A cambio, los emisarios diplomáticos tienen más probabilidades de éxito y la mejora de relaciones pasa de 5-15 a 8-20.

Rule.Original: Egalitarian changed: removed happiness-based tax bonus as well as starting happiness penalty. Added 10% worker production bonus, 1 additional worker per level, -3 overmax workers, worker base cost increased by 10
Rule.Raw: Egalitarian changed: removed happiness-based tax bonus as well as starting happiness penalty. Added 10% worker production bonus, 1 additional worker per level, -3 overmax workers, worker base cost increased by 10
Rule.Translated: Cambios en Igualitaria: eliminadas la bonificación fiscal basada en felicidad y la penalización inicial de felicidad. Añadidos un 10% de producción de trabajadores, 1 trabajador extra por nivel y -3 trabajadores por encima del máximo. El coste base del trabajador aumenta en 10.

Rule.Original: Expansionist changed: no more free starting settlement, no more 50% discount once per year. Instead, all settlements are 25% cheaper, but start at 75% prosperity. Threat scaling increased by 10% as well
Rule.Raw: Expansionist changed: no more free starting settlement, no more 50% discount once per year. Instead, all settlements are 25% cheaper, but start at 75% prosperity. Threat scaling increased by 10% as well
Rule.Translated: Cambios en Expansionista: desaparecen el asentamiento inicial gratis y el descuento anual del 50%. Todos los asentamientos cuestan un 25% menos, pero comienzan con un 75% de prosperidad. El escalado de amenaza aumenta también un 10%.

Rule.Original: Technocratic nerfed: now carries a -10% penalty to base tax percentage
Rule.Raw: Technocratic nerfed: now carries a -10% penalty to base tax percentage
Rule.Translated: Reducida Tecnocrática: ahora tiene una penalización de -10% al porcentaje de impuesto base.

Rule.Original: Slaver nerfed: -0.5 happiness and +0.5 unrest per day. You don't get to rely on slave labor for free, bucko (and the +2 workers per settlement level *is* quite strong)
Rule.Raw: Slaver nerfed: -0.5 happiness and +0.5 unrest per day. You don't get to rely on slave labor for free, bucko (and the +2 workers per settlement level *is* quite strong)
Rule.Translated: Reducida Esclavista: -0.5 de felicidad y +0.5 de agitación al día. No puedes depender gratis del trabajo esclavo; la bonificación de +2 trabajadores por nivel de asentamiento es bastante potente.

Rule.Original: Scorched Earth Doctrine buffed: building destruction chance 2x -> 1.25x, defending bonus 1.3x -> 1.5x, prosperity loss on victory 1.5x -> 1.2x
Rule.Raw: Scorched Earth Doctrine buffed: building destruction chance 2x -> 1.25x, defending bonus 1.3x -> 1.5x, prosperity loss on victory 1.5x -> 1.2x
Rule.Translated: Mejorada la doctrina Tierra quemada: probabilidad de destruir edificios de 2x a 1.25x, bonificación defensiva de 1.3x a 1.5x y pérdida de prosperidad tras una victoria de 1.5x a 1.2x.

Rule.Original: Added option to clear policy choices after they've already been chosen, for a cost that scales based on Empire size and prosperity
Rule.Raw: Added option to clear policy choices after they've already been chosen, for a cost that scales based on Empire size and prosperity
Rule.Translated: Añadida la opción de borrar las políticas ya elegidas pagando un coste que aumenta según el tamaño y la prosperidad de Empire.

Rule.Original: Update to use actual PlanetTile type wherever appropriate
Rule.Raw: Update to use actual PlanetTile type wherever appropriate
Rule.Translated: Se utiliza el tipo PlanetTile real donde corresponde.

Rule.Original: Always spawn animals without riders in manual defense battles
Rule.Raw: Always spawn animals without riders in manual defense battles
Rule.Translated: Los animales aparecen siempre sin jinetes en las batallas defensivas manuales.

Rule.Original: Updates events to have one of four phases, indicating at what stage of processing they're in. Makes event tracking more clear
Rule.Raw: Updates events to have one of four phases, indicating at what stage of processing they're in. Makes event tracking more clear
Rule.Translated: Los sucesos tienen una de cuatro fases que indica su etapa de procesamiento y hace más claro su seguimiento.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the list of caravan traderkinds is assembled before faction-level production allocations are loaded, resulting in an empty caravan list until tax time
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the list of caravan traderkinds is assembled before faction-level production allocations are loaded, resulting in an empty caravan list until tax time
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la lista de tipos de mercader de caravanas se montaba antes de cargar la producción de la facción y quedaba vacía hasta el siguiente cobro de impuestos.

Rule.Original: Removes an overly-strict tax period guard in TaxTick() that blocked the debug action for instantly proccing taxes
Rule.Raw: Removes an overly-strict tax period guard in TaxTick() that blocked the debug action for instantly proccing taxes
Rule.Translated: Eliminada una restricción excesiva del período fiscal en TaxTick() que impedía activar impuestos al instante desde la depuración.

Rule.Original: Auto-resolve battles now play out round-by-round over time, complete with a window to watch the battle's progress. Now you can see all of the RNG and math that goes into determining an auto-resolve result.
Rule.Raw: Auto-resolve battles now play out round-by-round over time, complete with a window to watch the battle's progress. Now you can see all of the RNG and math that goes into determining an auto-resolve result.
Rule.Translated: Las batallas automáticas se desarrollan por rondas a lo largo del tiempo, con una ventana para seguir su progreso. Ahora puedes ver los cálculos y el azar que determinan el resultado.

Rule.Original: Battle Reports for both auto- and manual-battles are archived in the Military main tab. Reports for auto-battles include the round-by-round progress.
Rule.Raw: Battle Reports for both auto- and manual-battles are archived in the Military main tab. Reports for auto-battles include the round-by-round progress.
Rule.Translated: Los informes de batallas automáticas y manuales se archivan en la pestaña militar principal. Los automáticos incluyen el progreso ronda a ronda.

Rule.Original: Multiple simultaneous attacks on the same settlement are now supported. The mod currently doesn't actually *use* this behavior, but it opens the door to lots of fun stuff in the future.
Rule.Raw: Multiple simultaneous attacks on the same settlement are now supported. The mod currently doesn't actually *use* this behavior, but it opens the door to lots of fun stuff in the future.
Rule.Translated: Se admiten varios ataques simultáneos contra el mismo asentamiento. El mod todavía no utiliza esta posibilidad, pero abre opciones interesantes para el futuro.

Rule.Original: The reward for an Overwhelming Victory has been changed from cooldown elimination to a small happiness and loyalty boost.
Rule.Raw: The reward for an Overwhelming Victory has been changed from cooldown elimination to a small happiness and loyalty boost.
Rule.Translated: La recompensa de una victoria arrolladora cambia: en lugar de eliminar el tiempo de recuperación, concede una pequeña bonificación de felicidad y lealtad.

Rule.Original: Added Crushing Defeat, the opposite of Overwhelming Victory. A Crushing Defeat is when you're defeated without inflicting a single casualty on the opposing force. The penalties for Crushing Defeat are more severe than for regular defeats.
Rule.Raw: Added Crushing Defeat, the opposite of Overwhelming Victory. A Crushing Defeat is when you're defeated without inflicting a single casualty on the opposing force. The penalties for Crushing Defeat are more severe than for regular defeats.
Rule.Translated: Añadida la derrota aplastante, opuesta a la victoria arrolladora. Ocurre cuando pierdes sin causar ni una baja al enemigo y conlleva penalizaciones más graves que una derrota normal.

Rule.Original: Squads have been completely reworked. No longer do you design a squad and then assign it to a settlement for free. Now, you must hire each individual squad. Furthermore, squads will not automatically update if you change their associated template; you have to pay to update them. And if a member of the squad dies, you'll need to hire a replacement. Squads aren't a free lunch anymore, pal!
Rule.Raw: Squads have been completely reworked. No longer do you design a squad and then assign it to a settlement for free. Now, you must hire each individual squad. Furthermore, squads will not automatically update if you change their associated template; you have to pay to update them. And if a member of the squad dies, you'll need to hire a replacement. Squads aren't a free lunch anymore, pal!
Rule.Translated: Escuadrones completamente rediseñados. Ya no basta con diseñarlos y asignarlos gratis: hay que contratar cada escuadrón. Cambiar su plantilla no lo actualiza automáticamente; debes pagar la actualización. También debes contratar reemplazos para los miembros muertos. ¡Los escuadrones ya no salen gratis!

Rule.Original: (There are options in the settings to reduce the hire/upgrade cost for squads. If you *really* hate paying for things, you can drop the costs to 0, to emulate older Empire behavior.)
Rule.Raw: (There are options in the settings to reduce the hire/upgrade cost for squads. If you *really* hate paying for things, you can drop the costs to 0, to emulate older Empire behavior.)
Rule.Translated: Hay ajustes para reducir el coste de contratación y mejora de escuadrones. Si realmente detestas pagar, puedes reducirlo a 0 para imitar el funcionamiento antiguo de Empire.

Rule.Original: Injured squad members will heal over time. A squad that is deployed with injured members will not be as effective as when it's completely healthy.
Rule.Raw: Injured squad members will heal over time. A squad that is deployed with injured members will not be as effective as when it's completely healthy.
Rule.Translated: Los miembros heridos de los escuadrones se curan con el tiempo. Desplegar un escuadrón con heridos es menos eficaz que desplegarlo completamente sano.

Rule.Original: All deployments and offensive operations cost 20% of the squad's value. This was technically already true for deployments, but this update surfaces that cost in the UI and sends you a bill.
Rule.Raw: All deployments and offensive operations cost 20% of the squad's value. This was technically already true for deployments, but this update surfaces that cost in the UI and sends you a bill.
Rule.Translated: Todos los despliegues y operaciones ofensivas cuestan el 20% del valor del escuadrón. Ya era así en los despliegues, pero ahora la interfaz muestra el coste y envía una factura.

Rule.Original: Post-deployment squad cooldowns have been mostly replaced with travel time based on the distance back to their home settlement.
Rule.Raw: Post-deployment squad cooldowns have been mostly replaced with travel time based on the distance back to their home settlement.
Rule.Translated: Los tiempos de recuperación tras un despliegue se sustituyen en gran parte por el tiempo de viaje de regreso al asentamiento de origen.

Rule.Original: You can now personally customize each squad by editing the loadouts of specific squad members, or hiring additional members to a specific squad. All of these changes flow naturally into a squad's effective power, currently calculated from the squad's total value.
Rule.Raw: You can now personally customize each squad by editing the loadouts of specific squad members, or hiring additional members to a specific squad. All of these changes flow naturally into a squad's effective power, currently calculated from the squad's total value.
Rule.Translated: Puedes personalizar cada escuadrón modificando el equipo de miembros concretos o contratando miembros adicionales. Los cambios afectan a su fuerza efectiva, calculada actualmente según su valor total.

Rule.Original: Settlements without an assigned squad will defend at half-power when attacked.
Rule.Raw: Settlements without an assigned squad will defend at half-power when attacked.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos sin escuadrón asignado se defienden a media fuerza cuando son atacados.

Rule.Original: There is now support for a settlement to host multiple squads. The mod itself doesn't take advantage of this yet, but it opens some neat doors for the future.
Rule.Raw: There is now support for a settlement to host multiple squads. The mod itself doesn't take advantage of this yet, but it opens some neat doors for the future.
Rule.Translated: Un asentamiento puede alojar varios escuadrones. El mod todavía no aprovecha esta posibilidad, pero abre opciones interesantes para el futuro.

Rule.Original: New UI for picking squads to defend a settlement, or to attack an enemy settlement. Estimated enemy power and each squad's estimated win chance are now surfaced in the UI, so offensive operations aren't blind anymore.
Rule.Raw: New UI for picking squads to defend a settlement, or to attack an enemy settlement. Estimated enemy power and each squad's estimated win chance are now surfaced in the UI, so offensive operations aren't blind anymore.
Rule.Translated: Nueva interfaz para elegir escuadrones defensores o atacantes. Muestra la fuerza enemiga estimada y las probabilidades de victoria de cada escuadrón, para que las operaciones ofensivas ya no sean a ciegas.

Rule.Original: Non-Empire NPC settlements now show their estimated military level and efficiency when selected on the world map.
Rule.Raw: Non-Empire NPC settlements now show their estimated military level and efficiency when selected on the world map.
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos no jugadores ajenos a Empire muestran su nivel y eficiencia militar estimados al seleccionarlos en el mapa mundial.

Rule.Original: Deployed squads will now immediately follow new orders instead of finishing their previous order first.
Rule.Raw: Deployed squads will now immediately follow new orders instead of finishing their previous order first.
Rule.Translated: Los escuadrones desplegados obedecen inmediatamente las nuevas órdenes, sin terminar antes la anterior.

Rule.Original: Bills can now carry custom late- and unpaid-payment penalties, used for mercenary deployment bills currently.
Rule.Raw: Bills can now carry custom late- and unpaid-payment penalties, used for mercenary deployment bills currently.
Rule.Translated: Las facturas pueden incluir penalizaciones personalizadas por pagos atrasados o impagados, utilizadas actualmente en los despliegues de mercenarios.

Rule.Original: Rework the xenotype cost calculation for merc units
Rule.Raw: Rework the xenotype cost calculation for merc units
Rule.Translated: Rediseñado el cálculo del coste de xenotipos de unidades mercenarias.

Rule.Original: Create a FindFC class, similar to Verse.Find
Rule.Raw: Create a FindFC class, similar to Verse.Find
Rule.Translated: Creada la clase FindFC, similar a Verse.Find.

Rule.Original: Pull Tax and Event code out of the FactionFC World Component
Rule.Raw: Pull Tax and Event code out of the FactionFC World Component
Rule.Translated: El código de impuestos y sucesos se extrae del componente mundial FactionFC.

Rule.Original: Adds a prisoner tab to the main tab window, giving an overview of all prisoners in your empire
Rule.Raw: Adds a prisoner tab to the main tab window, giving an overview of all prisoners in your empire
Rule.Translated: Añadida una pestaña de prisioneros a la ventana principal con una vista general de todos los prisioneros de tu imperio.

Rule.Original: Prisoners now lose health on a daily basis, instead of on each tax tick
Rule.Raw: Prisoners now lose health on a daily basis, instead of on each tax tick
Rule.Translated: Los prisioneros pierden salud diariamente en lugar de en cada tick de impuestos.

Rule.Original: Downed prisoners do not grant a worker bonus
Rule.Raw: Downed prisoners do not grant a worker bonus
Rule.Translated: Los prisioneros abatidos no conceden bonificaciones de trabajadores.

Rule.Original: Prisoners at full health no longer magically regrow their legs
Rule.Raw: Prisoners at full health no longer magically regrow their legs
Rule.Translated: A los prisioneros con salud completa ya no les vuelven a crecer las piernas por arte de magia.

Rule.Original: Prisoners must be physically transported to the destination settlement and then transfer via world map gizmo. No more magical teleportation
Rule.Raw: Prisoners must be physically transported to the destination settlement and then transfer via world map gizmo. No more magical teleportation
Rule.Translated: Los prisioneros deben transportarse físicamente hasta el asentamiento y transferirse mediante el botón del mapa mundial. Se acabó la teletransportación mágica.
Se comprueba RaceProps.Humanlike en lugar de !AnimalOrWildMan.

Rule.Original: Adds more Def caching to FactionCache
Rule.Raw: Adds more Def caching to FactionCache
Rule.Translated: Añadidas más cachés de definiciones a FactionCache.

Rule.Original: When checking for battle end-state, loop over AllPawnsSpawned with a Faction.OfPlayer filter instead of looping over FreeColonistsSpawned
Rule.Raw: When checking for battle end-state, loop over AllPawnsSpawned with a Faction.OfPlayer filter instead of looping over FreeColonistsSpawned
Rule.Translated: Para comprobar el final de una batalla se recorre AllPawnsSpawned con un filtro Faction.OfPlayer, en lugar de FreeColonistsSpawned.

Rule.Original: Adds buttons to set the default prisoner workload on a faction and per-settlement basis
Rule.Raw: Adds buttons to set the default prisoner workload on a faction and per-settlement basis
Rule.Translated: Añadidos botones para fijar la carga de trabajo predeterminada de prisioneros por facción y por asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Adds buttons to bulk set prisoner workloads on a faction and per-settlement basis
Rule.Raw: Adds buttons to bulk set prisoner workloads on a faction and per-settlement basis
Rule.Translated: Añadidos botones para cambiar en bloque la carga de trabajo de prisioneros por facción y por asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Multiple prisoner deaths at the same settlement are bundled into one letter
Rule.Raw: Multiple prisoner deaths at the same settlement are bundled into one letter
Rule.Translated: Las muertes de varios prisioneros en el mismo asentamiento se agrupan en una sola carta.

Rule.Original: Prisoner deaths now grant a -2 relations penalty with the prisoner's home faction
Rule.Raw: Prisoner deaths now grant a -2 relations penalty with the prisoner's home faction
Rule.Translated: Las muertes de prisioneros causan ahora una penalización de -2 a las relaciones con su facción de origen.

Rule.Original: Patch DeliveryEvent.Action to check the TaxMap early; if null, go through the safe handling route in PaymentUtil
Rule.Raw: Patch DeliveryEvent.Action to check the TaxMap early; if null, go through the safe handling route in PaymentUtil
Rule.Translated: DeliveryEvent.Action comprueba TaxMap al principio. Si es nulo, utiliza la gestión segura de PaymentUtil.

Rule.Original: Adds a mod option to scale silver costs of event options
Rule.Raw: Adds a mod option to scale silver costs of event options
Rule.Translated: Añadida una opción para ajustar los costes de plata de las opciones de sucesos.

Rule.Original: Various tweaks and edits to random events
Rule.Raw: Various tweaks and edits to random events
Rule.Translated: Varios ajustes y cambios en los sucesos aleatorios.

Rule.Original: Recalculate defender strength at the start of a defense battle
Rule.Raw: Recalculate defender strength at the start of a defense battle
Rule.Translated: La fuerza defensora se recalcula al comenzar una batalla defensiva.

Rule.Original: Force-pause the game when an event with options pops
Rule.Raw: Force-pause the game when an event with options pops
Rule.Translated: El juego se pausa obligatoriamente cuando aparece un suceso con opciones.

Rule.Original: Scale event option costs by the number of affected settlements, as well as optionally by faction income or resource production
Rule.Raw: Scale event option costs by the number of affected settlements, as well as optionally by faction income or resource production
Rule.Translated: Los costes de las opciones de sucesos escalan según el número de asentamientos afectados y, opcionalmente, los ingresos o la producción de recursos de la facción.

Rule.Original: General balance and editing pass for all events
Rule.Raw: General balance and editing pass for all events
Rule.Translated: Revisión general de equilibrio y redacción de todos los sucesos.

Rule.Original: In BattlefieldContext.RecruitMapInhabitants, move the GeneratePawn call into the try/catch block
Rule.Raw: In BattlefieldContext.RecruitMapInhabitants, move the GeneratePawn call into the try/catch block
Rule.Translated: En BattlefieldContext.RecruitMapInhabitants, la llamada GeneratePawn pasa al bloque try/catch.

Rule.Original: When setting up a defense battle in BattlefieldContext.StartDefense, strip third-party hostiles after generating the map but before setting up the actual attack
Rule.Raw: When setting up a defense battle in BattlefieldContext.StartDefense, strip third-party hostiles after generating the map but before setting up the actual attack
Rule.Translated: Al preparar una defensa en BattlefieldContext.StartDefense, los enemigos externos se eliminan tras generar el mapa y antes de organizar el ataque.

Rule.Original: Update Dialog_DefendSettlement to handle non-WorldSettlementFC defenders
Rule.Raw: Update Dialog_DefendSettlement to handle non-WorldSettlementFC defenders
Rule.Translated: Dialog_DefendSettlement admite defensores que no sean WorldSettlementFC.

Rule.Original: Updates IRaidTarget to use PlanetTile instead of int
Rule.Raw: Updates IRaidTarget to use PlanetTile instead of int
Rule.Translated: IRaidTarget utiliza PlanetTile en lugar de int.

Rule.Original: Change FactionFC.TickActions to only tick policybehaviors that tick
Rule.Raw: Change FactionFC.TickActions to only tick policybehaviors that tick
Rule.Translated: FactionFC.TickActions solo actualiza por ticks los comportamientos de políticas que lo necesitan.

Rule.Original: Override both Tick and TickInterval in WorldSettlementFC to exclude WorldObjectComps that haven't defined their own Ticks (and thus, don't need to tick)
Rule.Raw: Override both Tick and TickInterval in WorldSettlementFC to exclude WorldObjectComps that haven't defined their own Ticks (and thus, don't need to tick)
Rule.Translated: Tick y TickInterval de WorldSettlementFC omiten los WorldObjectComps que no definen sus propios ticks y no necesitan actualizarse.

Rule.Original: Various augments to the animal filter to reduce the likelihood of the player encountering Empire caravans that fail to spawn due to not having any animal carriers that support the player's biome
Rule.Raw: Various augments to the animal filter to reduce the likelihood of the player encountering Empire caravans that fail to spawn due to not having any animal carriers that support the player's biome
Rule.Translated: Mejorado el filtro de animales para reducir las caravanas de Empire que no pueden aparecer por carecer de animales de carga compatibles con el bioma del jugador.

Rule.Original: Adds support for crystalline caverns, earthen depths, and fungal forest from Biomes! Caverns
Rule.Raw: Adds support for crystalline caverns, earthen depths, and fungal forest from Biomes! Caverns
Rule.Translated: Añadida compatibilidad con las cavernas cristalinas, las profundidades terrestres y el bosque de hongos de Biomes! Caverns.

Rule.Original: Augment the unit designer and edit pawn windows to let the player specify the unit's inventory and implants
Rule.Raw: Augment the unit designer and edit pawn windows to let the player specify the unit's inventory and implants
Rule.Translated: El diseñador de unidades y la edición de peones permiten elegir el inventario y los implantes de la unidad.

Rule.Original: Fix a bug where squads, on deployment, would immediately try to follow the last order they were given on their previous deployment
