Rule.Raw: Fix a bug where squads, on deployment, would immediately try to follow the last order they were given on their previous deployment
Rule.Translated: Corregido un error que hacía que los escuadrones intentaran obedecer la última orden del despliegue anterior nada más desplegarse.

Rule.Original: Assign only the player's primary ideology to the Empire faction on creation
Rule.Raw: Assign only the player's primary ideology to the Empire faction on creation
Rule.Translated: Al crear Empire se le asigna únicamente la ideología principal del jugador.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the settlement cost modifier, when added to a biome, would not actually affect the cost of founding a new settlement in that biome
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the settlement cost modifier, when added to a biome, would not actually affect the cost of founding a new settlement in that biome
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el modificador de coste de asentamiento aplicado a un bioma no afectaba realmente al coste de fundación en ese bioma.

Rule.Original: Added stats for building cost base, building cost multiplier, building upkeep base, and building upkeep multiplier. Each has a military and civilian version that stacks
Rule.Raw: Added stats for building cost base, building cost multiplier, building upkeep base, and building upkeep multiplier. Each has a military and civilian version that stacks
Rule.Translated: Añadidas estadísticas de coste base, multiplicador de coste, mantenimiento base y multiplicador de mantenimiento de edificios. Cada una tiene versiones militares y civiles acumulables.

Rule.Original: BuildingFCDef has a new IsMilitary field. Moving forward, this field is what determines whether a building is military or civilian
Rule.Raw: BuildingFCDef has a new IsMilitary field. Moving forward, this field is what determines whether a building is military or civilian
Rule.Translated: BuildingFCDef incorpora IsMilitary, que determina en adelante si el edificio es militar o civil.

Rule.Original: Add numerous other new stats: fireSupportCostMultiplier, policyActionCooldownMultiplier, casualtyWoundSeverityMultiplier, threatAdaptationGrowthMultiplier, battleLossProsperityBase, battleLossHappinessBase, battleLossLoyaltyBase, victoryHappinessBonus, victoryLoyaltyBonus, settlementUpgradeCostBase, settlementUpgradeCostMultiplier, settlementExpansionCostPerSettlement, buildingSlotsPerLevelBonus, workerOverworkPenaltyMultiplier
Rule.Raw: Add numerous other new stats: fireSupportCostMultiplier, policyActionCooldownMultiplier, casualtyWoundSeverityMultiplier, threatAdaptationGrowthMultiplier, battleLossProsperityBase, battleLossHappinessBase, battleLossLoyaltyBase, victoryHappinessBonus, victoryLoyaltyBonus, settlementUpgradeCostBase, settlementUpgradeCostMultiplier, settlementExpansionCostPerSettlement, buildingSlotsPerLevelBonus, workerOverworkPenaltyMultiplier
Rule.Translated: Añadidas numerosas estadísticas: fireSupportCostMultiplier, policyActionCooldownMultiplier, casualtyWoundSeverityMultiplier, threatAdaptationGrowthMultiplier, battleLossProsperityBase, battleLossHappinessBase, battleLossLoyaltyBase, victoryHappinessBonus, victoryLoyaltyBonus, settlementUpgradeCostBase, settlementUpgradeCostMultiplier, settlementExpansionCostPerSettlement, buildingSlotsPerLevelBonus y workerOverworkPenaltyMultiplier.

Rule.Original: Add new stat scopes: squads, and units. Stats can now be set to apply their bonuses directly to a military squad or even an individual unit. This feature currently isn't actually used, but it opens the door to some neat future feature
Rule.Raw: Add new stat scopes: squads, and units. Stats can now be set to apply their bonuses directly to a military squad or even an individual unit. This feature currently isn't actually used, but it opens the door to some neat future feature
Rule.Translated: Nuevos ámbitos de estadísticas: escuadrones y unidades. Las bonificaciones pueden aplicarse directamente a un escuadrón militar o a una unidad. La función todavía no se utiliza, pero abre posibilidades interesantes.

Rule.Original: Updates the Biomes! Caverns compat patch
Rule.Raw: Updates the Biomes! Caverns compat patch
Rule.Translated: Actualizado el parche de compatibilidad con Biomes! Caverns.

Rule.Original: Squads will now receive their combat efficiency hediff when deployed, not just during manual battles
Rule.Raw: Squads will now receive their combat efficiency hediff when deployed, not just during manual battles
Rule.Translated: Los escuadrones reciben su afección de eficiencia de combate al desplegarse, no solo en las batallas manuales.

Rule.Original: Added an "Anti-Exploit" setting (default on). When enabled, merc gear is biocoded, and all mercs spawn with Death Acidifiers. This replaces the old Empire behavior where dead mercs would have their corpse and all of their items immediately deleted on death
Rule.Raw: Added an "Anti-Exploit" setting (default on). When enabled, merc gear is biocoded, and all mercs spawn with Death Acidifiers. This replaces the old Empire behavior where dead mercs would have their corpse and all of their items immediately deleted on death
Rule.Translated: Nuevo ajuste «Antiexploit», activado por defecto. El equipo mercenario lleva biocódigo y todos los mercenarios aparecen con acidificadores de cadáver. Sustituye el comportamiento antiguo que eliminaba el cadáver y todos sus objetos al morir.

Rule.Original: When determining if an item can be used for mercs or selected for tithing, check the ThingDef's own research fields, not just the recipe. This should filter out modded stuff like Warcasket armor if their research hasn't been unlocked
Rule.Raw: When determining if an item can be used for mercs or selected for tithing, check the ThingDef's own research fields, not just the recipe. This should filter out modded stuff like Warcasket armor if their research hasn't been unlocked
Rule.Translated: Para determinar si un objeto puede usarse por mercenarios o como diezmo, se comprueban los campos de investigación de ThingDef además de la receta. Así se filtran objetos de mods, como armaduras de sarcófago de guerra, cuya investigación no está desbloqueada.

Rule.Original: Mercs can be assigned psylinks. Comes with support for Vanilla Psycasts Expanded
Rule.Raw: Mercs can be assigned psylinks. Comes with support for Vanilla Psycasts Expanded
Rule.Translated: Se pueden asignar psienlaces a los mercenarios, con compatibilidad para Vanilla Psycasts Expanded.

Rule.Original: Mercs can be made into mechanitors, and assigned mechs
Rule.Raw: Mercs can be made into mechanitors, and assigned mechs
Rule.Translated: Los mercenarios pueden convertirse en mecanitores y recibir mecanoides.

Rule.Original: Mercs can now be assigned more than one animal. This goes out to all of you druid fans out there
Rule.Raw: Mercs can now be assigned more than one animal. This goes out to all of you druid fans out there
Rule.Translated: Los mercenarios pueden tener más de un animal asignado. Esto va por los aficionados a los druidas.

Rule.Original: Updated Giddy-Up 2 support: if Giddy-Up 2 Continued is enabled, mercs can be assigned a mount, and will spawn riding it
Rule.Raw: Updated Giddy-Up 2 support: if Giddy-Up 2 Continued is enabled, mercs can be assigned a mount, and will spawn riding it
Rule.Translated: Actualizada la compatibilidad con Giddy-Up 2: si está activo Giddy-Up 2 Continued, se puede asignar una montura a los mercenarios y aparecerán sobre ella.

Rule.Original: Fixes a couple of issues with the 1.3 -> 1.5 migration codepaths
Rule.Raw: Fixes a couple of issues with the 1.3 -> 1.5 migration codepaths
Rule.Translated: Corregidos varios problemas de la migración de 1.3 a 1.5.

Rule.Original: Whenever an Empire pawn dies, the pawn's home settlement recieves a temporary happiness penalty. If the pawn's death is caused by the player, then the penalty is more severe, and includes a loyalty or unrest penalty
Rule.Raw: Whenever an Empire pawn dies, the pawn's home settlement recieves a temporary happiness penalty. If the pawn's death is caused by the player, then the penalty is more severe, and includes a loyalty or unrest penalty
Rule.Translated: Cuando muere un peón de Empire, su asentamiento de origen recibe una penalización temporal de felicidad. Si lo mata el jugador, la penalización es mayor e incluye lealtad o agitación.

Rule.Original: Killing all of an Empire caravan's pack animals will result in a severe happiness/loyalty penalty
Rule.Raw: Killing all of an Empire caravan's pack animals will result in a severe happiness/loyalty penalty
Rule.Translated: Matar a todos los animales de carga de una caravana de Empire causa una penalización grave de felicidad y lealtad.

Rule.Original: Prevent the player from picking up items belonging to the Empire faction when "visiting" a settlement for a manual defense battle
Rule.Raw: Prevent the player from picking up items belonging to the Empire faction when "visiting" a settlement for a manual defense battle
Rule.Translated: Se impide recoger objetos de Empire al visitar un asentamiento para una defensa manual.

Rule.Original: Prevent the player from caravanaing away with items belonging to the Empire faction when leaving a settlement after a manual defense battle
Rule.Raw: Prevent the player from caravanaing away with items belonging to the Empire faction when leaving a settlement after a manual defense battle
Rule.Translated: Se impide llevarse en caravana los objetos de Empire al abandonar un asentamiento tras una defensa manual.

Rule.Original: Add settings to disable most anti-exploit mechanics
Rule.Raw: Add settings to disable most anti-exploit mechanics
Rule.Translated: Añadidos ajustes para desactivar la mayoría de las medidas antiexploit.

Rule.Original: Prevent settlements from deploying squads or sending them on raids if the settlement's happiness or loyalty are under 25%, or if its unrest is above 75%
Rule.Raw: Prevent settlements from deploying squads or sending them on raids if the settlement's happiness or loyalty are under 25%, or if its unrest is above 75%
Rule.Translated: Los asentamientos no pueden desplegar escuadrones ni enviarlos a incursiones si su felicidad o lealtad están por debajo del 25%, o su agitación supera el 75%.

Rule.Original: Prosperity now difts toward its target value by distance / 5 (min 1) instead of simply 1 a day. Prosperity will now react more quickly to swift changes in happiness, loyalty, or unrest
Rule.Raw: Prosperity now difts toward its target value by distance / 5 (min 1) instead of simply 1 a day. Prosperity will now react more quickly to swift changes in happiness, loyalty, or unrest
Rule.Translated: La prosperidad se acerca a su objetivo a razón de distancia / 5, con un mínimo de 1, en lugar de solo 1 al día. Reacciona más rápido a cambios bruscos de felicidad, lealtad o agitación.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: add null-guards to patches that touched faction relations
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: add null-guards to patches that touched faction relations
Rule.Translated: Corrección: añadidas comprobaciones de valores nulos a los parches que modifican relaciones de facción.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: player caravans will not spawn into manual defense battles in the same location as the enemy anymore
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: player caravans will not spawn into manual defense battles in the same location as the enemy anymore
Rule.Translated: Corrección: las caravanas del jugador ya no aparecen en la misma ubicación que el enemigo en las defensas manuales.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: in rare cases, manual battles would only end when all defenders die, instead of simply going down
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: in rare cases, manual battles would only end when all defenders die, instead of simply going down
Rule.Translated: Corrección: en casos raros, las batallas manuales solo terminaban cuando morían todos los defensores, en lugar de cuando quedaban abatidos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: if a merc dies on deployment, their assigned animals might not leave when commanded to, leaving the squad command window open and the squad busy
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: if a merc dies on deployment, their assigned animals might not leave when commanded to, leaving the squad command window open and the squad busy
Rule.Translated: Corrección: si un mercenario moría durante un despliegue, sus animales podían no retirarse al recibir la orden, dejando abierta la ventana de escuadrón y al escuadrón ocupado.

Rule.Original: Settings UI change: give each discrete section its own "Reset to Defaults" button
Rule.Raw: Settings UI change: give each discrete section its own "Reset to Defaults" button
Rule.Translated: Cambio de interfaz de ajustes: cada sección tiene su propio botón «Restablecer valores predeterminados».

Rule.Original: MILITARY RAIDS CHANGE: the strength of enemy raids on Empire settlements has been reworked. Enemy strength no longer scales by an invisible "Empire Threat Level"; instead, empires will preferentially be raided by enemy factions that are within 2 levels of the empire's average military level
Rule.Raw: MILITARY RAIDS CHANGE: the strength of enemy raids on Empire settlements has been reworked. Enemy strength no longer scales by an invisible "Empire Threat Level"; instead, empires will preferentially be raided by enemy factions that are within 2 levels of the empire's average military level
Rule.Translated: CAMBIO EN INCURSIONES MILITARES: la fuerza enemiga contra los asentamientos de Empire ya no escala según un nivel de amenaza invisible. Los atacan preferentemente facciones cuyo nivel militar está a un máximo de 2 niveles de la media del imperio.

Rule.Original: Add Neutroamine to the medicine resource (unlocked by the same research that unlocks industrial medicine)
Rule.Raw: Add Neutroamine to the medicine resource (unlocked by the same research that unlocks industrial medicine)
Rule.Translated: Añadida neutroamina al recurso de medicina, desbloqueada por la misma investigación que los medicamentos industriales.

Rule.Original: Compat: when Vanilla Gravships Expanded is enabled, Astrofuel is added to the chemfuel and gravtech resources (gated by Basic Gravtech)
Rule.Raw: Compat: when Vanilla Gravships Expanded is enabled, Astrofuel is added to the chemfuel and gravtech resources (gated by Basic Gravtech)
Rule.Translated: Compatibilidad: si está activo Vanilla Gravships Expanded, se añade astrocombustible a los recursos de biocombustible y tecnología gravitatoria, condicionado a la investigación gravitatoria básica.

Rule.Original: Manual Defense change: manual defense maps are slightly larger by default, and there are settings to let the player further adjust their size
Rule.Raw: Manual Defense change: manual defense maps are slightly larger by default, and there are settings to let the player further adjust their size
Rule.Translated: Cambio de defensa manual: sus mapas son algo mayores por defecto y hay ajustes para modificar más su tamaño.

Rule.Original: Add a mod setting to block new random events from firing if a multi-step event chain is still in progress
Rule.Raw: Add a mod setting to block new random events from firing if a multi-step event chain is still in progress
Rule.Translated: Nuevo ajuste que impide activar sucesos aleatorios mientras sigue en marcha una cadena de sucesos de varias etapas.

Rule.Original: Add mod settings to let the user scale how long it takes for settlements to upgrade, or for buildings to construct
Rule.Raw: Add mod settings to let the user scale how long it takes for settlements to upgrade, or for buildings to construct
Rule.Translated: Nuevos ajustes para modificar el tiempo de mejora de asentamientos y de construcción de edificios.

Rule.Original: Replace most instances of "empire"/"your empire" with the player empire's actual name or title ("title" is now treated as though it's a polity type, e.g. Kingdom, Republic, Commune)
Rule.Raw: Replace most instances of "empire"/"your empire" with the player empire's actual name or title ("title" is now treated as though it's a polity type, e.g. Kingdom, Republic, Commune)
Rule.Translated: La mayoría de las referencias a «imperio» o «tu imperio» se sustituyen por su nombre o título real. El título se interpreta como tipo de entidad política, por ejemplo reino, república o comuna.

Rule.Original: Update existing Codex entries and add several more
Rule.Raw: Update existing Codex entries and add several more
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas las entradas existentes del códice y añadidas otras nuevas.

Rule.Original: Add a Biomes section to the Codex, showing the resource breakdown for every biome in the game. Supports modded biomes
Rule.Raw: Add a Biomes section to the Codex, showing the resource breakdown for every biome in the game. Supports modded biomes
Rule.Translated: Nueva sección de biomas del códice con el desglose de recursos de cada bioma del juego, incluidos los añadidos por mods.

Rule.Original: Minor balance tweaks to Expansionist, Pacifist, and Slavor policies
Rule.Raw: Minor balance tweaks to Expansionist, Pacifist, and Slavor policies
Rule.Translated: Pequeños ajustes de equilibrio en las políticas Expansionista, Pacifista y Esclavista.

Rule.Original: Various fixes and updates to the various squad UIs (including a dedicated window for hiring squads)
Rule.Raw: Various fixes and updates to the various squad UIs (including a dedicated window for hiring squads)
Rule.Translated: Varias correcciones y actualizaciones de las interfaces de escuadrones, incluida una ventana específica de contratación.

Rule.Original: Backend changes only, user experience should not change.
Rule.Raw: Backend changes only, user experience should not change.
Rule.Translated: Solo hay cambios internos; la experiencia del usuario debería mantenerse igual.

Rule.Original: In the Tithing section of the settlement window, the Per-Worker tithe modifier now includes the bonus from tithe value multipliers. A tooltip breaks down the math
Rule.Raw: In the Tithing section of the settlement window, the Per-Worker tithe modifier now includes the bonus from tithe value multipliers. A tooltip breaks down the math
Rule.Translated: En la sección de diezmos del asentamiento, el modificador por trabajador incluye la bonificación de los multiplicadores de valor. Una ayuda desglosa el cálculo.

Rule.Original: Prisoners can now be added to a settlement by simply sending them via transport pod
Rule.Raw: Prisoners can now be added to a settlement by simply sending them via transport pod
Rule.Translated: Los prisioneros se pueden añadir a un asentamiento simplemente enviándolos en una cápsula de transporte.

Rule.Original: Player caravans no longer have the option to attack Empire settlements
Rule.Raw: Player caravans no longer have the option to attack Empire settlements
Rule.Translated: Las caravanas del jugador ya no pueden atacar asentamientos de Empire.

Rule.Original: Player caravans should no longer see duplicate Trade options when right-click Empire settlements
Rule.Raw: Player caravans should no longer see duplicate Trade options when right-click Empire settlements
Rule.Translated: Las caravanas del jugador ya no deberían mostrar opciones de comercio duplicadas al hacer clic derecho en asentamientos de Empire.

Rule.Original: Cleaner squad-level UI in the military main tab window
Rule.Raw: Cleaner squad-level UI in the military main tab window
Rule.Translated: Interfaz de escuadrones más clara en la pestaña militar principal.

Rule.Original: Fix a widespread issue where some numeric bonuses weren't being colorized in tooltips
Rule.Raw: Fix a widespread issue where some numeric bonuses weren't being colorized in tooltips
Rule.Translated: Corregido un problema extendido que impedía aplicar colores a algunas bonificaciones numéricas en las ayudas.

Rule.Original: Fix a handful of UI issues in the "Choose Defender" window
Rule.Raw: Fix a handful of UI issues in the "Choose Defender" window
Rule.Translated: Corregidos varios problemas de interfaz en la ventana «Elegir defensor».

Rule.Original: Updates the loadAfter block in About.xml to list all mods that Empire has a compat patch for, to ensure that we load after all of them
Rule.Raw: Updates the loadAfter block in About.xml to list all mods that Empire has a compat patch for, to ensure that we load after all of them
Rule.Translated: El bloque loadAfter de About.xml enumera todos los mods con parches de compatibilidad de Empire para cargar después de ellos.

Rule.Original: Reword the Settlement Military Level tooltip (in the settlement window) to more clearly explain how military level is calculated, and what it derives from
Rule.Raw: Reword the Settlement Military Level tooltip (in the settlement window) to more clearly explain how military level is calculated, and what it derives from
Rule.Translated: Reescrita la ayuda del nivel militar del asentamiento para explicar mejor cómo se calcula y de qué depende.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: fixed an issue with Mercenary v1.3 -> v1.5 save migration
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: fixed an issue with Mercenary v1.3 -> v1.5 save migration
Rule.Translated: Corrección: solucionado un problema de migración de mercenarios de v1.3 a v1.5.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: fixed a niche bug that could result in settlements appearing to disappear from the UI
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: fixed a niche bug that could result in settlements appearing to disappear from the UI
Rule.Translated: Corrección: solucionado un error poco frecuente que podía hacer que los asentamientos parecieran desaparecer de la interfaz.

Rule.Original: Add a "Non-Income Resource" header to the settlement window production area, cordoning Research and Power from the list of regular resources
Rule.Raw: Add a "Non-Income Resource" header to the settlement window production area, cordoning Research and Power from the list of regular resources
Rule.Translated: Añadida la cabecera «Recursos sin ingresos» al área de producción del asentamiento para separar investigación y energía de los recursos normales.

Rule.Original: Add a Codex entry for Non-Income Resources, explaining that their income is converted to a faction-wide pool instead of silver
Rule.Raw: Add a Codex entry for Non-Income Resources, explaining that their income is converted to a faction-wide pool instead of silver
Rule.Translated: Nueva entrada del códice sobre recursos sin ingresos: su producción se incorpora a una reserva de la facción en lugar de convertirse en plata.

Rule.Original: Clean up the settlement window production area when there are enough resources to spawn a scrollbar
Rule.Raw: Clean up the settlement window production area when there are enough resources to spawn a scrollbar
Rule.Translated: Mejorada la presentación del área de producción cuando hay suficientes recursos para necesitar una barra de desplazamiento.

Rule.Original: Use a blocklist instead of an allowlist as the base for building the list of items that a merc can carry in their inventory
Rule.Raw: Use a blocklist instead of an allowlist as the base for building the list of items that a merc can carry in their inventory
Rule.Translated: La lista de objetos que un mercenario puede llevar en el inventario se construye a partir de una lista de bloqueados, en lugar de permitidos.

Rule.Original: Show the player's available silver in the Found New Settlement dialog
Rule.Raw: Show the player's available silver in the Found New Settlement dialog
Rule.Translated: El diálogo de fundación muestra la plata disponible del jugador.

Rule.Original: When Merc Squads use items from their inventory or have their weapons or apparel damaged in a fight, they are now restocked afterwards, with the cost being billed to the player (separate from the cost of deploying)
Rule.Raw: When Merc Squads use items from their inventory or have their weapons or apparel damaged in a fight, they are now restocked afterwards, with the cost being billed to the player (separate from the cost of deploying)
Rule.Translated: Si los mercenarios consumen objetos de su inventario o su equipo se daña en combate, se repone después. El coste se factura al jugador por separado del despliegue.

Rule.Original: Change the default Max Concurrent Battle Maps to 3 (instead of Unlimited), and increase the max slider value to 10 (from 5)
Rule.Raw: Change the default Max Concurrent Battle Maps to 3 (instead of Unlimited), and increase the max slider value to 10 (from 5)
Rule.Translated: El máximo predeterminado de mapas de batalla simultáneos pasa de ilimitado a 3. El máximo del control deslizante aumenta de 5 a 10.

Rule.Original: Condense all of the slider settings to one line, instead of two
Rule.Raw: Condense all of the slider settings to one line, instead of two
Rule.Translated: Todos los ajustes con controles deslizantes se condensan en una línea, en lugar de dos.

Rule.Original: Add a numeric text field to all slider settings so the user can input exact values
Rule.Raw: Add a numeric text field to all slider settings so the user can input exact values
Rule.Translated: Todos los controles deslizantes incorporan un campo numérico para introducir valores exactos.

Rule.Original: Use zebra striping and tooltip-signaling mouseover highlights to increase overall readability
Rule.Raw: Use zebra striping and tooltip-signaling mouseover highlights to increase overall readability
Rule.Translated: Se utilizan filas alternas y resaltados al pasar el ratón para indicar las ayudas y mejorar la legibilidad.

Rule.Original: Add cooldowns to all random events, including a 60 day cooldown on the infamous Death In The Family event
Rule.Raw: Add cooldowns to all random events, including a 60 day cooldown on the infamous Death In The Family event
Rule.Translated: Añadidos tiempos de espera a todos los sucesos aleatorios, incluidos 60 días para el conocido suceso Muerte en la familia.

Rule.Original: The Gravtech resource is now locked behind Basic Gravtech
Rule.Raw: The Gravtech resource is now locked behind Basic Gravtech
Rule.Translated: El recurso de tecnología gravitatoria requiere ahora la investigación gravitatoria básica.

Rule.Original: Empire Caravans are now limited in the number of items they stock, which should eliminate the possibility of caravans with tons of pack animals (that likely only would happen with 10+ level settlements anyways)
Rule.Raw: Empire Caravans are now limited in the number of items they stock, which should eliminate the possibility of caravans with tons of pack animals (that likely only would happen with 10+ level settlements anyways)
Rule.Translated: Las caravanas de Empire tienen limitado el número de objetos transportados, evitando caravanas con enormes cantidades de animales de carga, algo que probablemente solo ocurría con asentamientos de nivel 10 o superior.

Rule.Original: Fix for minor stat modifier colorizing issues in some UI
Rule.Raw: Fix for minor stat modifier colorizing issues in some UI
Rule.Translated: Corregidos pequeños problemas de colores de modificadores en algunas interfaces.

Rule.Original: Events can be gated by Ideology memes now. Meme-gated options are culled from the list entirely if Ideology isn't active
Rule.Raw: Events can be gated by Ideology memes now. Meme-gated options are culled from the list entirely if Ideology isn't active
Rule.Translated: Los sucesos pueden depender de memes de Ideology. Si Ideology no está activo, las opciones que los requieren desaparecen de la lista.

Rule.Original: Add meme-gated options to Dense Wildlife and Widespread Food Shortage events
Rule.Raw: Add meme-gated options to Dense Wildlife and Widespread Food Shortage events
Rule.Translated: Añadidas opciones dependientes de memes a Fauna abundante y Escasez alimentaria generalizada.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: it was possible for the number of available workers at a settlement to go negative
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: it was possible for the number of available workers at a settlement to go negative
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el número de trabajadores disponibles de un asentamiento podía ser negativo.

Rule.Original: When an event affects more than 3 settlements, the options window now says merely "N Settlements" (or "All Settlements" if actually all settlements are affected)
Rule.Raw: When an event affects more than 3 settlements, the options window now says merely "N Settlements" (or "All Settlements" if actually all settlements are affected)
Rule.Translated: Cuando un suceso afecta a más de 3 asentamientos, la ventana muestra simplemente «N asentamientos», o «Todos los asentamientos» si afecta realmente a todos.

Rule.Original: The "Assigned Workers" and "Assigned Overmax Workers" boxes in the settlement window now have tooltips listing all active stat modifiers on them
Rule.Raw: The "Assigned Workers" and "Assigned Overmax Workers" boxes in the settlement window now have tooltips listing all active stat modifiers on them
Rule.Translated: Las casillas «Trabajadores asignados» y «Trabajadores asignados por encima del máximo» tienen ayudas que enumeran todos sus modificadores activos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: a world object icon caching issue would result in showing old Empire faction settlement icons even if the player loaded a different save
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: a world object icon caching issue would result in showing old Empire faction settlement icons even if the player loaded a different save
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la caché de iconos de objetos mundiales podía mostrar los iconos de una facción Empire anterior al cargar otra partida.

Rule.Original: Backend code to help with submod UI rendering - companion windows on the Found New Settlement screen shouldn't stack anymore
Rule.Raw: Backend code to help with submod UI rendering - companion windows on the Found New Settlement screen shouldn't stack anymore
Rule.Translated: Cambios internos para ayudar a dibujar interfaces de mods complementarios: las ventanas adicionales de la pantalla de fundación ya no deberían apilarse.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: some events were renamed between v1.3 and v1.5, causing problems when loading or trying to view the Events tab
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: some events were renamed between v1.3 and v1.5, causing problems when loading or trying to view the Events tab
Rule.Translated: Corrección: algunos sucesos cambiaron de nombre entre v1.3 y v1.5 y causaban problemas al cargar o abrir la pestaña de sucesos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: a save migration issue would cause mercs to load incorrectly in Empire Refactored v1.5 when loading a v1.3 save
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: a save migration issue would cause mercs to load incorrectly in Empire Refactored v1.5 when loading a v1.3 save
Rule.Translated: Corrección: un problema de migración hacía que los mercenarios cargaran mal en Empire Refactored v1.5 al abrir una partida de v1.3.

Rule.Original: Pull Japanese language files up to the correct folder depth
Rule.Raw: Pull Japanese language files up to the correct folder depth
Rule.Translated: Los archivos japoneses se trasladan a la profundidad de carpeta correcta.

Rule.Original: When calculating the dynamic cost of an event option, base the cost on the production difference from the free option, rather than on total resource production
Rule.Raw: When calculating the dynamic cost of an event option, base the cost on the production difference from the free option, rather than on total resource production
Rule.Translated: El coste dinámico de una opción de suceso se basa en la diferencia de producción respecto a la opción gratuita, en lugar de en la producción total.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: it is possible to "defend" a settlement that is already in an active battle, causing errors and preventing caravans from joining in-progress battles
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: it is possible to "defend" a settlement that is already in an active battle, causing errors and preventing caravans from joining in-progress battles
Rule.Translated: Corrección: se podía defender un asentamiento que ya estaba en una batalla activa, provocando errores e impidiendo incorporar caravanas a batallas en curso.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the "defend" gizmo appears even once the battle is already underway; clicking it at that point spawns a new wave to the battle, which is incorrect behavior
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the "defend" gizmo appears even once the battle is already underway; clicking it at that point spawns a new wave to the battle, which is incorrect behavior
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el botón «Defender» aparecía durante una batalla ya iniciada y pulsarlo generaba incorrectamente una nueva oleada.

Rule.Original: In each of the squad picker windows, for unavailable squads, add a tooltip explaining why the squad is unavailable
Rule.Raw: In each of the squad picker windows, for unavailable squads, add a tooltip explaining why the squad is unavailable
Rule.Translated: Los selectores de escuadrones incorporan una ayuda que explica por qué un escuadrón no está disponible.

Rule.Original: Add a toggle to enable the automatic re-hiring of mercs for squads that suffer deaths
Rule.Raw: Add a toggle to enable the automatic re-hiring of mercs for squads that suffer deaths
Rule.Translated: Añadida una opción para volver a contratar automáticamente mercenarios cuando un escuadrón sufre bajas.

Rule.Original: When gun-toting mercs are spawned, they now immediately have their weapon reloaded. Relevant mostly for Yayo's Combat
Rule.Raw: When gun-toting mercs are spawned, they now immediately have their weapon reloaded. Relevant mostly for Yayo's Combat
Rule.Translated: Los mercenarios con armas de fuego aparecen con el arma recargada. Esto afecta especialmente a Yayo's Combat.

Rule.Original: In Rimworld, artificial bodyparts and implants are two distinct categories. The unit designer only allowed implants, resulting in stuff like bionic arms never appearing. With this patch, bionics should now be an option
Rule.Raw: In Rimworld, artificial bodyparts and implants are two distinct categories. The unit designer only allowed implants, resulting in stuff like bionic arms never appearing. With this patch, bionics should now be an option
Rule.Translated: RimWorld distingue partes corporales artificiales e implantes. El diseñador solo admitía implantes y omitía objetos como brazos biónicos. Ahora las prótesis biónicas deberían poder elegirse.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the Empire faction could become hostile to the player, at which point Empire pawns would become hostile to each other and even themselves
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the Empire faction could become hostile to the player, at which point Empire pawns would become hostile to each other and even themselves
Rule.Translated: Corrección: Empire podía volverse hostil al jugador y sus peones pasaban a ser hostiles entre sí e incluso consigo mismos.

Rule.Original: Block fertilized eggs from tithing and Empire trader caravans. This will prevent the possibility of a large stack of fertilized eggs getting dropped on the ground and then hatching into a billion lions
Rule.Raw: Block fertilized eggs from tithing and Empire trader caravans. This will prevent the possibility of a large stack of fertilized eggs getting dropped on the ground and then hatching into a billion lions
Rule.Translated: Se bloquean los huevos fertilizados en diezmos y caravanas de Empire para evitar que una gran pila depositada en el suelo eclosione en una cantidad enorme de leones.

Rule.Original: Add a daily sweep of Empire animals on every player map. Any orphaned animals are told to leave the map. This should prevent Empire animals from lingering on the map for longer than a day
Rule.Raw: Add a daily sweep of Empire animals on every player map. Any orphaned animals are told to leave the map. This should prevent Empire animals from lingering on the map for longer than a day
Rule.Translated: Se revisan a diario los animales de Empire en cada mapa del jugador. Los animales huérfanos reciben la orden de irse, para que no permanezcan más de un día.

Rule.Original: Small change to the location text translation key for settlements
Rule.Raw: Small change to the location text translation key for settlements
Rule.Translated: Pequeño cambio de la clave de traducción del texto de ubicación de asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Update costs and build times for the orbital settlement types
Rule.Raw: Update costs and build times for the orbital settlement types
Rule.Translated: Actualizados los costes y tiempos de construcción de los tipos de asentamiento orbital.

Rule.Original: Add mod settings for previously un-tweakable values
Rule.Raw: Add mod settings for previously un-tweakable values
Rule.Translated: Añadidos ajustes del mod para valores que antes no podían modificarse.

Rule.Original: Backend code updates. User-facing behavior should not change.
Rule.Raw: Backend code updates. User-facing behavior should not change.
Rule.Translated: Cambios internos del código. El comportamiento visible para el usuario debería mantenerse igual.

Rule.Original: Resource production rework: all values are calculated on a daily basis. The length of the tax cycle merely determines how frequently acrued production is sent to the player
Rule.Raw: Resource production rework: all values are calculated on a daily basis. The length of the tax cycle merely determines how frequently acrued production is sent to the player
Rule.Translated: Rediseñada la producción de recursos: todos los valores se calculan diariamente. La duración del ciclo fiscal solo determina cada cuánto se entrega la producción acumulada.

Rule.Original: Minor tithes rework: the tithe item list is now a priority list, sending the first N items that fit within the tithe budget
Rule.Raw: Minor tithes rework: the tithe item list is now a priority list, sending the first N items that fit within the tithe budget
Rule.Translated: Pequeño rediseño de diezmos: la lista de objetos es ahora una lista de prioridades y se envían los primeros N objetos que caben en el presupuesto.

Rule.Original: When a settlement defends itself in a manual defense battle without an assigned squad, its defenders are assembled from the player's unit designs
Rule.Raw: When a settlement defends itself in a manual defense battle without an assigned squad, its defenders are assembled from the player's unit designs
Rule.Translated: Si un asentamiento se defiende manualmente sin escuadrón asignado, sus defensores se forman a partir de los diseños de unidades del jugador.

Rule.Original: Food resource is now Farming, and features all resources that can be harvested from plants (except for medicine and drugs, which continue to belong to the Medicine resource (except for beer))
Rule.Raw: Food resource is now Farming, and features all resources that can be harvested from plants (except for medicine and drugs, which continue to belong to the Medicine resource (except for beer))
Rule.Translated: El recurso de alimentos pasa a ser Agricultura e incluye todo lo cosechable de plantas, excepto medicinas y drogas, que siguen en Medicina, salvo la cerveza.

Rule.Original: The Mining resource now only allows rock types belonging to the settlement's tile. Obsidian is only titheable in the Lava Field biome
Rule.Raw: The Mining resource now only allows rock types belonging to the settlement's tile. Obsidian is only titheable in the Lava Field biome
Rule.Translated: Minería solo permite los tipos de roca de la casilla del asentamiento. La obsidiana solo puede entregarse como diezmo en el bioma de campo de lava.

Rule.Original: Add difficulty settings for global worker base production and worker production multipliers. Higher difficulties have a harsh multiplier; lower difficulties are now swimming in resources
Rule.Raw: Add difficulty settings for global worker base production and worker production multipliers. Higher difficulties have a harsh multiplier; lower difficulties are now swimming in resources
Rule.Translated: Añadidos ajustes de dificultad para la producción base global de trabajadores y sus multiplicadores. Las dificultades altas tienen multiplicadores duros; las bajas reciben abundantes recursos.

Rule.Original: Allow more than one event window to be open at a time
Rule.Raw: Allow more than one event window to be open at a time
Rule.Translated: Se permite abrir varias ventanas de sucesos a la vez.

Rule.Original: When the player defeats an NPC settlement through a normal vanilla attack, they are now given the option to capture the settlement for their empire
Rule.Raw: When the player defeats an NPC settlement through a normal vanilla attack, they are now given the option to capture the settlement for their empire
Rule.Translated: Al derrotar un asentamiento no jugador mediante un ataque normal del juego base, se ofrece capturarlo para tu imperio.

Rule.Original: When generating a manual defense battle map, all turrets are stripped if the player doesn't have the tech for them. This was unnecessary for Empire itself, but *is* necessary when using other mods for base gen, such as Vanilla Base Generation Expanded
Rule.Raw: When generating a manual defense battle map, all turrets are stripped if the player doesn't have the tech for them. This was unnecessary for Empire itself, but *is* necessary when using other mods for base gen, such as Vanilla Base Generation Expanded
Rule.Translated: Al generar una defensa manual se eliminan las torretas cuya tecnología no tiene el jugador. Empire no lo necesitaba, pero otros generadores de bases, como Vanilla Base Generation Expanded, sí.

Rule.Original: In manual defense battles, civilian pawns' names are rendered in a muted color compared to the defender pawns, making them easier to tell apart
Rule.Raw: In manual defense battles, civilian pawns' names are rendered in a muted color compared to the defender pawns, making them easier to tell apart
Rule.Translated: En las defensas manuales, los nombres de civiles tienen un color más apagado que los de defensores para distinguirlos mejor.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the "Settlement Formed" letter that's sent after capturing an enemy settlement would not report the correct name
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the "Settlement Formed" letter that's sent after capturing an enemy settlement would not report the correct name
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la carta «Asentamiento formado» enviada tras capturar un asentamiento enemigo no mostraba el nombre correcto.

Rule.Original: Leathers that do not come directly from an animal (e.g. patchleather) are moved from the Animals resource to the Apparel resource. In theory, this should provide compatibility with Vanilla Factions Expanded: Midieval 2 as well
Rule.Raw: Leathers that do not come directly from an animal (e.g. patchleather) are moved from the Animals resource to the Apparel resource. In theory, this should provide compatibility with Vanilla Factions Expanded: Midieval 2 as well
Rule.Translated: Los cueros que no proceden directamente de animales, como el cuero remendado, pasan de Animales a Ropa. En teoría, esto también da compatibilidad con Vanilla Factions Expanded: Medieval 2.

Rule.Original: Add a mod setting to let the player control how frequently (or infrequently) their roads build
Rule.Raw: Add a mod setting to let the player control how frequently (or infrequently) their roads build
Rule.Translated: Nuevo ajuste para controlar con qué frecuencia se construyen las carreteras.
Añadida una traducción al español actualizada.

Rule.Original: Adds the ability for the player to periodically hire laborers from the Empire faction, with several configuration options in the mod settings
Rule.Raw: Adds the ability for the player to periodically hire laborers from the Empire faction, with several configuration options in the mod settings
Rule.Translated: El jugador puede contratar periódicamente trabajadores de Empire, con varias opciones en los ajustes del mod.

Rule.Original: Adds Manual Offense battles (e.g. raid, capture, enslave). Offense battles have their own auto-vs-manual toggle in the settings, independent of defense battles
Rule.Raw: Adds Manual Offense battles (e.g. raid, capture, enslave). Offense battles have their own auto-vs-manual toggle in the settings, independent of defense battles
Rule.Translated: Añadidas batallas ofensivas manuales, como saquear, capturar o esclavizar. Tienen su propio ajuste automático o manual, independiente de las defensivas.

Rule.Original: Adds a Raze attack type, the sole objective of which is to destroy the target settlement. Only available to Militaristic, Isolationist, or Authortarian empires
Rule.Raw: Adds a Raze attack type, the sole objective of which is to destroy the target settlement. Only available to Militaristic, Isolationist, or Authortarian empires
Rule.Translated: Nuevo ataque Arrasar, cuyo único objetivo es destruir el asentamiento. Solo está disponible para imperios Militaristas, Aislacionistas o Autoritarios.

Rule.Original: Barracks changed: it is more expensive to build and upkeep, but now grants +1 squad slot to its settlement
Rule.Raw: Barracks changed: it is more expensive to build and upkeep, but now grants +1 squad slot to its settlement
Rule.Translated: Cambios en el cuartel: cuesta más construirlo y mantenerlo, pero concede +1 espacio de escuadrón al asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Add mod settings to let the user add additional military levels to npc factions, for added difficulty
Rule.Raw: Add mod settings to let the user add additional military levels to npc factions, for added difficulty
Rule.Translated: Nuevos ajustes para añadir niveles militares a las facciones no jugadoras y aumentar la dificultad.

Rule.Original: Add mod setting to let the user control the military level -> raid points conversion
Rule.Raw: Add mod setting to let the user control the military level -> raid points conversion
Rule.Translated: Nuevo ajuste para controlar la conversión de nivel militar a puntos de incursión.

Rule.Original: Fixes some issues with rendering settlement stat modifiers
Rule.Raw: Fixes some issues with rendering settlement stat modifiers
Rule.Translated: Corregidos varios problemas al mostrar modificadores de estadísticas de asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Updates the message that appears when checking the Empire faction tech level to be aware of the "mirror player faction tech level" setting
Rule.Raw: Updates the message that appears when checking the Empire faction tech level to be aware of the "mirror player faction tech level" setting
Rule.Translated: El mensaje de comprobación del nivel tecnológico de Empire tiene en cuenta el ajuste que refleja el nivel de la facción del jugador.

Rule.Original: Minor perf-related changes to the Codex and a couple of harmony patches on hot paths
Rule.Raw: Minor perf-related changes to the Codex and a couple of harmony patches on hot paths
Rule.Translated: Pequeñas mejoras de rendimiento del códice y de varios parches de Harmony ejecutados con frecuencia.
Numerosas correcciones de las batallas ofensivas manuales.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when loading a post-squad-refactor save with deployed merc squads, their lord, map, and order would be clobbered by default values
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when loading a post-squad-refactor save with deployed merc squads, their lord, map, and order would be clobbered by default values
Rule.Translated: Corrección: al cargar una partida posterior al rediseño de escuadrones con mercenarios desplegados, su grupo de comportamiento, mapa y orden se sobrescribían con valores predeterminados.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: on-disk custom xenotypes could be wiped from the xenotype filter when loading a save
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: on-disk custom xenotypes could be wiped from the xenotype filter when loading a save
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los xenotipos personalizados guardados podían desaparecer del filtro al cargar una partida.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: non-settlement objects that participate in Empire's raid system (such as Vanilla Outposts Expanded outposts when using the Outposts & Settlements submod) would not correctly resolve their post-battle events, and would permanently become un-choosable for further raids
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: non-settlement objects that participate in Empire's raid system (such as Vanilla Outposts Expanded outposts when using the Outposts & Settlements submod) would not correctly resolve their post-battle events, and would permanently become un-choosable for further raids
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los objetos que no eran asentamientos pero participaban en las incursiones de Empire, como puestos de Vanilla Outposts Expanded con Outposts & Settlements, no resolvían bien sus sucesos posteriores y quedaban bloqueados para futuras incursiones.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when viewing a building after selecting the slot that it's currently in, the UI would show both a "Demolish" and a "Destroy" button, with the latter having almost none of the protections of the former
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when viewing a building after selecting the slot that it's currently in, the UI would show both a "Demolish" and a "Destroy" button, with the latter having almost none of the protections of the former
Rule.Translated: Corrección: al ver un edificio tras seleccionar su espacio, aparecían «Demoler» y «Destruir», pero el segundo apenas tenía las protecciones del primero.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: rolled-over random-tithe stock is paid out twice due to never actually being subtracted from the original budget
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: rolled-over random-tithe stock is paid out twice due to never actually being subtracted from the original budget
Rule.Translated: Corrección: las existencias acumuladas de diezmos aleatorios se pagaban dos veces porque no se restaban del presupuesto original.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: settlements use the faction name generator instead of the settlement generator
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: settlements use the faction name generator instead of the settlement generator
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los asentamientos utilizaban el generador de nombres de facción en lugar del de asentamientos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: caravan deliveries with more than 100 items would silently lose everything past the 100th
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: caravan deliveries with more than 100 items would silently lose everything past the 100th
Rule.Translated: Corrección: las entregas por caravana con más de 100 objetos perdían sin avisar todos los posteriores al objeto 100.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: merc gear quality would shift as a result of combat efficiency. Now that players can set their gear quality directly, this feature is defunct
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: merc gear quality would shift as a result of combat efficiency. Now that players can set their gear quality directly, this feature is defunct
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la calidad del equipo mercenario variaba con la eficiencia de combate. Ahora el jugador puede fijarla directamente y esa función queda obsoleta.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: some cooldowns were saved incorrectly, resulting in them never firing a letter on cooldown completion after saving and loading the game
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: some cooldowns were saved incorrectly, resulting in them never firing a letter on cooldown completion after saving and loading the game
Rule.Translated: Corrección: algunos tiempos de recuperación se guardaban mal y no enviaban su carta de finalización tras guardar y cargar.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the founding date for both the faction and settlements was calculated incorrectly
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the founding date for both the faction and settlements was calculated incorrectly
Rule.Translated: Corrección: las fechas de fundación de la facción y los asentamientos se calculaban mal.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: gravship launches could improperly destroy the capital spot
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: gravship launches could improperly destroy the capital spot
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los despegues de gravinaves podían destruir incorrectamente el punto de capital.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: settlement levels were improperly capped, resulting in them clamping to the global cap instead of the minimum of the global cap and the settlement type cap
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: settlement levels were improperly capped, resulting in them clamping to the global cap instead of the minimum of the global cap and the settlement type cap
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los niveles de asentamiento se limitaban al máximo global, en lugar de al menor entre el máximo global y el del tipo de asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the weighting of pawn options derived from the xenotype filter was calculated incorrectly
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the weighting of pawn options derived from the xenotype filter was calculated incorrectly
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los pesos de las opciones de peón derivados del filtro de xenotipos se calculaban mal.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the "starting" lat/long was overwritten on every game load
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the "starting" lat/long was overwritten on every game load
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la latitud y longitud iniciales se sobrescribían cada vez que se cargaba el juego.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the inventory and apparel sections in the unit designer would only consider thingdef and count when it comes to equality, ignoring stuff and quality
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the inventory and apparel sections in the unit designer would only consider thingdef and count when it comes to equality, ignoring stuff and quality
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el inventario y la ropa del diseñador de unidades solo comparaban thingdef y cantidad, ignorando material y calidad.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: an overly terse patch on Notify_MemberDied would skip ideo and faction leader death handling
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: an overly terse patch on Notify_MemberDied would skip ideo and faction leader death handling
Rule.Translated: Corrección: un parche demasiado breve de Notify_MemberDied omitía la gestión de muertes de líderes de ideología y facción.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: delivery pawns would lose their lord info across a save and load
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: delivery pawns would lose their lord info across a save and load
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los peones de entrega perdían la información de su grupo de comportamiento al guardar y cargar.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when processing a defense battle loss, we would only check the first 4 buldings for destruction instead of all of them
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when processing a defense battle loss, we would only check the first 4 buldings for destruction instead of all of them
Rule.Translated: Corrección: al procesar una derrota defensiva solo se comprobaba la destrucción de los primeros 4 edificios, en lugar de todos.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: faction-wide events could apply their penalties to settlements that didn't exist when the event first fired
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: faction-wide events could apply their penalties to settlements that didn't exist when the event first fired
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los sucesos de facción podían penalizar asentamientos que no existían cuando se activaron.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: edict activation wouldn't properly rebuild their action gates
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: edict activation wouldn't properly rebuild their action gates
Rule.Translated: Corrección: la activación de edictos no reconstruía correctamente sus condiciones de acciones.

Rule.Original: Remove the now-outdated "Reset All Military Squad Assignments" debug action
Rule.Raw: Remove the now-outdated "Reset All Military Squad Assignments" debug action
Rule.Translated: Eliminada la acción de depuración obsoleta que restablecía todas las asignaciones de escuadrones militares.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the computation for if a shuttle or other skyfaller would fit in a space could return true when it shouldn't
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the computation for if a shuttle or other skyfaller would fit in a space could return true when it shouldn't
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el cálculo de espacio para una lanzadera u otro objeto que cae del cielo podía indicar que cabía cuando no era cierto.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: rewire the stat modifier descriptions for squadCapPerSettlement and maxSquadSize to match how other stat modifiers are printed in the UI
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: rewire the stat modifier descriptions for squadCapPerSettlement and maxSquadSize to match how other stat modifiers are printed in the UI
Rule.Translated: Corrección: las descripciones de squadCapPerSettlement y maxSquadSize se adaptan al formato de los demás modificadores de la interfaz.

Rule.Original: Update the buttons used for rearranging tithe priority in the settlement window
Rule.Raw: Update the buttons used for rearranging tithe priority in the settlement window
Rule.Translated: Actualizados los botones que reordenan la prioridad de diezmos en la ventana del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Performance: use caching and viewport culling to improve performance of the unit designer
Rule.Raw: Performance: use caching and viewport culling to improve performance of the unit designer
Rule.Translated: Rendimiento: el diseñador de unidades utiliza caché y omite elementos fuera de la vista.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: if an external auto-defender is assigned to a settlement under attack, and the militayr op is torn down without going through the battle path (e.g. by removing the settlement outright), then the external auto-defender would never be alerted that they can stand down
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: if an external auto-defender is assigned to a settlement under attack, and the militayr op is torn down without going through the battle path (e.g. by removing the settlement outright), then the external auto-defender would never be alerted that they can stand down
Rule.Translated: Corrección: si se asignaba un defensor automático externo y se cancelaba la operación sin pasar por la batalla, por ejemplo eliminando el asentamiento, nunca se le avisaba de que podía retirarse.

Rule.Original: Alter several stats to actually apply to the settlement scope: military level bonus (defending), military efficiency bonus (defending), battle prosperity/happiness/loyalty loss multiplier, building destruction chance, flat tax bonus, research contribution multiplier, extra workers softcap, over-max workers adjustment
Rule.Raw: Alter several stats to actually apply to the settlement scope: military level bonus (defending), military efficiency bonus (defending), battle prosperity/happiness/loyalty loss multiplier, building destruction chance, flat tax bonus, research contribution multiplier, extra workers softcap, over-max workers adjustment
Rule.Translated: Varias estadísticas se aplican correctamente al asentamiento: nivel y eficiencia militares defensivos, multiplicadores de pérdida de prosperidad, felicidad y lealtad, destrucción de edificios, bonificación fiscal fija, contribución de investigación, límite flexible y exceso de trabajadores.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: events that open with options wouldn't actually increase their fire count, meaning that events that are supposed to happen only once or twice could actually happen endlessly
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: events that open with options wouldn't actually increase their fire count, meaning that events that are supposed to happen only once or twice could actually happen endlessly
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los sucesos que comenzaban con opciones no aumentaban su contador de activaciones y podían repetirse sin límite aunque debieran ocurrir solo una o dos veces.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: some events would show up in the mod settings disablement window when they aren't supposed to
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: some events would show up in the mod settings disablement window when they aren't supposed to
Rule.Translated: Corrección: algunos sucesos aparecían en la ventana para desactivarlos cuando no correspondía.

Rule.Original: During a manual offense battle that the player has reinforced with their own pawns, in the period between vanilla thinking that the battle is over and Empire thinking that the battle is over, the player could Reform Caravan to take draft Empire mercs out of the map. They'd be culled a second later due to not being world pawns, so the exploit potential is minimal; but the player should not be able to form a caravan with empire pawns in the first place
Rule.Raw: During a manual offense battle that the player has reinforced with their own pawns, in the period between vanilla thinking that the battle is over and Empire thinking that the battle is over, the player could Reform Caravan to take draft Empire mercs out of the map. They'd be culled a second later due to not being world pawns, so the exploit potential is minimal; but the player should not be able to form a caravan with empire pawns in the first place
Rule.Translated: Durante una ofensiva manual reforzada con peones del jugador, había un intervalo en que el juego base daba la batalla por terminada y Empire todavía no. Se podía reformar una caravana con mercenarios reclutados de Empire, que desaparecían poco después por no ser peones mundiales. Ahora se impide incluirlos en la caravana.

Rule.Original: Update tooltips in the production area of the settlement window
Rule.Raw: Update tooltips in the production area of the settlement window
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas las ayudas del área de producción del asentamiento.

Rule.Original: Update the tithing UI and tooltips to better explain how tithing works with the new daily cadence
Rule.Raw: Update the tithing UI and tooltips to better explain how tithing works with the new daily cadence
Rule.Translated: Actualizadas la interfaz y las ayudas de diezmos para explicar mejor su funcionamiento con la nueva frecuencia diaria.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: settlements founded in the middle of a tax cycle would show an incorrect 'days til tax' estimate
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: settlements founded in the middle of a tax cycle would show an incorrect 'days til tax' estimate
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los asentamientos fundados a mitad de un ciclo fiscal mostraban mal los días restantes hasta los impuestos.

Rule.Original: Spelling and grammar fixes in user-facing text
Rule.Raw: Spelling and grammar fixes in user-facing text
Rule.Translated: Correcciones ortográficas y gramaticales de los textos visibles para el usuario.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: random events could fire more frequently than the min/max days per random event setting should allow
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: random events could fire more frequently than the min/max days per random event setting should allow
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los sucesos aleatorios podían activarse más a menudo de lo permitido por los ajustes de días mínimo y máximo.

Rule.Original: Max radius for fire support changed to 100 (was 30)
Rule.Raw: Max radius for fire support changed to 100 (was 30)
Rule.Translated: El radio máximo del apoyo de fuego pasa de 30 a 100.

Rule.Original: Every trait, policy, and buildings that affected worker base cost have had the value slashed to a fifth to respect the new Daily Cadence
Rule.Raw: Every trait, policy, and buildings that affected worker base cost have had the value slashed to a fifth to respect the new Daily Cadence
Rule.Translated: Los valores de rasgos, políticas y edificios que afectan al coste base de trabajadores se reducen a una quinta parte para adaptarse a la frecuencia diaria.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when dropping a prisoner off at a settlement through a caravan that is carrying goods, some of the goods could disappear with the prisoner, and would not come back even if the prisoner was recalled
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when dropping a prisoner off at a settlement through a caravan that is carrying goods, some of the goods could disappear with the prisoner, and would not come back even if the prisoner was recalled
Rule.Translated: Corrección: al dejar un prisionero en un asentamiento desde una caravana con mercancías, parte de ellas podía desaparecer con él y no regresar ni al reclamarlo.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: low-tech empires with HAR races could generate naked pawns due to how apparel tags were collected
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: low-tech empires with HAR races could generate naked pawns due to how apparel tags were collected
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los imperios de baja tecnología con razas HAR podían generar peones desnudos por la forma de recopilar etiquetas de ropa.

Rule.Original: Minor UI tweak: let the pawn apparel coloring text wordwrap in the Customize Faction window
Rule.Raw: Minor UI tweak: let the pawn apparel coloring text wordwrap in the Customize Faction window
Rule.Translated: Pequeño ajuste de interfaz: el texto de coloración de ropa admite saltos de línea en la personalización de facción.

Rule.Original: When generating empire pawns, if one would generate without apparel on their torso, then force the cheapest available torso apparel
Rule.Raw: When generating empire pawns, if one would generate without apparel on their torso, then force the cheapest available torso apparel
Rule.Translated: Si un peón de Empire iba a generarse sin ropa en el torso, se le asigna la prenda de torso disponible más barata.

Rule.Original: However, if the empire has the Nudism gene, then empire pawns are instead stripped of all apparel (does not apply to mercenaries - they keep their gear)
Rule.Raw: However, if the empire has the Nudism gene, then empire pawns are instead stripped of all apparel (does not apply to mercenaries - they keep their gear)
Rule.Translated: Si Empire tiene el gen de nudismo, sus peones aparecen sin ropa. No afecta a los mercenarios, que conservan su equipo.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: a shuttle port built on an orbital settlement wouldn't be able to send a shuttle to a colony on the planet's surface
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: a shuttle port built on an orbital settlement wouldn't be able to send a shuttle to a colony on the planet's surface
Rule.Translated: Corrección: un puerto de lanzaderas orbital no podía enviar una lanzadera a una colonia en la superficie.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: squads assigned to orbital settlements can't auto-defend ground targets, and vice versa
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: squads assigned to orbital settlements can't auto-defend ground targets, and vice versa
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los escuadrones asignados a asentamientos orbitales no pueden defender automáticamente objetivos terrestres, ni viceversa.

Rule.Original: Issue: Empire world pawns could be selected for Rimworld's visitor groups or trader caravans, which would mutate their gear and possibly other things about the pawn. This patch prevents Empire world pawns from being valid ReDress candidates to prevent that
Rule.Raw: Issue: Empire world pawns could be selected for Rimworld's visitor groups or trader caravans, which would mutate their gear and possibly other things about the pawn. This patch prevents Empire world pawns from being valid ReDress candidates to prevent that
Rule.Translated: Problema: RimWorld podía utilizar peones mundiales de Empire para visitantes o caravanas comerciales y cambiarles el equipo u otros datos. Ahora se excluyen de ReDress para evitarlo.

Rule.Original: When everything available has been researched, the daily unspent research points notification is suppressed
Rule.Raw: When everything available has been researched, the daily unspent research points notification is suppressed
Rule.Translated: Si ya se ha investigado todo lo disponible, no aparece el aviso diario de puntos de investigación sin gastar.

Rule.Original: When everything available has been researched, it becomes possible to convert research points into silver at a 2:1 ratio through the research pool float menu
Rule.Raw: When everything available has been researched, it becomes possible to convert research points into silver at a 2:1 ratio through the research pool float menu
Rule.Translated: Si ya se ha investigado todo lo disponible, se pueden convertir puntos de investigación en plata a razón de 2:1 desde el menú de la reserva de investigación.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: pool resources would always show 0 Accrued points in the production area of the settlement window, even though they really are (correctly) accruing points
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: pool resources would always show 0 Accrued points in the production area of the settlement window, even though they really are (correctly) accruing points
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los recursos compartidos mostraban siempre 0 puntos acumulados en la producción del asentamiento, aunque sí los acumulaban correctamente.

Rule.Original: Power production is scaled by the silver-per-resource setting instead of a flat x100.
Rule.Raw: Power production is scaled by the silver-per-resource setting instead of a flat x100.
Rule.Translated: La producción de energía escala con el ajuste de plata por recurso, en lugar de un multiplicador fijo x100.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the "watch battle" gizmo would show up on the home settlement of the defending squad, rather than the actual defending settlement
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the "watch battle" gizmo would show up on the home settlement of the defending squad, rather than the actual defending settlement
Rule.Translated: Corrección: «Ver batalla» aparecía en el asentamiento de origen del escuadrón defensor en lugar del asentamiento realmente atacado.

Rule.Original: Add protections against starting a manual defense battle with zero defenders
Rule.Raw: Add protections against starting a manual defense battle with zero defenders
Rule.Translated: Añadidas protecciones para impedir defensas manuales sin defensores.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: loading pawns into a shuttle after a manual defense battle is finished could result in the map being removed along with the shuttle and the pawns, disappearing them into the ether
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: loading pawns into a shuttle after a manual defense battle is finished could result in the map being removed along with the shuttle and the pawns, disappearing them into the ether
Rule.Translated: Corrección: cargar peones en una lanzadera tras una defensa manual podía eliminar el mapa junto con la lanzadera y los peones, haciéndolos desaparecer.

Rule.Original: Shuttle deliveries are attempted only 3 times in a row. If the shuttle can't find a place to land after the 3rd attempt, then the delivery is sent by drop pod instead.
Rule.Raw: Shuttle deliveries are attempted only 3 times in a row. If the shuttle can't find a place to land after the 3rd attempt, then the delivery is sent by drop pod instead.
Rule.Translated: Las entregas por lanzadera solo se intentan 3 veces consecutivas. Si no encuentra dónde aterrizar en el intento 3, la entrega se envía en cápsula de transporte.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: the battle log would show the name of the defending squad's home settlement, rather than the settlement that is under attack
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: the battle log would show the name of the defending squad's home settlement, rather than the settlement that is under attack
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el registro de batalla mostraba el asentamiento de origen del escuadrón defensor en lugar del asentamiento atacado.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when Empire's "Anti-Exploit" setting is on, Death Acidifiers are applied to mercs unconditionally. If a mod disables or removes the Death Acidifier, then any attempt to add it will error and fail, resulting in the merc not being generated
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when Empire's "Anti-Exploit" setting is on, Death Acidifiers are applied to mercs unconditionally. If a mod disables or removes the Death Acidifier, then any attempt to add it will error and fail, resulting in the merc not being generated
Rule.Translated: Corrección: el ajuste antiexploit añadía acidificadores de cadáver sin comprobarlos. Si un mod los desactivaba o eliminaba, la generación del mercenario fallaba.

Rule.Original: Relax the non-violent xenotype classification to require shooting accuracy < 50% AND melee hit chance < 50% AND melee dodge chance < 50%. This is independent of the check for whether or not a xenotype can do violent work
Rule.Raw: Relax the non-violent xenotype classification to require shooting accuracy < 50% AND melee hit chance < 50% AND melee dodge chance < 50%. This is independent of the check for whether or not a xenotype can do violent work
Rule.Translated: La clasificación de xenotipos no violentos exige precisión de disparo < 50%, probabilidad de acertar cuerpo a cuerpo < 50% y probabilidad de esquivar cuerpo a cuerpo < 50%. Es independiente de si el xenotipo puede realizar trabajo violento.

Rule.Original: Change the hard-coded strings in ResourceProductionExtension_TileField to use translation keys
Rule.Raw: Change the hard-coded strings in ResourceProductionExtension_TileField to use translation keys
Rule.Translated: Los textos fijos de ResourceProductionExtension_TileField utilizan ahora claves de traducción.

Rule.Original: Explicitly set extName and extDesc for Hilliness resource production extensions in the XML, to make it more obvious that resource production extensions should set their extName and extDesc through XML
Rule.Raw: Explicitly set extName and extDesc for Hilliness resource production extensions in the XML, to make it more obvious that resource production extensions should set their extName and extDesc through XML
Rule.Translated: extName y extDesc se establecen explícitamente en XML para las extensiones de producción según relieve, para dejar claro que deben definirse mediante XML.

Rule.Original: Clean up a couple of other scattered hard-coded strings
Rule.Raw: Clean up a couple of other scattered hard-coded strings

Rule.Original: Bugfix: if a merc unit had no apparel or weapons, then it wouldn't spawn with its squad
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: if a merc unit had no apparel or weapons, then it wouldn't spawn with its squad
Rule.Translated: Corrección: una unidad mercenaria sin ropa ni armas no aparecía con su escuadrón.

Rule.Original: Allows crafted textiles to be picked for merc gear when Medieval Overhaul is enabled
Rule.Raw: Allows crafted textiles to be picked for merc gear when Medieval Overhaul is enabled
Rule.Translated: Se pueden elegir textiles elaborados para el equipo mercenario cuando está activo Medieval Overhaul.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: when generating prisoners, we would use the Empire faction instead of the enemy settlement's faction
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: when generating prisoners, we would use the Empire faction instead of the enemy settlement's faction
Rule.Translated: Corrección: los prisioneros se generaban con la facción Empire en lugar de la facción del asentamiento enemigo.

Rule.Original: Allow Empire settlements to be destroyed by RimWorld if they have no associated faction (the typical corruption clean-up case)
Rule.Raw: Allow Empire settlements to be destroyed by RimWorld if they have no associated faction (the typical corruption clean-up case)
Rule.Translated: RimWorld puede destruir asentamientos de Empire sin facción asociada, como parte de la limpieza habitual de datos corruptos.

Rule.Original: Add a debug action to force deletion of an Empire settlement
Rule.Raw: Add a debug action to force deletion of an Empire settlement
Rule.Translated: Añadida una acción de depuración para forzar la eliminación de un asentamiento de Empire.

Rule.Original: Bugfix: after completion of a non-raze manual offense battle, the enemy settlement could be destroyed, even though it's supposed to survive
Rule.Raw: Bugfix: after completion of a non-raze manual offense battle, the enemy settlement could be destroyed, even though it's supposed to survive
Rule.Translated: Corrección: después de una ofensiva manual que no era de arrasamiento, el asentamiento enemigo podía destruirse aunque debía sobrevivir.

Rule.Original: Harden Empire's stuck-settlement check so it can catch all such stuck settlements
Rule.Raw: Harden Empire's stuck-settlement check so it can catch all such stuck settlements
Rule.Translated: Reforzada la comprobación de asentamientos atascados de Empire para detectar todos esos casos.

Rule.Original: - +10% combat modifier when using your faction's military forces
Rule.Raw: - +10% combat modifier when using your faction's military forces
Rule.Translated: - +10% al modificador de combate al usar las fuerzas militares de tu facción

Rule.Original: - Once per five days, you can deploy a second squad from a single settlement by paying 40% of the squad's cost in Silver
Rule.Raw: - Once per five days, you can deploy a second squad from a single settlement by paying 40% of the squad's cost in Silver
Rule.Translated: - Una vez cada cinco días, puedes desplegar un segundo escuadrón desde un mismo asentamiento pagando el 40% de su coste en plata

Rule.Original: - When creating a new settlement, it will start with a Barracks
Rule.Raw: - When creating a new settlement, it will start with a Barracks
Rule.Translated: - Los nuevos asentamientos comienzan con un cuartel

Rule.Original: - All military buildings cost 50 less upkeep
Rule.Raw: - All military buildings cost 50 less upkeep
Rule.Translated: - Todos los edificios militares cuestan 50 menos de mantenimiento

Rule.Original: - Can send your military to raze another faction's settlement, destroying it and wiping it from the map
Rule.Raw: - Can send your military to raze another faction's settlement, destroying it and wiping it from the map
Rule.Translated: - Puedes enviar a tus militares a arrasar el asentamiento de otra facción, destruyéndolo y borrándolo del mapa

Rule.Original: - Can send your military to raze another faction's settlement, destroying it and wiping it from the map
Rule.Raw: - Can send your military to raze another faction's settlement, destroying it and wiping it from the map
Rule.Translated: - Puedes enviar a tus militares a arrasar el asentamiento de otra facción, destruyéndolo y borrándolo del mapa

Rule.Original: - Can send your military to raze another faction's settlement, destroying it and wiping it from the map
Rule.Raw: - Can send your military to raze another faction's settlement, destroying it and wiping it from the map
Rule.Translated: - Puedes enviar a tus militares a arrasar el asentamiento de otra facción, destruyéndolo y borrándolo del mapa

Rule.Original: - Once per five days, can send a diplomatic envoy to another faction to attempt to improve relations
Rule.Raw: - Once per five days, can send a diplomatic envoy to another faction to attempt to improve relations
Rule.Translated: - Una vez cada cinco días, puedes enviar un emisario diplomático a otra facción para intentar mejorar las relaciones

Rule.Original: - A populace at peace is a happy one (+0.5 happiness per day in every settlement)
Rule.Raw: - A populace at peace is a happy one (+0.5 happiness per day in every settlement)
Rule.Translated: - Una población en paz es una población feliz (+0.5 de felicidad al día en cada asentamiento)

Rule.Original: - Cannot use military forces to raid or to capture other faction's settlements
Rule.Raw: - Cannot use military forces to raid or to capture other faction's settlements
Rule.Translated: - No puedes usar fuerzas militares para saquear ni capturar asentamientos de otras facciones

Rule.Original: - Can send your military to raid another faction's settlement to enslave members of their faction instead of ordinary raiding
Rule.Raw: - Can send your military to raid another faction's settlement to enslave members of their faction instead of ordinary raiding
Rule.Translated: - Puedes enviar a tus militares al asentamiento de otra facción para esclavizar a sus habitantes en lugar de realizar un saqueo normal

Rule.Original: - You can spend silver to increase the loyalty of a settlement
Rule.Raw: - You can spend silver to increase the loyalty of a settlement
Rule.Translated: - Puedes gastar plata para aumentar la lealtad de un asentamiento

Rule.Original: - +1 to worker softcap per settlement level
Rule.Raw: - +1 to worker softcap per settlement level
Rule.Translated: - +1 al límite flexible de trabajadores por nivel del asentamiento

Rule.Original: - Can grant a 10-day tax break to a settlement to boost happiness and prosperity at the cost of tax revenue
