Rule.Raw: - Can grant a 10-day tax break to a settlement to boost happiness and prosperity at the cost of tax revenue
Rule.Translated: - Puedes conceder una exención de impuestos de 10 días a un asentamiento para aumentar su felicidad y prosperidad a costa de los ingresos fiscales
- Todos los trabajadores cuestan 2 de plata adicionales
- -3 al límite de trabajadores por encima del máximo

Rule.Original: - The time to upgrade settlements and construct buildings is reduced by 50%
Rule.Raw: - The time to upgrade settlements and construct buildings is reduced by 50%
Rule.Translated: - El tiempo para mejorar asentamientos y construir edificios se reduce un 50%

Rule.Original: - Every settlement receives an extra +3 to worker softcap per level of the settlement
Rule.Raw: - Every settlement receives an extra +3 to worker softcap per level of the settlement
Rule.Translated: - Cada asentamiento recibe +3 al límite flexible de trabajadores por cada nivel del asentamiento

Rule.Original: - All settlements receive +10% to base tax
Rule.Raw: - All settlements receive +10% to base tax
Rule.Translated: - Todos los asentamientos reciben +10% al impuesto base

Rule.Original: - The cost to create new settlements is increased by 100%
Rule.Raw: - The cost to create new settlements is increased by 100%
Rule.Translated: - El coste de fundar nuevos asentamientos aumenta un 100%

Rule.Original: - Cannot use your military forces to capture other faction's settlements
Rule.Raw: - Cannot use your military forces to capture other faction's settlements
Rule.Translated: - No puedes usar tus fuerzas militares para capturar asentamientos de otras facciones

Rule.Original: - All new settlements cost 25% less to establish
Rule.Raw: - All new settlements cost 25% less to establish
Rule.Translated: - Todos los nuevos asentamientos cuestan un 25% menos al fundarlos

Rule.Original: - Settlements that you construct start at level 2
Rule.Raw: - Settlements that you construct start at level 2
Rule.Translated: - Los asentamientos que construyes comienzan en el nivel 2
- Los nuevos asentamientos comienzan con un 50% de prosperidad

Rule.Original: - Rapid expansion strains governance (+0.5 unrest per day in every settlement)
Rule.Raw: - Rapid expansion strains governance (+0.5 unrest per day in every settlement)
Rule.Translated: - La expansión rápida sobrecarga el gobierno (+0.5 de agitación al día en cada asentamiento)

Rule.Original: - All research produced by your settlements is doubled
Rule.Raw: - All research produced by your settlements is doubled
Rule.Translated: - Se duplica toda la investigación producida por tus asentamientos

Rule.Original: - Can send items that you have not completed the research for or are above your tech level to your settlements to be reverse-engineered, giving you their value in research points
Rule.Raw: - Can send items that you have not completed the research for or are above your tech level to your settlements to be reverse-engineered, giving you their value in research points
Rule.Translated: - Puedes enviar a tus asentamientos objetos cuya investigación no hayas completado o que superen tu nivel tecnológico para estudiarlos mediante ingeniería inversa y obtener su valor en puntos de investigación

Rule.Original: - Research investment reduces tax revenue (-10% base tax)
Rule.Raw: - Research investment reduces tax revenue (-10% base tax)
Rule.Translated: - La inversión en investigación reduce los ingresos fiscales (-10% al impuesto base)

Rule.Original: - Once per season, can request for a mercenary from your faction to join your colony
Rule.Raw: - Once per season, can request for a mercenary from your faction to join your colony
Rule.Translated: - Una vez por estación, puedes solicitar que un mercenario de tu facción se una a tu colonia

Rule.Original: - All tithes received have their value increased by 20%
Rule.Raw: - All tithes received have their value increased by 20%
Rule.Translated: - El valor de todos los diezmos recibidos aumenta un 20%

Rule.Original: - Failing to protect your settlements against a raid causes loyalty to drop significantly
Rule.Raw: - Failing to protect your settlements against a raid causes loyalty to drop significantly
Rule.Translated: - No proteger tus asentamientos de una incursión provoca una caída considerable de su lealtad

Rule.Original: - Your Faction has been using slaves for its projects since the start, gaining more workers at the cost of not being able to hire as many normal citizens.
Rule.Raw: - Your Faction has been using slaves for its projects since the start, gaining more workers at the cost of not being able to hire as many normal citizens.
Rule.Translated: - Tu facción utiliza esclavos en sus proyectos desde el principio y obtiene más trabajadores a costa de poder contratar a menos ciudadanos normales.

Rule.Original: - Can send your military to raid another faction's settlement to enslave its members instead of ordinary raiding
Rule.Raw: - Can send your military to raid another faction's settlement to enslave its members instead of ordinary raiding
Rule.Translated: - Puedes enviar a tus militares al asentamiento de otra facción para esclavizar a sus habitantes en lugar de realizar un saqueo normal

Rule.Original: - Slave labor breeds discontent (-0.5 happiness gained, +0.5 unrest gained per day)
Rule.Raw: - Slave labor breeds discontent (-0.5 happiness gained, +0.5 unrest gained per day)
Rule.Translated: - El trabajo esclavo genera descontento (-0.5 de felicidad ganada y +0.5 de agitación ganada al día)

Rule.Original: - Reduce prosperity loss by 50% when attacked
Rule.Raw: - Reduce prosperity loss by 50% when attacked
Rule.Translated: - Reduce la pérdida de prosperidad un 50% al sufrir un ataque

Rule.Original: - Cannot lose buildings or settlement levels upon a failed defense
Rule.Raw: - Cannot lose buildings or settlement levels upon a failed defense
Rule.Translated: - No puedes perder edificios ni niveles de asentamiento al fracasar una defensa

Rule.Original: - Increases the value of loot by 20% when raiding
Rule.Raw: - Increases the value of loot by 20% when raiding
Rule.Translated: - El valor del botín de los saqueos aumenta un 20%

Rule.Original: - Military forces are available 1 day sooner after using them to raid
Rule.Raw: - Military forces are available 1 day sooner after using them to raid
Rule.Translated: - Tus fuerzas militares vuelven a estar disponibles 1 día antes tras usarlas para saquear

Rule.Original: - Military forces receive a +2 level bonus to combat when defending
Rule.Raw: - Military forces receive a +2 level bonus to combat when defending
Rule.Translated: - Las fuerzas militares reciben una bonificación de +2 niveles de combate al defender

Rule.Original: - All settlements receive a steady +5 to base tax
Rule.Raw: - All settlements receive a steady +5 to base tax
Rule.Translated: - Todos los asentamientos reciben una bonificación constante de +5 al impuesto base

Rule.Original: - Automatically unlocks the first road technology
Rule.Raw: - Automatically unlocks the first road technology
Rule.Translated: - Desbloquea automáticamente la primera tecnología de carreteras

Rule.Original: - Roads are constructed in 33% of the required time
Rule.Raw: - Roads are constructed in 33% of the required time
Rule.Translated: - Las carreteras se construyen en el 33% del tiempo necesario

Rule.Original: - Roads will also be constructed to connect to allied faction's settlements
Rule.Raw: - Roads will also be constructed to connect to allied faction's settlements
Rule.Translated: - También se construyen carreteras para conectar los asentamientos de facciones aliadas

Rule.Original: - A random trade caravan will arrive to your capital every 3-5 days
Rule.Raw: - A random trade caravan will arrive to your capital every 3-5 days
Rule.Translated: - Una caravana comercial aleatoria llega a tu capital cada 3-5 días

Rule.Original: - Settlements passively generate research points equal to 5% of their total profit
Rule.Raw: - Settlements passively generate research points equal to 5% of their total profit
Rule.Translated: - Los asentamientos generan pasivamente puntos de investigación equivalentes al 5% de su beneficio total

Rule.Original: - Negative random Empire events have a 20% chance to be re-rolled in exchange for a new event
Rule.Raw: - Negative random Empire events have a 20% chance to be re-rolled in exchange for a new event
Rule.Translated: - Los sucesos aleatorios negativos de Empire tienen un 20% de probabilidad de volver a sortearse y ser sustituidos por un nuevo suceso

Rule.Original: A specially-treated firepit that produces a dim light over a large area. People who prefer darklight work best with this light source. Cooks meals and produces heat, but burns wood in the process. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable.
Rule.Raw: A specially-treated firepit that produces a dim light over a large area. People who prefer darklight work best with this light source. Cooks meals and produces heat, but burns wood in the process. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable.
Rule.Translated: Una hoguera especialmente tratada que produce una luz tenue sobre una gran superficie. Las personas que prefieren la luz oscura consiguen mejores resultados con esta fuente de luz. Permite preparar comidas y produce calor, pero consume madera en el proceso. Dura más tiempo que una hoguera estándar. Como todas las fuentes de calor, debe colocarse en interiores para que tenga un espacio cerrado que calentar. Se puede repostar.

Rule.Original: A heavy incinerator mounted on a barricade to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. It is equipped with a powerful mega-burner that requires bioferrite to reload.
Rule.Raw: A heavy incinerator mounted on a barricade to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. It is equipped with a powerful mega-burner that requires bioferrite to reload.
Rule.Translated: Una poderoso incinerador colocado sobre sacos de arena para proporcionar cobertura al usuario. Necesita ser manejado para disparar. Está equipado con un potente mega-quemador que requiere de bioferrita para recargarse.

Rule.Original: A heavy incinerator designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Raw: A heavy incinerator designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un incinerador pesado diseñado para montarse en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A devastating gamma ray laser mounted on a barricade to grant cover. It fires a sweeping beam capable of piercing armor and igniting targets. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires plasteel to refurbish its emitter array after heavy use.
Rule.Raw: A devastating gamma ray laser mounted on a barricade to grant cover. It fires a sweeping beam capable of piercing armor and igniting targets. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires plasteel to refurbish its emitter array after heavy use.
Rule.Translated: Un devastador láser de rayos gamma colocado sobre unos sacos de arena para proporcionar cobertura al usuario. Dispara un haz capaz de atravesar blindajes e incendiar objetivos. Requiere de un operador para disparar. Necesita de plastiacero para reacondicionar su matriz emisora tras un uso intensivo.

Rule.Original: A turret designed to fire rubber bullets at intruders or unruly colonists. It causes pain and blunt trauma with low chance of fatal injury, making it ideal for non-lethal suppression. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Raw: A turret designed to fire rubber bullets at intruders or unruly colonists. It causes pain and blunt trauma with low chance of fatal injury, making it ideal for non-lethal suppression. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta diseñada para disparar balas de goma a intrusos o colonos rebeldes. Provoca dolor y traumatismos contusos con pocas posibilidades de causar lesiones mortales, lo que la hace ideal para la represión no letal. Puede explotar cuando se daña. Su tonot cerebro de IA no se puede controlar directamente, por lo que debes tener cuidado con el fuego amigo.

Rule.Original: One of the weirdest plants from Earth, genetically modified to thrive in wet, warm environments. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: One of the weirdest plants from Earth, genetically modified to thrive in wet, warm environments. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una de las plantas más extrañas de la Tierra, modificada genéticamente para prosperar en ambientes cálidos y húmedos. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: This jungle tree is not of terrestrial origins, originating from the deepest crevices of an alien jungle. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This jungle tree is not of terrestrial origins, originating from the deepest crevices of an alien jungle. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este árbol selvático no es de origen terrestre: procede de las grietas más profundas de una jungla alienígena. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A giant alien mushroom that glows in the strange darkening mist. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A giant alien mushroom that glows in the strange darkening mist. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una seta alienígena gigante que brilla entre la extraña niebla oscura. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: This Septimum plant has grown to an enormous size, with a flowering top as large as a person. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This Septimum plant has grown to an enormous size, with a flowering top as large as a person. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Esta planta Septimum ha alcanzado un tamaño enorme, con una copa florida tan grande como una persona. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Hierba silvestre. Crece donde haya algo de luz y un suelo mínimamente fértil. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: This twisting alien plant grows small glowing berries. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This twisting alien plant grows small glowing berries. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Esta retorcida planta alienígena produce pequeñas bayas luminosas. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: Like many other flora from the Forsakens native planet, this huge globular plant is bioluminescent. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: Like many other flora from the Forsakens native planet, this huge globular plant is bioluminescent. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Como muchas otras plantas del planeta natal de los Forsakens, esta enorme planta globular es bioluminiscente. Es una imitación.

Rule.Raw: This strange plant seems to be of alien origins. It doesn't seem to be fit for human consumption. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Esta extraña planta parece de origen alienígena. No parece apta para el consumo humano. Es una imitación.

Rule.Translated: Pese a su nombre común, el árbol de emparrado muerto no está realmente muerto: está excepcionalmente adaptado a sobrevivir en climas áridos. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: Wild tall grass. Slows down anyone moving over it. This one is fake.

Rule.Original: A bunch of colourful flowers. These are fake.

Rule.Translated: Esto fue un árbol. Los mecanoides transformaron sus células en una abominación mitad árbol y mitad mecanoide cuya función se desconoce. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.

Rule.Translated: Una palmera adaptada a las condiciones del manglar. Es una imitación.

Rule.Translated: Todo en este hongo grita «soy tóxico, aléjate de mí». Es una imitación.

Rule.Translated: Una micorriza es una asociación simbiótica entre un hongo y una planta. Es una imitación.

Rule.Translated: Una seta rosa enorme que rezuma constantemente una sustancia de olor penetrante parecida a la resina. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A blueish-pink mushroom, secreting a slimy substance that attracts insects. This one is fake.

Rule.Original: This grass is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based. Not very edible for terrestrial creatures. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This grass is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based. Not very edible for terrestrial creatures. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Esta hierba es totalmente alienígena y probablemente ni siquiera esté basada al 100% en el carbono. Apenas es comestible para las criaturas terrestres. Es una imitación.

Rule.Translated: Una extraña infección parece estar transformando este roble común en un árbol ocular. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: This plant is completely alien. The blue nodules at the end of each branch / tentacle produce an eerie rattling sound from time to time. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This plant is completely alien. The blue nodules at the end of each branch / tentacle produce an eerie rattling sound from time to time. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Esta planta es totalmente alienígena. Los nódulos azules del extremo de cada rama / tentáculo producen de vez en cuando un inquietante traqueteo. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A sickly pink orb supported by a network of gnarled branches. A reddish sap constantly drips from its wood, and seems to keep insects at bay. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A sickly pink orb supported by a network of gnarled branches. A reddish sap constantly drips from its wood, and seems to keep insects at bay. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un orbe de un rosa enfermizo sostenido por una red de ramas retorcidas. De su madera gotea constantemente una savia rojiza que parece mantener alejados a los insectos. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A spiny plant with some kind of fruit hanging from its top. The fruit seems to be as hard as the trunk itself, and equally covered in spines. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A spiny plant with some kind of fruit hanging from its top. The fruit seems to be as hard as the trunk itself, and equally covered in spines. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una planta espinosa con una especie de fruto que cuelga de su parte superior. El fruto parece tan duro como el tronco y está igual de cubierto de espinas. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: These translucent plants seem to be able to grow almost anywhere, even in some snow covered areas. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: These translucent plants seem to be able to grow almost anywhere, even in some snow covered areas. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Estas plantas translúcidas parecen capaces de crecer casi en cualquier lugar, incluso en algunas zonas cubiertas de nieve. Son imitaciones.

Rule.Original: A tall, translucent flower that seems to be partially inorganic. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A tall, translucent flower that seems to be partially inorganic. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor alta y translúcida que parece parcialmente inorgánica. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: The brown barrel cactus, Ferocactus Brunetus, is an extremophile plant that thrives in low-water and poor sunlight conditions. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: The brown barrel cactus, Ferocactus Brunetus, is an extremophile plant that thrives in low-water and poor sunlight conditions. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: El cactus de barril marrón, Ferocactus Brunetus, es una planta extremófila que prospera con poca agua y escasa luz solar. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.

Rule.Translated: Un helecho alto silvestre. Ralentiza a cualquiera que lo atraviese. Es una imitación.

Rule.Raw: This slimy bulb seems to be feeding on the polluted terrain like a parasite. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este bulbo viscoso parece alimentarse del terreno contaminado como un parásito. Es una imitación.

Rule.Translated: Hierba silvestre. Crece donde haya algo de luz y un suelo mínimamente fértil. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A continously blooming giant flower with a dangerous, bright pink colour. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A continously blooming giant flower with a dangerous, bright pink colour. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor gigante que florece sin cesar y tiene un intenso color rosa que advierte de su peligro. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A giant mushroom that has adapted to growing in extremely polluted environments. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A giant mushroom that has adapted to growing in extremely polluted environments. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una seta gigante adaptada a crecer en ambientes extremadamente contaminados. Es una imitación.

Rule.Translated: Un hongo morado muy extraño que se parece a un coral. Solo crece en suelos contaminados. Es una imitación.

Rule.Raw: This ocular tree has been affected by pollution and mutated in strange ways. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este árbol ocular se ha visto afectado por la contaminación y ha mutado de formas extrañas. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: This globular aberration has been affected by pollution and mutated in strange ways. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This globular aberration has been affected by pollution and mutated in strange ways. This one is fake.

respiradero antiguo de lluvia de sangre

Rule.Raw: A moderately-sized archotech tower rising from the ground. It seems to be long inert.
Rule.Translated: Una torre arqueotecnológica de tamaño moderado que se alza desde el suelo. Parece llevar mucho tiempo inerte.

Rule.Original: A large archotech structure. The dull green surface is ruiend and covered in vegetation. It seems to be long inert.

Rule.Translated: Una gran estructura arqueotecnológica. Su superficie de un verde apagado está arruinada y cubierta de vegetación. Parece llevar mucho tiempo inerte.

Rule.Original: The ruined central core of an archonexus. Its broad surfaces are dusty and covered with vegetation. It seems to be long inert.
Rule.Raw: The ruined central core of an archonexus. Its broad surfaces are dusty and covered with vegetation. It seems to be long inert.

base de torreta mecanoide en ruinas

Rule.Original: A ruined mech turret base. Completely broken.
Rule.Raw: A ruined mech turret base. Completely broken.
Rule.Translated: Una base de torreta mecanoide en ruinas. Está totalmente rota.

Rule.Original: A ruined mech auto-mortar. Completely broken. No useful components can be scavenged from this old mortar.
Rule.Raw: A ruined mech auto-mortar. Completely broken. No useful components can be scavenged from this old mortar.
Rule.Translated: Un mortero automático mecanoide en ruinas. Está totalmente roto. No se pueden recuperar componentes útiles de este viejo mortero.
base de torreta mecanoide grande en ruinas

Rule.Original: A ruined mech large turret base. Whatever this base held, it's long gone.
Rule.Raw: A ruined mech large turret base. Whatever this base held, it's long gone.
Rule.Translated: Una base de torreta mecanoide grande en ruinas. Lo que sostenía esta base desapareció hace mucho tiempo.
célula de energía mecanoide en ruinas

Rule.Original: A ruined mech power cell. Perhaps a few components can be scavenged from this one.
Rule.Raw: A ruined mech power cell. Perhaps a few components can be scavenged from this one.
Rule.Translated: Una célula de energía mecanoide en ruinas. Quizá puedan recuperarse algunos componentes.
activador de proximidad mecanoide en ruinas

Rule.Original: A ruined mech proximity activator. Perhaps a few components can be scavenged from this one.
Rule.Raw: A ruined mech proximity activator. Perhaps a few components can be scavenged from this one.
Rule.Translated: Un activador de proximidad mecanoide en ruinas. Quizá puedan recuperarse algunos componentes.

Rule.Original: A ruined mech capsule. Thankfully it has been empty for a while.
Rule.Raw: A ruined mech capsule. Thankfully it has been empty for a while.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula mecanoide en ruinas. Por suerte, lleva un tiempo vacía.

Rule.Original: A ruined mech assembler. Thankfully it has been inactive for a while.
Rule.Raw: A ruined mech assembler. Thankfully it has been inactive for a while.
Rule.Translated: Un ensamblador mecanoide en ruinas. Por suerte, lleva un tiempo inactivo.

Rule.Raw: This was once a relaxing swimming pool, but it is now a fetid, stagnant pool of water.
Rule.Translated: Esto fue una piscina relajante, pero ahora es una poza de agua estancada y fétida.

Rule.Raw: A recliner used for relaxation. Rotten and dirty to the point of uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una tumbona para relajarse. Está tan podrida y sucia que ya no sirve para nada.

Rule.Raw: A beach umbrella so broken that it won't even keep the sun out.
Rule.Translated: Una sombrilla de playa tan rota que ni siquiera protege del sol.

Rule.Raw: A half-deflated beach ball that has seen better days.
Rule.Translated: Una pelota de playa medio desinflada que ha conocido tiempos mejores.

Rule.Translated: Esta escalera de piscina ha conocido tiempos mejores.

Rule.Original: A deflated and dirty pool float.

Rule.Translated: Un flotador de piscina desinflado y sucio.

Rule.Original: A wide band receiver designed to intercept lingering mechanoid signal patterns from the environment. Completely inactive.
Rule.Raw: A wide band receiver designed to intercept lingering mechanoid signal patterns from the environment. Completely inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un receptor de banda ancha diseñado para interceptar patrones de señales mecanoides que persisten en el entorno. Está totalmente inactivo.

Rule.Original: Collects edible airborne micro-fungi present in this map and extracts them into processed fungi that can be used as a food ingredient. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: Collects edible airborne micro-fungi present in this map and extracts them into processed fungi that can be used as a food ingredient. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Recoge microhongos comestibles presentes en el aire de este mapa y los procesa para usarlos como ingrediente alimentario. Está inactivo.

Rule.Original: Produces electricity from hyperheated geothermal steam geysers in a magma rich zone. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: Produces electricity from hyperheated geothermal steam geysers in a magma rich zone. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Produce electricidad a partir de géiseres de vapor geotérmico sobrecalentado en una zona rica en magma. Está inactivo.

Rule.Original: A containment vat designed to preserve and regulate the life of a Gamma plant beyond its natural span. This gamma seems to be a plastic plant.
Rule.Raw: A containment vat designed to preserve and regulate the life of a Gamma plant beyond its natural span. This gamma seems to be a plastic plant.
Rule.Translated: Una cuba de contención diseñada para conservar y regular la vida de una planta Gamma más allá de su duración natural. Este gamma parece una planta de plástico.

Rule.Original: Uses alcyonite solar cells to extract electricity from the sun. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: Uses alcyonite solar cells to extract electricity from the sun. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Usa células solares de alcionita para obtener electricidad del sol. Está inactivo.

Rule.Original: Uses alcyonite solar cells to extract electricity from the sun. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: Uses alcyonite solar cells to extract electricity from the sun. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Usa células solares de alcionita para obtener electricidad del sol. Está inactivo.

Rule.Original: This device needs a small amount of electricity to condense atmospheric gases and spew a large cloud of ocular gas. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: This device needs a small amount of electricity to condense atmospheric gases and spew a large cloud of ocular gas. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Este dispositivo necesita una pequeña cantidad de electricidad para condensar gases atmosféricos y expulsar una gran nube de gas ocular. Está inactivo.

Rule.Original: An experimental device that emmanates strange waves making everyone love the truly alien weather. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: An experimental device that emmanates strange waves making everyone love the truly alien weather. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo experimental que emite ondas extrañas y hace que a todo el mundo le encante el clima verdaderamente alienígena. Está inactivo.

Rule.Original: Extracts tar from a natural tar hole and transforms the tar into chemfuel. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: Extracts tar from a natural tar hole and transforms the tar into chemfuel. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Extrae alquitrán de una poza natural y lo transforma en biocombustible. Está inactivo.

Rule.Original: A huge mound of hardened organic matter that communicates with an extensive underground hive. This one was built out of papier mache.
Rule.Raw: A huge mound of hardened organic matter that communicates with an extensive underground hive. This one was built out of papier mache.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme montículo de materia orgánica endurecida que se comunica con una extensa colmena subterránea. Está hecho de papel maché.

Rule.Original: These rare trees grow giant, shimmering golden cubes in place of fruit. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: These rare trees grow giant, shimmering golden cubes in place of fruit. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Estos árboles poco comunes producen cubos dorados gigantes y relucientes en lugar de frutos. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A grotesque growth of pulsing, veiny tissue stretched over a warped wooden frame. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A grotesque growth of pulsing, veiny tissue stretched over a warped wooden frame. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una grotesca masa de tejido palpitante y lleno de venas extendida sobre un armazón de madera deformado. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: An easy answer to the question: "what would you create if you were an insane plant geneticist?". This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: An easy answer to the question: "what would you create if you were an insane plant geneticist?". This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una respuesta sencilla a la pregunta: «¿qué crearías si fueras un genetista de plantas demente?». Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A bizarre fusion of bark and circuitry, this half-synthetic tree hums with low energy pulses. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A bizarre fusion of bark and circuitry, this half-synthetic tree hums with low energy pulses. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una extraña fusión de corteza y circuitos: este árbol semisintético zumba con pulsos de baja energía. Es una imitación.

Rule.Original: A tree-like giant bramble that supports a huge globe of glowing sap that casts a soft, colorful light in the dark. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A tree-like giant bramble that supports a huge globe of glowing sap that casts a soft, colorful light in the dark. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una zarza gigante con aspecto de árbol que sostiene un enorme globo de savia luminosa y proyecta una luz suave y colorida en la oscuridad. Es una imitación.

Rule.Raw: A workbench for creating implantable xenogerms from genepacks stored in nearby gene banks. This device has collapsed in on itself, rendering it useless.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de trabajo para crear xenogérmenes implantables a partir de paquetes genéticos almacenados en bancos genéticos cercanos. El dispositivo ha colapsado sobre sí mismo y ha quedado inservible.

Rule.Original: An automated surgery machine that was able to extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them. Its internal machinery is completely fused and rusted.
Rule.Raw: An automated surgery machine that was able to extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them. Its internal machinery is completely fused and rusted.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina de cirugía automatizada que podía extraer los genes de una persona y crear un paquete genético. Su maquinaria interna está totalmente fundida y oxidada.

Rule.Original: A genetic analysis and processing system. Ruined and unuseable.
Rule.Raw: A genetic analysis and processing system. Ruined and unuseable.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de análisis y procesamiento genético. Está arruinado e inservible.

Rule.Original: A huge gene bank, much larger than the ones in use nowadays. Completely broken.
Rule.Raw: A huge gene bank, much larger than the ones in use nowadays. Completely broken.
Rule.Translated: Un banco genético enorme, mucho mayor que los que se usan actualmente. Está totalmente roto.

Rule.Original: A broken vitals monitor with a dead screen.
Rule.Raw: A broken vitals monitor with a dead screen.
Rule.Translated: Un monitor de constantes vitales roto con la pantalla apagada.

Rule.Original: A broken mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Its antennas are bent in weird angles.
Rule.Raw: A broken mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Its antennas are bent in weird angles.
Rule.Translated: Un amplificador de señales de banda mecanoide roto. Sus antenas están dobladas en ángulos extraños.

Rule.Original: A broken mech recharger. The connecting pins are bent and chipped, making the whole machine useless.
Rule.Raw: A broken mech recharger. The connecting pins are bent and chipped, making the whole machine useless.
Rule.Translated: Un recargador de mecanoides roto. Los contactos están doblados y astillados, por lo que toda la máquina resulta inservible.

Rule.Original: A broken mech recharger. The connecting pins are bent and chipped, making the whole machine useless.

Rule.Original: A tank used to create new mechanoids. The mechanite tank was punctured long ago, and all the fluid has long since evaporated.
Rule.Raw: A tank used to create new mechanoids. The mechanite tank was punctured long ago, and all the fluid has long since evaporated.
Rule.Translated: Un tanque para crear nuevos mecanoides. El depósito de mecanitos se perforó hace mucho y todo el líquido se evaporó hace tiempo.

Rule.Translated: Una cama diseñada especialmente para hospitales. El colchón se ha podrido hasta desaparecer.

Rule.Raw: An ancient postbox, smashed and deteriorated to uselessness. It seems to have been moved here long ago for some unknown reason.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo buzón de correos, destrozado y deteriorado hasta la inutilidad. Parece haber sido trasladado aquí hace mucho tiempo por alguna razón desconocida.

Rule.Original: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.
Rule.Raw: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina expendedora. Quedó inservible hace siglos, y generaciones de saqueadores se han llevado todas las piezas útiles. Cómo acabó aquí es un misterio.

Rule.Original: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.
Rule.Raw: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina de aire acondicionado. Su interior ha quedado inservible hace mucho tiempo y lo que no ha sido saqueado se ha oxidado durante el tiempo transcurrido desde entonces.

Rule.Original: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.
Rule.Raw: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo fregadero de cocina hecho de algún material no metálico. Está muy deteriorado y no hay forma de aprovechar nada de él.\n\nCómo llegó aquí debe ser una larga historia.

Rule.Original: An ancient device used for washing textiles. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient device used for washing textiles. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo aparato utilizado para lavar tejidos. Destrozada y oxidada, ahora es completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo ha llegado hasta aquí.

Rule.Original: A small, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Raw: A small, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja vacía, abandonada hace años. Está demasiado oxidada como para almacenar nada.

Rule.Original: A long, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Raw: A long, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Translated: Una especie de cajón largo y vacío que fue abandonado hace años. Está demasiado oxidada como para almacenar nada.

Rule.Original: A large crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Raw: A large crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.
Rule.Translated: Una gran caja abandonada hace años. Está demasiado oxidada como para almacenar nada.

Rule.Original: A giant wheel which came off some large vehicle many ages ago. The rubber has disintegrated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Raw: A giant wheel which came off some large vehicle many ages ago. The rubber has disintegrated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda gigante que se desprendió de algún gran vehículo hace muchos años. La goma se ha desintegrado, y el metal está retorcido y oxidado.
torso de caminante de guerra antiguo

Rule.Original: The torso of a mid-scale warwalker which fell here in ancient days. The valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: The torso of a mid-scale warwalker which fell here in ancient days. The valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: El torso de un caminante de guerra de tamaño medio que cayó aquí en tiempos remotos. Las partes valiosas fueron saqueadas hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient dropship. The valuable parts were looted long ago and the rest has deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient dropship. The valuable parts were looted long ago and the rest has deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de una antigua nave de transporte. Las partes valiosas fueron saqueadas hace tiempo y el resto se han deteriorado tanto que han quedado inservibles.
garra de caminante de guerra antigua

Rule.Original: The assault claw of an ancient mid-scale warwalker. This weapon specialized in tearing through heavy plasteel armor at close range. Its valuable components were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: The assault claw of an ancient mid-scale warwalker. This weapon specialized in tearing through heavy plasteel armor at close range. Its valuable components were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: La garra de asalto de un antiguo caminante de guerra de tamaño media. Esta arma estaba especializada en desgarrar armaduras pesadas de plastiacero a corta distancia. Sus valiosos componentes fueron saqueados hace mucho tiempo.
pata de caminante de guerra antigua

Rule.Original: The shattered leg of a mid-scale warwalker that fell here long ago. It has been picked clean by looters, and no valuable components remain.
Rule.Raw: The shattered leg of a mid-scale warwalker that fell here long ago. It has been picked clean by looters, and no valuable components remain.
Rule.Translated: La pierna destrozada de un caminante de guerra de tamaño medio, que cayó aquí hace mucho tiempo. Los saqueadores ya se han hecho con cualquier componente valioso que quedaba.
restos de velocista de guerra antiguo

Rule.Original: The shattered remains of an ancient sub-scale warsprinter. Whatever parts weren't ruined when it was destroyed were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: The shattered remains of an ancient sub-scale warsprinter. Whatever parts weren't ruined when it was destroyed were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Los restos destrozados de un antiguo sprinter de guerra. Las partes que no se arruinaron cuando fue destruido fueron saqueadas hace tiempo.
restos de araña de guerra antigua

Rule.Original: The ruined remains of an ancient mid-scale warspider. It has been picked over many times, and there is nothing valuable left to loot.
Rule.Raw: The ruined remains of an ancient mid-scale warspider. It has been picked over many times, and there is nothing valuable left to loot.
Rule.Translated: Los restos destrozados de una antigua araña de guerra. Los han saqueado en numerosas ocasiones, por lo que no queda nada valioso.

Rule.Original: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una sección de una antigua tubería. Una vez transportó un fluido valioso a través de largas distancias. Ya la han despojado de cualquier resto útil, y se ha deteriorado hasta la inutilidad.
pie de caminante de guerra antiguo

Rule.Original: A massive foot from an ancient warwalker. It seems to have been torn free from its owner by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Raw: A massive foot from an ancient warwalker. It seems to have been torn free from its owner by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un pie enorme de un antiguo caminante de guerra. Parece haber sido arrancado del conjunto por algún tipo de arma pesada. Todos los componentes útiles fueron saqueados o se han deteriorado hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient tank which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient tank which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un antiguo tanque que fue destruido por algún tipo de arma pesada. Todos los componentes útiles fueron saqueados o se han deteriorado hace tiempo.
transporte blindado de personal antiguo en ruinas
carcasa de caminante de guerra antigua

Rule.Original: Most of the armored shell of a warwalker. It appears to have been torn off by some colossal weapon system. All the valuable parts were looted, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Raw: Most of the armored shell of a warwalker. It appears to have been torn off by some colossal weapon system. All the valuable parts were looted, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Translated: La mayor parte del blindaje de un caminante de guerra. Parece haber sido arrancado del conjunto por algún sistema de armas colosal. Todas las partes valiosas fueron saqueadas, y el resto está demasiado deteriorado.

Rule.Original: An ancient jet engine, probably detached from a large airplane. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient jet engine, probably detached from a large airplane. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo motor a reacción, que probablemente ha pertenecido a un gran avión. Sus delicadas partes internas están oxidadas hasta la inutilidad, y las piezas valiosas fueron saqueadas hace tiempo.
motor de nave de desembarco antiguo

Rule.Original: An ancient dropship engine. It probably came off a military troop carrier. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient dropship engine. It probably came off a military troop carrier. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo motor de nave, que probablemente perteneció a algún tipo de transporte militar de tropas. Sus delicadas partes internas están oxidadas hasta la inutilidad, y las piezas valiosas fueron saqueadas hace mucho tiempo.

Rule.Original: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Raw: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo vehículo capaz de volar de forma automática. Sus partes valiosas fueron saqueadas hace tiempo y el resto está muy deteriorado.

Rule.Original: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.
Rule.Raw: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua valla hecha de postes de hormigón armado unidos por paneles de hormigón.

Rule.Original: A mounting platform that once held some sort of cannon. It has been broken for many years and every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: A mounting platform that once held some sort of cannon. It has been broken for many years and every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una plataforma de montaje que una vez sostuvo algún tipo de cañón. Lleva muchos años rota y todos sus componentes útiles fueron saqueados hace tiempo.

Rule.Original: A barrel from a long-range cannon for artillery or anti-ship use. When it was new, it must have been frighteningly powerful. Now, it's far beyond repair and every useful component has been looted.
Rule.Raw: A barrel from a long-range cannon for artillery or anti-ship use. When it was new, it must have been frighteningly powerful. Now, it's far beyond repair and every useful component has been looted.
Rule.Translated: El cilindro de un gran cañón de largo alcance para uso artillero o antibuque. Cuando funcionaba, debía de ser terriblemente potente. Ahora está mucho más allá de la reparación y cada componente útil ha sido saqueado.

Rule.Original: The remains of a smashed mechanoid. All the useful components and materials are ruined or missing.
Rule.Raw: The remains of a smashed mechanoid. All the useful components and materials are ruined or missing.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un mecanoide destrozado. Todos los componentes y materiales útiles están estropeados o han desaparecido.

Rule.Original: The broken shell of a mech drop beacon. Its useful components are missing and the shell has deteriorated after many years.
Rule.Raw: The broken shell of a mech drop beacon. Its useful components are missing and the shell has deteriorated after many years.
Rule.Translated: El armazón roto de una baliza de descenso mecanoide. Faltan sus componentes útiles y el armazón se ha deteriorado tras muchos años.

Rule.Original: An ancient engine block that is rusted through. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Raw: An ancient engine block that is rusted through. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Translated: Un bloque de motor antiguo que está completamente oxidado. Ninguna reparación podría salvarlo.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken ship navigation beacon. Every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken ship navigation beacon. Every useful component was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua baliza de navegación, completamente rota. Ya ha sido despojada de cualquier componente útil hace mucho tiempo.
