Rule.Translated: intro(tag=meme_Pirate) ->En [place_summary] [place_name], los [memberNamePlural] habían creado un refugio seguro, donde su botín podía ser contado para la gloria de [deity0_name].

Rule.Original: conflict(tag=meme_Pirate) ->A coward [foeLeader] looked at this with scorn, for [foeLeader_pronoun] desired all the riches for [foeLeader_objective]self.
Rule.Raw: conflict(tag=meme_Pirate) ->A coward [foeLeader] looked at this with scorn, for [foeLeader_pronoun] desired all the riches for [foeLeader_objective]self.
Rule.Translated: conflict(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Un [foeLeader] cobarde observaba esto con desdén, ya que [foeLeader_pronoun] deseaba todas las riquezas para [foeLeader_objective]-mismo.

Rule.Original: founderJoin(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[deity0_name]'s truest follower, captain [founderName], captured the [foeLeader] in a daring raid.
Rule.Raw: founderJoin(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[deity0_name]'s truest follower, captain [founderName], captured the [foeLeader] in a daring raid.
Rule.Translated: founderJoin(tag=meme_Pirate) ->El seguidor más fiel de [deity0_name], el capitán [founderName], capturó al [foeLeader] en una audaz incursión.

Rule.Original: victory(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName]'s crewmates incarcerated the [foeLeader], who was executed a few days later for [deity0_name]'s glory.
Rule.Raw: victory(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName]'s crewmates incarcerated the [foeLeader], who was executed a few days later for [deity0_name]'s glory.
Rule.Translated: victory(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Los camaradas de [founderName] encarcelaron al [foeLeader], que fue ejecutado unos días después para la gloria de [deity0_name].

Rule.Original: setup(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName] was the greatest captain, a true leader. Thousands of pirates united under [founder_possessive] terrifying banner.
Rule.Raw: setup(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName] was the greatest captain, a true leader. Thousands of pirates united under [founder_possessive] terrifying banner.
Rule.Translated: setup(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName] fue el mayor capitán, un verdadero líder. Miles de piratas se unieron bajo su aterradora bandera.

Rule.Original: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName] made us understand that hardships, suffering and sacrifices must be faced together, as a crew. We learned to value the comradeship and camaraderie, and respect each other.
Rule.Raw: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName] made us understand that hardships, suffering and sacrifices must be faced together, as a crew. We learned to value the comradeship and camaraderie, and respect each other.
Rule.Translated: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Pirate) ->[founderName] nos hizo entender que las pruebas, los sufrimientos y los sacrificios deben enfrentarse juntos, como una tripulación. Aprendimos a apreciar la camaradería y el respeto mutuo.

Rule.Original: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Pirate) ->I talked to the greatest pirate to ever live, a legend amongst men. He showed me that
Rule.Raw: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Pirate) ->I talked to the greatest pirate to ever live, a legend amongst men. He showed me that
Rule.Translated: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Hablé con el mayor pirata que jamás haya vivido, una leyenda entre los hombres. Me mostró que

Rule.Original: lesson(tag=meme_Pirate) ->hardships, suffering and sacrifices must be faced together, as a crew
Rule.Raw: lesson(tag=meme_Pirate) ->hardships, suffering and sacrifices must be faced together, as a crew
Rule.Translated: lesson(tag=meme_Pirate) ->las dificultades, los sufrimientos y los sacrificios deben enfrentarse juntos, como una tripulación

Rule.Original: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Pirate) ->He taught me to value the comradeship and camaraderie, and the merits of respecting each other.
Rule.Raw: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Pirate) ->He taught me to value the comradeship and camaraderie, and the merits of respecting each other.
Rule.Translated: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Me enseñó a apreciar la camaradería y el espíritu de equipo, así como los méritos del respeto mutuo.

Rule.Original: archistBasis(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Archotechs do not respect those who can't defend themselves: we will face those weaker than ourselves as a crew.
Rule.Raw: archistBasis(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Archotechs do not respect those who can't defend themselves: we will face those weaker than ourselves as a crew.
Rule.Translated: archistBasis(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Los Arqueotécnicos no respetan a quienes no pueden defenderse: enfrentaremos a los que sean más débiles que nosotros como una tripulación.

Rule.Original: archistFact(tag=meme_Pirate) ->We will prove to the archotechs that comradeship and camaraderie are the values that keep us strong.
Rule.Raw: archistFact(tag=meme_Pirate) ->We will prove to the archotechs that comradeship and camaraderie are the values that keep us strong.
Rule.Translated: archistFact(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Demostraremos a los arqueotécnicos que la camaradería y la ayuda mutua son los valores que nos hacen fuertes.

Rule.Original: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Only by standing proud together can we become worthy of transcendence.
Rule.Raw: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Only by standing proud together can we become worthy of transcendence.
Rule.Translated: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Solo al mantenernos unidos podemos hacernos dignos de la trascendencia.

Rule.Original: animistBasis(tag=meme_Pirate) ->The spirits do not respect those who can't defend themselves: we will face those weaker than ourselves as a crew.
Rule.Raw: animistBasis(tag=meme_Pirate) ->The spirits do not respect those who can't defend themselves: we will face those weaker than ourselves as a crew.
Rule.Translated: animistBasis(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Los espíritus no respetan a quienes no pueden defenderse: enfrentaremos a los que sean más débiles que nosotros como una tripulación.

Rule.Original: animistFact(tag=meme_Pirate) ->We will prove to the spirits that comradeship and camaraderie are the values that keep us strong.
Rule.Raw: animistFact(tag=meme_Pirate) ->We will prove to the spirits that comradeship and camaraderie are the values that keep us strong.
Rule.Translated: animistFact(tag=meme_Pirate) ->Demostraremos a los espíritus que la camaradería y el espíritu de equipo son los valores que nos hacen fuertes.

Rule.Original: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[itIsSaid] only by standing proud together can we make the spirits truly listen to us.
Rule.Raw: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[itIsSaid] only by standing proud together can we make the spirits truly listen to us.
Rule.Translated: animistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate) ->[itIsSaid] solo al mantenernos unidos lograremos que los espíritus realmente nos escuchen.

Rule.Original: serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->[itIsSaid] we will prove that comradeship and camaraderie are the values that keep us strong.
Rule.Raw: serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->[itIsSaid] we will prove that comradeship and camaraderie are the values that keep us strong.
Rule.Translated: serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->[itIsSaid] demostraremos que la camaradería y el espíritu de equipo son los valores que nos hacen fuertes.

Rule.Original: chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->These eldritch entities would seek to destroy us, but we will stand together against them. Our camaraderie can't be shaken by anything, not even them.
Rule.Raw: chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->These eldritch entities would seek to destroy us, but we will stand together against them. Our camaraderie can't be shaken by anything, not even them.
Rule.Translated: chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->Estas entidades eldritch buscarían destruirnos, pero les haremos frente juntos. Nuestra camaradería no puede ser sacudida por nada, ni siquiera por ellos.

Rule.Original: esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->Such occult knowledge requires an unified will. We will stand together as a crew, our camaraderie allowing us to embrace these arcane secrets with ease.
Rule.Raw: esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->Such occult knowledge requires an unified will. We will stand together as a crew, our camaraderie allowing us to embrace these arcane secrets with ease.
Rule.Translated: esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->Tales conocimientos ocultos requieren una voluntad unificada. Nos mantendremos unidos como una tripulación, nuestra camaradería nos permitirá abrazar estos secretos oscuros con facilidad.

Rule.Original: eschatologismFact(tag=meme_Pirate)->We will plunder and pillage those weaker than ourselves, for the world they have created must be destroyed, and only our crew deserves their achievements.
Rule.Raw: eschatologismFact(tag=meme_Pirate)->We will plunder and pillage those weaker than ourselves, for the world they have created must be destroyed, and only our crew deserves their achievements.
Rule.Translated: eschatologismFact(tag=meme_Pirate)->Vamos a saquear y arrasar a los que sean más débiles que nosotros, porque el mundo que han creado debe ser destruido, y solo nuestra tripulación merece sus logros.

Rule.Original: introMemo(tag=meme_Pirate)->As a member of our Reclamation and Repossession Office, let us remind you that any resources found on this planet are the property of the Company, and as such any hostile factions trying to take possession of our assets must be terminated with EXTREME prejudice. We will not allow others to take what is rightfully ours.
Rule.Raw: introMemo(tag=meme_Pirate)->As a member of our Reclamation and Repossession Office, let us remind you that any resources found on this planet are the property of the Company, and as such any hostile factions trying to take possession of our assets must be terminated with EXTREME prejudice. We will not allow others to take what is rightfully ours.
Rule.Translated: introMemo(tag=meme_Pirate)->Como miembro de nuestra Oficina de Recuperación y Reapropiación, permítanos recordarle que todos los recursos encontrados en este planeta son propiedad de la Compañía, y como tal, cualquier facción hostil que intente tomar posesión de nuestros bienes debe ser eliminada con un PREJUICIO EXTREMO. No permitiremos que otros tomen lo que por derecho nos pertenece.

Rule.Original: alienistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->These wayward creatures are ours to do as we please.
Rule.Raw: alienistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->These wayward creatures are ours to do as we please.
Rule.Translated: alienistProphecy(tag=meme_Pirate)->Estas criaturas rebeldes son nuestras y podemos hacer con ellas lo que queramos.

Rule.Original:
Different interests, yet aiming for one: hardships, suffering and sacrifices must be faced together, as a crew.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a +3 mood bonus after socializing with another colonist.
Rule.Raw:
Different interests, yet aiming for one: hardships, suffering and sacrifices must be faced together, as a crew.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a +3 mood bonus after socializing with another colonist.
Rule.Translated:
Diversos intereses, pero un solo objetivo: las pruebas, los sufrimientos y los sacrificios deben enfrentarse juntos, como una tripulación.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos recibirán un aumento de humor de +3 después de simpatizar con otro colono.

Rule.Original:
In the table of brotherhood we'll dine, the banner of camaraderie will be unroll, all for one, one for all. Together, we will have the world.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a +6 mood bonus after socializing with another colonist.
Rule.Raw:
In the table of brotherhood we'll dine, the banner of camaraderie will be unroll, all for one, one for all. Together, we will have the world.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists will receive a +6 mood bonus after socializing with another colonist.
Rule.Translated:
En la mesa de la hermandad, cenaremos, la bandera de la camaradería se desplegará, todos para uno, uno para todos. Juntos, conquistaremos el mundo.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos reciben un aumento de humor de +6 después de simpatizar con otro colono.

Rule.Original: Been through some tough times together! (cumulative +5 per slain colonist)
Rule.Raw: Been through some tough times together! (cumulative +5 per slain colonist)
Rule.Translated: ¡Hemos superado momentos difíciles juntos! (acumulativo +5 por colono asesinado)

Rule.Original: Colonists gather around a campfire and sing shanties to strengthen their camaraderie.
Rule.Raw: Colonists gather around a campfire and sing shanties to strengthen their camaraderie.
Rule.Translated: Los colonos se reúnen alrededor de una hoguera y cantan canciones para fortalecer su camaradería.

Rule.Original: Generally chosen for his daring and dominating character, a pirate captain is often admired for his cruelty and destructiveness.
Rule.Raw: Generally chosen for his daring and dominating character, a pirate captain is often admired for his cruelty and destructiveness.
Rule.Translated: Generalmente elegido por su carácter audaz y dominante, un capitán pirata es a menudo admirado por su crueldad y capacidad de destrucción.

Rule.Original: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days. A shanty of above average quality will provide a new quest. A good quality shanty will remove negative thoughts from losing someone for all participants.
Rule.Raw: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days. A shanty of above average quality will provide a new quest. A good quality shanty will remove negative thoughts from losing someone for all participants.
Rule.Translated: Según la calidad del ritual, los participantes ganarán entre {MINMOOD} y {MAXMOOD} de humor durante {MOODDAYS} días. Una canción de calidad superior a la media proporcionará una nueva misión. Una canción de buena calidad eliminará los pensamientos negativos relacionados con la pérdida de un ser querido para todos los participantes.

Rule.Original: The {0} were incredibly boring. The cap'n displayed a lack of passion and the feeling of camaraderie just wasn't there.
Rule.Raw: The {0} were incredibly boring. The cap'n displayed a lack of passion and the feeling of camaraderie just wasn't there.
Rule.Translated: {0} fue increíblemente aburrido. El capitán mostró una falta de pasión y el sentimiento de camaradería simplemente no estaba allí.

Rule.Original: The {0} were lame. The cap'n treated us like children, wanting so desperately to hear something to lift their spirits.
Rule.Raw: The {0} were lame. The cap'n treated us like children, wanting so desperately to hear something to lift their spirits.
Rule.Translated: {0} fue malo. El capitán nos trató como a niños, queriendo desesperadamente cantar algo que nos levantara el ánimo.

Rule.Original: The {0} were very rousing. Shiver me timbers, those were some good shanties! The cap'n lifted our spirits and made us feel a camaraderie and togetherness that will only make us stronger.\n\nAnalyzing the lyrics afterwards, we found that the ancient words are actually cleverly encoded clues to a possible quest!
Rule.Raw: The {0} were very rousing. Shiver me timbers, those were some good shanties! The cap'n lifted our spirits and made us feel a camaraderie and togetherness that will only make us stronger.\n\nAnalyzing the lyrics afterwards, we found that the ancient words are actually cleverly encoded clues to a possible quest!
Rule.Translated: {0} fue muy animado. ¡Tengo escalofríos de alegría, son buenas canciones! El capitán nos levantó el ánimo y nos hizo sentir una camaradería y solidaridad que nos hará más fuertes.\n\nAl analizar las letras después, descubrimos que las antiguas letras son en realidad pistas inteligentemente codificadas de una posible misión.

Rule.Original: The {0} were amazing! We can still hear the mesmerizing words of the cap'n, as they reminded us of the importance of our shared camaraderie. We can even feel our sadness vanish away.\n\nAnalyzing the lyrics afterwards, we found that the ancient words are actually cleverly encoded clues to a possible quest!
Rule.Raw: The {0} were amazing! We can still hear the mesmerizing words of the cap'n, as they reminded us of the importance of our shared camaraderie. We can even feel our sadness vanish away.\n\nAnalyzing the lyrics afterwards, we found that the ancient words are actually cleverly encoded clues to a possible quest!
Rule.Translated: {0} fue increíble. Todavía podemos escuchar las palabras cautivadoras del capitán, que nos recordaron la importancia de nuestra camaradería compartida. Incluso podemos sentir cómo nuestra tristeza se desvanece.\n\nAl analizar las letras después, descubrimos que las antiguas letras son en realidad pistas inteligentemente codificadas de una posible misión.

Rule.Original: A downscaled variant of a swarmer missile turret mounted on a rifle frame, warbolter fires semi-precise missiles over medium range with the fire rate of a machine gun. Due to the very large recoil caused by the missiles leaving the barrel, it can only be fired in short bursts.\n\nThe weapon also comes equipped with a bioferrite-powered long-burner unit which generates a very narrow blast of flame from a pressurized bioferrite charge. Due to the tight stream of the long-burner, it can be fired over very long distances. The long-burner unit must be refueled after each use.
Rule.Raw: A downscaled variant of a swarmer missile turret mounted on a rifle frame, warbolter fires semi-precise missiles over medium range with the fire rate of a machine gun. Due to the very large recoil caused by the missiles leaving the barrel, it can only be fired in short bursts.\n\nThe weapon also comes equipped with a bioferrite-powered long-burner unit which generates a very narrow blast of flame from a pressurized bioferrite charge. Due to the tight stream of the long-burner, it can be fired over very long distances. The long-burner unit must be refueled after each use.
Rule.Translated: Variante reducida de una torreta de misiles múltiples montada sobre un chasis de rifle, el warbolter dispara misiles semi-precisos a media distancia con la cadencia de una ametralladora. Debido al fuerte retroceso causado por los misiles al salir del cañón, solo puede dispararse en ráfagas cortas.\n\nEl arma también está equipada con un quemador de bioferrita que genera un chorro de llamas muy fino a partir de una carga incendiaria de bioferrita presurizada. Gracias al fino chorro del quemador, el disparo puede llegar a distancias muy largas. El quemador debe recargarse después de cada uso.

Rule.Original: Fire a short-ranged flame blast over a short but wide area.
Rule.Raw: Fire a short-ranged flame blast over a short but wide area.
Rule.Translated: Dispara un chorro de llamas de largo alcance pero en una pequeña área.

lanzagranadas de gas lacrimógeno para exotraje

Rule.Original: An upscaled version of the Tear Gas Grenade Launcher designed for use by a Warcasket. A straight upgrade, it fires 2 rounds and benefits from more powerful propellant for better range. In order to improve gas dispersal and not have two gas clouds overlap, the weapon was made even less accurate in order to try and spread out the supporting fire.
Rule.Raw: An upscaled version of the Tear Gas Grenade Launcher designed for use by a Warcasket. A straight upgrade, it fires 2 rounds and benefits from more powerful propellant for better range. In order to improve gas dispersal and not have two gas clouds overlap, the weapon was made even less accurate in order to try and spread out the supporting fire.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada del lanzagranadas de gas lacrimógeno diseñada para ser utilizada con un exotraje. Mejora directa, dispara 2 proyectiles y se beneficia de un propulsor de gas más potente para un mayor alcance. Para mejorar la dispersión del gas y evitar que dos nubes de gas se superpongan, el arma se ha vuelto aún menos precisa para intentar repartir los disparos de apoyo.

adicción a las pociones de maná

Rule.Original: A chemical addiction to mana potion. Long-term presence of mana potion has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of mana potion, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Raw: A chemical addiction to mana potion. Long-term presence of mana potion has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of mana potion, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Rule.Translated: Una adicción química a las pociones de maná. La exposición prolongada a estas pociones ha provocado adaptaciones neurológicas a nivel celular, por lo que el cerebro ya no puede funcionar correctamente sin la sustancia. \nSin dosis regulares de poción de maná aparecerán síntomas de abstinencia. Sin embargo, una abstinencia prolongada obligará al cerebro a readaptarse a su estado normal y acabará resolviendo la adicción.

Rule.Original: Because of a mana potion addiction, this person needs to regularly consume mana potion to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Raw: Because of a mana potion addiction, this person needs to regularly consume mana potion to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
Rule.Translated: Debido a una adicción a las pociones de maná, esta persona necesita consumirlas regularmente para evitar los síntomas de abstinencia.
tolerancia a las pociones de maná

Rule.Original: A built-up tolerance to mana potion. The more severe this tolerance is, the more mana potion it takes to get the same effect.
Rule.Raw: A built-up tolerance to mana potion. The more severe this tolerance is, the more mana potion it takes to get the same effect.
Rule.Translated: Tolerancia acumulada a las pociones de maná. Cuanto mayor sea la tolerancia, más poción de maná será necesaria para conseguir el mismo efecto.

Rule.Original: Improved Arcane Load Dispersal rate gained by imbibing a Lesser Mana Potion.
Rule.Raw: Improved Arcane Load Dispersal rate gained by imbibing a Lesser Mana Potion.
Rule.Translated: Velocidad mejorada de dispersión de carga arcana obtenida al beber una poción inferior de maná.

Rule.Original: Improved Arcane Load Dispersal rate gained by imbibing a Minor Mana Potion.
Rule.Raw: Improved Arcane Load Dispersal rate gained by imbibing a Minor Mana Potion.
Rule.Translated: Velocidad mejorada de dispersión de carga arcana obtenida al beber una poción menor de maná.

Rule.Original: The Aether Bloom is a mesmerizing and radiant flower, celebrated for its luminous beauty and potent magical essence. This extraordinary plant features large, luminescent petals that emit a gentle, azure glow, reminiscent of the vibrant blue hue of a mana potion. The petals are a striking blue, with intricate patterns that seem to pulse with magical energy.
Rule.Raw: The Aether Bloom is a mesmerizing and radiant flower, celebrated for its luminous beauty and potent magical essence. This extraordinary plant features large, luminescent petals that emit a gentle, azure glow, reminiscent of the vibrant blue hue of a mana potion. The petals are a striking blue, with intricate patterns that seem to pulse with magical energy.
Rule.Translated: La flor de éter es una planta fascinante y radiante, apreciada por su belleza luminosa y su potente esencia mágica. Esta extraordinaria flor posee grandes pétalos luminiscentes que emiten un suave resplandor azulado, similar al intenso tono azul de una poción de maná. Sus pétalos presentan intrincados patrones que parecen palpitar con energía mágica.

Rule.Original: Unprocessed petals of the Aether Bloom plant.
Rule.Raw: Unprocessed petals of the Aether Bloom plant.
Rule.Translated: Pétalos sin procesar de la flor de éter.

Rule.Original: A concentrated mixture of aether essence extracted by grinding raw aether bloom. Used in the crafting of mana potions.
Rule.Raw: A concentrated mixture of aether essence extracted by grinding raw aether bloom. Used in the crafting of mana potions.
Rule.Translated: Una mezcla concentrada de esencia de éter extraída al moler flor de éter en bruto. Se utiliza para fabricar pociones de maná.

Rule.Original: Ancient tribesfolk concocted an elixir that replenishes a modest amount of mana and significantly amplifies the arcane load dispersal for those who imbibe it. However, there is a slight risk that individuals may fall under its addictive spell.
Rule.Raw: Ancient tribesfolk concocted an elixir that replenishes a modest amount of mana and significantly amplifies the arcane load dispersal for those who imbibe it. However, there is a slight risk that individuals may fall under its addictive spell.
Rule.Translated: Los antiguos pueblos tribales elaboraron un elixir que repone una cantidad modesta de maná y aumenta considerablemente la dispersión de carga arcana de quien lo bebe. Sin embargo, existe un pequeño riesgo de desarrollar adicción.

Rule.Original: Esteemed alchemists of the noble houses have concocted a potion that replenishes a moderate amount of mana and significantly amplifies the arcane load dispersal for those who partake. However, there is a slight risk that individuals may become ensnared by its addictive properties.
Rule.Raw: Esteemed alchemists of the noble houses have concocted a potion that replenishes a moderate amount of mana and significantly amplifies the arcane load dispersal for those who partake. However, there is a slight risk that individuals may become ensnared by its addictive properties.
Rule.Translated: Los prestigiosos alquimistas de las casas nobles han elaborado una poción que repone una cantidad moderada de maná y aumenta considerablemente la dispersión de carga arcana de quien la consume. Sin embargo, existe un pequeño riesgo de desarrollar adicción.

Rule.Original: A vial containing a Tribal Lesser Mana Elixir that restores a small amount of mana, and doubles the speed of arcane load dispersal. Infused with the essence of the Aether Bloom, it has a vibrant blue hue.
Rule.Raw: A vial containing a Tribal Lesser Mana Elixir that restores a small amount of mana, and doubles the speed of arcane load dispersal. Infused with the essence of the Aether Bloom, it has a vibrant blue hue.
Rule.Translated: Un vial que contiene un elixir tribal inferior de maná que restaura una pequeña cantidad de maná y duplica la velocidad de dispersión de carga arcana. Infundido con esencia de flor de éter, presenta un intenso tono azul.
Fabricar poción inferior de maná x5

Rule.Original: Quaffing that Minor Mana Elixir filled me with such euphoria, I already crave another. I pray I don’t succumb to its enchanting allure.
Rule.Raw: Quaffing that Minor Mana Elixir filled me with such euphoria, I already crave another. I pray I don’t succumb to its enchanting allure.
Rule.Translated: Beber aquel elixir menor de maná me llenó de tal euforia que ya deseo otro. Espero no sucumbir a su encantador atractivo.

Rule.Original: A holy shrine covered in candles, capable of storing a relic within the safety of a silver box. In holding such a sacred symbol, the reliquary itself becomes consecrated,demanding worship from its faithful congregation.Relics are ancient objects venerated by some cultures, belief systems, or religions.
Rule.Raw: A holy shrine covered in candles, capable of storing a relic within the safety of a silver box. In holding such a sacred symbol, the reliquary itself becomes consecrated,demanding worship from its faithful congregation.Relics are ancient objects venerated by some cultures, belief systems, or religions.
Rule.Translated: Un santuario sagrado cubierto de velas, capaz de guardar una reliquia dentro de la seguridad de una caja plateada. Al sostener un símbolo tan sagrado, el relicario mismo se consagra y exige adoración por parte de su fiel congregación. Las reliquias son objetos antiguos venerados por algunas culturas, sistemas de creencias o religiones.

In holding such a sacred symbol, the reliquary itself becomes consecrated,demanding worship from its faithful congregation.Relics are ancient objects venerated by some cultures, belief systems, or religions.

Las reliquias son objetos antiguos venerados por algunas culturas, sistemas de creencias o religiones.
