Al sostener un símbolo tan sagrado, el relicario mismo se consagra y exige adoración por parte de su fiel congregación. Las reliquias son objetos antiguos venerados por algunas culturas, sistemas de creencias o religiones.

Rule.Original: Detonates the mechanoid, instantly destroying it and damaging those nearby, friend or foe.
Rule.Raw: Detonates the mechanoid, instantly destroying it and damaging those nearby, friend or foe.
Rule.Translated: Detona el meca, destruyéndolo instantáneamente y dañando a los que estén cerca, sean amigos o enemigos.

Rule.Original: Resurrect a recently-killed mechanoid by externally supercharging its self-repair processes. The mechanoid will come back with some but not all of its wounds healed. This ability is slower than the one used by the Apocriton, but doesn't have charges.
Rule.Raw: Resurrect a recently-killed mechanoid by externally supercharging its self-repair processes. The mechanoid will come back with some but not all of its wounds healed. This ability is slower than the one used by the Apocriton, but doesn't have charges.
Rule.Translated: Resucita un meca recientemente destruido sobrecargando externamente sus procesos de autorreparación. El meca volverá con algunas, pero no todas, sus heridas curadas. Esta habilidad es más lenta que la utilizada por el Apocriton.

Rule.Original: Jump to a distant location using special ultrafast mechanoid muscles.
Rule.Raw: Jump to a distant location using special ultrafast mechanoid muscles.
Rule.Translated: Salta a una ubicación distante usando músculos ultrarrápidos especiales del meca.

Rule.Original: Swaps between a mini needle gun and a mortar.
Rule.Raw: Swaps between a mini needle gun and a mortar.
Rule.Translated: Intercambia entre una mini pistola de agujas y un mortero.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} is equipped with an incredibly dangerous orbital strike targetter. It is very slow to charge, but once fired it will blanket a huge area in explosions.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} is equipped with an incredibly dangerous orbital strike targetter. It is very slow to charge, but once fired it will blanket a huge area in explosions.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} está equipado con un objetivo de ataque orbital increíblemente peligroso. Su carga es muy lenta, pero una vez disparado, cubrirá una gran área con explosiones.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} is equipped with a long range slug sniper turret, and will constantly summon Guttersnipes, dangerous close combat mechanoids that will rip anything to shreds.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} is equipped with a long range slug sniper turret, and will constantly summon Guttersnipes, dangerous close combat mechanoids that will rip anything to shreds.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} está equipado con una torreta francotiradora de proyectiles de largo alcance, y constantemente invocará a los Guttersnipes, mechanoides peligrosos de combate cuerpo a cuerpo que destrozarán todo a su paso.

Rule.Original: The {LEADERKIND_label} is malice incarnate. A towering mechanoid commander armed with both acid and soul draining weapons, it will resurrect mechanoids surrounding it and plunge your colony into despair.
Rule.Raw: The {LEADERKIND_label} is malice incarnate. A towering mechanoid commander armed with both acid and soul draining weapons, it will resurrect mechanoids surrounding it and plunge your colony into despair.
Rule.Translated: El {LEADERKIND_label} es la maldad personificada. Un imponente comandante mecanoide armado con armas que drenan ácido y alma, resucitará a los mecanoides que lo rodean y sumirá tu colonia en la desesperación.

Rule.Original: Such a deep hatred, I can feel it in my bones. I'm gonna be sick.
Rule.Raw: Such a deep hatred, I can feel it in my bones. I'm gonna be sick.
Rule.Translated: Un odio tan profundo, lo siento hasta en los huesos. Me va a dar asco.
nodo de ancho de banda emisor de haces (sintonizado)

Rule.Original: This mechanitor's bandwidth is being increased by 2 per node thanks to the influence of a beamcaster band node structure.
Rule.Raw: This mechanitor's bandwidth is being increased by 2 per node thanks to the influence of a beamcaster band node structure.
Rule.Translated: La banda ancha de este mecanitor está siendo aumentada en 2 por nodo gracias a la influencia de una estructura de nodo de banda de lanzador de rayos.
nodo de ancho de banda de enlace de vacío (sintonizado)

Rule.Original: This mechanitor's bandwidth is being increased by 5 per node thanks to the influence of a voidlink band node structure.
Rule.Raw: This mechanitor's bandwidth is being increased by 5 per node thanks to the influence of a voidlink band node structure.
Rule.Translated: La banda ancha de este mecanitor está siendo aumentada en 5 por nodo gracias a la influencia de una estructura de nodo de banda de enlace vacío.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid's capacities have been boosted by a nearby persistent mech booster building. This condition will stay on the mechanoid for two hours after leaving the range of the mech booster building, but it will be overwritten if the mech enters the range of a standard mech booster.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid's capacities have been boosted by a nearby persistent mech booster building. This condition will stay on the mechanoid for two hours after leaving the range of the mech booster building, but it will be overwritten if the mech enters the range of a standard mech booster.
Rule.Translated: Las capacidades de este mecañoide han sido potenciadas por un edificio cercano de potenciador persistente de mecas. Esta condición permanecerá en el mecañoide durante dos horas después de salir del alcance del edificio potenciador persistente, pero será reemplazada si el mecañoide entra en el alcance de un potenciador estándar.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid's energy efficiency has been improved by a nearby mechanoid efficiency booster building.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid's energy efficiency has been improved by a nearby mechanoid efficiency booster building.
Rule.Translated: La eficiencia energética de este mecañoide ha sido mejorada por un edificio cercano de potenciador de eficiencia de mecañoides.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid's armor has been reinforced by a nearby mechanoid protection booster building.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid's armor has been reinforced by a nearby mechanoid protection booster building.
Rule.Translated: La armadura de este mecanoide ha sido reforzada por un edificio cercano de potenciador de protección mecanoide.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid's targeting has been enhanced by a nearby mechanoid targeting booster building.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid's targeting has been enhanced by a nearby mechanoid targeting booster building.
Rule.Translated: La puntería de este mecañoide ha sido mejorada por un edificio cercano de potenciador de puntería para mecañoides.

Rule.Original: This mechanoid's targeting, speed and agility are being dirupted by a nearby mechanoid disruptor building.
Rule.Raw: This mechanoid's targeting, speed and agility are being dirupted by a nearby mechanoid disruptor building.
Rule.Translated: La puntería, velocidad y agilidad de este mecañoide están siendo interrumpidas por un edificio cercano de disruptor de mecañoides.
Gestar un mecañoide gusano de fuego
Gestar un mecañoide Emperatriz de guerra

Rule.Original: Light specialized worker mechs that can do work types from other mods, as well as light attack mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: Light specialized worker mechs that can do work types from other mods, as well as light attack mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Mecas alfa ligeros especializados que pueden realizar tipos de trabajo de otros mods, además de funcionar como mecañoides de ataque ligero.

Rule.Original: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control standard-tier alpha mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control standard-tier alpha mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: La tecnología necesaria para que tu mecanitor cree y controle mecañoides alfa de nivel estándar.

Rule.Original: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control high-tier alpha mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control high-tier alpha mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: La tecnología necesaria para que tu mecanitor cree y controle mecañoides alfa de alto nivel.

Rule.Original: The advanced technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control ultra-tier alpha mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: The advanced technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control ultra-tier alpha mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: La tecnología avanzada necesaria para que tu mecanitor cree y controle mecañoides alfa de nivel ultra.

Rule.Original: Research technology that harnesses advanced energy manipulation techniques to create focused and directed energy beams that can be transmitted across vast distances, and enable the summoning of the formidable Infernus mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: Research technology that harnesses advanced energy manipulation techniques to create focused and directed energy beams that can be transmitted across vast distances, and enable the summoning of the formidable Infernus mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Tecnología de investigación que aprovecha técnicas avanzadas de manipulación energética para crear rayos de energía focalizados y dirigidos, capaces de transmitirse a grandes distancias, y que permiten la invocación del formidable mecañoide Infernus.

Rule.Original: A communication method that operates on a framework of relay stations positioned across the system. These relay stations, known as "voidlinks," use subspace communication technology to transmit messages at near-light speed, allowing for rapid communication across sub-stellar distances. Enables the summoning of the War Empress mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: A communication method that operates on a framework of relay stations positioned across the system. These relay stations, known as "voidlinks," use subspace communication technology to transmit messages at near-light speed, allowing for rapid communication across sub-stellar distances. Enables the summoning of the War Empress mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Un método de comunicación que funciona mediante una red de estaciones repetidoras distribuidas por todo el sistema. Estas estaciones, conocidas como "voidlinks" (enlaces vacíos), utilizan tecnología de comunicación por subespacio para transmitir mensajes a velocidades cercanas a la de la luz, permitiendo una comunicación rápida a través de distancias subestelares. Permite la invocación del mecañoide Emperatriz de Guerra.

Rule.Original: A cutting-edge communication system that leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to transmit information using more than just binary states of 0s and 1s. The use of these qubits allows for the transmission of complex data, instructions, or commands in a highly efficient and secure manner. Enables the summoning of the Apoptosis mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: A cutting-edge communication system that leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to transmit information using more than just binary states of 0s and 1s. The use of these qubits allows for the transmission of complex data, instructions, or commands in a highly efficient and secure manner. Enables the summoning of the Apoptosis mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema de comunicación de vanguardia que aprovecha los principios de la mecánica cuántica para transmitir información usando más que solo estados binarios de 0 y 1. El uso de estos qubits permite la transmisión de datos complejos, instrucciones o comandos de manera altamente eficiente y segura. Permite la invocación del mecañoide Apoptosis.

Rule.Original: A technology that involves the use of advanced cryptographic algorithms to achieve perfect synchronization and coordination between multiple mechanoid units or systems. It allows for seamless communication, information exchange, and coordination.
Rule.Raw: A technology that involves the use of advanced cryptographic algorithms to achieve perfect synchronization and coordination between multiple mechanoid units or systems. It allows for seamless communication, information exchange, and coordination.
Rule.Translated: Una tecnología que implica el uso de algoritmos criptográficos avanzados para lograr una sincronización y coordinación perfectas entre múltiples unidades o sistemas mecañoides. Permite una comunicación fluida, intercambio de información y coordinación eficiente.
emisor de haces de ancho de banda de mecas (nivel 4)

Rule.Original: A mechband signaling device more powerful than the mechband dish. When activated, it puts out a powerful mech signal pulse, which will attract an Infernus mechanoid to attack with its escorts. If you can defeat it, you can collect special technologies from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the beamcaster, so this building can only be used once.
Rule.Raw: A mechband signaling device more powerful than the mechband dish. When activated, it puts out a powerful mech signal pulse, which will attract an Infernus mechanoid to attack with its escorts. If you can defeat it, you can collect special technologies from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the beamcaster, so this building can only be used once.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de señalización mechband más potente que la antena mechband. Al activarse, emite un potente pulso de señal mecánica que atraerá a un mecanoide Infernus para que ataque junto con sus escoltas. Si logras derrotarlo, podrás recolectar tecnologías especiales de su cadáver. El pulso de señal quema el beamcaster, por lo que este edificio solo puede usarse una vez.

Rule.Original: A mechband signaling device that connects to a framework of relay stations positioned across the system. These relay stations, known as "voidlinks," use subspace communication technology to transmit messages at near-light speed, allowing for rapid communication across sub-stellar distances. Activating it which will attract a War Empress mechanoid to attack with its escorts. If you can defeat it, you can collect special technologies from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the relay, so this building can only be used once.
Rule.Raw: A mechband signaling device that connects to a framework of relay stations positioned across the system. These relay stations, known as "voidlinks," use subspace communication technology to transmit messages at near-light speed, allowing for rapid communication across sub-stellar distances. Activating it which will attract a War Empress mechanoid to attack with its escorts. If you can defeat it, you can collect special technologies from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the relay, so this building can only be used once.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de señalización mechband que se conecta a una red de estaciones repetidoras distribuidas por todo el sistema. Estas estaciones repetidoras, conocidas como “voidlinks”, utilizan tecnología de comunicación por subespacio para transmitir mensajes a velocidad cercana a la de la luz, permitiendo una comunicación rápida a través de distancias subestelares. Al activarlo, atraerá a un mecanoide Emperatriz de Guerra para que ataque junto con sus escoltas. Si logras derrotarlo, podrás recolectar tecnologías especiales de su cadáver. El pulso de señal quema el repetidor, por lo que este edificio solo puede usarse una vez.

Rule.Original: A mechband signaling device that leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to transmit information using more than just binary states of 0s and 1s. The use of these qubits allows for the transmission of complex data, instructions, or commands in a highly efficient and secure manner. Activating it which will attract an Apoptosis mechanoid to attack with its escorts. If you can defeat it, you can collect special technologies from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the complex, so this building can only be used once.
Rule.Raw: A mechband signaling device that leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to transmit information using more than just binary states of 0s and 1s. The use of these qubits allows for the transmission of complex data, instructions, or commands in a highly efficient and secure manner. Activating it which will attract an Apoptosis mechanoid to attack with its escorts. If you can defeat it, you can collect special technologies from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the complex, so this building can only be used once.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de señalización mechband que utiliza los principios de la mecánica cuántica para transmitir información usando más que solo estados binarios de 0 y 1. El uso de estos qubits permite la transmisión de datos, instrucciones o comandos complejos de manera muy eficiente y segura. Al activarlo, atraerá a un mecanoide Apoptosis para que ataque junto con sus escoltas. Si logras derrotarlo, podrás recolectar tecnologías especiales de su cadáver. El pulso de señal quema el complejo, por lo que este edificio solo puede usarse una vez.
nodo de ancho de banda emisor de haces

Rule.Original: A mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Band nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor. This will add 2 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids.\n\nOnce a band node is constructed, it can be quickly tuned to a mechanitor. However, retuning a band node to a different mechanitor takes significantly longer.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Band nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor. This will add 2 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids.\n\nOnce a band node is constructed, it can be quickly tuned to a mechanitor. However, retuning a band node to a different mechanitor takes significantly longer.
Rule.Translated: Un amplificador de señal de banda mecanoide. Los nodos de banda deben sintonizarse a un mecanitor específico. Esto añadirá 2 de ancho de banda al total de ese mecanitor, permitiéndole controlar más mecanoides. Una vez que un nodo de banda está construido, puede sintonizarse rápidamente a un mecanitor. Sin embargo, volver a sintonizar un nodo de banda para otro mecanitor toma mucho más tiempo.
nodo de ancho de banda de enlace de vacío

Rule.Original: A voidlink relay band node. Band nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor. This will add 5 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids.\n\nOnce a band node is constructed, it can be quickly tuned to a mechanitor. However, retuning a band node to a different mechanitor takes significantly longer.
Rule.Raw: A voidlink relay band node. Band nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor. This will add 5 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids.\n\nOnce a band node is constructed, it can be quickly tuned to a mechanitor. However, retuning a band node to a different mechanitor takes significantly longer.
Rule.Translated: Un nodo de banda repetidor voidlink. Los nodos de banda deben sintonizarse a un mecanitor específico. Esto añadirá 5 de ancho de banda al total de ese mecanitor, permitiéndole controlar más mecanoides. Una vez que un nodo de banda está construido, puede sintonizarse rápidamente a un mecanitor. Sin embargo, volver a sintonizar un nodo de banda para otro mecanitor toma mucho más tiempo.

Rule.Original: A remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster. This boost will be overwritten if the mech enters the range of a standard mech booster. The effect of the persistent mech booster will remain on the mech up to 3 hours after leaving its area of effect.
Rule.Raw: A remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster. This boost will be overwritten if the mech enters the range of a standard mech booster. The effect of the persistent mech booster will remain on the mech up to 3 hours after leaving its area of effect.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo remoto de mejora energética y computacional. Cualquier mecanoide aliado dentro de su radio de efecto se moverá y trabajará más rápido. Este impulso será reemplazado si el mecha entra en el rango de un potenciador mecánico estándar. El efecto del potenciador mecánico persistente permanecerá en el mecha hasta 3 horas después de salir de su área de influencia.

Rule.Original: A remote energy efficiency enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will use less energy per day.
Rule.Raw: A remote energy efficiency enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will use less energy per day.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo remoto de mejora de eficiencia energética. Cualquier mecanoide aliado dentro de su radio de efecto consumirá menos energía por día.

Rule.Original: A remote armor reinforcement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will have greater protection against attacks.
Rule.Raw: A remote armor reinforcement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will have greater protection against attacks.
Rule.Translated: 一Un dispositivo remoto de refuerzo de armadura. Cualquier mecanoide aliado dentro de su radio de efecto tendrá mayor protección contra ataques.

Rule.Original: A remote targeting enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced weapon cooldown.
Rule.Raw: A remote targeting enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced weapon cooldown.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo remoto de mejora de puntería. Cualquier mecanoide aliado dentro de su radio de efecto tendrá una reducción en el tiempo de recarga de sus armas.

Rule.Original: A remote mech disruption device. Any enemy mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced agility, movement and targeting skill.
Rule.Raw: A remote mech disruption device. Any enemy mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced agility, movement and targeting skill.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo remoto de interferencia mecánica. Cualquier mecanoide enemigo dentro de su radio de efecto tendrá reducida su agilidad, movimiento y habilidad de puntería.
recargador de mecas por enlace de vacío

Rule.Original: A large mech recharger that acts as a relay for the mechanoid voidlink network orbiting this planet's Sun. This network downloads necessary data to properly recharge ultra-complex mechanoids such as the Infernus, Apoptosis, War Empress or Starfire. It can also recharge Ultra Heavy mechs. During recharge, this recharger produces toxic wastepacks and stores them internally. Haulers must remove the wastepacks from time to time.
Rule.Raw: A large mech recharger that acts as a relay for the mechanoid voidlink network orbiting this planet's Sun. This network downloads necessary data to properly recharge ultra-complex mechanoids such as the Infernus, Apoptosis, War Empress or Starfire. It can also recharge Ultra Heavy mechs. During recharge, this recharger produces toxic wastepacks and stores them internally. Haulers must remove the wastepacks from time to time.
Rule.Translated: Un gran recargador de mechs que funciona como un repetidor para la red voidlink de mecanoides que orbita alrededor del Sol de este planeta. Esta red descarga los datos necesarios para recargar correctamente mecanoides ultra complejos como el Infernus, Apoptosis, War Empress o Starfire. También puede recargar mechs Ultra Pesados. Durante la recarga, este recargador produce paquetes de desechos tóxicos y los almacena internamente. Los transportadores deben retirar estos paquetes de desechos de vez en cuando.

Rule.Original: A beamcasting-band synchronization micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the Infernus.
Rule.Raw: A beamcasting-band synchronization micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the Infernus.
Rule.Translated: Un micro-organismo de sincronización de banda de emisión de rayos. Es necesario para producir ciertos tipos avanzados de mecanoides y equipamiento. Un mecanitor puede estudiar este chip para ayudar a desbloquear niveles superiores de investigación mechtech. Soltado por el Infernus.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original: A voidlink-focusing mechanoid micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the War Empress.
Rule.Raw: A voidlink-focusing mechanoid micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the War Empress.
Rule.Translated: Un micro-organismo mecanoide enfocado en voidlink. Es necesario para producir ciertos tipos avanzados de mecanoides y equipamiento. Un mecanitor puede estudiar este chip para ayudar a desbloquear niveles superiores de investigación mechtech. Soltado por la emperatriz de guerra.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original: A quantum-restructing mechanoid micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the Apoptosis.
Rule.Raw: A quantum-restructing mechanoid micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the Apoptosis.
Rule.Translated: Un micro-organismo mecanoide de reestructuración cuántica. Es necesario para producir ciertos mecanoides y equipamientos avanzados. Un mecanitor puede estudiar este chip para ayudar a desbloquear niveles superiores de investigación mechtech. Soltado por Apoptosis.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original: A heavy power armor helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mech master helmet drastically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, while being as protective as a marine helmet.
Rule.Raw: A heavy power armor helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mech master helmet drastically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, while being as protective as a marine helmet.
Rule.Translated: Un casco pesado de armadura motorizada equipado con dispositivos de asistencia para mecanitores. El casco maestro mecánico amplifica drásticamente el ancho de banda del mecanitor, mientras ofrece una protección equivalente a la de un casco de infantería naval.

Rule.Original: A modified siegebreaker helmet designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.
Rule.Raw: A modified siegebreaker helmet designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.
Rule.Translated: Un casco modificado de rompeasedios diseñado para mejorar aún más las habilidades de un mecanitor.

Rule.Original: A mechanite enhanced projectile-repulsion device. The user can shoot out, but the shield will block shots coming in. This shield only protects the user, not those around them. It does nothing against melee attacks or heat. The shield will break instantly if hit by EMP. This shield seems to be bigger and stronger than usual.
Rule.Raw: A mechanite enhanced projectile-repulsion device. The user can shoot out, but the shield will block shots coming in. This shield only protects the user, not those around them. It does nothing against melee attacks or heat. The shield will break instantly if hit by EMP. This shield seems to be bigger and stronger than usual.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de repulsión de proyectiles mejorado con mecanita. El usuario puede disparar hacia afuera, pero el escudo bloqueará los disparos entrantes. Este escudo solo protege al usuario, no a quienes están a su alrededor. No ofrece protección contra ataques cuerpo a cuerpo ni calor. El escudo se romperá instantáneamente si es golpeado por un pulso electromagnético (EMP). Este escudo parece ser más grande y fuerte de lo habitual.

Rule.Original: A backpack containing a beamcaster antenna to more adequately reach all controlled mechanoids. It can greatly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Rule.Raw: A backpack containing a beamcaster antenna to more adequately reach all controlled mechanoids. It can greatly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila que contiene una antena lanzadora de rayos para alcanzar de manera más eficiente a todos los mecanoides controlados. Puede aumentar considerablemente el ancho de banda total máximo de un mecanitor.

Rule.Original: A backpack containing a voidlink relay to access the vast amounts of data present on this system's mechanoid voidlink network. It can vastly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Rule.Raw: A backpack containing a voidlink relay to access the vast amounts of data present on this system's mechanoid voidlink network. It can vastly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila que contiene un enlace voidlink para acceder a la gran cantidad de datos presentes en la red voidlink de mecanoides de este sistema. Puede aumentar enormemente el ancho de banda total máximo de un mecanitor.

Rule.Original: A backpack containing an array of mechanoid encryption decoders. It allows a mechanitor to control an additional control group, whilst also vastly increasing a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Rule.Raw: A backpack containing an array of mechanoid encryption decoders. It allows a mechanitor to control an additional control group, whilst also vastly increasing a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Rule.Translated: Una mochila que contiene un conjunto de decodificadores de cifrado de mecanoides. Permite a un mecanitor controlar un grupo adicional de control, además de aumentar enormemente el ancho de banda total máximo del mecanitor.

Rule.Original: A power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. Greatly amplifies the abilities of a mechanitor, while also being slightly stronger than a suit of marine armor.
Rule.Raw: A power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. Greatly amplifies the abilities of a mechanitor, while also being slightly stronger than a suit of marine armor.
Rule.Translated: Un traje de armadura potenciada equipado con dispositivos de asistencia para mecanitores. Amplifica enormemente las habilidades de un mecanitor, además de ser ligeramente más resistente que un traje de armadura naval.

Rule.Original: A modified suit of siegebreaker armor designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.
Rule.Raw: A modified suit of siegebreaker armor designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.
Rule.Translated: Un traje modificado de armadura rompeasedios diseñado para mejorar aún más las habilidades de un mecanitor.

Rule.Original: A targetting beam that will select a certain position in the ground for a strike from an orbital missile platform. Very, very slow to select its targets, but with a significant area of effect.
Rule.Raw: A targetting beam that will select a certain position in the ground for a strike from an orbital missile platform. Very, very slow to select its targets, but with a significant area of effect.
Rule.Translated: Un rayo de puntería que selecciona una posición específica en el terreno para un ataque desde una plataforma de misiles orbitales. Muy, muy lento para elegir sus objetivos, pero con un área de efecto significativa.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid lance that electromagnetically accelerates piercing metal shards to enormous speeds.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid lance that electromagnetically accelerates piercing metal shards to enormous speeds.
Rule.Translated: Una lanza mecanoide que acelera electromagnéticamente fragmentos metálicos perforantes a velocidades enormes.

Rule.Original: A meaner, stronger version of the charge blaster. Fires more burst shots that are slightly more damaging.
Rule.Raw: A meaner, stronger version of the charge blaster. Fires more burst shots that are slightly more damaging.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más agresiva y potente del bláster de carga. Dispara más ráfagas que causan un poco más de daño.

Rule.Original: A devastating weapon designed to unleash a torrent of acidic sludge upon its targets. Equipped with advanced chemical reservoirs and spraying mechanisms, it is capable of spraying a wide area with a potent acid that can dissolve even the most durable materials.
Rule.Raw: A devastating weapon designed to unleash a torrent of acidic sludge upon its targets. Equipped with advanced chemical reservoirs and spraying mechanisms, it is capable of spraying a wide area with a potent acid that can dissolve even the most durable materials.
Rule.Translated: Un arma devastadora diseñada para lanzar una tormenta de lodo ácido sobre sus objetivos. Equipado con avanzados depósitos químicos y mecanismos de pulverización, es capaz de rociar un área amplia con un ácido potente que puede disolver incluso los materiales más resistentes.

Rule.Original: A heavy-duty energy weapon designed to unleash a searing beam of focused light upon its targets that can slice through even the toughest armor.
Rule.Raw: A heavy-duty energy weapon designed to unleash a searing beam of focused light upon its targets that can slice through even the toughest armor.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de energía pesada diseñada para liberar un rayo concentrado de luz abrasadora sobre sus objetivos, capaz de cortar incluso la armadura más resistente.

Rule.Original: A gigantic flamethrower mounted on top of a siegebreaker chassis. Its fire reaches incredibly high temperatures.
Rule.Raw: A gigantic flamethrower mounted on top of a siegebreaker chassis. Its fire reaches incredibly high temperatures.
Rule.Translated: Un gigantesco lanzallamas montado sobre un chasis de rompeasedios. Su fuego alcanza temperaturas increíblemente altas.

Rule.Original: A fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.
Rule.Raw: A fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.
Rule.Translated: Un temible arma de energía diseñada para desatar una cascada de energía electromagnética sobre sus objetivos. Capaz de generar una descarga de EMP que puede aturdir y desactivar mecanoides con un solo disparo. Al mismo tiempo, libera un rayo abrasador de energía eléctrica que puede quemar objetivos orgánicos, dejándolos humeantes y vulnerables.

Rule.Original: A gigantic cannon mounted on top of a siegebreaker chassis. It fires a slow moving unstable singularity that will destroy anything it touches upon impact.
Rule.Raw: A gigantic cannon mounted on top of a siegebreaker chassis. It fires a slow moving unstable singularity that will destroy anything it touches upon impact.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón gigantesco montado sobre un chasis rompeasedios. Dispara una singularidad inestable de movimiento lento que destruye todo lo que toca al impactar.

Rule.Original: A short-range rapid-firing shotgun designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: A short-range rapid-firing shotgun designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Una escopeta de fuego rápido y corto alcance diseñada para ser montada en un mecanoide ligero de combate.

Rule.Original: A gamma ray laser weapon that uses a high-energy beam to annihilate targets at extreme distances. Its sweeping beam can penetrate even the toughest armor, and its incredible power output makes it capable of vaporizing entire squads of soldiers in seconds.
Rule.Raw: A gamma ray laser weapon that uses a high-energy beam to annihilate targets at extreme distances. Its sweeping beam can penetrate even the toughest armor, and its incredible power output makes it capable of vaporizing entire squads of soldiers in seconds.
Rule.Translated: Un arma láser de rayos gamma que utiliza un rayo de alta energía para aniquilar objetivos a distancias extremas. Su haz barrido puede penetrar incluso la armadura más resistente, y su increíble potencia le permite vaporizar escuadrones enteros de soldados en segundos.
{0} ha sido abatido por un rayo.

Rule.Original: A versatile weapon that can fire a continuous stream of needle-like projectiles. Its rotating barrel allows for sustained fire, making it effective against swarms of enemies. Although it lacks the pinpoint accuracy of its single-shot counterpart, the rotary needle gun more than compensates with its high rate of fire and capacity for suppressing large areas.
Rule.Raw: A versatile weapon that can fire a continuous stream of needle-like projectiles. Its rotating barrel allows for sustained fire, making it effective against swarms of enemies. Although it lacks the pinpoint accuracy of its single-shot counterpart, the rotary needle gun more than compensates with its high rate of fire and capacity for suppressing large areas.
Rule.Translated: Un arma versátil que puede disparar un flujo continuo de proyectiles en forma de aguja. Su cañón giratorio permite fuego sostenido, haciéndola efectiva contra enjambres de enemigos. Aunque carece de la precisión puntual de su contraparte de disparo único, la pistola aguja rotativa compensa con su alta cadencia de fuego y su capacidad para suprimir grandes áreas.

Rule.Original: A long-range weapon used by artillerons. Shoots with great accuracy over very long distances, but does very little damage.
Rule.Raw: A long-range weapon used by artillerons. Shoots with great accuracy over very long distances, but does very little damage.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de largo alcance usada por artillerons. Dispara con gran precisión a distancias muy largas, pero causa muy poco daño.

Rule.Original: A small mech mounted mortar that fires explosive canisters.
Rule.Raw: A small mech mounted mortar that fires explosive canisters.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño mortero montado en un mecanoide que dispara proyectiles explosivos.

Rule.Original:
Malice incarnate, the Apoptosis is an advanced Apocriton that acts as a commander designed to coordinate and motivate other mechs during long extermination campaigns. They are less adept at resurrecting other mechanoids than Apocritons, but the aura of hate they emanate is so powerful and intense that it will cause uncontrollable despair on those too close to it.

The Apoptosis is armed with two dangerous ranged weapons: an acid spewer that can melt the flesh out of the bone, and a psychically charged energy pulse that can damage the very soul of its target.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> The Apoptosis is a stronger version of the Apocriton, and should be treated as such. Its hatred aura will make everyone nearby scream in despair. It will unleash two devastating ranged attacks against defenders, as well as resurrect nearby mechanoids, although not as often as an Apocriton would.
Rule.Raw:
Malice incarnate, the Apoptosis is an advanced Apocriton that acts as a commander designed to coordinate and motivate other mechs during long extermination campaigns. They are less adept at resurrecting other mechanoids than Apocritons, but the aura of hate they emanate is so powerful and intense that it will cause uncontrollable despair on those too close to it.

The Apoptosis is armed with two dangerous ranged weapons: an acid spewer that can melt the flesh out of the bone, and a psychically charged energy pulse that can damage the very soul of its target.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> The Apoptosis is a stronger version of the Apocriton, and should be treated as such. Its hatred aura will make everyone nearby scream in despair. It will unleash two devastating ranged attacks against defenders, as well as resurrect nearby mechanoids, although not as often as an Apocriton would.
Rule.Translated: Encarnación de la malicia, el Apoptosis es un Apocriton avanzado que actúa como comandante, diseñado para coordinar y motivar a otros mechs durante largas campañas de exterminio. Son menos hábiles para resucitar a otros mecanoides que los Apocritons, pero el aura de odio que emanan es tan poderosa e intensa que provoca una desesperación incontrolable en quienes se acercan demasiado. El Apoptosis está armado con dos peligrosas armas a distancia: un lanzador de ácido capaz de disolver la carne hasta el hueso, y un pulso de energía cargado psíquicamente que puede dañar el alma misma de su objetivo. Efecto en el juego: El Apoptosis es una versión más poderosa del Apocriton y debe ser tratado como tal. Su aura de odio hará que todos los cercanos griten de desesperación. Desatará dos devastadores ataques a distancia contra los defensores, además de resucitar mecanoides cercanos, aunque no con tanta frecuencia como un Apocriton.

Rule.Original: A terrifying weapon designed to drain the souls of its targets. Equipped with soul-draining technology, it is capable of siphoning the life force of organic beings, leaving them weakened and vulnerable.
Rule.Raw: A terrifying weapon designed to drain the souls of its targets. Equipped with soul-draining technology, it is capable of siphoning the life force of organic beings, leaving them weakened and vulnerable.
Rule.Translated: Un arma aterradora diseñada para drenar las almas de sus objetivos. Equipado con tecnología de absorción de almas, es capaz de succionar la fuerza vital de los seres orgánicos, dejándolos debilitados y vulnerables.

Rule.Original: An advanced combat mechanoid designed to excel in high-risk combat situations. With a height of around 5 feet, it is armed with a rapid-firing tactical mechanoid shotgun. Unlike its predecessor, the Militor, the Bellicor is highly durable and has the ability to withstand intense battles. It is often deployed in the front lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives. Due to its advanced capabilities, the Bellicor is more expensive to produce and maintain, but is still highly valued by those who seek to dominate the battlefield.
Rule.Raw: An advanced combat mechanoid designed to excel in high-risk combat situations. With a height of around 5 feet, it is armed with a rapid-firing tactical mechanoid shotgun. Unlike its predecessor, the Militor, the Bellicor is highly durable and has the ability to withstand intense battles. It is often deployed in the front lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives. Due to its advanced capabilities, the Bellicor is more expensive to produce and maintain, but is still highly valued by those who seek to dominate the battlefield.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide de combate avanzado diseñado para destacar en situaciones de alto riesgo. Con una altura de alrededor de 1.5 metros, está armado con una escopeta táctica de disparo rápido para mecanoides. A diferencia de su predecesor, el Militor, el Bellicor es muy resistente y tiene la capacidad de soportar combates intensos. Suele desplegarse en las líneas frontales para eliminar objetivos prioritarios y asegurar objetivos estratégicos. Debido a sus capacidades avanzadas, el Bellicor es más caro de producir y mantener, pero sigue siendo muy valorado por quienes buscan dominar el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: A variation of the militor and bellicor, the artilleron stands at a height of around 5 feet and it is armed with a powerful mortar that fires explosive canisters with great accuracy. With its reduced durability, the Artilleron can't withstand intense battles and is often deployed in the rear lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives from afar. It can also swap weapons between its mortar and a low damage, high accuracy micro needle gun to avoid causing friendly fire with its explosives.
Rule.Raw: A variation of the militor and bellicor, the artilleron stands at a height of around 5 feet and it is armed with a powerful mortar that fires explosive canisters with great accuracy. With its reduced durability, the Artilleron can't withstand intense battles and is often deployed in the rear lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives from afar. It can also swap weapons between its mortar and a low damage, high accuracy micro needle gun to avoid causing friendly fire with its explosives.
Rule.Translated: Una variante del militor y bellicor, el Artilleron mide alrededor de 1.5 metros de altura y está armado con un potente mortero que dispara proyectiles explosivos con gran precisión. Debido a su durabilidad reducida, el Artilleron no puede soportar combates intensos y suele desplegarse en las líneas traseras para eliminar objetivos prioritarios y asegurar objetivos estratégicos desde lejos. También puede cambiar entre su mortero y una microaguja de bajo daño y alta precisión para evitar causar fuego amigo con sus explosivos.

Rule.Original: The Blietzkrieg is a unique mechanoid designed for tactical warfare and area denial. Shaped like a sleek and menacing metallic mine, it is capable of self-propelling itself to the intended target location before detonating in a devastating explosion. However, its indiscriminate detonation makes it a double-edged sword, and careful coordination is required to ensure that it does not harm friendly forces.
Rule.Raw: The Blietzkrieg is a unique mechanoid designed for tactical warfare and area denial. Shaped like a sleek and menacing metallic mine, it is capable of self-propelling itself to the intended target location before detonating in a devastating explosion. However, its indiscriminate detonation makes it a double-edged sword, and careful coordination is required to ensure that it does not harm friendly forces.
Rule.Translated: El Blietzkrieg es un mecanoide único diseñado para la guerra táctica y la negación de áreas. Con forma de una mina metálica elegante y amenazante, es capaz de impulsarse por sí mismo hacia la ubicación objetivo antes de detonar en una explosión devastadora. Sin embargo, su detonación indiscriminada lo convierte en un arma de doble filo, por lo que se requiere una coordinación cuidadosa para evitar que dañe a las fuerzas aliadas.

Rule.Original: A small, deployable combat mechanoid usually manufactured inside an ultra-heavy war empress mech. Contrary to War urchins, the Guttersnipe is a melee fighter, using its wicked circular saws to lunge at their targets. They have a non-rechargeable power source.
Rule.Raw: A small, deployable combat mechanoid usually manufactured inside an ultra-heavy war empress mech. Contrary to War urchins, the Guttersnipe is a melee fighter, using its wicked circular saws to lunge at their targets. They have a non-rechargeable power source.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño mecanoide de combate desplegable, usualmente fabricado dentro de un mech ultra pesado War Empress. A diferencia de los War Urchins, el Guttersnipe es un luchador cuerpo a cuerpo, usando sus afiladas sierras circulares para lanzarse sobre sus objetivos. Cuenta con una fuente de energía no recargable.

Rule.Original: An ultra-heavy mechanoid with an incredibly dangerous orbital strike targeter. The targeter won't cause any damage on its own, but a devastating orbital strike will be launched a few seconds after it finishes focusing on a target. This attack takes a long time to charge, and it has a large minimum range. The Infernus accumulates heat constantly due to its enormous size, and it can release it to ignite flammable objects nearby.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Seriously, don't let this thing fire...
Rule.Raw: An ultra-heavy mechanoid with an incredibly dangerous orbital strike targeter. The targeter won't cause any damage on its own, but a devastating orbital strike will be launched a few seconds after it finishes focusing on a target. This attack takes a long time to charge, and it has a large minimum range. The Infernus accumulates heat constantly due to its enormous size, and it can release it to ignite flammable objects nearby.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Seriously, don't let this thing fire...
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide ultra pesado con un designador de ataque orbital increíblemente peligroso. El designador no causa daño por sí mismo, pero tras unos segundos de enfocar un objetivo, se lanzará un devastador ataque orbital. Este ataque tarda mucho en cargarse y tiene un rango mínimo bastante grande. El Infernus acumula calor constantemente debido a su enorme tamaño, y puede liberarlo para prender objetos inflamables cercanos. Efecto en el juego: En serio, no dejes que esta cosa dispare.

Rule.Original: An ultraheavy mech with a built-in advanced shield bubble generator. The Legate lacks the point-defense bulb turret present in Centurions, but in exchange it is armed with a super heavy charge blaster that is much more dangerous than standard ones.
Rule.Raw: An ultraheavy mech with a built-in advanced shield bubble generator. The Legate lacks the point-defense bulb turret present in Centurions, but in exchange it is armed with a super heavy charge blaster that is much more dangerous than standard ones.
Rule.Translated: Un mech ultra pesado con un generador avanzado de burbujas de escudo incorporado. El Legate carece de la torreta bulb de defensa puntual presente en los Centurions, pero a cambio está armado con un cañón de carga super pesado que es mucho más peligroso que los estándar.

Rule.Original: The Lux is a sleek and agile humanoid mechanoid designed for fast-paced combat operations. Equipped with a powerful heavy laser weapon, it is capable of dealing devastating damage to both ground and air targets with pinpoint accuracy. The Lux's agility comes at the cost of durability, and it must rely on its speed and evasion to survive on the battlefield.
Rule.Raw: The Lux is a sleek and agile humanoid mechanoid designed for fast-paced combat operations. Equipped with a powerful heavy laser weapon, it is capable of dealing devastating damage to both ground and air targets with pinpoint accuracy. The Lux's agility comes at the cost of durability, and it must rely on its speed and evasion to survive on the battlefield.
Rule.Translated: El Lux es un mecanoide humanoide ágil y estilizado, diseñado para operaciones de combate rápido. Equipado con un poderoso arma láser pesada, es capaz de infligir un daño devastador tanto a objetivos terrestres como aéreos con precisión milimétrica. La agilidad del Lux va a costa de su durabilidad, por lo que debe confiar en su velocidad y evasión para sobrevivir en el campo de batalla.

Rule.Original: Designed for culinary arts, the Culinarius can analyze ingredients and create delicious meals with exceptional precision and consistency. The Culinarius can access an extensive database of recipes, culinary techniques, and flavor profiles, allowing it to adapt and customize its cooking style to suit any cuisine or dietary requirement. Its sturdy metal frame and robust construction make it resistant to heat, moisture, and other common hazards in the kitchen. Much better at cooking than a fabricor, but very inefficient in combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Can do cooking tasks with a cooking skill of 15, as well as 150% work speed.
Rule.Raw: Designed for culinary arts, the Culinarius can analyze ingredients and create delicious meals with exceptional precision and consistency. The Culinarius can access an extensive database of recipes, culinary techniques, and flavor profiles, allowing it to adapt and customize its cooking style to suit any cuisine or dietary requirement. Its sturdy metal frame and robust construction make it resistant to heat, moisture, and other common hazards in the kitchen. Much better at cooking than a fabricor, but very inefficient in combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Can do cooking tasks with a cooking skill of 15, as well as 150% work speed.
Rule.Translated: Diseñado para las artes culinarias, el Culinarius puede analizar ingredientes y crear comidas deliciosas con una precisión y consistencia excepcionales. El Culinarius tiene acceso a una extensa base de datos de recetas, técnicas culinarias y perfiles de sabor, lo que le permite adaptar y personalizar su estilo de cocina para cualquier tipo de gastronomía o requerimiento dietético. Su estructura metálica resistente y construcción robusta lo hacen resistente al calor, la humedad y otros peligros comunes en la cocina. Mucho mejor cocinando que un fabricor, pero muy ineficiente en combate.

Rule.Original: The Munifex are formidable human-sized combat mechanoids designed specifically for long-range combat scenarios. They are equipped with advanced coil lances, which are mass driver weapons that fire electromagnetically accelerated slugs at incredible velocities. These projectiles are capable of penetrating through almost any kind of defense, including thick armor plating and reinforced concrete.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Yes, this is the friendly fire mech. Yes, this is very much intended. Beware!
Rule.Raw: The Munifex are formidable human-sized combat mechanoids designed specifically for long-range combat scenarios. They are equipped with advanced coil lances, which are mass driver weapons that fire electromagnetically accelerated slugs at incredible velocities. These projectiles are capable of penetrating through almost any kind of defense, including thick armor plating and reinforced concrete.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Yes, this is the friendly fire mech. Yes, this is very much intended. Beware!
Rule.Translated: Los Munifex son formidables mecanoides de combate tamaño humano diseñados específicamente para escenarios de combate a larga distancia. Están equipados con lanzas de bobina avanzadas, que son armas de impulsor de masa que disparan proyectiles acelerados electromagnéticamente a velocidades increíbles. Estos proyectiles son capaces de penetrar casi cualquier tipo de defensa, incluyendo blindajes gruesos y concreto reforzado. Efecto en el juego: Sí, este es el mecanoide que causa fuego amigo. Sí, esto está muy intencionado. ¡Cuidado!.

Rule.Original: An elite combat support mechanoid that employs a rotary needle launcher. Its armor is reinforced to withstand heavy firepower, and it can project a formidable energy shield to protect nearby allies. The Optio is a valuable asset on the battlefield, able to quickly adapt to changing situations and provide crucial support to other mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: An elite combat support mechanoid that employs a rotary needle launcher. Its armor is reinforced to withstand heavy firepower, and it can project a formidable energy shield to protect nearby allies. The Optio is a valuable asset on the battlefield, able to quickly adapt to changing situations and provide crucial support to other mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide de apoyo de combate élite que utiliza un lanzador rotatorio de agujas. Su armadura está reforzada para soportar un fuego pesado, y puede proyectar un formidable escudo de energía para proteger a los aliados cercanos. El Optio es un recurso valioso en el campo de batalla, capaz de adaptarse rápidamente a situaciones cambiantes y brindar apoyo crucial a otros mecanoides.

Rule.Original: A heavy combat mechanoid with a graser cannon that can deal massive damage to armored targets. Though it lacks agility, its graser cannon is capable of firing focused energy beams that can cut through most shielding and leave enemies defenseless.
Rule.Raw: A heavy combat mechanoid with a graser cannon that can deal massive damage to armored targets. Though it lacks agility, its graser cannon is capable of firing focused energy beams that can cut through most shielding and leave enemies defenseless.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanoide de combate pesado con un cañón graser capaz de infligir un daño masivo a objetivos blindados. Aunque carece de agilidad, su cañón graser puede disparar rayos de energía concentrada que atraviesan la mayoría de los escudos y dejan a los enemigos indefensos.

Rule.Original: An automated, mobile mechanoid factory. The assembler is designed for efficient energy-to-matter conversion. Using its advanced molecular assembly system, it can convert various forms of energy into usable materials with remarkable precision. This particular assembler doesn't need to consume organic matter to aid in the conversion, being compatible with standard mech rechargers.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> At random, the Assembler will produce 10: Steel, Gold, Uranium, Plasteel, Silver, Go-Juice, Flake, Yayo, Chocolate, Synthread, Cloth, Jade, Devilstrand cloth, Muffalo wool, Heavy leather, Explosive shells, Industrial medicine, Neutroamine, Chemfuel or Components every 24 hours.
Rule.Raw: An automated, mobile mechanoid factory. The assembler is designed for efficient energy-to-matter conversion. Using its advanced molecular assembly system, it can convert various forms of energy into usable materials with remarkable precision. This particular assembler doesn't need to consume organic matter to aid in the conversion, being compatible with standard mech rechargers.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> At random, the Assembler will produce 10: Steel, Gold, Uranium, Plasteel, Silver, Go-Juice, Flake, Yayo, Chocolate, Synthread, Cloth, Jade, Devilstrand cloth, Muffalo wool, Heavy leather, Explosive shells, Industrial medicine, Neutroamine, Chemfuel or Components every 24 hours.
Rule.Translated: Una fábrica mecanoide automatizada y móvil. El ensamblador está diseñado para una conversión eficiente de energía a materia. Usando su avanzado sistema de ensamblaje molecular, puede convertir diversas formas de energía en materiales utilizables con notable precisión. Este ensamblador en particular no necesita consumir materia orgánica para ayudar en la conversión, siendo compatible con recargadores mecanoides estándar.

Rule.Original: Although rare, mechanoids have been known to capture prisoners, and the Slurrypede is their solution to feed them in the most efficient way possible. The Slurrypede is a modified bio-mechanoid capable of extracting energy from standard mech rechargers and use it to process inorganic matter into a homogeneous organic slurry. This slurry is edible for carnivore and omnivore animals, but barely, and completely indigestible for herbivores.
Rule.Raw: Although rare, mechanoids have been known to capture prisoners, and the Slurrypede is their solution to feed them in the most efficient way possible. The Slurrypede is a modified bio-mechanoid capable of extracting energy from standard mech rechargers and use it to process inorganic matter into a homogeneous organic slurry. This slurry is edible for carnivore and omnivore animals, but barely, and completely indigestible for herbivores.
Rule.Translated: Aunque es raro, se sabe que los mecanoides capturan prisioneros, y el Slurrypede es su solución para alimentarlos de la manera más eficiente posible. El Slurrypede es un bio-mecanoide modificado capaz de extraer energía de recargadores mecanoides estándar y usarla para procesar materia inorgánica en una papilla orgánica homogénea. Esta papilla es comestible para animales carnívoros y omnívoros, aunque apenas, y completamente indigerible para herbívoros.

Rule.Original: A more advanced, mechanite-grown version of the autostrider, the pristine strider has a large carrying capacity, making it perfect as a partner on long caravan trips. Can also be ridden by pawns to increase travel speed.
Rule.Raw: A more advanced, mechanite-grown version of the autostrider, the pristine strider has a large carrying capacity, making it perfect as a partner on long caravan trips. Can also be ridden by pawns to increase travel speed.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más avanzada, cultivada con mecanitas, del autostrider, el pristine strider tiene una gran capacidad de carga, lo que lo hace perfecto como compañero en largos viajes de caravanas. También puede ser montado por colonos para aumentar la velocidad de viaje.

Rule.Original: The siegemelter is a variant of the siegebreaker armed with a powerful flamethrower. Their movement is incredibly slow, but their siegemelter turret has a considerable range, so they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.
Rule.Raw: The siegemelter is a variant of the siegebreaker armed with a powerful flamethrower. Their movement is incredibly slow, but their siegemelter turret has a considerable range, so they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.
Rule.Translated: El fundidor de asedio es una variante del rompedor de asedio, armado con un potente lanzallamas. Su movimiento es increíblemente lento y el lanzallamas tiene un alcance bastante bajo, pero deberían ser considerados objetivos prioritarios en la mayoría de los casos.

Rule.Original: The Starfire mechanoid is a massive tank-like machine, equipped with a powerful cannon that fires very slow-moving unstable singularities. These singularities are generated by a complex fusion reactor at the heart of the machine, which channels and amplifies energy from nearby stars via microscopic skipgates. When fired, the singularities unleash devastating amounts of energy, capable of obliterating entire structures in a single blast, as well as creating secondary energy discharges that arc to nearby targets. The Starfire is heavily armored and equipped with advanced targeting systems, allowing it to rain destruction from afar. However, due to the intense energy requirements of the singularities, the Starfire is only deployed in the most extreme situations, where its destructive power is needed to turn the tide of battle.
Rule.Raw: The Starfire mechanoid is a massive tank-like machine, equipped with a powerful cannon that fires very slow-moving unstable singularities. These singularities are generated by a complex fusion reactor at the heart of the machine, which channels and amplifies energy from nearby stars via microscopic skipgates. When fired, the singularities unleash devastating amounts of energy, capable of obliterating entire structures in a single blast, as well as creating secondary energy discharges that arc to nearby targets. The Starfire is heavily armored and equipped with advanced targeting systems, allowing it to rain destruction from afar. However, due to the intense energy requirements of the singularities, the Starfire is only deployed in the most extreme situations, where its destructive power is needed to turn the tide of battle.
Rule.Translated: El mecanoide Starfire es una máquina masiva con forma de tanque, equipada con un poderoso cañón que dispara singularidades inestables y muy lentas. Estas singularidades son generadas por un complejo reactor de fusión en el corazón de la máquina, que canaliza y amplifica la energía de estrellas cercanas mediante microrrutas de salto (skipgates). Al ser disparadas, las singularidades liberan cantidades devastadoras de energía, capaces de destruir estructuras enteras con una sola explosión. El Starfire está fuertemente blindado y equipado con sistemas avanzados de puntería, lo que le permite descargar destrucción desde lejos. Sin embargo, debido a los intensos requerimientos energéticos de las singularidades, el Starfire solo se despliega en las situaciones más extremas, donde su poder destructivo es necesario para cambiar el curso de la batalla.

Rule.Original: Basically a cleansweeper mounted on two small gyro-stabilized turbine engines. The turbocleaner hovers over terrain, using a vacuum nozzle to suction dirt and other debris. Absurdly useless in combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Hovers over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs.
Rule.Raw: Basically a cleansweeper mounted on two small gyro-stabilized turbine engines. The turbocleaner hovers over terrain, using a vacuum nozzle to suction dirt and other debris. Absurdly useless in combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Hovers over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs.
Rule.Translated: Básicamente, un Turbolimpiador montado sobre dos pequeños motores de turbina giroscópicos estabilizados. El Turbolimpiador se desplaza flotando sobre el terreno, usando una boquilla de vacío para succionar tierra y otros desechos. Absurdamente inútil en combate. Efecto en el juego: Flota sobre el terreno, ignorando los costos de movimiento por terreno.

Rule.Original: An ultra-heavy mech with a built-in mech gestator. Fed with appropriate resources, the War empress can form swarms of small melee-adept guttersnipe combat mechs within its massive carapace and deploy them into combat. The Empress is armed with a very dangerous and long ranged slug sniper turret that should be avoided at all costs, but the greatest threat comes from her sharp rending claws, which she uses to viciously lash at her targets.
Rule.Raw: An ultra-heavy mech with a built-in mech gestator. Rule.Translated: Un mech ultra pesado con un gestador mecanoide incorporado. Alimentada con los recursos adecuados, la emperatriz de guerra puede formar enjambres de pequeños mecanoides de combate cuerpo a cuerpo llamados Guttersnipes dentro de su enorme caparazón y desplegarlos en combate. La emperatriz de guerra está armada con una torreta francotiradora de proyectiles muy peligrosa y de largo alcance que debe evitarse a toda costa, pero la mayor amenaza proviene de sus afiladas garras desgarradoras, que usa para atacar ferozmente a sus objetivos.

Rule.Original: A powerful, long-range defense mechanism designed to take out enemy targets from a distance. Fires depleted uranium slugs at extreme velocities, capable of piercing even the toughest armor.
Rule.Raw: A powerful, long-range defense mechanism designed to take out enemy targets from a distance. Fires depleted uranium slugs at extreme velocities, capable of piercing even the toughest armor.
Rule.Translated: Un mecanismo de defensa poderoso y de largo alcance diseñado para eliminar objetivos enemigos desde la distancia. Dispara proyectiles de uranio empobrecido a velocidades extremas, capaces de perforar incluso la armadura más resistente.

Rule.Original: A sturdy wooden crane that is used to help lift off large boulders and minerals from underground. Increases work speed when placed near a mine shaft.

Rule.Original: A heavily reinforced door. It is slow to open and requires electricity, but is very strong. It's a good choice if you want to keep something dangerous out - or in. The door requires walls on either side to function.

Rule.Original: A weaker airtight wall that prevents oxygen leaks in the vacuum of space. The wall connects directly into the underlying substructure, meaning it can only be built on a gravship.
Rule.Raw: A weaker airtight wall that prevents oxygen leaks in the vacuum of space. The wall connects directly into the underlying substructure, meaning it can only be built on a gravship.
Rule.Translated: Una versión más débil del casco convencional que previene fugas de oxígeno en el vacío del espacio. La pared se conecta directamente a la subestructura subyacente, lo que significa que solo puede construirse en una gravinave.

Rule.Original: An airtight wall embedded with pressure-resistant viewing windows. Designed for safe stargazing, this hall integrates directly into the gravship’s structural framework. Can only be constructed on a gravship.
Rule.Raw: An airtight wall embedded with pressure-resistant viewing windows. Designed for safe stargazing, this hall integrates directly into the gravship’s structural framework. Can only be constructed on a gravship.
Rule.Translated: Una pared fuerte y hermética que previene fugas de oxígeno en el vacío del espacio. La pared se conecta directamente a la subestructura subyacente, lo que significa que solo puede construirse en una gravinave.

Rule.Original: A massive glass facade offers an uninterrupted view of space. Built as part of the gravship’s substructure, this airtight hall combines structural integrity with breathtaking visibility. Only constructible on a gravship.
Rule.Raw: A massive glass facade offers an uninterrupted view of space. Built as part of the gravship’s substructure, this airtight hall combines structural integrity with breathtaking visibility. Only constructible on a gravship.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme ventanal que ofrece una vista completa del espacio exterior. Esta estructura hermética, que solo puede construirse sobre la subestructura de una gravinave, combina la integridad estructural con una visibilidad impresionante.

Rule.Original: An air-conditioning machine that fits into a floor tile. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts.
Rule.Raw: An air-conditioning machine that fits into a floor tile. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de aire acondicionado que puede integrarse en una celda de suelo. Emite aire frío o caliente en la misma dirección, dependiendo de la temperatura actual de la habitación. A menos que se desvincule de los ajustes de la red, intentará alcanzar la temperatura especificada en la unidad de control de climatización. Debe conectarse a la unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire.
