Rule.Original: A rich, crimson liquid crafted from concentrated hemogen packs. When the user drinks it, it enhances all traits and abilities tied to their hemogenic nature, boosting physical and mental capacities. Additionally, this draught replenishes the user's hemogen supply over time, maintaining their vitality and enhancing their overall function.
Rule.Raw: A rich, crimson liquid crafted from concentrated hemogen packs. When the user drinks it, it enhances all traits and abilities tied to their hemogenic nature, boosting physical and mental capacities. Additionally, this draught replenishes the user's hemogen supply over time, maintaining their vitality and enhancing their overall function.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido concentrado de color carmesí elaborado a partir de paquetes de hemógeno. Cuando se consume, potencia todas las características y habilidades relacionadas con la naturaleza hemogénica, y aumenta las capacidades físicas y mentales. Además, este brebaje repone el suministro de hemógeno del usuario con el tiempo, manteniendo su vitalidad y mejorando su funcionamiento general.

Rule.Original: A large, tightly packed fire pit capable of holding high amounts of wood at once. Provides hefty warmth and light to thronerooms and halls alike and acts as a gathering spot for idle colonists.
Rule.Raw: A large, tightly packed fire pit capable of holding high amounts of wood at once. Provides hefty warmth and light to thronerooms and halls alike and acts as a gathering spot for idle colonists.
Rule.Translated: Una hoguera grande y compacta capaz de albergar grandes cantidades de leña. Proporciona calor y luz a los salones del trono y demás tipos de salas, y actúa como punto de reunión para los colonos ociosos.

Rule.Original: Luxurious, carefully stitched matting made from leather strips. Beautiful to look at, but cleaning it is a labor-intensive process.
Rule.Raw: Luxurious, carefully stitched matting made from leather strips. Beautiful to look at, but cleaning it is a labor-intensive process.
Rule.Translated: Una estera lujosa, hecha cuidadosamente a partir de tiras de cuero entrelazadas. Es muy hermosa a la vista, pero es muy difícil de limpiar.

Rule.Original: Luxurious leather matting that has been burned in a fire.
Rule.Raw: Luxurious leather matting that has been burned in a fire.
Rule.Translated: Una esterilla de cuero lujosa que se ha quemado en un incendio.

Rule.Original: A light blue liquid that’s sparkling with a subtle effervescence. When the user drinks it, it restores some of their psychic focus and enhances their psychic sensitivity, allowing for clearer mental processing and heightened awareness. However, this increased mental activity significantly raises the user's hunger rate, making them need to eat more often. Additionally, the relentless mental buzz from the draught leads to a noticeable drop in mood due to the overwhelming flow of thoughts.
Rule.Raw: A light blue liquid that’s sparkling with a subtle effervescence. When the user drinks it, it restores some of their psychic focus and enhances their psychic sensitivity, allowing for clearer mental processing and heightened awareness. However, this increased mental activity significantly raises the user's hunger rate, making them need to eat more often. Additionally, the relentless mental buzz from the draught leads to a noticeable drop in mood due to the overwhelming flow of thoughts.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido azul claro que brilla con una sutil efervescencia. Cuando se consume, restaura parte del foco psíquico a la vez que aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica, lo que permite un procesamiento mental más claro y un mayor nivel de conciencia. Sin embargo, este aumento de la actividad mental eleva significativamente el nivel de hambre del consumidor, lo que le obliga a comer con más frecuencia. Además, el incesante zumbido mental que provocan los efectos de este brebaje conduce a una notable caída del estado de humor, debido al abrumador flujo de pensamientos.

Rule.Original: A shimmering golden liquid. When the user drinks it, it significantly improves their immunity gain speed, enhancing their body's natural defenses against diseases and infections. Additionally, this draught boosts the user's consciousness and movement speed, sharpening their mental alertness and enhancing their physical agility. Upon consumption, it also lowers the progress of any ongoing infections by 5%.
Rule.Raw: A shimmering golden liquid. When the user drinks it, it significantly improves their immunity gain speed, enhancing their body's natural defenses against diseases and infections. Additionally, this draught boosts the user's consciousness and movement speed, sharpening their mental alertness and enhancing their physical agility. Upon consumption, it also lowers the progress of any ongoing infections by 5%.
Rule.Translated: Un líquido dorado que centellea cuando la luz incide sobre él. Cuando es consumido, aumenta significativamente la velocidad de ganancia de inmunidad, mejorando las defensas naturales de su cuerpo contra enfermedades e infecciones. Además, este brebaje aumenta la velocidad de movimiento y el nivel de conciencia del usuario, agudizando su agilidad mental y mejorando su destreza física. Tras su consumo, también reduce el progreso de cualquier infección en curso en un 5 %.

Rule.Original: A sharp-tasting wheel of cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling animal milk. It makes for both a tasty treat on its own, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
Rule.Raw: A sharp-tasting wheel of cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling animal milk. It makes for both a tasty treat on its own, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda de queso de sabor fuerte, creada mediante un proceso especial de cuajado intencional de leche animal. Sirve tanto como delicia por sí solo como ingrediente versátil en comidas.

Rule.Original: A sharp-tasting wheel of soft cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling goldilox milk. Its golden rind and soft core which melts in the mouth it is a cheese fit for kings, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
Rule.Raw: A sharp-tasting wheel of soft cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling goldilox milk. Its golden rind and soft core which melts in the mouth it is a cheese fit for kings, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
Rule.Translated: Una rueda de queso blando de sabor fuerte, creada mediante un proceso especial de cuajado intencional de leche de vellocino áureo. Su corteza dorada y núcleo blando que se derrite en la boca lo convierten en un queso digno de reyes, además de un ingrediente versátil en comidas.

Rule.Original: I had the unfortunate experience of eating awful-quality goldfort cheese. The core was dry and the taste was less than satisfying.
Rule.Raw: I had the unfortunate experience of eating awful-quality goldfort cheese. The core was dry and the taste was less than satisfying.
Rule.Translated: Tuve la desfortunada experiencia de comer queso dorado de calidad horrible. El núcleo estaba seco y el sabor era menos que satisfactorio.

Rule.Original: I ate some poor-quality goldfort cheese. The crust hadn't properly formed yet and the core was barely melting.
Rule.Raw: I ate some poor-quality goldfort cheese. The crust hadn't properly formed yet and the core was barely melting.
Rule.Translated: Comí un poco de queso dorado de baja calidad. La corteza aún no se había formado correctamente y el núcleo apenas se derretía.

Rule.Original: I ate some average goldfort cheese.
Rule.Raw: I ate some average goldfort cheese.
Rule.Translated: Comí un poco de queso dorado corriente.

Rule.Original: I ate good-quality goldfort cheese. The texture is perfect as it melts in your mouth, leaving but an exquisite taste behind.
Rule.Raw: I ate good-quality goldfort cheese. The texture is perfect as it melts in your mouth, leaving but an exquisite taste behind.
Rule.Translated: Comí queso dorado de buena calidad. La textura es perfecta al derretirse en la boca, dejando solo un sabor exquisito.

Rule.Original: I savoured excellent-quality goldfort cheese. A heavenly taste overtook me and I cannot wait to eat more of it.
Rule.Raw: I savoured excellent-quality goldfort cheese. A heavenly taste overtook me and I cannot wait to eat more of it.
Rule.Translated: Saboreé queso dorado de calidad excelente. Un sabor celestial me embargó y no puedo esperar a comer más.

Rule.Original: I savoured a divinely melty goldfort cheese. It's delightfully elegant taste transports me to the skies and beyond.
Rule.Raw: I savoured a divinely melty goldfort cheese. It's delightfully elegant taste transports me to the skies and beyond.
Rule.Translated: Saboreé un queso dorado divinamente fundente. Su deliciosamente elegante sabor me transporta a los cielos y más allá.

Rule.Original: The divine taste overwhelms my very being as its soft core melts in my mouth. My perception of taste is forever changed.
Rule.Raw: The divine taste overwhelms my very being as its soft core melts in my mouth. My perception of taste is forever changed.
Rule.Translated: El sabor divino inunda todo mi ser mientras su suave núcleo se derrite en mi boca. Mi percepción del gusto ha cambiado para siempre.

Rule.Original: The larval stage of giant snaptoad. Their spongy flesh tastes of mud and little else, but is nevertheless considered a delicacy in some cultures.
Rule.Raw: The larval stage of giant snaptoad. Their spongy flesh tastes of mud and little else, but is nevertheless considered a delicacy in some cultures.
Rule.Translated: La etapa larvaria del sapo mordedor gigante. Su carne esponjosa sabe a barro y poco más, pero aun así se considera un manjar en algunas culturas.

Rule.Original: While reaching out for {PAWN_possessive} catch, {PAWN_nameDef} was bitten by a snapping tadpole!\n\nThe the fish was lost in the commotion.
Rule.Raw: While reaching out for {PAWN_possessive} catch, {PAWN_nameDef} was bitten by a snapping tadpole!\n\nThe the fish was lost in the commotion.
Rule.Translated: Al intentar recoger {PAWN_possessive} captura, ¡{PAWN_nameDef} fue mordido por un renacuajo mordedor!\n\nLa captura se perdió en el alboroto.

Rule.Original: Reeling in {PAWN_possessive} catch after a fierce battle with what {PAWN_pronoun} presumed to be a fish, {PAWN_nameDef} came face to face with a very angry giant snaptoad froglet!\n\nThe maddened animal turned manhunter and will try and hunt your colonists until it becomes exhausted.
Rule.Raw: Reeling in {PAWN_possessive} catch after a fierce battle with what {PAWN_pronoun} presumed to be a fish, {PAWN_nameDef} came face to face with a very angry giant snaptoad froglet!\n\nThe maddened animal turned manhunter and will try and hunt your colonists until it becomes exhausted.
Rule.Translated: Tras una feroz lucha con lo que {PAWN_pronoun} creía que era un pez, al recoger {PAWN_possessive} captura, ¡{PAWN_nameDef} se encontró cara a cara con un enfurecido sapo mordedor gigante!\n\nEl animal ha enloquecido e intentará cazar a tus colonos hasta quedar exhausto.

Rule.Original: Reeling in {PAWN_possessive} catch after a fierce battle with what {PAWN_pronoun} presumed to be a fish, {PAWN_nameDef} came face to face with a leviathan hatchling!
Rule.Raw: Reeling in {PAWN_possessive} catch after a fierce battle with what {PAWN_pronoun} presumed to be a fish, {PAWN_nameDef} came face to face with a leviathan hatchling!
Rule.Translated: Tras una feroz lucha con lo que {PAWN_pronoun} creía que era un pez, al recoger {PAWN_possessive} captura, ¡{PAWN_nameDef} se encontró cara a cara con una cría de leviatán!

Rule.Original: While fishing, {PAWN_pronoun} saw a large shadow beneath the surface. Suddenly it bursted out of the water, {PAWN_nameDef} came face to face with a giant leviathan crab !
Rule.Raw: While fishing, {PAWN_pronoun} saw a large shadow beneath the surface. Suddenly it bursted out of the water, {PAWN_nameDef} came face to face with a giant leviathan crab !
Rule.Translated: Mientras pescaba, {PAWN_pronoun} vio una gran sombra bajo la superficie. De repente, emergió del agua, ¡y {PAWN_nameDef} se encontró cara a cara con un cangrejo leviatán gigante!

Rule.Original: The larval stage of giant snaptoad. Their spongy flesh tastes of mud and little else, but is nevertheless considered a delicacy in some cultures.
Rule.Raw: The larval stage of giant snaptoad. Their spongy flesh tastes of mud and little else, but is nevertheless considered a delicacy in some cultures.
Rule.Translated: La etapa larvaria del sapo mordedor gigante. Su carne esponjosa sabe a barro y poco más, pero aun así se considera un manjar en algunas culturas.

Rule.Original: Scabbard holding a saber, stylish and comfortable personal defense carry.
Rule.Raw: Scabbard holding a saber, stylish and comfortable personal defense carry.
Rule.Translated: Una vaina para llevar un sable de forma elegante, cómoda y práctica como arma de defensa personal.

Rule.Original: A thick padded coat made of felt and lots of fabric layers, protects from cuts and bruises.
Rule.Raw: A thick padded coat made of felt and lots of fabric layers, protects from cuts and bruises.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo acolchado grueso hecho de fieltro y numerosas capas de tela que protege de cortes y golpes.

Rule.Original: An archer's bow and arrow quiver belt, ergonomic, fits many arrows.
Rule.Raw: An archer's bow and arrow quiver belt, ergonomic, fits many arrows.
Rule.Translated: Un cinturón con carcaj para arco y flechas, ergonómico y con capacidad para muchas flechas.

Rule.Original: A thick padded coat made of lots of fabric layers, protects from cuts and bruises.
Rule.Raw: A thick padded coat made of lots of fabric layers, protects from cuts and bruises.
Rule.Translated: Un abrigo acolchado grueso formado por numerosas capas de tela que protege de cortes y golpes.

Rule.Original: Articulated jaw and throat protection plate.
Rule.Raw: Articulated jaw and throat protection plate.
Rule.Translated: Placa articulada que protege la mandíbula y la garganta.

Rule.Original: An small metal shield, usually paired with a light sword. Too small to offer any meaningful protection from incoming projectiles, the buckler is instead designed to deflect and trap a foe's weaopon in close-quarters combat.
Rule.Raw: An small metal shield, usually paired with a light sword. Too small to offer any meaningful protection from incoming projectiles, the buckler is instead designed to deflect and trap a foe's weaopon in close-quarters combat.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño escudo metálico, normalmente combinado con una espada ligera. Es demasiado pequeño para ofrecer una protección significativa contra proyectiles, pero está diseñado para desviar y atrapar el arma del enemigo en combate cerrado.

Rule.Original: Simple shield that can block simple projectiles and hits with melee weapons.
Rule.Raw: Simple shield that can block simple projectiles and hits with melee weapons.
Rule.Translated: Un escudo sencillo capaz de bloquear proyectiles simples y golpes de armas cuerpo a cuerpo.
Cultivar (o desarrollar) un mecha de apicultura.

Rule.Original: The Apiarist is a small, bee-shaped machine designed specifically for beekeeping tasks. With its advanced sensors and programming, it can monitor hive health, collect honey, and perform other essential tasks with exceptional precision and efficiency. The Apiarist's compact size and winged design allow it to hover over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs and accessing hard-to-reach locations. While not designed for combat, its robust construction and ability to move swiftly and nimbly make it difficult to catch.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Special abilities:</color> Hovers over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs.
Rule.Raw: The Apiarist is a small, bee-shaped machine designed specifically for beekeeping tasks. With its advanced sensors and programming, it can monitor hive health, collect honey, and perform other essential tasks with exceptional precision and efficiency. The Apiarist's compact size and winged design allow it to hover over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs and accessing hard-to-reach locations. While not designed for combat, its robust construction and ability to move swiftly and nimbly make it difficult to catch.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Special abilities:</color> Hovers over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs.
Rule.Translated: Diseñado para criar y cuidar abejas, es un cuerpo mecánico ligero. Gracias a avanzados sensores y programación, la máquina de apicultura puede monitorear con gran precisión y eficiencia el estado de las colmenas, recolectar miel y realizar otras tareas necesarias. Su forma similar a la de una abeja les permite acceder fácilmente a lugares de difícil acceso. Aunque no están diseñadas para combate, es muy difícil detener estos cuerpos debido a su estructura robusta y alta movilidad. Efecto en el juego: La máquina de apicultura no recibe penalización de velocidad por el terreno.

Rule.Original: A synthetic mixture of protein, carbohydrates, and vitamins, amino acids and minerals. Everything the body needs, and absolutely disgusting. This paste is EVEN more disgusting than the paste produced by a nutrient paste dispenser, and people will just outright hate eating it. It was cheap, though!\n\nThis slurry is edible for carnivore and omnivore animals, but barely, and completely indigestible for herbivores.
Rule.Raw: A synthetic mixture of protein, carbohydrates, and vitamins, amino acids and minerals. Everything the body needs, and absolutely disgusting. This paste is EVEN more disgusting than the paste produced by a nutrient paste dispenser, and people will just outright hate eating it. It was cheap, though!\n\nThis slurry is edible for carnivore and omnivore animals, but barely, and completely indigestible for herbivores.
Rule.Translated: Una mezcla sintética compuesta por proteínas, carbohidratos, vitaminas, aminoácidos y minerales. Satisface todas las necesidades del cuerpo, pero sabe aún más repugnante que una pasta nutritiva común. ¡Sin embargo, es muy barata! Esta pasta nutritiva puede ser consumida por animales carnívoros y omnívoros, pero los herbívoros casi no pueden digerirla.
Casco del Señor Mecánico de la Armadura Sagrada

Rule.Original: A heavy plasteel-weave helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord helmet dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A heavy plasteel-weave helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord helmet dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Casco pesado de armadura sagrada de fibra de vidrio equipado con un dispositivo asistente para mecánicos. El casco del Señor Mecánico puede aumentar considerablemente el límite de ancho de banda del mecánico, aunque su capacidad de protección no es tan buena como la de un casco de armadura pesada especializado. Esta armadura sagrada, costosa y lujosa, generalmente está hecha para personas de alto rango. Los grabados con runas espirituales pueden mejorar la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: A heavy power armor helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mech master helmet drastically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, while being as protective as a marine helmet.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A heavy power armor helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mech master helmet drastically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, while being as protective as a marine helmet.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Casco motorizado pesado sagrado equipado con un dispositivo asistente para mecánicos. El casco sagrado del Dominador Mecánico puede aumentar el límite de ancho de banda del mecánico de manera extraordinaria y ofrece una protección comparable a la de un casco naval. Esta armadura sagrada, costosa y lujosa, generalmente está fabricada para personas de alto rango. Los grabados con runas espirituales pueden mejorar la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: A modified siegebreaker helmet designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A modified siegebreaker helmet designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Casco sagrado del asaltante, especialmente modificado, capaz de aumentar el límite de ancho de banda del mecánico de manera extraordinaria. Esta armadura sagrada, costosa y lujosa, generalmente está fabricada para personas de alto rango. Los grabados con runas espirituales pueden mejorar la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.
Armadura del Señor Mecánico de la Armadura Sagrada

Rule.Original: A power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

La armadura sagrada del Señor Mecánico puede aumentar considerablemente el límite de ancho de banda del mecánico, aunque su capacidad de protección no es tan buena como la de una armadura pesada especializada. Esta armadura sagrada, costosa y lujosa, generalmente está hecha para personas de alto rango. Los grabados con runas espirituales pueden mejorar la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: A power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. Greatly amplifies the abilities of a mechanitor, while also being slightly stronger than a suit of marine armor.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

Greatly amplifies the abilities of a mechanitor, while also being slightly stronger than a suit of marine armor.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Armadura motorizada pesada sagrada equipada con un dispositivo asistente para mecánicos. La armadura sagrada del Dominador Mecánico puede aumentar el límite de ancho de banda del mecánico de manera extraordinaria, y ofrece una protección ligeramente superior a la armadura naval. Esta armadura sagrada, costosa y lujosa, generalmente está fabricada para personas de alto rango. Los grabados con runas espirituales pueden mejorar la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.

Rule.Original: A modified suit of siegebreaker armor designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Raw: A modified suit of siegebreaker armor designed to improve the abilities of a mechanitor even further.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
Rule.Translated: Armadura sagrada del asaltante, especialmente modificada, capaz de aumentar el límite de ancho de banda del mecánico de manera extraordinaria. Esta armadura sagrada, costosa y lujosa, generalmente está fabricada para personas de alto rango. Los grabados con runas espirituales pueden mejorar la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario.
Cultivar (o desarrollar) mecha de núcleo de mantenimiento
Cultivar (o desarrollar) un mecha de núcleo de mantenimiento.

Rule.Original: A specialized Lifter mechanoid designed to transport fissile material inserting and extracting it into nuclear reactors. It is equipped with a secure containment unit to prevent any leaks or contamination during transportation. As it is less versatile than a Lifter, it is also quite faster moving.
Rule.Raw: A specialized Lifter mechanoid designed to transport fissile material inserting and extracting it into nuclear reactors. It is equipped with a secure containment unit to prevent any leaks or contamination during transportation. As it is less versatile than a Lifter, it is also quite faster moving.
Rule.Translated: Diseñado para transportar, cargar y remover combustible de fisión nuclear, es un manipulador especialmente mejorado. Este cuerpo mecánico ligero está equipado con un dispositivo de contención de seguridad, que puede evitar eficazmente posibles fugas nucleares o accidentes de contaminación durante la manipulación. Aunque su versatilidad no es tan alta como la de un manipulador estándar, posee una mayor velocidad de movimiento.
Cultivar (o desarrollar) un mecha de redacción.

Rule.Original: The Scriptomaton is a humanoid mechanoid designed for writing and maintaining libraries. It has a vast database of knowledge at its disposal and can quickly and efficiently categorize and organize new information as it becomes available. The Scriptomaton is equipped with advanced writing tools, including pens, pencils, and quills, as well as cutting-edge software that allows it to transcribe written text into digital formats. Its sleek, humanoid form and advanced mobility systems enable it to move swiftly and gracefully through libraries and archives, collecting and preserving valuable documents and artifacts.
Rule.Raw: The Scriptomaton is a humanoid mechanoid designed for writing and maintaining libraries. It has a vast database of knowledge at its disposal and can quickly and efficiently categorize and organize new information as it becomes available. The Scriptomaton is equipped with advanced writing tools, including pens, pencils, and quills, as well as cutting-edge software that allows it to transcribe written text into digital formats. Its sleek, humanoid form and advanced mobility systems enable it to move swiftly and gracefully through libraries and archives, collecting and preserving valuable documents and artifacts.
Rule.Translated: Diseñado para escribir y mantener libros, es un cuerpo mecánico ligero. La máquina de redacción está equipada con una base de datos académica extremadamente extensa; cuando se ingresa nueva información, puede organizarla y clasificarla de manera precisa y eficiente. También cuentan con una variedad de herramientas de escritura avanzadas, como plumas estilográficas, lápices y plumas de ave, así como con software de vanguardia que convierte textos manuscritos en formatos electrónicos. Su forma aerodinámica y sistema de propulsión avanzado les permite moverse con agilidad y elegancia en bibliotecas y archivos, o realizar rápidamente la restauración y mantenimiento de documentos valiosos y artefactos.
Cultivar (o desarrollar) un mecha de pesca
Cultivar (o desarrollar) un mecha de pesca.

Rule.Original: The Oceanus mechanoid is a unique machine, shaped like an old tugboat, that is specialized in fishing. It is equipped with state-of-the-art fishing gear, including nets, hooks, and lines, as well as advanced sonar and radar systems that allow it to locate schools of fish with great precision. Its hull is reinforced with advanced materials, making it impervious to most natural hazards in the sea, and it features a large cargo hold that can store great amounts of fresh fish. It is however pretty useless in combat.
Rule.Raw: The Oceanus mechanoid is a unique machine, shaped like an old tugboat, that is specialized in fishing. It is equipped with state-of-the-art fishing gear, including nets, hooks, and lines, as well as advanced sonar and radar systems that allow it to locate schools of fish with great precision. Its hull is reinforced with advanced materials, making it impervious to most natural hazards in the sea, and it features a large cargo hold that can store great amounts of fresh fish. It is however pretty useless in combat.
Rule.Translated: Diseñado para la pesca, es un cuerpo mecánico ligero. La máquina de pesca está equipada con redes, anzuelos y líneas de pesca de primera calidad, así como con un avanzado sistema de radar sónico capaz de localizar con precisión los bancos de peces. Su cuerpo reforzado con materiales avanzados les permite resistir la mayoría de los desastres naturales marítimos, y el compartimento trasero puede almacenar grandes cantidades de captura fresca. No cuentan con armas a distancia y sus habilidades de combate cuerpo a cuerpo son bastante limitadas.

Rule.Original: The Geneticor mechanoid is a humanoid robot designed for genetic engineering tasks. With advanced sensors and programming, it can analyze and manipulate DNA sequences with exceptional precision and speed. The Geneticor is equipped with a suite of specialized tools and equipment, including gene sequencers, CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing systems, and gene splicers, among others. Its programming includes an extensive database of genetic information and sequences, allowing it to adapt and customize its approach to any given task.
Rule.Raw: The Geneticor mechanoid is a humanoid robot designed for genetic engineering tasks. With advanced sensors and programming, it can analyze and manipulate DNA sequences with exceptional precision and speed. The Geneticor is equipped with a suite of specialized tools and equipment, including gene sequencers, CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing systems, and gene splicers, among others. Its programming includes an extensive database of genetic information and sequences, allowing it to adapt and customize its approach to any given task.
Rule.Translated: Diseñado para experimentos de ingeniería genética, es un cuerpo mecánico ligero. Gracias a avanzados sensores y programación, la máquina experimental puede analizar y manipular secuencias de ADN biológico con gran precisión y eficiencia. Está equipada con secuenciadores genéticos, sistemas de edición genética CRISPR-Cas9, ensambladores de genes y otras herramientas especializadas. Su base de datos contiene una gran cantidad de información genética y secuencias, siendo un asistente indispensable para los genetistas.

Rule.Original: Extract hemogen directly from the blood of a downed person. The target will lose blood and get knocked down. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.
Rule.Raw: Extract hemogen directly from the blood of a downed person. The target will lose blood and get knocked down. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.
Rule.Translated: Extrae plasma sanguíneo de unidades objetivo que ya estén derribadas (sin capacidad de acción) y lo almacena en un tanque de almacenamiento en la espalda. Debido a que durante la extracción se inyecta automáticamente un coagulante de rápida acción, no se causa daño alguno al objetivo.
Cultivar (o desarrollar) un mecha de extracción de sangre
Cultivar (o desarrollar) un mecha de extracción de sangre.

Rule.Original: A fearsome weapon that harnesses the power of boiling, acidic blood. When activated, the Blood Belcher propels a high-pressure stream of acidic hemogen towards its target.
Rule.Raw: A fearsome weapon that harnesses the power of boiling, acidic blood. When activated, the Blood Belcher propels a high-pressure stream of acidic hemogen towards its target.
Rule.Translated: Un arma aterradora utilizada por la máquina de extracción de sangre, capaz de expulsar plasma sanguíneo acidificado calentado hasta el punto de ebullición para dañar a los enemigos que se acerquen.

Rule.Original: A formidable mechanoid that resembles a Centipede in its body plan, optimized for the efficient collection and processing of hemogen. Its sharp, retractable proboscis makes precise incisions to extract the resource, which is then processed and stored within its internal reservoirs.
Rule.Raw: A formidable mechanoid that resembles a Centipede in its body plan, optimized for the efficient collection and processing of hemogen. Its sharp, retractable proboscis makes precise incisions to extract the resource, which is then processed and stored within its internal reservoirs.
Rule.Translated: Diseñado para la recolección y procesamiento eficiente de plasma sanguíneo, es un cuerpo mecánico de tamaño mediano con una apariencia algo similar a un ciempiés mecánico. La máquina de extracción de sangre cuenta con una probóscide inyectora alargada, similar al aparato bucal de un mosquito, que puede extraer plasma humano de manera precisa e indolora, almacenándolo en un tanque de almacenamiento ubicado en su espalda.

Rule.Original:
A small-size pieces of pottery with artisting engravings. Can be crafted on a crafting spot. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Food, PlantMatter
Rule.Raw:
A small-size pieces of pottery with artisting engravings. Can be crafted on a crafting spot. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Food, PlantMatter
Rule.Translated: Una pieza de cerámica de pequeño tamaño con grabados artísticos. Se puede elaborar en un punto de trabajo artesanal.

Rule.Original:
A small plinth with an artistic imagery carved into the sides. Can be used for storing miscellaneous items. Items stored in this will not deteriorate, even if outside. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 1 Stack per tile: 1
Allowed items: Weapons
Rule.Raw:
A small plinth with an artistic imagery carved into the sides. Can be used for storing miscellaneous items. Items stored in this will not deteriorate, even if outside. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 1 Stack per tile: 1
Allowed items: Weapons
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño zócalo con una imagen artística tallada en los laterales. Puede utilizarse para guardar diversos objetos. Los objetos guardados en él no se deteriorarán, aunque estén en el exterior.

Rule.Original:
A piece of furniture used for organising documents and records in paper form. It will help you perform research tasks faster. This structure can also be used to store research items. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Techprints, Tech Subpersona Core, Neurotrainers, Signal chips, Empire Intel, Research papers
Rule.Raw:
A piece of furniture used for organising documents and records in paper form. It will help you perform research tasks faster. This structure can also be used to store research items. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Techprints, Tech Subpersona Core, Neurotrainers, Signal chips, Empire Intel, Research papers
Rule.Translated: Un mueble que sirve para organizar documentos y registros en papel. Aumenta la velocidad de investigación cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de investigación. Una mesa de investigación puede utilizar hasta dos archivadores al mismo tiempo.

Rule.Original:
A tall wardrobe for storing clothing and other items. Gives a small sleep effectiveness bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 3
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Raw:
A tall wardrobe for storing clothing and other items. Gives a small sleep effectiveness bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 3
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Translated: Un armario alto para guardar ropa y otros objetos. Da una pequeña bonificación a la efectividad del sueño a todas las camas cercanas. Colocar más de un armario cerca de la misma cama no tiene ningún efecto.

Rule.Original:
A luxurious dresser, adorned with solid gold and elegant in design, making nearby beds more comfortable.Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect. Can be used to store Apparel. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 3
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Raw:
A luxurious dresser, adorned with solid gold and elegant in design, making nearby beds more comfortable.Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect. Can be used to store Apparel. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 3
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Translated: Una cómoda lujosa, adornada con detalles de oro macizo y con un diseño elegante, que hace más cómodas las camas cercanas. Colocar más de una cómoda cerca de la misma cama no tiene ningún efecto.

Rule.Original:
A grand, gold-trimmed wardrobe designed for nobility. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one royal wardrobe near the same bed has no effect. Can be used to store Apparel. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 8 Stack per tile: 4
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Raw:
A grand, gold-trimmed wardrobe designed for nobility. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one royal wardrobe near the same bed has no effect. Can be used to store Apparel. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 8 Stack per tile: 4
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Translated: Un gran armario dorado diseñado para la nobleza. Otorga una pequeña bonificación de comodidad a todas las camas cercanas. Colocar más de un armario regio cerca de la misma cama no tiene ningún efecto adicional.

Rule.Original:
Increases work speed when placed near a drug lab. One workbench links up to two drug cabinets. Can be used as storage. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 8 Stack per tile: 4
Allowed items: Medicine, Plant Matter, Cloth, Neutroamine 

<color=#0094FF>Items stored can be frozen when powered.</color>
Rule.Raw:
Increases work speed when placed near a drug lab. One workbench links up to two drug cabinets. Can be used as storage. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 8 Stack per tile: 4
Allowed items: Medicine, Plant Matter, Cloth, Neutroamine 

<color=#0094FF>Items stored can be frozen when powered.</color>
Rule.Translated: Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de un laboratorio de drogas cuando se coloca cerca. Una de estas puede conectarse hasta con dos estantes de drogas.

Rule.Original:

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 8 Stack per tile: 4

Allowed items: Mortar Shells, Ammunition (CE, LTS, Yayo)

Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja de munición que mejora la velocidad de recarga de todos los que están cerca. Explota si es dañada.

Rule.Original:
An illuminated dresser, adorned with light strips. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds, whilst lighting up the room. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect. Can be used as storage. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 8 Stack per tile: 4
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Raw:
An illuminated dresser, adorned with light strips. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds, whilst lighting up the room. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect. Can be used as storage. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 8 Stack per tile: 4
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Translated: Una elegante y moderna cómoda con una lámpara de luz tenue integrada. Proporciona un pequeño aumento en la comodidad de todas las camas cercanas. Colocar más de una cómoda cerca de una misma cama no mejora este efecto.

Rule.Original:
A sleek, modern wardrobe with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Gives a small comfort and rest effectiveness bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect. Can be used as storage. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 10 Stack per tile: 5
Allowed items: Apparel

A sleek, modern wardrobe with an integrated soft-glow lamp. Gives a small comfort and rest effectiveness bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect. Can be used as storage. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 10 Stack per tile: 5

Rule.Translated: Un elegante y moderno armario con una lámpara de luz tenue integrada. Proporciona un pequeño aumento en la comodidad de todas las camas cercanas. Colocar más de un armario cerca de una misma cama no mejora este efecto.

Rule.Original:
A handy cabinet that contains a whole bunch of extra tools of various sizes and functions. Increases work speed when placed near a garage bench. One bench can use up to two garage cabinets. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 12 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Car parts
Rule.Raw:
A handy cabinet that contains a whole bunch of extra tools of various sizes and functions. Increases work speed when placed near a garage bench. One bench can use up to two garage cabinets. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 12 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Car parts
Rule.Translated: Un práctico armario que contiene un montón de herramientas adicionales de diversos tamaños y funciones. Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo cuando se coloca cerca de una mesa de garaje. Una mesa puede utilizar hasta dos armarios de garaje.

Rule.Original: Salt is a common mineral, often found in natural rocky deposits and in abundance in the ocean. It is often used for food preservation, and as a seasoning in meals. Rock salt, like common salt, enhances the flavor profile of other ingredients it is cooked with.
Rule.Raw: Salt is a common mineral, often found in natural rocky deposits and in abundance in the ocean. It is often used for food preservation, and as a seasoning in meals. Rock salt, like common salt, enhances the flavor profile of other ingredients it is cooked with.
Rule.Translated: La sal es un mineral común que suele encontrarse en depósitos rocosos naturales y en abundancia en el océano. Se utiliza a menudo para conservar alimentos y como condimento en las comidas.

Rule.Original: A large beetle covered in iron-like carapace. Fearful and reclusive, these peculiar insectoids burrow into ore deposits to give birth, where their young can stay safe and absorb the minerals necessary for formation of their metallic shells.\n\nExperienced quarry overseers often hire hunters to track ironcasket beetle nests, as their shells can be extracted for a hassle-free source of iron.
Rule.Raw: A large beetle covered in iron-like carapace. Fearful and reclusive, these peculiar insectoids burrow into ore deposits to give birth, where their young can stay safe and absorb the minerals necessary for formation of their metallic shells.\n\nExperienced quarry overseers often hire hunters to track ironcasket beetle nests, as their shells can be extracted for a hassle-free source of iron.
Rule.Translated: Un gran escarabajo cubierto por un caparazón similar al hierro. Temerosos y solitarios, estos insectoides peculiares excavan en depósitos de mineral para dar a luz, donde sus crías pueden permanecer seguras y absorber los minerales necesarios para la formación de sus caparazones metálicos.\n\nLos supervisores de canteras experimentados a menudo contratan cazadores para rastrear nidos de escarabajos de hierro, ya que sus caparazones pueden extraerse para obtener una fuente de acero sin complicaciones.

Rule.Original: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Raw: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
Rule.Translated: Puede ser analizado por un colono.

Rule.Original: A graser cannon designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Raw: A graser cannon designed to be attached to a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un cañón de rayos gamma diseñado para montarse en una torreta.

Rule.Original: A non-lethal rubber bullet gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Raw: A non-lethal rubber bullet gun made to be mounted on a turret.
Rule.Translated: Un arma no letal que dispara balas de goma, diseñada para montarse en una torreta.

Rule.Original: An unusually tall plant with bright, pink nodules. Its nodules are slightly toxic for humans, and it produces a strange, rotten fruit smell, so it is considered absolutely inedible. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: An unusually tall plant with bright, pink nodules. Its nodules are slightly toxic for humans, and it produces a strange, rotten fruit smell, so it is considered absolutely inedible. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una planta inusualmente alta con nódulos de un rosa brillante. Sus nódulos son ligeramente tóxicos para los humanos y desprende un extraño olor a fruta podrida, por lo que se considera totalmente incomestible. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A rare, huge flower which can be found in the deepest jungles. Its quite striking colour and nice smell makes it popular in gardening, if it can be extracted from the deep jungle, of course. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A rare, huge flower which can be found in the deepest jungles. Its quite striking colour and nice smell makes it popular in gardening, if it can be extracted from the deep jungle, of course. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme flor poco común que se encuentra en lo más profundo de las selvas. Su llamativo color y su agradable aroma la hacen popular en jardinería, siempre que se consiga extraerla de la espesura, claro. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A plant of the euphorbia genus, commonly called spurges. This plant has adapted to arid climates and stores a lot of water inside their spine-covered leaves. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A plant of the euphorbia genus, commonly called spurges. This plant has adapted to arid climates and stores a lot of water inside their spine-covered leaves. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una planta del género Euphorbia, conocido comúnmente como euforbias. Se ha adaptado a climas áridos y almacena mucha agua en sus hojas cubiertas de espinas. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: Although at first sight this seems to be an independent plant, its roots are intricately interconnected with the rest of the gelatinous superorganism. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: Although at first sight this seems to be an independent plant, its roots are intricately interconnected with the rest of the gelatinous superorganism. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Aunque a primera vista parece una planta independiente, sus raíces están intrincadamente conectadas con el resto del superorganismo gelatinoso. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: Although at first sight this seems to be an independent plant, its roots are intricately interconnected with the rest of the gelatinous superorganism. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: Although at first sight this seems to be an independent plant, its roots are intricately interconnected with the rest of the gelatinous superorganism. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Aunque a primera vista parece una planta independiente, sus raíces están intrincadamente conectadas con el resto del superorganismo gelatinoso. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: This tree doesn't seem to be entirely solid. Upon further examination, it isn't an independent entity, its roots fusing seamlessly with the hardened gelatinous ground. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This tree doesn't seem to be entirely solid. Upon further examination, it isn't an independent entity, its roots fusing seamlessly with the hardened gelatinous ground. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este árbol no parece del todo sólido. Un examen más detenido revela que no es una entidad independiente: sus raíces se funden con el suelo gelatinoso endurecido. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: This tree doesn't seem to be entirely solid. Upon further examination, it isn't an independent entity, its roots fusing seamlessly with the hardened gelatinous ground. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This tree doesn't seem to be entirely solid. Upon further examination, it isn't an independent entity, its roots fusing seamlessly with the hardened gelatinous ground. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este árbol no parece del todo sólido. Un examen más detenido revela que no es una entidad independiente: sus raíces se funden con el suelo gelatinoso endurecido. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: Lithops is a genus of succulent plants often known as pebble plants or living stones, due to their stone-like appearance that allows them to avoid being eaten by blending in with surrounding rocks. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: Lithops is a genus of succulent plants often known as pebble plants or living stones, due to their stone-like appearance that allows them to avoid being eaten by blending in with surrounding rocks. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Lithops es un género de plantas suculentas conocidas como plantas piedra o piedras vivas. Su aspecto pétreo les permite confundirse con las rocas circundantes y evitar que se las coman. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: This tree is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based, and it seems to be struggling to grow from exposure to a terrestrial environment. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This tree is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based, and it seems to be struggling to grow from exposure to a terrestrial environment. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este árbol es completamente alienígena, probablemente ni siquiera está compuesto al 100% de carbono, y parece tener dificultades para crecer en un entorno terrestre. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: This strange flower seems to be only partially organic. Part of its structure is clearly crystalline, and it appears to be unaffected, or even bolstered, by the extremely cold climate. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This strange flower seems to be only partially organic. Part of its structure is clearly crystalline, and it appears to be unaffected, or even bolstered, by the extremely cold climate. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Esta extraña flor parece ser solo parcialmente orgánica. Parte de su estructura es claramente cristalina, y el clima extremadamente frío parece no afectarla o incluso favorecerla. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A very strange plant, partly inorganic, that seems to extract propane from the surrounding landscape and store it as an energy source in rime-bound chemical sacs. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A very strange plant, partly inorganic, that seems to extract propane from the surrounding landscape and store it as an energy source in rime-bound chemical sacs. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una planta muy extraña, parcialmente inorgánica, que parece extraer propano del entorno y almacenarlo como fuente de energía en sacos químicos cubiertos de escarcha. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: This tree, which probably started growing in a rare period of summer heat, has been frozen in place by the extreme temperatures, its leaves crystallized by the toxic propane compounds. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This tree, which probably started growing in a rare period of summer heat, has been frozen in place by the extreme temperatures, its leaves crystallized by the toxic propane compounds. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este árbol, que probablemente empezó a crecer durante un raro periodo de calor estival, quedó congelado por las temperaturas extremas, con las hojas cristalizadas por compuestos tóxicos de propano. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: Firevine trees are pyrophitic plants that are able to survive wildfires due to a clever layer of thermal insulation provided by their fire retardant bark. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: Firevine trees are pyrophitic plants that are able to survive wildfires due to a clever layer of thermal insulation provided by their fire retardant bark. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Los árboles de enredadera ígnea son plantas pirófitas capaces de sobrevivir a incendios forestales gracias al aislamiento térmico de su corteza ignífuga. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: This vivid green plant seem to be related to cacti. Though it's fleshy bark is not edible, it produces flowers than can be consumed by humans. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This vivid green plant seem to be related to cacti. Though it's fleshy bark is not edible, it produces flowers than can be consumed by humans. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Esta planta de verde intenso parece emparentada con los cactus. Aunque su corteza carnosa no es comestible, produce flores que los humanos pueden consumir. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: The sugar famewort grows in areas with a high concentration of pollinating insects. It generates a sweet nectar that attracts these insects, and they disperse its pollen when they feed on it. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: The sugar famewort grows in areas with a high concentration of pollinating insects. It generates a sweet nectar that attracts these insects, and they disperse its pollen when they feed on it. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: La planta azucarera crece en zonas con una gran concentración de insectos polinizadores. Genera un néctar dulce que los atrae, y estos dispersan su polen al alimentarse. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A huge bioluminescent globular plant. Can be used as a natural sunlamp to grow regular plants, though the toxic environment it grows at might not be the best for cultivation. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A huge bioluminescent globular plant. Can be used as a natural sunlamp to grow regular plants, though the toxic environment it grows at might not be the best for cultivation. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme planta globular bioluminiscente. Puede usarse como lámpara solar natural para cultivar plantas comunes, aunque el ambiente tóxico en el que crece quizá no sea el más apropiado para ello. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: This jungle polux tree has adapted so perfectly to polluted soil and airborne toxins that it doesn't even need to remove pollution from its environment. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: This jungle polux tree has adapted so perfectly to polluted soil and airborne toxins that it doesn't even need to remove pollution from its environment. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Este árbol pólux selvático se ha adaptado tan bien al suelo contaminado y a las toxinas del aire que ni siquiera necesita eliminar la contaminación de su entorno. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: A plant of the euphorbia genus, commonly called spurges. This plant is a variety of the Euphorbia Rimworldia plant that has adapted to polluted environments. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A plant of the euphorbia genus, commonly called spurges. This plant is a variety of the Euphorbia Rimworldia plant that has adapted to polluted environments. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una planta del género Euphorbia, conocido comúnmente como euforbias. Es una variedad de Euphorbia rimworldia adaptada a entornos contaminados. Esta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent freezing cold air from an underground megastructure, dramatically lowering the temperature of the surrounding area. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Raw: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent freezing cold air from an underground megastructure, dramatically lowering the temperature of the surrounding area. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme conducto que se adentra sin fin en el suelo. Libera periódicamente aire helado procedente de una megaestructura subterránea, reduciendo drásticamente la temperatura de la zona. Permanentemente inactivo.

Rule.Original: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent large amounts of sickly looking smoke that will plunge the area into a preternatural darkness. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Raw: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent large amounts of sickly looking smoke that will plunge the area into a preternatural darkness. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme conducto que se adentra sin fin en el suelo. Libera periódicamente grandes cantidades de humo de aspecto malsano que sumen la zona en una oscuridad sobrenatural. Permanentemente inactivo.

Rule.Original: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent huge red clouds of a vaporized blood-like substance that will coalesce into a disgusting blood rain. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Raw: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent huge red clouds of a vaporized blood-like substance that will coalesce into a disgusting blood rain. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme conducto que se adentra sin fin en el suelo. Libera periódicamente enormes nubes rojas de una sustancia vaporizada parecida a la sangre, que se condensan en una repugnante lluvia de sangre. Permanentemente inactivo.

Rule.Original: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent clouds of microscopic self-powered archites that affect corpses reanimating them to create a twisted imitation of life. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Raw: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent clouds of microscopic self-powered archites that affect corpses reanimating them to create a twisted imitation of life. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme conducto que se adentra sin fin en el suelo. Libera periódicamente nubes de arquitas microscópicas autónomas que reaniman cadáveres para crear una retorcida imitación de la vida. Permanentemente inactivo.

Rule.Original: This ribcage once belonged to a living Gallatross of truly exceptional size. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Raw: This ribcage once belonged to a living Gallatross of truly exceptional size. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Translated: Esta caja torácica perteneció a un gallatross de tamaño realmente excepcional. Nota: si tienes instalado el mod Rim of Madness - Bones, puedes desmontarla para obtener huesos utilizables.

Rule.Original: This skull belonged to an exceptionally huge Gallatross. Look at the size of this thing! Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Raw: This skull belonged to an exceptionally huge Gallatross. Look at the size of this thing! Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Translated: Este cráneo perteneció a un gallatross excepcionalmente enorme. ¡Mira qué tamaño! Nota: si tienes instalado el mod Rim of Madness - Bones, puedes desmontarlo para obtener huesos utilizables.

Rule.Original: This fosilized bone might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Raw: This fosilized bone might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Translated: Este hueso fosilizado pudo pertenecer a un gallatross excepcionalmente grande. Nota: si tienes instalado el mod Rim of Madness - Bones, puedes desmontarlo para obtener huesos utilizables.

Rule.Original: This fosilized bone might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.

Rule.Original: These fosilized bones might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Raw: These fosilized bones might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Translated: Estos huesos fosilizados pudieron pertenecer a un gallatross excepcionalmente grande. Nota: si tienes instalado el mod Rim of Madness - Bones, puedes desmontarlos para obtener huesos utilizables.

Rule.Original: These fosilized bones might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Raw: These fosilized bones might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
Rule.Translated: Estos huesos fosilizados pudieron pertenecer a un gallatross excepcionalmente grande. Nota: si tienes instalado el mod Rim of Madness - Bones, puedes desmontarlos para obtener huesos utilizables.

Rule.Original: A bulky, churning machine that grinds down organic slime and compresses it under immense pressure, slowly transforming the ooze into dense, usable sandstone. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: A bulky, churning machine that grinds down organic slime and compresses it under immense pressure, slowly transforming the ooze into dense, usable sandstone. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina voluminosa que tritura limo orgánico y lo comprime a una presión inmensa, transformándolo lentamente en arenisca densa y utilizable. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: This device was able to store genepacks and make them usable to create new xenogerms, when placed near a gene assembler. It has corroded beyond any repair, and the genepacks stored inside are far gone.
Rule.Raw: This device was able to store genepacks and make them usable to create new xenogerms, when placed near a gene assembler. It has corroded beyond any repair, and the genepacks stored inside are far gone.
Rule.Translated: Este dispositivo podía almacenar paquetes genéticos y permitir su uso para crear nuevos xenogérmenes si se colocaba cerca de un ensamblador de genes. Está corroído sin remedio y los paquetes de su interior se perdieron hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A vat of fluid which was able to gestate an embryo or accelerate a child's growth. Its transparent plasteel sheel has been smashed open, seemingly from the inside... Ominous.
Rule.Raw: A vat of fluid which was able to gestate an embryo or accelerate a child's growth. Its transparent plasteel sheel has been smashed open, seemingly from the inside... Ominous.
Rule.Translated: Un tanque de líquido que podía gestar un embrión o acelerar el crecimiento de un niño. Su cubierta de plastiacero transparente está destrozada, aparentemente desde dentro... Inquietante.

Rule.Original: This thing is SO edgy. Like, SUPER edgy. Basically a medical bed with spikes. I bet it only worked if you played symphonic metal in the background. I blame Oskar.
Rule.Raw: This thing is SO edgy. Like, SUPER edgy. Basically a medical bed with spikes. I bet it only worked if you played symphonic metal in the background. I blame Oskar.
Rule.Translated: Esto es TAN siniestro. Pero MUY siniestro. Básicamente, una cama médica con pinchos. Apuesto a que solo funcionaba con metal sinfónico de fondo. La culpa es de Oskar.

Rule.Original: A large stone used to construct a prehistoric structure or monument, either alone or together with other stones, often hewn in definite shapes for special purposes.
Rule.Raw: A large stone used to construct a prehistoric structure or monument, either alone or together with other stones, often hewn in definite shapes for special purposes.
Rule.Translated: Una gran piedra utilizada para construir una estructura o monumento prehistórico, sola o junto a otras piedras, a menudo tallada con una forma concreta para un propósito especial.

Rule.Original: Arrrr, matey, this here be a mote prop for "Skull". Shiver me timber, this be intrinsically laggy, me lad, though less than effecter props. Use in moderation, ye scurvy sea dog.
Rule.Raw: Arrrr, matey, this here be a mote prop for "Skull". Shiver me timber, this be intrinsically laggy, me lad, though less than effecter props. Use in moderation, ye scurvy sea dog.
Rule.Translated: ¡Arrr, camarada! Este es un elemento decorativo de partículas llamado «Calavera». ¡Por todos los mares! Reduce el rendimiento por naturaleza, muchacho, aunque menos que los elementos decorativos con efectos. Úsalo con moderación, viejo lobo de mar.

Rule.Original: A medieval sailing vessel characterized by a sturdy, broad-bottomed design with a single mast and a square-rigged sail. It was commonly used for trade, transportation, and exploration during the Middle Ages in Europe. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed. Intended to be placed over water. Or wherever you want, I'm not your mom!
Rule.Raw: A medieval sailing vessel characterized by a sturdy, broad-bottomed design with a single mast and a square-rigged sail. It was commonly used for trade, transportation, and exploration during the Middle Ages in Europe. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed. Intended to be placed over water. Rule.Original: A spacer-tech shuttle designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A spacer-tech shuttle designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una lanzadera de tecnología espacial diseñada para viajar entre la superficie y la órbita, o entre las lunas de un sistema planetario. Esta parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: The Imperial maxpack is a formidable armored transport truck, known for its impressive cargo capacity. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: The Imperial maxpack is a formidable armored transport truck, known for its impressive cargo capacity. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: El maxpack imperial es un formidable camión de transporte blindado, conocido por su impresionante capacidad de carga. Este parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A small-sized box containing uranium slug ammunition. Used by Kontarion turrets to reload. May explode when damaged. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic slugs.
Rule.Raw: A small-sized box containing uranium slug ammunition. Used by Kontarion turrets to reload. May explode when damaged. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic slugs.
Rule.Translated: Una caja pequeña con proyectiles de uranio, utilizados para recargar las torretas Kontarion. Puede explotar si recibe daños. Al examinarla de cerca, parece estar llena únicamente de proyectiles de plástico.

Rule.Original: A small-sized box containing autocannon ammunition. Used by Palintone turrets to reload. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic slugs.
Rule.Raw: A small-sized box containing autocannon ammunition. Used by Palintone turrets to reload. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic slugs.
Rule.Translated: Una caja pequeña con munición de cañón automático, utilizada para recargar las torretas Palintone. Al examinarla de cerca, parece estar llena únicamente de proyectiles de plástico.

Rule.Original: A small-sized box containing missiles. Used by Onager turrets to reload. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic missiles.
Rule.Raw: A small-sized box containing missiles. Used by Onager turrets to reload. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic missiles.
Rule.Translated: Una caja pequeña con misiles, utilizados para recargar las torretas Onager. Al examinarla de cerca, parece estar llena únicamente de misiles de plástico.

Rule.Original: A small imperial crate containing valuables. Sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: A small imperial crate containing valuables. Sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja imperial con objetos valiosos. Está sellada.

Rule.Original: A small imperial crate containing extremely valuable items. Sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: A small imperial crate containing extremely valuable items. Sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja imperial con objetos extremadamente valiosos. Está sellada.

Rule.Original: A large pillar with a series of sensors, cameras and motion detectors. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Raw: A large pillar with a series of sensors, cameras and motion detectors. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un gran pilar con sensores, cámaras y detectores de movimiento. Parece inactivo.

Rule.Original: A large military crate of aerodrone munitions. Upon closer inspection, all the missiles are fake plastic ones.
Rule.Raw: A large military crate of aerodrone munitions. Upon closer inspection, all the missiles are fake plastic ones.
Rule.Translated: Una gran caja militar con munición de aerodron. Al examinarla de cerca, todos los misiles son de plástico.

Rule.Original: A large, overcharged aerodrone battery. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A large, overcharged aerodrone battery. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una gran batería de aerodron sobrecargada. No funciona.

Rule.Original: Aerodrone is a spacer-tech, unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with advanced sensors and a missile payload. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: Aerodrone is a spacer-tech, unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with advanced sensors and a missile payload. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: El aerodron es un vehículo aéreo no tripulado de tecnología espacial, equipado con sensores avanzados y misiles. No funciona.

Rule.Original: A large fuel tank used to refuel Imperial shuttles. Completely empty.
Rule.Raw: A large fuel tank used to refuel Imperial shuttles. Completely empty.
Rule.Translated: Un gran depósito de combustible utilizado para repostar lanzaderas imperiales. Está completamente vacío.

Rule.Original: A large console designed to link to surrounding surveillance pillars. This one is disconnected from the grid.
Rule.Raw: A large console designed to link to surrounding surveillance pillars. This one is disconnected from the grid.
Rule.Translated: Una gran consola diseñada para conectarse a los pilares de vigilancia cercanos. Esta está desconectada de la red.

Rule.Original: An imperial computer interface. This one is disconnected from the grid.
Rule.Raw: An imperial computer interface. This one is disconnected from the grid.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz informática imperial. Esta está desconectada de la red.

Rule.Original: The Techprinter is a marvel of technological innovation, designed to capture and preserve the intricate knowledge residing within a techfriar’s mind. This one is disconnected from the grid.
Rule.Raw: The Techprinter is a marvel of technological innovation, designed to capture and preserve the intricate knowledge residing within a techfriar’s mind. This one is disconnected from the grid.
Rule.Translated: La tecnoimpresora es una maravilla de la innovación tecnológica, diseñada para capturar y conservar los complejos conocimientos de la mente de un tecnofraile. Esta está desconectada de la red.

Rule.Original: A compact stack of discs crafted from the enigmatic element known as techite, produced exclusively by the Empire for knowledge transcribing. These are all blank.
Rule.Raw: A compact stack of discs crafted from the enigmatic element known as techite, produced exclusively by the Empire for knowledge transcribing. These are all blank.
Rule.Translated: Una pila compacta de discos hechos del enigmático elemento llamado tecnita, producidos exclusivamente por el Imperio para transcribir conocimientos. Todos están en blanco.

Rule.Original: An underground hydroponics basic used by the empire to feed their subjects. Upon closer inspection it is disconnected from the water mains and all its plants are made of plastic.
Rule.Raw: An underground hydroponics basic used by the empire to feed their subjects. Upon closer inspection it is disconnected from the water mains and all its plants are made of plastic.
Rule.Translated: Una instalación hidropónica subterránea utilizada por el Imperio para alimentar a sus súbditos. Al examinarla de cerca, está desconectada de las tuberías y todas sus plantas son de plástico.

Rule.Original: A large node connecting all the nearby water mains. Upon closer inspection it is disconnected from the water grid.
Rule.Raw: A large node connecting all the nearby water mains. Upon closer inspection it is disconnected from the water grid.
Rule.Translated: Un gran nodo que conecta todas las tuberías de agua cercanas. Al examinarlo de cerca, está desconectado de la red de agua.

Rule.Original: An advanced shielding apparatus. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Raw: An advanced shielding apparatus. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de escudo avanzado. Parece inactivo.

Rule.Original: This terminal serves as the primary interface for operating the Zeus Cannon batteries. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Raw: This terminal serves as the primary interface for operating the Zeus Cannon batteries. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Translated: Esta terminal es la interfaz principal para manejar las baterías de cañones Zeus. Parece inactiva.

Rule.Original: A capacitor bank that transforms electricity into raw energy for the Zeus cannon. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Raw: A capacitor bank that transforms electricity into raw energy for the Zeus cannon. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de condensadores que convierte electricidad en energía pura para el cañón Zeus. Parece inactivo.

Rule.Original: A relic of ancient Sophiamundan technology, the Zeus Cannon is a closely guarded secret of the Empire. Wait, what is this? It's... made of cardboard!
Rule.Raw: A relic of ancient Sophiamundan technology, the Zeus Cannon is a closely guarded secret of the Empire. Wait, what is this? It's... made of cardboard!
Rule.Translated: Una reliquia de la antigua tecnología de Sophiamunda: el cañón Zeus es un secreto celosamente guardado por el Imperio. Espera, ¿qué es esto? ¡Está... hecho de cartón!

Rule.Original: A deserter device capable of intercepting imperial communication. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Raw: A deserter device capable of intercepting imperial communication. Seems to be inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de los desertores capaz de interceptar comunicaciones imperiales. Parece inactivo.

Rule.Original: A spacer-tech imperial gunship designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A spacer-tech imperial gunship designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una nave artillada imperial de tecnología espacial, diseñada para viajar entre la superficie y la órbita, o entre las lunas de un sistema planetario. Esta parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A spacer-tech imperial gunship designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A spacer-tech imperial gunship designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una nave artillada imperial de tecnología espacial, diseñada para viajar entre la superficie y la órbita, o entre las lunas de un sistema planetario. Esta parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A super-charged air-conditioning unit designed for its intended purpose of preventing genomes from breaking down entropically. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A super-charged air-conditioning unit designed for its intended purpose of preventing genomes from breaking down entropically. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de aire acondicionado de gran potencia, diseñada para evitar la degradación entrópica de los genomas. Esta no funciona.

Rule.Original: This device has collapsed in on itself, rendering it useless.
Rule.Raw: This device has collapsed in on itself, rendering it useless.
Rule.Translated: Este dispositivo se ha derrumbado sobre sí mismo y ha quedado inutilizado.

Rule.Original: The exterior shell has completely fallen apart, yet it seems that it exploded instead of imploded.
Rule.Raw: The exterior shell has completely fallen apart, yet it seems that it exploded instead of imploded.
Rule.Translated: La cubierta exterior se ha desintegrado por completo, aunque parece haber explotado hacia fuera en vez de implosionar.

Rule.Original: A very old recombinator that somehow possesses an awful stench and excessive mould.
Rule.Raw: A very old recombinator that somehow possesses an awful stench and excessive mould.
Rule.Translated: Un recombinador muy antiguo que, de algún modo, desprende un hedor espantoso y está cubierto de moho.

Rule.Original: A Genomorpher that has fallen into complete disrepair, some salvage still remains.
Rule.Raw: A Genomorpher that has fallen into complete disrepair, some salvage still remains.
Rule.Translated: Un genomorfador completamente deteriorado. Aún quedan algunas piezas recuperables.

Rule.Original: Lacking proper maintenance for so long, this machine is rusted shut.
Rule.Raw: Lacking proper maintenance for so long, this machine is rusted shut.
Rule.Translated: Tras tanto tiempo sin mantenimiento, el óxido ha dejado esta máquina atascada.

Rule.Original: Most of the useful and otherwise functional parts are missing, indicating intentional sabotage.
Rule.Raw: Most of the useful and otherwise functional parts are missing, indicating intentional sabotage.
Rule.Translated: Faltan la mayoría de las piezas útiles y funcionales, lo que indica un sabotaje deliberado.

Rule.Original: The machinery and electronics are irreparable but could be broken down for scrap.
Rule.Raw: The machinery and electronics are irreparable but could be broken down for scrap.
Rule.Translated: La maquinaria y la electrónica son irreparables, pero pueden desmontarse para obtener chatarra.

Rule.Original: This ancient tank once converted biological matter into an electrical current. It is now completely broken and useless.
Rule.Raw: This ancient tank once converted biological matter into an electrical current. It is now completely broken and useless.
Rule.Translated: Este antiguo tanque convertía materia biológica en corriente eléctrica. Ahora está completamente roto e inutilizado.

Rule.Original: This ancient structure was once used to inject nanomachines in a subject in an attempt to create the perfect soldier. It now lies rusted and unsalvageable.
