Rule.Raw: This ancient structure was once used to inject nanomachines in a subject in an attempt to create the perfect soldier. It now lies rusted and unsalvageable.
Rule.Translated: Esta antigua estructura se utilizaba para inyectar nanomáquinas en un sujeto e intentar crear al soldado perfecto. Ahora está oxidada y no se puede recuperar.

Rule.Original: A very efficient ancient battery. Sadly out of service.
Rule.Raw: A very efficient ancient battery. Sadly out of service.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua batería muy eficiente. Por desgracia, está fuera de servicio.

Rule.Original: An ancient genepod that was used to combine genetic material. This machine is obsolete and damaged beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: An ancient genepod that was used to combine genetic material. This machine is obsolete and damaged beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua cápsula genética utilizada para combinar material genético. Está obsoleta y dañada sin remedio.

Rule.Original: It seems that this structure was capable of emitting some kind of electromagnetic radiation used to control brain function of certain animals. This was crude and primitive technology prone to failure and instability, and as such it is completely useless now.
Rule.Raw: It seems that this structure was capable of emitting some kind of electromagnetic radiation used to control brain function of certain animals. This was crude and primitive technology prone to failure and instability, and as such it is completely useless now.
Rule.Translated: Esta estructura parece haber emitido radiación electromagnética para controlar la función cerebral de ciertos animales. Era una tecnología rudimentaria, propensa a fallos e inestabilidad, y ahora está completamente inutilizada.

Rule.Original: Whatever was held inside this dank, rusted metal coffin has long since escaped. It is damaged beyond all repair.
Rule.Raw: Whatever was held inside this dank, rusted metal coffin has long since escaped. It is damaged beyond all repair.
Rule.Translated: Lo que hubiera dentro de este húmedo ataúd de metal oxidado escapó hace mucho. Está dañado sin remedio.

Rule.Original: This deteriorated platform seems to have been used to assemble some kind of machinery. It now lays bare and empty.
Rule.Raw: This deteriorated platform seems to have been used to assemble some kind of machinery. It now lays bare and empty.
Rule.Translated: Esta plataforma deteriorada parece haberse utilizado para montar algún tipo de maquinaria. Ahora está desnuda y vacía.

Rule.Original: This semi-spherical vat seems to have held some kind of viscuous liquid inside, as evidenced by the rancid-smelling residue coating its insides. It is now completely ruined and only useful as metal scrap.
Rule.Raw: This semi-spherical vat seems to have held some kind of viscuous liquid inside, as evidenced by the rancid-smelling residue coating its insides. It is now completely ruined and only useful as metal scrap.
Rule.Translated: Este tanque semiesférico parece haber contenido un líquido viscoso, a juzgar por los residuos de olor rancio de su interior. Está completamente destrozado y solo sirve como chatarra.

Rule.Original: A completely obsolete model of gene recombinator, that is also deteriorated and rusted beyond and salvaging.
Rule.Raw: A completely obsolete model of gene recombinator, that is also deteriorated and rusted beyond and salvaging.
Rule.Translated: Un modelo de recombinador genético completamente obsoleto, tan deteriorado y oxidado que no puede recuperarse.

Rule.Original: This ancient computer was used to storage genetic information and feed genetic dataprints to other machines, but its components have deteriorated so far that all the data it contained has degraded to nothingness.
Rule.Raw: This ancient computer was used to storage genetic information and feed genetic dataprints to other machines, but its components have deteriorated so far that all the data it contained has degraded to nothingness.
Rule.Translated: Este antiguo ordenador almacenaba información genética y enviaba datos genéticos a otras máquinas, pero sus componentes están tan deteriorados que todos sus datos se han perdido.

Rule.Original: Yet another workstation that has deteriorated beyond all recovery. A foul-smelling vial of stagnant liquid warns you to keep away from it.
Rule.Raw: Yet another workstation that has deteriorated beyond all recovery. A foul-smelling vial of stagnant liquid warns you to keep away from it.
Rule.Translated: Otra estación de trabajo deteriorada sin remedio. Un vial de líquido estancado y maloliente invita a mantenerse lejos.

Rule.Original: This little wheeled table housed a small specialized computer and refrigerated trays to store genetic material, but it is now so damaged it can only be used as scrap.
Rule.Raw: This little wheeled table housed a small specialized computer and refrigerated trays to store genetic material, but it is now so damaged it can only be used as scrap.
Rule.Translated: Esta pequeña mesa con ruedas alojaba un ordenador especializado y bandejas refrigeradas para almacenar material genético. Ahora está tan dañada que solo sirve como chatarra.

Rule.Original: A large centrifuge used in gene sequencing. Its corroded parts will never be of use to anyone again.
Rule.Raw: A large centrifuge used in gene sequencing. Its corroded parts will never be of use to anyone again.
Rule.Translated: Una gran centrífuga utilizada para la secuenciación genética. Sus piezas corroídas nunca volverán a servirle a nadie.

Rule.Original: This small canister has been smashed to pieces and whatever it contained has long evaporated.
Rule.Raw: This small canister has been smashed to pieces and whatever it contained has long evaporated.
Rule.Translated: Este pequeño recipiente está hecho pedazos y lo que contuviera se evaporó hace mucho.

Rule.Original: Whatever this barrel held has long ago evaporated.
Rule.Raw: Whatever this barrel held has long ago evaporated.
Rule.Translated: Lo que contuviera este bidón se evaporó hace mucho.

Rule.Original: Whatever this barrel held has long ago evaporated.
Rule.Raw: Whatever this barrel held has long ago evaporated.
Rule.Translated: Lo que contuviera este bidón se evaporó hace mucho.

Rule.Original: This server rack once housed a lot of genetic information, but all its data has now degraded completely.
Rule.Raw: This server rack once housed a lot of genetic information, but all its data has now degraded completely.
Rule.Translated: Este bastidor de servidores almacenaba mucha información genética, pero todos sus datos se han degradado por completo.

Rule.Original: This was once a smart table. But now it's dumb.
Rule.Raw: This was once a smart table. But now it's dumb.
Rule.Translated: Antes era una mesa inteligente. Ahora es una mesa tonta.

Rule.Original: This tangle of decayed cables were probably once housed inside the ceiling panels.
Rule.Raw: This tangle of decayed cables were probably once housed inside the ceiling panels.
Rule.Translated: Esta maraña de cables deteriorados probablemente estuvo alojada en los paneles del techo.

Rule.Original: Whatever this crate contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Raw: Whatever this crate contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Translated: Lo que contuviera esta caja se pudrió y se convirtió en polvo hace mucho.

Rule.Original: Whatever this crate contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Raw: Whatever this crate contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Translated: Lo que contuviera esta caja se pudrió y se convirtió en polvo hace mucho.

Rule.Original: Whatever this crate contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Raw: Whatever this crate contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Translated: Lo que contuviera esta caja se pudrió y se convirtió en polvo hace mucho.

Rule.Original: Whatever these crates contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Raw: Whatever these crates contained has long ago rotted and turned to dust.
Rule.Translated: Lo que contuvieran estas cajas se pudrió y se convirtió en polvo hace mucho.

Rule.Original: Small canisters that once held some valuable liquids.
Rule.Raw: Small canisters that once held some valuable liquids.
Rule.Translated: Pequeños recipientes que antes contenían líquidos valiosos.

Rule.Original: Rusted shelving units coated in grime and dust.
Rule.Raw: Rusted shelving units coated in grime and dust.
Rule.Translated: Estanterías oxidadas cubiertas de suciedad y polvo.

Rule.Original: This workbench appears to have been used to try and reverse engineer mechanoid components, but it is damaged to the point of uselessness.
Rule.Raw: This workbench appears to have been used to try and reverse engineer mechanoid components, but it is damaged to the point of uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Este banco de trabajo parece haberse utilizado para estudiar y reproducir componentes de mecanoides, pero está tan dañado que resulta inútil.

Rule.Original: A machine used to process mutagenic minerals, now completely broken and unsalvageable.
Rule.Raw: A machine used to process mutagenic minerals, now completely broken and unsalvageable.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina para procesar minerales mutagénicos, completamente averiada e irrecuperable.

Rule.Original: A slurry of liquefied organic pulp filled this reinforced glass vat. It now lays broken and empty.
Rule.Raw: A slurry of liquefied organic pulp filled this reinforced glass vat. It now lays broken and empty.
Rule.Translated: Este tanque de cristal reforzado contenía una mezcla de pulpa orgánica licuada. Ahora está roto y vacío.

Rule.Original: A weird-looking machine that shredded wood into organic pulp. Broken beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: A weird-looking machine that shredded wood into organic pulp. Broken beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina de aspecto extraño que trituraba madera para obtener pulpa orgánica. Dañada sin remedio.

Rule.Original: An obsolete, ancient machine that recycled wood, corpses and bones into organic pulp. Broken beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: An obsolete, ancient machine that recycled wood, corpses and bones into organic pulp. Broken beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua máquina obsoleta que reciclaba madera, cadáveres y huesos para obtener pulpa orgánica. Dañada sin remedio.

Rule.Original: These structural cryofuel coils have been completely ruined by time and neglect. They can no longer function.
Rule.Raw: These structural cryofuel coils have been completely ruined by time and neglect. They can no longer function.
Rule.Translated: Estas bobinas estructurales de criocombustible están completamente deterioradas por el tiempo y el abandono. Ya no pueden funcionar.

Rule.Original: A metal sarcophagus used to grow bio-mechanic implants in a controlled manner. Its machinery has been gutted and has later decayed into rusted scrap.
Rule.Raw: A metal sarcophagus used to grow bio-mechanic implants in a controlled manner. Its machinery has been gutted and has later decayed into rusted scrap.
Rule.Translated: Un sarcófago metálico utilizado para cultivar implantes biomecánicos de forma controlada. Su maquinaria fue desmantelada y luego se convirtió en chatarra oxidada.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.
Rule.Translated: Un banco antiguo de taquillas oxidadas. Todas han sido forzadas y no queda nada de valor.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.
Rule.Translated: Un banco antiguo de taquillas oxidadas. Todas han sido forzadas y no queda nada de valor.

Rule.Original: These monitors will never show any information again.
Rule.Raw: These monitors will never show any information again.
Rule.Translated: Estos monitores nunca volverán a mostrar información.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Raw: A weathered sign advertising a company that has long been forgotten.
Rule.Translated: Un letrero desgastado que anuncia una empresa olvidada hace mucho.

Rule.Original: Drinking from this will give you more than just a few rads...
Rule.Raw: Drinking from this will give you more than just a few rads...
Rule.Translated: Beber de esto te dará mucho más que unas pocas dosis de radiación...

Rule.Original: Drinking from this will give you more than just a few rads...
Rule.Raw: Drinking from this will give you more than just a few rads...
Rule.Translated: Beber de esto te dará mucho más que unas pocas dosis de radiación...

Rule.Original: A metallic capsule filled with some bioluminescent compound. Seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A metallic capsule filled with some bioluminescent compound. Seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula metálica llena de un compuesto bioluminiscente. Parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A metallic capsule filled with some bioluminescent compound. Seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A metallic capsule filled with some bioluminescent compound. Seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula metálica llena de un compuesto bioluminiscente. Parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: The broken maws of this ancient factory will never be able to close again.
Rule.Raw: The broken maws of this ancient factory will never be able to close again.
Rule.Translated: Las fauces rotas de esta antigua fábrica nunca volverán a cerrarse.

Rule.Original: A collapsed antenna that is completely unable of transmitting anything ever again.
Rule.Raw: A collapsed antenna that is completely unable of transmitting anything ever again.
Rule.Translated: Una antena derrumbada que jamás volverá a transmitir nada.

Rule.Original: A self-powered hermetically-sealed crate for preserving valuable items. These can preserve their contents for a long time. Sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered hermetically-sealed crate for preserving valuable items. These can preserve their contents for a long time. Sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: Una caja hermética con alimentación propia para conservar objetos valiosos durante mucho tiempo. Está sellada.

Rule.Original: A large self-powered hermetically-sealed crate with built-in security alarms. These can preserve their contents for a long time. Sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: A large self-powered hermetically-sealed crate with built-in security alarms. These can preserve their contents for a long time. Sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: Una gran caja hermética con alimentación propia y alarmas de seguridad integradas, capaz de conservar su contenido durante mucho tiempo. Está sellada.

Rule.Original: An ancient console with an attached communications dish. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient console with an attached communications dish. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua consola con una antena de comunicaciones. Faltan las piezas valiosas y el resto está deteriorado hasta resultar inútil.

Rule.Original: An ancient, depleted fuel node once used to charge machines with fuel.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, depleted fuel node once used to charge machines with fuel.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo nodo de combustible agotado, utilizado para abastecer máquinas.

Rule.Original: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame.
Rule.Raw: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame.
Rule.Translated: Un colchón viejo y podrido sobre un armazón oxidado.

Rule.Original: An ancient computer interface. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient computer interface. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua interfaz informática. Faltan las piezas valiosas y el resto está deteriorado hasta resultar inútil.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una caja antigua y rota. Todo lo valioso que contuviera se ha deteriorado hasta resultar inútil.

Rule.Original: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.
Rule.Translated: Una caja antigua de aspecto militar. Se rompió hace mucho y saquearon todo lo valioso que contenía.

Rule.Original: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa utilizada antaño para operaciones quirúrgicas. Lleva mucho tiempo deteriorada e inutilizada.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.
Rule.Translated: Un carrito de compra antiguo y oxidado. Cómo llegó aquí es un misterio, pero su historia es larga y probablemente bastante triste.

Rule.Original: An ancient stove. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient stove. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua cocina. Destrozada y oxidada, ahora resulta completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo horno. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora resulta completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo cajero automático. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora resulta completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua boca de incendios. Muy oxidada, ahora resulta completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo dispositivo para calentar comida. Destrozado y oxidado, ahora resulta completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Raw: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo inodoro. Destrozado hace mucho, ahora resulta completamente inútil.\n\nEs difícil saber cómo llegó aquí.

Rule.Original: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo frigorífico. Sus piezas útiles fueron retiradas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Raw: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua rueda de algún vehículo. La goma se ha desintegrado y el metal está retorcido y oxidado.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un coche antiguo y averiado. Todo lo que no se ha oxidado fue saqueado hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un camión antiguo y averiado. Todo lo útil se ha oxidado o fue saqueado hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un transporte de tropas antiguo y averiado. Todo lo que no se ha oxidado fue saqueado hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.
Rule.Translated: Un chasis de coche antiguo y oxidado. La carrocería se desintegró por la corrosión hace mucho.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient armored troop carrier which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient armored troop carrier which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un antiguo transporte blindado de tropas destruido por algún arma pesada. Todos sus componentes útiles fueron saqueados o se deterioraron hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Raw: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Translated: Una fortificación defensiva para detener vehículos. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose.

Rule.Original: A large, ancient engine block from some giant vehicle or power source. It's rusted through, and all the useful components are gone. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Raw: A large, ancient engine block from some giant vehicle or power source. It's rusted through, and all the useful components are gone. No repair could salvage this.
Rule.Translated: Un gran bloque de motor antiguo de algún vehículo gigante o fuente de energía. Está completamente oxidado y faltan todos los componentes útiles. No puede recuperarse con ninguna reparación.

Rule.Original: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.
Rule.Raw: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.
Rule.Translated: Un tramo de antigua alambrada de cuchillas. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose y ya no supone ningún peligro.

Rule.Original: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.
Rule.Raw: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.
Rule.Translated: Un montón de tuberías viejas y oxidadas. Es difícil saber cómo acabaron aquí.

Rule.Original: A large container from some ancient freight carrying vehicle. It has long since been looted and deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A large container from some ancient freight carrying vehicle. It has long since been looted and deteriorated into uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un gran contenedor de algún antiguo vehículo de carga. Fue saqueado hace mucho y se ha deteriorado hasta resultar inútil.

Rule.Original: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.
Rule.Raw: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de seguridad antigua y averiada. Todas las piezas valiosas fueron saqueadas o destrozadas.

Rule.Original: A celebratory tree decorated with ornaments and lights traditionally made as part of Christmas celebrations. Made of plastic.
Rule.Raw: A celebratory tree decorated with ornaments and lights traditionally made as part of Christmas celebrations. Made of plastic.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol festivo adornado con luces y decoraciones, tradicionalmente preparado para celebrar la Navidad. Está hecho de plástico.

Rule.Original: Plastic grass painted in the same colour as gauranlen moss. Probably terrible for the environment.
Rule.Raw: Plastic grass painted in the same colour as gauranlen moss. Probably terrible for the environment.
Rule.Translated: Hierba de plástico pintada del mismo color que el musgo gauranlen. Probablemente pésima para el medio ambiente.

Rule.Original: Plastic tree imitating a gauranlen tree. No dryads here.
Rule.Raw: Plastic tree imitating a gauranlen tree. No dryads here.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol de plástico que imita un árbol gauranlen. Este no tiene dríadas.

Rule.Original: A fake meaty bioengineered mushroom grown for its nutritious value.
Rule.Raw: A fake meaty bioengineered mushroom grown for its nutritious value.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una seta carnosa modificada mediante bioingeniería por su valor nutritivo.

Rule.Original: A fake inedible, fibrous plant which usually produces a small amount of a wood-like substance.
Rule.Raw: A fake inedible, fibrous plant which usually produces a small amount of a wood-like substance.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una planta fibrosa e incomestible que suele producir una pequeña cantidad de una sustancia similar a la madera.

Rule.Original: A fake tall brown mushroom with a long stem.
Rule.Raw: A fake tall brown mushroom with a long stem.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una seta marrón alta y de tallo largo.

Rule.Original: A fake tree, pruned and shaped to look visually pleasing.
Rule.Raw: A fake tree, pruned and shaped to look visually pleasing.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol artificial, podado y moldeado para resultar agradable a la vista.

Rule.Original: A cardboard imitation of the central core of an archonexus.
Rule.Raw: A cardboard imitation of the central core of an archonexus.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de cartón del núcleo central de un arquonexo.

Rule.Original: A cardboard imitation of a grand archotech structure of towering height and impressive bulk.
Rule.Raw: A cardboard imitation of a grand archotech structure of towering height and impressive bulk.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de cartón de una enorme estructura arquitécnica de altura y volumen imponentes.

Rule.Original: A cardboard imitation of a large archotech structure.
Rule.Raw: A cardboard imitation of a large archotech structure.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de cartón de una gran estructura arquitécnica.

Rule.Original: A cardboard imitation of a large archotech structure.
Rule.Raw: A cardboard imitation of a large archotech structure.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de cartón de una gran estructura arquitécnica.
Un antiguo dron espacial de ultratecnología. Desactivado.

Rule.Original: Don't seem to contain any important information.
Rule.Raw: Don't seem to contain any important information.

Rule.Original: This is NOT the latest fashion.
Rule.Raw: This is NOT the latest fashion.
Rule.Translated: Esto NO es lo último en moda.

Rule.Original: I picture it tasting like Tang.
Rule.Raw: I picture it tasting like Tang.
Rule.Translated: Me imagino que sabe a Tang.

Rule.Original: If these appear under your car, take it to a mechanic.
Rule.Raw: If these appear under your car, take it to a mechanic.
Rule.Translated: Si aparecen bajo tu coche, llévalo a un mecánico.

Rule.Original: A fake gibbet cage with nothing inside. Sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: A fake gibbet cage with nothing inside. Sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: Una jaula de ejecución artificial y vacía. Está sellada.

Rule.Original: This fake pot is similar to those used for planting bonsai trees. Colonists will not plant anything here, so you can put a fake flower on top.
Rule.Raw: This fake pot is similar to those used for planting bonsai trees. Colonists will not plant anything here, so you can put a fake flower on top.
Rule.Translated: Esta maceta artificial se parece a las utilizadas para bonsáis. Los colonos no plantarán nada aquí, así que puedes colocarle una flor artificial encima.

Rule.Original: A small insectoid-made hole connecting to some unseen cave network deep under the surface. The walls are covered in insectoid goop and are too slippery to climb down. Seems to be empty inside.
Rule.Raw: A small insectoid-made hole connecting to some unseen cave network deep under the surface. The walls are covered in insectoid goop and are too slippery to climb down. Seems to be empty inside.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño agujero excavado por insectoides que conecta con una red de cuevas invisible, muy bajo la superficie. Las paredes están cubiertas de mucosidad y son demasiado resbaladizas para bajar. Parece vacío por dentro.

Rule.Original: A medium-sized insectoid-made hole connecting to some unseen cave network deep under the surface. The walls are covered in insectoid goop and are too slippery to climb down. Seems to be empty inside.
Rule.Raw: A medium-sized insectoid-made hole connecting to some unseen cave network deep under the surface. The walls are covered in insectoid goop and are too slippery to climb down. Seems to be empty inside.
Rule.Translated: Un agujero mediano excavado por insectoides que conecta con una red de cuevas invisible, muy bajo la superficie. Las paredes están cubiertas de mucosidad y son demasiado resbaladizas para bajar. Parece vacío por dentro.

Rule.Original: A massive insectoid-made hole connecting to some unseen cave network deep under the surface. The walls are covered in insectoid goop and are too slippery to climb down. Insectoid chittering can be heard from the tunnels beneath. Seems to be empty inside.
Rule.Raw: A massive insectoid-made hole connecting to some unseen cave network deep under the surface. The walls are covered in insectoid goop and are too slippery to climb down. Insectoid chittering can be heard from the tunnels beneath. Seems to be empty inside.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme agujero excavado por insectoides que conecta con una red de cuevas invisible, muy bajo la superficie. Las paredes están cubiertas de mucosidad y son demasiado resbaladizas para bajar. Desde los túneles se oyen chirridos de insectoides. Parece vacío por dentro.

Rule.Original: A large bioluminescent pod produced by giant insects.
Rule.Raw: A large bioluminescent pod produced by giant insects.
Rule.Translated: Una gran cápsula bioluminiscente producida por insectos gigantes.

Rule.Original: A large cluster of bioluminescent pods produced by giant insects.
Rule.Raw: A large cluster of bioluminescent pods produced by giant insects.
Rule.Translated: Un gran grupo de cápsulas bioluminiscentes producidas por insectos gigantes.

Rule.Original: An incredibly tall spire of bioluminescent pods produced by giant insects.
Rule.Raw: An incredibly tall spire of bioluminescent pods produced by giant insects.
Rule.Translated: Una torre increíblemente alta de cápsulas bioluminiscentes producidas por insectos gigantes.

Rule.Original: A medium-sized hive structure capable of generating small amounts of electricity, produced by giant insects. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A medium-sized hive structure capable of generating small amounts of electricity, produced by giant insects. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura de colmena mediana capaz de generar pequeñas cantidades de electricidad, producida por insectos gigantes. No funciona.

Rule.Original: An organic, firefoam pod produced by giant insects. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An organic, firefoam pod produced by giant insects. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula orgánica de espuma ignífuga producida por insectos gigantes. No funciona.

Rule.Original: A pillar that slowly grows clusters of insectoid tendrilmoss.
Rule.Raw: A pillar that slowly grows clusters of insectoid tendrilmoss.
Rule.Translated: Un pilar en el que crecen lentamente grupos de musgo de zarcillos insectoide.

Rule.Original: A hive-like structure created by giant insects.
Rule.Raw: A hive-like structure created by giant insects.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura similar a una colmena, creada por insectos gigantes.

Rule.Original: A deep organic bioreactor constantly generating insect jelly from nearby minerals and nutrition.
Rule.Raw: A deep organic bioreactor constantly generating insect jelly from nearby minerals and nutrition.
Rule.Translated: Un biorreactor profundo que genera continuamente jalea de insecto a partir de los minerales y nutrientes cercanos.

Rule.Original: A chunk of a spacecraft covered in biomass and insect jelly.
Rule.Raw: A chunk of a spacecraft covered in biomass and insect jelly.
Rule.Translated: Un fragmento de nave espacial cubierto de biomasa y jalea de insecto.

Rule.Original: An ancient ship part, torn off of a craft of unknown origin.
Rule.Raw: An ancient ship part, torn off of a craft of unknown origin.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua pieza de nave, arrancada de una embarcación de origen desconocido.

Rule.Original: A mysterious segment of a long destroyed spaceship.
Rule.Raw: A mysterious segment of a long destroyed spaceship.
Rule.Translated: Un misterioso segmento de una nave espacial destruida hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A hive of giant insects of the Kemian geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A hive of giant insects of the Kemian geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una colmena de insectos gigantes del linaje genético Kemian. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A hive of giant insects of the Chelis geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A hive of giant insects of the Chelis geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una colmena de insectos gigantes del linaje genético Chelis. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A hive of giant insects of the Xanides geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A hive of giant insects of the Xanides geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una colmena de insectos gigantes del linaje genético Xanides. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A hive of giant insects of the Nuchadus geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A hive of giant insects of the Nuchadus geneline. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una colmena de insectos gigantes del linaje genético Nuchadus. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: An artificially constructed hive of giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: An artificially constructed hive of giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una colmena de insectos gigantes construida artificialmente. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: These jelly cocoons keep swarmlings safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats while they undergo a metamorphosis process. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: These jelly cocoons keep swarmlings safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats while they undergo a metamorphosis process. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Estos capullos de jalea protegen a las crías del enjambre del fuego, las temperaturas extremas y otras amenazas mientras sufren una metamorfosis. No funcionan: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A bioluminescent pod produced by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A bioluminescent pod produced by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula bioluminiscente producida por insectos gigantes. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A deep canal that connects to some underground steam caverns, dug up by giant insects. Sprays out superheated steam at random, similar to steam geysers. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A deep canal that connects to some underground steam caverns, dug up by giant insects. Sprays out superheated steam at random, similar to steam geysers. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un canal profundo excavado por insectos gigantes que conecta con cavernas subterráneas de vapor. Expulsa vapor sobrecalentado al azar, como un géiser. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: An exotic, pulsating bioformation that forces attached insect jelly to undergo a chemical process that changes it into royal jelly. Produced by giant insects. Needs to be constructed on the creep and requires refueling with insect jelly in order to produce the royal variant. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: An exotic, pulsating bioformation that forces attached insect jelly to undergo a chemical process that changes it into royal jelly. Produced by giant insects. Needs to be constructed on the creep and requires refueling with insect jelly in order to produce the royal variant. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una bioformación exótica y palpitante que somete la jalea de insecto a un proceso químico para convertirla en jalea real. Producida por insectos gigantes. Debe construirse sobre la biomasa y abastecerse de jalea de insecto para producir la variedad real. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A hive-like structure created by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A hive-like structure created by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura similar a una colmena, creada por insectos gigantes. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A large, exotic goop spire created by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A large, exotic goop spire created by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una gran torre exótica de mucosidad creada por insectos gigantes. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A volatile pod covered in sharp chitin thorns, produced by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A volatile pod covered in sharp chitin thorns, produced by giant insects. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula inestable cubierta de espinas afiladas de quitina, producida por insectos gigantes. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A heavily-reinforced door made of an ultratech polymer, sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: A heavily-reinforced door made of an ultratech polymer, sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: Una puerta muy reforzada de polímero de ultratecnología. Está sellada.

Rule.Original: A heavily-reinforced door frame made of an ultratech polymer.
Rule.Raw: A heavily-reinforced door frame made of an ultratech polymer.
Rule.Translated: Un marco de puerta muy reforzado de polímero de ultratecnología.

Rule.Original: The crumbled remains of an ancient structure.
Rule.Raw: The crumbled remains of an ancient structure.
Rule.Translated: Los restos derrumbados de una antigua estructura.

Rule.Original: The remains of a mining vehicle. The valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: The remains of a mining vehicle. The valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un vehículo minero. Las piezas valiosas fueron saqueadas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A device meant for drilling deep into the earth. Any valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: A device meant for drilling deep into the earth. Any valuable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo para perforar las profundidades de la tierra. Las piezas valiosas fueron saqueadas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: The claw of an ancient mining mechanoid. All the parts are degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: The claw of an ancient mining mechanoid. All the parts are degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: La garra de un antiguo mecanoide minero. Todas sus piezas se han deteriorado hasta resultar inútiles.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient mining mechanoid. Its complex parts are all degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient mining mechanoid. Its complex parts are all degraded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un antiguo mecanoide minero. Todos sus componentes complejos se han deteriorado hasta resultar inútiles.

Rule.Original: An old, rudimentary research bench with corroded tools and faded notes. Nothing of value remains.
Rule.Raw: An old, rudimentary research bench with corroded tools and faded notes. Nothing of value remains.
Rule.Translated: Una vieja mesa de investigación rudimentaria con herramientas corroídas y notas descoloridas. No queda nada de valor.

Rule.Original: A dilapidated brewing table once used for fermentation. The equipment is rusted beyond use.
Rule.Raw: A dilapidated brewing table once used for fermentation. The equipment is rusted beyond use.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de elaboración de cerveza deteriorada, utilizada antaño para la fermentación. El equipo está tan oxidado que resulta inútil.

Rule.Original: A broken butcher's table littered with old stains.
Rule.Raw: A broken butcher's table littered with old stains.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de carnicería rota y cubierta de manchas antiguas.

Rule.Original: A crumbling lab table with shattered glassware. The equipment is useless and contaminated.
Rule.Raw: A crumbling lab table with shattered glassware. The equipment is useless and contaminated.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de laboratorio que se desmorona, con cristalería rota. El equipo está inutilizado y contaminado.

Rule.Original: A single bed frame with rusted metal and a torn mattress. It's better than sleeping on the ground, but just barely.
Rule.Raw: A single bed frame with rusted metal and a torn mattress. It's better than sleeping on the ground, but just barely.
Rule.Translated: Un armazón de cama individual con metal oxidado y un colchón rasgado. Es mejor que dormir en el suelo, pero por poco.

Rule.Original: A double bed with broken springs and a tattered mattress. It barely offers comfort, but two can sleep here if desperate.
Rule.Raw: A double bed with broken springs and a tattered mattress. It barely offers comfort, but two can sleep here if desperate.
Rule.Translated: Una cama doble con muelles rotos y un colchón hecho jirones. Apenas ofrece comodidad, pero pueden dormir dos personas si están desesperadas.

Rule.Original: A container of ancient ammunition. It's empty and any remaining rounds are corroded to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: A container of ancient ammunition. It's empty and any remaining rounds are corroded to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente de munición antigua. Está vacío y los proyectiles que queden están corroídos e inutilizados.

Rule.Original: A rusted antenna used to transmit long-forgotten communications.
Rule.Raw: A rusted antenna used to transmit long-forgotten communications.
Rule.Translated: Una antena oxidada utilizada para transmitir comunicaciones olvidadas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A small rusted generator. The fuel tank is empty and the engine is beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: A small rusted generator. The fuel tank is empty and the engine is beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño generador oxidado. El depósito está vacío y el motor es irreparable.

Rule.Original: An autocannon turret with a shattered barrel. The targeting system is missing and all the components are rusted and bent to uselessness.
Rule.Raw: An autocannon turret with a shattered barrel. The targeting system is missing and all the components are rusted and bent to uselessness.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta de cañón automático con el tubo destrozado. Falta el sistema de puntería y todos los componentes están oxidados y doblados hasta resultar inútiles.

Rule.Original: A heavy turret designed to fire uranium slugs. The mechanism is smashed and the ammo is depleted.
Rule.Raw: A heavy turret designed to fire uranium slugs. The mechanism is smashed and the ammo is depleted.
Rule.Translated: Una torreta pesada diseñada para disparar proyectiles de uranio. Su mecanismo está destrozado y la munición se ha agotado.

Rule.Original: A shattered mortar emplacement. It's smashed and will never work again.
Rule.Raw: A shattered mortar emplacement. It's smashed and will never work again.
Rule.Translated: Un emplazamiento de mortero destrozado. Nunca volverá a funcionar.

Rule.Original: A rusted shipping container. It's completely empty.
Rule.Raw: A rusted shipping container. It's completely empty.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de transporte oxidado. Está completamente vacío.

Rule.Original: A rusted shipping container. It's completely empty.
Rule.Raw: A rusted shipping container. It's completely empty.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de transporte oxidado. Está completamente vacío.

Rule.Original: A rusted shipping container. Its contents are worthless.
Rule.Raw: A rusted shipping container. Its contents are worthless.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor de transporte oxidado. Su contenido no tiene valor.

Rule.Original: A pallet for stacking and transporting crates. The contents have been scavenged long ago.
Rule.Raw: A pallet for stacking and transporting crates. The contents have been scavenged long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un palé para apilar y transportar cajas. Su contenido fue saqueado hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A weathered wooden crate. It's empty, and the wood is brittle.
Rule.Raw: A weathered wooden crate. It's empty, and the wood is brittle.
Rule.Translated: Una caja de madera desgastada. Está vacía y la madera es quebradiza.

Rule.Original: The base of a large industrial crane.
Rule.Raw: The base of a large industrial crane.
Rule.Translated: La base de una gran grúa industrial.

Rule.Original: A rusted crane arm, twisted and broken.
Rule.Raw: A rusted crane arm, twisted and broken.
Rule.Translated: Un brazo de grúa oxidado, retorcido y roto.

Rule.Original: A smaller chunk of a crane arm, snapped and rusted.
Rule.Raw: A smaller chunk of a crane arm, snapped and rusted.
Rule.Translated: Un fragmento más pequeño de brazo de grúa, partido y oxidado.

Rule.Original: A vertical support column from a ruined crane. It's rusted and no longer stable.
Rule.Raw: A vertical support column from a ruined crane. It's rusted and no longer stable.
Rule.Translated: Una columna de soporte vertical de una grúa destrozada. Está oxidada y ya no es estable.

Rule.Original: A broken forklift, rusted and missing parts. It's far too damaged to be repaired.
Rule.Raw: A broken forklift, rusted and missing parts. It's far too damaged to be repaired.
Rule.Translated: Una carretilla elevadora averiada, oxidada y con piezas faltantes. Está demasiado dañada para repararla.

Rule.Original: An industrial truck, heavily rusted and abandoned. The engine is beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: An industrial truck, heavily rusted and abandoned. The engine is beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Un camión industrial abandonado y muy oxidado. Su motor es irreparable.

Rule.Original: A metal crate, now rusted shut. It's empty and worthless.
Rule.Raw: A metal crate, now rusted shut. It's empty and worthless.
Rule.Translated: Una caja metálica atascada por el óxido. Está vacía y no tiene valor.

Rule.Original: An soggy cardboard box filled with old detritus.
Rule.Raw: An soggy cardboard box filled with old detritus.
Rule.Translated: Una caja de cartón empapada, llena de desperdicios antiguos.

Rule.Original: An industrial shelf covered in rust. It offers nothing of value.
Rule.Raw: An industrial shelf covered in rust. It offers nothing of value.
Rule.Translated: Una estantería industrial cubierta de óxido. No contiene nada de valor.

Rule.Original: An ancient shelf. There's nothing useful left on it.
Rule.Raw: An ancient shelf. There's nothing useful left on it.
Rule.Translated: Una estantería antigua. No queda nada útil en ella.

Rule.Original: A ruined console. It is now completely inoperable. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: A ruined console. It is now completely inoperable. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una consola destrozada y completamente inoperativa. Sus piezas útiles fueron destruidas o saqueadas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A ruined console. It is now completely inoperable. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: A ruined console. It is now completely inoperable. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una consola destrozada y completamente inoperativa. Sus piezas útiles fueron destruidas o saqueadas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A pallet containing fake medical supplies.
Rule.Raw: A pallet containing fake medical supplies.
Rule.Translated: Un palé con suministros médicos artificiales.

Rule.Original: A pallet containing fake survival meals.
Rule.Raw: A pallet containing fake survival meals.
Rule.Translated: Un palé con comidas de supervivencia artificiales.

Rule.Original: A box filled with fake components.
Rule.Raw: A box filled with fake components.
Rule.Translated: Una caja llena de componentes artificiales.

Rule.Original: A box of fake advanced components.
Rule.Raw: A box of fake advanced components.
Rule.Translated: Una caja de componentes avanzados artificiales.

Rule.Original: A box filled with fake steel scrap. It's heavy.
Rule.Raw: A box filled with fake steel scrap. It's heavy.
Rule.Translated: Una caja llena de chatarra de acero artificial. Pesa mucho.

Rule.Original: A cargo pod with a faulty release mechanism. It's still sealed, and empty.
Rule.Raw: A cargo pod with a faulty release mechanism. It's still sealed, and empty.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula de carga con el mecanismo de apertura averiado. Sigue sellada y está vacía.

Rule.Original: A sealed canister of chemfuel. It is empty.
Rule.Raw: A sealed canister of chemfuel. It is empty.
Rule.Translated: Un bidón sellado de combustible químico. Está vacío.

Rule.Original: A locked safe. It's heavily rusted, and empty.
Rule.Raw: A locked safe. It's heavily rusted, and empty.
Rule.Translated: Una caja fuerte cerrada. Está muy oxidada y vacía.

Rule.Original: A pallet stacked with fake steel scrap.
Rule.Raw: A pallet stacked with fake steel scrap.
Rule.Translated: Un palé con chatarra de acero artificial apilada.

Rule.Original: A small crate that's still sealed.
Rule.Raw: A small crate that's still sealed.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja que sigue sellada.

Rule.Original: A small container that's still sealed.
Rule.Raw: A small container that's still sealed.
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño recipiente que sigue sellado.

Rule.Original: A chunk of mechanoid spacecraft made of steel and gravlite panels. It seems to have been torn off either by uncontrolled re-entry forces or some kind of weapon.
Rule.Raw: A chunk of mechanoid spacecraft made of steel and gravlite panels. It seems to have been torn off either by uncontrolled re-entry forces or some kind of weapon.
Rule.Translated: Un fragmento de nave mecanoide hecho de acero y paneles de gravlita. Parece arrancado por las fuerzas de una reentrada descontrolada o por algún arma.

Rule.Original: The ultratech heart of a gravship. Generates lift by inverting and intensifying gravity in a field around itself. Upon closer inspection it seems to be made out of cardboard.
Rule.Raw: The ultratech heart of a gravship. Generates lift by inverting and intensifying gravity in a field around itself. Upon closer inspection it seems to be made out of cardboard.
Rule.Translated: El corazón de ultratecnología de una gravinave. Genera sustentación al invertir e intensificar la gravedad en un campo a su alrededor. Al examinarlo de cerca, parece hecho de cartón.

Rule.Original: Extends the area in which substructure can be built and increases support capacity. This extender seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: Extends the area in which substructure can be built and increases support capacity. This extender seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Amplía la zona donde puede construirse la subestructura y aumenta la capacidad de soporte. Este extensor parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravship. This console seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravship. This console seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz para lanzar y pilotar una gravinave. Esta consola parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A chemfuel storage tank that supplies fuel for thrusters on a gravship. This tank seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A chemfuel storage tank that supplies fuel for thrusters on a gravship. This tank seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un depósito de combustible químico que abastece los propulsores de una gravinave. Este depósito parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A massive chemfuel storage tank that supplies fuel for thrusters on a gravship. This tank seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A massive chemfuel storage tank that supplies fuel for thrusters on a gravship. This tank seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme depósito de combustible químico que abastece los propulsores de una gravinave. Este depósito parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A chemfuel thruster that increases the range of a gravship. This thruster seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A chemfuel thruster that increases the range of a gravship. This thruster seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un propulsor de combustible químico que aumenta el alcance de una gravinave. Este propulsor parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: An advanced chemfuel thruster that greatly increases the range of a gravship. This thruster seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: An advanced chemfuel thruster that greatly increases the range of a gravship. This thruster seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un propulsor avanzado de combustible químico que aumenta considerablemente el alcance de una gravinave. Este propulsor parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A gravtech unit that reduces the fuel needed for gravship flight. This unit seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A gravtech unit that reduces the fuel needed for gravship flight. This unit seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad gravitécnica que reduce el combustible necesario para el vuelo de una gravinave. Esta unidad parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A signal emitter that disguises the electromagnetic signature of your gravship. This emitter seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A signal emitter that disguises the electromagnetic signature of your gravship. This emitter seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un emisor de señales que disimula la firma electromagnética de tu gravinave. Este emisor parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A power generator that draws energy from gravitational waves passing through the gravship. This generator seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A power generator that draws energy from gravitational waves passing through the gravship. This generator seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un generador que extrae energía de las ondas gravitatorias que atraviesan la gravinave. Este generador parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A low-grade subpersona specialized in gravship flight. This one only has access to chatGPT and is therefore dumber than a Steam mod commenter.
Rule.Raw: A low-grade subpersona specialized in gravship flight. This one only has access to chatGPT and is therefore dumber than a Steam mod commenter.
Rule.Translated: Una subpersona de baja categoría especializada en el vuelo de gravinaves. Esta solo tiene acceso a chatGPT y, por eso, es más tonta que un comentarista de mods de Steam.

Rule.Original: Creates a short-lived momentum repulsor surface to block projectiles. This generator seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: Creates a short-lived momentum repulsor surface to block projectiles. This generator seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Crea una superficie repulsora de impulso de corta duración para bloquear proyectiles. Este generador parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: Prevents the local map from being destroyed during a gravship launch. This anchor seems completely inert.
Rule.Raw: Prevents the local map from being destroyed during a gravship launch. This anchor seems completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Evita que el mapa local se destruya al lanzar una gravinave. Esta ancla parece completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A shield projecter that protects a nearby mechanoid relay. This one is completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A shield projecter that protects a nearby mechanoid relay. This one is completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un proyector de escudo que protege un repetidor mecanoide cercano. Este está completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A node that coordinates signals across a planet-wide mechanoid communication network. This one is completely inert.
Rule.Raw: A node that coordinates signals across a planet-wide mechanoid communication network. This one is completely inert.
Rule.Translated: Un nodo que coordina señales en una red planetaria de comunicaciones mecanoides. Este está completamente inerte.

Rule.Original: A node that coordinates signals across a planet-wide mechanoid communication network. Wrecked.
Rule.Raw: A node that coordinates signals across a planet-wide mechanoid communication network. Wrecked.
Rule.Translated: Un nodo que coordina señales en una red planetaria de comunicaciones mecanoides. Está destrozado.

Rule.Original: An ancient generator powered by a gravcore. Once capable of producing massive amounts of power, it has now fallen into disrepair.
Rule.Raw: An ancient generator powered by a gravcore. Once capable of producing massive amounts of power, it has now fallen into disrepair.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo generador alimentado por un gravinúcleo. Antes producía cantidades enormes de energía, pero ahora está deteriorado.

Rule.Original: An ultratech engine used to bring large structures and ships into orbit. Nonfunctional for many years.
Rule.Raw: An ultratech engine used to bring large structures and ships into orbit. Nonfunctional for many years.
Rule.Translated: Un motor de ultratecnología utilizado para llevar grandes estructuras y naves a órbita. Lleva muchos años sin funcionar.

Rule.Original: An explosive device used to quickly blast through rock. It is made from refined chemfuel. The explosive is old and inert.
Rule.Raw: An explosive device used to quickly blast through rock. It is made from refined chemfuel. The explosive is old and inert.
Rule.Translated: Un explosivo utilizado para abrirse paso rápidamente a través de la roca. Está hecho de combustible químico refinado. Es antiguo e inerte.

Rule.Original: A container of ancient mining charges. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: A container of ancient mining charges. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente de antiguas cargas mineras. Inactivo.

Rule.Original: A slimy sac containing an insect larva. This one is empty.
Rule.Raw: A slimy sac containing an insect larva. This one is empty.
Rule.Translated: Un saco viscoso que contiene una larva de insecto. Este está vacío.

Rule.Original: A stasis cocoon containing a locust. This one is empty.
Rule.Raw: A stasis cocoon containing a locust. This one is empty.
Rule.Translated: Un capullo de estasis que contiene una langosta. Este está vacío.

Rule.Original: An ancient cargo pod capable of carrying people, animals, and items. Not in working condition.
Rule.Raw: An ancient cargo pod capable of carrying people, animals, and items. Not in working condition.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua cápsula de carga capaz de transportar personas, animales y objetos. No funciona.

Rule.Original: The entrance to a long-abandoned subterranean facility. Sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: The entrance to a long-abandoned subterranean facility. Sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: La entrada de una instalación subterránea abandonada hace mucho. Está sellada.

Rule.Original: A launchable cargo pod intended to carry mechanoids. Not in working condition.
Rule.Raw: A launchable cargo pod intended to carry mechanoids. Not in working condition.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula de carga lanzable destinada a transportar mecanoides. No funciona.

Rule.Original: An ancient terraforming device powered by a gravcore. It is inert.
Rule.Raw: An ancient terraforming device powered by a gravcore. It is inert.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo dispositivo de terraformación alimentado por un gravinúcleo. Está inerte.

Rule.Original: The thinking mind of the mechanoid swarm. Powered by Linux.
Rule.Raw: The thinking mind of the mechanoid swarm. Powered by Linux.
Rule.Translated: La mente pensante del enjambre mecanoide. Funciona con Linux.

Rule.Original: The smashed neural nexus of the mechanoid swarm that once commanded mechanoids around the planet.
Rule.Raw: The smashed neural nexus of the mechanoid swarm that once commanded mechanoids around the planet.
Rule.Translated: El nexo neural destrozado del enjambre mecanoide que antes controlaba a los mecanoides del planeta.

Rule.Original: A remote shield generator that makes the nearby cerebrex core nearly invincible. Or it would, if it wasn't fake.
Rule.Raw: A remote shield generator that makes the nearby cerebrex core nearly invincible. Or it would, if it wasn't fake.
Rule.Translated: Un generador remoto de escudo que vuelve casi invencible al núcleo cerebrex cercano. O lo haría, si no fuera una imitación.

Rule.Original: A powerful mechanoid computer running Windows 98.
Rule.Raw: A powerful mechanoid computer running Windows 98.
Rule.Translated: Un potente ordenador mecanoide que ejecuta Windows 98.

Rule.Original: A chemfuel-powered shuttle designed for long-distance travel. This one refuses to start.
Rule.Raw: A chemfuel-powered shuttle designed for long-distance travel. This one refuses to start.
Rule.Translated: Una lanzadera de combustible químico diseñada para viajes de larga distancia. Esta se niega a arrancar.

Rule.Original: A node in a distributed mechanoid computation network.
Rule.Raw: A node in a distributed mechanoid computation network.
Rule.Translated: Un nodo de una red distribuida de computación mecanoide.

Rule.Original: A wideband sensor unit that can detect and map various features in a local area.
Rule.Raw: A wideband sensor unit that can detect and map various features in a local area.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de sensores de banda ancha que puede detectar y cartografiar diversos rasgos de la zona.

Rule.Original: An ancient transmitter used for secure communications between the surface and orbit.
Rule.Raw: An ancient transmitter used for secure communications between the surface and orbit.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo transmisor utilizado para comunicaciones seguras entre la superficie y la órbita.

Rule.Original: A massive anti-ship cannon that uses electromagnets to launch large metallic darts at extreme velocities. Pew pew.
Rule.Raw: A massive anti-ship cannon that uses electromagnets to launch large metallic darts at extreme velocities. Pew pew.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme cañón antinaves que usa electroimanes para lanzar grandes dardos metálicos a velocidades extremas. Pium, pium.

Rule.Original: A massive anti-ship beam weapon. Pew pew.
Rule.Raw: A massive anti-ship beam weapon. Pew pew.
Rule.Translated: Una enorme arma de rayos antinaves. Pium, pium.

Rule.Original: An automated mechanoid factory. It periodically births fresh mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: An automated mechanoid factory. It periodically births fresh mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: Una fábrica automatizada de mecanoides. Produce nuevos mecanoides periódicamente.

Rule.Original: The entrance to a cave network. Seems to be just painted on the floor.
Rule.Raw: The entrance to a cave network. Seems to be just painted on the floor.
Rule.Translated: La entrada de una red de cuevas. Parece estar simplemente pintada en el suelo.

Rule.Original: A naturally-occurring break in the ground from which volcanic gases escape. These vents bring nutrients to the surface from deep underground. Collectively, the fumes they spew are enough to block out the sun.
Rule.Raw: A naturally-occurring break in the ground from which volcanic gases escape. These vents bring nutrients to the surface from deep underground. Collectively, the fumes they spew are enough to block out the sun.
Rule.Translated: Una grieta natural del terreno por la que escapan gases volcánicos. Estos respiraderos llevan nutrientes desde las profundidades hasta la superficie. En conjunto, sus emanaciones bastan para tapar el sol.

Rule.Original: The exhaust vent of some long forgotten underground megastructure. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Raw: The exhaust vent of some long forgotten underground megastructure. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Translated: El respiradero de alguna megaestructura subterránea olvidada hace mucho. Permanentemente inactivo.

Rule.Original: A massive duct that vents toxic fumes from an underground megastructure. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Raw: A massive duct that vents toxic fumes from an underground megastructure. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme conducto que libera vapores tóxicos de una megaestructura subterránea. Permanentemente inactivo.

Rule.Original: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Raw: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. Permanently inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme conducto que se adentra sin fin en el suelo. Permanentemente inactivo.

Rule.Original: An ancient light containing a long-lasting battery. Inactive
Rule.Raw: An ancient light containing a long-lasting battery. Inactive
Rule.Translated: Una antigua lámpara con una batería de larga duración. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: A unit connected to the orbital platform's larger life support network. It keeps rooms heated and pressurized.
Rule.Raw: A unit connected to the orbital platform's larger life support network. It keeps rooms heated and pressurized.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad conectada a la red general de soporte vital de la plataforma orbital. Mantiene las salas calentadas y presurizadas.

Rule.Original: A sensor unit that passively scans for irregular objects orbiting the planet. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: A sensor unit that passively scans for irregular objects orbiting the planet. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de sensores que busca pasivamente objetos irregulares en órbita alrededor del planeta. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: A small wall-mounted unit that does nothing.
Rule.Raw: A small wall-mounted unit that does nothing.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña unidad de pared que no hace nada.

Rule.Original: A dormant and inactive hunter drone trap.
Rule.Raw: A dormant and inactive hunter drone trap.
Rule.Translated: Una trampa de drones cazadores dormida e inactiva.

Rule.Original: Several dormant and inactive wasp drones.
Rule.Raw: Several dormant and inactive wasp drones.
Rule.Translated: Varios drones avispa dormidos e inactivos.

Rule.Original: A rusted machining table covered in debris. All useful parts have been scavenged.
Rule.Raw: A rusted machining table covered in debris. All useful parts have been scavenged.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de mecanizado oxidada y cubierta de escombros. Todas sus piezas útiles han sido retiradas.

Rule.Original: An ancient smithy that once burned fuel for crafting. Now, it's covered in soot and rust.
Rule.Raw: An ancient smithy that once burned fuel for crafting. Now, it's covered in soot and rust.
Rule.Translated: Una antigua herrería que quemaba combustible para fabricar objetos. Ahora está cubierta de hollín y óxido.

Rule.Original: A ruined electric smithy with frayed wires and scorched surfaces. It's beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: A ruined electric smithy with frayed wires and scorched surfaces. It's beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Una herrería eléctrica destrozada, con cables deshilachados y superficies chamuscadas. Es irreparable.

Rule.Original: An old electric stove with shattered heating elements. It's far too damaged to use.
Rule.Raw: An old electric stove with shattered heating elements. It's far too damaged to use.
Rule.Translated: Una vieja cocina eléctrica con las resistencias destrozadas. Está demasiado dañada para usarla.

Rule.Original: A rusted cooking stove. It's beyond unusable.
Rule.Raw: A rusted cooking stove. It's beyond unusable.
Rule.Translated: Una cocina oxidada. Está completamente inutilizada.

Rule.Original: A ruined tailor's bench with torn fabric and broken tools. It's beyond salvage.
Rule.Raw: A ruined tailor's bench with torn fabric and broken tools. It's beyond salvage.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de sastre destrozada, con telas rasgadas y herramientas rotas. No puede recuperarse.

Rule.Original: A simple tailor's bench with splintered wood and rusted needles. Nothing useful remains.
Rule.Raw: A simple tailor's bench with splintered wood and rusted needles. Nothing useful remains.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de sastre sencilla, con madera astillada y agujas oxidadas. No queda nada útil.

Rule.Original: A toppled wind turbine with broken blades. It's been scavenged for parts long ago.
Rule.Raw: A toppled wind turbine with broken blades. It's been scavenged for parts long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una turbina eólica derribada con las aspas rotas. Sus piezas útiles fueron retiradas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A concrete barrier used to block the path of vehicles.
Rule.Raw: A concrete barrier used to block the path of vehicles.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera de hormigón utilizada para impedir el paso de vehículos.

Rule.Original: A concrete barrier once used for military roadblocks.
Rule.Raw: A concrete barrier once used for military roadblocks.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera de hormigón utilizada antaño en controles militares de carretera.

Rule.Original: A rusted barrel that once stored chemfuel. It's empty and corroded.
Rule.Raw: A rusted barrel that once stored chemfuel. It's empty and corroded.
Rule.Translated: Un bidón oxidado que antes almacenaba combustible químico. Está vacío y corroído.

Rule.Original: A stack of rusted barrels on a decayed pallet. Any valuable fuel leaked out long ago.
Rule.Raw: A stack of rusted barrels on a decayed pallet. Any valuable fuel leaked out long ago.
Rule.Translated: Una pila de bidones oxidados sobre un palé deteriorado. Todo el combustible valioso se filtró hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An abandoned chemfuel transport truck. Any usable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Raw: An abandoned chemfuel transport truck. Any usable parts were looted long ago.
Rule.Translated: Un camión cisterna de combustible químico abandonado. Sus piezas útiles fueron saqueadas hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A faded and torn armchair. It's unusable in its current state.
Rule.Raw: A faded and torn armchair. It's unusable in its current state.
Rule.Translated: Un sillón descolorido y rasgado. No se puede usar en su estado actual.

Rule.Original: A large cracked pot with dead soil. Nothing can grow here any more.
Rule.Raw: A large cracked pot with dead soil. Nothing can grow here any more.
Rule.Translated: Una gran maceta agrietada con tierra muerta. Ya no puede crecer nada aquí.

Rule.Original: A shattered television set. The screen is broken and the electronics are stripped out.
Rule.Raw: A shattered television set. The screen is broken and the electronics are stripped out.
Rule.Translated: Un televisor destrozado. La pantalla está rota y la electrónica ha sido retirada.

Rule.Original: A bathtub with deep cracks and rust stains. It's completely unusable.
Rule.Raw: A bathtub with deep cracks and rust stains. It's completely unusable.
Rule.Translated: Una bañera con grietas profundas y manchas de óxido. Está completamente inutilizada.

Rule.Original: A broken shower stall. The plumbing is corroded and the ceramics are shattered.
Rule.Raw: A broken shower stall. The plumbing is corroded and the ceramics are shattered.
Rule.Translated: Una cabina de ducha rota. Las tuberías están corroídas y la cerámica, destrozada.

Rule.Original: A corroded filing cabinet. There's nothing useful left inside.
Rule.Raw: A corroded filing cabinet. There's nothing useful left inside.
Rule.Translated: Un archivador corroído. No queda nada útil dentro.

Rule.Original: An old refrigeration unit, now rusted shut. Any contents have long since decayed to dust.
Rule.Raw: An old refrigeration unit, now rusted shut. Any contents have long since decayed to dust.
Rule.Translated: Una vieja unidad de refrigeración atascada por el óxido. Su contenido se convirtió en polvo hace mucho.

Rule.Original: A set of metal lockers, heavily rusted and bent. They've been thoroughly looted.
Rule.Raw: A set of metal lockers, heavily rusted and bent. They've been thoroughly looted.
Rule.Translated: Un conjunto de taquillas metálicas muy oxidadas y dobladas. Han sido saqueadas por completo.

Rule.Original: An ancient microwave covered in rust. It's beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: An ancient microwave covered in rust. It's beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Un antiguo microondas cubierto de óxido. Es irreparable.

Rule.Original: A tree imitating those bioengineered to terraform deadworlds and early-stage rimworlds. This is a non-functional fake.
Rule.Raw: A tree imitating those bioengineered to terraform deadworlds and early-stage rimworlds. This is a non-functional fake.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol que imita a los modificados mediante bioingeniería para terraformar mundos muertos y mundos frontera en sus primeras etapas. Es una imitación que no funciona.

Rule.Original: A fake tall slender plant that grows in water.
Rule.Raw: A fake tall slender plant that grows in water.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una planta alta y delgada que crece en el agua.

Rule.Original: A fake water plant with a broad floating leaf.
Rule.Raw: A fake water plant with a broad floating leaf.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una planta acuática con una amplia hoja flotante.

Rule.Original: A fake plant commonly found in swamps, recognizable for its brown cigar-shaped top.
Rule.Raw: A fake plant commonly found in swamps, recognizable for its brown cigar-shaped top.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una planta habitual de los pantanos, reconocible por su espiga marrón con forma de puro.

Rule.Original: A fake aquatic plant known for its fragrant flowers.
Rule.Raw: A fake aquatic plant known for its fragrant flowers.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una planta acuática conocida por sus flores aromáticas.

Rule.Original: A fake prickly vine adapted to living in harsh conditions.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A fake prickly vine adapted to living in harsh conditions.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una enredadera espinosa adaptada a condiciones extremas.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A fake gnarled slow-growing tree, adapted to live in toxic scarlands.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A fake gnarled slow-growing tree, adapted to live in toxic scarlands.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol nudoso de crecimiento lento, adaptado a tierras devastadas y tóxicas.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A fake resilient species of cactus notable for its ability to survive extreme heat.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A fake resilient species of cactus notable for its ability to survive extreme heat.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una especie resistente de cactus, conocida por sobrevivir al calor extremo.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A fake grass-like fungus that grows as part of a massive mycelium network.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A fake grass-like fungus that grows as part of a massive mycelium network.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un hongo parecido a la hierba que crece como parte de una enorme red de micelio.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original:
These mushrooms produce volatile chemicals as a defensive measure. They can be harvested for chemfuel. However, this must be done with extreme caution, as the mushrooms can explode if they're destroyed.

Glitterworld researchers have used genetic material from boomshrooms to bioengineer a number of chemfuel-producing animals.

This object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw:
