These mushrooms produce volatile chemicals as a defensive measure. They can be harvested for chemfuel. However, this must be done with extreme caution, as the mushrooms can explode if they're destroyed.

Glitterworld researchers have used genetic material from boomshrooms to bioengineer a number of chemfuel-producing animals.

This object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated:
Estas setas producen sustancias volátiles como defensa. Pueden cosecharse para obtener combustible químico, pero hay que hacerlo con extrema precaución, ya que pueden explotar al destruirlas.

Investigadores de mundos brillantes han utilizado material genético de estas setas explosivas para crear animales productores de combustible químico mediante bioingeniería.

Este objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A fungus that gives off hallucinogenic spores. Standing next to them is enough to produce mild hallucinations. Psilocaps can be harvested and ingested to produce a vivid sensory experience that increases the user's mood.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A fungus that gives off hallucinogenic spores. Standing next to them is enough to produce mild hallucinations. Psilocaps can be harvested and ingested to produce a vivid sensory experience that increases the user's mood.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Un hongo que libera esporas alucinógenas. Basta con permanecer cerca para sufrir alucinaciones leves. Las psilosetas pueden cosecharse e ingerirse para producir una intensa experiencia sensorial que mejora el ánimo.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A tall spindly slow-growing mushroom with gills that droop like a willow tree. It gives off a soft light.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A tall spindly slow-growing mushroom with gills that droop like a willow tree. It gives off a soft light.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Una seta alta, delgada y de crecimiento lento, con láminas que cuelgan como las ramas de un sauce. Emite una luz tenue.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A distant cousin of the giant rafflesia, this plant has adapted to thrive in dark locations. Its beauty is tempered by a strong stench of musk and rotten eggs.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A distant cousin of the giant rafflesia, this plant has adapted to thrive in dark locations. Its beauty is tempered by a strong stench of musk and rotten eggs.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Una pariente lejana de la raflesia gigante, adaptada a prosperar en lugares oscuros. Su belleza queda empañada por un fuerte hedor a almizcle y huevos podridos.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Hierba silvestre. Crece donde hay algo de luz y un suelo mínimamente fértil.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: Wild tall grass that grows in tough thickets. It slows down anyone moving over it.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: Wild tall grass that grows in tough thickets. It slows down anyone moving over it.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Hierba alta silvestre que crece en matas resistentes. Ralentiza a quien la atraviesa.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A low-lying plant that produces clusters of purple flowers. It is common in alpine environments.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Raw: A low-lying plant that produces clusters of purple flowers. It is common in alpine environments.\n\nThis object is inert and serves no biological function.
Rule.Translated: Una planta baja que produce racimos de flores moradas. Es común en entornos alpinos.\n\nEste objeto es inerte y no cumple ninguna función biológica.

Rule.Original: A fake mechanoid power generation unit. It won't output any power.
Rule.Raw: A fake mechanoid power generation unit. It won't output any power.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad mecanoide de generación de energía artificial. No produce electricidad.

Rule.Original: A self-powered mechanoid node of unknown function. Deactivated.
Rule.Raw: A self-powered mechanoid node of unknown function. Deactivated.
Rule.Translated: Un nodo mecanoide de función desconocida y alimentación propia. Desactivado.

Rule.Original: An area-denial device which annihilates nearby plants without affecting animals. Permanently out of order.
Rule.Raw: An area-denial device which annihilates nearby plants without affecting animals. Permanently out of order.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de bloqueo de zonas que aniquila las plantas cercanas sin afectar a los animales. Permanentemente fuera de servicio.

Rule.Original: A timed mechanoid activation unit. After counting down, it will... do nothing... Welp.
Rule.Raw: A timed mechanoid activation unit. After counting down, it will... do nothing... Welp.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad temporizada de activación de mecanoides. Al terminar la cuenta atrás... no hará nada... En fin.

Rule.Original: A proximity alarm for dormant mechanoids. If it detects a human-like threat nearby, it will... do nothing... Welp.
Rule.Raw: A proximity alarm for dormant mechanoids. If it detects a human-like threat nearby, it will... do nothing... Welp.
Rule.Translated: Una alarma de proximidad para mecanoides dormidos. Si detecta una amenaza humanoide cercana... no hará nada... En fin.

Rule.Original: A shielding device which projects a momentum repulsor field. Or it would, it it wasn't so fake.
Rule.Raw: A shielding device which projects a momentum repulsor field. Or it would, it it wasn't so fake.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de escudo que proyecta un campo repulsor de impulso. O lo haría, si no fuera tan artificial.

Rule.Original: A shielding device which projects a momentum repulsor field. Or it would, it it wasn't so fake.
Rule.Raw: A shielding device which projects a momentum repulsor field. Or it would, it it wasn't so fake.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de escudo que proyecta un campo repulsor de impulso. O lo haría, si no fuera tan artificial.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid storage and deployment capsule. Sealed shut and inactive.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid storage and deployment capsule. Sealed shut and inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula de almacenamiento y despliegue de mecanoides. Sellada e inactiva.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid storage and deployment capsule. Open and empty.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid storage and deployment capsule. Open and empty.
Rule.Translated: Una cápsula de almacenamiento y despliegue de mecanoides. Abierta y vacía.

Rule.Original: An automated mechanoid factory. Deactivated and sealed shut.
Rule.Raw: An automated mechanoid factory. Deactivated and sealed shut.
Rule.Translated: Una fábrica automatizada de mecanoides. Desactivada y sellada.

Rule.Original: A mechanoid reinforcement drop beacon. When activated, it does nothing, because it's not real. Imaginary mechanoids can't hurt you.
Rule.Raw: A mechanoid reinforcement drop beacon. When activated, it does nothing, because it's not real. Imaginary mechanoids can't hurt you.
Rule.Translated: Una baliza de lanzamiento de refuerzos mecanoides. Al activarse no hace nada, porque no es real. Los mecanoides imaginarios no pueden hacerte daño.

Rule.Original: An ultratech machine that generates a sheet of exotic fields at high altitude, turning the sky opaque and blocking the sun. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: An ultratech machine that generates a sheet of exotic fields at high altitude, turning the sky opaque and blocking the sun. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Una máquina de ultratecnología que genera una lámina de campos exóticos a gran altitud, volviendo el cielo opaco y bloqueando el sol. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: An ultratech weapon of mass destruction designed for area denial. By harvesting available compounds and converting them into self-reproducing opaque molecules, it can spew enough smoke to block the sun in a whole region of the planet. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: An ultratech weapon of mass destruction designed for area denial. By harvesting available compounds and converting them into self-reproducing opaque molecules, it can spew enough smoke to block the sun in a whole region of the planet. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de destrucción masiva de ultratecnología diseñada para bloquear zonas. Recoge compuestos disponibles y los convierte en moléculas opacas autorreplicantes, produciendo suficiente humo para tapar el sol en toda una región del planeta. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: An ultratech weapon of mass destruction designed for area denial. This device harvests available compounds and converts them into self-reproducing poisons. By spewing these into the atmosphere, it can poison a whole region of the planet. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: An ultratech weapon of mass destruction designed for area denial. This device harvests available compounds and converts them into self-reproducing poisons. By spewing these into the atmosphere, it can poison a whole region of the planet. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Un arma de destrucción masiva de ultratecnología diseñada para bloquear zonas. Recoge compuestos disponibles y los convierte en venenos autorreplicantes que, liberados a la atmósfera, pueden envenenar toda una región del planeta. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: An ultratech device for controlling weather. Using chemicals and exotic fields, it forces the weather into a particular configuration. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: An ultratech device for controlling weather. Using chemicals and exotic fields, it forces the weather into a particular configuration. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de ultratecnología para controlar el tiempo atmosférico. Mediante sustancias químicas y campos exóticos, impone unas condiciones meteorológicas concretas. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: An ultratech device for controlling climate. Using chemicals and exotic fields to manipulate the atmosphere, it shifts the temperature in this region of the world. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: An ultratech device for controlling climate. Using chemicals and exotic fields to manipulate the atmosphere, it shifts the temperature in this region of the world. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de ultratecnología para controlar el clima. Manipula la atmósfera mediante sustancias químicas y campos exóticos para cambiar la temperatura de esta región del mundo. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: An archotech device transmitting the thoughts of a mad superintelligence. It generates a massive psychic drone tuned to one gender and affecting a whole region of the planet. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: An archotech device transmitting the thoughts of a mad superintelligence. It generates a massive psychic drone tuned to one gender and affecting a whole region of the planet. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo arquitécnico que transmite los pensamientos de una superinteligencia demente. Genera un enorme zumbido psíquico dirigido a un género y que afecta a toda una región del planeta. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: An archotech device that generates a massive psychic suppression field tuned to a particular gender. People of that gender have their psychic activity suppressed, reducing their consciousness. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: An archotech device that generates a massive psychic suppression field tuned to a particular gender. People of that gender have their psychic activity suppressed, reducing their consciousness. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo arquitécnico que genera un enorme campo de supresión psíquica dirigido a un género concreto. Suprime la actividad psíquica de las personas de ese género y reduce su consciencia. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: A massive electromagnetic interference generator. It interferes with or shuts down electrical devices in nearby regions. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Raw: A massive electromagnetic interference generator. It interferes with or shuts down electrical devices in nearby regions. Looking inside, you'll discover it's actually a cardboard cutout without any relevant machinery.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme generador de interferencias electromagnéticas. Interfiere con los dispositivos eléctricos de las regiones cercanas o los apaga. Al mirar dentro descubrirás que en realidad es una figura de cartón sin maquinaria útil.

Rule.Original: A decorative drape. This will not satisfy any noble requirements, as it is just for decorative purposes.
Rule.Raw: A decorative drape. This will not satisfy any noble requirements, as it is just for decorative purposes.
Rule.Translated: Un cortinaje decorativo. No satisface ningún requisito de los nobles, ya que solo sirve como decoración.
Una lanzadera imperial fuera de servicio.
Una lanzadera imperial MUY fuera de servicio.

Rule.Original: Plastic grass painted in the same colour as anima grass. Probably terrible for the environment.
Rule.Raw: Plastic grass painted in the same colour as anima grass. Probably terrible for the environment.
Rule.Translated: Hierba de plástico pintada del mismo color que la hierba ánima. Probablemente pésima para el medio ambiente.

Rule.Original: Plastic tree imitating an anima tree. Doesn't provide any sort of psychic powers.
Rule.Raw: Plastic tree imitating an anima tree. Doesn't provide any sort of psychic powers.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol de plástico que imita un árbol ánima. No proporciona ningún poder psíquico.

Rule.Original: Marks the corner of a landing area. Shuttles will ignore this one as it is inactive.
Rule.Raw: Marks the corner of a landing area. Shuttles will ignore this one as it is inactive.
Rule.Translated: Marca la esquina de una zona de aterrizaje. Las lanzaderas lo ignorarán porque está inactivo.

Rule.Original: A large, industrial-type heater machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. It is capable of heating up the room to a much higher temperature than the standard heaters. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A large, industrial-type heater machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. It is capable of heating up the room to a much higher temperature than the standard heaters. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de calefacción de grandes dimensiones que se comporta como un muro. Convierte la energía eléctrica en calor. Puede encenderse o apagarse automáticamente para mantener una temperatura determinada. Es capaz de calentar la habitación a una temperatura mucho más alta que los calefactores estándar. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A large, industrial-type air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. It’s capable of cooling the room to much lower temperature than the standard cooler. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A large, industrial-type air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. It’s capable of cooling the room to much lower temperature than the standard cooler. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de refrigeración de aire de grandes dimensiones que se comporta como un muro. El aire frío sale por un lado y el caliente, por el otro. Puede utilizarse para enfriar habitaciones en verano o para crear cámaras frigoríficas. Es capaz de enfriar la habitación a una temperatura mucho más baja que el refrigerador estándar. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A heating machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can be used to heat up rooms during winter. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A heating machine that fits into a wall. It converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can be used to heat up rooms during winter. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de calefacción que se comporta como una pared. Convierte la energía eléctrica en calor. Puede encenderse o apagarse automáticamente para mantener una temperatura determinada. Puede utilizarse para calentar habitaciones en invierno. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted device that converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted device that converts electricity into heat. It can automatically turn itself on or off to reach a specific target temperature. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de calefacción de pared que transforma la energía eléctrica en calor. Puede encenderse o apagarse automáticamente para mantener una temperatura determinada. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de refrigeración de aire de pared. El aire frío sale por un lado y el caliente, por el otro. Puede utilizarse para enfriar habitaciones en verano o para crear cámaras frigoríficas. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A simple, wall-mounted vent for equalizing the temperature between two rooms without allowing people to walk between them. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A simple, wall-mounted vent for equalizing the temperature between two rooms without allowing people to walk between them. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una sencilla rejilla de ventilación de pared que permite igualar la temperatura entre dos habitaciones a la vez que impide el paso de personas. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A free standing air-cooling machine. Cool air comes out of a fan and spreads over surrounding area. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A free standing air-cooling machine. Cool air comes out of a fan and spreads over surrounding area. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer. Not efficient enough to refrigerate food. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo de refrigeración de aire independiente. El aire frío sale de un ventilador y se esparce por los alrededores. Puede utilizarse para enfriar habitaciones en verano. No es lo bastante eficaz como para refrigerar alimentos. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: An air duct used by the AC network to transport air between the AC units and compressors. These do not transport anything.
Rule.Raw: An air duct used by the AC network to transport air between the AC units and compressors. These do not transport anything.
Rule.Translated: Un conducto que la red de aire acondicionado utiliza para transportar aire entre sus unidades y compresores. Estos no transportan nada.

Rule.Original: Switches air flow on/off. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: Switches air flow on/off. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Activa o desactiva el flujo de aire. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A main air conditioning control unit. Connects to compressors to allow AC units to generate cool or hot air. Needs to be connected to compressors by air ducts. AC control unit dictates the desired temperature for all AC units in the same network. Installing too many AC units may decrease the efficiency of the network, increasing the power drain of all devices. Constructing additional compressors will improve the efficiency of the network. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A main air conditioning control unit. Connects to compressors to allow AC units to generate cool or hot air. Needs to be connected to compressors by air ducts. AC control unit dictates the desired temperature for all AC units in the same network. Installing too many AC units may decrease the efficiency of the network, increasing the power drain of all devices. Constructing additional compressors will improve the efficiency of the network. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: La unidad principal de control de un sistema de climatización. Se conecta a los compresores para que las unidades de aire acondicionado puedan generar aire frío o caliente. Debe conectarse a los compresores mediante conductos de aire. La unidad de control de climatización es la que dicta la temperatura deseada para todas las unidades de aire acondicionado de su misma red. Instalar demasiadas unidades de aire acondicionado puede disminuir la eficiencia de la red, aumentando el consumo de energía de todos los dispositivos. La construcción de compresores adicionales mejorará la eficiencia de la red. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: An air-conditioning machine that fits into a wall. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: An air-conditioning machine that fits into a wall. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de aire acondicionado que se comporta como un muro. Emite aire frío o caliente en la misma dirección, dependiendo de la temperatura actual de la habitación. A menos que se desvincule de los ajustes de la red, intentará alcanzar la temperatura especificada en la unidad de control de climatización. Debe conectarse a la unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted air-conditioning machine. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted air-conditioning machine. Emits either cool or warm air in the same direction, depending on the current temperature of the room. Unless unlinked from the network settings, it will aim to achieve the temperature specified in the AC control unit. Needs to be connected to the AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be constructed on a wall. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de aire acondicionado que se monta sobre un muro. Emite aire frío o caliente en la misma dirección, dependiendo de la temperatura actual de la habitación. A menos que se desvincule de los ajustes de la red, intentará alcanzar la temperatura especificada en la unidad de control de climatización. Debe conectarse a la unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire. Solo puede construirse sobre un muro ya existente. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: An air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate two additional AC devices without losing efficiency. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: An air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate two additional AC devices without losing efficiency. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un compresor de aire acondicionado que debe conectarse a una unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire. Solo puede colocarse en el exterior. Cuando está alimentado, permite que la red de climatización haga funcionar dos dispositivos de climatización adicionales sin perder eficiencia. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A large air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate six additional AC devices without losing efficiency. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Raw: A large air conditioning compressor that needs to be connected to an AC control unit via air ducts. Can only be placed outside. When powered, it allows the AC network to operate six additional AC devices without losing efficiency. Non-functional: all its internal mechanisms have been removed.
Rule.Translated: Un compresor de aire acondicionado grande que debe conectarse a una unidad de control de climatización a través de conductos de aire. Solo puede colocarse en el exterior. Cuando está alimentado, permite que la red de climatización haga funcionar seis dispositivos de climatización adicionales sin perder eficiencia. No funciona: se han retirado todos sus mecanismos internos.

Rule.Original: A somewhat ornate countertop stocked to the brim with different vessels and devices for making a variety of drinks.
Rule.Raw: A somewhat ornate countertop stocked to the brim with different vessels and devices for making a variety of drinks.
Rule.Translated: Una encimera algo ornamentada, repleta de recipientes y dispositivos para preparar diversas bebidas.

Rule.Original: An all-in-one soda manufacturing unit. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An all-in-one soda manufacturing unit. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad integral de fabricación de refrescos. Esta está inactiva y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A gilded distillery of very delicate craftsmanship meant for aging ambrosia must into a drinkable form. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A gilded distillery of very delicate craftsmanship meant for aging ambrosia must into a drinkable form. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una destilería dorada de factura muy delicada, destinada a envejecer mosto de ambrosía hasta hacerlo bebible. Esta está inactiva y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A huge barrel meant for aging a high volume of whiskey at once. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A huge barrel meant for aging a high volume of whiskey at once. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme barril para envejecer grandes cantidades de whisky a la vez. Este está vacío y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A small still and fermenter combo unit. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A small still and fermenter combo unit. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña unidad que combina un alambique y un fermentador. Esta está vacía y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A cheap container meant for storing water retrofitted to be air tight for short-term fermenting. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A cheap container meant for storing water retrofitted to be air tight for short-term fermenting. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente barato para almacenar agua, modificado para ser hermético y permitir fermentaciones breves. Este está vacío y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A fully metal industrial distilling device, meant to purify and ferment gin into a drinkable form. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A fully metal industrial distilling device, meant to purify and ferment gin into a drinkable form. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un destilador industrial completamente metálico, destinado a purificar y fermentar ginebra hasta hacerla bebible. Este está vacío y no funciona.

Rule.Original: An espresso machine brews coffee by forcing pressurized water near boiling point through a "puck" of ground coffee and a filter in order to produce a thick, concentrated coffee called espresso. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An espresso machine brews coffee by forcing pressurized water near boiling point through a "puck" of ground coffee and a filter in order to produce a thick, concentrated coffee called espresso. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una cafetera exprés prepara café haciendo pasar agua casi hirviendo a presión por una pastilla de café molido y un filtro, para producir un café espeso y concentrado llamado espresso. Esta está inactiva y no funciona.

Rule.Original: An industrial liquid storage tank meant for storing chemfuel. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An industrial liquid storage tank meant for storing chemfuel. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un tanque industrial para almacenar combustible químico. Este está vacío y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A heavy industrial sludge storage tank meant for storing deepchem delivered via deepchem pipe network. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A heavy industrial sludge storage tank meant for storing deepchem delivered via deepchem pipe network. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un pesado tanque industrial de lodos para almacenar combustible profundo transportado por su red de tuberías. Este está vacío y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A working table to cut, slice and prepare condiments used in gourmet recipes.
Rule.Raw: A working table to cut, slice and prepare condiments used in gourmet recipes.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo para cortar y preparar condimentos utilizados en recetas de alta cocina.

Rule.Original: A fake, thick, tall, tropical grass with jointed stems. While not exactly the most nutritious thing to eat on its own, this genetically modified sugarcane is easily milled into sugar and then used for a variety of culinary creations - Particularly desserts.
Rule.Raw: A fake, thick, tall, tropical grass with jointed stems. While not exactly the most nutritious thing to eat on its own, this genetically modified sugarcane is easily milled into sugar and then used for a variety of culinary creations - Particularly desserts.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una hierba tropical alta y gruesa, con tallos segmentados. Aunque no es muy nutritiva por sí sola, esta caña de azúcar modificada genéticamente se muele fácilmente para obtener azúcar y preparar diversas creaciones culinarias, sobre todo postres.

Rule.Original: A fake, anomalous, leafy vine bearing tiny unpalatable green fruits. When ground finely during cooking the fruits release a complex, peppery flavor, perfect for spicing dishes.
Rule.Raw: A fake, anomalous, leafy vine bearing tiny unpalatable green fruits. When ground finely during cooking the fruits release a complex, peppery flavor, perfect for spicing dishes.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una enredadera anómala y frondosa, con diminutos frutos verdes de sabor desagradable. Al molerse finamente durante la cocina, liberan un sabor complejo y picante, perfecto para condimentar platos.

Rule.Original: A fake, amber cereal plant that takes almost an entire growing season to come to fruition. While fragile and time-consuming, this wheat has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.
Rule.Raw: A fake, amber cereal plant that takes almost an entire growing season to come to fruition. While fragile and time-consuming, this wheat has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una planta de cereal ambarina que tarda casi toda una temporada de cultivo en madurar. Aunque es frágil y lenta, este trigo ha sido modificado genéticamente para convertirse suavemente en harina con solo tocarlo.

Rule.Original: An electric pot, also called a thermo pot, is a small appliance used for boiling water and maintaining it at a constant temperature. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An electric pot, also called a thermo pot, is a small appliance used for boiling water and maintaining it at a constant temperature. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un termo eléctrico es un pequeño electrodoméstico que hierve agua y la mantiene a una temperatura constante. Este está inactivo y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A grill is a device that cooks food by applying heat from below. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A grill is a device that cooks food by applying heat from below. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una parrilla cocina los alimentos aplicando calor desde abajo. Esta está inactiva y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A deep fryer is a kitchen appliance used for deep frying. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A deep fryer is a kitchen appliance used for deep frying. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una freidora es un electrodoméstico que cocina alimentos sumergiéndolos en aceite caliente. Esta está inactiva y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A canning machine is an appliance to store preserved food inside metallic cans. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A canning machine is an appliance to store preserved food inside metallic cans. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una enlatadora es un aparato que almacena alimentos en conserva en latas metálicas. Esta está inactiva y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A cheese press is a device for pressing whey from curds when making cheese. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A cheese press is a device for pressing whey from curds when making cheese. This one is empty and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una prensa de queso sirve para extraer el suero de la cuajada al elaborar queso. Esta está vacía y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A wood-fired stove with a top side perfectly indented for a large pot. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A wood-fired stove with a top side perfectly indented for a large pot. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una cocina de leña con un hueco superior ajustado a una olla grande. Esta está inactiva y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A working table to cut, slice and prepare all kinds of sushi.
Rule.Raw: A working table to cut, slice and prepare all kinds of sushi.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de trabajo para cortar y preparar todo tipo de sushi.

Rule.Original: A soy fermenter is a cilindrical, metallic drum where soybeans are pressed, mixed with aspergillus bacteria and grain, and aged for long time periods. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A soy fermenter is a cilindrical, metallic drum where soybeans are pressed, mixed with aspergillus bacteria and grain, and aged for long time periods. This one is inactive and non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un fermentador de soja es un bidón metálico cilíndrico donde se prensan habas de soja, se mezclan con microorganismos Aspergillus y grano, y se dejan madurar durante largos periodos. Este está inactivo y no funciona.

Rule.Original: A wood-fueled oven designed for baking cookies, pastries, and cakes. Its steady heat ensures even cooking and sweet results. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A wood-fueled oven designed for baking cookies, pastries, and cakes. Its steady heat ensures even cooking and sweet results. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un horno de leña para preparar galletas, pasteles y tartas. Su calor estable garantiza una cocción uniforme y resultados deliciosos. No funciona.

Rule.Original: An electric oven designed for baking cookies, pastries, and cakes with reliable, consistent heat distribution for perfect results every time. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An electric oven designed for baking cookies, pastries, and cakes with reliable, consistent heat distribution for perfect results every time. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un horno eléctrico para preparar galletas, pasteles y tartas, con una distribución uniforme y constante del calor para obtener resultados perfectos. No funciona.

Rule.Original: An enclosed, space-efficient growing unit designed for use on gravships. Upon closer inspection, it's just a decal!
Rule.Raw: An enclosed, space-efficient growing unit designed for use on gravships. Upon closer inspection, it's just a decal!
Rule.Translated: Una unidad de cultivo cerrada y compacta, diseñada para gravinaves. Al examinarla de cerca, ¡resulta ser solo una pegatina!

Rule.Original: A space-efficient, gravship-powered stove designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A space-efficient, gravship-powered stove designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una cocina compacta alimentada por la gravinave y diseñada para usarla a bordo. Esta parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A space-efficient, gravship-powered drug lab designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A space-efficient, gravship-powered drug lab designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un laboratorio de drogas compacto, alimentado por la gravinave y diseñado para usarlo a bordo. Este parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A space-efficient, gravship-powered machining table designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A space-efficient, gravship-powered machining table designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de mecanizado compacta, alimentada por la gravinave y diseñada para usarla a bordo. Esta parece no funcionar.
