Rule.Raw: A space-efficient, gravship-powered smithy designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una herrería compacta alimentada por la gravinave y diseñada para usarla a bordo. Esta parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A space-efficient, gravship-powered tailor bench designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A space-efficient, gravship-powered tailor bench designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de sastre compacta, alimentada por la gravinave y diseñada para usarla a bordo. Esta parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A space-efficient, gravship-powered biofuel refinery designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A space-efficient, gravship-powered biofuel refinery designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una refinería de biocombustible compacta, alimentada por la gravinave y diseñada para usarla a bordo. Esta parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A space-efficient, gravship-powered fabrication bench designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A space-efficient, gravship-powered fabrication bench designed for use aboard gravships. This one seems to be non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un banco de fabricación compacto, alimentado por la gravinave y diseñado para usarlo a bordo. Este parece no funcionar.

Rule.Original: A control station dedicated to operating a single gravship artillery piece. Out of order.
Rule.Raw: A control station dedicated to operating a single gravship artillery piece. Out of order.
Rule.Translated: Una estación de control dedicada a manejar una pieza de artillería de gravinave. Fuera de servicio.

Rule.Original: A small-sized box containing large fake uranium shells.
Rule.Raw: A small-sized box containing large fake uranium shells.
Rule.Translated: Una caja pequeña con grandes proyectiles de uranio artificiales.

Rule.Original: This tank once supplied oxygen to the gravship, but it’s now broken and useless.
Rule.Raw: This tank once supplied oxygen to the gravship, but it’s now broken and useless.
Rule.Translated: Este tanque suministraba oxígeno a la gravinave, pero ahora está roto e inutilizado.

Rule.Original: This tank once stored astrofuel for thrusters, but it has been destroyed.
Rule.Raw: This tank once stored astrofuel for thrusters, but it has been destroyed.
Rule.Translated: Este tanque almacenaba astrocombustible para los propulsores, pero está destruido.

Rule.Original: This device once expanded a gravship’s build area, but it is now shattered.
Rule.Raw: This device once expanded a gravship’s build area, but it is now shattered.
Rule.Translated: Este dispositivo ampliaba la zona de construcción de una gravinave, pero ahora está destrozado.

Rule.Original: This thruster once powered the gravship, but it is now wrecked beyond use.
Rule.Raw: This thruster once powered the gravship, but it is now wrecked beyond use.
Rule.Translated: Este propulsor impulsaba la gravinave, pero ahora está destrozado e inutilizado.

Rule.Original: This powerful thruster once pushed gravships across space, but now it lies broken.
Rule.Raw: This powerful thruster once pushed gravships across space, but now it lies broken.
Rule.Translated: Este potente propulsor llevaba gravinaves por el espacio, pero ahora está averiado.

Rule.Original: This heatsink once cooled the gravship’s systems, but it has burned out.
Rule.Raw: This heatsink once cooled the gravship’s systems, but it has burned out.
Rule.Translated: Este disipador refrigeraba los sistemas de la gravinave, pero se ha quemado.

Rule.Original: An advanced ultratech device that dramatically increases the size of a gravship. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: An advanced ultratech device that dramatically increases the size of a gravship. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo avanzado de ultratecnología que aumenta drásticamente el tamaño de una gravinave. Inactivo.

Rule.Original: A reinforced storage shelf designed for use aboard gravships. Made out of cardboard, can't hold any items.
Rule.Raw: A reinforced storage shelf designed for use aboard gravships. Made out of cardboard, can't hold any items.
Rule.Translated: Una estantería reforzada diseñada para gravinaves. Está hecha de cartón y no puede contener objetos.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted variant of the firefoam popper. It is empty.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted variant of the firefoam popper. It is empty.
Rule.Translated: Una variante de pared del extintor de espuma ignífuga. Está vacía.

Rule.Original: A compact version of a comms console that allows radio contact with other factions and orbital traders. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: A compact version of a comms console that allows radio contact with other factions and orbital traders. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una consola de comunicaciones compacta que permite contactar por radio con otras facciones y comerciantes orbitales. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: A wall-mounted version of an orbital trade beacon. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: A wall-mounted version of an orbital trade beacon. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una versión de pared de la baliza de comercio orbital. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: An artificial plant in a sturdy metal pot. It requires no light, water, or air, making it perfect for adding beauty to even the most inhospitable gravship environments.
Rule.Raw: An artificial plant in a sturdy metal pot. It requires no light, water, or air, making it perfect for adding beauty to even the most inhospitable gravship environments.
Rule.Translated: Una planta artificial en una maceta metálica resistente. No necesita luz, agua ni aire, por lo que es perfecta para embellecer incluso los entornos más inhóspitos de una gravinave.

Rule.Original: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravjumper. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravjumper. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz para lanzar y pilotar un gravisaltador. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravhulk. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravhulk. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz para lanzar y pilotar una gravinave pesada. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: An auxiliary interface that allows a copilot to assist in launching and piloting a gravship. Inactive.
Rule.Raw: An auxiliary interface that allows a copilot to assist in launching and piloting a gravship. Inactive.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz auxiliar que permite a un copiloto ayudar a lanzar y pilotar una gravinave. Inactiva.

Rule.Original: A compact thermal regulator that absorbs heat from gravship travel and slowly converts part of it into usable power while preventing system overheating and decreasing the grav engine cooldown duration. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A compact thermal regulator that absorbs heat from gravship travel and slowly converts part of it into usable power while preventing system overheating and decreasing the grav engine cooldown duration. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un regulador térmico compacto que absorbe el calor de los viajes de la gravinave y convierte lentamente una parte en energía útil, evitando el sobrecalentamiento y reduciendo el tiempo de enfriamiento del motor gravitacional. No funciona.

Rule.Original: A large thermal regulator that absorbs heat from gravship travel and slowly converts part of it into usable power while preventing system overheating and decreasing the grav engine cooldown duration. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A large thermal regulator that absorbs heat from gravship travel and slowly converts part of it into usable power while preventing system overheating and decreasing the grav engine cooldown duration. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un gran regulador térmico que absorbe el calor de los viajes de la gravinave y convierte lentamente una parte en energía útil, evitando el sobrecalentamiento y reduciendo el tiempo de enfriamiento del motor gravitacional. No funciona.

Rule.Original: A specialized thermal sink that draws all residual heat from the grav engine, instantly clearing its cooldown. The absorbed heat leaves the gravheat absorber inoperable for an extended period while it safely dissipates the stored energy. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A specialized thermal sink that draws all residual heat from the grav engine, instantly clearing its cooldown. The absorbed heat leaves the gravheat absorber inoperable for an extended period while it safely dissipates the stored energy. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un disipador especializado que extrae todo el calor residual del motor gravitacional y elimina instantáneamente su tiempo de enfriamiento. El calor absorbido deja al absorbedor térmico inoperativo durante un largo periodo mientras disipa la energía almacenada de forma segura. No funciona.

Rule.Original: An interface used to monitor the maintenance status of all gravship components. It draws power directly from the grav engine. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An interface used to monitor the maintenance status of all gravship components. It draws power directly from the grav engine. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz para supervisar el mantenimiento de todos los componentes de la gravinave. Obtiene energía directamente del motor gravitacional. No funciona.

Rule.Original: The cold, artificial heart of a mechanoid orbital platform. This one seems inert.
Rule.Raw: The cold, artificial heart of a mechanoid orbital platform. This one seems inert.
Rule.Translated: El frío corazón artificial de una plataforma orbital mecanoide. Este parece inerte.

Rule.Original: A massive astrofuel thruster built by the mechanoid core to propel their orbital platforms. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A massive astrofuel thruster built by the mechanoid core to propel their orbital platforms. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme propulsor de astrocombustible construido por el núcleo mecanoide para impulsar sus plataformas orbitales. Este no funciona.

Rule.Original: A machine-built structure that sustains mechanoid platforms by breaking down cosmic debris and wreckage into usable resources. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A machine-built structure that sustains mechanoid platforms by breaking down cosmic debris and wreckage into usable resources. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura construida por máquinas que abastece las plataformas mecanoides al descomponer residuos y restos espaciales en recursos utilizables. Esta no funciona.

Rule.Original: A mechanized launch bay that periodically fires drop pods packed with mechanoids. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A mechanized launch bay that periodically fires drop pods packed with mechanoids. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una bahía de lanzamiento mecanizada que dispara periódicamente cápsulas repletas de mecanoides. Esta no funciona.

Rule.Original: A compact defense unit that projects a localized shield around itself. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A compact defense unit that projects a localized shield around itself. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad defensiva compacta que proyecta un escudo localizado a su alrededor. Esta no funciona.

Rule.Original: A compact fuel reservoir integrated into mechanoid platforms. Empty and sealed.
Rule.Raw: A compact fuel reservoir integrated into mechanoid platforms. Empty and sealed.
Rule.Translated: Un depósito compacto de combustible integrado en las plataformas mecanoides. Vacío y sellado.

Rule.Original: A massive gravtech reactor that channels and amplifies gravitational wave energy into immense electrical output. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A massive gravtech reactor that channels and amplifies gravitational wave energy into immense electrical output. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un enorme reactor gravitécnico que canaliza y amplifica la energía de las ondas gravitatorias para producir inmensas cantidades de electricidad. Este no funciona.

Rule.Original: Stores high amounts of electricity for later use. Or it would, if it wasn't so fake!
Rule.Raw: Stores high amounts of electricity for later use. Or it would, if it wasn't so fake!
Rule.Translated: Almacena grandes cantidades de electricidad para usarlas después. ¡O lo haría, si no fuera tan artificial!

Rule.Original: Fake solar panelling built out of cardboard. This will probably win a high school science fair or something. We don't have those where I live, so I have only seen them in movies.
Rule.Raw: Fake solar panelling built out of cardboard. This will probably win a high school science fair or something. We don't have those where I live, so I have only seen them in movies.
Rule.Translated: Paneles solares artificiales hechos de cartón. Seguramente ganarán una feria de ciencias de instituto o algo así. Donde vivo no hay de eso, así que solo las he visto en películas.

Rule.Original: An interface used to analyze gravdata gathered from gravship launches and travel. Inert.
Rule.Raw: An interface used to analyze gravdata gathered from gravship launches and travel. Inert.
Rule.Translated: Una interfaz para analizar datos gravitacionales obtenidos durante los lanzamientos y viajes de una gravinave. Inerte.

Rule.Original: An advanced recorder integrated into the gravship’s systems. The only thing this one would do in an accident is be blown to pieces.
Rule.Raw: An advanced recorder integrated into the gravship’s systems. The only thing this one would do in an accident is be blown to pieces.
Rule.Translated: Un registrador avanzado integrado en los sistemas de la gravinave. Lo único que haría este durante un accidente sería saltar en pedazos.

Rule.Original: An advanced computational unit that optimizes data collection during gravship travel. Non-functional.
Rule.Raw: An advanced computational unit that optimizes data collection during gravship travel. Non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad informática avanzada que optimiza la recogida de datos durante los viajes de la gravinave. No funciona.

Rule.Original: A low-grade subpersona specialized in gravship combat. This one lacks the brain, so it can post on Reddit.
Rule.Raw: A low-grade subpersona specialized in gravship combat. This one lacks the brain, so it can post on Reddit.
Rule.Translated: Una subpersona de baja categoría especializada en combate de gravinaves. A esta le falta el cerebro, así que puede publicar en Reddit.

Rule.Original: A centralized system that optimizes and automates routine upkeep across the gravship. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A centralized system that optimizes and automates routine upkeep across the gravship. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un sistema centralizado que optimiza y automatiza el mantenimiento rutinario de toda la gravinave. Este no funciona.

Rule.Original: A specialized device that balances and synchronizes energy flow between nearby capacitors. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A specialized device that balances and synchronizes energy flow between nearby capacitors. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo especializado que equilibra y sincroniza el flujo de energía entre condensadores cercanos. Este no funciona.

Rule.Original: A complex vertical launch and stabilization platform integrated into the gravship’s core structure. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Raw: A complex vertical launch and stabilization platform integrated into the gravship’s core structure. This one is non-functional.
Rule.Translated: Una compleja plataforma de lanzamiento vertical y estabilización, integrada en la estructura central de la gravinave. Esta no funciona.

Rule.Original: A fast-growing aquatic plant cultivated in hydroponics and used to generate oxygen when converted in algae oxygenator. This one seems to be a plastic plants.
Rule.Raw: A fast-growing aquatic plant cultivated in hydroponics and used to generate oxygen when converted in algae oxygenator. This one seems to be a plastic plants.
Rule.Translated: Una planta acuática de crecimiento rápido, cultivada en hidroponía para generar oxígeno al procesarla en un oxigenador de algas. Esta parece ser de plástico.

Rule.Original: A monumental astrofuel storage tank that supplies fuel for thrusters on a gravship. Sealed and empty
Rule.Raw: A monumental astrofuel storage tank that supplies fuel for thrusters on a gravship. Sealed and empty
Rule.Translated: Un depósito monumental de astrocombustible que abastece los propulsores de una gravinave. Sellado y vacío.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage device meant to hold dispensed astrofuel for use later.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage device meant to hold dispensed astrofuel for use later.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo similar a una tolva, pensado para almacenar astrocombustible dispensado y utilizarlo después.

Rule.Original: A hopper-like storage structure meant to input astrofuel into the network, filling up connected tanks.
Rule.Raw: A hopper-like storage structure meant to input astrofuel into the network, filling up connected tanks.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura similar a una tolva, pensada para introducir astrocombustible en la red y llenar los depósitos conectados.

Rule.Original: Produces power by consuming astrofuel. Much more efficient than chemfuel generators.
Rule.Raw: Produces power by consuming astrofuel. Much more efficient than chemfuel generators.
Rule.Translated: Produce energía consumiendo astrocombustible. Es mucho más eficiente que los generadores de combustible químico.

Rule.Original: Produces a large amount of power by consuming astrofuel. Much more efficient than chemfuel generators.
Rule.Raw: Produces a large amount of power by consuming astrofuel. Much more efficient than chemfuel generators.
Rule.Translated: Produce grandes cantidades de energía consumiendo astrocombustible. Es mucho más eficiente que los generadores de combustible químico.

Rule.Original: A specialized structure that refines chemfuel into high-grade astrofuel. It must be connected to the astrofuel pipe network and linked to at least one astrofuel tank to operate. Once connected, it automatically converts inserted chemfuel into astrofuel for use in engines and systems.
Rule.Raw: A specialized structure that refines chemfuel into high-grade astrofuel. It must be connected to the astrofuel pipe network and linked to at least one astrofuel tank to operate. Once connected, it automatically converts inserted chemfuel into astrofuel for use in engines and systems.
Rule.Translated: Una estructura especializada que refina combustible químico para obtener astrocombustible de alta calidad. Para funcionar debe conectarse a la red de tuberías y a al menos un depósito de astrocombustible. Una vez conectada, convierte automáticamente el combustible introducido en astrocombustible para motores y sistemas.

Rule.Original: A gravtech unit that enhances the precision and stability of astrofuel refinement. When placed next to an astrofuel synthesizer, it enables perfect 1:1 conversion from chemfuel to astrofuel, though the process takes twice as long.
Rule.Raw: A gravtech unit that enhances the precision and stability of astrofuel refinement. When placed next to an astrofuel synthesizer, it enables perfect 1:1 conversion from chemfuel to astrofuel, though the process takes twice as long.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad gravitécnica que mejora la precisión y estabilidad del refinado de astrocombustible. Colocada junto a un sintetizador, permite convertir combustible químico en astrocombustible con una proporción perfecta de 1:1, aunque el proceso tarda el doble.

Rule.Original:
A massive, reinforced astrofuel thruster built with advanced alloys and ultra-dense vacstone plating. It massively increases the range and maximum size of the gravship. Thrusters require an unobstructed area free of large buildings and gravship substructure.

Requires vacstone blocks, which can be obtained from orbital asteroids.

A gravship can support up to four giant thrusters.
Rule.Raw:
A massive, reinforced astrofuel thruster built with advanced alloys and ultra-dense vacstone plating. It massively increases the range and maximum size of the gravship. Thrusters require an unobstructed area free of large buildings and gravship substructure.

Requires vacstone blocks, which can be obtained from orbital asteroids.

A gravship can support up to four giant thrusters.
Rule.Translated:
Un enorme propulsor reforzado de astrocombustible, construido con aleaciones avanzadas y blindaje de piedra del vacío ultradensa. Aumenta considerablemente el alcance y el tamaño máximo de la gravinave. Los propulsores necesitan una zona despejada, sin grandes edificios ni subestructura de gravinave.

Requiere bloques de piedra del vacío, que pueden obtenerse de asteroides orbitales.

Una gravinave admite hasta cuatro propulsores gigantes.

Rule.Original: An oxygen tank that supplies oxygen to pumps throughout the gravship.
Rule.Raw: An oxygen tank that supplies oxygen to pumps throughout the gravship.
Rule.Translated: Un depósito de oxígeno que abastece las bombas de toda la gravinave.

Rule.Original: A large oxygen tank that supplies oxygen to pumps throughout the gravship.
Rule.Raw: A large oxygen tank that supplies oxygen to pumps throughout the gravship.
Rule.Translated: Un gran depósito de oxígeno que abastece las bombas de toda la gravinave.

Rule.Original: A device that draws in breathable oxygen from the surrounding atmosphere and stores it in the oxygen network. It functions only on planetary surfaces with an atmosphere and will not operate in vacuum or low-oxygen environments.
Rule.Raw: A device that draws in breathable oxygen from the surrounding atmosphere and stores it in the oxygen network. It functions only on planetary surfaces with an atmosphere and will not operate in vacuum or low-oxygen environments.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo que extrae oxígeno respirable de la atmósfera circundante y lo almacena en la red de oxígeno. Solo funciona en superficies planetarias con atmósfera; no funciona en el vacío ni en entornos con poco oxígeno.

Rule.Original: A vital device that processes harvested oxyalgae into breathable oxygen. Converts biomass into gas and pumps it into the oxygen network to supply pressurized rooms and equipment.
Rule.Raw: A vital device that processes harvested oxyalgae into breathable oxygen. Converts biomass into gas and pumps it into the oxygen network to supply pressurized rooms and equipment.
Rule.Translated: Un dispositivo vital que procesa oxialgas cosechadas para obtener oxígeno respirable. Convierte biomasa en gas y lo bombea a la red para abastecer salas presurizadas y equipos.

Rule.Original: A self-contained atmospheric unit that extracts trace oxygen from surrounding gases. It produces oxygen at a slow, steady rate, but requires no input materials. Needs to be connected to an oxygen tank via oxygen pipes to work.
Rule.Raw: A self-contained atmospheric unit that extracts trace oxygen from surrounding gases. It produces oxygen at a slow, steady rate, but requires no input materials. Needs to be connected to an oxygen tank via oxygen pipes to work.
Rule.Translated: Una unidad atmosférica autónoma que extrae trazas de oxígeno de los gases circundantes. Produce oxígeno lentamente y de forma constante, sin necesitar materiales de entrada. Para funcionar debe conectarse a un depósito mediante tuberías de oxígeno.

Rule.Original: A fake herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike, notably nutritious and historically used in dye making.
Rule.Raw: A fake herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike, notably nutritious and historically used in dye making.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una hortaliza herbácea muy cultivada para humanos y ganado, nutritiva y utilizada históricamente para fabricar tintes.

Rule.Original: A fake bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish.
Rule.Raw: A fake bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un fruto morado y bulboso de la familia de las solanáceas. La berenjena rara vez se sirve como guarnición: suele ser el ingrediente principal del plato.

Rule.Original: A fake somewhat hardy, leafy green vegetable, often chopped and then fermented or stewed.
Rule.Raw: A fake somewhat hardy, leafy green vegetable, often chopped and then fermented or stewed.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de una hortaliza verde y frondosa, bastante resistente, que suele picarse y luego fermentarse o guisarse.

Rule.Original: A fake edible bulb of pungent, savory taste and smell with almost as many varieties as cooking applications.
Rule.Raw: A fake edible bulb of pungent, savory taste and smell with almost as many varieties as cooking applications.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un bulbo comestible de sabor y olor intensos, con casi tantas variedades como usos culinarios.

Rule.Original: Fake spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Pea plants are known to be quite thirsty, and will benefit greatly from rainfall.
Rule.Raw: Fake spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Pea plants are known to be quite thirsty, and will benefit greatly from rainfall.
Rule.Translated: Semillas esféricas verdes artificiales, protegidas dentro de una vaina carnosa. Los guisantes necesitan bastante agua y se benefician mucho de la lluvia.

Rule.Original: Fake, tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders.
Rule.Raw: Fake, tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders.
Rule.Translated: Pequeñas vainas carmesíes artificiales y picantes, utilizadas a menudo en salsas, condimentos o en polvo.

Rule.Original: Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest. These ones are fake.
Rule.Raw: Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest. These ones are fake.
Rule.Translated: Las calabazas son técnicamente bayas gigantes y destacan por lo fácil que resulta sembrarlas y cosecharlas. Estas son artificiales.

Rule.Original: A series of juicy, glossy red fruits attached by vine, used commonly as a vegetable. These ones are fake.
Rule.Raw: A series of juicy, glossy red fruits attached by vine, used commonly as a vegetable. These ones are fake.
Rule.Translated: Una serie de frutos rojos, jugosos y brillantes unidos por una enredadera, utilizados comúnmente como hortalizas. Estos son artificiales.

Rule.Original: A fake tree bearing glossy, red apples, while a myriad of different varieties exist this particular type favors warm summers and mild winters.
Rule.Raw: A fake tree bearing glossy, red apples, while a myriad of different varieties exist this particular type favors warm summers and mild winters.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol que produce manzanas rojas y brillantes. Aunque existen muchas variedades, esta prefiere veranos cálidos e inviernos suaves.

Rule.Original: A fake deciduous tree bearing fuzzy, stone fruit known as peaches, peach trees often require full sunlight and warm temperatures.
Rule.Raw: A fake deciduous tree bearing fuzzy, stone fruit known as peaches, peach trees often require full sunlight and warm temperatures.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol caducifolio que produce frutos de hueso y piel vellosa llamados melocotones. Los melocotoneros suelen necesitar pleno sol y temperaturas cálidas.

Rule.Original: A fake tree bearing tiny purple-red sweet cherries.
Rule.Raw: A fake tree bearing tiny purple-red sweet cherries.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol que produce pequeñas cerezas dulces de color rojo violáceo.

Rule.Original: A fake bushy tree bearing a smooth-skinned purple fruit.
Rule.Raw: A fake bushy tree bearing a smooth-skinned purple fruit.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol frondoso que produce un fruto morado de piel lisa.

Rule.Original: A fake stout tree bearing crispy green pears, pear trees are notable for requiring high amounts of water and cool weather, and also doing quite well in shade.
Rule.Raw: A fake stout tree bearing crispy green pears, pear trees are notable for requiring high amounts of water and cool weather, and also doing quite well in shade.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol robusto que produce peras verdes y crujientes. Los perales necesitan mucha agua y un clima fresco, y también crecen bien a la sombra.

Rule.Original: More often referred to as the “prickly pear” cactus, this plant is known to be quite bountiful even in hot, dry deserts. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: More often referred to as the “prickly pear” cactus, this plant is known to be quite bountiful even in hot, dry deserts. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Conocido habitualmente como nopal o chumbera, este cactus produce cosechas abundantes incluso en desiertos cálidos y secos. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: A low-lying bush speckled with pink berries that thrives in poor, even sandy soil. This one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A low-lying bush speckled with pink berries that thrives in poor, even sandy soil. This one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto bajo salpicado de bayas rosadas, que prospera en suelos pobres e incluso arenosos. Este es artificial.

Rule.Original: A fake, broad-leafed, tall tropical tree adorned with a cluster of yellow, elongated berries succinctly known as bananas.
Rule.Raw: A fake, broad-leafed, tall tropical tree adorned with a cluster of yellow, elongated berries succinctly known as bananas.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol tropical alto y de hojas anchas, con un racimo de bayas amarillas y alargadas conocidas como plátanos.

Rule.Original: A fake, bushy, semi-tropical tree dotted with orange fruits well equipped for growing in humid environments and in wet soil.
Rule.Raw: A fake, bushy, semi-tropical tree dotted with orange fruits well equipped for growing in humid environments and in wet soil.
Rule.Translated: Una imitación de un árbol subtropical frondoso, cubierto de frutos naranjas y adaptado a entornos húmedos y suelos mojados.

Rule.Original: A dense, woody shrub known for producing vibrant, classic roses. With its thick foliage and striking blooms, it serves as an excellent ornamental centerpiece for any garden.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A dense, woody shrub known for producing vibrant, classic roses. With its thick foliage and striking blooms, it serves as an excellent ornamental centerpiece for any garden.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto denso y leñoso conocido por producir rosas clásicas de colores vivos. Su espeso follaje y sus llamativas flores lo convierten en un excelente centro ornamental para cualquier jardín.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: A common, cheerful flower with white petals and a yellow center, often found in fields and lawns. It's a symbol of innocence and purity.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A common, cheerful flower with white petals and a yellow center, often found in fields and lawns. It's a symbol of innocence and purity.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor común y alegre, de pétalos blancos y centro amarillo, habitual en campos y praderas. Simboliza la inocencia y la pureza.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A fragrant perennial herb, known for its calming properties. It's highly prized for its scent and vibrant purple flowers, and its presence can uplift the mood of everyone.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A fragrant perennial herb, known for its calming properties. It's highly prized for its scent and vibrant purple flowers, and its presence can uplift the mood of everyone.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una hierba perenne aromática, conocida por sus propiedades calmantes. Su aroma y sus flores moradas son muy apreciados, y su presencia puede mejorar el ánimo de todos.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A classic spring flower known for its vibrant, cup-shaped blooms on a single stem. They are symbols of perfect love and new beginnings.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A classic spring flower known for its vibrant, cup-shaped blooms on a single stem. They are symbols of perfect love and new beginnings.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor primaveral clásica, con flores vistosas en forma de copa sobre un único tallo. Simboliza el amor perfecto y los nuevos comienzos.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A popular, dense shrub known for its large, round clusters of flowers that bloom for a long season. Their color often changes based on soil acidity.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A popular, dense shrub known for its large, round clusters of flowers that bloom for a long season. Their color often changes based on soil acidity.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto denso y popular, conocido por sus grandes grupos redondos de flores y su larga floración. Su color suele variar según la acidez del suelo.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: A popular, dense shrub known for its large, round clusters of flowers that bloom for a long season. Their color often changes based on soil acidity.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A popular, dense shrub known for its large, round clusters of flowers that bloom for a long season. Their color often changes based on soil acidity.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto denso y popular, conocido por sus grandes grupos redondos de flores y su larga floración. Su color suele variar según la acidez del suelo.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: A cultivated hybrid flower famous for its bright, "face-like" blooms. It thrives in cool temperatures and is often one of the first flowers to appear in spring.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A cultivated hybrid flower famous for its bright, "face-like" blooms. It thrives in cool temperatures and is often one of the first flowers to appear in spring.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor híbrida cultivada, famosa por sus flores coloridas con aspecto de rostro. Prospera a temperaturas frescas y suele ser una de las primeras flores de la primavera.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A vibrant, sun-loving flower known for its brilliant orange and yellow blooms. Its presence is sometimes associated with repelling insectoids, though some varieties can have a distinct, pungent scent.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A vibrant, sun-loving flower known for its brilliant orange and yellow blooms. Its presence is sometimes associated with repelling insectoids, though some varieties can have a distinct, pungent scent.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor vistosa amante del sol, con flores naranjas y amarillas brillantes. A veces se asocia con la repulsión de insectoides, aunque algunas variedades tienen un olor intenso y característico.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A highly fragrant, woody shrub known for its dense clusters of purple or white flowers that signify the start of summer. Very resilient and cold-hardy.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A highly fragrant, woody shrub known for its dense clusters of purple or white flowers that signify the start of summer. Very resilient and cold-hardy.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto leñoso muy aromático, conocido por sus densos grupos de flores moradas o blancas que anuncian el verano. Muy resistente, incluso al frío.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: A highly fragrant, dense flower known for its clusters of bell-shaped blooms. As a bulb flower, it is one of the earliest signs of spring and is highly valued for its sweet scent.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A highly fragrant, dense flower known for its clusters of bell-shaped blooms. As a bulb flower, it is one of the earliest signs of spring and is highly valued for its sweet scent.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor densa y muy aromática, con racimos de flores acampanadas. Al crecer de un bulbo, es una de las primeras señales de la primavera y se aprecia mucho por su aroma dulce.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A small, low-lying flower that is one of the very first signs of spring, often pushing its blooms through the last of the winter snow. Its beautiful, cup-shaped bloom brings a brief but powerful moment of color to the early year.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A small, low-lying flower that is one of the very first signs of spring, often pushing its blooms through the last of the winter snow. Its beautiful, cup-shaped bloom brings a brief but powerful moment of color to the early year.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña flor baja que anuncia la primavera, a menudo abriéndose paso entre las últimas nieves del invierno. Su hermosa flor en forma de copa aporta un breve e intenso toque de color al comienzo del año.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A majestic, showy bulb flower known for its large, trumpet-shaped blooms and long, elegant stalks. It is highly valued for its striking beauty and ability to bloom during the deep cold, when conditions are right.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A majestic, showy bulb flower known for its large, trumpet-shaped blooms and long, elegant stalks. It is highly valued for its striking beauty and ability to bloom during the deep cold, when conditions are right.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una majestuosa flor de bulbo, con grandes flores en forma de trompeta y tallos largos y elegantes. Se aprecia por su belleza y por florecer incluso durante el frío intenso si las condiciones son adecuadas.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A classic, cheerful spring flower known for its trumpet-shaped central corona and wide petals. It's an early bloomer, symbolizing new beginnings and unrequited love.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A classic, cheerful spring flower known for its trumpet-shaped central corona and wide petals. It's an early bloomer, symbolizing new beginnings and unrequited love.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una alegre flor primaveral clásica, con una corona central en forma de trompeta y pétalos anchos. Florece pronto y simboliza los nuevos comienzos y el amor no correspondido.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A large, woody shrub famous for its massive, tropical-looking, trumpet-shaped flowers that bloom continuously in warm weather. Much more beautiful outside than inside. A symbol of delicate beauty and a warm climate staple.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A large, woody shrub famous for its massive, tropical-looking, trumpet-shaped flowers that bloom continuously in warm weather. Much more beautiful outside than inside. A symbol of delicate beauty and a warm climate staple.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un gran arbusto leñoso famoso por sus enormes flores tropicales en forma de trompeta, que florecen continuamente con el calor. Es mucho más hermoso fuera que dentro. Simboliza la belleza delicada y es habitual en climas cálidos.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: A widely cultivated flowering plant known for its diverse forms and colors, often blooming in the late year. It is a symbol of joy and a long, vibrant life. Its flowers are much more beautiful outside than inside, especially when fully bloomed.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A widely cultivated flowering plant known for its diverse forms and colors, often blooming in the late year. It is a symbol of joy and a long, vibrant life. Its flowers are much more beautiful outside than inside, especially when fully bloomed.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una planta de flor muy cultivada por su variedad de formas y colores, que suele florecer a finales de año. Simboliza la alegría y una vida larga y plena. Sus flores son mucho más hermosas fuera que dentro, sobre todo en plena floración.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A star-shaped, daisy-like flower, often with purple-blue petals, famous for providing vibrant color in the late season. It is a symbol of patience and elegance.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A star-shaped, daisy-like flower, often with purple-blue petals, famous for providing vibrant color in the late season. It is a symbol of patience and elegance.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una flor en forma de estrella, parecida a una margarita y a menudo de pétalos azul violáceo, famosa por aportar color al final de la temporada. Simboliza la paciencia y la elegancia.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: Sedums are tough, succulent plants known for their fleshy leaves and star-shaped flower clusters that bloom for a long season. Unlike other plants, they do not enter a leafless state in cold temperatures.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: Sedums are tough, succulent plants known for their fleshy leaves and star-shaped flower clusters that bloom for a long season. Unlike other plants, they do not enter a leafless state in cold temperatures.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Los sedums son suculentas resistentes, conocidas por sus hojas carnosas y racimos de flores estrelladas de larga duración. A diferencia de otras plantas, no pierden las hojas con el frío.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: An iconic, tropical perennial known as the 'Bird of Paradise' flower. Its crane-like, vibrant orange and blue blooms make it one of the most striking and beautiful plants in a garden. When it withers, it’s incredibly difficult to look at.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: An iconic, tropical perennial known as the 'Bird of Paradise' flower. Its crane-like, vibrant orange and blue blooms make it one of the most striking and beautiful plants in a garden. When it withers, it’s incredibly difficult to look at.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una emblemática planta tropical perenne, conocida como ave del paraíso. Sus flores naranjas y azules, parecidas a una grulla, la convierten en una de las plantas más bellas y llamativas del jardín. Cuando se marchita, resulta difícil mirarla.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A tropical flowering tree, also known as frangipani, famous for its intensely fragrant, waxy, pinwheel-shaped flowers. It is a symbol of perfection and spring in tropical climates.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A tropical flowering tree, also known as frangipani, famous for its intensely fragrant, waxy, pinwheel-shaped flowers. It is a symbol of perfection and spring in tropical climates.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol tropical de flor, también llamado frangipani, famoso por sus flores cerosas, muy aromáticas y con forma de molinillo. Simboliza la perfección y la primavera en los climas tropicales.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: A dense, long-lived shrub known for its large, fragrant, lush blooms. Peonies are slow to establish, but a mature plant can live for decades, rewarding the grower with increasing beauty year after year.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A dense, long-lived shrub known for its large, fragrant, lush blooms. Peonies are slow to establish, but a mature plant can live for decades, rewarding the grower with increasing beauty year after year.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto denso y longevo, con grandes flores frondosas y aromáticas. Las peonías tardan en establecerse, pero una planta madura puede vivir décadas y recompensar al cultivador con mayor belleza cada año.\n\nEste es artificial.

Rule.Original: A small, fuzzy-leafed perennial, commonly known as the african violet. It produces clusters of dainty, colorful flowers almost continuously, making it a highly prized indoor ornamental. It thrives only in stable, warm conditions.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A small, fuzzy-leafed perennial, commonly known as the african violet. It produces clusters of dainty, colorful flowers almost continuously, making it a highly prized indoor ornamental. It thrives only in stable, warm conditions.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña planta perenne de hojas vellosas, conocida como violeta africana. Produce racimos de delicadas flores de colores casi continuamente, por lo que es muy apreciada como planta ornamental de interior. Solo prospera en condiciones cálidas y estables.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A stately and elegant perennial flower, known for its large, showy, trumpet-shaped blooms atop a single stem. It grows from a bulb and brings dramatic color to the summer garden.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A stately and elegant perennial flower, known for its large, showy, trumpet-shaped blooms atop a single stem. It grows from a bulb and brings dramatic color to the summer garden.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una elegante flor perenne, con grandes flores vistosas en forma de trompeta sobre un único tallo. Crece de un bulbo y aporta colores intensos al jardín de verano.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A distinct perennial known for its unique, beard-like hairs on the lower petals of its large, elegant flowers. It creates a stunning visual display and grows in large clusters.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Raw: A distinct perennial known for its unique, beard-like hairs on the lower petals of its large, elegant flowers. It creates a stunning visual display and grows in large clusters.\n\nThis one is fake.
Rule.Translated: Una planta perenne singular, conocida por los pelos semejantes a una barba de los pétalos inferiores de sus grandes y elegantes flores. Produce un espectáculo visual impresionante y crece en grandes grupos.\n\nEsta es artificial.

Rule.Original: A striking, deciduous shrub known for its brilliant, flame-orange clusters of tubular flowers. It thrives in acidic soils and provides a vibrant, fire-like visual contrast in any garden.\n\nThis one is fake.

Rule.Original: The stars beckon, and we obey. We shall be the faceless bearers of a new awakening, for we have peered into the unknown and its vastness has filled us with wonder.
Rule.Raw: The stars beckon, and we obey. We shall be the faceless bearers of a new awakening, for we have peered into the unknown and its vastness has filled us with wonder.
Rule.Translated: Las estrellas nos llaman y obedecemos. Seremos los portadores sin rostro de un nuevo despertar, pues hemos contemplado lo desconocido y su inmensidad nos ha llenado de asombro.

Rule.Original: The dark confines of the Universe hid the existence of the Flesh that Hungers, a transdimensional conversion that reveals the true reality of life. We will forcefully bring its boon into the whole galaxy, erasing the obsolete examples of prior lifeforms, faulty and incomplete as they are.
Rule.Raw: The dark confines of the Universe hid the existence of the Flesh that Hungers, a transdimensional conversion that reveals the true reality of life. We will forcefully bring its boon into the whole galaxy, erasing the obsolete examples of prior lifeforms, faulty and incomplete as they are.
Rule.Translated: Los oscuros confines del universo ocultaban la existencia de la Carne que Devora, una conversión transdimensional que revela la verdadera realidad de la vida. Impondremos su bendición a toda la galaxia, borrando las formas de vida anteriores, obsoletas, defectuosas e incompletas.

Rule.Original: Reading a good book is like nourishing the mind.
Rule.Raw: Reading a good book is like nourishing the mind.
Rule.Translated: Leer un buen libro es como alimentar la mente.

Rule.Original: I hate reading. I was forced to read this book and hated every second of it.
Rule.Raw: I hate reading. I was forced to read this book and hated every second of it.
Rule.Translated: Odio leer. Me obligaron a leer este libro y detesté cada segundo.

Rule.Original: I did it! I am now a distinguished author.
Rule.Raw: I did it! I am now a distinguished author.
Rule.Translated: ¡Lo conseguí! Ahora soy un autor distinguido.

Rule.Original: I had to write a book. Putting your thoughts to paper is sinful and disgusting.
Rule.Raw: I had to write a book. Putting your thoughts to paper is sinful and disgusting.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que escribir un libro. Poner los pensamientos por escrito es pecaminoso y repugnante.

Rule.Original: Writing comes naturally to us, and we do it fast and efficiently.
Rule.Raw: Writing comes naturally to us, and we do it fast and efficiently.
Rule.Translated: Escribir nos resulta natural y lo hacemos con rapidez y eficiencia.

Rule.Original: Writing is a chore, something that wastes time and requires a huge effort.
Rule.Raw: Writing is a chore, something that wastes time and requires a huge effort.
Rule.Translated: Escribir es una tarea pesada que hace perder el tiempo y exige un esfuerzo enorme.

Rule.Original:
A place of learning is essential for our community. A nice collection of marvelous tomes and filled shelves will fill our hearts with joy.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists gets mood penalties / bonuses depending on size of library rooms found in the map. Only library rooms with an impressiveness of "decent" or higher will count for this calculation. Libraries will need to be clean or colonists will complain too!
Rule.Raw:
A place of learning is essential for our community. A nice collection of marvelous tomes and filled shelves will fill our hearts with joy.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists gets mood penalties / bonuses depending on size of library rooms found in the map. Only library rooms with an impressiveness of "decent" or higher will count for this calculation. Libraries will need to be clean or colonists will complain too!
Rule.Translated:
Un lugar de aprendizaje es esencial para nuestra comunidad. Una buena colección de tomos maravillosos y estanterías llenas nos colmará de alegría.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los colonos reciben penalizaciones o bonificaciones de ánimo según el tamaño de las bibliotecas del mapa. Solo cuentan las bibliotecas con una impresión de «decente» o superior. ¡También deben estar limpias o los colonos se quejarán!
Biblioteca poco impresionante (impresión inferior a decente)

Rule.Original: We lack a place of knowledge.
Rule.Raw: We lack a place of knowledge.
Rule.Translated: Nos falta un lugar de conocimiento.

Rule.Original: We have a library, but it needs to be "decent" at least!
Rule.Raw: We have a library, but it needs to be "decent" at least!
Rule.Translated: Tenemos una biblioteca, ¡pero debe ser «decente» como mínimo!

Rule.Original: We have a library, but it is incredibly dirty. We are not animals!
Rule.Raw: We have a library, but it is incredibly dirty. We are not animals!
Rule.Translated: Tenemos una biblioteca, pero está increíblemente sucia. ¡No somos animales!

Rule.Original: We have a very spacious library.
Rule.Raw: We have a very spacious library.

Rule.Original: We have a huge, professional library!
Rule.Raw: We have a huge, professional library!

Rule.Original: That dessert was very simple, but certainly tasty.
Rule.Raw: That dessert was very simple, but certainly tasty.
Rule.Translated: Ese postre era muy sencillo, pero sin duda estaba rico.

Rule.Original: That dessert was really good! I want more!
Rule.Raw: That dessert was really good! I want more!

Rule.Original: That dessert was unbelievably good, I'm so eager to eat more of it!
Rule.Raw: That dessert was unbelievably good, I'm so eager to eat more of it!
Rule.Translated: ¡Ese postre estaba increíblemente bueno! ¡Tengo muchísimas ganas de comer más!

Rule.Original: Oh my God! My palate had never experienced such an explosion of orgasmic tastes. That was pure food porn. I need more!
Rule.Raw: Oh my God! My palate had never experienced such an explosion of orgasmic tastes. That was pure food porn. I need more!
Rule.Translated: ¡Dios mío! Mi paladar nunca había experimentado una explosión de sabores tan orgásmica. Eso era pura pornografía gastronómica. ¡Necesito más!

Rule.Original: I'm craving some sweet food badly... I feel so tired... this is ridiculous, I’d do just about anything for a single sprinkle.
Rule.Raw: I'm craving some sweet food badly... I feel so tired... this is ridiculous, I’d do just about anything for a single sprinkle.
Rule.Translated: Tengo un antojo terrible de algo dulce... Me siento sin fuerzas... Es ridículo: haría casi cualquier cosa por una sola viruta de azúcar.

Rule.Original: I haven't had a sweet treat in a while now. Is a chocolate bar or piece of cake too much to ask for?
Rule.Raw: I haven't had a sweet treat in a while now. Is a chocolate bar or piece of cake too much to ask for?
Rule.Translated: Hace tiempo que no como algo dulce. ¿Es mucho pedir una tableta de chocolate o un trozo de tarta?

Rule.Original: How about some dessert? It has been a while...
Rule.Raw: How about some dessert? It has been a while...
Rule.Translated: ¿Qué tal un postre? Hace bastante tiempo...

Rule.Original: I've recently eaten some dessert, it was amazing.
Rule.Raw: I've recently eaten some dessert, it was amazing.
Rule.Translated: Hace poco comí un postre. Estaba increíble.

Rule.Original: I'm in heaven. Sweet, greasy, delicious heaven.
Rule.Raw: I'm in heaven. Sweet, greasy, delicious heaven.
Rule.Translated: Estoy en el paraíso. Un paraíso dulce, grasiento y delicioso.

Rule.Original: Serene and therapeutic, placid lakes and lapping shores are criminally underappreciated. With a little time or simple engineering rivers and oceans alike can leave our bellies full of tasty fish.
Rule.Raw: Serene and therapeutic, placid lakes and lapping shores are criminally underappreciated. With a little time or simple engineering rivers and oceans alike can leave our bellies full of tasty fish.
Rule.Translated: Los lagos apacibles y las costas bañadas por las olas son serenos y terapéuticos, pero están injustamente infravalorados. Con algo de tiempo o ingeniería sencilla, ríos y océanos pueden llenarnos el estómago de pescado delicioso.

Rule.Original: creation(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] spoke to all [deity0_possessive] followers and told them: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet cast into the sea, and gathering fish of every kind."
Rule.Raw: creation(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] spoke to all [deity0_possessive] followers and told them: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet cast into the sea, and gathering fish of every kind."
Rule.Translated: creation(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] habló a todos [deity0_possessive] seguidores y les dijo: «El reino de los cielos también es como una red arrojada al mar, que recoge peces de toda clase».

Rule.Original: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] said to all the [memberNamePlural], "Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men."
Rule.Raw: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] said to all the [memberNamePlural], "Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men."
Rule.Translated: episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] dijo a todos los [memberNamePlural]: «Seguidme y os haré pescadores de hombres».

Rule.Original: intro(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[memberNamePlural] built a great [altarName] on the [place_summary] [place_name], and great angling competitions took place there every year.
Rule.Raw: intro(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[memberNamePlural] built a great [altarName] on the [place_summary] [place_name], and great angling competitions took place there every year.
Rule.Translated: intro(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Los [memberNamePlural] construyeron un gran [altarName] en [place_summary] [place_name], donde cada año se celebraban grandes competiciones de pesca.

Rule.Original: conflict(tag=meme_Anglers) ->An envious [foeLeader], seeking to deny the will of [deity0_name], told [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] to poison the lakes and seas surrounding the [altarName].
Rule.Raw: conflict(tag=meme_Anglers) ->An envious [foeLeader], seeking to deny the will of [deity0_name], told [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] to poison the lakes and seas surrounding the [altarName].
Rule.Translated: conflict(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Un [foeLeader] envidioso, que quería desafiar la voluntad de [deity0_name], ordenó a [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] envenenar los lagos y mares que rodeaban el [altarName].

Rule.Original: founderJoin(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] blessed a [place_job] named [founderName] with [deity0_possessive] divine intelligence and [founder_pronoun] built a great water purifier, and the waters once again teamed with thousands of fish.
Rule.Raw: founderJoin(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] blessed a [place_job] named [founderName] with [deity0_possessive] divine intelligence and [founder_pronoun] built a great water purifier, and the waters once again teamed with thousands of fish.
Rule.Translated: founderJoin(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[deity0_name] bendijo a [place_job] llamado [founderName] con [deity0_possessive] inteligencia divina, y [founder_pronoun] construyó un gran purificador de agua. Las aguas volvieron a rebosar de miles de peces.

Rule.Original: victory(tag=meme_Anglers) ->The [foeSoldiers] and the [foeLeader] were humiliated and thwarted, and they had to leave the [memberNamePlural] alone.
Rule.Raw: victory(tag=meme_Anglers) ->The [foeSoldiers] and the [foeLeader] were humiliated and thwarted, and they had to leave the [memberNamePlural] alone.
Rule.Translated: victory(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Los [foeSoldiers] y el [foeLeader] quedaron humillados y derrotados, y tuvieron que dejar en paz a los [memberNamePlural].

Rule.Original: setup(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Our founder [founderName] was the greatest angler to have lived. No fish was big enough for [founderName_objective].
Rule.Raw: setup(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Our founder [founderName] was the greatest angler to have lived. No fish was big enough for [founderName_objective].
Rule.Translated: setup(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Nuestro fundador, [founderName], fue el mayor pescador de todos los tiempos. Ningún pez era demasiado grande para [founderName_objective].

Rule.Original: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Anglers) ->[founderName] taught us that fishing is a state of mind. [founderName_pronoun] always said that the charm of fishing is that it is the pursuit of what is elusive but attainable, a perpetual series of occasions for hope.
Rule.Raw: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Anglers) ->[founderName] taught us that fishing is a state of mind. [founderName_pronoun] always said that the charm of fishing is that it is the pursuit of what is elusive but attainable, a perpetual series of occasions for hope.
Rule.Translated: story(uses=1,tag=meme_Anglers) ->[founderName] nos enseñó que la pesca es un estado mental. [founderName_pronoun] siempre decía que su encanto consiste en perseguir lo esquivo pero alcanzable: una sucesión perpetua de oportunidades para la esperanza.

Rule.Original: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Anglers) ->I've spent as much of my life fishing as decency allowed, and sometimes I don't let even that get in my way. I have learned that
Rule.Raw: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Anglers) ->I've spent as much of my life fishing as decency allowed, and sometimes I don't let even that get in my way. I have learned that
Rule.Translated: lessonIntro(tag=meme_Anglers) ->He pasado tanto tiempo pescando como permitía la decencia y, a veces, ni siquiera dejo que eso me frene. He aprendido que

Rule.Original: lesson(tag=meme_Anglers) ->fishing is a hard job. Fishing at night. Rain. Day, night. You have to be wise and smart. And quick.
Rule.Raw: lesson(tag=meme_Anglers) ->fishing is a hard job. Fishing at night. Rain. Day, night. You have to be wise and smart. And quick.
Rule.Translated: lesson(tag=meme_Anglers) ->pescar es un trabajo duro. Pescar de noche. Lluvia. Día y noche. Hay que ser sabio e inteligente. Y rápido.

Rule.Original: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Anglers) ->After a day's fishing, I'll know the solution to something or have good ideas that were not accessible before.
Rule.Raw: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Anglers) ->After a day's fishing, I'll know the solution to something or have good ideas that were not accessible before.
Rule.Translated: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Tras un día de pesca, encuentro la solución a algún problema o ideas que antes no tenía.

Rule.Original: archistBasis(tag=meme_Anglers) ->The archotechs filled the oceans and the rivers with wondrous plenty, accessible to anyone with the knowledge to take advantage of it.
Rule.Raw: archistBasis(tag=meme_Anglers) ->The archotechs filled the oceans and the rivers with wondrous plenty, accessible to anyone with the knowledge to take advantage of it.
Rule.Translated: archistBasis(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Los arquitecnólogos llenaron los océanos y los ríos de una abundancia maravillosa, accesible a cualquiera que supiera aprovecharla.

Rule.Original: archistFact(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Archotechs value resourcefulness above other things, and we must accept the bounty of the waters as their gift.
Rule.Raw: archistFact(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Archotechs value resourcefulness above other things, and we must accept the bounty of the waters as their gift.
Rule.Translated: archistFact(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Los arquitecnólogos valoran el ingenio por encima de todo y debemos aceptar la abundancia de las aguas como su regalo.

Rule.Original: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will be the greatest anglers, and their catch will be the ones worthy of transcendence.
Rule.Raw: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will be the greatest anglers, and their catch will be the ones worthy of transcendence.
Rule.Translated: archistProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers) ->[inTheEnd], los arquitecnólogos serán los mayores pescadores, y su captura serán quienes merezcan trascender.

Rule.Original: animistFact(tag=meme_Anglers) ->The spirits of fish provide us with the greatest bounty: the teeming life present in rivers and oceans.
Rule.Raw: animistFact(tag=meme_Anglers) ->The spirits of fish provide us with the greatest bounty: the teeming life present in rivers and oceans.
Rule.Translated: animistFact(tag=meme_Anglers) ->Los espíritus de los peces nos ofrecen la mayor abundancia: la vida que rebosa en ríos y océanos.

Rule.Original: serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers)->[itIsSaid] we will learn the ways of insects to find food whenever it's needed, by exploiting the greatest bounty: the teeming life present in rivers and oceans.
Rule.Raw: serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers)->[itIsSaid] we will learn the ways of insects to find food whenever it's needed, by exploiting the greatest bounty: the teeming life present in rivers and oceans.
Rule.Translated: serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers)->[itIsSaid] aprenderemos las costumbres de los insectos para encontrar alimento cuando haga falta, aprovechando la mayor abundancia: la vida que rebosa en ríos y océanos.

Rule.Original: esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers)->We will discern what is hidden behind these secrets, perhaps by divining the entrails of dead fish.
Rule.Raw: esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers)->We will discern what is hidden behind these secrets, perhaps by divining the entrails of dead fish.
Rule.Translated: esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Anglers)->Descubriremos lo que se oculta tras estos secretos, quizá adivinando en las entrañas de peces muertos.

Rule.Original: eschatologismFact(tag=meme_Anglers)->Like the slippery fish that hide beyond the abyssal depths, we will strike from the darkness and we will be unstoppable.
Rule.Raw: eschatologismFact(tag=meme_Anglers)->Like the slippery fish that hide beyond the abyssal depths, we will strike from the darkness and we will be unstoppable.
Rule.Translated: eschatologismFact(tag=meme_Anglers)->Como los peces escurridizos que se esconden en las profundidades abisales, atacaremos desde la oscuridad y seremos imparables.

Rule.Original: introMemo(tag=meme_Anglers)->Good news! In this year's company-wide raffle we are again including as a prize a two weeks, all expenses paid fishing trip! I know you are as excited as I am, so get those tickets as soon as possible!
Rule.Raw: introMemo(tag=meme_Anglers)->Good news! In this year's company-wide raffle we are again including as a prize a two weeks, all expenses paid fishing trip! I know you are as excited as I am, so get those tickets as soon as possible!
Rule.Translated: introMemo(tag=meme_Anglers)->¡Buenas noticias! ¡El sorteo de toda la empresa de este año vuelve a incluir un viaje de pesca de dos semanas con todos los gastos pagados! Sé que os entusiasma tanto como a mí, ¡así que conseguid vuestros boletos cuanto antes!

Rule.Original:
Fishing is the right way; ranching and farming is not.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Adept fishermen will be able to catch additional fish from fishing zones. These fish are considered "adept catches" and provide double nutrition from other fish in the same size category.
Rule.Raw:
Fishing is the right way; ranching and farming is not.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Adept fishermen will be able to catch additional fish from fishing zones. These fish are considered "adept catches" and provide double nutrition from other fish in the same size category.
Rule.Translated:
La pesca es el camino correcto; la ganadería y la agricultura no lo son.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los pescadores expertos pueden capturar peces adicionales en las zonas de pesca. Estas «capturas expertas» proporcionan el doble de nutrición que otros peces de su misma categoría de tamaño.

Rule.Original: Why would we raise land animals or hunt, waste our time training and butchering them when we can get all the meat we need from the sea?
Rule.Raw: Why would we raise land animals or hunt, waste our time training and butchering them when we can get all the meat we need from the sea?
Rule.Translated: ¿Por qué criar animales terrestres o cazar, y perder tiempo adiestrándolos y despiezándolos, si podemos obtener toda la carne que necesitamos del mar?

Rule.Original:
Fishing is one of the most relaxing and fulfilling activities you could possibly spend your free time doing.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Colonists gain recreation when fishing.
Rule.Raw:
Fishing is one of the most relaxing and fulfilling activities you could possibly spend your free time doing.

<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color>
 - Colonists gain recreation when fishing.
Rule.Translated:
La pesca es una de las actividades más relajantes y satisfactorias para dedicarle el tiempo libre.

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas:</color>
 - Los colonos obtienen recreación al pescar.

Rule.Original: A small metal box filled with different hooks, bobbers and baits meant to entice fish big and small to latch on before being reeled in via line and rod.
Rule.Raw: A small metal box filled with different hooks, bobbers and baits meant to entice fish big and small to latch on before being reeled in via line and rod.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña caja metálica llena de anzuelos, flotadores y cebos para atraer a peces grandes y pequeños, antes de recogerlos con el sedal y la caña.

Rule.Original: We’ve lost one of ours. What a sad day it is.
Rule.Raw: We’ve lost one of ours. What a sad day it is.
Rule.Translated: Hemos perdido a uno de los nuestros. Qué día tan triste.

Rule.Original: I’ve socialised with a comrade, which strengthens our bond.
Rule.Raw: I’ve socialised with a comrade, which strengthens our bond.
Rule.Translated: He convivido con un camarada y eso fortalece nuestro vínculo.

Rule.Original: We’ve lost one of ours. I need to look to others for strength.
Rule.Raw: We’ve lost one of ours. I need to look to others for strength.
Rule.Translated: Hemos perdido a uno de los nuestros. Necesito apoyarme en los demás para encontrar fuerzas.

Rule.Original: I’ve socialised with a comrade. We are unstoppable!
Rule.Raw: I’ve socialised with a comrade. We are unstoppable!
Rule.Translated: He convivido con un camarada. ¡Somos imparables!

Rule.Original: The cap'n displayed a lack of passion and the feeling of camaraderie just wasn't there.
Rule.Raw: The cap'n displayed a lack of passion and the feeling of camaraderie just wasn't there.
Rule.Translated: Al capitán le faltó pasión y no se sintió ninguna camaradería.

Rule.Original: The cap'n treated us like children, wanting so desperately to hear something to lift their spirits.
Rule.Raw: The cap'n treated us like children, wanting so desperately to hear something to lift their spirits.
Rule.Translated: El capitán nos trató como niños, desesperados por oír algo que nos levantara el ánimo.

Rule.Original: Shiver me timbers, those were some good shanties! The cap'n lifted our spirits and made us feel a camaraderie and togetherness that will only make us stronger.
Rule.Raw: Shiver me timbers, those were some good shanties! The cap'n lifted our spirits and made us feel a camaraderie and togetherness that will only make us stronger.
Rule.Translated: ¡Por todos los mares, qué buenos cantos! El capitán nos levantó el ánimo y nos hizo sentir una camaradería y una unión que nos harán más fuertes.

Rule.Original: We can still hear the mesmerizing words of the cap'n, as they reminded us of the importance of our shared camaraderie. We can even feel our sadness vanish away.
Rule.Raw: We can still hear the mesmerizing words of the cap'n, as they reminded us of the importance of our shared camaraderie. We can even feel our sadness vanish away.
Rule.Translated: Aún oímos las fascinantes palabras del capitán, que nos recordaron la importancia de nuestra camaradería. Hasta sentimos cómo desaparece la tristeza.
cañón criogénico de sarcófago de combate

Rule.Original: Combines both crypto technology with military flamethrowers for a close range defense weapon. Sacrifices direct damage potential for area denial. Applies variable cold effect to those affected by the stream of supercooled particles, reducing their manipulation and inducing hypothermia. Ideally used with a pair of fast-moving warcaskets.
Rule.Raw: Combines both crypto technology with military flamethrowers for a close range defense weapon. Sacrifices direct damage potential for area denial. Applies variable cold effect to those affected by the stream of supercooled particles, reducing their manipulation and inducing hypothermia. Ideally used with a pair of fast-moving warcaskets.
Rule.Translated: Combina tecnología criogénica y lanzallamas militares en un arma defensiva de corto alcance. Sacrifica daño directo para bloquear zonas. La corriente de partículas superenfriadas aplica un efecto variable de frío, reduce la manipulación y provoca hipotermia. Ideal para una pareja de sarcófagos de combate rápidos.
cañón de riel de sarcófago de combate
cañón de riel de sarcófago de combate

Rule.Original: A terrifying modification of the Gauss Lance with a revolving magazine and three barrels. Quite a long warmup period due to the barrels needing charging before firing in a series, however the slugs are considerably larger, translating as more damaging and better range. The potential for collateral damage is immense and many commanders typically forbid its use outside of guerilla tactics and solo raids.
Rule.Raw: A terrifying modification of the Gauss Lance with a revolving magazine and three barrels. Quite a long warmup period due to the barrels needing charging before firing in a series, however the slugs are considerably larger, translating as more damaging and better range. The potential for collateral damage is immense and many commanders typically forbid its use outside of guerilla tactics and solo raids.
Rule.Translated: Una aterradora modificación de la lanza Gauss, con cargador giratorio y tres cañones. Tiene una preparación bastante larga porque los cañones deben cargarse antes de disparar en serie, pero sus proyectiles son mucho mayores, con más daño y alcance. El riesgo de daños colaterales es inmenso y muchos comandantes prohíben usarla fuera de tácticas de guerrilla e incursiones en solitario.

Rule.Original: A rather complicated piece of laser technology that was primarily developed as a siege weapon to generate explosions within hardened bunkers. In order to miniaturize an emplacement weapon without needing a massive power unit, the shoulder-mounted laser fires in irregular pulses with a frequency between kHz and MHz. The results are hard to dispute as it can cause a devastating blast, however it has a limited effective range and a long warm-up period to charge the capacitor banks.
Rule.Raw: A rather complicated piece of laser technology that was primarily developed as a siege weapon to generate explosions within hardened bunkers. In order to miniaturize an emplacement weapon without needing a massive power unit, the shoulder-mounted laser fires in irregular pulses with a frequency between kHz and MHz. The results are hard to dispute as it can cause a devastating blast, however it has a limited effective range and a long warm-up period to charge the capacitor banks.
Rule.Translated: Una compleja pieza de tecnología láser, desarrollada como arma de asedio para generar explosiones dentro de búnkeres fortificados. Para reducir un arma de emplazamiento sin necesitar una enorme fuente de energía, este láser de hombro dispara pulsos irregulares con frecuencias entre kHz y MHz. Puede causar explosiones devastadoras, aunque su alcance eficaz es limitado y necesita una larga preparación para cargar los bancos de condensadores.

bláster láser de sarcófago de combate

Rule.Original: An enlarged laser weapon, combining both modern and antique methods into a compact package. Taking advantage of a greater weight tolerance, this system includes a revolver cylinder using advanced battery cells instead of cartridges. This allows the weapon to fire more powerful shots at a slower warmup reduction, meaning safer sustained fire for the operator.
Rule.Raw: An enlarged laser weapon, combining both modern and antique methods into a compact package. Taking advantage of a greater weight tolerance, this system includes a revolver cylinder using advanced battery cells instead of cartridges. This allows the weapon to fire more powerful shots at a slower warmup reduction, meaning safer sustained fire for the operator.
Rule.Translated: Un arma láser ampliada que combina métodos modernos y antiguos en un conjunto compacto. Aprovecha su mayor tolerancia al peso para incorporar un tambor de revólver con celdas de batería avanzadas en lugar de cartuchos. Esto permite disparos más potentes con una reducción más lenta del tiempo de preparación, y un fuego sostenido más seguro para el operador.
arma plegable de sarcófago de combate
arma plegable de sarcófago de combate

Rule.Original: A weapon designed to give Warcaskets rapid ranged response in an urban environment, able to be collapsed for ease of storage and transportation. The mediocre damage and accuracy is an acceptable trade-off for this convenience, with an increase in rate of fire and minimal aiming to improve its ‘spray and pray’ functionality.
Rule.Raw: A weapon designed to give Warcaskets rapid ranged response in an urban environment, able to be collapsed for ease of storage and transportation. The mediocre damage and accuracy is an acceptable trade-off for this convenience, with an increase in rate of fire and minimal aiming to improve its ‘spray and pray’ functionality.
Rule.Translated: Un arma diseñada para que los sarcófagos de combate respondan rápidamente a distancia en entornos urbanos. Puede plegarse para facilitar su transporte y almacenamiento. Su daño y precisión mediocres son un sacrificio aceptable a cambio de esa comodidad, una mayor cadencia y una puntería mínima para mejorar su función de «disparar y rezar».
