bala de arma plegable de sarcófago de combate

Rule.Original: Make animal kibble by combining raw meat and moss. This recipe is slightly more efficient than using hay.
Rule.Raw: Make animal kibble by combining raw meat and moss. This recipe is slightly more efficient than using hay.
Rule.Translated: Preparar pienso animal combinando carne cruda y musgo. Esta receta es algo más eficiente que utilizar heno.

Rule.Original: A nutrient-rich moss that can be used to feed cave animals, but not humans.
Rule.Raw: A nutrient-rich moss that can be used to feed cave animals, but not humans.
Rule.Translated: Un musgo rico en nutrientes que sirve para alimentar animales de cueva, pero no humanos.

Rule.Original: A nutrient-rich moss that can be used to feed cave animals, but not humans. It can grow on fungal gravel, but only in darkness - exposing it to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.
Rule.Raw: A nutrient-rich moss that can be used to feed cave animals, but not humans. It can grow on fungal gravel, but only in darkness - exposing it to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.
Rule.Translated: Un musgo rico en nutrientes que sirve para alimentar animales de cueva, pero no humanos. Puede crecer en grava fúngica, pero solo en la oscuridad: exponerlo a cualquier luz, incluidas las luces oscuras, lo matará.

Rule.Original: A genetically-engineered mushroom which secretes a self-altering dye. This dye can be coaxed into different colors and used to dye apparel. It can grow on fungal gravel, but only in darkness - exposing it to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.
Rule.Raw: A genetically-engineered mushroom which secretes a self-altering dye. This dye can be coaxed into different colors and used to dye apparel. It can grow on fungal gravel, but only in darkness - exposing it to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.
Rule.Translated: Una seta modificada genéticamente que secreta un tinte capaz de cambiar por sí mismo. El tinte puede ajustarse a distintos colores para teñir ropa. Puede crecer en grava fúngica, pero solo en la oscuridad: exponerla a cualquier luz, incluidas las luces oscuras, la matará.

Rule.Original: A slow-growing mushroom which yields herbal medicine when harvested. Sowing and harvesting healshroom are both very labor-intensive tasks because of its fragility. It can grow on fungal gravel, but only in darkness - exposing it to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.
Rule.Raw: A slow-growing mushroom which yields herbal medicine when harvested. Sowing and harvesting healshroom are both very labor-intensive tasks because of its fragility. It can grow on fungal gravel, but only in darkness - exposing it to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.
Rule.Translated: Una seta de crecimiento lento que proporciona medicina herbal al cosecharla. Por su fragilidad, sembrarla y cosecharla requiere mucho trabajo. Puede crecer en grava fúngica, pero solo en la oscuridad: exponerla a cualquier luz, incluidas las luces oscuras, la matará.

Rule.Original: Extract vegetable milk from rice. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nRice is very inefficient when converted into milk, and a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Raw: Extract vegetable milk from rice. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nRice is very inefficient when converted into milk, and a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Translated: Extraer leche vegetal de arroz. Puede utilizarse en cualquier receta que requiera leche.\n\nEl arroz es muy poco eficiente al convertirse en leche y se pierde mucha nutrición durante el proceso.

Rule.Original: Extract vegetable milk from almonds. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Raw: Extract vegetable milk from almonds. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Translated: Extraer leche vegetal de almendras. Puede utilizarse en cualquier receta que requiera leche.\n\nLas leches vegetales suelen ser poco eficientes, ya que se pierde mucha nutrición durante el proceso.

Rule.Original: Extract vegetable milk from coconuts. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Raw: Extract vegetable milk from coconuts. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Translated: Extraer leche vegetal de coco. Puede utilizarse en cualquier receta que requiera leche.\n\nLas leches vegetales suelen ser poco eficientes, ya que se pierde mucha nutrición durante el proceso.

Rule.Original: Extract vegetable milk from oats. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Raw: Extract vegetable milk from oats. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process.
Rule.Translated: Extraer leche vegetal de avena. Puede utilizarse en cualquier receta que requiera leche.\n\nLas leches vegetales suelen ser poco eficientes, ya que se pierde mucha nutrición durante el proceso.

Rule.Original: Vegetable milk extraction allows the colonists to extract milk from rice, oats, almonds, coconuts and soybeans.
Rule.Raw: Vegetable milk extraction allows the colonists to extract milk from rice, oats, almonds, coconuts and soybeans.
Rule.Translated: La extracción de leche vegetal permite a los colonos obtener leche de arroz, avena, almendras, cocos y soja.

Rule.Original: A small work station containing a presser and an industrial decanter centrifuge to separate vegetable extract from mash. The high G-forces generated by the decanter centrifuge allow you to extract vegetable milk from rice, almonds, coconuts, oats and soybeans.
Rule.Raw: A small work station containing a presser and an industrial decanter centrifuge to separate vegetable extract from mash. The high G-forces generated by the decanter centrifuge allow you to extract vegetable milk from rice, almonds, coconuts, oats and soybeans.
Rule.Translated: Una pequeña estación de trabajo con una prensa y una centrífuga decantadora industrial para separar el extracto vegetal de la pulpa. Las elevadas fuerzas centrífugas permiten extraer leche vegetal de arroz, almendras, cocos, avena y soja.

Rule.Original: The grain of the oat plant. Oats have numerous uses in foods; most commonly, they are rolled or crushed into oatmeal. Oatmeal is chiefly eaten as porridge, but may also be used in a variety of baked goods. Oats are also used for production of milk substitutes.
Rule.Raw: The grain of the oat plant. Oats have numerous uses in foods; most commonly, they are rolled or crushed into oatmeal. Oatmeal is chiefly eaten as porridge, but may also be used in a variety of baked goods. Oats are also used for production of milk substitutes.
Rule.Translated: El grano de la planta de avena. Tiene numerosos usos culinarios; normalmente se aplana o tritura para obtener copos o harina. Suele consumirse como gachas, pero también se usa en distintos productos horneados y para fabricar sustitutos de la leche.

Rule.Original: A cereal grain that people can use in bread, beverages, stews, and other dishes. As a whole grain, barley provides fiber, vitamins, and minerals. It has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Barley is a "dual crop", in the sense that it produces both flour and hay.
Rule.Raw: A cereal grain that people can use in bread, beverages, stews, and other dishes. As a whole grain, barley provides fiber, vitamins, and minerals. It has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Barley is a "dual crop", in the sense that it produces both flour and hay.
Rule.Translated: Un cereal que puede utilizarse en pan, bebidas, guisos y otros platos. Como grano integral, la cebada aporta fibra, vitaminas y minerales. Ha sido modificada genéticamente para convertirse suavemente en harina con solo tocarla.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La cebada es un «cultivo doble»: produce tanto harina como heno.

Rule.Original: A drought resistant cereal used for food, animal fodder, the production of alcoholic beverages, and biofuels. Sorghum grain is gluten free, high in resistant starch, and more abundant and diverse phenolic compounds compared to other major cereal crops.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Sorghum stalks can grow to up to 2.5 meters in height, and grow very close together. A sorghum field can be used as quite effective cover.
Rule.Raw: A drought resistant cereal used for food, animal fodder, the production of alcoholic beverages, and biofuels. Sorghum grain is gluten free, high in resistant starch, and more abundant and diverse phenolic compounds compared to other major cereal crops.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Sorghum stalks can grow to up to 2.5 meters in height, and grow very close together. A sorghum field can be used as quite effective cover.
Rule.Translated: Un cereal resistente a la sequía, utilizado como alimento, forraje y para producir bebidas alcohólicas y biocombustibles. Su grano no contiene gluten, es rico en almidón resistente y tiene compuestos fenólicos más abundantes y diversos que otros cereales importantes.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los tallos de sorgo pueden alcanzar 2.5 metros y crecen muy juntos. Un campo de sorgo puede servir como cobertura bastante eficaz.

Rule.Original: A plant that grows well in much poorer soils than those necessary for most cereal grains. Thus, it is an especially valuable crop in regions where the soil has sand or peat. It has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Rye is only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Rye needs to be grown away from large bodies of water (water within 10 tiles of it will stop its growth).
Rule.Raw: A plant that grows well in much poorer soils than those necessary for most cereal grains. Thus, it is an especially valuable crop in regions where the soil has sand or peat. It has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Rye is only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space. Rye needs to be grown away from large bodies of water (water within 10 tiles of it will stop its growth).
Rule.Translated: Una planta que crece bien en suelos mucho más pobres que los necesarios para la mayoría de los cereales, especialmente útil en regiones con arena o turba. Ha sido modificada genéticamente para convertirse suavemente en harina con solo tocarla.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> El centeno solo crece en zonas de cultivo arenosas, que ignoran la fertilidad. Sembrarlo y cosecharlo lleva mucho tiempo, intercambiando trabajo de los colonos por el uso de un espacio normalmente desaprovechado. Debe crecer lejos de grandes masas de agua: el agua a menos de 10 casillas detiene su crecimiento.

Rule.Original: The oat, sometimes called the common oat, is a species of cereal grain grown for its seed, which is known by the same name. Oats have numerous uses in gastronomy, and they can also be turned into vegetable milk.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Oat has low yield, but it is very versatile, being a "dual crop", in the sense that it produces both flour and oats which can be either used as a vegetable or turned into milk.
Rule.Raw: The oat, sometimes called the common oat, is a species of cereal grain grown for its seed, which is known by the same name. Oats have numerous uses in gastronomy, and they can also be turned into vegetable milk.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Oat has low yield, but it is very versatile, being a "dual crop", in the sense that it produces both flour and oats which can be either used as a vegetable or turned into milk.
Rule.Translated: La avena común es una especie de cereal cultivada por su semilla, conocida por el mismo nombre. Tiene numerosos usos gastronómicos y también puede convertirse en leche vegetal.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> La avena tiene poco rendimiento, pero es muy versátil. Es un «cultivo doble»: produce harina y granos de avena que pueden utilizarse como vegetal o convertirse en leche.

Rule.Original: A sweet, edible fruit hailed as a "superfood", blueberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.
Rule.Raw: A sweet, edible fruit hailed as a "superfood", blueberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.
Rule.Translated: Un fruto dulce y comestible, considerado un «superalimento». Los arándanos suelen comerse frescos como postre y pueden utilizarse en distintos productos de repostería.

Rule.Original: A shrub prized for its sweet edible fruits. Hailed as a "superfood", blueberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Blueberries are pollinated by bees: they will receive a growth boost if an apiary is found in a radius of 6 tiles. To avoid lag this is only calculated once, when the plant is sown, so apiaries placed after sowing it will have no effect. If there are no apiaries it will behave as a slower strawberry plant.
Rule.Raw: A shrub prized for its sweet edible fruits. Hailed as a "superfood", blueberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Blueberries are pollinated by bees: they will receive a growth boost if an apiary is found in a radius of 6 tiles. To avoid lag this is only calculated once, when the plant is sown, so apiaries placed after sowing it will have no effect. If there are no apiaries it will behave as a slower strawberry plant.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto apreciado por sus frutos dulces y comestibles. Considerados un «superalimento», los arándanos suelen comerse frescos como postre o utilizarse en repostería.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Las abejas polinizan los arándanos: reciben una bonificación al crecimiento si hay un colmenar en un radio de 6 casillas. Para evitar problemas de rendimiento, solo se calcula al sembrar; colocar un colmenar después no tiene efecto. Sin colmenares, se comportan como fresas de crecimiento más lento.

Rule.Original: A specialized apparatus designed to rejuvenate the psyfocus of deathresting psycasters by delicately nurturing their psychic centers. Employing a meticulous balance of sanguine infusions and harmonic neural stimulation, the well works in concert with the psycaster's innate psychic energies. As the individual rests within the deathrest casket, the Psychofluid Well revitalizes their psychic reservoirs, preparing them for future psychic exertions. To operate effectively, the device must be connected to a deathrest casket and requires a steady supply of hemogen to fuel its subtle yet powerful restorative functions.\n\nContrary to other deathrest machines, the psychofluid well regenerates 5% of total Psyfocus to the deathresting occupant every 1 hour, instead of acting all at once when the deathrest ends.
Rule.Raw: A specialized apparatus designed to rejuvenate the psyfocus of deathresting psycasters by delicately nurturing their psychic centers. Employing a meticulous balance of sanguine infusions and harmonic neural stimulation, the well works in concert with the psycaster's innate psychic energies. As the individual rests within the deathrest casket, the Psychofluid Well revitalizes their psychic reservoirs, preparing them for future psychic exertions. To operate effectively, the device must be connected to a deathrest casket and requires a steady supply of hemogen to fuel its subtle yet powerful restorative functions.\n\nContrary to other deathrest machines, the psychofluid well regenerates 5% of total Psyfocus to the deathresting occupant every 1 hour, instead of acting all at once when the deathrest ends.
Rule.Translated: Un aparato especializado para renovar el enfoque psíquico de psíquicos en descanso mortal, estimulando delicadamente sus centros psíquicos. Equilibra infusiones sanguíneas y estimulación neural armónica con las energías innatas del usuario. Mientras este descansa en el sarcófago, el pozo revitaliza sus reservas para futuras actividades psíquicas. Debe conectarse a un sarcófago de descanso mortal y necesita un suministro estable de hemógeno.\n\nA diferencia de otras máquinas de descanso mortal, regenera un 5% del enfoque psíquico total del ocupante cada 1 hora, en vez de actuar de golpe cuando termina el descanso.
Invocar amenaza de emperatriz de guerra

Rule.Original: By studying the hyper-linkage chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Rule.Raw: By studying the hyper-linkage chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Rule.Translated: Al estudiar el chip de hiperenlace, {PAWN_labelShort} ha adquirido los conocimientos necesarios para los proyectos de investigación {RESEARCH}.\n\nTus investigadores ya pueden utilizar mesas de investigación para averiguar cómo aprovechar esta tecnología.
Chip de procesamiento estelar estudiado: {RESEARCH} desbloqueado

Analizar el chip de procesamiento estelar.
Chip de matriz cuántica estudiado: {RESEARCH} desbloqueado

Rule.Original: By studying the quantum matrix chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.

Analizar el chip de matriz cuántica.

Rule.Original: The Sagittarius is a humanoid mechanoid equipped with a powerful tesla gun, a fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If controlled by the player, the Sagittarius' weapon will not auto target enemies, as the game doesn't consider the EMP damage to be valid against fleshy targets. Be sure to draft them and choose their targets.
Rule.Raw: The Sagittarius is a humanoid mechanoid equipped with a powerful tesla gun, a fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If controlled by the player, the Sagittarius' weapon will not auto target enemies, as the game doesn't consider the EMP damage to be valid against fleshy targets. Be sure to draft them and choose their targets.
Rule.Translated: El Sagitario es un mecanoide humanoide equipado con una potente arma Tesla, capaz de liberar una cascada de energía electromagnética. Su descarga de energía PEM puede aturdir e incapacitar mecanoides de un solo disparo y, al mismo tiempo, lanzar un rayo abrasador de electricidad que quema los objetivos orgánicos y los deja vulnerables.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Si lo controla el jugador, su arma no seleccionará enemigos automáticamente porque el juego no considera válido el daño PEM contra objetivos de carne. Reclútalo y elige sus objetivos manualmente.

Rule.Original: I can't stand such a deep hatred. It's gnawing at my bones! I'm going to be sick.
Rule.Raw: I can't stand such a deep hatred. It's gnawing at my bones! I'm going to be sick.
Rule.Translated: No soporto un odio tan profundo. ¡Me corroe los huesos! Voy a vomitar.

Rule.Original: I hear its hatred in my mind, speaking directly to me. Like a crazed whisper.
Rule.Raw: I hear its hatred in my mind, speaking directly to me. Like a crazed whisper.
Rule.Translated: Oigo su odio en mi mente, hablándome directamente. Como un susurro enloquecido.

Rule.Original: I feel it out there somewhere, it despises our humanity.
Rule.Raw: I feel it out there somewhere, it despises our humanity.
Rule.Translated: Lo siento en algún lugar ahí fuera. Desprecia nuestra humanidad.

Rule.Original:
The Aura, also known as Avenging Angels, are angel-shaped mechanoids surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Auras don't have much health, but they will regenerate damage quite fast.

Regeneration is 0.1 damage to a random wound every 10 ticks, 1/6th of a second.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.

They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Auras don't have much health, but they will regenerate damage quite fast.

Regeneration is 0.1 damage to a random wound every 10 ticks, 1/6th of a second.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.
Rule.Translated:
Los Aura, también llamados ángeles vengadores, son mecanoides angelicales rodeados por seis cuchillas metálicas flotantes. Prefieren el cuerpo a cuerpo: se acercan a sus víctimas y las envuelven en un torbellino de cortes mortales. También regeneran heridas con mecanitos de acción rápida. Esta unidad parece recién fabricada y funcionará con mayor robustez.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los Aura tienen poca salud, pero regeneran el daño muy deprisa.

La regeneración repara 0.1 de daño de una herida aleatoria cada 10 ticks, 1/6 de segundo.

Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituyen por un Segador.

Rule.Original: The daggersnout is a fast, insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.
Rule.Raw: The daggersnout is a fast, insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.
Rule.Translated: El morrodagas es un mecanoide de combate rápido, semejante a un insecto y armado con una feroz cuchilla afilada en la cabeza. No es tan peligroso como otros mecanoides de corto alcance, como los segadores, pero suele aparecer en mayor número. Esta unidad parece recién fabricada y funcionará con mayor robustez.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Segador.

Rule.Original:
A huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let a fireworm approach your defenses!

The fireworm superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like... This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 15 Bomb damage on a 1.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Rule.Raw:
A huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let a fireworm approach your defenses!

The fireworm superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like... This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 15 Bomb damage on a 1.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Rule.Translated:
Un enorme gusano mecánico armado con un peligroso lanzallamas de combustible químico. Su arma tiene muy poco alcance, ¡así que no dejes que se acerque a tus defensas!

El gusano de fuego se parece superficialmente a un coloso helado. ¿Casualidad? Quizá los mecanoides usen seres vivos como modelo. Si es así, no querrías ver el aspecto de un segador biológico... Esta unidad parece recién fabricada y funcionará con mayor robustez.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Explota al morir, causando 15 de daño explosivo en un radio de 1.9 casillas.

Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Piquero.

Rule.Original: The Goliath is a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Faster than a centipede, but weaker due to their weaker weapons. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.
Rule.Raw: The Goliath is a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Faster than a centipede, but weaker due to their weaker weapons. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.
Rule.Translated: El Goliat es un mecanoide de combate pesado de forma humanoide. Es más rápido que un ciempiés y suele llevar armas mecanoides pesadas o armas de agujas. Esta unidad parece recién fabricada y funcionará con mayor robustez.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Más rápido que un ciempiés, pero más débil por su armamento menos potente. Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Ciempiés artillero.

Rule.Original:
A hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.

This cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 10 Frostbite damage on a 2.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.

A hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.

This cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 10 Frostbite damage on a 2.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Rule.Translated:
Un enorme mecanoide basado en la forma de un escarabajo rinoceronte. El caparazón de plastiacero de la Falange oculta un potente motor criogénico que produce continuamente cápsulas compactas de gas superenfriado, disparadas desde una abertura de su cabeza.

Esta arma tiene muy poco alcance, pero resulta peligrosa para seres susceptibles a la congelación. Esta unidad parece recién fabricada y funcionará con mayor robustez.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Explota al morir, causando 10 de daño por congelación en un radio de 2.9 casillas.

Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Piquero.

Rule.Original: The siegebreaker is a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosives shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as priority targets in most cases. This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Siegebreakers fire from an extremely long range, but they need line of sight, so they can be fooled to enter into close quarters combat, where their cannons are mostly useless. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.

This particular unit appears to be freshly manufactured and will operate more robustly.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Siegebreakers fire from an extremely long range, but they need line of sight, so they can be fooled to enter into close quarters combat, where their cannons are mostly useless. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.
Rule.Translated: El rompeasedios es un mecanoide con forma de tanque especialmente peligroso. Su cañón dispara proyectiles explosivos y detecta presencias hostiles a cientos de metros, actuando como un arma de asedio implacable capaz de destruir incluso las defensas más fuertes. Se mueve muy despacio y tarda mucho en recargar, pero suele ser un objetivo prioritario. Esta unidad parece recién fabricada y funcionará con mayor robustez.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Dispara a distancias extremas, pero necesita línea de visión: se le puede atraer al cuerpo a cuerpo, donde su cañón resulta casi inútil. Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Ciempiés artillero.

Rule.Original: The Colossus is an advanced version of the Goliath, a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns. Unlike their more ancient and less advanced relatives this particular unit is much more intelligent and will seek cover and prove to be a much more challenging opponent in melee combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by an Advanced Centipede.

Unlike their more ancient and less advanced relatives this particular unit is much more intelligent and will seek cover and prove to be a much more challenging opponent in melee combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by an Advanced Centipede.
Rule.Translated: El Coloso es una versión avanzada del Goliat, un mecanoide de combate pesado de forma humanoide. Es más rápido que un ciempiés y suele llevar armas mecanoides pesadas o armas de agujas. A diferencia de sus parientes más antiguos y menos avanzados, esta unidad es mucho más inteligente: busca cobertura y resulta un rival más difícil en cuerpo a cuerpo.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Ciempiés avanzado.

Rule.Original:
An improved and strengthened version of the Aura, a Dominion is an angel-shaped mechanoid surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with VERY fast acting mechanites. Unlike their more ancient and less advanced relatives this particular unit is much more intelligent and will seek cover and prove to be a much more challenging opponent in melee combat.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Dominion don't have much health, but they will regenerate damage quite fast.

Regeneration is 0.1 damage to a random wound every 5 ticks, 1/12th of a second.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by an Advanced Scyther.

Una versión mejorada y reforzada del Aura. El Dominio es un mecanoide angelical rodeado por seis cuchillas metálicas flotantes. Prefiere el cuerpo a cuerpo y envuelve a sus víctimas en un torbellino de cortes mortales. También regenera heridas con mecanitos de acción MUY rápida. Esta unidad es mucho más inteligente que sus parientes antiguos: busca cobertura y resulta más difícil en cuerpo a cuerpo.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Los Dominio tienen poca salud, pero regeneran el daño muy deprisa.

La regeneración repara 0.1 de daño de una herida aleatoria cada 5 ticks, 1/12 de segundo.

Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituyen por un Segador avanzado.

Rule.Original: The eviscerator is a more advanced version of the daggersnout, an insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers. Unlike their more ancient and less advanced relatives this particular unit is much more intelligent and will seek cover and prove to be a much more challenging opponent in melee combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by an Advanced Scyther.

Esta unidad es mucho más inteligente que sus parientes antiguos: busca cobertura y resulta más difícil en cuerpo a cuerpo.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Segador avanzado.

Rule.Original:
The Incinerator is an advanced version of the Fireworm, a huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let an incinerator approach your defenses!

The incinerator superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like... Unlike their more ancient and less advanced relatives this particular unit is much more intelligent and will seek cover and prove to be a much more challenging opponent in melee combat.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 20 Bomb damage on a 2.9 tile radius

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by an Advanced Pikeman.

Se parece superficialmente a un coloso helado. ¿Casualidad? Quizá los mecanoides usen seres vivos como modelo. Si es así, no querrías ver un segador biológico... Esta unidad es mucho más inteligente que sus parientes antiguos: busca cobertura y resulta más difícil en cuerpo a cuerpo.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Explota al morir, causando 20 de daño explosivo en un radio de 2.9 casillas.

Si se desactiva su aparición en las opciones del mod, se sustituye por un Piquero avanzado.

Rule.Original:
It's okay to sell, install and use organs, as well as harvest them, but only from a pigskin, as it is their primary function.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
- For the purposes of this precept, anyone having the pork flesh gene counts as a pigskin.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
- For the purposes of this precept, anyone having the pork flesh gene counts as a pigskin.
Rule.Translated:
Está bien vender, instalar, utilizar y extraer órganos, pero solo de porcinos, ya que esa es su función principal.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
- Para este precepto, se considera porcino a cualquiera que tenga el gen de carne porcina.

Rule.Original:
A sealed metal container designed to keep your perishable food safe, frozen, and easily accessible for both lunch and dinner. Items stored inside will not rot over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings, as long as it's powered. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Foods, Plant matter, Alcohol, Beverages, Musts, Hay, Condiments 

<color=#0094FF>Items stored can be frozen when powered.</color>

Allowed items: Foods, Plant matter, Alcohol, Beverages, Musts, Hay, Condiments 

<color=#0094FF>Items stored can be frozen when powered.</color>
Rule.Translated:
Un recipiente metálico sellado que conserva los alimentos perecederos de forma segura, congelada y accesible para las comidas. Mientras tenga electricidad, su contenido no se pudre ni afecta a la belleza del entorno. 

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas de almacenamiento:</color> Capacidad total de pilas: 6 Pilas por casilla: 6
Objetos permitidos: Alimentos, materia vegetal, alcohol, bebidas, mostos, heno y condimentos 

<color=#0094FF>El contenido puede congelarse si hay electricidad.</color>

Rule.Original: A draught is improving all traits and abilities of the hemogenic user, as well as replenishes the hemogen over time.
Rule.Raw: A draught is improving all traits and abilities of the hemogenic user, as well as replenishes the hemogen over time.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje que mejora todos los rasgos y habilidades del usuario hemogénico y repone el hemógeno con el tiempo.

Rule.Original: This ideoligion is a descendant of Germanic paganism, also known as Asatru. It may have very different precepts than those of thousands of years ago, but its symbols are similar.
Rule.Raw: This ideoligion is a descendant of Germanic paganism, also known as Asatru. It may have very different precepts than those of thousands of years ago, but its symbols are similar.
Rule.Translated: Esta ideorreligión desciende del paganismo germánico, también conocido como Asatru. Sus preceptos pueden ser muy distintos a los de hace miles de años, pero sus símbolos son similares.

Rule.Original: museum->in the archive of Yggdrasil Station

Rule.Original: museum->in the ruins of Jotunheim Prime

Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->Escucha las palabras de Odín, el Padre de Todos, que susurra desde el Pozo de Urd:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonIntro->Lo, the verses of the Völuspá proclaim to all who would listen:

Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->He aquí lo que los versos del Völuspá proclaman a quienes quieran escuchar:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonIntro->Take heed of Thor's hammer as it strikes, for it teaches:
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonIntro->Take heed of Thor's hammer as it strikes, for it teaches:
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->Presta atención al martillo de Thor cuando golpea, pues enseña:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonIntro->Hark, the ravens Huginn and Muninn circle and cry their truth:
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonIntro->Hark, the ravens Huginn and Muninn circle and cry their truth:
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->Escucha: los cuervos Huginn y Muninn vuelan en círculos y proclaman su verdad:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonIntro->Under the shade of Yggdrasil, the gods did gather and declare:
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonIntro->Under the shade of Yggdrasil, the gods did gather and declare:
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->Bajo la sombra de Yggdrasil, los dioses se reunieron y declararon:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonIntro->By the light of Baldr's blessing, know this:
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonIntro->By the light of Baldr's blessing, know this:
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->A la luz de la bendición de Baldr, debes saber esto:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonIntro->On the fjords of the Nine Worlds, wisdom echoes, saying:
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonIntro->On the fjords of the Nine Worlds, wisdom echoes, saying:
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->En los fiordos de los Nueve Mundos, la sabiduría resuena y dice:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonIntro->The runes carved deep into the stones of Midgard teach us thus:
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonIntro->The runes carved deep into the stones of Midgard teach us thus:
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonIntro->Las runas profundamente talladas en las piedras de Midgard nos enseñan:

Rule.Original: asatruLessonReinforcement->May your deeds echo in the halls of Valhalla.
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonReinforcement->May your deeds echo in the halls of Valhalla.
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonReinforcement->Que tus hazañas resuenen en los salones del Valhalla.

Rule.Original: asatruLessonReinforcement->The Norns weave your destiny with threads of honor.
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonReinforcement->The Norns weave your destiny with threads of honor.
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonReinforcement->Las nornas tejen tu destino con hilos de honor.

Rule.Original: asatruLessonReinforcement->Stand firm, for the gods reward courage and resolve.
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonReinforcement->Stand firm, for the gods reward courage and resolve.
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonReinforcement->Mantente firme, pues los dioses recompensan el valor y la determinación.

Rule.Original: asatruLessonReinforcement->Hail, for your actions shall inspire skalds to song.
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonReinforcement->Hail, for your actions shall inspire skalds to song.
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonReinforcement->Salve, pues tus actos inspirarán los cantos de los escaldos.

Rule.Original: asatruLessonReinforcement->The hammer of Thor blesses those who uphold truth and strength.
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonReinforcement->The hammer of Thor blesses those who uphold truth and strength.
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonReinforcement->El martillo de Thor bendice a quienes defienden la verdad y la fuerza.

Rule.Original: asatruLessonReinforcement->The All-Father watches those who honor the old ways.
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonReinforcement->The All-Father watches those who honor the old ways.
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonReinforcement->El Padre de Todos observa a quienes honran las antiguas costumbres.

Rule.Original: asatruLessonReinforcement->May you find victory in the sacred bonds of kinship.
Rule.Raw: asatruLessonReinforcement->May you find victory in the sacred bonds of kinship.
Rule.Translated: asatruLessonReinforcement->Que encuentres la victoria en los sagrados vínculos del parentesco.

Rule.Original: lessonReinforcement->And so the tale will live on.
Rule.Raw: lessonReinforcement->And so the tale will live on.

Rule.Original: A stone bas relief of viking imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Raw: A stone bas relief of viking imagery for decorating a floor.
Rule.Translated: Un bajorrelieve de piedra con imágenes vikingas para decorar el suelo.

Rule.Original: A draught is improving psychic sensitivity of the user, improving their meditation capabilities.
Rule.Raw: A draught is improving psychic sensitivity of the user, improving their meditation capabilities.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje que aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del usuario y mejora su capacidad de meditación.

Rule.Original: My mind is racing. I can’t stop all the thoughts.
Rule.Raw: My mind is racing. I can’t stop all the thoughts.
Rule.Translated: Mi mente va a toda velocidad. No puedo detener los pensamientos.

Rule.Original: A draught is greatly improving the immunity gain speed of the user while also boosting their consciousness and movement speed.
Rule.Raw: A draught is greatly improving the immunity gain speed of the user while also boosting their consciousness and movement speed.
Rule.Translated: Un brebaje que aumenta considerablemente la velocidad de adquisición de inmunidad, además de mejorar la consciencia y la velocidad de movimiento.

Rule.Original: Coif made of fine ring maille, protects face and neck well from cuts.
Rule.Raw: Coif made of fine ring maille, protects face and neck well from cuts.
Rule.Translated: Un almófar de fina cota de malla que protege bien la cara y el cuello de los cortes.

Rule.Original: A padded coif, somewhat protects from cuts but it's really more for wear under a helmet
Rule.Raw: A padded coif, somewhat protects from cuts but it's really more for wear under a helmet
Rule.Translated: Una cofia acolchada que ofrece cierta protección contra cortes, aunque está pensada sobre todo para llevarla bajo un casco.

Rule.Raw: Helmet made of iron plates attached into a conical shape, fitted with a nose guard
Rule.Translated: Un casco cónico formado por placas de hierro unidas y equipado con una protección para la nariz.

Rule.Raw: Helmet made of iron plates attached into a conical shape, fitted with a nose guard and rings around the eyes, moderate amount of face protection
Rule.Translated: Un casco cónico formado por placas de hierro unidas, equipado con una protección para la nariz y aros alrededor de los ojos. Ofrece una protección moderada para el rostro.

casco con protección ocular y almófar

Rule.Original: Helmet made of iron plates attached into a conical shape, fitted with a nose guard and rings around the eyes, worn with maille coif
Rule.Raw: Helmet made of iron plates attached into a conical shape, fitted with a nose guard and rings around the eyes, worn with maille coif
Rule.Translated: Un casco cónico formado por placas de hierro unidas, equipado con una protección para la nariz y aros alrededor de los ojos, llevado sobre un almófar de malla.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] once worked as a sub-individual of a hive mind under the command of a certain transcendent intelligence. {PAWN_pronoun} was dispatched into the cosmos to observe anomalous entities, which provided {PAWN_pronoun} with an opportunity to escape from its control.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] once worked as a sub-individual of a hive mind under the command of a certain transcendent intelligence. {PAWN_pronoun} was dispatched into the cosmos to observe anomalous entities, which provided {PAWN_pronoun} with an opportunity to escape from its control.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] trabajó como una subunidad de una mente colmena al servicio de cierta inteligencia trascendente. {PAWN_pronoun} recibió la misión de observar entidades anómalas por el cosmos, lo que dio a {PAWN_pronoun} una oportunidad de escapar de su control.

Rule.Original: A deranged maid approaches the colony, draped in blue feathers...
Rule.Raw: A deranged maid approaches the colony, draped in blue feathers...
Rule.Translated: Una doncella trastornada se acerca a la colonia, cubierta de plumas azules...

Rule.Original: Resurrect a friendly mechanoid of anomaly class. So long as the mechanoid's body is not completely destroyed, it can be resurrected.
Rule.Raw: Resurrect a friendly mechanoid of anomaly class. So long as the mechanoid's body is not completely destroyed, it can be resurrected.
Rule.Translated: Resucitar un mecanoide amistoso de clase anómala. Mientras su cuerpo no esté completamente destruido, puede resucitarse.

Rule.Original:
An eerie mechanoid composed of shard, bioferrite, and hate. It is said to be designed based on terrifying legends from the Eastern systems. Mechanics occasionallycatch glimpses of her sinister smile—perhaps a dangerous consciousness is gestatingwithin this bioferrite chrysalis.

She possesses a pair of slender bioferrite powerclaws, excellent tools for mining ore and breaking down doors, not to mention slicingthrough flesh with ease.

bioferrite grants the mechanoid enhanced cognition andspeed, along with some psychic sensitivity, and it is no longer affected by EMP.However, the trade-off is weaker heat resistance compared to other mechanoids, as wellas slight flammability.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Can regenerate at an uncanny speed.
Rule.Raw:
An eerie mechanoid composed of shard, bioferrite, and hate. It is said to be designed based on terrifying legends from the Eastern systems. Mechanics occasionallycatch glimpses of her sinister smile—perhaps a dangerous consciousness is gestatingwithin this bioferrite chrysalis.

She possesses a pair of slender bioferrite powerclaws, excellent tools for mining ore and breaking down doors, not to mention slicingthrough flesh with ease.

bioferrite grants the mechanoid enhanced cognition andspeed, along with some psychic sensitivity, and it is no longer affected by EMP.However, the trade-off is weaker heat resistance compared to other mechanoids, as wellas slight flammability.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Can regenerate at an uncanny speed.
Rule.Translated:
Un inquietante mecanoide compuesto de fragmentos, bioferrita y odio. Se dice que su diseño se basa en aterradoras leyendas de los sistemas orientales. Los mecánicos a veces vislumbran su sonrisa siniestra: quizá una consciencia peligrosa se esté gestando dentro de esta crisálida de bioferrita.

Tiene dos esbeltas garras de energía de bioferrita, excelentes para extraer mineral, derribar puertas y cortar carne con facilidad.

La bioferrita mejora su capacidad cognitiva y su velocidad, le otorga cierta sensibilidad psíquica y lo hace inmune al PEM. A cambio, resiste peor el calor que otros mecanoides y es ligeramente inflamable.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Puede regenerarse a una velocidad sobrenatural.

Rule.Original: A table for conjure or assemble maid constructs, will also produce dangerous alchemy waste.
Rule.Raw: A table for conjure or assemble maid constructs, will also produce dangerous alchemy waste.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa para invocar o ensamblar doncellas constructo. También produce residuos alquímicos peligrosos.

Rule.Original: Lightweight mechanoids can recharge here. During recharge, this recharger produces toxic wastepacks and stores them internally. Haulers must remove the wastepacks from time to time.
Rule.Raw: Lightweight mechanoids can recharge here. During recharge, this recharger produces toxic wastepacks and stores them internally. Haulers must remove the wastepacks from time to time.
Rule.Translated: Los mecanoides ligeros pueden recargarse aquí. Durante la recarga, produce paquetes de residuos tóxicos y los almacena en su interior. Los transportistas deben retirarlos de vez en cuando.

Rule.Original: deformed gauranlen tree, can never grow dryads, but can drop seeds.\nIt is not considered as artifical building, and raiders will ignore it.
Rule.Raw: deformed gauranlen tree, can never grow dryads, but can drop seeds.\nIt is not considered as artifical building, and raiders will ignore it.
Rule.Translated: Un árbol gauranlen deforme que nunca puede producir dríadas, pero sí dejar semillas.\nNo se considera una construcción artificial y los asaltantes lo ignorarán.

Rule.Original: A processed Gauranlen seed, suspended at the germination stage. Perhaps a bold individual could attempt to thread its roots through the nasal cavity and implant itinto the brain, thus planting a Gauranlen Tree within the mind.
Rule.Raw: A processed Gauranlen seed, suspended at the germination stage. Perhaps a bold individual could attempt to thread its roots through the nasal cavity and implant itinto the brain, thus planting a Gauranlen Tree within the mind.
Rule.Translated: Una semilla gauranlen procesada, suspendida en la fase de germinación. Quizá alguien audaz intente pasar sus raíces por la cavidad nasal e implantarlas en el cerebro, plantando así un árbol gauranlen en la mente.

Rule.Original: arrivalLetterText->The emissary of the Gauranlen Tree, clad in black and white robes, descends from the sky. [mechanitor_nameDef] feels the connection with[mech_label], and her will to serve the Master.
Rule.Raw: arrivalLetterText->The emissary of the Gauranlen Tree, clad in black and white robes, descends from the sky. [mechanitor_nameDef] feels the connection with[mech_label], and her will to serve the Master.
Rule.Translated: arrivalLetterText->El emisario del árbol gauranlen, vestido con ropas blancas y negras, desciende del cielo. [mechanitor_nameDef] siente la conexión con [mech_label] y su voluntad de servir al Maestro.

Rule.Original: A germinated Gauranlen seed. Implanting it into a Mechanitor increases control threads, but requires the consumption of additional nutrients.\n\n Up to 5 implants can be administered.
Rule.Raw: A germinated Gauranlen seed. Implanting it into a Mechanitor increases control threads, but requires the consumption of additional nutrients.\n\n Up to 5 implants can be administered.
Rule.Translated: Una semilla gauranlen germinada. Implantarla en un mecanitor aumenta los hilos de control, pero exige consumir nutrientes adicionales.\n\n Se pueden aplicar hasta 5 implantes.

Rule.Original: A germinated Gauranlen seed. Implanting it into a Mechanitor increases control threads, but requires the consumption of additional nutrients.\n\n Up to 5 implants can be administered.

Rule.Original: A rooted Gauranlen seed. Implanting it into a Mechanitor increases construct work speed, but requires the consumption of additional nutrients.\n\n Up to 5 implants can be administered.
Rule.Raw: A rooted Gauranlen seed. Implanting it into a Mechanitor increases construct work speed, but requires the consumption of additional nutrients.\n\n Up to 5 implants can be administered.
Rule.Translated: Una semilla gauranlen arraigada. Implantarla en un mecanitor aumenta la velocidad de trabajo de los constructos, pero exige consumir nutrientes adicionales.\n\n Se pueden aplicar hasta 5 implantes.

Rule.Original: Implanting a Gauranlen seed into the body enhances construct working speed，but it causes the host to consume additional nutrients to sustain the internal Gauranlen Tree.\n\n Up to 5 implants can be administered.
Rule.Raw: Implanting a Gauranlen seed into the body enhances construct working speed，but it causes the host to consume additional nutrients to sustain the internal Gauranlen Tree.\n\n Up to 5 implants can be administered.
Rule.Translated: Implantar una semilla gauranlen en el cuerpo mejora la velocidad de trabajo de los constructos, pero obliga al huésped a consumir nutrientes adicionales para mantener el árbol de su interior.\n\n Se pueden aplicar hasta 5 implantes.

Rule.Original:
The constructs used by the Legion Node before the military reform. At that time, light infantry units stood in the front line of the three-tier formation, employing javelins or bows to attrition the main forces of organic enemies, while also serving as skirmishers for raiding and disruptive operations.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Can pick up neolithic and medieval weapons.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Can regenerate slowly.

Rule.Translated:
Los constructos que utilizaba el Nodo Legión antes de la reforma militar. Entonces, las unidades de infantería ligera ocupaban la primera línea de la formación de tres niveles y empleaban jabalinas o arcos para desgastar a las fuerzas orgánicas enemigas. También actuaban como hostigadores en incursiones y operaciones de sabotaje.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Puede recoger armas neolíticas y medievales.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Puede regenerarse lentamente.

Rule.Original:
A dryad maid clad in heavy armor, who stood in the second row of the three-tier formation before the Legion Node implemented military reforms. She maintained the battle line with a dual-edged sword and shield.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>
Can pick up neolithic and medieval weapons.

<color=yellow>Vanilla ExpandedFramework</color>
Can regenerate slowly.

<color=yellow>Fortified Features Framework</color>

Rule.Original:
Mysterious construct, design was copied from an Earth military company 3000 years ago.

Can pick up a variety of weapons like DMS Automatroids.

Can regenerate slowly.

Rule.Original: Ancient knowledge passed down among the tribes, used to summon basic construct maids. Essentially, these constructs are twisted dryads, connected to their summoners through seeds of the Gauranlen Tree.\n<color=yellow>Buildings will be categorized under Ideology</color>
Rule.Raw: Ancient knowledge passed down among the tribes, used to summon basic construct maids. Essentially, these constructs are twisted dryads, connected to their summoners through seeds of the Gauranlen Tree.\n<color=yellow>Buildings will be categorized under Ideology</color>
Rule.Translated: Conocimientos antiguos transmitidos entre las tribus para invocar doncellas constructo básicas. En esencia, son dríadas deformadas, conectadas a sus invocadores mediante semillas del árbol gauranlen.\n<color=yellow>Los edificios se clasificarán en Ideología</color>

Rule.Original: subject_story->authored a children's book covering the basic types of constructs
Rule.Raw: subject_story->authored a children's book covering the basic types of constructs
Rule.Translated: subject_story->escribió un libro infantil sobre los tipos básicos de constructos

Rule.Original: subject_story->was implanted with a prototype mechlink
Rule.Raw: subject_story->was implanted with a prototype mechlink
Rule.Translated: subject_story->recibió el implante de un prototipo de mecenlace

Rule.Original: subject_story->was mining an ancient exostrider wreck and found a mechlink preserved in the body
Rule.Raw: subject_story->was mining an ancient exostrider wreck and found a mechlink preserved in the body
Rule.Translated: subject_story->extraía materiales de los restos de un antiguo exozancudo y encontró un mecenlace conservado en su cuerpo

Rule.Original: You are a devout tribal wanderer. Guided by the Gauranlen Tree, you enter an ancient ruin and extract a mysterious Gauranlen seed from a corpse. No one knows what this means...\n\nNote: You start poorly and lack power technology, which is a difficult script.
Rule.Raw: You are a devout tribal wanderer. Guided by the Gauranlen Tree, you enter an ancient ruin and extract a mysterious Gauranlen seed from a corpse. No one knows what this means...\n\nNote: You start poorly and lack power technology, which is a difficult script.
Rule.Translated: Eres un devoto vagabundo tribal. Guiado por el árbol gauranlen, entras en unas ruinas antiguas y extraes una misteriosa semilla gauranlen de un cadáver. Nadie sabe qué significa...\n\nNota: empiezas con pocos recursos y sin tecnología eléctrica. Es un escenario difícil.

Rule.Original: The journey of a wanderer and mech maid from the sky.
Rule.Raw: The journey of a wanderer and mech maid from the sky.
Rule.Translated: El viaje de un vagabundo y una doncella mecanoide venida del cielo.

Rule.Original: You are a devout tribal wanderer. Guided by the Gauranlen Tree, you enter an ancient ruin and extract a mysterious Gauranlen seed from a corpse. No one knows what this means...

Rule.Original: Resurrect a friendly maid construct. So long as the construct's body is not completely destroyed, it can be resurrected.
Rule.Raw: Resurrect a friendly maid construct. So long as the construct's body is not completely destroyed, it can be resurrected.
Rule.Translated: Resucitar una doncella constructo amistosa. Puede resucitarse mientras su cuerpo no esté completamente destruido.
Falta el brasero de luz oscura.
El brasero de luz oscura no está encendido.

Rule.Original:
Our adoration for the water and all life within has led us to employ new and subtle techniques for catching as many fish as possible.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Adept fishermen will be able to catch additional fish from fishing zones. These "adept fish" will be caught 20% of the time in a stack of 10, increasing the overall yield of fishing.
Rule.Raw:
Our adoration for the water and all life within has led us to employ new and subtle techniques for catching as many fish as possible.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Adept fishermen will be able to catch additional fish from fishing zones. These "adept fish" will be caught 20% of the time in a stack of 10, increasing the overall yield of fishing.
Rule.Translated:
Nuestra veneración del agua y de toda su vida nos ha llevado a emplear técnicas nuevas y sutiles para capturar tantos peces como sea posible.

<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color>
 - Los pescadores expertos pueden obtener peces adicionales en las zonas de pesca. Estas «capturas expertas» aparecen el 20% de las veces en grupos de 10, aumentando el rendimiento total de la pesca.

Rule.Original: Raw crayfish. Crayfish are freshwater crustaceans resembling small lobsters (to which they are related). Some species are found in brooks and streams, where fresh water is running, while others thrive in swamps, ditches, and paddy fields.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.
Rule.Raw: Raw crayfish. Crayfish are freshwater crustaceans resembling small lobsters (to which they are related). Some species are found in brooks and streams, where fresh water is running, while others thrive in swamps, ditches, and paddy fields.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.
Rule.Translated: Cangrejo de río crudo. Estos crustáceos de agua dulce se parecen a pequeñas langostas, con las que están emparentados. Algunas especies habitan arroyos de agua corriente y otras prosperan en pantanos, zanjas y arrozales.\n\nEsta captura experta se obtiene además de otros peces.

Rule.Original: Raw Atlantic butterfish. The Atlantic butterfish is distinguished by its very thin, deep body, resembling a flounder on edge. It earned its buttery name from its high oil content.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.
Rule.Raw: Raw Atlantic butterfish. The Atlantic butterfish is distinguished by its very thin, deep body, resembling a flounder on edge. It earned its buttery name from its high oil content.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.
Rule.Translated: Pez mantequilla atlántico crudo. Se distingue por su cuerpo muy delgado y alto, parecido a un pez plano puesto de canto. Su nombre se debe a su elevado contenido en aceite.\n\nEsta captura experta se obtiene además de otros peces.

Rule.Original: Raw freshwater stingray. Freshwater stingrays are one of the only rays inhabiting freshwater rather than saltwater. Though docile animals, they were responsiblein old Earth for more injuries to humans each year than any other Amazonian species.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.

Though docile animals, they were responsiblein old Earth for more injuries to humans each year than any other Amazonian species.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.
Rule.Translated: Raya de agua dulce cruda. Es una de las pocas rayas que viven en agua dulce en vez de salada. Aunque son dóciles, en la antigua Tierra causaban más lesiones humanas al año que cualquier otra especie amazónica.\n\nEsta captura experta se obtiene además de otros peces.

Rule.Original: Raw flying fish. While they cannot fly in the same way a bird does, flying fish can make powerful, self-propelled leaps out of the water where their long wing-like fins enable gliding for considerable distances above the water's surface.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.
Rule.Raw: Raw flying fish. Rule.Translated: Pez volador crudo. No vuela como un ave, pero puede dar potentes saltos fuera del agua y usar sus largas aletas semejantes a alas para planear distancias considerables sobre la superficie.\n\nEsta captura experta se obtiene además de otros peces.

Rule.Original: Raw arapaima. On old Earth, it was among the world's largest freshwater fish, reaching as much as 3 m in length. It was an important food fish.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.

Rule.Translated: Arapaima crudo. En la antigua Tierra era uno de los mayores peces de agua dulce y podía alcanzar 3 m de longitud. Era una importante fuente de alimento.\n\nEsta captura experta se obtiene además de otros peces.

Rule.Original: Raw shortfin mako shark. A large, predatory shark that lives in the open ocean and is often considered the fastest shark. It is known for its incredible leaping ability and can be observed jumping to extreme heights (out of the water) when hunting.\n\nThis is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.

Rule.Original: A primitive, though quite ingenious barricade made of wooden stick and netting meant to entrap incoming fish and leave them with no way out. Fish traps are eventually destroyed by the currents and struggling fish, and will need replacing.\n\nThis is a small trap that will only catch small sized fish.
Rule.Raw: A primitive, though quite ingenious barricade made of wooden stick and netting meant to entrap incoming fish and leave them with no way out. Fish traps are eventually destroyed by the currents and struggling fish, and will need replacing.\n\nThis is a small trap that will only catch small sized fish.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera primitiva pero ingeniosa, hecha de palos y redes, que atrapa a los peces sin dejarles salida. Las corrientes y los peces que forcejean terminan destruyéndola, por lo que hay que reemplazarla.\n\nEsta trampa pequeña solo captura peces pequeños.

Fish traps are eventually destroyed by the currents and struggling fish, and will need replacing.\n\nThis is a medium trap that will only catch medium sized fish.
