Rule.Original: Extract vegetable milk from oats. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process. Soybeans are more efficient than other recipes.
Rule.Raw: Extract vegetable milk from oats. This milk can be used in any recipe that asks for milk.\n\nVegetable milks are generally inefficient, as a lot of nutrition is lost in the process. Soybeans are more efficient than other recipes.
Rule.Translated: Extraer leche vegetal de avena. Puede utilizarse en cualquier receta que requiera leche.\n\nLas leches vegetales suelen ser poco eficientes, ya que se pierde mucha nutrición durante el proceso. La soja es más eficiente que las otras recetas.

Rule.Original: A shrub prized for its sweet edible fruits. Huckleberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Huckleberries are pollinated by bees: they will receive a growth boost if an apiary is found in a radius of 6 tiles. To avoid lag this is only calculated once, when the plant is sown, so apiaries placed after sowing it will have no effect. If there are no apiaries it will behave as a slower strawberry plant.
Rule.Raw: A shrub prized for its sweet edible fruits. Huckleberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Huckleberries are pollinated by bees: they will receive a growth boost if an apiary is found in a radius of 6 tiles. To avoid lag this is only calculated once, when the plant is sown, so apiaries placed after sowing it will have no effect. If there are no apiaries it will behave as a slower strawberry plant.
Rule.Translated: Un arbusto apreciado por sus frutos dulces y comestibles. Los arándanos silvestres suelen comerse frescos como postre o utilizarse en repostería.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Efecto en el juego:</color> Las abejas los polinizan: reciben una bonificación al crecimiento si hay un colmenar en un radio de 6 casillas. Para evitar problemas de rendimiento, solo se calcula al sembrar; colocar un colmenar después no tiene efecto. Sin colmenares, se comportan como fresas de crecimiento más lento.

Rule.Original: A sweet, edible fruit. Huckleberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.
Rule.Raw: A sweet, edible fruit. Huckleberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.
Rule.Translated: Un fruto dulce y comestible. Los arándanos silvestres suelen comerse frescos como postre o utilizarse en repostería.

Rule.Original:
A highly potent healing potion.

Consuming the potion will heal the single worst health condition affecting someone at any given time.

Works even on health conditions that would otherwise be incurable. The healing effect can even regenerate missing limbs or organs.
Rule.Raw:
A highly potent healing potion.

Consuming the potion will heal the single worst health condition affecting someone at any given time.

Works even on health conditions that would otherwise be incurable. The healing effect can even regenerate missing limbs or organs.
Rule.Translated:
Una poción de curación de gran potencia.

Al consumirla, cura el peor problema de salud que afecte a la persona en ese momento.

Funciona incluso con afecciones normalmente incurables. Su efecto puede regenerar miembros u órganos perdidos.
Administrar una poción de curación superior.
Administrando una poción de curación superior.

Rule.Original:
A healing potion of such potent magic that a few drops placed in the mouth of a corpse can resurrect the dead.

Unfortunately, those brought back may suffer from brain damage, blindness, or progressive madness. They will also experience mild amnesia, forgetting some recent memories and social interactions.

Outcomes are better when used on a fresher body. If a body is preserved, it can even be resurrected long after death.
Rule.Raw:
A healing potion of such potent magic that a few drops placed in the mouth of a corpse can resurrect the dead.

Unfortunately, those brought back may suffer from brain damage, blindness, or progressive madness. They will also experience mild amnesia, forgetting some recent memories and social interactions.

Outcomes are better when used on a fresher body. If a body is preserved, it can even be resurrected long after death.
Rule.Translated:
Una poción de magia curativa tan potente que unas gotas en la boca de un cadáver pueden resucitarlo.

Por desgracia, quienes regresen pueden sufrir daño cerebral, ceguera o locura progresiva. También experimentarán una amnesia leve y olvidarán algunos recuerdos e interacciones sociales recientes.

Los resultados son mejores cuanto más reciente sea el cadáver. Si se conserva, puede resucitarse incluso mucho después de la muerte.

Rule.Original: I had to eat something that was processed in the guts of a biomechanical abomination. I haven't eaten a more disgusting meal in my whole life.
Rule.Raw: I had to eat something that was processed in the guts of a biomechanical abomination. I haven't eaten a more disgusting meal in my whole life.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que comer algo procesado en las entrañas de una abominación biomecánica. Nunca había probado una comida más asquerosa.

Rule.Original: An improved and strengthened version of the Aura, a Dominion is an angel-shaped mechanoid surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites.
Rule.Raw: An improved and strengthened version of the Aura, a Dominion is an angel-shaped mechanoid surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites.
Rule.Translated: Una versión mejorada y reforzada del Aura. El Dominio es un mecanoide angelical rodeado por seis cuchillas metálicas flotantes. Prefiere el cuerpo a cuerpo: se acerca a sus víctimas y las envuelve en un torbellino de cortes mortales. También regenera heridas con mecanitos de acción rápida.

Rule.Original: The eviscerator is a more advanced version of the daggersnout, an insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers.
Rule.Raw: The eviscerator is a more advanced version of the daggersnout, an insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers.
Rule.Translated: El Eviscerador es una versión avanzada del morrodagas, un mecanoide de combate parecido a un insecto y armado con una feroz cuchilla afilada en la cabeza. No es tan peligroso como otros mecanoides de corto alcance, como los segadores, pero suele aparecer en mayor número.

Rule.Original: The Incinerator is an advanced version of the Fireworm, a huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let an incinerator approach your defenses!\n\nThe incinerator superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like...
Rule.Raw: The Incinerator is an advanced version of the Fireworm, a huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let an incinerator approach your defenses!\n\nThe incinerator superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like...
Rule.Translated: El Incinerador es una versión avanzada del gusano de fuego, un enorme gusano mecánico armado con un peligroso lanzallamas de combustible químico. Su arma tiene muy poco alcance, ¡así que no dejes que se acerque a tus defensas!\n\nSe parece superficialmente a un coloso helado. ¿Casualidad? Quizá los mecanoides usen seres vivos como modelo. Si es así, no querrías ver el aspecto de un segador biológico...

Rule.Original: The Colossus is an advanced version of the Goliath, a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns. If built by the player, it will have a "Swap weapon" ability to choose between the charge blaster and the Needle gun.
Rule.Raw: The Colossus is an advanced version of the Goliath, a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns. If built by the player, it will have a "Swap weapon" ability to choose between the charge blaster and the Needle gun.
Rule.Translated: El Coloso es una versión avanzada del Goliat, un mecanoide de combate pesado de forma humanoide. Es más rápido que un ciempiés y suele llevar armas mecanoides pesadas o armas de agujas. Si lo construye el jugador, tendrá la habilidad «Cambiar arma» para elegir entre el bláster de carga y el arma de agujas.

Rule.Original: The Hoplite is an advanced version of the Phalanx, a bulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The hoplite's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.\n\nThis cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.
Rule.Raw: The Hoplite is an advanced version of the Phalanx, a bulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The hoplite's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.\n\nThis cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.
Rule.Translated: El Hoplita es una versión avanzada de la Falange, un enorme mecanoide basado en un escarabajo rinoceronte. Su caparazón de plastiacero oculta un potente motor criogénico que produce continuamente cápsulas compactas de gas superenfriado, disparadas desde una abertura de la cabeza.\n\nEsta arma tiene muy poco alcance, pero puede ser muy peligrosa para seres susceptibles a la congelación.

Rule.Original: The Siegemaster is an advanced version of the Siegebreaker, a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosive shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.
Rule.Raw: The Siegemaster is an advanced version of the Siegebreaker, a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosive shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.
Rule.Translated: El maestro de asedio es una versión avanzada del rompeasedios, un peligroso mecanoide con forma de tanque. Su cañón dispara proyectiles explosivos y detecta hostiles a cientos de metros, actuando como un arma de asedio implacable capaz de destruir incluso las defensas más fuertes. Se mueve muy despacio y tarda mucho en recargar, pero suele ser un objetivo prioritario.
Gestar un mecanoide maestro de asedio.

Rule.Original: The Slurrymaster is an advanced version of the Slurrypede. This extremely rare bio-mechanical creature is the result of a batch of mechanoids receiving a hardware upgrade. The Slurrymaster is a modified bio-mechanoid capable of extracting energy from standard mech rechargers and use it to process inorganic matter into a homogeneous organic slurry. This slurry is virtually indistinguishable from nutrient paste produced in a nutrient paste dispenser.
Rule.Raw: The Slurrymaster is an advanced version of the Slurrypede. This extremely rare bio-mechanical creature is the result of a batch of mechanoids receiving a hardware upgrade. The Slurrymaster is a modified bio-mechanoid capable of extracting energy from standard mech rechargers and use it to process inorganic matter into a homogeneous organic slurry. This slurry is virtually indistinguishable from nutrient paste produced in a nutrient paste dispenser.
Rule.Translated: El maestro de pulpa es una versión avanzada del ciempiés de pulpa. Esta criatura biomecánica extremadamente rara surge cuando un lote de mecanoides recibe una mejora de hardware. Es un biomecanoide modificado que extrae energía de recargadores normales para procesar materia inorgánica y convertirla en una pulpa orgánica homogénea, prácticamente indistinguible de la pasta nutritiva de un dispensador.
Gestar un mecanoide maestro de pulpa prístino.

Rule.Original: Researching the mechanoid hardware upgrade will allow you to build all the advanced alpha mechs added in Vanilla Factions Expanded - Mechanoid.
Rule.Raw: Researching the mechanoid hardware upgrade will allow you to build all the advanced alpha mechs added in Vanilla Factions Expanded - Mechanoid.
Rule.Translated: Investigar la mejora de hardware mecanoide permite construir todos los mecanoides alfa avanzados añadidos en Vanilla Factions Expanded - Mechanoid.
sarcófago de combate de maestro mecanoide

Rule.Original: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell that enables the wearer to control mechanoids effectively.
Rule.Raw: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell that enables the wearer to control mechanoids effectively.
Rule.Translated: Una carcasa especializada de sarcófago de combate de tecnología espacial que permite controlar mecanoides con eficacia.

Rule.Original: The Mech Master Warcasket is a specialized warcasket shell that enables the wearer to control mechanoids effectively. It is equipped with advanced technology that enhances the wearer's neural mechlink with mechanoids, providing unparalleled control over these machines on the battlefield.\n\nIn addition to its advanced control systems, the Mech Master Warcasket also features a powerful energy shield that can absorb and deflect incoming attacks, making it an excellent choice for frontline combat situations. Its integrated power systems ensure that the shield remains operational even in the most intense combat situations.
Rule.Raw: The Mech Master Warcasket is a specialized warcasket shell that enables the wearer to control mechanoids effectively. It is equipped with advanced technology that enhances the wearer's neural mechlink with mechanoids, providing unparalleled control over these machines on the battlefield.\n\nIn addition to its advanced control systems, the Mech Master Warcasket also features a powerful energy shield that can absorb and deflect incoming attacks, making it an excellent choice for frontline combat situations. Its integrated power systems ensure that the shield remains operational even in the most intense combat situations.
Rule.Translated: El sarcófago de combate de maestro mecanoide es una carcasa especializada que permite controlar mecanoides con eficacia. Su tecnología avanzada mejora el mecenlace neural del usuario y proporciona un control incomparable de estas máquinas en el campo de batalla.\n\nAdemás de sus sistemas de control, incorpora un potente escudo de energía que absorbe y desvía ataques, ideal para combatir en primera línea. Sus sistemas de alimentación integrados mantienen el escudo operativo incluso en los enfrentamientos más intensos.

Rule.Original: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a mech master warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on them, and they can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. {PAWN_nameDef} will be unable to do most tasks, except those necessary to maintain and build mechanoids.
Rule.Raw: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a mech master warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on them, and they can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. {PAWN_nameDef} will be unable to do most tasks, except those necessary to maintain and build mechanoids.
Rule.Translated: {PAWN_nameDef} está encerrado en un sarcófago de combate de maestro mecanoide. Ninguna cantidad de dolor le afecta y nunca puede sufrir un shock ni perder la consciencia por dolor. {PAWN_nameDef} no podrá realizar la mayoría de las tareas, salvo las necesarias para mantener y construir mecanoides.

Rule.Original:
Increases work speed when placed near a workbench. One workbench can use up to two tool cabinets. This structure can also be used to store goods and valuables. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 3
Allowed items: Metals
Rule.Raw:
Increases work speed when placed near a workbench. One workbench can use up to two tool cabinets. This structure can also be used to store goods and valuables. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 3
Allowed items: Metals
Rule.Translated:
Aumenta la velocidad de trabajo al colocarse junto a un banco de trabajo. Cada banco puede aprovechar hasta dos armarios de herramientas. También permite almacenar mercancías y objetos valiosos. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas de almacenamiento:</color> Capacidad total de pilas: 6 Pilas por casilla: 3
Objetos permitidos: Metales

Rule.Original:
A dresser. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect. Can be used to store Apparel. Items stored in this will not deteriorate, even if outside. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 4 Stack per tile: 2
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Raw:
A dresser. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect. Can be used to store Apparel. Items stored in this will not deteriorate, even if outside. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 4 Stack per tile: 2
Allowed items: Apparel
Rule.Translated:
Una cómoda que proporciona una pequeña bonificación de comodidad a las camas cercanas. Colocar más de una junto a la misma cama no tiene efecto. Puede almacenar ropa, que no se deteriora ni siquiera al aire libre. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas de almacenamiento:</color> Capacidad total de pilas: 4 Pilas por casilla: 2
Objetos permitidos: Ropa

Rule.Original:
A triple-stack shelf that holds three times as much as empty ground. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.

Since shelf space is limited, shelves cannot hold chunks, buildings, plants and large corpses. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 6 Stack per tile: 3
Allowed items: Foods, Manufactured, Raw Resources, Items, Weapons, Apparel, Corpses

Rule.Translated:
Una estantería de apilamiento triple que almacena tres veces más que el suelo vacío. Su contenido nunca se deteriora ni afecta a la belleza del entorno.

Por su espacio limitado, las estanterías no pueden contener bloques de roca, edificios, plantas ni cadáveres grandes. 

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas de almacenamiento:</color> Capacidad total de pilas: 6 Pilas por casilla: 3
Objetos permitidos: Alimentos, productos manufacturados, recursos básicos, objetos, armas, ropa y cadáveres

Rule.Original: By studying the gauranlen seed, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Rule.Raw: By studying the gauranlen seed, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Rule.Translated: Al estudiar la semilla gauranlen, {PAWN_labelShort} ha adquirido los conocimientos necesarios para los proyectos de investigación {RESEARCH}.\n\nTus investigadores ya pueden utilizar mesas de investigación para averiguar cómo aprovechar esta tecnología.

Rule.Original: A display case that can showcase a single item. Colonists can admire it like a work of art.
Rule.Raw: A display case that can showcase a single item. Colonists can admire it like a work of art.
Rule.Translated: Una soporte acristalado que puede exponer un objeto.

Rule.Original: A round pedestal that can showcase a single item. Colonists can admire it like a work of art.
Rule.Raw: A round pedestal that can showcase a single item. Colonists can admire it like a work of art.
Rule.Translated: Un pedestal redondo que puede exponer un objeto.

Rule.Original: A tall crate that can hold up to 24 stacks of various items.
Rule.Raw: A tall crate that can hold up to 24 stacks of various items.
Rule.Translated: Un contenedor alto que puede almacenar hasta 24 objetos de varios tipos.

Rule.Original: A large crate that can hold up to 24 stacks of various items.
Rule.Raw: A large crate that can hold up to 24 stacks of various items.
Rule.Translated: Una contenedor grande que puede almacenar hasta 24 objetos de varios tipos.

Rule.Original: Spelt is a species of wheat that has been cultivated since approximately 5000 BC. A good source of dietary fiber, protein (which it contains more of than common wheat), and vitamins and minerals. Spelt takes almost an entire growing season to come to fruition. While fragile and time-consuming, this cereal has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.
Rule.Raw: Spelt is a species of wheat that has been cultivated since approximately 5000 BC. A good source of dietary fiber, protein (which it contains more of than common wheat), and vitamins and minerals. Spelt takes almost an entire growing season to come to fruition. While fragile and time-consuming, this cereal has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.
Rule.Translated: Una planta de cereal de color ámbar que tarda casi toda una estación en dar sus frutos. Aunque es frágil y requiere mucho tiempo, este trigo ha sido modificado genéticamente para que se deshaga suavemente en harina con un simple toque.

Rule.Original: Spelt flour, ideal for use in baking. Spelt flour takes a very long time to go bad, if stored in a dry environment. It was produced by spelt that has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.
Rule.Raw: Spelt flour, ideal for use in baking. Spelt flour takes a very long time to go bad, if stored in a dry environment. It was produced by spelt that has been genetically engineered to gently break into flour with a mere touch.
Rule.Translated: Harina de trigo, utilizada en la repostería. La harina de trigo tarda mucho tiempo en estropearse, siempre que se almacene en un entorno seco. Se produce con trigo que ha sido modificado genéticamente para que se deshaga suavemente en harina con un simple toque.

Rule.Original: A thick, tall, tropical grass with jointed stems. The Uba variety is much hardier but less productive than common sugarcane. While not exactly the most nutritious thing to eat on its own, this genetically modified sugarcane is easily milled into brown sugar and then used for a variety of culinary creations - Particularly desserts.
Rule.Raw: A thick, tall, tropical grass with jointed stems. The Uba variety is much hardier but less productive than common sugarcane. While not exactly the most nutritious thing to eat on its own, this genetically modified sugarcane is easily milled into brown sugar and then used for a variety of culinary creations - Particularly desserts.
Rule.Translated: A thick, tall, tropical grass with jointed stems. While not exactly the most nutritious thing to eat on its own, this genetically modified sugarcane is easily milled into sugar and then used for a variety of culinary creations - Particularly desserts.

Rule.Original: Brown sugar is a sucrose sugar product with a distinctive brown color due to the presence of sugarcane molasses, and it adds a much desired sweetness. While sugar is good on the tongue, it is not so good on the kidneys and can quickly cause diabetes when eaten in mass. Sugar is easily converted into energy by the body, which may result in a nice burst of energy.
Rule.Raw: Brown sugar is a sucrose sugar product with a distinctive brown color due to the presence of sugarcane molasses, and it adds a much desired sweetness. While sugar is good on the tongue, it is not so good on the kidneys and can quickly cause diabetes when eaten in mass. Sugar is easily converted into energy by the body, which may result in a nice burst of energy.
Rule.Translated: Azúcar de caña, pura y cristalina, que aporta una dulzura muy deseada. Aunque el azúcar es buena en la lengua, no lo es tanto en los riñones y puede causar rápidamente diabetes cuando se consume en exceso. El cuerpo convierte con facilidad el azúcar en energía, por lo que puede provocar un agradable subidón de energía.
