Rule.Translated: Una zona donde se celebrarán los combates. Los prisioneros lucharán dentro de las zonas blancas y los espectadores permanecerán junto a la zona gris.

Rule.Original: stuff things in inventory and haul
Rule.Raw: stuff things in inventory and haul
Rule.Translated: guardar objetos en el inventario y transportarlos
recogiendo TargetA en el inventario de transporte.
Haciendo una reverencia antes del duelo.
Haciendo una reverencia antes del duelo.

Rule.Original:
A sealed metal container designed to keep your perishable food safe, frozen, and easily accessible for both lunch and dinner. Items stored inside will not rot over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings, as long as it's powered. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 12 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Foods, Plant matter, Alcohol, Beverages, Musts, Hay, Condiments 

<color=#0094FF>Items stored can be frozen when powered.</color>
Rule.Raw:
A sealed metal container designed to keep your perishable food safe, frozen, and easily accessible for both lunch and dinner. Items stored inside will not rot over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings, as long as it's powered. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 12 Stack per tile: 6
Allowed items: Foods, Plant matter, Alcohol, Beverages, Musts, Hay, Condiments 

<color=#0094FF>Items stored can be frozen when powered.</color>
Rule.Translated:
Un recipiente metálico sellado que conserva los alimentos perecederos congelados y accesibles para el almuerzo y la cena. Su contenido no se pudre ni afecta a la belleza del entorno mientras tenga electricidad. 

<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas de almacenamiento:</color> Capacidad total de pilas: 12 Pilas por casilla: 6
Objetos permitidos: Comida, materia vegetal, alcohol, bebidas, mostos, heno, condimentos 

<color=#0094FF>El contenido se puede congelar con electricidad.</color>

Rule.Original:
A collection of wooden crates designed for storing mass quantities of goods and valuables. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 40 Stack per tile: 10
Allowed items: Everything except Foods, Corpses and Chunks
Rule.Raw:
A collection of wooden crates designed for storing mass quantities of goods and valuables. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> Stack size total: 40 Stack per tile: 10
Allowed items: Everything except Foods, Corpses and Chunks
Rule.Translated:
Un conjunto de cajones de madera para almacenar grandes cantidades de bienes y objetos valiosos. Su contenido no se deteriora ni afecta a la belleza del entorno. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas de almacenamiento:</color> Capacidad total de pilas: 40 Pilas por casilla: 10
Objetos permitidos: Todo excepto comida, cadáveres y bloques de roca

Rule.Original: Unlocks simple construction techniques to make rings, simple hooks, and poles for the production of curtains, which open far faster than standard doors, but slowly vent temperatures between rooms.
Rule.Raw: Unlocks simple construction techniques to make rings, simple hooks, and poles for the production of curtains, which open far faster than standard doors, but slowly vent temperatures between rooms.
Rule.Translated: Desbloquea técnicas de construcción simples para fabricar anillas, ganchos y barras para cortinas. Se abren mucho más rápido que las puertas normales, pero permiten un intercambio lento de temperatura entre habitaciones.

Rule.Original: Provides simple prison doors to keep inmates safe, well, mostly.
Rule.Raw: Provides simple prison doors to keep inmates safe, well, mostly.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir puertas de prisión sencillas para mantener a los reclusos a salvo. Bueno, casi siempre.

Rule.Original: Unlocks remote doors for remote containment as well as buttons and levers to manipulate them.
Rule.Raw: Unlocks remote doors for remote containment as well as buttons and levers to manipulate them.
Rule.Translated: Desbloquea puertas de control remoto y botones y palancas para manejarlas.

Rule.Original: Hinges and fastening techniques allow for the construction of swinging doors, such as large gates.
Rule.Raw: Hinges and fastening techniques allow for the construction of swinging doors, such as large gates.
Rule.Translated: Las técnicas de bisagras y sujeción permiten construir puertas batientes, incluidos portones grandes.

Rule.Original: Allows for the production of blast absorbing pressurized blast doors.
Rule.Raw: Allows for the production of blast absorbing pressurized blast doors.
Rule.Translated: Permite fabricar puertas blindadas presurizadas que absorben explosiones.

Rule.Original: Sliding jail cell door with strong bars.
Rule.Raw: Sliding jail cell door with strong bars.
Rule.Translated: Puerta corredera de celda con barrotes resistentes.

Rule.Original: Divides rooms. Curtains are much faster to open than standard doors, but are flammable and slowly vent temperatures between rooms.
Rule.Raw: Divides rooms. Curtains are much faster to open than standard doors, but are flammable and slowly vent temperatures between rooms.
Rule.Translated: Divide habitaciones. Las cortinas se abren mucho más rápido que las puertas normales, pero son inflamables y permiten un intercambio lento de temperatura entre habitaciones.

Rule.Original: A heavy pair of doors that are far more resilient to damage.
Rule.Raw: A heavy pair of doors that are far more resilient to damage.
Rule.Translated: Un par de puertas pesadas con una resistencia al daño muy superior.

Rule.Original: A button that connects to doors (functions the same as a lever).
Rule.Raw: A button that connects to doors (functions the same as a lever).
Rule.Translated: Un botón conectado a puertas que funciona igual que una palanca.

Rule.Original: A lever that connects to doors (functions the same as a button).
Rule.Raw: A lever that connects to doors (functions the same as a button).
Rule.Translated: Una palanca conectada a puertas que funciona igual que un botón.

Rule.Original: Vertical sliding metal door. Uses less power than an autodoor but opens more slowly.
Rule.Raw: Vertical sliding metal door. Uses less power than an autodoor but opens more slowly.
Rule.Translated: Puerta metálica corredera vertical. Usa menos energía que una puerta automática, pero se abre más despacio.
Objetos para la higiene de los colonos.

Rule.Original: Bad hygiene will increase risk of disease and impact social interaction.
Rule.Raw: Bad hygiene will increase risk of disease and impact social interaction.
Rule.Translated: La mala higiene aumenta el riesgo de enfermedad y afecta a las relaciones sociales.

Rule.Original: Diarrhea is loose, watery stools. Also known as bowel movements.
Rule.Raw: Diarrhea is loose, watery stools. Also known as bowel movements.
Rule.Translated: La diarrea produce deposiciones blandas y acuosas.

Rule.Original: Dysentery is a type of gastroenteritis that results in diarrhea with blood.
Rule.Raw: Dysentery is a type of gastroenteritis that results in diarrhea with blood.
Rule.Translated: La disentería es un tipo de gastroenteritis que produce diarrea con sangre.

Rule.Original: Cholera is an infectious disease that causes severe watery diarrhea, which can lead to dehydration and even death if untreated.
Rule.Raw: Cholera is an infectious disease that causes severe watery diarrhea, which can lead to dehydration and even death if untreated.
Rule.Translated: El cólera es una enfermedad infecciosa que causa diarrea acuosa intensa y puede provocar deshidratación e incluso la muerte si no se trata.

Rule.Original: Dehydration is a condition that can occur when the loss of body fluids, mostly water, exceeds the amount that is taken in.
Rule.Raw: Dehydration is a condition that can occur when the loss of body fluids, mostly water, exceeds the amount that is taken in.
Rule.Translated: La deshidratación ocurre cuando la pérdida de líquidos corporales, principalmente agua, supera la cantidad ingerida.

Rule.Original: An advanced artificial bladder. A chemical recycling system breaks down waste products from the body into molecules which are recycled with the remainder released as gas, the downside of this being that it gives the user gas.
Rule.Raw: An advanced artificial bladder. A chemical recycling system breaks down waste products from the body into molecules which are recycled with the remainder released as gas, the downside of this being that it gives the user gas.
Rule.Translated: Una vejiga artificial avanzada. Un sistema de reciclaje químico descompone los desechos corporales en moléculas que se reutilizan; el resto se libera como gas. Su inconveniente es que causa flatulencias.

Rule.Original: Releases mechanites that break down dead skin cells and other detritus on the skin and hair releasing it harmlessly into the air.
Rule.Raw: Releases mechanites that break down dead skin cells and other detritus on the skin and hair releasing it harmlessly into the air.
Rule.Translated: Libera mecanitos que descomponen las células muertas y otros residuos de la piel y el cabello, y los dispersan de forma inocua en el aire.
llenando la botella de agua en TargetA
Velocidad a la que disminuye la higiene
Velocidad a la que disminuye el nivel de vejiga

Rule.Original: How much sewage is produced from each flush
Rule.Raw: How much sewage is produced from each flush
Rule.Translated: Cantidad de aguas residuales producidas por cada descarga
Velocidad a la que disminuye el nivel de sed

Rule.Original: Chance for a colonist to get contaminated from untreated water
Rule.Raw: Chance for a colonist to get contaminated from untreated water
Rule.Translated: Probabilidad de que un colono se contamine por agua sin tratar
Capacidad de las bombas de agua
Capacidad de las bombas de agua

Rule.Original: How much hot water is used while washing
Rule.Raw: How much hot water is used while washing
Rule.Translated: Cantidad de agua caliente utilizada al lavarse
Límite de aguas residuales por casilla

Rule.Original: How much sewage can fit into a cell on the surface
Rule.Raw: How much sewage can fit into a cell on the surface
Rule.Translated: Cantidad de aguas residuales que cabe en una casilla de superficie
Velocidad de limpieza de aguas residuales

Rule.Original: How fast sewage on the surface cleans up over time
Rule.Raw: How fast sewage on the surface cleans up over time
Rule.Translated: Velocidad a la que se limpian las aguas residuales de la superficie
Velocidad de tratamiento de aguas residuales

Rule.Original: How fast sewage is treated in septic tanks and sewage treatment
Rule.Raw: How fast sewage is treated in septic tanks and sewage treatment
Rule.Translated: Velocidad de tratamiento en fosas sépticas y plantas depuradoras

Rule.Original: How much effect of irrigation has on fertility
Rule.Raw: How much effect of irrigation has on fertility
Rule.Translated: Efecto del riego sobre la fertilidad

Rule.Original: How much effect fertilizer has on fertility
Rule.Raw: How much effect fertilizer has on fertility
Rule.Translated: Efecto del fertilizante sobre la fertilidad
Valor base de fertilidad del terreno

Rule.Original: How long terrain remains fertilized after applying fertilizer
Rule.Raw: How long terrain remains fertilized after applying fertilizer
Rule.Translated: Tiempo que el terreno permanece fertilizado tras aplicar fertilizante

Rule.Original: To prevent the risk of disease it is important to maintain a good level of sanitation by removing or treating waste, and preventing sewage from contaminating your water supply.
Rule.Raw: To prevent the risk of disease it is important to maintain a good level of sanitation by removing or treating waste, and preventing sewage from contaminating your water supply.
Rule.Translated: Para evitar enfermedades, es necesario mantener una buena salubridad eliminando o tratando los desechos y evitando que las aguas residuales contaminen el suministro de agua.

Rule.Original: Water is required for many of life’s physiological processes. If this reaches zero then the creature will slowly die of dehydration.
Rule.Raw: Water is required for many of life’s physiological processes. If this reaches zero then the creature will slowly die of dehydration.
Rule.Translated: El agua es necesaria para muchos procesos fisiológicos. Si este nivel llega a cero, la criatura morirá lentamente por deshidratación.

Rule.Original: Make a batch of chemfuel from fecal sludge.
Rule.Raw: Make a batch of chemfuel from fecal sludge.
Rule.Translated: Fabricar un lote de quimicombustible con lodo fecal.
Refinando quimicombustible a partir de lodo fecal

Rule.Original: When properly treated and processed, sewage sludge becomes biosolids that offer a small boost to terrain fertility. Useful for harsh environments with limited space to grow. Biosolids also produce a large boost to the fertility of sand which can make it fertile when combined with irrigation.
Rule.Raw: When properly treated and processed, sewage sludge becomes biosolids that offer a small boost to terrain fertility. Useful for harsh environments with limited space to grow. Biosolids also produce a large boost to the fertility of sand which can make it fertile when combined with irrigation.
Rule.Translated: El tratamiento adecuado convierte los lodos residuales en biosólidos que aumentan ligeramente la fertilidad del terreno. Son útiles en entornos duros con poco espacio de cultivo. También aumentan mucho la fertilidad de la arena, que puede volverse cultivable al combinarse con riego.

Rule.Original: When properly treated and processed, sewage sludge becomes biosolids that offer a small boost to terrain fertility. Useful for harsh environments with limited space to grow. Biosolids also produce a large boost to the fertility of sand which can make it fertile when combined with irrigation.
Rule.Raw: When properly treated and processed, sewage sludge becomes biosolids that offer a small boost to terrain fertility. Useful for harsh environments with limited space to grow. Biosolids also produce a large boost to the fertility of sand which can make it fertile when combined with irrigation.
Rule.Translated: El tratamiento adecuado convierte los lodos residuales en biosólidos que aumentan ligeramente la fertilidad del terreno. Son útiles en entornos duros con poco espacio de cultivo. También aumentan mucho la fertilidad de la arena, que puede volverse cultivable al combinarse con riego.

Rule.Original: Build multi-split air conditioning systems with outdoor units piped to indoor units and freezers.
Rule.Raw: Build multi-split air conditioning systems with outdoor units piped to indoor units and freezers.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir sistemas multisplit con unidades exteriores conectadas por tuberías a unidades interiores y congeladores.

Rule.Original: Use pipes, plumbing fixtures, storage tanks, wind pumps and other apparatuses to deliver and drain water and sewage.
Rule.Raw: Use pipes, plumbing fixtures, storage tanks, wind pumps and other apparatuses to deliver and drain water and sewage.
Rule.Translated: Usa tuberías, instalaciones de fontanería, depósitos, bombas eólicas y otros equipos para suministrar agua y evacuar aguas residuales.

Rule.Original: Build log boilers which can be used to heat rooms and can be placed adjacent to baths to heat bathwater.
Rule.Raw: Build log boilers which can be used to heat rooms and can be placed adjacent to baths to heat bathwater.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir calderas de leña para calentar habitaciones. También pueden colocarse junto a bañeras para calentar el agua del baño.

Rule.Original: Build central heating systems with radiators, hot water tanks, boilers and thermostats.
Rule.Raw: Build central heating systems with radiators, hot water tanks, boilers and thermostats.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir sistemas de calefacción central con radiadores, depósitos de agua caliente, calderas y termostatos.

Rule.Original: Build geothermal heaters which can be built over geysers to generate heat for central heating and hot water tanks.
Rule.Raw: Build geothermal heaters which can be built over geysers to generate heat for central heating and hot water tanks.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir calentadores geotérmicos sobre géiseres para la calefacción central y los depósitos de agua caliente.

Rule.Original: Build a dedicated room with a sauna heater where colonists can relax and clean, frequent use can reduce the chance of heart attacks.
Rule.Raw: Build a dedicated room with a sauna heater where colonists can relax and clean, frequent use can reduce the chance of heart attacks.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir una habitación con calentador de sauna para que los colonos se relajen y se aseen. Su uso frecuente puede reducir el riesgo de ataques al corazón.

Rule.Original: Build modern-style bathroom fixtures like toilets and showers.
Rule.Raw: Build modern-style bathroom fixtures like toilets and showers.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir instalaciones de baño modernas, como inodoros y duchas.

Rule.Original: Powered water pumps for pressurized continuous water pumping.
Rule.Raw: Powered water pumps for pressurized continuous water pumping.
Rule.Translated: Bombas de agua eléctricas para un suministro presurizado y continuo.

Rule.Original: Build power showers which halve the time spent showering and improve comfort.
Rule.Raw: Build power showers which halve the time spent showering and improve comfort.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir duchas presurizadas que reducen a la mitad el tiempo de ducha y mejoran la comodidad.

Rule.Original: Build comfortable, self cleaning, super efficient smart toilets.
Rule.Raw: Build comfortable, self cleaning, super efficient smart toilets.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir inodoros inteligentes cómodos, autolimpiables y muy eficientes.

Rule.Original: Build hot tubs which can be used for hydrotherapy, relaxation, and pleasure.
Rule.Raw: Build hot tubs which can be used for hydrotherapy, relaxation, and pleasure.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir jacuzzis para hidroterapia, relajación y recreación.

Rule.Original: Build industrial-scale water pumps and storage tanks.
Rule.Raw: Build industrial-scale water pumps and storage tanks.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir bombas de agua y depósitos a escala industrial.

Rule.Original: Drill deeper wells to access a much larger area of ground water.
Rule.Raw: Drill deeper wells to access a much larger area of ground water.
Rule.Translated: Permite perforar pozos más profundos para acceder a una zona mucho mayor de agua subterránea.

Rule.Original: Build washing machines that can wash clothes so well that you couldn't even tell someone died wearing it!
Rule.Raw: Build washing machines that can wash clothes so well that you couldn't even tell someone died wearing it!
Rule.Translated: ¡Permite construir lavadoras que limpian tan bien que ni se nota que alguien murió llevando esa ropa!

Rule.Original: Build water filtration systems which treat the water supply, eliminating the risk of disease.
Rule.Raw: Build water filtration systems which treat the water supply, eliminating the risk of disease.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir sistemas de filtración que tratan el agua y eliminan el riesgo de enfermedad.

Rule.Original: Craft bionics that help to process bodily waste and manage personal hygiene.
Rule.Raw: Craft bionics that help to process bodily waste and manage personal hygiene.
Rule.Translated: Permite fabricar implantes biónicos que procesan los desechos corporales y facilitan la higiene personal.

Rule.Original: Build septic tanks which accumulate sewage and provide moderate treatment of sewage.
Rule.Raw: Build septic tanks which accumulate sewage and provide moderate treatment of sewage.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir fosas sépticas que acumulan y depuran las aguas residuales a un ritmo moderado.

Rule.Original: Build large sewage treatment systems which accumulate large amounts of sewage and provide fast treatment of sewage.
Rule.Raw: Build large sewage treatment systems which accumulate large amounts of sewage and provide fast treatment of sewage.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir grandes depuradoras que acumulan y tratan rápidamente grandes cantidades de aguas residuales.

Rule.Original: Build sprinklers that can irrigate soil to improve fertility.
Rule.Raw: Build sprinklers that can irrigate soil to improve fertility.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir aspersores que riegan el suelo para mejorar su fertilidad.

Rule.Original: Build sprinklers that suppress fires with a spray of water.
Rule.Raw: Build sprinklers that suppress fires with a spray of water.
Rule.Translated: Permite construir aspersores que extinguen incendios rociando agua.

Rule.Original: A multiplier on how quickly a creature becomes thirsty.
Rule.Raw: A multiplier on how quickly a creature becomes thirsty.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador de la velocidad a la que una criatura tiene sed.

Rule.Original: A multiplier on how quickly a creatures hygiene level falls.
Rule.Raw: A multiplier on how quickly a creatures hygiene level falls.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador de la velocidad a la que disminuye la higiene de una criatura.

Rule.Original: A multiplier on how quickly a creatures bladder level falls.
Rule.Raw: A multiplier on how quickly a creatures bladder level falls.
Rule.Translated: Un multiplicador de la velocidad a la que disminuye el nivel de vejiga de una criatura.

Rule.Original: Steel tiles in a mosaic pattern, stylish in bathrooms or kitchens.
Rule.Raw: Steel tiles in a mosaic pattern, stylish in bathrooms or kitchens.
Rule.Translated: Baldosas de acero con patrón de mosaico, elegantes para baños y cocinas.
Tuberías para conectar instalaciones de fontanería.

Rule.Original: Opens or closes connections between pipes.
Rule.Raw: Opens or closes connections between pipes.
Rule.Translated: Abre o cierra las conexiones entre tuberías.
Tubería para conectar unidades de aire acondicionado.

Rule.Original: Thin door which only blocks line of sight to people using bathroom fixtures. Does not create new rooms or prevent heat loss.
Rule.Raw: Thin door which only blocks line of sight to people using bathroom fixtures. Does not create new rooms or prevent heat loss.
Rule.Translated: Puerta fina que solo impide ver a quienes usan el baño. No crea habitaciones ni evita la pérdida de calor.

Rule.Original: A pit latrine that collects faeces in a hole in the ground. Must be emptied manually, or can be plumbed.\n14L per use
Rule.Raw: A pit latrine that collects faeces in a hole in the ground. Must be emptied manually, or can be plumbed.\n14L per use
Rule.Translated: Una letrina que recoge las heces en un hoyo del suelo. Debe vaciarse manualmente o conectarse a las tuberías.\n14L por uso

Rule.Original: Accesses ground water. Water must be hauled to a water tub before it can be used for washing or drinking.
Rule.Raw: Accesses ground water. Water must be hauled to a water tub before it can be used for washing or drinking.
Rule.Translated: Permite acceder al agua subterránea. Hay que llevarla a una tina para poder usarla al lavarse o beber.

Rule.Original: Tub of water used for personal hygiene. Must be regularly refilled with fresh water, also fills with rain water. Can also be used for drinking if thirst is enabled.
Rule.Raw: Tub of water used for personal hygiene. Must be regularly refilled with fresh water, also fills with rain water. Can also be used for drinking if thirst is enabled.
Rule.Translated: Tina de agua para la higiene personal. Debe rellenarse con agua limpia, aunque también recoge lluvia. Puede usarse para beber si la sed está activada.

Rule.Original: Trough of water used by animals, a service box with a ballcock valve automatically refills the water when the level is low, also refills in rain.
Rule.Raw: Trough of water used by animals, a service box with a ballcock valve automatically refills the water when the level is low, also refills in rain.
Rule.Translated: Abrevadero para animales. Una válvula de flotador lo rellena automáticamente cuando baja el nivel; también recoge lluvia.

Rule.Original: Bowl of water used by animals.
Rule.Raw: Bowl of water used by animals.

Rule.Original: An indoor faeces and urine collection box for small animals.
Rule.Raw: An indoor faeces and urine collection box for small animals.
Rule.Translated: Un recipiente interior para recoger las heces y la orina de animales pequeños.

Rule.Original: Eliminates fecal sludge by burning it as fuel. Can also be used for disposing of corpses or other detritus. Colonists may become sick if they spend too long near burning waste.
Rule.Raw: Eliminates fecal sludge by burning it as fuel. Can also be used for disposing of corpses or other detritus. Colonists may become sick if they spend too long near burning waste.
Rule.Translated: Elimina lodo fecal usándolo como combustible. También sirve para deshacerse de cadáveres y otros residuos. Los colonos pueden enfermar si pasan demasiado tiempo cerca de desechos ardiendo.

Rule.Original: Clean and simple bathroom basin for keeping your hands clean after using the toilet.
Rule.Raw: Clean and simple bathroom basin for keeping your hands clean after using the toilet.
Rule.Translated: Lavabo sencillo y limpio para lavarse las manos después de usar el inodoro.

Rule.Original: Everything but a kitchen sink. Increases room cleanliness.
Rule.Raw: Everything but a kitchen sink. Increases room cleanliness.
Rule.Translated: Lo que le faltaba a la cocina. Aumenta la limpieza de la habitación.

Rule.Original: Sanitation fixture used for the disposal of human urine and faeces.\n14L per use
Rule.Raw: Sanitation fixture used for the disposal of human urine and faeces.\n14L per use
Rule.Translated: Instalación sanitaria para eliminar orina y heces humanas.\n14L por uso

Rule.Original: A small mat used next to a bathtub to absorb water.
Rule.Raw: A small mat used next to a bathtub to absorb water.
Rule.Translated: Alfombrilla colocada junto a la bañera para absorber agua.

Rule.Original: Slow to use, but very comfortable. Can be heated by placing an adjacent campfire or log boiler, or via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n190L per wash
Rule.Raw: Slow to use, but very comfortable. Can be heated by placing an adjacent campfire or log boiler, or via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n190L per wash
Rule.Translated: Lenta de usar, pero muy cómoda. Se calienta con una hoguera o caldera de leña adyacente, o mediante depósitos de agua caliente conectados. No necesita desagüe de aguas residuales.\n190L por lavado

Rule.Original: Simple shower. Requires water from water towers. Can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Rule.Raw: Simple shower. Requires water from water towers. Can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Rule.Translated: Ducha sencilla que necesita agua de los depósitos elevados. Puede calentarse mediante depósitos de agua caliente conectados. No necesita desagüe de aguas residuales.\n65L por lavado

Rule.Original: Simple shower. Requires water from water towers. Can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Rule.Raw: Simple shower. Requires water from water towers. Can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Rule.Translated: Ducha sencilla que necesita agua de los depósitos elevados. Puede calentarse mediante depósitos de agua caliente conectados. No necesita desagüe de aguas residuales.\n65L por lavado

Rule.Original: Heats water on demand and does not need a hot water tank, cleans twice as fast\n90L per wash
Rule.Raw: Heats water on demand and does not need a hot water tank, cleans twice as fast\n90L per wash
Rule.Translated: Calienta el agua al momento sin necesitar un depósito de agua caliente y limpia el doble de rápido\n90L por lavado

Rule.Original: Swimming pool used for hydrotherapy, relaxation, or pleasure. Must be filled with water from water towers first.
Rule.Raw: Swimming pool used for hydrotherapy, relaxation, or pleasure. Must be filled with water from water towers first.
Rule.Translated: Piscina para hidroterapia, relajación o recreación. Primero hay que llenarla con agua de los depósitos elevados.

Rule.Original: Hot tub used for hydrotherapy, relaxation, or pleasure. Filled with water from water towers on first use. Self-heated and does not require a sewage outlet.
Rule.Raw: Hot tub used for hydrotherapy, relaxation, or pleasure. Filled with water from water towers on first use. Self-heated and does not require a sewage outlet.
Rule.Translated: Jacuzzi para hidroterapia, relajación o recreación. Se llena con agua de los depósitos elevados en el primer uso. Se calienta por sí mismo y no necesita desagüe de aguas residuales.

Rule.Original: Washes clothes so well that you can't even tell someone died wearing it!
Rule.Raw: Washes clothes so well that you can't even tell someone died wearing it!
Rule.Translated: ¡Lava la ropa tan bien que ni se nota que alguien murió llevándola!

Rule.Original: A heater designed specifically for creating a sauna room, using a sauna regularly reduces the risk of heart attacks, heats a room to 60c.
Rule.Raw: A heater designed specifically for creating a sauna room, using a sauna regularly reduces the risk of heart attacks, heats a room to 60c.
Rule.Translated: Calentador diseñado para una sala de sauna. Su uso habitual reduce el riesgo de ataques al corazón. Calienta la habitación a 60c.

Rule.Original: A heater designed specifically for creating a sauna room, using a sauna regularly reduces the risk of heart attacks, heats a room to 60c.
Rule.Raw: A heater designed specifically for creating a sauna room, using a sauna regularly reduces the risk of heart attacks, heats a room to 60c.
Rule.Translated: Calentador diseñado para una sala de sauna. Su uso habitual reduce el riesgo de ataques al corazón. Calienta la habitación a 60c.
Asientos de listones para salas de sauna

Rule.Original: Accesses ground water which can be pumped by water pumps. The presence of sewage or other pollution will reduce water quality and can cause contamination.
Rule.Raw: Accesses ground water which can be pumped by water pumps. The presence of sewage or other pollution will reduce water quality and can cause contamination.
Rule.Translated: Accede al agua subterránea que extraen las bombas. Las aguas residuales y otros contaminantes reducen su calidad y pueden contaminarla.

Rule.Original: Accesses a large area of ground water which can be pumped by water pumps. Deep wells are unaffected by pollution.
Rule.Raw: Accesses a large area of ground water which can be pumped by water pumps. Deep wells are unaffected by pollution.
Rule.Translated: Accede a una gran zona de agua subterránea que extraen las bombas. Los pozos profundos no se ven afectados por la contaminación.

Rule.Original: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. Slowly fills when raining. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 100.
Rule.Raw: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. Slowly fills when raining. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 100.
Rule.Translated: Almacena agua para instalaciones conectadas. Se llena lentamente con la lluvia. Debe drenarse si se contamina. Capacidad: 100.

Rule.Original: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 8000.
Rule.Raw: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 8000.
Rule.Translated: Almacena agua para instalaciones conectadas. Debe drenarse si se contamina. Capacidad: 8000.

Rule.Original: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 50,000.
Rule.Raw: Stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 50,000.
Rule.Translated: Almacena agua para instalaciones conectadas. Debe drenarse si se contamina. Capacidad: 50,000.

Rule.Original: Pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 3000 L/day.
Rule.Raw: Pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 3000 L/day.
Rule.Translated: Bombea agua de los pozos a los depósitos elevados. Capacidad: 3000 L/día.

Rule.Original: Pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 1500 L/day.
Rule.Raw: Pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 1500 L/day.
Rule.Translated: Bombea agua de los pozos a los depósitos elevados. Capacidad: 1500 L/día.

Rule.Original: Pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 10000 L/day.
Rule.Raw: Pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 10000 L/day.
Rule.Translated: Bombea agua de los pozos a los depósitos elevados. Capacidad: 10000 L/día.

Rule.Original: Can be placed anywhere. Sewage will pool and spread on land or disperse in water. Sewage cleans up over time; the presence of trees, water, or rain will speed this up.
Rule.Raw: Can be placed anywhere. Sewage will pool and spread on land or disperse in water. Sewage cleans up over time; the presence of trees, water, or rain will speed this up.
Rule.Translated: Puede colocarse en cualquier lugar. Las aguas residuales se acumulan y extienden por el suelo o se dispersan en el agua. Se limpian con el tiempo; los árboles, el agua y la lluvia aceleran el proceso.

Rule.Original: Slowly cleans sewage over time. Sewage is directed to septic tanks first. If it reaches full capacity, excess sewage is sent to sewage outlets.
Rule.Raw: Slowly cleans sewage over time. Sewage is directed to septic tanks first. If it reaches full capacity, excess sewage is sent to sewage outlets.
Rule.Translated: Limpia lentamente las aguas residuales. Estas van primero a las fosas sépticas; cuando se llenan, el exceso pasa a los desagües.

Rule.Original: Slowly cleans sewage over time. If it reaches full capacity then excess sewage is sent directly to sewage outlets without treatment.
Rule.Raw: Slowly cleans sewage over time. If it reaches full capacity then excess sewage is sent directly to sewage outlets without treatment.
Rule.Translated: Limpia lentamente las aguas residuales. Cuando se llena, el exceso pasa directamente a los desagües sin tratar.

Rule.Original: Cleans 99.99% of germs! Filters existing water in storage towers, and any water used by fixtures, eliminating the risk of disease.
Rule.Raw: Cleans 99.99% of germs! Filters existing water in storage towers, and any water used by fixtures, eliminating the risk of disease.
Rule.Translated: ¡Elimina el 99.99% de los gérmenes! Filtra el agua de los depósitos y la que usan las instalaciones, eliminando el riesgo de enfermedad.

Rule.Original: Used to control electric and gas boilers. More than one can be placed. Connects via standard plumbing.
Rule.Raw: Used to control electric and gas boilers. More than one can be placed. Connects via standard plumbing.
Rule.Translated: Controla las calderas eléctricas y de gas. Pueden colocarse varios. Se conecta por las tuberías normales.

Rule.Original: Produces 2000 heating units for piped radiators and hot water tanks. Heats the room and adjacent baths. Requires wood logs for fuel.
Rule.Raw: Produces 2000 heating units for piped radiators and hot water tanks. Heats the room and adjacent baths. Requires wood logs for fuel.
Rule.Translated: Produce 2000 unidades de calor para radiadores y depósitos de agua caliente. Calienta la habitación y las bañeras adyacentes. Usa troncos como combustible.

Rule.Original: Produces 2000 heating units for radiators and hot water tanks. Requires chemfuel for fuel. Can be controlled by thermostats.
Rule.Raw: Produces 2000 heating units for radiators and hot water tanks. Requires chemfuel for fuel. Can be controlled by thermostats.
Rule.Translated: Produce 2000 unidades de calor para radiadores y depósitos de agua caliente. Usa quimicombustible y puede controlarse con termostatos.

Rule.Original: Produces a variable amount of heating units for radiators and hot water tanks. Manually controlled power setting. Can be controlled by thermostats.
Rule.Raw: Produces a variable amount of heating units for radiators and hot water tanks. Manually controlled power setting. Can be controlled by thermostats.
Rule.Translated: Produce una cantidad variable de calor para radiadores y depósitos de agua caliente. La potencia se ajusta manualmente y puede controlarse con termostatos.

Rule.Original: Uses sunlight to heat hot water tanks and radiators. 0-2000 units of heating power depending on light level and ambient temperature.
Rule.Raw: Uses sunlight to heat hot water tanks and radiators. 0-2000 units of heating power depending on light level and ambient temperature.
Rule.Translated: Usa luz solar para calentar depósitos de agua y radiadores. Produce 0-2000 unidades de calor según la luz y la temperatura ambiente.

Rule.Original: Uses geothermal heat to heat hot water tanks and radiators. 3700 units of heating.
Rule.Raw: Uses geothermal heat to heat hot water tanks and radiators. 3700 units of heating.
Rule.Translated: Usa calor geotérmico para calentar depósitos de agua y radiadores. Produce 3700 unidades de calor.

Rule.Original: Stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.
Rule.Raw: Stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.
Rule.Translated: Almacena agua caliente para duchas y baños. Conéctalo a una caldera para calentarlo.

Rule.Original: Heats rooms using hot water from boilers. Requires 100 heating units.
Rule.Raw: Heats rooms using hot water from boilers. Requires 100 heating units.
Rule.Translated: Calienta habitaciones con agua caliente de las calderas. Necesita 100 unidades de calor.

Rule.Original: Three times the output of a standard radiator. Useful for larger rooms. Requires 300 heating units.
Rule.Raw: Three times the output of a standard radiator. Useful for larger rooms. Requires 300 heating units.
Rule.Translated: Produce el triple que un radiador normal. Útil para habitaciones grandes. Necesita 300 unidades de calor.
Un toallero impresionante para el baño.

Rule.Original: Cools a room by circulating air. Includes a built-in lamp.
Rule.Raw: Cools a room by circulating air. Includes a built-in lamp.
Rule.Translated: Enfría la habitación haciendo circular el aire. Incluye una lámpara.

Rule.Original: Cools a room by circulating air. Includes a built-in lamp.
Rule.Raw: Cools a room by circulating air. Includes a built-in lamp.
Rule.Translated: Enfría la habitación haciendo circular el aire. Incluye una lámpara.

Rule.Original: Multi-split air conditioner unit. Place outdoors and pipe to indoor units or freezer units. Power mode selection with 100-1000 cooling units capacity.
Rule.Raw: Multi-split air conditioner unit. Place outdoors and pipe to indoor units or freezer units. Power mode selection with 100-1000 cooling units capacity.
Rule.Translated: Unidad de aire acondicionado multisplit. Colócala fuera y conéctala a unidades interiores o congeladores. Permite elegir una capacidad de 100-1000 unidades de refrigeración.

Rule.Original: Indoor air-con unit for rooms. Connect to outdoor air-con units. Requires 100 cooling units.
Rule.Raw: Indoor air-con unit for rooms. Connect to outdoor air-con units. Requires 100 cooling units.
Rule.Translated: Unidad interior para habitaciones. Conéctala a una unidad exterior. Necesita 100 unidades de refrigeración.

Rule.Original: Freezer unit for creating a walk-in freezer. Connect to outdoor air-con units. Requires 300 cooling units.
Rule.Raw: Freezer unit for creating a walk-in freezer. Connect to outdoor air-con units. Requires 300 cooling units.
Rule.Translated: Unidad para crear una cámara frigorífica. Conéctala a una unidad exterior de aire acondicionado. Necesita 300 unidades de refrigeración.

Rule.Original: Waters the surrounding area once every morning to improve the fertility of the soil through the day. Uses 1000L each morning at max radius.
Rule.Raw: Waters the surrounding area once every morning to improve the fertility of the soil through the day. Uses 1000L each morning at max radius.
Rule.Translated: Riega la zona circundante cada mañana para mejorar la fertilidad durante el día. Consume 1000L cada mañana con el radio máximo.

Rule.Original: Triggered by fire or high temperature. Douses flames with a spray of water.
Rule.Raw: Triggered by fire or high temperature. Douses flames with a spray of water.
Rule.Translated: Se activa con fuego o temperaturas altas. Apaga las llamas rociando agua.

Rule.Original: A composter for turning sewage into fertilizer for increasing the fertility of diggable terrain.
Rule.Raw: A composter for turning sewage into fertilizer for increasing the fertility of diggable terrain.
Rule.Translated: Convierte aguas residuales en fertilizante para mejorar la fertilidad de terrenos excavables.

Rule.Original: A receptacle used by a bedridden patient for urine and faeces.
Rule.Raw: A receptacle used by a bedridden patient for urine and faeces.
Rule.Translated: Recipiente para la orina y las heces de pacientes encamados.

Rule.Original: A barrel filled with fecal sludge. Can be dumped, burned, or composted into biosolids.
Rule.Raw: A barrel filled with fecal sludge. Can be dumped, burned, or composted into biosolids.
Rule.Translated: Barril lleno de lodo fecal. Puede vaciarse, quemarse o convertirse en biosólidos mediante compostaje.

Rule.Original: Drank a bottle of contaminated water.
Rule.Raw: Drank a bottle of contaminated water.
Rule.Translated: Bebí una botella de agua contaminada.

Rule.Original: Someone saw me bathing and it made me uncomfortable.
Rule.Raw: Someone saw me bathing and it made me uncomfortable.
Rule.Translated: Alguien me vio bañándome y me sentí incómodo.

Rule.Original: Someone walked in on me while I was using the toilet.
Rule.Raw: Someone walked in on me while I was using the toilet.
Rule.Translated: Alguien entró mientras usaba el inodoro.

Rule.Original: I couldn't hold it in any longer and soiled myself.
Rule.Raw: I couldn't hold it in any longer and soiled myself.
Rule.Translated: No pude aguantar más y me hice encima.

Rule.Original: I had a nice hot shower.
Rule.Raw: I had a nice hot shower.
Rule.Translated: Me di una agradable ducha caliente.

Rule.Original: The heated pool was very relaxing.
Rule.Raw: The heated pool was very relaxing.
Rule.Translated: La piscina climatizada era muy relajante.

Rule.Original: I had a nice hot bath.
Rule.Raw: I had a nice hot bath.
Rule.Translated: Me di un agradable baño caliente.

Rule.Original: I had a nice refreshing cold bath.
Rule.Raw: I had a nice refreshing cold bath.
Rule.Translated: Me di un agradable y refrescante baño frío.

Rule.Original: I had a nice refreshing cold shower.
Rule.Raw: I had a nice refreshing cold shower.
Rule.Translated: Me di una agradable y refrescante ducha fría.

Rule.Original: I had to relieve myself outside in the open.
Rule.Raw: I had to relieve myself outside in the open.
Rule.Translated: Tuve que hacer mis necesidades al aire libre.

Rule.Original: My bathroom is an awful place.
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is an awful place.
Rule.Translated: Mi baño es un lugar horrible.

Rule.Original: My bathroom is very interesting. I like it.
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is very interesting. I like it.
Rule.Translated: Mi baño es muy interesante. Me gusta.

Rule.Original: My bathroom is actually slightly impressive. I like it.
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is actually slightly impressive. I like it.
Rule.Translated: Mi baño es algo impresionante. Me gusta.

Rule.Original: My bathroom is impressive. I love it!
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is impressive. I love it!

Rule.Original: My bathroom is very impressive. This is the best place ever!
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is very impressive. This is the best place ever!
Rule.Translated: Mi baño es muy impresionante. ¡Es el mejor lugar del mundo!

Rule.Original: My bathroom is extremely impressive. This is the best place ever!
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is extremely impressive. This is the best place ever!
Rule.Translated: Mi baño es extremadamente impresionante. ¡Es el mejor lugar del mundo!

Rule.Original: My bathroom is unbelievably impressive. This is the best place ever!
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is unbelievably impressive. This is the best place ever!
Rule.Translated: Mi baño es increíblemente impresionante. ¡Es el mejor lugar del mundo!

Rule.Original: My bathroom is the best place one can ever imagine. It's wonderful.
Rule.Raw: My bathroom is the best place one can ever imagine. It's wonderful.
Rule.Translated: Mi baño es el mejor lugar que se pueda imaginar. Es maravilloso.

Rule.Original: I smell like I have been swimming in sewage.
Rule.Raw: I smell like I have been swimming in sewage.
Rule.Translated: Huelo como si hubiera nadado en aguas residuales.

Rule.Original: I need to go so bad I'm about to burst!
Rule.Raw: I need to go so bad I'm about to burst!
Rule.Translated: ¡Necesito ir al baño tanto que voy a reventar!

Rule.Original: I need to go to the bathroom.
Rule.Raw: I need to go to the bathroom.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is obsessed with germs and will wash much more frequently than normal.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is obsessed with germs and will wash much more frequently than normal.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] siente obsesión por los gérmenes y se lava mucho más a menudo de lo normal.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is very hygienic and will wash more frequently.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is very hygienic and will wash more frequently.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] es muy higiénico y se lava más a menudo.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] is very unhygienic and will wash less frequently.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] is very unhygienic and will wash less frequently.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] es muy antihigiénico y se lava menos a menudo.

Rule.Original: [PAWN_nameDef] has very low standards of cleanliness and will only wash when they absolutely have to.
Rule.Raw: [PAWN_nameDef] has very low standards of cleanliness and will only wash when they absolutely have to.
Rule.Translated: [PAWN_nameDef] tiene estándares de limpieza muy bajos y solo se lava cuando no tiene otra opción.
realizar tareas del foso de quema

Rule.Original: A medieval society that has ruled over all of Rimworld's humanity for centuries. Their culture is based on a code of honour, a strict class system and enforced social stasis.\n\nThey refuse to trade with anyone who does not have the appropriate royal title.
Rule.Raw: A medieval society that has ruled over all of Rimworld's humanity for centuries. Their culture is based on a code of honour, a strict class system and enforced social stasis.\n\nThey refuse to trade with anyone who does not have the appropriate royal title.
Rule.Translated: Una sociedad medieval que ha gobernado a toda la humanidad de Rimworld durante siglos. Su cultura se basa en un código de honor, un sistema de clases estricto y un inmovilismo social impuesto.\n\nSe niegan a comerciar con quienes no tengan el título real adecuado.

Rule.Original: Call a group of 5 light soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is trained (7-11) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a chain armor and a pike or crossbow.
Rule.Raw: Call a group of 5 light soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is trained (7-11) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a chain armor and a pike or crossbow.
Rule.Translated: Llama a 5 soldados ligeros para ayudarte en la batalla. Todos tienen entrenamiento de nivel 7-11 en combate cuerpo a cuerpo y a distancia, y llevan cota de malla y una pica o ballesta.

Rule.Original: Call a group of 5 heavy soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is well trained (12-16) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a full platemail and a two-handed mace or a heavy crossbow.
Rule.Raw: Call a group of 5 heavy soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is well trained (12-16) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a full platemail and a two-handed mace or a heavy crossbow.
Rule.Translated: Llama a 5 soldados pesados para ayudarte en la batalla. Todos tienen buen entrenamiento de nivel 12-16 en combate cuerpo a cuerpo y a distancia, y llevan armadura de placas completa y una maza a dos manos o ballesta pesada.

Rule.Original: Call a group of 5 crusaders to aid you in battle. Every Crusader is battle-hardened and exceptionally well trained (17-20) in melee combat and comes equipped with a full platemail armor and a two-handed weapon.
Rule.Raw: Call a group of 5 crusaders to aid you in battle. Every Crusader is battle-hardened and exceptionally well trained (17-20) in melee combat and comes equipped with a full platemail armor and a two-handed weapon.
Rule.Translated: Llama a 5 cruzados para ayudarte en la batalla. Todos son veteranos con entrenamiento excepcional de nivel 17-20 en combate cuerpo a cuerpo, y llevan armadura de placas completa y un arma a dos manos.

Rule.Original: Call for a drop of 400 iron ingots.
Rule.Raw: Call for a drop of 400 iron ingots.
Rule.Translated: Solicita una entrega de 400 lingotes de hierro.

Rule.Original: Call for a drop of 20 packed meal rations.
Rule.Raw: Call for a drop of 20 packed meal rations.
Rule.Translated: Solicita una entrega de 20 raciones de comida empaquetadas.

Rule.Original: Call a group of 5 light infantry soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is trained (7-11) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a chain armor and a pike or crossbow.
Rule.Raw: Call a group of 5 light infantry soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is trained (7-11) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a chain armor and a pike or crossbow.
Rule.Translated: Llama a 5 soldados de infantería ligera para ayudarte en la batalla. Todos tienen entrenamiento de nivel 7-11 en combate cuerpo a cuerpo y a distancia, y llevan cota de malla y una pica o ballesta.

Rule.Original: Call a group of 5 heavy infantry soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is well trained (12-16) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a full platemail, a sword and shield or a heavy crossbow.
Rule.Raw: Call a group of 5 heavy infantry soldiers to aid you in battle. Every soldier is well trained (12-16) in melee and ranged combat and comes equipped with a full platemail, a sword and shield or a heavy crossbow.
Rule.Translated: Llama a 5 soldados de infantería pesada para ayudarte en la batalla. Todos tienen buen entrenamiento de nivel 12-16 en combate cuerpo a cuerpo y a distancia, y llevan armadura de placas completa y una espada con escudo o ballesta pesada.

Rule.Original: Call for a drop of 100 herbal medicine.
Rule.Raw: Call for a drop of 100 herbal medicine.
Rule.Translated: Solicita una entrega de 100 unidades de medicina herbal.

Rule.Original: A powerful curse that ensures disappearance of equipment in the event of death.
Rule.Raw: A powerful curse that ensures disappearance of equipment in the event of death.
Rule.Translated: Una poderosa maldición que hace desaparecer el equipo al morir.
Perforar para extraer mineral de hierro.
Perforando para extraer mineral de hierro.
Perforar para extraer mineral de oro.
Perforando para extraer mineral de oro.
Perforar para extraer mineral de plata.
Perforando para extraer mineral de plata.

Rule.Original: A rare metal highly sought after for its strength, light weight and malleability.
Rule.Raw: A rare metal highly sought after for its strength, light weight and malleability.
Rule.Translated: Un metal raro muy codiciado por su resistencia, ligereza y maleabilidad.
Roca que contiene mitril y puede extraerse.

Rule.Original: A dark and heavy metal. Its extreme density and hardness make it an ideal material for crafting armour and blunt weapons.
Rule.Raw: A dark and heavy metal. Its extreme density and hardness make it an ideal material for crafting armour and blunt weapons.
Rule.Translated: Un metal oscuro y pesado. Su densidad y dureza extremas lo convierten en un material ideal para fabricar armaduras y armas contundentes.
Roca que contiene adamantita y puede extraerse.

Rule.Original: An intricate fabric made from cotton and linen with a silk weave. It is soft, light, strong and insulates well.
Rule.Raw: An intricate fabric made from cotton and linen with a silk weave. It is soft, light, strong and insulates well.
Rule.Translated: Un tejido elaborado con algodón y lino, con una trama de seda. Es suave, ligero, resistente y buen aislante.

Rule.Original: A mysterious fabric of unknown origin. At a glance, it resembles regular cloth but closer inspection reveals faintly glowing runes adorning its surface. It is highly resistant to cold and heat, extremely tough and seems to harden itself in response to attacks.
Rule.Raw: A mysterious fabric of unknown origin. At a glance, it resembles regular cloth but closer inspection reveals faintly glowing runes adorning its surface. It is highly resistant to cold and heat, extremely tough and seems to harden itself in response to attacks.
Rule.Translated: Un tejido misterioso de origen desconocido. Parece tela normal, pero un examen más atento revela runas de brillo tenue en su superficie. Resiste muy bien el frío y el calor, es extremadamente resistente y parece endurecerse ante los ataques.

Rule.Original: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call down magic missiles from the sky to bombard a targeted area.
Rule.Raw: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call down magic missiles from the sky to bombard a targeted area.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino para lanzar un hechizo. Cualquiera puede usarlo, pero se consume al lanzar el hechizo.\n\nEste pergamino invoca proyectiles mágicos desde el cielo para bombardear una zona.

Rule.Original: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call a destructive beam of light from the sky to scorch a targeted area.
Rule.Raw: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call a destructive beam of light from the sky to scorch a targeted area.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino para lanzar un hechizo. Cualquiera puede usarlo, pero se consume al lanzar el hechizo.\n\nEste pergamino invoca un rayo de luz destructivo desde el cielo para abrasar una zona.

Rule.Original: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call forth a circular barrier that will deflect incoming ranged attacks but not outgoing attacks, allowing anyone within to continue attacking. The barrier will remain for a short while before dissipating.
Rule.Raw: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call forth a circular barrier that will deflect incoming ranged attacks but not outgoing attacks, allowing anyone within to continue attacking. The barrier will remain for a short while before dissipating.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino para lanzar un hechizo. Cualquiera puede usarlo, pero se consume al lanzar el hechizo.\n\nEste pergamino crea una barrera circular que desvía los ataques a distancia entrantes, pero deja pasar los salientes, permitiendo seguir atacando desde dentro. La barrera dura poco antes de disiparse.

Rule.Original: A magic barrier that will deflect incoming ranged attacks but not outgoing attacks, allowing anyone within to continue attacking.\n\nThe barrier will remain for a short while before dissipating.
Rule.Raw: A magic barrier that will deflect incoming ranged attacks but not outgoing attacks, allowing anyone within to continue attacking.\n\nThe barrier will remain for a short while before dissipating.
Rule.Translated: Una barrera mágica que desvía los ataques a distancia entrantes, pero deja pasar los salientes, permitiendo seguir atacando desde dentro.\n\nLa barrera dura poco antes de disiparse.

Rule.Original: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to conjure a thick cloud of smoke, obscuring incoming ranged attacks and preventing turrets from locking on.
Rule.Raw: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to conjure a thick cloud of smoke, obscuring incoming ranged attacks and preventing turrets from locking on.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino para lanzar un hechizo. Cualquiera puede usarlo, pero se consume al lanzar el hechizo.\n\nEste pergamino crea una espesa nube de humo que dificulta los ataques a distancia entrantes e impide que las torretas fijen sus objetivos.

Rule.Original: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to conjure a thick layer of foam around the caster, extinguishing any fires in the area.
Rule.Raw: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to conjure a thick layer of foam around the caster, extinguishing any fires in the area.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino para lanzar un hechizo. Cualquiera puede usarlo, pero se consume al lanzar el hechizo.\n\nEste pergamino crea una gruesa capa de espuma alrededor del usuario que apaga los incendios de la zona.

Rule.Original: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call forth a destructive tornado to devastate an area.
Rule.Raw: A scroll that can be used to cast a magic spell, it can be used by anyone but will be consumed when the spell is cast.\n\nThis particular scroll can be used to call forth a destructive tornado to devastate an area.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino para lanzar un hechizo. Cualquiera puede usarlo, pero se consume al lanzar el hechizo.\n\nEste pergamino invoca un tornado destructivo que arrasa una zona.

Rule.Original: A faintly glowing crystal that hums with energy.\n\nIt can be consumed to awaken the user's psychic potential, granting them the ability to use psycasts. It can also be used by those who already have a psylink to increase their psylink level.
Rule.Raw: A faintly glowing crystal that hums with energy.\n\nIt can be consumed to awaken the user's psychic potential, granting them the ability to use psycasts. It can also be used by those who already have a psylink to increase their psylink level.
Rule.Translated: Un cristal de brillo tenue que vibra con energía.\n\nPuede consumirse para despertar el potencial psíquico del usuario y permitirle usar poderes psíquicos. Quienes ya tengan un psicoenlace pueden usarlo para aumentar su nivel.

Rule.Original: Use attunement crystal to form a psylink
Rule.Raw: Use attunement crystal to form a psylink
Rule.Translated: Usar cristal de sintonización para crear un psicoenlace

Rule.Original: A magic orb that pulses with a sinister power.\n\nIf used it will shatter, producing a terrifying shriek that will drive all animals in the region into a manhunting rage. Animals currently under your control will not be affected.
Rule.Raw: A magic orb that pulses with a sinister power.\n\nIf used it will shatter, producing a terrifying shriek that will drive all animals in the region into a manhunting rage. Animals currently under your control will not be affected.
Rule.Translated: Un orbe mágico que palpita con un poder siniestro.\n\nAl usarlo se rompe y emite un grito aterrador que vuelve cazahombres a todos los animales de la región. No afecta a los animales bajo tu control.

Rule.Original: A magic orb that pulses with a benevolent power.\n\nIf used it will shatter, producing a soothing wave that will give a temporary mood boost to everyone in the region.
Rule.Raw: A magic orb that pulses with a benevolent power.\n\nIf used it will shatter, producing a soothing wave that will give a temporary mood boost to everyone in the region.
Rule.Translated: Un orbe mágico que palpita con un poder benévolo.\n\nAl usarlo se rompe y emite una onda calmante que mejora temporalmente el ánimo de todos en la región.

Rule.Original: An ancient staff capable of casting a powerful spell, unfortunately it is mostly depleted of power and it will have limited uses.\n\nIt shocks the target's mind with chaotic images, causing temporary paralysis. There is a risk of brain damage. It has a long range, but requires line of sight.
Rule.Raw: An ancient staff capable of casting a powerful spell, unfortunately it is mostly depleted of power and it will have limited uses.\n\nIt shocks the target's mind with chaotic images, causing temporary paralysis. There is a risk of brain damage. It has a long range, but requires line of sight.
Rule.Translated: Un bastón antiguo capaz de lanzar un hechizo poderoso. Por desgracia, casi ha agotado su energía y tiene usos limitados.\n\nSacude la mente del objetivo con imágenes caóticas que causan parálisis temporal. Hay riesgo de daño cerebral. Tiene mucho alcance, pero necesita línea de visión.

Rule.Original: An ancient staff capable of casting a powerful spell, unfortunately it is mostly depleted of power and it will have limited uses.\n\nIt overwhelms to target's mind with disturbing visions, driving them into a berserk state. There is a risk of brain damage. It has a long range, but requires line of sight.
Rule.Raw: An ancient staff capable of casting a powerful spell, unfortunately it is mostly depleted of power and it will have limited uses.\n\nIt overwhelms to target's mind with disturbing visions, driving them into a berserk state. There is a risk of brain damage. It has a long range, but requires line of sight.
Rule.Translated: Un bastón antiguo capaz de lanzar un hechizo poderoso. Por desgracia, casi ha agotado su energía y tiene usos limitados.\n\nAbruma la mente del objetivo con visiones perturbadoras y lo vuelve berserker. Hay riesgo de daño cerebral. Tiene mucho alcance, pero necesita línea de visión.

Rule.Original: An unstable fire staff.\n\nIt fires out three explosive fireballs at a target location but will destroy itself in the process.
Rule.Raw: An unstable fire staff.\n\nIt fires out three explosive fireballs at a target location but will destroy itself in the process.
Rule.Translated: Un bastón de fuego inestable.\n\nLanza tres bolas de fuego explosivas hacia un lugar, pero se destruye en el proceso.
bastón de gran bola de fuego

Rule.Original: An unstable fire staff.\n\nIt fires out a single, highly destructive fireball at a target location but will destroy itself in the process.
Rule.Raw: An unstable fire staff.\n\nIt fires out a single, highly destructive fireball at a target location but will destroy itself in the process.
Rule.Translated: Un bastón de fuego inestable.\n\nLanza una única bola de fuego muy destructiva hacia un lugar, pero se destruye en el proceso.

Rule.Original:
A highly potent resurrection potion capable of bringing the dead back to life.

Unfortunately, those brought back may suffer from brain damage, blindness, or progressive madness. They will also experience mild amnesia, forgetting some recent memories and social interactions.

Outcomes are better when used on a fresher body. If a body is preserved, it can even be resurrected long after death.
Rule.Raw:
A highly potent resurrection potion capable of bringing the dead back to life.

Unfortunately, those brought back may suffer from brain damage, blindness, or progressive madness. They will also experience mild amnesia, forgetting some recent memories and social interactions.

Outcomes are better when used on a fresher body. If a body is preserved, it can even be resurrected long after death.
Rule.Translated:
Una poción de resurrección muy potente que devuelve la vida a los muertos.

Por desgracia, los resucitados pueden sufrir daño cerebral, ceguera o locura progresiva. También padecen amnesia leve y olvidan algunos recuerdos e interacciones sociales recientes.

Los resultados son mejores en cuerpos más recientes. Si se conserva el cuerpo, puede resucitarse incluso mucho después de la muerte.

Rule.Original: An ancient scroll containing details of long-forgotten secrets and scholarly pursuits.\n\nThe scroll can be used to instantly complete an ongoing research project but will crumble to dust upon use.
Rule.Raw: An ancient scroll containing details of long-forgotten secrets and scholarly pursuits.\n\nThe scroll can be used to instantly complete an ongoing research project but will crumble to dust upon use.
Rule.Translated: Un pergamino antiguo con secretos olvidados y conocimientos académicos.\n\nPuede completar al instante una investigación en curso, pero se deshace en polvo al usarlo.

Rule.Original:
An ominous alchemical concoction containing the blood of a demon.

Consuming this potion will grant demonic strength, improving all bodily functions and even allowing old scars or brain damage to heal.

Unfortunately, the change is permanent and anyone that consumes demon blood will need more every five or six days otherwise they will descend into madness, causing continuous berserk rages and eventually, death.
Rule.Raw:
An ominous alchemical concoction containing the blood of a demon.

Consuming this potion will grant demonic strength, improving all bodily functions and even allowing old scars or brain damage to heal.

Unfortunately, the change is permanent and anyone that consumes demon blood will need more every five or six days otherwise they will descend into madness, causing continuous berserk rages and eventually, death.
Rule.Translated:
Un ominoso preparado alquímico con sangre de demonio.

Concede fuerza demoníaca, mejora todas las funciones corporales e incluso permite curar cicatrices antiguas y daño cerebral.

Por desgracia, el cambio es permanente. Quien beba sangre demoníaca necesitará más cada cinco o seis días; de lo contrario, caerá en la locura, sufrirá ataques berserker continuos y acabará muriendo.

Rule.Original: Demon blood is coursing through the veins, improving the body's functioning in all respects.\n\nIf the demon blood is not regularly replenished, the user will rapidly descend into madness, causing continuous berserk rages and eventually, death.
Rule.Raw: Demon blood is coursing through the veins, improving the body's functioning in all respects.\n\nIf the demon blood is not regularly replenished, the user will rapidly descend into madness, causing continuous berserk rages and eventually, death.
Rule.Translated: La sangre demoníaca corre por las venas y mejora todas las funciones del cuerpo.\n\nSi no se repone con regularidad, el usuario caerá rápidamente en la locura, sufrirá ataques berserker continuos y acabará muriendo.

Rule.Original: Demon blood is coursing through this person's veins, improving all bodily functions.\n\nHowever, if it is not regularly replenished, they will rapidly descend into madness, causing continuous berserk rages and eventually, death.
Rule.Raw: Demon blood is coursing through this person's veins, improving all bodily functions.\n\nHowever, if it is not regularly replenished, they will rapidly descend into madness, causing continuous berserk rages and eventually, death.
Rule.Translated: La sangre demoníaca corre por las venas de esta persona y mejora todas sus funciones corporales.\n\nSin embargo, si no se repone con regularidad, caerá rápidamente en la locura, sufrirá ataques berserker continuos y acabará muriendo.

Rule.Original: Once consumed, the need for demon blood can never be removed.\n\nIf not regularly replenished, typically every five to six days, it will cause a rapid descent into madness.
Rule.Raw: Once consumed, the need for demon blood can never be removed.\n\nIf not regularly replenished, typically every five to six days, it will cause a rapid descent into madness.
Rule.Translated: Una vez consumida, la necesidad de sangre demoníaca nunca desaparece.\n\nSi no se repone con regularidad, normalmente cada cinco o seis días, provoca una rápida caída en la locura.

Rule.Original: A sealed box of medical supplies consisting of gemstones imbued with healing magic, rare medicinal herbs, conconctions and salves aswell as the finest quality medical tools and equipment.
Rule.Raw: A sealed box of medical supplies consisting of gemstones imbued with healing magic, rare medicinal herbs, conconctions and salves aswell as the finest quality medical tools and equipment.
Rule.Translated: Una caja sellada de suministros médicos con gemas imbuidas de magia curativa, hierbas medicinales raras, preparados y ungüentos, además de herramientas y equipos médicos de la mejor calidad.

Rule.Original: A magic talisman that will shield its holder from ranged attacks, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat.\n\nThe shield will break if it takes too much damage and can be instantly nullified by EMP damage
Rule.Raw: A magic talisman that will shield its holder from ranged attacks, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat.\n\nThe shield will break if it takes too much damage and can be instantly nullified by EMP damage
Rule.Translated: Un talismán mágico que protege de los ataques a distancia, pero no del combate cuerpo a cuerpo ni del calor.\n\nEl escudo se rompe si recibe demasiado daño y queda anulado inmediatamente por daño PEM

Rule.Original: A large, ornate longsword adorned with magic runes. It is lighter than it looks with a razor sharp edge capable of slicing through even the toughest armor with ease.
Rule.Raw: A large, ornate longsword adorned with magic runes. It is lighter than it looks with a razor sharp edge capable of slicing through even the toughest armor with ease.
Rule.Translated: Una espada larga, grande y ornamentada, adornada con runas mágicas. Es más ligera de lo que parece y su filo puede atravesar con facilidad incluso las armaduras más resistentes.

Rule.Original: An imposing warhammer imbued with lightning magic. Upon impact, it blasts the target with a burst of electricity in addition to physical damage.
Rule.Raw: An imposing warhammer imbued with lightning magic. Upon impact, it blasts the target with a burst of electricity in addition to physical damage.
Rule.Translated: Un imponente martillo de guerra imbuido de magia eléctrica. Al impactar, descarga electricidad además del daño físico.

Rule.Original: A curved sword with a blade composed of scorching magma. Targets struck with this weapon have a chance of being burned or ignited.
Rule.Raw: A curved sword with a blade composed of scorching magma. Targets struck with this weapon have a chance of being burned or ignited.
Rule.Translated: Una espada curva cuya hoja está formada por magma abrasador. Sus golpes pueden quemar o prender fuego al objetivo.

Rule.Original:
A large, ornate longsword adorned with magic runes. It is lighter than it looks with a razor sharp edge capable of slicing through even the toughest armor with ease.

This weapon is possessed by an ancient spirit and will exhibit some of their traits. The spirit will bond with the first person to wield it and thereafter, refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

When wielded by the bonded person, the spirit will augment their combat abilities, allowing them to attack with greater ferocity, speed and accuracy than ever before.
Rule.Raw:
A large, ornate longsword adorned with magic runes. It is lighter than it looks with a razor sharp edge capable of slicing through even the toughest armor with ease.

This weapon is possessed by an ancient spirit and will exhibit some of their traits. The spirit will bond with the first person to wield it and thereafter, refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

When wielded by the bonded person, the spirit will augment their combat abilities, allowing them to attack with greater ferocity, speed and accuracy than ever before.
Rule.Translated:
Una espada larga, grande y ornamentada, adornada con runas mágicas. Es más ligera de lo que parece y su filo puede atravesar con facilidad incluso las armaduras más resistentes.

Esta arma está poseída por un espíritu antiguo y manifiesta algunos de sus rasgos. El espíritu se vincula a la primera persona que la empuñe y luego rechaza a cualquier otra.

En manos de la persona vinculada, mejora sus capacidades de combate para que ataque con más ferocidad, velocidad y precisión que nunca.

When wielded by the bonded person, the spirit will augment their combat abilities, allowing them to attack with greater ferocity, speed and accuracy than ever before.

Una espada curva cuya hoja está formada por magma abrasador. Sus golpes pueden quemar o prender fuego al objetivo.

Esta arma está poseída por un espíritu antiguo y manifiesta algunos de sus rasgos. El espíritu se vincula a la primera persona que la empuñe y luego rechaza a cualquier otra.
