Rule.Original: An intricate circlet bearing a magic gemstone.\n\nIt provides no physical protection, but will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: An intricate circlet bearing a magic gemstone.\n\nIt provides no physical protection, but will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Una diadema elaborada con una gema mágica.\n\nNo ofrece protección física, pero aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del portador y ayuda a disipar el calor neural.

Rule.Original: An ornate, lightweight helmet bearing a magic gemstone.\n\nWhile it provides little physical protection, it will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: An ornate, lightweight helmet bearing a magic gemstone.\n\nWhile it provides little physical protection, it will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Un yelmo ligero y ornamentado con una gema mágica.\n\nAunque ofrece poca protección física, aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del portador y ayuda a disipar el calor neural.

Rule.Original: An intricately designed tunic made to improve a psycaster's focus.\n\nIt will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: An intricately designed tunic made to improve a psycaster's focus.\n\nIt will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Una túnica elaborada para mejorar la concentración de quien usa poderes psíquicos.\n\nAumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del portador y ayuda a disipar el calor neural.

Rule.Original: An intricately designed vest made to improve a psycaster's focus.\n\nIt will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: An intricately designed vest made to improve a psycaster's focus.\n\nIt will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Un chaleco elaborado para mejorar la concentración de quien usa poderes psíquicos.\n\nAumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del portador y ayuda a disipar el calor neural.

Rule.Original: An intricately designed robe made to improve a psycaster's focus.\n\nIt will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Raw: An intricately designed robe made to improve a psycaster's focus.\n\nIt will enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
Rule.Translated: Un manto elaborado para mejorar la concentración de quien usa poderes psíquicos.\n\nAumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del portador y ayuda a disipar el calor neural.

Rule.Original: An ornate staff bearing a large, magic crystal.\n\nWhile it can be used as melee weapon, its main purpose is to enhance the wielder's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat, allowing more use of psycasts.
Rule.Raw: An ornate staff bearing a large, magic crystal.\n\nWhile it can be used as melee weapon, its main purpose is to enhance the wielder's psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat, allowing more use of psycasts.
Rule.Translated: Un bastón ornamentado con un gran cristal mágico.\n\nPuede usarse como arma cuerpo a cuerpo, pero su finalidad principal es aumentar la sensibilidad psíquica y ayudar a disipar el calor neural para usar más poderes psíquicos.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon will increase the wielders psychic sensitivity by 40%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon will increase the wielders psychic sensitivity by 40%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del portador un 40%. Solo se aplica mientras la empuña.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon will increase the wielders psychic sensitivity by 20%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon will increase the wielders psychic sensitivity by 20%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma aumenta la sensibilidad psíquica del portador un 20%. Solo se aplica mientras la empuña.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon will decrease the wielders psychic sensitivity by 30%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon will decrease the wielders psychic sensitivity by 30%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma reduce la sensibilidad psíquica del portador un 30%. Solo se aplica mientras la empuña.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon will reduce the wielders psychic sensitivity by 15%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon will reduce the wielders psychic sensitivity by 15%. This only applies when the weapon is held.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma reduce la sensibilidad psíquica del portador un 15%. Solo se aplica mientras la empuña.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is kind and supportive. It whispers kind thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, increasing their mood.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is kind and supportive. It whispers kind thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, increasing their mood.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma es amable y comprensivo. Susurra pensamientos bondadosos a la persona vinculada y mejora su ánimo.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is relaxed and steady. It whispers calming thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, increasing their mood.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is relaxed and steady. It whispers calming thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, increasing their mood.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma es tranquilo y estable. Susurra pensamientos relajantes a la persona vinculada y mejora su ánimo.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is neurotic and unstable. It mutters mad thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, suppressing their mood.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is neurotic and unstable. It mutters mad thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, suppressing their mood.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma es neurótico e inestable. Murmura pensamientos insensatos a la persona vinculada y empeora su ánimo.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is highly disturbed and manic. It wails mad notions to whoever it is bonded with, suppressing their mood.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is highly disturbed and manic. It wails mad notions to whoever it is bonded with, suppressing their mood.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma está muy perturbado y es maníaco. Grita ideas delirantes a la persona vinculada y empeora su ánimo.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is hungry for mortal souls. If this weapon kills someone, it will absorb a portion of their soul, restoring 20% of the wielder's psyfocus.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is hungry for mortal souls. If this weapon kills someone, it will absorb a portion of their soul, restoring 20% of the wielder's psyfocus.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma ansía almas mortales. Si el arma mata a alguien, absorbe parte de su alma y restaura un 20% de la psicoconcentración del portador.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is bloodthirsty and loves nothing more than taking lives. If this weapon kills someone, its joy will be felt by the wielder, making them happier for a few days.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is bloodthirsty and loves nothing more than taking lives. If this weapon kills someone, its joy will be felt by the wielder, making them happier for a few days.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma es sanguinario y adora matar. Si el arma mata a alguien, el portador siente su alegría y mejora su ánimo durante varios días.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon hates conflict and bloodshed. If this weapon kills someone, its sorrow will be felt by the wielder, reducing their mood for a few days.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon hates conflict and bloodshed. If this weapon kills someone, its sorrow will be felt by the wielder, reducing their mood for a few days.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma odia el conflicto y el derramamiento de sangre. Si el arma mata a alguien, el portador siente su pena y empeora su ánimo durante varios días.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon finds purpose in bloodshed. If it does not kill for 20 days, its will become restless and angry. This will be felt by the wielder, reducing their mood until the weapon kills again.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon finds purpose in bloodshed. If it does not kill for 20 days, its will become restless and angry. This will be felt by the wielder, reducing their mood until the weapon kills again.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma encuentra propósito en el derramamiento de sangre. Si no mata durante 20 días, se vuelve inquieto y furioso. El portador lo siente y su ánimo empeora hasta que el arma vuelve a matar.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is naturally meditative and helps its wielder focus during meditation. The wielder gains an extra 10% psyfocus per day whilst meditating, as long as the weapon is held.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is naturally meditative and helps its wielder focus during meditation. The wielder gains an extra 10% psyfocus per day whilst meditating, as long as the weapon is held.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma es meditativo y ayuda al portador a concentrarse al meditar. Gana un 10% adicional de psicoconcentración diaria durante la meditación mientras empuña el arma.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon revels in agony, as long as the weapon is held it will take the pain on behalf of the wielder.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon revels in agony, as long as the weapon is held it will take the pain on behalf of the wielder.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma disfruta la agonía y asume el dolor del portador mientras este la empuña.

Rule.Original: No pain is felt as it is being absorbed by the wielded weapon.
Rule.Raw: No pain is felt as it is being absorbed by the wielded weapon.
Rule.Translated: No se siente dolor porque lo absorbe el arma empuñada.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon is energetic and hyperactive. It confers this onto the wielder, making them move 15% faster as long as the weapon is held.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon is energetic and hyperactive. It confers this onto the wielder, making them move 15% faster as long as the weapon is held.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma es enérgico e hiperactivo. Transmite esa energía al portador y le permite moverse un 15% más rápido mientras la empuña.

Rule.Original: Movement is sped up by the influence of a wielded weapon.
Rule.Raw: Movement is sped up by the influence of a wielded weapon.
Rule.Translated: El movimiento se acelera por la influencia del arma empuñada.

Rule.Original: Although long dead, the spirit residing within this weapon was a glutton for food in life. This will be felt by whoever bonds with it, increasing their hunger rate by 50%.
Rule.Raw: Although long dead, the spirit residing within this weapon was a glutton for food in life. This will be felt by whoever bonds with it, increasing their hunger rate by 50%.
Rule.Translated: Aunque murió hace mucho, el espíritu de esta arma era glotón en vida. La persona vinculada lo siente y su ritmo de hambre aumenta un 50%.

Rule.Original: Hunger is increased by the influence of a wielded weapon.
Rule.Raw: Hunger is increased by the influence of a wielded weapon.
Rule.Translated: El hambre aumenta por la influencia del arma empuñada.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon will absorb some of the neural heat generated by it's wielder, increasing neural heat dissipation by 0.15 per second.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon will absorb some of the neural heat generated by it's wielder, increasing neural heat dissipation by 0.15 per second.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma absorbe parte del calor neural del portador y aumenta su disipación en 0.15 por segundo.

Rule.Original: neural heat dissipation is improved by the influence of a wielded weapon.
Rule.Raw: neural heat dissipation is improved by the influence of a wielded weapon.
Rule.Translated: La disipación de calor neural mejora por la influencia del arma empuñada.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon becomes angry when the bonded individual uses another weapon. This will be felt by the bonded person, reducing their mood.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon becomes angry when the bonded individual uses another weapon. This will be felt by the bonded person, reducing their mood.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma se enfada cuando la persona vinculada usa otra arma. Esa persona siente su enfado y su ánimo empeora.

Rule.Original: The spirit residing within this weapon does not form bonds like others do, allowing anyone to wield it.
Rule.Raw: The spirit residing within this weapon does not form bonds like others do, allowing anyone to wield it.
Rule.Translated: El espíritu de esta arma no forma vínculos como los demás, por lo que cualquiera puede empuñarla.

Rule.Original: Ancient texts. They can be deciphered to reveal long-forgotten information.
Rule.Raw: Ancient texts. They can be deciphered to reveal long-forgotten information.
Rule.Translated: Textos antiguos que pueden descifrarse para revelar información olvidada.

Rule.Original: An ancient tablet. It can be studied to reveal long-forgotten information.
Rule.Raw: An ancient tablet. It can be studied to reveal long-forgotten information.
Rule.Translated: Una tablilla antigua que puede estudiarse para revelar información olvidada.

Rule.Original: A pedestal conspicuously displaying what appears to be valuable items, you have a feeling there is more to this pedestal than meets the eye
Rule.Raw: A pedestal conspicuously displaying what appears to be valuable items, you have a feeling there is more to this pedestal than meets the eye
Rule.Translated: Un pedestal que exhibe objetos aparentemente valiosos. Tienes la impresión de que oculta más de lo que parece

Rule.Original: An ancient loot chest that has not yet been opened, it may contain valuable items.
Rule.Raw: An ancient loot chest that has not yet been opened, it may contain valuable items.
Rule.Translated: Un cofre antiguo sin abrir que puede contener objetos valiosos.

Rule.Original: A large, ancient lockbox. Closer inspection reveals a trap trigger, attempting to open the lockbox will probably trigger some sort of alarm.
Rule.Raw: A large, ancient lockbox. Closer inspection reveals a trap trigger, attempting to open the lockbox will probably trigger some sort of alarm.
Rule.Translated: Una gran caja fuerte antigua. Un examen más atento revela un mecanismo de trampa; intentar abrirla probablemente activará alguna alarma.

Rule.Original: An ancient sarcophagus. It is sealed shut, suggesting that it has an occupant, surely they are long dead.
Rule.Raw: An ancient sarcophagus. It is sealed shut, suggesting that it has an occupant, surely they are long dead.
Rule.Translated: Un sarcófago antiguo cerrado herméticamente, lo que sugiere que contiene un ocupante. Seguro que murió hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An ancient sarcophagus. It has been magically sealed, who knows what it could contain.
Rule.Raw: An ancient sarcophagus. It has been magically sealed, who knows what it could contain.
Rule.Translated: Un sarcófago antiguo sellado con magia. Quién sabe qué contiene.

Rule.Original: An ancient brazier, it still has some weakly glowing embers and is emitting a small amount of light.
Rule.Raw: An ancient brazier, it still has some weakly glowing embers and is emitting a small amount of light.
Rule.Translated: Un brasero antiguo con algunas brasas de brillo tenue que todavía emite algo de luz.

Rule.Original: An ancient beacon, activating it may provide aid or attract the attention of nearby enemies.
Rule.Raw: An ancient beacon, activating it may provide aid or attract the attention of nearby enemies.
Rule.Translated: Una baliza antigua. Activarla puede proporcionar ayuda o llamar la atención de enemigos cercanos.

Rule.Original: A sealed barrel containing a highly flammable substance, disturbing it may cause it to explode.
Rule.Raw: A sealed barrel containing a highly flammable substance, disturbing it may cause it to explode.
Rule.Translated: Un barril sellado con una sustancia muy inflamable. Manipularlo puede hacerlo explotar.

Rule.Original: An ancient embalming table, it clearly hasn't been used in a very long time.
Rule.Raw: An ancient embalming table, it clearly hasn't been used in a very long time.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa de embalsamamiento antigua que claramente lleva mucho tiempo sin usarse.

Rule.Original: A large, ancient shrine. It may have once been used for performing ancient rituals or perhaps it was just someone's dinner table, we will never know.
Rule.Raw: A large, ancient shrine. It may have once been used for performing ancient rituals or perhaps it was just someone's dinner table, we will never know.
Rule.Translated: Un gran santuario antiguo. Quizá sirvió para rituales antiguos o quizá era la mesa de alguien; nunca lo sabremos.

Rule.Original: An ancient cage once used to contain animals or perhaps unlucky prisoners, it is deteriorated and falling apart.
Rule.Raw: An ancient cage once used to contain animals or perhaps unlucky prisoners, it is deteriorated and falling apart.
Rule.Translated: Una jaula antigua para animales o prisioneros desafortunados. Está deteriorada y se desmorona.

Rule.Original: An old chest that has been smashed open, if it once contained valuable items they are long gone.
Rule.Raw: An old chest that has been smashed open, if it once contained valuable items they are long gone.
Rule.Translated: Un cofre antiguo roto. Si alguna vez contuvo objetos valiosos, desaparecieron hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An ancient bed. Though unconfortable, it can still be used.
Rule.Raw: An ancient bed. Though unconfortable, it can still be used.
Rule.Translated: Una cama antigua. Aunque incómoda, todavía puede usarse.

Rule.Original: An ancient weapon rack, any remaining weapons are either broken beyond repair or too deteriorated to be useful
Rule.Raw: An ancient weapon rack, any remaining weapons are either broken beyond repair or too deteriorated to be useful
Rule.Translated: Un armero antiguo. Las armas restantes están rotas sin posibilidad de reparación o demasiado deterioradas para usarse

Rule.Original: An ancient table and chest, if they once contained anything of value it is long gone.
Rule.Raw: An ancient table and chest, if they once contained anything of value it is long gone.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa y un cofre antiguos. Si alguna vez guardaron algo valioso, desapareció hace mucho.

Rule.Original: An ancient wooden barrel, it contains nothing but a small pool of stagnant water.
Rule.Raw: An ancient wooden barrel, it contains nothing but a small pool of stagnant water.
Rule.Translated: Un barril de madera antiguo que solo contiene un poco de agua estancada.

Rule.Original: An ancient power generator of some sort, its inner workings are a mystery as most parts have been looted or deteriorated beyond recongnition .
Rule.Raw: An ancient power generator of some sort, its inner workings are a mystery as most parts have been looted or deteriorated beyond recongnition .
Rule.Translated: Algún tipo de generador antiguo. Su funcionamiento es un misterio: la mayoría de sus piezas fueron saqueadas o se deterioraron hasta ser irreconocibles.

Rule.Original: An defensive fortification for stopping mounted infantry. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Raw: An defensive fortification for stopping mounted infantry. It's been deteriorating for many years.
Rule.Translated: Una fortificación defensiva para detener soldados montados. Lleva muchos años deteriorándose.

Rule.Original: An ancient cobblestone wall, it has stood the test of time and is mostly intact.
Rule.Raw: An ancient cobblestone wall, it has stood the test of time and is mostly intact.
Rule.Translated: Un muro de adoquines antiguo que ha resistido el paso del tiempo y sigue casi intacto.

Rule.Original: The remains of an ancient stone wall.
Rule.Raw: The remains of an ancient stone wall.
Rule.Translated: Los restos de un muro de piedra antiguo.

Rule.Original: An ancient ballista, its mechanical parts are completely siezed and the rest is heavily deteriorated beyond repair.
Rule.Raw: An ancient ballista, its mechanical parts are completely siezed and the rest is heavily deteriorated beyond repair.
Rule.Translated: Una balista antigua. Sus mecanismos están completamente atascados y el resto está demasiado deteriorado para repararse.

Rule.Original: Ancient ballista bolts, they are far too rusty and degraded to be of use.
Rule.Raw: Ancient ballista bolts, they are far too rusty and degraded to be of use.
Rule.Translated: Proyectiles de balista antiguos, demasiado oxidados y deteriorados para usarse.

Rule.Original: An ancient barricade once used as a defensive fortification.
Rule.Raw: An ancient barricade once used as a defensive fortification.
Rule.Translated: Una barricada antigua que se usó como fortificación defensiva.

Rule.Original: An ancient outpost that may contain treasure.
Rule.Raw: An ancient outpost that may contain treasure.
Rule.Translated: Un puesto avanzado antiguo que puede contener un tesoro.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You've recieved word of an ancient outpost nearby. It is believed to contain ancient texts that may have information about [relic_name].

If you can break in and decipher the ancient texts inside, you can collect the information.

Watch out - there may be all manner of dangers inside, and other enemies may also be attracted by activity at the location.
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->You've recieved word of an ancient outpost nearby. It is believed to contain ancient texts that may have information about [relic_name].

If you can break in and decipher the ancient texts inside, you can collect the information.

Watch out - there may be all manner of dangers inside, and other enemies may also be attracted by activity at the location.
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->Has recibido noticias de un puesto avanzado antiguo cercano. Se cree que contiene textos antiguos con información sobre [relic_name].

Si consigues entrar y descifrarlos, podrás obtener esa información.

Ten cuidado: puede haber toda clase de peligros dentro y tu actividad allí podría atraer a otros enemigos.

Rule.Original: allTerminalsHackedMessage->You've deciphered all ancient texts and discovered secret information about [relic_name]! You can now leave.
Rule.Raw: allTerminalsHackedMessage->You've deciphered all ancient texts and discovered secret information about [relic_name]! You can now leave.
Rule.Translated: allTerminalsHackedMessage->¡Has descifrado todos los textos antiguos y descubierto información secreta sobre [relic_name]! Ya puedes marcharte.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You've received word of a stolen airship on the run from the empire. it may contain records with information about [relic_name]. You can signal the fugitive pilot to land at [map_definite].

To get the records, you'll have to search the airship. Searching takes time, but colonists strong in intellectual skill can find the correct records faster.[raidsDescription]

The airship has sustained heavy damage is likely to explode in [destroyDelayTicks_duration].
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->You've received word of a stolen airship on the run from the empire. it may contain records with information about [relic_name]. You can signal the fugitive pilot to land at [map_definite].

To get the records, you'll have to search the airship. Searching takes time, but colonists strong in intellectual skill can find the correct records faster.[raidsDescription]

The airship has sustained heavy damage is likely to explode in [destroyDelayTicks_duration].
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->Has recibido noticias de un dirigible robado que huye del imperio. Puede contener registros con información sobre [relic_name]. Puedes señalar al piloto fugitivo que aterrice en [map_definite].

Para obtener los registros, tendrás que registrar el dirigible. Lleva tiempo, pero los colonos con buena habilidad intelectual encontrarán los documentos más rápido.[raidsDescription]

El dirigible ha sufrido daños graves y probablemente explotará en [destroyDelayTicks_duration].

Rule.Original: raidsDescription(allowViolence==true)->\n\n[enemyFaction_pawnsPlural] from [enemyFaction_name] will spot the airship during its decent. As long as it's present, they'll send attackers approximately every [raidIntervalAvg_duration] to destroy it and steal the treasure they think it contains. You will have some time to prepare defenses around it before they arrive.
Rule.Raw: raidsDescription(allowViolence==true)->\n\n[enemyFaction_pawnsPlural] from [enemyFaction_name] will spot the airship during its decent. As long as it's present, they'll send attackers approximately every [raidIntervalAvg_duration] to destroy it and steal the treasure they think it contains. You will have some time to prepare defenses around it before they arrive.
Rule.Translated: raidsDescription(allowViolence==true)->\n\n[enemyFaction_pawnsPlural] de [enemyFaction_name] avistarán el dirigible durante su descenso. Mientras permanezca allí, enviarán atacantes aproximadamente cada [raidIntervalAvg_duration] para destruirlo y robar el tesoro que creen que contiene. Tendrás algo de tiempo para preparar defensas antes de que lleguen.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->You've recieved word of an ancient structure nearby that might contain treasure.

You can break in to collect the loot inside.

Be warned - these kinds of structures can contain a variety of threats. In addition, your activity at the location might draw unwanted attention.
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->You've recieved word of an ancient structure nearby that might contain treasure.

You can break in to collect the loot inside.

Be warned - these kinds of structures can contain a variety of threats. In addition, your activity at the location might draw unwanted attention.
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->Has recibido noticias de una estructura antigua cercana que podría contener un tesoro.

Puedes entrar para recoger el botín de su interior.

Ten cuidado: estas estructuras pueden contener amenazas diversas. Además, tu actividad allí podría atraer atención no deseada.

Rule.Original:
questDescription->[asker_nameDef], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] of [asker_faction_name], has discovered an ancient stronghold a long distance away. [asker_pronoun] believes it contains ancient texts that may have information about the relic known as [relic_name].

[asker_nameDef] can't spare people to look into it, but hopes you can help by supplying exactly [colonistCount] [colonistsSingularOrPlural] to carry out the investigation.

The stronghold contains unknown threats and is also being sought by [asker_nameDef]'s enemies, [enemyFaction_name].

[asker_pronoun] will send an airship to pick up your colonists, bring them to the location, and take them home afterward. They will be fed and tended to en-route.

Once you have landed, you must decipher all ancient texts in the stronghold within [timeoutTicks_duration].
Rule.Raw:
questDescription->[asker_nameDef], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] of [asker_faction_name], has discovered an ancient stronghold a long distance away. [asker_pronoun] believes it contains ancient texts that may have information about the relic known as [relic_name].

[asker_nameDef] can't spare people to look into it, but hopes you can help by supplying exactly [colonistCount] [colonistsSingularOrPlural] to carry out the investigation.

The stronghold contains unknown threats and is also being sought by [asker_nameDef]'s enemies, [enemyFaction_name].

[asker_pronoun] will send an airship to pick up your colonists, bring them to the location, and take them home afterward. They will be fed and tended to en-route.

Once you have landed, you must decipher all ancient texts in the stronghold within [timeoutTicks_duration].
Rule.Translated:
questDescription->[asker_nameDef], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] de [asker_faction_name], ha descubierto un bastión antiguo muy lejano. [asker_pronoun] cree que contiene textos antiguos con información sobre la reliquia [relic_name].

[asker_nameDef] no puede enviar gente a investigarlo, pero espera que aportes exactamente [colonistCount] [colonistsSingularOrPlural] para hacerlo.

El bastión contiene amenazas desconocidas y también lo buscan los enemigos de [asker_nameDef], [enemyFaction_name].

[asker_pronoun] enviará un dirigible para recoger a tus colonos, llevarlos al lugar y devolverlos a casa después. Durante el viaje recibirán comida y atención médica.

Tras aterrizar, debes descifrar todos los textos antiguos del bastión en [timeoutTicks_duration].

Rule.Original: passengersIncapableOfHackingDialogText->The airship for the quest '[resolvedQuestName]' has no passenger capable of deciphering. You must send at least one person capable of deciphering to investigate the ancient stronghold.
Rule.Raw: passengersIncapableOfHackingDialogText->The airship for the quest '[resolvedQuestName]' has no passenger capable of deciphering. You must send at least one person capable of deciphering to investigate the ancient stronghold.
Rule.Translated: passengersIncapableOfHackingDialogText->El dirigible de la misión '[resolvedQuestName]' no tiene ningún pasajero capaz de descifrar textos. Debes enviar al menos a una persona con esa capacidad para investigar el bastión antiguo.

Rule.Original: questDescription->You've recieved word of an ancient tablet that may provide insight about the [relic_name]. However, the tablet is surrounded by a tribal village, and the locals venerate it. They aren't part of any major faction.\n\n[visitInfo]
Rule.Raw: questDescription->You've recieved word of an ancient tablet that may provide insight about the [relic_name]. However, the tablet is surrounded by a tribal village, and the locals venerate it. They aren't part of any major faction.\n\n[visitInfo]
Rule.Translated: questDescription->Has recibido noticias de una tablilla antigua que podría revelar información sobre [relic_name]. Sin embargo, se encuentra en una aldea tribal cuyos habitantes la veneran. No pertenecen a ninguna facción importante.\n\n[visitInfo]

Rule.Original:
visitInfo(allowViolentQuests==true)->They are willing to let you visit on the pretense of worshipping it, but they will attack if you touch it.

You can attack the village from the outside, or enter peacefully and try to quickly escape with the information.

Beware - If you spend over [timer_duration] in the village or build anything near it, the locals will attack, and call reinforcements.
Rule.Raw:
visitInfo(allowViolentQuests==true)->They are willing to let you visit on the pretense of worshipping it, but they will attack if you touch it.

You can attack the village from the outside, or enter peacefully and try to quickly escape with the information.

Beware - If you spend over [timer_duration] in the village or build anything near it, the locals will attack, and call reinforcements.
Rule.Translated:
visitInfo(allowViolentQuests==true)->Te permiten visitarla con el pretexto de rendirle culto, pero atacarán si la tocas.

Puedes atacar la aldea desde fuera o entrar pacíficamente e intentar escapar rápidamente con la información.

Ten cuidado: si pasas más de [timer_duration] en la aldea o construyes algo cerca, los habitantes atacarán y pedirán refuerzos.

Rule.Original: visitInfo(allowViolentQuests==false)->They are willing to let you visit.
Rule.Raw: visitInfo(allowViolentQuests==false)->They are willing to let you visit.

Rule.Original: terminalHackedMessage->Tablet investigated. You've gathered information and can now leave.
Rule.Raw: terminalHackedMessage->Tablet investigated. You've gathered information and can now leave.
Rule.Translated: terminalHackedMessage->Tablilla investigada. Has obtenido la información y ya puedes marcharte.

Rule.Original: An airship commonly used by the empire for long distance travel.
Rule.Raw: An airship commonly used by the empire for long distance travel.
Rule.Translated: Un dirigible que el imperio usa habitualmente para viajar largas distancias.

Rule.Original: Call an airship for your own use. It will transport colonists, items, and animals anywhere you like within 70 world tiles.
Rule.Raw: Call an airship for your own use. It will transport colonists, items, and animals anywhere you like within 70 world tiles.
Rule.Translated: Solicita un dirigible para tu uso. Puede transportar colonos, objetos y animales a cualquier lugar a un máximo de 70 casillas del mapa mundial.

Rule.Original: A stolen airship containing records kept by the empire.
Rule.Raw: A stolen airship containing records kept by the empire.
Rule.Translated: Un dirigible robado que contiene registros del imperio.

Rule.Original: A small hot air balloon capable of carrying people, items, or animals. Can be used for sending gifts, transporting people or supplies, surprise attacks, or reinforcing battles
Rule.Raw: A small hot air balloon capable of carrying people, items, or animals. Can be used for sending gifts, transporting people or supplies, surprise attacks, or reinforcing battles
Rule.Translated: Un pequeño globo aerostático que transporta personas, objetos o animales. Sirve para enviar regalos, transportar gente o suministros, lanzar ataques sorpresa o reforzar batallas

Rule.Original: A small hot air balloon capable of carrying people, items, or animals. Can be used for sending gifts, transporting people or supplies, surprise attacks, or reinforcing battles

Rule.Original: Tailor noble-specific apparel like formal shirts and royal robes.
Rule.Raw: Tailor noble-specific apparel like formal shirts and royal robes.
Rule.Translated: Confecciona ropa para nobles, como camisas formales y mantos reales.

Rule.Original: Craft the harpsichord, a complex stationary musical instrument.
Rule.Raw: Craft the harpsichord, a complex stationary musical instrument.
Rule.Translated: Fabrica el clavecín, un complejo instrumento musical fijo.

Rule.Original: The noise caused by your mining have grabbed the attention of some underground dwellers. Now they're tunneling upwards to seek revenge!\n\nBeware - unkown entities have been angered and will try to destroy your base.
Rule.Raw: The noise caused by your mining have grabbed the attention of some underground dwellers. Now they're tunneling upwards to seek revenge!\n\nBeware - unkown entities have been angered and will try to destroy your base.
Rule.Translated: El ruido de la minería ha llamado la atención de algunos habitantes subterráneos. ¡Ahora excavan hacia la superficie para vengarse!\n\nTen cuidado: entidades desconocidas se han enfurecido e intentarán destruir tu base.

Rule.Original: Learn to craft more than the most basic of bows.
Rule.Raw: Learn to craft more than the most basic of bows.
Rule.Translated: Aprende a fabricar arcos más elaborados que los básicos.

Rule.Original: A simple bench with writing implements and simple measurement devices. This bench is essential in any study or library, scholars write here to pursue knowledge and discovery.
Rule.Raw: A simple bench with writing implements and simple measurement devices. This bench is essential in any study or library, scholars write here to pursue knowledge and discovery.
Rule.Translated: Una mesa sencilla con útiles de escritura e instrumentos de medición básicos. Es esencial en cualquier estudio o biblioteca: aquí escriben los eruditos para buscar conocimiento y descubrimientos.

Rule.Original: Planks are processed wood. It has been cut into more manageable sizes making it more manageable to build with.
Rule.Raw: Planks are processed wood. It has been cut into more manageable sizes making it more manageable to build with.
Rule.Translated: Los tablones son madera procesada cortada en tamaños más manejables para facilitar la construcción.

Rule.Original: Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items, as well as refines stone chunks into glass. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Raw: Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items, as well as refines stone chunks into glass. Consumes a lot of power.
Rule.Translated: Extrae metal aprovechable de escoria y otros objetos metálicos mezclados, y transforma bloques de roca en vidrio. Consume mucha energía.

Rule.Original: Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the torso, neck, shoulders and arms. Offers no leg protection.
Rule.Raw: Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the torso, neck, shoulders and arms. Offers no leg protection.
Rule.Translated: Placas de armadura superpuestas que cubren el torso, cuello, hombros y brazos. No protege las piernas.
punto de llegada de pacientes invitados
punto de entrega de recompensas del narrador

Total Capacity: 6

Rotate to change appearance.
